title: Assistant Manager, Enterprise Intelligence & Analytics
categories: Public Health, Hospitals and Health Care, and Hospitals
description:
Nestled in the heart of Tengah Forest Town, the new Tengah General and Community Hospital (TGCH) will be an exciting and innovative health campus with a comprehensive range of clinical specialties and healthcare services including emergency, inpatient, rehabilitative and outpatient specialist care.


As part of National University Health System (NUHS) cluster, this state-of-the-art facility is slated to be ready by early 2030s.


Intricately connected with the surrounding community, TGCH offers you the opportunity to create a healthcare facility of the future, tightly integrated with the residents and nature. As a people-focused organisation, we believe in respect and recognition. By harnessing the passion and strength of our team and putting them at the core of our culture, we create a nurturing environment to excel and deliver fulfilling care.


Be part of our groundbreaking team to bring our vision to life – a hospital in a forest, and a healing oasis within the hospital.


Join #TeamTengah #GrowWithUs #TGCH #TGCHFamily


Assistant Manager, Enterprise Intelligence & Analytics
(Tengah General and Community Hospital)


This is a foundational Digital, Data & Technology role responsible for building the enterprise data and analytics layer that will support TGCH’s Enterprise Planning Platform and future operational intelligence capabilities. The role will integrate data from multiple internal and external sources, convert them into trusted planning datasets and develop analytics outputs that support hospital planning, operational readiness and future data-driven operations.


In this role, you will connect data across demand, capacity, workforce, finance and operations so that TGCH can make better enterprise-level decisions from the planning phase through ramp-up and post go-live operations.


Job Responsibilities

- Identify, acquire, consolidate and manage data from multiple sources, including MOH and GCCP planning datasets, national census and demographic datasets, operational activity and utilisation datasets, workforce and HR datasets, financial datasets, and service, infrastructure and capacity planning datasets.
- Transform disparate data sources into structured, documented and reusable enterprise planning datasets, and support data governance, quality assurance, validation and version control processes.
- Conduct analyses to support demand forecasting, service planning, capacity planning, workforce planning and financial planning, and translate complex datasets into insights that inform strategic and operational decisions.
- Support the development of planning assumptions, scenario analyses and forecasting exercises, and assist in evaluating implications of demand changes, service redesign, policy shifts and operational strategies.
- Design, develop and maintain dashboards and visual analytics products for demand monitoring, capacity planning, workforce tracking, financial planning, operational readiness and enterprise performance monitoring.
- Support the development of TGCH’s Enterprise Planning Platform by preparing, structuring and maintaining the underlying data layer, integrating new data sources and developing analytical models and data structures required for planning use cases.
- Support the development of AI-enabled analytics and decision-support capabilities, and explore opportunities to leverage Generative AI, predictive analytics and machine learning, natural language query and search, retrieval-augmented workflows, process mining and pattern detection, and scenario modelling and simulation.
- Support analytics related to hospital commissioning, service activation and ramp-up planning, including workforce ramp-up, capacity monitoring and benefits realisation.
- Work with stakeholders across Enterprise Strategy & Planning, Clinical Services, Operations, Human Resources, Finance, IT and Digital teams, and cluster and system-level planning partners.
- Present analytical findings in a clear and practical manner and bridge business questions, data requirements and technology solutions.


Job Requirements

- Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Operations Research or a related discipline.
- 3 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, planning analytics, data integration or related disciplines.
- Experience working with large, complex or multi-source datasets. Experience in healthcare, public sector planning, infrastructure planning or complex operational environments would be advantageous.
- Strong SQL skills for querying, joining and managing datasets, with proficiency in Power BI, Tableau or equivalent data visualisation platforms.
- Working knowledge of Python, R or equivalent analytical tools, and strong Microsoft Excel and data modelling skills.
- Familiarity with data integration, ETL processes, statistical analysis, forecasting and scenario analysis.
- Familiarity with artificial intelligence, machine learning, Generative AI and modern analytics concepts would be advantageous.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, practical and actionable insights.
- Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with high ownership, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a dynamic planning environment.
- Candidates with more relevant experience may be considered for appointment at the Senior Assistant Manager level.

title: Principal Treasury Officer, Head of Treasury Strategic Planning and Middle Office(Based in Beijing)
description:
The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) is a multilateral development bank whose mission is financing Infrastructure for Tomorrow in Asia and beyond – infrastructure with sustainability at its core. We began operations in Beijing in 2016 and have since grown to 111 approved members worldwide. We are capitalized at USD100 billion and AAA-rated by the major international credit rating agencies. Collaborating with partners, AIIB meets clients' needs by unlocking new capital and investing in infrastructure that is green, technology-enabled, and promotes regional connectivity.


The Principal Treasury Officer, Head of Treasury Strategic Planning and Middle Office, is a senior leadership role within the Office of the Treasurer (TRE) at AIIB. The position serves as a strategic integrator across asset liability management (ALM), funding strategy, risk oversight, financial control, and treasury operations, directly supporting the delivery of AIIB's financial and balance sheet strategy.


Operating with a high degree of independence and decision authority, the role will lead a multifunctional team responsible for balance sheet management, long-term financial projections, performance analytics, first-line risk oversight, portfolio valuation, and treasury IT infrastructure. The position will provide core decision support to the treasurer, asset liability committee (ALCO), Chief Financial Officer (CFO), and senior governance committees, and will serve as a key interface with credit rating agencies, shareholders, and external counterparties.


Responsibilities:

- Lead the development and execution of AIIB's balance sheet strategy within the ALM policy framework, driving cross-departmental collaboration across treasury, finance, and risk.
- Direct medium- and long-term cash flow forecasting (contractual and behavioral), including modeling, analysis, projection, and stress testing, to ensure compliance with liquidity policies and limits.
- Own and maintain the Bank's long-term financial projections (LTFP) model, providing strategic decision support for business planning, capital allocation, and budgeting.
- Shape ALM strategies and guidelines, exercising independent judgment on interest rate risk, refinancing risk, currency risk, and liquidity risk positioning.
- Provide strategic advice on hedging, pricing, and structuring for client operations, including flexible financing products, local currency lending, structured finance, and loan syndications.
- Lead treasury's first-line risk oversight function, ensuring compliance of all treasury portfolios to credit, market, and liquidity risk limits.
- Direct the treasury valuation and collateral management functions, including modeling and pricing of the Bank's financial instruments, and monitoring of collateral activity.
- Ensure Credit Support Annex terms are met, and directly manage collateral posted as independent amount. Lead treasury in CSA negotiations with counterparties.
- Monitor and report on the performance of all assets in the treasury management system at the portfolio level.
- Maintain valuation integrity across all treasury positions, coordinating with risk management on model validation.

title: Business Development Manager - Fertilizers
description:
We are looking for a qualified Business Developer to join our growing team in Singapore. This role will suit an outgoing person who is customer-focused, energized by commercial interactions, enjoys solving problems, is comfortable cold-calling and enjoys extensive traveling within Asia / the Middle East. 

The ideal candidate is a subject matter expert on commodity pricing and fertilizer markets to raise Argus’ profile, develop and nurture relationships with key stakeholders in the fertilizer industry and promote the use of Argus price benchmarks. This strategic industry-facing role requires frequent engagement with industry participants to promote Argus fertilizer services and to provide intelligence to drive product development and inform strategic decisions for the business.

 You will represent Argus at industry events and establish relationships with industry decision-makers across Asia and the Middle East. As part of engaging with the market, there will be a significant focus on making relevant connections, then successfully securing meetings and relationship building to discuss customer pain points. The aim will be to identify opportunities to better support customers’ commercial activities and decision-making using Argus services.

Key areas of focus will be fertilizer raw materials markets, including sulphur, sulphuric acid and ammonia, as well as finished fertilizers such as urea, processed phosphates, potash, and NPKs.

What You Will Be Doing



- Develop and execute regional strategies across Asia and the Middle East to increase usage of Argus price assessments and grow the regional subscription business in fertilizer market reports and analytics services.
- Support strategic sector objectives. One of the key objectives will be to support Argus; relationship with brokers and exchanges and develop existing and upcoming Argus-based fertilizer derivatives.
- Build strong business relationships with fertilizer industry executives through proactive engagement.
- Work with subject matter experts and editors of fertilizer market reports to develop price assessments and methodologies and new products that solve real problems clients and prospects face.
- Understand client requirements for fundamentals data and fertilizer price forecasts.
- Monitor the competitive environment for Argus fertilizer services in Asia and the Middle East and propose strategies to maintain or achieve market leadership.
- Support account managers to grow their accounts by identifying commercial opportunities and joining meetings where appropriate to demonstrate the value of Argus services.
- Represent Argus at industry conferences and business gatherings, including regular speaking engagements.
- Coordinate regional fertilizer strategy with SVP Fertilizers and the fertilizer sector leadership team. Regularly communicate opportunities and challenges faced in the region with this group.
- Contribute (as needed) to white papers, presentations, analyses, and marketing materials.

To learn more about the report this role covers you can click here: https://www.argusmedia.com/en/fertilizer

What We’re Looking For In You



- Experience promoting price indexation, business intelligence or market analytics services in energy or fertilizer-related industries.
- 7+ years of experience in price reporting, supply, trading, and/or analysis in fertilizer markets, including deep understanding of industry economics and logistics.
- Strong negotiation and persuasion skills with the ability to build long-lasting, positive relationships with a wide range of stakeholders, including but not limited to senior executives, corporate entities, as well as government and non-government organisations.
- Ability to uncover customers’ problems and align them back to our value proposition.
- Cross-cultural management track record, with focus on APAC, South Asia, Middle East.
- Demonstrated ability to deliver successful outcomes in a complex matrix management environment and build effective working relationships with colleagues in all business functions.
- Suitable professional qualifications, such as undergraduate or master’s degree in a relevant field.
- Proactive and able to work independently.

Travel



- 20-25% of extensive travel within Asia / the Middle East

What’s In It For You



- Work within a highly motivated team at an industry-leading and rapidly growing global company.
- Competitive salary and commission scheme.
- A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork.
- Excellent location at Raffles Place in central Singapore – close to public transport and amenities.
- Hybrid working model - Work from Home available upon completion of probation.
- Comprehensive benefits package including medical (GP and specialist), dental and hospitalisation.
- 20 vacation days your first year, up to a maximum of 25 days.
- Extensive internal and external training.
- Employee Welfare & Employee Assistance Programme.

Argus is the leading independent provider of market intelligence to the global energy and commodity markets. We offer essential price assessments, news, analytics, consulting services, data science tools and industry conferences to illuminate complex and opaque commodity markets.

Headquartered in London with 1,500 staff, Argus is an independent media organisation with 32 offices in the world’s principal commodity trading hubs.

Companies, trading firms and governments in 160 countries around the world trust Argus data to make decisions, analyse situations, manage risk, facilitate trading and for long-term planning. Argus prices are used as trusted benchmarks around the world for pricing transportation, commodities and energy.

Founded in 1970, Argus remains a privately held UK-registered company owned by employee shareholders and global growth equity firm General Atlantic.

title: Client Success Director (Thai Speaking)
description:
Thought Machine's mission is bold – to properly and permanently rid the world's banks of legacy technology. To achieve this, we have developed the foundations of modern banking through core and payments technology which run natively in the cloud. What we are attempting is hard and means we need great people working together to build great technology.

We have grown rapidly in the past few years – growing our team to more than 550 individuals across offices in London, New York, Singapore, Sydney and our newly established Engineering Hub in Lisbon. We have raised more than £500m in funding and our investors include Molten Ventures, Eurazeo, Intesa Sanpaolo, Temasek, Nyca Partners, JPMorgan Chase Strategic Investments, Standard Chartered Ventures, and more.

We have created a culture that enables our team to produce the best work in the industry while ensuring we have fun along the way. We're regularly cited as having a fantastic workplace culture and have been recognised by Sifted magazine as having one of the highest Glassdoor ratings for a UK fintech company and the industry's most generous employee share package. Named one of the world's most innovative fintechs by Global Finance Magazine, we were also recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe's fastest-growing companies for two consecutive years—and a UK Best Employer for 2026.

The Client Success Director (CSD) is accountable for ensuring Clients successfully adopt and scale our platform to achieve their contracted outcomes. The primary measure of success for this role is enabling clients to reach their contracted volume of live accounts within agreed milestone dates and budget, while maintaining high client satisfaction and long-term commercial value.

This is a senior, client-facing role requiring deep experience in core banking transformation programmes, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to orchestrate delivery, support, and sales teams across complex, multi-year engagements.

Duties

Client Outcomes & Delivery



- Own the end-to-end client success plan from sales support, to implementation through to scale and steady state.
- Ensure clients achieve their contracted account volumes within agreed milestones, timelines, and budgets.
- Act as the primary point of accountability for delivery outcomes across implementation, upgrades, and ongoing services within the scope of the MSA.
- Proactively identify risks to delivery, adoption, or timelines and drive mitigation plans across internal and client teams.
- Monitor and analyse client product usage, forecasting key account metrics.

Client Engagement & Governance



- Following the Vault Delivery Framework, establish and run robust account governance, including steering committees, operational forums, and executive engagement.
- Own CSAT, including measurement, action planning, and continuous improvement.
- As part of the governance model and ensuring compliance with Thought Machine Support requirements, define the Target Operating Model for support as early on in the engagement as possible.
- As part of being accountable for the client success plan, lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), demonstrating progress against milestones, value delivered, and forward roadmap.
- Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders across business, technology, and operations.
- Ensure Client production readiness is complete and signed off by all stakeholders for all go live events including upgrades, particularly the issue of SPM’s (Service Procedure Manuals) and the acceptance into support by the Thought Machine Support organisation.

Support & Platform Stability



- Act as the escalation point for support issues, ensuring the support organisation resolves defects and incidents in a timely and transparent manner.
- Work with the assigned client support lead to track and communicate bug resolution, root cause analysis, and preventative actions to clients.
- Work with the assigned client support lead to ensure platform stability and service quality meet contractual and regulatory expectations.

Commercial & Financial Ownership



- Own the P&L for all paid services delivered to the client, ensuring services are delivered profitably or within the understood company investment envelope for a specified outcome to assure client success.
- Maintain overall services profitability for the client, balancing issue remediation and client satisfaction, delivery quality, cost control, and long-term account value.
- Oversee commercials related to professional services, managed services, upgrades, and Statements of Work (SOWs).
- Work closely with the CCO office and Finance to forecast revenue, margin, and delivery costs.

Growth & Sales Collaboration



- Partner with the Account Director who is accountable for growing the account and expanding white space.
- Support sales cycles by articulating and presenting the client journey — from onboarding to scale — tailoring the level of engagement to be as “hands-on” as the client desires depending on the nature of the engagement (client maturity, partner involvement etc.).
- Identify expansion opportunities across modules, services, upgrades, and additional volumes to get the client to the contracted volume on the platform.
- Contribute to renewals and contract extensions through demonstrated value and strong relationships.

Upgrades & Roadmap Management



- Oversee planning and execution of platform upgrades, ensuring minimal disruption and clear client communication.
- Being the voice of the client to ensure alignment of client roadmaps and their required regulatory change with product evolution.
- Ensure upgrades are delivered on time, within scope, and are commercially aligned.

Requirements

Essential



- Fluent in Thai.
- Proven experience delivering core banking transformation programmes, either:
- On the vendor side (core banking / fintech provider), or
- On the client side (bank, building society, or financial institution).
- Strong understanding of core banking domains, including account servicing, payments, lending, and regulatory considerations.
- Demonstrated accountability for delivery outcomes, milestones, and Client adoption at scale,
- Experience owning or influencing commercials, P&L, and services profitability.
- Ability to operate credibly with senior banking stakeholders, including CIO, COO, and business heads.
- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive-level presentation skills.

Desirable



- Experience in SaaS or cloud-based core banking platforms.
- Background in professional services, client success, managed services, or large-scale systems integration.
- Familiarity with regulated operating environments and supervisory expectations.

Personal Attributes



- Outcome-driven, commercially astute, and comfortable being held accountable,
- Calm under pressure and effective in complex, multi-stakeholder environments,
- Collaborative leader who can influence without direct authority,
- Pragmatic problem-solver with a strong Client-first mindset.

Benefits



- Highly competitive salary
- Healthcare
- 25 days holiday and public holidays
- Competitive maternity and paternity leave
- $1,500 SGD per year flexible spend benefit
- All the latest tech you need
- A talented and experienced team as your colleagues
- An environment where we encourage learning and progress

We actively hire candidates who demonstrate technical excellence in their field and welcome people of all ages and backgrounds, providing everyone with equal access to professional development. You are encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't accurately match the job description. We also encourage applications from those with different abilities, including candidates with ADHD, autism, dyslexia or dyspraxia.

description:

Singapore

Ref #

10054507

Description & Requirements

The Analytics & Sales Program offers a unique opportunity to build expertise in financial markets, Bloomberg technology, and client engagement while developing a foundation for a long-term career within Bloomberg's Financial Solutions business.

You will begin your career in Analytics, where you'll work directly with Bloomberg Professional Services clients across the global financial community. In our Analytics business, you will provide 24/7 support to Bloomberg users around the world and across multiple industries. Through Instant Bloomberg (IB) chat, you'll answer client questions, solve complex workflow challenges, and help clients maximize the value of Bloomberg's products and solutions. 

On any given day, our teams respond to tens of thousands of client inquiries in over 15 languages. From helping portfolio managers analyze risk to supporting traders as they uncover new sources of market liquidity, you'll gain exposure to a wide range of financial workflows while developing deep product, market, and client expertise. 

As Bloomberg continues to innovate, you'll partner with clients to introduce new products, deliver training, support onboarding and product rollouts, and help organizations utilize technology more effectively. You'll also collaborate closely with Sales teams on strategic client initiatives, building the skills and relationship management capabilities that prepare you for future opportunities across Financial Solutions.

As your expertise grows, you'll have the opportunity to progress into Sales, the most common career path within the program. In Sales, you'll become a trusted advisor to clients, building long-term relationships, understanding business goals and workflows, and identifying opportunities to deliver Bloomberg solutions while driving business growth.

What's In It for You? 

Industry-Leading Training 

From day one, you'll participate in one of the industry's most comprehensive training programs, building a foundation in financial markets, asset classes, Bloomberg technology, and client workflows. 

Client Exposure from Day One 

After training, you'll join one of our Analytics teams, where you'll continue learning through hands-on client exposure, mentorship, and specialized asset class and workflow training. Every client interaction is an opportunity to deepen your expertise, develop your problem-solving skills, and build confidence as a trusted advisor.

Long-Term Career Growth 

The Analytics & Sales Program is designed to accelerate your professional development.  As your knowledge and experience grow, so do your opportunities. Most participants progress into Sales, where they build long-term client relationships and drive business growth, while others pursue specialist client-facing, product or leadership roles across Bloomberg's Financial Solutions business.

Who You Are

You are intellectually curious, client-focused, and energized by financial markets. You enjoy solving problems, learning new technologies, and understanding the drivers behind market-moving events. A strong communicator and relationship builder, you thrive in fast-paced environments, are passionate about delivering exceptional client experiences, and are motivated to build a long-term career helping clients solve challenges and achieve their business goals.

You’ll need To Have



- Bachelor's degree (or above) and the ability to start a full-time role in 2027 (Candidates graduating by July 2027 are welcome to apply) 
- Up to 3 years of work experience 
- Professional fluency in English and Thai (written and spoken), as the role requires regular communication and support business activities conducted in Thai
- Demonstrated academic coursework or work experience in financial markets, economics or fintech 
- Experience in customer service roles (interacting with both internal and external clients) 
- Experience with client interaction in sales or account management capacity 
- Strong multitasking, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn quickly and adapt in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. 
- Interest in innovative technologies and their potential to enhance workflows and efficiencies. 
- Flexibility to occasionally work weekends or on bank/public/federal holiday (weekday off in lieu). 

We’d love To See



- Demonstrated practical exposure to Python or other coding languages preferably. 
- Beginner to intermediate experience with Excel and/or Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) 
- With 1-3 years of full-time work experience in the financial market or financial services industry, or in client-facing/relationship management/sales/consulting role 

AI tools can be useful for interview preparation and research. Use them to brainstorm practice questions, refine a study plan, or simulate a role play. During the interview, however, we ask that your responses reflect your own experiences, judgment, critical thinking, and communication skills, and that you do not use AI tools at any point during the interview process. This helps us accurately assess your skills and potential, while also ensuring a fair and consistent experience for all candidates.

If This Sounds Like You

Apply if you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch to let you know what the next steps are, but in the meantime feel free to have a look at:  

Please note this is a two-stage application process. Following the submission of your main application, you will receive an email with directions to complete an online assessment. Completing this assessment is a necessary step to be considered for the role.

title: Regional Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description
We are seeking a dynamic, highly motivated, and commercially driven Regional Marketing Manager to lead student acquisition initiatives across China, Southeast Asia, and the broader Asia-Pacific (APAC) region.
As a key brand representative, you will play a pivotal role in driving student recruitment through daily live streaming, digital marketing, and audience engagement. You will be responsible for hosting compelling live broadcasts that engage prospective students, build brand credibility, generate qualified leads, and convert audience interest into successful student applications and enrolments.
You will also manage supporting digital channels, particularly Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) and WeChat, to strengthen brand visibility, promote live streaming sessions, and support regional student recruitment objectives.
Key Responsibilities
1. Live Streaming & Student Acquisition

- Plan, produce, manage, and host engaging daily live streaming sessions across relevant digital platforms.
- Develop compelling live content that showcases the institution's programmes, educational offerings, student experiences, and value propositions.
- Engage prospective students in real time, address enquiries, build trust, and guide audiences through the student recruitment and enrolment journey.
- Implement effective audience engagement and conversion strategies to generate qualified leads and drive student applications and enrolments.
2. Digital Marketing & Social Media Management

- Manage and optimise regional digital marketing channels, particularly Xiaohongshu and WeChat, to increase brand awareness and drive traffic to live streaming sessions.
- Develop and execute content strategies to promote upcoming broadcasts, maintain audience engagement, and nurture prospective student leads.
- Create localised digital content and promotional materials tailored to the preferences and behaviours of target audiences across China and Southeast Asia.
- Maintain consistent brand messaging across all digital touchpoints.
3. Regional Brand Development & Market Intelligence

- Develop compelling brand narratives and high-quality promotional materials to strengthen brand positioning across the APAC region.
- Monitor regional education market trends, student mobility patterns, competitor activities, and consumer behaviour.
- Analyse audience engagement and market feedback to identify new recruitment opportunities and refine live streaming content.
- Apply cultural intelligence and market insights to improve campaign relevance and effectiveness across different markets.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with admissions, academic, and other relevant teams to ensure the accuracy and consistency of programme information communicated during live broadcasts.
- Coordinate recruitment campaigns and promotional activities to support institutional enrolment targets.
- Maintain effective communication with prospective students and build positive relationships throughout the recruitment process.
Requirements

- Proven experience in digital marketing, regional marketing, student recruitment, education marketing, live streaming, or a related field.
- Demonstrated commercial awareness and the ability to convert audience interest into qualified leads and measurable business outcomes.
- Familiarity with Chinese digital platforms, particularly Xiaohongshu and WeChat, and their application in marketing and audience development.
- Good understanding of the education market in China, Southeast Asia region.
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret marketing data and implement improvement strategies.
- Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish trust with prospective students.
- Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in education recruitment, education consultancy, or marketing.
- Experience hosting regular live streaming sessions for marketing, sales, or customer acquisition.
- Professional proficiency in Mandarin to engage effectively with Chinese-speaking audiences. Additional regional language capabilities will be an advantage.
- Experience developing localised content and marketing campaigns for diverse Asian markets.
- Familiarity with digital marketing, management systems, and conversion optimisation tools.

title: Solutions Engineer, DoiT Cloud Intelligence — Thai Speaking
description:
Location: Our Solutions Engineer, DoiT Cloud Intelligence, will be an integral part of our Solutions Engineering / Field Engineering team in APAC. This role is based remotely in APJ timezone, and requires native-level Thai language fluency to serve our Thai customers, prospects, and AWS field teams.

Who We Are

DoiT is a global technology company empowering cloud-driven organizations to achieve business growth and innovation through strategic cloud utilization. We blend data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state, from initial planning to full-scale production.

With extensive experience across various cloud environments, we possess deep specializations in Cloud Data Platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery, as well as FinOps expertise. As a trusted and award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we proudly support over 4,000 customers worldwide.

Our flagship offering is DoiT Cloud Intelligence (DCI), which uniquely combines advanced technology with human insight, enabling us to solve complex multicloud challenges and drive significant efficiency for our clients.

The DoiT Cloud Intelligence platform:



- Provides deep visibility into cloud cost, usage, performance, and optimization opportunities across complex multi-cloud environments, enabling organizations to make data-driven infrastructure decisions.
- Combines automation, analytics, and expert guidance to identify savings opportunities, improve resource efficiency, and continuously optimize cloud investments at scale.
- Powers Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Systems Integrators (SIs), and Private Equity (PE) operating teams with portfolio-level insights, benchmarking, and operational tooling to manage multiple cloud environments effectively.
- Goes beyond reporting by delivering prescriptive recommendations and automated workflows that help engineering, finance, and platform teams turn cloud intelligence into measurable operational and financial outcomes.

The Opportunity

As a Solutions Engineer supporting DoiT Cloud Intelligence in Thailand, you will be the hands-on technical face of DoiT in the local market. Partnering with Account Executives, Customer Success, and the AWS field team, you will help Thai enterprises, digital natives, MSPs, and Systems Integrators unlock actionable insights across their AWS and multi-cloud environments — driving cost efficiency, operational visibility, and smarter cloud decision-making through DCI.

This is a growth-oriented Field Engineering role. You are chartered to drive DCI and product adoption through high-impact technical sales plays, measurable revenue growth, partner-led pipeline, new logo acquisition, and upsell/cross-sell motions. You will sit at the intersection of customers, cloud platforms, and our product — an embedded technical partner inside the account team rather than a reactive support resource.

Responsibilities

Technical Qualification & Discovery: Collaborate with the Account Executive to thoroughly understand the prospect’s cloud environment, FinOps maturity, cost management challenges, and operational goals through in-depth technical discovery sessions across engineering, finance, and platform teams.

Technical Validation & POV Leadership: Own and drive technical validation and Proof of Value (POV) exercises for DoiT Cloud Intelligence, including POV preparation, proactive management, and ensuring successful technical outcomes that demonstrate clear value and alignment with prospect requirements.

Platform Demonstrations: Develop and deliver compelling, tailored demonstrations of DCI in Thai and English, showcasing cloud cost visibility, optimization insights, and operational intelligence across complex multi-cloud environments.

Business Case & ROI Development: Leverage your understanding of cloud economics and FinOps to build business cases and ROI analyses that clearly articulate the financial and operational impact of adopting DCI, for both engineering and executive audiences.

AWS Partner-Led Growth: Work with AWS field teams and local partners on co-sell motions, partner-sourced pipeline, and accelerator programs — including GenAI, Migration Acceleration Program (MAP), and Well-Architected Framework Review (WAFR) engagements. Support GTM initiatives that convert partner relationships into qualified opportunities.

Hands-On Cloud Engineering: Act as a trusted cloud engineer who designs and helps implement improvements in cost efficiency, resilience, security posture, and operational automation. Lead structured technical engagements such as optimization sessions, reliability and security reviews, architecture deep dives, migration assessments, and Well-Architected style assessments.

DCI Power User & Expertise: Become the go-to expert for DoiT Cloud Intelligence in the region: build analytics and cost allocation views, surface cost and risk opportunities, write Composer queries, create CloudFlow automations, and embed DCI into customer observability, governance, and CI/CD workflows.

Partner & Portfolio Motion Support (MSP, PE, SI): Support technical engagements with MSPs, PE firms, and SIs by demonstrating how DCI enables portfolio-level visibility, operational insight across multiple cloud environments, and scalable optimization strategies.

Technical Win Ownership: Take full ownership of the technical win for DCI engagements — guiding prospects through evaluation, addressing technical requirements, and building confidence in the platform’s ability to drive cloud efficiency and operational insight.

Reusable Assets & Enablement. Convert field work into reusable assets: playbooks, Terraform modules, automations, architecture diagrams, internal tooling, and documented patterns. Create external-facing technical content such as webinars, workshops, and customer enablement sessions in Thai.

Event & Conference Presentations. Represent DoiT and DCI at local and regional events, AWS events, webinars, and industry conferences, delivering engaging presentations and demonstrations.

Product Feedback & Customer Advocacy. Translate customer pain points, partner requirements, and feature gaps into structured, technically credible input for Product and Engineering, helping shape the evolution of the Cloud Intelligence platform. Represent the voice of the Thai and APAC technical customer in roadmap discussions.

Accurate, Timely Documentation. Ensure timely entry of data into internal business support systems and contribute to the tools and metrics that highlight business performance and effectiveness.

About You

You are an accomplished Solutions Engineer or hands-on cloud architect with customer-facing experience, ideally in a B2B SaaS or cloud consulting environment. You are a native Thai speaker who can move fluidly between a Thai-language executive conversation and an English-language technical deep dive with a global product team.

You are excited about enabling companies to transform themselves using the public cloud, and you hold yourself accountable for the success of any initiative you are involved in. You want to be part of a high-performance, growth-focused organization and you enjoy winning against the competition. You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative, entrepreneurial, remote-first environment across multiple time zones.

Qualifications

Native-level Thai fluency (spoken and written) with professional working proficiency in English.



- 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating production workloads on AWS (experience with GCP or Azure is a strong plus), with the ability to reason across compute, storage, networking, IAM, and observability.
- Experience in a customer-facing technical role — Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre-Sales Engineering, or Field/Forward Deployed Engineering — selling or delivering into enterprise and mid-market accounts.
- Depth in at least one technical domain: cloud infrastructure, data & analytics, or ML/GenAI.
- Practical FinOps and cloud cost management judgment: the ability to explain cost-versus-performance-versus-reliability tradeoffs to both engineers and finance/leadership stakeholders.
- Practical observability experience: monitoring, logging, and alerting, and an understanding of tools in the ecosystem such as Datadog, New Relic, ServiceNow, and cloud-native equivalents.
- An automation mindset with coding or scripting ability, plus hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and CI/CD tooling.
- Strong data analysis skills and comfort navigating large data sets and spreadsheets to identify trends, outliers, correlations, and reconciliation needs.
- The ability to take complex pieces of technology and explain them in a simple, easy-to-understand way.
- Solid verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills, including experience presenting to executive-level prospects and customers.
- Comfort working in a metric-driven environment, reporting on and improving business performance against monthly KPIs.
- Experience working in an account-team model across multiple functions (AE, CSM, AM, TAM) and time zones.
- Intellectual curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and a passion for continuous improvement.

Bonus Points



- AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Professional, Advanced Networking, Machine Learning) or FinOps Certified Practitioner.
- Prior experience working with or alongside AWS partner programs (MAP, WAFR, GenAI accelerators) or within an AWS Partner / MSP / SI.
- Background in FinOps, SRE, or platform engineering.
- Experience with cloud cost management or cloud intelligence platforms such as DCI.
- Datacenter and hypervisor experience (e.g. VMware) in the context of migration to cloud.
- Experience with modern technical selling best practices, including trial, demo, POV, and RFP processes.
- Contributions to open source, public speaking, community leadership, or internal enablement.
- Track record of success in a fast-growing and scaling business.

We are looking for a Performance Marketing Executive to manage and optimize the performance funnel across paid media and organic discovery, while supporting our channel sales partners with marketing execution. You will also help ensure that the Actxa Core Smart Ring and AI Glucose Scan are represented accurately and prominently wherever customers search, whether through a search engine or AI answer engine.

This is a hands-on, metrics-driven role suited to someone equally comfortable building a Meta Advantage+ campaign, briefing a retail partner's sales team, and investigating a drop in organic traffic following a Google algorithm update.

Paid Media (Meta, Google, TikTok)



- Plan, launch and manage paid campaigns across Meta, Google (Search, Shopping, Performance Max) and TikTok, aligned with revenue and CAC/ROAS targets
- Work within allocated budgets across channels and campaigns, reallocating spend toward the best-performing audiences, creatives and placements
- Build and maintain audience segmentation, retargeting and lookalike strategies across platforms
- Partner with the creative team to brief, test and refine ad creative and copy, running structured A/B tests across hooks, formats and offers
- Monitor pixel and conversion tracking, attribution and campaign health, and troubleshoot tracking issues as platforms evolve, including iOS/privacy changes, Meta CAPI and GA4

SEO & GEO



- Manage on-site and off-site SEO, including keyword strategy, technical SEO health, on-page optimization and content recommendations to improve organic search traffic and rankings
- Develop and execute a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) approach to help ensure Actxa's products, claims and content are accurately surfaced and cited by AI answer engines such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity
- Work with the content team to structure product and educational content, including schema markup, clear claims and FAQ formatting, for both traditional search and AI-driven discovery
- Track organic and AI-referral visibility, keyword rankings and share of voice against competitors in the smart wearable and glucose-monitoring space

Channel Sales & Marketing Support



- Act as the marketing point of contact for distributors, resellers and retail channel partners, supporting their sales efforts with campaigns, assets and promotions
- Develop co-marketing materials, including sell sheets, in-store/POS collateral, digital banners and campaign toolkits, tailored to each channel partner's needs
- Plan and execute joint promotional campaigns and trade activities with channel partners, aligned with regional launch and sales calendars
- Train and brief channel partner sales teams on product positioning, claims and key selling points for the Actxa Core Smart Ring and AI Glucose Scan
- Track channel partner performance and marketing ROI, and share insights to improve ongoing sell-through. 

Reporting & Optimization



- Build and maintain performance dashboards across paid and organic channels, reporting weekly and monthly on spend, ROAS, CAC, conversion rate and organic growth
- Translate performance data into clear, actionable recommendations for budget shifts, creative refreshes and campaign improvements
- Stay current on platform updates across Meta, Google and TikTok, including algorithm and policy changes, and adjust execution accordingly. 

Requirements



- Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Digital Marketing or a related discipline
- Experience in health tech, wearables, consumer electronics or FMCG is a plus. 
- 3-5 years of hands-on experience running paid media across Meta and Google Ads; TikTok Ads experience is strongly preferred
- Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals, including keyword research, technical SEO and on-page optimization, with familiarity with or a strong interest in GEO and AI search optimization
- Proficient in the use of generative AI tools to support campaign planning, content development, customer and market research, performance analysis, SEO/GEO, reporting and day-to-day marketing execution
- Experience supporting channel sales or distributor and retail partners with marketing collateral and campaigns is a strong plus
- Comfortable working with GA4, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads Manager and marketplace seller dashboards
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends and turn insights into actions rather than simply reporting numbers
- Excellent attention to detail, particularly when working with product claims and regulatory-sensitive content
- A self-starter who can manage multiple channels and priorities independently in a fast-moving team

Benefits



- The opportunity to help grow the performance and ecommerce engine behind a category-defining product: the world's first clinically studied non-invasive AI Glucose Scan ring
- A collaborative marketing team with direct exposure to regional growth strategy and channel partnerships
- The opportunity to experiment with emerging channels and AI-driven search and discovery ahead of much of the market

description:

title: E Commerce Digital Marketing Executive
description:
About the Role
We're looking for a hands-on Ecommerce Digital Marketer whose single most important job is simple: drive sales on our ecommerce platforms. You will own the full revenue funnel — from paid ads that bring traffic in, to the pricing, bundles, and promotions that convert browsers into buyers.
This is not a branding or content-only role. You will be measured on GMV, ROAS, and conversion rate. If you love seeing numbers go up and know how to make it happen with ads and offers, this role is for you.
Key Responsibilities
1. Paid Advertising (Traffic & Sales)
Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns across TikTok Ads (GMV Max / Product Shopping Ads), Meta Ads, and platform ads (Shopee Ads, Lazada Sponsored Solutions)
Manage monthly ad budgets with clear ROAS targets; scale winners, kill losers fast
Run A/B tests on creatives, audiences, and landing/product pages
Work with content team on ad creatives (short video, image, live-stream traffic)
2. Pricing, Bundles & Promotions
Own the promo calendar: double-date campaigns (9.9, 10.10, 11.11, 12.12), payday sales, flash deals, platform mega campaigns
Design product bundles, tiered discounts, gift-with-purchase, and vouchers to raise average order value (AOV)
Monitor competitor pricing and adjust our offers to stay attractive without killing margin
Coordinate with operations on stock levels before launching promos
3. Livestream Commerce Support
Design livestream-exclusive offers: flash prices, limited-quantity deals, live-only bundles, and voucher drops timed to peak viewership
Set pricing and promo mechanics before each stream (anchor price vs. live price, countdown deals, tiered unlocks e.g. "hit 500 viewers, price drops")
Coordinate with hosts/streamers on the offer rundown: what to push, in what order, at what price point
Run live traffic ads (e.g. TikTok LIVE Shopping Ads) to boost stream viewership during key selling windows
Review post-stream data (GPM, viewers, conversion, top SKUs) and refine offer mechanics for the next stream
4. Conversion & Store Optimization
Optimize product listings: titles, images, descriptions, reviews, ratings
Improve store conversion rate through better merchandising and offer placement
Set up and manage affiliate/influencer commissions where relevant (TikTok Affiliate)
5. Reporting & Analysis
Track and report weekly on GMV, ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, AOV, and margin impact of promos
Provide clear recommendations: what worked, what didn't, what we do next week
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Monthly GMV / sales target achievement
Blended ROAS across paid channels
Store conversion rate and AOV growth
Promo campaign performance (uplift vs. baseline, margin protected)
Livestream performance: GPM (GMV per 1,000 views), live conversion rate, and stream-over-stream GMV growth
Requirements
2–4 years' hands-on experience in ecommerce performance marketing (TikTok Shop, Shopee, or Lazada strongly preferred)
Proven track record of hitting sales/ROAS targets — be ready to show numbers in the interview
Practical experience managing ad budgets of at least [SGD 10K+/month]
Strong grasp of pricing psychology, bundling, and promo mechanics in SEA marketplaces
Comfortable with data: can pull numbers, build a simple report, and explain what to do about it
Bilingual in English and Mandarin (our market and content are heavily Chinese-speaking)
Experience supporting live-commerce (TikTok LIVE / Shopee Live): offer planning, live pricing mechanics, or live traffic boosting
Willing to work around livestream schedules, including some evenings/weekends during major campaigns
Bonus: experience with affiliate programs or beauty/FMCG products
Who You Are
A doer, not just a planner — you launch fast, learn fast, and iterate
Commercially minded: you think in margin and profit, not just clicks and views
Self-driven; you don't wait to be told what to test next
Thrive in a fast-moving, target-driven environment
What We Offer
Base salary + kpi incentives
Real ownership of a revenue channel with direct visibility to leadership
Fast-growing brand portfolio with room to grow into a lead role
[Other benefits: CPF, medical, flexible arrangements, etc.]

title: F&B Brand Executive
description:
We are looking for a creative, commercially minded, and execution-focused Food Brand Executive to support the development and growth of our food brand. The Food Brand Executive will be responsible for translating the brand strategy into effective marketing campaigns, product launches, promotional activities, content, customer engagement, and in-store execution. The role works closely with Operations, Product Development, Design, Sales, and external partners to ensure the brand remains relevant, consistent, and commercially successful. The ideal candidate combines food industry passion, marketing creativity, strong execution skills, and commercial awareness.
The Food Brand Executive is responsible for turning the food brand's strategy into compelling customer experiences and commercially effective marketing activities.The role sits at the intersection of Brand × Product ×Marketing × Customer × Operations, ensuring that every campaign, product launch, promotion, and customer touchpoint strengthens the brand while contributing to sustainable business growth.
Key Responsibilities
1. Brand Management

- Support the development and execution of the brand strategy and annual brand plans.
- Ensure consistent brand positioning, identity, tone of voice, and customer experience across all touchpoints.
- Monitor market trends, competitor activities, consumer behaviour, and emerging food trends.
- Identify opportunities to strengthen brand awareness, customer engagement, and market positioning.
- Maintain brand guidelines and ensure all communications and materials are aligned with brand standards.
- Support brand health tracking and recommend initiatives to strengthen brand equity.
2. Marketing Campaigns & Promotions

- Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns to drive traffic, sales, and customer engagement.
- Develop promotional calendars covering seasonal campaigns, new product launches, festive periods, and key commercial occasions.
- Coordinate campaign execution across kiosks, social media, digital platforms, delivery channels, and other customer touchpoints.
- Work with Operations to ensure promotions are implemented accurately and consistently at store level.
- Monitor campaign performance and recommend improvements based on results.
- Coordinate with external agencies, designers, printers, influencers, and other marketing partners where required.
3. Product Launches & Menu Development

- Support the development and launch of new food and beverage products.
- Work closely with Operations and Product Development teams on product positioning, naming, packaging, pricing, and launch plans.
- Develop go-to-market plans for new products and limited-time offerings.
- Coordinate product photography, menu boards, promotional materials, and digital content.
- Monitor new product performance and gather customer feedback.
- Recommend product improvements or promotional strategies based on sales and customer insights.
4. Digital & Social Media

- Manage and execute the brand's social media and digital content calendar.
- Develop engaging content ideas around products, promotions, brand stories, and customer experiences.
- Coordinate photography, videography, graphic design, and other content production.
- Monitor social media engagement, customer comments, reviews, and online sentiment.
- Support digital campaigns, paid media, and online promotions.
- Track digital performance and recommend improvements to increase reach and engagement.
5. Customer & Market Insights

- Gather customer feedback and identify changing customer preferences.
- Conduct basic market and competitor research.
- Monitor competitor pricing, promotions, new product launches, and marketing activities.
- Analyse customer behaviour, sales trends, and campaign performance.
- Translate insights into practical recommendations for products, promotions, and brand initiatives.
- Support customer surveys, focus groups, sampling, and other market research activities where required.
6. In-Store Brand Execution

- Ensure brand campaigns and promotional materials are effectively implemented across all kiosks.
- Coordinate POSM, menu boards, posters, displays, packaging, and promotional materials.
- Conduct store checks to ensure visual and promotional standards are maintained.
- Work closely with Operations to ensure campaigns are executed consistently and on time.
- Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and brand experience within the kiosk environment.
7.Commercial & Sales Support

- Work closely with Operations and Commercial teams to support sales growth.
- Monitor product sales, campaign results, customer traffic, and promotional performance.
- Analyse the commercial effectiveness of promotions and marketing activities.
- Support pricing and promotional recommendations using market and sales data.
- Balance brand-building activities with commercial objectives.
- Identify opportunities to improve product visibility, customer conversion, and average transaction value.
8. Brand Partnerships & Activations

- Identify and coordinate suitable brand partnerships and collaboration opportunities.
- Support sampling events, pop-ups, community activities, and promotional activations.
- Coordinate with external partners, landlords, suppliers, and event organisers where required.
- Ensure brand activations are aligned with brand positioning and commercial objectives.
- Evaluate the effectiveness and ROI of brand activities.
9. Marketing Budget & Administration

- Assist in preparing and managing the annual marketing and brand activity budget.
- Track campaign spending and ensure activities remain within approved budgets.
- Coordinate quotations, purchase orders, invoices, and supplier payments where required.
- Maintain accurate records of campaigns, promotional materials, suppliers, and marketing activities.
10. Reporting & Performance Tracking

- Prepare regular reports on marketing campaigns, promotions, social media, product launches, and brand performance.
- Monitor key marketing and commercial KPIs.
- Evaluate campaign ROI and identify opportunities for improvement.
- Present insights and recommendations to management.
- Maintain a central calendar of brand activities and ensure timely execution.
Requirements

- Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Hospitality, Food & Beverage, or a related discipline.
- Minimum 2 years of experience in brand marketing, FMCG, food & beverage, retail, hospitality, or a related industry.
- Experience in food, restaurant, café, QSR, kiosk, or consumer brands is an advantage.
- Strong understanding of social media, digital marketing, promotions, and consumer engagement.
- Good project management and campaign execution skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Creative mindset with good attention to detail.
- Commercially aware and comfortable working with sales and performance data.
- Good presentation and stakeholder management skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office and familiar with digital marketing and content management tools.
- Experience working with creative agencies, designers, photographers, influencers, or other external partners is an advantage.
- Passionate about food, brands, customer experience, and consumer trends.
Working Conditions

- Full-time position
- Primarily office-based with regular visits to food kiosks/outlets
- May require work outside normal office hours for events, activations, launches, or campaigns
- May require occasional weekend or public holiday work depending on marketing activities
What We Offer

- Competitive salary package
- Performance incentives, where applicable
- Opportunities to work across brand, marketing, product, and commercial functions
- Exposure to new product development and food industry trends
- Career development opportunities within a growing food & beverage business
- Dynamic and creative working environment

title: Marketing Executive
description:
You run marketing for Truescope Singapore, with experiential marketing at the centre of the job. You plan and deliver six events a year, from client roundtables and industry forums to partner showcases, and you turn each one into pipeline for the sales team. This is a hands on role. You design the collateral, brief the vendors, manage the run sheet and stand at the door on the day.


You are also the custodian of the Truescope brand in Singapore. You work to elevate and maintain its premium positioning in the local market, and you represent it well in every client, partner and industry setting you are in. You report directly to the Managing Director and take guidance from the Global VP of Marketing on global campaigns, brand standards and content that runs across markets.


What you own
●	Events. Six events a year, from concept and budget through to execution, follow up and post event reporting.
●	Pipeline. Meetings and opportunities generated from events and local campaigns, tracked with the sales team in the CRM.
●	Brand. The premium positioning of Truescope Singapore in the local market. Every touchpoint, from event branding to social content, holds to that standard.
●	Design. Collateral, event branding, social creatives, decks and one pagers, produced directly using design and AI tools rather than waiting on an agency.
●	Global alignment. Localisation and execution of global campaigns in Singapore and Southeast Asia, aligned with the Global VP of Marketing.
●	Content and community. Local social presence, client stories, event recaps and industry partnerships such as IPRS.


Must have
●	B2B marketing experience. One to four years, with at least one full cycle of planning and running live events end to end.
●	Design capability. Working proficiency in tools such as Canva, Figma or Adobe Creative Suite, plus AI design and content tools, with a portfolio of work you produced yourself.
●	Brand judgement. You know what premium looks like and you protect it in the detail, from typography to venue choice to how a guest is greeted.
●	Project discipline. Run sheets, vendor timelines and budgets stay tight without being chased.
●	Presence. You are comfortable in front of clients and partners and represent the company well in the room.


Nice to have
●	Experience in SaaS, media intelligence, martech, research or a communications agency.
●	Exposure to HubSpot or similar marketing automation and CRM tools.
●	Experience adapting global or regional campaigns for a local market.
●	Video editing or motion graphics for event recaps and social content.


Success in the first twelve months
●	Six events delivered on schedule and on budget, each with a clear pipeline outcome the sales team can point to.
●	The Truescope brand is visibly stronger in the Singapore market, consistent across every touchpoint and aligned with global standards.

Here, We Turn Dreams Into Stardom And Audiences Into Fans. We Are Guided By Three Core Values That Underpin Everything We Do Across All Our Diverse Businesses



- Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 
- Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
- Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

Job Title: Commercial Executive - Strategic Repertoire

A Little Bit About Our Team

At Warner Music Group, our Commercial team works at the dynamic intersection of music, data, and fan culture to maximise the reach and impact of our world class catalogue. As part of the Streaming and Strategic Repertoire team focusing on South East Asia, we bring timeless tracks to new generations of listeners while unlocking commercial opportunities for legendary music. In this role, you will work directly alongside our Regional Senior Manager, Streaming and Strategic Repertoire (SEA), collaborating with internal marketing, creative, ecommerce, and playlist teams to drive real audience growth across the region.

Your Role

As the Commercial Executive - Strategic Repertoire, you will play a key role in executing catalogue campaigns and audience engagement strategies across South East Asia. This role balances hands on creative execution, from digital campaign management to creative asset coordination, with essential daily project workflows and administration. One hour you will be analysing campaign metrics and tracking budgets, and the next you will be collaborating on DSP playlist initiatives with our Topsify team or supporting creator marketing initiatives. It is an energetic, detail driven role where your work directly shapes how fans discover and rediscover WMG catalogue.

Here You’ll Get To



- You will partner with the Regional Senior Manager to develop and execute catalogue marketing strategies that boost consumption across South East Asia.
- You will lead mid-weight projects end-to-end, taking charge of campaign delivery, asset sourcing, workflow compliance, and stakeholder updates.
- You will create, launch, and track digital marketing campaigns for catalogue artists, compilation themes, and regional growth projects.
- You will track and analyse campaign performance against KPIs while keeping project budgets and cost administration organised.
- You will collaborate on creative asset development, ensuring seamless usage, manipulation, and distribution across external channels.
- You will build strong working relationships with internal departments, artist managers, repertoire owners, and external business partners.
- You will coordinate with our Owned & Operated Topsify team to drive high-impact DSP playlist campaigns.
- You will support catalogue digitisation and partner with the E-Commerce team to promote exclusive physical and D2C products.

About You



- You have minimum 3+ years of marketing experience within a record label, music company, or entertainment environment ideally within SEA.
- You have a proven track record assisting with digital marketing campaigns across paid media, social, content, and promotional activations.
- You are passionate about music across diverse genres and eras, bringing active user knowledge of current streaming platforms and social media trends.
- You enjoy a data-informed approach to work, bringing strong analytical skills and creative problem-solving to every campaign.
- You are highly organised and detail orientated, with strong project coordination skills and a continuous learning mindset.
- You possess strong relationship management skills and business-level English communication skills, thriving as a collaborative team player.

We’d Love It If You Also Had



- Experience working on regional campaigns across South East Asian music markets.
- Hands-on familiarity with basic image editing tools and asset management platforms.
- Prior exposure to playlist marketing, creator marketing or direct-to-consumer (D2C) e-commerce strategy.

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships.

WMG is committed to inclusion and diversity in all aspects of our business. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and will evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, religion or belief, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, disability, pregnancy, childbirth or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Performance Marketing Executive
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a strategic, data-driven and performance-focused Senior Performance Marketing Executive to drive digital demand generation and customer acquisition.
You will take ownership of end-to-end performance marketing campaigns that generate qualified leads, support pipeline growth and contribute to measurable business growth.
Working closely with Product Marketing, Brand, Sales, Business Units, media agencies and platform partners, you will use data, customer insights and experimentation to continuously improve campaign performance and maximise marketing ROI


How you’ll contribute to MyRepublic’s success:

- Develop and execute integrated performance marketing strategies to drive qualified leads, pipeline growth and customer acquisition.
- Plan, manage and optimise paid media campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, Yahoo Native, display and remarketing.
- Manage media budgets and investments to optimise ROI, CPL and overall campaign efficiency.
- Drive continuous optimisation through A/B testing, audience segmentation, bid strategies, creative testing and landing page improvements.
- Monitor campaign performance and develop dashboards covering lead quality, attribution, conversion rates and key marketing KPIs.
- Work with media agencies and platform partners to ensure campaigns are delivered on schedule and meet performance objectives.
- Collaborate with Product Marketing, Brand, Sales and Business Units to translate business priorities into measurable digital initiatives.
- Drive website conversion optimisation across landing pages, lead forms, user journeys and CTAs.
- Support SEO and SEM initiatives to improve organic visibility and website traffic.
- Manage marketing tracking and measurement, including GA4, Adobe Analytics, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, UTM governance and attribution.
- Analyse customer behaviour and audience insights to identify growth opportunities and improve targeting strategies.
- Drive first-party data activation, audience segmentation, remarketing and lookalike audience strategies.
- Explore emerging digital platforms, AI-powered marketing tools and automation opportunities to improve marketing efficiency.


We think you’ll fit in great with us if you:

- Experience in performance marketing, digital marketing or growth marketing.
- Experience in B2B technology, telecommunications, ICT, SaaS or related industries is preferred.
- Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager and native advertising platforms.
- Proficiency in GA4, Adobe Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio and other digital analytics platforms.
- Strong understanding of SEO, SEM, CRO, marketing automation and attribution modelling.
- Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Zoho or similar.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable marketing insights.
- Strong project and stakeholder management skills, including experience coordinating agencies and cross-functional teams.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present campaign performance and strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders.
- Self-motivated, commercially driven and comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-oriented environment.


Why Join Us?
At MyRepublic, we believe in creating a workplace that values your well-being, growth, and happiness — both in and out of work. Here’s what you can look forward to when you join our team:

- Wellness Day - Enjoy 1 wellness day every quarter to rest, recharge, or do something that makes you feel great.
- Industry Leading Family Care Benefits– Time off to care for your loved ones when they need you most.
- Birthday Leave – Celebrate you! Take a day off on your special day.
- Work From Anywhere (WFA) Leave – Up to 20 days a year to work from wherever inspires you.
- Hybrid Work Arrangement – Enjoy flexibility with a mix of office collaboration and remote work.
- Plenty of Fun Events! – From team bonding activities to festive celebrations, there’s always something happening to keep the energy high and connections strong.


From being the first to launch 1Gbps broadband plans and the first network optimised broadband service for gaming in Singapore, to crafting workplace practices that put wellbeing at its core, our values guide us in everything we do at MyRepublic. It’s the secret sauce that makes us tick. If you espouse the following, we know you would fit in great with us!

title: Senior Channel Marketing Executive
description:
Legal & General (L&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor. 


We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders. 


We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income. 


Our global asset management business provides our clients and partners with complex, responsible investment solutions, working internationally across public and private markets. 


Who we are 


We are one of Europe’s largest asset managers and a major global investor across public and private markets.


Asset Management is a critical driver of our Group strategy. The business aims to work synergistically with our Institutional Retirement and Retail divisions to benefit our clients and customers, and deliver enhanced shareholder returns.  


Our investment philosophy and processes are focused on creating value over the long term. We believe that incorporating financially material sustainability criteria, when relevant to our clients, can create value and drive positive change. 



Job Description


We’re looking for a commercially curious and collaborative marketer to join our growing APAC Asset Management business. This is an opportunity to play a key role in supporting marketing activity across both Institutional and Wholesale client channels, helping deliver campaigns, content, client communications and market engagement initiatives across Asia-Pacific. 


Working within a lean regional team, you’ll gain broad exposure across marketing disciplines and partner with stakeholders across Asia and the UK. 


What you’ll be doing:



- 
Supporting APAC marketing plans across Institutional and Wholesale channels 



- 
Coordinating campaign delivery across content, digital, email, events and social channels 



- 
Adapting global marketing campaigns and content for APAC audiences 



- 
Supporting client communications and engagement initiatives across regional markets 



- 
Managing campaign timelines, approvals and stakeholder inputs 



- 
Tracking campaign performance and preparing insight reports 



- 
Coordinating suppliers, compliance approvals and operational processes 



- 
Ensuring marketing activity aligns with brand, regulatory and governance requirements 


Who we’re looking for:



- 
5–8 years’ marketing experience within asset management, financial services or another regulated environment 



- 
Experience supporting or delivering integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels 



- 
Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills 



- 
Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail 



- 
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities independently 



- 
Strong written and verbal communication skills 



- 
Fluency in English and Chinese, both written and spoken 



- 
Knowledge of APAC investment markets and Institutional or Wholesale audiences 


Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:



- The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance -related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
- Life assurance
- Healthcare and Dental Plan 
- 20 days holiday

Additional Information


At L&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all. 


If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.


We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can. 


It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.
