About us:
Universal Music Group (UMG) is the world leader in music-based entertainment, with a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries.


Featuring the most comprehensive catalog of recordings and songs across every musical genre, UMG identifies and develops artists and produces and distributes the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music in the world. title: Senior Marketing Executive
description:
Brand strategy and positioning
Define what the brand stands for — its mission, values, personality, and unique selling proposition. This includes identifying the target audience, analyzing competitors, and deciding how the brand should be positioned in the market relative to rivals.
Brand identity management
Oversee the visual and verbal identity: logo usage, color palettes, typography, tone of voice, and messaging guidelines. Ensure every touchpoint (packaging, ads, website, social media) stays consistent with brand guidelines.
Marketing and campaign execution
Plan and run campaigns across channels — digital, social, print, events, influencer partnerships. This involves briefing creative agencies, coordinating with media buyers, and making sure campaigns align with the brand's positioning and business goals.
Market research and consumer insights
Track consumer behavior, preferences, and perceptions through surveys, focus groups, social listening, and sales data. Use these insights to refine strategy and spot opportunities or threats early.
Budget management
Allocate and manage the marketing/brand budget, negotiate with vendors and agencies, and justify spending with measurable returns.
Performance tracking
Monitor KPIs like brand awareness, brand equity, market share, engagement rates, and campaign ROI. Report results to senior management and adjust plans based on what the data shows.
Cross-functional collaboration
Work with product teams, sales, PR, legal, and external agencies to keep everyone aligned on the brand's direction — for example, ensuring new product launches fit the brand story.
Reputation and crisis management
Protect the brand's image by monitoring public sentiment, responding to negative press or social media issues, and having crisis communication plans ready.
Innovation and growth
Identify opportunities for brand extensions, new markets, partnerships, or repositioning as consumer trends shift.
In short: a brand executive is the guardian and growth driver of the brand — keeping it consistent, relevant, and profitable. Want me to tailor this to a specific industry or turn it into a job description?

title: Marketing Executive, Email Marketing
categories: Retail Health and Personal Care Products
description:
Stryv (pronounced “Strive”) is one of the fastest-growing consumer brands in Southeast Asia. We’ve received multiple platform awards from major retailers such as Shopee, Watsons, Guardian, and 7-Eleven. Founded by former Grab executives who helped build Grab Financial Group, Stryv is committed to making personal care accessible and aspirational.


Our Vision
We aim to become the Uniqlo of Personal Care—offering well-designed, high-quality personal care electronics like hairdryers, shavers, and electric toothbrushes. Our products are built in tier-1 global factories that manufacture for some of the world’s biggest brands. By selling directly to consumers at accessible prices, we ensure that personal care is inclusive across all income levels.


Backed by Leading Investors
We’re proud to be backed by billion-dollar venture capital funds including East Ventures and GSR. Our supporters also include founders and leaders from some of the region’s most iconic brands: Razer, Carousell, ShopBack, Carro, PRISM+, Grab, Atome, and many more.


The Role
You'll own Stryv's direct marketing engine—building, executing, and optimizing email, SMS, and WhatsApp campaigns that inform, educate, and drive revenue. You'll work across multiple audiences and markets, balancing promotional campaigns with educational content that builds brand trust.


Key Responsibilities:

- Campaign Planning & Execution: Develop and maintain a comprehensive email and direct marketing campaign calendar across all markets. Plan campaigns that drive seasonal promotions, product launches, and customer education initiatives. Coordinate closely with product managers to align on launch timelines and messaging, and work with local marketing teams across Singapore, Malaysia, and Hong Kong to ensure campaigns reflect regional priorities and insights. Effective cross-team communication is essential to align timelines, share customer data, and ensure consistent execution across channels.
- Email & Copy Strategy: Write compelling, culturally relevant copy for email campaigns, SMS, and WhatsApp that converts. Balance promotional messaging with helpful beauty, wellness, and health educational content that connects back to Stryv offerings.
- Product Launches: Lead direct marketing strategy for new product announcements, including segmentation, messaging, and optimization to drive awareness and early adoption.
- CRM & Platform Management: Work with external partners to develop and execute Stryv's overall CRM strategy. Manage day-to-day operations and optimization on Klaviyo, ensuring clean data, effective segmentation, and compliance across markets.

- Manage marketing collateral and showroom materials, including coordinating updates, monitoring inventory and arranging replenishment where required.
- Partner with Sales, Operations, Customer Experience and other business teams to support customer acquisition, retention, conversion and overall commercial objectives.
- Manage day-to-day marketing administration and operational processes, including purchase requisitions, invoice processing, budget tracking, vendor coordination, campaign documentation and reporting.
- Prepare presentations, reports, business updates and marketing materials for management and internal stakeholders.

Cycle & Carriage (C&C) is one of Singapore's leading automotive groups. Our people practices have also been recognised through various awards, including:

- HR Asia's Best Companies to Work For - Platinum Award 2025, marking our 11th consecutive year of recognition
- Happiest Workplace Certified 2024
 
As the automotive industry continues to evolve, we are also growing our presence in electric and new energy vehicles and mobility solutions. This gives our people the opportunity to be part of an industry that is changing how people and businesses move. Keen for a career conversation? Connect with us to find out more.

title: Marketing Executive, Clé de Peau Beauté
description:
MAIN PURPOSE
Reporting to the Marketing Manager, the Marketing Executive is responsible for the execution of Trade Marketing and Customer Experience initiatives across retail and digital channels, ensuring strong operational delivery and a consistent luxury brand experience.
The role supports integrated marketing campaigns across retail, CRM, digital commerce and experiential touchpoints, working closely with internal teams, retailers, agencies and vendors to deliver initiatives accurately, effectively and on time.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Trade Marketing & Retail Excellence — Primary

- Execute Trade Marketing initiatives across Department Stores, Sephora and Boutiques in line with agreed brand and retailer plans.
- Coordinate product launches, promotional mechanics, sampling programmes, seasonal campaigns and retail activations.
- Manage day-to-day implementation of the retail marketing calendar, ensuring activities are delivered accurately and on time.
- Coordinate the production, allocation and deployment of POSM and retail marketing materials.
- Support visual merchandising implementation and ensure consistency with brand guidelines.
- Work closely with Retail Operations, Store Managers and retail partners on day-to-day marketing requirements and store readiness.
- Track trade activities and promotional performance, consolidating feedback and identifying opportunities for improvement.
2. Customer Experience & Engagement

- Plan and execute customer experiences including workshops, VIP events, facial experiences and brand activations in line with agreed objectives.
- Execute CRM communications and customer engagement initiatives to support recruitment, engagement and loyalty.
- Coordinate event planning and delivery including customer recruitment, logistics, materials, vendors and on-site execution.
- Support partnership activations and experiential initiatives that enhance the customer experience.
- Ensure customer-facing activities consistently reflect Clé de Peau Beauté’s luxury service and brand standards.
- Track participation, conversion and engagement results and support post-activity evaluation.
3. Omnichannel & Campaign Execution

- Support integrated 360° campaigns and product launches across retail, CRM, PR, digital and experiential channels.
- Manage retailer e-commerce content, product information, promotional mechanics and merchandising across Sephora.sg and other retailer platforms.
- Coordinate digital assets, retailer media requirements and online campaign implementation.
- Coordinate campaign timelines, assets, samples and other executional requirements.
- Liaise with agencies, vendors and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate campaign delivery.
- Support PR, influencer, content and partnership activities as required.
4. Marketing Operations & Performance

- Maintain marketing calendars, project trackers and campaign documentation.
- Support budget tracking, purchase orders, invoices and vendor administration.
- Consolidate trade, CRM, campaign and e-commerce performance reporting.
- Support post-campaign evaluations and identify executional learnings and opportunities for improvement.
- Manage assigned projects and timelines, proactively flagging risks and resolving day-to-day issues with the Marketing Manager.
- Support continuous improvement of marketing processes and ways of working.
REQUIREMENTS:

- Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business or a related discipline.
- 1–3 years of relevant marketing experience, preferably within beauty, luxury, retail or consumer goods.
- Experience or exposure to Trade Marketing, Retail Marketing, customer events, CRM or digital commerce is preferred.
- Strong project coordination and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple timelines.
- Detail-oriented with strong executional discipline and follow-through.
- Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Comfortable working with data and tracking campaign and retail performance.
- Proactive, resourceful and adaptable in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong interest in luxury beauty, retail and customer experience.

title: Singapore - Marketing Executive, Shiseido
description:

This role is responsible for driving commercial performance across channels through the planning and execution of retail marketing campaigns, trade promotions, and activation programs that support brand and business objectives. The role also supports product marketing initiatives and is responsible for delivering elevated in-store brand experiences through effective visual merchandising, retail excellence, and consumer-centric activations. This position plays a key role in maximizing visibility, conversion, and shopper engagement across all retail touchpoints.

Key Responsibilities

Retail and Trade Marketing 



- Develop and execute retail marketing plans, promotions, and campaigns across all retail channels 
- Translate brand objectives into retailer-specific activation plans that drive traffic, conversion, and sell-out performance
- Support the planning and execution of promotional calendars, retailer exclusives, seasonal campaigns, and key commercial moments
- Collaborate closely with sales team and retailers to identify growth opportunities and maximize business performance
- Monitor retail performance and campaign results, providing insights and recommendations to optimize effectiveness

Omnichannel Activation and Execution



- Support the development and implementation of integrated omnichannel activation plans across retail, EC, social, CRM, and digital touchpoints
- Ensure seamless execution and consistency of brand campaigns across all consumer-facing channels
- Coordinate marketing assets, POSM, merchandising materials, and campaign deployment to support launches and promotional activities
- Work closely with internal stakeholders, retailers and agencies to ensure timely delivery and execution excellence

- Support the development and implementation of visual merchandising guidelines and in-store communication materials
- Ensure brand standards and visual consistency are maintained across all retail locations and counters

- Partner with retailers and vendors to ensure timely installation and execution of VM initiatives

Product Marketing Support 



- Support the planning and execution of product launches and hero campaigns across retail channels
- Coordinate launch materials, non-saleable products, product information and retail merchandising requirements
- Track launch performance and gather retail feedback to identity opportunities for improvement

- Plan and recommend GWP offerings from HQ assets and local sourcing opportunities, ensuring alignment with campaign objectives, consumer needs, and budget allocation across all channels
- Track and manage promotional investments, including rebates, vouchers, and marketing support by channel and retailer, ensuring spending remains within approved budgets

- Prepare post-campaign report and provide recommendations to improve future activations

- Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Retail Management or related field
- At least 2 years of relevant experience; retail marketing, trade marketing, brand marketing
- Experience in beauty, luxury, FMCG, retail, or consumer industries preferred
- Exposure to product launches, retail activations, promotions, and visual merchandising execution
- Experience working with retailers, external agencies, and cross-functional stakeholders
- Familiarity with omnichannel marketing and retail operations is advantageous
- Commercially driven with a strong understanding of retail dynamics
- Highly organized with excellent execution capabilities
- Collaborative team player who works effectively across functions and retail partners
- Proactive and solution-oriented with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

Job Purpose

The role works closely with the Localization Manager, internal project teams, external translation vendors and LQA vendors to ensure timely delivery, linguistic consistency, clear documentation and continuous improvement of Thai localization quality.

This position will be responsible for seamlessly managing all localization and LQA activities for assigned titles, serving as the primary point of coordination across internal stakeholders, vendors, and QA teams. Responsibilities include project planning and execution, vendor management, linguistic quality oversight, issue tracking, reporting, knowledge-base maintenance, and ensuring timely delivery of localization milestones. Final budget, vendor, project, and commercial approval authority will remain with the Localization Manager and/or designated internal approver.

Why This Role Matters

This role supports BNEAS in building a scalable Thai localization model by strengthening vendor coordination, improving linguistic consistency, maintaining title-specific language assets, and ensuring knowledge continuity across projects and vendors. The role is important in reducing dependency on individual translators and supporting smoother vendor transition, project hand over and business continuity.

Key Responsibilities

1. Localization Coordination

Support localization projects across assigned titles, including planning support, task tracking, delivery follow-up and coordination with internal stakeholders and external vendors.

Track project milestones, dependencies, risks, open issues and pending decisions, and escalate delays or quality concerns to the Localization Manager in a timely manner.

Coordinate project requests and workflows using memoQ and/or other CAT tools, TMS platforms or internal tracking tools, where applicable.

Support delivery alignment across translation, LQA, internal review and final submission stages.

Ensure translated materials and related deliverables are coordinated accurately and delivered according to agreed timelines.

Support continuous improvement initiatives for localization processes, tools, and workflows, including the evaluation and implementation of automation and AI-assisted solutions where appropriate.

2. Vendor Coordination & Communication

Coordinate day-to-day communication with Thai translation and LQA vendors, including project briefing, query handling, delivery follow-up, issue tracking and feedback consolidation.

Brief vendors on project scope, schedule, source materials, style requirements, terminology expectations, delivery format and quality requirements.

Act as the day-to-day contact point for vendor queries and consolidate questions for internal clarification where required.

Maintain vendor communication records, open issue logs and action trackers to ensure clear follow-up and timely resolution.

Provide structured feedback to vendors and escalate quality, schedule, scope or delivery risks to the Localization Manager for decision-making.

3. Thai Linguistic Quality Review

Conduct Thai linguistic spot checks on vendor deliverables to review terminology, tone, consistency, cultural appropriateness, text accuracy and adherence to project guidelines.

Review translated content from vendors, including translation and LQA deliverables, to identify recurring linguistic or quality issues.

Provide practical and structured linguistic feedback to vendors to support quality improvement and calibration.

Recommend Thai linguistic acceptance or rejection for review by the Localization Manager, where required.

Support quality calibration with LQA vendors and internal stakeholders to improve consistency across titles and content types.

4. Localization Knowledge Base & Language Asset Management

Build and maintain Thai localization knowledge assets, including title-specific glossaries, translation memories, style guides, terminology notes, character/IP-specific translation rules and recurring issue logs.

Compile title-specific translation tips, vendor handover notes and project learning points to support continuity across vendors, projects and internal team changes.

Maintain and update Thai terminology references to ensure consistency across different documents, content types and project phases.

Support proper documentation of Thai language decisions, approved terminology and localization guidelines for future reference.

Assist in identifying gaps in existing language assets and recommend improvements to strengthen localization quality and efficiency.

5. Weekly Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Prepare weekly Thai localization progress reports for the Localization Manager / BNEAS localization team, covering project status, vendor progress, key risks, quality issues, pending decisions and next actions.

Prepare post-project summaries, issue trends, quality observations and improvement recommendations to support future localization planning.

Document recurring vendor, process or quality issues and propose practical workflow improvements.

Support the development and maintenance of localization guidelines, best practices, reporting templates and project tracking documents.

6. Schedule and Cost Tracking Support

Track localization and LQA schedules, delivery milestones and vendor submission status, and highlight risks to the Localization Manager and relevant internal stakeholders.

Support cost tracking by maintaining records of vendor quotations, purchase requests, invoices and approved budget references, where applicable.

Coordinate with the Localization Manager and designated internal approvers on cost reporting, project status and required follow-up actions.

Monitor potential schedule or cost risks and provide timely updates; however, budget ownership, vendor commercial negotiation and approval authority remain with the Localization Manager and/or designated internal approver.

7. LQA Coordination Support

Support LQA coordination for all localized content, including issue follow-up, bug and defect clarification, vendor query management, and status tracking across assigned languages, including but not limited to Thai, Bahasa Indonesia, English, and other languages as required.

Assist in checking localized content for language-related issues, inconsistencies or terminology deviations during LQA review stages.

Coordinate with internal QA/LQA stakeholders and vendors on Thai language-related issues within the agreed project scope.

Support LQA reporting and quality feedback documentation for assigned Thai localization projects.

Requirements

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree preferably in Translation, Linguistics, Communications, Game Studies, Business Administration or a related discipline.

Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in the gaming industry, including at least 3 to 5 years in game localization, LQA, localization project coordination, translation project management or vendor coordination.

Experience working with external localization, translation or LQA vendors, including query handling, delivery tracking, feedback consolidation and issue escalation.

Experience supporting launched game titles or live/ongoing game localization projects will be an advantage.

Prior experience in PC, console, mobile game, entertainment, media or digital content localization will be highly relevant.

Language Skills

Professional fluency in Thai, with strong written and spoken proficiency and the ability to review Thai localization for tone, terminology, style, cultural appropriateness, consistency and player-facing language quality.

Strong professional proficiency in English for daily communication, reporting, documentation and coordination with regional stakeholders.

Professional proficiency in Japanese for regular communication and coordination with Japan-based stakeholders, including clarification of localization requirements, source content, terminology, cultural nuances, project queries and linguistic quality issues. JLPT N2 or equivalent proficiency is preferred.

Technical Skills

Familiarity with CAT tools, TMS or localization platforms such as memoQ, XLOC or equivalent systems.

Ability to manage translation memories, glossaries, terminology lists, issue trackers and project documentation accurately.

Familiarity with video game consoles. Able to maneuver and use debug functions.

Proficient in Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel, Copilot, Word and PowerPoint, for reporting, tracking and documentation.

Good understanding of game localization workflows, LQA processes, vendor coordination, issue tracking and delivery management.

Business & Functional Competencies

Strong understanding of Asian and Western gaming markets, player expectations, cultural sensitivities and game localization requirements.

Ability to coordinate multiple projects, schedules, stakeholders and vendors while maintaining quality and documentation discipline.

Ability to translate localization requirements into clear vendor instructions, action trackers and follow-up items.

Strong project tracking capability, including timelines, dependencies, risks, open issues and escalation points.

Ability to identify linguistic quality risks and provide practical feedback for improvement.

Behavioral Attributes

Meticulous, organised and highly attentive to detail.

Strong ownership and follow-through on assigned tasks, open issues and project deliverables.

Clear, respectful and professional communication style with both internal stakeholders and external vendors.

Able to manage multiple deadlines and priorities, especially during peak release or submission periods.

Proactive in documenting knowledge, improving workflows and supporting team continuity.

Able to work independently in an offsite arrangement while maintaining regular communication and reporting discipline.

Team player with a constructive, service-oriented and problem-solving mindset.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

This role requires relevant experience in game localization, LQA, localization project coordination, vendor communication and Thai linguistic quality review, together with strong attention to detail and project management skills.

Relevant experience includes coordinating with external localization and LQA vendors, reviewing Thai-language content for accuracy, terminology, tone and consistency, maintaining glossaries and translation memories, preparing project status reports, and tracking project issues, risks and deliverables.

Knowledge of game localization workflows, LQA processes, title-specific terminology and language assets, and experience working with cross-functional and regional stakeholders would be advantageous. Familiarity with Asian and Western gaming markets, player expectations and localization quality standards would also be relevant to the role.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work with well-loved Bandai Namco IPs and major PC/console game titles across Asia.

Exposure to regional localization workflows, external vendor coordination, LQA processes, and cross-market project communication.

Opportunity to contribute to the development of Thai localisation standards, glossaries, style guides, and title-specific knowledge assets.

A collaborative regional working environment with stakeholders across BNEAS and external localisation/LQA partners.

Bandai Namco Entertainment Asia Pte Ltd. part of Bandai Namco Holdings Inc., is a leading global publisher and developer of interactive content — including all major video game consoles, mobile and web.

The company is known for creating and publishing many of the industry’s top video game franchises including but not limited to PAC-MAN®, TEKKEN®, SOULCALIBUR®, NARUTO™, NARUTO SHIPPUDEN™, Dragon Ball®, GALAGA®, RIDGE RACER® and ACE COMBAT®. More information about the company and its products can be found at www.bandainamcoent.sg or www.facebook.com/BandaiNamcoEnt.Asia.

The Bandai Namco Group is a global entertainment operation represented in industries ranging from Toys, Games, Anime, Music to Amusement machines & facilities.

title: Corporate Paralegal (Fixed Term Contract)
description:
Contexte et environnement

The 12 months fixed-term contract position will be based in Singapore. Your internal counterparts will be based all across South East Asia and in France. TotalEnergies Renewables Singapore hub counts about 100 people of all horizons, jobs and ethnicities.

Activités

You have the opportunity to join TotalEnergies Renewables to take up the challenge of solar energy within the TotalEnergies group and to contribute to our objective of becoming leader in responsible energy produced, distributed and consumed on a global scale. The legal team in TotalEnergies Renewables, APAC situated in Singapore is looking to hire a Corporate Paralegal to form part of the Legal Department of the TotalEnergies Renewables Singapore hub and lead the other paralegals of the hub.

Activities

Specific scope of work will include:

· Liaising with and leading the other paralegals of the hub;

· Assistance of the Legal Counsels in administrative and corporate secretarial tasks;

· Assistance in the corporate activities of the hub including preparation and management of directors’ resolutions, shareholder resolutions, meeting minutes, and other corporate documentation;

· Assistance in the creation of new legal entities and/or M&A processes (creation of JVs, project or company acquisitions, consortiums, and/or other types of partnerships);

· Coordination with external law firms, external corporate secretaries, and internal legal resources across the region; and

· Help in management and archiving of contracts, contractual documents and/or official documents;

all of which will be done under the supervision of the Legal Counsels and in coordination with the other departments of the hub (finance, project finance, project development).

Accountabilities

While working under the supervision of the Legal Counsels in the Renewables APAC legal team at all times, the Corporate Paralegal will have daily links with all departments within the hub, as well as a number of other departments at the Company headquarters in France (Paris). Externally, the Corporate Paralegal will also have daily links with external law firms and counsels, as well as corporate secretary companies and official executants such as Notary Public.

She/He will have a strong capacity to organise herself/himself, and work in a timely, efficient and proactive manner, and to innovate in execution to meet internal requirements and deadlines. She/He must have corporate affairs and corporate governance awareness.

Profil du candidat

Qualification:

· Diploma in Law and Management, Legal Studies or Paralegal Studies, preferably with a focus on corporate/company law.

· Professional Track: Completed corporate secretarial examinations (e.g., CSIS/MAICSA) or holds a relevant local legal qualification.

· Jurisdictional Knowledge: Strong familiarity with the Singapore Companies Act and practical experience dealing with ACRA. Familiarity with company laws and filing systems in other SEA countries (e.g., SSM in Malaysia, OSS in Indonesia) is highly advantageous.

· Minimum of 4-year previous experience within a law firm or a legal or corporate secretarial professional services company required.

Technical: prior experience of corporate structuring /restructuring within a law firm or a corporation will be an advantage.

Character: Proactivity, innovative spirit, organisational and methodical skills will be required for this position.

Languages:

· English: full professional proficiency required.

· Mandarin Chinese, Malay, Thai, Vietnamese, and / or Japanese considered a plus.

title: Vice President, Thailand Wealth Business (Singapore-based)
description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore Team: Sales & Relationship Mgmt Job Requisition #: R264183 Date posted: Oct. 06, 2026
Job description

About this role

Thailand represents a strategic growth market for wealth management, supported by increasing affluence, evolving investor sophistication, expanding private wealth pools, and growing adoption of diversified investment solutions. The Thailand Wealth team is responsible for understanding market dynamics and client needs across Thailand’s wealth landscape and translating these into commercial opportunities for the business. The team partners with private banks, consumer banks, securities firms, insurance companies, digital wealth platforms, and asset management partners to deliver the breadth of BlackRock’s investment capabilities across active, index, ETFs, and alternatives.

Working closely with clients, the team develops tailored investment solutions that address evolving investor objectives while leveraging BlackRock's global investment platform, portfolio construction expertise, and technology capabilities. The role also partners extensively with regional and global colleagues to bring the full breadth of BlackRock's platform and insights to Thailand's wealth investors.

Job Purpose / Background

BlackRock⁠’s Thailand Wealth business is seeking a Vice President to lead and deepen relationships with key wealth clients in Thailand. The primary responsibility is to drive commercial engagement with clients, contribute to local wealth distribution strategy, and deliver business growth through high-quality client coverage, strategic partnership development, and investment solution positioning.

The role requires close collaboration across regional and global teams including product specialists, portfolio management, marketing, and client business functions across APAC, EMEA, and the US to deliver the firm’s capabilities to Thai wealth investors. You will be responsible for managing and growing strategic client relationships across private banks, retail banks, securities firms, insurance channels, and wealth platforms in Thailand. The role also involves identifying market trends, client needs, and commercial opportunities to support product development initiatives and broader business priorities. Success in this role requires delivering BlackRock’s value proposition and investment capabilities effectively to clients, while helping partners achieve their business objectives and better outcomes for end-investors.

Reporting to the Head of Thailand Client Business (or SEA Wealth leadership), the successful candidate should possess strong knowledge of Thailand’s wealth landscape, including key distributors and evolving investor trends. A solid understanding of investment products across mutual funds, ETFs, alternatives, and portfolio solutions is important, while familiarity with sustainable investing and private markets would be advantageous. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong commercial acumen, relationship management skills, and the ability to operate effectively within a highly matrixed, global organization. Intellectual curiosity, a growth mindset, and the ability to influence stakeholders internally and externally are critical for success in this role.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with the Thailand Client Business and broader APAC Wealth team to develop and execute the Thailand sales and client engagement strategy, with a focus on growing adoption of BlackRock⁠ investment solutions across wealth distribution channels. Build and deepen strategic relationships with key clients including private banks, retail banks, securities firms, insurance partners, and wealth platforms in Thailand.

Position and differentiate BlackRock’s investment capabilities, thought leadership, and product offerings against competitors in the Thai wealth market.

Demonstrate strong knowledge across investment solutions including mutual funds, ETFs, model portfolios, alternatives, and portfolio construction frameworks, and communicate these effectively to clients and internal stakeholders.

Identify new business opportunities by understanding evolving client needs, market trends, and regulatory developments within Thailand’s wealth industry.

Drive commercial outcomes through proactive client coverage, strategic account planning, and effective pipeline management.

Maintain a high level of market awareness and engage clients on investment themes, macroeconomic developments, and portfolio positioning ideas.

Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across investments, product, marketing, operations, and risk functions to deliver seamless client outcomes and strengthen client relationships.

Leverage the firm’s global platform and resources to broaden and deepen client engagement across priority accounts.

Maintain disciplined use of CRM systems and ensure timely documentation of client activities, opportunities, and engagement plans.

Ensure all client activities are conducted in compliance with applicable regulatory, legal, and internal risk management standards.

Support preparation of client presentations, business updates, strategic initiatives, and management reporting as required.

Experience / Qualifications

Minimum 6 years of experience in asset management, wealth management, private banking, or financial services, with a strong network across Thailand's wealth ecosystem.

Proven success in relationship management, business development, and driving investment solution adoption across wealth distribution channels.

Strong understanding of investment markets and products, including mutual funds, ETFs, discretionary solutions, and alternatives.

Commercially driven, with the ability to identify opportunities, generate market insights, and deliver client-focused solutions.

Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex investment concepts for diverse audiences.

Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with experience working across local, regional, and global teams.

Entrepreneurial, self-motivated, and results-oriented, with a commitment to delivering outstanding client outcomes.

Familiarity with Thailand's regulatory environment, fund industry, and distribution landscape preferred.

Fluency in Thai and English is required given the client-facing nature of the role and coverage of the Thailand market.

Bachelor's degree required; CFA and/or advanced degree preferred.

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Analyst, Real Estate and Data Centers
description:
About General Atlantic

General Atlantic is a leading global investor with more than four and a half decades of experience providing capital and strategic support for over 885 companies throughout its history. Established in 1980, General Atlantic continues to be a dedicated partner to visionary founders and investors seeking to build dynamic businesses and create lasting value. Guided by the conviction that entrepreneurs can be incredible agents of transformational change, the firm combines a collaborative global approach, sector specific expertise, a long-term investment horizon, and a deep understanding of growth drivers to partner with and scale innovative businesses around the world. The firm leverages its patient capital, operational expertise, and global platform to support a diversified investment platform spanning Growth Equity, Infrastructure, and Strategic Solutions. General Atlantic manages approximately $126 billion in assets under management, inclusive of all strategies, as of March 31, 2026, with more than 900 professionals in 20 countries across five regions. For more information on General Atlantic, please visit www.generalatlantic.com.

About Actis

In October 2024, General Atlantic acquired Actis, which now operates as its Sustainable Infrastructure business alongside its existing strategies in Growth Equity, Credit, and Climate. Actis is a leading global investor in sustainable infrastructure, delivering competitive returns for institutional investors and measurable positive impact for the countries, cities and communities in which it operates. Actis invests in structural themes that support long-term, equitable growth in defensive, critical infrastructure across energy transition, digitalization transition, and supply chain transformation. The firm’s decades of global experience, operational know-how and strong culture allows it to create global sustainability leaders at scale. Since inception, Actis has raised $26 billion to invest in a better tomorrow. Actis is a signatory to the United Nations backed Principles for Responsible Investment (UNPRI), an investor initiative developed by the UNEP FI. The firm has consistently been awarded the highest rating score in the UNPRI independent assessment. You can learn more about Actis at www.act.is.

Position Description

General Atlantic is looking to hire an Analyst to support the Actis Southeast Asia Real Estate team, based in Singapore. This is a small, high-ownership team investing in real assets across the region: the Analyst will work on live transactions from first screen through to structuring, financing, asset management and exit, rather than a single slice of the process.

You will build and own the models that underpin pricing and structuring decisions, run defined diligence workstreams with external advisers, and draft the memoranda that go to Investment Committee. The work is quantitative, commercially exposed and visible to senior members of the firm from day one.

Why This Role

Ownership from day one. In a small Singapore team, the Analyst owns models, diligence workstreams and adviser relationships directly
The full lifecycle. Origination, underwriting, structuring, debt financing, asset management and exit
Real assets, real complexity. Development and operating risk, project-level debt, joint venture and platform structures, and multiple Southeast Asian jurisdictions — technical ground that compounds into a durable specialism
Senior access and a defined path. Direct working exposure to Managing Directors and Principals

Responsibilities

Build and own asset- and platform-level financial models — development and operating cash flows, project finance debt sizing, joint venture waterfalls and returns analysis — and run the sensitivities that inform pricing and structuring decisions
Draft investment memoranda and Investment Committee presentations, translating diligence findings into a clear investment case with risks and mitigants set out plainly
Run defined due diligence workstreams end to end — commercial, technical, legal, tax and insurance — coordinating external advisers, tracking issues to resolution and escalating what matters
Support capital structuring and debt raising, including lender materials, base and downside cases, and covenant and debt service coverage analysis
Maintain the team’s market evidence base: supply and demand, rents and yields, land pricing, comparable transactions, buyer appetite and exit routes across the region
Conduct proprietary primary research through calls with operators, developers, occupiers, consultants and other industry contacts
Work alongside Managing Directors, Principals and portfolio company management on value creation — budget review, capital expenditure tracking, performance reporting and asset-level initiatives
Support origination: screening opportunities, preparing early-stage pricing views and keeping the pipeline current

The First Twelve Months

By month three you should be able to build a development cash flow model from a blank sheet and defend the assumptions in it. By month six you should be running a diligence workstream with limited supervision and drafting sections of an Investment Committee paper. By month twelve you should be the person on the team who knows the market data best and be trusted to take an adviser call alone.

Join our team and play a pivotal role in building General Atlantic’s real estate and sustainable infrastructure footprint in Southeast Asia. If you are a results-oriented professional with a passion for real assets and investing, we invite you to apply.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Finance, Business, Accounting, Economics, Engineering or a related field
1+ years of full-time relevant experience required (investment banking or private equity preferred; consulting or relevant operating experience will also be considered)
Superior financial modelling skills: able to build, audit and stress-test complex models from a blank sheet with minimal guidance
Strong understanding of accounting principles and the ability to read financial statements critically
Strong analytical ability, sound commercial judgement and professional maturity
Advanced Microsoft Excel; strong PowerPoint and Word
A clear communicator who can hold a view and defend it with evidence, and change it when the evidence changes; verbal and written fluency in English.
Comfortable with regular travel across Southeast Asia
Record of outstanding academic and professional achievement, high energy, and a real interest in investing
Collaborative and intellectually curious about how assets, markets and capital structures actually behave

Preferred

CFA Level II or Level III candidate or charterholder, or comparable evidence of quantitative discipline
Exposure to real estate, infrastructure, project finance or another real asset class — including development, construction or operating assets
Experience working directly with external advisers, lenders or joint venture partners
An additional Southeast Asian language (Vietnamese, Bahasa Malaysia or Indonesia, Thai or Mandarin) is advantageous, but not required

Attributes we look for

You check your own work, flag your own errors early, and understand that a number in an Investment Committee paper carries your judgement with it
Proactive and low-ego, with a genuine willingness to pick up the unglamorous work
A clear communicator who can hold a view and defend it with evidence, and change it when the evidence changes
Intellectually curious about how assets, markets and capital structures actually behave
Record of outstanding academic and professional achievement
High energy, and a real interest in investing
Keen to collaborate with colleagues across the firm globally

GA Values

Competitive compensation, including a performance-linked bonus
Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage
Retirement savings provision in line with local statutory requirements and market practice
Support for professional development and qualifications, including structured training
Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for advancement

Process

Please apply with your CV and a short note (no more than half a page) on an asset, sector or transaction you find interesting and why. Shortlisted candidates will complete a timed modelling exercise and meet the Singapore team as well as senior members of the global Real Estate and Sustainable Infrastructure platform.

General Atlantic is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

By completing this application, you are consenting to General Atlantic’s processing and use of your personal data. Information on how General Atlantic will use and process your data can be found here: https://www.generalatlantic.com/privacy-notice/

2 years of experience with software development using Python or related coding languages.
Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)).
Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.
Experience taking production-grade AI solutions from conception to launch for customers.
Ability to communicate in Thai and English fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, Agent Development Kit (ADK)) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).

Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.
Responsibilities
Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including Application Programming Interface (APIs), legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.

Be able to co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.
Translate technical concepts to non-technical executive and Thai-speaking audiences.

title: Software Sales Executive (Thailand)
description:
Join HashMicro, a leading software development company revolutionizing the business landscape. We specialize in providing customized and scalable software solutions tailored to specific industries, including ERP, CRM, HRM, and inventory management systems.

With a focus on simplicity and user-friendliness, our solutions empower businesses to optimize operations, make data-driven decisions, and achieve success. Join our team of dedicated professionals, and be part of a supportive and innovative environment where your skills are valued, and you can make a meaningful impact on the industry.

We are looking for a driven Software Sales Executive with a passion for B2B or IT SaaS sales to drive revenue growth and achieve sales targets. In this role, you will manage prospects and close deals through meetings, presentations, and consistent follow-ups. Beyond closing sales, you will be developed to understand B2B sales workflows and build strong, long-term client relationships by identifying and addressing client needs. You will also prepare sales reports and forecasts for management, while staying up to date with market trends, emerging opportunities, new products, and competitor activity.

description:
Inside Sales Account Executive, Matterport - Singapore

Job Description

COSTAR GROUP – INSIDE SALES ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, MATTERPORT - SINGAPORE

OVERVIEW

CoStar Group is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S&P 500 Index, CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and connections that improve their businesses and lives.

We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings to our customers. ABOUT MATTERPORT

Matterport, part of the CoStar Group, is leading the digital transformation of the built world. Our ground-breaking spatial computing platform turns buildings into data making every space more valuable and accessible. Millions of buildings in more than 177 countries have been transformed into immersive Matterport digital twins to improve every part of the building lifecycle from planning, construction, and operations to documentation, appraisal, and marketing.

Learn more about Matterport.

DESCRIPTION

As an Inside Sales Account Executive at Matterport, you will be part of a fast-growing, high-velocity sales organization responsible for helping customers across industries digitize their buildings, streamline operations, and unlock measurable business value through Matterport’s leading 3D digital twin platform.

You will run a full-cycle sales motion—prospecting, discovery, demos, pricing, negotiation, and closing—in a high-activity environment where speed, precision, and strong communication are critical. You’ll speak daily with customers in industries such as Architecture, Engineering & Construction, Facilities Management, Corporate Real Estate, Industrial/Manufacturing, Retail, Hospitality, and Insurance/Restoration.

You’ll work closely with Sales Enablement and your Regional Director to master Matterport’s sales frameworks, sharpen your outbound skills, deliver strong discovery, and run efficient, consultative sales cycles. As one of the first hires in our expanding Inside Sales organization, you’ll help shape the culture, standards, and execution rhythms of a team built to scale. Your mission: create pipeline, convert conversations, close business, and help customers experience the impact of digitizing the built world - fast.

This role is on-site five days a week in our office on McCallum Street.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Run a full cycle inside sales process, including prospecting, discovery, demos, pricing, negotiation, and closing.

Generate your own pipeline, using outbound calls, emails, sequences, and follow-up to reach decision-makers .

Drive new customer acquisition through a mix of inbound follow-up and outbound prospecting.

Manage a fast-paced pipeline, balancing new opportunities daily while keeping active deals moving efficiently.

Conduct high-quality discovery calls, uncovering customer pain points, workflows, and use cases that demonstrate the value of Matterport’s platform.

Deliver polished product demonstrations that map customer needs to Matterport’s capabilities and ROI drivers.

Follow structured sales frameworks to deliver clear, disciplined, high-impact conversations.

Collaborate with your Regional Director and Sales Enablement for coaching, call reviews, skill development, and rapid improvement.

Maintain CRM accuracy - updating activities, opportunities, next steps, and forecasting data with precision.

Partner with cross-functional teams (Product, Marketing, Support) to deliver exceptional customer experience and accelerate deals.

Achieve monthly and quarterly revenue targets while maintaining high activity and strong conversion rates.

Represent Matterport with professionalism, continuously reinforcing our values and delivering customer-first engagement.

QUALIFICATIONS

Demonstrable B2B sales experience, ideally in inside sales, SaaS, or a high-velocity sales environment.

Demonstrated success in roles requiring high outbound activity, pipeline generation, and consistent quota attainment.

Strong communication and presentation skills - confident on the phone, on Teams/Zoom, and in demos.

Experience running short sales cycles, balancing multiple deals, and driving urgency with clarity.

Highly coachable with a strong desire to improve quickly and master modern sales skills.

Strong organizational discipline - accurate forecasting, CRM management, and time prioritization.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

A track record of commitment to prior employers.

Operates with high degree of integrity.

Some travel to deepen customer relationships and execute a high-touch sales strategy.

PREFERRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

Experience selling SaaS or technology solutions to AEC, Facilities Management, CRE, Industrial/Manufacturing, Insurance/Restoration, Retail, or related industries.

Professional level English is essential alongside Korean or Thai.

Proven ability to build pipeline independently through outbound efforts.

Experience with Salesforce.com, Gong, Clari, or similar sales tools.

Strong storytelling and value articulation skills - able to explain complex ideas simply.

A high-energy, positive presence that contributes to a competitive, supportive team environment.

Passion for learning and mastering new technologies and sales frameworks.

Comfort operating in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Working at CoStar Group means you'll enjoy a culture of collaboration and innovation that attracts the best and brightest across a broad range of disciplines . You will enjoy an outstanding working environment, equipped to help you to be your best .

title: Business Development Manager, South Asia
description:
Company Overview:

Verathon is a global medical device company focused on supporting customers by being their trusted partner, delivering high-quality products that endure over time and ensure clinical and economic utility. Two areas where Verathon has significantly impacted patient care, and become the market leader in each, are bladder volume measurement and airway management. The company’s BladderScan portable ultrasound and GlideScope video laryngoscopy & bronchoscopy systems effectively address unmet needs for healthcare providers and meaningfully raise the standard of care for patients. Verathon, a subsidiary of Roper Technologies, is headquartered in Bothell, Washington, USA and has international subsidiaries in Canada, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit www.verathon.com.

Overview:

This is a commercial execution role — a genuine product expert with sharp market knowledge who can hold their own in a distributor sales meeting, a hospital tender review, or a pricing negotiation. The BDM owns the performance of Verathon's distributor network across Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, and the Philippines — markets significantly underpenetrated relative to Verathon's global footprint, with substantial room to grow.

The VP of Asia retains final contract ownership; this role drives the day-to-day commercial work, measured on three things:

Finding the right partners — identifying and recommending distributors who can perform in-market
Educating and influencing them — building partner sales teams' clinical and commercial capability
Holding them accountable — to forecasting, pricing, and revenue targets, including compliant conduct in government and tender dealings

Best suited to someone who has managed distributor performance before and drives outcomes through product credibility and follow-through rather than a direct reporting line.

Responsibilities:

Partner Identification & Selection (~10%)

Identify, evaluate, and recommend distributor partners across all five markets based on market reach, capability, and strategic fit
Lead due diligence before onboarding; ensure new distributors are approved by Verathon's Quality organization per regulatory requirements
Continuously assess the distributor network and evolve the partner mix as the business grows

Distributor Negotiation & Commercial Terms (~15%)

Negotiate distributor pricing and discounts within Verathon's GDLP framework and delegated authority; escalate requests outside standard parameters to the VP of Asia
Manage agreements using Verathon's standard contract templates; recommend non-standard terms for the VP of Asia's review — the VP of Asia retains contract ownership and sign-off
Ensure all pricing and contracting activity aligns with Pricing Committee governance

Partner Education & Influence (~25%)

Design and deliver training on Verathon's Airway and Urology portfolio for distributor sales and clinical teams; partner with Marketing on product launches so teams are trained and equipped ahead of time
Build referral networks and a repeatable onboarding/certification framework to accelerate adoption and ramp new reps quickly
Provide direct clinical/technical support during evaluations and case reviews; develop "local champions" who can carry product advocacy independently

Partner Accountability & Performance Management (~20%)

Hold partners accountable to forecasting discipline, pricing execution, and revenue targets through structured business reviews; drive corrective action when targets or contractual commitments are missed
Address underperformance proactively and constructively, escalating to the VP of Asia when more significant partnership changes are warranted
Monitor partners on an ongoing basis for competitive conflicts of interest and for compliance with anti-corruption/anti-bribery requirements in government and tender dealings; escalate immediately if issues arise
Own forecast input and pipeline visibility (Salesforce/CRM); drive revenue growth and margin discipline together, not one at the expense of the other

Tender & Public Bid Management (~10%)

Own end-to-end tender/RFP strategy for public and institutional healthcare bids across all five markets, from opportunity identification through submission
Build TCO models and health economic value dossiers to justify premium pricing in cost-constrained, GPO-driven public healthcare systems
Coordinate with distributor teams, Legal, and Regulatory on bid compliance; develop competitive bid positioning with Commercial Ops and Pricing
Track win/loss outcomes and tender pipeline as a standing input to quarterly business reviews

Stakeholder Relationships & Market Intelligence (~15%)

Build relationships with KOLs, reference sites, healthcare institutions, government health agencies, regulatory bodies, and professional societies relevant to market access and tender success
Represent Verathon at regional conferences and industry events
Monitor competitive activity (e.g., Ambu, Olympus) and market dynamics; champion digital/AI tools to improve territory planning, forecasting, and distributor productivity
Deliver structured quarterly business reviews to the VP of Asia — what's working, what isn't, and what needs escalation

Cross-Functional Operational Support (~5%)

Coordinate with Customer Care, Technical Service, Finance, and Marketing to keep distributor operations running smoothly — order flow, service issues, credit terms, and product end-of-life transitions
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Business, Life Sciences, Healthcare, or related field
5–7 years of experience in business development, channel/distributor management, or commercial roles within medical devices, capital equipment, or healthcare
Strong product and clinical knowledge of relevant device categories (airway management, urology, or comparable surgical/endoscopy equipment) — sufficient to train and hold credibility with distributor teams and clinicians directly
Demonstrated ability to navigate healthcare regulatory, tender/RFP, and pricing/contract processes across multiple SE Asia markets, including building health economic/TCO value propositions for GPO and tender wins
Experience selecting, negotiating with, and managing performance of distributor/channel partners within standardized pricing/contract frameworks — this is not a bag-carrying rep role
Comfortable operating across multiple countries and cultures without a local reporting structure; working knowledge of anti-corruption/anti-bribery compliance requirements (e.g., FCPA)
Fluent English required; Bahasa, Thai, or Tagalog a strong plus
Willing and able to travel regionally, often on short notice

Preferred

Track record of building training or certification programs from scratch
Experience managing distributor transitions without disrupting revenue continuity
Existing market knowledge/relationships within Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, or the Philippines healthcare systems
"Customer first" mentality — proactive service orientation with clinicians and distributor partners, not just quota focus

Success Metrics (First 12 Months)

Partner Selection: Quality/fit of newly recommended partners (ramp speed, early performance); time-to-resolution on underperforming relationships
Education & Influence: Distributor training/certification completion rates; adoption metrics for priority products
Accountability: Revenue growth and margin performance by country vs. target; forecast accuracy; pricing/contract compliance; zero unresolved compliance red flags; tender win rate and pipeline generated

Skills

Business Development, Distributor Management, Channel Sales, Partner Selection & Due Diligence, Pricing Strategy, Contract Negotiation, Health Economics & TCO Modeling, Anti-Corruption Compliance, Conflict of Interest Monitoring, Clinical Education, Sales Training, Territory Planning, Tender & RFP Management, Public Procurement, Key Account Management, KOL Engagement, Government & Regulatory Relations, Relationship Building, Market Research, Competitive Intelligence, Product Launch Support, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Performance Management, Salesforce/CRM Reporting, Negotiation, Medical Device Sales, Southeast Asia Market Expertise
