title: Group Procurement Director
description:
Group Procurement Director

Oatside · Singapore (Group HQ) · Full-time

About Oatside

Oatside is Asia's #1 oat milk brand, headquartered in Singapore and sold across 19 markets. We own and operate our manufacturing in Chonburi, Thailand and in Indonesia, with further capacity expansion underway. We are a fast-scaling, founder-led business moving toward institutional-grade governance, and procurement is one of the biggest levers we have on margin, supply security and quality.

The role

The Group Procurement Director owns all third-party spend across the group — direct materials, packaging, indirect and capex — and leads our procurement teams in Indonesia and Thailand from Singapore. You will take a centre-led procurement model that has been designed and make it real: consistent category strategies, one supplier base managed to group standards, hard savings that show up in the P&L, and supply continuity for a business that cannot afford a line to stop.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will personally lead the largest categories and the most important supplier relationships while building the capability of the local teams.

Reports to:

CEO

Direct reports:

Country procurement leads procurement teams across Indonesia and Thailand covering all direct and indirect spends and procurement operations.

Location:

Singapore, with regular travel to Thailand and Indonesia (~30–40%)

What you'll do

Strategy and governance

Own the group procurement strategy, operating model and annual plan; run the centre-led model with clear splits between group categories and local buying.

Own the spend taxonomy, procurement policy, delegation of authority and sourcing governance — fit for a company preparing for public-market scrutiny.

Report procurement performance (savings, cost avoidance, supplier OTIF, quality, working capital) to the leadership team monthly.

Category and supplier management

Lead sourcing for the critical direct categories: oats and oat ingredients, packaging (aseptic carton, PET, closures, secondary), other ingredients and co-packing.

Lead indirect and capex procurement, including major equipment purchases and construction/projects for capacity expansion.

Build multi-year category strategies with a clear view of cost drivers, market dynamics, dual-sourcing and supply risk.

Own strategic supplier relationships: contracts, performance management, quality issues, disputes and exits. Structure supply agreements with proper quality specifications, remedies and termination rights.

Drive commodity and FX risk management for key inputs in partnership with Finance.

Team and capability

Lead, develop and align the Thailand and Indonesia procurement teams; set common ways of working, KPIs and career paths.

Build capability in negotiation, should-cost analysis, contracting and supplier quality.

Partner closely with Manufacturing & Engineering, Quality, R&D, Finance and Commercial so procurement is embedded early in NPD, capex and budget decisions.

Systems and process

Drive procure-to-pay discipline in NetSuite: PO compliance, supplier master data, contract repository, spend visibility.

Introduce fit-for-purpose tools for sourcing events, supplier scorecards and savings tracking.

What we're looking for

10+ years in procurement, with at least 5 years leading a multi-country procurement function in food & beverage or FMCG manufacturing.

Deep direct-materials experience — ingredients (grains/dairy alternatives a strong plus) and packaging, ideally including aseptic/Tetra Pak and PET.

Track record of building or transforming a procurement function in a scale-up or post-acquisition environment, not just running a mature one.

Strong commercial and contracting skills; comfortable leading complex negotiations and handling supplier disputes and quality failures.

Capex and project procurement experience (equipment, construction, greenfield/brownfield builds).

Experience operating in Southeast Asia, especially Thailand and Indonesia; understands local supplier markets, regulatory and import dynamics.

Analytically rigorous — should-cost modelling, total cost of ownership, commodity market analysis.

Comfortable with ERP-driven P2P processes (NetSuite a plus).

Senior leadership presence: able to work directly with the CEO and leadership team, and to lead remotely across cultures.

Fluent English; Thai or Bahasa Indonesia an advantage.

Willing to travel regularly to our plants.

What success looks like in 18 months

Group procurement operating model fully live, with every major category under a group strategy and a named owner.

Measurable, Finance-validated savings against a baseline; improved payment terms and inventory position.

No unplanned supply interruptions on critical materials; dual sources qualified for the top-risk inputs.

Supplier contracts, specifications and performance management in place for all strategic suppliers.

A cohesive, capable regional team that operates as one function.

Why join

Own a full-scope procurement function at Asia's category leader during its highest-growth period.

Direct line of sight to the CEO and to the decisions that shape the company's next phase.

Competitive package including equity participation.

Adjust the reporting line, travel % and remuneration details as needed. If you'd like, I can put this in a doc you can share with recruiters or the leadership team.

title: Solutions Engineer, DoiT Cloud Intelligence — Thai Speaking
description:
Location: Our Solutions Engineer, DoiT Cloud Intelligence, will be an integral part of our Solutions Engineering / Field Engineering team in APAC. This role is based remotely in APJ timezone, and requires native-level Thai language fluency to serve our Thai customers, prospects, and AWS field teams.

Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company empowering cloud-driven organizations to achieve business growth and innovation through strategic cloud utilization. We blend data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state, from initial planning to full-scale production.
With extensive experience across various cloud environments, we possess deep specializations in Cloud Data Platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery, as well as FinOps expertise. As a trusted and award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we proudly support over 4,000 customers worldwide.
Our flagship offering is DoiT Cloud Intelligence (DCI), which uniquely combines advanced technology with human insight, enabling us to solve complex multicloud challenges and drive significant efficiency for our clients.

The DoiT Cloud Intelligence platform:

Provides deep visibility into cloud cost, usage, performance, and optimization opportunities across complex multi-cloud environments, enabling organizations to make data-driven infrastructure decisions.
Combines automation, analytics, and expert guidance to identify savings opportunities, improve resource efficiency, and continuously optimize cloud investments at scale.
Powers Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Systems Integrators (SIs), and Private Equity (PE) operating teams with portfolio-level insights, benchmarking, and operational tooling to manage multiple cloud environments effectively.
Goes beyond reporting by delivering prescriptive recommendations and automated workflows that help engineering, finance, and platform teams turn cloud intelligence into measurable operational and financial outcomes.

The Opportunity

As a Solutions Engineer supporting DoiT Cloud Intelligence in Thailand, you will be the hands-on technical face of DoiT in the local market. Partnering with Account Executives, Customer Success, and the AWS field team, you will help Thai enterprises, digital natives, MSPs, and Systems Integrators unlock actionable insights across their AWS and multi-cloud environments — driving cost efficiency, operational visibility, and smarter cloud decision-making through DCI.
This is a growth-oriented Field Engineering role. You are chartered to drive DCI and product adoption through high-impact technical sales plays, measurable revenue growth, partner-led pipeline, new logo acquisition, and upsell/cross-sell motions. You will sit at the intersection of customers, cloud platforms, and our product — an embedded technical partner inside the account team rather than a reactive support resource.

Responsibilities

Technical Qualification & Discovery: Collaborate with the Account Executive to thoroughly understand the prospect's cloud environment, FinOps maturity, cost management challenges, and operational goals through in-depth technical discovery sessions across engineering, finance, and platform teams.
Technical Validation & POV Leadership: Own and drive technical validation and Proof of Value (POV) exercises for DoiT Cloud Intelligence, including POV preparation, proactive management, and ensuring successful technical outcomes that demonstrate clear value and alignment with prospect requirements.
Platform Demonstrations: Develop and deliver compelling, tailored demonstrations of DCI in Thai and English, showcasing cloud cost visibility, optimization insights, and operational intelligence across complex multi-cloud environments.
Business Case & ROI Development: Leverage your understanding of cloud economics and FinOps to build business cases and ROI analyses that clearly articulate the financial and operational impact of adopting DCI, for both engineering and executive audiences.
AWS Partner-Led Growth: Work with AWS field teams and local partners on co-sell motions, partner-sourced pipeline, and accelerator programs — including GenAI, Migration Acceleration Program (MAP), and Well-Architected Framework Review (WAFR) engagements. Support GTM initiatives that convert partner relationships into qualified opportunities.
Hands-On Cloud Engineering: Act as a trusted cloud engineer who designs and helps implement improvements in cost efficiency, resilience, security posture, and operational automation. Lead structured technical engagements such as optimization sessions, reliability and security reviews, architecture deep dives, migration assessments, and Well-Architected style assessments.
DCI Power User & Expertise: Become the go-to expert for DoiT Cloud Intelligence in the region: build analytics and cost allocation views, surface cost and risk opportunities, write Composer queries, create CloudFlow automations, and embed DCI into customer observability, governance, and CI/CD workflows.
Partner & Portfolio Motion Support (MSP, PE, SI): Support technical engagements with MSPs, PE firms, and SIs by demonstrating how DCI enables portfolio-level visibility, operational insight across multiple cloud environments, and scalable optimization strategies.
Technical Win Ownership: Take full ownership of the technical win for DCI engagements — guiding prospects through evaluation, addressing technical requirements, and building confidence in the platform's ability to drive cloud efficiency and operational insight.
Reusable Assets & Enablement. Convert field work into reusable assets: playbooks, Terraform modules, automations, architecture diagrams, internal tooling, and documented patterns. Create external-facing technical content such as webinars, workshops, and customer enablement sessions in Thai.
Event & Conference Presentations. Represent DoiT and DCI at local and regional events, AWS events, webinars, and industry conferences, delivering engaging presentations and demonstrations.
Product Feedback & Customer Advocacy. Translate customer pain points, partner requirements, and feature gaps into structured, technically credible input for Product and Engineering, helping shape the evolution of the Cloud Intelligence platform. Represent the voice of the Thai and APAC technical customer in roadmap discussions.
Accurate, Timely Documentation. Ensure timely entry of data into internal business support systems and contribute to the tools and metrics that highlight business performance and effectiveness.

About You

You are an accomplished Solutions Engineer or hands-on cloud architect with customer-facing experience, ideally in a B2B SaaS or cloud consulting environment. You are a native Thai speaker who can move fluidly between a Thai-language executive conversation and an English-language technical deep dive with a global product team.
You are excited about enabling companies to transform themselves using the public cloud, and you hold yourself accountable for the success of any initiative you are involved in. You want to be part of a high-performance, growth-focused organization and you enjoy winning against the competition. You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative, entrepreneurial, remote-first environment across multiple time zones.

Qualifications

Native-level Thai fluency (spoken and written) with professional working proficiency in English.

5+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating production workloads on AWS (experience with GCP or Azure is a strong plus), with the ability to reason across compute, storage, networking, IAM, and observability.
Experience in a customer-facing technical role — Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre-Sales Engineering, or Field/Forward Deployed Engineering — selling or delivering into enterprise and mid-market accounts.
Depth in at least one technical domain: cloud infrastructure, data & analytics, or ML/GenAI.
Practical FinOps and cloud cost management judgment: the ability to explain cost-versus-performance-versus-reliability tradeoffs to both engineers and finance/leadership stakeholders.
Practical observability experience: monitoring, logging, and alerting, and an understanding of tools in the ecosystem such as Datadog, New Relic, ServiceNow, and cloud-native equivalents.
An automation mindset with coding or scripting ability, plus hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and CI/CD tooling.
Strong data analysis skills and comfort navigating large data sets and spreadsheets to identify trends, outliers, correlations, and reconciliation needs.
The ability to take complex pieces of technology and explain them in a simple, easy-to-understand way.
Solid verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills, including experience presenting to executive-level prospects and customers.
Comfort working in a metric-driven environment, reporting on and improving business performance against monthly KPIs.
Experience working in an account-team model across multiple functions (AE, CSM, AM, TAM) and time zones.
Intellectual curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and a passion for continuous improvement.

Bonus Points

AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Professional, Advanced Networking, Machine Learning) or FinOps Certified Practitioner.
Prior experience working with or alongside AWS partner programs (MAP, WAFR, GenAI accelerators) or within an AWS Partner / MSP / SI.
Background in FinOps, SRE, or platform engineering.
Experience with cloud cost management or cloud intelligence platforms such as DCI.
Datacenter and hypervisor experience (e.g. VMware) in the context of migration to cloud.
Experience with modern technical selling best practices, including trial, demo, POV, and RFP processes.
Contributions to open source, public speaking, community leadership, or internal enablement.
Track record of success in a fast-growing and scaling business.

Are you a Do'er?

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.
What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.
We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

Unlimited Vacation
Flexible Working Options
Health Insurance
Parental Leave
Employee Stock Option Plan
Home Office Allowance
Professional Development Stipend
Peer Recognition Program

Many Do'ers, One Team
DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal — it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

title: Regional Product Manager
description:
Medline - Together, Advancing Healthcare
Medline is a healthcare company–a manufacturer, distributor and so much more, doing business in more than 125 countries and territories around the world. We provide the quality medical products and solutions our customers need to deliver their best care to every person in every care setting.
Medline is committed to reducing our carbon footprint, developing responsible products, supporting our employees and local communities, and promoting high ethical standards internally and among our supplier partners. Click here to discover what Medline is doing to make healthcare more sustainable for people and the planet.

Job Summary

The Regional Product Manager – Operating Room & Peri-Operative Solutions is responsible for driving the regional product management agenda and leading the strategic management of a portfolio of products and solutions supporting the Operating Room (OR) and peri-operative care environment across Southeast Asia.
The role focuses on identifying market opportunities, generating actionable insights, and translating them into effective portfolio and go-to-market strategies that enhance customer value and support sustainable business growth. The incumbent will develop a deep understanding of surgical workflows, patient pathways, customer needs, market dynamics, and competitive landscapes to ensure the portfolio remains relevant and differentiated across diverse healthcare systems.
Acting as a critical link between Global Product Divisions, regional teams, distributors, and in-market stakeholders, the incumbent will drive product readiness, launch excellence, portfolio optimisation, and commercial execution across Southeast Asia.
Success in this role requires strong strategic thinking, commercial acumen, stakeholder influence, and the ability to operate effectively in a matrix organisation. The individual will build strong partnerships across functions and markets, support capability development within the commercial organisation, and contribute to Medline’s long-term growth strategy within the Operating Room & Peri-Operative Solutions portfolio.

Job Description

Responsibilities:

Identify and develop new products and manage each stage of the process through take to market.

Develop and implement comprehensive marketing plans and promotional programs for existing products to include product strategy development, pricing strategy, collateral creation and brand management.

Review monthly financial performance and determine contributing factors. Offer solutions for detrimental sales or cost trends. Prepare product forecasts to include revenue and expense expectations. Analyze sales trends over time and impact of competitive strategies. Support forecasts and budgets with appropriately detailed marketing plans.

Work with Manufacturing, Purchasing and Engineering to reduce Cost of Goods by assessing packaging, alternate materials, new sources of material, stocking, make to order, direct to customer shipments, etc. Manage inventory by focusing on eliminating surplus and optimizing SKU count. May negotiate pricing with vendors for raw materials and finished goods. Visit vendors to develop products and train personnel all aspects of each product and usages. Coordinate materials with vendors and develop finished custom items.

Analyze and bid on GPO and/or Integrated Delivery Network contracts for assigned product categories.

Develop and deliver training materials for internal stakeholders, sales forces and customers. Create sales tools.

Conduct market research and translate that research into new products, product improvements, or line extensions by providing leadership to a multi-functional team.

Travel with sales force to support efforts to convert customers to purchase Medline products. Provide timely follow up to sales forces by answering product questions via e-mail and phone.

Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field, with advanced degrees being advantageous.
Minimum 5 years of experience in product management, marketing, or commercial roles within the healthcare, medical device, or life sciences industry.
Experience supporting products used within the Operating Room and peri-operative care environment, with a strong understanding of surgical workflows, clinical practices, customer needs, and healthcare purchasing dynamics.
Demonstrated ability in strategic thinking, business analysis, and translating insights into actionable growth plans.
Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across cross-functional and multicultural teams.
Experience working with distributors and managing indirect markets within Southeast Asia is highly desirable.
Strong communication, presentation, and storytelling skills to engage both internal and external stakeholders effectively.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Self-driven, proactive, and capable of managing responsibilities independently with a strong sense of ownership.
Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data interpretation and tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, and other business intelligence platforms.
Willingness and flexibility to travel frequently across Southeast Asia as required.
Proficiency in additional regional languages such as Mandarin, Bahasa or Thai is considered a strong advantage to communicate with in country distributors.

What we will offer you

• Hybrid working environment
• Comprehensive Health Benefits including access to dedicated Employee Assistant Program
• Learning & Development opportunities in a diverse and inclusive workplace
and much more!

Belonging at Medline

It takes every team member for us to succeed. At Medline you can expect to feel respected, enjoy your work, reach your potential, and be given the opportunity to do more - and go further. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome your unique contribution regardless of your culture, ethnicity, life stage, race, gender identity, disability, or religious beliefs.

title: Senior Project Manager - Human Resources
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a strategic and results-driven

Senior Project Manager, Human Resources

to lead and deliver complex HR programs across the Asia Pacific region. In this role, you will partner with HR Centers of Excellence, regional HR teams, and business leaders to manage key initiatives including talent programs, employee experience, workforce transformation, HR technology, compliance, and operational excellence projects.

Success in this role requires strong project management expertise, exceptional stakeholder management skills, and the ability to navigate diverse cultural, regulatory, and business environments across APAC. The ideal candidate is comfortable leading global initiatives while adapting execution approaches to meet local market needs.

Key Responsibilities:

HR Project Leadership:

Lead end-to-end execution of regional and global HR initiatives, including talent management, employee experience, organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, HR technology implementations, benefits programs, and compliance-related projects.

Regional Stakeholder Partnership:

Build strong partnerships with HR leaders, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams across multiple countries and cultures to drive alignment, decision-making, and successful project outcomes.

Global Program Deployment:

Support the localization and execution of global HR programs within all markets, ensuring alignment with regional business requirements and local regulations.

Change & Transformation Management:

Lead organizational change and workforce transformation initiatives, developing implementation strategies that drive adoption, minimize disruption, and enable successful business outcomes.

Risk & Compliance:

Ensure HR projects align with labor laws, data privacy regulations, and company policies, mitigating risks related to compliance and employee relations through partnership with Legal and Compliance teams.

Resource Planning & Delivery Management:

Manage project timelines, dependencies, resources, and delivery plans to ensure successful execution and achievement of business objectives.

Governance & Reporting:

Establish project governance, executive reporting, and performance metrics that provide visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and business outcomes. Prepare and deliver executive-level communications and presentations to support decision-making and stakeholder alignment.

Opportunity to play a key role in scaling Sitecore’s presence across high-growth Asian markets

You’ll own our social end to end, filming in our studios, editing, designing, posting, replying, and telling us what’s working. You'll also design what customers see everywhere else. Emails, marketplace listings, website visuals and in-studio collateral.
What You’ll Do
Film & Photograph:
● Run batched shoot days across our two studios

● Screen-record and capture scalp scan imagery as a repeatable content format
● Keep the raw asset library organised, named and backed up
Edit & Design:

● Design website banners, product imagery and landing page visuals
● Design in-studio collateral when we need it. Price displays, treatment menus, posters
● Keep everytouchpoint consistent, so the ad, the email, the listing and the studio wall look like the same company
Publish & Engage:
● Own the content calendar, planned at least four weeks ahead
● Write captions in our brand voice, with hashtags and alt text
● Reply to comments and DMs the same working day, and hand genuine enquiries to the booking team
● Liaise with UGC creators to bring in additional content
● Set up and maintain automated replies, saved responses and story highlights

Who We’re Looking For
● At least 3 years of experience, in-house or agency. If you've grown an account from a cold start, lead with that and tell us what you achieved
● You shoot and edit short-form vertical video independently, by phone or camera, in CapCut or Premiere
● Basic graphic design in Canva. Photoshop or Figma is an advantage
● You write clean, natural English captions
● You're comfortable being on camera
● You're organised enough to hold a four-week content calendar
● You're fluent in current TikTok and Instagram Reels trends. Formats, audio, what's working right now
● You can turn a reactive piece around within 24 hours when something is moving
● You're happy working across different locations with a camera kit, and the occasional evening or weekend for shoots and events
● You've designed for e-commerce or email before, or you can show us layout work that isn't social
● Beauty, wellness or aesthetics experience is a plus, not a requirement

This Role Is Not For You If…
● You need to be reminded to meet deadlines
● You post content only when inspired. Consistency is not your strong suit
● You wait to be told what to do instead of spotting opportunities yourself
● You're looking for a slow, structured corporate environment
● You treat social media as a side hobby, not a craft

title: Social Media Content Specialist
description:
This is a full-time role in our Singapore office. 
We are looking for a Content Creator / Producer who can spot a strong idea, shape it for the right platform and bring it to life from start to finish. This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable behind a camera, inside an editing suite and at the centre of a production. You will turn briefs, trends and cultural moments into content that feels relevant, looks sharp and performs with purpose.
In short: you do not just make content. You make content happen.


Key Responsibilities: Social Content Creation

- Develop original content ideas based on client briefs, audience insights, platform trends and cultural conversations.
- Translate ideas into scripts, storyboards, shot lists and practical production plans.
- Create photography, short-form videos, social-first content, interviews, event coverage and behind-the-scenes material.
- Shoot confidently using smartphones and professional camera equipment.
- Edit content with strong pacing, sound, captions, colour treatment and platform-appropriate storytelling.
- Adapt and optimise content for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and LinkedIn.
- Repurpose master assets into multiple content formats without making them feel recycled.
- Keep up with emerging formats, creators, tools and platform behaviours—and know which trends are worth following.


Collaboration

- Work closely with Creative, Content, Planning, Account Servicing and Project teams.
- Contribute practical production thinking during the concept stage—not only after an idea has been approved.
- Present ideas clearly and confidently to internal teams and clients.
- Balance creative ambition with timelines, budgets and real-world production realities.
- Use content performance and audience response to improve future work.


What We Are Looking For

- At least 2 years of relevant experience in content creation, social media, video production or a similar role.
- A strong portfolio demonstrating social-first thinking, visual storytelling and hands-on production ability.
- Proficiency in video-editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut.
- Working knowledge of cameras, lighting, audio recording and basic production equipment.
- Strong storytelling instincts and a good eye for composition, pacing and detail.
- A clear understanding of how content differs across platforms and audiences.
- The ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines and moving parts without losing the plot.
- Confidence working independently as well as collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
- Openness to using generative AI and emerging creative tools to improve ideation, production and workflow.
- Flexibility to attend shoots, events or live coverage outside regular working hours when required.


You Will Thrive Here If You

- Think like a creator but operate like a producer.
- Know that “viral” is not a strategy, but relevance is.
- Can move quickly without making the work feel rushed.
- Care about the small details audiences may not consciously notice—but definitely feel.
- Stay calm on set when plans change, batteries die at a concert or the weather refuses to read the brief.
- Take ownership, solve problems and finish what you start.


What Success Looks Like

- You consistently create content that feels native to the platform, true to the brand and worth the audience’s attention. Productions run smoothly, deadlines are respected, teams trust you and the final work is stronger because you were involved.

title: Content Producer (Short-form Videos)
description:
Company Description
Astro Health Ventures is a Singapore healthcare company re-shaping how traditional medical services are delivered. We build and run specialised digital clinics, pairing licensed doctors with technology we build ourselves. Our first venture, Trimly (trimly.sg), is an MOH-licensed clinic providing medically supervised weight management in Singapore. We are founder-led with seven-figure monthly revenue, and short-form video is the biggest creative lever in our growth.


This is a Singapore-based role with regular on-site shoot days. We will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore and do not require visa sponsorship.


Role Description
We are hiring a fresh diploma or degree graduate who loves making short-form video and wants to do it full-time, at volume, for a brand where the numbers show what works.


What You'll Do

- Come up with short-form video concepts for TikTok, Instagram Reels and paid ads
- Write hooks, scripts, captions and simple storyboards
- Film content with our doctors, team members, creators and actors when needed
- Create UGC-style videos that feel real, not like ads
- Turn what we know about our patients (constant hunger, years of dieting, busy schedules, hormonal challenges) into stories people recognise themselves in
- Edit quickly in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or Final Cut 
- Make multiple versions of hooks, intros, captions and formats for testing
- Study ad and content performance with the marketing team and improve based on what works
- Build a swipe file of strong ideas from health, wellness, beauty and consumer brands
- Keep a steady pipeline of new creative assets coming every week


What We're Looking For

- A diploma or degree in any field. Media, film, communications or marketing helps, but your portfolio matters more than your course
- You genuinely enjoy making content and understand short-form video culture
- You have a portfolio, TikTok or Instagram account, or past content you can show us. School, personal and freelance projects all count
- You understand hooks, pacing, captions and framing, and why people keep watching
- You can write simple, emotionally clear scripts
- You can film and edit on your own
- You would rather test many ideas than spend a week on one "perfect" video
- You take feedback well and turn revisions around quickly
- You are based in Singapore and can film locally


Nice To Have

- Experience making UGC ads or performance marketing creatives
- Experience working with creators, influencers or non-actors on camera
- Familiarity with Meta ads, TikTok ads or creative testing
- Comfortable with AI image and video tools
- Basic design skills for thumbnails, subtitles and simple graphics
- Comfortable appearing on camera, though this is not required


What Success Looks Like
Success means we are consistently launching new content that helps us learn what our audience responds to. You don't need every video to be a winner. You do need to help us produce, test, learn and improve quickly.


We care about:

- Number of usable video concepts produced each week
- Speed of filming and editing
- Quality of hooks and storytelling
- Ability to find different angles for the same pain point
- Improvement in ad and content performance over time


What We Offer

- S$3,000 to S$4,500 a month depending on portfolio, plus 13th month bonus
- Direct mentorship from the founder who leads growth
- Hybrid working: in Singapore for shoot days, flexible otherwise
- Apply with your CV and links to 3 to 5 videos you filmed and edited yourself. Applications without links won't be reviewed. We read every application and reply either way.

title: Junior Content Creator, We. Studio
description:
Purpose of the Position:
You sit in We. Studio but spend most of your time with the Brand Content & Commerce team, working our consumer growth portfolio. Think travel, tourism, hospitality. Brands that live and die on social. You make thumb-stopping content that gets people to stop, watch, and act.


RESPONSIBILITIES:


Make content that connects
You concept, produce, and post-produce. Static or video, you take an idea from a scribble to something live on feed. You're fluent in CapCut, TikTok Symphony, and platform-native editing tools. You can write the copy too, because a great video with a flat caption is a wasted post. Editing, motion graphics, colour grading, and audio mixing (After Effects, Premiere, DaVinci, or similar) are a real plus.


Turn ideas into content people share
You're in the room when ideas start. You take a brief, a trend, or a random spark and turn it into something worth making. You think in formats and hooks, not just visuals. You know the difference between content that's fine and content people actually send to their friends.


Run the community, not just the calendar
You post, schedule, and stay close to the comments. You reply, you jump on the right moments, and you know when to hijack a trend versus when to sit one out. You treat the community like a live thing, because it is.


Live on-platform
You already know what's working this week because you're on the apps for fun, not just for work. You bring that instinct into the room. New tools, new formats, new ways of doing things. You help build the kind of portfolio that makes people ask how we did it.


Co-create with AI
You use AI as part of how you make things, not as an afterthought. Higgsfield or similar for video generation, Midjourney, Gemini, Google Stitch or ChatGPT for image. You experiment, you find what's usable, and you fold the good stuff into your workflow. You're not precious about trying something new and binning it if it doesn't land.


QUALIFICATIONS: 



- A Diploma or Bachelor's in Film, Media Production, Digital Arts, Communications, Marketing, or a related field. Or a portfolio strong enough.
- 0–2 years in content creation, social, or video. Strong fresh graduates are warmly welcomed.
- Comfortable with CapCut, TikTok Symphony, and platform-native editing. Working knowledge of Premiere Pro or After Effects is a plus, not a must.
- A portfolio or set of live socials that shows you can make content people actually watch and share. Early stage is fine; we care about instinct.
- You can write. Social copy, captions, hooks. You know words carry the post as much as the visuals.
- You live on the platforms. You know what's trending, what's dying, and when to jump on a moment.
- Some exposure to motion graphics, colour grading, or sound design is a bonus.
- Curious about AI creative tools (Higgsfield, Midjourney, ChatGPT and the like) and keen to build them into how you work.
- Sharp attention to detail and able to juggle multiple projects without dropping any.
- A collaborative spirit and clear communication. You'll be client-facing, so this matters.
- Comfortable in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

title: Social Media & Audience Development Specialist, MAVU
categories: Newspaper Publishing, Online Audio and Video Media, and Writing and Editing
description:
The Chinese Media Group (CMG) is establishing a new unit, Misinformation Awareness & Verification Unit (MAVU), dedicated to strengthening information integrity in the digital age. Combining journalism, digital verification and public education, the unit aims to produce trusted, evidence-based reporting, practical verification tools and innovative ways of strengthening media literacy in Singapore and beyond.


We are looking for a creative, audience-focused and digitally savvy Social Media Specialist to build and grow the unit's presence and engagement across social media platforms. You will play a pivotal role in translating complex investigations and digital issues into engaging, platform-native content that informs and allows audiences to better navigate today's information environment.


Working closely with the editorial and product teams, you will develop the unit's social media strategy, produce original content and foster meaningful engagement with audiences across Singapore and the region.


Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute the unit's social media strategy across major platforms, with a strong focus on Chinese-language social media and messaging ecosystems.
- Create and publish platform-native content, including short-form videos, graphics, explainers and interactive posts that translate complex digital investigations and verification findings into engaging content that promotes information literacy and public education.
- Grow and manage the unit's online communities by monitoring conversations, engaging audiences where appropriate, and identifying emerging trends, misinformation narratives and audience concerns.
- Monitor and leverage on audience insights and platform analytics to optimise content performance, evaluate impact and refine content and engagement strategies.
- Collaborate with the editorial, product and technology teams to develop innovative storytelling formats, campaigns and digital initiatives that strengthen information literacy and public trust.


Required Qualifications

- Diploma/bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, digital media, marketing, multimedia, design or a related discipline.
- At least three years of relevant experience in social media, digital content, audience engagement, journalism or related fields.
- Candidates with experience managing Chinese-language social media accounts or developing digital audience strategies are preferred.
- Excellent command of written and spoken English and Chinese is required, as the role involves managing Chinese-language social media ecosystems and supporting Chinese publications.
- Strong news judgment, curiosity and keen awareness of current affairs, emerging misinformation trends and the evolving digital information landscape.
- Strong understanding of social media platforms, audience behaviour and digital content trends, particularly across Chinese-language platforms such as WeChat, Xiaohongshu, Douyin and Weibo, as well as Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok and Telegram.
- Excellent storytelling skills with the ability to adapt content creatively for different social media platforms, content formats and audiences.
- Proficient in social content creation, including short-form video production, graphic design and AI-assisted creative tools e.g., Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro, Photoshop or similar platforms.
- Experienced in using audience analytics and social media management tools to measure and optimise content performance and audience engagement and identify trends.
- Proactive, collaborative and possesses a creative mindset and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


To Apply
Please send us your CV together with a brief cover letter (300–500 words) answering the following questions:

- Tell us about a social media account, campaign or content series that you managed or contributed significantly to. What was your strategy, what role did you play, and how did you measure its success?
- Imagine you are launching social media accounts for a new information integrity initiative aimed at helping Singaporeans identify misinformation and AI-generated content. Which platform would you prioritise first, what type of content would you create, and why?
(Note: Please ensure you answer the two questions above and attach your submission when applying. Incomplete applications without these answers will not be considered.)


职位总体目标


人工智能正在改变资讯世界，也让辨识真假变得越来越困难。 新报业媒体华文媒体集团（CMG）正成立全新的数码调查与资讯诚信单位，结合调查报道、数码查证与公众教育，探索人工智能时代的新型新闻实践，并帮助公众提升资讯辨识能力。 我们诚邀具创意、以受众为中心，并熟悉社交媒体生态的人才加入团队，负责建立及拓展单位在各大社交媒体平台上的品牌影响力及受众互动。 你将与记者、编辑及产品团队紧密合作，制定单位的社交媒体策略，策划及制作原创内容，并把复杂的数码调查报道和数码资讯议题，转化为适合不同平台特性、兼具吸引力及教育意义的内容，帮助新加坡及区域的受众更好地理解和应对当今复杂的资讯环境。


工作职责

- 制定及执行单位的社交媒体策略，负责各大社交媒体平台的日常营运，重点拓展华文社交媒体及即时通讯平台的影响力。
- 策划、制作及发布符合不同平台特性的原创内容，包括短视频、图文、资讯图表、互动内容及其他创意形式，将复杂的数码调查和资讯核查成果转化为具吸引力的内容，推动资讯素养和公众教育。
- 建立及经营单位的线上社群，持续关注社群讨论，适时与受众互动，并识别新兴趋势、错误与虚假资讯叙事及受众关注议题。
- 持续监测并运用受众洞察及平台分析数据，优化内容表现、评估成效，并持续完善内容及受众互动策略。
- 与编辑、产品及技术团队紧密合作，探索创新叙事形式及数码传播项目，提升公众资讯素养及对可信资讯的信任。


职位要求

- 新闻学、传播学、数码媒体、市场营销、多媒体、设计或相关学科的文凭或学士学位。
- 具备至少三年在社交媒体、数码内容、用户发展、新闻或相关领域的工作经验。
- 曾负责华文社交媒体帐号营运，或具备用户增长及数码传播策略经验者将获优先考虑。
- 具备优秀的中英文书写及口语能力。由于此职位主要负责营运华文社交媒体生态并支援华文媒体出版物，申请者须能熟练运用华文。
- 具备良好的新闻判断力与强烈的好奇心，对时事、错误与虚假资讯趋势，以及数码资讯生态的演变保持高度敏感。
- 深入了解各大社交媒体平台、用户行为及数码内容趋势。尤其熟悉微信、小红书、抖音、微博等华文平台，以及 Instagram、Facebook、YouTube、TikTok、Telegram 等国际平台。
- 具备优秀的内容策划及叙事能力，能够发挥创意，针对不同社交媒体平台、内容形式及受众灵活调整传播策略。
- 熟练掌握社交媒体内容制作技能，包括短视频拍摄及剪辑、平面设计，以及运用 Canva、CapCut、Premiere Pro、Photoshop 等工具；乐于运用 AI 创作工具辅助内容生产。
- 熟悉受众分析与社交媒体管理工具，能够利用数据衡量并优化内容表现与用户参与度，并识别新兴趋势。
- 主动积极，富创意及团队合作精神，能够在快速变化的环境中同时妥善管理多个项目。


应征方式
请提交您的个人履历（CV），并附上一篇 300 至 500 字的简短求职信（Cover Letter），回答以下问题：

- 请分享一个你曾负责或深度参与营运的社交媒体帐号、传播项目或内容系列。你的整体策略是什么？你负责哪些工作？又如何评估它是否成功？
- 假设你负责为一个协助新加坡公众辨识错误资讯及 AI 生成内容的全新“资讯诚信品牌”建立社交媒体帐号，你会优先经营哪一个平台？会制作什么类型的内容？为什么？
(注：所有申请者必须在提交申请时，附上对上述两道问题的答复。未附上答复的申请将不获考虑。)

title: Social Media & Marketing Executive / Intern
description:
Company / 公司： ShengWang Tech
Location / 工作地点： The Great World, Singapore
Employment Type / 类型： Full-time / Internship 全职 / 实习
Headcount / 招聘人数： 1
About the Role / 岗位介绍
ShengWang Tech is looking for a highly motivated and hands-on Social Media & Marketing Executive / Intern to build and manage our social media presence from 0 to 1 in the Singapore market.
You will independently take ownership of our social media channels, from account setup and content planning to content creation, publishing, community engagement and performance analysis.
This is not a role limited to posting content. We are looking for someone with strong ownership, learning agility and execution ability, who can gradually grow with the business and take on broader marketing responsibilities.
ShengWang Tech 正在招聘一名 社交媒体与市场运营专员 / 实习生，面向新加坡市场，从 0 到 1 搭建并运营公司的社交媒体矩阵。
你将相对独立地负责公司社媒账号的搭建、内容规划、内容制作、发布、用户互动及数据分析，并持续探索适合业务的内容和增长方式。
这并不是一个单纯“发帖”的岗位。我们希望找到一位具有较强 Ownership、学习能力和综合执行能力 的成员，未来随着业务发展，逐步承担更完整的市场营销工作。
Key Responsibilities / 工作职责
1. Social Media 0–1 Setup & Operations
社媒账号 0–1 搭建与运营
· Build and manage ShengWang Tech’s social media presence from the ground up.
· Develop appropriate positioning, content pillars, tone of voice and operating approaches for different platforms.
· Manage day-to-day publishing, account maintenance and community engagement.
主要平台包括：
International Platforms / 国际平台
· Facebook
· Instagram
· TikTok
· X
· Other relevant platforms
Chinese Platforms / 中文平台
· 小红书 Xiaohongshu / RED
· 抖音 Douyin
· 微信视频号 WeChat Channels
· 其他适合业务发展的平台
针对不同平台的用户群体、内容生态和传播机制，制定相应的运营方式，而非简单进行同一内容的跨平台复制。
2. Content Planning & Creation
内容策划与制作
· Develop monthly and weekly content calendars.
· Identify relevant topics, trends and content opportunities.
· Create social-first content including posts, graphics, short-form videos and other formats.
· Write and adapt content in both English and Chinese.
· Localise content for Singapore audiences while considering different cultural and platform contexts.
· Coordinate basic photography, videography and editing where required.
负责日常选题、文案、图片、短视频等内容的策划和制作，并根据国际平台和中文平台特点进行针对性调整。
能够完成基础内容制作，不要求候选人是专业摄影师或设计师，但需要具备良好的内容审美和较强的动手能力。
3. Growth & Community Management
用户增长与社区运营
· Monitor comments, messages and audience feedback.
· Engage with users and help build the company’s online community.
· Experiment with different content formats and growth approaches.
· Explore collaborations, trending topics, creators/KOL/KOC opportunities and relevant communities where appropriate.
持续寻找能够提升品牌曝光、粉丝增长和用户互动的有效方式，而不是机械执行固定内容计划。
4. Performance Analysis & Optimisation
数据分析与持续优化
· Track key social media metrics such as reach, views, engagement, follower growth and traffic.
· Review content performance regularly and identify what works and what does not.
· Turn insights into concrete improvements to future content and campaigns.
· Prepare simple periodic performance reports.
我们希望你不仅关注“发布了多少内容”，也关注 哪些内容有效、为什么有效，以及下一步如何做得更好。
5. Marketing Support & Future Development
市场营销及岗位发展
As the role develops, responsibilities will gradually expand beyond social media into broader marketing activities, including:
· Marketing campaign planning and execution
· Business/product promotion
· Online and offline campaign support
· Promotional materials and marketing content
· Partnership and collaboration initiatives
· Brand communication
· Supporting day-to-day marketing operations for relevant business lines
随着业务和岗位的发展，该职位未来将逐步从 Social Media 扩展至更完整的 Marketing 职能，包括业务线的日常市场运营、品牌宣传、活动策划、营销项目执行以及其他相关工作。
Requirements / 任职要求
What We Care About Most / 我们最看重的
Strong Ownership
You are willing to take responsibility for outcomes, not just complete assigned tasks. When facing something unfamiliar, your first reaction should be to research, learn, experiment and solve the problem.
具备很强的 Ownership。相比“等任务、等指导”，我们更希望你能够主动发现问题、研究问题并推动解决。
Fast & Independent Learner
Social media platforms, algorithms, tools and trends change quickly. We expect you to be able to independently learn new platforms, tools and working methods.
具备较强的独立学习能力，能够快速学习新的平台、工具、业务和工作方式。
Bilingual Communication
· Fluent in both English and Chinese, written and spoken.
· Able to create natural content in both languages rather than relying solely on literal translation.
· Daily internal communication will be primarily in Chinese.
中英文听说读写流利，能够根据不同受众独立完成中英文内容，而不仅仅进行直译。公司内部日常沟通以中文为主。
Social Media Native
You should have a strong understanding of social media and preferably be an active user of platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Xiaohongshu or similar platforms.
对社交媒体有较强敏感度，理解短视频、图文内容及不同平台的基本内容逻辑和用户习惯。
Preferred / 加分项
The following are advantages, but not mandatory:
· Experience managing social media accounts, personal or commercial
· Experience with TikTok / Instagram Reels / Xiaohongshu / Douyin
· Short-form video shooting and editing skills
· Familiarity with CapCut / 剪映, Canva, Adobe or similar tools
· Basic photography or visual design skills
· Experience in digital marketing, branding, e-commerce or content marketing
· Experience with Meta Ads, TikTok Ads or other paid social platforms
· Personal social media accounts or a content portfolio demonstrating your ability
· Good understanding of Singapore’s local consumer and social media environment
有社媒运营、短视频制作、设计、摄影、Marketing、电商或个人自媒体经验均为加分项，但不是硬性要求。
相比单纯的学历或工作年限，我们更看重 实际能力、学习速度、审美、执行力以及解决问题的能力。
AI-Friendly Workplace / 欢迎使用 AI
We actively encourage the appropriate use of AI tools to improve productivity and creativity.
You are welcome to use AI for:
· Research and brainstorming
· Content ideation
· Copywriting
· Translation and localisation
· Image and video creation
· Data analysis
· Workflow automation
· Learning new skills
We care about the quality of the final output and your judgement, rather than whether every task is completed manually.
我们欢迎并鼓励合理使用 AI。
可以使用 ChatGPT 等 AI 工具辅助信息研究、创意、文案、翻译、图片与视频制作、数据分析、自动化以及学习。
我们关注的是 最终结果、你的判断力以及解决问题的能力，而不是要求所有工作必须手工完成。
Who We Think Will Fit / 我们期待的你
You may be a good fit if you:
· Are proactive rather than waiting for detailed instructions.
· Enjoy figuring things out from scratch.
· Have good judgement and attention to detail.
· Are creative but also execution-oriented.
· Are comfortable working independently.
· Are curious about new tools, technologies and AI.
· Want to grow beyond social media into broader marketing responsibilities.
如果你喜欢从 0 到 1 做事情，遇到问题愿意自己研究，希望自己的工作能够真正影响业务，而不是只执行固定流程，这个岗位会比较适合你。
Fresh graduates and students are welcome to apply. Strong portfolios, personal projects or demonstrated capabilities may be more valuable than years of experience.
欢迎优秀应届毕业生及实习生申请。我们不会单纯以工作年限判断候选人，优秀的作品、个人项目和实际能力同样重要。

title: Social Commerce Content Specialist
description:
About Us

Dyson is a global technology enterprise. We solve the problems others choose to ignore, with surprising new inventions that defy convention and simply work better. We’re growing fast and our ambition is huge – more categories, more locations, and more people.

From its beginnings in cyclonic vacuums, Dyson’s portfolio has grown to include five main areas of technology: Cord-free and corded vacuum cleaners, hand dryers, lighting, environmental control machines (purifying fans, heating and cooling fans and humidifiers) and hair styling tools, which are sold in more than 82 countries across the world. We are on a mission to improve our customer’s lives: whether that be by making the the air they breathe safe and clean, or connecting them to high performing machines, which keep their homes clean.

About The Role

Role Overview

The Social Commerce Content Specialist supports the execution and optimization of Dyson Singapore's social commerce content across TikTok Shop and other platforms. The role plans, creates, publishes and optimizes social commerce-native content that supports discovery, engagement, qualified traffic and commerce contribution, while exploring AI-enabled workflows to improve creative speed and production efficiency.

Key Responsibilities About You



-  Always-On Content Planning
- Support the development of weekly content plans and publishing schedules based on commercial priorities and campaign requirements.
- Recommend content themes, product focus areas and campaign support ideas for Dyson's owned social commerce channel.
- Maintain a strong base bank of planned content while protecting capacity for reactive trends and timely cultural moments.
- Balance product education, demonstration, problem-solution, creator-led, entertainment and conversion-oriented formats.
- Plan sufficient content depth to support multiple daily posts during launches and key commercial periods without compromising quality or accuracy.
-  End-to-End Content Creation
- Spot relevant social trends, behaviors, sounds, formats and hooks; translate them into ideas appropriate for a premium technology brand.
- Develop concepts, hooks, scripts and shot lists for organic and commerce content, with guidance from the wider team where required.
- Shoot and edit content using mobile-first workflows and collaborate with internal stakeholders; create platform-native cuts, captions, graphics and sound treatments.
- Publish content accurately and on time, with correct product naming, claims, links, tags and social commerce Shop product anchors.
- Explore AI-enabled tools to improve ideation, scripting, editing, localization and content versioning.
-  Content Re-Purposing and Capture
- Rework suitable global and regional assets into local, social-native edits.
- Identify and repurpose high-performing material from affiliates, owned livestreams, experts, stylists, launches and events, subject to usage rights.
- Create content briefs and capture plans for colleagues, creators, and talent, so usable footage is generated efficiently.
- Maintain an organized content library with clear status, usage rights, product, format, and tags.
-  Trend-Jacking and Reactive Execution
- Identify reactive opportunities that are relevant to Dyson products, audiences and brand standards.
-  Performance Optimization
- Track views, watch time, completion, engagement, shares, saves, profile visits, product clicks and video-attributed GMV.
- Identify winning hooks, formats, products and creators; create follow-up variations and retire approaches that are consistently weak.
- Provide a concise weekly content readout with insights, next tests and recommended changes, not only a list of posts published.
- Work with the Social Commerce Lead and Marketing to identify high-performing organic content suitable for paid boosting.
-  Brand and Content Governance
- Ensure all content meets brand, legal, product-claim, music-rights and platform-compliance requirements.
- Maintain Dyson's premium positioning while creating content that feels current and native to TikTok.
-  Key Performance Indicators
- Output and Consistency: Agreed owned-channel publishing cadence delivered; planned base content and reactive content produced on time.
- Speed: Time from trend identification or commercial brief to approved publication.
- Attention Quality: Average watch time, completion rate, shares, saves and engagement versus benchmarks.
- Commerce Contribution: Product clicks, click-through rate, video-attributed GMV and qualified content passed for boosting.
- Learning Velocity : Number and quality of structured tests, repeatable winning formats and performance-led iterations.
- 1-2 years' experience in short-form video, social content, creative production or creator-led marketing.
- Demonstrable social media-native portfolio with strong hooks, pacing, storytelling, product demonstration and editing judgement.
- Able to concept, script, shoot and edit independently using tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro or equivalent.
- Fast and resourceful, with strong trend judgement and discipline to protect premium brand standards.
- Curious and hands-on with AI content tools, with the ability to test new workflows responsibly and turn successful experiments into repeatable production processes.
- Strong attention to detail in product claims, captions, tagging, links, file management and publishing accuracy.
- Able to work with employees, creators, experts and stylists to capture natural, useful content efficiently.


Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

Feel it in 5 is the promise, and people are responding: we launched on TikTok Shop in Singapore and the early traction has been strong, fast. Now we are scaling and building a real community of people who care about sleeping better, having more energy, and looking after themselves.

We are a team of serial entrepreneurs who have built and run several consumer brands. Abso is our newest one: we are scaling it in Singapore now, with the US next. You would be joining early, working directly with the founders, with real ownership from day one.

We are hiring our first dedicated content and community person to be the face and hands of the brand: make the content, run the creators, and build Abso’s presence on the ground.

What you’ll do



- Own our Instagram and TikTok channels. Run them end to end: own the content calendar, shoot, edit and post, reply to comments and DMs, and grow the following. Organic plus the raw, real content we reuse in our ads. You are comfortable on camera and behind it.
- Run our creator and influencer programme. Find the right creators, reach out, ship them samples, brief them well, and manage the content and campaigns they deliver.
- Build our community on the ground. Represent Abso in person at gyms, spas, recovery studios and wellness venues across Singapore. Run sampling and seeding, build partnerships, and be the friendly human face people remember.
- Listen and feed it back. Tell us what is landing, what customers and partners are saying, and what we should make next.

What you’ll bring



- You already make content. You have a TikTok or Instagram you can show us. You get the culture and you know what makes someone stop scrolling.
- You are confident on camera and in person. You will happily walk into a gym, talk to people, and represent the brand.
- You use AI fluently. Claude, ChatGPT and similar tools are already part of how you work, draft, research and move faster. This matters to us: we move fast and we use AI everywhere.
- You are organised. You can run creators and partners without dropping balls.
- You are Singapore-based and you have a feel for the local wellness and fitness scene. A personal network or following is a big plus.
- You are hungry. You want to own something and grow with a brand, not sit in a big-company seat.

Nice to have: Experience running influencer or affiliate campaigns, comfortable editing (CapCut / Premiere / equivalent), a personal creator following, a real interest in fitness, wellness or supplements.

How we work



- Work from home most of the week, with one day together in the office.
- Flexible hours built around your output, not the clock.
- Work directly with the founders, with real ownership from day one.
- Grow with us as we scale from Singapore into the US.

The deal

Competitive base salary plus a performance-linked bonus tied to what you create, the partnerships you land, and the sales you help drive. Real responsibility from day one.

How to apply

Email careers@absohealth.com with:



- A short note on why you, why Abso.
- A short CV or resume (one page is plenty).
- Your TikTok and/or Instagram handle, or a link to content you’ve made.
- A 60-second selfie video talking to camera: who you are and why you’d be great at this. Keep it real, we want to see you, not a polished showreel.

Company Profile
Bright Culture (https://www.instagram.com/brightculture/)  is a growing tuition centre in Singapore focused on helping students learn smarter, build confidence and achieve better academic outcomes.
We believe education should be engaging, relatable and meaningful — not simply about memorising content and preparing for exams.
As we grow our digital presence, we're looking for a creative individual who can help us tell our story, connect with students and parents, and make educational content people genuinely want to watch and share.
The role will also involve opportunities to collaborate with Radical Kindness(https://www.instagram.com/k.weee/) on creative initiatives, campaigns and content that promote positive values and meaningful impact among young people.
Job Description
You'll be involved in the entire content journey:
IDEA → CREATE → PUBLISH → ANALYSE → IMPROVE
Your responsibilities include:

- 
Develop creative content ideas for students and parents
- 
Shoot and edit TikToks, Reels, short-form videos and other social content
- 
Write hooks, scripts, captions and engaging educational content
- 
Turn complex academic concepts into simple, relatable and shareable content
- 
Create content across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Telegram and our website
- 
Identify social media trends and adapt them creatively for education
- 
Work with teachers and the academic team to develop educational content
- 
Monitor and analyse content performance
- 
Identify what works, what doesn't and what we should try next
- 
Engage with students and parents and turn their questions into content ideas
- 
Explore AI and emerging digital tools to improve content creation
- 
Support digital marketing campaigns and Bright Culture's overall brand development
This is a hands-on role. You'll have the opportunity to develop ideas, create the content and see how audiences respond to your work.
Competencies & Values
We're looking for a fresh graduate from a Polytechnic or University who is:

- 
Creative, curious and naturally full of ideas
- 
Passionate about social media and content creation
- 
Genuinely interested in education and interacting with young people
- 
Comfortable with video creation and basic editing
- 
Able to understand trends without simply copying them
- 
A strong communicator and storyteller
- 
Willing to experiment and learn from failure
- 
Comfortable working independently and taking initiative
- 
Interested in both creative ideas and content performance
- 
Open to feedback and constantly looking to improve
Relevant backgrounds include Marketing, Digital Marketing, Mass Communication, Media, Advertising, Design, Creative Media, Business, Education or related fields.
Your academic qualification matters, but your creativity, portfolio, attitude and values matter more.
THIS IS VERY IMPORTANT
We are not looking for someone who simply wants a social media job.
We're looking for someone who genuinely believes in what we're trying to achieve in education.
You should care about making learning:
More engaging.
More relatable.
More memorable.
More human.
We want someone who can look at a boring topic and think:
“How can we make this interesting?”
Look at a difficult concept and think:
“How can we explain this differently?”
See a viral video and think:
“Why did this work, and how could we create our own version?”
And when something doesn't perform:
“What can we learn from it?”
Proven content experience matters.
You don't need years of professional experience. However, you must have created content before.
This could be through:

- 
Personal social media accounts
- 
Polytechnic or university projects
- 
Internships
- 
Freelance work
- 
Personal projects
- 
Content creation
Experience creating high-performing or viral content will be highly valued.
It doesn't have to be educational.
We want to see what you've created, how you think, and what you've learned from the results.

What's in It for You
You'll get the opportunity to:

- 
Build a strong portfolio of real-world content
- 
Gain hands-on experience in content and digital marketing
- 
Work directly with teachers and an academic team
- 
Learn how to turn educational knowledge into engaging content
- 
Develop skills in video production, storytelling and copywriting
- 
Learn how content performance is measured and optimised
- 
Explore AI tools and emerging digital technologies
- 
Understand how a growing education brand is built
- 
Learn from experienced education content creators
- 
Develop your own creative voice and ideas
- 
Work with one of the fastest growing education brands in the social media space
Most importantly, your work will have a real audience and a real purpose.
Behind every view is a student.
Behind every enquiry is a parent.
And behind every piece of content is an opportunity to make someone's learning journey a little better.

How to Apply
Please submit:
1. Your CV
2. Your portfolio or examples of content you've created
3. One piece of content you're most proud of
For the selected piece of content, tell us:

- 
What did you create?
- 
How did it perform?
- 
Why do you think it worked?
- 
What would you do differently today?
We don't just want to see your numbers. We want to understand how you think.
Applications without examples of previous content may not be considered.
Bring your creativity. Bring your portfolio. Bring your heart for education.
Let's create something that matters.

In this role, you’ll own the content process end to end — from spotting trends and developing ideas to shooting, editing, publishing, and analyzing performance. - Fast-moving, proactive, and performance-driven

Education:
