title: E-commerce & Social Media Growth Executive (US Market)
description:
JOB DEFINITION
The E-commerce & Social Media Growth Executive is responsible for building ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned content, social media presence and measurable off-Amazon traffic for the US market.
This is not a traditional customer-service role and does not depend on influencer partnerships. Even if no external creator works with us, employees will continue building ChoiceRefill’s own social media channels, content library and customer-acquisition assets.
ODORSEAL is hiring two employees for this position. Each employee will be assigned individual content projects, social media activities, Amazon Attribution links and measurable results. Both employees will be cross-trained to provide backup coverage when required, while individual project ownership and attributable results remain separately recorded.
ABOUT ODORSEAL AND CHOICEREFILL
ODORSEAL PTE. LTD. is a Singapore-based consumer-products and product-development company.
Our ChoiceRefill brand has been selling round diaper-pail refills to US customers through Amazon since 2017. ChoiceRefill is a practical, repeat-purchase household product that helps families find compatible, easy-to-use and cost-effective refill options.
ChoiceRefill is not a simple trading or standard private-label product. The company has independently developed its production lines, product structure and manufacturing processes.
We continue to improve film performance, production efficiency, product compatibility, packaging structure and the overall user experience. These product-development and manufacturing capabilities create a meaningful technical and operational barrier to entry that many ordinary e-commerce products do not have.
Employees will have the opportunity to understand how a consumer product moves from product development and manufacturing to Amazon sales, customer feedback, product improvement and repeat purchases.
ESTABLISHED AMAZON FOUNDATION
The company founder has many years of practical Amazon e-commerce experience and a clear understanding of product positioning, pricing, traffic, conversion, profitability and repeat purchases.
The founder is responsible for:
• Amazon Listing creation and optimisation
• Product images, selling points and page structure
• Amazon on-platform advertising
• Pricing and promotion strategy
• Product positioning and pack-size strategy
• Purchasing, inventory and core business decisions
• Product compliance and overall brand direction
Employees are not required to build Amazon Listings from the beginning or independently operate Amazon advertising.
Instead, employees will work from an established product, supply-chain, Listing and advertising foundation to build ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned content, social media channels and measurable off-Amazon traffic.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- 
BUILD BRAND-OWNED CONTENT ASSETS — APPROXIMATELY 35%
Create practical English-language content that answers real customer questions and supports Amazon purchase decisions.
Content may include:
• Compatibility demonstrations for tested round diaper-pail models
• How to identify compatible and incompatible pail structures
• Installation, film-pulling, cutting, tying and refill-replacement instructions
• Troubleshooting for common installation problems
• Guidance on choosing between 3-pack, 4-pack, 6-pack and 8-pack options
• Guidance for existing ChoiceRefill customers moving from older products to the latest version
• Explanations of product length, capacity, value and intended use
• Frequently asked questions based on real customer concerns
Employees do not always need to appear on camera. Clear product demonstrations, hand movements, close-up shots, captions and simple voiceovers are acceptable.
Strong master content should be repurposed into suitable formats for the company website and different social media platforms.
The objective is not to publish content simply to appear busy. The objective is to build an accurate, reusable content library that helps customers understand the product and make the correct purchase decision.

- 
OPERATE BRAND SOCIAL MEDIA AND GENERATE ORGANIC TRAFFIC — APPROXIMATELY 25%
Support and operate ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned social media channels, which may include TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest and Facebook.
Responsibilities include:
• Maintaining a practical content calendar
• Publishing approved content consistently
• Adapting content for each platform and audience
• Writing clear English captions, titles and calls to action
• Responding appropriately to relevant public questions and comments
• Participating helpfully in relevant online discussions while respecting community rules
• Directing interested customers to the correct Amazon product page
• Checking that every published Amazon link is accurate and traceable
• Reusing effective content across suitable channels
ChoiceRefill’s social media and off-Amazon growth activities must be able to operate normally without relying on external influencers.

- 
RESEARCH CUSTOMER DEMAND AND IMPROVE CONVERSION — APPROXIMATELY 15%
Actively identify what US customers need to know before making a purchase.
Research sources may include:
• Amazon customer reviews and product questions
• Competitor reviews and recurring complaints
• Customer enquiries received through the ChoiceRefill website
• Social media comments and discussions
• Search suggestions and frequently asked questions
• Feedback from existing ChoiceRefill customers
• Performance data from previously published content
Turn useful findings into:
• New content topics
• FAQ improvements
• Troubleshooting guides
• Website updates
• Product-information recommendations
• Clear suggestions for Amazon Listing improvement for the founder’s consideration
Employees should report “problem + evidence + recommendation,” rather than forwarding screenshots without analysis.

- 
TRACK RESULTS AND RUN GROWTH EXPERIMENTS — APPROXIMATELY 15%
Use Amazon Attribution and internal tracking sheets to measure employee-owned content and traffic sources.
Responsibilities include:
• Using an approved tracking link for each content item
• Recording the platform, content ID, product, publication date and responsible employee
• Monitoring clicks, product-page activity, purchases and attributable sales
• Comparing different topics, formats, openings, captions and calls to action
• Identifying content that attracts clicks but does not result in purchases
• Recommending which content should be repeated, improved or discontinued
• Preparing a short weekly performance summary
• Maintaining accurate content and campaign records
Each employee will receive a separately assigned Amazon Attribution link structure so that individual contributions can be measured.

- 
SUPPORT DAILY E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS — APPROXIMATELY 15%
Support the founder by completing and following up on routine work surrounding the Amazon business.
Responsibilities may include:
• Checking whether key products are available for sale
• Monitoring obvious price, stock, variation, image or link abnormalities
• Tracking approved inventory, inbound-shipment and replenishment matters
• Maintaining product information, packaging files, images and version records
• Organising sales or advertising reports and highlighting meaningful exceptions
• Preparing supporting information for platform cases
• Following up on approved changes and confirming completion
• Escalating urgent issues with evidence and a recommended next step
Employees do not independently change Amazon advertising, Listings, prices, purchasing plans or budgets.

- 
HANDLE LIMITED CUSTOMER ENQUIRIES — UP TO 10%
Customer service is a small, on-demand part of this position.
Most ChoiceRefill customers understand and purchase the product directly through Amazon. The role is not expected to spend most of the working day handling enquiries.
Responsibilities include:
• Checking the company website for customer enquiries
• Answering questions about compatibility, installation and product use
• Following up on unresolved matters
• Classifying recurring customer problems
• Updating approved response templates and FAQ drafts
• Turning repeated questions into useful content or improvement recommendations
When customer-service volume is low, the available time will be redirected to content creation, social media operation, research and growth experiments.

- 
OPTIONAL CREATOR AND INFLUENCER COLLABORATION — 0% TO 10%
Creator partnerships are an additional growth opportunity, not the foundation of this role.
When a genuinely suitable US parenting, household or value-focused creator is identified, employees may:
• Evaluate the creator’s audience and content quality
• Make initial contact
• Explain the product clearly
• Coordinate approved product samples
• Prepare a content brief
• Follow up on agreed timelines
• Record published content and measurable outcomes
Employees are not required to contact creators simply to fill working hours. Creator activity should expand only when it produces useful content, qualified traffic, measurable sales or a valuable long-term relationship.
Time used for creator partnerships will be allocated from the social media and organic-growth portion of the role.
INDIVIDUAL ATTRIBUTION AND SALES INCENTIVES
The fixed basic salary is S$3,400 per month and covers the normal responsibilities of the position.
In addition to the basic salary:
• Employees may receive a monthly performance bonus based on execution quality, accuracy, follow-up discipline, teamwork and backup capability
• Each employee will be assigned a separate Amazon Attribution link structure for employee-owned content
• Eligible individual sales incentives will be calculated using valid, finalised Amazon data
• Refunds, cancellations, self-purchases, abnormal traffic and ineligible activity will not be counted
• Individual attributable-sales incentives do not have a fixed upper limit
• The calculation method will be provided in writing so that employees can understand and verify their results
External Amazon Associates or Amazon Influencers may use their own affiliate links. Such partnerships will be assessed separately and will not replace the employee’s responsibility to build ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned content and traffic.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
A successful employee will not wait for the founder to assign every daily task.
You should be able to:
• Identify useful customer questions independently
• Convert customer questions into content ideas
• Produce or help produce clear product content
• Publish content using the correct tracking link
• Review the resulting performance data
• Decide what should be improved next
• Maintain accurate and complete records
• Follow up until work is completed
• Provide reliable backup coverage when required
• Explain problems using evidence and practical recommendations
Success is not measured only by the number of posts published, messages sent or hours spent.
We value work that is accurate, reusable, commercially useful and capable of producing measurable improvement.
WHAT YOU CAN LEARN
Using real operating data and active commercial projects, the company founder will help employees understand:
• How to identify real customer demand
• How to distinguish views, clicks and purchases
• How to evaluate the commercial value of content
• How to use Amazon Attribution to measure off-Amazon activities
• How pricing, conversion rates, sales, costs and profit are connected
• How customer feedback can lead to content and product improvements
• How to turn one-time tasks into repeatable SOPs
• How product development, manufacturing and supply chains affect a consumer-products business
• How to participate in business decisions using a “problem + evidence + recommendation” approach
This role is suitable for candidates at an early stage of their careers who want to develop long-term commercial judgement, product thinking and independent problem-solving ability.
REQUIREMENTS
• Strong written English, with the ability to communicate clearly with US customers and write natural social media content
• Chinese reading and writing ability, as internal SOPs, training materials, product-development information and reporting templates are currently maintained in Chinese
• Proactive and organised, with the ability to continue work without constant reminders
• Comfortable maintaining accurate records in Excel or Google Sheets
• Able to learn from customer feedback and performance data
• Willing to perform practical content work, including simple filming, editing and publishing
• Comfortable working with a practical household consumable rather than relying only on fashionable or entertainment-focused content
• Able to work with a colleague, review each other’s work and provide backup coverage
• Careful with product facts, compatibility information and customer-facing claims
Fresh graduates and candidates with internship, freelance or personal-project experience are welcome. Prior Amazon experience is not required.
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
Experience in any of the following areas will be helpful:
• E-commerce operations
• Social media management
• Content creation
• Short-form video production
• Digital marketing
• Customer service
• Community management
• Creator or influencer coordination
• US consumer markets
• Household, parenting or baby-care products
Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, Excel, Google Sheets and commonly used generative-AI tools is an advantage.
Candidates do not need to have a large personal following or maintain a public influencer account. Examples of content, school projects, freelance work, previously managed brand accounts or a simple portfolio are welcome.
WHAT WE PROVIDE
• Fixed basic salary of S$3,400 per month
• Monthly performance bonus
• Uncapped individual attributable-sales incentive
• Established US Amazon sales infrastructure
• Amazon Listings and on-platform advertising managed by the company founder
• Products supported by independent product-development and manufacturing capabilities
• Access to real product, sales, traffic and customer-feedback data
• Structured product training, SOPs, templates and tracking systems
• Direct participation in building a US consumer brand
• Exposure to the complete commercial process from product and manufacturing to content, traffic and sales
• Business guidance from a founder with many years of practical e-commerce experience
• Individual results that can be recorded and measured clearly
• Opportunities to earn additional income based on verified sales contributions
APPLICATION
Please submit your resume through MyCareersFuture.
You may include links to two or three examples of content, writing, videos, social media accounts or projects you have worked on. A portfolio is welcome but not compulsory.
Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a brief practical exercise involving:
• A customer compatibility response
• A short product-content idea
• A simple Amazon traffic or content-tracking task
The exercise is intended only to assess practical thinking and communication ability. It will not be used as unpaid commercial work.
ODORSEAL PTE. LTD. recruits and selects candidates based on their ability, relevant skills and suitability for the position.
岗位定义
电商与社媒增长专员负责为ChoiceRefill美国市场建立品牌自有内容、社媒影响力和可衡量的Amazon站外流量。
这不是一个传统客服岗位，也不是一个依赖红人合作才能开展工作的岗位。即使没有任何外部创作者与我们合作，员工仍然需要持续建设ChoiceRefill自己的社媒账号、内容资料库和客户获取资产。
ODORSEAL将为这个岗位招聘两名员工。每名员工分别负责各自的内容项目、社媒活动、Amazon Attribution归因链接和可衡量结果。
两名员工都会接受交叉培训，并在需要时为对方提供备岗支持。但是，每个人原有的项目、内容和可归因销售结果都会分别记录。
关于ODORSEAL和ChoiceRefill
ODORSEAL PTE. LTD.是一家位于新加坡的消费品和产品开发公司。
旗下ChoiceRefill品牌自2017年起，通过美国Amazon销售圆形尿布桶替换装。ChoiceRefill是一款实用的家庭重复购买型消耗品，帮助美国家庭找到兼容、易用且更具性价比的替换装。
ChoiceRefill不是简单的贸易产品或标准贴牌产品。公司自主开发了生产线、产品结构和制造工艺。
我们持续改进薄膜性能、生产效率、产品兼容性、包装结构和整体用户体验。这些产品开发和制造能力形成了有实际意义的技术及运营门槛，是许多普通电商产品不具备的。
公司的业务能力覆盖：

- 
产品研发；
- 
自主开发的生产工艺；
- 
制造和质量控制；
- 
包装和供应链执行；
- 
Amazon销售；
- 
客户反馈；
- 
持续产品改进。
加入ODORSEAL后，员工将有机会了解一款消费品如何从产品研发和制造，走向市场验证、客户反馈和持续复购。
已经建立的Amazon经营基础
公司负责人拥有多年Amazon电商实战经验，对产品定位、价格、流量、转化、利润和复购之间的关系具有清楚的理解。
公司负责人负责：

- 
Amazon Listing的建立和优化；
- 
产品图片、核心卖点和页面结构；
- 
Amazon站内广告；
- 
定价及促销策略；
- 
产品定位及包装规格策略；
- 
采购、库存和核心经营决策；
- 
产品合规及整体品牌方向。
员工不需要从零建立Amazon Listing，也不需要独立操作Amazon站内广告。
员工将在公司已经具备产品、供应链、Listing和广告基础的情况下，继续建立ChoiceRefill的品牌自有内容、社媒渠道和可衡量的Amazon站外流量。
主要工作职责
一、建立品牌自有内容资产——约占35%
制作能够回答真实客户问题、帮助客户完成Amazon购买决策的实用英文内容。
内容可能包括：

- 
已完成实测的圆形尿布桶型号兼容演示；
- 
如何辨认兼容和不兼容的尿布桶结构；
- 
安装、抽膜、切袋、打结和更换替换盒的操作说明；
- 
常见安装问题的排查方法；
- 
3盒、4盒、6盒和8盒包装的选择建议；
- 
ChoiceRefill老客户从旧版产品转换到新版产品的说明；
- 
产品长度、容量、价值和适用场景说明；
- 
根据真实客户问题整理的常见问答。
员工不一定需要本人出镜。清楚的产品演示、手部操作、产品特写、字幕和简单配音都可以使用。
优质的母内容应当根据公司官网和不同社媒平台的需要，拆分和改编为相应格式。
我们的目标不是为了显得忙碌而发布内容，而是建立一个准确、可以重复使用，并能帮助客户理解产品和作出正确购买决定的内容资料库。
二、运营品牌社媒并获取自然流量——约占25%
协助运营ChoiceRefill自主拥有的社媒账号，包括但不限于TikTok、Instagram、YouTube Shorts、Pinterest和Facebook。
主要工作包括：

- 
维护清楚实用的内容日历；
- 
按计划持续发布经过批准的内容；
- 
根据不同平台和受众调整内容；
- 
编写清楚自然的英文标题、文案和行动指引；
- 
适当回复相关的公开问题和评论；
- 
在遵守社区规则的前提下，参与相关网络讨论并提供有帮助的答案；
- 
将有购买兴趣的客户引导到正确的Amazon商品页面；
- 
检查每个已发布的Amazon链接是否准确、有效和可追踪；
- 
将已经验证有效的内容合理复用到其他渠道。
ChoiceRefill的社媒和站外增长工作必须能够在不依赖外部红人的情况下正常运行。
三、研究客户需求并改善转化——约占15%
主动寻找美国客户在购买前真正需要了解的信息。
可以参考的信息来源包括：

- 
Amazon客户评价和商品问答；
- 
竞品评价及反复出现的投诉；
- 
ChoiceRefill独立站收到的客户咨询；
- 
社媒评论和相关讨论；
- 
搜索建议和常见问题；
- 
ChoiceRefill现有客户的反馈；
- 
已发布内容的表现数据。
员工需要把有价值的发现转化为：

- 
新的内容选题；
- 
FAQ改进；
- 
故障排查指南；
- 
官网内容更新；
- 
产品信息改善建议；
- 
提供给公司负责人参考的Amazon Listing优化建议。
提交问题时，应采用“问题＋证据＋建议”的方式，而不是只转发截图而不进行分析。
四、跟踪结果并开展增长测试——约占15%
使用Amazon Attribution和公司内部追踪表，衡量员工负责的内容和流量来源。
主要工作包括：

- 
为每项内容使用经过批准的追踪链接；
- 
记录平台、内容编号、对应产品、发布日期和负责人；
- 
跟踪点击、商品页面活动、购买和可归因销售；
- 
对比不同内容主题、形式、开头、文案和行动指引的表现；
- 
找出有点击但没有产生购买的内容；
- 
建议哪些内容应该继续、修改或停止；
- 
每周提交一份简短的表现总结；
- 
准确维护内容和推广活动记录。
公司将为每名员工分配独立的Amazon Attribution链接体系，以便准确衡量个人贡献。
五、支持日常电商运营——约占15%
通过完成和跟进Amazon业务周边的日常工作，减少公司负责人处理例行事务的时间。
工作可能包括：

- 
检查重点产品是否正常在售；
- 
监控明显的价格、库存、变体、图片或链接异常；
- 
跟进已经批准的库存、入仓和补货事项；
- 
维护产品资料、包装文件、图片及版本记录；
- 
整理销售或广告报表，并标出有实际意义的异常；
- 
准备平台问题处理需要的支持资料；
- 
跟进已经批准的修改，并确认是否完成；
- 
发现紧急问题时，连同证据和建议处理方式一起上报。
员工不得自行调整Amazon广告、Listing、价格、采购计划或预算。
六、处理少量客户咨询——最多占10%
客户服务是本岗位中工作量较小、按照实际需求发生的工作。
大部分ChoiceRefill客户会直接通过Amazon了解并购买产品，因此本岗位不会把大部分工作时间用于处理客户咨询。
主要工作包括：

- 
检查公司独立站收到的客户咨询；
- 
回复兼容、安装和产品使用问题；
- 
跟进尚未解决的问题；
- 
对反复出现的客户问题进行分类；
- 
更新经过批准的回复模板和FAQ草稿；
- 
把重复问题转化为有用的内容或改进建议。
当客户咨询量较少时，相应时间将自动转移到内容制作、社媒运营、需求研究和增长测试。
七、选择性开展创作者和红人合作——占0%至10%
创作者合作是额外的增长机会，不是本岗位存在的基础。
当员工发现真正适合的美国育儿、家庭生活或性价比消费类创作者时，可以：

- 
评估创作者的受众和内容质量；
- 
进行初步联系；
- 
清楚介绍产品；
- 
协调已经批准的产品样品；
- 
准备内容要求；
- 
跟进双方约定的时间；
- 
记录已经发布的内容和可衡量结果。
公司不要求员工为了填满工作时间而联系创作者。只有当红人合作能够产生有价值的内容、合格流量、可衡量销售或有价值的长期合作关系时，才会逐步扩大投入。
红人合作所需时间将从社媒和自然流量工作时间中调配，不会额外增加整体工作比例。
个人归因与销售奖励
S$3,400的固定月薪对应本岗位的正常工作职责。
除固定月薪外：

- 
员工可以根据执行质量、数据准确性、跟进纪律、团队协作和备岗能力获得月度绩效奖金；
- 
公司会为每名员工负责的品牌自有内容分配独立的Amazon Attribution链接体系；
- 
个人销售奖励以Amazon最终确认的有效数据为依据；
- 
退款、取消订单、自购、异常流量和不符合规定的活动不计入奖励；
- 
个人可归因销售奖励不设固定上限；
- 
公司会以书面形式提供计算方法，确保员工能够理解并核对自己的结果。
外部Amazon Associates或Amazon Influencers可能使用其自己的联盟链接。这类合作将单独评估，不能代替员工建设ChoiceRefill品牌自有内容和流量的基本责任。
怎样才算在这个岗位上取得成功
一名表现优秀的员工，不会等待公司负责人每天逐项分配任务。
你应该能够：

- 
主动发现有价值的客户问题；
- 
将客户问题转化为内容选题；
- 
制作或协助制作清楚的产品内容；
- 
使用正确的追踪链接发布内容；
- 
查看内容产生的表现数据；
- 
判断下一步应该改进什么；
- 
保持准确、完整的工作记录；
- 
持续跟进，直到工作真正完成；
- 
在需要时提供可靠的备岗支持；
- 
使用证据和可执行建议说明问题。
公司不会只按照发布数量、发送消息数量或投入的时间判断员工表现。
我们更看重准确、可以重复使用、具有实际商业价值并能够产生可衡量改善的工作成果。
你能够学习什么
公司负责人会结合真实经营数据和实际商业项目，帮助员工理解：

- 
如何判断真实客户需求；
- 
如何区分浏览量、点击量和实际购买；
- 
如何判断一项内容是否具有商业价值；
- 
如何通过Amazon Attribution衡量站外活动；
- 
如何理解价格、转化率、销售额、成本和利润之间的关系；
- 
如何把客户反馈转化为内容改进和产品改进；
- 
如何把一次性任务建立成可重复执行的SOP；
- 
产品开发、制造和供应链如何影响消费品业务；
- 
如何用“问题＋证据＋建议”的方式参与经营决策。
员工将逐步学习为什么要完成一项工作、如何判断结果，以及下一步应该如何改进。
这份工作适合处于职业发展早期，并希望建立长期商业判断、产品思维和独立解决问题能力的候选人。
任职要求

- 
具备良好的英文书面表达能力，能够清楚地与美国客户沟通，并编写自然的英文社媒内容；
- 
具备中文阅读和书写能力，因为公司的内部SOP、培训资料、产品开发信息和报告模板目前均使用中文；
- 
做事主动、有条理，无须持续提醒也能继续推进工作；
- 
能够使用Excel或Google Sheets维护准确的工作记录；
- 
能够根据客户反馈和表现数据持续学习；
- 
愿意完成实际内容工作，包括简单拍摄、剪辑和发布；
- 
能够接受实用型家庭消耗品，不只对时尚、娱乐或容易制造话题的产品感兴趣；
- 
能够与同事协作、互相检查并提供备岗支持；
- 
对产品事实、兼容信息和面向客户的宣传内容保持谨慎。
欢迎应届毕业生，以及拥有实习、自由职业或个人项目经验的候选人申请。不要求具备Amazon运营经验。
优先考虑的经验
拥有以下任何一项经验者优先：

- 
电商运营；
- 
社媒账号管理；
- 
内容创作；
- 
短视频制作；
- 
数字营销；
- 
客户服务；
- 
社区运营；
- 
创作者或红人合作协调；
- 
美国消费市场；
- 
家庭用品、育儿用品或母婴产品。
熟悉Canva、CapCut、Excel、Google Sheets和常用生成式AI工具者优先。
候选人不需要拥有大量个人粉丝，也不需要经营公开的网红账号。欢迎提供内容案例、学校项目、自由职业项目、曾经管理的品牌账号或简单作品集。
公司提供

- 
S$3,400固定月薪；
- 
月度绩效奖金；
- 
不设固定上限的个人可归因销售奖励；
- 
已经建立的美国Amazon销售基础；
- 
由公司负责人管理的Amazon Listing和站内广告；
- 
具有自主产品开发和制造能力支持的产品；
- 
真实的产品、销售、流量和客户反馈数据；
- 
系统化的产品培训、SOP、模板和数据追踪系统；
- 
直接参与美国消费品牌建设的机会；
- 
从产品和制造到内容、流量和销售结果的完整商业流程经验；
- 
由拥有多年电商实战经验的公司负责人提供业务指导；
- 
能够被清楚记录和衡量的个人工作成果；
- 
根据可核实销售贡献获得额外收入的机会。
申请方式
请通过MyCareersFuture提交简历。
候选人可以附上两至三个自己参与过的内容、文章、视频、社媒账号或项目案例。作品集不是强制要求。
入围候选人可能会被邀请完成一项简短的实际能力测试，包括：

- 
回复一个客户兼容性问题；
- 
提出一个简短的产品内容创意；
- 
完成一个简单的Amazon站外流量或内容追踪任务。
该测试只用于评估候选人的实际思考和沟通能力，不会被公司作为免费的商业内容使用。
ODORSEAL PTE. LTD.根据候选人的实际能力、相关技能及岗位适配程度进行公平招聘和录用。

title: Social Media & AI Marketing Executive — Genuine Grape
description:
About Genuine Grape
Genuine Grape helps people discover authentic wines, understand producers, and find bottles that match their preferences. Our tools include detailed wine search, wine-list scanning, and personal wine collections.
We’re looking for a creative, hands-on marketer to grow our social presence, engage wine communities, and turn ideas into promotional campaigns using AI tools.
What you’ll do

- 
Manage social media: Plan, create, and publish posts, short videos, and stories across relevant channels, including Instagram, TikTok, and Reddit.
- 
Engage with communities: Participate in wine discussions, respond to comments and messages, gather feedback, and build relationships with users.
- 
Develop promotional plans: Create content calendars and campaigns around product features, wine topics, and audience interests.
- 
Use AI in your workflow: Research ideas, draft copy, generate visuals, edit videos, and automate repetitive tasks while reviewing everything for accuracy and quality.
- 
Show the product in action: Create demos and practical examples that explain how Genuine Grape helps people choose and discover wines.
- 
Explore partnerships: Identify relevant wine creators, educators, clubs, and businesses, and help develop collaborations.
- 
Track results: Measure engagement, website visits, sign-ups, and repeat usage. Use the findings to improve future campaigns.
- 
Work with the founder: Suggest ideas, run small experiments, and turn user feedback into useful marketing insights.
What we’re looking for

- 
Strong written English and a feel for clear, engaging content.
- 
Practical experience creating social media content, either professionally or through your own projects.
- 
Confidence using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Canva, or AI video and image tools.
- 
Basic video editing and design skills.
- 
Ability to independently take an idea from planning through publication.
- 
Curiosity, good judgment, and willingness to test ideas and learn from results.
- 
Interest in wine, food, or travel. Formal wine qualifications are welcome but not required.
What success looks like
A consistent stream of useful content, active conversations with wine enthusiasts, and campaigns that bring people to Genuine Grape and give them reasons to return.
How to apply
Send a short introduction, examples of content you’ve created, and one promotional idea for Genuine Grape. Tell us which AI tools you use and how they help your work.

For more information please visit
https://www.genuinegrape.com/

title: Social Media Marketing Executive / Content Creator
description:
Salary Range: $3000–$5000

Job Summary

As a Social Media Executive, you will initially focus on strengthening the company’s and subsidiaries’ social media presence through strategic content planning and audience engagement. Over time, the role will expand to managing external clients and developing social media strategies aligned with their branding and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Phase 1: Internal Social Media



-  Develop and execute social media strategies across key platforms including Facebook, Instagram, RedNote, TikTok, and LinkedIn.
-  Manage content calendars, content creation, and publishing schedules.
-  Develop engaging social media content, including short-form videos, visual assets, and copywriting.
-  Monitor social media metrics, audience engagement, and content performance.
-  Work closely with internal teams to align content with brand positioning and marketing objectives.

Phase 2: External Clients



-  Manage social media accounts and campaigns for external clients.
-  Develop platform-specific content strategies based on clients’ brand and business objectives.
-  Monitor, analyze, and optimize campaign performance.
-  Prepare performance reports and provide data-driven recommendations.
-  Progressively take on team leadership and oversee client campaign execution.

Requirements



-  Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field.
-  Minimum 1–3 years of experience in social media or digital marketing.
-  Strong knowledge of social media strategy, content marketing, and audience engagement.

title: Head of Communications & Brand
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

About BW Group

BW Group is a leading global energy and maritime company involved in shipping, deepwater oil & gas production, renewable energy and digital infrastructure. BW controls a fleet of over 400 vessels transporting oil, gas and dry commodities. In the infrastructure space, the group operates in wind, batteries, water, subsea cable networks and data centres.

BW is proud to be listed among Forbes World's Best Employers and Financial Times Best Employers Asia-Pacific 2025.

Are you ready to make an impact?

What drives us is our mission to deliver energy for the world today, and to find solutions for tomorrow. If you want to make lives better around the world by providing access to energy, while working on sustainability and decarbonisation, we'd like to hear from you. Working at BW you will feel the pulse of the world each day. If something happens in the world, we feel it, and you can play your part by anticipating and responding to it. Our high-performing teams are drawn to BW by the global nature of our work and the satisfaction of working with collaborative people who inspire each other to deliver exceptional results.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Role Overview

Based in Singapore and reporting to the Chief People Officer, BW Group, the Head of Communications & Brand leads communications and corporate brand activities across BW Group whilst also supporting BW LNG.

This is a highly visible role partnering closely with the Chairman, senior executives and Communications leaders across our affiliate companies to strengthen BW's reputation, shape its corporate narrative and foster greater collaboration across the Group.

Success requires far more than exceptional communications capability. You will be a commercially minded strategic thinker who anticipates issues, shapes narratives and influences outcomes through sound judgement, trusted relationships and collaboration in a federated organisation where credibility matters more than hierarchy.

Working with a lean team and external partners, you will combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, helping shape executive communications, protect and enhance the BW brand, support organisational transformation and drive communications excellence across the Group.

Key Accountabilities

Corporate Communications

Develop and deliver BW Group's corporate communications strategy aligned with the Group's long-term vision and priorities.

Shape compelling narratives that strengthen understanding of BW's purpose, strategy and portfolio of businesses.

Advise leaders on communications strategy, executive messaging and stakeholder engagement.

Lead communications for strategic initiatives, organisational change, major announcements and corporate events.

Oversee BW Group's digital communications, including LinkedIn and other channels, delivering engaging content that strengthens the brand and supports strategic objectives.

Executive

Communications

Partner closely with the Chairman and senior executives on speeches, presentations, thought leadership and executive communications.

Develop executive communications that reflect BW's values and high editorial standards.

Lead the production of flagship Group communications, including World Horizon, the Annual Report, Sustainability Report, corporate website and key leadership updates.

Support senior executives at conferences, media engagements, investor events and industry forums through end-to-end communications planning and delivery.

Serve as a trusted communications adviser to the Chairman and senior leadership, providing sound judgement on messaging, stakeholder considerations and reputational matters.

Employee

Communications

Lead Group-wide employee communications across digital channels.

Deliver engaging communications that connect shore-based and seafaring employees through platforms such as BW Connect.

Foster a culture of openness, pride and engagement across the Group.

Brand & Reputation

Act as steward of the BW corporate brand, ensuring consistency whilst respecting the autonomy of our affiliate businesses.

Evolve BW's corporate identity and positioning to strengthen the Group's reputation and create value across the portfolio.

Protect and enhance BW's reputation with employees, customers, investors, regulators, partners and the wider maritime and energy community.

Lead crisis and issues communications, partnering with senior management and external advisers as required for ongoing incidents and with post-communications.

BW LNG Communications & Marketing

Partner with the BW LNG leadership team to develop communications and marketing initiatives that strengthen the company's commercial positioning and reputation.

Lead communications supporting commercial initiatives, including vessel launches, technology innovations, customer campaigns and industry events.

Develop marketing content and digital campaigns that showcase BW LNG's capabilities, innovation and market leadership.

Ensure alignment between BW LNG's communications and the wider BW corporate brand.

Leadership & Influence

Lead BW's Communications Community of Practice, fostering collaboration, sharing best practice and identifying opportunities for greater alignment across affiliate companies.

Build trusted relationships with affiliate CEOs and Communications leaders, influencing through credibility rather than authority.

Foster collaboration across the Group whilst respecting the entrepreneurial culture and autonomy of individual businesses.

Digital Communications & AI

Harness AI and emerging technologies to improve the quality, consistency, efficiency and reach of communications.

Identify and implement new tools, channels and approaches that enhance engagement and communications effectiveness.

Measure communications impact using meaningful qualitative and quantitative insights.

Team Leadership

Lead, coach and develop a small, high-performing communications team.

Manage external agencies and specialist partners to maximise quality, capability and value.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

We're looking for someone who combines strategic communications leadership with exceptional judgement and the ability to influence senior stakeholders. You'll ideally bring:

Significant experience leading corporate communications within a global organisation or consultancy.

Experience advising CEOs and senior executives on communications strategy and reputation management.

Strong understanding of corporate branding, stakeholder engagement and executive communications.

Experience leading communications during periods of organisational change, transformation or significant corporate activity.

Experience working across complex, matrixed or federated organisations would be advantageous.

Experience within the maritime or energy sectors would be beneficial, although not essential.

What Will Make You Successful

You'll be someone who naturally earns trust and credibility. You'll demonstrate:

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

Excellent judgement and discretion.

The ability to simplify complex issues into clear, compelling messages.

Exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills.

Strong commercial awareness.

High levels of curiosity and strategic thinking.

Comfort working directly with senior executives and Board-level stakeholders.

A collaborative style with low ego and high integrity.

The ability to balance strategic thinking with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and deliver.

Demonstrates sound judgement in knowing when to follow established processes and when a pragmatic, flexible approach will deliver a better outcome.

A passion for continuous improvement, innovation and practical application of AI.

This role is unlikely to suit someone who prefers highly structured environments, relies on formal authority to get things done, or wants to specialise in a single area of communications. Success requires sound judgement, adaptability, collaboration and a willingness to operate across a broad range of strategic and hands-on responsibilities.

OTHER INFORMATION

Why BW?

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the voice and reputation of one of the world's most respected maritime and energy groups.

You'll work closely with visionary leaders who value integrity, long-term thinking and collaboration, while helping tell the story of a business investing in both today's energy needs and tomorrow's energy transition.

The role offers exceptional breadth, combining strategy, executive partnership, brand leadership, organisational change, employee engagement and external communications in an entrepreneurial international environment.

Please note that your application will be sent to and reviewed by the direct employer - BW Maritime

title: Head of Sales, Asia
description:
About Intellect

Intellect is the global leader in mental health benefits, trusted by the world’s most forward-thinking employers, insurers, and governments to deliver care that is local, personalised, and effective at scale. Today, we serve over 4 million people across 100 countries and languages, making mental health support truly accessible across borders and cultures.

Our platform powers the mental wellbeing of workforces at hundreds of Fortune 500 and major companies, enabling them to support their people with the highest standards of clinical quality, cultural relevance, and on-demand accessibility.

Driven by our mission to build the world’s most trusted mental health benefits platform, Intellect combines a best-in-class digital platform with a world-leading global provider network to deliver unmatched client outcomes and transformative care experiences.

We are backed by top global investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, Insignia Ventures Partners, HOF Capital, K3 Ventures, JAFCO, Headline, East Ventures, IHH Healthcare, MS&AD Ventures, and more, alongside an extensive coalition of notable family offices, big tech executives, and leading angel investors.

The Role

The Director of Sales, Asia will drive Intellect’s enterprise sales growth across our core Asian markets through direct sales and strategic alliances.

This is a hands-on leadership role with accountability for regional sales performance and an individual new business revenue target. You will lead and develop a team of Account Executives and SDRs while personally originating, owning and closing a focused portfolio of strategic enterprise opportunities.

We are looking for a strong enterprise seller and people leader who understands how to win complex deals, lead competitive RFPs and build trusted relationships with C-suite decision-makers. You should be equally comfortable setting market priorities, coaching a salesperson, leading an executive presentation and negotiating a contract.

You will work closely with Marketing, Revenue Operations and Partnerships to shape our sales go-to-market strategy, strengthen commercial discipline and build repeatable routes to growth. You will also partner with Clinical, Operations, Product and Finance to ensure our proposals deliver value for customers and are commercially sustainable.

Your Responsibilities

1. Revenue Ownership & Enterprise Selling

Own regional new business sales performance, translating revenue targets into clear market priorities, account plans and execution.
Carry an individual new business revenue target and personally own a focused portfolio of strategic deals through the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation, contracting and close.
Build qualified pipeline through targeted outreach, executive networks, referrals and partner channels, alongside Marketing and SDR-led activity.
Navigate complex buying groups, uncover customer priorities, develop compelling business cases and secure access to economic buyers and executive sponsors.
Build and deepen relationships with CHROs, Chief People Officers, Total Rewards and Benefits leaders, and other senior stakeholders involved in enterprise buying decisions.

2. Sales Team Leadership & Development

Lead, coach and develop Account Executives and SDRs, setting clear expectations for pipeline creation, opportunity progression and revenue delivery.
Run effective pipeline reviews, deal reviews and individual coaching, identifying performance gaps early and taking action to address them.
Develop the team’s capabilities in discovery, stakeholder mapping, multithreading, value articulation, executive engagement and negotiation.
Establish clear account and territory ownership; help shape hiring, team structure and incentives as the business scales.
Build a culture of accountability, collaboration and high performance through direct feedback, recognition and timely performance management.

3. RFP Leadership & Complex Deal Strategy

Lead priority enterprise RFPs and tenders end to end, including bid qualification, go/no-go decisions, win strategy, proposal development, presentations and commercial negotiations.
Build each bid strategy around the customer’s priorities, evaluation criteria, competitive landscape and Intellect’s differentiated value.
Coordinate solution specialists and cross-functional contributors to deliver accurate, compelling proposals on time, with clear ownership of deliverables.
Lead customer engagement throughout the process, navigating procurement requirements and aligning stakeholders around the proposed solution.
Use win/loss reviews to improve bid selection, sales execution, proposals and competitive positioning.

4. Go-to-Market Strategy & Marketing Collaboration

Shape and execute the sales go-to-market strategy across Asia, prioritising markets, industries, customer segments and direct versus partner-led routes.
Partner with Marketing on target account selection, account-based campaigns, events and demand generation, with shared focus on qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes.
Establish clear lead handovers and follow-up standards, using conversion data and sales feedback to improve lead quality and campaign effectiveness.
Work with Marketing and Product to sharpen enterprise positioning, value propositions and sales narratives based on customer insights and competitive intelligence.
Translate market feedback into practical recommendations on offerings, packaging and growth opportunities.

5. Alliances & Ecosystem-Led Growth

Work with the Partnerships team to turn broker, insurer and other strategic relationships into qualified enterprise pipeline and revenue.
Develop joint account plans and sales initiatives that improve access to priority customers and markets.
Lead sales execution for agreed alliance-led opportunities, coordinating partner introductions, joint pitches and negotiations.
Establish clear opportunity ownership and handovers with Partnerships, aligning direct and partner-led activity to avoid channel conflict.
Evaluate alliance-led sales activity through pipeline quality, conversion and revenue contribution.

6. Revenue Operations & Commercial Discipline

Partner with Revenue Operations to strengthen the foundations for scale: CRM standards, pipeline stages, qualification criteria, forecasting, account planning and performance reporting.
Own adoption of these standards within Sales, maintaining accurate opportunity data, realistic forecasts and clear next steps.
Use pipeline coverage, conversion, sales cycle and productivity data to identify bottlenecks and improve performance; build repeatable playbooks across priority segments.
Help shape pricing, packaging and deal structures with Finance and relevant teams, balancing customer value, competitiveness, delivery requirements and sustainable margins.
Lead deal negotiations within agreed approval frameworks and ensure effective handovers to Client Success and Operations, with clear customer commitments and ownership of follow-on opportunities.

Requirements

Proven Enterprise Sales Leader

You have a track record of delivering B2B new business growth and leading sales teams against clear revenue targets. You have personally originated and closed complex enterprise deals and can explain your contribution to those wins.

Hands-On Player-Coach

You enjoy leading a team while continuing to own and close your own opportunities. You can balance personal selling with coaching, delegate effectively and step into team deals without creating confusion over ownership.

Experienced RFP Leader

You have led and won competitive enterprise RFPs or tenders. You bring sound judgment on which bids to pursue, how to differentiate a proposal and how to coordinate teams through demanding timelines and commercial negotiations.

Strong Enterprise Seller & Executive Relationship Builder

You understand long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, from discovery and business case development through procurement, legal review and contracting. You can engage credibly with C-suite leaders, develop executive sponsors and build new relationships through outreach, networks and partner introductions.

Disciplined Sales Operator

You understand pipeline generation, qualification, forecasting, territory planning, sales methodologies and performance management. You use data to improve decisions and execution, supported by sound judgment and a close understanding of your customers.

Commercially Strategic & Collaborative

You bring strong judgment on market priorities, pricing, positioning and deal economics. You work effectively with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Partnerships and delivery teams, aligning different perspectives around clear commercial outcomes.

Experienced Across Asian Markets

You have meaningful experience in Asian enterprise markets and understand differences in buying behaviour, procurement practices and market maturity. Experience across Singapore and other major Asian markets is strongly preferred.

Experience in enterprise SaaS, HR technology, employee benefits, healthcare, insurance, professional services or another complex B2B category is advantageous. Direct mental healthcare experience is not required.

Builder Mindset & Mission Alignment

You are comfortable in a growing business where processes continue to evolve. You bring structure, take ownership and adapt as you learn. You are motivated by expanding access to quality mental healthcare while building a commercially sustainable business.

What Success Looks Like
Delivery against regional and individual new business revenue targets.
A healthy enterprise pipeline, stronger conversion and reliable forecasting.
Strategic enterprise and RFP wins on commercially sound terms.
A capable, accountable sales team with improving productivity and performance.
Measurable pipeline and revenue from alliance-led sales.
Repeatable sales practices and effective collaboration across the teams supporting growth.

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

Birthday leave – enjoy a day off on your birthday

title: Communications & Marketing Executive
description:
About the Role:

The Communications & Marketing Executive plays a vital role in promoting Practice and its programmes, as well as advocating for the value and importance of Singapore theatre by crafting compelling marketing campaigns and fostering strategic partnerships. Reporting to the managers/lead of the department, you'll work closely with internal and external stakeholders to achieve our organisational goals and objectives, ensuring the success of our diverse programmes and initiatives.

What You'll Do:

Assist the team in brainstorming and executing marketing and publicity strategies for sales, ticketing, and promotions.

Develop and execute comprehensive marketing communication plans across various communication channels, including direct marketing, digital marketing, advertising, etc.

Assist in creating marketing materials, preparing reports, and analysing campaign results.

Develop and manage timelines and project plans for various marketing and publicity initiatives. This includes:

Setting realistic deadlines for each phase of the project

Identifying and managing dependencies between tasks

Monitoring progress and making adjustments as needed

Manage social media strategy and content calendar. Work closely with the team to create content, schedule and publish content consistently, track and analyse key metrics to provide feedback, and respond and engage with the online community.

Develop and foster strategic partnerships with like-minded organisations for increased publicity.

Collaborate with various stakeholders to maintain consistent brand messaging.

Attend regular meetings and contribute ideas and insights to achieve marketing and sales targets.

Communicate effectively with partners and audiences, handle inquiries professionally, and gather feedback for improvement.

Provide administrative support to team members as needed.

Who You Are:

You are passionate about theatre and the performing arts.

You possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

You have strong organisational and time management skills.

You are creative, resourceful, and a team player.

Experience in marketing, communications, or a related field is an advantage.

Proficiency in social media platforms and digital marketing tools is preferred.

Comfortable working across English and Chinese communications, including reviewing bilingual marketing materials.

The Theatre Practice (Practice) is Singapore’s longest-standing professional bilingual theatre institution. Artist-driven and deeply progressive, Practice strives to be an arts space in Singapore that consciously nurtures and empowers people who care about humanity. Over the past 61 years, we have developed and presented works that aim to reflect the richness and complexities of Singapore’s diverse cultures.

Today, we carry on the work of our visionary co-founders and cultural medallion recipients, Kuo Pao Kun and Goh Lay Kuan. Under the helm of current Artistic Director Kuo Jian Hong, Practice continues to shape Singapore’s cultural landscape as the definitive voice in Singapore theatre. Jian Hong is deeply influenced by the importance of play in art-making and under her leadership, Practice has become the embodiment of the irrepressible spirit and fearless experimentation of play.

Practice is motivated by a desire to always respectfully entertain. We have collaborated with Singapore and international artists alike to present a critically-acclaimed repertoire of over 330 productions including musicals, classics, original and experimental works. We have toured extensively in the region. Many of our works have entered the canon of Southeast Asian literature and have been adapted and presented by theatre companies worldwide, presenting an authentically Singaporean voice on the world stage.

Since our inception, Practice has served as a cultural bridge between Asia and the world. Our current theatre festival – M1 Patch! A Theatre Festival of Artful Play – comes from a legacy of carefully curated festivals and seminars that gather practitioners of all disciplines and cultures for sharing and exchange, while providing a valuable platform for outstanding international works.

As pioneers in Arts Education in Singapore, Practice has been instrumental both in nurturing leaders in the Singapore arts scene, and inculcating a love for the arts in generations of Singapore youth.

Artistically diverse and constantly relevant, Practice will always engage with the ceaseless exploration of new frontiers.

The Theatre Practice is an Institution of Public Character, a recipient of the National Arts Council’s Major Grant 2017-2020, and a member of the Singapore Chinese Language Theatre Alliance.

title: Social Media Account Manager
description:
Job Description — Social Media Account Manager

Role

Social Media Account Manager

Reports to

Head of Operations

Location

Remote, Singapore-based

Type

Full-time

Compensation

SGD 2,200 per month

Accounts held

[X] client accounts

Review

At 3 months and 6 months

Purpose of the role

Network manages social media for interior design firms, architects and furniture suppliers across IG, FB, TikTok and YouTube. Production, design and video editing sit with the delivery team.

This role owns the account and the result. Everything that reaches a client's channel goes through this person: what gets made, what gets written, when it gets shot, and whether it performs.

The delivery team makes the work. The consultant owns the commercial relationship. The Account Manager is accountable for the work being right, landing on time, and growing the account organically. Delivery is the floor, not the measure.

Key responsibilities

Client strategy

Build the content strategy for each account with the consultant assigned to it

Take the commercial context from the consultant (what the client sells, who they want, what they have promised) and turn it into a content direction that delivers it

Set the account's organic objective with the consultant at the start of each cycle, and agree what success looks like

Bring performance data to the consultant so strategy changes are based on what happened, not on what the client asked for last

Flag when a client request will not serve the objective, and give the consultant an alternative to take back

The consultant owns the client relationship and the commercial conversation. The Account Manager owns what gets made and why.

Organic performance

Own the organic result on every assigned account: reach, engagement, page growth and enquiries

Decide what gets made based on what is performing, not on filling a calendar

Track performance weekly and change direction on evidence, not at month end

Identify formats that work on one account and carry them to others

Visual direction and alignment

Hold the visual standard on every account. Network works in a premium category and output must look considered, not templated

Keep each account visually coherent. A feed should read as one brand, not a run of unrelated posts

Reject work that meets the brief but misses the bar, and say why

Client posting and accountability

Own the posting schedule for every assigned account across all platforms

Publish or schedule all content to the agreed calendar

Review every asset before it goes live for typos, brand accuracy and strategic fit

Take responsibility for anything published in error, including retraction and client explanation

Copywriting

Write captions for all assigned accounts in the client's voice, not a house voice

Write hooks, on-creative text and CTAs supplied to the design and video teams

Adapt one concept into platform-appropriate copy across IG, FB, TikTok and YouTube

Maintain a written voice reference for each account so copy stays consistent

Creative deliverables

Plan the content calendar and pipeline for each account against the agreed monthly deliverable

Write briefs for the graphic and video teams that are complete enough to execute without follow-up

Track every deliverable from brief to published, and know its status without being asked

Run revision rounds with the delivery team and close them out

Shoot scheduling and coordination

Schedule production shoots with the client and the production team

Confirm site access, timing, homeowner permissions and scope before the shoot date

Brief the production team on what the shoot must produce

Chase and confirm footage handover after the shoot

Delivery team communication

Act as the single point of contact between clients and the graphic, video and production teams

Give the delivery team enough lead time to work; escalate capacity conflicts early

Keep the delivery team unblocked so they are never waiting on information

Client communication

Own client group chats as the day-to-day point of contact

Respond within working hours, with no dropped threads

Manage expectations on timelines and flag delays before the client notices them

Performance measures

Performance on this role is judged on organic outcomes, not activity.

Primary

Organic creative performance: reach, retention and engagement on published content against account baseline

Page growth: follower growth, saves and shares across assigned accounts

Organic enquiries: DMs, comments and leads generated through organic content

Visual direction: accounts hold a consistent, premium visual standard across the feed

Strategic alignment: what gets made maps to the account's growth objective

Baseline

On-time publishing rate across all assigned accounts

Errors reaching a live client channel (target: zero)

Deliverables completed against monthly contracted volume

Shoot dates held versus rescheduled

Delivery team blocked time attributable to missing briefs or information

Baseline measures are expectations. Missing them is a problem. Meeting them is not performance.

Requirements

Experience

1–2 years running social media accounts in a client-facing role

Demonstrated organic growth on an account you owned, with numbers

Skills

Written Mandarin and English

Copywriting for social, with samples

Meta Business Suite, native platform scheduling and native analytics

Able to read performance data and change direction from it

Taste. Two versions of an asset in front of you, you can say which is better and why

Able to write a brief another person can execute without asking questions

Able to hold a strategy conversation with a salesperson and push back with reasoning

Accurate proofreading under volume

Other

Contactable and responsive on WhatsApp during working hours

Works without supervision or reminders

Singapore-based

Working arrangement

Remote. Occasional attendance at shoots or client meetings as required. Communication runs through WhatsApp and [project management tool].

Out of scope

Graphic design and video editing

Filming and on-site production

Paid media buying

Client contract negotiation, pricing and upselling

Ownership of the commercial relationship

Network Singapore is a digital marketing and lead generation company specialising in the interior design industry. We operate one of Singapore's leading online portals connecting homeowners with interior design firms, helping businesses grow their client base through targeted digital exposure and a consistent flow of qualified leads.

Founded with a focus on results, we work closely with interior design professionals across Singapore to deliver marketing solutions that are measurable, scalable, and built around the needs of a competitive market. Our platform is designed to reduce the time and cost of client acquisition for interior design firms, allowing them to focus on what they do best — delivering exceptional spaces.

At Network Singapore, we believe in building long-term partnerships with our clients. Our team combines deep industry knowledge with a data-driven approach to ensure that every firm on our platform gets maximum visibility and genuine business opportunities.

We are a growing company with a performance-driven culture, committed to developing talent from within and building a team that takes pride in delivering results.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
About This Role

We’re looking for an Account Manager who can make a complex account feel clear, controlled and well-run—for the client and for the team delivering it.

You will be a senior day-to-day client contact across TGP’s social media accounts. You will guide the client relationship, account plan, delivery rhythm and commercial health of the work, while collaborating closely with an Account Executive and colleagues across strategy, content, design and production.

The role brings together client partnership, delivery management and commercial awareness. You will turn client priorities into clear action, keep the team ahead of deadlines and give the client confidence that TGP understands both the work and the wider business context.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Build strong client relationships: Lead day-to-day communication, meetings and status updates. Understand the client’s priorities, working style, brand sensitivities and internal stakeholders.

• Shape the account plan: Work with the strategy and content teams to translate monthly priorities into a clear content calendar, production plan and approval schedule.

• Turn discussions into clear action: Make sure important meetings are followed by an accurate written record covering the client’s request, TGP’s recommendation, agreed deliverables, owners and deadlines.

• Provide clear recommendations: Bring together input from the team, explain TGP’s point of view confidently and help the client make informed decisions.

• Coordinate delivery: Keep content, design, production, editing, approvals and publishing moving across multiple work streams. Identify risks early and work with the relevant people to resolve them.

• Work closely with the AccountExecutive: Agree priorities, coordinate responsibilities and review key trackers, follow-ups and client records together. Help the AE build confidence and take on greater ownership over time.

• Support the account’s commercial health: Track deliverables against the agreed scope, identify additional requests, support costings and keep agency time and margins in mind.

• Keep communication connected: Make sure everyone has the context, decisions and client feedback needed to do the work well.

• Turn performance into action: Coordinate reporting and work with the wider team to identify useful recommendations for the next content cycle.

• Contribute to pitches: Bring client insight, delivery planning and account-management thinking to new-business opportunities when needed.

Who You Are

You are organised, calm and decisive. You communicate early, maintain clear written records and keep several priorities moving with clarity.

You are comfortable bringing a point of view rather than simply reporting a problem. When an issue needs attention, you can explain the context, recommend a way forward and identify the decision required.

You are collaborative and generous with information. You understand that strong account management helps different disciplines work well together while giving the client a clear and consistent experience.

You are also comfortable using modern tools, includingAI-assisted tools where useful, to reduce repetitive administration, structure information and improve speed. You review the work carefully and apply your own judgment, client knowledge and communication standards before it is used.

Skills & Experience

• 4+ years of account management or client-services experience, ideally in a creative, social media, digital or integrated agency.

• Experience managing recurring content or social media retainers with multiple monthly deliverables is strongly preferred.

• Strong client-facing presence and clear, confident written communication.

• Proven ability to manage calendars, approvals, revisions, production dependencies and competing deadlines.

• Experience working with and supporting the development of an Account Executive or junior colleague.

• Commercial awareness, including scope control, cost implications and agency profitability.

• Confidence collaborating with strategists, writers, designers, producers and editors.

• Familiarity with social media content workflows, platform formats, reporting and publishing processes.

• Resourcefulness and a willingness to learn and apply tools that improve how work is organised and delivered.

Review and maintain the Marketing Events Calendar and plan marketing activity sufficiently in advance.

Identify content opportunities from events for future marketing use.

Maintain an organised and current library of photography, video and marketing assets.

Identify opportunities that support SEO, GEO and AEO visibility, brand awareness and lead generation.

Maintain and regularly review School profiles across education portals, directories and external listings.

Support delivery of agreed marketing requirements for partnerships and external collaborations.

Ensure partner branding and marketing assets remain consistent with School guidelines.

Monitor agreed third-party deliverables and ensure required content and assets are supplied within deadlines.

7. Reporting, Suppliers & Marketing Operations

Prepare quarterly marketing reports covering campaigns, social media, website activity, digital visibility and other agreed performance metrics, working with relevant team members to consolidate inputs.

Maintain and develop trackers and reports for management review, internal planning and marketing strategy alignment.

Maintain accurate marketing trackers, calendars and project records.

Obtain supplier quotations and manage routine production requirements within approved parameters.

Track supplier deliverables, timelines and quality, escalating issues where required.

Maintain records of marketing expenditure, purchase requests, invoices and associated documentation.

Maintain appropriate stock levels of marketing collateral, branded materials and event assets.

8. Cross-Departmental Working & Ownership

Build strong working relationships with Admissions, Academic Teams, Events, Partnerships and Business Development, Parent Engagement, Finance and other School departments.

Take ownership of agreed marketing requests and ensure they are followed through to completion.

Manage competing deadlines and escalate priorities where appropriate.

Proactively identify opportunities across School activities that could support marketing, reputation or admissions objectives.

Bring forward ideas and recommendations rather than relying solely on assigned tasks.

Contribute actively to marketing planning discussions and team initiatives.

Safeguarding:

Abide by the school safeguarding policy and keep abreast of any changes.

Ensure appropriate safeguarding, consent and privacy requirements are followed in relation to student photography, filming and marketing content.

Ad Hoc:

Undertake other reasonable responsibilities and provide additional support as required in line with the evolving business needs of the AMC Department.

title: Head of Client Experience Marketing, Executive Director
description:
WHO WE ARE:

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

 Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

 We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

Job Purpose

The Head of Client Experience Marketing is responsible for the execution and experience delivery of OCBC’s signature client engagement programs across Global Consumer Financial Services (GCFS), spanning children and youth, mass banking, seniors, Premier Banking and Premier Private Client.

Segment owns each program, including its strategic rationale, target audience, proposition, business objectives and overall direction. Client Experience Marketing owns the How, translating that strategy into a distinctive, on-brand client experience through experience design, curation, production, partnerships and content amplification.

The role provides specialist expertise and execution leadership to deliver programs consistently, efficiently and to a high standard across CFS.

Key Responsibilities

Program Execution & Experience Delivery

Lead the end-to-end execution of signature client programs owned by CFS Segment teams.
Translate Segment and Sales objectives into compelling experiences tailored to the intended audience, from children and young adults to affluent, high-net-worth and intergenerational families.
Lead experience design and curation of the events, including program format, speakers, activities, partners, venues and the overall client journey.
Oversee production and delivery, including agencies, hospitality, guest experience, logistics and appropriate safeguarding requirements.
Establish common experience and delivery standards while ensuring programs are tailored to the needs of each client segment.
Develop playbooks, standards and best practices to enable markets including Malaysia, Indonesia and Hong Kong to deliver signature programs consistently, while local markets retain ownership of execution.
Manage the cross-segment program calendar and coordinate resources and production requirements across GCFS.

Content & Social Amplification

Lead the content and amplification approach for signature programs, extending their reach and impact beyond event attendees.
Develop content across pre-event, live and post-event stages to drive awareness, engagement and advocacy.
Work with internal teams and external agencies to create compelling, shareable and on-brand content and storytelling.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

Partner with Segment and Sales to define appropriate measures of program effectiveness and provide insights into client experience, participation, engagement and content performance.
Recommend improvements to program format, curation and experience based on performance, client feedback and execution learnings.
Support Segment in refreshing, scaling or evolving programs, bringing an experience and execution perspective.
Build and share best practices across the portfolio to continuously improve quality, efficiency and client impact.

Budget, Partnerships & Vendor Management

Manage program and experiential marketing budgets within agreed business priorities, ensuring effective allocation, tracking and cost discipline.
Build and manage a strong ecosystem of partners across luxury, hospitality, lifestyle, entertainment, content and experiential marketing.
Lead agency and vendor selection, negotiation and performance management, while maintaining a strong bench of preferred partners.

Stakeholder & Governance Management

Partner closely with Segment Heads, Sales, Relationship Managers, Marketing and other stakeholders to deliver programs against intended client and business objectives.
Bring creative and execution expertise to program planning, constructively challenging and recommending enhancements where appropriate.
Work with Brand, Compliance, Legal, Risk and other relevant functions to ensure programs meet applicable brand, regulatory, safeguarding, gifting and entertainment requirements.

Candidate Profile

18+ years of relevant experience in client engagement, experiential marketing, branded programs or premium events, with a strong track record in senior leadership roles.
Experience in private banking, premier or priority banking, luxury, hospitality, lifestyle or a comparable premium consumer environment would be advantageous.
Proven experience translating business and brand strategies into high-quality experiential programs spanning experience design, curation, production and content amplification.
Experience building and evolving recurring experiential platforms or signature programs, rather than solely delivering one-off events.
Ability to design experiences for different customer segments and life stages, including affluent, high-net-worth and intergenerational families.
Strong experience in content and social amplification, agency management and luxury, hospitality, lifestyle and experiential ecosystem.
Excellent senior stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed organization where program ownership sits with the business.
Polished and credible, with the presence to engage senior stakeholders and clients across all segments, including affluent, high-net-worth and next-generation clients.

What we offer:

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

title: Account Executive / Senior Account Executive
description:
Company Description

AKA is an integrated communications agency based in Singapore, supporting our clients locally, regionally and globally by conceptualising and bringing to life compelling creative campaigns. Part of our offering is design and production support - from creating on-point infographics for an infant formula brand, through to shooting stylish cinema ads for a travel destination. Everyone at AKA is forward-thinking, collaborative, and passionate about delivering great work for our clients (plus we're a friendly bunch). We enjoy a flat hierarchy and expect everyone - no matter what level - to bring ideas to work every day, speak their mind, and positively contribute to the culture. We're proud to work with some of the world's leading brands - the likes of Durex, Meta, Jetstar Asia, Tourism New Zealand, and Levi's to name just a few.

Overview

An Account Executive / Senior Account Executive at AKA Asia supports the development and execution of integrated PR campaigns across lifestyle, entertainment, and corporate brands. This role involves managing day-to-day client communications, coordinating media outreach, crafting press materials, and ensuring seamless campaign delivery. You will work closely with internal teams and media partners to secure impactful coverage, while maintaining strong client relationships and delivering against strategic objectives. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and passionate about storytelling, with a solid understanding of the media landscape in Singapore and the region.

Responsibilities

Client Handling



- Set up and attend client meetings (as part of a team) with enthusiasm and a willingness to learn
- Understand the client’s goals and the team’s role in meeting those goals
- Produce reports with care and accuracy where required (social media evaluations, coverage
- reports etc)
- Monitor and flag issues relevant to client’s business
- Keep up to date on your client’s industry, especially competitor activity

Working with the team

- Plan campaigns with team and support with implementing scope on projects to deadline
- Be detailed and thorough in research you carry out to provide the team with the best intel

New business



- Support with brainstorms, research and proposal development
- Build knowledge of the different services we provide as an agency to help with development of
- integrated ideas and to grow existing clients
- Learn how we can communicate better through Digital and Design

Stakeholder engagement (media, influencers)



- Establish key relationships through engagement with media & influencers
- Create first draft materials (press release, bi-lines, pitch notes and posts)
- Run daily media monitoring to stay updated on what makes news/trends

- Maintain media/influencer databases (on our platforms affable.ai & telum media)
- Master the technical aspects of managing digital channels e.g. social media, intranet, internal
- social platforms, podcasts
- Coordinate events including planning programme run-down, liaising with suppliers, creating
- media packs, logistics, travel requirements etc.Digital and Design
- Have sound and current knowledge of social media/digital platforms and be eager to learn more
- Create social media posts based on agreed content strategy
- Work closely with the Design team to deliver relevant assets for clients
- Prop source for shoots
- Keep on top of current trends and share with the team

Financial and Admistrative



- Stay on top of office administrative matters i.e. timesheets, expense reports, petty cash etc.

Living the AKA Values



- Regardless of level, our culture at AKA is what binds us together to deliver the most formidable
- outcomes for our clients, and fosters a positive and vibrant environment in which to work and
- build relationships:
- Be a leader (we put our hand up, we trust our gut and flag concerns, we make
- recommendations, we ask why)
- People first, always
- Be a self starter
- A passion to learn
- Fearless Creativity

Qualifications



- 1 – 4 years in the communications industry, with relevant experience
- Good writing skills (across various platforms)
- Experience working with media & influencers
- Capability across multiple comms platforms including social media (instagram, facebook, twitter, tiktok, linkedin etc), events and media relations
- Provide reliable support to teams on accounts and new business

title: Communications Specialist
description:
Meet the Team

Join the dynamic Asia Pacific, Japan and Greater China Communications team, part of Cisco’s International Communications function which spans the globe and includes Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Canada. We are at the forefront of the digital disruption narrative, actively shaping global perceptions and conversations around the transformative power of Cisco technology. You’ll be an integral part of a high-impact team amplifying how Cisco is delivering the critical infrastructure for the AI era.  

 

For more than 40 years, Cisco has securely connected the world. With its industry leading AI-powered solutions and services, Cisco enables its customers, partners and communities to unlock innovation, enhance productivity and strengthen digital resilience. With purpose at its core, Cisco remains committed to powering an inclusive future for all. 

Your Impact

As a Communications Specialist, you will be a central part of the ASEAN communications efforts. You won’t just support programs; you will lead defined initiatives to support the regional business priorities by translating global business goals into local, high-impact stories and driving employee engagement. This is an exciting opportunity to act as a trusted advisor to regional executives, shape our external reputation, and work alongside the broader APJC team to deliver world-class communication outcomes in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

- Develop and execute integrated internal and external communication strategies that align with ASEAN business priorities and global themes, using storytelling to bring narratives to life. 
- Act as a trusted advisor to senior ASEAN and Asia Pacific leadership, providing counsel on positioning, media engagement, and reputation management. 
- Build and maintain relationships with regional media, and support agency management to ensure high-quality output against defined KPIs.

- Minimum of 5+ years of professional experience in corporate communications, PR agencies, or media-related businesses. 
- Experience supporting B2B technology communications or managing integrated campaigns. 
- Experience coordinating with agency partners on content execution and performance against KPIs. 

Preferred Qualifications



- Established media relationships within the ASEAN market 
- Strong editorial and writing skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas into clear messaging. 
- Demonstrated ability to build trust with stakeholders and collaborate across a matrixed organization. 
- Experience using data and measurement tools to track campaign performance and inform strategy. 
- Growth mindset — proven ability to challenge the status quo and implement innovative communication tactics. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

- Strong project management skills to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

#

What’s In It For You?

Our Mission

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

Our People

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective.
