title: Senior Executive / (Senior) Assistant Manager, Communications (2-Year Contract)
description:
Career in the Hospital

Join our incredible team at the National University Hospital (NUH), where we believe that a hospital is more than just a workplace. Every day, we witness the remarkable impact that our healthcare professionals can have on individuals, families, and entire communities.

At NUH, we are driven by a shared purpose – to lend a helping hand to those in need, to be a source of support and healing, and to empower patients to live their best lives.

We are looking for passionate and committed individuals to join us as we transform lives and create a lasting impact in the lives of our patients. The impact you make at NUH will be profound, regardless of the role you take up in the hospital.

About NUH

The National University Hospital (NUH) is Singapore’s leading university hospital, with a proud heritage dating back to 1905 with the establishment of what’s now the NUS Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine. Our strong ties with the medical school have shaped us into a unique institution, allowing us to seamlessly integrate clinical care with teaching and research. As a university hospital, we go beyond the realm of providing tertiary medical care. We are a hub of knowledge and innovation, attracting healthcare professionals who are passionate about pushing boundaries and making significant contributions to the field.

About Department And Purpose Of The Position

We are looking for a team player to work alongside a group of passionate professionals in a supportive and innovative environment, to make a real impact in healthcare communications. You will play a key role in promoting the NUH brand as Singapore’s University Hospital, engaging diverse stakeholders and driving impactful campaigns that showcase the hospital’s values and achievements.

Key Responsibilities



-  Conceptualise and implement campaigns to the hospital’s programmes, initiatives, innovations and people, including social media content 
-  Develop and execute staff engagement plans to strengthen organisational culture 
-  Provide strategic communications counsel including branding and editorial oversight and support to internal stakeholders 
-  Develop crisis communications plans and participate in emergency preparedness exercises 


Key Requirements



-  Bachelor in mass communications, public relations, marketing, journalism or a related field 
-  Minimum three years’ relevant work experience in a fast-paced environment, with a proven track record in managing communications campaigns 
-  Good knowledge in effective communication channels and tools 
-  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, creative, meticulous and results-oriented 
-  Able to handle multiple projects, multitask and work well under pressure. A team player who thrives in a dynamic and evolving workplace 


Closing & Applications

When you join NUH, you become part of a dynamic and collaborative environment where expertise, knowledge, and compassion all come together.

Working in healthcare offers satisfaction that extend far beyond the ordinary. The smiles of gratitude from patients and the profound sense of fulfilment that comes from helping others cannot be measured. It is a career that allows for both personal and professional growth. The challenges you encounter in this rapidly evolving industry push you to constantly expand your knowledge and skills, as well as encourage lifelong learning.

Be a part of a team that gets to create a transformative healthcare experience for our patients and professionals alike.

description:

Qualifications

- Are scrappy. You thrive in thinking “outside the box” and find joy in marrying a problem to its solution
- Are experienced at hiring, onboarding, and managing PR agencies
- Are adept in pre-IPO communications

- Are an exceptional writer with a talent for distilling complex, cross-functional topics into simple, compelling narratives

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

How And Where We Work

title: APAC Media Relations Spokesperson
description:
About The Role

As the APAC Media Relations Spokesperson, you will play a dual role as a spokesperson and a regional coordinator. You will need to display a clear understanding of Shell's strategy and an ability to communicate it in a coherent way across print, broadcast, online and social media, and work to mitigate the reach and impact of inaccurate stories. 

You will work closely with country media relations leads within the APAC region, and act as a focal point to help ensure they respond on behalf of Shell consistently, and are proactively communicating company content and messages. 

 

Where you fit in 

Reporting to the head of media relations APAC, the APAC media relations spokesperson is a support for heads of media relations in countries in the APAC region and a bridge to the Group External Communications and Campaigns team. Together, the regional and Group media relations teams act as one, managing relationships with major domestic and international print, online, social and broadcast media and driving consistency of Shell message. 

 

Key Responsibilities: 

You will be accountable for helping to drive the consistency of media relations in the region, with focus on English language outlets. You will also support with media relations work in Australia as required. 

More specifically, your role will include: 



- Build and strengthen relationships with senior journalists from international news wires and influential trade publications based in Singapore, to provide trusted insight and context for Shell’s strategy and key activities.   
- Engagement with international media on projects, activities and developing/emerging issues (including crisis situations) across APAC and issues above country level.  
- Supporting on Australia-specific media relations work as required, including leave cover and support on major projects, announcements, issues and activities.  
- Leverage senior leader visits to countries in the region and drive consistency of briefings and alignment with group story,  identify opportunities with country Corporate Relations teams to maximise benefit and cut-through of activities such as media briefings, events and site visits within the region.  
- Acting on own initiative when representing the Group’s policies and actions to media, and in determining appropriate tone and level of response.  
- Filtering incoming requests from international media for interviews/engagement with business leaders across the region and advising the in-country media leads. Drive proactive activity where needed to support Shell’s business strategy.  
- Implementing the strategy, policy and standards guidelines process to drive consistency of media relations work across APAC.  
- Connect country Corporate Relations teams with Group standards, guidelines, strategy, and best practices to drive consistency in media relations and messaging across APAC, including:

- Acting as a sounding board for media relations advice and coordination across the region.
- Supporting a regional community of practice.
- Disseminating Group messaging and holding statements.
- Acting as the regional approver, where required.
- Coordinate with Group team to monitor and measure cut through of Shell messaging in proactive storytelling and to keep track of momentum with issues, to inform action, including use of data and analytics.   
- Disclosure assistance for country leads as needed.  

 

What we need from you :

A hunger for and insight into news is essential.  You should have a strong interest in the external media landscape and the interaction of traditional, social and broadcast media outlets. You should be keen to get out and about to engage with journalists. You have a learner mindset and are always willing to learn from mistakes and successes. You are someone who integrates and collaborates across boundaries to maximise commercial value for Shell as a whole. When it comes to a fast-paced and constantly changing environment, you are resilient and can thrive in these situations. 

 

You’ll ideally have extensive media relations experience, preferably within a multinational organisation. Beyond that, we’d hope to see as many of the following as possible: 



- Strong experience working in a corporate communications team, within a complex organisation either in the public or private sector.  
- Demonstrate and deploy good judgment and creativity.  
- An ability to identify compelling stories and have an external focus.  
- Extensive experience working with senior business leaders, providing strategic support and guidance, developing trusted partnerships to support business outcomes.  
- Strong writing skills and proven track record in the development of creative, engaging content.  
- Use of data and insights to inform strategy and tactics.   

 

What we offer 

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself. 



- Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.  
- Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.  
- Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.  
- Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.  
- Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.  
- Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.  
- Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.  
- Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents.  
- Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.  
- Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and  international teams.  
- Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.  

 

We'd like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal, click here. 

  

We are committed to attracting a broader and more diverse pool of candidates. If this position doesn’t feel like the perfect fit for your qualifications right now, we’d still love to hear from you. Consider creating a profile in our Talent Community so we can keep you in mind for future opportunities that may align with your skills. 

  

Shell in Singapore 

Shell is an international energy company that uses advanced technologies and takes an innovative approach to help build a sustainable energy future. Here in Singapore, Shell has a long history and is one of the country’s largest foreign investors. It has businesses spanning trading and marketing of liquefied natural gas; refining, trading, marketing and shipping of oil products, lubricants and chemicals; low carbon solutions; and operating a network of service stations through retailers, as well as electric vehicles charging. 

 

Diversity, equity and inclusion | Shell Global 

At Shell we are working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive organisations in the world, a place where everyone feels valued and respected and has a strong sense of belonging.

[What we are looking for]

What we offer you:

title: Communications Business Partner
description:
Why explore



- Be part of a values driven organisation where safety, care and inclusion are always the top priority
- Work in a strategic, high impact communications role partnering with senior leaders across Development, Commercial & Functions
- Flexible working arrangements available, supporting balance between work and life
- Based in Singapore, a global commercial hub for Rio Tinto

About The Role

We are looking for a Communications Business Partner to play a critical role in shaping and protecting Rio Tinto’s reputation and culture, supporting the strategic priorities of Development, Commercial & Functions (DCF) and the Group more broadly.

This is a great opportunity for a strategic and commercially minded communications professional to provide trusted counsel to senior leaders and deliver purposeful, high impact communications that enable business outcomes. This role is part of the Communications - Development, Commercial & Functions team and, for the foreseeable future, will support Commercial including executive communications

Reporting to the General Manager Communications - Development, Commercial & Functions, you will work closely with the Chief Commercial Officer and senior leaders of Commercial, or other Heads of Division or Function and their leadership teams, as required. Your portfolio may evolve over time in response to business priorities.

You will be responsible for



- Developing and delivering communications strategies aligned to Group and DCF priorities.
- Providing strategic communications counsel to senior leaders, ensuring communications are purposeful and effective.
- Strengthening and protecting the profile and reputation of supported functions or divisions.
- Identifying, managing and escalating communications and reputational risks as required.
- Supporting leadership communications, including business updates and key messages.
- Managing leader profiles and coordinating key engagements in line with Group priorities.
- Planning and delivering key events such as town halls and leadership engagements.
- Creating and overseeing high-quality communications materials, including narratives, messaging, digital content and visual assets.

About You

To be successfully considered for this role, you will have 



- Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, Business, or a related discipline.
- 10-15+ years of relevant communications or external affairs experience, including substantial experience within mining and metals, natural resources, energy, commodities, or other complex industrial environments.
- A commitment to the safety of yourself and your team.
- Proven experience providing strategic communications counsel to senior leaders.
- Strong ability to translate complex business priorities into clear, targeted communications.
- Experience managing reputational risk with sound judgement and discretion.
- Excellent stakeholder engagement and influencing skills across senior and cross functional teams.
- Strong writing and content development capability across multiple channels and formats.
- Strong understanding of mining market experience.

What We Offer

Be recognised for your contribution, your thinking and your hard work, and go home knowing you’ve helped the world progress.



- A work environment where safety is always the number one priority
- A competitive salary package with annual cash incentive awards for eligible employees
- Career development & education assistance to further your ambitions
- Access top tier family-friendly health and medical programs and pension plan
- Wellbeing benefits
- Generous Rio Tinto employee share program
- Employee Assistance Program
- Ongoing individual wellbeing support for you and your family for personal and professional matter
- Leave for all of life’s reasons (vacation/annual, paid parental, sick leave)

Where you will be working

You will be part of Rio Tinto’s Group Communications function, working in a collaborative and high performing environment that partners closely with senior leaders across the business to deliver meaningful outcomes. This role is based in Singapore.

(Rio Tinto reserves the right to remove job postings prior to the stated closing date)

Please note, in order to be successfully considered for this role you must complete all pre-screening questions.

Rio Tinto does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles from recruiters or employment agencies. Rio Tinto will not consider or agree to payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee relating to unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles. Rio Tinto reserves the right to hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles, including those submitted to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Rio Tinto.”

About Rio Tinto

Rio Tinto is a leading global mining and materials company. We operate in 35 countries where we produce iron ore, copper, aluminium, critical minerals, and other materials needed for the global energy transition and for people, communities, and nations to thrive.

We have been mining for 150 years and operate with knowledge built up across generations and continents. Our purpose is finding better ways to provide the materials the world needs – striving for innovation and continuous improvement to produce materials with low emissions and to the right environmental, social and governance standards. But we can’t do it on our own, so we’re focused on creating partnerships to solve problems, create win-win situations and meet opportunities.

Respect and Inclusion

At Rio Tinto, we particularly welcome and encourage applications from Indigenous Peoples, women, the LGBTQ+ community, mature workers, people with disabilities and people from different cultural backgrounds.

We are committed to an inclusive environment where people feel comfortable to be themselves. We want our people to feel that all voices are heard, all cultures respected and that a variety of perspectives are not only welcome – they are essential to our success. We treat each other fairly and with dignity regardless of race, gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, age, sexual orientation or anything else that makes us different.

title: AVP/VP, Employee Communications
description:
GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 locations around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world’s industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.

Corporate Affairs and Communications 

The Corporate Affairs and Communications (CAC) department is responsible for managing corporate affairs, branding and reputation, and all internal and external communications. It includes GIC’s interface with key stakeholders, including the general public and media.

Employee Communications

GIC’s Employee Communications team connects employees across 11 global offices to the organisation’s vision, purpose and strategic direction. The team drives impactful storytelling and engagement through internal communications channels, campaigns, and events — ensuring every GICian understands how their work contributes to GIC’s long-term success.

What impact can you make in this role?

As AVP/VP, Employee Communications, you will help shape how GIC communicates internally — turning complex ideas into clear, engaging stories that inspire and inform employees globally. You’ll strengthen connection and alignment across offices, enhance digital engagement, and use data and technology to elevate how we communicate as one GIC.

What will you do as a AVP/VP, Employee Communications?

Reporting to the Head of Employee Communications, you will be part of the Global Corporate Affairs and Communications team. You will plan and deliver internal communications content and campaigns across multiple channels and events. Your role will include:



- Develop and deliver internal content and campaigns — Plan, draft, and publish high-quality communications across channels such as newsletters, Yammer, and enterprise campaigns. Shape leadership messages, event materials, and storytelling that connect employees to GIC’s mission, values, and strategic priorities.
- Enhance and manage the OneGIC intranet — Partner with the intranet lead to curate engaging content, manage homepage and news updates, design and layout articles on the site, and ensure the platform remains dynamic, user-friendly, and aligned with GIC’s tone and digital content standards. 
- Launch and enhance internal communication channels — Work closely with technology teams to improve existing digital platforms and launch new solutions features that strengthen employee engagement globally, streamline content delivery, and enhance the overall user experience.
- Manage the internal communications ecosystem and calendar — Oversee the planning and coordination of content across all internal channels, including the intranet, newsletters, digital screens, physical spaces, and events, ensuring cohesive messaging, consistent cadence, and optimal use of each platform for departments to reach employees effectively.
- Lead enterprise-wide initiatives — Support major internal campaigns and events, from concept development to post-event storytelling.
- Drive global alignment and engagement — Cascade key enterprise messages through toolkits, rollout guides, and briefing materials that enable regional teams to communicate effectively, while driving initiatives and content that strengthen connection, participation, and a unified culture across GIC’s global offices.
- Enhance impact through data and AI — Use channels analytics to uncover insights that drive smarter communication decisions, and apply AI tools to boost efficiency, personalise content, and deepen employee engagement.
- Collaborate across teams — Liaise with internal stakeholders and external agencies to deliver best-in-class content, manage end-to-end workflows, and ensure alignment, quality, and consistency across all internal communications initiatives.


What makes you a successful candidate?



- Minimum of 6–10 years of relevant experience in communications disciplines, with dedicated experience in internal or employee communications.
- Background in financial services preferred.
- Proven experience managing internal communication channels, including intranet and newsletter platforms, with a strong track record of creating engaging, high-impact content.
- Experience working with Content Management Systems and an understanding of UI/UX ideal.
- Ability to think laterally and apply AI and digital tools creatively to solve communication gaps and challenges, enhance processes, and improve technology-driven workflows.
- Strong writing and editorial skills, with expertise in structuring news and storytelling for internal audiences, supported by sound research and critical thinking.
- Keen attention to detail and editorial judgment, capable of reviewing content critically and ensuring alignment with GIC’s tone and standards.
- Ability to connect the dots across enterprise initiatives teams, synthesising information and perspectives to craft cohesive, enterprise-level narratives that reinforce alignment and shared purpose.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
- Sound stakeholder management and judgment, operating with professionalism, discretion, and collaboration.
- Proactive and solutions-oriented, able to multitask, manage priorities, and take ownership of projects with strong initiative and follow-through.


Work at the Point of Impact

We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.

Flexibility at GIC 

At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration, but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

We are an equal opportunity employer

GIC is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Please email grphrodtaops@gic.com.sg at any point of the application or interview process if adjustments need to be made due to a disability.

Learn more about our Corporate Affairs & Communication Department here: 

https://gic.careers/group/corporate-affairs-communication/
Our PRIME Values
GIC is a values driven organization. GIC’s PRIME Values act as our compass, enabling us to fulfil our fundamental purpose and objectives. It is the foundational bedrock which governs our behaviors, our decision making, and our focus. It informs both our long-term strategy as a firm, and the way we relate to our Client, business partners and employees. PRIME stands for Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence.

title: PR & Communications Director, APAC
categories: IT Services and IT Consulting, Technology, Information and Internet, and Advertising Services
description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

Who We Are

The Trade Desk is changing the way global brands and their agencies advertise to audiences around the world. How? With a media-buying platform that empowers marketers to deliver a more insightful and relevant ad experience for consumers — and sets a new standard for global reach, accuracy, and transparency.

The public relations and communications team at The Trade Desk plays a vital role in elevating the company’s profile through compelling storytelling, high-impact media engagement, and strategic external events that resonate with key audiences. As a link between the organization and external audiences, the team partners collaboratively across the business to build strong relationships and advocacy across stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

The Trade Desk is seeking an experienced strategic communications leader who will be responsible for setting the PR strategy in Australia, India, Southeast Asia and elevating the company’s profile through impactful programs that amplify compelling narratives and drive media and external engagement.

This role requires proven experience within B2B communications – ideally within technology or digital media – with a proven track record of developing strategic communications programs, strong media relations strategy, strong relationship management skills and an ability to grasp complex issues in a technical environment.

The candidate should possess exceptional hunting ability to proactively drive stories, strong attention to detail, paired with the ability to craft compelling narratives that engage the media and clearly connect PR efforts to business impact. This person should be a self-starter who thrives in fast-moving environments and can collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders across different regions and time zones.

In this role, you will:




- Lead and develop strategic PR plans across Australia, India and Southeast Asia, building awareness of The Trade Desk and articulating the vision and value of the company
- Drive proactive media coverage in support of The Trade Desk, including major trade publications and national business press, leveraging existing relationships and building new ones
- Prepare and support executives for media interviews, external speaking engagements and opportunities for thought leadership
- Manage external PR agencies to ensure alignment on strategic, high-priority initiatives and an effective press calendar
- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to manage executive communications and key events end-to-end
- Support business and marketing leaders on the creation, development and execution of media and partner marketing strategies
- Coordinate with local, regional and global marketing and global communications colleagues to ensure alignment on messaging, news releases, product launches, key events, and press interviews

Who You Are




- 12+ years of PR and Communications experience
- We are looking for a strategic thinker, sharp writer and seasoned media relations professional within B2B communications, ideally within technology or digital media
- Experienced in shaping and leading complex, multi-market communications programs at scale particularly across Australia, India and Southeast Asia
- Demonstrated success in media strategy and relations, cultivating strong journalist relationships and driving high-impact coverage across business and trade press
- Strong executive-presence skills, with the ability to advise, brief and influence senior stakeholders with confidence and clarity
- Highly organized and detail-oriented with the ability to connect tactical execution to broader strategic goals
- Demonstrated critical thinking skills, including data analysis, problem solving and attention to detail
- A collaborative, solutions-oriented approach, particularly in fast-moving or ambiguous environments, across markets and diverse stakeholder groups
- Experience working in information technology organizations, software, marketing technology, advertising technology, or knowledge of the data and technology businesses within the advertising industry are strongly preferred

The Trade Desk does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm recruiters. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of The Trade Desk. The Trade Desk is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, The Trade Desk is committed to creating an inclusive hiring experience where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

Please reach out to us at accommodations@ thetradedesk. com to request an accommodation or discuss any accessibility needs you may require to access our Company Website or navigate any part of the hiring process.

When you contact us, please include your preferred contact details and specify the nature of your accommodation request or questions. Any information you share will be handled confidentially and will not impact our hiring decisions.

title: Sr Executive, Communications
description:
Job Summary

The Senior Executive supports TTSH's corporate communications and elective marketing efforts through the development of visual, digital and multimedia content. The incumbent is responsible for conceptualising and creating marketing collateral, producing multimedia content, and managing projects independently from ideation to publication. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners, the incumbent will support communications and marketing campaigns while ensuring timely delivery of content, adherence to TTSH's brand guidelines and serving as a brand steward for the department.

Main Duties And Responsibilities



-  Design marketing and communications collateral, including social media graphics, posters, EDMs, infographics, banners, brochures and event materials. 
-  Create multimedia content, including photography, videography, motion graphics and short-form digital content for TTSH's communication platforms. 
-  Conceptualise and develop content ideas, storyboards, copy and scripts to support communications and marketing campaigns. 
-  Manage content production from planning through publication, ensuring timely delivery of content and campaigns, including filming, editing, stakeholder coordination, approval and clearance processes. 
-  Liaise with clinicians, departments, senior stakeholders and external vendors to ensure the timely delivery of quality content and campaigns. 
-  Ensure all communications materials comply with TTSH's brand guidelines and organisational standards, serving as a brand steward for the department.

_______________________________________________________________________________________________________

title: Head of Marketing and Communications (Singapore and Indonesia)
description:
Job ID

295222

Posted

08-Sep-2026

Service line

Advisory Segment

Role type

Full-time

Areas of Interest

Marketing

Location(s)

Singapore - Singapore

About The Role


Lead marketing and communications for CBRE across Singapore and Indonesia, and position the company as the pre-eminent real estate thought leader in both markets. Using earned and owned media, digital and social channels, events and research-led content, you will build share of voice and turn CBRE’s market intelligence into commercial advantage.

Armed with strong media relationships, you will identify opportunities to profile subject matter experts and work closely with them to deliver differentiated points of view on the real estate industry. You will lead a team of five to eight marketing and communications professionals, own the country marketing budget, and act as a trusted adviser to country and business line leadership.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role in a matrix environment. You will set strategy and stay close enough to the work to deliver it.

What You’ll Do


 Strategy and business partnering 


‒ Develop and deliver an integrated, ROI-focused marketing and communications strategy across Singapore and Indonesia, covering public relations, digital and social, events, internal communications and brand.

‒ Partner country leadership and business line leaders so that marketing and communications operates as a business enabler rather than a service desk.

‒ Own and manage the country marketing budget, with clear reporting of spend against outcomes.

‒ Set the measurement standard for the function, covering share of voice, campaign performance, event contribution to pipeline and digital engagement, and report against it to leadership each quarter.

‒ Contribute to regional marketing and communications initiatives and project roll-outs across Asia Pacific.

 Public relations and media 


‒ Act as the key media liaison in Singapore and Indonesia, identifying and pitching stories and securing profiling opportunities for business leaders.

‒ Develop compelling messages, media releases, media responses, byline articles and speeches for senior management.

‒ Build and maintain relationships with tier-one business, property and trade media across both markets.

‒ Manage PR agency partners, including scope, performance, deliverables and budget.

‒ Support regional and global teams on issues and crisis communications, preparing local statements, briefing spokespeople and managing local media response, escalating in line with CBRE protocol.

‒ Maintain spokesperson briefing materials and question-and-answer documents, and arrange media training for senior leaders.

 Events and industry engagement 


‒ Own the events strategy end to end, from flagship client events and research launches to executive roundtables, industry sponsorships and internal town halls.

‒ Manage event budgets, venue and vendor selection, run of show, speaker preparation and post-event follow-up, with clear measurement of commercial return.

‒ Develop an influencer and industry body engagement strategy, including CBRE’s presence and speaking platforms at key industry events in both markets.

 Content, research marketing and digital 


‒ Work with CBRE Research to turn market intelligence into campaign-ready content and to build launch moments around flagship reports.

‒ Drive lead generation through social and digital channels, working with regional digital teams on campaign build, targeting, marketing technology and reporting.

‒ Act as brand custodian for both markets, maintaining CBRE brand standards across every piece of external and internal output.

‒ Support business development and pursuit teams with marketing collateral and credentials for major client bids.

 Internal communications and employer brand 


‒ Drive internal communications for employee engagement, change communications and leadership visibility.

‒ Strengthen CBRE’s employer brand in partnership with the People team, supporting recruitment and retention priorities.

 Team leadership 


‒ Lead, coach and develop a team of five to eight professionals across PR, digital, events and internal communications.

‒ Set objectives, manage performance and build capability and succession within the team.

‒ Provide direction and quality control across all local marketing initiatives and campaigns.

What You’ll Need


 Experience: essential 


‒ Degree holder with 12 to 14 years’ experience in marketing and communications.

‒ Within that, a minimum of three to four years leading public relations and events at a senior level, with direct accountability for media strategy and for flagship event delivery.

‒ Experience gained in a multinational or large listed organisation with multiple stakeholders, matrix reporting and regional or global reporting lines. This is a requirement, not a preference.

‒ Proven record of managing PR and event agencies, including briefing, performance management and budget control.

‒ Demonstrated ownership of a marketing budget, with the ability to report return on that spend.

‒ People leadership experience, having managed a team of five or more.

‒ Established media relationships in Singapore, with proven ability to secure tier-one coverage.

 Experience: advantageous 


‒ Indonesia market exposure, or a demonstrated track record of building media relationships in a new market.

‒ Real estate, professional services, financial services or agency background.

‒ Experience supporting issues or crisis communications within an established corporate protocol.

‒ Bahasa Indonesia or Mandarin in addition to strong written and spoken English in view of the in-country market communications.

 Skills and attributes 


‒ Proven expertise in social and digital marketing, including campaign measurement and marketing technology platforms.

‒ Credible with senior stakeholders, and comfortable advising and constructively challenging country and business line leadership.

‒ Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a dynamic environment with competing priorities.

‒ A positive, can-do attitude and readiness to roll up the sleeves and get the job done.

‒ Willingness to travel between Singapore and Indonesia as the role requires.

Why CBRE


When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

Applicant AI Use Disclosure


We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

OUR VALUES IN HIRING


At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

About CBRE Group, Inc. CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE: CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm and a premier provider of critical infrastructure services. The company has more than 155,000 employees serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves clients through four business segments: Advisory (leasing, sales, debt origination, mortgage servicing, valuations); Building Operations & Experience (facilities management, property management, flex space & experience, critical infrastructure); Project Management (program management, project management, cost consulting); Real Estate Investments (investment management, development). Please visit our website at www.cbre.com .

Why DP World

- Be part of a business reshaping the future of global trade

title: Regional Head of Communications
description:
How You Will Make An Impact

This role leads the integrated Communications strategy for SEAO across PR, media, influence, corporate and internal communications, strengthening the Maison’s desirability, visibility and reputation. Reporting to Regional MCC Director, you will translate global Maison priorities into regionally and locally relevant strategies, acting as the key communications partner to HQ, regional leaders, and a strategic enabler to markets, driving greater integration, effectiveness and impact in SEAO.

Your Key Responsibilities Include

Regional Communications 



- Define and drive the SEAO Communications strategy and roadmap, ensuring strong alignment between global priorities, regional business objectives and market opportunities.
- Orchestrate and harmonize communications initiatives across markets while preserving local relevance and market ownership.
- Manage and optimize regional communications budgets and key investments, cultivating strong partnerships with key agencies to maximize impact.
- Establish clear KPIs and measurement frameworks for SEAO, translating performance and insights into meaningful, actionable recommendations.
- Provide oversight on clear governance and alignment across HQ, region and markets.
- Develop regional communications resources, build a strong, collaborative SEAO community across markets.

PR, Media & Influence 



- Provide strategic leadership across PR, media, celebrities, ambassadors and influence.
- Shape regional priorities around key Maison launches and moments, identify cross-market opportunities and strengthen integration across paid, earned and influence channels.

Corporate & Internal Communications 



- Craft and amplify Cartier's corporate narrative, ensuring commitments – including Women's empowerment, Arts & Culture, and heritage – authentically resonate with target audiences, thereby solidifying distinctive positioning as a purpose-driven luxury Maison.
- Manage the comprehensive execution of corporate events.
- Shape and strategically refine leadership scripts/key messages for key events.
- Serve as a trusted advisor for sensitive communications and orchestrate strategic announcements. Collaborate closely with HR to ensure seamless coordination and solid editorial consistency across internal channels.

Your Profile/Key Skills



- 10 – 12 years of progressive experience across communications, PR, media and/or integrated marketing, ideally within luxury or an international premium brand.
- 3 – 5 years of people or team management experience.
- Proven record in leading multi-market communications strategies and translating global brand priorities into locally relevant plans.
- Deep expertise spanning PR, media relations, and influencer engagement, complemented by a robust background in corporate and internal communications.
- Excellent communication, storytelling and stakeholder management skills.
- Demonstrate deep sensitivity to local cultures, traditions and cultural dynamics across SEAO, with the ability to translate them into relevant expressions.
- Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to connect communications investment and performance to brand desirability and business objectives.
- Exhibit strong executive presence and a proven ability to influence senior stakeholders within a matrix organization, adeptly navigating ambiguity and change.
- Ability to work flexible hours as dictated by corporate events’ needs, with some travel required, cross SEAO and internationally for press trips and key activation (15 - 20%).

title: Manager, Corporate Affairs & Communications
description:
Job Description

At American Express, our culture is built on a long history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities and colleagues. As part of Team Amex, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, learn and grow while helping us define the future of American Express.

The American Express Corporate Affairs & Communications (CA&C) team is a strategic function that works to enhance and protect the continued strength of the American Express brand through public relations, social media and content, colleague communications and community impact initiatives.

We are looking for an experienced communications professional to lead the Corporate Affairs & Communications agenda across Southeast Asia, with primary responsibility for Singapore and Thailand, while supporting communications across other partner card markets in the region. Reporting to the Vice President of CA&C Asia based in India, this role will serve as the senior day-to-day communications partner to business leaders in Southeast Asia, providing strategic counsel and developing integrated communications strategies that advance business priorities, strengthen the company's reputation and build engagement with key internal and external audiences.

The role, as a head of the function, requires a strong combination of strategic thinking and hands-on execution. The successful candidate will be expected to anticipate reputational opportunities and risks, navigate complex issues, build compelling narratives, advise senior leaders and translate business priorities into effective communications.

Responsibilities



-  Strategic Communications & Reputation Management
- Develop and execute integrated communications strategies that support business priorities, strengthen corporate reputation and advance key market narratives across Singapore and Thailand and other Southeast Asia markets. 
- Identify opportunities to proactively tell the American Express story across media, social and owned channels, as well as via thought leadership, partnerships, research, events and business milestones.
- Lead media relations programs, managing relationships with journalists, influencers and external stakeholders to generate high-quality coverage and visibility.
- Anticipate and manage reputational risks, providing issues management counsel and developing messaging, holding statements and response strategies when needed.
- Act as a member of the crisis response team, ensuring timely, accurate and coordinated communications during issues and incidents.
- Monitor the external environment and identify emerging trends, risks and opportunities relevant to the business and brand.
-  Executive & Leadership Communications
- Serve as a trusted adviser to senior leaders and spokespersons, providing communications counsel on business priorities, stakeholder engagement and reputation considerations.
- Develop executive messaging, talking points, speeches, Q&As, briefing documents and communication materials for internal and external audiences.
- Manage executive media interviews, speaking opportunities and stakeholder engagements, including preparation, coaching and message development.
- Partner with senior leaders to strengthen executive visibility and thought leadership through media, owned content and strategic communications opportunities.
-  Colleague Communications & Engagement
- Develop and execute internal communications programs that connect colleagues to the company's strategy, priorities, culture and key milestones.
- Create compelling content and storytelling initiatives that engage colleagues and reinforce business objectives.
- Lead and/or support town halls, leadership forums, colleague events and other strategic engagement initiatives.
- Ensure communications align with enterprise policies, governance requirements and disclosure guidelines.
-  Stakeholder, Agency & Team Management
- Build strong relationships with a wide range of stakeholders internally and externally; and become a trusted partner and adviser to business unit leaders to deliver coordinated communications outcomes.
- Collaborate with Corporate Affairs & Communications colleagues across Asia and globally to ensure alignment with enterprise priorities while addressing local market needs.
- Lead and develop a communications team member, providing coaching, prioritization and oversight to ensure successful delivery of market communications priorities.
- Foster a collaborative and high-performing team environment while driving strong stakeholder engagement across the organization.
- Manage communications agencies and external partners, ensuring quality execution, strong counsel and effective use of budgets.
- Measure communications outcomes and provide recommendations to strengthen future strategies and programs. 

Qualifications



- At least 10 years’ experience working in a similar role with a large organization is a must. Experience with working in communication agency or editorial organization is a plus.
- Demonstrated experience developing and executing strategic, integrated communications programs, with the ability to connect communications activity to business and reputational outcomes.
- Strong editorial mindset, natural storytelling ability and excellent capability to develop compelling narratives and messages
- Strong knowledge and experience across media relations, corporate reputation, issues management and social media. Well established media network and contacts are needed. 
- Demonstrated ability to operate as a trusted adviser to senior executives and business leaders, with strong judgment and the ability to influence effectively.
- Excellent written and verbal English communications skills. Proficiency in Mandarin or Thai is a plus. Ability to operate effectively within a global and matrix environment; International experience is a plus
- Creative and strategic problem solver, self-starter and proven track-record to drive tangible communication results backed up with data and analysis.
- Proactive, flexible and collaborative, with excellent interpersonal and relationship management skills. Ability to influence others and be comfortable in communicating at all levels.
- People leadership experience, with the ability to coach, develop and motivate talent.
- Requires ability to handle highly sensitive and in many cases confidential company information as well as managing multiple stakeholders.
- Able to manage and respond quickly to multiple priorities while driving results and delivery against deadlines. Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed and highly regulated environment. 

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:



- Competitive base salaries
- Bonus incentives
- Support for financial-well-being and retirement
- Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
- Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
- Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
- Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
- Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
- Career development and training opportunities

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Head of AI & Innovation Communications, APAC
description:
Meta is seeking a senior communications leader to shape and drive the external narrative around artificial intelligence and innovation across the Asia-Pacific region. In this role, you will develop and execute high-impact communications strategies that advance understanding of Meta's AI products, research, and responsible innovation agenda among media, policymakers, industry partners, and the public across diverse APAC markets. You will serve as a strategic advisor and thought leader, translating complex AI and technology developments into compelling stories that resonate with regional audiences and reinforce Meta's position at the forefront of AI-driven human connection.

Head of AI & Innovation Communications, APAC Responsibilities:



- Develop and lead the regional communications strategy for Meta's AI and innovation portfolio across APAC, aligning with global narratives while adapting for local market context and audience priorities
- Build and manage relationships with top-tier technology, business, and policy media across APAC markets to drive proactive coverage of Meta's AI products, research, and responsible innovation initiatives
- Serve as a strategic communications advisor to APAC leadership and cross-functional partners including policy, product, legal, and research teams on AI-related announcements and issues
- Craft and refine executive messaging, briefing materials, op-eds, press statements, and thought leadership content that articulate Meta's AI vision and innovation agenda to external audiences
- Identify emerging AI narratives, industry trends, and reputational risks across the region and develop proactive and reactive communications plans to address them
- Lead cross-functional collaboration with global communications, policy, and product teams to ensure APAC perspectives are integrated into company-wide AI communications strategies
- Manage high-stakes media moments including product launches, research publications, regulatory developments, and crisis communications related to AI and technology innovation
- Build and maintain a network of influential stakeholders including journalists, analysts, academic researchers, and industry voices who shape the AI conversation across APAC
- Develop measurement frameworks to evaluate the effectiveness of AI communications programs and use data-driven insights to continuously refine strategy and execution
- Coach and guide communications colleagues and cross-functional partners across the region on AI messaging, media engagement, and storytelling best practices

Minimum Qualifications:



- 12+ years of experience in external communications, public relations, or corporate communications with a focus on technology, AI, or innovation subject matter
- Experience developing and executing multi-market communications strategies across APAC, with demonstrated ability to adapt messaging for culturally and linguistically diverse audiences
- Experience managing complex, high-visibility communications programs involving AI, emerging technology, or research-driven narratives for a global technology company or equivalent organization
- Track record of building and sustaining influential media and stakeholder relationships across multiple APAC markets and driving measurable earned media outcomes
- Experience advising and influencing senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders on communications strategy, messaging, and reputational risk management

Preferred Qualifications:



- Experience communicating AI policy, responsible AI, or technology ethics topics to external audiences including media, regulators, and the public across APAC markets
- Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
- Experience leading communications during high-stakes product launches or regulatory moments involving AI or emerging technology in the APAC region
- Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
- Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
- Demonstrated ability to translate highly technical AI or machine learning concepts into accessible, compelling narratives for non-technical audiences

About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about  benefits  at Meta.

title: Head, Communications & Partnerships
categories: Higher Education, Education Administration Programs, and Government Administration
description:
About The College

The College of Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences (CoHASS) at Nanyang Technological University (NTU) aims to be Asia’s leading centre for innovative, interdisciplinary humanities, arts and social science teaching and research. Through its four schools and research centres, the College explores human agency, society and culture in a world of rapid change. As part of a technological university, it works with scientists, engineers and creators to make sense of our technological society.

CoHASS is advancing its strategy, “Shaping the Human Future”, through four interdisciplinary research themes: AI and Digital Cultures; Global Asia; Health, Culture and Society; and Art, Science and Ecology. Each is anchored in a research centre and supported by partners across Asia, Europe and the US. We are seeking an accomplished and forward-looking leader to join us as Head, Communications and Partnerships, to strengthen the College’s profile, global reach and strategic relationships.

Head, Communications and Partnerships

The Head, Communications and Partnerships leads the College’s communications and strategic partnerships, shaping how CoHASS is seen and building the relationships that extend its reach and impact. You will turn the College’s academic, research and educational strengths into compelling stories, raise its global reputation, and develop high-value partnerships locally and internationally.

Working closely with the Dean’s Office, School and Centre leaders, central University offices and external partners, you will build a College-level function that brings coherence, storytelling and strategic partnerships to a diverse academic community.

The incumbent reports to the Director, College Strategy and Operations.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Communications and Positioning



- Lead an integrated College-wide communications and branding strategy aligned with the College’s vision and NTU’s identity.
- Translate the College’s academic, research and societal contributions into compelling narratives for diverse audiences.
- Set editorial and visual standards, and drive alignment across schools, centres and central University communications.
- Advise College leadership on positioning, reputation and sensitive issues, including crisis communications.

Content, Digital and Global Profile



- Direct content across the College’s website, social media, newsletters, video and publications.
- Lead campaigns that showcase the College’s research themes and attract top students, alongside alumni engagement and outreach.
- Build the College’s international profile through media, thought leadership and academic networks, including on AI and the human future, contributing to NTU’s global standing.
- Use analytics to measure impact and refine strategy.

Strategic Partnerships



- Build and lead a portfolio of partnerships with universities, research institutes, industry, government, and healthcare and cultural organisations, aligned with the College’s research themes.
- Identify and assess opportunities, and develop mutually beneficial propositions with College and School leaders.
- Cultivate senior-level relationships with local and international partners.
- Track partnership outcomes, deepen existing relationships, and support major collaborative research funding bids.

Stakeholder Engagement and Leadership



- Lead engagement with staff, students, alumni, donors, industry and government, including internal communications and high-profile College events.
- Represent the College at external forums and networks.
- Lead and develop the Communications and Partnerships team, and manage budgets and vendors.
- Anticipate developments in higher education and communications, including the implications of artificial intelligence.

Requirements



- A recognised Bachelor’s degree in Humanities, Social Sciences, Communications or a related discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
- At least 10 years of experience in strategic communications, public relations, corporate affairs or external relations, including at least 5 years in a leadership role, preferably in a university, research institution or public-sector organisation.
- Proven track record in developing and managing strategic partnerships with senior stakeholders across academia, industry, government or international institutions.
- Strong experience in brand management, media relations, digital communications and issues management.
- Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in complex, matrixed environments with diverse stakeholders.
- Excellent writing, storytelling and editorial judgement, with the ability to make complex ideas accessible to diverse audiences.
- Experience managing teams, budgets and vendors.
- Strategic, creative and globally minded, with the professional presence to engage senior academic and external leaders. with credibility, judgement and communication skills to engage effectively with senior academic and external leaders.

We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: Communications and CSR Director East Asia

description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time Cluster Communications & CSR Director iEast Asia we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your strategic communications and corporate social responsibility expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside dynamic, collaborative, and forward-thinking teammates.

You'll play a pivotal role in shaping Alstom’s image and fostering business growth across the country and emerging territories in East Asia. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (HR, project teams, Corporate/Sector publications), build trust with key stakeholders, and drive impactful initiatives that align with Alstom’s values and goals.

You’ll specifically take care of internal and external communications strategies, but also develop CSR programs that engage employees and enhance Alstom’s social impact.

We’ll look to you for:



- Building trust-based relationships with Communications management and Country MD to ensure the meaningful involvement of the Communications Department across projects. 
- Developing and implementing employee engagement strategies in collaboration with HR. 
- Managing the flow of information to employees using diverse communication tools (Intranet, publications, face-to-face meetings, events). 
- Driving media relations, including press releases, press conferences, and social media presence. 
- Supporting crisis communications at the country level. 
- Organizing and managing internal and external events to enhance Alstom’s visibility and engagement. 
- Managing branding and visual identity to align with Alstom’s corporate standards. 
- Building CSR and employee volunteering programs and fostering relationships with NGOs. 
- Leading a team and managing PR agencies and budgets effectively. 

All About You

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:



- Educational background in PR, Marketing, or Communications. 
- 15-18 years of experience in communications. 
- Experience working with manufacturing or heavy engineering industries with a strong B2G (Business-to-Government) connection is highly desirable. 
- Prior experience in journalism or at a PR/Corporate Affairs agency. 
- Experience working in matrix organizations is a plus. 
- Strong understanding of internal and external communication strategies. 
- Proficiency in managing cross-functional teams and budgets. 

Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:



- Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines. 
- Work with cutting-edge communication and CSR strategies that drive meaningful impact. 
- Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues. 
- Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of mobility. 
- Utilise our inclusive and collaborative working environment. 
- Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries. 
- Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning. 
- Progress towards senior leadership positions within Alstom. 
- Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).

title: Marketing Communications Executive
description:
About UnlockLand
UnlockLand is a Singapore-based AI technology company building decision-making software for land development, urban planning and pre-development.
Our platform combines planning policies, land data, development evidence and AI-powered workflows, helping developers, planners and public-sector organisations assess opportunities and make better decisions.
We are looking for a versatile Marketing & Communications Executive to support our social media, short-form video, content, design and public relations activities.The Role
This is a hands-on role for someone who can manage different types of marketing and communications work independently.
You will turn product updates, customer projects, company milestones and industry insights into social posts, short videos, visual materials, blog articles and PR content.
You should be comfortable writing, designing, filming, editing and publishing content—not only coordinating external agencies.Key Responsibilities

- Manage UnlockLand’s LinkedIn and other relevant social media channels.
- Plan and maintain a regular content and publishing calendar.
- Create social media posts, carousels, graphics and other visual content.
- Develop ideas, scripts and storyboards for short-form videos.
- Film, edit and publish interviews, product demonstrations and event videos.
- Write blog articles, newsletters, company updates and basic press releases.
- Turn technical product information into clear and engaging content.
- Identify stories from product releases, customer projects, partnerships and company milestones.
- Interview founders, planners, engineers, customers and partners for content.
- Support media outreach, events, conferences and company announcements.
- Prepare presentation materials, company profiles and media kits.
- Support founder thought-leadership content and executive social media.
- Assist with website content, SEO and GEO initiatives.
- Monitor social media performance, media coverage and audience growth.
- Coordinate with designers, videographers, agencies and other vendors when required.
- Support other marketing, communications and business tasks based on company priorities.Requirements

- At least 2 years of relevant experience in marketing, social media, content, PR or communications.
- Hands-on experience managing social media accounts for a company or organisation.
- Experience producing and editing short-form video content.
- Strong written and spoken English.
- Ability to write clear and professional social media, blog and corporate content.
- Basic to intermediate visual design skills.
- Proficiency in tools such as Canva, Figma, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite or similar platforms.
- Good visual judgment and attention to detail.
- Strong research, interviewing and storytelling skills.
- Ability to understand technical or professional topics and explain them simply.
- Comfortable working directly with founders, engineers, planners and customers.
- Able to manage multiple projects and meet publishing deadlines.
- Comfortable working in a startup where responsibilities may change frequently.
- Willing to handle both creative work and routine operational tasks.Preferred Experience

- Experience working with a technology, AI, SaaS, PropTech or professional-services company.
- Background in urban planning, architecture, urban design, real estate or the built environment.
- Experience writing press releases or communicating with media organisations.
- Experience producing interviews, webinars, podcasts or event content.
- Familiarity with LinkedIn content strategy, SEO, GEO and digital analytics.
- Basic photography, videography or motion-graphics skills.
- Professional proficiency in Mandarin is an advantage.This Role May Not Be Suitable If

- Your experience is limited to paid advertising or media buying.
- You have not personally created written, visual or video content.
- You prefer to rely entirely on agencies or external vendors.
- You are looking for a narrowly defined role with only one area of responsibility.What Success Looks Like

- UnlockLand publishes professional content consistently.
- Product and company updates are quickly converted into social posts and videos.
- Social media reach and engagement improve over time.
- Short videos explain the company and its products clearly.
- Company presentations, PR materials and visual assets remain professional and consistent.
- Customers, partners, candidates and investors can easily understand UnlockLand’s progress and capabilities.
- You can independently take a content idea from concept through production and publication.

title: Senior Executive / Executive, Marketing & Communications
description:

Events (strategic planning & delivery)

Rankings, legal directories, awards & league tables (end-to-end ownership)

title: Executive, Marketing Communications
description:

The Executive, Marketing Communications develops and leads communications strategies for assigned revenue streams and lifestyle-led portfolios across Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford. LIFESTYLE, PUBLIC RELATIONS & PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT



- Lead or support lifestyle and Public Relations -driven portfolios such as selected F&B venues, spa, wellness, partnerships, IP-led collaborations, festive campaigns and hotel stories.

- Conduct market research to identify consumer preferences, competitor activity, hospitality trends and relevant lifestyle or dining developments.

- Review competitive communications to identify opportunities for differentiation and stronger positioning.

- Monitor campaign-level budgets, quotations and supplier costs for assigned projects, ensuring forecast accuracy and procurement compliance.

Others

Qualifications



- Degree or Diploma in Hospitality, Tourism, Marketing, Communications, Public Relations or a related discipline.

title: Executive/Senior Executive, Climate and Sustainability Communications
description:

Working closely with programme teams and WWF-Singapore's communications team, the Senior Executive will help translate complex technical topics into accessible and impactful content for diverse audiences.

1. Communications & Content Development

- Develop engaging communications materials, including articles, social media content, newsletters, presentations, infographics and other digital content.
- Translate technical information on climate resilience, sustainable agriculture and carbon finance into clear and compelling narratives for different audiences.
- Support the development of key messages, storytelling and communications materials that showcase WWF's climate programmes.
- Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to source stories, case studies and other content.


2. Communications Campaigns & Outreach

- Support the planning and execution of communications campaigns to raise the visibility of WWF-Singapore's climate initiatives.
- Coordinate content publication across WWF's digital platforms, social media and partner communications channels.
- Support media engagement activities, including drafting press releases, media briefs and other publicity materials.
- Track communications performance and prepare updates on outreach and engagement outcomes.

- Develop partner-facing communications materials, including newsletters, presentations, updates and briefing documents.
- Coordinate with coalition partners on joint communications, announcements and storytelling opportunities.
- Support communications for stakeholder events, workshops, roundtables and regional convenings.


4. Programme & Communications Coordination

- Work closely with WWF's Strategic Communications teams to ensure consistent messaging and alignment with WWF's brand and communications priorities.
- Support the development and implementation of communications plans for climate programmes.
- Coordinate with external vendors, designers and content creators where required.
- Maintain communications calendars, content libraries and relevant reporting materials.


Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, Public Relations, Environmental Studies or a related field.
- 2–4 years of relevant experience in communications, content development, digital marketing, public relations or related fields.
- Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly and engagingly.
- Experience developing content for digital platforms, social media and stakeholder communications.
- Familiarity with climate change, sustainability, agriculture or environmental issues would be advantageous.

Join WWF-Singapore to help tell the stories that inspire action for climate, nature and communities.
