- Leverage your relationships across Korea's enterprise and partner community to open doors at target accounts, accelerate early pipeline, and establish Asana as a credible, trusted brand in market.
- Serve as a trusted advisor to C-level and line-of-business leaders, translating Asana's value into business outcomes that resonate in the Korean market.
- Position and sell Asana's AI portfolio, including AI Teammates, AI Studio, and Dash, helping customers identify high-impact use cases for human + AI collaboration.
- Anticipate roadblocks and objections with foresight, crafting win-win solutions that ensure every stakeholder sees the value of Asana.
- Partner seamlessly with SDRs, Field Marketing, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to deliver an exceptional customer experience and drive long-term expansion.
- Act as the voice of the Korean market internally, sharing customer and competitive insights with Product, Marketing, and regional leadership to inform localization and strategy.

About You



- Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making. 
- Native or professional fluency in Korean and English, with a deep understanding of how enterprise buying works in the Korean market.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

These ranges are a guideline; actual base salary and OTE may vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process, and the ranges for this role may be modified.

In addition, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity and benefits. We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

About Us

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Our goal is to ensure that Asana upholds an environment where all people feel that they are respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. title: Senior Marketing & Communications Specialist
description:
Overview

ENGIE is a global energy company, a leading provider of electricity, natural gas, and energy services. With 100 000 employees in more than 70 countries worldwide, ENGIE achieved revenue of €95 billion in 2023. ENGIE is committed to being a leader in the energy transition. We are looking for talented and motivated people to create the future of energy. Join a rewarding and flexible work environment that encourages innovation and creativity, and help us meet the energy challenges of today and tomorrow.

The Supply & Energy Management (S&EM) Global Business Unit covers trading and risk management activities as well as B2B and B2C supply activities across a large and highly diversified energy portfolio, including electricity, natural gas, biomass, LNG and other fuels, CO2 and environmental products

Within the S&EM Business Unit, Business Platform APAC is developing ENGIE’s trading and risk management activities across the APAC region, Middle East and India, around 4 main pillars: risk management and market access, asset management, green solutions and energy supply businesses.

Purpose

The Senior Marketing & Communications Specialist supports the development and delivery of integrated marketing and communications activities that strengthen ENGIE’s Supply & Energy Management positioning and business growth across Asia.The role serves as a regional principal Marketing and Communications focal point of contact for S&EM activities across markets in the region, including Singapore and Japan, working closely ensuring consistency of S&EM’s positioning and coordinating with the relevant Country, GBU and Group Communications teams to ensure consistent messaging, brand alignment and effective execution in accordance with the ENGIE Communications operating model. Communications accountability in individual markets remains with the respective Country Communications teams.

The role contributes to positioning ENGIE as a credible partner in energy supply, renewable energy solutions, corporate PPAs, environmental products, energy management and decarbonisation. Working with commercial, trading and business development teams, the role supports market-facing campaigns, thought leadership, customer engagement initiatives and communications materials that build visibility and enable business development.

Key Responsibilities

Business marketing and commercial support: Support the planning and execution of marketing and communications activities aligned with S&EM growth objectives; work with commercial and business development teams to develop customer-facing materials; and prepare sales-enablement content, presentations, business profiles and solution collateral.

Thought leadership and market positioning: Support and in the development of markets relevant to S&EM’s regional activities and client coverage market insights, executive viewpoints, case studies, industry articles and customer success stories; work with subject matter experts to translate complex market and trading topics into clear, engaging content for customers and internal stakeholders.

External communications and reputation: Support proactive communications activities linked to S&EM business priorities; draft and coordinate media materials, press releases, industry submissions and external messaging; monitor relevant industry developments and support issues management preparation when required.

Digital marketing and content: Manage and produce content for websites, LinkedIn and other relevant channels; maintain an S&EM editorial calendar aligned to commercial priorities; develop campaign assets, newsletters, infographics, videos and presentations; and track engagement and campaign performance indicators.

Events and customer engagement: Coordinate communications and marketing support for industry conferences, customer forums, webinars, roundtables and trade exhibitions; prepare event content, key messages and engagement materials; and support regional customer engagement initiatives.

Internal communications: Prepare internal communications materials that build awareness of S&EM’s activities, products and capabilities across ENGIE; support leadership communications, employee engagement content and regional announcements.

Brand and governance: Ensure communications and marketing materials follow ENGIE brand standards; coordinate with ENGIE Group and regional communications teams; and apply established communications review and approval processes.

Qualifications, skills and experience

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Public Relations, Journalism or a related discipline.

Professional communications, digital marketing or brand-related certification would be advantageous.

Technical Skills & Experience

4 years’ experience in B2B marketing, communications, corporate affairs, digital marketing or a related field.

Exposure to power, utilities, energy trading, renewable energy, sustainability, infrastructure or related sectors would be advantageous.

Good understanding of commercial marketing, customer engagement and business development support.

Experience assisting with thought leadership content, digital campaigns, customer-facing communications materials and executive presentations.

Strong writing, editing, messaging and storytelling capability, with the ability to simplify technical energy and market topics for different audiences.

Ability to coordinate with stakeholders across commercial, trading, leadership, communications and regional teams.

Competencies

Clear communication and business partnering mindset.

Commercial awareness and ability to connect marketing activities to business priorities.

Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

Creativity, curiosity and ability to develop compelling market-facing narratives.

High attention to detail, brand discipline and governance mindset.

Ability to work independently while seeking alignment in a regional, matrixed environment.

ENGIE Energy Marketing Singapore Pte Ltd

ENGIE Energy Marketing Singapore Pte Ltd is the LNG trading platform at the heart of ENGIE, a global energy player in the three businesses of gas, power and energy services, and a comprehensive presence throughout the energy value chain.

Combining in-depth industry experience and financial-market know-how, we serve with LNG solutions all ENGIE business activities worldwide and trade LNG with third parties, from upstream producers to downstream utilities.

ENGIE Energy Marketing Singapore Pte Ltd also has a local presence in Europe (Paris, London, and Madrid).

Unequivocally client-focused, we bring the best of both worlds – energy and trading – to our business partners, be they within the Group or external customers.

title: Senior Marketing Executive / Assistant Manager, Marketing & Communications
description:
About the Role

OaksPlus Limited is seeking a proactive, creative and results-driven marketing professional to join our Marketing & Communications team as a Senior Marketing Executive or Assistant Manager.

This role will focus primarily on growing the visibility, brand presence and enrolment opportunities of 7oaks Preschool through integrated digital and offline marketing initiatives.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing digital marketing campaigns and agency relationships, driving social media and content strategies, overseeing website content, developing marketing communications materials and building corporate partnerships.

We are looking for someone who combines creative thinking with strong execution capabilities, is comfortable working with data and can independently drive marketing initiatives from planning through to implementation and performance evaluation.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is both a strategic thinker and a hands-on executor — someone who can translate marketing plans into well-executed campaigns and measurable outcomes.

You should be comfortable managing agencies and external partners, working with internal stakeholders, analysing campaign results and taking the initiative to improve performance.

Above all, you should have a strong sense of ownership, attention to detail and a genuine interest in building brands that connect meaningfully with families.

Key Responsibilities

1. Digital Marketing & Agency Management

Plan, coordinate and execute integrated digital marketing campaigns across platforms including Google, Meta and other relevant channels to drive brand awareness, enquiries and enrolments.

Manage external digital marketing agencies, including campaign briefs, creative development, budgets, timelines, performance reviews and optimisation.

Monitor campaign performance against agreed KPIs, including website traffic, leads, cost per lead (CPL), lead quality and enrolment conversions.

Work closely with agencies to identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness, return on investment and marketing efficiency.

Prepare regular performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.

2. Social Media & Content Management

Develop and manage social media content plans and calendars across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.

Plan and execute engaging content that showcases the preschool's curriculum, learning experiences, educators, community engagement and brand proposition.

Oversee content creation, including copywriting, graphic design, photography and short-form video production.

Coordinate content gathering with preschool centres and internal stakeholders to ensure a consistent flow of relevant and engaging content.

Monitor social media performance, audience engagement and emerging trends to continuously improve content effectiveness.

Maintain consistent brand messaging, visual identity and quality across all social media platforms.

3. Website Management & Digital Presence

Manage and maintain the 7oaks Preschool website using WordPress, ensuring content is accurate, relevant and regularly updated.

Oversee updates to website pages, campaign landing pages, blog articles, promotional content and calls to action.

Coordinate with web developers and external vendors on website enhancements, maintenance and technical issues.

Monitor website performance using tools such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console and other relevant analytics platforms.

Work with agencies and vendors to improve search engine visibility, website user experience and lead generation effectiveness.

Support ongoing website enhancement and revamp initiatives where required.

4. Marketing Communications & Brand Management

Plan and execute marketing communications initiatives across digital and offline channels, ensuring alignment with brand positioning and business objectives.

Develop and coordinate marketing collaterals, including brochures, flyers, posters, banners, digital advertisements, out-of-home (OOH) advertising and promotional materials.

Support corporate communications and internal branding requirements, including staff event collaterals, Dinner & Dance materials, annual reports, presentations and internal announcements.

Liaise with creative agencies, printers, media owners and other vendors to ensure timely and cost-effective production of marketing materials.

Maintain brand consistency across all communications touchpoints.

Support public relations, community outreach and other brand-building opportunities as required.

5. Corporate Partnerships & Community Outreach

Identify and develop corporate partnership opportunities to increase brand awareness, generate qualified leads and support preschool enrolment.

Establish and maintain relationships with companies, community organisations and other relevant partners.

Develop partnership proposals, promotional arrangements and joint marketing initiatives.

Coordinate corporate outreach activities, roadshows and partnership activations.

Track partnership activities, leads generated and outcomes to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.

6. Campaigns, Events & Performance Reporting

Plan and coordinate marketing support for preschool open houses, Discovery Days, roadshows, enrolment drives and other events.

Work closely with centre leaders and internal stakeholders to ensure marketing initiatives support centre-specific enrolment priorities.

Track marketing performance across channels, including leads, centre visit registrations, visit attendance and enrolment conversions.

Maintain campaign budgets, timelines, marketing calendars and performance reports.

Identify gaps in performance and recommend corrective actions to improve results.

Support other marketing and communications initiatives as assigned.

Requirements

Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Business, Digital Marketing or a related discipline.

Senior Executive: Preferably 3–5 years of relevant marketing experience.

Assistant Manager: Preferably 5–7 years of relevant marketing experience, with demonstrated ownership of marketing campaigns and agency relationships.

Strong hands-on experience in digital marketing, including paid advertising, campaign coordination, agency management and performance tracking.

Proven experience managing social media channels, content calendars and creative production.

Practical experience managing websites using WordPress or a similar CMS; familiarity with basic SEO and website analytics.

Good understanding of digital marketing metrics, including CPL, conversion rates, website traffic and campaign ROI.

Strong writing and communication skills, with the ability to develop compelling marketing content and coordinate with diverse stakeholders.

Good eye for design and familiarity with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar tools.

Experience in offline marketing, collateral production, vendor coordination and event management.

Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and competing deadlines.

Resourceful, proactive and solutions-oriented, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables.

Experience in the education, preschool or family-oriented services sector will be an advantage.

The appointment level will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and capabilities.

Oaks Plus Limited (hereafter known as “OPL”) is a Company Limited by Guarantee (CLG) with Charity status that is committed to assisting underprivileged kids and their families. As one of the appointed operators under ECDA's Partner Operator Scheme, we believe that every child should have equal access to opportunities in learning and education and reach their maximum potential in life regardless of their socioeconomic status.

OPL has experience in serving Singapore’s multi-racial community. Presently, OPL owns and operates 7oaks Preschool centres, offering affordable and quality early childhood offerings that encompass a robust curriculum, highly qualified educators and centre leaders, and standards in line with the SPARK accreditation.

OPL has in place an experienced management committee comprising of the Board of Directors and the preschool management team who brings together a myriad of experience and expertise in the day-to-day running of the company and the curation of OPL early childhood strategies.

OPL also works closely with regulatory agencies such as ECDA and MSF to ensure compliance with legal and licensing regulations of its preschool centres.

title: Executive/Senior Executive, Climate and Sustainability Communications
description:
WWF-Singapore is seeking a dynamic and creative Executive/ Senior Executive, Climate Communications to support communications and engagement activities for the WWF-Singapore's climate and carbon finance programmes.

The role will support the development and delivery of compelling communications that raise awareness, engage stakeholders and showcase WWF's work in advancing climate resilience, sustainable food systems and innovative climate finance solutions across Southeast Asia.

Working closely with programme teams and WWF-Singapore's communications team, the Senior Executive will help translate complex technical topics into accessible and impactful content for diverse audiences.

Key Responsibilities

1. Communications & Content Development

Develop engaging communications materials, including articles, social media content, newsletters, presentations, infographics and other digital content.

Translate technical information on climate resilience, sustainable agriculture and carbon finance into clear and compelling narratives for different audiences.

Support the development of key messages, storytelling and communications materials that showcase WWF's climate programmes.

Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to source stories, case studies and other content.

2. Communications Campaigns & Outreach

Support the planning and execution of communications campaigns to raise the visibility of WWF-Singapore's climate initiatives.

Coordinate content publication across WWF's digital platforms, social media and partner communications channels.

Support media engagement activities, including drafting press releases, media briefs and other publicity materials.

Track communications performance and prepare updates on outreach and engagement outcomes.

3. Partner & Coalition Communications

Support communications and engagement activities for WWF Singapore’s Climate activities including related Coalitions

Develop partner-facing communications materials, including newsletters, presentations, updates and briefing documents.

Coordinate with coalition partners on joint communications, announcements and storytelling opportunities.

Support communications for stakeholder events, workshops, roundtables and regional convenings.

4. Programme & Communications Coordination

Work closely with WWF's Strategic Communications teams to ensure consistent messaging and alignment with WWF's brand and communications priorities.

Support the development and implementation of communications plans for climate programmes.

Coordinate with external vendors, designers and content creators where required.

Maintain communications calendars, content libraries and relevant reporting materials.

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, Public Relations, Environmental Studies or a related field.

2–4 years of relevant experience in communications, content development, digital marketing, public relations or related fields.

Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly and engagingly.

Experience developing content for digital platforms, social media and stakeholder communications.

Familiarity with climate change, sustainability, agriculture or environmental issues would be advantageous.

Basic graphic design, video editing or multimedia content creation skills would be an advantage.

Strong organisational and project coordination skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple assignments.

Proactive, creative and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively across teams and with external partners.

Why Join Us

Join WWF-Singapore to help tell the stories that inspire action for climate, nature and communities. You will contribute to high-impact regional initiatives, working with diverse partners to raise awareness and accelerate solutions for climate resilience, sustainable food systems and nature-positive development across Southeast Asia.

This job description covers the main tasks and conveys the spirit of the sort of tasks that are anticipated proactively from staff. Other tasks may be assigned as necessary according to organisational needs.

Interested applicants are encouraged to complete the online application form -

https://forms.cloud.microsoft/e/AD1HJvJsz9

. Priority consideration will be given to candidates who have submitted the form.

ABOUT WWF-SINGAPORE

World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF) is one of the world’s largest and most respected independent conservation organisations. WWF’s mission is to stop the degradation of Earth’s natural environment and to build
a future in which humans live in harmony with nature. As one of WWF’s international hubs, WWF-Singapore supports a global network spanning over 100 countries.

WWF-Singapore works closely with local stakeholders towards a greener and more sustainable Singapore and the region around us. We work to address key environmental concerns, such as climate change, sustainable finance, deforestation, illegal wildlife trade, species recovery, as well as sustainable production and consumption, through collaboration, education and outreach efforts involving the communities, businesses, and governments.

· Lead commercial strategies that drive room, event and wedding revenue, market share, demand generation and conversion.

· Set the hotel’s sales deployment, key-account development, prospecting, customer engagement and market coverage priorities.

· Guide the Revenue Management function in evaluating business pace, demand patterns, competitive conditions, displacement and need periods, while developing well-supported pricing and revenue recommendations.

· Lead the commercial performance of Events and Weddings, including pipeline conversion, space utilisation, client engagement, revenue delivery and cross-functional handovers.

· Oversee integrated marketing, public relations, digital, advertising, partnership and content initiatives, ensuring measurable returns and consistency with Andaz brand standards.

· Maintain accurate commercial forecasts, pipeline information, competitive intelligence, campaign analysis and executive performance reporting.

· Manage the department’s budget, productivity, promotional investment, contracts, purchasing and financial controls.

· Recruit, coach and develop a high-performing and inclusive commercial team, while strengthening succession planning and leadership capability.

· Ensure that commercial activities, contracts, records, data controls and departmental procedures comply with Hyatt policies and applicable requirements.

Qualifications

WHAT YOU HAVE

· Substantial senior leadership experience in luxury hospitality Sales & Marketing.

· Broad commercial exposure across sales, events, revenue collaboration, marketing communications and digital channels.

· A demonstrated ability to develop complex commercial plans, interpret market and financial performance, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

· Strong understanding of lifestyle positioning, customer expectations, brand standards and long-term brand equity.

· Executive presence, sound judgement, discretion and the ability to contribute constructively to hotel-wide decisions.

· Strong communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to engage senior leaders, owners, corporate partners, customers and colleagues.

· A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Hospitality, Communications or a related discipline, or equivalent executive experience. You will be expected to connect market intelligence, customer demand, pricing, channel performance and hotel operating capacity to clear commercial action. You will use financial, digital, CRM, business intelligence and revenue data to identify opportunities, manage risks and improve performance.

You will work collaboratively with the General Manager, hotel leadership, operating divisions, Finance, Human Resources and Hyatt partners to create shared accountability and deliver sustainable results. title: Executive, Marketing Communications
description:

 Minimum 1 to 3 years of marketing communications or public relations experience, preferably within hospitality, travel, lifestyle, luxury, F&B or agency environments.

AI-enabled marketer, proficient in Claude, ChatGPT, relevant tools for content creation, presentations, project management

title: Marketing Manager
description:
*BlueTree Education | Full-Time | Singapore*

*Big Ideas. Good People. Meaningful Growth.*

Love marketing, enjoy bringing ideas to life, and want to work with people who genuinely care about what they do?

*Come grow with BlueTree!*

At BlueTree Education, we believe that great work happens when passionate people come together in a supportive, fun-loving environment.

We are a growing Singapore education company with a big heart, ambitious plans and a shared belief that learning should make a difference.

Our team works hard, celebrates wins, supports one another and believes there is always room to learn, improve and grow.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we are looking for a \**Marketing Manager who brings both creativity and commercial thinking to the table.* Someone who enjoys rolling up their sleeves, taking ownership and turning good ideas into real results.

*The Role*

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead marketing execution across two education brands, bringing our 2027 marketing strategy to life.

You will have the opportunity to shape campaigns, develop our brand presence, work with a passionate team and make a measurable impact on business growth.

This is not a role where you simply manage agencies and review reports. We want someone who enjoys being in the action, experimenting with ideas and making things happen.

*What You'll Be Doing*

*1. Branding*

* Own and protect our brand across all touchpoints, including centres, signage, print, digital and parent materials. Ensure every piece of work is consistent with our brand direction and guidelines, and lead brand refresh projects.

*2. External Communication*

* Lead parent communications, public relations, media relations, partnerships and crisis communications. Shape how BlueTree is seen by parents, schools and the wider education community.

*3. Internal Communication*

* Plan and deliver communications to staff across our seven branches, so that teachers and branch teams understand, support and represent our campaigns, brand standards and key messages.

*4. Make Campaigns Happen*

* Plan and execute creative, effective marketing campaigns that attract parents, generate enquiries and drive student enrolments.

*5. Grow Our Digital Presence*

* Manage and optimise Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO and organic content to improve visibility, lead quality and conversions. And manage BlueTree Education's social media channels, including Instagram, TikTok and Facebook.

*6. Build Stronger Parent Connections*

* Develop referral campaigns, engagement initiatives and re-enrolment activities that strengthen relationships with our BlueTree families.

*7. Bring Ideas to Life*

* Work closely with our teachers, centre teams and creative partners to develop engaging content, promotions and brand experiences.

*8. Lead and Grow Together*

* Guide our Marketing Executive, collaborate with external agencies and freelancers, and build a positive, productive marketing team.

*9. Know Your Numbers*

* Track campaign performance, marketing budgets, leads, trials and enrolments. Use insights to make smarter decisions and drive continuous improvement.

*10. Team Leadership*

* Lead and develop the marketing executive, and manage agencies and vendors.

*Who We're Looking For*

We would love to meet someone who:

* Has a proven track record in marketing, particularly in generating leads, sales or enrolments.
* At least 5 years of marketing experience, with a track record of leading campaigns end to end and managing a brand
* Proven experience in branding and in internal and external communications
* Is confident with Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, GA4 and content marketing.
* Understands Singapore parents and ideally has experience in education, enrichment or consumer marketing.
* Is both creative and analytical — someone who loves a great campaign idea but also cares about the results.
* Enjoys taking ownership, solving problems and getting things done.
* Has experience guiding junior team members and managing external partners.
* Brings positive energy, a collaborative spirit and a good sense of humour.
* Is curious about AI and new ways to make marketing more effective.
* Experience leading junior staff and managing agencies or vendors

Experience in multi-brand, multi-branch or referral marketing would be a bonus.

*Why You'll Love Working with Us*

*A Warm, Close-Knit Team*

_We believe work should be enjoyable. Expect friendly colleagues, genuine support, laughter and a workplace where people know one another beyond their job titles._

*Big Ambitions, Real Opportunities*

_We are an established education company with exciting growth plans. You will have the space to contribute ideas, take ownership and grow professionally alongside the business._

*Your Ideas Matter*

_We value initiative over hierarchy. Good ideas can come from anyone, and we encourage people to speak up, experiment and make things better._

*Work That Makes a Difference*

_Behind every campaign is a child learning, a parent finding support and a teacher making an impact. Your work contributes to something meaningful._

*A Culture of Learning and Celebration*

_We believe in developing our people, recognising effort and celebrating milestones — big and small._

*Ready to Grow with Us?*

If you are a marketer who loves a good challenge, enjoys working with good people and wants to be part of a growing education brand, *we would love to hear from you!*

The Director of Housekeeping provides strategic and operational leadership for the Housekeeping Department, ensuring the highest standards of cleanliness, hygiene, presentation and upkeep are maintained across the entire Capella Singapore resort. The role is responsible for establishing a strong culture of ownership, accountability, pride and continuous improvement, while ensuring that the Housekeeping team is supported, developed and well cared for. The Director manages departmental payroll, budgets, forecasting, productivity, staffing, supplies, linen, uniforms and equipment, ensuring resources are used responsibly without compromising standards. Through close collaboration with the Executive Committee and other departments, the Director ensures Housekeeping is fully aligned with the resort's operational, commercial and guest experience objectives. The role also leads quality assurance, training, talent development and succession planning to build a high-performing and sustainable team. Ultimately, the Director of Housekeeping acts as the guardian of the resort's cleanliness and presentation, ensuring every area consistently reflects the exceptional standards and attention to detail expected of Capella Singapore.

Ensure all guest rooms and public spaces meet established cleanliness and quality standards.

Engage and drive a positive working relationship with all other departments.

Job Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and commercially aware Investor Relations Manager to support investor communications, corporate positioning, and stakeholder engagement projects for a range of corporate clients.

You will help prepare investor-facing materials, coordinate corporate communications activities, monitor relevant market developments, and support the delivery of client projects.

The ideal candidate has strong writing and relationship-management skills, an understanding of corporate finance and business communications, and the ability to manage multiple assignments in a professional consulting environment.

Key Responsibilities

* *Investor Communications:* Develop and coordinate investor presentations, company profiles, briefing documents, shareholder communications, and other investor-facing materials.
* *Client Relationship Management:* Build and maintain professional relationships with clients, corporate executives, investors, analysts, and other relevant stakeholders.
* *Corporate Messaging:* Help clients communicate their business strategies, financial performance, corporate developments, and long-term objectives clearly and consistently.
* *Financial Information Coordination:* Review publicly available financial information, company announcements, annual reports, and relevant business updates to support the preparation of investor communications.
* *Public Relations Coordination:* Work with communications colleagues to align investor messaging with corporate communications, media engagement, and reputation-management initiatives.
* *Research and Market Monitoring:* Monitor industry developments, competitor announcements, investor sentiment, and relevant market news to identify communication opportunities and potential issues.
* *Presentation and Report Preparation:* Prepare presentation decks, meeting briefs, project reports, communication plans, and stakeholder updates for client meetings.
* *Investor Meetings and Events:* Coordinate investor briefings, corporate presentations, stakeholder meetings, and related events, including schedules, materials, and follow-up actions.
* *Project Management:* Manage timelines, coordinate deliverables, maintain documentation, and work with internal teams to ensure client projects are completed accurately and on schedule.
* *Quality and Confidentiality:* Review materials for accuracy, consistency, and professional presentation while handling confidential client information appropriately.
* *Compliance Coordination:* Work with clients and relevant professional advisers to ensure communications follow applicable disclosure requirements and company policies.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Communications, Public Relations, Economics, or a related discipline.
* Relevant experience in investor relations, corporate communications, public relations, financial communications, consulting, or a related field.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain business and financial information clearly.
* Excellent research, analytical, organisational, and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple client assignments and meet deadlines in a consulting environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and other common business communication tools.
* Strong attention to detail and sound judgement when handling sensitive or confidential information.
* Professional interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with clients and cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience preparing investor presentations, annual report content, corporate announcements, or financial communications materials.
* Familiarity with listed-company reporting, capital markets, shareholder engagement, or corporate governance.
* Experience working in an investor relations agency, public relations consultancy, financial communications firm, or corporate advisory environment.
* Knowledge of the Singapore business environment and relevant corporate disclosure practices.
* Strong project coordination skills and the ability to manage stakeholder expectations.

What We Offer

* Exposure to investor relations and corporate communications projects across different industries.
* Opportunities to develop expertise in financial communications, stakeholder engagement, and client advisory services.
* A collaborative working environment with opportunities for professional development.
* Compensation and benefits based on relevant experience, qualifications, and company policy.

title: Sponsorship Fulfilment Associate Manager
description:
The Sponsorship Fulfilment Associate Manager (12 months contract role) is responsible for managing confirmed sponsors and ensuring that all contracted sponsorship rights, benefits, exhibitor booth requirements, and deliverables are executed accurately and to a high standard.
This is a delivery-focused role and does not involve sponsorship prospecting, sales, or commercial negotiation. The Sponsorship Fulfilment Associate Manager will act as the primary day-to-day contact for confirmed sponsors, coordinating closely with the client, internal teams, venues, vendors, and event partners throughout the planning and delivery process.
The role requires a highly organised, detail-oriented professional who can manage multiple stakeholders, deadlines, and deliverables in a fast-paced event environment.


Key Responsibilities:


Sponsor Onboarding and Account Support

- Act as the day-to-day contact for an assigned portfolio of sponsors and exhibitors, and support the Sponsorship Fulfilment Manager on key and high-value accounts from onboarding through to post-event reporting.
- Review sponsorship agreements with the Sponsorship Fulfilment Manager and help translate contracted rights and benefits into fulfilment plans, timelines, and deliverables.
- Coordinate and take part in sponsor onboarding meetings to confirm objectives, booth requirements, key contacts, deadlines, and approval processes. Lead these meetings for assigned accounts.
- Give sponsors timely updates, clear guidance, and responsive support throughout the event lifecycle.
- Build positive working relationships with sponsors by delivering a professional and attentive service.
- Track sponsor requests and flag potential risks, delays, or out-of-scope requests to the Sponsorship Fulfilment Manager promptly.


Sponsorship Fulfilment and Coordination

- Maintain and update the sponsorship fulfilment tracker covering contracted benefits, exhibitor booth requirements, submission deadlines, approvals, dependencies, and completion status.
- Collect sponsor assets, including logos, advertisements, speaker information, presentation materials, booth designs, activation plans, guest lists, and other required content, and follow up on outstanding items.
- Check sponsor materials and booth submissions against event specifications, brand guidelines, venue regulations, production requirements, and agreed timelines, and flag any issues for resolution.
- Coordinate the delivery of sponsorship benefits such as branding, exhibition space, speaking opportunities, hospitality, digital exposure, delegate passes, and promotional activations.
- Support exhibitor booth coordination, including booth allocation, design submissions, and operational needs.
- Liaise with sponsors, booth contractors, venues, and appointed suppliers on booth production, technical requirements, and approvals.
- Work with creative, marketing, content, production, operations, registration, and venue teams to make sure sponsor and exhibitor requirements are reflected in event plans.
- Manage the internal and external approvals workflow for sponsor-related content, branding, booth designs, and activations, and escalate where needed.
- Carry out regular checks on the progress of sponsorship commitments and booth requirements, and report any gaps to the Sponsorship Fulfilment Manager.


Event Production and On-Site Delivery

- Support the translation of sponsorship commitments, such as booth space, branding, speaking slots, hospitality, and activations, into production and operational requirements.
- Coordinate sponsor and exhibitor logistics across the event production timeline, with a focus on accuracy and attention to detail.
- Prepare sponsor briefing materials, exhibitor guidelines, schedules, contact lists, and on-site fulfilment checklists.
- Coordinate booth setup requirements, exhibitor access, contractor arrangements, and build-up and breakdown schedules.
- Support sponsor and exhibitor setup, rehearsals, speaker coordination, and activation readiness ahead of the event.
- Support the on-site sponsor and exhibitor experience. Act as the first point of contact for assigned sponsors and make sure contracted deliverables are fulfilled.
- Handle on-site sponsor and exhibitor issues promptly, resolving them directly where possible and escalating to the Sponsorship Fulfilment Manager or relevant teams as needed.
- Conduct on-site checks of sponsor branding, exhibitor booths, activations, and other contracted benefits.


Reporting and Post-Event Follow-Up

- Prepare regular status updates on fulfilment progress, outstanding actions, dependencies, and potential risks for review by the Sponsorship Fulfilment Manager.
- Maintain accurate records of sponsor communications, booth requirements, approvals, changes, and completed deliverables.
- Collect evidence of fulfilment, including photographs, attendance information, digital metrics, and other relevant records.
- Assist in preparing post-event sponsor reports and fulfilment summaries.
- Gather sponsor and exhibitor feedback and contribute recommendations to improve future sponsorship programmes and event delivery.


Qualifications and Experience

- Strong experience in sponsorship fulfilment, sponsor servicing, exhibitor management, account management, or event delivery.
- Demonstrated experience managing sponsorship programmes and exhibitor booths for conferences, exhibitions, or large-scale events.
- Good understanding of exhibition production, booth requirements, and venue regulations.
- Excellent project-management and organisational skills, with strong attention to detail.
- Ability to interpret sponsorship agreements and convert them into practical delivery plans.
- Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, including experience working with senior representatives.
- Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with clients, internal teams, agencies, venues, contractors, and suppliers.
- Calm, solutions-focused, and comfortable working under pressure in a fast-paced event environment.
- Proficient in maintaining trackers, timelines, status reports, and fulfilment documentation.
- Experience with financial services or FinTech events would be an advantage.


Contract Terms

- Duration: 12 months
- Work location: Client’s office, on-site up to four days per week, supplemented by travel for events
- Reporting line: Dual reporting to the client and the General Manager of AMC Asia

Feedback and Continuous Improvement

The Ideal Candidate

title: Members Services Administrative Support – Events & Travel
description:
ABOUT THE POSITION
This position is being created in response to a temporary increase in activity resulting from a change in the regional operating model and the redistribution of responsibilities within the Members Services function.
To support this transition and maintain a high level of service across Events and Member travel activities, FICOFI is recruiting a Members Services Administrative Support – Events & Travel on a fixed-term basis until 30 June 2027.
Although the requirement is temporary, the assignment offers broad exposure to Members Services, events, travel and cross-functional operational coordination within an international environment
The Members Services Administrative Coordinator – Events & Travel is part of the Members Services Managers (MSM) team and provides administrative and coordination support to the Members Services team globally, with a primary focus on Asia-Pacific and France. The position supports the commercial teams – Le Club FICOFI® Advisors (LCFA) – through the Members Services organization and focuses on the administrative management of Member events, travel arrangements, hospitality bookings, participant follow-up and related invoicing activities.
The role acts as an internal concierge-style support for the Members Services team across locations. It requires a hands-on and service-oriented approach, with the confidence to contact hotels, restaurants, partners, Members’ assistants and internal teams directly, including by phone, to clarify information, resolve issues and secure timely solutions.
KEY RESPONSIBLITIES
Administrative support for Member events:

- Coordinate invitation follow-up and maintain accurate RSVP and attendance information in Salesforce or any successor tool.
- Proactively follow up with MSMs, LCFAs, Members or their assistants to collect guest names, dietary requirements, hotel details and any information required for the event.
- Prepare and update guest lists, attendance trackers (dinners and side activities), table plans and other event administration documents.
- Prepare programmes and communications with practical information to participants and keep clear records of communications and confirmations.
- Manage programme changes and circulate daily or ad hoc updates to relevant stakeholders and participants.
Travel, hospitality and booking coordination:

- Manage hotel bookings with partners, including rooming lists follow-up, confirmations, changes, cancellations and special requests.
- Coordinate restaurant bookings and hospitality arrangements linked to Member events, trips and programmes.
- Arrange and follow up on side activities, transfers and other travel-related services with providers and participants.
- Handle last-minute changes calmly and proactively, escalating only when a decision, exception or approval is required.
Invoicing, payment and administrative control:

- Prepare, consolidate and check the information required for event and trip invoicing
- Coordinate invoicing follow-up for participation fees, side activities and extra guests, and maintain visibility on pending items.
- Follow up on deposits, payments, supporting documents and discrepancies with MSMs.
- Ensure event references, participant numbers, pricing information and supporting documentation are accurate and traceable.
- Maintain orderly digital files and trackers so that the status of each booking, payment and open point can be understood quickly.
 Internal coordination and service delivery:

- Work closely with MSMs, LCFAs, Event and Finance Teams to ensure smooth administrative delivery before, during and after events.
- Provide regular and concise status updates, highlighting missing information, deadlines, risks and actions required.
- Take ownership of follow-up: contact the right person, obtain the answer and close the loop rather than simply forwarding a request.
KEY DELIVERABLES:

- Accurate and up-to-date RSVP, guest, dietary, hotel and activity trackers.
- Confirmed and documented hotel, restaurant, transfer and side-activity bookings.
- Complete invoicing instructions and reliable payment follow-up.
- Clear programme communications and controlled management of changes.
- Well-maintained event files, checklists and post-event administrative closure.
- Proactive reporting on deadlines, missing inputs, risks and unresolved items.
It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties or skills required. Responsibilities may evolve according to business needs, regional activity and the development of the function during the fixed-term assignment ending on 30 June 2027.
KEY SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

- Professional Experience: Approximately 2–5 years in administrative coordination, events, travel, hospitality, executive assistance, customer service or another fast-moving service environment. A varied or non-linear career path may be considered where the candidate demonstrates strong potential.

- Proactivity and Resourcefulness: Willing to take initiative, make direct contact and find practical solutions to move matters forward.
- Organization and Attention to Detail: Able to manage multiple events, deadlines, bookings and changing priorities with accuracy.
- Service Orientation and Relationship Skills: Discreet, thoughtful and reliable when supporting internal teams, Members, assistants and external partners.
- Communication: Confident and courteous in writing, by phone and in person with a wide range of stakeholders.
- Problem-Solving: Calm under pressure, solution-oriented and able to follow issues through to resolution.
- Tools:Good command of Microsoft Office and confidence learning CRM, ERP, event and collaboration tools.
- Language Proficiency:Fluent professional English and Mandarin, written and spoken, to communicate with the internal and external stakeholders.

title: Event Executive
description:
Roles & Responsibilities

Company Overview

Get Out! Events is dedicated to creating unforgettable events that inspire and connect. Specialising in corporate events, summits and conferences, we deliver tailored experiences with creativity, precision and seamless execution to leave a lasting impact.

We are an AI-native events agency. We believe in equipping every team member with AI tools and agents, so our people spend less time on repetitive admin and more time on clients, creativity and great events.

Role Overview

Get Out! Events is looking for an Event Executive to support the planning, coordination, and execution of corporate and government events.

This role is ideal for someone who has some events experience and wants to build deeper hands-on exposure across event planning, coordination, and execution. You will work closely with our Event Managers and project team, with the opportunity to grow into larger event responsibilities over time.

Why Join Us



- AI-native way of working: every staff member is equipped with AI tools and agents to support their day-to-day work
- Less admin, more event craft: AI helps with first drafts of run sheets, packing lists, vendor follow-ups and documentation, so you can focus on learning and execution
- Learn from experienced Event Managers and grow into larger event responsibilities
- Future-ready skills: learn to run events alongside AI, a capability few events agencies offer

Key Responsibilities

Event Planning Support



- Assist Event Managers with event planning, timelines, run sheets, vendor coordination, and logistical preparation.
- Help prepare event documents such as programme flows, packing lists, manpower plans, briefing notes, and setup requirements.
- Coordinate with vendors, suppliers, venues, crew, and internal team members to ensure event requirements are clear and followed up.
- Support sourcing, quotation requests, simple proposal inputs, and operational planning where required.

Event Operations



- Support on-site event setup, execution, and teardown.
- Assist with registration, guest flow, activity management, stage coordination, vendor coordination, and general event operations.
- Ensure event equipment, materials, signage, and supplies are properly prepared, packed, transported, and accounted for.
- Help troubleshoot on-ground issues calmly and escalate matters to the Event Manager when needed.

Client and Team Coordination



- Communicate professionally with clients, vendors, partners, and internal team members.
- Attend internal briefings, client meetings, site recces, and event debriefs when required.
- Take clear notes, follow up on assigned tasks, and keep the Event Manager updated on progress.
- Learn to manage client expectations and support smooth communication across all parties.

Requirements



- Some experience in events, hospitality, production, customer service, operations, or a related field.
- Comfortable working on-site at events, including weekends or irregular hours when required.
- Organised, responsible, and able to follow through on assigned tasks.
- Good communication skills and a positive working attitude.
- Willingness to learn, ask questions, receive feedback, and improve.
- Able to stay calm under pressure and work well with different teams.
- Comfortable using AI tools and modern productivity platforms to research, organise information, draft documents, and coordinate event work.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is dependable, humble, hands-on, and eager to grow. You should be comfortable taking ownership of assigned event components while learning to handle larger responsibilities over time.

Career Growth

This role offers exposure to a wide range of corporate and government events and a clear pathway to take on larger event responsibilities as you build confidence, consistency, and execution ability.

Working Style

This is a hands-on events role. You will support both office-based planning and on-site event execution. Some events may require early mornings, evenings, weekends, or physical setup work.

Other Information



- Full-time position based in Singapore
- Salary range: SGD 2,500 to SGD 3,300 per month
- Working hours: weekdays, 10am to 6pm
- Occasional evening and weekend work during events

description:
You run marketing for Truescope Singapore, with experiential marketing at the centre of the job. We are looking for you,

Operations Event Coordinator

title: Senior Executive, Venue Event Services
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION 
Who we are 
Constellar is a leading venue management group in the Meetings, Incentives, Conventions and Exhibitions (MICE) sector, based in Singapore. - Maintain accurate event documentation and records, including operational notes, feedback where applicable.
- Any ad hoc duties as assigned by Reporting Officer from time to time.  QUALIFICATIONS 

- Diploma or Degree in Events, Hospitality, Business, Marketing or related discipline advantageous.
- Minimum 1 to 2 years of experience in a venue-based event, operations or hospitality environment.

- Proven ability to work effectively with multiple internal departments and external stakeholders.
- Ability to multi-task and manage multiple priorities across concurrent events and timelines.
- Strong planning, organisational, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple events concurrently.
- High level of attention to detail and sound operational judgment.
- Resourceful, proactive, and calm under pressure in a live event environment.

description:
Young and research-intensive, Nanyang Technological University (NTU Singapore) is ranked among the world’s top universities. The University combines technological strength with human creativity to address the significant challenges facing society, and draws its faculty and students from across the world.

The College of Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences (CoHASS) aims to be Asia’s leading centre for innovative, interdisciplinary humanities, arts and social science teaching and research. Its research priorities are Digital Culture and Society; Health, Culture and Society; Global Asia; and Art, Science and Ecology.

The Global Asia Research Centre (GARC) is a research centre within the College of Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences (CoHASS), Nanyang Technological University, Singapore. The Centre serves as a platform for interdisciplinary research and scholarly exchange on Asia and its global connections, bringing together academics, researchers, policymakers, and industry partners through research initiatives, conferences, workshops, seminars, and public engagement activities.

Through its research programmes and events, GARC facilitates dialogue on issues of regional and global significance, supports the dissemination of research findings, and fosters collaborations across institutions and disciplines.

For more information, please visit: https://www.ntu.edu.sg/hass/research/global-asia-research-centre

Globally ranked among top research and technology organizations in the environment and water domain, the NTU’s Nanyang Environment and Water Research Institute (NEWRI) ecosystem interacts across a multi- and inter- disciplinary platform of Research – engineering – Development (RED) activities in its approach to developing innovative solutions.

With leading edge technology and robust engineering, NEWRI strives to take its fundamental research from novel lab-scale innovation to industry-level translation and derisking activities - from field applications to piloting and development at full scale in real life settings. Through industrial and community- philanthropic projects for commercial and societal impact, NEWRI continuously strives to make a difference towards developing a circular economy for global sustainability.

For more details, please view https://www.ntu.edu.sg/newri

This is a joint appointment between the Global Asia Research Centre and the Mining Mineral Life project, housed at the Nanyang Environment and Water Research Institute (NEWRI). The Project Officer will contribute to the management and delivery of programs in the Global Asia Research Centre and the Mining Mineral Life: Extracting the Energy Transition in Southeast Asia research project. The role will be divided 60% on the Global Asia Research Centre and 40% on Mining Mineral Life. The role will be essential to the delivery of world class research programs and impact activities including organizing international conferences, seminars, fieldwork logistics.

At GARC, the candidate will join a team of the Director, the Deputy Director, and multiple Early Career Fellows. The centre also hosts Visiting Fellows and Visiting Professors.

On the Mining Mineral Life side, the candidate will join a team including the PI, two Research Fellows, and one PhD student. The team will also collaborate with artists and graphic designers on a program of scholarly and public facing artistic impact projects.

description:
About Intellect

Intellect is the global leader in mental health benefits, trusted by the world’s most forward-thinking employers, insurers, and governments to deliver care that is local, personalised, and effective at scale. Today, we serve over 4 million people across 100 countries and languages, making mental health support truly accessible across borders and cultures.

Our platform powers the mental wellbeing of workforces at hundreds of Fortune 500 and major companies, enabling them to support their people with the highest standards of clinical quality, cultural relevance, and on-demand accessibility.

Driven by our mission to build the world’s most trusted mental health benefits platform, Intellect combines a best-in-class digital platform with a world-leading global provider network to deliver unmatched client outcomes and transformative care experiences.

We are backed by top global investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, Insignia Ventures Partners, HOF Capital, K3 Ventures, JAFCO, Headline, East Ventures, IHH Healthcare, MS&AD Ventures, and more, alongside an extensive coalition of notable family offices, big tech executives, and leading angel investors.

The Role

The Director of Sales, Asia will drive Intellect’s enterprise sales growth across our core Asian markets through direct sales and strategic alliances.

This is a hands-on leadership role with accountability for regional sales performance and an individual new business revenue target. You will lead and develop a team of Account Executives and SDRs while personally originating, owning and closing a focused portfolio of strategic enterprise opportunities.

We are looking for a strong enterprise seller and people leader who understands how to win complex deals, lead competitive RFPs and build trusted relationships with C-suite decision-makers. You should be equally comfortable setting market priorities, coaching a salesperson, leading an executive presentation and negotiating a contract.

You will work closely with Marketing, Revenue Operations and Partnerships to shape our sales go-to-market strategy, strengthen commercial discipline and build repeatable routes to growth. You will also partner with Clinical, Operations, Product and Finance to ensure our proposals deliver value for customers and are commercially sustainable.

Your Responsibilities

1. Revenue Ownership & Enterprise Selling

Own regional new business sales performance, translating revenue targets into clear market priorities, account plans and execution.
Carry an individual new business revenue target and personally own a focused portfolio of strategic deals through the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation, contracting and close.
Build qualified pipeline through targeted outreach, executive networks, referrals and partner channels, alongside Marketing and SDR-led activity.
Navigate complex buying groups, uncover customer priorities, develop compelling business cases and secure access to economic buyers and executive sponsors.
Build and deepen relationships with CHROs, Chief People Officers, Total Rewards and Benefits leaders, and other senior stakeholders involved in enterprise buying decisions.

2. Sales Team Leadership & Development

Lead, coach and develop Account Executives and SDRs, setting clear expectations for pipeline creation, opportunity progression and revenue delivery.
Run effective pipeline reviews, deal reviews and individual coaching, identifying performance gaps early and taking action to address them.
Develop the team’s capabilities in discovery, stakeholder mapping, multithreading, value articulation, executive engagement and negotiation.
Establish clear account and territory ownership; help shape hiring, team structure and incentives as the business scales.
Build a culture of accountability, collaboration and high performance through direct feedback, recognition and timely performance management.

3. RFP Leadership & Complex Deal Strategy

Lead priority enterprise RFPs and tenders end to end, including bid qualification, go/no-go decisions, win strategy, proposal development, presentations and commercial negotiations.
Build each bid strategy around the customer’s priorities, evaluation criteria, competitive landscape and Intellect’s differentiated value.
Coordinate solution specialists and cross-functional contributors to deliver accurate, compelling proposals on time, with clear ownership of deliverables.
Lead customer engagement throughout the process, navigating procurement requirements and aligning stakeholders around the proposed solution.
Use win/loss reviews to improve bid selection, sales execution, proposals and competitive positioning.

4. Go-to-Market Strategy & Marketing Collaboration

Shape and execute the sales go-to-market strategy across Asia, prioritising markets, industries, customer segments and direct versus partner-led routes.
Partner with Marketing on target account selection, account-based campaigns, events and demand generation, with shared focus on qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes.
Establish clear lead handovers and follow-up standards, using conversion data and sales feedback to improve lead quality and campaign effectiveness.
Work with Marketing and Product to sharpen enterprise positioning, value propositions and sales narratives based on customer insights and competitive intelligence.
Translate market feedback into practical recommendations on offerings, packaging and growth opportunities.

5. Alliances & Ecosystem-Led Growth

Work with the Partnerships team to turn broker, insurer and other strategic relationships into qualified enterprise pipeline and revenue.
Develop joint account plans and sales initiatives that improve access to priority customers and markets.
Lead sales execution for agreed alliance-led opportunities, coordinating partner introductions, joint pitches and negotiations.
Establish clear opportunity ownership and handovers with Partnerships, aligning direct and partner-led activity to avoid channel conflict.
Evaluate alliance-led sales activity through pipeline quality, conversion and revenue contribution.

6. Revenue Operations & Commercial Discipline

Partner with Revenue Operations to strengthen the foundations for scale: CRM standards, pipeline stages, qualification criteria, forecasting, account planning and performance reporting.
Own adoption of these standards within Sales, maintaining accurate opportunity data, realistic forecasts and clear next steps.
Use pipeline coverage, conversion, sales cycle and productivity data to identify bottlenecks and improve performance; build repeatable playbooks across priority segments.
Help shape pricing, packaging and deal structures with Finance and relevant teams, balancing customer value, competitiveness, delivery requirements and sustainable margins.
Lead deal negotiations within agreed approval frameworks and ensure effective handovers to Client Success and Operations, with clear customer commitments and ownership of follow-on opportunities.

Requirements

Proven Enterprise Sales Leader

You have a track record of delivering B2B new business growth and leading sales teams against clear revenue targets. You have personally originated and closed complex enterprise deals and can explain your contribution to those wins.

Hands-On Player-Coach

You enjoy leading a team while continuing to own and close your own opportunities. You can balance personal selling with coaching, delegate effectively and step into team deals without creating confusion over ownership.

Experienced RFP Leader

You have led and won competitive enterprise RFPs or tenders. You bring sound judgment on which bids to pursue, how to differentiate a proposal and how to coordinate teams through demanding timelines and commercial negotiations.

Strong Enterprise Seller & Executive Relationship Builder

You understand long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, from discovery and business case development through procurement, legal review and contracting. You can engage credibly with C-suite leaders, develop executive sponsors and build new relationships through outreach, networks and partner introductions.

Disciplined Sales Operator

You understand pipeline generation, qualification, forecasting, territory planning, sales methodologies and performance management. You use data to improve decisions and execution, supported by sound judgment and a close understanding of your customers.

Commercially Strategic & Collaborative

You bring strong judgment on market priorities, pricing, positioning and deal economics. You work effectively with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Partnerships and delivery teams, aligning different perspectives around clear commercial outcomes.

Experienced Across Asian Markets

You have meaningful experience in Asian enterprise markets and understand differences in buying behaviour, procurement practices and market maturity. Experience across Singapore and other major Asian markets is strongly preferred.

Experience in enterprise SaaS, HR technology, employee benefits, healthcare, insurance, professional services or another complex B2B category is advantageous. Direct mental healthcare experience is not required.

Builder Mindset & Mission Alignment

You are comfortable in a growing business where processes continue to evolve. You bring structure, take ownership and adapt as you learn. You are motivated by expanding access to quality mental healthcare while building a commercially sustainable business.

What Success Looks Like
Delivery against regional and individual new business revenue targets.
A healthy enterprise pipeline, stronger conversion and reliable forecasting.
Strategic enterprise and RFP wins on commercially sound terms.
A capable, accountable sales team with improving productivity and performance.
Measurable pipeline and revenue from alliance-led sales.
Repeatable sales practices and effective collaboration across the teams supporting growth.

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

Global company – work in a diverse environment with people from nearly 20 countries
Generous leave policy – time off to rest and recharge
Christmas week off – company-wide break during Christmas, separate from annual leave
Birthday leave – enjoy a day off on your birthday

title: Head of Communications & Brand
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

About BW Group

BW Group is a leading global energy and maritime company involved in shipping, deepwater oil & gas production, renewable energy and digital infrastructure. BW controls a fleet of over 400 vessels transporting oil, gas and dry commodities. In the infrastructure space, the group operates in wind, batteries, water, subsea cable networks and data centres.

BW is proud to be listed among Forbes World's Best Employers and Financial Times Best Employers Asia-Pacific 2025.

Are you ready to make an impact?

What drives us is our mission to deliver energy for the world today, and to find solutions for tomorrow. If you want to make lives better around the world by providing access to energy, while working on sustainability and decarbonisation, we'd like to hear from you. Working at BW you will feel the pulse of the world each day. If something happens in the world, we feel it, and you can play your part by anticipating and responding to it. Our high-performing teams are drawn to BW by the global nature of our work and the satisfaction of working with collaborative people who inspire each other to deliver exceptional results.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Role Overview

Based in Singapore and reporting to the Chief People Officer, BW Group, the Head of Communications & Brand leads communications and corporate brand activities across BW Group whilst also supporting BW LNG.

This is a highly visible role partnering closely with the Chairman, senior executives and Communications leaders across our affiliate companies to strengthen BW's reputation, shape its corporate narrative and foster greater collaboration across the Group.

Success requires far more than exceptional communications capability. You will be a commercially minded strategic thinker who anticipates issues, shapes narratives and influences outcomes through sound judgement, trusted relationships and collaboration in a federated organisation where credibility matters more than hierarchy.

Working with a lean team and external partners, you will combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, helping shape executive communications, protect and enhance the BW brand, support organisational transformation and drive communications excellence across the Group.

Key Accountabilities

Corporate Communications

Develop and deliver BW Group's corporate communications strategy aligned with the Group's long-term vision and priorities.

Shape compelling narratives that strengthen understanding of BW's purpose, strategy and portfolio of businesses.

Advise leaders on communications strategy, executive messaging and stakeholder engagement.

Lead communications for strategic initiatives, organisational change, major announcements and corporate events.

Oversee BW Group's digital communications, including LinkedIn and other channels, delivering engaging content that strengthens the brand and supports strategic objectives.

Executive

Communications

Partner closely with the Chairman and senior executives on speeches, presentations, thought leadership and executive communications.

Develop executive communications that reflect BW's values and high editorial standards.

Lead the production of flagship Group communications, including World Horizon, the Annual Report, Sustainability Report, corporate website and key leadership updates.

Support senior executives at conferences, media engagements, investor events and industry forums through end-to-end communications planning and delivery.

Serve as a trusted communications adviser to the Chairman and senior leadership, providing sound judgement on messaging, stakeholder considerations and reputational matters.

Employee

Communications

Lead Group-wide employee communications across digital channels.

Deliver engaging communications that connect shore-based and seafaring employees through platforms such as BW Connect.

Foster a culture of openness, pride and engagement across the Group.

Brand & Reputation

Act as steward of the BW corporate brand, ensuring consistency whilst respecting the autonomy of our affiliate businesses.

Evolve BW's corporate identity and positioning to strengthen the Group's reputation and create value across the portfolio.

Protect and enhance BW's reputation with employees, customers, investors, regulators, partners and the wider maritime and energy community.

Lead crisis and issues communications, partnering with senior management and external advisers as required for ongoing incidents and with post-communications.

BW LNG Communications & Marketing

Partner with the BW LNG leadership team to develop communications and marketing initiatives that strengthen the company's commercial positioning and reputation.

Lead communications supporting commercial initiatives, including vessel launches, technology innovations, customer campaigns and industry events.

Develop marketing content and digital campaigns that showcase BW LNG's capabilities, innovation and market leadership.

Ensure alignment between BW LNG's communications and the wider BW corporate brand.

Leadership & Influence

Lead BW's Communications Community of Practice, fostering collaboration, sharing best practice and identifying opportunities for greater alignment across affiliate companies.

Build trusted relationships with affiliate CEOs and Communications leaders, influencing through credibility rather than authority.

Foster collaboration across the Group whilst respecting the entrepreneurial culture and autonomy of individual businesses.

Digital Communications & AI

Harness AI and emerging technologies to improve the quality, consistency, efficiency and reach of communications.

Identify and implement new tools, channels and approaches that enhance engagement and communications effectiveness.

Measure communications impact using meaningful qualitative and quantitative insights.

Team Leadership

Lead, coach and develop a small, high-performing communications team.

Manage external agencies and specialist partners to maximise quality, capability and value.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

We're looking for someone who combines strategic communications leadership with exceptional judgement and the ability to influence senior stakeholders. You'll ideally bring:

Significant experience leading corporate communications within a global organisation or consultancy.

Experience advising CEOs and senior executives on communications strategy and reputation management.

Strong understanding of corporate branding, stakeholder engagement and executive communications.

Experience leading communications during periods of organisational change, transformation or significant corporate activity.

Experience working across complex, matrixed or federated organisations would be advantageous.

Experience within the maritime or energy sectors would be beneficial, although not essential.

What Will Make You Successful

You'll be someone who naturally earns trust and credibility. You'll demonstrate:

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

Excellent judgement and discretion.

The ability to simplify complex issues into clear, compelling messages.

Exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills.

Strong commercial awareness.

High levels of curiosity and strategic thinking.

Comfort working directly with senior executives and Board-level stakeholders.

A collaborative style with low ego and high integrity.

The ability to balance strategic thinking with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and deliver.

Demonstrates sound judgement in knowing when to follow established processes and when a pragmatic, flexible approach will deliver a better outcome.

A passion for continuous improvement, innovation and practical application of AI.

This role is unlikely to suit someone who prefers highly structured environments, relies on formal authority to get things done, or wants to specialise in a single area of communications. Success requires sound judgement, adaptability, collaboration and a willingness to operate across a broad range of strategic and hands-on responsibilities.

OTHER INFORMATION

Why BW?

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the voice and reputation of one of the world's most respected maritime and energy groups.

You'll work closely with visionary leaders who value integrity, long-term thinking and collaboration, while helping tell the story of a business investing in both today's energy needs and tomorrow's energy transition.

The role offers exceptional breadth, combining strategy, executive partnership, brand leadership, organisational change, employee engagement and external communications in an entrepreneurial international environment.

Please note that your application will be sent to and reviewed by the direct employer - BW Maritime
