title: Senior/Executive, Client Engagement & Partnerships
description:
Senior/Executive, Client Engagement & Partnerships

Singapore Environment Council (SEC)

Build Relationships That Make Sustainability Matter

The Singapore Environment Council (SEC) is an independent, non-profit organisation dedicated to promoting environmental sustainability and responsible business practices. Through certification programmes, sustainability initiatives and stakeholder engagement, SEC works with organisations across industries to drive positive environmental impact.

We are looking for a relationship-focused

Senior/Executive, Client Engagement & Partnerships

to look after and grow SEC's portfolio of clients and partners. If you enjoy being a trusted point of contact, understanding client needs and turning relationships into long-term partnerships, we would like to hear from you.

About the Role

You will manage a portfolio of clients and partners using SEC's certification, sustainability and advisory services. You will be their main point of contact, help them get the most from our programmes, grow each relationship over time, and steward the agreements that underpin our partnerships. This is an individual contributor role with revenue and renewal goals, offering the chance to build deep expertise in sustainability certification programmes and environmental standards.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Account Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and partners on certification and sustainability matters.

Build strong, long-term relationships with existing clients, partners and stakeholders.

Understand client needs and recommend suitable SEC programmes and services.

Achieve individual revenue goals through renewals, upselling and new business from referrals and outreach.

Conduct presentations and discussions with organisations interested in SEC's programmes and services.

Partnership Stewardship & Documentation

Draft, format and coordinate business agreements, Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs) and partnership proposals.

Work with internal stakeholders and external parties to facilitate document review and finalisation.

Track agreement milestones, renewal dates and commitments to keep partnerships on course.

Maintain organised records of agreements and client correspondence.

Events & Stakeholder Engagement

Represent SEC at industry events, exhibitions, networking sessions and stakeholder engagement activities.

Support the planning and execution of major SEC events and programmes.

Business Operations Support

Prepare reports, presentations, meeting materials and management updates on client and partner activity.

Coordinate meetings and follow-up actions with the Deputy Director, Client Engagement.

Support departmental projects and initiatives as required.

What We're Looking For

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Sustainability, or a related discipline.

At least 3 years of experience in client engagement, account management, client servicing, partnerships or business development.

Experience in sustainability, certification, compliance, environmental services, professional services or consulting environments will be an advantage.

Candidates with strong client-facing experience or sustainability-related work are encouraged to apply.

Skills & Competencies

Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills; builds trust easily.

Comfortable presenting to clients, partners and stakeholders.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Good organisational skills and attention to detail, especially with agreements and records.

Works independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Word and Excel.

Manages multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic environment.

Professional and ethical in handling confidential information.

Willing to learn and progressively develop expertise in sustainability certifications and standards.

Additional Information

Occasional regional travel may be required for client engagement, stakeholder engagement and certification-related activities.

Why Join SEC?

Contribute to Singapore's sustainability journey and environmental goals.

Build lasting relationships with organisations across multiple industries.

Gain exposure to sustainability certifications, environmental standards and stakeholder engagement.

Be part of a purpose-driven organisation committed to a more sustainable future.

Opportunities for professional development and career growth.

Diversity & Inclusion

Singapore Environment Council is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, gender, race, religion, marital status, caregiving responsibilities, disability status or background. Selection is based on merit, skills, experience and job-related competencies.

Interested applicants are invited to submit a detailed resume outlining their relevant experience and achievements.

Established in 1995, the

Singapore Environment Council (SEC)

is an independently managed, non-profit, non-governmental organisation (NGO) dedicated to fostering a lasting culture of environmental ownership. As an approved

Institution of a Public Character (IPC)

, we serve as a primary catalyst for environmental advocacy and coordinate efforts across Singapore and the region.

We hold a unique position in the global sustainability landscape:

Global Recognition:

We are the only recognised member of the

Global Ecolabelling Network (GEN)

in Singapore, a non-profit association of leading eco-labelling organisations worldwide.

UN Accreditation:

In 2018, the SEC was granted

United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)

accredited environmental NGO status, further amplifying our influence on sustainability issues.

National Impact:

We work closely with government agencies, statutory boards, and industry partners to translate environmental policy into actionable solutions, such as the

Resource Sustainability Act

and

Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)

frameworks.

At SEC, we don't just influence thinking; we drive systemic change. By joining our team, you will be at the heart of Singapore’s transition toward a circular economy and a more sustainable future

title: Junior Sous Chef
description:
The COMO Group represents an integrated approach to living well, grounded in a celebration of diversity and a deep respect for authenticity. The Group’s businesses extend across hospitality (COMO Hotels and Resorts), fashion (Club21, Kids21, Dover Street Market Singapore), wellness (COMO Shambhala), organic living and specialty foods (COMO Dempsey, Culina and SuperNature) and philanthropy (COMO Foundation).

Culina is a leading purveyor of specialist epicurean foods and wines, a choice distributor to hotels, restaurants and cafes in Singapore. Culina runs a Bistro and Gourmet boutique, an Organic retail store SuperNature in Dempsey as well as a chain of butcheries in major supermarkets island wide.

Job Summary:

The role of Executive Sous Chef manages the daily operations, leads the kitchen team, and oversees the food operation to ensure that the restaurant achieves excellence in food quality and profitability.

Key Responsibilities:

To maintain standards set by the Culinary VP in relation to food preparation, food quality and presentation.

Lead and supervise the kitchen team in their work and career development. Ensure all kitchen staff comply with safe work procedures and practices.

Take an active part in the development of new food items. Come up with a variety of high-quality food that are creatively well prepared, presented, and flavorful in a cost-effective manner.

Prepare and develop new menus with necessary revision on a regular basis to produce delicious, eye-appealing, and nutritious food while adhering to the food cost guidelines.

Monitor the use of ingredients to minimize leftovers and reuse these in the best productive manner possible.

Ensure that the ordering of food stock meet the food requirements, checking deliveries and ingredient quality.

Monitor stock level through regular stock check. Ensure the quantity and range of product prepared is adequate and timely to meet sales levels.

Implement strategies to minimize stock holding and wastage, develop effective workflow to ensure that Mise En Place is completed on time.

Safety and Sanitation

Enforce a high standard of hygiene and sanitation. Adhere to the rules and regulations from the local Ministry of Health.

Ensure that the kitchen team always adhere to the Company policy, including personal hygiene standard.

Enforce daily reporting of Time and Temperature of products & ingredients in storage. Ensure there is labelling, dating, and rotating of all food products and make sure that the storage and the handling of food meet the statutory health and safety requirements.

Ensure that all equipment is properly handled and maintained by all staff.

Train kitchen team in the safe operating procedures of all equipment, utensils and machinery.

Establish maintenance schedule in conjunction with manufacturer’s instructions for all equipment.

Leadership

Work alongside with the Management to deliver a robust manpower planning for the kitchen.

Create a great working environment, through enthusiasm, having a positive attitude, showing respect to all departments & staff.

Ensure effective training and development plan is in place to make sure all the kitchen staffs understand the importance of recipe specification, portion control and recording wastage so they can achieve food margin and food safety standards.

Inspire and motivate team to achieve KPI and achieving sales. Lead by example, setting standard and pace and by using effective communication.

Supervision and Development of Staff

Hire, train and discipline the team when needed, while remaining fair and impartial.

Conduct regular meetings with the team to maintain effective communication.

Develop and implement training programs to develop the team and establish a positive work environment.

Review working schedules of different sections, taking into consideration the volume of expected business, but to conserve labor costs.

Check periodically the culinary teams’ grooming and uniform cleanliness.

Coach the team to adhere to COMO philosophy, culture and commitment to quality food and service.

Customer Service

Treat all customers with professionalism, care and respect. Respond to all comments and complaints promptly.

Work with the Operations team to identify how complaints can be resolved and minimized. Effectively ensures that problems that arise are rectified in a positive and professional manner.

Cost Control

Consult with Management in menu pricing. Ensure that business-operating objectives are met according to the standard established, i.e., food cost, portion control, quality of food, productivity, labor cost, and speed in service.

Determine the pricing of unlisted food items, to implement the quality and size of portions of food at the restaurant.

Control the quality and quantity of the ingredients, suggest modifications or other ingredients to be used, which may yield a better cost. Control and minimize spoiled or contaminated products.

Ensure food items prepared are always of the highest quality possible, both in presentation and taste.

Work closely with the Steward in keeping the kitchen clean and orderly.

Determine the quantity of food to be prepared based on expected business volume.

Check the maintenance schedule of all equipment and request immediate repair when necessary.

Ensure that soiled or damaged serving utensils are not put into use, watching out particularly for cracked or chipped glassware and chinaware.

Wastage and Loss Management

Work with Management to develop a business plan/budget and carry the plan for achievement of margin and reduce loss and wastage.

Develop and implement appropriate menu which deliver financial target and meet quality expectations.

Develop an effective system and establish controls to ensure that food sales revenue and margins are met.

Ensure holding stock are appropriate to sales level to prevent wastage and maximize sales.

Monitor the turnover of materials in storage and to eliminate wastage and spoilage.

Report issues in relation to quality of supplies to supplier and ensure refund are obtained.

Ensure all stock is securely stored and that periodic stock take is carried out timely.

Requirements:

Diploma /Degree in Culinary Arts

WSQ Food Safety Course Level 4

Minimum 2 year of F&B experience in similar role and lead a team

Possess F&B operational skills, good management and problem-solving skills

Established in 1994, and part of COMO Group since 2012, Culina is a leading food and beverage distributor and winner of World Gourmet Summit Awards of Excellence.

Culina has been inspiring professional chefs and novice cooks with our extensive range of fresh quality food, carefully and expertly sourced from around the globe.

As a well-established distributor and importer, we specialise in premium cuts of meat, imported fish and seafood, old and new world wines, as well as a diverse selection of top-notch produce from France, Australia, New Zealand, Italy and beyond.

Our exquisite products are also made available to the consumers at our own retail stores and selected supermarkets across Singapore.

We continue to maintain our hallmarks of quality, service and integrity. Our international team of culinary aficionados endeavours to search for the best food the world has to offer. We anticipate and manage food trends, optimise purchasing and supply chain capabilities to make available and accessible these quality products, under food-safe and hygienic conditions.

We have a penchant for producers who share the same philosophy and commitment to quality and food safety. Since day one, our company has carved solid partnerships with a bevy of top brands.

Today, with our meticulously curated portfolio of gastronomic treasures, our reputation as a leading food and beverage player is publicly affirmed by trade professionals and consumers voted industry awards.

title: Vice President - Transformation Specialist - Chief Transformation Office
description:
Company Overview

Nomura is a financial services group with an integrated global network. By connecting markets East & West, we service the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through our four business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking) and Banking.

Driven by the insights of some 28,000 people worldwide, we put our clients at the center of everything we do, delivering unparalleled access to, from and within Asia. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com

Divisional Overview

The Chief Transformation Office function oversees group-wide transformation on mission critical projects for the firm. We’re aligned to our key businesses across the group and operate to global standards and governance across our programs. Our purpose is to support Nomura’s business strategy and deliver consistent group-wide services based on common operating principles.

Job Overview

The Vice President, Transformation Specialist is a high-impact, execution-focused role tasked with defining and delivering strategic transformation initiatives across Nomura. This position bridges strategic vision and operational execution, requiring a change-driven leader who can translate ambiguous objectives into structured, measurable outcomes while engaging senior stakeholders globally.

The ideal candidate is a go-getter with strong technical rigor (financial modeling, AI/Excel) and exceptional leadership (influencing without authority, driving cross-functional alignment). While domain expertise in financial services is advantageous, the role prioritizes technical adaptability, change leadership, and execution excellence.

The VP will lead cross-functional teams and engage senior stakeholders across functions and regions. The portfolio will span structural reform, location strategy, AI-enabled transformation, outsourcing and strategic vendor partnerships, with a focus on measurable outcomes and effective execution.

Responsibilities

Strategy, Business Cases and Workstream Definition

Translate strategic priorities into well-defined initiatives, problem statements, options and target outcomes.

Develop rigorous business cases, including baseline analysis, financial models, benefits, costs, dependencies, implementation options and delivery risks.

Scope workstreams, define deliverables and milestones, establish governance, and create practical mobilisation and execution plans.

Apply strong numerical judgement to challenge assumptions, test scenarios and support evidence-based investment decisions.

Transformation Delivery and Value Realisation

Own initiatives from definition through mobilisation and delivery, maintaining clear plans, decision points, dependencies, risks and outcomes.

title: Brand Marketing Director
description:
About GNAME

GNAME is Asia’s leading domain registrar, based out of Singapore. We power a native marketplace designed for discovering, buying, and selling the perfect brand identity—including a backorder system of high-value, premium domain names that have expired into digital ether.

For more info on what we do: https://www.gname.com

We are seeking an experienced Brand Marketing Director to lead GNAME's global brand and marketing strategy, strengthen brand positioning, build integrated marketing capabilities, grow brand awareness and customer engagement across priority international markets, and translate business strategy into measurable brand and marketing outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

1. Global Brand Strategy & Positioning

· Develop and lead GNAME's global brand strategy, positioning, value proposition and brand architecture in alignment with business strategy and international growth priorities.

· Define brand narratives, messaging frameworks, tone of voice and visual direction to ensure a consistent and differentiated brand across markets and customer touchpoints.

· Advise senior management on brand strategy, market positioning, reputation and major marketing priorities.

· Establish brand governance standards across corporate, product, digital, event and employer-facing communications.

· Monitor brand health, market perception and competitive positioning and translate insights into strategic actions.

2. Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning

· Develop annual and multi-market marketing strategies, priorities, budgets and execution roadmaps supporting customer acquisition, engagement, retention and business growth.

· Lead integrated campaigns across digital, content, social media, public relations, partnerships, events, community and other relevant channels.

· Translate business and product priorities into audience strategies, campaign propositions and go-to-market programmes.

· Build effective planning, campaign governance, agency/vendor management and performance review processes.

· Balance long-term brand building with measurable demand and commercial outcomes.

3. International Market Development & Go-to-Market

· Lead brand and marketing initiatives for priority international markets, including market-entry and growth programmes where relevant.

· Conduct market, customer, competitor and category analysis to identify growth opportunities, audience needs and positioning gaps.

· Adapt global brand and campaign strategies to local market context while maintaining overall brand consistency.

· Partner with business development, sales, product and operations teams on market launches, customer programmes and strategic partnerships.

· Build relationships with relevant industry communities, media, partners and ecosystem stakeholders to expand GNAME's visibility and credibility.

4. Digital, Content & Community Marketing

· Set the strategy for owned digital channels, social media, content, community and thought-leadership programmes.

· Develop content frameworks communicating GNAME's expertise in domain names and internet services to relevant customer and industry audiences.

· Oversee editorial calendars, campaign content, executive communications, corporate storytelling and key digital assets.

· Strengthen customer and industry engagement through communities, educational content, events and other relationship-building initiatives.

· Ensure content quality, brand consistency and appropriate review processes across external communications.

5. Marketing Performance, Analytics & Customer Insights

· Define marketing KPIs covering brand awareness, engagement, customer acquisition, conversion, campaign effectiveness and return on marketing investment.

· Use customer, market, channel and campaign data to evaluate performance and guide budget and resource allocation.

· Develop regular marketing dashboards and management reports with clear insights, risks and recommended actions.

· Strengthen customer insight and feedback mechanisms to improve positioning, messaging, campaigns and customer experience.

· Promote a test-and-learn culture and continuously improve marketing effectiveness through experimentation and performance analysis.

6. Team Leadership & Cross-functional Collaboration

· Build, lead and develop the brand and marketing function, including capability planning, objective setting, performance management and talent development.

· Work closely with the CEO and senior management to align brand and marketing priorities with Company strategy.

· Partner with product, business development, sales, operations, customer service, compliance, legal, finance and HR teams to deliver integrated initiatives.

· Manage external agencies, consultants, media, creative partners and other vendors where required.

· Establish clear standards, workflows and accountability to ensure high-quality and timely marketing execution.

7. Reputation, Communications & Brand Risk Management

· Oversee corporate brand communications and support reputation management across relevant external channels.

· Develop communication approaches for significant company announcements, partnerships, product developments and industry engagement.

· Work with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure external marketing and communications are accurate, appropriate and aligned with applicable requirements.

· Identify brand and reputation risks and establish appropriate escalation, review and response mechanisms.

· Support senior leaders in external communications and thought leadership where appropriate.

Requirements

· Bachelor's degree or above in Marketing, Communications, Business, Brand Management or a related discipline.

· At least 12 years of progressive experience in brand, marketing or integrated communications, including substantial experience in a senior marketing leadership role.

· Demonstrated experience developing and executing brand and marketing strategy across multiple markets, including brand positioning, integrated campaigns, digital/content marketing and marketing performance.

· Experience in technology, internet, SaaS, digital platforms, e-commerce, fintech or another international digital business is highly preferred.

· Strong understanding of digital customer journeys, international marketing channels, content and community building, and data-driven marketing.

· Proven ability to partner with CEOs, senior executives and cross-functional leaders and translate business strategy into practical brand and marketing programmes.

· Strong leadership, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, analytical, communication and change-management capabilities.

· Experience managing marketing budgets, agencies, vendors and multi-channel programmes with measurable outcomes.

· Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, international and evolving organisation, balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution when required.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Chinese to liaise with internal and external stakeholders.

About Us

GNAME was established in Singapore as a professional international domain name registrar. We are dedicated to creating a comprehensive service platform for Internet domain names. At GNAME, domain names are at the heart of our business, and we offer a wide range of services to our customers, including global domain name registration, dropcatch, transactions, management, API interfaces, and other relevant services. Adopting an open reseller model, we offer reseller a one-stop management system including products, transactions, and financial management, fully supporting their business development. In addition to domain services, we also provide a diverse range of cloud products such as cloud servers, SSL certificates, website protection, and enterprise email services. Based on cloud computing technology, these services are highly scalable and secure, meeting customers’ needs in information technology and network security.

Our strong reputation is built on our commitment to putting customers first. In the future, we will continue to work hard, stay current with industry trends, and deliver the most valuable products and services to our global customers.

description:
About This Role

We’re looking for an Account Manager who can make a complex account feel clear, controlled and well-run—for the client and for the team delivering it.

You will be a senior day-to-day client contact across TGP’s social media accounts. You will guide the client relationship, account plan, delivery rhythm and commercial health of the work, while collaborating closely with an Account Executive and colleagues across strategy, content, design and production.

The role brings together client partnership, delivery management and commercial awareness. You will turn client priorities into clear action, keep the team ahead of deadlines and give the client confidence that TGP understands both the work and the wider business context.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Build strong client relationships: Lead day-to-day communication, meetings and status updates. Understand the client’s priorities, working style, brand sensitivities and internal stakeholders.

• Shape the account plan: Work with the strategy and content teams to translate monthly priorities into a clear content calendar, production plan and approval schedule.

• Turn discussions into clear action: Make sure important meetings are followed by an accurate written record covering the client’s request, TGP’s recommendation, agreed deliverables, owners and deadlines.

• Provide clear recommendations: Bring together input from the team, explain TGP’s point of view confidently and help the client make informed decisions.

• Coordinate delivery: Keep content, design, production, editing, approvals and publishing moving across multiple work streams. Identify risks early and work with the relevant people to resolve them.

• Work closely with the AccountExecutive: Agree priorities, coordinate responsibilities and review key trackers, follow-ups and client records together. Help the AE build confidence and take on greater ownership over time.

• Support the account’s commercial health: Track deliverables against the agreed scope, identify additional requests, support costings and keep agency time and margins in mind.

• Keep communication connected: Make sure everyone has the context, decisions and client feedback needed to do the work well.

• Turn performance into action: Coordinate reporting and work with the wider team to identify useful recommendations for the next content cycle.

• Contribute to pitches: Bring client insight, delivery planning and account-management thinking to new-business opportunities when needed.

Who You Are

You are organised, calm and decisive. You communicate early, maintain clear written records and keep several priorities moving with clarity.

You are comfortable bringing a point of view rather than simply reporting a problem. When an issue needs attention, you can explain the context, recommend a way forward and identify the decision required.

You are collaborative and generous with information. You understand that strong account management helps different disciplines work well together while giving the client a clear and consistent experience.

You are also comfortable using modern tools, includingAI-assisted tools where useful, to reduce repetitive administration, structure information and improve speed. You review the work carefully and apply your own judgment, client knowledge and communication standards before it is used.

Skills & Experience

• 4+ years of account management or client-services experience, ideally in a creative, social media, digital or integrated agency.

• Experience managing recurring content or social media retainers with multiple monthly deliverables is strongly preferred.

• Strong client-facing presence and clear, confident written communication.

• Proven ability to manage calendars, approvals, revisions, production dependencies and competing deadlines.

• Experience working with and supporting the development of an Account Executive or junior colleague.

• Commercial awareness, including scope control, cost implications and agency profitability.

• Confidence collaborating with strategists, writers, designers, producers and editors.

• Familiarity with social media content workflows, platform formats, reporting and publishing processes.

• Resourcefulness and a willingness to learn and apply tools that improve how work is organised and delivered.

Minimum 1 to 3 years of relevant experience in logistics coordination, warehousing, or supply chain administration (fresh graduates with relevant qualifications are welcome to apply).

Knowledge of import/export shipping documentation (delivery orders, bills of lading, packing lists) and local transport coordination.

Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, especially Microsoft Excel and Outlook.

High attention to detail, accuracy in data entry, and strong organizational skills.

title: Head of Marketing and Communications (Singapore and Indonesia)
description:
About The Role

Lead marketing and communications for CBRE across Singapore and Indonesia, and position the company as the pre-eminent real estate thought leader in both markets. Using earned and owned media, digital and social channels, events and research-led content, you will build share of voice and turn CBRE’s market intelligence into commercial advantage.

Armed with strong media relationships, you will identify opportunities to profile subject matter experts and work closely with them to deliver differentiated points of view on the real estate industry. You will lead a team of five to eight marketing and communications professionals, own the country marketing budget, and act as a trusted adviser to country and business line leadership.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role in a matrix environment. You will set strategy and stay close enough to the work to deliver it.

What You’ll Do

Strategy and business partnering

‒ Develop and deliver an integrated, ROI-focused marketing and communications strategy across Singapore and Indonesia, covering public relations, digital and social, events, internal communications and brand.

‒ Partner country leadership and business line leaders so that marketing and communications operates as a business enabler rather than a service desk.

‒ Own and manage the country marketing budget, with clear reporting of spend against outcomes.

‒ Set the measurement standard for the function, covering share of voice, campaign performance, event contribution to pipeline and digital engagement, and report against it to leadership each quarter.

‒ Contribute to regional marketing and communications initiatives and project roll-outs across Asia Pacific.

Public relations and media

‒ Act as the key media liaison in Singapore and Indonesia, identifying and pitching stories and securing profiling opportunities for business leaders.

‒ Develop compelling messages, media releases, media responses, byline articles and speeches for senior management.

‒ Build and maintain relationships with tier-one business, property and trade media across both markets.

‒ Manage PR agency partners, including scope, performance, deliverables and budget.

‒ Support regional and global teams on issues and crisis communications, preparing local statements, briefing spokespeople and managing local media response, escalating in line with CBRE protocol.

‒ Maintain spokesperson briefing materials and question-and-answer documents, and arrange media training for senior leaders.

Events and industry engagement

‒ Own the events strategy end to end, from flagship client events and research launches to executive roundtables, industry sponsorships and internal town halls.

‒ Manage event budgets, venue and vendor selection, run of show, speaker preparation and post-event follow-up, with clear measurement of commercial return.

‒ Develop an influencer and industry body engagement strategy, including CBRE’s presence and speaking platforms at key industry events in both markets.

Content, research marketing and digital

‒ Work with CBRE Research to turn market intelligence into campaign-ready content and to build launch moments around flagship reports.

‒ Drive lead generation through social and digital channels, working with regional digital teams on campaign build, targeting, marketing technology and reporting.

‒ Act as brand custodian for both markets, maintaining CBRE brand standards across every piece of external and internal output.

‒ Support business development and pursuit teams with marketing collateral and credentials for major client bids.

Internal communications and employer brand

‒ Drive internal communications for employee engagement, change communications and leadership visibility.

‒ Strengthen CBRE’s employer brand in partnership with the People team, supporting recruitment and retention priorities.

Team leadership

‒ Lead, coach and develop a team of five to eight professionals across PR, digital, events and internal communications.

‒ Set objectives, manage performance and build capability and succession within the team.

‒ Provide direction and quality control across all local marketing initiatives and campaigns.

What You’ll Need

Experience: essential

‒ Degree holder with 12 to 14 years’ experience in marketing and communications.

‒ Within that, a minimum of three to four years leading public relations and events at a senior level, with direct accountability for media strategy and for flagship event delivery.

‒ Experience gained in a multinational or large listed organisation with multiple stakeholders, matrix reporting and regional or global reporting lines. This is a requirement, not a preference.

‒ Proven record of managing PR and event agencies, including briefing, performance management and budget control.

‒ Demonstrated ownership of a marketing budget, with the ability to report return on that spend.

‒ People leadership experience, having managed a team of five or more.

‒ Established media relationships in Singapore, with proven ability to secure tier-one coverage.

Experience: advantageous

‒ Indonesia market exposure, or a demonstrated track record of building media relationships in a new market.

‒ Real estate, professional services, financial services or agency background.

‒ Experience supporting issues or crisis communications within an established corporate protocol.

‒ Bahasa Indonesia or Mandarin in addition to strong written and spoken English in view of the in-country market communications.

Skills and attributes

‒ Proven expertise in social and digital marketing, including campaign measurement and marketing technology platforms.

‒ Credible with senior stakeholders, and comfortable advising and constructively challenging country and business line leadership.

‒ Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a dynamic environment with competing priorities.

‒ A positive, can-do attitude and readiness to roll up the sleeves and get the job done.

‒ Willingness to travel between Singapore and Indonesia as the role requires.

Why CBRE

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

Applicant AI Use Disclosure

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

OUR VALUES IN HIRING

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

title: MISSION SECRETARY- PEACE AND DEVELOPMENT
description:
1. ABOUT THIS ROLE

The “Peacebuilding and Community Development” is one of the six primary areas of the Council for World Mission’s (CWM) Programmatic Structure. This programmatic area aims to help CWM member churches in achieving the vision of creating life-flourishing communities that co-exist in peace and harmony and grow in solidarity with one another. The

“Mission Secretary for Peace and Development”

will assist CWM in developing proposals and strategies for guiding member churches to engage in peace pedagogy and advocacy, conflict resolutions, and achieve life-flourishing growth by transforming community development.

Directly reporting to the Deputy General Secretary-Programmes (DGS-Programmes), the successful incumbent will be expected to relocate to the headquarters of the CWM in Singapore for a contract period of four years which can be renewed to another term. The candidate will work in partnership with member churches, ecumenical partners, and peoples’ movements in promoting peace and community development while also taking the responsibility of a particular region the person represents.

2. KEY ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

2.1. GLOBAL

2.1.1. Having full responsibility on planning, budgeting, coordinating, implementing, and evaluating the programmes or projects on peace and community development programmes across the member churches.

2.1.2. Engaging with member churches and assisting them in developing medium and long-term mission programmes towards building peace and conflict resolution.

2.1.3. Working in collaboration with the member churches in advocating for life-flourishing growth through community development programmes and promoting solidarity.

2.1.4. Engaging and facilitating the member churches and ecumenical partners to discern and identify the contemporary challenges that disrupt peace in various contexts and assist them in finding conflict resolutions and reconciliation.

2.2.1. Support and facilitate the member churches in the pursuit of their mission and coordinate shared mission activities of the churches in the region.

2.2.2. Implement CWM’s global strategic objectives within the context of the region.

2.2.3. Assist the member churches in transforming themselves as life flourishing communities.

2.3.1. Work in collaboration with the other CWM staff in relevant programmatic areas and maintain clear and open lines of communication.

2.3.2. Work in collaboration with the finance office to prepare, monitor and manage an annual budget for the programme within the agreed guidelines.

2.3.3. Maintain proper documentation, prepare necessary reports and present to the administrative bodies when needed.

2.3.4. Ability to integrate Planning, Monitoring, Evaluation, and Reporting (PMER) system, and work constantly with a result-oriented approach.

2.3.5. Ability to be part of the Management Team to make programmatic decisions and to provide executive level leadership to the CWM office.

3. QUALIFICATIONSAND SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS

3.1. EXPERIENCE

3.1.1. Over five years of experience in working in faith-based organizations and churches in the areas of peace and development with a clear understanding on global and regional issues that hinder peace.

3.2. EDUCATION

3.2.1. Post Graduate(PG) degree (Masters or Equivariant) in the relevant area. A PhD will be an added advantage.

3.3. COMPETENCIES

3.3.1. Proficiency in English language to effectively communicate through verbal, written and digital communication tools.

3.3.2. Ability to work in a team with mutual respect, commitment to diversity and inclusivity, and quality of discretion in handling confidential and sensitive information.

3.3.3. Understanding on CWM’s model of working in partnership with member churches and ecumenical organizations.

3.3.4. Knowledge on CWM’s Strategy Framework for the decade, 2022-2029 and the ability to translate the strategy framework into programmes.

3.3.5. Ability to cope with working schedules, required travels, and maintaining communications.

3.3.6. High level of computer skills to adapt to hybrid workstyle, and maintain digital communications.

ouncil for

orld

title: Director, Asia Procurement
description:
Barnes Aerospace, is an international manufacturer of precision-machined and fabricated components and assemblies for original equipment manufacturer (OEM) turbine engine, airframe and industrial gas turbine builders throughout the world, and for the military. Barnes Aerospace also provides jet engine component overhaul and repair (MRO) services for many of the world's major turbine engine manufacturers, commercial airlines and the military. Barnes Aerospace Singapore, with legal entity name - Windsor Airmotive Asia Pte Ltd in the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA), is a leading provider of Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) services and spare parts for many of the world's major turbine engine manufacturers, airline operators, and third-party providers. The Barnes Aerospace Singapore OEM Division is a world-class provider for Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), specializing in precision stamped assemblies and tight tolerance machining, serving a robust global customer base throughout the aerospace industry. To learn more about Barnes Aerospace, please visit www.barnesaero.com (http://www.onebarnes.com/).

Barnes Aerospace is seeking an expert Director, ASIA Procurement, to join its team and be responsible for the procurement of raw materials, goods, and services for our manufactured goods and services. This includes the planning, scheduling, and monitoring of the movement of materials through the production cycle; utilizing production schedules to maintain inventory at planned levels; ensuring materials standards are met; and managing outside vendors through the processes of qualifying, obtaining quotes, examining bids, and making award decisions for the company. The Director, ASIA Procurement is the procurement and escalation focal point for raw materials, outside service processes, indirect and CAPEX purchasing, supplier selections, rating of supplier performance and maintaining supplier relationships.

Core Responsibilities:

P2R Governance – Design, document, and roll out standard work for requisition, PO placement, supplier acknowledgment, manage ASL (Approved Supplier List), goods/invoice receipt, and GR/IR resolution; align ERPs and related master-data rules including Coupa implementation transition.
Material Availability & Expediting – Lead daily shortage management and tiered escalation; resolve constraints rapidly while transitioning sites from reactive expediting to disciplined planning.
PO Execution Excellence – Drive 100 % PO accuracy, secure supplier confirmations within 48 hours, and achieve best-in-class on-time delivery through disciplined processes, supplier development, and inventory-buffer strategies (kanban, & VMI).
Performance Management & Analytics – Build real-time dashboards for OTD, inventory turns, PPV, GR/IR aging, and P2P cycle time; facilitate weekly site huddles and monthly executive reviews.
Continuous Improvement – Champion Lean/Six-Sigma kaizens to compress P2P cycle time and release working capital; cleanse MRP parameters (min/max, safety stock, MOQ) to align inventory with demand variability.
People & Change Leadership – Lead tactical buyers/expediters through regional managers; coach talent pipelines and cultivate a culture of data-driven decision-making and operational rigor.
Participate in supplier selections and onboarding of new sources for indirect commodity spend and supplier consolidation.
Maintain current knowledge of market conditions that affect overall cost, lead time, and availability of critical commodities.
Continuously improve supplier performance by understanding business requirements and aligning suppliers with business needs.
Participate in supplier quarterly reviews and communicate expectations.
Work closely with Procurement Managers and Commodity Managers to negotiate favorable contracts and long-term agreements.
Must meet or exceed Key Performance Indicators on cost, quality, delivery and cash flow.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or related discipline
Minimum 10 years’ progressive procurement/materials leadership in aerospace or other complex, regulated manufacturing
Demonstrated success running multi-site P2P or tactical buying organizations (>$250 M annual spend)
Expert knowledge of ERP/MRP systems (Coupa, SAP, Oracle, Syteline, or equivalent) and advanced analytics tools (Power BI/Tableau; Excel)
Proven Lean/Six-Sigma practitioner with quantifiable cost, cycle-time, or inventory wins and supplier relationship management
Willing and able to travel up to 30 % globally
Excellent written and verbal communication skills as well as negotiation, analytical and project management skills
Strong collaboration and leader of teamwork orientation with ability to interact with all levels within the organization
Ability to drive global supply chain goals and performance metrics, reduce total landed costs and develop supplier partnerships
Experience in negotiating with raw material and outside service suppliers to secure favorable pricing and long-term contracts
Experience with advanced data analysis and visualization tools including creative thinking with problem-solving capabilities
Impeccable integrity, strong communication and presentation skills

Preferred Qualifications:

MBA or MS in Supply Chain
Professional certifications (CPSM, CPIM, CSCP)
Experience harmonizing multiple ERPs during M&A or footprint consolidation
Bachelor’s degree required in business administration, supply chain, or related field. MBA or advanced degree preferred

Change Agent – Standardizes processes in historically decentralized environments; builds stakeholder alignment

title: Vice President, ASEAN FX Strategist (Job ID:10079919)
description:
An exceptional opportunity has arisen for an experienced Vice President Senior Currency Analyst to join a highly respected global financial institution in Singapore. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on producing insightful research reports focused on ASEAN economies and foreign exchange rates, particularly with expertise in INR, VND, and PHP. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the organisation’s visibility across international markets by conducting independent research and contributing to team’s regular publications that provide actionable insights to both internal stakeholders and a diverse global client base. The position offers a unique blend of analytical rigour, stakeholder engagement, and the chance to work closely with colleagues across Tokyo, London, New York, and Asia. With a supportive team environment, this is your chance to make a significant impact while developing your career within a collaborative and inclusive culture.

Deliver high-impact research on ASEAN economies and FX rates, enhancing the organisation’s reputation across global markets through regular publications and thematic studies.

Engage directly with clients and internal teams via seminars, webinars, conference calls, and company visits to share insights and foster strong professional relationships.

Benefit from flexible working opportunities within a knowledgeable team that values collaboration, ongoing learning, and personal growth.

What you'll do:

As a Vice President Senior Currency Analyst based in Singapore, you will be at the forefront of delivering high-quality economic research that shapes strategic decisions for both internal stakeholders and external clients worldwide. Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve producing detailed analyses of ASEAN economies—especially focusing on India (INR), Vietnam (VND), and the Philippines (PHP)—and generating regular publications that keep clients informed about market developments. You will collaborate closely with colleagues across multiple regions to contribute to global research pipelines while also engaging directly with customers through various channels such as seminars or webinars. Success in this role requires not only technical expertise but also excellent communication skills for presenting complex information clearly. Your ability to build strong relationships internally and externally will be crucial as you help drive customer satisfaction through insightful analysis.

Produce comprehensive research reports on ASEAN economic trends and foreign exchange rates with a particular focus on INR, VND, and PHP currencies.

Contribute regularly to daily FX updates, weekly market reviews, and quarterly outlooks as part of the Asia Global Market Research team.

Develop in-depth thematic studies and ad-hoc commentary on economic data releases, policy changes, market events, and currency movements relevant to Southeast Asia.

Create and maintain robust quantitative models for economic indicators and foreign exchange forecasting to support research outputs.

Participate actively in regional and global research initiatives by collaborating with colleagues in Tokyo, London, New York, and other key locations.

Engage with clients through conference calls, seminars, webinars, company visits, and business trips to present research findings and address queries.

Build effective partnerships with sales teams, traders, relationship managers, and other stakeholders to ensure timely responses to market-related questions.

Support junior team members by providing coaching, guidance, and sharing best practices within the Asia GMR team.

Ensure all activities comply with relevant regulations, internal policies, risk controls, and dual-entity guidelines as required by the functional arrangement.

Assist in managing the department’s risk profile by adhering strictly to compliance standards and supporting operational excellence.

What you bring:

To excel as a Vice President Senior Currency Analyst in Singapore you will bring substantial experience from previous roles where you have delivered high-quality economic or FX research within major financial institutions or consultancies. Your background should include advanced academic training—ideally at postgraduate level—in economics or finance coupled with hands-on expertise in both qualitative assessment techniques (such as policy analysis) and quantitative methods (including econometric modelling). You are adept at distilling complex macroeconomic trends into actionable insights for diverse audiences ranging from senior executives to institutional investors. Strong interpersonal skills; you thrive when collaborating across functions or mentoring less experienced colleagues. A deep understanding of compliance requirements—particularly those associated with multi-entity operations—is essential given the dual-hat nature of this role. Above all else your commitment to accuracy integrity teamwork continuous learning sets you apart as an invaluable member of any high-performing research function.

Minimum 10 years of experience in Global markets working in Singapore or any other regional market.

Demonstrated experience of at least eight years in economic or foreign exchange research within financial services or related sectors is essential for this position.

Proven experience building robust models for economic indicators or FX forecasting supports data-driven decision-making within the team

A bachelor’s degree or higher qualification in economics, finance or another relevant discipline provides the necessary academic foundation for success.

Proven ability to conduct both qualitative assessments and quantitative analyses when tackling complex economic issues is vital for producing impactful research outputs.

Strong presentation abilities enable you to communicate findings effectively during seminars, webinars or client meetings across different regions.

A collaborative approach is important as you will work closely with colleagues from various departments such as sales or trading as well as mentor junior staff members.

Familiarity with regulatory frameworks governing financial institutions ensures compliance with all relevant laws including those specific to dual-entity arrangements.

Excellent stakeholder management skills allow you to develop productive relationships both internally within the organisation and externally with global corporate clients.

What sets this company apart:

This organisation stands out as one of the world’s most established financial institutions renowned for its commitment to excellence integrity innovation within global markets. Employees benefit from being part of an inclusive workplace culture that prioritises knowledge-sharing professional development mutual respect among colleagues at every level. The company offers flexible working opportunities designed to support work-life balance alongside access to extensive training resources that empower individuals at all stages of their careers. Collaboration is deeply embedded in everyday practice ensuring everyone feels valued supported able contribute meaningfully towards shared goals whether working locally in Singapore or connecting virtually with peers around the globe. By joining this team you become part of a network dedicated not only delivering outstanding results but also nurturing talent fostering long-term growth leadership within financial services sector.

What's next:

Lead high-stakes client negotiations, commercial pricing strategies, and contract execution for complex, high-value deals.

Track and analyze AI technology trends, emerging market dynamics, and competitive landscapes.

Translate market insights into actionable strategic recommendations to continually refine product offerings and commercial positioning.

Expand market reach by nurturing strategic alliances with System Integrators (SIs), ecosystem partners, and channel networks.

3+ years of professional background in multinational corporations (MNCs) with proven experience in building, leading, or mentoring sales teams.

Industry Experience:

3+ years in AI, Data Center (IDC), Cloud Infrastructure, IT Infrastructure, Telecom, or High-Tech B2B sectors, with a strong track record of closing large-scale deals.

AI Expertise & Passion:

Deep conceptual understanding of AI infrastructure (GPU, compute, tokens) accompanied by genuine enthusiasm for the AI/Tech industry.

Solution Sales & Negotiation:

Proven capability in orchestrating end-to-end sales cycles, pitching to C-level executives, and executing complex multi-product commercial arrangements.

Language Proficiency:

Business fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese (spoken and written) to effectively collaborate with regional stakeholders, clients, and senior group executives in China. (Proficiency in Cantonese is a plus).

Education & Location:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or an equivalent practical field. Based in Singapore with the flexibility to travel on demand.

Why join us

Strategic Regional Impact:

As an earlysales leader in our Singapore regional headquarters, you will have directautonomy in shaping our APAC Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy and building ahigh-performing team.

High-Demand Portfolio & Uncapped Potential:

title: Head of Information Security
description:
Role Summary

The Head of Information Security (CISO) is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining the organization's information security strategy, governance framework, and cybersecurity programs. This role ensures the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of company information assets while supporting business growth, regulatory compliance, and risk management objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Security Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's information security strategy and roadmap.

Establish cybersecurity policies, standards, and procedures aligned with business objectives.

Advise executive leadership and senior management on cybersecurity risks and mitigation strategies.

Foster a security-aware culture across the organization.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

Lead the enterprise information security governance framework.

Conduct regular risk assessments and maintain the organization's cyber risk register.

Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, GDPR, PDPA).

Manage internal and external security audits.

Cybersecurity Operations

Oversee security monitoring, threat detection, and incident response capabilities.

Lead investigations into security incidents and coordinate remediation activities.

Ensure effective vulnerability management, penetration testing, and security assessments.

Drive continuous improvement of security controls and technologies.

Security Architecture & Technology

Provide strategic direction on security architecture, cloud security, identity and access management, data protection, and network security.

Evaluate and implement security solutions to address emerging threats.

Ensure secure design principles are embedded into business processes and technology initiatives.

Third-Party & Vendor Security

Establish processes to assess and monitor third-party cybersecurity risks.

Review vendor security controls and contractual security requirements.

Manage security due diligence for new partnerships and technology implementations.

Business Continuity & Resilience

Oversee cybersecurity aspects of business continuity and disaster recovery planning.

Conduct cyber incident simulations and tabletop exercises.

Ensure organizational readiness for cyber threats and disruptions.

Team Leadership

Build, mentor, and lead the Information Security team.

Manage security budgets, resources, and vendor relationships.

Define performance objectives and professional development plans for team members.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

12+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, information security, IT risk, or related disciplines.

5+ years in a senior leadership or management role.

Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks, standards, and regulations.

Experience leading security programs in a complex enterprise environment.

Proven experience managing cybersecurity incidents and regulatory compliance requirements.

Key Competencies

Strategic thinking and business acumen

Leadership and stakeholder management

Risk management and decision-making

Incident response and crisis management

Strong communication and influencing skills

Regulatory and compliance expertise

Vendor and budget management

About This Role

We are looking for a curious, analytical, and hands-on graduate to join us as a Product & AI Engagement Trainee. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, product, and user experience, where you’ll learn how to turn insights into action and experiments into growth.

You’ll collaborate closely with various stakeholders to understand user behavior, launch experiments, and shape how our users engage with AI-powered products. If you’re excited about building, testing, learning, and iterating, this traineeship is a great place to start your career in product and growth.

What you will be doing

Boost Engagement & Monetization



- Design and run experiments (A/B tests, gamification, AI feature adoption, etc.) to improve Daily Active Users (DAU) and Monthly Active Users (MAU).
- Analyze user behavior and campaign performance to identify growth opportunities.
- Collaborate with the product and data teams to translate insights into actionable improvements.

Accelerate Partner & Content Integration



- Support onboarding of new content partners, AI models, and localized experiences.
- Help maintain and update the in-app content catalog to keep it fresh and relevant.
- Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure smooth rollout of new features.

Product Operations & Insights



- Track product KPIs and compile monthly performance dashboards.
- Document experiment results, learnings, and recommendations for future cycles.
- Prepare summaries and reports for internal presentations and reviews.

User Research & Engagement



- Call and interview users to gather feedback, understand behavior, and test new ideas.
- Develop user research scripts, record insights, and identify recurring themes.
- Coordinate follow-up calls or surveys to validate hypotheses and measure satisfaction.
- Summarize findings to guide product improvements and feature design.

What we are looking for



- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering or a related field.
- Strong curiosity about AI, product design, and user engagement.
- Comfortable with data and eager to learn how to use analytics for decision-making.
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills — enjoys working across different teams.
- Organised, resourceful, and proactive in taking ownership of small projects.
- Excited to learn how products grow through experimentation and user insight.

All Trainees Must Fulfil The Following Criteria



- Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident; and a. Graduated in 2024 or 2025 from Universities, Polytechnics, Institutes of Technical Education (ITE), or other Educational Institutions (e.g. private universities and overseas institutions); or Graduated earlier from above institutions and completed National Service in 2024 or 2025

title: Insight Consultant
description:
Department: Client Teams

Employment Type: Permanent - Full Time

Location: Singapore

Reporting To: Daniel Teixeira

Description

As an Insight Consultant, you are determined to activate change for great brands through a passion for data and consumer insights. You are project driven and can manage your time and workload independently, but equally you love to collaborate in teams to reach the best result.

Initially, your focus is on data analysis and reporting, but you are eager to learn and develop expertise in quantitative and/or qualitative research methods across full projects in Southeast Asia.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management 




- You assist in the planning, setting up and management of online research projects, either supporting or being supported by more senior colleagues. 
-  You have a good enough understanding of the research process at Human8 to manage a simple project. 
-  You collaborate well with and act as a liaison for PST. 


Activity Design 




-  You attend activity design meetings and brainstorms. 


Fieldwork




-  You grow your moderating experience on 1on1 interviews and group discussions ( both synchronous and asynchronous). 
-  You can brief external moderators 
-  You can check the status of survey fieldwork and communicate it internally.


Analysis And Reporting (primary Focus In This Role)




-  You can analyse, interpret and report on the findings of most research projects (except for very complex projects)

-  You can interpret an analysis plan and use it as a base to collaborate with others (e.g. PST, external moderator, etc.) when relevant. 
-  You listen with an open mind to colleague's feedback on your work. 


Presenting




-  You grow experience by presenting internally (e.g. team meetings) 
-  You attend client presentations and can answer questions that relate to your analyses. 


Account Management 




-  You gain experience and exposure to clients by supporting more senior consultants with project related tasks and communications. 


Commercial Management




-  You follow our marketing content for own interest and to develop your knowledge about our offering. 
-  You are building your social professional profile and becoming an active networker. 
-  You can pitch your role naturally and what impact it has on your clients, to a friend/family member. 
-  You are aware of the commercial objectives and targets of your team. 
- You are aware and understand the budget build-up of projects where you have an active role. 


Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

-  Attention to Detail: Carefully handle data and research materials.

The position will work closely with the relevant Business Units to conduct analysis, develop reporting and analytical solutions, maintain commercial systems and data infrastructure, and support data-driven decision-making.

- Conduct commercial, customer, vessel, market and competitor analysis to support business decision-making.
- Identify and analyse revenue optimization opportunities and monitor related initiatives and outcomes.
- Develop and maintain KPIs, dashboards, management reports and performance analysis.
- Conduct analysis, modelling and research to support budgeting, forecasting, planning, investment evaluation and business cases.
- Administer, maintain and improve the Group’s commercial systems, including CRM systems, data warehouse and analytical data infrastructure.
- Support data quality, cleansing, validation and governance, and resolve data and system issues.
- Develop and maintain automated reporting, analytical and data solutions to improve efficiency and decision support.

title: Coffee Category Development Specialist, Singapore
description:
About SharkNinja


Our mission to positively impact people's lives every day in every home around the world allows our employees to be thinkers and tinkerers, designers and doers, creators and number crunchers, makers of things they love.


SharkNinja APAC is expanding and scaling rapidly. Our two brands, Shark and Ninja, have enjoyed unprecedented growth over the past five years, driven by a very strong innovation pipeline across both brands. Building on that success, SharkNinja APAC has embarked on a bold plan for growth in which Singapore and Malaysia play a critical role. We have taken these markets back from our distributors so that we can run them directly and drive strong growth behind innovation and investment.


Position Summary
The Coffee Category Development Specialist builds SharkNinja's credibility and commercial position in coffee in Singapore. This is a category where consumers are knowledgeable, opinionated and unforgiving — they can tell within one cup whether a brand understands coffee or is simply selling a machine.


Your job is to make sure we understand coffee, and that everyone who represents us does too. You will build the category expertise inside the business, the education programme for promoters and retail floor staff, and the in-store and event experiences that let consumers taste the difference rather than read about it.


This is a hybrid role and deliberately so. It requires genuine coffee craft — you should be able to dial in a grinder, pull a decent shot and hold your own with a specialty roaster — combined with commercial capability: range input, pricing and mechanics, distribution targets and accountability for what the category delivers.


You will also be our voice in the coffee community in Singapore: roasters, cafés, baristas, competitions and enthusiasts. Credibility here cannot be bought with media spend; it is earned person by person.


Key Responsibilities

- Build the Singapore coffee category plan: where we play, against whom, at what price points and with what proposition.
- Own the commercial development of the range in market — distribution targets, listings, pricing input and promotional mechanics.
- Provide structured range, feature and proposition feedback to Product and Marketing based on what the market and the community actually say.
- Track category performance, competitor activity and consumer trends, and bring a monthly point of view rather than a report.
- Build the coffee education and certification programme for promoters, retail floor staff and our own team — beans, grind, extraction, milk, maintenance and how our machines deliver.
- Train to competence, not to attendance. Certify people and re-certify them.
- Create the demonstration standard for coffee specifically: what a great in-store coffee demonstration looks like, start to finish.
- Build the materials — guides, videos, cheat sheets — that let someone perform well without you in the room.
- Design how coffee is demonstrated and sampled in our doors: equipment, consumables, hygiene, workflow and the actual quality of what goes in the cup.
- Work with Retail Excellence to build coffee experience into the perfect-store standard.
- Ensure demonstration machines are maintained, calibrated and genuinely capable of producing good coffee. A bad demonstration cup does more damage than no demonstration.
- Manage the consumables and equipment supply chain that keeps this running.
- Build genuine relationships with specialty roasters, cafés, baristas and the Singapore coffee community.
- Develop partnerships — bean partnerships, café collaborations, competition presence, training tie-ups — that earn us credibility rather than buy us exposure.
- Represent SharkNinja at coffee events, roadshows and trade moments as a credible practitioner.
- Be an honest channel back into the business about how we are really perceived by people who know coffee.
- Own the coffee category revenue and distribution targets for Singapore.
- Drive attachment of consumables, accessories and care products — the recurring revenue that makes this category valuable.
- Support launches: readiness, training, demonstration capability and early reviews.
- Prove the return on coffee education and experience investment so we know whether to scale it.


Essential

- 5+ years across coffee and commercial roles — for example specialty coffee, coffee equipment sales, category development or trade training, with genuine hands-on coffee craft.
- Real coffee credibility. You can dial in a grinder, pull and assess a shot, texture milk and hold a technical conversation with a specialty roaster. This is not a category where theory is enough.
- Evidence of building an education or category programme. Training you designed and delivered, or a category you developed from a weak position — with a before and after.
- Commercial capability — comfortable carrying a revenue and distribution number, not just a training calendar.
- Existing relationships in the Singapore coffee community, or the credibility to build them quickly.
- Strong communication and teaching ability. You will train people who are not naturally interested in coffee.
- Practical, hands-on temperament — you will maintain and calibrate equipment yourself when needed.


Experience might get you the interview. Mindset is what sets you apart.


YOUR ROLE IN LEADING OUR SUCCESS DRIVERS

- Lead us to be “RARELY SATISFIED”
- Make things better each day; “PROGRESS OVER PERFECTION”
- Use your knowledge of our consumer, understand that “DETAILS MAKE THE DIFFERENCE”
- Deliver something great; “WINNING IS A TEAM SPORT”
- Be clear and honest, “COMMUNICATING FOR IMPACT”


Explore SharkNinja On Our Social Channels

- https://www.linkedin.com/company/sharkninja-apac/mycompany/
- https://www.linkedin.com/company/sharkninja-apac/jobs/
