title: Commercial Analyst
description:
The Commercial Analyst transforms commercial, distributor, retail, inventory, market and promotional data into actionable business insights that drive sustainable growth and improve commercial decision-making across Asia Pacific.


The role provides Management, Sales and Trade Marketing teams with a fact-based understanding of business performance by answering four critical questions:


What happened? Why did it happen? What is the commercial impact? What should we do next?


A key focus of the role is evaluating performance across multiple APAC distributor markets by connecting sell-in shipments, distributor IMS (sell-out), inventory levels, stock cover, distribution, retail performance and commercial activities to identify opportunities and risks. The Commercial Analyst proactively challenges assumptions and forecasts, identifies root causes behind business performance, and recommends actions that improve commercial execution and business outcomes.


Working closely with Sales and Trade Marketing teams, the Commercial Analyst drives fact-based decision-making through commercial analysis, forecasting support and strategic business insights. While reporting, dashboards and analytics tools are important enablers, the primary purpose of the role is to generate actionable recommendations that support business growth.


This position reports to the Chief Commercial Officer, Emerging Markets - Haribo Asia Pacific


Key Responsibilities


1. Sales Performance & Business Analysis

- Analyze sales performance by customer, channel, market, SKU, category and period.
- Track actual performance against Budget, Forecast and Latest Business Estimate (LBE).
- Identify drivers of growth, decline and market share changes.
- Conduct SKU-level analysis covering volume, value, velocity, mix and contribution to growth.
- Evaluate customer, channel and category performance trends.
- Perform deep-dive analyses on significant commercial opportunities and business risks.
- Monitor performance against key commercial KPIs and strategic priorities.


2. APAC Distributor, Sell-In, Sell-Out & Inventory Analytics

- Analyze performance across multiple APAC distributor markets using shipment, IMS, inventory and retail data.
- Reconcile company sell-in performance against distributor sell-out (IMS) and retailer consumption trends.
- Monitor distributor inventory levels, stock cover, stock aging and inventory health across markets.
- Identify abnormal stock build-up, pipeline loading, forward-buying and destocking activities.
- Distinguish genuine consumer demand trends from inventory-related fluctuations.
- Assess distributor inventory holdings against shipment trends and forecast assumptions.
- Proactively challenge distributor forecasts based on IMS run rates, inventory positions, stock cover, distribution trends and historical performance.
- Highlight markets at risk of overstocking, understocking or supply disruptions.
- Identify opportunities to improve inventory health, stock productivity and forecast accuracy.
- Support commercial discussions with distributor partners through fact-based insights and recommendations.


3. Forecasting & Commercial Planning

- Review and challenge Forecast, LBE and Budget assumptions using commercial and market data.
- Assess forecast realism by evaluating:
- IMS (sell-out) performance
- Distributor inventory and stock cover
- Distribution trends
- Velocity and rate of sale
- Planned commercial activities
- Historical performance and seasonality
- Monitor forecast accuracy and identify recurring forecasting gaps.
- Proactively identify risks and opportunities that may impact achievement of Budget and Forecast commitments.
- Support monthly forecasting, S&OP and business review processes through analytical insights.
- Develop forward-looking scenario analyses and business projections.
- Provide early warning indicators and recommend corrective actions where required.


4. Distribution & Route-to-Market Analytics

- Monitor numeric and weighted distribution across customers, channels and SKUs.
- Identify distribution gaps and quantify incremental revenue opportunities.
- Analyze relationships between distribution, sales velocity and overall performance.
- Assess customer and outlet universe opportunities to support expansion plans.
- Support route-to-market effectiveness evaluations and sales force prioritization.


5. Retail & Shopper Analytics

- Analyze retailer scan/POS data to identify category, segment and brand performance trends.
- Generate actionable insights from NielsenIQ, Kantar, Circana and retailer-provided data sources.
- Identify category growth opportunities and customer-specific assortment recommendations.
- Analyze shopper, category and retailer performance drivers.
- Support customer category reviews and Joint Business Planning (JBP) discussions with fact-based recommendations.
- Assess customer assortments and identify opportunities for expansion, optimization or rationalization.
- Benchmark customer performance against category growth and market trends.
- Translate retail and shopper insights into practical commercial actions.


6. Promotion & Trade Investment Analytics

- Analyze promotional uplift, incremental volume and value generated by trade activities.
- Measure the effectiveness of promotions, displays, secondary placements, checkout executions and price reductions.
- Conduct pre-, during- and post-promotion analysis to assess commercial impact.
- Analyze promotional cannibalization, pantry-loading effects and post-promotion retention where data permits.
- Evaluate promotional mechanics by customer, retailer and channel.
- Compare ROI across promotional activities and trade investments.
- Identify optimal discount depth, promotional frequency and activation strategies.
- Support annual trade spend allocation through historical effectiveness and ROI analysis.
- Recommend which trade activities should be scaled, optimized or discontinued.
- Partner with Trade Marketing and Sales teams to improve planning, execution and post-event evaluation.


7. Marketing & Campaign Effectiveness

- Assess the impact of marketing campaigns, product launches and brand initiatives on sales performance.
- Evaluate campaign impact on sell-out, market share, distribution and category performance.
- Connect marketing investments with commercial outcomes.
- Provide post-campaign evaluations and recommendations to improve effectiveness.


8. SKU, Assortment & Portfolio Analytics

- Evaluate SKU productivity using sales, distribution, velocity and profitability metrics.
- Identify high-performing and underperforming SKUs.
- Assess assortment effectiveness by customer and channel.
- Identify cannibalization risks and incremental contributions of new SKUs.
- Support fact-based assortment, rationalization and portfolio prioritization decisions.
- Recommend customer-specific assortment improvements.


9. Market, Category & Competitive Intelligence

- Analyze syndicated and retailer data sources such as NielsenIQ, Kantar and Circana.
- Monitor category performance, market share and competitive developments.
- Track competitor pricing, promotions, assortment and distribution activities.
- Identify emerging consumer, category and customer trends.
- Integrate external market intelligence with internal data to explain performance and identify opportunities.


10. Dashboards, Data Quality & Commercial Reporting

- Develop and maintain automated Power BI and Excel dashboards that support commercial decision-making.
- Create an integrated view of performance across customers, channels, categories and markets.
- Improve reporting efficiency through automation and process enhancements.
- Ensure data integrity, consistency and governance across reporting sources.
- Support development of standardized commercial KPI reporting.
- Enable self-service reporting capabilities for commercial stakeholders.


11. Commercial Insights, Strategic Analysis & Business Partnering

- Convert complex datasets into concise, actionable recommendations.
- Clearly articulate: What happened? Why it happened? Business impact Recommended actions
- Identify root causes behind performance changes rather than simply reporting outcomes.
- Challenge assumptions, forecasts and commercial plans using fact-based analysis.
- Proactively identify growth opportunities, distribution gaps, customer opportunities and business risks before they become business issues.
- Support Sales and Trade Marketing teams with actionable recommendations that improve business performance.
- Prepare management presentations, business reviews and strategic analyses.
- Act as a trusted commercial business partner to the Chief Commercial Officer and leadership team.


Key Competencies and Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Finance, Business Analytics, Data Analytics or related discipline.


Experience

- 3-5 years of experience in Commercial Analytics, Sales Analytics, Trade Marketing Analytics, Category Management Analytics, Business Insights or Commercial Excellence.
- FMCG or Consumer Goods experience is strongly preferred.
- Experience working with distributors, modern trade customers and retailer POS data.
- Experience supporting category reviews, Joint Business Planning and customer decision-making is highly desirable.
- Exposure to regional or multi-market business environments is advantageous.


Commercial & Analytical Capabilities

- Strong FMCG commercial understanding with the ability to connect shipments, IMS, inventory, distribution, retail performance and promotional activities into a coherent business story.
- Demonstrated ability to explain not only what happened, but also why it happened and what actions should be taken next.
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capability.
- Commercially curious and comfortable challenging assumptions with data.
- Ability to identify root causes, risks and opportunities across complex datasets.
- Strong business partnering, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
- Excellent communication and presentation capabilities.
- Ability to simplify complex analysis into practical business recommendations.
- Proactive, collaborative and capable of working effectively across functions and markets.

title: Project Coordinator/Manager: Business Development & Market Research

Are you interested in international trade and cross-border innovation? 


Do you want to help international entrepreneurs bring their ideas to life with some of the largest brands in Asia, and play a role in helping Asian corporations to digitalise and decarbonise their operations?


Or maybe you’re interested in cross-border investment and want to play a role in enabling Singaporean corporations to expand overseas?


If that’s yes to all three, you may be who we are looking for to join our team.


You’ll work alongside a diverse group of 180+ business development consultants with a deep specialism in Asia. Over 35 years in the business, we’ve supported over 2,000 clients across startups and scaleups, SMEs, corporates and government bodies – generating upwards of $20 billion in revenues and investment for our clients across 40+ international markets.


We’re growing our team in Singapore. So, if you think you’re up for the challenge, read on – and apply.


What you'll be doing
You’ll be working with our international clients from both the private and public sector, with a concentration on high-growth sectors such as medtech, renewables, automotive, industrial robotics, consumer electronics, semiconductors and agritech; in addition to F&B, agriculture, consumer goods, among others.
 
For your private sector clients, you’ll be the on-the-ground extension of your clients’ business development team, with a goal of developing their route to market, plus securing partners and customers in Singapore. In your day-to-day, you’ll be identifying, meeting, pitching to and gathering crucial feedback from your clients’ potential customers, distributors and partners in the market. 


For some projects, you’ll be doing the groundwork: conducting the desk research and market intelligence that underpins every client engagement. That means sizing the market opportunity, mapping competitors and distribution structures, screening and qualifying potential partners and customers, and checking regulatory or certification requirements – then turning your findings into clear, client-ready market-entry reports.


You might also work with our government agency clients from overseas. You’ll be the on-the-ground representative of your client’s export promotion team, supporting trade missions, delivering B2B meetings and organizing trade events.


You’ll be working closely with your clients and providing them with key progress indicators in the form of meeting notes, reports, and sync calls. 


And when the time is right, you will arrange for your clients to visit Singapore. You’ll be their local expert – taking them to key customer meetings, interpreting and providing the incredibly important cultural context to business conversations. 


Through all this, you’ll deepen your consulting knowledge and gain first-hand experience in making international business happen.


What you'll be getting

- Competitive salary and vacation, plus flexible working arrangements
- International office environment and work culture
- Opportunities for growth and advancement within the company
- On-the-job experience across multiple industries, often working with cutting-edge tech 
- A chance to sharpen your sales, consultancy, research and business development skills by learning from best-in-class consultants and business builders
- An opportunity to make a difference by enabling green transformation and digital transition through international collaboration


What you'll need

- Full professional proficiency in spoken and written English
- Minimum of four years’ experience working in sales, business development, market research, consultancy, economic development or export promotion
- Ideally, relevant experience in our B2B fields (industrial, medtech, automotive, semiconductor, energy, software, engineering, life sciences, medtech, F&B, agri, etc.)
- Regional experience across Southeast Asian markets is a plus
- Demonstrated research and analytical skills, with the ability to build evidence-based target lists, market insights market-entry recommendations
- Comfort with data sources and research tools – trade and industry statistics, company registries, LinkedIn/Sales Navigator, industry databases
- Strong analytical writing skills: with the ability to synthesise raw findings into structured reports, briefs and meeting notes on which your clients can act
- A firm understanding of Singaporean business culture and the ability to proactively guide international clients through local nuances 
- The ability to quickly grasp new concepts and communicate that knowledge to stakeholders
- A keen interest in international trade and overseas business development 
- A degree in business/marketing/law/engineering/science, or in a related field


Apply for this role

title: (Senior) Consumer Insights Analyst

description:
Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.

Google's leadership team hand-picks thorny business challenges, and members of BizOps work in small teams to find solutions. As a Data Science and Analytics Specialist, you will possess a strong technical and coding foundation—specifically in SQL, Python, or equivalent, and data pipeline management—and are eager to apply these skills within the domain of consumer insights (market insights for our Marketing organization). You will bridge the gap between traditional market research and data analysis. You will focus on completing tasks within the scope of larger analytical outcomes, utilizing an analytical mindset to manage large, complex datasets.

Your contributions will be direct and task-oriented, operating under the general guidance of a manager or senior researcher. Google will provide you with comprehensive training and mentorship in market research methodologies, primary/secondary data analytics, and the art of building compelling insight narratives. You will assist in the research and application of data-driven insights that have a tangible impact on marketing performance, such as business case development and trend analysis.

title: Market Research Analyst / Senior Market Research Analyst
description:
JOB SCOPE
Join our dynamic research team to uncover consumer insights and drive strategic decisions for our clients. Depending on experience, you will join as a Research Analyst or Senior Research Analyst, working primarily on quantitative research projects, with opportunities to contribute to qualitative studies and combine findings across both approaches.


The key areas include but are not limited to the following:


Research, Analysis and Insights

- Design and execute end-to-end online and offline quantitative research projects such as brand tracking, campaign/concept tests and customer-centric studies.
- Conduct secondary/desk research to support research hypotheses, questionnaire and discussion guide development, and interpretation of findings.
- Develop survey questionnaires, logic flows, sampling plans, and fieldwork specifications.
- Develop discussion guides for focus group discussions (FGDs) and in-depth interviews (IDIs), with guidance from senior researchers where needed.
- Occasionally moderate or support the moderation of FGDs and IDIs, depending on experience and project needs, including note-taking, probing and capturing key observations.
- Review interview transcripts, recordings and discussion notes to identify key themes and translate qualitative findings into clear, actionable insights.
- Monitor fieldwork progress, conduct data checks, and liaise with vendor partners to ensure sample quality, quota compliance and desired tables.
- Analyse quantitative datasets, including applying statistical techniques such as cross-tabulation, significance testing and correlations.
- Prepare research reports and client presentations, including charting, insight generation and data storytelling.
- Collaborate with senior researchers and clients to ensure methodological robustness, business relevance, and actionable recommendations.
- Where applicable, integrate quantitative findings and qualitative insights to develop a fuller understanding of consumer attitudes, motivations and behaviours.


Project Management

- Manage project timelines and collaborate with cross-functional teams (i.e. programmers, vendors, data science, etc) to ensure timely project completion
- Manage or assist in project setup and fieldwork management
- Support fieldwork audit and quality control efforts
- Check survey link to ensure there are no errors
- Provide regular project or fieldwork updates to clients and other relevant stakeholders.


___________________________________________


JOB EXPECTATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

- Education: Minimum bachelor’s degree in Market Research, Communications, Psychology, Sociology, Business, or a related field.
- Experience at Analyst level: Fresh graduates are welcome but must demonstrate interest in both quantitative and qualitative research. Prior exposure through an internship or similar experience will be an advantage.
- Experience at Senior Analyst level: Minimum 1–2 years of hands-on experience in agency-side market research, primarily in quantitative studies. Experience in qualitative research, including discussion guide development or moderation support, will be an advantage.
- Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities, with the ability to interpret numerical data and identify themes from qualitative feedback.
- Communication Skills: Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, listen actively, ask probing questions and build rapport with clients, colleagues and research participants.
- Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and in a highly organised approach, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery. Also able to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
- Attention to detail: High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all aspects of research and reporting. 


_____________________________________________


ABOUT US
Welcome to the Insights Table. We are a market research agency that see ourselves being able to do better for the industry. On our table, we are proud of our drive, conviction, and authenticity to deliver best-in-class insights and value to our clients. We strive to create a work environment that excites and motivates our people on the table. An environment where individuals can be excited about starting their day, with a purpose, every day.


This is a table where insights are uncovered, curiosity leads to answers, important agenda are discussed, and informed decisions are made. Above all, everyone on the table enjoys coming together.

title: Sales and Event Executive
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Sales & Events Executive to support client engagement and sponsorship coordination, alongside end-to-end event delivery across our portfolio of B2B conferences, exhibitions, and industry networking events.

This role supports both sales and sponsorship development as well as event coordination and delivery, working closely with the sales, marketing, and operations teams. It is ideal for someone who enjoys building client relationships while also being actively involved in the practical execution of high-quality industry events.

Key Responsibilities

Sales & Business Development

Identify prospect, and engage potential sponsors, exhibitors, and partners across MediaComz’s event portfolio.

Manage inbound and outbound sales outreach, including follow-ups, proposals, and sponsorship discussions.

Support contract preparation, invoicing coordination, and sponsorship confirmations.

Maintain and update CRM and sales trackers, ensuring accurate records of leads and client interactions.

Build and maintain relationships with existing clients to encourage repeat participation and upselling.

Represent MediaComz at industry events, networking sessions, and client meetings.

Event Planning & Execution

Support the planning and delivery of conferences, exhibitions, and networking events.

Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors (venues, AV, catering, branding, logistics).

Assist in managing event timelines, run-of-show documents, and on-site logistics.

Liaise with sponsors and exhibitors to ensure all agreed deliverables are fulfilled accurately and on time.

Provide on-site event support, including registration, sponsor management, speaker coordination, and troubleshooting.

Marketing & Communications Support

Assist in the preparation of marketing and sales collateral, including sponsorship decks, brochres, EDMs, and

social media content.

Coordinate with designers and content teams on timelines and deliverables.

Support post-event communications such as thank-you notes, surveys, testimonials, and reports.

Administrative & Operational Support

Assist with general administrative tasks, including documentation, filing, and scheduling.

Track payment milestones and follow up on outstanding invoices in coordination with finance.

Support reporting on sales performance, sponsorship uptake, and event outcomes.

Handle ad-hoc tasks related to event operations and business development as required.

Requirements

Diploma or Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Events Management, or related fields.

1–3 years’ experience in B2B sales, sponsorship, events, or project coordination (experience in media, maritime,

energy, or industrial sectors is an advantage).

Strong interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable speaking with clients and stakeholders.

Highly organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

Willingness to support events outside normal office hours when required.

Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); CRM experience is a plus.

What We Offer

Exposure to regional and international industry events.

Hands-on experience across sales, marketing, and event delivery.

Opportunities to grow within a dynamic events and media environment.

Supportive team culture with direct exposure to senior stakeholders.

SEATECH SOLUTIONS INTERNATIONAL (S) PTE LTD

ABOUT US

Since inception in 2000, SeaTech has built a strong reputation for reliable, highly efficient and environmentally friendly vessel designs operating globally. We take pride in building a strong bond with clients, from inception, to delivery, and beyond, by listening to their operational requirements to ensure best-customised solutions. To date, SeaTech has over 300 unique designs and more than 400 vessels sailing globally.

As a centre for marine and offshore excellence, SeaTech covers the complete set of design, engineering and consulting disciplines in-house. Clients receive high quality services at cost-effective rates due to our multi-talented team using the latest modern technology.

Embracing Singapore’s “Can Do” spirit, we reach out globally but deliver locally, through regional offices in Singapore, China, India, Malaysia, Myanmar, Thailand, Japan, Vietnam, Korea, Australia and Germany.

MISSION

To Assure Optimum Performance with Design, Innovation & Technology.

VISION

A Sea of Technology

title: Head of Sales, Asia
description:
About Intellect

Intellect is the global leader in mental health benefits, trusted by the world’s most forward-thinking employers, insurers, and governments to deliver care that is local, personalised, and effective at scale. Today, we serve over 4 million people across 100 countries and languages, making mental health support truly accessible across borders and cultures.

Our platform powers the mental wellbeing of workforces at hundreds of Fortune 500 and major companies, enabling them to support their people with the highest standards of clinical quality, cultural relevance, and on-demand accessibility.

Driven by our mission to build the world’s most trusted mental health benefits platform, Intellect combines a best-in-class digital platform with a world-leading global provider network to deliver unmatched client outcomes and transformative care experiences.

We are backed by top global investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, Insignia Ventures Partners, HOF Capital, K3 Ventures, JAFCO, Headline, East Ventures, IHH Healthcare, MS&AD Ventures, and more, alongside an extensive coalition of notable family offices, big tech executives, and leading angel investors.

The Role

The Director of Sales, Asia will drive Intellect’s enterprise sales growth across our core Asian markets through direct sales and strategic alliances.

This is a hands-on leadership role with accountability for regional sales performance and an individual new business revenue target. You will lead and develop a team of Account Executives and SDRs while personally originating, owning and closing a focused portfolio of strategic enterprise opportunities.

We are looking for a strong enterprise seller and people leader who understands how to win complex deals, lead competitive RFPs and build trusted relationships with C-suite decision-makers. You should be equally comfortable setting market priorities, coaching a salesperson, leading an executive presentation and negotiating a contract.

You will work closely with Marketing, Revenue Operations and Partnerships to shape our sales go-to-market strategy, strengthen commercial discipline and build repeatable routes to growth. You will also partner with Clinical, Operations, Product and Finance to ensure our proposals deliver value for customers and are commercially sustainable.

Your Responsibilities

1. Revenue Ownership & Enterprise Selling

Own regional new business sales performance, translating revenue targets into clear market priorities, account plans and execution.
Carry an individual new business revenue target and personally own a focused portfolio of strategic deals through the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation, contracting and close.
Build qualified pipeline through targeted outreach, executive networks, referrals and partner channels, alongside Marketing and SDR-led activity.
Navigate complex buying groups, uncover customer priorities, develop compelling business cases and secure access to economic buyers and executive sponsors.
Build and deepen relationships with CHROs, Chief People Officers, Total Rewards and Benefits leaders, and other senior stakeholders involved in enterprise buying decisions.

2. Sales Team Leadership & Development

Lead, coach and develop Account Executives and SDRs, setting clear expectations for pipeline creation, opportunity progression and revenue delivery.
Run effective pipeline reviews, deal reviews and individual coaching, identifying performance gaps early and taking action to address them.
Develop the team’s capabilities in discovery, stakeholder mapping, multithreading, value articulation, executive engagement and negotiation.
Establish clear account and territory ownership; help shape hiring, team structure and incentives as the business scales.
Build a culture of accountability, collaboration and high performance through direct feedback, recognition and timely performance management.

3. RFP Leadership & Complex Deal Strategy

Lead priority enterprise RFPs and tenders end to end, including bid qualification, go/no-go decisions, win strategy, proposal development, presentations and commercial negotiations.
Build each bid strategy around the customer’s priorities, evaluation criteria, competitive landscape and Intellect’s differentiated value.
Coordinate solution specialists and cross-functional contributors to deliver accurate, compelling proposals on time, with clear ownership of deliverables.
Lead customer engagement throughout the process, navigating procurement requirements and aligning stakeholders around the proposed solution.
Use win/loss reviews to improve bid selection, sales execution, proposals and competitive positioning.

4. Go-to-Market Strategy & Marketing Collaboration

Shape and execute the sales go-to-market strategy across Asia, prioritising markets, industries, customer segments and direct versus partner-led routes.
Partner with Marketing on target account selection, account-based campaigns, events and demand generation, with shared focus on qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes.
Establish clear lead handovers and follow-up standards, using conversion data and sales feedback to improve lead quality and campaign effectiveness.
Work with Marketing and Product to sharpen enterprise positioning, value propositions and sales narratives based on customer insights and competitive intelligence.
Translate market feedback into practical recommendations on offerings, packaging and growth opportunities.

5. Alliances & Ecosystem-Led Growth

Work with the Partnerships team to turn broker, insurer and other strategic relationships into qualified enterprise pipeline and revenue.
Develop joint account plans and sales initiatives that improve access to priority customers and markets.
Lead sales execution for agreed alliance-led opportunities, coordinating partner introductions, joint pitches and negotiations.
Establish clear opportunity ownership and handovers with Partnerships, aligning direct and partner-led activity to avoid channel conflict.
Evaluate alliance-led sales activity through pipeline quality, conversion and revenue contribution.

6. Revenue Operations & Commercial Discipline

Partner with Revenue Operations to strengthen the foundations for scale: CRM standards, pipeline stages, qualification criteria, forecasting, account planning and performance reporting.
Own adoption of these standards within Sales, maintaining accurate opportunity data, realistic forecasts and clear next steps.
Use pipeline coverage, conversion, sales cycle and productivity data to identify bottlenecks and improve performance; build repeatable playbooks across priority segments.
Help shape pricing, packaging and deal structures with Finance and relevant teams, balancing customer value, competitiveness, delivery requirements and sustainable margins.
Lead deal negotiations within agreed approval frameworks and ensure effective handovers to Client Success and Operations, with clear customer commitments and ownership of follow-on opportunities.

Requirements

Proven Enterprise Sales Leader

You have a track record of delivering B2B new business growth and leading sales teams against clear revenue targets. You have personally originated and closed complex enterprise deals and can explain your contribution to those wins.

Hands-On Player-Coach

You enjoy leading a team while continuing to own and close your own opportunities. You can balance personal selling with coaching, delegate effectively and step into team deals without creating confusion over ownership.

Experienced RFP Leader

You have led and won competitive enterprise RFPs or tenders. You bring sound judgment on which bids to pursue, how to differentiate a proposal and how to coordinate teams through demanding timelines and commercial negotiations.

Strong Enterprise Seller & Executive Relationship Builder

You understand long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, from discovery and business case development through procurement, legal review and contracting. You can engage credibly with C-suite leaders, develop executive sponsors and build new relationships through outreach, networks and partner introductions.

Disciplined Sales Operator

You understand pipeline generation, qualification, forecasting, territory planning, sales methodologies and performance management. You use data to improve decisions and execution, supported by sound judgment and a close understanding of your customers.

Commercially Strategic & Collaborative

You bring strong judgment on market priorities, pricing, positioning and deal economics. You work effectively with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Partnerships and delivery teams, aligning different perspectives around clear commercial outcomes.

Experienced Across Asian Markets

You have meaningful experience in Asian enterprise markets and understand differences in buying behaviour, procurement practices and market maturity. Experience across Singapore and other major Asian markets is strongly preferred.

Experience in enterprise SaaS, HR technology, employee benefits, healthcare, insurance, professional services or another complex B2B category is advantageous. Direct mental healthcare experience is not required.

Builder Mindset & Mission Alignment

You are comfortable in a growing business where processes continue to evolve. You bring structure, take ownership and adapt as you learn. You are motivated by expanding access to quality mental healthcare while building a commercially sustainable business.

What Success Looks Like
Delivery against regional and individual new business revenue targets.
A healthy enterprise pipeline, stronger conversion and reliable forecasting.
Strategic enterprise and RFP wins on commercially sound terms.
A capable, accountable sales team with improving productivity and performance.
Measurable pipeline and revenue from alliance-led sales.
Repeatable sales practices and effective collaboration across the teams supporting growth.

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

Global company – work in a diverse environment with people from nearly 20 countries
Generous leave policy – time off to rest and recharge
Christmas week off – company-wide break during Christmas, separate from annual leave
Birthday leave – enjoy a day off on your birthday
Quarterly mental health days – one day off every quarter to focus on your wellbeing
Flexible work arrangements – work in a way that suits your lifestyle and goals
Work-life balance – a culture that values personal time and long-term wellness
Medical coverage – comprehensive insurance for peace of mind
Performance bonus – high performance is recognised and rewarded
Development budget - annual allowance to support your professional development
Mental health support – premium coaching access to our mental health app and resources & dedicated budget for clinical and psychiatric care
Socials and communities – regular non-work events/activities to connect and have fun together

title: PILATES STUDIO MANAGER
description:
STUDIO MANAGER

Position Overview

The

Studio Manager

is responsible for the continued growth, performance and culture of FS8, with a strong focus on creating a

community-led, high-performing and welcoming studio environment

.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining

studio operations, team leadership, client management, business development, training, community engagement, marketing and partnerships

.

The Manager will oversee the day-to-day running of the studio, lead and develop the trainer and front-of-house team, deliver exceptional client experiences, drive membership and revenue growth, and ensure the studio is maintained to the highest operational and presentation standards.

A key component of the role is being visible on the studio floor and building genuine relationships with clients. The Manager will deliver approximately

12 hours of client-facing training per week

, using this time to support client development, understand member needs, build relationships and strengthen the overall studio experience.

The successful candidate will be creative, energetic, organised and commercially minded, with a genuine passion for fitness and community. They will be expected to identify opportunities, develop new initiatives and help establish FS8 as a

community studio — not simply a place where people come to take a class.

Formal FS8 brand and methodology training will be provided.

Key Responsibilities

1. Studio & Operational Management

Take overall responsibility for the smooth and efficient day-to-day operation of the studio.

Manage studio opening and closing procedures, class set-up and pack-down, reception and front-of-house standards.

Oversee trainer schedules, cover requirements and studio timetable requirements.

Ensure all classes are adequately staffed and delivered to FS8 standards.

Maintain a clean, organised, safe and welcoming studio environment at all times.

Conduct regular checks of reformers, equipment, furniture and studio facilities.

Identify maintenance requirements and coordinate repairs or servicing where required.

Ensure equipment is appropriately maintained and reported when issues arise.

Manage studio supplies, stock and operational requirements.

Develop and maintain effective operational procedures and checklists.

Ensure all studio policies, procedures and brand standards are followed.

Monitor studio KPIs and use data to identify opportunities to improve performance.

2. Team Leadership & Staff Development

Lead, support and develop the studio team.

Work closely with trainers to ensure consistent delivery of the FS8 experience and methodology.

Support trainer onboarding, training and development.

Provide regular feedback and coaching to team members.

Assist with trainer scheduling, cover and performance management.

Create a positive, collaborative and accountable team culture.

Identify opportunities to improve team performance and client experience.

Encourage trainers to actively participate in studio community initiatives and events.

Work with senior FS8 leadership on trainer development and ongoing education.

3. Client Training & Experience

The Manager will remain an active part of the studio floor and will deliver approximately

12 hours of client-facing training per week

.

Responsibilities include:

Deliver high-quality FS8 classes in accordance with FS8 methodology and standards.

Build strong relationships with clients through regular interaction and coaching.

Understand individual client goals, motivations and challenges.

Provide appropriate guidance and recommendations to support client progression.

Identify opportunities to improve the client journey and overall studio experience.

Welcome new clients and help them feel comfortable and connected to the studio.

Recognise regular clients and create a personalised experience.

Proactively identify clients who may need additional support, encouragement or follow-up.

Encourage consistency, progression and long-term engagement.

Gather client feedback and turn it into actionable improvements.

4. Client Management & Communication

The Manager will take ownership of the client relationship beyond the studio floor.

Respond promptly and professionally to client enquiries across all communication channels.

Manage client communication through

Mindbody, Loyalsnap, WhatsApp, email and other relevant platforms

.

This includes weekly emails, promotion development and our corporate engagement.

Ensure leads and enquiries are followed up consistently and professionally.

Maintain accurate client records and notes within the client management system.

Monitor client attendance, engagement and purchasing behaviour.

Identify clients at risk of becoming inactive and implement appropriate re-engagement strategies.

Manage membership renewals, upgrades and conversions.

Communicate promotions, programs, events and studio initiatives.

Develop personalised client outreach where appropriate.

Ensure clients receive a high level of communication before, during and after their studio journey.

5. Mindbody & Client Management Systems

Take responsibility for the effective use and administration of

Mindbody

and associated client management systems.

This includes:

Managing client profiles and ensuring information is accurate.

Monitoring bookings, attendance, cancellations and no-shows.

Managing memberships, class packs and relevant client accounts.

Tracking leads and enquiries.

Monitoring client purchasing behaviour.

Supporting reporting and KPI tracking.

Identifying opportunities through client data.

Ensuring the team is appropriately trained in system use.

Maintaining consistent and accurate client records.

Using data to support retention, sales and community-building initiatives.

6. Business Development & Sales

The Manager will play a key role in driving the commercial performance and continued growth of the studio.

Responsibilities include:

Respond promptly and professionally to all enquiries.

Track and manage leads from initial enquiry through to conversion.

Implement systems to maximise enquiry-to-client conversion.

Promote and sell memberships, class packs, programs and studio services.

Meet and exceed agreed membership and sales targets.

Develop member sign-up, retention and renewal strategies.

Identify opportunities to increase client frequency and lifetime value.

Promote studio programs and initiatives consistently.

Develop strategies to increase class utilisation.

Monitor sales performance and identify areas for improvement.

Work with senior management on pricing, promotions and commercial initiatives.

Identify new revenue opportunities for the studio.

7. Community Development

A core objective of this role is to

build FS8 into a community studio

.

The Manager will be responsible for creating an environment where clients know the team, feel recognised and want to spend time at the studio.

This includes:

Developing a strong sense of community among members.

Creating opportunities for clients to connect with one another.

Developing regular studio celebrations and community events.

Celebrating client milestones, achievements and birthdays.

Creating member challenges and participation initiatives.

Developing social and wellness activities outside regular classes.

Encouraging trainers to actively engage with the studio community.

Creating initiatives that make clients feel recognised and valued.

Building relationships with local businesses and the wider MBFC community.

Identifying opportunities to make FS8 a destination within the local corporate and fitness community.

The goal is to create a studio where clients don't simply attend classes — they feel that they belong.

8. Studio Events, Celebrations & Initiatives

The Manager will be responsible for developing and executing initiatives that drive engagement and create memorable studio experiences.

Examples may include:

Member appreciation events.

Studio anniversary celebrations.

Birthday and milestone celebrations.

Fitness challenges.

Community workouts.

Wellness events.

Guest trainer sessions.

Corporate fitness initiatives.

Member competitions and incentives.

New program launches.

Seasonal campaigns.

Charity and community initiatives.

The Manager should continuously look for

new and creative ways to bring people into the studio and give existing clients a reason to remain engaged.

9. Partnerships & Collaborations

Develop and maintain relationships with relevant brands, businesses and organisations.

Responsibilities include:

Identify potential collaboration opportunities.

Develop partnerships with complementary fitness, health, wellness, beauty, food and lifestyle brands.

Build relationships with businesses within the MBFC and CBD community.

Develop corporate wellness opportunities.

Coordinate collaborative events and activations.

Negotiate and manage mutually beneficial partnership arrangements.

Ensure partnerships add genuine value to the FS8 client experience.

Track the performance and effectiveness of collaborations.

10. Marketing & Social Media

The Manager will work closely with the marketing team while taking an active role in the studio's local marketing and digital engagement.

Responsibilities include:

Support the development and execution of local marketing campaigns.

Create and identify opportunities for social media content.

Encourage trainers and clients to participate in content creation.

Promote studio events, offers, challenges and initiatives.

Engage with clients and the local community through social media.

Support Instagram and other digital channels with timely studio updates.

Identify local marketing opportunities within MBFC and Marina Bay.

Work with collaborative brands on joint marketing initiatives.

Ensure the studio's online presence reflects the energy and culture of the physical studio.

11. Training & Development

The Manager will receive formal FS8 brand and methodology training and will be expected to continually develop their own knowledge and skills.

Responsibilities include:

Complete all required FS8 training and education.

Maintain current knowledge of FS8 programming and methodology.

Participate in ongoing trainer development.

Support the development of the wider studio team.

Keep up to date with developments in the fitness and wellness industry.

Bring new ideas and best practices into the studio where appropriate.

Encourage a culture of continuous learning and development.

12. Cleaning, Maintenance & Studio Standards

The Manager is responsible for ensuring the studio consistently meets FS8 standards of cleanliness, presentation and safety.

This includes:

Ensuring reformers and equipment are cleaned and maintained regularly.

Ensuring the studio floor, mats, mirrors and communal areas are clean.

Maintaining reception, changing areas and client facilities.

Monitoring cleaning standards throughout the day.

Managing cleaning schedules and external cleaning providers where applicable.

Reporting and following up on maintenance issues.

Conducting regular equipment and facility checks.

Ensuring the studio is presented to a high standard before, during and after operating hours.

Creating a studio environment that feels professional, welcoming and premium.

13. Reporting & Performance

Monitor studio KPIs including membership growth, sales, retention, attendance and utilisation.

Provide regular performance updates to senior management.

Analyse client and business data to identify trends and opportunities.

Monitor promotional and campaign performance.

Track lead conversion and client retention.

Identify operational issues and propose solutions.

Set and work towards agreed studio targets.

Take ownership of results and proactively communicate challenges and opportunities.

Key Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured through a combination of

commercial performance, client experience and community development

, including:

Membership growth.

Sales and revenue performance.

Lead conversion.

Client retention and renewal.

Class utilisation.

Client attendance and engagement.

Client satisfaction and feedback.

Trainer performance and development.

Studio cleanliness and operational standards.

Successful delivery of events and initiatives.

Growth of corporate and local partnerships.

Social media and digital engagement.

Strength and vibrancy of the FS8 Marina Bay community.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

Has a genuine passion for fitness, health and wellness.

Is confident leading a team.

Is highly organised and commercially aware.

Has excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Enjoys building relationships and creating community.

Is comfortable with sales and achieving targets.

Is proactive and able to work independently.

Is creative and constantly looking for new ideas.

Is confident using technology and client management systems.

Has experience with

Mindbody or a similar booking/CRM platform

.

Is comfortable communicating with clients digitally.

Has strong attention to detail.

Takes pride in the presentation and cleanliness of a studio.

Is willing to be hands-on and lead by example.

Understands that exceptional client experience is created through the small details.

Wants to build something, rather than simply manage something.

Role Philosophy

We are building a community, not just running a studio.

The Studio Manager should be the heartbeat of the studio — the person who knows the clients, supports the trainers, drives the business, creates the energy and makes sure every person who walks through the door feels welcomed and valued.

This role is for someone who wants to take ownership, develop ideas, build relationships and make a visible impact on the growth and culture of the studio.

Collection of elevated and emerging fitness studios, united with a strong Global and regional presence. We are now bringing the vision to Singapore.

title: Senior/Executive, Client Engagement & Partnerships
description:
Senior/Executive, Client Engagement & Partnerships

Singapore Environment Council (SEC)

Build Relationships That Make Sustainability Matter

The Singapore Environment Council (SEC) is an independent, non-profit organisation dedicated to promoting environmental sustainability and responsible business practices. Through certification programmes, sustainability initiatives and stakeholder engagement, SEC works with organisations across industries to drive positive environmental impact.

We are looking for a relationship-focused

Senior/Executive, Client Engagement & Partnerships

to look after and grow SEC's portfolio of clients and partners. If you enjoy being a trusted point of contact, understanding client needs and turning relationships into long-term partnerships, we would like to hear from you.

About the Role

You will manage a portfolio of clients and partners using SEC's certification, sustainability and advisory services. You will be their main point of contact, help them get the most from our programmes, grow each relationship over time, and steward the agreements that underpin our partnerships. This is an individual contributor role with revenue and renewal goals, offering the chance to build deep expertise in sustainability certification programmes and environmental standards.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Account Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and partners on certification and sustainability matters.

Build strong, long-term relationships with existing clients, partners and stakeholders.

Understand client needs and recommend suitable SEC programmes and services.

Achieve individual revenue goals through renewals, upselling and new business from referrals and outreach.

Conduct presentations and discussions with organisations interested in SEC's programmes and services.

Partnership Stewardship & Documentation

Draft, format and coordinate business agreements, Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs) and partnership proposals.

Work with internal stakeholders and external parties to facilitate document review and finalisation.

Track agreement milestones, renewal dates and commitments to keep partnerships on course.

Maintain organised records of agreements and client correspondence.

Events & Stakeholder Engagement

Represent SEC at industry events, exhibitions, networking sessions and stakeholder engagement activities.

Support the planning and execution of major SEC events and programmes.

Business Operations Support

Prepare reports, presentations, meeting materials and management updates on client and partner activity.

Coordinate meetings and follow-up actions with the Deputy Director, Client Engagement.

Support departmental projects and initiatives as required.

What We're Looking For

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Sustainability, or a related discipline.

At least 3 years of experience in client engagement, account management, client servicing, partnerships or business development.

Experience in sustainability, certification, compliance, environmental services, professional services or consulting environments will be an advantage.

Candidates with strong client-facing experience or sustainability-related work are encouraged to apply.

Skills & Competencies

Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills; builds trust easily.

Comfortable presenting to clients, partners and stakeholders.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Good organisational skills and attention to detail, especially with agreements and records.

Works independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Word and Excel.

Manages multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic environment.

Professional and ethical in handling confidential information.

Willing to learn and progressively develop expertise in sustainability certifications and standards.

Additional Information

Occasional regional travel may be required for client engagement, stakeholder engagement and certification-related activities.

Why Join SEC?

Contribute to Singapore's sustainability journey and environmental goals.

Build lasting relationships with organisations across multiple industries.

Gain exposure to sustainability certifications, environmental standards and stakeholder engagement.

Be part of a purpose-driven organisation committed to a more sustainable future.

Opportunities for professional development and career growth.

Diversity & Inclusion

Singapore Environment Council is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, gender, race, religion, marital status, caregiving responsibilities, disability status or background. Selection is based on merit, skills, experience and job-related competencies.

Interested applicants are invited to submit a detailed resume outlining their relevant experience and achievements.

Established in 1995, the

Singapore Environment Council (SEC)

is an independently managed, non-profit, non-governmental organisation (NGO) dedicated to fostering a lasting culture of environmental ownership. As an approved

Institution of a Public Character (IPC)

, we serve as a primary catalyst for environmental advocacy and coordinate efforts across Singapore and the region.

We hold a unique position in the global sustainability landscape:

Global Recognition:

We are the only recognised member of the

Global Ecolabelling Network (GEN)

in Singapore, a non-profit association of leading eco-labelling organisations worldwide.

UN Accreditation:

In 2018, the SEC was granted

United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)

accredited environmental NGO status, further amplifying our influence on sustainability issues.

National Impact:

We work closely with government agencies, statutory boards, and industry partners to translate environmental policy into actionable solutions, such as the

Resource Sustainability Act

and

Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)

frameworks.

At SEC, we don't just influence thinking; we drive systemic change. By joining our team, you will be at the heart of Singapore’s transition toward a circular economy and a more sustainable future

title: Network Sales Admin Support
description:
Job Title

Network Sales Admin Support

Occupation

Sales & Business Development Support

About Super Sistem Group

Super Sistem is a

licensed telecommunications infrastructure operator and builder

, holding a

Facilities-Based Operator (FBO) licence in Singapore

and a

Jartup (Jaringan Telekomunikasi Tertutup) licence in Indonesia

.

These licences enable Super Sistem to develop, operate and manage telecommunications infrastructure across

Singapore and Indonesia

, including submarine cable and terrestrial fibre infrastructure.

We specialize in developing and operating

submarine cable and terrestrial fibre infrastructure

, connecting key digital, data centre and telecommunications hubs across Singapore and Indonesia.

As a rapidly growing cross-border network operator, Super Sistem combines

engineering expertise, regulatory knowledge and commercial capabilities

to develop reliable, scalable and future-ready digital connectivity infrastructure.

We are now seeking a

Network Sales Admin Support

to join our Singapore team and work closely with our

Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)

in developing Super Sistem's regional wholesale connectivity business.

About the Role

The

Network Sales Admin Support

will work closely with the CMO to support the day-to-day execution of Super Sistem's

sales, business development and customer engagement activities

across Singapore and the region.

This is more than a traditional administrative support position. The successful candidate will be exposed to the

full commercial sales cycle

— from identifying prospects and preparing sales materials, to customer meetings, quotations, negotiations, contracting and ultimately closing business.

The role is designed for a

high-potential, commercially minded individual who wants to build a long-term career in telecommunications infrastructure sales

.

The successful candidate will initially provide strong administrative, coordination and sales support to the CMO. As the candidate develops product knowledge, commercial understanding and customer relationships, the role will progressively expand to include

direct customer engagement, account management, business development and ownership of sales opportunities

.

Our objective is to develop the successful candidate towards taking on

greater responsibility and independently leading sales activities within approximately three years

, subject to performance, capability and business requirements.

Prior telecommunications or submarine cable experience is

not essential

. We are particularly interested in candidates who are

fast learners, commercially driven, confident in dealing with people and have a proven track record in sales or customer-facing business development

.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales & Business Development Support

Work closely with the CMO to support

sales and business development activities

across Singapore and the region.

Assist in identifying and researching

potential customers, partners and business opportunities

.

Maintain and update the company's

sales pipeline, customer database and opportunity tracking

.

Coordinate customer follow-ups, meetings, presentations and commercial discussions.

Prepare sales quotations, proposals, presentations, capability statements and other customer-facing materials.

Assist in tracking opportunities from initial enquiry through to

quotation, negotiation, contract and service delivery

.

Ensure timely follow-up on outstanding customer enquiries, proposals and commercial matters.

Support the CMO in maintaining strong relationships with existing customers and business partners.

2. Sales Administration & Coordination

Provide day-to-day administrative and coordination support to the CMO and sales function.

Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, action items and follow-up reports.

Maintain accurate records of

customer contacts, opportunities, quotations, contracts and sales activities

.

Coordinate internally with technical, project, operations, finance and management teams to respond to customer requirements.

Assist in preparing internal sales reports, pipeline updates and management presentations.

Coordinate travel arrangements, customer meetings and regional business activities when required.

3. Customer & Market Research

Conduct research on

telecommunications operators, ISPs, data centres, cloud providers, hyperscalers, content providers and other potential customers

.

Monitor market developments, new infrastructure projects, submarine cable systems, data centre developments and regional connectivity opportunities.

Identify potential new customers and business opportunities for Super Sistem's network infrastructure and connectivity services.

Assist in developing customer and market intelligence to support the CMO's business development strategy.

4. Commercial & Product Development

Develop a strong understanding of Super Sistem's products and services, including

submarine fibre capacity, dark fibre, wavelength, cable landing station and data centre connectivity solutions

.

Work with the technical team to understand customer requirements and translate them into appropriate connectivity solutions.

Assist in preparing commercial models, pricing comparisons and customer proposals.

Develop an understanding of the commercial considerations surrounding

capacity, fibre pairs, IRUs, connectivity services and infrastructure projects

.

Support the CMO in evaluating new commercial opportunities and partnerships.

5. Progressive Sales Responsibility

As the candidate develops experience and demonstrates capability:

Participate directly in

customer meetings and commercial negotiations

.

Take ownership of selected customer accounts and sales opportunities.

Develop and maintain relationships with customers and industry partners.

Independently manage defined sales opportunities from prospecting through to closure.

Develop and maintain an individual sales pipeline and sales targets.

Represent Super Sistem at selected

industry conferences, exhibitions and customer events

.

Progressively take on responsibility for

regional sales and business development activities

.

The long-term objective is for the successful candidate to develop from a sales support role into a

commercially independent sales and business development professional

capable of leading customer relationships and sales opportunities.

Qualifications & Experience

Essential

Diploma or Bachelor's Degree

in Business, Marketing, Sales, Communications, Information Technology or a related discipline.

A

Diploma is sufficient

for this position; academic qualifications are less important than demonstrated commercial ability and attitude.

Proven sales or business development track record

, preferably with measurable sales achievements or customer acquisition results.

Strong interest in developing a career in

sales and business development

.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Confident and comfortable communicating with customers, partners and senior stakeholders.

Strong organisational skills with attention to detail.

Good written and spoken

English

.

Strong Microsoft Office / Google Workspace skills.

Fast learner with the ability to understand new products, technologies and commercial concepts quickly.

Self-motivated, proactive and able to work independently.

Willingness to travel regionally when required, particularly to

Indonesia and other Southeast Asian markets

.

Industry Experience

Prior experience in

telecommunications, submarine cables or digital infrastructure is not mandatory

.

Candidates with sales experience in other sectors are welcome, particularly those from:

IT / technology

Data centres

Cloud services

Engineering

Construction / infrastructure

Energy and utilities

Marine / offshore

Enterprise solutions

B2B services

Other technical or solution-based sales environments

What matters most is

proven sales ability, commercial instinct, willingness to learn and the drive to build a long-term career in network infrastructure sales

.

Career Development

This position is intended to provide a

structured pathway from Sales Support to Network Sales / Business Development

.

First Year — Learn & Support

Build a strong foundation in:

Super Sistem's network and connectivity products

Customers and regional telecommunications markets

Sales processes and CRM/pipeline management

Quotations and commercial proposals

Customer engagement

Submarine cable and fibre infrastructure fundamentals

Second Year — Develop & Own

Progressively take responsibility for:

Customer accounts

Sales opportunities

Customer meetings

Commercial proposals

Business development activities

Regional customer engagement

Third Year — Lead

Subject to performance and capability, take increasing ownership of:

Sales pipeline

Key customer relationships

Business development opportunities

Commercial negotiations

Regional sales activities

New customer acquisition

The intention is to develop the successful candidate into a

capable Network Sales / Business Development professional who can independently originate, manage and close connectivity opportunities

.

Why Join Super Sistem

Join an

emerging licensed telecom infrastructure operator

with an

FBO licence in Singapore and Jartup licence in Indonesia

.

Work directly with senior management and gain exposure to

cross-border telecommunications and digital infrastructure development

.

Learn from an experienced CMO and senior management team with extensive experience in

telecommunications, submarine cable systems and international connectivity

.

Gain exposure to Super Sistem's growing portfolio of

submarine cable and connectivity infrastructure

, including BTI, SS Batam SG and SEAX-1.

Opportunity to build a long-term career in

B2B network sales and business development

, rather than remaining in a purely administrative role.

Structured opportunity to progressively move from

sales support → account management → business development → network sales

.

Work with customers and partners across

Singapore, Indonesia and Southeast Asia

.

Flexible hybrid

(Office / Remote / Customer Meetings / Regional Travel)

work culture.

Competitive salary and benefits package.

What We Value

At Super Sistem, we believe in

curiosity, ownership and adaptability

.

We are looking for someone who is

hungry to learn, comfortable talking to customers and willing to take responsibility

.

You do not need to know everything about submarine cables or telecommunications when you join us. What matters is that you are a

fast learner with proven sales ability

, have the confidence to engage people, and are willing to put in the effort to understand a technically complex industry.

If you have demonstrated that you can

build relationships, identify opportunities and close sales

, we will provide the industry knowledge and exposure needed for you to develop further.

If your ambition is to become a regional network sales professional within the next three years, this role provides an opportunity to learn directly from senior management while helping build Super Sistem's growing connectivity business across Southeast Asia.

Super Sistem's current business spans submarine systems and connectivity solutions including dark fibre, wavelength, cable landing station and data-centre infrastructure.
