title: HubSpot Implementation Consultant
description:
We are looking for fresh graduates to join us as a HubSpot Implementation Consultant to support client onboarding, requirement gathering, solution planning, HubSpot configuration, project coordination, and user training.

The consultant will work closely with Sales teams and HubSpot Specialists to understand client requirements and translate them into practical HubSpot solutions.

You do not need to be a developer or a HubSpot expert when you join us. Training and guidance will be provided. More importantly, we are looking for someone who is curious about how mar-tech works, can communicate clearly, think logically, manage responsibilities, and develop into a trusted consultant.

This role begins with a 3-month period of coaching, guidance, and on-the-job training, followed by a 3-month probation period. By the end of probation, we will assess the candidate's readiness to independently manage client accounts.

The role will support clients across areas such as HubSpot onboarding, CRM implementation, sales and marketing automation, reporting, training, optimisation, and integrations.

Responsibilities

Requirement Gathering and Solution Advisory

Participate in requirement gathering meetings and workshops with client stakeholders.

Ask relevant questions to understand the client's sales, marketing, service, and operational processes.

Work with HubSpot Specialists and our internal technology team to translate business requirements into practical CRM solutions.

Help document client requirements, workflows, processes, and implementation decisions.

Learn to identify what can be implemented natively in HubSpot and where alternative approaches may be required.

Support the preparation and presentation of proposed solutions to clients.

Clearly articulate recommendations and explain how proposed solutions support the client's business processes.

Sales and Marketing Architecture & Automation

Support the setup of marketing automation, lead nurturing, lead routing, and lifecycle workflows.

Assist with sales automation including task creation, lead assignment, pipeline progression, and follow-up processes.

Support the configuration of lead qualification processes such as MQL, SQL, lead scoring, and segmentation.

Help implement campaign tracking and reporting requirements.

Work with HubSpot Specialists to test automation before deployment.

HubSpot Implementation and Configuration

Support the configuration of HubSpot CRM based on approved requirements.

Set up contact, company, deal, ticket, and other CRM properties.

Configure pipelines, deal stages, lead statuses, lifecycle stages, and ownership rules.

Create forms, lists, workflows, internal notifications, and basic automation.

Support the setup of meeting links, sales templates, snippets, sequences, and tasks.

Assist with HubSpot onboarding for new clients and optimisation projects for existing clients.

Conduct testing to ensure configurations work according to agreed requirements.

Project Coordination and Management

Work with HubSpot Specialists to coordinate implementation activities.

Track project tasks, timelines, dependencies, and outstanding client requirements.

Follow up on action items with clients and internal teams.

Help ensure project documentation and requirements remain updated throughout the engagement.

Identify potential delays, risks, or missing information and escalate them early.

Support multiple projects while maintaining clear priorities and deadlines.

Reporting and Dashboard Setup

Support the creation of dashboards and reports for sales, marketing, and management teams.

Understand client reporting requirements and translate them into HubSpot reports.

Help configure properties and data structures required for reporting accuracy.

Learn how common metrics such as lead conversion, pipeline value, sales activities, and campaign performance are measured.

Support client training on using HubSpot dashboards and reports.

Data and Migration Support

Assist with CRM data preparation, clean-up, and property mapping.

Support contact, company, deal, and ticket imports.

Review data for duplicates, missing information, and inconsistencies.

Work with the project team to establish mandatory fields and basic data governance rules.

Support testing and validation after data migration.

Client Training and Support

Support and gradually lead HubSpot onboarding and training workshops.

Present HubSpot features and processes clearly to different user groups.

Conduct role-specific training for administrators, marketing teams, sales teams, and other users.

Prepare user guides, SOPs, workshop materials, and documentation.

Support clients during onboarding and post-launch adoption.

Troubleshoot basic HubSpot issues and work with Specialists on more complex requirements.

Problem-Solving and Analytical Approach

Investigate client challenges before recommending solutions.

Break complex requirements into manageable problems.

Work with Specialists and technical teams to evaluate possible solutions.

Identify potential risks or limitations before implementation.

Clearly explain proposed approaches to clients and internal teams.

Be comfortable acknowledging when further investigation is required instead of making assumptions.

Collaboration with Internal Teams

Work closely with HubSpot Specialists on solution design and configuration.

Work with Developers where integrations, APIs, or custom development are required.

Work with Designers and Content teams on landing pages, marketing emails, forms, and campaign assets.

Support the Sales team with solution research or technical input during pre-sales discussions when required.

Identify new opportunities with the sales team and scope requirements to expand project revenue.

Requirements

Diploma or Degree in Business, Marketing, Information Systems, Communications, Digital Marketing, Technology, or a related discipline.

Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.

Strong interest in technology, digital platforms, automation, and how systems work together.

Must have strong verbal communication and presentation skills.

Must be able to articulate ideas and explain solutions clearly.

Strong problem-solving and logical thinking skills.

Good organisational and project coordination skills.

Comfortable interacting with clients and different stakeholders.

Able to ask questions and clarify requirements instead of making assumptions.

Comfortable learning new software and digital platforms.

Strong attention to detail and documentation.

Able to manage multiple tasks and follow through on commitments.

Good written and spoken English.

Positive learning attitude with an interest in CRM, automation, digital marketing, and technology.

Able to work collaboratively across different teams.

Good to have

Basic understanding of web development, coding, APIs, databases, or system integrations.

Development experience is not required, but an interest in technical concepts will be an advantage.

Basic understanding of CRM, digital marketing, sales processes, or marketing automation.

Experience presenting through school projects, internships, competitions, or client-facing activities.

Internship experience in an agency, consulting company, technology company, marketing team, or SaaS business.

Basic understanding of project management methodologies or tools.

Proficiency in Mandarin is an advantage, as the role may support regional or China-based client accounts.

title: Senior Health Insurance Specialist
description:
Job Description:

Senior Health Insurance Specialist

Location: Singapore

Permanent

Full time

Hybrid working

Job Purpose:

To lead, coach and manage a team of Health Insurance Specialists responsible for achieving Bupa Global's sales targets through its partnership with Standard Chartered Bank in Singapore.

The role works closely with Standard Chartered Relationship Managers and Insurance Specialists to build referral opportunities, identify eligible customers and support effective sales engagement. The Senior Health Insurance Specialist and the team engage directly with referred customers to understand their needs, explain the proposition, recommend appropriate cover and sell Bupa Global's individual international private medical insurance plans designed exclusively for the bank's priority private and affluent customers.

How you'll help us make health happen:

Own delivery of the Singapore Standard Chartered sales target, translating annual objectives into clear team plans, activity expectations and individual performance goals.
Recruit, onboard, lead, coach and develop a high-performing team of Health Insurance Specialists, setting clear expectations and fostering a customer-focused, compliant and accountable sales culture.
Conduct regular one-to-one meetings, coaching sessions and formal performance reviews, managing performance in line with Bupa's people policies and applicable training and competency requirements.
Manage the team's sales pipeline, referral activity, conversion, productivity and service levels; maintain accurate forecasts and provide timely, insightful sales and performance reporting.
Lead and support direct, needs-based customer sales conversations, particularly for complex or high-value cases, ensuring recommendations are appropriate, clearly explained and accurately documented.
Build strong working relationships with Standard Chartered Relationship Managers and Insurance Specialists to generate qualified referrals, improve customer engagement and increase conversion while maintaining clear roles and responsibilities in the sales process.
Oversee the end-to-end customer journey from referral, initial contact and fact-finding through quotation, application, underwriting, policy issuance and follow-up, working with internal teams to resolve issues promptly.
Ensure the team protects customer personal and medical information and complies with applicable Singapore data-protection requirements, Bupa policies and Standard Chartered information-handling requirements.
Maintain full compliance with applicable Singapore insurance licensing, conduct, disclosure, record-keeping and continuing competency requirements, and ensure consistently fair customer outcomes.
Collaborate closely with Bupa Global Sales Support, Underwriting, Operations, Compliance, Marketing and other relevant teams to progress cases, remove operational barriers and deliver a seamless customer and partner experience.
Assist the Head of Channel Sales on project-related work, including management updates, sales reporting and forecasting, sales initiatives and programmes, and sales engagement plans. Track actions, assess results and support effective implementation across the channel.

Key Skills/Qualifications needed for this role:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in business, finance, health insurance, or a related field (required).
Hold, or be able to obtain before appointment, all licences, certifications and competency requirements applicable to the sale of the relevant insurance products in Singapore.
Maintain all required continuing professional development, product knowledge and training and competency standards.
Fluency in English is essential; proficiency in Mandarin or another language relevant to Standard Chartered's Singapore customer base is advantageous.
Customer Centricity - Understands the needs of priority private and affluent customers and ensures the team delivers suitable solutions and consistently high-quality outcomes.
Product and Regulatory Knowledge - Good understanding of individual IPMI, underwriting considerations, product benefits, exclusions and the applicable sales and conduct framework.
Leadership and Communication - Sets clear direction, coaches effectively and communicates persuasively with customers, colleagues and partner stakeholders across different cultural contexts.
Sales Leadership and Execution - Translates targets into account plans and team activity, manages pipelines and forecasts, and applies consultative selling techniques to convert quality referrals into sustainable sales.
Partnership and Stakeholder Management - Builds trusted relationships with Standard Chartered and Bupa stakeholders, coordinates shared priorities and resolves issues constructively.
Delivery and Adaptability - Manages competing priorities, delivers projects and sales initiatives at pace, and adapts effectively within a dynamic bank-

Why Bupa?

Bupa Global is the international health insurance division of Bupa. We provide customers who want premium international coverage with products and services to access the healthcare they need anytime, around the world, whether at home or when studying, living, travelling or working abroad.

Bupa Global has offices around the world including London and Brighton (UK), Dublin (Europe), Miami (USA), Dubai (UAE, in partnership with Sukoon), Egypt and Hong Kong (China) as well as regional offices in mainland Singapore, the Dominican Republic, Bolivia, Panama, Guatemala and Ecuador.

Full time

Locations:

Singapore

description:

General Support

Act as a coordination point between the Singapore office and relevant regional or Malaysia-based support teams.
Support ad hoc projects, reporting and initiatives as assigned.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve administrative processes, ways of working and overall efficiency.

· Diploma or Degree in Business Administration, Sales, Management or a related field.

· At least 2–4 years of experience in sales administration, commercial support, office administration or a similar role.

· Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word.

· Experience with ERP, CRM or other business systems would be an advantage.

· Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders at different levels.

· A proactive, resourceful and hands-on approach to work.

Core Competencies:

• Self-starter. You are keen for new experience, responsibility and accountability. You are self-driven, problem-solver with a proven track record of delivering great results;

title: Ad Sales Planner
description:
Job Description
Job Requisition ID: 53533
Job Closing Date: 20/10/2026
Singapore, SGP, 79909

JOB DETAILS

Role: Ad Sales Planner

Contract Type: Permanent, Full-Time

Location: Singapore

Working Rights: Candidates must be legally authorised to work in Singapore without requiring visa sponsorship or work pass support.

WE ARE BBC STUDIOS

A globally renowned media company borne of the BBC. We make and distribute the world's most sought-after TV, audio and digital content.

Our ambition is to be the home of the most powerful, entertaining, and inspiring stories for people all around the world.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Ad Sales Planner is a critical member of the APAC Advertising Sales team, supporting revenue growth across BBC Studios' portfolio of television, digital, audio, sponsorship, branded content and audience solutions. Working closely with sales, clients, agencies and internal stakeholders, the role supports the full advertising sales cycle, from proposal development and campaign planning through to execution, reporting and post-campaign analysis.

The APAC region presents a significant growth opportunity through a dual-pronged strategy of expanding our base of premium television advertisers while accelerating growth across BBC Studios' evolving digital, audience, data and content marketing solutions. As a result, this role plays an important part in helping clients better understand and access BBC Studios' unique audiences, premium content environments and advertising capabilities.

The successful candidate will combine strong commercial acumen, attention to detail and client management skills with a passion for media, content, audience insights and advertising innovation. They will become a trusted partner to the sales team, supporting business growth while ensuring the highest standards of campaign execution and client service.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT

1. Commercial Sales Planning & Client Solutions (55%)

Support the APAC Advertising Sales team in developing strategic advertising solutions that drive revenue growth across television, digital, audio, sponsorship, branded content and audience-led opportunities.

Develop compelling media plans, presentations and commercial proposals in response to client and agency briefs.
Translate client marketing objectives into integrated advertising solutions leveraging BBC Studios' content, audience and platform capabilities.
Partner with Sales, Insights, StoryWorks and other internal stakeholders to deliver competitive and commercially effective recommendations.
Support proactive pitches and business development initiatives designed to grow revenue and expand advertiser relationships.
Identify opportunities to introduce clients to BBC Studios' growing suite of audience, data, content and digital advertising solutions.
Review inventory availability and recommend effective advertising, sponsorship and content-led opportunities.
Ensure proposals are commercially sound, accurately costed and aligned with sales objectives.
Support programmatic advertising opportunities and act as a point of contact for agency trading desks where required.
Assist in creating best-in-class sales material that positions BBC Studios as a premium advertising partner across APAC.
Act as a trusted commercial partner to the sales team, anticipating client needs and delivering responsive support throughout the sales process.
2. Campaign Management & Client Service Excellence (30%)

Manage the successful implementation, delivery and optimisation of campaigns while providing exceptional support to clients, agencies and internal stakeholders.

Coordinate campaign setup and execution with Ad Operations, StoryWorks, Compliance and other business functions.
Manage campaign bookings, insertion orders, sponsorship documentation and internal approval processes.
Liaise with clients and agencies to ensure all creative materials and campaign assets are received, approved and delivered on schedule.
Monitor campaign performance and identify optimisation opportunities to maximise campaign outcomes.
Provide timely communication and support throughout the campaign lifecycle.
Troubleshoot campaign delivery issues in partnership with operational teams and communicate resolutions to stakeholders.
Prepare campaign performance reports, transmission reports and post-campaign reviews.
Ensure campaigns are delivered in accordance with contractual commitments and client expectations.
Build strong day-to-day relationships with agencies, advertisers and regional sales representatives.
Act as a reliable first point of contact for campaign-related enquiries and operational support.
3. Commercial Reporting, Sales Operations & Business Support (15%)

Provide accurate reporting, financial coordination and operational support to enable effective decision-making and seamless commercial execution.

Prepare and distribute campaign performance reports, post-campaign analyses, transmission reports and revenue tracking updates.
Support the sales team with audience insights, market intelligence and competitor monitoring to strengthen client conversations and commercial outcomes.
Partner closely with Finance to support billing accuracy, invoice reconciliation, revenue recognition processes and client payment enquiries.
Coordinate client onboarding requirements and ensure all necessary commercial documentation, contracts and compliance processes are completed.
Maintain accurate information across CRM, booking, reporting and sales management systems.
Support regional business reporting requirements and sales administration processes.
Ensure consistency with BBC Studios' commercial policies, reporting standards and product messaging across APAC.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and sales effectiveness.
Success Measures

The Ad Sales Planner will be successful when they:

Deliver high-quality, strategic media plans that contribute to revenue growth across APAC.
Become a trusted commercial partner to the sales team and a valued contact for clients and agencies.
Contribute to the growth of both premium television advertising and emerging digital, audience and content-led revenue streams.
Maintain high standards of campaign delivery, reporting accuracy and client satisfaction.
Drive operational excellence through efficient processes, accurate forecasting and strong financial coordination.
Provide actionable insights that strengthen BBC Studios' commercial proposition and market position.
Support the achievement of regional revenue targets through outstanding planning, execution, campaign servicing and stakeholder management.
YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Essential

Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
Experience within a media owner, publisher, agency or advertising environment preferred.
Strong interest in media, advertising, content marketing and audience strategy.
Excellent organisational, administrative and project management skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Commercially minded with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Numerate and data-driven, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Ability to interpret campaign performance data and convert insights into actionable recommendations.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple teams and markets.
Self-starter with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.
Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment.
Fluent written and spoken English.

Desirable

Experience in digital advertising, broadcast advertising, audio advertising or programmatic media.
Understanding of media planning, campaign management or advertising operations.
Familiarity with audience measurement, analytics and reporting platforms.
Knowledge of branded content, sponsorship and content marketing solutions.
Experience working with CRM, ad-serving, booking or sales management systems.
Additional APAC language capabilities are advantageous.
Passion for media, technology and emerging advertising trends.

title: Talent Management & Development Intern
description:
LUXASIA is the leading and largest beauty omnichannel brand-builder of Asia Pacific. With LUXASIA, an exciting career filled with robust professional growth awaits you. Isn’t that beautiful?

Looking for an internship where you can do more than support from the sidelines?

As a Talent Management & Development Intern in the Talent & Excitement (HR) team, you will gain hands-on exposure to both Talent Management and Learning & Development, working on regional initiatives that reach employees across LUXASIA's markets in Asia Pacific.

Over six months, you will experience how talent and learning programmes come together from design and execution to measurement and improvement. Currently pursuing a Diploma or Degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, Organisational Behaviour or a related discipline.

Organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Comfortable with Canva, Excel and PowerPoint, and working with data.
A collaborative team player who works well with others.

Regional exposure through initiatives spanning multiple Asia Pacific markets.
End-to-end experience across both Talent Management and L&D, giving you a broader view of how organisations develop their people.
Real ownership and meaningful work, with opportunities to deliver projects you can see through from idea to outcome.
Practical experience in programme management, stakeholder engagement, people analytics and learning design.

If you are curious about people, passionate about learning and ready to turn ideas into action, this internship will give you the opportunity to learn by doing and make a meaningful contribution from day one.

Do you have what it takes to succeed in a fast-paced and intense environment? Do you thrive on challenges? Do you want to bring innovative ideas to life? Are you keen to abandon the status quo, try new things, embrace failures as lessons, recover fast, yet always pursue excellence?

If so, you are the one we are looking for. JOIN US and let’s grow together.

Function: Finance

Location: Singapore

Role: Permanent

Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst

The incumbent will provide financial planning and analysis support to the FP&A Manager across the Cluster markets (Australia, Thailand, and Singapore), playing a key role in the overall budgeting and planning cycle, alongside forecasting, performance reporting, and business analysis.

The position supports the preparation and consolidation of budgets across the markets, working with relevant stakeholders to ensure planning inputs and submissions are accurate, aligned, and timely. The role also provides variance analysis and contributes to practical improvements that enhance the efficiency, consistency, and data quality of budgeting processes.

Working closely with local business stakeholders, Entity Finance Controlling, Supply Planning, and other cross-functional teams, the incumbent will help collect and validate planning inputs, maintain accurate working files, and ensure timely and reliable submissions in line with Cluster, Regional, and Corporate requirements.

With demonstrated performance, growing business knowledge, and the required capabilities, the incumbent may progressively assume broader FP&A coordination and business-partnering responsibilities for a designated market within the Cluster.

As the FP&A Analyst, you will be responsible for:

Planning & Budgeting
- Support and coordinate annual budgeting, forecasting, and A&SP planning activities across the Cluster markets.
- Prepare and consolidate planning templates and working files, and coordinate with budget owners to collect and validate inputs.
- Maintain planning assumptions and supporting schedules, highlighting gaps or inconsistencies.
- Support TM1 / IBP / GPM uploads and timely submissions to Cluster, Regional, and Corporate FP&A.
- Contribute practical ideas and support the implementation of improvements to budgeting templates, workflows, and controls to enhance efficiency, consistency, and data quality.

Performance Reporting & Variance Analysis
- Prepare management reports and track actual performance against budget and forecast.
- Analyze key P&L variances, including OPEX and Marketing & Sales performance, and summarize business drivers for management review.
- Help identify performance gaps and track follow-up actions with relevant stakeholders.
- Assist with financial models and scenario analyses, including pricing and commercial simulations.

Business Partnering & Market Analysis
- Work with budget owners and cross-functional stakeholders to support budget reviews and provide relevant financial analysis.
- Develop an understanding of market performance and key business drivers to support business discussions and decision-making.
- As business knowledge, capability, and performance develop, progressively take on a broader scope of market-level analysis, stakeholder coordination, and business-partnering activities.

Closing & Financial Data Quality
- Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end activities in coordination with Entity Finance Controlling, Accounting, GBS, and business partners.
- Perform checks and reconciliations on management P&L data and investigate discrepancies.
- Help ensure accurate, complete, and timely reporting in relevant finance systems.

Systems, Master Data & Ad-hoc Analysis
- Coordinate with GBS on finance master-data requests, including product cost, profit and cost centers, transfer pricing, and PIR setup.
- Support cross-functional and global initiatives through ad-hoc analysis, simulations, and structured financial models.
- Perform other related tasks and projects as requested by the manager.

University degree or equivalent in Finance, Business, or Accounting
2 years experience in Financial Planning & Analysis or related position, preferably in international or FMCG environment is an advantage.

Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel; working knowledge of SAP or similar ERP systems is preferred.
Foundational understanding of budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and variance analysis.
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to organize financial data and communicate clear findings.
Ability to manage deadlines, learn business drivers, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
Demonstrates ownership, adaptability, curiosity, and a growth mindset.

The Regional Commercial Manager (Associate Director) Specialty Care/Immunology will report to the Regional Franchise Director Pharma and is the regional commercial owner and ambassador for assigned brand(s) within Specialty Care/Immunology across Asia Pacific. The role is responsible for shaping brand strategy, planning, market prioritization, forecasting, and lifecycle strategy while driving strong cross‑functional execution to help markets deliver business results.

As the regional commercial lead for Specialty Care/Immunology, the Regional Commercial Manager is a trusted commercial partner to market brand teams, global marketing colleagues, and regional cross-functional teams—bringing clarity, discipline, and momentum to strategy, execution, launch readiness, and ongoing performance.

The role requires strong strategic thinking, business judgment, analytical discipline, and cross-functional collaboration. The Regional Commercial Manager will translate market insights, competitive intelligence, access realities, customer needs, and financial assumptions into clear actionable brand plans, and high-quality business decisions within the context of Specialty Care/Immunology across Asia Pacific.

What will you do:

Brand Strategy Ownership

• Own and articulate the regional strategy for Specialty Care/Immunology and assigned brand(s), aligned to global direction and adapted for AP market realities.
• Serve as the regional ambassador and subject‑matter expert in the disease area, providing clear strategic direction to markets and feed into the Franchise strategy for the region.
• Define what is standard vs. localised across messaging, campaigns, and execution.
• Own the brand narrative and storytelling, translating strategy into clear, executable plans.

Regional–Global–Local Orchestration

• Act as the primary connector between global, regional, and local teams for Specialty Care/Immunology and assigned brand(s).
• Adapt global strategies and campaigns to ensure local relevance without strategic dilution or duplication.
• Ensure markets understand not justwhat to do, butwhy—making strategy practical and actionable.

Cross‑Functional Leadership Execution

• Mobilise and align cross‑functional teams (marketing, sales, access, medical, finance, policy, etc.).
• Drive executional excellence across launch preparation, brand activation, and lifecycle management.
• Navigate competing priorities while maintaining focus, alignment, and momentum.

Market Stakeholder Partnership

• Be a high‑value partner to markets, enabling BU Heads and their teams through clarity and support.
• Coaching markets in the deployment of company’s L3Next Framework developing market specific strategy driving brand and business performance.
• Build trust as a commercial thought partner, not a service/activity provider.

Commercial Leadership

• Demonstrate commercial and PL awareness for the assigned brand(s).
• Partner with the local commercial teams and escalate when appropriate and value‑adding.
• Solve problems pragmatically, balancing strategic intent with execution realities.

People Leadership and Capability Building

• Guide, coach, and support local marketers or project teams responsible for assigned brand and indication priorities.
• Create clarity on priorities, deliverables, timelines, decision points, and ways of working to ensure strong brand discipline and accountability.
• Support marketing capability building across brand planning, forecasting, opportunity assessment, competitive strategy, and cross-functional leadership.
• · Contribute to a collaborative, accountable, and inclusive team culture that enables high performance across regional and country teams.

What should you have:

• Minimum of 7 years marketing or commercial experience required. At least 3 years of marketing or commercial experience in Pharmaceuticals with digital and omni-channel experiences preferred.
• In-line marketing and / or commercial experience, including launch and LOE, coupled with strong understanding of or experience in market access, policy, digital, and value evidence generation in Specialty Care/Immunology
• Solid grounding in marketing excellence and structured commercial capabilities with the proven ability to develop strategy and translate it into execution.
• Strong curiosity and ability to apply AI in analysis, communication and execution
• Business and financial acumen, strong analytical ability.

Preferred

• Asia Pacific market experience.
• Strong storytelling and executive communication capability.
• Comfort operating with stakeholders at regional and global levels.

Who We Are
We are known as Merck Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have brought forward medicines and vaccines for many of the worlds most challenging diseases.

What We Look For
We are looking for a leader who combines strategic thinking, operational discipline, and clear, compelling communication. If you bring intellectual rigor, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to convert ideas into measurable outcomes across a complex matrix, we invite you to help shape how Asia Pacific turns strategy into sustained performance and patient impact.

title: Practice Manager (Clinic Operations and Services)
description:
Our team is growing in Singapore!

The Practice Manager (Clinic Operations & Services) manages the clinic and ensure the highest quality of veterinary care, exceptional client service, associate engagement and maximum productivity of the veterinary medical team. S/he partners with Lead Veterinarian and Field Leadership to operate an effective and productive clinic team, ensures a safe and engaging clinic environment, and improve both the medical quality and business performance of the clinic.

Live and exemplify the Five Principles of Mars, Inc. within self and team.

Partner with the Lead Veterinarian to manage the clinic/s as role models and champions of the brand to provide consistent high-quality care and exceptional service to the most pets and clients and to maximize efficiency, productivity and profitability. Train the team on guidelines and practices; supervise associates to ensure compliance.

Regularly supervise the team of paraprofessionals in the clinic, consisting of at least two associates and often more (the size of the paraprofessional team will vary by clinic/s depending on factors such as business volume and client needs).

Oversee and train associates on professional, efficient and exceptional client service (lead by example), to include client education, preventive care, pet health needs, clinic services, marketing campaigns, and other related information; effectively resolve client issues.

Follow all protocols and practices and be responsible for ensuring that associates achieve practice priorities while building our culture and brand.

Identify potential “bottlenecks” and formulate solutions to remove barriers in medical operations that would impede doctors from providing world class care.

Partner with the Field Leadership to interview, select, train, develop, coach, mentor and, if necessary, discipline and separate paraprofessional associate.

Direct, lead and mentor the paraprofessional team to realize their full professional potential and deliver outstanding, high-quality medical care, client service and business results.

Work with the Field Leadership to establish development plans (PDPs) for the paraprofessionals and focus teams to deliver practice priorities and exceed goals while building our culture and brand.

Conduct frequent development discussions with paraprofessionals to construct compelling development plans and execute them.

Effectively create and maintain paraprofessional schedules and work with Lead Veterinarian to schedule associates to meet client needs according to guidelines, while proactively planning time off and Continuing Education (CE) scheduling.

Provide effective communication between associates, clients, field leadership and regional support team.

Act as communications liaison, including holding routine clinic team meetings, sharing business information and messaging to all clinic associates, ensuring they remain informed, engaged and have opportunities to provide feedback.

Provide inspirational leadership to the team by creating a positive professional relationship with clients, field leadership and regional support team.

Create a collaborative environment and develop an efficient, productive clinic team that provides the highest quality care and service to the most pets and clients.

Develop annual planning, budgeting and clinic productivity levels for the clinic/s in partnership with the Field Leaders, Medical Operations and Central Support team.

Partner with area Field Leadership to execute market objectives, goals, strategies and measurements (OGSMs).

Participate in market level team discussions, and initiatives.

Partner with the Field Leadership to deliver outstanding financial results for assigned clinic/s.

Manage and drive consistent revenue growth and profitability improvements in the clinic/s. Monitor all financial and operational metrics ensuring deviations from plan are addressed timely and appropriately.

Manage daily operations of clinic/s to deliver consistent performance in market penetration and client and associate retention. Manage overall labour costs while ensuring appropriate scheduling / staffing during all operating hours.

Use proven methods to promote clinic/s and practice growth.

Responsible for cost containment, cash control/banking, loss prevention, office and medical supply ordering, and inventory management, maintaining acceptable Clinic Audit scores.

Responsible with Field Leadership to develop a stable, trained and technically competent paraprofessional team.

Responsible for ensuring all associates adhere to dress and grooming guidelines.

Provide leadership to other area clinics as needed throughout the market.

Ensure compliance with all practice policies and procedures and with Singapore laws.

Other assigned duties.

Who are you?

Bachelor’s degree in business or related discipline is preferred, or the equivalent combination of education, training and experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities.

Three years related experience required (health care, veterinary profession, service industry, etc.), including direct supervisory experience (includes hiring, associate development, etc.)

Clinic experience and/or previous experience as a Practice Manager in veterinary medicine or human healthcare preferred.

Independent, self-motivated, capable to meet tight timelines.

Attention to details and accuracy with strong sense of urgency.

Ability to handle multi-tasks and respond effectively to ad-hoc requests.

Strong stakeholder management skills, interpersonal and communication skills.

Connect with MVHAsiaTalent@effem.com for a confidential conversation. Thank you for your interest in our vacancy, shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Singapore Veterinary Health comprise of Brighton Vet Care, Gentle Oak Veterinary Clinic, Hillside Veterinary Surgery, Pets Avenue Veterinary Clinic, The Animal Doctors and VES Hospital.

title: Regional Product Marketing Manager (TV / AV / Monitor)
description:
Job Description Summary

As the Regional Product Marketing Manager, you will drive the Monitor business across Southeast Asia and Oceania (SEAO),translating HQ strategy into regional priorities and market-level action plans that drive sustainable revenue, profitability and market share growth.

You will be part of the TV/AV/Monitor Product Marketing Center of Excellence (CoE), working closely with Samsung’s HQ in South Korea, country subsidiaries and cross-functional teams across the Regional HQ. The role combines business strategy, performance management, product portfolio and pricing strategy, go-to-market planning and product marketing capability development across markets.

Your primary focus will be the Monitor business,covering Gaming, Office/General Use and Smart Monitors. Depending on business needs and your experience, the scope may also expand over time to include Sound Devices such as Soundbars, Party Audio and Wi-Fi Speakers.

Key Responsibilities:

As part of the TV / AV / Monitor Product Marketing COE, you will own the regional Monitor business across eight markets and report to the TV / AV / Monitor Product Marketing Head.

Regional Business Strategy

Translate HQ TV/AV/Monitor strategy, product direction and priorities into clear regional strategies and market-level action plans.

Develop a strong understanding of assigned markets, analyzing market trends, competitors and business performance to identify growth opportunities and gaps by country.

Develop and drive regional growth initiatives and strategic projects, with clear objectives and measurable business impact.

Business Performance Management

Analyze regional and market performance across key metrics including sales, market share, profitability and product mix, and provide regular updates to management.

Review country business plans, identify performance gaps and root causes, and work with local teams to develop and track corrective and recovery actions.

Monitor sell-in, sell-out, inventory, weeks of supply and aging to identify demand and stock risks early and drive appropriate actions.

Product Portfolio &Pricing Strategy

Optimize the regional Monitor portfolio and price-band architecture to strengthen market coverage, competitiveness and profitability.

Consolidate market requirements and provide HQ with regional input on product line-up, specifications, positioning and market needs.

Define regional pricing and promotional guardrails while allowing appropriate adaptation to local market conditions.

Go-to-Market Planning

Define regional GTM direction for key product launches, priority growth segments and strategic campaigns, with a particular focus on the Monitor business.

Review local launch plans, challenge assumptions, provide feedback and track execution across key launch indicators such as sales ramp-up, awareness and in-store/display execution.

Develop regional promotions and product bundles, and analyze promotional ROI to assess business impact.

Product MarketingCapability Development

Identify high-performing market initiatives and global best practices, and develop playbooks and toolkits to scale effective approaches across the region.

Build common PM tools, templates, dashboards and analytical approaches to improve consistency, efficiency and decision-making.

Leverage automation and AI tools to streamline recurring reporting and analysis.

Strengthen country PM capabilities through business reviews, coaching, shared standards and capability-building initiatives.

Skills and Qualifications:

Bachelor’sdegree required; postgraduate qualifications such as an MA or MBA arepreferred.

8+years of relevant experience in Product Marketing, Product Management,Commercial Strategy or a related function within consumer electronics,technology or device businesses.

Strongcommercial and strategic thinking, with the ability to translate businessobjectives into practical plans and measurable actions.

Stronganalytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify rootcauses and translate data into actionable insights.

Stronginterpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence andcollaborate effectively with senior stakeholders, country teams andcross-functional partners.

Proactive,practical and results-oriented approach, with the ability to manage multiplepriorities in a fast-paced regional environment.

Comfortable leveraging AI and digital tools to improve analysis, reporting and ways of working.

Product Marketing experience in the Monitor business, particularly Gaming Monitors, is highly preferred.

Regional or subsidiary Product Marketing experience within Consumer Electronics, particularly across SEAO markets is an advantage

Samsung Electronics is a global leader in technology, opening new possibilities for people everywhere. Through relentless innovation and discovery, we are transforming the worlds of smartphones, TVs, wearable devices, tablets, digital appliances, network systems, medical devices, semiconductors, LED solutions and Internet of Things.

We have grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, and become recognized as one of the top 10 global brands. Our network now extends across the world, and Samsung takes great pride in the creativity and diversity of its talented people who drive our growth.

In the diverse and vibrant Southeast Asia and Oceania region, our offices are present in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Myanmar, Cambodia, Laos, Philippines, Vietnam, Australia and New Zealand. We support the digital ambitions of the region by working closely with local partners as part of our commitment to give back to the communities we operate in.

Visit www.samsung.com to learn more about our business, and www.samsung.com/careers to learn more about career opportunities. Join us as we Reimagine Your Future.

title: Assistant PR Manager
description:
Join the Bacha Coffee team

Great ideas start with coffee, Bacha Coffee starts with you. We are headquartered in Singapore with coffee rooms and boutiques in Europe and Asia currently. We are expanding aggressively to achieve a worldwide presence in the upcoming months...

Bacha Coffee specialises in 100% Arabica coffees and provides customers with a unique opportunity to travel the world through their cup by exploring harvests from over 30 of the most well-reputed coffee producing countries. Even our distinctive fine blended, fine-flavoured and naturally decaffeinated coffees are produced using only 100% Arabica beans to give coffee lovers the widest choice, without ever sacrificing quality or flavour.

The qualities that have made Bacha Coffee a legendary brand around the world also make us a great place to work: innovation, creativity, passion, and excellence.

Job Summary

Responsible for planning and implementing Bacha Coffee’s global public relations strategies and activities while ensuring consistency in brand messaging across relevant markets. This role is responsible for the development and implementation of support materials and management of PR agencies internationally, as well as coordinating strategically with the other departments and stakeholders within the company and the brand.

Primary Relationships

The position reports directly to the Public Relations Manager.

Within the organisation, this position has primary working relationships with the other members of the Corporate Communication Department, other HQ Departments and overseas partners.

Outside the organization, the position coordinates primarily with PR agencies, business partners and the media.

Responsibilities

Create and execute global Public Relations strategy that align with the brand developments, priorities and announcements

Familiarising with the brand DNA, heritage and offerings, while embodying the brand ethos. Support other departments, partners and stakeholders in ensuring that all external-facing communication is on-brand and Bacha Coffee’s desired image and positioning is consistently and accurately articulated

Support Public Relations Manager to guide overseas partners (both subsidiaries and franchises) for the management of their local media relations and vet their suggested press releases, PR campaigns, etc. across all markets globally

Write and proofread communication materials i.e., press releases, responses for media queries and interviews, boilerplates, management biographies, fact sheets, media kits, etc.

Elevating brand presence and positioning the brand accurately in local and global media sphere through media related activities such as media liaison, gifting, events and hostings, overseas media trips, etc.

Coordinating internally with other departments on all Public Relations matters including the creation of Public Relations materials and assets

Working with Bacha Coffee subsidiaries, franchises and distributors to ensure implementation of brand and editorial guidelines and directives

Effectively manage issues and crises in collaboration with Public Relations teams and Public Relations agencies in Singapore and overseas

Ensuring that proper archives of global media clippings are maintained and regularly updating Public Relations reporting standards

Regularly monitoring trends and informing management of developments in luxury, retail and F&B industries

Maintaining Bacha Coffee media databases and periodically revising and refreshing media outreach to constantly remain current

Qualifications

Required:

Minimum of 5 years’ experience in communications or public relations with demonstrated success, preferably in the luxury retail sector

Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, marketing, or public relations preferred

Past experience working in a Public Relations agency or managing international Public Relations agencies preferred

Past experience practising Public Relations for a luxury brand preferred

Past experience dealing with international markets/stakeholders and media being responsible for a global or regional scope

Applicants must be fluent in written and spoken English and have excellent writing and proofreading skills.

A second or third language would be an advantage, as it would support effective communication with our diverse franchise partners

Other:

Strong creative, strategic, analytical, organizational and personal skills

Demonstrated successful experience writing press releases, pitching and hosting media

Computer literacy in word processing, data base management and page layout

Commitment to working in cross-functional teams

Very strong oral and written communication skills

Ability to manage multiple projects at a time

Out-of-town, overnight travel might be required from time to time (less than 10%)

Bacha Coffee is an equal opportunity employer. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

The story of Bacha Coffee begins in the medina of Marrakech, Morocco. Built in 1910, the spectacular Dar el Bacha palace, which means “house of the Pasha”, united the greatest cultural and political minds of the century over glittering pots of “coffee of Arabia” or Arabica, as it is known today. Being the finest luxury coffee brand in the world, Bacha Coffee specialises in 100% Arabica coffees and provides customers with a unique opportunity to travel the world through their cup by exploring harvests from over 30 of the most well-reputed coffee producing countries. Even our distinctive fine blended, fine flavoured and naturally decaffeinated coffees are produced using only 100% Arabica beans to give coffee lovers the widest choice, without ever sacrificing quality or flavour.

title: Account Executive
description:
Job Description
Posting Start Date: 15/10/2026
Brand: MCI
Country/Region: Singapore
Work Location: Singapore
Workplace Type: Hybrid
Contract type: Permanent
Job Function: Account Management
Information at a Glance

We are a global engagement marketing agency that creates human-centric touchpoints that unleash the power of people to deliver innovation and growth. Firm believers in the power of building community since 1987, we are helping brands, associations and not-for-profit organisations solve their key people challenges through our core expertise: Live & virtual events, Strategic & digital communications and Consulting & community solutions. We are an independently owned agency, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, with a global presence of 60 offices in 31 countries.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At MCI, we believe great experiences start with great people, bold ideas, and strong collaboration. As an Account Executive, you will be an integral part of the team, working closely with Account Managers and colleagues to bring exciting brand experiences, events, and marketing campaigns to life.

From supporting new business pitches and developing creative ideas to sourcing suppliers, preparing costings, and servicing client accounts, you will be involved in the action from day one. This is an opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow while playing a meaningful role in delivering impactful experiences for our clients.

THE WORK

1. Support Pitches & New Business Development

Work closely with Account Managers and the wider team to develop compelling pitch proposals and presentations.
Contribute ideas, research trends, explore creative concepts, and help turn client briefs into engaging event and marketing experiences.
Research venues, suppliers, entertainment, activities, and other event elements to support creative recommendations.
Source quotations, develop cost estimates, compare supplier options, and support budget preparation to ensure ideas are both exciting and commercially viable.
Assist in preparing pitch decks, proposals, and supporting materials that bring our ideas to life and help us win new business.

2. Support Account Servicing & Client Relationships

Work alongside Account Managers to support the day-to-day servicing of client accounts, ensuring projects and requests are managed efficiently.
Assist in understanding client briefs, coordinating internal teams, and following up on project deliverables.
Prepare meeting materials, project updates, reports, timelines, and other account documentation.
Build positive working relationships with clients, suppliers, and internal stakeholders through clear communication and a collaborative approach.
Stay curious about our clients’ businesses, brands, and objectives, and look for opportunities to contribute ideas that add value.

THE CONNECTION

Reports To

Account Manager (for daily activities)

Works Closely With

Sales Team (Local and Regional), Operation Team / Project Managers, Sales Support and other Product Practices within MCI.

THE MUST HAVE

This role is suitable for well-rounded individuals with business, hospitality, or a marketing degree.
1 – 3 years of experience in the meetings and events and/or hotel and hospitality industry would be an advantage.
1 – 3 years of experience in the account management or account servicing role would be an advantage.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office and presentation development, are essential.
Great customer mindset, proactive disposition with strong negotiation and problem-solving skills.
Result driven personality with energy, commitment and a strong drive to succeed.

THE GOOD TO HAVE

Adaptable and solution oriented, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
Strong sense of ownership, responsibility, and attention to detail
Willingness to travel and support onsite delivery when required

ADDITIONAL LOCAL BENEFITS

Birthday Leave
Employer-paid Business Travel Insurance, unlimited Whitecoat tele consults, Dental & Vision reimbursements
Employer-paid Group Hospital & Surgical, Outpatient Clinical, Outpatient Specialist & Personal Accident Insurance
Comprehensive internal Learning & Development portal and opportunities for external courses

MCI is where you can bring your true self to work and be proud of what you do. Join us and make a difference!

title: Retail Manager, Travel Retail SEA
description:
Company Description

CONTEXT

TR Guerlain SEA team, based in Singapore is supporting the business for the region.

Job Description

ROLE

The Retail Manager is to be Retail Expert responsible for collaborating with the Commercial team and the local operators to manage day to day airports, shop-in-shops and boutique businesses in TR environment. This person is responsible optimizing the business, expediting, and identifying opportunities. They are the liaison accountable for ensuring achievement of sales targets, driving replication and consistency (brand image and service level) across the business identifying opportunities, and providing on-going support for Commercial teams, local operators and in-store staff. The RM is responsible for the co-management of a team of sales ambassadors and will guide the professional development of the sales ambassadors. Successful candidate will deliver Retail Excellence by driving a complete O2O consumer experience that will amplify The GUERLAIN brand; hence, setting a benchmark in the luxury sector brand across TR.

As an ambassador for our Maison, you represent and transmit Guerlain's values to your customers and employees. You will oversee the achievement of sales objectives, the excellence of our customer service and the implementation of the strategy set by the Management. You ensure the management, training and development of your employees and put the customer relationship and experience at the heart of all your actions.

MAIN TASKS

GUERLAIN IS THE PARISIAN ALCHEMIST THAT PURSUES AN INFINITE QUEST FOR WONDER OF SENSES AND CRAFTS ARTISTIC BEAUTY FROM NATURE, SINCE 1828.

ELEVATE GUERLAIN AS THE MOST HIGH-END FRENCH & PARISIAN 3-AXIS BEAUTY BRAND

A UNIQUE JEWEL IN THE BEAUTY WORLD by Building image, desirability & premiumness.

GROW & DRIVE THE BUSINESS: DELIVER CONSISTENT SALES AND PROFIT GROWTH:

Ensure achievement of the Airport Stores & Boutique sales and targets from daily to monthly basis and of corporate objectives,

Set, drive and follow up on individual and collective sales objectives, on daily, weekly and monthly basis.

Maximize sales potential through business analyses

Use business tools such as: Sell out reports, Power BI, operator’s POS systems along with personal insight to maximize understanding and improve results

Recommend solutions to identify opportunities taking into consideration cross-functional interdependencies, and cultural complexities

Create an understanding of the consumer through spending time in stores, reinforcing the use of Retail Operations provided training tools, and personally demonstrating how to foster a consumer centric culture

Ensure realization of the following administrative tasks: stock management (at store level) planogram check in support of merchandising team, Novelties & promotional plan communication and briefing

Influence and optimize shift planning of the team

Advise on an incentive plan (focusing on products and mechanisms) or action plans that will help achieve precise objectives

Collaborate with Cross-functional teams to determine business opportunities

Able to adapt to the different ways of working with multiple operators in the Market

Provide inputs on expansion plans opportunities (i.e. retail spaces)

CAPABILITY: DRIVE OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE:

Ensure commercial viability of the product assortment – do we have the right product in the right store?

Ensure appropriate inventory levels per airport stores, shop-in-shop and boutique

Recognize inventory opportunities in store and elevate issues to Commercial team and local operators

Understand the inventory cycle to identify opportunities to improve or sustain optimal performance with inventory levels, inventory availability in-store, transit times, and store allocation

Conduct market research in island to identify key competitors’, and different consumer influences (regionally). Recap findings for Cross Functional team in TR regional team and his/her own region team

Support Commercial, Retail and Marketing team in new store opening execution of stores

Escalate critical issues impacting performance and work with the Commercial team and Head of Retail Operations to eliminate obstacles, expedite issue resolution, and ensure operational execution and financial goals are achieved

TALENT MANAGEMENT – DEMONSTRATE LEADERSHIP:

Participate in talent recruitment, including field complements, pay structures, incentive programs, management and retention strategies in collaboration with the training team and local operators

Responsible for the sales ambassadors’ management and daily briefing. His or her daily physical presence in the field is a necessary part of these responsibilities

title: Account Executive, Japan & Korea
description:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the next-generation commodity trading platform.

We give trading desks the clarity, control, and collaboration they need to move faster and trade smarter.

In February 2025, we secured $42 million in Series B funding. Now we’re scaling up across the business, and it’s an exciting time to join.

Our people are the driving force behind everything we do. At Sparta, you’ll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. You’ll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow. Because building something this ambitious takes everyone at their best.

At Sparta, your work has reach. From improving our platform, to powering smarter decisions for our customers, to changing how commodity trading is done around the world.

And because we’re growing fast, you won’t just build your career. You’ll accelerate it, with a level of ownership and impact you simply don’t get at bigger, more bureaucratic companies.

The Role

This is a new-logo hunter role with an account development edge. Based in Singapore, you will own Sparta’s Japanese and Korean territory: building pipeline from scratch, getting in front of trading desks in person, and closing complex, multi-product deals. Roughly 70% of your time goes to winning new logos and 30% to growing and supporting the clients you bring in.

Japan is the immediate priority, with Korea following as the territory matures. Many of the desks you sell to sit in Singapore, but sometimes the budget, the mandate and the long-term relationship often sit with headquarters in Tokyo or Seoul. You will work both, building credibility locally and sponsorship at HQ.

You will sell to C-suite and VP-level buyers while winning over the traders, analysts and risk managers who will use the product and know their market cold.

You will have pre-sales and Customer Success behind you, and an Asia Pacific team growing quickly.

You will work from our Singapore office 4 days a week.

What You Will Be Doing

New Business

• Research opportunities, initiate discussions, build prospect relationships, run demos, manage product trials and close deals across Japanese and Korean energy commodity firms.

• Develop a pipeline of high-value opportunities through networking, events and in-person interaction with traders and decision-makers in Singapore and HQ.

• Sell to C-suite, VP-level and trading desks, articulating a clear business case and ROI for our SaaS solutions.

• Build relationships with headquarters stakeholders so that regional wins convert into group-level commitments.

Account Development and Expansion

• Grow the clients you win: expand usage across desks, verticals and products, and build the internal advocacy that turns a first deal into a multi-year relationship.

• Work with Customer Success to protect renewals and spot expansion signals early.

• Act as the commercial point of contact your clients trust, and bring their market feedback back into the business.

Enterprise Sales Execution

• Lead a virtual account team, coordinating with internal resources across pre-sales, customer success and marketing to drive deals forward.

• Use value-selling methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger and SPIN to align solutions with customer pain points and strategic initiatives.

• Structure and negotiate complex, multi-product deals tailored to customer needs.

Forecasting and Pipeline Management

• Maintain accurate sales forecasts, using HubSpot and sales analytics tools to manage deal progression and pipeline health.

• Track sales KPIs and continually refine sales tactics to improve conversion rates and shorten deal cycles.

About You

• 5+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, preference selling into commodities or energy markets.

• Business-level fluency in Japanese or Korean, in addition to English. This is required because most stakeholders will be Japanese and Koreans and prefer this as their working language

• Proven track record of hunting and closing complex, high-value deals, and hitting six- or seven-figure annual revenue targets.

• Able to build pipeline across a set territory from scratch: identifying the right opportunities, getting access to senior decision-makers, and building the internal advocacy that enterprise deals need.

• Comfortable running product demonstrations and navigating long sales cycles with multiple business and technical stakeholders.

• Strong knowledge of value-based selling frameworks such as MEDDPICC, Challenger and SPIN, and able to run a consultative sales motion.

• Experience orchestrating a cross-functional virtual team across pre-sales, customer success, marketing and executive sponsors.

• Based in Singapore, in the office 4 days a week, and happy to travel frequently for customer meetings and industry events across Asia Pacific. This is a face-to-face, relationship-driven role.

Nice to Have

• Prior exposure to energy and commodity markets, particularly refining, petrochemicals, shipping or trading houses.

• Experience selling financial data platforms, analytics software or SaaS solutions directly to traders, analysts, quants or risk managers.

• An existing network across Japanese or Korean trading houses, refiners, utilities or shipping firms.

• Experience selling for a scale-up or challenger brand, where the name does not open the door for you.

• Familiarity with HubSpot and Claude.

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced and impact is rewarded.

• $42M in Series B funding, with strong market traction and investment.

• Early-stage growth, so you build your career as we scale.

• Market-leading product that is redefining energy trading intelligence.

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success.

You will collaborate with like-minded people who are passionate about our mission and deeply committed to crafting outstanding products and achieving success for our customers.

Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law.

title: Associate Director of Quality
description:
The Associate Director of Quality is a senior leadership role within the AMS Quality & Technical Team, responsible for the end-to-end quality framework across Vita Coco's Singapore operations. This role leads a multi-functional team spanning Brand Quality, Operations-facing Quality, and the Quality Laboratory, ensuring that quality standards are embedded across the full value chain — from supplier to consumer.

The role serves as the primary Quality interface between the Singapore site and global Quality leadership at US headquarters, translating corporate strategy into locally actionable plans while representing the realities of local operations in global forums. The Associate Director of Quality plays a critical role in driving a culture of quality, food safety, and continuous improvement across the organization.

Key accountabilities include:

Strategic Leadership & HQ Alignment

Serve as the primary Quality liaison between Singapore operations and global Quality leadership, ensuring corporate strategy is translated into locally actionable priorities.

Represent local operational realities and constraints in global Quality forums and contribute to the development and review of global Quality policies.

Champion a culture of quality and food safety across the Singapore Site & Manufacturing network, setting the standard for quality performance at all levels.

Proactively drive alignment across markets to standardize working methods and ensure consistency across the business.

Support all new product launches from a quality framework perspective, as required.

People & Team Leadership

Lead, develop and inspire a multi-functional Quality team spanning Brand Quality, Operations-facing Quality and the Quality Laboratory.

Set clear objectives, KPIs and development plans for direct and indirect reports.

Build team capability through coaching, training and structured development programs.

Manage team resourcing, workload prioritization and succession planning.

Foster collaboration and clear ownership across Corporate Quality, Operations Quality and Laboratory functions.

Corporate & Regulatory Quality

Supports the implementation of the QMS system once identified.

Ensure compliance with relevant local regulatory requirements (e.g. SFA) as well as international standards (FSSC 22000, BRC, ISO 22000, etc.).

Leads as needed various regulatory inspections and customer or third-party audits.

Manage document control, SOPs and quality records governance.

Drive CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) processes across quality incidents.

Oversee supplier and vendor quality assurance programs, including qualification and ongoing performance monitoring.

Create and maintain a framework supporting smart data analysis, including product integrity monitoring, shelf-life testing and other key data streams.

Operations & Factory-Facing Quality

Ensure robust quality controls are embedded throughout the manufacturing process, from raw material intake to finished goods.

Lead internal and external audit programs as needed.

Lead and support the supplier audit network, maintaining and developing audit capability across the supply base.

Partner closely with Operations, Supply Chain and R&D to resolve quality issues impacting production and supply chain continuity.

Monitor and analyze production quality data, driving root cause analysis for non-conformances.

Oversee new product and process qualifications from a quality standpoint.

Maintain strong relationships with the supply chain team, supplier network and internal stakeholders.

Laboratory Oversight

Provide senior oversight of the Quality Laboratory, ensuring it operates within a clear framework aligned with business and Quality objectives.

Act as the organizational buffer for the laboratory, ensuring incoming requests from across the business are appropriately filtered and prioritized before reaching the team.

Own senior-level cross-functional relationships on behalf of the lab, ensuring structured and well-managed engagement with key stakeholder functions.

Represent the laboratory at leadership level, advocating for the resources, investment and support needed for it to perform effectively.

Ensure the laboratory maintains its regulatory and accreditation standing, escalating quality risks with broader business implications as needed.

Consumer & Brand Protection

Oversee the consumer complaints management process, ensuring timely investigation and resolution.

Lead and coordinate product recall and withdrawal procedures if required.

Monitor quality performance metrics and trends to proactively identify and mitigate brand risk.

Partner with Marketing and Commercial teams to protect brand integrity and consumer trust.

Reporting, Data & Governance

Define and track Quality KPIs across Corporate, Operations and Laboratory functions.

Prepare and present regular Quality performance reports to local senior leadership and US HQ.

Ensure Quality risks and escalations are communicated proactively to relevant stakeholders.

Lead the local Quality Management Review process.

Maintain awareness of emerging food safety trends, regulatory changes and industry best practices relevant to Singapore and the broader region.

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Food Science, Food Technology, Microbiology, Chemistry or a related scientific discipline; Master’s degree would be beneficial.

Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in Quality within the food and beverage industry, with at least 2-4 years in a senior leadership role.

Strong written and communication skills.

Experience with low-acid aseptic Tetra Pak processing is required; experience with retorted cans and aseptic PET is a strong advantage.

Proven track record managing multi-functional Quality teams, including both corporate and operations-facing functions.

Strong working knowledge of food safety standards and frameworks (HACCP, FSSC 22000, BRC, ISO 22000).

Familiarity with laboratory operations and accreditation requirements (ISO/IEC 17025 advantageous).

Experience working within a multinational organization and interfacing with regional or global headquarters.

Solid understanding of local regulatory requirements (SFA and relevant Singapore food safety legislation).

Proficiency in Quality Management Systems (QMS) and data-driven decision making.

Willingness to travel internationally and to work extended hours during critical periods as needed.

Personal Characteristics

Natural leader who leads by example and earns trust at all levels of the organization.

Collaborative and relationship-driven, able to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Strong analytical mindset with sharp attention to detail, without losing sight of the bigger picture.

Pragmatic and calm under pressure, able to navigate ambiguity and manage competing priorities without compromising standards.

High degree of personal accountability and integrity.

Comfortable operating in a matrix environment, balancing local operational needs with global strategic direction.

Curious and growth-oriented, keeping pace with industry trends, emerging regulations and best practices.

Understands the dynamics of an entrepreneurial, high-growth business and brings the energy and results-orientation to thrive in it.

Vita Coco, the leading coconut water brand, launched in 2004 when two friends, Michael Kirban and Ira Liran learned about the tropical elixir after a chance encounter at a New York City bar. Not only did their discovery bring coconut water into the mainstream beverage aisle, it rebranded coconut water as a premium lifestyle drink and helped propel the trend of natural-functional beverages. Fast forward 18 years, and Vita Coco is available in 30+ countries and has expanded coconut water into new occasions with innovations like Vita Coco Sparkling, Pressed, Coconutmilk, and Coconut Oil.

title: Marketing & Digital Growth Specialist
description:
About the company

If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.

Job description

We are seeking an operational, highly adaptable Marketing & Digital Growth Specialist to serve as the direct support to the Marketing Manager.

This role is designed to bridge traditional on-the-ground marketing operations with full-stack digital performance execution. You will be responsible for managing day-to-day sales enablement, event execution, vendor logistics & field media capture, while simultaneously owning performance ad management (Meta/Google), e-commerce storefront optimization (Shopify/Shopee/Lazada/TikTok) & lifecycle marketing (Klaviyo/WhatsApp). Furthermore, you will support regional marketing rollouts & localization efforts as we expand across Southeast Asia & target Greater China markets.

Key Responsibilities:

Digital Marketing, Creative Strategy & Performance Media

Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google):

Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Ads & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces

Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries

Full-Funnel Creative Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific formats (e.g., Meta carousel ads, Meta/TikTok Reels, Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banners)

A/B Testing & Optimization: Formulate hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, CTAs, visual styles, copy length) & run A/B tests to systematically improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
