Media Budget Optimization: Manage ad spend budgets effectively, scaling winning creatives & optimise underperforming ads based on real-time ROAS & Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) data

Content Production

Performance Creative Development: Lead end-to-end creative production for organic & paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube) with a focus on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing

Video & Static Creation: Produce & edit native social content, including UGC-style video, product demos & testimonials using tools like CapCut or Premiere Pro, as well as static ad variations & storefront banners

Copywriting: Write high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social captions that align with brand voice & healthcare regulatory requirements

Generative AI Integration: Utilize AI tools & prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video & image assets for testing cycles

E-Commerce & Social Media Account Ownership

E-Commerce Storefront Custodian: Maintain & integrate winning creative messages across official storefronts on Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok Shop (product pages, banners) to maximize conversion rates

Social Accounts Ownership & Community Management: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for official accounts on Meta (FB/IG) & TikTok. Ensure profiles feature updated bios, Linktree/Shopify integrations & highlighted stories

Content Programming & Scheduling: Maintain a consistent content calendar balancing educational, lifestyle & promotional posts

Active Social Listening & UGC Mining: Monitor comments & DMs to identify customer pain points for new content hooks & curate customer testimonials to deploy as high-converting growth assets

CRM, Lifecycle Marketing & Retention

EDM & E-Newsletter Strategy: Develop & execute a high-frequency newsletter calendar via Klaviyo, including educational insights & promotional product-launch/seasonal campaigns

Automated Flow Management: Design & execute end-to-end email & WhatsApp automation (e.g., Welcome series, Post-Purchase care, Win-back flows & Replenishment Reminders)

Subscription & Loyalty Optimization: Craft compelling creative & copy for subscription programs, optimizing triggers to reduce churn, increase Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & grow Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)

WhatsApp Marketing: Integrate direct-to-consumer WhatsApp communication for personalized consultations, loyalty rewards & rapid promotions

Day-to-Day Marketing Operations & Brand Execution

Execute Business & Marketing Initiatives: Execute effective marketing & business development initiatives tailored to each health supplement brand to increase market share, achieve revenue & reach profitability targets in line with overall business objectives

Budget & Spend Monitoring: Track & monitor marketing budget allocations, campaign expenditures, purchase orders (POs) & invoices to ensure optimal ROI, resource allocation, & strict adherence to financial targets

Marketing Collateral Development: Manage the end-to-end production of printed & digital collaterals (e.g., product packaging, brochures, POSM displays & email newsletters), liaising with print vendors & briefing internal design teams

Marketing Collaterals Inventory Management: Monitor & maintain inventory levels of promotional materials, product samples & event displays to support ongoing on-ground campaigns.

Field Media Capture & Event Execution

Medical Conferences & Sponsorships: Lead on-the-ground setup, booth operations & logistics for major medical association conventions & trade events (e.g., Singapore Orthopaedic Association - SOA, Malaysian Orthopaedic Association - MOA)

CME Workshop Coordination: Support Continuing Medical Education (CME) seminars for healthcare professionals—managing attendee invites, venue logistics, collateral preparation & post-event survey collation

On-Site Media Capture: Direct & capture raw video footage & photos during events, social media content creation & patient/doctor testimonial shoots using mobile/camera gear

Digital Handoff & Asset Tagging: Organize raw media assets, write clear creative briefs & storyboards & transfer files to internal design teams (for video editing/graphics) or deploy them directly across paid ad channels

Sales Team Enablement & Trade Support

Sales Collaterals: Develop & update product brochures, product samples & promotional offers to empower the Sales team

Retail Pharmacy Activations: Coordinate trade marketing collaterals, listing campaigns & point-of-sale displays for retail pharmacy chains

Compliance & Brand Integrity

Regulatory Compliance: Safeguard brand credibility by ensuring all promotional messaging remain factual, align with company values & strictly comply with regional healthcare advertising standards & product claim guidelines

Requirements:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Life Sciences, or a related field

Experience: 2–4 years of hands-on marketing executive experience, combining general marketing operations with full-stack digital marketing & e-commerce execution

Performance Marketing: Proven hands-on experience setting up, managing & optimizing paid ad campaigns within Meta Ads Manager & Google Ads

E-Commerce Ecosystems: Direct experience managing content, storefronts & promotions on Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok Shop

Technical & Analytics Proficiency: Working knowledge of Google Analytics 4 (GA4), UTM tracking structures & CRM/EDM automation tools (Klaviyo preferred)

Design & Editing Tools: Proficient in producing rapid static & video content using CapCut, Canva, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, or Illustrator

Language Proficiency: Fluency in spoken & written Mandarin is required to effectively liaise with Mandarin-speaking healthcare professionals, retail pharmacy partners, media platforms & suppliers/vendors

On-Ground Operations: Strong event execution, vendor management & trade marketing coordination skills

Content Capture Instincts: Confident in capturing raw smartphone/camera footage during events & directing quick on-site interviews

title: Head of APAC GTM Operations - MendixRapidMiner (MXRM)
description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.

The Opportunity

Head of APAC GTM Operations - MendixRapidMiner (MXRM) is the operational backbone of the MXRM Specialized Sales organization in Asia-Pacific. This role exists to protect and accelerate the APAC Zone Sales Leader's ability to execute: by running the forecasting rhythm, building the pipeline visibility the zone needs, and translating GTM performance into Finance-ready P&L narratives.

This is not a generalist ops role. MXRM operates on a distinct GTM motion — high-velocity lead funnel, Land-to-Expand post-sale engine, ARR and NRR as primary value metrics.

The role operates within the two-layer GTM Ops model: global strategy and tooling is set by the VP GTM Ops (Global); zone-level execution and insights are owned by this role for APAC. The role reports solid-line to the VP GTM Ops (Global), with dotted lines to the APAC Zone Sales Leader. Geographic scope covers Asia-Pacific — ANZ, Japan, SEA, India, Korea, and Greater China — with Singapore preferred.

Key Responsibilities:

Own and drive the APAC zone Management Operating Rhythm (MOR): weekly pipeline reviews, opportunity scrubs, Sales Manager syncs, and forecast calls. Ensure the APAC zone operates with the same cadence and rigour as AMS and EMEA, consistent with the global Franchise Model. Manage time zone complexity across sub-regions (Japan/Korea, SEA, ANZ, India) and flag deviations from MOR standards to the VP GTM Ops and APAC Zone Sales Leader.

Lead the APAC end to end forecasting process. Manage the weekly forecast call with the APAC Zone Sales Leader and Sales Managers. Own SRC (Sales Review Cadence) preparation for the APAC zone — ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and full alignment with the global GSCS rhythm. Maintain rolling forecast visibility that enables the Zone Sales Leader to call the number with confidence.

Leverage APAC-specific dashboards and reporting with a Specialized Sales lens. Core metrics include New Logo vs. Expansion split, ARR and NRR performance, GRR, pipeline coverage by motion, and time-to-value indicators. Provide sub-regional breakdowns (ANZ, Japan, SEA, India, Korea, Greater China) and define and defend MXRM-specific metric definitions where they differ from GSCS corporate defaults.

Translate APAC GTM performance into Finance-ready outputs — revenue gap analysis, attainment bridges against plan, ARR/ACV variance reporting, and scenario modelling inputs for the APAC P&L. Act as the primary operational interface between the APAC Zone Sales Leader and Finance, handling multi-currency complexity across APAC markets (JPY, AUD, SGD, INR, KRW, CNY).

Ensure Salesforce (SFDC) data quality, opportunity management standards, and CPQ/quoting accuracy across the APAC sales team. Identify and resolve operational friction points — process gaps, tooling issues, or data inconsistencies — that slow pipeline velocity or distort reporting. Partner with the Global GTM Ops team to implement tooling improvements in the APAC zone.

Manage 1–2 GTM Ops Analysts / Coordinators dedicated to the APAC zone. Set clear priorities, build operational capacity, and coach the team to deliver high-quality insights and execution support as the zone scales. Contribute to a high-performance GTM Ops culture globally. This also means this is a hands-on leader role.

Serve as the APAC GTM Ops point of contact for larger Siemens org, Finance, Growth/Marketing, and Global GTM Ops. Ensure APAC-specific insights and operational learnings flow into global conversations and navigate partner-heavy GTM motions in markets where indirect channel is dominant (Japan, Korea, SEA). Translate global directives — process changes, new tooling, updated definitions — into effective APAC implementation.

Continuously refine APAC GTM processes, operational cadences, and reporting practices in line with the global GTM Ops framework. Feed validated improvements and playbook learnings back to the VP GTM Ops as inputs to the global replication framework.

Qualifications:

7–10 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Operations in a SaaS or enterprise software environment.

Minimum 3 years in a regional or zone-level operations role, covering APAC (multi-country at minimum).

Proven track record of owning forecasting cadences and pipeline reporting for a substantial revenue organization ($50M+ ARR or equivalent).

Demonstrated experience bridging Sales and Finance — translating pipeline data and attainment into P&L-relevant narratives for senior leadership.

Proficient in Salesforce (SFDC) — opportunity management, pipeline reporting, and data hygiene at scale.

Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills — financial modelling, scenario analysis, and variance reporting.

Working knowledge of CPQ or quoting tools in a SaaS sales context.

Strong communicator — able to present operational insights clearly and concisely to Zone Sales Leaders, Finance partners, and global GTM leadership.

Player-coach mentality: comfortable being hands-on on analysis and execution while developing and mentoring junior analyst talent.

Comfortable working across multiple timezones and culturally diverse teams spanning ANZ, Japan, SEA, India, and Korea.

Experience operating within a matrixed organisation with multiple reporting lines and cross-functional stakeholders.

Familiarity with Specialized Sales or horizontal GTM motions (Mid-Market, SMB, product-led or free trial funnels).

Exposure to ARR, NRR, and GRR metric frameworks in a land-and-expand commercial model.

Experience working in or with a global ops function where zone-level insights feed into an enterprise-wide reporting framework.

Understanding of APAC-specific GTM dynamics: partner/indirect channel reliance in Japan and Korea, emerging market growth in SEA and India, and regulatory considerations in Greater China.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field; MBA is a plus.

Why This Role Is Needed:

APAC is an operationally complex MXRM zone — six sub-regions, multiple currencies, partner-heavy markets, and a wide time zones. This role ensures APAC executes with the same rigour as the other zones and protects the Zone Sales Leader's ability to call the number with confidence.

We are Siemens

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! We offer a comprehensive reward package which includes a competitive basic salary, bonus scheme, generous holiday allowance, pension, and private healthcare.

Manage stock transfers from our B2B warehouse into the B2C warehouse and into our 3PL, keeping the right level of cover in each.

Arrange courier pickups and last-mile deliveries.

Handle inbound pallets, storage of marketing materials, and general upkeep of the stock area.

Keep the warehouse laid out so pallets can be inbounded without a backlog, and raise it early when space is running short.

Packer planning and management (25%)

Plan packer headcount and shifts against order forecasts, including campaign peaks such as double days.

Hire, onboard and train part-time packers, and bring in ad-hoc labour when volume spikes.

Set packing targets, monitor performance against them

Maintain packing cost vs. target

3PL and vendor management (20%)

Own the day-to-day relationship with our e-commerce 3PL, from onboarding and transition through to steady state.

Check 3PL billing against what was actually shipped, and raise claims for errors, damage or loss.

Monitor service levels on pick accuracy, dispatch time and stock accuracy, and chase corrective action when they slip.

Govern 3PL cost vs. targets

Inventory management (15%)

Run monthly e-commerce stock counts and the half-yearly full count.

Investigate and clear variances between system and physical stock.

Manage returns, damages, expiry and write-offs on B2C stock.

Keep stock records in our ERP current and accurate.

Marketing support and consumer orders (5%)

Prepare and send stock for marketing events, activations and retail drops.

Handle small volumes international e-commerce orders..

Requirements

2-4 years in e-commerce fulfilment, warehousing, or 3PL operations.

Some experience supervising or coordinating a small team, including part-time or contract staff.

Comfortable spending part of the week on a warehouse floor. This role is hands-on.

Good Excel (pivot tables, lookups) and confident working in an ERP. Microsoft Dynamics Business Central experience is a plus.

Clear written English for working with 3PLs, couriers and marketplace platforms.

Nice to have

Worked with Shopee, Lazada or TikTok Shop seller centres.

Familiar with how 3PLs bill (pick fee, storage, handling) and managing cost

Has set up or reworked a warehouse layout before.

Perks

Full staff benefits - Annual Leaves, $300/year for health & wellness etc.

Office-hours, aircon environment

Friendly team members, fun & engaging company events & team activities

Great opportunities to learn and grow your career in operations

Opportunity to be a value-adding team member in a fast-growing regional brand

Blood (previously known as pslove) is on a mission to provide game-changing period care that inspires better days and endless possibilities for anyone who bleeds.

We invented MenstruHeat, the #1 menstrual cramp relief patch in the region with more than 1 million cramps relieved across 15 countries.

As a fast-growing consumer start-up, working with us is both an opportunity to make a real difference, as well as experience unique learnings first-hand as we launch new products and new markets in the region together.

title: Director, Retail - Singapore & Malaysia
description:
Director, Retail - Singapore & Malaysia
Requisition ID: 17209
Job Location(s):

Singapore, Singapore, SG, 138589

Time in Office: Hybrid

At Crocs, Inc., every career offers a chance to make a real impact. No two journeys look the same. And that's exactly how we like it. Whether you’re welcoming customers into our stores, collaborating with global teams at our headquarters, or keeping operations moving at our distribution centers, your impact is real and valued. At Crocs, Inc. you’re not expected to fit a mold. You’re encouraged to break it and create something better.

Overview

The Director, Retail – Singapore and Malaysia is responsible for leading the retail business across both markets, driving commercial performance, operational excellence, and exceptional consumer experiences across all company-owned stores. This role provides strategic leadership for retail growth, ensuring the successful execution of business, brand, and operational priorities while delivering sustainable financial results.

As a commercially driven and people-focused leader, the Director will develop and execute market growth strategies, optimize retail operations, and build a high-performing organization. Working closely with cross-functional partners, the incumbent will champion innovation, drive change, and strengthen organizational capability to support the long-term success and profitability of the Singapore and Malaysia retail business.

The role can be based either in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia or Singapore.

What You'll Do
Lead Singapore and Malaysia Retail Strategy: Develop and execute the long-term retail strategy for Singapore and Malaysia, driving sustainable revenue growth, market expansion, brand equity, consumer engagement, and operational excellence while ensuring alignment with regional and global business priorities.
Own P&L and Business Performance: Assume full accountability for retail sales, profitability, productivity, and key performance indicators. Leverage data-driven insights to identify growth opportunities, mitigate risks, and implement strategic actions that deliver consistent business results.
Drive Retail Excellence and Consumer Experience: Lead the delivery of best-in-class consumer experiences and operational standards across all retail locations. Partner with Area Managers, Retail Operations, Training, and Visual Merchandising teams to ensure execution excellence, brand consistency, and customer satisfaction.
Shape Merchandise and Inventory Strategies: Collaborate closely with Merchandising and Planning teams to optimize assortment, inventory productivity, allocation strategies, and product availability, maximizing sell-through, profitability, and consumer demand fulfillment.
Lead Commercial Activation: Partner cross-functionally to develop and execute in-store marketing, promotional, and brand activation initiatives that drive traffic, conversion, and revenue growth.
Drive Store Portfolio and Expansion Strategy: Identify and execute retail expansion opportunities, including new store openings, relocations, remodels, pop-up concepts, and portfolio optimization initiatives to strengthen market presence, enhance consumer accessibility, and improve financial returns.
Build Organizational Capability: Lead, coach, and develop retail talent across stores and the support organization, fostering leadership capability, succession strength, and a high-performance culture.
Champion Operational Governance and Compliance Ensure adherence to company policies, operational controls, compliance requirements, and risk management practices, safeguarding the business while maintaining a productive and engaging store environment.
What You'll Bring to the Table
Bachelor's degree in Business, Retail Management, Marketing, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
12+ years of progressive retail leadership experience, including multi-store, district, or national retail responsibility within a consumer-facing brand.
Proven track record of leading large, geographically dispersed retail teams and delivering sustainable sales, profit, and operational KPI improvements.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience managing retail P&L performance, productivity, inventory, and store portfolio optimization.
Demonstrated ability to develop high-performing teams, build leadership capability, and drive succession planning within a retail organization.
Strategic thinker with the ability to translate market insights and business priorities into executable retail growth strategies.
Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with a proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally across Merchandising, Planning, Marketing, Finance, HR, and Operations.
Strong communication, change leadership, and decision-making capabilities.

The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability, or any other protected classification.

At Crocs, Inc. we believe in the power of a blend of in-person and virtual collaboration to drive creativity and strengthen relationships. Your participation in this flexible schedule plays a key role in building a connected and successful team. In-office requirements vary by our work personas: Resident (5 days), Collaborator (4 days), Connector (2-3 days), Explorer (fully remote). This role has been aligned to the Collaborator persona.

title: Associate / Associate Director, FICC Trading (APAC)
description:
Purpose

BNS Singapore acts as the regional trading hub, providing centralized, efficient client coverage and engagement for our flow business, DCM activities, private placements, financing, and credit- and rates- linked structured products. The primary role is to make markets for clients, and trade the firm’s repo, FX, STIR, rates and credit books in the region. The role will execute and hedge transactions to manage and mitigate risk associated with these customer transactions, along with managing risks associated with trading positions through a variety of hedging strategies to maximize the return to the business within approved risk appetite. At the same time, to engage with clients to foster and leverage Banking relationships.

The trader will contribute to the overall success of the FICC and GBM business regionally and globally ensuring specific individual goals, plans, and initiatives are executed / delivered in support of the team’s business strategies and objectives. Ensures all activities conducted are in compliance with governing regulations, internal policies, and procedures.

The role is based in Singapore.

Accountabilities

Meet and exceed client volumes and market share metrics.

Price fixed income cash securities from Scotiabank’s global product suite including but not limited to USD and CAD denominated instruments (Governments, SSAs and Corporates).

Help manage and hedge relevant interest rate derivatives trading risks (IRS, Xccy, and basis), as appropriate. Promote BNS interest rate products and identify and action cross-sell opportunities with clients

Help manage and hedge relevant FX spot, forwards, swaps, options and NDFs risks as appropriate in the region. Drive up trading volume during the process of expanding the FX business.

Help manage and hedge relevant short term interest rate risks and liaise with the global STIR desks to promote Bank’s products.

Assist with the structuring, marketing and pricing of various non-linear / exotic FICC structured solutions & FICC linked structured notes, during Asia time-zone, providing support to the client coverage teams (primarily APAC Fixed Income Sales).

Contribute to a client-focused culture throughout their team to deepen client relationships and leverage broader Bank relationships, systems, and knowledge.

Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture should be considered in day-to-day activities and decisions.

Actively pursue effective and efficient operations of their respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank's Values, its Code of Conduct, and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk.

Champion a high-performance environment and contributes to an inclusive work environment.

Operate within approved risk limits and promptly escalate any actual or potential breaches

Dimensions

• This role requires successful completion of the National Futures Association’s Swaps Proficiency Requirement (SPR), prior to engaging in in-scope activity.

• Operate within designated trading limits

• Operates under general guidelines, specific code of conduct, and general bank policies

• Positive contribution to overall global business

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Demonstrate ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and excel under pressure.

• Ability to work in Singapore.

• Self-motivated, with excellent judgement and discretion.

• The role requires a thorough understanding of liability management and extensive experience in the global fixed income and foreign exchange markets. Critical skillset includes hedging, price making, and risk management.

NOTE: Partial secondment to BNS Singapore Branch will be required to enable candidate to perform bookings in the name of BNS to comply with Singapore regulations governing Securities and Futures activities.

Education I Experience I Other Information (include only those that are specific to the role)

• MBA or undergraduate degree, with an established record of academic achievement.

• Minimum 3 years in Fixed Income markets primarily dealing Fixed Income (US, UK, Singapore)

• Current Singapore MAS (1B, 6A)

• Will have exposure to legal, risk, management, and regulatory issues both globally and in Asia Pacific; will be required to coordinate and connect with other global teams on a regular basis.

• Strong personal attributes, including enthusiasm, initiative, persistence, results driven, attention to detail, and setting high standards.

• Flexibility to meet demands inherent in a global business that operates 24 hours a day, over 5 days a week.

• Knowledge of Canadian fixed income markets an advantage

Working Conditions

1. Majority of time will be spent on the trading room floor.

2. High stress fast paced working environment with many deadlines.

3. Ability to multitask and deal with numerous competing demands

4. Moderate international travel, as required.

5. The transactions in which the position becomes directly involved have tight deadlines. Evening and weekend work can be regular, without prior notice, and could take place out of town. The position requires a very high degree of flexibility and cooperation, as well as occasionally accepting responsibilities outside of the defined accountabilities.

Work closely with regional market managers, and product engineering for the design and development of new products with particular focus around application support. Act as liaison between regional/global customers and manufacturing/engineering by forwarding customer technical requests and coordinating communication and follow-up with customers on results of requests.

· Support the roll out of new products with external presentations focused on the technical differentiation aspects of the product and value proposition.

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills

title: Head of Sales - SEA
description:
Reporting directly to the APAC President, this role serves as a key member of the APAC leadership team and is accountable for

developing and executing regional sales strategies, driving commercial excellence, strengthening market leadership

, and building a high-performing sales organization.

The incumbent will lead both the

SEA Sales

and

Sales Engineering

teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer centricity, and performance. Success in this role requires a highly strategic, inspirational, and commercially astute leader who can align diverse teams around a common vision while delivering sustainable and profitable growth.

Key Responsibiities:

Strategic Leadership & Business Growth

Develop and execute the SEA growth strategy aligned with APAC business objectives.

Identify market opportunities, emerging trends, and competitive threats to strengthen i-PRO’s leadership position across the region.

Act as a strategic advisor to the APAC President on market developments, investment priorities, organizational effectiveness, and business growth initiatives.

Drive revenue growth, market share expansion, profitability, and long-term business sustainability.

Lead strategic planning, annual business planning, forecasting, and operational reviews across SEA.

Sales Leadership & Commercial Excellence

Own and deliver the SEA sales target, revenue growth, profitability, and market expansion objectives.

Drive consistent sales execution and KPI achievement across all SEA countries.

Establish performance standards, operating rhythms, and governance mechanisms to ensure predictable and sustainable business results.

Monitor sales performance, pipeline health, forecasting accuracy, and business productivity.

Champion best practices in sales management, opportunity management, and channel development.

Leadership & People Development

Lead, coach, and inspire a geographically dispersed team of sales leaders, account managers, and sales engineers across SEA.

Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, customer success, and continuous improvement.

Develop leadership capabilities within the organization and establish a robust succession pipeline.

Drive employee engagement, talent retention, and organizational effectiveness across the region.

Create an environment that motivates individuals and teams to consistently perform at their highest potential.

Regional Stakeholder Management

Build and maintain executive-level relationships with distributors, channel partners, strategic customers, consultants, and system integrators (SIs).

Represent i-PRO at key customer engagements, industry forums, and strategic partner discussions.

Collaborate closely with Marketing, Product Management, Operations, Finance, HR, and other APAC functions to deliver business objectives.

Influence internal and external stakeholders to drive alignment and execution across multiple countries.

Sales Engineering Leadership

Provide strategic leadership to the SEA Sales Engineering organization.

Ensure technical resources are effectively deployed to support business growth and customer success.

Drive technical excellence, solution selling capabilities, and pre-sales effectiveness throughout the region.

Align technical strategies with commercial objectives to maximize business impact.

Business & Financial Management

Own the SEA P&L and ensure achievement of revenue, margin, and profitability objectives.

Allocate resources and investments strategically to optimize business outcomes.

Drive disciplined forecasting, budgeting, and performance review processes.

Deliver data-driven insights and recommendations to the APAC leadership team.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in engineering. Business Administration & Master's degree is advantageous.

At least 15 years of sales experience, preferably within the technology or security equipment sector.

Proven experience in managing P&L responsibilities across multiple countries.

Extensive knowledge of the CCTV/security industry with a strong understanding of market dynamics in the SEA region.

Exceptional leadership and team management skills, with a proven ability to mentor and retain top talent.

Strong business acumen with a strategic, proactive, and hunter mentality.

Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with fluency in English. Additional languages spoken in the region are a plus.

Willingness to travel extensively within the SEA region as required.

i-PRO, formerly Panasonic Security, is proud of our 60-year heritage in the security industry, where we continue to deliver the exceptional durability, reliability, and quality that Japanese technology is known for.

We are committed to providing the industry’s most reliable and trustworthy eyes and to advancing through continuous innovation. We have transformed our hardware from simple image-capturing devices into industry-leading edge computing sensors. i-PRO technology transforms video data into highly accurate insights that empower businesses through real-time situational awareness giving the ability to take proactive measures that enhance operational efficiency.

i-PRO’s edge AI technology enables easy customization and integration to ensure that our products meet any specific application and customer need. Our open platform approach, together with Docker technology, supports and fosters collaboration and co-development with leading software partners, ensuring our hardware remains adaptable and future-proof. Our dedication to responsible innovation is at the core of our mission, and is further demonstrated by our decision to join the United Nations Global Compact in 2023. To maintain the highest level of data integrity, all of our products are built with the highest levels of cybersecurity by design. i-PRO leads the security and safety industry as the first camera manufacturer to set standards and rules for the ethical use of AI technology.

i-PRO is a pioneer in edge computing, committed to providing peace of mind to our partners, customers and users of our products. We protect their businesses without compromise, while delivering premium AI vision-based insights that improve efficiency and drive growth.

title: Manager, Media Planning
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary and Impact

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Manager to join WPP Media Singapore Clients Team. You will be responsible for leading a portfolio of strategic client relationships. Acting as a trusted strategic advisor and central hub integrator across specialists and local market teams, this role oversees the complete campaign lifecycle, from integrated cross-channel media strategy and planning to execution, optimization, and financial governance.

You will bridge client business goals with innovative and effective media solutions across all digital biddable and non-biddable/traditional channels, ensuring high client satisfaction, account profitability, and operational excellence while mentoring junior talent.

Experience working with Singapore and regional premium lifestyle and luxury publishers, with established media relationships and a good understanding of the publisher landscape, will be a strong advantage.

Client Partnership & Strategic Leadership
Client Champion & Trusted Advisor: Build and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with senior client stakeholders based on trust, transparency, and proactive communication. Act as the primary point of contact and escalate/resolve challenges with confidence.
Business & Category Insight: Deeply understand client business models, market dynamics, competitive landscapes, and growth priorities across diverse sectors (luxury, financial services, FMCG, wine & spirits).
Strategic Roadmap Development: Lead annual strategy sessions, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and campaign roadmaps, translating overarching business targets into actionable, high-impact marketing and media strategies.
Account Growth & Scope Management: Proactively identify portfolio expansion opportunities, unlock new revenue streams, and champion client satisfaction to drive long-term retention.
Integrated Media Strategy & Campaign Planning
Cross-Channel Planning: Develop end-to-end, integrated media strategies combining digital channels (Search, Social, Programmatic) and traditional/non-biddable channels (TV, Print, Radio, OOH/DOOH, Cinema, Digital IOs).
Goal-Oriented Media Design: Define clear, measurable performance benchmarks and KPIs, ensuring media allocations align with client investment strategies and brand priorities.
Innovative Integration: Partner with internal specialists (Planning, Investment, Activation, Content, Analytics) to deliver cohesive, data-led communications solutions.
Campaign Execution, Operations & Governance
Seamless Implementation: Oversee end-to-end execution, launch accuracy, and quality control across all media channels, maintaining robust documentation, approvals, and audit readiness.
Regional & Local Governance: Coordinate across regional hubs, local markets, and external partners to ensure consistency of delivery, process optimization, and compliance with agency standards.
Issue & Workflow Resolution: Act as the operational escalation point to resolve delivery, billing, technology, and implementation challenges across internal and external stakeholders.
Commercial Management & Financial Stewardship
Account Profitability & Revenue Ownership: Manage account P&L, accurate revenue forecasting, scope control, and commercial compliance against contractual targets.
Meticulous Budget Management: Oversee client media investments, managing budget allocations, spend tracking, reconciliations, invoicing, credit notes, and accruals with full client transparency.
Financial Risk Mitigation: Partner with Finance and Operations teams to ensure timely billing, revenue recognition, and proactive resolution of financial discrepancies.
Data Analytics, Optimization & Reporting
Performance Monitoring & Insights: Analyze campaign performance using tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, PowerBI, Clear Decisions, and Evogenious (TV) to derive actionable strategic insights beyond surface-level metrics.
A/B Testing & Continuous Improvement: Design and lead A/B testing and experimentation initiatives to continuously optimize conversions, engagement, and ROI across campaigns.
Executive Reporting: Deliver clear, tailored performance reports and forward-looking strategic recommendations that articulate value to senior client leadership.
People Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Team Mentorship & Coaching: Support the growth and capability development of junior team members through day-to-day guidance, skill-building, and knowledge sharing.
Cross-Functional Synergy: Facilitate smooth collaboration between media owners, technology partners, creative agencies, procurement teams, and internal practice specialists.
Culture Champion: Drive a high-performing, inclusive, and collaborative team culture grounded in accountability and continuous learning.

What You Will Need (Qualifications & Experience)

Experience: At least 6-7 years of experience in media planning and client servicing in integrated advertising, with a proven track record of managing end-to-end campaigns in the Singapore market and regional hubs.
Cross-Channel Knowledge: Good understanding of biddable channels, as well as strong working knowledge on non-biddable media particularly premium lifestyle and luxury category.
Tool & Analytics Proficiency: Hands-on experience with industry analytics, research, and reporting tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, PowerBI, Excel, Clear Decisions, Evogenious).
Commercial Acumen: Strong fluency in media math, financial stewardship (reconciliations, billing, accruals), contract management, and account profitability.
Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and written/verbal communication skills, with experience managing executive-level clients.
Leadership Qualities: Self-driven ownership with demonstrated ability to guide, mentor, and elevate junior team members in a fast-paced environment.

Core Competencies

Client Leadership & Advisory: Strategic relationship building, consultative problem solving, executive stakeholder engagement.
Integrated Media Mastery: Dynamic cross-channel planning, including performance media, direct publishers and traditional media.
Commercial Acumen: Financial discipline, budget governance, scope management, profitability tracking.
Operational Excellence: Process rigor, quality control, multi-stakeholder orchestration in the Singapore and regional markets.
People & Team Leadership: Talent coaching, cross-functional collaboration, team alignment.

Success Measures

Client Satisfaction & Retention: High Net Promoter Scores (NPS) and successful contract renewals across assigned portfolio.
Commercial Health: Achievement of revenue targets, forecast accuracy, and healthy account margin performance.
Operational Accuracy: Zero major financial/billing discrepancies and 100% adherence to governance and audit standards.
Campaign Effectiveness: Exceeding client campaign KPIs through continuous testing and data-driven optimization.
Team Growth: Positive engagement, skill progression, and capability development among junior direct reports/mentees.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we're just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

#LI-Promoted

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Apple Ads - Client Partner Manager,
description:
At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. You’ll quickly gain the respect and support of both management and other employees by achieving business goals and demonstrating good judgment, business insight, balance, objectivity, collaboration, quiet confidence, and trustworthiness. - This role requires a strong player-coach leader who can effectively develop and inspire the team while remaining hands-on in managing and expanding relationships with our most strategic customers.

- This role will be accountable for building, managing, and expanding relationships with leading advertisers and app developers across the Korea market.

- Sales Leadership: Lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing Korea team, fostering a strong culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

- Revenue Growth & Strategy: Own and deliver against revenue targets, driving sustainable growth through strategic account planning, business development, and expansion of existing partnerships.

- Client & Partner Engagement: Cultivate senior-level relationships with key clients and developers across Korea, positioning Apple’s Advertising Platforms as a strategic growth partner.

- Operational Excellence: Ensure strong sales discipline through accurate forecasting, pipeline management, and consistent use of CRM and internal tools (e.g., Salesforce), aligned with global standards.

- Performance Optimization: Oversee the Platform Specialist function to ensure best-in-class campaign execution, optimization, and performance outcomes across key metrics such as CPT, CPA, and customer satisfaction indices.

- Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Marketing, Product, and other global teams to provide Korea market insights, influence product roadmap, and ensure local market needs are effectively represented.

- Market Expertise: Maintain deep knowledge of the Korea digital advertising ecosystem, including attribution models, measurement frameworks, privacy considerations, and competitive dynamics.

Preferred Qualifications
A hands-on player-coach leadership style, with the ability to both lead strategically and actively engage in key client relationships and sales opportunities.
Excellent communication skills, be able to listen effectively, socialize ideas across functions and articulate the business visions both internally and externally
Established network across advertisers, agencies, and developers within Korea.
Demonstrated ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels, including C-suite executives and senior marketing leaders.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate strategic perspectives clearly and effectively.
Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and drive alignment across regional and global teams.
Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with a proactive and solutions-oriented mindset.
Experience in gaming app category preferred.

Minimum Qualifications
Bachelors degree educated, MBA a plus.
English fluency required.
Deep understanding of the mobile app economy and evolving digital marketing landscape in Korea.
Extensive experience in digital, online, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile app ecosystem and data-driven marketing environments.
Strong expertise in performance marketing, including campaign optimization, attribution, and measurement frameworks.
Proven track record of building and leading high-performing sales teams, with demonstrated success in attracting, developing, and retaining top talent.

title: Account & Strategy Lead
description:
A leadership opportunity to shape strategy, inspire creative work and lead a next-generation agency operation for a global hospitality brand.

We are seeking an exceptional Account & Strategy Lead for immediate hire, combining strategic depth, creative judgement and client leadership with personal responsibility for programme delivery and results.

The Role

As Programme & Strategy Lead, you will lead the strategic direction, client relationship and delivery of the client’s Brand Governance & APAC mid-funnel programme. Mid-funnel is made up of two complementary programmes: an always-on campaign and an influencer campaign, both designed to build brand consideration across priority markets.

This is a hands-on senior account leadership role within a lean team. You will partner with the client to understand their business priorities, shape the strategic response, and guide the agency team from brief through to delivery and learning. You will need the judgement to challenge constructively, the creative fluency to recognise and develop strong ideas, and the commercial awareness to connect marketing activity to brand and business outcomes

Responsibilities

Own the senior agency relationship for the APAC agency programme, with accountability for strategic quality, client confidence, delivery and results across both the always-on and influencer programmes.

Work with the client’s leadership team to understand business priorities, shape the annual roadmap, set programme priorities and identify opportunities to strengthen consideration for the brand.

Translate client needs, business objectives, audience insights and performance signals into incisive briefs, creative interpretation and actionable content direction.

Develop, bounce back and constructively challenge ideas with the client and agency teams, ensuring creative work is distinctive, relevant to the audience and connected to the strategic objective

Lead integrated development across strategy, creative, content, influencers, media and performance, ensuring the different disciplines work together as one coherent programme.

• Guide the agency team through briefing, planning, production, approvals and delivery, creating clarity around priorities, roles, timelines, dependencies and decisions.

Personally develop and present persuasive leadership decks, strategic recommendations and creative work, making complex thinking easy to understand and building alignment at senior level.

Own measurement, performance read-outs and learning loops, turning results and market signals into practical optimisation recommendations and stronger future work

What We’re Looking For

Significant senior experience in account leadership, brand strategy, integrated marketing, creative content or a related agency role, ideally across multiple markets.

A strong understanding of how brand strategy, creative work, content, influencers, media and performance connect to build consideration and deliver commercial value

Proven ability to understand a client’s business challenge and translate it into a clear strategic response, inspiring briefs and focused agency action.

A track record of becoming a trusted senior client partner: someone who listens carefully, understands the client’s world, asks the right questions and provides confident, informed counsel.

Strong creative judgement and fluency, with the ability to recognise a good idea, improve it through constructive discussion and guide creative, content and production teams towards high-quality work.

Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to lead senior conversations, facilitate decisions, sell an idea and manage challenge constructively.

A hands-on, solutions-oriented leader who can bring structure to ambiguity, prioritise effectively and lead a small, agile agency team without losing sight of the detail.

Why this role

Own and evolve a regional agency operating model with direct influence on its success.

Be the senior account lead at the centre of a high-profile APAC programme for a globally recognised hospitality brand.

Have direct influence on how client priorities become distinctive, effective and measurable work.

Work within a senior, agile team backed by advanced data, media and technology capabilities, with the opportunity to make a visible difference to the way the partnership operates.

title: Business Development Executive (Media and Advertising Sales)

At Koocester you will sell branded content and advertising across our six media titles (Koocester, Autos, Homes, Business, Foodie and Wealth) to Singapore businesses. Salary S$2,000 to 3,500 a month, plus commission.

- Find and open new accounts every day: calls, walk-ins, LinkedIn, email and referrals

- Send proposals within 12 hours and follow through to a signed deal
- Grow past clients into repeat clients
- Keep a clean, honest pipeline and report your numbers daily and weekly
- Brief our producers so every campaign we sell is delivered well

What we measure
- Daily: new conversations opened, follow-ups, meetings booked
- Weekly: proposals sent, deals closed, revenue secured, pipeline value
- Monthly: close rate, repeat business, referrals, forecast accuracy

You must have
- At least 2 years in B2B, agency or media sales with a target
- A track record you can show with figures at interview
- Comfort with cold calling and walking into meetings
- The drive to move from proposal to close in days, not weeks

Good to have

- Experience with a CRM such as HubSpot

Hungry, coachable, fast to act, calm under pressure and driven by targets.

Where this goes
Business Development Executive, Senior Executive, Sales Manager, Country Head of Revenue, Regional Revenue Director, Chief Revenue Officer.

We stand by GUIDE Values.

G- Growth and curiosity

U- Uniting through trust and relationships

I- Impact through Inspiration

D- Dare to be bold and innovate

E- Empathy and Giving

Our purpose is - Symbol of Inspiration, Empowering Growth, Powered by People.

What started as interview-driven storytelling has evolved into a multi-vertical media network covering business, homes, autos, lifestyle, and entrepreneurship. Through our platforms, we connect ambitious brands with audiences that value trust, aspiration, and real-world insight. Our approach goes beyond exposure. We focus on meaningful visibility, long-term brand positioning, and partnerships that create measurable business impact.

Koocester operates at the intersection of media, branding, and community. We work closely with founders, operators, and decision-makers to tell authentic stories, build authority, and create opportunities for growth. When stories are told well, they inspire action. And when influence is used responsibly, it creates lasting value.

description:

Able to commit for full time internship from Oct 2026 to June 2027
A great team player with a positive, can-do attitude
Strong communication and writing skills
Organised, efficient, and not afraid of multitasking
Comfortable with creative tools and interested in visual content and digital assets
Passionate about marketing and eager to learn

What you’ll get:

Full exposure to country-level and regional marketing operations in a fast-paced environment
Experience across regional, trade, PR, eCommerce, and digital marketing
Be part of a fun, lovely, and collaborative team that supports your growth
Real, meaningful marketing experience to help kickstart your career

Organised, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
Curious, proactive, responsible and willing to take ownership of tasks.
Ability to adapt and be flexible to changing environment and business needs
Team player
Good communication and coordination skills.
Comfortable working with different teams and stakeholders.
Strong interest in the beauty, retail, luxury or FMCG industry.
Positive, collaborative and eager to learn.
Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel.

Additional Information

Interested to take part in impactful missions? Send us your resume: recruitment@sg.lvmh-pc.com

LVMH Perfumes & Cosmetics is committed to creating a diverse ecosystem and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: Sales Director, Head of Asia
description:
We are looking for an experienced

Director of Sales

to lead our commercial organization across

Asia

. This leader isaccountable for the overall performance of the region, including revenuegrowth, sales execution, leadership development, customer success, andorganizational capability.

This role requires an authentic and highly visible leader who combines commercial strategy with operational excellence. The successful candidate will build executive-level relationships across distributors, strategic partners, system integrators, consultants, and enterprise customers while developing a high-performing sales organization capable of delivering sustainable growth.

Beyond achieving annual sales objectives, this leader will elevate sales excellence across the region by strengthening leadership capability, improving forecast accuracy and pipeline discipline, increasing adoption of value-based and multi-product selling, and building a culture of accountability, coaching, and execution.

The Sales Director, Head of Asia reports to the Chief Revenue Officer and serves as a member of the Global Sales Leader-ship Team, contributing to Milestone's global commercial strategy while representing the voice of the Asia market.

What You Will Do

Commercial Strategy and Growth

Develop and execute the Asia commercial strategy aligned with Milestone's global growth objectives.

Translate corporate strategy into clear regional priorities, execution plans, and measurable business outcomes.

Identify market opportunities, competitive threats, and strategic growth initiatives across Asia.

Own and exceed annual sales targets for the region.

Sales Leadership and Organizational Performance

Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing regional sales organization across Asia.

Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and execution excellence.

Develop sales leaders and employees through coaching, performance management, succession planning, and talent development.

Build organizational capability by attracting, developing, and retaining strong commercial talent.

Drive organizational alignment and consistency across the region while accounting for local market differences.

Customer and Partner Executive Engagement

Build executive relationships with Milestone's largest customers, distributors, strategic partners, consultants, and system integrators across Asia.

Serve as the executive sponsor for the region's most strategic customer relationships.

Represent Milestone at executive customer meetings, industry events, and key commercial engagements.

Partner with Global Channel leadership to support strategic distributor and partner relationships within the region.

Sales Execution and Operational Excellence

Champion a modern, value-based sales methodology across the regional organization.

Improve pipeline quality, forecast accuracy, CRM adoption, and sales operating discipline.

Increase adoption of multi-product and solution selling across Milestone's portfolio.

Deliver regional financial performance through effective planning, forecasting, and resource management.

Enterprise Leadership

Serve as a member of the Global Sales Leadership Team, contributing to global commercial strategy and organizational priorities.

Partner closely with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Sales Operations, and Global Channel leadership to align execution.

Represent the voice of the Asia market by providing customer and market insights that influence business strategy.

Professional Qualifications

12+ years of progressive sales experience within enterprise software, SaaS, IT, security, networking, infrastructure, or related technology markets, including significant sales leadership responsibility.

Demonstrated success leading geographically dispersed sales teams and delivering consistent revenue growth.

Extensive experience with complex two-tier distribution and channel sales models.

Strong executive presence and the ability to influence customers, partners, employees, peers, and senior leadership.

Experience strengthening or transforming sales organizations through coaching, operational discipline, and sales process excellence.

Strong commercial, financial, and strategic business acumen.

Experience developing regional go-to-market strategies and leading cross-functional execution.

Deep understanding of Asian markets and the cultural and commercial differences across Asia, Korea, and Japan.

Passion for developing people and building a high-performance culture rooted in accountability and collaboration.

Bachelor's degree in Business or a related field is preferred.

Experience with modern CRM platforms and sales methodologies is strongly preferred.

Primary business language is English; fluency in English is required. Proficiency in additional languages relevant to the region is an advantage.

Willingness and ability to travel regularly across Asia and internationally as business needs require.

What You Bring

You are an authentic, visible, and commercially minded leader who combines strategic thinking with operational discipline. You build trust with customers and partners, create clarity for your team, and act early when performance is off track. You are passionate about developing people and building a high-performance culture while working collaboratively across a global, matrixed organization.

Why Join Milestone

At Milestone Systems, you will join an international software company with a strong portfolio of video technology solutions and an ambitious strategy for the future. For more than 25 years, Milestone has helped organizations use video to see, understand, and respond to the world around them.

Milestone is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Contact and Application

Please apply through our website: www.milestonesys.com

When joining Milestone, you will be part of the world’s leading provider of IP Video Management Systems. Since our start in Denmark in 1998 we have grown to be nearly 1.500 employees across development centers and regional offices in more than 26 countries. Today, our solutions are used in 500,000+ installations worldwide – with many more to come.

We believe that our success first and foremost is based on our sworn dedication to put people first – the people we work with and the people around us. It's how we grow our culture, our business and our community. We want to blaze new trails, stay curious and push the industry standard. Investing in people is how we do it. Because at Milestone, we grow together!

title: Contract Technician (1 Year contract)
description:
About the role

We're hiring a reliable, detail-oriented technician who works well with people. You'll visit residential properties and capture high-quality 3D virtual tours with Matterport cameras. Your scans will be used for real estate listings, rentals, insurance documentation, renovation planning and property marketing. You'll work on your own in the field, represent our company in clients' homes, and deliver accurate, polished scans on schedule.

Key responsibilities

Travel to scheduled homes and properties and complete 3D scans with Matterport equipment (Pro2, Pro3 or a similar camera).

Plan efficient scan paths so the space is fully covered, with no gaps, misalignments or missing rooms.

Prepare each space before scanning: open blinds, turn on lights, close mirrored doors where needed, and point out clutter or personal items to the homeowner or agent.

Take supplemental 2D photos, mark points of interest, and capture measurements or floor-plan data when requested.

Upload scans to Matterport Cloud and check processing quality before you leave the site, where possible.

Do light post-processing: set the start location, trim or hide scan points, add Mattertags, set up highlight reels, and blur sensitive items such as faces, family photos and documents.

Talk with homeowners, tenants and real estate agents in a professional, courteous way, including confirming appointments and arrival times.

Look after company equipment (camera, tripod, iPad or phone, batteries) and report any damage or problems right away.

Keep accurate records of jobs, mileage and hours.

Follow privacy, safety and property-respect rules in every home.

Qualifications

Required:

Comfortable with technology, including tablets, smartphone apps and cloud uploads.

Strong time management and punctuality.

Professional appearance and good communication skills.

Able to pass a background check, since you'll be working inside private residences.

Availability that includes some weekdays. Weekend availability is a plus.

Preferred:

Experience with Matterport, 360° cameras, real estate photography or drone work.

Basic photography knowledge: lighting, exposure and composition.

What we provide:

Paid training on scanning best practices and our quality standards

A flexible schedule that suits students, freelancers

Mileage reimbursement

title: Shop Manager
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an organized, results-driven Shop Manager to lead daily retail operations at our aquarium store. In this role, you will oversee team scheduling, financial controls, customer satisfaction, inventory management, and store profitability while working closely with our Regional Management and Marketing teams.

Key Responsibilities

Store Operations & Cash Control:

Manage shift rosters, oversee daily POS reconciliations/cash handling, enforce SOPs, and execute directives from Regional Management.

Sales & Customer Experience:

Motivate staff to exceed sales targets, maintain high customer service standards, assist with custom aquarium orders, and resolve complex feedback.

Inventory & Stock Management:

Store Upkeep & Marketing:

Proven supervisory or management experience in a retail (experience in aquatics, pet care, or specialized retail is a strong advantage).

Solid understanding of daily cash reconciliation, POS operations, and basic retail financial metrics.

Strong organizational and scheduling skills with the ability to manage team performance.

Excellent communication and problem-solving skills with a strong customer-first mindset.

A Manufacturer and Distributor in

Aquarium Trade to Our Singapore Market

title: Business Development Representative
description:
About Us:

Vortexa was founded to solve the immense information gap that exists in the energy industry. By using massive amounts of new satellite data and pioneering work in artificial intelligence, Vortexa creates an unprecedented view of global seaborne energy flows in real-time, bringing transparency and efficiency to the energy markets.

With offices in London, New York, Houston, Singapore, Geneva and the UAE, we are building the definitive platform for energy and freight analytics globally - backed by leading investors including Morgan Stanley & Notion Capital.

The Role:

We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our BDR Pipeline Generation team, based in our Singapore office and focused on the APAC region. You will play a crucial role in driving the growth of our business, helping to generate new opportunities across our core APAC customer segments.

You’ll be responsible for identifying and engaging high-potential prospects across APAC — including Singapore and Southeast Asia (e.g. Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and Vietnam), Japan, South Korea, Australia, India and Greater China — through both marketing-generated leads and proactive outbound efforts ensuring our Sales team is set up to succeed. You'll work closely with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to drive pipeline generation through inbound lead discovery and qualification, proactive and energetic outbounding, and driving attendance at key APAC industry events.

It’s an ideal opportunity for someone eager to develop their SaaS career in a high-performing, global team, while learning about one of the world’s most impactful and complex industries.

In this role you will:

Drive qualified pipeline through personalised, multichannel outreach (email, LinkedIn, phone, event follow-up, and local channels such as WeChat, LINE and KakaoTalk where appropriate)
Conduct Discovery calls and qualify leads before handover to Sales, mapping the buying group and approval process (often consensus-driven in markets such as Japan and Korea)
Research and map high-potential accounts across APAC’s core segments — national oil companies and refiners, Japanese trading houses and utilities, Singapore-based trading firms, shipowners and brokers, bunkering, and banks and commodity funds
Collaborate with the Marketing team to promote and drive registrations for Vortexa-hosted and APAC industry events (e.g. Singapore International Energy Week, APPEC, Singapore Maritime Week, Asia Pacific Maritime, and LNG and freight conferences in Japan, Korea and Australia)
Collaborate with the RevOps, Sales, and Marketing teams to evolve scalable playbooks and processes
Ensure accurate tracking and maintenance of data within the BDR tech stack (Salesforce, Salesloft, Gong, Marketo etc.)
Run outreach in line with regional data-privacy and anti-spam rules (e.g. Singapore PDPA, China PIPL, Japan APPI, India DPDP Act, Australia Spam Act)
Maintain core working hours aligned to Singapore time, with flexibility to engage prospects across APAC time zones (from India to Japan and Australia), plus occasional regional travel for key events and customer meetings (10-20%)
Consistently meet or exceed quarterly targets for revenue contribution (e.g. qualified demos booked with AEs, pipeline created, and pipeline closed won)

Requirements

You will have:

At least 2 years of experience in a SaaS BDR, SDR, or commercial associate role
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling outreach and hold engaging conversations with senior stakeholders to engage prospects and nurture leads
Cultural fluency in APAC business norms, including relationship-led selling and hierarchy-aware engagement with senior stakeholders
Genuine interest in the energy, freight, or commodities space; (experience in the sector is a plus)
A proactive and curious attitude, with an eagerness to grow within a high-performing team
A proven track record of exceeding commercial OKRs
Experience with Salesforce, Salesloft, Gong, ZoomInfo, etc. or similar tools, plus the resourcefulness to research accounts manually where database coverage is thin (common in North and Southeast Asia)
Professional working proficiency English and additional local languages (bonus)
Sound judgement when engaging prospects in sanctions-sensitive or politically sensitive trade flows
The ability to work independently, take initiative, and meet deadlines

Great if you have:

A background in the energy industry (e.g. oil & gas trading, freight analytics, commodities, etc.) and are looking to pivot into a SaaS commercial career, we’d love to hear from you.
Prior exposure to APAC commercial, trading or maritime environments.

Benefits

Stock-options in a fast-growing, high-potential business
An open, collaborative, and supportive working culture built on merit, which celebrates creative thinking and “getting things done.”
The opportunity to work with AI-driven technology in a scale-up environment with commodity trading experts
Private Health Insurance offered via AXA
A flexible working policy- accommodating both remote & home working, with regular staff events
Global Volunteering Policy to help you ‘do good’ and feel better
Competitive base salary plus commission and a clear career path from BDR to Sales Manager

title: Jewellery Specialist
description:
Company Profile

AstaGuru, Mumbai’s Premier Online Auction House, seamlessly blends sophistication with expertise, defining its identity through a profound commitment to artistic preservation. Since its establishment in 2008, AstaGuru has emerged as a pioneer among online auction houses, specializing in art,antiques, and collectibles. Beyond being a mere e-auction website in Mumbai India, AstaGuru is a curator of experiences, a guardian of cultural legacies and a beacon for those who value the profound richness of artistic expression.

Our name, AstaGuru, is a fusion of the Italian word “Asta” for auction with “Guru” symbolizing our unwavering dedication to the art of auctioneering. Each meticulously curated catalogue guarantees authenticity, provenance,rarity, artistry, and craftsmanship, ensuring a distinctive and unparalleled experience.

AstaGuru has evolved into the preferred destination for original artworks and collectibles, achieving world record prices for revered artists like A. Ramachandran, Jeram Patel, António Xavier Trindade, M F Husain, and more. We joyously celebrate and seek custodians for timeless works that embody defining aesthetic movements in India.

Job Title:

Jewellery Specialist

Location:

Singapore

Reporting to:

Managing Director

Department:

Jewellery

Position Summary:

Build and establish AstaGuru’s Jewellery category in Singapore and the Southeast Asian market by driving sourcing, developing supplier networks, and creating a strong pipeline of high-quality consignments. The role focuses on identifying rare and valuable pieces, cultivating relationships within the luxury ecosystem, and laying the foundation for long-term category growth, with sales as a secondary outcome.

Primary Responsibilities

• Identify, source, and curate high-value, rare, and collectible jewellery pieces across regional and international markets

• Build and expand a strong network of jewellers, collectors, dealers, and luxury stakeholders in Singapore and Southeast Asia

• Develop the jewellery category from the ground up, establishing sourcing strategies and market positioning

• Research, evaluate, and assess jewellery pieces for authenticity, rarity, and auction potential

• Generate and manage a pipeline of consignments for future auctions and private sales

• Engage with HNI/UHNI clients,family offices, and collectors to build long-term sourcing relationships

• Track market trends, pricing benchmarks, and emerging opportunities within the luxury jewellery segment

• Collaborate with internal teams(research, cataloguing, marketing) to build strong category narratives and presentations

• Support catalogue creation through insights, sourcing inputs, and market knowledge

• Represent AstaGuru at industry events, exhibitions, and private client meetings

• Travel within the region as required for sourcing and relationship building

Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience in luxury jewellery, sourcing, or category development

• Strong exposure to international or Southeast Asian luxury markets preferred

• Holder of GIA/FGA or similar

• Bachelor’s degree required

• MBA or specialization in Luxury Management preferred

Competencies & Skills

• Deep knowledge of fine jewellery,luxury markets, and sourcing practices

• Strong network within the jewellery and luxury ecosystem

• Excellent research and evaluation skills

• Strong relationship-building and interpersonal skills with a polished professional presence

• Strategic thinking with the ability to build categories from scratch

• Understanding of HNI/UHNI client behaviour

• Independent, proactive, and entrepreneurial mindset

• Strong communication and presentation skills

• Proficiency in MS Office tools
