title: Marketing Director
description:
Job Overview

AWA Gymnastics is seeking an experienced and results-driven

Marketing Director

to lead the academy's marketing, branding, student acquisition and market expansion strategies in Singapore.

The Marketing Director will be responsible for strengthening AWA Gymnastics' brand presence, generating qualified student enquiries, increasing trial-class bookings and enrolments, and developing effective online and offline marketing channels.

This is a leadership role requiring a strong combination of strategic marketing, digital acquisition, brand management, data analysis and commercial awareness.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Student Acquisition

Develop and execute the overall marketing strategy for AWA Gymnastics.

Create marketing plans to increase student enrolment across recreational and competitive rhythmic gymnastics programmes.

Develop targeted campaigns for children, teenagers, adults and parents.

Establish monthly, quarterly and annual marketing targets aligned with enrolment and revenue objectives.

Design effective customer acquisition funnels from initial awareness and enquiry to trial class, enrolment and renewal.

Identify new customer segments and opportunities for business growth.

Digital Marketing

Lead digital marketing campaigns across Google, Meta, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and other relevant platforms.

Develop and manage SEO and SEM strategies to increase organic and paid search visibility.

Plan and optimise paid advertising campaigns based on leads, trial bookings, enrolments and customer acquisition costs.

Manage website marketing performance, landing pages and online enquiry funnels.

Develop retargeting and lead-nurturing strategies for prospective students and parents.

Analyse campaign data and continuously improve marketing ROI.

Brand Management

Develop and strengthen AWA Gymnastics' brand positioning in Singapore's gymnastics and sports education market.

Maintain consistent brand identity and messaging across digital and offline channels.

Oversee the creation of promotional materials, photography, videos, social media content, brochures and advertisements.

Communicate the academy's coaching expertise, training methodology, facilities and student development opportunities effectively.

Build a premium and professional brand image that appeals to both recreational and competitive gymnastics families.

Content & Social Media

Develop the academy's overall content and social media strategy.

Create content plans featuring coaches, training sessions, student development, competitions, events and academy achievements.

Work with coaches and operational teams to identify suitable stories and content opportunities.

Grow the academy's social media presence and engagement.

Develop educational content to help parents understand rhythmic gymnastics, training pathways and student development.

Events, Competitions & Community Marketing

Develop marketing campaigns for trial classes, open houses, holiday camps, workshops and special programmes.

Support the promotion of local and international rhythmic gymnastics competitions.

Coordinate marketing activities around student performances, competitions and academy events.

Develop community outreach initiatives to increase awareness of rhythmic gymnastics.

Identify opportunities for exhibitions, demonstrations and promotional events.

Partnerships & Business Development

Develop partnerships with schools, international schools, preschools, clubs, community organisations and other relevant institutions.

Identify opportunities for school-based rhythmic gymnastics programmes and enrichment partnerships.

Develop referral and cross-promotional partnerships with complementary businesses and organisations.

Explore collaboration opportunities with international coaches, gymnastics organisations and training programmes.

Support the academy's regional and international brand development where appropriate.

Sales & Marketing Coordination

Work closely with the sales and customer service teams to improve enquiry-to-trial and trial-to-enrolment conversion.

Analyse customer feedback and identify barriers to enrolment.

Develop promotional offers and campaigns to support enrolment and student retention.

Monitor the performance of different lead-generation channels.

Ensure marketing campaigns generate measurable commercial outcomes.

Team & Budget Management

Build, manage and develop the marketing team.

Manage external agencies, designers, photographers, videographers and digital marketing partners where required.

Establish clear marketing KPIs and reporting systems.

Manage the annual marketing budget and allocate resources effectively.

Prepare regular marketing performance reports for senior management.

Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Management or a related discipline is preferred.

Relevant experience in marketing, brand management, digital marketing or business development.

Previous experience in a marketing leadership or management position is preferred.

Strong understanding of digital advertising, social media marketing, SEO, SEM and lead generation.

Strong commercial mindset with the ability to connect marketing activities with student enrolment and revenue.

Experience in education, sports, enrichment, fitness, children's services or other B2C industries will be an advantage.

Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate campaign performance and marketing ROI.

Experience managing agencies, vendors or internal marketing teams is preferred.

Knowledge of rhythmic gymnastics or the gymnastics industry is an advantage but not essential.

Ability to work in a fast-paced and growth-oriented environment.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance may be measured based on:

Number of qualified student enquiries

Trial class bookings

Trial-to-enrolment conversion

New student enrolment

Customer acquisition cost

Marketing-generated revenue

Digital advertising performance and ROI

Website traffic and organic search growth

Social media reach and engagement

Partnership and referral channel development

Student retention and re-enrolment support

Overall brand awareness and market presence

What We Offer

Senior marketing leadership position within a growing rhythmic gymnastics academy.

Opportunity to shape the brand and marketing strategy of AWA Gymnastics.

Exposure to both recreational and competitive rhythmic gymnastics programmes.

Opportunity to work with an international coaching team and develop partnerships within the sports and education sectors.

Performance-driven career development opportunities.

Dynamic working environment combining education, sports, events and international competition.

AWA Gymnastics

welcomes experienced marketing professionals who are passionate about brand building, business growth, sports education and developing meaningful experiences for students and families.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Job Summary

NPR Singapore Pte. Ltd. is seeking a motivated and results-oriented Sales Executive to support its automotive and marine engine spare-parts business. The product portfolio includes piston rings, cylinder liners, and other products handled through direct sales, trading and indent operations.

The successful candidate will manage existing customer and supplier relationships,develop new business opportunities, and contribute to sales growth across Singapore and regional markets, including Southeast Asia, the UAE, Sri Lanka,India and Australia.

This is a regional sales position involving customer visits, business-development activities and regular overseas travel. Candidates must be willing and able totravel overseas based on business requirements.

The ideal candidate is self-driven, adaptable and commercially minded, with the ability to understand technical customer requirements, prepare quotations, negotiate effectively and provide responsive sales support.

Key Responsibilities

Manage and develop relationships with existing customers, prospective customers and suppliers.

Achieve assigned sales targets and identify new business opportunities within designated territories and markets.

Manage sales activities for automotive and marine engine spare parts, including piston rings, cylinder liners, trading and indent operations.

Develop business opportunities across Singapore and regional markets, including Malaysia, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, the UAE, Sri Lanka, India and Australia. Market coverage may be adjusted according to the Company’s business requirements.

Plan and carry out sales and marketing activities in accordance with the Company’s business strategies and objectives.

Conduct customer visits, product presentations and business-development meetings in Singapore and overseas.

Understand customers’ technical and commercial requirements and recommend suitable products and solutions.

Handle customer enquiries, address objections, negotiate commercial terms and follow through on sales opportunities.

Prepare accurate quotations, pricing proposals and discount calculations in accordance with the Company’s approval procedures.

Coordinate with customers, suppliers, Sales Administration, Warehouse, Accounts and other internal departments to support order fulfilment and customer service.

Monitor market developments, customer requirements, competitor activities and potential business opportunities, and provide regular reports to the Sales Manager.

Maintain accurate sales records, customer information, quotations, visit reports, forecasts and other required documentation.

Use Microsoft Excel and other approved digital or AI-enabled tools to support sales analysis, reporting, market research and customer engagement.

Demonstrate initiative, resilience, accountability, self-discipline and professional conduct in achieving sales objectives.

Travel within Singapore and overseas as required. Regular overseas travel is an essential requirement of this position, with the frequency and duration determined by business needs.

Perform other reasonable duties related to the position as assigned by the Sales Manager or Company.

Qualifications and Requirements

Diploma in Engineering or a related technical discipline.

Preferably 6–8 years of relevant experience in technical sales, account management, business development or customer service within the automotive, marine, engineering, spare-parts, trading or related industries.

Experience in regional sales or managing overseas customers will be an advantage.

Valid Singapore Class 3 driving licence and willingness to drive for authorised business activities.

Willingness and ability to undertake regular overseas business travel.

Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and customer-relationship management skills.

Commercially aware, customer-focused and able to understand technical product information.

Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel.

Familiarity with data-analysis functions such as Power Query or Power Pivot, and approved digital or AI tools, will be an advantage.

Self-motivated, results-oriented and able to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

Other Information

·

Working days:

Monday to Friday,five-day work week

·

Working hours:

8:15 a.m. to5:45 p.m., including a one-hour meal break

·

Work arrangements:

The positioninvolves office-based work, customer visits, local travel and overseas businesstravel. Overtime payment is not applicable to this position, subject toapplicable law.

·

Salary:

S$3,800 to S$4,500 permonth, depending on qualifications, relevant experience and demonstratedcapabilities

·

Commission and AWS:

No sales commission or AWS is payable for this position

·

Performance bonus:

A discretionary annual performance bonus may be awarded based on the Company’sperformance and the employee’s individual performance

title: Supply Chain Planning Manager
description:
The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end supply chain planning for the MX business to ensure optimal inventory levels, forecast accuracy and on-time fulfilment. With a sound understanding of demand and supply planning, order-to-cash processes and the supporting systems from Suwon supply to channel sell-out, he/she will manage the SCM planning role for the business and collaborate with cross-functional teams in Sales, Product Marketing, Logistics, Finance and Suwon and SEAO Regional Office to achieve division KPIs and expectations.

Role Responsibilities:

To deliver on following KPIs:

(a) Forecast Accuracy

(b) Weeks of Stock (WOS) & Aged Inventory

(c) Order Fulfilment & Out-of-Stock

Manage demand forecasting (AP2) by coordinating short, mid and long-term forecasts with Sales and Product Marketing teams, aligned to monthly, quarterly and yearly business targets.

Lead weekly SCM meetings and Channel PSI reviews, providing a clear view of sell-in, sell-out and inventory status against business targets.

Provide accurate Weeks of Stock (WOS) simulation based on sell-in and sell-out, and manage aged inventory with Product and Sales teams on exit strategy.

Manage supply allocation, order fulfilment and new product launch readiness in line with customer requirements and delivery schedules.

Work closely with Suwon, Logistics and 3PL partners on inbound capacity, stock transfers and outbound prioritisation to minimise out-of-stock and delivery delays.

Coordinate and maintain constant communications with all stakeholders (SESP, SEAO Regional Office and Suwon) on supply status, issues and escalations.

Drive SCM process and system improvements (SAP, automated reporting and dashboards) to improve visibility, efficiency and exception-based management.

Contribute towards change management initiatives to achieve operational excellence.

Role Requirements:

Degree in Business, Supply Chain Management or related discipline

5 to 10 years of experience in Supply Chain, Demand/Supply Planning or related operations

MS Office, advance capability particularly in Excel

SAP(SD/MM), ERP and BI tools knowledge is advantageous

Strong communication, stakeholder management and analysis skills

Proficiency in Korean is required due to close collaboration with Global HQ stakeholders in South Korea.

title: Head of Marketing and Communications (Singapore and Indonesia)
description:
About The Role

Lead marketing and communications for CBRE across Singapore and Indonesia, and position the company as the pre-eminent real estate thought leader in both markets. Using earned and owned media, digital and social channels, events and research-led content, you will build share of voice and turn CBRE’s market intelligence into commercial advantage.

Armed with strong media relationships, you will identify opportunities to profile subject matter experts and work closely with them to deliver differentiated points of view on the real estate industry. You will lead a team of five to eight marketing and communications professionals, own the country marketing budget, and act as a trusted adviser to country and business line leadership.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role in a matrix environment. You will set strategy and stay close enough to the work to deliver it.

What You’ll Do

Strategy and business partnering

‒ Develop and deliver an integrated, ROI-focused marketing and communications strategy across Singapore and Indonesia, covering public relations, digital and social, events, internal communications and brand.

‒ Partner country leadership and business line leaders so that marketing and communications operates as a business enabler rather than a service desk.

‒ Own and manage the country marketing budget, with clear reporting of spend against outcomes.

‒ Set the measurement standard for the function, covering share of voice, campaign performance, event contribution to pipeline and digital engagement, and report against it to leadership each quarter.

‒ Contribute to regional marketing and communications initiatives and project roll-outs across Asia Pacific.

Public relations and media

‒ Act as the key media liaison in Singapore and Indonesia, identifying and pitching stories and securing profiling opportunities for business leaders.

‒ Develop compelling messages, media releases, media responses, byline articles and speeches for senior management.

‒ Build and maintain relationships with tier-one business, property and trade media across both markets.

‒ Manage PR agency partners, including scope, performance, deliverables and budget.

‒ Support regional and global teams on issues and crisis communications, preparing local statements, briefing spokespeople and managing local media response, escalating in line with CBRE protocol.

‒ Maintain spokesperson briefing materials and question-and-answer documents, and arrange media training for senior leaders.

Events and industry engagement

‒ Own the events strategy end to end, from flagship client events and research launches to executive roundtables, industry sponsorships and internal town halls.

‒ Manage event budgets, venue and vendor selection, run of show, speaker preparation and post-event follow-up, with clear measurement of commercial return.

‒ Develop an influencer and industry body engagement strategy, including CBRE’s presence and speaking platforms at key industry events in both markets.

Content, research marketing and digital

‒ Work with CBRE Research to turn market intelligence into campaign-ready content and to build launch moments around flagship reports.

‒ Drive lead generation through social and digital channels, working with regional digital teams on campaign build, targeting, marketing technology and reporting.

‒ Act as brand custodian for both markets, maintaining CBRE brand standards across every piece of external and internal output.

‒ Support business development and pursuit teams with marketing collateral and credentials for major client bids.

Internal communications and employer brand

‒ Drive internal communications for employee engagement, change communications and leadership visibility.

‒ Strengthen CBRE’s employer brand in partnership with the People team, supporting recruitment and retention priorities.

Team leadership

‒ Lead, coach and develop a team of five to eight professionals across PR, digital, events and internal communications.

‒ Set objectives, manage performance and build capability and succession within the team.

‒ Provide direction and quality control across all local marketing initiatives and campaigns.

What You’ll Need

Experience: essential

‒ Degree holder with 12 to 14 years’ experience in marketing and communications.

‒ Within that, a minimum of three to four years leading public relations and events at a senior level, with direct accountability for media strategy and for flagship event delivery.

‒ Experience gained in a multinational or large listed organisation with multiple stakeholders, matrix reporting and regional or global reporting lines. This is a requirement, not a preference.

‒ Proven record of managing PR and event agencies, including briefing, performance management and budget control.

‒ Demonstrated ownership of a marketing budget, with the ability to report return on that spend.

‒ People leadership experience, having managed a team of five or more.

‒ Established media relationships in Singapore, with proven ability to secure tier-one coverage.

Experience: advantageous

‒ Indonesia market exposure, or a demonstrated track record of building media relationships in a new market.

‒ Real estate, professional services, financial services or agency background.

‒ Experience supporting issues or crisis communications within an established corporate protocol.

‒ Bahasa Indonesia or Mandarin in addition to strong written and spoken English in view of the in-country market communications.

Skills and attributes

‒ Proven expertise in social and digital marketing, including campaign measurement and marketing technology platforms.

‒ Credible with senior stakeholders, and comfortable advising and constructively challenging country and business line leadership.

‒ Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a dynamic environment with competing priorities.

‒ A positive, can-do attitude and readiness to roll up the sleeves and get the job done.

‒ Willingness to travel between Singapore and Indonesia as the role requires.

Why CBRE

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

Applicant AI Use Disclosure

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

OUR VALUES IN HIRING

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

title: Ad Sales Planner
description:

JOB DETAILS

Role: Ad Sales Planner

Contract Type: Permanent, Full-Time

WE ARE BBC STUDIOS

A globally renowned media company borne of the BBC. We make and distribute the world's most sought-after TV, audio and digital content.

Our ambition is to be the home of the most powerful, entertaining, and inspiring stories for people all around the world.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Ad Sales Planner is a critical member of the APAC Advertising Sales team, supporting revenue growth across BBC Studios' portfolio of television, digital, audio, sponsorship, branded content and audience solutions. Working closely with sales, clients, agencies and internal stakeholders, the role supports the full advertising sales cycle, from proposal development and campaign planning through to execution, reporting and post-campaign analysis.

The APAC region presents a significant growth opportunity through a dual-pronged strategy of expanding our base of premium television advertisers while accelerating growth across BBC Studios' evolving digital, audience, data and content marketing solutions. As a result, this role plays an important part in helping clients better understand and access BBC Studios' unique audiences, premium content environments and advertising capabilities.

The successful candidate will combine strong commercial acumen, attention to detail and client management skills with a passion for media, content, audience insights and advertising innovation. They will become a trusted partner to the sales team, supporting business growth while ensuring the highest standards of campaign execution and client service.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT

1. Commercial Sales Planning & Client Solutions (55%)

Support the APAC Advertising Sales team in developing strategic advertising solutions that drive revenue growth across television, digital, audio, sponsorship, branded content and audience-led opportunities.

Develop compelling media plans, presentations and commercial proposals in response to client and agency briefs.
Translate client marketing objectives into integrated advertising solutions leveraging BBC Studios' content, audience and platform capabilities.
Partner with Sales, Insights, StoryWorks and other internal stakeholders to deliver competitive and commercially effective recommendations.
Support proactive pitches and business development initiatives designed to grow revenue and expand advertiser relationships.
Identify opportunities to introduce clients to BBC Studios' growing suite of audience, data, content and digital advertising solutions.
Review inventory availability and recommend effective advertising, sponsorship and content-led opportunities.
Ensure proposals are commercially sound, accurately costed and aligned with sales objectives.
Support programmatic advertising opportunities and act as a point of contact for agency trading desks where required.
Assist in creating best-in-class sales material that positions BBC Studios as a premium advertising partner across APAC.
Act as a trusted commercial partner to the sales team, anticipating client needs and delivering responsive support throughout the sales process.
2. Campaign Management & Client Service Excellence (30%)

Manage the successful implementation, delivery and optimisation of campaigns while providing exceptional support to clients, agencies and internal stakeholders.

Coordinate campaign setup and execution with Ad Operations, StoryWorks, Compliance and other business functions.
Manage campaign bookings, insertion orders, sponsorship documentation and internal approval processes.
Liaise with clients and agencies to ensure all creative materials and campaign assets are received, approved and delivered on schedule.
Monitor campaign performance and identify optimisation opportunities to maximise campaign outcomes.
Provide timely communication and support throughout the campaign lifecycle.
Troubleshoot campaign delivery issues in partnership with operational teams and communicate resolutions to stakeholders.
Prepare campaign performance reports, transmission reports and post-campaign reviews.
Ensure campaigns are delivered in accordance with contractual commitments and client expectations.
Build strong day-to-day relationships with agencies, advertisers and regional sales representatives.
Act as a reliable first point of contact for campaign-related enquiries and operational support.
3. Commercial Reporting, Sales Operations & Business Support (15%)

Provide accurate reporting, financial coordination and operational support to enable effective decision-making and seamless commercial execution.

Prepare and distribute campaign performance reports, post-campaign analyses, transmission reports and revenue tracking updates.
Support the sales team with audience insights, market intelligence and competitor monitoring to strengthen client conversations and commercial outcomes.
Partner closely with Finance to support billing accuracy, invoice reconciliation, revenue recognition processes and client payment enquiries.
Coordinate client onboarding requirements and ensure all necessary commercial documentation, contracts and compliance processes are completed.
Maintain accurate information across CRM, booking, reporting and sales management systems.
Support regional business reporting requirements and sales administration processes.
Ensure consistency with BBC Studios' commercial policies, reporting standards and product messaging across APAC.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and sales effectiveness.
Success Measures

The Ad Sales Planner will be successful when they:

Deliver high-quality, strategic media plans that contribute to revenue growth across APAC.
Become a trusted commercial partner to the sales team and a valued contact for clients and agencies.
Contribute to the growth of both premium television advertising and emerging digital, audience and content-led revenue streams.
Maintain high standards of campaign delivery, reporting accuracy and client satisfaction.
Drive operational excellence through efficient processes, accurate forecasting and strong financial coordination.
Provide actionable insights that strengthen BBC Studios' commercial proposition and market position.
Support the achievement of regional revenue targets through outstanding planning, execution, campaign servicing and stakeholder management.
YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Essential

Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
Experience within a media owner, publisher, agency or advertising environment preferred.
Strong interest in media, advertising, content marketing and audience strategy.
Excellent organisational, administrative and project management skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Commercially minded with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Numerate and data-driven, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Ability to interpret campaign performance data and convert insights into actionable recommendations.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple teams and markets.
Self-starter with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.
Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment.
Fluent written and spoken English.

Desirable

Experience in digital advertising, broadcast advertising, audio advertising or programmatic media.
Understanding of media planning, campaign management or advertising operations.
Familiarity with audience measurement, analytics and reporting platforms.
Knowledge of branded content, sponsorship and content marketing solutions.
Experience working with CRM, ad-serving, booking or sales management systems.

Passion for media, technology and emerging advertising trends.

title: Business Development & Growth Intern
description:
Business Development & Growth Intern

LAURENE Living | Singapore | Performance-Based

Are you energetic, entrepreneurial and excited by the idea of helping build a lifestyle brand from the ground up?

LAURENE Living is a Singapore-based botanical home & lifestyle brand creating premium, modern products designed to bring a sense of calm and freshness into everyday spaces.

We are looking for an

energetic, commercially minded and entrepreneurial individual

to work directly with the founder and help take LAURENE Living from a small founder-led business to a scalable brand.

This is

not a conventional office internship

. You will have the opportunity to get involved in real business development, sales, product development, AI and eventually building a scalable operating model.

Our digital marketing is already supported by an external marketing agency.

Your primary focus will therefore be the physical, human side of the business — getting the products into people's hands, letting customers experience the scent and developing opportunities that cannot be achieved purely online.

What you will do

PHASE 1 — Physical Business Development & Sales

Your initial focus will be getting LAURENE Living physically in front of potential customers.

You may:

Introduce and demonstrate our products at suitable offline opportunities

Approach potential corporate clients, boutiques, lifestyle businesses, events and communities

Organise product sampling and scent experiences

Identify potential retail, corporate gifting and partnership opportunities

Speak directly with potential customers and understand their feedback

Build a database of potential business leads and partnership opportunities

Test different offline sales approaches and report what works

Represent the LAURENE Living brand professionally and confidently

The key objective: get people to experience the products physically and convert that experience into sales and partnerships.

PHASE 2 — Product Making & Development

As you become familiar with the brand, you may be trained to assist with the

production of LAURENE Living products

using the founder's formulations and processes.

This could include:

Preparing products according to established formulations

Learning our production and quality-control process

Assisting with small-batch production

Understanding product costing and margins

Helping improve production efficiency

Maintaining consistency and quality

You will be working with established formulations and processes rather than independently creating or modifying formulas without approval.

PHASE 3 — Build a Scalable Business Model

The longer-term objective is to move beyond the founder personally making and selling every product.

You will help explore:

How production can be delegated to other people

Training and standardising production processes

Developing simple SOPs

Creating a repeatable sales model

Building partnerships and distribution channels

Improving unit economics and margins

Using AI and automation to reduce administrative work

Developing a model that can grow without everything depending on the founder

The goal is to help turn LAURENE Living from a founder-operated business into a scalable business.

PHASE 4 — Regional Expansion

If the business reaches the appropriate stage, you may become involved in exploring expansion into other markets.

This could include:

Market research

Identifying potential distributors and partners

Testing demand in other countries

Understanding local customer preferences

Exploring regional e-commerce and retail opportunities

Supporting the development of an APAC expansion model

Who we are looking for

You may be a good fit if you are:

Energetic, outgoing and comfortable speaking to strangers

Naturally curious and commercially minded

Comfortable approaching people and starting conversations

Presentable and confident in customer-facing situations

Interested in

marketing, business, design, entrepreneurship or technology

Interested in

AI and how AI can be used to build a better business

Comfortable working independently without being given instructions for every task

Resourceful — you see a problem and think of a way to solve it

Interested in building something rather than simply completing assigned tasks

Comfortable with a fast-moving, founder-led environment

Interested in eventually building a career in

technology, startups, entrepreneurship or business development

Students and recent graduates are welcome to apply.

Marketing, business, design, communications, entrepreneurship, technology or related backgrounds are particularly relevant.

This opportunity is different

You will work directly with the founder of LAURENE Living and see how a business is built from the ground up.

You will get exposure to:

Business Development → Sales → Product → Operations → AI → Scaling → Regional Expansion

If you are ambitious, this can potentially develop into a

long-term role with increasing responsibility

as the business grows.

Compensation

This is currently structured as a

part-time / freelance entrepreneurial opportunity as an internship

, with compensation primarily linked to business results.

The initial structure may include:

Commission on sales generated

Performance-based incentives

Profit-sharing arrangements for appropriate projects

A small stipend or other compensation may be discussed depending on experience, commitment and scope

The longer-term compensation structure can evolve as the business grows and your responsibilities increase.

This is not intended to be a traditional fixed-salary internship.

Working arrangement

Singapore-based

Part-time / freelance initially

Flexible hours, with a significant focus on offline business development

Some work can be done remotely

Physical meetings / product activities will take place in Singapore

Potential for a longer-term role if there is strong mutual fit

Location for interview

Physical interview in Singapore required.

Interview locations:

Tanjong Pagar or Somerset

How to apply

Please send:

Your CV or LinkedIn profile

A short introduction about yourself

Why you are interested in LAURENE Living

Your current studies / work situation

Your availability

One idea for how you would get

20 people in Singapore to smell and experience LAURENE Living products within your first month

We are particularly interested in people who

take initiative rather than wait for instructions.

This is a small business with a big ambition. If you want to help build something rather than simply work in something, we would like to hear from you.

LAURENE Living

is a Singapore-based modern botanical home & lifestyle brand creating thoughtfully crafted products that elevate everyday spaces.

Inspired by nature, calm and modern living, we create premium home essentials designed to bring a sense of freshness and wellbeing into everyday routines. Our approach combines thoughtful product design, botanical ingredients and a clean, contemporary aesthetic.

As a growing founder-led brand, we are building LAURENE Living with a long-term ambition to expand beyond Singapore. We are exploring new retail, corporate, partnership and regional opportunities while using technology and AI to build a more efficient and scalable business.

We are looking for entrepreneurial people who want to be part of building a brand — not simply working in one.

title: Creative & Content Intern
description:
Company Description

At Fresh, we create beauty products that perform with experiences that transform.

Born in Boston, Raised in New York. What began as a small collection in a neighborhood shop by our founders Lev & Alina, has evolved into a full lifestyle line of skincare, lip care, bodycare, and fragrance sold all over the world.

The sensoriality of our products—their textures and scents—sets us apart. It’s this combination of high efficacy and amazing sensations that we’re known for, and why those who know us love us. Lev says fresh creates products people don’t know they need—and then can’t live without. Our founders still work with the brand every day to fulfill their original dream of making beauty that performs and transforms.

We are driven by our never complacent indie spirit where the sky's the limit. This approach is initiated by Lev and Alina and lived by the entire organization. Our boundless curiosity fuels our search for the extraordinary, whether it’s a moment of pleasure in nature or an experience of generosity in our shops. Where fresh goes, beauty follows. We’re pioneers—in product, in experience, in culture, and in process.

We believe that fresh is more than what it sells; it’s the emotional connection to the brand that we call the sixth sense. It’s the heartfelt experience we craft for our people and our guests.

Fresh is a brand of LVMH group worldwide. In SEA, it is managed through LBeauty Pte Ltd, a joint venture between LVMH group and Luxasia.

Job Description

We are looking for a highly driven, dynamic and passionate Creative & Content Intern. The role will join the Fresh SEA-Oceania marketing & creative team that drives and supports all creative development (digital, collaterals and in store content) for Fresh in the region. Being a part of Fresh Creative team, you should be passionate about beauty and will be responsible to translate brand communication objectives into creative fresh inspired, compelling content that will connect with our audience.

Job Description

Brainstorm and collaborate with the team to conceptualize compelling social content to develop engaging content that resonates across platforms like TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and EDM.
Conceptualize, visualize, design and execute creative content and layouts to support SEA-Oceania regional marketing campaigns
Attuned to latest social and beauty trends and tap on the pulse of culture
Create storyboards, shot lists, and pre-production materials for both site content and social-first content. Create timelines, shooting schedules and storyboards. Manage every phase of production from ideation, scripting, filming to post-production.
Utilize photography and videography skills for marketing campaigns, including post-production and editing.
Capture and edit original video content and have a hand in all phases of video production from pre-to-post (filming, editing, color correction, sound design, etc.)
Design and produce marketing collaterals for print and digital, including websites, EDM, social media, brochures, banners, packaging print and other marketing materials and understand market design preferences
Be the driver of “think outside the box” ideas, oftentimes thinking ahead of the curve, steering trend curation and thumb-stopping content audiences want to rewatch, share, and continuously tune in
Highly proficient to shoot, edit and create short-form videos for social media platforms
Work closely with regional team to maintain high production standards
Troubleshoot technical issues when needed and work with the team on revisions through delivery.
Researching and compiling social trends, ideas, competitors’ best-in-class examples, and cutting-edge executions to inform and propose new content

Qualifications

Requirements:

Able to commit for a 6 months full time internship from Jan 2027 to Jun 2027
Photography, videography, editing or creative content skills. Ability to leverage AI in content creation is a plus.
A strong visual mindset and understanding of the wider landscape of beauty video
Strong communication skills and ability to take creative direction and bring it to life through video editing
Strong understanding of frame composition (lighting, angles, negative space, photo clarity/depth of frame)
Strong understanding of studio tools such as ring lights, tripods, props, backdrops, etc.
Excellent verbal communication skills and ability to clearly articulate and document technical processes and issues
Exceptional time-management and multi-tasking abilities
Expertise in tools and processes for creative assets and content workflows.
Degree or diploma in design courses or relevant.
Strong understanding & skilled in Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, inDesign, After Effects
Experienced with DSLR or mirrorless cameras to shoot photos and videos for social media content, able to use basic lighting and audio equipment
Creative, passionate, independent and resourceful
A knack for creative storytelling and the ability to articulate rationales for designs.
Ability to prioritize and multi-task in a flexible, fast paced and dynamic environment
Detail-oriented and able to work proactively and effectively with minimal supervision
Able to work independently or with a team.
Enjoy and excel in a fast-paced, environment. Target-driven and good in deadline management.
Fresh graduates with high potential will be considered

title: Project Coordinator (WHP Internship)
description:
Job Description
Posting Start Date: 12/10/2026
Brand: MCI
Country/Region: Singapore
Work Location: Singapore
Workplace Type: Hybrid
Contract type: Intern
Job Function: Project Management
Information at a Glance

We are a global engagement and marketing agency that creates human-centric touchpoints that unleash the power of people to deliver innovation and growth.
Firm believers in the power of building community since 1987, we are helping brands, associations and not-for-profit organisations solve their key people challenges through our core expertise: Live & virtual events, Strategic & digital communications and Consulting & community solutions.

We are an independently owned agency, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, with a global presence of 60 offices in 31 countries.

THE OPPORTUNITY

AMC is a division within MCI that provides consultancy and event management services to associations active in the Asia Pacific Region.

The Project Coordinator will assist in providing professional membership service support to client association clients served by AMC. In addition to the key duties and responsibilities, he/she will assist the team to schedule meetings, conduct research and maintain working relationship with clients. Candidates must be available to commit to a 6 month full time internship.

THE WORK

Operations (30%)

Work with other functional managers on initiatives to improve aspects of MCI and the clients’ business.
Represent Business Support department on any operational matters or meetings in the event of the Business Support Manager’s absence.
Perform all duties and responsibilities and others as assigned by Business Support Manager in a timely, accurate and efficient manner.
Disseminate information received from client contact point to the team members in a timely manner and ensures that the team members are fully briefed on the information received.
Execute project from start to finish, analyzing data and present findings.

Stakeholder Engagement (25%)

Provide membership support service on behalf of AMC associations clients and their members.
Identify client needs and propose strategies to meet their various project objectives.
Provide regional product knowledge and technical expertise to client(s) for compliance issues and to management and other functions for market research purposes.
Attends to member complaints received by team members.
Ensures all 2nd level escalations are followed up and resolved timely and accurately.
Manage telemarketing, translation, and other operational assistance projects.

Market Development (35%)

Maintain and improve performance level by identifying key trends and forecasts business needs through developing strategic, accurate and actionable data analysis.

Identify opportunities, challenges, and workflow issues. Propose solutions with relevant functions and/or divisions.
Communicates performance against objective with the individual team members and constantly monitors performance in terms of agreed key performance indicators.

Strategy Development (10%)

Plan for effective use of resources, anticipating resource needs to ensure consistent delivery of service standards are met and exceeded every day.

THE HIVE

The Project Coordinator reports to the Deputy Director and works closely with the AMC team internally.

THE MUST HAVE

Well-rounded individuals pursuing a degree in Hospitality, Tourism or MICE
Experience within the hospitality or MICE service sector, non-profit, NGO, association will be advantageous and the ability to adapt to changing needs and demands of key stakeholders/membership is important.
Quick, efficient, and accurate in all administrative duties

THE GOOD TO HAVE

Great customer service mind-set and proactive disposition
Superior verbal and written communication skills are essential as success is dependent upon developing positive relationships and communicating with a wide variety of stakeholders related to the association.

Well-developed organizational and leadership skills
Database management experience is beneficial

MCI is where you can bring your true self to work and be proud of what you do. Join us and make a difference!

title: Business Development Executive
description:
About UnlockLand

UnlockLand is a Singapore-based AI technology company building software for land development, urban planning and pre-development decision-making.

Our platform combines planning policies, land data, development evidence and AI-powered workflows to help developers, planners and public-sector organisations make better decisions.

We are looking for an experienced Account Executive to develop UnlockLand’s enterprise and public-sector business in Singapore.

Job Summary

The Account Executive will be responsible for building strategic relationships, identifying customer needs and converting opportunities into POCs, pilots and long-term contracts.

This is a full-cycle business development and enterprise sales role. You will work with government agencies, statutory boards, property developers, infrastructure companies and other built-environment organisations.

An existing and relevant network in Singapore is essential.

Key Responsibilities

Build and manage relationships with Singapore government agencies, statutory boards, property developers and infrastructure organisations.

Develop relationships with relevant stakeholders at organisations such as URA, JTC, HDB, LTA, GovTech, CapitaLand and other major industry participants.

Identify decision-makers, understand their priorities and create qualified business opportunities.

Lead client discovery meetings, workshops, presentations and product demonstrations.

Understand customer needs relating to planning, land, development, data and operational workflows.

Work with the product and planning teams to design relevant solutions and POCs.

Develop account plans, business cases, commercial proposals and sales strategies.

Own opportunities from initial engagement through POC, pilot, procurement, negotiation and signed contract.

Coordinate internal and external stakeholders throughout the sales process.

Navigate enterprise and public-sector procurement and tender processes.

Maintain accurate sales pipelines, stakeholder maps and account records.

Build long-term relationships that support renewals, expansion and strategic partnerships.

Represent UnlockLand professionally at client meetings, conferences and industry events.

Requirements

Professional experience in enterprise sales, business development, partnerships or strategic accounts.

Existing and verifiable relationships with Singapore government agencies, statutory boards, property developers or infrastructure organisations.

Experience accessing and communicating with senior decision-makers.

Proven ability to create opportunities through direct relationships and business development.

Experience managing enterprise sales cycles from discovery through POC, pilot, procurement and contract signing.

Strong ability to understand customer needs and translate them into practical business or technology solutions.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong presentation, negotiation, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Professional and confident when representing the company in senior-level meetings.

Commercially driven, organised and accountable for business results.

Able to work independently in a fast-moving startup environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience selling enterprise software, AI, data products, PropTech or planning technology.

Experience working with URA, JTC, HDB, LTA, GovTech or major Singapore property developers.

Understanding of Singapore’s urban planning, land development, infrastructure or real estate ecosystem.

Experience delivering government or enterprise POCs and pilot projects.

Familiarity with public-sector procurement, tenders and enterprise purchasing processes.

Experience working with technology, consulting, planning or built-environment solutions.

Professional proficiency in Mandarin is an advantage.

This Role May Not Be Suitable If

Your experience is mainly in digital marketing, advertising or inbound lead handling.

You do not have relevant relationships within Singapore’s government, property or infrastructure sectors.

You have not previously managed enterprise opportunities through POC, procurement and contract negotiation.

You are looking for a role focused only on making introductions without owning commercial outcomes.

What Success Looks Like

Creating qualified access to relevant senior decision-makers.

Converting customer discussions into structured POCs and pilots.

Managing opportunities through procurement and commercial negotiation.

Converting successful pilots into paid enterprise contracts.

Building long-term strategic relationships and expanding customer accounts.

Establishing UnlockLand as a trusted AI technology partner in Singapore’s built environment.

What We Offer

The opportunity to represent an AI-native Singapore technology company.

Direct exposure to government, infrastructure and real estate organisations.

Ownership of strategic accounts from first engagement to signed contract.

The opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, planning and real estate.

A fast-moving environment with significant autonomy and responsibility.

Opportunities to contribute to regional and international expansion.

UNLOCKLAND is a Singapore-headquartered, AI-native software company building a decision platform for real estate development.

Our platform helps real estate developers discover opportunities, evaluate land, compare development scenarios, and make faster, smarter, and lower-risk investment decisions.

We connect parcel, planning, market, and development evidence to the workflows that turn land into a complete, reviewable opportunity.

Our data coverage currently spans 15 global markets across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East, including Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, New Zealand, the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, France, the Netherlands, Denmark, Norway, Finland, and Saudi Arabia.

We are expanding rapidly across new markets, deeper data coverage, and more connected development workflows.

title: Senior Commercial Associate , Financial Institutions ( APAC)
description:
About the position

Aurora Energy Research is seeking a Senior Commercial Associate to drive the growth of our Financial Institutions business across the APAC. Working within Aurora's Global Financial Institutions Team, you will develop strategic relationships with leading financial institutions supporting the energy transition across APAC. You will own Aurora's APAC Financial Institutions portfolio, managing a combination of strategic accounts and high-priority prospects. You will lead complex commercial engagements and work closely with Aurora's market leads, research, advisory, software, and product teams to support investment and financing decisions across the region.

This is a highly autonomous role suited to an experienced commercial professional who combines strong relationship-building skills with dedication, strategic mindset, excellent business development capabilities, and a genuine interest in energy markets and project finance. You will join an entrepreneurial, international, and fast-growing organisation at the forefront of the global energy transition, with significant opportunities for professional development and progression.

Key responsibilities

Strategic Account Management

Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across major financial institutions in your region.

Develop a deep understanding of client organisations, priorities, challenges, and decision-making processes.

Expand Aurora's relationships across multiple stakeholder groups to maximise account value and long-term retention.

Drive cross-selling and upselling opportunities across Aurora's subscription, software, advisory, and bankability offerings.

Business Development & Commercial Growth

Lead business development activities with major financial institutions across APAC, generating new opportunities and expanding Aurora's regional footprint.

Develop and execute account and market engagement strategies for strategic clients, priority prospects, and target financial institution segments across APAC.

Identify emerging market trends, investment themes, and financing activity to proactively create commercial opportunities.

Manage the full sales cycle, from opportunity qualification through proposal development, negotiation, contracting, and closing.

Deliver against individual and team revenue targets.

Represent Aurora at industry conferences, financing events, client workshops, and stakeholder meetings across APAC.

Bankability

Help facilitating financing transactions that utilise Aurora's analytics, software, and advisory services.

Maintain a strong understanding of project finance fundamentals, due diligence processes, lender requirements, and market trends influencing energy investments.

Contribute to maintaining Aurora's bankability proposition by tracking the use of Aurora's analysis in financing transactions and sharing insights across teams.

Organise banking roundtables and market engagement initiatives that strengthen Aurora's relationships within the financial institutions community.

Help position Aurora as a trusted thought partner in energy finance and energy market analysis.

Provide market intelligence and client insights to inform Aurora's product strategy, commercial priorities, and regional growth plans.

Internal Leadership & Collaboration

Establish yourself as Aurora's subject matter expert for Financial Institutions and bankability topics within your region.

Develop and maintain market-specific Financial Institutions and Bankability Strategies for key APAC markets, including tailored approaches to client engagement, marketing and content.

Collaborate closely with Market Leads and Aurora's research, advisory, software, product, and commercial teams to execute regional strategies.

Contribute to the continuous improvement of commercial processes, tools, and ways of working across the Global FI Team and the wider commercial organisation.

What we are looking for

Required attributes:

Strong commercial mindset with a proven track record in business development, sales, and account management.

Demonstrated ability to build credibility and long-term relationships with senior stakeholders at financial institutions.

Excellent coordination, communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.

Ability to operate independently and drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

Highly organised, proactive, and resilient, with strong attention to detail.

Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and functions.

Passion for delivering exceptional client experiences and building long-term partnerships.

Strong interest in energy markets, project finance, infrastructure investment, and the energy transition, with a proactive approach to continuous learning and development.

Fluency in English and additional APAC language capabilities, particularly Japanese, Mandarin, Korean

Experience

5+ years of experience in business development, sales, account management, client relationship management, or related commercial roles.

Experience working with financial institutions, infrastructure investors, financial advisors, project finance teams, or energy market participants.

Demonstrated success managing strategic client relationships, executing account strategies, and delivering commercial growth.

Experience negotiating commercial agreements and structured proposals.

Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM systems.

Desirable attributes:

Existing network within APAC-based banks, financial advisors, infrastructure investors, debt funds, insurers, or energy-focused financial institutions.

Understanding of project finance, debt financing, due diligence, or investment processes within renewable energy, storage, power markets, or broader energy infrastructure.

Experience selling subscription-based research, software, data, analytics, consulting, or information services.

Exposure to APAC power markets and energy market fundamentals.

Experience developing market engagement or commercial growth strategies.

What we offer

The opportunity to substantially influence major decisions in the energy sector

Direct engagement with clients through Aurora conferences, workshops and webinars all around Europe

The opportunity to grow into a publicly visible industry expert

A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture

A competitive salary package

Access to regular coaching and mentoring sessions and the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals

Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.

Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects

description:

Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

title: Senior/Executive, Business Development & Partnerships
description:
Senior/Executive, Business Development & Partnerships

Singapore Environment Council (SEC)

Grow Sustainability. Grow Your Career.

The Singapore Environment Council (SEC) is an independent, non-profit organisation dedicated to promoting environmental sustainability and responsible business practices. Through certification programmes, sustainability initiatives and stakeholder engagement, SEC works with organisations across industries to drive positive environmental impact.

We are looking for a driven, results-oriented

Senior/Executive, Business Development & Partnerships

to grow SEC's certification, sustainability and advisory business. If you enjoy opening doors, closing deals and building partnerships that create real environmental impact, we would like to hear from you.

If you have a passion for client engagement, business development and sustainability, we would like to hear from you.

About the Role

As a Senior/Executive, Client Engagement & Business Development, you will play an important role in growing SEC's certification and sustainability services. You will engage clients and partners, develop new business opportunities, support agreement development, and provide administrative support to ensure smooth departmental operations.

This is an individual contributor position with sales targets and opportunities to develop expertise in sustainability certification programmes and environmental standards.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Sales

Identify, qualify and pursue new business opportunities across SEC's certification, sustainability and advisory service offerings.

Achieve individual sales targets and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospects.

Generate leads through networking, outreach, industry events and targeted campaigns.

Conduct presentations and pitches to organisations interested in SEC's programmes and services.

Build and maintain relationships with new and existing clients to secure renewals and expand business.

Partnerships & Deal Closing

Develop partnerships with industry associations, corporates, government agencies and other stakeholders.

Draft, format and negotiate business agreements, Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs) and partnership proposals.

Work with internal stakeholders and external parties to move agreements through review to finalisation.

Maintain accurate records of agreements, proposals and deal status.

Events & Market Presence

Represent SEC at industry events, exhibitions, networking sessions and stakeholder engagement activities.

Support the planning and execution of major SEC events and programmes to generate leads and partnerships.

Business Operations Support

Prepare sales reports, pipeline updates, presentations and management materials.

Coordinate meetings and follow-up actions with the Deputy Director, Client Engagement.

Support departmental projects and initiatives as required.

What We're Looking For

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Sustainability, or a related discipline.

At least 3 years of experience in business development, sales, partnerships or account management, with a track record of meeting targets.

Experience selling services in sustainability, certification, compliance, environmental services, professional services or consulting will be an advantage.

Candidates with strong business development experience but no sustainability background are encouraged to apply; we will help you build that expertise.

Skills & Competencies

Proactive and target-driven, comfortable with prospecting and outreach.

Confident presenter and persuasive communicator, in writing and in person.

Able to draft and negotiate business documents with attention to detail.

Works independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Word and Excel.

Manages multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic environment.

Professional and ethical in handling confidential information.

Additional Information

Occasional regional travel may be required for business development, stakeholder engagement and certification-related activities.

Why Join SEC?

Grow a business that directly advances Singapore's sustainability goals.

Work with organisations across multiple industries to drive positive environmental impact.

Build expertise in sustainability certifications and environmental standards.

Be part of a purpose-driven organisation committed to a more sustainable future.

Opportunities for professional development and career growth.

Diversity & Inclusion

Singapore Environment Council is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, gender, race, religion, marital status, caregiving responsibilities, disability status or background. Selection is based on merit, skills, experience and job-related competencies.

Interested applicants are invited to submit a detailed resume outlining their relevant experience and achievements, including sales or partnership results where possible.

Established in 1995, the

Singapore Environment Council (SEC)

is an independently managed, non-profit, non-governmental organisation (NGO) dedicated to fostering a lasting culture of environmental ownership. As an approved

Institution of a Public Character (IPC)

, we serve as a primary catalyst for environmental advocacy and coordinate efforts across Singapore and the region.

We hold a unique position in the global sustainability landscape:

Global Recognition:

We are the only recognised member of the

Global Ecolabelling Network (GEN)

in Singapore, a non-profit association of leading eco-labelling organisations worldwide.

UN Accreditation:

In 2018, the SEC was granted

United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)

accredited environmental NGO status, further amplifying our influence on sustainability issues.

National Impact:

We work closely with government agencies, statutory boards, and industry partners to translate environmental policy into actionable solutions, such as the

Resource Sustainability Act

and

Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)

frameworks.

At SEC, we don't just influence thinking; we drive systemic change. By joining our team, you will be at the heart of Singapore’s transition toward a circular economy and a more sustainable future

title: Aftermarket Product Sales Manager
description:
If you desire to be part of something special, to be part of a winning team, to be part of a fun team – winning is fun. We are looking forward to an Aftermarket Product Sales Manager in Eaton’s Aerospace business, based in Singapore. In Eaton, making our work exciting, engaging, meaningful; ensuring safety, health, wellness; and being a model of inclusion & diversity are already embedded in who we are - it’s in our values, part of our vision, and our clearly defined aspirational goals.

What you’ll do:

Leads the business launch, market development, and profitable growth of aftermarket repair, overhaul, retrofit, modification, and upgrade solutions supported by Eaton Aerospace Component Services Asia (EAS) across the Asia Pacific region.

The Aftermarket Product Sales Manager serves as the commercial business owner for the assigned product lines and aftermarket programs. The position identifies and evaluates market opportunities, develops business and customer capture strategies, establishes pricing approaches, coordinates cross-functional business launch activities, and drives opportunities through execution to achieve order intake, sales, profitability, and market share objectives.

The position works closely with the APAC Sales team, EAS, FMC team, Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Customer Service, and other global stakeholders to translate customer and market requirements into commercially viable aftermarket solutions.

Following the establishment of EAS and the initial deployment of MRO capabilities, the role focuses primarily on launching and sustaining new business, developing the regional opportunity pipeline, expanding customer and product coverage, supporting new repair capability introduction, and ensuring that commercial commitments are converted into sustainable business performance and customer satisfaction.

• Market Development & Opportunity Identification - Identify and prioritize aftermarket repair, upgrade, and service opportunities through market, customer, and competitive analysis to drive profitable growth across APAC.
• Business Development & Customer Capture - Develop customer engagement and capture strategies in partnership with Sales and product teams to convert opportunities into bookings and revenue.
• Opportunity Pipeline Management - Manage the regional opportunity pipeline and drive execution to improve opportunity conversion, forecast accuracy, and business growth.
• Business Launch & Commercial Execution - Lead commercial activities for new business launches, ensuring customer requirements and market opportunities are successfully translated into executable growth plans.
• Capability Expansion & Business Cases - upport new repair capability and service expansion initiatives through market assessments, business case development, and revenue projections.
• Pricing & Commercial Strategy - Develop pricing strategies and commercial proposals that support competitiveness, profitability, and long-term business growth.
• Market Intelligence - Monitor market trends, fleet developments, customer needs, and competitor activities to support strategic decision-making and growth initiatives.
• Forecasting & Business Planning - Prepare forecasts and business analyses that support Profit Plan, SIOP, business reviews, and strategic planning activities.
• Cross-Functional Coordination - Coordinate commercial, operational, and technical stakeholders to support successful business launches and opportunity execution.
• Business Performance Management - Monitor sales, pipeline, pricing, and profitability performance and recommend actions to improve business results and customer satisfaction.
• Customer & Partner Engagement - Support customer engagement and build effective relationships with airlines, MROs, distributors, and strategic partners to expand aftermarket business opportunities.
• Sales Enablement & Knowledge Sharing - Develop sales tools, customer presentations, and training materials to improve commercial effectiveness and organizational capability.

Qualifications:

• Requires a bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing, Aviation, or a related discipline. An MBA or advanced degree is preferred.
• Requires a minimum of five years of relevant experience in sales, product management, business development, marketing, program management, or a related commercial role.

• Requires strong business acumen and the ability to understand customer requirements, market trends, competitive dynamics, business case financials, pricing considerations, and the commercial implications of operational decisions.
• Requires knowledge of the aerospace industry. Experience in aerospace aftermarket, airline maintenance, MRO, component repair, product support, or related service businesses is preferred.
• Requires the ability to conduct market assessments, customer analysis, competitive analysis, opportunity qualification, and business case development.
• Requires the ability to translate market and customer information into practical growth strategies, value propositions, commercial plans, and cross-functional execution actions.
• Requires an understanding of aftermarket business models, including repair and overhaul services, retrofit, modification and upgrade programs, long-term agreements, PBH arrangements, and service capability development.
• Requires demonstrated capability in opportunity pipeline management, sales forecasting, commercial planning, pricing strategy, and performance analysis.
• Requires effective program and project management skills to coordinate business launches, capability expansion activities, customer commitments, and cross-functional deliverables.
• Requires the ability to operate effectively within a global and highly matrixed organization, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and drive alignment across commercial and operational functions.
• Requires strong customer interface skills and the ability to uncover customer needs, frame business problems, develop differentiated solutions, and contribute to winning capture strategies.
• Requires the ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with customers, Sales teams, business leaders, product divisions, operational sites, and strategic partners.
• Requires strong analytical skills and proficiency in interpreting sales, forecast, customer, product, fleet, and financial information.
• Requires strong written and verbal communication, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
• Requires the ability to manage multiple priorities, make recommendations with incomplete information, and maintain execution discipline in a changing business environment.
• Requires proficiency in standard business systems and tools used for customer relationship management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, reporting, presentation development, and data analysis.
• Prefers experience supporting new capability deployment, MRO business launch, commercial integration, or regional expansion initiatives.

title: Health Insurance Specialist
description:
Job Description:

Health Insurance Specialist

Location: Singapore

Permanent

Full time

Hybrid working

Job Purpose:

The Health Insurance Specialist is responsible for working closely with Standard Chartered Bank (SCB) Singapore Relationship Managers and Insurance Specialists to generate qualified customer referrals and deliver sales of the Bupa Global SCB international private medical insurance product to eligible Priority Private and high-net-worth customers.

The role provides needs-based product advice, manages customers through the end-to-end sales and application journey, and delivers regular product and sales training to Standard Chartered Relationship Managers and Insurance Specialists. The role is accountable for achieving assigned sales targets while delivering suitable customer outcomes and complying with Bupa, Standard Chartered and applicable Singapore regulatory requirements.

How you'll help us make health happen:

Build strong working relationships with Standard Chartered Bank Singapore Relationship Managers and Insurance Specialists across the relevant Priority Private and private banking segments.
Develop a consistent pipeline of qualified referrals through regular engagement, branch or banking-centre visits, joint customer activity and structured follow-up.
Deliver regular training to SCB Relationship Managers and Insurance Specialists on the Bupa Global SCB IPMI proposition, customer eligibility, referral processes, sales positioning and approved customer communications.
Support SCB Relationship Managers and Insurance Specialists in identifying customers for whom international private medical insurance may be relevant.
Conduct needs-based customer discussions and recommend a suitable Bupa Global SCB IPMI product in accordance with approved sales, suitability and compliance processes.
Achieve assigned sales, conversion, referral and activity targets.
Manage the full customer journey, including referral follow-up, fact-finding, quotation, application, documentation, underwriting coordination, payment and policy issuance.
Conduct initial eligibility and application-completeness checks and refer medical disclosures or complex cases to Bupa Underwriting.
Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and provide regular reporting on referrals, appointments, conversion, issued business and forecast performance.
Use pipeline data to identify referral or conversion gaps and agree improvement actions with SCB stakeholders and the Senior Health Insurance Specialist.
Work with Bupa Underwriting, Operations, Sales Support, Marketing and Compliance teams to progress cases and resolve issues.
Maintain complete and accurate customer and sales records and comply with applicable data privacy, conduct and regulatory requirements.

o Attention to detail.

• A portfolio link or PDF showcasing recent print design work, including multi-page editorial layouts, prepress projects, and sample photography.
