title: Senior Marketing & Communications Specialist
description:
Overview

ENGIE is a global energy company, a leading provider of electricity, natural gas, and energy services. With 100 000 employees in more than 70 countries worldwide, ENGIE achieved revenue of €95 billion in 2023. ENGIE is committed to being a leader in the energy transition. We are looking for talented and motivated people to create the future of energy. Join a rewarding and flexible work environment that encourages innovation and creativity, and help us meet the energy challenges of today and tomorrow.

The Supply & Energy Management (S&EM) Global Business Unit covers trading and risk management activities as well as B2B and B2C supply activities across a large and highly diversified energy portfolio, including electricity, natural gas, biomass, LNG and other fuels, CO2 and environmental products

Within the S&EM Business Unit, Business Platform APAC is developing ENGIE’s trading and risk management activities across the APAC region, Middle East and India, around 4 main pillars: risk management and market access, asset management, green solutions and energy supply businesses.

Purpose

The Senior Marketing & Communications Specialist supports the development and delivery of integrated marketing and communications activities that strengthen ENGIE’s Supply & Energy Management positioning and business growth across Asia.The role serves as a regional principal Marketing and Communications focal point of contact for S&EM activities across markets in the region, including Singapore and Japan, working closely ensuring consistency of S&EM’s positioning and coordinating with the relevant Country, GBU and Group Communications teams to ensure consistent messaging, brand alignment and effective execution in accordance with the ENGIE Communications operating model. Communications accountability in individual markets remains with the respective Country Communications teams.

The role contributes to positioning ENGIE as a credible partner in energy supply, renewable energy solutions, corporate PPAs, environmental products, energy management and decarbonisation. Working with commercial, trading and business development teams, the role supports market-facing campaigns, thought leadership, customer engagement initiatives and communications materials that build visibility and enable business development.

Key Responsibilities

Business marketing and commercial support: Support the planning and execution of marketing and communications activities aligned with S&EM growth objectives; work with commercial and business development teams to develop customer-facing materials; and prepare sales-enablement content, presentations, business profiles and solution collateral.

Thought leadership and market positioning: Support and in the development of markets relevant to S&EM’s regional activities and client coverage market insights, executive viewpoints, case studies, industry articles and customer success stories; work with subject matter experts to translate complex market and trading topics into clear, engaging content for customers and internal stakeholders.

External communications and reputation: Support proactive communications activities linked to S&EM business priorities; draft and coordinate media materials, press releases, industry submissions and external messaging; monitor relevant industry developments and support issues management preparation when required.

Digital marketing and content: Manage and produce content for websites, LinkedIn and other relevant channels; maintain an S&EM editorial calendar aligned to commercial priorities; develop campaign assets, newsletters, infographics, videos and presentations; and track engagement and campaign performance indicators.

Events and customer engagement: Coordinate communications and marketing support for industry conferences, customer forums, webinars, roundtables and trade exhibitions; prepare event content, key messages and engagement materials; and support regional customer engagement initiatives.

Internal communications: Prepare internal communications materials that build awareness of S&EM’s activities, products and capabilities across ENGIE; support leadership communications, employee engagement content and regional announcements.

Brand and governance: Ensure communications and marketing materials follow ENGIE brand standards; coordinate with ENGIE Group and regional communications teams; and apply established communications review and approval processes.

Qualifications, skills and experience

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Public Relations, Journalism or a related discipline.

Professional communications, digital marketing or brand-related certification would be advantageous.

Technical Skills & Experience

4 years’ experience in B2B marketing, communications, corporate affairs, digital marketing or a related field.

Exposure to power, utilities, energy trading, renewable energy, sustainability, infrastructure or related sectors would be advantageous.

Good understanding of commercial marketing, customer engagement and business development support.

Experience assisting with thought leadership content, digital campaigns, customer-facing communications materials and executive presentations.

Strong writing, editing, messaging and storytelling capability, with the ability to simplify technical energy and market topics for different audiences.

Ability to coordinate with stakeholders across commercial, trading, leadership, communications and regional teams.

Competencies

Clear communication and business partnering mindset.

Commercial awareness and ability to connect marketing activities to business priorities.

Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

Creativity, curiosity and ability to develop compelling market-facing narratives.

High attention to detail, brand discipline and governance mindset.

Ability to work independently while seeking alignment in a regional, matrixed environment.

ENGIE Energy Marketing Singapore Pte Ltd

ENGIE Energy Marketing Singapore Pte Ltd is the LNG trading platform at the heart of ENGIE, a global energy player in the three businesses of gas, power and energy services, and a comprehensive presence throughout the energy value chain.

Combining in-depth industry experience and financial-market know-how, we serve with LNG solutions all ENGIE business activities worldwide and trade LNG with third parties, from upstream producers to downstream utilities.

ENGIE Energy Marketing Singapore Pte Ltd also has a local presence in Europe (Paris, London, and Madrid).

Unequivocally client-focused, we bring the best of both worlds – energy and trading – to our business partners, be they within the Group or external customers.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Kiztopia Group is a leading family edutainment and active entertainment business dedicated to creating meaningful, engaging experiences through play, exploration and movement.

With multiple concepts and locations across Singapore and the region, we continue to grow our portfolio through innovation, creativity and a commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences.

Our established Kiztopia brand brings families together through purposeful play, while Xventure, our next-generation indoor actives ports park, introduces exciting experiences designed for older children, youths, young adults and families.

As we expand, we are looking for passionate and capable individuals to help strengthen our brands, grow our customer base and shape the future of entertainment in Singapore.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a

commercially driven, creative and hands-on Marketing Manager

to lead the marketing strategy, planning and execution for Kiztopia Group's Singapore businesses, including Kiztopia and Xventure.

You will take ownership of integrated marketing initiatives that strengthen brand positioning, increase customer acquisition, drive visitorship and contribute to business growth.

This role requires someone who can translate business objectives into actionable marketing strategies, balance brand-building with performance marketing, and lead campaigns from concept through execution and performance evaluation.

You will manage marketing budgets, guide team members, coordinate external agencies and work closely with Commercial, Operations and other stakeholders to deliver results.

We are looking for a well-rounded marketing leader who is equally comfortable developing strategy, analysing performance and getting involved in execution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketing Strategy & Business Growth

Develop and lead integrated marketing strategies for Kiztopia and Xventure, aligned with brand positioning, commercial objectives and business priorities.

Translate revenue targets, visitorship goals and customer acquisition objectives into actionable monthly, quarterly and annual marketing plans.

Develop targeted strategies for different customer segments, including families, children, youths, young adults, schools and relevant community groups.

Identify opportunities to drive ticket sales, increase repeat visits, build brand loyalty and strengthen customer lifetime value.

Plan and manage campaigns across business-as-usual operations, seasonal peaks, new outlet launches and special events.

Monitor consumer trends, competitor activities and market opportunities to keep our brands relevant and competitive.

2. Integrated Campaign Management

Lead end-to-end planning and execution of marketing campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels.

Develop clear campaign objectives, audience targeting, promotional mechanics, timelines, budgets and measurable KPIs.

Oversee campaign delivery across social media, digital advertising, CRM, website, partnerships, PR and on-ground activations.

Establish effective customer journeys from awareness and engagement through to ticket purchase and repeat visits.

Ensure campaigns are delivered on time, within budget and aligned with business objectives.

Review campaign effectiveness and refine strategies based on performance data and customer response.

3. Digital Marketing & Performance Management

Lead digital marketing strategies across platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok and other relevant channels.

Manage advertising budgets and optimise resource allocation based on campaign objectives and performance.

Oversee audience segmentation, retargeting, conversion campaigns and relevant testing initiatives.

Monitor key performance indicators such as reach, engagement, website traffic, acquisition cost, conversions and attributable revenue.

Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency, conversion rates and return on marketing investment.

Work with relevant stakeholders to improve website, booking and ticketing conversion journeys.

4. Brand, Social Media & Content Strategy

Own the overall brand marketing direction and ensure consistent positioning across campaigns and communication channels.

Develop differentiated content and communication strategies for Kiztopia and Xventure based on their respective target audiences.

Lead social media planning across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and other relevant platforms.

Guide the development of engaging content, including short-form videos, attraction highlights, promotional campaigns, customer experiences and community-driven content.

Review creative concepts, campaign messaging and marketing assets to ensure brand consistency and audience relevance.

Identify emerging content formats, cultural trends and creative opportunities that can strengthen organic reach and brand visibility.

Work closely with the marketing team, content creators and external agencies to deliver relevant, high-quality content.

5. Customer Engagement, CRM & Retention

Develop CRM and customer engagement strategies to encourage repeat visits, strengthen relationships and drive incremental revenue.

Oversee segmented email marketing, WhatsApp campaigns and other customer communications.

Identify opportunities for cross-promotion between Kiztopia, Xventure and other relevant business concepts.

Develop targeted campaigns around school holidays, birthdays, memberships, special occasions and customer engagement opportunities.

Review customer engagement and campaign data to identify opportunities for improved targeting and retention.

6. Partnerships, Events & Brand Activations

Collaborate with mall partners, ticketing platforms, community groups, schools, influencers and external partners on marketing initiatives.

Work closely with Commercial and Operations teams to support new outlet launches, grand openings, events and promotional activations.

Develop marketing initiatives that build awareness, generate publicity and encourage customer participation.

Identify and evaluate potential partnerships based on audience relevance, commercial value and expected marketing exposure.

Manage external agencies and vendors, ensuring clear deliverables, timelines, quality standards and value for money.

7. Budget, Reporting & Performance Accountability

Develop, manage and monitor marketing budgets across brands, campaigns and channels.

Track campaign performance against marketing KPIs and business objectives.

Prepare weekly marketing performance updates and monthly management reports covering key results, budget utilisation, insights and recommended actions.

Evaluate campaign effectiveness beyond engagement metrics, with emphasis on measurable business outcomes.

Identify underperforming initiatives early and recommend practical corrective actions.

Maintain clear marketing plans, campaign trackers, budgets and reporting frameworks.

8. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Lead, coach and develop the Singapore marketing team, establishing clear priorities, ownership and performance expectations.

Delegate effectively while remaining hands-on when required by business priorities.

Establish efficient workflows for campaign planning, creative production, approvals, execution and reporting.

Work collaboratively with Operations, Commercial, Partnerships, Sales and regional stakeholders.

Ensure marketing campaigns and promotions are communicated clearly to frontline teams and are operationally executable.

Foster a culture of accountability, creativity, initiative and continuous improvement.

REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Minimum 5 years of relevant marketing experience, with demonstrated ownership of integrated marketing campaigns and experience leading projects or team members.

Strong understanding of digital marketing, performance advertising, social media, CRM and integrated campaign management.

Proven ability to develop actionable marketing plans and manage campaigns from strategy to execution.

Commercially minded, with the ability to interpret campaign performance and connect marketing activities to business outcomes.

Experience managing marketing budgets, external agencies and multiple concurrent campaigns.

Strong leadership, project management, communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

Proactive, resourceful and comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Creative and analytical, with the ability to balance brand development and performance-driven marketing.

Willingness to take a hands-on approach and support execution where necessary.

ADDED ADVANTAGES

Experience in attractions, entertainment, family-oriented businesses, lifestyle, leisure, retail, hospitality or other consumer-facing industries.

Experience managing multiple brands, business locations or new product launches.

Familiarity with online ticketing platforms, e-commerce conversion and customer acquisition campaigns.

Knowledge of SEO, Google Analytics, marketing automation or relevant CRM tools.

Experience in influencer marketing, community engagement, experiential marketing or event activations.

Hands-on content creation, photography or video editing experience.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Clear, executable marketing plans aligned with commercial and brand objectives.

Improved brand visibility, customer engagement and qualified traffic.

Measurable contribution to customer acquisition, ticket sales, visitorship and repeat visits.

Effective utilisation of marketing budgets and continuous campaign optimisation.

Consistent delivery of high-quality campaigns across Kiztopia and Xventure.

A well-organised, accountable marketing team capable of executing independently.

WHY JOIN US?

Lead marketing for two exciting entertainment brands with distinct growth opportunities.

Play a meaningful role in new brand development, outlet launches and business expansion.

Take ownership of marketing initiatives with direct visibility into business performance.

Work in a dynamic, entrepreneurial and collaborative environment.

Grow professionally within an expanding regional entertainment group.

If you enjoy building brands, developing creative campaigns and turning marketing ideas into measurable results, we would love to hear from you.

Kiztopia is Singapore's mega-indoor kids' edutainment playgrond centre for families to enjoy endless fun and have a unique "Play, Learn, Eat and Bond" experience. Warm, inviting and family-oriented environments with specially designed play areas to support holistic development of children.

P.T. Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk, is a leading Indonesian bank providing comprehensive corporate banking solutions to support business growth and financial needs. The Global Syndication Desk (GSD) is responsible for originating, structuring, syndicating, and distributing loan transactions across BNI’s international network. The role supports business growth by enhancing client relationships, optimizing loan portfolio distribution, improving balance sheet management, and providing market intelligence and advisory services to Management and Credit Committees.

The position works closely with Overseas Branches (KLN), Head Office, borrowers, investors, and financial institutions to execute syndicated loan transactions and support strategic business initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Loan Origination & Lead Arranger Activities

Support Overseas Branches (KLN) in identifying and originating syndicated loan opportunities.

Develop target client lists aligned with the Bank’s risk appetite and business strategy.

Prepare marketing proposals, financing presentations, and pitchbooks to secure financing mandates.

Conduct market analysis and recommend optimal loan pricing based on comparable transactions and prevailing market conditions.

Structure loan facilities and prepare term sheets that meet both client requirements and the Bank’s risk and return objectives.

Support internal credit approval processes through preparation of credit papers and presentations.

Assist in transaction execution, including documentation review, negotiations with borrowers, and syndication activities.

Build and maintain relationships with corporate clients, financial institutions, and key market participants.

2. Syndicated Loan Participation & Credit Support

Evaluate opportunities to participate in syndicated loan transactions arranged by other financial institutions.

Serve as a key liaison between Mandated Lead Arrangers (MLABs) and BNI’s overseas network.

Support negotiations with external arrangers to achieve favorable pricing and allocation terms.

Conduct financial and credit assessments of transactions and borrowers.

Prepare transaction analyses and recommendations for Management and Credit Committees.

Provide independent market views regarding deal structure, pricing, syndication progress, and risk considerations.

3. Global Loan Distribution & Portfolio Management

Lead the distribution of BNI-originated syndicated loans to financial institutions outside Indonesia.

Support bookrunning and syndication efforts across Corporate Banking, Financial Institutions, Non-Bank Financial Institutions, and Overseas Branch portfolios.

Develop and maintain relationships with regional and international investor banks.

Identify distribution opportunities to optimize portfolio management and balance sheet utilization.

Facilitate loan sell-down activities to improve capital efficiency and enhance return on equity (ROE).

Provide origination ideas that align with market demand and investor appetite.

4. Market Advisory & Intelligence

Monitor developments in the syndicated loan market and provide regular market updates.

Analyze sector trends, banking liquidity, investor appetite, pricing benchmarks, and comparable transactions.

Prepare investor call reports and market intelligence updates for senior management.

Advise business units, management, and Credit Committees on market conditions, transaction structures, pricing strategy, and syndication feasibility.

Contribute to strategic decision-making by providing insights into market trends and transaction opportunities.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Banking, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related discipline.

Professional qualifications such as CFA, FRM, ACAMS, or other relevant banking and finance certifications will be an advantage.

Strong knowledge of syndicated lending, corporate banking, structured finance, credit analysis, and loan documentation.

Good understanding of financial markets, credit risk assessment, and portfolio management.

Strong financial modeling and financial statement analysis skills.

Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Experience

Minimum

5-10 years of relevant experience

in syndicated loans, corporate banking, investment banking, structured finance, credit analysis, debt capital markets, or loan distribution.

Proven track record in originating, structuring, executing, or distributing syndicated loan transactions.

Experience in managing complex financing transactions involving multiple stakeholders.

Familiarity with internal credit approval processes and presentations to senior management and credit committees.

Experience working with borrowers, financial institutions, investors, legal counsel, and external arrangers.

Regional or international banking experience, particularly in cross-border transactions, is highly desirable.

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple transactions simultaneously under tight deadlines.

Key Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management capabilities.

Strong commercial acumen and business development mindset.

Ability to build and maintain relationships with clients and market participants.

Effective presentation and communication skills.

High attention to detail and strong project management capabilities.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic international environment.

Sound judgment, integrity, and commitment to regulatory and compliance standards.

title: Sales Manager Asia
description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

Context (challenges, specific issues):

The position is based in Singapore with regional responsibility across Asia.
Responsible for developing business in diverse Asian markets, each with different customer requirements, competitive environments, procurement practices and regulatory considerations.
Requires effective navigation of the Business Line/DGDI matrix organisation, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders across organisations without direct hierarchical authority.
Requires the ability to identify, shape and capture opportunities at an early stage and translate customer needs into viable business opportunities for Thales.
Requires strong commercial judgement, customer relationship skills and the ability to manage complex, long-cycle opportunities involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.
Requires the ability to operate effectively in a multi-cultural environment and to engage confidently with senior customers, government stakeholders, partners and industry leaders.

Missions and responsibilities:

Regional Sales Development

Own and drive sales activities (with Sales Consultants) for opportunities across Asia, in alignment with Business Line strategy.
Take ownership of key opportunities from early identification and qualification through capture, bid, negotiation and contract award.
Develop and maintain clear opportunity/sales strategies & plans, capture plans, win themes, stakeholder maps and customer engagement strategies for strategic pursuits to achieve Order Intake and growth objectives.
Apply left-shift principles to shape opportunities early and influence customer requirements, procurement strategies, solution definition and partner ecosystems.
Build, maintain and continuously develop a strong and clear opportunities pipeline by identifying new customers, markets, opportunities and business models.
Qualify and prioritise opportunities based on strategic value, probability of success, competitive position and required resources.
Lead commercial engagement and negotiations within delegated authority and in accordance with Thales governance requirements.
Contribute directly to the achievement of regional Order Intake, pipeline and business objectives.

Customer & Market Engagement

Establish and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders across Air Navigation Service Providers (ANSPs), aviation authorities, airports, airlines, government agencies and other relevant aviation and industry organisations.
Lead customer engagements, meetings and presentations for assigned opportunities and represent the AMS Business Line at an appropriate senior level.
Develop a strong understanding of customer strategies, operational requirements, procurement priorities and decision-making processes, translating customer insight into actionable business opportunities.
Work closely with Country Directors and Key Account Managers to ensure coordinated and effective customer engagement.
Build and maintain a strong network across aviation, government, industry, suppliers, technology partners and academic institutions.
Provide market intelligence and competitive insight to support regional strategy, opportunity positioning and Business Line decision-making.

Opportunity Capture, Bid & Negotiation

Lead or co-lead capture activities for strategically important opportunities, coordinating Business Line, country and functional stakeholders.
Develop and maintain capture plans, opportunity strategies, customer engagement plans and competitive positioning.
Work closely with Bid Management, Engineering, Product Management, Finance, Legal, Contracts, Procurement and other stakeholders to develop compelling, competitive and commercially sound offers.
Ensure appropriate governance, quality, commercial discipline and adherence to critical timelines throughout the opportunity lifecycle.
Identify key risks, dependencies and resource requirements at an early stage and escalate appropriately to the Regional Sales Director and relevant Business Line management.
Develop and manage strategic partnerships and local industrial relationships, in cooperation with DGDI Country organisations, to strengthen Thales' competitive position and probability of success.

Business Line / DGDI Matrix Collaboration

Develop effective working relationships with the DGDI Country organisation to align Business Line opportunities with country strategies and priorities.
Work closely with Country Directors and local teams to coordinate customer engagement, opportunity development, partnerships and market access.
Ensure appropriate alignment of roles, responsibilities and priorities between the Business Line and DGDI Country organisations throughout the sales and capture lifecycle.
Influence and mobilise stakeholders across the matrix to achieve common business objectives without relying on hierarchical authority.

description:

Full-time

Asia Pacific

Executive Director, TAPA APAC

About the Role:

TAPA APAC is seeking an experienced Brand Protection professional to lead stakeholder engagement, programme adoption and regional growth of its established Brand Protection programme and standards.

The role requires credible industry relationships and the ability to turn engagement into practical collaboration, programme adoption and membership growth. You will serve as the dedicated relationship owner across

Brand Owners, Logistics Service Providers (LSPs), Customs and Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs)

.

This is a hands-on role requiring sustained external engagement, proactive follow-up and measurable results. Applicants must demonstrate relevant industry experience and direct stakeholder ownership.

Key Responsibilities:

Brand Owner and Industry Engagement

Build and maintain trusted relationships with Brand Owners, manufacturers, intellectual property rights holders and corporate Brand Protection, security and investigations teams.

Identify stakeholder needs, adoption barriers and opportunities for collaboration.

Develop and manage a qualified pipeline of prospective Brand Owner participants and members.

LSP Engagement and Programme Adoption

Engage logistics providers and supply-chain security stakeholders to drive participation in TAPA APAC’s Brand Protection programme.

Connect Brand Owners with relevant LSPs to support practical adoption and collaborative outcomes.

Own the engagement process from prospecting and needs assessment through to adoption, membership conversion and ongoing relationship management.

Customs and Law Enforcement Collaboration

Develop and sustain relationships with Customs, LEAs and relevant government stakeholders across APAC.

Facilitate lawful information-sharing, industry dialogue, stakeholder briefings and capacity-building activities.

Coordinate public-private collaboration addressing counterfeiting, illicit trade, product diversion and related supply-chain risks.

Membership Growth and Commercial Contribution

Deliver agreed targets for Buyer and LSP Brand Protection memberships and associated revenue.

Identify opportunities for training, certification, events, sponsorship and broader industry participation.

Maintain clear stakeholder plans, engagement pipelines and follow-up actions.

Industry Consultation and Internal Coordination

Organise stakeholder meetings, roundtables and regional consultation activities.

Maintain structured records of stakeholder feedback, emerging issues and programme improvement opportunities.

Support periodic standards reviews through consultation, user feedback and practical-operability validation.

Work with CREATE on technical interpretation and standards matters, and AMPLIFY on intelligence, communications and events. Technical drafting and standards governance remain with CREATE.

Performance and Reporting

Maintain accurate, current CRM records covering stakeholder ownership, engagement stage, next actions and outcomes.

Report on programme adoption, institutional engagement, membership conversion and commercial contribution.

Represent TAPA APAC at relevant industry conferences and regional stakeholder meetings.

Essential Experience and Capabilities:

To be considered, applicants must demonstrate:

At least five years of directly relevant experience

in Brand Protection, corporate or supply-chain security, investigations, Customs or law enforcement, or closely related industry engagement roles.

Direct responsibility for managing external stakeholder relationships

, with specific examples of sustained engagement and results.

Established professional relationships with Brand Owners and/or Customs or LEAs

, together with the ability to engage logistics and supply-chain stakeholders credibly.

A working understanding of counterfeiting, illicit trade, product diversion and supply-chain operations.

Experience translating stakeholder needs into programme participation, partnerships, adoption or other measurable outcomes.

Strong prospecting, presentation, facilitation, negotiation and follow-up skills.

Disciplined CRM, pipeline management, documentation and reporting practices.

The ability to work independently, manage regional priorities and remain accountable for agreed KPIs.

Professional proficiency in English and willingness to travel across APAC.

Strongly Preferred:

Direct experience across

at least two

of the following stakeholder groups:

Brand Owners, LSPs, Customs/LEAs

.

Experience engaging senior corporate or institutional stakeholders across multiple APAC markets.

Demonstrated membership conversion, business development or programme commercialisation outcomes.

Experience facilitating public-private partnerships, industry consultations or standards adoption.

Additional Asian-language capabilities.

A relevant degree or equivalent professional experience.

Relevant backgrounds include Brand Owner Brand Protection or corporate security teams, Customs or law enforcement, LSP security functions, and specialist Brand Protection, investigations or risk consultancies.

Applicants whose experience is primarily in general sales, marketing or administration must also demonstrate substantial, directly relevant Brand Protection or supply-chain security experience and stakeholder relationships.

How Success Will Be Measured

Performance will be assessed against agreed objectives covering:

Brand Owner and LSP engagement and programme adoption.

Customs/LEA relationships and collaborative outcomes.

Buyer and LSP membership conversion and revenue contribution.

Industry consultation and actionable standards feedback.

CRM accuracy, follow-through and reporting discipline.

What We Offer

Ownership of a regional Brand Protection engagement and adoption agenda.

Direct collaboration with TAPA APAC’s Executive Director and industry leadership.

Access to an established international supply-chain security community.

Opportunities to work with multinational Brand Owners, logistics providers and government stakeholders across APAC.

How to Apply

We welcome applications from experienced professionals who are passionate about brand protection, industry collaboration, and strengthening supply chain security across Asia Pacific.

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV, together with a brief summary of their relevant experience, particularly any prior engagement with brand owners, LEAs, customs authorities, and regional industry programmes.

Please describe stakeholder relationships without disclosing confidential information.

Email To: secretariat@tapa-apac.org

Subject:

Application – Brand Protection Lead, APAC

Website:

TAPA APAC

Shortlisting will focus on demonstrated domain experience, stakeholder credibility and evidence of delivery.

The Leading Association for Global Supply Chain Resilience & Sustainability

The Transported Asset Protection Association (TAPA) is the leading global association that unites supply chain industry leaders and organizations with the common aim of upholding the highest standards of supply chain resilience and sustainability.

Today, in Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA), The Americas and Asia Pacific (APAC), TAPA’s membership is at its highest ever level – and growing month-on-month. The Association’s members include many of the world’s leading manufacturing brands as well as their logistics and transport providers with combined annual sales of over US$900 billion.

At Asia Pacific, TAPA APAC is the fastest growing supply chain community of over 1000 member companies, government agencies and custom partners in the region.

TAPA APAC members include:

Manufacturers & Shippers;

Logistic Service Providers;

Security Service Providers;

Insurance Providers;

Parking Place Operators;

Independent Audit Bodies;

Law Enforcement Agencies, Government Entities & Customs Partners;

Academic Partners and others.

Mission

To minimize cargo losses from the supply chain. TAPA achieves this through the development and application of global security standards, recognized industry practices, technology, education, benchmarking, regulatory collaboration, and the proactive identification of crime trends and supply chain security threats

Vision

TAPA’s vision is an international supply chain where controlled and traceable product can be transported in a cost efficient and secure environment.

title: Product Life Cycle Manager, ROPU ASKAN
description:
THE POSITION

The Product Life Cycle Manager, ROPU ASKAN is responsible for managing and coordinating the end-to-end SKU lifecycle across both Human Pharma and Animal Health businesses, from product launch and post-launch changes through to product withdrawal. The role ensures seamless execution of lifecycle activities through established governance processes and systems, including Product Review Meetings, CSC, SLCI, Product Readiness, and other applicable tools.

As the regional subject matter expert, the Product Life Cycle Manager maintains strong knowledge of both global and local product lifecycle management requirements and ensures alignment with relevant launch, change, and discontinuation processes. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, the role drives operational excellence, supports supply continuity, facilitates effective change management, and ensures products are introduced, maintained, and retired in a compliant and efficient manner across the ASKAN region.

Tasks & responsibilities
Coordinate product launch activities:
Manage SKU creation requests, business justification and cross-functional coordination for AH & HP within the respective computerized systems.
Maintain oversight through a consolidated database based on inputs from relevant functions, including Regulatory Affairs (RA), Commercial/Marketing, Quality and Supply Chain.
Coordinate SCM-related launch activities, including scenario planning, risk identification and stakeholder alignment to support launch timelines and readiness.
Participate as a member of the Launch Readiness Team and ensure SCM requirements and dependencies are addressed.
Coordinate product changes
Coordinate end-to-end implementation of product changes, including labelling and packaging changes, site transfers and other supply-related changes.
Maintain and manage the master transfer list to provide visibility of implementation status, timelines and key dependencies.
Align change management activities with key stakeholders, including Business Controllers, ROPU RA, ROPU Quality, local CSCM and other relevant functions.
Evaluate and manage opportunities for bundling of changes to optimize implementation and minimize operational complexity.
Coordinate complex changes across multiple countries, considering market-specific requirements, implementation timelines and supply constraints.
Manage Product Phase-Out, Discontinuation and Withdrawal:
Manage and coordinate the end-to-end product discontinuation and withdrawal process across multiple countries and functions.
Coordinate product discontinuation activities, including forecast deletion, SKU withdrawal, license/registration withdrawal and other related supply chain activities.
Coordinate the annual review of local initiatives for SKU portfolio optimization.
Provide visibility of withdrawal/discontinuation status, dependencies, risks and outstanding actions to relevant stakeholders.
Coordinate Multi-Country Redressing & Repacking
Coordinate multi-country redressing and repacking activities involving Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Commercial and other relevant stakeholders.
Manage cross-country requirements, timelines, quantities and dependencies to support effective execution.
Facilitate cross-functional and cross-country alignment to resolve operational issues and ensure timely implementation.
Drive Process Improvement, Automation & Digitalization
Identify and implement opportunities to improve and simplify Product Lifecycle Management processes.
Drive process automation and digitalization initiatives to reduce manual activities, improve efficiency and enhance data accuracy.
Develop and maintain dashboards and report solutions to improve visibility of lifecycle activities, milestones, risks and performance.
Drive continuous improvement based on operational experience, stakeholder feedback and lessons learned.
System, Process & SOP Ownership
Act as System and Process Owner for Product Lifecycle Management, covering the key processes of Product Launch, Product Change and Product Discontinuation/Withdrawal.
Own, maintain and continuously improve relevant SOPs, work instructions, process documentation and training materials.
Ensure process and system changes are appropriately incorporated into SOPs and supporting documentation.
Ensure consistent understanding and application of Product Lifecycle Management processes across users and markets.
Provide functional expertise and guidance related to Product Lifecycle Management systems, processes and governance.
Subject Matter Expert, Training & Capability Building
Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Product Launch, Product Change and Product Discontinuation/Withdrawal processes.
Provide expert process guidance and support to stakeholders and users across countries and functions.
Develop and conduct new-user training and onboarding covering Product Lifecycle Management processes, systems and applicable SOPs.
Provide ongoing user support, process clarification and refresher training as required.
Support users in resolving process and system-related issues and provide guidance for complex cases
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Business Administration, Economics, Supply Chain Management or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of Supply Chain Management experience, preferably within pharmaceutical, OTC or FMCG industries, with experience in demand/replenishment planning, commercial SCM, packaging/artwork management and/or Product Lifecycle Management.
At least 2 years of people leadership experience and proven project management experience are preferred.
Strong understanding of end-to-end Product Lifecycle Management, covering Product Launch, Product Change, site transfers, phase-out, discontinuation and withdrawal.
Demonstrated experience in multi-country Product Lifecycle Management, with the ability to coordinate different market requirements, timelines and stakeholders.
Experience in multi-country redressing and repacking processes, including cross-functional coordination and execution.
Experience in system, process and SOP ownership, including process governance, documentation, standardization and continuous improvement.
Extensive SAP knowledge, particularly SAP APO.
Good understanding of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
Strong project management capability and the ability to lead and influence cross-functional stakeholders across multiple countries.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across functions and organizational levels, with the ability to drive alignment and follow-through.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to interpret information and reports and translate them into actionable insights.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in an ambiguous and changing environment.
Proficient in English.
APICS Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP) certification is preferable.
Preference may be given to candidates who do not require work visa sponsorship.

title: Wellness Education Specialist
description:
*Job Title: *Education & Customer Success Specialist

*Location: *Singapore

*Employment Type:* Full-Time

*Reports To:* Country Manager

*Salary Range: *SGD6,500 - SGD7,500

*Job Highlights:*

* Be part of a *global leading wellness brand*, *Technogym*, that powers *Olympic athletes* and is trusted by luxury gyms, health clubs, and elite sports teams worldwide.
* Be part of a *high performing team* that *challenges individual growth *while continuously innovating in the fitness and wellness industry.
* Get *complimentary access* to our *Technogym showroom equipment *for personal training and workouts as part of your employee benefits.

*About the Company*
*SE Active* is the exclusive partner for *Technogym* in Singapore & Malaysia, managing everything from equipment sales to after-sales services and warranty protection. SE Active aims to be the market leader in offering total wellness solutions in both countries, with a customer-first approach to meet fitness and wellness needs. The company's focus is on growing the brand's presence and anchoring market dominance while providing the Technogym experience by embodying its core values.

*About Technogym*

For more than 40 years, we at *Technogym* have been helping people live healthier and happier lives. If 50 million people in the world train on our equipment every day, it’s not just a matter of chance. We are the global experts of wellness, be it for fitness, health, or sports. Reaching over 100 countries in the world, Technogym has brought wellness through movement to thousands of locations around the world. Technogym produces top-notch fitness equipment found in luxury property gyms and has been the Official Supplier of the Olympic Games for ten consecutive editions, from Sydney 2000 to Milano Cortina 2026, supporting Olympic athletes in their quest for excellence.

*Job Overview:*

As an Education & Customer Success Specialist, you will play a key role in elevating Technogym’s brand experience through impactful education, customer engagement, training excellence, and relationship management. You will work closely with internal teams, partners, trainers, and customers to drive product adoption, customer satisfaction, and long-term engagement with Technogym’s wellness ecosystem.

This role combines elements of wellness education, customer success, account support, coaching, community engagement, and event coordination. You will empower internal teams, B2B partners, and end consumers with in-depth product knowledge and training support, while also building strong customer relationships and a network of certified personal trainers and wellness advocates.

You will serve as a key point of contact in ensuring customers receive a seamless experience throughout their journey — from onboarding and training to ongoing engagement and retention. Through proactive support, product education, and community activation initiatives, you will help customers maximize the value of Technogym solutions while strengthening brand loyalty and advocacy.

The ideal candidate is passionate about fitness, wellness, and customer experience, with strong communication and interpersonal skills. You are a confident trainer and relationship builder who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys engaging with diverse audiences, and is committed to delivering exceptional education and customer experiences across markets.

*Responsibilities:*

*1. Internal Product Education & Sales Enablement*

* Lead ongoing product education and training initiatives for the sales team throughout the year.
* Ensure all sales team members complete Technogym’s product storytelling assessments and maintain a minimum performance score across all products.
* Identify underperforming team members and conduct targeted coaching and training sessions to strengthen product knowledge and storytelling capabilities.
* Maintain a minimum personal product knowledge rating, as assessed by the Regional Education & Training Manager, to qualify for delivering storytelling assessments.
* Develop and update training materials, user guides, and educational resources to support internal product learning and customer engagement.

*2. Customer Onboarding, Training & Success Management*

* Support the onboarding of new customers by guiding them through product setup, training, and adoption to ensure a smooth customer experience.
* Conduct quarterly product refresher trainings and ongoing educational sessions for key account clients in collaboration with their internal training managers.
* Coordinate and deliver on-site product training during new equipment installations, ensuring all facility staff receive relevant training materials via the Technogym Trainer Portal.
* Facilitate post-delivery product education sessions for home customers. Where required, coordinate with certified freelance personal trainers from the Technogym training network to deliver training sessions.
* Create and implement customer success plans that outline customer goals, milestones, adoption strategies, and engagement initiatives.
* Educate customers on product features, capabilities, and best practices to maximize product utilization and long-term value.

*3. Customer Relationship Management & Retention*

* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers to understand their operational needs, business goals, and challenges.
* Proactively engage customers through various communication channels to monitor satisfaction, gather feedback, and support ongoing success.
* Monitor customer usage and adoption trends to identify at-risk accounts and implement retention strategies.
* Support account management activities, including license renewals to drive customer retention and long-term account success.
* Address customer concerns, issues, and escalations promptly while coordinating with internal stakeholders to ensure effective resolution.
* Identify and develop customer advocates for testimonials, referrals, case studies, and community engagement opportunities.

*4. Trainer Network Development*

* Expand and manage the Technogym-certified personal trainer network through onboarding, certification, and ongoing engagement initiatives.
* Ensure certified trainers remain up to date with the latest Technogym products, training methodologies, and wellness solutions.
* Maintain the quality and consistency of training standards through regular assessments, refresher programs, and recertification initiatives.

*5. Community Engagement & Wellness Events*

* Collaborate with frontline managers and the marketing team to identify and engage relevant fitness and wellness communities.
* Establish partnerships with coaches, medical professionals, wellness experts, influencers, and other industry stakeholders to support wellness initiatives and community outreach.
* Plan and execute community-focused events, workshops, clinics, and wellness activations with clearly defined KPIs to measure engagement and impact.
* Represent Technogym as a wellness and product ambassador during events, training sessions, and customer engagements.

*6. Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement*

* Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer satisfaction, training effectiveness, customer retention, engagement, and revenue growth.
* Collect and analyze customer feedback to identify trends, areas for improvement, and opportunities to enhance the customer experience.
* Work closely with sales, marketing, after-sales, and regional teams to ensure a seamless and consistent customer journey.
* Stay updated on industry trends, customer success best practices, and Technogym product developments to continuously improve training delivery and customer engagement strategies.

*Requirements:*

* *Bachelor’s degree* in Sports Science, Exercise Physiology, or a related field.
* *5–7 years of experience *in fitness education, personal training, customer success, business development, consultancy, or a similar client-facing role.
* *Strong presentation and training delivery skills* — able to engage, educate, and inspire diverse audiences including sales teams, fitness professionals, and customers.
* Proven experience in *conducting workshops, seminars, or product training sessions* in a professional setting.
* Ability to *build rapport and credibility* quickly with internal stakeholders (e.g., sales team) and external clients.
* *Confident and polished communicator* with excellent interpersonal skills and professional presence.
* Comfortable working *independently and cross-functionally*, with strong organizational and time management skills.
* Tech-savvy with the ability to *navigate digital platforms* for training, communication, and certification delivery.
* Passionate about *fitness, wellness, and the Technogym philosophy* of lifestyle transformation through movement.

title: Manager, Exhibitor Marketing & Buyer Programmes
description:
The Manager, Exhibitor Marketing & Buyer Programmes leads exhibitor-facing marketing and high-value buyer programmes across IAPL’s portfolio of shows.

The role supports exhibitor recruitment and retention through year-round marketing campaigns, while also taking ownership of hosted and high-value buyer acquisition, matchmaking and guaranteed meeting programmes that directly contribute to the value delivered to exhibitors.

The position works across InfoComm India and InfoComm Asia, as well as international buyer recruitment for InfoComm China. As a team member working closely with the Sales team, the role connects exhibitor requirements with qualified buyer acquisition and helps demonstrate measurable return on investment to exhibitors.

For InfoComm Asia, the role will work closely with the Senior Marketing Manager, who owns the overall visitor and audience strategy, with this position specifically responsible for the hosted and high-value buyer segment.

*KEY INDUSTRIES*

* Professional audiovisual and integrated experiential communications technology
* Emerging technologies including AI, IoT, 5G, AR/VR/MR, Big Data Analytics, Drones, Robotics, Content Development (Software), Wearables and Cloud Applications

*OVERALL RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES*

*Exhibitor Marketing*

* Lead and execute year-round exhibitor marketing campaigns that support exhibitor recruitment, retention and rebooking across IAPL’s portfolio of shows.
* Achieve agreed sales-accepted lead targets for exhibitor recruitment and provide Sales with a consistent pipeline of qualified prospects.
* Develop exhibitor-facing marketing materials including sector collateral, sales prospectuses, case studies, testimonials and ROI evidence that support the Sales team in converting prospects.
* Own exhibitor communications across the pre-show, onsite and post-show journey, ensuring communications are timely, accurate and relevant.
* Develop campaigns that demonstrate the business value and ROI of participating in IAPL’s exhibitions.
* Develop co-marketing and advocacy programmes with exhibitors to extend buyer reach.
* Support exhibitor retention and rebooking activities through post-show communications, performance reporting and ROI evidence.
* Work closely with Sales to understand exhibitor requirements, market feedback and commercial priorities.

*High-Value & Hosted Buyer Acquisition*

* Own and deliver hosted and high-value buyer acquisition programmes against agreed recruitment, attendance and quality targets.
* Source, identify and qualify senior decision-makers, buyers, specifiers and other high-value attendees relevant to the exhibitor mix.
* Manage the complete buyer journey including sourcing, qualification, invitation, confirmation, communications, attendance and onsite experience.
* Lead overseas hosted and local high-value strategic buyer programmes for InfoComm India and InfoComm Asia.
* Recruit and manage international buyers attending InfoComm China in collaboration with the China marketing team.
* Develop qualification criteria to ensure buyer profiles meet agreed programme requirements and are relevant to participating exhibitors.
* Monitor buyer registration and confirmation pipelines, identify potential shortfalls early and implement corrective actions.
* Manage buyer attendance and no-show rates to maximise programme effectiveness.

*Matchmaking & Guaranteed Meetings*

* Design, manage and deliver exhibitor–buyer matchmaking and guaranteed meeting programmes against commitments sold to exhibitors.
* Work closely with Sales to understand contractual meeting commitments and exhibitor buyer-profile requirements.
* Match qualified buyers with relevant exhibitors based on purchasing requirements, product interests, industry sector and other agreed criteria.
* Track scheduled and completed meetings against targets and contractual commitments.
* Identify potential meeting shortfalls early and work with Sales and relevant teams to implement corrective actions.
* Ensure accurate records are maintained for scheduled, completed, cancelled and no-show meetings.
* Collect feedback from exhibitors and buyers to continuously improve the matchmaking programme.

*Agency, Vendor & Programme Management*

* Manage buyer acquisition agencies, matchmaking platforms and event vendors against agreed scope, budget, timeline and performance targets.
* Establish clear KPIs and deliverables for external agencies and vendors.
* Monitor agency performance including buyer quality, attendance, cost per qualified buyer and delivery against contracted targets.
* Ensure external expenditure remains within approved budgets and flag potential variances in a timely manner.
* Evaluate vendor and agency effectiveness following each show and recommend improvements for future cycles.

*Sponsorship Delivery & Fulfilment*

* Coordinate with Sales, Operations and Marketing to ensure marketing-related sponsorship and exhibitor deliverables are fulfilled as contracted.
* Maintain clear records of relevant exhibitor and sponsorship commitments and monitor delivery status.
* Work with Sales to ensure that buyer and matchmaking commitments sold to exhibitors are understood and appropriately delivered.
* Support onsite delivery of hosted buyer, matchmaking and exhibitor programmes.
* Produce post-show exhibitor ROI reporting jointly with Sales.
* Contribute to exhibitor NPS, satisfaction and rebooking initiatives.

*Data, CRM & Reporting*

* Maintain high-value buyer information within CRM and marketing automation platforms.
* Use CRM data to segment, target and track buyer campaigns.
* Provide timely updates on exhibitor lead generation, buyer recruitment pipeline, confirmed buyers, meeting volumes and overall programme status.
* Track campaign and programme performance against agreed KPIs.
* Analyse buyer profiles, attendance, meeting completion and exhibitor feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Produce post-show analysis covering buyer performance, matchmaking results, exhibitor engagement and programme effectiveness.
* Maintain high standards of data quality and accuracy across buyer databases.

*Collaboration*

* Work closely with Sales on B2B/exhibitor promotion, marketing priorities, buyer requirements, contractual commitments and post-show reporting.
* Work with the Show Marketing Managers across shows to ensure high-value and hosted buyer programmes are aligned with the overall audience strategy.
* Work closely with Operations on onsite buyer and sponsor delivery.
* Contribute to marketing campaigns across IAPL’s three expos and work with counterpart teams across the wider global show portfolio.
* Maintain awareness of industry trends, key market players, buyer requirements and competing regional events.

*EXPERIENCE & ATTRIBUTES*

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in B2B sales/marketing, exhibition marketing, buyer acquisition, event marketing, exhibition sales support or a related field.
* At least 2 years of experience leading campaigns, programmes or projects with measurable targets.
* Experience in hosted buyer, delegate acquisition, audience acquisition or exhibitor–buyer matchmaking programmes is highly preferred.
* Experience within trade exhibitions, conferences, B2B events or related industries would be a strong advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to manage external agencies, vendors and programme partners.
* Commercially aware and comfortable working with targets, budgets and performance data.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills with the ability to monitor buyer pipelines, conversion rates and programme performance.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to achieve and exceed buyer and lead-generation targets.
* Dependable with strong follow-through on commitments made to exhibitors and internal stakeholders.
* Highly organised with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple programmes simultaneously.
* Experienced with marketing automation and CRM platforms such as HubSpot or equivalent, and confident working with database segmentation, data quality and analysis.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and customer service skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
* Self-starter, problem solver and collaborative team player.
* Ability to work effectively in a matrix environment and with global teams.
* Able and willing to travel domestically and internationally as required.

*WHAT WE OFFER*

* Remote / work-from-home arrangement
* Health benefits
* Multicultural and international working environment
* Regional exposure across China, India, Malaysia and Southeast Asia
* Opportunity to develop and manage high-value buyer and exhibitor programmes across three major professional audiovisual trade shows
* Collaboration with international teams across a global portfolio of professional audiovisual exhibitions

description:
Job Overview

ANGELS WING EDUCATION is seeking an experienced and results-driven

Sales Director

to lead the sales and business development of our rhythmic gymnastics programmes in Singapore.

The Sales Director will be responsible for driving student enrolment, developing effective sales strategies, building partnerships, managing customer relationships, and leading the sales team to achieve the company's revenue and growth objectives.

This role requires a strong commercial mindset, excellent communication skills, and the ability to convert enquiries and leads into long-term students and customers.

Key Responsibilities

Sales & Enrolment Growth

Develop and implement sales strategies to increase enrolment in rhythmic gymnastics programmes.

Lead the sales process from initial enquiry, consultation and trial class booking through to enrolment and package renewal.

Establish monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets and monitor performance against agreed KPIs.

Identify opportunities to increase revenue through new programmes, packages, promotions and customer segments.

Improve lead conversion, trial-to-enrolment conversion and student retention rates.

Business Development

Identify and develop new business opportunities and strategic partnerships.

Build relationships with schools, international schools, preschools, education organisations, community groups and other potential partners.

Develop B2B and B2C sales channels to expand the academy's customer base.

Explore opportunities for competitions, training camps, workshops, holiday programmes and international exchange programmes.

Represent the company in meetings, events and partnership discussions when required.

Sales Team Management

Recruit, train, manage and motivate sales and customer service staff.

Establish clear sales processes, targets and performance standards.

Conduct regular sales reviews and provide coaching to improve individual and team performance.

Ensure timely follow-up of enquiries received through website, social media, advertising platforms, messaging applications and other channels.

Develop sales scripts, follow-up procedures and customer relationship management practices.

Customer Relationship Management

Build strong relationships with students, parents and prospective customers.

Understand customers' needs and recommend suitable rhythmic gymnastics programmes and training packages.

Manage customer enquiries professionally and ensure a high standard of service throughout the enrolment journey.

Work closely with coaches and operations staff to ensure customer expectations are properly communicated and managed.

Support student retention, renewals and referrals.

Marketing & Sales Coordination

Work closely with the marketing team to plan campaigns that generate qualified leads and enrolments.

Provide feedback on customer profiles, market demand, pricing and competitors.

Monitor the effectiveness of different lead-generation channels and recommend improvements.

Support promotional activities, open houses, trial classes, competitions and academy events.

Analyse sales data and prepare regular management reports on leads, conversions, enrolment and revenue.

Requirements

Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, Management or a related discipline is preferred.

Relevant experience in sales, business development, education, enrichment, sports, fitness or other service-based industries.

Experience in a managerial or sales leadership position is preferred.

Strong sales, negotiation and customer relationship management skills.

Proven ability to develop sales strategies and achieve revenue targets.

Strong leadership and team management capabilities.

Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.

Comfortable communicating with parents, students, corporate partners and external organisations.

Able to work independently in a fast-paced and target-driven environment.

Experience in the education, enrichment, sports or rhythmic gymnastics industry will be an advantage.

Familiarity with CRM systems, digital lead management and social media enquiries will be an advantage.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance may be measured based on:

Student enrolment and sales revenue

Monthly and annual sales target achievement

Lead-to-trial conversion rate

Trial-to-enrolment conversion rate

Student renewal and retention

Development of new sales channels and partnerships

Sales team performance and productivity

Customer satisfaction and response efficiency

What We Offer

Leadership position within a growing education and rhythmic gymnastics organisation.

Opportunity to build and lead the company's sales function.

Performance-driven career development opportunities.

Exposure to the education, sports and enrichment sectors.

Opportunity to work closely with professional coaches and develop premium rhythmic gymnastics programmes in Singapore.

welcomes commercially minded sales professionals who are passionate about business growth, customer experience, education and sports development to join our team.

title: Head of Communications & Brand
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

About BW Group

BW Group is a leading global energy and maritime company involved in shipping, deepwater oil & gas production, renewable energy and digital infrastructure. BW controls a fleet of over 400 vessels transporting oil, gas and dry commodities. In the infrastructure space, the group operates in wind, batteries, water, subsea cable networks and data centres.

BW is proud to be listed among Forbes World's Best Employers and Financial Times Best Employers Asia-Pacific 2025.

Are you ready to make an impact?

What drives us is our mission to deliver energy for the world today, and to find solutions for tomorrow. If you want to make lives better around the world by providing access to energy, while working on sustainability and decarbonisation, we'd like to hear from you. Working at BW you will feel the pulse of the world each day. If something happens in the world, we feel it, and you can play your part by anticipating and responding to it. Our high-performing teams are drawn to BW by the global nature of our work and the satisfaction of working with collaborative people who inspire each other to deliver exceptional results.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Role Overview

Based in Singapore and reporting to the Chief People Officer, BW Group, the Head of Communications & Brand leads communications and corporate brand activities across BW Group whilst also supporting BW LNG.

This is a highly visible role partnering closely with the Chairman, senior executives and Communications leaders across our affiliate companies to strengthen BW's reputation, shape its corporate narrative and foster greater collaboration across the Group.

Success requires far more than exceptional communications capability. You will be a commercially minded strategic thinker who anticipates issues, shapes narratives and influences outcomes through sound judgement, trusted relationships and collaboration in a federated organisation where credibility matters more than hierarchy.

Working with a lean team and external partners, you will combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, helping shape executive communications, protect and enhance the BW brand, support organisational transformation and drive communications excellence across the Group.

Key Accountabilities

Corporate Communications

Develop and deliver BW Group's corporate communications strategy aligned with the Group's long-term vision and priorities.

Shape compelling narratives that strengthen understanding of BW's purpose, strategy and portfolio of businesses.

Advise leaders on communications strategy, executive messaging and stakeholder engagement.

Lead communications for strategic initiatives, organisational change, major announcements and corporate events.

Oversee BW Group's digital communications, including LinkedIn and other channels, delivering engaging content that strengthens the brand and supports strategic objectives.

Executive

Communications

Partner closely with the Chairman and senior executives on speeches, presentations, thought leadership and executive communications.

Develop executive communications that reflect BW's values and high editorial standards.

Lead the production of flagship Group communications, including World Horizon, the Annual Report, Sustainability Report, corporate website and key leadership updates.

Support senior executives at conferences, media engagements, investor events and industry forums through end-to-end communications planning and delivery.

Serve as a trusted communications adviser to the Chairman and senior leadership, providing sound judgement on messaging, stakeholder considerations and reputational matters.

Employee

Communications

Lead Group-wide employee communications across digital channels.

Deliver engaging communications that connect shore-based and seafaring employees through platforms such as BW Connect.

Foster a culture of openness, pride and engagement across the Group.

Brand & Reputation

Act as steward of the BW corporate brand, ensuring consistency whilst respecting the autonomy of our affiliate businesses.

Evolve BW's corporate identity and positioning to strengthen the Group's reputation and create value across the portfolio.

Protect and enhance BW's reputation with employees, customers, investors, regulators, partners and the wider maritime and energy community.

Lead crisis and issues communications, partnering with senior management and external advisers as required for ongoing incidents and with post-communications.

BW LNG Communications & Marketing

Partner with the BW LNG leadership team to develop communications and marketing initiatives that strengthen the company's commercial positioning and reputation.

Lead communications supporting commercial initiatives, including vessel launches, technology innovations, customer campaigns and industry events.

Develop marketing content and digital campaigns that showcase BW LNG's capabilities, innovation and market leadership.

Ensure alignment between BW LNG's communications and the wider BW corporate brand.

Leadership & Influence

Lead BW's Communications Community of Practice, fostering collaboration, sharing best practice and identifying opportunities for greater alignment across affiliate companies.

Build trusted relationships with affiliate CEOs and Communications leaders, influencing through credibility rather than authority.

Foster collaboration across the Group whilst respecting the entrepreneurial culture and autonomy of individual businesses.

Digital Communications & AI

Harness AI and emerging technologies to improve the quality, consistency, efficiency and reach of communications.

Identify and implement new tools, channels and approaches that enhance engagement and communications effectiveness.

Measure communications impact using meaningful qualitative and quantitative insights.

Team Leadership

Lead, coach and develop a small, high-performing communications team.

Manage external agencies and specialist partners to maximise quality, capability and value.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

We're looking for someone who combines strategic communications leadership with exceptional judgement and the ability to influence senior stakeholders. You'll ideally bring:

Significant experience leading corporate communications within a global organisation or consultancy.

Experience advising CEOs and senior executives on communications strategy and reputation management.

Strong understanding of corporate branding, stakeholder engagement and executive communications.

Experience leading communications during periods of organisational change, transformation or significant corporate activity.

Experience working across complex, matrixed or federated organisations would be advantageous.

Experience within the maritime or energy sectors would be beneficial, although not essential.

What Will Make You Successful

You'll be someone who naturally earns trust and credibility. You'll demonstrate:

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

Excellent judgement and discretion.

The ability to simplify complex issues into clear, compelling messages.

Exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills.

Strong commercial awareness.

High levels of curiosity and strategic thinking.

Comfort working directly with senior executives and Board-level stakeholders.

A collaborative style with low ego and high integrity.

The ability to balance strategic thinking with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and deliver.

Demonstrates sound judgement in knowing when to follow established processes and when a pragmatic, flexible approach will deliver a better outcome.

A passion for continuous improvement, innovation and practical application of AI.

This role is unlikely to suit someone who prefers highly structured environments, relies on formal authority to get things done, or wants to specialise in a single area of communications. Success requires sound judgement, adaptability, collaboration and a willingness to operate across a broad range of strategic and hands-on responsibilities.

OTHER INFORMATION

Why BW?

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the voice and reputation of one of the world's most respected maritime and energy groups.

You'll work closely with visionary leaders who value integrity, long-term thinking and collaboration, while helping tell the story of a business investing in both today's energy needs and tomorrow's energy transition.

The role offers exceptional breadth, combining strategy, executive partnership, brand leadership, organisational change, employee engagement and external communications in an entrepreneurial international environment.

Please note that your application will be sent to and reviewed by the direct employer - BW Maritime

Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 4600 people. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 30 years where it employs over 200 people.

Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience.

Your role

This role support and develop Pictet Asset Services B2B client relationships in Asia by combining front-facing relationship management with strong operational and servicing capabilities, acting as a shadow Client Relationship Manager (CRM) while ensuring best-in-class day-to-day support. For the candidate with the appropriate credential and ambition, this position offers a potential pathway to a full CRM role in the future.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Relationship Officer

Lead with complex account opening/closing, static data changes and onboarding of new services, ensuring completeness and accuracy of documentation.

Provide daily operational support including but not limited to: processing and monitoring of payments, cash movements, securities orders, fund subscriptions/redemptions, and asset transfers.

Handle client queries and incidents, ensuring timely resolution, proper escalation and clear communication to clients and internal teams.

Verify the accuracy of transactions and data input in core banking and PAS tools; maintain up-to-date client files and internal records.

Contribute to client satisfaction and retention through proactive, solution-oriented servicing and regular contact (calls, emails, meetings).

Assist in coordinating internal stakeholders (Operations, Legal, Compliance, Credit, Trading, other PAS locations) to deliver a seamless client experience. Promote collaboration and alignment of processes between Singapore and other PAS hubs (Geneva/Luxembourg).

Contribute to keeping operating memoranda, procedures and checklists accurate and up to date as processes evolve.
