title: Sales & Marketing Manager / Assistant Manager (Brand & Bakery)
description:
Job Title

Sales & Marketing Manager / Assistant Manager (Brand & Bakery)

Department

Sales & Marketing

Reports To

General Manager (day-to-day); Chief Executive Officer (brand direction)

Direct Reports

Nil – standalone role

Employment Type

Full-time, permanent

Work Location

70 Bendemeer Road #01-03 (Luzerne) and 44 Jalan Merah Saga #01-42 (Chip Bee Gardens), with travel between outlets and to client / vendor sites

Salary Range

Assistant Manager: S$3,300 – S$3,800 Manager: S$3,800 – S$4,300

(Final offer commensurate with experience and portfolio)

1.

Job Purpose

The Sales & Marketing Manager / Assistant Manager owns the full marketing portfolio of Keong Saik Bakery and is accountable for translating the founder’s vision for the brand into a coherent, commercially effective marketing programme across our retail outlets, e-commerce, and corporate / B2B channels.

This is a standalone role. The successful candidate will be the company’s only dedicated marketing resource, and must therefore be equally comfortable setting direction and executing it personally – from building and maintaining the marketing framework and managing the marketing budget, through to shooting content, briefing printers, and installing collateral at outlet level.

The role suits a self-motivated individual who is energised by building something from the ground up in a small, fast-moving business, and who understands that marketing is ultimately accountable for commercial outcomes and not activity alone.

2.

Key Responsibilities

a. Marketing Framework& Brand Direction

i.

Framework Ownership:

Develop, document, and own the company’s marketing framework, covering brand positioning, target audience, channel strategy, content pillars, campaign calendar, and partnership approach.

ii.

Relevance & Refresh:

Review and refresh the framework at least annually, and on an ad hoc basis where market conditions require, so that it remains relevant to consumer trends, competitor activity, and the company’s commercial priorities.

iii.

Alignment to Brand Vision:

Ensure all marketing direction, tone of voice, and visual identity remain aligned with the founder’s vision for the brand. Where the post-holder wishes to evolve the brand expression, this is to be proposed to and agreed with the Chief Executive Officer and General Manager before execution.

iv.

Campaign Planning:

Translate the framework into a rolling campaign calendar covering seasonal and festive campaigns, product launches, and always-on activity, with sufficient lead time for production and operational readiness.

b. Digital Content Creation

i.

Content Production:

Plan, shoot, and edit all digital content – photography, videography, and short-form video – for social media, website, e-commerce, and third-party delivery platforms.

ii.

Visual Storytelling:

Lead and conduct all product and lifestyle photoshoots, coordinating with the kitchen, outlet teams, and external vendors as required.

iii.

Copywriting:

Write all brand-facing copy, including social captions, EDM content, website and product descriptions, menu copy, and campaign messaging.

iv.

Asset Management:

Maintain an organised content and asset library so that approved images, videos, and copy are readily retrievable by the wider team.

c. Physical Marketing Materials

i.

Design:

Design all physical marketing collateral, including menus, posters, banners, buntings, flyers, table talkers, packaging inserts, and point-of-sale displays.

ii.

Print & Vendor Management:

Source, brief, and manage print and fabrication vendors – obtaining quotations, checking proofs and colour accuracy, and controlling cost and lead times.

iii.

Installation & Upkeep:

Take personal responsibility for the installation, rotation, and upkeep of physical collateral at both outlets, ensuring displays are current, correctly sited, and in good condition. This is a hands-on responsibility and not one that is delegated to outlet teams by default.

iv.

Approvals:

Obtain any landlord, building management, or regulatory approvals required for external signage, displays, or promotional installations.

d. Marketing Budget

i.

Budget Development:

Propose an annual marketing budget, broken down by channel, campaign, and expense category, for approval by the General Manager and Chief Executive Officer.

ii.

Budget Management:

Manage spend against the approved budget, maintain a live spend tracker, and flag anticipated variances in advance rather than in retrospect.

iii.

Return on Spend:

Justify marketing spend against expected commercial return, and reallocate budget away from underperforming activity where the evidence supports doing so.

iv.

Cost Control:

Negotiate rates and terms with vendors, media partners, platforms, and collaborators.

e. Sales Development &Lead Management

i.

Lead Generation:

Identify and pursue corporate, catering, gifting, event-planner, and community sales opportunities through outreach, networking, and partnerships.

ii.

Enquiry Management:

Manage incoming sales and event enquiries end-to-end – response, quotation, follow-up, and conversion – within agreed response timelines.

iii.

Client Relationships:

Build and maintain relationships with prospective and existing corporate clients to support repeat business and long-term accounts.

iv.

Opportunity Tracking:

Maintain an organised lead and opportunity tracker capturing enquiry source, status, value, and conversion outcome, to support forecasting and reporting.

v.

Operational Coordination:

Coordinate with outlet managers and the kitchen to confirm that corporate orders, catering, and event bookings are operationally deliverable before commitments are made to the client.

f. Community &Partnerships

i.

Partnership Development:

Identify and develop brand partnerships, collaborations, and co- marketing opportunities that extend reach without proportional increases in spend.

ii.

Media & Creators

:

Manage relationships with media, food publications, influencers, and content creators, including hosting and briefing.

iii.

Social Media &Community:

Maintain a consistent and timely presence across all company social media accounts, including community management of comments, direct messages, and public reviews.

iv.

On-the-Ground Coordination:

Work with outlet managers and frontline staff to capture authentic in-store content and to ensure campaigns are executed correctly and consistently at store level.

g. Reporting & Performance Measurement

i.

Metrics Design:

Propose, implement, and maintain a set of marketing performance measures that connect marketing activity to sales outcomes, rather than reporting reach and engagement in isolation.

ii.

Fortnightly Updates:

Provide a written fortnightly update to the General Manager and Chief Executive Officer covering campaigns currently in market, campaigns upcoming, spend against budget, results against agreed measures, and any matters requiring a decision.

iii.

Management Reporting:

Present a consolidated marketing and sales performance review at Management Team Meetings.

iv.

Post-Campaign Review:

Conduct a documented review after every major campaign, recording what worked, what did not, and what will be done differently next time.

3.

Working Relationships

– Reports to the General Manager on day-to-day priorities, budget, and performance, and to the Chief Executive Officer on brand direction and major campaign approvals.

– Works closely with outlet managers and operations teams to ensure campaigns, promotions, catering requests, and partnership activations are operationally executable and delivered to brand standard.

– Coordinates with the Head Baker and production team on product launches, seasonal offerings, product photography, and promotional planning, with adequate lead time for production capacity.

– Maintains working relationships with external vendors, photographers, designers, printers, media partners, influencers, and community collaborators.

– Develops and manages relationships with corporate clients, event organisers, and business partners to support revenue growth and brand visibility.

– Collaborates with frontline staff to gather customer insight, identify emerging trends, and capture authentic brand content at store level.

4.

Qualifications & Experience

– Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related discipline. Equivalent practical experience and a strong portfolio will be considered in lieu of formal qualifications.

–

Manager:

Minimum four years of relevant experience, including at least two years independently owning a marketing function, brand, or portfolio.

–

Assistant Manager:

Minimum two years of relevant experience, with demonstrated readiness to take on end-to-end ownership of a marketing portfolio.

– Prior experience in F&B, retail, hospitality, or a consumer lifestyle brand is strongly preferred.

– A portfolio of self-produced work – photography, video, design, and campaign examples– is required at interview.

– Experience managing a marketing budget and reporting on commercial outcomes is a distinct advantage.

5.

Skills Required

– Marketing strategy, framework development, and campaign planning

– Sales development, lead generation, and pipeline management

– Social media management, content scheduling, and community management

– Photography, videography, and content editing (including short-form video)

– Graphic design and production of marketing collateral

– Copywriting and brand communication

– Print production knowledge – file preparation, material selection, and vendor briefing

– Budget planning, spend tracking, and cost negotiation

– Data tracking, reporting, and performance analysis, including familiarity with social platform analytics, website analytics, and POS sales reporting

– Client relationship management and business development

– Event and partnership coordination

– Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, CapCut, or equivalent creative platforms

– Proficiency in Microsoft Office and presentation tools

– Strong verbal and written communication skills in English

6.

Key Attributes

–

Self-Motivated & Self-Directed:

Sets own priorities, works to self-imposed deadlines, and makes progress without being chased or closely supervised.

–

Comfortable Operating Independently:

Able to function effectively as a department of one, without an in-house team or standing agency support, and to know when to bring in external help.

–

Hands-On:

Willing to do the work personally – including shooting content, carrying and installing collateral, and being present at outlets – rather than working exclusively at a planning level.

–

Creative & Commercial Mindset:

Balances strong creative ideas against practical business and revenue objectives, and can explain why a piece of work is expected to earn its cost.

–

Commercially Numerate:

Comfortable working with budgets, sales figures, and performance data, and able to draw defensible conclusions from them.

–

Receptive to Direction:

Able to work within an established brand vision set by the founder, contributing ideas constructively and raising disagreement through discussion rather than through unilateral action.

–

Relationship Builder & Collaborative:

Comfortable engaging customers, partners, vendors, and internal teams across all levels, and contributes positively to team culture.

–

Organised & Detail-Oriented:

Maintainsstrong attention to detail across campaigns, communications, timelines,quotations, and sales coordination.

–

Adaptable & Resourceful:

Operates effectively where priorities and operational needs shift quickly, problem-solves independently, andremains composed under pressure or tight deadlines.

–

Brand Conscious & Culturally Attuned:

Understands the importance of consistency in branding, customer experience, and public perception, and has genuine feeling for the local heritage and food culture the brand is built on.

–

Results-Oriented:

Driven by measurable outcomes, continual improvement, and business growth.

–

Professionalism & Accountability:

Demonstrates maturity, reliability, discretion, and accountability in representing the company internally and externally.

7.

What Success Looks Like in the First Twelve Months

The following are indicative expectations and will be confirmed with the post-holder on appointment:

1. A documented marketing framework, approved by the Chief Executive Officer and General Manager, in active use as the basis for campaign planning.

2. An approved annual marketing budget supported by a live spend tracker, with spend managed within approved limits.

3. A consistent content cadence maintained across all active channels, with no unplanned gaps in the calendar.

4. A functioning lead and opportunity tracker, with measurable improvement in corporate and catering enquiry conversion.

5. An agreed set of performance measures that credibly links marketing activity to sales outcomes, reported on consistently.

6. Fortnightly reporting established as routine practice, and post-campaign reviews completed for all major campaigns.

Interested applicants are invited to send a curriculum vitae and portfolio to hello@keongsaikbakery.com. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

Traditional. Nostalgic. Contemporary.

A bakery bridging the past and present through varying baking styles and flavour combinations.

title: Brand Marketing Director
description:
About GNAME

GNAME is Asia’s leading domain registrar, based out of Singapore. We power a native marketplace designed for discovering, buying, and selling the perfect brand identity—including a backorder system of high-value, premium domain names that have expired into digital ether.

For more info on what we do: https://www.gname.com

We are seeking an experienced Brand Marketing Director to lead GNAME's global brand and marketing strategy, strengthen brand positioning, build integrated marketing capabilities, grow brand awareness and customer engagement across priority international markets, and translate business strategy into measurable brand and marketing outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

1. Global Brand Strategy & Positioning

· Develop and lead GNAME's global brand strategy, positioning, value proposition and brand architecture in alignment with business strategy and international growth priorities.

· Define brand narratives, messaging frameworks, tone of voice and visual direction to ensure a consistent and differentiated brand across markets and customer touchpoints.

· Advise senior management on brand strategy, market positioning, reputation and major marketing priorities.

· Establish brand governance standards across corporate, product, digital, event and employer-facing communications.

· Monitor brand health, market perception and competitive positioning and translate insights into strategic actions.

2. Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning

· Develop annual and multi-market marketing strategies, priorities, budgets and execution roadmaps supporting customer acquisition, engagement, retention and business growth.

· Lead integrated campaigns across digital, content, social media, public relations, partnerships, events, community and other relevant channels.

· Translate business and product priorities into audience strategies, campaign propositions and go-to-market programmes.

· Build effective planning, campaign governance, agency/vendor management and performance review processes.

· Balance long-term brand building with measurable demand and commercial outcomes.

3. International Market Development & Go-to-Market

· Lead brand and marketing initiatives for priority international markets, including market-entry and growth programmes where relevant.

· Conduct market, customer, competitor and category analysis to identify growth opportunities, audience needs and positioning gaps.

· Adapt global brand and campaign strategies to local market context while maintaining overall brand consistency.

· Partner with business development, sales, product and operations teams on market launches, customer programmes and strategic partnerships.

· Build relationships with relevant industry communities, media, partners and ecosystem stakeholders to expand GNAME's visibility and credibility.

4. Digital, Content & Community Marketing

· Set the strategy for owned digital channels, social media, content, community and thought-leadership programmes.

· Develop content frameworks communicating GNAME's expertise in domain names and internet services to relevant customer and industry audiences.

· Oversee editorial calendars, campaign content, executive communications, corporate storytelling and key digital assets.

· Strengthen customer and industry engagement through communities, educational content, events and other relationship-building initiatives.

· Ensure content quality, brand consistency and appropriate review processes across external communications.

5. Marketing Performance, Analytics & Customer Insights

· Define marketing KPIs covering brand awareness, engagement, customer acquisition, conversion, campaign effectiveness and return on marketing investment.

· Use customer, market, channel and campaign data to evaluate performance and guide budget and resource allocation.

· Develop regular marketing dashboards and management reports with clear insights, risks and recommended actions.

· Strengthen customer insight and feedback mechanisms to improve positioning, messaging, campaigns and customer experience.

· Promote a test-and-learn culture and continuously improve marketing effectiveness through experimentation and performance analysis.

6. Team Leadership & Cross-functional Collaboration

· Build, lead and develop the brand and marketing function, including capability planning, objective setting, performance management and talent development.

· Work closely with the CEO and senior management to align brand and marketing priorities with Company strategy.

· Partner with product, business development, sales, operations, customer service, compliance, legal, finance and HR teams to deliver integrated initiatives.

· Manage external agencies, consultants, media, creative partners and other vendors where required.

· Establish clear standards, workflows and accountability to ensure high-quality and timely marketing execution.

7. Reputation, Communications & Brand Risk Management

· Oversee corporate brand communications and support reputation management across relevant external channels.

· Develop communication approaches for significant company announcements, partnerships, product developments and industry engagement.

· Work with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure external marketing and communications are accurate, appropriate and aligned with applicable requirements.

· Identify brand and reputation risks and establish appropriate escalation, review and response mechanisms.

· Support senior leaders in external communications and thought leadership where appropriate.

Requirements

· Bachelor's degree or above in Marketing, Communications, Business, Brand Management or a related discipline.

· At least 12 years of progressive experience in brand, marketing or integrated communications, including substantial experience in a senior marketing leadership role.

· Demonstrated experience developing and executing brand and marketing strategy across multiple markets, including brand positioning, integrated campaigns, digital/content marketing and marketing performance.

· Experience in technology, internet, SaaS, digital platforms, e-commerce, fintech or another international digital business is highly preferred.

· Strong understanding of digital customer journeys, international marketing channels, content and community building, and data-driven marketing.

· Proven ability to partner with CEOs, senior executives and cross-functional leaders and translate business strategy into practical brand and marketing programmes.

· Strong leadership, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, analytical, communication and change-management capabilities.

· Experience managing marketing budgets, agencies, vendors and multi-channel programmes with measurable outcomes.

· Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, international and evolving organisation, balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution when required.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Chinese to liaise with internal and external stakeholders.

About Us

GNAME was established in Singapore as a professional international domain name registrar. We are dedicated to creating a comprehensive service platform for Internet domain names. At GNAME, domain names are at the heart of our business, and we offer a wide range of services to our customers, including global domain name registration, dropcatch, transactions, management, API interfaces, and other relevant services. Adopting an open reseller model, we offer reseller a one-stop management system including products, transactions, and financial management, fully supporting their business development. In addition to domain services, we also provide a diverse range of cloud products such as cloud servers, SSL certificates, website protection, and enterprise email services. Based on cloud computing technology, these services are highly scalable and secure, meeting customers’ needs in information technology and network security.

Our strong reputation is built on our commitment to putting customers first. In the future, we will continue to work hard, stay current with industry trends, and deliver the most valuable products and services to our global customers.

title: Vice President - Transformation Specialist - Chief Transformation Office
description:
Company Overview

Nomura is a financial services group with an integrated global network. By connecting markets East & West, we service the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through our four business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking) and Banking.

Driven by the insights of some 28,000 people worldwide, we put our clients at the center of everything we do, delivering unparalleled access to, from and within Asia. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com

Divisional Overview

The Chief Transformation Office function oversees group-wide transformation on mission critical projects for the firm. We’re aligned to our key businesses across the group and operate to global standards and governance across our programs. Our purpose is to support Nomura’s business strategy and deliver consistent group-wide services based on common operating principles.

Job Overview

The Vice President, Transformation Specialist is a high-impact, execution-focused role tasked with defining and delivering strategic transformation initiatives across Nomura. This position bridges strategic vision and operational execution, requiring a change-driven leader who can translate ambiguous objectives into structured, measurable outcomes while engaging senior stakeholders globally.

The ideal candidate is a go-getter with strong technical rigor (financial modeling, AI/Excel) and exceptional leadership (influencing without authority, driving cross-functional alignment). While domain expertise in financial services is advantageous, the role prioritizes technical adaptability, change leadership, and execution excellence.

The VP will lead cross-functional teams and engage senior stakeholders across functions and regions. The portfolio will span structural reform, location strategy, AI-enabled transformation, outsourcing and strategic vendor partnerships, with a focus on measurable outcomes and effective execution.

Responsibilities

Strategy, Business Cases and Workstream Definition

Translate strategic priorities into well-defined initiatives, problem statements, options and target outcomes.

Develop rigorous business cases, including baseline analysis, financial models, benefits, costs, dependencies, implementation options and delivery risks.

Scope workstreams, define deliverables and milestones, establish governance, and create practical mobilisation and execution plans.

Apply strong numerical judgement to challenge assumptions, test scenarios and support evidence-based investment decisions.

Transformation Delivery and Value Realisation

Own initiatives from definition through mobilisation and delivery, maintaining clear plans, decision points, dependencies, risks and outcomes.

Lead multidisciplinary project teams through influence, setting direction and holding contributors accountable without relying on formal line-management authority.

Create transparent reporting for senior governance forums and ensure agreed benefits are measurable, tracked and realised.

Balance strategic ambition, execution feasibility, control requirements and sustainable organisational capability.

Strong AI-Adoption into the role

Identify, articulate and prioritise practical AI prompts and use cases that improve productivity, decision-making and business outcomes within the role.

Use Microsoft Copilot effectively for administration, analysis, document production and presentations; bring familiarity with the broader enterprise AI landscape.

Senior Stakeholder Engagement and Project Leadership

Build trusted relationships with Business Managers and senior stakeholders across functions and regions, including at VP, Executive Director and Managing Director level.

Structure complex issues into concise, decision-ready materials and communicate recommendations with clarity and credibility.

Facilitate workshops, challenge constructively, resolve ambiguity and build alignment across stakeholders with differing priorities.

Coordinate global project teams across Asia, the UK and the US, ensuring clear ownership, timely decisions and consistent execution.

What Success Looks Like

Strategic priorities are converted quickly into credible, decision-ready business cases and clearly scoped workstreams.

Financial and operational assumptions are transparent, evidence-based and sufficiently robust to support senior investment decisions.

Projects mobilise effectively, maintain senior stakeholder alignment and deliver agreed milestones, benefits and control outcomes.

AI use cases and prompts move beyond ideas into practical adoption, with measurable productivity or business value.

Project and business solution recommendations balance value, capability, resilience, governance and regulatory requirements.

The VP is recognized as a trusted, self-directed transformation partner who can lead project teams and influence effectively across functions, cultures and time zones.

Requirements

Minimum Degree in Business Management or related field

Minimum 10 years’ experience in business transformation function with a focus on strategy, change delivery, and business analysis within investment banking or the wider financial services sector.

description:
Position Overview:

Clifford Capital Asset Management (“CCAM”) is a new line of business that was established in December 2024. CCAM is regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (the “MAS”) and holds a Capital Market Service License to conduct fund management activities for accredited and institutional investors. CCAM will focus on launching mandates as well as collective investment schemes. CCAM products are expected to invest in range of credit instruments including but not limited to senior credit, subordinated debt/high yield as well as hybrid instruments representing debt financing.

Primary Responsibilities:

Work closely with origination, corporate coverage and investor coverage teams to source, assess and execute infrastructure credit investment opportunities across CCAM-managed pools of capital

Lead credit due diligence, investment analysis, financial modelling, structuring assessment and risk evaluation for primary and secondary market opportunities

Build and maintain relationships with banks, sponsors, intermediaries, investors and other market participants to strengthen CCAM’s market presence and access to investment opportunities

Prepare and present investment recommendations, credit papers and portfolio updates to CCAM’s Investment Committee, senior management and relevant governance forums

Drive the internal credit application and approval process, coordinating inputs from origination, risk, legal, operations and other relevant stakeholders

Undertake upfront and ongoing relative value analysis, portfolio monitoring, asset performance review and portfolio management activities across relevant mandates and funds

Support investor marketing, fundraising and due diligence processes by providing investment insights, portfolio information and market perspectives as required

Act as deal captain for selected transactions, providing end-to-end transaction leadership and, over time, supervising and mentoring junior investment team members

Professional Experience / Qualifications:

At least 10 years of relevant experience in infrastructure credit, private credit, project finance, leveraged finance, structured finance, asset management or a related investment role within a financial institution or investment platform

Strong academic background, with demonstrated investment judgement and experience in credit analysis, investment structuring, financial modelling and investment committee processes

Strong understanding of infrastructure, private credit and APAC markets; experience across global infrastructure debt markets or cross-border transactions would be advantageous

Proven ability to manage multiple transactions and portfolio priorities independently, with strong execution discipline, commercial judgement and attention to detail

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the maturity and credibility to engage senior management, investment committees, investors, counterparties and external advisers

Business-level Japanese language skills are advantageous for engaging with Japanese investors and counterparties

Headquartered in Singapore and established in 2012, Clifford Capital is an infrastructure credit financing platform for real assets globally across the debt capital structure. The Group is increasingly pivoting towards areas such as clean energy, energy transition, social and digital infrastructure, electrification, and maritime decarbonisation to address the challenges posed by environmental, social and governance issues globally, and in particular within the Asia Pacific region. Its ambition is to deliver innovative financing solutions that positively influence sustainability and deliver commercial returns for its shareholders.

Clifford Capital aims to build a globally competitive alternative asset management and financing platform closely aligned to Singapore’s objectives of creating a centre of excellence in financial markets focused on sustainability and green finance.

Clifford Capital’s shareholders comprise Temasek Holdings, Prudential Assurance Company Singapore, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, Standard Chartered Bank, DBS Bank, John Hancock Life Insurance Company (Manulife), and the Asian Development Bank.

description:

R-92756

Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. WHO WILL YOU WORK WITH?

You’ll be a key member of the Southeast Asia & India (SEAI) Analytics team, delivering action-oriented quantitative insights across our channels including Nike Digital, Nike Stores, and Wholesale Partners. Reporting to the Senior Manager of SEAI Marketplace Analytics, the Analytics Lead will work with cross-functional stakeholders to unlock insights and integrate them into business processes to maximize revenue and profitable growth. In this role, you’ll work closely with SEAI Marketplace, Planning, Finance and Strategy and their cross-functional teams. You’ll also partner with Enterprise Business Intelligence, Data Science, and Competitive Intelligence teams in Asia Pacific & Latin America, as well as global teams, to deliver territory insights. This role offers an exciting opportunity to drive significant impact on Nike’s growth strategy by using data-driven insights to inform strategic decisions and improve business performance.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

You’re a seasoned analytics professional who thrives as a trusted authority. You love solving hard problems and can present complex ideas in a way that’s easy to understand, anticipating objections while persuading others to adopt and act on a point of view. You’re a champion of analytics and applied data science, bringing creative and innovative quantitative methods to deliver insight-driven strategies. Your people and communication skills are unparalleled. You’re a gifted storyteller who is adept at crafting work that persuades, influences, and inspires multi-disciplinary teams. You’ve got an in-depth knowledge of the retail landscape and emerging trends and are passionate about turning data into impactful business decisions.

Advanced quantitative degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Business, Data Science, or related field
5+ years of experience in Advanced Analytics, Applied Data Science, Economics or related areas
Expertise in retail operations analytics (conversion, basket economics), localized assortment and allocation insights, and member and digital engagement in physical stores (e.g., attach, redemption, and omnichannel journeys)
Hands-on experience with SQL, cloud-based platforms (e.g., Databricks), visualization tools (e.g., Tableau), and proficiency in one or more scripting languages (Python or R)
Experience applying AI/ML to retail store analytics, including forecasting, store segmentation, and decision support for assortment and door-level fulfillment
Ability to think creatively with data, formulate and gain traction around new ideas, and bring a new perspective to the business
Proven ability to influence and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills with a high level of attention to detail and commitment to excellence
Experience working in direct-to-consumer and retail environments, with a deep understanding of omnichannel trends
Ability to collaborate closely with data science and business intelligence teams to translate business strategy into data-driven solution
Passion for the consumer experience, ideally at the intersection of retail and sports

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

Analyze large, complex datasets to identify patterns, correlations and actionable insights using statistical methods and advanced analytics techniques
Define and monitor KPIs, use root cause analysis to diagnose changes in trends, and apply causal inference techniques to optimize marketplace, marketing, product, and operational strategies
Act as an ongoing thought partner and strategic advisor to stakeholders to ensure insights are being interpreted and effectively applied
Collaborate with Marketplace, Strategy, Finance, and their cross-functional teams to translate technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations
Craft presentations and reports that distill complex analyses into compelling narratives for stakeholders across various levels of leadership

NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete* in the world.

NIKE, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

OUR HIRING GAME PLAN
01 Apply

Our teams are made up of diverse skillsets, knowledge bases, inputs, ideas and backgrounds. We want you to find your fit – review job descriptions, departments and teams to discover the role for you.

02 Meet a Recruiter or Take an Assessment

If selected for a corporate role, a recruiter will reach out to start your interview process and be your main contact throughout the process. For retail roles, you’ll complete an interactive assessment that includes a chat and quizzes and takes about 10-20 minutes to complete. No matter the role, we want to learn about you – the whole you – so don’t shy away from how you approach world-class service and what makes you unique.

03 Interview

Go into this stage confident by doing your research, understanding what we are looking for and being prepared for questions that are set up to learn more about you, and your background.

title: Corporate Communications Intern
description:
Purpose of Role

Support the Corporate Communications Manager in content development, digital communications, multimedia production, and corporate communication initiatives while gaining practical experience in the communications profession.

Key Responsibilities

Content Development and Storytelling

Assist in developing written and visual content for internal and external communication channels.

Support the collection and organisation of information, stories, and communication assets from various departments.

Digital Communications

Support the maintenance and updating of website and digital communication platforms.

Assist in preparing and publishing content across relevant digital channels.

Multimedia Production

Assist in photography, videography, and basic multimedia production for organisational activities, events, and campaigns.

Support the management and organisation of digital media assets.

Publications and CommunicationsProjects

Support the development of corporate publications, reports, and communication materials.

Assist in coordinating communication projects and tracking timelines.

Internal Communications and Events

Support employee engagement and internal communication initiatives.

Assist with communication-related activities during organisational events and campaigns.

General Support

Provide administrative and coordination support for corporate communications activities and projects.

Undertake other duties and projects assigned by the supervisor.

Requirements

Qualifications

Pursuing a Diploma or Degree in Communications, Marketing, Media, Public Relations, Journalism, or a related discipline.

Skills and Attributes

Good written and verbal communication skills.

Strong interpersonal and organisational skills.

Able to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Attention to detail and willingness to learn.

Familiarity with Microsoft Office applications.

Experience with content creation, design, photography, videography, or digital media tools would be an advantage.

The Humble Beginning

Cheng Hong Welfare Service Society has come a long way since its humble beginnings.

Cheng Hong Welfare started as the welfare arm of Cheng Hong Slang Tng (Charitable Organisation) in 2004 and till today, Cheng Hong Slang Tng has been generously support us operationally and financially.

Cheng Hong Welfare Society has abided by the highest standard of Governance and Transparency and has been granted Institution of Public Character (i.e. tax-exempt) status by the Commissioner of Charities. We are also a full member of National Council of Social Service (NCSS).

The Journey

For the past 12 years, our Management Committee members, dedicated staff and most importantly, our generous donors, supporters and big hearted volunteers have worked hard to help build this organization.

Cheng Hong Welfare Service Society has slowly grown stronger and gathering more resources to make a bigger impact on the community we are serving.

Out TCM Medical Services provide Pro Bono TCM treatment and free medications to the disadvantaged and elderly. It started with a humble clinic in Cheng Hong Siang Tng. With the support of generous donors working together with government agencies and partners, it has expanded to include a Medical Centre and six TCM Clinics island-wide.

In additions, it also offered other charitable services like provide food ration, education grants, visits to homes, bring elderly for tours etc.

The New Service

In October 2012, with the generous support of friends and donors, Cheng Hong Welfare Service Society has established a fund and setup an afterlife memorial service. This service provides free columbarium service to those who requires service, regardless of race and religion.

We have been working hard to raise awareness through television and radio with the help of MediaCorp as well as on the ground to elderly homes and care centres with the help of Emperor Entertainment Production Co’s artiste. We are developing this service with pre-registration of funeral arrangement. What the Charity has done in the last twelve years, is serve the communities in need and to make Singapore better place where nobody is left behind.

title: Manager, Donor Engagement (Community Engagement and Partnerships)
description:
The Manager of Donor Engagement is responsible for growing and managing donor relationships across multiple segments to strengthen long-term support for the Society. Working closely with the Senior Manager, the role leads a team to deliver meaningful supporter experiences, identify new opportunities for growth and ensure strong portfolio performance while maintaining effective governance and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

1. Relationship Management and Resource Development

Develop and manage a portfolio of donors across multiple segments, building trusted relationships that strengthen long-term engagement and financial support.

Cultivate existing supporters while proactively identifying and securing new donors to expand the Society's supporter community.

Develop engagement strategies that encourage donor retention, increased giving, advocacy and long-term partnerships.

Represent the Society confidently during donor meetings, networking opportunities and engagement activities.

2. Portfolio Growth and Performance

Lead the planning and execution of donor engagement strategies that strengthen acquisition, retention and portfolio growth.

Monitor portfolio performance and identify opportunities to deepen relationships through renewals, multi-year giving, referrals and strategic collaborations.

Analyse donor behaviour, giving trends and engagement data to improve supporter experience and long-term value.

Support fundraising campaigns, donor events and engagement initiatives that contribute to organisational fundraising goals.

3. Team Leadership and Capability Development

Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching and guidance to team members to strengthen relationship management capability and performance.

Conduct regular portfolio reviews and support staff in achieving agreed engagement and fundraising objectives.

Foster a collaborative, proactive and supporter-centred team culture that encourages continuous learning and innovation.

Lead by example through active donor engagement and professional relationship management.

4. Governance and Operational Excellence

Ensure accurate and timely maintenance of supporter records, engagement activities and portfolio reporting.

Ensure due diligence, safeguarding, compliance and governance requirements are consistently applied across supporter engagement activities.

Prepare reports, forecasts and management information to support planning, performance monitoring and strategic decision-making.

Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, systems and supporter engagement practices.

Qualifications and Experience

Postgraduate qualifications preferred.

At least 5 years of relevant experience in fundraising, donor engagement or stakeholder relations, preferably in the social service or non-profit sector.

Demonstrated experience supervising teams and managing stakeholder relationships.

Experience managing donor portfolios, corporate partnerships or community engagement initiatives.

Experience in governance, compliance and fundraising regulations will be advantageous.

Strong communication, relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.

Personal Attributes

Compassionate and genuinely enjoys connecting with people.

Proactive, resilient and motivated to identify new opportunities.

Confident communicator who builds trust with diverse stakeholders.

Organised and able to balance relationship-building with operational excellence.

High integrity and strong commitment to the well-being and protection of children.

About Singapore Children’s Society

Singapore Children’s Society protects and nurtures children and youth of all races and religions. In 2025, the Society reached out to 22,333 children, youth and families in need. Established in 1952, its services have evolved to meet the changing needs of children.

Today, Children’s Society operates more than 10 service centres islandwide, offering services in the four categories of: Vulnerable Children and Youth, Children and Youth Services, Family Services, and Research and Advocacy.

Our Patron-in-Chief is President Tharman Shanmugaratnam.

Our

Mission

We champion the wellbeing of children and youth by shifting mindsets and creating lasting change

Our

Vision

A future where every child and youth enjoys a safe and happy childhood and flourishes in strong families and caring communities

Our

Core Values

Compassion and Caring, Commitment, Professionalism, Integrity, and Openness to Change

For more information, please you can also watch our latest corporate video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UW_xE_3y-nY

title: Training Management Trainee
description:
About the Role

Build your career through AKC’s two year Management Trainee Programme, designed to develop future Team Leads and business leaders.

You will complete four six-month rotations across Customer Success & Marketing, Revenue, Training Management and Compliance, and Business Development. Through hands-on assignments, mentorship and cross-functional projects, you will gain a strong understanding of AKC’s customers, operations, products and growth strategies.

High-performing trainees may be considered for progression into a Team Lead or suitable specialist position upon successful completion.

What You’ll Be Doing

1. Customer Success & Marketing

Conduct market and competitor research.

Follow up on leads, registrations and customer engagement.

Support digital campaigns, paid advertising, content creation and course promotions.

Assist with roadshows, events and course launches.

Track campaign performance, lead generation and conversions.

2. Revenue

Support sales pipelines, revenue tracking and performance reporting.

Maintain accurate records across CRM, ERP and reporting systems.

Analyse business data and identify performance trends.

Support workflow improvement, automation and digitalisation projects.

3. Business Development

Research new markets, clients and partnership opportunities.

Support corporate outreach, meetings and presentations.

Prepare proposals, quotations and tender submissions.

Assist with partnerships, new courses and business expansion projects.

4. Training Management and Compliance

Support the planning, coordination, and administration of training programmes.

Coordinate training materials, assessments and certification records.

Assist with quality assurance, audits and regulatory compliance.

Monitor compliance processes and recommend improvements where appropriate.

Leadership Development

In addition to the four rotations, you will:

Receive coaching and mentorship from staff and senior leaders.

Lead or support cross-functional projects.

Present recommendations and project outcomes to management.

Develop skills in decision-making, communication and stakeholder management.

Take on increasing responsibility throughout the programme.

Build the capabilities needed to progress into a Team Lead position.

What You’ll Gain

Four structured six-month departmental rotations to develop a holistic understanding of the business.

Practical experience solving real business and operational challenges.

Potential progression into a Team Lead or suitable specialist role

What We’re Looking For

Diploma or degree in Business Management or related disciplines

Fresh graduates and entry-level candidates are welcome.

Strong interest in business management and leadership.

Good communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.

Proactive, adaptable and willing to take ownership.

Able to work independently and collaborate across teams.

Absolute Kinetics Consultancy (AKC) Pte Ltd officially opened for business on 18th April 2001.

AKC is an Approved Training Organisation appointed by SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG) to provide a wide range of courses approved by Ministry of Manpower (MOM), SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG), Singapore Resuscitation and First Aid Council (SRFAC), & Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF).

Its clientele list includes SMEs to MNCs from various industrials ranging from construction, manufacturing, oil & gas to employment firms (Certificate of Employment Intermediaries for Key Appointment Holders & General Employees). The company is also an approved MOM SIP (Settling in Programme for Foreign Domestic Workers) training center and an approved Food Safety training provider.

AKC conducts workplace and health safety courses as its core business and also offers consultancy, risk management and other specialised training services such as certificate for employment intermediaries. It also has a team of around 100 professionals (comprising full time and part time trainers) skilled in various safety specialisations such as construction safety, scaffolding, shipyard safety, metalworking and welding, amongst others.

title: Regional Programme Director, APAC
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.

JLL are seeking candidates for the role of Regional Programme Director, APAC

This position is a key management role, leading the delivery of project and programme services across APAC for a regional Client with whom JLL provides end-to-end services. The position reports to the APAC Account Director, but interfaces with internal and client stakeholders across service lines. The successful candidate will lead a small team of programme managers responsible for the governance, oversight and implementation of pan regional programmes of work.

The successful candidate will be responsible for:
Leading and mentoring a diverse team across the APAC region in the delivery of: The Client’s rolling 5-year plan for asset renewal and maintenance works
Selected capital programmes with projects of higher complexity / value

Implementation of an effective PMO structure, including project and programme governance and performance management and driving a culture if continuous improvement in process
Oversight of, and point of escalation, for ‘variable project teams
Meeting and exceeding Account / Client KPI’s

Typical project types include refurbishment of existing facilities including offices and residential, work involving replacement of life expired building fabric (roof, façade) and infrastructure works including drainage renewal, HVAC replacement etc.

The preferred candidate will have a background in overseeing construction projects of a diverse nature with multiple interdependencies and strong stakeholder engagement skills. They will exhibit strong contract literacy, be confident in liaising with international consultants and holding them accountable within the project lifecycle and treat Health & Safety as non-negotiable. In their leadership role they will be culturally aware, bridging the gap between an established delivery baseline and local operating realities through effective communication in both directions.

Key Responsibilities
Act as the Client’s primary point of contact in the region for strategy, implementation and escalation for capital works, blending Client’s Global direction with Local Business needs.
Own the relationship with Key Stakeholders and assure effective communication from internal Client challenge. Serve as the single point of contact providing accountability and certainty. Ensure alignment and communication to client business lines and stakeholders. Where required manage conflict resolution.
Provides accountability to client for the project delivery of Client’s real estate portfolio in APAC, from strategy to handover to internal Facility Management team.
Assist the Client in the development and implementation of a rolling 5-year capital project strategy including, but not limited, to annual project planning and defining in country delivery strategy to achieve value for money
Active involvement during the due diligence / planning stage, providing information and recommendations to Client on budget, program, and procurement route, informed by a working knowledge of public sector contract frameworks and the consultant landscape the Client draws from.
Establish and maintain a standard set of practices, processes and templates for managing projects consistently and efficiently to reduce project related risk and costs, constructively challenging the Client's inherited approach where it does not fit APAC delivery conditions.
Lead the continuous review and optimisation of process / governance with a view to ensuring it is aligned to business needs, reflects industry best practice, proportionate and scalable to the needs of the regional business – identifying and driving opportunities for strengthening governance / compliance through efficiency and improvement to project management process and methods
Spearhead Client’s process for business approval in the region, review before formal submission into Client’s systems.
Conducts regular update presentations to Global and Regional Client Stakeholders.
Oversee the collection, consolidation and analysis of program and project data to drive effective decision making
Act as a point of escalation, liaising with JLL Country leads to resolve matters in relation to project stress
Establish and foster strong relationship with key Client Stakeholders (eg: Operations, IT and Security) and local Business Sponsors.
Ensure effective implementation of client’s standards and local office requirements and regulations.
Support the development of the Client’s Global Sustainable initiatives by working with the JLL Sustainability Team to develop and prioritize projects to be incorporated into the annual capital plan
Lead a team of programme / project managers to: define, agree and report on project timelines, technical issues and stakeholder engagement for capital projects
Ensure all work orders and contracts are drafted, approved and executed before starting work on a project
Provide oversight to all of the regional projects, give expert guidance and advice on all matters relating to project delivery.
On board in country delivery project managers and ensure they deliver projects to specification, on time and in budget.
Take ownership of project reporting, ensuring that the PM’s report accurately, through inhouse PMIS tools or other preferred methods, on the status of the project and project finances
Ensure that changes to scope or budget are reported on and managed accordingly
Ensure that project/program risks are reported on and managed accordingly
Drive cost assurance and value engineering.
Ensure Health & Safety is planned effectively and implemented across all projects, driving the expected standard of behaviour through the whole project team.

Manage existing performance management frameworks associated with vendors (consultants, contractors and suppliers)
Identify and address areas of concern regarding potential liabilities and risk.
Ensure that Client Security requirements are adhered to across project delivery

Key Roles & Responsibilities internal to JLL
Manage, mentor and develop JLL staff members employed on the Account
Implement JLL’s Account Management Deliverables, including Mandatory Account Deliverables
Support regular Account Health checks
Own all commercial and contractual matters in connection with JLL’s services. Ensure all agreements and documentation necessary for invoicing is in place, assure the issue of invoices, drive cash collection and identify opportunities that improve JLL margin without comprising the service provided.
Monitor and review account profitability with Business Line heads periodically
Create awareness of JLL’s full range of services to the client as value creation opportunities
Develop and deliver value add services within the PMO
Comply with all JLL policies and procedures, including but not limited to ethics and business practice
Demonstrate knowledge transfer from lessons learnt across projects and within the programme to improve service delivery.

Growth of Account
Meet assigned financial targets covering account sales and key pursuits. Services include Account Management, Project & Program Management and Design Services.
Own and participate with representatives from Client and JLL in the development of the annual business plan covering whole company objectives.
Create awareness of JLL’s full range of services to the client as value creating opportunities
Develop the relationship with JLL and Client Leadership Teams to promote JLL capability in the delivery of larger Capex projects
Monitor and review account profitability with Account Director periodically
Keep key Business Heads aware of business opportunities with the Client and exercise judgment which will have organizational wide impacts.

Key Result Areas
1. Client Satisfaction Scores
2. KPIs
3. Consistent delivery measured by reduced Client escalations
4. Revenue growth measured by increasing Margin / Revenue
5. Reapplication of learnings
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.

About JLL –

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Vice President, ASEAN FX Strategist (Job ID:10079919)
description:
An exceptional opportunity has arisen for an experienced Vice President Senior Currency Analyst to join a highly respected global financial institution in Singapore. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on producing insightful research reports focused on ASEAN economies and foreign exchange rates, particularly with expertise in INR, VND, and PHP. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the organisation’s visibility across international markets by conducting independent research and contributing to team’s regular publications that provide actionable insights to both internal stakeholders and a diverse global client base. The position offers a unique blend of analytical rigour, stakeholder engagement, and the chance to work closely with colleagues across Tokyo, London, New York, and Asia. With a supportive team environment, this is your chance to make a significant impact while developing your career within a collaborative and inclusive culture.

Deliver high-impact research on ASEAN economies and FX rates, enhancing the organisation’s reputation across global markets through regular publications and thematic studies.

Engage directly with clients and internal teams via seminars, webinars, conference calls, and company visits to share insights and foster strong professional relationships.

Benefit from flexible working opportunities within a knowledgeable team that values collaboration, ongoing learning, and personal growth.

What you'll do:

As a Vice President Senior Currency Analyst based in Singapore, you will be at the forefront of delivering high-quality economic research that shapes strategic decisions for both internal stakeholders and external clients worldwide. Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve producing detailed analyses of ASEAN economies—especially focusing on India (INR), Vietnam (VND), and the Philippines (PHP)—and generating regular publications that keep clients informed about market developments. You will collaborate closely with colleagues across multiple regions to contribute to global research pipelines while also engaging directly with customers through various channels such as seminars or webinars. Success in this role requires not only technical expertise but also excellent communication skills for presenting complex information clearly. Your ability to build strong relationships internally and externally will be crucial as you help drive customer satisfaction through insightful analysis.

Produce comprehensive research reports on ASEAN economic trends and foreign exchange rates with a particular focus on INR, VND, and PHP currencies.

Contribute regularly to daily FX updates, weekly market reviews, and quarterly outlooks as part of the Asia Global Market Research team.

Develop in-depth thematic studies and ad-hoc commentary on economic data releases, policy changes, market events, and currency movements relevant to Southeast Asia.

Create and maintain robust quantitative models for economic indicators and foreign exchange forecasting to support research outputs.

Participate actively in regional and global research initiatives by collaborating with colleagues in Tokyo, London, New York, and other key locations.

Engage with clients through conference calls, seminars, webinars, company visits, and business trips to present research findings and address queries.

Build effective partnerships with sales teams, traders, relationship managers, and other stakeholders to ensure timely responses to market-related questions.

Support junior team members by providing coaching, guidance, and sharing best practices within the Asia GMR team.

Ensure all activities comply with relevant regulations, internal policies, risk controls, and dual-entity guidelines as required by the functional arrangement.

Assist in managing the department’s risk profile by adhering strictly to compliance standards and supporting operational excellence.

What you bring:

To excel as a Vice President Senior Currency Analyst in Singapore you will bring substantial experience from previous roles where you have delivered high-quality economic or FX research within major financial institutions or consultancies. Your background should include advanced academic training—ideally at postgraduate level—in economics or finance coupled with hands-on expertise in both qualitative assessment techniques (such as policy analysis) and quantitative methods (including econometric modelling). You are adept at distilling complex macroeconomic trends into actionable insights for diverse audiences ranging from senior executives to institutional investors. Strong interpersonal skills; you thrive when collaborating across functions or mentoring less experienced colleagues. A deep understanding of compliance requirements—particularly those associated with multi-entity operations—is essential given the dual-hat nature of this role. Above all else your commitment to accuracy integrity teamwork continuous learning sets you apart as an invaluable member of any high-performing research function.

Minimum 10 years of experience in Global markets working in Singapore or any other regional market.

Demonstrated experience of at least eight years in economic or foreign exchange research within financial services or related sectors is essential for this position.

Proven experience building robust models for economic indicators or FX forecasting supports data-driven decision-making within the team

A bachelor’s degree or higher qualification in economics, finance or another relevant discipline provides the necessary academic foundation for success.

Proven ability to conduct both qualitative assessments and quantitative analyses when tackling complex economic issues is vital for producing impactful research outputs.

Strong presentation abilities enable you to communicate findings effectively during seminars, webinars or client meetings across different regions.

A collaborative approach is important as you will work closely with colleagues from various departments such as sales or trading as well as mentor junior staff members.

Familiarity with regulatory frameworks governing financial institutions ensures compliance with all relevant laws including those specific to dual-entity arrangements.

Excellent stakeholder management skills allow you to develop productive relationships both internally within the organisation and externally with global corporate clients.

What sets this company apart:

This organisation stands out as one of the world’s most established financial institutions renowned for its commitment to excellence integrity innovation within global markets. Employees benefit from being part of an inclusive workplace culture that prioritises knowledge-sharing professional development mutual respect among colleagues at every level. The company offers flexible working opportunities designed to support work-life balance alongside access to extensive training resources that empower individuals at all stages of their careers. Collaboration is deeply embedded in everyday practice ensuring everyone feels valued supported able contribute meaningfully towards shared goals whether working locally in Singapore or connecting virtually with peers around the globe. By joining this team you become part of a network dedicated not only delivering outstanding results but also nurturing talent fostering long-term growth leadership within financial services sector.

What's next:

If you are ready to take your career in economic research to new heights we encourage you to explore this exciting opportunity further!

Apply today by clicking on the link provided – your next rewarding challenge awaits.

We regret to inform that only shortlisted applicants will be notified.

title: Assistant PR Manager
description:

Great ideas start with coffee, Bacha Coffee starts with you. We are headquartered in Singapore with coffee rooms and boutiques in Europe and Asia currently. We are expanding aggressively to achieve a worldwide presence in the upcoming months...

Bacha Coffee specialises in 100% Arabica coffees and provides customers with a unique opportunity to travel the world through their cup by exploring harvests from over 30 of the most well-reputed coffee producing countries. Even our distinctive fine blended, fine-flavoured and naturally decaffeinated coffees are produced using only 100% Arabica beans to give coffee lovers the widest choice, without ever sacrificing quality or flavour.

The qualities that have made Bacha Coffee a legendary brand around the world also make us a great place to work: innovation, creativity, passion, and excellence.

Job Summary

Responsible for planning and implementing Bacha Coffee’s global public relations strategies and activities while ensuring consistency in brand messaging across relevant markets. This role is responsible for the development and implementation of support materials and management of PR agencies internationally, as well as coordinating strategically with the other departments and stakeholders within the company and the brand.

Primary Relationships

The position reports directly to the Public Relations Manager.

Within the organisation, this position has primary working relationships with the other members of the Corporate Communication Department, other HQ Departments and overseas partners.

Outside the organization, the position coordinates primarily with PR agencies, business partners and the media.

Responsibilities

Create and execute global Public Relations strategy that align with the brand developments, priorities and announcements

Familiarising with the brand DNA, heritage and offerings, while embodying the brand ethos. Support other departments, partners and stakeholders in ensuring that all external-facing communication is on-brand and Bacha Coffee’s desired image and positioning is consistently and accurately articulated

Support Public Relations Manager to guide overseas partners (both subsidiaries and franchises) for the management of their local media relations and vet their suggested press releases, PR campaigns, etc. across all markets globally

Write and proofread communication materials i.e., press releases, responses for media queries and interviews, boilerplates, management biographies, fact sheets, media kits, etc.

Elevating brand presence and positioning the brand accurately in local and global media sphere through media related activities such as media liaison, gifting, events and hostings, overseas media trips, etc.

Coordinating internally with other departments on all Public Relations matters including the creation of Public Relations materials and assets

Working with Bacha Coffee subsidiaries, franchises and distributors to ensure implementation of brand and editorial guidelines and directives

Effectively manage issues and crises in collaboration with Public Relations teams and Public Relations agencies in Singapore and overseas

Ensuring that proper archives of global media clippings are maintained and regularly updating Public Relations reporting standards

Regularly monitoring trends and informing management of developments in luxury, retail and F&B industries

Maintaining Bacha Coffee media databases and periodically revising and refreshing media outreach to constantly remain current

Qualifications

Required:

Minimum of 5 years’ experience in communications or public relations with demonstrated success, preferably in the luxury retail sector

Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, marketing, or public relations preferred

Past experience working in a Public Relations agency or managing international Public Relations agencies preferred

Past experience practising Public Relations for a luxury brand preferred

Past experience dealing with international markets/stakeholders and media being responsible for a global or regional scope

Applicants must be fluent in written and spoken English and have excellent writing and proofreading skills.

A second or third language would be an advantage, as it would support effective communication with our diverse franchise partners

Other:

Strong creative, strategic, analytical, organizational and personal skills

Demonstrated successful experience writing press releases, pitching and hosting media

Computer literacy in word processing, data base management and page layout

Commitment to working in cross-functional teams

Very strong oral and written communication skills

Ability to manage multiple projects at a time

Out-of-town, overnight travel might be required from time to time (less than 10%)

Bacha Coffee is an equal opportunity employer. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

The story of Bacha Coffee begins in the medina of Marrakech, Morocco. Built in 1910, the spectacular Dar el Bacha palace, which means “house of the Pasha”, united the greatest cultural and political minds of the century over glittering pots of “coffee of Arabia” or Arabica, as it is known today. Being the finest luxury coffee brand in the world, Bacha Coffee specialises in 100% Arabica coffees and provides customers with a unique opportunity to travel the world through their cup by exploring harvests from over 30 of the most well-reputed coffee producing countries. Even our distinctive fine blended, fine flavoured and naturally decaffeinated coffees are produced using only 100% Arabica beans to give coffee lovers the widest choice, without ever sacrificing quality or flavour.

description:

Corporate Functions

Responsibilities

Team Introduction The Global Payment Treasury team provides the payment solutions behind ByteDance platforms including TikTok: payment acquiring, disbursements, transaction monitoring, payment method management, foreign exchange conversion, accounting, and reconciliations. We solve complex treasury and payment challenges across global markets, managing liquidity, FX, reconciliation, and payment operations while balancing regulatory requirements, cost efficiency, and business needs. You will keep payments smooth, secure, and reliable at scale, for users across ByteDance's platforms. This role owns internal and external financing for the company’s consumer and merchant lending businesses, covering financing planning, funding-partner origination, structuring, negotiation, documentation, closing, and post-closing management. The role partners with the Asset & Liability Management team to define financing size, tenor, currency, and cost parameters and works across business, finance, credit risk, legal, tax, compliance, product, technology, data, and institutional business development. Responsibilities: - Funding Strategy & Planning: Own the medium- to long-term funding strategy and execution roadmap; develop short-, medium-, and long-term financing plans; design the financing mix across countries, products, and providers to diversify sources and control concentration; establish financing reserves and refinancing plans based on capacity, market conditions, and stress tests. - Funding Channels & Institutional Relationships: Originate and maintain relationships with banks, funds, and institutional investors; partner with business development teams on asset issuances and pitches; lead funding-partner onboarding, commercial negotiation, and solution design across size, cost, tenor, and covenant requirements. - Structured Finance & Transaction Execution: Independently lead financing transactions end-to-end from origination and structuring through due diligence, negotiation, documentation, and closing; collaborate with finance, tax, legal, compliance, and credit risk teams; convert financing structures into repeatable, scalable models; and assess the impact of asset quality and prepayment on financing terms and credit enhancement. - Asset Pool & Post-Closing Management: Establish asset eligibility, pool onboarding, ongoing management, amortization, and performance analysis mechanisms; manage drawdowns, repayments, data reporting, and covenant monitoring; track facility utilization and refinancing risks; and partner with the ALM team to match assets to funding channels. - Funding Operations & Systems: Build funding operating policies and process controls across the transaction lifecycle; drive systems to centrally manage facilities, drawdowns, repayments, covenants, asset pools, and institutional relationships; and establish analytics for cost of funds, channel performance, and execution efficiency to improve funding strategy. This role will be based onsite at our office and will require a 5-day onsite work arrangement.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s): - 5+ years of experience in funding, structured finance, treasury, or a related field, preferably with experience in credit-asset or consumer-finance funding. - Hands-on experience independently leading structured financing transactions, with clear ownership across origination, structuring, negotiation, documentation, and closing. - Deep understanding of consumer lending models, the loan asset lifecycle, and asset-quality metrics. - Full-cycle experience across funding-partner origination, pitch, term sheet, due diligence, structuring, negotiation, documentation, and closing. - Strong financial modelling skills covering loan cash flows, financing requirements, cost of funds, and transaction structures. - Strong understanding of how vintage, delinquency, loss, and prepayment affect financing structures and asset-pool performance. - Strong external communication, commercial negotiation, cross-functional leadership, senior stakeholder management, team management, and proficient in both written and spoken English. Preferred Qualification(s): - Experience in Southeast Asian and Latin American financial markets is preferred, together with knowledge of local regulatory and capital-control constraints.

Liaise with internal stakeholders across finance, legal, development, asset management and operations to align on deal terms and execution requirements

Track post-acquisition performance against underwriting assumptions and flag variances

5–8 years of relevant experience in corporate development, M&A, investment banking, real estate private equity,or real estate investment/development, with direct exposure to real estate transactions

Familiarity with real estate asset classes (residential, commercial, retail, industrial/logistics, hospitality)and REIT/fund investment structures is highly valued
