Strong financial modelling and valuation skills, including DCF, residual land value and comparable transaction analysis

Solid understanding of real estate fundamentals, market cycles and development economics

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear, concise materials for senior management and investment committees

Strong negotiation andrelationship-management skills

Close attention to detail and strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deals concurrently under tight timelines

Proficiency in Excel-based financial modelling and PowerPoint; familiarity with real estate/finance data platforms

A collaborative, proactive mindset with sound commercial judgement and the ability to work effectively across teams and cultures

title: Assistant Director, Digital & Visual Communications (EG)
description:
Family Group: Administration

JOB PURPOSE

The Assistant Director, Digital & Visual Communications leads Woodlands Hospital's digital, visual and content communications portfolio, driving integrated storytelling, audience engagement and brand experience across digital, social and physical touchpoints.

Reporting to the Director, Corporate Communications, the incumbent is responsible for translating organisational priorities into compelling, audience-centric communications through effective content planning, creative storytelling, channel management and digital engagement strategies.

The role oversees the development and execution of Woodlands Hospital's content and editorial calendar, social media presence, visual communications, video strategy, digital storytelling, publications and environmental branding initiatives. Working closely with the Strategic Communications team, the incumbent ensures organisational narratives are effectively amplified through coordinated, timely and engaging content across all owned channels.

The incumbent will lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for content development, visual design, photography, videography and digital communications, while strengthening Woodlands Hospital's reputation, visibility and stakeholder engagement.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Specific

1. Content Strategy and Editorial Leadership

Lead the development and execution of Woodlands Hospital's integrated content strategy across internal and external channels.
Own and manage the organisation's content and editorial calendar, ensuring content priorities are aligned with organisational goals, service launches, campaigns and strategic initiatives.
Identify opportunities for proactive storytelling and audience engagement through timely, relevant and impactful content.
Drive a coordinated content planning process across departments and stakeholders.
Ensure effective amplification of organisational priorities through appropriate content formats, channels and campaign sequencing.

2. Digital Communications and Channel Management

Lead Woodlands Hospital's digital communications strategy and content distribution across owned digital platforms.
Oversee management of corporate social media channels, and digital engagement initiatives.
Develop channel strategies that strengthen audience reach, engagement and digital influence.
Monitor channel performance, audience trends and emerging digital platforms to optimise communications effectiveness.
Ensure content is distributed through the most appropriate channels and formats to maximise impact and audience reach.

3. Visual Storytelling and Creative Communications

Lead the conceptualisation and development of compelling visual communications that strengthen Woodlands Hospital's reputation and brand presence.
Ensure creative outputs are audience-centric, visually engaging and aligned with corporate messaging and brand standards.
Establish and maintain creative quality standards across all communications outputs.

4. Brand Experience and Environmental Communications

Lead the planning and execution of visual storytelling initiatives across the hospital campus.
Ensure consistency of visual identity across physical and digital touchpoints.
Support efforts to strengthen the Woodlands Hospital brand and stakeholder experience through environmental storytelling and placemaking initiatives.

5. Campaign Development and Amplification

Develop integrated communications campaigns that support organisational priorities, service launches, community outreach and staff engagement initiatives.
Plan and coordinate content deployment across multiple channels and platforms.
Ensure effective amplification of strategic communications initiatives through coordinated content, creative and channel strategies.
Partner Strategic Communications colleagues to translate organisational narratives into impactful audience experiences.

6. Leadership and Team Management

Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team comprising content creators, designers, photographers, videographers and digital communications professionals.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Build team capabilities in digital storytelling, social media, visual communications and content development.
Provide coaching, mentorship and performance management to team members.

7. Stakeholder and Vendor Management

Partner internal stakeholders to understand communications objectives and develop effective content and creative solutions.
Manage external agencies, production houses, photographers, videographers and other creative vendors.
Oversee project budgets, procurement processes and vendor performance.
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and to expected quality standards.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Education / Training / Experience

At least 10 years of experience in Corporate Communications, Marketing, Digital Communications, and/or creative leadership roles.
Proven leadership capabilities, with experience leading teams, managing complex projects, and engaging diverse stakeholders.
Good understanding of Singapore's healthcare sector and key healthcare initiatives is an added advantage.

Professional License (if any)

Degree in Public Relations, Mass Communications or related course.
Knowledge of Canva, Capcut, Adobe softwares (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro etc.) preferred

Attributes

Highly fluent in English (written and spoken) with excellent writing, editing and proofreading skills.
Independent individual with strong project management skills. Ability to handle multiple projects and deadlines.
Passionate about communications and storytelling; ability to see the big picture and translate complex concepts into easily understandable and engaging content.
Agile team player, results-oriented, self-motivated and resourceful

title: Business Development & Sales Executive
description:
Job Summary

The Business Development & Sales Executive drives offline sales growth by acquiring new B2B customers, expanding retail and wholesale channels, promoting consumer electronic products, and achieving sales targets within the consumer electronics market.

Responsibilities

Identify and research potential B2B customers such as electronics retailers, mobile phone shops, wholesalers, distributors, and corporate buyers to expand the customer base.

Proactively source new customers using cold calling, WhatsApp, email, referrals, networking, field visits, and trade shows to generate sales opportunities.

Conduct regular field visits to present product offerings and establish new business relationships.

Develop and maintain a sales pipeline with detailed customer information, business needs, and follow-up status to track prospects effectively.

Convert qualified prospects into active purchasing accounts and meet new customer acquisition targets.

Promote the company’s product range by explaining specifications, features, pricing, and competitive advantages to customers.

Recommend products tailored to customers’ target markets, profiles, budgets, and purchasing requirements.

Introduce new product launches, promotional bundles, and seasonal offers to existing and prospective customers.

Provide sales materials such as catalogues, quotations, and samples to support customer decision-making.

Collect and report customer feedback on product quality, packaging, pricing, and market acceptance to inform product strategy.

Prepare and submit quotations, proposals, and price lists aligned with company pricing and discount policies.

Negotiate prices, order quantities, promotional terms, and commercial conditions to close sales within approved guidelines.

Follow up on quotations and enquiries to convert opportunities into confirmed purchase orders.

Encourage bulk purchases, product range expansion, and repeat orders to maximize sales revenue.

Monitor sales opportunities’ progress and maintain accurate records of negotiations and expected closing dates.

Document and obtain approval for all confirmed orders, prices, and terms according to company procedures.

Identify and develop new retail outlets, resellers, wholesale partners, and distribution channels to increase product availability.

Build relationships with decision-makers such as shop owners and purchasing managers to support channel growth.

Recommend product assortments and order quantities based on customer demand and market trends.

Identify opportunities for bulk supply, corporate gifts, promotional bundles, and B2B product packages.

Monitor product sell-through, customer demand, and replenishment needs to support inventory management.

Explore new territories, customer segments, and partnerships to sustain business growth.

Maintain regular contact and conduct scheduled visits with existing customers to support retention and growth.

Follow up on customers’ purchasing plans, stock replenishment, and new product needs to encourage repeat sales.

Introduce cross-selling opportunities and new products to increase account value.

Monitor customer purchasing patterns and resolve routine sales-related issues professionally.

Coordinate with internal teams on product quality, warranty, and technical matters to ensure customer satisfaction.

Monitor competitors’ products, pricing, promotions, and distribution to identify market trends and opportunities.

Gather customer insights on preferred brands, specifications, price points, and buying behavior to inform sales strategy.

Provide regular market intelligence and actionable recommendations to management.

Verify product availability, pricing, and delivery lead times before confirming orders to ensure accuracy.

Coordinate with warehouse, customer service, and finance teams to manage order fulfillment, invoicing, and payment follow-up.

Monitor outstanding payments and follow up on overdue accounts in line with company credit policies.

Escalate significant issues such as stock shortages, defects, delivery delays, or pricing disputes promptly.

Avoid unauthorized commitments on product specifications, delivery dates, warranties, discounts, or credit terms.

Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets for revenue, gross profit, and customer acquisition.

Maintain updated customer databases, sales pipelines, quotation records, and purchase order histories.

Submit regular reports on sales performance, customer visits, quotations, order conversions, and market developments.

Prepare sales forecasts based on customer requirements, confirmed orders, and qualified opportunities.

Review sales performance and propose action plans to address shortfalls.

Ensure accurate and timely updates of sales activities and customer records in CRM, ERP, or reporting systems.

Maintain current knowledge of product range, specifications, pricing, and approved claims to ensure accurate communication.

Comply with company policies on pricing, discounts, credit, order approvals, and sales documentation.

Observe product safety, labeling, and regulatory requirements when promoting and supplying electronic products.

Handle customer and company pricing information confidentially.

Represent the company professionally during customer meetings, business visits, exhibitions, and sales activities.

Communicate effectively in English to engage with customers and internal teams; additional languages relevant to the customer base are advantageous.

Travel locally as needed to conduct customer visits and business development activities.

Preferred competencies and qualifications

Previous experience in sales, business development, or B2B customer management.

Experience in consumer electronics, mobile accessories, IT products, retail distribution, or wholesale trading.

Ability to quickly learn and understand electronic accessories product specifications.

Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.

Proactive, independent, and target-driven with capability to conduct field sales activities.

Good organizational skills to manage multiple customers and sales opportunities.

Proficiency in basic computer applications, spreadsheets, and sales reporting systems.

Valid driving licence and own transport are advantageous for field sales.

title: Senior Executive, Public Relations
description:
The Senior Executive, Public Relations supports NTUC Club’s external communications, corporate reputation and earned-media efforts across its B2B and B2C portfolio of brands. The role develops accurate, newsworthy and audience-relevant publicity materials; supports key messaging for corporate announcements, campaigns and strategic initiatives; builds relationships with media, influencers and PR partners; coordinates media engagement; and monitors coverage, public sentiment and emerging issues. The Senior Executive is expected to work closely with internal stakeholders to understand business priorities, secure factual and management clearances, protect NTUC Club’s reputation and strengthen sustained brand visibility.

Key Responsibilities:

PR planning and story development

Support the development and delivery of integrated PR plans that strengthen NTUC Club’s corporate reputation across its B2B and B2C portfolios. Identify newsworthy angles, shape story narratives and key messages for corporate announcements, campaigns and strategic initiatives, and maintain a forward publicity pipeline aligned with organisational and business priorities.

Media materials and editorial

Draft, edit and proofread media releases, advisories, interview pitches, media invitations, fact sheets, FAQs, holding statements, speeches, talking points and briefing notes. Ensure materials are clear, accurate, aligned with NTUC Club’s house style and tone of voice, and ready for the intended audience and channel.

Media pitching, relations and engagement

Develop and proactively pitch tailored story angles to relevant journalists, editors and producers to secure earned-media opportunities. Build and maintain strong working relationships with media contacts, PR partners and relevant stakeholders; disseminate approved materials; manage follow-ups; and respond promptly and professionally to media enquiries and requests to drive coverage, publicity and brand visibility.

Interviews and spokesperson support

Coordinate interview opportunities, media briefings and on-site coverage. Prepare spokesperson briefs, anticipated questions and approved messages; manage logistics and ensure relevant internal stakeholders are aligned before engagement.

Media events, drops and influencer engagement

Plan and execute media previews, invitations, media drops and relevant influencer engagements. Manage guest lists, RSVPs, materials, gifting and on-site requirements while ensuring appropriate approvals, records and follow-up.

Media monitoring and reporting

Monitor media coverage, public sentiment and relevant conversations; maintain accurate clipping records; and prepare PR reports post-campaign. Assess results against agreed indicators, highlight sentiment and emerging issues, recommend actions where necessary, and capture learnings and recommendations for future outreach.

Issues and crisis communications support

Monitor for potential reputational issues, escalate concerns promptly and support crisis communications planning and response across external channels in accordance with the approved Incident and Media Management SOP. Assist with fact gathering, holding lines, stakeholder coordination, media monitoring and post-incident documentation.

Stakeholder and clearance management

Work with business units, corporate stakeholders, Customer Experience, PR partners and other relevant teams to obtain complete information, visuals and factual confirmation, and to address reputational issues and opportunities. Maintain clear review and approval trails, and ensure materials are not disseminated before the required departmental, management and business unit clearances are secured.

PR platforms, databases and records

Maintain the media database, campaign media lists, PR WIP, coverage folders, templates, approved materials and decision history in SharePoint. Support the effective use and administration of media-monitoring and PR tools.

Budget, vendor and governance support

Track approved PR spend, quotations and commitments; brief and coordinate vendors; and maintain supporting procurement, reconciliation, evaluation and audit documentation in accordance with internal requirements.

Requirements:

Degree or diploma in Mass Communications, Public Relations, Media Studies, Journalism or a related field.

At least 3–5 years of relevant experience in public relations, media relations, corporate communications or a related communications role.

Proven experience in media pitching, developing newsworthy story angles and securing earned media opportunities.

Exceptional writing, copywriting, editing and proofreading skills, with strong news judgement and critical-thinking ability.

Strong project management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate internal teams, media contacts, agencies and vendors.

Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment while supporting both B2B and B2C portfolios.

Ability to multitask, manage competing priorities and deadlines, and respond calmly and promptly to emerging media or reputational issues.

Note: This scope of work is not limited to the above and may include additional responsibilities under the Group Marketing, Communications and Brand department, as required by business needs.

About NTUC Club @ Downtown East

Established in 1986 as the entertainment and leisure arm of the National Trades Union Congress (NTUC), NTUC Club is committed to the social mission of providing affordable recreational experiences of choice for our members and the public.

We also support the Labour Movement and aim to build a more inclusive society in Singapore. This means taking a social responsibility towards our staff, the community, and the environment, which is core to everything NTUC Club does.

Brands and Entities

Our key properties include Downtown East, a lifestyle destination which provides exciting activities and fun facilities for members of the Labour Movement and public alike under one roof. With the completion of the five-year Refreshing Downtown East redevelopment project in 2018, Downtown East now includes the nature-inspired D’Resort, an expanded water park Wild Wild Wet, a myriad of retail dining and entertainment options at Market Square – E!Avenue and E!Hub, and union engagement amenities MUCE (Membership & Union Community Engagement).

Other brands under NTUC Club include Aranda Country Club, Orchid Country Club, Marina Bay Golf Course, Quebec Leisure as well as clubhouses such as Scarlet City, Happy Days, Jest D’Place and Union Square.

NTUC Club also engages members of the Labour Movement at their various life stages – nEbO, the junior membership arm of NTUC for youths aged 12 to 25; U Live, the community for active agers aged 55 and above; and U Sports, for sports enthusiasts.

Social Commitment

NTUC Club's Family Fun Fiesta (F3) is one of the ways we fulfil our social purpose to ensure no one is excluded from enjoying quality recreational experiences. Held several times a year, F3 provides lower-income NTUC members and their families with complimentary experiential fun at our facilities.

In addition, we also give back to the community by volunteering and working with various beneficiaries. Our staff visited beneficiaries such as Willing Hearts and Singapore Food Bank, to help prepare meals. Together with the Attractions, Resorts & Entertainment Union (AREU), our staff sewed stuffed toys made from socks, with proceeds going to Dignity Mama to enable young adults with disabilities to gain basic entrepreneurial skills and lead independent lives.

If you aspire to be part of the Labour Movement, and believe in our social mission, find out more at: www.ntucclub.com/career.

title: Manager, Admissions and Financial Aid (Outreach and Marketing)
description:
Job Description
Manager, Admissions and Financial Aid (Outreach and Marketing)

1. Student Recruitment and Outreach

Support the development and implementation of local and international recruitment and outreach plans aligned with the University’s enrolment objectives.
Plan and deliver recruitment and engagement activities, including SIT Open House, learning journeys, education fairs, admissions talks and outreach programmes.
Develop and implement student engagement and yield-enhancement initiatives.
Represent SIT at local and international outreach activities, effectively communicating the University’s programmes and value proposition to prospective students, parents and educators.
Build and maintain relationships with schools, educational institutions and other stakeholders to support student recruitment and strengthen SIT’s presence.

Undertake application processing, respond to applicant enquiries and support other operational requirements in accordance with University policies and procedures.

Manage assigned outreach, recruitment and marketing projects from planning through implementation, ensuring timelines, budgets and deliverables are met.
Contribute to team planning, process improvements and the development of new engagement initiatives.
Support cross-functional initiatives across the Admissions and Financial Aid Division.
Guide junior team members or project teams where required.
Undertake additional duties and special projects as assigned.

Requirements

A recognised degree from a reputable university.
At least 5 - 7 years of relevant experience, preferably in outreach, marketing and communications, events or a related field.
Experience in developing and delivering recruitment, outreach or marketing initiatives, preferably within the education sector.
Good project management, stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
Strong presentation and public speaking skills, with confidence in engaging diverse audiences.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Experience working with creative agencies and coordinating photography, videography and multimedia productions will be advantageous.
Experience in an international or cross-cultural environment is an added advantage.

title: Travel Designer
description:

Join us and start your journey as a Travel Designer.

Diploma or relevant qualification in Tourism, Hospitality, Business Administration or a related field is preferred, but not required.

Proficiency in Email.

Comfortable communicating with overseas agents, travellers, suppliers, tour guides and internal departments.

Service-oriented and committed to delivering a positive traveller experience.

Resourceful and confident in resolving operational problems.

Professional when communicating with clients, suppliers and colleagues.

Willing to learn, accept feedback and continuously improve.

Due to the operational nature of inbound tourism, work may occasionally be required outside standard office hours, including evenings, weekends and Public Holidays.

After-hours duties may include responding to urgent calls and messages, monitoring active tours, attending onsite assignments or resolving operational issues.

What We Offer

Exposure to inbound travel operations and destination management.

Opportunities to design customised programmes for international leisure, educational and corporate groups.

Practical experience working with hotels, attractions, restaurants, transport providers and tourism professionals.

A multicultural working environment with opportunities to develop industry knowledge and business relationships.

The opportunity to contribute ideas and help create meaningful travel experiences for visitors to Singapore and the region.

Salary is negotiable based on experience.

To Apply - Please send your CV to admin@southernx.co

Southern Cross International (S) Pte Ltd is an established inbound tour operator and destination management company based in Singapore. Supported by the Southern Cross International network across Asia, we provide a comprehensive range of travel services, including accommodation, transportation, sightseeing, dining arrangements, educational programmes, corporate and incentive travel, wellness experiences, dive travel and multi-destination itineraries. title: Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT STYL SOLUTIONS

Ride on the wave of Industry 4.0! Join STYL Solutions in the forefront of using Fintech and IoT technologies for smart city/nation transformation. Headquartered in Singapore with R&D center in Vietnam, STYL Solutions designs, develops, and supplies hardware, software and integrated solutions for applications in payment, loyalty management, location tracking, self-service operation, telemetry.

Our market segment coverage extends from financial services, retail, mass transit, education to social services markets in Singapore and South Asia Pacific.

Our vision is to use Fintech and IoT to create smart and efficient cities that enhance Quality of Life through convenience and healthier living.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We are looking for an independent and creative Marketing Manager to join us in our growth journey. You will own the full spectrum of STYL Solutions' marketing communications (MarComm) and corporate communications (CorpComm) activities. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role spanning event marketing, content and campaign development, sales collateral, digital and social media, corporate website management, presentation branding, a physical product demo space, and internal communications. You will work closely with the Product, Sales and Management teams and, where required, external vendors and subcontractors, to plan, produce and measure marketing outcomes that support customer acquisition, brand consistency and employee engagement.

RESPONSIBILITIES

A. Marketing Communications (MarComm)

Trade Show & Event Marketing

Plan and coordinate STYL's participation in trade shows and industry events in Singapore and overseas, from booth concept to on-site execution.

Design the booth layout and develop event collateral (backdrop, banners, brochures) and event gifts, including sourcing quotations and managing vendors and job orders.

Develop pre-event promotional eDMs and email signature banners; set up lead-collection methods for the event team.

Consolidate post-event leads, produce a post-event report, coordinate lead nurturing with Sales, and publish post-event social media content.

Content & Inbound Marketing

Work with Product Owners and Sales to plan a campaign calendar (topics, audience, timing) promoting STYL's SaaS solutions.

Maintain and grow the leads database; develop and broadcast eDM campaigns with clear, customer-focused messaging and calls to action.

Track campaign performance (delivery, open and click-through rates, conversions) and hand qualified leads to Sales for follow-up.

Produce blogs, whitepapers, case studies and product videos, and distribute them across the website, social media and sales channels; report on content performance and lead generation.

Product & Solution Pitch Decks and Brochures

Review and refresh existing brochures and Product-team pitch decks for clarity, professionalism and consistent STYL branding.

Simplify technical content into customer-focused messaging and finalise materials for use by Product, Sales and Marketing.

Product Advertising & Campaigns

Plan and execute advertising and marketing campaigns with Product and Sales teams, from objective-setting through channel selection and content creation.

Launch campaigns across selected channels, track reach, engagement and leads, and report results with recommendations for future campaigns.

STYL Marketplace Marketing Support

Support the Marketplace team's campaigns for merchants and the parent/student community, including decal designs, artwork and supporting digital materials.

Ensure all Marketplace marketing materials follow STYL branding and track campaign performance where applicable.

B. Corporate Communications (CorpComm)

Internal Communications

Develop a company-wide internal communications plan covering CEO messages, Town Halls, product updates and newsletters.

Coordinate with Management and other teams to produce and distribute clear, consistent internal content through appropriate channels.

Corporate Website Management

Keep the STYL corporate website accurate, current and optimised for SEO; monitor traffic and page performance.

Publish company news, events and articles, and coordinate with internal teams or the website vendor on content, design and functionality updates.

Social Media Management

Develop and maintain a LinkedIn content calendar; create on-brand posts and visuals covering company activities, products and events.

Schedule and publish approved content, and monitor performance (impressions, engagement, follower growth) to continuously improve STYL's social presence across various platforms (i.e. LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook).

Presentation Templates & Branding

Standardise STYL's corporate PowerPoint templates — layout, fonts, colours and slide types — for consistent, professional use across teams.

Product & Solution Demo Space

Plan a dedicated demo space to showcase STYL's products, including layout, branding, signage and content requirements.

Prepare cost estimates and budget for management approval, and coordinate with vendors and subcontractors on installation, then test and finalise the space for customer visits.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Here at STYL Solutions, we value proactive ownership and require independence and hands-on involvement in our daily responsibilities. We seek entrepreneurial candidates with the following:

Experience

At least 3 years of relevant experience in marketing communications and/or corporate communications, ideally in a B2B technology, hardware or SaaS environment.

Demonstrated experience planning and executing trade shows or corporate events, from concept to post-event reporting.

Experience running digital and content marketing campaigns (eDM, webinars, social media, SEO) and managing a leads database.

Experience liaising with external vendors, printers, designers or subcontractors, including obtaining quotations and managing budgets, is an advantage.

Prior exposure to internal communications (newsletters, Town Halls, management messaging) is an advantage.

Education & Qualifications

Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Mass Communications, Business Administration or a related field.

Skills

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to translate technical product information into clear, customer-friendly messaging.

Working knowledge of digital marketing tools (eDM platforms, basic SEO, social media scheduling and analytics).

Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Word for presentation and collateral development; working knowledge of design tools (e.g. Canva, Adobe Creative Suite) or the ability to brief designers effectively.

Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel for tracking campaign metrics, budgets and reporting.

Project and vendor management skills, including budgeting, timeline management and coordination of multiple external suppliers.

Aptitudes & Personal Attributes

Highly organised self-starter, able to independently manage multiple concurrent work streams across events, content, digital and internal communications.

Strong stakeholder management skills, able to work closely with Product, Sales and Management to align marketing output with business needs.

Creative and detail-oriented, with sound judgement on brand consistency and messaging.

Comfortable working hands-on across both strategic planning and operational execution.

Adaptable and resourceful, comfortable operating with a lean or single-person marketing function.

What measures the success of the role

Event Execution & Lead Generation

: Successful planning and execution of trade shows and corporate events, resulting in qualified lead collection and timely post-event sales nurturing.

Digital Campaign & Content Performance

: Engagement levels, open/click-through rates, and lead conversions from eDM, social media, and website campaigns.

Brand Consistency & Collateral Quality

: Delivery of clear, standardized, and customer-focused product pitch decks, marketing collateral, and corporate presentation templates.

Website & Social Media Growth

: Up-to-date corporate website and steady growth in follower reach and engagement on the Company’s social media accounts.

Internal & Operational Delivery

: On-time execution of internal communication initiatives, demo space setup, and efficient vendor and budget management.

STYL SOLUTIONS PTE. LTD.

Established in 2008, STYL has grown significantly from a small startup into a leading trusted partner for Fintech IoT solutions with 100+ employees and market segment coverage extending from financial services, retail, mass transit, education to social services in Singapore and South Asia Pacific today.

Headquartered in Singapore with a dedicated R&D center in Vietnam, we provide end-to-end solutions from designing, developing, and supplying hardware to software integration for applications in payment, loyalty management, location tracking, self-service operation, environment management and telemetry. Our Mission is to infuse Fintech IoT to create smart and efficient cities that enhance Quality of Life for all through convenience and healthier living.

As we continue and bring our mission journey globally, we give thanks to our dedicated People who contribute to our continuous success. Hence, we strive to provide opportunities for employees to learn, grow and thrive yet maintain a well-balance lifestyle. With our lean and open organization culture, we believe that trusting work relationships will be built and our People can continue to drive creativity, innovation, and excellence with confidence.

Join us now if you are interested to be part of the creation of smarter and more efficient cities through our solutions!

title: Vice President, Investments - Asset Management
company: CLIFFORD CAPITAL MANAGEMENT SERVICES PTE. LTD.
description:
Position Overview:

Clifford Capital Asset Management (“CCAM”) is a new line of business that was established in December 2024. CCAM is regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (the “MAS”) and holds a Capital Market Service License to conduct fund management activities for accredited and institutional investors. CCAM will focus on launching mandates as well as collective investment schemes. CCAM products are expected to invest in range of credit instruments including but not limited to senior credit, subordinated debt/high yield as well as hybrid instruments representing debt financing.

Primary Responsibilities:

Work closely with origination, corporate coverage and investor coverage teams to source, assess and execute infrastructure credit investment opportunities across CCAM-managed pools of capital

Lead credit due diligence, investment analysis, financial modelling, structuring assessment and risk evaluation for primary and secondary market opportunities

Build and maintain relationships with banks, sponsors, intermediaries, investors and other market participants to strengthen CCAM’s market presence and access to investment opportunities

Prepare and present investment recommendations, credit papers and portfolio updates to CCAM’s Investment Committee, senior management and relevant governance forums

Drive the internal credit application and approval process, coordinating inputs from origination, risk, legal, operations and other relevant stakeholders

Undertake upfront and ongoing relative value analysis, portfolio monitoring, asset performance review and portfolio management activities across relevant mandates and funds

Support investor marketing, fundraising and due diligence processes by providing investment insights, portfolio information and market perspectives as required

Act as deal captain for selected transactions, providing end-to-end transaction leadership and, over time, supervising and mentoring junior investment team members

Professional Experience / Qualifications:

At least 8 years of relevant experience in infrastructure credit, private credit, project finance, leveraged finance, structured finance, asset management or a related investment role within a financial institution or investment platform

Strong academic background, with demonstrated investment judgement and experience in credit analysis, investment structuring, financial modelling and investment committee processes

Strong understanding of infrastructure, private credit and APAC markets; experience across global infrastructure debt markets or cross-border transactions would be advantageous

Proven ability to manage multiple transactions and portfolio priorities independently, with strong execution discipline, commercial judgement and attention to detail

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the maturity and credibility to engage senior management, investment committees, investors, counterparties and external advisers

Business-level Japanese language skills are advantageous for engaging with Japanese investors and counterparties

Headquartered in Singapore and established in 2012, Clifford Capital is an infrastructure credit financing platform for real assets globally across the debt capital structure. The Group is increasingly pivoting towards areas such as clean energy, energy transition, social and digital infrastructure, electrification, and maritime decarbonisation to address the challenges posed by environmental, social and governance issues globally, and in particular within the Asia Pacific region. Its ambition is to deliver innovative financing solutions that positively influence sustainability and deliver commercial returns for its shareholders.

Clifford Capital aims to build a globally competitive alternative asset management and financing platform closely aligned to Singapore’s objectives of creating a centre of excellence in financial markets focused on sustainability and green finance.

Clifford Capital’s shareholders comprise Temasek Holdings, Prudential Assurance Company Singapore, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, Standard Chartered Bank, DBS Bank, John Hancock Life Insurance Company (Manulife), and the Asian Development Bank.

At Crocs, Inc., every career offers a chance to make a real impact. No two journeys look the same. And that's exactly how we like it. Whether you’re welcoming customers into our stores, collaborating with global teams at our headquarters, or keeping operations moving at our distribution centers, your impact is real and valued. Overview

The Director, Retail – Singapore and Malaysia is responsible for leading the retail business across both markets, driving commercial performance, operational excellence, and exceptional consumer experiences across all company-owned stores. This role provides strategic leadership for retail growth, ensuring the successful execution of business, brand, and operational priorities while delivering sustainable financial results.

As a commercially driven and people-focused leader, the Director will develop and execute market growth strategies, optimize retail operations, and build a high-performing organization. Working closely with cross-functional partners, the incumbent will champion innovation, drive change, and strengthen organizational capability to support the long-term success and profitability of the Singapore and Malaysia retail business.

The role can be based either in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia or Singapore.

What You'll Do
Lead Singapore and Malaysia Retail Strategy: Develop and execute the long-term retail strategy for Singapore and Malaysia, driving sustainable revenue growth, market expansion, brand equity, consumer engagement, and operational excellence while ensuring alignment with regional and global business priorities.
Own P&L and Business Performance: Assume full accountability for retail sales, profitability, productivity, and key performance indicators. Leverage data-driven insights to identify growth opportunities, mitigate risks, and implement strategic actions that deliver consistent business results.
Drive Retail Excellence and Consumer Experience: Lead the delivery of best-in-class consumer experiences and operational standards across all retail locations. Partner with Area Managers, Retail Operations, Training, and Visual Merchandising teams to ensure execution excellence, brand consistency, and customer satisfaction.
Shape Merchandise and Inventory Strategies: Collaborate closely with Merchandising and Planning teams to optimize assortment, inventory productivity, allocation strategies, and product availability, maximizing sell-through, profitability, and consumer demand fulfillment.
Lead Commercial Activation: Partner cross-functionally to develop and execute in-store marketing, promotional, and brand activation initiatives that drive traffic, conversion, and revenue growth.
Drive Store Portfolio and Expansion Strategy: Identify and execute retail expansion opportunities, including new store openings, relocations, remodels, pop-up concepts, and portfolio optimization initiatives to strengthen market presence, enhance consumer accessibility, and improve financial returns.
Build Organizational Capability: Lead, coach, and develop retail talent across stores and the support organization, fostering leadership capability, succession strength, and a high-performance culture.
Champion Operational Governance and Compliance Ensure adherence to company policies, operational controls, compliance requirements, and risk management practices, safeguarding the business while maintaining a productive and engaging store environment.
What You'll Bring to the Table
Bachelor's degree in Business, Retail Management, Marketing, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
12+ years of progressive retail leadership experience, including multi-store, district, or national retail responsibility within a consumer-facing brand.
Proven track record of leading large, geographically dispersed retail teams and delivering sustainable sales, profit, and operational KPI improvements.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience managing retail P&L performance, productivity, inventory, and store portfolio optimization.
Demonstrated ability to develop high-performing teams, build leadership capability, and drive succession planning within a retail organization.
Strategic thinker with the ability to translate market insights and business priorities into executable retail growth strategies.
Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with a proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally across Merchandising, Planning, Marketing, Finance, HR, and Operations.
Strong communication, change leadership, and decision-making capabilities.

The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability, or any other protected classification.

At Crocs, Inc. we believe in the power of a blend of in-person and virtual collaboration to drive creativity and strengthen relationships. title: Marketing & Growth Assistant
description:
We are looking for a creative and commercially curious Marketing & Growth Assistant to help RhetoriQo grow its brand and business. You'll have creative bandwidth to generate content ideas, produce videos, and track performance — and you'll also get hands-on exposure to business development, from identifying opportunities to supporting outreach.

Who Are We?

RhetoriQo transforms inner voices into outside influence through curated speaking and communication training programmes. Founded by seasoned speaker, lawyer, and coach Zulhafni Zulkeflee, we empower individuals and organisations to excel in their high-stakes settings with public speaking, negotiation, persuasion, and communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

Content Planning & Ideation:

Lead RhetoriQo's online presence by (i) maintaining a clear content calendar for Instagram, TikTok, and other platforms, and (ii) proposing daily post ideas — including videos, images, and captions — that align with our coaching mission, based on research trends and industry topics.

Video Production & Editing:

Capture, edit, and polish videos (e.g., Reels, TikToks, stories) optimised for trend relevance, engagement, and credibility-building — with an opportunity to work within the public speaking and communication sector.

Platform Management & Community Engagement:

Lead RhetoriQo's social media growth by managing content across our platforms (e.g., scheduling and publishing according to best posting times), monitoring performance, and refining strategy based on analytics.

Analytics & Strategy:

Experiment with different content formats (e.g., storytelling, teaching snippets, behind-the-scenes) to learn what resonates, by tracking engagement, reach, and other key metrics.

Business Development Support:

Support RhetoriQo's growth by (i) researching potential corporate clients, events, and partnership opportunities, (ii) assisting with outreach tracking and lead lists (e.g., on LinkedIn), and (iii) collaborating on growth ideas — such as relevant industry events to attend, speak at, or pitch to — as you grow into the role.

Qualifications

We value an openness to learn and experiment over experience — if you have the traits below and are up for a new challenge, we would be happy to chat with you:

Proficient in content editing tools (Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere, etc.) and general office tools (e.g., Google Docs/Sheets, Excel, Email)

Strong awareness and curiosity of social media trends, particularly on Instagram/TikTok

Excellent written and verbal communication, organisational skills, and attention to detail

Keen to try new things and have an eye for creativity

Commercially curious — you think about not just how to grow an audience, but how that translates into real business opportunities

Self-motivated with the ability to propose ideas and follow through independently

Previous experience in content creation or social media is a plus, but not necessary — if you're new to this, tell us how you'd go about learning and growing in the role

Remuneration & Working Conditions

Contract/part-time role: 3–4 hours/day, flexible schedule

SGD $13–15/hour

Remote and/or hybrid (Singapore-based preferred; you may be required to follow along for training programmes or sessions on occasion)

Why Join Us?

Real ownership from day one — you won't be a pair of hands, you'll have genuine creative and commercial input into how RhetoriQo grows

Work directly with a highly experienced public speaking trainer and coach within the training and coaching industry

Clear growth pathway — at 3 months we'll assess fit and scope, with potential to convert to a higher rate or full-time role

Ready to apply?

Send us: (i) your resume, (ii) samples of content if you have them (Reels, TikToks, CapCut projects, or anything you're proud of), and (iii) a short response to this:

what is one initiative — an event, a partnership, or an outreach campaign — you would propose to help RhetoriQo win its next client?

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Successful completion of critical initiatives in a timely manner

Qualifications

Must have experience in big deal pursuit at large enterprise software vendor, preferably outside IT and addressing customers’ core business needs
Must have experience in partnering with global major consulting/advisory firms to create big deal opportunities
Must have experience in selling solutions addressing non-IT domains

title: Associate / Associate Director, FICC Trading (APAC)
description:
Purpose

BNS Singapore acts as the regional trading hub, providing centralized, efficient client coverage and engagement for our flow business, DCM activities, private placements, financing, and credit- and rates- linked structured products. The primary role is to make markets for clients, and trade the firm’s repo, FX, STIR, rates and credit books in the region. The role will execute and hedge transactions to manage and mitigate risk associated with these customer transactions, along with managing risks associated with trading positions through a variety of hedging strategies to maximize the return to the business within approved risk appetite. At the same time, to engage with clients to foster and leverage Banking relationships.

The trader will contribute to the overall success of the FICC and GBM business regionally and globally ensuring specific individual goals, plans, and initiatives are executed / delivered in support of the team’s business strategies and objectives. Ensures all activities conducted are in compliance with governing regulations, internal policies, and procedures.

The role is based in Singapore.

Accountabilities

Meet and exceed client volumes and market share metrics.

Price fixed income cash securities from Scotiabank’s global product suite including but not limited to USD and CAD denominated instruments (Governments, SSAs and Corporates).

Help manage and hedge relevant interest rate derivatives trading risks (IRS, Xccy, and basis), as appropriate. Promote BNS interest rate products and identify and action cross-sell opportunities with clients

Help manage and hedge relevant FX spot, forwards, swaps, options and NDFs risks as appropriate in the region. Drive up trading volume during the process of expanding the FX business.

Help manage and hedge relevant short term interest rate risks and liaise with the global STIR desks to promote Bank’s products.

Assist with the structuring, marketing and pricing of various non-linear / exotic FICC structured solutions & FICC linked structured notes, during Asia time-zone, providing support to the client coverage teams (primarily APAC Fixed Income Sales).

Contribute to a client-focused culture throughout their team to deepen client relationships and leverage broader Bank relationships, systems, and knowledge.

Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture should be considered in day-to-day activities and decisions.

Actively pursue effective and efficient operations of their respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank's Values, its Code of Conduct, and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk.

Champion a high-performance environment and contributes to an inclusive work environment.

Operate within approved risk limits and promptly escalate any actual or potential breaches

Dimensions

• This role requires successful completion of the National Futures Association’s Swaps Proficiency Requirement (SPR), prior to engaging in in-scope activity.

• Operate within designated trading limits

• Operates under general guidelines, specific code of conduct, and general bank policies

• Positive contribution to overall global business

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Demonstrate ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and excel under pressure.

• Ability to work in Singapore.

• Self-motivated, with excellent judgement and discretion.

• The role requires a thorough understanding of liability management and extensive experience in the global fixed income and foreign exchange markets. Critical skillset includes hedging, price making, and risk management.

NOTE: Partial secondment to BNS Singapore Branch will be required to enable candidate to perform bookings in the name of BNS to comply with Singapore regulations governing Securities and Futures activities.

Education I Experience I Other Information (include only those that are specific to the role)

• MBA or undergraduate degree, with an established record of academic achievement.

• Minimum 3 years in Fixed Income markets primarily dealing Fixed Income (US, UK, Singapore)

• Current Singapore MAS (1B, 6A)

• Will have exposure to legal, risk, management, and regulatory issues both globally and in Asia Pacific; will be required to coordinate and connect with other global teams on a regular basis.

• Strong personal attributes, including enthusiasm, initiative, persistence, results driven, attention to detail, and setting high standards.

• Flexibility to meet demands inherent in a global business that operates 24 hours a day, over 5 days a week.

• Knowledge of Canadian fixed income markets an advantage

Working Conditions

1. Majority of time will be spent on the trading room floor.

2. High stress fast paced working environment with many deadlines.

3. Ability to multitask and deal with numerous competing demands

4. Moderate international travel, as required.

5. The transactions in which the position becomes directly involved have tight deadlines. Evening and weekend work can be regular, without prior notice, and could take place out of town. The position requires a very high degree of flexibility and cooperation, as well as occasionally accepting responsibilities outside of the defined accountabilities.

title: Manager, Partnerships, Climate & Food Systems (2-year contract)
description:
About WWF

WWF-Singapore World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF) is one of the world’s largest and most respected independent conservation organisations. WWF’s mission is to stop the degradation of the earth’s natural environment and to build a future in which humans live in harmony with nature. As one of WWF’s international hubs, WWF-Singapore supports a global network spanning over 100 countries. WWF Singapore works closely with local stakeholders towards a greener and more sustainable Singapore and the region around us. We work to address key conservation areas, such as climate change, sustainable finance, deforestation, illegal wildlife trade, marine conservation, and sustainable production and consumption, through collaboration, education and outreach efforts involving the community, businesses, and governments. For more information, please visit wwf.sg.

Overview

WWF-Singapore is seeking a Partnerships Manager to develop and manage strategic partnerships for its Climate Finance programmes, with a primary focus on its Climate Resilient Rice/Food Coalition.

The role will identify, onboard and steward partners across the private sector, financial institutions, government, philanthropy and other organisations, helping to build a strong coalition that can mobilise finance and collective action for climate-resilient and low-carbon food systems across Southeast Asia.

Key Responsibilities

1. Partnership Development & Onboarding

Identify and engage prospective partners for the Climate Resilient Rice/Food Coalition.

Develop compelling partnership propositions, proposals and engagement materials.

Lead prospective partners from initial engagement through onboarding and formalisation of partnerships.

Identify opportunities for partners to contribute through finance, technical expertise, market access, procurement and other forms of collaboration.

2. Partner Stewardship

Manage relationships with a portfolio of partners and serve as their primary WWF point of contact.

Maintain regular engagement with partners and identify opportunities to deepen collaboration.

Coordinate with WWF programme and technical teams to ensure effective delivery of partnership commitments.

Prepare partnership updates, reports and briefings as required.

3. Coalition Development & Engagement

Support the growth and development of the Climate Resilient Rice/Food Coalition as an effective regional multi-stakeholder platform.

Engage coalition members and facilitate collaboration across businesses, financial institutions, governments, technical organisations and civil society.

Coordinate coalition meetings, roundtables, workshops and other partner engagements.

Identify opportunities for joint initiatives that can mobilise finance and scale climate-resilient and low-carbon agriculture.

4. Programme Development

Support the development of sustainable food programmes and related carbon finance programmes.

Represent WWF-Singapore at relevant external engagements and industry forums.

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Business, Sustainability, Environmental Studies, International Relations, Finance or a related field.

Minimum 5 years' experience in partnerships, business development, sustainability, programme development or stakeholder engagement.

Demonstrated ability to develop and manage relationships with corporate, financial, government or institutional partners.

Strong communication, relationship-management and project-management skills.

Experience in sustainable agriculture, food systems, climate finance or carbon markets would be advantageous.

Experience working in Southeast Asia would be an advantage.

Why Join Us

Join WWF-Singapore to build partnerships that mobilise finance and collective action for climate, nature and communities. You will work with leading organisations across the region to help scale climate-resilient and sustainable food systems across Southeast Asia.

title: Manager of Investment, Utility Power Projects
description:
Job Description

About Peak Energy

Peak Energy is a clean energy platform that develops, finances, builds, and operates utility-scale solar, rooftop generation, onshore wind, and battery storage solutions across Asia-Pacific. As a fast-growing scale-up, we build on the experience of a team drawn from TotalEnergies, Vestas, Cleantech Energy, and other leading players, combining world-class technical expertise with entrepreneurial agility.

With over 300 MW of operating assets and 1 GW of projects in development across Japan, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, the Philippines, Thailand, Singapore and Indonesia, we are greenfield developers at heart, but we also partner flexibly with industrials, developers, and investors to accelerate delivery and scale impact.

We combine the customer focus of a developer, the technical expertise of an EPC and the financial strength of a heavyweight institution, enabling clients to meet decarbonization targets on time, on budget, and without risk of delivery failure. Peak Energy is wholly owned by Stonepeak, one of the world's leading alternative investment firms specializing in infrastructure and real assets. Our financial and technical strength coupled with our relationships in local markets allows us to optimize our capital deployment in high-quality assets.

Our clients can expect clean energy solutions delivered on time, on budget, and at scale, with no surprises. Let's partner together to support your sustainability journey.

Role Overview

The Associate / Senior Associate, Investments will support the identification, evaluation, development, and execution of utility-scale renewable energy investments across Asia Pacific with a closer line of sight to markets in Malaysia, Thailand, and the Philippines. The role is expected to report directly to the CIO in supporting decision-making for the entire group.

Working closely with colleagues across development, engineering, finance, legal, and external stakeholders, this individual will contribute to greenfield development opportunities, mergers and acquisitions, strategic partnerships, and project financing initiatives. The role offers broad exposure across the investment lifecycle and the opportunity to help grow one of the region's leading renewable energy platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Investment Analysis & Evaluation

· Develop and maintain financial models for renewable energy and infrastructure investments.

· Perform valuation, scenario, sensitivity, and risk analyses to support investment decisions including offtake negotiations, FID decisions and devex initiation / monitoring..

· Assess project economics, commercial assumptions, and potential returns across development and acquisition opportunities.

· Support the preparation of investment recommendations and internal approval materials.

· Preparation of regular reporting material with local team to discuss next quarterly spend profiles and project priorities

Greenfield Development & Opportunity Assessment

· Support the evaluation of greenfield renewable energy opportunities across Southeast Asia.

· Conduct market, commercial, and regulatory research to identify attractive investment opportunities.

· Work closely with development teams to assess project viability and investment attractiveness.

· Monitor industry trends, power markets, and competitive activity across the region.

Transaction Execution & Due Diligence

· Support acquisition, partnership, and investment opportunities across the region.

· Participate in due diligence activities and coordinate with internal teams and external advisors.

· Review project and company information to identify key risks and opportunities.

· Support financing, transaction execution, and other strategic initiatives as required.

Stakeholder Collaboration

· Work collaboratively with development, legal, engineering, finance, and operations teams.

· Support engagement with developers, investors, lenders, advisors, and strategic partners.

· Prepare analyses and presentations for management and investment discussions.

· Contribute to initiatives that support the continued growth of Peak Energy's utility-scale platform.

Qualifications & Experience

· Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

· Relevant experience in renewable energy, infrastructure, project finance, investment banking, corporate development, consulting, or a related field.

· Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities.

· Financial modelling experience relating to infrastructure, power, or renewable energy projects is required.

· Financial due diligence experience relating to renewable energy or infrastructure investments is preferred,

· Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across functions and cultures.

Peak Energy is a renewable energy platform with a focus on developing solar, wind and battery projects across Asia. As the region's consumption of energy rises, Peak Energy is dedicated to meeting these demands while contributing to carbon neutrality. We accomplish this by developing large utility-scale projects. These include some of the largest solar and wind farms in Korea and Japan.

Peak Energy is the renewable arm of Stonepeak Infrastructure Partners; a leading global infrastructure investment firm with +USD 57 Bn in assets under management. Our portfolio includes the offshore wind farm in Taiwan with plans to develop a further +5 GWp.

Our team has decades of experience and long-standing relationships. This combination of knowledge and relationships, combined with expertise in design and supply chains enables Peak Energy to deliver high performing, robust alternative energy systems on time and under budget.

At Peak Energy, you'll collaborate with passionate individuals, drive meaningful impact, and be at the forefront of Asia’s transition to renewable energy. We believe everyone is needed for carbon neutrality. Therefore, fresh ideas are always welcomed. Are you excited about disrupting traditional energy sources and developing a sustainable future? Come join our team and be a part of the energy revolution with Peak Energy!
