title: Associate
description:
TRINITY INTERNATIONAL

Tough projects. Exciting markets. Great people.

Trinity International is a boutique law firm with a unique focus on projects, finance, corporate and commercial transactions and international arbitration and dispute resolution in emerging markets. We think like entrepreneurs: we believe clients doing the most challenging deals in the most challenging markets deserve senior, hands-on lawyers who roll up their sleeves and get things done.

Our award-winning, senior-led team boasts vast experience in the power and renewables, resources, mining and infrastructure, industrial and agricultural sectors. With offices in Singapore, London, Paris and Washington, D.C., we are a boutique firm with a global vision.

The firm provides legal services in project finance, commercial and corporate transactions and international arbitration and dispute resolution in emerging markets across the Asia-Pacific, Africa and Latin America. These are tough, fast-moving and sometimes unpredictable markets, and that is exactly why we love working in them.

The firm’s clients include financial institutions, including development finance institutions, multilaterals, commercial banks and funds, major corporates, developers and sponsors of projects, equity investors, governments and other public sector stakeholders.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

We are looking for an Associate with energy, curiosity and a sense of adventure to join our growing Singapore team.

This is not a role for someone who wants to sit on one small piece of a very large deal. At Trinity you will be close to the action from day one: working directly with partners and clients, and helping to get landmark projects over the line in markets where the playbook is still being written.

The role covers the full life of energy and infrastructure projects: drafting, reviewing and negotiating project, finance and security documents, supporting M&A and joint venture transactions, carrying out due diligence and managing the interface with clients, local counsel and other advisers. You will work in a dynamic team with different partners, counsel and associates, often alongside colleagues in the firm's other offices.

Trinity does not believe in lawyers having a narrow focus or being pigeon-holed. As a result, although financing and energy M&A experience is key, the role will allow and encourage the successful candidate to experience other aspects of the firm’s practice, including project development, wider M&A/private equity and international arbitration. If you enjoy variety, you will fit right in.

Core focus will be on the power/energy and infrastructure sectors, but will also involve sectors including mining, oil & gas, petrochemicals, heavy industry, manufacturing and agribusiness.

Day-to-day tasks include drafting and reviewing contracts, conducting due diligence, managing client relationships, and advising clients on project and corporate finance and energy M&A matters. The role requires collaboration with international colleagues and handling cross-border transactions.

We are a growing firm and everyone has a stake in building it. All members of the team are encouraged to play a part in business development, and good ideas are welcome from anyone, whatever their seniority.

It is a hybrid role that requires no fewer than 3 days per week in the relevant office.

QUALIFICATIONS

Singapore or common law qualified (admitted in Singapore, UK, Australia, New Zealand or Canada), 3+ years PQE, preferably in a global law firm.

Experience in project finance, corporate finance, energy M&A and project development, with a particular focus on financing.

Proven ability to draft and negotiate finance and M&A transaction documents, conduct due diligence, and manage client relationships.

Strong knowledge of energy, infrastructure, resources, and industry sectors.

Excellent negotiation and communication skills.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with a willingness to collaborate across international offices.

Fluency in English; additional language skills are a plus.

Previous experience working in emerging markets, or a genuine appetite to do work in them.

ESSENTIAL QUALITIES

Entrepreneurial Spirit: Enjoy building things. See a tricky market or a complex deal as an opportunity, not an obstacle.

Team Player: Work in a team environment in a collaborative and positive manner. Be willing to help colleagues in busy times in particular.

Positive Outlook: Exhibit a friendly and enthusiastic demeanour that encourages a collaborative environment. Find solutions, not problems.

A Sense of Humour: We work hard on demanding matters and we like to enjoy it. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves.

Manager

or

technology policy

.

Tech firms face a challenging policy and regulatory environment across Asia-Pacific. We are looking for candidates who have

experience

relevant to

technology policy

, particularly in

but not limited to

AI policy and regulation, online safety, data governance, data centres, and competition in digital markets.

We welcome any candidates with experience working for government departments or regulators. We are also open to candidates from commercial backgrounds, including in-house policy roles in industry or experience in other consulting firms, with a keen interest in politics, policy and regulation. For

4 - 9 years’ work experience –

though this is a

g

uide only and we will consider applications on a case-by-case basis.

Our ideal candidate will have:

Strong experience in technology policy fields – this might include one or several of AI policy and regulation, online safety, data governance, data centres, competition in digital markets, and telecommunications.

A professional background in government, a regulator, consultancy, think tank, or industry body in managerial positions.

A proven track record of managing projects and teams in fast-paced, delivery-focused environments.

Excellent analytical, research and problem-solving skills - the ability to quickly dive into new topics and draw out the implications of complex evidence to give clear strategy and policy advice.

Strong interpersonal skills – a flexible approach and the ability to work well across teams, both with colleagues and clients.

Commercial acumen, with the ability to identify new business opportunities and deliver commercially viable solutions to clients.

Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise advice to stakeholders, both in written and verbal form.

(desirable but not required) Connections to government officials and/or regulators working on technology-related policy in at least one Asia-Pacific country or multilateral grouping.

CV

with a short

cover letter

(max 600 words) by

Friday 30 October

.

To be successful, please submit your CV and cover letter setting out:

Why you would like to join Flint.

How your experience and skills qualify you for this specific role and its requirements.

The policy areas you are knowledgeable of and/or particularly interested in.

Whether you have the right to work in Singapore.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Kiztopia Group is a leading family edutainment and active entertainment business dedicated to creating meaningful, engaging experiences through play, exploration and movement.

With multiple concepts and locations across Singapore and the region, we continue to grow our portfolio through innovation, creativity and a commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences.

Our established Kiztopia brand brings families together through purposeful play, while Xventure, our next-generation indoor actives ports park, introduces exciting experiences designed for older children, youths, young adults and families.

As we expand, we are looking for passionate and capable individuals to help strengthen our brands, grow our customer base and shape the future of entertainment in Singapore.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a

commercially driven, creative and hands-on Marketing Manager

to lead the marketing strategy, planning and execution for Kiztopia Group's Singapore businesses, including Kiztopia and Xventure.

You will take ownership of integrated marketing initiatives that strengthen brand positioning, increase customer acquisition, drive visitorship and contribute to business growth.

This role requires someone who can translate business objectives into actionable marketing strategies, balance brand-building with performance marketing, and lead campaigns from concept through execution and performance evaluation.

You will manage marketing budgets, guide team members, coordinate external agencies and work closely with Commercial, Operations and other stakeholders to deliver results.

We are looking for a well-rounded marketing leader who is equally comfortable developing strategy, analysing performance and getting involved in execution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketing Strategy & Business Growth

Develop and lead integrated marketing strategies for Kiztopia and Xventure, aligned with brand positioning, commercial objectives and business priorities.

Translate revenue targets, visitorship goals and customer acquisition objectives into actionable monthly, quarterly and annual marketing plans.

Develop targeted strategies for different customer segments, including families, children, youths, young adults, schools and relevant community groups.

Identify opportunities to drive ticket sales, increase repeat visits, build brand loyalty and strengthen customer lifetime value.

Plan and manage campaigns across business-as-usual operations, seasonal peaks, new outlet launches and special events.

Monitor consumer trends, competitor activities and market opportunities to keep our brands relevant and competitive.

2. Integrated Campaign Management

Lead end-to-end planning and execution of marketing campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels.

Develop clear campaign objectives, audience targeting, promotional mechanics, timelines, budgets and measurable KPIs.

Oversee campaign delivery across social media, digital advertising, CRM, website, partnerships, PR and on-ground activations.

Establish effective customer journeys from awareness and engagement through to ticket purchase and repeat visits.

Ensure campaigns are delivered on time, within budget and aligned with business objectives.

Review campaign effectiveness and refine strategies based on performance data and customer response.

3. Digital Marketing & Performance Management

Lead digital marketing strategies across platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok and other relevant channels.

Manage advertising budgets and optimise resource allocation based on campaign objectives and performance.

Oversee audience segmentation, retargeting, conversion campaigns and relevant testing initiatives.

Monitor key performance indicators such as reach, engagement, website traffic, acquisition cost, conversions and attributable revenue.

Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency, conversion rates and return on marketing investment.

Work with relevant stakeholders to improve website, booking and ticketing conversion journeys.

4. Brand, Social Media & Content Strategy

Own the overall brand marketing direction and ensure consistent positioning across campaigns and communication channels.

Develop differentiated content and communication strategies for Kiztopia and Xventure based on their respective target audiences.

Lead social media planning across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and other relevant platforms.

Guide the development of engaging content, including short-form videos, attraction highlights, promotional campaigns, customer experiences and community-driven content.

Review creative concepts, campaign messaging and marketing assets to ensure brand consistency and audience relevance.

Identify emerging content formats, cultural trends and creative opportunities that can strengthen organic reach and brand visibility.

Work closely with the marketing team, content creators and external agencies to deliver relevant, high-quality content.

5. Customer Engagement, CRM & Retention

Develop CRM and customer engagement strategies to encourage repeat visits, strengthen relationships and drive incremental revenue.

Oversee segmented email marketing, WhatsApp campaigns and other customer communications.

Identify opportunities for cross-promotion between Kiztopia, Xventure and other relevant business concepts.

Develop targeted campaigns around school holidays, birthdays, memberships, special occasions and customer engagement opportunities.

Review customer engagement and campaign data to identify opportunities for improved targeting and retention.

6. Partnerships, Events & Brand Activations

Collaborate with mall partners, ticketing platforms, community groups, schools, influencers and external partners on marketing initiatives.

Work closely with Commercial and Operations teams to support new outlet launches, grand openings, events and promotional activations.

Develop marketing initiatives that build awareness, generate publicity and encourage customer participation.

Identify and evaluate potential partnerships based on audience relevance, commercial value and expected marketing exposure.

Manage external agencies and vendors, ensuring clear deliverables, timelines, quality standards and value for money.

7. Budget, Reporting & Performance Accountability

Develop, manage and monitor marketing budgets across brands, campaigns and channels.

Track campaign performance against marketing KPIs and business objectives.

Prepare weekly marketing performance updates and monthly management reports covering key results, budget utilisation, insights and recommended actions.

Evaluate campaign effectiveness beyond engagement metrics, with emphasis on measurable business outcomes.

Identify underperforming initiatives early and recommend practical corrective actions.

Maintain clear marketing plans, campaign trackers, budgets and reporting frameworks.

8. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Lead, coach and develop the Singapore marketing team, establishing clear priorities, ownership and performance expectations.

Delegate effectively while remaining hands-on when required by business priorities.

Establish efficient workflows for campaign planning, creative production, approvals, execution and reporting.

Work collaboratively with Operations, Commercial, Partnerships, Sales and regional stakeholders.

Ensure marketing campaigns and promotions are communicated clearly to frontline teams and are operationally executable.

Foster a culture of accountability, creativity, initiative and continuous improvement.

REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Minimum 5 years of relevant marketing experience, with demonstrated ownership of integrated marketing campaigns and experience leading projects or team members.

Strong understanding of digital marketing, performance advertising, social media, CRM and integrated campaign management.

Proven ability to develop actionable marketing plans and manage campaigns from strategy to execution.

Commercially minded, with the ability to interpret campaign performance and connect marketing activities to business outcomes.

Experience managing marketing budgets, external agencies and multiple concurrent campaigns.

Strong leadership, project management, communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

Proactive, resourceful and comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Creative and analytical, with the ability to balance brand development and performance-driven marketing.

Willingness to take a hands-on approach and support execution where necessary.

ADDED ADVANTAGES

Experience in attractions, entertainment, family-oriented businesses, lifestyle, leisure, retail, hospitality or other consumer-facing industries.

Experience managing multiple brands, business locations or new product launches.

Familiarity with online ticketing platforms, e-commerce conversion and customer acquisition campaigns.

Knowledge of SEO, Google Analytics, marketing automation or relevant CRM tools.

Experience in influencer marketing, community engagement, experiential marketing or event activations.

Hands-on content creation, photography or video editing experience.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Clear, executable marketing plans aligned with commercial and brand objectives.

Improved brand visibility, customer engagement and qualified traffic.

Measurable contribution to customer acquisition, ticket sales, visitorship and repeat visits.

Effective utilisation of marketing budgets and continuous campaign optimisation.

Consistent delivery of high-quality campaigns across Kiztopia and Xventure.

A well-organised, accountable marketing team capable of executing independently.

WHY JOIN US?

Lead marketing for two exciting entertainment brands with distinct growth opportunities.

Play a meaningful role in new brand development, outlet launches and business expansion.

Take ownership of marketing initiatives with direct visibility into business performance.

Work in a dynamic, entrepreneurial and collaborative environment.

Grow professionally within an expanding regional entertainment group.

If you enjoy building brands, developing creative campaigns and turning marketing ideas into measurable results, we would love to hear from you.

title: Wellness Education Specialist
description:
*Job Title: *Education & Customer Success Specialist

*Location: *Singapore

*Employment Type:* Full-Time

*Reports To:* Country Manager

*Salary Range: *SGD6,500 - SGD7,500

*Job Highlights:*

* Be part of a *global leading wellness brand*, *Technogym*, that powers *Olympic athletes* and is trusted by luxury gyms, health clubs, and elite sports teams worldwide.
* Be part of a *high performing team* that *challenges individual growth *while continuously innovating in the fitness and wellness industry.
* Get *complimentary access* to our *Technogym showroom equipment *for personal training and workouts as part of your employee benefits.

*About the Company*
*SE Active* is the exclusive partner for *Technogym* in Singapore & Malaysia, managing everything from equipment sales to after-sales services and warranty protection. SE Active aims to be the market leader in offering total wellness solutions in both countries, with a customer-first approach to meet fitness and wellness needs. The company's focus is on growing the brand's presence and anchoring market dominance while providing the Technogym experience by embodying its core values.

*About Technogym*

For more than 40 years, we at *Technogym* have been helping people live healthier and happier lives. If 50 million people in the world train on our equipment every day, it’s not just a matter of chance. We are the global experts of wellness, be it for fitness, health, or sports. Reaching over 100 countries in the world, Technogym has brought wellness through movement to thousands of locations around the world. Technogym produces top-notch fitness equipment found in luxury property gyms and has been the Official Supplier of the Olympic Games for ten consecutive editions, from Sydney 2000 to Milano Cortina 2026, supporting Olympic athletes in their quest for excellence.

*Job Overview:*

As an Education & Customer Success Specialist, you will play a key role in elevating Technogym’s brand experience through impactful education, customer engagement, training excellence, and relationship management. You will work closely with internal teams, partners, trainers, and customers to drive product adoption, customer satisfaction, and long-term engagement with Technogym’s wellness ecosystem.

This role combines elements of wellness education, customer success, account support, coaching, community engagement, and event coordination. You will empower internal teams, B2B partners, and end consumers with in-depth product knowledge and training support, while also building strong customer relationships and a network of certified personal trainers and wellness advocates.

You will serve as a key point of contact in ensuring customers receive a seamless experience throughout their journey — from onboarding and training to ongoing engagement and retention. Through proactive support, product education, and community activation initiatives, you will help customers maximize the value of Technogym solutions while strengthening brand loyalty and advocacy.

The ideal candidate is passionate about fitness, wellness, and customer experience, with strong communication and interpersonal skills. You are a confident trainer and relationship builder who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys engaging with diverse audiences, and is committed to delivering exceptional education and customer experiences across markets.

*Responsibilities:*

*1. Internal Product Education & Sales Enablement*

* Lead ongoing product education and training initiatives for the sales team throughout the year.
* Ensure all sales team members complete Technogym’s product storytelling assessments and maintain a minimum performance score across all products.
* Identify underperforming team members and conduct targeted coaching and training sessions to strengthen product knowledge and storytelling capabilities.
* Maintain a minimum personal product knowledge rating, as assessed by the Regional Education & Training Manager, to qualify for delivering storytelling assessments.
* Develop and update training materials, user guides, and educational resources to support internal product learning and customer engagement.

*2. Customer Onboarding, Training & Success Management*

* Support the onboarding of new customers by guiding them through product setup, training, and adoption to ensure a smooth customer experience.
* Conduct quarterly product refresher trainings and ongoing educational sessions for key account clients in collaboration with their internal training managers.
* Coordinate and deliver on-site product training during new equipment installations, ensuring all facility staff receive relevant training materials via the Technogym Trainer Portal.
* Facilitate post-delivery product education sessions for home customers. Where required, coordinate with certified freelance personal trainers from the Technogym training network to deliver training sessions.
* Create and implement customer success plans that outline customer goals, milestones, adoption strategies, and engagement initiatives.
* Educate customers on product features, capabilities, and best practices to maximize product utilization and long-term value.

*3. Customer Relationship Management & Retention*

* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers to understand their operational needs, business goals, and challenges.
* Proactively engage customers through various communication channels to monitor satisfaction, gather feedback, and support ongoing success.
* Monitor customer usage and adoption trends to identify at-risk accounts and implement retention strategies.
* Support account management activities, including license renewals to drive customer retention and long-term account success.
* Address customer concerns, issues, and escalations promptly while coordinating with internal stakeholders to ensure effective resolution.
* Identify and develop customer advocates for testimonials, referrals, case studies, and community engagement opportunities.

*4. Trainer Network Development*

* Expand and manage the Technogym-certified personal trainer network through onboarding, certification, and ongoing engagement initiatives.
* Ensure certified trainers remain up to date with the latest Technogym products, training methodologies, and wellness solutions.
* Maintain the quality and consistency of training standards through regular assessments, refresher programs, and recertification initiatives.

*5. Community Engagement & Wellness Events*

* Collaborate with frontline managers and the marketing team to identify and engage relevant fitness and wellness communities.
* Establish partnerships with coaches, medical professionals, wellness experts, influencers, and other industry stakeholders to support wellness initiatives and community outreach.
* Plan and execute community-focused events, workshops, clinics, and wellness activations with clearly defined KPIs to measure engagement and impact.
* Represent Technogym as a wellness and product ambassador during events, training sessions, and customer engagements.

*6. Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement*

* Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer satisfaction, training effectiveness, customer retention, engagement, and revenue growth.
* Collect and analyze customer feedback to identify trends, areas for improvement, and opportunities to enhance the customer experience.
* Work closely with sales, marketing, after-sales, and regional teams to ensure a seamless and consistent customer journey.
* Stay updated on industry trends, customer success best practices, and Technogym product developments to continuously improve training delivery and customer engagement strategies.

*Requirements:*

* *Bachelor’s degree* in Sports Science, Exercise Physiology, or a related field.
* *5–7 years of experience *in fitness education, personal training, customer success, business development, consultancy, or a similar client-facing role.
* *Strong presentation and training delivery skills* — able to engage, educate, and inspire diverse audiences including sales teams, fitness professionals, and customers.
* Proven experience in *conducting workshops, seminars, or product training sessions* in a professional setting.
* Ability to *build rapport and credibility* quickly with internal stakeholders (e.g., sales team) and external clients.
* *Confident and polished communicator* with excellent interpersonal skills and professional presence.
* Comfortable working *independently and cross-functionally*, with strong organizational and time management skills.
* Tech-savvy with the ability to *navigate digital platforms* for training, communication, and certification delivery.
* Passionate about *fitness, wellness, and the Technogym philosophy* of lifestyle transformation through movement.
* Certification as a *personal trainer or fitness instructor* (e.g., ACE, NASM, NSCA) is a strong advantage.
* Prior experience in a *premium brand environment* or wellness tech company is a plus.
* Proven ability in *customer success*, account management, consultancy, business development, or pre-sales support roles preferred.
* Strong *customer-centric mindset* with a focus on onboarding, engagement, retention, and long-term relationship building preferred.

*Alignment with our Core Values:*

* *Refinement*: Living in curiosity to drive excellence and improve processes.
* _Behaviours: Curiosity and Process Driven._
* *Respect*: Respecting others and oneself, with humility in approach.
* _Behaviours: Humility and Self-Worth._
* *Reliability*: Actions following sincere commitments, accountable for words and actions.
* _Behaviours: Sincerity and Accountability._
* *Relentlessness*: Challenging what’s possible, thriving despite challenges.
* _Behaviours: Possibility & Resilience._
* *Resourcefulness*: Being creative and proactive in adding value.
* _Behaviours: Proactiveness & Creativeness._

title: Marketing Executive
description:
About Young Hungry Free

Young Hungry Free is a Singapore fashion label founded in 2012, known for edgy basics and wearable trends in sizes XXS to 3XL. A new named collection drops online every Monday at 8pm, and the #YHFAMILY community — members, Telegram subscribers and creators — is at the centre of how the brand grows. We ship from Singapore to customers across the region and beyond.

The role

You will tell the Young Hungry Free story every week. The core of the role is the weekly drop cycle: the content, copy, social publishing and creator seeding that bring each Monday collection to life. Around that, you will help deliver the brand's bigger moments — seasonal and collaboration campaigns, PR and events.

You will lead those bigger moments rather than support them, own media relations, and manage campaign budgets.

What you will do

1. Weekly content and social

Plan and run the content calendar around the Monday 8pm drop: teasers, launch-night content and follow-up.

Write copy for collection launches, product stories, social posts, EDMs and the website, in line with the brand's tone of voice and house style.

Schedule and publish across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and the #YHFAMILY Telegram channel, and manage community comments.

Brief designers, photographers and videographers.

Supply copy and assets for performance and CRM campaigns. The performance and marketing teams own targeting, flows and media buying.

2. Campaigns

Turn campaign strategy into narratives, key messages and visual direction for seasonal, launch and collaboration campaigns.

Coordinate campaign delivery across channels and teams, to agreed timelines.

Lead campaigns from brief to wrap reports.

3. PR and earned media

Maintain the media list, draft press releases and pitches, and manage press seeding.

Track coverage and report on earned media.

Own media relations, including building relationships with editors and handling enquiries.

4. Events and activations

Help plan and run pop-ups, launches and brand events, including vendor coordination and on-the-day delivery.

Lead events from concept to wrap, including vendors and budget.

5. Creators, KOLs and community

Run / Co-run the organic creator and ambassador programme end to end: shortlisting, outreach, product seeding against each drop, briefing and relationship management.

Build a library of user-generated content with written usage permissions.

Ensure all gifted and paid creator content carries the correct disclosure.

Work with the performance team on paid and affiliate creator partnerships, which they co-own.

6. Brand consistency

Apply the brand guidelines across every customer touchpoint, and flag inconsistencies before they go live.

7. Platform, Systems and Channel Management: Content Management Systems, Customer Relationship Management Systems, EDM Tools and Advertising Tools

Plan, execute and improve integrated campaign and marketing initiatives across our different CMS, CRM, EDM, Advertising tools and platforms.

8. Budget and reporting

Track campaign, seeding and event spend against budget, within approval limits set by the Head of Marketing.

Report monthly on content, social, creator and PR performance: what worked, what did not and what to change.

Work closely with performance marketing, CRM, product, operations and customer service.

Take on other duties within the marketing team as needed.

What we are looking for

Essential

Experience at the level you are applying for, ideally in fashion, lifestyle, e-commerce or an agency.

A portfolio showing copy you have written and social content you have produced or managed.

Strong English copywriting, with a sharp ear for tone.

Deep working knowledge of Instagram and TikTok — formats, trends, and what the analytics are telling you.

Experience working with creators or influencers.

A strong visual eye and the ability to give clear campaign, marketing and suggest creative direction together with the creative team.

The organisation to hit a weekly launch deadline, every week.

Comfort reading platform insights and basic web analytics, and turning them into decisions.

Advantageous

Events, pop-up or physical activation experience.

PR or media relations experience.

Short-form video editing, for example CapCut or Premiere Pro; basic Photoshop, Illustrator or Canva.

Experience with Klaviyo or a similar email platform, and with social scheduling tools.

Confident use of AI tools for research and ideation, with the judgement to check what they produce.

HOW TO APPLY

Email your application to

humans@younghungryfree.com,

include position title in the subject line, your CV and any relevant information and the following details:

Name:

Earliest availability:

Expected Salary:

Why Young Hungry Free?

What difference can you make?

What makes you stand out?

Young Hungry Free is an online fashion brand that puts our customers in the forefront. Known to embody the spirit of risk takers and rule breakers in our designs, we aim to give our customers the voice they need through our clothes. Find timeless, reinvented wardrobe staples and dress like you're forever young, hungry and free.

We are a team of adventurous, passionate risk-takers who believe in the endless pursuit of excellence. We aim to constantly improve and innovate our work, and on our performance in being the best.

We are always on the lookout for dedicated people to join the team, if you love to be part of something awesome and kick ass, you are looking in the right place!

title: Social Media Executive
description:
ABOUT US

The Hey Co Group is a homegrown Singapore F&B group founded in 2016. Over nine years we have built and scaled a portfolio of brands across quick-service, casual dining, cafe, restaurant and bar. We are not a chain. Each brand has its own identity, its own audience, and its own reason to exist — and we obsess over quality and consistency across every touchpoint, including the ones on people's screens.

Social media is where most people meet our brands for the first time. A single Reel can fill a restaurant on a quiet Tuesday. That is why this role sits at the heart of how we grow.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a creative Social Media Executive to support our Branding & Marketing Manager in bringing six distinct brands to life.

You will be the hands-on engine of our social channels — creating content and caring for our communities. You bring the ideas and the execution. The Branding & Marketing Manager brings the strategy and brand direction. Together you will make sure each brand shows up consistently, on time, and looking its best, every single week.

We are a team that embraces AI, and we want someone who uses it to create faster and think bigger — from ideation through to editing.

This is a great role for a creative, platform-native person who wants to do the work, learn fast, and see their content reach thousands of guests.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

No two days look the same. A typical week might involve shooting a new menu launch at one of our cafes in the morning, editing a batch of Reels and Stories over lunch, scheduling the week's posts, replying to a wave of comments and DMs, checking how last week's content performed, and syncing with the Branding & Marketing Manager on an upcoming campaign.

Some days are quiet and edit-heavy. Others are fast, on-location and full of energy.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Create content — shoot, edit, schedule and publish posts, Reels and Stories across our brands, following the direction and calendar set with the Branding & Marketing Manager

Shoot and edit — capture short-form video and photography in-store and on-location, quickly, with a phone and light kit

Community — reply to comments and DMs across assigned brand accounts, engage followers, and keep each brand's tone right. Escalate service issues and complaints to the relevant outlet manager promptly

Support campaigns — support the launches, seasonal menus, promotions and collaborations that the Branding & Marketing Manager plans

Paid social support — set up and boost posts across Meta and TikTok under the Branding & Marketing Manager's direction. Monitor spend and basic performance, and flag what is and is not working

Local SEO support — keep our Google Business Profiles current across outlets (hours, photos, menus, review responses) and apply keyword and caption basics so our content is easier to find

KOL coordination — coordinate influencer and food creator visits: scheduling, logistics and hosting on the day

Use AI — use AI tools to work faster and smarter: drafting captions and ideas, generating and editing images and video, researching trends, and streamlining your day to day

Report — track reach, engagement, saves and follower growth by brand, and share a simple monthly update on what is working and what is not

Consistency and ideas — keep each brand's tone, look and quality distinct and consistent, and bring fresh, on-trend ideas to the table

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

Essential:

One to three years in social media and content — F&B, hospitality, lifestyle or agency

A portfolio, showreel, or links to two or three accounts you have personally run. Applications without work samples will not be reviewed

A creative, ideas-driven eye for aesthetics, storytelling, and food that looks irresistible

Strong hands-on skills across Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, plus shooting and editing short-form video and photography

Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager at boosting and basic campaign level

Basic understanding of local SEO — keywords, captions, hashtags, and Google Business Profile management

Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Canva AI, CapCut, image and video generators) to create, ideate and work efficiently

Able to juggle several brands and deadlines without dropping quality, and to hold distinct brand voices apart rather than blending them into one

Comfortable working in live restaurant environments, including occasional evenings and weekends for shoots

A genuine love for food, hospitality, culture and people

Based in Singapore and able to travel between our outlets

Advantageous:

Basic design ability (Canva, Figma or Adobe)

Familiarity with Xiaohongshu

Written Mandarin

Experience with a multi-outlet or multi-brand group

Familiarity with the Singapore F&B and dining scene

HOW TO APPLY

Send the following to HR@theheyco.com:

Your CV

A short note on why this excites you

Links to content you have created — a portfolio, a showreel, or two to three accounts you have run, with a line on what you were responsible for

The Hey Co Group (HCG) is a Singapore-born F&B group founded in 2016. In under a decade, we've grown into a family of brands spanning — each built with the same obsession: concepts that are timeless, consistent, and genuinely good. We do not chase trends but rather market demands; we're building things that last, held together by a tight ecosystem across branding, marketing, operations, supply chain, and cost.

What makes HCG different is how we work. We move fast, we stay hands-on, and we care as much about our people as we do our product. Our teams have real ownership, direct access to leadership, and the room to grow with the group as we expand. Whether you're behind the bar, in the kitchen, running an outlet, or supporting from HQ, you're part of building something — not just clocking a shift.

We look for people who are curious, gritty, and take pride in getting the details right. If you want to learn fast, be trusted with responsibility, and grow alongside a group that's still hungry, HCG is a place to build a career — not just find a job.

title: PUBLIC RELATIONS OFFICER
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Public Relations Officer to join our team. As a Public Relations Officer, you will be responsible for managing and enhancing the public image and reputation of our organization. You will develop and execute effective communication strategies, build relationships with key stakeholders, and handle media relations. The ideal candidate has exceptional communication skills, a strong understanding of public relations principles, and the ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Responsibilities

Communication Strategy: Develop and implement comprehensive communication strategies that align with the organization's goals and objectives. Create messaging frameworks, key talking points, and press releases to effectively convey the organization's mission, initiatives, and achievements.

Media Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with media representatives, journalists, and influencers. Proactively pitch stories and secure media coverage for the organization and its events, campaigns, and milestones. Serve as the primary point of contact for media inquiries and coordinate interviews and press conferences.

Content Creation: Write, edit, and distribute compelling and engaging content for various channels, including press releases, newsletters, articles, blog posts, and social media. Ensure all content is accurate, consistent, and aligned with the organization's brand and messaging.

Crisis Management: Act as the organization's spokesperson during times of crisis or reputation management issues. Develop crisis communication plans, prepare key messaging, and manage media inquiries effectively. Mitigate potential damage to the organization's reputation and maintain transparency and trust with stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, partners, government agencies, and community organizations. Develop communication materials tailored to specific audiences and collaborate with internal teams to ensure consistent messaging across all touchpoints.

Event Planning and Management: Coordinate and oversee the planning and execution of press conferences, product launches, corporate events, and other public relations initiatives. Work closely with event organizers, vendors, and internal teams to ensure seamless execution and maximum media exposure.

Monitoring and Reporting: Monitor media coverage and public sentiment related to the organization and its industry. Prepare regular reports on media activity, campaign effectiveness, and key performance indicators. Analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

Requirements

Experience working in the entertainment and nightlife industry

Able to work on weekends and public holidays if required

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building abilities.

Knowledge of public relations principles, strategies, and best practices.

Experience in media relations, including pitching stories and handling media inquiries.

Ability to effectively manage crisis situations and handle sensitive information.

Familiarity with social media platforms and digital marketing trends.

Exceptional organizational and time management skills.

Proficiency in relevant software and tools.

Knowledge of mandarin dialect is essential as our customer base is primarily mandarin speaking

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Able to work late-night hours up to 3am, including weekends and public holidays

We offer a competitive salary, along with benefits and opportunities for professional growth. If you have a passion for public relations, a knack for storytelling, and a desire to shape and protect our organization's reputation, we invite you to apply for the position of Public Relations Officer.

title: Relationship Manager
description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

12

The Role: Relationship Manager

Relationship Manager (RM) is a senior level position who leverages knowledge of the commodity markets and energy industry to grow our bank of business in the region. RM's role is to develop relationships with our strategic clients who are key industry influencers, big energy conglomerates, financial institutions, ministries, and government agencies think thanks, policy makers etc.

The RM will leverage his/her understanding of the Client’s core business spanning upstream, midstream and downstream to help later realize bottom line benefits from the use of S&P Global Energy’s (SPE) products.

A good understanding of the client workflows and trusted relationships in place, the RM will be the guardian of this relationship, orchestrating the deployment of corporate-wide resources (including internal personnel who have specialized skills sets) to provide value to these key accounts. RM is accountable for enhancing our net promoter score and for channelizing the voice of the customer internally.

work closely with individual account managers to not only retain the current bank but also develop whitespace opportunities. This opening is for a RM role in our Singapore office wherein the RM will be responsible for managing relationships with our strategic Thai customers in Thailand and Singapore. As it will involve working with multiple clients in the industry and with multiple account managers, the RM will work closely with the Senior Commercial Director of the Region to map out a growth strategy for the region that includes a SWOT analysis and acquiring new logo opportunities.

As the customer advocate, RM must also provide actionable customer feedback that will enhance SPE’s products and service to earn client trust and business.

Responsibilities:

Managing Key Account Relationship and Service Level Agreement (SLA)

Main point of contact/liaison - accountable for the experience the customer has with SPE,
Considers both the big picture as well as the day-to-day when managing the account,
Develops and builds meaningful and lasting relationships with key and influential contacts,
Effectively navigates around client organizations and leverages internal cross functional resources to create value,
Continuous investigative and collaborative contact with customers to gather strategic information about their business, understands their issues, uncovers unrecognized problems providing solutions to them,
As owner of the SLA, co-ordinates with all other functions and third parties to help ensure service levels and value add offerings are attained and customer needs are met,
Acts as a broker of capabilities or services for client, advocates internally and facilitates the involvement of various SPGE’s functions (sales, content, client services, products, commodity specialists and marketing) to achieve common goals for the client and for SPGE,
Understands the client usage of product/services and help define potential use cases or enhancements of new products to benefit client,
Monitors and reports on the health of SPGE’s relationship with the Client.

Lead Generation - Driving Increased Usage and Adoption of New Services

Plays an instrumental role in the sales cycle by researching customer business, identifying and qualifying leads, involving sales to negotiate and close opportunities,
Promote non-benchmark services and identifies new product development needs by working across functions within the customer organization to understand their needs,
Contribute relevant input to product launch, SPE's forums, conferences and marketing plans,
Seeks out cross and up selling opportunities
Drives interest in trials and demonstrations, participating in their presentation and drive customer buy in for product discussions or testing,
Responds to incremental sales and incoming orders, processed via the sales administrator

Retention

Close collaboration with the sales managers and internal stakeholders,
Prevents cancellations and mitigates risk by ensuring existing clients continue to derive value from SPE's services,
Devise value-add plan for clients with enterprise-wide licenses by working closely with the sales managers, client services, commodity specialists, marketing and content team to drive increased usage and broader adoption.

Reporting

Communicates potential client and/or market shifts, changes or reactions, as well as client needs back to appropriate levels,
Monitors and reports on use of SPGE's services and usage levels,
Contributes to account Plan and participates in plan implementation,
Works with RMs within the region to drive a uniform customer experience and across regional boundaries to ensure the customer account plan is developed and executed consistently and effectively,
Provides status risk and opportunity, competition know how and product development needs,
Updates salesforce,
Monthly activity reporting.

Requirements:

Degree with minimum 10 years of successful experience managing client relations within major or complex accounts, preferably in a trading, consulting, marketing and/or business development role,
Good understanding of SPGE's business and previous user of SPGE's services is a bonus,
Good understanding of S&P Global’s other businesses is a bonus
Excellent business communication and presentation (verbal/ written) skills in Thai and English,
Right to work in Thailand will be a plus
Can distill, summarize, interpret and communicate information to facilitate its usefulness
Proven leadership in managing multi-national global and/or strategic accounts, multi-cultural awareness and regional experience is preferred
Superior customer relationship management skills, proven ability to develop multiple level of relationships within an account of a strategic nature
Competency in creating and identifying needs using consultative sales techniques is a must
Very strong planning and organizational skills, able to prioritize
Competent with systems (Salesforce CRM, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
Frequent travelling required around the region at least once or twice a month

About S&P Global Energy

title: Assistant Manager, Marketing Communications
description:
Company Description

HOTEL OVERVIEW

Strategically located in the heart of Singapore’s shopping, dining and entertainment districts and with the City Hall and Esplanade Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) train stations and other major transportation nodes at its doorstep, Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford are the gateway to explore Singapore’s landscapes at your convenience. With a total of 2,030 well-appointed guestrooms, both hotels also offer a distinct collection of 12 lifestyle and dining choices including Michelin-starred fine dining restaurant JAAN by Kirk Westaway, cutting-edge meeting space at Raffles City Convention Centre with 34 meeting rooms and one of Asia’s largest spas, Willow Stream Spa.

ABOUT OUR COMPANY

At Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford, we design career plans and unveil new professional perspectives through our various development programs. We shine when YOU shine. Come and be part of our dynamic team and experience immerse growth and career opportunities with us.

Job Description

The Assistant Marketing Communications Manager develops and leads communications strategies for assigned revenue streams and lifestyle-led portfolios across Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford. This role has a strong focus on campaign management, public relations, media relations, content development, influencer engagement, media planning, partnerships, F&B storytelling, spa and lifestyle campaigns, while supporting broader hotel, brand and corporate initiatives. The role supports the Director of Marketing Communications in managing campaign execution, agency coordination, media hosting and team workflow. This is a leadership position as second in-charge to lead and manage the team.

COMMUNICATIONS & MEDIA PLANNING

Formulate communications and media calendars for assigned portfolios, ensuring timely and accurate execution of initiatives with relevant business units and stakeholders.

Develop Public Relations angles, media materials, influencer briefs and content narratives that generate positive and relevant coverage across local, regional and international channels.

Develop media plan for campaigns and dedicated business units for brand positioning and/or to meet campaign objectives

Review communications materials including press releases, media pitches, social copy, sales decks, in-house collaterals, ad copy and campaign assets to ensure accuracy, tonality and brand alignment.

Lead assigned awards submissions, canvassing of votes or nominations, and post-award amplification with relevant stakeholders.

Identify partnership opportunities with lifestyle, luxury, F&B, wellness, cultural and corporate brands to create differentiated guest experiences.

LIFESTYLE, PUBLIC RELATIONS & PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT

Lead or support lifestyle and Public Relations -driven portfolios such as selected F&B venues, spa, wellness, partnerships, IP-led collaborations, festive campaigns and hotel stories.

Manage media, blogger, content creator and influencer hosting to drive positive coverage and beneficial commercial outcomes.

Coordinate media familiarisation stays, F&B tastings, chef interviews, partner activations and hosted experiences in line with approved strategy and budgets.

Support restaurant and bar positioning by developing story angles around culinary concepts, chefs, menus, events, awards and collaborations.

Maintain active awareness of hospitality, lifestyle, dining, wellness and media trends to identify relevant opportunities.

CAMPAIGN & EVENT MANAGEMENT

Conceptualise, plan and execute integrated communications campaigns with the Director, internal team, Public relations agencies, digital partners and business unit stakeholders.

Support marketing and promotion of hotel-led events, ensuring strong attendance, media relevance, guest experience and post-event reporting.

Prepare campaign briefs, timelines, content requirements, photography or videography briefs, creative references and partner deliverables.

Coordinate cross-channel launches across website, social media, email, in-house displays, press outreach, partner platforms and advertising placements.

Monitor campaign performance and prepare updates with recommendations for optimisation.

MARKET RESEARCH & ANALYSIS

Conduct market research to identify consumer preferences, competitor activity, hospitality trends and relevant lifestyle or dining developments.

Analyse public relations , campaign, media monitoring, social and stakeholder feedback to develop informed recommendations that support business goals.

Review competitive communications to identify opportunities for differentiation and stronger positioning.

PARTNER, AGENCY & VENDOR ENGAGEMENT

Manage day-to-day agency, partner and vendor coordination for assigned projects, ensuring clear scopes, timelines, deliverables and approvals.

Host partners and industry contacts for ongoing engagement and potential collaborations.

Support negotiation of value-added partner arrangements that enhance brand relevance, reduce costs or improve guest experiences.

BUDGETING & ADMINISTRATION

Manage campaign and assigned business unit budgets and forecast.

Monitor campaign-level budgets, quotations and supplier costs for assigned projects, ensuring forecast accuracy and procurement compliance.

Support annual budget planning by gathering scopes, historical costs and proposed activity requirements.

Work with the Coordinator to ensure agreements, purchase requests, invoices and accruals are submitted accurately and on time.

OTHERS

Comply with hotel and department policies and procedures at all times.

Assist with Sales & Marketing projects and carry out other duties as assigned by Management.

Qualifications

Degree or Diploma in Hospitality, Tourism, Marketing, Communications, Public Relations or a related discipline.

 Minimum 3 to 6 years of marketing communications or public relations experience, preferably within hospitality, travel, lifestyle, luxury, F&B or agency environments.

Leadership – experience in leading and managing teams

Excellent spoken and written English. Fluency in a second language is preferred.

AI-enabled marketer, proficient in Claude, ChatGPT, relevant tools for content creation, presentations, project management

Strong knowledge of marketing communications (Branding, Public Relations , Events, Advertising), hospitality trends, media//KOL connections locally/regionally

Excellent writing, editing, media pitching and content planning skills.

Strong stakeholder management with the ability to work across multiple business units and senior stakeholders.

Ability to brief agencies, designers, photographers and vendors with clear objectives and timelines.

Strong analytical skills with comfort using media monitoring, influencer analysis and campaign performance data.

Creative, proactive and commercially minded, with a passion for hospitality and guest experiences.

Collaborative, adaptable and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

description:

We are looking for a proactive and results-driven *Social Commerce Executive* to grow our TikTok Shop and Shopee social commerce channels through *affiliate partnerships*, *creator collaborations*, and *livestream operations*.

This is a hands-on role where you'll *recruit and manage affiliates*, *coordinate livestream hosts*, *optimise campaign performance*, and *analyse sales data *to drive growth. Working closely with the founder, you'll have the opportunity to shape strategies that directly impact revenue.

*Key ResponsibilitiesAffiliate & Creator Management*

* Recruit 30–50 affiliates and KOCs each month through TikTok Shop and Shopee Affiliate programmes.
* Manage the end-to-end affiliate lifecycle, including prospecting, outreach, sample seeding, follow-ups, onboarding, and relationship management.
* Negotiate commission structures and collaboration opportunities with high-performing creators.
* Manage TikTok Shop Affiliate Center and Shopee Affiliate backend, including campaign setup, sample requests, and payout tracking.
* Build and maintain an affiliate CRM to track creator performance, GMV, engagement, and communications.

*Livestream Operations*

*Performance & Analytics*

* Analyse affiliate, creator, and livestream performance to identify opportunities for growth.
* Benchmark competitors using tools such as Kalodata, FastMoss, and TikTok Shop Analytics.

* Direct exposure to the founders with fast decision-making and minimal bureaucracy.

title: TikTok Performance Marketing Manage
description:
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on TikTok Performance Marketing Manager who specialises in selling physical consumer products through TikTok Shop.

Your primary responsibility is to generate profitable sales through TikTok advertising, particularly TikTok Shop GMV Max campaigns.

We are not looking for a traditional social media manager who focuses on followers, engagement or brand awareness. We want someone who understands how to convert advertising expenditure into revenue, identify winning video advertisements and scale campaigns profitably.

You will work closely with our in-house video production, influencer, affiliate and e-commerce teams to grow our skincare products in Singapore and Malaysia.

Key Responsibilities

1. TikTok Ads & GMV Max Management

- Independently set up, launch, monitor and optimise TikTok Shop GMV Max campaigns.

- Manage Product GMV Max campaigns and, where applicable, LIVE GMV Max campaigns.

- Set appropriate ROI targets, campaign budgets and product selections.

- Monitor advertising expenditure, GMV, ROI and cost per order daily.

- Identify underperforming campaigns and implement corrective actions.

- Optimise advertising expenditure according to product margins and profitability.

- Troubleshoot issues involving campaign delivery, insufficient spending, poor conversion rates and declining advertising returns.

- Manage campaigns across Singapore and Malaysia, accounting for differences in consumer behaviour and pricing.

2. Advertising Performance & Profitability

- Take direct responsibility for achieving assigned online sales and advertising profitability targets.

- Calculate product-level break-even ROAS based on selling price, cost of goods, platform fees, affiliate commissions and other variable costs.

- Identify which products generate the highest advertising returns.

- Recommend suitable promotional prices, product bundles and offers to improve conversion rates.

- Monitor customer acquisition costs and contribution margin after advertising.

- Distinguish between sales attributed to advertising and actual incremental sales growth.

- Scale successful campaigns without compromising profitability.

3. Video Advertising & Creative Optimisation

- Work directly with the internal video production team to identify and develop high-converting TikTok advertisements.

- Analyse individual video performance to determine which creatives generate sales.

- Develop creative briefs covering product pain points, selling propositions, hooks, demonstrations and calls to action.

- Recommend new video concepts based on advertising performance data.

- Test different video openings, product demonstrations, offers and messaging.

- Identify creative fatigue and recommend replacement advertisements before campaign performance deteriorates.

- Work with the influencer and affiliate teams to identify high-performing creator content suitable for paid advertising.

- Ensure a consistent pipeline of new advertising creatives for testing.

4. Campaign Testing & Scaling

- Develop structured testing plans for new products, advertisements and promotional offers.

- Establish clear criteria for identifying winning and losing creatives.

- Allocate initial test budgets and determine when campaigns should be scaled, maintained or stopped.

- Conduct controlled testing where feasible to distinguish creative performance from pricing, audience and promotional effects.

- Expand successful advertising strategies across additional products.

- Identify opportunities to increase sales during major TikTok Shop campaigns and promotional periods.

- Manage advertising budgets efficiently during both regular sales periods and major shopping events.

5. Reporting & Performance Analysis

- Maintain accurate daily tracking of advertising expenditure, attributed GMV, ROAS and cost per order.

- Produce weekly reports showing performance by product, campaign and advertising creative.

- Compare actual performance against assigned revenue and profitability targets.

- Identify the three strongest and three weakest advertising creatives each week, explaining their results.

- Provide actionable recommendations for increasing sales and improving advertising returns.

- Coordinate with the e-commerce team to reconcile advertising-attributed sales against actual orders, refunds and net revenue.

- Present clear recommendations for budget allocation and campaign improvements.

Job Requirement:

TikTok Advertising Experience

- Minimum 3 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, including substantial direct experience managing TikTok advertising campaign.

- Demonstrable experience managing TikTok Shop GMV Max campaigns.

- Must have personally managed advertising campaigns rather than solely overseeing external agencies.

- Experience advertising physical consumer products through TikTok Shop.

- Strong understanding of TikTok Shop's advertising ecosystem, campaign optimisation and performance measurement.

Commercial & Analytical Skills

- Proven ability to generate measurable e-commerce revenue through paid advertisements.

- Strong understanding of ROAS, ROI, CPA, CAC, GMV and advertising contribution margin.

- Ability to calculate campaign profitability after product costs, platform charges and affiliate commissions.

- Experience scaling daily advertising budgets while maintaining commercially acceptable returns.

- Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets for advertising performance analysis.

Creative Advertising Skills

- Strong understanding of TikTok video advertisements that drive purchases.

- Ability to identify effective hooks, product demonstrations and sales messaging.

- Experience testing UGC, creator-led advertisements and direct-response advertising creatives.

- Ability to translate campaign performance data into actionable instructions for video creators.

Preferred Experience

- Previous experience marketing skincare, cosmetics, personal care or FMCG products.

- Experience managing TikTok Shop advertising in Singapore and Malaysia.

- Experience working with affiliate creators and content authorisation for paid campaigns.

- Familiarity with Shopee Ads and Meta Ads.

- Experience in promoting products with relatively low selling prices, where advertising efficiency and margins are critical.

Company Description

The ASPAC Legal Department of LVMH’s Beauty Division is looking to hire a Legal Counsel (7- PQE) to be based in Singapore. If you are a diligent, capable and articulate common-law and private practice-trained lawyer with strong legal fundamentals, intellectual curiosity and exceptional drafting skills, looking for a role where law, data, business and luxury gracefully intertwine, this opportunity is for you – your lawyering prowess, diplomacy and keen eye for detail will directly contribute to the smooth functioning of a fast-paced and dynamic Legal Department in the ASPAC region.

This is an incredible opportunity to work with our iconic houses in the Beauty Division: Parfums Christian Dior, Guerlain, Givenchy, Benefit Cosmetics, Make Up For Ever, Fresh, Acqua di Parma, Maison Francis Kurkdjian, Kendo Brands and Kenzo Parfums.

Job Description

Provide day-to-day legal advice and support to the LVMH Beauty portfolio in both its local market and travel retail businesses and across all operational verticals, including real estate/ leasing, retail, digital, supply chain, marketing and visual merchandising, for the following brands: Parfums Christian Dior, Guerlain, Givenchy, Benefit Cosmetics, Make Up For Ever, Fresh, Acqua di Parma, Maison Francis Kurkdjian, Kendo Brands, Fenty and Kenzo Parfums.
Draft, review and advise on a broad range of commercial, corporate, real estate and regulatory matters relevant to the Beauty Division, including agency, retail, e-commerce, marketing, influencer and talent engagement, events, licensing, supply chain, warehousing, logistics, procurement, services, confidentiality, and other business partnership arrangements.
Spearhead and support data privacy, data governance and legal compliance projects and workstreams, including advising on personal data protection laws, marketing consent frameworks, customer data use, cross-border transfers, vendor compliance and the implementation of internal privacy policies and processes.
Track and interpret developments in ASPAC’s data protection laws and regulatory frameworks, reviewing new legislation to assess its practical implications for the Beauty Division’s operations; provide compliance support in advising Maison stakeholders on data privacy compliance matters arising from the division’s business activities, identifying and recommending best practices where relevant.
Support the conduct of regular privacy and consumer law risk assessments, coordinate data audits, and help maintain accurate and compliant privacy documentation and records.
Assist in managing privacy-related user complaints and data breach incidents, supporting timely investigation, escalation, and resolution in line with regulatory requirements.
Partner with regional and global legal colleagues to develop, roll out and embed legal best practices and legal risk management initiatives across the Beauty Division.
Prepare and update contract templates to maintain an up-to-date repository of contracts for key stakeholders, and provide regular training to stakeholders across the business, including training on the use of contract templates and key legal issues relevant to their roles within the business.
Support legal, privacy and special projects as tasked by the Beauty Division – Regional Legal Director (General Counsel) from time to time.

Qualifications

Holder of a valid legal practitioner qualification in a developed Common Law jurisdiction, preferably Singapore.
7+ years of post-qualification experience in a reputable law firm – our preference is to hire candidates currently working in private practice.
Demonstrated substantial hands-on experience in drafting and reviewing a broad range of commercial, licensing, eCommerce and marketing terms & conditions, as well as preparing articulated legal advice & memoranda. (Strong drafting and communication skills are fundamental requirements for the role and will be assessed as part of the recruitment process through a written test.)
Experience dealing with privacy, data protection and cybersecurity matters arising in the context of general corporate and commercial transactions. Whilst we are not seeking a specialist data privacy counsel - candidates should however be comfortable in reviewing regulations, identifying and addressing mandatory requirements, spotting issues, and undertaking data/ risk mapping exercises as part of the assigned broader commercial legal work.
Demonstrated experience in coordinating and managing legal projects on selected marketing, advertising and eCommerce projects, including working cross-functionally and driving matters through implementation.
Ability to work independently – once the successful candidate is assimilated into the role, he/she will not be under daily supervision for BAU (‘business as usual’) matters.
Highly agile with the ability to adapt quickly to changing circumstances and continuously recalibrate priorities in response to evolving business, legal and organizational needs.
Excellent command of the English language is essential. Proficiency in Mandarin and Bahasa Indonesia/Malay would be an advantage, as the role involves liaising with stakeholders across our Southeast Asia and Greater China operations.
Warm, yet polished, firm and well-spoken, with outstanding interpersonal skills and a proven ability to communicate effectively and diplomatically across diverse cultures and seniority levels.

title: Asia Business Development Associate
description:
*The role of Asia Business Development Associate*

GLAS is an international provider of institutional debt administration services, serving lenders, borrowers, issuers, and advisers offering a global platform across Loan Agency and related services, Capital Markets and Restructuring.

GLAS’ vision is to be recognised as the best-in-class independent, non-creditor, conflict-free provider of institutional debt administration services, enabling global clients and counterparties to achieve successful outcomes on their transactions.

The business currently comprises c.500 employees who deliver a solution-based, innovative service, ensuring GLAS is the preferred global partner of choice. GLAS has a blue-chip customer base developed over many years; select clients include Apollo, Blackstone, CVC, Deutsche Bank and Goldman Sachs. GLAS has been recognised as the premier independent provider of loan agency and bond trustee services with a portfolio of over $800 billion assets across its global platform. The company is headquartered in London with offices in Paris, Frankfurt, Madrid, New York, New Jersey, Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong, Milan and Rome.

We are seeking a commercially focused Asia Business Development Associate to support the growth of GLAS across Singapore, Hong Kong and wider Asian markets. This is a mid-level sales role focused on originating and converting new business across GLAS’ specialist and core product offering.

Working closely with the Head of Business Development, Asia, and broader APAC Sales team, the successful candidate will build market coverage, develop high-quality opportunities and strengthen relationships with priority clients and intermediaries. The role will contribute across GLAS’ debt administration services (including Loan Agency, Capital Markets and Restructuring, Escrow and Custody products) as well as Investment + Private Capital infrastructure services, fund accounting and entity management services.

The position requires a proactive business development professional with financial services experience, strong relationship-building skills and the ability to manage opportunities from initial engagement through proposal, mandate award and handover to delivery teams.

*Key Responsibilities*

*New Business Growth and Origination*

* Identify, develop and convert new business opportunities across Singapore and wider Asian markets.
* Support the execution of the Asia business development plan in alignment with APAC and global growth priorities.
* Build and maintain a disciplined pipeline across GLAS’ service offerings.
* Undertake targeted prospecting and market outreach across agreed client segments and service lines.
* Support client meetings, pitches, presentations, RFP responses, fee proposals and commercial discussions.
* Maintain momentum across opportunities from initial engagement through mandate award and successful handover.
* Identify cross-selling opportunities across existing relationships and introduce relevant GLAS services.

*Market Coverage and Relationship Development*

* Build and maintain relationships with banks, private credit funds, financial sponsors, law firms, borrowers, issuers, advisers, fund managers, family offices and other relevant market participants.
* Develop relationship maps and account plans for priority prospects, clients and market influencers.
* Represent GLAS at client meetings, industry conferences, networking events and market forums, as appropriate.
* Increase awareness of GLAS’ independent, conflict-free service proposition across target markets.
* Support the Head of Business Development, Asia in deepening senior relationships and expanding GLAS’ market presence.
* Product coverage across debt administration services (including Loan Agency, Capital Markets and Restructuring, Escrow and Custody products), Investment and Private Capital infrastructure services, fund accounting and entity management services
* Develop a working knowledge of GLAS’ core products across Loan Agency, Capital Markets and Restructuring services.
* Develop and promote GLAS’ specialist offering for funds, fund managers, family offices, investment trusts, corporate services and other relevant client groups.
* Work with product and operational specialists to understand client needs, shape solutions and communicate GLAS’ value proposition clearly.
* Identify opportunities to connect specialist and core capabilities into coordinated client solutions.
* Keep current on product developments, service capabilities and relevant transaction experience across GLAS’ global platform.

*Pipeline, CRM and Commercial Management*

* Maintain accurate and timely prospect, activity, opportunity and deal information within CRM systems.
* Prepare pipeline updates, forecasts and business development reporting for the Head of Business Development, Asia.
* Track agreed activity, progression, conversion and revenue measures and highlight risks or gaps early.
* Support opportunity qualification, pricing, proposal development and sales governance processes.
* Use sales data, client feedback and market intelligence to prioritise activity and improve conversion.

*Market Intelligence*

* Monitor market activity, competitor developments, regulatory trends and emerging client needs across Asia.
* Research priority sectors, client segments and market participants to support targeted origination.
* Share relevant market intelligence and commercial insights with Asia, APAC and global colleagues.
* Use market insights to identify new product, sector and geographical opportunities for growth.

*Cross-Functional Collaboration*

* Work closely with Client Relationship Management, Transaction Management, Operations, Product and Marketing teams to deliver a coordinated client experience.
* Partner with the APAC Business Development Lead and regional BD colleagues to support cross-border opportunities and consistent market coverage.
* Coordinate the successful handover and onboarding of new mandates to operational teams.
* Collaborate with global colleagues to pursue international opportunities and deliver consistent pitches and proposals across jurisdictions.
* Support marketing initiatives, thought leadership and campaigns relevant to the Australian market.

*Experience & Qualifications*

* Relevant business development, sales, relationship management or origination experience within financial services, professional services or a related commercial environment.
* Demonstrated experience developing prospects, supporting pitches and progressing opportunities through a sales pipeline.
* An understanding of syndicated loans, private credit, debt capital markets, restructuring, trustee services, funds or related financial products is preferred.
* Experience engaging with banks, funds, financial sponsors, law firms, advisers, borrowers, issuers or institutional clients.
* Strong presentation, written communication and interpersonal skills, with confidence engaging senior stakeholders.
* Experience using CRM systems and maintaining accurate commercial data and reporting.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Law or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Fluency in English is required; additional Asian language capability is advantageous.

*Skills & Competencies*

* Commercially minded and growth-oriented, with a strong interest in new business generation.
* Proactive and confident in prospecting, networking and building new relationships.
* Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
* Able to understand client needs and communicate complex services in a clear, compelling way.
* Disciplined in pipeline management, follow-up, CRM administration and reporting.
* Highly organised, self-motivated and able to manage multiple priorities.
* Collaborative and able to work effectively across regional and global teams.
* Adaptable and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, growing international organisation.
* Professional, credible and able to represent GLAS to a high standard.

Success Measures

* Growth in new business revenue and mandates across Asia.
* A strong, qualified pipeline aligned to agreed target markets, client segments and service lines.
* Achievement of agreed activity, conversion and revenue targets.
* Expansion of GLAS’ Asia market coverage, prospect relationships and brand presence.
* Accuracy of pipeline data, forecasting and management reporting.
* Successful execution of pitches, proposals and commercial negotiations.
* Effective onboarding and handover of new mandates.
* Strong collaboration with APAC and global commercial and operational teams

*Benefits*

* Competitive base salary plus discretionary annual bonus
* Paid annual leave plus Singapore public holidays
* Long service award
* Career development and study support available
* Private medical insurance

title: Creative Production Manager

This role is ideal for someone from a production house, creative agency, media company, or social media agency who is passionate about creating engaging short-form content.
