title: TikTok Performance Marketing Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on TikTok Performance Marketing Manager who specialises in selling physical consumer products through TikTok Shop.

Your primary responsibility is to generate profitable sales through TikTok advertising, particularly TikTok Shop GMV Max campaigns.

We are not looking for a traditional social media manager who focuses on followers, engagement or brand awareness. We want someone who understands how to convert advertising expenditure into revenue, identify winning video advertisements and scale campaigns profitably.

You will work closely with our in-house video production, influencer, affiliate and e-commerce teams to grow our skincare products in Singapore and Malaysia.

Key Responsibilities

1. TikTok Ads & GMV Max Management

- Independently set up, launch, monitor and optimise TikTok Shop GMV Max campaigns.

- Manage Product GMV Max campaigns and, where applicable, LIVE GMV Max campaigns.

- Set appropriate ROI targets, campaign budgets and product selections.

- Monitor advertising expenditure, GMV, ROI and cost per order daily.

- Identify underperforming campaigns and implement corrective actions.

- Optimise advertising expenditure according to product margins and profitability.

- Troubleshoot issues involving campaign delivery, insufficient spending, poor conversion rates and declining advertising returns.

- Manage campaigns across Singapore and Malaysia, accounting for differences in consumer behaviour and pricing.

2. Advertising Performance & Profitability

- Take direct responsibility for achieving assigned online sales and advertising profitability targets.

- Calculate product-level break-even ROAS based on selling price, cost of goods, platform fees, affiliate commissions and other variable costs.

- Identify which products generate the highest advertising returns.

- Recommend suitable promotional prices, product bundles and offers to improve conversion rates.

- Monitor customer acquisition costs and contribution margin after advertising.

- Distinguish between sales attributed to advertising and actual incremental sales growth.

- Scale successful campaigns without compromising profitability.

3. Video Advertising & Creative Optimisation

- Work directly with the internal video production team to identify and develop high-converting TikTok advertisements.

- Analyse individual video performance to determine which creatives generate sales.

- Develop creative briefs covering product pain points, selling propositions, hooks, demonstrations and calls to action.

- Recommend new video concepts based on advertising performance data.

- Test different video openings, product demonstrations, offers and messaging.

- Identify creative fatigue and recommend replacement advertisements before campaign performance deteriorates.

- Work with the influencer and affiliate teams to identify high-performing creator content suitable for paid advertising.

- Ensure a consistent pipeline of new advertising creatives for testing.

4. Campaign Testing & Scaling

- Develop structured testing plans for new products, advertisements and promotional offers.

- Establish clear criteria for identifying winning and losing creatives.

- Allocate initial test budgets and determine when campaigns should be scaled, maintained or stopped.

- Conduct controlled testing where feasible to distinguish creative performance from pricing, audience and promotional effects.

- Expand successful advertising strategies across additional products.

- Identify opportunities to increase sales during major TikTok Shop campaigns and promotional periods.

- Manage advertising budgets efficiently during both regular sales periods and major shopping events.

5. Reporting & Performance Analysis

- Maintain accurate daily tracking of advertising expenditure, attributed GMV, ROAS and cost per order.

- Produce weekly reports showing performance by product, campaign and advertising creative.

- Compare actual performance against assigned revenue and profitability targets.

- Identify the three strongest and three weakest advertising creatives each week, explaining their results.

- Provide actionable recommendations for increasing sales and improving advertising returns.

- Coordinate with the e-commerce team to reconcile advertising-attributed sales against actual orders, refunds and net revenue.

- Present clear recommendations for budget allocation and campaign improvements.

Job Requirement:

TikTok Advertising Experience

- Minimum 3 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, including substantial direct experience managing TikTok advertising campaign.

- Demonstrable experience managing TikTok Shop GMV Max campaigns.

- Must have personally managed advertising campaigns rather than solely overseeing external agencies.

- Experience advertising physical consumer products through TikTok Shop.

- Strong understanding of TikTok Shop's advertising ecosystem, campaign optimisation and performance measurement.

Commercial & Analytical Skills

- Proven ability to generate measurable e-commerce revenue through paid advertisements.

- Strong understanding of ROAS, ROI, CPA, CAC, GMV and advertising contribution margin.

- Ability to calculate campaign profitability after product costs, platform charges and affiliate commissions.

- Experience scaling daily advertising budgets while maintaining commercially acceptable returns.

- Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets for advertising performance analysis.

Creative Advertising Skills

- Strong understanding of TikTok video advertisements that drive purchases.

- Ability to identify effective hooks, product demonstrations and sales messaging.

- Experience testing UGC, creator-led advertisements and direct-response advertising creatives.

- Ability to translate campaign performance data into actionable instructions for video creators.

Preferred Experience

- Previous experience marketing skincare, cosmetics, personal care or FMCG products.

- Experience managing TikTok Shop advertising in Singapore and Malaysia.

- Experience working with affiliate creators and content authorisation for paid campaigns.

- Familiarity with Shopee Ads and Meta Ads.

- Experience in promoting products with relatively low selling prices, where advertising efficiency and margins are critical.

Overview:

We are looking for an experienced Account Director - Senior Account Director who can act as a senior communications specialist and strategic client lead across a portfolio of high-profile corporate and consumer brands. The role will lead accounts such as Science Centre Singapore, TWG Tea and PropertyGuru, with responsibility for communications strategy, senior client counsel, earned media and reputation, integrated campaign development, team leadership and account growth.

The successful candidate must bring deep PR and communications expertise and be able to independently shape narratives, distil and unpack briefs, identify reputational and earned opportunities, counsel senior clients and spokespeople, and lead teams to deliver communications programmes that create meaningful public and media impact. At Senior Account Director level, the role will also be expected to operate as part of the agency’s senior leadership bench, with broader responsibility for people development, business growth and the quality of the agency’s communications thinking.

Responsibilities:

Strategic client counsel & account leadership

Lead senior client relationships and act as a trusted point of counsel on communications strategy, reputation, positioning and campaign direction.
Critically analyse briefs and business challenges, identify the real communications problem to solve, and recommend the right approach rather than simply executing a prescribed scope.
Lead strategic planning across assigned accounts, ensuring programmes have clear objectives, audiences, narratives, KPIs and a strong earned rationale.
Anticipate client needs, issues and opportunities, and proactively course-correct accounts where required.
Orchestrate account teams end-to-end, setting priorities, maintaining momentum and ensuring clients receive consistently senior, high-quality counsel.
PR strategy, earned media & reputation
Own the earned communications strategy across accounts, including corporate profiling, consumer storytelling, thought leadership, media engagement and issues preparedness.
Bring strong news judgement and a sophisticated understanding of the Singapore media environment, including how different newsrooms, verticals and stakeholders assess relevance and credibility.
Develop strong media narratives and story architecture that connect client business priorities with wider cultural, consumer, industry or societal conversations.
Build and leverage senior relationships with editors, journalists, creators, influencers and other relevant opinion-formers and stakeholders.
Provide senior counsel on reactive communications, sensitive issues and reputational considerations, including when to engage, how to position and when not to pursue publicity.
Lead senior spokesperson preparation for interviews, announcements and high-stakes external engagements.

Content, messaging & integrated communications

Counsel teams and clients on communications strategy, messaging and narrative development across corporate and consumer audiences.
Guide the development of high-quality communications materials including strategic plans, key messages, press materials, speeches, briefing documents, thought-leadership content and executive communications.
Provide senior editorial judgement and ensure work is persuasive, audience-led and strategically sharp, not simply factually correct.
Partner with Creative, Social, Influence and other specialist teams to develop integrated ideas with a strong communications backbone and clear potential to earn attention.
Ensure channel choices support the communications objective, bringing together earned, owned, social, creator and paid activity where appropriate rather than defaulting to a single discipline.

Stakeholder, campaign & event leadership

Lead the agency approach to stakeholder engagement across media, influencers, partners, industry bodies, communities and other relevant audiences.
Oversee major launches, media programmes, experiential activations, briefings and events, ensuring the communications story is clear and the experience delivers against strategic objectives.
Represent clients and the agency confidently in senior stakeholder engagements, meetings, interviews and external forums.
Think ahead on potential risks, sensitivities and opportunities, and ensure teams are prepared to troubleshoot effectively.

Team leadership & capability building

Lead, coach and develop Account Managers, Executives and junior team members through both formal and day-to-day guidance.
Set the strategic and quality bar for teams, helping them move beyond task delivery into stronger judgement, counsel and communications thinking.
Resource accounts effectively, bringing in the right specialists and senior support when needed while maintaining commercial discipline.
Create confident, motivated teams and provide clear direction during complex or high-pressure periods.
Contribute to the agency’s communications capability through training, mentoring, best-practice development and active championing of agency culture and standards.
Commercial leadership, account growth & new business
Own the commercial health of assigned accounts, including scope, resourcing, budget management, profitability and contract considerations.
Identify and convert opportunities to deepen existing client relationships and grow accounts organically through relevant communications counsel and new initiatives.
Lead or play a senior role in new business development, from strategic response and proposition development through pitch narrative and presentation.
Build strong chemistry with prospective clients and bring a clear senior point of view that demonstrates the agency’s communications expertise.
At Senior Account Director level, contribute to broader agency growth priorities, capability development and senior management discussions.
Qualifications:
Approximately 10+ years of relevant PR and communications experience, ideally within an agency environment, with a proven track record leading significant client relationships and teams.
Essential: deep, hands-on PR and earned communications expertise. Candidates must have personally led communications strategy, media narratives, senior media engagement and client counsel — not only managed integrated campaign delivery.
Strong strategic judgement and the ability to connect business objectives, audience insight, reputation and earned opportunity into a clear communications recommendation.
Established understanding of the Singapore media and stakeholder landscape, with credible senior media relationships and the confidence to advise clients on what will and will not earn attention.
Excellent writing, messaging and editorial judgement, with the ability to simplify complex information and sharpen the work of others.
Confidence counselling senior clients and spokespeople, including challenging assumptions constructively and navigating sensitive or ambiguous communications situations.
Proven ability to lead multiple accounts and teams, manage resourcing and commercial considerations, and maintain quality across a demanding portfolio.
Experience across corporate and consumer communications is strongly preferred. Exposure to public-sector/institutional, luxury/lifestyle, property/technology or similarly complex categories would be advantageous.
For Senior Account Director candidates: demonstrated ability to operate beyond individual accounts by mentoring senior team members, driving growth areas and contributing to agency-wide leadership and capability building.

Negotiate and evaluate commercial opportunities together with relevant internal teams.

Conversion Rate

Customer Acquisition Cost

Marketing ROI

Repeat Customer Rate

Inventory Turnover

Markdown Rate

New Store Performance

Experience managing P&L and business performance.

Strong understanding of merchandising, marketing and retail operations.

Demonstrated track record of growing sales and improving profitability.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent understanding of Singapore’s retail and consumer market.

Strong leadership and people-management skills.

Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

is a modern fashion footwear brand that combines

style, comfort and sustainability

to create versatile footwear for the modern consumer.

.

Build and nurture relationships with influencers, content creators and influencer agencies to amplify brand narratives and extend reach.
Support social media listening and community management across IKEA Singapore's owned channels.

At least 3-4 years of experience managing, producing & publishing content across social channels.

Elmwood is proud of its long track record at the DBA Design Effectiveness Awards, the longest-running awards for design that delivers measurable business results.

Requirements
02 Why this role matters.

The Senior Account Executive sits between the Account Executive and Account Manager levels — and it is one of the most important developmental roles in the client services team. You will step up to own day-to-day client relationships on key workstreams, manage projects end to end, coordinate internal and external teams, and ensure work is delivered on brief, on time and on budget. You will be a trusted partner to clients and an organised, proactive driver of project excellence within the studio.

03 What you will be doing.

People & Team accountabilities:

Begin to coach and support more junior team members, sharing your knowledge and applying developing coaching techniques to help them grow.
Contribute actively to knowledge-sharing initiatives and encourage team interaction — helping to build a collaborative, high-energy team environment.
Begin to understand and connect your work to the wider agency strategy and business goals, and help your team do the same.
Assist in managing small-scale project or team changes, helping to maintain momentum and morale when things shift.

Work/offer accountabilities:

Manage day-to-day delivery of assigned client projects, from brief through to final implementation, ensuring timelines, budgets and quality standards are met.
Support in writing and refining clear, actionable creative, design execution and production briefs for internal teams and suppliers.
Coordinate closely with design, strategy and provocation teams to ensure creative work aligns with client objectives and brand strategy.
Prepare proposals, cost estimates, project timelines, contact reports and maintain up-to-date project documentation and folders.
Liaise with third-party suppliers and production partners to manage implementation phases and ensure delivery excellence.
Begin to manage resources more effectively — tracking your own time, supporting workflow management and contributing to team capacity planning.

Client accountabilities:

Handle day-to-day client communications, proactively managing expectations, sharing status updates and ensuring a consistently high standard of service.
Play a more active and independent role in maintaining and nurturing client relationships, taking ownership of your assigned workstreams with growing confidence.
Identify and suggest new areas for client development — recognising opportunities for additional briefs and up-selling relevant services.
Assist in preparing proposals, credentials and pitch materials, beginning to take active management of smaller pitch responses.
Develop a more detailed understanding of specific client industry segments — leading in gathering and analysing client and competitor data.

Business accountabilities

Monitor project financials, including tracking hours, costs and billing information, flagging risks early and supporting revenue and profitability targets.
Assist in managing parts of the client revenue pipeline and support accurate forecasting and reporting.
Support new business efforts with research, credentials collation, case study preparation and pitch support when required.
Identify and begin to act on growth opportunities within your client accounts, flagging potential new projects or service extensions to your senior team.
Participate in negotiation processes as an active contributor, building your commercial awareness and confidence in client conversations.
Develop your industry knowledge — researching trends and consumer behaviours and sharing findings with the broader team.
Contribute to award submissions, case study development and agency reputation initiatives.

04 What you know and bring.

The knowledge you'll need:

3–4 years of account management experience in a branding, packaging, design or marketing agency, with exposure to FMCG or consumer brands preferred.
Experience working with packaging design across 2D graphics; 3D structural design experience is strongly preferred.
Growing understanding of brand and design processes, from briefing through to creative development, production and delivery.
Strong commercial awareness, with experience working to budgets, timelines and financial targets.
A background in Business, Marketing, Communications or a related field is preferred.
Experience in project management, collaboration and file-sharing tools such as ClickUp, Pitch, LucidLink or similar. platforms.
AI fluency: confident using AI tools day to day to work smarter across briefing, planning, reporting and client communication. You're curious about how AI is changing agency workflows and keen to bring new ideas to the team.

The skills that'll set you apart

Clear, concise communicator with excellent written, verbal and presentation skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects, coordinating cross-functional teams efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Highly organised, detail-oriented and rigorous, with strong time management skills and a proactive, solution-focused mindset.
Confident working directly with clients, building trust and contributing to strategic conversations with senior team support.
Developing storytelling skills — able to enhance project presentations and communicate ideas with growing clarity and impact.
A strong eagerness to listen, learn and grow within a dynamic, sometimes unstructured environment.
A genuine passion for creativity, innovation and delivering outstanding work, with a growing appreciation for what makes a brand truly great.
High sense of responsibility and commitment — you take pride in the quality and accuracy of everything you deliver.

Benefits

05 What we offer.

The work

The opportunity to learn your craft on real, high-impact brand and design projects for some of the world's most exciting companies — from day one.

The people & culture

A fun studio environment working alongside great and talented individuals, with a collaborative, down-to-earth culture where craft, curiosity and generosity are valued.

Annual festivities and various social events throughout the year that bring the team together.

Growth & development

Access to learning, feedback and stretch opportunities across studios and disciplines, with support to shape a career that works for you.

title: Executive Director, Technology Sales Advisory

About the Tech Advisory & Sales Team

Tech Advisory & Sales team supports both JLL Technologies (JLLT) and Work Dynamics (WD) to serve the needs of our enterprise occupier clients driving their sustainability, technology and real estate agendas through the use of technology. By combining innovative JLLT technologies with WD’s world-renowned expertise, we’re able to unveil untapped opportunities to shape the future of real estate for a better world.

Our best-of-breed portfolio is designed to meet and exceed the industry’s demands for better business intelligence, workplace experience, and smart building platforms. JLL Technologies helps organizations transform the way they acquire, operate, manage, and experience space.

Role Purpose
The Executive Director of Tech Advisory is accountable for all elements of Technology for the assigned Sub-Division, including priorities for the vertical division to differentiate, client NPS & delivery escalations, and market penetration strategy. The Executive Director of Tech Advisory acts as overall technology advisor lead for the Sub-Division and aligned accounts to define technology-enabled growth and operating efficiency priorities. In this capacity they own and communicate the technology strategy for the vertical in close collaboration with broader JLL Technology strategy. This includes ensuring Technology delivery meets client expectations of JLL’s contracts. The Executive Director of Tech Advisory is directly responsible for the go to market strategy and execution across the Sub-Division for the portfolio of JLL technology products.

The role requires well versed expertise across many domains of real estate and facilities culminating in the bringing together of multiple software product and services solutions to solve complex challenges. The role requires strategic problem-solving ability and established credibility in the Commercial Real Estate community that instills confidence and trust.

Key responsibilities include:
Technology Advisory
· Accountable for all elements of Technology for the Sub-Division.
· Serve as the lead technology advisor for the Sub-Division and aligned accounts.
· Define priorities for Account Tech Advisors aligned to accounts in Sub-Division for NPS Improvements, Internal Education, Growth and Innovation.
· Participate in account team and client meetings to drive awareness and adoption of JLL’s technology strategy, platforms, and products.
· Establish and monitor technology priorities that enhance the Sub-Division's competitive advantage, communicate VOC to Product teams.
· Support SD Sales team with strategic tech guidance for complex or major pursuits in the division ensuring alignment with account tech roadmaps.
· Partner with Technology Delivery Executive for the Sub-Division to align priorities, communicate technology initiatives as well as drive technology adoptions within the Accounts in the Sub-Division and resolve and oversee delivery escalations.
Technology Sales
· Develop and oversee comprehensive technology sales strategy for the Sub-Division.
· Provide account segmentation strategy of accounts in the Sub-Division.
· Provide input to Technology Sales Managers to align sellers to accounts and opportunities.
· Design market penetration strategies for technology products and services in assigned Sub-Division; works with BD, Marketing and Sales Managers to activate.
· Collaborate with Sales teams; removing barriers to sales with the WD accounts business, managing sales escalations and deconflicting sales motions.
· Participate in deal go-no go, deal strategy development for key clients/opportunities.

The Candidate Experience
10+ years of sales or sales solutioning experience at a large, global organization.

Experience across multiple disciplines of Corporate Real Estate services, technologies and/or solutions.

Proven capabilities in growing relationships at the senior executive level and C-Suite for global, Fortune 500.

Successful track record of achieving immediate credibility; presenting varying ideas to create value and challenge the status quo; and able to think quickly, listen well, and understand how to react and modify approach in front of clients and other key influencers.

Outstanding stakeholder management skills and ability to influence and motivate others on a team and help them succeed.

High attention to detail and very organized with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

An excellent communicator with strong written and verbal presentation skills.

Results driven, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth work environment.

Ability to supervise and manage multiple projects at the same time.

Capacity to conceptualize as well as operationalize commercial strategies.

Ability to efficiently interact with company senior leaders.

Superior organizational awareness.

Experienced at managing diverse and geographically remote teams.

Understands the market of CRE Technologies, Prop Tech, IWMS, Smart Buildings, IoT, Experience Technologies etc.

Experience with successful selling outcomes using structured sales processes and tools such as Miller Heiman and Salesforce.


Behavioral Competencies
Passion to Win – wakes up every day thinking about how to engage new clients and beat the competition.

Strategic mindset – able to see big picture and future direction of the business, then translate into achievable new business development opportunities.

Influential – persuasive yet instills confidence among stakeholders, gravitas to drive change and obtain results.

Connector – can bring together various constituents across the organization to help drive client solutions.

Thrives in Ambiguity - can navigate through a complex, multi-faceted organization with multiple stakeholders.

Obsessed with customer habits – can use data derived from those behaviors; and trends within the industry to drive share of wallet.


If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.

About JLL –

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Client Manager
description:

Requirements

02 Why this role matters.

The Account Manager is responsible for managing day-to-day client relationships and projects, translating client needs into clear briefs, and ensuring work is delivered on time, on budget and to an excellent standard, directly impacting client satisfaction, retention and account growth.

03 What you will be doing.

People & Team accountabilities:

Collaborate closely with Account Executives, aiding in their development while also managing smaller-scale projects or specific workstreams independently.
Encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing and feedback within project teams to build capability and improve how we work together.
Implement studio and network-wide strategies within your account teams, ensuring ways of working align with the one Elmwood vision and goals.
Manage team dynamics on your projects, holding people (including yourself) accountable for agreed actions, quality standards and timelines.

Work/offer accountabilities:

Oversee the daily delivery of client projects, making sure tasks are completed on time, meet requirements, and stay within budget.
Lead internal briefings, manage timelines, and coordinate estimates and contact reports, ensuring clarity for internal teams.
Work in partnership with cross-functional teams such as creative, strategy and production to monitor progress and manage deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.
Collaborate with creative and operations teams, as well as external partners, to ensure all work aligns with strategy and achieves the desired creative outcomes.
Track and evaluate project effectiveness with senior team members, helping to define success metrics and feeding learnings back into future work.
Advocate for internal systems, processes, and financial tools, ensuring we stick to budgets and timelines and support accurate reporting.
Document project insights and outcomes through post-project reviews (“washups”) to drive continuous improvement.

Client accountabilities:

Foster trust with client contacts through clear, professional communication, consistent follow-up, and well-managed expectations.
Act as a dependable point of contact for daily updates and issues on your accounts, with support from your senior team members where needed.
Assist in preparing for meetings, presentations and proposal writing, helping to shape compelling, on-brand responses.
Keep detailed records of client feedback, approvals and change requests to ensure alignment and avoid scope creep.
Manage key client relationships and day-to-day interactions, demonstrating a measurable impact on their business and identifying opportunities to grow and deepen the relationship.

Business accountabilities

Engage in weekly planning, resource and forecasting meetings to maintain transparency, accountability and visibility of pipeline and capacity.
Manage and meet specific business targets for your accounts in line with the studio business plan and Strategic Account Plans.
Build and manage the client revenue pipeline for your accounts, ensuring accurate forecasting, visibility and strong recoverability.
Support value-based pricing and project costing, using financial tools and data to manage scope, protect margins and escalate risks early.
Contribute to award entries, case studies and marketing initiatives that build Elmwood’s fame and reputation in the region.

04 What you know and bring.

The knowledge you'll need:

3–5 years of experience in a design, branding, or marketing agency in client servicing and/or project management roles.
Relevant experience in advertising agencies is a plus.
A background in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a similar field is preferred.
Solid understanding of brand and design processes, from briefing and strategy through to creative development and production.
Good commercial acumen, including familiarity with scopes of work, pricing models, budgets, forecasting and profitability drivers.
Proficient in project management, collaboration and file-sharing tools such as ClickUp, Pitch, LucidLink or similar. platforms.
AI fluency: confident using AI tools day to day to work smarter across briefing, planning, reporting and client communication. You're curious about how AI is changing agency workflows and keen to bring new ideas to the team.

The skills that'll set you apart

Proven ability to manage multiple projects and cross-functional teams simultaneously, balancing priorities and deadlines.
Keen attention to detail and accuracy across timings, budgets, documentation and deliverables.
Outstanding organisational and time management abilities, with a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.
Professional writing tone, style, and email etiquette, with the ability to communicate clearly and persuasively with clients and colleagues.
Strong eagerness to listen, learn, and grow in a dynamic, occasionally unstructured environment, bringing a genuine passion for creativity, innovation, and delivering exceptional work.
High sense of responsibility and commitment to the role, taking ownership of outcomes for your clients, projects and team.

Benefits

05 What we offer.

The work

The opportunity to work with leading global and regional brands across categories, shaping strategies and design that get seen and felt in the real world.

The people & culture

A fun studio environment working alongside great and talented individuals, with a collaborative, down-to-earth culture where craft, curiosity and generosity are valued.

Annual festivities and various social events throughout the year that bring the team together.

Growth & development

Access to learning, feedback and stretch opportunities across studios and disciplines, with support to shape a career that works for you.

title: Freelance Strategist
description:
About Us

We Are Social is a global socially-led creative agency with unrivalled social media expertise. With more than 1,200 people in 15 offices spanning four continents, we deliver world-class creative campaigns and strategies based on social insights, for forward-thinking brands.

Overall purpose of the role

We’re keen to bring aboard a limited term (Oct-Dec, extendable) freelance strategist with data, measurement and social media reporting for exciting brands in SG and other markets. But it doesn’t stop with data - we want you to go beyond and identify patterns, extract insights & learnings, manage extensive data and cross-pollinate it, catalyse logic to magic!

The role will be focused on research and insights, social and content and measurement - setting KPIs and benchmarks, tracking outbound and inbound social campaigns and always on-content, finding synergies with organic x paid, content calendars and community management, thinking on-brand, x-channel & x-market, feeding back into optimising the strategy, creative and unearthing opportunities on how data informs effectiveness!

We want to create work that we’re proud of, that positively impacts people’s feeds, and drives business value for our clients. We welcome fresh thinking, well thought through and presented work, and an entrepreneurial spirit. We offer the opportunity to contribute and learn from some fantastic brands on social, the place where culture thrives!

What does the role involve?

RESEARCH & INSIGHTS

Social Performance Tracking, Reporting and Optimisation - Setting KPI benchmarks with past owned and industry data, ensuring metrics are valuable and measurable, data AI dashboards, crafting custom dashboards aligned to KPIs, creator tracking, organic + paid synergies, funnel thinking, Community Management analytics & social listening opportunities, bringing in weekly and monthly reported and derived metrics data and analysing them into insightful and business-valuable reports.
Elevating reports with insights, linking performance data to executional elements like creative-creator-platform-posting schedule/time/occasion etc. Live tracking to identify high engagement content opportunities for boosting, Community Management and optimisation learnings. Crafting and delivering presentations to clients independently, clearly, with rigour, clear narratives and takeaways, and highly sophisticated presentation and hygiene.
Research: Crafting audience profiles rich with actionable data for creative, influencer and media approaches, understanding category macro dynamics and nuances across market data, comms, pricing, social listening, portfolio and competitor, brands on social - identifying best practices and best & worst performing content along with why - the creative and social science that drives success
Tools we use include: Sprinklr, Sprout Social, Social Insider, Tagger, Brandwatch, Meltwater, Global Web Index, and Euromonitor. Research approaches we use include: social listening, ethnography, fieldwork, interviews
Big Picture Feedback: Data led insights to inform audience, culture, content & creator planning, platforms format & frequency, and validate strategy & creative approaches
Clear understanding of how marketing is driven by social effectiveness, designing for performance measurability and insights, both qualitatively and quantitatively.

STRATEGY

Taking client briefs, challenging them, and mining the right kind of audience, market, media and brand data to input into inspiring and informative internal briefs and external proposals/ pitch decks.
Campaign thinking: Turning ideas into well-rounded plans, collaborating with the team to encompass platform and format thinking, consumer journey x content calendar/campaign plans, marketing/media executions, creator/influencer approaches, driving and measuring engagement, timings and budgets.
Effectiveness: Focus and understand how client business’ work, and the ability to develop strategic approaches designed to help grow clients’ brands and business.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

4-7 years of relevant data-driven experience, preferably in agencies, preferably social.
Systematic thinker and organised doer balancing big picture thinking with attention to detail, capable of driving projects independently and guiding smaller teams
Fluency and comfort crafting data-driven strategic thinking
Culture vulture - tuned into wider communications/marketing trends and culture
Social media/advertising /brand enthusiast
Collaborative with a passion for delivering industry-defining work
Brings something new to the agency - demonstrate individual passions and expertise

At We Are Social Singapore, we celebrate diverse perspectives and experiences, believing the best ideas come from unique voices and talents, including those not traditionally represented in advertising. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people from all backgrounds, reviewing every application fairly against the requirements of the role and striving to ensure everyone feels valued, included, and empowered to contribute to our shared success.

title: Brand Partnerships & Growth Specialist
description:
Crimson Education is the world’s leading college admissions consulting firm, with over 1,490 Ivy League offers and 2,410 to the US Top 15. We help ambitious students gain admission to the world’s top universities through expert-led guidance and proven, data-driven strategies. Crimson students are 7x more likely to get into the Ivy League than their peers. We were recently featured on the front page of the Wall Street Journal.

Crimson is the only college admissions consultancy that brings together:

Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications

Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation

Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards

Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation

We’re backed by leading VC firms, including Tiger Global, Heal Partners, IceHouse Ventures, and Movac, and recently closed a USD $40M Series D funding round at a USD $640M valuation. We now operate across 21 markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, and New Zealand.

Beyond college admissions consulting, Crimson offers a wide range of Enrichment programs designed to help students discover their interests, develop new skills, and achieve meaningful academic and extracurricular accomplishments. As we continue expanding our reach internationally, we're looking for a part-time Brand Partnerships & Growth Specialist to help introduce these programs to new audiences and strengthen their presence in key markets.

The role will initially focus on Indigo Research and Crimson Rise, two of our key Enrichment products. You’ll find creative ways to get them in front of the right students and families — whether through partnerships with leading schools and organizations, media and podcasts, creators, conferences, community placements, events, pop-ups, or other brand activations.

You’ll work closely with our marketing and leadership teams to identify opportunities others might miss and turn them into action. We’re looking for someone with strong existing networks who can open doors, generate ideas independently, and think commercially about how greater visibility can translate into audience growth, leads, and ultimately revenue.

Responsibilities include

Brand Growth & Opportunity Development

Identify creative ways to get Indigo and Rise in front of the right audiences – from media, podcasts, and creators to conferences, school and community placements, pop-ups, activations, and other unconventional opportunities.

Strengthen Indigo and Rise’s positioning across international markets, adapting ideas and messaging to local audiences while maintaining a consistent global brand.

Turn student, mentor, leadership, and company stories into compelling campaigns, content, PR, thought leadership, and other brand-building opportunities.

Develop and test creative market-specific ideas that build awareness and credibility, while considering how visibility can translate into audience growth, qualified leads, demand, and revenue.

Track results, identify what works, and recommend which channels, ideas, and initiatives we should scale.

Partnerships, Networks & Execution

Use your existing network – and continuously expand it – to open doors with journalists, creators, schools, education organizations, event organizers, companies, communities, and other influential partners.

Develop creative collaborations such as events, content partnerships, creator campaigns, webinars, competitions, community initiatives, and brand activations.

Proactively secure high-value media coverage, podcast appearances, speaking opportunities, conference placements, partnerships, and other forms of brand exposure.

Own opportunities end-to-end, from identifying the idea and making the introduction through pitching, execution, follow-up, and measuring impact.

What skills and experience you’ll need

5+ years of experience across brand marketing, partnerships, PR, growth, events, communications, or a related field.

Demonstrated experience building brands and creating growth opportunities across international markets.

An established, active network in at least one of our priority markets – the US, India, Singapore/Southeast Asia, or the Middle East – with relationships you can genuinely activate to open doors. This could include journalists, media outlets, schools, education organizations, event organizers, creators, influencers, community leaders, or other relevant partners.

A track record of independently spotting and creating opportunities – from partnerships and PR to events, creator collaborations, activations, and other forms of meaningful brand exposure.

A commercial mindset: not every brand activity needs to generate leads immediately, but you naturally think about how awareness and credibility can ultimately contribute to audience growth, demand, leads, and revenue.

Excellent written and spoken English, with strong pitching, storytelling, and communication skills.

Strong relationship-building skills and confidence approaching journalists, creators, organizations, partners, and senior external stakeholders.

Highly proactive, resourceful, and organized – you can take a broad objective, identify the right opportunity and people, and independently drive it from idea through execution.

What success looks like

Indigo and Rise become meaningfully more visible, relevant, and credible in the markets you own.

You consistently uncover opportunities we would not have found without you – new partners, creators, media, events, communities, placements, and creative ways to reach our target audiences.

Your existing network opens doors quickly, while the network you build becomes an increasingly valuable asset for Indigo and Rise.

Your initiatives generate measurable outcomes across brand awareness, audience growth, qualified leads, strategic relationships, and ultimately revenue.

You develop a clear understanding of what works in each market, learn quickly from what doesn’t, and scale the strongest ideas.

Why join us

Part-time, fully remote role with flexible working hours.

Help shape two education brands across multiple international markets.

High ownership and the freedom to turn good ideas into real campaigns, partnerships, and events.

Work with a global team of ambitious, curious people.

title: Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Specialist
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.

Job description

We are looking for a Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Specialist to be the visionary link between our brand identity & measurable e-commerce performance. You will shape how our health brands communicate across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & social media.

This role is responsible for developing high-impact creative strategies & producing assets (visual, video, copy) designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok E-Commerce stores. You will work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the expansion of our business. You won't just be creating content; you will be engineering 'Performance Stories' that turn scientific evidence into consumer trust & measurable revenue.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry.

Key Responsibilities

1. Creative & Performance Strategy

Full-Funnel Content: Craft tailored strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific formats (e.g. Meta carousel ads, Meta/TikTok Reels, Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banners & Klaviyo email/whatsapp marketing)

A/B Testing & Data Insights: Develop clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, CTAs, visual styles) & run A/B tests to improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion)

Competitive Intelligence: Identify emerging hooks & messaging trends in the wellness/supplement industry to keep our brands ahead of the curve

2. In-House Content Production & Execution

Performance Creative Development: Lead end-to-end creative production for organic & paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube) with a focus on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing

Video & Static Creation: Rapidly produce & edit native social content, including:

Video: Fast-paced assembly of UGC-style content, product demos & testimonials (CapCut/Premiere)

Static: Adapting product photography into high-performing ad variations & storefront banners

Generative AI Integration: Utilize AI tools & prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video & image assets for rapid testing cycles

Copywriting: Write high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & captions that align with brand voice & regulatory requirements

Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok storefronts

3. E-commerce Growth & Social Account Management

E-Commerce Storefront Custodian (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok): Integrate winning creative messages into e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a seamless customer journey for maximum sales conversion

Social Accounts Ownership & Community Manager: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for Miraco’s official accounts on Meta (FB/IG) & TikTok. Ensure all profiles are optimized for conversion, featuring up-to-date bios, Linktree/Shopify integrations & high-lighted stories

Content Programming & Scheduling: Develop & maintain a consistent content calendar that balances "Digital Pearls" (educational), Lifestyle (relatable) & Promotional (sales-driven) posts

Active Social Listening: Use comments & DMs to identify "pain points" to fuel new content hooks

User Generated Content (UGC) Mining: Identify & curate customer testimonials from the community to use as high-converting growth assets

Growth Analytics: Monitor account health metrics (Follower growth, Engagement Rate, Profile Visits) & use these insights to refine the organic reach strategy

Data-Driven Optimization: Work with the Marketing Manager to analyze performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving revenue on Shopify & Marketplaces. Apply insights & analytics to refine content effectiveness continuously

4. Performance Media & Technical Tracking

Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google):

Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Sales & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces

Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries

Precision Tracking & UTM Tagging: Implement a standardized UTM tagging nomenclature across all Digital Pearls, EDMs, WhatsApp blasts & Affiliate links to ensure 100% attribution accuracy in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) & Shopify

Monitor the "customer path" from the first touchpoint (e.g., a Meta post) to the final conversion (e.g. e-commerce purchase, loyalty program subscription, etc.)

Media Optimization: Manage ad spend budgets effectively, focusing on scaling winning creatives & "killing" underperforming ads based on real-time ROAS & CPA data

5. CRM, Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing (Retention & CLV)

CRM Management, Loyalty & Monetization: Serve as the lead strategist for the CRM loyalty program, designing lifecycle journeys that move customers from "First-Time Buyer" to "Loyal Subscriber"

Develop loyalty-driven content that rewards repeat purchases & encourages long-term brand advocacy to maximize Consumer Lifetime Value (CLV)

Electronic Direct Mailer (EDM) & E-Newsletter Strategy: Develop & execute a high-frequency E-newsletter calendar via Klaviyo. This includes:

Educational Newsletters: Delivering "Digital Pearls" & expert insights from our HCP partners to build brand authority

Promotional EDMs: Creating high-converting seasonal offers & product-launch campaigns

Automated Flow Management: Design & execute end-to-end email & WhatsApp marketing automation (eg. Klaviyo) to nurture leads & re-engage existing customers

Automated Lifecycle Flows: Building "Welcome" series, "Post-Purchase" care, "Win-back" flows & "Replenishment Reminders"

Subscription & Monetization: Craft compelling creative & copy for "Subscribe & Save" programs, focusing on reducing churn & maximizing monthly recurring revenue (MRR)

Optimize the "Subscribe & Save" funnel through targeted email & WhatsApp triggers, focusing on increasing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)

WhatsApp Marketing: Integrate direct-to-consumer WhatsApp communication for personalized health consultations, loyalty rewards & rapid-response promotions

Data-Driven Personalization & Segmented Campaigns: Segment the CRM database based on health concerns, purchase behavior & engagement levels to ensure the right story reaches the right customer at the right time

6. Influencer & Affiliate Strategy (E-Commerce Growth & Acquisition)

Creator Partnerships: Identify & manage relationships with health influencers & HCP advocates via Shopify Collabs, TikTok Creator Marketplace & similar platforms

Affiliate Creative Kits: Develop high-converting "Affiliate Toolkits" (ready-to-use stories, hooks & banners) that empower partners to sell Miraco products effectively

Performance Tracking: Monitor affiliate-driven traffic & conversion data to optimize commission structures & creative briefs for better ROAS

7. Growth-Driven Storytelling

Translating Science to Story: Distilling complex clinical data & health benefits into relatable, high-impact stories that resonate with a consumer’s pain points & emotional aspirations

Narrative Funneling: Crafting story arcs specifically designed for the customer journey, from "educational hooks" that capture attention to "empathy-led consideration" to "urgency-driven conversion"

Growth-Centric CTAs: Developing persuasive, multi-variant Calls-to-Action (CTAs) that don't just ask for a click but provide a compelling reason to engage, directly impacting Click-Through Rates (CTR) & customer acquisition

Performance Iteration: The ability to pivot a brand story based on real-time data insights, identifying which "angle" or "hook" is driving the highest Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

Omnichannel Cohesion: Ensuring a seamless visual & narrative experience across all touchpoints, from high-energy social media (Meta/TikTok) to professional platforms (LinkedIn) & offline trade materials

Compliance & Brand Integrity: Safeguarding brand credibility by ensuring all "Performance Stories" remain factual, align with company values & strictly compliant with regional healthcare advertising standards & product claim guidelines. Partnering with internal teams to audit content for accuracy & compliance prior to regional deployment

Requirements:

3–5 years of experience in full-stack digital growth, with a track record of managing end-to-end performance campaigns (Meta/Google), official social accounts (Meta/TikTok) & e-commerce growth (Shopify is a plus)

Ability to move customers through the funnel—from initial awareness to community loyalty—ideally within the healthcare or wellness sectors

Proven experience managing or creating content for Shopify, TikTok, Shopee & Lazada ecosystems. Familiarity with e-commerce metrics (AOV, CR, ROAS) is essential

Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager & Google Ads

Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Generative AI)

Hands-on proficiency in Klaviyo (highly preferred), HubSpot, or Zoho CRM for email & mobile marketing

Track record of managing or growing a brand loyalty club with a focus on retention & community building

Experience navigating Shopify Collabs, TikTok Marketplace, or similar affiliate management software

A solid understanding of the "Growth Equation": CAC, ROAS, AOV & CLV

Expert in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools

Experience using Generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini AI, Midjourney, Sora/Runway) for rapid asset prototyping & production

Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills. Adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals

Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

Excellent communication, project management skills & the ability to work cross-functionally

title: E-commerce & Social Media Growth Executive (US Market)
description:
JOB DEFINITION

The E-commerce & Social Media Growth Executive is responsible for building ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned content, social media presence and measurable off-Amazon traffic for the US market.

This is not a traditional customer-service role and does not depend on influencer partnerships. Even if no external creator works with us, employees will continue building ChoiceRefill’s own social media channels, content library and customer-acquisition assets.

ODORSEAL is hiring two employees for this position. Each employee will be assigned individual content projects, social media activities, Amazon Attribution links and measurable results. Both employees will be cross-trained to provide backup coverage when required, while individual project ownership and attributable results remain separately recorded.

ABOUT ODORSEAL AND CHOICEREFILL

ODORSEAL PTE. LTD. is a Singapore-based consumer-products and product-development company.

Our ChoiceRefill brand has been selling round diaper-pail refills to US customers through Amazon since 2017. ChoiceRefill is a practical, repeat-purchase household product that helps families find compatible, easy-to-use and cost-effective refill options.

ChoiceRefill is not a simple trading or standard private-label product. The company has independently developed its production lines, product structure and manufacturing processes.

We continue to improve film performance, production efficiency, product compatibility, packaging structure and the overall user experience. These product-development and manufacturing capabilities create a meaningful technical and operational barrier to entry that many ordinary e-commerce products do not have.

Employees will have the opportunity to understand how a consumer product moves from product development and manufacturing to Amazon sales, customer feedback, product improvement and repeat purchases.

ESTABLISHED AMAZON FOUNDATION

The company founder has many years of practical Amazon e-commerce experience and a clear understanding of product positioning, pricing, traffic, conversion, profitability and repeat purchases.

The founder is responsible for:

• Amazon Listing creation and optimisation

• Product images, selling points and page structure

• Amazon on-platform advertising

• Pricing and promotion strategy

• Product positioning and pack-size strategy

• Purchasing, inventory and core business decisions

• Product compliance and overall brand direction

Employees are not required to build Amazon Listings from the beginning or independently operate Amazon advertising.

Instead, employees will work from an established product, supply-chain, Listing and advertising foundation to build ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned content, social media channels and measurable off-Amazon traffic.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

BUILD BRAND-OWNED CONTENT ASSETS — APPROXIMATELY 35%

Create practical English-language content that answers real customer questions and supports Amazon purchase decisions.

Content may include:

• Compatibility demonstrations for tested round diaper-pail models

• How to identify compatible and incompatible pail structures

• Installation, film-pulling, cutting, tying and refill-replacement instructions

• Troubleshooting for common installation problems

• Guidance on choosing between 3-pack, 4-pack, 6-pack and 8-pack options

• Guidance for existing ChoiceRefill customers moving from older products to the latest version

• Explanations of product length, capacity, value and intended use

• Frequently asked questions based on real customer concerns

Employees do not always need to appear on camera. Clear product demonstrations, hand movements, close-up shots, captions and simple voiceovers are acceptable.

Strong master content should be repurposed into suitable formats for the company website and different social media platforms.

The objective is not to publish content simply to appear busy. The objective is to build an accurate, reusable content library that helps customers understand the product and make the correct purchase decision.

OPERATE BRAND SOCIAL MEDIA AND GENERATE ORGANIC TRAFFIC — APPROXIMATELY 25%

Support and operate ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned social media channels, which may include TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest and Facebook.

Responsibilities include:

• Maintaining a practical content calendar

• Publishing approved content consistently

• Adapting content for each platform and audience

• Writing clear English captions, titles and calls to action

• Responding appropriately to relevant public questions and comments

• Participating helpfully in relevant online discussions while respecting community rules

• Directing interested customers to the correct Amazon product page

• Checking that every published Amazon link is accurate and traceable

• Reusing effective content across suitable channels

ChoiceRefill’s social media and off-Amazon growth activities must be able to operate normally without relying on external influencers.

RESEARCH CUSTOMER DEMAND AND IMPROVE CONVERSION — APPROXIMATELY 15%

Actively identify what US customers need to know before making a purchase.

Research sources may include:

• Amazon customer reviews and product questions

• Competitor reviews and recurring complaints

• Customer enquiries received through the ChoiceRefill website

• Social media comments and discussions

• Search suggestions and frequently asked questions

• Feedback from existing ChoiceRefill customers

• Performance data from previously published content

Turn useful findings into:

• New content topics

• FAQ improvements

• Troubleshooting guides

• Website updates

• Product-information recommendations

• Clear suggestions for Amazon Listing improvement for the founder’s consideration

Employees should report “problem + evidence + recommendation,” rather than forwarding screenshots without analysis.

TRACK RESULTS AND RUN GROWTH EXPERIMENTS — APPROXIMATELY 15%

Use Amazon Attribution and internal tracking sheets to measure employee-owned content and traffic sources.

Responsibilities include:

• Using an approved tracking link for each content item

• Recording the platform, content ID, product, publication date and responsible employee

• Monitoring clicks, product-page activity, purchases and attributable sales

• Comparing different topics, formats, openings, captions and calls to action

• Identifying content that attracts clicks but does not result in purchases

• Recommending which content should be repeated, improved or discontinued

• Preparing a short weekly performance summary

• Maintaining accurate content and campaign records

Each employee will receive a separately assigned Amazon Attribution link structure so that individual contributions can be measured.

SUPPORT DAILY E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS — APPROXIMATELY 15%

Support the founder by completing and following up on routine work surrounding the Amazon business.

Responsibilities may include:

• Checking whether key products are available for sale

• Monitoring obvious price, stock, variation, image or link abnormalities

• Tracking approved inventory, inbound-shipment and replenishment matters

• Maintaining product information, packaging files, images and version records

• Organising sales or advertising reports and highlighting meaningful exceptions

• Preparing supporting information for platform cases

• Following up on approved changes and confirming completion

• Escalating urgent issues with evidence and a recommended next step

Employees do not independently change Amazon advertising, Listings, prices, purchasing plans or budgets.

HANDLE LIMITED CUSTOMER ENQUIRIES — UP TO 10%

Customer service is a small, on-demand part of this position.

Most ChoiceRefill customers understand and purchase the product directly through Amazon. The role is not expected to spend most of the working day handling enquiries.

Responsibilities include:

• Checking the company website for customer enquiries

• Answering questions about compatibility, installation and product use

• Following up on unresolved matters

• Classifying recurring customer problems

• Updating approved response templates and FAQ drafts

• Turning repeated questions into useful content or improvement recommendations

When customer-service volume is low, the available time will be redirected to content creation, social media operation, research and growth experiments.

OPTIONAL CREATOR AND INFLUENCER COLLABORATION — 0% TO 10%

Creator partnerships are an additional growth opportunity, not the foundation of this role.

When a genuinely suitable US parenting, household or value-focused creator is identified, employees may:

• Evaluate the creator’s audience and content quality

• Make initial contact

• Explain the product clearly

• Coordinate approved product samples

• Prepare a content brief

• Follow up on agreed timelines

• Record published content and measurable outcomes

Employees are not required to contact creators simply to fill working hours. Creator activity should expand only when it produces useful content, qualified traffic, measurable sales or a valuable long-term relationship.

Time used for creator partnerships will be allocated from the social media and organic-growth portion of the role.

INDIVIDUAL ATTRIBUTION AND SALES INCENTIVES

The fixed basic salary is S$3,400 per month and covers the normal responsibilities of the position.

In addition to the basic salary:

• Employees may receive a monthly performance bonus based on execution quality, accuracy, follow-up discipline, teamwork and backup capability

• Each employee will be assigned a separate Amazon Attribution link structure for employee-owned content

• Eligible individual sales incentives will be calculated using valid, finalised Amazon data

• Refunds, cancellations, self-purchases, abnormal traffic and ineligible activity will not be counted

• Individual attributable-sales incentives do not have a fixed upper limit

• The calculation method will be provided in writing so that employees can understand and verify their results

External Amazon Associates or Amazon Influencers may use their own affiliate links. Such partnerships will be assessed separately and will not replace the employee’s responsibility to build ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned content and traffic.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

A successful employee will not wait for the founder to assign every daily task.

You should be able to:

• Identify useful customer questions independently

• Convert customer questions into content ideas

• Produce or help produce clear product content

• Publish content using the correct tracking link

• Review the resulting performance data

• Decide what should be improved next

• Maintain accurate and complete records

• Follow up until work is completed

• Provide reliable backup coverage when required

• Explain problems using evidence and practical recommendations

Success is not measured only by the number of posts published, messages sent or hours spent.

We value work that is accurate, reusable, commercially useful and capable of producing measurable improvement.

WHAT YOU CAN LEARN

Using real operating data and active commercial projects, the company founder will help employees understand:

• How to identify real customer demand

• How to distinguish views, clicks and purchases

• How to evaluate the commercial value of content

• How to use Amazon Attribution to measure off-Amazon activities

• How pricing, conversion rates, sales, costs and profit are connected

• How customer feedback can lead to content and product improvements

• How to turn one-time tasks into repeatable SOPs

• How product development, manufacturing and supply chains affect a consumer-products business

• How to participate in business decisions using a “problem + evidence + recommendation” approach

This role is suitable for candidates at an early stage of their careers who want to develop long-term commercial judgement, product thinking and independent problem-solving ability.

REQUIREMENTS

• Strong written English, with the ability to communicate clearly with US customers and write natural social media content

• Chinese reading and writing ability, as internal SOPs, training materials, product-development information and reporting templates are currently maintained in Chinese

• Proactive and organised, with the ability to continue work without constant reminders

• Comfortable maintaining accurate records in Excel or Google Sheets

• Able to learn from customer feedback and performance data

• Willing to perform practical content work, including simple filming, editing and publishing

• Comfortable working with a practical household consumable rather than relying only on fashionable or entertainment-focused content

• Able to work with a colleague, review each other’s work and provide backup coverage

• Careful with product facts, compatibility information and customer-facing claims

Fresh graduates and candidates with internship, freelance or personal-project experience are welcome. Prior Amazon experience is not required.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Experience in any of the following areas will be helpful:

• E-commerce operations

• Social media management

• Content creation

• Short-form video production

• Digital marketing

• Customer service

• Community management

• Creator or influencer coordination

• US consumer markets

• Household, parenting or baby-care products

Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, Excel, Google Sheets and commonly used generative-AI tools is an advantage.

Candidates do not need to have a large personal following or maintain a public influencer account. Examples of content, school projects, freelance work, previously managed brand accounts or a simple portfolio are welcome.

WHAT WE PROVIDE

• Fixed basic salary of S$3,400 per month

• Monthly performance bonus

• Uncapped individual attributable-sales incentive

• Established US Amazon sales infrastructure

• Amazon Listings and on-platform advertising managed by the company founder

• Products supported by independent product-development and manufacturing capabilities

• Access to real product, sales, traffic and customer-feedback data

• Structured product training, SOPs, templates and tracking systems

• Direct participation in building a US consumer brand

• Exposure to the complete commercial process from product and manufacturing to content, traffic and sales

• Business guidance from a founder with many years of practical e-commerce experience

• Individual results that can be recorded and measured clearly

• Opportunities to earn additional income based on verified sales contributions

APPLICATION

Please submit your resume through MyCareersFuture.

You may include links to two or three examples of content, writing, videos, social media accounts or projects you have worked on. A portfolio is welcome but not compulsory.

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a brief practical exercise involving:

• A customer compatibility response

• A short product-content idea

• A simple Amazon traffic or content-tracking task

The exercise is intended only to assess practical thinking and communication ability. It will not be used as unpaid commercial work.

ODORSEAL PTE. LTD. recruits and selects candidates based on their ability, relevant skills and suitability for the position.

岗位定义

电商与社媒增长专员负责为ChoiceRefill美国市场建立品牌自有内容、社媒影响力和可衡量的Amazon站外流量。

这不是一个传统客服岗位,也不是一个依赖红人合作才能开展工作的岗位。即使没有任何外部创作者与我们合作,员工仍然需要持续建设ChoiceRefill自己的社媒账号、内容资料库和客户获取资产。

ODORSEAL将为这个岗位招聘两名员工。每名员工分别负责各自的内容项目、社媒活动、Amazon Attribution归因链接和可衡量结果。

两名员工都会接受交叉培训,并在需要时为对方提供备岗支持。但是,每个人原有的项目、内容和可归因销售结果都会分别记录。

关于ODORSEAL和ChoiceRefill

ODORSEAL PTE. LTD.是一家位于新加坡的消费品和产品开发公司。

旗下ChoiceRefill品牌自2017年起,通过美国Amazon销售圆形尿布桶替换装。ChoiceRefill是一款实用的家庭重复购买型消耗品,帮助美国家庭找到兼容、易用且更具性价比的替换装。

ChoiceRefill不是简单的贸易产品或标准贴牌产品。公司自主开发了生产线、产品结构和制造工艺。

我们持续改进薄膜性能、生产效率、产品兼容性、包装结构和整体用户体验。这些产品开发和制造能力形成了有实际意义的技术及运营门槛,是许多普通电商产品不具备的。

公司的业务能力覆盖:

产品研发;

自主开发的生产工艺;

制造和质量控制;

包装和供应链执行;

Amazon销售;

客户反馈;

持续产品改进。

加入ODORSEAL后,员工将有机会了解一款消费品如何从产品研发和制造,走向市场验证、客户反馈和持续复购。

已经建立的Amazon经营基础

公司负责人拥有多年Amazon电商实战经验,对产品定位、价格、流量、转化、利润和复购之间的关系具有清楚的理解。

公司负责人负责:

Amazon Listing的建立和优化;

产品图片、核心卖点和页面结构;

Amazon站内广告;

定价及促销策略;

产品定位及包装规格策略;

采购、库存和核心经营决策;

产品合规及整体品牌方向。

员工不需要从零建立Amazon Listing,也不需要独立操作Amazon站内广告。

员工将在公司已经具备产品、供应链、Listing和广告基础的情况下,继续建立ChoiceRefill的品牌自有内容、社媒渠道和可衡量的Amazon站外流量。

主要工作职责

一、建立品牌自有内容资产——约占35%

制作能够回答真实客户问题、帮助客户完成Amazon购买决策的实用英文内容。

内容可能包括:

已完成实测的圆形尿布桶型号兼容演示;

如何辨认兼容和不兼容的尿布桶结构;

安装、抽膜、切袋、打结和更换替换盒的操作说明;

常见安装问题的排查方法;

3盒、4盒、6盒和8盒包装的选择建议;

ChoiceRefill老客户从旧版产品转换到新版产品的说明;

产品长度、容量、价值和适用场景说明;

根据真实客户问题整理的常见问答。

员工不一定需要本人出镜。清楚的产品演示、手部操作、产品特写、字幕和简单配音都可以使用。

优质的母内容应当根据公司官网和不同社媒平台的需要,拆分和改编为相应格式。

我们的目标不是为了显得忙碌而发布内容,而是建立一个准确、可以重复使用,并能帮助客户理解产品和作出正确购买决定的内容资料库。

二、运营品牌社媒并获取自然流量——约占25%

协助运营ChoiceRefill自主拥有的社媒账号,包括但不限于TikTok、Instagram、YouTube Shorts、Pinterest和Facebook。

主要工作包括:

维护清楚实用的内容日历;

按计划持续发布经过批准的内容;

根据不同平台和受众调整内容;

编写清楚自然的英文标题、文案和行动指引;

适当回复相关的公开问题和评论;

在遵守社区规则的前提下,参与相关网络讨论并提供有帮助的答案;

将有购买兴趣的客户引导到正确的Amazon商品页面;

检查每个已发布的Amazon链接是否准确、有效和可追踪;

将已经验证有效的内容合理复用到其他渠道。

ChoiceRefill的社媒和站外增长工作必须能够在不依赖外部红人的情况下正常运行。

三、研究客户需求并改善转化——约占15%

主动寻找美国客户在购买前真正需要了解的信息。

可以参考的信息来源包括:

Amazon客户评价和商品问答;

竞品评价及反复出现的投诉;

ChoiceRefill独立站收到的客户咨询;

社媒评论和相关讨论;

搜索建议和常见问题;

ChoiceRefill现有客户的反馈;

已发布内容的表现数据。

员工需要把有价值的发现转化为:

新的内容选题;

FAQ改进;

故障排查指南;

官网内容更新;

产品信息改善建议;

提供给公司负责人参考的Amazon Listing优化建议。

提交问题时,应采用“问题+证据+建议”的方式,而不是只转发截图而不进行分析。

四、跟踪结果并开展增长测试——约占15%

使用Amazon Attribution和公司内部追踪表,衡量员工负责的内容和流量来源。

主要工作包括:

为每项内容使用经过批准的追踪链接;

记录平台、内容编号、对应产品、发布日期和负责人;

跟踪点击、商品页面活动、购买和可归因销售;

对比不同内容主题、形式、开头、文案和行动指引的表现;

找出有点击但没有产生购买的内容;

建议哪些内容应该继续、修改或停止;

每周提交一份简短的表现总结;

准确维护内容和推广活动记录。

公司将为每名员工分配独立的Amazon Attribution链接体系,以便准确衡量个人贡献。

五、支持日常电商运营——约占15%

通过完成和跟进Amazon业务周边的日常工作,减少公司负责人处理例行事务的时间。

工作可能包括:

检查重点产品是否正常在售;

监控明显的价格、库存、变体、图片或链接异常;

跟进已经批准的库存、入仓和补货事项;

维护产品资料、包装文件、图片及版本记录;

整理销售或广告报表,并标出有实际意义的异常;

准备平台问题处理需要的支持资料;

跟进已经批准的修改,并确认是否完成;

发现紧急问题时,连同证据和建议处理方式一起上报。

员工不得自行调整Amazon广告、Listing、价格、采购计划或预算。

六、处理少量客户咨询——最多占10%

客户服务是本岗位中工作量较小、按照实际需求发生的工作。

大部分ChoiceRefill客户会直接通过Amazon了解并购买产品,因此本岗位不会把大部分工作时间用于处理客户咨询。

主要工作包括:

检查公司独立站收到的客户咨询;

回复兼容、安装和产品使用问题;

跟进尚未解决的问题;

对反复出现的客户问题进行分类;

更新经过批准的回复模板和FAQ草稿;

把重复问题转化为有用的内容或改进建议。

当客户咨询量较少时,相应时间将自动转移到内容制作、社媒运营、需求研究和增长测试。

七、选择性开展创作者和红人合作——占0%至10%

创作者合作是额外的增长机会,不是本岗位存在的基础。

当员工发现真正适合的美国育儿、家庭生活或性价比消费类创作者时,可以:

评估创作者的受众和内容质量;

进行初步联系;

清楚介绍产品;

协调已经批准的产品样品;

准备内容要求;

跟进双方约定的时间;

记录已经发布的内容和可衡量结果。

员工可以根据执行质量、数据准确性、跟进纪律、团队协作和备岗能力获得月度绩效奖金;

公司会为每名员工负责的品牌自有内容分配独立的Amazon Attribution链接体系;

个人销售奖励以Amazon最终确认的有效数据为依据;

退款、取消订单、自购、异常流量和不符合规定的活动不计入奖励;

个人可归因销售奖励不设固定上限;

公司会以书面形式提供计算方法,确保员工能够理解并核对自己的结果。

怎样才算在这个岗位上取得成功

一名表现优秀的员工,不会等待公司负责人每天逐项分配任务。

你应该能够:

制作或协助制作清楚的产品内容;

月度绩效奖金;

已经建立的美国Amazon销售基础;

由拥有多年电商实战经验的公司负责人提供业务指导;

能够被清楚记录和衡量的个人工作成果;

根据可核实销售贡献获得额外收入的机会。

申请方式

请通过MyCareersFuture提交简历。

候选人可以附上两至三个自己参与过的内容、文章、视频、社媒账号或项目案例。作品集不是强制要求。

入围候选人可能会被邀请完成一项简短的实际能力测试,包括:

回复一个客户兼容性问题;

提出一个简短的产品内容创意;

完成一个简单的Amazon站外流量或内容追踪任务。

该测试只用于评估候选人的实际思考和沟通能力,不会被公司作为免费的商业内容使用。

ODORSEAL PTE. LTD.根据候选人的实际能力、相关技能及岗位适配程度进行公平招聘和录用。

Company Profile: ODORSEAL PTE. LTD.

ODORSEAL PTE. LTD. is a Singapore-registered consumer products company. It develops, brands, and sells diaper-pail refills and odor-sealing flexible packaging. The company owns and operates the consumer brand ChoiceRefill™. Its core technology mark is OdorSeal™.

The business started from a closed refill market. For years, many families could buy only the refill made for their own pail, at the price set by that brand. ChoiceRefill has been sold on Amazon US since 2017 as a compatible alternative for selected round diaper-pail systems. The brand states that more than 100,000 US families have used its refills. Its main Amazon listing has held about a 4.6-star rating from more than 50,000 reviews. The official store, choicerefill.com, sells the same products, fulfilled from US and EU centers.

The refill uses a 7-layer high-barrier film to lock in odor, with a film that is strong, easy to start, and loaded in the way parents already know. Each refill holds a large number of newborn diapers, so the pail is changed and emptied less often. The brand promise is compatibility, odor control, and fair pricing, with a trial option and a satisfaction guarantee (90-day money-back support on Amazon, with a satisfaction guarantee on the official site). ChoiceRefill is made for selected round refill systems, including some Diaper Genie® and Munchkin® models. It is not universal; fit should be checked before stocking up. Those names are used only to describe compatibility. ODORSEAL is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by those brands.

The company is based in Singapore and works with certified manufacturing partners in Asia on high-barrier film, lamination, and bag converting. Sales are focused on the United States, through Amazon FBA and the brand site, with wholesale available to baby retailers and institutional buyers. The aim is a simple, affordable, odor-proof refill that does not lock a family to one brand.

Tagline: ChoiceRefill — Freedom, Not Overpayment.
