title: Business Development Manager
description:
Business Development Manager

*Company:* Agtiv Media Pte Ltd
*Employment Type:* Full-Time

*About GratiData*

GratiData is a mobile content platform that rewards users for engaging with digital content. Users earn GratiData Coins through activities such as watching and engaging with content, which can be redeemed for mobile data.

As we grow our platform and expand our network of telecommunications, advertising, content and creator partners, we are looking for a *Business Development Manager* to identify new commercial opportunities, develop strategic partnerships and help drive GratiData's growth.

*The Role*

The Business Development Manager will play a key role in developing and executing GratiData's commercial strategy. You will identify potential partners, initiate and manage business discussions, negotiate commercial arrangements, and work closely with management and internal teams to turn partnerships into successful implementations.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who is commercially minded, proactive and comfortable developing opportunities from initial research and outreach through negotiation and execution.

*Key Responsibilities*

*Business Development & Partnerships*

* Identify and develop new business opportunities that support GratiData's growth and monetisation strategy.
* Build relationships with telecommunications companies, advertising partners, content providers, creator/influencer networks, agencies and other strategic partners.
* Conduct outreach to prospective partners and arrange business discussions and presentations.
* Develop partnership proposals, commercial structures and collaboration models.
* Negotiate commercial terms and coordinate agreements through to execution.
* Maintain and develop relationships with existing partners.

*Advertising & Monetisation*

* Identify opportunities to grow advertising revenue and expand GratiData's monetisation partnerships.
* Develop relationships with ad networks, agencies, brands and other advertising partners.
* Work with internal teams and external partners to support the implementation and growth of advertising solutions on the platform.
* Monitor industry developments and identify new monetisation opportunities.

*Creator & Content Partnerships*

* Develop relationships with influencer agencies, creator networks, MCNs and content partners.
* Identify opportunities to onboard creators and content to the GratiData platform.
* Develop commercial arrangements for creator campaigns, content production and promotional collaborations.
* Support influencer and creator acquisition initiatives in GratiData's target markets.

*Market Expansion & Strategy*

* Research potential markets, partners, competitors and industry developments.
* Evaluate new countries and commercial opportunities for regional expansion.
* Prepare market research, competitor analysis and business cases to support management decisions.
* Assist management with financial and commercial analysis of potential partnerships and expansion opportunities.

*Project Coordination & Reporting*

* Coordinate with product, technology, marketing, finance and management teams to ensure partnerships are successfully implemented.
* Track partnership discussions, deliverables, timelines and commercial outcomes.
* Prepare proposals, presentations, reports and other business-development materials.
* Maintain an organised pipeline of prospective partners and opportunities.
* Provide regular updates to management on business development activities and progress.

*Requirements*

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Economics, Communications or a related discipline.
* Relevant experience in business development, partnerships, sales, account management or a related commercial role.
* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Strong commercial awareness and ability to understand different business and revenue models.
* Comfortable conducting market research and analysing commercial opportunities.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
* Highly organised and able to manage multiple discussions and projects simultaneously.
* Proactive and comfortable approaching and developing relationships with new partners.
* Strong written and spoken English.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with different teams.

*Preferred Experience*

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage:

* Mobile applications or consumer technology
* Telecommunications
* Digital advertising or ad-tech
* Influencer or creator marketing
* Content platforms or media
* Strategic partnerships
* Regional business development in Southeast Asia

*What We're Looking For*

We are looking for someone who does more than wait for opportunities to arrive. You should be comfortable researching a market, identifying the right company and decision-maker, making the initial approach, developing the commercial proposition, and following the opportunity through to execution.

The ideal candidate combines *strong relationship-building skills with commercial thinking and execution ability*. You should be curious, resourceful and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where you will have the opportunity to contribute directly to the growth of the business.

*Why Join GratiData?*

You will have the opportunity to work on partnerships across telecommunications, digital advertising, content and the creator economy while helping scale a new consumer technology platform. The role provides significant exposure to senior management and the opportunity to participate directly in GratiData's commercial development and regional expansion.

Pay: $2,500.00 - $3,500.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Marketing Executive to independently manage and execute day-to-day marketing activities across the Company's brands and business activities.

The role covers digital marketing, social media, events, partnerships, marketing communications and market research. The Marketing Executive will work directly with the Director and is expected to take ownership of assigned marketing projects from planning and coordination through to execution and performance reporting.

The role requires a hands-on and organized individual who can work independently, coordinate with internal teams and external vendors, and manage multiple marketing activities with limited day-to-day supervision.

Job Responsibilities

1. Marketing Planning & Campaign Execution

Plan and execute marketing activities in line with business objectives and direction from the Director.

Develop campaign plans, timelines and required marketing materials.

Coordinate campaign setup, scheduling, content placement and execution to ensure activities are delivered accurately and on time.

Monitor campaign results and prepare reports on key performance indicators.

Review campaign results and recommend practical improvements for future activities.

2. Digital & Social Media Marketing

Plan and manage social media content across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram and TikTok.

Maintain content calendars and coordinate content creation, publishing and scheduling.

Plan and execute digital campaigns, including paid social media advertising where required.

Monitor campaign performance, engagement, leads and other relevant metrics.

Manage EDM campaigns and customer communications where required.

3. Events & Offline Marketing

Plan, coordinate and execute marketing activities including roadshows, travel fairs, workshops, promotions, corporate events and other relevant events.

Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, partners and event organizers on logistics, setup, materials and timelines.

Source and coordinate event requirements, including marketing materials, equipment and manpower support.

5. Marketing Content & Creative Coordination

Coordinate with designers, agencies and external vendors for more specialized creative work.

Coordinate the production of printed materials such as brochures, banners, advertisements and promotional collateral.

Ensure marketing materials are accurate, timely and consistent with the Company's brand guidelines.

title: Integrated Strategy Director
description:
Location: APAC / Remote

Engagement: 12-month fixed-term contract

Format: Remote/Hybrid

Travel: Regional travel required

About the Project

We’re looking for a Integrated Strategy Director to become an embedded strategic partner to a global hospitality brand growing in APAC.

This is the first and most important hire within a broader new creative and content capability. You’ll sit close to the client’s leadership team, deeply understand the business, and help turn commercial priorities, audience insight and cultural signals into a clear strategic direction for the brand’s mid-funnel programme.

The ambition is bigger than campaign planning. The opportunity spans brand strategy, creative development, always-on content, influencers, production and brand governance, with a significant opportunity to unlock more commercial value from the content already being created.

You’ll be expected to bring the perspective of an excellent agency strategist while operating with the closeness, context and accountability of an in-house partner.

About the Role

Brand & Business Strategy

Partner with senior client stakeholders to understand business priorities, commercial objectives, audience needs and brand challenges.
Shape the annual strategic roadmap and priorities for the APAC mid-funnel programme.
Translate business needs, consumer insight, cultural signals and performance data into clear strategic recommendations and inspiring briefs.
Identify opportunities to connect activity across the customer journey and unlock incremental commercial impact.
Bring strong outside-in thinking and challenge category conventions where it can strengthen the brand.
Use measurement, market signals and learning loops to continuously improve the strategic direction.

Integrated Strategy & Creative Partnership

Lead integrated thinking across brand, creative, content, influencers, media and performance.
Work closely with the Creative Director to turn strategy into emotionally resonant, culturally relevant work.
Develop and constructively challenge ideas to ensure they are distinctive, audience-led and commercially meaningful.
Connect ATL and BTL thinking rather than treating channels and programmes in isolation.
Personally develop and present compelling leadership decks, strategic narratives and recommendations.
Make complex thinking clear and help senior stakeholders confidently make decisions.

Brand Governance & Ways of Working

Help shape a clearer operating model between APAC/corporate teams and individual hotel teams.
Identify where better processes, systems, tools or governance could reduce friction and protect brand consistency.
Bring structure to briefing, approvals, roles, responsibilities and decision-making.
Help create ways of working that are centrally governed but scalable across local markets.
Partner with MASH and wider specialists as the future governance and technology model develops.

About You
You bring significant senior experience across brand strategy, integrated marketing, communications planning or strategic planning, ideally across multiple markets.
You have worked with premium consumer brands and understand how culture, creativity and commercial performance connect.
You can take a complex business challenge and turn it into a clear strategic response, inspiring brief and focused action.
You understand how brand, creative, content, creators, media and performance work together to build consideration.
You are an exceptional storyteller and presentation builder, with the confidence to lead senior conversations and sell an idea.
You know how to challenge constructively while remaining a trusted partner.
You are commercially minded and naturally look for opportunities to deliver more value rather than simply answering the brief.
You are comfortable with ambiguity and can bring clarity, structure and momentum without overcomplicating things.
Experience across fashion, sport, luxury, lifestyle, beauty, FMCG or other culturally progressive consumer categories would be particularly interesting.
Hospitality experience is welcome, but it is not required. We are deliberately interested in perspectives from outside traditional hospitality.

Please Note

Due to the high volume of applications, we unfortunately can’t get back to everyone, and only successful applicants will be contacted. When you share your details with us, we consider this as consent for us to use your data during the application process. We may implement AI in various stages of the recruitment process, but human involvement will always remain as part of our hiring ethos. At the moment, MASH is not in a position to sponsor work visas, so you have to be eligible to legally work in the country where we’re hiring.

title: Creative Director (Brand & Social)
description:
Location: Singapore / or remote across APAC (+/- 2hrs from SG)
Engagement: 12-month fixed-term contract
Format: Hybrid or remote, depending on your location
Travel: Regional travel required

About the Project

We’re looking for a Creative Director, Brand & Social to become the social-first creative partner within an embedded APAC team for a leading global hospitality brand.

This is not a traditional campaign Creative Director role. You’ll turn cultural signals, audience insight and everyday travel behaviour into visual stories and social-first content that make people stop, feel something and recognise themselves in the brand. You’ll live close to social culture, spotting emerging behaviours, humour and creative references before they become marketing trends. The work should feel boldly human, visually beautiful, culturally sharp and genuinely relatable.

You’ll bring a clear creative point of view, while working collaboratively with the client and Integrated Strategy Director to shape ideas quickly and take them into market. Strong producer instincts matter: there will not always be a large production house behind you. Success means creating a living portfolio of brand content that feels native to social, culturally relevant and premium – with enough craft to build the brand and enough agility to keep it current.

About the Role

Social-First Creative Direction

Turn culture, audience insight and travel behaviour into social-first creative ideas.
Stay close to the most interesting social content, formats and behaviours shaping culture.
Find unexpected ways to place the brand within the story rather than making the brand the story.
Create work that feels premium and distinctive without becoming overly polished, gimmicky or trend-led.
Use humour and relatability with intelligence and restraint.

Storytelling & Content

Build stories around relatable human moments and the emotional side of travel.
Develop social films, short-form video, creator-led storytelling, visual comedy and culturally responsive content.
Create a living portfolio of always-on content, destination storytelling and regional moments
Tell stories visually, not just through messaging.
Ensure content feels native to the platform and market it appears in.

Creator, Influencer & Regional Creative

Shape creative ideas for creator and influencer content while allowing creators to retain their own voice.
Develop ideas that can flex across priority APAC markets without losing the central creative thought.
Bring fresh references from lifestyle, fashion, beauty, sport, entertainment and culture.
Help regional teams translate strong central ideas into locally relevant content.

Hands-on Creative & Production

Take ideas from concept through to market-ready execution.
Work directly with writers, designers, creators, producers and specialist makers.
Move quickly from idea to prototype to production.
Know when an idea needs full production and when it can be made more simply and intelligently.
Maintain strong craft standards while recognising that polish cannot substitute for relevance.
Use AI and emerging creative tools where they improve speed, quality or creative possibility.

About You

You bring 10+ years of experience in creative direction, social-first content strategy, brand storytelling, art direction, copywriting or integrated creative and senior stakeholder upselling experience.
You have a portfolio demonstrating strong ideas and beautifully executed work across multiple formats, most importantly, across social.
You understand the difference between producing content and building a story that creates brand memory and commercial impact.
You have strong experience across social, content, creators/influencers and static/video production.
You can take a strategic direction and translate it into emotionally relatable creative.
You understand how global brand platforms can be regionalised and localised without losing consistency.
You are confident presenting and selling ideas directly to senior clients.
You enjoy working closely with strategists and can move easily between strategy, creative development and production.
Experience within fashion, sport, luxury, beauty, lifestyle, entertainment or premium consumer brands would be particularly interesting.
Hospitality experience is not required. We actively welcome people who can bring a different creative perspective to the category.

Please Note

Due to the high volume of applications, we unfortunately can’t get back to everyone, and only successful applicants will be contacted. When you share your details with us, we consider this as consent for us to use your data during the application process. We may implement AI in various stages of the recruitment process, but human involvement will always remain as part of our hiring ethos. At the moment, MASH is not in a position to sponsor work visas, so you have to be eligible to legally work in the country where we’re hiring.

title: Supply Chain Lead, APM
description:
Campari Group today is a major player in the global branded spirits industry, with a portfolio of over 50 premium and super premium brands, marketed and distributed in over 190 markets around the world, with leading positions in Europe and the Americas.

Headquartered in Milan, Italy, Campari Group owns 25 plants worldwide and has its own distribution network in 26 countries, and employs approximately 4,700 people.

Shares of the parent company Davide Campari - Milano N.V. are listed on the Italian Stock Exchange since 2001. Campari Group is today the sixth-largest player worldwide in the premium spirits industry.

Role Purpose

The Supply Chain Lead is the recognised face of Supply Chain to the Market and the voice of the Market within Supply Chain. The role owns and orchestrates end-to-end APM (Asia Distributors markets + Singapore IMC) Supply Chain performance across service levels, demand quality, S&OP outcomes, cost to serve, customer service, logistics execution and inventory-related trade-offs. The incumbent partners closely with the APM Managing Director and commercial leadership, translating business priorities into disciplined Supply Chain choices while leveraging local, regional and global resources to deliver sustainable service, growth and cost performance.

Key Accountabilities

Supply Chain Business Partnering & Market Leadership

Act as the single, responsive point of contact for Supply Chain for the APM Leadership Team and commercial organisation.
Partner with the APM Managing Director to anticipate business constraints, understand customer and channel needs, and translate market priorities into Supply Chain actions.
Influence cross-functional decisions beyond Supply Chain by bringing fact-based trade-off recommendations on service, cost, inventory, availability and demand quality.
Communicate Supply Chain priorities, risks, opportunities and project impacts clearly to market stakeholders, ensuring strong alignment and follow-through.

S&OP, Demand Planning & Commercial Collaboration

Lead the local S&OP / Demand Planning process, enabling consensus meetings, challenging assumptions and tracking risks and opportunities.
Improve the level of maturity of the existing S&OP process in APM, ensure standardization to Campari One plan model
Own forecast quality at market level, including bias, forecast value-add, data integrity and appropriate aggregation for regional and local decision-making.
Drive one-plan discipline and readiness for IBP / digital planning capabilities, ensuring local teams adopt standard planning cycles and ways of working.

Customer Service, Logistics & Cost to Serve

Be responsible for customer service and logistics operations in APM, including order-to-delivery performance, service recovery, delivery reliability and distribution performance, from Singapore warehouse.
Be responsible for the implementation and the logistics operation of the future Logistics Asia Hub, coordinating supply of defined Asia markets from all sources
Own cost-to-serve visibility and improvement plans, identifying logistics levers and productivity opportunities while protecting service and growth.
Manage and develop strategic relationships with third-party logistics providers, transportation partners, warehouses and key external service providers.
Partner with the commercial organisation on distributor relationships, collaborative planning, service alignment and issue resolution.

End-to-End Supply Chain Performance & Continuous Improvement

Connect demand, supply, inventory, materials, customer service and logistics into a coherent end-to-end market view.
Identify business and operational opportunities, define action plans and drive execution to enhance service delivery, availability and working capital outcomes.
Build robust performance management routines based on clear KPIs for service, forecast accuracy, cost, inventory and operational productivity.
Lead local Supply Chain transformation initiatives and continuous improvement projects, including logistics network optimisation, customer service transformation and route-to-market related change.

People Leadership, Matrix Collaboration & Operating Model Catalyst

Coordinate local functional Supply Chain efforts and foster collaboration across Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Customer Service, Logistics, Finance and Commercial teams.
Engage regional and global Supply Chain counterparts proactively to answer local business needs, escalating trade-offs and priorities with clear recommendations.
Develop team capability and succession pipeline across demand planning, customer service and logistics roles where direct or functional leadership is in scope.
Role model Campari values, GSC behaviours and mindsets, creating an engaged, accountable and performance-oriented Supply Chain climate.

Key Relationships

Internal: APM Leadership Team: Managing Director, Sales and Marketing, Finance / FP&A, HR - Regional Supply Chain: Supply Planning, S&OP and Demand Planning, Procurement and CoMan, Quality and R&D – Global Supply Chain functions: Innovation, MDM, CS&L and Planning.

External: Third-party logistics providers, distributors, key customers, freight forwarders, service partners where relevant.

Experience, Education & Success Profile

Required Experience & Education

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business or a related discipline.
Approximately 10+ years of Supply Chain experience, ideally including APM/Singapore exposure in S&OP, Demand Planning, Customer Service, Logistics or Commercial Planning.
Proven experience in FMCG or F&B industry
Experience operating in a matrix organisation and influencing senior commercial stakeholders without relying only on formal authority.
People management or functional leadership experience, including capability building and performance management, is strongly recommended.
Experience leading continuous improvement projects in logistics, customer service, planning, network optimisation or route-to-market change.
Strong digital and data literacy; SAP S/4HANA, SAP IBP or advanced planning system exposure is an advantage.
Fluent English required; other Asian language and cross-cultural APAC experience are strong advantages.

Leadership Traits & Behaviours

Business partner and influencer: credible with commercial leaders and able to build consensus around difficult trade-offs.
Decision-oriented: turns data, KPIs and market signals into clear choices and action plans.
Commercial-first and service-obsessed: protects growth and customer experience while balancing cost and inventory.
Pragmatic and resilient: able to work through ambiguity, prioritise effectively and sustain momentum in transformation.
People developer: builds internal capability, coaches team members and reinforces accountability.
Matrix leader: connects local, regional and global teams into one coherent operating model.

Differentiating Success Factors

P&L fluency and ability to explain the financial implications of service, stock, cost-to-serve and route-to-market decisions.
Distributor / customer collaboration experience, including joint planning and service-level alignment.
Scenario planning capability and comfort leading trade-off discussions across demand, supply, cost and inventory.
Multi-country or APAC regional experience, with the cultural agility to navigate diverse stakeholder environments.
Transformation mindset: able to upgrade ways of working and embed future-ready planning and service operations.

Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:

At Campari Group we believe in building more value together, thus we see diversity in all forms as a source of enrichment. Our employment policies and practices ensure that we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment without regard to any individual’s race, religion, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or characteristics or expression, political affiliation or activity, age, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Campari Group believes that fair compensation and equal opportunities are crucial for employees’ well-being, empowerment, and engagement. Our efforts to ensure fair pay have earned us the Fair Pay Certification by Fair Pay Workplace, an independent organization dedicated to dismantling pay disparities based on gender, race and their intersection.

Note to applicants:

Your application will be assessed based on your abilities, expertise, general knowledge and experience, not because of any confidential, proprietary or trade secret information you may possess. You must not disclose to Campari Group any such information. In the event that you are asked a question that cannot be answered without disclosure of any confidential, proprietary or trade secret information (including from a current or prior employer or their vendors or customers), you must decline to answer the question.

Notice to third party agencies:

Please refrain from cold-calling or emailing our executive leadership team or the HR community directly. The Talent Acquisition department manages centralized recruiting operations globally, including the selection and management of external suppliers. Currently, our preferred supplier list is at full capacity. To ensure we have your information on file for future consideration, we kindly request that you complete the online form provided here.

title: Performance and Demand Generation Manager
description:
Description

About the role

The Performance & Demand Generation Manager drives qualified demand, lead generation and customer acquisition for the Singapore business. This hands-on role owns demand generation performance, with a primary focus on paid media, funnel optimisation and data-led experimentation to improve acquisition efficiency and contribute to pipeline and revenue growth.

Working closely with the Business Development team, the role plans, tests and optimises acquisition initiatives within the wider Singapore marketing plan.

Key responsibilities

Demand generation and acquisition

Plan and execute Singapore demand generation initiatives aligned with business priorities and agreed acquisition targets.

Drive qualified lead generation and optimise campaigns for lead volume, lead quality, acquisition efficiency and pipeline contribution.

Identify and test new acquisition opportunities across digital and selected offline channels, prioritising those with measurable commercial potential.

Align demand generation plans and budget priorities with the Senior Marketing Manager.

Paid media and performance marketing

Manage and optimise paid acquisition campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube and other relevant digital channels.

Own campaign set-up, targeting, bidding, audience development and allocation of approved campaign budgets.

Work with creative teams to brief and test messaging, formats and creative variations that improve acquisition performance.

Evaluate emerging advertising platforms and formats, including ChatGPT Ads where available and relevant, through structured tests.

Funnel optimisation and conversion

Monitor the acquisition funnel from lead generation through qualification, opportunity and conversion.

Analyse performance across campaigns, channels, audiences and customer segments to identify bottlenecks.

Optimise landing pages, lead forms, offers and conversion journeys in collaboration with relevant teams.

Use Business Development feedback on lead quality, customer objections and downstream conversion to improve campaigns and lead handover.

Data measurement and experimentation

Track and report lead volume, marketing-qualified leads, cost per lead, customer acquisition cost, conversion rates, pipeline contribution and return on marketing spend.

Translate performance data into actionable insights, recommendations and clear stakeholder reporting.

Run structured experiments across channels, audiences, creative, messaging, offers and landing pages; use findings to guide optimisation and scaling.

Support forecasting, budget planning and regular performance reviews with the Senior Marketing Manager.

Broader demand generation support

Support selected activities, field marketing, activations and partnerships

Help Business Development and creative teams develop relevant brochures, flyers, product sheets and campaign collateral

Contribute ideas for integrated acquisition campaigns and help track the leads, conversion and pipeline generated by supporting activities.

Cross functional collaboration

Work closely with the Senior Marketing Manager, Business Development, Creative, Product and other stakeholders to deliver Singapore acquisition priorities.

Provide clear briefs, performance feedback and optimisation recommendations; coordinate agencies, media partners and vendors where required.

Requirements

What we are looking for

4–6 years of experience in performance marketing, demand generation, growth marketing or a related discipline.

Strong hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads, with demonstrated ownership of lead generation campaigns and budgets.

Demonstrated success generating qualified leads and supporting measurable commercial outcomes.

Strong understanding of acquisition funnels, conversion optimisation and performance marketing metrics.

Experience using CRM, analytics or marketing automation platforms, with strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data into decisions.

Experience working closely with sales or Business Development teams, with strong project and stakeholder management skills.

Experience that would be valuable

Experience in B2B, SME, SaaS, fintech, payments, POS or technology businesses, particularly marketing to small and medium-sized businesses in Singapore.

Exposure to offline demand generation, events, partnerships or field marketing.

Commercially minded, analytical and hands-on, with curiosity and a willingness to test new acquisition approaches.

Benefits

What success looks like

Success means a scalable, diversified Singapore demand generation engine that delivers higher-quality leads, stronger funnel conversion and more efficient customer acquisition. The role demonstrates a measurable contribution to pipeline and revenue while supporting the Senior Marketing Manager’s wider marketing priorities.

title: Senior Marketing & Communications Specialist
description:
Overview

ENGIE is a global energy company, a leading provider of electricity, natural gas, and energy services. With 100 000 employees in more than 70 countries worldwide, ENGIE achieved revenue of €95 billion in 2023. ENGIE is committed to being a leader in the energy transition. We are looking for talented and motivated people to create the future of energy. Join a rewarding and flexible work environment that encourages innovation and creativity, and help us meet the energy challenges of today and tomorrow.

The Supply & Energy Management (S&EM) Global Business Unit covers trading and risk management activities as well as B2B and B2C supply activities across a large and highly diversified energy portfolio, including electricity, natural gas, biomass, LNG and other fuels, CO2 and environmental products

Within the S&EM Business Unit, Business Platform APAC is developing ENGIE’s trading and risk management activities across the APAC region, Middle East and India, around 4 main pillars: risk management and market access, asset management, green solutions and energy supply businesses.

Purpose

The Senior Marketing & Communications Specialist supports the development and delivery of integrated marketing and communications activities that strengthen ENGIE’s Supply & Energy Management positioning and business growth across Asia.The role serves as a regional principal Marketing and Communications focal point of contact for S&EM activities across markets in the region, including Singapore and Japan, working closely ensuring consistency of S&EM’s positioning and coordinating with the relevant Country, GBU and Group Communications teams to ensure consistent messaging, brand alignment and effective execution in accordance with the ENGIE Communications operating model. Communications accountability in individual markets remains with the respective Country Communications teams.

The role contributes to positioning ENGIE as a credible partner in energy supply, renewable energy solutions, corporate PPAs, environmental products, energy management and decarbonisation. Working with commercial, trading and business development teams, the role supports market-facing campaigns, thought leadership, customer engagement initiatives and communications materials that build visibility and enable business development.

Key Responsibilities

Business marketing and commercial support: Support the planning and execution of marketing and communications activities aligned with S&EM growth objectives; work with commercial and business development teams to develop customer-facing materials; and prepare sales-enablement content, presentations, business profiles and solution collateral.

Thought leadership and market positioning: Support and in the development of markets relevant to S&EM’s regional activities and client coverage market insights, executive viewpoints, case studies, industry articles and customer success stories; work with subject matter experts to translate complex market and trading topics into clear, engaging content for customers and internal stakeholders.

External communications and reputation: Support proactive communications activities linked to S&EM business priorities; draft and coordinate media materials, press releases, industry submissions and external messaging; monitor relevant industry developments and support issues management preparation when required.

Digital marketing and content: Manage and produce content for websites, LinkedIn and other relevant channels; maintain an S&EM editorial calendar aligned to commercial priorities; develop campaign assets, newsletters, infographics, videos and presentations; and track engagement and campaign performance indicators.

Events and customer engagement: Coordinate communications and marketing support for industry conferences, customer forums, webinars, roundtables and trade exhibitions; prepare event content, key messages and engagement materials; and support regional customer engagement initiatives.

Internal communications: Prepare internal communications materials that build awareness of S&EM’s activities, products and capabilities across ENGIE; support leadership communications, employee engagement content and regional announcements.

Brand and governance: Ensure communications and marketing materials follow ENGIE brand standards; coordinate with ENGIE Group and regional communications teams; and apply established communications review and approval processes.

Qualifications, skills and experience

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Public Relations, Journalism or a related discipline.

Professional communications, digital marketing or brand-related certification would be advantageous.

Technical Skills & Experience

4 years’ experience in B2B marketing, communications, corporate affairs, digital marketing or a related field.

Exposure to power, utilities, energy trading, renewable energy, sustainability, infrastructure or related sectors would be advantageous.

Good understanding of commercial marketing, customer engagement and business development support.

Experience assisting with thought leadership content, digital campaigns, customer-facing communications materials and executive presentations.

Strong writing, editing, messaging and storytelling capability, with the ability to simplify technical energy and market topics for different audiences.

Ability to coordinate with stakeholders across commercial, trading, leadership, communications and regional teams.

Competencies

Clear communication and business partnering mindset.

Commercial awareness and ability to connect marketing activities to business priorities.

Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

Creativity, curiosity and ability to develop compelling market-facing narratives.

High attention to detail, brand discipline and governance mindset.

Ability to work independently while seeking alignment in a regional, matrixed environment.

ENGIE Energy Marketing Singapore Pte Ltd

ENGIE Energy Marketing Singapore Pte Ltd is the LNG trading platform at the heart of ENGIE, a global energy player in the three businesses of gas, power and energy services, and a comprehensive presence throughout the energy value chain.

Combining in-depth industry experience and financial-market know-how, we serve with LNG solutions all ENGIE business activities worldwide and trade LNG with third parties, from upstream producers to downstream utilities.

ENGIE Energy Marketing Singapore Pte Ltd also has a local presence in Europe (Paris, London, and Madrid).

Unequivocally client-focused, we bring the best of both worlds – energy and trading – to our business partners, be they within the Group or external customers.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Kiztopia Group is a leading family edutainment and active entertainment business dedicated to creating meaningful, engaging experiences through play, exploration and movement.

With multiple concepts and locations across Singapore and the region, we continue to grow our portfolio through innovation, creativity and a commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences.

Our established Kiztopia brand brings families together through purposeful play, while Xventure, our next-generation indoor actives ports park, introduces exciting experiences designed for older children, youths, young adults and families.

As we expand, we are looking for passionate and capable individuals to help strengthen our brands, grow our customer base and shape the future of entertainment in Singapore.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a

commercially driven, creative and hands-on Marketing Manager

to lead the marketing strategy, planning and execution for Kiztopia Group's Singapore businesses, including Kiztopia and Xventure.

You will take ownership of integrated marketing initiatives that strengthen brand positioning, increase customer acquisition, drive visitorship and contribute to business growth.

This role requires someone who can translate business objectives into actionable marketing strategies, balance brand-building with performance marketing, and lead campaigns from concept through execution and performance evaluation.

You will manage marketing budgets, guide team members, coordinate external agencies and work closely with Commercial, Operations and other stakeholders to deliver results.

We are looking for a well-rounded marketing leader who is equally comfortable developing strategy, analysing performance and getting involved in execution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketing Strategy & Business Growth

Develop and lead integrated marketing strategies for Kiztopia and Xventure, aligned with brand positioning, commercial objectives and business priorities.

Translate revenue targets, visitorship goals and customer acquisition objectives into actionable monthly, quarterly and annual marketing plans.

Develop targeted strategies for different customer segments, including families, children, youths, young adults, schools and relevant community groups.

Identify opportunities to drive ticket sales, increase repeat visits, build brand loyalty and strengthen customer lifetime value.

Plan and manage campaigns across business-as-usual operations, seasonal peaks, new outlet launches and special events.

Monitor consumer trends, competitor activities and market opportunities to keep our brands relevant and competitive.

2. Integrated Campaign Management

Lead end-to-end planning and execution of marketing campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels.

Develop clear campaign objectives, audience targeting, promotional mechanics, timelines, budgets and measurable KPIs.

Oversee campaign delivery across social media, digital advertising, CRM, website, partnerships, PR and on-ground activations.

Establish effective customer journeys from awareness and engagement through to ticket purchase and repeat visits.

Ensure campaigns are delivered on time, within budget and aligned with business objectives.

Review campaign effectiveness and refine strategies based on performance data and customer response.

3. Digital Marketing & Performance Management

Lead digital marketing strategies across platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok and other relevant channels.

Manage advertising budgets and optimise resource allocation based on campaign objectives and performance.

Oversee audience segmentation, retargeting, conversion campaigns and relevant testing initiatives.

Monitor key performance indicators such as reach, engagement, website traffic, acquisition cost, conversions and attributable revenue.

Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency, conversion rates and return on marketing investment.

Work with relevant stakeholders to improve website, booking and ticketing conversion journeys.

4. Brand, Social Media & Content Strategy

Own the overall brand marketing direction and ensure consistent positioning across campaigns and communication channels.

Develop differentiated content and communication strategies for Kiztopia and Xventure based on their respective target audiences.

Lead social media planning across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and other relevant platforms.

Guide the development of engaging content, including short-form videos, attraction highlights, promotional campaigns, customer experiences and community-driven content.

Review creative concepts, campaign messaging and marketing assets to ensure brand consistency and audience relevance.

Identify emerging content formats, cultural trends and creative opportunities that can strengthen organic reach and brand visibility.

Work closely with the marketing team, content creators and external agencies to deliver relevant, high-quality content.

title: Sales Manager Asia
description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

Context (challenges, specific issues):

The position is based in Singapore with regional responsibility across Asia.
Responsible for developing business in diverse Asian markets, each with different customer requirements, competitive environments, procurement practices and regulatory considerations.
Requires effective navigation of the Business Line/DGDI matrix organisation, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders across organisations without direct hierarchical authority.
Requires the ability to identify, shape and capture opportunities at an early stage and translate customer needs into viable business opportunities for Thales.
Requires strong commercial judgement, customer relationship skills and the ability to manage complex, long-cycle opportunities involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.
Requires the ability to operate effectively in a multi-cultural environment and to engage confidently with senior customers, government stakeholders, partners and industry leaders.

Missions and responsibilities:

Regional Sales Development

Own and drive sales activities (with Sales Consultants) for opportunities across Asia, in alignment with Business Line strategy.
Take ownership of key opportunities from early identification and qualification through capture, bid, negotiation and contract award.
Develop and maintain clear opportunity/sales strategies & plans, capture plans, win themes, stakeholder maps and customer engagement strategies for strategic pursuits to achieve Order Intake and growth objectives.
Apply left-shift principles to shape opportunities early and influence customer requirements, procurement strategies, solution definition and partner ecosystems.
Build, maintain and continuously develop a strong and clear opportunities pipeline by identifying new customers, markets, opportunities and business models.
Qualify and prioritise opportunities based on strategic value, probability of success, competitive position and required resources.
Lead commercial engagement and negotiations within delegated authority and in accordance with Thales governance requirements.
Contribute directly to the achievement of regional Order Intake, pipeline and business objectives.

Customer & Market Engagement

Establish and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders across Air Navigation Service Providers (ANSPs), aviation authorities, airports, airlines, government agencies and other relevant aviation and industry organisations.
Lead customer engagements, meetings and presentations for assigned opportunities and represent the AMS Business Line at an appropriate senior level.
Develop a strong understanding of customer strategies, operational requirements, procurement priorities and decision-making processes, translating customer insight into actionable business opportunities.
Work closely with Country Directors and Key Account Managers to ensure coordinated and effective customer engagement.
Build and maintain a strong network across aviation, government, industry, suppliers, technology partners and academic institutions.
Provide market intelligence and competitive insight to support regional strategy, opportunity positioning and Business Line decision-making.

Opportunity Capture, Bid & Negotiation

Lead or co-lead capture activities for strategically important opportunities, coordinating Business Line, country and functional stakeholders.
Develop and maintain capture plans, opportunity strategies, customer engagement plans and competitive positioning.
Work closely with Bid Management, Engineering, Product Management, Finance, Legal, Contracts, Procurement and other stakeholders to develop compelling, competitive and commercially sound offers.
Ensure appropriate governance, quality, commercial discipline and adherence to critical timelines throughout the opportunity lifecycle.
Identify key risks, dependencies and resource requirements at an early stage and escalate appropriately to the Regional Sales Director and relevant Business Line management.
Develop and manage strategic partnerships and local industrial relationships, in cooperation with DGDI Country organisations, to strengthen Thales' competitive position and probability of success.

Business Line / DGDI Matrix Collaboration

Develop effective working relationships with the DGDI Country organisation to align Business Line opportunities with country strategies and priorities.
Work closely with Country Directors and local teams to coordinate customer engagement, opportunity development, partnerships and market access.
Ensure appropriate alignment of roles, responsibilities and priorities between the Business Line and DGDI Country organisations throughout the sales and capture lifecycle.
Influence and mobilise stakeholders across the matrix to achieve common business objectives without relying on hierarchical authority.
Facilitate effective sharing of customer insight, market intelligence, opportunity strategies and best practices across the relevant organisations.
Identify opportunities for collaboration with other Thales Business Lines where this can strengthen customer value propositions and create additional business opportunities.

Pipeline, Forecasting & Commercial Performance

Own the quality, accuracy and development of the assigned regional sales pipeline.
Ensure opportunities are properly qualified, prioritised and regularly updated in accordance with Thales processes.
Provide regular pipeline reviews, sales forecasts, opportunity assessments and business updates to the Regional Sales Director and relevant Business Line management.
Monitor performance against Order Intake, pipeline and business objectives and proactively develop corrective actions where required.
Ensure sales activities and opportunity development remain aligned with Business Line strategic priorities and relevant country business plans.
Maintain appropriate commercial discipline throughout the sales process, including accurate forecasting, opportunity qualification and reporting.

Compliance, Ethics & Integrity

Conduct all sales, business development, customer engagement and commercial activities in full accordance with Thales compliance policies, procedures, ethical standards, integrity principles and applicable laws and regulations.
Ensure that commercial objectives are pursued within the compliance and ethical boundaries established by Thales, without compromising the company's integrity standards.
Exercise sound judgement in identifying potential compliance, ethical or integrity risks and ensure that such matters are appropriately raised and escalated through the established Thales processes.
Ensure that relationships with customers, partners, suppliers and other external stakeholders are managed in accordance with applicable Thales policies and governance requirements.
Maintain a strong culture of integrity and responsible business conduct throughout all opportunity and customer activities.

Strategic Partnerships & Business Development

Identify, assess and develop strategic partnerships, alliances and local industrial relationships that can strengthen Thales' market position and support business growth.
Work with DGDI Country organisations and Business Line stakeholders to develop sustainable ecosystems around strategic opportunities.
Identify new markets, adjacent opportunities and longer-term growth opportunities for Airspace Mobility Solutions in Asia.

Develop relationships with key industry, government, technology and institutional stakeholders that can support future business development.

Marketing & Market Development

Represent Airspace Mobility Solutions at selected industry, government and customer events across the region.
Support and, where appropriate, lead customer workshops, seminars, demonstrations, presentations and other market-development activities.
Provide market and customer insight to regional marketing and business development activities.
Contribute to positioning Thales as a leading technology and business partner within the regional aviation ecosystem.

Requirement :

Required Education/Certificate:

University Degree in Aeronautics, Electronics Engineering, Business or a related discipline.
Additional qualifications in business, sales, strategy or a relevant technical discipline would be advantageous.

Working Experience:

Typically 10+ years of relevant sales, business development, capture or commercial experience, preferably within the aviation, aerospace, defense or related high-technology sector.
Proven experience in managing complex B2B and/or government opportunities involving long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders.
Experience working with ANSPs, aviation authorities, airports, airlines, government agencies or other major aviation stakeholders is highly desirable.
Strong knowledge of the Air Traffic Management / Airspace Mobility / Surveillance industry is highly preferred.
Demonstrated track record of developing and converting significant business opportunities and delivering measurable commercial results.
Experience working successfully within a matrix organisation and across multiple countries and cultures.
Experience in strategic account development, opportunity capture, complex bid management and commercial negotiation.
Proven ability to establish and maintain relationships with senior customer and government stakeholders.

Personnel Skills:

Strong commercial acumen with a strategic business development mindset.
Demonstrated ability to own opportunities, influence stakeholders and deliver measurable business results.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills.
Strong influencing and stakeholder-management capability, particularly within a matrix organisation.
Ability to develop compelling opportunity strategies and competitive positioning.
Strong analytical capability and commercial judgement, with the ability to assess opportunities, risks and priorities.
Able to operate effectively at both strategic and operational levels.
Proactive, entrepreneurial and results-oriented approach to business development.
Strong collaboration skills and ability to mobilise diverse internal and external stakeholders towards common objectives.
Comfortable operating in complex, ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.
Strong cultural awareness and ability to work effectively across diverse Asian markets.
Demonstrates high standards of personal integrity and sound judgement, with the ability to balance commercial objectives with Thales' compliance, ethical and integrity requirements.
Strong commitment to Thales governance, compliance and responsible business practices.

Other:

Willingness to travel extensively across Asia and, where required, internationally.
Able to manage multiple strategic opportunities simultaneously and operate effectively under pressure.
Ability to represent Thales professionally with senior customers, government stakeholders, partners and industry leaders.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

in Brand Protection, corporate or supply-chain security, investigations, Customs or law enforcement, or closely related industry engagement roles.

Application – Brand Protection Lead, APAC

TAPA APAC

The Leading Association for Global Supply Chain Resilience & Sustainability

The Transported Asset Protection Association (TAPA) is the leading global association that unites supply chain industry leaders and organizations with the common aim of upholding the highest standards of supply chain resilience and sustainability.

Today, in Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA), The Americas and Asia Pacific (APAC), TAPA’s membership is at its highest ever level – and growing month-on-month. The Association’s members include many of the world’s leading manufacturing brands as well as their logistics and transport providers with combined annual sales of over US$900 billion.

Manufacturers & Shippers;

Logistic Service Providers;

Security Service Providers;

Insurance Providers;

Parking Place Operators;

Independent Audit Bodies;

Law Enforcement Agencies, Government Entities & Customs Partners;

Academic Partners and others.

To minimize cargo losses from the supply chain. Vision

TAPA’s vision is an international supply chain where controlled and traceable product can be transported in a cost efficient and secure environment.

Since 2012 we have worked with more than 700 students, and most of our new families come to us through referrals. We deliver a fully integrated journey for families: academic mastery, guardianship, and university placement under one roof.

We aim to bring out the best in our students, ignite opportunities and nurture them towards success.

We are looking for committed and talented additions to our team. As an ideal candidate, you should display a proven ability to develop and maintain an environment of trust, diversity, and inclusion within the QE team. You should be able to work with the team to meet deadlines and instill a culture of continuous work improvement.

As part of the position, you will work with the founders, Ivy League and Oxbridge graduates and other high-performing teammates.

The Role

We're looking for a Communications Executive to own the day-to-day relationship between QE and our families. You'll be the first person a parent speaks to when they enquire, and the person who keeps them informed once their child is with us. That means answering enquiries every day, matching students with the right tutors and mentors, and following up with students and parents regularly so nothing slips through.

You'll also help keep our marketing materials and partner relationships in good order. We are open to full-time or part-time candidates, so tell us the arrangement that works for you.

If you're a confident communicator in both English and Mandarin\*, stay calm and warm with demanding parents, and like being the person who makes sure things actually get done — we'd love to meet you.

This is a temporary role for 6 months to cover a colleague on leave for 4-6 months. If desired, conversion to full time permanent can be discussed closer from the 5-6th month onwards.

\*As a major group of customers are from China and are only able to converse in Mandarin.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Enquiries & Enrolment

* Respond to daily parent and student enquiries via phone, WhatsApp, WeChat, and email, ideally within the same working day.
* Explain our IGCSE, IB, and admissions programmes clearly and recommend the right fit for each student.
* Match students with suitable tutors and mentors, and arrange trial lessons and consultations.
* Track every enquiry through to enrolment and follow up with families who have not yet decided.

2. Student Follow-Up & Parent Relations

* Check in regularly with enrolled students and parents on progress, attendance, and any concerns.
* Collect lesson feedback from students and tutors, and deal with issues early before they become complaints.
* Arrange class schedules, replacement lessons, and changes with tutors and families.
* Keep parents informed ahead of key moments: exam periods, predicted grades, application deadlines, and results day.
* Follow up on renewals and next-stage programmes (e.g. IGCSE to IB, IB to university applications).

3. Business Operations

* Prepare and track invoices and payments.
* Draft and manage service agreements for clients and tutors.
* Keep client records, notes, and follow-up schedules up to date.
* Keep a simple monthly record of enquiries, enrolments, and renewals for the founders.

4. Marketing & Partnerships

* Keep brochures, website content, and newsletters accurate and up to date.
* Work with design and digital marketing agencies on campaigns and collateral.
* Support parent seminars and events, including Mandarin-language sessions with our China school partners.
* Maintain relationships with partner schools, education consultants, and collaborators.

We're Looking For Someone Who:

* Has experience in a client-facing role such as education, admissions, client services, or customer service. Fresh graduates with strong communication skills are welcome to apply.
* Has excellent verbal and written communication in English and Chinese. This is required as some Chinese customers can only communicate in Chinese. Japanese and Korean are a bonus as some customers only communicate in these languages.
* Is calm, warm, and professional with high-expectation parents, and comfortable handling difficult conversations.
* Is highly organised, follows up without being reminded, and keeps clear records.
* Can manage many families and a busy inbox at the same time without losing track of details.
* Is proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), Notion or Airtable, and marketing tools (Mailchimp, Canva).
* Is comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) and light automation to streamline workflows.

Bonus If You:

* Have experience in the education, tuition, or admissions sector.
* Know the IB, IGCSE, or university application process (UK, US, or Singapore).
* Are familiar with WeChat or Xiaohongshu.

Working Hours

Location: 545 Orchard Road, #14-06/9, Singapore 238882. In Person role.

Start Date: As soon as possible

Commitment: Full-time or part-time. Propose the days and hours that suit you in your application.

* Full-time: 5-day work week, Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, 4 days in office and 1 day remote
* Part-time: Days and hours by arrangement, with enough weekday cover to keep up with daily enquiries

Salary & Benefits

* Monthly Salary: $4,500 upwards for full-time, depending on experience; pro-rated for part-time
* Bonuses: Additional performance and team-based bonuses apply
* Benefits Include: $500 Specialist Stipend per annum (e.g. medical or mental health support), $100 Dental Stipend per annum, $500 Personal Development Stipend per annum (for courses, books, conferences, etc.)

Send your CV and a short paragraph on why you're interested in the role to hr@qeducation.sg with the subject line: Application – Communications Executive (Full Time / Part Time)

title: Manager, Exhibitor Marketing & Buyer Programmes
description:
The Manager, Exhibitor Marketing & Buyer Programmes leads exhibitor-facing marketing and high-value buyer programmes across IAPL’s portfolio of shows.

The role supports exhibitor recruitment and retention through year-round marketing campaigns, while also taking ownership of hosted and high-value buyer acquisition, matchmaking and guaranteed meeting programmes that directly contribute to the value delivered to exhibitors.

The position works across InfoComm India and InfoComm Asia, as well as international buyer recruitment for InfoComm China. As a team member working closely with the Sales team, the role connects exhibitor requirements with qualified buyer acquisition and helps demonstrate measurable return on investment to exhibitors.

For InfoComm Asia, the role will work closely with the Senior Marketing Manager, who owns the overall visitor and audience strategy, with this position specifically responsible for the hosted and high-value buyer segment.

*KEY INDUSTRIES*

* Professional audiovisual and integrated experiential communications technology
* Emerging technologies including AI, IoT, 5G, AR/VR/MR, Big Data Analytics, Drones, Robotics, Content Development (Software), Wearables and Cloud Applications

*OVERALL RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES*

*Exhibitor Marketing*

* Lead and execute year-round exhibitor marketing campaigns that support exhibitor recruitment, retention and rebooking across IAPL’s portfolio of shows.
* Achieve agreed sales-accepted lead targets for exhibitor recruitment and provide Sales with a consistent pipeline of qualified prospects.
* Develop exhibitor-facing marketing materials including sector collateral, sales prospectuses, case studies, testimonials and ROI evidence that support the Sales team in converting prospects.
* Own exhibitor communications across the pre-show, onsite and post-show journey, ensuring communications are timely, accurate and relevant.
* Develop campaigns that demonstrate the business value and ROI of participating in IAPL’s exhibitions.
* Develop co-marketing and advocacy programmes with exhibitors to extend buyer reach.
* Support exhibitor retention and rebooking activities through post-show communications, performance reporting and ROI evidence.
* Work closely with Sales to understand exhibitor requirements, market feedback and commercial priorities.

*High-Value & Hosted Buyer Acquisition*

* Own and deliver hosted and high-value buyer acquisition programmes against agreed recruitment, attendance and quality targets.
* Source, identify and qualify senior decision-makers, buyers, specifiers and other high-value attendees relevant to the exhibitor mix.
* Manage the complete buyer journey including sourcing, qualification, invitation, confirmation, communications, attendance and onsite experience.
* Lead overseas hosted and local high-value strategic buyer programmes for InfoComm India and InfoComm Asia.
* Recruit and manage international buyers attending InfoComm China in collaboration with the China marketing team.
* Develop qualification criteria to ensure buyer profiles meet agreed programme requirements and are relevant to participating exhibitors.
* Monitor buyer registration and confirmation pipelines, identify potential shortfalls early and implement corrective actions.
* Manage buyer attendance and no-show rates to maximise programme effectiveness.

*Matchmaking & Guaranteed Meetings*

* Design, manage and deliver exhibitor–buyer matchmaking and guaranteed meeting programmes against commitments sold to exhibitors.
* Work closely with Sales to understand contractual meeting commitments and exhibitor buyer-profile requirements.
* Match qualified buyers with relevant exhibitors based on purchasing requirements, product interests, industry sector and other agreed criteria.
* Track scheduled and completed meetings against targets and contractual commitments.
* Identify potential meeting shortfalls early and work with Sales and relevant teams to implement corrective actions.
* Ensure accurate records are maintained for scheduled, completed, cancelled and no-show meetings.
* Collect feedback from exhibitors and buyers to continuously improve the matchmaking programme.

*Agency, Vendor & Programme Management*

* Manage buyer acquisition agencies, matchmaking platforms and event vendors against agreed scope, budget, timeline and performance targets.
* Establish clear KPIs and deliverables for external agencies and vendors.
* Monitor agency performance including buyer quality, attendance, cost per qualified buyer and delivery against contracted targets.
* Ensure external expenditure remains within approved budgets and flag potential variances in a timely manner.
* Evaluate vendor and agency effectiveness following each show and recommend improvements for future cycles.

*Sponsorship Delivery & Fulfilment*

* Coordinate with Sales, Operations and Marketing to ensure marketing-related sponsorship and exhibitor deliverables are fulfilled as contracted.
* Maintain clear records of relevant exhibitor and sponsorship commitments and monitor delivery status.
* Work with Sales to ensure that buyer and matchmaking commitments sold to exhibitors are understood and appropriately delivered.
* Support onsite delivery of hosted buyer, matchmaking and exhibitor programmes.
* Produce post-show exhibitor ROI reporting jointly with Sales.
* Contribute to exhibitor NPS, satisfaction and rebooking initiatives.

*Data, CRM & Reporting*

* Maintain high-value buyer information within CRM and marketing automation platforms.
* Use CRM data to segment, target and track buyer campaigns.
* Provide timely updates on exhibitor lead generation, buyer recruitment pipeline, confirmed buyers, meeting volumes and overall programme status.
* Track campaign and programme performance against agreed KPIs.
* Analyse buyer profiles, attendance, meeting completion and exhibitor feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Produce post-show analysis covering buyer performance, matchmaking results, exhibitor engagement and programme effectiveness.
* Maintain high standards of data quality and accuracy across buyer databases.

*Collaboration*

* Work closely with Sales on B2B/exhibitor promotion, marketing priorities, buyer requirements, contractual commitments and post-show reporting.
* Work with the Show Marketing Managers across shows to ensure high-value and hosted buyer programmes are aligned with the overall audience strategy.
* Work closely with Operations on onsite buyer and sponsor delivery.
* Contribute to marketing campaigns across IAPL’s three expos and work with counterpart teams across the wider global show portfolio.
* Maintain awareness of industry trends, key market players, buyer requirements and competing regional events.

*EXPERIENCE & ATTRIBUTES*

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in B2B sales/marketing, exhibition marketing, buyer acquisition, event marketing, exhibition sales support or a related field.
* At least 2 years of experience leading campaigns, programmes or projects with measurable targets.
* Experience in hosted buyer, delegate acquisition, audience acquisition or exhibitor–buyer matchmaking programmes is highly preferred.
* Experience within trade exhibitions, conferences, B2B events or related industries would be a strong advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to manage external agencies, vendors and programme partners.
* Commercially aware and comfortable working with targets, budgets and performance data.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills with the ability to monitor buyer pipelines, conversion rates and programme performance.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to achieve and exceed buyer and lead-generation targets.
* Dependable with strong follow-through on commitments made to exhibitors and internal stakeholders.
* Highly organised with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple programmes simultaneously.
* Experienced with marketing automation and CRM platforms such as HubSpot or equivalent, and confident working with database segmentation, data quality and analysis.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and customer service skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
* Self-starter, problem solver and collaborative team player.
* Ability to work effectively in a matrix environment and with global teams.
* Able and willing to travel domestically and internationally as required.

*WHAT WE OFFER*

* Remote / work-from-home arrangement
* Health benefits
* Multicultural and international working environment
* Regional exposure across China, India, Malaysia and Southeast Asia
* Opportunity to develop and manage high-value buyer and exhibitor programmes across three major professional audiovisual trade shows
* Collaboration with international teams across a global portfolio of professional audiovisual exhibitions

title: Senior Manager, Business Development – Carousell Luxury
description:
Company Description

Carousell Group is the leading recommerce group in Greater Southeast Asia on a mission to inspire the world to start selling, and to make secondhand the first choice. Negotiate terms, sign and manage partners, and track performance weekly

Own the numbers

Set targets, track partner performance, and report progress to leadership every week

Experience in B2B partnerships, business development or wholesale, ideally in luxury, resale or retail

Comfortable owning targets and reporting against them weekly

Why join us

Build new partnerships and channels from the ground up, with real ownership and visibility to leadership
Work at the intersection of luxury, recommerce and marketplaces at Southeast Asia’s leading recommerce platform
A cross-functional role where your decisions directly shape how the business grows

Additional Information

By proceeding with your application, you are adhering to our PDPA policies. In case you are interested to know more, read about our Candidates Personal Data Privacy Statement.

title: Director of Catering Sales & Conference Services
description:
Position Overview

The Director of Catering Sales & Conference Service Manager is responsible for all areas of the Catering Sales & Conference Services department. The individual provides our guests with specialized and personalized service for events and group accommodation management with responsibilities revolving around ensuring a smooth transition Pre-Sales to Post Event Phase through efficient coordination and communication.

The Role

Sales Activities

Develop high-level strategies for each business segment, with clear timelines, target accounts and specific actions.

Prepare an action plan with priorities, milestones and measurable outcomes.

Develop a proactive sales call plan to the Director of Sales & Marketing.

Create a citywide events calendar, outlining the hotel's commercial strategy and actions for each opportunity.

Create a segmented client database with clear account ownership and growth potential.

Analyse banquet performance to identify key producers and lost business.

Drive account reactivation through targeted outreach and clear timelines.

Benchmark five key competitors to assess market positioning and competitiveness.

Develop a personalised wedding journey, from bespoke consultations to post-wedding engagement, anniversaries and future family celebrations.

Develop and implement personalized site inspection SOPs for Events and Weddings, ensuring cross-department coordination, effective sales conversion and timely follow-up.

Partner with Marketing Communications to develop and execute catering marketing plans by segment, reviewing performance regularly to improve lead quality and conversion.

Maximize sales and upselling/cross-selling opportunities through soliciting new catering accounts and maintaining relationship with existing accounts

Conduct site inspections

Prepare and present sales contract to clients for Catering & Social Events

Execution of Group Contracts

Collaborate and communicate with relevant departments to meet guests' requirements

Ensure high level of customer satisfaction is achieved through professionalism in all aspects of event delivery

Booking of function spaces, follow up on room attrition and timeline for rooming lists

Timely and accuracy preparation of Group Resumes, Banquet Event Orders, Internal Reports and Billing

Meet or exceed individual and group catering sales target set by the management

Determines availability of space based on yield management principles

Lead participation in relevant industry events, trade exhibitions and sales trips for networking and lead generation

Preparations of department reports

Attends and chairs meetings

Manage Team

Supervise and support Catering Sales & Conference Services Team

Present sales reports and recommendations for management updates and decision-making

Lead weekly team meetings and regular one-to-ones to drive accountability and performance.

Develop individual growth plans, monitor progress and address risks proactively.

Uphold grooming standards and lead by example in professional presentation.

Talent Profile

Diploma in Hospitality Management

Minimum 5-7 years working experience in Catering & Conference Services for an upscale property

Prior experience in managing a team

Knowledge in Microsoft Office including words, excel, power point

Knowledge in Opera Cloud

Basic knowledge of AV equipment

Understanding of room space, entertainment options, menus, floral options

Able to lead and train new team members

CAPELLA HOTEL, SINGAPORE
