title: Specialist Solutions Architect, Radar (APAC)
description:
Specialist Solutions Architect, Radar (Fraud)
Who We Are
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About The Team

Specialist Solutions Architects (SSA) are domain experts aligned to specific Stripe solutions and customer buying centers. We have in-depth knowledge of specific solution offerings and a deep understanding of customer challenges. We align with specialist product sellers on deals, advise the broader pre-sales team on complex opportunities, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, serve as an advisor on go-to-market sales plays, and provide critical insights to our product and engineering teams.

Stripe Radar is Stripe's fully integrated fraud and risk management platform. The Radar team's mission is to evolve from a best-in-class payment fraud product into a unified risk intelligence platform that protects businesses from all forms of financial loss-from sophisticated payment fraud and account takeovers to first-party misuse and policy abuse. With Radar, businesses can confidently navigate the evolving fraud landscape, accept more good revenue, and focus on growth.
What You'll Do

You will collaborate closely with sales and pre-sales teams to drive pipeline and revenue targets, while also educating the product and engineering teams on market trends and strongly influencing the product roadmap. You will develop deep relationships with senior customer business leaders and grow Stripe's solution offerings with new and existing customers. As a subject matter expert, you will scale the broader organization by creating reusable assets and coaching others on complex, high-value opportunities. You will serve as the domain and product expert to our users and GTM team for Stripe Radar globally.
Responsibilities

Act as a subject matter expert on Stripe's Radar product suite to accelerate opportunities globally
Demonstrate a deep understanding of trends in the fraud and risk management ecosystem, including AI-powered detection, processor-agnostic architectures, and the shift from payment fraud to holistic business risk (policy abuse, account takeover, first-party misuse)
Develop expertise with the functional and architectural patterns for deploying advanced fraud systems, including the lifecycle of rule management, ML model tuning, and manual review optimization
Understand the ecosystem of risk and identity integrations (device fingerprinting, identity verification, bot mitigation, case management) Stripe must support for users to be successful
Define, share, and learn best practices and reusable assets with the broader GTM organization to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team
Create reference architectures to uplevel the team and refine reference solutions based on product enhancements and customer feedback
Partner closely with the Radar product sales team on Stripe's largest and most complex Radar opportunities, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships
Partner closely with the Radar product team to get early exposure to new products and features
Serve as a "Voice of the Customer" internally to drive product and feature request prioritization, providing actionable insights on the competitive landscape and emerging fraud vectors
Act as an escalation point to drive complex technical issues to resolution with Stripe's engineering team
Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation
Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows
Who You Are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum Requirements

7+ years of experience in a pre-sales, technical consulting, product, or risk strategy role focused on e-commerce fraud prevention, risk management, or trust and safety
Deep working knowledge of the fraud and risk ecosystem, including payment fraud (CNP), account takeover (ATO), first-party misuse (friendly fraud), and policy/content abuse
Demonstrated knowledge of risk management architectures, including the role of rules engines, machine learning models, and manual review queues in fraud decisioning
Strong knowledge of the signals and data used in fraud detection: device/IP data, behavioral biometrics, identity verification, and graph-based analysis
Strong knowledge of software engineering and architecture patterns, with the ability to understand how a wide variety of technologies and systems interact
Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, comfortable explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners
Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment
Strong proficiency in English and Mandarin and the position would require you to communicate with customers based in the Greater China region.
Preferred Qualifications

Experience integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications
Experience with processor-agnostic fraud solutions and multi-processor payment environments
Experience with risk management for platforms/marketplaces, subscription services, and digital goods
Familiarity with liability shift programs (chargeback guarantees) and value-based pricing models for risk products
Understanding of how to extend fraud protection across the payment lifecycle-payouts (Issuing), in-person (Terminal), or recurring (Billing)
Experience as a subject matter expert in a relevant industry, vertical, or product

*Job Highlights:*

* Be part of a *global leading wellness brand*, *Technogym*, that powers *Olympic athletes* and is trusted by luxury gyms, health clubs, and elite sports teams worldwide.
* Be part of a *high performing team* that *challenges individual growth *while continuously innovating in the fitness and wellness industry.

*About the Company*
*SE Active* is the exclusive partner for *Technogym* in Singapore & Malaysia, managing everything from equipment sales to after-sales services and warranty protection. SE Active aims to be the market leader in offering total wellness solutions in both countries, with a customer-first approach to meet fitness and wellness needs. The company's focus is on growing the brand's presence and anchoring market dominance while providing the Technogym experience by embodying its core values.

*About Technogym*

For more than 40 years, we at *Technogym* have been helping people live healthier and happier lives. If 50 million people in the world train on our equipment every day, it’s not just a matter of chance. We are the global experts of wellness, be it for fitness, health, or sports. Reaching over 100 countries in the world, Technogym has brought wellness through movement to thousands of locations around the world. Technogym produces top-notch fitness equipment found in luxury property gyms and has been the Official Supplier of the Olympic Games for ten consecutive editions, from Sydney 2000 to Milano Cortina 2026, supporting Olympic athletes in their quest for excellence.

*Job Overview:*

As an Education & Customer Success Specialist, you will play a key role in elevating Technogym’s brand experience through impactful education, customer engagement, training excellence, and relationship management. You will work closely with internal teams, partners, trainers, and customers to drive product adoption, customer satisfaction, and long-term engagement with Technogym’s wellness ecosystem.

This role combines elements of wellness education, customer success, account support, coaching, community engagement, and event coordination. You will empower internal teams, B2B partners, and end consumers with in-depth product knowledge and training support, while also building strong customer relationships and a network of certified personal trainers and wellness advocates.

You will serve as a key point of contact in ensuring customers receive a seamless experience throughout their journey — from onboarding and training to ongoing engagement and retention. Through proactive support, product education, and community activation initiatives, you will help customers maximize the value of Technogym solutions while strengthening brand loyalty and advocacy.

The ideal candidate is passionate about fitness, wellness, and customer experience, with strong communication and interpersonal skills. You are a confident trainer and relationship builder who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys engaging with diverse audiences, and is committed to delivering exceptional education and customer experiences across markets.

*Responsibilities:*

*1. Internal Product Education & Sales Enablement*

* Lead ongoing product education and training initiatives for the sales team throughout the year.
* Ensure all sales team members complete Technogym’s product storytelling assessments and maintain a minimum performance score across all products.
* Identify underperforming team members and conduct targeted coaching and training sessions to strengthen product knowledge and storytelling capabilities.
* Maintain a minimum personal product knowledge rating, as assessed by the Regional Education & Training Manager, to qualify for delivering storytelling assessments.
* Develop and update training materials, user guides, and educational resources to support internal product learning and customer engagement.

*2. Customer Onboarding, Training & Success Management*

* Support the onboarding of new customers by guiding them through product setup, training, and adoption to ensure a smooth customer experience.
* Conduct quarterly product refresher trainings and ongoing educational sessions for key account clients in collaboration with their internal training managers.
* Coordinate and deliver on-site product training during new equipment installations, ensuring all facility staff receive relevant training materials via the Technogym Trainer Portal.
* Facilitate post-delivery product education sessions for home customers. Where required, coordinate with certified freelance personal trainers from the Technogym training network to deliver training sessions.
* Create and implement customer success plans that outline customer goals, milestones, adoption strategies, and engagement initiatives.
* Educate customers on product features, capabilities, and best practices to maximize product utilization and long-term value.

*3. Customer Relationship Management & Retention*

* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers to understand their operational needs, business goals, and challenges.
* Proactively engage customers through various communication channels to monitor satisfaction, gather feedback, and support ongoing success.
* Monitor customer usage and adoption trends to identify at-risk accounts and implement retention strategies.
* Support account management activities, including license renewals to drive customer retention and long-term account success.
* Address customer concerns, issues, and escalations promptly while coordinating with internal stakeholders to ensure effective resolution.
* Identify and develop customer advocates for testimonials, referrals, case studies, and community engagement opportunities.

*4. Trainer Network Development*

* Expand and manage the Technogym-certified personal trainer network through onboarding, certification, and ongoing engagement initiatives.
* Ensure certified trainers remain up to date with the latest Technogym products, training methodologies, and wellness solutions.
* Maintain the quality and consistency of training standards through regular assessments, refresher programs, and recertification initiatives.

*5. Community Engagement & Wellness Events*

* Collaborate with frontline managers and the marketing team to identify and engage relevant fitness and wellness communities.
* Establish partnerships with coaches, medical professionals, wellness experts, influencers, and other industry stakeholders to support wellness initiatives and community outreach.
* Plan and execute community-focused events, workshops, clinics, and wellness activations with clearly defined KPIs to measure engagement and impact.
* Represent Technogym as a wellness and product ambassador during events, training sessions, and customer engagements.

*6. Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement*

* Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer satisfaction, training effectiveness, customer retention, engagement, and revenue growth.
* Collect and analyze customer feedback to identify trends, areas for improvement, and opportunities to enhance the customer experience.
* Work closely with sales, marketing, after-sales, and regional teams to ensure a seamless and consistent customer journey.
* Stay updated on industry trends, customer success best practices, and Technogym product developments to continuously improve training delivery and customer engagement strategies.

*Requirements:*

* *Bachelor’s degree* in Sports Science, Exercise Physiology, or a related field.
* *5–7 years of experience *in fitness education, personal training, customer success, business development, consultancy, or a similar client-facing role.
* *Strong presentation and training delivery skills* — able to engage, educate, and inspire diverse audiences including sales teams, fitness professionals, and customers.
* Proven experience in *conducting workshops, seminars, or product training sessions* in a professional setting.
* Ability to *build rapport and credibility* quickly with internal stakeholders (e.g., sales team) and external clients.
* *Confident and polished communicator* with excellent interpersonal skills and professional presence.
* Comfortable working *independently and cross-functionally*, with strong organizational and time management skills.
* Tech-savvy with the ability to *navigate digital platforms* for training, communication, and certification delivery.
* Passionate about *fitness, wellness, and the Technogym philosophy* of lifestyle transformation through movement.
* Certification as a *personal trainer or fitness instructor* (e.g., ACE, NASM, NSCA) is a strong advantage.
* Prior experience in a *premium brand environment* or wellness tech company is a plus.
* Proven ability in *customer success*, account management, consultancy, business development, or pre-sales support roles preferred.
* Strong *customer-centric mindset* with a focus on onboarding, engagement, retention, and long-term relationship building preferred.

*Alignment with our Core Values:*

title: Marketing Executive (Events & Digital Media)
description:
Job Summary:

The Marketing Executive will play a key role in driving the digital presence, events and online engagement for projects. This individual will be responsible for executing digital marketing campaigns, managing social media accounts, optimizing the association or project's website, and supporting online content initiatives to enhance the visibility of the association's mission and events. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of digital marketing strategies, social media platforms, and website management.

Key Responsibilities:

Campaign Execution

: Develop and implement digital and event marketing campaigns across various channels (social media, email marketing, website, paid media, etc.) to promote the association’s events, programs, and initiatives.

Content Creation & Management

: Create compelling digital content (e.g., blog posts, articles, newsletters, videos, and graphics) that aligns with the goals and audience interests.

Social Media Management

: Manage and grow the social media presence on platforms like Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, and others. Schedule posts, engage with followers, and monitor trends.

Website Optimization

: Oversee the content management of the website, ensuring that it is up-to-date, user-friendly, and optimized for search engines (SEO).

Email Marketing

: Design and execute email marketing campaigns, including newsletters and event promotions, to engage members and prospects.

Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

: Implement on-page and off-page SEO strategies to improve search rankings and drive organic traffic to the association’s website.

Paid Advertising

: Assist in managing digital advertising campaigns (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, etc.), monitoring budgets, and analyzing the ROI of paid marketing efforts.

Member Engagement

: Leverage digital platforms to engage with members and stakeholders, encouraging participation in the activities, events, and initiatives.

Brand Consistency

: Ensure all digital content aligns with the brand guidelines and voice.

Collaboration

: Work closely with other departments, including event management, membership, and communications teams, to align digital marketing efforts with broader organizational goals.

Leadership

: to lead a team of marketing executives in ensuring timely and consistent delivery of marketing objectives

Skills & Qualifications:

Proven experience (at least 2 year) in marketing.

Solid understanding of digital marketing tools and platforms.

Familiarity with SEO techniques, website management, and content management systems (CMS) is a plus.

Strong knowledge of social media platforms and trends.

Experience with email marketing tools and campaign design.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to create engaging content.

Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and digital design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Canva).

Ability to multitask and manage multiple digital projects simultaneously.

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Ability to lead a team

Preferred Qualifications:

Degree & above specialised in marketing

Compensation:

Competitive salary based on experience.

Additional benefits, including insurance and project incentives.

Overseas travelling opportunity

TAC-Group is one of the leading Association Secretariat Management services companies headquartered in Singapore with office in Malaysia. It currently services more than 14 associations across Singapore and South East Asia.

Green Harvest Pte Ltd is a high-tech hydroponics vegetable farm supplying fresh leafy vegetables to supermarkets, restaurants, HORECA, food-service operators and other business customers across Singapore.

If you are a result-driven professional who enjoys opening new accounts, winning customers and growing business, we want to hear from you.

Sales & Business Development

• Develop new B2B customers across HORECA, food service, catering, supermarkets and retail.

• Proven ability in new customer acquisition, prospecting and account development.

• Strong communication, negotiation, follow-up and relationship-building skills.

• Proactive, commercially driven and comfortable with field sales and customer visits.

• Basic Excel / Google Sheets / email / WhatsApp skills.

• Own vehicle preferred for customer and market visits.

WHY GREEN HARVEST?

Own your sales pipeline and results.

Work closely with management and influence commercial growth.

Represent locally grown fresh produce from a Singapore high-tech hydroponics farm.

YOUR MISSION

PROSPECT → MEET → SAMPLE → QUOTE → CLOSE → GROW

Green Harvest Pte Ltd had constructed South East Asia's largest hydroponics glass greenhouse to use high-tech automation to grow vegetables efficiently and productively.

title: Senior Business Development Executive
description:
About us

We are a Singaporean organization that supports local bakeries by sourcing affordable, high-quality ingredients and providing resources for growth. Guided by our “Wheat” logo, a symbol of our commitment to quality, we supply essential baking products to home bakers and businesses across Singapore.

The role

This is a hybrid role. You will spend most of your time on business development, finding and winning new business. You will also support area operations, helping our operation run smoothly and consistently.

Business development responsibilities

Identify and pursue new sales channels, partners and corporate clients (gifting, events, catering, retail and F&B partnerships, wholesale)

Prepare proposals, quotations and pitches, and negotiate terms

Manage key accounts, including repeat orders and festive-season campaigns

Track the sales pipeline, market trends and competitor activity, and report monthly

Work with Marketing on promotions, collaterals and seasonal launches

Represent the brand at tastings, trade events and partner meetings

Area operations responsibilities

Visit regularly to check service standards, product quality, display and cleanliness

Make sure SOPs are followed, food safety and hygiene requirements

Support on daily sales performance, stock levels and ordering

Coordinate manpower, rostering and shift cover with teams and HR

Follow up on customer feedback and operational issues

Requirements

Diploma or degree in Business, Marketing, Hospitality or a related field

2–4 years of experience in business development, B2B sales, preferably in F&B, bakery or retail

Strong communication, negotiation and people management skills

Self-driven, organised and able to balance sales targets with day-to-day operations

Proficient in Microsoft Office; CRM or POS experience is a plus

Willing to travel between outlets and work weekends, public holidays and event days

title: Content creator
description:
Company Overview

Löyly Studio is Singapore's authentic Finnish sauna space offering traditional sauna rituals with wood-panelled saunas and cold plunges. We promote wellness through heat, cold, and stillness to reduce stress and boost longevity in a founder-led, culture-driven environment.

Job Summary

This role creates engaging short-form video content and educational copy to teach the Finnish sauna ritual, building cultural literacy and habitual sauna practice in Singapore through authentic storytelling and community engagement.

Responsibilities

Shoot and edit short-form vertical videos for Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook independently to showcase the sauna ritual

Write clear, educational captions and short copy explaining sauna practices including löyly, hot-cold cycles, vihta, rest, and etiquette

Build and maintain a digital asset library of B-roll, still photos, guest testimonials (with consent), and event coverage

Capture live moments during guided sauna sessions, community events, and partner activities to enrich content

Analyze engagement metrics such as reach, saves, watch-through rates, and profile visits to inform weekly content reviews

Participate in the sauna ritual weekly to authentically experience and communicate the practice

Required competencies and certifications

Currently enrolled in or recently completed a diploma/degree in Media, Communications, Marketing, Design, or a related field, or possess a portfolio demonstrating equivalent skills

Portfolio of self-shot and self-edited vertical videos with at least 3 links, including view/save metrics if available

Proficient written English with a calm, warm, and unhurried tone, avoiding hype and clickbait

Working knowledge of video editing tools such as CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut, or equivalents, and design tools like Canva or Figma

Comfortable with heat and cold immersion and willing to practice sauna rituals weekly

Own a phone and laptop suitable for content creation

Based in Singapore with legal right to undertake an internship

Preferred competencies and qualifications

Comfortable on camera and willing to present to the lens when the shot calls for it

Prior content work for a consumer wellness, fitness, hospitality or F&B venue, where filming happens around live guests

Working knowledge of Meta Business Suite, native TikTok/Instagram scheduling, and reading platform analytics beyond surface reach

Still photography and light retouching in natural and low light — much of our footage is shot in dim, high-humidity conditions

Basic motion graphics, subtitling and sound design

Copywriting for email or newsletter formats in addition to social captions

Genuine interest in one or more of: Nordic culture, endurance sport, longevity, sleep, or mental wellbeing

Ability to plan a monthly content calendar independently from a set of brand themes, rather than working post-by-post

Availability for evening and weekend coverage, when the studio is busiest and most of our community moments happen

Löyly Studio is a Wellness space inspired by Finnish Sauna tradition and culture.

In Finnish, löyly is the spirit of the sauna—the rising steam, the living breath of the room. To the Finns, it’s sacred. To us, it’s the perfect word for what we want Löyly Studio to be: a space where the spirit of warmth can soften the edges of daily life.

We lead a busy life, inverted work-rest cycles, reports of many people struggling with stress and anxiety and rising burnout across professionals and seniors, and growing interest in longevity and holistic fitness. The solution isn’t always more productivity, or even more exercise. It’s balance.

The kind of balance the sauna offers—a rhythm of heat, cold, and stillness proven to lower cortisol, improve circulation, and eve n boost mood. One Finnish study linked regular sauna use with reduced risk of depression. Another showed that older adults who practiced sauna bathing several times a week lived longer, healthier lives

title: TikTok Performance Marketing Manage
description:
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on TikTok Performance Marketing Manager who specialises in selling physical consumer products through TikTok Shop.

Your primary responsibility is to generate profitable sales through TikTok advertising, particularly TikTok Shop GMV Max campaigns.

We are not looking for a traditional social media manager who focuses on followers, engagement or brand awareness. We want someone who understands how to convert advertising expenditure into revenue, identify winning video advertisements and scale campaigns profitably.

You will work closely with our in-house video production, influencer, affiliate and e-commerce teams to grow our skincare products in Singapore and Malaysia.

Key Responsibilities



-  TikTok Ads & GMV Max Management
-  Independently set up, launch, monitor and optimise TikTok Shop GMV Max campaigns.
-  Manage Product GMV Max campaigns and, where applicable, LIVE GMV Max campaigns.
-  Set appropriate ROI targets, campaign budgets and product selections.
-  Monitor advertising expenditure, GMV, ROI and cost per order daily.
-  Identify underperforming campaigns and implement corrective actions.
-  Optimise advertising expenditure according to product margins and profitability.
-  Troubleshoot issues involving campaign delivery, insufficient spending, poor conversion rates and declining advertising returns.
-  Manage campaigns across Singapore and Malaysia, accounting for differences in consumer behaviour and pricing.
-  Advertising Performance & Profitability
-  Take direct responsibility for achieving assigned online sales and advertising profitability targets.
-  Calculate product-level break-even ROAS based on selling price, cost of goods, platform fees, affiliate commissions and other variable costs.
-  Identify which products generate the highest advertising returns.
-  Recommend suitable promotional prices, product bundles and offers to improve conversion rates.
-  Monitor customer acquisition costs and contribution margin after advertising.
-  Distinguish between sales attributed to advertising and actual incremental sales growth.
-  Scale successful campaigns without compromising profitability.
-  Video Advertising & Creative Optimisation
-  Work directly with the internal video production team to identify and develop high-converting TikTok advertisements.
-  Analyse individual video performance to determine which creatives generate sales.
-  Develop creative briefs covering product pain points, selling propositions, hooks, demonstrations and calls to action.
-  Recommend new video concepts based on advertising performance data.
-  Test different video openings, product demonstrations, offers and messaging.
-  Identify creative fatigue and recommend replacement advertisements before campaign performance deteriorates.
-  Work with the influencer and affiliate teams to identify high-performing creator content suitable for paid advertising.
-  Ensure a consistent pipeline of new advertising creatives for testing.
-  Campaign Testing & Scaling
-  Develop structured testing plans for new products, advertisements and promotional offers.
-  Establish clear criteria for identifying winning and losing creatives.
-  Allocate initial test budgets and determine when campaigns should be scaled, maintained or stopped.
-  Conduct controlled testing where feasible to distinguish creative performance from pricing, audience and promotional effects.
-  Expand successful advertising strategies across additional products.
-  Identify opportunities to increase sales during major TikTok Shop campaigns and promotional periods.
-  Manage advertising budgets efficiently during both regular sales periods and major shopping events.
-  Reporting & Performance Analysis
-  Maintain accurate daily tracking of advertising expenditure, attributed GMV, ROAS and cost per order.
-  Produce weekly reports showing performance by product, campaign and advertising creative.
-  Compare actual performance against assigned revenue and profitability targets.
-  Identify the three strongest and three weakest advertising creatives each week, explaining their results.
-  Provide actionable recommendations for increasing sales and improving advertising returns.
-  Coordinate with the e-commerce team to reconcile advertising-attributed sales against actual orders, refunds and net revenue.
-  Present clear recommendations for budget allocation and campaign improvements.

Job Requirement

TikTok Advertising Experience



-  Minimum 3 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, including substantial direct experience managing TikTok advertising campaign.
-  Demonstrable experience managing TikTok Shop GMV Max campaigns.
-  Must have personally managed advertising campaigns rather than solely overseeing external agencies.
-  Experience advertising physical consumer products through TikTok Shop.
-  Strong understanding of TikTok Shop's advertising ecosystem, campaign optimisation and performance measurement.

Commercial & Analytical Skills



-  Proven ability to generate measurable e-commerce revenue through paid advertisements.
-  Strong understanding of ROAS, ROI, CPA, CAC, GMV and advertising contribution margin.
-  Ability to calculate campaign profitability after product costs, platform charges and affiliate commissions.
-  Experience scaling daily advertising budgets while maintaining commercially acceptable returns.
-  Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets for advertising performance analysis.

Creative Advertising Skills



-  Strong understanding of TikTok video advertisements that drive purchases.
-  Ability to identify effective hooks, product demonstrations and sales messaging.
-  Experience testing UGC, creator-led advertisements and direct-response advertising creatives.
-  Ability to translate campaign performance data into actionable instructions for video creators.

Preferred Experience



-  Previous experience marketing skincare, cosmetics, personal care or FMCG products.
-  Experience managing TikTok Shop advertising in Singapore and Malaysia.
-  Experience working with affiliate creators and content authorisation for paid campaigns.
-  Familiarity with Shopee Ads and Meta Ads.
-  Experience in promoting products with relatively low selling prices, where advertising efficiency and margins are critical.

title: Loyalty Lead
description:
Job Purpose:
The Loyalty Lead owns the Guardian membership proposition in Singapore and is accountable for growing the identified customer base, member sales penetration and the commercial value the programme returns to the business across Guardian stores, the Guardian app, online and brand-specific programmes such as GNC Rewards.


Reporting to the Marketing Director, the role owns the loyalty proposition end to end — from member strategy, value proposition, pricing, rewards and lifecycle engagement through to programme economics, personalisation, platform capability to and in-store execution. The role holds an agreed annual target for member penetration, member sales and net programme contribution.


The role will build the capabilities, customer data and operating model required for Guardian loyalty programme. This includes translating customer insight and commercial priorities into a differentiated member proposition that drives frequency, retention, customer value and profitable growth. 


Leading a team spanning programme strategy, CRM and campaign operations, analytics and partnerships, and works closely with Commercial, Retail Media, Digital, Technology, Finance and Store Operations to turn first-party customer data into relevant member value, supplier-funded income and incremental sales and margin.


Main Duties and Responsibilities:
Loyalty Strategy and Digital Growth

- Own the Guardian Singapore loyalty strategy and multi-year roadmap, aligned with the overall business and customer growth strategy.
- Deliver annual targets for member acquisition, active members, member sales penetration, transaction penetration, frequency, retention and customer value.
- Own the acquisition engine across every touchpoint — point of sale, app, online, services and brand programmes — and hold identification rate as a tracked operating metric.
- Build the activation, retention, reactivation and win-back agenda for different customer value segments.
- Develop customer segmentation and value frameworks to identify priority customer groups, growth opportunities and differentiated engagement strategies.
- Benchmark competing health & beauty, and other high-frequency cross category loyalty programmes and translate relevant learnings into a prioritised design and investment list.


Member Proposition & Lifecycle Engagement

- Design the member benefits, including member pricing tiers, points and voucher mechanics, birthday and milestone rewards, and wellness benefits.
- Own the lifecycle journey framework - welcome, onboarding, replenishment, cross-category engagement, birthday, lapsed and win-back 
- Own the calendar of member-exclusive campaigns and activations 
- Set reward and redemption rules, validity, exclusions and reversal logic, ensuring mechanics are scalable and configurable.
- Own member communications across app, email, SMS and relevant in-store touchpoints, ensuring relevance, frequency discipline and consistent brand experience.
- Establish a structured test and learn programme across mechanics, offers and creative, refining them against sales and margin data.


Programme Economics & Commercial Performance

- Own the loyalty P&L, balancing issuance cost, redemption rate, reward and voucher funding, platform and operating cost against member sales and margin delivered.
- Maintain the programme economics model, including reward cost, redemption, breakage, points liability, funded value ceilings and programme contribution.
- Set clear return thresholds for loyalty investment and reallocate reward investment away from activities that does not pay back.
- Secure supplier funding for member offers and pricing in partnership with Commercial, and track funding claimed and received.
- Prepare business cases, budget submissions and investment approvals for loyalty capabilities and campaigns, with clear assumptions and measurable expected returns


Data, Personalisation & Monetisation 

- Provide thought leadership on digital trends, tools, and emerging technologies relevant to retail and omnichannel marketing
- Own the member data agenda with H&B Format and Group Technology Team
- Drive segmentation, RFM and lifetime value models and next-best-offer logic.
- Drive personalised offers and recommendations at scale, and report the incremental sales and margin attributable to it.
- Enrich the customer view with wellness services, pharmacy and digital behaviour data, within consent and privacy requirements.
- Partner the Retail Media and supplier marketing teams to monetise member audiences through targeted, supplier-funded offers, audience targeting and closed-loop measurement.
- Translate customer data and insights into clear actions for Commercial, Marketing, Digital and Store Operations, influencing range, pricing, promotions and customer activation.


Loyalty Platform, Digital Product & Store Execution

- Act as the primary business owner for the loyalty and customer engagement platform, owning requirements, configuration decisions, scope, User Acceptance Testing and release readiness.
- Own member identification and entitlement at the point of sale, including member lookup, member-price trigger and voucher validation, working with Technology and Store Systems. 
-  Drive app adoption as the primary member channel, including downloads, daily active users, enrolment, offer activation and redemption rates.
- Ensure a consistent member experience across assisted checkout, self-checkout, click and collect, delivery and online, with no “dead ends” in the member journey.
- Work with Store Operations to ensure frontline teams are equipped with training, prompts, tools and incentives to drive consistent member identification and enrolment
Partnerships & Brand Programmes

- Build and manage partnerships that extend member value beyond Guardian, structured so partner-funded value carries the cost of participation.
- Own brand-specific member programmes such as GNC Rewards, ensuring mechanics are competitive in category, consistent in design rules, and able to consolidate into the wider membership over time.
- Manage loyalty platform vendors and agencies against commercial terms, service levels and delivery milestones, including data portability and exit provisions.
- Support cross-border and cross-banner member initiatives with Group and neighbouring markets, within agreed commercial and legal boundaries.
Governance, Compliance & Team Leadership

- Lead, coach and develop a high performing team spanning programme design, CRM and campaign operations, and partnerships.
- Establish governance for loyalty performance, including reporting cadence, decision forums, programme roadmap, risk register and escalation processes.
- Ensure compliance with PDPA, consent management, marketing permissions, data retention and information security requirements, working with Legal and Technology.
- Provide regular performance reporting to leadership covering member growth, penetration, engagement, programme economics and initiative-level return, with clear recommendations.
- Influence across Commercial, Store Operations, Marketing, Finance, Technology and Group functions to align timelines and unblock decisions at working level.


Requirements:

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, Economics or a quantitative discipline.
- 8–12 years' experience in loyalty, CRM, customer marketing or omnichannel retail, including at least 4 years leading teams and owning a programme or channel P&L.
- Demonstrated ownership of a consumer loyalty or membership programme at scale, with quantified results in member acquisition, penetration and retention.
- Strong command of programme economics — issuance and redemption cost, breakage, liability, funded value ceiling and return on reward investment.
- Proven experience designing member mechanics, including member pricing, tiering, points and voucher constructs, and lifecycle journeys.
- Working knowledge of modern retail technology, including customer data and engagement platforms, loyalty engines, CRM automation tools, POS integration and app ecosystems.
- Experience acting as business owner on a platform implementation, including requirements definition, scope control, UAT and go-live readiness.
- Strong analytical capability - segmentation, RFM, cohort analysis and lifetime value analysis, campaign measurement and control-group testing; able to defend the numbers in front of leadership.
- Experience securing supplier or partner funding for member value, and familiarity with retail media or data monetisation models.
- Sound understanding of PDPA, consent and data governance requirements in Singapore.
- Experience managing external platform vendors and agencies against commercial terms and service levels.
- Resilient & Pragmatic: Operates in a fast-moving, multi-stakeholder environment; makes reversible decisions quickly and high-impact ones carefully.
- Health and beauty, pharmacy, grocery or other high-frequency/multi-brand experience is a strong advantage.

title: Marketing & Digital Growth Specialist
description:
About the company
At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.


Job description
We are seeking an operational, highly adaptable Marketing & Digital Growth Specialist to serve as the direct support to the Marketing Manager. This role is designed to bridge traditional on-the-ground marketing operations with full-stack digital performance execution. You will be responsible for managing day-to-day sales enablement, event execution, vendor logistics & field media capture, while simultaneously owning performance ad management (Meta/Google), e-commerce storefront optimization (Shopify/Shopee/Lazada/TikTok) & lifecycle marketing (Klaviyo/WhatsApp). Furthermore, you will support regional marketing rollouts & localization efforts as we expand across Southeast Asia & target Greater China markets.


Key Responsibilities:
1.Digital Marketing, Creative Strategy & Performance Media

- Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google):
-Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Ads & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces
-Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries

- Full-Funnel Creative Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific formats (e.g., Meta carousel ads, Meta/TikTok Reels, Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banners)
- A/B Testing & Optimization: Formulate hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, CTAs, visual styles, copy length) & run A/B tests to systematically improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
- Precision Tracking & UTM Tagging: Implement a standardized UTM tagging nomenclature across all campaigns, EDMs, WhatsApp blasts & affiliate links to ensure 100% attribution accuracy in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) & Shopify. Monitor the customer path from first touchpoint to conversion
- Media Budget Optimization: Manage ad spend budgets effectively, scaling winning creatives & optimise underperforming ads based on real-time ROAS & Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) data
2.Content Production

- Performance Creative Development: Lead end-to-end creative production for organic & paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube) with a focus on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing
- Video & Static Creation: Produce & edit native social content, including UGC-style video, product demos & testimonials using tools like CapCut or Premiere Pro, as well as static ad variations & storefront banners
- Copywriting: Write high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social captions that align with brand voice & healthcare regulatory requirements
- Generative AI Integration: Utilize AI tools & prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video & image assets for testing cycles
3.E-Commerce & Social Media Account Ownership

- E-Commerce Storefront Custodian: Maintain & integrate winning creative messages across official storefronts on Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok Shop (product pages, banners) to maximize conversion rates
- Social Accounts Ownership & Community Management: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for official accounts on Meta (FB/IG) & TikTok. Ensure profiles feature updated bios, Linktree/Shopify integrations & highlighted stories
- Content Programming & Scheduling: Maintain a consistent content calendar balancing educational, lifestyle & promotional posts
- Active Social Listening & UGC Mining: Monitor comments & DMs to identify customer pain points for new content hooks & curate customer testimonials to deploy as high-converting growth assets
4.CRM, Lifecycle Marketing & Retention

- EDM & E-Newsletter Strategy: Develop & execute a high-frequency newsletter calendar via Klaviyo, including educational insights & promotional product-launch/seasonal campaigns
- Automated Flow Management: Design & execute end-to-end email & WhatsApp automation (e.g., Welcome series, Post-Purchase care, Win-back flows & Replenishment Reminders)
- Subscription & Loyalty Optimization: Craft compelling creative & copy for subscription programs, optimizing triggers to reduce churn, increase Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & grow Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)
- WhatsApp Marketing: Integrate direct-to-consumer WhatsApp communication for personalized consultations, loyalty rewards & rapid promotions
5.Day-to-Day Marketing Operations & Brand Execution

- Execute Business & Marketing Initiatives: Execute effective marketing & business development initiatives tailored to each health supplement brand to increase market share, achieve revenue & reach profitability targets in line with overall business objectives
- Budget & Spend Monitoring: Track & monitor marketing budget allocations, campaign expenditures, purchase orders (POs) & invoices to ensure optimal ROI, resource allocation, & strict adherence to financial targets
- Marketing Collateral Development: Manage the end-to-end production of printed & digital collaterals (e.g., product packaging, brochures, POSM displays & email newsletters), liaising with print vendors & briefing internal design teams
- Marketing Collaterals Inventory Management: Monitor & maintain inventory levels of promotional materials, product samples & event displays to support ongoing on-ground campaigns
6.Field Media Capture & Event Execution

- Medical Conferences & Sponsorships: Lead on-the-ground setup, booth operations & logistics for major medical association conventions & trade events (e.g., Singapore Orthopaedic Association - SOA, Malaysian Orthopaedic Association - MOA)
- CME Workshop Coordination: Support Continuing Medical Education (CME) seminars for healthcare professionals—managing attendee invites, venue logistics, collateral preparation & post-event survey collation
- On-Site Media Capture: Direct & capture raw video footage & photos during events, social media content creation & patient/doctor testimonial shoots using mobile/camera gear
- Digital Handoff & Asset Tagging: Organize raw media assets, write clear creative briefs & storyboards & transfer files to internal design teams (for video editing/graphics) or deploy them directly across paid ad channels
7.Sales Team Enablement & Trade Support

- Sales Collaterals: Develop & update product brochures, product samples & promotional offers to empower the Sales team
- Retail Pharmacy Activations: Coordinate trade marketing collaterals, listing campaigns & point-of-sale displays for retail pharmacy chains
8.Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Regulatory Compliance: Safeguard brand credibility by ensuring all promotional messaging remain factual, align with company values & strictly comply with regional healthcare advertising standards & product claim guidelines


Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Life Sciences, or a related field
- 2–4 years of hands-on marketing executive experience, combining general marketing operations with full-stack digital marketing & e-commerce execution
- Proven hands-on experience setting up, managing & optimizing paid ad campaigns within Meta Ads Manager & Google Ads
- Direct experience managing content, storefronts & promotions on Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok Shop
- Working knowledge of Google Analytics 4 (GA4), UTM tracking structures & CRM/EDM automation tools (Klaviyo preferred)
- Proficient in producing rapid static & video content using CapCut, Canva, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, or Illustrator
- Fluency in spoken & written Mandarin is required to effectively liaise with Mandarin-speaking healthcare professionals, retail pharmacy partners, media platforms & suppliers/vendors
- Strong event execution, vendor management & trade marketing coordination skills
- Confident in capturing raw smartphone/camera footage during events & directing quick on-site interviews


Email your cover letter alongside your application to talent@miraconutripharm.com

Creative & Content Direction

- Own the Skincare Body growth agenda: Support the development and execution of a clear, multi-year growth strategy across core and emerging body formats, grounded in consumer needs, market whitespace, brand fit and commercial attractiveness.
- Lead end-to-end New Product Development: Translate priority opportunities into robust innovation projects, from insight, concept and proposition through business case, product development, packaging, claims, launch readiness and post-launch review.
- Build an efficient innovation roll-out engine: Work with the Beauty & Wellbeing Innovations Lead and cross-functional partners to improve portfolio deployment, engage the right stakeholders at the right stage and accelerate projects that meet size-of-prize and profitability guardrails.
- Drive global innovation roll-outs: Assess global innovations for Unilever International, define the right market and portfolio fit, adapt the mix where required and lead disciplined deployment across priority markets.
- Create tailored local marketing plans: Partner with Business Unit Brand Leads and Business Development teams to translate global brand platforms into locally relevant plans across key visuals, digital, retail activation, PR, influencer and customer programmes.
- Lead major brand campaigns: Own selected Body campaigns and activation programmes, ensuring that the strategic idea, asset ecosystem and market deployment plan build the total brand and support priority ranges.
- Shape the long-range innovation plan: Build and maintain a three-year innovation roadmap for Body, mapping global pipelines and local whitespace
- Make commercially grounded choices: Develop size-of-prize, pricing, margin and investment cases with Finance and Supply Chain; prioritize the highest-value opportunities; and recommend where to scale, adapt, defer or stop.
- Own performance tracking: Monitor the total Body P&L and launch scorecards, including turnover, incremental turnover, underlying sales growth, gross margin, brand investment and unit economics, translating performance into clear corrective actions.
- Lead cross-functional delivery: Align Brand, R&D, Supply Chain, procurement, Finance, Customer Development, regulatory, legal, artwork, agencies and markets around clear milestones, decisions, risks and accountable owners.
- Influence senior stakeholders: Prepare sharp recommendations and leadership updates, surface risks early and drive timely decisions across a complex global and regional stakeholder network.
- The roles of duties are not exhaustive and may change according to business requirements. 

What You Need To Succeed

Essential experience and qualifications



- 3-5 years of relevant brand management, innovation, category or commercial marketing experience, preferably within FMCG, beauty, personal care or consumer healthcare.
- Demonstrated experience owning meaningful brand or innovation workstreams from strategy through execution, with clear evidence of commercial thinking and delivery impact.
- Strong grounding in core marketing fundamentals, including consumer insight, positioning, innovation development, marketing mix creation, communications, go-to-market planning and performance evaluation.
- Experience building business cases and using P&L, market, consumer and customer data to make prioritization decisions.
- Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and external partners across markets and time zones, influencing without formal authority and resolving ambiguity with ownership.
- Strong project leadership, with the discipline to manage milestones, dependencies, risks, budgets and decision forums across multiple concurrent initiatives.
- Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to present recommendations, challenge constructively and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders.
- Bachelor degree or equivalent experience in marketing, business, economics, communications or a related discipline.

Preferred Experience



- Experience in global or regional brand management, innovation development, portfolio strategy, localisation or multi-market deployment.
- Experience working on skincare, body care or adjacent beauty and personal care categories.
- Exposure to product, packaging, claims and artwork development, with an understanding of regulatory and production requirements.
- Experience partnering with Customer Development or commercial teams to translate brand strategy into channel and customer activation.
- Flexibility to support occasional early-morning or evening meetings across Asia, Europe and North America when critical business milestones require it.

Core Skills



- Brand strategy and portfolio management
- Consumer and market insight
- End-to-end innovation and NPD leadership
- Integrated marketing and local market activation
- Commercial acumen and P&L understanding
- Business case development and prioritisation
- Cross-functional leadership and senior stakeholder influence
- Structured problem solving and decision quality
- Project and budget management
- Learning agility, resilience and ownership

THE LEADERSHIP WE EXPECT

You operate as a brand owner, not a project coordinator. You can frame the opportunity, make a recommendation, align diverse stakeholders and drive the work through to measurable market impact. You stay close enough to the detail to protect quality while keeping sight of the strategic and commercial objective. You are curious about consumers, decisive with data, comfortable challenging established approaches and motivated by building repeatable growth platforms rather than delivering isolated activities.

description:

title: Marketing Manager - APAC
description:
Who We Are

We’re not in the wing business. We’re in the flavor business. It’s been our mission to Serve the World Flavor since we first opened in 1994, and we’re just getting started. 1997 saw the opening of our first brand partner operated Wingstop location, and by 2002 we had served the world one billion wings. It’s flavor that defines us and has made Wingstop one of the fastest growing brands in the restaurant industry.

Above all else – our success is largely due to our people and our core values, or what we call The Wingstop Way of being entrepreneurial, service-minded, fun, and authentic. We believe having a strong people foundation centered on these collective values creates a crave-worthy culture and talented team, as well as ensures our brand is poised for accelerated growth. We all win together.

What We’ll Need

We are seeking a Marketing Manager - APAC to help drive brand growth, support our franchise partners, and execute best-in-class regional marketing initiatives across Asia Pacific. This role will partner closely with the Director, Marketing - APAC to implement regional marketing strategies, launch new market initiatives, and strengthen brand performance across existing and emerging markets.

The ideal candidate is passionate about brand building, thrives in a fast-paced international environment, and enjoys collaborating with cross-functional teams and franchise partners to deliver measurable business results.



-  Partner with the Director, Marketing - APAC to execute regional marketing strategies that drive same-store sales, guest traffic, brand awareness, and restaurant growth.
-  Support marketing launches across existing and emerging APAC markets, ensuring consistent execution of campaigns, promotions, and brand standards.
-  Coordinate the development and execution of integrated 360° marketing campaigns across digital, social, media, PR, and in-store channels.
-  Assist in building annual marketing calendars and field marketing plans aligned with regional business priorities.
-  Support the planning and execution of Limited Time Offers (LTOs), menu innovation launches, and seasonal campaigns.
-  Work closely with franchise partners to provide marketing guidance, review local marketing plans, and share best practices.
-  Coordinate with creative, media, digital, and agency partners to ensure timely delivery of marketing initiatives.
-  Monitor campaign performance and marketing effectiveness through analysis of sales, guest insights, media performance, and ROI.
-  Gather and communicate consumer insights, competitive intelligence, and industry trends to support future marketing strategies.
-  Partner with cross-functional teams including Operations, Supply Chain, Development, Finance, and Brand to successfully execute marketing initiatives.
-  Assist with new restaurant openings by coordinating local marketing plans and launch activities.
-  Support regional digital marketing initiatives including CRM, loyalty, delivery platforms, social media, and digital ordering.
-  Manage marketing budgets for assigned projects while ensuring efficient use of resources.
-  Help maintain marketing assets, promotional calendars, and project timelines across the region.
-  Contribute to regional brand projects, creative development, pricing analysis, and marketing research as needed.
-  Build collaborative relationships with franchise partners while serving as a trusted marketing resource.
-  Identify opportunities to improve processes, marketing effectiveness, and franchise support.

What You’ll Need



-  5–8 years of marketing experience, preferably within QSR, retail, hospitality, or consumer brands.
-  Experience supporting multi-unit or franchise businesses.
-  Experience managing integrated marketing campaigns from planning through execution.
-  Experience working across multiple countries or markets is preferred.
-  A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
-  Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
-  A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership.
-  The ability to adapt quickly within a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
-  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
-  Experience interpreting marketing performance metrics and consumer insights.
-  Excellent communication and presentation skills.
-  Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
-  The ability to influence stakeholders across cultures and functions.

Who You Are

No job is too small. You recognize that the real work happens in the restaurants, and everything we do should support their success. You stay humble, roll up your sleeves, and always look for ways to help. You learn from others and contribute wherever you can.

You care deeply about doing great work and driving results. You’re curious, ask questions, and seek out opportunities to improve. You don’t just point out problems—you bring solutions, ideas, and perspectives that move the team forward.

You take full responsibility for your work and see things through to completion. You aren’t afraid to fail because you know that failure is a part of learning and growth. You take action, move fast, and keep pushing forward.

You lead with empathy, respect, and emotional intelligence. You collaborate effectively, fostering a culture of trust and constructive feedback. You understand the importance of teamwork and ensure that your actions build others up rather than break them down.

You push yourself and others to be better. You embrace healthy conflict, knowing that great ideas and strong teams emerge from honest, constructive conversations. You believe that leaders create leaders and are committed to fostering a culture of growth, challenge, and continuous improvement.

Benefits

Singapore



-  Medical coverage (outpatient clinical, outpatient specialist, hospital & surgical)
-  Dental coverage
-  Life & TPD
-  AD&D
-  Work injury compensation
-  Business travel accident coverage

Additional Benefits



-  EAP
-  Business Travel Medical

Wingstop provides equal opportunities for everyone that works for us and everyone that applies to join our team, without regard to sex or gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, any service, past, present, or future, in the uniformed services of the United States (military or veteran status), or any other consideration protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Brand & Marketing Executive
description:
SUMMARY
The Brand & Marketing Executive supports the planning, coordination and execution of brand, marketing and social media initiatives across the group’s dining concepts.
This role works closely with the Brand & Marketing Communications team, outlet teams, designers, agencies, vendors and external partners to bring campaigns, promotions, content and brand experiences to life. The role requires someone who is organised, detail-oriented and creatively aware, with the ability to manage timelines, coordinate stakeholders, maintain brand consistency and support the administrative needs behind smooth marketing execution.


RESPONSIBILITIES 


Brand & Campaign Support

- Support the planning and execution of brand campaigns, seasonal promotions, new menu launches, outlet initiatives and marketing activations.
- Assist in developing campaign timelines, marketing calendars, task lists and rollout plans.
- Coordinate campaign requirements across internal teams, outlet teams, designers, agencies, vendors and partners to ensure timely execution.
- Assist in preparing campaign briefs, creative references, copy points and marketing materials.
- Ensure campaign messaging, visuals and guest-facing touchpoints are aligned with each brand’s tone, personality and positioning.


Content & Communications

- Assist in creating and coordinating marketing content across social media, eDMs, websites, in-store materials and promotional channels.
- Draft social media captions, newsletter copy, website updates, promotional copy and basic campaign write-ups.
- Work with designers, photographers, videographers and external agencies to produce marketing assets.
- Support content shoots by coordinating shot lists, props, products, outlet arrangements and creative requirements.
- Ensure all content and communications are clear, polished, on-brand and consistent across platforms.


Social Media & Digital Marketing

- Support the day-to-day management of social media platforms (Meta & Rednote), including content scheduling, posting, community engagement and basic page upkeep.
- Monitor social media trends, competitor activity and relevant F&B, lifestyle and hospitality content ideas.
- Track social media performance and assist in compiling reports on reach, engagement, follower growth and campaign results.
- Support influencer/KOL coordination, including shortlist preparation, outreach, hosting arrangements, briefing and follow-ups.
- Assist in digital marketing initiatives such as boosted posts, campaign tracking and basic performance tracking


Outlet, Event & Partnership Coordination

- Liaise with outlet teams to ensure campaigns, promotions and marketing materials are properly briefed and implemented.
- Coordinate the delivery, display and upkeep of marketing materials such as posters, menus, table talkers, standees, signage, tent cards and promotional assets.
- Support media visits, influencer tastings, brand events, activations and partnership campaigns.
- Assist in gathering outlet feedback, campaign photos and operational updates to ensure smooth execution.
- Help maintain clear communication between marketing, operations and external partners


Administrative & Reporting

- Maintain organised records of marketing assets, campaign materials, vendor contacts, quotations, invoices, timelines and brand resources.
- Assist with marketing expense tracking, quotation requests, purchase orders, invoice processing and basic budget coordination.
- Compile campaign performance reports, post-campaign summaries and key learnings.
- Support competitor research, market research and simple presentation decks when required.
- Maintain content calendars, campaign trackers, internal marketing documentation.
- Assist with administrative coordination for shoots, events, partnerships and marketing rollouts, including bookings, logistics, samples, deliveries and follow-ups.


REQUIREMENTS



- Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Hospitality, Media or a related field.
- 1–3 years of experience in marketing, social media, brand communications, hospitality, F&B or lifestyle brands preferred.
- Strong written English with an eye for tone, detail and clarity.
- Good understanding of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Rednote, and lifestyle/F&B content trends.
- Organised, reliable and able to manage timelines across multiple brands, outlets and campaigns.
- Comfortable coordinating with different stakeholders, including outlet teams, designers, vendors, agencies and partners.
- Able to manage administrative tasks carefully and systematically.
- Basic knowledge of Canva, OneDrive Workspace, Meta Business Suite, Mailchimp, website CMS or similar tools is a plus.
- Interest in food, hospitality, lifestyle, design, culture and brand storytelling.
- Able to work independently while being collaborative, responsive and hands-on.

title: Associate Manager / Manager, Global Brand Marketing
description:
About Klook

We are a leading pan-regional experiences platform in Asia Pacific, purpose built to digitalize experiences and make them accessible to every traveler.

Our mission is to build the digital infrastructure for the global experience economy — empowering merchants to share their passions and travelers to discover the heartbeat of each destination.

We operate a mobile-first, curated platform featuring diverse experiences across global destinations.

Do you share our belief in the wonders of travel? Global citizens ourselves, Klookers are not only curating memorable experiences for others but co-creating our world of joy within Klook.

We work hard and play hard, upkeeping our high-performing culture as we are guided daily by our 6 core values:



- Customer First
- Push Boundaries
- Critical Thinking
- Build for Scale
- Less is More
- Win as One

We never settle, and together, we believe in achieving greater heights and realizing endless possibilities ahead of us in the dynamic new era of travel. Care to be a part of this revolution? Join us!

About The Role

We’re looking for an Associate Manager / Manager, Brand Growth to join our Global Brand Marketing team and help connect Brand more closely to the products we want to grow, the channels where consumers make decisions, and ultimately business impact.

We’re looking for a left-brain brand marketer — someone who believes in the power of creativity, but is equally comfortable with audience insight, commercial priorities and data.

The role sits at the intersection of brand, product, audience insight and growth, with three core jobs:

Integrate product into Brand



- Work with vertical teams and local markets to identify the products Klook should be talking about, uncover relevant audience insights, and turn them into compelling consumer stories within our larger brand campaigns.
- The job is to go beyond features and find the reason people should notice and care.

Integrate Brand into lower-funnel marketing



- Work across paid media, Kreator, PR, social and local marketing teams to make sure Klook’s brand, values and distinctiveness show up further down the funnel.
- You’ll connect Brand, product, channels and markets around one clear consumer story — so commercial activity builds memory for Klook, not just the immediate transaction.

Measure the impact of Brand



- Work with analytics and research partners to understand Brand’s impact across both brand and business outcomes — from awareness and consideration to branded search, direct traffic and downstream behaviour.
- You’ll also help lead audience research, turning insights and performance data into clear recommendations for what we do next.

What You’ll Do



- Identify priority products and categories to integrate into Brand activity.
- Gather and synthesise audience and market insights.
- Turn product benefits into compelling consumer propositions and stories.
- Lead integrated marketing campaigns across Brand, paid media, Kreator, PR, social and local markets.
- Bring stronger Brand thinking into lower-funnel and commercial activity.
- Partner with research and analytics teams to measure Brand impact.
- Turn performance and research into actionable recommendations.
- Explore how AI can improve the speed, quality and scale of our work.

What We’re Looking For



- 4–5 years of experience in brand, integrated marketing, product marketing or communications planning.
- A left-brain brand mindset: strong creative judgement, but equally comfortable with data, commercial questions and measurement.
- Strong consumer, audience and value proposition thinking.
- Experience working across regional or global campaigns and multiple channels.
- Good understanding of paid media and lower-funnel marketing.
- Strong stakeholder and project management skills.
- Comfortable working with research, brand metrics and business data.
- Able to simplify messy inputs into a clear point of view.
- AI-curious and proactive about experimenting with better ways of working.

What Success Looks Like



- Klook’s priority products are naturally embedded into Brand campaigns.
- Audience insights actively shape our marketing decisions.
- Lower-funnel campaigns build the Klook brand while driving commercial outcomes.
- Brand, channels and markets work from one connected consumer story.
- We have a clearer view of Brand’s impact across both brand and business metrics.

Klook is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented and passionate people of all backgrounds. We believe that a joyful workplace is an inclusive workplace, one where employees from all walks of life have an equal opportunity to thrive. We're dedicated to creating a welcoming and supportive culture where everyone belongs.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Our Journey 

The ShopBack Group is Asia-Pacific's leading shopping and rewards platform, trusted by over 20 million active members across 13 markets, including Germany and the United States. Driven by the vision to make every day more rewarding, ShopBack saves members money and time with more ways to earn and more to do with what they earn, and empowers merchants and brand partners to effectively engage its members. Founded in Singapore in 2014, ShopBack now powers over US$5.5 billion in annual sales and half a million transactions a day for more than 20,000 online and in-store partners.

As part of the Global Performance Marketing team, you will play a pivotal role in designing and implementing online media strategies to drive growth in acquisition, retention, and branding for the North America market. You will be working closely with local teams and regional stakeholders to foster strong partnerships, ensuring seamless coordination and execution of marketing initiatives across countries. If you are an experienced, self-motivated, and innovative online marketer, who is AI-forward, this could be the role for you.

Note: This role is based in Singapore, with frequent collaboration and timezone overlap with our US team (Texas, Austin)

What You'll Own



- Manage and own the performance of all relevant online marketing channels including but not limited to Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, and programmatic channels.
- Collaborate with local marketing teams to deliver localized strategy: campaign and media planning, and creative development.
- Analyze online paid media campaigns and product data to derive actionable insights for optimization purposes.
- Responsible for budget planning and execution, aimed at maximizing marketing effectiveness. Growth hacking through constant testing to discover new marketing opportunities.


Essentials To Succeed



- 7+ years of hands-on experience in online paid media for APP and Web products.
- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or relevant experience.
- Proven track record of driving significant growth with marketing efficiency in the North America market.
- Proficient in managing campaigns across the following advertising platforms - Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, and programmatic channels.
- Excellent communication skills and stakeholder management are able to work across multiple markets and cultures, collaborate easily with others, and adapt agilely.
- Proficient in marketing tools, including Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Branch.io/ Appsflyer.
- Excellent analytical skills with a data-driven mindset to interpret and act on data insights.
- Growth hacking mentality and a holistic view of marketing strategy to discover key business opportunities.
- Self-starter with the ability to work independently, owning the problem and developing the solution.
- AI Competency: Demonstrated use of AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) to develop new or improve workflows, enhance productivity, and drive efficiency at scale.


ShopBacker Traits



- Agency - We take ownership and act, rather than waiting for permission. When something's blocking progress, we find a way through it and follow through until it's done.
- Judgement - We aim for high-impact decisions, not just easy wins, and we put the bigger picture ahead of individual interests. That means moving quickly and confidently, while staying thoughtful about when a call really matters.
- Learning Velocity - We pick up new skills fast and let go of old habits just as quickly when something better comes along. We benchmark ourselves against the best and keep raising our own bar.
- Tenacity - We stay in it when things get hard, keeping a level head under pressure. We debate openly before deciding, then commit fully — and support each other along the way.


What's in it for ShopBackers



- Career growth opportunities to take on greater challenges that help you realise your ambitions.
- Be part of a winning team on a journey to global scale.
- Competitive compensation based on performance.
- Candid, open, and collaborative culture where feedback is valued.


We are committed to protecting your data and ensuring fairness in our recruitment process.
