title: Assistant Brand Manager
description:
Position

The Opportunity…

At Moët Hennessy, We Don't Just Create Exceptional Experiences - We Live Them.

For generations, our 27 Maisons, including Dom Pérignon, Veuve Clicquot, and Hennessy, have defined luxury. Now, it's your turn. Imagine a career fueled by passion and creativity, where you redefine what's possible. We seek individuals who thrive in collaborative environments, sharing our love for craftsmanship, elegance, and integrity. We celebrate diversity and the pursuit of excellence.

We're thrilled to announce an opening for an Assistant Brand Manager. Reporting to the Senior Brand Manager, you will be responsible for developing marketing strategies and plans for the Hennessy portfolio to maximize brand equity and drive business growth in the market.

We are looking for an ambitious, dynamic, and detail-oriented marketer who is passionate about building iconic brands. In this role, you will play a critical part in executing the local marketing strategy, driving brand desirability, and accelerating growth for the Hennessy portfolio. A key focus will be leading strategic activations and trade partnerships across channels, while strengthening on-trade and retail visibility through impactful consumer experiences.

You will also be responsible for building strong agency partnerships and leading the flawless execution of brand campaigns and on-ground activations. In addition to managing the A&P budget and monitoring market and consumer trends, you will work closely with Management and Sales teams to achieve business objectives.

At Moët Hennessy, we are committed to creating a workplace where people aspire to grow and thrive. We empower our people, value diverse perspectives, and foster a culture built on inclusivity, honesty, and authenticity.

You will have the opportunity to work in an innovative and cross-cultural environment where you will be encouraged to develop your entrepreneurial mindset and pioneering spirit. We support our people in pursuing their career aspirations and exploring mobility opportunities across countries, as well as within both Moët Hennessy and the wider LVMH Group.

If you want to inspire and be inspired, to craft exceptional experiences while experiencing the very best in craftsmanship, Moët Hennessy is where you'll flourish.

Job Responsibilities

How you will contribute…

1) Marketing & Business Strategy



- Contribute to the development of the long-term strategic plan for Singapore. 
- Define and implement marketing strategies for your brands aligned with business objectives, brand equity, market dynamics, and consumer-centric principles across all touchpoints of the consumer journey. 
- Drive the creation and execution of annual 360° marketing plans, including product launches, campaign prioritization, experiential concepts, ATL/BTL activations, budget allocation, and ROI measurement. 
- Partner closely with the Commercial and Sales teams to develop channel-specific strategies, promotions, visibility programs, and trade partnerships that drive brand desirability and business growth. 
- Support the Senior Brand Manager in executing the local marketing calendar, new product launches, and thematic campaigns. 

2) Marketing, Digital & PR Activations



- Directly manage end-to-end brand management. 
- Lead the conceptualization, planning, and delivery of activation campaigns across various channels (digital, out-of-home media, experiential, visual merchandising, and channel plans) in close collaboration with the Commercial team. 
- Develop and execute localized marketing and trade initiatives across key consumer touchpoints, ensuring strong brand visibility and premium consumer experiences. 
- Lead holistic amplification plans across paid, owned, and earned channels with a strong audience- and culture-led approach. 
- Drive excellence by collaborating with internal and external partners to maximize brand visibility, impact, and consumer engagement while ensuring consistent campaign performance tracking. 
- Plan and execute experiential events, trade activations, tastings, and consumer engagement programs to drive brand equity and commercial performance. 
- Manage and evaluate Media, PR, and BTL agencies to achieve optimum performance across all executions. 
- Monitor various aspects of brand performance through market visits, research, and trade feedback. 

3) Partnerships & Stakeholder Management



- Work closely with the other Senior Brand Managers to ensure alignment of priorities, ways of working, communication, and team spirit across the full MH portfolio. 
- Be able to articulate and share a clear vision with key stakeholders regarding Singapore consumers, market dynamics, and cultural specificities. 
- Cultivate and manage relationships with key stakeholders across the region, Maisons, agencies, customers, and industry influencers. 
- Collaborate closely with Customer Marketing teams to ensure effective execution of key brand initiatives and commercial programs. 
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between marketing strategies and business objectives (Retail, Finance, Maisons, Media, Digital, E-retail, etc.). 
- Promote the SEA markets within the Group through regular communication and influence. 

4) Analytics, Financial Management & Operations



- Monitor market, consumer, and channel trends to identify opportunities and risks. 
- Track and analyze campaign performance, volume, market share, and ROI to generate actionable insights and recommendations. 
- Manage A&P budgets, purchase orders, vendor relationships, and financial tracking to ensure effective investment management. 
- Coordinate with Supply Chain, Logistics, and regional stakeholders to ensure product availability and timely delivery of brand assets. 

Profile

We are looking for unique and amazing talent. Join us if you have…



- Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related discipline. 
- 3+ years of experience in Brand Management, Marketing, Trade Marketing, or Category Management, preferably within FMCG, luxury, consumer goods, or wines & spirits industries. 
- Experience in project management, brand activations, and agency management. 
- Strong commercial, marketing, and digital mindset, with a good understanding of consumer behavior, market trends, and brand performance analytics. 
- Experience working closely with Sales and cross-functional stakeholders to drive business growth and brand visibility. 
- Understanding of Singapore's consumer landscape, on-trade environment, and premium hospitality channels would be an advantage. 
- Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and levels. 
- Results-driven, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
- Fluent in English; proficiency in additional languages would be an advantage. 
- Comfortable working outside of regular business hours on occasion. 

Additional Information

When you join Moët Hennessy…



- You embark on a career journey with the leaders of luxury wines, champagnes, and spirits, within the prestigious LVMH Group. 
- You enter a world of possibility where career development opportunities across our 5 global regions and within the entire LVMH Group are unmatched. 
- You join a passionate workforce within our internationally diverse and inclusive teams, exploring the rich heritage of our Maisons and shaping the next chapter of our story
- You discover our essential relationship with our terroirs and the soils that define our products. Through our Living Soils Living Together program, we are committed to regenerating soils, reducing climate impact, and empowering communities for a sustainable future. 
- You will share in our passion for hosting, the art of living, and creating products that celebrate life’s most memorable milestones, always experienced through responsible tasting. 

Ready for a world of possibilities? Discover Moët Hennessy today!

title: Assistant Manager, Lifecycle Marketing & Campaign Delivery
description:
Help turn a new Changi Account member’s first interaction into a lasting relationship with Changi. As part of Market Experimentation & Personalization (MXP) team, you will design and deliver customer journeys that encourage first and repeat purchases, strengthen loyalty and bring inactive customers back across Changi’s F&B, retail, travel and digital experiences.

You will own assigned lifecycle programs and campaigns from initial idea to launch and ongoing improvement. Working with marketers, platform specialists and data analysts, you will translate customer insights into relevant communications across email, app push, in-app messaging and other owned digital channels. The role combines customer journey design with hands-on campaign building and experimentation.

What You Will Do

Design customer journeys



- Plan and design lifecycle programs that welcome new members and encourage their first purchase, drive repeat purchases, re-engage inactive customers and invite eligible customers to renew their marketing consent. Define clear customer needs, business objectives and success measures.
- Turn customer behavior and insights into audience segments and journey plans, defining who enters and exits each journey, what they receive, and when and through which channels they are engaged.
- Partner with marketers to develop relevant messages, benefits and offers that encourage member engagement. Recommend and test incentives where they can improve customer and business outcomes.

Build & deliver campaigns



- Manage lifecycle and tactical marketing campaigns from brief to launch, coordinating content, assets, approvals and timelines with marketing teams and creative agencies.
- Build and maintain automated journeys and campaigns in Braze, using customer behavior, event triggers, segmentation and personalized content to coordinate engagement across channels.
- Check targeting, consent, exclusions, contact frequency, journey logic, content and links before launch. Monitor live campaigns and work with relevant specialists to resolve issues.
- Work with MXP Tech and data colleagues to define the customer attributes and events needed for journeys, and test that campaigns respond correctly to customer actions.

Test learn and improve



- Plan and run A/B tests with clear hypotheses, success measures and appropriate comparison or control groups. Test messages, offers, timing, channels and journey design.
- Incorporate lifecycle communications with relevant web and app experiences and activate through experiments using Adobe Target or similar tools.
- Use campaign and customer data to evaluate activation, repeat purchase, retention and incremental impact where measurable. Share findings and recommend improvements to journeys and campaigns.
- Make delivery more efficient and reliable through reusable journey components, templates, documentation and quality checks.

What You Will Bring



- 3–5 years of relevant experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, loyalty engagement or marketing automation. We welcome candidates with a different length of experience who can demonstrate the capabilities below.
- Practical experience designing and delivering automated customer journeys, such as onboarding, activation, retention or win-back. You can explain the audience, journey logic, your contribution and what you learned from the results.
- Hands-on experience with a customer engagement platform such as Braze is preferred; strong experience with a comparable platform is welcome.
- A good understanding of segmentation, behavioral triggers and personalization, with the ability to translate a marketing objective into a working campaign or journey.
- Experience running A/B tests, interpreting campaign data and turning findings into practical recommendations.
- Confidence working with technology and data: understanding targeting and automation logic, investigating campaign setup issues and explaining requirements to technical colleagues. 
- Strong attention to detail, sound judgement and clear communication. You can take ownership of delivery, manage competing timelines and work constructively with stakeholders. 
- A degree in Marketing, Business, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant practical experience.

Why Join MXP?

You will help shape how customers experience Changi across their lifecycle, with the opportunity to develop your skills in journey design, marketing automation and experimentation. Working within a team that brings together campaign delivery, customer data and platform expertise, you will see your ideas through from design to live delivery and measurable learning.

title: Marketing Executive, Email Marketing

description:

Our products are built in tier-1 global factories that manufacture for some of the world’s biggest brands. By selling directly to consumers at accessible prices, we ensure that personal care is inclusive across all income levels.


Backed by Leading Investors
We’re proud to be backed by billion-dollar venture capital funds including East Ventures and GSR. Our supporters also include founders and leaders from some of the region’s most iconic brands: Razer, Carousell, ShopBack, Carro, PRISM+, Grab, Atome, and many more.


The Role
You'll own Stryv's direct marketing engine—building, executing, and optimizing email, SMS, and WhatsApp campaigns that inform, educate, and drive revenue. You'll work across multiple audiences and markets, balancing promotional campaigns with educational content that builds brand trust.

- Campaign Planning & Execution: Develop and maintain a comprehensive email and direct marketing campaign calendar across all markets. Plan campaigns that drive seasonal promotions, product launches, and customer education initiatives. Coordinate closely with product managers to align on launch timelines and messaging, and work with local marketing teams across Singapore, Malaysia, and Hong Kong to ensure campaigns reflect regional priorities and insights. - Innovation & Testing: Identify and test new engagement channels, messaging formats, and audience segments. Stay current on trends in direct marketing and identify opportunities for Stryv to stand out.

Required Qualifications:

- 3–4+ years of direct marketing experience, with a strong focus on email marketing. Experience with SMS and WhatsApp marketing is a plus.

title: Brand and Marketing Manager, SEA & India – Fenty Beauty
categories: Retail and Retail Luxury Goods and Jewelry
description:

Kendo is the small but mighty force behind your favourite beauty products. A play on the words “can do,” Kendo is redefining the beauty industry through next-generation products, visionary campaigns and unforgettable retail presence. Kendo creates original founder brands, partnering with major faces from fashion and entertainment. The house of brands currently includes KVD Vegan Beauty, Fenty Beauty by Rihanna, Fenty Skin, Ole Henriksen, and Lip Lab. We tell their stories to bring to life the dream products you’ve always wanted but have never been able to find.


POSITION SUMMARY 
The Brand & Marketing Manager is responsible for orchestrating and executing the brand and marketing strategy for the SEA & India region. Reporting to the Senior Marketing Manager, this role leads the development and implementation of brand positioning, messaging, and consumer engagement across all touchpoints, ensuring a cohesive and impactful brand presence.
The Brand & Marketing Manager drives the planning and execution of comprehensive 360° marketing initiatives, manages the marketing calendar and budget, and collaborates closely with commercial, retail, and education teams to optimize brand performance and market share. Additionally, this role oversees in-store visual merchandising, leads special projects and consumer events, and partners with PR and social media teams to ensure alignment with brand objectives. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker and hands-on leader with deep experience in brand management and marketing within the beauty industry, a proven track record in the SEA & India markets, and a passion for building strong cross-functional relationships in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead and oversees the end-to-end design and execution of consumer events, ensuring consistency with brand guidelines, objectives and delivering a cohesive brand experience.
- Define pricing strategies for new launches and review annual price adjustments. Lead product launch forecasting and collaborate with Planning and Retail teams to maintain optimal stock levels, particularly for key products (eg: Key bets, Top SKUs, Hot off Press etc)
- Lead the delivery of marketing projects and campaigns, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and timely execution.
- Measure and analyze the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and activities. Provide actionable insights and recommendations to the Senior Marketing Manager for continuous improvement.

- The ability to work in a fast-paced environment and juggle multiple priorities.

- Strong business acumen and analytical skills, results oriented.
- Good interpersonal skills high level of integrity.

title: CRM and Growth Assistant Manager
description:
The COMO Group represents an integrated approach to living well, grounded in a celebration of diversity and a deep respect for authenticity. The Group’s businesses extend across hospitality (COMO Hotels and Resorts), fashion (Club21, Kids21, Dover Street Market Singapore), wellness (COMO Shambhala), organic living and specialty foods (COMO Dempsey, Culina and SuperNature) and philanthropy (COMO Foundation).


Job Summary
We are seeking a proactive, agile and data-driven CRM and Growth Assistant Manager / Manager to join our marketing team. Balancing luxury brand flair with commercial growth principles, you will play a central role in driving customer activation, lifecycle engagement and retention across omnichannel touchpoints.


In this role, you will take full ownership of lifecycle communications, database segmentation and conversion journeys while collaborating closely with retail and merchandising teams to experiment across physical and digital channels. By delivering a seamless online-to-offline experience and integrated CRM/CX strategies, you will optimize customer lifetime value (LTV) and brand growth.


 Job Responsibilities


CRM and Lifecycle Marketing

- Plan, build and deploy targeted eDM, SMS and offline clienteling/direct mail communications with meticulous accuracy, high deliverability and strong brand alignment.
- Partner with leadership and the loyalty team to design and implement automated lifecycle workflows, including welcome sequences, birthday triggers, win-back triggers and omnichannel VIP loyalty journeys, using RFM segmentation.
- Translate customer insights into actionable learnings to help shape member benefits and strengthen engagement.
- Partner with retail and merchandising teams to equip them with customer insights and outreach lists for a seamless online-to-offline experience.
- Brief and collaborate with the Creative team on copy, visuals and templates that uphold the brand’s tone of voice and identity.


Data, Database and Compliance

- Maintain database hygiene, manage deliverability protocols and ensure full compliance with relevant privacy legislation (PDPA/GDPR) and data protection standards.
- Support IT, e-commerce and system partners in integrating and unifying customer data across POS, e-commerce, CRM and CDP platforms for a single customer view.
- Establish and maintain tracking standards (UTM parameters, conversion events and tagging) to measure campaign performance accurately.


 Digital Growth and Conversion

- Build and optimize high-converting landing pages, lead-capture forms and sign-up mechanisms across omnichannel touchpoints.
- Design, implement and analyze continuous A/B and multivariate experiments across email messaging, landing page layouts, CTAs and onboarding flows to increase conversion rates and revenue per recipient.
- Explore and pilot emerging owned and paid channels suited to our customer base.
- Align CRM journeys with social, affiliate and paid media campaigns for consistent full-funnel messaging.


 Reporting and Insights

- Prepare comprehensive CRM performance reviews and post-campaign analytics evaluating conversion metrics, sales attribution (online and in-store) and traffic impact to generate actionable growth recommendations.
- Partner with leadership to build and maintain dashboards tracking core KPIs, including database growth, opt-in rates, open/click-through rates, retention and repeat purchase rates, LTV and CRM-attributed revenue.


Stakeholder Collaboration

- Work closely with internal stakeholders including loyalty, merchandising and e-commerce teams to translate promotional calendars and events into automated lead-capture and growth workflows.
- Monitor luxury retail market trends, MarTech developments and competitor retention strategies to identify emerging automation and growth opportunities.


Job Requirements

- Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Business Management or a related discipline.
- 3 to 5 years’ experience in CRM, lifecycle, email or growth marketing, ideally within retail, fashion or high-growth consumer brands.
- Hands-on proficiency with CRM or marketing automation platforms (e.g. Klaviyo, CleverTap, HubSpot, Salesforce), Excel, Google Analytics 4 and basic HTML or landing page builders.
- Experience running multichannel campaigns across email, SMS, push, WhatsApp and Telegram.
- Analytical mindset, with experience in A/B testing, customer data analysis and segmentation.
- Strong project management, ownership and cross-functional communication skills with the ability to manage competing deadlines.
- Strong written English skills.


Advantageous

- Experience with paid retargeting on Meta and Google Ads, including custom audience syncing, plus a working knowledge of attribution and customer funnels.
- Familiarity with e-commerce platforms, Power BI or Tableau and customer data platforms such as Treasure Data.
- Start-up or lean-team experience.

title: Data Analyst (Marketing & Customer Analytics)
description:

Why Join Us?
Every day, millions of people across Singapore rely on FairPrice Group for their daily essentials. As a Data Analyst (Marketing & Customer Analytics), you won't just analyze numbers—you will shape how Singapore shops.

- Analytical & Statistical Mindset: Skilled in statistical modeling, customer segmentation, cohort analysis, and campaign incrementality measurement.
- Business Acumen & Storytelling: Able to bridge the gap between complex datasets and commercial strategy, articulating insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
The Marketing Manager is a leadership role responsible for shaping and driving Hegen’s brand and growth strategy across key markets. You will be responsible for developing and executing integrated marketing initiatives that strengthen brand equity, accelerate customer acquisition, and support commercial objectives across both direct-to-consumer and retail channels.


The ideal candidate is both strategic and hands-on, someone who can translate insights into action, manage multiple campaigns with precision, and continuously refine approaches based on data and market trends. You should be comfortable navigating a fast-paced, evolving environment, with a strong sense of ownership and a passion for building meaningful consumer connections.


This role offers the opportunity to take end-to-end ownership of marketing initiatives and contribute directly to the growth of a purpose-driven, internationally recognised brand.


Key Responsibilities: 
Brand & Creative Leadership

- Champion the development of first-in-class consumer engagement and brand campaigns that deliver measurable results and emotional resonance across all channels.
- Lead creative strategy and direction in partnership with the Creative team to ensure all assets reflect brand DNA, campaign objectives, and consumer insights.
- Guard and evolve brand equity by ensuring all communications, activations, and experiences consistently embody Hegen’s tone, purpose, and visual identity.


Integrated 360° GTM Strategy

- Develop and execute holistic GTM plans that integrate paid, earned, shared, and owned media to meet brand and commercial objectives.
- Build multi-channel campaign frameworks (digital, retail, PR, social, influencer, experiential) that deliver both awareness and conversion outcomes.
- Work cross-functionally with Commerical, Strategic Partnerships, International and E-Commerce to align marketing initiatives with business priorities and launch pipelines.


Digital, Social & Consumer Engagement

Insights, Performance & Budget Management

- Develop annual marketing plans and manage marketing budgets (PR, social, digital, and commercial) to ensure efficiency and ROI.
- Use analytics and insights to evaluate campaign effectiveness against defined KPIs, optimize in real time, and inform future strategy.
- Prepare monthly reports on progress versus strategy, identifying key learnings and growth opportunities.


Cross-Market Synergy & Partnerships

- Ensure alignment of brand message, positioning, and creative expression across all international markets.

Continuous Innovation

- Stay abreast of emerging tools, technologies, and cultural trends to identify white spaces and elevate Hegen’s brand relevance.
- Bring fresh creative and data-driven thinking to marketing challenges, ensuring the brand remains ahead of consumer expectations.


Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related discipline
- 5 to 8 years of integrated marketing experience, including progression into a managerial capacity
- Prior experience in FMCG, parenting, lifestyle, or consumer goods industries preferred
- Proven track record of developing and executing multi-channel marketing campaigns with measurable business impact
- Experience managing agencies and cross-functional stakeholders effectively
- Strong understanding of digital, social, and performance marketing, including analytics and optimisation
- Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable marketing insights
- Experience leading or mentoring a marketing team, with ability to set direction and drive accountability
- Strategic, data-driven with strong commercial acumen and organisational skills
- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and project management skills
- Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile and entrepreneurial environment


At Hegen, we redefine the parenting experience with award-winning innovations tailored for mothers and their little ones. As a trusted brand in mother and baby products, our mission is to empower mothers in their breastfeeding journey and ease the transition into parenthood through meaningful products and services. Recognised as one of Singapore’s top 10 fastest growing companies, Hegen takes pride in creating practical solutions that combine thoughtful designs with functionality and sustainability for time-strapped parents.


Equal Opportunity & Data Protection Statement
Hegen is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. By submitting your application, you consent to the collection, use and disclosure of your personal data for recruitment and employment-related purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws.


Join Us
At Hegen, we are passionate about fostering a purpose-driven, inclusive and collaborative work environment where every team member can thrive. We are committed to supporting personal growth and offering opportunities for career development at every stage of your journey.
Join us in realising our bold vision of impacting 100 million mothers worldwide through innovation, compassion, and excellence. If you are inspired to make a difference and grow with a dynamic team, apply now and embark on an exciting journey with Hegen.

title: CRM & Loyalty Manager
description:
About Us

Love, Bonito is Southeast Asia's leading womenswear brand, built with a mission to empower women to find confidence through style. Incorporated in 2010 in Singapore, we've since grown from a humble online startup into a multi-channel business with over 20 stores and counting across Asia and a thriving online presence.

For the next decade, we are looking to expand through new categories, markets, wholesale partnerships, and brand acquisitions. We are evolving into a next-generation regional consumer group — one that blends heart with performance, and creativity with technology.

At our core, we're a team of builders, dreamers, and doers who believe culture is more than words on a wall — it's how we show up every day. We move fast, stay curious, and take bold bets on ideas and people we believe in. Here, you'll find a community that challenges you to grow, trusts you to lead, and celebrates you for being you. Together, we're shaping the future of Asian brands — from right here in Southeast Asia, to the world.

Why join us?

At Love, Bonito, you'll do more than just a job — you'll help build a movement. We're creating an organization that's lean, bold, and full of heart — where every person has the space to make an impact. Here's what you can expect:



- Purpose with performance: We're building a world-class Asian brand that competes globally. We hold ourselves to high standards and operate with purpose, integrity, grit and excellence. Join us if you take customer service excellence seriously and are passionate about creating real impact!
- Growth that's real: We are known to be incredibly dynamic and fast-paced. You'll be expected to learn fast, stretch beyond your comfort zone, and work alongside people who challenge and support you in equal measure. Don't join us if you're looking for a comfortable, fully structured setup, but do join us if you're excited to build, shape, and make an impact together!
- Culture at our core: If you're looking for a no-corporate-BS environment, you'll fit right in. We lead with empathy, celebrate individuality, and believe that great work comes from trust, not titles. We believe in teamwork and effective collaboration - because when we run together, we go further. If this speaks to your values, come join us and be part of #TeamLB!

Join us as we redefine what it means to build an enduring global consumer group.

About The Role

We are looking for a CRM & Loyalty Manager to own how we talk to and reward our customers. Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll lead a lean team of three, and turn customer data into campaigns, rewards, and decisions that drive engagement, retention, and lifetime value.

Main Responsibilities



-  CRM Communications
- Own the CRM communications strategy and calendar 
- Build and manage campaigns to drive acquisition, retention, and LTV
- Drive segmentation, personalisation, and A/B testing to improve open, click, and conversion rates
-  Mobile Engagement
- Own the mobile communications strategy and calendar
- Build and manage mobile campaigns to drive acquisition, retention, and LTV
- Drive segmentation, personalisation, and A/B testing to improve open, click, and conversion rates
-  Loyalty Programme
- Own the loyalty programme strategy end to end — enrollment, tiering, rewards, and redemption
- Design and launch new perks, rewards, and experiences that increase engagement and repeat purchase
- Track programme performance (enrollment, redemption, incremental revenue) and iterate based on results
- Manage the loyalty platform vendor relationship and lead evaluations of new capabilities
-  Customer Insights
- Analyse customer data — behaviour, purchase, and engagement — to generate insights that inform CRM, loyalty, and broader marketing decisions
- Build customer segmentation and journey mapping to sharpen targeting across channels
- Run surveys, focus groups, and voice-of-customer programmes to deepen the company's understanding of customer needs
- Partner cross-functionally to embed customer insights into product, merchandising, and marketing strategy
-  Reporting & Budgeting
- Report CRM and loyalty performance against KPIs — acquisition, retention, engagement, and programme ROI
- Manage the team's budget, with full accountability for allocation across CRM and loyalty priorities
-  Technology, Automation & AI
- Manage the CRM and push platforms, and maximize martech tools to strengthen automation and targeting
- Utilize technology and AI with the goal of improving efficiency whether across driving revenue optimization or automation
-  Team & Stakeholder Management
- Lead and coach a team, owning goal-setting, performance management, and capability development
- Own CRM and loyalty KPIs — acquisition, retention, engagement, and programme ROI 
- Represent CRM and loyalty priorities into broader marketing and leadership planning
- Manage vendor and agency relationships supporting CRM and loyalty execution

What Success Looks Like In 6 Months



- CRM communications run on a consistent, optimised calendar, with operational efficiency, with a measurable lift in engagement
- The loyalty programme has a clear roadmap 
- Customer insights is feeding directly into marketing and business decisions

Main KPIs



- Revenues from email and mobile push notification channels
- Customer retention metrics 
- Loyalty programme enrollment, redemption, and incremental revenue
- Mobile MAU

Requirements

Qualifications 



- 7+ years of experience in a CRM role, preferably in retail or e-commerce
- Hands-on experience with CRM/marketing automation platforms (we use Braze)
- Experience in driving mobile engagement 
- Experience managing a loyalty or membership programme
- Experience leading and developing a team
- Analytical and proficient in SQL

What Sets You Apart



- You're equal parts strategist and executor — as comfortable building the loyalty roadmap as you are debugging a campaign send

Who Will Not Be a Fit



- Anyone who wants to set strategy without owning execution

How We Work



- Clarity over complexity
- Fewer, bigger bets
- Hands-on, accountable leadership
- Open challenge, fast decisions

title: Marketing Manager
description:
BullionStar has no shortage of things worth marketing. We sell physical gold and silver, operate a market leading bullion centre and vaults across three countries, have an active and highly engaged customer base, and sit in an industry that is rarely short of something to talk about. What we need is someone to bring it all together.


As Marketing Manager, you will own the marketing plan and turn it into campaigns across social, email, content, PR, the website and our physical bullion centre. You will decide what we should be talking about, how we should talk about it, where it should appear, and how the different pieces come together. This is not a role where you will be handed a marketing plan to execute, you will help shape it with the Deputy CEO, and the wider team. What we need from you is the judgement to spot a good opportunity, know what to do with it, and turn it into marketing that works.


Who we are


BullionStar is Singapore’s leading precious metals dealer. We sell, buy back, store, and deliver physical gold, silver, and platinum to customers worldwide – from first-time buyers to institutional investors. We operate a full-service showroom in Singapore, a comprehensive e-commerce platform, and vault storage facilities across multiple jurisdictions.


We are independently owned, founder-led, and intentionally lean. There are no layers of corporate bureaucracy here. Decisions are made quickly, everyone is close to the customer, and every person in the business has a direct impact on what we deliver. We’ve built our reputation on trust, transparency, and doing things properly.


We’re looking for people who are drawn to that kind of environment – people who want ownership, not job titles, and who find energy in building something rather than maintaining something.


One thing to know about our audience: they are sceptics by temperament. They distrust banks, they distrust hype, and they will distrust us the moment we sound like an ad. The marketing that works here earns attention with substance.


What you will do

- Strategy. A real marketing plan: which audiences, what message, which channels, what calendar, and why. Shaped with the Deputy CEO, the wider team, and owned and executed by you.



- Campaigns. Product launches, limited time offers, seasonal pushes and competitions across digital, social, email and the store itself. The idea, the assets, the timing and the follow-through are yours.



- Social and community. With our creatives, drive what we do on X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok and LinkedIn: the calendar, the formats and the growth. Show up where people already talk about gold and silver too: Reddit, forums and comment sections. Answer questions genuinely, understand what people care about, and bring those insights back into our marketing.



- Email. The programme end-to-end: calendar, segments, offers, copy, send, and the honest read on what it returned. Every send must earn the next one.



- Creative and content direction. Photography, video, graphics, ad creative and written content. You will not be behind the camera all day, but you will be the reason the work is good: the briefs, the direction, the feedback and the standard. You will also have real input into how bullionstar.com itself develops.



- Media relations. Be proactive with PR. Spot the opportunity, whether it is a journalist’s query, a news moment or a story worth pitching, and find the way to make it happen and land well.



- Analytics. We have an unusually deep warehouse of order and campaign data, plus analytics support. Know which campaigns moved product, which did not, and feed that into the next plan.



- The thread. Product, the shop floor, editorial, social, email, website: someone must make the post, the email, the site banner and the shop window feel like one campaign.


Who you are

- Campaigns directed, not just contributed to. Walk us through one from strategy to results: the audience, the idea, what you made, what you directed and what happened. More than once and across more than one channel.



- Excellent written and spoken English. This one is absolute. Plans that persuade, copy that sells without sounding like it, and the same standard out loud. Nothing else on this list can offset it. Your application is your first writing sample.



- E-commerce experience. You have marketed products that people buy online and understand the whole journey from first impression to landing page to checkout and repeat purchase. You think about the campaign and the buying experience as one thing and understand that getting attention is only useful if something happens afterwards.



- Social and email as crafts, not distribution channels. You understand how each platform works. Follower counts you inherited do not count; things you made that travelled do. You have also run an EDM programme yourself and can show what it returned.



- Understanding of brand and customer. Your creative judgement is grounded in who we are and who buys from us, not personal taste. You can explain the call to someone who disagrees.



- Genuinely inquisitive. You do not need to arrive knowing the difference between a kilobar and a collectible coin, but you should want to. Nobody hands you a syllabus here. You teach yourself the business, the industry, the products and the customers because you want to know, and it shows up in the work.



- You see the opportunity in the product. Gold and silver are unusual things to market. They are valuable, physical, visual and surrounded by history, markets, politics, manufacturing, collecting and some very opinionated customers. Then there are the vaults, the shop floor, the deliveries and the moments when the price moves and the shop suddenly fills up. You notice those things and instinctively start thinking about what we could do with them.



- You pay attention to the market. You know what our competitors are doing, what they are doing well and where they are getting it wrong. You look beyond bullion too, learning from the best ideas in e-commerce and other industries. You do not copy for the sake of it, but you are always watching, learning and thinking about what we could do better.



- Creative judgement. You have made enough yourself, whether video, image, layout or ad, to know quickly when something is not good enough and to explain why.



- Commercial instinct. You care about reach, engagement and brand, but you know they are not the result. Marketing here ultimately must attract customers, sell metal and grow the business. You naturally ask what something cost, what it returned and whether we should do it again.



- The whole digital picture. You understand SEO, paid media, attribution and conversion well enough to see how they fit together, even where specialists run the channel. You are comfortable enough with numbers to judge your own campaigns honestly.



- Media relations. You know how to spot a story worth pitching, deal with journalists and turn something happening in the business or the market into an opportunity.



- Based in Singapore. This is an on-site role at New Bridge Road. We work in the same room. And when we are busy, everyone gets stuck in the shop, the customers, the vault. An afternoon on the shop floor can teach you more than a month of dashboards.

If you are a natural team builder, sharp with data, fearless in a negotiation and passionate about health and fitness, we want you to join our team. We are open to sponsoring a Singapore Employment Pass for the right candidate.


About the Role:
The Marketing Manager (Influencers & Campaigns) is responsible for building OxyShred’s North American athlete and influencer program, delivering 52 commercially driven campaigns a year and turning influencer content into measurable revenue.


This role sits at the intersection of talent, campaigns and performance. You will lead a team Athlete & Influencer Performance Executives across Australia and Singapore/Malaysia, signing and managing talent, building campaigns, negotiating deals and proving the return on every dollar invested.


Reporting to the Global Director of Marketing, you will play a pivotal role in building our new global marketing hub in Singapore and Malaysia.


Content is king, but distribution is the kingdom.


Success in this role means a high-performing roster, a campaign every week, and athlete and influencer partnerships that generate demand, customers and revenue.


Responsibilities:

- Drive Athlete & Influencer Performance: Plan and run 52 athlete- and influencer-led campaigns a year across North America, driving e-commerce revenue through discount codes, email acquisition and @OxyShred follower growth.
- Lead Campaigns & Launches: Own the talent layer of major brand campaigns, product launches and retail moments, with integrated plans across social, content, paid media, retail and e-commerce.
- Own TikTok Reach & Frequency: Set the strategy and brief for TikTok Reach & Frequency campaigns that drive awareness and retail velocity around launches.
- Scale Winning Content: Identify top-performing organic content fast, push it to Paid Media for amplification, and keep a steady pipeline of creative ready for paid.
- Build & Lead the Team: Hire 4 new executives in Singapore/Malaysia, coach the team against clear commercial KPIs, and run a weekly pipeline and performance cadence across both offices.
- Negotiate Talent Partnerships: Recruit athletes and influencers who fit our target consumer, and negotiate deals end to end, including fees, deliverables, exclusivity, usage rights and renewals.
- Manage the Roster for Return: Benchmark rates, track performance, cut or renegotiate underperforming partnerships, and move investment to the strongest performers.
- Report & Optimise: Report campaign and roster performance weekly to the Global Director of Marketing, using data to sharpen briefs, hooks, talent selection and creative.


About you:

- Proven experience leading athlete, influencer or creator marketing programs with clear commercial outcomes.
- Experience leading, hiring and performance-managing a team, ideally across multiple locations.
- Strong negotiator with experience in talent contracts, usage rights and exclusivity.
- Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram and short-form content that drives both attention and sales.
- Commercially minded and comfortable owning revenue, ROI and budgets.
- Confident reading performance data and making fast decisions from it.
- Experience with paid social amplification and the North American market is highly desirable.
- Comfortable challenging talent, agencies and internal teams when performance isn’t good enough.
- Passionate about fitness, wellness and consumer brands.
- Most importantly, you know the best influencer programs don’t just generate attention. They generate revenue.


About EHPlabs:
At EHPlabs we are about leading health and fitness through our ethos of ‘we rise by lifting others’. Our prefix 'EHP' stands for 'Empowered Human Potential' as we believe in empowering our community with the tools and vital information to make better-informed decisions leading to healthier, happier lifestyles.


Since our launch in 2012 we are proud to have positively impacted millions of people's lives through our industry-leading fitness supplements as well as our high-impact marketing through digital channels.


We are a team of passionate people who strive for continuous and never-ending improvement. To learn more about us please visit our website: http://ehplabs.com

title: Senior/Manager, CRM, Loyalty & Customer Engagement
description:
Position Summary 
The CRM, Loyalty and Customer Engagement Manager owns EYSS’s customer engagement strategy, Eu Rewards loyalty programme and CRM technology ecosystem. The role drives customer acquisition, engagement, retention, repeat purchase and customer lifetime value by translating business objectives into data-led lifecycle strategies, loyalty propositions and automated customer journeys across retail, e-commerce and digital channels. 
The incumbent acts as the business owner for Salesforce Loyalty Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud and related CRM technologies, working closely with Retail, E-Commerce, IT, Customer Service, Finance and external partners to deliver seamless customer experiences, personalised engagement, programme governance and measurable loyalty-led growth. 


Key Responsibilities 
1. CRM, Lifecycle and Customer Engagement Strategy 

- Develop and implement customer lifecycle strategies across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, reactivation and loyalty. 
- Use segmentation, contact strategy and omnichannel journey design to improve repeat purchase, member engagement, customer lifetime value and churn reduction. 
- Collaborate with Retail and E-Commerce teams to ensure consistent customer experiences across store, online and digital touchpoints. 


2. Loyalty Programme Ownership 

- Own the Eu Rewards loyalty programme, including programme proposition, tier structure, rewards, member engagement mechanics, bonus point campaigns and performance monitoring. 
- Ensure programme governance, operational controls, data integrity and loyalty liability coordination with Finance are properly managed. 
- Identify opportunities to improve programme relevance, member value, participation and commercial contribution. 


3. Salesforce, Martech and Platform Business Ownership 

- Act as the business owner for Salesforce Loyalty Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud and related CRM technologies. 
- Manage business requirements, enhancement requests, solution design input, UAT, deployment readiness, defect assessment, platform optimisation and operational governance. 
- Maintain a strong business understanding of how CRM, loyalty, ERP, POS, e-commerce, customer data, integrations, APIs and member identity platforms connect to support customer experience, reporting and business processes. 
- Work with IT and implementation partners to ensure platform solutions are scalable, well-governed and aligned with EYSS’s business needs. 


4. Marketing Automation and Customer Journey Management 

- Plan, implement and optimise Salesforce Marketing Cloud customer journeys across lifecycle automation, segmentation, triggered communications, email, SMS and personalised engagement. 
- Use Journey Builder, Contact Builder, Data Extensions, Automation Studio and campaign performance insights to improve marketing relevance, operational efficiency and customer engagement effectiveness. 
- Establish automation frameworks that support onboarding, nurture, retention, reactivation, replenishment and other customer lifecycle use cases. 


5. Customer Analytics, Insights and Performance Optimisation 

- Monitor customer, loyalty and campaign performance to identify growth opportunities and recommend data-driven initiatives. 
- Track and interpret key customer metrics across membership growth, active member rate, retention, repeat purchase, CLV, churn, segmentation, cohort, RFM, loyalty participation and campaign effectiveness. 
- Prepare insights and recommendations that support strategic decision-making, customer growth and continuous improvement. 


6. CRM Partnership, Stakeholder and Vendor Management 

- Develop and manage CRM partnership marketing initiatives that strengthen member acquisition, customer value propositions and engagement. 
- Coordinate external partner campaigns, loyalty collaborations, joint promotions and ROI evaluation. 
- Manage CRM, loyalty and martech vendors, including Salesforce partners, agencies, consultants and system implementors. 
- Facilitate requirements prioritisation, review solution approaches, support issue resolution and RCA, and ensure contracted outcomes are delivered. 


Qualifications and Experience 

- Degree in Marketing, Business, Information Systems, Digital Marketing or a related discipline. 
- Minimum 5 years of experience in CRM, loyalty, customer engagement, marketing operations or martech. 
- Hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience is required; exposure to Salesforce Loyalty Cloud or enterprise loyalty platforms is strongly preferred. 
- Experience in customer lifecycle marketing, marketing automation, loyalty programme management, segmentation and campaign optimisation. 
- Experience working with system implementors, technology vendors and cross-functional project teams. 
- Retail, healthcare, wellness, FMCG, consumer membership or omnichannel business experience is preferred.

We Are Looking For

We are seeking a proactive and highly analytical professional with a talent for translating data into strategy and building strong partnerships.

- An excellent collaborator with strong project and stakeholder management abilities, capable of navigating a complex matrix organization.
- A deeply analytical mindset with proven, hands-on experience turning disparate data sets into clear business insights and strategic recommendations.
- A natural relationship-builder, skilled at creating and nurturing strategic partnerships with external parties.
- A strategic thinker with a strong appreciation for luxury branding and the ability to maintain high brand standards.
- An entrepreneurial and problem-solving mindset, comfortable with ambiguity and skilled at crafting new workflows for first-in-the-industry initiatives.

Your Experience And Requirements



- Bachelor’s degree or above preferably in Business, Marketing, Analytics, or a related discipline
- 5-8 years of solid experience in CRM, customer loyalty programs, or managing data collaboration partnerships. Experience from industries like financial services, travel & hospitality, telecommunications, or luxury retail is highly valuable.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About the company
At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.


Job description
We're looking for a Creative Strategist & Content Producer to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. The Creative Strategist & Content Producer will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms. You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry.


Key Responsibilities:


Creative Strategy 

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Spearhead tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads)
- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR)
- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion)
- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy


In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing
- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:
1. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications
2. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads
3. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)
4. Generative AI Production: Utilize AI tools and prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video and static image assets for rapid content production and testing

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs
- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms)
- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms


Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic
- Iteration & Optimization:
1. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance
2. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

- Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey


Multi-Channel Storytelling

- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials
- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion
- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition


Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities
- Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines & marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language & digital promotions
- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values
- Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness & compliance before publication


Requirements:

- 3–5 years of experience in creative strategy, content creation, social media, or brand marketing — ideally in health supplements, healthcare or wellness.
- Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta (FB/IG), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google, Generative AI).
- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
- Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills — adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals.
- Excellent communication, project management & cross-functional collaboration skills.
- Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

title: Manager, Loyalty Marketing, APEC
description:
JOB SUMMARY
The Manager, Loyalty Marketing is a high-impact, commercially oriented role responsible for driving member growth, engagement and retention across Asia Pacific excluding China (APEC).
This is a new role sitting at the intersection of loyalty strategy, CRM, and experiential partnerships - built for a marketer who is equally comfortable designing a lifecycle journey and activating world-class partnerships. You will own the end-to-end member journeys for one of the world's largest hospitality loyalty programs, translating global strategy into locally relevant, measurable initiatives across a diverse and dynamic region. This role will report to the Director, Loyalty Marketing, APEC.


You will lead the evolution of CRM and lifecycle marketing for APEC — defining segmentation strategy, designing engagement programs, and driving measurable improvements in activation, retention and reactivation. You will work in close collaboration with global, continent and market teams, and play a central role in building the reach and scaling our loyalty program as a long-term growth driver for the business. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, strategic thinking and a member-centric mindset.
This role is based in Singapore.


CORE COMPETENCIES 

- CRM & Lifecycle Marketing: Deep, hands-on experience designing and executing programs across the full customer journey. Builds segmentation logic, personalisation strategy and automated flows anchored in commercial outcomes, not just campaign execution.
- Loyalty & Partnership Marketing: Solid understanding of loyalty program mechanics (earn/burn, tiering, member value proposition) and how to market them effectively across segments and channels. Proven ability to activate brand partnerships, event management and experiential moments from brief to delivery, with strong agency management.
- Data Analysis & Fluency: Comfortable working with member behaviour data, campaign analytics and dashboards to surface insight and drive continuous improvement. Tracks activity to outcomes, not outputs.
- Communication & Brand Stewardship: Executes customer-facing communications with a consistent, on-brand voice across owned and paid channels. Brings sharp copywriting instincts, strong creative review judgment, and the ability to influence and align across global, regional and local teams with different cultures and working styles.
- Execution & Project Management: Highly organised with a strong bias for delivery. Manages multiple workstreams simultaneously, ensuring projects adhere to timelines.


CANDIDATE PROFILE
We are looking for a marketer with 4+ years of experience in loyalty, CRM or lifecycle marketing, ideally within hospitality, travel, or a consumer brand environment.
Requirement

- 4-5 years of relevant professional experience in program management, marketing strategy, loyalty and lifecycle disciplines, digital or related function
- Experience managing and directing strategic partners / agencies /vendors. Demonstrated relationship marketing skills a must.
- Team player, proven ability to lead and work with cross-functional teams in support of specific business priorities
- Languages: Proficiency in English required; proficiency in reading and writing in other Asian languages strongly preferred.


JOB SCOPE
Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing 

- Drive member growth, engagement and advocacy across APEC through loyalty-led initiatives that build program awareness, deepen usage and deliver locally relevant member value
- Develop and execute the continent's loyalty marketing plan - spanning promotions, lifecycle programs and CRM strategy - aligned with global strategy and optimised for local market nuance
- Define and manage CRM strategy across the full customer lifecycle: acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention and reactivation
- Plan and execute loyalty-led campaigns across owned channels (email, app, digital) and paid channels (social, digital) with audience analysis, targeting, segmentation and performance tracking
- Identify opportunities for segmentation, personalisation to deliver on deeper customer value optimisation; drive continuous improvement in CRM effectiveness and automation capabilities
- Leverage market research, member insights and data analytics to inform engagement strategies and personalised experiences
- Design, implement and optimise loyalty programs that drive advocacy and revenue, delivering tangible value to target member segments
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including but not limited to MarTech, Enterprise Partnerships (Co-Brand, Airlines, Everyday Earn) and Loyalty Operations to integrate and orchestrate initiatives across key customer touchpoints
- Serve as gatekeeper for all loyalty member communications, ensuring on-brand, accurate and effective execution


Performance Operations & Governance

- Track and report program KPIs covering member acquisition, activation, retention, revenue contribution and repeat stay behaviour, with clear recommendations for improvement
- Oversee CRM data accuracy, integrity and compliance across programs
- Drive effective onboarding, training and adoption of loyalty programs and systems across property teams


Experiential Partnerships

- Support the activation of global and regional marketing partnerships translating partnership rights into compelling, member-facing campaigns that drive high member engagement, leveraging on Marriott Bonvoy Moments
- Ensure all partnership campaigns are executed in full alignment with partners, with rigorous agency management and end-to-end campaign planning
- Support end-to-end event management and logistics planning for partnership activations, ensuring seamless on-ground execution and member experiences


Working Relations
Key interfaces:-

- Area Directors of Marketing
- Field Marketing team
- Continent level agencies.
Integrated Marketing Planning

- Supports development of continent destination marketing strategy and focused on key source markets and KPIs.
- Monitor competitive activity in the category.
Promotions/ Partnerships

- Partners with Revenue Strategy, develops and executes promotions/offers that drive KPIs for the continent or market (eg. Enrollment goals, direct channel goals, driving leisure revenue, etc.).
- Partner with analytics team to ensure proper tracking and communication of all programs.
Integrated Marketing Execution

- Engages agencies in RFP process and project manages the creative design and execution process to bring a program to market. Ensures consumer messaging is clear.

- Provides strong guidance on positioning and pull through of brands.
- Advises field marketing on effective marketing communications planning, implementation and evaluation.
- Conducts destination marketing training and develops resources and materials for Directors of Sales and Marketing with a focus on marketing planning, branding, positioning, messaging and storytelling.
- Deal with own development of the process for new hotel ramp up and hotel positioning and messaging development. Partners with area marketing leaders to execute where needed.


MANAGEMENT COMPETENCIES

title: E-Commerce Lead
description:
Aire is a Singapore-born senior care brand on a mission to redefine ageing and incontinence. We make adult diapers, pull-up pants and leak pads that are softer, more absorbent and sized for Asian bodies, so older adults can enjoy carefree days and restful nights.


The Role
We're hiring a hands-on, data-driven E-Commerce Lead to own Aire's online business across Shopee, Amazon and TikTok Shop, plus our D2C site. You'll own the full funnel: traffic, conversion, retention and channel P&L. You'll also build our livestream and social commerce engine from the ground up.
This is a fully remote role. We're a small, lean team, so you'll set the strategy and do the work yourself. A big part of the job is coaching our existing team members and growing their e-commerce skills as we scale.


Responsibilities
Marketplaces and social commerce

- Own e-commerce revenue and profitability targets (GMV, ROAS, CAC, LTV, repeat rate) across Shopee, Amazon, TikTok Shop and the D2C site
- Run day-to-day marketplace operations: listings, pricing, promotions, mega-sale calendars (9.9, 11.11, 12.12), stock planning and platform account-manager relationships
- Lead livestream and social commerce on TikTok Shop and Shopee Live: strategy around our hosts, scripts, run-of-show, KOL and affiliate partnerships - leading team here 
- Manage marketplace ads (Shopee Ads, Amazon Sponsored Ads, TikTok GMV Max) and allocate budget based on performance
D2C, performance and organic growth

- Grow the D2C site (shop-aire.com) as a profitable channel
- Build and scale performance marketing, including paid social, paid search (Google) and affiliate
- Drive organic growth through SEO, content and community, for both the D2C site and marketplace search
- Design and run CRO experiments across the D2C site and marketplace storefronts (product pages, bundles, vouchers)
- Build retention and lifecycle programs (email, SMS, WhatsApp, subscription and repeat purchase). Incontinence care is a recurring need, so retention is core to the business.
Data, planning and partners

- Manage the e-commerce budget and report weekly on channel performance, unit economics and forecasts
- Build market-specific playbooks as we expand into Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand
- Manage agencies and e-enabler partners, and hold them to clear targets
- Work with product, design and supply chain on launches, packaging and inventory
Team development

- Train and coach our small team in marketplace operations, ads, livestreaming and analytics
- Document processes and playbooks so the team can run channels independently
- Help hire and grow the e-commerce team as the business scales


Requirements
Must have

- 6–8+ years in e-commerce, marketplace or growth marketing, ideally in FMCG, personal care, health or wellness
- Proven experience running livestream and social commerce, with measurable results on TikTok Shop and/or Shopee Live
- Hands-on experience managing Shopee, Amazon and TikTok Shop stores, including ads, campaigns and operations
- A track record of scaling paid acquisition profitably across channels (marketplace ads, paid social, paid search)
- Working knowledge of SEO and D2C site growth (Shopify or similar), including CRO and lifecycle marketing
- Strong data skills: comfortable in seller centers, GA4, dashboards and spreadsheets, and able to make budget calls from cohort, LTV and margin data
- Experience coaching or managing others, and patience to train a team that is still learning
- Self-directed and comfortable working remotely in a lean team, doing both strategy and execution
Preferred

- Experience at an e-commerce enabler or marketplace (e.g. aCommerce, Synagie, Shopee, Lazada, Amazon, TikTok), managing multiple brands or categories
- Experience across multiple Southeast Asian markets and their regulatory environments
- Background in senior care, adult incontinence, healthcare or other regulated consumer health categories
Why Join Aire

- Build a category that serves Asia's ageing population with dignity
- Real ownership of the e-commerce channel and its P&L, working directly with the founder
- Fully remote, flexible working
- Shape and grow a team from the early stage as we expand across Southeast Asia
Read more about Aire

- After being laid off from Meta, this S'porean invested 6 figures to start an adult diaper biz (Vulcan Post, Nov 2024)
- Why We Doubled Down On Our Partnership With Aire (DSG Consumer Partners, Jun 2025)
- Why We Partnered with Aire: Championing the Silver Economy in Southeast Asia (DSG Consumer Partners, May 2024)
How to Apply
Send your CV and a short note on a livestream or marketplace campaign you're proud of (with results) to nivedita@shop-aire.com.

title: Senior Manager, CRM Marketing, Asia
description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About The Role

We’re looking for a passionate and data-driven Lifecycle Marketing Senior Manager to join our Regional Engagement team, based in Singapore. In this role, you’ll lead localized lifecycle strategies across Asia, designing and implementing campaigns that engage, retain, and win back Anime fans. You’ll combine deep knowledge of local market dynamics with a global fan-first vision, ensuring Crunchyroll connects authentically with our community across every stage of the customer journey.

What You’ll Do



- Lifecycle Strategy & Execution: Help to develop and implement lifecycle marketing strategies tailored to audiences across Asia covering acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, and winback working closely with our Lifecycle Marketing team. Ensure best practices in personalization, segmentation, and lifecycle orchestration.
- Regional Expertise: Serve as the regional expert for customer lifecycle nuances, shaping best practices, and advising on culturally & market-specific approaches, and fan engagement opportunities.
- Go-to-Market Campaigns: Collaborate with regional marketing, programming, and curation teams to design localized go-to-market moments for major content launches, seasonal events, and fan activations.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with regional marketing, content programming, and curation teams to develop go-to-market strategies and localized moments that drive subscriber growth and fandom engagement.
- Marketing Technology Leadership: Own and optimize our Braze instance in the region, leveraging its full capabilities (email, push, SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, in-app, and notification center) to design seamless and personalized user journeys.
- Fan-First Campaigns: Create impactful communications that celebrate anime fandom and strengthen Crunchyroll’s emotional connection with fans in Asia.
- Data-Driven Growth: Partner with Product, Content, Data Science, and Growth teams to measure performance, analyze insights, and continuously optimize lifecycle initiatives.
- Innovation & Experimentation: Stay on top of Asia-specific marketing trends (e.g.mobile-first experiences, digital payments, WhatsApp-first engagement) and adapt lifecycle strategies to meet fans where they are.

In this role, you will report to the Director, Growth - Asia + MENA.

We are considering applicants for the location of Singapore.

About You



- 8+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle, or retention marketing is required, ideally in the streaming, entertainment, or digital subscription services industry.
- Extensive experience with Braze (or comparable orchestration platforms), including journey design, real-time triggers, and channel execution.
- Experience in Asian markets and cultural nuances, digital marketing platforms, and messaging ecosystems with experience tailoring campaigns for diverse local audiences.
- Analytical skills to interpret performance data, identify trends, and optimize campaigns.
- Collaborative spirit—comfortable working across regional and global teams in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
- Creative acumen is essential to conceptualize and drive dynamic, fan-first engagement campaigns that captivate our growing Southeast Asian audience.
- A genuine passion for anime, fandom culture, or entertainment brands!
- Additional proficiency in relevant regional languages.

About The Team

Our Lifecycle Marketing team designs personalized journeys that drive fan connection, engagement, and loyalty. Through data-driven insights and creativity, we activate the right experiences at the right time across channels—helping anime fans feel seen, understood, and inspired by Crunchyroll.



About Our Values

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value



- Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves. 
- Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding. 
- Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.
- Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others. 

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Crunchyroll. Pursuant to applicable law, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Senior Campaign Analyst
description:
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Campaign Analyst to help shape the bank's transition towards AI-enabled, journey-led customer engagement. With 7-10 years of experience in campaign analytics, CRM or customer engagement, you will design and optimise multi-channel campaigns and always-on customer journeys that drive customer growth, product adoption and long-term value. The role combines audience intelligence, MarTech platform capabilities, experimentation and performance measurement to deliver personalised, data-driven experiences at scale. Partnering with Product, Marketing, Digital, Data and Technology teams, you will transform customer insights into actionable engagement strategies while ensuring strong governance, compliance and measurable business outcomes.


Key Responsibilities :


Campaign Strategy & Execution

- Develop and manage end-to-end marketing campaigns across email, SMS, push notifications, telesales, direct mailer and paid media.
- Design journey based campaigns, segment customers based on lifecycle stages and behaviors, and map out touchpoints & triggers.
- Conduct A/B testing and multivariate analysis to optimize campaign performance.
- Ensure all campaigns comply with PDPA and other relevant regulatory requirements and internal governance standards.


 MarTech Adoption & Continuous Improvement 

- Act as a power user and business subject-matter expert for the evolving MarTech stack, including CDP, journey orchestration, personalisation, experimentation and analytics capabilities.
- Support platform implementation, data and channel onboarding, user acceptance testing, operating-model design and migration from legacy campaign processes.
- Identify opportunities to use predictive, generative and agentic AI safely for audience discovery, journey design, insight generation and operational productivity.

Stakeholder management

- Collaborate closely with product managers to understand user requirements, campaign objectives, and fulfilment needs.
- Ensure timely and accurate delivery of campaigns and fulfilments.Customer Segmentation
- Partner with data science and analytics teams to leverage advanced analytics and predictive models in targeting customers.
- Refine customer segments and personalize outreach based on behavioral trends and product take-up.


Campaign Measurement & Fulfilment

- Prepare detailed reports and dashboards for campaign tracking, fulfilment and executive review.
- Analyze campaign performance using tools like SAS, or Power BI.
- Generate actionable insights


Required Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science or a related discipline.
- 7-10 years of experience in campaign analytics, CRM, digital analytics or customer engagement, preferably in banking or financial services.
- Hands-on proficiency in SQL and at least one analytical environment such as SAS, Python or R; experience with Power BI, Tableau or equivalent visualisation tools.
- Practical experience with CRM, marketing automation, CDP or journey orchestration platforms. Exposure to platforms such as Adobe Experience Platform / Journey Optimizer, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or equivalent is advantageous.
- Working knowledge of audience segmentation, experimentation, customer lifecycle analytics, campaign measurement and data quality controls.
- Strong stakeholder management, structured problem solving, documentation and presentation skills.
