title: Associate Consumer Experience Director, Region APAC
description:
Your impact begins here

As Associate Consumer Experience Director APAC, you will build two new capabilities that make brand marketing more credible and more measurable across the region. You will define how brands responsibly engage online influencers to earn trust and reference, and you will bring brand, campaign, digital and content-creator activity into one clear performance narrative. Your work will help teams decide where to invest and sharpen how Novo shows up for customers.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for a strong consumer marketer who can build capability from first principles and turn data into decisions.

You'll Need



-  A bachelor's degree; an advanced degree (Master's, MBA or equivalent) in Marketing, Data/Commercial or a related field is strongly preferred.
-  12+ years of progressive experience across marketing, digital, media, customer engagement or data/insights, ideally with significant regional or multi-market responsibility.
-  Local Singaporean citizens or PR holders are highly preferred.
-  Proven experience at a regional/APAC level, translating global strategy into practical approaches across markets with different priorities, regulations and levels of digital maturity.
-  Strong modern digital and social marketing expertise, including influencer/Digital Opinion Leaders (DOL) and Key Opinion Influencers (KOI) partnerships, creator collaborations, social amplification and content strategy.
-  A track record of designing new capabilities, processes or operating models — playbooks, governance and measurement frameworks — not only running established programmes.
-  Deep marketing performance and insight skills: integrating data across brand, media, digital, content and engagement, and translating it into clear recommendations and investment decisions.
-  Experience defining KPIs and reporting standards across multiple markets, channels or brands, working with analytics specialists where needed.
-  Strong cross-functional leadership and influence without direct authority, partnering with senior marketing, Medical Affairs, Legal/Ethics & Compliance, data teams, agencies and affiliates.
-  Comfort operating in a complex, matrixed multinational, balancing regional consistency with local execution realities.

Useful, But Not Essential



-  Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals or another highly regulated industry is strongly preferred. Candidates from consumer, technology or other sectors will be considered where they bring highly relevant social/influencer and data-driven marketing expertise.

What You'll Do

This is a two-pillar role. In the first, you'll lead how brands engage online influencers; in the second, you'll own how APAC marketing measures and understands its performance. Across both, you'll help shape how Novo shows up across the wider customer experience.

Online Influencer Lead, APAC 



-  Own the APAC strategy for how brands responsibly leverage online influencers (DOLs and KOIs) to build awareness, trust, credible reference and engagement, and design the process to identify, prioritise and activate opportunities with clear governance, briefing, approval and measurement.
-  Partner with Brand, Medical Affairs, Communications, Legal/Ethics & Compliance and affiliates so influencer activity is strategically relevant, medically credible, responsibly executed and compliant — and integrated with broader brand, content, digital and communications plans.
-  Work with Communications on content creator engagement, narratives, social amplification, reputation and audience trust, and help shape how brands appear across digital platforms, content environments, NovoCare and emerging discovery experiences such as Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO).
-  Define brand- and audience-specific KPIs — awareness, engagement, sentiment, share of voice, trust and reference-building — and connect influencer results to brand health and campaign performance.
-  Share best practice, case studies and reusable assets across APAC markets to build capability and reduce duplication.

Marketing Data and Insights Lead, APAC 



-  Design and own a single, integrated measurement framework across consumer marketing, media, digital, content, influencer and customer experience activity, with consistent KPI definitions, data sources, reporting standards and cadence that replace fragmented channel-level reporting.
-  Bring campaign, media, digital, content, influencer and customer experience data into one cohesive performance narrative for APAC marketing leadership, on a regular reporting and insight rhythm that connects investment to impact.
-  Translate data into clear insight and recommendations — what is working, why, where to invest next and how to optimise — and use it to inform decisions across markets, channels, campaigns, segments and content formats.
-  Partner with Brand, Communications, Medical Affairs, Campaign and affiliate teams during planning cycles to bring an evidence-based view to prioritisation and resource allocation, including practical ways to assess customer experience across key touchpoints.
-  Build data and insight capability across affiliate teams through clear tools, playbooks, templates and coaching.

Who You'll Work With

You'll work across markets in International Operations, where colleagues serve people around the world and help improve health at scale. This is a highly cross-functional role, so your ability to build trust and clear ways of working matters. Your closest partners will be Brand, Communications, Medical Affairs, Legal/Ethics & Compliance, Digital, Content and platform owners, along with regional and affiliate marketing teams across APAC. You'll also collaborate with data and analytics specialists and external agencies. These relationships are how influencer programmes stay credible and how a single performance narrative earns the confidence of leadership.

What You Can Expect Here

You'll build two new capabilities from the ground up and see your thinking shape how brands engage customers and how leadership invests across APAC. It's an environment where you're trusted to set direction, challenge established approaches and make your voice heard — and supported to do your best work as you build new skills across markets, functions and channels.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you're ready to build credible influencer engagement and a clear, decision-useful view of performance across APAC, apply for the Associate Consumer Experience Director role. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Performance Marketing & Campaign Specialist (Chinese Media Group)

title: TikTok Performance Marketing Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on TikTok Performance Marketing Manager who specialises in selling physical consumer products through TikTok Shop.

Your primary responsibility is to generate profitable sales through TikTok advertising, particularly TikTok Shop GMV Max campaigns.

We are not looking for a traditional social media manager who focuses on followers, engagement or brand awareness. We want someone who understands how to convert advertising expenditure into revenue, identify winning video advertisements and scale campaigns profitably.

You will work closely with our in-house video production, influencer, affiliate and e-commerce teams to grow our skincare products in Singapore and Malaysia.

Key Responsibilities



-  TikTok Ads & GMV Max Management
-  Independently set up, launch, monitor and optimise TikTok Shop GMV Max campaigns.
-  Manage Product GMV Max campaigns and, where applicable, LIVE GMV Max campaigns.
-  Set appropriate ROI targets, campaign budgets and product selections.
-  Monitor advertising expenditure, GMV, ROI and cost per order daily.
-  Identify underperforming campaigns and implement corrective actions.
-  Optimise advertising expenditure according to product margins and profitability.
-  Troubleshoot issues involving campaign delivery, insufficient spending, poor conversion rates and declining advertising returns.
-  Manage campaigns across Singapore and Malaysia, accounting for differences in consumer behaviour and pricing.
-  Advertising Performance & Profitability
-  Take direct responsibility for achieving assigned online sales and advertising profitability targets.
-  Calculate product-level break-even ROAS based on selling price, cost of goods, platform fees, affiliate commissions and other variable costs.
-  Identify which products generate the highest advertising returns.
-  Recommend suitable promotional prices, product bundles and offers to improve conversion rates.
-  Monitor customer acquisition costs and contribution margin after advertising.
-  Distinguish between sales attributed to advertising and actual incremental sales growth.
-  Scale successful campaigns without compromising profitability.
-  Video Advertising & Creative Optimisation
-  Work directly with the internal video production team to identify and develop high-converting TikTok advertisements.
-  Analyse individual video performance to determine which creatives generate sales.
-  Develop creative briefs covering product pain points, selling propositions, hooks, demonstrations and calls to action.
-  Recommend new video concepts based on advertising performance data.
-  Test different video openings, product demonstrations, offers and messaging.
-  Identify creative fatigue and recommend replacement advertisements before campaign performance deteriorates.
-  Work with the influencer and affiliate teams to identify high-performing creator content suitable for paid advertising.
-  Ensure a consistent pipeline of new advertising creatives for testing.
-  Campaign Testing & Scaling
-  Develop structured testing plans for new products, advertisements and promotional offers.
-  Establish clear criteria for identifying winning and losing creatives.
-  Allocate initial test budgets and determine when campaigns should be scaled, maintained or stopped.
-  Conduct controlled testing where feasible to distinguish creative performance from pricing, audience and promotional effects.
-  Expand successful advertising strategies across additional products.

title: Performance Marketing Lead
description:
Trust is the first of a new breed of banks in Singapore – digitally native and focused on delivering a delightful customer experience.  You will work in a fast-paced and collaborative environment to solve new and interesting challenges each day. Together with our Trust team, you will help shape the future of our bank. 
Customer team at Trust is where strategy, design, data, and creative come together. The team drives design and marketing of all new products, brand building, launch campaigns, accelerating acquisitions, and boosting engagement and retention. They turn insights into actions, working across teams to scale what works and experiment with what’s next.
We're looking for a Performance Marketing Lead to join Customer team in Singapore. This hands-on leadership role will own the strategy, execution, and continuous optimisation of Trust’s paid acquisition engine. Your job is to make every dollar of paid media work harder, while amplifying, rather than competing with, the referral and word-of-mouth growth that has carried Trust to a million customers.
 
The Role Responsibility:
Own performance marketing strategy and results

- Set the strategy, budget allocation and long-term roadmap for paid acquisition across search, paid social, app install (UAC), programmatic and affiliate/partnership channels.
- Own acquisition KPIs end to end - CAC, conversion rate, activation, ROAS and downstream LTV, and report performance and outlook to marketing and business leadership.
- Manage a multi-million-dollar annual media budget, reallocating spend in real time based on channel efficiency and business priorities.
Run and scale the paid media engine

- Plan, launch and optimise always-on and campaign-based activity across Google (Search, UAC, PMax), Meta, TikTok, Apple Search Ads and programmatic/DSP platforms.
- Build a rigorous testing agenda - creative, audience, bidding strategy and landing page experiments to continuously improve efficiency at scale.
- Direct performance-focused creative briefs and work with in-house and agency creative teams to keep a high-velocity content pipeline feeding every channel.
Build the measurement backbone

- Own mobile and web attribution end to end, including MMP configuration (e.g. AppsFlyer/Adjust), SKAN and ATT frameworks, and server-side/first-party tracking as third-party signal degrades.
- Partner with Data and Engineering to build dashboards and incrementality/holdout tests that separate genuinely incremental growth from channel noise.
- Bring a strong point of view on marketing mix modelling and multi-touch attribution to guide budget decisions across paid, referral and on-ground channels.
Integrate paid, referral and on-ground growth

- Work closely with the growth and partnership team to design paid campaigns that reinforce (not cannibalise) Trust's referral programme.
- Identify where performance media can accelerate proven organic and word-of-mouth loops, and where it should step back and let them run.
Lead people and partners

- Manage and develop a small team of performance marketing specialists, plus media, creative and analytics agency partners.
- Act as the performance marketing voice in cross-functional forums with Product, Data Science, Finance, Legal and Compliance, translating regulatory and risk requirements into campaigns that are both effective and fully compliant with MAS advertising guidelines and internal fair-dealing standards.
Our Ideal Candidate:

- 10+ years in performance or growth marketing, including experience leading paid acquisition strategy at a consumer app, e-commerce, fintech, or digital-first brand.
- Deep, hands-on expertise across paid social, paid search and mobile app install campaigns (Google UAC, Meta, TikTok, Apple Search Ads), with a track record of managing meaningful budgets against hard efficiency targets.
- Strong command of mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer or Adjust), SKAN/ATT, GA4 and attribution methodology in a privacy-constrained environment.
- Comfortable in the data SQL and spreadsheet-level analysis at minimum, and able to turn campaign and cohort data into a clear investment recommendation.
- A builder's mindset: equally comfortable setting quarterly strategy and personally troubleshooting a tracking issue or a stalled campaign.
- Excellent stakeholder management, you can hold your own with Finance on ROI and with Compliance on what a bank can and cannot say in an ad.
- Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, economics, a quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. 
Good to have:

- Prior performance marketing experience at e-commerce or high-growth fintech.
- Experience designing or scaling referral, loyalty or partnership-driven growth loops alongside paid media.
- Familiarity with Singapore's media landscape and MAS guidelines on financial promotions.
- Working knowledge of Python or scripting for marketing automation and reporting.

title: Analyst Marketing Innovations
description:
Location

Singapore

About The Hershey Company

The Hershey Company (NYSE: HSY) is an industry-leading snacks company known for making more moments of goodness through its iconic brands. With a strong portfolio across chocolate, confectionery, and salty snacks, Hershey delights consumers every day. Our beloved brands include Hershey’s, Reese’s, KitKat®, Dots Pretzels, Lesser Evil, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Ice Breakers, and more.

At Hershey, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in the communities where we live, work, and do business. This commitment originated with our founder, Milton Hershey, and continues to shape who we are today.

Guided by our employee value proposition, Lead Today. Create Tomorrow, we empower our people to drive impact now while shaping what comes next. Our One Hershey mindset brings teams together across functions, geographies, and businesses, enabling us to operate with speed, collaboration, and shared purpose.

The Hershey Company is proud to be recognized as a top employer in the United States, reflecting our commitment to our people, culture, and purpose.

How will you fit in the big picture?

As a Analyst Marketing Innovation for APAC, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering Hershey's innovation strategy across the Asia Pacific region. Working closely with the APAC Innovation Manager and cross-functional teams, you will identify consumer-led growth opportunities and support the development of innovations that strengthen brands, expand market reach, and drive sustainable business growth. Success in this role requires strong project management to coordinate multiple initiatives, align stakeholders, and ensure the effective progression of innovation projects from idea to market across APAC.

What will you do?



- Lead and coordinate innovation projects through the Stage-Gate process, ensuring alignment across all project workstreams and stakeholders.
- Manage project timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables to ensure successful to ensure projects remain on track and launch-ready.
- Prepare and present project updates, recommendations, and Gate materials to leadership and cross-functional teams.
- Maintain project documentation and administration within company project management systems.
- Partner with cross-functional teams and external agencies to support the development and execution of innovation projects.
- Translate consumer, market, and category insights into actionable innovation opportunities and project briefs.
- Support the development of consumer-led innovation concepts that address barriers to trial and accelerate brand growth.
- Create and maintain approved assets, packaging guidance, and communication materials to support innovation execution across APAC markets.
- Analyze business, consumer, customer, category, and competitive data to identify growth opportunities and inform innovation priorities and commercialization decisions.

Minimum Requirement of Experience:



- 3 to 4 years of experience in Marketing, Innovation, Product Development, Project Management, or a related commercial function, preferably within an FMCG environment. Regional experience is an advantage.
- Proven project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and delivering against project timelines, milestones, and business objectives.
- Experience working across cross-functional teams and effectively engaging stakeholders across functions and markets.
- Analytical skills, with the ability to interpret consumer, market, and business data to identify insights, opportunities, and implications.
- Problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage ambiguity, resolve issues, and support decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.
- Working knowledge of project management methodologies and/or experience supporting projects from development through market execution.
- Basic Commercial acumen, including an understanding of key business drivers, market performance, and profitability.
- Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to effectively articulate insights and recommendations to diverse stakeholders.
- Familiarity with syndicated market research tools such as Nielsen or IRI is preferred.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

Education:



- Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Benefits And Perks

At Hershey, we offer competitive pay and a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, financial security, and life outside of work.



- Health & Wellbeing: Medical, plus wellness programs that support your physical and mental health
- Financial Security: Competitive pay, annual incentive opportunities
- Time Off & Flexibility: Paid time off, company holidays, and flexible ways of working where applicable
- Growth & Development: Career development programs, learning opportunities, and internal mobility

Benefits may vary based on role, location, and eligibility

title: Senior Director - Performance Marketing (Remote)
categories: Retail, Internet Marketplace Platforms, and Marketing Services
description:
Own the paid media engine for a $1Billion+ brand. Decide what to launch and where the budget goes.


Total Annual Package: Up to USD $240,000 + comprehensive benefits (Base salary + monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)
Location: Remote (Global)
Growth path from here is fluid: all paid channels, including the ones you select, moving toward scope at the intersection of capital allocation, creative strategy, and P&L ownership. What takes 4-5 years elsewhere happens in 1-2 here.


We've been AI-first since December 2023: Every proposal that reaches the CEO ships with an LLM validation link. Your first spend case gets stress-tested by an advanced model to eliminate blind spots.


Role Overview:
Puffy, a market-leading, nine-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Senior Director of Performance Marketing to own a multi-million-dollar monthly paid media engine across Google and Meta with full authority over systems, measurement, creative testing, capital allocation, and team, reporting directly to the CEO.


This role exists to convert a multi-million-dollar paid budget into maximum contribution margin, building the decision systems, measurement infrastructure, and team that let the revenue engine run and scale without day-to-day executive involvement.


The Problems You'll Own:

- Primary: Decide what to launch and where the budget goes: A multi-million-dollar monthly budget runs across Google and Meta, and every standard campaign type is already live and optimized: brand and non-brand search, PMax, Meta prospecting and retargeting, Shopping and feed. Growth now has to come from what isn't running: new campaign structures, new creative, a different mix of spend.



- Secondary: Build the system that runs the scaling decisions: Design and document the rules that govern spend, when to pause, when to increase budget, when to pull back, and the measurement each decision depends on. The system should run the scaling without day-to-day executive oversight.


The Career Accelerator:
This is not a role where you manage dashboards and present decks.



- The scope is scarce: very few Senior Directors of Performance Marketing get simultaneous authority over multi-million-dollar monthly budgets on both major platforms, full ownership of measurement and creative systems, org design power, and a direct line to the CEO with no layers in between.
- Your first 12 months: build pause/hold/scale logic, budget guardrails, and escalation protocols from scratch. Deploy incrementality testing and reconcile platform attribution against backend reality. Architect the creative engine as a system: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, and whitelisting. Design capital allocation on marginal return rather than platform-reported averages. Design promo architecture across the retail calendar: pulse strategy, financing offers, funnel alignment. Identify, evaluate, and pilot paid channels beyond Google and Meta. Structure the performance marketing function itself. Shape the future of performance marketing at Puffy, where paid media is the primary growth lever.


What Is In It For You:
This isn't just another performance marketing role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.


1. Own the Paid Engine End to End, With No Layers Above You
You set the strategy, build the systems, and own the outcomes.



- You allocate multi-million-dollar monthly budgets across Google and Meta on marginal return rather than platform-reported averages, design the pause/hold/scale logic and budget guardrails that govern all paid spend, and serve as the single source of truth on paid media performance. Creative runs as a system you architect: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, whitelisting.
- You hold profitability to a contribution-margin standard after returns and financing costs, not ROAS in isolation. You lead, assess, and structure the performance marketing function with org design authority and CEO sign-off, reporting directly to the CEO.


2. Join a High-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:

- 🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
- 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
- 💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.
Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high-velocity execution that drives a global brand


3. Embrace Radical Flexibility
Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co-working space, (OR) our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.


4. Become the Operator Other Brands Try to Hire
In most companies, performance marketing leaders inherit a system somebody else built and spend the next three years defending its numbers in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides how much capital goes into growth next quarter, your model is the input to that decision, not a report on it afterwards. You'll leave with a paid media system you designed end to end, and the proof that it held contribution margin at scale, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI-native toolbox behind you rather than an agency deck in front of you.


What You'll Need:

- 7+ years in performance marketing with sustained ownership of $1M+/month on both Google and Meta (concurrently or across roles). "Ownership" means authority over strategy, structure, and budget, not just execution.
- Google depth at PMax-era: campaign structure, feed management, brand/non-brand economics.
- High-AOV considered-purchase experience ($1,000+ order values): sparse-conversion, long-decision-cycle categories.
- Personally built, not inherited, bid, budget, and pause decision systems at scale. You'll be asked to present a playbook you authored.
- Statistical decision literacy: volume gating, false-kill vs. wasted-spend trade-offs, threshold derivation, incrementality test design.
- Creative testing systems at scale in a post-ATT environment: concept-vs-variation discipline, creative analytics.
- Team leadership including senior direct reports. Experience building or restructuring a performance marketing function.
- Structured approach to new channel evaluation: selection frameworks, pilot design, budget allocation, and kill criteria.


Good-to-Have:

- Scripting against Meta/Google APIs; Google Ads Scripts.
- Mixed agency + in-house background.
- Experience with emerging paid channels (e.g., TikTok, Connected TV, affiliate/partnerships, etc.).
- D2C e-commerce background in home goods, furniture, or comparable high-AOV verticals.


The Puffy DNA: 
We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.

- Be the Owner: We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
- Execute with Urgency: We thrive in high-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
- Demand Excellence: We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
- Be AI-First: Daily multi-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
- Go All-In: When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.


✨ Your Total Compensation & Benefits:

- 💰 Compensation: Total Annual Package: Up to USD $240,000 + comprehensive benefits (Base salary + monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)
Annual salary review every January

- 🏥 Health & Protection: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance (based on country of hire)
- 🌴 Time Off: Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) + Public holidays


💼 Work Environment:

- AI-First organization with access to AI-native tool stack
- Remote First: Work from the comfort of your home office
- Learning & development opportunities
- International team collaboration across 16+ nationalities. Your assumptions get challenged daily.


🏆 Rewards & Recognition:

- Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreats
- Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company-wide celebration for exceptional contributions


Ready to Shape Your Story? 
Click "Apply" and take the first step.

title: Associate Director, Affluent and Wealth Marketing
description:

Our Ideal Candidate

title: Associate Marketing Manager, Singapore
description:
About SharkNinja
Our mission to positively impact people's lives every day in every home around the world allows our employees to be thinkers and tinkerers, designers and doers, creators and number crunchers, makers of things they love.


SharkNinja APAC is expanding and scaling rapidly. Our two brands, Shark and Ninja, have enjoyed unprecedented growth over the past five years, driven by a very strong innovation pipeline across both brands. Building on that success, SharkNinja APAC has embarked on a bold plan for growth in which Singapore and Malaysia play a critical role. We have taken these markets back from our distributors so that we can run them directly and drive strong growth behind innovation and investment.


Shark and Ninja have exceptional product pipelines and consumers who have not yet been given a strong enough reason to care. This role is where campaigns actually get built and launched — and where our next brand leaders are grown.


Position Summary
The Associate Marketing Manager runs Shark or Ninja marketing activity in Singapore day to day, depending on the category they own: campaign planning and delivery, NPD launch execution, content production, creator and PR activity, and the reporting that tells us whether it worked.
Shark competes in home care, floor care and beauty, and Ninja in kitchen, cooking and food preparation. In both, the product genuinely does something better and the job of marketing is to make people see it. Content, demonstration and credible third-party proof matter more here than message repetition.


This is a hands-on role in a small team. You will write the brief, build the content, brief the creators, manage the agency, check the assets and pull the results together. The plan and the execution both sit with you.


You will also own a defined category or sub-category of Shark or Ninja in Singapore — its plan, its numbers and its results. You work alongside the Marketing Manager, who sets the brand direction, and you are expected to run your area, not simply support theirs.
It is also a development role. We are building the marketing organisation these markets will need, and we want people who will grow into brand ownership. Scope will expand as fast as you can carry it.


Key Responsibilities

- Own a defined category or sub-category of Shark or Ninja in Singapore end to end: set its plan, priorities and targets within the brand plan agreed with the Marketing Manager.
- Be the go-to person for your category — its consumers, competitors, pricing, range and pipeline — and bring a point of view to the Marketing Manager rather than waiting for direction.
- Manage the budget allocated to your category within the brand envelope, and recommend where to invest more or stop.
- Answer for your category's results: demand, conversion and launch performance, reported honestly with learning applied.
- Work as a partner to the Marketing Manager, who sets the brand direction, and not as their support resource.
- Build and execute the Shark or Ninja campaign calendar for Singapore against commercial moments — launches, peak, category occasions and platform campaigns.
- Write clear, insight-led briefs and hold agencies and partners to them.
- Manage delivery end to end: assets, media, channels, timing and go-live, with nothing landing late or incomplete.
- Own campaign budgets and track spend against plan.
- Execute NPD launches
- Deliver every Shark or Ninja launch in your area in Singapore: proposition and message, assets, media, PR, seeding, creators, and online and retail landing.
- Run the launch checklist and chase every dependency — content, stock, pricing, listings, training — rather than assuming others will.
- Secure early reviews and credible demonstration content before day one.
- Report launch performance at 30 and 90 days with learning attached.
- Build content that shows what our products do, grounded in how people actually live, clean, cook and eat here — the small home, the hawker habit, the weekend cook, the health-conscious family.
- Manage creator and influencer activity: selection, briefing, content review and performance measurement.
- Work with the E-Commerce Designer and Social Commerce team so brand and commerce content reinforce each other.
- Work closely with E-Commerce and Sales so campaigns land where the product can actually be bought, with content and availability ready.
- Provide the shopper and in-store material the commercial teams need — claims, demonstration messages and reasons to choose.
- Track what converts and bring that back into the next campaign.
- Bring a point of view to the trading rhythm rather than a report.
- Build campaign and content reporting that is honest about what worked and what did not.
- Test deliberately rather than repeating what was done last year.
- Track competitor activity and flag anything that needs a response.
- Recommend stopping things that are not delivering, including things you built.


Essential

- 4+ years in consumer brand marketing, campaign delivery or product marketing in Singapore.
- Evidence that you build and improve, not just deliver. A campaign, content approach, process or test you initiated yourself — and what changed as a result.
- Hands-on execution capability across content, creators, media and assets. You do the work, not only manage it.
- Genuine Singapore consumer understanding and curiosity about how people actually live and buy.
- Strong project discipline — many moving parts, tight timelines, nothing dropped.
- Commercial awareness: understands that marketing exists to create demand that converts.
- Clear communication and the confidence to brief, challenge and chase.
- Ability to run a defined category or sub-category: set its plan, own its numbers and make the case for investment, with the Marketing Manager as partner rather than director.
- Appetite to grow into brand ownership.


Experience might get you the interview. Mindset is what sets you apart.


YOUR ROLE IN LEADING OUR SUCCESS DRIVERS

- Lead us to be “RARELY SATISFIED”
- Make things better each day; “PROGRESS OVER PERFECTION”
- Use your knowledge of our consumer, understand that “DETAILS MAKE THE DIFFERENCE”
- Deliver something great; “WINNING IS A TEAM SPORT”
- Be clear and honest, “COMMUNICATING FOR IMPACT”
-

title: Performance Marketing Executive - AX26007
description:
Actxa is a Singapore-rooted smart wearable company on a mission to make better health accessible at scale through technology. Built on years of innovation in connected devices and smart living, Actxa has grown into a trusted companion supporting individuals across the region in taking control of their wellbeing.

Our flagship product, the Actxa Core Smart Ring, features AI Glucose Scan, the world's first clinically studied, non-invasive approach to glucose awareness, delivering a Normal or Elevated reading in just one minute through a ring designed for everyday wear.

We are looking for a Performance Marketing Executive to manage and optimize the performance funnel across paid media and organic discovery, while supporting our channel sales partners with marketing execution. You will run and optimize paid campaigns across Meta, Google and TikTok, drive organic visibility through SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and support distributors and retail partners with the marketing tools they need to sell Actxa effectively. You will also help ensure that the Actxa Core Smart Ring and AI Glucose Scan are represented accurately and prominently wherever customers search, whether through a search engine or AI answer engine.

This is a hands-on, metrics-driven role suited to someone equally comfortable building a Meta Advantage+ campaign, briefing a retail partner's sales team, and investigating a drop in organic traffic following a Google algorithm update.

Paid Media (Meta, Google, TikTok)



- Plan, launch and manage paid campaigns across Meta, Google (Search, Shopping, Performance Max) and TikTok, aligned with revenue and CAC/ROAS targets
- Work within allocated budgets across channels and campaigns, reallocating spend toward the best-performing audiences, creatives and placements
- Build and maintain audience segmentation, retargeting and lookalike strategies across platforms
- Partner with the creative team to brief, test and refine ad creative and copy, running structured A/B tests across hooks, formats and offers
- Monitor pixel and conversion tracking, attribution and campaign health, and troubleshoot tracking issues as platforms evolve, including iOS/privacy changes, Meta CAPI and GA4

SEO & GEO

title: Marketing & Media Senior Manager Asia & AMEA
description:
We're seeking a senior regional transformation leader who can redesign how marketing operates across Asia and AMEA. The role is ideal for someone who has led marketing effectiveness, media, agency, and operating model transformation initiatives and enjoys influencing across a complex stakeholder environment.
What we ask

- Bachelor or Master in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
- 15+ years of experience in senior marketing, media or transformation roles within large, multi-market organisations, including experience in B2B and B2C environments.
- Proven track record in marketing operating model transformation, media transformation, agency consolidation and end-to-end process improvement.
- You have a broader view than your own role, identify with our purpose "Nourishing by Nature", are customer-focused and act with speed and decisiveness to deliver results.
- Strong stakeholder management, commercial acumen and change leadership skills, combined with experience in data-driven decision-making, AI-enabled marketing tools and cross-functional collaboration.
 
What We Offer

- Unique company culture of Dutch heritage and international presence. At FrieslandCampina you work on strong, globally loved brands enjoyed by millions every day, like Friso, Campina, Chocomel and Frisian Flag. As a farmer-owned cooperative, we combine an international environment with a clear social and sustainable purpose. We support your growth through training, coaching and internal career opportunities. With trust and autonomy, you can make real impact. 
- Competitive bonus scheme, flexible working hours, and the ability to work from home.
- Exceptional support of cross disciplinary movement within the company to broaden your knowledge and growth paths. 
- A friendly and informal working environment
- Autonomy and trust to create longer term impact that helps bring better nutrition to the world
 
Vacancy Description
FrieslandCampina is executing a company-wide transformation to accelerate profitable growth, improve margins and strengthen global competitiveness. Marketing and media are key levers in this transformation and must become more focused, effective and efficient to ensure investments drive commercial impact. As Marketing & Media Manager Asia & AMEA, you will play a critical role in making this ambition a reality.
 
You will lead the creation and activation of the vision for marketing across the region, ensuring marketing remains relevant, competitive, efficient and a strong growth engine for the business. In close partnership with leadership and global stakeholders, you will be responsible for the design and delivery of strategic marketing transformation initiatives.
 
In this role, you will co-create the marketing transformation roadmap, align priorities with enterprise strategy and business objectives, and ensure measurable business impact through clear milestones, governance and performance tracking. You will drive the implementation of media transformation initiatives, lead the consolidation of creative agency ecosystems and production operations, enabling a more simplified, scalable and efficient operating model. Through the implementation of new governance structures, workflows and ways of working, you will improve transparency, speed, consistency and cross-functional collaboration across teams and markets.
 
A key part of the role is translating and embedding the new marketing operating model across Operating Companies. You will work closely with Marketing, Sales, eCommerce, IT, Data & Analytics, Procurement, Finance and external agency partners to drive alignment and execution in a highly matrixed and decentralised environment. Success will depend on your ability to influence without direct authority, build strong relationships and bring stakeholders together around a shared vision.
 
In addition, you will support organisation design, capability building and change adoption efforts. By identifying capability gaps, enabling upskilling and embedding new behaviours, you will ensure transformation is fully adopted and delivers sustainable results. You will continuously identify opportunities to improve media, creative, production and marketing operations while fostering a test-and-learn culture focused on ongoing efficiency and effectiveness gains.
 
This is a highly visible international role within Global Commerce with impact across Asia & AMEA B2C businesses. It offers the opportunity to shape the future of marketing at FrieslandCampina while working with senior stakeholders across the global marketing ecosystem.
For thousands of people every day, FrieslandCampina means more than just a dairy company. We provide high-quality nutrition while creating value for our member farmers, customers, consumers and communities around the world.
 
You will join the Global Commerce organisation and work at the centre of FrieslandCampina's marketing transformation agenda. The team is responsible for shaping the future of marketing through operating model excellence, media transformation, capability development and process optimisation. Working across Business Group Europe, B2B, Operating Companies and global functions, the team partners with senior commercial leaders, marketing teams, eCommerce, Sales, IT, Data & Analytics and external agency partners to build a more agile, data-driven and performance-focused marketing organisation.
 
Together, we are building the capabilities, ways of working and partnerships that will enable marketing to become a true growth engine for FrieslandCampina.

title: Post Creative Strategist
description:
About Vaynerx

VaynerX (https://vaynerx.com) is the most contemporary family of companies, working together to build and grow brands. Subsidiaries include VaynerMedia, Eva Nosidam Productions, The Sasha Group, Gallery Media Group, Tingley Lane Trading, VaynerSpeakers, and VaynerCommerce.

About Vaynermedia

VaynerMedia is a global integrated creative and media agency, built for today's consumers. As the Modern Agency of Record, it understands the nuances of today's attention landscape, empowering brands to win attention, drive relevance, and deliver business results. Founded in 2009, by Gary Vaynerchuk, the independently owned agency operates in 15 offices worldwide, including Amsterdam, Bangkok, Chicago, New Delhi, Kuala Lumpur, London, Los Angeles, Mexico City, Miami, New York, Tokyo, Toronto, Singapore, and Sydney. VaynerMedia is part of the VaynerX family of companies.

Culture is our key and Empathy is how we build it. VaynerMediaAPAC is strong with a world-class combination of diverse backgrounds collaborating to put forward innovative, creative and strategic solutions to the one advantage that stands the test of time --- PEOPLE. Day in and day out, we propel some of the biggest brands in the world to the intersection of attention and culture. In APAC, we are proudly +300, servicing a diverse client all around the region.

The PITCH

Well, now we’re looking for someone who lives and breathes social media even more than us. Do you know all of the latest trends? Memes? And TikToks? Maybe you’ve dabbled in the world of influencers? Believe in the power of social media and community management to change hearts, minds, and drive sales? Love the hustle of fast-paced, hyper-growth agency life? Thrive in a role where you can bring ideas to life on billions of screens? Cool. Then let’s talk.

This exciting opportunity of a full-time role based in the Singapore will allow you to collaborate with the local team as well learn from the experts globally. You will manage and drive our strategy expertise and someone who is familiar with the Sinapore landscape.

Are you based in Singapore? Do you wanna geek out on the world of media and creative advertising agency? Oh well, we could be meant to be -----so keep reading!

Here’s where you come in.

Volume, ideation and listening are the building blocks to being an exceptional Post Creative Strategist. We believe everyone's got brilliant ideas. But what sets YOU apart from the rest? It’s about forming several strategies to win with different groups of demographics.

You have a solid understanding of what works in the industry but at the same time, constantly determining what can make your strategies better. Possessing an undying passion to continuously make magic happen regardless of the adversities thrown in your way.

Our Post Creative Strategists do more than just providing insights and research to the Creative team, they provide continuous recommendations based on daily evolving conversations. This position represents the community’s voice in every aspect of the brand and maneuvers way through multiple channels. The ideal candidate synergises well with the Creative team and is deeply rooted in the purpose of ‘customer first’.

The Brief



- Knowledge and implementation of end-to-end customer experience strategies, including customer research, strategy, vision & design
- A keen sense of developing strategy solutions, from brand strategy, down to tactical social, content and influencer strategies
- An out of the box perspective on data and research to find interesting consumer insights that we can leverage on
- Strong understanding of marketing fundamentals
- Able to craft content calendars, caption banks, and trendjacking posts with ease.
- An understanding of community management and social listening to deeply understand people
- Ability to read and internalise social media comments and differentiate people’s behaviours on different social platforms
- Brings the consumer’s world to life for creative teams and clients using qualitative and cultural mining and insightful synthesis of quantitative research to inform a strategic approach.
- Articulate effective strategic rationale and logic flow that will help form a compelling story.
- Deck crafter - someone that can detail out ideas and insights that are clear and can sell!

What You Should Know About VaynerMedia

Think “lab” and not “agency”. We get excited about solving business problems, not creating advertising for the sake of making advertising. Our entrepreneurship DNA runs deep. We’re willing to break rules, try new things, and test hypotheses if it means better understanding our craft. It’s fun!

Our environment (and pace) feels much more like a start-up than most agencies you might be used to. Hopefully that, and the opportunity to collaborate with the talented and enthusiastic crew, work with big brands excites you, as it does us. We can’t wait to meet you.

P.S Portfolio would be nice :)

title: Senior Marketing Associate – Remote
description:

----------


Why Join JazzUpCo?


🌍 100% Remote in Singapore with field mobility for events


⚡ Fast Growth, Real Ownership – Direct control over a fast-growing market launch


🌴 Paid Time Off & Benefits


📈 Learning & Career Path – Grow from Senior Marketing Associate → Marketing Manager

Next Steps:

We can’t wait to meet you 🙂

title: Senior Strategist
description:
Company Description

AKA is an integrated communications agency based in Singapore, supporting our clients locally, regionally and globally by conceptualising and bringing to life compelling creative campaigns. Part of our offering is design and production support - from creating on-point infographics for an infant formula brand, through to shooting stylish cinema ads for a travel destination. Everyone at AKA is forward-thinking, collaborative, and passionate about delivering great work for our clients (plus we're a friendly bunch). We enjoy a flat hierarchy and expect everyone - no matter what level - to bring ideas to work every day, speak their mind, and positively contribute to the culture. We're proud to work with some of the world's leading brands - the likes of Durex, Meta, Jetstar Asia, Tourism New Zealand, and Levi's to name just a few.

Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior / Strategist with a strong focus on social-first storytelling and digital culture to join our talented team. If you are a passionate cultural translator with a proven track record of developing insights that drive impactful, platform-native campaigns, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities

As a Senior / Strategist at AKA Asia, you will sit at the heart of our Strategy & Studio teams, playing a pivotal role in shaping client narratives and developing forward-thinking communication strategies. You will be responsible for translating complex business objectives into actionable consumer insights, crafting inspiring creative briefs, and providing strategic counsel to clients across diverse industries. Because of our growing focus on social-first scopes, this role requires a deep, intuitive understanding of the digital and social landscape, emerging cultural trends, and platform behaviors. You will collaborate intimately with our Social & Content and Integrated Creative hubs to ensure strategies are seamlessly brought to life in ways that resonate deeply with modern audiences.



- Strategic Counsel & Vision: Provide high-level strategic counsel to clients, deeply understanding their business challenges and developing tailored, future-proofed communication strategies to achieve their goals.
- Social-First Strategy: Lead the development of social-first campaigns. Demonstrate a deep understanding of platform nuances (TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.), creator culture, and digital community behaviors to build strategies that are native to the platforms they live on.
- Research & Cultural Insights: Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to uncover human truths, cultural shifts, and audience behaviors. Utilize social listening tools and market analysis to identify untapped opportunities for clients.
- Creative Collaboration & Briefing: Distill complex research into clear, compelling, and inspiring creative briefs. Act as a strategic partner to the creative, social, and earned comms teams throughout the creative process to ensure the work stays on strategy and delivers maximum impact.
- Client & Pitch Management: Play a lead role in new business pitches, shaping the strategic narrative from the ground up. Manage the strategic components of day-to-day client accounts and participate in critical client presentations.
- Measurement & Effectiveness: Define campaign KPIs and collaborate with data/analytics counterparts to track and measure the effectiveness of social and integrated campaigns. Use data to refine ongoing strategies and demonstrate clear ROI.
- Thought Leadership & Mentorship: Elevate the agency's strategic output by keeping the broader team up-to-date on industry trends, platform algorithm changes, and competitor activities. Mentor junior team members and contribute to a collaborative, intellectually curious agency culture. 

Qualifications



- Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Advertising, Sociology, or a related field.
- Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in strategic planning, with a heavy emphasis on social media, digital strategy, or integrated communications.
- Proven track record of developing and executing successful, award-worthy social-first and integrated campaigns.
- Deep expertise in social media platforms, digital culture, and creator-led ecosystems.
- Proficiency with social listening, audience insight, and analytics tools (e.g., Brandwatch, Meltwater, GWI, native platform analytics).
- Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to turn data into compelling narratives.
- Excellent writing, briefing, and presentation skills, with the ability to command a room and influence senior client stakeholders.
- Ability to work independently, manage multiple moving parts, and thrive in a fast-paced agency environment.

title: E-Commerce Marketing Executive
description:
Sony Electronics Singapore is seeking a commercially minded E-Commerce Executive to drive sales and profitability across our four online channels: Sony Store Online (SSO), Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop.


The role owns channel performance, platform content and marketing, and campaign pricing execution, working closely with Product Managers, Operations and the Customer Marketing (CMK) team.


As platform costs continue to rise, the role is expected to grow revenue profitably, making informed trade-offs on where to invest, what to promote and how each channel contributes to Sony's direct-to-consumer strategy.


What you will be doing
Sales & Channel Profitability

- Own sales targets for SSO, Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop, tracking performance against monthly and campaign targets
- Monitor channel P&L, including platform commission, fees, vouchers co-funding, logistics and ad spend, to manage cost to serve per channel
- Recommend where to grow, hold or pull back by channel, category and SKU, based on profitability and Sony's direct-first channel strategy
- Analyse why performance moved (traffic, conversion, pricing, assortment, competition) and propose corrective actions, not just report results
- Prepare channel performance reports and post-campaign reviews for department and management meetings


Marketing & Content
Across all channels

- Work with Operations team to manage product listings, content and storefronts across all four platforms, ensuring accuracy, brand consistency and compliance with approved product claims
- Work with Digital Marketing to drive qualified traffic to SSO and marketplace stores, aligning paid media with channel priorities


Brand Store (SSO)

- Plan and execute customer-centric campaigns that focus on engagement, not just conversion: driving web traffic, clicks and longer browsing time
- Run seasonal campaigns and gamification activities that give customers reasons to visit, interact and return
- Drive new customer acquisition and repeat purchase on SSO with the CMK team, using CRM, loyalty and member-exclusive mechanics
- Track engagement metrics (sessions, CTR, time on site, active customers, etc) alongside sales to measure what each campaign delivers


Marketplaces (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop)

- Plan and execute platform marketing calendars around key mega sales (e.g. 9.9, 11.11, 12.12), product launches and Sony campaigns
- Manage on-platform marketing tools: vouchers, flash deals, bundles, sponsored ads and livestream or affiliate activity (TikTok Shop)
- Manage marketplace partner relationships (KAMs) to secure campaign slots, visibility and commercial support
- Partner with the CMK team to grow product registration from marketplace buyers, bringing them into My Sony Rewards


Campaign Pricing & Operations 

- Liaise with Product Managers to align campaign prices across platforms and campaign periods, protecting price consistency and channel harmony
- Flag pricing conflicts, margin risks and overlapping promotions before campaigns go live
- Consolidate pricing, promotion and listing details into clear, accurate briefs for the Operations team to execute and upload on time
- Validate live prices, promotions and listings after upload, and resolve discrepancies quickly


Success Measures

- Achievement of sales targets by channel
- Channel profitability and cost-to-serve within agreed thresholds
- SSO new and returning customer sales growth
- Product registration volume from marketplace purchases
- Pricing and listing accuracy; on-time campaign execution
- Quality of performance insights and recommendations


What you should have

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Digital Commerce or a related discipline
- 3+ years of hands-on e-commerce experience, managing brand stores on Shopee, Lazada and/or TikTok Shop
- Experience with a brand-owned web store (e.g. Shopify) is a strong advantage
- Track record of growing marketplace sales while managing margin, platform fees and promotional costs
- Strong analytical skills; advanced Excel required, Power BI or similar is a plus
- Consumer electronics, retail, FMCG or other brand-led DTC environments preferred


What will help you succeed
Commercial Ownership

- Treats each channel as a business with its own P&L, not just a sales outlet
- Balances short-term campaign wins with long-term channel health and pricing integrity
- Knows when a sale is not worth chasing because cost to serve outweighs the return


Functional Knowledge

- Solid understanding of marketplace mechanics: commission structures, platform-funded vs brand-funded vouchers, ad tools and campaign participation requirements
- Working knowledge of e-commerce metrics (traffic, CVR, AOV, ROAS) and how they drive revenue
- Familiarity with DTC, CRM and loyalty levers that bring marketplace buyers into a direct relationship with Sony


Ways of Working

- Coordinates confidently across Product Managers, Operations, Digital Marketing, CMK and platform partners
- Writes clear, accurate briefs so others can execute without back-and-forth
- Detail-oriented on prices, promotions and listings; checks before things go live


Mindset

- Takes ownership of channel results and explains the why behind the numbers
- Spots problems early and comes with a proposed solution
- Adapts quickly as platforms change their rules, fees and features


Benefits you will have

- Flexible work arrangement (because we understand Life happens)
- Comprehensive medical benefits (including physical health screenings and term life insurance benefits)
- AWS and variable bonus
- Special staff purchase rates
- Flexible benefits (so you can claim for that staycay or gym membership you’ve been eyeing)
- Corporate social responsibility time off for 1 day each year to volunteer for a charity of your choice
- Milestone gifts (such as long service award and marriage gift because we want to celebrate both your professional and personal milestones)
- Wellness activities to promote healthy lifestyles
- Curated training programmes to encourage continuous professional development


At Sony, we strive to create a place for you to realise your potential and inspire you to make positive impact through innovation, smart collaboration and boundless curiosity. We are looking for people who believe that they can enrich lives and help us achieve our purpose – fill the world with emotion, through the power of creativity and technology.

title: Branding Lead
categories: Financial Services and Technology, Information and Media
description:
About Us 
Longbridge is a new-generation, AI-driven online brokerage on a mission to make investing smarter, simpler, and more accessible for everyone. Headquartered in Singapore, we are redefining the investment journey by connecting the stages of “Discovery → Learning → Trading.”With our proprietary AI assistant, Longbridge AI, and a cloud-native infrastructure, we provide retail investors with institutional-grade insights and a seamless global trading network. At Longbridge, you won’t just be working for a brokerage; you’ll be building the future of financial infrastructure.


About the Role
The Branding Lead holds the senior brand seat within the group function. You will fully own the global brand system across all brands and markets — encompassing brand strategy and architecture, identity governance, and performance measurement frameworks. Working in close partnership with business leadership, you will translate commercial priorities into strategic brand initiatives that build deep recognition and trust across retail, institutional, and partner audiences. This is a hands-on senior role in a lean, high-velocity team, perfectly suited for a strategic builder who enjoys both establishing framework standards and actively driving execution.


Location: Hong Kong or Singapore


What You Will Do

- Brand Strategy & Architecture: Own the master-brand architecture across all brands. Define positioning, brand relationships (endorsement vs. separation), and strategic roadmaps for Hong Kong, Singapore, and global expansion.
- Identity & Group-wide Governance: Own the visual and verbal identity system and global brand book. Establish review standards and lead the Brand & Comms Council to drive unified decision-making and cross-market brand enablement.
- Business Unit Partnership: Serve as the strategic brand business partner to BU leaders. Translate commercial goals into actionable brand plans, balance competing market demands, and maintain brand integrity on fast-paced timelines.
- Flagship Campaigns & Summits: Direct regional flagship brand campaigns and our signature in-house regional summit end-to-end — from core value proposition and creative concepting to measured business impact.
- Measurement & Analytics: Manage the brand tracker and Brand Strength Index. Report key metrics (Share of Voice, sentiment, AI-association) to executive leadership on a monthly cadence, focusing on core outcome-driven KPIs.
- Market Entry & Expansion: Develop the brand launch strategy for new markets and segment expansions, crafting localized propositions, entry narratives, and commercial enablement toolkits.
- Team Leadership: Manage and mentor the Branding Manager and creative support team, establishing clear scorecards and scaling the function as the business grows.

title: Director, Digital Marketing (Paid Search)
description:
Job Description 

Job ID: MJ000389

About The Role

Paid search is Traveloka's largest paid channel and its most measurable one. You'll own it: the operating plan, the budget, the team, and the outcome, measured as incremental growth for the business rather than channel metrics.

We're changing how this function works, and this role leads that change:



- From markets to capabilities. Account structure and bidding run as regional disciplines, not country by country.
- From attributed to incremental. One measure of success that finance and leadership trust.
- From manual to automated. Build in-house capability in bidding and optimisation, and automate the operational work so the team spends its time on decisions.

What You'll Do



- Own the paid search operating plan and a major share of the paid-media budget across our markets, accountable for incremental growth and profit.
- Lead through team leads and senior specialists: set priorities, targets and trade-offs, and hold the bar on how decisions get made.
- Re-architect the function from country-based to capability-based, and own that change end to end, including the people side.
- Set the standard for measurement and budget governance: incrementality testing, clear allocation rules, numbers that hold up under scrutiny.
- Build in-house bidding, optimisation and automation capability, and lead the team's hands-on use of AI to remove manual work.
- Run our most strategic platform relationships: negotiate early access, test scope and commercial terms through conflicting objectives.
- Build the bench: hire, develop, and where needed exit, and leave a leadership pipeline behind you.
- Position paid search for structural change: AI-driven search, privacy, and shifts in how travellers discover and book.

What You Bring

Must have



- 10+ years in performance marketing, growth or an analytically intensive role, including leading a team through managers.
- Owned a large paid-media budget against business outcomes, and can explain what you changed when the numbers told you to.
- Close enough to the data to challenge your own team's numbers. You can interrogate transaction-level data yourself.
- Led a structural change to a team or function as its owner, and saw it through.
- Designed or commissioned incrementality measurement (holdouts, geo tests, MMM) and made budget calls on the result.
- A quantitative degree (engineering, maths, statistics, economics, CS) or equivalent demonstrated depth.
- Strong communication skills with company leadership, and you can defend a recommendation under questioning.

Strong plus



- Paid search leadership at scale.
- Travel, e-commerce or marketplace background.
- Multi-market APAC experience across Southeast Asia, North Asia and Australia.
- Built in-house bidding or automation capability, or brought work back from an agency.
- A consulting or analytics background before marketing.

title: Director Insights & Analytics, SEA

description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

The Director, Insights & Analytics (I&A) is a strategic leadership role within the SEA Business Unit, reporting directly to the VP Marketing, Southeast Asia and sitting as a member of the SEA Marketing Leadership Team. This role leads the full I&A function across three sub-pillars — E&I I&A (scale brands), Country I&A (five SEA markets), and Growth Analytics & Shopper COE (cross-market/cross-category capabilities) — translating consumer, shopper, and market intelligence into competitive advantage. The Director partners Marketing, Managing Directors, and Commercial functions to shape growth strategy, lead annual contract planning through consumer insights, and pioneer the adoption of AI/technology to automate and scale intelligence generation.

How You Will Contribute



-  Growth Opportunities Identification
- Contributes to the BU Strategic Plan and Annual Contract, articulating key cross-category consumer and market issues, implications, and opportunities 
- Leads identification and anticipation of key consumer and market trends that can influence BU strategy

Must-Have



- 12–15+ years of progressive experience in consumer insights, analytics, or strategy roles within FMCG/CPG or adjacent industries

- Deep expertise in quantitative and qualitative research, syndicated data (Nielsen/IRI), household panel (Europanel), brand health tracking, and market mix modelling 
- Experience leading annual/strategic planning processes with consumer insight inputs (Annual Contract, JBP) 
- Demonstrated ability to influence C-suite / senior leadership and translate complex data into compelling strategic narratives 
- Experience managing and developing teams of 10+ across multiple geographies and functional sub-pillars 
- Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect consumer insight to P&L outcomes

Strongly Preferred

- Familiarity with SEA consumer landscape and multi-market complexity 
- Experience with Revenue Growth Management analytics and shopper insights 
- Background in both agency-side and client-side insights roles 
- Experience contributing to global/regional functional leadership forums 
- Fluency in modern, digital-first marketing: social commerce, performance marketing, creator partnerships, and platform strategy  
- People leadership track record: building team engagement, developing talent, and delivering results through others  
- Excellent communication skills with the maturity to work across markets, cultures, and levels of seniority

Senior Manager, Customer Engagement & Lifecycle Marketing 

So, who are we?

description:
COME, EXPRESS YOUR ANDAZ


Join Andaz Singapore, the first Andaz hotel in Southeast Asia.


Occupying Levels 25 to 39 of the DUO Tower, Andaz Singapore is a lifestyle hotel brand by Hyatt Hotels Corporation that inspires fresh perspectives.The first Andaz property in Southeast Asia offers well-appointed guestrooms and suites, four event venues, and five dining and drinking concepts. Situated at the crossroads of the Kampong Glam, Little India and Bras Basah Bugis cultural districts—with their intimate shophouse-filled alleyways and atmospheric colours, textures and flavours— Andaz Singapore aims to spark discovery of the rich culture of Singapore, and inspire guests to experience the city from new angles.


Global in scale while local in perspective, the Andaz brand empowers self-expression and stimulates guests’ curiosity through imaginative travel for a distinctively local experience. Through thoughtful, unscripted service tailored for travelers, Andaz hotels enable guests to go beyond the familiar to discover and define their personal essence while immersing themselves in the spirit of the eclectic culture around them.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR


At Andaz Singapore, we believe in creating inspiring experiences through genuine connections, thoughtful leadership and a culture where colleagues can be their best selves.


We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Director of Sales & Marketing / Executive Assistant Manager-Sales & Marketing to join our Leadership Committee. Reporting to the General Manager, this role provides strategic leadership across Sales, Events, Weddings, Revenue Management coordination, Marketing Communications and Digital Marketing. The position translates the hotel’s strategy, brand direction and financial priorities into integrated commercial plans that drive revenue, market share, customer preference and long-term brand value.


This is an exciting opportunity for an accomplished commercial leader who combines strong business acumen with a passion for developing people, building meaningful customer relationships and delivering measurable results.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Develop and execute an integrated Sales & Marketing business plan covering key market segments, accounts, channels, events, weddings and communications.
- Lead commercial strategies that drive room, event and wedding revenue, market share, demand generation and conversion.
- Set the hotel’s sales deployment, key-account development, prospecting, customer engagement and market coverage priorities.
- Guide the Revenue Management function in evaluating business pace, demand patterns, competitive conditions, displacement and need periods, while developing well-supported pricing and revenue recommendations.
- Lead the commercial performance of Events and Weddings, including pipeline conversion, space utilisation, client engagement, revenue delivery and cross-functional handovers.
- Oversee integrated marketing, public relations, digital, advertising, partnership and content initiatives, ensuring measurable returns and consistency with Andaz brand standards.
- Maintain accurate commercial forecasts, pipeline information, competitive intelligence, campaign analysis and executive performance reporting.
- Manage the department’s budget, productivity, promotional investment, contracts, purchasing and financial controls.
- Recruit, coach and develop a high-performing and inclusive commercial team, while strengthening succession planning and leadership capability.
- Ensure that commercial activities, contracts, records, data controls and departmental procedures comply with Hyatt policies and applicable requirements.


WHAT YOU HAVE

- Substantial senior leadership experience in luxury hospitality Sales & Marketing.
- Broad commercial exposure across sales, events, revenue collaboration, marketing communications and digital channels.
- A demonstrated ability to develop complex commercial plans, interpret market and financial performance, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
- Strong understanding of lifestyle positioning, customer expectations, brand standards and long-term brand equity.
- Executive presence, sound judgement, discretion and the ability to contribute constructively to hotel-wide decisions.
- Strong communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to engage senior leaders, owners, corporate partners, customers and colleagues.
- A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Hospitality, Communications or a related discipline, or equivalent executive experience. You will be expected to connect market intelligence, customer demand, pricing, channel performance and hotel operating capacity to clear commercial action. You will use financial, digital, CRM, business intelligence and revenue data to identify opportunities, manage risks and improve performance.


You will work collaboratively with the General Manager, hotel leadership, operating divisions, Finance, Human Resources and Hyatt partners to create shared accountability and deliver sustainable results. You will build strong customer and industry relationships, communicate with clarity, and create an environment where colleagues are empowered to experiment, improve and grow.

description:
Job Description:

About Us

ATR is the world's number one aircraft manufacturer in regional aviation providing a new generation of turboprops. We are a joint venture between two European aeronautical heavyweights, Airbus and Leonardo.

From the world’s largest cities, to our planet’s most remote regions, our purpose is to deliver air travel to people, communities and businesses in an innovative, sustainable and modern way.

If you strive for excellence, are driven by ambition, trust and respect as we are, then get your career off to a flighting start with ATR!

Our leadership profile:

People Centric - Entrepreneurial - Inspiring - Exemplary - Innovative - Humble

At ATR you will work with passionate colleagues to make a difference in a human size company with attractive advantages!

Customer Marketing and Business Development Manager

A unique opportunity to join the ATR Commercial Directorate as a Customer Marketing & Business Development Manager in the dynamic APAC region. The team, made up of people based over 3 continents, is looking for it’s newest member to come onboard.

Your mission:


- Influence and convince airline and lessor decision-makers of the competitive advantage of ATR products and their contribution to airline profitability, both in the context of sales campaigns and business development.
- Play a critical role in setting the sales strategy and approach with the regional sales directors.
- Manage all marketing and business development activities on specific accounts and campaigns in the APAC region:

- Identify targets and prospects with regional sales directors and contribute to the definition and implementation of regional strategies.
- Prepare and present analyses on aircraft performance and technical aspects, airline economics as well as network and fleet planning at all phases of sales campaigns.
- Build strong pitches for sales campaigns and ensure that value-added arguments are effectively communicated, understood by the customer and used to develop a business offer when appropriate.
- Find and engage with possible future prospects in the region, including but not limited to VIP prospects, oil and gas prospects and future airline prospects.
- Develop a thorough understanding of all aspects of an airline’s requirements, global and regional aviation market trends, airline business drivers, evolving fleet and network requirements, revenue and profit generation models, and the markets competitive environment.
- Build relationships with customer counterparts.
- Proactively drive business development analyses and presentations to fuel new market opportunities and influence the market by promoting the superiority of ATR products and their latest developments.
- Contribute to the product policy by providing feedback on the market needs expressed during sales campaigns.
- Strengthen the impact of customer-facing messages in close collaboration with the Product Marketing, Market Development and Communications teams.

About You



- Ideally 3-5 years of relevant work experience, with at least one experience within an airline or in a customer-facing role. A strong technical (performance and operations) and commercial understanding of regional air transport, the cost structure of airlines, the product landscape and influencing factors.
- Excellent presentation skills: Experience in delivering presentations to large audiences and the ability to communicate with different sources and users of information.
- Analysis: Strong analytical skills and ability to turn findings from technical or digital analysis into compelling marketing arguments.
- Customer Focus: ability to work to satisfy internal and/or external customers by managing time and quality expectations.
- Adaptability: ability to adapt to new subjects (technical, commercial, communication, services, tools).
- Economic impact: ability to achieve objectives by integrating the notions of time, quality and financial results.
- Innovation: The ability to take a creative approach to developing new marketing strategies, solving problems, and achieving goals.
- Team spirit and collaboration
- Strong interpersonal skills

Technical skills



- Understanding of the key players, stakeholders, trends, and drivers of the aviation market.
- Understanding of regional air transport, the cost structure of airlines, the product landscape.
- Understanding of the macro-economic environment.
- Aircraft financing landscape.
- Fleet and network planning, revenue management.
- Product knowledge: performance, aircraft systems, engines, cabin, etc.
- Marketing and communication: messages, presentations.

Language skills



- An excellent level of spoken and written English is mandatory
- The ability to communicate in another language is a plus.

IT skills



- Software: MS Office, ideally aircraft performance and maintenance cost tools (PACE, FOS, DMC tool).
- Databases: understanding of the following data: planned flights & traffic (e.g. OAG, SABRE, MIDT), macro-economic data (e.g. IHS, Oxford Economics).
- Ideally Excel (expert), SQL (advanced), R&RStudio or Python (advanced) skills.
- PowerBI skills are a plus

description:
