This strategic role is responsible for leading the development and execution of the growth strategy for the iconic Betadine Wound portfolio across AMENA and ensuring markets are aligned against the key strategic priorities required to deliver agreed financial, market share, brand health and profitability targets. This role also ensures marketing investments are translated into sustainable business growth and value creation.

The role is accountable for defining portfolio and innovation strategies, identifying growth opportunities, primarily focused

on developing scalable consumer (Direct-to-Consumer) and supported by healthcare professional (HCP) engagement programmes, to ensure the effective management of the Wound Care portfolio as part of the Betadine megabrand architecture.

The role also supports capability development across the region, fosters responsible adoption of AI-enabled marketing workflows and manages and develops a direct report.

-  Deliver financial targets including Net Sales, EBITDA, SOM and agreed brand health metrics across the Wound Care portfolio within the AMENA region.
-  Lead the development and execution of regional franchise strategies, annual brand plans and long-term portfolio growth roadmaps. Define portfolio roles, investment priorities and growth plans across markets
-  Develop integrated Consumer and HCP growth strategies that drive brand preference and conversion across priority channels. Ensure a strong consumer, patient and HCP-centric mindset is embedded across all strategic and operational marketing activities, integrating consumer demand generation and HCP recommendation into one coherent approach.
-  Ensure a consumer/patient/HCP centric mindset is at the forefront of all brand activity, with the identification and development of compelling consumer/patient/HCP insights. Drive evidence-based decision making through analytics, scenario planning, standard KPIs, performance dashboards
-  Develop and govern Wound Care brand positioning, message hierarchy, distinct brand assets, communication frameworks and brand guidelines across all AMENA markets, enabling compliant local adaptation within defined guardrails.

-  Champion adoption of approved AI-powered marketing tools and workflows across insight generation, content creation, localisation, performance optimisation and reporting. Ensure outputs are validated, human-owned and reviewed in line with data privacy, intellectual property, medical, regulatory and company requirements.
-  Partner with Commercial Excellence and Finance to optimize portfolio strategy, pricing architecture, revenue growth management and A&P allocation, using clear investment cases, assumptions, payback and risk considerations.
-  Manage and develop direct report through clear objectives, coaching, performance management, feedback and development planning.
-  Support the identification and evaluation of external growth opportunities and market expansions

-  A recognised university degree and/or Masters/MBA qualification.

-  Demonstrated success in developing and executing brand, category and portfolio growth strategies across multiple markets.
-  Strong understanding of consumer, patient and HCP marketing principles and the ability to integrate them into one growth strategy.
-  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills supporting the identification, prioritisation and evaluation of growth opportunities.
-  Strong commercial and financial acumen with experience in business case development, ROI evaluation, pricing, revenue growth management and portfolio strategy.
-  Experience leading and developing direct report and influencing senior stakeholders across functions and geographies.
-  Excellent communication skills and ability to work within and lead cross functional teams

-  Ability to make clear choices and progress decisions in conditions of ambiguity.

title: Director of Sales & Marketing / EAM - Sales & Marketing
description:
Organization- Andaz Singapore

Summary

COME, EXPRESS YOUR ANDAZ

Join Andaz Singapore, the first Andaz hotel in Southeast Asia.

Occupying Levels 25 to 39 of the DUO Tower, Andaz Singapore is a lifestyle hotel brand by Hyatt Hotels Corporation that inspires fresh perspectives. The first Andaz property in Southeast Asia offers well-appointed guestrooms and suites, four event venues, and five dining and drinking concepts. Reporting to the General Manager, this role provides strategic leadership across Sales, Events, Weddings, Revenue Management coordination, Marketing Communications and Digital Marketing. The position translates the hotel’s strategy, brand direction and financial priorities into integrated commercial plans that drive revenue, market share, customer preference and long-term brand value.

This is an exciting opportunity for an accomplished commercial leader who combines strong business acumen with a passion for developing people, building meaningful customer relationships and delivering measurable results.

What You Will Do



-  Develop and execute an integrated Sales & Marketing business plan covering key market segments, accounts, channels, events, weddings and communications.
-  Lead commercial strategies that drive room, event and wedding revenue, market share, demand generation and conversion.
-  Set the hotel’s sales deployment, key-account development, prospecting, customer engagement and market coverage priorities.
-  Guide the Revenue Management function in evaluating business pace, demand patterns, competitive conditions, displacement and need periods, while developing well-supported pricing and revenue recommendations.
-  Lead the commercial performance of Events and Weddings, including pipeline conversion, space utilisation, client engagement, revenue delivery and cross-functional handovers.
-  Oversee integrated marketing, public relations, digital, advertising, partnership and content initiatives, ensuring measurable returns and consistency with Andaz brand standards.

-  Manage the department’s budget, productivity, promotional investment, contracts, purchasing and financial controls.
-  Recruit, coach and develop a high-performing and inclusive commercial team, while strengthening succession planning and leadership capability.

Qualifications

WHAT YOU HAVE

-  Broad commercial exposure across sales, events, revenue collaboration, marketing communications and digital channels.
-  A demonstrated ability to develop complex commercial plans, interpret market and financial performance, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
-  Strong understanding of lifestyle positioning, customer expectations, brand standards and long-term brand equity.
-  Executive presence, sound judgement, discretion and the ability to contribute constructively to hotel-wide decisions.
-  Strong communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to engage senior leaders, owners, corporate partners, customers and colleagues.

You will be expected to connect market intelligence, customer demand, pricing, channel performance and hotel operating capacity to clear commercial action. You will work collaboratively with the General Manager, hotel leadership, operating divisions, Finance, Human Resources and Hyatt partners to create shared accountability and deliver sustainable results. title: Head of APJ Marketing, Strategic Customer and Partner Marketing
description:
Description

As the SCPM Geo Leader for APJ, you will serve as the "Single Threaded Leader” (STL) for AWS marketing in your geography, informing and influencing the full marketing investment across digital, events, partner and ABM to maximize impact in your region. You work backwards to drive key marketing outputs (e.g., perception, Marketing Engaged Framework metrics) from brand to demand across channels. You are an advocate and “voice of the customer” representing the sale leadership and more importantly the growth targets of the Geo. You represent marketing outcomes that deliver revenue to the sales leader on behalf of WW Marketing; you directly own Account Based Marketing and influence the digital; event marketing, partner marketing and other Marketing program/ investments on behalf of your region. You will drive the regional ABM strategy while serving as the single point of accountability for representing your Geo back to all marketing teams.

Key job responsibilities



- Ensure the marketing investments across functions (IDC, Events, Partner Marketing, ABM CoE, Industries, Developer, product marketing, andBrand) is aligned with the marketing growth by customer segment that is needed in your Geo.
-  Lead and scale the Account Based Marketing program for your geography, including account selection, coverage strategy, and resource deployment decisions, adapting global ABM playbooks to local market context and building regional ABM capability through hiring, coaching, and upskilling.
-  Represent marketing as a unified growth partner to regional sales leadership by participating in business reviews, annual planning, and governance forums, and by owning the investment framework that categorizes country-level marketing spend using a standardized, data-driven model.
-  Serve as the region's marketing intelligence expert, translating local customer insights, market dynamics, and cultural moments into actionable briefs for product marketing, industry marketing, public relations, public policy, and analyst relations teams.
-  Build and lead an inclusive marketing community across all functions operating in your geography — coaching and developing marketers regardless of reporting line, championing talent progression, and creating collaboration forums that connect global teams to the regional mission.

A day in the life

You open the morning reviewing regional demand metrics, spotting a gap in pipeline coverage for an emerging customer segment. You pull together a brief for the digital and events teams proposing a rebalanced investment mix, then jump into a call with sales leadership to align on priorities for the upcoming quarter. After lunch you lead an ABM working session, reviewing account-level engagement data and coaching your team on refining a precision campaign. You close out the day connecting with a global counterpart to share a local customer story that could inform worldwide messaging.

About The Team

Our team sits at the center of AWS marketing's regional go-to-market motion. We connect worldwide marketing strategy to local execution, ensuring every investment — from large-scale summits to targeted ABM campaigns — is grounded in real customer and market insights. We are an inclusive group of marketers, strategists, and analysts who collaborate across digital, events, partner, and industry functions to drive measurable growth. As AWS continues to expand, this team plays a critical role in shaping how we engage customers and accelerate revenue across geographies.

Basic Qualifications



-  12+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
-  Experience managing teams
-  Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
-  Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams
-  Experience working in a matrixed environment, influencing strategy, and achieving goals by working across the organization
-  Track record of developing and implementing strategic marketing plans that drive business impact

Preferred Qualifications



-  Experience leading across multiple locales
-  Experience defining marketing strategy and executional excellence
-  Experience in leadership roles, overseeing teams conducting data analysis, process improvements, creative problem solving, and cross-functional collaboration
-  Strong business acumen with ability to align marketing activities to business outcomes
-  Proven ability to build high-trust relationships with sales and business leadership
-  Excellent change management skills to navigate organizational transformation
-  Comfort operating in ambiguous environments with evolving decision rights
-  Track record of influencing across organizational boundaries and leading without direct authority
-  History of successfully representing regional perspectives to global leadership

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Regional Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description
We are seeking a dynamic, highly motivated, and commercially driven Regional Marketing Manager to lead student acquisition initiatives across China, Southeast Asia, and the broader Asia-Pacific (APAC) region.
As a key brand representative, you will play a pivotal role in driving student recruitment through daily live streaming, digital marketing, and audience engagement. You will be responsible for hosting compelling live broadcasts that engage prospective students, build brand credibility, generate qualified leads, and convert audience interest into successful student applications and enrolments.
You will also manage supporting digital channels, particularly Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) and WeChat, to strengthen brand visibility, promote live streaming sessions, and support regional student recruitment objectives.
Key Responsibilities
1. Live Streaming & Student Acquisition

- Plan, produce, manage, and host engaging daily live streaming sessions across relevant digital platforms.
- Develop compelling live content that showcases the institution's programmes, educational offerings, student experiences, and value propositions.
- Engage prospective students in real time, address enquiries, build trust, and guide audiences through the student recruitment and enrolment journey.
- Implement effective audience engagement and conversion strategies to generate qualified leads and drive student applications and enrolments.

- Manage and optimise regional digital marketing channels, particularly Xiaohongshu and WeChat, to increase brand awareness and drive traffic to live streaming sessions.

- Develop compelling brand narratives and high-quality promotional materials to strengthen brand positioning across the APAC region.
- Monitor regional education market trends, student mobility patterns, competitor activities, and consumer behaviour.
- Analyse audience engagement and market feedback to identify new recruitment opportunities and refine live streaming content.
- Apply cultural intelligence and market insights to improve campaign relevance and effectiveness across different markets.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with admissions, academic, and other relevant teams to ensure the accuracy and consistency of programme information communicated during live broadcasts.
- Coordinate recruitment campaigns and promotional activities to support institutional enrolment targets.
- Maintain effective communication with prospective students and build positive relationships throughout the recruitment process.
Requirements

- Proven experience in digital marketing, regional marketing, student recruitment, education marketing, live streaming, or a related field.
- Demonstrated commercial awareness and the ability to convert audience interest into qualified leads and measurable business outcomes.
- Familiarity with Chinese digital platforms, particularly Xiaohongshu and WeChat, and their application in marketing and audience development.

- Professional proficiency in Mandarin to engage effectively with Chinese-speaking audiences. Additional regional language capabilities will be an advantage.
- Experience developing localised content and marketing campaigns for diverse Asian markets.
- Familiarity with digital marketing, management systems, and conversion optimisation tools.

title: Field & Event Marketing Manager, APAC (Singapore)
description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Team Overview

Deepgram recently opened its APAC headquarters in Singapore, and the region is one of our fastest-moving markets. You’ll build the APAC marketing function from zero, partnering closely with the APAC GM and regional sales leadership to shape and execute the regional plan. As part of the global Events & Field Marketing team, you’ll get the playbooks, brand assets, budget framework and coaching to help you move fast.

Your job is to make Deepgram visible and credible across the region through technical community and partner motions, and to turn that presence into pipeline. As the senior marketer in region, you're also marketing's local point of contact: you'll work with our APAC PR agency and partner with global Brand, Web, and Product Marketing to keep regional messaging local and consistent.

Key Goals



- Ship an APAC field and events plan and budget, agreed with regional sales leadership, with reserve held for in-quarter opportunities
- Launch a recurring technical community program out of Singapore, India, and Australia, with steady attendance from developers, builders and customers
- Stand up repeatable joint field programs with cloud, technology, and channel partners, each with shared pipeline goals and tracking
- Grow program-sourced and program-influenced pipeline and new logos across APAC
- Localize global "event-in-a-box" kits for priority markets and follow up with every lead fast
- Put a live APAC customer proof library (stories, case studies, references) into active use by sales aligned to global Marketing Team.
- Work with global Brand Team to properly represent APAC on the website: a regional landing page, local customer logos, case studies, proof points, product news and team presence.
- Deliver executive roundtables, customer dinners, and sponsorships, on time and on budget, reporting spend, attendance, and pipeline against plan

Minimum Skills, Knowledge & Capabilities



- Plans and runs field and event programs end to end, from small executive dinners to large sponsorships, on time and on budget
- Builds community technical audiences choose to attend: hands-on content, credible speakers, and real builders in the room
- Designs partner marketing motions (joint programs, co-marketing, co-sell) with shared goals and measurable pipeline
- Partners with sales to tie every program in the quarterly plan to pipeline
- Adapts global playbooks to local markets across language, culture, format, and buyer expectations, and knows the APAC vendor landscape
- Operates AI-native: designs Human+AI workflows for planning, logistics, follow-up, and reporting, and builds systems that eliminate recurring event work instead of redoing it each time
- Works self-directed as the first in region, across time zones with a US-based team; travels across the region regularly (roughly 30-40%)

Preferred Qualifications (nice-to-have, not required)



- Typically ~3–6 years in field or event marketing covering APAC, or equivalent demonstrated experience
- Background in B2B SaaS, developer-focused, or AI/infrastructure marketing
- Co-marketing experience with technical partners
- Experience working with PR agencies or supporting regional communications
- Professional proficiency in an additional regional language (e.g., Bahasa, Mandarin)

Our Values



- Be You: bring your whole self and a different perspective; diverse viewpoints make our products better.
- Be Curious: challenge the status quo, keep learning, and ask 'how might we?' instead of accepting limits.
- Grow Together: push each other to do great work, treat feedback as a gift, and leave the drama out.
- Do the Right Thing: act with integrity and candor, assume best intent, choose ethics over expediency.
- Think Smart. Act Fast.: weigh the high-leverage options, decide, and move; no analysis paralysis.
- Put the Customer First: listen with empathy, understand their goals, and let their success drive ours.

We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting great candidates — so please don't hesitate to apply. We'd love to hear from you.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

title: International PR & Content | Marketing (Senior) Manager
description:
Location: Hong Kong / Singapore / Remote (International / Global)


About the Role
We are seeking an energetic, strategically minded Marketing Business Partner (Manager / Senior Manager grade) to drive OSL’s brand awareness, PR presence, and content-led pipeline expansion across international and developed markets (Europe, North America, and key global hubs). Operating as OSL’s primary content storyteller and brand catalyst internationally, you will translate complex PayFi and cross-border payment innovations into high-impact market messaging.


In this role, you will lead our English-first content strategy, direct international PR agency partners, and leverage high-profile media collaborations to build enterprise domain authority. While your core focus is high-impact written content, PR, and brand messaging, you will also support field marketing initiatives and offline event execution—including owned flagship events at major global gatherings.


Currently structured as a hands-on Individual Contributor role, this position offers immediate strategic ownership with long-term growth potential. As our international operations expand, the role is positioned to evolve to include people management responsibilities and driving cross-functional output through central shared service centers and matrixed contributors.


Key Responsibilities

- International Content Strategy & Execution: Plan, write, and publish high-caliber English B2B content—including whitepapers, deep-dive articles, enterprise case studies, and executive thought leadership—tailored to international corporate decision-makers and financial institutions.
- PR Agency & Tier-1 Media Management: Manage external international PR agencies across target regions to amplify brand reach cost-effectively. Drive tier-1 media placements, executive interview opportunities (e.g., CNBC), and strategic content distribution via partners like The Block.
- Executive Presence & Conference Strategy: Coordinate high-impact speaking slots and panel opportunities for OSL leadership at major global summits to establish the firm as a premier PayFi and regulated digital asset partner.
- Pipeline Foundation & Budget Scaling: Establish the client pipeline and content foundation in Q4 to prepare for strategic budget scaling and campaign deployment in Q1. Ensure content and PR directly feed top-of-funnel enterprise lead generation.
- Field Marketing & Flagship Event Support: Provide field marketing support for global roadshows, webinars, and partner salons. Co-lead the planning and execution of OSL’s owned flagship side-event during Hong Kong Fintech Week next year.
- Ecosystem Partnerships & Co-Marketing: Collaborate with key industry platforms, media channels, and ecosystem partners to negotiate co-marketing initiatives, build platform-level endorsements, and expand brand authority.
- Competitive Benchmarking & Positioning: Continuously benchmark OSL’s value proposition against traditional and emerging international payment and crypto infrastructure providers to refine brand narrative and positioning.


Requirements & Qualifications

- 5+ years of B2B content marketing, PR, or brand marketing experience targeting international/developed markets. Background in Web3/Crypto, Fintech, Enterprise SaaS, or Payments is preferred.
- Native or near-native English copywriting and editing skills, with a proven portfolio of B2B technical narratives, thought leadership, and PR copy for executive audiences.
- Proven experience managing international PR agencies and securing placements or executive interviews in tier-1 financial and tech media outlets.
- A self-starter capable of taking full ownership from high-level campaign conceptualization through execution as a high-impact IC, with the capability to scale into people management or lead shared-service resources in the future.
- Experience supporting offline industry events, webinars, or commercial roadshows.
- Self-motivated and comfortable collaborating across global time zones.
- Fluent/Native English is required. Mandarin is a plus (good to have), but not required.
- Deep payment experience is a plus (good to have), but not mandatory—ability to quickly master cross-border payment mechanics, stablecoins, and PayFi is required.


About OSL

- OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
- OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Field Marketing Manager, APAC
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

We're looking for our founding APAC Field Marketing Leader, someone strategy-strong who can autonomously own a regional function end to end — set the strategy, build the operating system, carry the number, and represent marketing credibly to regional sales leadership and to global marketing leadership at the same time. Not a program manager who executes a plan set elsewhere.

The essential tension to screen for: this person needs the seniority and judgment to lead an org, and the willingness to be a team of one for a while. Regional expansion is planned but the timing isn't fixed, which means for some meaningful period they are writing the doc, running the roundtable, and negotiating with the agency themselves. Scrappy, low-ego, and hands-on — but senior enough to see the whole picture without the support systems a mature regional marketing org would provide.

Regional judgment matters more here than in most field marketing roles. One person cannot serve five sub-regions equally, so the job is fundamentally about sequencing: which markets get real first-party investment, which get partner-led coverage, and which wait. They need to make those calls, defend them to sales leaders in each market, and revisit them as signal comes in.

Partner fluency is not a nice-to-have in this region — it's the primary distribution mechanism. Someone who has only run first-party programs will find the leverage model unfamiliar.

What a successful candidate looks like: a leader who landed in a new region with nothing, picked the right two markets to prove out, used partner and agency capacity to punch well above their headcount, and can point to the pipeline, the operating system, and the team plan they left behind.

Ideal Profiles



- The first-in-region builder who then scaled it. Was the founding field or regional marketing hire for APAC at an enterprise software company and grew it into a team. Brings direct experience with both halves of this job. Pressure-test whether they built a durable function or just ran events, and whether they're still willing to be hands-on at the start.
- The partner-led regional leader. Led co-marketing and demand programs through cloud providers, resellers, and distributors across APAC markets. Strongest on leverage and ecosystem motion. Pressure-test whether they can also build direct enterprise ABM and own a pipeline number independent of partners.
- The multi-market APAC field marketing leader. Owned field marketing across several APAC sub-regions at a scaled tech company. Brings market fluency, local vendor and event relationships, and cultural range. Pressure-test appetite for building infrastructure from scratch rather than operating within an existing system, and for the period before they have a team.

Key responsibilities



- Build and lead the APAC field marketing function, establishing scalable frameworks and processes from scratch in the region
- Drive field marketing initiatives across enterprise while building scaled programs for startups, adapting strategy for diverse international markets and buying behaviors
- Create and run field marketing programs including executive roundtables, customer events, industry conferences, partner programs, and ABM activations
- Partner closely with APAC sales leadership to align programs to territory and account-specific pipeline and revenue goals
- Establish measurement frameworks including lead scoring, attribution models, and ROI reporting to demonstrate marketing's impact on revenue
- Evaluate and select premium third-party events that align with business goals, and build high-impact activation strategies around them
- Collaborate with Global Field Marketing and other central marketing teams so APAC programs align with company-wide strategy while meeting local market needs
- Coordinate with APAC Solutions Marketing and Product Marketing for consistent messaging and positioning across regional programs
- Manage regional resources including relationships with key partners, vendors, and industry organizations across APAC
- Build and manage the regional field marketing budget with strong financial discipline and ROI focus
- Define the regional team plan and hire and lead the function as expansion headcount lands
- Drive continuous improvement through post-program analysis, stakeholder feedback, and data-driven optimization

Minimum Qualifications



- 14+ years B2B enterprise marketing with blended expertise in field marketing, ABM, and demand generation in APAC markets
- Deep understanding of enterprise sales cycles and buying processes; software company experience is required
- Track record building and scaling field marketing and demand generation programs from the ground up
- Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to program optimization and attribution
- Demonstrated contribution to significant revenue goals through integrated marketing initiatives
- International marketing experience and understanding of regional market dynamics across Asia Pacific
- Proven self-starter who has run sophisticated programs with small teams in fast-paced startup environments
- Strong project management across complex, multi-country programs simultaneously
- Exceptional budgeting and financial management with experience managing substantial field marketing budgets
- Cultural awareness and ability to adapt strategy for diverse APAC markets
- Excellent cross-functional collaboration, particularly with sales teams and executive stakeholders
- Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for thoughtful action
- Existing right to work in Singapore is required for this role.

Strong candidates may also have



- Experience marketing AI/ML or complex technical products to enterprise customers
- Experience building and leading demand generation teams in APAC
- Knowledge of account-based marketing strategies and execution
- Background at high-growth technology companies such as Okta, Splunk, Snowflake, or Workday
- Previous experience as a first field marketing hire in a new region
- Fluency in multiple Asia Pacific languages
- Understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements for marketing activities
- Experience evaluating and activating at premium third-party events strategically, including hospitality management at high-end venues and cultural

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. title: Director, NI APAC Marketing
description:
Job Description

Position Summary:

If you are a Director, APAC Marketing professional looking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you. In this strategic leadership role, you will lead regional marketing strategy, execution, and business performance across Asia-Pacific, excluding China. As a key member of both the Global Marketing Leadership Team and Regional Marketing Leadership Team, you will connect enterprise growth priorities with regional market needs, helping drive customer engagement, demand generation, brand awareness, pipeline growth, and sustainable business results. This position offers the opportunity to influence global strategy, partner with senior leaders across the organization, and lead a talented, geographically diverse team across some of the world's most dynamic markets.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:



-  Lead the APAC regional marketing organization outside China, including direct and matrixed team members across multiple countries, cultures, and functions. 
-  Develop and execute annual and multi-year regional marketing strategies aligned with global business objectives and regional growth priorities. 
-  Build, coach, and develop a collaborative, accountable, and customer-focused team that supports individual growth and organizational success. 
-  Partner with sales, services, business, and marketing leaders to identify market opportunities, understand customer needs, and prioritize growth investments. 
-  Lead integrated demand generation and customer engagement programs across digital marketing, communications, events, partner marketing, technical marketing, and thought leadership initiatives. 
-  Adapt global campaigns, messaging, and customer experiences to increase relevance, engagement, and business impact across local markets. 
-  Establish success measures, evaluate campaign and program performance, and optimize investments based on measurable business outcomes, including pipeline, revenue contribution, and customer engagement. 
-  Serve as an external spokesperson and thought leader through industry events, customer engagements, conferences, media opportunities, social channels, and internal forums. 
-  Communicate compelling perspectives on company strategy, solutions, customer challenges, industry trends, and emerging opportunities. 
-  Translate customer insights and regional market dynamics into recommendations that influence global strategy, investment decisions, and execution priorities. 
-  Collaborate closely with Global Marketing, Product Marketing, Business Units, Operations, Communications, and regional teams to drive shared business outcomes. 
-  Manage regional budgets, workforce planning, performance reporting, resource allocation, and operational excellence initiatives. 
-  Champion data-informed decision-making, operational discipline, continuous improvement, and cross-functional accountability. 
-  Represent APAC marketing within global and regional leadership forums, ensuring regional perspectives help inform enterprise-wide decisions. 

Who You Are:

You see ahead to future possibilities and translate them into breakthrough strategies. You create competitive and breakthrough strategies that show a clear connection between vision and action. You build strong customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions. You develop people to meet both their career goals and the organization's goals while fostering collaboration, accountability, and high performance across diverse teams.

For This Role, You Will Need:



-  Significant experience in marketing, commercial strategy, business leadership, or a related field with responsibility for regional, multinational, or global programs. 
-  Demonstrated success leading, coaching, and developing geographically distributed teams within multicultural environments. 
-  Experience in test and measurement, industrial technology, enterprise software, manufacturing technology, engineering-focused industries, business-to-business technology, or other complex technical markets. 
-  Strong business and commercial judgment, with the ability to connect marketing investments to customer engagement, pipeline generation, revenue growth, and business outcomes. 
-  The ability to understand technical products, engineering-driven solutions, and customer applications and translate them into meaningful business value. 
-  Experience turning complex concepts into clear, compelling, and customer-relevant communications. 
-  A demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and collaborate effectively across functions in a global, matrixed organization. 
-  Experience developing marketing strategies and delivering measurable outcomes through integrated marketing programs and go-to-market initiatives. 
-  Excellent written, verbal, and executive-level presentation skills in English. 
-  The ability and willingness to travel regularly across APAC and internationally. 
-  Residence within the APAC region, subject to applicable employment and work authorization requirements. 
-  A bachelor's degree, professional qualification, or an equivalent combination of practical experience and demonstrated success in engineering, computer science, marketing, business, communications, or a related field. 

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:



-  Knowledge of the test and measurement market, engineering workflows, or adjacent industrial technology sectors. 
-  Experience owning APAC regional marketing strategy, growth planning, and execution. 
-  Experience working within a complex, highly matrixed global organization. 
-  Proficiency in an Asian language in addition to professional fluency in English. 
-  A master's degree in business administration, international business, marketing, engineering, or a related field. 
-  Experience representing an organization through executive presentations, customer events, industry conferences, media engagements, analyst briefings, or thought leadership programs. 
-  Experience leading marketing transformation, digital marketing, commercial excellence, or customer experience initiatives. 

Our Culture & Commitment  To  You:

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing.

We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.

About Us

WHY EMERSON

Our Commitment to Our People

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.

At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.

Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. title: Assistant Marketing Manager, Events
categories: Retail Apparel and Fashion and Retail
description:
Goldheart Jewelry is evolving how a heritage brand speaks to a new generation of romantics, achievers and self-gifters through meaningful experiences and cultural moments. As Assistant Marketing Manager, Events, you will play a key role in bringing the brand to life through well-executed marketing activations and events. This includes planning and executing boutique and atrium activations, corporate staff sales, campaign launches and PR-related events that drive brand visibility and retail engagement.


You will lead the planning and execution of events that translate our brand story into impactful moments for customers, media and partners. Working closely with the Marketing, Creative, Retail Operations, Merchandising teams and external partners, you will translate campaign strategies into on-ground experiences while also supporting tactical marketing needs such as boutique promotional collaterals and activation materials.


What you’ll own
Event & Activation Planning

- Plan and execute a calendar of marketing events and activations aligned with key campaigns, product launches and seasonal retail moments which includes:
- Boutique events and in-store activations
- Mall atrium events
- Corporate office staff sales
- PR and media events in collaboration with the Marketing team
- Oversee end-to-end event execution including concept development, budgeting and timeline planning to vendor coordination, programme flow, gifting, RSVP coordination, event logistics, on-ground execution and post-event evaluation.
- Translate brand events into experiential moments, working closely with Marketing to ensure key product stories, seasonal campaigns and brand narratives come to life through immersive activations.
- Take a hands-on role in planning and executing consumer and branding events, while also guiding and coordinating external partners - including agencies, production vendors, stylists, and PR collaborators - to ensure quality brand experiences aligned with brand guidelines.
- Collaborate with Marketing to maximise amplification of events and PR moments across digital channels, ensuring strong storytelling before, during and after key activations.


Retail & Campaign Activations

- Work closely with the Marketing team to translate campaign narratives and product stories into engaging retail and experiential activations.
- Ensure event concepts and setups reflect the brand’s positioning while supporting commercial objectives such as traffic generation, sales conversion and customer engagement.


Boutique Marketing & Promotional Collaterals

- Support the development of marketing collaterals for tactical activations including:
- Preparing artwork briefs for Creative team
- Coordinating production of in-store POSM, event signages, promotional materials and activation visuals with Creative team
- Ensuring brand consistency across boutique marketing materials


PR Event Support

- Support the Marketing team in the planning and execution of PR and media-related events, including:
- Media previews and product showcases
- Influencer or stylist engagements
- Campaign launch events
- Assist with coordination of guest management, event logistics, gifting and on-site event operations to ensure smooth execution.


Vendor & Partner Coordination

- Manage relationships with event vendors, production partners, venues and mall management teams.
- Coordinate with agencies, suppliers and VM team on event setup, fabrication, logistics and installation to ensure timely and high-quality execution.
- Identify and pursue partnership opportunities with lifestyle brands/venues that extend brand reach and relevance.


Event Performance Tracking

- Support post-event reporting by tracking key outcomes such as:
- RSVP sign-ups, event attendance and engagement
- Gift redemptions
- Retail traffic or sales performance during activations
- Provide insights to improve future activations and event strategies.


Competencies Required
• STRATEGIC THINKING – Applies an understanding of the organization’s mission, vision and strategic priorities to design events initiatives that support brand growth and business objectives.
• INFLUENCE – Builds strong relationships with internal stakeholders and partners to amplify brand narratives and drive successful collaborations.
• PROJECT MANAGEMENT & LEADERSHIP – Demonstrates initiative, accountability and a hands-on approach in managing projects and partners, while contributing positively to team performance and outcomes. Able to anticipate operational challenges and respond quickly in fast-paced event environments.
• INNOVATION – Brings fresh ideas to brand activations, partnerships and product storytelling, contributing to a culture that embraces creative thinking and continuous improvement.
• BUSINESS AWARENESS - Understands how retail activations and marketing events contribute to brand visibility, customer engagement and sales performance.


The portfolio you’ll build here

- A portfolio of brand experiences and events that bring Goldheart’s campaigns and collections to life — from media previews and product launches to retail activations, collaborations and brand partnerships.
- End-to-end event ownership, including concept proposals, event briefs, guest strategies, programme flow, vendor coordination and post-event reports that demonstrate both creative thinking and operational excellence.
- Experience developing experiential frameworks and event playbooks (event formats, guest journeys, media engagement approaches, partnership structures) that can be replicated and scaled across campaigns and retail initiatives.
- Case studies of brand activations and PR initiatives that generated measurable impact — such as media coverage, influencer reach, brand buzz, customer engagement or retail traffic uplift.
- Cross-functional collaboration experience, working closely with brand marketing, content, social, retail operations, merchandising and external partners to ensure campaigns translate seamlessly into impactful real-world experiences.


About you

- 3–5 years of experience in events, brand activations, either in-house or agency, ideally within fashion, beauty or lifestyle industries.
- Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Marketing, Communications, Business, Events Management or a related field.
- Proven experience planning and executing brand events, launches or experiential activations with strong attention to detail and operational execution.
- Strong project management and vendor coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple timelines, partners and deliverables simultaneously.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, comfortable working with media, influencers, agencies, venues and internal stakeholders.
- Highly organised, proactive and resourceful, with the ability to troubleshoot quickly and stay calm in fast-paced event environments.
- Highly proactive, resourceful and comfortable working in dynamic event environments.
- A strong interest in lifestyle, culture and brand storytelling, with an instinct for creating experiences that resonate with audiences and reflect brand identity.


What we offer

- A front-row role in shaping how a beloved jewellery brand comes to life through memorable experiences, partnerships and cultural moments.
- Opportunities to build expertise in experiential marketing, retail activations and brand storytelling
- A dynamic in-house marketing environment where creative ideas, strong partnerships and flawless execution come together to drive brand impact.
- A collaborative marketing environment where events, campaigns and retail experiences come together to drive brand growth

- Data-driven marketer, proficient in marketing automation (e.g., Marketo) and CRM (Salesforce) platforms, with experience in objective-driven reporting, analytics, and leveraging AI tools to optimize marketing performance and streamline project management.
- Strong cultural awareness and experience marketing across the diverse SEA regions.

Marketing at AVEVA

At AVEVA Marketing, you’ll be part of a diverse global group of creative, strategic and digitally savvy thinkers and builders. Through integrated reputation, demand, engagement and enablement programs, we are at the very heart of advancing AVEVA’s mission to spark industrial ingenuity and drive responsible use of the world’s resources.

title: Director, Field Marketing
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role

Aspen Technology (AspenTech®), now part of Emerson, is a global leader in industrial software, delivering AI-powered solutions that optimize the entire asset lifecycle—from design and operations to maintenance. Our technology helps the world's leading organizations in energy, chemicals, utilities, mining, engineering and construction and other asset-intensive industries improve operational performance, accelerate digital transformation and achieve their sustainability goals.

We're looking for an experienced, strategic and results-driven Director of Field Marketing, APAC to lead regional marketing across one of our fastest-growing markets. Based in Singapore, you'll shape and execute the marketing strategy for Southeast Asia, India, Korea, Japan, China, Australia and New Zealand, leading a high-performing team focused on accelerating pipeline, revenue growth, customer expansion and new logo acquisition.

This is a highly visible leadership role that sits at the intersection of sales, corporate marketing, product marketing and regional leadership. You'll bring global strategy to life through locally relevant programs while serving as the trusted marketing partner for the APAC business.

Your Impact

Lead Regional Growth Strategy



- Develop and execute an integrated APAC field marketing strategy aligned to regional business priorities and global marketing objectives.
- Drive measurable pipeline and revenue growth through targeted campaigns, events, account-based initiatives, digital programs and demand generation activities.
- Identify market opportunities, customer trends and competitive insights to inform regional marketing investments.

Inspire and Develop a High-Performing Team



- Lead, mentor and empower a high-performing team of regional field marketers.
- Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement.
- Build scalable processes and best practices that improve marketing effectiveness across the region.

Partner Closely with Sales and Business Leaders



- Serve as the primary marketing partner to regional sales leadership, ensuring strong alignment on priorities, campaigns, pipeline targets and execution.
- Translate corporate marketing strategies into localized programs that reflect regional market dynamics and customer needs.
- Influence go-to-market planning through data-driven insights and market expertise.

Deliver Exceptional Customer Engagement



- Oversee the planning and execution of regional events, executive programs, webinars, trade shows and customer experiences that strengthen relationships and generate demand.
- Collaborate with product marketing, technical teams and corporate marketing to deliver compelling messaging and content tailored to regional audiences.
- Expand market reach through strategic partnerships with industry associations, academia, technology partners and regional influencers.

Drive Operational Excellence



- Manage regional marketing budgets with a focus on ROI, performance measurement and continuous optimization.
- Establish clear KPIs and leverage analytics to evaluate campaign effectiveness and inform future investment decisions.
- Select and manage external agencies, vendors and partners to ensure high-quality, cost-effective execution.

Support Global Initiatives



- Partner with the Corporate Events team to deliver successful APAC participation in global events, including AspenTech's User Conference and Sales Meetings.
- Travel throughout the region (approximately 30%) to support customers, field teams, and strategic events, with one to two trips annually to the United States.

This role reports to the Vice President, Marketing Programs, based in the United States.

What You'll Need



- Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of B2B technology marketing experience across the Asia-Pacific region.
- Proven success developing and executing integrated field marketing strategies that generate measurable pipeline and revenue growth.
- Demonstrated ability to partner with executive leadership, sales, product management and corporate marketing to influence go-to-market strategy and business outcomes.
- Experience leading geographically dispersed teams across diverse markets and cultures.
- Strong understanding of regional business practices and the ability to balance global consistency with local market relevance.
- Expertise across demand generation, digital marketing, events, account-based marketing, sales enablement and campaign management.
- Hands-on experience with modern marketing technologies, including Salesforce, Eloqua, LinkedIn, ZoomInfo and AI-powered marketing tools.
- Strong analytical skills with experience using marketing performance data to optimize strategy and investment.
- Proven ability to manage budgets, multiple priorities and complex cross-functional initiatives.
- Excellent communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills.
- Experience marketing enterprise software or other technical B2B solutions is strongly preferred.
- Fluency in written and spoken English is required; Mandarin language skills are a plus.

Why Join AspenTech?

This is an opportunity to shape the growth strategy for a diverse and rapidly evolving region while leading a talented marketing team with significant business impact. You'll work alongside global leaders, collaborate across functions and help some of the world's largest industrial organizations solve complex challenges through cutting-edge software and AI innovation.

If you're a strategic marketing leader who thrives on driving growth, building high-performing teams and delivering measurable business results, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Head of APJ Field Marketing
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About The Role

As the Head Field Marketing, APJ , you are the chief marketing architect of our go-to-market engine across the Enterprise and Strategic teams. You will lead a high-performing team of Field Marketing Managers to design, execute, and optimize regional marketing strategies that drive pipeline and revenue.

We are looking for a player-coach who is as comfortable interpreting a dashboard as they are commanding a room during a QBR. If you think business-first, are outcome-obsessed and thrive in high-growth, fast-paced environments, we want to talk.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Leadership & Revenue Growth



- Architect the Theater Strategy: Develop comprehensive marketing plans across regions, segments, and industries to both land and expand in the largest enterprise accounts.
- Deliver theatre growth plans: Build differentiated strategies, scalable programs, and world class events across buying personas and industries, delivering at-scale and account-based tactics. You also won’t be afraid to jump in and execute alongside your team!
- Galvanize Sales Partnerships: Act as a trusted strategic advisor to Sales and Inside Sales Leadership through compelling executive presentations, insights-driven recommendations, and business reviews.
- Outcome Optimization: Track lead flow from initial touchpoint to closed-won revenue. Partner with Sales Ops to refine conversion metrics and maximize ROI.

Team Orchestration & Development



- Lead a Remote Fleet: Manage and mentor a geographically dispersed team. You’ll be responsible for hiring, onboarding, and fostering a culture of high performance and continuous learning.
- Drive cultural excellence: Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, data-driven decision-making, and collaborative execution across geographically distributed teams.
- Develop future leaders: Own talent strategy including succession planning, career pathing, and leadership development to build bench strength for sustained growth.
- Cross-Functional Advocacy: Serve as the "voice of the theater" back to Corporate Marketing to ensure regional needs are met and global initiatives are successfully localized.

Analytics, Insights & Business Acumen



- Establish executive-level reporting: Build comprehensive dashboards and KPI frameworks that track pipeline, program ROI, and business impact.
- Drive data-informed strategy: Leverage analytics to identify growth opportunities, optimize resource allocation, measure program effectiveness, and demonstrate marketing's contribution to revenue.
- Continuously optimize: Develop feedback loops and refinement processes that improve investment efficiency and program performance.
- Budget Ownership: Manage the APAC roll-up budget, ensuring every dollar is allocated toward high-impact activities.

You may be a fit if



- Proven people leader: 10+ years of progressive leadership experience with a track record of building, scaling, and inspiring high-performing marketing teams
- Coaching excellence: Demonstrated ability to develop talent, drive career growth, and create environments where top performers thrive
- Change management prowess: Ability to lead organizational transformation, drive adoption of new processes, and navigate ambiguity in fast-paced, high-growth environments
- The Data Storyteller: You don't just report numbers; you provide insights. You are fluent in the metrics that drive the business
- The Communicator: Exceptional presentation skills. You can build trust with C-suite executives and external partners alike

Technical & Tactical Toolkit

Ability to travel as needed to support theater events and team meetings.

title: Field Marketing Specialist  - Asia
description:
At Jensen Hughes, we help create safe, secure and resilient communities around the world. As a global leader in fire engineering, safety, security and risk-based consulting, our work makes a real difference to the people and places around us.

We are looking for a Field Marketing Specialist to support our growing business across Asia (Korea, Greater China, Singapore and Malaysia). The purpose of this role is to support marketing activities across Asia, working closely with regional leaders, business development teams and technical experts. The successful candidate will help plan and deliver integrated marketing campaigns and initiatives that strengthen brand awareness, support client engagement and contribute to business growth. This is an opportunity to influence how one of the world's leading consulting firms connects with clients, builds its brand and drives business growth across diverse and rapidly evolving markets, including Korea, Greater China, Singapore and Malaysia.

You will join a collaborative global marketing team where ideas are encouraged, innovation is valued and success is shared. If you enjoy balancing strategy with execution, thrive in a fast-paced professional environment and love bringing great stories to life, we would love to hear from you. Working with the global marketing team, you will manage a range of activities including content development, events, digital marketing initiatives such as social media, webinars, and email campaigns.

In this role you will



- Deliver marketing end to end marketing campaigns across Korea, Greater China, Singapore and Malaysia.
- Work closely with regional leaders and technical experts to develop and execute marketing activities that support business growth.
- Be part of a highly collaborative global marketing team that values creativity, initiative and continuous learning.
- Work for a respected international organisation with outstanding career development opportunities.
- This role can be based in Seoul, Singapore, Malaysia, Auckland, Sydney, Brisbane or Melbourne.

If you're looking for a role where your ideas are valued, your work has a visible impact, and your career can continue to grow on an international stage, we would love to welcome you to Jensen Hughes.

Essential functions and duties:



- Collaborate with subject matter experts, regional leaders, and business development specialists to identify and prioritise regional marketing needs and translate them into action plans.
- Support global marketing team colleagues on projects that cross regions and service lines, contributing to a collaborative and team orientated marketing function.
- Plan, coordinate and deliver end to end marketing campaigns and activities that support regional and service line priorities. Tactics may include thought leadership initiatives articles, blogs, webinars, podcasts, case studies, social media, email, speaking opportunities, events/conferences support.
- Adapt marketing plans to regional and cultural differences while fostering open, collaborative communication and diverse perspectives.
- Collaborate with graphic designers, digital marketing managers and internal communications colleagues to develop materials and tools that support service line and regional efforts.
- Contribute to the development and implementation of regional marketing plans and campaign activity.
- Use marketing data to identify opportunities and provide recommendations to improve campaign performance.

Requirements And Qualifications



- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or a related field of study is preferred.
- 6+ years’ experience in B2B marketing, preferably within the architecture, engineering and construction (AEC) sector or a related professional services consulting environment.
- Professional working proficiency in Korean, English, and Mandarin, with the ability to create content and collaborate effectively across global regions. Full professional or native-level fluency is highly preferred.
- Technical writing, marketing copywriting experience (experience with AP writing style preferred).
- Demonstrated experience with creating and managing content for social media platforms, including writing social media posts for business specific to the Asian market (WeChat, Webo, Naver, Remember, LinkedIn, YouTube ).
- Demonstrated experience managing a diverse set of marketing tasks such as digital campaigns (organic and paid), thought leadership (blogs, webinars, podcasts, case studies, whitepapers), email, speaking opportunities, and events/conferences support.
- Ability to identify opportunities to improve marketing outcomes and campaign performance.
- Exceptional attention to detail, quality control review, copywriting, grammatical and proofreading skills.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver projects to deadline.
- Ability to be client focused, both internal and external, work in a fast paced environment, prioritise a high workload and meet tight timelines.
- Strong understanding of brand elements and guidelines.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office/365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Copilot) and virtual meeting platforms (MS Teams).
- Experience with Adobe InDesign, Adobe Express, Email Marketing Platforms and Digital Asset Management Tools (Brandfolder).
- Understanding of SEO best practices and marketing success metrics is a plus.
- Experience with CRM systems (Dynamics) is a plus.
- Occasional flexibility to work extended hours to accommodate deliverables and time zones may be required.

Company Overview

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.

Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.

At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization.

Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.

Jensen Hughes is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

At Jensen Hughes, we embrace innovation and understand that people are increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) tools like ChatGPT and other generative platforms to learn, prepare and communicate. We have provided some guidelines regarding the responsible use of AI in the recruitment process. Please click here to review.

The security of your personal data is important to us. Jensen Hughes has implemented reasonable physical, technical, and administrative security standards to protect personal data from loss, misuse, alteration, or destruction. We protect your personal data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, using security technologies and procedures, such as encryption and limited access. Only authorized individuals may access your personal data for the purpose for which it was collected, and these individuals receive training about the importance of protecting personal data. Jensen Hughes is committed to compliance with all relevant data privacy laws in all areas where we do business, including, but not limited to, the GDPR and the CCPA. Additionally, our service providers are contractually bound to maintain the confidentiality of personal data and may not use the information for any unauthorized purpose.



- Policy on use of 3rd party recruiting agency for direct placements

Jensen Hughes will occasionally augment a recruiting search through agencies for certain positions when business conditions warrant. Jensen Hughes will not accept resumes, inquiries or proposals from recruiting agencies as an acceptable method to consider a candidate. 3rd party recruiting agencies must sign a standard Jensen Hughes agreement after being evaluated and accepted by a Human Resources or Talent Acquisition manager, or member of the talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and employees of Jensen Hughes are not authorized to accept resumes, engage in fee-based searches through recruiting firms or sign a search agreement. Please note this policy does not apply to “staffing firms” or firms that are involved with hiring temporary staff. Any recruiting agency interested in being considered may contact our recruiting team at jensenhughesrecruiting.com.
