title: Director of Field Marketing - Asia Pacific / Middle East (R5943)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn , X , Instagram , and YouTube .

Shield AI is expanding rapidly across global defense markets, working with governments, militaries, defense organizations, and strategic partners to deliver next-generation autonomous capabilities. As we scale internationally, we are building a world-class go-to-market organization capable of engaging customers and partners across some of the most strategically important defense markets in the world.

The Director of Field Marketing, Asia Pacific / Middle East will lead and scale Shield AI’s largest regional field marketing organization, spanning the Middle East, India, and Asia Pacific. Based in Singapore and reporting to the VP, Global Field Marketing Units, this leader will develop the strategy, team, programs, and operating discipline required to support Shield AI’s growth across a diverse and rapidly evolving set of aerospace and defense markets.

This role will partner closely with Sales, Business Development, Capture, Growth, Product Marketing, and executive leadership to translate regional business priorities into high-impact field marketing programs that strengthen strategic relationships, accelerate opportunities, support capture efforts, and generate measurable pipeline impact.

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of international defense and aerospace markets and is comfortable navigating complex government, military, acquisition, and industry stakeholder environments. This is a player-coach role for a strategic leader who can build and lead a high-performing regional team while remaining hands-on in the development and execution of critical programs.

The role requires significant international travel, approximately 25-50% of the time, across the Middle East, India, and Asia Pacific.

What You'll Do



- Lead and scale Field Marketing across the Middle East, India, and Asia Pacific, establishing a unified regional strategy aligned with Shield AI’s global Go-to-Market priorities.
- Lead the company’s largest regional field marketing team, developing organizational structure, talent, processes, and operating rhythms that enable the team to scale effectively across multiple markets.
- Build and institutionalize field marketing as a disciplined, revenue-aligned function within a fast-growing aerospace and defense organization.
- Develop and execute account-based marketing strategies for priority government, military, defense, aerospace, and strategic industry accounts, mapping stakeholders and orchestrating multi-touch engagement across events, executive briefings, targeted campaigns, and other high-value experiences.
- Develop a deep understanding of the defense and aerospace ecosystems across the Middle East, India, Japan, Korea, Australia, Southeast Asia, and other priority APAC markets, including key military, government, acquisition, industry, and technology stakeholders.
- Partner with Sales, Business Development, and Capture teams to identify strategic accounts and opportunities and develop marketing programs that support relationship development, pipeline creation, opportunity progression, and capture objectives.
- Own strategy and execution for major aerospace and defense events across the region, prioritizing strategic account engagement, executive meetings, customer relationships, and opportunity acceleration over brand presence alone.
- Create and execute high-impact ABM programs, executive engagements, customer experiences, roundtables, and regional campaigns designed to generate new pipeline and accelerate existing opportunities.
- Develop regional marketing strategies that account for differences in defense procurement processes, government structures, military organizations, acquisition timelines, budgets, and business cultures across individual markets.
- Build strong relationships with regional Sales, Business Development, Capture, and Growth leaders to ensure field marketing investments are directly connected to business priorities and revenue opportunities.
- Establish KPIs that reflect international defense sales realities, including strategic account penetration, stakeholder engagement depth, executive engagement, opportunity creation, pipeline contribution, and deal acceleration.
- Lead regional agencies, vendors, event partners, and other external resources, ensuring high-quality execution and disciplined management of marketing investments.
- Bring creativity, structure, cultural awareness, and adaptability to a rapidly evolving environment where new markets, capabilities, and customer opportunities are developing in real time.
- Represent Shield AI and Field Marketing with senior internal and external stakeholders, demonstrating the credibility, judgment, and executive presence required to operate in complex aerospace and defense environments.

Required Qualifications:



- 10 to 15+ years of experience in field marketing, demand generation, integrated marketing, or related marketing leadership roles.
- Demonstrated experience marketing into international government, military, aerospace, defense, or other highly complex B2G environments.
- Strong understanding of aerospace and defense markets across the Middle East and/or Asia Pacific, with the ability to operate effectively across multiple countries and cultures.

title: Marketing Director
description:
Job Overview
WU XING ACADEMY is seeking an experienced and commercially driven Marketing Director to lead the academy's brand development, student recruitment, marketing strategy and channel partnerships.
WU XING ACADEMY focuses on the education and study of traditional Chinese culture and Taoist-related knowledge, providing structured courses, workshops and learning programmes for adult learners.
The Marketing Director will be responsible for building the academy's market presence, developing effective student acquisition channels, establishing partnerships with external organisations and creating marketing strategies that support sustainable enrolment growth.
This position requires a strong understanding of branding, digital marketing, partnership development and education marketing, together with the ability to communicate traditional cultural subjects in a professional and accessible manner.
Key Responsibilities
Brand Strategy & Development

- Develop and implement the overall brand and marketing strategy for WU XING ACADEMY.
- Establish a distinctive and professional brand positioning for the academy.
- Develop consistent brand messaging across websites, social media, advertising, events and offline marketing materials.
- Promote the academy's educational philosophy, instructors, curriculum and cultural heritage.
- Develop marketing initiatives that make traditional Chinese cultural education accessible and relevant to modern learners.
- Monitor market trends and identify opportunities to strengthen the academy's brand presence in Singapore and overseas markets.
Student Recruitment & Enrolment Growth

- Develop student acquisition strategies for courses, workshops, seminars and other educational programmes.
- Build effective marketing funnels from initial awareness and enquiry through to course registration.
- Plan campaigns for introductory programmes, experience classes and advanced courses.
- Work closely with the admissions and customer service teams to improve enquiry-to-enrolment conversion.
- Analyse student profiles, enrolment patterns and customer feedback to improve recruitment strategies.
- Develop initiatives to encourage course progression, repeat enrolment and student referrals.
Channel & Partnership Development

- Identify, establish and manage student recruitment channels and strategic partnerships.
- Develop relationships with cultural organisations, education providers, community organisations, business associations and other relevant partners.
- Build referral partnerships with individuals and organisations that can introduce suitable prospective students.
- Develop cooperation models with overseas education and cultural organisations.
- Negotiate partnership arrangements and establish commercially sustainable student recruitment channels.
- Maintain long-term relationships with key recruitment and business partners.
- Monitor the performance and quality of different student acquisition channels.
Digital Marketing

- Develop and oversee digital marketing strategies across Google, social media, content platforms and other relevant channels.
- Lead SEO and content marketing initiatives to increase the academy's online visibility.
- Plan and manage paid advertising campaigns for courses and events.
- Develop landing pages and online enquiry funnels to generate qualified student leads.
- Monitor campaign performance, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs and marketing ROI.
- Continuously optimise digital marketing activities based on performance data.
Content & Social Media

- Develop an integrated content strategy covering traditional Chinese culture, educational topics, academy activities, instructors and courses.
- Manage the academy's social media presence and content calendar.
- Oversee the production of articles, short-form videos, course introductions, interviews and promotional materials.
- Ensure that cultural and educational content is communicated accurately, professionally and respectfully.
- Develop multilingual or international marketing content where required to reach different target markets.
Events & Community Engagement

- Plan and promote cultural seminars, workshops, public lectures, experience classes and academy events.
- Develop events as both brand-building and student acquisition opportunities.
- Identify suitable exhibitions, cultural events and community activities for academy participation.
- Build relationships with relevant cultural and educational communities.
- Coordinate with instructors and operations teams to ensure successful delivery and promotion of events.
Marketing Team & Performance Management

- Build, manage and develop the academy's marketing function.
- Establish clear marketing and student acquisition KPIs.
- Manage external agencies, designers, content creators, media partners and other vendors where required.
- Prepare and manage marketing budgets.
- Track marketing expenditure and evaluate return on investment.
- Prepare regular reports on brand development, lead generation, enrolment and channel performance for management.
Requirements

- Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Management or a related discipline is preferred.
- Relevant experience in marketing, business development, brand management, education or student recruitment.
- Experience in a marketing leadership or management position is preferred.
- Strong experience in developing partnerships, referral networks or student recruitment channels.
- Good understanding of digital marketing, social media, SEO, content marketing and lead generation.
- Strong commercial awareness and ability to translate marketing activities into measurable enrolment growth.
- Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship management skills.
- Ability to communicate effectively with students, instructors, partners and external organisations.
- Interest in traditional Chinese culture, Taoist studies or related cultural subjects will be an advantage.
- Experience in education, cultural organisations, training institutions or adult learning will be an advantage.
- Ability to work independently and lead multiple marketing and partnership initiatives simultaneously.
Key Performance Indicators
Performance may be measured based on:

- Qualified student enquiries generated
- New student enrolments
- Enquiry-to-enrolment conversion rate
- Development of new student recruitment channels
- Number and quality of strategic partnerships
- Revenue generated through partnership and referral channels
- Customer acquisition cost and marketing ROI
- Website and organic search growth
- Digital campaign performance
- Brand awareness and social media growth
- Course progression and repeat enrolment
- Performance of cultural events, workshops and experience classes
What We Offer

- Senior marketing leadership role within a growing cultural education organisation.
- Opportunity to develop the WU XING ACADEMY brand in Singapore and international markets.
- Opportunity to build student recruitment and strategic partnership networks from an early stage.
- Exposure to traditional Chinese cultural education and adult learning programmes.
- Opportunity to develop innovative ways of presenting traditional knowledge to modern audiences.
- Performance-driven career development opportunities.
WU XING ACADEMY welcomes experienced marketing professionals who combine strong commercial capabilities with an appreciation for education, culture and long-term brand development.

title: Marketing & Communications Director

Sponsorship revenue and renewal rates.

Event registrations, attendance and participant satisfaction.

Conversion of marketing enquiries into memberships, sponsorships and programme participation.

title: Senior APAC Marketing Manager
categories: IT System Data Services, IT System Design Services, and Technology, Information and Media
description:
About the Company
GMI Cloud is a fast-growing, AI-native infrastructure company delivering high-performance GPU compute, inference services, and infrastructure for AI agents.


From large-scale compute to optimized inference and agentic workloads, GMI Cloud gives AI teams the infrastructure they need to build, deploy, and scale on one unified cloud.


One cloud for compute, inference, and agents.


About the Role
GMI Cloud is looking for a Senior APAC Marketing Manager to lead marketing strategy and execution across the region (excluding mainland China). APAC isn't one market — Singapore, Taiwan, Malaysia, Thailand, and other sub-markets each have distinct channel ecosystems, buyer journeys, and content preferences. This role isn't about running one playbook everywhere; it's about designing a set of differentiated but coordinated approaches that reinforce each other.


What You'll Do
1. Regional Market Strategy & Approach

- Design differentiated, market-specific playbooks across GMI's APAC footprint (Singapore, Taiwan, Malaysia, Thailand, and other priority markets) — channel priority, content tone, and campaign cadence should reflect each market, not a single template
- Continuously evaluate and refine channel strategy across mainstream regional platforms (e.g., LinkedIn, local trade media, regional tech publications) to keep investment aligned with actual conversion by market
- Rationalize the events calendar, consolidating budget and team bandwidth around high-value moments (e.g., major AI/tech conferences, regional trade shows) rather than spreading thin across low-yield events
- Build out enterprise GTM content and event strategy for priority markets across Southeast Asia (e.g., AgentBox and Prime Inference-focused enterprise events and webinars), and assess where that model can extend further
2. Brand Narrative, Content & Product-Led Growth

- Translate GMI's core brand narrative (five-pillar content strategy, Inference/Compute weighting) into content that fits each market's context — genuine localization, not direct translation
- Bring a product-led growth lens to brand execution — design and run public product launches that use the product itself as the primary growth and conversion mechanism, not just an announcement wrapped in marketing
- Use product launches as a wedge into specific industry verticals — mapping launch messaging, positioning, and follow-through content to the verticals most likely to convert
- Coordinate regional adaptation of social, web, and event content, keeping the global narrative framework consistent without feeling forced
- Build a content calendar and cadence that maps market activity, product launches, and industry events into one unified schedule


How We'll Measure This Role

- Channel performance by market — lead and pipeline generation across LinkedIn, regional trade media, and event channels in each priority market
- Product launch impact — activation and conversion driven directly through launch mechanics, and vertical-specific pickup following a launch
- Content cadence and consistency — steady output aligned with the brand narrative framework
- Event ROI — whether consolidated investment in core events produces measurable pipeline or brand impact
- Cross-functional alignment — how well marketing execution tracks with product launches, partnership timing, and sales targets


What We're Looking For

- 10+ years of marketing experience, including hands-on ownership across multiple APAC sub-markets (Singapore, Taiwan, Southeast Asia, or similar)
- A track record spanning multiple marketing functions — brand, content, demand gen, product marketing — rather than depth in a single lane
- Direct experience with product-led growth: running public product launches where the product itself drives adoption and conversion, and translating launch momentum into vertical-specific pipeline
- Experience designing regional market strategy from scratch, not just executing an existing plan
- Familiarity with mainstream regional channels — LinkedIn, local trade press, industry events, regional tech media — and the ability to design channel and content strategy accordingly by market
- Proven experience localizing brand narrative into region-specific content — understanding the balance between global consistency and local relevance
- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, able to align with Product, Sales, and Partnerships on priorities
- Fluent in English, with additional regional language ability (Mandarin or Southeast Asian languages) a plus
- Working understanding of, or strong interest in, AI infrastructure, GPU cloud computing, or inference services


Bonus Points

- B2B SaaS or cloud/AI infrastructure marketing experience
- Experience marketing into Southeast Asian tech ecosystems (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam)
- Experience organizing large industry trade shows or regional AI conferences
- Experience managing content teams or working alongside Developer Advocate / community functions

title: (Senior) Marketing Director
description:
Position Overview
The (Senior) Marketing Director will lead the overall marketing and commercial strategy across all business segments in the Asia Pacific (APAC) region, with responsibility for driving market development, revenue growth, margin improvement, channel effectiveness and commercial performance.


The role will provide strategic leadership across market strategy, pricing, dealer and channel management, promotions, market intelligence and commercial analytics. The Senior Marketing Director will work closely with Sales, Product, Finance, Engineering, Service, regional management and HQ to translate market insights into actionable business strategies and ensure effective execution across APAC.


The role will also be responsible for providing senior management with comprehensive analysis of market size, market share, revenue, margin, pricing, channel performance and other key commercial indicators across all business segments.


Key Responsibilities
1. APAC Marketing Strategy and Regional Leadership

- Lead the development and execution of the overall marketing strategy and marketing activities across all business segments in the APAC region.
- Develop regional marketing strategies, annual plans, priorities and initiatives aligned with business objectives and growth targets.
- Identify market development opportunities, target markets, customer segments and growth areas across APAC.
- Drive the development of segment-specific marketing strategies based on market dynamics, customer requirements, competitive landscape and business priorities.
- Ensure effective alignment between regional marketing strategy, sales strategy, product strategy and overall business objectives.
- Provide strategic market and commercial recommendations to senior management and HQ.
- Monitor the effectiveness of regional marketing activities and adjust strategies based on market performance and business results.


2. Pricing, Dealer and Channel Management

- Take the lead in developing and managing regional pricing strategies across all relevant business segments and markets.
- Analyse market pricing, competitor pricing, product positioning, customer requirements and profitability to support pricing decisions.
- Work closely with Sales, Product, Finance and HQ to establish pricing strategies that balance market competitiveness, revenue growth and margin objectives.
- Lead the development and optimisation of dealer and distribution channel strategies across APAC.
- Establish channel management principles, dealer segmentation, channel coverage, performance monitoring and development plans.
- Evaluate dealer and channel performance and identify opportunities to improve market coverage, sales effectiveness and profitability.
- Develop strategies for dealer appointment, development, performance improvement and channel expansion in collaboration with regional teams.
- Lead the development and execution of regional promotional strategies and programmes, including pricing campaigns, sales promotions, product promotions and market activation initiatives.
- Ensure pricing, dealer/channel strategy and promotional activities are aligned with overall regional business objectives.


3. Market Size, Market Share and Commercial Analytics

- Lead the development of comprehensive market intelligence and commercial analytics across all APAC markets and business segments.
- Establish and maintain analysis of market size, market growth, market share, competitor performance, customer segments, product segments and industry trends.
- Monitor market share performance by country, segment, product and customer category.
- Identify changes in market dynamics, competitor positioning, customer demand and industry trends and translate them into actionable business recommendations.
- Develop market sizing and forecasting models to support business planning, market entry, product planning and resource allocation.
- Analyse sales performance against total addressable market, available market and competitive performance.
- Establish regular dashboards and management reports covering key market and commercial indicators.
- Provide data-driven insights to support strategic decision-making by regional management and HQ.


4. Revenue and Margin Management

- Lead the preparation and analysis of revenue and margin performance across all business segments in APAC.
- Work closely with HQ, Finance, Sales and regional teams to ensure accurate and timely revenue and margin reporting.
- Monitor revenue, gross margin, product mix, pricing, volume and other key commercial performance indicators by country, segment, product and channel.
- Identify key drivers of revenue and margin performance and highlight significant variances against budget, forecast and previous periods.
- Provide management with regular analysis and recommendations to improve revenue quality, profitability and commercial performance.
- Support annual budgeting, business planning, forecasting and strategic target-setting processes through market and commercial analysis.
- Develop standardised regional reporting frameworks to improve visibility and consistency of commercial performance across APAC.
- Work closely with HQ to align regional reporting definitions, methodologies, targets and performance indicators.


5. Sales and Business Development Support

- Act as a strategic business partner to regional Sales and Business Development teams.
- Translate market, customer, pricing, channel and competitive insights into actionable sales and business development strategies.
- Support key account development, new market entry, product launches and strategic business opportunities.
- Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition, market penetration, product mix and channel effectiveness.
- Provide Sales teams with relevant market intelligence, competitor analysis, pricing insights and commercial recommendations.
- Facilitate close collaboration between Marketing, Sales, Product, Finance, Engineering and Service functions.


6. Product and Market Development

- Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to align product strategies with APAC market requirements.
- Provide market and customer insights to support product planning, product positioning, portfolio optimisation and new product development.
- Identify product gaps and market opportunities across different countries and business segments.
- Support product launches and market introduction strategies across APAC.
- Monitor product performance, competitive positioning, customer acceptance and market development following product launches.


7. Regional Promotion and Marketing Activities

- Lead the development and implementation of regional marketing and promotional programmes across APAC.
- Oversee exhibitions, industry events, customer engagement activities, product launches, digital marketing and other market activation initiatives.
- Develop marketing materials and commercial content to support regional sales and business development activities.
- Ensure marketing activities are focused on measurable business outcomes, including market development, lead generation, customer engagement and sales support.
- Track and evaluate the effectiveness and commercial impact of marketing activities.


8. HQ and Regional Coordination

- Serve as the key regional marketing and commercial interface between APAC markets and HQ.
- Work closely with HQ on revenue, margin, pricing, market size, market share, sales performance and other commercial reporting.
- Ensure timely and accurate submission of regional market and commercial information to HQ.
- Align regional strategies, reporting standards, business targets and performance indicators with HQ requirements.
- Consolidate and communicate market intelligence and commercial insights from individual APAC markets to HQ and senior management.
- Drive regional initiatives and ensure effective implementation across countries and business segments.


9. Team and Stakeholder Leadership

- Lead and develop the regional marketing function, including manpower planning organisational structure, capabilities and performance management.
- Provide strategic direction and guidance to marketing and commercial team members across the region.
- Build capabilities in market intelligence, commercial analytics, pricing, channel management, product marketing and market development.
- Lead relationships with dealers, distributors, external agencies, consultants, event organisers and other strategic partners where applicable.
- Foster strong collaboration across Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering, Service, HQ and country teams.


Job Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, Finance or a related discipline. A Master’s degree or MBA is an advantage.
- Minimum 10 years of relevant experience, with substantial experience in a senior marketing, commercial, business development or regional management role.
- Strong experience in B2B, industrial, automotive, power generation, construction machinery, commercial vehicles, engines or other technical industries is highly preferred.
- Proven experience managing regional marketing strategies across multiple APAC markets and business segments.
- Strong understanding and practical experience in pricing strategy, dealer management, channel management, market development and promotional strategy.
- Strong analytical capabilities, with demonstrated experience in market sizing, market share analysis, forecasting, commercial analytics, revenue analysis and margin analysis.
- Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to understand and analyse revenue, gross margin, pricing, product mix, volume and profitability.
- Experience working with HQ or regional headquarters on business planning, reporting, performance management and commercial analysis.
- Strong understanding of APAC markets, including different market structures, customer behaviours, competitive environments and distribution models.
- Proven leadership experience in managing teams and cross-functional stakeholders across multiple countries.
- Excellent strategic thinking, analytical, communication, presentation, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with BI, CRM, market intelligence or data analytics platforms is an advantage.
- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced regional environment and manage multiple markets and business priorities.
- English proficiency is required; Mandarin is an advantage for communication with HQ and Chinese-speaking stakeholders.
- Willingness to travel extensively within the APAC region as required.

title: Regional Marketing Manager
description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

title: Regional Marketing Manager, APAC
description:
The Regional Marketing Manager, APAC is responsible for driving customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and advocacy across the APAC region. Through customer insights, analytics, digital marketing, content, and customer experience initiatives, this role supports business growth while enhancing the overall customer experience.

This role requires a strong combination of customer experience expertise, digital marketing capabilities, analytical skills, and re-gional stakeholder management. Working closely with local market teams, the successful candidate will understand diverse cus-tomer needs across APAC markets, identify customer experience gaps and opportunities, and lead initiatives that improve customer journeys, strengthen customer loyalty, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities



-  Customer Experience Strategy & Execution (Customer-Centric Mindset)
- CX Strategy & Customer Journeys: Lead the design, mapping, and improvement of end-to-end customer journeys across APAC to enhance customer satisfaction, loyalty, and overall experience. Ensure journeys reflect the needs of different cus-tomer segments, market conditions, and customer expectations across the region.
- CX Measurement & ROI: Establish and track key customer experience metrics, including Net Promoter Score (NPS), cus-tomer retention, engagement, and CX ROI, to measure programme effectiveness and business impact.
- Regional Initiative Management: Lead the implementation of regional and global customer experience initiatives across APAC, ensuring programmes are adapted to local customer needs, market conditions, and business priorities. Research market trends and best practices to continuously improve programme effectiveness and customer experience.
-  Customer Analytics, Feedback & Insights (Analytical & Growth Mindset)
- Customer Insights & Analytics: Manage customer analytics programmes, including NPS, customer feedback, competitor analysis, market sizing, complaints analysis, and CRM reporting to generate actionable insights and support business deci-sions.
- Customer Segmentation & Growth Insights: Analyse customer profiles, behaviours, and engagement trends across mar-kets to identify opportunities for customer acquisition, retention, and business growth.
- Complaint & Feedback Management: Review customer complaints and feedback, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to improve customer satisfaction and experience.
-  Brand, Content & Digital Engagement (Digital & Innovative Mindset)
- Customer Engagement & Digital Marketing: Develop and execute customer engagement programmes across digital channels, using marketing automation and digital tools to improve communication, engagement, retention, and customer experience.
- Content & Brand Development: Create and manage customer-focused content, thought leadership, customer communi-cations, campaigns, and digital assets to strengthen brand awareness, customer engagement, and loyalty.
- Events & Experience Programmes: Plan and deliver webinars, customer events, roundtables, and regional marketing programmes that support customer acquisition, engagement, retention, advocacy and overall customer experience.
-  Stakeholder Management & Regional Coordination (Resilient & Collaborative Mindset)
- Regional CX Leadership: Lead and coordinate customer experience programmes across APAC markets, ensuring con-sistent execution while balancing local customer needs and business priorities.
- Cross-Functional & Local Market Collaboration: Work closely with local teams and key stakeholders to identify cus-tomer experience gaps, align priorities, and implement improvement initiatives across the region.
- CX Governance & Reporting: Provide regular reporting and recommendations on NPS, customer retention, customer feedback, customer journey performance, key customer trends, and improvement opportunities to stakeholders.

Job Requirements



- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Finance, Data Analytics or a related field
- More than 7 years of proven experience in customer experience, marketing, analytics, customer engage-ment, or related roles, preferably within financial services, insurance, or B2B environments
- Proven experience managing regional programmes and working across multiple APAC markets within a matrix organisation
- Experience managing customer experience programmes, NPS initiatives, customer retention strategies, customer feedback programmes, and customer engagement initiatives
- Proficiency in Marketing Automation platforms (e.g. Marketo) and CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce), including customer en-gagement, reporting, and campaign tracking
- Knowledge of customer journey mapping, customer lifecycle management, customer segmentation, and customer en-gagement strategies
- Strong understanding of customer experience measurement, including NPS, customer retention, customer feedback, complaint management, and CX ROI
- Ability to manage digital content, customer communications, webinars, events, and multi-channel marketing campaigns
- Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Lookups, dashboards, data analysis, reporting, and trend identification
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and business recom-mendations
- Familiarity with reporting and visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms
- Excellent presentation, communication and stakeholder communication skills

Behavioral Traits



- Resilient & Results-Oriented: You are motivated by delivering meaningful business and customer outcomes. You remain driven through complex projects, multiple stakeholders, and changing business priorities while maintaining a strong focus on results.
- Entrepreneurial, Innovative & Proactive: You are a self-starter who takes ownership, identifies opportunities, explores new ideas, and continuously seeks better ways to improve customer experience, engagement, and business performance.
- Customer-Centric & Analytical: You are passionate about understanding customer needs and behaviours. You are comfortable working with data, customer insights, and feedback, translating them into practical recommendations that im-prove customer satisfaction, loyalty, retention, and business outcomes.

description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

About the role: Marketing Manager, APAC Operating Unit, Caltrate

This is an opportunity to help shape the next phase of growth for Caltrate across APAC markets.

Working across strategy, innovation, communications, and activation, you will help identify growth opportunities, shape innovation priorities, and define the brand and communication agenda that enables Caltrate to win across APAC markets outside China. You will partner with local markets to translate regional strategy into relevant portfolio choices, consumer propositions, claims, and content.

Partnering closely with cross-functional and market teams, you will bring together consumer insight, trusted science, and commercial thinking to strengthen Caltrate’s relevance, competitiveness, and sustainable growth across the region.

Role Responsibilities



- Drive APAC Growth Strategy & Innovation for Caltrate Outside China
- Identify emerging consumer needs, category shifts, and growth opportunities for total mobility across APAC markets.
- Serve as the regional business lead for non-China APAC markets, partnering with local teams on growth priorities, portfolio strategy, innovation, communications, and business performance.
- Define strategic priorities and innovation opportunities that strengthen Caltrate’s competitiveness and accelerate sustainable brand growth.
- Partner with cross-functional and market teams to translate consumer needs into relevant products, claims, formats, packs, and experiences.
- Lead innovation development from opportunity identification through business case, commercialization, launch, and scaling across priority markets.
- Build the APAC Communication & Activation Growth Model for Caltrate
- Define Caltrate’s communication and activation agenda across APAC markets outside China, aligned with regional growth priorities and local market needs.
- Develop compelling consumer propositions, claims, content territories, and communication toolkits that can be adapted by markets.
- Identify how Caltrate can drive growth through digital commerce, retail media, creators, healthcare professional influence, partnerships, and emerging commerce ecosystems.
- Build scalable activation frameworks, best practices, and capabilities that help markets improve execution quality and drive stronger consumer engagement.


Why This Role?



- Lead key growth, innovation, communications, and activation initiatives for Caltrate across APAC markets outside China.
- Shape regional strategy while partnering closely with local markets to enable relevant execution and business impact.
- Influence how one of Haleon’s leading mobility brands grows across the region.
- Build regional experience across brand strategy, innovation, communications, commercial activation, and market partnership.


Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most for this role



- 7+ years of experience in brand marketing, portfolio management, innovation, and/or commercial leadership, preferably in consumer health, nutrition, wellness, or OTC categories.
- Experience translating consumer, customer, and category insights into regional strategy, effective communications, and sustainable brand growth.
- Experience leading innovation pipelines, large-scale launches, and market adoption through cross-functional collaboration in a matrix organization.
- Strong commercial and financial acumen, including business case development, budget management, and performance tracking to drive profitable growth.
- Experience working across diverse APAC markets and adapting regional strategy into locally relevant activation plans is a plus.


Job Posting End Date

2026-10-03

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

Adjustment or Accommodations Request

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

Note to candidates

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Global Partner Marketing Lead
description:
About the company:
Founders today are building global companies from day one — but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!
We’re building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building.
Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment.
Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50,000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J.P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we’re building for the next generation of global companies.


About the Role:
You'll own Aspire's global partner marketing strategy and execution. This isn't a coordination role — you're the architect and the operator. You'll design the playbook, set the standards, and drive partner-sourced revenue and customer acquisition across all three business units, all geographies, and all partner categories: banking and fintech, ERPs and accounting platforms, VCs, channel partners, resellers, and ISVs.
Reporting to the VP of Partnerships, you'll set the global strategy and playbook that regional teams execute and localize. You'll work hand-in-hand with Field Marketing Managers in each market and Partnership Managers globally to ensure global consistency and local relevance both hold.
This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role. You're the strategist and the operator — comfortable setting the agenda and shipping campaigns. You'll drive outcomes through influence and partnership, not (initially) through headcount. It's ideal for someone who wants to build a function from blank page and isn't afraid to roll up your sleeves.


What You'll Own:
Global Partner Marketing Strategy & Playbook

- Define and own Aspire's partner marketing roadmap tied directly to partner-sourced revenue and new customer acquisition targets across Aspire BA, Aspire OS, and AspireX.
- Build the standard playbook: co-marketing program structures, MDF frameworks, partner enablement assets, campaign templates. Let regions localize, not reinvent.
- Prioritize investment across partner categories and markets based on revenue potential, partner engagement, and strategic fit for each business unit.


Partner-Sourced Pipeline & Revenue

- Identify and activate partner marketing opportunities with Partnership and Channel Managers globally. Turn relationships into active co-marketing pipeline.
- Own the global Marketing Development Fund (MDF) framework — allocation principles, governance, ROI tracking — that regional and in-market teams execute against.
- Track partner-sourced pipeline, revenue contribution, and new-logo acquisition. Use data to reallocate investment toward what works.


Co-Marketing Campaigns at Scale

- Design repeatable co-marketing campaign frameworks (joint content, webinars, events, social) that Field Marketing and partner teams can run in-market.
- Localize global messaging and positioning for partner-facing campaigns, market by market.
- Equip partners with ready-to-use assets, playbooks, and enablement materials so they can market Aspire effectively


Bridge Between Partnerships & Field Marketing

- Work closely with Field Marketing Managers in every market to align partner marketing execution with local go-to-market priorities.
- Be the central coordination point so partner initiatives are globally consistent but locally relevant. No reinventing the wheel. No one-size-fits-all that ignores reality on the ground.
- Represent partner marketing's needs and opportunities in Aspire's broader marketing and partnerships planning.


Measurement & Performance

- Establish shared metrics and reporting cadence for partner marketing performance — pipeline and revenue contribution, campaign output, MDF efficiency, partner activation.
- Share regular performance readouts with VP of Partnerships and BU stakeholders. Translate results into where to double down or pull back.


About You:
Must Have

- 8+ years in partner marketing, channel marketing, or field marketing spanning multiple partner types (channel partners, resellers, ISVs minimum).
- Proven track record designing and running co-marketing programs and/or MDF frameworks that drove measurable partner-sourced pipeline or revenue — not just brand awareness.
- Experience working globally or across multiple markets/regions, setting central strategy that local teams executed.
- Operate as both strategist and operator. Equally comfortable setting the agenda and shipping a campaign yourself.
- Strong stakeholder management across Partnerships, Sales, Field Marketing, and BU/Product Marketing leadership.


Nice to Have

- Background in fintech, SaaS, or financial services.
- Experience in fast-growing, multi-business-unit organizations spanning SME, mid-market, and enterprise.
- Familiarity with the full partner ecosystem in fintech — banks, ERPs/accounting platforms, VCs, channel resellers, ISVs.
- Built partner marketing measurement frameworks (partner-sourced pipeline attribution, MDF ROI dashboards).
- Fluency in Mandarin/Chinese — Aspire's partner ecosystem in China is growing.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
If you are a hands-on campaign strategist who loves translating big-picture priorities into well-executed, multi-channel campaigns, this role is for you.


As part of Elsevier's Research Marketing organization serving the Academic & Government (A&G) market, the Senior Manager for Global Campaigns owns the strategy and performance of campaigns for priority A&G business areas and portfolio initiatives. You will act as a primary liaison and partner for Audience and Field teams, turning briefs into clear, actionable plans and partnering with Field to support aligned global and local campaign activation. You will track campaign performance across awareness, sales, and renewal, surfacing insights that improve campaigns and GTM effectiveness. This is a role for a confident, collaborative operator who thrives in a cross-functional environment, ready to guide and support colleagues while driving end-to-end campaign delivery and performance.


RESPONSIBILITIES



- Own end-to-end campaign delivery for priority business areas and portfolio initiatives
- Act as primary liaison for Audience and Field teams, ensuring briefs are clear, aligned, and translated into actionable execution plans
- Drive campaign strategy and execution support for regional campaigns
- Coordinate cross-functionally across Content, Creative, and execution teams
- Lead campaign performance tracking, optimization, and insight sharing for priority business areas and portfolio initiatives
- Reports into Director of Global Campaigns


TYPICAL ACTIVITIES



- Lead or partner on the development of campaign strategies based on briefs from Audience and/or Field
- Integrate global priorities and regional needs into cohesive campaign approaches
- Manage campaign briefing, ensuring inputs are clear, aligned, and actionable
- Coordinate creative and asset development with Content and Creative teams
- Translate campaign strategy into localized execution with Field teams
- Lead end-to-end campaign delivery and optimization
- Share performance insights with Audience, Field, and Product teams
- Works with peers across Demand & Lifecycle Marketing to ensure cohesiveness and coordination across multiple campaigns in market


PROFILE & EXPERIENCE



- Strong experience in B2B campaign or demand generation marketing
- Proven ability to manage multi-channel campaign execution and optimization
- Strong stakeholder management across Audience, Field, and Marketing teams
- Confident cross-functional operator who can guide and support junior colleagues


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS


At Elsevier, campaigns are the engine that connects strategy to market impact. The Senior Manager for Global Campaigns plays a pivotal role in ensuring that Audience and Field priorities are translated into well-executed, high-performing campaigns that build awareness and engagement across the Academic & Government markets. This is a role where your ability to orchestrate across teams, manage complex briefs, and deliver at pace makes a real difference for the customers and researchers Elsevier serves.

title: Digital Marketing Assistant
description:
We are a TCM Group of Companies established in 2016 and have been faithfully serving our customers over the years. Adhering to our mission of providing exceptional and results oriented solutions complemented by our proprietary therapies and techniques developed over many years. We are currently expanding our islandwide clinical services in Singapore, we would like you to join us to be part of the expansion plans:
Key responsibilities
1. Basic execution of SEO: content, technical basics and backlinks

- Basic SEO knowledge is required.
- Write and publish SEO articles and treatment and location pages from keyword briefs, in English with Chinese variants where needed.
- Earn backlinks through partners, events, community collaborations and directories.
- Training is provided.
2. Experience with WordPress/Elementor

- Build and update campaign landing pages for promotions, pricing, outlet changes and seasonal campaigns.
- Website management experience in Wordpress will be advantageous.
3. Tracking and lead data checks

- Check appointment sheets and the flow of leads into the sheet.
- Keep lead sheets accurate and deduplicated and escalate tracking problems to the Marketing Manager.
4. Reporting

- Monthly: Produce an SEO and an SEM report on the brand that you will take charge of and report to Marketing Manager

What we're looking for

What you'll get

- Hands-on ownership of SEO for healthcare brands. Few entry-level roles offer this.
- Mentorship, SOPs and checklists for every core task.
- A clear path to SEO or Digital Marketing Executive, with a wider scope once targets are met.

title: Salesforce Campaign Strategist
categories: IT Services and IT Consulting and IT System Custom Software Development
description:
We are seeking a Salesforce Campaign Strategist who will be responsible for designing, planning, and optimizing data-driven marketing campaigns leveraging the Salesforce ecosystem. This role combines marketing strategy, customer insights, campaign automation, and performance analytics to drive lead generation, customer engagement, pipeline growth, and revenue outcomes. 
The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in marketing technology, customer journey mapping, and campaign optimization, with the ability to translate business goals into impactful multi-channel marketing strategies. 


Responsibilities

- Develop data-driven campaign strategies aligned with business and marketing objectives, focusing on customer acquisition, engagement, retention and conversion. 
- Define campaign approach and planning, including objectives, audience strategy, customer journeys, content, channels, measurement framework and KPIs. 
- Leverage customer and performance insights to recommend segmentation, targeting, personalisation and lifecycle engagement strategies. 
- Design and optimise customer journeys, nurture programmes and lifecycle initiatives to improve customer engagement and conversion. 
- Analyse campaign performance across markets, divisions, audiences and channels, identifying trends, opportunities and areas for improvement. Drive continuous optimisation through A/B testing, experimentation, attribution and performance analysis to improve campaign effectiveness and ROI. 
- Lead quarterly performance reviews, translating cross-campaign learnings and best practices into actionable recommendations and future optimisation priorities. 
- Collaborate with Campaign Managers, SFMC Architect and business stakeholders to ensure strategic recommendations are practical, technically feasible and incorporated into future campaign planning.


Profile

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Information Technology, Communications, or a related field.
- 4-8 years of experience in campaign strategy, CRM marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, or related functions.
- Strong experience in customer lifecycle management, lead generation, marketing automation, and B2B/B2C marketing strategies.
- Knowledge in Salesforce CRM, including Campaign Management, Reports, Dashboards, Analytics, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
- Knowledge of email marketing, digital marketing, marketing automation, and campaign optimization best practices.
- Proficient in data analysis, performance measurement, reporting tools, with the ability to translate insights into actionable recommendations.

title: Executive Director Marketing - APAC
location: Kallang, Central Singapore Community Development Council, Singapore
description:
Ingram Micro is the business behind the world’s brands, reaching nearly 90 percent of the world’s population. Our market reach, diverse solutions portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart. We have approximately 27,000 associates committed to serving our more than 161,000 customers and 1,500 vendor partners worldwide. Learn more at www.ingrammicro.com.

Come join our team where you’ll make technology happen in surprising ways. Let’s shape tomorrow - it’ll be a fun journey!

The Executive Director, Asia Pacific Marketing, will be responsible for leading our regional Marketing strategies, localizing platform Marketing and managing the P&L for the regional Marketing business in Asia Pacific, all to support the growth of Ingram Micro as the IT Industry’s most desired business partner. Our goal is to drive clear business outcomes with high-performing marketing plans, programs, manage regional marketing performance metrics, as well as use and develop selling skills for the company’s regional Marketing business. This role also serves as the regional strategic leader to localize and implement the global Marketing Playbook and digital marketing products developed to drive growth via Ingram Micro Xvantage, the company’s digital experience platform.

To do this, we strengthen Ingram Micro’s brand, modernize regional Marketing capabilities and automate our Marketing practices, and develop the talent within our Marketing organization.

This role will sit on our Asia Pacific and Marketing, Senior Leadership Team (SLT), reporting directly to the President of Asia Pacific and with a dotted line to the Senior Vice President, Global Marketing. Will be jointly responsible for Nine Countries Marketing KPI’s tied to the business results for each country, as well as the region’s Marketing P&L to grow and support business. You will also foster strong relationships with regional and local Vendor Representatives who rely on Ingram Micro to generate profitable growth. To do this, it will require collaboration and partnership with the nine countries’ key stakeholders, vendor partners, and customers to drive success in each of the independent markets.

Your role:



- Partner with country Managing Directors (MDs) and Country Chief Executives (CCEs) across the markets in APAC (Australia, New Zealand, India, China, and ASEAN/HK cluster) to shape and align marketing strategy, and direction with business objectives and go-to-market priorities with the global standardized Marketing Playbooks and strategies designed to acquire, engage and retain customers, as well as generate demand with end-user audiences on behalf of our customers. 
- Influence and collaborate with diverse, multi-country marketing teams with varying levels of maturity, cultural dynamics, and business needs—to drive consistency, capability uplift, and shared success. 
- Work closely with the regional Finance leaders to provide strategic oversight and guidance on marketing P&L performance across the cluster, enabling sustainable growth in vendor/partner marketing programs and year-on-year marketing income. 
- Build strong, trust-based relationships with vendors across the region; align with the global vendor programs, and other global and regionalized Marketing programs, as well as co-develop localized marketing strategies in partnership with country leadership teams. 
- Identify and communicate regional shared services opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and operational optimization across markets together with the global Marketing Centers of Excellence (COEs). 
- Act as a key marketing advisor within regional and country leadership forums, bringing strategic marketing insights and solutions to support business outcomes which reflect strong ROI measures as determined with country stakeholders and vendor partners, while also governing and managing compliance. 
- Guide the execution of country-level growth marketing strategies to deliver against global Marketing KPIs, including pipeline, incremental revenue lift, retention, upsell, and expansion targets. 
- Champion and strengthen Ingram Micro’s brand equity across markets by supporting countries in building a differentiated and impactful market presence. 
- Ensuring marketing operations excellence across the region through the adoption of standardized automation, global processes, systems and MarTech tools, as well as regulatory compliance. 
- Build regional marketing capability by fostering a strong network of in-country marketing professionals who can effectively support vendors, partners, and business stakeholders. 
- Act as a change agent—driving alignment, adoption, and effective implementation of digital and Marketing transformation initiatives together with key stakeholders across the region. 
- Support countries in collaboration with global PR and Social Media leaders to build strong external ecosystems, including media, key opinion leaders, and influencers, to enhance brand visibility and market influence. 

What you bring to the role:



- A strategic and engaging leader with a bachelor's degree in marketing or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience required
- 15+ years’ experience in distribution, Cloud or Software as a Services businesses, technology, product, or services industries with 10+ years in a senior leadership capacity and leading through subordinate managers. 
- Established network of industry relationships, influential contacts and reputation across the APAC region. 
- Extensive, relevant, and proven Channel Marketing and Corporate Marketing experience, with deep knowledge about Digital Marketing, Demand Generation, and experience with platform businesses or eCommerce
- Highly collaborative and proven commercial marketing experience specifically in strategy, digital marketing, marketing intelligence, content development and packaging. 
- Motivational leaders who is able to encourage, inspire and build team spirit among associates, bring about mutual respect and cooperation and work effectively within a matrix organizational structure. 
- Financial and analytical mindset to drive profitable Marketing P&L and comfortable partnering with data analytical teams to measure Marketing performance and overall business results. 
- Excellence in Marketing Operations capabilities to drive Marketing Operation Excellence and Governance. 
- Change-oriented, and business-minded with the ability to influence new solutions and be hands-on to implement and execute for results; ability to balance strategy with operational rigor across teams and projects. 
- Strong interest in working in a large and fast-paced international organization.

title: Senior Director, Regional Marketing & eCommerce - Asia Pacific (APACx)
description:
Job Description

The Senior Director, Regional Marketing & eCommerce – Asia Pacific (APACx) is the regional business strategist for Marketing and eCommerce performance across Hilton’s Asia Pacific markets outside Greater China. This leader sets the discipline strategy, operating model, growth priorities and performance standards that help markets, hotels and ownership groups capture demand, grow direct and digital revenue, and improve the return on marketing investment.

You will be the voice of the business, the region and the customer—turning consumer insight, market context and business performance into clear priorities across multiple markets. In partnership with Marketing, Loyalty and other regional teams, you will ensure local needs and market nuances inform integrated, omnichannel strategies that strengthen demand, revenue, market share, customer engagement and loyalty. You will connect the right audiences to the right channels and experiences, while enabling markets to make faster, more effective and commercially accountable decisions.

As the primary regional marketing and digital performance expert, you will build trusted relationships across Operations, Commercial, Brand Support, Development and other enterprise functions. You will represent the discipline with senior stakeholders, strengthen collaboration across markets and establish a culture of accountability, learning and continuous improvement—ultimately driving stronger revenue and channel performance across the region.

Responsibilities

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

Your role is important, and below are some of the fundamental job duties that make your work unique.

What Your Day-to-day Will Be Like



- Own the APACx Marketing and eCommerce performance strategy, translating enterprise and area priorities into market-level growth plans, targets, investment choices and clear accountability.
- Lead regional performance management across direct, digital and other demand-capture channels, using revenue, conversion, acquisition, cost, contribution and channel-shift metrics to identify opportunities and remove barriers to growth.
- Build multi-year capability and operating-model roadmaps covering planning, measurement, consulting, media effectiveness, channel optimization, test-and-learn practices, automation and market enablement.
- Set the regional approach to scenario planning, budget phasing and business cases, balancing near-term commercial delivery with sustainable customer and channel growth.
- Engage regularly with Regional Commercial, Revenue Management, Distribution and on-property commercial leaders to review performance, identify demand and conversion opportunities, align marketing investments to business needs, and translate insights into measurable revenue, channel and share outcomes.
- Lead, coach and develop a distributed team of regional Marketing and eCommerce strategists and consultants, creating a culture of commercial ownership, curiosity, pace and high-quality decision-making.

How You Will Collaborate With Others



- Partner with APAC Commercial, Revenue Management, Distribution, Loyalty, Operations, Finance and Development leaders to align channel strategy with hotel, portfolio and market business priorities.
- Work with Global Marketing, eCommerce, Media, CRM, Analytics, Technology and Product teams to translate global platforms, playbooks and capabilities into practical regional adoption; provide performance requirements and feedback without owning product roadmaps.
- Build trusted relationships with market leaders, hotel executive committees, owners, management companies, agencies, media partners and commerce platforms, including regular business reviews and performance escalations.

What Deliverables You Will Take Ownership Of



- The APACx Marketing and eCommerce discipline strategy, annual operating plan and multi-year capability roadmap, including priorities, service levels, governance and investment recommendations.
- A regional performance-management system with scorecards, forecasts, channel and market diagnostics, test-and-learn readouts, quarterly business reviews and clear actions for markets and enterprise partners.
- Scalable consulting tools, playbooks, training and automation that raise the performance maturity of markets, hotels and ownership groups and improve the speed and consistency of execution.

Qualifications

WHY YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT

You Have These Minimum Qualifications



- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Economics, Analytics or a related field.
- 12+ years of progressive experience in regional, international or global marketing, digital commerce, eCommerce, revenue growth or a closely related commercial discipline.
- At least 5 years leading multi-market teams, cross-functional teams or complex regional programs in a matrixed multinational organization.
- Proven experience setting strategy and improving business performance across multiple markets, brands, channels or customer segments.
- Strong understanding of eCommerce and digital performance levers, including demand generation, conversion, acquisition efficiency, channel mix, marketplaces or direct-to-consumer models.
- Demonstrated financial and analytical capability, including forecasting, investment prioritization, performance measurement, business cases and translating data into decisions.
- Experience influencing senior leaders, owners, franchisees, agencies and market teams without relying solely on direct authority.
- Ability to travel approximately 25% across APAC and internationally.

It Would Be Useful If You Have



- Experience in hospitality, travel, consumer, retail, marketplace or another multi-brand, multi-market business.
- Experience operating across a franchise, owner, partner or distributed-market model.
- Experience with experimentation, incrementality, marketing mix, media effectiveness, CRM performance or advanced commercial analytics.
- An MBA or advanced degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics or a related discipline.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

title: Regional Brand Manager, APAC
description:
Our Craft

Edrington’s vision is to give more by crafting exceptional ultra-premium spirit brands. The Macallan is our central focus, supported by Highland Park and The Glenrothes in the single malt category. Our portfolio is completed with Brugal premium rum from the Dominican Republic. Edrington also has a strategic partnership with No.3 London Dry Gin.

Our principal shareholder is a charitable trust, so we were built to make a world of difference. Discover a place where values define our culture. The home of exceptional brands, where people and teams thrive.

Our Blend Of Benefits



-  4 Giving More volunteer days 
-  Medical insurance 
-  24/7 support for you and your loved ones to counselling, life coaching and information on financial, mental, and physical wellbeing 


Embrace Excellence

The Regional Brand Manager, APAC will support the development and execution of regional brand strategy primarily for The Macallan, with a strong focus on delivering brand growth, equity building and elevated consumer experiences across key APAC markets.

Working closely with global, regional and local stakeholders, the role is responsible for translating brand ambition into regionally relevant plans and programs that strengthen brand presence, drive executional excellence and support long-term commercial growth. This role will lead key initiatives across campaign planning, market activation, portfolio development, channel visibility, budget management and performance evaluation, while ensuring activity is aligned to brand standards and resonates with target consumers.

Make an Impact



-  Support the development of regional brand and portfolio strategy across APAC for The Macallan, ensuring alignment to global vision, market opportunities and long-term growth ambitions. 
-  Partner with regional and local market teams to support & coordinate The Macallan’s brand plans that balance strategic consistency with local relevance across diverse consumer and channel environments. 
-  Consolidate market input, consumer insights and local needs to inform recommendations. Support annual planning and key regional business reviews. 
-  Lead the Regional Experiential strategy and execution framework for APAC markets working closely with the Global teams ensuring consistent brand standards whilst enabling locally relevant execution. 
-  Provide guidance to APAC markets in the development and delivery of market-specific experiential initiatives ensuring that we continue to build brand equity, deliver an elevated consumer experience with executional excellence and drive recruitment of new consumers 
-  Manage regional launch planning for new products and key portfolio initiatives. 
-  Coordinate launch readiness across markets, including toolkits, samples, assets and guidelines 
-  Support local markets on the openings of new retail spaces across the region, ensuring consistency of design and execution in line with Global guidelines 
-  Consolidate performance of all spaces and share insights across transversal teams 
-  Support local markets with activation ideas to drive traffic, increase consumer engagement and recruitment and drive sales. 
-  Support management and tracking of regional marketing budgets. 
-  Monitor investment allocation, spend efficiency and performance against plans. 
-  Monitor and evaluate market, brand, campaign and activation performance, identifying key drivers, risks and opportunities. 
-  Develop actionable recommendations based on performance trends, consumer insights and market dynamics to enhance brand growth. 
-  Support preparation for performance reviews, QBRs, AOP cycles and planning sessions, ensuring robust analysis and clear business recommendations. 
-  Manage external agencies and partners to deliver high-quality creative development, production and execution in line with brand standards. 
-  Lead the development and deployment of scalable toolkits, assets and operating frameworks that strengthen execution quality, marketing effectiveness and brand consistency across local markets. 
-  Work closely with global, regional and local teams to ensure alignment across brand plans and execution 
-  Partner with commercial, finance, insights, communications, education and private client teams. 


Your Talent And Skills



-  Marketing experience, preferably in brand management, regional marketing, consumer marketing, luxury goods, wines & spirits, hospitality, beauty, lifestyle or premium consumer categories. 
-  Experience in managing the development and execution of brand plans, campaigns, product launches and activation programs across multiple markets or channels. 
-  Strong understanding of brand building, consumer engagement and premium/luxury execution standards across online and offline touchpoints. 
-  Experience working with global, regional and local market teams to adapt brand direction into locally relevant plans.

title: Segment Marketing Manager - Semiconductor
description:

You are passionate about understanding customer challenges and translating market insights into business opportunities. You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy uncovering trends, identifying growth opportunities, and helping organizations make informed strategic decisions.

You are naturally curious, collaborative, and comfortable working across commercial and technical teams. You use data, customer feedback, and market intelligence to influence decisions and drive action.

You thrive in fast-paced environments, demonstrate a strong sense of ownership, and consistently deliver high-quality work while managing multiple priorities.

For This Role, You Will Need:

- 3+ years of experience in the Semiconductor industry, or Segment Marketing experience within an adjacent high-tech industry.

- Experience collecting, analyzing, and synthesizing market, customer, application, and competitive intelligence.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to convert data and market insights into actionable business recommendations.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and communicate with both technical and commercial audiences.

Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. We provide a variety of medical insurance plans, with dental and vision coverage, Employee Assistance Program, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.

At Emerson, our employee’s passion for innovation and results drives our success. We actively pursue new technologies, capabilities and approaches to deliver tangible value for our customers. We firmly believe that when Emerson achieves its operational and financial goals, our employees share in the company’s success. At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.

Accessibility Assistance or Accommodation

About Emerson

Local Press Relations

Vendor Management

Professional Experience And Qualifications



- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

Sounds like you?

title: Asst Manager/ Manager Marketing & Communications

description:
Asst Manager/ Manager Marketing & Communications
Position Summary
The Assistant Manager / Manager, Marketing & Communications is responsible forthe institution’s day-to-day marketing, communications, student recruitment support, educationagent engagement and website operations.
The position manages communications with education agents, coordinates recruitmentand marketing campaigns, develops bilingual marketing content, and maintainsthe institution’s website and promotional materials across online and offline channels.
A key responsibility is to ensure that marketing, advertising, recruitment and website communications are accurate, current and compliant with applicable Skills and Workforce Development Agency (SWDA) requirements, EduTrust Guidance Document 4 (GD4), PEI marketing and advertising requirements, and the institution’sinternal policies and approval processes.
The role requires strong proficiency in both spoken and written English and Chinese, as the position involves developing and reviewing content in both languages and regular communication with English- and Chinese-speaking education agents, prospective students and stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
1.Agent Management & Engagement

- Manage day-to-day communications and relationships with local and overseas education agents and recruitment partners.
- Coordinate agent onboarding, documentation, training and ongoing engagement.
- Ensure agents receive accurate and current information on programmes, entry requirements, fees, institutional information and recruitment procedures.
- Conduct briefings and updates for agents on programmes, marketing requirements and relevant regulatory requirements.
- Review agent-generate or distributed promotional content to ensure consistency with approved institutional information and applicable requirements.
- Maintain accurate and audit-ready records of agent communications, training, documentation and marketing materials.

Plan and coordinate student recruitment campaigns, marketing initiatives, promotional activities, recruitment events and outreach programmes.

- Design and maintain the institution’s website through its Content Management System (CMS), including creating and updating webpages, landing pages, programme information, fees, admissions information, images, banners and other content.
