- Monitor website functionality and coordinate with external developers or vendors for complex technical development or troubleshooting where required.
- Apply basic SEO and web analytics practices to improve website visibility, user experience and recruitment effectiveness.
- Develop, edit, translate and proofread institutional and programme-related marketing content in English and Chinese across websites, digital platforms and other communication channels.
- Design and produce digital and print marketing materials, including brochures, advertisements, social media content, presentations, website graphics, banners and recruitment collateral.
- Maintain proper version control, approval records and archives of website content, marketing assets and published materials.
Requirements

- Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Media, Public Relations or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
- Relevant experience in marketing, communications, student recruitment or education-agent management; experience within Singapore’s Private Education sector is strongly preferred.
- Strong proficiency in spoken and written English and Chinese is required, as the role involves independently developing, editing, translating and proofreading marketing and website content in both languages and communicating regularly with English- and Chinese-speaking education agents, prospective students and stakeholders.
- Hands-on experience managing and maintaining websites using a Content Management System (CMS) such as WordPress or equivalent, including webpage creation, content updates and basic website administration.

The candidate must be able to understand, apply and keep abreast of requirements relevant to marketing, recruitment communications and website content.
- Strong attention to detail, with the ability to review marketing, website and recruitment materials for factual accuracy, consistency and potential compliance issues.

description:

- Ownership: Takes accountability for campaign and event deliverables from planning through execution.

Content Marketing, Conversion Rate, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Data Analysis, Demand Generation, Lead Generation, Marketing Automation, Project Management, Salesforce (Software)

title: Operations & Brand Manager/Assistant
description:
We are a contemporary Vietnamese specialty cafe chain in Singapore. Committed to delivering authentic yet modern Vietnamese coffee culture and culinary experiences, we pride ourselves on exceptional quality and vibrant brand storytelling. We are looking for an entrepreneurial and dynamic Brand & Operations Manager/Assistant to oversee both our brand's market presence and daily retail operations.
This dual-focused role requires a blend of creative marketing leadership and disciplined operational management. You will be responsible for building our brand identity, designing and executing multi-channel marketing campaigns, and driving the operational excellence of our cafe outlets. You will ensure that our brand promise translates seamlessly into daily customer experiences, staff efficiency, and financial profitability.
Key Responsibilities
1. Brand & Marketing Management

- Brand Strategy: Unify, develop and execute culture-driven brand positioning and marketing strategies to grow our customer base and footprint in Singapore.
- Campaign Management: Plan, launch, and monitor integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, website, e-commerce and offline channels.
- Content Creation: Oversee the development of high-quality visuals, copy, and promotional assets for menus, social media, e-commerce, website, and in-store displays.
- Public Relations & Partnerships: Identify and manage collaborations with local food influencers, media, corporate partners, and delivery platforms (e.g., GrabFood, Foodpanda).
2. Cafe Operations Management

- Daily Operations: Standardise workflow processes, manage inventory levels, ensure food safety compliance, and maintain strict quality control across all outlets.
- Team Leadership: Hire, train, schedule, and mentor outlet service and kitchen crews to ensure consistent customer service excellence.
- P&L Accountability: Monitor outlet sales performance, optimise operational costs, control wastage, and implement revenue-driving initiatives.
Required Skills & Competencies

- F&B Marketing & Branding: Proven track record in culture-driven brand positioning, storytelling, and community-building specifically tailored to the Singapore F&B landscape.
- Operational Leadership: Strong grasp of restaurant metrics (COGS, labuor costs, inventory management) and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
- Cultural Affinity: Passion for or strong understanding of Vietnamese coffee, cuisine, and hospitality culture is highly advantageous.
- Communication: Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills to bridge creative ideas with ground-level operations.
Software Tools & Technical Requirements
The ideal candidate must be highly proficient in utilising the following tools to execute their duties independently:

- Design & Content Creation: Canva and Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop) for quick menu updates, digital assets, and marketing collateral.
- Social Media & Advertising: Meta Business Suite (Facebook/Instagram Ads Manager) and TikTok Ads Manager, Google Adz to schedule, execute, and track performance marketing campaigns.
- Analytics & CRM: Google Analytics, Mailchimp (or equivalent email marketing tools), and local loyalty program backends to track customer data and web traffic.
- Operations & POS: Experience with modern F&B Point of Sale (POS) and inventory management systems (e.g. Rewardly, AppsPOS etc.)
Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
- At least 2–5 years of working experience in the F&B or hospitality sector, with minimum 1 year in a managerial or hybrid marketing-operations capacity.
- Business-level fluency in English while knowing Vietnamese and basic conversational Chinese is an advantage as this role requires the candidate to handle domestic and cross-border vendor relations and tailer marketing communications for target demographic segments.

title: Assistant Brand Manager
description:
Position

The Opportunity…

At Moët Hennessy, We Don't Just Create Exceptional Experiences - We Live Them.

For generations, our 27 Maisons, including Dom Pérignon, Veuve Clicquot, and Hennessy, have defined luxury. Now, it's your turn. Imagine a career fueled by passion and creativity, where you redefine what's possible. We seek individuals who thrive in collaborative environments, sharing our love for craftsmanship, elegance, and integrity. We celebrate diversity and the pursuit of excellence.

We're thrilled to announce an opening for an Assistant Brand Manager. Reporting to the Senior Brand Manager, you will be responsible for developing marketing strategies and plans for the Hennessy portfolio to maximize brand equity and drive business growth in the market.

We are looking for an ambitious, dynamic, and detail-oriented marketer who is passionate about building iconic brands. In this role, you will play a critical part in executing the local marketing strategy, driving brand desirability, and accelerating growth for the Hennessy portfolio. A key focus will be leading strategic activations and trade partnerships across channels, while strengthening on-trade and retail visibility through impactful consumer experiences.

You will also be responsible for building strong agency partnerships and leading the flawless execution of brand campaigns and on-ground activations. In addition to managing the A&P budget and monitoring market and consumer trends, you will work closely with Management and Sales teams to achieve business objectives.

At Moët Hennessy, we are committed to creating a workplace where people aspire to grow and thrive. We empower our people, value diverse perspectives, and foster a culture built on inclusivity, honesty, and authenticity.

You will have the opportunity to work in an innovative and cross-cultural environment where you will be encouraged to develop your entrepreneurial mindset and pioneering spirit. We support our people in pursuing their career aspirations and exploring mobility opportunities across countries, as well as within both Moët Hennessy and the wider LVMH Group.

If you want to inspire and be inspired, to craft exceptional experiences while experiencing the very best in craftsmanship, Moët Hennessy is where you'll flourish.

Job Responsibilities

How you will contribute…

1) Marketing & Business Strategy



- Contribute to the development of the long-term strategic plan for Singapore. 
- Define and implement marketing strategies for your brands aligned with business objectives, brand equity, market dynamics, and consumer-centric principles across all touchpoints of the consumer journey. 
- Drive the creation and execution of annual 360° marketing plans, including product launches, campaign prioritization, experiential concepts, ATL/BTL activations, budget allocation, and ROI measurement. 
- Partner closely with the Commercial and Sales teams to develop channel-specific strategies, promotions, visibility programs, and trade partnerships that drive brand desirability and business growth. 
- Support the Senior Brand Manager in executing the local marketing calendar, new product launches, and thematic campaigns. 

2) Marketing, Digital & PR Activations



- Directly manage end-to-end brand management. 
- Lead the conceptualization, planning, and delivery of activation campaigns across various channels (digital, out-of-home media, experiential, visual merchandising, and channel plans) in close collaboration with the Commercial team. 
- Develop and execute localized marketing and trade initiatives across key consumer touchpoints, ensuring strong brand visibility and premium consumer experiences. 
- Lead holistic amplification plans across paid, owned, and earned channels with a strong audience- and culture-led approach. 
- Drive excellence by collaborating with internal and external partners to maximize brand visibility, impact, and consumer engagement while ensuring consistent campaign performance tracking. 
- Plan and execute experiential events, trade activations, tastings, and consumer engagement programs to drive brand equity and commercial performance. 
- Manage and evaluate Media, PR, and BTL agencies to achieve optimum performance across all executions. 
- Monitor various aspects of brand performance through market visits, research, and trade feedback. 

3) Partnerships & Stakeholder Management



- Work closely with the other Senior Brand Managers to ensure alignment of priorities, ways of working, communication, and team spirit across the full MH portfolio. 
- Be able to articulate and share a clear vision with key stakeholders regarding Singapore consumers, market dynamics, and cultural specificities. 
- Cultivate and manage relationships with key stakeholders across the region, Maisons, agencies, customers, and industry influencers. 
- Collaborate closely with Customer Marketing teams to ensure effective execution of key brand initiatives and commercial programs. 
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between marketing strategies and business objectives (Retail, Finance, Maisons, Media, Digital, E-retail, etc.). 
- Promote the SEA markets within the Group through regular communication and influence. 

4) Analytics, Financial Management & Operations



- Monitor market, consumer, and channel trends to identify opportunities and risks. 
- Track and analyze campaign performance, volume, market share, and ROI to generate actionable insights and recommendations. 
- Manage A&P budgets, purchase orders, vendor relationships, and financial tracking to ensure effective investment management. 
- Coordinate with Supply Chain, Logistics, and regional stakeholders to ensure product availability and timely delivery of brand assets. 

Profile

We are looking for unique and amazing talent. Join us if you have…



- Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related discipline. 
- 3+ years of experience in Brand Management, Marketing, Trade Marketing, or Category Management, preferably within FMCG, luxury, consumer goods, or wines & spirits industries. 
- Experience in project management, brand activations, and agency management. 
- Strong commercial, marketing, and digital mindset, with a good understanding of consumer behavior, market trends, and brand performance analytics. 
- Experience working closely with Sales and cross-functional stakeholders to drive business growth and brand visibility. 
- Understanding of Singapore's consumer landscape, on-trade environment, and premium hospitality channels would be an advantage. 
- Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and levels. 
- Results-driven, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
- Fluent in English; proficiency in additional languages would be an advantage. 
- Comfortable working outside of regular business hours on occasion. 

Additional Information

When you join Moët Hennessy…



- You embark on a career journey with the leaders of luxury wines, champagnes, and spirits, within the prestigious LVMH Group. 
- You enter a world of possibility where career development opportunities across our 5 global regions and within the entire LVMH Group are unmatched. 
- You join a passionate workforce within our internationally diverse and inclusive teams, exploring the rich heritage of our Maisons and shaping the next chapter of our story
- You discover our essential relationship with our terroirs and the soils that define our products. Through our Living Soils Living Together program, we are committed to regenerating soils, reducing climate impact, and empowering communities for a sustainable future. 
- You will share in our passion for hosting, the art of living, and creating products that celebrate life’s most memorable milestones, always experienced through responsible tasting. 

Ready for a world of possibilities? Discover Moët Hennessy today!

title: Digital Marketing Lead, APAC
description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Digital Marketing Lead, APAC

We are looking for an experienced and data-driven Digital Marketing Lead, APAC to join our regional team in Singapore. Reporting directly to the VP of Marketing, APAC, you will own and elevate the end-to-end digital marketing strategy across Australia, India, Southeast Asia, Hong Kong, and Japan.

In this role, you will bridge high-level regional growth strategies with hands-on digital execution. This role will lead digital experience across the entire customer lifecycle while focusing heavily on net-new customer acquisition through paid, earned, and owned channel performance across the APAC region.

As a commercial conduit and trusted team leader, you will partner closely with local country marketers, global digital marketing leaders and regional commercial leaders. This is a player-coach role where you will not only coach and grow a high-performing digital marketing function but also be comfortable to roll up your sleeves to get into details and execution.

We are looking for a respected and trusted leader with experience in coaching and developing teams to perform at their best capacity

What you'll do

Regional Strategy & Leadership



- Drive Full-Funnel Digital Strategy- Formulate, execute, and evaluate a multi-market web and digital marketing strategy across APAC to build brand awareness, acquire new customers, and drive revenue impact across target verticals.
- Stakeholder Alignment- Serve as a bridge between regional commercial leadership, country marketing teams, and global digital/acquisition hubs to ensure regional campaigns align with local market realities and pipeline goals.
- Strategic Partnerships- Collaborate directly with the VP of Marketing, APAC on spends and ROI forecasting, and high-impact strategic projects across the broader marketing organization.
- Team Leadership & Development- Build, coach and guide local and regional digital marketers. Set clear goals, foster individual career growth, and drive organizational alignment around shared business metrics.

Campaign Execution & Media Operations



- Acquisition & Pipeline Generation- Oversee the planning, setup, and optimization of integrated demand generation campaigns (Search/SEM, Paid Social, Display, Programmatic, Content Syndication) to deliver qualified Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).
- Search & LLM Optimization- Drive search strategy across regional markets, maintaining a forward-looking approach to search trends, user behavior, and modern AI/LLM discovery engines.
- Web & Localization Management- Lead regional web strategy—including local landing page creation, web copy translation, user experience optimization, and web personalization across APAC sub-regions.
- Agency & Vendor Management- Direct agency partners and media buyers across APAC. Manage campaign briefings, media plan evaluations, agency output, direct publisher deals, and ongoing execution quality.

Analytics, Budget & ROI



- Budget Allocation- Manage, and continuously optimize quarterly and annual digital marketing spend across APAC markets to ensure maximum return on investment (ROI).
- Performance Analytics- Leverage analytics platforms (e.g., GA4, Salesforce, Marketo, Looker) to track campaign efficacy, model multi-channel attribution, and extract actionable insights for rapid continuous improvement.

Your Background



- Experience- 10+ years of total experience in B2B digital marketing with a deep emphasis on net-new customer acquisition. Fintech or B2B tech experience is strongly preferred
- Leadership- 5+ years of team leadership experience, with a proven track record of developing multi-market, regional teams in APAC (e.g., Australia, SEA, Japan, India)
- Balanced Skillset- Ability to seamlessly balance strategic leadership with hands-on technical execution—from defining high-level commercial objectives to auditing campaign architecture and conversion flows
- Technical & Analytics Depth- Hands-on mastery of full-funnel digital tactics (SEO/SEM, LLM search, Paid Social, Programmatic) and modern martech/analytics tools (GA4, Salesforce, Marketo, Looker)
- Commercial Mindset- Strong business acumen with demonstrated success partnering with Commercial/Sales functions and tracking success against revenue-based goals (SAOs, Pipeline, ROI)
- Experimentation mindset- Evidence of cultivating a test-and-learn culture that balances strategic vision with operational execution
- Agency Leadership- Extensive experience managing regional digital agencies, media budgets, contract negotiations, and external partner performance
- Ability to travel up to 20%+ of the time across APAC.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of our Singapore office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

title: Marketing Executive (1-Year Contract)

Working closely with the Assistant Marketing Manager, you will support the planning and execution of integrated marketing campaigns that span product launches, seasonal retail moments, tactical promotions and customer engagement initiatives. You will collaborate closely with Branding, Content, Creative, Retail Operations, eCommerce and Events teams to ensure campaigns are executed consistently and effectively.


This role is ideal for a marketer who enjoys both strategic planning and hands-on execution, with exposure to 360° marketing across retail, digital and experiential channels.


What you’ll own
Campaign Planning & Execution

- Support the development and execution of marketing campaigns aligned with product launches, seasonal retail moments and key business priorities.
- Coordinate campaign timelines, deliverables and stakeholder alignment across Branding, Content, Creative and Retail Operations
- Ensure campaign messaging and visual identity are implemented consistently across all customer touchpoints.
- Assist in translating brand strategies into actionable marketing initiatives that drive both brand awareness and commercial performance.


Retail Activations & Customer Engagement

- Plan and execute retail marketing initiatives that bring campaigns and product stories to life within boutiques and retail environments.
- Collaborate with Retail Operations and Visual Merchandising teams to ensure boutiques are campaign-ready and aligned with brand standards.
- Support the development and execution of tactical retail initiatives, customer engagement activities and promotional campaigns to drive traffic, conversion and sales.
- Monitor execution standards across boutiques and identify opportunities to enhance customer experience and campaign effectiveness.


Event Planning & Execution

- Support the planning and execution of brand events, customer activations and experiential marketing initiatives including:
- Boutique events
- VIP customer events
- Mall atrium activations
- Corporate staff sales
- Campaign launches and promotional roadshows
- Coordinate event logistics, vendor management, guest experience and on-site operations to ensure seamless execution.
- Work closely with the Events and PR team to bring marketing campaigns to life through engaging customer experiences.


Partnerships & Collaborations

- Identify and support opportunities for brand partnerships, mall collaborations and cross-promotional campaigns that enhance brand visibility and customer acquisition.
- Coordinate partnership deliverables and ensure alignment with campaign objectives and brand positioning.
- Build and maintain relationships with external partners, landlords, vendors and agencies.


Marketing Operations & Project Management

- Manage campaign calendars, project timelines and cross-functional deliverables.
- Coordinate production and deployment of campaign assets, POSM and promotional materials.
- Liaise with agencies, vendors and suppliers to ensure timely execution of marketing initiatives.
- Ensure all campaigns and activations are delivered accurately, efficiently and within budget.


Campaign Reporting & Insights

- Track campaign and activation performance across marketing channels and retail touchpoints.
- Prepare post-campaign and post-event reports including customer engagement, traffic, sales and ROI metrics.
- Identify key learnings and recommendations to optimise future campaigns and activations.


Competencies Required

- Integrated Marketing & Commercial Mindset
- Understands how branding, retail marketing, customer engagement, events and partnerships work together to drive business results.
- Event & Activation Management
- Strong ability to translate marketing campaigns into engaging retail activations and customer experiences that strengthen brand affinity and support sales objectives.
- Project & Operational Excellence
- Demonstrates strong organisation and project management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple timelines, stakeholders and operational requirements simultaneously.
- Stakeholder Collaboration
- Builds strong relationships with internal teams, agencies, vendors, mall partners and external stakeholders to deliver successful campaigns and activations.
- Initiative & Ownership
- Proactive, resourceful and comfortable taking ownership of projects from planning through execution while supporting broader marketing objectives.


The portfolio you’ll build here

- End-to-end ownership of integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
- Exposure to branding, retail marketing, customer engagement, partnerships and events.
- Experience working on major jewellery launches, seasonal campaigns and VIP initiatives.
- Cross-functional collaboration across Content, Creative, Retail Operations, eCommerce and Events teams.
- Development into a future Senior Marketing Executive with broad 360° marketing exposure.


About you

- 1–2 years of marketing experience, preferably within retail, fashion, beauty, lifestyle or luxury sectors.
- Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Events Management or a related field.
- Proven experience in marketing campaigns, executing brand events, retail activations or campaign launches.
- Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple timelines and stakeholders simultaneously.
- Highly proactive, resourceful and comfortable working in a fast-paced retail environment.
- A strong interest in lifestyle marketing, brand storytelling and experiential marketing.


What we offer

- Opportunities to lead and execute high-visibility brand events and retail activations.
- Exposure to integrated marketing across retail, campaigns and experiential marketing.
- Hands-on experience creating meaningful brand moments that bring jewellery collections and stories to life.
- A collaborative in-house marketing environment focused on building a modern jewellery brand through impactful experiences.

-  Minimum 10 years’ marketing experience within financial services, with significant experience in asset management marketing.

-  Proven experience developing and executing marketing strategies that support business growth across multiple markets. 
-  Demonstrated people leadership experience, including managing and coordinating teams across countries and building a high-performance culture. 
-  Strong knowledge of financial markets, investment products and both public and private markets across Asia.

-  Excellent communication, presentation, planning and organisational skills, with the ability to deliver high-quality outcomes through collaboration. 
-  Sound understanding of marketing governance, regulatory requirements and compliance standards relevant to Hong Kong and Singapore.

-  Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration or a related field; a Master’s degree would be advantageous. 
-  Experience working with Marketing Centres of Expertise and leveraging global or regional campaigns for local market execution. 
-  Curiosity about emerging technologies, including AI tools, to improve marketing productivity, effectiveness and innovation. 
-  A client-centric, commercially aware and action-oriented mindset, with the ability to manage ambiguity, solve problems creatively and focus resources on the highest-value priorities.

title: Assistant Manager, Marketing Communications
description:
HOTEL OVERVIEW
Strategically located in the heart of Singapore’s shopping, dining and entertainment districts and with the City Hall and Esplanade Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) train stations and other major transportation nodes at its doorstep, Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford are the gateway to explore Singapore’s landscapes at your convenience. With a total of 2,030 well-appointed guestrooms, both hotels also offer a distinct collection of 12 lifestyle and dining choices including Michelin-starred fine dining restaurant JAAN by Kirk Westaway, cutting-edge meeting space at Raffles City Convention Centre with 34 meeting rooms and one of Asia’s largest spas, Willow Stream Spa.


ABOUT OUR COMPANY
At Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford, we design career plans and unveil new professional perspectives through our various development programs. We shine when YOU shine. Come and be part of our dynamic team and experience immerse growth and career opportunities with us.


The Assistant Marketing Communications Manager develops and leads communications strategies for assigned revenue streams and lifestyle-led portfolios across Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford. This role has a strong focus on campaign management, public relations, media relations, content development, influencer engagement, media planning, partnerships, F&B storytelling, spa and lifestyle campaigns, while supporting broader hotel, brand and corporate initiatives. The role supports the Director of Marketing Communications in managing campaign execution, agency coordination, media hosting and team workflow. This is a leadership position as second in-charge to lead and manage the team.


COMMUNICATIONS & MEDIA PLANNING

- Formulate communications and media calendars for assigned portfolios, ensuring timely and accurate execution of initiatives with relevant business units and stakeholders.
- Develop Public Relations angles, media materials, influencer briefs and content narratives that generate positive and relevant coverage across local, regional and international channels.
- Develop media plan for campaigns and dedicated business units for brand positioning and/or to meet campaign objectives
- Review communications materials including press releases, media pitches, social copy, sales decks, in-house collaterals, ad copy and campaign assets to ensure accuracy, tonality and brand alignment.
- Lead assigned awards submissions, canvassing of votes or nominations, and post-award amplification with relevant stakeholders.
- Identify partnership opportunities with lifestyle, luxury, F&B, wellness, cultural and corporate brands to create differentiated guest experiences.


LIFESTYLE, PUBLIC RELATIONS & PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT

- Lead or support lifestyle and Public Relations -driven portfolios such as selected F&B venues, spa, wellness, partnerships, IP-led collaborations, festive campaigns and hotel stories.
- Manage media, blogger, content creator and influencer hosting to drive positive coverage and beneficial commercial outcomes.
- Coordinate media familiarisation stays, F&B tastings, chef interviews, partner activations and hosted experiences in line with approved strategy and budgets.
- Support restaurant and bar positioning by developing story angles around culinary concepts, chefs, menus, events, awards and collaborations.
- Maintain active awareness of hospitality, lifestyle, dining, wellness and media trends to identify relevant opportunities.


CAMPAIGN & EVENT MANAGEMENT

- Conceptualise, plan and execute integrated communications campaigns with the Director, internal team, Public relations agencies, digital partners and business unit stakeholders.
- Support marketing and promotion of hotel-led events, ensuring strong attendance, media relevance, guest experience and post-event reporting.
- Prepare campaign briefs, timelines, content requirements, photography or videography briefs, creative references and partner deliverables.
- Coordinate cross-channel launches across website, social media, email, in-house displays, press outreach, partner platforms and advertising placements.
- Monitor campaign performance and prepare updates with recommendations for optimisation.


MARKET RESEARCH & ANALYSIS

- Conduct market research to identify consumer preferences, competitor activity, hospitality trends and relevant lifestyle or dining developments.
- Analyse public relations , campaign, media monitoring, social and stakeholder feedback to develop informed recommendations that support business goals.
- Review competitive communications to identify opportunities for differentiation and stronger positioning.


PARTNER, AGENCY & VENDOR ENGAGEMENT

- Manage day-to-day agency, partner and vendor coordination for assigned projects, ensuring clear scopes, timelines, deliverables and approvals.
- Host partners and industry contacts for ongoing engagement and potential collaborations.
- Support negotiation of value-added partner arrangements that enhance brand relevance, reduce costs or improve guest experiences.


BUDGETING & ADMINISTRATION

- Manage campaign and assigned business unit budgets and forecast.
- Monitor campaign-level budgets, quotations and supplier costs for assigned projects, ensuring forecast accuracy and procurement compliance.
- Support annual budget planning by gathering scopes, historical costs and proposed activity requirements.
- Work with the Coordinator to ensure agreements, purchase requests, invoices and accruals are submitted accurately and on time.


OTHERS

- Comply with hotel and department policies and procedures at all times.
- Assist with Sales & Marketing projects and carry out other duties as assigned by Management.


REQUIREMENTS

- Degree or Diploma in Hospitality, Tourism, Marketing, Communications, Public Relations or a related discipline.
- Minimum 3 to 6 years of marketing communications or public relations experience, preferably within hospitality, travel, lifestyle, luxury, F&B or agency environments.
- Leadership – experience in leading and managing teams
- Excellent spoken and written English. Fluency in a second language is preferred.
- AI-enabled marketer, proficient in Claude, ChatGPT, relevant tools for content creation, presentations, project management
- Strong knowledge of marketing communications (Branding, Public Relations , Events, Advertising), hospitality trends, media//KOL connections locally/regionally
- Excellent writing, editing, media pitching and content planning skills.
- Strong stakeholder management with the ability to work across multiple business units and senior stakeholders.
- Ability to brief agencies, designers, photographers and vendors with clear objectives and timelines.
- Strong analytical skills with comfort using media monitoring, influencer analysis and campaign performance data.
- Creative, proactive and commercially minded, with a passion for hospitality and guest experiences.
- Collaborative, adaptable and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.


Why work for Accor?
We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.
By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality.
Do what you love, care for the world, dare to challenge the status quo! #BELIMITLESS

title: Product Marketing Manager - APJ
description:
Job Description

At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold “what if.”

What if your ideas could ignite global innovation?

We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of your career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it’s like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. In a world where you can be anything, Be Infoblox.

We are looking for Product Marketing Manager based in Singapore to join our global Product and Solutions Marketing team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Product Marketing based in Europe. In this role, you will adapt global messaging campaigns, and content for priority APJ markets to support the Go-To-Market execution. You will partner closely with the APJ Sales, Field Marketing and Channel Marketing organizations to localize positioning, develop market-relevant assets and improve adoption of Infoblox’s solutions portfolio across the region. This role is based in Singapore, a key Infoblox hub in APJ, and will require in-office collaboration in line with Infoblox’s hybrid working policy.

You are an excellent verbal and written communicator who combines strong storytelling and practical execution. You understand how regional market needs differ across APJ and can adapt broader product and solutions messaging into content and programs that are relevant for local buyers, partners, and influencers.

Be a Contributor - What You’ll Do



- Adapt and localize global product and solutions marketing messaging, campaigns, assets, and sales play for priority APJ markets 
- Develop and maintain regional content pitch decks, sales enablement materials, webinar content, blogs, social posts, and short-form video 
- Partner with APJ Sales, Field Marketing, and Channel Marketing to locally support launches, campaigns, sales plays, customer conversations, and events 
- Gather input from customers, partner, the field and local market trends to help refine regional positioning and messaging 
- Support webinars, field events, and partner programs with relevant messaging and content for target audiences 
- Track engagement and feedback on content and campaigns and recommend improvements based on performance and field input 
- Work with global Product and Solutions Marketing to ensure regional adaptations stay aligned to core messaging and company priorities 
- Contribute regional insights, localization need and buyer feedback into broader team planning 
- Support local adoption of go-to-market tools, sales plays, etc. with the APJ team, helping them to activate changes swiftly 
- Use AI tools to accelerate content drafting, research synthesis, problem solving, experimentation, and performance analysis while maintaining quality and brand voice 

Be Prepared - What You Bring



- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or equivalent 
- 5+ years of experience in product/solutions marketing, content marketing, or B2B technology marketing 
- 5 years of experience adapting messaging and assets for regional or country-level audiences within Asia 
- Strong storytelling and content development skills across multiple formats and channels, including creating whitepapers, datasheets, solution notes 
- Ability to simplify technical concepts and communicate product value clearly to different audiences 
- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with sales, marketing, and product stakeholders 
- Working knowledge of APJ market dynamics and an understanding of how buyer needs vary across countries in the region 
- Excellent written and verbal English skills and fluent in at least one other language 
- Proficiency in at least one additional APJ language (e.g., Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Thai) strongly preferred, along with experience localizing messaging for local markets 
- Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple deliverables with consistent quality and attention to detail 
- Hands-on proficiency with AI tools and workflows (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to boost productivity in research, content creation, problem solving, experimentation, and analytics, with curiosity to keep learning as AI evolves 

Be Successful - Your Path

Six Months: 



- Understand the Infoblox portfolio and how to position key solutions for APJ audiences 
- Build strong working relationships with APJ Sales, Field Marketing, Channel Marketing, and global Product and Solutions Marketing 
- Deliver localized messaging and content for priority APJ campaigns, launches, and field needs 
- Become a reliable regional partner for adapting global content into market-relevant assets 

One Year: 



- Own execution of regional product marketing deliverables for priority APJ initiatives under the guidance of the broader Product and Solutions Marketing strategy 
- Be a trusted partner to APJ stakeholders for localized positioning, campaign support, and field enablement 
- Establish a repeatable approach for capturing regional insights and feeding them back into global messaging and asset planning 
- Help improve regional adoption and campaign effectiveness through better market relevance, localization, and content performance 

Belong -  Your Community

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here. Click here to learn more about life as a Bloxer.

Be Rewarded -  Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong



- Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options. 
- Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops.
- Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy.
- Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations.
- Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match.

Ready to Be the Difference?

title: Head of Client Experience Marketing, Executive Director
description:
Who We Are

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

Job Purpose

The Head of Client Experience Marketing is responsible for the execution and experience delivery of OCBC’s signature client engagement programs across Global Consumer Financial Services (GCFS), spanning children and youth, mass banking, seniors, Premier Banking and Premier Private Client.

Segment owns each program, including its strategic rationale, target audience, proposition, business objectives and overall direction. Client Experience Marketing owns the How, translating that strategy into a distinctive, on-brand client experience through experience design, curation, production, partnerships and content amplification.

The role provides specialist expertise and execution leadership to deliver programs consistently, efficiently and to a high standard across CFS.

Key Responsibilities

Program Execution & Experience Delivery



- Lead the end-to-end execution of signature client programs owned by CFS Segment teams.
- Translate Segment and Sales objectives into compelling experiences tailored to the intended audience, from children and young adults to affluent, high-net-worth and intergenerational families.
- Lead experience design and curation of the events, including program format, speakers, activities, partners, venues and the overall client journey.
- Oversee production and delivery, including agencies, hospitality, guest experience, logistics and appropriate safeguarding requirements.
- Establish common experience and delivery standards while ensuring programs are tailored to the needs of each client segment.
- Develop playbooks, standards and best practices to enable markets including Malaysia, Indonesia and Hong Kong to deliver signature programs consistently, while local markets retain ownership of execution.
- Manage the cross-segment program calendar and coordinate resources and production requirements across GCFS.

Content & Social Amplification



- Lead the content and amplification approach for signature programs, extending their reach and impact beyond event attendees.
- Develop content across pre-event, live and post-event stages to drive awareness, engagement and advocacy.
- Work with internal teams and external agencies to create compelling, shareable and on-brand content and storytelling.

Performance & Continuous Improvement



- Partner with Segment and Sales to define appropriate measures of program effectiveness and provide insights into client experience, participation, engagement and content performance.
- Recommend improvements to program format, curation and experience based on performance, client feedback and execution learnings.
- Support Segment in refreshing, scaling or evolving programs, bringing an experience and execution perspective.
- Build and share best practices across the portfolio to continuously improve quality, efficiency and client impact.

Budget, Partnerships & Vendor Management



- Manage program and experiential marketing budgets within agreed business priorities, ensuring effective allocation, tracking and cost discipline.
- Build and manage a strong ecosystem of partners across luxury, hospitality, lifestyle, entertainment, content and experiential marketing.
- Lead agency and vendor selection, negotiation and performance management, while maintaining a strong bench of preferred partners.

Stakeholder & Governance Management



- Partner closely with Segment Heads, Sales, Relationship Managers, Marketing and other stakeholders to deliver programs against intended client and business objectives.
- Bring creative and execution expertise to program planning, constructively challenging and recommending enhancements where appropriate.
- Work with Brand, Compliance, Legal, Risk and other relevant functions to ensure programs meet applicable brand, regulatory, safeguarding, gifting and entertainment requirements.

Candidate Profile



- 18+ years of relevant experience in client engagement, experiential marketing, branded programs or premium events, with a strong track record in senior leadership roles.
- Experience in private banking, premier or priority banking, luxury, hospitality, lifestyle or a comparable premium consumer environment would be advantageous.
- Proven experience translating business and brand strategies into high-quality experiential programs spanning experience design, curation, production and content amplification.
- Experience building and evolving recurring experiential platforms or signature programs, rather than solely delivering one-off events.
- Ability to design experiences for different customer segments and life stages, including affluent, high-net-worth and intergenerational families.
- Strong experience in content and social amplification, agency management and luxury, hospitality, lifestyle and experiential ecosystem.
- Excellent senior stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed organization where program ownership sits with the business.
- Polished and credible, with the presence to engage senior stakeholders and clients across all segments, including affluent, high-net-worth and next-generation clients.

What We Offer

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

title: Team Lead Marketing & Communications - Siemens Mobility Asia Pacific
description:
Siemens Mobility is a global leader in rail transport and mobility solutions. From our Asia Pacific headquarters in Singapore, we support customers across Australia, Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam and other key markets, delivering innovative rolling stock, rail infrastructure, digital solutions, and customer services that help shape the future of sustainable mobility.

You'll lead regional communications, product marketing, customer engagement, executive messaging, and major industry events while managing a high-performing team across the region.

You'll Make a Difference By



- Serve as the senior marketing and communications business partner to Asia Pacific leadership across Australia, Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam and other regional markets, shaping strategic narratives, executive messaging, customer value propositions and market positioning.
- Provide direct marketing and communications leadership for the Singapore market, supporting customer engagement, key industry events and strategic initiatives, while driving communications activities for growth opportunities in emerging markets across Asia Pacific, including Vietnam's developing high-speed rail sector.
- Lead the end-to-end planning, storytelling, orchestration, and execution of major rail industry trade shows, customer events, executive engagements, media activities, and employee events, ensuring excellence from concept development through delivery.
- Act as the primary interface to Siemens Mobility Communications Headquarters, translating global product and portfolio messaging into compelling regional campaigns and communication strategies tailored to the needs of Asia Pacific rail customers.
- Drive hands-on product marketing and tender communications, developing customer references, presentations, videos, digital and social media assets, product brochures, and press materials that directly support business acquisition and customer engagement.
- Own communications for key rail projects and business milestones, including vehicle deliveries, launch campaigns, factory visits, media tours, and customer-facing communication initiatives, ensuring close stakeholder alignment and flawless execution.
- Combine strategic communications expertise with strong editorial capabilities, creating newsletters, campaign content, and messaging frameworks while personally driving operational implementation.
- Lead and develop a lean team of two communications professionals in Thailand and Australia while remaining a highly hands-on contributor who independently manages critical projects and strategic deliverables across the region.
- Collaborate closely with Siemens Limited communications teams responsible for corporate brand, thought leadership, and reputation management, while retaining primary accountability for operational product marketing, business communications, customer engagement, and market-facing campaigns for Siemens Mobility in Asia Pacific.

What You'll Bring



- Deep experience leading integrated marketing and communications functions within complex infrastructure, transportation, industrial, technology, or public-sector environments.
- Ability to translate customer, market, regulatory, industry and business dynamics into compelling positioning, narratives, and marketing and communications strategies.
- Credibility as a trusted senior advisor, with sound judgement, discretion, and resilience when managing sensitive reputational, commercial, and strategic issues.
- Confidence leading high-profile stakeholder engagement, including customer events, executive forums, industry conferences, media activities, and government-facing engagements.
- Strong people leadership capability, with experience building, developing, and motivating high-performing teams in regional and matrixed organisations.
- Expertise delivering integrated, data-driven campaigns across owned, earned, digital, and customer-facing channels, supported by a commercial and customer-centric mindset.
- Knowledge of emerging AI-enabled marketing and communications technologies, with the ability to identify, adopt, and leverage AI-driven solutions to enhance content creation, audience engagement, campaign effectiveness, and operational efficiency.
- Experience supporting business acquisition activities through product marketing, tender communications, customer engagement, and value proposition development.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to simplify complex topics and influence diverse audiences.
- Strategic thinking combined with a highly hands-on approach to execution.

Why Siemens Mobility?

This is an opportunity to shape the reputation, positioning, and growth of one of the world's leading rail technology businesses across Asia Pacific. You'll work alongside regional and global leaders, support landmark rail projects, and help drive the future of sustainable mobility across the region.

Transform the everyday with us.

We support a diverse workforce.

Siemens is a proud equal opportunity employer, creating a work environment of diversity and inclusion. Our diverse workforce cultivates innovation and excellence and, in turn, creates a workplace where our employees belong and prosper. Diversity and inclusion help us fully realise the potential of our people. As part of Siemens' ownership culture, Siemens also genuinely supports flexible working practices that empower our employees to best meet work and personal commitments.

title: Associate Marketing Manager, Singapore
description:
About SharkNinja
Our mission to positively impact people's lives every day in every home around the world allows our employees to be thinkers and tinkerers, designers and doers, creators and number crunchers, makers of things they love.


SharkNinja APAC is expanding and scaling rapidly. Our two brands, Shark and Ninja, have enjoyed unprecedented growth over the past five years, driven by a very strong innovation pipeline across both brands. Building on that success, SharkNinja APAC has embarked on a bold plan for growth in which Singapore and Malaysia play a critical role. We have taken these markets back from our distributors so that we can run them directly and drive strong growth behind innovation and investment.


Shark and Ninja have exceptional product pipelines and consumers who have not yet been given a strong enough reason to care. This role is where campaigns actually get built and launched — and where our next brand leaders are grown.


Position Summary
The Associate Marketing Manager runs Shark or Ninja marketing activity in Singapore day to day, depending on the category they own: campaign planning and delivery, NPD launch execution, content production, creator and PR activity, and the reporting that tells us whether it worked.
Shark competes in home care, floor care and beauty, and Ninja in kitchen, cooking and food preparation. In both, the product genuinely does something better and the job of marketing is to make people see it. Content, demonstration and credible third-party proof matter more here than message repetition.


This is a hands-on role in a small team. You will write the brief, build the content, brief the creators, manage the agency, check the assets and pull the results together. The plan and the execution both sit with you.


You will also own a defined category or sub-category of Shark or Ninja in Singapore — its plan, its numbers and its results. You work alongside the Marketing Manager, who sets the brand direction, and you are expected to run your area, not simply support theirs.
It is also a development role. We are building the marketing organisation these markets will need, and we want people who will grow into brand ownership. Scope will expand as fast as you can carry it.


Key Responsibilities

- Own a defined category or sub-category of Shark or Ninja in Singapore end to end: set its plan, priorities and targets within the brand plan agreed with the Marketing Manager.
- Be the go-to person for your category — its consumers, competitors, pricing, range and pipeline — and bring a point of view to the Marketing Manager rather than waiting for direction.
- Manage the budget allocated to your category within the brand envelope, and recommend where to invest more or stop.
- Answer for your category's results: demand, conversion and launch performance, reported honestly with learning applied.
- Work as a partner to the Marketing Manager, who sets the brand direction, and not as their support resource.
- Build and execute the Shark or Ninja campaign calendar for Singapore against commercial moments — launches, peak, category occasions and platform campaigns.
- Write clear, insight-led briefs and hold agencies and partners to them.
- Manage delivery end to end: assets, media, channels, timing and go-live, with nothing landing late or incomplete.
- Own campaign budgets and track spend against plan.
- Execute NPD launches
- Deliver every Shark or Ninja launch in your area in Singapore: proposition and message, assets, media, PR, seeding, creators, and online and retail landing.
- Run the launch checklist and chase every dependency — content, stock, pricing, listings, training — rather than assuming others will.
- Secure early reviews and credible demonstration content before day one.
- Report launch performance at 30 and 90 days with learning attached.
- Build content that shows what our products do, grounded in how people actually live, clean, cook and eat here — the small home, the hawker habit, the weekend cook, the health-conscious family.
- Manage creator and influencer activity: selection, briefing, content review and performance measurement.
- Work with the E-Commerce Designer and Social Commerce team so brand and commerce content reinforce each other.
- Work closely with E-Commerce and Sales so campaigns land where the product can actually be bought, with content and availability ready.
- Provide the shopper and in-store material the commercial teams need — claims, demonstration messages and reasons to choose.
- Track what converts and bring that back into the next campaign.
- Bring a point of view to the trading rhythm rather than a report.
- Build campaign and content reporting that is honest about what worked and what did not.
- Test deliberately rather than repeating what was done last year.
- Track competitor activity and flag anything that needs a response.
- Recommend stopping things that are not delivering, including things you built.


Essential

- 4+ years in consumer brand marketing, campaign delivery or product marketing in Singapore.
- Evidence that you build and improve, not just deliver. A campaign, content approach, process or test you initiated yourself — and what changed as a result.
- Hands-on execution capability across content, creators, media and assets. You do the work, not only manage it.
- Genuine Singapore consumer understanding and curiosity about how people actually live and buy.
- Strong project discipline — many moving parts, tight timelines, nothing dropped.
- Commercial awareness: understands that marketing exists to create demand that converts.
- Clear communication and the confidence to brief, challenge and chase.
- Ability to run a defined category or sub-category: set its plan, own its numbers and make the case for investment, with the Marketing Manager as partner rather than director.
- Appetite to grow into brand ownership.


Experience might get you the interview. Mindset is what sets you apart.


YOUR ROLE IN LEADING OUR SUCCESS DRIVERS

- Lead us to be “RARELY SATISFIED”
- Make things better each day; “PROGRESS OVER PERFECTION”
- Use your knowledge of our consumer, understand that “DETAILS MAKE THE DIFFERENCE”
- Deliver something great; “WINNING IS A TEAM SPORT”
- Be clear and honest, “COMMUNICATING FOR IMPACT”
- 
Explore SharkNinja On Our Social Channels

- https://www.linkedin.com/company/sharkninja-apac/mycompany/
- https://www.linkedin.com/company/sharkninja-apac/jobs/

title: Assistant Brand Manager
description:
About Urgo Medical
Urgo Medical is the advanced wound care division of the French family-owned Urgo Group.


Our mission: healing people
As wounds are a source of suffering around the world, our mission, as the Healing Company, is to support healthcare professionals heal people with evidence-based treatments and innovative services so that life can start again for patients.
Our mission is based on three pillars:

- Putting patients at the heart – Listening to patients to understand their needs and adapt our solutions accordingly.
- Caring for caregivers – Working closely with healthcare professionals and scientific bodies to develop innovative solutions and education programs.
- Leading with science – Continuously investing in R&D and generating robust clinical evidence to support evidence-based treatments.


We are 1,600 colleagues across Europe, Asia (Australia, China, India, Singapore & Vietnam), and the Americas — united by one passion: making a difference for patients.


Our Company Culture in APAC:
Across Asia-Pacific, Urgo Medical has built a strong, people-centered culture recognized through Great Place to Work® certification in all affiliates. 


At Urgo Medical, we know our mission starts with our people. Our culture is shaped by three key pillars:

- Winning Mindset – Striving for excellence, leading with boldness, and believing that anything is possible.
- Learning Organization – Encouraging continuous growth through transparency, feedback, and opportunities for development.
- Engaging Teams – Promoting teamwork, collaboration, and open communication built on empathy and inclusiveness, where every voice is heard and valued.


As a family-owned business, we combine autonomy and agility with the global reach of a leading healthcare company. We are committed to developing our people and creating real opportunities for advancement — from rapid career progression to international mobility.


Why Join Urgo Medical Singapore?
This is an opportunity to join a focused and agile Singapore team and play a meaningful role in the continued growth of Urgo Medical’s Advanced Wound Care business.


As Assistant Brand Manager, you will have broad exposure across the business and work closely with the General Manager, Sales team, Regional Marketing and other cross-functional partners. In a lean team environment, the role offers the opportunity to see the impact of your work directly and to contribute across the full marketing cycle — from market insights and brand planning through to product launches, customer engagement and commercial execution.


The role offers:

- Meaningful ownership of brands and marketing initiatives within the Singapore market.
- Reporting directly to the General Manager, with close collaboration across Sales and other key functions.
- The opportunity to contribute to upcoming product launches and the continued development of Urgo Medical’s Advanced Wound Care portfolio.
- A strong connection to the market through regular engagement with Sales, healthcare professionals and customers.
- Exposure to APAC Regional and Global Marketing teams, while retaining the flexibility to adapt initiatives to the needs of the Singapore market.
- A hands-on and entrepreneurial environment where initiative, agility and new ideas are encouraged.
- Opportunities to learn and develop through close collaboration with experienced local, regional and global colleagues.
- A people-focused culture reflected in Urgo Medical Singapore’s Great Place to Work® certification.


As a smaller local organisation within an international group, Urgo Medical Singapore offers the opportunity to combine local ownership and visibility with regional and global exposure.


Position Summary
The Assistant Brand Manager – Advanced Wound Care is responsible for supporting the development and execution of strategies that drive brand growth, market adoption and commercial performance across the wound care portfolio.


The role involves understanding patient and healthcare professional needs, translating clinical evidence and market insights into effective brand activities, and supporting the positioning of products within a competitive healthcare environment.


Key responsibilities include brand and portfolio management, market analysis, customer engagement, campaign development, sales enablement, stakeholder engagement and collaboration with Sales, Medical/Clinical, Regulatory and Regional Marketing teams.


The Assistant Brand Manager will also monitor market trends, competitor activity and customer feedback to identify opportunities, while ensuring brand activities remain aligned with clinical evidence, regulatory requirements and overall business objectives.


Key Responsibilities:
Brand Strategy & Portfolio Management

- Support the development and execution of brand strategies and annual marketing plans aligned with business objectives, customer needs and market opportunities.
- Support product lifecycle management, positioning, value proposition development, product launches and portfolio optimisation.
- Monitor market trends, competitor activity, clinical developments and emerging wound-care technologies to identify growth opportunities.
- Work with Regional and Global Marketing teams to adapt brand strategies, materials and initiatives for the Singapore market where relevant.


Market Insights & Commercial Growth

- Develop a strong understanding of customer and patient journeys, healthcare needs, treatment pathways and market dynamics.
- Gather market and customer insights through research, field visits, customer engagement and close collaboration with the Sales team.
- Support initiatives that drive sales, revenue, market share and product adoption.
- Partner with Sales to develop account-specific strategies, sales tools, product messaging and customer engagement programmes.
- Analyse sales and market performance and recommend actions to address gaps and maximise opportunities.
- Monitor customer behaviour, competitor activity and market trends and adapt marketing activities where appropriate.


Marketing, Digital & Customer Engagement

- Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns, product launches, promotional activities, workshops, conferences, exhibitions and educational programmes.
- Support digital marketing activities, including content development, campaign coordination and performance tracking across relevant channels.
- Manage the end-to-end planning and administration of brand events, including timelines, vendors, logistics, materials, registrations, approvals and post-event evaluation.
- Manage marketing and event budgets, including budget planning, purchase orders, invoices, expense tracking and reconciliation.
- Evaluate the effectiveness and ROI of marketing and event activities and recommend improvements for future initiatives.


Clinical & Professional Engagement

- Work with Medical/Clinical teams to translate clinical evidence and product benefits into clear, compelling and compliant brand messaging.
- Support clinical education, product training, workshops and professional engagement activities.
- Build and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals, wound-care specialists, Key Opinion Leaders and professional organisations.
- Gather customer and clinical insights to strengthen brand activities and product adoption.
- Ensure brand activities reflect current wound-care practices, clinical guidelines and customer needs.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

- Work closely with Sales, Medical/Clinical, Regulatory, Finance, Supply Chain, Customer Service and other relevant teams.
- Collaborate with APAC Regional Marketing and Global teams to leverage brand assets, expertise, tools and best practices.
- Ensure timely execution of brand plans, product launches, campaigns, events and commercial initiatives.
- Support Sales capability through product training, brand updates, sales materials and competitive insights.
- Maintain a strong connection to the field through regular customer and Sales engagement.


Performance, Administration & Compliance

- Monitor and report brand performance, including sales, market share, campaign effectiveness, event outcomes and budget utilisation.
- Maintain accurate documentation, forecasts, marketing plans, CRM records, contracts, purchase orders, samples and other administrative requirements.
- Coordinate vendors, agencies and external partners and ensure deliverables are completed according to agreed timelines and budgets.
- Track key marketing KPIs and use performance data to support continuous improvement.
- Ensure all marketing, promotional, educational and event activities comply with company policies, healthcare regulations, industry codes and applicable compliance requirements.


Qualifications & Experience:

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biomedical Science or a related discipline.
- Approximately 2–4 years of professional experience, ideally in brand, product or healthcare marketing.
- Experience in medical devices, pharmaceuticals, healthcare or life sciences is preferred.
- Experience in Advanced Wound Care, surgical care or related specialties would be advantageous.
- Previous exposure to Sales, clinical applications or other customer-facing roles is advantageous.
- Exposure to digital marketing, product launches, events or healthcare professional engagement would be beneficial.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

- Good understanding of healthcare markets, customer needs and market dynamics.
- Good knowledge of brand management, marketing strategy and campaign development.
- Ability to translate market and customer insights into effective marketing initiatives.
- Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.
- Strong analytical and commercial acumen, with the ability to use data and insights to support business decisions.
- Strong project-management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage campaigns, events, budgets and multiple priorities.
- Ability to develop clear, compelling and evidence-based product messaging and marketing materials.
- Proactive, adaptable and comfortable working in a lean and dynamic environment.
- Strong learning agility, collaborative mindset and willingness to take ownership.
- Strong ethics, integrity and commitment to compliance.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office; familiarity with CRM and digital marketing tools is advantageous.


Working Conditions:

- Field & Office-Based Work: Primarily office-based, with regular field engagement alongside Sales and healthcare professionals.
- Travel & Customer Engagement: Local travel may be required to support customer meetings, field visits, product demonstrations, clinical education, conferences and exhibitions.
- Flexible Working Hours: Occasional evening or weekend work may be required to support professional events, conferences and collaboration with Regional or Global teams.
- Regional Collaboration: Occasional overseas travel within APAC may be required.
