title: Glucerna/Therapeutics Marketing Manager
description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Our nutrition business develops science-based nutrition products for people of all ages, from helping babies and children grow, to keeping adult bodies strong and active. Millions of people around the world count on our leading brands – including Similac®, PediaSure®, Pedialyte®, Ensure® and Glucerna® – to help get the nutrients they need to live their healthiest life.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to :



- Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
- A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
- A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

As the Marketing Manager, Glucerna & Therapeutics, you will be responsible for driving brand growth for the Glucerna and Therapeutics portfolio across the Asia Pacific region. This role combines Business Planning, Upstream and Consumer Marketing, including Brand Planning, brand restaging, and HCP engagement, with hands-on downstream execution for consumer marketing. You will partner closely with in-country marketing teams, medical/scientific affairs, and HCP-facing commercial teams to translate regional strategy into locally executed programs while managing multiple concurrent regional projects across markets.

What You’ll Do



- Conduct market scoping and landscape analysis across Asia Pacific markets to identify white-space opportunities, emerging consumer needs, and competitive threats for Glucerna and Therapeutics.
- Design and commission consumer and market research (quantitative and qualitative) to generate actionable insights that inform brand strategy and innovation pipelines.
- Lead brand restaging projects, including positioning, messaging architecture, and go-to-market strategy, in partnership with regional and global brand teams.
- Develop the annual regional marketing plan and brand strategy, aligning cross-functional stakeholders (medical, regulatory, sales, finance, e-commerce) around shared priorities.
- Build and execute HCP engagement strategies, including scientific communication plans, KOL engagement, medical education programs, and congress activities.
- Partner with Medical Affairs to translate clinical and scientific evidence into HCP-facing marketing materials and detailing tools that support field sales teams.
- Ensure all HCP-directed materials comply with local regulatory, medical, and legal review requirements across multiple Asia Pacific markets.
- Develop and execute integrated consumer marketing campaigns (digital, social, e-commerce, in-store) that build brand equity and drive trial and conversion.
- Manage agency partners and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver campaign assets on time, on budget, and on brand across multiple markets simultaneously.
- Track and report campaign performance against KPIs, using data-driven insights to optimize in-flight activity and inform future planning.
- Act as the regional point of contact for in-country marketing teams, balancing multiple concurrent projects, timelines, and priorities across the Asia Pacific portfolio.
- Manage budgets, timelines, and vendor relationships, ensuring efficient allocation of resources across strategic and execution workstreams.

Requirements



- Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing (Master’s degree or MBA preferred).
- 5–8 years of experience in marketing or strategic marketing roles, ideally spanning both upstream brand strategy and downstream campaign execution.
- Experience within the healthcare, nutrition, pharmaceutical, or FMCG industry, with exposure to both HCP-facing and consumer-facing marketing.
- Demonstrated experience leading market research, market scoping, and brand restaging projects from insight generation through to execution.
- Experience in launching products in Asia Pacific.
- Strong stakeholder management skills, with proven ability to influence cross-functionally and work effectively with in-country marketing, medical, and sales teams across diverse Asia Pacific markets.
- Implemented best-in-class HCP events at a local or regional level.
- Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities and deliver against tight timelines in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
- Willingness to travel across the Asia Pacific region as required.
- Background in Diabetes and Oncology preferred.

title: Brand & Communications Manager
description:
Start2 Group is a global innovation leader taking your startup journey to the next level. As a premier startup ecosystem platform, Start2 Group serves as the ultimate destination for growth-oriented startups, corporations, investors, and governments to shape and scale ventures with growth potential.


Founded in 2008, Start2 Group has consistently played a pivotal role in the success stories of thousands of startups, guiding them seamlessly from initial fundraising to global expansion. We operate in key markets across Europe, the Americas, Asia, and the Middle East, shaping the future of innovation on a global scale.


We are looking for a Brand & Communications Manager to elevate Start2 Group’s brand presence, shape compelling narratives, and strengthen engagement across the startup and innovation ecosystem. This role is ideal for a strategic communicator who enjoys combining storytelling, brand building, content creation, and community engagement in a fast-paced international environment.


The responsibilities outlined below are not exhaustive and can include other related tasks. The consultant will from time to time work for other projects as the company requires.


Role and Responsibilities
Brand & Communications Strategy

- Support the development and execution of Start2 Group’s brand and communications strategy across priority markets in Asia.
- Ensure brand consistency and messaging alignment across channels, regions, and programs.
- Strengthen Start2 Group and program brand positioning through compelling storytelling and ecosystem narratives.


Content & Storytelling

- Own and manage content creation across digital channels including LinkedIn, website, newsletters, email campaigns, presentations, and marketing collateral.
- Translate startup, corporate, and ecosystem activities into engaging stories, case studies, interviews, and thought leadership content.
- Develop and maintain editorial calendars aligned with program milestones, events, and business priorities.


PR & External Communications

- Support media outreach, press releases, PR distribution, and communication opportunities across regional markets.
- Coordinate external communications for partnerships, ecosystem collaborations, startup delegations, and market programs.
- Build visibility for Start2 Group through ecosystem and media amplification.


Event Communications

- Lead communications for flagship ecosystem events, startup programs, demo days, conferences, and partner activations.
- Develop event messaging, promotional assets, speaker communication support, and post-event content amplification.
- Ensure event outcomes are leveraged for brand awareness and stakeholder engagement.


Cross-functional Collaboration

- Collaborate closely with Program, Business Development, and regional teams to gather content opportunities and ensure communication alignment.
- Support leadership communications, presentations, and external-facing messaging where relevant.
- Coordinate with designers, freelancers, agencies, and ecosystem partners on communication deliverables.


Brand Governance

- Maintain brand standards, templates, tone of voice, and communication quality across markets.
- Ensure proper usage of Start2 Group and partner branding across assets and channels.


Performance Monitoring

- Track communication performance, social engagement, media visibility, and content effectiveness.
- Recommend improvements based on performance insights and business priorities.


Key Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Business, or a related field.
- 5+ years of experience in brand management, communications, content marketing, PR, or ecosystem/community marketing.
- Experience working in startups or supporting startup ecosystems (e.g., accelerators, incubators, venture programs, or innovation hubs).
- Proven experience managing multi-channel content and communication strategies.
- Strong experience in stakeholder management across cross-functional and multicultural teams.
- Experience supporting events, conferences, or ecosystem engagement initiatives is preferred.
- Experience managing social media, content marketing, and event planning.
- Passion for startups, entrepreneurship, and global business expansion.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.


Skills Required

- Strong brand storytelling and copywriting skills.
- Excellent content creation and editorial capabilities.
- Strong project management and coordination skills.
- Ability to translate complex topics into compelling narratives.
- Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
- Familiarity with social media management, email marketing, and digital communications.
- Proficiency in using digital tools (Slack, social media platforms, email marketing software, event platforms).
- Strong attention to detail and quality control.


Other Qualifications

- Experience working in international and fast-paced environments.
- Strong interest in startups, innovation, technology, and entrepreneurship ecosystems.
- Ability to work independently while coordinating across multiple regions and stakeholders.
- Comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
- Additional Asian language capabilities (Korean, Japanese, Mandarin, or Southeast Asian languages) are considered a plus.


We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: Senior Manager, Marketing (TNF ROA)
categories: Marketing Services and Retail Apparel and Fashion
description:
Role & Responsibilities: 

Position Definition (Key Purpose of the Position):

The position’s ultimate goal is to build The North Face to be the #1 Outdoor Brand in Rest of Asia. This role is to inspire, equip and enable the next generation of “Explorers” – to build an inclusive brand, to spark curiosity for adventure and to ensure they understand the latest product innovations that will help them achieve their goals.

This position is responsible to work with TNF Marketing APAC team closely to drive consumer-centric strategy and execution within APAC Integrated Marketing process that will differentiate TNF as the world-class brand & product storytelling experiences and activations that inspire and enable creative expression in our consumer in markets enlisted above. He/she will be responsible for managing the brand strategies, GTM process, campaigns, landing TNF global and APAC marketing tools and content, to connect with consumers throughout the purchase funnel, from planning to execution. This role requires a proven track record in people management, x-function collaboration, as well as in building strong brand and product marketing campaigns by leveraging the full marketing mix and delivering integrated solutions fully in line with our brand DNA and strategies.

He/she will be working closely with TNF Marketing head, responsible to collaborate closely with the APAC marketing team, ROA Omni Channel business and VM team, to ensure the markets will stay true to The North Face’s DNA, follow the TNF global and APAC brand guideline & campaign roadmap according to product booking, drive integrated marketing impact at brand and sales levels. Provide guidance against in market execution and coordination of plans to guide market-based brand managers.

The role’s responsibility will cover HongKong, Taiwan and TNF APAC distributor markets, with Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and the Philippines as priorities, covering Vietnam, Mongolia, Nepal and other markets’ needs on a regular basis.

He/she will:



- Work together with APAC Marketing head to manage TNF ROA GTM, seasonal brand roadmap, campaign planning, strategies, budget planning, guide ROA team on campaign executions and recap in designated markets. 
- Drive collaboration between Marketing / Omnichannel and Sales Ops/ Product as well as global marketing peers to deliver and improve marketing deliverables throughout the GTM process. 
- Manage and own ROA marketing budgets to maximize ROI and achieve financial plans. Track and monitor budget on a monthly basis to ensure compliance with company approved numbers
- Be the brand gate keeper, ensure TNF creative assets, digital/social/retail/EC presentation and BTL event activation/Sports IP on brand standard
- Support new store opening in ROA markets
- Consumer research, analysis, digital trends to fuel and support dynamic markets’ needs
- Athletes & outdoor community management & support, with key markets as priority
- Lead, coach and develop ROA marketing team, both from a structural and talent development standpoint. 
- Support other APAC related projects when needed

Key Result Areas:

Brand Stewardship:



- Be the Brand Gate Keeper for ROA, create and develop brand strategy and budget with APAC marketing peers to fulfil ROA market needs, ensure regional consistency and local relevancy. 
- Identify the right Global & APAC campaign assets for markets’ consumer touch points to fuel demand, raise brand awareness, engagement, and conversion. 
- Lead, coach, support marketing team based on key markets, be the value-add and indispensable brand partners. 

Consumer, Market & Business Intelligence:



- Share consumer insights with country teams to nurture consumer-led culture across the brand, leverage and integrate consumer insights to deliver effective consumer led campaigns and brand experiences
- Work closely with VF digital hub & CI team, and other sources to identify actionable insights, opportunities and key projects that will support APD markets’ brand development. 

Brand Planning & Execution Excellence: 



- Drive collaboration between ROA business team & APAC Marketing peers to deliver and improve marketing deliverables throughout the markets’ GTM (Go To Market ) process, ensure brand drivers & marketing key styles are aligned, ultimately to drive brand campaign execution consistency. 
- Guide the country’s marketing team to plan & execute seasonal campaigns with targeted KPIs, including Performance & Sportswear categories, UE in designated markets, across marketing functions including Digital (social, CLM, EC), VM, PR, Sports Marketing and Events. 
- Support marketplace transformation strategy, amplify L2/L2+ and other new stores’ marketing activations, drive consumer & community energy at designated retail destinations. 
- Help country’s marketing team to set up KPIs and ‘how to measure’ methods, guide them measure marketing KPIs & ROI based on APAC brand planning guide. 
- Report and recap with clear actions & follows; ensure the markets share campaign plans, recaps based on APAC brand cadences and templates. 

Athletes & Community Management Support:



- ROA Athletes and community strategy (work with APAC Sports MKT team)
- Trail athletes & community in top countries, TNF100 landing in ROA markets
- Climb athletes & communities in top countries

Competency Requirements : 

Behavioral Competencies -

(Please refer to VF guiding principles)



-  High EQ in working with cross function/multi-cultural partners
- Experience in managing complex organizational matrix (Region to markets)
- People management skill and experience
- Understanding of outdoor sports and business
- Understanding of retail
- Understanding of ROA key markets (HK, TW, Some APD markets etc)
-  Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (oral and written) with team of multi-cultural background, a leader as well as a pleasant team player
-  Entrepreneurial & result-driven
-  Presentation skill- both written and verbal English communication skill, able to produce impactful and succinct reports, content calendar, analysis, and recommendation on action
-  Optimistic and dare to take calculated risks
-  Team player and the ability to work independently
-  Communication and influence regionally, internally and externally with partners
-  Bold and creative thinking
-  Patient and resilient, able to work under pressure with multiple tasks simultaneously while meeting tight deadlines
-  Willing to travel

Functional Competencies –

List down specific set of functional skills required to perform in this role



- Deep understanding of The North Face brand with a passion for the outdoor industries
- Understanding of integrated marketing functions (PR, Digital, Retail and Events)
- Understanding of Go-to-market process and Brand planning process

Experience

Minimum Relevant Experience: 8+ years’ experience in brand marketing role managing full marketing mix and direct reports.

Study and/or working experiences in HK, TW, or SEA countries (Singapore is preferred).

Academic Qualifications

Minimum Degree Held: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or above;

A preference for majors in Marketing, Communication or Business Management, though not mandatory.

Language Proficiency:



- Fluent in English (native speaker preferred)

Frequency of Travel: As required.

- Flexibility for travel when required.

title: Marketing & Communications Lead
description:

Reporting to the Marketing and Communications International Lead, you will be responsible for developing and executing the marketing and go-to-market brand strategy for our Singapore markets.

You will ensure seamless integration with broader growth initiatives. Taking a multi-market approach, the GTM strategy will be designed to test, optimise, and lead marketing initiatives and brand activations in order to accelerate market entry, introduce the CPA Australia Brand, grow and retain membership base across the assigned markets. The Marketing Lead will also act as the market subject matter expert in the creation of marketing and brand campaigns, ensuring marketing activities deliver genuine cut-through and engagement in local markets.

Your Key Duties:



- Brand Promotion, Enhance the brand awareness and visibility through marketing and PR activities for assigned markets as well as supporting our global brand campaigns. 
- Marketing Execution, work with the central marketing delivery team to ensure global campaigns are optimized for assigned markets. 
- Conceptualise, develop and execute targeted marketing campaigns to drive participation in our major events and CPD Programs in the assigned markets for members and industry stakeholders. 
- Identify relevant content angles and unique selling propositions (USPs) for assigned markets to enhance online and offline visibility 
- Act as a regional marketing and communication expert in the creation of localised market content, ensuring marketing activities deliver genuine cut-through and engagement in local markets. 
- Support the regional market communication strategy to position. 
- Develop and localise content to earn media exposure in the assigned markets. 
- Support external stakeholder management with the BD team, such as government, regulatory bodies, media, and key members.

- Previous experience of marketing and communication ideally within growth markets 
- Experience in GTM strategy and implementation for successful market penetration 
- Ability to think strategically and communicate confidently across various marketing channels. 
- Enjoy working cross functionally across different markets. 
- Strong experience working with internal and external stakeholders, organizations, industry bodies and government agencies to drive brand trust and awareness. 
- Tertiary qualifications in Business, Marketing, or Communications

At CPA Australia, we’re proud of our vibrant, values-led culture. We live by our core values: Create Opportunity, Pursue Excellence, and Achieve Together—and they shape everything we do.

Here’s what makes working here special:

- Incentives that reward you – Participate in our annual incentive scheme.

CPA Australia is Australia’s leading professional accounting body and one of the largest in the world. We have more than 175,000 members in over 100 countries and regions. Our core services include education, training, technical support and advocacy. CPA Australia provides thought leadership on local, national and international issues affecting the accounting profession and public interest. We engage with governments, regulators and industries to advocate policies that stimulate sustainable economic growth and have positive business and public outcomes.

We are values-based organisation underpinned by the CPA Australia Way, which is our commitment to each other and a way of working. It is the foundation of our success, experienced and lived by our people, and felt by members.

title: Global Campaigns Lead
description:
Secretlab is an international ergonomic chair and desk brand powering over 3 million users worldwide, with key markets across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.


Positioned at the intersection of brand strategy, product narrative, and culture, this role serves as a key strategic partner to leadership, working closely with the Head of Global Comms to chart the next phase of Secretlab’s growth. This role will shape how we communicate our brand and products globally.


Rather than managing routine content streams, you will fundamentally rethink our approach to category messaging. Your mandate spans reimagining long-term brand storytelling, pioneering next-generation content strategies—including leveraging AI for brand visibility and search—and establishing dynamic short-form video frameworks that capture modern audiences across digital touchpoints.


Responsibilities

- Develop campaign strategies from first principles by defining objectives, audience, messaging, creative direction and success measures.
- Translate business priorities into compelling creative concepts, visual systems and storytelling that guide end-to-end campaign execution.
- Define campaign messaging and copy direction to ensure a clear and consistent narrative across all touchpoints.
- Own the creative quality and strategic alignment of assigned global campaigns from concept through launch.
- Review and refine campaign deliverables to ensure they meet creative objectives before stakeholder reviews.
- Proactively identify creative risks, recommend solutions and align stakeholders on the best path forward.
- Raise the overall quality of creative output by providing campaign strategy direction, guidance, and feedback across the team.
- Establish and evolve campaign management frameworks, messaging guidelines, and best practices to drive consistency across global campaigns.
- Partner closely with Product Owners and cross-functional teams to shape campaign direction and deliver impactful creative outcomes.
- Review campaign outcomes and incorporate learnings to continuously improve future campaigns and creative standards.


Requirements

- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Design, Advertising, Communications, Marketing or a related discipline.
- Minimum 6 years of experience in creative, brand or campaign roles, with experience leading integrated marketing campaigns from strategy through execution.
- Strong marketing and creative thinking, with the ability to translate business objectives into compelling campaign strategies, messaging and creative concepts.
- Exceptional strategic thinking with a strong eye for brand storytelling, campaign consistency, and messaging alignment across integrated marketing channels.
- Proven ability to lead creative quality by providing direction, constructive feedback, and mentorship to multidisciplinary creative teams.
- Excellent presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to confidently articulate and defend creative decisions.
- Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and a strong understanding of digital marketing channels, content formats and creative production workflows.


Bonuses

- Experience leading global or integrated marketing campaigns.
- Experience directing photography, video or motion productions.
- Experience mentoring creatives or establishing creative standards across a team.
- Exceptional art direction or copywriting skills with a strong eye for visual or verbal storytelling, design systems and brand consistency across channels.

title: Brand Manager
description:
LUXASIA is the leading and largest beauty omnichannel brand-builder of Asia Pacific. Do you have what it takes to succeed in a fast-paced and intense environment? Do you thrive on challenges? Do you want to bring innovative ideas to life? Are you keen to abandon the status quo, try new things, embrace failures as lessons, recover fast, yet always pursue excellence?

title: Assistant Brand Manager
description:
Position

The Opportunity…

At Moët Hennessy, We Don't Just Create Exceptional Experiences - We Live Them.

For generations, our 27 Maisons, including Dom Pérignon, Veuve Clicquot, and Hennessy, have defined luxury. Now, it's your turn. Imagine a career fueled by passion and creativity, where you redefine what's possible. We seek individuals who thrive in collaborative environments, sharing our love for craftsmanship, elegance, and integrity. We celebrate diversity and the pursuit of excellence.

We're thrilled to announce an opening for an Assistant Brand Manager. Reporting to the Senior Brand Manager, you will be responsible for developing marketing strategies and plans for the Hennessy portfolio to maximize brand equity and drive business growth in the market.

We are looking for an ambitious, dynamic, and detail-oriented marketer who is passionate about building iconic brands. In this role, you will play a critical part in executing the local marketing strategy, driving brand desirability, and accelerating growth for the Hennessy portfolio. A key focus will be leading strategic activations and trade partnerships across channels, while strengthening on-trade and retail visibility through impactful consumer experiences.

You will also be responsible for building strong agency partnerships and leading the flawless execution of brand campaigns and on-ground activations. In addition to managing the A&P budget and monitoring market and consumer trends, you will work closely with Management and Sales teams to achieve business objectives.

At Moët Hennessy, we are committed to creating a workplace where people aspire to grow and thrive. We empower our people, value diverse perspectives, and foster a culture built on inclusivity, honesty, and authenticity.

You will have the opportunity to work in an innovative and cross-cultural environment where you will be encouraged to develop your entrepreneurial mindset and pioneering spirit. We support our people in pursuing their career aspirations and exploring mobility opportunities across countries, as well as within both Moët Hennessy and the wider LVMH Group.

If you want to inspire and be inspired, to craft exceptional experiences while experiencing the very best in craftsmanship, Moët Hennessy is where you'll flourish.

Job Responsibilities

How you will contribute…

1) Marketing & Business Strategy



- Contribute to the development of the long-term strategic plan for Singapore. 
- Define and implement marketing strategies for your brands aligned with business objectives, brand equity, market dynamics, and consumer-centric principles across all touchpoints of the consumer journey. 
- Drive the creation and execution of annual 360° marketing plans, including product launches, campaign prioritization, experiential concepts, ATL/BTL activations, budget allocation, and ROI measurement. 
- Partner closely with the Commercial and Sales teams to develop channel-specific strategies, promotions, visibility programs, and trade partnerships that drive brand desirability and business growth. 
- Support the Senior Brand Manager in executing the local marketing calendar, new product launches, and thematic campaigns. 

2) Marketing, Digital & PR Activations



- Directly manage end-to-end brand management. 
- Lead the conceptualization, planning, and delivery of activation campaigns across various channels (digital, out-of-home media, experiential, visual merchandising, and channel plans) in close collaboration with the Commercial team. 
- Develop and execute localized marketing and trade initiatives across key consumer touchpoints, ensuring strong brand visibility and premium consumer experiences. 
- Lead holistic amplification plans across paid, owned, and earned channels with a strong audience- and culture-led approach. 
- Drive excellence by collaborating with internal and external partners to maximize brand visibility, impact, and consumer engagement while ensuring consistent campaign performance tracking. 
- Plan and execute experiential events, trade activations, tastings, and consumer engagement programs to drive brand equity and commercial performance. 
- Manage and evaluate Media, PR, and BTL agencies to achieve optimum performance across all executions. 
- Monitor various aspects of brand performance through market visits, research, and trade feedback. 

3) Partnerships & Stakeholder Management



- Work closely with the other Senior Brand Managers to ensure alignment of priorities, ways of working, communication, and team spirit across the full MH portfolio. 
- Be able to articulate and share a clear vision with key stakeholders regarding Singapore consumers, market dynamics, and cultural specificities. 
- Cultivate and manage relationships with key stakeholders across the region, Maisons, agencies, customers, and industry influencers. 
- Collaborate closely with Customer Marketing teams to ensure effective execution of key brand initiatives and commercial programs. 
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between marketing strategies and business objectives (Retail, Finance, Maisons, Media, Digital, E-retail, etc.). 
- Promote the SEA markets within the Group through regular communication and influence. 

4) Analytics, Financial Management & Operations



- Monitor market, consumer, and channel trends to identify opportunities and risks. 
- Track and analyze campaign performance, volume, market share, and ROI to generate actionable insights and recommendations. 
- Manage A&P budgets, purchase orders, vendor relationships, and financial tracking to ensure effective investment management. 
- Coordinate with Supply Chain, Logistics, and regional stakeholders to ensure product availability and timely delivery of brand assets. 

Profile

We are looking for unique and amazing talent. Join us if you have…



- Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related discipline. 
- 3+ years of experience in Brand Management, Marketing, Trade Marketing, or Category Management, preferably within FMCG, luxury, consumer goods, or wines & spirits industries. 
- Experience in project management, brand activations, and agency management. 
- Strong commercial, marketing, and digital mindset, with a good understanding of consumer behavior, market trends, and brand performance analytics. 
- Experience working closely with Sales and cross-functional stakeholders to drive business growth and brand visibility. 
- Understanding of Singapore's consumer landscape, on-trade environment, and premium hospitality channels would be an advantage. 
- Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and levels. 
- Results-driven, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
- Fluent in English; proficiency in additional languages would be an advantage. 
- Comfortable working outside of regular business hours on occasion. 

Additional Information

When you join Moët Hennessy…



- You embark on a career journey with the leaders of luxury wines, champagnes, and spirits, within the prestigious LVMH Group. 
- You enter a world of possibility where career development opportunities across our 5 global regions and within the entire LVMH Group are unmatched. 
- You join a passionate workforce within our internationally diverse and inclusive teams, exploring the rich heritage of our Maisons and shaping the next chapter of our story
- You discover our essential relationship with our terroirs and the soils that define our products. Through our Living Soils Living Together program, we are committed to regenerating soils, reducing climate impact, and empowering communities for a sustainable future. 
- You will share in our passion for hosting, the art of living, and creating products that celebrate life’s most memorable milestones, always experienced through responsible tasting. 

Ready for a world of possibilities? Discover Moët Hennessy today!

title: Global Assistant Brand Manager - Vaseline
description:
JOB TITLE: GLOBAL ASSISTANT BRAND MANAGER - VASELINE

LOCATION: SINGAPORE

About Unilever International

Unilever International is Unilever's agile, entrepreneurial route to market for white-space and complementary portfolio opportunities. We bring iconic brands and new formats to consumers across geographies and channels, working with a founder's mindset to serve underserved demand. Our people connect global scale with local opportunity, move decisively across boundaries and build practical solutions that unlock growth.

Job Purpose

This role will help shape and deliver the next phase of growth for Skincare brands across Unilever International. The Assistant Global Brand Manager will translate the Vaseline Skincare Body growth strategy into a focused innovation and market deployment agenda, with end-to-end ownership across new product development, tailored local marketing plans and global innovation roll-outs.

This is a commercially accountable brand-building role for an experienced marketer who can move confidently between strategy and execution. The role will identify growth opportunities across Petroleum Jelly, Body Lotions and emerging formats; build compelling business cases; lead cross-functional innovation; and partner with markets to land launches and campaigns with pace, relevance and excellence.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Vaseline is one of our priority growth brands within Unilever International, with significant opportunity to strengthen the total Body portfolio. The role provides dedicated leadership to convert global pipelines and local market opportunities into scalable, profitable growth. It will connect Global Brand, Business Group and Business Unit teams with R&D, Supply Chain, Finance, Customer Development, regulatory, agencies and market partners, ensuring that the right innovations and marketing plans reach consumers with strong commercial discipline.

What Will Your Main Responsibilities Be



- Own the Skincare Body growth agenda: Support the development and execution of a clear, multi-year growth strategy across core and emerging body formats, grounded in consumer needs, market whitespace, brand fit and commercial attractiveness.
- Lead end-to-end New Product Development: Translate priority opportunities into robust innovation projects, from insight, concept and proposition through business case, product development, packaging, claims, launch readiness and post-launch review.
- Build an efficient innovation roll-out engine: Work with the Beauty & Wellbeing Innovations Lead and cross-functional partners to improve portfolio deployment, engage the right stakeholders at the right stage and accelerate projects that meet size-of-prize and profitability guardrails.
- Drive global innovation roll-outs: Assess global innovations for Unilever International, define the right market and portfolio fit, adapt the mix where required and lead disciplined deployment across priority markets.
- Create tailored local marketing plans: Partner with Business Unit Brand Leads and Business Development teams to translate global brand platforms into locally relevant plans across key visuals, digital, retail activation, PR, influencer and customer programmes.
- Lead major brand campaigns: Own selected Body campaigns and activation programmes, ensuring that the strategic idea, asset ecosystem and market deployment plan build the total brand and support priority ranges.
- Shape the long-range innovation plan: Build and maintain a three-year innovation roadmap for Body, mapping global pipelines and local whitespace
- Make commercially grounded choices: Develop size-of-prize, pricing, margin and investment cases with Finance and Supply Chain; prioritize the highest-value opportunities; and recommend where to scale, adapt, defer or stop.
- Own performance tracking: Monitor the total Body P&L and launch scorecards, including turnover, incremental turnover, underlying sales growth, gross margin, brand investment and unit economics, translating performance into clear corrective actions.
- Lead cross-functional delivery: Align Brand, R&D, Supply Chain, procurement, Finance, Customer Development, regulatory, legal, artwork, agencies and markets around clear milestones, decisions, risks and accountable owners.
- Influence senior stakeholders: Prepare sharp recommendations and leadership updates, surface risks early and drive timely decisions across a complex global and regional stakeholder network.
- The roles of duties are not exhaustive and may change according to business requirements. 

What You Need To Succeed

Essential experience and qualifications



- 3-5 years of relevant brand management, innovation, category or commercial marketing experience, preferably within FMCG, beauty, personal care or consumer healthcare.
- Demonstrated experience owning meaningful brand or innovation workstreams from strategy through execution, with clear evidence of commercial thinking and delivery impact.
- Strong grounding in core marketing fundamentals, including consumer insight, positioning, innovation development, marketing mix creation, communications, go-to-market planning and performance evaluation.
- Experience building business cases and using P&L, market, consumer and customer data to make prioritization decisions.
- Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and external partners across markets and time zones, influencing without formal authority and resolving ambiguity with ownership.
- Strong project leadership, with the discipline to manage milestones, dependencies, risks, budgets and decision forums across multiple concurrent initiatives.
- Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to present recommendations, challenge constructively and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders.
- Bachelor degree or equivalent experience in marketing, business, economics, communications or a related discipline.

Preferred Experience



- Experience in global or regional brand management, innovation development, portfolio strategy, localisation or multi-market deployment.
- Experience working on skincare, body care or adjacent beauty and personal care categories.
- Exposure to product, packaging, claims and artwork development, with an understanding of regulatory and production requirements.
- Experience partnering with Customer Development or commercial teams to translate brand strategy into channel and customer activation.
- Flexibility to support occasional early-morning or evening meetings across Asia, Europe and North America when critical business milestones require it.

Core Skills



- Brand strategy and portfolio management
- Consumer and market insight
- End-to-end innovation and NPD leadership
- Integrated marketing and local market activation
- Commercial acumen and P&L understanding
- Business case development and prioritisation
- Cross-functional leadership and senior stakeholder influence
- Structured problem solving and decision quality
- Project and budget management
- Learning agility, resilience and ownership

THE LEADERSHIP WE EXPECT

You operate as a brand owner, not a project coordinator. You can frame the opportunity, make a recommendation, align diverse stakeholders and drive the work through to measurable market impact. You stay close enough to the detail to protect quality while keeping sight of the strategic and commercial objective. You are curious about consumers, decisive with data, comfortable challenging established approaches and motivated by building repeatable growth platforms rather than delivering isolated activities.

TO APPLY

Please apply online by clicking on the “Apply” button. Your application will be reviewed against our requirements. Should you not meet our immediate requirements, your profile will be registered in our talent pool system, and we will match your profile to suitable future vacancies.

You will be able to access your status update through the candidate tracking link.

In line with Singapore Government regulations, we are committed to giving priority to local Singaporean candidates during our hiring process. Applications from foreign candidates will be considered if suitable local talent is not available

There’s more to Unilever than the role. Discover our people, culture, and everyday life on our Life at Unilever Singapore.

Thank you for your interest and application.

Unilever is an organisation committed to equity, inclusion and diversity to drive our business results and create a better future, every day, for our diverse employees, global consumers, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. At Unilever we are interested in every individual bringing their ‘Whole Self’ to work and this includes you! Thus if you require any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of your application so that we can support you through your recruitment journey.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
The Marketing Manager is a leadership role responsible for shaping and driving Hegen’s brand and growth strategy across key markets. The ideal candidate is both strategic and hands-on, someone who can translate insights into action, manage multiple campaigns with precision, and continuously refine approaches based on data and market trends. This role offers the opportunity to take end-to-end ownership of marketing initiatives and contribute directly to the growth of a purpose-driven, internationally recognised brand.


Key Responsibilities:

- Use analytics and insights to evaluate campaign effectiveness against defined KPIs, optimize in real time, and inform future strategy.
- Prepare monthly reports on progress versus strategy, identifying key learnings and growth opportunities.


Cross-Market Synergy & Partnerships

- Ensure alignment of brand message, positioning, and creative expression across all international markets.
- Identify and build strategic partnerships (brands, communities, media, influencers) that expand Hegen’s reach and reinforce its advocacy for mothers worldwide.
- Manage agency and vendor relationships to deliver excellence in creative output and execution.


Leadership & Team Development

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of high-performing, impact-driven marketers to deliver breakthrough campaigns with precision and heart.
- Foster a collaborative and agile culture within the marketing team, ensuring alignment with evolving business needs and brand ambitions.

- Bring fresh creative and data-driven thinking to marketing challenges, ensuring the brand remains ahead of consumer expectations.


Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related discipline
- 5 to 8 years of integrated marketing experience, including progression into a managerial capacity
- Prior experience in FMCG, parenting, lifestyle, or consumer goods industries preferred
- Proven track record of developing and executing multi-channel marketing campaigns with measurable business impact
- Experience managing agencies and cross-functional stakeholders effectively
- Strong understanding of digital, social, and performance marketing, including analytics and optimisation
- Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable marketing insights
- Experience leading or mentoring a marketing team, with ability to set direction and drive accountability
- Strategic, data-driven with strong commercial acumen and organisational skills
- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and project management skills
- Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile and entrepreneurial environment


At Hegen, we redefine the parenting experience with award-winning innovations tailored for mothers and their little ones. As a trusted brand in mother and baby products, our mission is to empower mothers in their breastfeeding journey and ease the transition into parenthood through meaningful products and services. Recognised as one of Singapore’s top 10 fastest growing companies, Hegen takes pride in creating practical solutions that combine thoughtful designs with functionality and sustainability for time-strapped parents.


Equal Opportunity & Data Protection Statement
Hegen is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. By submitting your application, you consent to the collection, use and disclosure of your personal data for recruitment and employment-related purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws.


Join Us
At Hegen, we are passionate about fostering a purpose-driven, inclusive and collaborative work environment where every team member can thrive. We are committed to supporting personal growth and offering opportunities for career development at every stage of your journey.
Join us in realising our bold vision of impacting 100 million mothers worldwide through innovation, compassion, and excellence. If you are inspired to make a difference and grow with a dynamic team, apply now and embark on an exciting journey with Hegen.

title: Brand Manager.
description:
LUXASIA is the leading and largest beauty omnichannel brand-builder of Asia Pacific. Since 1986, it has successfully enabled market entry and brand growth for more than 100 luxury beauty brands, the likes of Albion, Aveda, Bvlgari, Calvin Klein, Creed, Diptyque, Hermes, La Prairie, Maison Francis Kurkdjian, Montblanc, Rabanne, Ferragamo, and SK-II. Why Join Us?

At LUXASIA, we believe there is beauty within every talent - that is you.

We grow you by building your competencies and unleashing your potential. We have curated a vast portfolio of over 100 luxury brands across Asia Pacific and growing. Your work will enrich the lives of millions of consumers across the region. With us, you get to be an entrepreneur, running the business like it is your very own. Together as #OneTeam, we celebrate differences, embrace change, explore new ideas, take risks, fail fast, and drive results. While challenges at work are inevitable, the journey promises to be fulfilling.

With LUXASIA, an exciting career filled with robust professional growth awaits you. Isn't that beautiful?

Key Responsibilities

Channel & Retail Marketing

- Business and channel sales performance tracking and analysis, launch follow-up and action plan development
- Implement Door-by-Door Marketing plan (CRM, events and promotions)
- Budget Management: Responsible for full P&L 


Customer Relationship Marketing (CRM)



- Defines the Brand's local CRM campaign priorities
- Builds CRM campaign calendar
- Ensures that customer segmentation remain up to date and relevant for each campaign
- Develops relevant and engaging brand communications behind the right product mix

- Strategize, develop and execute CRM programs for the brand

Requirements



- More than 4 years of brand management and/or marketing experience in beauty and/or FMCG industry
- Experience in luxury beauty or consumer brand will be advantageous
- Good business insights to the industry and strong business acumen
- Good analytical skills, problem solver, self-starter with an entrepreneurial spirit
- Strong understanding of the P&L of the business.

- Proven track sales record in a target driven environment
- Strong people management experience with the ability to motivate, inspire, coach and develop people
- Meticulous with a strong analytical mind
- Creatively driven to think out of the box
- Strong ability to multi-task; strong project management skills with good time management ability

title: Marketing Manager (Shop by COMO)
description:
The COMO Group represents an integrated approach to living well, grounded in a celebration of diversity and a deep respect for authenticity. The Group’s businesses extend across hospitality (COMO Hotels and Resorts), fashion (Club21, Kids21, Dover Street Market Singapore), wellness (COMO Shambhala), organic living and specialty foods (COMO Dempsey, Culina and SuperNature) and philanthropy (COMO Foundation).


Shop by COMO (SBC) is the curated lifestyle retail arm of the COMO Group, bridging the worlds of fashion, wellness and luxury hospitality.


Job Summary
We are seeking a resourceful, commercially driven Marketing Manager to lead the marketing engine for Shop by COMO. This is a hands-on retail marketing role responsible for turning product, brand and trading priorities into campaigns and communications that drive traffic, conversion and revenue. The ideal candidate combines strong commercial and e-commerce thinking with excellent copywriting and brand instincts, and will work closely with e-commerce, merchandising, product and the wider COMO ecosystem to grow the business while maintaining a luxury lifestyle positioning.


Key Responsibilities


Marketing Strategy & Campaigns

- Own the annual marketing strategy and calendar, aligning brand, product, seasonal and commercial priorities. 
- Translate SBC’s brand pillars into compelling consumer narratives, campaigns and content. 
- Plan and execute seasonal, product and tactical campaigns in line with inventory, launches and key trading opportunities. 
- Define campaign objectives, audiences, messaging, timing and channel strategy, and guide creative development.


Retail Trading

- Work closely with e-commerce and merchandising to drive traffic, conversion and revenue. 
- Identify opportunities across product launches, trading periods, and customer behaviour. 
- Use performance and customer insights to optimise marketing activity and improve commercial results. 
- Lead CRM and lifecycle initiatives to drive customer acquisition, engagement, retention and repeat purchase


Content, Copywriting & Communications

- Develop campaign concepts, messaging and customer-facing content across CRM, social, onsite, editorial and PR.
- Write and edit high-quality campaign copy, press releases, email communications and product storytelling.
- Ensure communications are both compelling and consistent with SBC’s luxury positioning and tone of voice.


COMO Ecosystem, PR & Partnerships

- Leverage the wider COMO ecosystem to build awareness and create opportunities to convert COMO guests and customers into SBC customers. 
- Work across business units and external partners to develop relevant collaborations, partnerships and communications opportunities. 
- Manage PR, affiliates and external partners to maximise brand visibility and reach.


Budget & Performance

- Manage the annual marketing budget, prioritising activity based on commercial objectives and return on investment.
- Track key marketing and e-commerce KPIs and use insights to inform priorities and investment. 
- Balance luxury brand equity with commercial performance and operational discipline.


Prerequisite

- 8+ years of marketing experience across luxury retail, fashion, hospitality or lifestyle. 
- Proven experience developing and executing marketing strategies that drive commercial and e-commerce growth. 
- Strong retail and e-commerce understanding, including product, customer journey, conversion and trading considerations. 
- Excellent copywriting skills, with experience developing campaign, editorial content. 
- Strategic thinker who can also drive execution. 
- Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate a complex, multi-business-unit environment. 
- Resourceful, highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities in dynamic environment. 
- Strong eye for luxury aesthetics, design and brand expression.

title: Brand Marketing Manager
description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Brand Marketing Manager to lead the activation, execution, and management of brand marketing campaigns across global markets. You will manage advertising campaigns across digital channels, collaborate with internal teams and external agencies, and use data-driven insights to deliver measurable brand recognition and engagement.


Key Responsibilities

- Brand Campaign Activation, Execution & Management: Develop, activate, and manage brand marketing campaigns across social media, programmatic, YouTube, and local media, partnering with Content, Performance Marketing, Creative, Brand & PR teams, and external agencies to deliver against defined KPIs
- Agency & Project Management: Brief, steer, and hold creative and advertising agencies accountable for output quality and deadlines, overseeing project timelines, budgets, and deliverables across concurrent campaigns
- Creative & Brand Content Production: Drive end-to-end brand content creation from concept development and scriptwriting through production and post-production, ensuring all assets are visually compelling and consistent with brand guidelines
- Performance & Optimisation: Monitor, analyse, and report on key marketing metrics across all brand initiatives, anchoring activity to measurable outcomes including reach, engagement, conversion, and ROI to continuously optimise campaign performance
- Market Intelligence: Track global marketing trends, competitive landscapes, and consumer insights to inform brand strategy and ensure the brand remains relevant across markets


What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Business, or a related field, with 5+ years of experience in brand marketing combining in-house and agency exposure
- Proven ability to deliver measurable campaigns across multiple digital channels, with a strong understanding of paid media including budget allocation, performance reporting, and A/B testing; familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and GA4 is an advantage
- Prior experience working in and/or managing creative or advertising agencies is strongly preferred; experience in fintech, financial services, or technology industries is a plus
- Strong project management and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, agencies, and stakeholders simultaneously and present ideas persuasively to creative teams and business stakeholders
- Strong understanding of digital marketing analytics, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights that improve campaign performance

title: Senior Manager, Brand
description:
About DayOne Data Centers

DayOne Data Centers is a Singapore-headquartered global digital infrastructure platform that develops and operates next-generation data centers across Asia Pacific and Europe. Trusted by leading hyperscalers and businesses, the company engineers, builds, and operates high-capacity, AI-ready campuses with speed, scale, and reliability.

This is a strategic role responsible for defining the brand vision, ensuring consistent execution across markets, and overseeing the creative quality of DayOne’s global presence — from corporate identity and digital experiences to flagship events and thought leadership exposure. You will own the strategy, direction, and quality, guiding teams and external agencies to deliver a premium, globally consistent brand.

Role Summary

As The Brand Lead, You Will



-  Define and evolve DayOne’s brand strategy and identity
-  Lead creative direction across all visual and experiential assets
-  Shape the brand expression for global events and key milestones
-  Drive brand visibility through strategic sponsorships and industry presence
-  Govern brand consistency across regions, platforms, and content
-  Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure brand alignment
-  Manage creative agencies, production partners, and internal resources

Your mandate is to elevate DayOne into a globally recognisable, trusted, and differentiated brand in the digital infrastructure ecosystem.



-  Brand Strategy & Identity
-  Develop and refine DayOne’s brand strategy, positioning, and architecture.
-  Lead the evolution of the visual identity system, tone of voice, and brand guidelines.
-  Define how the brand expresses itself across markets, customer segments, and product categories.
-  Ensure brand clarity, differentiation, and relevance in the global digital infrastructure, cloud and AI ecosystem.
-  Creative & Design Leadership
-  Set the creative direction for all key brand assets, including corporate visual systems, digital interfaces, and experiential branding.
-  Lead the creative review and approval of major deliverables (visuals, design systems, imagery, digital concepts).
-  Collaborate with external agencies, production houses, and internal teams to uphold high standards.
-  Brand Experience for Events & Milestones
-  Define the brand look, feel, and thematic experience for flagship events, launches, and strategic announcements.
-  Create event-level brand frameworks that align with corporate positioning and regional priorities.
-  Ensure branded experiences are premium, consistent, and reflective of DayOne’s values.
-  Sponsorships, Visibility & Thought Leadership Exposure
-  Develop a strategic calendar of sponsorships, partnerships, and industry engagements that enhance DayOne’s brand equity.
-  Evaluate speaking opportunities and thought-leadership platforms that align with brand positioning.
-  Work with Communications and Product Marketing to ensure narrative consistency across appearances.
-  Digital & Website Brand Governance
-  Provide creative direction for DayOne’s website, digital brand systems, and new visual concepts.
-  Guide the integration of multimedia assets (e.g., photography, video, animations, 3D) into digital experiences.
-  Brand Governance & Quality Control
-  Establish a global brand governance framework to ensure consistency across all markets.
-  Maintain a brand library with templates, standards, and creative resources.
-  Conduct brand audits and implement improvements based on insights.
-  Cross-Functional Collaboration
-  Partner with Corporate Communications, Marketing, and Corporate Affairs to ensure brand-aligned messaging and visuals.
-  Work closely with all markets to guide local adaptation without diluting global standards.
-  Measurement & Brand Performance
-  Define and track brand KPIs such as visibility, consistency, recognition, and engagement across key audiences.
-  Ensure sponsorships and brand activation initiatives have measurable outcomes.

Qualifications Required



-  8–12 years in brand strategy, brand management, or creative direction, preferably in:
- technology / cloud / enterprise B2B
- Digital infrastructure / telecommunications
- industrial or professional services
-  Proven experience leading brand identity development at a regional or global level.
-  Strong ability to set creative direction and review high-quality visual work.
-  Experience managing branding for major corporate events or product launches.
-  Demonstrated success in managing agencies, production partners, and creative teams.
-  Excellent ability to translate business strategy into brand expression.
-  Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills.
-  Experience in branding for multi-country or multi-site infrastructure businesses.
-  Familiarity with digital brand systems, UI/UX design principles, or experiential design.
-  Exposure to fast-growth or transformation-stage organisations.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

title: Brand and Marketing Manager, SEA & India – Fenty Beauty
categories: Retail and Retail Luxury Goods and Jewelry
description:
ABOUT KENDO 
Kendo is the small but mighty force behind your favourite beauty products. A play on the words “can do,” Kendo is redefining the beauty industry through next-generation products, visionary campaigns and unforgettable retail presence. Kendo creates original founder brands, partnering with major faces from fashion and entertainment. The house of brands currently includes KVD Vegan Beauty, Fenty Beauty by Rihanna, Fenty Skin, Ole Henriksen, and Lip Lab. We tell their stories to bring to life the dream products you’ve always wanted but have never been able to find.


POSITION SUMMARY 
The Brand & Marketing Manager is responsible for orchestrating and executing the brand and marketing strategy for the SEA & India region. Reporting to the Senior Marketing Manager, this role leads the development and implementation of brand positioning, messaging, and consumer engagement across all touchpoints, ensuring a cohesive and impactful brand presence.
The Brand & Marketing Manager drives the planning and execution of comprehensive 360° marketing initiatives, manages the marketing calendar and budget, and collaborates closely with commercial, retail, and education teams to optimize brand performance and market share. Additionally, this role oversees in-store visual merchandising, leads special projects and consumer events, and partners with PR and social media teams to ensure alignment with brand objectives. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker and hands-on leader with deep experience in brand management and marketing within the beauty industry, a proven track record in the SEA & India markets, and a passion for building strong cross-functional relationships in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


RESPONSIBILITIES 
Brand Management 

- Responsible to strategize, define and implement the brands’ mission, objectives and positioning in the market. Oversees the consistency & timely delivery of brand messaging across all touchpoints and all stakeholders.
- Serves as the brands’ spokesperson, ensuring to maintain a cohesive narrative (brand messaging, brand positions, brand values) across PR, social media, Advertising, Retail & Education.
- Lead all brand meetings and support negotiations to secure optimal support from retail partners.
- Responsible to design and oversee the consumer engagement journey in collaboration with cross functional stakeholders to achieve brands objectives.
- Collaborate with cross functional team to consolidate and share consumer insights to global teams, offering region-specific product enhancement suggestions and championing regional requirements (from brand assets to engagement activities)
- Stay abreast of makeup trends, innovations, and regulatory changes in SEA & India. Analyse market trends, consumer behaviour, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and inform marketing plans. Integrate digital and social-first thinking into core brand strategies.
Marketing 

- Owns the development and management of Marketing Calendar. Responsible to design milestones to achieve brand strategy & aligned KPI. Responsible to ensure all key stakeholders are consulted, informed and aligned on the identified priority in a timely manner.
- Lead the planning and execution of comprehensive marketing strategies for SEA & India, spanning paid media, partnerships, promotions, CRM, sampling, retail events, and brand-led initiatives, ensuring alignment with overall brand direction.
- Own and manage the brand’s marketing budget, ensuring responsible spending and achievement of ROI targets.
- Collaborate with commercial, retail, and education teams to develop tools and materials that drive sell-through and optimize brand presence with retail partners and distributors.
- May be appointed to lead or participate in special projects (e.g., always-on campaigns, combat plans), ensuring brand cohesiveness, effective execution, and achievement of KPIs.
- Lead and oversees the end-to-end design and execution of consumer events, ensuring consistency with brand guidelines, objectives and delivering a cohesive brand experience.
- Define pricing strategies for new launches and review annual price adjustments. Lead product launch forecasting and collaborate with Planning and Retail teams to maintain optimal stock levels, particularly for key products (eg: Key bets, Top SKUs, Hot off Press etc)
- Lead the delivery of marketing projects and campaigns, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and timely execution.
- Measure and analyze the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and activities. Provide actionable insights and recommendations to the Senior Marketing Manager for continuous improvement.
PR 

- Partner with the PR and Social Media team to ensure all PR and social media strategies are aligned with brand objectives and guidelines.
Visual Merchandising 

- Oversee the brand’s in-store visual merchandising and gondola displays, ensuring they are updated seasonally to reflect new launches and discontinuations, and are consistent with brand guidelines.
- Work closely with the retail and education teams to ensure timely implementation of marketing mechanics and visual updates at the counter.
General 

- Foster strong relationships with internal teams and external partners to secure aligned support and resources for all marketing initiatives.
- Actively contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and creative team culture in line with Kendo SEA values. Mentor and support team members, promoting a positive and high-performance work environment.
- Identify and implement processes, tools, and procedures to enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of brand and marketing operations.
- Take ownership for achieving key brand KPIs, leveraging insights from the team and reporting progress and recommendations to the Senior Marketing Manager.


REQUIREMENTS 

- At least 7 years of experience in a Brand or Marketing role. Beauty Industry a plus.
- Experience in Southeast Asia and India markets is a plus
- Strategic thinker and brand builder.
- Team player that inspires others and collaborates cross functionally.
- The ability to work in a fast-paced environment and juggle multiple priorities.
- Strong organizational, keen attention to detail, follow-up skills, hands-on in getting things done.
- Strong business acumen and analytical skills, results oriented.
- Good interpersonal skills high level of integrity.
- Can do attitude, flexible with an ability to work with a level of ambiguity.
- Ability to deploy ideas effectively and present to Senior Management.
- Proactively collaborate to strengthen the core values and culture of Kendo Brands

title: Marketing Manager

title: Head, Brand
description:
Overview


The Head of Brand is a senior role sitting at the heart of The Kallang Group’s Brand, Marketing, Communications and Digital team. You will work closely and directly with the Group Head of Brand, Marketing, Communications and Digital, as the brand guardian and custodian of The Kallang Group.


We are looking for a visionary, high-energy Head of Brand to lead the evolution of The Kallang as the "excitement epicentre." Following our rebrand from the Singapore Sports Hub, this role sits at the heart of our shift into a world-class curator of the global experience economy.


As the Head of Brand, you will be the Brand Guardian for The Kallang. You will own the long-term brand strategy, define our brand architecture, and drive initiatives that build deep brand love and long-term equity.


Leading a team of passionate marketers, you will translate consumer insights into high-impact campaigns, cultivate strategic marketing partnerships, and manage agency ecosystems to deliver world-class brand experiences. You will ensure absolute consistency across all touchpoints while collaborating cross-functionally to drive commercial growth and brand loyalty.


Key Responsibilities:


Brand stewardship and architecture



- Brand Guardian: Custodian of the brand identity, ensuring all visual assets, tone of voice, and messaging remain consistent across all physical and digital touchpoints.
- Brand Strategy and Architecture: Define, evolve, and execute a comprehensive brand strategy and architecture.
- Brand love and equity Building: Design and scale long-term positioning frameworks that elevate brand affinity, driving The Kallang from a physical destination to an iconic, emotionally resonant brand.


Brand health and consumer insights measurement



- Brand health tracking: Work with agencies to measure and identify approach on growing brand health.
- User Insights Understanding: Partner with data and research teams to analyse consumer behaviours, market trends, and audience sentiment to unearth actionable insights that feed into creative briefs.


Campaign execution



- Campaign and Activation Management: Concept and oversee end-to-end multi-channel branding campaigns, experiential activations, and cultural events that maximize earned media and drive foot traffic.


Partnerships and ecosystem management



- Marketing Partnerships: Working hand in hand with commercial partnerships team to identify, negotiate, and execute strategic, co-branded partnerships with global brands, local community leaders, and government stakeholders to amplify brand reach.
- Agency Management: Appoint, evaluate, and manage creative and experiential agencies, fostering an environment of collaborative excellence and ensuring top-tier deliverable standards.


Operations and leadership



- Budget Management: Own and optimize the brand marketing budget, ensuring maximum ROI, cost efficiency, and strategic resource allocation across all campaigns.
- Cross-Team Collaboration: Foster close collaboration with Commercial, Operations, PR, Digital, Marketing and Events teams to align the brand's narrative with broader business objectives.
- Team Leadership: Mentor and develop a high-performing brand marketing team, nurturing internal talent and promoting a culture of creativity, accountability, and bold thinking.


Leadership Expectations



- Strong ability to influence, able to align teams, agencies, and senior stakeholders through credibility and clarity rather than hierarchy.
- Manages up and across effectively, comfortable engaging C-suite stakeholders and navigating organisational dynamics with maturity and discretion.
- Communicates with precision, translates complexity into clear recommendations, whether in a deck, a brief, or a room.
- Brings calm to ambiguity, takes unclear or fast-moving situations and creates structure, momentum, and direction.
- Earns trust quickly, builds strong working relationships across functions and levels, and is relied upon to deliver.


Requirements:



- Minimum 12 years of marketing experience, with a track record in both strategy, planning and execution.
- Relevant experience and expertise across brand, customer insights, social and CRM. Performance marketing knowledge is a plus but not critical to the role.
- Strong commercial mindset; understands how marketing connects to revenue, audience growth, and long-term brand equity.
- Sharp problem-solving instincts, moves quickly from diagnosis to recommendation to action.
- Experience in live entertainment, sports, hospitality, or experience-economy sectors is an advantage.


If you are facing issues submitting your application through Linkedln, please email us your resume at recruit@thekallang.com.sg with the job title.
Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.


The level of appointment will depend on the qualifications and experience of the candidate.
For more information on The Kallang Group, refer to www.thekallang.com.sg

title: Brand Executive, Haircare (Lucido-L, Naturelab Tokyo & myBoostars)
description:

title: Senior Brand Manager
description:
Job Description

About Us

Headquartered in Singapore, SATS Ltd. is one of the world’s largest providers of air cargo handling services and Asia’s leading airline caterer. SATS Gateway Services provides airfreight and ground handling services including passenger services, ramp and baggage handling, aviation security services, aircraft cleaning and aviation laundry. SATS Food Solutions serves airlines and institutions, and operates central kitchens with large-scale food production and distribution capabilities for a wide range of cuisines.

SATS is present in the Asia-Pacific, the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, powering an interconnected world of trade, travel and taste. Following the acquisition of Worldwide Flight Services (WFS) in 2023, the combined SATS and WFS network operates over 225 stations in 27 countries. These cover trade routes responsible for more than 50% of global air cargo volume. SATS has been listed on the Singapore Exchange since May 2000. For more information, please visit www.sats.com.sg

Why Join Us

At SATS, people are our greatest asset and we build our success on the knowledge, expertise and performance of every contributor, by embracing diversity and uniqueness. As part of our holistic approach and commitment to embracing FAM (Fulfilling, Appreciated, Meaningful) in the workplace, we offer the runway to develop Fulfilling careers that foster your career growth, recognising and Appreciating the strength of talent and capabilities that we continue to build internally; and inspiring and encouraging each other to make Meaningful contributions in the work we do at SATS.

Key Responsibilities

This is a high-impact, strategic role at the heart of SATS’ global transformation. As our Senior Brand Manager, you will be the guardian of the SATS brand, driving how it is expressed consistently across markets while ensuring relevance in diverse regions.

Shape Our Global Brand

Champion Brand Excellence



- Develop and maintain comprehensive brand guidelines across visual identity, messaging, and tone of voice

Drive Global Campaigns

Own Brand Platforms & Assets
