title: Brand Marketing Manager
categories: Broadcast Media Production and Distribution and Technology, Information and Media
description:
About Us


SPH Media’s mission is to be the trusted source of news and lifestyle content in Singapore and Asia. One of our core purposes is to produce credible, balanced, and objective news and analysis, always with a view to uphold the public good and fostering an informed, engaged citizenry.


We welcome talented individuals to join us and grow a career in a vibrant and collaborative environment built around a culture of respect and inclusivity.


As an employer, we are committed to rewarding our people fairly and developing them in their careers.


About the Role


The Manager will work with the team to build and strengthen our brand presence across various channels and initiatives. This role is responsible for developing and executing brand marketing strategies that enhance visibility, support business objectives, and reinforce our position as a trusted and forward-looking media organisation. You will assist in developing one-SPH Media and titular marketing campaigns that leverage market trends, and tell the overarching story about SPH Media and its mission in a sustained manner across multiple touchpoints and at key tentpole moments. The ideal candidate is creative, data-informed, and able to translate brand vision into impactful campaigns that resonate with diverse audiences. Most importantly, these campaigns should enhance brand affinity for SPH Media and our family of brands.


Roles & Responsibilities


The scope of responsibilities is as outlined:


Brand Strategy & Development

- Develop and implement brand marketing strategies to strengthen the organisation’s brand identity and market positioning.
- Ensure consistent application of brand guidelines, visual identity, and messaging across all touchpoints.
- Monitor market trends, audience behaviours, and competitor activity to refine brand strategies and identify new opportunities.
- Partner with External Communications to ensure brand alignment with overall corporate narrative and organisational priorities.


Marketing Campaigns & Audience Engagement

- Lead the development, planning, and execution of integrated brand campaigns across digital, social, print, on-ground, and OOH channels, utilising SPH Media's platforms and others.
- Work closely with internal stakeholders to highlight key brand initiatives, content offerings, and audience programmes.
- Manage creative development, including copywriting, visuals, videos, and campaign assets.
- Optimise campaigns based on data insights such as through pre-campaign surveys to improve reach, engagement, and audience conversion.


Brand Partnerships & Stakeholder Collaboration

- Identify and manage brand partnerships that enhance visibility, relevance, and market reach.
- Collaborate with internal departments and external partners (agencies, survey companies, production houses, industry bodies) to deliver effective marketing initiatives.
- Provide marketing guidance to business units and project owners to ensure cohesive brand storytelling.


Market Insights & Performance Tracking

- Use data, audience insights, and market research to guide marketing decisions and campaign effectiveness.
- Develop dashboards, KPIs, and regular reports to evaluate brand health, campaign results, and audience growth.
- Recommend improvements to strengthen brand engagement and maximise impact.


Brand Governance & Consistency

- Work with the website and social media team to uphold brand standards across internal and external touchpoints, especially on our corporate social media channels and website
- Ensure alignment of messaging, tone, and brand experience across campaigns and organisational materials.
- Conduct regular reviews to maintain consistency and quality of brand application.


Creative & Content Direction

- Lead the creative direction for brand initiatives, working closely with designers, content teams, and agency partners.
- Produce compelling narratives that highlight the organisation’s strengths, innovations, and community impact.
- Guide development of marketing assets for events, launches, and key corporate milestones.


Who we are looking for


Required Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree or above, in marketing, branding, communications or a related field
- Five – eight years of experience in brand marketing, preferably in media, consumer brands, or fast-paced industries.
- Marketing experience in the media industry, content creation or platform companies preferred but not a must.
- Experience with digital marketing, consumer insights, and performance tracking tools.
- Proficiency in marketing software (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Creative Suite, CRM tools).


Required Competencies:

- Strong understanding of brand-building, audience insights, and integrated marketing campaigns.
- Proficient in digital marketing, social media strategy, and content development.
- Strong creativity paired with analytical thinking; ability to interpret data and translate insights into action.
- Excellent communication, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills.
- Experience working with agencies, creatives, and cross-functional teams.
- Able to manage multiple projects efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong experience in through the line marketing
- Strong communicator with proficiency in English. Proficiency in a second language is a plus, as some campaigns may target multilingual audiences.
- Advanced stakeholder management and presentation skills.
- Thrive in matrixed environments and is adept at influencing and coordinating with different stakeholders.
- A self-starter who is analytical and meticulous

Location: Hong Kong or Singapore


What You Will Do

- Brand Strategy & Architecture: Own the master-brand architecture across all brands. Define positioning, brand relationships (endorsement vs. separation), and strategic roadmaps for Hong Kong, Singapore, and global expansion.

- Team Leadership: Manage and mentor the Branding Manager and creative support team, establishing clear scorecards and scaling the function as the business grows.


What You Bring

- 10+ years of experience in brand strategy, brand marketing, or integrated marketing, with a proven track record of regional scope across APAC (global exposure highly preferred).
- Proven Brand System Capability: Demonstrated experience building scalable brand systems (architecture, guidelines, governance framework) that were successfully adopted by cross-functional teams.
- 0-to-1 Execution Experience: Proven track record of launching a brand, product category, or function from the ground up, with high comfort in navigating ambiguity.
- Trilingual Fluency: Professional written and spoken fluency in English, Mandarin, and Cantonese (including proficiency in both Simplified and Traditional Chinese).
- Domain Expertise: Background in Financial Services, Fintech, or other regulated/high-trust industries. Familiarity with listed-company communication standards is a strong plus.
- Stakeholder Management: Exceptional capability to influence senior leadership and cross-functional teams without direct authority.
- AI-Native Mindset: Daily proficiency in AI tools, with an understanding of AI-era brand visibility (e.g., how AI search engines/answer engines represent the brand) as an essential channel.
- Commercial Acumen: Strong ability to connect branding initiatives directly to commercial pipelines, market expansion goals, and corporate investor narratives.

title: Associate Manager / Manager, Global Brand Marketing
description:
About Klook

We are a leading pan-regional experiences platform in Asia Pacific, purpose built to digitalize experiences and make them accessible to every traveler.

Our mission is to build the digital infrastructure for the global experience economy — empowering merchants to share their passions and travelers to discover the heartbeat of each destination.

We operate a mobile-first, curated platform featuring diverse experiences across global destinations.

Do you share our belief in the wonders of travel? Global citizens ourselves, Klookers are not only curating memorable experiences for others but co-creating our world of joy within Klook.

We work hard and play hard, upkeeping our high-performing culture as we are guided daily by our 6 core values:



- Customer First
- Push Boundaries
- Critical Thinking
- Build for Scale
- Less is More
- Win as One

We never settle, and together, we believe in achieving greater heights and realizing endless possibilities ahead of us in the dynamic new era of travel. Care to be a part of this revolution? Join us!

About The Role

We’re looking for an Associate Manager / Manager, Brand Growth to join our Global Brand Marketing team and help connect Brand more closely to the products we want to grow, the channels where consumers make decisions, and ultimately business impact.

We’re looking for a left-brain brand marketer — someone who believes in the power of creativity, but is equally comfortable with audience insight, commercial priorities and data.

The role sits at the intersection of brand, product, audience insight and growth, with three core jobs:

Integrate product into Brand



- Work with vertical teams and local markets to identify the products Klook should be talking about, uncover relevant audience insights, and turn them into compelling consumer stories within our larger brand campaigns.
- The job is to go beyond features and find the reason people should notice and care.

Integrate Brand into lower-funnel marketing



- Work across paid media, Kreator, PR, social and local marketing teams to make sure Klook’s brand, values and distinctiveness show up further down the funnel.
- You’ll connect Brand, product, channels and markets around one clear consumer story — so commercial activity builds memory for Klook, not just the immediate transaction.

Measure the impact of Brand



- Work with analytics and research partners to understand Brand’s impact across both brand and business outcomes — from awareness and consideration to branded search, direct traffic and downstream behaviour.
- You’ll also help lead audience research, turning insights and performance data into clear recommendations for what we do next.

What You’ll Do



- Identify priority products and categories to integrate into Brand activity.
- Gather and synthesise audience and market insights.
- Turn product benefits into compelling consumer propositions and stories.
- Lead integrated marketing campaigns across Brand, paid media, Kreator, PR, social and local markets.
- Bring stronger Brand thinking into lower-funnel and commercial activity.
- Partner with research and analytics teams to measure Brand impact.
- Turn performance and research into actionable recommendations.
- Explore how AI can improve the speed, quality and scale of our work.

What We’re Looking For



- 4–5 years of experience in brand, integrated marketing, product marketing or communications planning.
- A left-brain brand mindset: strong creative judgement, but equally comfortable with data, commercial questions and measurement.
- Strong consumer, audience and value proposition thinking.
- Experience working across regional or global campaigns and multiple channels.
- Good understanding of paid media and lower-funnel marketing.
- Strong stakeholder and project management skills.
- Comfortable working with research, brand metrics and business data.
- Able to simplify messy inputs into a clear point of view.
- AI-curious and proactive about experimenting with better ways of working.

What Success Looks Like



- Klook’s priority products are naturally embedded into Brand campaigns.
- Audience insights actively shape our marketing decisions.
- Lower-funnel campaigns build the Klook brand while driving commercial outcomes.
- Brand, channels and markets work from one connected consumer story.
- We have a clearer view of Brand’s impact across both brand and business metrics.

Klook is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented and passionate people of all backgrounds. We believe that a joyful workplace is an inclusive workplace, one where employees from all walks of life have an equal opportunity to thrive. We're dedicated to creating a welcoming and supportive culture where everyone belongs.

At Longbridge, you won’t just be working for a brokerage; you’ll be building the future of financial infrastructure.


About the role
The Brand Manager leads the brand management mandate for the group: how Longbridge is perceived across markets, and whether every touchpoint, from a paid ad to a flagship event to an in-app card, reflects one consistent, high-quality brand. You own the brand book and its governance, run the review desk that every growth and channel team relies on, and carry brand execution through integrated campaigns, out-of-home and traditional media, co-branded work and events. This is a hands-on role that requires both strategic thinking and strong execution. You will work across Product, User Growth, Design, Corporate Affairs and the Group Content Hub, manage several projects at once, and be the person the organisation turns to when it needs a brand decision made quickly and made well. Based in Hong Kong or Singapore, you cover Hong Kong and Singapore and support the group's other markets as they open.


What you will do

- Brand management and governance — Maintain and evolve the brand identity across all brands, own the brand book, messaging and guidelines, and run the brand governance process so that consistency is built into how teams work rather than checked at the end.
- Review desk and service standard — Run the brand review desk for User Growth and channel teams against established service level standards, so conversion work moves at funnel speed without drifting from the brand.
- Integrated marketing — Plan and execute brand campaigns across owned, earned and paid channels with User Growth, the Content Hub and Corporate Affairs; own out-of-home and traditional media execution end to end, including media planning input, production and vendor management.
- Brand storytelling — Translate AI capabilities, product launches and market insights into brand stories, and adapt messaging for different audiences and regional markets in English and Chinese, working from the product packaging owned by the Product Marketing Manager.
- Co-branded and partner assets — Review and approve co-branded assets with strategic partners, sponsors and distribution partners, so that third parties represent the brand correctly.
- Events and launches — Provide brand production support to Corporate Affairs on flagship events, launches and sponsorship activations: environmental branding, collateral, merchandise and on-site brand execution, working with the Creative & User Experience Designer.
- Agencies and vendors — Manage creative agencies, production vendors and brand research partners day to day: briefs, timelines, quality control, and budget tracking.
- Brand health and measurement — Own brand health reporting: brand tracker, share of voice and sentiment, campaign performance and periodic brand audits; present insights and recommendations that shape upcoming campaigns.


What you bring

- At least 5 years in brand management, integrated marketing or product marketing, with experience in fintech, brokerage, financial services, AI or technology, and campaigns you have led end to end.
- You understand financial markets and investment products, and you know how a regulated category influences brand communication.
- Strong brand and visual judgment, and the confidence to make a call and explain it to a growth team on a deadline.
- Proven experience managing agencies, production vendors and partners, and running out-of-home or traditional media campaigns.
- Excellent English and Chinese communication and copywriting skills; Cantonese is an advantage for the Hong Kong market.
- Organised and detail-oriented, able to run several projects independently with minimal supervision across different teams and markets.
- AI-fluent in practice: you use AI tools in your daily work and have marketed AI or technical products, or are keen to.
- Familiarity with brand tracking, media monitoring or analytics tools is a plus.

description:
Nestlé Purina Petcare AOA

Location: Changi Business Park, Singapore

5+ years of experience in marketing and/or generating demand functions at Nestlé or equivalent FMCG

Position Summary

At Nestlé Purina Petcare, we are passionately committed to enriching lives of pets and the people who love them. Our dedication to pets, and their owners, directs everything we do, every day, everywhere. Today, Nestlé Purina Petcare is one of the world’s leading pet care companies. We offer an attractive and dynamic work environment with a high focus on developing people.

As a Brand Manager for Fancy Feast, this role will be responsible for supporting the Marketing Strategy and Long Term Vision for the Brand on a central level and guide key markets to maximize local opportunities. Brand Managers must be able to engage and inspire others both cross functionally and in the local markets.

The Brand Manager will Co-lead with the Senior Brand Manager through a complementary partnership with clear decision rights and shared accountability. Independently own agreed workstreams, the day-to-day Brand Plan and budget, while shaping choices across a complex multi-market portfolio spanning Oceania, ASEAN, Korea, Greater China and MENA.

A day in the life of a Brand Manager…



- Develop Brand Strategy: Analyse business and consumer trends, identify key issues affecting your brand, build and execute innovative brand plans. Demonstrate above average consumer insight/strategic brand building capability and posess effective project management skills.
- Build Great Brands : Implement growth strategies via 3 year brand plan and yearly implementation plan (ICP). Develop or apply (locally aligned or global) brand essence, vision and manifesto. Create strategies to win at the first and second moment of truth (product and packaging). Create effective brand strategies in collaboration with category to delight shoppers.
- Develop Compelling Communications : Campaign Idea, engagement strategies, implementation and tracking effectiveness with support and guidance from the Marketing Manager.
- Deliver Growth Through Innovation And Renovation: Responsible for the delivery of a 3 year consumer and technically validated category innovation plan (risk adjusted). Identify new, consumer insight driven, innovative ideas to drive brand growth. Develop new product ideas, renovation to current products and strategies. Demonstrate vision and leadership in building of long-term I&R Pipeline.
- Brand Performance & Market Cluster Management : Accountable for brand performance in markets. Lead the main cluster of markets for the brand, identify gaps and opportunities for these markets and find synergies to drive an efficient business.
- Team Leadership: Key leader of cross-functional internal (and external, including agency) teams in the development and execution of marketing plan strategies. Identify gaps and opportunities for markets and find synergies to create win-win situations to ensure needs of the markets are delivering to overall business objectives. Deliver cross functional alignment to aligned brand strategies and implementation plans.

What Will Make You Successful...



- 3-5 years experience in marketing and/or generating demand functions at Nestlé or equivalent FMCG
- Experience working in cross functional teams
- Successful experience in project management.
- Successful experience in achieving goals through working with others (ie not sole contributor).
- Experience leading a complex portfolio, owning a Brand Plan and budget, and influencing senior stakeholders in ambiguity.
- Brief writing, agency management, and successful creative campaign execution.

People Leadership and Capability Building

- Support marketing capability building across brand planning, forecasting, opportunity assessment, competitive strategy, and cross-functional leadership.
-

What Should You Have



- Minimum of 7 years marketing or commercial experience required. At least 3 years of marketing or commercial experience in Pharmaceuticals with digital and omni-channel experiences preferred.
- In-line marketing and / or commercial experience, including launch and LOE, coupled with strong understanding of or experience in market access, policy, digital, and value evidence generation in Specialty Care/Immunology
- Solid grounding in marketing excellence and structured commercial capabilities with the proven ability to develop strategy and translate it into execution.

description:
About the Role


Job Purpose The Manager, Programme Origination reports to the Head, Program Origination and leads the Programme Origination team in developing and executing commemorative coin, collectible, bullion and related product programmes. The role owns programme strategy, concept origination, launch readiness, marketing communications, delivery governance, P&L actualisation, KPI achievement and yearly margin targets. The role also manages internal teams and external contractors to deliver cohesive brand positioning, impactful product communications, effective campaigns and commercially aligned go-to-market execution.


Responsibilities



- Programme Origination Leadership
- Lead and manage the Programme Origination team to deliver programmes, achieve yearly margin targets and strengthen team performance in a dynamic environment.
- Own programme planning, execution and review across scope, schedule, budget, quality, launch readiness, risks and post-launch performance.
- Programme Origination, Marketing & Commercial Delivery
- Conduct market research, identify trends and originate differentiated product concepts that challenge the norm and strengthen brand equity.
- Oversee marketing and communications plans, product stories, campaign briefs, sales enablement materials and channel support across retail, e-commerce, corporate sales and digital platforms.
- Stakeholder, Team & Contractor Management
- Manage internal teams across programme origination, marketing, sales, design, production and operations to ensure coordinated delivery and accountability.
- Manage external contractors, agencies, vendors and partners to deliver agreed quality, cost, timelines, messaging and brand standards.
- Monitor programme KPIs and programme-level P&L, track performance against sales, margin and engagement targets, and drive timely corrective actions.
- Key Accountabilities
- Leadership, development and progression of the Programme Origination team.
- Strong P&L management and actualisation of commercial objectives, KPIs, yearly margin targets and profitability outcomes.
- KPI-driven performance management with clear metrics, timely reviews, accountability and corrective actions.
- Effective coordination of internal teams, external contractors and cross-functional stakeholders.
- Accurate programme reporting, documentation and management updates.
- Consistent product marketing, brand messaging, campaign delivery and customer engagement.
- Key Decisions & Dimensions
- Recommend programme concepts, timelines, budget allocations, go-to-market requirements and actions to mitigate risks or improve performance.
- Manage the Programme Origination team and influence cross-functional delivery across marketing, production, operations, sales and external partners.
- Oversee internal marketing resources and external contractors supporting communications, campaigns and customer engagement.
- Accountable for programme-level P&L actualisation and KPI achievement, including sales, margin, engagement and timeline adherence.


Qualifications



- Qualifications & Experience
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or a related discipline.
- More than 10 years of relevant experience in marketing, product marketing, integrated communications, programme origination or related commercial roles, with team leadership experience.
- Proven experience managing internal teams, external agencies, contractors and cross-functional stakeholders.


Required Skills



- Skills & Competencies
- Strong leadership, ownership mindset and ability to work independently, influence and motivate teams, and drive team progression in a dynamic environment.
- Highly organised, proactive and adaptable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and solve problems effectively.
- Strong communication, stakeholder management and presentation skills.
- Sound commercial acumen, analytical capability, P&L understanding and ability to interpret market and performance data.
- Strong understanding of marketing strategy, brand communications, campaign execution, product storytelling and customer engagement.
- Creative thinker who challenges the norm, originates impactful collectibles and crafts compelling communication messaging that strengthens brand equity, market appeal and customer engagement.

title: Marketing Manager (FHC Category SEA)

title: Assistant Manager/Manager, Brand & Content, Singapore Global Network
categories: Government Administration, Business Consulting and Services, and Think Tanks
description:
[What the role is]

About Singapore Global Network

Singapore Global Network (SGN) is a division under EDB that grows and engages a 220,000-strong international community of overseas Singaporeans and friends of Singapore. Our mission is to grow Singapore’s global networks by fostering meaningful relationships and communities among international talent, entrepreneurs, students and partners worldwide, while strengthening Singapore’s position as the ideal place to work, live and play.

[What you will be working on]

You will be part of SGN’s Brand & Content team, supporting the development and execution of brand and content marketing initiatives that promote SGN as an international networking community among target audience segments, and building a positive experience with members. This includes building the SGN brand experience, growing its digital channel following, promoting its product offerings, generating new members for the network, and engaging audiences through a mix of online and offline initiatives.

You will also help shape global perceptions of Singapore as an ideal city for international talent to live, work and play in. This includes promoting the many aspects of Singapore’s culture, people and environment. Using compelling storytelling techniques, you will creatively convey Singapore value propositions in a way that gets target audiences excited about the prospects and opportunities that Singapore has to offer.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys creating, experimenting, and collaborating — from shaping creative campaign ideas to producing inspiring content and supporting delivery across digital channels. You will work closely with internal teams, marketing agencies and brand partners to shape how Singapore is represented to global audiences.

Key Responsibilities

Brand & Campaign Management



- Drive the ideation, development and execution of brand initiatives and marketing campaigns aimed at growing SGN’s digital following, network membership and brand experience.
- Work with marketing agencies to develop and execute campaigns across online and offline channels.
- Serve as the custodian of the SGN brand, responsible for reviewing the effectiveness of existing brand toolkit and proposing recommendations that help foster a stronger brand identity and affinity among audiences.
- Identify brand partners for collaboration to enhance SGN’s value offerings to members.

Content Development & Marketing



- Shape the content strategy for SGN and drive content development across channels, markets and audience segments.
- Contribute content ideas and create engaging content across formats that include but are not limited to short-form videos, human-interest stories, explainer videos, editorial content, event coverage, and guides.
- This includes working with content agencies, media publishers and partners to develop content initiatives and partnerships.
- Collaborate with product and regional teams to drive content and campaigns aimed at promoting opportunities in Singapore among global talent and entrepreneurs.
- Identify relevant content creators and key opinion leaders to collaborate on content and campaigns.

Measurement & Optimisation



- Measure and report on brand, campaign and content-related performance using marketing analytics and social listening tools.
- Help translate data and insights into learnings and recommendations for improving future campaigns and content.

[What we are looking for]

We are looking for a digital native with a fun personality. Someone who is creative, energetic and with a good sense of humour, to bring out the best that Singapore and SGN has to offer.

You May Be a Good Fit If You



- Have 1–3 years of experience (or equivalent internships/projects) in digital marketing, content, communications, or social media. Agency and/or media production house experience is welcome but not mandatory.
- Are a strategic thinker with hands-on experience planning and executing digital marketing campaigns, developing engaging content, and managing social media channels.
- Enjoy creative storytelling and creating content, especially for social and digital platforms.
- Are comfortable experimenting with short-form content and open to being behind or in front of the camera when needed (but not required to be an on-screen personality).
- Have strong writing skills and an eye for attention to detail, from crafting captions to polishing longer-form content.
- Are familiar with social platforms and trends, and curious about how audiences engage with content.
- Possess basic experience with tools such as video editing apps (e.g. CapCut), analytics platforms (e.g. Google Analytics), or social listening tools — or are keen to learn.
- An independent and self-motivated individual who takes ownership of deliverables and is committed to excellence in execution, as well as adept at managing priorities, timelines and achieving targets.
- Enjoy working collaboratively in a team environment and contributing ideas and are open to feedback, learning, and developing new skills over time.
- Are a Singapore Citizen.

title: AVP/VP, Brand and Marketing (Creative)
description:
GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 locations around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world’s industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.

Corporate Affairs and Communications

The Corporate Affairs & Communications team is responsible for managing corporate affairs, branding and reputation, and all internal and external communications. It is GIC’s interface with key stakeholders, including the general public, media, and employees.

Brand and Marketing

We develop narratives that underpin the GIC brand and protect GIC’s reputation and share these narratives with a range of audiences – our client, partners, the public, media, and our employees – through both internal and external communications. Our team includes Brand and Marketing, Corporate Communications, Employee Engagement, and Impact and Partnerships.

What impact can you make in this role?

We are looking for a suitable candidate to join our team as AVP/VP – Brand and Marketing, reporting to the Head of Brand and Marketing. This is a pivotal hire — the creative conscience of our team, setting the standard for how GIC looks, feels, and communicates across every touchpoint. In this hands-on strategic role, the successful candidate will work alongside the team to shape and deliver creative output across the platforms.

What will you do as a AVP/VP in Brand and Marketing?

Brand Ownership



- Brand Custodian - Own and evolve GIC's visual identity, brand guidelines, and creative standards across all touchpoints globally
- Ensure brand consistency across platforms and materials


Agency Partnership & Creative Direction



- Serve as GIC's primary creative authority with external agencies — setting briefs, reviewing output, and holding work to an institutional standard.
- Build a clear briefing framework and a deep understanding of what 'right' looks like for GIC, elevating first-draft quality and reducing iterations.
- Manage agency relationships actively — Defined deliverables, honest feedback — and know when to commission, push back, or deliver in-house.


Design & Creative Execution



- Produce key assets directly where needed. 
- Apply user-centric design principles to digital platforms, contributing to UI/UX projects. 
- Comfortable working in Adobe Creative Suite; not only direct and able to prototype and deliver finished assets.


Team & Strategic Contribution



- Build and maintain the brand toolkit so the team can produce on-brand work independently
- Be the creative partner to teams across the department, raising the design quality of the content produced
- Contribute to the department strategy a creative lens, bringing an external perspective on how peer institutions are evolving their brand presence. 
- Collaborate with team members and cross-functional departments to align creative direction with strategic goals 


What makes you a successful candidate?

Experience



- 8–10 years in brand, creative, or design roles — in-house or senior agency side
- Background in financial services, professional services, or institutional organisations strongly preferred — you understand how to brief and direct work that feels right in a regulated, high-trust environment
- Proven track record as a sophisticated creative client — experience managing multiple relationships and projects effectively in a fast-paced environment. 
- Experience operating as a trusted creative advisor to senior stakeholders – diagnosing needs, shaping direction and bringing an outside-in view of how leading institutions are evolving their brand. 
- Hands-on experience producing a range of collateral and creative outputs – brand identity, events creative, publication, video/ motion content and multi-formal institutional design 
- History of raising agency output quality through better briefing, sharper creative standards, and informed, constructive feedback


Skills & Attributes



- Strong design software skills — fluent in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Familiarity with Figma or Sketch and basic HTML/CSS knowledge, Understanding of UX/UI design and accessibility best practices and comfortable as both strategist and maker: you can write the brief and produce the asset.
- Strategic, consultative mindset — sets the creative standard, exercises independent judgment on what 'right' looks like for GIC, and influences rather than simply executes.
- Strong stakeholder and project management skills — able to run multiple workstreams concurrently, manage agency and internal timelines across time zones, and land creative ideas in a conservative institutional context without diluting them.
- A genuine team player — generous with time and knowledge, supportive of colleagues, and invested in the team's collective success, not just individual output.
- Builds strong relationships across a wide range of stakeholders, raising the quality and confidence of everyone they work with.
- Strong problem-solver — anticipates, initiates, and resolves issues, and able to pivot in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.
- Highly organised — delivers to a high standard under competing deadlines, with a positive, continuous-learning attitude.


Work at the Point of Impact

We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.

title: Brand & Marketing Executive
description:
SUMMARY
The Brand & Marketing Executive supports the planning, coordination and execution of brand, marketing and social media initiatives across the group’s dining concepts.
This role works closely with the Brand & Marketing Communications team, outlet teams, designers, agencies, vendors and external partners to bring campaigns, promotions, content and brand experiences to life. The role requires someone who is organised, detail-oriented and creatively aware, with the ability to manage timelines, coordinate stakeholders, maintain brand consistency and support the administrative needs behind smooth marketing execution.


RESPONSIBILITIES 


Brand & Campaign Support

- Support the planning and execution of brand campaigns, seasonal promotions, new menu launches, outlet initiatives and marketing activations.
- Assist in developing campaign timelines, marketing calendars, task lists and rollout plans.
- Coordinate campaign requirements across internal teams, outlet teams, designers, agencies, vendors and partners to ensure timely execution.
- Assist in preparing campaign briefs, creative references, copy points and marketing materials.
- Ensure campaign messaging, visuals and guest-facing touchpoints are aligned with each brand’s tone, personality and positioning.


Content & Communications

- Assist in creating and coordinating marketing content across social media, eDMs, websites, in-store materials and promotional channels.
- Draft social media captions, newsletter copy, website updates, promotional copy and basic campaign write-ups.
- Work with designers, photographers, videographers and external agencies to produce marketing assets.
- Support content shoots by coordinating shot lists, props, products, outlet arrangements and creative requirements.
- Ensure all content and communications are clear, polished, on-brand and consistent across platforms.


Social Media & Digital Marketing

- Support the day-to-day management of social media platforms (Meta & Rednote), including content scheduling, posting, community engagement and basic page upkeep.
- Monitor social media trends, competitor activity and relevant F&B, lifestyle and hospitality content ideas.
- Track social media performance and assist in compiling reports on reach, engagement, follower growth and campaign results.
- Support influencer/KOL coordination, including shortlist preparation, outreach, hosting arrangements, briefing and follow-ups.
- Assist in digital marketing initiatives such as boosted posts, campaign tracking and basic performance tracking


Outlet, Event & Partnership Coordination

- Liaise with outlet teams to ensure campaigns, promotions and marketing materials are properly briefed and implemented.
- Coordinate the delivery, display and upkeep of marketing materials such as posters, menus, table talkers, standees, signage, tent cards and promotional assets.
- Support media visits, influencer tastings, brand events, activations and partnership campaigns.
- Assist in gathering outlet feedback, campaign photos and operational updates to ensure smooth execution.
- Help maintain clear communication between marketing, operations and external partners


Administrative & Reporting

- Maintain organised records of marketing assets, campaign materials, vendor contacts, quotations, invoices, timelines and brand resources.
- Assist with marketing expense tracking, quotation requests, purchase orders, invoice processing and basic budget coordination.
- Compile campaign performance reports, post-campaign summaries and key learnings.
- Support competitor research, market research and simple presentation decks when required.
- Maintain content calendars, campaign trackers, internal marketing documentation.
- Assist with administrative coordination for shoots, events, partnerships and marketing rollouts, including bookings, logistics, samples, deliveries and follow-ups.


REQUIREMENTS



- Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Hospitality, Media or a related field.
- 1–3 years of experience in marketing, social media, brand communications, hospitality, F&B or lifestyle brands preferred.
- Strong written English with an eye for tone, detail and clarity.
- Good understanding of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Rednote, and lifestyle/F&B content trends.
- Organised, reliable and able to manage timelines across multiple brands, outlets and campaigns.
- Comfortable coordinating with different stakeholders, including outlet teams, designers, vendors, agencies and partners.
- Able to manage administrative tasks carefully and systematically.
- Basic knowledge of Canva, OneDrive Workspace, Meta Business Suite, Mailchimp, website CMS or similar tools is a plus.
- Interest in food, hospitality, lifestyle, design, culture and brand storytelling.
- Able to work independently while being collaborative, responsive and hands-on.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Company Overview:
Four Star is the largest Singaporean direct-to-consumer mattress and furnishing brand, dedicated to offering innovative products at value-driven prices. As a rapidly growing organization, we are expanding and seeking dynamic individuals to join our team.


About the Role
We are looking for an exceptionally creative, commercially minded marketer who can uncover new customer segments and create compelling reasons for them to choose Four Star.


You will challenge conventional approaches to mattress and furnishing marketing, develop distinctive campaigns, and build new routes to customers through digital content, creators, partnerships, and e-commerce platforms.


Working closely with the CEO and Head of Digital Marketing, you will play a pivotal role in driving our marketing strategy in Singapore and other Asia markets. Your primary goal will be to enhance brand visibility, drive market share, and foster seamless brand experiences both online and offline.


Key Responsibilities


Strategy Development & New Customer Acquisition

- Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive marketing strategies tailored to Singapore and other Asia markets, ensuring alignment with company’s objectives.
- Define execution strategies for the brand and niche positioning, devising disruptive and innovative strategies to drive the brand into a digital retail powerhouse.
- Develop distinctive campaign concepts that make mattresses and furnishings relevant to customers’ lifestyles, life stages, and purchasing motivations.
- Create and test new messaging, offers, content formats, and customer experiences that attract audiences beyond the brand’s existing customer base.
- Explore opportunities in new customer segments and channels validating their commercial potential through research and testing.
- Establish and monitor KPIs to evaluate campaign effectiveness and ROI, leveraging data-driven insights to continuously improve marketing initiatives.


Digital Transformation & E-commerce Development:

- Drive the digital transformation of the brand in all markets via digital-driven marketing strategies and campaigns planning, including programmatic marketing, analytics, social media, operational marketing, and CRM.
- Identify, evaluate, and develop new customer-acquisition opportunities across marketplaces, social commerce, creator-led commerce, and emerging digital platforms
- Strong knowledge of Social Media platforms (such as Meta, Tik Tok, XHS, etc.).
- Knowledge in online advertising channels.
- Development of E-commerce sales channels.
- Apply SEO, GEO & SEM, content development, distribution, and measurement to effectively tailor content to reach audience personas.


Campaign Management:

- Oversee the planning, execution, and optimization of integrated marketing campaigns across digital and traditional channels, including website, newsletters, social media, and more.
- Develop seasonal/key calendars and campaign flighting, maintaining a communication flow across all global digital/traditional channels.
- Conduct thorough market analysis to identify consumer trends, competitive landscapes, and growth opportunities, translating insights into actionable strategies.
- Translate brand full funnel media plans to optimize channel efficiency, traffic, and conversion tactics based on brand, audience/customer, channel, and campaign strategies.
- Lead the development of compelling creative briefs and guide teams, agencies, and creators from concept through execution.


Brand and Market Presence:

- Lead the team to curate, innovate, and test new ideas to bring about new transformations that rise above unprecedented customer experience, executing offline brand engagement strategies such as pop-up stores, retail partnerships, and collaborations.
- Lead negotiations and relationship-building with key strategic partners.


Team Leadership:

- Manage and inspire a high-performing marketing team, providing guidance and mentorship to drive excellence and innovation.
- Lead daily integrated marketing cross-functional scrum and related stand-up activity to identify and prioritize planning and execution agenda.


Ideal Candidate Profile

- 7+ years of digital marketing experience within consumer electronics, furnishing, technology, or retail industries, with a strong track record in campaign management and team leadership.
- Proven success in marketing partnership, branding, or equivalent roles (e.g., strategic partnership, new traffic acquisition, brand building & awareness).
- Experience developing marketing strategies and monitoring frameworks for different go-to-market channels.
- Evidence of reaching new customer segments or building productive acquisition channels beyond an existing customer base.
- Demonstrated ability to turn creative ideas into measurable improvements in customer acquisition, conversion, or e-commerce sales.
- Strong understanding of platform-specific content, creator partnerships, social commerce, and online purchasing behaviour.
- Demonstrated leadership skills in leading marketing teams and ability to succeed in a fast-paced, startup environment.
- A strategic mindset with the ability to develop and execute innovative marketing strategies that align with business objectives and market dynamics.
- Deep understanding of regional consumer behaviors, market trends, and digital marketing best practices.
- Strong analytical skills with proficiency in interpreting data, measuring performance metrics, and making data-driven decisions.
- Exceptional analytical skills, both quantitative and qualitative, with strong experience in interpreting test results and drawing conclusions.
- Ability to pull data from various resources and translate it into trends, action plans, and reporting templates.


Education:

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related fields. MBA/ Advanced degrees or certifications are a plus.


Join Four Star to be part of an innovative, fast-paced environment where your ideas and contributions will directly impact our expansion, growth, and success. We offer competitive compensation packages, opportunities for career advancement, and a vibrant company culture that values creativity and teamwork.


If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for driving impactful marketing initiatives and hands-on experience in a dynamic industry, we invite you to apply and join us on our growing journey

description:

At Sephora, beauty is about feeling seen, valued, and empowered, individually and collectively. It is connecting deeply with others, celebrating diversity and inclusivity, unlocking your potential and making a difference every day. Together, we belong to something beautiful.
 
Sephora SEA’s omni channel business spans over 8 countries (Australia, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand) with 100+ stores and boasts some global flagships such as ION and Raffles City in Singapore, F88 in Kuala Lumpur and Pitt Street in Sydney. Sephora SEA is experiencing rapid growth in the region with new store openings and business channels (i.e., Click and collect and marketplace).
 
 
Manager, Integrated Marketing (SEA ANZ)


Our Marketing organization aims to inspire and connect people through meaningful storytelling, always pushing the norms and boundaries, one person, one community at a time.
We are a strategic team of big thinkers and creatives who truly work interdependently to stimulate demand and drive traffic across our network.  From developing marketing strategies, designing toolkits connecting consumer insights to our expertise & selection, planning our loyalty program, and building exciting in-store experiences, we are constantly finding ways to remind beauty lovers why Sephora is extraordinary and cement our place as an authentic beauty expert.
 
As the Integrated Marketing Manager, reporting to the Senior Manager, Integrated Marketing (SEA ANZ), you will be directly responsible for planning and strategizing omnichannel marketing campaigns. You will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders and country marketing teams to develop comprehensive toolkits across all Sephora marketing levers and touchpoints, ensuring alignment with business goals.
This role suits a dynamic individual with strong creative instincts, who thrives in strategic discussions as well as detailed execution. You excel in complex, cross-functional environments where no two days are alike, bringing ideas to life across diverse channels.
 

You Will Shine Here If You Enjoy…
 
- Executing marketing calendar and campaign strategies. 
- Originating creative and innovative marketing ideas and strategies, driving them from concept to launch. 
- Working across functions, markets, and all levels of seniority. 
- Finding clarity in ambiguity and establishing processes where none exist. 
- Drive experiential marketing initiatives by closely monitoring and leveraging industry best practices and pioneering groundbreaking campaign concepts.  

What You Will Do
Campaign Planning & Execution
 
- Lead the strategic and creative ideation and development of omni-channel marketing campaigns activations across SEA ANZ 
- Develop integrated campaign frameworks that ensure a clear and consistent consumer journey across digital, retail, social, and PR. 
- Translate regional campaign strategy into detailed marketing activation plans, adapting direction for local contexts while maintaining overall campaign integrity. 
- Maintain and manage the marketing calendar to optimize activations to sales plan, ensuring alignment with strategic campaign priorities. 
- Deliver timely and aligned toolkits and post-mortems for priority campaigns. 
- Champion the voice of the customer and Sephora brand codes across all campaign executions. 


Cross-Functional Collaboration
 
- Collaborate with diverse internal teams (e.g., Creative, Paid Media & Analytics, Digital, Retail Execution, Social & PR, Merchandising, Brand Partner Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and store managers) to align on campaign priorities and execution. 
- Drive central campaign leadership, managing interdependencies, resolving blockers, and ensuring seamless project progression and timely signoffs. 
- Partner with Merchandising to translate product strategies and commercial priorities into compelling campaign narratives and customer activations. 
- Work with regional Retail Excellence and Training teams to implement activation guidance and ensure market teams are briefed and trained on campaign mechanics and in-store executions. 


Market Management

 
- Oversee campaign execution for direct markets (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Australia, New Zealand) and support franchise markets through toolkit development and adaptation guidance. 
- Ensure market-specific nuances are reflected in activation planning without compromising campaign coherence. 
- Share insights and data with regional and country teams to optimize market-specific plans. 
- Review and ensure final market assets align with campaign direction and brand standards.

 
Reporting & Performance
 
- Lead campaign reporting and post-mortems to understand, improve, and elevate execution and performance. 
- Track campaign milestones and proactively surface risks to senior leadership. 
- Analyze performance data to derive actionable insights, correlating marketing outcomes with commercial targets and formulating strategic recommendations. 

 
What We Are Looking For
 
- 6-8 years of integrated marketing or campaign management experience, preferably in retail or multi-brand environments. 
- A visionary who can define strategy, plan programs, and oversee detailed execution. 
- Proven experience managing complex, multi-channel campaigns across multiple markets simultaneously. 
- Exceptional project management skills, able to lead multiple workstreams, manage timelines, and drive alignment across cross-functional teams. 
- Strong communication and stakeholder management, adept at navigating matrixed organizations at local, regional, and global levels. 
- High accountability, resilience, and emotional maturity. 
- Highly organized, proactive, and skilled at process development in ambiguous situations. 
- Ability to operate effectively in high-complexity and ambiguous environments. 
- Experience across SEA markets; knowledge of ANZ is a significant plus. 
- Passion for beauty, thrive in dynamic, highly matrixed fast paced environment preferred

title: Assistant Manager, Marketing Communications
description:
HOTEL OVERVIEW
Strategically located in the heart of Singapore’s shopping, dining and entertainment districts and with the City Hall and Esplanade Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) train stations and other major transportation nodes at its doorstep, Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford are the gateway to explore Singapore’s landscapes at your convenience. With a total of 2,030 well-appointed guestrooms, both hotels also offer a distinct collection of 12 lifestyle and dining choices including Michelin-starred fine dining restaurant JAAN by Kirk Westaway, cutting-edge meeting space at Raffles City Convention Centre with 34 meeting rooms and one of Asia’s largest spas, Willow Stream Spa.


ABOUT OUR COMPANY
At Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford, we design career plans and unveil new professional perspectives through our various development programs. We shine when YOU shine. Come and be part of our dynamic team and experience immerse growth and career opportunities with us.


The Assistant Marketing Communications Manager develops and leads communications strategies for assigned revenue streams and lifestyle-led portfolios across Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford. This role has a strong focus on campaign management, public relations, media relations, content development, influencer engagement, media planning, partnerships, F&B storytelling, spa and lifestyle campaigns, while supporting broader hotel, brand and corporate initiatives. The role supports the Director of Marketing Communications in managing campaign execution, agency coordination, media hosting and team workflow. This is a leadership position as second in-charge to lead and manage the team.


COMMUNICATIONS & MEDIA PLANNING

- Formulate communications and media calendars for assigned portfolios, ensuring timely and accurate execution of initiatives with relevant business units and stakeholders.
- Develop Public Relations angles, media materials, influencer briefs and content narratives that generate positive and relevant coverage across local, regional and international channels.
- Develop media plan for campaigns and dedicated business units for brand positioning and/or to meet campaign objectives
- Review communications materials including press releases, media pitches, social copy, sales decks, in-house collaterals, ad copy and campaign assets to ensure accuracy, tonality and brand alignment.
- Lead assigned awards submissions, canvassing of votes or nominations, and post-award amplification with relevant stakeholders.
- Identify partnership opportunities with lifestyle, luxury, F&B, wellness, cultural and corporate brands to create differentiated guest experiences.


LIFESTYLE, PUBLIC RELATIONS & PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT

- Lead or support lifestyle and Public Relations -driven portfolios such as selected F&B venues, spa, wellness, partnerships, IP-led collaborations, festive campaigns and hotel stories.
- Manage media, blogger, content creator and influencer hosting to drive positive coverage and beneficial commercial outcomes.
- Coordinate media familiarisation stays, F&B tastings, chef interviews, partner activations and hosted experiences in line with approved strategy and budgets.
- Support restaurant and bar positioning by developing story angles around culinary concepts, chefs, menus, events, awards and collaborations.
- Maintain active awareness of hospitality, lifestyle, dining, wellness and media trends to identify relevant opportunities.


CAMPAIGN & EVENT MANAGEMENT

- Conceptualise, plan and execute integrated communications campaigns with the Director, internal team, Public relations agencies, digital partners and business unit stakeholders.
- Support marketing and promotion of hotel-led events, ensuring strong attendance, media relevance, guest experience and post-event reporting.
- Prepare campaign briefs, timelines, content requirements, photography or videography briefs, creative references and partner deliverables.
- Coordinate cross-channel launches across website, social media, email, in-house displays, press outreach, partner platforms and advertising placements.
- Monitor campaign performance and prepare updates with recommendations for optimisation.


MARKET RESEARCH & ANALYSIS

- Conduct market research to identify consumer preferences, competitor activity, hospitality trends and relevant lifestyle or dining developments.
- Analyse public relations , campaign, media monitoring, social and stakeholder feedback to develop informed recommendations that support business goals.
- Review competitive communications to identify opportunities for differentiation and stronger positioning.


PARTNER, AGENCY & VENDOR ENGAGEMENT

- Manage day-to-day agency, partner and vendor coordination for assigned projects, ensuring clear scopes, timelines, deliverables and approvals.
- Host partners and industry contacts for ongoing engagement and potential collaborations.
- Support negotiation of value-added partner arrangements that enhance brand relevance, reduce costs or improve guest experiences.


BUDGETING & ADMINISTRATION

- Manage campaign and assigned business unit budgets and forecast.
- Monitor campaign-level budgets, quotations and supplier costs for assigned projects, ensuring forecast accuracy and procurement compliance.
- Support annual budget planning by gathering scopes, historical costs and proposed activity requirements.
- Work with the Coordinator to ensure agreements, purchase requests, invoices and accruals are submitted accurately and on time.


OTHERS

- Comply with hotel and department policies and procedures at all times.
- Assist with Sales & Marketing projects and carry out other duties as assigned by Management.


REQUIREMENTS

- Degree or Diploma in Hospitality, Tourism, Marketing, Communications, Public Relations or a related discipline.
- Minimum 3 to 6 years of marketing communications or public relations experience, preferably within hospitality, travel, lifestyle, luxury, F&B or agency environments.
- Leadership – experience in leading and managing teams
- Excellent spoken and written English. Fluency in a second language is preferred.
- AI-enabled marketer, proficient in Claude, ChatGPT, relevant tools for content creation, presentations, project management
- Strong knowledge of marketing communications (Branding, Public Relations , Events, Advertising), hospitality trends, media//KOL connections locally/regionally
- Excellent writing, editing, media pitching and content planning skills.
- Strong stakeholder management with the ability to work across multiple business units and senior stakeholders.
- Ability to brief agencies, designers, photographers and vendors with clear objectives and timelines.
- Strong analytical skills with comfort using media monitoring, influencer analysis and campaign performance data.
- Creative, proactive and commercially minded, with a passion for hospitality and guest experiences.
- Collaborative, adaptable and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.


Why work for Accor?
We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.
By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality.
Do what you love, care for the world, dare to challenge the status quo! #BELIMITLESS
If you feel you are ready for your next professional challenge, apply on: https://careers.accor.com/

title: Team Lead Marketing & Communications - Siemens Mobility Asia Pacific
description:
Siemens Mobility is a global leader in rail transport and mobility solutions. From our Asia Pacific headquarters in Singapore, we support customers across Australia, Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam and other key markets, delivering innovative rolling stock, rail infrastructure, digital solutions, and customer services that help shape the future of sustainable mobility.

The Opportunity

As Senior Director & Team Lead Marketing & Communications, you will serve as the strategic communications and marketing partner to the Siemens Mobility Asia Pacific leadership team. You'll lead regional communications, product marketing, customer engagement, executive messaging, and major industry events while managing a high-performing team across the region.

You'll Make a Difference By



- Serve as the senior marketing and communications business partner to Asia Pacific leadership across Australia, Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam and other regional markets, shaping strategic narratives, executive messaging, customer value propositions and market positioning.
- Provide direct marketing and communications leadership for the Singapore market, supporting customer engagement, key industry events and strategic initiatives, while driving communications activities for growth opportunities in emerging markets across Asia Pacific, including Vietnam's developing high-speed rail sector.
- Lead the end-to-end planning, storytelling, orchestration, and execution of major rail industry trade shows, customer events, executive engagements, media activities, and employee events, ensuring excellence from concept development through delivery.
- Act as the primary interface to Siemens Mobility Communications Headquarters, translating global product and portfolio messaging into compelling regional campaigns and communication strategies tailored to the needs of Asia Pacific rail customers.
- Drive hands-on product marketing and tender communications, developing customer references, presentations, videos, digital and social media assets, product brochures, and press materials that directly support business acquisition and customer engagement.
- Own communications for key rail projects and business milestones, including vehicle deliveries, launch campaigns, factory visits, media tours, and customer-facing communication initiatives, ensuring close stakeholder alignment and flawless execution.
- Combine strategic communications expertise with strong editorial capabilities, creating newsletters, campaign content, and messaging frameworks while personally driving operational implementation.
- Lead and develop a lean team of two communications professionals in Thailand and Australia while remaining a highly hands-on contributor who independently manages critical projects and strategic deliverables across the region.
- Collaborate closely with Siemens Limited communications teams responsible for corporate brand, thought leadership, and reputation management, while retaining primary accountability for operational product marketing, business communications, customer engagement, and market-facing campaigns for Siemens Mobility in Asia Pacific.

What You'll Bring



- Deep experience leading integrated marketing and communications functions within complex infrastructure, transportation, industrial, technology, or public-sector environments.
- Ability to translate customer, market, regulatory, industry and business dynamics into compelling positioning, narratives, and marketing and communications strategies.
- Credibility as a trusted senior advisor, with sound judgement, discretion, and resilience when managing sensitive reputational, commercial, and strategic issues.
- Confidence leading high-profile stakeholder engagement, including customer events, executive forums, industry conferences, media activities, and government-facing engagements.
- Strong people leadership capability, with experience building, developing, and motivating high-performing teams in regional and matrixed organisations.
- Expertise delivering integrated, data-driven campaigns across owned, earned, digital, and customer-facing channels, supported by a commercial and customer-centric mindset.
- Knowledge of emerging AI-enabled marketing and communications technologies, with the ability to identify, adopt, and leverage AI-driven solutions to enhance content creation, audience engagement, campaign effectiveness, and operational efficiency.
- Experience supporting business acquisition activities through product marketing, tender communications, customer engagement, and value proposition development.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to simplify complex topics and influence diverse audiences.
- Strategic thinking combined with a highly hands-on approach to execution.

Why Siemens Mobility?

This is an opportunity to shape the reputation, positioning, and growth of one of the world's leading rail technology businesses across Asia Pacific. You'll work alongside regional and global leaders, support landmark rail projects, and help drive the future of sustainable mobility across the region.

Transform the everyday with us.

We support a diverse workforce.

Siemens is a proud equal opportunity employer, creating a work environment of diversity and inclusion. Our diverse workforce cultivates innovation and excellence and, in turn, creates a workplace where our employees belong and prosper. Diversity and inclusion help us fully realise the potential of our people. As part of Siemens' ownership culture, Siemens also genuinely supports flexible working practices that empower our employees to best meet work and personal commitments.

title: Global Esports Marketing Specialist
description:
Joining Razer will place you on a global mission to revolutionize the way the world games. Razer is a place to do great work, offering you the opportunity to make an impact globally while working across a global team located across 5 continents. Razer is also a great place to work, providing you the unique, gamer-centric  experience that will put you in an accelerated growth, both personally and professionally.

Job Responsibilities

As a Global Esports Marketing Specialist, you will drive global marketing campaigns across Team Razer, esports gear, product launches, partner activations, and always-on sustain marketing programs. This role is for a strong marketer who understands how campaigns are built end to end, from strategy and briefs through execution and post-campaign learning. You will work closely with internal teams, regional marketers, product teams, agencies, esports partners, pro players, and creators to bring Razer’s esports marketing to life globally.

The ideal candidate pairs strong marketing judgment and creative instincts with a genuine passion for competitive play and the culture around it.

Global Esports Marketing & Campaigns



- Plan and execute global esports marketing campaigns across product launches, partner moments, tournaments, and always-on sustain programs.
- Translate campaign objectives into clear briefs, creative direction, asset requirements, timelines, and channel plans.
- Partner with Product Marketing, Regional Marketing, Creative, Social, PR, and business unit teams to align esports campaigns with broader business goals.
- Support launch and sustain marketing for Razer esports products, ensuring the right messaging, assets, partners, and moments are ready for market.


Project Management, Execution & Collaboration



- Manage timelines, deliverables, approvals, asset development, and campaign execution across multiple workstreams.
- Keep projects moving by driving follow-ups, tracking action items, and maintaining clear communication with internal and external stakeholders so global esports initiatives land on time, on brand, and at a high standard.
- Support operational needs such as vendor onboarding, purchase requests, contracts, invoices, and internal documentation.
- Contribute to a team culture built on strong project management, marketing fundamentals, creativity, accountability, and continuous improvement.


Esports Partners, Players & Community



- Support relationships and co-marketing with esports teams, players, creators, agencies, and tournament partners to drive brand visibility and engagement.
- Help develop authentic content and activations that connect Razer products with esports culture.
- Coordinate product seeding and partner support to ensure pro players and teams have access to the latest Razer gear.
- Represent Razer at esports events when needed, supporting activations, content capture, partner management, and community engagement.
- Stay close to esports culture, major titles, teams, tournaments, players, and community conversations.


Performance, Insights & Competitive Tracking



- Track campaign performance across key channels — product adoption, partner performance, audience engagement, content results, and overall campaign impact — and summarize learnings for future planning.
- Support competitive benchmarking across esports brands, hardware competitors, teams, tournaments, and market activity.
- Turn insights into practical recommendations that improve future campaigns and activations.


AI-Enabled Ways of Working



- Use AI tools to accelerate day-to-day marketing work — player and team outreach, campaign briefs, content drafts, localization, research, and reporting.
- Identify and pilot AI-driven improvements to esports marketing workflows and share repeatable practices with the wider marketing team.
- Apply AI outputs with sound judgment, upholding brand voice, factual accuracy, and confidentiality standards.


Pre-Requisites

Required Qualifications



- 2+ years of marketing experience, ideally across areas such as campaigns, product marketing, digital marketing, content marketing, social, influencer, gaming, esports, or consumer tech.
- Strong understanding of marketing fundamentals, including positioning, campaign planning, briefs, creative development, asset pipelines, channel strategy, launch execution, and performance measurement.
- Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage timelines, details, approvals, and multiple workstreams simultaneously.
- Strong creative judgment and the ability to evaluate whether content, messaging, and assets are clear, compelling, and on brand.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills across internal teams, agencies, partners, creators, and talent.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities, live events, and tight deadlines.
- Analytical mindset with the ability to review campaign results, identify learnings, and recommend improvements.
- Comfortable with travel for esports events, partner activations, and community moments when required.


Preferred Qualifications



- Genuine passion for esports and gaming, with familiarity across major games, teams, players, tournaments, and competitive communities.
- Prior experience in the esports or gaming industry.
- Hands-on fluency with AI tools in a marketing context, with clear judgment about where AI can accelerate the work and where human review is required.

title: Integrated Strategy Director

The ambition is bigger than campaign planning. The opportunity spans brand strategy, creative development, always-on content, influencers, production and brand governance, with a significant opportunity to unlock more commercial value from the content already being created.
You'll be expected to bring the perspective of an excellent agency strategist while operating with the closeness, context and accountability of an in-house partner.


About the Role
Brand & Business Strategy

- Partner with senior client stakeholders to understand business priorities, commercial objectives, audience needs and brand challenges.
- Shape the annual strategic roadmap and priorities for the APAC mid-funnel programme.
- Translate business needs, consumer insight, cultural signals and performance data into clear strategic recommendations and inspiring briefs.
- Identify opportunities to connect activity across the customer journey and unlock incremental commercial impact.
- Bring strong outside-in thinking and challenge category conventions where it can strengthen the brand.
- Use measurement, market signals and learning loops to continuously improve the strategic direction.
Integrated Strategy & Creative Partnership

- Lead integrated thinking across brand, creative, content, influencers, media and performance.
- Work closely with the Creative Director to turn strategy into emotionally resonant, culturally relevant work.
- Develop and constructively challenge ideas to ensure they are distinctive, audience-led and commercially meaningful.
- Connect ATL and BTL thinking rather than treating channels and programmes in isolation.
- Personally develop and present compelling leadership decks, strategic narratives and recommendations.
- Make complex thinking clear and help senior stakeholders confidently make decisions.
Brand Governance & Ways of Working

- Help shape a clearer operating model between APAC/corporate teams and individual hotel teams.
- Identify where better processes, systems, tools or governance could reduce friction and protect brand consistency.
- Bring structure to briefing, approvals, roles, responsibilities and decision-making.
- Help create ways of working that are centrally governed but scalable across local markets.
- Partner with MASH and wider specialists as the future governance and technology model develops.


About You

- You bring significant senior experience across brand strategy, integrated marketing, communications planning or strategic planning, ideally across multiple markets.
- You have worked with premium consumer brands and understand how culture, creativity and commercial performance connect.
- You can take a complex business challenge and turn it into a clear strategic response, inspiring brief and focused action.
- You understand how brand, creative, content, creators, media and performance work together to build consideration.
- You are an exceptional storyteller and presentation builder, with the confidence to lead senior conversations and sell an idea.
- You know how to challenge constructively while remaining a trusted partner.
- You are commercially minded and naturally look for opportunities to deliver more value rather than simply answering the brief.
- You are comfortable with ambiguity and can bring clarity, structure and momentum without overcomplicating things.
- Experience across fashion, sport, luxury, lifestyle, beauty, FMCG or other culturally progressive consumer categories would be particularly interesting.
- Hospitality experience is welcome, but it is not required. We are deliberately interested in perspectives from outside traditional hospitality.


Please Note
Due to the high volume of applications, we unfortunately can't get back to everyone, and only successful applicants will be contacted. When you share your details with us, we consider this as consent for us to use your data during the application process. We may implement AI in various stages of the recruitment process, but human involvement will always remain as part of our hiring ethos. At the moment, MASH is not in a position to sponsor work visas, so you have to be eligible to legally work in the country where we're hiring.

Marketing's role is to convert execution on those three pillars into brand equity, user mindshare, and ecosystem reputation — and to proactively open new distribution and growth channels, not simply amplify existing content. The H1 2026 internal review identified conventional execution and a static channel mix as the primary gaps in the current Marketing function. We need a lead who can diagnose this situation and drive meaningful change.


Responsibilities

Redefine PancakeSwap's brand voice and visual language to build differentiated positioning in a crowded DeFi landscape. Discover and operationalize new distribution channels beyond the standard crypto playbook (Twitter/X, Telegram) — community-led platforms, creator economies, crypto-native media, Web2 surfaces, and whatever emerges next.

Build PancakeSwap's reputational equity with institutional audiences, developer communities, and mainstream crypto media. Lead the development of a multilingual, multi-regional KOL and Key Opinion Builder (KOB) system. Turn Div2 launch milestones — xStocks, RWA products, institutional partnerships — into high-impact brand moments.

Build a growth marketing framework where channel investment and content priorities are decided by data. Partner closely with Product and BD to design GTM plans for every major feature launch: Aggregator, xStocks, PropAMM. Establish a clear Marketing funnel (Awareness → Activation → Retention) with quantitative metrics reported directly to the CEO.

Quickly assess the existing Marketing team, define clear roles and workflows aligned with your leadership style, and identify capability gaps. Drive deep adoption of AI tools across content production, channel analytics, and community operations to materially improve team output per headcount.

5+ years of crypto / Web3 marketing experience, with at least one verifiable case of building a brand or growth system from scratch.
Deep understanding of DeFi products (DEX, AMM, aggregators) and the ability to translate complex technical products into clear user-value narratives.

Fluent in English; Chinese proficiency a strong plus given PancakeSwap's primary userbase.
