Prior Marketing leadership at a major DEX, CEX, or on-chain infrastructure project.
Familiarity with the BNB Chain ecosystem or hands-on BSC community operations experience.
Experience with institutional-grade or compliant DeFi product communications (RWA, regulated assets).
Heavy personal use of AI productivity tools — generative content, automated workflows, channel analytics.

title: International PR & Content | Marketing (Senior) Manager
description:
Location: Hong Kong / Singapore / Remote (International / Global)


About the Role
We are seeking an energetic, strategically minded Marketing Business Partner (Manager / Senior Manager grade) to drive OSL’s brand awareness, PR presence, and content-led pipeline expansion across international and developed markets (Europe, North America, and key global hubs). Operating as OSL’s primary content storyteller and brand catalyst internationally, you will translate complex PayFi and cross-border payment innovations into high-impact market messaging.


In this role, you will lead our English-first content strategy, direct international PR agency partners, and leverage high-profile media collaborations to build enterprise domain authority. While your core focus is high-impact written content, PR, and brand messaging, you will also support field marketing initiatives and offline event execution—including owned flagship events at major global gatherings.


Currently structured as a hands-on Individual Contributor role, this position offers immediate strategic ownership with long-term growth potential. As our international operations expand, the role is positioned to evolve to include people management responsibilities and driving cross-functional output through central shared service centers and matrixed contributors.


Key Responsibilities

- International Content Strategy & Execution: Plan, write, and publish high-caliber English B2B content—including whitepapers, deep-dive articles, enterprise case studies, and executive thought leadership—tailored to international corporate decision-makers and financial institutions.
- PR Agency & Tier-1 Media Management: Manage external international PR agencies across target regions to amplify brand reach cost-effectively. Drive tier-1 media placements, executive interview opportunities (e.g., CNBC), and strategic content distribution via partners like The Block.
- Executive Presence & Conference Strategy: Coordinate high-impact speaking slots and panel opportunities for OSL leadership at major global summits to establish the firm as a premier PayFi and regulated digital asset partner.
- Pipeline Foundation & Budget Scaling: Establish the client pipeline and content foundation in Q4 to prepare for strategic budget scaling and campaign deployment in Q1. Ensure content and PR directly feed top-of-funnel enterprise lead generation.
- Field Marketing & Flagship Event Support: Provide field marketing support for global roadshows, webinars, and partner salons. Co-lead the planning and execution of OSL’s owned flagship side-event during Hong Kong Fintech Week next year.
- Ecosystem Partnerships & Co-Marketing: Collaborate with key industry platforms, media channels, and ecosystem partners to negotiate co-marketing initiatives, build platform-level endorsements, and expand brand authority.
- Competitive Benchmarking & Positioning: Continuously benchmark OSL’s value proposition against traditional and emerging international payment and crypto infrastructure providers to refine brand narrative and positioning.


Requirements & Qualifications

- 5+ years of B2B content marketing, PR, or brand marketing experience targeting international/developed markets. Background in Web3/Crypto, Fintech, Enterprise SaaS, or Payments is preferred.
- Native or near-native English copywriting and editing skills, with a proven portfolio of B2B technical narratives, thought leadership, and PR copy for executive audiences.
- Proven experience managing international PR agencies and securing placements or executive interviews in tier-1 financial and tech media outlets.
- A self-starter capable of taking full ownership from high-level campaign conceptualization through execution as a high-impact IC, with the capability to scale into people management or lead shared-service resources in the future.
- Experience supporting offline industry events, webinars, or commercial roadshows.
- Self-motivated and comfortable collaborating across global time zones.
- Fluent/Native English is required. Mandarin is a plus (good to have), but not required.
- Deep payment experience is a plus (good to have), but not mandatory—ability to quickly master cross-border payment mechanics, stablecoins, and PayFi is required.


About OSL

- OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
- OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
BullionStar has no shortage of things worth marketing. We sell physical gold and silver, operate a market leading bullion centre and vaults across three countries, have an active and highly engaged customer base, and sit in an industry that is rarely short of something to talk about. What we need is someone to bring it all together.


As Marketing Manager, you will own the marketing plan and turn it into campaigns across social, email, content, PR, the website and our physical bullion centre. You will decide what we should be talking about, how we should talk about it, where it should appear, and how the different pieces come together. This is not a role where you will be handed a marketing plan to execute, you will help shape it with the Deputy CEO, and the wider team. What we need from you is the judgement to spot a good opportunity, know what to do with it, and turn it into marketing that works.


Who we are


BullionStar is Singapore’s leading precious metals dealer. We sell, buy back, store, and deliver physical gold, silver, and platinum to customers worldwide – from first-time buyers to institutional investors. We operate a full-service showroom in Singapore, a comprehensive e-commerce platform, and vault storage facilities across multiple jurisdictions.


We are independently owned, founder-led, and intentionally lean. There are no layers of corporate bureaucracy here. Decisions are made quickly, everyone is close to the customer, and every person in the business has a direct impact on what we deliver. We’ve built our reputation on trust, transparency, and doing things properly.


We’re looking for people who are drawn to that kind of environment – people who want ownership, not job titles, and who find energy in building something rather than maintaining something.


One thing to know about our audience: they are sceptics by temperament. They distrust banks, they distrust hype, and they will distrust us the moment we sound like an ad. The marketing that works here earns attention with substance.


What you will do

- Strategy. A real marketing plan: which audiences, what message, which channels, what calendar, and why. Shaped with the Deputy CEO, the wider team, and owned and executed by you.



- Campaigns. Product launches, limited time offers, seasonal pushes and competitions across digital, social, email and the store itself. The idea, the assets, the timing and the follow-through are yours.



- Social and community. With our creatives, drive what we do on X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok and LinkedIn: the calendar, the formats and the growth. Show up where people already talk about gold and silver too: Reddit, forums and comment sections. Answer questions genuinely, understand what people care about, and bring those insights back into our marketing.



- Email. The programme end-to-end: calendar, segments, offers, copy, send, and the honest read on what it returned. Every send must earn the next one.



- Creative and content direction. Photography, video, graphics, ad creative and written content. You will not be behind the camera all day, but you will be the reason the work is good: the briefs, the direction, the feedback and the standard. You will also have real input into how bullionstar.com itself develops.



- Media relations. Be proactive with PR. Spot the opportunity, whether it is a journalist’s query, a news moment or a story worth pitching, and find the way to make it happen and land well.



- Analytics. We have an unusually deep warehouse of order and campaign data, plus analytics support. Know which campaigns moved product, which did not, and feed that into the next plan.



- The thread. Product, the shop floor, editorial, social, email, website: someone must make the post, the email, the site banner and the shop window feel like one campaign.


Who you are

- Campaigns directed, not just contributed to. Walk us through one from strategy to results: the audience, the idea, what you made, what you directed and what happened. More than once and across more than one channel.



- Excellent written and spoken English. This one is absolute. Plans that persuade, copy that sells without sounding like it, and the same standard out loud. Nothing else on this list can offset it. Your application is your first writing sample.



- E-commerce experience. You have marketed products that people buy online and understand the whole journey from first impression to landing page to checkout and repeat purchase. You think about the campaign and the buying experience as one thing and understand that getting attention is only useful if something happens afterwards.



- Social and email as crafts, not distribution channels. You understand how each platform works. Follower counts you inherited do not count; things you made that travelled do. You have also run an EDM programme yourself and can show what it returned.



- Understanding of brand and customer. Your creative judgement is grounded in who we are and who buys from us, not personal taste. You can explain the call to someone who disagrees.



- Genuinely inquisitive. You do not need to arrive knowing the difference between a kilobar and a collectible coin, but you should want to. Nobody hands you a syllabus here. You teach yourself the business, the industry, the products and the customers because you want to know, and it shows up in the work.



- You see the opportunity in the product. Gold and silver are unusual things to market. They are valuable, physical, visual and surrounded by history, markets, politics, manufacturing, collecting and some very opinionated customers. Then there are the vaults, the shop floor, the deliveries and the moments when the price moves and the shop suddenly fills up. You notice those things and instinctively start thinking about what we could do with them.



- You pay attention to the market. You know what our competitors are doing, what they are doing well and where they are getting it wrong. You look beyond bullion too, learning from the best ideas in e-commerce and other industries. You do not copy for the sake of it, but you are always watching, learning and thinking about what we could do better.



- Creative judgement. You have made enough yourself, whether video, image, layout or ad, to know quickly when something is not good enough and to explain why.



- Commercial instinct. You care about reach, engagement and brand, but you know they are not the result. Marketing here ultimately must attract customers, sell metal and grow the business. You naturally ask what something cost, what it returned and whether we should do it again.



- The whole digital picture. You understand SEO, paid media, attribution and conversion well enough to see how they fit together, even where specialists run the channel. You are comfortable enough with numbers to judge your own campaigns honestly.



- Media relations. You know how to spot a story worth pitching, deal with journalists and turn something happening in the business or the market into an opportunity.



- Based in Singapore. This is an on-site role at New Bridge Road. We work in the same room. And when we are busy, everyone gets stuck in the shop, the customers, the vault. An afternoon on the shop floor can teach you more than a month of dashboards.

title: Head of Communications & Creative
description:
Reimagine access. Reimagine ownership. Build the future with Cinch.

Cinch is Southeast Asia's leading circular tech subscription company, redefining how people and businesses access technology. Instead of adding to the growing e-waste crisis, we enable affordable, sustainable access to devices through subscriptions that maximize reuse and extend their lifecycle.

We operate across B2C, B2B, and B2B2C channels, including major partnerships with global leaders like Samsung. Our model sits at the intersection of powerful mega trends—sustainability, embedded finance, and the shift from ownership to access—creating a massive opportunity to reshape the future of tech consumption.

At Cinch, we are builders with high standards, a bias for action, and a shared mission to create a generational company that outlasts us. Freshly funded by leading institutional investors and growing rapidly, we're creating an environment where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers—and where the work has real, lasting impact.

About The Role

We're looking for a Head of Communications & Creative to lead Cinch's brand voice, creative output, and communications strategy across both B2C and B2B. This is a senior leadership role for someone who sets direction and raises the bar — building out the brand framework, messaging architecture, and tone of voice, and ensuring everything we put out reflects a consistent, high standard.

You'll lead a small in-house team and work alongside external creative partners to deliver at pace and scale. The role requires someone equally at home shaping strategy and reviewing final creative — someone who can lead a team as effectively as they can write a brief.

This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to senior leadership across B2C and B2B, including major regional and global partnerships.

What You'll Do

Communications Leadership



- Own Cinch's communications strategy across B2C and B2B — defining what we say, how we say it, and to whom
- Develop and refine messaging pillars, tone of voice, and narrative frameworks that hold consistently across all channels and audiences
- Lead Cinch's media and PR presence; manage relationships with communications agencies and press contacts
- Partner with Product, CX, and Commercial teams to translate business milestones into timely, high-impact communications

Creative Direction



- Set and maintain the creative vision for Cinch across all brand touchpoints — digital, print, video, events, and presentations
- Lead the in-house team and external creative partners to deliver work that meets a consistently high standard
- Provide clear creative direction on all major briefs, ensuring quality and on-brand execution regardless of who produces the work
- Ensure visual and verbal consistency across everything Cinch produces

Brand Strategy



- Strengthen and evolve Cinch's brand identity — including visual language, brand guidelines, and messaging architecture
- Act as the internal brand custodian, setting the framework and maintaining final sign-off on creative output
- Build brand equity through consistent, well-executed communications — not just campaign moments

B2B Communications



- Drive communications for high-stakes B2B partnerships and commercial relationships, including fast-turnaround deliverables for regional and global partners
- Oversee business-facing materials: pitch decks, co-marketing assets, partner announcements, and thought leadership content
- Balance speed and quality in a high-pressure B2B environment where timelines are tight and stakes are high

Team Leadership & Operations



- Lead, develop, and grow a small in-house communications and creative team
- Bring in and manage external agencies and freelancers to supplement in-house capacity where needed
- Establish clear briefing processes, creative workflows, and quality standards across all output
- Manage the communications and creative budget effectively

What We're Looking For

Must-haves



- 8–12 years in communications, brand, or creative leadership — with meaningful experience on both strategy and execution
- A track record of elevating brand and communications in a high-growth environment (tech, fintech, marketplace, or consumer brand)
- Experience leading in-house teams while managing external agencies and freelancers in parallel
- Strong command of both B2C and B2B communications; comfortable shifting between consumer campaigns and business-critical partner materials
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — you can produce a compelling brief, a polished announcement, and a persuasive pitch in the same week
- High creative judgment — you know what good looks like and can communicate it clearly enough that your team consistently delivers it

Nice-to-haves



- Experience strengthening or refreshing a brand identity, in-house or with an external agency
- Familiarity with the SEA media landscape and regional creative ecosystem
- Background in fintech, payments, or a related regulated industry
- Hands-on comfort with design tools (Figma, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite) — not required, but appreciated

title: Category & Brand Director, SEA
description:

Total enterprise leadership to create a consumer first business, which is consistently beating the competition and delivering high total shareholder return.

From defining brand strategy to launching campaigns that people remember, the work here influences how we show up in the moments that matter.

title: Senior Marketing Communications Specialist
description:
About Us
We are building a new-generation leadership development venture focused on transforming how CEOs and senior executives lead, grow, and create lasting impact.
Through bespoke, evidence-informed solutions, we aim to redefine CEO development by integrating leadership intelligence, human potential, organisational transformation, and technology.
As an early-stage company, we seek an entrepreneurial, resourceful, hands-on marketing professional to build our brand, establish market presence, and create meaningful visibility.
This is an opportunity to work directly with the founder and shape a distinctive brand in the global leadership development market.


Key Responsibilities
1. Brand Development & Market Positioning

- Develop and execute initiatives to establish the company's brand identity, positioning, messaging, and value proposition.
- Build awareness among CEOs, C-suite executives, CHROs, corporate decision-makers, and industry stakeholders.
- Translate the company's vision, intellectual property, frameworks, and programmes into compelling, commercially relevant messaging.
- Maintain consistent brand positioning and visual identity across digital channels and corporate materials.
- Develop marketing collateral that communicates the value and differentiation of our solutions.


2. Digital Marketing & Social Media

- Manage the company's digital presence and social media, particularly LinkedIn.
- Develop a content calendar aligned with brand positioning, business priorities, and founder visibility.
- Create, edit, publish, and repurpose posts, articles, newsletters, videos, interviews, and other content.
- Communicate the founder's expertise, leadership perspectives, and distinctive points of view.
- Monitor reach, engagement, audience growth, and other metrics to improve effectiveness.
- Apply AI-powered tools to enhance content production, efficiency, and workflow automation.


3. Public Relations, Media Relations & Founder Visibility

- Develop and execute a proactive PR and media relations plan to strengthen the company's and founder's visibility and credibility.
- Identify relevant journalists, editors, business publications, podcasts, broadcasters, event organisers, conferences, and industry communities.
- Proactively pitch the founder for interviews, expert commentary, podcasts, panel discussions, speaking engagements, and media features.
- Build and maintain a targeted media contact database and structured pipeline for outreach and follow-ups.
- Identify timely business, leadership, workplace, and organisational topics for the founder to comment on.
- Prepare media pitches, press releases, executive profiles, interview briefs, and talking points.
- Coordinate interview preparation, scheduling, and distribution of published content.
- Build relationships with media professionals and event organisers, tracking outreach, invitations, confirmed engagements, and coverage to refine results.


4. Content Marketing & Thought Leadership

- Develop a content strategy that reinforces the company's expertise, intellectual property, and market differentiation.
- Work with the founder to turn complex leadership concepts and original insights into clear, engaging content.
- Produce articles, newsletters, interviews, videos, case studies, and other thought leadership materials.
- Repurpose existing intellectual property, programme insights, research, and interviews for different audiences and platforms.
- Maintain an editorial calendar aligned with marketing priorities and business objectives.
- Explore content collaborations with business communities, professional associations, publications, and industry experts.
5. Marketing Campaigns & Business Development Support

- Plan and execute targeted campaigns to build awareness, generate qualified enquiries, and support commercial growth.
- Promote CEO coaching, executive development programmes, leadership workshops, and other offerings.
- Develop tailored materials for corporate clients, strategic partners, and potential investors.
- Support executive roundtables, leadership forums, webinars, and other strategic initiatives.
- Align marketing with target markets, client acquisition priorities, and sales opportunities.
- Identify partnerships, co-marketing initiatives, and channels to expand market reach.
- Monitor campaign performance and improve lead quality, engagement, and commercial outcomes.
6. Website, Marketing Operations & Performance Tracking

- Maintain website content, landing pages, search visibility, and digital brand consistency.
- Coordinate external designers, developers, photographers, videographers, PR providers, and other specialists.
- Establish practical systems for content planning, media outreach, campaign execution, and reporting.
- Manage marketing expenditure responsibly, prioritising strategic impact within available resources.
- Track digital engagement, media outreach, founder visibility, campaign outcomes, qualified enquiries, and business development contribution.
- Review performance and adjust activities based on results, audience feedback, and business priorities.
7. Hands-on Execution & Collaboration

- Own marketing and communications activities from planning through execution.
- Manage multiple projects independently, meeting deadlines and quality standards.
- Coordinate freelancers, agencies, and other external partners when specialist support is needed.
- Deliver effective outcomes with limited resources by establishing efficient processes and reusable marketing assets.
- Work closely with the founder to translate business priorities into actionable plans.
- Identify opportunities, solve problems, and improve effectiveness without waiting for detailed instructions.


Requirements

- At least 10 years of relevant experience in marketing, brand communications, PR, digital marketing, content marketing, or related disciplines.
- Proven experience executing marketing activities and building brand visibility, preferably in B2B, professional services, consulting, leadership development, technology, or other expertise-driven businesses.
- Practical experience in media relations, PR, executive profiling, thought leadership, or securing speaking and interview opportunities.
- Strong hands-on capabilities in social media management, content development, and digital marketing.
- Excellent English writing, editing, storytelling, and communication skills.
- Ability to translate business objectives and complex ideas into clear, compelling communications.
- Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage priorities independently.
- Commercial awareness and understanding of how marketing supports credibility, lead generation, partnerships, and revenue growth.
- Experience working with founders, senior executives, or leadership teams is an advantage.
- Familiarity with AI-powered content tools, digital analytics, marketing platforms, and workflow automation.
- Comfortable coordinating external agencies and freelancers while personally executing key activities.
Personal Attributes
We are looking for someone who is:

- Hands-on and resourceful: Executes, rather than simply plans or delegates.
- Proactive and opportunity-driven: Identifies media opportunities, builds relationships, and follows up consistently.
- A strong communicator and storyteller: Communicates complex ideas with clarity, credibility, and originality.
- Entrepreneurial and adaptable: Thrives in an early-stage venture with limited resources and evolving priorities.
- Independent and accountable: Takes ownership and delivers without constant supervision.
- Commercially minded: Connects marketing activities to meaningful business outcomes, not just visibility.
- Collaborative and trustworthy: Works closely with the founder and represents the company professionally.
What Success Looks Like
Success will be measured against agreed priorities, available resources, and the company's stage of development. Key expectations for the first 6–12 months include:
Brand & Digital Presence

- Establish clear, consistent positioning across key communication channels.
- Implement a sustainable marketing and content calendar.
- Improve the quality, relevance, consistency, and reach of digital communications.
Media & Founder Visibility

- Build a targeted database of media contacts, podcast hosts, conference organisers, and speaking platforms.
- Establish a consistent, documented process for pitching, follow-ups, and relationship development.
- Generate qualified media enquiries, interview invitations, podcast opportunities, speaking engagements, and other visibility opportunities.
- Increase relevant media coverage and distribution of the founder's thought leadership, subject to editorial decisions and external platform availability.
Content & Market Engagement

- Establish a repeatable process for developing and distributing distinctive thought leadership.
- Improve engagement among executive, corporate, and industry audiences.
- Develop marketing assets that clearly communicate the company's expertise and differentiated offerings.
Commercial Contribution

- Support qualified enquiries, client acquisition, partnerships, and business development.
- Track marketing's contribution to commercial opportunities and refine campaigns accordingly.
- Establish a practical reporting framework to evaluate progress and guide priorities.
- Performance targets will be agreed with the founder based on baseline measurements, available resources, and business objectives

title: Head of Marketing and Communications (Singapore and Indonesia)
description:
Job ID

295222

08-Sep-2026

Advisory Segment

About The Role


Lead marketing and communications for CBRE across Singapore and Indonesia, and position the company as the pre-eminent real estate thought leader in both markets. Using earned and owned media, digital and social channels, events and research-led content, you will build share of voice and turn CBRE’s market intelligence into commercial advantage.

Armed with strong media relationships, you will identify opportunities to profile subject matter experts and work closely with them to deliver differentiated points of view on the real estate industry. You will lead a team of five to eight marketing and communications professionals, own the country marketing budget, and act as a trusted adviser to country and business line leadership.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role in a matrix environment. You will set strategy and stay close enough to the work to deliver it.

What You’ll Do


 Strategy and business partnering 


‒ Develop and deliver an integrated, ROI-focused marketing and communications strategy across Singapore and Indonesia, covering public relations, digital and social, events, internal communications and brand.

‒ Partner country leadership and business line leaders so that marketing and communications operates as a business enabler rather than a service desk.

‒ Own and manage the country marketing budget, with clear reporting of spend against outcomes.

‒ Set the measurement standard for the function, covering share of voice, campaign performance, event contribution to pipeline and digital engagement, and report against it to leadership each quarter.

‒ Contribute to regional marketing and communications initiatives and project roll-outs across Asia Pacific.

 Public relations and media 


‒ Act as the key media liaison in Singapore and Indonesia, identifying and pitching stories and securing profiling opportunities for business leaders.

‒ Develop compelling messages, media releases, media responses, byline articles and speeches for senior management.

‒ Build and maintain relationships with tier-one business, property and trade media across both markets.

‒ Manage PR agency partners, including scope, performance, deliverables and budget.

‒ Support regional and global teams on issues and crisis communications, preparing local statements, briefing spokespeople and managing local media response, escalating in line with CBRE protocol.

‒ Maintain spokesperson briefing materials and question-and-answer documents, and arrange media training for senior leaders.

 Events and industry engagement 


‒ Own the events strategy end to end, from flagship client events and research launches to executive roundtables, industry sponsorships and internal town halls.

‒ Manage event budgets, venue and vendor selection, run of show, speaker preparation and post-event follow-up, with clear measurement of commercial return.

‒ Develop an influencer and industry body engagement strategy, including CBRE’s presence and speaking platforms at key industry events in both markets.

 Content, research marketing and digital 


‒ Work with CBRE Research to turn market intelligence into campaign-ready content and to build launch moments around flagship reports.

‒ Drive lead generation through social and digital channels, working with regional digital teams on campaign build, targeting, marketing technology and reporting.

‒ Act as brand custodian for both markets, maintaining CBRE brand standards across every piece of external and internal output.

‒ Support business development and pursuit teams with marketing collateral and credentials for major client bids.

 Internal communications and employer brand 


‒ Drive internal communications for employee engagement, change communications and leadership visibility.

‒ Strengthen CBRE’s employer brand in partnership with the People team, supporting recruitment and retention priorities.

 Team leadership 


‒ Lead, coach and develop a team of five to eight professionals across PR, digital, events and internal communications.

‒ Set objectives, manage performance and build capability and succession within the team.

‒ Provide direction and quality control across all local marketing initiatives and campaigns.

What You’ll Need


 Experience: essential 


‒ Degree holder with 12 to 14 years’ experience in marketing and communications.

‒ Within that, a minimum of three to four years leading public relations and events at a senior level, with direct accountability for media strategy and for flagship event delivery.

‒ Experience gained in a multinational or large listed organisation with multiple stakeholders, matrix reporting and regional or global reporting lines. This is a requirement, not a preference.

‒ Proven record of managing PR and event agencies, including briefing, performance management and budget control.

‒ Demonstrated ownership of a marketing budget, with the ability to report return on that spend.

‒ People leadership experience, having managed a team of five or more.

‒ Established media relationships in Singapore, with proven ability to secure tier-one coverage.

 Experience: advantageous 


‒ Indonesia market exposure, or a demonstrated track record of building media relationships in a new market.

‒ Real estate, professional services, financial services or agency background.

‒ Experience supporting issues or crisis communications within an established corporate protocol.

‒ Bahasa Indonesia or Mandarin in addition to strong written and spoken English in view of the in-country market communications.

 Skills and attributes 


‒ Proven expertise in social and digital marketing, including campaign measurement and marketing technology platforms.

‒ Credible with senior stakeholders, and comfortable advising and constructively challenging country and business line leadership.

‒ Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a dynamic environment with competing priorities.

‒ A positive, can-do attitude and readiness to roll up the sleeves and get the job done.

‒ Willingness to travel between Singapore and Indonesia as the role requires.

Why CBRE


When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

Applicant AI Use Disclosure


We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

OUR VALUES IN HIRING


At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

About CBRE Group, Inc. CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE: CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm and a premier provider of critical infrastructure services. The company has more than 155,000 employees serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves clients through four business segments: Advisory (leasing, sales, debt origination, mortgage servicing, valuations); Building Operations & Experience (facilities management, property management, flex space & experience, critical infrastructure); Project Management (program management, project management, cost consulting); Real Estate Investments (investment management, development). Please visit our website at www.cbre.com .

The Role


The specific portfolio will be confirmed on appointment, based on your strengths and the needs of the business.


Your primary focus is go-to-market and demand generation: planning, budgeting, resourcing, execution, reporting, and optimisation, directed at building qualified pipeline across our commercial and government customers. You also lead the region’s external presence across media, PR, and messaging.


This is a hands-on role. You lead a small team while remaining close to the work yourself: developing the strategy, building the plans, and delivering the campaigns. You will also help build the templates and playbooks the wider team adopts, piloting them in your own market first.


Where This Leads


This is a lean team, which means real responsibility from the outset and broad exposure to how the function operates. There is scope to take on more over time, earned through delivery rather than tenure.


What You Will Own



- Go-to-market and demand generation. Own the end-to-end cycle across digital, paid search, content, account-based marketing, and events, from plan and budget through to channel mix and results. You are accountable for pipeline and revenue, and you measure the work on outcomes rather than activity.
- PR and communications. Lead external communications for your market, including media relations, press, messaging, and any local agency, in coordination with the central communications team.
- Product marketing. Lead positioning, product launches, and the sales narrative, supported by the competitive intelligence that differentiates us in trade and port technology.
- Sales enablement. Equip the sales team to win with the right pitch, collateral, and case studies, identifying gaps and addressing them to a high standard.
- Events and field marketing. Own major industry events and field marketing end to end, from positioning through to measurable results.
- Team leadership. Lead and develop a small team: setting objectives, supporting development, managing performance, and raising the standard of the team’s work.
- Performance and optimisation. Own measurement and reporting, including dashboards, attribution, and analysis, and use the findings to improve marketing performance.
- Budget. Own the marketing budget, allocate it against priorities, and account for the return it delivers.


Who You Are



- You own the result. You are measured on pipeline, revenue, and adoption, and you manage to those targets. You plan back from the goal and adjust the approach when the numbers are not moving.
- You work independently. When you encounter something unfamiliar, you research it, test it, and make a decision, then document what worked so others can build on it.
- You speak your mind. When a strategy is weak or a forecast does not hold up, you say so, to peers and to leadership alike, and you support your position with reasoning. You revise your view when the evidence changes, and you expect the same of others.
- You hold a high standard. You expect a great deal of yourself and your team, and you see work through until it is right. You give direct feedback, and those around you improve for it.
- You lead across functions. You align sales, product, and the wider business through influence and credibility rather than authority. You manage upwards and sideways as effectively as you manage your own team.


About the Group Marketing & Communications Team


The Group Marketing & Communications team is small but broad in scope, covering demand generation and go-to-market across our commercial and government customers, in both trade and ports, together with corporate events, internal communications, and PR. Everyone here owns a substantial portfolio rather than a narrow function.


Qualifications


You bring around five to eight years in B2B marketing, ideally with B2G exposure, and a track record of progression from campaign execution to owning strategy and being accountable for pipeline and revenue. You have communications experience across media, PR, and external messaging, and you write well. Product marketing experience is an advantage. Ideally you have run a region, segment, or product line, managed a budget, and led at least one direct report. You are fluent across the marketing stack: demand generation, product marketing, sales enablement, CRM and marketing automation, paid search, and analytics. You are comfortable with data and decisive in your judgement. Experience in technology, supply chain, trade, or government-facing sectors is an advantage, though the ability to learn a complex domain quickly matters more.

title: Pasta & Condiments Southeast Asia Associate Manager
description:
Sep 25, 2026

Pasta & Condiments Southeast Asia Associate Manager

About Barilla

At Barilla, we believe that every great journey begins with passion and a bold vision. From our humble beginnings in 1877 in a small shop in Parma, Italy, we’ve blossomed into a global leader in the food industry, guided by our commitment to progress and excellence.

Today, Barilla is an international group present in more than 100 countries and we are proud to be recognized as the world’s top food company by reputation. With 22 beloved brands in our portfolio, we are world leader for pasta, the number one choice for ready-made sauces in Europe, leader for bakery products in Italy, and for crispbread across Scandinavia with Wasa.

Our success story is written by a passionate team of almost 9,000 dedicated employees across 30 plants and offices worldwide, all united by a shared mission to nourish the future with purpose and passion.

Are you ready to add your unique flavor to our journey?

Introduction - Organizational Details

Barilla Singapore seeks to recruit the next marketing leader responsible for Southeast Asia Cluster. The individual will directly report to the Pasta & Condiments Director APAC. The position is based in Singapore.

Lead and implement the 3Y and annual plans (incl. innovation) for both Pasta and Condiments, and ensure congruent executions in the market via collaboration with internal functions (sales, etc.) and distributors and agencies.

Manage operational implementation and tracking of annual plan for the pasta and condiment categories, in order to achieve brand penetration & share growth and profitability within the defined framework set by the guidelines provided.

- Continuously advocate the Barilla values in the market and with the Business Partner. Champion the bridge of Barilla’s values with core values of the Business Partner and local consumers.
- Lead and collaborate with the distributors in the definition of the marketing strategy and plans which include budget management, pricing, promotion, portfolio and communication strategy. Support the Business Partner in the integration and adaptation of categories marketing plan into a meaningful local plan. Maintain continuous partnership with the Business Partner to optimise plans where necessary.
- Lead new innovation development in collaboration with the region, RDQ and external partners; and roll outs of current innovations. Guarantee full operational support to specific launches & campaign development, in order to maximize the market performance in terms of effectiveness, timeliness, efficiency, and quality, by working closely with internal and external partners to implement the plan (e.g. sales, logistics, service providers, agencies, suppliers, etc.).
- Collaborate with the Business Partner and agency in the definition of the in-store and digital strategy. Digital strategy includes the editorial plan and content creation with agency and chef(s).

- Manage and maintain relationships by providing constant feedback and updates to all the stakeholders involved.

Requirements 



- Bachelor’s or Master degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing or related field
- Min 5 years of experience in Marketing roles
- Intellectual curiosity, open minded, passionate and flexible
- Solid communication and presentation skills
- Resilient and positive attitude
- “Can do” attitude, ability to combine hands on approach with strategic thinking and excellence in execution

- Understanding of Barilla’s values and strategy
- Experience in leading digital strategy and category management
- Experience with innovation and project management

title: Manager/Senior Manager, Segment Marketing & Visitor Experience B
description:
[What the role is]

The Segment Marketing and Visitor Experience Division (SMVE) is a division within Marketing Group that champions target segment strategies to support quality tourism. The division plays an integral role in developing segment insights through research and analysis – including demographics, psychographics, travel motivations and behaviours, decision drivers and spending habits – to formulate effective segment marketing and segment-focused product and experience strategies, and execute segment marketing initiatives that drive arrivals and spend amongst our target segments.

[What you will be working on]

In this role, your main focus would be on the BTMICE segment. You will need to gain in-depth MICE target segment (MICE event organisers and travellers) understanding to identify gaps and opportunities and develop actionable insights that will inform the formulation of a segment-specific marketing strategy and corresponding workplan.

You will be a key member of the team that plans and executes global MICE marketing activities to profile and drive consideration for Singapore as a top MICE destination.

Target segment analysis and understanding

Develop target segment analysis and regularly track and monitor indicators that can inform and guide global marketing strategy, and where relevant, product and experience development. The target segment understanding includes but is not limited to, analysing data sets from a breadth of sources, and/or conducting in-depth consumer research (quantitative and qualitative) on STB’s target MICE event organiser segments, to understand their demographics, psychographics, booking motivations, decision-making, needs and behaviours and the formulation of actionable insights that can inform the BTMICE marketing strategy and plans.

Development and implementation of MICE marketing activities



- Develop and execute Board’s MICE global marketing activities across paid and owned touchpoints, ensuring the activities are grounded on target segment’s insights, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, external agencies and vendors to ensure timely delivery and quality outcomes. The successful candidate should also be able to demonstrate the ability to conceptualise and craft engaging and effective content across digital platforms (including social media, MICE EDM, landing pages, video and written case studies) and below-the-line formats:
-  Content partnerships: Develop and execute strategic media partnerships with key MICE trade and business news media publications to create engaging branded content to drive awareness and consideration as the choice destination among MICE event organisers and attendees. You will be required to work closely with media partners in the conceptualisation and shaping of content angles/structure as well as on the ideal content formats (e.g. web, social, video) for effective delivery of our key messages. Track and analyse the effectiveness of the media partnership plans against the intended objectives and to work with media partners to optimise performance and quality of content.
-  VisitSingapore Business Events LinkedIn page management: Lead and manage STB’s MICE global social media account (VisitSingapore Business Events) on LinkedIn including content strategy, calendar planning and execution to meet MICE marketing objectives. The successful candidate will need to collaborate with external agencies as well as in-house creative studio to execute and produce the social content. Analyse paid and organic performance and formulate recommendations to optimise social content to enhance marketing performance.
-  MICE EDM marketing campaign: Develop and execute quarterly MICE EDM marketing campaigns targeting MICE event organisers, from conceptualisation to delivery and analysis, with support of an external agency. Formulate engaging and compelling EDM content including copy, appealing visuals and persuasive calls to action. Analyse performance and identify opportunities for EDM campaign optimisation to optimise campaign effectiveness and engagement rates. To also update and maintain the accuracy and hygiene of the MICE email database on a regular cadence, complying with prevailing data protection regulations.
-  MICE event case studies (video and web) Lead and develop video content captures of notable MICE events held in Singapore for use for paid and owned marketing, with the support of an appointed video production company. You will be required to manage the appointed production house in the crafting of the video's narrative, storyboarding, selection and liaison with interview profiles (e.g. event organiser, event delegates, conference speakers) across pre-production, during the actual shoot and into post-production to ensure output delivers the intended marketing objectives and messages. For each video case study, there will be an accompanying web case study for STB’s MICE website (VisitSingapore.com/MICE) that you will need to develop with the support of an external agency/in-house creative studio.
-  Partner STB’s MICE line units and Regional Offices to support business development efforts through various marketing activities, including collateral and asset creation for owned and paid touchpoints, key MICE travel tradeshows and business development activities.
-  You may also be asked to support initiatives that the division may need to take on from time to time.

[What we are looking for]



- At least 3 years of relevant experience in marketing campaign planning, development and execution. 
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyse data from multiple sources (e.g., in-house data, surveys, third-party research studies) to identify trends, patterns, and derive actionable insights related to target segments and their visitor experience that will result in clear strategies to grow STB's target segments outcomes.
- Strong project management and analytical skills, with the ability to navigate issues, problem solve and work collaboratively with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
- Highly motivated, organised, adaptable and able to perform within tight timelines.
- Experience managing creative, social and PR agencies, production house and other vendors in a multi-stakeholder setting.
- Content marketing experience across videos, short form and long form storytelling.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and strong attention to detail.
- Able to work independently with high initiative and can effectively contribute within a dynamic cross-functional, cross-cultural environment.

“Good to Have” for the job



- Familiarity and past experience with B2B marketing and communications is a plus.
- Experience in applying Generative AI solutions to accelerate content ideation and development and optimise workflows is a plus.
- Proficiency in conducting market research using various methodologies (e.g., surveys, focus groups, in-depth interviews) to understand traveller behaviour, preferences, and needs.
- Prior work experience in consumer research.

Application Status: Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within 2 weeks from the closing date of this job posting. We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: Marketing Manager, Southeast Asia
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

We are seeking a versatile marketing leader to manage our marketing engagement across Southeast Asia. As our first local marketing person in the region, you will design and execute a comprehensive GTM strategy that accounts for the diverse cultural, economic, and linguistic landscape of Southeast Asia, with a core focus on key markets like Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia, and Thailand. You will be responsible for identifying high-growth clusters, navigating complex regulatory environments, and building a unified brand voice that resonates across multiple markets. Your work will span social, influencers, partner, and event marketing. You will be at the center of the region's organic, outbound activity.

Location: Singapore (plus a few weeks at HQ for an extended orientation)

You Will



- Holistic Regional Strategy: Design a scalable marketing framework that can be adapted for priority Southeast Asian markets and secondary markets across the broader region.
- Localized Content Ecosystem: Oversee the "transcreation" and localization of all marketing assets. While English is our core working language, you will ensure our brand voice translates with native-level nuance across regions, leveraging your language skills where applicable.
- Agile GTM Execution: Lead product launches across Southeast Asia, prioritizing markets based on data, barriers to entry, and localized product-market fit.
- Cross-Border Community & Influencer Growth: Leverage regional social media and platform trends to build a loyal community through targeted influencer partnerships and localized channels (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, etc.).
- Policy & Comms Collaboration: Work closely with legal and policy teams to navigate the varied regulatory landscapes, ensuring absolute compliance with local data privacy and advertising standards.
- Event & Ecosystem Strategy: Develop locally relevant events and community initiatives across key priority markets, while also participating in existing industry events that support relationship building, market understanding and ecosystem growth.
- Strategic Market Partnerships: Build and develop trusted partnerships with brands, NGOs, and platforms across markets to strengthen local credibility, relevance and long-term growth, while deepening engagement with creators, industry stakeholders and broader market ecosystems.

You'll Have



- 8+ years of marketing experience with a deep, pan-regional focus across Southeast Asia.
- Independent Drive: Proven ability to operate autonomously within a strategic framework, driving clear outcomes with minimal day-to-day oversight.
- Language Proficiency: Absolute professional fluency in English. The ability to understand, speak, or review content in Bahasa Indonesia, Filipino/Tagalog, Bahasa Malaysia, and/or Vietnamese is a plus.
- Broad Market Knowledge: Experience managing marketing efforts in highly fragmented environments—from varying audience demographics and cultural perceptions to distinct economic climates across Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia, and Vietnam.
- 5+ years in Consumer Tech: Deep understanding of the Southeast Asian consumer journey, specifically mobile-first behaviors, privacy considerations, and local trust barriers.
- Strategic Influence: Proven ability to advocate effectively for regional Southeast Asian needs (budget, product localized features, compliance requirements) to a global/US-based HQ.
- Data-Driven test and learn mentality: Ability to drive growth and iterate quickly by being resourceful, analytical, and hands-on.

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About the company
At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.


Job description
We're looking for a Creative Strategist & Content Producer to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. The Creative Strategist & Content Producer will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms. You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry.


Key Responsibilities:


Creative Strategy 

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Spearhead tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads)
- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR)
- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion)
- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy


In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing
- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:
1. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications
2. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads
3. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)
4. Generative AI Production: Utilize AI tools and prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video and static image assets for rapid content production and testing

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs
- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms)
- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms


Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic
- Iteration & Optimization:
1. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance
2. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

- Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey


Multi-Channel Storytelling

- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials
- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion
- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition


Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities
- Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines & marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language & digital promotions
- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values
- Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness & compliance before publication


Requirements:

- 3–5 years of experience in creative strategy, content creation, social media, or brand marketing — ideally in health supplements, healthcare or wellness.
- Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta (FB/IG), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google, Generative AI).
- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
- Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills — adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals.
- Excellent communication, project management & cross-functional collaboration skills.
- Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

Acting as a senior strategic partner to the client, this role will bring together deep understanding of the beauty category, the global traveler and the evolving Travel Retail landscape to identify opportunities for brand and commercial growth.


The Global Director will connect strategy, creativity, experience, digital and execution—translating the client's global brand ambitions into distinctive and effective Travel Retail experiences across markets, retailers and touchpoints.

title: Partnership Manager, APAC
description:
The Role

Apryse is scaling its go-to-market across Asia-Pacific, and we're looking for a Partner Manager, APAC to lead and grow our partner ecosystem in the region. We already work with a number of partners across APAC. Your first mandate will be to take stock of this existing partner base, assess where the real value lies, and shape it into a coherent strategy, while recruiting and onboarding new partners with an initial focus on Australia, New Zealand, and India. This is a senior individual contributor role with a rare opportunity to own a function end to end: from defining the partner programs and securing executive sponsorship, to enabling the right partners, to driving measurable pipeline and revenue alongside our sales teams.

You will be the connective tissue between external partners (systems integrators, consultancies, resellers, distributors, and technology/ISV partners) and internal stakeholders across sales, presales, marketing, and executive leadership. Success will require sourcing the right partners, but more importantly, matching each partner's skill set, network, and market presence to the right sales motions and the right parts of the Apryse product portfolio. You'll then work lockstep with our Account Executives in each territory to ensure partner-sourced opportunities convert beyond pipeline creation through to closed revenue.

Responsibilities



- Design and launch Apryse's APAC partner program from creation through execution: define the partner strategy, program structure, tiering, incentives, and operating model, and secure executive sponsorship and cross-functional buy-in. 
- Audit and assess the existing partner base across the region: evaluate performance, capability, and fit, and make clear recommendations on where to invest, re-engage, or restructure as part of the overall partner strategy. 
- Identify, recruit, and onboard new partners across the region, with initial priority markets of Australia, New Zealand, and India. 
- Assess each partner's capabilities, vertical expertise, and customer network, and deliberately map them to the sales motions and product portfolio areas where they can create the most value. 
- Build and execute partner enablement plans (training, certification, sales plays, and co-selling frameworks) so partners can confidently position and sell the Apryse portfolio. 
- Act as the bridge between partners and Apryse Account Executives in each territory, establishing clear rules of engagement, joint account planning, and deal-level collaboration. 
- Work hand in hand with sales reps throughout the deal cycle to ensure partner-sourced opportunities progress from pipeline to close, driving accountability on both sides of the partnership. 
- Support and orchestrate partners across multiple sales motions, including new-logo acquisition (land) and account growth (expand). 
- Develop joint business plans with strategic partners, including pipeline targets, co-marketing initiatives, and executive alignment cadences. 
- Serve as the internal voice of the partner ecosystem: report on partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, surface market intelligence, and continuously refine the program based on results. 

How Success Is Measured



- Pipeline generated through partners. 
- Revenue closed through partners. 
- MBOs tied to onboarding new partners in Australia, New Zealand, and India, and to partner enablement outcomes that support selling of the Apryse portfolio in collaboration with territory sales teams. 

Requirements



- 10+ years of experience in B2B software, with at least 5 years in partner/channel management, alliances, or business development roles across APAC. 
- Demonstrated success building a partner program from scratch (strategy, executive buy-in, launch, and execution), not just running an established one. 
- Experience inheriting and rationalizing an existing partner portfolio: assessing partner performance and potential, and making decisive investment and prioritization calls. 
- A proven track record of generating and converting partner-sourced pipeline into closed revenue, with quantifiable results. 
- Deep familiarity with the APAC partner landscape across systems integrators, consultancies, resellers, distributors, and technology partners. 
- Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills: able to earn trust with partner executives and internal leaders alike, and to align teams without direct authority. 
- Strong commercial judgment and the maturity to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and direct sales cultures, including the ability to collaborate closely with quota-carrying reps and keep joint deals moving to close. 
- Analytical approach to partner selection: able to evaluate a partner's strengths, coverage, and network, and match them to specific sales motions and product lines. 
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, comfortable engaging C-level executives at partner organizations and internally. 
- Professional working fluency in English. 
- Willingness to travel across the region (Australia, New Zealand, India, and Southeast Asia) as needed. 

Nice To Haves



- Established relationships with partners in Australia, New Zealand, and India. 
- Experience selling or partnering around complex software products; familiarity with SDK/developer-focused or document technology solutions. 
- Additional regional languages. 
- Experience using CRM and PRM tools to manage partner pipeline and performance. 
- A college or university degree, or equivalent experience. 

Benefits



- Competitive salary commensurate with experience & qualifications. 
- A comprehensive extended benefits package including health and dental for you and your family that starts from day one. 
- A great team environment and resources, supporting you to do the best work of your life and providing unlimited career growth potential. 
- Highly autonomous and entrepreneurial environment. 
- Annual recurring WFH allowance for you to purchase items you need for your home office. 
- On going support for learning development so you can master your craft. 
- Diverse and inclusive workplace where we all learn from each other. 

Company Description

As the industry-leading provider of document software development (SDK) technology powering everything from traditional desktop software to innovative web and mobile applications, at Apryse we are committed to delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that empower our clients to achieve their goals. With a broad international portfolio of combined companies, products, and leading technologies, we are actively changing the way the world works with documents to make work better and life simpler.

Customers like IBM, Autodesk, DocuSign, Boeing, Microsoft (and many more!) come to us to realize their web and mobile strategies for document management, editing, and collaboration as the #1-ranked commercial document SDK of choice for companies worldwide. As a result, you can find our document technology in thousands of solutions, including those of household names, used by millions across virtually every industry. Our XODO app alone has 25M unique installs -- and counting -- and the highest ratings among PDF productivity apps on the largest online app marketplaces.

Ready to join our team?

If you are interested in helping Apryse deliver on its commitments and taking your career to the next level, we invite you to apply online now. Additionally, we view the above section as a guide, not a checklist. We welcome diverse and non-traditional backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you do not have every requirement listed.

We are committed to a work environment that is inclusive to all and free of discrimination. It is our policy to be an equal opportunity employer without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic predisposition or carrier status, veteran status, citizenship status or any other factors prohibited by law. Apryse will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals.

title: APJ Partner Category Lead - DevOps and Observability, APJ Partner Category
description:
Description

As the APJ DevOps and Observability Partner Category Lead, you will own and drive the end-to-end DevOps and Observability technology partner strategy across the Asia-Pacific and Japan region. You will be responsible for understanding customer and market signals, accelerating customer adoption of DevOps and Observability solutions, growing top-line Marketplace revenue across all market segments and across all countries in APJ.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role that sits at the intersection of AWS's most strategic DevOps and Observability partnerships and the rapidly converging Observability-Security-Data landscape. You will serve as the single-threaded owner (STO) for the DevOps and Observability partnership category in APJ, orchestrating executive governance, field enablement, and go-to-market execution.

The ideal candidate will have direct sales and/or ISV/Technology Partner experience, as well as deep familiarity with the Observability and DevOps technology landscape (infrastructure monitoring, log analytics, AIOps, cloud-native observability), cloud platform economics, and enterprise partner development. The candidate will have strong business acumen and problem-solving skills, as well as the ability to manage multiple customer personas and successfully align executive stakeholders with differing goals. A strong executive presence and the ability to successfully manage ambiguous, fast-moving situations autonomously and deliver results is required.

Key job responsibilities



-  Define and execute the APJ DevOps & Observability category partnership strategy, goals, and metrics. Break down the overall goals and metrics into country/area outcomes
-  Set up partner governance and executive engagement. Establish and run the partnership operating model for DevOps & Observability partners, serving as AWS's primary relationship holder with partners' APJ leadership
-  Work with cross-functional stakeholders (Area Partner Leaders, Security Category Lead, Data/AI Category Lead, SI Partners, and Sales Leaders) to deliver integrated programs and customer engagements
-  Enable Area/Country Partner teams to serve as local representatives for DevOps & Observability partnerships
-  Work back from market signals to identify customer needs and mitigate partnership risks with proactive remediation plans
-  Track and communicate key metrics. Maintain pipeline visibility and identify and share insights.

A day in the life

Your day might start with a pipeline review call with Japan's Area Partner team to unblock a strategic enterprise deal, followed by a bi-weekly sync with APJ partner leadership to align on upcoming product launches. Mid-morning you're reviewing market signals and customer feedback. After lunch you're enabling a group of sellers on a new co-sell play, and in the afternoon you're leading an executive monthly business review presenting APJ progress to world wide leadership.

About The Team

The APJ Partner Category Team is responsible for AWS's most strategic technology partnerships across Asia-Pacific and Japan. We operate as category leaders - each owning an end-to-end partnership strategy that spans revenue, GTM, enablement, and executive governance. We work at the intersection of AWS's fastest-growing services and our partners' go-to-market ambitions to drive customer outcomes at scale.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications



-  3+ years of business development, partnership management, or sourcing new business experience
-  Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
-  5+ years of communicating with and presenting to executive and senior audiences experience
-  Experience working with Observability, DevOps, Monitoring, or Cloud Operations related technologies, including but not limited to log analytics, infrastructure monitoring, and AIOps
-  Track record of building operating models, governance mechanisms, and field enablement at scale across multiple geographies

Preferred Qualifications



-  5+ years of experience in technology partner development, ISV alliances, or strategic business development in the cloud/DevOps ecosystem
-  Direct experience managing Observability or DevOps technology partnerships (APM, cloud monitoring, log management, or infrastructure observability platforms)
-  Understanding of Observability technology economics (consumption-based pricing, platform convergence across observability-security-data, and cloud-native architectures)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
