- Coordinate closely with the broader Partnerships team to ensure regional execution is aligned to the overall program while remaining focused on in-market partner activation and revenue growth.

We’re Looking For Candidates Who Have



- Proven experience managing channel, reseller, distributor, MSP, VAR, and SI relationships at a B2B technology company.
- Demonstrated ability to enable partners effectively, including training on value proposition, sales plays, qualification, and how to work opportunities with internal sales teams.
- Experience driving measurable business outcomes through partners, including partner-sourced pipeline
- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with sales, marketing, RevOps, and other internal stakeholders to execute partner plans.
- Strong commercial judgment and execution skills, including the ability to prioritize partners, manage competing opportunities, and navigate ambiguity in a fast-moving environment.
- Experience working in APAC or in a multi-country region with different market dynamics, sales motions, and partner maturity levels.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build credibility internally and externally.
- Knowledge of the crypto and blockchain ecosystem, and the ability to ramp quickly on Chainalysis products, use cases, and customer needs in order to enable partners effectively.
- Background in crypto, financial services, public sector, fintech, cybersecurity, or risk/compliance software.

Nice To Have Experience



- Experience with PRM tools, deal registration processes, account mapping, and partner performance tracking.
- Experience building channels in an environment where direct sales and indirect routes to market must coexist and be carefully governed.
- Comfort working across time zones and in a highly matrixed global organization.

AI at Chainalysis

One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

title: Senior Strategic Alliances Manager, GSI (SEA)

How will you make an impact?

- Shape and scale a NiCE practice inside the partner: joint solution offerings built on CXone Mpower and Cognigy, certified delivery capacity, and a clear place in the partner's go-to-market
- Drive joint pursuit of named accounts, growing partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline through SI-led bids, RFPs and co-sell alongside NiCE direct sales
- Work with NiCE sales, marketing, product, professional services and customer success to deliver aligned joint campaigns, enablement programmes and delivery quality

- Act as the voice of South East Asia in NiCE's global GSI programme, giving regional insight to alliance leaders in the US, Europe and the rest of APAC and influencing strategy, programme design and investment

Have you got what it takes?

title: Regional Partnership Lead
categories: Business Consulting and Services, Hospitals and Health Care, and Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
description:
About The Role
The Regional Partnership Lead is accountable for strengthening and growing DKSH's strategic partnerships with assigned pharmaceutical and healthcare clients across Asia Pacific (APAC), delivering sustainable revenue, profitability, and long-term partnership value. In this role, you will serve as the critical regional bridge between client leadership, DKSH country teams, and cross-functional stakeholders, translating partnership strategy into measurable commercial outcomes.


What You Will Deliver

- Own the regional relationship and account strategy for assigned clients, serving as the primary point of contact for client leadership, DKSH country teams, and regional functions to ensure alignment on partnership priorities and execution.
- Develop and maintain joint value-creation roadmaps and annual business plans across assigned portfolios, including cardiometabolic health, women's health, and other priority therapeutic areas.
- Drive performance against revenue, gross margin, profitability, patient access, and agreed commercial objectives; identify performance gaps and lead corrective action plans with country teams.
- Lead the regional governance cadence, including monthly and quarterly business reviews, senior leadership meetings, and decision papers, ensuring timely escalation and resolution of material issues.
- Identify and advance growth opportunities across existing brands, new indications, pipeline assets, new markets, and expanded service scope, supported by robust business cases and resource recommendations.
- Coordinate regional launch readiness across commercial, regulatory, medical, market access, supply chain, and finance workstreams; monitor milestones, resolve dependencies, and escalate launch risks.
- Drive the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) process with country teams, finance, supply chain, and clients to improve forecast accuracy, inventory health, supply continuity, and working capital outcomes.
- Monitor contractual commitments, service levels, investments, and agreed deliverables; coordinate Legal, Finance, Compliance, Regulatory, and other functions to manage risks, disputes, and scope alignment.
- Protect DKSH's commercial position while maintaining constructive, transparent client relationships and ensuring compliance with relevant policies, agreements, and governance standards.
- Facilitate best-practice sharing across markets and translate regional insights into practical improvements in execution, capability, and partnership value.
- Lead through influence in a complex matrix environment, creating accountability across country and regional teams without direct authority.
- Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and internal leaders, framing complex issues, aligning differing perspectives, and driving timely, fact-based decisions.
- Represent DKSH with commercial judgment, resilience, and professionalism in sensitive negotiations and escalations.
- Administrative duties and coordination tasks as required.


What You Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or a related discipline; a Master of Business Administration (MBA) or other relevant postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
- Minimum 8 years of pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences commercial experience, including at least 3 years in a regional, alliance management, commercial strategy, or strategic account role.
- Demonstrated experience leading cross-market initiatives and senior stakeholder relationships across multiple APAC markets.
- Experience in primary care and/or specialty care commercialization, including established brands, lifecycle management, and new product launches.
- Experience in cardiometabolic, cardiovascular, renal, or women's health portfolios is preferred but not mandatory.
- Experience working with outsourced commercialization, distribution, full-agency, or multi-country partnership models is advantageous.
- Strong strategic account management, alliance management, joint business planning, and stakeholder governance capabilities.
- Strong understanding of pharmaceutical commercial operations, market access, lifecycle management, launch excellence, and commercial excellence across APAC.
- Commercial and financial acumen, including revenue, margin, profitability, investment, forecasting, business case development, and performance risk analysis.
- Working knowledge of commercial agreements, contractual obligations, service levels, governance, change control, and risk management.
- Ability to translate regional strategy into clear country priorities, execution plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
- Excellent executive communication, facilitation, influencing, and negotiation skills across internal and external senior stakeholders in multicultural environments.
- Strong analytical judgment with the ability to synthesize complex commercial, operational, and financial information into decision-ready recommendations.
- Proactive and resilient, with the ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, sensitive issues, and tight timelines with a high degree of autonomy.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; fluency in English is mandatory.


Why Join DKSH
At DKSH, See What You Can Do! We offer you breadth that accelerates growth, trust that lets you lead, and purpose that connects your work to the things people depend on every day. As DKSH spans industries, markets, and segments, serving thousands of customers, you'll build expertise that is rare, well rounded, and difficult to replicate elsewhere. You'll be trusted to own your role and supported to deliver real results. Through the work you do in Regional Commercial Partnerships, you are an essential part of making, powering, and improving everyday life.

title: Principal, Agency Partnerships
categories: Software Development and IT Services and IT Consulting
description:
foodpanda is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Description

Build the Regional Agency Strategy



- Define and own the regional agency strategy for Retail Media, identifying the agency groups, markets, clients and categories with the highest growth potential. 
- Develop a clear framework to increase Retail Media penetration across agency planning, buying and client investment processes. 
- Establish regional agency engagement models, commercial priorities and ways of working that can be replicated across APAC and EU markets. 
- Identify structural barriers preventing agencies from investing in our Retail Media proposition and develop solutions to unlock incremental spend. 

Develop Strategic Agency Partnerships



- Build and strengthen senior relationships across key media agency groups, holding companies and their specialist commerce, programmatic and performance teams. 
- Position our Retail Media capabilities with agency leadership, planning teams and client leads, moving the relationship beyond individual campaign briefs toward strategic partnerships. 
- Develop joint business plans and strategic initiatives with priority agency partners to grow investment across their client portfolios. 
- Create access to new advertisers and budgets through agency relationships, including brands where we currently have limited or no direct commercial relationship. 

Drive Market Execution



- Partner with local Retail Media teams to translate the regional agency strategy into market-specific action plans and commercial opportunities. 
- Identify priority agencies and advertisers by market and support local teams in developing the right engagement approach. 
- Lead or support strategic pitches, agency roadshows, workshops and senior client conversations where regional involvement can accelerate opportunities. 
- Build playbooks, best practices and scalable approaches that improve agency engagement capabilities across markets. 
- Ensure learnings and successful agency models are shared and replicated across the region. 

Grow Retail Media Revenue Through Agencies



- Build a measurable pipeline of agency-led opportunities and establish clear targets for agency-sourced and agency-influenced revenue. 
- Increase the share of Retail Media investment coming through agencies and unlock incremental budgets beyond existing trade and shopper marketing relationships. 
- Work across onsite, offsite, programmatic and other Retail Media solutions to create propositions relevant to how agencies plan and buy media. 
- Identify opportunities to package audiences, inventory, insights and measurement into propositions that can compete effectively for broader media budgets. 

Shape Our Agency Proposition



- Bring an agency-insider perspective into the evolution of our Retail Media proposition. 
- Provide structured feedback on what agencies and advertisers need across products, measurement, insights, buying models, campaign execution and reporting. 
- Partner with Product, Commercial, Marketing, Data and other regional teams to improve agency readiness and remove barriers to investment. 
- Represent the agency perspective within the Retail Media organization and help shape our longer-term go-to-market strategy. 

Qualifications



- 10+ years experience within a leading media agency, agency holding company, commerce/media practice or closely related environment, ideally with regional APAC exposure. 
- Strong understanding of how agencies operate, including media planning, investment decisions, client leadership, trading, programmatic and commercial models. 
- Established senior relationships across the media agency ecosystem in APAC. 
- Experience developing strategic partnerships and translating them into measurable commercial growth. 
- Strong understanding of digital media, programmatic advertising and the evolving Retail Media ecosystem. 
- Ability to operate strategically while remaining highly execution-oriented. This is a senior IC role with significant ownership, not a people-management position. 
- Experience working across multiple APAC markets and navigating different levels of market maturity. 
- Strong executive presence and ability to influence senior agency, advertiser and internal stakeholders. 
- Commercial mindset with the ability to identify opportunities, build a pipeline and ultimately convert strategy into revenue. 
- Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where the playbook is still being built. 

Additional Information

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means that agencies become a material and scalable growth channel for our Retail Media business in APAC & EU.

You will have built a clear regional agency strategy, established strategic relationships with priority agency groups, created repeatable market playbooks, increased the number of advertisers accessing our Retail Media solutions through agencies, and delivered measurable growth in agency-driven media investment.

Most importantly, you will help shift our relationship with agencies from campaign-by-campaign execution to strategic, recurring media partnerships.

title: Global VP of New BD & Partnerships
categories: Banking, Financial Services, and Investment Banking
description:
Global VP of New BD & Partnerships 


Web3 Payments & Cards
Location: Singapore / Flexible / Remote
Reports to: CEO


About the Role
We are a fast-growing Web3 payments infrastructure company transforming how businesses and users interact with digital assets. Our mission is to bridge traditional finance and the digital asset ecosystem through innovative card issuing, crypto-to-fiat payment rails, stablecoin payments, and Cards-as-a-Service (CaaS) solutions for Web3 institutions, protocols, fintechs, and consumer-facing brands.


We are looking for a Global VP of Partnerships & Business Development to lead our global partnership strategy and drive international business expansion.
This role will be responsible for building and managing high-impact relationships across card schemes, BIN sponsors, banks, payment institutions, and leading Web3 companies, with a strong focus on strategic partnerships, co-branded card programs, CaaS opportunities, and scalable global expansion.


Key Responsibilities

- Lead the global partnership strategy across card schemes (e.g., Visa, Mastercard), BIN sponsors, issuing/acquiring banks, payment institutions, and other key ecosystem partners.
- Build and manage strategic relationships with Web3 companies, exchanges, wallets, protocols, digital asset platforms, fintechs, and other financial institutions to drive adoption of our card and payment solutions.
- Identify and develop CaaS and co-branded card opportunities, particularly with leading Web3 institutions and consumer-facing platforms.
- Own end-to-end deal execution, from opportunity sourcing and commercial structuring through negotiation, contracting, onboarding, and launch.
- Work closely with Product, Compliance, Legal, Risk, Operations, and Engineering teams to structure scalable and compliant partnership models.
- Drive strategic expansion into priority markets across APAC, EMEA, LATAM, and other key regions, leveraging existing relationships and developing new market opportunities.
- Develop relationships with senior decision-makers across the global cards, payments, banking, and digital asset ecosystems.
- Represent the company at key industry events, conferences, and strategic partner engagements.
- Work closely with the CEO and leadership team to shape commercial strategy, partnership priorities, market expansion, and go-to-market plans.


Ideal Candidate

- 8+ years of experience in card issuing, payments, fintech partnerships, banking partnerships, BIN sponsorship, or business development, with meaningful exposure to the Web3 / digital asset ecosystem.
- Strong understanding of the global card and payment ecosystem, including card schemes, BIN sponsors, issuing/acquiring banks, program managers, processors, and compliance requirements.
- Experience developing co-branded card programs, CaaS solutions, payment infrastructure, or other embedded financial products.
- Proven track record of building strategic partnerships from scratch and taking them through to commercial launch.
- Experience working across multiple markets and navigating complex international partnerships.
- Existing senior-level relationships with Visa, Mastercard, issuing/acquiring banks, BIN sponsors, payment institutions, major Web3 companies, exchanges, wallets, or digital asset platforms is a strong advantage.
- Strong commercial judgment, negotiation skills, and ability to manage complex multi-party deals.
- Able to operate effectively across Product, Compliance, Legal, Risk, Engineering, and commercial teams.
- Entrepreneurial, highly execution-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-growing and evolving environment.
- Strong global mindset and ability to work independently across regions and time zones.


What Success Looks Like
You will help build and scale the partnerships that underpin our global card and payment infrastructure — from card schemes and banking relationships to CaaS and Web3 distribution partnerships.
We are particularly interested in candidates who combine deep payment infrastructure knowledge with a strong global network and the ability to convert strategic relationships into commercially meaningful partnerships and transaction volume.

title: Sales Channel Partnership Manager
description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Nice-to-haves

title: Senior Lead, Partnership
description:
Job Description 

Job ID: MJ000375

About Traveloka

Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle super-app. We connect tens of millions of travellers across the region with flights, hotels, experiences, financial services, and more — all from a single platform. Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognised consumer brands in the region.

We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that.

About The Team

Payments is the platform every Traveloka transaction runs through — and the commercial side is where that platform turns into lasting partnerships with the institutions that make regional payments work. You will shape how millions of travellers across Southeast Asia pay: the cards, wallets, bank rails, and pay-later options that fit each of our markets, no two of which behave the same way. This is product and partnership work where the agreement you negotiate and the experience you ship are the same problem.

You will build and steward relationships with banks, networks, and fintech players — understanding their priorities as closely as our own — and translate that collaboration into payment products people actually choose at checkout. You think in unit economics and conversion rates as fluently as in partner roadmaps and mutual value. If you want to build durable, win-win partnerships around a system the whole company depends on, this is where you do it.

About The Job

As a Senior Lead on the Payment team, you are the deepest individual-contributor authority on a complex set of payment partnerships spanning markets and partner types. You influence payment strategy well beyond your own remit, without managing a team.



- Own the health of a broad payment partnership portfolio across multiple markets and segments as an expert IC, shaping terms, incentives, and partner mix collaboratively for the relationships you own
- Shape Traveloka's payment cost and partnership approach alongside product and finance leadership
- Steward our most critical relationships — leading negotiations with major banks, schemes, and fintechs toward agreements that work for both sides
- Build the analytical and negotiation standards the wider team works to, raising the bar through expertise rather than headcount

description:

Leveraging resources from both AspenTech and partners, you’ll drive regional collaboration, portfolio financial performance, business planning, governance, compliance, sales/technical enablement, and joint go-to-market initiatives.

- 10-15 years of proven success in enterprise tech partner management, alliance building, or channel sales within the Asia Pacific region.

- Self-starter comfortable operating independently

title: Business Development Senior Manager, APAC
description:

We’ve connected hundreds of millions of people to the content they love and built the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service. We operate in more than 180 markets and continue to scale rapidly across APAC.

We’re building a world-class business development team and are looking for a multi-talented self-starter with ambition and drive who will help grow Spotify’s Premium distribution partnerships in the APAC region. You will own, negotiate, and scale strategic agreements with partners who can accelerate subscriber and engagement growth. This role will be based in either Singapore or Seoul and you will report to the APAC Director of Business Development. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.

What You'll Do



- Identify, structure, negotiate, amend, close, and manage strategic distribution partnerships across APAC that advance Spotify’s growth and long‑term vision.
- Develop and refine partner strategies for priority markets in collaboration with the regional lead, carrying out detailed partner analysis and setting priorities and forecasts.
- Serve as the primary point of contact for partners, building credibility across all levels—from C‑suite to Marketing to Commercial teams —and owning the full relationship lifecycle.
- Analyze existing partnerships to unlock additional value, improve performance, and uncover opportunities for expansion.
- Manage internal approvals including interacting with senior internal executives from relevant functions (e.g., Legal, Finance, Accounting, Product).
- Drive internal cross‑functional workstreams toward deal objectives, ensuring clarity, alignment, and timely execution.
- Manage a pipeline of prospective partnerships and assess commercial impact through disciplined analysis and business case development.
- Travel as needed across APAC to strengthen partner relationships and support deal execution.

Who You Are



- You have a minimum of 5+ years of significant business development or strategic partnerships experience within APAC—ideally across telcos, OEMs, payments, entertainment, or digital platforms.
- Fluency in English and Korean is required for the role; other additional APAC languages a plus.
- You have a proven track record of structuring and closing complex deals with large enterprises and scaling partnerships with measurable commercial impact.
- You understand the nuances of APAC markets and bring relevant local insights; deep experience in Korea, Thailand or Indonesia is especially valuable.
- You think strategically about complex business issues, yet you’re equally strong in operational execution and relationship ownership.
- You excel in multicultural, fast‑moving environments and collaborate effectively across distributed teams.

- You are analytical, data‑driven, and experienced in financial modelling and constructing clear business cases.
- You communicate with clarity and influence, simplifying complexity for senior audiences internally and externally.
- You are diligent with strong commercial instincts and the ability to see long‑term value in every opportunity.
- You demonstrate initiative, resilience, and the ability to independently drive deals from ideation to launch.
- BA/BS degree with outstanding academic performance; MBA a plus.
- Experience in using basic AI tools.

Where You'll Be



- This role is based in either Singapore or Seoul, South Korea.
- We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

Spotify transformed music listening forever when we launched in 2008. Our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators. Everything we do is driven by our love for music and podcasting. Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Senior Manager, Ecosystem Partnerships, IT&T
description:
Who we are. 
Pioneering workers' rights since 1961, the National Trades Union Congress (NTUC) unites 59 trade unions, seven trade associations, 12 social enterprises, and other enterprise partners as we create better lives for workers here in Singapore.


Our work cuts across the different ages and stages of life as we walk the ground and respond to everyday needs. Through initiatives that protect our workers at work, transform careers, manage the cost of living, help with financial resilience and health, and nurture relationships for families, we champion every worker through every touch point as we work towards better wages, welfare, and work prospects.


Because Every Worker Matters.


Summary of Role
The Industry Training and Transformation (IT&T) Department is part of NTUC's Training and Transformation Group that supports companies in workforce and workplace training and business transformation.


The Ecosystem Partnerships team sits within the Development Branch of IT&T and is responsible for building and leveraging strategic partnerships and ecosystem networks to accelerate workforce transformation, business transformation and worker outcomes.


The role works closely with Industry Training Officers (ITOs), partners and stakeholders to operationalise partnership initiatives, drive collaboration and monitor programme outcomes. This role reports to the Assistant Director, Ecosystem Partnerships, IT&T.


Key Responsibilities
1. Manage a Portfolio of Industry Partnerships

- Manage a portfolio of partners, including large anchor companies that can bring their supplier and business networks along ("Queen Bees"), technology and service providers that can reach companies in their ecosystem at once ("Multipliers"), and other industry ecosystem players
- Drive efforts and work closely with industry teams in approaching new partners


2. Apply Partnership Standards and Frameworks

- Apply the agreed selection criteria, partnership models and agreement templates to partners to ensure consistency across clusters
- Keep partnership frameworks, scopes and terms consistent across all industry teams, and flag any departures for review
- Maintain partner records, agreements and supporting documentation


3. Run Partnership Programmes and Support Industry Teams

- Manage partnerships end to end, from onboarding and agreement signing through rollout and regular review
- Curate what partners can offer and provide matchmaking, project scoping support and templates so industry teams can move faster


4. Support Government and Funding Engagement

- Gather feedback from partners and industry teams on funding conditions and support discussions with government agencies and funding bodies


5. Support New Partnership Models and Pilots

- Coordinate pilots of new approaches, document what works and support replication and scale up of models


6. Track Performance and Prepare Reporting

- Maintain the partnership dashboard, tracking progress. Analyse partnership data and prepare reporting for management and industry team updates
- Support continuous improvement efforts to strengthen how well programmes and partnerships are working


Qualifications and Competencies 
Education & Experience

- At least 8-12 years of working experience in partnership development, stakeholder engagement, business development, programme management or transformation-related roles.
- Experience in managing partnerships involving enterprises, industry stakeholders, government agencies or ecosystem partners.
- Experience in workforce transformation, business transformation, capability development or industry development initiatives will be advantageous.
- Experience working with enterprises, SMEs, TACs, government agencies or technology ecosystem partners is preferred.


Core Competencies / Skills

- Strong partnership development, stakeholder engagement and relationship management capabilities.
- Strong analytical, communication and programme management skills.
- Ability to collaborate across diverse stakeholders and organisational boundaries to drive outcomes.
- Self-driven, resourceful and outcomes-focused, with the ability to translate partnership opportunities into tangible business, workforce and worker outcomes.

This role reports to the Deputy Director, Development Branch, IT&T.

1. Lead Partnership Strategy and Development

- Develop and implement the strategy to grow NTUC's network of industry partners, including large anchor companies that can bring their supplier and business networks along ("Queen Bees"), technology and service providers that can reach companies in their ecosystem ("Multipliers"), and other industry ecosystem players

2. Own Partnership Governance and Frameworks

- Own the criteria for selecting partners, the partnership models and the agreement templates used across all partnerships
- Maintain the approval and review process, and keep partnership standards consistent across all industry teams

- Manage partnerships end to end, from early conversations and onboarding through agreement signing, rollout and review

- Work with government agencies and funding bodies on the design and use of company transformation funding

5. Drive Innovation in Partnership Models

- Pilot and evaluate new approaches and joint arrangements. Assess what works and scale successful partnership models across industries


6. Drive Performance, Analysis and Reporting

- Establish performance measures, analyse how well partnerships are converting into results, prepare reporting and strategic reviews


Qualifications and Competencies
Education & Experience

- At least 12 to 15 years of working experience in partnership development, business development, ecosystem building, stakeholder engagement, programme management or transformation-related roles.
- Strong track record in developing and managing strategic partnerships involving enterprises, industry stakeholders, government agencies or ecosystem partners.
- Experience in workforce transformation, business transformation, capability development or industry development initiatives will be advantageous.
- Experience working with large enterprises, SMEs, TACs, government agencies or technology ecosystem partners is preferred.


Core Competencies / Skills

- Strategic thinker with strong partnership, ecosystem development and business development capabilities.
- Excellent stakeholder engagement, relationship management and influencing skills, including engagement with senior leaders.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and programme management capabilities, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
- Self-driven, resourceful and outcomes-focused, with the ability to translate partnerships into tangible business, workforce and worker outcomes.

title: Manager, Strategic Partnership (eSIM)
description:
About Klook

We are a leading pan-regional experiences platform in Asia Pacific, purpose built to digitalize experiences and make them accessible to every traveler.

Our mission is to build the digital infrastructure for the global experience economy — empowering merchants to share their passions and travelers to discover the heartbeat of each destination.

We operate a mobile-first, curated platform featuring diverse experiences across global destinations.

Do you share our belief in the wonders of travel? Global citizens ourselves, Klookers are not only curating memorable experiences for others but co-creating our world of joy within Klook.

We work hard and play hard, upkeeping our high-performing culture as we are guided daily by our 6 core values:



- Customer First
- Push Boundaries
- Critical Thinking
- Build for Scale
- Less is More
- Win as One

We never settle, and together, we believe in achieving greater heights and realizing endless possibilities ahead of us in the dynamic new era of travel. Care to be a part of this revolution? Join us!

We're looking for a Manager, Strategic Partnerships to join our SIM/WiFi team and grow our eSIM business through partnerships. This is an owner's role: you will define the partnership strategy for Klook eSIM — where we play, with whom, and on what terms — and then personally execute it, building and closing the pipeline that turns that strategy into new-user growth.

The ideal candidate moves fluently between the two halves of the job: structured strategic thinking to set direction and prioritise, and hands-on deal-making to open doors, negotiate and get agreements signed — with the rigour to turn signed partners into acquisition volume rather than logos on a slide.

Key Responsibilities

Set the strategy



- Develop the strategic partnerships strategy for Klook eSIM: the partner archetypes and channels that can deliver new users at scale, the value proposition for each, and the commercial models to pursue.
- Translate it into an annual and quarterly plan with prioritised targets, sequencing and resourcing — using market data, competitive analysis and partner economics to decide where to concentrate effort and what to deprioritise.
- Refresh the strategy as the eSIM distribution landscape shifts, and report progress to senior leadership on a regular cadence.

Build pipeline and close deals



- Own the eSIM partnership pipeline end to end: map the landscape and identify high-potential partners across tech platforms, travel and OTA players, telcos, device and app ecosystems, fintech, loyalty programmes and offline travel channels.
- Generate qualified opportunities through outbound prospecting, industry networks, events and inbound inquiries, and maintain a disciplined pipeline with clear stages and next steps.
- Lead deals from first conversation to signature: pitch, commercial modelling, negotiation, and alignment with Legal, Finance and Product on structure and risk.
- Build the internal business case for each deal — expected new users, economics, resourcing — and secure senior stakeholder buy-in.

Scale partners into user growth



- Own launch and ramp-up: coordinate Product, Tech, Supply and Operations to get integrations live on time and performing.
- Manage live partners as a growth portfolio — review performance, pull levers to increase conversion and volume, expand where partners are working and exit where they are not.
- Design and land partner co-marketing and joint go-to-market activity, working with our marketing teams on execution to drive new customer acquisition.
- Act as the primary commercial relationship owner for key partners, and use performance data to sharpen targeting, deal structure and partner management.

Flex across broader growth channels



- Support other external growth and awareness channels that can drive eSIM acquisition — such as affiliates, social and creator-led channels — and work with internal marketing teams to launch campaigns with Klook's platform-level strategic partners.

What You'll Need



- 6+ years in strategic partnerships, business development or commercial strategy, with a proven track record of independently sourcing, negotiating and closing partnerships that delivered measurable user or revenue growth. OTA, ecommerce, travel, telco or tech startup experience is a plus.
- Experience owning a partnership or growth strategy end to end — building the thesis, target list and plan, then delivering it, rather than executing someone else's.
- Demonstrated ability to build pipeline from scratch: comfortable with cold outreach, working a network, and creating opportunities where none existed.
- Strong commercial and negotiation skills, with the judgement to structure deals that are both closeable and good for the business.
- Strong analytical skills — able to size markets, model partner economics, and use data to prioritise and make the case internally.
- Ability to drive cross-functional projects, getting Product, Tech, Legal, Finance and Marketing aligned behind a strategy, a deal and its launch.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with credibility in front of senior external and internal stakeholders.
- Fluent in English and Chinese; additional languages a plus. Globally minded and comfortable working across cultures and time zones.
- A start-up attitude — entrepreneurial, roll-up-your-sleeves, and able to work independently when required.
- Exposure to affiliates, social or influencer marketing, or knowledge of the telecommunications / eSIM space, is a plus but not required.

Klook is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented and passionate people of all backgrounds. We believe that a joyful workplace is an inclusive workplace, one where employees from all walks of life have an equal opportunity to thrive. We’re dedicated to creating a welcoming and supportive culture where everyone belongs.

title: Ecosystem Partnership Manager / Director
description:
About the Team & Your Mission
We are building a brand-new Ecosystem Partnership (BD) team in the APAC region, with a strategic focus on the Singapore and Hong Kong markets. We aim to establish deep collaborations with leading SaaS platforms, ERP systems, logistics & warehousing systems, and B2B trade infrastructures. Your ultimate mission is to deeply understand the underlying business models of these ecosystem partners, tailor industry-specific payment solutions for various vertical scenarios and successfully bring these partners and their massive end-customer base into PingPong's global payment closed-loop ecosystem.


Core Responsibilities

- Strategic Partner Acquisition & Breakthrough: Lead and execute partnerships with core ecosystem service providers in SG/HK based on company strategy. Key breakthrough targets include but are not limited to:
- Enterprise TMS & FA&P Giants (New Core Focus): CTSI-Global, nVision Global, GoComet, Blue Yonder, Oracle OTM, etc.
- Order & Fulfillment Systems: Anchanto, Shipsy, Yojee, etc.
- B2B Procurement & Trade Networks: Eezee, Proxtera, GUUD, SGTraDex, etc.
- Leading Regional ERP & Accounting Software: Mekari, Deskera, HashMicro, Bukku, Logi-Sys, Fresa Technologies, etc.
- Scenario-Based Solution Design & Ecosystem Closed-Loop: Based on a profound understanding of clients' business logic and the complex supply chain finance of enterprise clients, deliver highly competitive, niche payment solutions. Examples include:
- Exclusive TMS & FA&P Scenarios: Deliver Mass Payouts via Local Rails to institutions like CTSI-Global to replace expensive and inefficient traditional SWIFT wire transfers, enabling instant, full-amount freight payouts; provide White-label Virtual Accounts for Shippers to help partners instantly open independent fund pools via API to isolate prepaid freight funds for multinational shippers; provide FX Risk Management / Forwards for large-volume shipping routes, helping shippers hedge against FX volatility over 1-3 month ocean freight billing cycles.
- SaaS / ERP / Logistics Scenarios: Enable order synchronization and closed-loop supplier payments within Order Management Systems (e.g., Anchanto); embed cross-border supply chain mass payouts within logistics systems (e.g., Shipsy/Yojee); build APAC Multi-Currency Rails within ERP and accounting systems (e.g., Mekari/Deskera) to bypass USD intermediary routing.
- Data Pipeline Integration: Drive the data closed-loop construction of "Order/Contract + Logistics/Fulfillment/Invoice Reconciliation + Payment/Settlement." title: Strategic Partnerships, GSI, APAC
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

Owns Mistral’s strategic relationship with EY across APAC. Manages the EY relationship and joint go-to-market end to end, delivering revenue and industry impact.

Orchestrates multi-country pursuits spanning ASEAN (Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia and the Philippines), Australia, India, Japan and Korea, owning the seating model, deal economics and partner governance through MD sign-off. Owns partner-leadership access at the change-maker level: AI practice leads, industry MDs and CTOs at regional and global level, including EY Consulting leadership.

Architects and operationalises the APAC GSI Partner Playbook: the frameworks, co-sell motions, solution accelerators and delivery-readiness programmes needed to scale frontier AI regionally, including the sovereign AI narrative that differentiates Mistral in regulated markets.

Location: Based in Singapore, with travel to ASEAN and APAC countries.

What Success Looks Like

First 12 months



- Executive relationships built across EY Consulting at AI practice lead, industry MD and CTO level, including EY’s Singapore hub and its practices across ASEAN and APAC countries. 
- A joint EY–Mistral GTM plan live: shared ICPs, vertical use cases, field plays and demand generation, with named account coverage across ASEAN and APAC countries. 
- One to two named, in-flight APAC deals of flagship scope and complexity, converted from or created through global agreements. 
- Partner-led and partner-attached pipeline delivered against the team target across sovereign AI, AI Studio and enterprise deployments. 
- Two to three multi-year GTM agreements or MOUs signed, covering revenue targets, co-sell motions, enablement and commercial frameworks. 

Key outcomes



- Partner-influenced revenue from EY contributes a fifth or more of APAC annual bookings. 
- Mistral embedded in partner platforms, marketplaces, sovereign-cloud offerings and regional AI Lab programmes. 
- Certified EY delivery pods operational, with a stable base of partners delivering repeatable demand. 

Key responsibilities



- Own the EY relationship and joint GTM across APAC: executive sponsorship, joint account planning, pursuit support and governance. 
- Own APAC GSI partner strategy, with EY as the anchor integrator. 
- Drive EY engagement across ASEAN and APAC countries from Singapore. 
- Convert or create global agreements and MPAs into named APAC deals; orchestrate multi-country pursuits across ASEAN and APAC countries. 
- Architect joint GTM: messaging, ICP alignment, vertical use-case strategy, field plays and demand generation. 
- Guide EY in building profitable Mistral service lines and certified delivery pods. 
- Lead deal orchestration: partner qualification, commercial alignment, seating model, deal economics and delivery planning. 
- Own partner scorecards, QBRs, pipeline reviews and performance analytics; ensure MPA, reseller/OEM and AI Lab frameworks are fit for multi-country use. 

Must have



- 8–12+ years driving partner-led revenue with GSIs, hyperscalers, telcos or OEMs across APAC. 
- Has worked at EY, or has directly managed the EY relationship (alliance, partnership or account leadership), with first-hand knowledge of how EY Consulting operates, including its service lines, practice and industry structure, alliance model, decision-making, and how deals are sold, staffed and governed. 
- Demonstrated ability to manage a strategic GSI relationship and its joint GTM, operating at AI practice lead, industry MD and CTO level and converting or creating global agreements into named APAC deals. 
- Track record engaging C-suite and securing multi-year commercial frameworks. 
- Experience structuring multi-country pursuits, seating models and partner governance requiring MD-level sign-off, including across ASEAN and APAC countries. 
- Commercial acumen in AI/cloud: able to translate AI Studio, sovereign AI and GPUaaS into clear revenue models. 

Nice to have



- Familiarity with model deployment, GPU infrastructure or AI Lab concepts. 
- Existing relationships within EY AI/Cloud practices. 
- Prior use of hyperscaler funding (ECIF, MACC, OCP), MDF or co-sell pipelines. 
- Exposure to sovereign AI or public-sector transformation in regulated APAC markets, including ASEAN. 

Ideal backgrounds

Current or former EY Consulting leaders (alliance directors, AI/data practice leads, industry or sector leads), and leaders who have directly managed the EY relationship from a vendor, hyperscaler or technology partner side (e.g. senior partner sales managers at AWS, Microsoft or Google Cloud; partner account managers at Nvidia, Dell or HPE); regional or global alliance directors at Deloitte; GTM and strategic partnership leads at fast-growing AI, data or infrastructure vendors.

Languages: English required. Mandarin, Japanese or Korean a bonus for multi-country engagement. Bahasa (Indonesia/Malaysia), Thai, Vietnamese or Filipino a plus for ASEAN engagement.

What we offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Global Partnerships Lead — Greater China, Hong Kong & Singapore
categories: Software Development, Financial Services, and Technology, Information and Internet
description:
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet.

About The Team

The Global Partnerships team develops and manages the strategic relationships that enable Stripe’s payments, financial-services, and geographic-expansion ambitions. We work with local payment methods, financial institutions, card networks, banks, and other ecosystem partners to build the infrastructure, commercial models, and market access Stripe needs to serve users globally.

What you’ll do

We are hiring a Global Partnerships Lead based in Singapore to own Stripe’s Global Partnerships strategy and execution across Greater China, Hong Kong, and Singapore.

As the regional Global Partnerships Lead, you will own Stripe’s most important in-market relationships across local payment methods, financial partners, card networks, banks, and expansion partners. You will set the partnership strategy for the region; identify, prioritize, and develop new opportunities; lead complex negotiations; and ensure partnerships deliver durable commercial, product, and expansion outcomes for Stripe and our users.

This is a leadership role at the intersection of product strategy, market expansion, and commercial execution. You will serve as Stripe’s senior partnership representative for the region, build trusted executive relationships with ecosystem partners, and lead alignment across Product, Engineering, Go-to-Market, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, and Operations.

Responsibilities



- Act as Stripe’s Global Partnerships Lead for Greater China, Hong Kong, and Singapore, with end-to-end accountability for the regional partnership portfolio.
- Set and execute the regional strategy across local payment methods, financial partners, card networks, banks, and expansion partners.
- Lead Stripe’s senior external relationships in the region, building alignment and representing Stripe’s strategic priorities with partners.
- Own partnership opportunities from market assessment and strategy through negotiation, contracting, onboarding, launch, governance, and performance management.
- Lead regional expansion-partnership strategy and execution, coordinating the partnerships required to establish, operate, and scale Stripe in-market.
- Translate market intelligence, partner priorities, and ecosystem developments into clear recommendations for Stripe’s product and business strategy.
- Drive cross-functional decision-making on commercial, product, operational, regulatory, and technical dependencies related to regional partnerships.
- Establish and manage partner-performance metrics, including commercial outcomes, product adoption, operational health, and strategic progress.
- Anticipate and manage partnership risks, escalations, and trade-offs, ensuring sustained executive alignment internally and externally.


Who you are

We are looking for a commercially rigorous, strategically minded partnerships leader who is deeply familiar with the payments ecosystem in Greater China, Hong Kong, and Singapore. You are comfortable navigating complex stakeholder environments, structuring ambiguous opportunities, and independently driving high-impact outcomes.

Minimum Requirements



- 10+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, corporate development, strategy, financial services, or a related field.
- Significant experience in payments, fintech, ecommerce, banking, card networks, local payment methods, or adjacent financial-services sectors.
- Demonstrated experience leading complex, strategic commercial negotiations with senior external stakeholders.
- Deep knowledge of the payments and financial-partnership landscape in Greater China, Hong Kong, and/or Singapore, including relevant market dynamics and business models.
- Excellent written, verbal, and English executive communication skills and business-level Mandarin proficiency, written and spoken as this role would require working closely with our users and partners in the Greater China region.
- Strong ability to develop a clear point of view amid ambiguity, influence without authority, and drive decisions across complex internal and external stakeholder groups.
- Experience working closely with product and engineering organizations on partnerships with meaningful technical, operational, and regulatory dependencies.
- Ability to operate autonomously while balancing multiple high-priority initiatives and long-term strategic relationships.


Preferred Qualifications



- Experience owning a regional or multi-market portfolio of payments or financial-infrastructure partnerships.
- Experience supporting market-entry, expansion, licensing, or ecosystem-development initiatives.
- Existing senior relationships across banks, networks, payment-method providers, fintechs, or other relevant ecosystem partners in the region.
- Experience working in a fast-paced, global technology company with cross-functional product, commercial, and regulatory stakeholders.


In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is SGD 253,800 - SGD 380,800. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

title: Head of Global Partnership
description:
ABOUT US
PayerMax is a global fintech company rooted in emerging markets, offering seamless global payment solutions, including acquiring, payouts, and collections. Beyond payments, we deliver value-added services such as risk management, foreign exchange, multi-currency accounts, payment marketing, and tax services, designed to simplify and enhance the global payment experience


Driven by a long-term strategic vision, we have steadily expanded our global payment network since our founding in 2018 and now serve over 150 markets worldwide. We’ve built local offices in 18 countries and secured financial licenses and regulatory accreditations in key regions including Singapore, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Hong Kong (China), Thailand, Indonesia, and the Philippines. Rooted in emerging markets, our mission is to help merchants make the most of every minute and every cent, while continuing to drive innovation in digital finance




ABOUT THE ROLE
The Head of Global Partnership will be responsible for leading the company's global partnership strategy across key regions including Europe & Americas, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, Latin America and other strategic markets. This senior leadership role requires an accomplished executive with deep industry networks, extensive international payments experience, and proven leadership capabilities to drive the company's global payment infrastructure, ecosystem development, and localized market penetration, thereby supporting business growth and global expansion




CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Global Partnership Ecosystem Strategy & Business Development

- Formulate and execute a comprehensive global partner acquisition roadmap aligned with the company's international business strategy and regional client needs, ensuring robust, stable, cost-effective, and fully compliant local payment capabilities across all core markets
- Lead high-level strategic dialogues and negotiations with top-tier global partners, including but not limited to global and regional banks, acquiring institutions, e-wallets, card networks, cross-border payment platforms, fintech firms, and regulatory bodies
- Build and sustain long-term trusted relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers of partner organizations; drive deep collaboration models such as joint innovation, exclusive partnerships, and equity/strategic investment alliances
2. Team Leadership & Organizational Development

- Lead and manage a globally distributed partnership team of 20+ members across multiple countries and time zones
- Establish efficient global collaboration mechanisms, foster cross-regional and cross-cultural teamwork, define clear performance management systems, and continuously enhance team professionalism and execution capabilities
- Develop a robust talent pipeline and build a versatile, internationally-minded team with strong local market expertise
3. Local Market Implementation

- Based on strategic priorities, spearhead local market entry and scaling in key countries/regions; collaborate closely with Legal, Compliance, Finance, Product, Technology, and Business teams to ensure that localisation solutions are commercially viable, legally sound, and operationally competitive
4. Internal Synergy & Resource Integration

- Serve as the overall owner of global payment capability development, coordinating with internal stakeholders to ensure end-to-end efficient delivery of partnership projects—from contract signing to go-live—while continuously optimising cost and service quality
- Regularly report on project milestones, market opportunities, and risk assessments; evaluate strategic investment opportunities across the payment value chain to accelerate global network coverage and technology capability enhancement




QUALIFICATIONS

- Minimum 15 years of relevant industry experience, with at least 10 years in senior regional or global leadership roles within large financial institutions, international payment companies, or cross-border payment platforms
- Extensive and established network of global payment partners, with deep understanding and first-hand relationships with local payment channels, banking counterparts, and regulatory environments in emerging markets such as Europe & Americas, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, and Latin America; ability to directly access and influence key decision-makers
- Proven track record in managing large-scale, multicultural, and geographically dispersed teams, with direct supervisory experience over 20+ employees and demonstrated competence in cross-time-zone and cross-language collaboration
- Adept at engaging in C-level dialogue with financial institution executives; strong strategic negotiation and complex deal-structuring skills, supported by a history of successfully leading major partnership initiatives
- Excellent command of both English and Chinese (Mandarin) as working languages, with the ability to conduct high-stakes communications with sophistication
- Highly strategic with strong business acumen, combined with exceptional execution capabilities and resilience; ability to make clear, decisive judgments in highly ambiguous and fast-changing environments
- Unwavering integrity and strong compliance awareness. Bachelor's degree or above required; MBA preferred




关于我们
PayerMax是一家植根于新兴市场的全球金融科技公司，致力于提供无缝衔接的全球支付解决方案，涵盖收单、支付与收款服务。在此基础上，我们还提供风险管理、外汇兑换、多币种账户、支付营销及税务服务等增值服务，旨在全面简化和提升全球支付体验 


秉持长期主义的战略愿景，自2018年成立以来，我们稳步拓展全球支付网络，目前已覆盖150多个市场，在18个国家设立了本地办事处，并在新加坡、阿联酋、沙特阿拉伯、中国香港、泰国、印尼和菲律宾等主要地区获得了金融牌照及监管认证。立足新兴市场，我们的使命是帮助商户用好每一分钟、花好每一分钱，同时持续推动数字金融领域的创新 关于职位 作为人力资源团队的一员，你将有机会与各国家/地区的人力资源及业务团队紧密协作，作为人力资源和行政管理方面的专家，为PayerMax中东业务提供坚实支撑，共同推动公司未来发展




关于职位
全球合作伙伴关系负责人（Head of Global Partnership）将全面领导公司的Global Partnership战略，覆盖欧美，亚太、中东、拉美等市场。此岗位需要一位拥有深厚行业资源、丰富国际化支付经验及卓越领导力的资深管理者，推动公司全球支付能力建设、生态合作及本地化深耕，支持公司业务增长与全球化布局。




核心职责
1. 全球合作伙伴生态战略与拓展

- 基于公司全球业务战略及区域客户需求，制定并执行全球支付合作伙伴的拓展蓝图，确保公司在各核心市场具备丰富、稳定、低成本且合规的本地支付能力
- 主导与全球顶级合作伙伴的高层战略对话与谈判，合作伙伴涵盖：全球及区域性银行、收单机构、电子钱包、卡组织、跨境支付平台、金融科技公司及监管机构等
- 建立并维护与合作伙伴C-level及决策层长期信任关系，推动联合创新、独家合作、资本合作等深度绑定模式
2. 团队管理与组织建设

- 领导并管理分布在全球多个国家/地区的Global Partnership团队，团队总规模20人以上
- 建立高效的全球协作机制，推动跨区域、跨文化团队的协同作战能力，制定清晰绩效管理体系，持续提升团队专业度与执行力
- 培养梯队人才，打造具备国际化视野和本地深耕能力的复合型团队
3. 关键市场本地化落地

- 结合公司战略优先级，主导关键国家/地区的本地化进程；与法务、合规、财务、产品、技术及业务团队紧密协同，确保本地化方案在商业、法律及运营层面均具备可行性与竞争力
4. 内部协同与资源整合

- 作为全球支付能力建设的总负责人，协同内部部门，确保合作伙伴项目从签约到上线的全链路高效落地，并持续优化成本与服务质量
- 定期沟通关键项目进展、市场机会与风险，评估支付产业链上下游的战略投资机会，协助加速公司全球网络覆盖与技术能力升级




任职要求

- 15年以上相关行业经验，其中至少10年以上在大型金融机构、国际支付公司、或跨境支付平台负责全球或区域管理
- 拥有深厚的全球支付合作伙伴资源网络，尤其对欧美、亚太、中东、拉美等新兴市场的本地支付渠道、银行及监管环境有深刻理解和一手人脉；有能力直接触达并影响关键决策者
- 具备管理大规模、全球化、多文化团队的成功经验，直接管理过20人以上团队，擅长跨时区、跨语言协作
- 擅长与金融机构C-level高管进行高层对话，具有优秀的战略博弈及复杂条款谈判的能力，过往有大型合作项目的主导落地案例
- 优秀的中英文沟通能力，可作为工作语言进行高复杂度沟通 
- 极具战略视野与商业敏锐度，同时具备极强的执行力与韧性；能够在高度不确定和快速变化的环境中做出清晰决策
- 诚信、合规意识强，本科及以上学历，MBA优先

title: Partner Development Manager
categories: Software Development, Financial Services, and Technology, Information and Internet
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

What you’ll do

We are hiring a Global Partnerships Lead based in Singapore to own Stripe’s Global Partnerships strategy and execution across SE Asia.

As the regional Global Partnerships Lead, you will own Stripe’s most important in-market relationships across local payment methods, financial partners, card networks, banks, and expansion partners. You will set the partnership strategy for the region; identify, prioritize, and develop new opportunities; lead complex negotiations; and ensure partnerships deliver durable commercial, product, and expansion outcomes for Stripe and our users.

This is a leadership role at the intersection of product strategy, market expansion, and commercial execution. You will serve as Stripe’s senior partnership representative for the region, build trusted executive relationships with ecosystem partners, and lead alignment across Product, Engineering, Go-to-Market, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, and Operations.

Responsibilities



- Act as Stripe’s Global Partnerships Lead for SE Asia Expansion, with end-to-end accountability for the regional partnership portfolio.
- Set and execute the regional strategy across local payment methods, financial partners, card networks, banks, and expansion partners.
- Lead Stripe’s senior external relationships in the region, building alignment and representing Stripe’s strategic priorities with partners.
- Own partnership opportunities from market assessment and strategy through negotiation, contracting, onboarding, launch, governance, and performance management.
- Lead regional expansion-partnership strategy and execution, coordinating the partnerships required to establish, operate, and scale Stripe in-market.
- Translate market intelligence, partner priorities, and ecosystem developments into clear recommendations for Stripe’s product and business strategy.
- Drive cross-functional decision-making on commercial, product, operational, regulatory, and technical dependencies related to regional partnerships.
- Establish and manage partner-performance metrics, including commercial outcomes, product adoption, operational health, and strategic progress.
- Anticipate and manage partnership risks, escalations, and trade-offs, ensuring sustained executive alignment internally and externally.


Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements



- 10+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, corporate development, strategy, financial services, or a related field.
- Significant experience in payments, fintech, e-commerce, banking, card networks, local payment methods, or adjacent financial-services sectors.
- Demonstrated experience leading complex, strategic commercial negotiations with senior external stakeholders.
- Deep knowledge of the payments and financial-partnership landscape in SE Asia, including relevant market dynamics and business models.
- Excellent written, verbal, and English executive communication skills.
- Strong ability to develop a clear point of view amid ambiguity, influence without authority, and drive decisions across complex internal and external stakeholder groups.
- Experience working closely with product and engineering organizations on partnerships with meaningful technical, operational, and regulatory dependencies.
- Ability to operate autonomously while balancing multiple high-priority initiatives and long-term strategic relationships.


Preferred Qualifications



- Experience owning a regional or multi-market portfolio of payments or financial-infrastructure partnerships.
- Experience supporting market-entry, expansion, licensing, or ecosystem-development initiatives.
- Existing senior relationships across banks, networks, payment-method providers, fintechs, or other relevant ecosystem partners in the region.
- Experience working in a fast-paced, global technology company with cross-functional product, commercial, and regulatory stakeholders.


In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is SGD 253,800 - SGD 380,800. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

title: APAC Ecosystem Partnerships Lead (Public Sector) - Global Payments Firm
description:
A global payments leader is hiring an APAC Lead for Public Sector/Government Ecosystem Partnerships to help scale its government payments ecosystem across Asia Pacific.

You'll be responsible for developing strategic relationships with organisations already embedded within the public sector - including global system integrators, cloud providers, SaaS platforms, GovTech players, and enterprise technology partners - creating scalable routes to market across the region.


Working across multiple APAC markets, you will identify, negotiate, and grow high-value partnerships that unlock new government payment opportunities. This is a highly cross-functional role, partnering with product, sales, market, and global leadership teams to create repeatable partnership models that accelerate regional growth.
