title: Senior Manager, Business Development – Carousell Luxury
description:
Company Description

Carousell Group is the leading recommerce group in Greater Southeast Asia on a mission to inspire the world to start selling, and to make secondhand the first choice. Founded in August 2012 in Singapore, the Group has a leading presence in eight markets under the brands Carousell, Cho Tot, Laku6, Mudah.my, OneKyat, Ox Street, and Refash, serving tens of millions of monthly active users. Carousell is backed by leading investors including Telenor Group, Rakuten Ventures, Naver, STIC Investments and Sequoia Capital India.

As a team of passionate individuals working together to solve meaningful problems, there is so much more for you to discover in a career with Carousell. Our culture is made up of hiring, developing, and promoting people who embody our values of solving problems for our users; having a mission-first mindset; being relentlessly resourceful; caring deeply; and staying humble to constantly improve. Together as an organisation, we make magic happen.

Job Description

About the role

Carousell Luxury is growing, and this role sits at the centre of it. You’ll build and run our partner network, working with professional resellers, dealers and trade partners to unlock new growth for the business.

This is a zero-to-one role with real ownership. You’ll test new commercial models, prove the numbers, and help decide what scales. You’ll work closely with Marketing, Tech, Operations, Retail, Finance and Legal.

What You’ll Do

Grow our Brand Fair reseller network



- Recruit and manage professional resellers to exhibit at Carousell Luxury Brand Fairs, and grow partner participation event by event
- Own the event calendar: plan dates (including peak long weekends), secure venues well in advance, and make each event commercially viable

Build B2B partnerships



- Develop new B2B partnerships with high-volume luxury resellers and dealers
- Design partner processes end to end, working closely with Operations and Retail so they run smoothly without adding to the team’s workload
- Negotiate terms, sign and manage partners, and track performance weekly
- Make data-driven calls on when to scale, adjust or stop a pilot

Own the numbers



- Set targets, track partner performance, and report progress to leadership every week

Qualifications

What we’re looking for



- Experience in B2B partnerships, business development or wholesale, ideally in luxury, resale or retail
- Strong commercial judgement: you can size a deal, negotiate terms, and know when to scale or exit a pilot
- An operator’s mindset: you design processes that work on the ground
- Comfortable owning targets and reporting against them weekly
- Self-driven and at home in ambiguity, with a track record of building something new
- A network among luxury resellers and dealers in Singapore is a strong plus

Why join us



- Build new partnerships and channels from the ground up, with real ownership and visibility to leadership
- Work at the intersection of luxury, recommerce and marketplaces at Southeast Asia’s leading recommerce platform
- A cross-functional role where your decisions directly shape how the business grows

Additional Information

description:
Responsibilities
About the Team
The Monetization Product Partnerships team sits at the intersection of technology, advertising, and business growth. We build and scale the partner ecosystem that enables businesses to thrive on TikTok — spanning AI, campaign management, commerce, data & measurement, and content & community management.

Our culture mirrors that of a high-performing fast-paced: entrepreneurial, fast-moving, and always looking around the corner for what's next. Partnerships are a critical lever for scaling how TikTok users discover and interact with brands across the region.

You will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders — including Product, Strategy, Legal, Sales and Marketing — to develop innovative ways for consumers to interact with the products, services, and experiences they love.

Responsibilities
- New Business Development: Source, qualify, and close new strategic partnerships aligned with TikTok's ads monetization strategy.

- Partner Growth: Drive product adoption of monetization integrations and solutions across the existing partner base; identify opportunities to expand coverage and bring more advertisers onto TikTok.

- Operational Excellence: Own annual planning, OKRs, reporting cadences, and contract management; proactively identify and resolve business blockers.

Qualifications

- 5+ years of client-facing partnerships or business development experience for Japan market.
- Strong understanding of the digital advertising industry, with familiarity across major media platforms and ad-tech players in Japan.
- Demonstrated ability to present to and influence audiences at all levels of seniority, both internally and externally.
- Quantitative and analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data to drive decision
- Proficiency in Japanese is required to effectively engage with Japanese-speaking external stakeholders and partners, understand local market and cultural nuances, and support business development and partnership initiatives in the Japan market, ensuring effective cross-cultural collaboration.

Preferred Qualification(s)
- Experience developing and shipping complex product integrations with third-party platforms.
- Background in growth marketing or performance marketing initiatives.
- Familiarity with the South Korea ad-tech ecosystem is a strong plus

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

About The Role

This is a senior, execution-focused strategic partnerships role supporting Klaviyo’s Mid/Large Enterprise motion across Asia. The role will help build and scale high-impact relationships with global and regional strategic partners, including Accenture, WPP, Hakuhodo, and Dentsu, while developing a broader partner ecosystem across Southeast Asia, Japan, Greater China, and South Korea.

Reporting to the APAC Partnerships Leader, you will identify, recruit, and grow strategic partnerships from the ground up. You will navigate complex, multi-threaded stakeholder environments and translate partner engagement into measurable pipeline, revenue, customer outcomes, and market expansion.

A key part of the role is building Klaviyo’s presence with partners that have strong enterprise reach, delivery capability, and influence across the target markets. Experience working with MSP and OSP models will be beneficial as we creatively explore how these partners can help bring Klaviyo’s next generation of AI-forward product capabilities to market.

You will articulate and differentiate Klaviyo in the market, drive business development and co-sell opportunities, and shape services-led go-to-market plays that help partners grow their Klaviyo practice and profitability. You will also work closely with Partner Marketing, Sales, Product, Customer Success, and regional leadership to bring Klaviyo’s broader platform story to market, including our B2C CRM, AI-powered capabilities, and service offerings.

Strong martech experience is preferred but not required. More important is the ability to understand complex customer and partner environments, build credibility with senior stakeholders, and turn strategic relationships into repeatable commercial outcomes.

Focus markets



- Southeast Asia (SEA)
- Japan
- Greater China (GCR)
- South Korea

How You’ll Make An Impact



- Lead the development and execution of Klaviyo’s strategic partnerships strategy across SEA, Japan, GCR, and South Korea.
- Identify, recruit, and build high-impact partnerships with global and regional GSIs, SIs, agency holding companies, MSPs, OSPs, and other strategic services providers.
- Develop and deepen relationships with priority partners such as Accenture, WPP, Hakuhodo, and Dentsu.
- Build joint business plans that align partner priorities, Klaviyo’s growth objectives, target accounts, routes to market, and measurable revenue outcomes.
- Create repeatable co-sell and partner-led motions across enterprise and upper mid-market accounts.
- Own and grow a focused portfolio of strategic partners, with accountability for partner-sourced pipeline, partner-influenced revenue, activation, and market coverage.
- Establish executive relationships across partner leadership, alliance teams, sales organisations, delivery teams, and relevant country or market leads.
- Develop multi-partner plays that combine Klaviyo with GSIs, SIs, MSPs, OSPs, technology partners, and adjacent ecosystem partners to deliver differentiated customer value.
- Partner closely with Sales to identify whitespace, map strategic accounts, create executive alignment, and accelerate complex opportunities.
- Shape services-led and transformation-driven go-to-market plays that help partners build, scale, and monetise their Klaviyo practices.
- Collaborate with Partner Marketing on regional campaigns, executive programs, events, and partner-led demand generation.
- Work with Product, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Enablement to remove barriers to partner activation and customer adoption.
- Bring Klaviyo’s broader platform story to partners and customers, including martech, AI, data, and service use cases.
- Drive regular business reviews with strategic partners, using data and insight to improve performance, accountability, and long-term impact.
- Travel across Asia, up to 25%, to meet partners, support field engagement, and attend strategic events.

Who You Are



- You have 8+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, alliances, business development, enterprise sales, channel, or a related SaaS go-to-market role.
- You have experience building and scaling high-value relationships with GSIs, SIs, agency holding companies, MSPs, OSPs, or broader services partners.
- You have direct experience with partner recruitment, ideally taking partnerships from zero to one and creating the structure, momentum, and commercial case for growth.
- You understand MSP and OSP operating models and how these partners influence technology decisions, customer relationships, implementation, and ongoing services.
- You have a track record of driving partner-sourced, partner-influenced, or direct revenue outcomes against clear targets.
- You are comfortable engaging senior executives across organisations such as Accenture, WPP, Hakuhodo, Dentsu, and comparable strategic partners.
- You have experience working across multiple Asian markets and can adapt your approach to different business cultures, buying processes, and partner ecosystems.
- You have a strong commercial mindset and know how to turn partner activity into pipeline, revenue, and strategic growth.
- You are comfortable managing complex, multi-threaded relationships across external partners and internal cross-functional teams.
- You have a strong understanding of SaaS sales motions, enterprise deal cycles, co-sell dynamics, and services-led growth.
- You have experience building and executing joint go-to-market plans across co-sell, co-marketing, partner enablement, strategic accounts, and partner-led demand generation.
- You are credible with executive stakeholders and confident leading solution, value, and business discussions with partners and customers.
- You have strong strategic judgement, balanced with the ability to execute hands-on and maintain momentum.
- You have a challenger mindset and are comfortable bringing a clear point of view, asking hard questions, and pushing toward better outcomes.
- You are highly collaborative, operate well independently, set priorities effectively, and drive outcomes in a fast-moving environment.
- Strong martech experience is preferred but not required; experience in adjacent SaaS, CRM, data, commerce, or digital transformation ecosystems is also relevant.
- You are AI fluent and use AI responsibly in your day-to-day work to improve productivity, sharpen thinking, and model new ways of working for partners and internal teams.
- Bilingual capability, particularly in a language relevant to the focus markets, is an advantage.

Klaviyo In APAC

We are rapidly expanding our footprint in Asia-Pacific with our new Singapore Hub. Since launching here just six months ago we are already scaling fast, aggressively building out our core GTM functions, including Sales, Pre-sales, Business Development, Customer Success, Partnerships, Marketing, and People.

This is a true “1% done” moment. While we build on the strong foundation of our Sydney presence, our Singapore Hub offers the unique energy of a startup within a global company. We are looking for “Drivers”—builders who want to shape our local culture and define the future of Klaviyo in Asia-Pacific and Japan.

Aligned with our value of Always Learning, we are looking for the leaders of the future. The headroom for growth here is massive. If you are insatiably curious and eager to accelerate your career, Klaviyo provides the platform. Join us, and help build something exceptional from the ground up.

title: APAC Partner Business Development Manager
description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Deepgram is the Voice AI platform powering the next generation of enterprise voice agents, contact centers, and real-time speech applications. As we continue expanding globally, APAC represents one of our highest-growth strategic regions for partner-led expansion.

We are hiring an APAC Partner Business Development Manager to build and scale Deepgram’s partner ecosystem across ANZ, ASEAN, Japan, Korea, India, and Greater China. In this role, you will drive sell-to, sell-through, and sell-with motions alongside strategic partners including hyperscalers, ISVs, CCaaS/CX platforms, GSIs, telcos, and regional system integrators.

This is a highly cross-functional, builder-oriented role focused on growing partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue across diverse APAC markets. You’ll work closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing, and global partner teams to establish Deepgram as a leading Voice AI platform in the region.

If you thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy building new GTM motions, and are excited about shaping the future of AI partnerships in APAC, we’d love to meet you.

What You’ll DoDrive Regional Partner Growth



- Build and manage strategic partner relationships across APAC
- Develop joint value propositions, GTM plans, and regional co-sell motions tailored to local market dynamics
- Establish Deepgram as a strategic Voice AI partner across key ecosystems in the region

Drive Sell-To, Sell-Through, and Sell-With Motions

- Generate and accelerate partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline across APAC markets

Build Pipeline & Revenue

Expand the APAC Partner Ecosystem



- Identify and onboard new strategic partners aligned with Deepgram’s platform and regional expansion priorities

Represent Deepgram in APAC



- Participate in regional partner and customer engagements, both virtual and in-person
- Stay informed on APAC market trends, competitive dynamics, AI adoption, regulatory requirements, and sovereign AI initiatives
- Act as a strategic voice for APAC market needs internally

What You Bring



- Proven experience in business development, partnerships, alliance management, or enterprise sales within the technology industry
- Experience driving revenue through strategic partnerships and co-sell motions across APAC markets
- Strong understanding of APAC business dynamics and experience operating across multiple regions including ANZ, ASEAN, Japan, Korea, India, and/or Greater China
- Experience partnering with cloud providers, ISVs, GSIs, telcos, CCaaS/CX platforms, or regional system integrators

- Analytical mindset with strong operational and forecasting discipline
- Self-starter mentality with the ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments
- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across global teams and time zones

Nice to Have

title: Partner Sales Manager, AWS
description:

What You’ll Do

- Drive focused go-to-market activity: Translate joint account planning, campaigns, events and workshops into qualified opportunities and clear follow-up actions.
- Maintain pipeline discipline: Keep opportunity records, partner registrations, forecasts and next steps accurate and current.
- Enable both sides of the partnership: Help AWS teams understand Slalom’s capabilities and help Slalom teams recognize where AWS relationships and programs can support customer outcomes.


What You’ll Bring

- 6–10 years of relevant experience across partner sales, alliances, technology sales, business development or consulting.
- A consulting or professional services background is preferred, with an understanding of how advisory and technology engagements are scoped, sold and delivered.
- Experience working with AWS or a comparable cloud partner ecosystem, ideally including joint selling and partner-led opportunity development.
- Sufficient technical understanding to qualify cloud, data, modernization and AI opportunities, without needing to own detailed solution architecture.
- Experience identifying and activating partner funding programs, with the ability to connect program requirements to customer opportunities.

- A track record of building qualified pipeline and progressing complex, multi-stakeholder sales opportunities.
- Strong relationship-building, discovery and communication skills, including the ability to engage business and technical stakeholders.
- An activator mindset: resourceful, proactive and comfortable turning relationships and ideas into concrete next steps.
- The ability to work independently while coordinating effectively across sales, consulting, delivery and partner teams.

What Success Looks Like

- Growth in qualified AWS partner-sourced and co-sell pipeline.
- Stronger AWS relationships that consistently generate customer opportunities.
- Effective use of eligible funding programs to support customer engagements.
- Earlier involvement of Slalom in customer discovery, design and scoping.

Deep connections, better outcomes

We’re there to work side-by-side with client teams, enabling their success long after we’ve gone. We’re all about momentum that outlasts us.
Flexibility
Life is busy, and we understand that. Our team often juggles work, family, personal commitments, and crucial client obligations. We prioritise supporting our people in balancing what matters to them while ensuring we meet our client commitments. Flexibility is key, as we sometimes need to adapt to meet client needs. This way, our team can work on high-impact projects they’ll love, knowing they have the flexibility to manage their personal and professional lives effectively.
People-first
Great solutions start with great people. At our employee-led company, your voice matters, and we love to hear your feedback. By leading with kindness, empathy, and striving for equity, we create better experiences for everyone. Our culture encourages passion, adventure, adaptability, and diverse thinking. Inclusion, diversity, and equity are our top priorities, empowering our team to be their best selves. Together, we can create a great future by working collaboratively and supporting each other.
What keeps us here?
Our Singapore office knows the importance of a good work/life balance. We have the freedom to be ourselves when life gets in the way. We make a big effort to bring everyone together and allow space when space is needed. We believe in helping each other thrive in work and life and are proud to invest in benefits that include holistic well-being, meaningful allowances, and investment in our team’s professional, technical, and personal growth.

It’s an exciting time to be one of our foundational members, getting involved in setting up our unique Singapore culture

description:

Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle super-app. We connect tens of millions of travelers across the region with flights, hotels, experiences, financial services, and more — all from a single platform. Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognized consumer brands in the region.

We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that.

The Accommodation team owns the hotel and property booking experience across Traveloka's eleven markets — from budget guesthouses in Bali to premium international chains in Bangkok and Singapore. We win by getting supply right destination by destination: the right property, at the right price, available every time a traveler searches.

This is the partnership and account-management engine behind that supply. You sit across the table from hotel owners and chains, turning conversations into competitive rates, exclusive inventory, and partnerships that grow. You will know your portfolio better than anyone — what each property needs, where we can win share, and how to make Traveloka the channel they bet on. If you like ambitious commercial targets, real ownership of relationships, and seeing your deals show up in what millions of travelers book, this is your team.

You role is structured with a 70% focus on account management & commercial strategy, and a 30% focus on managing connectivity partners — making it ideal for someone who combines strong business acumen with operational understanding



- Own and manage relationships with global hotel chains.
- Scale Traveloka's connectivity ecosystem by managing Channel Managers and Switch providers to expand high-quality hotel supply coverage across key markets.
- Negotiate commercial terms, analyze performance metrics & provide actionable insights to hotel chains- act as the primary account lead for these chains.

- Develop and execute Joint Business Planning aligned with partner and company objectives.

Job Requirements



- You have minimum 8 years experience working in sales, account management, market management, project management, or a travel technology company.
- You have OTA, travel, or hospitality experience preferred.
- You have strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously and deliver results within deadlines.
- You have excellent communication skills with the ability to manage and influence multiple stakeholders.
- You have strong analytical skills with a proven track record of data-driven decision-making processes.

Join Us

If you have read this far and felt something click — the problem, the scale, the moment — we would like to hear from you.

We review every application. If your background is a strong fit, you will hear from us within 5 business days.

We are building the kind of company where strong people choose to stay because the work keeps getting bigger and better. If that is what you are looking for, apply.

title: Partner Sales Manager, AWS
description:
Who You’ll Work With
You’ll work in Slalom to grow our AWS partnership and turn shared opportunities into meaningful customer outcomes.
We’re looking for an activator partner sales manager who can build trusted relationships, build opportunities and bring the right people together to move them forward. You’ll combine a consulting mindset with technical fluency and a strong focus on activating partner programs and funding.

What You’ll Do

- Grow the AWS partnership: Develop and execute a partner sales plan that increases partner-sourced pipeline, joint customer engagement and revenue.
- Activate partner relationships: Build strong relationships with AWS account teams, partner managers, specialists and Professional Services stakeholders to identify opportunities and position Slalom early in customer conversations.
- Originate and qualify opportunities: Understand customer priorities, business drivers, technology environments, budget and decision-making processes to assess opportunity fit and readiness.
- Bring technical fluency to sales conversations: Discuss cloud migration, modernization, data and AI opportunities confidently, recognizing when to involve Slalom’s technical and delivery specialists.
- Maximize funding opportunities: Identify relevant AWS funding and partner programs, assess their applicability and coordinate with the appropriate teams on submissions, approvals and delivery requirements.
- Shape joint pursuits: Connect AWS stakeholders with Slalom account and practice teams to develop customer propositions, shape scope and progress opportunities toward closure.
- Drive focused go-to-market activity: Translate joint account planning, campaigns, events and workshops into qualified opportunities and clear follow-up actions.
- Maintain pipeline discipline: Keep opportunity records, partner registrations, forecasts and next steps accurate and current.
- Enable both sides of the partnership: Help AWS teams understand Slalom’s capabilities and help Slalom teams recognize where AWS relationships and programs can support customer outcomes.
What You’ll Bring

- 6–10 years of relevant experience across partner sales, alliances, technology sales, business development or consulting.
- A consulting or professional services background is preferred, with an understanding of how advisory and technology engagements are scoped, sold and delivered.
- Experience working with AWS or a comparable cloud partner ecosystem, ideally including joint selling and partner-led opportunity development.
- Sufficient technical understanding to qualify cloud, data, modernization and AI opportunities, without needing to own detailed solution architecture.
- Experience identifying and activating partner funding programs, with the ability to connect program requirements to customer opportunities.

- A track record of building qualified pipeline and progressing complex, multi-stakeholder sales opportunities.
- Strong relationship-building, discovery and communication skills, including the ability to engage business and technical stakeholders.
- An activator mindset: resourceful, proactive and comfortable turning relationships and ideas into concrete next steps.
- The ability to work independently while coordinating effectively across sales, consulting, delivery and partner teams.
- AWS certifications are advantageous, but practical technical fluency and commercial judgment are more important.
What Success Looks Like

- Growth in qualified AWS partner-sourced and co-sell pipeline.
- Stronger AWS relationships that consistently generate customer opportunities.
- Effective use of eligible funding programs to support customer engagements.
- Earlier involvement of Slalom in customer discovery, design and scoping.
- Clear progression from joint account planning to pursuits, wins and delivery handoffs.

description:

Senior Director, APJ Channels & Alliances

Based in Singapore ( Open to Singapore citizens and Permanent Residents (PRs) only )

EnterpriseDB (EDB) is the largest provider of Enterprise Postgres software and services and a leader in the open-source database marketplace. EDB delivers the premier open source-based data platform for new applications, cloud re-platforming, application modernization, and legacy database migration. EDB integrates with enterprise technologies and infrastructures for hybrid cloud management, data integration, and data warehousing. Our customers benefit from the highest performing, secure, reliable, flexible, open, and cost-effective data management platform available.

We are seeking a Senior Director, APJ Channels & Alliances to own and scale our entire partner business across Asia Pacific and Japan. Strategy & Revenue Ownership



- Own the APJ channel and alliances revenue target, with a track record of delivering through partners and distribution
- Define and execute a multi-year APJ partner strategy aligned with regional and global business goals, including market prioritization, partner segmentation, and investment decisions

- Create a consistent, scalable operating rhythm for partner management across all APJ markets

- Build and expand strategic relationships with hyperscalers (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud and others), global and regional SIs, distributors, and key VARs
- Develop joint GTM plans, co-selling motions, and marketplace strategies with strategic alliance partners
- Grow EDB's presence in the data and AI ecosystem, positioning EDB Postgres® AI within partner-led modernisation, migration, and AI initiatives
- Own executive-level relationships with partner leadership across the region

Partner Programs & Enablement



- Design and roll out partner programs, incentives, tiering, and certification tailored to APJ markets
- Ensure partners are trained, enabled, and technically capable of selling and delivering EDB solutions
- Drive partner-led demand generation in collaboration with Marketing

Cross-Functional Leadership



- Partner closely with APJ Sales, Pre-Sales, Marketing, Professional Services, and Customer Success leaders to align direct and indirect motions and reduce channel conflict
- Represent APJ in global channel strategy, contributing to programs, policy, and investment priorities
- Provide clear forecasting, reporting, and business reviews to APJ and global leadership using the company's CRM

Qualifications



- 15+ years of experience in enterprise software sales, channels, and business development
- 10+ years in channel and alliances roles, including 7+ years leading multi-country partner teams across APJ
- Proven track record of building a partner ecosystem from the ground up and scaling it into a significant revenue contributor
- Deep experience working with distributors, VARs, SIs, GSIs, OEMs, ISVs, and hyperscaler alliances and marketplaces
- Strong understanding of databases, open-source, or infrastructure software; experience with Postgres or data and AI platforms is a strong advantage
- Experience designing partner programs, incentives, and GTM plans with measurable outcomes
- Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior leaders internally and across partner organisations
- Comfortable operating in a matrixed, global organisation

title: Head of Partners, APAC
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

So, what's the role all about?

This is a senior leadership role for a commercially sharp, relationship-first partnerships executive who is ready to own APAC partner growth for NiCE. You will report directly into the VP Partner Sales, International, and lead a team of 8-10 partner managers across a region spanning India, Middle East, ANZ, Japan and South-East Asia.

APAC is at an inflection point for NiCE. Partner-led revenue is growing quickly, and this role exists to accelerate that momentum by building deeper strategic relationships, raising the execution quality of the team, and aligning the partner ecosystem to the AI-first CX transformation story that NiCE and Cognigy represent together.

How will you make an impact?

Partner strategy and ecosystem development



- Own and execute the APAC partner strategy, aligned to NiCE's international commercial objectives and partner-led revenue targets. 
- Build and grow a high-performing partner ecosystem across GSIs, hyperscalers, regional system integrators, BPOs, and value-added resellers in India, Middle East, ANZ, Japan, and South-East Asia.

- Build joint business plans with Tier 1 and Platinum partners, including clear revenue commitments, enablement milestones, and executive alignment. 
- Work cross-functionally with APAC sales leadership, marketing, and pre-sales to ensure partner opportunities convert and partners are fully equipped to close. 

Team leadership and performance



- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 8-10 Partner Managers across APAC, setting clear performance standards and a high-execution culture. 
- Build a team environment anchored on accountability, coaching, and continuous enablement with a focus on producing partner managers who can operate independently in market. 
- Hire, onboard, and retain talent in line with APAC headcount plans as the function scales. 
- Bring the energy and operating discipline to run a high-performing regional function, with a consistent rhythm of field engagement, pipeline reviews, and executive stakeholder management. 

AI-first partner enablement



- Champion NiCE's AI-first CX narrative CXone and Cognigy across the APAC partner ecosystem, ensuring partners can confidently position agentic AI to their customers. 
- Drive structured enablement programmes across the region, including certifications, AI readiness training, and joint presales capability. 
- Identify and develop partner-led reference customers and lighthouse accounts across India, ANZ, and Japan that demonstrate the NiCE and Cognigy value proposition. 

Executive presence and market representation



- Represent NiCE at major APAC industry events, partner summits, and customer forums across India, Australia, and Japan. 
- Build and maintain senior relationships with partner C-suite and alliance leadership, acting as the face of NiCE's partner business in the region. 
- Provide regular reporting and insight to the VP Partner Sales International on partner performance, pipeline health, market trends, and competitive intelligence. 

Have you got what it takes?

Experience



- 12+ years of experience in partner sales, alliances, channel, or business development within a B2B SaaS or AI/CX business with significant tenure in APAC markets. 
- A proven track record of building and scaling partner-led revenue across at least two of the three key markets: India, ANZ, and Japan. 
- Hands-on experience leading and growing a team of 8+ partner managers in a complex, multi-country regional role. 
- Deep working knowledge of GSI and hyperscaler operating models, with existing C-level and VP-level relationships across the APAC ecosystem. 
- Demonstrable success in delivering against partner-sourced revenue targets in a fast-paced, commercially competitive environment. 

Skills And Capabilities



- Strong commercial instincts you understand how to structure partner programmes, protect deal economics, and align partner incentives to mutual growth. 
- Credible AI and CX fluency you can speak with conviction about agentic AI, contact centre transformation, cloud platforms, and the practical outcomes NiCE delivers for enterprise customers. 
- Exceptional executive presence and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust at C-suite and senior partner leadership level across diverse APAC cultures. 
- High proficiency in pipeline management, sales cadence, and partner governance frameworks you run a clean, disciplined operating model. 
- Cross-functional collaboration skills you work naturally with sales, marketing, product, and finance to align on shared outcomes. 
- Ability to communicate and influence in English to board level; additional APAC language proficiency (Mandarin, Japanese) is a significant advantage. 

Background



- Experience in CCaaS, contact centre AI, unified communications, CX platforms, or enterprise SaaS strongly preferred. 
- Familiarity with partner programme design, deal registration, MDF allocation, and partner performance management. 
- Experience working within a global matrix organisation, managing upward to international leadership and laterally with regional sales teams.

NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.

title: VP of Licensing & Business Development
description:
The Opportunity


We are looking for a VP of Licensing & Business Development to lead and expand Partex.AI's business development activities across APAC, with a particular focus on pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies Japan, China, Korea, Singapore and the broader APAC region.
We are looking for someone who brings the skills and commercial understanding of a true drug
hunter — someone who understands what pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies look
for when evaluating assets for licensing, strategic partnerships and portfolio expansion.
The primary focus of this role will be to identify strategic partners for Partex unique , develop senior-level relationships and drive opportunities from initial engagement through valuation, negotiation and potentially term-sheet execution.
The ideal candidate will bring a strong, demonstrable deal sheet, an established network across
Pharma/Biotech in APAC region and the ability to independently identify, qualify and convert high-value licensing opportunities.


Role & Business Context
Partex.AI's Asset Exchange business focuses on increasing the value and attractiveness of
pharmaceutical assets through AI-driven dossier enrichment. e.g,
• Identification of new indications, Pharma/Biotech asset search and evaluation
Many of our Asset Exchange opportunities are structured around risk-sharing commercial
models, where revenues are linked to the successful licensing or development of an asset.
In addition to Asset Exchange and Asset Management, Partex.AI operates a significant Asset
Services business focused on AI solutions for R&D, patient data, validation and related
services. While this will not be the primary focus of the position, the ability to identify crossselling and strategic partnership opportunities across the broader Partex.AI portfolio will be
highly valued.


Location & Working Model


Singapore Candidates
Candidates based in Singapore will be expected to work from the Partex.AI office and
collaborate closely with the global Commercial and Leadership teams.
Japan / China / Korea Candidates
Candidates based in Japan or China may work remotely from their home location, with regular
virtual collaboration with the global team and travel to Singapore and/or other Partex.AI
locations as required.
Regional Travel
The role will require regular travel across Singapore, Japan, China and other APAC markets, as
well as occasional international travel for licensing meetings, conferences, partner
engagements and internal business activities.


Key Responsibilities

- Lead Licensing activities across APAC region.
- Identify, search, and evaluate Pharma/Biotech assets and potential partners.
- Build and manage relationships with Pharma/Biotech BD, Licensing, R&D, and Corporate Development teams.
- Identify and develop strategic partnerships and licensing opportunities.
- Evaluate asset scientific, clinical, commercial, and strategic potential.
- Drive opportunities through partner identification, due diligence, valuation, negotiation, term sheets, and deal execution.
- Build and maintain a strong APAC Pharma/Biotech network.
- Represent Partex.AI at relevant industry and partnering events.


Preferred Qualification

- 5+ years of Pharma/Biotech experience in Business Development, Licensing, Corporate Development, or related functions.
- Mandatory: Proven Out-Licensing experience in Pharma/Biotech.
- Mandatory: Pharma/Biotech asset search and evaluation experience.
- Required: Hands-on Business Development experience.
- Strong Oncology and/or Immunology experience preferred.
- Established Pharma/Biotech network across APAC preferred.
- Strong understanding of drug development, licensing, asset valuation, and negotiations.
- Excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.
- Experience with AI, computational drug discovery, or data-driven R&D is a plus.


Why Join Partex.AI?
• Opportunity to play a key role in building Partex.AI's APAC commercial and licensing
strategy.
• Direct exposure to high-value pharmaceutical and biotechnology partnerships.
• Opportunity to work with AI-driven drug discovery and real-world data technologies.
• High degree of ownership, autonomy and decision-making responsibility.
• Opportunity to influence the company's global asset strategy and commercial growth.
• International collaboration with teams across Asia, Europe and the United States.
• Performance-oriented remuneration and strong career growth opportunities.
• Opportunity to contribute to building the next generation of an AI-enabled pharmaceutical
company.


We are looking for people who “dare to care” — individuals who combine scientific curiosity,
commercial excellence and the ambition to create meaningful impact in healthcare.

description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION 
NVPC is the national agency dedicated to growing a culture of volunteerism and philanthropy in Singapore. By engaging individuals, organisations, communities and leaders across the people, private and public sectors, we seek to create a more caring, inclusive, and compassionate society. Together, we envision Singapore as a City of Good, where everyone is able to give every day and everywhere (3Es), contributing their time, talent, treasure, ties and testimony (5Ts). Learn more at nvpc.org.sg. 
RESPONSIBILITIES 
This role sits in NVPC's Corporate and Industry Partnerships (CIP) department, which drives the Company of Good (COG) initiative — a national platform that supports and recognises companies in Singapore to integrate purpose and social impact into their core business strategies. 
Today, there are over 1,000 recognised Companies of Good, helping businesses translate purpose into action across five key impact areas: People, Society, Governance, Environment, and Economic. 
As the anchor for this work, NVPC's CIP department plays a pivotal role in shaping and strengthening Singapore's corporate purpose ecosystem — catalysing partnerships and collective impact, with the business community as a driving force for a stronger Singapore. 
We are now seeking a purpose-driven and impact-led individual to help advance this national momentum — where both meaningful programme delivery and growing awareness of COG will increasingly become key levers for scaling impact. 
In this role, you will support the design, execution and evaluation of programmes and platforms that encourage companies to give and volunteer more, as they embed purpose and impact into how they operate. 
Your core work will centre on three key areas: (1) strengthening corporate capabilities in social impact, (2) building and growing the Company of Good community, and (3) scaling impact programmes. 
This role works closely with colleagues across CIP to understand what companies are experiencing on the ground, and uses that insight to continuously refine our programmes — ensuring the overall Company of Good journey for firms remains relevant and valuable, not just individual initiatives in isolation. 
Strengthen Corporate Capabilities in Social Impact 

- Support the planning and delivery of our leadership development programmes — spanning different leadership audiences — to enable organisations to volunteer and/or donate better - as one reflection of corporates' purpose journeys
- Proactively cultivate new leads through targeted publicity and peer referrals
- Follow through (and improve) processes that will create powerful and valuable experiences for participants  
Build and Grow the Community 

- Support the design and facilitation of community-building and engagement efforts within the Company of Good ecosystem e.g. peer learning, networking events, and platforms for programme alumni to connect, share, and deepen their contributions
- Support the development and implementation of community engagement and growth strategies  
Scale Impact Programmes 

- Support the planning and delivery of NVPC's flagship corporate volunteering programme and ensure it remains relevant to corporates
- Cultivate potential leads and enable corporates to participate in our volunteering programme
- Respond to and fulfil requests from corporates seeking support in their corporate volunteering journey
- Gather insights and feedback from existing partners to identify opportunities to strengthen programme design, delivery and impact   QUALIFICATIONS 

- Bachelor's Degree in Business, Communications, Social Sciences, or a related discipline
- ACTA or WSQ Advanced Certificate in Learning and Performance (ACLP) qualification is advantageous
- Experience in managing multiple concurrent projects and working across different departments and teams
- Comfortable forging and growing corporate partnerships to deepen organisations' engagement with NVPC
- Ability to gather and synthesise input from colleagues and stakeholders to inform programme design and improvement, rather than working in a silo
- A collaborative mindset; experience in partnerships and stakeholder engagement is an advantage
- Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing
- Comfortable navigating ambiguity and uncertainty while keeping an eye on outcomes
- Exposure to ESG, sustainability, or social and community impact initiatives is an advantage   Please note that your application will be sent to and reviewed by the direct employer - National Volunteer & Philanthropy Centre

title: Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships
description:

title: Senior Manager, Distributor Management (SEA & Emerging Markets)
categories: Sporting Goods Manufacturing, Performing Arts and Spectator Sports, and Retail
description:
Note: While this role is listed as being based in Singapore, we are also open to candidates based in Bangkok or other key locations across Southeast Asia.


About JOOLA
JOOLA is a globally recognised table tennis and pickleball brand with an expanding presence across Asia-Pacific. With over 70 years of heritage in racket sports and a strong commitment to innovation, we create products and experiences for players at every level - from everyday enthusiasts to elite athletes competing at the highest levels of the sport.


As JOOLA continues to grow, so do the opportunities for our people. Our expanding regional business offers exposure across markets, functions and cultures, as well as the chance to take on broader responsibilities and help build new capabilities. We want our people to develop alongside the organisation by deepening their expertise, broadening their experience and taking on new challenges as opportunities emerge.


We combine the energy and ownership of an entrepreneurial environment with the ambition of a global brand. At JOOLA, you will be encouraged to contribute ideas, work across boundaries and make a visible impact - not only within your role, but also on the next stage of our growth.


Our global headquarters is based in the United States, and our Asia-Pacific headquarters is based in Singapore.


Take your Next Step with JOOLA
As part of our continued growth across Asia Pacific, we are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Senior Manager, Distributor (SEA & Emerging Markets) to lead the development and growth of JOOLA’s distributor-led markets across Southeast Asia and Emerging Markets.


This role will drive the commercial performance and long-term development of the assigned market portfolio, working with distribution partners and regional teams to strengthen JOOLA’s market presence, develop channels and build scalable commercial capabilities that support the Company’s long-term growth ambitions across APAC.


The role requires a commercially minded leader who can operate across markets of different maturity, balance strategy with execution, and lead effectively through both external partners and internal stakeholders. Success in this role will be measured by the sustainable growth and commercial performance of the assigned markets, effective development of distribution partners and channels, and progress against JOOLA’s strategic market priorities.


As a key Commercial leader for APAC, you will play a pivotal role in developing markets, strengthening strategic partnerships and evolving JOOLA’s route-to-market as the business scales, while building the commercial foundations that support the next phase of the Company’s regional expansion.


Key Responsibilities


1. Market Strategy & Development

- Develop and execute multi-year commercial strategies and annual business plans for assigned markets, aligned with APAC priorities
- Assess market potential, competitive dynamics and consumer and channel trends to identify growth opportunities and investment priorities
- Develop market-specific route-to-market strategies and recommend how JOOLA’s commercial model should evolve as markets grow and mature
- Identify opportunities across categories, channels and strategic accounts to expand JOOLA’s presence and build sustainable market leadership


2. Commercial & Financial Performance

- Own revenue delivery and overall commercial performance across the assigned market portfolio
- Establish targets and commercial priorities, monitor performance and drive corrective actions where required
- Evaluate growth opportunities and commercial investments based on business impact and return
- Develop strong understanding and ownership of market-level P&L drivers, including revenue, margin, investment and cost-to-serve


3. Distributor Leadership & Capability

- Lead JOOLA’s commercial relationships with distribution partners, establishing clear business objectives, expectations and performance standards
- Drive structured business planning and performance reviews covering growth, inventory, channel development and key commercial priorities
- Strengthen distributor capabilities in commercial planning, forecasting, inventory management and market execution
- Evaluate partner effectiveness and identify new or alternative distribution partners where required to support JOOLA’s long-term market development


4. Channel, Product & Commercial Execution

- Develop appropriate channel and assortment strategies based on market maturity, consumer needs and JOOLA’s brand objectives
- Lead distributor readiness and commercial execution for key product launches and seasonal initiatives
- Drive pricing, trade-term and channel discipline in line with JOOLA’s regional commercial framework
- Partner with regional eCommerce expertise to integrate marketplaces and digital commerce appropriately within overall market strategies
- Monitor sell-in, sell-through, inventory and market performance to identify opportunities and proactively address business risks


5. Cross-Functional Leadership

- Act as the commercial lead for assigned markets, aligning regional functions and distribution partners around agreed market priorities
- Translate market needs and opportunities into clear commercial priorities while ensuring effective execution across relevant functions
- Provide structured market insights and recommendations to support regional decision-making, resource allocation and future growth


What We’re Looking For

- 10+ years of progressive commercial experience across sales, business development, general management, distributor management or related commercial functions
- Demonstrated experience leading multi-market distributor or partner-led businesses, ideally across Southeast Asia and/or Emerging Markets
- Strong track record of delivering revenue growth while developing markets, channels and long-term commercial capabilities
- Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience in business planning, P&L drivers, route-to-market, forecasting and inventory management
- Strong strategic judgement, with the ability to assess opportunities, set priorities and make sound commercial decisions in complex or developing markets
- Strong leadership, negotiation and influencing skills, with the ability to lead effectively across external partners and cross-functional stakeholders
- Experience in sporting goods, consumer products, footwear, apparel, lifestyle or other brand-led industries is preferred; working knowledge of eCommerce and marketplace business models is an advantage


Why Join Us?
At JOOLA, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of your work and make a meaningful contribution. As part of a growing business, you will be able to learn, take on new challenges and develop your career.


Our core values define how we work together towards our brand promise:

- Innovation - We approach challenges with curiosity and initiative. We take responsibility for solving problems and look for better ways to serve our customers and strengthen our business.
- Inspiration - We bring a champion mindset to our work. We set high standards, pursue meaningful goals and continually seek to improve.
- Inclusion - We work collaboratively, communicate openly and treat one another with respect. We value the different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives across our teams and markets.


Our Commitment to Inclusion
JOOLA is committed to maintaining an inclusive and respectful workplace. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates and make employment decisions based on the requirements of the role, relevant experience, demonstrated capabilities and organisational needs, in accordance with applicable local employment laws.

title: Business Development
description:
Senior Business Development Manager – Pharma

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Business Development Manager to join a growing pharmaceutical business and play a key role in expanding its portfolio across the ASEAN region.

This is a highly commercial and externally-facing role, focused on identifying and securing in-licensing opportunities, strategic partnerships and multi-country deals across ASEAN. You will work closely with pharmaceutical and biotech companies to identify the right assets, understand their commercial potential and ultimately position the business as the right partner to bring these products successfully to market.

This is not simply a licensing role. We are looking for someone who can build relationships, originate opportunities and sell the broader value proposition of the organisation — including its ability to commercialise, launch and scale pharmaceutical products across multiple ASEAN markets.

Key Responsibilities



- Identify, source and evaluate in-licensing opportunities across pharmaceutical and biotech companies, with a particular focus on assets with potential across ASEAN.
- Build and maintain relationships with pharma, biotech and asset owners, acting as a senior external representative of the business.
- Lead the end-to-end BD process from opportunity identification and partner engagement through to negotiation, deal structuring and execution.
- Develop and negotiate multi-country licensing, distribution, co-promotion and strategic partnership agreements.
- Clearly articulate the company's commercialisation capabilities, market access, regulatory expertise, local market infrastructure and route-to-market strategy across ASEAN.
- Engage potential partners at senior levels and effectively communicate why the company is the right commercial partner for their assets.
- Work closely with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Market Access and Finance teams to assess the feasibility and commercial attractiveness of new opportunities.
- Develop business cases covering market potential, competitive landscape, pricing, investment requirements, revenue opportunity and commercial strategy.
- Lead commercial due diligence and support internal investment and portfolio decisions.
- Monitor emerging pharmaceutical trends, competitor activity and portfolio gaps to identify new partnership opportunities.

What We're Looking For



- Strong experience in Business Development, Licensing, Alliance Management or Corporate Development within the pharmaceutical industry.
- Demonstrated experience in in-licensing pharmaceutical products/assets, ideally across multiple therapeutic areas.
- Proven experience managing or negotiating regional or multi-country deals, rather than purely single-market transactions.
- Strong network and relationships across pharma and biotech companies, particularly within Asia and/or internationally.
- Commercially minded and comfortable engaging externally with senior stakeholders, including BD, Licensing, Commercial and C-suite executives.
- Able to sell a compelling story around what the organisation can do for a partner and how it can successfully commercialise an asset across ASEAN.
- Strong understanding of pharmaceutical commercialisation, including market access, regulatory considerations, pricing, distribution and launch strategy.
- Comfortable managing complex, cross-functional deal processes and translating market opportunity into a compelling business case.
- Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to represent the company in external meetings and industry discussions.
- Excellent communication skills in English; additional ASEAN or Asian language capabilities would be advantageous. 

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to take a highly visible regional BD role within a growing pharmaceutical organisation, with significant scope to shape the company's external partnerships and future product portfolio across ASEAN.

You will have the opportunity to originate deals, build senior-level relationships and play a direct role in bringing new pharmaceutical products into the region, while helping shape the company's broader commercialisation strategy.

Email Jodie at Jodie@barringtonjames.com

title: Business Development Director
categories: Financial Services and Appliances, Electrical, and Electronics Manufacturing
description:
Newland NPT is looking for a Business Development Director to drive business expansion across the APAC region, with a particular focus on developing the ISV ecosystem and accelerating growth in the unattended payment segment. Based in Singapore and reporting directly to the Regional General Manager, APAC, this position requires regular travel across the region, depending on business needs.


This role is well suited for a proactive and commercially driven professional who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys engaging with customers and partners, and excels at building long-term, trusted relationships across the APAC market.


Key Responsibilities



- Drive business development initiatives across the APAC region, with a strong focus on expanding the ISV ecosystem and growing the unattended payment business, particularly within the vending segment.
- Identify and develop strategic partnerships and customer opportunities in the vending and unattended space, and build strong relationships with key industry stakeholders to accelerate market penetration.
- Develop and execute a comprehensive ISV strategy across APAC, systematically engaging and growing the ISV network and establishing it as a dedicated business vertical for the region.
- Collaborate closely with Visa, Mastercard and other ecosystem partners to generate new leads, drive joint business opportunities, and strengthen Newland NPT's presence across the payments value chain.
- Develop and implement effective go-to-market and growth strategies to achieve business objectives, including pipeline development, revenue forecasting and regular business reviews with management.
- Work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver customer solutions, resolve escalated issues, and ensure seamless collaboration across internal and external stakeholders.
- Represent Newland NPT in industry events and partner engagements, contribute to brand building, and strengthen strategic relationships throughout the APAC region.


Key Requirements



- Bachelor’s degree or above, a degree in in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or other related disciplines is preferred.
- Minimum15years of experience in the payments industry, with a strong background in business development, strategic partnerships, or ecosystem development across the APAC region.
- Solid understanding of the payments ecosystem, particularly in areas such as ISVs, acquiring, unattended payments, vending, POS solutions, and related technologies.
- Experience working with key industry stakeholders, including card schemes, acquirers, ISVs, payment service providers, or channel partners. Existing relationships with Visa, Mastercard, or major ecosystem players would be an advantage.
- Strong commercial acumen and the ability to develop and execute go-to-market strategies, with experience in building new business verticals considered a plus.
- Self-motivated and results-oriented, with excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to collaborate effectively across functions and cultures.
- Willingness to travel regularly across the APAC region, depending on business requirements.
- Fluent in English. Proficiency in Mandarin or other Asian languages would be an advantage.

title: Strategic AI, NeoClouds & NVIDIA Business Development Lead
description:
About The Job

DDN is seeking a highly connected, commercially oriented Director of AI Sales to accelerate growth across APAC through strategic collaboration with NVIDIA, AI infrastructure providers, Neoclouds/NVIDIA Cloud Partners (NCPs), and the broader AI technology ecosystem.

This role will be reporting to worldwide vice president of NCP & AI Native sales and serve as the primary regional connector between DDN's APAC Sales organization, NVIDIA's regional sales and technical teams, key Neocloud/NCP partners, and DDN's NVIDIA headquarters organization. The Director will build relationships, identify opportunities, create alignment across organizations, and help DDN gain earlier and more strategic participation in major AI infrastructure opportunities.

This is primarily a business development and relationship leadership role, with approximately 80% of the focus on ecosystem engagement, relationship development, opportunity creation, and field collaboration, and 20% on technical fluency and solution positioning.

What Will You Do

NVIDIA Regional Engagement



-  Build and maintain strong relationships with NVIDIA sales, business development, solution architecture, and ecosystem teams across APAC.
-  Establish DDN as a trusted infrastructure partner for NVIDIA field teams pursuing strategic AI opportunities.
-  Connect DDN account teams with the appropriate NVIDIA sales and technical resources and identify NVIDIA-influenced opportunities early.
-  Work closely with DDN's NVIDIA HQ team to navigate NVIDIA organizational structures, executive relationships, technical influencers, and decision-makers.
-  Ensure regional intelligence and field activity are connected back to DDN's broader global NVIDIA strategy.

Neocloud & NCP Development



-  Identify and develop relationships with Neoclouds, GPU cloud providers, NVIDIA Cloud Partners, sovereign AI providers, and emerging AI infrastructure companies across APAC.
-  Map key decision-makers, technical influencers, investors, customers, and ecosystem relationships surrounding priority AI infrastructure providers.
-  Connect DDN field teams to emerging Neocloud/NCP opportunities and help coordinate multi-party pursuit strategies.
-  Identify expansion opportunities within established AI infrastructure customers and new opportunities with emerging providers.
-  Help DDN understand where GPU capacity is being deployed across APAC and which organizations are likely to become important future AI infrastructure buyers.

Regional AI Business Development



-  Serve as a business development overlay to DDN's APAC sales organization for strategic AI opportunities.
-  Collaborate with Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Strategic AI sellers, partner teams, and regional leadership on account and opportunity strategies.
-  Create connections across customers, NVIDIA, Neoclouds, technology partners, and DDN resources that improve DDN's ability to win.
-  Develop account and ecosystem maps for priority AI opportunities and support executive meetings, partner engagements, and strategic pursuits.
-  Identify emerging trends, companies, workloads, and investment patterns that should influence DDN's regional strategy.

AI Ecosystem & Technology Partnerships



-  Identify ISVs and technology partners that are becoming influential in AI infrastructure buying decisions.
-  Work with DDN's ISV and Technical Alliances organization to develop relationships and joint motions with priority software and platform partners.
-  Understand where orchestration, data platforms, inference technologies, AI frameworks, and security platforms influence infrastructure decisions.

Technical & Solution Fluency



-  Maintain working knowledge of DDN's AI infrastructure portfolio and its role in GPU-intensive environments.
-  Understand at a high level how storage, networking, data movement, GPU utilization, training, inference, checkpointing, and AI data pipelines affect infrastructure architecture.
-  Understand NVIDIA's major AI infrastructure architectures, platforms, and ecosystem motions sufficiently to identify where DDN adds value.
-  Recognize when deeper technical engagement is required and bring the appropriate DDN Solution Engineering, Solution Architecture, Field CTO, Product, or Engineering resources into the opportunity.
-  Translate technical differentiation into customer and partner business value.

GEOGRAPHIC SCOPE

The role will cover APAC and requires the ability to operate across highly diverse markets, cultures, business practices, and stages of AI infrastructure adoption. The successful candidate will prioritize markets with significant GPU investment, Neocloud activity, sovereign AI initiatives, hyperscale infrastructure development, and AI-native company formation. Frequent travel throughout the region and close collaboration across time zones will be expected.

What Will You Bring



- 10+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, business development, alliances, AI infrastructure, cloud, data infrastructure, or related markets.
- Strong track record of developing executive and field relationships across complex technology ecosystems.
- Demonstrated ability to create opportunities through relationships and ecosystem engagement rather than relying solely on traditional direct selling.
- Experience working collaboratively with field sales and technical organizations.
- Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure and the evolving AI technology ecosystem.
- Ability to engage credibly with sales executives, technical leaders, partners, customers, and senior executives.
- Excellent executive communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills; ability to operate independently in an entrepreneurial environment.

Preferred Experience



- Existing relationships within NVIDIA or the NVIDIA partner ecosystem.
- Experience with Neoclouds, GPU cloud providers, NCPs, hyperscalers, AI infrastructure companies, or AI-native organizations.
- Experience with GPU infrastructure, HPC, high-performance storage, networking, cloud infrastructure, or AI data platforms.
- Familiarity with NVIDIA DGX, SuperPOD, reference architectures, accelerated computing, and AI infrastructure concepts.
- Experience working with AI software vendors, data platforms, orchestration technologies, or emerging accelerator providers.
- Experience developing business across multiple APAC markets.
- Native Chinese language proficiency would be a beneficial thought not mandatory.

LEADERSHIP CHARACTERISTICS



- Relationship Builder - creates trusted connections across organizations and turns relationships into productive engagement.
- Ecosystem Thinker - understands how customers, GPU providers, Neoclouds, ISVs, integrators, and infrastructure vendors interact.
- Commercially Oriented - connects ecosystem activity to pipeline, customer access, competitive advantage, and revenue.
- Technically Credible - understands AI infrastructure sufficiently to identify opportunity and engage the right technical resources.
- Highly Collaborative - makes regional sales and technical teams more successful rather than competing with them.
- Entrepreneurial and Externally Focused - seeks emerging opportunities and spends significant time in the market building DDN's presence.
- Culturally Agile - operates effectively across the diverse business environments that make up APAC.

MEASURES OF SUCCESS



- Strength and breadth of DDN's relationships with NVIDIA teams across APAC.
- NVIDIA-influenced and ecosystem-influenced pipeline creation.
- Number and quality of joint DDN/NVIDIA customer engagements.
- Identification and development of priority Neocloud/NCP relationships.
- Earlier DDN engagement in strategic AI infrastructure opportunities.
- Increased connectivity between DDN regional sellers and NVIDIA field teams.
- Expansion of DDN's relationships across the broader AI technology ecosystem.
- Strategic intelligence provided to DDN leadership regarding emerging AI customers, partners, workloads, and market shifts.

title: (Senior) Development Partner, SMEC, Partner

title: Associate, Global Partnerships Manager I
description:
Secretlab is an international gaming chair brand seating over 3 million users worldwide, with our key markets in the United States, Europe and Singapore, where we are headquartered.

- Intrapreneurial thinking – take pride in your work, be driven, versatile, initiative and result orientated.
- Outstanding interpersonal and relationship building skills.
- Effective presentation and preparation of decks (Google Slides, Powerpoint, etc.)
- Able to work independently with initiative, and a strong team player.
- Excellent communication and people skills

title: Senior Assistant Director, Chinese Executive Education Partnerships
categories: Higher Education, Education Administration Programs, and Government Administration
description:
Nanyang Business School (NBS), Nanyang Technological University (NTU), is seeking a Senior Assistant Director (Business Development – Joint Executive Education) to support the growth of its executive education portfolio through collaborative programmes with partner universities.

Based within the ASEAN & China Programmes Office, this role focuses on co‑developing and delivering joint executive education programmes with selected partner institutions, primarily in China and selected international markets. The role complements existing open‑enrolment executive education activities by strengthening NBS’ institution‑to‑institution partnerships.

Key Responsibilities Include, But Not Limited To The Following

Joint Executive Education Programme Development (Partner Universities)



- Drive the origination, assessment, and development of joint executive education programme opportunities with partner universities, primarily in China.
- Lead collaboration with academic directors and faculty from NTU and partner institutions to define joint programme themes, target audiences, and delivery formats that align academic excellence with market demand.
- Lead engagement with partner universities on programme structuring, positioning, branding, and delivery arrangements to ensure alignment of academic, commercial, and institutional objectives.

Partner University Relationship Management



- Serve as the primary working‑level contact for designated partner universities on joint EE initiatives.
- Maintain regular engagement to ensure alignment on programme objectives, timelines, and expectations.
- Facilitate resolution of operational or coordination issues during programme development and delivery.

Commercial Structuring and Financial Viability of Joint Programmes



- Lead the commercial structuring of joint executive education programmes, including pricing strategy, cost-sharing models, and revenue frameworks, in alignment with ACP leadership and institutional objectives.
- Drive financial viability assessments for joint programmes, working with finance and operations teams to ensure sustainable and scalable programme delivery models that meet revenue targets.
- Oversee financial and participation performance of joint programmes, identifying optimisation opportunities and recommending strategic adjustments to improve commercial outcomes. 

Programme Design Input and Market Relevance



- Shape the design and positioning of joint executive education programmes by translating market intelligence, client needs, and industry trends into strategic curriculum direction.
- Lead engagement with academic directors to ensure joint executive education programmes reflect emerging global themes, including internationalisation, leadership development, and geopolitical dynamics.
- Drive continuous curriculum refinement by synthesising participant and partner feedback into actionable programme enhancements that strengthen market relevance and differentiation.

Internal Collaboration and Team Contribution



- Lead cross-functional coordination across academic directors, marketing, finance, operations, and programme teams to ensure effective development and delivery of joint executive education programmes.
- Provide strategic pipeline analysis and partner intelligence to ACP leadership to inform portfolio planning, prioritisation, and growth strategy.
- Lead capability development by codifying and disseminating best practices in partnership-based executive education programme development across teams. 

Key Competencies And Qualification Requirements



- Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred.
- Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience in business development, executive education, programme development, partnerships, stakeholder engagement, or professional services roles.
- Strong understanding of executive education and senior leadership development, with the ability to translate market and client needs into programme and partnership strategies.
