title: Business Development Manager - HPE Networking
location: Kallang, Central Singapore Community Development Council, Singapore
description:
Who We Are

Shape how technology reaches the world.

Technology moves fast. So do we.

At Ingram Micro, we help businesses grow through technology. Together with HPE, we’re helping partners build what’s next across AI, cloud, networking, and infrastructure.

This is not a place where you sit on the sidelines. You’ll work with people across countries, partners, and technologies while helping shape one of our biggest global partnerships.

How Our Team Works

The HPE team moves quickly, works closely together, and spends a lot of time helping partners solve real business challenges.

No two days look exactly the same. One moment you’re helping a partner grow their cloud business, the next you’re working with marketing or technical teams on a new opportunity.

People who enjoy ownership, visibility, and building relationships will thrive here.

Our values in action

We like people who bring ideas, energy, and curiosity.

You don’t need to have every answer on day one. What matters most is being proactive, collaborative, and willing to keep learning. Around here, people grow by getting involved, speaking up, and taking opportunities when they appear.

What You Will Do



- Grow HPE partner relationships and business opportunities
- Responsible for driving HPE Networking GTM strategy, partner development and revenue growth across SMB and Commercial segments. 
- Own the distributor-level business plan, including portfolio growth, partner activation, sales enablement and pipeline development. 
- Work closely with HPE, resellers, sales teams and internal functions to identify and execute growth opportunities. 
- Focus on business development and commercial growth, while working with Product Management and Operations teams on pricing, inventory, supply and product lifecycle matters. 
- Track business performance and provide regular updates on revenue, pipeline, margin, partner growth and key initiatives. 
- Use insights and market data to support smart business decisions
- Lead competitive and market intelligence to identify growth opportunities and strengthen HPE Networking positioning. 
- Joint business planning and business engagement with HPE, including quarterly priorities, programs, incentives. 

What You Bring To The Role



- Experience in business development, sales, channel management or IT distribution. 
- Basic knowledge of HPE, networking and partner ecosystems. 
- Strong commercial and business development mindset. 
- Good communication and relationship-building skills. 
- Ability to identify new opportunities and drive business growth. 
- Comfortable working with sales targets, pipeline and revenue. 
- Good teamwork and stakeholder management skills. 
- Proactive, organised and willing to learn. 
- Able to work independently and manage multiple priorities. 

Your growth with us

At Ingram Micro, growth comes through visibility, collaboration, and taking initiative. You’ll work with global teams, partner directly with HPE, and help shape one of our most strategic technology partnerships. Let’s shape tomorrow.

title: Commercial Operations Analyst (Americas)
description:
General Description

Commercially-minded Commercial Operations Analyst to support business development, shipping operations and commercial decision-making from our Singapore office.

The role combines shipping market analysis, operational and fixture-related data, client intelligence and business analytics to identify opportunities, monitor performance and support client-facing teams across Asia and the Americas. The position is collaborative and client-facing, requiring strong interpersonal skills, sound judgement and the ability to engage effectively across cultures and seniority levels.

Given the Americas focus, the role requires regular overlap with Americas business hours, flexibility outside standard Singapore office hours, and periodic travel. Fluency in English and Spanish is required, with Spanish supporting commercial engagement across Latin America and the wider Americas.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Commercial & Shipping Analytics

Analyse vessel, fleet and market data to identify commercial opportunities and trends.

Monitor shipowners, managers, operators, charterers, newbuildings, S&P activity and fleet movements.

Analyze client portfolios, flag composition, registration opportunities, pipelines and fleet performance.

Support client acquisition, fleet expansion and retention through market-share and competitor analysis.

Develop forecasts, KPIs and management reporting.

Analyze regulatory, inspection and Port State Control data where commercially relevant.

Operations, Fixtures &Post-Fixture

Support analysis of vessel employment, fixtures and operational performance.

Track voyages, vessel activity, cargo movements and client fleets.

Assist with post-fixture analysis, including performance, costs, documentation and commercial follow-up.

Monitor vessel and trade activity across Asia, North America, the US Gulf, Caribbean and Latin America.

Prepare vessel, fleet and client briefs for commercial discussions.

Data Analytics &Business Intelligence

Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, Excel models and commercial reporting tools.

Clean, combine and validate data from internal systems and external maritime databases.

Automate recurring reports and analytical processes where practical.

Use Salesforce or similar CRM platforms for pipeline analysis, segmentation and commercial prioritization.

Present analytical findings clearly to management and commercial stakeholders.

Market Intelligence &Client Support

Monitor shipping activity across Asia and the Americas.

Research shipowners, managers, operators, charterers and other industry participants.

Track newbuildings, ownership and management changes and other events that may create commercial opportunities.

Analyze fleet developments and trading patterns across the Americas.

Support engagement with US and Latin American maritime stakeholders.

Prepare client profiles, fleet analyses, presentations and commercial proposals.

Visit client offices, vessels and other operational premises as required to support commercial relationships and gain direct insight into client operations.

Travel periodically within Asia and to the Americas for client meetings and industry events.

General Qualification Guidelines

Bachelor's degree or equivalent.

Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience in shipping, maritime services, commercial analytics or vessel operations.

Strong proficiency in Excel and Power BI and experience with complex datasets.

Familiarity with Salesforce and maritime data sources such as S&P Global/IHS, Waypoint, Clarksons or AIS platforms is advantageous.

Understanding of shipping operations, vessel terminology and fixture/post-fixture processes.

Knowledge of the Americas shipping market, including fleet developments and key maritime stakeholders, is highly desirable.

Familiarity with US and Latin American maritime regulatory and commercial environments is advantageous.

Experience with forecasting, automation or APIs is beneficial.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Strong analytical and commercial judgement.

Ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights.

Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence, with the ability to build rapport and read situations effectively.

Confidence engaging with stakeholders across cultures and seniority levels.

Strong attention to detail, communication and presentation skills.

Ability to work independently and take ownership.

Comfortable working across commercial, operational and technical teams.

Flexibility to maintain regular overlap with business hours in the Americas and travel internationally as required.

The role requires regular working-hour overlap with North and Latin American time zones, including early-morning and/or evening hours in Singapore where required. Periodic travel to the Americas and within Asia, including visits to client premises, vessels and industry events, will form part of the role.

title: JUNIOR COMMODITY TRADER
description:
Essential Language Requirement — Please Read Before Applying

*Working proficiency in both English and Mandarin is mandatory for this position.*

The successful candidate must be able to:

* Conduct business conversations, meetings and commercial discussions confidently in both English and Mandarin.
* Read and understand business correspondence, quotations, product specifications and commercial documents in both languages.
* Write clear and professional emails and messages in both English and Mandarin.
* Communicate directly with counterparties in China and Taiwan who conduct their business communications primarily in Mandarin.

*Candidates who are unable to conduct business communications in both English and Mandarin will not meet the essential requirements of this position. Language proficiency will be assessed during the interview process.*

About Sherman Mineral Trading

Sherman Mineral Trading is an international commodity trading company focused on supporting the metals, mining and mineral-processing industries.

Our trading activities include sulphur, sulphuric acid, nickel-related products, battery materials and other industrial commodities. We work with producers, suppliers, customers and business partners across Asia, the Middle East and other international markets.

Position Overview

We are seeking a bilingual, commercially astute, resourceful and highly motivated Junior Commodity Trader to join our Singapore team.

The successful candidate will support the full physical commodity trading cycle—from market research, supplier sourcing and business development to commercial negotiation, contract execution, shipping coordination and payment follow-up.

This is a hands-on commercial position requiring strong situational awareness, practical judgement and the confidence to communicate with suppliers, customers, banks, shipping companies and internal stakeholders.

We are looking for someone who is not only academically capable, but also practical, adaptable and commercially alert. The candidate must be able to understand people and situations, identify what is important, ask intelligent questions and respond appropriately without requiring detailed instructions at every stage.

Key ResponsibilitiesTrading and Business Development

* Support the sourcing, purchase and sale of sulphur, sulphuric acid, nickel-related products, battery materials and other industrial commodities.
* Identify and develop potential suppliers, customers, traders and strategic business partners in international markets.
* Communicate directly with counterparties in English and Mandarin to obtain quotations, product specifications, available quantities, shipment schedules and payment terms.
* Prepare commercial comparisons covering price, product quality, logistics, financing costs, payment risks and expected trading margins.
* Support senior management during negotiations, meetings and commercial discussions.
* Follow up actively with counterparties and maintain momentum until each opportunity reaches a clear outcome.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of trading leads, quotations, negotiations and outstanding action items.
* Assist in preparing commercial proposals, presentations and management updates.

Market Intelligence

* Monitor commodity prices, regional supply and demand, freight rates, port conditions and relevant geopolitical and industry developments.
* Prepare concise market updates and highlight developments that may affect pricing, supply availability, logistics or trading strategy.
* Verify market information through multiple credible sources instead of accepting unconfirmed statements at face value.
* Develop a practical understanding of major producers, traders, customers, shipping routes and end-use industries.
* Identify new business opportunities and promptly escalate commercially significant information to management.
* Distinguish actionable market intelligence from rumours, promotional claims and unreliable information.

Trade Execution

* Coordinate with operations, finance, banks, customers, suppliers, brokers, surveyors, shipping agents and other service providers to ensure smooth trade execution.
* Review commercial terms, product specifications, contracts, invoices, letters of credit and shipping documents for accuracy and consistency.
* Track important milestones, including contract execution, payment, vessel nomination, loading, documentation, arrival, discharge and final settlement.
* Anticipate potential delays, discrepancies or execution risks and raise them early, together with practical proposed solutions.
* Ensure that commitments, deadlines and management instructions are accurately recorded and followed through.
* Support the resolution of operational, documentation and payment discrepancies.

Counterparty Assessment and Risk Control

* Conduct preliminary due diligence on prospective suppliers, customers and intermediaries.
* Check company registration information, ownership, operating history, website and email authenticity, product origin, trading record and commercial references.
* Recognise warning signs such as unrealistic pricing, unclear product origin, inconsistent documents, unusual advance-payment requests or reluctance to provide verifiable information.
* Support sanctions screening, compliance checks and internal approval processes.
* Escalate material commercial, credit, documentation or counterparty risks promptly.
* Protect the company’s commercial interests and confidential information at all times.

Relationship and Stakeholder Management

* Build professional and constructive relationships with internal and external stakeholders from different countries, cultures and seniority levels.
* Communicate tactfully and confidently when seeking clarification, correcting misunderstandings, negotiating terms or following up on overdue matters.
* Understand the priorities and sensitivities of different stakeholders and adjust communication appropriately.
* Represent Sherman Mineral Trading professionally during meetings, business meals, conferences, site visits and overseas travel.
* Prepare clear bilingual meeting notes, action lists and follow-up communications when required.
* Maintain professionalism and composure when dealing with difficult, sensitive or fast-moving situations.

Required Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, Maritime Studies, Engineering or a related discipline.
* One to three years of relevant experience in commodity trading, international trade, shipping, logistics, banking, procurement or business development is preferred.
* Strong fresh graduates with relevant internship experience, commercial maturity and demonstrated initiative may also be considered.
* Strong numerical ability and proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Outlook.
* Basic understanding of international trade, shipping documents, payment terms and letters of credit is preferred.
* Willingness to travel internationally and attend occasional business engagements outside normal office hours.

Mandatory Language Proficiency

* Strong spoken and written English.
* Strong spoken and written Mandarin.
* Ability to conduct commercial conversations and prepare professional business correspondence in both languages.
* Ability to read Mandarin quotations, commercial correspondence, specifications and other business documents.
* Language proficiency will be tested during the selection process.

Essential Personal Qualities

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

* *Commercial awareness:* Understands how price, quality, logistics, financing, timing and counterparty risk affect profitability.
* *Situational awareness:* Notices important details, reads situations appropriately and understands the wider commercial context.
* *Practical judgement:* Distinguishes urgent or material matters from routine issues and knows when to act independently or escalate.
* *Resourcefulness:* Looks for practical solutions and alternative approaches when facing obstacles.
* *Initiative:* Follows through without repeated reminders and takes appropriate action without waiting to be directed at every stage.
* *Interpersonal maturity:* Communicates appropriately with senior executives, colleagues, customers and suppliers.
* *Intellectual curiosity:* Asks thoughtful questions and seeks to understand the reasons behind instructions and decisions.
* *Learning agility:* Learns quickly from experience and feedback and does not repeatedly make the same mistake.
* *Attention to detail:* Carefully checks prices, specifications, quantities, dates, payment terms and documentation.
* *Resilience:* Remains composed and effective in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.
* *Integrity:* Handles confidential information responsibly and communicates facts accurately.
* *Ownership:* Accepts personal responsibility for assignments from initiation through completion.
* *Commercial confidence:* Is comfortable speaking with unfamiliar parties, asking direct questions and following up persistently but professionally.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Junior Commodity Trader will:

* Provide management with timely, accurate and commercially useful information.
* Communicate effectively with counterparties in both English and Mandarin.
* Follow up consistently and close action items without constant supervision.
* Identify risks, inconsistencies and warning signs before they become serious problems.
* Exercise sound judgement when handling unfamiliar or ambiguous situations.
* Build a dependable network of suppliers, customers and market contacts.
* Progressively manage selected counterparties and trading opportunities independently.
* Contribute positively to Sherman’s culture of *Accuracy, Discipline, Accountability and Commercial Excellence*.

What We Offer

* Direct exposure to international physical commodity trading and senior decision-makers.
* Hands-on involvement in sourcing, negotiation, trade finance, shipping and execution.
* Opportunities to work with major mining, energy and industrial groups.
* Regional and international business exposure.
* Performance-based rewards and career development for employees who demonstrate strong judgement, initiative and results.

Application Requirement

Applicants should submit an English résumé and clearly indicate their level of spoken and written Mandarin proficiency.

Shortlisted candidates should expect part of the interview and practical assessment to be conducted in Mandarin.

Pay: $4,000.00 - $5,200.00 per month

Benefits:
* Professional development

Work Location: In person

About the Role

In this role, you’ll work directly with customers through support tickets and live calls, troubleshooting high-impact issues and resolving novel, often ambiguous technical problems in one of the fastest-moving environments in technology. As AI adoption rapidly accelerates, the work you do will directly support mission-critical systems being built on OpenAI’s platform, serving as a critical line of defense for customers operating at massive scale.

Beyond resolving technical issues, you’ll help define what world-class support looks like in an AGI-driven future. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Operations to improve systems, reduce bugs, and elevate the customer experience, while leveraging automation, agents, and our own AI technology to transform how support operates at scale.

title: Principal Computer Vision Scientist
description:
Sourceability is building a new Global Engineering Organization (GEO) to strengthen internal software delivery, improve production ownership, and build long-term engineering capability inside the company.

We are looking for a Principal Computer Vision Scientist to lead advanced Computer Vision and AI / ML work inside GEO. This role will be responsible for research direction, model architecture, experimentation, model quality, production readiness, and practical implementation of computer vision solutions used in company products.

This is a senior technical leadership role for a highly experienced specialist who can work across research, engineering, product, and production systems. The right candidate should be able to evaluate new approaches, design model architectures, run experiments, improve model quality, and help engineering teams bring AI / ML capabilities into real production workflows.

This role requires PhD-level education and strong hands-on experience in applied Computer Vision, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning. The person in this role should be comfortable working with business-critical systems, practical production constraints, imperfect datasets, and evolving product requirements.

Assigned Product Group

This role will be primarily aligned with the Computer Vision product group inside GEO.

The role may also support other internal product groups or AI / ML initiatives where computer vision, image processing, visual search, object detection, segmentation, classification, or model evaluation expertise is needed.

Product Group Focus Areas

Depending on business priorities, the role may focus on one or more of the following areas:

Mobile App / Computer Vision:

Image capture workflows, mobile application integration, computer vision model development, model inference, warehouse / field usability, user feedback loops, production model quality, and UAT support.

AI / ML Product Features:

Applied machine learning features, model evaluation workflows, proof-of-concepts, model-assisted automation, AI-assisted business tools, and integration of AI / ML capabilities into existing business workflows.

Data and Annotation Workflows:

Image datasets, data quality, annotation requirements, labeling guidelines, model training datasets, validation datasets, failure case analysis, and continuous improvement of model performance.

Production ML Systems:

Model deployment, model versioning, inference performance, monitoring, reproducibility, scalability, reliability, and MLOps practices.

Insight on Your Impact

In this role, you will:

Lead research, design, development, and implementation of Computer Vision and AI / ML solutions.

Define model architecture, technical approach, experiment strategy, validation methodology, and production readiness criteria.

Train, fine-tune, evaluate, optimize, and deploy models for object detection, semantic segmentation, image classification, feature matching, OCR, visual search, and image understanding.

Own the full model lifecycle, including data analysis, dataset quality, annotation requirements, model training, experiment tracking, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Build prototypes, proof-of-concepts, demos, and technical experiments to validate new ideas before full product implementation.

Analyze model performance, identify failure cases, and recommend practical improvements based on data, user behavior, and business needs.

Review and improve existing Computer Vision pipelines, model quality, inference performance, scalability, and production reliability.

Work with software engineers to integrate ML models into production applications and services.

Define standards for model evaluation, model versioning, dataset management, reproducibility, and MLOps practices.

Evaluate research papers, open-source models, AI platforms, and new technologies for potential use in company products.

Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers working on AI / ML and computer vision features.

Support planning and estimation for AI / ML work by clarifying technical complexity, risks, dependencies, and realistic delivery assumptions.

Create technical documentation, model evaluation reports, architecture notes, and recommendations for engineering and product teams.

Partner with Product / Delivery Managers to translate business needs into practical AI / ML implementation plans.

Partner with Engineering Managers, Team Leads / Architects, QA, DevOps, Data, and business stakeholders to make sure AI / ML work can be delivered and supported in production.

Your Qualifications, Your Influence

To be successful in this role, you should have:

PhD in Computer Science, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or closely related technical field.

7+ years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning / Deep Learning, with strong focus on Computer Vision.

Strong practical experience with PyTorch and / or TensorFlow.

Strong Python development skills.

Experience with OpenCV, NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, and modern Python ML ecosystem.

Deep understanding of classical Computer Vision algorithms and modern deep learning approaches.

Strong experience with object detection, semantic segmentation, image classification, feature matching, image retrieval, and model evaluation.

Experience with modern Computer Vision architectures and techniques, including CNNs, Transformers, Vision Transformers, YOLO, Mask R-CNN, CLIP-like models, SAM-like models, or similar.

Experience bringing ML models into production environments.

Experience with model optimization for inference speed, latency, memory usage, scalability, and reliability.

Experience with REST APIs, Docker, CI / CD, model versioning, experiment tracking, and MLOps practices.

Strong understanding of datasets, data quality, annotation processes, labeling requirements, and model error analysis.

Ability to read, understand, and evaluate technical documentation and research papers in English.

Ability to explain complex technical topics to engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

Experience working in Agile software development environment.

Strong ownership mindset, good judgment, and ability to make practical technical decisions under uncertainty.

Comfortable working in distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones.

Preferred Skills and Technical Familiarity

The following experience will be helpful:

Post-PhD research or industry experience in applied Computer Vision.

Publications, patents, or strong applied research record in Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or AI.

Experience leading technical direction for AI / ML projects.

Experience mentoring ML engineers, software engineers, or data annotation teams.

Experience with edge or mobile inference technologies, including ONNX, TensorRT, OpenVINO, TFLite, CoreML, or similar.

Experience with large-scale image processing pipelines.

Experience with synthetic data generation, active learning, weak supervision, or dataset quality improvement.

Experience with multimodal models, vision-language models, prompt engineering, OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.

Experience with cloud ML platforms and production monitoring of ML models.

Familiarity with mobile applications, warehouse workflows, field operations systems, or image capture workflows.

Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Git, CI / CD tooling, documentation systems, and practical software delivery processes.

Experience in electronic components, technology distribution, supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, e-commerce, or similar B2B environments.

Success in the First 90 Days

Within the first 90 days, the Principal Computer Vision Scientist should be able to:

Understand the relevant product areas, users, business workflows, image capture workflows, datasets, model use cases, and current technical risks.

Establish working relationships with Engineering Managers, Team Leads / Architects, Product / Delivery Managers, engineers, QA, DevOps, Data, and business stakeholders.

Review current Computer Vision and AI / ML work, including models, datasets, evaluation methods, annotation process, production integration, and known quality issues.

Identify the most important model quality risks, data quality gaps, technical debt items, production risks, and maintainability concerns.

Define or improve model evaluation criteria, validation process, dataset requirements, and model readiness expectations.

Help improve technical clarity of the active AI / ML backlog by adding design notes, technical breakdown, dependencies, estimates, and risks.

Lead at least one meaningful model improvement, prototype, evaluation effort, or production risk-reduction activity.

Improve documentation around model architecture, data flows, evaluation results, known limitations, and production behavior.

Create an initial technical roadmap or remediation plan for Computer Vision work aligned with product priorities and engineering capacity.

Help onboard or mentor engineers working on Computer Vision, AI / ML, or related product features.

What This Role Does Not Own

This role does not own formal people management for engineers. Engineering Managers remain responsible for hiring, performance management, compensation input, team structure, and capacity planning.

This role does not own business prioritization or user acceptance. Product / Delivery Managers and business stakeholders remain responsible for intake, priority alignment, backlog readiness, UAT coordination, and business acceptance.

This role does not independently commit delivery dates without alignment with Engineering Managers and Product / Delivery Managers.

This role does not own all AI / ML work across the company unless specifically assigned by GEO leadership. The primary responsibility is Computer Vision technical leadership and production-quality AI / ML implementation for assigned product areas.

This role does not replace Software Architects, DevOps, Data, QA, or Infrastructure ownership. The role will work closely with those teams to make sure Computer Vision solutions are technically sound, production-ready, and supportable.

The position offers a unique blend of analytical rigour, stakeholder engagement, and the chance to work closely with colleagues across Tokyo, London, New York, and Asia. With a supportive team environment, this is your chance to make a significant impact while developing your career within a collaborative and inclusive culture.

Engage directly with clients and internal teams via seminars, webinars, conference calls, and company visits to share insights and foster strong professional relationships.

Benefit from flexible working opportunities within a knowledgeable team that values collaboration, ongoing learning, and personal growth.

What you'll do:

As a Vice President Senior Currency Analyst based in Singapore, you will be at the forefront of delivering high-quality economic research that shapes strategic decisions for both internal stakeholders and external clients worldwide. Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve producing detailed analyses of ASEAN economies—especially focusing on India (INR), Vietnam (VND), and the Philippines (PHP)—and generating regular publications that keep clients informed about market developments. You will collaborate closely with colleagues across multiple regions to contribute to global research pipelines while also engaging directly with customers through various channels such as seminars or webinars. Success in this role requires not only technical expertise but also excellent communication skills for presenting complex information clearly. Your ability to build strong relationships internally and externally will be crucial as you help drive customer satisfaction through insightful analysis.

Produce comprehensive research reports on ASEAN economic trends and foreign exchange rates with a particular focus on INR, VND, and PHP currencies.

Contribute regularly to daily FX updates, weekly market reviews, and quarterly outlooks as part of the Asia Global Market Research team.

Develop in-depth thematic studies and ad-hoc commentary on economic data releases, policy changes, market events, and currency movements relevant to Southeast Asia.

Create and maintain robust quantitative models for economic indicators and foreign exchange forecasting to support research outputs.

Participate actively in regional and global research initiatives by collaborating with colleagues in Tokyo, London, New York, and other key locations.

Engage with clients through conference calls, seminars, webinars, company visits, and business trips to present research findings and address queries.

Build effective partnerships with sales teams, traders, relationship managers, and other stakeholders to ensure timely responses to market-related questions.

A deep understanding of compliance requirements—particularly those associated with multi-entity operations—is essential given the dual-hat nature of this role. General Manager

and

Managing Director

.

We are looking for someone who can lead engineers, close process loopholes, prevent costly mistakes, control technical documentation and ensure that every product, supplier and department follows one

Company Department Structure

Business Development, including Marketing

Supply Chain

Finance

HR

Technical, including QC/QA

The Senior Technical Engineer will lead the Technical Department and work closely with all departments to ensure technical, quality, and process requirements are properly controlled.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lead Technical & QC/QA Department

Lead and manage engineers and QC/QA personnel.

Plan, organize, and improve the Technical and QC/QA functions.

Set clear department standards, responsibilities and follow-up procedures.

Ensure timely technical and quality support to internal teams, customers and suppliers.

Build a culture of accuracy, accountability, discipline and continuous improvement.

2. Technical Support & Product Application

Provide product and application-related technical support to internal and external customers.

Support Business Development and Sales teams with technical advice, product comparison, and application guidance.

Analyze technical issues and propose practical solutions.

Develop and maintain technical documents, product guides, and training materials.

Translate technical information into clear explanations for customers and commercial teams.

3. QC/QA Management

Develop, maintain, and improve QC/QA processes, inspection plans and quality standards.

Ensure internal QC/QA procedures are properly followed and documented.

Conduct root cause analysis for technical and quality issues.

Implement corrective and preventive actions.

Ensure the QC/QA team meets internal, external and customer audit requirements.

Maintain control of inspection records, test reports, certificates and quality documentation.

4. Engineering Change & Drawing Control

Manage, track and catalogue engineering changes for every SKU.

Maintain clear visibility of product engineering changes, drawing revisions and technical specification updates.

Ensure each SKU has proper engineering history, including what changed, why it changed, when it changed and who approved it.

Control technical drawing revisions and ensure the latest approved drawings are used internally and by suppliers.

Assess how engineering changes affect product dimensions, performance, application, certification, packaging, inspection requirements and customer approval status.

Define whether a change requires a new SKU, revised drawing, customer approval, supplier requalification or updated inspection plan.

Prevent uncontrolled changes to products, drawings or specifications.

Ensure Business Development, Supply Chain, QC/QA and suppliers are informed of approved engineering changes.

Maintain proper version control for drawings, specifications, technical documents and product records.

5. Internal Workflow & Risk Control

Review internal department workflows and identify loopholes, weak controls and failure points.

Design practical workflows to prevent errors, miscommunication and costly mistakes.

Work with Business Development, Supply Chain, Finance, HR and Technical teams to align responsibilities and checkpoints.

Define approval processes, escalation rules and documentation requirements.

Ensure critical technical and quality decisions are properly recorded and followed through.

6. Supplier Quality Management

Establish and maintain supplier QC/QA requirements.

Conduct supplier audits, surveillance checks and supplier qualification assessments.

Ensure suppliers comply with EESG’s specifications, drawings, inspection standards and quality requirements.

Review supplier inspection reports, test reports and quality documents.

Work with suppliers to resolve quality issues and prevent recurrence.

Align supplier QC/QA plans with EESG’s internal standards.

7. Supplier Control of Change

Put in place a supplier control-of-change process for critical materials, tooling and processes.

Ensure suppliers seek approval before changing coating chemicals, plating chemicals, heat treatment processes, tooling, dies, raw materials, critical dimensions, packaging specifications or other quality-sensitive items.

Assess the technical and quality impact of supplier changes.

Coordinate testing, sample approval or requalification where required.

Ensure approved supplier changes are reflected in the relevant SKU records, drawings, specifications and QC/QA plans.

Prevent unauthorised supplier changes that may lead to product failure, customer complaints or certification issues.

title: Head of Marketing and Communications (Singapore and Indonesia)
description:
About The Role

Lead marketing and communications for CBRE across Singapore and Indonesia, and position the company as the pre-eminent real estate thought leader in both markets. Using earned and owned media, digital and social channels, events and research-led content, you will build share of voice and turn CBRE’s market intelligence into commercial advantage.

Armed with strong media relationships, you will identify opportunities to profile subject matter experts and work closely with them to deliver differentiated points of view on the real estate industry. You will lead a team of five to eight marketing and communications professionals, own the country marketing budget, and act as a trusted adviser to country and business line leadership.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role in a matrix environment. You will set strategy and stay close enough to the work to deliver it.

What You’ll Do

Strategy and business partnering

‒ Develop and deliver an integrated, ROI-focused marketing and communications strategy across Singapore and Indonesia, covering public relations, digital and social, events, internal communications and brand.

‒ Partner country leadership and business line leaders so that marketing and communications operates as a business enabler rather than a service desk.

‒ Own and manage the country marketing budget, with clear reporting of spend against outcomes.

‒ Set the measurement standard for the function, covering share of voice, campaign performance, event contribution to pipeline and digital engagement, and report against it to leadership each quarter.

‒ Contribute to regional marketing and communications initiatives and project roll-outs across Asia Pacific.

Public relations and media

‒ Act as the key media liaison in Singapore and Indonesia, identifying and pitching stories and securing profiling opportunities for business leaders.

‒ Develop compelling messages, media releases, media responses, byline articles and speeches for senior management.

‒ Build and maintain relationships with tier-one business, property and trade media across both markets.

‒ Manage PR agency partners, including scope, performance, deliverables and budget.

‒ Support regional and global teams on issues and crisis communications, preparing local statements, briefing spokespeople and managing local media response, escalating in line with CBRE protocol.

‒ Maintain spokesperson briefing materials and question-and-answer documents, and arrange media training for senior leaders.

Events and industry engagement

‒ Own the events strategy end to end, from flagship client events and research launches to executive roundtables, industry sponsorships and internal town halls.

‒ Manage event budgets, venue and vendor selection, run of show, speaker preparation and post-event follow-up, with clear measurement of commercial return.

‒ Develop an influencer and industry body engagement strategy, including CBRE’s presence and speaking platforms at key industry events in both markets.

Content, research marketing and digital

‒ Work with CBRE Research to turn market intelligence into campaign-ready content and to build launch moments around flagship reports.

‒ Drive lead generation through social and digital channels, working with regional digital teams on campaign build, targeting, marketing technology and reporting.

‒ Act as brand custodian for both markets, maintaining CBRE brand standards across every piece of external and internal output.

‒ Support business development and pursuit teams with marketing collateral and credentials for major client bids.

Internal communications and employer brand

‒ Drive internal communications for employee engagement, change communications and leadership visibility.

‒ Strengthen CBRE’s employer brand in partnership with the People team, supporting recruitment and retention priorities.

Team leadership

‒ Lead, coach and develop a team of five to eight professionals across PR, digital, events and internal communications.

‒ Set objectives, manage performance and build capability and succession within the team.

‒ Provide direction and quality control across all local marketing initiatives and campaigns.

What You’ll Need

Experience: essential

‒ Degree holder with 12 to 14 years’ experience in marketing and communications.

‒ Within that, a minimum of three to four years leading public relations and events at a senior level, with direct accountability for media strategy and for flagship event delivery.

‒ Experience gained in a multinational or large listed organisation with multiple stakeholders, matrix reporting and regional or global reporting lines. This is a requirement, not a preference.

‒ Proven record of managing PR and event agencies, including briefing, performance management and budget control.

‒ Demonstrated ownership of a marketing budget, with the ability to report return on that spend.

‒ People leadership experience, having managed a team of five or more.

‒ Established media relationships in Singapore, with proven ability to secure tier-one coverage.

Experience: advantageous

‒ Indonesia market exposure, or a demonstrated track record of building media relationships in a new market.

‒ Real estate, professional services, financial services or agency background.

‒ Experience supporting issues or crisis communications within an established corporate protocol.

‒ Bahasa Indonesia or Mandarin in addition to strong written and spoken English in view of the in-country market communications.

Skills and attributes

‒ Proven expertise in social and digital marketing, including campaign measurement and marketing technology platforms.

‒ Credible with senior stakeholders, and comfortable advising and constructively challenging country and business line leadership.

‒ Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a dynamic environment with competing priorities.

‒ A positive, can-do attitude and readiness to roll up the sleeves and get the job done.

‒ Willingness to travel between Singapore and Indonesia as the role requires.

Why CBRE

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

Applicant AI Use Disclosure

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

OUR VALUES IN HIRING

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

title: Account Executive, Japan & Korea
description:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the next-generation commodity trading platform.

We give trading desks the clarity, control, and collaboration they need to move faster and trade smarter.

In February 2025, we secured $42 million in Series B funding. Now we’re scaling up across the business, and it’s an exciting time to join.

Our people are the driving force behind everything we do. At Sparta, you’ll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. You’ll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow. Because building something this ambitious takes everyone at their best.

At Sparta, your work has reach. From improving our platform, to powering smarter decisions for our customers, to changing how commodity trading is done around the world.

And because we’re growing fast, you won’t just build your career. You’ll accelerate it, with a level of ownership and impact you simply don’t get at bigger, more bureaucratic companies.

The Role

This is a new-logo hunter role with an account development edge. Based in Singapore, you will own Sparta’s Japanese and Korean territory: building pipeline from scratch, getting in front of trading desks in person, and closing complex, multi-product deals. Roughly 70% of your time goes to winning new logos and 30% to growing and supporting the clients you bring in.

Japan is the immediate priority, with Korea following as the territory matures. Many of the desks you sell to sit in Singapore, but sometimes the budget, the mandate and the long-term relationship often sit with headquarters in Tokyo or Seoul. You will work both, building credibility locally and sponsorship at HQ.

You will sell to C-suite and VP-level buyers while winning over the traders, analysts and risk managers who will use the product and know their market cold.

You will have pre-sales and Customer Success behind you, and an Asia Pacific team growing quickly.

You will work from our Singapore office 4 days a week.

What You Will Be Doing

New Business

• Research opportunities, initiate discussions, build prospect relationships, run demos, manage product trials and close deals across Japanese and Korean energy commodity firms.

• Develop a pipeline of high-value opportunities through networking, events and in-person interaction with traders and decision-makers in Singapore and HQ.

• Sell to C-suite, VP-level and trading desks, articulating a clear business case and ROI for our SaaS solutions.

title: AI Model Trainer
description:
About ChronoAI

ChronoAI is a Singapore-headquartered AI technology company building infrastructure for the next generation of AI agents.

Our mission is to make persistent, always-on AI agents as easy to deploy as cloud services. We are building an Agent-as-a-Service ecosystem covering connectivity, runtime and skills.

Our products include NyxID, which connects AI agents to services and applications; Aevatar, infrastructure for persistent cloud-based agents; Ornn, a plug-and-play skill marketplace for AI agents; and Automath, an AI engine for mathematical discovery and formal verification.

At ChronoAI, we believe AI should handle more execution while humans focus on judgment, creativity and decision-making. We value people who are curious, move fast, take ownership and constantly look for smarter ways to solve problems.

About the Role

We are looking for an AI Model Trainer to improve model capabilities through better data, training methods and evaluation.

This is a hands-on, experimental role. You will turn complex knowledge and reasoning processes into structured training examples, investigate where models fail, and design experiments to determine what actually improves performance. You will work with domain experts, AI/ML engineers and leadership, but you should be comfortable forming your own hypotheses and taking ownership of the work from dataset design through to evaluation.

We care about more than a higher benchmark score. The right person can tell whether a model has learned a capability, identify when an apparent improvement is caused by data leakage or a weak evaluation, and explain the trade-offs behind the next experiment.

What You'll Do

Develop, curate and validate high-quality datasets for model training and fine-tuning.

Translate abstract concepts, domain expertise and multi-step reasoning into clear, machine-trainable examples.

Run training, fine-tuning and iterative optimisation experiments.

Design evaluation criteria, test cases and benchmarks that measure the capabilities we actually need.

Analyse model outputs for accuracy, reasoning quality, consistency and completeness.

Identify hallucinations, reasoning errors, knowledge gaps and recurring failure patterns; investigate their likely causes.

Experiment with prompting, synthetic data, training approaches and model selection, using results to decide what to try next.

Put quality controls around data generation and evaluation so errors are not amplified at scale.

Document datasets, methods, experiment results and decisions clearly enough for the team to reproduce and build on them.

Use AI tools and automation to accelerate repetitive work while maintaining rigorous human judgment over data quality and conclusions.

What We're Looking For

A degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics or a related discipline.

A strong understanding of machine learning and modern language models, with hands-on experience or solid practical knowledge of training, fine-tuning, data preparation or evaluation.

Python proficiency and familiarity with common AI/ML frameworks and workflows.

Strong analytical and logical reasoning skills, including the ability to structure complex or abstract knowledge.

The ability to examine individual failures, not just aggregate metrics, and turn observations into testable hypotheses.

Care with experimental design, data quality, documentation and reproducibility.

Curiosity about new AI methods, comfort with ambiguity and the self-direction to make progress in a fast-moving environment.

Nice to Have

Experience training, fine-tuning or evaluating language and reasoning models.

Familiarity with PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, LoRA/QLoRA, PEFT or similar tools.

Exposure to SFT, reinforcement learning, synthetic data generation or reasoning-model training.

Experience with domain-specific models, formal reasoning or quantitative research.

Research or engineering work you can share that shows how you identified a model limitation and improved it.

ChronoAI Pte Ltd | Next-Generation AI for Human Insight

ChronoAI is an AI research and development company building advanced language models that understand human psychology, personal context, and individual decision-making patterns.

Our flagship product,

GodGPT

, combines large language model capabilities with personalized analysis to provide nuanced insights for personal and professional growth.

Our technology features advanced natural language processing for contextual understanding, personalized AI that adapts to individual communication styles and needs, real-time analysis of complex human situations and relationships, and privacy-focused architecture ensuring secure personal data handling.

Key applications include personal coaching and development, decision-making support for complex life situations, emotional intelligence enhancement, and strategic planning for individuals and small businesses.

This positions us uniquely in the growing market for AI-powered personal guidance and human-centric technology solutions.

At ChronoAI, we believe AI should understand humans as individuals, not just process generic requests. We're building technology that recognizes the nuances of human experience and provides personalized guidance at scale.

Our approach combines cutting-edge AI research with deep understanding of human psychology to create tools that truly serve individual needs.

Based in Singapore 🇸🇬 | Serving users globally

Connect with us to explore the future of personalized AI technology.

title: Business Development & Growth Intern
description:
Business Development & Growth Intern

LAURENE Living | Singapore | Performance-Based

Are you energetic, entrepreneurial and excited by the idea of helping build a lifestyle brand from the ground up?

LAURENE Living is a Singapore-based botanical home & lifestyle brand creating premium, modern products designed to bring a sense of calm and freshness into everyday spaces.

We are looking for an

energetic, commercially minded and entrepreneurial individual

to work directly with the founder and help take LAURENE Living from a small founder-led business to a scalable brand.

This is

not a conventional office internship

. You will have the opportunity to get involved in real business development, sales, product development, AI and eventually building a scalable operating model.

Our digital marketing is already supported by an external marketing agency.

Your primary focus will therefore be the physical, human side of the business — getting the products into people's hands, letting customers experience the scent and developing opportunities that cannot be achieved purely online.

What you will do

PHASE 1 — Physical Business Development & Sales

Your initial focus will be getting LAURENE Living physically in front of potential customers.

You may:

Introduce and demonstrate our products at suitable offline opportunities

Approach potential corporate clients, boutiques, lifestyle businesses, events and communities

Organise product sampling and scent experiences

Identify potential retail, corporate gifting and partnership opportunities

Speak directly with potential customers and understand their feedback

Build a database of potential business leads and partnership opportunities

Test different offline sales approaches and report what works

Represent the LAURENE Living brand professionally and confidently

The key objective: get people to experience the products physically and convert that experience into sales and partnerships.

PHASE 2 — Product Making & Development

As you become familiar with the brand, you may be trained to assist with the

production of LAURENE Living products

using the founder's formulations and processes.

This could include:

Preparing products according to established formulations

Learning our production and quality-control process

Assisting with small-batch production

Understanding product costing and margins

Helping improve production efficiency

Maintaining consistency and quality

You will be working with established formulations and processes rather than independently creating or modifying formulas without approval.

PHASE 3 — Build a Scalable Business Model

The longer-term objective is to move beyond the founder personally making and selling every product.

You will help explore:

How production can be delegated to other people

Training and standardising production processes

Developing simple SOPs

Creating a repeatable sales model

Building partnerships and distribution channels

Improving unit economics and margins

Using AI and automation to reduce administrative work

Developing a model that can grow without everything depending on the founder

The goal is to help turn LAURENE Living from a founder-operated business into a scalable business.

PHASE 4 — Regional Expansion

If the business reaches the appropriate stage, you may become involved in exploring expansion into other markets.

This could include:

Market research

Identifying potential distributors and partners

Testing demand in other countries

Understanding local customer preferences

Exploring regional e-commerce and retail opportunities

Supporting the development of an APAC expansion model

Who we are looking for

You may be a good fit if you are:

Energetic, outgoing and comfortable speaking to strangers

Naturally curious and commercially minded

Comfortable approaching people and starting conversations

Presentable and confident in customer-facing situations

Interested in

marketing, business, design, entrepreneurship or technology

Interested in

AI and how AI can be used to build a better business

Comfortable working independently without being given instructions for every task

Resourceful — you see a problem and think of a way to solve it

Interested in building something rather than simply completing assigned tasks

Comfortable with a fast-moving, founder-led environment

Interested in eventually building a career in

technology, startups, entrepreneurship or business development

Students and recent graduates are welcome to apply.

Marketing, business, design, communications, entrepreneurship, technology or related backgrounds are particularly relevant.

This opportunity is different

You will work directly with the founder of LAURENE Living and see how a business is built from the ground up.

You will get exposure to:

Business Development → Sales → Product → Operations → AI → Scaling → Regional Expansion

If you are ambitious, this can potentially develop into a

long-term role with increasing responsibility

as the business grows.

Compensation

This is currently structured as a

part-time / freelance entrepreneurial opportunity as an internship

, with compensation primarily linked to business results.

The initial structure may include:

Commission on sales generated

Performance-based incentives

Profit-sharing arrangements for appropriate projects

A small stipend or other compensation may be discussed depending on experience, commitment and scope

The longer-term compensation structure can evolve as the business grows and your responsibilities increase.

This is not intended to be a traditional fixed-salary internship.

Working arrangement

Singapore-based

Part-time / freelance initially

Flexible hours, with a significant focus on offline business development

Some work can be done remotely

Physical meetings / product activities will take place in Singapore

Potential for a longer-term role if there is strong mutual fit

Location for interview

Physical interview in Singapore required.

Interview locations:

Tanjong Pagar or Somerset

How to apply

Please send:

Your CV or LinkedIn profile

A short introduction about yourself

Why you are interested in LAURENE Living

Your current studies / work situation

Your availability

One idea for how you would get

20 people in Singapore to smell and experience LAURENE Living products within your first month

We are particularly interested in people who

take initiative rather than wait for instructions.

This is a small business with a big ambition. If you want to help build something rather than simply work in something, we would like to hear from you.

LAURENE Living

is a Singapore-based modern botanical home & lifestyle brand creating thoughtfully crafted products that elevate everyday spaces.

Inspired by nature, calm and modern living, we create premium home essentials designed to bring a sense of freshness and wellbeing into everyday routines. Our approach combines thoughtful product design, botanical ingredients and a clean, contemporary aesthetic.

As a growing founder-led brand, we are building LAURENE Living with a long-term ambition to expand beyond Singapore. We are exploring new retail, corporate, partnership and regional opportunities while using technology and AI to build a more efficient and scalable business.

We are looking for entrepreneurial people who want to be part of building a brand — not simply working in one.

Ensure changes are embedded into business as usual process

Support the implementation of new technologies to deliver next generation

You will own Aurora's APAC Financial Institutions portfolio, managing a combination of strategic accounts and high-priority prospects. You will lead complex commercial engagements and work closely with Aurora's market leads, research, advisory, software, and product teams to support investment and financing decisions across the region.

This is a highly autonomous role suited to an experienced commercial professional who combines strong relationship-building skills with dedication, strategic mindset, excellent business development capabilities, and a genuine interest in energy markets and project finance. You will join an entrepreneurial, international, and fast-growing organisation at the forefront of the global energy transition, with significant opportunities for professional development and progression.

Key responsibilities

Strategic Account Management

Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across major financial institutions in your region.

Develop a deep understanding of client organisations, priorities, challenges, and decision-making processes.

Expand Aurora's relationships across multiple stakeholder groups to maximise account value and long-term retention.

Drive cross-selling and upselling opportunities across Aurora's subscription, software, advisory, and bankability offerings.

Business Development & Commercial Growth

Lead business development activities with major financial institutions across APAC, generating new opportunities and expanding Aurora's regional footprint.

Develop and execute account and market engagement strategies for strategic clients, priority prospects, and target financial institution segments across APAC.

Identify emerging market trends, investment themes, and financing activity to proactively create commercial opportunities.

Manage the full sales cycle, from opportunity qualification through proposal development, negotiation, contracting, and closing.

Deliver against individual and team revenue targets.

Represent Aurora at industry conferences, financing events, client workshops, and stakeholder meetings across APAC.

Bankability

Help facilitating financing transactions that utilise Aurora's analytics, software, and advisory services.

Maintain a strong understanding of project finance fundamentals, due diligence processes, lender requirements, and market trends influencing energy investments.

Contribute to maintaining Aurora's bankability proposition by tracking the use of Aurora's analysis in financing transactions and sharing insights across teams.

Organise banking roundtables and market engagement initiatives that strengthen Aurora's relationships within the financial institutions community.

Help position Aurora as a trusted thought partner in energy finance and energy market analysis.

Provide market intelligence and client insights to inform Aurora's product strategy, commercial priorities, and regional growth plans.

Internal Leadership & Collaboration

Establish yourself as Aurora's subject matter expert for Financial Institutions and bankability topics within your region.

Develop and maintain market-specific Financial Institutions and Bankability Strategies for key APAC markets, including tailored approaches to client engagement, marketing and content.

Collaborate closely with Market Leads and Aurora's research, advisory, software, product, and commercial teams to execute regional strategies.

Contribute to the continuous improvement of commercial processes, tools, and ways of working across the Global FI Team and the wider commercial organisation.

What we are looking for

Required attributes:

Strong commercial mindset with a proven track record in business development, sales, and account management.

Demonstrated ability to build credibility and long-term relationships with senior stakeholders at financial institutions.

Excellent coordination, communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.

Ability to operate independently and drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

Highly organised, proactive, and resilient, with strong attention to detail.

Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and functions.

Passion for delivering exceptional client experiences and building long-term partnerships.

Strong interest in energy markets, project finance, infrastructure investment, and the energy transition, with a proactive approach to continuous learning and development.

Fluency in English and additional APAC language capabilities, particularly Japanese, Mandarin, Korean

Experience

5+ years of experience in business development, sales, account management, client relationship management, or related commercial roles.

Experience working with financial institutions, infrastructure investors, financial advisors, project finance teams, or energy market participants.

Demonstrated success managing strategic client relationships, executing account strategies, and delivering commercial growth.

Experience negotiating commercial agreements and structured proposals.

Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM systems.

Desirable attributes:

Existing network within APAC-based banks, financial advisors, infrastructure investors, debt funds, insurers, or energy-focused financial institutions.

Understanding of project finance, debt financing, due diligence, or investment processes within renewable energy, storage, power markets, or broader energy infrastructure.

Experience selling subscription-based research, software, data, analytics, consulting, or information services.

Exposure to APAC power markets and energy market fundamentals.

Experience developing market engagement or commercial growth strategies.

What we offer

The opportunity to substantially influence major decisions in the energy sector

Direct engagement with clients through Aurora conferences, workshops and webinars all around Europe

The opportunity to grow into a publicly visible industry expert

A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture

A competitive salary package

Access to regular coaching and mentoring sessions and the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals

title: Associate, Media Planning
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

We are looking for aspiring and fun-loving Media Planner. You will have the opportunity to work/ be exposed to multiple brands and category (eg. Luxury, Automotive & Entertainment) You will play a crucial supporting role in the development and execution of integrated media planning and client servicing. Skills and Experience

What you will do:

Integrated Media Strategy & Planning: Support the development of comprehensive, insight-driven media plans, spanning both digital and traditional channels. Assist in ensuring plans are rooted in consumer understanding and aligned to business objectives, encompassing both Brand and Performance.
Campaign Excellence & Execution Oversight: Support the Activation Teams in ensuring accurate and timely campaign execution. Develop a strong working knowledge of digital campaign requirements. Assist in maintaining rigour and accuracy for campaign tracking, performance optimization, and delivery standards.
Reporting: Assist in the creation of in-flight and post-campaign reporting, contributing to clear and actionable performance insights for the client.
Client Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Support the team in managing day-to-day client communication and requests. Participate in client conversations, assisting with the preparation of media plans, performance updates, and new opportunities under guidance.
Innovation & Research: Support the manager in researching and bringing forward-thinking ideas such as platform innovations, first-to-market activations, and new partners to the client. Assist in working with media partners and local teams to develop these ideas.
Account Operations Support: Assist in ensuring smooth account operations including adherence to globally defined media thresholds, sufficiency exercises, PO trackers, monthly billing inputs, and reporting cadences.

Measures of Success:

In 3 Months:

Establish relationships with client contacts, internal teams, and key partners.
Develop a thorough understanding of the client's business, brand portfolio, media approach, and historical campaign performance.
Successfully contribute to ongoing media plan execution and campaign implementation.
Understand and support the team in ensuring robust KPI-setting and tracking frameworks are in place across active campaigns.

In 6 Months:

Independently manage specific tasks within media planning and client servicing for key campaigns, with guidance from the Manager for client conversations and presentations.
Contribute proactively to insight-led discussions that enhance campaign performance and identify potential growth opportunities.
Demonstrate strong ownership of assigned tasks and a proactive approach to learning

In 12 Months:

Become a reliable and integral member of the account team, consistently delivering high-quality support and contributing to client satisfaction.
Build a track record of proactive support and measurable contributions to campaign impact.
Demonstrate a growing understanding of the media landscape and client objectives.

What you will need:

At least 1 year of media planning experience, with a strong track record in integrated digital and traditional media planning within a media agency environment.
Fresh graduates with media agency internship experience, or strong background in finance, accounting and marketing will be considered for this role as well.
Working knowledge of digital media platforms including paid social (Meta, TikTok), search (Google), and programmatic; offline media knowledge is an added advantage.
Strong analytical skills with an ability to support the development of insight-driven media strategies aligned to client business objectives.
Excellent organizational, operational, and numeracy skills, with strong attention to detail.
Clarity in written and spoken communication.
A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel (including formulas) and Microsoft PowerPoint.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we're just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

About the role

Shopify's Solutions Engineers are trusted technical advisors who help merchants design and adopt the right commerce solutions. You'll blend technical depth, commercial awareness, and clear communication to guide merchants through complex, multi-stakeholder decisions.

As a Senior Solutions Engineer on the ASIA team, you'll support merchants across the Greater China Region and South East Asia. The team operates with a high degree of self-sufficiency. Time zones, market complexity, and regional scale mean you'll need to be hands-on, collaborative, and comfortable using AI as a daily multiplier.

Run deep discovery with merchants and partners, mapping workflows, systems, constraints, risks, and success metrics to find the real problem behind stated requirements.

Design practical solution architectures across Shopify's commerce stack and adjacent systems (ERP, OMS, payments, integrations), including migration paths from legacy platforms.

Partner cross-functionally with Account Executives, Solution Partners, Product, Launch, and CSM teams to shape opportunity strategy, remove blockers, and translate field insights back into the business.

Use AI to accelerate your work, from merchant research and transcript synthesis to demo planning and technical validation, while building reusable tools, prompts, and workflows that create leverage for the team.

Apply judgment on when to go deep, when to simplify, when to bring in specialists, and when to challenge assumptions.

The role includes merchant-facing activities, including remote and on-site engagements with merchants and supporting community events. You'll be partnering with Shopify merchants across the Asia Pacific (APAC) region, and be a key source of insight to provide feedback to Shopify’s Product, Engineering and User Experience teams.

This is a remote position and will support merchants and our business growth in China. You will have the opportunity to engage directly with our merchants their technical teams and our established partners across the GCR region to have solutions-focused discussions around the Shopify platform.

Qualifications

Fluency in the Mandarin language is required of this role to engage directly with merchants in the Greater China Region

Relevant experience in solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical consulting, solutions architecture, or commerce technology implementation.

Technical fluency across APIs, integrations, data flows, authentication, webhooks, and modern SaaS architecture, with enough depth to shape practical, adoptable solutions.

Strong requirements discovery skills, including gathering, inferring, and interpreting complex business needs from customers, then translating them into clear technical requirements and scalable solutions across Shopify and adjacent systems.

Commercial instincts that connect technical recommendations to merchant outcomes, including revenue growth, operational efficiency, customer experience, and risk reduction.

Clear communication, with the judgment to turn complexity into simple, compelling stories for both executive and technical audiences, written and verbal.

Strong stakeholder influence, including earning trust, reading the room, building champions, and navigating tension across technical, executive, and partner stakeholders.

Comfort with ambiguity and self-directed learning in a fast-moving, regionally distributed team.

Practical use of AI tools without over-relying on them as a substitute for technical thinking or customer empathy.

Based in Singapore, with ability to travel for customer meetings, partner engagements, and team events.

Nice to have

Experience with Shopify, commerce platforms, POS, B2B, retail operations, or integration-heavy environments, particularly in GCR enterprise or mid-market sales cycles.

Familiarity with JavaScript, Liquid, React, GraphQL, REST APIs, SQL, or similar. Enough to build small things that clarify feasibility (prototypes, scripts, demo stores, proof points).

Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development or workflow tools (Claude, Cursor, Gemini, NotebookLM, or similar).

A track record of creating reusable assets, enablement, or internal systems that make others around you better.

About Shopify

Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to over 8,300 employees and generated over $1 trillion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.

This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About you

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.

Before you apply, consider if you can:
Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
Bring critical thought and opinion
Put AI agents and tools to work on the tasks they're built for, and focus on the work only humans can do
Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
Work digital-first for your daily work

Shopifyhttps://www.shopify.com
We hire people, not resumes. If you think you’re right for the role, apply now.
