title: Business Development Representative
description:
About Us:

Vortexa was founded to solve the immense information gap that exists in the energy industry. By using massive amounts of new satellite data and pioneering work in artificial intelligence, Vortexa creates an unprecedented view of global seaborne energy flows in real-time, bringing transparency and efficiency to the energy markets.

With offices in London, New York, Houston, Singapore, Geneva and the UAE, we are building the definitive platform for energy and freight analytics globally - backed by leading investors including Morgan Stanley & Notion Capital.

The Role:

We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our BDR Pipeline Generation team, based in our Singapore office and focused on the APAC region. You will play a crucial role in driving the growth of our business, helping to generate new opportunities across our core APAC customer segments.

You’ll be responsible for identifying and engaging high-potential prospects across APAC — including Singapore and Southeast Asia (e.g. Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and Vietnam), Japan, South Korea, Australia, India and Greater China — through both marketing-generated leads and proactive outbound efforts ensuring our Sales team is set up to succeed. You'll work closely with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to drive pipeline generation through inbound lead discovery and qualification, proactive and energetic outbounding, and driving attendance at key APAC industry events.

It’s an ideal opportunity for someone eager to develop their SaaS career in a high-performing, global team, while learning about one of the world’s most impactful and complex industries.

In this role you will:

Drive qualified pipeline through personalised, multichannel outreach (email, LinkedIn, phone, event follow-up, and local channels such as WeChat, LINE and KakaoTalk where appropriate)
Conduct Discovery calls and qualify leads before handover to Sales, mapping the buying group and approval process (often consensus-driven in markets such as Japan and Korea)
Research and map high-potential accounts across APAC’s core segments — national oil companies and refiners, Japanese trading houses and utilities, Singapore-based trading firms, shipowners and brokers, bunkering, and banks and commodity funds
Collaborate with the Marketing team to promote and drive registrations for Vortexa-hosted and APAC industry events (e.g. Singapore International Energy Week, APPEC, Singapore Maritime Week, Asia Pacific Maritime, and LNG and freight conferences in Japan, Korea and Australia)
Collaborate with the RevOps, Sales, and Marketing teams to evolve scalable playbooks and processes
Ensure accurate tracking and maintenance of data within the BDR tech stack (Salesforce, Salesloft, Gong, Marketo etc.)
Run outreach in line with regional data-privacy and anti-spam rules (e.g. Singapore PDPA, China PIPL, Japan APPI, India DPDP Act, Australia Spam Act)
Maintain core working hours aligned to Singapore time, with flexibility to engage prospects across APAC time zones (from India to Japan and Australia), plus occasional regional travel for key events and customer meetings (10-20%)
Consistently meet or exceed quarterly targets for revenue contribution (e.g. qualified demos booked with AEs, pipeline created, and pipeline closed won)

Requirements

You will have:

At least 2 years of experience in a SaaS BDR, SDR, or commercial associate role
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling outreach and hold engaging conversations with senior stakeholders to engage prospects and nurture leads
Cultural fluency in APAC business norms, including relationship-led selling and hierarchy-aware engagement with senior stakeholders
Genuine interest in the energy, freight, or commodities space; (experience in the sector is a plus)
A proactive and curious attitude, with an eagerness to grow within a high-performing team
A proven track record of exceeding commercial OKRs
Experience with Salesforce, Salesloft, Gong, ZoomInfo, etc. or similar tools, plus the resourcefulness to research accounts manually where database coverage is thin (common in North and Southeast Asia)
Professional working proficiency English and additional local languages (bonus)
Sound judgement when engaging prospects in sanctions-sensitive or politically sensitive trade flows
The ability to work independently, take initiative, and meet deadlines

Great if you have:

A background in the energy industry (e.g. oil & gas trading, freight analytics, commodities, etc.) and are looking to pivot into a SaaS commercial career, we’d love to hear from you.
Prior exposure to APAC commercial, trading or maritime environments.

Benefits

Stock-options in a fast-growing, high-potential business
An open, collaborative, and supportive working culture built on merit, which celebrates creative thinking and “getting things done.”
The opportunity to work with AI-driven technology in a scale-up environment with commodity trading experts
Private Health Insurance offered via AXA
A flexible working policy- accommodating both remote & home working, with regular staff events
Global Volunteering Policy to help you ‘do good’ and feel better
Competitive base salary plus commission and a clear career path from BDR to Sales Manager

title: Field Executive, Market Research Operations (6 or 12 months Contract)
description:

Fieldwork Operations

title: Business Development Executive
description:
*About NuSpace*

NuSpace is a Singapore-headquartered company building satellite IoT connectivity and CubeSat hardware. Our mission is to connect every sensor, asset, and machine on Earth, including the places terrestrial networks never reach. Our NuLink connectivity service and CubeSat bus platform serve customers who need reliable data from remote and demanding environments. We are a small, engineering-led team entering a commercial growth phase, and we are hiring our first dedicated business development associate.

*About the Role*

You will work directly with our Chief Executive Officer to turn our technology into customer relationships. This is a commercial role, not a research role. You will spend most of your time on market research, outreach, and proposal support, and you will learn how a deep-tech company actually wins business. Sales cycles in this industry are long, so expect early wins to be small: a qualified lead, a well-received proposal, an insight that changes how we position a product.

What you will do:

* *Research markets:* Analyse where satellite IoT and CubeSat hardware create the most value (for example agriculture, logistics, maritime, energy, and government) and recommend where we should focus.
* *Qualify leads:* Handle inbound inquiries and outbound outreach, working out who the decision-maker is, what the customer needs, and whether it is a real opportunity.
* *Support proposals and bids:* Help draft proposals, capability documents, and grant or tender submissions, working with our engineers to translate technical specs into customer language.
* *Maintain the pipeline:* Keep our prospective customer lists accurate and give leadership a clear weekly view of opportunities and risks.
* *Feed customer insight back:* Bring what customers say to our product and engineering team. Your notes will be used in roadmap discussions.

*What your first 12 months look like*

* *Months 1 to 3:* Learn our products and customers, shadow leadership on calls and meetings, and create your own lead tracker and market research pack.
* *Months 4 to 6:* Run lead qualification independently and draft proposals with review.
* *Months 7 to 12:* Own a defined segment or account set, and take part in pricing and positioning discussions.
* *At 12 months:* We review your scope, title, and compensation together, based on agreed goals set at the start.

*Who You Are*

* You are a recent graduate (or within two years of graduating) in business, engineering, science, or a related field. Any discipline is fine if you can show the skills below.
* You are curious about how technology becomes a product customers pay for. Interest in space is welcome, and we will teach you the rest.
* You write clearly and can explain technical ideas to non-technical people, and business needs to engineers.
* You take initiative, follow through, and treat rejection as information.
* You are comfortable with ambiguity and with a small team where roles overlap.

*Nice to have*

* Internship or project experience in sales, market research, or client-facing work.
* Familiarity with creating a method to track prospective customers or proposal writing.
* Startup or fast-paced team experience.

*What We Offer*

* *Real ownership:* A small team means your work is visible and your input is used.
* *Structured mentorship:* Regular one-to-ones with CEO and exposure to engineering, so you learn both the technology and the commercial side.
* *A defined growth path:* A documented 12-month review and clear expectations for what the next role looks like.
* *A team that supports each other:* We start you off at the deep end by having you identify unfamiliar concepts, then provide guidance to fill those gaps. The team is friendly, welcoming, and supportive throughout.

*How to Apply*

Send your resume and a short written note (no more than 300 words) on what interests you about our business and one market you think we should pursue and why, to jobs@nuspace.sg. We review every application and will reply within 3 working days.

Pay: $4,000.00 - $5,000.00 per month

Benefits:
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Parental leave
* Professional development
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Singapore 117292

title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, GenAI, Google Cloud
description:
Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.

Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
8 years of experience shipping production-grade AI solutions to external or internal customers.
Experience building full-stack solutions that interface with enterprise systems.
Experience in Python.
Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms.

Preferred qualifications:
Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, or Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK)) and patterns like ReAct, self-reflection, and hierarchical delegation.
Experience in the telecommunication, manufacturing or retail industry.
Knowledge of large language model-native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.
Ability to implement secure agentic workflows incorporating Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool-calling, and OAuth-based authentication.
About the job

As a Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Forward Deployed Engineer at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier Artificial Intelligence (AI) products and production-grade reality within customer environments. You will function as a builder-consultant, moving beyond architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions. You will solve the integration complexities, data readiness, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. You will serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment and acting as a critical feedback loop for Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities
Lead the discovery-to-deployment journey, serving as the lead developer for AI applications and transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems and MCP servers) that drive measurable return on investment.
Bridge the enterprise gap by architecting and coding the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters.
Engineer for production excellence, building high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet the requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
Act as a product catalyst, identifying repeatable field patterns and technical friction points in Google’s AI stack and converting them into reusable modules or product feature requests for engineering teams.
Drive regional leadership and upskilling by mentoring talent, co-building with customer teams, and influencing cross-functional strategies to uplevel organizational technical capabilities.

Information at a Glance

We are a global engagement and marketing agency that creates human-centric touchpoints that unleash the power of people to deliver innovation and growth.
Firm believers in the power of building community since 1987, we are helping brands, associations and not-for-profit organisations solve their key people challenges through our core expertise: Live & virtual events, Strategic & digital communications and Consulting & community solutions.

Represent Business Support department on any operational matters or meetings in the event of the Business Support Manager’s absence.

The Project Coordinator reports to the Deputy Director and works closely with the AMC team internally.

Well-rounded individuals pursuing a degree in Hospitality, Tourism or MICE

Quick, efficient, and accurate in all administrative duties

Well-developed organizational and leadership skills
Database management experience is beneficial

title: Marketing Manager
description:
We are seeking a well-rounded and results-driven Marketing Manager to manage the organisation’s branding, communications and promotional campaigns, able to implement marketing strategies for How I Care company with ownership over promotions and awareness of How I Care products.

This role is more than managing day-to-day marketing activities. We are looking for a Marketing Manager who can rebuild and strengthen our marketing function, bringing clarity, structure and consistency across all marketing efforts.

You will lead a team of three to five marketing members and be responsible for creating a high-performing marketing department with clear processes, measurable outcomes and strong collaboration.

Working closely with the CEO, you will develop and execute marketing strategies that increase brand awareness, grow our online community and convert engagement into sustainable business growth.

Success in this role means more people know who How I Care is, understand what we stand for and actively engage with our products, programmes and community.

The ideal candidate will be someone innovative, resourceful using various forms of business intelligence and information to identify key trends and develop successful marketing programmes.

Also, enthusiastic in sharing the power of journaling with others, advocating for mental wellbeing and able to be building a strong connection with our audience.

Be responsible for the implementation of multi-channel marketing strategies, in charge of managing all social platforms (inclusive of community engagement), with clear deliverables in brand engagement and visibility.

If you are a creative thinker, skilled storyteller and results-driven marketer, we would love to meet and talk to you!

The primary objective of this role is to significantly increase awareness of the How I Care brand, establish a strong and engaged online community, and convert that awareness into sustainable growth across our educational programmes, workshops and retail products.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Brand Leadership

Develop and execute the overall marketing strategy aligned with the company's vision and business objectives.

Lead the repositioning and strengthening of the How I Care brand across all customer touchpoints.

Ensure consistency in brand identity, messaging, storytelling and visual communications.

Develop annual and quarterly marketing plans with measurable KPIs.

Build scalable marketing systems, workflows and processes to improve team efficiency and effectiveness.

Identify opportunities for innovation, partnerships and new marketing initiatives.

Digital & Social Media Marketing

· Manage and grow our presence for our brands on Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Facebook, etc. ensuring high engagement and growth of respective channels.

· Strong writing skills and ability to create compelling copy for different channels

· Produce high-quality reels, infographics, photography and video content.

· Create comprehensive and visually appealing content using Canva or Adobe Suite.

Develop content strategies that drive meaningful engagement, community growth and brand advocacy.

Oversee the content calendar across all digital platforms.

Analyse platform performance and optimise content based on insights and analytics.

Grow our social media presence with the objective of establishing How I Care as a leading voice in wellbeing, journaling and self-awareness.

Community Management & Engagement:

· Build and maintain a vibrant journaling community, both online and offline.

· Host or support journal-related events, challenges and wellness campaigns.

· Encourage feedback and collect user stories to shape marketing direction.

Develop brand ambassadors, influencers and strategic partnerships aligned with the How I Care mission.

Build long-term relationships with schools, educators, mental wellbeing advocates and community partners.

·

Merchandise & Product Development

· Support development and promotion of branded merchandise and educational products.

Product Marketing & Commercial Growth

Develop go-to-market strategies for new journals, card games and lifestyle merchandise.

Plan and execute product launch campaigns.

Increase product awareness and drive online and offline sales.

Work closely with internal stakeholders to translate customer insights into future product improvements.

·

Performance Marketing & Analytics

Monitor and report on key marketing metrics including reach, engagement, website traffic, lead generation and sales conversion.

Develop dashboards and reports to evaluate campaign performance.

Optimise marketing spend based on ROI.

Make data-driven recommendations to improve marketing effectiveness.

Budget Management

· Propose and manage marketing budgets to ensure optimal allocation of funds and ROI.

SEO & Paid Ads

· Implement and optimise SEO strategies and Google Ads campaigns to enhance online visibility.

Campaigns and Event Management

· Design, implement and manage marketing campaigns across various platforms (digital, print etc.)

· Plan and execute marketing activations such as pop-up events and school workshops.

Team Leadership

· Manage and mentor marketing members, delegate tasks and foster optimum collaboration amongst members.

Lead, coach and develop a team of three to five marketing professionals.

Set clear goals, responsibilities and performance expectations.

Foster accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement within the team.

Build a culture of creativity, ownership and excellence.

Review team performance and provide regular feedback and development opportunities

·

Market Research

· Analyse market developments to identify key trends, consumer/user behaviour and propose applicable marketing decisions.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured through:

Growth in overall brand awareness.

Growth in social media audience and engagement.

Increase in website traffic and qualified leads.

Growth in sales of journals, card games and lifestyle merchandise.

Successful execution of campaigns and product launches.

Strong relationships with schools and strategic partners.

Development of an organised, high-performing marketing department.

Achievement of agreed marketing KPIs and ROI.

Qualifications & Skills

· A marketing professional with a strong creative mindset and entrepreneurial spirit.

· Ideal personal interest in journaling and promoting wellbeing through reflective practices.

· Minimum 3-5 years’ experience in marketing activities (preferably in wellness or education sectors).

· With at least 2 years in a leadership or team management role.

· Proven experience running successful digital and affiliate campaigns.

· Strong community engagement and robust communication skills.

· Self-driven and able to manage multiple priorities independently.

· Strong time management and budget controlling skills.

· Highly creative with a proactive approach to problem-solving and campaign execution.

· Ability to work independently while also thriving in a collaborative team environment.

· Open to feedback and capable of following instructions effectively.

· Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

Experience building or scaling a marketing function is highly advantageous.

Experience in education, wellness, lifestyle or purpose-driven brands is preferred.

Demonstrated ability to grow social media communities and translate engagement into measurable business outcomes.

Strong understanding of branding, content marketing, digital marketing, SEO, paid advertising and analytics.

Commercial mindset with the ability to balance creativity and business performance.

·

Work hours

· Weekdays between 09:00 and 17:30 hours

Other

· Able to travel within the region as per company’s requirements and plans.

· Attractive remuneration as well as employee overall benefits.

At How I Care, mental health and well-being are not just priorities—they are the essence of our mission. Based in Singapore, we are an Education Lab dedicated to elevating social awareness and personal growth through transformative education across Asia.

Our curriculum, now implemented in schools throughout the region, is tailored to the unique needs of each school year, aiming to equip students with effective strategies to embrace challenges and grow into socially aware, responsible individuals. We create engaging learning textbooks and conduct workshops that foster character development. Additionally, we offer training for teachers to maximise the impact of our resources.

Join us in our mission to empower the next generation. Together, we can nurture a better tomorrow and ensure every student has the opportunity to thrive confidently and contribute meaningfully to their community.

title: Manager of Investment, Utility Power Projects
description:
Job Description

About Peak Energy

Peak Energy is a clean energy platform that develops, finances, builds, and operates utility-scale solar, rooftop generation, onshore wind, and battery storage solutions across Asia-Pacific. As a fast-growing scale-up, we build on the experience of a team drawn from TotalEnergies, Vestas, Cleantech Energy, and other leading players, combining world-class technical expertise with entrepreneurial agility.

With over 300 MW of operating assets and 1 GW of projects in development across Japan, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, the Philippines, Thailand, Singapore and Indonesia, we are greenfield developers at heart, but we also partner flexibly with industrials, developers, and investors to accelerate delivery and scale impact.

We combine the customer focus of a developer, the technical expertise of an EPC and the financial strength of a heavyweight institution, enabling clients to meet decarbonization targets on time, on budget, and without risk of delivery failure. Peak Energy is wholly owned by Stonepeak, one of the world's leading alternative investment firms specializing in infrastructure and real assets. Our financial and technical strength coupled with our relationships in local markets allows us to optimize our capital deployment in high-quality assets.

Our clients can expect clean energy solutions delivered on time, on budget, and at scale, with no surprises. Let's partner together to support your sustainability journey.

Role Overview

The Associate / Senior Associate, Investments will support the identification, evaluation, development, and execution of utility-scale renewable energy investments across Asia Pacific with a closer line of sight to markets in Malaysia, Thailand, and the Philippines. The role is expected to report directly to the CIO in supporting decision-making for the entire group.

Working closely with colleagues across development, engineering, finance, legal, and external stakeholders, this individual will contribute to greenfield development opportunities, mergers and acquisitions, strategic partnerships, and project financing initiatives. The role offers broad exposure across the investment lifecycle and the opportunity to help grow one of the region's leading renewable energy platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Investment Analysis & Evaluation

· Develop and maintain financial models for renewable energy and infrastructure investments.

· Perform valuation, scenario, sensitivity, and risk analyses to support investment decisions including offtake negotiations, FID decisions and devex initiation / monitoring..

· Assess project economics, commercial assumptions, and potential returns across development and acquisition opportunities.

· Support the preparation of investment recommendations and internal approval materials.

· Preparation of regular reporting material with local team to discuss next quarterly spend profiles and project priorities

Greenfield Development & Opportunity Assessment

· Support the evaluation of greenfield renewable energy opportunities across Southeast Asia.

· Conduct market, commercial, and regulatory research to identify attractive investment opportunities.

· Work closely with development teams to assess project viability and investment attractiveness.

· Monitor industry trends, power markets, and competitive activity across the region.

Transaction Execution & Due Diligence

· Support acquisition, partnership, and investment opportunities across the region.

· Participate in due diligence activities and coordinate with internal teams and external advisors.

· Review project and company information to identify key risks and opportunities.

· Support financing, transaction execution, and other strategic initiatives as required.

Stakeholder Collaboration

· Work collaboratively with development, legal, engineering, finance, and operations teams.

· Support engagement with developers, investors, lenders, advisors, and strategic partners.

· Prepare analyses and presentations for management and investment discussions.

· Contribute to initiatives that support the continued growth of Peak Energy's utility-scale platform.

Qualifications & Experience

· Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

· Relevant experience in renewable energy, infrastructure, project finance, investment banking, corporate development, consulting, or a related field.

· Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities.

· Financial modelling experience relating to infrastructure, power, or renewable energy projects is required.

· Financial due diligence experience relating to renewable energy or infrastructure investments is preferred,

· Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across functions and cultures.

Peak Energy is a renewable energy platform with a focus on developing solar, wind and battery projects across Asia. As the region's consumption of energy rises, Peak Energy is dedicated to meeting these demands while contributing to carbon neutrality. We accomplish this by developing large utility-scale projects. These include some of the largest solar and wind farms in Korea and Japan.

Peak Energy is the renewable arm of Stonepeak Infrastructure Partners; a leading global infrastructure investment firm with +USD 57 Bn in assets under management. Our portfolio includes the offshore wind farm in Taiwan with plans to develop a further +5 GWp.

Our team has decades of experience and long-standing relationships. This combination of knowledge and relationships, combined with expertise in design and supply chains enables Peak Energy to deliver high performing, robust alternative energy systems on time and under budget.

At Peak Energy, you'll collaborate with passionate individuals, drive meaningful impact, and be at the forefront of Asia’s transition to renewable energy. We believe everyone is needed for carbon neutrality. Therefore, fresh ideas are always welcomed. Are you excited about disrupting traditional energy sources and developing a sustainable future? Come join our team and be a part of the energy revolution with Peak Energy!

description:
We don’t just trade — we live and breathe the markets.

At our firm, trading is not just a job — it’s a passion and a craft. We are a fast-growing proprietary trading company, built by professionals who are deeply committed to the markets. We combine rigorous research, disciplined execution, and innovative technology to stay ahead.

We are looking for outstanding individuals who not only want to build a career in trading, but also share our long-term vision. This role is not just about earning a salary — it’s about joining a team with ambition, professionalism, and the potential to grow into future partners of the firm.

What you will do

-Stay on top of market news, and share insights with the team in real time.

-Monitor market trends, order flow, and trading activity throughout the day.

-Contribute ideas using our proprietary processes and research tools.

-Dive into Bloomberg and other platforms to perform fundamental analysis.

-Apply coding skills to improve, optimize, and automate trading workflows.

-Work closely with like-minded teammates who share the same obsession with the markets.

What we are looking for

-A strong passion for trading and financial markets

-Minimum 3 years of experience as an ETF Trader or in a similar role, preferably within a proprietary trading firm, hedge fund, or financial institution

-Bachelor’s degree or above in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering or related

-In-depth understanding of China’s & HK market, financial instruments, trading strategies, and risk management principles.

-Solid analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to perform under pressure.

-Experience with Bloomberg or similar research tools is a plus.

-Coding proficiency (Python, C++ or similar) highly valued.

-Excellent communication skills and a strong sense of teamwork.

-Fluency in English; Mandarin or Cantonese is a bonus.

Why join us?

-Your growth matters — we push each other to get better every day.

-Direct exposure to markets and hands-on trading from day one.

-A culture built on passion, intensity, and a relentless drive to succeed.

-Beyond a job: the chance to grow with us into a partner and potential shareholder, shaping the future of the firm together.

If you are ambitious, driven, and eager to grow in both skill and responsibility, we invite you to join us and build something extraordinary.

Story

We are SSIT, a Singapore-based maritime and energy company with strong roots in shipping services, marine waste management, and petroleum recycling. Over the years, our core businesses have built a foundation of financial stability, integrity, and operational discipline — values that now guide our next great endeavor: establishing our Proprietary Trading Division. In a world of volatility and transformation, we believe that trading is not merely about profit. It is about understanding markets, managing risk, and creating sustainable value. With our industry background, disciplined mindset, and self-owned capital, we are building a professional, transparent, and high-performance trading platform focused on equity and related markets.

Vision

To transform SSIT from a successful industrial enterprise into a world-class investment platform — one that integrates industrial insight with financial intelligence. We aim to grow from proprietary trading into a multi-strategy fund management platform, representing Singapore’s new generation of disciplined, ethical, and globally oriented investment firms. Our long-term goal: To reach USD 10 billion in managed assets through consistency, credibility, and compounding excellence.

Founder’s Letter

We started with ships and seas, learning discipline from the waves and resilience from the storms. Today, we bring that same spirit into the markets. At SSIT, trading is not speculation — it is craftsmanship. It is the pursuit of clarity amidst noise, and conviction amidst uncertainty. We believe success comes not from chasing luck, but from mastering structure, risk, and mindset. We are committed to building a trading platform that endures — one that investors, partners, and traders alike can trust for decades to come. Our journey begins in Singapore, but our vision is global. And we know, with discipline and passion, we will succeed.

“Beyond Oceans, Toward a Shared Future.”

title: Assistant Director, Finance
description:
About the Opportunity

Our client is an established organisation in Singapore with a sizeable and growing operational footprint. As part of its continued development, the organisation is looking to strengthen its Finance function and drive greater efficiency, standardisation and digitalisation across its finance operations.

This is a leadership role for an experienced finance professional who combines strong operational finance fundamentals with a track record in finance transformation. The successful candidate will oversee key finance operations while driving process improvements, automation and stronger controls across the function.

Key Responsibilities

Finance Operations & Governance

Oversee key finance operations including billing, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, General Ledger and Fixed Assets.

Ensure accurate and timely financial processing, reconciliations and month-end activities.

Strengthen financial controls, policies and standard operating procedures to support good governance and compliance.

Oversee relevant funding and grant-related finance processes where applicable.

Support internal and external audits and ensure appropriate follow-up on audit and control matters.

Finance Transformation & Process Improvement

Lead finance transformation initiatives aimed at improving efficiency, scalability and controls across Finance.

Drive the review and redesign of finance processes, identifying opportunities for standardisation, simplification and automation.

Play a key role in ERP and finance system implementation or enhancement projects, working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners.

Champion the use of workflow automation, RPA and other digital tools to improve finance operations.

Develop appropriate operational metrics and reporting to improve visibility and performance across the function.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead, coach and develop finance managers and team members, building stronger capabilities within the function.

Partner with internal stakeholders to address operational issues and support organisation-wide initiatives.

Work closely with senior management and cross-functional teams on finance transformation, governance and process improvement matters.

Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability and collaboration within the Finance team.

The Profile We're Looking For

We are looking for an experienced finance leader who is comfortable managing day-to-day finance operations while also taking a broader view of how processes, systems and controls can be improved.

The ideal candidate should have:

A recognised degree in Accountancy, Finance or a related discipline, with relevant professional accounting qualifications being advantageous.

Approximately 12–15 years of relevant finance experience, including meaningful experience leading finance operations and teams.

Strong hands-on understanding across multiple finance functions such as AP, AR, billing, GL and fixed assets.

Demonstrated experience in finance transformation, process improvement and/or ERP implementation.

Good understanding of financial controls, governance, audit and compliance requirements.

Exposure to process automation, RPA, workflow tools or finance digitalisation initiatives would be advantageous.

Experience managing and developing finance teams, including managers or experienced finance professionals.

Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across different functions and levels of seniority.

Experience in complex, multi-site, regulated or service-oriented organisations would be advantageous.

Exposure to grant administration or government-funded programmes would be useful but is not essential.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of a broad Finance Operations portfolio while playing an active role in shaping how the function evolves. Beyond running the day-to-day operations, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to drive meaningful improvements across processes, systems, automation and controls.

It would suit someone who enjoys both the operational and transformation sides of Finance and is looking for a broader leadership mandate within an established organisation.

title: Analyst, Real Estate and Data Centers
description:
About General Atlantic

General Atlantic is a leading global investor with more than four and a half decades of experience providing capital and strategic support for over 885 companies throughout its history. Established in 1980, General Atlantic continues to be a dedicated partner to visionary founders and investors seeking to build dynamic businesses and create lasting value. Guided by the conviction that entrepreneurs can be incredible agents of transformational change, the firm combines a collaborative global approach, sector specific expertise, a long-term investment horizon, and a deep understanding of growth drivers to partner with and scale innovative businesses around the world. The firm leverages its patient capital, operational expertise, and global platform to support a diversified investment platform spanning Growth Equity, Infrastructure, and Strategic Solutions. General Atlantic manages approximately $126 billion in assets under management, inclusive of all strategies, as of March 31, 2026, with more than 900 professionals in 20 countries across five regions. For more information on General Atlantic, please visit www.generalatlantic.com.

About Actis

In October 2024, General Atlantic acquired Actis, which now operates as its Sustainable Infrastructure business alongside its existing strategies in Growth Equity, Credit, and Climate. Actis is a leading global investor in sustainable infrastructure, delivering competitive returns for institutional investors and measurable positive impact for the countries, cities and communities in which it operates. Actis invests in structural themes that support long-term, equitable growth in defensive, critical infrastructure across energy transition, digitalization transition, and supply chain transformation. The firm’s decades of global experience, operational know-how and strong culture allows it to create global sustainability leaders at scale. Since inception, Actis has raised $26 billion to invest in a better tomorrow. Actis is a signatory to the United Nations backed Principles for Responsible Investment (UNPRI), an investor initiative developed by the UNEP FI. The firm has consistently been awarded the highest rating score in the UNPRI independent assessment. You can learn more about Actis at www.act.is.

Position Description

General Atlantic is looking to hire an Analyst to support the Actis Southeast Asia Real Estate team, based in Singapore. This is a small, high-ownership team investing in real assets across the region: the Analyst will work on live transactions from first screen through to structuring, financing, asset management and exit, rather than a single slice of the process.

You will build and own the models that underpin pricing and structuring decisions, run defined diligence workstreams with external advisers, and draft the memoranda that go to Investment Committee. The work is quantitative, commercially exposed and visible to senior members of the firm from day one.

Why This Role

Ownership from day one. In a small Singapore team, the Analyst owns models, diligence workstreams and adviser relationships directly
The full lifecycle. Origination, underwriting, structuring, debt financing, asset management and exit
Real assets, real complexity. Development and operating risk, project-level debt, joint venture and platform structures, and multiple Southeast Asian jurisdictions — technical ground that compounds into a durable specialism
Senior access and a defined path. Direct working exposure to Managing Directors and Principals

Responsibilities

Build and own asset- and platform-level financial models — development and operating cash flows, project finance debt sizing, joint venture waterfalls and returns analysis — and run the sensitivities that inform pricing and structuring decisions
Draft investment memoranda and Investment Committee presentations, translating diligence findings into a clear investment case with risks and mitigants set out plainly
Run defined due diligence workstreams end to end — commercial, technical, legal, tax and insurance — coordinating external advisers, tracking issues to resolution and escalating what matters
Support capital structuring and debt raising, including lender materials, base and downside cases, and covenant and debt service coverage analysis
Maintain the team’s market evidence base: supply and demand, rents and yields, land pricing, comparable transactions, buyer appetite and exit routes across the region
Conduct proprietary primary research through calls with operators, developers, occupiers, consultants and other industry contacts
Work alongside Managing Directors, Principals and portfolio company management on value creation — budget review, capital expenditure tracking, performance reporting and asset-level initiatives
Support origination: screening opportunities, preparing early-stage pricing views and keeping the pipeline current

The First Twelve Months

By month three you should be able to build a development cash flow model from a blank sheet and defend the assumptions in it. By month six you should be running a diligence workstream with limited supervision and drafting sections of an Investment Committee paper. By month twelve you should be the person on the team who knows the market data best and be trusted to take an adviser call alone.

Join our team and play a pivotal role in building General Atlantic’s real estate and sustainable infrastructure footprint in Southeast Asia. If you are a results-oriented professional with a passion for real assets and investing, we invite you to apply.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Finance, Business, Accounting, Economics, Engineering or a related field
1+ years of full-time relevant experience required (investment banking or private equity preferred; consulting or relevant operating experience will also be considered)
Superior financial modelling skills: able to build, audit and stress-test complex models from a blank sheet with minimal guidance
Strong understanding of accounting principles and the ability to read financial statements critically
Strong analytical ability, sound commercial judgement and professional maturity
Advanced Microsoft Excel; strong PowerPoint and Word
A clear communicator who can hold a view and defend it with evidence, and change it when the evidence changes; verbal and written fluency in English.
Comfortable with regular travel across Southeast Asia
Record of outstanding academic and professional achievement, high energy, and a real interest in investing
Collaborative and intellectually curious about how assets, markets and capital structures actually behave

Preferred

CFA Level II or Level III candidate or charterholder, or comparable evidence of quantitative discipline
Exposure to real estate, infrastructure, project finance or another real asset class — including development, construction or operating assets
Experience working directly with external advisers, lenders or joint venture partners
An additional Southeast Asian language (Vietnamese, Bahasa Malaysia or Indonesia, Thai or Mandarin) is advantageous, but not required

Attributes we look for

You check your own work, flag your own errors early, and understand that a number in an Investment Committee paper carries your judgement with it
Proactive and low-ego, with a genuine willingness to pick up the unglamorous work
A clear communicator who can hold a view and defend it with evidence, and change it when the evidence changes
Intellectually curious about how assets, markets and capital structures actually behave
Record of outstanding academic and professional achievement
High energy, and a real interest in investing
Keen to collaborate with colleagues across the firm globally

GA Values

Competitive compensation, including a performance-linked bonus
Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage
Retirement savings provision in line with local statutory requirements and market practice
Support for professional development and qualifications, including structured training
Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for advancement

Process

Please apply with your CV and a short note (no more than half a page) on an asset, sector or transaction you find interesting and why. Shortlisted candidates will complete a timed modelling exercise and meet the Singapore team as well as senior members of the global Real Estate and Sustainable Infrastructure platform.

General Atlantic is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

By completing this application, you are consenting to General Atlantic’s processing and use of your personal data. Information on how General Atlantic will use and process your data can be found here: https://www.generalatlantic.com/privacy-notice/

title: Head of Futures
description:
Synthesis x Head of Futures

At Synthesis, we push the boundaries of what’s possible with Open Source Intelligence. It’s a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment vibrant with collaboration and creativity, at the intersection of data science, cultural analysis & brand consultancy (we call this HCDS: Human Centred Data Science!).

We are looking for people who are culturally curious and passionate about data storytelling.

We work with famous brands including Netflix, Nike, PepsiCo, 2K Games, Amazon Music, Pernod Ricard, Brown-Forman and Tetra Pak. Our team is nimble, diverse, and adaptable. Together we represent a variety of experiences – from computer science, digital anthropology, engineering, advertising, to gaming and law.

We will have a great working relationship if you...

Are comfortable with open-ended challenges, working collaboratively to find creative solutions

Are innately curious, interested in macro, consumer, cultural and category shifts

Have the drive to learn and innovate new technologies and methodologies

Have strong written and communication skills

The Head of Futures at Synthesis develops strategies, innovations and scenarios for the sharpest insights and marketing professionals in the world.

Your core focus:

Leading a business unit.

Working closely with the leadership team. You will have the freedom to guide and coach a multidisciplinary team of data scientists and strategists. This includes leading decisions on recruitment and financial planning. You will oversee multiple projects, ensuring efficient resourcing and high-quality output.

Business development:

Working together with the leadership team, you will play a crucial role in establishing and growing client partnerships with existing and new clients. This means writing proposals, pitching, helping design approaches for new and existing clients and brainstorming cross-sell ideas to grow clients across the business.

Commercial foresight storytelling:

You will craft persuasive, memorable data-driven narratives and scenarios around how people will live, work and play, and how businesses will operate and grow in the next 5-10 years, including translating words into experiences to bring the future to life, presenting confidently and persuasively to influence the next steps of senior stakeholders.

Trusted advisor for world-leading clients:

You will be the day-to-day lead and decision-maker. Your role will require you to deeply understand our client’s business, run projects end-to-end and have a ‘nose’ for what’s next through forward-looking insights and innovations that will be most useful and inspiring for their growth strategy.

You’ll need:

10+ years' experience working in trends and foresight, strategy and planning, management consultancy, or a related role. Foresight experience is an advantage.

Strong analytical skills: an ability to translate client requirements into data briefings with the data science team, confidently digest complex datasets, and process and layer different data outputs to build a complete picture of people, categories and themes in the next 5-10 years

Strong creativity and communication skills: extraordinary writing, visual storytelling, experience design and presentation skills to bring ideas to life

Strong interpersonal skills: a flexible thinker who thrives in positive, collaborative environments and can work under pressure. Naturally adopts a ‘plussing’ approach– pushes, questions and stretches thinking by adding, not criticising without suggestions

Openness and enjoyment of iteratively developing your ideas, drawing on the value of the diverse perspectives of those around you. You recognise the value of having an array of approaches at your disposal rather than focusing solely on one methodology or model.

Advantageous, but not required:

Experience working with Google Scholar and Google Patents as well as census, search, social, advertising & e-commerce data

Knowledge of quantitative, statistical and qualitative research techniques and analysis

About Working Here

We are a diverse team; we value creativity, a ‘plussing’ mindset and collaboration. To help create this, we offer flexible working and a supportive environment. This includes the following benefits:

Twice yearly, uncapped profit-share bonus scheme—so everyone is collectively rewarded for business success.

20 days paid holidays per annum + Public holidays + Whole company paid ‘reading week’ between Christmas and New Year.

10:00-15:00 core working hours for meetings, otherwise flexible working.

No meetings on Fridays, wherever possible, to secure Friday as a focus working day.

Opportunity to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per calendar year.

Performance Program to support continuous learning, including an annual conference or language-learning budget, time allocated for learning, and mentorship.

AIA health insurance and an extra SGD $1000 per annum for health and wellbeing.

Paid maternity and paternity leave

Synthesis is a data science-fuelled brand consultancy

We do Human Centred Data Science. The rigorous exploration of data underpinned by a strategic understanding of people, category and context

We use human understanding to ask better questions of the numbers. Our proprietary frameworks and algorithms are designed and tested by category experts to ensure we deliver fresh, smart and actionable output

Our team has experience across sectors, from beauty, to travel, FMCG and new media. We work globally and our tools work with all major languages, but we have special focus on Asia

We work on:

- Brand Equity & Positioning

- M&A and Portfolio Strategy

- Market & Target Understanding

- Advocacy & Influencer Strategy

- Early Trend Identification

- Service Experience Evolution

- Communications Strategy

title: Intern - Consumer & Business Insights & Analytics (CBIA)
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Hello. We’re Haleon. A new world-leading consumer health company. Shaped by all who join us. Together, we’re improving everyday health for billions of people. By growing and innovating our global portfolio of category-leading brands – including Sensodyne, Panadol, Advil, Voltaren, Theraflu, Otrivin, and Centrum – through a unique combination of deep human understanding and trusted science. What’s more, we’re achieving it in a company that we’re in control of. In an environment that we’re co-creating. And a culture that’s uniquely ours. Care to join us. It isn’t a question.

This is an exciting time to join us and help shape the future. It’s an opportunity to be part of something special.

Job Purpose

As the APAC Wellness Consumer and Business Insights and Analytics (CBIA) Intern, you will be working with a highly visible and strategic team partnering with the business and be part of a function that sparks corporate imagination! You will be integrated into both a dynamic and growing APAC Wellness CBIA team in Haleon, as well as the APAC Wellness Marketing team, with a specific focus on building deep consumer and category understanding and bringing that to life and back into the business.

Title of Hiring Manager: Senior Consumer and Business Insights & Analytics Manager, APAC Wellness
Number of internship positions: 1
Preferred Period of Internship Required: January 2027 – June/July 2027
Preferred (not required) School/Course of Intern: Undergraduates or postgraduate students in Social Sciences/ Psychology/ Communications/ Marketing / Business Analytics/Research/Mathematics/Statistics or related disciplines

Key Responsibilities:
You will be responsible for specific projects across our 3 categories, driving analyses in the spaces of:

Researching innovation trends across APAC markets with specific Wellness (Vitamins & Supplements) focus-areas to inspire and benchmark Haleon innovation plans/ pipelines
Analyses of communication & brand health in a particular set of APAC markets with specific category focus-areas to mine for insights in competitor communication
Researching consumer trends and insights for new aspirational wellness consumers
Analyses of different businesses and category landscape to drive business decision
Looking at new applications of AI in the context of CBIA as ‘experimental’ pilot projects

Learning Outcomes

Throughout the course of the internship, you will attain the following learning objectives:

Master the Art of Data Storytelling and Analytics: Learn how to transform complex data into compelling narratives that drive business decisions and captivate stakeholders.
Dive into Consumer Behaviour and Psychology: Gain insights into consumer trends and behaviours, and discover how to leverage this knowledge to enhance product strategies and marketing efforts.
Collaborate and Innovate: Work closely with cross-functional teams to brainstorm and implement innovative solutions that address real-world business challenges.

Why You?

We are seeking candidates with the following skills and competencies:

(Preferred not Required) Undergraduates or postgraduate students in Social Sciences/ Psychology/ Communications/ Marketing / Business Analytics/Research/Mathematics/Statistics or related disciplines
Basic knowledge on excel is preferred. Power BI and other coding are optional.
Analytical and curious mind to challenge the status quo
Deep curiosity on how human behavior and psychology
Able to work with large data sets and dig deep when necessary
Having a creative and “think outside of the box” mindset
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Collaborative mindset
Applicants are requested to specify their internship start and end dates in their application.

Interested?

Upon submission of applications, we will be contacting shortlisted candidates for an initial conversation to share more about Haleon and our recruitment process. We recommend you apply as soon as possible, because we accept ongoing applications and offer positions on a first come, first served basis.

At Haleon we embrace our diverse workforce by creating an inclusive environment that celebrates our unique perspectives, generates curiosity to create unmatched understanding of each other, and promotes fair and equitable outcomes for everyone. We’re striving to create a climate where we celebrate our diversity in all forms by treating each other with respect, listening to different viewpoints, supporting our communities, and creating a workplace where your authentic self belongs and thrives. We believe in an agile working culture for all our roles. If flexibility is important to you, we encourage you to explore with our hiring team what the opportunities are.

 Job Posting End Date

2026-11-05

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. title: Senior R&D Formulator
description:
About Hysses

Hysses (乡术 — “arts from the village”) is Singapore’s leading aromatherapy and natural wellness brand, with a retail footprint of essential oil-based skincare, haircare, body care, and home scent products across Singapore, Malaysia, and beyond. All formulation, research, and development is done in-house at the Hysses Singapore HQ.

Hysses formulates with natural botanicals and bioactive ingredients, sourced from farmers and native communities worldwide, and is committed to genuine efficacy over ingredient trends — avoiding synthetic silicones, parabens, paraffin, artificial colours, synthetic fragrances, and unrefined petroleum-derived ingredients. The brand’s growth has been driven by a small, hands-on R&D team responsible for everything from raw material sourcing to finished product launch.

Role Summary

The Senior R&D Formulator will lead the development of new products and reformulation of existing ones across Hysses’ skincare, haircare, body care, and home fragrance/essential oil ranges. This is a senior, hands-on technical role for an experienced formulator who can independently own projects from concept to commercial launch — balancing natural/clean-beauty ingredient philosophy, sensory and olfactory quality, regulatory compliance, cost, and manufacturability.

The role also carries a mentorship component, guiding junior formulators and coordinating closely with sourcing, QA, regulatory, marketing, and manufacturing partners.

Key Responsibilities

Formulation & Product Development

Independently develop, trial, and optimise formulations for skincare, haircare, body care, and home/car scent products using natural botanical actives, essential oils, and bioactive ingredients.

Lead formulation projects end-to-end: concept briefs, bench trials, stability testing, pilot batches, scale-up, and handover to production.

Reformulate existing SKUs to improve efficacy, sensory experience, stability, cost, or compliance with Hysses’ clean-formulation standards (free from synthetic silicones, parabens, paraffin, artificial colours, synthetic fragrances, and unrefined petroleum derivatives).

Design and refine essential oil blends and fragrance accords for both leave-on/rinse-off body products and ambient home scent

formats (diffuser oils, room mists, candles).

Technical & Quality Ownership

Conduct and oversee stability testing (accelerated & real-time), compatibility testing, challenge testing, and preservative efficacy studies in coordination with QA/QC and external labs.

Troubleshoot formulation issues arising in pilot or full-scale production runs (viscosity, separation, discolouration, scent drift, microbial stability, etc.).

Maintain rigorous documentation: formulation records, batch trial data, INCI listings, safety data, and version control for all formulas.

Ensure all formulations meet applicable regulatory requirements across Hysses’ markets (e.g., Singapore HSA cosmetic notification,

ASEAN Cosmetic Directive, and relevant requirements in export markets).

Ingredient & Supplier Management

Source, vet, and qualify new natural and bioactive raw materials, essential oils, and botanical extracts, working directly with farmers, growers, and ingredient suppliers.

Evaluate raw materials for purity, sustainability, traceability, and consistency with Hysses’ natural-ingredient philosophy.

Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the aromatherapy and natural ingredient landscape, including emerging actives, extraction techniques, and sustainable sourcing practices.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Marketing and Product teams to translate brand and consumer briefs into technically sound, launch-ready formulations.

Work with Manufacturing/Operations to ensure formulas are scalable, cost-effective, and manufacturable within existing production capabilities.

Liaise with Regulatory/QA on labelling, claims substantiation, and safety documentation.

Support packaging compatibility testing in coordination with the packaging development team.

Leadership & Process

Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior formulators and R&D associates.

Help establish and improve R&D processes, documentation standards, and lab protocols as the team and product range scale.

Contribute to long-term R&D roadmap and innovation pipeline planning.

Requirements

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field.

Hands-on formulation experience in cosmetics/personal care, with demonstrated ownership of products from concept through commercial launch.

Proven experience formulating with natural, naturally-derived, and/or essential oil-based ingredient systems is strongly preferred; aromatherapy or fragrance formulation experience is a strong plus.

Experience across multiple product categories (skincare, haircare, body care, and/or home fragrance) preferred.

Technical Skills

Strong working knowledge of cosmetic chemistry: emulsions, surfactant systems, natural preservation/preservative-boosting strategies, rheology, and natural emulsifiers/thickeners.

Familiarity with essential oil chemistry, blending, and safe usage levels (IFRA guidelines knowledge a plus).

Working knowledge of ASEAN Cosmetic Directive and/or Singapore HSA cosmetic product notification requirements; familiarity with international regulatory frameworks (EU, US, China) is an advantage.

Comfortable with stability protocol design, analytical/QC basics, and reading INCI/safety documentation.

Proficient with formulation costing and understanding manufacturing/scale-up constraints.

Personal Attributes

Strong sensory evaluation skills (texture, scent, colour, performance) and genuine passion for natural/botanical ingredients.

Detail-oriented with excellent documentation discipline.

Able to work independently and take ownership of multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Strong cross-functional communicator, comfortable working closely with sourcing, marketing, and operations teams.

Interest in sustainability, ethical sourcing, and holistic wellness aligned with Hysses’ brand values.

What Hysses Offers

A senior, high-ownership R&D role at Singapore’s leading homegrown aromatherapy brand, with formulations developed entirely in-house.

Direct exposure to the full product lifecycle — from raw ingredient sourcing through to retail shelf across a growing regional footprint (Singapore, Malaysia, and beyond).

A close-knit, hands-on team environment with direct access to leadership and cross-functional decision-making.

The opportunity to shape formulation standards and R&D processes as the brand scales into new categories and markets.

Location & Work Arrangement

Based at the Hysses Singapore Headquarters / R&D Lab. This is an on-site, lab-based role given the hands-on nature of formulation and bench work.

Barn & Potter – Experience Nature through wellness

Barn & Potter is founded in Singapore in 2013. The brand was inspired by the rich history of both traditional folk pottery and aromatic medicine in the olden days. We focus on manufacturing high-quality aromatherapy, wellness and skincare products for retail brands.

We use only the finest ingredients from best plantations around the world. These include – USA, Brazil, India, Thailand, Egypt, Australia, Bulgaria, Italy and France. Our products are 100% naturopathic, that is, no form of petrochemicals and synthetic fragrances are used. From harvest to distillation, to design and innovation, we ensure devotion to detail and responsibility to Natural – socially and environmentally governed by goods manufacturing process (GMP).

Our aim is to research and develop innovative products using premium oils and exciting raw materials. Our RND work closely with our manufacturing facilities to produce customised aromatherapy products based on the specification stated by our customers.

title: Trainee Operations Executive
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a motivated Graduate to join our team as a

Trainee Operations Executive

. This role provides an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in tanker operations, voyage administration, chartering support and commercial shipping activities. The successful candidate will work closely with experienced industry professionals and senior management, developing a strong understanding of vessel operations, freight markets, charter parties, commercial processes and the wider maritime industry. In addition to operational responsibilities, the candidate will occasionally support senior management on special projects involving market research, business analysis and strategic initiatives, providing exposure to broader commercial and corporate aspects of the shipping business. This position is intended for individuals seeking a long-term career in the maritime industry.

Graduates from Nanyang Technological University, National University of Singapore, Singapore Management University, Singapore Institute of Technology, Singapore University of Social Sciences and the local polytechnics are encouraged to apply. Recent Graduates with limited experience but strong academic performance and a keen interest in shipping will be considered.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Tanker Operations Support

• Assist with day-to-day operational matters relating to tanker vessel voyages.

• Monitor vessel movements, voyage progress, port calls, ETA/ETD and operational status.

• Maintain voyage schedules, vessel trackers and operational databases.

• Follow up with Masters, vessel operators, agents, terminals and counterparties on operational matters.

• Monitor loading, discharging, shifting, waiting time and other port activities.

• Assist in the preparation and maintenance of voyage files and operational records.

• Support compliance with company operational procedures and reporting requirements.

2. Laytime & Demurrage Administration

• Assist with laytime and demurrage calculations under supervision.

• Review Statements of Facts (SOF), Notices of Readiness (NOR) and supporting port documentation.

• Record operational timings accurately within calculation templates and tracking systems.

• Maintain demurrage records, outstanding claims logs and supporting documentation.

• Follow up with agents and counterparties to obtain missing operational documents.

3. Freight & Commercial Administration

• Assist in preparing freight invoices and supporting documentation.

• Verify quantities, freight rates and voyage details prior to submission for review.

• Maintain invoice tracking systems and commercial records.

• Support follow-up of outstanding invoices and voyage-related accounts.

• Assist with maintenance of cargo, bunker and voyage information databases.

4. Chartering & Market Support

• Support chartering personnel with administrative and research tasks.

• Monitor freight market developments and vessel positions.

• Assist in preparing internal market reports and commercial updates.

• Maintain records of vessel fixtures, chartering activities and market intelligence.

• Compile information on vessel availability, cargo opportunities and freight movements.

5. Document Management & E-Filing

• Maintain proper electronic filing of vessel, voyage and commercial documents.

• Organise Bills of Lading, cargo documentation, invoices, charter party documents, SOFs, NORs and operational correspondence.

• Ensure documents are correctly filed and easily retrievable.

• Maintain accurate and organised records in accordance with company procedures.

6. Management & Strategic Project Support

• Support senior management on special projects and business initiatives as required.

• Conduct research on shipping markets, industry developments, competitors and emerging trends.

• Assist in gathering and analysing operational, commercial and market data.

• Prepare management reports, presentations and briefing materials.

• Support data collection for business development opportunities, investment reviews and strategic discussions.

• Assist with due diligence information gathering and management presentations where required.

• Undertake ad hoc assignments and special projects as directed by management.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Candidates should possess a degree or diploma in a relevant discipline, including:

Singapore Maritime and Maritime-Related Programmes

• Bachelor of Science (Maritime Studies) – Nanyang Technological University (NTU)

• Bachelor of Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Accountancy or related disciplines from recognised universities

• Engineering degrees with an interest in shipping and commercial operations

• Maritime Business or Logistics-related degrees from recognised institutions

Polytechnic Graduates

• Diploma in Maritime Business

• Diploma in Maritime & Offshore Management

• Diploma in International Logistics & Supply Chain Management

• Diploma in Business Studies

• Diploma in Accountancy & Finance

• Other relevant business, logistics or engineering diplomas

DESIRE SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES:

• Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

• Good numerical aptitude and attention to detail.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Microsoft Office applications.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and work under deadlines.

• Self-motivated with a willingness to learn.

• Commercial curiosity and interest in global shipping markets.

• Ability to work effectively with both operational and commercial teams.

• Professional attitude and willingness to take ownership of assigned tasks.

• Interest in developing a long-term career within the maritime and shipping industry.

About the Norstar Group

Norstar Ship Management Pte Ltd (NSM) is a privately owned, Singapore-headquartered ship management company founded by Chris and Tom Bonehill. NSM specialises in the fully integrated management of hazardous product tankers, gas carriers and bulk carriers worldwide - providing commercial management, technical management, crew management and owner accounting under one roof.

NSM currently manages a fleet of ocean going vessels across multiple flags with approximately shore staff globally and over 2,000 active seafarers. The Group has offices in Singapore, Westport CT(USA), Yangon (Myanmar), Tokyo (Japan), Khobar (Saudi Arabia) and Delhi(India). NSM's client roster includes oil majors and other leading global energy and commodity companies.

As regulation develops and institutional adoption accelerates, Helix provides the infrastructure needed to support tokenised asset markets across diverse regulatory environments and institutional workflows. Purpose-built for Southeast Asia and broader Asian markets, Helix supports multi-jurisdictional issuance and a wide range of asset classes, including funds, bonds, private credit, real estate, equities, gold, stablecoins, and more. Its modular, chain-agnostic, end-to-end stack spans issuance, compliance, custody, and distribution, integrating directly into existing institutional workflows.

Helix powers Myrra, the platform underpinning Bank Kenanga’s launch of Malaysia’s first tokenised money market funds in February 2026. Led by TradFi veterans with a $900M+ track record built over eight years, Helix is grounded in the operational realities of institutional finance.

A winner of the Tokenised Debt & Bond Award at the 2023 TADS Awards, Helix is backed by top-tier venture capital firms including Kenanga Bank, Taisu Ventures, Saison Capital, Superscrypt, Outlier Ventures, Comma3 Ventures, Wave Digital, NewTribe Capital, Aptos, and Gallet Capital. We are also supported by select angels from leading organisations such as Fireblocks, BlockTower, NeoClassic Capital, Algorand, Hedera, Wormhole, Synthetix, and the Milken Institute.

Job Description

As a Business Analyst Intern at Helix, you will work directly with our Product Manager and CEO across several client platforms that we build in parallel. You will help capture what clients need, translate them into clear business and product requirements, and support projects through implementation and delivery. You will gain hands-on exposure to how Institutional Banks, Asset Managers, Fintechs, and Enterprises adopt Tokenisation Infrastructure to launch and scale Tokenised real-world assets (RWAs) and stablecoins.

This role is ideal for someone who is structured, detail-oriented and comfortable working with clients, and interested in the intersection of institutional finance, technology, and digital assets.

Business Development Support

Skill Sets and Requirements

Strong attention to detail and time management skills

Nice-to-Haves

Interest in FinTech, Asset Tokenization, Blockchain, or Web3
Familiarity with tools like Azure Board, Jira, Linear, Canva, or Figma
Prior internship or project experience in business analysis, product or consulting
