title: Senior Analyst - APAC Growth
description:
Your mission will be to deeply understand the needs of APAC customers and help your team to focus on solving their most critical problems.

The focus of this team is to ensure that money moves in and out of Wise in the most seamless, cost-effective, convenient, and fast way for customers. The goal for you, in this role will be to focus on and affect the parts of our product that will help us scale 10x as we enable core functionality for global money transfers.

Here’s how you’ll be contributing:

You’ll derive actionable insights from data to inform product decisions, which includes funnel analysis to optimize conversions across the customer journey from onboarding, retention to reactivation

You’ll partner with Product Managers and other Analysts to set growth KPIs for the region and monitor the impact of new product features on conversion, stickiness and engagement

You’ll help to understand our customers to uncover unmet needs to support on strategic product discovery research for new product opportunities

You’ll help building conviction on high-value areas and challenging them if there are faster or more effective ways to grow the market

You’ll contribute to a collaborative team environment, where ideas are shared and openness is valued

This role will give you the opportunity to:

Choose your path to impact – we believe people are most empowered when they can act autonomously. So rather than telling you what to do, you’ll work with your team to create a vision of your own. Of course, you can always gather feedback from smart, curious people across Wise but you’ll have the freedom to make your own calls

Grow as a Product Analyst – Grow and inspire your team and others across Wise

Get amazing exposure to the full breadth and depth of our product while working with a group of multi disciplinary teams of amazing, smart and dedicated product analysts, engineers, product managers, researchers, designers and many more

The freedom to have real impact – The opportunities you’ll identify are key to Wise reaching future millions of customers and redefining how payments work internationally at scale

A fun work environment with loads of social activities and events at your team and analytics community level

Be part of our mission to make money without borders the new normal

Ideal candidate would have:

At least 2 years of relevant experience in a data driven and complex environment with limited guidance

Strong analytical mind and product intuition

Technical skill-set in Python, advanced SQL, BI tools

Experience working with technical teams (PMs, engineers, designers, analysts)

Understanding of events data - Mixpanel / Google Analytics / Amplitude or similar

Excellent data visualisation and presentation skills

Hustler-mentality. You can take work beyond the analysis and get things done.

Good to have:

Knowledge of the fintech ecosystem

Knowledge of utilities like Airflow/Github/DBT

Experience on funnel optimization

Experience in Data Science and Machine Learning

Interest in learning new tools

Who we are

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move money around the world. With the Wise account people and businesses can hold over 40 currencies, move money between countries and spend money abroad. Large companies and banks use Wise technology too; an entirely new cross-border payments network that will one day power money without borders for everyone, everywhere. However you use the platform, Wise is on a mission to make your life easier and save you money.

Co-founded by Kristo Käärmann and Taavet Hinrikus, Wise launched in 2011 under its original name TransferWise. It is one of the world’s fastest growing, profitable technology companies and is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker, WISE.

16 million people and businesses use Wise. In fiscal year 2023, Wise processed approximately £105 billion in cross-border transactions, saving customers around £1.5 billion.

What it’s really like to work here

At Wise, we do things a bit differently. There’s no corporate nonsense, and no old-fashioned hierarchy. Instead, we work in dozens of self-sufficient, autonomous teams. Think of them like start-ups within a start-up that learn from each other.

Each team picks the problems they want to solve. So there’s no micro-management. No hiding behind fancy job titles. And no one telling you what to do. You are your own boss. But you’ll get tons of guidance and plenty of support from talented, super-smart colleagues from all over Wise.

We’re going to be upfront — the way we work doesn’t suit everyone. But if freedom, autonomy, and life-affirming, head-scratching professional challenges rock your world, we could be a match made in heaven.

The VP, Pricing, Protection, India is one of the leaders of Pacific Life Re’s India Protection business and a member of the India Protection Market Leadership Committee (PMLC) that sets our strategic and tactical objectives and plays a key role in the overall success of the India business, including how we can leverage our core capabilities to shape and achieve our market strategy and delivering an aligned functional strategy.

Specific local pricing responsibilities are for the performance of the India pricing function, incorporating all aspects of the pricing process including setting of bases, development of pricing terms and management of the pricing pipeline.

The role is a core member of the global Protection Pricing Functional Leadership Team (FLT), with shared accountability for executing global pricing strategy, shaping functional priorities, and driving consistent execution and capability uplift across regions. The incumbent is expected to operate as a peer leader within the global Pricing FLT, constructively challenging ideas, influencing outcomes beyond their home market, and representing regional perspectives while acting in the best interests of the global Protection Pricing function.

The incumbent will have a deep understanding of client requirements and play a key role in developing solutions that appropriately balance the needs of Pacific Life Re and the client. The incumbent will also support the AVP, Client Solutions, Protection, India in building and maintaining relationships with clients and partners in India.

The individual will lead the India Pricing team and work closely with other functions including Client Solutions, R&D, Underwriting & Claims Solutions and Services, and Corporate Actuarial areas.

The incumbent will be responsible for overseeing risk management processes, ensuring that all quotes comply with Pricing standards and that appropriate processes and documentation standards are in place.

In addition, they will also be expected to collaborate with the Divisional Pricing team (supported by the Global Pricing team) which is responsible for the oversight and support of pricing across Pacific Life Re. This will include collaboration in areas such as prioritisation and co-ordination of global projects (e.g. actuarial model changes), co-ordination of information for quotes needing to be approved within Pacific Life and development of various aspects of the underlying bases such as non-decrement terms of trade.

Finally, the incumbent will be a part of the broader Pacific Life Re Leadership Team.

Managing workflow,

Sponsoring and, where appropriate, leading global or cross‑regional initiatives (e.g. methodology changes, model development, process improvement, talent initiatives)

Support the VP, Protection and AVP, Client Solutions in building and maintaining effective relationships with clients and promoting the Pacific Life Re brand. Deep experience in operating in market facing roles in (re)insurance. Experience in the markets that PL Re focuses on would be preferred and global experience would be considered an advantage

What drives us is our mission to deliver energy for the world today, and to find solutions for tomorrow. If you want to make lives better around the world by providing access to energy, while working on sustainability and decarbonisation, we'd like to hear from you. Working at BW you will feel the pulse of the world each day. If something happens in the world, we feel it, and you can play your part by anticipating and responding to it. Our high-performing teams are drawn to BW by the global nature of our work and the satisfaction of working with collaborative people who inspire each other to deliver exceptional results.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Role Overview

Based in Singapore and reporting to the Chief People Officer, BW Group, the Head of Communications & Brand leads communications and corporate brand activities across BW Group whilst also supporting BW LNG.

This is a highly visible role partnering closely with the Chairman, senior executives and Communications leaders across our affiliate companies to strengthen BW's reputation, shape its corporate narrative and foster greater collaboration across the Group.

Success requires far more than exceptional communications capability. You will be a commercially minded strategic thinker who anticipates issues, shapes narratives and influences outcomes through sound judgement, trusted relationships and collaboration in a federated organisation where credibility matters more than hierarchy.

Working with a lean team and external partners, you will combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, helping shape executive communications, protect and enhance the BW brand, support organisational transformation and drive communications excellence across the Group.

Key Accountabilities

Corporate Communications

Develop and deliver BW Group's corporate communications strategy aligned with the Group's long-term vision and priorities.

Shape compelling narratives that strengthen understanding of BW's purpose, strategy and portfolio of businesses.

Advise leaders on communications strategy, executive messaging and stakeholder engagement.

Lead communications for strategic initiatives, organisational change, major announcements and corporate events.

Oversee BW Group's digital communications, including LinkedIn and other channels, delivering engaging content that strengthens the brand and supports strategic objectives.

Executive

Communications

Partner closely with the Chairman and senior executives on speeches, presentations, thought leadership and executive communications.

Develop executive communications that reflect BW's values and high editorial standards.

Lead the production of flagship Group communications, including World Horizon, the Annual Report, Sustainability Report, corporate website and key leadership updates.

Support senior executives at conferences, media engagements, investor events and industry forums through end-to-end communications planning and delivery.

Serve as a trusted communications adviser to the Chairman and senior leadership, providing sound judgement on messaging, stakeholder considerations and reputational matters.

Employee

Communications

Lead Group-wide employee communications across digital channels.

Deliver engaging communications that connect shore-based and seafaring employees through platforms such as BW Connect.

Foster a culture of openness, pride and engagement across the Group.

Brand & Reputation

Act as steward of the BW corporate brand, ensuring consistency whilst respecting the autonomy of our affiliate businesses.

Evolve BW's corporate identity and positioning to strengthen the Group's reputation and create value across the portfolio.

Protect and enhance BW's reputation with employees, customers, investors, regulators, partners and the wider maritime and energy community.

Lead crisis and issues communications, partnering with senior management and external advisers as required for ongoing incidents and with post-communications.

BW LNG Communications & Marketing

Partner with the BW LNG leadership team to develop communications and marketing initiatives that strengthen the company's commercial positioning and reputation.

Lead communications supporting commercial initiatives, including vessel launches, technology innovations, customer campaigns and industry events.

Develop marketing content and digital campaigns that showcase BW LNG's capabilities, innovation and market leadership.

Ensure alignment between BW LNG's communications and the wider BW corporate brand.

Leadership & Influence

Lead BW's Communications Community of Practice, fostering collaboration, sharing best practice and identifying opportunities for greater alignment across affiliate companies.

Build trusted relationships with affiliate CEOs and Communications leaders, influencing through credibility rather than authority.

Foster collaboration across the Group whilst respecting the entrepreneurial culture and autonomy of individual businesses.

Digital Communications & AI

Harness AI and emerging technologies to improve the quality, consistency, efficiency and reach of communications.

Identify and implement new tools, channels and approaches that enhance engagement and communications effectiveness.

Measure communications impact using meaningful qualitative and quantitative insights.

Team Leadership

Lead, coach and develop a small, high-performing communications team.

Manage external agencies and specialist partners to maximise quality, capability and value.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

We're looking for someone who combines strategic communications leadership with exceptional judgement and the ability to influence senior stakeholders. You'll ideally bring:

Significant experience leading corporate communications within a global organisation or consultancy.

Experience advising CEOs and senior executives on communications strategy and reputation management.

Strong understanding of corporate branding, stakeholder engagement and executive communications.

Experience leading communications during periods of organisational change, transformation or significant corporate activity.

Experience working across complex, matrixed or federated organisations would be advantageous.

Experience within the maritime or energy sectors would be beneficial, although not essential.

What Will Make You Successful

You'll be someone who naturally earns trust and credibility. You'll demonstrate:

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

Excellent judgement and discretion.

The ability to simplify complex issues into clear, compelling messages.

Exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills.

Strong commercial awareness.

High levels of curiosity and strategic thinking.

Comfort working directly with senior executives and Board-level stakeholders.

A collaborative style with low ego and high integrity.

The ability to balance strategic thinking with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and deliver.

Demonstrates sound judgement in knowing when to follow established processes and when a pragmatic, flexible approach will deliver a better outcome.

A passion for continuous improvement, innovation and practical application of AI.

This role is unlikely to suit someone who prefers highly structured environments, relies on formal authority to get things done, or wants to specialise in a single area of communications. Success requires sound judgement, adaptability, collaboration and a willingness to operate across a broad range of strategic and hands-on responsibilities.

OTHER INFORMATION

Why BW?

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the voice and reputation of one of the world's most respected maritime and energy groups.

You'll work closely with visionary leaders who value integrity, long-term thinking and collaboration, while helping tell the story of a business investing in both today's energy needs and tomorrow's energy transition.

The role offers exceptional breadth, combining strategy, executive partnership, brand leadership, organisational change, employee engagement and external communications in an entrepreneurial international environment.

Please note that your application will be sent to and reviewed by the direct employer - BW Maritime

title: Data Center Operation Technician, Data Center Operations
description:
DESCRIPTION

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.
Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.

Key job responsibilities
In this role as a Data Center Operations Technician, you will be responsible for the on-site management of hardware lifecycle of our IT infrastructure that includes:
- You will work as part of the Operations team; whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
- Your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.
- You will work and meet SLAs against assigned trouble tickets via a directed workflow, be the first line touch point for hardware troubleshooting and technical issues.
- You will perform on-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
- You will participate in team meetings for metric analysis and to discuss achieving daily/weekly goals.
- You have the knowledge of the policies and procedures, including safety and security, within your department, and understand the appropriate application of such knowledge
- You will contribute to documentation on technical issues through root cause analysis for operational issues that occur, and contribute to process improvement initiatives relevant to the data center environment.
- More experienced technicians may assist in training less experienced members of the team.
- Involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

A day in the life
You will support DC (Data Center) infrastructure equipment (e.g. racks, servers, networking devices, hardware components, cables, etc.),

You will follow the instructions ticket-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution and perform routine operation activities on hardware, or spare parts, including rack install, server break/fix, rack decom etc.

You will perform on-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving

You will be involved with site management and maintain tidiness in operation areas

Your role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience
- 1+ years of computer networking experience
- High school or equivalent diploma

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Pet Nutritionist
description:
We are looking for a Nutritionist to join BOM BOM, supporting personalised pet nutrition, nutritional data analysis and new product development. In this role, you will provide tailored dietary recommendations for pets, maintain our nutritional database and SOPs, and contribute to the development and improvement of our pet food products. You will work closely with our Customer Solutions, Operations and Marketing teams to ensure our nutritional recommendations and products are accurate, practical and aligned with established nutritional standards. You will also play a role in improving our Nutrition BOM BOT AI system by reviewing nutritional information, analysing customer insights and enhancing the accuracy of its recommendations. If you have a strong foundation in animal nutrition, enjoy working with data and product development, and are a pet owner who is genuinely passionate about pet health and nutrition, we’d love for you to join us!

Responsibilities

Pet Nutrition & Dietary Recommendations

Provide personalised dietary recommendations based on pets' nutritional requirements, life stages, health conditions and individual needs.

Review pet profiles and nutritional information to recommend suitable products and feeding plans.

Support the Customer Solutions team with nutrition-related enquiries that require specialised knowledge.

Review and update dietary recommendations based on new nutritional findings, product changes and customer feedback.

Escalate complex medical or veterinary-related cases to the appropriate specialists.

Nutritional Database & Analysis

Maintain and update nutritional databases, ingredient information and product specifications.

Analyse nutritional data to support dietary recommendations and product development.

Review nutritional calculations and ensure consistency and accuracy across products and feeding recommendations.

Support the ongoing improvement of Nutrition BOM BOT by reviewing its nutritional knowledge base and identifying gaps or inaccuracies.

SOP Maintenance& Documentation

Maintain and update nutrition-related SOPs, formulation records and technical documentation.

Ensure nutritional information and internal guidelines remain accurate, consistent and up to date.

Work with relevant departments to review and improve existing nutrition-related processes.

Maintain proper records of product formulations, nutritional calculations and supporting documentation.

New Product Development (NPD)

Support the research, formulation and development of new pet food products.

Evaluate ingredients based on nutritional value, suitability and product requirements.

Conduct nutritional calculations and review formulations against established standards, including NRC, AAFCO and FEDIAF.

Coordinate with Operations, Procurement and external laboratories on ingredient testing, product trials and nutritional analysis.

Review existing products and recommend improvements based on nutritional findings, customer feedback and market trends.

Assist with product specifications, nutritional labelling and technical documentation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with Customer Solutions to ensure dietary recommendations and nutritional information are communicated accurately.

Collaborate with Operations and Procurement on ingredient suitability, product specifications and formulation requirements.

Provide technical nutritional information to support Marketing's product content and claims.

Work with internal stakeholders to improve nutritional processes and product offerings.

Requirements

Degree in Animal Science, Animal Nutrition, Food Science, Nutrition or a related discipline.

Preferably 2–4 years of relevant experience in pet nutrition, food formulation, product development or a related field.

Good understanding of companion animal nutrition, particularly dogs and cats.

Familiarity with NRC, AAFCO and FEDIAF nutritional guidelines.

Knowledge of nutritional calculations, ingredient functionality and dietary formulation.

Proficient in Microsoft Excel, with the ability to analyse and maintain nutritional data.

Good documentation, organisational and communication skills.

Able to work independently and collaborate with different departments.

Detail-oriented, with an interest in product development and continuous improvement.

Genuine interest in pet health, nutrition and animal welfare.

BOM BOM is a fast-growing, SFA-licensed company founded upon the principle that all pets should have access to fresh, top-grade, scientifically-balanced foods at affordable prices. Nutrigenomic-based R&D, world-class supply chain management, and cutting-edge technology ensure that BOM BOM remains a market leader in pet nutrition.

BOM BOM offers fresh meal customisation plans which optimise bioavailability, aid digestion and promote healthier immune systems. Not only do pets thrive on BOM BOM's fresh approach, but owners enjoy the convenience of easy ordering, flexible deliveries and proactive nutritionist support.

BOM BOM is a results-driven company that bases its success on the well-being of its pet clients. Its mission is to ensure a measurably higher quality of life and extended longevity for pets via nutrition.

Job Responsibilities

The ideal candidate will bring editorial judgement, intellectual curiosity, bilingual capability and strong project management skills. Key responsibilities include:

i) Editorial Strategy and Standards

Develop and champion editorial standards for ArtScience Museum and Attractions across various platforms and public programmes.
Ensure consistent tone, style, terminology and institutional voice, adapting language for different audiences and formats.
Advise on structure, hierarchy, accessibility and readability for exhibition texts, labels, scripts, webpages and learning resources.

ii) Publications

Lead editorial development for publications, brochures, essays, guides and partner print materials.
Work with curators, artists, writers, designers, publishers, translators and partners to shape content from concept to final proof.
Commission, edit and proofread all written content across all digital and print materials
Manage schedules, version control, proofreading stages and final sign-off to ensure consistent and timely delivery.
Ensure publications meet standards for accuracy, accessibility, permissions, image crediting and quality.

iii) Museum Interpretation for Exhibitions

Work with curators, exhibition teams, internal and external partners to develop interpretative frameworks from concept to installation.
Translate artistic, scientific, technological and cultural ideas into clear, engaging and accurate language for broad audiences.
Support content hierarchies, visitor journeys and layered interpretation for both general and specialist audiences.

iv) Website and Digital Content

Create and oversee website content acting as the interface between Musuem and MBS marketing and digital teams
Ensure web copy is accurate, timely, audience-focused and aligned with brand, campaign and ticketing needs.
Adapt long-form curatorial, educational and programme content into concise, searchable and accessible digital copy.
Ensure digital content follows editorial standards, accessibility principles, SEO considerations and bilingual requirements.

v) Education and Public Programmes Content

Work with the team to develop and edit learning resources, festival copy, event descriptions, biographies, programme notes, workshop materials and scripts.
Ensure content for schools, families, educators, general visitors and specialist audiences is clear, age-appropriate and inclusive.
Collaborate with producers and educators on language for talks, workshops, tours, screenings, festivals and community engagement.

vi) Bilingual English/Mandarin Content Development

Provide high-quality English writing, editing, proofreading and quality assurance with sensitivity to tone, nuance and register.
Review and quality check Mandarin content, translations and bilingual materials for accuracy, cultural appropriateness and visitor experience.
Work with translators, vendors and stakeholders to manage bilingual workflows, terminology and consistency.

vii) Work within the Marina Bay Sands Operating Environment

Work with senior managers and colleagues across the Museum and wider Attractions portfolio to support effective communication on key content matters.
Work collaboratively across Marina Bay Sands, including Marketing, Communications, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Procurement and other departments.
Work flexibly, including evenings and weekends when necessary.

Job Requirements

Education & Certification

Degree in English, Literature, Art History, Museum Studies, Publishing, Journalism, Communications, Translation, Chinese Studies or a related field.
Postgraduate qualification or equivalent professional experience in editing, publishing, museum interpretation, translation or communications is advantageous.

Experience

At least 4 years’ experience in editing, publishing, museum interpretation, cultural communications, journalism, copywriting, translation or related editorial work.
Track record delivering public-facing content from concept to final delivery across print, digital and/or physical environments.
Experience editing complex material for broad audiences, ideally across art, science, technology, design, culture or interdisciplinary subjects.
Experience managing editorial schedules, proofreading, version control, approvals and content sign-off.

Other Prerequisites

Native-level English writing, editing and proofreading ability, with excellent command of grammar, tone, structure and nuance.
Professional Mandarin proficiency, including the ability to review, edit and quality assure Mandarin translations and bilingual materials.
Excellent editorial judgement and the ability to translate complex ideas into clear, accurate, elegant and engaging public-facing language.
Strong understanding of audiences, accessibility, readability and inclusive communication.
Excellent organisation skills and impeccable attention to detail.
Ability to work diplomatically with senior stakeholders, creative practitioners, external partners and cross-functional teams.
Proven experience in project management and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
High level of cultural literacy and an interest in the intersection of art, science, technology and culture.
Ability to work as part of a team and independently, in an often-pressured environment and fast-paced work environment.
Experience working in a museum, gallery, cultural institution, publisher, media organisation, university, festival or creative agency.
Knowledge of current debates and practices in museum interpretation, accessible writing, bilingual communication and digital content strategy.
Good computer skills, including Microsoft Office and collaborative content management tools. Familiarity with CMS platforms, Adobe Acrobat proofing tools or editorial workflow systems would be advantageous.

Marina Bay Sands is committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce, providing equal opportunities as we grow our talent base to match our growth ambitions in Singapore. Our employees are committed to adhere to and abide by all rules, regulations, policies and procedures, including the rules of conduct and business ethics of the Company.

title: HubSpot Implementation Consultant
description:
We are looking for fresh graduates to join us as a HubSpot Implementation Consultant to support client onboarding, requirement gathering, solution planning, HubSpot configuration, project coordination, and user training.

The consultant will work closely with Sales teams and HubSpot Specialists to understand client requirements and translate them into practical HubSpot solutions.

You do not need to be a developer or a HubSpot expert when you join us. Training and guidance will be provided. More importantly, we are looking for someone who is curious about how mar-tech works, can communicate clearly, think logically, manage responsibilities, and develop into a trusted consultant.

This role begins with a 3-month period of coaching, guidance, and on-the-job training, followed by a 3-month probation period. By the end of probation, we will assess the candidate's readiness to independently manage client accounts.

The role will support clients across areas such as HubSpot onboarding, CRM implementation, sales and marketing automation, reporting, training, optimisation, and integrations.

Responsibilities

Requirement Gathering and Solution Advisory

Participate in requirement gathering meetings and workshops with client stakeholders.

Ask relevant questions to understand the client's sales, marketing, service, and operational processes.

Work with HubSpot Specialists and our internal technology team to translate business requirements into practical CRM solutions.

Help document client requirements, workflows, processes, and implementation decisions.

Learn to identify what can be implemented natively in HubSpot and where alternative approaches may be required.

Support the preparation and presentation of proposed solutions to clients.

Clearly articulate recommendations and explain how proposed solutions support the client's business processes.

Sales and Marketing Architecture & Automation

Support the setup of marketing automation, lead nurturing, lead routing, and lifecycle workflows.

Assist with sales automation including task creation, lead assignment, pipeline progression, and follow-up processes.

Support the configuration of lead qualification processes such as MQL, SQL, lead scoring, and segmentation.

Help implement campaign tracking and reporting requirements.

Work with HubSpot Specialists to test automation before deployment.

HubSpot Implementation and Configuration

Support the configuration of HubSpot CRM based on approved requirements.

Set up contact, company, deal, ticket, and other CRM properties.

Configure pipelines, deal stages, lead statuses, lifecycle stages, and ownership rules.

Create forms, lists, workflows, internal notifications, and basic automation.

Support the setup of meeting links, sales templates, snippets, sequences, and tasks.

Assist with HubSpot onboarding for new clients and optimisation projects for existing clients.

Conduct testing to ensure configurations work according to agreed requirements.

Project Coordination and Management

Work with HubSpot Specialists to coordinate implementation activities.

Track project tasks, timelines, dependencies, and outstanding client requirements.

Follow up on action items with clients and internal teams.

Help ensure project documentation and requirements remain updated throughout the engagement.

Identify potential delays, risks, or missing information and escalate them early.

Support multiple projects while maintaining clear priorities and deadlines.

Reporting and Dashboard Setup

Support the creation of dashboards and reports for sales, marketing, and management teams.

Understand client reporting requirements and translate them into HubSpot reports.

Help configure properties and data structures required for reporting accuracy.

Learn how common metrics such as lead conversion, pipeline value, sales activities, and campaign performance are measured.

Support client training on using HubSpot dashboards and reports.

Data and Migration Support

Assist with CRM data preparation, clean-up, and property mapping.

Support contact, company, deal, and ticket imports.

Review data for duplicates, missing information, and inconsistencies.

Work with the project team to establish mandatory fields and basic data governance rules.

Support testing and validation after data migration.

Client Training and Support

Support and gradually lead HubSpot onboarding and training workshops.

Present HubSpot features and processes clearly to different user groups.

Conduct role-specific training for administrators, marketing teams, sales teams, and other users.

Prepare user guides, SOPs, workshop materials, and documentation.

Support clients during onboarding and post-launch adoption.

Troubleshoot basic HubSpot issues and work with Specialists on more complex requirements.

Problem-Solving and Analytical Approach

Investigate client challenges before recommending solutions.

Break complex requirements into manageable problems.

Work with Specialists and technical teams to evaluate possible solutions.

Identify potential risks or limitations before implementation.

Clearly explain proposed approaches to clients and internal teams.

Be comfortable acknowledging when further investigation is required instead of making assumptions.

Collaboration with Internal Teams

Work closely with HubSpot Specialists on solution design and configuration.

Work with Developers where integrations, APIs, or custom development are required.

Work with Designers and Content teams on landing pages, marketing emails, forms, and campaign assets.

Support the Sales team with solution research or technical input during pre-sales discussions when required.

Identify new opportunities with the sales team and scope requirements to expand project revenue.

Requirements

Diploma or Degree in Business, Marketing, Information Systems, Communications, Digital Marketing, Technology, or a related discipline.

Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.

Strong interest in technology, digital platforms, automation, and how systems work together.

Must have strong verbal communication and presentation skills.

Must be able to articulate ideas and explain solutions clearly.

Strong problem-solving and logical thinking skills.

Good organisational and project coordination skills.

Comfortable interacting with clients and different stakeholders.

Able to ask questions and clarify requirements instead of making assumptions.

Comfortable learning new software and digital platforms.

Strong attention to detail and documentation.

Able to manage multiple tasks and follow through on commitments.

Good written and spoken English.

Positive learning attitude with an interest in CRM, automation, digital marketing, and technology.

Able to work collaboratively across different teams.

Good to have

Basic understanding of web development, coding, APIs, databases, or system integrations.

Development experience is not required, but an interest in technical concepts will be an advantage.

Basic understanding of CRM, digital marketing, sales processes, or marketing automation.

Experience presenting through school projects, internships, competitions, or client-facing activities.

Internship experience in an agency, consulting company, technology company, marketing team, or SaaS business.

Basic understanding of project management methodologies or tools.

Proficiency in Mandarin is an advantage, as the role may support regional or China-based client accounts.

title: Marketing & Digital Growth Specialist
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.

Job description

We are seeking an operational, highly adaptable Marketing & Digital Growth Specialist to serve as the direct support to the Marketing Manager.

This role is designed to bridge traditional on-the-ground marketing operations with full-stack digital performance execution. You will be responsible for managing day-to-day sales enablement, event execution, vendor logistics & field media capture, while simultaneously owning performance ad management (Meta/Google), e-commerce storefront optimization (Shopify/Shopee/Lazada/TikTok) & lifecycle marketing (Klaviyo/WhatsApp). Furthermore, you will support regional marketing rollouts & localization efforts as we expand across Southeast Asia & target Greater China markets.

Key Responsibilities:

Digital Marketing, Creative Strategy & Performance Media

Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google):

Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Ads & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces

Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries

Full-Funnel Creative Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific formats (e.g., Meta carousel ads, Meta/TikTok Reels, Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banners)

A/B Testing & Optimization: Formulate hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, CTAs, visual styles, copy length) & run A/B tests to systematically improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

Precision Tracking & UTM Tagging: Implement a standardized UTM tagging nomenclature across all campaigns, EDMs, WhatsApp blasts & affiliate links to ensure 100% attribution accuracy in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) & Shopify. Monitor the customer path from first touchpoint to conversion

Media Budget Optimization: Manage ad spend budgets effectively, scaling winning creatives & optimise underperforming ads based on real-time ROAS & Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) data

Content Production

Performance Creative Development: Lead end-to-end creative production for organic & paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube) with a focus on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing

Video & Static Creation: Produce & edit native social content, including UGC-style video, product demos & testimonials using tools like CapCut or Premiere Pro, as well as static ad variations & storefront banners

Copywriting: Write high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social captions that align with brand voice & healthcare regulatory requirements

Generative AI Integration: Utilize AI tools & prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video & image assets for testing cycles

E-Commerce & Social Media Account Ownership

E-Commerce Storefront Custodian: Maintain & integrate winning creative messages across official storefronts on Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok Shop (product pages, banners) to maximize conversion rates

Social Accounts Ownership & Community Management: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for official accounts on Meta (FB/IG) & TikTok. Ensure profiles feature updated bios, Linktree/Shopify integrations & highlighted stories

Content Programming & Scheduling: Maintain a consistent content calendar balancing educational, lifestyle & promotional posts

Active Social Listening & UGC Mining: Monitor comments & DMs to identify customer pain points for new content hooks & curate customer testimonials to deploy as high-converting growth assets

CRM, Lifecycle Marketing & Retention

EDM & E-Newsletter Strategy: Develop & execute a high-frequency newsletter calendar via Klaviyo, including educational insights & promotional product-launch/seasonal campaigns

Automated Flow Management: Design & execute end-to-end email & WhatsApp automation (e.g., Welcome series, Post-Purchase care, Win-back flows & Replenishment Reminders)

Subscription & Loyalty Optimization: Craft compelling creative & copy for subscription programs, optimizing triggers to reduce churn, increase Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & grow Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)

WhatsApp Marketing: Integrate direct-to-consumer WhatsApp communication for personalized consultations, loyalty rewards & rapid promotions

Day-to-Day Marketing Operations & Brand Execution

Execute Business & Marketing Initiatives: Execute effective marketing & business development initiatives tailored to each health supplement brand to increase market share, achieve revenue & reach profitability targets in line with overall business objectives

Budget & Spend Monitoring: Track & monitor marketing budget allocations, campaign expenditures, purchase orders (POs) & invoices to ensure optimal ROI, resource allocation, & strict adherence to financial targets

Marketing Collateral Development: Manage the end-to-end production of printed & digital collaterals (e.g., product packaging, brochures, POSM displays & email newsletters), liaising with print vendors & briefing internal design teams

Marketing Collaterals Inventory Management: Monitor & maintain inventory levels of promotional materials, product samples & event displays to support ongoing on-ground campaigns.

Field Media Capture & Event Execution

Medical Conferences & Sponsorships: Lead on-the-ground setup, booth operations & logistics for major medical association conventions & trade events (e.g., Singapore Orthopaedic Association - SOA, Malaysian Orthopaedic Association - MOA)

CME Workshop Coordination: Support Continuing Medical Education (CME) seminars for healthcare professionals—managing attendee invites, venue logistics, collateral preparation & post-event survey collation

On-Site Media Capture: Direct & capture raw video footage & photos during events, social media content creation & patient/doctor testimonial shoots using mobile/camera gear

Digital Handoff & Asset Tagging: Organize raw media assets, write clear creative briefs & storyboards & transfer files to internal design teams (for video editing/graphics) or deploy them directly across paid ad channels

Sales Team Enablement & Trade Support

Sales Collaterals: Develop & update product brochures, product samples & promotional offers to empower the Sales team

Retail Pharmacy Activations: Coordinate trade marketing collaterals, listing campaigns & point-of-sale displays for retail pharmacy chains

Compliance & Brand Integrity

Regulatory Compliance: Safeguard brand credibility by ensuring all promotional messaging remain factual, align with company values & strictly comply with regional healthcare advertising standards & product claim guidelines

Requirements:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Life Sciences, or a related field

Experience: 2–4 years of hands-on marketing executive experience, combining general marketing operations with full-stack digital marketing & e-commerce execution

Performance Marketing: Proven hands-on experience setting up, managing & optimizing paid ad campaigns within Meta Ads Manager & Google Ads

E-Commerce Ecosystems: Direct experience managing content, storefronts & promotions on Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok Shop

Technical & Analytics Proficiency: Working knowledge of Google Analytics 4 (GA4), UTM tracking structures & CRM/EDM automation tools (Klaviyo preferred)

Design & Editing Tools: Proficient in producing rapid static & video content using CapCut, Canva, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, or Illustrator

Language Proficiency: Fluency in spoken & written Mandarin is required to effectively liaise with Mandarin-speaking healthcare professionals, retail pharmacy partners, media platforms & suppliers/vendors

On-Ground Operations: Strong event execution, vendor management & trade marketing coordination skills

Content Capture Instincts: Confident in capturing raw smartphone/camera footage during events & directing quick on-site interviews

title: Manager, Media Planning
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary and Impact

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Manager to join WPP Media Singapore Clients Team. You will be responsible for leading a portfolio of strategic client relationships. Acting as a trusted strategic advisor and central hub integrator across specialists and local market teams, this role oversees the complete campaign lifecycle, from integrated cross-channel media strategy and planning to execution, optimization, and financial governance.

You will bridge client business goals with innovative and effective media solutions across all digital biddable and non-biddable/traditional channels, ensuring high client satisfaction, account profitability, and operational excellence while mentoring junior talent.

Experience working with Singapore and regional premium lifestyle and luxury publishers, with established media relationships and a good understanding of the publisher landscape, will be a strong advantage.

Client Partnership & Strategic Leadership
Client Champion & Trusted Advisor: Build and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with senior client stakeholders based on trust, transparency, and proactive communication. Act as the primary point of contact and escalate/resolve challenges with confidence.
Business & Category Insight: Deeply understand client business models, market dynamics, competitive landscapes, and growth priorities across diverse sectors (luxury, financial services, FMCG, wine & spirits).
Strategic Roadmap Development: Lead annual strategy sessions, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and campaign roadmaps, translating overarching business targets into actionable, high-impact marketing and media strategies.
Account Growth & Scope Management: Proactively identify portfolio expansion opportunities, unlock new revenue streams, and champion client satisfaction to drive long-term retention.
Integrated Media Strategy & Campaign Planning
Cross-Channel Planning: Develop end-to-end, integrated media strategies combining digital channels (Search, Social, Programmatic) and traditional/non-biddable channels (TV, Print, Radio, OOH/DOOH, Cinema, Digital IOs).
Goal-Oriented Media Design: Define clear, measurable performance benchmarks and KPIs, ensuring media allocations align with client investment strategies and brand priorities.
Innovative Integration: Partner with internal specialists (Planning, Investment, Activation, Content, Analytics) to deliver cohesive, data-led communications solutions.
Campaign Execution, Operations & Governance
Seamless Implementation: Oversee end-to-end execution, launch accuracy, and quality control across all media channels, maintaining robust documentation, approvals, and audit readiness.
Regional & Local Governance: Coordinate across regional hubs, local markets, and external partners to ensure consistency of delivery, process optimization, and compliance with agency standards.
Issue & Workflow Resolution: Act as the operational escalation point to resolve delivery, billing, technology, and implementation challenges across internal and external stakeholders.
Commercial Management & Financial Stewardship
Account Profitability & Revenue Ownership: Manage account P&L, accurate revenue forecasting, scope control, and commercial compliance against contractual targets.
Meticulous Budget Management: Oversee client media investments, managing budget allocations, spend tracking, reconciliations, invoicing, credit notes, and accruals with full client transparency.
Financial Risk Mitigation: Partner with Finance and Operations teams to ensure timely billing, revenue recognition, and proactive resolution of financial discrepancies.
Data Analytics, Optimization & Reporting
Performance Monitoring & Insights: Analyze campaign performance using tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, PowerBI, Clear Decisions, and Evogenious (TV) to derive actionable strategic insights beyond surface-level metrics.
A/B Testing & Continuous Improvement: Design and lead A/B testing and experimentation initiatives to continuously optimize conversions, engagement, and ROI across campaigns.
Executive Reporting: Deliver clear, tailored performance reports and forward-looking strategic recommendations that articulate value to senior client leadership.
People Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Team Mentorship & Coaching: Support the growth and capability development of junior team members through day-to-day guidance, skill-building, and knowledge sharing.
Cross-Functional Synergy: Facilitate smooth collaboration between media owners, technology partners, creative agencies, procurement teams, and internal practice specialists.
Culture Champion: Drive a high-performing, inclusive, and collaborative team culture grounded in accountability and continuous learning.

What You Will Need (Qualifications & Experience)

Experience: At least 6-7 years of experience in media planning and client servicing in integrated advertising, with a proven track record of managing end-to-end campaigns in the Singapore market and regional hubs.
Cross-Channel Knowledge: Good understanding of biddable channels, as well as strong working knowledge on non-biddable media particularly premium lifestyle and luxury category.
Tool & Analytics Proficiency: Hands-on experience with industry analytics, research, and reporting tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, PowerBI, Excel, Clear Decisions, Evogenious).
Commercial Acumen: Strong fluency in media math, financial stewardship (reconciliations, billing, accruals), contract management, and account profitability.
Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and written/verbal communication skills, with experience managing executive-level clients.
Leadership Qualities: Self-driven ownership with demonstrated ability to guide, mentor, and elevate junior team members in a fast-paced environment.

Core Competencies

Client Leadership & Advisory: Strategic relationship building, consultative problem solving, executive stakeholder engagement.

title: SPECIALIST TEACHER: ENGLISH LANGUAGE LEARNING (ELL)
description:
ROLE:

The ELL Teacher will build foundational systems, policies, and inclusive practices for multilingual learners while delivering a comprehensive English language program. The role is distinguished by its dual emphasis on language development and academic integration, working across grades and subjects to ensure students gain English proficiency alongside continued cognitive growth.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Develop and Implement Curriculum

:

Design and implement an age-appropriate English language curriculum aligned with school standards and the science of learning.

Deliver targeted instruction aligned to internationally recognized frameworks.

Differentiate lessons to develop listening, speaking, reading, and writing across proficiency levels.

Apply research-based strategies, including sheltered instruction and language scaffolding.

Use varied, engaging approaches—such as collaborative, hands-on, and inquiry-based learning—to promote engagement and critical thinking.

Create a Positive and Inclusive Classroom Environment

:

Foster a supportive, safe, and inclusive classroom where all students feel valued and respected.

Establish clear expectations for behavior, classroom routines, and academic goals, creating a structured and nurturing environment.

Promote social-emotional learning, helping students build essential skills such as empathy, collaboration, and self-regulation.

Assess Student Progress and Provide Feedback

:

Regularly assess students’ English proficiency through formal and informal assessments, including tests, quizzes, projects, and observations.

Provide constructive, timely, and personalized feedback to students to help them understand their strengths and areas for improvement.

Use assessment data to adjust teaching strategies and support individual learning needs.

Differentiate Instruction to Meet Student Needs

:

Tailor lessons to accommodate diverse learning styles, abilities, and backgrounds, ensuring that each student has the opportunity to succeed.

Modify assignments, assessments, and classroom activities for students with varying levels of understanding and those with special needs.

Provide additional support for students who need extra help and offer enrichment opportunities for advanced learners.

Support Social and Emotional Development

:

Support the development of students' social-emotional skills, including conflict resolution, communication, and self-awareness.

Foster positive relationships among students through team-building exercises, class discussions, and cooperative learning activities.

Help students set personal goals, track their progress, and celebrate achievements to build confidence and motivation.

Collaborate with Other Teachers and Staff

:

Work closely with other teachers and/or subject-specific teachers to support students' individual needs.

Participate in school-wide initiatives and collaborate with other teachers to plan interdisciplinary projects or school events.

Attend meetings with school leadership, counselors, and other staff to discuss students’ academic, social, and emotional progress.

Communicate with Parents and Caregivers

:

Regularly update parents on their child's academic progress, behavior, and overall well-being through newsletters, emails, and parent-teacher conferences.

Maintain open lines of communication with parents to address concerns, provide updates, and collaborate on strategies to support student learning at home.

Provide parents with resources and suggestions to help their children with homework, studying, and personal development.

Manage Classroom Behavior and Foster Positive Relationships

:

Establish clear classroom rules and routines to maintain order and encourage positive behavior.

Use positive reinforcement techniques to motivate students and promote a positive learning environment.

Address behavioral issues in a constructive manner, using conflict resolution strategies and involving students in discussions about appropriate behavior.

Plan and Supervise Field Trips and Extracurricular Activities

:

Organize and supervise field trips, school events, and extracurricular activities that enhance students' learning experiences and provide real-world connections to classroom content.

Ensure that activities are educational, engaging, and safe for students.

Communicate with parents about upcoming trips and volunteer opportunities to ensure participation and support.

Create and Maintain Classroom Materials and Resources

:

Organize and maintain classroom supplies, materials, and resources to ensure a well-prepared learning environment.

Prepare visual aids, bulletin boards, and learning stations that support student engagement and enhance classroom instruction.

Maintain student records, including grades, attendance, and progress reports, in an organized and accessible manner.

Engage in Professional Development

:

Participate in professional development opportunities to stay current with best practices in teaching, curriculum development, and classroom management.

Attend workshops, conferences, and seminars to learn new teaching strategies, educational technologies, and methods for supporting diverse learners.

Collaborate with colleagues to share knowledge, resources, and strategies that improve teaching and student outcomes.

Support School Community and Culture

:

Actively participate in school events, activities, and committees that promote school spirit and community engagement.

Serve as a role model for students by demonstrating respect, responsibility, and commitment to the school community.

Foster positive relationships with colleagues, students, and parents, contributing to a collaborative and welcoming school environment.

REQUIREMENTS:

A recognized bachelor's degree in teaching, education, Applied Linguistics, or a related field of study, ideally with recognized credentials in ELL/ELA.

Experience working with multilingual learners in international or diverse settings.

A minimum of three years of relevant and successful full-time teaching experience in a K-12 school. Direct experience in an ELL/ELA-focused role is ideal.

Strong understanding of second language acquisition and scaffolding techniques.

Curriculum and program development knowledge preferred.

Strong communication and coaching skill.

Familiarity with cognitive science-based teaching and learning is an advantage.

Passionate about helping students to learn and grow.

Able to make decisions in the best interests of children.

Sound EQ, empathy and a strong understanding of self.

Excited about working collaboratively in a learning-focused team.

Possess a learning and growth mindset.

Internationally minded and accepting of all people regardless of age, gender, sexual persuasion, culture or language.

Creative and innovative in ideas and outlook.

Sense of humor.

Adaptable and flexible to the needs of colleagues, students, school and self.

At RD American School, you’ll be part of a forward-thinking team shaping the future of education. You’ll have the opportunity to innovate, lead, and make a meaningful impact on learners and families across the region

title: Analyst / Senior Analyst - Fund Management
description:
Overview:

When you join Hines, you will embark on a career journey fueled by vision and guided by leaders who set the standards of our industry. Our legacy is rooted in innovation and excellence, earning us a spot on Fast Company’s esteemed annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies, as well as recognition as one of U.S. News & World Report’s Best Companies to Work For in 2024. Discover endless opportunities to grow and make your mark at Hines.

Responsibilities:

As an Analyst / Senior Analyst - Fund Management with Hines, you will work primarily across various fund management responsibilities, with a particular focus on financial modelling, performance analysis, valuation, liquidity and reporting, together with selective exposure to acquisitions, investor due diligence and capital raising. The role is designed to develop from analytical execution into increasing ownership of portfolio-management workstreams.

Hines is looking to hire an Analyst / Senior Analyst into the Investment Management team, primarily to work on Hines Asia Property Partners (HAPP), Hines' flagship institutional Asia-Pacific core-plus fund. Launched in 2021, HAPP is an open-ended, diversified vehicle investing across developed Asia markets, including Japan, Australia, South Korea, Singapore and New Zealand.

Based in Singapore, this is an opportunity to join a high-performing investment team and contribute to the continued growth of HAPP while working at the centre of Hines' Asia-Pacific investment platform. The role will work closely with senior Investment Management leadership, as well as Hines' acquisition, asset management, research, financing, development and sustainable value creation teams across the region. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, participating in:

Portfolio Management

Development, maintenance and review of HAPP's asset- and fund-level financial models, including portfolio performance, return forecasting, liquidity, valuation, cash flow, performance attribution and scenario analysis, with a focus on identifying the key drivers of fund and investment performance.
HAPP's recurring fund-management cycle, including quarterly business planning, valuation, asset-model roll-up, liquidity forecasting, performance and return analysis, and portfolio and investor reporting, working with country teams and relevant functional specialists to review inputs, analyse actual performance against budget and prior periods, and ensure accurate and timely outputs.
Process improvement, automation and technology initiatives across portfolio modelling, reporting and data workflows to improve scalability, controls and efficiency.

Investment & Asset Management

Asset management of the Fund's investments, including analysis of business plans, monitoring of portfolio performance and identification of value-enhancing initiatives in collaboration with country teams. More experienced candidates will progressively own selected portfolio and asset-management workstreams with senior oversight.
Selected acquisitions and strategic opportunities across Asia-Pacific, including underwriting, portfolio-fit and fund-level impact analysis, transaction execution, and investment strategy / portfolio construction, working with Hines' local country teams, Hines Research and relevant functional specialists.

Investor Relations & Capital Raising

Investor relationships with current and prospective institutional investors, including investor due diligence, DDQ / RFP responses, portfolio analysis and selected investor meetings, working with the broader Fund team, Capital Markets and other stakeholders across Hines.
Preparation and coordination of analysis and investment content for investors and internal stakeholders, including fund updates, investor meeting materials, portfolio reviews and other capital-raising materials.
Qualifications:

Minimum Requirements include:

Typically 2-5 years of relevant experience in real estate private equity, investment management, investment banking, real estate investment or a related field. Candidates somewhat below or above this range may also be considered where capabilities and experience are strongly aligned. Direct Asia-Pacific experience is desirable but not essential.

Bachelor degree from a high-calibre institution, preferably in a subject area demanding high analytical aptitude.

Highly numerate with strong analytical and financial modelling capability. Demonstrated ability to build, audit and interpret financial models, identify key performance and return drivers, and explain conclusions clearly. Experience analysing real estate investments, portfolios or operating companies is desirable.

Ability to distil complex analysis into clear conclusions and present ideas effectively in written, verbal and graphical form, including in Word and PowerPoint.

Excellent communication skills with confident fluency in written and spoken English. Additional Asian language capability would be advantageous given the regional remit of the role.

Ability to relate well to other people at all levels, internally and externally. Culturally sensitive and comfortable working across multiple Asia-Pacific markets and stakeholder groups. Display passion and energy, creating a positive working environment.

Proactive, self-motivated and able to take ownership, use initiative and escalate appropriately.

Confidence, independence and strong interest in working in an entrepreneurial, growth-oriented investment environment.

Strong attention to detail, particularly in financial models, recurring reporting and data quality.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and recurring reporting / modelling deadlines, working quickly and accurately to a high standard under pressure.

Positive energy and contribution to team spirit.

Ambition and willingness to learn, with a clear desire to develop from analytical execution into investment and portfolio-management ownership. More experienced candidates should be able to take increasing responsibility for portfolio analysis, selected asset-management workstreams and investor due diligence.

Closing:

At Hines, we believe the built world is ultimately about people. As one of the world’s largest privately held real assets firms, we bring nearly seven decades of investment, development, and management experience to work that shapes cities and communities around the world.

Our people make that possible. Across 29 countries, more than 4,600 colleagues bring different perspectives and expertise to Hines, with opportunities to take on meaningful responsibility, learn from leaders across the business, and build a career with room to evolve. We support that journey through professional development, competitive rewards, comprehensive benefits, and a culture grounded in trust and high standards.

Hines is proud to be named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies for 2024.

We are an equal opportunity employer and support workforce diversity.

No calls or emails from third parties at this time please.

description:
