Responsibilities

TikTok's Customer Support team's vision is to deliver industry-leading support for our users and creators to inspire creativity and bring joy. We are looking for an experienced results-oriented individual to join the team that is at the forefront of this mission. As a Creator & User Excellence Specialist within the Customer Support team, you will be part of a team that drives cross-functional service governance and continuous improvement for user and creator support. You will consolidate voice-of-customer insights from Customer Support and XFN stakeholders, translate them into prioritized problem statements, and partner with Product, Program Management, Operations, Policy, Communications, and other teams to drive structured triage, alignment, and action. This shared intelligence enables faster issue detection, better resource prioritization, and more effective decision-making across teams. You will also be responsible for leading root-cause analyses (RCAs), shaping prioritization frameworks, and driving end-to-end remediation from problem definition through implementation. This includes strengthening operational health, supporting incident response and post-incident follow-through, and improving Customer Support north star metrics through structured program management. You will establish tools, governance mechanisms, and scalable processes to manage top-priority issues, while identifying opportunities to streamline workflows and increase intelligent automation across support operations. You are passionate about elevating the user and creator support experience and enjoy turning complex operational pain points into scalable solutions. You combine analytical rigor with strong execution, and you are comfortable moving between investigations, stakeholder alignment, program delivery, and process design. Your background is grounded in problem solving, program or project management, operational excellence, and cross-functional collaboration, with a strong appreciation for customer support and user safety. Responsibilities - Feedback Loop Operations and Optimization: - Support feedback loop operations, ensuring smooth day-to-day operational functionality including the intake, triage and prioritisation flows, leveraging analytical skills to enrich feedback and quantify priorities based on business impact - Support ongoing iteration of the feedback loop—identify bottlenecks and pain points, and recommend improvements to boost efficiency and impact - Collaborate with XFN partners (Product, Policy, Security, T&S) to design new workflows that close discovered gaps / pain points or increase the comprehensiveness of feedback received - RCA, prioritization and remediation execution: - Root Cause Analysis: Conduct deep dives into recurring or high-severity issues, identify root causes across people, process, policy, and platform dimensions, and define data-driven recommendations to prevent future occurrences. - Prioritization & Impact Assessment: Quantify user, creator, and business impact to prioritize the most important pain points, using data and structured judgment to inform sequencing and resource allocation. - Cross-Functional Solutioning & Service Governance: Facilitate solution design sessions, define mid- and long-term fixes, and influence Executive stakeholders to secure buy-in, clarify ownership, and prioritize implementation across Customer Support and XFNs. - Remediation Program Delivery: Build and execute remediation plans in partnership with relevant XFNs (content, process/policy, product management, data analytics, operations, other support teams, and engineering) to address recurring escalations and systemic gaps. Plan, pilot, iterate, and drive implementation of approved solutions, including hypercare support, while monitoring key metrics to validate impact and detect unintended consequences. - Operational Health, Incident Readiness & Data-Driven Decision Making: Monitor key metrics, analyze trends, support structured responses to high-impact incidents, and use insights to influence process enhancements and operational strategies. - User-Centric Advocacy, Automation & Scalability: Act as a voice for users and creators, ensuring their concerns are understood and addressed in support services and product improvements, while identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, standardize practices, and scale support through automation.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications: - 5+ years of experience in customer support, trust & safety, operations, program management, product operations, or similar functions in online platforms. - Experience in understanding operational workflows across intake, prioritization, resolution, and service readiness. - Track record of solving complex problems using formal RCA methodologies, challenging the status quo, and turning findings into executable remediation plans. - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and program/project management skills, with the ability to align multiple teams, manage risks, clarify ownership, and drive delivery to completion. - Proven ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment, operate with ambiguity, and maintain a strong bias for execution in fast-moving environments. - Strong analytical mindset with experience in prioritizing ambiguous problem spaces, quantifying business impact, conducting RCA, and translating insights into actionable recommendations. - Passion for improving user and creator experiences on digital platforms, with a customer-centric mindset and strong ownership of outcomes. Preferred Qualifications: - Strong data analysis skills and data-driven mindset. - Exposure to customer support workflows and cross-functional service governance is a strong plus. - Background in Trust & Safety, online platform operations, risk management, service operations, or incident management. - Experience with process automation, workflow tooling, or technology-driven operational improvement is a plus. - Self-starter who can manage multiple priorities autonomously and drive projects from inception through implementation, with an eye for process design, scalability, and automation.

Job Information

Trust & Safety

Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis. ​

​

TikTok recognises that keeping our platform safe for the TikTok communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining. ​

​

We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person-centred, innovative and integrated approach. ​

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo. ​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day. ​

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. ​

​

Diversity & Inclusion ​

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

title: Sr. Field Application Scientist, Cell Culture Automation
description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Molecular Devices, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Join Molecular Devices and help drive scientific discovery for life science customers in academia, biotech, pharma, and government. Our automated and AI-enabled technology empowers researchers to tackle complex questions and gain deep insights, accelerating the development of safer, more effective therapeutics. As part of our team—rooted in collaboration, authenticity, and innovation—you’ll ultimately contribute to groundbreaking science that enhances lives globally and shapes a healthier future for all.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Sr. Field Application Scientist, Cell Culture Automation is responsible for serving as the primary scientific and technical expert for cell culture automation across JAPAC. The role accelerates customer success, scientific adoption and commercial growth by translating complex cell biology workflows into reliable automated solutions, leading proof-of-concept work and supporting customers from evaluation through long-term adoption.

This position reports on an interim basis to the Interim General Manager, JAPAC and is part of the Commercial Applications / Scientific Affairs organization, located in Singapore and working remotely to cover Japan and Asia Pacific (JAPAC).

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

Serve as the regional scientific and technical expert for cell culture automation, supporting customer discovery, workflow assessment, solution design, evaluation, implementation and sustained adoption across JAPAC.
Design and execute product demonstrations, feasibility studies and proof-of-concept projects for advanced cell models, including induced pluripotent stem cells, organoids, spheroids, immuno-oncology and translational disease models.
Translate cell culture protocols and acceptance criteria into reliable automated workflows, including liquid handling, labware configuration, imaging, monitoring, feeding, seeding, passaging, compound addition and endpoint assays.
Guide customers in AI-enabled image analysis, phenotype classification, segmentation, feature extraction, quantitative analysis, data interpretation and image-guided automated decision making.
Partner with commercial and cross-functional teams to advance opportunities, lead onboarding and training, optimize applications, coordinate technical escalations, and develop strategic reference sites and scientific collaborations.

The essential requirements of the job include:

PhD in Cell Biology, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences, Bioengineering, Pharmacology, Computational Biology or a related discipline; or a Master’s degree in a related discipline with substantial relevant industry experience.
Multiple years of customer-facing scientific applications experience in a field applications, application scientist, product specialist, scientific consulting or comparable technical-commercial role.
Demonstrated experience with automated cell culture, liquid handling, laboratory robotics or workflow automation, together with relevant cell-based applications such as stem cells, induced pluripotent stem cells, organoids or spheroids.
Demonstrated experience with live-cell imaging, high-content screening, automated microscopy, cell-based assay development or AI-assisted image analysis, including data interpretation and workflow optimization.
Fluent English communication and presentation capability, with experience supporting customers and cross-functional stakeholders across multiple countries and cultures.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

Ability to travel internationally approximately 40-60%, including overnight travel, to support customers and commercial teams across JAPAC.
Ability to work in customer laboratory environments and comply with applicable site safety, access and training requirements.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

Cell culture automation, ImageXpress systems, MetaXpress, IN Carta, high-content screening platforms, automated cell culture platforms or comparable technologies.
Drug discovery, biopharmaceutical, contract research organization, academic research institute, stem cell center or imaging core-facility environments.
Launching emerging scientific technologies, developing strategic reference sites or driving adoption across Asia Pacific.

Molecular Devices, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job.

At Molecular Devices we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. title: Producer
description:
About Arkchetype

ARKCHETYPE is a Singapore-based creative studio.

We help organisations find the story within an idea, then work out the most compelling way to bring it to life.

For more than a decade, we’ve worked across industries and markets in the region, combining storytelling craft with production expertise across film, animation, design, photography and emerging creative technology.

As the boundaries between filmmaking, design and AI continue to shift, we’re interested in what new tools make possible - not for technology’s sake, but in service of better stories.

We’re looking for a Producer to join our team.

The Role

This is a role for someone who likes taking ownership.

You’ll run projects from brief to delivery - understanding what the client is trying to achieve, keeping people aligned, managing the moving parts and solving problems before they become bigger ones.

The work is varied. One project might be a brand film, another an animation or regional event production, and the next something we’re figuring out for the first time.

You don’t need to know everything from Day One. We can teach processes and parts of production.

What is harder to teach - and what matters to us - is good judgment, curiosity, follow-through and the instinct to take responsibility for getting something across the line.

What You’ll Do

Own and coordinate projects from briefing and pre-production through production, post-production and final delivery.

Manage schedules, budgets, resources, crews, vendors and project logistics.

Be a dependable day-to-day point of contact for clients, communicating clearly and professionally.

Keep projects moving and visible - knowing what’s happening, what’s pending, what comes next and what may be at risk.

Anticipate problems, surface them early and work out what needs to happen next.

Brief and coordinate creative, production and post-production teams, and translate client feedback into clear, actionable direction.

Develop the technical understanding needed to work effectively with editors, animators, filmmakers and other specialists.

Contribute to story and creative discussions where you have the interest and ability.

Explore AI and emerging creative tools and help us identify where they can genuinely improve the way we think, create and produce.

What We’re Looking For

We’re less concerned with having the perfect title, qualification or number of years on your CV than with how you think, work and learn.

You may be a good fit if you:

Have around 2–5 years of relevant experience in production, content, creative agencies, media or a related environment. Strong candidates outside this range are welcome too.

Take ownership and follow through without needing to be constantly chased.

Are organised, resourceful and able to keep multiple moving parts under control.

Communicate early when something is unclear, delayed or at risk.

Write and speak English confidently and professionally.

Can communicate effectively in Mandarin, as the role involves working with Mandarin-speaking clients and production partners in Greater China.

Understand that good client servicing is about clarity, judgment and trust - not simply passing messages between people.

Are curious about AI and emerging creative technology. You don’t need to know every platform, but you should want to experiment, learn quickly and think critically about where these tools add value.

Have enough humility to ask when you don’t know something and enough initiative to work things out.

Are comfortable speaking up when you see a better way, open to having your own thinking challenged in return, and able to move forward once a decision is made.

Experience with video production, post-production workflows, Premiere Pro, After Effects or other creative tools is useful, but you don’t need to be an editor or animator.

Formal qualifications matter less to us than demonstrated ability, judgment and attitude.

Working at Arkchetype

We’re a small team, so you’ll work closely with the founder and creative team and get exposure to much more than one narrow part of the production process.

There isn’t a large hierarchy to disappear into. Your contribution will be visible, and you’ll sometimes need to work beyond neat functional boundaries. In return, good work is noticed quickly too - and as you demonstrate capability and judgment, so will the responsibility you’re trusted with.

We value people who think for themselves. Speak up, question assumptions and bring a point of view - but be equally willing to have your own thinking challenged. Good ideas matter more than hierarchy, and once a decision is made, we move forward together.

Our normal working hours are 9:30am - 6:30pm, Monday to Friday. Production isn’t always predictable, and shoots, events or deadlines will occasionally require flexibility. We try to plan responsibly around normal hours and believe flexibility should work both ways.

This is primarily an in-person role, with a weekly work-from-home day where project requirements allow.

Compensation & Benefits

S4,000–S5,000 per month, depending on experience, capability and the level of responsibility you can independently take on

Annual performance bonus

Health insurance

Exposure to regional projects and clients

Hands-on learning across creative, production, client management and emerging AI workflows

Room to take on greater project, client and team responsibility as you grow

ARKCHETYPE PRODUCTIONS is a Singapore-based storytelling studio that helps organisations translate complex ideas into clear, compelling narratives. Combining craft in video production with photography, animation and advanced AI-driven techniques, the studio brings stories to life and helps brands connect meaningfully with audiences across the region.

title: Medical Marketing Specialist
description:
MORROW MEDICAL

MORROW Medical is a physician-led longevity and lifestyle medicine clinic in Singapore, focused on helping individuals understand, optimise, and protect their long-term health. We combine comprehensive health screening, preventive care, and evidence-based lifestyle medicine to identify early signs of metabolic, cardiovascular, and functional change—often before disease develops. Our fully licensed doctors diagnose conditions, prescribe medication, and manage chronic disease where required, while also guiding patients through personalised lifestyle interventions that support sustainable improvement. From preventive screening to ongoing medical management, MORROW Medical delivers integrated care designed to strengthen function, resilience, and long-term health outcomes.

Location: Singapore

Reports To: Medical Director

Works closely with: Doctors, Head of Clinical Operations, Various teams of Allied Health Professionals and Marketing

Role Summary

The Medical Marketing Specialist is responsible for developing accurate, engaging, and compliant medical content while supporting the clinic's marketing and patient engagement initiatives. This role bridges clinical expertise and marketing execution, translating complex medical concepts into clear, patient-friendly communications that support health education, programme enrolment, and brand growth.

The ideal candidate is a strong communicator with a passion for healthcare, excellent writing skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with doctors, allied health professionals, and marketing teams.

Key Responsibilities

Medical Content Development

Research, write, edit, and review medical and health-related content for patients and the public.
Create content for medical programmes, educational materials, brochures, newsletters, website articles, and patient resources.
Work closely with doctors and healthcare professionals to ensure clinical accuracy.
Translate complex medical concepts into clear, engaging, and patient-friendly language.
Develop FAQs, programme guides, patient onboarding materials, and educational resources.
Ensure all content complies with MOH advertising regulations, HCSA requirements, PDPA requirements, and clinic policies.

Marketing & Communications

Support planning and execution of marketing campaigns for clinic services and medical programmes.
Develop content for social media, email marketing, website updates, and other digital platforms.
Coordinate with external vendors, agencies, and partners on marketing initiatives.
Assist in creation of marketing collateral, presentations, and corporate partnership materials.
Support events, webinars, workshops, and patient engagement activities.
Help maintain consistency of the clinic's brand messaging and voice.

Medical Programme Support

Collaborate with programme owners to develop programme-specific communications.
Support launch activities for new clinical programmes and services.
Develop lifecycle communication journeys, including onboarding materials, follow-up communications, and patient education content.
Assist in tracking programme marketing performance and engagement metrics.

Digital & Content Management

Maintain content calendars and publication schedules.
Update website content and programme information as needed.
Monitor content performance and optimise materials based on engagement data.
Support search engine optimisation (SEO) initiatives where applicable.

Events & Community Engagement

Plan, coordinate, and execute MORROW events, health talks, webinars, corporate wellness programmes, and community engagement activities.
Support Head, Clinical Operations to plan CME workshops
Work with doctors, allied health professionals, and external partners to develop event content and educational materials.
Coordinate logistics, venue arrangements, registrations, speakers, vendors, and event communications.
Develop and implement marketing plans to drive event awareness, attendance, and engagement.
Create promotional materials, email campaigns, social media content, and event collateral.
Support post-event follow-up activities, including attendee communications, feedback collection, and programme conversion opportunities.
Track and report on event performance metrics, attendance, engagement, and business outcomes.
Identify opportunities to strengthen patient engagement and community outreach through educational initiatives and partnerships.

Requirements

Degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or related discipline.
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in medical writing, healthcare communications, healthcare marketing, or related field.
Experience working within healthcare, medical, pharmaceutical, wellness, or health-tech environments preferred.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
Strong ability to simplify complex medical information for different audiences.
Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Ability to work effectively with healthcare professionals and cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong project management and organisational skills.
Familiarity with healthcare regulations governing advertising and patient communications in Singapore preferred.
Experience with content management systems, social media platforms, and email marketing tools is advantageous.
Passionate about preventive healthcare, lifestyle medicine, and patient education.
Curious, proactive, and able to work independently.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Able to work within a high-performance culture aligned with the organisation's operating principles and values.
Collaborative team player with a growth mindset and willingness to continuously learn.

title: Business Management Trainee
description:
About the Role

Build your career through AKC’s two year Management Trainee Programme, designed to develop future Team Leads and business leaders.

You will complete four six-month rotations across Customer Success& Marketing, Revenue, Training Management and Compliance, and Business Development. Through hands-on assignments, mentorship and cross-functional projects, you will gain a strong understanding of AKC’s customers, operations, products and growth strategies.

High-performing trainees may be considered for progression into a Team Lead or suitable specialist position upon successful completion.

What You’ll Be Doing

1. Customer Success & Marketing

Conduct market and competitor research.

Follow up on leads, registrations and customer engagement.

Support digital campaigns, paid advertising, content creation and course promotions.

Assist with roadshows, events and course launches.

Track campaign performance, lead generation and conversions.

2. Revenue

Support sales pipelines, revenue tracking and performance reporting.

Maintain accurate records across CRM, ERP and reporting systems.

Analyse business data and identify performance trends.

Support workflow improvement, automation and digitalisation projects.

Research new markets, clients and partnership opportunities.

Support corporate outreach, meetings and presentations.

Prepare proposals, quotations and tender submissions.

Lead or support cross-functional projects.

Four structured six-month departmental rotations to develop a holistic understanding of the business.

Practical experience solving real business and operational challenges.

Potential progression into a Team Lead or suitable specialist role

Diploma or degree in Business Management or related disciplines

Fresh graduates and entry-level candidates are welcome.

Strong interest in business management and leadership.

Good communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.

Proactive, adaptable and willing to take ownership.

Able to work independently and collaborate across teams.

Absolute Kinetics Consultancy (AKC) Pte Ltd officially opened for business on 18th April 2001.

AKC conducts workplace and health safety courses as its core business and also offers consultancy, risk management and other specialised training services such as certificate for employment intermediaries. It also has a team of around 100 professionals (comprising full time and part time trainers) skilled in various safety specialisations such as construction safety, scaffolding, shipyard safety, metalworking and welding, amongst others.

title: Cloud Architect, AWS Managed Services
description:
DESCRIPTION

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Amazon's technology business has a history and tradition of leading the world in Web-related technologies and services. Now with Amazon Web Services (AWS) you have the chance to help individuals and businesses take their computing infrastructures and applications into "the Cloud".

AWS Managed Services is designed to accelerate cloud adoption. It simplifies deployment, migration, and management using automation and machine learning backed up by a dedicated team of Amazon employees. AWS Managed Services provides ongoing management and operations of the AWS infrastructure. It automates common activities such as change requests, monitoring, patch management, security, and backup services and provides full-lifecycle services to provision run and support your infrastructure.

We are seeking a professional that is able to operate at the forefront of transformational technology assisting enterprise customers to take advantage of a growing set of AWS services and features to run their applications.

As an AMS Cloud Architect you will be the technical resource to help our largest customers navigate the operational challenges of cloud computing. You will be an adviser supporting the customers' effort to identify good candidate workloads from their application pipeline and offer AMS specific advice on their architecture to ensure they are getting the full value of the AMS feature set. You will be the person people seek out as a resource to solve difficult problems. You possess customer facing skills that enable you to represent AWS well within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior personnel regarding incidents, trade-offs, best practices, and risk management. You will constantly seek out new ideas and technologies that you can use to deliver a higher quality service.

You will be accountable for providing our customers with an exceptional AMS Operations experience. You will possess excellent customer facing communication skills. You will represent AMS within the customers' environment and drive discussions at multiple levels within the customer organization to Senior Leaders at the C level technical personnel and management regarding incident management, trade-offs, best practices, and risk management.

You will be surrounded by people who are smart passionate about cloud computing and believe that world class operations is critical to customer success. Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:

· Ensure customer business objectives are achieved with strong partnership and infrastructure solutions that meet customer's needs.

· Drive customer transformation activities and manage the engagement via governance to ensure successful delivery of solutions.

· Guide customers to ensure success in building and migrating applications software and services following the principles of the AWS Well-Architected Framework.

· Make impactful recommendations and develop technical direction and future state architecture for clients in alignment with their business plans.

· Help educate enterprise customers on the value proposition of AWS and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud.

· Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates.

· Engage customers - collaborate with Customer Service Delivery Managers, Account Teams, and Technical Delivery Managers to develop strong customer and partner relationships.

· You will engage directly with AMS and AWS service teams to be the voice of the customer and work with internal AWS resources to drive innovation, feature requests, and resolution to customer impacting bugs and/or issues.

· Capture and share best-practice knowledge among the AMS Cloud Architecture community.

· Assist in building AMS Operational service offerings and processes that demonstrate the value of well-operated infrastructure in the cloud.

· Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as blogs and whitepapers.

Key job responsibilities
• Work with AWS field sales presales training and support team to help customers and partners on key engagements in technical cloud computing using AWS. Develop and deliver proof-of-concept projects and technical workshops. Support implementation projects and assist customers with cloud computing & processing capabilities. Help partners and customers utilize AWS services which include understanding customer requirements, proposing and delivering packaged offerings, and delivering custom solution engagements. Support new distributed computing solutions spanning private and public cloud services. Migrate existing applications and develop new ones using AWS cloud services.

About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
- 5+ years of cloud based solution (AWS or equivalent), system, network and operating system experience
- Bachelor's degree, or 5+ years of professional experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- AWS Professional level certification

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Portfolio Manager, Portfolio Management, Strategic Portfolio Management
description:
DESCRIPTION

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com which provides cloud services. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. If you are interested in a career working in a high growth, fast paced and Customer focused work environment then AWS may be the right fit for you.

The AWS Global Data Center Supply Solutions Team is looking for an experienced professional based in Singapore. In this role, you will be a key member of the Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) team responsible for mitigating financial and contractual risks for our expanding portfolio in Asia Pacific, Japan and China region. Managers work closely with lessors/vendors and internal partner teams to ensure accurate and timely payment of our rent obligations while ensuring contractual compliance.

The ideal candidate is detail oriented and a strong communicator that can work independently in an extremely fast-paced environment with a high demand with a high degree of ambiguity.

Key job responsibilities
- Independently manage a portfolio of complex leases and contracts end-to-end — including abstraction, verification, and integration into lease management systems. Interpret contractual nuances and identify cost optimization opportunities.
- Oversee payment processes, audit invoices against contractual obligations, and monitor compliance of internal and external stakeholders. Support regulatory audit requirements.
- Lead the review of contract abstractions against source documents; establish and refine QC standards for the team.
- Maintain accurate site-level data across contract administration systems to support financial reporting, planning, and leadership decision-making. Produce team performance metrics.
- Maintain effective relationships with vendors, landlords, and internal teams (Accounting, Finance, Business Development, Legal). Proactively identify relationship improvement opportunities.
- Track renewals, escalations, and notices to maintain compliance and operational continuity.
Identify portfolio risks and potential blockers; manage escalations independently and escalate to senior leaders when required.
- Guide and mentor junior team members; share best practices and contribute to team capability development.
- Improve operations and audit processes to bolster team efficacy. Drive scalable solutions that enhance efficiency and stakeholder experience.

- 5+ years of property management, asset management, portfolio management and/or real estate financial analysis experience
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Real Estate, or another related field

- Experience with Landlord and Tenant codes, commercial law and service charge

- Experience reading and interpreting lease language, managing critical lease dates, and conducting lease negotiations

- Experience with lease administration processes
- Master's degree or above in enginnering or equivalent, or 3+ years of vendor management experience

- Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines

title: Coordinator, Human Resources
description:
Company Description

VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.

CNBC INTERNATIONAL

CNBC is the world’s number one business and financial news network. Its mission is to help the influential and aspirational make astute decisions to get ahead by providing live market updates, breaking news, in-depth analysis and exclusive interviews.

CNBC’s vast portfolio includes CNBC.com, the online destination for global business; CNBC PRO, the network’s premium subscription service that provides real-time global market data and market analysis, as well as a growing slate of live and virtual events where consumers can experience CNBC’s award-winning journalism, live.

With headquarters in New Jersey, London, Singapore, and Abu Dhabi, CNBC provides a truly global 24-hour business briefing for senior business leaders, the financial community and those with assets to invest or protect. Today the channel is available in more than 392 million homes worldwide. CNBC also boasts a growing audience across its social media and digital video platforms.

Visit www.cnbc.com for more information.

Job Description

OVERVIEW

CNBC International is looking for an HR Coordinator to provide comprehensive operational support to the International HR team in employee lifecycle processes. This role provides exposure to a range of generalist activities, embedding the HR Coordinator as a key member of the HR team for the business.

In this role, you will be the first point of contact for a range of HR related queries and administrative processes.

You’ll be joining a collaborative and friendly team of corporate functions professionals working alongside digital and TV news experts, creative talents, operations specialists, and sales teams. Reporting to the HR Director, CNBC International, this role offers an exciting opportunity for someone looking to build on their HR Generalist skills within a fast-paced environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

HRIS & Payroll

Maintain accurate and timely employee records in Workday, ensuring data quality, compliance, and reliable reporting across the employee lifecycle.

Serve as primary expert for all HR systems and transactions to keep our business running.

Partner with the HR Generalist, payroll teams, and relevant vendors to deliver accurate data and run monthly payroll reports, and maintaining up-to-date trackers for all our processes.

Provide timely employee data to benefits providers for new hires, lifecycle changes, and leavers, while managing vendor escalations and feedback on benefits matters.

Support the ongoing integration and optimization of Workday across CNBC International, including testing system enhancements, documenting processes, and identifying opportunities to streamline HR workflows.

Build employee and manager confidence in Workday by creating clear guidance, troubleshooting self-service issues, and promoting adoption of available tools and functionality.

Partner with HR Operations and relevant stakeholders to ensure Workday processes, data standards/changes, and reporting requirements are consistently implemented across the region.

Employee Experience

Deliver outstanding first-line support for daily HR queries from employees and managers, proactively enhancing the employee experience while escalating complex issues to the HR Director as needed.

Champion and support CNBC employee engagement initiatives, serving as the go-to resource for queries about employee events and experiences across CNBC International.

Assist and support onboarding and offboarding processes, including managing new hire background checks, creating and updating employee records in HRIS, and ensuring all induction and offer materials are accurate and complete.

Administrative Support

Prepare employment contracts, letters, and communications related to employee lifecycle changes and accurately document and track their contents.

Partner with the HR Generalist to prepare job descriptions and work closely with the Talent Acquisition team to support open requisitions.

Track and capture all visa and immigration related documentation.

Assist in any program rollouts (i.e. performance review process, salary planning, benefits open enrollment, early careers programs, etc.)

Ensure prompt processing of employee benefits and perks, such as gift vouchers for long service awards and life event recognition.

Plan and coordinate induction sessions and HR events, while providing administrative support for organizational changes.

Support Global Mobility in managing internal and external relocations, and remote working requests.

Use HR systems to provide accurate reports and data to HR business partners, government surveys, and business leaders.

Organize, conduct and maintain data on leavers and exit interviews.

Support with note taking in a variety of meetings.

Check and process invoices.

Qualifications

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

In this role, you’ll exercise sound personal judgment, cultivate relationships, and explore available resources to rapidly build institutional knowledge and effectively support our client groups. The attributes below are essential in successfully accomplishing this.

Demonstrated experience in developing, implementing, and managing new processes and project deliverables.

Excellent digital fluency skills, including the ability to coordinate and administer meetings using communication platforms (e.g., Zoom, and Slack) and strong knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.

Ability to succinctly record in writing the main points of what is presented in a meeting, highlighting important key topics or themes that are emphasized, and organizing the material in a style that will best capture facts, ideas, and action item.

Demonstrated ability to work effectively with a diverse group of management and staff including executive levels.

Methodical and organized in your approach to work with high attention to detail and a professional, calm manner.

A supportive and collaborative team member with strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Able to maintain a high level of confidentiality and discretion in handling sensitive information

Ability to prioritize tasks and a pro-active, solutions orientated approach to work.

Adaptable to changing priorities and deadlines

Punctual and able to effectively manage time.

Excellent written and oral communication.

Strong attention to detail.

DESIRED ATTRIBUTES

While not essential for this role, candidates with experience or proficiency in the following attributes tend to excel in this position.

Two (2) or more years of experience working in administrative and/or planning capacities.

Fluency in Chinese language in order to edit templates, appropriately file documents, and understand important aspects of employee files and benefits.

Experience working within an HR specialty or environment.

The responsibilities associated with this position are not limited to the above description and may be modified at any time by the Company.

Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with a VERSANT Media employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. VERSANT Media's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to candidateaccessibility@versantmedia.com.

VERSANT Media is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at VERSANT via-email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written Statement of Work in place for this position from VERSANT's Talent Acquisition team will be deemed the sole property of VERSANT. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by VERSANT as a result of the referral or through other means.

title: Software Technical Lead
company: ST ENGINEERING TRAINING & SIMULATION SYSTEMS PTE. LTD.
description:
About ST Engineering

ST Engineering

is a global technology, defence, and engineering group with offices across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and the U.S., serving customers in more than 100 countries. The Group uses technology and innovation to solve real-world problems and improve lives through its diverse portfolio of businesses across the aerospace, smart city, defence, and public security segments. title: Consultant, Red Team
description:
We are seeking a skilled and adaptable Red Team Consultant to deliver Red Team and Purple Team engagements for our customers. The consultant will simulate realistic threats, identify weaknesses across people, processes, and technology, and collaborate with defensive teams to improve security detection and response capabilities.

This is a dynamic, customer-facing role involving assignments that may vary in scope, duration, location, and delivery approach. Consultants should be comfortable adapting to different customer environments and evolving project requirements.

Red Team Engagements

- Plan and conduct authorised Red Team engagements, adversarial simulations, and objective-based security assessments.

- Translate relevant threats and customer risks into realistic attack scenarios.

- Perform reconnaissance, initial-access testing, social engineering, privilege escalation, lateral movement, persistence, and data-access simulations where authorised.

- Assess security controls across networks, endpoints, applications, cloud platforms, identity systems, and operational processes.

- Identify and demonstrate attack paths that could expose critical systems or business assets.

- Develop or adapt tools, scripts, payloads, and supporting infrastructure to achieve engagement objectives.

- Maintain operational security and minimise the risk of unintended disruption throughout each engagement.

Purple Team Engagements

- Collaborate with Blue Teams, Security Operations Centres, incident response teams, and other defensive stakeholders.

- Design and execute controlled attack scenarios to validate preventive, detective, and responsive security controls.

- Map simulated adversary behaviours to recognised frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

- Evaluate security alerts, telemetry, logging coverage, investigation workflows, and response procedures.

- Help defensive teams develop and refine detection rules, use cases, playbooks, and response processes.

- Facilitate knowledge-sharing sessions to explain attacker techniques and strengthen defensive capabilities.

- Conduct validation and retesting to confirm that identified security gaps have been addressed.

- Document improvements and remaining areas of security exposure.

Engagement Planning and Governance

- Define engagement objectives, scope, assumptions, success criteria, and rules of engagement with relevant stakeholders.

- Ensure all activities are conducted within approved legal, ethical, safety, and customer-defined boundaries.

- Follow applicable change-control, data-handling, access-control, and escalation procedures.

- Maintain accurate records of actions, evidence, findings, and attack paths.

- Communicate critical findings, operational concerns, and potential business risks promptly.

- Coordinate with project managers, internal teams, and customer stakeholders throughout the engagement lifecycle.

Reporting and Stakeholder Communication

- Produce clear technical reports, executive summaries, attack narratives, and prioritised remediation recommendations.

- Explain technical findings in terms of their operational and business impact.

- Present engagement outcomes to technical teams, senior management, and executive stakeholders.

- Deliver engagement debriefs and remediation workshops where required.

- Support remediation planning, validation, and retesting.

Capability Development

- Contribute to the improvement of Red Team and Purple Team methodologies, tools, procedures, and knowledge bases.

- Research emerging threats, vulnerabilities, attack techniques, defensive approaches, and security technologies.

- Share technical knowledge, lessons learned, and good practices with team members.

- Support the development of reusable attack scenarios and detection-validation content.

Customer Engagement and Adaptability

- Deliver assignments of varying scope, complexity, and duration based on customer and business needs.

- Work at customer premises when required.

- Adapt to different industries, technologies, operating environments, and levels of security maturity.

- Remain flexible in supporting planned and ad-hoc project requirements.

- Communicate effectively with internal teams and customer stakeholders throughout each assignment.

- Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP) is required.

- Advanced or specialist certifications, such as OSEP, OSED, OSWE, CRTO, CRTE, CREST CRT/CCT, GPEN, GXPN, would be advantageous.

- Demonstrated experience in Red Teaming, Purple Teaming, adversarial simulation, penetration testing, or a related offensive security role.

- Strong knowledge of adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures, including the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

- Hands-on experience with network, Active Directory, Windows, Linux, web application, cloud, and identity-based attack techniques.

- Experience collaborating with defensive security teams to validate and improve security controls.

- Understanding of defensive technologies and processes, including SIEM, endpoint detection and response, network monitoring, security logging, threat hunting, and incident response.

- Proficiency with relevant commercial or open-source offensive security tools and frameworks.

- Ability to develop or modify tools and scripts using languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, C#, or another relevant programming language.

- Ability to analyse complex attack paths and translate technical findings into clear business risks and actionable recommendations.

- Strong report-writing, presentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

- Sound professional judgement and a strong commitment to ethics, confidentiality, operational security, and authorised testing boundaries.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.

- Willingness and ability to undertake customer-facing assignments of varying duration, including working at customer premises when required.

- Flexibility to support ad-hoc assignments and changing project requirements.

- Eligibility to obtain any security clearance or customer-specific access approval required for assigned engagements.

- A degree or diploma in cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, or a related discipline is preferred; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

title: Digital Media Management Specialist , Entertainment
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Mediacorp is Singapore's largest content creator and national media network, operating a suite of TV channels, radio stations, and multiple digital platforms. Its mission is to engage, entertain, and enrich audiences by harnessing the power of creativity.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace where talent thrives. Our hiring decisions are made based on merit and fit-to-role. If you have a disability or special need which requires accommodation to participate in the recruitment process, please inform us when you submit your online application. We will be happy to support as necessary.

Thank you for your interest and application to this role. Please note that only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

RESPONSIBILITIES

This role has organisation-wide scope across entertainment content, covering the end-to-end management of digital media assets within the Production Asset Management ecosystem.

The role is responsible for metadata governance, AI-assisted tagging accuracy, taxonomy management, and the organisation of content to support efficient ingest, search, retrieval, reuse, localisation, and multiplatform distribution. It ensures that all media assets are consistently classified, rights-aware, and aligned with branding and data governance standards.

Working cross-functionally with Editorial, Production, Programming, Marketing, Digital, Technology, and Data Governance teams, the role supports the integration, adoption, and optimisation of asset management workflows, user practices, and system capabilities.

Candidates appointed to the role will also be cross-trained to support news-related workflows and operational requirements where needed.

While not responsible for content creation decisions, the role plays a critical enabling function by improving content discoverability, supporting compliance and rights visibility, enhancing AI-enabled workflows, and identifying opportunities for content reuse and operational efficiency across platforms.

Responsibilities:

Metadata and AI Tagging Management

Oversee the generation, review, and accuracy of metadata created by AI tools, including facial recognition, speech-to-text transcription, scene detection, object detection, logo recognition, speaker identification, talent identification, and location tagging

Develop and maintain metadata standards, taxonomies, genre classifications, keyword hierarchies, and tagging conventions aligned with entertainment content workflows

Ensure consistent tagging across drama, variety, lifestyle, reality, music, promotional, short-form, and archival assets to support accurate search and retrieval within the Production Asset Management system.

Maintain structured metadata for key entertainment attributes, including programme title, episode number, season, synopsis, cast, hosts, guests, locations, topics, themes, language, subtitles, ratings, rights windows, platform restrictions, embargoes, and promotional usage

Support improved content discoverability for internal users across production, editorial, programming, marketing, digital, social, distribution, and related teams

Workflow Integration and Asset Management

Manage the integration of the Production Asset Management system with entertainment production, post-production, promo, and publishing tools, including systems such as Adobe Premiere

Support efficient ingest, cataloguing, versioning, localisation, retrieval, reuse, archival, and publishing of entertainment media assets

Set up and maintain user roles, access rights, approval workflows, and asset permissions for production, editorial, programming, marketing, promo, digital, and technical teams

Ensure entertainment assets are properly organised for multiplatform use, including digital platforms, social media platforms, partner platforms, and commercial distribution

Work with stakeholders to streamline media handover processes from production, field teams and post-production into archival and publishing workflows

Quality Control, Rights, and Compliance

Perform regular quality checks on ingested video, audio, image, subtitle, caption, transcript, and promotional assets to ensure technical, branding, metadata, and compliance integrity

Oversee copyright management, talent rights, music rights, clip usage, third-party material, platform restrictions, embargoes, sponsorship obligations, and rights usage tracking

Ensure compliance with data privacy policies and content governance frameworks, particularly for facial recognition, audience footage, minors, and rights-managed material

Maintain adherence to archival, retention, backup, and preservation policies to protect the long-term value and integrity of entertainment content

Flag missing, inconsistent, outdated, duplicated, sensitive, embargoed, or incorrectly tagged assets and coordinate resolution with relevant teams

Training and User Support

Conduct training sessions and workshops for producers, promo teams, programming teams, marketers, and digital teams on AI-enabled search, tagging, metadata standards, and media retrieval

Develop user manuals, quick guides, workflow notes, and best practice documents for entertainment metadata management and AI-assisted asset workflows

Act as the primary point of contact for teams on asset-related issues, search and retrieval queries, metadata corrections, rights information, access permissions, and system feedback

Gather user feedback and work with Technology and Data Governance teams to improve system usability, tagging accuracy, workflow efficiency, and adoption across entertainment operations

Content Opportunity and Performance Monitoring

Monitor newly ingested and archived entertainment assets to identify content suitable for social media, promotional campaigns, digital features, highlights, compilations, recaps, or commercial reuse

Alert relevant content, marketing, digital, or social teams when there are strong opportunities to repurpose entertainment clips and assets

Monitor and report on system performance metrics, including tagging accuracy, ingest efficiency, search success rate, asset usage, storage utilisation, and metadata completeness

Propose workflow improvements based on user feedback, operational needs, emerging technologies, and evolving multiplatform content strategies

Support initiatives that improve content discoverability, archive value, entertainment content reuse, multiplatform publishing efficiency, and audience engagement

QUALIFICATIONS

Good understanding of entertainment content formats, including drama, variety, lifestyle, reality, music, short-form video, promos, interviews, and archival programming

Degree or Diploma in Media Management, Broadcast Technology, Mass Communication, Film, Television, Digital Media, Entertainment Management, or a related field

At least 3 years of experience in broadcast, entertainment, digital media, production asset management, post-production, content operations, or media archive management

Familiarity with Production Asset Management or Media Asset Management systems, preferably within a broadcast, entertainment, OTT, or post-production environment

Experience with media-related AI tools such as facial recognition, speech-to-text, scene detection, object detection, automated transcription, speaker identification, or metadata generation will be an advantage

Strong understanding of metadata standards, content taxonomy, SEO basics, digital discoverability, and multiplatform content workflows

Knowledge of rights management, talent rights, music usage, platform restrictions, data governance, and content security practices

Excellent communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with creative, production, technical, programming, marketing, and digital teams

Detail-oriented, organised, and comfortable managing large volumes of media assets and metadata in fast-paced environments

Experience working in entertainment production, post-production, programming, digital content, or media archive environments will be an advantage

Prepared to work irregular shift hours, weekends, and public holidays where operational needs require

Please note that your application will be sent to and reviewed by the direct employer - Mediacorp Pte. Ltd.

title: Business Development & Marketing Manager (Education)
description:
About SCALA

The Supply Chain And Logistics Academy (SCALA) is the industry level training academy for logistics and supply chain and the only organization that specializes in Experiential Workplace Learning focused on supply chain leadership, technology and sustainability.

We currently serve over 600 corporate clients, many of whom are leading industry icons. Our courses are experiential and designed to make individuals job-ready and future-skilled. Our programs are both place-and-train as well as train-and-place, with redeployment and re-skilling options. We are expanding our offerings to include advanced programs that enable organizations to leverage technology and new business models.

The Business Development Manager (BDM) is responsible for driving SCALA's revenue growth through student enrolment, new programme development, marketing initiatives, business partnerships, and sales channel expansion. The role requires a highly entrepreneurial and results-driven individual who can independently generate leads, convert prospects into enrolled learners, develop new revenue streams, and execute integrated marketing activities to achieve monthly and annual revenue targets.

The successful candidate must possess strong business development and B2C sales capabilities, excellent presentation and networking skills, and hands-on experience in marketing execution, learner recruitment, and programme commercialization.

Key Responsibilities

1. Revenue Growth:

Achieve and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets set by management.

Drive learner enrolment growth through proactive lead generation, consultative selling, and relationship management.

Manage the full sales cycle from lead acquisition, qualification, consultation, follow-up, proposal preparation, and enrolment conversion.

Develop and implement strategies to maximize learner acquisition and retention.

Monitor sales pipeline performance and provide accurate revenue forecasts.

Identify, develop, and establish new sales channels to increase market reach and revenue generation.

Build strategic partnerships with corporate organizations, educational institutions, associations, industry bodies, and referral networks.

Explore new business opportunities and market segments that align with SCALA's growth objectives.

Negotiate and manage partnership agreements to drive sustainable enrolment growth.

2. Marketing & Lead Generation:

Plan and execute marketing campaigns to generate qualified leads and increase market awareness of SCALA's programmes.

Create and manage marketing collateral, promotional materials, sales presentations, brochures, videos, and digital assets.

Work closely with internal or external vendors to manage and continuously improve SCALA's website and digital presence.

Support content creation for social media, email marketing, online advertising, and other lead generation initiatives.

Track and analyse marketing campaign effectiveness and optimize activities based on performance metrics.

3. Programme Development & New Revenue Streams:

Research market trends, learner demands, and industry skill gaps to identify new programme opportunities.

Propose, develop, and launch new training programmes that generate additional revenue streams for SCALA.

Collaborate with trainers, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to design market-relevant learning solutions.

Develop business cases and go-to-market plans for new programmes and services.

4. Events, Seminars & Brand Building:

Represent SCALA professionally at seminars, workshops, exhibitions, education fairs, and networking events.

Deliver engaging presentations to prospective learners, corporate clients, and industry partners.

Organize and manage marketing events, industry networking sessions, and lead generation activities.

Build SCALA's reputation and visibility within the learning and professional development ecosystem.

5. Reporting & Performance Management:

Track KPIs related to sales performance, lead conversion, marketing effectiveness, and programme profitability.

Prepare regular sales and business development reports for management.

Maintain an updated CRM database and ensure effective follow-up on all leads and opportunities.

Recommend continuous improvements to enhance sales productivity and revenue performance.

Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor's Degree in Business Studies, Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or other related disciplines.

Minimum 4 to 5 years of relevant Business Development, Sales, or Marketing experience with demonstrable revenue achievement records.

Proven success in B2C/B2B sales, learner recruitment, student enrolment, training programme sales, education services, or professional development sectors.

Strong track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales and revenue targets.

Candidates with working experience in the following sectors will have an added advantage:

- Education &Training

- Professional Learning & Development

- Executive Education

- Corporate Training

- Skills Development

- Higher Education

- Lifelong Learning& Adult Education

Skills & Competencies

1. Sales & Business Development

Strong consultative selling and negotiation skills.

Ability to independently source, develop, and close business opportunities.

Excellent pipeline management and lead conversion capabilities.

Strong commercial acumen and revenue-focused mindset.

2. Marketing

Experience planning and executing digital and offline marketing campaigns.

Ability to create marketing content, promotional materials, and sales collateral.

Familiarity with website management, social media marketing, email campaigns, and lead generation strategies.

3. Communication & Presentation

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong presentation and public speaking abilities.

Confidence in conducting seminars, webinars, and industry presentations.

4. Relationship Management

Strong networking and stakeholder engagement skills.

Ability to build and maintain long-term relationships with learners, partners, and industry stakeholders.

5. Personal Attributes

Self-motivated, independent, and results oriented.

Entrepreneurial mindset with strong initiative.

Creative thinker with strong problem-solving skills.

Able to thrive in a fast-paced and target-driven environment.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Business Development Manager will be measured on:

Monthly and annual revenue achievement.

Learner enrolment numbers.

Lead generation volume and quality.

Lead-to-enrolment conversion rate.

Number of new programmes launched.

Revenue generated from new programmes.

Number of strategic partnerships and sales channels established.
