title: Research Assistant/Associate (AI Specialist)
description:
Job Title: Research Assistant/Associate (AI Specialist)
University-Level Unit: Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine
Faculty/Department-Level Unit: Biochemistry
Employee Category: Research Staff
Location_ONB: Kent Ridge Campus
Posting Start Date: 20/05/2026
Job Description

About the Program:
The MSc in Precision Health and Medicine x Artificial Intelligence (MScPHMxAI) programme at the National University of Singapore is a forward-looking graduate programme designed to train the next generation of healthcare, biomedical, and data-driven professionals in precision health and medicine.

The programme integrates emerging approaches in multi-omics, biomedical data science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, computational biology, digital health, and translational medicine. A key objective of the programme is to develop innovative, research-informed approaches to teaching, learning, student support, capstone training, industry engagement, and AI-enabled programme delivery.

We are seeking a motivated and capable Research Assistant (s) (at least 1) to support research and innovation activities within the MScPHM programme, with a particular focus on AI-enabled education, precision health learning support, programme analytics, computational infrastructure, and capstone research coordination.

Position Summary:
The Research Assistant(s) will work closely with the Programme Directors, faculty members, students, and relevant academic and industry partners to support applied research and innovation in the MSc in Precision Health and Medicine programme.

The role will focus on developing, implementing, and evaluating AI-enabled approaches to enhance learning, research training, student support, programme operations, and capstone project development. The successful candidate will contribute to research on the effective and ethical use of AI in graduate education, learning analytics, precision health training, student progression, outreach strategy, industry alignment, and computational learning support.

This is a research-facing role with programme implementation responsibilities. The Research Assistant will support the generation of research outputs, reports, dashboards, workflows, educational resources, and evidence-based recommendations to improve the MScPHM programme and strengthen its role in precision health and medicine education.

Key Responsibilities

1. Applied Research in AI for Precision Health and Medicine Education

The Research Assistant(s) will contribute to research and innovation projects related to AI-enabled learning, programme development, and precision health education. Responsibilities include:

Assist in research on the use of AI, machine learning, and data-driven methods to support learning in precision health and medicine.
Support research into ethical, effective, and responsible approaches for using AI in graduate education, including how AI can enhance learning without compromising deep understanding, academic integrity, or independent thinking.
Contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of AI-assisted learning workflows for MScPHM students.
Assist in developing research frameworks to evaluate student learning needs, progression, engagement, and performance across the programme.
Support the preparation of research reports, presentations, manuscripts, grant materials, and internal programme evaluation documents.
Conduct literature reviews and benchmarking studies on AI in education, precision health training, biomedical data science education, and graduate programme innovation.

2. Capstone Research Support and Student Research Development

The Research Assistant(s) will support the research training component of the MScPHM programme, particularly capstone and project-based learning activities. Responsibilities include:

Assist Programme Directors and faculty members in guiding students undertaking capstone projects involving AI, data science, multi-omics, bioinformatics, or precision health applications.
Provide research and technical support to students working on computational or AI-related capstone projects.
Help monitor capstone project progress and identify students who may require additional research or technical support.
Support the development of capstone project resources, templates, research guidance materials, and computational learning aids.
Assist in identifying suitable academic, clinical, research, and industry partners who may host or co-supervise capstone projects.
Maintain and improve structured systems for tracking capstone topics, mentors, student progress, outputs, and project outcomes.
Contribute to research on how capstone training can be better aligned with industry, healthcare, research, and workforce needs in precision health and medicine.
Key Responsibilities

3. Programme Analytics, Student Progress Research, and Learning Support

The Research Assistant(s) will support data-driven approaches to student learning, engagement, and progression. Responsibilities include:

Assist in collecting, organising, analysing, and interpreting programme-related data, including student engagement, academic progression, assessment outcomes, capstone outcomes, and feedback.
Develop dashboards, reports, and analytical summaries to help the programme team identify student needs and improve learning support.
Support research-informed strategies to help students with varied computational backgrounds succeed in modules involving AI, data science, statistics, bioinformatics, or programming.
Assist in organising research-informed computational support sessions, workshops, or clinics for students requiring additional help with programming, Linux, R, Python, AI/ML tools, or data analysis workflows.
Support the development of learning materials for computational and AI-related components of the programme.
Assist in evaluating the effectiveness of active learning tools, digital platforms, and AI-enabled learning interventions.
Support academic integrity initiatives by helping evaluate tools and workflows related to assessment design, online learning, and responsible AI use.

4. AI-Enabled Workflow Development and Research Operations

The Research Assistant(s) will help design and implement AI-enabled workflows to improve the efficiency, quality, and evidence base of programme-related research and operations. Responsibilities include:

Identify opportunities to streamline research, learning support, student monitoring, capstone coordination, outreach tracking, and programme evaluation workflows.
Design, implement, or recommend AI-assisted solutions, scripts, dashboards, forms, databases, and automation workflows to reduce repetitive manual work.
Develop and maintain structured datasets related to student progression, capstone projects, mentor networks, industry engagement, outreach outcomes, and programme evaluation.
Assist in building reproducible workflows for reporting, data cleaning, analysis, and visualisation.
Support responsible use of AI tools in programme processes, including documentation, data privacy awareness, and quality control.
Stay updated on emerging AI, automation, and educational technology tools relevant to graduate education and precision health training.
Key Responsibilities

5. Computational and Technical Research Support

The Research Assistant(s) will support the technical and computational infrastructure required for AI-enabled learning and research activities. Responsibilities include:

Support the maintenance and management of programme-related computing environments, including Linux-based servers, user accounts, permissions, and relevant software environments.
Assist students and faculty with basic troubleshooting of computational workflows used in teaching, learning, and capstone research.
Support the use of high-performance computing, cluster, cloud, or server-based workflows where relevant.
Help prepare technical documentation, guides, and reproducible examples for students using R, Python, Bash, Linux, bioinformatics tools, data analysis workflows, or AI/ML platforms.
Assist in ensuring that computing environments are reliable, secure, and suitable for student learning and research activities.
Work with relevant IT or institutional teams where needed to support programme-related technical requirements.

6. Research on Programme Positioning, Outreach, and Industry Alignment

The Research Assistant(s) will contribute to research and evidence-gathering activities that strengthen the MScPHM programme’s positioning and relevance. Responsibilities include:

Assist in research to identify the profiles, motivations, and needs of prospective students who are best suited for the MScPHM programme.
Support analysis of admissions trends, applicant backgrounds, recruitment channels, and outreach effectiveness.
Help evaluate how the programme can better attract high-quality, best-fit applicants.
Assist in identifying relevant research groups, clinical partners, companies, industry sectors, and organisations in precision health and medicine that may support capstone projects, internships, employment pathways, or collaborations.
Maintain structured records of potential academic, clinical, and industry partners.
Support the development of evidence-based outreach materials, digital content, programme summaries, and impact reports.
Assist in analysing the impact of website updates, social media activities, information sessions, and other outreach initiatives.

7. Programme Implementation Support

As part of supporting research and innovation within the programme, the Research Assistant(s) will also assist with selected implementation activities necessary for the smooth running and evaluation of MScPHM initiatives. These may include:

Supporting the preparation of learning materials, digital resources, workshops, and programme documentation.
Assisting with coordination of research-related student activities, capstone briefings, workshops, seminars, and industry engagement sessions.
Liaising with students, faculty, mentors, and partners on matters related to research activities, capstone coordination, technical support, and learning resources.
Supporting the accurate organisation of programme-related data, records, reports, and documentation.
Assisting with website and digital content updates related to programme research activities, capstone highlights, student achievements, and outreach initiatives.
Assisting in organizing activities for the MScPHM students
Qualifications

Essential Requirements

A good Honours Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in computational biology, bioinformatics, data science, biomedical informatics, computer science, biomedical sciences, precision health, or a closely related field.
Strong interest in AI, machine learning, data analytics, biomedical data science, or precision health and medicine.
Strong programming skills in Python and/or R .
Familiarity with Linux-based computing environments and basic Bash scripting.
Ability to support students or research users with computational workflows, coding issues, data analysis, or reproducible research practices.
Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks, datasets, documents, and project timelines.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with faculty, students, administrators, and external partners.
Strong attention to detail, especially in data management, documentation, reporting, and student progress tracking.

Desirable Requirements

Experience with AI/ML methods, biomedical data analysis, bioinformatics pipelines, omics data, health data, or computational medicine.
Experience supporting research projects, capstone projects, student projects, or academic programme evaluation.
Experience with Linux server administration, user management, permissions, software installation, or computing infrastructure support.
Experience with high-performance computing, cloud computing, clusters, or containerised environments.
Familiarity with workflow automation, scripting, dashboards, data pipelines, or automated reporting.
Experience with educational technology, learning analytics, digital learning platforms, or active learning tools.

title: Communications Executive
description:
*We're Hiring: Communications Executive (English & Mandarin Speaking)*

*Quintessential Education | Full-Time or Part-Time | Orchard Road, Singapore*

*About QE*

Quintessential Education is Singapore's leading provider of pre-tertiary academic programmes (IGCSE & IB) and university admissions advisory for top-tier global universities — Ivy League, Oxbridge, and NUS/NTU/SMU. Since 2012 we have worked with more than 700 students, and most of our new families come to us through referrals. We deliver a fully integrated journey for families: academic mastery, guardianship, and university placement under one roof.

We aim to bring out the best in our students, ignite opportunities and nurture them towards success.

We are looking for committed and talented additions to our team. As an ideal candidate, you should display a proven ability to develop and maintain an environment of trust, diversity, and inclusion within the QE team. You should be able to work with the team to meet deadlines and instill a culture of continuous work improvement.

As part of the position, you will work with the founders, Ivy League and Oxbridge graduates and other high-performing teammates.

*The Role*

We're looking for a Communications Executive to own the day-to-day relationship between QE and our families. You'll be the first person a parent speaks to when they enquire, and the person who keeps them informed once their child is with us. That means answering enquiries every day, matching students with the right tutors and mentors, and following up with students and parents regularly so nothing slips through.

You'll also help keep our marketing materials and partner relationships in good order. We are open to full-time or part-time candidates, so tell us the arrangement that works for you.

If you're a confident communicator in both *English and Mandarin\**, stay calm and warm with demanding parents, and like being the person who makes sure things actually get done — we'd love to meet you.

\*As a major group of customers are from China and are only able to converse in Mandarin.

*Key Responsibilities:*

*1. Enquiries & Enrolment*

* Respond to daily parent and student enquiries via phone, WhatsApp, WeChat, and email, ideally within the same working day.
* Explain our IGCSE, IB, and admissions programmes clearly and recommend the right fit for each student.
* Match students with suitable tutors and mentors, and arrange trial lessons and consultations.
* Track every enquiry through to enrolment and follow up with families who have not yet decided.

*2. Student Follow-Up & Parent Relations*

* Check in regularly with enrolled students and parents on progress, attendance, and any concerns.
* Collect lesson feedback from students and tutors, and deal with issues early before they become complaints.
* Arrange class schedules, replacement lessons, and changes with tutors and families.
* Keep parents informed ahead of key moments: exam periods, predicted grades, application deadlines, and results day.
* Follow up on renewals and next-stage programmes (e.g. IGCSE to IB, IB to university applications).

*3. Business Operations*

* Prepare and track invoices and payments.
* Draft and manage service agreements for clients and tutors.
* Keep client records, notes, and follow-up schedules up to date.
* Keep a simple monthly record of enquiries, enrolments, and renewals for the founders.

*4. Marketing & Partnerships*

* Keep brochures, website content, and newsletters accurate and up to date.
* Work with design and digital marketing agencies on campaigns and collateral.
* Support parent seminars and events, including Mandarin-language sessions with our China school partners.
* Maintain relationships with partner schools, education consultants, and collaborators.

*We're Looking For Someone Who:*

* Has experience in a client-facing role such as education, admissions, client services, or customer service. Fresh graduates with strong communication skills are welcome to apply.
* Has excellent verbal and written communication in English and Chinese. This is required as some Chinese customers can only communicate in Chinese. Japanese and Korean are a bonus as some customers only communicate in these languages.
* Is calm, warm, and professional with high-expectation parents, and comfortable handling difficult conversations.
* Is highly organised, follows up without being reminded, and keeps clear records.
* Can manage many families and a busy inbox at the same time without losing track of details.
* Is proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), Notion or Airtable, and marketing tools (Mailchimp, Canva).
* Is comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) and light automation to streamline workflows.

*Bonus If You:*

* Have experience in the education, tuition, or admissions sector.
* Know the IB, IGCSE, or university application process (UK, US, or Singapore).
* Are familiar with WeChat or Xiaohongshu.

*Working Hours*

*Location: *545 Orchard Road, #14-06/9, Singapore 238882. In Person role.

*Start Date: *As soon as possible

*Commitment: *Full-time or part-time. Propose the days and hours that suit you in your application.

* *Full-time: *5-day work week, Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, 4 days in office and 1 day remote
* *Part-time: *Days and hours by arrangement, with enough weekday cover to keep up with daily enquiries

*Salary & Benefits*

* *Monthly Salary: *$4,500 upwards for full-time, depending on experience; pro-rated for part-time
* *Bonuses: *Additional performance and team-based bonuses apply
* *Benefits Include: *$500 Specialist Stipend per annum (e.g. medical or mental health support), $100 Dental Stipend per annum, $500 Personal Development Stipend per annum (for courses, books, conferences, etc.)

*How to Apply*

Send your CV and a short paragraph on why you're interested in the role to hr@qeducation.sg with the subject line: *Application – Communications Executive (Full Time / Part Time)*

We look forward to hearing from people who want to make a real difference to the families we work with.

You will be part of Esco Aster’s EVs/Exosomes division and contribute to the company’s CDMO mission and objectives. Job Responsibilities

Execute service contracts from research to clinical grade EVs/Exosomes for upstream and downstream bioprocessing.
Utilize Tide Motion to generate EVs/Exosomes alongside with characterization via FACS and equivalent techniques.
Perform process characterization as needed based on project scope.
Work jointly with other departments (DSP processing/analytical development/QC) to develop end to end continuous process with process intensification.

Write and execute experimental plans as well as white papers, technical reports, presentations.
Support sales, Business Development, product specialists and associated departments as subject matter expert by assisting in technical proposal and costing generation.
Support product and service sales in application, marketing content and quotations.
Aid in working with cross functional team to develop and test new tools for producing Exosomes /EVs.
Aid in writing of user requirement specifications.

Requirements

Degree in Biology or related disciplines.
Bioengineering/Cell biology Background.
At least 1-2 year Cell Culture experience.
At least 1-2 years related laboratory experience with good laboratory practices and pipetting skills (experience in EVs/exosomes preferred).
Experience using formulas and linking spreadsheets in Excel.
Strong computer, scientific, and organizational skills.
Excellent communication (oral and written) and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team, self-motivation, adaptability, and a positive attitude.
Ability to learn new techniques, perform multiple tasks simultaneously, keep accurate records, follow instructions, take initiative and self-learn to keep up with market trends and comply with company policies.
Good presentation skills.
A friendly and pleasant disposition able to work with team.
Experience in the production, purification, and characterization of exosomes or nanoparticles is highly favorable but not strictly required (OJT provided).

Minimum Requirements

Ability to read, analyze and interpret scientific data and publications.
Ability to author or review protocols, technical reports, and technology transfer documents.
Ability to author or review standard operating procedures and other related documents.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw conclusions.
Repetitive motions due to certain laboratory techniques.
Ability to adapt and keep up with rapid changes in a fluid and dynamic environment as this is a rapidly evolving space.

title: Senior Executive / Assistant Manager, NCIS (EPIC, 2-Year Contract)
description:
Career in the Hospital
Join our incredible team at the National University Hospital (NUH), where we believe that a hospital is more than just a workplace. Every day, we witness the remarkable impact that our healthcare professionals can have on individuals, families, and entire communities.

At NUH, we are driven by a shared purpose – to lend a helping hand to those in need, to be a source of support and healing, and to empower patients to live their best lives.
We are looking for passionate and committed individuals to join us as we transform lives and create a lasting impact in the lives of our patients. The impact you make at NUH will be profound, regardless of the role you take up in the hospital.

About NUH
The National University Hospital (NUH) is Singapore’s leading university hospital, with a proud heritage dating back to 1905 with the establishment of what’s now the NUS Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine. Our strong ties with the medical school have shaped us into a unique institution, allowing us to seamlessly integrate clinical care with teaching and research. As a university hospital, we go beyond the realm of providing tertiary medical care. Coordinate with NCIS stakeholders and GMIO on system change requests, enhancements, and workplans
Support daily operations of the NGEMR EPIC Beacon module through system analysis, configuration, testing, maintenance, and troubleshooting
Gather, document, and validate user requirements in collaboration with clinical and operational users
Translate documented requirements to enterprise IT partners (e.g. Synapxe) clearly and accurately
Configure and maintain oncology treatment plans, protocols, and related clinical build content in accordance with approved workflows
Support system testing activities, including preparation of test scripts, test data, and coordination of user acceptance testing
Provide at-the-elbow or on-site support during system go-live and post-implementation stabilization periods
Participate in on-call or after-hours support rotas when required, in accordance with operational schedules
Adhere to institutional governance, information security, and change management policies
Support assigned projects and initiatives led by GMIO or NCIS, as directed by supervisors
Represent the team in workgroups or committees when assigned
Participate in cross-training and continuous learning to expand system and domain knowledge
Contribute positively as a team member and support collaborative working relationships

Key Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Nursing, Health Informatics, Biomedical Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related healthcare / IT disciplines
2 to 3 years of relevant clinical, healthcare operations, informatics, or EMR-related experience
Strong understanding of clinical workflows, preferably oncology-related
Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills
Effective verbal and written communication skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
EPIC certification (e.g. Beacon or other clinical modules) is preferred
Experience supporting EMR build, configuration, or system implementation projects would be an advantage
Exposure to healthcare IT governance, change management, and information security practices would be an advantage

Closing & Applications
When you join NUH, you become part of a dynamic and collaborative environment where expertise, knowledge, and compassion all come together.

Working in healthcare offers satisfaction that extend far beyond the ordinary. The smiles of gratitude from patients and the profound sense of fulfilment that comes from helping others cannot be measured. It is a career that allows for both personal and professional growth. The challenges you encounter in this rapidly evolving industry push you to constantly expand your knowledge and skills, as well as encourage lifelong learning.

Be a part of a team that gets to create a transformative healthcare experience for our patients and professionals alike.

title: Math Tutor (Junior College)
company: ACHIEVERS DREAM LEARNING CENTRE PTE. LTD.
description:
The Sequoia Vision is looking for a passionate and academically strong

JC Mathematics Tutor / Mathematics Specialist

to join our teaching team.

We are looking for educators who enjoy teaching Mathematics, are confident with the

Singapore A-Level Mathematics syllabus and

are able to break down challenging concepts into clear, structured explanations that students can understand and apply.

Whether you are an experienced JC tutor, former/current MOE educator, or a strong Mathematics graduate looking to build a long-term career in education, we welcome you to explore this opportunity with us.

Team Culture

We believe good educators grow best in an environment where people can learn from one another, exchange ideas and continuously improve their craft.

Real Connections:

We value open and honest communication. Ideas, teaching strategies and constructive feedback are encouraged.

Team Support:

You will work alongside fellow educators who share resources, teaching insights and feedback to help one another improve.

Focus on Teaching:

We want our educators to spend their energy on helping students learn, rather than being weighed down by unnecessary administrative work.

Continuous Improvement:

We believe even experienced teachers can continue developing their teaching methodology, classroom delivery and ability to engage different types of learners.

Impact on Students:

Our goal goes beyond helping students complete questions—we want them to understand Mathematics, become stronger problem-solvers and gain confidence in the subject.

Key Responsibilities

As a

JC Mathematics Tutor / Mathematics Specialist

, you will:

Teach

JC H1 and/or H2 Mathematics

in accordance with the Singapore MOE A-Level syllabus.

Deliver clear, structured and engaging lessons that help students understand complex mathematical concepts.

Guide students in developing strong problem-solving techniques and effective approaches to A-Level examination questions.

Identify students' learning gaps and provide targeted guidance to strengthen weaker areas.

Help students connect mathematical concepts across different topics instead of relying solely on memorised procedures.

Prepare, review and/or improve lesson materials, worksheets, revision resources and assessment questions.

Analyse students' work and common misconceptions to improve teaching effectiveness.

Monitor students' academic progress and provide appropriate feedback and intervention where necessary.

Participate in lesson observations, peer sharing, internal training and professional development.

Collaborate with other Mathematics educators on curriculum development, teaching strategies and educational projects.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

Has a

strong command of JC / A-Level Mathematics

.

Is confident in explaining challenging mathematical concepts in a simple and logical manner.

Enjoys working with teenagers and understands that students learn at different speeds and ability levels.

Is patient, engaging and able to build students' confidence in Mathematics.

Is receptive to coaching, lesson feedback and continuous professional development.

Is reliable, responsible and able to work collaboratively within a teaching team.

Is interested in developing a

long-term career in education and Mathematics teaching

.

Qualifications

Candidates should preferably meet one or more of the following:

Bachelor's Degree in

Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, Physics

, or another highly quantitative discipline from a recognised university.

Strong academic results in

A-Level H2 Mathematics or equivalent

.

Prior experience teaching

JC H1/H2 Mathematics

in an MOE school, tuition centre or private tuition setting is highly advantageous.

Fresh university graduates with excellent Mathematics fundamentals and strong communication skills are also welcome to apply.

Candidates will be required to demonstrate sufficient Mathematics content competency as part of the selection process.

Training & Career Development

For candidates joining our full-time teaching team, we provide structured training and development, which may include:

Observation of experienced educators.

Training in our teaching methodology and lesson delivery approach.

Lesson practice and teaching feedback.

Curriculum and resource familiarisation.

Classroom management and student engagement techniques.

Progressive assignment of classes based on teaching readiness.

Experienced educators may progress more quickly through the training pathway based on demonstrated teaching competency and performance.

Career progression opportunities are available towards roles such as:

Mathematics Specialist → Senior Mathematics Specialist → Master / Lead Mathematics Specialist

Progression is based on teaching competency, contribution, performance and demonstrated ability.

Working Arrangement

Full-Time and Part-Time opportunities are available.

As our students attend lessons primarily outside regular school hours, candidates should be comfortable with a teaching schedule of 4 weekdays and 1 weekend or 3 weekdays and 2 weekends.

Specific working arrangements will be discussed according to the position applied for.

Join Us

If Mathematics is a subject you genuinely enjoy and you find satisfaction in helping students finally understand concepts they once struggled with, we would love to hear from you.

At The Sequoia Vision, we are looking for educators who want to continuously improve their craft, contribute to a strong teaching team and make a meaningful difference in their students' learning.

To apply, please submit your updated resume for our review.

We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Founded in 2017, Achievers Dream is a Chemistry Specialist Tuition Centre dedicated to helping students truly understand the subject — not just memorise it. We’re one of the few centres in Singapore with an NEA-approved Chemistry lab, where students get to learn in a real, guided setting. Our structured learning system breaks down difficult topics into manageable steps and real-life examples that make learning more relatable. We believe in clear teaching, solid systems, and a team that supports one another and takes pride in seeing students improve.

Training/Compliance

Develop and train Medical Writing Services staff to enhance writing quality, efficiency, and project management.
Implement and monitor departmental compliance to SOPs. Input to development or revision of departmental SOPs, as appropriate.
Develop and present external training courses.

General

Comply with departmental procedures and requirements, such as completion of project assignment and workload trackers on the applicable software platform
Analyze efficiency of work and discuss improvement ideas with Medical Writing
Services management and colleagues, e.g., evaluation of software to increase productivity and document quality.

Skills:

Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, verbal, and written communication skills.
A flexible attitude with respect to work assignments and new learning.
Motivation to work consistently in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment.
Ability to manage multiple and varied tasks with enthusiasm and prioritize workload with attention to detail, e.g., organizational skills.
Competent working in a matrix environment and values the importance of teamwork. Possesses team leadership skills and cross-cultural sensitivity.
Exhibits sound judgement: escalates issues to project teams or departmental management as appropriate. Presents solutions and follows through to ensure problems have been satisfactorily resolved.
Ability to negotiate on behalf of medical writing to ensure resources, timelines and expectations are aligned.
Understands and satisfies client needs.
Establishes a connection with the client beyond one's project, to gain repeat business and/or to widen existing scope and services. Ability to gain trust and confidence within the company.
Provides departmental expertise and perspectives to promote prospective business opportunities; provide Parexel colleagues with pertinent information to formalize a sound business strategy.

Knowledge and Experience:

Demonstrated understanding of clinical research, the drug development process, and applicable regulatory guidelines and regulations.
Broad experience in preparation of all types of clinical regulatory documentation. Experience in management of complex medical writing projects.
Knowledge of resource management and productivity metric management.
Advanced word processing skills, including MS Office (expertise in Word); software and systems knowledge or ability to learn and adapt to various IT systems: document management systems, collaborative authoring (e.g., SharePoint), and file conversion and databases (Excel).
Ability to travel.
Fluent in written and spoken English.

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences/Health Related Sciences or equivalent.

title: Creative Director (Brand & Social)
description:
Location: Singapore / or remote across APAC (+/- 2hrs from SG)
Engagement: 12-month fixed-term contract
Format: Hybrid or remote, depending on your location
Travel: Regional travel required

About the Project

We’re looking for a Creative Director, Brand & Social to become the social-first creative partner within an embedded APAC team for a leading global hospitality brand.

This is not a traditional campaign Creative Director role. You’ll turn cultural signals, audience insight and everyday travel behaviour into visual stories and social-first content that make people stop, feel something and recognise themselves in the brand. You’ll live close to social culture, spotting emerging behaviours, humour and creative references before they become marketing trends. The work should feel boldly human, visually beautiful, culturally sharp and genuinely relatable.

You’ll bring a clear creative point of view, while working collaboratively with the client and Integrated Strategy Director to shape ideas quickly and take them into market. Strong producer instincts matter: there will not always be a large production house behind you. Success means creating a living portfolio of brand content that feels native to social, culturally relevant and premium – with enough craft to build the brand and enough agility to keep it current.

About the Role

Social-First Creative Direction

Turn culture, audience insight and travel behaviour into social-first creative ideas.
Stay close to the most interesting social content, formats and behaviours shaping culture.
Find unexpected ways to place the brand within the story rather than making the brand the story.
Create work that feels premium and distinctive without becoming overly polished, gimmicky or trend-led.
Use humour and relatability with intelligence and restraint.

Storytelling & Content

Build stories around relatable human moments and the emotional side of travel.
Develop social films, short-form video, creator-led storytelling, visual comedy and culturally responsive content.
Create a living portfolio of always-on content, destination storytelling and regional moments
Tell stories visually, not just through messaging.
Ensure content feels native to the platform and market it appears in.

Creator, Influencer & Regional Creative

Shape creative ideas for creator and influencer content while allowing creators to retain their own voice.
Develop ideas that can flex across priority APAC markets without losing the central creative thought.
Bring fresh references from lifestyle, fashion, beauty, sport, entertainment and culture.
Help regional teams translate strong central ideas into locally relevant content.

Hands-on Creative & Production

Take ideas from concept through to market-ready execution.
Work directly with writers, designers, creators, producers and specialist makers.
Move quickly from idea to prototype to production.
Know when an idea needs full production and when it can be made more simply and intelligently.
Maintain strong craft standards while recognising that polish cannot substitute for relevance.
Use AI and emerging creative tools where they improve speed, quality or creative possibility.

About You

You bring 10+ years of experience in creative direction, social-first content strategy, brand storytelling, art direction, copywriting or integrated creative and senior stakeholder upselling experience.
You have a portfolio demonstrating strong ideas and beautifully executed work across multiple formats, most importantly, across social.
You understand the difference between producing content and building a story that creates brand memory and commercial impact.
You have strong experience across social, content, creators/influencers and static/video production.
You can take a strategic direction and translate it into emotionally relatable creative.
You understand how global brand platforms can be regionalised and localised without losing consistency.
You are confident presenting and selling ideas directly to senior clients.
You enjoy working closely with strategists and can move easily between strategy, creative development and production.
Experience within fashion, sport, luxury, beauty, lifestyle, entertainment or premium consumer brands would be particularly interesting.
Hospitality experience is not required. We actively welcome people who can bring a different creative perspective to the category.

Please Note

Due to the high volume of applications, we unfortunately can’t get back to everyone, and only successful applicants will be contacted. When you share your details with us, we consider this as consent for us to use your data during the application process. We may implement AI in various stages of the recruitment process, but human involvement will always remain as part of our hiring ethos. At the moment, MASH is not in a position to sponsor work visas, so you have to be eligible to legally work in the country where we’re hiring.

title: Head of Client Experience Marketing, Executive Director
description:
WHO WE ARE:

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

 Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

 We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

Job Purpose

The Head of Client Experience Marketing is responsible for the execution and experience delivery of OCBC’s signature client engagement programs across Global Consumer Financial Services (GCFS), spanning children and youth, mass banking, seniors, Premier Banking and Premier Private Client.

Segment owns each program, including its strategic rationale, target audience, proposition, business objectives and overall direction. Client Experience Marketing owns the How, translating that strategy into a distinctive, on-brand client experience through experience design, curation, production, partnerships and content amplification.

The role provides specialist expertise and execution leadership to deliver programs consistently, efficiently and to a high standard across CFS.

Key Responsibilities

Program Execution & Experience Delivery

Lead the end-to-end execution of signature client programs owned by CFS Segment teams.
Translate Segment and Sales objectives into compelling experiences tailored to the intended audience, from children and young adults to affluent, high-net-worth and intergenerational families.
Lead experience design and curation of the events, including program format, speakers, activities, partners, venues and the overall client journey.
Oversee production and delivery, including agencies, hospitality, guest experience, logistics and appropriate safeguarding requirements.
Establish common experience and delivery standards while ensuring programs are tailored to the needs of each client segment.
Develop playbooks, standards and best practices to enable markets including Malaysia, Indonesia and Hong Kong to deliver signature programs consistently, while local markets retain ownership of execution.
Manage the cross-segment program calendar and coordinate resources and production requirements across GCFS.

Content & Social Amplification

Lead the content and amplification approach for signature programs, extending their reach and impact beyond event attendees.
Develop content across pre-event, live and post-event stages to drive awareness, engagement and advocacy.
Work with internal teams and external agencies to create compelling, shareable and on-brand content and storytelling.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

Partner with Segment and Sales to define appropriate measures of program effectiveness and provide insights into client experience, participation, engagement and content performance.
Recommend improvements to program format, curation and experience based on performance, client feedback and execution learnings.
Support Segment in refreshing, scaling or evolving programs, bringing an experience and execution perspective.
Build and share best practices across the portfolio to continuously improve quality, efficiency and client impact.

Budget, Partnerships & Vendor Management

Manage program and experiential marketing budgets within agreed business priorities, ensuring effective allocation, tracking and cost discipline.
Build and manage a strong ecosystem of partners across luxury, hospitality, lifestyle, entertainment, content and experiential marketing.
Lead agency and vendor selection, negotiation and performance management, while maintaining a strong bench of preferred partners.

Stakeholder & Governance Management

Partner closely with Segment Heads, Sales, Relationship Managers, Marketing and other stakeholders to deliver programs against intended client and business objectives.
Bring creative and execution expertise to program planning, constructively challenging and recommending enhancements where appropriate.
Work with Brand, Compliance, Legal, Risk and other relevant functions to ensure programs meet applicable brand, regulatory, safeguarding, gifting and entertainment requirements.

Candidate Profile

18+ years of relevant experience in client engagement, experiential marketing, branded programs or premium events, with a strong track record in senior leadership roles.
Experience in private banking, premier or priority banking, luxury, hospitality, lifestyle or a comparable premium consumer environment would be advantageous.
Proven experience translating business and brand strategies into high-quality experiential programs spanning experience design, curation, production and content amplification.
Experience building and evolving recurring experiential platforms or signature programs, rather than solely delivering one-off events.
Ability to design experiences for different customer segments and life stages, including affluent, high-net-worth and intergenerational families.
Strong experience in content and social amplification, agency management and luxury, hospitality, lifestyle and experiential ecosystem.
Excellent senior stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed organization where program ownership sits with the business.
Polished and credible, with the presence to engage senior stakeholders and clients across all segments, including affluent, high-net-worth and next-generation clients.

What we offer:

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

title: Operations Manager

Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, service quality, and cost effectiveness across facilities and operations.

Diploma in Facilities Management, Building Services, Engineering, Hospitality Operations, or a related field.

Minimum 3–5 years of experience in facilities management, building operations, hospitality, or a related environment.

Strong vendor management and procurement coordination skills

Good organisational and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment

Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. AWS is one of Amazon’s fastest growing businesses, servicing millions of customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative startups like Netflix, Pinterest, Airbnb, and Instagram as well as some of the largest global enterprises like Shell International, Unilever, Hitachi, Sharp, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Samsung.

AWS is seeking an experienced Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) Customer Success Specialist for Amazon Connect. Connect was born out of Amazon’s own need for the best CCaaS solution that works at scale, while improving customer experience. Today, Connect is one of AWS's fastest growing services, leveraging native generative AI capabilities to improve customer and employee experiences. As a Connect Customer Success Specialist, you will act as a strategic advisor to customers, helping them innovate and optimize their contact center and customer experience through adoption of the Connect capabilities. You will lead cross-functional field teams in sales, solutions architecture, partner sales, product, and will work at the CxO level with customers to maximize the value of their Connect investment.

The ideal candidate will have enterprise sales and/or consulting experience in Contact Center as a Service or similar SaaS solutions in areas such as telecommunications, VoIP, and/or or CRM/ERP applications. You will be passionate about customer experience and advocacy and bring the voice of the customer into the product development process. You will enjoy solving complex problems; our customers will rely on your guidance to scale Connect across their complex global businesses, overcoming technical and organizational roadblocks on the way.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of strategic customer accounts, managing relationships and being a strategic advisor, driving enterprise-wide adoption of Connect.
- Deliver compelling presentations, product demos, sample solutions and programs, events, and discussions to enable customer success.
- Build customer skills and proficiency with Connect.
- Engage with C-level stakeholders to understand the value proposition of Connect and uncover new areas of business value.

title: B2B Growth Marketing Lead - APAC
description:
We're looking for a B2B Growth Marketing Lead to accelerate the growth of Wise Business across APAC.

This is a senior, hands-on role for an exceptional B2B growth marketer. You'll identify the markets, customer segments and opportunities with the greatest growth potential, then turn those choices into locally relevant campaigns that acquire valuable business customers.

You'll own the regional B2B growth strategy and bring it to life across both self-serve and sales-assisted acquisition. You'll move comfortably between market prioritisation, customer insight, campaign strategy, proposition development, detailed execution and performance optimisation.

You won't be starting with a large dedicated team or a finished regional playbook. You'll work through specialist teams across content, events, paid search and other channels, partner closely with Sales, and make the evidence-based case for additional regional investment when an opportunity requires it.

You'll be based in Singapore and work closely with our APAC Regional Marketing Lead and market teams. Singapore is your operating base, but you'll use evidence to determine where Wise Business has the strongest growth opportunities across APAC.

Your mission

Make APAC a major contributor to Wise Business growth by building a repeatable engine that identifies the region's best opportunities and turns them into locally relevant, commercially effective campaigns.

Help more micro and small businesses discover and choose Wise for their international money needs, while growing within our customer-value and payback requirements.

What you'll be doing

Own the B2B growth strategy for APAC, using customer, market, product and commercial evidence to prioritise the most attractive opportunities.

Develop and execute locally relevant, integrated campaigns that acquire valuable business customers across self-serve and sales-assisted journeys.

Translate customer problems into clear growth hypotheses, propositions, campaign briefs, channel plans and measurement approaches.

Work hands-on with specialists across content, events, paid search and other channels to take campaigns from idea to market without losing strategic quality or pace.

Partner closely with Product Marketing and Sales on the Go-To-Market Plan and our ideal customer profiles delivering crucial market feedback.

Connect campaign performance to new business profiles, customer quality, downstream value and payback - not just impressions, clicks or lead volume.

Build credible business cases for regional investment outside established marketing activity, defining the opportunity, expected return, resources required and how the activity will be tested.

Use performance and customer evidence to decide what to scale, improve, stop or redirect, creating a consistent pipeline of activity rather than isolated launches.

Build a strong operating rhythm with the APAC Regional Marketing Lead and regional stakeholders, combining local context with the wider Wise Business growth strategy.

Identify and propose issues or improvements to Wise Business from a regional product perspective to help strengthen the offering.

Qualifications

You have deep B2B growth marketing experience and can demonstrate meaningful commercial outcomes that you personally helped create.

You're an exceptional, hands-on growth marketer. You can set the strategy, write the brief, shape the proposition, work through funnel problems and stay close to execution and performance.

You have built growth across multiple markets and understand that APAC is not one homogeneous audience. You know how to adapt a strategy to different customer needs, channels and competitive conditions.

You can identify and prioritise valuable B2B audiences, uncover the customer problem that matters and turn that insight into a focused acquisition proposition.

You understand both self-serve and sales-assisted acquisition and know how Marketing and Sales can operate as one connected growth system.

You make commercially grounded decisions using acquisition cost, conversion, customer quality, payback and lifetime-value considerations.

You're comfortable defining success before launch, working with imperfect data and making clear scale, stop or change decisions from the evidence.

You can bring together specialist and cross-functional teams without formal authority, maintaining clarity, quality and momentum.

You're comfortable operating independently in an ambiguous environment and move quickly from uncertainty to a sensible test.

You're motivated by Wise's mission and the opportunity to help small businesses operate and grow internationally.

Nice to haves

Most of your career has been spent in B2B SaaS marketing.

Experience in B2B fintech, payments, financial services or a comparable technology platform with a multi-stage customer journey.

Direct experience growing a business in Singapore, Southeast Asia or other APAC markets.

Experience marketing to freelancers, micro-businesses, small businesses, agencies, consultancies or startups.

Experience with cross-border, multi-currency or international-expansion products.

Experience entering or scaling an early-stage regional market.

Familiarity with partner-, community- or event-led B2B acquisition alongside digital channels.

Who we are

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move money around the world. With the Wise account people and businesses can hold over 40 currencies, move money between countries and spend money abroad. Large companies and banks use Wise technology too; an entirely new cross-border payments network that will one day power money without borders for everyone, everywhere. However you use the platform, Wise is on a mission to make your life easier and save you money.

Co-founded by Kristo Käärmann and Taavet Hinrikus, Wise launched in 2011 under its original name TransferWise. It is one of the world’s fastest growing, profitable technology companies and is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker, WISE.

16 million people and businesses use Wise. In fiscal year 2023, Wise processed approximately £105 billion in cross-border transactions, saving customers around £1.5 billion.

What it’s really like to work here

At Wise, we do things a bit differently. There’s no corporate nonsense, and no old-fashioned hierarchy. Instead, we work in dozens of self-sufficient, autonomous teams. Think of them like start-ups within a start-up that learn from each other.

Each team picks the problems they want to solve. So there’s no micro-management. No hiding behind fancy job titles. And no one telling you what to do. You are your own boss. But you’ll get tons of guidance and plenty of support from talented, super-smart colleagues from all over Wise.

We’re going to be upfront — the way we work doesn’t suit everyone. But if freedom, autonomy, and life-affirming, head-scratching professional challenges rock your world, we could be a match made in heaven.

Clear communication and business partnering mindset.

Commercial awareness and ability to connect marketing activities to business priorities.

Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

Creativity, curiosity and ability to develop compelling market-facing narratives.

title: Specialist Solutions Architect, Radar (APAC)
description:
Specialist Solutions Architect, Radar (Fraud)
Who We Are
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About The Team

Specialist Solutions Architects (SSA) are domain experts aligned to specific Stripe solutions and customer buying centers. We have in-depth knowledge of specific solution offerings and a deep understanding of customer challenges. We align with specialist product sellers on deals, advise the broader pre-sales team on complex opportunities, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, serve as an advisor on go-to-market sales plays, and provide critical insights to our product and engineering teams.

Stripe Radar is Stripe's fully integrated fraud and risk management platform. The Radar team's mission is to evolve from a best-in-class payment fraud product into a unified risk intelligence platform that protects businesses from all forms of financial loss-from sophisticated payment fraud and account takeovers to first-party misuse and policy abuse. With Radar, businesses can confidently navigate the evolving fraud landscape, accept more good revenue, and focus on growth.
What You'll Do

You will collaborate closely with sales and pre-sales teams to drive pipeline and revenue targets, while also educating the product and engineering teams on market trends and strongly influencing the product roadmap. You will develop deep relationships with senior customer business leaders and grow Stripe's solution offerings with new and existing customers. As a subject matter expert, you will scale the broader organization by creating reusable assets and coaching others on complex, high-value opportunities. You will serve as the domain and product expert to our users and GTM team for Stripe Radar globally.
Responsibilities

Act as a subject matter expert on Stripe's Radar product suite to accelerate opportunities globally
Demonstrate a deep understanding of trends in the fraud and risk management ecosystem, including AI-powered detection, processor-agnostic architectures, and the shift from payment fraud to holistic business risk (policy abuse, account takeover, first-party misuse)
Develop expertise with the functional and architectural patterns for deploying advanced fraud systems, including the lifecycle of rule management, ML model tuning, and manual review optimization
Understand the ecosystem of risk and identity integrations (device fingerprinting, identity verification, bot mitigation, case management) Stripe must support for users to be successful
Define, share, and learn best practices and reusable assets with the broader GTM organization to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team
Create reference architectures to uplevel the team and refine reference solutions based on product enhancements and customer feedback
Partner closely with the Radar product sales team on Stripe's largest and most complex Radar opportunities, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships
Partner closely with the Radar product team to get early exposure to new products and features
Serve as a "Voice of the Customer" internally to drive product and feature request prioritization, providing actionable insights on the competitive landscape and emerging fraud vectors
Act as an escalation point to drive complex technical issues to resolution with Stripe's engineering team
Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation
Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows
Who You Are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum Requirements

7+ years of experience in a pre-sales, technical consulting, product, or risk strategy role focused on e-commerce fraud prevention, risk management, or trust and safety
Deep working knowledge of the fraud and risk ecosystem, including payment fraud (CNP), account takeover (ATO), first-party misuse (friendly fraud), and policy/content abuse
Demonstrated knowledge of risk management architectures, including the role of rules engines, machine learning models, and manual review queues in fraud decisioning
Strong knowledge of the signals and data used in fraud detection: device/IP data, behavioral biometrics, identity verification, and graph-based analysis
Strong knowledge of software engineering and architecture patterns, with the ability to understand how a wide variety of technologies and systems interact
Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, comfortable explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners
Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment
Strong proficiency in English and Mandarin and the position would require you to communicate with customers based in the Greater China region.
Preferred Qualifications

Experience integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications
Experience with processor-agnostic fraud solutions and multi-processor payment environments
Experience with risk management for platforms/marketplaces, subscription services, and digital goods
Familiarity with liability shift programs (chargeback guarantees) and value-based pricing models for risk products
Understanding of how to extend fraud protection across the payment lifecycle-payouts (Issuing), in-person (Terminal), or recurring (Billing)
Experience as a subject matter expert in a relevant industry, vertical, or product

You should be able to work with the team to meet deadlines and instill a culture of continuous work improvement.

As part of the position, you will work with the founders, Ivy League and Oxbridge graduates and other high-performing teammates.

The Role

We're looking for a Communications Executive to own the day-to-day relationship between QE and our families. You'll be the first person a parent speaks to when they enquire, and the person who keeps them informed once their child is with us. That means answering enquiries every day, matching students with the right tutors and mentors, and following up with students and parents regularly so nothing slips through.

You'll also help keep our marketing materials and partner relationships in good order. We are open to full-time or part-time candidates, so tell us the arrangement that works for you.

If you're a confident communicator in both English and Mandarin\*, stay calm and warm with demanding parents, and like being the person who makes sure things actually get done — we'd love to meet you.

This is a temporary role for 6 months to cover a colleague on leave for 4-6 months. If desired, conversion to full time permanent can be discussed closer from the 5-6th month onwards.

\*As a major group of customers are from China and are only able to converse in Mandarin.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Enquiries & Enrolment

* Respond to daily parent and student enquiries via phone, WhatsApp, WeChat, and email, ideally within the same working day.
* Explain our IGCSE, IB, and admissions programmes clearly and recommend the right fit for each student.
* Match students with suitable tutors and mentors, and arrange trial lessons and consultations.
* Track every enquiry through to enrolment and follow up with families who have not yet decided.

2. Student Follow-Up & Parent Relations

* Check in regularly with enrolled students and parents on progress, attendance, and any concerns.
* Collect lesson feedback from students and tutors, and deal with issues early before they become complaints.
* Arrange class schedules, replacement lessons, and changes with tutors and families.
* Keep parents informed ahead of key moments: exam periods, predicted grades, application deadlines, and results day.
* Follow up on renewals and next-stage programmes (e.g. IGCSE to IB, IB to university applications).

3. Business Operations

* Prepare and track invoices and payments.
* Draft and manage service agreements for clients and tutors.
* Keep client records, notes, and follow-up schedules up to date.
* Keep a simple monthly record of enquiries, enrolments, and renewals for the founders.

4. Marketing & Partnerships

* Keep brochures, website content, and newsletters accurate and up to date.
* Work with design and digital marketing agencies on campaigns and collateral.
* Support parent seminars and events, including Mandarin-language sessions with our China school partners.
* Maintain relationships with partner schools, education consultants, and collaborators.

We're Looking For Someone Who:

* Has experience in a client-facing role such as education, admissions, client services, or customer service. Fresh graduates with strong communication skills are welcome to apply.
* Has excellent verbal and written communication in English and Chinese. This is required as some Chinese customers can only communicate in Chinese. Japanese and Korean are a bonus as some customers only communicate in these languages.
* Is calm, warm, and professional with high-expectation parents, and comfortable handling difficult conversations.
* Is highly organised, follows up without being reminded, and keeps clear records.
* Can manage many families and a busy inbox at the same time without losing track of details.
* Is proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), Notion or Airtable, and marketing tools (Mailchimp, Canva).
* Is comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) and light automation to streamline workflows.

Bonus If You:

* Have experience in the education, tuition, or admissions sector.
* Know the IB, IGCSE, or university application process (UK, US, or Singapore).
* Are familiar with WeChat or Xiaohongshu.

Working Hours

Location: 545 Orchard Road, #14-06/9, Singapore 238882. In Person role.

Start Date: As soon as possible

Commitment: Full-time or part-time. Propose the days and hours that suit you in your application.

* Full-time: 5-day work week, Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, 4 days in office and 1 day remote
* Part-time: Days and hours by arrangement, with enough weekday cover to keep up with daily enquiries

Salary & Benefits

* Monthly Salary: $4,500 upwards for full-time, depending on experience; pro-rated for part-time
* Bonuses: Additional performance and team-based bonuses apply
* Benefits Include: $500 Specialist Stipend per annum (e.g. medical or mental health support), $100 Dental Stipend per annum, $500 Personal Development Stipend per annum (for courses, books, conferences, etc.)

Send your CV and a short paragraph on why you're interested in the role to hr@qeducation.sg with the subject line: Application – Communications Executive (Full Time / Part Time)

title: Ecommerce onboarding specialist
description:
uParcel is a Singapore-based e-commerce fulfilment and last-mile delivery 3PL. We combine in-house warehousing with our own fleet of same-day delivery drivers, giving online sellers on Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop one integrated partner from inbound stock to the customer’s doorstep.

As our E-commerce Onboarding Specialist, you are the first face clients see after they sign with us and the person who sets them up to succeed. You will guide each new client from kick-off to a smooth first live order, coach their teams on our system until they are confident using it independently, and remain their go-to contact for support questions. Your work directly shapes client satisfaction, retention and long-term growth.

1. Client onboarding

• Run kick-off calls with new clients to understand their products, order volumes, sales channels and fulfilment requirements.

• Own the onboarding plan for each client, with clear milestones, owners and timelines from sign-up to go-live.

• Collect and validate client information such as SKU masters, inbound stock details and channel integrations (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop).

• Configure client accounts in the system and coordinate with warehouse and delivery teams so inbound, storage, picking and delivery are ready before go-live.

• Test the end-to-end flow with each client, from order sync through to delivery, and resolve issues before the first live order.

2. System coaching and training

• Coach client teams on how to use the system, including order management, inventory visibility, inbound bookings, reporting and tracking.

• Deliver live walkthroughs and workshops, and tailor training to each client’s size and level of e-commerce experience.

• Create and maintain easy-to-follow guides, SOPs, FAQs and short how-to videos that clients can refer to on their own.

• Check in after go-live to confirm clients are using the system correctly and getting full value from it.

3. Customer support

• Be the first point of contact for client questions on system use, orders, inventory, inbound and delivery status.

• Respond promptly and clearly through email, chat and phone, and meet agreed response-time standards.

• Investigate issues with the warehouse, delivery and tech teams, and follow each case through to resolution.

• Log and categorise support cases and identify recurring questions, so they can be fixed at the root through training material or product improvements.

4. Customer success

• Build strong, trusted relationships with clients takeholders, from founders and sellers to operations staff.

• Monitor early client health indicators such as adoption, order accuracy and support volume, and act early when something looks off.

• Spot opportunities where additional uParcel services could help a client grow, and pass these to the sales team.

• Feed client insights and feature requests back to Operations and Product to improve the onboarding experience and the system.

Requirements

• Diploma or degree in Business, Supply Chain, Information Systems or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• 1 to 3 years of experience in client onboarding, customer success, account support or implementation, ideally in e-commerce, logistics or SaaS.

• Working knowledge of how online selling works on Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop, including order flow and seller operations.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain system features in simple, practical terms.

• Patient, empathetic and confident coaching clients with different levels of technical skill.

• Strong organisation and follow-through, able to manage several onboardings and support cases at once.

• Comfortable learning new software quickly and with Excel or Google Sheets for data checks and reporting.

• Fluent in English; additional languages such as Mandarin or Malay are a plus.

Goodto Have

• Experience with warehouse management systems, order management systems or delivery management platforms.

• Experience with helpdesk or CRM tools.

• Experience creating training content such as guides, SOPs or video tutorials.

• Familiarity with 3PL, fulfilment or last-mile delivery operations.

How Success Is Measured

•

Onboarding speed:

Time from contracts igning to first live order.

•

Go-live quality:

Share of clients who go live on schedule and without major issues.

•

Adoption:

Client confidence and independent system use after training.

•

Support responsiveness:

First-response and resolution times on support cases.

•

Customer satisfaction:

Client satisfaction scores and early-stage retention.

What You Will Gain

• Hands-on exposure to a fast-growing e-commerce fulfilment and last-mile delivery operation.

• Direct impact on client success, working closely with the Operations, warehouse and delivery teams.

• A clear path to grow into Customer Success Management or Account Management roles.

uParcel has planned, matched and optimised millions of same day deliveries using our proprietary logistics technology platform. Backed by data and driven by an innovative decentralised clustering model, we provide the most efficient deliveries to consumers through artificial intelligence assignment of delivery jobs to our network of delivery partners.

In contrast to the traditional hub-and-spoke last mile delivery model, our point-to-point clustering model enable same day deliveries efficiently by removing the need for extensive packaging, warehouse sorting and reducing distance travelled for greater productivity.

Our vision is to become the leading logistics platform that enables greater resource sharing and optimized routing to move the world more sustainably.

We are currently present in Singapore and Malaysia, with expansion plans to the rest of the region.

title: Relationship Manager

12

work closely with individual account managers to not only retain the current bank but also develop whitespace opportunities. As the customer advocate, RM must also provide actionable customer feedback that will enhance SPE’s products and service to earn client trust and business.

Considers both the big picture as well as the day-to-day when managing the account,
Develops and builds meaningful and lasting relationships with key and influential contacts,

description:

This is a hands-on product and platform leadership role, not a day-to-day campaign operations position. Build and scale DBS’s in-house performance marketing platform, controls, and operating Own the AdTech product strategy, roadmap, AdTech architecture, AdOps standards, audience activation, measurement, and transition of selected repeatable media activities from agencies to DBS.

Develop an enterprise performance marketing capability across Marketing, Data, and Technology, directly influencing platform strategy, operating standards, investment priorities, and measurable business outcomes across markets.

Hybrid operating model: Decide which repeatable activities should be operated internally, and which specialist services should remain with agencies. Establish service levels, decision rights, handoffs, scorecards and escalation paths.

12+ years across performance marketing, paid media, AdTech, AdOps or digital platform product leadership, including ownership of enterprise-scale transformation and delivery.
Deep working knowledge of Google Ads and Google Marketing Platform, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, TikTok Ads and relevant programmatic platforms.

Proven leadership across Marketing, Technology, Data Engineering, Analytics, external platform or agency partners.
Strong understanding of Data Science, Machine Learning and AI product development, including model lifecycle management, experimentation frameworks, predictive marketing, recommendation systems, generative AI and agentic workflows. Experience defining requirements for AI-enabled marketing capabilities and translating business objectives into scalable data and AI solutions.
Demonstrated experience designing or materially improving an in-house or hybrid performance-media operating model, including agency transition and capability transfer.

Strong command of automated bidding, signal quality, campaign architecture, attribution, incrementality, experimentation and closed-loop optimisation.
Knowledge of access governance, privacy, brand safety, media quality, change and incident controls, including governance for AI-generated advertising assets.
Product-led and outcome-oriented, with the ability to connect business goals, customer value, platform decisions and measurable results.
Technically credible without losing commercial judgement or becoming a pure engineering specialist.
