title: Procurement & Submittals Mgr., AWS, Power and Cooling
description:
DESCRIPTION

Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, and low-cost cloud platform that powers thousands of businesses in over 190 countries.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for a results-oriented individual to support AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)'s Power and Cooling (PAC) sourcing requirements for mission critical equipment and manufacturing for AWS data centers.
Our AWS Procurement team is looking for a results-oriented individual to assume responsibility in our Procurement Operations Center to drive standard process for RFQ (Request for Quote) for capital equipment, Change order management, budget approvals and supplier qualification related to our growing Infrastructure. Wiki - https://w.amazon.com/bin/view/ISCaP/ISCaP_Power_and_Cooling/PAC_Procurement_Ops

Key job responsibilities
As a Procurement and Submittals Manager, you will:
• Generate RFQ (Request for Quote) according to forecasted demand
• Manage the End-to-End Purchase Order (PO) change management process
• Manage the funding reallocation process to enable issuance of PO
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to drive change management
• Proactively communicate risks and issues to key stakeholders and recommend mitigations
• Develop Key Performance Indicators (KPI's) and track progress against goals
• Develop new processes for supplier qualification and onboarding
• Adapt to a fast paced, constantly changing environment
• Manage internal and external stakeholder communication, and provide status updates on projects and deliverables related to supplier technical drawing and specification approval activities.
• Track the supplier drawing and specification approval life cycle to secure design approvals in a timely manner.
• Manage supplier performance as it relates to supplier technical drawing and specification approvals.
• Monitor existing metrics as well as develop and propose new metrics to provide actionable data to critical business stakeholders as it relates to supplier drawing and specification approval process management.
• Support suppliers and internal stakeholders involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems including medium and low voltage power systems, Generators, UPS, HVAC and transformers.
• Required Travel: Approx. 5% of the time.

A day in the life
• Drive supply chain and procurement improvement initiatives to simplify, automate, and scale processes and reduce SLAs
• Collect data and present metrics to influence functional improvement plans
• Influence the change order management process, supplier qualification and process automation in ways that are mutually beneficial and sustainable for all cross-functional teams
• Having weekly sync with Vendors, Engineers, Construction managers, and many others
• Composing reports and analyzing metrics, and reporting out on Key Performance Indicators
• Pursuing initiatives to standardize and improve work processes
• Troubleshooting ad-hoc issues and doing all that's necessary to unblock the submittals approval process including fielding escalations

About the team
*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE), inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of procurement, supply chain, inventory management, contract management, lease administration or operations experience
- 5+ years of relevant strategic sourcing including vendor negotiations, global contract management, process improvement, operational and financial analysis experience
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related technical field
- Experience with data analysis tools such as Advanced Excel, SQL, Tableau, Python
- Experience in global supply chain management, managing cross-functional teams in a fast-paced consumer electronics product company

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 4+ years of program, project, product management, or leading a product implementation process experience
- Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field
- Experience in program, project, product management, or leading a product implementation process
- Experience in data centers, infrastructure service providers, or related technology companies

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Manager, Business Development & Cloud Partnerships Enablement APAC
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Manager, Business Development & Cloud Partnerships Enablement APAC

Overview:
Mastercard Services is building a cloud channel to distribute its ISV and SaaS products through the hyperscalers. AWS is the priority, followed by Microsoft Azure, Alibaba Cloud, and others across Asia Pacific. The priority products are in MarTech (Dynamic Yield personalisation) and cybersecurity (Recorded Future threat intelligence).

As Partner Enablement Manager, reporting to Director, Cloud Partnerships APAC, you will make sure hyperscaler sellers understand what Mastercard brings and why it matters to their customers. You will also make sure Mastercard's own sellers know how to work with the hyperscalers instead of around them. Everything you build should lead to registered opportunities, co-sell activity and revenue through cloud channels.

Role/Responsibilities:
• Hyperscaler Enablement: Getting Cloud Partners Ready to Sell Mastercard
o Design and deliver enablement programs for hyperscaler field teams (account managers, partner managers, solutions architects and marketplace specialists) on Mastercard Services products.
o Build role-based content that gives partner sellers a reason to bring Mastercard into their accounts: value propositions, customer use cases, discovery questions, joint sales plays and objection handling.
o Work with hyperscaler partner teams to plug Mastercard content into their own internal enablement channels and seller programs.
o Support marketplace readiness, including listing content, private offer mechanics and collateral that explains how customers can buy Mastercard solutions through the marketplace and their cloud commitments.
o Localise enablement for APAC markets (e.g. Japan, Australia, Singapore, Southeast Asia), adjusting for language, regulation and how local field teams operate.
o Assist in field marketing activities (e.g. staff a trade show booth, deliver sales presentations, etc.)

• Internal Enablement: Helping Mastercard's Field Win with Hyperscalers
o Equip Mastercard sellers, solution specialists and account teams to co-sell with the hyperscalers confidently.
o Build "How to Win with Cloud Partners" resources covering account mapping, opportunity registration, co-sell programs (e.g. AWS ACE and ISV Accelerate) and marketplace transactions.
o Develop and run the account mapping process between Mastercard and hyperscaler sales teams, from preparation and joint prioritisation through to follow-through. This includes working with Legal and Compliance on what can be shared and when.
o Run regular internal sessions on partner engagement models, deal registration, co-marketing funds and how marketplace deals affect revenue and attribution.
o Act as the go-between for the Mastercard field and the cloud partnerships team, making sure sellers know who to call and when.

• Programs, Content and Operations
o Own the cloud partner enablement library: co-sell decks, battlecards, sales plays, case studies and FAQs, kept current and easy to find.
o Work with Product Marketing and product teams to turn launches and messaging into partner-ready materials quickly.
o Coordinate partner-facing events, workshops and seller enablement days with hyperscaler field teams, including using MDF where it's available.
o Track and manage enablement deliverables across products and markets, and keep stakeholders informed without burying them in status reports.

• Measuring Impact
o Track enablement KPIs and connect them to commercial outcomes: sellers enabled, opportunities registered, co-sell engagement, marketplace transactions and partner-sourced pipeline.
o Use pipeline data, win/loss insights and field feedback to find gaps and improve programs.
o Feed partner and market insights back to Sales, Product and Marketing.
Experience:
• 3+ years in partner enablement, channel enablement or partner programs at a SaaS, cloud or technology company.
• A track record of building scalable partner and internal sales enablement programs tied to pipeline and revenue, not just content production.
• Experience building or supporting account mapping and joint pipeline processes between a vendor's field team and partner sales organisations.
• Strong programme and project management skills, with several workstreams across markets running at once.
• A data-driven approach: you measure what you do and drop what doesn't work.
• Highly Preferred: Hands-on experience with at least one major hyperscaler partner program (AWS strongly preferred), including co-sell mechanics, opportunity registration and marketplace listings.

About you:
• You're comfortable with ambiguity and like building things as you go.

title: Commercial and CX Graduate Associate - CHR 805
description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

09

S&P Global Energy Commercial and CX Graduate Program

Role: Associate, Commercial and CX Graduate

The Location: Singapore

The S&P Global Energy Commercial and CX Graduate Program journey begins with an intensive 5-week onboarding in our London office.

The 3-months thereafter will be part of the EMEA Customer Success Team, focusing on building a foundational knowledge of the commodity markets, developing essential business-related skills while learning about various S&P Global Energy data, research and analytical products. With Customer Success, you would be a primary contact for clients, providing solutions to their requests in a timely, professional and courteous manner and providing training on S&P Global Energy products through virtual and onsite visits.

The program will consist of rotations to customer success, sales, channel management and marketing functions. This will enable each graduate to gain a holistic perspective of the business. Combined with on-the-job learning, graduates must complete and pass certification milestones along with a rigorous evaluation process that will test and stretch their skills and capabilities. As you progress though the program, you will have the opportunity to support the sales team and ultimately generate additional revenue that helps to grow our business

You will be offered the opportunity to assist S&P Global Energy in achieving its mission of being one of the leading providers of the highest quality price assessments and analytical information to the world’s financial and commodity markets. Our real-time news, pricing and analytical services help markets operate with transparency and efficiency worldwide. As the principal provider of commodity price assessment and information to more than 10,000 customers in 150 countries and with 20 offices spanning five continents, you will form part of a truly globally diverse workforce. You will be part of a rapidly growing organization with an exceptional corporate culture. Our data, analytics, and research help our customers make informed, smarter business decisions and investments.

We are looking for high achievers from a diverse pool of current undergraduates or recent graduates who are passionate about the energy and commodities markets and want to develop their career in a dynamic, high performing and multicultural commercial team. You will be someone who can quickly work out how to make things happen through intellectual curiosity, creativity, exceptional learning agility and problem solving skills as well as effective networking and collaboration skills. Additionally, proficiency in Generative AI technologies and the ability to leverage these tools for innovative solutions will be highly valued.

What’s in it for you:

You will join as a member of a cohort of Commercial and CX Associates. Here, you will be introduced to world-class experts in various commodities including former chief economists, traders and risk managers. They will give presentations about how commodity markets work and provide insightful perspectives on global economic, political, technological and legal issues linked to their specializations. You will also be enrolled in an e-learning curriculum, providing foundational knowledge about the technical aspects of various commodities and market.

Within weeks you will have the opportunity to present topics to senior management and to get constructive feedback on your progress. Throughout the program you will learn how to use tools including S&P Global Energy-Platts, CERA and HORIZON products, Excel add-ins and CRM systems.
You will be challenged on a daily basis with a steep learning curve. You will get the opportunity to work with a broad range of clients including governments, investment banks, commodity trading houses, major oil and gas companies, hedge funds and industry and get to be part of a large energetic and international team with fantastic opportunities for growth.

Career paths after the 18-month initial phase of the program include:

Regional Sales
Specialist Sales
Customer Success

Responsibilities:

Help clients understand how to navigate and extract useful data from the S&P Global Energy product range.
Liaise with the content, commercial and technical teams to address any client queries and ensure our data is maintained to the highest standards.
Proactively reaching out to clients for face-to-face/virtual training (this will apply towards the later stages of development once fully fluent and certified on the product range).
Conduct research about important issues at the forefront of energy and commodity markets and present this to colleagues.
Support sales teams with research and proposals.
Build account overviews and plans to support strategic sales teams.
Design data-driven models and templates for clients.
Create marketing materials for commercial culture initiatives and future graduate cohorts.
Getting involved in special project initiatives where determined necessary by management.

Requirements:

Ability to join a class of new hires in late February 2027
BSc or BA degree, or equivalent.
All applicants must have the right to work in Singapore
Fluent command of English is a prerequisite. Proficiency in additional ASEAN (Mandarin/Vietnamese/Thai) languages is highly desirable.
Strong presentation and communication skills. You must have good telephone manners and be comfortable presenting to large groups both in person and remotely.
Strong understanding and command of AI Capabilities.
Familiarity with or strong interest in learning about financial and commodity markets.
Good PC skills including the Microsoft Office product range.
Well versed in Excel
Ability to effectively multi-task and work independently.
Willingness to learn and take on a wide variety of tasks.

About S&P Global Energy
At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.

S&P Global Energy is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global enables businesses, governments, and individuals with trusted data, expertise, and technology to make decisions with conviction. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. title: TikTok Ads Specialist
description:
About Us

We provide travel eSIM solutions that help international travellers stay connected abroad. Customers can browse and purchase mobile data plans through our website and app. We are looking for an experienced TikTok advertising specialist to grow customer acquisition and sales across international markets.

About the Role

You will manage TikTok paid advertising, with a particular focus on using short-form video to attract relevant audiences, communicate product value and convert interest into purchases.

This role combines hands-on media buying, strong creative judgement and rigorous data analysis. You should be able to explain why a video attracts attention, whether that attention leads to sales, and how to improve both creative performance and acquisition efficiency through continuous testing.

Appointment at Specialist or Senior Specialist level will depend on your experience, capabilities and track record.

Key Responsibilities

Plan, launch and optimise TikTok Ads campaigns to drive customer acquisition and purchases through our website and app.

Develop a structured short-form video testing programme across travel scenarios, customer pain points, product demonstrations, offers and creator styles.

Prepare actionable creative briefs covering opening hooks, scripts, pacing, product benefits and calls to action.

Work with creative teams and content creators to produce and iterate video ads and UGC suited to TikTok.

Analyse video viewing and engagement metrics alongside click-through rates, purchase conversion, acquisition costs and returns.

Identify where performance breaks down between attracting attention, generating clicks and converting visitors into paying customers.

Maintain a consistent pipeline of new creative concepts and variations, using test results to guide subsequent production.

Monitor creative fatigue and scale successful ads while controlling acquisition costs and returns.

Manage campaign structures, targeting, bidding and budget allocation across international markets.

Work with product and technical teams to validate conversion tracking and website or app attribution.

Compare platform-reported results with actual sales and acquisition costs, and present clear findings and recommended actions.

Requirements

At least 3 years of hands-on TikTok Ads experience, including independently managing campaigns and budgets. Candidates with 5 or more years of relevant paid advertising experience and substantial TikTok Ads experience are encouraged to apply.

Strong ability to evaluate short-form video creatives and turn performance data into specific recommendations for hooks, scripts, pacing, product messaging and calls to action.

Strong data analysis and logical reasoning skills, with the ability to develop hypotheses, run structured tests and explain the results.

Proven success in paid campaigns that generated purchases or paying customers, supported by measurable acquisition costs and returns.

Experience testing multiple creative concepts and scaling successful campaigns while monitoring performance as budgets increase.

Strong working knowledge of TikTok Ads Manager, campaign optimisation and conversion tracking.

Ability to assess data quality, understand attribution limitations and distinguish meaningful improvements from short-term fluctuations.

Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and familiarity with relevant website or app analytics tools.

Clear written and spoken English, strong attention to detail and the ability to collaborate effectively with creative and technical teams.

Preferred Experience

International or multi-market TikTok advertising campaigns.

eSIM, telecommunications, travel technology, e-commerce or consumer apps.

Website purchase campaigns, app acquisition and app attribution tools.

UGC advertising, creator-led paid campaigns or short-form video production.

Relevant industry experience is an advantage. Experience with Google Ads or Meta Ads is welcome but is not required.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and one or two TikTok paid advertising campaigns you have personally managed. Include the objective, market, approximate budget, timeframe, your responsibilities, creative testing approach, optimisation decisions and measurable results.

ISerious Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based mobile virtual network operator (MVNO) focused on travel connectivity. Through our website and mobile app, we offer eSIM data plans that help leisure and business travellers stay connected across international destinations.

title: Account Manager - Stakeholder Advisory and Engagement Agency
description:
Overview
This is a fantastic opportunity to join one of our client communications teams and deliver high calibre, multi-channel communications solutions for our blue-chip client base. This can include annual reports and reviews, sustainability reports, investor relations and employee communications, online reporting centres and wider website content and communications initiatives.
Attracting and retaining the right people for our team is an absolute priority for us and we take their career development seriously from day one. We take every aspect of the work we deliver for clients seriously and we work to maintain the highest possible standards in everything we do for them and for the company. But as well as being passionate about our work, we are supportive, collaborative and positive, always looking to make what we do enjoyable and rewarding.

Why this job?
You will be instrumental in helping clients shape their communications strategies to positively influence and impact their key stakeholder audiences.
It’s a genuine opportunity to work in a fast-moving environment across a range of channels and audiences.
You will be involved in a diverse client base, providing an opportunity to learn across a range of sectors.
It’s a fantastic chance to grow and expand your responsibilities as part of a career development plan.

Overview of the role
Our client communication teams are looking for a highly motivated and ambitious individual, who is looking to deliver high calibre, multi-channel communications solutions for our blue-chip client base, including annual reports and reviews, sustainability reports, investor relations and employee communications, online reporting centres, website maintenance and social media campaigns.
In the Account Management teams, you will engage with senior stakeholders and provide you with the opportunity to develop an intimate understanding of your client’s strategy and business model as well as a deep knowledge of best practice and market trends in financial and non-financial reporting. In time you will have the opportunities and platform to develop your career within this growing and highly ambitious organisation.
The successful candidate must be comfortable communicating with clients and internal teams, have a keen eye for detail, strong communication and interpersonal skills, creative flair and want to participate in building one of the largest and most successful professional service companies of its kind.

Responsibilities:
Account management
Successfully manage the delivery of assigned mixed-media projects, taking responsibility for all deliverables
Develop an intrinsic understanding of your clients’ business model and strategy
Effectively manage each project stage
Accurately prepare all project documentation
Demonstrate real strength in identifying and managing account and project problems independently and provide effective solutions
Client relationship management
Proactively build strong client relationships with your day-to-day client contacts
Always deliver exemplary client services helping to ensure we maintain the current high levels of client satisfaction and continually seek ways to exceed our clients’ expectations
Commercial responsibility
Work closely with your team leader to develop your commercial awareness of Black Sun’s job costing and fee structures
Effectively manage project budgets by implementing all Black Sun’s quality assurance and financial processes
Where necessary, work with your team leader to develop strategies for auditing and managing overrun costs from clients
New business and client development
Work closely with team leaders to successfully identify new business opportunities from your existing clients, writing client proposals and effectively presenting concepts and delivery presentations
Support the new business process by assisting with the delivery of new business proposals
Research and strategic development
Support internal teams with Black Sun’s research into best practice corporate communications by conducting research
Continually drive your understanding of our clients’ businesses, the industries they operate in, and trends in best practice corporate communications

Qualifications, experience & skills:
Minimum 2.5 years agency or client-side experience, ideally within corporate marketing and communications.
Excellent writing, editing, proof reading skills are essential.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills are essential.
Exceptional attention to detail; and
Be fully conversant with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Your personal qualities:
Strong interpersonal and communications skills necessary to build trust and respect both externally and internally.
High-quality service ethic and committed to customer service excellence.
Ability to manage many urgent and often conflicting priorities.
Strong ‘can do’ attitude with an innate ambition to take initiative and work by yourself as well as in a team.
Flexibility and team focussed approach with a ‘roll up your sleeves’ attitude to getting the job done; and
A great sense of humour and fun!

Reporting Relationships
Reporting to: Account Director
Work closely with: Creative and Production teams, as well as Digital, Research & Strategy and Finance teams.

Interview process
Phone screening with office manager
1st Interview (teams) with hiring manager
2nd interview (f2f) with hiring director and hiring manager, presentation of task

What we offer
In addition to a competitive salary based on skills and experience, as an employee at Black Sun, you will have access to a range of great benefits and perks, including:
Extraordinary Workplace: : Our office is in a 1920s heritage building right in the heart of Chinatown, surrounded by Michelin-rated eats and city buzz. We’ve even got a rooftop garden home to over 70 species of bees and butterflies. It’s certainly not your average workspace!
Hybrid Working : We ask for three days a week in the office to keep our collaborative energy strong, but you can also work fully remotely for up to two 2-week periods a year (within a 2-hour time difference)
In addition to 22 days’ annual leave and bank holidays, we offer 14 fully paid medical leave and childcare leave, in accordance with MOM’s regulations.
Designated medical service via MinMed and have access to our wellbeing support via our international EAP Service ComPsych Guidance Resources, offering confidential emotional, legal, financial, and life support. This is available 24/7 to you and your immediate family with a digital App to easily access all these resources from your own device.
Bonus Scheme : we offer a discretionary annual bonus to recognise great work and team success.
Training & Development We’re big believers in potential. Our new digital learning platform, Viva Learning makes it easier than ever to build skills, explore content, and take ownership of your development. With access to thousands of videos, articles, and Microsoft 365 courses you can learn at your own pace, when and where it suits you.
Have Your Say: We’re a place where ideas are welcome and voices are heard. Our open-door culture means managers are approachable, and your input can genuinely shape how we work and grow.
Team Socials : We take our celebrations seriously. From social activities, festivity luncheons to company get-togethers, there’s always something to look forward to.

About Us :
Black Sun Global
Black Sun Global is a stakeholder advisory and engagement agency that’s been driving transformation and positive change for ambitious brands for more than 20 years. With deep expertise in disclosure and reporting, ESG, sustainability, and digital engagement, we reshape how organisations connect with customers, investors, employees, and the wider world.
We are trusted partners to some of the most influential global organisations, sparking innovation and sustainable performance through our strategic insights, partnerships, and proprietary technologies.
As founders of the Positive Change Group, we are on a mission to create a new kind of stakeholder relations partner. Our world-class specialists work closely with executive leadership teams to protect reputations, inspire trust, and promote responsible business practices - building resilience and long-term value in a rapidly changing world.
The Positive Change Group

title: Snr Specialist Analytics SA – ASEAN, WWSO Data APJC
description:
DESCRIPTION

In this role, as a Specialist Solutions Architect, you will be the analytics expert for customers across Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, the Philippines, and Vietnam. You will help them build and operate analytics, search, and streaming workloads, and partner with them to design **agent-ready data platforms**: open, governed foundations that let AI agents search, process, and analyse data to support decision-making. The work spans the full range of modernisation, from moving on-premises Hadoop and legacy data warehouses to an open lakehouse on Apache Iceberg and S3 Tables, through to semantic search, natural language data exploration, and RAG-based insight generation.

ASEAN is one of the fastest-growing data markets in the world, and many customers are still deciding where their data platform will live. You will work with banks, telcos, retailers, public sector agencies, and digital natives as they make that decision, often in head-to-head evaluations against Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Fabric, and GCP BigQuery. Grounded in deep analytics expertise, you will bring a broad perspective that spans databases, ML, and security, and you will advise on governance and access control as much as on performance and cost.

You will build reference architectures, demos, and workshops with your own hands and scale them across six countries through account teams and partners. Partners deliver much of the analytics work in ASEAN, so enabling them to land complex platforms such as SageMaker Unified Studio is a core part of the role. You will also carry the voice of ASEAN customers back to the AWS analytics, search, streaming, and generative AI service teams to shape their roadmaps.

Data is the context layer that turns generic AI into personalised, differentiated customer experiences. Every AI conversation is a data conversation, and this role sits at the centre of it for ASEAN. If you see that shift as an opportunity and want to co-create new value with customers across the region, come join us and build the future together!

Key job responsibilities
- Provide deep technical expertise in analytics, search, streaming, and governance (Redshift, Athena, EMR, Glue, Kinesis, MSK, OpenSearch, Lake Formation, DataZone, SageMaker Unified Studio, S3 Tables, QuickSight) across ASEAN's enterprise, public sector, and digital-native customers

- Design agent-ready data platforms on open lakehouse, Iceberg, zero-ETL, RAG, and semantic search

- Lead architecture reviews, immersion days, proofs of concept, and migrations (MAP) off Hadoop, legacy warehouses, and third-party platforms

- Win competitive evaluations against Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Fabric, and GCP BigQuery

- Enable partners and build repeatable assets that scale across six countries

- Carry customer feedback and competitive signals back to service teams to shape the roadmap

A day in the life
Your customers span Financial Services, Telecommunications, Retail, Public Sector, and Digital-Native companies. One morning you run an open data platform workshop in Singapore; by lunch you are designing governed data access for a Manila bank's first production agents. In the afternoon you build a RAG proof of concept with OpenSearch and Bedrock for a Jakarta retailer, then help a partner unblock a SageMaker Unified Studio rollout, before sending field feedback to the Redshift service team. You travel regularly across a region where the decisions customers make today will set their data platform for the next decade.

About the team
The WWSO Data & AI team helps customers adopt our newest and most advantageous technologies. This role sits on the APJC Data team alongside Analytics, Database, and Storage Specialist SAs and GTM Specialists across five geos. In ASEAN, you work closely with the Analytics GTM Specialist, the Database and Storage Specialist SAs, the partner team, and account teams in each country to deliver holistic data outcomes. If you thrive on going deep on technology, love building for customers, and measure success by the architectures you've shaped, this is the role for you.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 7+ years of data warehouse technical architectures, data modeling, infrastructure components, ETL/ ELT and reporting/analytic tools and environments, data structures and hands-on SQL coding experience
- Experience defining data center system-level architecture, documenting performance and equipment requirements, creating and communicating conceptual designs, and creating and maintaining project documentation
- Experience working with technical and business stakeholders from global cross-functional teams
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience
- Deep hands-on experience with analytics technologies, including data warehousing (e.g. Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, Teradata), data lakes, ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, Flink), search (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch), and data governance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience and demonstrated industry leadership in the fields of database or data warehousing, data sciences and big data processing
- AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Bachelor's degree
- Experience designing agent-ready data platforms (open lakehouse, Iceberg, zero-ETL, RAG, semantic search)
- Experience across multiple Southeast Asian markets and building reusable assets at scale
- Fluency in English required; a Southeast Asian language (e.g. Bahasa Indonesia, Thai, Vietnamese) is a plus

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Math Curriculum Specialist & Teacher (Primary) [Remote]
description:
Remote role. Game-based Math lessons. You design the curriculum and teach it yourself.

To apply, please submit an application here: https://airtable.com/appytuR6ewIdKWEFA/pagJkcixPTRFBXrSE/form

Job Highlights

- Fully remote. Every class is taught live online, so you work from home.

- Game-based lessons. We use games, including our own Roblox games, to help children enjoy Math and remember it.

- You design and you teach. You write the P1 to P6 Math lessons, then teach them and see how they land.

- 12 to 16 hours of classes a week, with the rest of your week set aside for curriculum work.

- Modern tools. We use AI to speed up drafting and checking materials, and we will show you how.

About the Role

Ottodot helps children learn Math and Science through live online classes and game-based learning. Our Primary programme is aligned to the Singapore MOE syllabus.

We are hiring a Math Curriculum Specialist & Teacher (Primary) to design our P1 to P6 Math lessons and teach them. The lessons you write are the lessons you teach, so you see every week what works and what needs fixing.

Teaching Responsibilities

- Teach 12 to 16 hours a week of live online Math classes, in groups of up to 4 students.

- Use student work, test results, and feedback to decide what to reteach and who needs extra help.

- Cover a class when another teacher is unavailable. Relief counts toward your monthly hours.

Curriculum Responsibilities

- Write P1 to P6 Math materials: slides, lesson plans, questions, homework, and post-tests.

- Review student results and decide where to focus next.

- Match every lesson to the MOE syllabus and PSLE standards, pitched at the right level.

- Keep the content correct, with full step-by-step working, and fix errors quickly when they are found.

- Work with our game team so the games in class reinforce what each lesson teaches.

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Mathematics, Science, Engineering, or Education is a plus.

- At least 2 years of experience teaching primary students (school, tuition, or online) or writing primary Math lessons and assessments.

- Well-versed in the Singapore MOE primary Math syllabus and PSLE requirements, including the model method and common PSLE question types.

- Comfortable using AI tools, or willing to learn.

- You remember or understand what it feels like to be a child who is stuck.

- Strong spoken and written English.

Work Schedule

- Employment: full-time, 3-month probation.

- Location: Remote. You need a quiet space and a stable internet connection.

- Core hours: Monday to Friday, 10am to 6pm (GMT+8).

- Curriculum work: at least 3 days a week, agreed together, within core hours.

- Teaching: 12 to 16 hours a week, counted monthly so busy and quiet weeks balance out.

- Class times: weekdays 4pm to 8:30pm and weekend daytime. You pick your slots from our schedule each term.

About Ottodot

Ottodot is a Singapore-based online learning company trusted by over 4,300 parents. We run weekly live online Math and Science classes for P1 to P6, in groups of up to 4 students, aligned to the Singapore MOE syllabus and PSLE question types. Our lessons are built around 200+ concept-aligned games on Roblox, and parents rate us 4.6 out of 5. Our students have reported gains of 20 marks or more, including 2 AL bands at PSLE.

Why Ottodot

- You see your work land. You write a lesson, teach it, and know by the end of the week whether it worked.

- Fun that still builds mastery. We put games at the centre and make sure homework and feedback point the same way.

- Real ownership. You are responsible for the quality and results of our Math curriculum, not just a stack of worksheets.

- Work from home, with clear core hours and a class schedule you can plan around.

To apply, please submit an application here: https://airtable.com/appytuR6ewIdKWEFA/pagJkcixPTRFBXrSE/form

Work Location: Remote

Pay: $3,800.00 - $5,000.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

title: Growth & Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
Growth & Performance Marketing Specialist

Company: Oliz Pte. Ltd.

Location: Singapore

Employment Type: Full-time

About Us

Oliz Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based company building innovative consumer brands across health, wellness, and everyday living. Our portfolio includes Solene Fertility.

We're looking for a hands-on, entrepreneurial marketer to help build and scale brands from

0 to 1

, driving growth across Singapore and international markets.

Key Responsibilities

1.

0-to-1 Growth:

Develop and execute go-to-market strategies, test new acquisition channels, and scale successful campaigns across different markets.

2.

Paid Advertising:

Plan, manage, and optimise campaigns across Meta (Facebook & Instagram), Google Ads, and TikTok Ads, focusing on CAC, ROAS, and conversions.

3.

KOL & Influencer Marketing:

Identify and manage KOLs, influencers, UGC creators, and affiliate partnerships, from outreach and negotiation to campaign execution.

4.

Email Marketing:

Build and optimise email campaigns, automated flows, customer segmentation, and retention strategies using Klaviyo or similar tools.

5.

Creative Strategy:

Research competitors, develop advertising hooks and concepts, coordinate content production, and continuously test new creatives.

6.

E-commerce Optimisation:

Improve Shopify landing pages, product pages, and conversion funnels to drive sales.

7.

Analytics & Reporting:

Monitor campaign performance, analyse key metrics, and recommend improvements based on data.

Requirements

- 2–4 years of experience in growth marketing, performance marketing, or e-commerce.

- Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads, plus Google Ads or TikTok Ads.

- Experience in KOL/influencer marketing and campaign management.

- Familiarity with Shopify, email marketing, and marketing analytics.

- Good understanding of creative testing, customer acquisition, and conversion optimisation.

- Resourceful, analytical, self-driven, and comfortable working in a startup environment.

- Strong written and spoken English.

Good to Have

- Ability to independently create UGC-style content, including shooting and editing short-form videos.

- Experience growing DTC brands from 0 to 1.

- Familiarity with Klaviyo, GA4, CapCut, Figma, and Canva.

- Experience in health, wellness, beauty, or consumer products.

- Experience running campaigns across international markets.

- Mandarin proficiency for collaboration with Chinese-speaking teams.

What We Offer

- Opportunity to build and scale consumer brands from the ground up.

- Hands-on ownership of growth initiatives across multiple channels.

- Exposure to Singapore and international markets.

- Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with opportunities for career growth.

How to Apply

Send us your CV and, if available, examples of campaigns you've managed or content you've created. We'd love to hear about your experience and results.

Salary:

S$4,500–S$8,000 per month

Oliz Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based company building a house of innovative consumer brands across health, wellness, and everyday living.

We believe great brands start with a deep understanding of people's needs. By combining consumer insights, thoughtful product design, and science-led innovation, we develop products and experiences that solve real problems and make everyday life better.

Our portfolio includes Solene Fertility, a reproductive health brand dedicated to making fertility solutions more accessible, empowering individuals and couples with practical tools and greater confidence on their fertility journey.

We bring together product development, technology, branding, and digital commerce to build meaningful consumer brands for global markets.

Our vision is simple: to create brands that people trust, products that make a difference, and better solutions for everyday life.

title: Market Specialist, Japan
description:
Meta is seeking a Market Specialist with Japanese language expertise to support risk and response management operations across Japanese-language content and markets. In this role, you will help identify, assess, and respond to integrity risks, policy violations, and emerging threats affecting Japanese-speaking communities on Meta's platforms. You will apply your understanding of Japanese cultural context, current events, and online behavior patterns to support accurate risk assessments and timely escalations, contributing to the safety and integrity of Meta's products for users across the region.

Market Specialist, Japan Responsibilities:

Review and assess Japanese-language content and accounts to identify potential policy violations, integrity risks, and coordinated inauthentic behavior
Apply knowledge of Japanese cultural context, political landscape, and online trends to support accurate risk classification and prioritization
Execute established response workflows to address identified risks in a timely and consistent manner
Document findings clearly and accurately to support cross-functional review and escalation processes
Collaborate with policy, trust and safety, and operations teams to surface patterns and emerging risks in the Japanese-language information environment
Provide input on Japan-market-specific nuances to help refine risk detection criteria and response guidelines
Support quality assurance processes by reviewing decisions for consistency and alignment with established policy frameworks
Communicate findings and risk signals to relevant stakeholders in a clear and structured manner
Adapt to evolving risk landscapes and updated response procedures as platform policies and threat environments change

Minimum Qualifications:

Professional working proficiency in Japanese is required to review, interpret, and assess Japanese-language content and communications as a core function of this role
Experience in trust and safety, content moderation, risk operations, compliance, or a related field involving structured decision-making against defined criteria
Experience applying established procedures and guidelines to evaluate cases and determine appropriate actions
Experience documenting work clearly and communicating findings to cross-functional partners

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience working in a scaled operations or risk management environment with defined workflows and quality standards
Exposure to policy enforcement, legal compliance, or regulatory risk frameworks in a technology or platform context
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
Familiarity with the Japanese political, media, and social media landscape and how it relates to online integrity risks
Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

title: Account Director / Senior Account Director
description:
Company Description:

Publicis Groupe is not just a company you work for; it’s a platform for you to take your talent to the world.

If you want to help change the world, ideas alone are not enough. Real impact can only come from having meaningful access to a world of knowledge, people and resources. At Publicis Groupe, you are connected to our global network, intelligence, tools, clients, brands and 80,000 brilliant minds with expertise in data, technology, media, strategy, creativity and business transformation, all literally at your fingertips.

Go ahead, the world is waiting.

Publicis Groupe is the largest communications group in the world. Founded in Paris in 1926, we are present in more than 100 countries as leaders in marketing, communication, and digital business transformation. Two of its biggest solution hubs in Singapore - Publicis Communications and Publicis Media & Digital.

Publicis Communications, the creative communications hub of the Publicis Groupe, is a collective of the most passionate, purposeful, and progressive creative agencies in Singapore. They are Publicis Worldwide, Leo Burnett, Saatchi & Saatchi, Prodigious, and MSL.

Publicis Media & Digital, which is comprised of global media agency brands Starcom, Zenith, Spark Foundry, and Performics, is powered by digital-first, data-driven global practices that together, help our clients navigate the modern media landscape.

Our two other solution hubs, Publicis Sapient and Publicis Commerce, empower businesses to embrace digital transformation and equip them with a total commerce experience.

Overview:

We are looking for an experienced Account Director - Senior Account Director who can act as a senior communications specialist and strategic client lead across a portfolio of high-profile corporate and consumer brands. The role will lead accounts such as Science Centre Singapore, TWG Tea and PropertyGuru, with responsibility for communications strategy, senior client counsel, earned media and reputation, integrated campaign development, team leadership and account growth.

The successful candidate must bring deep PR and communications expertise and be able to independently shape narratives, distil and unpack briefs, identify reputational and earned opportunities, counsel senior clients and spokespeople, and lead teams to deliver communications programmes that create meaningful public and media impact. At Senior Account Director level, the role will also be expected to operate as part of the agency’s senior leadership bench, with broader responsibility for people development, business growth and the quality of the agency’s communications thinking.

Responsibilities:

Strategic client counsel & account leadership

Lead senior client relationships and act as a trusted point of counsel on communications strategy, reputation, positioning and campaign direction.
Critically analyse briefs and business challenges, identify the real communications problem to solve, and recommend the right approach rather than simply executing a prescribed scope.
Lead strategic planning across assigned accounts, ensuring programmes have clear objectives, audiences, narratives, KPIs and a strong earned rationale.
Anticipate client needs, issues and opportunities, and proactively course-correct accounts where required.
Orchestrate account teams end-to-end, setting priorities, maintaining momentum and ensuring clients receive consistently senior, high-quality counsel.
PR strategy, earned media & reputation
Own the earned communications strategy across accounts, including corporate profiling, consumer storytelling, thought leadership, media engagement and issues preparedness.
Bring strong news judgement and a sophisticated understanding of the Singapore media environment, including how different newsrooms, verticals and stakeholders assess relevance and credibility.
Develop strong media narratives and story architecture that connect client business priorities with wider cultural, consumer, industry or societal conversations.
Build and leverage senior relationships with editors, journalists, creators, influencers and other relevant opinion-formers and stakeholders.
Provide senior counsel on reactive communications, sensitive issues and reputational considerations, including when to engage, how to position and when not to pursue publicity.
Lead senior spokesperson preparation for interviews, announcements and high-stakes external engagements.

Content, messaging & integrated communications

Counsel teams and clients on communications strategy, messaging and narrative development across corporate and consumer audiences.
Guide the development of high-quality communications materials including strategic plans, key messages, press materials, speeches, briefing documents, thought-leadership content and executive communications.
Provide senior editorial judgement and ensure work is persuasive, audience-led and strategically sharp, not simply factually correct.
Partner with Creative, Social, Influence and other specialist teams to develop integrated ideas with a strong communications backbone and clear potential to earn attention.
Ensure channel choices support the communications objective, bringing together earned, owned, social, creator and paid activity where appropriate rather than defaulting to a single discipline.

Stakeholder, campaign & event leadership

Lead the agency approach to stakeholder engagement across media, influencers, partners, industry bodies, communities and other relevant audiences.
Oversee major launches, media programmes, experiential activations, briefings and events, ensuring the communications story is clear and the experience delivers against strategic objectives.
Represent clients and the agency confidently in senior stakeholder engagements, meetings, interviews and external forums.
Think ahead on potential risks, sensitivities and opportunities, and ensure teams are prepared to troubleshoot effectively.

Team leadership & capability building

Lead, coach and develop Account Managers, Executives and junior team members through both formal and day-to-day guidance.
Set the strategic and quality bar for teams, helping them move beyond task delivery into stronger judgement, counsel and communications thinking.
Resource accounts effectively, bringing in the right specialists and senior support when needed while maintaining commercial discipline.
Create confident, motivated teams and provide clear direction during complex or high-pressure periods.
Contribute to the agency’s communications capability through training, mentoring, best-practice development and active championing of agency culture and standards.
Commercial leadership, account growth & new business
Own the commercial health of assigned accounts, including scope, resourcing, budget management, profitability and contract considerations.
Identify and convert opportunities to deepen existing client relationships and grow accounts organically through relevant communications counsel and new initiatives.
Lead or play a senior role in new business development, from strategic response and proposition development through pitch narrative and presentation.
Build strong chemistry with prospective clients and bring a clear senior point of view that demonstrates the agency’s communications expertise.
At Senior Account Director level, contribute to broader agency growth priorities, capability development and senior management discussions.
Qualifications:
Approximately 10+ years of relevant PR and communications experience, ideally within an agency environment, with a proven track record leading significant client relationships and teams.
Essential: deep, hands-on PR and earned communications expertise. Candidates must have personally led communications strategy, media narratives, senior media engagement and client counsel — not only managed integrated campaign delivery.
Strong strategic judgement and the ability to connect business objectives, audience insight, reputation and earned opportunity into a clear communications recommendation.
Established understanding of the Singapore media and stakeholder landscape, with credible senior media relationships and the confidence to advise clients on what will and will not earn attention.
Excellent writing, messaging and editorial judgement, with the ability to simplify complex information and sharpen the work of others.
Confidence counselling senior clients and spokespeople, including challenging assumptions constructively and navigating sensitive or ambiguous communications situations.
Proven ability to lead multiple accounts and teams, manage resourcing and commercial considerations, and maintain quality across a demanding portfolio.
Experience across corporate and consumer communications is strongly preferred. Exposure to public-sector/institutional, luxury/lifestyle, property/technology or similarly complex categories would be advantageous.
For Senior Account Director candidates: demonstrated ability to operate beyond individual accounts by mentoring senior team members, driving growth areas and contributing to agency-wide leadership and capability building.

title: Media Buying Specialist
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and analytically strong Media Buying Specialist to manage and optimise our paid media investments in support of institutional branding, student recruitment, thought leadership, and content amplification efforts.

Reporting to Head, Digital Communications from the Corporate Communications Office, the successful candidate will oversee end-to-end paid media execution across social platforms, search engines, native/content discovery networks and beyond, with a particular focus on the distribution and performance of long-form editorial, research, and institutional content in furtherance of building NTU’s global brand presence.

This is an in-house role, working closely with internal stakeholders across the University.

1. Media Planning and Campaign Management

Develop and execute integrated paid media strategies aligned with institutional priorities, campaign objectives, and audience segmentation frameworks.
Plan, launch, and manage campaigns across:
Paid social (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube and relevant platforms)
Search engine marketing and display advertising
Native and content discovery platforms (e.g., Outbrain, Taboola, and similar networks)
Translate campaign briefs and editorial priorities into structured media plans, budgets, and flighting schedules.
Own full-funnel media activation, from awareness and consideration to lead generation and engagement.

2. Social Media Boosting and Content Amplification

Lead paid distribution of institutional content, including – but not limited to – social media posts and long-form stories (e.g. research highlights, thought leadership articles, news pieces).
Design and execute social boosting strategies to maximise reach, engagement, and qualified traffic to long-form content.
Optimise formats, placements, and targeting to enhance content discoverability and engagement.

3. Ad Operations (Ad Ops) and Platform Management

Manage day-to-day ad operations, including:
Campaign setup and trafficking
Creative uploads and approvals
Pixel and conversion event validation
Naming conventions (e.g. adherence to the master UTM taxonomy) and documentation
Budget pacing and reconciliation
Procurement and finance processes related to media buying
Maintain clean and scalable account structures across platforms.
Ensure compliance with institutional governance, brand guidelines, and data privacy requirements.

4. Performance Optimisation and Testing

Monitor campaign performance on an ongoing basis and conduct systematic optimisation to improve efficiency and outcomes.
Execute structured A/B and multivariate testing across creatives, audiences, keywords, bidding strategies, and landing pages.
Implement learning agendas and experimentation roadmaps to inform long-term media strategy.

5. Measurement, Tracking, and Reporting

Ensure accuracy and reliability of tracking through GA4, Google Tag Manager, platform pixels, Conversion APIs, and UTMs.
Develop and maintain performance dashboards and reporting frameworks.
Analyse multi-channel attribution and user journeys to assess content and campaign effectiveness.
Provide regular performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.

6. Stakeholder Collaboration and Governance

Partner closely with internal stakeholders to align paid media with institutional messaging and priorities.
Support campaign planning cycles and cross-functional reviews.
Coordinate with external vendors and media partners where required.
Manage documentation, invoicing, and administrative processes related to media spend.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Analytics or a related discipline.
Minimum 2–4 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing or digital advertising.
Demonstrated experience managing paid campaigns across:
Meta and LinkedIn Ads
Google Ads (Search and Display)
Native/content discovery platforms
Strong understanding of ad operations workflows and best practices.
Proven ability to manage multi-campaign portfolios with disciplined budget control.
Experience working with analytics and tracking tools, including GA4, GTM, and reporting platforms.
Excellent analytical, organisational, and documentation skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

Hiring Institution: NTU

title: Senior/ Specialist, E-Commerce Marketing (Amazon Campaigns & Promotions)
description:
Company Overview: Truegenics Pte Ltd is a leading ecommerce company based in Singapore with a track record of over US$218M in online product sales. We specialise in e-retailing our own brand of health supplements to a global audience. We strive to create value and make a positive difference in the world, one life at a time. We believe that even the smallest action can define one’s destiny, and are committed to the creation of products that enhance the lives of our consumers.

Mission of the role: This role is responsible for driving our revenue growth through expert campaign and promotion planning across all four brands (Simple Promise, 5th & Glow, N-Labs, and 7th Manna). The Specialist will focus on optimizing conversions through data-driven insights, developing and executing robust promotional strategies, and working closely with our Operations and PPC teams to ensure flawless high and low-level execution. This person will act as the analytical engine for our campaigns, processing complex data to discern winning strategies from underperforming ones, and guiding the brands toward sustainable, high-impact growth.

Key Responsibilities:
Promotions & Campaigns

title: DCEO Maint Service Tech, DCEO
description:
DESCRIPTION

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

In this role, you will be part of a team responsible for the operation and maintenance of state-of-the-art critical infrastructure facilities based in Singapore. You will collaborate with a world-class technical team, working alongside some of the brightest and most talented engineers in the data center industry. This position offers the opportunity to work with highly experienced professionals while developing your skills and advancing your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies in the world.

Your responsibilities will include performing preventive maintenance on various facility equipment (such as electrical and mechanical, control, and fire-fighting systems), managing change processes, creating procedures, and overseeing vendor operations.

This role starts with 12-months contractual term with opportunity to convert to permanent full time employment.

Key job responsibilities
The Data Center Engineering Operation Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating within contract parameters within facilities. Often this will be including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.

• Meet daily hours of operations, on call requirements and response during rotations.
• Manage minor and major planned and unplanned site works for critical infrastructure, with a solid understanding of the works involved, risks, mitigation and seeking approvals within relevant SLA’s as required.
• Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
• Prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
• Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for DCEO activities.
• Coordinate with DCO managers (IT), Networking, Logistics, Safety, Security and other business leaders and operating partners to execute projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.
• Review and follow the documentation relevant to technical support of business & facility operations.
• Implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability.
• Support operating partners in the resolution of any infrastructure engineering issues

A day in the life
• Support troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
• Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management.
• Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained
• Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.
• Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

About the team
About AWS
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 2+ years of operations and on-call support for data center facilities, mission critical plants, or production facilities experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 2+ years of data center or mission critical facilities (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.) experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Regulatory Affairs Specialist
description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Our nutrition business develops science-based nutrition products for people of all ages, from helping babies and children grow, to keeping adult bodies strong and active. Millions of people around the world count on our leading brands, including Similac®, PediaSure®, Pedialyte®, Ensure® and Glucerna®, to help get the nutrients they need to live their healthiest life.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:
Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists

The Opportunity

As the Senior Regulatory Affairs Specialist, provide support for the regulatory department to ensure efficient and compliant business processes and environment. Execute regulatory tasks and play a consultative role by partnering across business functions. Assist in identifying data needed, obtaining these data and ensuring that they are effectively presented for the registration of products and/or conducting regulatory assessments using worldwide data. Prepare and submit documentation or oversee preparation of documentation needed for registration worldwide. Provide technical leadership to business units.

What You’ll Do

Responsible for compliance with applicable Corporate and Divisional Policies and procedures and Regulatory SOPs.
Work with markets and relevant SMEs to track emerging legislative changes and industry trends to support impact assessments and appropriate handover processes to cross functional teams.
Support and/or lead development of regulatory strategies for new product innovations, line extensions and market entry.
Partner with R&D, commercial, quality assurance, supply chain teams to address technical and regulatory hurdles.
Execute regulatory tasks and manage key projects critical to support AN strategy to futureproof business needs and changes.
Assist in Regulatory SOP development and/or review; identify areas for improvement and optimization in regulatory quality systems and processes.
Depending on specific role, may be involved in various regulatory activities including review of scientific documentation, regulatory submissions and follow-up, evaluation of product and manufacturing changes for regulatory implications, support compliance audits,
Maintaining annual licenses, registrations, listings and patent information, review and approval of label changes, advertising and promotional content, and providing regulatory input to product safety issues and product recalls.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) is required.
Preferred area of focus in science (biology, chemistry, nutrition, dietetics, microbiology, immunology, medical technology, pharmacy, and pharmacology), math, engineering, or medical fields. M.S. in a technical area or M.B.A. is preferred.
A Ph.D. in a technical area or law is helpful. Certification is a plus (such as RAC from the Regulatory Affairs Professionals Society).
6-7 years of experience in regulatory preferred, but may consider quality assurance, research and development, scientific affairs, operations, or related area.
4-5 years of experience in a regulated industry (e.g., infant and adult specialized nutritionals, medical/pharmaceutical products).
Regulatory knowledge of regulatory requirements, guidelines, policies, standards, practices, history, ethics, agency structure and processes.
Knowledge of GxPs (GMPs, GLPs, GCPs).
Knowledge of principles and requirements of promotion, advertising and labeling.
Specialized nutrition, food and pharmaceutical regulations, especially in Asia is an added advantage.
Strong communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing, communicate with diverse audiences and personnel, and work with and negotiate with people from various disciplines, organizations, and cultures.
Ability to follow scientific arguments, identify regulatory scientific data needs and, with supervision, solve regulatory issues and define regulatory strategy.
Ability to evaluate various technical alternatives.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to create and manage multiple project plans and timelines.
Ability to think analytically; organize and track complex information.
Proficient computer skills.

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

Connect with us at www.abbott.com, on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott and on Twitter @AbbottNews and @AbbottGlobal.
