title: Meta Ads Specialist
description:
About Us

We provide travel eSIM solutions that help international travellers stay connected abroad. Customers can browse and purchase mobile data plans through our website and app. We are looking for an experienced Meta advertising specialist to grow customer acquisition and sales across international markets.

About the Role

You will manage paid advertising across Facebook and Instagram, with a particular focus on finding effective combinations of audiences, creative concepts and product messaging that generate purchases.

This role requires strong analytical skills and commercial judgement. You should be able to test different travel scenarios and customer needs, identify which ads acquire customers efficiently, and scale successful campaigns while maintaining sustainable returns.

Appointment at Specialist or Senior Specialist level will depend on your experience, capabilities and track record.

Key Responsibilities

Plan, launch and optimise Meta Ads campaigns across Facebook and Instagram to drive customer acquisition and purchases.

Develop and test audience strategies for prospecting and retargeting, and evaluate their contribution to new-customer acquisition.

Build a structured creative testing programme covering travel scenarios, customer pain points, product benefits, offers and ad formats.

Work with creative teams to develop images, videos and user-generated content, providing clear briefs based on customer insights and campaign data.

Analyse creative and audience performance together to identify which combinations deliver purchases at sustainable acquisition costs.

Monitor creative fatigue, audience saturation and frequency, and recommend timely changes to messaging, assets or targeting.

Manage budgets across markets and campaigns, scaling successful approaches while monitoring acquisition costs and returns.

Run structured tests across creatives, audiences, placements, bidding and landing pages.

Work with product and technical teams to implement and validate conversion tracking through Meta Pixel, Conversions API and relevant analytics tools.

Compare platform-reported results with actual sales and acquisition costs, and present clear findings and recommended actions.

Requirements

At least 3 years of hands-on Meta Ads experience, including independently managing campaigns and budgets. Candidates with 5 or more years of relevant experience are encouraged to apply.

Strong ability to develop and evaluate creative and audience testing hypotheses, and translate results into specific optimisation decisions.

Strong data analysis and logical reasoning skills, with the ability to distinguish creative, audience, tracking and website conversion issues.

Proven campaign success, supported by measurable results such as lower customer acquisition costs, improved purchase conversion or increased sales at sustainable returns.

Experience scaling campaigns while monitoring performance as budgets increase.

Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, prospecting, retargeting and conversion tracking, including Meta Pixel and Conversions API.

Ability to assess data quality, understand attribution limitations and distinguish meaningful improvements from short-term fluctuations.

Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and familiarity with GA4 or other relevant analytics tools.

Clear written and spoken English, strong attention to detail and the ability to collaborate effectively with creative and technical teams.

Preferred Experience

International or multi-market advertising campaigns.

eSIM, telecommunications, travel technology, e-commerce or consumer apps.

Website purchase campaigns, app acquisition and app attribution tools.

Performance creative development, UGC advertising or landing-page conversion optimisation.

Relevant industry experience is an advantage. Experience with Google Ads or TikTok Ads is welcome but is not required.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and one or two Meta advertising campaigns you have personally managed. Include the objective, market, approximate budget, timeframe, your responsibilities, optimisation decisions and measurable results.

ISerious Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based mobile virtual network operator (MVNO) focused on travel connectivity. Through our website and mobile app, we offer eSIM data plans that help leisure and business travellers stay connected across international destinations.

title: Manager, Programme Development & Client Engagement
description:
ABOUT EQUAL

EQUAL is an IPC-registered charity that delivers equine-assisted and animal-assisted services to support the mental and emotional wellbeing of children, youth, seniors, families, and communities. Our work sits at the intersection of human wellbeing, animal welfare, and experiential learning, and is delivered through a multidisciplinary team of programme professionals, equine specialists, operations staff, and volunteers. Fundraising is mission-critical to EQUAL’s ability to deliver safe, high-quality, and impactful programmes. As the organisation scales, EQUAL is strengthening its fundraising infrastructure, pipeline discipline, and stewardship capability to support sustainable growth.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Manager, Programme Growth & Client Engagement is responsible for growing and sustaining demand for EQUAL's programmes through new institutional engagements, stronger existing client relationships and repeat programme opportunities.

The role proactively develops programme opportunities across schools, social service agencies, healthcare institutions, corporations and community organisations. This includes both fee-paying programme engagements and partnerships that extend programme access and beneficiary reach.

The Manager owns the external client engagement process, from prospecting and enquiries through needs assessment, proposals, quotations, programme confirmation, contracting coordination and renewal.

Working closely with the Programmes & Services team, the Manager ensures that programme opportunities are appropriate, financially sound where applicable, and aligned with EQUAL's programme capabilities and delivery capacity.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Programme Business Growth & New Institutional Engagements

Proactively identify and engage organisations that may benefit from EQUAL's programmes.

Develop new opportunities across schools, social service agencies, healthcare institutions, corporations and community organisations.

Qualify prospective engagements by understanding organisational needs, beneficiary groups, programme objectives, available budgets and potential engagement models.

Convert qualified enquiries and opportunities into confirmed programme engagements.

Respond promptly to assigned programme enquiries, establish clear next steps and follow through until each opportunity is confirmed, declined or closed.

Develop targeted institutional outreach and re-engagement plans.

Identify potential new markets, client segments and programme applications, working with Programme leadership to assess feasibility.

Work with Programme Specialists to assess programme requirements, delivery feasibility and suitable engagement models before making external commitments.

Maintain a clear and actively managed pipeline of programme opportunities.

2. Existing Programme Client Relationships & Retention

Client Relationships & Retention

Manage assigned institutional programme clients and partners.

Maintain regular engagement with existing clients to understand evolving programme needs.

Secure repeat programme engagements and renewals.

Proactively re-engage lapsed programme partners to explore renewed or expanded programme participation.

Identify opportunities to expand programme participation through additional sessions, beneficiary groups or approved programme offerings.

Maintain accurate engagement records, renewal schedules and client follow-up plans.

Collect structured client feedback and coordinate improvements with the Programme team.

3. Programme Proposals, Quotations & Contracting

Lead the preparation of programme proposals, concept notes, quotations and engagement documents, working with Programme Specialists on programme content and delivery requirements

Coordinate programme pricing, budgets and delivery assumptions with the relevant internal teams.

Assess fee-based opportunities using approved pricing, delivery cost and capacity information, escalating exceptions for the appropriate approval.

Manage procurement and tender submissions, including GeBIZ where applicable.

Coordinate service agreements, booking confirmations, contract renewals and amendments.

Ensure programme requirements, commercial terms and delivery commitments receive the necessary internal approvals before confirmation.

Work with Finance to ensure accurate billing information is submitted promptly and help resolve client-related commercial issues.

4. Programme Engagement & Client Coordination

Serve as the primary client-facing contact for assigned programme engagements.

Coordinate client needs and expectations with Programme Specialists and relevant operational colleagues.

Ensure confirmed programme commitments are handed over clearly to the teams responsible for delivery.

Monitor client-facing commitments, programme engagement milestones and renewal opportunities.

Maintain visibility of confirmed programme bookings, client requirements and engagement status, coordinating client-facing issues with the Programme team.

Coordinate the timely submission of agreed programme-client reports and deliverables, using content prepared and approved by the Programme team.

Address client-related issues and escalate operational matters to the relevant functional leads.

5. Programme Pipeline, Performance & Process Improvement

Maintain accurate records of prospective, confirmed and completed programme engagements.

Prepare programme booking forecasts, including expected programme income where applicable.

Track enquiry conversion, programme client retention, repeat engagements and engagement trends.

Monitor commercial engagement performance using approved pricing and cost information.

Identify gaps in enquiry management, proposal turnaround, contracting and client coordination.

Research emerging institutional needs and potential referral channels to inform targeted programme outreach and future growth.

Implement practical improvements to programme business processes.

Provide regular management updates on programme demand, pipeline performance, client retention and growth opportunities.

6. Cross-Functional Opportunity Development

Work with the Fundraising team where programme clients express interest in donations, sponsorships or broader philanthropic partnerships.

Refer volunteering opportunities to the Volunteer Manager and coordinate where volunteering forms part of a programme engagement.

Coordinate external communication with the designated relationship lead where a partner engages multiple EQUAL departments, while owning the programme workstream.

Provide programme scope, costings, delivery assumptions and relevant approved information to support fundraising or grant submissions led by designated colleagues.

Participate in integrated institutional partnership proposals when EQUAL's programmes form part of a broader collaboration.

Maintain coordinated external communication when a partner engages multiple EQUAL departments.

SCOPE & ACCOUNTABILITY BOUNDRIES

This role is

not

responsible for:

Fundraising solicitation, philanthropic funding negotiations or donor stewardship.

Independently managing corporate sponsorships, charitable grants or donation renewals.

Corporate volunteering programme design or volunteer management.

Programme methodology, beneficiary assessments or direct programme delivery.

Producing or approving technical programme outcome reports and research findings.

Issuing invoices, accounting for income or managing formal debt collection.

Making unauthorised commitments concerning programme pricing, expenditure, staffing, capacity or horse welfare.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

Demonstrated experience in institutional business development, service-based partnerships or account management, including converting new opportunities into confirmed engagements and maintaining client relationships.

Experience managing external partnerships, client relationships or institutional accounts.

Strong administrative, organisational and project coordination skills.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Core Competencies

Strong relationship-building and consultative engagement skills.

Proactive business development and follow-through.

Sound commercial judgement and ability to balance growth with operational feasibility.

Excellent written and verbal communication.

Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and CRM/pipeline discipline.

Ability to work across teams while respecting functional expertise and responsibilities.

Key Attributes

Proactive, resourceful and accountable for results.

Comfortable developing new business rather than relying solely on incoming enquiries.

Collaborative, practical and service-oriented. • Able to manage multiple client engagements and deadlines.

Motivated by EQUAL's mission and committed to quality, sustainable programme growth.

WHY JOIN US?

Make a tangible impact in a mission-driven team, grow across operations and systems, and work in a unique, nature-rich environment with meaningful outcomes.

HOW TO APPLY

Please email your updated CV and a short cover letter to

pradeep.thevar@equal.org.sg

with the subject line “Partnership & Development – Your Name”.

Founded in 2015, EQUAL (an IPC charity) strives to transform lives through Animal-Assisted Services. EQUAL partners with animals to provide experiential and educational programmes that help empower vulnerable persons such as children, youths, persons with special needs, families and seniors by enhancing their social and emotional well-being and supporting social integration in a safe environment — building resilience and inclusive communities.

title: Senior/ Specialist, E-Commerce Marketing (Amazon Campaigns & Promotions)
description:
*Company Overview:* Truegenics Pte Ltd is a leading ecommerce company based in Singapore with a track record of over US$218M in online product sales. We specialise in e-retailing our own brand of health supplements to a global audience. We strive to create value and make a positive difference in the world, one life at a time. We believe that even the smallest action can define one’s destiny, and are committed to the creation of products that enhance the lives of our consumers.

*Mission of the role:* This role is responsible for driving our revenue growth through expert campaign and promotion planning across all four brands (Simple Promise, 5th & Glow, N-Labs, and 7th Manna). The Specialist will focus on optimizing conversions through data-driven insights, developing and executing robust promotional strategies, and working closely with our Operations and PPC teams to ensure flawless high and low-level execution. This person will act as the analytical engine for our campaigns, processing complex data to discern winning strategies from underperforming ones, and guiding the brands toward sustainable, high-impact growth.

*Key Responsibilities:*

*Promotions & Campaigns*

* *Promotions Planning & Execution:* Take full ownership of developing and executing promotional strategies and campaigns. Coordinate seamlessly with the Operations and PPC teams to ensure all promo strategies and executions are carried out accurately and on time.
* *Data-Driven Insights & Analytics:* Process and analyze campaign data and key e-commerce metrics (e.g., ROAS, ACOS, TACoS). Exercise strong analytical judgment to discern "what is good and what is bad" in campaign performance, providing actionable insights to optimize overall spend and ROI.

*Merchandising & Content Execution*

* *Content Optimization:* Optimize and update keywords (KWs), product descriptions, image assets, and A+ content to maximize organic ranking and conversions.
* *Listings Management:* Create fully optimized new listings for new product launches and update existing listings where needed.
* *Inventory Management & Transparency Program: *Manage inventory replenishment, ensuring stock levels are optimal, discrepancies are resolved, and oversee Amazon's Transparency Program to prevent unauthorized sellers.
* *Competitor Benchmarking:* Continuously track competitor content (ads, videos, images, etc.) and benchmark competitor SKU prices to maintain our competitive edge.
* *Collaboration & Trend Identification:* Identify current trends in e-commerce content. Work closely with the Affiliates team to identify winning external content and mirror those strategies onto our Amazon listings.

*Cross-Functional & Strategic Support*

* *Cross-Team Collaboration:* Act as the central hub between Marketing, Operations, and PPC teams. Align stakeholders on campaign strategies, improve cross-departmental execution processes, and ensure all teams are synchronized for major promotions across all brands.
* *Reporting & Analytics:* Maintain, generate, and present detailed reports on promotional and campaign performance metrics to stakeholders, driving strategic decision-making.

*Key Skills / Experience Required:*

* *Education:* Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).
* *Experience:* At least 3 years in eCommerce or Digital Marketing, with a strong focus on the Amazon marketplace.
* *Campaign & Promotion Management:* Proven ability to plan, launch, and manage e-commerce promotional campaigns, coordinating with various teams to ensure successful execution.
* *Analytical & Strategic Insight:* Exceptional analytical skills. Must be highly capable of processing raw data, identifying trends, and discerning successful tactics from underperforming ones to drive future strategy.
* *Cross-Functional Leadership:* Experience collaborating with operations, advertising (PPC), and creative teams to bring campaigns to life.
* *Tools Proficiency:* Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central, advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP), and data analysis tools like Helium 10 or ScaleInsight.
* *Self-Starter:* Ability to work independently, take absolute ownership of promotional calendars, and lead initiatives from start to finish.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Benefits:
* Work from home



Application Question(s):
* Are you familiar with Amazon marketplace?
* What is your expected salary?

Experience:
* digital marketing: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Singapore 188979

title: Content Specialist, IKEA Singapore
description:
Company Description

The IKEA vision is to create a better everyday life for the many people. We do this by offering a wide range of well-designed, functional home furnishing products at prices so low that as many people as possible can afford them. We operate in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand – and have an ambitious expansion plan to bring a little bit of Sweden to new markets in the region. We are part of the Ikano Group of companies and the only IKEA franchisee owned by the Kamprad family that founded IKEA.

We also develop, own and operate Shopping Centres that are anchored by IKEA and create walkable communities by including residential, office and other types of real estate in our development plans.

We work towards making sustainability a natural part of our everyday work. We are active in our communities, driving and supporting social initiatives that benefit children, women and the environment.

Job Description

We are looking for an energetic, creatively driven and hands-on Content Specialist who knows how to turn ideas into compelling stories across social, digital and other brand channels. Someone who is curious, culturally tuned in, confident behind the camera and in the edit suite, and passionate about home furnishing and the IKEA brand. From playful trend-led content and unexpected product stories to influencer collaborations, major campaigns and in-store activations, you’ll help bring the IKEA brand to life through strong copy, photography and video—with wit, warmth and a little twinkle in the eye.

Work closely with Marketing colleagues (including Social Media Manager) to plan and execute content that supports IKEA Singapore's communication and business priorities.
Contribute ideas and support the sourcing, adaptation, hands-on production and delivery of engaging content, including copy, stills, videos and graphics, across social, digital and other relevant brand channels.
Plan and execute photography and video shoots, including concept development, storyboarding, shot planning, audio capture and on-location production.
Help turn products, offers, campaigns, trends and everyday moments into relevant stories.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Sales, Web, Food, Communications) to gather information, product lists and align requirements to ensure campaign readiness and content accuracy.
Coordinate with agencies, influencers, creators and vendors on content development, production and publishing matters, while overseeing timelines, deliverables and administrative matters.
Build and nurture relationships with influencers, content creators and influencer agencies to amplify brand narratives and extend reach.
Support social media listening and community management across IKEA Singapore's owned channels.
Monitor content performance, identify useful learnings and contribute to post-campaign reports, internal updates and performance trackers.
Support the team with purchase orders, agency billings and other administrative requirements that keep the work moving smoothly.

Qualifications

At least 3-4 years of experience managing, producing & publishing content across social channels.
Strong understanding of social platforms including its algorithms, publishing & advertising capabilities.
Proficient in software/tools for content creation, video editing and animation (e.g. Photoshop, InDesign, Adobe Premiere, CapCut).
Hands-on experience with AI tools for content production will be an added advantage.
Creative copywriting or journalistic experience with an ability to develop engaging content.
Hands-on experience planning and executing photography and video shoots for campaigns, products, events or social-first content.
High energy, proactive, highly responsible and able to multitask, work in a fast-paced environment and manage deliverables & timelines well.
Analytical skills to track, measure, and improve performance based on data and learnings.
Experience working with creative advertising/media agencies.
Able to work independently on shoots and collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders, creators, agencies and vendors.
Have a passion for home furnishing and the IKEA brand, share the IKEA values, tone of voice and vision and develop deep understanding of customer needs and living situations to craft impactful content.

Additional Information

Please apply by 26 October 2026.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, APAC DC Delivery Operations
description:
DESCRIPTION

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We're seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager to lead AI transformation across APAC Data Center Planning & Delivery. You will work with business owners in each of our five verticals to turn AI capabilities into measurable improvements in planning and delivery. Business impact will guide the roadmap, from workflow changes to the products teams use every day.

You will be APAC DCPD's accountable lead for collaboration with counterparts in the Americas (AMER) and Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA). Together, you will identify opportunities to reuse and scale shared AI solutions where business needs align.

Our AI solutions are already in production. You will establish and lead a central AI solutions hub for the agreed portfolio, consolidating overlapping solutions and developing reusable products. The hub combines a shared catalogue with product-lifecycle and governance mechanisms, using existing approved tools and agreed team responsibilities. It covers maintenance and enhancement priorities after rollout.

You will set change-management direction with process owners and define the mechanisms that turn approved AI capabilities into improved business outcomes. Business champions and enablement teams will deliver agreed communications, training and rollout activities. You will review results and remove barriers, using sustained use and feedback to explain where products or workflows need to improve.

Practical knowledge of AI product design and development is essential. You will guide technical decisions on data integration, model evaluation and deployment requirements, and build selected prototypes to validate approaches. You will work with senior engineering leaders across platforms to prioritise features and connectors that unblock AI development, deployment and integration. We prefer candidates who have deployed AI products for business users, especially on AWS.

You will own the regional governance framework and retain responsibility for portfolio evolution after launch. Engineering and service owners will implement, maintain and operate products under agreed responsibilities and capacity. Security and data owners retain approval authority. You will report time saved, quality and throughput improvements, and cost savings or avoidance against agreed baselines, using measures relevant to each initiative. Assess benefits alongside operating costs and the effort needed to review or correct AI outputs.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the APAC AI transformation roadmap across five verticals. Prioritise opportunities by business value, readiness, technical feasibility, cost and risk.
- Own APAC DCPD's collaboration with AMER and EMEA to identify opportunities for reuse and scaling of shared AI solutions.
- Establish the central AI solutions hub using approved tools and agreed team responsibilities. Lead portfolio consolidation, maintenance, enhancement and retirement, with named owners and lifecycle commitments.
- Set change-management direction with process owners and enablement teams. Redesign workflows and use feedback to improve business results.
- Own regional AI governance, risk reviews and evaluation criteria. Security and data owners retain approvals. Require read-only agents by default, with human approval and audit logging for changes to systems of record.
- Guide AI product design and build selected prototypes. Work with senior engineering leaders across platforms to prioritise features and connectors that unblock development, deployment and integration.
- Lead cross-functional delivery, resolve dependencies and agree operational ownership. Measure time saved, quality, throughput and cost savings or avoidance against baselines, accounting for operating costs and human review effort. Recommend what to scale, improve or stop.

About the team
About AWS

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 7+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale
- Experience with technology risk, IT security audit, compliance and/or relevant regulatory knowledge
- Experience leading AI or digital transformation programs across business units or regions, including change management.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience working with or evaluating AI systems
- Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
- Experience with automation or working with scripting languages like Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell, or equivalent
- Experience in data centers, infrastructure service providers, or related technology companies
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
- Experience consolidating technology products across business units and managing shared roadmaps through maintenance, enhancement and retirement.
- Experience defining business outcome metrics and presenting recommendations to senior leadership.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Head of Communications & Brand
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

About BW Group

BW Group is a leading global energy and maritime company involved in shipping, deepwater oil & gas production, renewable energy and digital infrastructure. BW controls a fleet of over 400 vessels transporting oil, gas and dry commodities. In the infrastructure space, the group operates in wind, batteries, water, subsea cable networks and data centres.

BW is proud to be listed among Forbes World's Best Employers and Financial Times Best Employers Asia-Pacific 2025.

Are you ready to make an impact?

What drives us is our mission to deliver energy for the world today, and to find solutions for tomorrow. If you want to make lives better around the world by providing access to energy, while working on sustainability and decarbonisation, we'd like to hear from you. Working at BW you will feel the pulse of the world each day. If something happens in the world, we feel it, and you can play your part by anticipating and responding to it. Our high-performing teams are drawn to BW by the global nature of our work and the satisfaction of working with collaborative people who inspire each other to deliver exceptional results.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Role Overview

Based in Singapore and reporting to the Chief People Officer, BW Group, the Head of Communications & Brand leads communications and corporate brand activities across BW Group whilst also supporting BW LNG.

This is a highly visible role partnering closely with the Chairman, senior executives and Communications leaders across our affiliate companies to strengthen BW's reputation, shape its corporate narrative and foster greater collaboration across the Group.

Success requires far more than exceptional communications capability. You will be a commercially minded strategic thinker who anticipates issues, shapes narratives and influences outcomes through sound judgement, trusted relationships and collaboration in a federated organisation where credibility matters more than hierarchy.

Working with a lean team and external partners, you will combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, helping shape executive communications, protect and enhance the BW brand, support organisational transformation and drive communications excellence across the Group.

Key Accountabilities

Corporate Communications

Develop and deliver BW Group's corporate communications strategy aligned with the Group's long-term vision and priorities.

Shape compelling narratives that strengthen understanding of BW's purpose, strategy and portfolio of businesses.

Advise leaders on communications strategy, executive messaging and stakeholder engagement.

Lead communications for strategic initiatives, organisational change, major announcements and corporate events.

Oversee BW Group's digital communications, including LinkedIn and other channels, delivering engaging content that strengthens the brand and supports strategic objectives.

Executive

Communications

Partner closely with the Chairman and senior executives on speeches, presentations, thought leadership and executive communications.

Develop executive communications that reflect BW's values and high editorial standards.

Lead the production of flagship Group communications, including World Horizon, the Annual Report, Sustainability Report, corporate website and key leadership updates.

Support senior executives at conferences, media engagements, investor events and industry forums through end-to-end communications planning and delivery.

Serve as a trusted communications adviser to the Chairman and senior leadership, providing sound judgement on messaging, stakeholder considerations and reputational matters.

Employee

Communications

Lead Group-wide employee communications across digital channels.

Deliver engaging communications that connect shore-based and seafaring employees through platforms such as BW Connect.

Foster a culture of openness, pride and engagement across the Group.

Brand & Reputation

Act as steward of the BW corporate brand, ensuring consistency whilst respecting the autonomy of our affiliate businesses.

Evolve BW's corporate identity and positioning to strengthen the Group's reputation and create value across the portfolio.

Protect and enhance BW's reputation with employees, customers, investors, regulators, partners and the wider maritime and energy community.

Lead crisis and issues communications, partnering with senior management and external advisers as required for ongoing incidents and with post-communications.

BW LNG Communications & Marketing

Partner with the BW LNG leadership team to develop communications and marketing initiatives that strengthen the company's commercial positioning and reputation.

Lead communications supporting commercial initiatives, including vessel launches, technology innovations, customer campaigns and industry events.

Develop marketing content and digital campaigns that showcase BW LNG's capabilities, innovation and market leadership.

Ensure alignment between BW LNG's communications and the wider BW corporate brand.

Leadership & Influence

Lead BW's Communications Community of Practice, fostering collaboration, sharing best practice and identifying opportunities for greater alignment across affiliate companies.

Build trusted relationships with affiliate CEOs and Communications leaders, influencing through credibility rather than authority.

Foster collaboration across the Group whilst respecting the entrepreneurial culture and autonomy of individual businesses.

Digital Communications & AI

Harness AI and emerging technologies to improve the quality, consistency, efficiency and reach of communications.

Identify and implement new tools, channels and approaches that enhance engagement and communications effectiveness.

Measure communications impact using meaningful qualitative and quantitative insights.

Team Leadership

Lead, coach and develop a small, high-performing communications team.

Manage external agencies and specialist partners to maximise quality, capability and value.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

We're looking for someone who combines strategic communications leadership with exceptional judgement and the ability to influence senior stakeholders. You'll ideally bring:

Significant experience leading corporate communications within a global organisation or consultancy.

Experience advising CEOs and senior executives on communications strategy and reputation management.

Strong understanding of corporate branding, stakeholder engagement and executive communications.

Experience leading communications during periods of organisational change, transformation or significant corporate activity.

Experience working across complex, matrixed or federated organisations would be advantageous.

Experience within the maritime or energy sectors would be beneficial, although not essential.

What Will Make You Successful

You'll be someone who naturally earns trust and credibility. You'll demonstrate:

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

Excellent judgement and discretion.

The ability to simplify complex issues into clear, compelling messages.

Exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills.

Strong commercial awareness.

High levels of curiosity and strategic thinking.

Comfort working directly with senior executives and Board-level stakeholders.

A collaborative style with low ego and high integrity.

The ability to balance strategic thinking with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and deliver.

Demonstrates sound judgement in knowing when to follow established processes and when a pragmatic, flexible approach will deliver a better outcome.

A passion for continuous improvement, innovation and practical application of AI.

This role is unlikely to suit someone who prefers highly structured environments, relies on formal authority to get things done, or wants to specialise in a single area of communications. Success requires sound judgement, adaptability, collaboration and a willingness to operate across a broad range of strategic and hands-on responsibilities.

OTHER INFORMATION

Why BW?

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the voice and reputation of one of the world's most respected maritime and energy groups.

You'll work closely with visionary leaders who value integrity, long-term thinking and collaboration, while helping tell the story of a business investing in both today's energy needs and tomorrow's energy transition.

The role offers exceptional breadth, combining strategy, executive partnership, brand leadership, organisational change, employee engagement and external communications in an entrepreneurial international environment.

Please note that your application will be sent to and reviewed by the direct employer - BW Maritime

description:
Marketing Officer

Job Purpose

The Marketing Officer supports the planning, coordination, and execution of partnership initiatives, events, sales enablement activities, and marketing campaigns across Stellar Lifestyle and Stellar Ace ecosystem.

The role works closely with sales teams, internal business units, brand partners, sponsors, tenants, merchants, vendors and other stakeholders to develop impactful partnership opportunities, event activations, sales materials and marketing initiatives that drive business growth, brand awareness, customer engagement, and stakeholder value.

Through the successful delivery of collaborations, campaigns, and activations across transit, retail, lifestyle and media platforms, the Marketing Officer plays a key role in supporting revenue opportunities, strengthening partner relationships, and enhancing the Stellar Lifestyle ecosystem.

Responsibilities

Partnerships & Sales Enablement

Support the planning, coordination, and execution of partnership initiatives, sponsorship opportunities, sales pitches and marketing outreach activities.
Assist in the preparation of pitch decks, proposals, presentations, sales kits, and marketing collaterals to support advertising, partnership, and outreach efforts.
Coordinate with partners, sponsors, merchants, tenants, and external stakeholders on deliverables, participation details, and campaign requirements.
Conduct research on market trends, potential partners, sponsorship opportunities, and industry developments to support business growth and team’s planning.
Maintain proper records of sales materials, partner databases, and follow-up documentation.

Events & Activations

Support the planning, coordination and execution of events, partner campaigns, station activations, and engagement programmes.
Liaise with event vendors, venue partners, tenants, station operations teams, and internal departments to ensure smooth event logistics and operational coordination.
Assist in sourcing for event materials, suppliers, vendors, premiums, and other resources while ensuring cost-effectiveness and quality standards.
Support on-site event requirements, including setup, manpower planning, publicity materials, stakeholder briefings and event-day support.
Assist in tracking event deliverables, timelines, budgets and post-event reporting.

Marketing & Communications Support

Support the development of marketing collaterals, campaign materials, communication assets, and promotional content for partnerships and events
Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors on creative assets, publicity materials, digital content, and campaign requirements.

Administrative Support

Provide administrative support for marketing, partnerships, and event-related activities, including scheduling, documentation, filing and coordination.
Assist with procurement processes, including vendor quotations, PR/PO submissions, invoice processing, payment follow-ups and budget tracking.
Maintain organized records of contracts, campaign materials, event documentation, partner correspondence, and supporting documents for audit and reporting purposes.
Perform other duties and ad-hoc tasks as assigned to support departmental operations and business objectives.
Qualifications & Work Experience
Diploma in Marketing, Business, Communications, Events Management, or a related field.
Candidates with 1–2 years of marketing, communications, digital, retail marketing, or campaign management experience are preferred.
Fresh graduates with a positive attitude, strong learning mindset, and relevant internship experience may be considered.
Experience in events, retail marketing, partnerships, media, advertising or stakeholder coordination will be advantageous.
Skills
Coordination Skills: Able to support multiple marketing, partnership, and event-related tasks while keeping track of timelines and deliverables.
Communication Skills: Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills when liaising with internal teams, vendors, partners, tenants, and other stakeholders.
Organisational Skills: Meticulous and structured in managing documentation, schedules, marketing assets, event requirements, and follow-up items.
Marketing Knowledge: Basic understanding of marketing campaigns, events, social media, digital platforms, and customer engagement.
Technical Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Office, Teams, Outlook, PowerPoint, and other commonly used presentation or reporting tools.
Creative and Design Sense: Able to assist with simple presentation layouts, marketing collaterals, and content coordination, with a good eye for detail.
Problem-Solving Attitude: Resourceful, proactive, and willing to learn, with the ability to remain calm and helpful during events or tight timelines.
Team Player: Positive disposition and collaborative mindset, with willingness to support on-site activities and cross-functional initiatives.

Retail and Advertising Solutions & Services Partner

Stellar Lifestyle is the largest managing agent of retail and advertising spaces in Singapore’s rail network. We create vibrant transit destinations through continuous innovation and a desire to make our everyday touchpoints better. Our expertise also includes retail mall management, outdoor media & digital advertising solutions, and digital engagement platforms.

title: Content Creator & Digital Storyteller

description:

You will be expected to plan, shoot, edit and publish engaging content that strengthens LSBF's brand presence and showcases student life, corporate events, academic activities, awards, achievements and institutional milestones.

Content Creation & Storytelling

* Excellent creative eye and aesthetic judgement.
* Strong understanding of social media trends and digital content.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

* Adobe Premiere Pro
* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Lightroom
* Adobe After Effects
* Adobe Illustrator
* DaVinci Resolve
* Canva Pro
* CapCut

title: Brand Marketing Director
description:
About GNAME

GNAME is Asia’s leading domain registrar, based out of Singapore. We power a native marketplace designed for discovering, buying, and selling the perfect brand identity—including a backorder system of high-value, premium domain names that have expired into digital ether.

For more info on what we do: https://www.gname.com

We are seeking an experienced Brand Marketing Director to lead GNAME's global brand and marketing strategy, strengthen brand positioning, build integrated marketing capabilities, grow brand awareness and customer engagement across priority international markets, and translate business strategy into measurable brand and marketing outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

1. Global Brand Strategy & Positioning

· Develop and lead GNAME's global brand strategy, positioning, value proposition and brand architecture in alignment with business strategy and international growth priorities.

· Define brand narratives, messaging frameworks, tone of voice and visual direction to ensure a consistent and differentiated brand across markets and customer touchpoints.

· Advise senior management on brand strategy, market positioning, reputation and major marketing priorities.

· Establish brand governance standards across corporate, product, digital, event and employer-facing communications.

· Monitor brand health, market perception and competitive positioning and translate insights into strategic actions.

2. Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning

· Develop annual and multi-market marketing strategies, priorities, budgets and execution roadmaps supporting customer acquisition, engagement, retention and business growth.

· Lead integrated campaigns across digital, content, social media, public relations, partnerships, events, community and other relevant channels.

· Translate business and product priorities into audience strategies, campaign propositions and go-to-market programmes.

· Build effective planning, campaign governance, agency/vendor management and performance review processes.

· Balance long-term brand building with measurable demand and commercial outcomes.

3. International Market Development & Go-to-Market

· Lead brand and marketing initiatives for priority international markets, including market-entry and growth programmes where relevant.

· Conduct market, customer, competitor and category analysis to identify growth opportunities, audience needs and positioning gaps.

· Adapt global brand and campaign strategies to local market context while maintaining overall brand consistency.

· Partner with business development, sales, product and operations teams on market launches, customer programmes and strategic partnerships.

· Build relationships with relevant industry communities, media, partners and ecosystem stakeholders to expand GNAME's visibility and credibility.

4. Digital, Content & Community Marketing

· Set the strategy for owned digital channels, social media, content, community and thought-leadership programmes.

· Develop content frameworks communicating GNAME's expertise in domain names and internet services to relevant customer and industry audiences.

· Oversee editorial calendars, campaign content, executive communications, corporate storytelling and key digital assets.

· Strengthen customer and industry engagement through communities, educational content, events and other relationship-building initiatives.

· Ensure content quality, brand consistency and appropriate review processes across external communications.

5. Marketing Performance, Analytics & Customer Insights

· Define marketing KPIs covering brand awareness, engagement, customer acquisition, conversion, campaign effectiveness and return on marketing investment.

· Use customer, market, channel and campaign data to evaluate performance and guide budget and resource allocation.

· Develop regular marketing dashboards and management reports with clear insights, risks and recommended actions.

· Strengthen customer insight and feedback mechanisms to improve positioning, messaging, campaigns and customer experience.

· Promote a test-and-learn culture and continuously improve marketing effectiveness through experimentation and performance analysis.

6. Team Leadership & Cross-functional Collaboration

· Build, lead and develop the brand and marketing function, including capability planning, objective setting, performance management and talent development.

· Work closely with the CEO and senior management to align brand and marketing priorities with Company strategy.

· Partner with product, business development, sales, operations, customer service, compliance, legal, finance and HR teams to deliver integrated initiatives.

· Manage external agencies, consultants, media, creative partners and other vendors where required.

· Establish clear standards, workflows and accountability to ensure high-quality and timely marketing execution.

7. Reputation, Communications & Brand Risk Management

· Oversee corporate brand communications and support reputation management across relevant external channels.

· Develop communication approaches for significant company announcements, partnerships, product developments and industry engagement.

· Work with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure external marketing and communications are accurate, appropriate and aligned with applicable requirements.

· Identify brand and reputation risks and establish appropriate escalation, review and response mechanisms.

· Support senior leaders in external communications and thought leadership where appropriate.

Requirements

· Bachelor's degree or above in Marketing, Communications, Business, Brand Management or a related discipline.

· At least 12 years of progressive experience in brand, marketing or integrated communications, including substantial experience in a senior marketing leadership role.

· Demonstrated experience developing and executing brand and marketing strategy across multiple markets, including brand positioning, integrated campaigns, digital/content marketing and marketing performance.

· Experience in technology, internet, SaaS, digital platforms, e-commerce, fintech or another international digital business is highly preferred.

· Strong understanding of digital customer journeys, international marketing channels, content and community building, and data-driven marketing.

· Proven ability to partner with CEOs, senior executives and cross-functional leaders and translate business strategy into practical brand and marketing programmes.

· Strong leadership, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, analytical, communication and change-management capabilities.

· Experience managing marketing budgets, agencies, vendors and multi-channel programmes with measurable outcomes.

· Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, international and evolving organisation, balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution when required.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Chinese to liaise with internal and external stakeholders.

About Us

GNAME was established in Singapore as a professional international domain name registrar. We are dedicated to creating a comprehensive service platform for Internet domain names. At GNAME, domain names are at the heart of our business, and we offer a wide range of services to our customers, including global domain name registration, dropcatch, transactions, management, API interfaces, and other relevant services. Adopting an open reseller model, we offer reseller a one-stop management system including products, transactions, and financial management, fully supporting their business development. In addition to domain services, we also provide a diverse range of cloud products such as cloud servers, SSL certificates, website protection, and enterprise email services. Based on cloud computing technology, these services are highly scalable and secure, meeting customers’ needs in information technology and network security.

Our strong reputation is built on our commitment to putting customers first. In the future, we will continue to work hard, stay current with industry trends, and deliver the most valuable products and services to our global customers.

title: Social Media Account Manager
description:
Job Description — Social Media Account Manager

Role

Social Media Account Manager

Reports to

Head of Operations

Location

Remote, Singapore-based

Type

Full-time

Compensation

SGD 2,200 per month

Accounts held

[X] client accounts

Review

At 3 months and 6 months

Purpose of the role

Network manages social media for interior design firms, architects and furniture suppliers across IG, FB, TikTok and YouTube. Production, design and video editing sit with the delivery team.

This role owns the account and the result. Everything that reaches a client's channel goes through this person: what gets made, what gets written, when it gets shot, and whether it performs.

The delivery team makes the work. The consultant owns the commercial relationship. The Account Manager is accountable for the work being right, landing on time, and growing the account organically. Delivery is the floor, not the measure.

Key responsibilities

Client strategy

Build the content strategy for each account with the consultant assigned to it

Take the commercial context from the consultant (what the client sells, who they want, what they have promised) and turn it into a content direction that delivers it

Set the account's organic objective with the consultant at the start of each cycle, and agree what success looks like

Bring performance data to the consultant so strategy changes are based on what happened, not on what the client asked for last

Flag when a client request will not serve the objective, and give the consultant an alternative to take back

The consultant owns the client relationship and the commercial conversation. The Account Manager owns what gets made and why.

Organic performance

Own the organic result on every assigned account: reach, engagement, page growth and enquiries

Decide what gets made based on what is performing, not on filling a calendar

Track performance weekly and change direction on evidence, not at month end

Identify formats that work on one account and carry them to others

Visual direction and alignment

Hold the visual standard on every account. Network works in a premium category and output must look considered, not templated

Keep each account visually coherent. A feed should read as one brand, not a run of unrelated posts

Reject work that meets the brief but misses the bar, and say why

Client posting and accountability

Own the posting schedule for every assigned account across all platforms

Publish or schedule all content to the agreed calendar

Review every asset before it goes live for typos, brand accuracy and strategic fit

Take responsibility for anything published in error, including retraction and client explanation

Copywriting

Write captions for all assigned accounts in the client's voice, not a house voice

Write hooks, on-creative text and CTAs supplied to the design and video teams

Adapt one concept into platform-appropriate copy across IG, FB, TikTok and YouTube

Maintain a written voice reference for each account so copy stays consistent

Creative deliverables

Plan the content calendar and pipeline for each account against the agreed monthly deliverable

Write briefs for the graphic and video teams that are complete enough to execute without follow-up

Track every deliverable from brief to published, and know its status without being asked

Run revision rounds with the delivery team and close them out

Shoot scheduling and coordination

Schedule production shoots with the client and the production team

Confirm site access, timing, homeowner permissions and scope before the shoot date

Brief the production team on what the shoot must produce

Chase and confirm footage handover after the shoot

Delivery team communication

Act as the single point of contact between clients and the graphic, video and production teams

Give the delivery team enough lead time to work; escalate capacity conflicts early

Keep the delivery team unblocked so they are never waiting on information

Client communication

Own client group chats as the day-to-day point of contact

Respond within working hours, with no dropped threads

Manage expectations on timelines and flag delays before the client notices them

Performance measures

Performance on this role is judged on organic outcomes, not activity.

Primary

Organic creative performance: reach, retention and engagement on published content against account baseline

Page growth: follower growth, saves and shares across assigned accounts

Organic enquiries: DMs, comments and leads generated through organic content

Visual direction: accounts hold a consistent, premium visual standard across the feed

Strategic alignment: what gets made maps to the account's growth objective

Baseline

On-time publishing rate across all assigned accounts

Errors reaching a live client channel (target: zero)

Deliverables completed against monthly contracted volume

Shoot dates held versus rescheduled

Delivery team blocked time attributable to missing briefs or information

Baseline measures are expectations. Missing them is a problem. Meeting them is not performance.

Requirements

Experience

1–2 years running social media accounts in a client-facing role

title: Digital Media Management Specialist , Entertainment
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Mediacorp is Singapore's largest content creator and national media network, operating a suite of TV channels, radio stations, and multiple digital platforms. Its mission is to engage, entertain, and enrich audiences by harnessing the power of creativity.

Thank you for your interest and application to this role. Please note that only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

RESPONSIBILITIES

This role has organisation-wide scope across entertainment content, covering the end-to-end management of digital media assets within the Production Asset Management ecosystem.

The role is responsible for metadata governance, AI-assisted tagging accuracy, taxonomy management, and the organisation of content to support efficient ingest, search, retrieval, reuse, localisation, and multiplatform distribution. It ensures that all media assets are consistently classified, rights-aware, and aligned with branding and data governance standards.

Working cross-functionally with Editorial, Production, Programming, Marketing, Digital, Technology, and Data Governance teams, the role supports the integration, adoption, and optimisation of asset management workflows, user practices, and system capabilities.

Candidates appointed to the role will also be cross-trained to support news-related workflows and operational requirements where needed.

While not responsible for content creation decisions, the role plays a critical enabling function by improving content discoverability, supporting compliance and rights visibility, enhancing AI-enabled workflows, and identifying opportunities for content reuse and operational efficiency across platforms.

Responsibilities:

Metadata and AI Tagging Management

Oversee the generation, review, and accuracy of metadata created by AI tools, including facial recognition, speech-to-text transcription, scene detection, object detection, logo recognition, speaker identification, talent identification, and location tagging

Develop and maintain metadata standards, taxonomies, genre classifications, keyword hierarchies, and tagging conventions aligned with entertainment content workflows

Ensure consistent tagging across drama, variety, lifestyle, reality, music, promotional, short-form, and archival assets to support accurate search and retrieval within the Production Asset Management system.

Maintain structured metadata for key entertainment attributes, including programme title, episode number, season, synopsis, cast, hosts, guests, locations, topics, themes, language, subtitles, ratings, rights windows, platform restrictions, embargoes, and promotional usage

Support improved content discoverability for internal users across production, editorial, programming, marketing, digital, social, distribution, and related teams

Workflow Integration and Asset Management

Manage the integration of the Production Asset Management system with entertainment production, post-production, promo, and publishing tools, including systems such as Adobe Premiere

Support efficient ingest, cataloguing, versioning, localisation, retrieval, reuse, archival, and publishing of entertainment media assets

Set up and maintain user roles, access rights, approval workflows, and asset permissions for production, editorial, programming, marketing, promo, digital, and technical teams

Ensure entertainment assets are properly organised for multiplatform use, including digital platforms, social media platforms, partner platforms, and commercial distribution

Work with stakeholders to streamline media handover processes from production, field teams and post-production into archival and publishing workflows

Quality Control, Rights, and Compliance

Perform regular quality checks on ingested video, audio, image, subtitle, caption, transcript, and promotional assets to ensure technical, branding, metadata, and compliance integrity

Oversee copyright management, talent rights, music rights, clip usage, third-party material, platform restrictions, embargoes, sponsorship obligations, and rights usage tracking

Ensure compliance with data privacy policies and content governance frameworks, particularly for facial recognition, audience footage, minors, and rights-managed material

Maintain adherence to archival, retention, backup, and preservation policies to protect the long-term value and integrity of entertainment content

Flag missing, inconsistent, outdated, duplicated, sensitive, embargoed, or incorrectly tagged assets and coordinate resolution with relevant teams

Training and User Support

Conduct training sessions and workshops for producers, promo teams, programming teams, marketers, and digital teams on AI-enabled search, tagging, metadata standards, and media retrieval

Develop user manuals, quick guides, workflow notes, and best practice documents for entertainment metadata management and AI-assisted asset workflows

Act as the primary point of contact for teams on asset-related issues, search and retrieval queries, metadata corrections, rights information, access permissions, and system feedback

Gather user feedback and work with Technology and Data Governance teams to improve system usability, tagging accuracy, workflow efficiency, and adoption across entertainment operations

Content Opportunity and Performance Monitoring

Monitor newly ingested and archived entertainment assets to identify content suitable for social media, promotional campaigns, digital features, highlights, compilations, recaps, or commercial reuse

Alert relevant content, marketing, digital, or social teams when there are strong opportunities to repurpose entertainment clips and assets

Monitor and report on system performance metrics, including tagging accuracy, ingest efficiency, search success rate, asset usage, storage utilisation, and metadata completeness

Propose workflow improvements based on user feedback, operational needs, emerging technologies, and evolving multiplatform content strategies

Support initiatives that improve content discoverability, archive value, entertainment content reuse, multiplatform publishing efficiency, and audience engagement

QUALIFICATIONS

Good understanding of entertainment content formats, including drama, variety, lifestyle, reality, music, short-form video, promos, interviews, and archival programming

Degree or Diploma in Media Management, Broadcast Technology, Mass Communication, Film, Television, Digital Media, Entertainment Management, or a related field

At least 3 years of experience in broadcast, entertainment, digital media, production asset management, post-production, content operations, or media archive management

Familiarity with Production Asset Management or Media Asset Management systems, preferably within a broadcast, entertainment, OTT, or post-production environment

Experience with media-related AI tools such as facial recognition, speech-to-text, scene detection, object detection, automated transcription, speaker identification, or metadata generation will be an advantage

Strong understanding of metadata standards, content taxonomy, SEO basics, digital discoverability, and multiplatform content workflows

Knowledge of rights management, talent rights, music usage, platform restrictions, data governance, and content security practices

Excellent communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with creative, production, technical, programming, marketing, and digital teams

Detail-oriented, organised, and comfortable managing large volumes of media assets and metadata in fast-paced environments

Experience working in entertainment production, post-production, programming, digital content, or media archive environments will be an advantage

Prepared to work irregular shift hours, weekends, and public holidays where operational needs require

Please note that your application will be sent to and reviewed by the direct employer - Mediacorp Pte. Ltd.

title: Marketing Director
description:

Identify new customer segments and opportunities for business growth.

Identify opportunities for exhibitions, demonstrations and promotional events.

Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate campaign performance and marketing ROI.

Trial class bookings

Customer acquisition cost

Marketing-generated revenue

Digital advertising performance and ROI

Website traffic and organic search growth

Social media reach and engagement

title: Social Media Account Manager
description:
Social Media Account ManagerThe Role Brief

We're Network, a Singapore media company that only does interior design marketing. 120+ ID firms on our books. We have a full creative team, a production team and consultants handling the commercial side, so you're not designing, editing or filming. You own the account. What gets made, what gets written, when it gets shot, and whether it grew. Every account you hold is judged on the organic result, not on how full the calendar looked.

Starting Salary: SGD 2,380 to 2,690 a month, Singapore based.

(Why the range? We pay based on skill. This is STARTING SALARY, and there are incentives to grow it.)

* Write the briefs. Complete enough that the creative team never comes back with questions.
* Schedule the shoots. Client and production team aligned so shoot days actually happen.
* Own the client groupchat. Fast replies, no dropped threads.
* Own the organic result. Reach, page growth, enquiries.
* Write the captions and hooks. In the client's voice, not a house voice.
* Platforms: IG, FB, TikTok, YT.

Language

You need to speak conversational Mandarin. A lot of our ID clients are more comfortable in Mandarin, and you'll be on calls and in groupchats with them.

All written content is in English. Captions, hooks, briefs, everything that goes out. You don't need to write in Mandarin, but your English writing needs to be good.

Working arrangement

Mainly remote. (90% of time)

Occasionally you'll have meetings with clients, and sometimes with celebrities or talent attached to a shoot, to align on what we're making. Some of those are over Google Meet, some are in person.

70/30

Every account has a consultant attached to it. The split is 70/30. You carry 70, which is why the title says Account Manager. They carry 30 on the commercial side.

They own the client relationship and the money conversation. You own the delivery and the result. When a client asks for something that won't work, you say so and give the consultant an alternative to take back.

What you get to work with

You'll have a full stack creative team behind you:

* Full stack UI/UX and backend developers
* Video editors
* Graphic designers
* Content strategists
* Performance marketers and lead gen media buyers

Plus team training, which is the part that matters most if you're serious about this.

Why this role, specifically

We're not looking for a competent account manager. We're looking for someone we can train.

You'll be taught organic and direct response marketing by people who do it every day, at volume, across 120+ accounts in one vertical. The goal is that you can execute and generate real ROI for a client, not just keep their feed looking busy. That skill is worth more than this salary, and it compounds.

Our delivery is our pride. Our fulfilment is our pride. If you want to take pride in your own work, this is the team to be around.

Pay: $2,380.00 - $2,690.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

Self-motivated, target-driven and able to work independently and in a team.

title: Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Assistant - Part-Time / Full-Time
description:
Part-Time: S$12.50–S$15/hour | Full-Time: S$2,500–S$3,500/month

Monday–Friday | On-site at 6 New Industrial Road, Singapore 536199

About the Role

NAMITEC is a Singapore automotive brand expanding into overseas markets, and we're looking for a proactive and organised person to help manage and grow our online marketing.

You'll help coordinate social media activities, engage influencers and content creators, and execute marketing ideas to grow our online presence and sales.

As we expand regionally, there may also be opportunities to travel, engage with overseas influencers and business partners, and support marketing activities in different markets.

We're a small, growing business, so we're looking for someone who takes initiative, enjoys working with people and can turn ideas into action.

Can you create engaging content or host livestreams? That's a big bonus, but not a requirement!

What You'll Do

Manage online marketing:

Organise NAMITEC's social media presence, coordinate content and ensure regular posting across our online channels.

Engage influencers and creators:

Identify potential collaborators, reach out to them and coordinate product collaborations and content deliverables.

Execute marketing ideas:

Support online promotions, suggest new ideas and work with management to bring approved campaigns to life.

Handle daily orders:

Pack online orders and prepare parcels for dispatch within marketplace deadlines. This is a smaller but essential part of the role, typically taking 30–60 minutes on normal days and longer during major promotions.

Who We're Looking For

Some experience in social media, digital marketing, content coordination or influencer engagement.

Organised, responsible and able to follow through on tasks without constant reminders.

Comfortable communicating with influencers, creators and customers.

Proactive and willing to suggest ideas, learn and try new things.

Comfortable with daily order packing and hands-on operational work.

Bonus skills:

Short-form video creation, basic video editing, Canva, livestreaming or appearing on camera.

A marketing qualification is not essential. We value practical experience, initiative and a willingness to learn.

Working Hours & Pay

Part-Time

Monday–Friday, 9am–3pm.

One-hour lunch break; five paid hours per day.

S$12.50–S$15 per hour, depending on experience.

Full-Time

Monday–Friday, 9am–6pm.

One-hour lunch break.

S$2,500–S$3,500 per month, depending on experience and capabilities.

About NAMITEC

NAMITEC is a Singapore automotive brand specialising in engine care and graphene-based automotive products. We're expanding beyond Singapore into overseas markets, building our presence through e-commerce, social media, influencer partnerships and international distribution.

Joining our team offers the opportunity to contribute directly to the growth of a developing brand, gain hands-on marketing experience and potentially participate in overseas marketing activities and collaborations as the business expands.

How to Apply

Please send us:

Your CV.

A short introduction about yourself.

Your availability and whether you're looking for part-time or full-time work.

Examples of social media accounts, content or campaigns you've worked on, if available.

We look forward to hearing from you!

NAMITEC is a Singapore-based company specialising in advanced engine oil additive solutions that enhance performance, efficiency, and protection for all types of engines. Proudly developed and produced locally, NAMITEC has grown from a homegrown brand into a regional player trusted by drivers, workshops, and distributors across the region and beyond.

We distribute and sell our products in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Australia, Philippines, Cambodia, and the United States, with continuous expansion into new markets. Our commitment is to deliver innovative, high-quality products that meet the demands of everyday drivers as well as motorsports professionals.

At NAMITEC, we are driven by a passion for technology, performance, and customer satisfaction. As we grow in Southeast Asia, we are building a dynamic team to join us on this journey of innovation and expansion.

title: CRM & Paid Campaigns Executive

Manage customer segmentation and develop targeted communications for different customer groups.

Support customer database growth and customer engagement initiatives.

Develop and execute lifecycle marketing campaigns across key customer stages, including:

1. Customer acquisition

2 . Welcome / onboarding

3. Customer engagement

4. Repeat purchase

5. Retention

6. Customer reactivation

Identify opportunities to improve customer engagement, repeat purchases and customer retention.

Monitor CRM campaign performance and recommend improvements.

Paid Digital Campaigns
