Manage audience targeting, campaign setup, budget allocation and ongoing optimisation.

Monitor campaign performance and make adjustments to improve campaign effectiveness and ROI.

Support paid campaigns for product launches, promotions, new store openings, events and key commercial periods.

Conduct testing of audiences, creative formats, messaging and campaign strategies.

Campaign Performance & Data Analysis

Monitor CRM and paid media performance against agreed KPIs.

Analyse campaign and customer data to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.

Prepare regular campaign performance reports and provide actionable insights and recommendations.

Track key performance indicators including engagement, conversion, customer acquisition, retention and ROI.

Use campaign data to support audience segmentation, targeting and budget allocation decisions.

Continuously review and optimise campaigns based on performance results.

E-Commerce & Digital Marketing

Work closely with the E-commerce and Marketing teams to align CRM and paid campaigns across digital channels.

Coordinate campaigns across email, SMS, social media, paid media and e-commerce platforms.

Support product launches, promotional campaigns and new store openings from a digital marketing perspective.

Ensure consistent campaign messaging and customer experience across different digital touchpoints.

Identify opportunities to improve customer engagement and conversion through digital channels.

Budget & ROI Management

Assist in managing paid media budgets across assigned brands and campaigns.

Monitor campaign spending against approved budgets.

Track campaign performance and return on investment.

Provide regular reporting on campaign spend, performance and ROI.

Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and maximise marketing spend.

Brand & Cross-Functional Support

Manage CRM and paid campaign requirements across SKIMS, Subdued, Alo, EDKITED and Olelar Brown.

Understand and adapt campaign strategies according to the positioning, target audience and commercial objectives of each brand.

Work closely with Brand Managers and the wider Marketing team to align campaign priorities.

Support the marketing requirements of additional or future brands introduced to the Company's portfolio.

Coordinate with external agencies, media partners and other vendors where required.

Digital Trends & Optimisation

Stay updated on CRM, digital marketing and paid media trends.

Keep up to date with platform developments, industry practices and changes in digital advertising.

Explore new platforms, tools, campaign formats and strategies to improve performance.

Recommend new approaches based on market trends, customer behaviour and campaign insights.

Other Responsibilities

Support other marketing and digital initiatives as assigned by the Marketing Manager.

Provide additional support during major campaign launches, store openings, events and peak business periods where required.

Undertake other duties reasonably assigned by the Company in line with the scope of the role.

Requirements

Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business, Communications or a related discipline.

2–4 years of relevant experience in CRM, digital marketing, paid media or a similar role.

Hands-on experience managing CRM and/or paid digital campaigns.

Experience with platforms such as Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads and Google Ads.

Experience in email marketing, SMS, loyalty programmes or customer lifecycle marketing.

Strong understanding of customer segmentation, acquisition, engagement and retention.

Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.

Comfortable working with campaign performance data and reporting.

Experience working with e-commerce teams or e-commerce platforms would be an advantage.

Strong project management and organisational skills.

Able to manage multiple campaigns, projects and brands simultaneously.

Good communication and stakeholder management skills.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT STYL SOLUTIONS

Ride on the wave of Industry 4.0! Join STYL Solutions in the forefront of using Fintech and IoT technologies for smart city/nation transformation. Headquartered in Singapore with R&D center in Vietnam, STYL Solutions designs, develops, and supplies hardware, software and integrated solutions for applications in payment, loyalty management, location tracking, self-service operation, telemetry.

Our market segment coverage extends from financial services, retail, mass transit, education to social services markets in Singapore and South Asia Pacific.

Our vision is to use Fintech and IoT to create smart and efficient cities that enhance Quality of Life through convenience and healthier living.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We are looking for an independent and creative Marketing Manager to join us in our growth journey. You will own the full spectrum of STYL Solutions' marketing communications (MarComm) and corporate communications (CorpComm) activities. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role spanning event marketing, content and campaign development, sales collateral, digital and social media, corporate website management, presentation branding, a physical product demo space, and internal communications. You will work closely with the Product, Sales and Management teams and, where required, external vendors and subcontractors, to plan, produce and measure marketing outcomes that support customer acquisition, brand consistency and employee engagement.

RESPONSIBILITIES

A. Marketing Communications (MarComm)

Trade Show & Event Marketing

Plan and coordinate STYL's participation in trade shows and industry events in Singapore and overseas, from booth concept to on-site execution.

Design the booth layout and develop event collateral (backdrop, banners, brochures) and event gifts, including sourcing quotations and managing vendors and job orders.

Develop pre-event promotional eDMs and email signature banners; set up lead-collection methods for the event team.

Consolidate post-event leads, produce a post-event report, coordinate lead nurturing with Sales, and publish post-event social media content.

Content & Inbound Marketing

Work with Product Owners and Sales to plan a campaign calendar (topics, audience, timing) promoting STYL's SaaS solutions.

Maintain and grow the leads database; develop and broadcast eDM campaigns with clear, customer-focused messaging and calls to action.

Track campaign performance (delivery, open and click-through rates, conversions) and hand qualified leads to Sales for follow-up.

Produce blogs, whitepapers, case studies and product videos, and distribute them across the website, social media and sales channels; report on content performance and lead generation.

Product & Solution Pitch Decks and Brochures

Review and refresh existing brochures and Product-team pitch decks for clarity, professionalism and consistent STYL branding.

Simplify technical content into customer-focused messaging and finalise materials for use by Product, Sales and Marketing.

Product Advertising & Campaigns

Plan and execute advertising and marketing campaigns with Product and Sales teams, from objective-setting through channel selection and content creation.

Launch campaigns across selected channels, track reach, engagement and leads, and report results with recommendations for future campaigns.

STYL Marketplace Marketing Support

Support the Marketplace team's campaigns for merchants and the parent/student community, including decal designs, artwork and supporting digital materials.

Ensure all Marketplace marketing materials follow STYL branding and track campaign performance where applicable.

B. Corporate Communications (CorpComm)

Internal Communications

Develop a company-wide internal communications plan covering CEO messages, Town Halls, product updates and newsletters.

Coordinate with Management and other teams to produce and distribute clear, consistent internal content through appropriate channels.

Corporate Website Management

Keep the STYL corporate website accurate, current and optimised for SEO; monitor traffic and page performance.

Publish company news, events and articles, and coordinate with internal teams or the website vendor on content, design and functionality updates.

Social Media Management

Develop and maintain a LinkedIn content calendar; create on-brand posts and visuals covering company activities, products and events.

Schedule and publish approved content, and monitor performance (impressions, engagement, follower growth) to continuously improve STYL's social presence across various platforms (i.e. LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook).

Presentation Templates & Branding

Standardise STYL's corporate PowerPoint templates — layout, fonts, colours and slide types — for consistent, professional use across teams.

Product & Solution Demo Space

Plan a dedicated demo space to showcase STYL's products, including layout, branding, signage and content requirements.

Prepare cost estimates and budget for management approval, and coordinate with vendors and subcontractors on installation, then test and finalise the space for customer visits.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Here at STYL Solutions, we value proactive ownership and require independence and hands-on involvement in our daily responsibilities. We seek entrepreneurial candidates with the following:

Experience

At least 3 years of relevant experience in marketing communications and/or corporate communications, ideally in a B2B technology, hardware or SaaS environment.

Demonstrated experience planning and executing trade shows or corporate events, from concept to post-event reporting.

Experience running digital and content marketing campaigns (eDM, webinars, social media, SEO) and managing a leads database.

Experience liaising with external vendors, printers, designers or subcontractors, including obtaining quotations and managing budgets, is an advantage.

Prior exposure to internal communications (newsletters, Town Halls, management messaging) is an advantage.

Education & Qualifications

Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Mass Communications, Business Administration or a related field.

Skills

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to translate technical product information into clear, customer-friendly messaging.

Working knowledge of digital marketing tools (eDM platforms, basic SEO, social media scheduling and analytics).

Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Word for presentation and collateral development; working knowledge of design tools (e.g. Canva, Adobe Creative Suite) or the ability to brief designers effectively.

Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel for tracking campaign metrics, budgets and reporting.

Project and vendor management skills, including budgeting, timeline management and coordination of multiple external suppliers.

Aptitudes & Personal Attributes

Highly organised self-starter, able to independently manage multiple concurrent work streams across events, content, digital and internal communications.

Strong stakeholder management skills, able to work closely with Product, Sales and Management to align marketing output with business needs.

Creative and detail-oriented, with sound judgement on brand consistency and messaging.

Comfortable working hands-on across both strategic planning and operational execution.

Adaptable and resourceful, comfortable operating with a lean or single-person marketing function.

What measures the success of the role

Event Execution & Lead Generation

: Successful planning and execution of trade shows and corporate events, resulting in qualified lead collection and timely post-event sales nurturing.

Digital Campaign & Content Performance

: Engagement levels, open/click-through rates, and lead conversions from eDM, social media, and website campaigns.

Brand Consistency & Collateral Quality

: Delivery of clear, standardized, and customer-focused product pitch decks, marketing collateral, and corporate presentation templates.

Website & Social Media Growth

: Up-to-date corporate website and steady growth in follower reach and engagement on the Company’s social media accounts.

Internal & Operational Delivery

: On-time execution of internal communication initiatives, demo space setup, and efficient vendor and budget management.

STYL SOLUTIONS PTE. LTD.

Established in 2008, STYL has grown significantly from a small startup into a leading trusted partner for Fintech IoT solutions with 100+ employees and market segment coverage extending from financial services, retail, mass transit, education to social services in Singapore and South Asia Pacific today.

Headquartered in Singapore with a dedicated R&D center in Vietnam, we provide end-to-end solutions from designing, developing, and supplying hardware to software integration for applications in payment, loyalty management, location tracking, self-service operation, environment management and telemetry. Our Mission is to infuse Fintech IoT to create smart and efficient cities that enhance Quality of Life for all through convenience and healthier living.

As we continue and bring our mission journey globally, we give thanks to our dedicated People who contribute to our continuous success. Hence, we strive to provide opportunities for employees to learn, grow and thrive yet maintain a well-balance lifestyle. With our lean and open organization culture, we believe that trusting work relationships will be built and our People can continue to drive creativity, innovation, and excellence with confidence.

Join us now if you are interested to be part of the creation of smarter and more efficient cities through our solutions!

title: Marketing Executive, Shiseido

Partner with retailers and vendors to ensure timely installation and execution of VM initiatives

Product Marketing Support

Coordinate launch materials, non-saleable products, product information and retail merchandising requirements

Track launch performance and gather retail feedback to identity opportunities for improvement

Track and manage promotional investments, including rebates, vouchers, and marketing support by channel and retailer, ensuring spending remains within approved budgets

Support POSM forecasting, allocation, and utilization to maximize impact while maintaining cost efficiency and minimizing wastage

Monitor and analyse retail campaign performance, promotional effectiveness and ROI

Track competitor activities, market trends and retail best practices

Prepare post-campaign report and provide recommendations to improve future activations

Minimum 1 year of relevant experience; retail marketing, trade marketing, brand marketing

Experience in beauty, luxury, FMCG, retail, or consumer industries preferred

Exposure to product launches, retail activations, promotions, and visual merchandising execution

Experience working with retailers, external agencies, and cross-functional stakeholders

Familiarity with omnichannel marketing and retail operations is advantageous

Commercially driven with a strong understanding of retail dynamics

Highly organized with excellent execution capabilities

Collaborative team player who works effectively across functions and retail partners

Proactive and solution-oriented with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

A key responsibility is to ensure that marketing, advertising, recruitment and website communications are accurate, current and compliant with applicable Skills and Workforce Development Agency (SWDA) requirements, EduTrust Guidance Document 4 (GD4), PEI marketing and advertising requirements, and the institution’sinternal policies and approval processes.

1.Agent Management & Engagement

Manage day-to-day communications and relationships with local and overseas education agents and recruitment partners.

Keep abreast of changes to SWDA, EduTrust GD4 and applicable PEI marketing and advertising requirements, and implement necessary updates to marketing practices.

Identify and promptly escalate potentially inaccurate, misleading or non-compliant marketing or recruitment content to management before publication or distribution.

3.Marketing, Website & Content Operations

Design and maintain the institution’s website through its Content Management System (CMS), including creating and updating webpages, landing pages, programme information, fees, admissions information, images, banners and other content.

Ensure website content is accurate, current and aligned with applicable SWDA, EduTrust GD4, PEI marketing/advertising and internal approval requirements.

Conduct regular website reviews and coordinate the correction or removal of outdated, inaccurate or potentially non-compliant information.

Monitor website functionality and coordinate with external developers or vendors for complex technical development or troubleshooting where required.

Apply basic SEO and web analytics practices to improve website visibility, user experience and recruitment effectiveness.

Develop, edit, translate and proofread institutional and programme-related marketing content in English and Chinese across websites, digital platforms and other communication channels.

Design and produce digital and print marketing materials, including brochures, advertisements, social media content, presentations, website graphics, banners and recruitment collateral.

Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Media, Public Relations or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

Strong proficiency in spoken and written English and Chinese is required, as the role involves independently developing, editing, translating and proofreading marketing and website content in both languages and communicating regularly with English- and Chinese-speaking education agents, prospective students and stakeholders.

Hands-on experience managing and maintaining websites using a Content Management System (CMS) such as WordPress or equivalent, including webpage creation, content updates and basic website administration.

Working knowledge of Singapore’s PEI regulatory environment, including EduTrust GD4, applicable SWDA requirements and PEI marketing/advertising requirements, is preferred. The candidate must be able to understand, apply and keep abreast of requirements relevant to marketing, recruitment communications and website content.

Strong attention to detail, with the ability to review marketing, website and recruitment materials for factual accuracy, consistency and potential compliance issues.

Strong organisational, stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, content updates and deadlines independently.

Able to follow institutional approval processes and appropriately escalate matters requiring management or regulatory clarification.

title: Head of Marketing and Communications (Singapore and Indonesia)
description:
About The Role

Lead marketing and communications for CBRE across Singapore and Indonesia, and position the company as the pre-eminent real estate thought leader in both markets. Using earned and owned media, digital and social channels, events and research-led content, you will build share of voice and turn CBRE’s market intelligence into commercial advantage.

Armed with strong media relationships, you will identify opportunities to profile subject matter experts and work closely with them to deliver differentiated points of view on the real estate industry. You will lead a team of five to eight marketing and communications professionals, own the country marketing budget, and act as a trusted adviser to country and business line leadership.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role in a matrix environment. You will set strategy and stay close enough to the work to deliver it.

What You’ll Do

Strategy and business partnering

‒ Develop and deliver an integrated, ROI-focused marketing and communications strategy across Singapore and Indonesia, covering public relations, digital and social, events, internal communications and brand.

‒ Partner country leadership and business line leaders so that marketing and communications operates as a business enabler rather than a service desk.

‒ Own and manage the country marketing budget, with clear reporting of spend against outcomes.

‒ Set the measurement standard for the function, covering share of voice, campaign performance, event contribution to pipeline and digital engagement, and report against it to leadership each quarter.

‒ Contribute to regional marketing and communications initiatives and project roll-outs across Asia Pacific.

Public relations and media

‒ Act as the key media liaison in Singapore and Indonesia, identifying and pitching stories and securing profiling opportunities for business leaders.

‒ Develop compelling messages, media releases, media responses, byline articles and speeches for senior management.

‒ Build and maintain relationships with tier-one business, property and trade media across both markets.

‒ Manage PR agency partners, including scope, performance, deliverables and budget.

‒ Support regional and global teams on issues and crisis communications, preparing local statements, briefing spokespeople and managing local media response, escalating in line with CBRE protocol.

‒ Maintain spokesperson briefing materials and question-and-answer documents, and arrange media training for senior leaders.

Events and industry engagement

‒ Own the events strategy end to end, from flagship client events and research launches to executive roundtables, industry sponsorships and internal town halls.

‒ Manage event budgets, venue and vendor selection, run of show, speaker preparation and post-event follow-up, with clear measurement of commercial return.

‒ Develop an influencer and industry body engagement strategy, including CBRE’s presence and speaking platforms at key industry events in both markets.

Content, research marketing and digital

‒ Work with CBRE Research to turn market intelligence into campaign-ready content and to build launch moments around flagship reports.

‒ Drive lead generation through social and digital channels, working with regional digital teams on campaign build, targeting, marketing technology and reporting.

‒ Act as brand custodian for both markets, maintaining CBRE brand standards across every piece of external and internal output.

‒ Support business development and pursuit teams with marketing collateral and credentials for major client bids.

Internal communications and employer brand

‒ Drive internal communications for employee engagement, change communications and leadership visibility.

‒ Strengthen CBRE’s employer brand in partnership with the People team, supporting recruitment and retention priorities.

Team leadership

‒ Lead, coach and develop a team of five to eight professionals across PR, digital, events and internal communications.

‒ Set objectives, manage performance and build capability and succession within the team.

‒ Provide direction and quality control across all local marketing initiatives and campaigns.

What You’ll Need

Experience: essential

‒ Degree holder with 12 to 14 years’ experience in marketing and communications.

‒ Within that, a minimum of three to four years leading public relations and events at a senior level, with direct accountability for media strategy and for flagship event delivery.

‒ Experience gained in a multinational or large listed organisation with multiple stakeholders, matrix reporting and regional or global reporting lines. This is a requirement, not a preference.

‒ Proven record of managing PR and event agencies, including briefing, performance management and budget control.

‒ Demonstrated ownership of a marketing budget, with the ability to report return on that spend.

‒ People leadership experience, having managed a team of five or more.

‒ Established media relationships in Singapore, with proven ability to secure tier-one coverage.

Experience: advantageous

‒ Indonesia market exposure, or a demonstrated track record of building media relationships in a new market.

‒ Real estate, professional services, financial services or agency background.

‒ Experience supporting issues or crisis communications within an established corporate protocol.

‒ Bahasa Indonesia or Mandarin in addition to strong written and spoken English in view of the in-country market communications.

Skills and attributes

‒ Proven expertise in social and digital marketing, including campaign measurement and marketing technology platforms.

‒ Credible with senior stakeholders, and comfortable advising and constructively challenging country and business line leadership.

‒ Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a dynamic environment with competing priorities.

‒ A positive, can-do attitude and readiness to roll up the sleeves and get the job done.

‒ Willingness to travel between Singapore and Indonesia as the role requires.

Why CBRE

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

Applicant AI Use Disclosure

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

OUR VALUES IN HIRING

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

Creative, proactive and highly organised.

title: Creative Director (Brand & Social)
description:
Location: Singapore / or remote across APAC (+/- 2hrs from SG)
Engagement: 12-month fixed-term contract
Format: Hybrid or remote, depending on your location
Travel: Regional travel required

About the Project

We’re looking for a Creative Director, Brand & Social to become the social-first creative partner within an embedded APAC team for a leading global hospitality brand.

This is not a traditional campaign Creative Director role. You’ll turn cultural signals, audience insight and everyday travel behaviour into visual stories and social-first content that make people stop, feel something and recognise themselves in the brand. You’ll live close to social culture, spotting emerging behaviours, humour and creative references before they become marketing trends. The work should feel boldly human, visually beautiful, culturally sharp and genuinely relatable.

You’ll bring a clear creative point of view, while working collaboratively with the client and Integrated Strategy Director to shape ideas quickly and take them into market. Strong producer instincts matter: there will not always be a large production house behind you. Success means creating a living portfolio of brand content that feels native to social, culturally relevant and premium – with enough craft to build the brand and enough agility to keep it current.

About the Role

Social-First Creative Direction

Turn culture, audience insight and travel behaviour into social-first creative ideas.
Stay close to the most interesting social content, formats and behaviours shaping culture.
Find unexpected ways to place the brand within the story rather than making the brand the story.
Create work that feels premium and distinctive without becoming overly polished, gimmicky or trend-led.
Use humour and relatability with intelligence and restraint.

Storytelling & Content

Build stories around relatable human moments and the emotional side of travel.
Develop social films, short-form video, creator-led storytelling, visual comedy and culturally responsive content.
Create a living portfolio of always-on content, destination storytelling and regional moments
Tell stories visually, not just through messaging.
Ensure content feels native to the platform and market it appears in.

Creator, Influencer & Regional Creative

Shape creative ideas for creator and influencer content while allowing creators to retain their own voice.
Develop ideas that can flex across priority APAC markets without losing the central creative thought.
Bring fresh references from lifestyle, fashion, beauty, sport, entertainment and culture.
Help regional teams translate strong central ideas into locally relevant content.

Hands-on Creative & Production

Take ideas from concept through to market-ready execution.
Work directly with writers, designers, creators, producers and specialist makers.
Move quickly from idea to prototype to production.
Know when an idea needs full production and when it can be made more simply and intelligently.
Maintain strong craft standards while recognising that polish cannot substitute for relevance.
Use AI and emerging creative tools where they improve speed, quality or creative possibility.

About You

You bring 10+ years of experience in creative direction, social-first content strategy, brand storytelling, art direction, copywriting or integrated creative and senior stakeholder upselling experience.
You have a portfolio demonstrating strong ideas and beautifully executed work across multiple formats, most importantly, across social.
You understand the difference between producing content and building a story that creates brand memory and commercial impact.
You have strong experience across social, content, creators/influencers and static/video production.
You can take a strategic direction and translate it into emotionally relatable creative.
You understand how global brand platforms can be regionalised and localised without losing consistency.
You are confident presenting and selling ideas directly to senior clients.
You enjoy working closely with strategists and can move easily between strategy, creative development and production.
Experience within fashion, sport, luxury, beauty, lifestyle, entertainment or premium consumer brands would be particularly interesting.
Hospitality experience is not required. We actively welcome people who can bring a different creative perspective to the category.

Please Note

Due to the high volume of applications, we unfortunately can’t get back to everyone, and only successful applicants will be contacted. When you share your details with us, we consider this as consent for us to use your data during the application process. We may implement AI in various stages of the recruitment process, but human involvement will always remain as part of our hiring ethos. At the moment, MASH is not in a position to sponsor work visas, so you have to be eligible to legally work in the country where we’re hiring.

Good written and verbal communication skills.

Strong interpersonal and organisational skills.

Able to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Attention to detail and willingness to learn.

Familiarity with Microsoft Office applications.

Experience with content creation, design, photography, videography, or digital media tools would be an advantage.

The Humble Beginning

Cheng Hong Welfare Service Society has come a long way since its humble beginnings.

Cheng Hong Welfare started as the welfare arm of Cheng Hong Slang Tng (Charitable Organisation) in 2004 and till today, Cheng Hong Slang Tng has been generously support us operationally and financially.

Cheng Hong Welfare Society has abided by the highest standard of Governance and Transparency and has been granted Institution of Public Character (i.e. tax-exempt) status by the Commissioner of Charities. We are also a full member of National Council of Social Service (NCSS).

The Journey

For the past 12 years, our Management Committee members, dedicated staff and most importantly, our generous donors, supporters and big hearted volunteers have worked hard to help build this organization.

Cheng Hong Welfare Service Society has slowly grown stronger and gathering more resources to make a bigger impact on the community we are serving.

Out TCM Medical Services provide Pro Bono TCM treatment and free medications to the disadvantaged and elderly. It started with a humble clinic in Cheng Hong Siang Tng. With the support of generous donors working together with government agencies and partners, it has expanded to include a Medical Centre and six TCM Clinics island-wide.

In additions, it also offered other charitable services like provide food ration, education grants, visits to homes, bring elderly for tours etc.

The New Service

In October 2012, with the generous support of friends and donors, Cheng Hong Welfare Service Society has established a fund and setup an afterlife memorial service. This service provides free columbarium service to those who requires service, regardless of race and religion.

We have been working hard to raise awareness through television and radio with the help of MediaCorp as well as on the ground to elderly homes and care centres with the help of Emperor Entertainment Production Co’s artiste. We are developing this service with pre-registration of funeral arrangement. What the Charity has done in the last twelve years, is serve the communities in need and to make Singapore better place where nobody is left behind.

title: Strategic Communications Executive
description:
About the role

The Strategic Comms Executive will plan and deliver communications that build Jamiyah Singapore's reputation, deepen stakeholder trust and advance the work of its Business Units. Reporting to the Head, Strategic Communications, the role works closely with Business Unit heads to turn organisational priorities into clear messages, integrated campaigns and compelling content, across owned, earned and partner channels. The aim is greater awareness and credibility, stronger relationships with the community, donors and partners, and support for programme and revenue growth.

Key responsibilities

Develop and implement integrated communications plans and campaigns for each Business Unit, aligned with Jamiyah's mission, brand and strategic priorities.

Partner with Business Unit heads to understand their goals, target audiences and funding or revenue needs, and translate these into key messages, channel plans and timelines.

Conduct audience research, media and sentiment monitoring, and benchmarking against peer organisations to guide communications decisions.

Write, edit and produce high-quality content, including press releases, articles, newsletters, web copy, social media posts, EDMs and annual report material.

Manage the content calendar and day-to-day publishing across digital channels (social media, website, EDMs) and oversee print and event collateral.

Support media relations by drafting media releases and statements, responding to media enquiries, and building relationships with journalists and media outlets.

Develop communications for corporate, donor and community partners, including sponsorship collateral, proposals, pitch materials and impact stories.

Plan and coordinate communications for events, programmes and fundraising drives, before, during and after delivery.

Keep messaging, tone and visual identity consistent across all Business Units, in line with Jamiyah's brand guidelines.

Support issues and crisis communications in coordination with management, including holding statements, Q&As and escalation, with appropriate cultural, religious and community sensitivity.

About you

Degree in Business Development, Communications, Mass Communication, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing or a related field.

1-3 years of relevant experience in corporate or strategic communications, public relations, content or marketing communications; fresh graduates with strong internships may be considered.

Excellent writing, editing and storytelling skills in English; the ability to adapt tone for different audiences and channels.

Sound knowledge of strategic communications, messaging, media relations, stakeholder engagement and brand management.

Experience in communications planning, campaign management and performance measurement.

Proficiency in digital tools (social media management, Google Analytics, EDM platforms, CMS).

Good project management, organisational and budgeting skills.

Able to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Articulate, creative, analytical and results-oriented, with sound judgement and attention to detail.

Collaborative, with the ability to work across different Business Units, and discreet in handling sensitive information.

About us

Jamiyah Singapore's vision is serving the community, caring for all. The mission is to work and contribute towards the welfare and development of the community and mankind.

Jamiyah Singapore, also known as Muslim Missionary Society Singapore, was founded in 1932 by the Roving Ambassador of Peace from Meerut (India), Moulana Abdul Aleem Siddique. Continuing Moulana’s legacy, vision and mission is to serve the community and to provide welfare services to the less privileged and disadvantaged of all races and faiths.

title: Marketing Executive - Immediate

description:
NLCS (Singapore) believes that each employee makes a significant contribution to our success and that contributions should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities.

Therefore, this position description is designed to outline primary duties, qualifications, and job scope, but not limit the employee, nor NLCS (Singapore), to only the work identified. Our School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. The School expects all teaching staff, non‐teaching staff and volunteers to share and uphold this commitment.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

The Marketing Executive will take ownership of the day-to-day delivery of the School’s marketing activities across campaigns, content, digital, events, partnerships and communications.

Working within the School’s agreed marketing strategy, the role is expected to be proactive, bring forward ideas and opportunities, lead projects through to completion and ensure marketing activity is delivered accurately, consistently and on time.

The role requires someone who can think beyond execution, understand the purpose behind each initiative and recommend practical ways to strengthen the School’s visibility, engagement and admissions objectives.

Main Responsibilities:

1. Campaigns & Marketing Delivery

Lead the day-to-day delivery of agreed marketing campaigns and initiatives.

Proactively propose campaign ideas, themes, content opportunities and improvements.

Develop first drafts of campaign messaging, concepts and supporting content for review.

Own campaign timelines, actions, approvals and follow-ups through to completion.

2. Content, PR & Communications

Develop content for social media, emailers, website, PR, third-party deliverables and marketing materials.

Develop and maintain a regular pipeline of blogs, thought leadership articles, school stories and long-form website content aligned with marketing and admissions priorities.

Proactively identify student, staff, academic, enrichment and community stories.

Develop story angles and content ideas that strengthen the School’s positioning and reputation.

Gather information from academic and non-academic teams and turn it into engaging marketing content.

Support PR opportunities by preparing content, background information, imagery and other required materials.

Identify content opportunities that strengthen the School’s authority and discoverability across SEO, GEO and AEO.

Maintain a forward content pipeline aligned with School marketing and admissions priorities.

3. Digital Presence, Social Media & Website

Own and manage the monthly social media and digital content calendar.

Lead day-to-day social media publishing and content scheduling.

Identify and implement opportunities to improve reach, engagement and content performance.

Monitor comments, messages and online engagement, escalating sensitive matters where appropriate.

Keep website content, imagery, event information and downloadable materials accurate and current.

Identify areas of the website requiring updates or improvements and take them forward with the relevant teams.

Support the continuous development of the School’s digital presence through SEO, GEO and AEO, including website content, blogs, FAQs, landing pages and other relevant content.

Identify and recommend content and website improvements based on search behaviour, emerging queries and marketing priorities.

Work with relevant internal and external teams to ensure content is structured and optimised for traditional search engines and AI-led discovery platforms.

Monitor organic visibility, website engagement and content performance and recommend areas for improvement.

4. Events & Community Marketing

Own the marketing requirements for admissions events, Open Houses, education fairs, community activities and outreach initiatives.

Develop event promotion plans and ensure digital, creative, signage, collateral and content requirements are delivered on time.

Review and maintain the Marketing Events Calendar and plan marketing activity sufficiently in advance.

Support live content and social media coverage at key events.

Identify content opportunities from events for future marketing use.

5. Brand, Collateral & Multimedia

Ensure approved brand guidelines are consistently followed across marketing materials and touchpoints.

Lead the development and production of routine marketing and event collateral.

Review materials for accuracy, consistency and quality before production or publication.

Identify photography and videography requirements for campaigns and key School events.

Brief and manage routine requirements with photographers, videographers, designers and production suppliers as required.

Maintain an organised and current library of photography, video and marketing assets.

Ensure appropriate student photography, filming permissions and safeguarding requirements are followed.

6. Partnerships, Listings & Marketing Opportunities

Research and recommend relevant third-party platforms, editorial listings, directories, partnerships and marketing opportunities for annual engagement.

Identify opportunities that support SEO, GEO and AEO visibility, brand awareness and lead generation.

Maintain and regularly review School profiles across education portals, directories and external listings.

Support delivery of agreed marketing requirements for partnerships and external collaborations.

Ensure partner branding and marketing assets remain consistent with School guidelines.

Monitor agreed third-party deliverables and ensure required content and assets are supplied within deadlines.

7. Reporting, Suppliers & Marketing Operations

Prepare quarterly marketing reports covering campaigns, social media, website activity, digital visibility and other agreed performance metrics, working with relevant team members to consolidate inputs.

Maintain and develop trackers and reports for management review, internal planning and marketing strategy alignment.

Maintain accurate marketing trackers, calendars and project records.

Obtain supplier quotations and manage routine production requirements within approved parameters.

Track supplier deliverables, timelines and quality, escalating issues where required.

Maintain records of marketing expenditure, purchase requests, invoices and associated documentation.

Maintain appropriate stock levels of marketing collateral, branded materials and event assets.

8. Cross-Departmental Working & Ownership

Build strong working relationships with Admissions, Academic Teams, Events, Partnerships and Business Development, Parent Engagement, Finance and other School departments.

Take ownership of agreed marketing requests and ensure they are followed through to completion.

Manage competing deadlines and escalate priorities where appropriate.

Proactively identify opportunities across School activities that could support marketing, reputation or admissions objectives.

Bring forward ideas and recommendations rather than relying solely on assigned tasks.

Contribute actively to marketing planning discussions and team initiatives.

Safeguarding:

Abide by the school safeguarding policy and keep abreast of any changes.

Ensure appropriate safeguarding, consent and privacy requirements are followed in relation to student photography, filming and marketing content.

Ad Hoc:

Undertake other reasonable responsibilities and provide additional support as required in line with the evolving business needs of the AMC Department.

About Fei Fah Medical Manufacturing

For over 75 years,

Fei Fah

has helped people live healthier lives through trusted wellness solutions — from the Electric Medibalm born in our original Chinatown drugstore in 1950, to modern innovations like our 1000-day fermented True Zen Sleep Enzyme. Today, we're building on that heritage by blending timeless values with digital innovation, growing our brands across eCommerce, social, and new markets.

We’re looking for a proven on-camera talent to become the lead face and voice of a beloved Singaporean brand as it finds its modern voice on camera.

The Role

This is a new, exploratory role, and you’ll help build it from the ground up.

Your main job is to

lead and host livestreams

that build awareness of our products and consistently turn viewers into customers. Your second job is to

create social media content

that does the same. You’ll bring your own playbook, test and refine it, and help us define what a winning livestream and content approach looks like for Fei Fah, including high-visibility sessions as we expand into new channels.

This is a hands-on role for someone with a track record of hosting and selling live, who takes ownership of results and sets the standard for the people around them.

Key Responsibilities

Livestreaming

(primary focus)

• Host and lead livestream selling sessions on TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada, Instagram, Facebook and other emerging platforms

• Present our wellness products with confidence, credibility and conversion in mind

• Engage viewers in real time, handle questions and objections, and drive sales through vouchers, bundles and flash deals

• Plan the livestream schedule, themes, formats and run-sheets, aligned with mega-sale events (e.g. 9.9, 11.11, 12.12)

• Take ownership of livestream performance targets (viewers, engagement, conversion, sales) and report with concise insights and recommendations

• Experiment with new formats, timings, platforms and co-host or guest-host arrangements

• Coordinate with operations and the marketing team so stock, pricing, promotions and equipment are ready before going live

• Coach and support junior hosts and co-hosts where needed

Social Media Content

(secondary focus)

• Create and star in short-form videos, Reels and other content for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Rednote and other channels that build awareness and drive sales

• Develop content ideas and series that turn attention into store traffic and sales

• Repurpose livestream highlights into clips and content

• Use AI tools wherever they help you ideate, produce and edit faster

• Work closely with our designer and content team, giving clear briefs and constructive feedback

Compliance

• Ensure everything you say and show, on live and in content, complies with platform policies and applicable local health product regulations (we’ll train you on what you can and can’t claim)

Who We’re Looking For

• 2-3+ years of experience in livestream hosting, live selling, or on-camera content with a track record of driving engagement or sales

• Strong on-camera presence: confident, expressive and natural, able to carry long sessions

• Ability to think quickly and handle live comments, objections and the unexpected with ease

• Experience with TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada or similar live selling platforms

• Comfortable with data, and confident turning numbers into actions

• Good sense of social media trends, and curious about AI tools

• Organised, accountable and able to work independently

• Experience in FMCG, health or wellness is an advantage

• Proficient in English and Mandarin to effectively communicate with English and Mandarin-speaking clients.

Essential Qualities

• Accountable and results-driven

• Passionate difference maker

• Proactive and loves to learn

• Experimental, with a test-and-learn mindset

• Attention to detail

What We Offer

•

An attractive compensation package which could be structured on base pay plus lucrative commission on sales

, depending on experience and the arrangement that suits you

•

Flexible engagement:

permanent, freelance, full-time or part-time, including evening and night sessions

•

Flexible location:

livestream from our office, from your own home, or from another suitable place you’d like

• Full product training

• Opportunity to be the lead on-screen personality of a heritage Singaporean wellness brand

•

Opportunity to go on board Genting Cruise

for livestreaming with us

• Room to shape our livestream playbook and grow into a team lead as operations expand

How to Apply

Send us your resume together with your TikTok or Instagram profile and

links to previous livestream replays or on-camera work

, ideally with any results you can share (viewers, engagement, sales).

title: SOCIAL MEDIA & CONTENT MARKETING MANAGER
description:
BMG Hospitality is building a hospitality ecosystem combining hotels, restaurants, social experiences and community-driven marketing.

We are looking for a

hands-on Social Media & Content Marketing Manager

who can turn everyday hospitality experiences into engaging content that people want to watch, share and visit.

This is not a role where you simply schedule posts.

We want someone who can

think, shoot, design, edit, publish, experiment and teach others how to create content.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

You will manage and create content across:

• Instagram

• TikTok

• Facebook

• LinkedIn

• YouTube

You will work closely with the BMG Hospitality, Gabriel Restaurant and Capsule Social Modern teams to build a consistent and recognisable brand presence.

CONTENT CREATION

You should be comfortable producing:

🎥 Short-form videos and Reels

🎥 TikTok videos

🎥 30–60 second animated videos

🎥 Restaurant food and lifestyle videos

🎥 Hotel and guest-experience content

🎥 Interviews and customer stories

🎥 Behind-the-scenes content

🎥 Promotional campaigns

🎥 Longer-form YouTube videos

🎨 Graphics, posters and digital advertisements

📸 Photography and photo editing

✍️ Captions, storytelling and social-media copy

You should also be able to create

YouTube-style brand and storytelling videos similar in concept and production quality to reference videos provided by BMG

, and repurpose longer videos into multiple short-form pieces for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook and YouTube Shorts.

A VERY IMPORTANT PART OF THE ROLE

We do not want content creation to depend on only one person.

You will be expected to

teach and coach our Front Desk, Guest Experience and Restaurant Crew

to create simple, engaging content themselves.

Our objective is for staff members to eventually be capable of producing a

60-second animated or edited social-media video

, using AI and modern content-creation tools.

You will create simple templates, workflows and training so that the operating team can capture moments happening inside our hotels and restaurants every day.

YOU SHOULD BE FAMILIAR WITH

• CapCut / Adobe Premiere Pro or similar

• Canva / Adobe Creative Suite

• AI video and image-generation tools

• AI-assisted content creation

• TikTok and Instagram Reels editing

• YouTube production

• Graphic design

• Photography and videography

• Social-media analytics

• Content calendars

• Meta Business Suite

• LinkedIn content

• TikTok trends and formats

Knowledge of tools such as

ChatGPT, Claude and other AI creative platforms

will be highly advantageous.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We want someone who is:

✔ Creative but commercially minded

✔ Comfortable appearing behind or occasionally in front of the camera

✔ Able to work independently and as part of a hospitality team

✔ Fast at turning ideas into actual content

✔ Comfortable working with restaurant and hotel operational teams

✔ Able to teach non-marketing staff how to create content

✔ Interested in AI-assisted content production

✔ Able to understand what makes people stop scrolling

✔ Focused on generating engagement, footfall, bookings and revenue — not merely followers

YOUR SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED BY

The quality and consistency of content produced, audience growth and engagement, restaurant traffic and hotel enquiries generated through social media, video performance, development of reusable content formats, and the ability to turn our operational team into a wider network of content creators.

BMG Hospitality Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based hospitality and lifestyle company building a technology-enabled ecosystem across accommodation, food & beverage, talent, education, community, digital marketing and media.

Our core hospitality concept, Capsule Modern, focuses on modern, well-designed and affordable accommodation for the next generation of travellers. We aim to combine efficient hotel operations, strong guest experiences, social interaction and technology to create a scalable hospitality platform. Our target guests include independent travellers, digital natives and younger international visitors seeking convenient locations, quality facilities, value and community experiences.

Alongside our hotels, BMG Hospitality is developing Gabriel Restaurants to support both hotel guests and external customers. The restaurant platform is designed to complement hotel operations through breakfast services, food and beverage offerings and social experiences while developing its own standalone revenue streams.

BMG operates with an asset-light approach, focusing primarily on leasing and converting suitable properties rather than purchasing real estate. Standardised operating procedures, technology, centralised management and disciplined project execution are intended to allow new properties to be developed and launched efficiently.

Technology and artificial intelligence form an important part of BMG's operating philosophy. We are building a cloud-based management environment covering hotel operations, revenue management, reservations, customer relationship management, finance, HR, recruitment, project management, marketing, social media, reporting and management dashboards. Our managers are expected to use AI as a practical working tool to improve productivity, decision-making, communication and reporting.

Beyond hotels and restaurants, BMG is developing an ecosystem that includes talent recruitment and development, BMG Academy, affiliate marketing, community programmes and digital media. Direct exposure to founders, engineers, planners and enterprise customers.

The opportunity to shape UnlockLand’s public image and content direction.

UNLOCKLAND is a Singapore-headquartered, AI-native software company building a decision platform for real estate development.

About the Role:

The Communications & Marketing Executive plays a vital role in promoting Practice and its programmes, as well as advocating for the value and importance of Singapore theatre by crafting compelling marketing campaigns and fostering strategic partnerships. Reporting to the managers/lead of the department, you'll work closely with internal and external stakeholders to achieve our organisational goals and objectives, ensuring the success of our diverse programmes and initiatives.

Provide administrative support to team members as needed.

Who You Are:

You are passionate about theatre and the performing arts.

You possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

You have strong organisational and time management skills.

You are creative, resourceful, and a team player.

Experience in marketing, communications, or a related field is an advantage.

Proficiency in social media platforms and digital marketing tools is preferred.

Comfortable working across English and Chinese communications, including reviewing bilingual marketing materials.

The Theatre Practice (Practice) is Singapore’s longest-standing professional bilingual theatre institution. Artist-driven and deeply progressive, Practice strives to be an arts space in Singapore that consciously nurtures and empowers people who care about humanity. Over the past 61 years, we have developed and presented works that aim to reflect the richness and complexities of Singapore’s diverse cultures.

Today, we carry on the work of our visionary co-founders and cultural medallion recipients, Kuo Pao Kun and Goh Lay Kuan. Under the helm of current Artistic Director Kuo Jian Hong, Practice continues to shape Singapore’s cultural landscape as the definitive voice in Singapore theatre. Jian Hong is deeply influenced by the importance of play in art-making and under her leadership, Practice has become the embodiment of the irrepressible spirit and fearless experimentation of play.

Practice is motivated by a desire to always respectfully entertain. We have collaborated with Singapore and international artists alike to present a critically-acclaimed repertoire of over 330 productions including musicals, classics, original and experimental works. We have toured extensively in the region. Many of our works have entered the canon of Southeast Asian literature and have been adapted and presented by theatre companies worldwide, presenting an authentically Singaporean voice on the world stage.

Since our inception, Practice has served as a cultural bridge between Asia and the world. Our current theatre festival – M1 Patch! A Theatre Festival of Artful Play – comes from a legacy of carefully curated festivals and seminars that gather practitioners of all disciplines and cultures for sharing and exchange, while providing a valuable platform for outstanding international works.

As pioneers in Arts Education in Singapore, Practice has been instrumental both in nurturing leaders in the Singapore arts scene, and inculcating a love for the arts in generations of Singapore youth.

Artistically diverse and constantly relevant, Practice will always engage with the ceaseless exploration of new frontiers.

The Theatre Practice is an Institution of Public Character, a recipient of the National Arts Council’s Major Grant 2017-2020, and a member of the Singapore Chinese Language Theatre Alliance.

title: Director of Marketing, APAC
description:
About the role

As the Director of Marketing, APAC, you'll drive full funnel marketing initiatives, brand awareness and commercial impact.

In this role, you’ll own the marketing strategy and execution across our growing Asia-Pacific portfolio — spanning existing markets and new launches across the region.

You will work closely with global leaders, senior APAC leadership, regional General Managers and Sales. You will lead a small, on-the-ground APAC marketing team and serve as the senior marketing authority for the region. This role demands a rare combination: a performance-oriented digital marketer who can drive measurable revenue impact and a hands-on brand leader who thrives in the operational complexity of launching and growing physical, experiential locations.

You are the critical connective tissue between APAC market realities and global marketing strategy — translating local intelligence into decisions that move the needle on leads, occupancy, and brand awareness.

You will report directly to the Vice President of Marketing (US-based) with a dotted-line reporting relationship tothe Managing Director, APAC.

What you’ll do

Digital Performance & Revenue Marketing

• Own regional digital marketing performance end-to-end — managing paid channels (Google, LinkedIn, Meta, and region-specific platforms) directly for APAC, with a Performance Marketing Manager as a direct report.

• You set the strategy, control the budget, and are accountable for results. The global paid media team serves in an advisory capacity, but execution, optimization, and performance decisions live with you and your team.

• Bring deep fluency in digital performance metrics: you know what good looks like, ask the right questions, and hold the team accountable to APAC-specific outcomes.

• Build and maintain tight feedback loops between marketing, sales, and unit operations to ensure demand generation directly supports occupancy goals and revenue targets.

• Report regularly to the Central Corporate Marketing and senior regional stakeholders on marketing performance, pipeline contribution, and ROI.

Overall Marketing Strategy (incl Content, Partnerships, Events)

• Own regional marketing strategy and work closely with APAC Creative and Content Lead to oversee content strategy, ensuring campaigns, messaging, and assets are locally relevant, on-brand, and commercially effective.

• Develop strategic partnerships (e.g. Chambers of Commerce, industry associations, brokers, local businesses) to grow visibility

• Lead activations and events to drive brand awareness, engagement, and qualified demand

• Support Sales leadership on broker marketing and enterprise outreach using global content adapted for local relevance

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

• Develop and manage a lean APAC marketing team,acting as both a strategic coach and a hands-on contributor when needed.

• Build deeply collaborative relationships with regional Sales Leads, General Managers, and Unit Operations teams — functioning as an integrated partner, not a siloed function.

• Guide local teams in developing high-value strategic partnerships (Chambers of Commerce, industry associations, brokernetworks, local businesses) that drive visibility and qualified prospect traffic.

• Partner with regional Sales leadership to support broker marketing and enterprise outreach, leveraging globally produced content with local customization.

Brand, PR & Agency Oversight

• Manage local agencies and freelancers (PR,creative, translation, events) as needed to fill capacity gaps and ensure excellence in execution.

• Coordinate with the US Corporate Brand team on high-visibility PR announcements, creative asset requests, and brand campaigns,ensuring global quality standards are maintained across all APAC markets.

• Serve as a senior brand ambassador for Industrious and Industrious in the region — capable of representing the company's vision clearly and compellingly to media, partners, and prospects.

Go-to-Market Leadership for Regional Launches

• Own and evolve the GTM marketing playbook for newmarket and location launches across APAC, adapting global frameworks for local relevance across varied markets and languages.

Who you are

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business,or a related field; advanced degree a plus

• 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, with at least 3 years in a senior or leadership role

• Background in experiential real estate (flexible office, hospitality, gyms, or related industries) preferred

• Digital performance marketing expertise(paid search, paid social, SEO, lead generation) with demonstrated impact onrevenue and pipeline

• Experience across APAC markets

• Proven experience leading regional marketing teams within a global organization

• Experience partnering with sales teams to drive demand, pipeline, and measurable business outcomes

• Experience managing GTM launches for physical locations

• Proven ability to hire, coach, and scale regional, distributed marketing teams

• Willingness to travel 2–3 times per quarter within APAC and periodically to the US

Qualities

• Strong strategic thinking with a hands-on, execution-focused mindset

• Ability to balance global standards with local market nuances

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills (especially with sales, ops, and creative teams)

• High level of operational rigor and ability to manage complex, multi-market initiatives

• Ability to synthesize market complexity across countries, languages, and buyer behaviors into clear, actionable insights

• Effective leadership in multicultural,distributed team environments

What’s in it for you

• Opportunity to work with various teams across regional locations

title: Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Specialist
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.

Job description

We are looking for a Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Specialist to be the visionary link between our brand identity & measurable e-commerce performance. You will shape how our health brands communicate across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & social media.

This role is responsible for developing high-impact creative strategies & producing assets (visual, video, copy) designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok E-Commerce stores. You will work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the expansion of our business. You won't just be creating content; you will be engineering 'Performance Stories' that turn scientific evidence into consumer trust & measurable revenue.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry.

Key Responsibilities

1. Creative & Performance Strategy

Full-Funnel Content: Craft tailored strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific formats (e.g. Meta carousel ads, Meta/TikTok Reels, Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banners & Klaviyo email/whatsapp marketing)

A/B Testing & Data Insights: Develop clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, CTAs, visual styles) & run A/B tests to improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion)

Competitive Intelligence: Identify emerging hooks & messaging trends in the wellness/supplement industry to keep our brands ahead of the curve

2. In-House Content Production & Execution

Performance Creative Development: Lead end-to-end creative production for organic & paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube) with a focus on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing

Video & Static Creation: Rapidly produce & edit native social content, including:

Video: Fast-paced assembly of UGC-style content, product demos & testimonials (CapCut/Premiere)

Static: Adapting product photography into high-performing ad variations & storefront banners

Generative AI Integration: Utilize AI tools & prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video & image assets for rapid testing cycles

Copywriting: Write high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & captions that align with brand voice & regulatory requirements

Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok storefronts

3. E-commerce Growth & Social Account Management

E-Commerce Storefront Custodian (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok): Integrate winning creative messages into e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a seamless customer journey for maximum sales conversion

Social Accounts Ownership & Community Manager: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for Miraco’s official accounts on Meta (FB/IG) & TikTok. Ensure all profiles are optimized for conversion, featuring up-to-date bios, Linktree/Shopify integrations & high-lighted stories

Content Programming & Scheduling: Develop & maintain a consistent content calendar that balances "Digital Pearls" (educational), Lifestyle (relatable) & Promotional (sales-driven) posts

Active Social Listening: Use comments & DMs to identify "pain points" to fuel new content hooks

User Generated Content (UGC) Mining: Identify & curate customer testimonials from the community to use as high-converting growth assets

Growth Analytics: Monitor account health metrics (Follower growth, Engagement Rate, Profile Visits) & use these insights to refine the organic reach strategy

Data-Driven Optimization: Work with the Marketing Manager to analyze performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving revenue on Shopify & Marketplaces. Apply insights & analytics to refine content effectiveness continuously

4. Performance Media & Technical Tracking

Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google):

Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Sales & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces

Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries

Precision Tracking & UTM Tagging: Implement a standardized UTM tagging nomenclature across all Digital Pearls, EDMs, WhatsApp blasts & Affiliate links to ensure 100% attribution accuracy in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) & Shopify

Monitor the "customer path" from the first touchpoint (e.g., a Meta post) to the final conversion (e.g. e-commerce purchase, loyalty program subscription, etc.)

Media Optimization: Manage ad spend budgets effectively, focusing on scaling winning creatives & "killing" underperforming ads based on real-time ROAS & CPA data

5. CRM, Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing (Retention & CLV)

CRM Management, Loyalty & Monetization: Serve as the lead strategist for the CRM loyalty program, designing lifecycle journeys that move customers from "First-Time Buyer" to "Loyal Subscriber"

Develop loyalty-driven content that rewards repeat purchases & encourages long-term brand advocacy to maximize Consumer Lifetime Value (CLV)

Electronic Direct Mailer (EDM) & E-Newsletter Strategy: Develop & execute a high-frequency E-newsletter calendar via Klaviyo. This includes:

Educational Newsletters: Delivering "Digital Pearls" & expert insights from our HCP partners to build brand authority

Promotional EDMs: Creating high-converting seasonal offers & product-launch campaigns

Automated Flow Management: Design & execute end-to-end email & WhatsApp marketing automation (eg. Klaviyo) to nurture leads & re-engage existing customers

Automated Lifecycle Flows: Building "Welcome" series, "Post-Purchase" care, "Win-back" flows & "Replenishment Reminders"

Subscription & Monetization: Craft compelling creative & copy for "Subscribe & Save" programs, focusing on reducing churn & maximizing monthly recurring revenue (MRR)

Optimize the "Subscribe & Save" funnel through targeted email & WhatsApp triggers, focusing on increasing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)

WhatsApp Marketing: Integrate direct-to-consumer WhatsApp communication for personalized health consultations, loyalty rewards & rapid-response promotions

Data-Driven Personalization & Segmented Campaigns: Segment the CRM database based on health concerns, purchase behavior & engagement levels to ensure the right story reaches the right customer at the right time

6. Influencer & Affiliate Strategy (E-Commerce Growth & Acquisition)

Creator Partnerships: Identify & manage relationships with health influencers & HCP advocates via Shopify Collabs, TikTok Creator Marketplace & similar platforms

Affiliate Creative Kits: Develop high-converting "Affiliate Toolkits" (ready-to-use stories, hooks & banners) that empower partners to sell Miraco products effectively

Performance Tracking: Monitor affiliate-driven traffic & conversion data to optimize commission structures & creative briefs for better ROAS

7. Growth-Driven Storytelling

Translating Science to Story: Distilling complex clinical data & health benefits into relatable, high-impact stories that resonate with a consumer’s pain points & emotional aspirations

Narrative Funneling: Crafting story arcs specifically designed for the customer journey, from "educational hooks" that capture attention to "empathy-led consideration" to "urgency-driven conversion"

Growth-Centric CTAs: Developing persuasive, multi-variant Calls-to-Action (CTAs) that don't just ask for a click but provide a compelling reason to engage, directly impacting Click-Through Rates (CTR) & customer acquisition

Performance Iteration: The ability to pivot a brand story based on real-time data insights, identifying which "angle" or "hook" is driving the highest Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

Omnichannel Cohesion: Ensuring a seamless visual & narrative experience across all touchpoints, from high-energy social media (Meta/TikTok) to professional platforms (LinkedIn) & offline trade materials

Compliance & Brand Integrity: Safeguarding brand credibility by ensuring all "Performance Stories" remain factual, align with company values & strictly compliant with regional healthcare advertising standards & product claim guidelines. Partnering with internal teams to audit content for accuracy & compliance prior to regional deployment

Requirements:

3–5 years of experience in full-stack digital growth, with a track record of managing end-to-end performance campaigns (Meta/Google), official social accounts (Meta/TikTok) & e-commerce growth (Shopify is a plus)

Ability to move customers through the funnel—from initial awareness to community loyalty—ideally within the healthcare or wellness sectors

Proven experience managing or creating content for Shopify, TikTok, Shopee & Lazada ecosystems. Familiarity with e-commerce metrics (AOV, CR, ROAS) is essential

Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager & Google Ads

Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Generative AI)

Hands-on proficiency in Klaviyo (highly preferred), HubSpot, or Zoho CRM for email & mobile marketing

Track record of managing or growing a brand loyalty club with a focus on retention & community building

Experience navigating Shopify Collabs, TikTok Marketplace, or similar affiliate management software

A solid understanding of the "Growth Equation": CAC, ROAS, AOV & CLV

Expert in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools

Experience using Generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini AI, Midjourney, Sora/Runway) for rapid asset prototyping & production

Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills. Adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals

Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

Excellent communication, project management skills & the ability to work cross-functionally
