The Marketing Communications Executive isresponsible for supporting the planning and execution of the Institute’smarketing and communications activities to strengthen brand awareness, promoteits programmes and services, and support student recruitment objectives.

The role manages marketing content andcommunication channels, including the Institute’s website, social mediaplatforms, digital campaigns, marketing collateral, events and otherpromotional activities.

As the Institute operates as a PrivateEducation Institution (PEI) in Singapore, the Executive is also responsible forensuring that published marketing information is accurate, current andconsistent with approved institutional and course information, and complieswith applicable regulatory requirements and internal policies.

2. KeyResponsibilities

A. Marketing Communications & BrandManagement

Support the development and implementation of the Institute’s marketing and communications plans.

Develop marketing content that communicates the Institute’s programmes, strengths, facilities, student experience and progression opportunities.

Maintain consistent branding, messaging, tone and visual identity across marketing channels.

Prepare and update brochures, flyers, posters, presentations, advertisements, banners and other marketing collateral.

Coordinate with internal departments to ensure that information communicated externally is accurate and up to date.

Maintain organised records of approved marketing materials, artwork and communication assets.

B. Digital Marketing & Social Media

Manage and regularly update the Institute’s social media platforms and other digital communication channels.

Develop and maintain a content calendar for social media and digital campaigns.

Create and publish engaging content, including graphics, photographs, short-form videos, programme highlights, student activities and institutional updates.

Support paid digital advertising campaigns, including campaign setup, content preparation and performance monitoring.

Monitor engagement, enquiries, reach, traffic and other relevant digital marketing indicators.

Recommend improvements to digital campaigns based on performance data and audience response.

Monitor online comments, messages and enquiries and coordinate appropriate responses or escalation.

C. Website & Online Content

Maintain and update marketing-related content on the Institute’s website.

Ensure information relating to programmes, intakes, fees, entry requirements, facilities and institutional information is presented accurately based on approved information.

Coordinate with relevant departments or vendors for website updates and improvements.

Review website content periodically to identify outdated, inaccurate or inconsistent information.

Support search engine optimisation (SEO) and other initiatives to improve the Institute’s online visibility.

D. Marketing Content & Creative Production

Produce written and visual content for marketing campaigns and institutional communications.

Coordinate photography, videography and design work for school activities, events and promotional campaigns.

Develop content featuring student activities, achievements, campus life, academic programmes and institutional developments.

Liaise with external designers, printers, photographers, media agencies and other marketing vendors where required.

Ensure appropriate consent and approval are obtained before using student photographs, videos, testimonials or personal information for marketing purposes.

E. Student Recruitment & BusinessDevelopment Support

Support Business Development and Student Services teams with marketing materials and communication required for student recruitment.

Prepare programme presentations, recruitment materials and promotional content for prospective students, parents, education agents and partners.

Support education fairs, roadshows, open houses, school visits, recruitment events and other promotional activities.

Assist with the preparation of materials for overseas and local recruitment activities.

Support communication campaigns for upcoming intakes, new programmes and institutional initiatives.

Track marketing-generated enquiries and provide relevant reports to management.

F. Events & Institutional Communications

Support the planning, promotion and execution of institutional events such as orientation programmes, graduation ceremonies, open houses, student activities and partner events.

Prepare event publicity materials, invitations, signage, presentation materials and digital communications.

Coordinate photography and content collection during institutional activities and events.

Support internal and external communications relating to significant institutional developments and activities.

G. PEI Marketing Compliance & InformationAccuracy

Ensure marketing and promotional materials are based on approved and current information.

Verify programme names, course duration, fees, entry requirements, awarding bodies, progression pathways, and other key information with relevant departments, ensuring compliance with the CPE Advertising Code for Private Education Institutions prior to publication.

Ensure that marketing communications do not contain misleading, unsubstantiated or unauthorised claims.

Ensure references to regulatory status, certifications, awards, partnerships and institutional achievements are accurately represented and appropriately approved.

Support periodic reviews of published marketing materials, social media content and website information for accuracy and compliance.

Promptly correct, withdraw or escalate marketing information identified as inaccurate, outdated or potentially misleading.

Maintain proper records and versions of approved marketing materials where required for internal review or regulatory purposes.

Observe applicable requirements relating to personal data protection, copyright, intellectual property and the use of student images and testimonials.

H. Marketing Performance & Reporting

Maintain records of marketing activities, campaigns, enquiries and expenditure.

Track agreed marketing KPIs such as reach, engagement, leads, enquiries, conversion indicators and campaign performance.

Prepare regular marketing reports for management.

Analyse the effectiveness of different marketing channels and recommend improvements.

Assist with the preparation and monitoring of the marketing budget.

Coordinate quotations, purchase requests and invoices relating to marketing activities and vendors.

3. OtherResponsibilities

Work collaboratively with Academic, Student Services, Business Development, Quality Assurance and other departments.

Participate in institutional meetings, events and improvement initiatives where required.

Maintain confidentiality of student, staff and institutional information.

Follow the Institute’s policies, procedures and quality assurance requirements.

Perform other reasonable duties assigned by the Principal or Management that are relevant to the position.

4. KeyPerformance Indicators

Performance may be assessed based on:

Timely execution of approved marketing plans and campaigns.

Quality and consistency of marketing content and branding.

Effectiveness of marketing campaigns and recruitment activities.

Accuracy and timeliness of website and marketing information.

Timely completion of marketing materials and projects.

Effectiveness of event and recruitment support.

Achieve the pre-determined number of leads specific to campaigns.

Achieve the pre-determined impression to leads conversion rate.

Achieve the pre-determined number to traffics visiting our website.

Achieve the pre-determined duration which an average visitor will stay on our website.

Achieved the pre-determined number of followers on our social platforms.

5.Requirements

Education

Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Mass Communication, Digital Marketing, Business or a related discipline.

Experience

Relevant experience in marketing, communications, digital marketing or content creation.

Experience within the education, training or private education sector would be advantageous.

Experience managing social media platforms and digital campaigns is preferred.

Budget planning for all activities.

6. KeyWorking Relationships

Internal:

Principal, Business Development, Student Services, Academic Department, QualityAssurance, Finance and Administration.

External:

Prospective students and parents, education agents, institutional partners,marketing agencies, designers, printers, photographers, media vendors and eventorganisers.

SSTC Institute is a premium private education institution established since 1978, the courses it offers ranges from Singapore Government School Preparatory courses, International Curriculum (Grade 1 to 12), Tertiary Programme, English language course as well as Workforce Skills Qualifications (WSQ) course.

title: Brand Partnerships & Growth Specialist
description:

Crimson students are 7x more likely to get into the Ivy League than their peers. We were recently featured on the front page of the Wall Street Journal.

Crimson is the only college admissions consultancy that brings together:

Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications

Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation

Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards

Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation

We’re backed by leading VC firms, including Tiger Global, Heal Partners, IceHouse Ventures, and Movac, and recently closed a USD $40M Series D funding round at a USD $640M valuation. We now operate across 21 markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, and New Zealand.

Beyond college admissions consulting, Crimson offers a wide range of Enrichment programs designed to help students discover their interests, develop new skills, and achieve meaningful academic and extracurricular accomplishments. As we continue expanding our reach internationally, we're looking for a part-time Brand Partnerships & Growth Specialist to help introduce these programs to new audiences and strengthen their presence in key markets.

The role will initially focus on Indigo Research and Crimson Rise, two of our key Enrichment products. You’ll find creative ways to get them in front of the right students and families — whether through partnerships with leading schools and organizations, media and podcasts, creators, conferences, community placements, events, pop-ups, or other brand activations.

You’ll work closely with our marketing and leadership teams to identify opportunities others might miss and turn them into action. We’re looking for someone with strong existing networks who can open doors, generate ideas independently, and think commercially about how greater visibility can translate into audience growth, leads, and ultimately revenue.

Responsibilities include

Brand Growth & Opportunity Development

Identify creative ways to get Indigo and Rise in front of the right audiences – from media, podcasts, and creators to conferences, school and community placements, pop-ups, activations, and other unconventional opportunities.

Strengthen Indigo and Rise’s positioning across international markets, adapting ideas and messaging to local audiences while maintaining a consistent global brand.

Turn student, mentor, leadership, and company stories into compelling campaigns, content, PR, thought leadership, and other brand-building opportunities.

Develop and test creative market-specific ideas that build awareness and credibility, while considering how visibility can translate into audience growth, qualified leads, demand, and revenue.

Track results, identify what works, and recommend which channels, ideas, and initiatives we should scale.

Partnerships, Networks & Execution

Use your existing network – and continuously expand it – to open doors with journalists, creators, schools, education organizations, event organizers, companies, communities, and other influential partners.

Develop creative collaborations such as events, content partnerships, creator campaigns, webinars, competitions, community initiatives, and brand activations.

Proactively secure high-value media coverage, podcast appearances, speaking opportunities, conference placements, partnerships, and other forms of brand exposure.

Own opportunities end-to-end, from identifying the idea and making the introduction through pitching, execution, follow-up, and measuring impact.

What skills and experience you’ll need

5+ years of experience across brand marketing, partnerships, PR, growth, events, communications, or a related field.

Demonstrated experience building brands and creating growth opportunities across international markets.

An established, active network in at least one of our priority markets – the US, India, Singapore/Southeast Asia, or the Middle East – with relationships you can genuinely activate to open doors. This could include journalists, media outlets, schools, education organizations, event organizers, creators, influencers, community leaders, or other relevant partners.

A track record of independently spotting and creating opportunities – from partnerships and PR to events, creator collaborations, activations, and other forms of meaningful brand exposure.

A commercial mindset: not every brand activity needs to generate leads immediately, but you naturally think about how awareness and credibility can ultimately contribute to audience growth, demand, leads, and revenue.

Excellent written and spoken English, with strong pitching, storytelling, and communication skills.

Strong relationship-building skills and confidence approaching journalists, creators, organizations, partners, and senior external stakeholders.

Highly proactive, resourceful, and organized – you can take a broad objective, identify the right opportunity and people, and independently drive it from idea through execution.

What success looks like

Indigo and Rise become meaningfully more visible, relevant, and credible in the markets you own.

You consistently uncover opportunities we would not have found without you – new partners, creators, media, events, communities, placements, and creative ways to reach our target audiences.

Your existing network opens doors quickly, while the network you build becomes an increasingly valuable asset for Indigo and Rise.

Your initiatives generate measurable outcomes across brand awareness, audience growth, qualified leads, strategic relationships, and ultimately revenue.

You develop a clear understanding of what works in each market, learn quickly from what doesn’t, and scale the strongest ideas.

Why join us

Part-time, fully remote role with flexible working hours.

Help shape two education brands across multiple international markets.

High ownership and the freedom to turn good ideas into real campaigns, partnerships, and events.

Work with a global team of ambitious, curious people.

Please keep an eye on your spam/junk email folder for correspondence from Team Tailor.

title: B2B Growth Marketing Lead - APAC
description:
We're looking for a B2B Growth Marketing Lead to accelerate the growth of Wise Business across APAC.

This is a senior, hands-on role for an exceptional B2B growth marketer. You'll identify the markets, customer segments and opportunities with the greatest growth potential, then turn those choices into locally relevant campaigns that acquire valuable business customers.

You'll own the regional B2B growth strategy and bring it to life across both self-serve and sales-assisted acquisition. You'll move comfortably between market prioritisation, customer insight, campaign strategy, proposition development, detailed execution and performance optimisation.

You won't be starting with a large dedicated team or a finished regional playbook. You'll work through specialist teams across content, events, paid search and other channels, partner closely with Sales, and make the evidence-based case for additional regional investment when an opportunity requires it.

You'll be based in Singapore and work closely with our APAC Regional Marketing Lead and market teams. Singapore is your operating base, but you'll use evidence to determine where Wise Business has the strongest growth opportunities across APAC.

Your mission

Make APAC a major contributor to Wise Business growth by building a repeatable engine that identifies the region's best opportunities and turns them into locally relevant, commercially effective campaigns.

Help more micro and small businesses discover and choose Wise for their international money needs, while growing within our customer-value and payback requirements.

What you'll be doing

Own the B2B growth strategy for APAC, using customer, market, product and commercial evidence to prioritise the most attractive opportunities.

Develop and execute locally relevant, integrated campaigns that acquire valuable business customers across self-serve and sales-assisted journeys.

Translate customer problems into clear growth hypotheses, propositions, campaign briefs, channel plans and measurement approaches.

Work hands-on with specialists across content, events, paid search and other channels to take campaigns from idea to market without losing strategic quality or pace.

Partner closely with Product Marketing and Sales on the Go-To-Market Plan and our ideal customer profiles delivering crucial market feedback.

Connect campaign performance to new business profiles, customer quality, downstream value and payback - not just impressions, clicks or lead volume.

Build credible business cases for regional investment outside established marketing activity, defining the opportunity, expected return, resources required and how the activity will be tested.

Use performance and customer evidence to decide what to scale, improve, stop or redirect, creating a consistent pipeline of activity rather than isolated launches.

Build a strong operating rhythm with the APAC Regional Marketing Lead and regional stakeholders, combining local context with the wider Wise Business growth strategy.

Identify and propose issues or improvements to Wise Business from a regional product perspective to help strengthen the offering.

Qualifications

You have deep B2B growth marketing experience and can demonstrate meaningful commercial outcomes that you personally helped create.

You're an exceptional, hands-on growth marketer. You can set the strategy, write the brief, shape the proposition, work through funnel problems and stay close to execution and performance.

You have built growth across multiple markets and understand that APAC is not one homogeneous audience. You know how to adapt a strategy to different customer needs, channels and competitive conditions.

You can identify and prioritise valuable B2B audiences, uncover the customer problem that matters and turn that insight into a focused acquisition proposition.

You understand both self-serve and sales-assisted acquisition and know how Marketing and Sales can operate as one connected growth system.

You make commercially grounded decisions using acquisition cost, conversion, customer quality, payback and lifetime-value considerations.

You're comfortable defining success before launch, working with imperfect data and making clear scale, stop or change decisions from the evidence.

You can bring together specialist and cross-functional teams without formal authority, maintaining clarity, quality and momentum.

You're comfortable operating independently in an ambiguous environment and move quickly from uncertainty to a sensible test.

You're motivated by Wise's mission and the opportunity to help small businesses operate and grow internationally.

Nice to haves

Most of your career has been spent in B2B SaaS marketing.

Experience in B2B fintech, payments, financial services or a comparable technology platform with a multi-stage customer journey.

Direct experience growing a business in Singapore, Southeast Asia or other APAC markets.

Experience marketing to freelancers, micro-businesses, small businesses, agencies, consultancies or startups.

Experience with cross-border, multi-currency or international-expansion products.

Experience entering or scaling an early-stage regional market.

Familiarity with partner-, community- or event-led B2B acquisition alongside digital channels.

Who we are

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move money around the world. With the Wise account people and businesses can hold over 40 currencies, move money between countries and spend money abroad. Large companies and banks use Wise technology too; an entirely new cross-border payments network that will one day power money without borders for everyone, everywhere. However you use the platform, Wise is on a mission to make your life easier and save you money.

Co-founded by Kristo Käärmann and Taavet Hinrikus, Wise launched in 2011 under its original name TransferWise. It is one of the world’s fastest growing, profitable technology companies and is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker, WISE.

16 million people and businesses use Wise. In fiscal year 2023, Wise processed approximately £105 billion in cross-border transactions, saving customers around £1.5 billion.

What it’s really like to work here

At Wise, we do things a bit differently. There’s no corporate nonsense, and no old-fashioned hierarchy. Instead, we work in dozens of self-sufficient, autonomous teams. Think of them like start-ups within a start-up that learn from each other.

Each team picks the problems they want to solve. So there’s no micro-management. No hiding behind fancy job titles. And no one telling you what to do. You are your own boss. But you’ll get tons of guidance and plenty of support from talented, super-smart colleagues from all over Wise.

We’re going to be upfront — the way we work doesn’t suit everyone. But if freedom, autonomy, and life-affirming, head-scratching professional challenges rock your world, we could be a match made in heaven.

Our pursuit of excellence defines every aspect of our work. Our team consists of dynamic, enthusiastic, and forward-thinking individuals with a deep appreciation for food and automotive culture. We cherish diversity, collaboration, and mutual respect, fostering an environment that promotes professional growth and development.

Join Us

Whether your passion lies in crafting unique gastronomic experiences or in bringing the latest in electric vehicle technology to the public, we encourage you to explore our open positions. Polished and credible, with the presence to engage senior stakeholders and clients across all segments, including affluent, high-net-worth and next-generation clients.

description:
Social Media Account Manager

Social Media Strategist

Remote, Singapore-based | 2.2K SGD/month

We're Network. We connect homeowners with interior design firms — 120+ ID firms on our books.

Our niche: Interior Designers, Architects, Furniture Suppliers, Personal Branding. Platforms we manage: IG, FB, TikTok, YT.

Most social media jobs are calendar management with a nice title. Posts go out, the calendar is full, nobody asks whether anything grew.

This one is judged on growth. You decide what gets made based on what is performing. We have a full creative team, so you're not designing or editing. You're deciding.

What you'll do:

Strategy

— build the content direction for each account with the consultant who owns the client. They bring the commercial context. You decide what gets made and why.

Performance

— own the organic result. Reach, page growth, enquiries. Read the data weekly and change direction on evidence, not at month end.

Visual direction

— hold the standard. A feed should read as one brand, not a run of unrelated posts. Reject work that meets the brief but misses the bar.

Briefs & calendar

— write briefs the creative team can execute without follow-up. Keep the pipeline moving.

Copywriting

— captions in the client's voice, not a house voice. Hooks and on-creative text for the creative team.

Shoot scheduling

— coordinate client and production team so shoot days happen when they're supposed to.

Client groupchats

— you're the point of contact. Fast replies, no dropped threads.

What we're looking for:

1–2 years running social media accounts, client-facing

Mandarin & English

You've grown an account you owned, and you can show the numbers

You can read native analytics and change direction from what you see

Taste. Two versions in front of you, you can say which is better and why.

You can push back on a salesperson with reasoning, not just opinion

WhatsApp fluent — you reply fast

Don't apply if:

You measure your work in posts published. Nobody here cares how full the calendar was.

You need chasing. If we have to ask, it's already late.

You can't defend a creative call. This role says no to work, and has to explain why.

Experience in social media management, content creation, retail, inventory, events or customer service is preferred.

Familiar with Instagram, TikTok and social media trends.

Good communication and customer service skills.

Strong attention to detail, particularly when handling stock and orders.

Organised, responsible and able to manage multiple tasks.

Proactive and willing to take initiative.

Comfortable working at booths, events and outside the usual office/showroom environment.

Hands-on and proactive

Organised and detail-oriented

Creative and social-media savvy

Customer-focused

Responsible when handling company stock and products

Comfortable working under pressure

Flexible with event and Live schedules

Willing to support both marketing and operational tasks

This is a hands-on role involving both online and offline responsibilities. The employee may be required to work at the showroom, stockroom, booths, events, pop-ups and other locations depending on business requirements.

The role may require availability outside regular working hours for TikTok Live sessions, events, launches and promotional activities, with scheduling arranged by Management where applicable.

title: Senior Marketing & Communications Specialist
description:
Overview

ENGIE is a global energy company, a leading provider of electricity, natural gas, and energy services. With 100 000 employees in more than 70 countries worldwide, ENGIE achieved revenue of €95 billion in 2023. ENGIE is committed to being a leader in the energy transition. We are looking for talented and motivated people to create the future of energy. Join a rewarding and flexible work environment that encourages innovation and creativity, and help us meet the energy challenges of today and tomorrow.

The Supply & Energy Management (S&EM) Global Business Unit covers trading and risk management activities as well as B2B and B2C supply activities across a large and highly diversified energy portfolio, including electricity, natural gas, biomass, LNG and other fuels, CO2 and environmental products

Within the S&EM Business Unit, Business Platform APAC is developing ENGIE’s trading and risk management activities across the APAC region, Middle East and India, around 4 main pillars: risk management and market access, asset management, green solutions and energy supply businesses.

Purpose

The Senior Marketing & Communications Specialist supports the development and delivery of integrated marketing and communications activities that strengthen ENGIE’s Supply & Energy Management positioning and business growth across Asia.The role serves as a regional principal Marketing and Communications focal point of contact for S&EM activities across markets in the region, including Singapore and Japan, working closely ensuring consistency of S&EM’s positioning and coordinating with the relevant Country, GBU and Group Communications teams to ensure consistent messaging, brand alignment and effective execution in accordance with the ENGIE Communications operating model. Communications accountability in individual markets remains with the respective Country Communications teams.

The role contributes to positioning ENGIE as a credible partner in energy supply, renewable energy solutions, corporate PPAs, environmental products, energy management and decarbonisation. Working with commercial, trading and business development teams, the role supports market-facing campaigns, thought leadership, customer engagement initiatives and communications materials that build visibility and enable business development.

Key Responsibilities

Business marketing and commercial support: Support the planning and execution of marketing and communications activities aligned with S&EM growth objectives; work with commercial and business development teams to develop customer-facing materials; and prepare sales-enablement content, presentations, business profiles and solution collateral.

Thought leadership and market positioning: Support and in the development of markets relevant to S&EM’s regional activities and client coverage market insights, executive viewpoints, case studies, industry articles and customer success stories; work with subject matter experts to translate complex market and trading topics into clear, engaging content for customers and internal stakeholders.

External communications and reputation: Support proactive communications activities linked to S&EM business priorities; draft and coordinate media materials, press releases, industry submissions and external messaging; monitor relevant industry developments and support issues management preparation when required.

Digital marketing and content: Manage and produce content for websites, LinkedIn and other relevant channels; maintain an S&EM editorial calendar aligned to commercial priorities; develop campaign assets, newsletters, infographics, videos and presentations; and track engagement and campaign performance indicators.

Events and customer engagement: Coordinate communications and marketing support for industry conferences, customer forums, webinars, roundtables and trade exhibitions; prepare event content, key messages and engagement materials; and support regional customer engagement initiatives.

Internal communications: Prepare internal communications materials that build awareness of S&EM’s activities, products and capabilities across ENGIE; support leadership communications, employee engagement content and regional announcements.

Brand and governance: Ensure communications and marketing materials follow ENGIE brand standards; coordinate with ENGIE Group and regional communications teams; and apply established communications review and approval processes.

Qualifications, skills and experience

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Public Relations, Journalism or a related discipline.

Professional communications, digital marketing or brand-related certification would be advantageous.

Technical Skills & Experience

4 years’ experience in B2B marketing, communications, corporate affairs, digital marketing or a related field.

Exposure to power, utilities, energy trading, renewable energy, sustainability, infrastructure or related sectors would be advantageous.

Good understanding of commercial marketing, customer engagement and business development support.

Experience assisting with thought leadership content, digital campaigns, customer-facing communications materials and executive presentations.

Strong writing, editing, messaging and storytelling capability, with the ability to simplify technical energy and market topics for different audiences.

Ability to coordinate with stakeholders across commercial, trading, leadership, communications and regional teams.

Competencies

Clear communication and business partnering mindset.

Commercial awareness and ability to connect marketing activities to business priorities.

Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

Creativity, curiosity and ability to develop compelling market-facing narratives.

High attention to detail, brand discipline and governance mindset.

Ability to work independently while seeking alignment in a regional, matrixed environment.

ENGIE Energy Marketing Singapore Pte Ltd

ENGIE Energy Marketing Singapore Pte Ltd is the LNG trading platform at the heart of ENGIE, a global energy player in the three businesses of gas, power and energy services, and a comprehensive presence throughout the energy value chain.

Combining in-depth industry experience and financial-market know-how, we serve with LNG solutions all ENGIE business activities worldwide and trade LNG with third parties, from upstream producers to downstream utilities.

ENGIE Energy Marketing Singapore Pte Ltd also has a local presence in Europe (Paris, London, and Madrid).

Unequivocally client-focused, we bring the best of both worlds – energy and trading – to our business partners, be they within the Group or external customers.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Kiztopia Group is a leading family edutainment and active entertainment business dedicated to creating meaningful, engaging experiences through play, exploration and movement.

With multiple concepts and locations across Singapore and the region, we continue to grow our portfolio through innovation, creativity and a commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences.

Our established Kiztopia brand brings families together through purposeful play, while Xventure, our next-generation indoor actives ports park, introduces exciting experiences designed for older children, youths, young adults and families.

As we expand, we are looking for passionate and capable individuals to help strengthen our brands, grow our customer base and shape the future of entertainment in Singapore.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a

commercially driven, creative and hands-on Marketing Manager

to lead the marketing strategy, planning and execution for Kiztopia Group's Singapore businesses, including Kiztopia and Xventure.

You will take ownership of integrated marketing initiatives that strengthen brand positioning, increase customer acquisition, drive visitorship and contribute to business growth.

This role requires someone who can translate business objectives into actionable marketing strategies, balance brand-building with performance marketing, and lead campaigns from concept through execution and performance evaluation.

You will manage marketing budgets, guide team members, coordinate external agencies and work closely with Commercial, Operations and other stakeholders to deliver results.

We are looking for a well-rounded marketing leader who is equally comfortable developing strategy, analysing performance and getting involved in execution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketing Strategy & Business Growth

Develop and lead integrated marketing strategies for Kiztopia and Xventure, aligned with brand positioning, commercial objectives and business priorities.

Translate revenue targets, visitorship goals and customer acquisition objectives into actionable monthly, quarterly and annual marketing plans.

Develop targeted strategies for different customer segments, including families, children, youths, young adults, schools and relevant community groups.

Identify opportunities to drive ticket sales, increase repeat visits, build brand loyalty and strengthen customer lifetime value.

Plan and manage campaigns across business-as-usual operations, seasonal peaks, new outlet launches and special events.

Monitor consumer trends, competitor activities and market opportunities to keep our brands relevant and competitive.

2. Integrated Campaign Management

Lead end-to-end planning and execution of marketing campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels.

Develop clear campaign objectives, audience targeting, promotional mechanics, timelines, budgets and measurable KPIs.

Oversee campaign delivery across social media, digital advertising, CRM, website, partnerships, PR and on-ground activations.

Establish effective customer journeys from awareness and engagement through to ticket purchase and repeat visits.

Ensure campaigns are delivered on time, within budget and aligned with business objectives.

Review campaign effectiveness and refine strategies based on performance data and customer response.

3. Digital Marketing & Performance Management

Lead digital marketing strategies across platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok and other relevant channels.

Manage advertising budgets and optimise resource allocation based on campaign objectives and performance.

Oversee audience segmentation, retargeting, conversion campaigns and relevant testing initiatives.

Monitor key performance indicators such as reach, engagement, website traffic, acquisition cost, conversions and attributable revenue.

Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency, conversion rates and return on marketing investment.

Work with relevant stakeholders to improve website, booking and ticketing conversion journeys.

4. Brand, Social Media & Content Strategy

Own the overall brand marketing direction and ensure consistent positioning across campaigns and communication channels.

Develop differentiated content and communication strategies for Kiztopia and Xventure based on their respective target audiences.

Lead social media planning across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and other relevant platforms.

Guide the development of engaging content, including short-form videos, attraction highlights, promotional campaigns, customer experiences and community-driven content.

Review creative concepts, campaign messaging and marketing assets to ensure brand consistency and audience relevance.

Identify emerging content formats, cultural trends and creative opportunities that can strengthen organic reach and brand visibility.

Work closely with the marketing team, content creators and external agencies to deliver relevant, high-quality content.

5. Customer Engagement, CRM & Retention

Develop CRM and customer engagement strategies to encourage repeat visits, strengthen relationships and drive incremental revenue.

Oversee segmented email marketing, WhatsApp campaigns and other customer communications.

Identify opportunities for cross-promotion between Kiztopia, Xventure and other relevant business concepts.

Develop targeted campaigns around school holidays, birthdays, memberships, special occasions and customer engagement opportunities.

Review customer engagement and campaign data to identify opportunities for improved targeting and retention.

6. Partnerships, Events & Brand Activations

Collaborate with mall partners, ticketing platforms, community groups, schools, influencers and external partners on marketing initiatives.

Work closely with Commercial and Operations teams to support new outlet launches, grand openings, events and promotional activations.

Develop marketing initiatives that build awareness, generate publicity and encourage customer participation.

Identify and evaluate potential partnerships based on audience relevance, commercial value and expected marketing exposure.

Manage external agencies and vendors, ensuring clear deliverables, timelines, quality standards and value for money.

7. Budget, Reporting & Performance Accountability

Develop, manage and monitor marketing budgets across brands, campaigns and channels.

Track campaign performance against marketing KPIs and business objectives.

Prepare weekly marketing performance updates and monthly management reports covering key results, budget utilisation, insights and recommended actions.

Evaluate campaign effectiveness beyond engagement metrics, with emphasis on measurable business outcomes.

Identify underperforming initiatives early and recommend practical corrective actions.

Maintain clear marketing plans, campaign trackers, budgets and reporting frameworks.

8. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Lead, coach and develop the Singapore marketing team, establishing clear priorities, ownership and performance expectations.

Delegate effectively while remaining hands-on when required by business priorities.

Establish efficient workflows for campaign planning, creative production, approvals, execution and reporting.

Work collaboratively with Operations, Commercial, Partnerships, Sales and regional stakeholders.

Ensure marketing campaigns and promotions are communicated clearly to frontline teams and are operationally executable.

Foster a culture of accountability, creativity, initiative and continuous improvement.

REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Minimum 5 years of relevant marketing experience, with demonstrated ownership of integrated marketing campaigns and experience leading projects or team members.

Strong understanding of digital marketing, performance advertising, social media, CRM and integrated campaign management.

Proven ability to develop actionable marketing plans and manage campaigns from strategy to execution.

Commercially minded, with the ability to interpret campaign performance and connect marketing activities to business outcomes.

Experience managing marketing budgets, external agencies and multiple concurrent campaigns.

Strong leadership, project management, communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

Proactive, resourceful and comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Creative and analytical, with the ability to balance brand development and performance-driven marketing.

Willingness to take a hands-on approach and support execution where necessary.

ADDED ADVANTAGES

Experience in attractions, entertainment, family-oriented businesses, lifestyle, leisure, retail, hospitality or other consumer-facing industries.

Experience managing multiple brands, business locations or new product launches.

Familiarity with online ticketing platforms, e-commerce conversion and customer acquisition campaigns.

Knowledge of SEO, Google Analytics, marketing automation or relevant CRM tools.

Experience in influencer marketing, community engagement, experiential marketing or event activations.

Hands-on content creation, photography or video editing experience.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Clear, executable marketing plans aligned with commercial and brand objectives.

Improved brand visibility, customer engagement and qualified traffic.

Measurable contribution to customer acquisition, ticket sales, visitorship and repeat visits.

Effective utilisation of marketing budgets and continuous campaign optimisation.

Consistent delivery of high-quality campaigns across Kiztopia and Xventure.

A well-organised, accountable marketing team capable of executing independently.

WHY JOIN US?

Lead marketing for two exciting entertainment brands with distinct growth opportunities.

Play a meaningful role in new brand development, outlet launches and business expansion.

Take ownership of marketing initiatives with direct visibility into business performance.

Work in a dynamic, entrepreneurial and collaborative environment.

Good copywriting, communication and organisational skills.

Experience in entertainment, attractions, sports, lifestyle, retail, hospitality or leisure industries.

About Us

Founded in 2014, Lumens Group is leading the transformation of the mobility industry in Singapore. We have successfully built one of Singapore's largest car fleets and expanded our offerings to personal and corporate leasing, purchasing and financing. As we enter a new phase, we're building an integrated ecosystem for merchants and consumers, driven by advanced technology and a mission to enrich everyday life.

Your Role on Our Journey

We are looking for a creative, driven, and passionate Content Creator to join our team and develop engaging content that strengthens our brands and connects with our target audience.

As a Content Creator, you will play a key role in growing our digital presence across social media platforms and online channels through compelling content, creative storytelling, and audience engagement.

Photography, videography, and basic video editing skills will be an added advantage.

Proficiency in additional languages is a plus.

Perform any other duties as assigned.

Based in Singapore, Lumens Group is a family of brands offering an ecosystem of services around cars. Our story began as a private hire car leasing company to address the needs of the new sharing economy led by Uber and Grab. Our core business has been leasing to ride hailing drivers and we grew our car fleet to one of the largest in Singapore in under 8 years. During this time, we have expanded our services to personal & corporate vehicle leasing, vehicle purchasing and financing.

Emerging strong from the Covid-19 period, Lumens is building for an exciting new era that brings in a wide range of merchants and individual consumers to our ecosystem. By owning a critical mass of vehicles and driver relationships, we are able to innovate on vehicle setup, driver upskilling & deployment, as well as technology and data capabilities to build mobility platform services that impact our everyday lives.

title: Lead Content Strategist
description:
About Feel Fresh

Two founders, a Singapore oral-care brand, and nobody between us and the customer. We make a peroxide-free whitening kit, a stain remover mouthwash, ultrasonic and UV cleaners for retainers and aligners, water flossers and toothbrush sterilisers. We sell on our own site and on TikTok Shop, Shopee and Lazada, and Malaysia is next.

The Straits Times, CNA and Mothership wrote about us without being pitched. Dentists started recommending the products because patients brought them into appointments. All of it was built on content we made ourselves.

We are a multi-million-dollar brand that still runs on content: a script, a phone, a shoot, an ad that works. We are looking for the person who decides what that content should be.

The job, honestly

You decide what Feel Fresh puts out and why. You set the content plan across TikTok, Instagram, our Meta ads and our TikTok Shop livestreams, you write and brief the scripts, and you read the numbers afterwards to see which ideas actually made people buy. Then you plan the next round on what you learned.

You will work shoulder to shoulder with the two founders and our performance marketer. Ideas get decided in a conversation, not in a deck. Pitch something on Monday and it can be filmed on Wednesday and live on Friday.

In a typical month you might

- Build the monthly content plan: which products, which angles, which formats, and what each channel gets.

- Write and brief 15 to 25 short-form scripts, and pick the ones worth shooting.

- Plan the content around launches and sale moments like 11.11, Payday and the Malaysia rollout.

- Sit with the ad account and the organic numbers, work out why the winner won, and turn that into next month's briefs.

- Brief and give feedback to our editors, filmers and content interns.

- Find the next format before everyone else copies the current one.

You would be right for this if

- You have 2 to 4 years of content, social or creative strategy work behind you, ideally for a consumer brand or an agency, and a portfolio you can walk us through.

- You can explain why a video worked with numbers, not just taste.

- You write well: hooks, scripts, captions, briefs.

- You would rather own one brand properly than juggle six accounts.

- You want to be measured on results, not on effort.

The deal

- S$3,500 to S$5,500 a month, depending on what you bring.

- A direct line to the founders and to the numbers behind the work.

- A brand with real reach: national press, dentist-recommended products, four marketplaces and a Malaysia launch.

- Room to grow into leading the content function as we grow.

Singapore-based, in office, with regular shoot days on location.

title: Program Origination & Marketing Manager
description:
Company Overview

The Singapore Mint, established in 1968, has evolved into a leading innovative mint producing high-quality coins, medallions, and collectibles. It combines advanced technology with skilled craftsmanship and serves both local and international markets.

Job Summary

The Manager, Programme Origination leads the team to develop and execute commemorative coin and collectible product programmes, owning strategy, marketing, delivery, and P&L to achieve commercial and performance targets.

Responsibilities

Lead and manage the Programme Origination team to deliver product programmes that meet yearly margin targets and enhance team capabilities in a dynamic environment

Plan, execute, and review programmes managing scope, schedule, budget, quality, launch readiness, risks, and post-launch performance

Conduct market research to identify trends and originate differentiated product concepts that enhance brand equity

Oversee marketing and communications plans, including product storytelling, campaign briefs, sales enablement materials, and channel support across retail, e-commerce, corporate sales, and digital platforms

Coordinate internal teams across programme origination, marketing, sales, design, production, and operations to ensure aligned delivery and accountability

Manage external contractors, agencies, vendors, and partners to deliver quality, cost, timelines, messaging, and brand standards

Monitor programme KPIs and P&L, track sales, margin, and engagement targets, and implement timely corrective actions

Provide accurate programme reporting, documentation, and management updates

Recommend programme concepts, timelines, budget allocations, go-to-market requirements, and risk mitigation or performance improvement actions

Influence cross-functional delivery across marketing, production, operations, sales, and external partners to ensure cohesive execution

The Singapore Mint was established in 1968 to mint circulation coins for the newly-independent nation. Over the years, The Singapore Mint has evolved from a basic minting facility to a fully integrated business operation, comprising programme concept, product design, marketing, sales and distribution with after sales service. Focusing on quality system and standards, The Singapore Mint is a certified ISO 9001 and 14001 organisation. Today, it has grown to become one of the leading innovative mints in the industry, capable of producing coins and medallions of the highest quality.

Leveraging on technology, The Singapore Mint has developed hybrid techniques to create high security and innovative features on circulation and commemorative coins and collectables. Fusing advanced minting technologies with authentic crafting methods, The Singapore Mint is one of the few mints in the world that still maintains a team of highly skilled craftsmen, adding intricate elements that can only be meticulously achieved by the human touch.

As a testament of its high quality crafting techniques, The Singapore Mint has won multiple international awards and its rising stature has garnered much interest internationally. The mint has been appointed by issuing authorities around the world for the production of their coins.

Other than producing coins and medallions, The Singapore Mint has also expanded to provide quality currency-related gifts and collectibles, lifestyle products and services to both local and international markets. We continue to pledge our unwavering commitment to our customers, business associates and partners to offer the best in quality, value and service.

The Singapore Mint (Singapore Precision Industries Pte Ltd) is a fully owned subsidiary of Sembcorp Industries.

title: Manager, Exhibitor Marketing & Buyer Programmes
description:
The Manager, Exhibitor Marketing & Buyer Programmes leads exhibitor-facing marketing and high-value buyer programmes across IAPL’s portfolio of shows.

The role supports exhibitor recruitment and retention through year-round marketing campaigns, while also taking ownership of hosted and high-value buyer acquisition, matchmaking and guaranteed meeting programmes that directly contribute to the value delivered to exhibitors.

The position works across InfoComm India and InfoComm Asia, as well as international buyer recruitment for InfoComm China. As a team member working closely with the Sales team, the role connects exhibitor requirements with qualified buyer acquisition and helps demonstrate measurable return on investment to exhibitors.

For InfoComm Asia, the role will work closely with the Senior Marketing Manager, who owns the overall visitor and audience strategy, with this position specifically responsible for the hosted and high-value buyer segment.

*KEY INDUSTRIES*

* Professional audiovisual and integrated experiential communications technology
* Emerging technologies including AI, IoT, 5G, AR/VR/MR, Big Data Analytics, Drones, Robotics, Content Development (Software), Wearables and Cloud Applications

*OVERALL RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES*

*Exhibitor Marketing*

* Lead and execute year-round exhibitor marketing campaigns that support exhibitor recruitment, retention and rebooking across IAPL’s portfolio of shows.
* Achieve agreed sales-accepted lead targets for exhibitor recruitment and provide Sales with a consistent pipeline of qualified prospects.
* Develop exhibitor-facing marketing materials including sector collateral, sales prospectuses, case studies, testimonials and ROI evidence that support the Sales team in converting prospects.
* Own exhibitor communications across the pre-show, onsite and post-show journey, ensuring communications are timely, accurate and relevant.
* Develop campaigns that demonstrate the business value and ROI of participating in IAPL’s exhibitions.
* Develop co-marketing and advocacy programmes with exhibitors to extend buyer reach.
* Support exhibitor retention and rebooking activities through post-show communications, performance reporting and ROI evidence.
* Work closely with Sales to understand exhibitor requirements, market feedback and commercial priorities.

*High-Value & Hosted Buyer Acquisition*

* Own and deliver hosted and high-value buyer acquisition programmes against agreed recruitment, attendance and quality targets.
* Source, identify and qualify senior decision-makers, buyers, specifiers and other high-value attendees relevant to the exhibitor mix.
* Manage the complete buyer journey including sourcing, qualification, invitation, confirmation, communications, attendance and onsite experience.
* Lead overseas hosted and local high-value strategic buyer programmes for InfoComm India and InfoComm Asia.
* Recruit and manage international buyers attending InfoComm China in collaboration with the China marketing team.
* Develop qualification criteria to ensure buyer profiles meet agreed programme requirements and are relevant to participating exhibitors.
* Monitor buyer registration and confirmation pipelines, identify potential shortfalls early and implement corrective actions.
* Manage buyer attendance and no-show rates to maximise programme effectiveness.

*Matchmaking & Guaranteed Meetings*

* Design, manage and deliver exhibitor–buyer matchmaking and guaranteed meeting programmes against commitments sold to exhibitors.
* Work closely with Sales to understand contractual meeting commitments and exhibitor buyer-profile requirements.
* Match qualified buyers with relevant exhibitors based on purchasing requirements, product interests, industry sector and other agreed criteria.
* Track scheduled and completed meetings against targets and contractual commitments.
* Identify potential meeting shortfalls early and work with Sales and relevant teams to implement corrective actions.
* Ensure accurate records are maintained for scheduled, completed, cancelled and no-show meetings.
* Collect feedback from exhibitors and buyers to continuously improve the matchmaking programme.

*Agency, Vendor & Programme Management*

* Manage buyer acquisition agencies, matchmaking platforms and event vendors against agreed scope, budget, timeline and performance targets.
* Establish clear KPIs and deliverables for external agencies and vendors.
* Monitor agency performance including buyer quality, attendance, cost per qualified buyer and delivery against contracted targets.
* Ensure external expenditure remains within approved budgets and flag potential variances in a timely manner.
* Evaluate vendor and agency effectiveness following each show and recommend improvements for future cycles.

*Sponsorship Delivery & Fulfilment*

* Coordinate with Sales, Operations and Marketing to ensure marketing-related sponsorship and exhibitor deliverables are fulfilled as contracted.
* Maintain clear records of relevant exhibitor and sponsorship commitments and monitor delivery status.
* Work with Sales to ensure that buyer and matchmaking commitments sold to exhibitors are understood and appropriately delivered.
* Support onsite delivery of hosted buyer, matchmaking and exhibitor programmes.
* Produce post-show exhibitor ROI reporting jointly with Sales.
* Contribute to exhibitor NPS, satisfaction and rebooking initiatives.

*Data, CRM & Reporting*

* Maintain high-value buyer information within CRM and marketing automation platforms.
* Use CRM data to segment, target and track buyer campaigns.
* Provide timely updates on exhibitor lead generation, buyer recruitment pipeline, confirmed buyers, meeting volumes and overall programme status.
* Track campaign and programme performance against agreed KPIs.
* Analyse buyer profiles, attendance, meeting completion and exhibitor feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Produce post-show analysis covering buyer performance, matchmaking results, exhibitor engagement and programme effectiveness.
* Maintain high standards of data quality and accuracy across buyer databases.

*Collaboration*

* Work closely with Sales on B2B/exhibitor promotion, marketing priorities, buyer requirements, contractual commitments and post-show reporting.
* Work with the Show Marketing Managers across shows to ensure high-value and hosted buyer programmes are aligned with the overall audience strategy.
* Work closely with Operations on onsite buyer and sponsor delivery.
* Contribute to marketing campaigns across IAPL’s three expos and work with counterpart teams across the wider global show portfolio.
* Maintain awareness of industry trends, key market players, buyer requirements and competing regional events.

*EXPERIENCE & ATTRIBUTES*

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in B2B sales/marketing, exhibition marketing, buyer acquisition, event marketing, exhibition sales support or a related field.
* At least 2 years of experience leading campaigns, programmes or projects with measurable targets.
* Experience in hosted buyer, delegate acquisition, audience acquisition or exhibitor–buyer matchmaking programmes is highly preferred.
* Experience within trade exhibitions, conferences, B2B events or related industries would be a strong advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to manage external agencies, vendors and programme partners.
* Commercially aware and comfortable working with targets, budgets and performance data.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills with the ability to monitor buyer pipelines, conversion rates and programme performance.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to achieve and exceed buyer and lead-generation targets.
* Dependable with strong follow-through on commitments made to exhibitors and internal stakeholders.
* Highly organised with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple programmes simultaneously.
* Experienced with marketing automation and CRM platforms such as HubSpot or equivalent, and confident working with database segmentation, data quality and analysis.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and customer service skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
* Self-starter, problem solver and collaborative team player.
* Ability to work effectively in a matrix environment and with global teams.
* Able and willing to travel domestically and internationally as required.

*WHAT WE OFFER*

* Remote / work-from-home arrangement
* Health benefits
* Multicultural and international working environment
* Regional exposure across China, India, Malaysia and Southeast Asia
* Opportunity to develop and manage high-value buyer and exhibitor programmes across three major professional audiovisual trade shows
* Collaboration with international teams across a global portfolio of professional audiovisual exhibitions

title: Marketing Executive (Events & Digital Media)
description:
Job Summary:

The Marketing Executive will play a key role in driving the digital presence, events and online engagement for projects. This individual will be responsible for executing digital marketing campaigns, managing social media accounts, optimizing the association or project's website, and supporting online content initiatives to enhance the visibility of the association's mission and events. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of digital marketing strategies, social media platforms, and website management.

Key Responsibilities:

Campaign Execution

: Develop and implement digital and event marketing campaigns across various channels (social media, email marketing, website, paid media, etc.) to promote the association’s events, programs, and initiatives.

Content Creation & Management

: Create compelling digital content (e.g., blog posts, articles, newsletters, videos, and graphics) that aligns with the goals and audience interests.

Social Media Management

: Manage and grow the social media presence on platforms like Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, and others. Schedule posts, engage with followers, and monitor trends.

Website Optimization

: Oversee the content management of the website, ensuring that it is up-to-date, user-friendly, and optimized for search engines (SEO).

Email Marketing

: Design and execute email marketing campaigns, including newsletters and event promotions, to engage members and prospects.

Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

: Implement on-page and off-page SEO strategies to improve search rankings and drive organic traffic to the association’s website.

Paid Advertising

: Assist in managing digital advertising campaigns (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, etc.), monitoring budgets, and analyzing the ROI of paid marketing efforts.

Member Engagement

: Leverage digital platforms to engage with members and stakeholders, encouraging participation in the activities, events, and initiatives.

Brand Consistency

: Ensure all digital content aligns with the brand guidelines and voice.

Collaboration

: Work closely with other departments, including event management, membership, and communications teams, to align digital marketing efforts with broader organizational goals.

Leadership

: to lead a team of marketing executives in ensuring timely and consistent delivery of marketing objectives

Skills & Qualifications:

Proven experience (at least 2 year) in marketing.

Solid understanding of digital marketing tools and platforms.

Familiarity with SEO techniques, website management, and content management systems (CMS) is a plus.

Strong knowledge of social media platforms and trends.

Experience with email marketing tools and campaign design.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to create engaging content.

Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and digital design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Canva).

Ability to multitask and manage multiple digital projects simultaneously.

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Ability to lead a team

title: Creative & Content Intern
description:
Company Description

At Fresh, we create beauty products that perform with experiences that transform.

Born in Boston, Raised in New York. What began as a small collection in a neighborhood shop by our founders Lev & Alina, has evolved into a full lifestyle line of skincare, lip care, bodycare, and fragrance sold all over the world.

The sensoriality of our products—their textures and scents—sets us apart. It’s this combination of high efficacy and amazing sensations that we’re known for, and why those who know us love us. Lev says fresh creates products people don’t know they need—and then can’t live without. Our founders still work with the brand every day to fulfill their original dream of making beauty that performs and transforms.

We are driven by our never complacent indie spirit where the sky's the limit. This approach is initiated by Lev and Alina and lived by the entire organization. Our boundless curiosity fuels our search for the extraordinary, whether it’s a moment of pleasure in nature or an experience of generosity in our shops. Where fresh goes, beauty follows. We’re pioneers—in product, in experience, in culture, and in process.

We believe that fresh is more than what it sells; it’s the emotional connection to the brand that we call the sixth sense. It’s the heartfelt experience we craft for our people and our guests.

Fresh is a brand of LVMH group worldwide. In SEA, it is managed through LBeauty Pte Ltd, a joint venture between LVMH group and Luxasia.

Job Description

We are looking for a highly driven, dynamic and passionate Creative & Content Intern. The role will join the Fresh SEA-Oceania marketing & creative team that drives and supports all creative development (digital, collaterals and in store content) for Fresh in the region. Being a part of Fresh Creative team, you should be passionate about beauty and will be responsible to translate brand communication objectives into creative fresh inspired, compelling content that will connect with our audience.

Job Description

Brainstorm and collaborate with the team to conceptualize compelling social content to develop engaging content that resonates across platforms like TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and EDM.
Conceptualize, visualize, design and execute creative content and layouts to support SEA-Oceania regional marketing campaigns
Attuned to latest social and beauty trends and tap on the pulse of culture
Create storyboards, shot lists, and pre-production materials for both site content and social-first content. Create timelines, shooting schedules and storyboards. Manage every phase of production from ideation, scripting, filming to post-production.
Utilize photography and videography skills for marketing campaigns, including post-production and editing.
Capture and edit original video content and have a hand in all phases of video production from pre-to-post (filming, editing, color correction, sound design, etc.)
Design and produce marketing collaterals for print and digital, including websites, EDM, social media, brochures, banners, packaging print and other marketing materials and understand market design preferences
Be the driver of “think outside the box” ideas, oftentimes thinking ahead of the curve, steering trend curation and thumb-stopping content audiences want to rewatch, share, and continuously tune in
Highly proficient to shoot, edit and create short-form videos for social media platforms
Work closely with regional team to maintain high production standards
Troubleshoot technical issues when needed and work with the team on revisions through delivery.
Researching and compiling social trends, ideas, competitors’ best-in-class examples, and cutting-edge executions to inform and propose new content

Qualifications

Requirements:

Able to commit for a 6 months full time internship from Jan 2027 to Jun 2027
Photography, videography, editing or creative content skills. Ability to leverage AI in content creation is a plus.
A strong visual mindset and understanding of the wider landscape of beauty video
Strong communication skills and ability to take creative direction and bring it to life through video editing
Strong understanding of frame composition (lighting, angles, negative space, photo clarity/depth of frame)
Strong understanding of studio tools such as ring lights, tripods, props, backdrops, etc.
Excellent verbal communication skills and ability to clearly articulate and document technical processes and issues
Exceptional time-management and multi-tasking abilities
Expertise in tools and processes for creative assets and content workflows.
Degree or diploma in design courses or relevant.
Strong understanding & skilled in Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, inDesign, After Effects
Experienced with DSLR or mirrorless cameras to shoot photos and videos for social media content, able to use basic lighting and audio equipment
Creative, passionate, independent and resourceful
A knack for creative storytelling and the ability to articulate rationales for designs.
Ability to prioritize and multi-task in a flexible, fast paced and dynamic environment
Detail-oriented and able to work proactively and effectively with minimal supervision
Able to work independently or with a team.
Enjoy and excel in a fast-paced, environment. Target-driven and good in deadline management.
Fresh graduates with high potential will be considered

title: International Private Banking - Go-To-Market - Associate
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Shape how digital tools reach and resonate with advisors and clients. You'll turn product updates into clear, compelling launch stories—and help people adopt new experiences that make a real difference. Working closely with product, design, and technology partners, you'll lead end-to-end go-to-market execution across internal and external channels. You'll gain high-visibility exposure, strengthen your strategic communications skills, and grow your launch expertise in a fast-moving environment.

As an Associate within International Private Banking Go-To-Market Team, you drive go-to-market plans that help advisors and clients discover, understand, and adopt digital tools. You translate product features into crisp value propositions and launch narratives that work across multiple channels. You partner across teams to align timelines, build launch materials, and keep stakeholders informed. You also track performance and apply learnings to continuously improve future launches.

Job Responsibilities

Partner with marketing, product, design, and technology teams to develop and execute go-to-market strategies across internal and external channels.
Manage the calendar of product launches and initiatives, ensuring timely alignment, communication, and execution across teams.
Develop high-quality launch materials including executive presentations, short-form content, internal newsletters, digital communications, and client-facing resources.
Build compelling storytelling and presentation decks to launch new digital tools and experiences, translating product features into clear value propositions.
Create scripts for videos and other dynamic engagement content that bring product stories to life across multiple channels.
Build communication strategies and activation plans that drive adoption of our advisor and client digital toolset and support business objectives.
Regularly participate in and share updates with senior stakeholders about go-to-market activities, plans, and storytelling.
Track and coordinate upcoming initiatives, monitoring digital adoption metrics and campaign performance to inform future strategies.
Identify opportunities to innovate communication approaches, testing new formats and channels to enhance engagement and impact.
Support diverse initiatives spanning product launches, internal campaigns, advisor enablement programs, and our digital awards recognition platform.
Adapt quickly to changing priorities and contribute to process improvements that enhance team efficiency and execution quality.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distil complex concepts for diverse audiences and craft compelling narratives.
Strong PowerPoint skills and proficiency with design tools (Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, Figma) to create polished, professional materials.
Highly organized with strong project management skills; proven ability to manage multiple priorities and tight deadlines simultaneously in a dynamic environment.
Demonstrated curiosity and innovative thinking—you proactively ask "why" and "what if" to identify better solutions and drive continuous improvement.
Minimum 5 years of experience in marketing, go-to-market, product marketing, or business management with a strong communications component.
Personable and collaborative, with demonstrated experience engaging senior stakeholders and building effective cross-functional relationships.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Strong attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and a self-starter mentality with comfort working under pressure.
Analytical mindset with ability to track metrics, derive insights, and apply learnings to optimize future initiatives.

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

title: Account Executive
description:
Job Description
Posting Start Date: 15/10/2026
Brand: MCI
Country/Region: Singapore
Work Location: Singapore
Workplace Type: Hybrid
Contract type: Permanent
Job Function: Account Management
Information at a Glance

We are a global engagement marketing agency that creates human-centric touchpoints that unleash the power of people to deliver innovation and growth. Firm believers in the power of building community since 1987, we are helping brands, associations and not-for-profit organisations solve their key people challenges through our core expertise: Live & virtual events, Strategic & digital communications and Consulting & community solutions. We are an independently owned agency, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, with a global presence of 60 offices in 31 countries.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At MCI, we believe great experiences start with great people, bold ideas, and strong collaboration. As an Account Executive, you will be an integral part of the team, working closely with Account Managers and colleagues to bring exciting brand experiences, events, and marketing campaigns to life.

From supporting new business pitches and developing creative ideas to sourcing suppliers, preparing costings, and servicing client accounts, you will be involved in the action from day one. This is an opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow while playing a meaningful role in delivering impactful experiences for our clients.

THE WORK

1. Support Pitches & New Business Development

Work closely with Account Managers and the wider team to develop compelling pitch proposals and presentations.
Contribute ideas, research trends, explore creative concepts, and help turn client briefs into engaging event and marketing experiences.
Research venues, suppliers, entertainment, activities, and other event elements to support creative recommendations.
Source quotations, develop cost estimates, compare supplier options, and support budget preparation to ensure ideas are both exciting and commercially viable.
Assist in preparing pitch decks, proposals, and supporting materials that bring our ideas to life and help us win new business.

2. Support Account Servicing & Client Relationships

Work alongside Account Managers to support the day-to-day servicing of client accounts, ensuring projects and requests are managed efficiently.
Assist in understanding client briefs, coordinating internal teams, and following up on project deliverables.
Prepare meeting materials, project updates, reports, timelines, and other account documentation.
Build positive working relationships with clients, suppliers, and internal stakeholders through clear communication and a collaborative approach.
Stay curious about our clients’ businesses, brands, and objectives, and look for opportunities to contribute ideas that add value.

THE CONNECTION

Reports To

Account Manager (for daily activities)

Works Closely With

Sales Team (Local and Regional), Operation Team / Project Managers, Sales Support and other Product Practices within MCI.

THE MUST HAVE

This role is suitable for well-rounded individuals with business, hospitality, or a marketing degree.
1 – 3 years of experience in the meetings and events and/or hotel and hospitality industry would be an advantage.
1 – 3 years of experience in the account management or account servicing role would be an advantage.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office and presentation development, are essential.
Great customer mindset, proactive disposition with strong negotiation and problem-solving skills.
Result driven personality with energy, commitment and a strong drive to succeed.

THE GOOD TO HAVE

Adaptable and solution oriented, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
Strong sense of ownership, responsibility, and attention to detail
Willingness to travel and support onsite delivery when required

ADDITIONAL LOCAL BENEFITS

Birthday Leave
Employer-paid Business Travel Insurance, unlimited Whitecoat tele consults, Dental & Vision reimbursements
Employer-paid Group Hospital & Surgical, Outpatient Clinical, Outpatient Specialist & Personal Accident Insurance
Comprehensive internal Learning & Development portal and opportunities for external courses

MCI is where you can bring your true self to work and be proud of what you do. Join us and make a difference!
