title: Manager, Admissions and Financial Aid (Outreach and Marketing)
description:
Job Description
Manager, Admissions and Financial Aid (Outreach and Marketing)
Posting Start Date: 29/09/2026
Schemes of Service: Corporate
Division: Admissions and Financial Aid
Employment Type: Fixed Term

The Manager, Outreach and Marketing supports SIT’s student recruitment and enrolment goals through the planning and delivery of outreach, marketing and engagement initiatives aimed at attracting and engaging prospective students who are a good fit for the University. Reporting to the Head of Outreach and Marketing, the incumbent will co-lead the planning and delivery of outreach and marketing initiatives , working closely with team members and internal stakeholders to implement local and international student recruitment activities and support the achievement of recruitment objectives.

The role encompasses both local and international student recruitment, including building relationships with educational institutions, representing SIT at recruitment events and education fairs, and enhancing SIT’s profile among prospective students, parents and educators. The incumbent will also support broader admissions and financial aid operations during the admissions cycle, including application processing and applicant engagement. Overseas travel is a key component of the role.

Key Responsibilities

1. Student Recruitment and Outreach

Support the development and implementation of local and international recruitment and outreach plans aligned with the University’s enrolment objectives.
Plan and deliver recruitment and engagement activities, including SIT Open House, learning journeys, education fairs, admissions talks and outreach programmes.
Develop and implement student engagement and yield-enhancement initiatives.
Represent SIT at local and international outreach activities, effectively communicating the University’s programmes and value proposition to prospective students, parents and educators.
Build and maintain relationships with schools, educational institutions and other stakeholders to support student recruitment and strengthen SIT’s presence.
Support international student recruitment and partnership development, including overseas travel where required.
Track outreach activities and outcomes and provide recommendations to improve future recruitment efforts.

2. Marketing and Communications

Support the planning and execution of marketing and communications initiatives to attract and engage prospective students.
Develop, review and coordinate recruitment content, collateral and communications across relevant platforms and channels.
Work closely with internal stakeholders and external agencies, including creative, media and production partners, on marketing campaigns and promotional initiatives.
Oversee and coordinate content creation activities, including photography, videography, student stories and multimedia productions.
Monitor emerging trends in higher education marketing, digital engagement and youth communications to enhance recruitment effectiveness.

3. Admissions and Financial Aid Operations

Support admissions, financial aid and scholarship activities during peak periods.
Undertake application processing, respond to applicant enquiries and support other operational requirements in accordance with University policies and procedures.
Contribute ideas and feedback to improve systems, processes and applicant touchpoints to enhance operational efficiency and applicant experience.

4. Stakeholder Engagement and Partnership Management

Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support recruitment and enrolment objectives.
Coordinate across diverse stakeholder groups to ensure the smooth delivery of outreach, engagement and marketing initiatives.
Represent SIT professionally at public engagements, presentations and recruitment events, both locally and internationally.
Uphold SIT's service standards and contribute to positive stakeholder experiences across all recruitment and applicant touchpoints.

5. Project and Operational Management

Manage assigned outreach, recruitment and marketing projects from planning through implementation, ensuring timelines, budgets and deliverables are met.
Contribute to team planning, process improvements and the development of new engagement initiatives.
Support cross-functional initiatives across the Admissions and Financial Aid Division.
Guide junior team members or project teams where required.
Undertake additional duties and special projects as assigned.

Requirements

A recognised degree from a reputable university.
At least 5 - 7 years of relevant experience, preferably in outreach, marketing and communications, events or a related field.
Experience in developing and delivering recruitment, outreach or marketing initiatives, preferably within the education sector.
Good project management, stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
Strong presentation and public speaking skills, with confidence in engaging diverse audiences.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Experience working with creative agencies and coordinating photography, videography and multimedia productions will be advantageous.
Experience in an international or cross-cultural environment is an added advantage.
Proficiency in additional languages relevant to SIT's international recruitment markets will be an advantage.
Willingness to travel internationally as required.

title: Operations & Brand Manager/Assistant
description:
We are a contemporary Vietnamese specialty cafe chain in Singapore. Committed to delivering authentic yet modern Vietnamese coffee culture and culinary experiences, we pride ourselves on exceptional quality and vibrant brand storytelling. We are looking for an entrepreneurial and dynamic

to oversee both our brand's market presence and daily retail operations.

This dual-focused role requires a blend of creative marketing leadership and disciplined operational management. You will be responsible for building our brand identity, designing and executing multi-channel marketing campaigns, and driving the operational excellence of our cafe outlets. You will ensure that our brand promise translates seamlessly into daily customer experiences, staff efficiency, and financial profitability.

Key Responsibilities

1. Brand & Marketing Management

Brand Strategy:

Unify, develop and execute culture-driven brand positioning and marketing strategies to grow our customer base and footprint in Singapore.

Campaign Management:

Plan, launch, and monitor integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, website, e-commerce and offline channels.

Content Creation:

Oversee the development of high-quality visuals, copy, and promotional assets for menus, social media, e-commerce, website, and in-store displays.

Public Relations & Partnerships:

Identify and manage collaborations with local food influencers, media, corporate partners, and delivery platforms (e.g., GrabFood, Foodpanda).

2. Cafe Operations Management

Daily Operations:

Standardise workflow processes, manage inventory levels, ensure food safety compliance, and maintain strict quality control across all outlets.

Team Leadership:

P&L Accountability:

Monitor outlet sales performance, optimise operational costs, control wastage, and implement revenue-driving initiatives.

F&B Marketing & Branding:

Proven track record in culture-driven brand positioning, storytelling, and community-building specifically tailored to the Singapore F&B landscape.

Operational Leadership:

Strong grasp of restaurant metrics (COGS, labuor costs, inventory management) and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Cultural Affinity:

Passion for or strong understanding of Vietnamese coffee, cuisine, and hospitality culture is highly advantageous.

Communication:

Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills to bridge creative ideas with ground-level operations.

Software Tools & Technical Requirements

The ideal candidate must be highly proficient in utilising the following tools to execute their duties independently:

Design & Content Creation:

Canva and Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop) for quick menu updates, digital assets, and marketing collateral.

Social Media & Advertising:

Meta Business Suite (Facebook/Instagram Ads Manager) and TikTok Ads Manager, Google Adz to schedule, execute, and track performance marketing campaigns.

Analytics & CRM:

Google Analytics, Mailchimp (or equivalent email marketing tools), and local loyalty program backends to track customer data and web traffic.

Operations & POS:

Experience with modern F&B Point of Sale (POS) and inventory management systems (e.g. Rewardly, AppsPOS etc.)

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hospitality Management, or a related field.

At least 2–5 years of working experience in the F&B or hospitality sector, with minimum 1 year in a managerial or hybrid marketing-operations capacity.

Business-level fluency in English while knowing Vietnamese and basic conversational Chinese is an advantage as this role requires the candidate to handle domestic and cross-border vendor relations and tailer marketing communications for target demographic segments.

title: Communications and CSR Director East Asia
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time Cluster Communications & CSR Director iEast Asia we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your strategic communications and corporate social responsibility expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside dynamic, collaborative, and forward-thinking teammates.

You'll play a pivotal role in shaping Alstom’s image and fostering business growth across the country and emerging territories in East Asia. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (HR, project teams, Corporate/Sector publications), build trust with key stakeholders, and drive impactful initiatives that align with Alstom’s values and goals.

You’ll specifically take care of internal and external communications strategies, but also develop CSR programs that engage employees and enhance Alstom’s social impact.

We’ll look to you for:

Building trust-based relationships with Communications management and Country MD to ensure the meaningful involvement of the Communications Department across projects.

Developing and implementing employee engagement strategies in collaboration with HR.

Managing the flow of information to employees using diverse communication tools (Intranet, publications, face-to-face meetings, events).

Driving media relations, including press releases, press conferences, and social media presence.

Supporting crisis communications at the country level.

Organizing and managing internal and external events to enhance Alstom’s visibility and engagement.

Managing branding and visual identity to align with Alstom’s corporate standards.

Building CSR and employee volunteering programs and fostering relationships with NGOs.

Leading a team and managing PR agencies and budgets effectively.

All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

Educational background in PR, Marketing, or Communications.

15-18 years of experience in communications.

Experience working with manufacturing or heavy engineering industries with a strong B2G (Business-to-Government) connection is highly desirable.

Prior experience in journalism or at a PR/Corporate Affairs agency.

Experience working in matrix organizations is a plus.

Strong understanding of internal and external communication strategies.

Proficiency in managing cross-functional teams and budgets.

Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines.

Work with cutting-edge communication and CSR strategies that drive meaningful impact.

Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues.

Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of mobility.

Utilise our inclusive and collaborative working environment.

Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.

Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning.

Progress towards senior leadership positions within Alstom.

Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Regional Brand Manager
description:
The Regional Brand Manager, APAC will support the development and execution of regional brand strategy primarily for The Macallan, with a strong focus on delivering brand growth, equity building and elevated consumer experiences across key APAC markets.

Working closely with global, regional and local stakeholders, the role is responsible for translating brand ambition into regionally relevant plans and programs that strengthen brand presence, drive executional excellence and support long-term commercial growth. This role will lead key initiatives across campaign planning, market activation, portfolio development, channel visibility, budget management and performance evaluation, while ensuring activity is aligned to brand standards and resonates with target consumers.

Job Description

Support the development of regional brand and portfolio strategy across APAC for The Macallan, ensuring alignment to global vision, market opportunities and long-term growth ambitions.

Partner with regional and local market teams to support & coordinate The Macallan’s brand plans that balance strategic consistency with local relevance across diverse consumer and channel environments.

Consolidate market input, consumer insights and local needs to inform recommendations. Support annual planning and key regional business reviews.

Lead the Regional Experiential strategy and execution framework for APAC markets working closely with the Global teams ensuring consistent brand standards whilst enabling locally relevant execution.

Provide guidance to APAC markets in the development and delivery of market-specific experiential initiatives ensuring that we continue to build brand equity, deliver an elevated consumer experience with executional excellence and drive recruitment of new consumers

Manage regional launch planning for new products and key portfolio initiatives.

Coordinate launch readiness across markets, including toolkits, samples, assets and guidelines

Support local markets on the openings of new retail spaces across the region, ensuring consistency of design and execution in line with Global guidelines

Consolidate performance of all spaces and share insights across transversal teams

Support local markets with activation ideas to drive traffic, increase consumer engagement and recruitment and drive sales.

Support management and tracking of regional marketing budgets.

Monitor investment allocation, spend efficiency and performance against plans.

Monitor and evaluate market, brand, campaign and activation performance, identifying key drivers, risks and opportunities.

Develop actionable recommendations based on performance trends, consumer insights and market dynamics to enhance brand growth.

Support preparation for performance reviews, QBRs, AOP cycles and planning sessions, ensuring robust analysis and clear business recommendations.

Manage external agencies and partners to deliver high-quality creative development, production and execution in line with brand standards.

Lead the development and deployment of scalable toolkits, assets and operating frameworks that strengthen execution quality, marketing effectiveness and brand consistency across local markets.

Work closely with global, regional and local teams to ensure alignment across brand plans and execution

Partner with commercial, finance, insights, communications, education and private client teams.

Talent and Skills

Marketing experience, preferably in brand management, regional marketing, consumer marketing, luxury goods, wines & spirits, hospitality, beauty, lifestyle or premium consumer categories.

Experience in managing the development and execution of brand plans, campaigns, product launches and activation programs across multiple markets or channels.

Strong understanding of brand building, consumer engagement and premium/luxury execution standards across online and offline touchpoints.

Experience working with global, regional and local market teams to adapt brand direction into locally relevant plans.

Experience across experiential marketing, events, retail activation, owned retail, trade visibility or consumer engagement programs.

Experience coordinating NPD, portfolio initiatives or product launches, including toolkits, assets, launch guidelines and market readiness.

Strong project management capability, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, timelines, stakeholders and agency partners.

Commercially aware, with the ability to track budgets, campaign performance, KPIs and post-activation learnings.

Strong interest in wines & spirits and luxury/premium consumer brands; WSET or equivalent qualification would be a plus.

Strong project management and organizational skills.

Collaborative team player with strong stakeholder management skills.

Confident communicator with the ability to influence and build relationships across global, regional and local teams.

Good analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and translate learnings into practical recommendations.

Analyse market information and provide insights to management to support business decisions.

Demonstrate critical thinking and commercial awareness when evaluating business opportunities and marketing initiatives.

Essential

Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Business, Construction Management, Engineering or a related discipline.

mandatory.

Minimum 5 years of relevant marketing/business development experience, preferably within the construction, M&E, engineering or built environment sector.

Strong understanding of the Singapore construction and M&E industry, including key stakeholders and business practices.

Proven experience in client and stakeholder management.

Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.

Strong critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills.

Able to understand technical information and translate it into clear and effective marketing or business development materials.

Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with clients, consultants, contractors and senior management.

REQUIREMENTS

Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Business, or a related field.

· At least 4 years of relevant work experience in marketing, communications or a related field.

· Experience in digital marketing, paid social, media planning or campaign optimisation.

· Experience working with creative, media or production agencies.

· Strong attention to detail and quality, particularly for public-facing content and creative assets.

· Proactive, resourceful and comfortable working independently through ambiguity and changing requirements.

1. Thinking Clearly and Making Sound Judgements

description:
Head of Marketing

FriedRice Experience | Singapore

The Role

FriedRice Experience (FRX) is looking for a

Head of Marketing

to lead how our experiences are positioned, launched and grown — from the first campaign idea through audience acquisition, ticket sales, CRM and long-term brand building.

Our portfolio spans different experiences and IPs, each with its own identity and audience. You will turn what makes each one compelling into marketing that is both creative and commercially effective, while building recognition of FRX as the platform behind them.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role. You will set the strategy, stay close to the work, and lead a focused team supported by agency and specialist partners.

Reports to:

Chief Executive Officer

What You Will Do

1. Lead the Team and Partners

Lead a focused marketing team and shape its structure as our portfolio grows.

Recruit, coach and develop high performers.

Decide which capabilities sit in-house and which are best supported by agencies and specialist partners.

Set clear standards for accountability, quality and performance.

2. Drive Strategy, Audience Growth and Ticket Sales

Own the marketing strategy for FRX and each experience, including positioning, audience strategy and go-to-market plan.

Turn visitor and commercial targets into marketing plans across digital, CRM, partnerships, PR and content.

Own marketing budgets and allocate resources based on performance and opportunity.

Track ticket-sales performance, acquisition cost, conversion and marketing effectiveness, and act quickly on what the data shows.

Develop a repeatable marketing model that can be adapted to other markets.

3. Grow CRM and Customer Intelligence

Lead the growth of FRX’s first-party customer database and CRM capability.

Drive segmentation, retention, re-engagement and cross-selling between experiences.

Use customer and campaign data to guide future marketing decisions.

4. Lead Brand, Creative and Partnerships

Set a high creative standard across all FRX marketing.

Ensure each experience keeps its own strong identity while strengthening recognition of FRX.

Write strong briefs and lead creative, media, PR and content partners.

Build partnerships across tourism, hospitality, travel, lifestyle, retail and other relevant sectors to reach both Singapore residents and international visitors.

What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months

Clear marketing strategy and annual plan in place for each experience.

Agreed audience-growth, ticket-sales and acquisition targets established and actively managed.

CRM and first-party database delivering working segmentation and re-engagement.

A strong internal team and effective agency partner network in place.

Marketing performance dashboard reviewed regularly, with clear actions taken from the data.

A repeatable marketing playbook established for future experiences and markets.

What We Are Looking For

10+ years of experience

across consumer marketing, growth, brand or integrated campaigns, including

at least 3 years leading teams and significant marketing programmes

.

Proven experience building, leading and developing marketing teams.

Strong creative and strategic judgement, with a commercial mindset and accountability for audience and ticket-sales performance.

Good grounding in digital acquisition, performance marketing, CRM and customer data.

Experience managing agencies, partners and significant marketing budgets.

Hands-on and entrepreneurial: comfortable staying close to campaign execution, reading dashboards and briefing agencies directly.

Ability to work across different brands, IPs and audience segments.

Knowledge of Singapore and Asian consumer markets is an advantage.

Candidates may come from creative or integrated agencies, entertainment, attractions, tourism, technology platforms, lifestyle businesses or major consumer brands. Exhibition experience is an advantage but not essential.

The Profile

Team builder • Marketing strategist • Creative thinker • Growth marketer • Commercial leader

This role is ideal for a resourceful and organised individual who is passionate about building meaningful partnerships and advancing positive social outcomes.

Research and identify prospective donors, corporate partners, foundations, grantmakers, and funding opportunities.

Work with programme teams to gather programme information, funding needs, budgets, impact data, and beneficiary stories.

Coordinate donor meetings, site visits, appreciation activities, and partnership engagements.

Manage donor communications, acknowledgements, and recognition requirements.

Ensure timely fulfilment of partnership and sponsorship commitments.

Build and maintain positive, long-term relationships with donors and partners.

Impact Reporting & Accountability

Track reporting timelines, funding utilisation, and donor requirements.

Support data collection and impact tracking to demonstrate the outcomes of donor and partner support.

Fundraising Campaigns & Events

Coordinate internal teams, partners, vendors, and service providers to ensure successful event delivery.

Work with the communications team to develop fundraising content and campaign materials.

Assist with post-campaign reporting, evaluation, and donor follow-up activities.

Operations & Administration

Maintain accurate donor, donation, and partnership records within relevant systems.

Support fundraising reporting, budget tracking, invoice processing, and reconciliation activities.

Monitor fundraising performance and prepare regular management updates.

Ensure proper documentation and compliance with governance, audit, and reporting requirements.

Manage fundraising and partnership enquiries through shared mailboxes and communication channels.

QUALIFICATIONS

Diploma or Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Social Sciences, or a related field.

At least 3 years of relevant experience in fundraising, partnerships, marketing, stakeholder engagement, or a related function.

Prior experience in the social service or non-profit sector is preferred but not essential.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with diverse stakeholders.

Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

Experience in donor management, event coordination, CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce), and digital marketing will be an advantage.

Passionate about community impact and committed to advancing Allkin Singapore's mission through meaningful partnerships and fundraising initiatives.

Proactive, resourceful, detail-oriented, and able to work independently.

Professional integrity with a collaborative, customer-centric approach and commitment to excellence.

About Chowa Cleaning

What You'll Be Doing

1. Social Media & Content Creation

Plan, create and publish engaging content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and other relevant platforms.

Develop creative concepts, scripts, captions and storylines for short-form videos, reels and posts.

title: E-commerce & Social Media Growth Executive (US Market)
description:
JOB DEFINITION

The E-commerce & Social Media Growth Executive is responsible for building ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned content, social media presence and measurable off-Amazon traffic for the US market.

This is not a traditional customer-service role and does not depend on influencer partnerships. Even if no external creator works with us, employees will continue building ChoiceRefill’s own social media channels, content library and customer-acquisition assets.

ODORSEAL is hiring two employees for this position. Each employee will be assigned individual content projects, social media activities, Amazon Attribution links and measurable results. Both employees will be cross-trained to provide backup coverage when required, while individual project ownership and attributable results remain separately recorded.

ABOUT ODORSEAL AND CHOICEREFILL

ODORSEAL PTE. LTD. is a Singapore-based consumer-products and product-development company.

Our ChoiceRefill brand has been selling round diaper-pail refills to US customers through Amazon since 2017. ChoiceRefill is a practical, repeat-purchase household product that helps families find compatible, easy-to-use and cost-effective refill options.

ChoiceRefill is not a simple trading or standard private-label product. The company has independently developed its production lines, product structure and manufacturing processes.

We continue to improve film performance, production efficiency, product compatibility, packaging structure and the overall user experience. These product-development and manufacturing capabilities create a meaningful technical and operational barrier to entry that many ordinary e-commerce products do not have.

Employees will have the opportunity to understand how a consumer product moves from product development and manufacturing to Amazon sales, customer feedback, product improvement and repeat purchases.

ESTABLISHED AMAZON FOUNDATION

The company founder has many years of practical Amazon e-commerce experience and a clear understanding of product positioning, pricing, traffic, conversion, profitability and repeat purchases.

The founder is responsible for:

• Amazon Listing creation and optimisation

• Product images, selling points and page structure

• Amazon on-platform advertising

• Pricing and promotion strategy

• Product positioning and pack-size strategy

• Purchasing, inventory and core business decisions

• Product compliance and overall brand direction

Employees are not required to build Amazon Listings from the beginning or independently operate Amazon advertising.

Instead, employees will work from an established product, supply-chain, Listing and advertising foundation to build ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned content, social media channels and measurable off-Amazon traffic.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

BUILD BRAND-OWNED CONTENT ASSETS — APPROXIMATELY 35%

Create practical English-language content that answers real customer questions and supports Amazon purchase decisions.

Content may include:

• Compatibility demonstrations for tested round diaper-pail models

• How to identify compatible and incompatible pail structures

• Installation, film-pulling, cutting, tying and refill-replacement instructions

• Troubleshooting for common installation problems

• Guidance on choosing between 3-pack, 4-pack, 6-pack and 8-pack options

• Guidance for existing ChoiceRefill customers moving from older products to the latest version

• Explanations of product length, capacity, value and intended use

• Frequently asked questions based on real customer concerns

Employees do not always need to appear on camera. Clear product demonstrations, hand movements, close-up shots, captions and simple voiceovers are acceptable.

Strong master content should be repurposed into suitable formats for the company website and different social media platforms.

The objective is not to publish content simply to appear busy. The objective is to build an accurate, reusable content library that helps customers understand the product and make the correct purchase decision.

OPERATE BRAND SOCIAL MEDIA AND GENERATE ORGANIC TRAFFIC — APPROXIMATELY 25%

Support and operate ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned social media channels, which may include TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest and Facebook.

Responsibilities include:

• Maintaining a practical content calendar

• Publishing approved content consistently

• Adapting content for each platform and audience

• Writing clear English captions, titles and calls to action

• Responding appropriately to relevant public questions and comments

• Participating helpfully in relevant online discussions while respecting community rules

• Directing interested customers to the correct Amazon product page

• Checking that every published Amazon link is accurate and traceable

• Reusing effective content across suitable channels

ChoiceRefill’s social media and off-Amazon growth activities must be able to operate normally without relying on external influencers.

RESEARCH CUSTOMER DEMAND AND IMPROVE CONVERSION — APPROXIMATELY 15%

Actively identify what US customers need to know before making a purchase.

Research sources may include:

• Amazon customer reviews and product questions

• Competitor reviews and recurring complaints

• Customer enquiries received through the ChoiceRefill website

• Social media comments and discussions

• Search suggestions and frequently asked questions

• Feedback from existing ChoiceRefill customers

• Performance data from previously published content

Turn useful findings into:

• New content topics

• FAQ improvements

• Troubleshooting guides

• Website updates

• Product-information recommendations

• Clear suggestions for Amazon Listing improvement for the founder’s consideration

Employees should report “problem + evidence + recommendation,” rather than forwarding screenshots without analysis.

TRACK RESULTS AND RUN GROWTH EXPERIMENTS — APPROXIMATELY 15%

Use Amazon Attribution and internal tracking sheets to measure employee-owned content and traffic sources.

Responsibilities include:

• Using an approved tracking link for each content item

• Recording the platform, content ID, product, publication date and responsible employee

• Monitoring clicks, product-page activity, purchases and attributable sales

• Comparing different topics, formats, openings, captions and calls to action

• Identifying content that attracts clicks but does not result in purchases

• Recommending which content should be repeated, improved or discontinued

• Preparing a short weekly performance summary

• Maintaining accurate content and campaign records

Each employee will receive a separately assigned Amazon Attribution link structure so that individual contributions can be measured.

SUPPORT DAILY E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS — APPROXIMATELY 15%

Support the founder by completing and following up on routine work surrounding the Amazon business.

Responsibilities may include:

• Checking whether key products are available for sale

• Monitoring obvious price, stock, variation, image or link abnormalities

• Tracking approved inventory, inbound-shipment and replenishment matters

• Maintaining product information, packaging files, images and version records

• Organising sales or advertising reports and highlighting meaningful exceptions

• Preparing supporting information for platform cases

• Following up on approved changes and confirming completion

• Escalating urgent issues with evidence and a recommended next step

Employees do not independently change Amazon advertising, Listings, prices, purchasing plans or budgets.

HANDLE LIMITED CUSTOMER ENQUIRIES — UP TO 10%

Customer service is a small, on-demand part of this position.

Most ChoiceRefill customers understand and purchase the product directly through Amazon. The role is not expected to spend most of the working day handling enquiries.

Responsibilities include:

• Checking the company website for customer enquiries

• Answering questions about compatibility, installation and product use

• Following up on unresolved matters

• Classifying recurring customer problems

• Updating approved response templates and FAQ drafts

• Turning repeated questions into useful content or improvement recommendations

When customer-service volume is low, the available time will be redirected to content creation, social media operation, research and growth experiments.

OPTIONAL CREATOR AND INFLUENCER COLLABORATION — 0% TO 10%

Creator partnerships are an additional growth opportunity, not the foundation of this role.

When a genuinely suitable US parenting, household or value-focused creator is identified, employees may:

• Evaluate the creator’s audience and content quality

• Make initial contact

• Explain the product clearly

• Coordinate approved product samples

• Prepare a content brief

• Follow up on agreed timelines

• Record published content and measurable outcomes

Employees are not required to contact creators simply to fill working hours. Creator activity should expand only when it produces useful content, qualified traffic, measurable sales or a valuable long-term relationship.

Time used for creator partnerships will be allocated from the social media and organic-growth portion of the role.

INDIVIDUAL ATTRIBUTION AND SALES INCENTIVES

The fixed basic salary is S$3,400 per month and covers the normal responsibilities of the position.

In addition to the basic salary:

• Employees may receive a monthly performance bonus based on execution quality, accuracy, follow-up discipline, teamwork and backup capability

• Each employee will be assigned a separate Amazon Attribution link structure for employee-owned content

• Eligible individual sales incentives will be calculated using valid, finalised Amazon data

• Refunds, cancellations, self-purchases, abnormal traffic and ineligible activity will not be counted

• Individual attributable-sales incentives do not have a fixed upper limit

• The calculation method will be provided in writing so that employees can understand and verify their results

External Amazon Associates or Amazon Influencers may use their own affiliate links. Such partnerships will be assessed separately and will not replace the employee’s responsibility to build ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned content and traffic.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

A successful employee will not wait for the founder to assign every daily task.

You should be able to:

• Identify useful customer questions independently

• Convert customer questions into content ideas

• Produce or help produce clear product content

• Publish content using the correct tracking link

• Review the resulting performance data

• Decide what should be improved next

• Maintain accurate and complete records

• Follow up until work is completed

• Provide reliable backup coverage when required

• Explain problems using evidence and practical recommendations

Success is not measured only by the number of posts published, messages sent or hours spent.

We value work that is accurate, reusable, commercially useful and capable of producing measurable improvement.

WHAT YOU CAN LEARN

Using real operating data and active commercial projects, the company founder will help employees understand:

• How to identify real customer demand

• How to distinguish views, clicks and purchases

• How to evaluate the commercial value of content

• How to use Amazon Attribution to measure off-Amazon activities

• How pricing, conversion rates, sales, costs and profit are connected

• How customer feedback can lead to content and product improvements

• How to turn one-time tasks into repeatable SOPs

• How product development, manufacturing and supply chains affect a consumer-products business

• How to participate in business decisions using a “problem + evidence + recommendation” approach

This role is suitable for candidates at an early stage of their careers who want to develop long-term commercial judgement, product thinking and independent problem-solving ability.

REQUIREMENTS

• Strong written English, with the ability to communicate clearly with US customers and write natural social media content

• Chinese reading and writing ability, as internal SOPs, training materials, product-development information and reporting templates are currently maintained in Chinese

• Proactive and organised, with the ability to continue work without constant reminders

• Comfortable maintaining accurate records in Excel or Google Sheets

• Able to learn from customer feedback and performance data

• Willing to perform practical content work, including simple filming, editing and publishing

• Comfortable working with a practical household consumable rather than relying only on fashionable or entertainment-focused content

• Able to work with a colleague, review each other’s work and provide backup coverage

• Careful with product facts, compatibility information and customer-facing claims

Fresh graduates and candidates with internship, freelance or personal-project experience are welcome. Prior Amazon experience is not required.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Experience in any of the following areas will be helpful:

• E-commerce operations

• Social media management

• Content creation

• Short-form video production

• Digital marketing

• Customer service

• Community management

• Creator or influencer coordination

• US consumer markets

• Household, parenting or baby-care products

Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, Excel, Google Sheets and commonly used generative-AI tools is an advantage.

Candidates do not need to have a large personal following or maintain a public influencer account. Examples of content, school projects, freelance work, previously managed brand accounts or a simple portfolio are welcome.

WHAT WE PROVIDE

• Fixed basic salary of S$3,400 per month

• Monthly performance bonus

• Uncapped individual attributable-sales incentive

• Established US Amazon sales infrastructure

• Amazon Listings and on-platform advertising managed by the company founder

• Products supported by independent product-development and manufacturing capabilities

• Access to real product, sales, traffic and customer-feedback data

• Structured product training, SOPs, templates and tracking systems

• Direct participation in building a US consumer brand

• Exposure to the complete commercial process from product and manufacturing to content, traffic and sales

• Business guidance from a founder with many years of practical e-commerce experience

• Individual results that can be recorded and measured clearly

• Opportunities to earn additional income based on verified sales contributions

APPLICATION

Please submit your resume through MyCareersFuture.

You may include links to two or three examples of content, writing, videos, social media accounts or projects you have worked on. A portfolio is welcome but not compulsory.

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a brief practical exercise involving:

• A customer compatibility response

• A short product-content idea

• A simple Amazon traffic or content-tracking task

The exercise is intended only to assess practical thinking and communication ability. It will not be used as unpaid commercial work.

ODORSEAL PTE. LTD. recruits and selects candidates based on their ability, relevant skills and suitability for the position.

岗位定义

电商与社媒增长专员负责为ChoiceRefill美国市场建立品牌自有内容、社媒影响力和可衡量的Amazon站外流量。

这不是一个传统客服岗位,也不是一个依赖红人合作才能开展工作的岗位。即使没有任何外部创作者与我们合作,员工仍然需要持续建设ChoiceRefill自己的社媒账号、内容资料库和客户获取资产。

ODORSEAL将为这个岗位招聘两名员工。每名员工分别负责各自的内容项目、社媒活动、Amazon Attribution归因链接和可衡量结果。

两名员工都会接受交叉培训,并在需要时为对方提供备岗支持��但是,每个人原有的项目、内容和可归因销售结果都会分别记录。

关于ODORSEAL和ChoiceRefill

ODORSEAL PTE. LTD.是一家位于新加坡的消费品和产品开发公司。

旗下ChoiceRefill品牌自2017年起,通过美国Amazon销售圆形尿布桶替换装。ChoiceRefill是一款实用的家庭重复购买型消耗品,帮助美国家庭找到兼容、易用且更具性价比的替换装。

ChoiceRefill不是简单的贸易产品或标准贴牌产品。公司自主开发了生产线、产品结构和制造工艺。

我们持续改进薄膜性能、生产效率、产品兼容性、包装结构和整体用户体验。这些产品开发和制造能力形成了有实际意义的技术及运营门槛,是许多普通电商产品不具备的。

公司的业务能力覆盖:

产品研发;

自主开发的生产工艺;

制造和质量控制;

包装和供应链执行;

Amazon销售;

客户反馈;

持续产品改进。

加入ODORSEAL后,员工将有机会了解一款消费品如何从产品研发和制造,走向市场验证、客户反馈和持续复购。

已经建立的Amazon经营基础

公司负责人拥有多年Amazon电商实战经验,对产品定位、价格、流量、转化、利润和复购之间的关系具有清楚的理解。

公司负责人负责:

Amazon Listing的建立和优化;

产品图片、核心卖点和页面结构;

Amazon站内广告;

定价及促销策略;

产品定位及包装规格策略;

采购、库存和核心经营决策;

产品合规及整体品牌方向。

员工不需要从零建立Amazon Listing,也不需要独立操作Amazon站内广告。

员工将在公司已经具备产品、供应链、Listing和广告基础的情况下,继续建立ChoiceRefill的品牌自有内容、社媒渠道和可衡量的Amazon站外流量。

主要工作职责

一、建立品牌自有内容资产——约占35%

制作能够回答真实客户问题、帮助客户完成Amazon购买决策的实用英文内容。

内容可能包括:

已完成实测的圆形尿布桶型号兼容演示;

如何辨认兼容和不兼容的尿布桶结构;

安装、抽膜、切袋、打结和更换替换盒的操作说明;

常见安装问题的排查方法;

3盒、4盒、6盒和8盒包装的选择建议;

ChoiceRefill老客户从旧版产品转换到新版产品的说明;

产品长度、容量、价值和适用场景说明;

根据真实客户问题整理的常见问答。

员工不一定需要本人出镜。清楚的产品演示、手部操作、产品特写、字幕和简单配音都可以使用。

优质的母内容应当根据公司官网和不同社媒平台的需要,拆分和改编为相应格式。

我们的目标不是为了显得忙碌而发布内容,而是建立一个准确、可以重复使用,并能帮助客户理解产品和作出正确购买决定的内容资料库。

二、运营品牌社媒并获取自然流量——约占25%

协助运营ChoiceRefill自主拥有的社媒账号,包括但不限于TikTok、Instagram、YouTube Shorts、Pinterest和Facebook。

主要工作包括:

维护清楚实用的内容日历;

按计划持续发布经过批准的内容;

根据不同平台和受众调整内容;

编写清楚自然的英文标题、文案和行动指引;

适当回复相关的公开问题和评论;

在遵守社区规则的前提下,参与相关网络讨论并提供有帮助的答案;

将有购买兴趣的客户引导到正确的Amazon商品页面;

检查每个已发布的Amazon链接是否准确、有效和可追踪;

将已经验证有效的内容合理复用到其他渠道。

ChoiceRefill的社媒和站外增长工作必须能够在不依赖外部红人的情况下正常运行。

三、研究客户需求并改善转化——约占15%

主动寻找美国客户在购买前真正需要了解的信息。

可以参考的信息来源包括:

Amazon客户评价和商品问答;

竞品评价及反复出现的投诉;

ChoiceRefill独立站收到的客户咨询;

社媒评论和相关讨论;

搜索建议和常见问题;

ChoiceRefill现有客户的反馈;

已发布内容的表现数据。

员工需要把有价值的发现转化为:

新的内容选题;

FAQ改进;

故障排查指南;

官网内容更新;

产品信息改善建议;

提供给公司负责人参考的Amazon Listing优化建议。

提交问题时,应采用“问题+证据+建议”的方式,而不是只转发截图而不进行分析。

四、跟踪结果并开展增长测试——约占15%

使用Amazon Attribution和公司内部追踪表,衡量员工负责的内容和流量来源。

主要工作包括:

为每项内容使用经过批准的追踪链接;

记录平台、内容编号、对应产品、发布日期和负责人;

跟踪点击、商品页面活动、购买和可归因销售;

对比不同内容主题、形式、开头、文案和行动指引的表现;

找出有点击但没有产生购买的内容;

建议哪些内容应该继续、修改或停止;

每周提交一份简短的表现总结;

准确维护内容和推广活动记录。

公司将为每名员工分配独立的Amazon Attribution链接体系,以便准确衡量个人贡献。

五、支持日常电商运营——约占15%

通过完成和跟进Amazon业务周边的日常工作,减少公司负责人处理例行事务的时间。

工作可能包括:

检查重点产品是否正常在售;

监控明显的价格、库存、变体、图片或链接异常;

跟进已经批准的库存、入仓和补货事项;

维护产品资料、包装文件、图片及版本记录;

整理销售或广告报表,并标出有实际意义的异常;

准备平台问题处理需要的支持资料;

跟进已经批准的修改,并确认是否完成;

发现紧急问题时,连同证据和建议处理方式一起上报。

员工不得自行调整Amazon广告、Listing、价格、采购计划或预算。

六、处理少量客户咨询——最多占10%

客户服务是本岗位中工作量较小、按照实际需求发生的工作。

大部分ChoiceRefill客户会直接通过Amazon了解并购买产品,因此本岗位不会把大部分工作时间用于处理客户咨询。

主要工作包括:

检查公司独立站收到的客户咨询;

回复兼容、安装和产品使用问题;

跟进尚未解决的问题;

对反复出现的客户问题进行分类;

更新经过批准的回复模板和FAQ草稿;

把重复问题转化为有用的内容或改进建议。

当客户咨询量较少时,相应时间将自动转移到内容制作、社媒运营、需求研究和增长测试。

七、选择性开展创作者和红人合作——占0%至10%

创作者合作是额外的增长机会,不是本岗位存在的基础。

当员工发现真正适合的美国育儿、家庭生活或性价比消费类创作者时,可以:

评估创作者的受众和内容质量;

进行初步联系;

清楚介绍产品;

协调已经批准的产品样品;

准备内容要求;

跟进双方约定的时间;

记录已经发布的内容和可衡量结果。

公司不要求员工为了填满工作时间而联系创作者。只有当红人合作能够产生有价值的内容、合格流量、可衡量销售或有价值的长期合作关系时,才会逐步扩大投入。

红人合作所需时间将从社媒和自然流量工作时间中调配,不会额外增加整体工作比例。

个人归因与销售奖励

S$3,400的固定月薪对应本岗位的正常工作职责。

除固定月薪外:

员工可以根据执行质量、数据准确性、跟进纪律、团队协作和备岗能力获得月度绩效奖金;

公司会为每名员工负责的品牌自有内容分配独立的Amazon Attribution链接体系;

个人销售奖励以Amazon最终确认的有效数据为依据;

退款、取消订单、自购、异常流量和不符合规定的活动不计入奖励;

个人可归因销售奖励不设固定上限;

公司会以书面形式提供计算方���,确保员工能够理解并核对自己的结果。

外部Amazon Associates或Amazon Influencers可能使用其自己的联盟链接。这类合作将单独评估,不能代替员工建设ChoiceRefill品牌自有内容和流量的基本责任。

怎样才算在这个岗位上取得成功

一名表现优秀的员工,不会等待公司负责人每天逐项分配任务。

你应该能够:

主动发现有价值的客户问题;

将客户问题转化为内容选题;

制作或协助制作清楚的产品内容;

使用正确的追踪链接发布内容;

查看内容产生的表现数据;

判断下一步应该改进什么;

保持准确、完整的工作记录;

持续跟进,直到工作真正完成;

在需要时提供可靠的备岗支持;

使用证据和可执行建议说明问题。

公司不会只按照发布数量、发送消息数量或投入的时间判断员工表现。

我们更看重准确、可以重复使用、具有实际商业价值并能够产生可衡量改善的工作成果。

你能够学习什么

公司负责人会结合真实经营数据和实际商业项目,帮助员工理解:

如何判断真实客户需求;

如何区分浏览量、点击量和实际购买;

如何判断一项内容是否具有商业价值;

如何通过Amazon Attribution衡量站外活动;

如何理解价格、转化率、销售额、成本和利润之间的关系;

如何把客户反馈转化为内容改进和产品改进;

员工将逐步学习为什么要完成一项工作、如何判断结果,以及下一步应该如何改进。

这份工作适合处于职业发展早期,并希望建立长期商业判断、产品思维和独立解决问题能力的候选人。

优先考虑的经验

拥有以下任何一项经验者优先:

电商运营;

社媒账号管理;

内容创作;

短视频制作;

数字营销;

客户服务;

社区运营;

创作者或红人合作协调;

美国消费市场;

家庭用品、育儿用品或母婴产品。

熟悉Canva、CapCut、Excel、Google Sheets和常用生成式AI工具者优先。

候选人不需要拥有大量个人粉丝,也不需要经营公开的网红账号。欢迎提供内容案例、学校项目、自由职业项目、曾经管理的品牌账号或简单作品集。

公司提供

S$3,400固定月薪;

月度绩效奖金;

不设固定上限的个人可归因销售奖励;

已经建立的美国Amazon销售基础;

由公司负责人管理的Amazon Listing和站内广告;

具有自主产品开发和制造能力支持的产品;

真实的产品、销售、流量和客户反馈数据;

系统化的产品培训、SOP、模板和数据追踪系统;

直接参与美国消费品牌建设的机会;

从产品和制造到内容、流量和销售结果的完整商业流程经验;

由拥有多年电商实战经验的公司负责人提供业务指导;

能够被清楚记录和衡量的个人工作成果;

申请方式

请通过MyCareersFuture提交简历。

候选人可以附上两至三个自己参与过的内容、文章、视频、社媒账号或项目案例。作品集不是强制要求。

入围候选人可能会被邀请完成一项简短的实际能力测试,包括:

回复一个客户兼容性问题;

完成一个简单的Amazon站外流量或内容追踪任务。

该测试只用于评估候选人的实际思考和沟通能力,不会被公司作为免费的商业内容使用。

ODORSEAL PTE. LTD.根据候选人的实际能力、相关技能及岗位适配程度进行公平招聘和录用。

Company Profile: ODORSEAL PTE. LTD.

ODORSEAL PTE. LTD. is a Singapore-registered consumer products company. It develops, brands, and sells diaper-pail refills and odor-sealing flexible packaging. The company owns and operates the consumer brand ChoiceRefill™. Its core technology mark is OdorSeal™.

The business started from a closed refill market. For years, many families could buy only the refill made for their own pail, at the price set by that brand. ChoiceRefill has been sold on Amazon US since 2017 as a compatible alternative for selected round diaper-pail systems. The brand states that more than 100,000 US families have used its refills. Its main Amazon listing has held about a 4.6-star rating from more than 50,000 reviews. The official store, choicerefill.com, sells the same products, fulfilled from US and EU centers.

The refill uses a 7-layer high-barrier film to lock in odor, with a film that is strong, easy to start, and loaded in the way parents already know. Each refill holds a large number of newborn diapers, so the pail is changed and emptied less often. The brand promise is compatibility, odor control, and fair pricing, with a trial option and a satisfaction guarantee (90-day money-back support on Amazon, with a satisfaction guarantee on the official site). ChoiceRefill is made for selected round refill systems, including some Diaper Genie® and Munchkin® models. It is not universal; fit should be checked before stocking up. Those names are used only to describe compatibility. ODORSEAL is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by those brands.

The company is based in Singapore and works with certified manufacturing partners in Asia on high-barrier film, lamination, and bag converting. Sales are focused on the United States, through Amazon FBA and the brand site, with wholesale available to baby retailers and institutional buyers. The aim is a simple, affordable, odor-proof refill that does not lock a family to one brand.

Tagline: ChoiceRefill — Freedom, Not Overpayment.

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven *Account Manager, PPC Campaigns* to join our team. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads platforms, a strong commercial acumen, and a proven ability to drive long-term client success and growth.

*1. Client Management & Communication*

* Serve as the *primary point of contact and trusted advisor* for a dedicated roster of clients.

* *Proactively identify and communicate* opportunities for campaign optimization, budget expansion, and new channel adoption.
* Develop and maintain *long-term client relationships*, focusing on retention and maximizing client lifetime value.
* Ensure effective communication between the client and the internal execution/specialist teams.

*2. Long-Term Strategy & Growth*

* Lead the development of *multi-quarter and annual paid media strategies* aligned with clients' overarching business objectives.

* Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., Execution Specialists, SEO, Creative, Analytics) to ensure an integrated, holistic digital marketing approach.
* Stay ahead of industry trends, platform updates, and competitor activities to ensure our strategies remain cutting-edge.

*3. Reporting & Analysis*

* Own all aspects of performance reporting, utilizing analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, CRM data) to provide insightful, data-driven analysis.
* *Translate complex campaign data into clear, actionable recommendations* for clients.
* Forecast campaign performance and track progress against key performance indicators (KPIs).

*Qualifications*

* *Minimum 3-5 years* of experience in an Account Management or Strategic PPC role, managing significant budgets.
* *Deep understanding* of core campaign principles, architecture, and reporting within *Google Ads* and *Meta Ads* platforms.
* Proven experience managing both *SMB and Enterprise* client accounts, showcasing an understanding of varying client needs and complexities.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate results into actionable strategies.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
* Proficiency with relevant tools such as Google Analytics, Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets, and data visualization software.

*Preferred (But Not Required)*

* Formal certifications in Google Ads and Meta Ads platforms.
* Experience with other major PPC channels (e.g., LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Amazon Ads, Programmatic campaigns).

description:
As an Executive / Manager, Engagement & Experience (Producer & Trade Communications) at BCRS Ltd, you will support the planning and execution of communications and engagement for producers, retailers, F&B operators and other trade stakeholders participating in the Beverage Container Return Scheme (BCRS).

The role translates regulatory and operational requirements into clear, timely and actionable communications, helping stakeholders understand what they need to do and where to get support.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Develop and execute communications for producers, retailers, F&B operators and industry partners.

Translate Scheme requirements and operational updates into clear, practical communications.

Maintain a communications calendar around key milestones, deadlines, reminders and changes.

Ensure consistent messaging across stakeholder touchpoints.

Manage stakeholder engagement

Develop and maintain B2B communications and channels

Requirements

Degree or diploma in Communications, Marketing, Business or related discipline.

3–6 years' experience in communications, stakeholder engagement, public affairs or B2B marketing.

Highly motivated entry-level candidates or those without prior experience, but who possess strong writing abilities, a willingness to learn, and a keen interest in sustainability, are strongly encouraged to apply.

Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to simplify complex information.

Good project management and stakeholder coordination skills.

Comfortable working across operational, technical and regulatory subject matter.

Experience in sustainability, supply chain, retail, government programmes or regulated sectors would be advantageous.

We thank all applicants for their interest in joining BCRS Ltd. Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

The Beverage Container Return Scheme (BCRS) was recommended by a Citizens’ Workgroup in 2019 as part of efforts to protect the environment, conserve finite resources, and increase recycling rates in Singapore.

The Scheme is designed to spark behavioural change by encouraging more sustainable consumption habits and enabling the transition towards a circular economy.

Under the Scheme:

Beverage producers and retailers are responsible for ensuring that beverage containers are properly collected and treated at end-of-life, and

Consumers are encouraged to return empty containers for recycling in exchange for a deposit refund.

The Scheme contributes to a more sustainable Singapore by:

Increasing the recycling rate of beverage containers and reducing waste sent for disposal;

Encouraging consistent recycling habits among Singaporeans; and

Aggregating a clean, high-quality stream of recyclable materials.

The impact of BCRS will be significant. The Scheme will cover more than one billion beverage containers used each year, allowing us to recover over 16,000 tonnes of material annually. This means less waste sent for incineration, lower carbon emissions, and a more circular economy.

BCRS is Singapore’s second Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) scheme, following the introduction of the e-waste EPR framework in 2021. EPR schemes place responsibility on producers for the collection and end-of-life management of the products they put on the market. Over time they will make changes to their supply chains, processes and materials used, knowing that they have some responsibility for recycling the container after it is sold.

As a producer-led scheme, BCRS is designed and operated by the industry, for the industry. This approach allows producers to determine the most practical and cost-effective way to recover used beverage containers, while maintaining efficiency and service standards. Producer-led return schemes have been shown to be effective in countries such as Norway, Denmark and Lithuania.

Successful implementation requires the support, understanding, and shared commitment from all stakeholders involved: producers, retailers, recyclers, and consumers. There will be teething issues and adjustments along the way, but we can address them with everyone’s support. Launching the Scheme in April is the first step and adjustments will need to be made along the way, in order for the scheme to be effective and impactful.

That someone is you.

Every deal you close becomes an account you own — and from there, your job is to make each relationship deeper, longer, and more valuable over time.

The more you close early on, the bigger the portfolio you manage — and the more your recurring income compounds through renewals, tier upgrades, and referrals. You are the person our clients trust from the very first call, the one who checks in before they have to ask, and the reason they sign, renew, upgrade, and refer.

2+ years in B2B sales, account management, or client success — with a track record of hitting sales targets and closing deals

A closer who thinks long-term: you know how to drive a deal to a decision, but you close clients you can grow, not just deals you can win

A natural relationship builder — the close is the start of the relationship, not the end of it

Consistent with follow-through: you do what you say, on time, every time

A clear communicator who can explain performance data and business concepts simply, in person and in writing

Commercially sharp — you can spot an upsell or referral opportunity without making the client feel sold to

Organised and self-directed: you manage your own portfolio, pipeline of renewals, and follow-up cadence

Proven ability to work independently in a remote setup — you stay responsive, structured, and visible without anyone looking over your shoulder

You will act as a primary liaison and partner for Audience and Field teams, turning briefs into clear, actionable plans and partnering with Field to support aligned global and local campaign activation. You will track campaign performance across awareness, sales, and renewal, surfacing insights that improve campaigns and GTM effectiveness. This is a role for a confident, collaborative operator who thrives in a cross-functional environment, ready to guide and support colleagues while driving end-to-end campaign delivery and performance.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Own end-to-end campaign delivery for priority business areas and portfolio initiatives
Act as primary liaison for Audience and Field teams, ensuring briefs are clear, aligned, and translated into actionable execution plans
Drive campaign strategy and execution support for regional campaigns
Coordinate cross-functionally across Content, Creative, and execution teams
Lead campaign performance tracking, optimization, and insight sharing for priority business areas and portfolio initiatives
Reports into Director of Global Campaigns

TYPICAL ACTIVITIES

Lead or partner on the development of campaign strategies based on briefs from Audience and/or Field
Integrate global priorities and regional needs into cohesive campaign approaches
Manage campaign briefing, ensuring inputs are clear, aligned, and actionable
Coordinate creative and asset development with Content and Creative teams
Translate campaign strategy into localized execution with Field teams
Lead end-to-end campaign delivery and optimization
Share performance insights with Audience, Field, and Product teams
Works with peers across Demand & Lifecycle Marketing to ensure cohesiveness and coordination across multiple campaigns in market

PROFILE & EXPERIENCE

Strong experience in B2B campaign or demand generation marketing
Proven ability to manage multi-channel campaign execution and optimization
Strong stakeholder management across Audience, Field, and Marketing teams
Confident cross-functional operator who can guide and support junior colleagues

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

At Elsevier, campaigns are the engine that connects strategy to market impact. description:
ABOUT

We are a new international school in Singapore committed to delivering excellence in education and nurturing a generation of culturally diverse students. Our mission is to create a community that fosters curiosity, creativity, and a lifelong passion for learning.

ROLE

The Senior Marketing Manager manages the operational delivery of the school’s marketing activities in support of enrolment, brand awareness and community engagement. The role translates agreed marketing priorities into campaigns, events and projects; coordinates internal teams and external partners; and tracks delivery and results. Strategic direction and priorities are set with the school’s leadership and marketing lead.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Campaigns and Promotions

Coordinate and deliver integrated marketing campaigns across digital, print, events and partner channels, based on agreed objectives and audience segments.

Manage campaign timelines, briefs, creative assets, approvals, landing pages and calls to action.

Work with Admissions to align campaign activity with enquiry generation, open houses and other recruitment priorities.

Track campaign activity and results, identify delivery issues and share recommendations for optimization.

Search and Digital Marketing

Manage the appointed agency’s delivery of Search Engine Marketing (SEM), including paid search campaigns on platforms such as Google Ads. Coordinate campaign briefs, keywords, ad copy, budgets and landing pages; review results such as impressions, clicks, cost per click, conversions and enquiry quality.

Coordinate Search Engine Optimization (SEO) activity to improve the school’s visibility in unpaid search results. This may include keyword and content recommendations, page titles and descriptions, website content updates, internal linking and monitoring organic traffic and search performance.

Coordinate paid social and other digital campaigns with agencies or platform partners, ensuring assets, targeting, tracking and reporting are in place.

Coordinate website and landing page updates through the relevant content management system (CMS), keeping information accurate and the enquiry journey clear.

Liaise with Admissions and CRM users to support campaign tracking and follow-up of marketing-generated enquiries.

Events and Community Activity

Plan and deliver marketing support for open houses, school events, exhibitions, webinars and community initiatives.

Coordinate event promotion, registration communications, collateral, suppliers, logistics and post-event follow-up.

Work with Admissions and relevant school teams to ensure event activity supports family engagement and enrolment objectives.

Marketing Projects and Content

Coordinate marketing projects from brief to completion, maintaining schedules, deliverables, approvals and stakeholder updates.

Work with internal teams and external creatives to develop and update digital and print materials, including photography, video, banners, brochures and campaign assets.

Coordinate EDMs and other audience communications, including copy, design, audience lists, approvals and deployment.

Ensure materials follow the school’s agreed brand and messaging guidelines, escalating content or positioning decisions to the marketing lead.

Agency, Media and Partner Liaison

Manage day-to-day relationships with digital agencies, media contacts, vendors and third-party partners.

Prepare clear briefs, coordinate approvals and assets, monitor timelines and follow up on agreed deliverables.

Coordinate media placements, listings, sponsorships and promotional opportunities with relevant external organizations.

Budget and Performance Reporting

Track campaign and event spend against approved budgets and coordinate quotations, purchase requests and supplier invoices.

Maintain a marketing calendar and records of campaign, event and partner activity.

Compile regular reports on campaign delivery and performance, including lead generation, website and search activity, event registrations and spend.

Use results and feedback to suggest practical improvements to future activity.

REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Marketing, Public Relations, or related field is preferred.

At least 7 years of experience in similar role, with at least 3 years in a leadership role. Experience in the education sector is desirable.

Proven track record of developing and implementing successful marketing strategies.

Strong leadership skills and the ability to manage cross-functional teams.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in English.

Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Strong analytical skills and some experience with CRM and CMS systems.

Knowledge of the Singapore and International education market is a plus.

At RD American School, you’ll be part of a forward-thinking team shaping the future of education. You’ll have the opportunity to innovate, lead, and make a meaningful impact on learners and families across the region.

title: B2B Marketing Sales Account Manager (Remote)
description:
Job Description

About Us

We help interior design and renovation firms in Singapore grow — through lead generation, branding, and marketing programmes that bring them qualified homeowners and stronger market positioning. Our clients don't just buy a service from us once; they grow with us across tiers as their firms scale. That only works when someone closes the right clients — and then owns the relationship after the first close.

That someone is you.

About the Role

This is a fully remote role.

You'll work from wherever you work best — no daily commute, no office face-time. What matters is that your clients feel looked after and your accounts grow. You'll meet clients over video calls (with the occasional in-person session if a key relationship calls for it), and stay connected to the team through our daily rhythms online.

This is a closing role first, a relationship role always.

You'll start by building your own book of business: running sales conversations with interior design firms, diagnosing where their business is stuck, and closing them into the right programme. Every deal you close becomes an account you own — and from there, your job is to make each relationship deeper, longer, and more valuable over time.

The more you close early on, the bigger the portfolio you manage — and the more your recurring income compounds through renewals, tier upgrades, and referrals. You are the person our clients trust from the very first call, the one who checks in before they have to ask, and the reason they sign, renew, upgrade, and refer.

What You'll Do

Run discovery and sales calls with interior design and renovation firms — diagnosing their growth bottlenecks and closing them into the programme that fits

Manage your own sales pipeline end to end: qualification, follow-ups, objection handling, and closing, with clear monthly targets

Own every account you close as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor

Run regular check-ins and performance reviews with clients — walking them through their results, diagnosing bottlenecks, and recommending next steps

Drive renewals by ensuring clients see and understand the value they're getting throughout the programme, not just at renewal time

Identify and develop expansion opportunities — helping clients climb to higher programme tiers when their business is ready for it

Generate referrals naturally by building the kind of relationship people recommend to their peers

Work with our internal teams to resolve client issues quickly and keep promises made during the sales process

Maintain accurate account records, follow-up rhythms, and relationship health tracking in our CRM

Who You Are

2+ years in B2B sales, account management, or client success — with a track record of hitting sales targets and closing deals

A closer who thinks long-term: you know how to drive a deal to a decision, but you close clients you can grow, not just deals you can win

A natural relationship builder — the close is the start of the relationship, not the end of it

Consistent with follow-through: you do what you say, on time, every time

A clear communicator who can explain performance data and business concepts simply, in person and in writing

Commercially sharp — you can spot an upsell or referral opportunity without making the client feel sold to

Organised and self-directed: you manage your own portfolio, pipeline of renewals, and follow-up cadence

Proven ability to work independently in a remote setup — you stay responsive, structured, and visible without anyone looking over your shoulder

Bonus: experience in or exposure to the interior design, renovation, real estate, or home services industry

Why Join Us

100% remote

— you're measured on client outcomes, not hours at a desk

Base salary + commissions on every deal you close, plus recurring incentives on retention, renewals, and account growth — your income compounds as your portfolio grows

Build your own book of business from day one, backed by proven sales scripts, frameworks, and playbooks — you close it, you keep it, you grow it

Clear frameworks, playbooks, and training on how we sell, manage, and grow accounts

A front-row seat to how design and renovation businesses in Singapore scale

To Apply

Reach out directly to our Head of Sales, Nigel:

WhatsApp: +65 9061 4389

Only candidates who reach out via WhatsApp will be contacted — a short intro message telling us who you are and why this role fits you is all it takes to start the conversation.

*Company Overview:* Truegenics Pte Ltd is a leading ecommerce company based in Singapore with a track record of over US$218M in online product sales. The Specialist will focus on optimizing conversions through data-driven insights, developing and executing robust promotional strategies, and working closely with our Operations and PPC teams to ensure flawless high and low-level execution. This person will act as the analytical engine for our campaigns, processing complex data to discern winning strategies from underperforming ones, and guiding the brands toward sustainable, high-impact growth.

*Key Responsibilities:*

*Promotions & Campaigns*

* *Promotions Planning & Execution:* Take full ownership of developing and executing promotional strategies and campaigns. Coordinate seamlessly with the Operations and PPC teams to ensure all promo strategies and executions are carried out accurately and on time.
* *Data-Driven Insights & Analytics:* Process and analyze campaign data and key e-commerce metrics (e.g., ROAS, ACOS, TACoS). Exercise strong analytical judgment to discern "what is good and what is bad" in campaign performance, providing actionable insights to optimize overall spend and ROI.

*Merchandising & Content Execution*

* *Content Optimization:* Optimize and update keywords (KWs), product descriptions, image assets, and A+ content to maximize organic ranking and conversions.
* *Listings Management:* Create fully optimized new listings for new product launches and update existing listings where needed.
* *Inventory Management & Transparency Program: *Manage inventory replenishment, ensuring stock levels are optimal, discrepancies are resolved, and oversee Amazon's Transparency Program to prevent unauthorized sellers.
* *Competitor Benchmarking:* Continuously track competitor content (ads, videos, images, etc.) and benchmark competitor SKU prices to maintain our competitive edge.
* *Collaboration & Trend Identification:* Identify current trends in e-commerce content. Work closely with the Affiliates team to identify winning external content and mirror those strategies onto our Amazon listings.

*Cross-Functional & Strategic Support*

* *Cross-Team Collaboration:* Act as the central hub between Marketing, Operations, and PPC teams. Align stakeholders on campaign strategies, improve cross-departmental execution processes, and ensure all teams are synchronized for major promotions across all brands.
* *Reporting & Analytics:* Maintain, generate, and present detailed reports on promotional and campaign performance metrics to stakeholders, driving strategic decision-making.

*Key Skills / Experience Required:*

* *Education:* Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).
* *Experience:* At least 3 years in eCommerce or Digital Marketing, with a strong focus on the Amazon marketplace.
* *Campaign & Promotion Management:* Proven ability to plan, launch, and manage e-commerce promotional campaigns, coordinating with various teams to ensure successful execution.
* *Analytical & Strategic Insight:* Exceptional analytical skills. Must be highly capable of processing raw data, identifying trends, and discerning successful tactics from underperforming ones to drive future strategy.
* *Cross-Functional Leadership:* Experience collaborating with operations, advertising (PPC), and creative teams to bring campaigns to life.
* *Tools Proficiency:* Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central, advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP), and data analysis tools like Helium 10 or ScaleInsight.

title: Assistant Manager – Trade Marketing & Commercial Planning
description:
Role Overview

The Assistant Manager – Trade Marketing & Commercial Planning will support the

growth of Retail, Food Service and E-commerce channels through trade marketing

initiatives, category development, market intelligence and commercial analysis.

This role works closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, brand principals and external

partners to translate market and customer insights into effective promotional

programmes, category strategies and commercial opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

1. Trade Marketing & Channel Development

• Plan and execute trade marketing activities, promotional campaigns, product

launches and brand activations across Retail, Food Service and E-commerce

channels.

• Partner with Sales teams to develop promotional plans, customer presentations,

product catalogues, POSM and other sales-support materials.

• Coordinate with brand principals, agencies, suppliers and external partners to

ensure timely execution of marketing initiatives.

• Support trade exhibitions, customer events, product demonstrations and industry-

related activities.

• Maintain marketing and promotional calendars to ensure coordinated execution

across different channels.

• Oversee the company's social media activities, including content planning, posting

schedules, audience engagement and performance monitoring.

2. Category Management & Market Insights

• Conduct regular market and outlet visits across supermarkets, convenience stores,

wholesalers, food service operators and key customer accounts.

• Identify opportunities relating to product assortment, pricing, promotions,

distribution and in-store visibility.

• Monitor competitor movements, new product introductions, market trends and

changes in consumer or customer behaviour.

• Analyse category performance and recommend initiatives to improve sales,

profitability and market share.

• Support range reviews, product rationalisation and new product listing exercises.

• Prepare category reviews and commercial recommendations for management and

brand principals.

3. Commercial Analysis & Business Planning

• Analyse sales, volume, margins, pricing and customer performance.

• Review monthly performance against budget and prepare sales gap and variance

analysis.

• Identify key business drivers behind performance gaps and recommend appropriate

corrective actions.

• Evaluate promotional effectiveness, customer investments and return on marketing

spend.

• Develop business cases for new product launches, promotional programmes and

potential growth opportunities.

• Provide commercial insights and recommendations to Sales and Management.

4. E-commerce & Online Channel Management

• Support the development and implementation of strategies to grow online sales

across e-commerce platforms and marketplaces.

• Manage product listings, online content, pricing and promotional updates.

• Track online sales, conversion, customer engagement and other relevant

performance indicators.

• Monitor online market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities for

growth.

• Work with Sales, Operations and Marketing teams to improve online execution and

customer experience.

5. Digital Platform & Application Coordination

• Coordinate the ongoing maintenance and improvement of company digital

platforms, including CRM, ordering and merchandising applications.

• Liaise with external technology partners and agencies on system issues,

enhancements and platform improvements.

• Monitor application performance, user feedback and usage trends.

• Support digital marketing activities across websites, email marketing and social

media channels.

6. Reporting, Insights & Management Presentation

• Prepare monthly sales performance and gap analysis reports for management.

• Develop category reviews, business performance reports and commercial analysis.

• Prepare management presentations, business reviews and recommendation decks

using PowerPoint.

• Present findings, insights and proposed actions to internal stakeholders,

management and brand principals.

• Maintain dashboards and reporting tools to track key commercial and business

performance indicators.

Key Requirements

Education & Experience

• Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Business, Retail Management, Commercial

Management or a related discipline.

• 3–5 years of relevant experience in Trade Marketing, Category Management,

Commercial Planning, E-commerce or Sales Analytics.

• Experience within FMCG, Food & Beverage, Retail or Distribution environments

will be advantageous.

• Candidates with a combination of trade marketing and commercial/sales analysis

experience are encouraged to apply.

Technical & Analytical Skills

• Strong Microsoft Excel skills with the ability to analyse and interpret commercial

data.

• Strong PowerPoint skills with experience preparing management and customer-

facing presentations.

• Experience working with market intelligence, retailer scan data or syndicated

market data such as Nielsen.

• Strong capability in sales analysis, reporting and performance tracking.

• Experience developing business cases and commercial recommendations.

• Familiarity with e-commerce platforms, digital marketing tools and online

marketplace operations.

Personal Attributes

• Commercially driven with strong understanding of business and customer needs.

• Analytical and comfortable working with numbers, trends and performance data.

• Able to convert data and market insights into practical business recommendations.

• Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.

• Proactive, hands-on and comfortable working across multiple functions.

• Results-oriented with strong attention to execution and follow-through.
