Crisis & Reputation Management: Monitor trends, social listening insights, and platform updates, while managing brand safety and partnering with PR on crisis management when needed.

You:

Education: BA/BS degree or equivalent experience.
Industry Experience: 12+ years of experience in tech, marketing, or a related industry with a proven track record in social media strategy and management.
Platform & AI Knowledge: Strong understanding of social platforms, emerging AI tools, and audience behaviour.
Strategic & Creative Thinking: A strategic and creative thinker who can navigate the ever-evolving social landscape and leverage AI and emerging tech for marketing.
Strategy Execution: Proven ability to develop and execute social strategies that drive engagement and growth.

Stakeholder Management: Able to positively influence diverse stakeholders and galvanise them on the social agenda and mission of the brand.
Regional Collaboration: Ability to work with local and geographically dispersed stakeholders to deliver clear instructions and directions.
Project Management: Solid project management experience, with an ability to bring both order and attention to detail.
Tool Expertise: Experience with social media publishing tools like Sprinklr and familiar with platform setup for Google Cloud use cases.
B2B Background: Background in the B2B or technology space is preferred.
Tool Proficiency: Proficiency with social media management tools such as Buffer, Hootsuite, and Sprout Social, alongside analytics platforms including Google Analytics and Meta Business Suite.
Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written English communication and presentation skills.

Our company is looking to hire a marketing assistant who will be working closely with our marketing team to develop and implement marketing plans and strategies for our brands. As a successful hire, you will be tasked with helping identify marketing trends and opportunities for growth, as well as creating marketing materials such as white papers and case studies. You will be giving presentations about our ongoing campaigns and provide administrative support to our marketing and sales teams.

To be chosen for this role, you must have a bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field. Prior work experience in administration, sales, or marketing is a plus. Effective written and verbal communication skills and a high level of attention to detail are both important keys to success in this role.

Marketing Assistant Manager Responsibilities:

• Collaborating with the marketing manager, internal teams, clients and partners on marketing strategy.

• Helping identify marketing trends and key opportunities for innovation.

• Learning and working with various types of software for digital marketing.

• Working closely with sales and marketing department.

• Creating marketing materials such as white papers, case studies, and presentations.

• Giving presentations.

• Maintaining a marketing database.

• Providing administrative support to the marketing and sales team.

• Preparing, formatting and editing a range of documents.

• Understanding company product and brand.

• General office duties.

• Creating and interpreting a variety of reports.

• Organizing market research.

• Analyzing questionnaires and other forms of feedback.

• Updating social media accounts.

• Perform any other duties assigned by the director.

Marketing Assistant Manager Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business or related field.

• Administration or sales and marketing assistant experience.

• Effective written and verbal communication skills.

• A high level of attention to detail.

• Ability to work effectively within a team and independently.

• Experience using computers for a variety of tasks.

• Competency in Microsoft applications including Word, Excel, and Outlook.

• Good organization skills.

• Related job and internship experience.

• Digital marketing experience.

• The ability to work under pressure.

• Availability to work within opening hours (e.g. evenings, holidays, weekends).

The Media Manager is the leader in project scoping and delivery – a ‘go to’ person to manage the clients’ business. He/she will be responsible for developing and implementing ongoing strategic communication solutions that achieve objectives and measurable results.

Performing an end-to-end communication management role, the Media Manager is responsible for on-time delivery and accountability. To do this role effectively you must also be incredibly flexible to meet changing client needs. This role also includes developing project team members and providing effective feedback, coaching and direction that enables them to learn and grow on-the-job.

There is also a business development element to the role which involves farming current clients for new opportunities and growing existing opportunities as well as supporting directors in looking for new business.

What does a Media Manager at SCREAME do?

You are responsible for leading through the line (online, online) media communication strategies. Through creative thinking with factual analysis, develop appropriate approaches, ensuring campaigns reach their target audiences as effectively and efficiently as possible.

A keen analytical mind and interest in consumer behaviour to build the foundation of every strategy and plan. Working with syndicated and sourced data to provide insights and recommendations that answers the brief and objectives. A deep understanding on the local media landscape and keeping yourself updated on the latest trends and developments via constant communications with vendors and technology providers.

Be a sharp and effective negotiator, by understanding the client’s and campaign’s needs and procuring the best value for the project in terms of quality. Less can be more at times.

Working with various stakeholders eg creative, media vendors, clients, teammates etc to ensure a collaborative, professional and smooth partnership on all projects. Taking on the initiative to be malleable and quick on your feet when crisis arises, providing solutions and minimising any damages. Managing and aligning expectations across all parties to promote a healthy working environment.Media Manager

Roles & responsibilities:

Leads the client servicing role and ensure their needs are always addressed.

Attends client briefing or progress meetings and prepare briefs/background

Aligns communications practices with business goals and client KPIs/milestones

Develops and present proposals, pitches and new business meetings in partnership with a director

Provides a clear brief, always including rationale and context, to the project team and engage them in the strategic objectives of the project

Monitors and manages on-going campaigns to ensure they are on plan and optimise for better performance.

Provide insightful interim and post campaign report that can be utilised for kick starting future projects or learnings for upcoming campaigns.

Ensures that Clients are efficiently charged for the work the agency has performed

Keeps her/himself updated on latest media developments and trends. Keen to upscale knowledge through self-learning or external vendor workshops.

Guide executive/s to manage day to day executions and train them on media and client servicing fundamentals.

What do we want in our Media Manager?

Minimum of 4-5 years work experience in a media agency and have the maturity to manage a team of executives.

Well versed in offline and digital platforms, namely

1. Offline: print, outdoor, radio, magazines, etc

2. Online: Digital portals and other self-serve platforms like SEM, Programmatic, Facebook/ Instagram, Outbrain, etc

Experience with digital 3rd party ad serving

Keen interest in meeting new people and always being articulate and confident

Being able to look deeper into numbers and tell a meaningful story and providing value with insights

Ability to think challenge norms and bend rules in providing solutions

Ability to perform effectively under pressure to meet deadlines without sacrificing professional standards

Demonstrate expertise in strategic thinking, development of media communications strategies, optimising and executing media plans.

Well established professional development network and active participation in ongoing learning opportunities

Leader/manager of a project, with end-to-end responsibility for the delivery as well as achievement of objectives and measurable results.

Depending on our campaign needs and your hunger to learn, we will be provide training based on the projects you are allocated to.

title: Manager/Senior Manager, Marketing & Brand Office (MXD)
description:
Plan, deliver and evaluate integrated marketing campaigns, taking end-to-end ownership – from understanding the audience and objectives, through content and media execution, to performance evaluation and recommendations for improvement. The role combines campaign management, content development, digital marketing, insights and reporting, and hands-on execution.

The successful candidate should exercise sound marketing judgement, confidently manage internal stakeholders and agency partners, and be able to translate business and communications objectives into effective marketing approaches. The candidate should also be comfortable developing or adapting straightforward creative assets in-house, such as social media carousels, EDM visuals and banners, where appropriate.

What you will be working on:

1. Integrated Campaign Management

• Lead integrated marketing campaigns from strategic planning and channel selection through to implementation, optimisation and post-campaign evaluation.

• Manage campaign timelines, budgets, deliverables, approvals and dependencies to ensure effective and timely delivery.

• Develop clear briefs and manage creative, media and other agency partners, ensuring accountability for agreed objectives, budgets and timelines.

• Recommend appropriate audiences, channels, content and campaign approaches based on communications objectives, audience needs and available insights.

• Manage internal stakeholders to align on objectives and desired outcomes, translating inputs into clear recommendations and actionable direction for agencies and partners.

2. Content Development and Communications

• Develop and refine audience-facing content across campaign, social, digital and other communication touchpoints.

• Translate policy, programme and technical information into clear, engaging and accessible communications for the intended audience.

• Develop coherent campaign narratives and messages, applying sound judgement on audience, tone and context.

• Ensure content and creative executions are accurate, on-brand and consistent across channels.

3. Practical Creative Execution and Asset Production

• Develop or adapt in-house marketing assets, including social media carousels, EDM visuals, digital banners and basic short-form videos, to accelerate delivery.

• Leverage accessible creative and AI-enabled tools effectively to improve production efficiency while maintaining quality and brand consistency.

• Apply working knowledge of visual design principles, including layout, typography, imagery and visual hierarchy; professional design training is not required.

4. Insights, Measurement and Reporting

• Analyse campaign performance metrics, audience research and relevant data sources to gather meaningful insights and identify optimisation opportunities.

• Translate findings into clear recommendations to inform campaign decisions and optimisation.

• Prepare concise reports and presentations for management, highlighting outcomes, implications and recommended next steps.

Requirements

• Excellent command of written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate complex information clearly and effectively.

• Strong critical and strategic thinking, with sound marketing judgement and the confidence to form a point of view and make recommendations.

• Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage priorities, timelines, budgets and multiple workstreams independently.

• Effective stakeholder and agency management skills, with the ability to provide clear direction and navigate differing perspectives.

• Ability to interpret campaign data, research and insights and translating them into practical recommendations.

• Familiarity with content creation tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or equivalent platforms.

• Familiarity with AI tools for ideation, writing, research, image or video production, with sound judgement regarding accuracy, copyright and responsible use.

• Proficiency in another official language, such as Chinese, Malay or Tamil, would be an advantage.

• At least 4 years of relevant work experience in marketing, communications or a related field.

• Experience in digital marketing, paid social, media planning or campaign optimisation.

• Experience working with creative, media or production agencies.

• Strong attention to detail and quality, particularly for public-facing content and creative assets.

• Proactive, resourceful and comfortable working independently through ambiguity and changing requirements.

1. Thinking Clearly and Making Sound Judgements

• You collect and analyse different sources of information to aid your assessment of the problem at hand.

• You consider and evaluate possible solutions and propose the most appropriate one.

2. Serving with Heart, Commitment and Purpose

• You serve citizens with empathy while respecting standard operating procedures and policies.

• You prioritise work tasks to deliver on agency and whole-of-government outcomes.

• You show consideration for stakeholders by engaging them throughout a project and keeping them updated on plans and progress.

3. Working as One Public Service

• You understand how your work contributes to whole-of-government outcomes.

• You reconcile differences in opinions and develop a plan to achieve common goals.

• You contribute and share information and knowledge within and across agencies.

• You build and maintain a strong network of contacts within and across agencies.

4. Working Effectively with Citizens and Stakeholders

• You actively reach out to citizens and stakeholders to gather feedback.

• You identify gaps in meeting their needs and propose possible solutions to close these gaps.

• You work with citizens and stakeholders to co-create solutions to advance a common good.

• You explain policy intent and processes in a way that signals care and concern for citizens and stakeholders.

5. Improving and Innovating Continuously

• You constantly experiment with ideas to improve work processes and service delivery while managing risks and mitigating the potential impact of change.

• You consider the perspectives of different stakeholders in your efforts to streamline work processes.

6. Keep Learning and Putting Skills into Action

• You proactively keep up with, and apply, new knowledge in your work domain.

• You seek and embrace learning opportunities for personal and professional growth within and beyond your work domain.

• You share your learnings with colleagues and encourage them to put new knowledge into practice.

Candidates are encouraged to sign up for a Careers & Skills Passport (CSP) account and include your CSP public profile in your resume. Please check out www.myskillsfuture.gov.sg for details on the CSP.

title: Lead Generation & Short-Form Content Copywriter
description:
*Compensation:* $2,000–$4,000 USD/month
*Location:* Remote
*Employment Type:* Full-time
*Experience Level:* Experienced professionals only

About Kings Media

Kings Media helps founders build their personal brands through strategic content and organic growth.

We're looking for a Lead Generation & Short-Form Content Copywriter who understands how to turn audience insights into compelling content that captures attention, builds trust, starts conversations, and generates business opportunities.

This is not a beginner-level writing position. We want someone with *real, hands-on experience creating short-form content* and a strong understanding of how content supports marketing and lead generation.

You should understand the relationship between:

*Audience → Problem → Hook → Content → CTA → Lead*

You won't just be writing captions or generating ideas. You'll help create content with a clear purpose and contribute to a content strategy designed to drive measurable business results.

What You'll DoShort-Form Content Creation

* Develop content ideas for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other relevant social platforms.
* Write compelling hooks, opening lines, talking points, and scripts for short-form videos.
* Turn long-form content, interviews, founder insights, and existing ideas into engaging short-form assets.
* Develop Instagram carousels, captions, stories, pinned-post copy, and other written social media content.
* Help structure Instagram profiles, Stories, Highlights, and pinned posts to communicate value and encourage inquiries.
* Create content angles that capture attention, maintain interest, and encourage viewers to take action.

Content Strategy & Copywriting

* Research target audiences, customer pain points, objections, desires, and buying motivations.
* Develop content pillars, messaging angles, and campaigns aligned with business objectives.
* Write educational, authority-building, storytelling, and direct-response content.
* Create compelling headlines, hooks, CTAs, and offer-focused messaging.
* Turn products and services into content that clearly communicates their value.
* Repurpose existing content into multiple formats without losing the original message.

Lead Generation & Optimization

* Create content designed to generate qualified leads, inquiries, and sales conversations.
* Connect each piece of content to a clear objective and call to action.
* Research competitors, successful content formats, and industry trends.
* Test different hooks, messaging angles, and CTAs.
* Review content performance and use available engagement and conversion data to improve future content.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to develop and improve organic lead-generation campaigns.

What We're Looking For

* At least 2 years of professional experience in content writing, copywriting, social media marketing, or a closely related field.
* *Demonstrable hands-on experience creating short-form video content*, particularly Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts.
* Experience writing scripts, hooks, captions, or content concepts for short-form videos.
* A strong portfolio of published content or relevant work samples.
* Experience creating content for businesses, founders, personal brands, agencies, consultants, or service providers.
* Proven understanding of direct-response copywriting and lead-generation principles.
* Strong storytelling, audience research, and customer psychology skills.
* Ability to write compelling hooks and CTAs that encourage action.
* Excellent written English and the ability to communicate ideas clearly.
* Ability to explain the reasoning behind content decisions.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver consistently.

*Important:* We are looking for candidates who have actually worked on short-form content projects—not applicants whose experience is limited to general blog writing, generic captions, or theoretical marketing knowledge.

Bonus Points

* Experience working with founders, creators, agencies, consultants, or B2B businesses.
* Experience developing organic lead-generation campaigns.
* Understanding of short-form video retention, pacing, storytelling, and audience engagement.
* Experience with Instagram Stories, Highlights, and profile conversion strategies.
* Experience with LinkedIn content, email marketing, or SEO content.
* Familiarity with Canva, AI-assisted workflows, and content analytics.
* Examples of content that generated qualified leads, inbound inquiries, or sales opportunities.

What We're NOT Looking For

* Someone who has never worked on short-form video content.
* Someone who only writes generic captions without understanding the strategy behind them.
* Someone who relies entirely on AI to produce content.
* Someone who focuses only on views, likes, or follower growth.
* Someone who cannot provide a portfolio or relevant work samples.
* Someone who cannot explain how their content supports a business objective.

We value creative thinking, but creativity alone is not enough. We want someone who understands how to turn attention into trust and trust into action.

Compensation

*$2,000–$4,000 USD per month*, depending on experience, demonstrated ability, portfolio quality, and the value you can bring to the team.

How to Apply

Complete the Kings Media application form:

https://kingsmedia.notion.site/3ce6468eef6780b48cfaefdccaf32d7f?pvs=105

Your application must include a Loom video introducing yourself and walking us through a relevant piece of work.

Please be prepared to explain:

* Your experience creating short-form content.
* Your role in developing the content, scripts, hooks, or copy.
* The reasoning behind your creative and strategic decisions.
* Any results you can demonstrate, including leads, inquiries, engagement, or conversions.

We care more about demonstrated skills, relevant experience, and the quality of your work than the length of your résumé.

*Work Location:* Remote

Job Number26134805

JOB SUMMARY:

The Executive, Brand Photography Operations, will provide project coordination and operational support to the Manager, Brand Photography, for hotel photography projects across Premium, Select, and Midscale brands in APEC.

The role will support the end-to-end photography workflow, from project initiation and pre-production through image-review coordination, final documentation, and asset delivery. The Executive will help ensure that projects progress according to agreed timelines, submissions are complete and accurately recorded, and hotels and photographers receive timely process guidance.

The position will work extensively with Marriott’s photography platform and serve as a day-to-day coordination contact for hotels, Area teams, photographers, and internal stakeholders. Final creative decisions, brand approvals, photographer governance, process strategy, and escalations will remain with the Manager, Brand Photography.

This is a six-month temporary role established to provide operational capacity during a period of significant photography project activity.

SCOPE OF WORK:

Overall Project Management:

Photography project coordination

Create, maintain, and monitor photography projects on the photography platform.
Maintain accurate project trackers, timelines, status updates, and follow-up actions.
Coordinate with hotels and photographers on shot lists, recce submissions, styling decks, post-production files, and final deliverables.
Follow up on overdue actions and flag timeline or submission risks to the Manager.
Schedule preparation calls, webinars, review sessions, and office hours.
Maintain clear records of project decisions, feedback, and approvals.

Pre-production support

Check photography requests, hotel information, shot lists, and project documentation for completeness.
Support introductions and coordination between hotel teams and approved photographers.
Confirm that relevant photography resources and preparation guidance have been shared.
Track recce decks, styling submissions, talent information, and supporting documents.
Consolidate submissions for Manager review and communicate approved feedback.

Image-review workflow support

Organize and prepare photography submissions for Manager review.
Conduct initial checks for completeness, duplication, file naming, and clearly visible inconsistencies against approved checklists.
Record and communicate approved comments to photographers.
Track revised submissions and confirm that comments have been addressed.
Reconcile approved images against the final shot list.
Escalate creative, technical, legal, or brand-interpretation questions to the Manager.

Final assets and compliance documentation

Check that high-resolution images, contact sheets, usage-rights documentation, and applicable talent or model releases have been received.
Organize final asset packages in the appropriate systems and folders.
Prepare documentation required for LOC review and issuance by the Manager.
Support the transfer of approved assets and documentation to relevant hotel and internal teams.
Maintain records of legacy, rendered, limited, or temporary assets and their documented expiry information.

AURA administration and reporting

Monitor platform dashboards, notifications, pending submissions, and project status.
Support hotels and photographers with routine system and process questions.
Maintain data accuracy across project records.
Prepare regular status reports covering open projects, delayed actions, upcoming shoots, and pending reviews.
Identify recurring workflow issues and recommend practical process improvements.
Support testing and documentation for approved platform enhancements.

Vendor and administrative support

Maintain current photographer contact and market-coverage information.
Coordinate collection of quotations and vendor-registration documents.
Check invoices against approved quotations, shot lists, and final delivered assets before routing them for approval.
Maintain organized records of agreements, invoices, approvals, and project documentation.
Provide other photography coordination support assigned by the Manager.

CANDIDATE PROFILE:

Education and Experience:

Diploma or bachelor’s degree in hospitality, marketing, communications, photography, media, project management, or a related discipline preferred.
One to three years of relevant experience in project coordination, hospitality marketing, photography production, creative operations, content management, or brand support.
Experience working with hotels, photographers, creative agencies, or digital-asset workflows would be advantageous.
Direct professional photography experience is not essential, but an interest in visual content and willingness to learn photography standards are important.
Strong written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in an additional Asian language would be advantageous.

Skills and Abilities:

Strong organization and project-tracking skills.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and deadlines.
High attention to detail in files, documents, trackers, and asset packages.
Confidence using Microsoft Office, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and digital workflow platforms.
Ability to follow established photography and brand standards consistently.
Clear and professional communication with hotels, photographers, and internal stakeholders.
Ability to distinguish routine coordination matters from issues requiring escalation.
Basic visual awareness and interest in architectural and lifestyle photography.
Ability to work independently on defined tasks while taking direction on creative and judgment-based matters.
Comfortable operating across multiple APEC markets and stakeholder groups.

title: Digital Content Specialist
description:
SL Aesthetic Group is a leading name in the aesthetics and wellness industry, with a diverse portfolio of established brands, including SL Aesthetic Clinic, SkinLab The Medical Spa, TrichoLab, Prologue, and Euphie. Each brand is dedicated to delivering premium experiences and effective results through professional expertise, innovation, and care.

Job Description

Content Strategy & Creative Ideation

Explore industry trends, audience behaviour, search demand and competitor insights to identify content gaps, emerging topics and opportunities for differentiation.

Develop and maintain a strategic content calendar that balances editorial priorities, audience interests, search opportunities and business objectives.

Pitch fresh ideas, compelling angles and distinctive content formats that engage audiences across different levels of knowledge and experience.

Build content strategies around audience needs and search intent, creating meaningful connections between what people want to know, what the brand can offer and what the business aims to achieve.

Editorial Voice & Written Content

Write and edit clear, engaging and well-researched content across blogs, articles, email newsletters, websites, landing pages, advertisements and social media.

Establish a strong editorial voice that makes complex concepts accessible, builds audience trust and differentiates the brand from competitors.

Balance editorial quality, originality and storytelling with search visibility, audience engagement and commercial objectives, ensuring content delivers value beyond rankings and traffic.

Translate complex topics into useful, relatable and easy-to-understand content without oversimplifying important information or losing the brand's point of view.

Apply strong editorial judgement to research, fact-checking, content structuring and editing, maintaining accuracy, clarity and consistency across all formats.

SEO, AI Search & Content Discoverability

Apply SEO fundamentals and advanced content optimisation techniques to improve organic visibility across traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered search experiences.

Structure content to support discoverability across search engine results, AI-generated answers and other relevant discovery platforms, using clear information architecture, descriptive headings, relevant entities and well-organised, authoritative content.

Understand how search intent, topical authority, internal linking, content depth and source credibility influence content discovery, and apply these principles throughout the content development process.

Monitor developments in AI search, answer engines and changing search behaviour to identify new opportunities for content visibility, brand mentions and citations.

Use relevant SEO and AI search tools to research topics, evaluate content performance and identify opportunities for optimisation, while maintaining original thinking, editorial integrity and human oversight.

Visual Content

Collaborate with designers to translate editorial ideas and complex information into engaging infographics, charts, illustrations and other visual formats.

Use AI-powered tools to create and refine infographics, data visualisations and supporting graphics that make complex concepts easier to understand and complement written content.

Performance Analytics & Optimisation

Track and analyse content performance across relevant metrics, including organic traffic, search visibility, AI citations and brand mentions, engagement, conversions and audience retention.

Interpret performance data to understand what resonates with audiences, identify content gaps and inform future editorial and distribution strategies.

Conduct experiments with headlines, content formats, visuals, calls to action and page structures to improve content effectiveness.

Conduct regular content audits to identify opportunities to refresh, consolidate, expand or repurpose existing content based on audience needs, search trends and business priorities.

Translate insights into actionable recommendations that improve content quality, discoverability and contribution to business goals.

AI-Assisted Content Development

Use AI-powered tools to support research, ideation, content analysis, workflow efficiency and optimisation, while applying sound editorial judgement and human oversight.

Evaluate AI-generated outputs critically, verifying factual accuracy, identifying generic or unsupported claims, and ensuring content reflects the brand's original perspective and editorial standards.

Identify opportunities to integrate AI into content workflows responsibly, improving efficiency without compromising originality, quality or audience trust.

Requirements

A bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, or a related field.

Minimum 2 years of experience as a Content Creator, Content Writer, or similar, with a portfolio that showcases versatility and creativity.

Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading abilities as well as the skill to switch tone depending on platform and audience.

Experience producing content for blogs, websites, and platforms such as X, Telegram, Discord, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, etc.

A solid grasp of SEO, content marketing, and digital storytelling.

Familiarity with CMS tools and social publishing platforms.

Strong research skills, especially when navigating medical aesthetics topics.

Ability to handle multiple projects at once, stay organised, and deliver on time.

A creative eye, a hunger to experiment, and a genuine love for creating great content.

A growth mindset, always improving, always learning.

Please indicate your last drawn salary and expectedsalary for the position you are applying for in your resume submission.

SL Aesthetic Group, founded in the 2000s, is one of Singapore’s largest and most reputable aesthetic groups in Singapore. It houses a diverse portfolio of brands, including SL Aesthetic Clinic, SkinLab The Medical Spa, TrichoLab and The Lifestyle Medical Clinic. Our brands offer a comprehensive range of treatments and services, encompassing advanced skincare solutions, medical spa therapies, hair and scalp treatments, as well as lifestyle and wellness services. title: Ad Product Marketing & Creative Lead
description:
About Cosmose AI

We make smartphones smarter. Cosmose is integrated by eight phone makers, capturing first-screen real estate and first-party data to drive over 2 billion daily user interactions in 60+ countries.

Why Join Cosmose AI?

Global Scale: Build a product natively integrated across eight major OEMs with access to first-party data from millions of phones in over 60 countries.
Elite Talent Density: Work alongside IOI and ACM-ICPC champions.
High Autonomy, Fast Velocity: Take complete ownership with rapid deployment cycles and a flat org chart.
Real Ownership: Earn stock options that directly tie your upside to our global growth and success.

We are looking for a hands-on Ad Product Marketing & Creative Lead to translate our KaiKai lock screen surface into a compelling, high-impact narrative that advertisers want to buy into.

This is a dual-impact role: you will own our go-to-market strategy, sales enablement, and corporate positioning from scratch, while staying deep in creative execution—setting the quality bar, building agency guidelines, and collaborating directly on client campaigns.

Who we think this person is

Most likely you are sitting in a strategy job at a creative agency, or in brand marketing, business marketing, or platform partnerships at a media house. If you already do ad product marketing at a platform, you will recognise this job instantly, and we want to hear from you, but we wrote this for the first two.

What you'll do

Go-to-market and product marketing

Own commercialisation for new ad formats, from first-client pilot through pilot programme to general availability
Define target advertiser segments and the problem each format solves for them
Write positioning, messaging and proof points, and keep sales speaking with one voice
Package formats into sellable offerings together with the CBO, who owns the rate card and pricing logic
Set and report success metrics for each launch: adoption, advertiser performance, revenue impact
Act as voice of the advertiser to product, and voice of product to sales

Sales-facing material and enablement

Own the full sales kit: decks, one-pagers, case studies, creative spec guides, objection handling
Every case study anchored to a measurable outcome, not a description of what ran
Train the sales team on new formats and refresh that training at each launch
Direct external design and production partners, and own those relationships and their briefs

Creative

Run brand collaborations end to end: concept, pitch, execution with the client's agency, sign-off
Work with the Creative Team
Set and hold the quality bar on everything that runs on the KaiKai surface
Build creative guidelines and a reference library agencies can work to without hand-holding
Put creative testing in place so format and execution decisions are evidenced rather than argued

Market

Track competing platforms: what they offer, how they package it, what they charge
Represent the product as subject matter expert in client and agency meetings, with the sales team
Co-build the annual product moment with the CBO (not the first year)

Cosmose corporate marketing and communication

Clean up corporate positioning and the public-facing basics: website, LinkedIn, company boilerplate
Keep a regular communication rhythm so client outreach lands on a company that looks alive
Owns the work.

KaiKai consumer brand

With the CBO, positioning of the consumer app and the case for voluntary download

What we're looking for

Six years or more; the title on your CV doesn't matter. Strategy, planning, brand marketing, business marketing, product marketing. What matters is what you have made, not what the role was called.
You can take something technical and turn it into a reason a marketer cares. This is the whole job in one line. We have a surface, a set of capabilities, and no story. You build the story, then you have to defend it to someone who buys media for a living.
You know how a brand buys media from the inside. What actually goes into an RFP. Who signs. What brand lift is and why measurement decides whether a budget grows or stays a test. If you have been on the buying side, this is your advantage, and it is the one we value most.
You have a view on creativity, and you can give a brand feedback they will accept. Not taste for its own sake. You can tell the difference between creative that will work on a specific surface and creative that was resized from a banner, and you can say so to a client without losing the client.
You can write about a company, not only about a product. Part of this job is making Cosmose look like a company a media buyer would take seriously. Website, LinkedIn, the basics. You do not need to have done corporate communications as a job. You need to be able to look at what we have today and say what a planner would think of it.
Your Polish and English are good enough to run meetings with internal teams and a global client. The team is spread across Warsaw, Singapore, the SEA market, and Brazil.
You are fine without a process. There is no playbook here yet, and you will be writing most of it.

What you do not need

You do not need to have worked at a platform. Most of the people we are talking to have not. We can teach you pricing, ad load, measurement partners, and how OEM deals work.
No adtech background and no technical knowledge of programmatic.
No sales experience. There is no quota, and you will not own accounts.
Not performance marketing. This is not a media buying or user acquisition role.

What you would be learning in the first six months

How this inventory is priced and why. How measurement works in OEM inventory, and why it is the thing that unlocks budgets. How an OEM partnership actually operates. If none of that sounds interesting, this is the wrong job, because it is where the first year goes.

We’re building something big—and we’re just getting started.

If you’re excited about shaping the future of AI-powered mobile content, we’d love to meet you.

Be part of the Cosmose story. Apply now!

About The Role

We are looking for a commercially driven, creative and proactive

Business Development & Adviser Marketing Executive

to work closely with an allocated Senior Financial Consultant (SFC). This is a hands-on, dual-function role combining prospecting, appointment setting, digital marketing, creative content production and campaign management to support the SFC's business growth.

The successful candidate will enjoy a performance-based remuneration structure comprising a monthly basic salary and commission, with opportunities to grow alongside the business.

Key Responsibilities

A. Business Development & Lead Generation

Identify, research and develop new business opportunities through online channels, professional networks, referrals, events and other suitable prospecting methods.

Generate and qualify leads and prospects that fit the SFC's target client profile.

Conduct proactive outreach to cold and warm prospects through appropriate communication channels.

Contact prospects and existing clients to arrange appointments, follow up on enquiries and coordinate meetings for the SFC.

Maintain an organised prospect pipeline, appointment calendar and lead-tracking database.

Build and nurture relationships with prospective clients, referral partners and relevant professional networks.

Attend networking sessions, industry events and business development activities to identify potential opportunities.

Monitor lead conversion, appointment attendance and follow-up outcomes, and recommend improvements to the prospecting process.

B. Adviser Marketing & Digital Content

Develop and execute marketing strategies and campaigns tailored to the SFC's target audience, business objectives and personal brand.

Ideate, plan, film and edit engaging short-form videos, reels, interviews and other digital content.

Create compelling marketing materials, social media posts, captions, visuals and campaign assets across relevant digital platforms.

Manage and maintain the SFC's approved social media presence and content calendar.

Leverage AI-powered tools to support content ideation, copywriting, editing, repurposing, research and workflow efficiency.

Develop creative campaign concepts to increase brand awareness, audience engagement, inbound enquiries and qualified leads.

Track and analyse campaign performance, including reach, engagement, enquiries, lead quality, appointment conversion and return on marketing spend where measurable.

Prepare regular marketing performance reports and recommend data-driven improvements.

Keep abreast of relevant digital marketing trends, content formats, platform developments and emerging AI tools.

C. Business Growth & Stakeholder Collaboration

Work closely with the allocated SFC to understand business priorities, target markets, client profiles and growth objectives.

Translate business objectives into actionable prospecting plans and marketing campaigns.

Coordinate with internal marketing, compliance and other relevant stakeholders to ensure marketing materials and activities follow GFC's policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

Maintain accurate records of leads, communications, appointments, campaigns and performance metrics.

Undertake other relevant business development and adviser marketing responsibilities as required.

Requirements

Minimum 2–3 years of relevant experience in business development, lead generation, digital marketing, content creation or a related field.

Degree or Diploma in Marketing, Communications, Media, Digital Media or a related discipline.

Proven ability to generate leads, engage prospects, arrange appointments and manage business development activities.

Strong portfolio showcasing content creation, video editing, or campaign work (personal, academic, or professional).

Demonstrated proficiency in video editing software (CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, and/or Adobe After Effects preferred)

Experience with AI-powered content creation tools such as Higgsfield, Runway or similar platforms.

Basic knowledge of marketing analytics platforms (Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, Sprout Social, etc).

Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects) is preferred.

Excellent attention to detail, creativity, and a strong aesthetic sense.

Strong communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills.

Proactive, organised and able to manage multiple campaigns, prospect follow-ups and deadlines independently.

Willingness to attend networking events and participate in business development activities outside the office when required.

Excellent English proficiency; additional languages relevant to GFC's target markets are an advantage.

Experience in financial services, wealth management, insurance, professional services or serving expatriate clients is an advantage.

Remuneration & Benefits

Competitive monthly basic salary + commission.

Opportunity to develop expertise across business development, digital marketing, creative content and wealth management client acquisition.

Collaborative working environment with direct exposure to business growth initiatives.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume together with a portfolio of relevant marketing campaigns, social media content, videos or other examples of their work. Candidates with demonstrable business development results may also include relevant examples of lead generation and appointment-setting achievements.

Job Description

We are seeking a dynamic, highly motivated, and commercially driven Regional Marketing Manager to lead student acquisition initiatives across China, Southeast Asia, and the broader Asia-Pacific (APAC) region.

As a key brand representative, you will play a pivotal role in driving student recruitment through daily live streaming, digital marketing, and audience engagement. You will be responsible for hosting compelling live broadcasts that engage prospective students, build brand credibility, generate qualified leads, and convert audience interest into successful student applications and enrolments.

You will also manage supporting digital channels, particularly Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) and WeChat, to strengthen brand visibility, promote live streaming sessions, and support regional student recruitment objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Live Streaming & Student Acquisition

Plan, produce, manage, and host engaging daily live streaming sessions across relevant digital platforms.

Develop compelling live content that showcases the institution's programmes, educational offerings, student experiences, and value propositions.

Engage prospective students in real time, address enquiries, build trust, and guide audiences through the student recruitment and enrolment journey.

Implement effective audience engagement and conversion strategies to generate qualified leads and drive student applications and enrolments.

2. Digital Marketing & Social Media Management

Manage and optimise regional digital marketing channels, particularly Xiaohongshu and WeChat, to increase brand awareness and drive traffic to live streaming sessions.

Develop and execute content strategies to promote upcoming broadcasts, maintain audience engagement, and nurture prospective student leads.

Create localised digital content and promotional materials tailored to the preferences and behaviours of target audiences across China and Southeast Asia.

Maintain consistent brand messaging across all digital touchpoints.

3. Regional Brand Development & Market Intelligence

Develop compelling brand narratives and high-quality promotional materials to strengthen brand positioning across the APAC region.

Monitor regional education market trends, student mobility patterns, competitor activities, and consumer behaviour.

Analyse audience engagement and market feedback to identify new recruitment opportunities and refine live streaming content.

Apply cultural intelligence and market insights to improve campaign relevance and effectiveness across different markets.

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with admissions, academic, and other relevant teams to ensure the accuracy and consistency of programme information communicated during live broadcasts.

Coordinate recruitment campaigns and promotional activities to support institutional enrolment targets.

Maintain effective communication with prospective students and build positive relationships throughout the recruitment process.

Requirements

Proven experience in digital marketing, regional marketing, student recruitment, education marketing, live streaming, or a related field.

Demonstrated commercial awareness and the ability to convert audience interest into qualified leads and measurable business outcomes.

Familiarity with Chinese digital platforms, particularly Xiaohongshu and WeChat, and their application in marketing and audience development.

Good understanding of the education market in China, Southeast Asia region.

Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret marketing data and implement improvement strategies.

Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish trust with prospective students.

Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in education recruitment, education consultancy, or marketing.

Experience hosting regular live streaming sessions for marketing, sales, or customer acquisition.

Professional proficiency in Mandarin to engage effectively with Chinese-speaking audiences. Additional regional language capabilities will be an advantage.

Experience developing localised content and marketing campaigns for diverse Asian markets.

Familiarity with digital marketing, management systems, and conversion optimisation tools.

description:
About the role

We're looking for a Brand Manager who can own the Bells brand system end to end — across all three sub-brands — and who is equally comfortable managing a website launch and standing on-site at a training centre reviewing a kiosk installation. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role at the centre of the Bells brand rollout — spanning digital brand execution (websites, programme pages), physical brand experience (centre branding, kiosks, experiential walls), and the ongoing marketing engine (testimonials, collateral, campaigns) that keeps each brand alive day to day.

You'll work directly with senior brand and marketing leadership, coordinating designers, developers, print vendors, and centre teams to bring a locked brand system to life consistently — online and in person — across every touchpoint a learner encounters, whichever Bells sub-brand they meet first.

Key responsibilities

Own end-to-end execution of Bells websites and programme pages — homepage, About Us, Contact Us, and all course/programme pages — across Bells School of AI, Bells School of Finance, and Bells Academy, coordinating information gathering, content, Figma design, dev handover, staging, and go-live against a live project tracker.

Ensure every page reflects locked, approved copy and the correct brand system for its sub-brand exactly — verbatim accuracy on approved lines is non-negotiable.

Coordinate with content, design, and tech stakeholders to keep multiple programme pages moving through the pipeline in parallel across all three brands without missing deadlines.

1. Media Planning and Campaign Management

Develop and execute integrated paid media strategies aligned with institutional priorities, campaign objectives, and audience segmentation frameworks.
Plan, launch, and manage campaigns across:
Paid social (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube and relevant platforms)
Search engine marketing and display advertising
Native and content discovery platforms (e.g., Outbrain, Taboola, and similar networks)

Campaign setup and trafficking
Creative uploads and approvals
Pixel and conversion event validation
Naming conventions (e.g. adherence to the master UTM taxonomy) and documentation
Budget pacing and reconciliation
Procurement and finance processes related to media buying
Maintain clean and scalable account structures across platforms.
Ensure compliance with institutional governance, brand guidelines, and data privacy requirements.

4. Performance Optimisation and Testing

Monitor campaign performance on an ongoing basis and conduct systematic optimisation to improve efficiency and outcomes.
Execute structured A/B and multivariate testing across creatives, audiences, keywords, bidding strategies, and landing pages.
Implement learning agendas and experimentation roadmaps to inform long-term media strategy.

5. Measurement, Tracking, and Reporting

Ensure accuracy and reliability of tracking through GA4, Google Tag Manager, platform pixels, Conversion APIs, and UTMs.
Develop and maintain performance dashboards and reporting frameworks.
Analyse multi-channel attribution and user journeys to assess content and campaign effectiveness.
Provide regular performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.

6. Stakeholder Collaboration and Governance

Partner closely with internal stakeholders to align paid media with institutional messaging and priorities.
Support campaign planning cycles and cross-functional reviews.
Coordinate with external vendors and media partners where required.
Manage documentation, invoicing, and administrative processes related to media spend.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Analytics or a related discipline.
Minimum 2–4 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing or digital advertising.
Demonstrated experience managing paid campaigns across:
Meta and LinkedIn Ads
Google Ads (Search and Display)
Native/content discovery platforms
Strong understanding of ad operations workflows and best practices.
Proven ability to manage multi-campaign portfolios with disciplined budget control.
Experience working with analytics and tracking tools, including GA4, GTM, and reporting platforms.
Excellent analytical, organisational, and documentation skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

description:
*Communications Executive (Compassionate Leave Cover 6 months)*

*1. JOB DESCRIPTION*

Job Title

Communications Executive (Compassionate Leave Cover 6 months)

Occupation

MARKETING COMMUNICATIONS EXECUTIVE

Job Description & Requirements

We're Hiring: Communications Executive

Quintessential Education | Full-Time or Part-Time | Orchard Road, Singapore

About QE

Quintessential Education is Singapore's leading provider of pre-tertiary academic programmes (IGCSE & IB) and university admissions advisory for top-tier global universities — Ivy League, Oxbridge, and NUS/NTU/SMU. Since 2012 we have worked with more than 700 students, and most of our new families come to us through referrals. We deliver a fully integrated journey for families: academic mastery, guardianship, and university placement under one roof.

We aim to bring out the best in our students, ignite opportunities and nurture them towards success.

We are looking for committed and talented additions to our team. As an ideal candidate, you should display a proven ability to develop and maintain an environment of trust, diversity, and inclusion within the QE team. You should be able to work with the team to meet deadlines and instill a culture of continuous work improvement.

As part of the position, you will work with the founders, Ivy League and Oxbridge graduates and other high-performing teammates.

The Role

We're looking for a Communications Executive to own the day-to-day relationship between QE and our families. You'll be the first person a parent speaks to when they enquire, and the person who keeps them informed once their child is with us. That means answering enquiries every day, matching students with the right tutors and mentors, and following up with students and parents regularly so nothing slips through.

You'll also help keep our marketing materials and partner relationships in good order. We are open to full-time or part-time candidates, so tell us the arrangement that works for you.

If you're a confident communicator in both English and Mandarin\*, stay calm and warm with demanding parents, and like being the person who makes sure things actually get done — we'd love to meet you.

This is a temporary role for 6 months to cover a colleague on leave for 4-6 months. If desired, conversion to full time permanent can be discussed closer from the 5-6th month onwards.

\*As a major group of customers are from China and are only able to converse in Mandarin.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Enquiries & Enrolment

* Respond to daily parent and student enquiries via phone, WhatsApp, WeChat, and email, ideally within the same working day.
* Explain our IGCSE, IB, and admissions programmes clearly and recommend the right fit for each student.
* Match students with suitable tutors and mentors, and arrange trial lessons and consultations.
* Track every enquiry through to enrolment and follow up with families who have not yet decided.

2. Student Follow-Up & Parent Relations

* Check in regularly with enrolled students and parents on progress, attendance, and any concerns.
* Collect lesson feedback from students and tutors, and deal with issues early before they become complaints.
* Arrange class schedules, replacement lessons, and changes with tutors and families.
* Keep parents informed ahead of key moments: exam periods, predicted grades, application deadlines, and results day.
* Follow up on renewals and next-stage programmes (e.g. IGCSE to IB, IB to university applications).

3. Business Operations

* Prepare and track invoices and payments.
* Draft and manage service agreements for clients and tutors.
* Keep client records, notes, and follow-up schedules up to date.
* Keep a simple monthly record of enquiries, enrolments, and renewals for the founders.

4. Marketing & Partnerships

* Keep brochures, website content, and newsletters accurate and up to date.
* Work with design and digital marketing agencies on campaigns and collateral.
* Support parent seminars and events, including Mandarin-language sessions with our China school partners.
* Maintain relationships with partner schools, education consultants, and collaborators.

We're Looking For Someone Who:

* Has experience in a client-facing role such as education, admissions, client services, or customer service. Fresh graduates with strong communication skills are welcome to apply.
* Has excellent verbal and written communication in English and Chinese. This is required as some Chinese customers can only communicate in Chinese. Japanese and Korean are a bonus as some customers only communicate in these languages.
* Is calm, warm, and professional with high-expectation parents, and comfortable handling difficult conversations.
* Is highly organised, follows up without being reminded, and keeps clear records.
* Can manage many families and a busy inbox at the same time without losing track of details.
* Is proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), Notion or Airtable, and marketing tools (Mailchimp, Canva).
* Is comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) and light automation to streamline workflows.

Bonus If You:

* Have experience in the education, tuition, or admissions sector.
* Know the IB, IGCSE, or university application process (UK, US, or Singapore).
* Are familiar with WeChat or Xiaohongshu.

Working Hours

Location: 545 Orchard Road, #14-06/9, Singapore 238882. In Person role.

Start Date: As soon as possible

Commitment: Full-time or part-time. Propose the days and hours that suit you in your application.

* Full-time: 5-day work week, Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, 4 days in office and 1 day remote
* Part-time: Days and hours by arrangement, with enough weekday cover to keep up with daily enquiries

Salary & Benefits

* Monthly Salary: $4,500 upwards for full-time, depending on experience; pro-rated for part-time
* Bonuses: Additional performance and team-based bonuses apply
* Benefits Include: $500 Specialist Stipend per annum (e.g. medical or mental health support), $100 Dental Stipend per annum, $500 Personal Development Stipend per annum (for courses, books, conferences, etc.)

How to Apply

Send your CV and a short paragraph on why you're interested in the role to hr@qeducation.sg with the subject line: Application – Communications Executive (Full Time / Part Time)

* Lead and develop the marketing executive, and manage agencies and vendors.

*Who We're Looking For*

We would love to meet someone who:

* Has a proven track record in marketing, particularly in generating leads, sales or enrolments.

* Proven experience in branding and in internal and external communications

* Brings positive energy, a collaborative spirit and a good sense of humour.

*Big Ambitions, Real Opportunities*

_We value initiative over hierarchy. Good ideas can come from anyone, and we encourage people to speak up, experiment and make things better._

Explore and adopt new AI tools, design technologies and automation solutions to improve creative production and marketing workflows.

Campaign planning, execution, optimisation and performance tracking.

Content and Copywriting:

Korean copywriting, content development and social media management.

Graphic Design:

Ability to create digital marketing visuals, promotional banners, campaign creatives and social media assets.

AI-Powered Design Tools:

Familiarity with AI-assisted design, image generation and creative production tools.

Paid Advertising:

Search and social advertising, campaign management and budget optimisation.

Analytics and Reporting:

Campaign tracking, performance measurement and data analysis.

Creative Technology:

Ability to explore and adopt new design tools, AI technologies and automation solutions to improve marketing efficiency.

Preferred Experience

Experience marketing to Korean-speaking audiences or within the Korean market.

Experience in user acquisition, conversion optimisation and retention campaigns.

A portfolio demonstrating graphic design, digital marketing creatives or other relevant creative work.

Experience using AI-powered design tools to generate, enhance or adapt marketing visuals and creative assets.

Experience managing KOLs, influencers or affiliate marketing partnerships.

Familiarity with Korean digital trends, online communities and consumer behaviour.

Experience working with cross-functional teams in a technology or digital platform environment.

Experience using marketing analytics tools to evaluate campaign performance and guide optimisation.

Qualifications

Native-level Korean proficiency in both written and spoken communication. TOPIK Level 5 or 6 is preferred.

At least 3 years of marketing experience, including hands-on digital marketing experience.

Proven ability to produce high-quality, natural Korean marketing content.

Strong understanding of Korean consumer behaviour, digital marketing trends and online culture.

Proficiency in graphic design tools and the ability to produce marketing visuals independently.

Familiarity with AI-powered design tools and a willingness to explore emerging creative technologies.

Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret campaign data and prepare performance reports.

Working proficiency in English for daily communication with the wider team.

Able to work independently, manage multiple campaigns and collaborate across departments.

Willing to travel for business assignments as required.

What We Offer

Competitive salary based on experience and capabilities.

The opportunity to take ownership of marketing for the Korean market.

The opportunity to combine digital marketing, creative design and AI-powered tools in practical business applications.

Direct collaboration with senior management and cross-functional teams.

The opportunity to develop and execute marketing strategies with measurable business impact.

Room to grow within a fast-growing technology company.

About Us

1M R&D is a technology research and development company focused on exploring, developing and applying technologies across Web2, Web3 and artificial intelligence. We bridge established digital infrastructure with emerging technologies to create innovative products, intelligent systems and practical business solutions.

Our work spans software engineering, digital platforms, system integration, AI-powered applications, intelligent automation, blockchain technologies and decentralised systems. Through continuous research, technical experimentation and applied development, we identify promising technologies, evaluate their real-world potential and transform viable ideas into scalable solutions.

By combining technical research with practical implementation, 1M R&D aims to turn technological advancements into meaningful applications, unlock new business opportunities and shape the next generation of digital experiences.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys combining strategic judgement with execution and building a more effective, repeatable marketing engine.

Your Responsibilities

Marketing Planning & Commercial Priorities

Translate business and market priorities into practical marketing plans, with clear audiences, objectives, budgets and measures of success.

Identify the campaigns, channels and opportunities most likely to generate relevant demand, balancing immediate commercial needs with longer-term market presence.

Own delivery across your marketing programmes, coordinating internal contributors, creative support and external partners.

Review results with commercial stakeholders and recommend where to invest, refine or stop activity.

Integrated Campaigns & Demand Generation

Plan and execute integrated campaigns targeting priority industries, enterprise accounts and decision-makers.

Bring together email, events, webinars, partner channels, content distribution and selective paid activity to generate qualified demand and commercial opportunities.

Own campaign delivery, including audience targeting, briefs, landing pages, email sequences and launch coordination.

Improve digital discovery and conversion across relevant website journeys, search and campaign channels, working with specialist support where needed.

Events & Partner Marketing

Lead the marketing execution of webinars, roundtables, industry conferences and other selected events, from assessing opportunities and shaping the proposition to promotion, delivery and follow-up.

Develop joint marketing programmes with partners, associations and industry communities to extend Intellect’s reach and credibility.

Work with sales to engage relevant prospects before and after events, turning participation into qualified conversations and opportunities.

Evaluate event and partnership performance to guide future activity and investment.

Prospect Lifecycle & Conversion

Build and run prospect nurture programmes across the enterprise buying cycle, including event follow-up, ongoing education and reactivation of dormant leads.

Personally manage audience segmentation, email campaigns and marketing automation workflows to deliver relevant, coordinated communications.

Align with sales on qualification, lead routing, handover and follow-up so marketing engagement translates into timely commercial action.

Use engagement data, funnel performance and sales feedback to improve lead quality and progression.

Market Positioning & Go-to-Market Support

Help translate Intellect’s solutions into clear, compelling messages for different buyers, industries and markets, working with product and content marketing.

Partner with local commercial teams to adapt marketing plans to buyer needs and support market expansion and the launch of relevant offerings.

Shape briefs and contribute to customer stories, campaign content and sales materials, drawing on expertise from clinical, product and commercial teams.

Strengthen Intellect’s visibility and credibility through consistent messaging and the distribution of thought leadership, customer evidence and expert perspectives.

Marketing Performance & Operations

Maintain a clear marketing calendar, reliable campaign tracking and visibility into performance across key programmes.

Assess results through qualified engagement, sales-accepted opportunities, pipeline contribution and conversion, using findings to improve activity and budget allocation.

Work with sales and the relevant CRM or revenue operations owner to strengthen reporting, attribution and shared processes.

Build reusable templates and workflows, using AI and automation thoughtfully to improve execution speed, quality and consistency.

Requirements

An experienced B2B marketer. You have personally owned and delivered marketing programmes for business audiences, ideally involving enterprise buyers and considered purchasing decisions. We value demonstrated scope, judgement and results over a particular title.

Able to shape the plan and deliver it. You can turn commercial objectives into clear priorities, choose an appropriate channel mix and carry work through without needing every step prescribed.

A hands-on owner. You’re comfortable moving between planning, campaign setup, copy and briefs, CRM execution and performance analysis, bringing in support where it adds the most value.

Comfortable across marketing disciplines. You bring practical depth in demand generation, events or webinars, and email nurture, with the ability to connect these to messaging, content and digital channels.

Commercially and analytically minded. You understand enterprise sales cycles and can explain how your work generated relevant demand, improved conversion or contributed to pipeline.

Confident with marketing tools. You can build segments, launch email journeys, configure straightforward automation and use CRM and campaign reporting to guide decisions.

A strong communicator and collaborator. You can develop effective copy and briefs, make complex solutions understandable, and align sales, subject-matter experts and external partners around a clear objective.

Resourceful and organised. You make sensible trade-offs, manage budgets and multiple workstreams reliably, and deliver within a lean environment.

Motivated by the mission. You’re excited to help expand access to mental healthcare and build marketing programmes that support meaningful business growth.

Intellect (

intellect.co

) is a venture-backed digital health company reinventing how mental health is in Asia. Our goal is to make it simple, easy and stigma-free for everyone.

We're building an entirely new way for modern organisations to easily provide support for their employees’ mental health & mental wellbeing, no matter where they are on their journey.

Join us on our mission to eliminate barriers to mental health and to create a wellbeing approach that people love using.

title: Senior/ Specialist, E-Commerce Marketing (Amazon Campaigns & Promotions)
description:

Truegenics Pte Ltd is a leading ecommerce company based in Singapore with a track record of over US$218M in online product sales. Mission of the role:

This role is responsible for driving our revenue growth through expert campaign and promotion planning across all four brands (Simple Promise, 5th & Glow, N-Labs, and 7th Manna). The Specialist will focus on optimizing conversions through data-driven insights, developing and executing robust promotional strategies, and working closely with our Operations and PPC teams to ensure flawless high and low-level execution. This person will act as the analytical engine for our campaigns, processing complex data to discern winning strategies from underperforming ones, and guiding the brands toward sustainable, high-impact growth.

Key Responsibilities:

Promotions & Campaigns

Promotions Planning & Execution:

Take full ownership of developing and executing promotional strategies and campaigns. Coordinate seamlessly with the Operations and PPC teams to ensure all promo strategies and executions are carried out accurately and on time.

Data-Driven Insights & Analytics:

Process and analyze campaign data and key e-commerce metrics (e.g., ROAS, ACOS, TACoS). Exercise strong analytical judgment to discern "what is good and what is bad" in campaign performance, providing actionable insights to optimize overall spend and ROI.

Merchandising & Content Execution

Content Optimization:

Optimize and update keywords (KWs), product descriptions, image assets, and A+ content to maximize organic ranking and conversions.

Listings Management:

Create fully optimized new listings for new product launches and update existing listings where needed.

Inventory Management & Transparency Program:

Manage inventory replenishment, ensuring stock levels are optimal, discrepancies are resolved, and oversee Amazon's Transparency Program to prevent unauthorized sellers.

Competitor Benchmarking:

Continuously track competitor content (ads, videos, images, etc.) and benchmark competitor SKU prices to maintain our competitive edge.

Collaboration & Trend Identification:

Identify current trends in e-commerce content. Work closely with the Affiliates team to identify winning external content and mirror those strategies onto our Amazon listings.

Cross-Functional & Strategic Support

Cross-Team Collaboration:

Act as the central hub between Marketing, Operations, and PPC teams. Align stakeholders on campaign strategies, improve cross-departmental execution processes, and ensure all teams are synchronized for major promotions across all brands.

Reporting & Analytics:

Maintain, generate, and present detailed reports on promotional and campaign performance metrics to stakeholders, driving strategic decision-making.

Key Skills / Experience Required:

Education:

Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Experience:

At least 3 years in eCommerce or Digital Marketing, with a strong focus on the Amazon marketplace.

Campaign & Promotion Management:

Proven ability to plan, launch, and manage e-commerce promotional campaigns, coordinating with various teams to ensure successful execution.

Analytical & Strategic Insight:

Exceptional analytical skills. Must be highly capable of processing raw data, identifying trends, and discerning successful tactics from underperforming ones to drive future strategy.

Cross-Functional Leadership:

Experience collaborating with operations, advertising (PPC), and creative teams to bring campaigns to life.

Tools Proficiency:

Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central, advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP), and data analysis tools like Helium 10 or ScaleInsight.

Self-Starter:

Ability to work independently, take absolute ownership of promotional calendars, and lead initiatives from start to finish.

TrueGenics Pte Ltd

description:

JOB SUMMARY

The Manager, Loyalty Marketing is a high-impact, commercially oriented role responsible for driving member growth, engagement and retention across Asia Pacific excluding China (APEC).

This is a new role sitting at the intersection of loyalty strategy, CRM, and experiential partnerships - built for a marketer who is equally comfortable designing a lifecycle journey and activating world-class partnerships. You will own the end-to-end member journeys for one of the world's largest hospitality loyalty programs, translating global strategy into locally relevant, measurable initiatives across a diverse and dynamic region. This role will report to the Director, Loyalty Marketing, APEC.

You will lead the evolution of CRM and lifecycle marketing for APEC — defining segmentation strategy, designing engagement programs, and driving measurable improvements in activation, retention and reactivation. You will work in close collaboration with global, continent and market teams, and play a central role in building the reach and scaling our loyalty program as a long-term growth driver for the business. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, strategic thinking and a member-centric mindset.

This role is based in Singapore.

CORE COMPETENCIES

CRM & Lifecycle Marketing: Deep, hands-on experience designing and executing programs across the full customer journey. Builds segmentation logic, personalisation strategy and automated flows anchored in commercial outcomes, not just campaign execution.

Proven ability to activate brand partnerships, event management and experiential moments from brief to delivery, with strong agency management.
Data Analysis & Fluency: Comfortable working with member behaviour data, campaign analytics and dashboards to surface insight and drive continuous improvement. Tracks activity to outcomes, not outputs.
Communication & Brand Stewardship: Executes customer-facing communications with a consistent, on-brand voice across owned and paid channels. Brings sharp copywriting instincts, strong creative review judgment, and the ability to influence and align across global, regional and local teams with different cultures and working styles.
Execution & Project Management: Highly organised with a strong bias for delivery. Manages multiple workstreams simultaneously, ensuring projects adhere to timelines.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

We are looking for a marketer with 4+ years of experience in loyalty, CRM or lifecycle marketing, ideally within hospitality, travel, or a consumer brand environment.

4-5 years of relevant professional experience in program management, marketing strategy, loyalty and lifecycle disciplines, digital or related function
Experience managing and directing strategic partners / agencies /vendors. Demonstrated relationship marketing skills a must.
Team player, proven ability to lead and work with cross-functional teams in support of specific business priorities

 Leverage market research, member insights and data analytics to inform engagement strategies and personalised experiences
