title: Programme Origination & Marketing Assistant Manager
description:
Company Overview

The Singapore Mint, established in 1968, is a leading innovative mint producing high-quality coins, medallions, and collectibles. It combines advanced technology with skilled craftsmanship and serves local and international markets with award-winning products.

Job Summary

Responsible for end-to-end planning, development, and execution of international commemorative coin and collectible programmes, ensuring alignment with strategic and commercial goals through cross-functional collaboration and market insight.

Responsibilities

Plan and deliver programmes managing scope, schedule, budget, quality, and launch readiness to meet strategic objectives

Manage full programme lifecycle from concept development through production coordination to market launch

Maintain detailed programme plans, milestones, approvals, and risk/issue logs to ensure timely execution

Conduct market research and competitive analysis to inform programme concepts, positioning, and commercial strategy

Identify market trends and opportunities to enhance programme differentiation and commercial outcomes

Coordinate internal teams (marketing, sales, design, production, operations) and external partners to align priorities and resolve bottlenecks

Collaborate with marketing and sales teams to develop go-to-market plans and launch support materials

Provide sales enablement content including product information, key messages, and data insights to support channel partners

Monitor programme KPIs and P&L performance; analyze results and market feedback to recommend adjustments

Prepare and present programme updates, reports, and presentations for management and senior stakeholders

Maintain accurate documentation of programme planning, market research, decision logs, and execution workflows

Preferred competencies and qualifications

Experience in consumer product industries and distribution channels

Resourceful, adaptable, and proactive problem-solving skills

Strong ownership mindset with ability to work independently

Detail-oriented, structured, and committed to delivery excellence

Creative interest in collectible products, arts, or cultural themes (advantageous but not mandatory)

The Singapore Mint was established in 1968 to mint circulation coins for the newly-independent nation. Over the years, The Singapore Mint has evolved from a basic minting facility to a fully integrated business operation, comprising programme concept, product design, marketing, sales and distribution with after sales service. Focusing on quality system and standards, The Singapore Mint is a certified ISO 9001 and 14001 organisation. Today, it has grown to become one of the leading innovative mints in the industry, capable of producing coins and medallions of the highest quality.

Leveraging on technology, The Singapore Mint has developed hybrid techniques to create high security and innovative features on circulation and commemorative coins and collectables. Fusing advanced minting technologies with authentic crafting methods, The Singapore Mint is one of the few mints in the world that still maintains a team of highly skilled craftsmen, adding intricate elements that can only be meticulously achieved by the human touch.

As a testament of its high quality crafting techniques, The Singapore Mint has won multiple international awards and its rising stature has garnered much interest internationally. The mint has been appointed by issuing authorities around the world for the production of their coins.

Other than producing coins and medallions, The Singapore Mint has also expanded to provide quality currency-related gifts and collectibles, lifestyle products and services to both local and international markets. We continue to pledge our unwavering commitment to our customers, business associates and partners to offer the best in quality, value and service.

The Singapore Mint (Singapore Precision Industries Pte Ltd) is a fully owned subsidiary of Sembcorp Industries.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
About Young Hungry Free

Young Hungry Free is a Singapore fashion label founded in 2012, known for edgy basics and wearable trends in sizes XXS to 3XL. A new named collection drops online every Monday at 8pm, and the #YHFAMILY community — members, Telegram subscribers and creators — is at the centre of how the brand grows. We ship from Singapore to customers across the region and beyond.

The role

You will tell the Young Hungry Free story every week. The core of the role is the weekly drop cycle: the content, copy, social publishing and creator seeding that bring each Monday collection to life. Around that, you will help deliver the brand's bigger moments — seasonal and collaboration campaigns, PR and events.

You will lead those bigger moments rather than support them, own media relations, and manage campaign budgets.

What you will do

1. Weekly content and social

Plan and run the content calendar around the Monday 8pm drop: teasers, launch-night content and follow-up.

Write copy for collection launches, product stories, social posts, EDMs and the website, in line with the brand's tone of voice and house style.

Schedule and publish across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and the #YHFAMILY Telegram channel, and manage community comments.

Brief designers, photographers and videographers.

Supply copy and assets for performance and CRM campaigns. The performance and marketing teams own targeting, flows and media buying.

2. Campaigns

Turn campaign strategy into narratives, key messages and visual direction for seasonal, launch and collaboration campaigns.

Coordinate campaign delivery across channels and teams, to agreed timelines.

Lead campaigns from brief to wrap reports.

3. PR and earned media

Maintain the media list, draft press releases and pitches, and manage press seeding.

Track coverage and report on earned media.

Own media relations, including building relationships with editors and handling enquiries.

4. Events and activations

Help plan and run pop-ups, launches and brand events, including vendor coordination and on-the-day delivery.

Lead events from concept to wrap, including vendors and budget.

5. Creators, KOLs and community

Run / Co-run the organic creator and ambassador programme end to end: shortlisting, outreach, product seeding against each drop, briefing and relationship management.

Build a library of user-generated content with written usage permissions.

Ensure all gifted and paid creator content carries the correct disclosure.

Work with the performance team on paid and affiliate creator partnerships, which they co-own.

6. Brand consistency

Apply the brand guidelines across every customer touchpoint, and flag inconsistencies before they go live.

7. Platform, Systems and Channel Management: Content Management Systems, Customer Relationship Management Systems, EDM Tools and Advertising Tools

Plan, execute and improve integrated campaign and marketing initiatives across our different CMS, CRM, EDM, Advertising tools and platforms.

8. Budget and reporting

Track campaign, seeding and event spend against budget, within approval limits set by the Head of Marketing.

Report monthly on content, social, creator and PR performance: what worked, what did not and what to change.

Work closely with performance marketing, CRM, product, operations and customer service.

Take on other duties within the marketing team as needed.

What we are looking for

Essential

Experience at the level you are applying for, ideally in fashion, lifestyle, e-commerce or an agency.

A portfolio showing copy you have written and social content you have produced or managed.

Strong English copywriting, with a sharp ear for tone.

Deep working knowledge of Instagram and TikTok — formats, trends, and what the analytics are telling you.

Experience working with creators or influencers.

A strong visual eye and the ability to give clear campaign, marketing and suggest creative direction together with the creative team.

The organisation to hit a weekly launch deadline, every week.

Comfort reading platform insights and basic web analytics, and turning them into decisions.

Advantageous

Events, pop-up or physical activation experience.

PR or media relations experience.

Short-form video editing, for example CapCut or Premiere Pro; basic Photoshop, Illustrator or Canva.

Experience with Klaviyo or a similar email platform, and with social scheduling tools.

Confident use of AI tools for research and ideation, with the judgement to check what they produce.

HOW TO APPLY

Email your application to

humans@younghungryfree.com,

include position title in the subject line, your CV and any relevant information and the following details:

Name:

Earliest availability:

Expected Salary:

Why Young Hungry Free?

What difference can you make?

What makes you stand out?

Young Hungry Free is an online fashion brand that puts our customers in the forefront. Known to embody the spirit of risk takers and rule breakers in our designs, we aim to give our customers the voice they need through our clothes. Find timeless, reinvented wardrobe staples and dress like you're forever young, hungry and free.

We are a team of adventurous, passionate risk-takers who believe in the endless pursuit of excellence. We aim to constantly improve and innovate our work, and on our performance in being the best.

title: Senior Marketing Executive / Assistant Manager, Marketing & Communications
description:
About the Role

OaksPlus Limited is seeking a proactive, creative and results-driven marketing professional to join our Marketing & Communications team as a Senior Marketing Executive or Assistant Manager.

This role will focus primarily on growing the visibility, brand presence and enrolment opportunities of 7oaks Preschool through integrated digital and offline marketing initiatives.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing digital marketing campaigns and agency relationships, driving social media and content strategies, overseeing website content, developing marketing communications materials and building corporate partnerships.

We are looking for someone who combines creative thinking with strong execution capabilities, is comfortable working with data and can independently drive marketing initiatives from planning through to implementation and performance evaluation.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is both a strategic thinker and a hands-on executor — someone who can translate marketing plans into well-executed campaigns and measurable outcomes.

You should be comfortable managing agencies and external partners, working with internal stakeholders, analysing campaign results and taking the initiative to improve performance.

Above all, you should have a strong sense of ownership, attention to detail and a genuine interest in building brands that connect meaningfully with families.

Key Responsibilities

1. Digital Marketing & Agency Management

Plan, coordinate and execute integrated digital marketing campaigns across platforms including Google, Meta and other relevant channels to drive brand awareness, enquiries and enrolments.

Manage external digital marketing agencies, including campaign briefs, creative development, budgets, timelines, performance reviews and optimisation.

Monitor campaign performance against agreed KPIs, including website traffic, leads, cost per lead (CPL), lead quality and enrolment conversions.

Work closely with agencies to identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness, return on investment and marketing efficiency.

Prepare regular performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.

2. Social Media & Content Management

Develop and manage social media content plans and calendars across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.

Plan and execute engaging content that showcases the preschool's curriculum, learning experiences, educators, community engagement and brand proposition.

Oversee content creation, including copywriting, graphic design, photography and short-form video production.

Coordinate content gathering with preschool centres and internal stakeholders to ensure a consistent flow of relevant and engaging content.

Monitor social media performance, audience engagement and emerging trends to continuously improve content effectiveness.

Maintain consistent brand messaging, visual identity and quality across all social media platforms.

3. Website Management & Digital Presence

Manage and maintain the 7oaks Preschool website using WordPress, ensuring content is accurate, relevant and regularly updated.

Oversee updates to website pages, campaign landing pages, blog articles, promotional content and calls to action.

Coordinate with web developers and external vendors on website enhancements, maintenance and technical issues.

Monitor website performance using tools such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console and other relevant analytics platforms.

Work with agencies and vendors to improve search engine visibility, website user experience and lead generation effectiveness.

Support ongoing website enhancement and revamp initiatives where required.

4. Marketing Communications & Brand Management

Plan and execute marketing communications initiatives across digital and offline channels, ensuring alignment with brand positioning and business objectives.

Develop and coordinate marketing collaterals, including brochures, flyers, posters, banners, digital advertisements, out-of-home (OOH) advertising and promotional materials.

Support corporate communications and internal branding requirements, including staff event collaterals, Dinner & Dance materials, annual reports, presentations and internal announcements.

Liaise with creative agencies, printers, media owners and other vendors to ensure timely and cost-effective production of marketing materials.

Maintain brand consistency across all communications touchpoints.

Support public relations, community outreach and other brand-building opportunities as required.

5. Corporate Partnerships & Community Outreach

Identify and develop corporate partnership opportunities to increase brand awareness, generate qualified leads and support preschool enrolment.

Establish and maintain relationships with companies, community organisations and other relevant partners.

Develop partnership proposals, promotional arrangements and joint marketing initiatives.

Coordinate corporate outreach activities, roadshows and partnership activations.

Track partnership activities, leads generated and outcomes to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.

6. Campaigns, Events & Performance Reporting

Plan and coordinate marketing support for preschool open houses, Discovery Days, roadshows, enrolment drives and other events.

Work closely with centre leaders and internal stakeholders to ensure marketing initiatives support centre-specific enrolment priorities.

Track marketing performance across channels, including leads, centre visit registrations, visit attendance and enrolment conversions.

Maintain campaign budgets, timelines, marketing calendars and performance reports.

Identify gaps in performance and recommend corrective actions to improve results.

Support other marketing and communications initiatives as assigned.

Requirements

Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Business, Digital Marketing or a related discipline.

Senior Executive: Preferably 3–5 years of relevant marketing experience.

Assistant Manager: Preferably 5–7 years of relevant marketing experience, with demonstrated ownership of marketing campaigns and agency relationships.

Strong hands-on experience in digital marketing, including paid advertising, campaign coordination, agency management and performance tracking.

Proven experience managing social media channels, content calendars and creative production.

Practical experience managing websites using WordPress or a similar CMS; familiarity with basic SEO and website analytics.

Good understanding of digital marketing metrics, including CPL, conversion rates, website traffic and campaign ROI.

Strong writing and communication skills, with the ability to develop compelling marketing content and coordinate with diverse stakeholders.

Good eye for design and familiarity with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar tools.

Experience in offline marketing, collateral production, vendor coordination and event management.

Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and competing deadlines.

Resourceful, proactive and solutions-oriented, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables.

Experience in the education, preschool or family-oriented services sector will be an advantage.

The appointment level will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and capabilities.

Oaks Plus Limited (hereafter known as “OPL”) is a Company Limited by Guarantee (CLG) with Charity status that is committed to assisting underprivileged kids and their families. As one of the appointed operators under ECDA's Partner Operator Scheme, we believe that every child should have equal access to opportunities in learning and education and reach their maximum potential in life regardless of their socioeconomic status.

OPL has experience in serving Singapore’s multi-racial community. Presently, OPL owns and operates 7oaks Preschool centres, offering affordable and quality early childhood offerings that encompass a robust curriculum, highly qualified educators and centre leaders, and standards in line with the SPARK accreditation.

OPL has in place an experienced management committee comprising of the Board of Directors and the preschool management team who brings together a myriad of experience and expertise in the day-to-day running of the company and the curation of OPL early childhood strategies.

OPL also works closely with regulatory agencies such as ECDA and MSF to ensure compliance with legal and licensing regulations of its preschool centres.

2. Communications Campaigns & Outreach

4. Programme & Communications Coordination

Qualifications & Experience

Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly and engagingly.

The website. Homepage, tool pages, comparison pages, ad landing pages, and the scripts for the explainer videos on them.
Campaigns. Concepts, headlines, banners and video scripts for our advertising.
Customer messages. Product emails and in-app notifications, the kind people read rather than archive.
Print and events. Brochures, flyers, and the copy on our booth walls.
The stage. Shape the message in our team's conference talks, including keynotes at Ahrefs Evolve.
Social. Work with our social media lead so a post and a landing page sound like they came from the same place.
Positioning and messaging. Decide the core story for the company and each product, write it down, and get other teams to adopt it.
You're probably right for this if
Writing copy is what you do best, and most of your career has gone into it: campaigns, websites, product emails, scripts.
You're hands-on. You'd rather write it yourself than brief someone else to. You can turn a banner headline around the same day you're halfway through a homepage rewrite, and you like having both on the go.
You can show us your work. Real, published copy, and you can tell us exactly which parts you wrote.
You know when to be funny and when to get straight to the point.
You pick up technical products quickly, and can explain them to experts without dumbing them down. You don't need to know SEO.
You've owned a brand voice or positioning before, and got teams who didn't report to you to use it.
You'll argue for a word with a CMO, and let go of the ones that don't matter.
Good to have
UX writing or product marketing experience.
Video scripts and speechwriting.
Comfortable enough in Figma or a CMS to fix your own copy in place.
Why Ahrefs?

We believe in giving smart people real ownership and not micromanaging them. You'll own how Ahrefs sounds, everywhere, and shape how millions of marketers see the brand. We value honesty, results and simple solutions over complicated ones, and you'll work with a smart, low-ego team where your words make a real difference.

Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third-party recruitment providers for the roles we hire for. If we need help, we'll let you know.

title: Social Media Executive
description:
ABOUT US

The Hey Co Group is a homegrown Singapore F&B group founded in 2016. Over nine years we have built and scaled a portfolio of brands across quick-service, casual dining, cafe, restaurant and bar. We are not a chain. Each brand has its own identity, its own audience, and its own reason to exist — and we obsess over quality and consistency across every touchpoint, including the ones on people's screens.

Social media is where most people meet our brands for the first time. A single Reel can fill a restaurant on a quiet Tuesday. That is why this role sits at the heart of how we grow.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a creative Social Media Executive to support our Branding & Marketing Manager in bringing six distinct brands to life.

You will be the hands-on engine of our social channels — creating content and caring for our communities. You bring the ideas and the execution. The Branding & Marketing Manager brings the strategy and brand direction. Together you will make sure each brand shows up consistently, on time, and looking its best, every single week.

We are a team that embraces AI, and we want someone who uses it to create faster and think bigger — from ideation through to editing.

This is a great role for a creative, platform-native person who wants to do the work, learn fast, and see their content reach thousands of guests.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

No two days look the same. A typical week might involve shooting a new menu launch at one of our cafes in the morning, editing a batch of Reels and Stories over lunch, scheduling the week's posts, replying to a wave of comments and DMs, checking how last week's content performed, and syncing with the Branding & Marketing Manager on an upcoming campaign.

Some days are quiet and edit-heavy. Others are fast, on-location and full of energy.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Create content — shoot, edit, schedule and publish posts, Reels and Stories across our brands, following the direction and calendar set with the Branding & Marketing Manager

Shoot and edit — capture short-form video and photography in-store and on-location, quickly, with a phone and light kit

Community — reply to comments and DMs across assigned brand accounts, engage followers, and keep each brand's tone right. Escalate service issues and complaints to the relevant outlet manager promptly

Support campaigns — support the launches, seasonal menus, promotions and collaborations that the Branding & Marketing Manager plans

Paid social support — set up and boost posts across Meta and TikTok under the Branding & Marketing Manager's direction. Monitor spend and basic performance, and flag what is and is not working

Local SEO support — keep our Google Business Profiles current across outlets (hours, photos, menus, review responses) and apply keyword and caption basics so our content is easier to find

KOL coordination — coordinate influencer and food creator visits: scheduling, logistics and hosting on the day

Use AI — use AI tools to work faster and smarter: drafting captions and ideas, generating and editing images and video, researching trends, and streamlining your day to day

Report — track reach, engagement, saves and follower growth by brand, and share a simple monthly update on what is working and what is not

Consistency and ideas — keep each brand's tone, look and quality distinct and consistent, and bring fresh, on-trend ideas to the table

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

Essential:

One to three years in social media and content — F&B, hospitality, lifestyle or agency

A portfolio, showreel, or links to two or three accounts you have personally run. Applications without work samples will not be reviewed

A creative, ideas-driven eye for aesthetics, storytelling, and food that looks irresistible

Strong hands-on skills across Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, plus shooting and editing short-form video and photography

Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager at boosting and basic campaign level

Basic understanding of local SEO — keywords, captions, hashtags, and Google Business Profile management

Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Canva AI, CapCut, image and video generators) to create, ideate and work efficiently

Able to juggle several brands and deadlines without dropping quality, and to hold distinct brand voices apart rather than blending them into one

Comfortable working in live restaurant environments, including occasional evenings and weekends for shoots

A genuine love for food, hospitality, culture and people

Based in Singapore and able to travel between our outlets

Advantageous:

Basic design ability (Canva, Figma or Adobe)

Familiarity with Xiaohongshu

Written Mandarin

Experience with a multi-outlet or multi-brand group

Familiarity with the Singapore F&B and dining scene

HOW TO APPLY

Send the following to HR@theheyco.com:

Your CV

A short note on why this excites you

Links to content you have created — a portfolio, a showreel, or two to three accounts you have run, with a line on what you were responsible for

The Hey Co Group (HCG) is a Singapore-born F&B group founded in 2016. In under a decade, we've grown into a family of brands spanning — each built with the same obsession: concepts that are timeless, consistent, and genuinely good. We do not chase trends but rather market demands; we're building things that last, held together by a tight ecosystem across branding, marketing, operations, supply chain, and cost.

What makes HCG different is how we work. We move fast, we stay hands-on, and we care as much about our people as we do our product. Our teams have real ownership, direct access to leadership, and the room to grow with the group as we expand. Whether you're behind the bar, in the kitchen, running an outlet, or supporting from HQ, you're part of building something — not just clocking a shift.

We look for people who are curious, gritty, and take pride in getting the details right. If you want to learn fast, be trusted with responsibility, and grow alongside a group that's still hungry, HCG is a place to build a career — not just find a job.

description:
Position title

:

Education & Outreach Intern

Reports to

: Manager, Youth Engagement and Manager, Schools Programme

Duration:

6 months (Minimum 3 months)

Location:

Singapore

About WWF-Singapore

World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF) is one of the world’s largest and most respected independent conservation organisations. WWF’s mission is to stop the degradation of the earth’s natural environment and to build a future in which humans live in harmony with nature. As one of WWF’s international hubs, WWF-Singapore supports a global network spanning over 100 countries. WWF Singapore works closely with local stakeholders towards a greener and more sustainable Singapore and the region around us. We work to address key conservation areas, such as climate change, sustainable finance, deforestation, illegal wildlife trade, marine conservation, and sustainable production and consumption, through collaboration, education and outreach efforts involving the community, businesses, and governments. For more information, please visit wwf.sg.

About Schools Programme

The WWF Schools Programme empowers students to understand environmental issues and take meaningful action for nature and sustainability. The programme delivers engaging learning experiences through classroom workshops, outdoor activities, school projects and digital resources, covering topics such as climate change, biodiversity, oceans, waste and food sustainability..

About #WeGotThis (Youth Programme)

#WeGotThis is WWF-Singapore’s flagship youth accelerator programme that empowers youths to move beyond awareness and take meaningful action for people and the planet. Through workshops, mentorship, networking opportunities, and hands-on projects, participants develop skills, knowledge, and confidence to learn fieldwork techniques, test conservation technologies, and develop film documentaries to address biodiversity and climate challenges.

Role Overview

As the Education and Outreach Intern, you will play a key role in growing our school and youth community and amplifying programme impact through engaging digital content. You will be responsible for developing social media content, supporting community engagement initiatives, and assisting with programme logistics and events.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys content creation, social media trends, event coordination, and working with young changemakers.

Key Responsibilities

1. Social Media, Digital Content & Communications (50%)

Develop and execute content ideas for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, websites, emailers and other digital platforms.

Create short-form videos, reels, graphics, carousels, stories and other multimedia content to showcase programme activities, school and youth projects, mentor highlights, and challenge statement topics.

Attend programme sessions and events to capture photos, videos, interviews, and behind-the-scenes content.

Draft engaging captions, social media copy and digital storytelling content aligned with WWF-Singapore’s brand voice.

Create content for programme emailers and participant communications

Support the design, maintenance and updating of programme webpages, ensuring information remains current, user-friendly and engaging.

Develop website content including programme descriptions, participant stories, mentor profiles, event pages and impact highlights.

Research emerging social media trends and recommend new content approaches to increase reach and engagement.

Maintain content calendars and publishing schedules across social media, website and email channels.

Track and report social media performance metrics and insights.

2. Community Management & Engagement (30%)

Support engagement of programme participants, alumni, mentors, and volunteers, responding to enquiries in a timely and professional manner.

Develop and maintain programme FAQs and resource guides to improve participant experience. Develop educational materials to engage students on sustainability issues.

Create and manage registration forms, application forms, surveys, attendance tracking systems, and feedback forms.

Monitor and respond to programme email enquiries, social media messages, and participant queries.

Coordinate participant onboarding and provide timely updates, reminders, and key programme information.

Escalate and manage participant issues, concerns, and requests, working closely with the Education and Outreach team to ensure effective resolution.

Gather participant stories, testimonials, and feedback for programme improvement and communications.

3. Event Planning & Logistics (20%)

Support planning and execution of workshops, networking sessions, mentorship events, field trips, and programme showcases.

Coordinate event registrations, attendance tracking, and participant communications.

Assist with venue setup, materials preparation, and on-site event support.

Current undergraduate, polytechnic student, or recent graduate.

Active user of social media platforms, especially Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

title: General Manager, Regional Marketing
description:
Nippon Shokubai (Asia) Pte. Ltd. (NSA) is seeking an experienced General Manager to lead regional marketing and business development for Nippon Shokubai Group products in Southeast Asia and India. Paints and coatings will be one of NSA’s core marketing pillars and an important area for future growth. The role requires a rare combination of technical expertise, marketing capability and commercial experience, particularly in paints, coatings, adhesives, emulsion polymers, construction chemicals and related application technologies.

Job Description

Lead the development and execution of NSA’s regional marketing strategy for Nippon Shokubai Group products in Southeast Asia and India, with paints and coatings positioned as one of the principal growth areas.

Identify growth opportunities in paints, coatings and related applications through market research, competitor analysis, customer interviews and engagement with customers’ R&D, technical and procurement functions.

Develop technically differentiated proposals by applying deep knowledge of emulsion products, coating formulations, surrounding raw materials and application technologies to customers’ performance, sustainability and cost requirements.

Work closely with Nippon Shokubai’s R&D, marketing and sales organizations in Japan to translate key regional customers (ASEAN, India and Japan) needs into product development, technical evaluation, sample work and commercialization plans in line with the Group’s strategy.

Lead new application exploration, market development and overseas business development projects, and manage a prioritized pipeline of opportunities across ASEAN and India from initial identification through customer evaluation and commercial readiness.

Coordinate the handover of commercially qualified opportunities to Nippon Shokubai’s responsible sales organization, which will lead commercial negotiations and enter into sales contracts, while NSA continues to support regional customer and market development.

Job Requirements

A minimum of 20 years of hands-on research and development experience in paints, adhesives, emulsion polymers, construction chemicals or related industries, gained at a globally listed chemical manufacturing company or its overseas subsidiaries.

A minimum of 2 years of practical experience in the sales and development of products for paints, adhesives, emulsion polymers, construction chemicals or related applications, including customer proposals, technical discussions, product evaluation and application development. The successful candidate must have gained this experience within the last 2 years.

A minimum of 5 years in a managerial role, leading cross-functional projects and coordinating effectively with R&D, marketing and sales teams in Japan and with customers across the region.

Experience in overseas business expansion, market development or new market entry projects, together with sound knowledge of key customers, market structures, competitors, distribution channels and business practices in ASEAN and India.

Demonstrated hands-on knowledge of resins, additives, related raw materials and formulation technologies used in paints, coatings, adhesives, emulsion polymers, construction chemicals or related applications.

Business-level proficiency in written and spoken English and Japanese language proficiency equivalent to JLPT N1 is required for technical and commercial discussions with key regional customers from ASEAN, India and Japan.　

Willingness to travel within ASEAN, India and Japan is required.

title: SVP/VP, AdTech Lead, Performance Marketing Platforms, Group Marketing & Communications
description:
Business Function:

The successful candidate should have the technical expertise to interpret API documentation, design solutions and requirements, lead prototypes, validate integrations, and approve production solutions with Technology and Data teams.
Build and scale DBS’s in-house performance marketing platform, controls, and operating Own the AdTech product strategy, roadmap, AdTech architecture, AdOps standards, audience activation, measurement, and transition of selected repeatable media activities from agencies to DBS.
Create a hybrid operating model that reduces unnecessary agency reliance while preserving access to specialist expertise and flexible capacity.
Develop an enterprise performance marketing capability across Marketing, Data, and Technology, directly influencing platform strategy, operating standards, investment priorities, and measurable business outcomes across markets.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy and roadmap: Define the target operating model for in-house paid digital media capability, overall product strategy, target architecture, capability backlog and success measures for performance marketing platforms, AdTech and AdOps.
Platform ownership : Establish DBS-owned account, access and campaign structures across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok and approved programmatic platforms, including clear controls for agency and market access. Define automation, machine learning and AI capabilities to enable scalable, agentic media planning, audience targeting, bid optimisation, creative generation, execution and performance optimisation.
AdTech product delivery: Convert marketing needs into solution designs, API and data requirements, event schemas, acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements and production-readiness standards. Deliver the capabilities working with Technology, Data Engineering, Analytics and platform partners.
Performance creative enablement: Connect paid-media requirements with in-house creative automation by defining channel specifications, reusable templates, creative metadata, testing frameworks, asset refresh rules and governance for AI-generated content.
AdOps capability and controls : Define standards for trafficking, naming, permissions, tags, pixels, events, feeds, conversion validation, launch QA, budget controls, brand safety, incidents and change management.
Audience and signal activation: Lead the roadmap for first-party audience activation, exclusions, audience synchronization, server-side tagging, conversion APIs, enhanced and offline conversions, and media-platform feedback loops.
Measurement and optimisation: Define the conversion framework and closed-loop measurement capability covering attribution, incrementality, experimentation, automated bidding, value signals and business-outcome reporting. Own the technical requirements for signal quality (tracking, conversions, audience feeds) in partnership with Data Engineering
Hybrid operating model: Decide which repeatable activities should be operated internally, and which specialist services should remain with agencies. Establish service levels, decision rights, handoffs, scorecards and escalation paths.
Leadership and governance: Align senior stakeholders across Marketing, Technology, Data, Analytics, Risk, Legal, Procurement, markets, agencies and media platforms. Own investment cases, delivery governance and measurable outcomes.

Requirements

12+ years across performance marketing, paid media, AdTech, AdOps or digital platform product leadership, including ownership of enterprise-scale transformation and delivery.
Deep working knowledge of Google Ads and Google Marketing Platform, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, TikTok Ads and relevant programmatic platforms.
Hands-on understanding of Google Ads API, Meta Marketing API, LinkedIn Advertising API and platform authentication, permissions, account hierarchies, campaign, audience, creative, reporting and conversion services.
Working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager and server-side tagging, AppsFlyer, conversion and event APIs, enhanced and offline conversions, audience matching and customer-data or audience-activation platforms such as Tealium.
Ability to interpret API documentation, JSON payloads, event schemas, data mappings and integration logs; shape prototypes; diagnose defects; and assess implementation quality and production readiness.
Practical experience establishing or governing AdOps across account setup, campaign trafficking, access, tagging, audience onboarding, feeds, conversion validation, launch QA and operational support.
Proven leadership across Marketing, Technology, Data Engineering, Analytics, external platform or agency partners.
Strong understanding of Data Science, Machine Learning and AI product development, including model lifecycle management, experimentation frameworks, predictive marketing, recommendation systems, generative AI and agentic workflows. Experience defining requirements for AI-enabled marketing capabilities and translating business objectives into scalable data and AI solutions.
Demonstrated experience designing or materially improving an in-house or hybrid performance-media operating model, including agency transition and capability transfer.
Experience in financial services or another regulated environment is strongly preferred.
Strong command of automated bidding, signal quality, campaign architecture, attribution, incrementality, experimentation and closed-loop optimisation.
Knowledge of access governance, privacy, brand safety, media quality, change and incident controls, including governance for AI-generated advertising assets.
Product-led and outcome-oriented, with the ability to connect business goals, customer value, platform decisions and measurable results.
Technically credible without losing commercial judgement or becoming a pure engineering specialist.

What We Offer

Unique company culture of Dutch heritage and international presence. At FrieslandCampina you work on strong, globally loved brands enjoyed by millions every day, like Friso, Campina, Chocomel and Frisian Flag. As a farmer-owned cooperative, we combine an international environment with a clear social and sustainable purpose. We support your growth through training, coaching and internal career opportunities. With trust and autonomy, you can make real impact.
Competitive bonus scheme, flexible working hours, and the ability to work from home.
Exceptional support of cross disciplinary movement within the company to broaden your knowledge and growth paths.
A friendly and informal working environment
Autonomy and trust to create longer term impact that helps bring better nutrition to the world

Vacancy Description

FrieslandCampina is executing a company-wide transformation to accelerate profitable growth, improve margins and strengthen global competitiveness. Marketing and media are key levers in this transformation and must become more focused, effective and efficient to ensure investments drive commercial impact. As Marketing & Media Manager Asia & AMEA, you will play a critical role in making this ambition a reality.

You will lead the creation and activation of the vision for marketing across the region, ensuring marketing remains relevant, competitive, efficient and a strong growth engine for the business. In close partnership with leadership and global stakeholders, you will be responsible for the design and delivery of strategic marketing transformation initiatives.

In this role, you will co-create the marketing transformation roadmap, align priorities with enterprise strategy and business objectives, and ensure measurable business impact through clear milestones, governance and performance tracking. You will drive the implementation of media transformation initiatives, lead the consolidation of creative agency ecosystems and production operations, enabling a more simplified, scalable and efficient operating model. Through the implementation of new governance structures, workflows and ways of working, you will improve transparency, speed, consistency and cross-functional collaboration across teams and markets.

A key part of the role is translating and embedding the new marketing operating model across Operating Companies. You will work closely with Marketing, Sales, eCommerce, IT, Data & Analytics, Procurement, Finance and external agency partners to drive alignment and execution in a highly matrixed and decentralised environment. description:
Summary

COME, EXPRESS YOUR ANDAZ

Join Andaz Singapore, the first Andaz hotel in Southeast Asia.

Occupying Levels 25 to 39 of the DUO Tower, Andaz Singapore is a lifestyle hotel brand by Hyatt Hotels Corporation that inspires fresh perspectives. The first Andaz property in Southeast Asia offers well-appointed guestrooms and suites, four event venues, and five dining and drinking concepts. Situated at the crossroads of the Kampong Glam, Little India and Bras Basah Bugis cultural districts—with their intimate shophouse-filled alleyways and atmospheric colours, textures and flavours— Andaz Singapore aims to spark discovery of the rich culture of Singapore and inspire guests to experience the city from new angles.

Global in scale while local in perspective, the Andaz brand empowers self-expression and stimulates guests’ curiosity through imaginative travel for a distinctively local experience. Through thoughtful, unscripted service tailored for travelers, Andaz hotels enable guests to go beyond the familiar to discover and define their personal essence while immersing themselves in the spirit of the eclectic culture around them.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

At Andaz Singapore, we believe in creating inspiring experiences through genuine connections, thoughtful leadership and a culture where colleagues can be their best selves.

We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Director of Sales & Marketing / Executive Assistant Manager-Sales & Marketing to join our Leadership Committee. Reporting to the General Manager, this role provides strategic leadership across Sales, Events, Weddings, Revenue Management coordination, Marketing Communications and Digital Marketing. The position translates the hotel’s strategy, brand direction and financial priorities into integrated commercial plans that drive revenue, market share, customer preference and long-term brand value.

This is an exciting opportunity for an accomplished commercial leader who combines strong business acumen with a passion for developing people, building meaningful customer relationships and delivering measurable results.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

· Develop and execute an integrated Sales & Marketing business plan covering key market segments, accounts, channels, events, weddings and communications.

· Lead commercial strategies that drive room, event and wedding revenue, market share, demand generation and conversion.

· Set the hotel’s sales deployment, key-account development, prospecting, customer engagement and market coverage priorities.

· Guide the Revenue Management function in evaluating business pace, demand patterns, competitive conditions, displacement and need periods, while developing well-supported pricing and revenue recommendations.

· Lead the commercial performance of Events and Weddings, including pipeline conversion, space utilisation, client engagement, revenue delivery and cross-functional handovers.

· Oversee integrated marketing, public relations, digital, advertising, partnership and content initiatives, ensuring measurable returns and consistency with Andaz brand standards.

· Maintain accurate commercial forecasts, pipeline information, competitive intelligence, campaign analysis and executive performance reporting.

· Manage the department’s budget, productivity, promotional investment, contracts, purchasing and financial controls.

· Recruit, coach and develop a high-performing and inclusive commercial team, while strengthening succession planning and leadership capability.

· Ensure that commercial activities, contracts, records, data controls and departmental procedures comply with Hyatt policies and applicable requirements.

Qualifications

WHAT YOU HAVE

· Substantial senior leadership experience in luxury hospitality Sales & Marketing.

· Broad commercial exposure across sales, events, revenue collaboration, marketing communications and digital channels.

· A demonstrated ability to develop complex commercial plans, interpret market and financial performance, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

· Strong understanding of lifestyle positioning, customer expectations, brand standards and long-term brand equity.

· Executive presence, sound judgement, discretion and the ability to contribute constructively to hotel-wide decisions.

· Strong communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to engage senior leaders, owners, corporate partners, customers and colleagues.

· A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Hospitality, Communications or a related discipline, or equivalent executive experience. You will be expected to connect market intelligence, customer demand, pricing, channel performance and hotel operating capacity to clear commercial action. You will use financial, digital, CRM, business intelligence and revenue data to identify opportunities, manage risks and improve performance.

You will work collaboratively with the General Manager, hotel leadership, operating divisions, Finance, Human Resources and Hyatt partners to create shared accountability and deliver sustainable results. You will build strong customer and industry relationships, communicate with clarity, and create an environment where colleagues are empowered to experiment, improve and grow.

title: Assistant Manager, Marketing Communications
description:
Company Description

HOTEL OVERVIEW

Strategically located in the heart of Singapore’s shopping, dining and entertainment districts and with the City Hall and Esplanade Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) train stations and other major transportation nodes at its doorstep, Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford are the gateway to explore Singapore’s landscapes at your convenience. With a total of 2,030 well-appointed guestrooms, both hotels also offer a distinct collection of 12 lifestyle and dining choices including Michelin-starred fine dining restaurant JAAN by Kirk Westaway, cutting-edge meeting space at Raffles City Convention Centre with 34 meeting rooms and one of Asia’s largest spas, Willow Stream Spa.

ABOUT OUR COMPANY

At Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford, we design career plans and unveil new professional perspectives through our various development programs. We shine when YOU shine. Come and be part of our dynamic team and experience immerse growth and career opportunities with us.

Job Description

The Assistant Marketing Communications Manager develops and leads communications strategies for assigned revenue streams and lifestyle-led portfolios across Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford. This role has a strong focus on campaign management, public relations, media relations, content development, influencer engagement, media planning, partnerships, F&B storytelling, spa and lifestyle campaigns, while supporting broader hotel, brand and corporate initiatives. The role supports the Director of Marketing Communications in managing campaign execution, agency coordination, media hosting and team workflow. This is a leadership position as second in-charge to lead and manage the team.

COMMUNICATIONS & MEDIA PLANNING

Formulate communications and media calendars for assigned portfolios, ensuring timely and accurate execution of initiatives with relevant business units and stakeholders.

Develop Public Relations angles, media materials, influencer briefs and content narratives that generate positive and relevant coverage across local, regional and international channels.

Develop media plan for campaigns and dedicated business units for brand positioning and/or to meet campaign objectives

Review communications materials including press releases, media pitches, social copy, sales decks, in-house collaterals, ad copy and campaign assets to ensure accuracy, tonality and brand alignment.

Lead assigned awards submissions, canvassing of votes or nominations, and post-award amplification with relevant stakeholders.

Identify partnership opportunities with lifestyle, luxury, F&B, wellness, cultural and corporate brands to create differentiated guest experiences.

LIFESTYLE, PUBLIC RELATIONS & PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT

Lead or support lifestyle and Public Relations -driven portfolios such as selected F&B venues, spa, wellness, partnerships, IP-led collaborations, festive campaigns and hotel stories.

Manage media, blogger, content creator and influencer hosting to drive positive coverage and beneficial commercial outcomes.

Coordinate media familiarisation stays, F&B tastings, chef interviews, partner activations and hosted experiences in line with approved strategy and budgets.

Support restaurant and bar positioning by developing story angles around culinary concepts, chefs, menus, events, awards and collaborations.

Maintain active awareness of hospitality, lifestyle, dining, wellness and media trends to identify relevant opportunities.

CAMPAIGN & EVENT MANAGEMENT

Conceptualise, plan and execute integrated communications campaigns with the Director, internal team, Public relations agencies, digital partners and business unit stakeholders.

Support marketing and promotion of hotel-led events, ensuring strong attendance, media relevance, guest experience and post-event reporting.

Prepare campaign briefs, timelines, content requirements, photography or videography briefs, creative references and partner deliverables.

Coordinate cross-channel launches across website, social media, email, in-house displays, press outreach, partner platforms and advertising placements.

Monitor campaign performance and prepare updates with recommendations for optimisation.

MARKET RESEARCH & ANALYSIS

Conduct market research to identify consumer preferences, competitor activity, hospitality trends and relevant lifestyle or dining developments.

Analyse public relations , campaign, media monitoring, social and stakeholder feedback to develop informed recommendations that support business goals.

Review competitive communications to identify opportunities for differentiation and stronger positioning.

PARTNER, AGENCY & VENDOR ENGAGEMENT

Manage day-to-day agency, partner and vendor coordination for assigned projects, ensuring clear scopes, timelines, deliverables and approvals.

Host partners and industry contacts for ongoing engagement and potential collaborations.

Support negotiation of value-added partner arrangements that enhance brand relevance, reduce costs or improve guest experiences.

BUDGETING & ADMINISTRATION

Manage campaign and assigned business unit budgets and forecast.

Monitor campaign-level budgets, quotations and supplier costs for assigned projects, ensuring forecast accuracy and procurement compliance.

Support annual budget planning by gathering scopes, historical costs and proposed activity requirements.

Work with the Coordinator to ensure agreements, purchase requests, invoices and accruals are submitted accurately and on time.

OTHERS

Comply with hotel and department policies and procedures at all times.

Assist with Sales & Marketing projects and carry out other duties as assigned by Management.

Qualifications

Degree or Diploma in Hospitality, Tourism, Marketing, Communications, Public Relations or a related discipline.

 Minimum 3 to 6 years of marketing communications or public relations experience, preferably within hospitality, travel, lifestyle, luxury, F&B or agency environments.

Leadership – experience in leading and managing teams

Excellent spoken and written English. Fluency in a second language is preferred.

AI-enabled marketer, proficient in Claude, ChatGPT, relevant tools for content creation, presentations, project management

Strong knowledge of marketing communications (Branding, Public Relations , Events, Advertising), hospitality trends, media//KOL connections locally/regionally

Excellent writing, editing, media pitching and content planning skills.

Strong stakeholder management with the ability to work across multiple business units and senior stakeholders.

Ability to brief agencies, designers, photographers and vendors with clear objectives and timelines.

Strong analytical skills with comfort using media monitoring, influencer analysis and campaign performance data.

Creative, proactive and commercially minded, with a passion for hospitality and guest experiences.

Collaborative, adaptable and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

title: TikTok Performance Marketing Manage
description:
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on TikTok Performance Marketing Manager who specialises in selling physical consumer products through TikTok Shop.

Your primary responsibility is to generate profitable sales through TikTok advertising, particularly TikTok Shop GMV Max campaigns.

We are not looking for a traditional social media manager who focuses on followers, engagement or brand awareness. We want someone who understands how to convert advertising expenditure into revenue, identify winning video advertisements and scale campaigns profitably.

You will work closely with our in-house video production, influencer, affiliate and e-commerce teams to grow our skincare products in Singapore and Malaysia.

Key Responsibilities

1. TikTok Ads & GMV Max Management

- Independently set up, launch, monitor and optimise TikTok Shop GMV Max campaigns.

- Manage Product GMV Max campaigns and, where applicable, LIVE GMV Max campaigns.

- Set appropriate ROI targets, campaign budgets and product selections.

- Monitor advertising expenditure, GMV, ROI and cost per order daily.

- Identify underperforming campaigns and implement corrective actions.

- Optimise advertising expenditure according to product margins and profitability.

- Troubleshoot issues involving campaign delivery, insufficient spending, poor conversion rates and declining advertising returns.

- Manage campaigns across Singapore and Malaysia, accounting for differences in consumer behaviour and pricing.

2. Advertising Performance & Profitability

- Take direct responsibility for achieving assigned online sales and advertising profitability targets.

- Calculate product-level break-even ROAS based on selling price, cost of goods, platform fees, affiliate commissions and other variable costs.

- Identify which products generate the highest advertising returns.

- Recommend suitable promotional prices, product bundles and offers to improve conversion rates.

- Monitor customer acquisition costs and contribution margin after advertising.

- Distinguish between sales attributed to advertising and actual incremental sales growth.

- Scale successful campaigns without compromising profitability.

3. Video Advertising & Creative Optimisation

- Work directly with the internal video production team to identify and develop high-converting TikTok advertisements.

- Analyse individual video performance to determine which creatives generate sales.

- Develop creative briefs covering product pain points, selling propositions, hooks, demonstrations and calls to action.

- Recommend new video concepts based on advertising performance data.

- Test different video openings, product demonstrations, offers and messaging.

- Identify creative fatigue and recommend replacement advertisements before campaign performance deteriorates.

- Work with the influencer and affiliate teams to identify high-performing creator content suitable for paid advertising.

- Ensure a consistent pipeline of new advertising creatives for testing.

4. Campaign Testing & Scaling

- Develop structured testing plans for new products, advertisements and promotional offers.

- Establish clear criteria for identifying winning and losing creatives.

- Allocate initial test budgets and determine when campaigns should be scaled, maintained or stopped.

- Conduct controlled testing where feasible to distinguish creative performance from pricing, audience and promotional effects.

- Expand successful advertising strategies across additional products.

- Identify opportunities to increase sales during major TikTok Shop campaigns and promotional periods.

- Manage advertising budgets efficiently during both regular sales periods and major shopping events.

5. Reporting & Performance Analysis

- Maintain accurate daily tracking of advertising expenditure, attributed GMV, ROAS and cost per order.

- Produce weekly reports showing performance by product, campaign and advertising creative.

- Compare actual performance against assigned revenue and profitability targets.

- Identify the three strongest and three weakest advertising creatives each week, explaining their results.

- Provide actionable recommendations for increasing sales and improving advertising returns.

- Coordinate with the e-commerce team to reconcile advertising-attributed sales against actual orders, refunds and net revenue.

- Present clear recommendations for budget allocation and campaign improvements.

Job Requirement:

TikTok Advertising Experience

- Minimum 3 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, including substantial direct experience managing TikTok advertising campaign.

- Demonstrable experience managing TikTok Shop GMV Max campaigns.

- Must have personally managed advertising campaigns rather than solely overseeing external agencies.

- Experience advertising physical consumer products through TikTok Shop.

- Strong understanding of TikTok Shop's advertising ecosystem, campaign optimisation and performance measurement.

Commercial & Analytical Skills

- Proven ability to generate measurable e-commerce revenue through paid advertisements.

- Strong understanding of ROAS, ROI, CPA, CAC, GMV and advertising contribution margin.

- Ability to calculate campaign profitability after product costs, platform charges and affiliate commissions.

- Experience scaling daily advertising budgets while maintaining commercially acceptable returns.

- Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets for advertising performance analysis.

Creative Advertising Skills

- Strong understanding of TikTok video advertisements that drive purchases.

- Ability to identify effective hooks, product demonstrations and sales messaging.

- Experience testing UGC, creator-led advertisements and direct-response advertising creatives.

- Ability to translate campaign performance data into actionable instructions for video creators.

Preferred Experience

- Previous experience marketing skincare, cosmetics, personal care or FMCG products.

- Experience managing TikTok Shop advertising in Singapore and Malaysia.

- Experience working with affiliate creators and content authorisation for paid campaigns.

- Familiarity with Shopee Ads and Meta Ads.

- Experience in promoting products with relatively low selling prices, where advertising efficiency and margins are critical.

title: Head of Communications & Brand
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

About BW Group

BW Group is a leading global energy and maritime company involved in shipping, deepwater oil & gas production, renewable energy and digital infrastructure. BW controls a fleet of over 400 vessels transporting oil, gas and dry commodities. In the infrastructure space, the group operates in wind, batteries, water, subsea cable networks and data centres.

BW is proud to be listed among Forbes World's Best Employers and Financial Times Best Employers Asia-Pacific 2025.

Are you ready to make an impact?

What drives us is our mission to deliver energy for the world today, and to find solutions for tomorrow. If you want to make lives better around the world by providing access to energy, while working on sustainability and decarbonisation, we'd like to hear from you. Working at BW you will feel the pulse of the world each day. If something happens in the world, we feel it, and you can play your part by anticipating and responding to it. Our high-performing teams are drawn to BW by the global nature of our work and the satisfaction of working with collaborative people who inspire each other to deliver exceptional results.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Role Overview

Based in Singapore and reporting to the Chief People Officer, BW Group, the Head of Communications & Brand leads communications and corporate brand activities across BW Group whilst also supporting BW LNG.

This is a highly visible role partnering closely with the Chairman, senior executives and Communications leaders across our affiliate companies to strengthen BW's reputation, shape its corporate narrative and foster greater collaboration across the Group.

Success requires far more than exceptional communications capability. You will be a commercially minded strategic thinker who anticipates issues, shapes narratives and influences outcomes through sound judgement, trusted relationships and collaboration in a federated organisation where credibility matters more than hierarchy.

Working with a lean team and external partners, you will combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, helping shape executive communications, protect and enhance the BW brand, support organisational transformation and drive communications excellence across the Group.

Key Accountabilities

Corporate Communications

Develop and deliver BW Group's corporate communications strategy aligned with the Group's long-term vision and priorities.

Shape compelling narratives that strengthen understanding of BW's purpose, strategy and portfolio of businesses.

Advise leaders on communications strategy, executive messaging and stakeholder engagement.

Lead communications for strategic initiatives, organisational change, major announcements and corporate events.

Oversee BW Group's digital communications, including LinkedIn and other channels, delivering engaging content that strengthens the brand and supports strategic objectives.

Executive

Communications

Partner closely with the Chairman and senior executives on speeches, presentations, thought leadership and executive communications.

Develop executive communications that reflect BW's values and high editorial standards.

Lead the production of flagship Group communications, including World Horizon, the Annual Report, Sustainability Report, corporate website and key leadership updates.

Support senior executives at conferences, media engagements, investor events and industry forums through end-to-end communications planning and delivery.

Serve as a trusted communications adviser to the Chairman and senior leadership, providing sound judgement on messaging, stakeholder considerations and reputational matters.

Employee

Communications

Lead Group-wide employee communications across digital channels.

Deliver engaging communications that connect shore-based and seafaring employees through platforms such as BW Connect.

Foster a culture of openness, pride and engagement across the Group.

Brand & Reputation

Act as steward of the BW corporate brand, ensuring consistency whilst respecting the autonomy of our affiliate businesses.

Evolve BW's corporate identity and positioning to strengthen the Group's reputation and create value across the portfolio.

Protect and enhance BW's reputation with employees, customers, investors, regulators, partners and the wider maritime and energy community.

Lead crisis and issues communications, partnering with senior management and external advisers as required for ongoing incidents and with post-communications.

BW LNG Communications & Marketing

Partner with the BW LNG leadership team to develop communications and marketing initiatives that strengthen the company's commercial positioning and reputation.

Lead communications supporting commercial initiatives, including vessel launches, technology innovations, customer campaigns and industry events.

Develop marketing content and digital campaigns that showcase BW LNG's capabilities, innovation and market leadership.

Ensure alignment between BW LNG's communications and the wider BW corporate brand.

Leadership & Influence

Lead BW's Communications Community of Practice, fostering collaboration, sharing best practice and identifying opportunities for greater alignment across affiliate companies.

Build trusted relationships with affiliate CEOs and Communications leaders, influencing through credibility rather than authority.

Foster collaboration across the Group whilst respecting the entrepreneurial culture and autonomy of individual businesses.

Digital Communications & AI

Harness AI and emerging technologies to improve the quality, consistency, efficiency and reach of communications.

Identify and implement new tools, channels and approaches that enhance engagement and communications effectiveness.

Measure communications impact using meaningful qualitative and quantitative insights.

Team Leadership

Lead, coach and develop a small, high-performing communications team.

Manage external agencies and specialist partners to maximise quality, capability and value.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

We're looking for someone who combines strategic communications leadership with exceptional judgement and the ability to influence senior stakeholders. You'll ideally bring:

Significant experience leading corporate communications within a global organisation or consultancy.

Experience advising CEOs and senior executives on communications strategy and reputation management.

Strong understanding of corporate branding, stakeholder engagement and executive communications.

Experience leading communications during periods of organisational change, transformation or significant corporate activity.

Experience working across complex, matrixed or federated organisations would be advantageous.

Experience within the maritime or energy sectors would be beneficial, although not essential.

What Will Make You Successful

You'll be someone who naturally earns trust and credibility. You'll demonstrate:

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

Excellent judgement and discretion.

The ability to simplify complex issues into clear, compelling messages.

Exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills.

Strong commercial awareness.

High levels of curiosity and strategic thinking.

Comfort working directly with senior executives and Board-level stakeholders.

A collaborative style with low ego and high integrity.

The ability to balance strategic thinking with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and deliver.

Demonstrates sound judgement in knowing when to follow established processes and when a pragmatic, flexible approach will deliver a better outcome.

A passion for continuous improvement, innovation and practical application of AI.

This role is unlikely to suit someone who prefers highly structured environments, relies on formal authority to get things done, or wants to specialise in a single area of communications. Success requires sound judgement, adaptability, collaboration and a willingness to operate across a broad range of strategic and hands-on responsibilities.

OTHER INFORMATION

Why BW?

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the voice and reputation of one of the world's most respected maritime and energy groups.

You'll work closely with visionary leaders who value integrity, long-term thinking and collaboration, while helping tell the story of a business investing in both today's energy needs and tomorrow's energy transition.

The role offers exceptional breadth, combining strategy, executive partnership, brand leadership, organisational change, employee engagement and external communications in an entrepreneurial international environment.

Please note that your application will be sent to and reviewed by the direct employer - BW Maritime
