title: Brand Marketing Director
description:
About GNAME

GNAME is Asia’s leading domain registrar, based out of Singapore. We power a native marketplace designed for discovering, buying, and selling the perfect brand identity—including a backorder system of high-value, premium domain names that have expired into digital ether.

For more info on what we do: https://www.gname.com

We are seeking an experienced Brand Marketing Director to lead GNAME's global brand and marketing strategy, strengthen brand positioning, build integrated marketing capabilities, grow brand awareness and customer engagement across priority international markets, and translate business strategy into measurable brand and marketing outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

1. Global Brand Strategy & Positioning

· Develop and lead GNAME's global brand strategy, positioning, value proposition and brand architecture in alignment with business strategy and international growth priorities.

· Define brand narratives, messaging frameworks, tone of voice and visual direction to ensure a consistent and differentiated brand across markets and customer touchpoints.

· Advise senior management on brand strategy, market positioning, reputation and major marketing priorities.

· Establish brand governance standards across corporate, product, digital, event and employer-facing communications.

· Monitor brand health, market perception and competitive positioning and translate insights into strategic actions.

2. Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning

· Develop annual and multi-market marketing strategies, priorities, budgets and execution roadmaps supporting customer acquisition, engagement, retention and business growth.

· Lead integrated campaigns across digital, content, social media, public relations, partnerships, events, community and other relevant channels.

· Translate business and product priorities into audience strategies, campaign propositions and go-to-market programmes.

· Build effective planning, campaign governance, agency/vendor management and performance review processes.

· Balance long-term brand building with measurable demand and commercial outcomes.

3. International Market Development & Go-to-Market

· Lead brand and marketing initiatives for priority international markets, including market-entry and growth programmes where relevant.

· Conduct market, customer, competitor and category analysis to identify growth opportunities, audience needs and positioning gaps.

· Adapt global brand and campaign strategies to local market context while maintaining overall brand consistency.

· Partner with business development, sales, product and operations teams on market launches, customer programmes and strategic partnerships.

· Build relationships with relevant industry communities, media, partners and ecosystem stakeholders to expand GNAME's visibility and credibility.

4. Digital, Content & Community Marketing

· Set the strategy for owned digital channels, social media, content, community and thought-leadership programmes.

· Develop content frameworks communicating GNAME's expertise in domain names and internet services to relevant customer and industry audiences.

· Oversee editorial calendars, campaign content, executive communications, corporate storytelling and key digital assets.

· Strengthen customer and industry engagement through communities, educational content, events and other relationship-building initiatives.

· Ensure content quality, brand consistency and appropriate review processes across external communications.

5. Marketing Performance, Analytics & Customer Insights

· Define marketing KPIs covering brand awareness, engagement, customer acquisition, conversion, campaign effectiveness and return on marketing investment.

· Use customer, market, channel and campaign data to evaluate performance and guide budget and resource allocation.

· Develop regular marketing dashboards and management reports with clear insights, risks and recommended actions.

· Strengthen customer insight and feedback mechanisms to improve positioning, messaging, campaigns and customer experience.

· Promote a test-and-learn culture and continuously improve marketing effectiveness through experimentation and performance analysis.

6. Team Leadership & Cross-functional Collaboration

· Build, lead and develop the brand and marketing function, including capability planning, objective setting, performance management and talent development.

· Work closely with the CEO and senior management to align brand and marketing priorities with Company strategy.

· Partner with product, business development, sales, operations, customer service, compliance, legal, finance and HR teams to deliver integrated initiatives.

· Manage external agencies, consultants, media, creative partners and other vendors where required.

· Establish clear standards, workflows and accountability to ensure high-quality and timely marketing execution.

7. Reputation, Communications & Brand Risk Management

· Oversee corporate brand communications and support reputation management across relevant external channels.

· Develop communication approaches for significant company announcements, partnerships, product developments and industry engagement.

· Work with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure external marketing and communications are accurate, appropriate and aligned with applicable requirements.

· Identify brand and reputation risks and establish appropriate escalation, review and response mechanisms.

· Support senior leaders in external communications and thought leadership where appropriate.

Requirements

· Bachelor's degree or above in Marketing, Communications, Business, Brand Management or a related discipline.

· At least 12 years of progressive experience in brand, marketing or integrated communications, including substantial experience in a senior marketing leadership role.

· Demonstrated experience developing and executing brand and marketing strategy across multiple markets, including brand positioning, integrated campaigns, digital/content marketing and marketing performance.

· Experience in technology, internet, SaaS, digital platforms, e-commerce, fintech or another international digital business is highly preferred.

· Strong understanding of digital customer journeys, international marketing channels, content and community building, and data-driven marketing.

· Proven ability to partner with CEOs, senior executives and cross-functional leaders and translate business strategy into practical brand and marketing programmes.

· Strong leadership, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, analytical, communication and change-management capabilities.

· Experience managing marketing budgets, agencies, vendors and multi-channel programmes with measurable outcomes.

· Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, international and evolving organisation, balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution when required.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Chinese to liaise with internal and external stakeholders.

About Us

GNAME was established in Singapore as a professional international domain name registrar. We are dedicated to creating a comprehensive service platform for Internet domain names. At GNAME, domain names are at the heart of our business, and we offer a wide range of services to our customers, including global domain name registration, dropcatch, transactions, management, API interfaces, and other relevant services. Adopting an open reseller model, we offer reseller a one-stop management system including products, transactions, and financial management, fully supporting their business development. In addition to domain services, we also provide a diverse range of cloud products such as cloud servers, SSL certificates, website protection, and enterprise email services. Based on cloud computing technology, these services are highly scalable and secure, meeting customers’ needs in information technology and network security.

Our strong reputation is built on our commitment to putting customers first. In the future, we will continue to work hard, stay current with industry trends, and deliver the most valuable products and services to our global customers.

title: Social Media Account Manager
description:
Job Description — Social Media Account Manager

Role

Social Media Account Manager

Reports to

Head of Operations

Location

Remote, Singapore-based

Type

Full-time

Compensation

SGD 2,200 per month

Accounts held

[X] client accounts

Review

At 3 months and 6 months

Purpose of the role

Network manages social media for interior design firms, architects and furniture suppliers across IG, FB, TikTok and YouTube. Production, design and video editing sit with the delivery team.

This role owns the account and the result. Everything that reaches a client's channel goes through this person: what gets made, what gets written, when it gets shot, and whether it performs.

The delivery team makes the work. The consultant owns the commercial relationship. The Account Manager is accountable for the work being right, landing on time, and growing the account organically. Delivery is the floor, not the measure.

Key responsibilities

Client strategy

Build the content strategy for each account with the consultant assigned to it

Take the commercial context from the consultant (what the client sells, who they want, what they have promised) and turn it into a content direction that delivers it

Set the account's organic objective with the consultant at the start of each cycle, and agree what success looks like

Bring performance data to the consultant so strategy changes are based on what happened, not on what the client asked for last

Flag when a client request will not serve the objective, and give the consultant an alternative to take back

The consultant owns the client relationship and the commercial conversation. The Account Manager owns what gets made and why.

Organic performance

Own the organic result on every assigned account: reach, engagement, page growth and enquiries

Decide what gets made based on what is performing, not on filling a calendar

Track performance weekly and change direction on evidence, not at month end

Identify formats that work on one account and carry them to others

Visual direction and alignment

Hold the visual standard on every account. Network works in a premium category and output must look considered, not templated

Keep each account visually coherent. A feed should read as one brand, not a run of unrelated posts

Reject work that meets the brief but misses the bar, and say why

Client posting and accountability

Own the posting schedule for every assigned account across all platforms

Publish or schedule all content to the agreed calendar

Review every asset before it goes live for typos, brand accuracy and strategic fit

Take responsibility for anything published in error, including retraction and client explanation

Copywriting

Write captions for all assigned accounts in the client's voice, not a house voice

Write hooks, on-creative text and CTAs supplied to the design and video teams

Adapt one concept into platform-appropriate copy across IG, FB, TikTok and YouTube

Maintain a written voice reference for each account so copy stays consistent

Creative deliverables

Plan the content calendar and pipeline for each account against the agreed monthly deliverable

Write briefs for the graphic and video teams that are complete enough to execute without follow-up

Track every deliverable from brief to published, and know its status without being asked

Run revision rounds with the delivery team and close them out

Shoot scheduling and coordination

Schedule production shoots with the client and the production team

Confirm site access, timing, homeowner permissions and scope before the shoot date

Brief the production team on what the shoot must produce

Chase and confirm footage handover after the shoot

Delivery team communication

Act as the single point of contact between clients and the graphic, video and production teams

Give the delivery team enough lead time to work; escalate capacity conflicts early

Keep the delivery team unblocked so they are never waiting on information

Client communication

Own client group chats as the day-to-day point of contact

Respond within working hours, with no dropped threads

Manage expectations on timelines and flag delays before the client notices them

Performance measures

Performance on this role is judged on organic outcomes, not activity.

Primary

Organic creative performance: reach, retention and engagement on published content against account baseline

Page growth: follower growth, saves and shares across assigned accounts

Organic enquiries: DMs, comments and leads generated through organic content

Visual direction: accounts hold a consistent, premium visual standard across the feed

Strategic alignment: what gets made maps to the account's growth objective

Baseline

On-time publishing rate across all assigned accounts

Errors reaching a live client channel (target: zero)

Deliverables completed against monthly contracted volume

Shoot dates held versus rescheduled

Delivery team blocked time attributable to missing briefs or information

Baseline measures are expectations. Missing them is a problem. Meeting them is not performance.

Requirements

Experience

1–2 years running social media accounts in a client-facing role

Demonstrated organic growth on an account you owned, with numbers

Skills

Written Mandarin and English

Copywriting for social, with samples

Meta Business Suite, native platform scheduling and native analytics

Able to read performance data and change direction from it

Taste. Two versions of an asset in front of you, you can say which is better and why

Able to write a brief another person can execute without asking questions

Able to hold a strategy conversation with a salesperson and push back with reasoning

Accurate proofreading under volume

Other

Contactable and responsive on WhatsApp during working hours

Works without supervision or reminders

Singapore-based

Working arrangement

Remote. Occasional attendance at shoots or client meetings as required. Communication runs through WhatsApp and [project management tool].

Out of scope

Graphic design and video editing

Filming and on-site production

Paid media buying

Client contract negotiation, pricing and upselling

Ownership of the commercial relationship

Network Singapore is a digital marketing and lead generation company specialising in the interior design industry. We operate one of Singapore's leading online portals connecting homeowners with interior design firms, helping businesses grow their client base through targeted digital exposure and a consistent flow of qualified leads.

Founded with a focus on results, we work closely with interior design professionals across Singapore to deliver marketing solutions that are measurable, scalable, and built around the needs of a competitive market. Our platform is designed to reduce the time and cost of client acquisition for interior design firms, allowing them to focus on what they do best — delivering exceptional spaces.

At Network Singapore, we believe in building long-term partnerships with our clients. Our team combines deep industry knowledge with a data-driven approach to ensure that every firm on our platform gets maximum visibility and genuine business opportunities.

We are a growing company with a performance-driven culture, committed to developing talent from within and building a team that takes pride in delivering results.

title: Events, Programming & Business Development Executive
description:
The Events, Programming & BusinessDevelopment Executive is responsible for managing assigned events, developing revenue opportunities and supporting entertainment programming and production activities across the company’s venues.

The role covers the end-to-end coordinationof corporate events, venue rentals, private functions, selected ticketed programmes and commercial partnerships, from initial enquiry through execution and post-event follow-up.

This is a commercially driven role withaccountability for assigned sales and revenue targets. The Executive will workclosely with internal departments, clients, artistes, technical personnel,vendors, sponsors and external partners to support the growth of the Music,Content & Events (MCE) portfolio.

The position is eligible for commission onqualifying revenue in accordance with the Company’s prevailing commissionscheme.

Key Responsibilities

1. Events & Client Management

Manage assigned corporate functions, venue rentals, private events, activations and ticketed programmes from enquiry through event completion.

Liaise directly with clients to understand event objectives, requirements, budgets and timelines.

Conduct client meetings, site inspections and event briefings where required.

Prepare event proposals, quotations, timelines, run sheets and operational requirements.

Coordinate with Operations, Marketing, Finance, Technical teams and external vendors to ensure smooth event delivery.

Coordinate venue setup, manpower, equipment, production and event logistics.

Be present on-site for assigned events and manage client and operational requirements during execution.

Resolve event-related issues promptly and escalate matters where necessary.

Ensure assigned events comply with venue requirements, operational procedures, safety standards and applicable licensing requirements.

Conduct post-event follow-up and identify opportunities for repeat business and service improvement.

2. Business Development & Revenue

Develop new business opportunities through corporate events, venue rentals, private functions, sponsorships and commercial partnerships.

Respond promptly to incoming event and venue enquiries.

Build and maintain relationships with corporate clients, event organisers, agencies and business partners.

Prepare and present proposals, quotations, event budgets and commercial packages.

Manage commercial discussions and negotiate within approved pricing and commercial guidelines, escalating exceptions for approval.

Follow up actively on proposals and enquiries to improve sales conversion.

Maintain an updated sales pipeline covering enquiries, proposals, confirmed events and prospective opportunities.

Identify opportunities for repeat business, account development and long-term client relationships.

Achieve assigned individual and/or team revenue targets.

Identify opportunities to improve event profitability and maximise revenue from assigned accounts and events.

3. Sponsorship & Commercial Partnerships

Identify potential sponsors, brand partners and commercial collaboration opportunities.

Develop or support the preparation of sponsorship proposals and activation packages.

Liaise with sponsors and partners on agreed requirements, timelines and deliverables.

Coordinate with Marketing and Operations to ensure agreed brand visibility and activation requirements are fulfilled.

Maintain sponsor and partner relationships before, during and after events.

Explore additional revenue opportunities through brand activations, collaborations and commercial initiatives.

4. Entertainment & DigitalProgramming

Coordinate resident band, artiste and entertainment schedules across assigned venues.

Maintain programming calendars, artiste schedules and related documentation.

Liaise with bands, artistes, agents and relevant partners on bookings, schedules and performance requirements.

Coordinate artiste agreements and administrative requirements where applicable.

Support the development of entertainment concepts aligned with venue positioning, audience profiles and business objectives.

Monitor audience response, customer feedback and programme performance.

Recommend programming improvements or new entertainment formats for management review.

Support livestreaming, TikTok Live and other digital entertainment initiatives where applicable.

Coordinate talent, scheduling and production requirements for digital programming.

Explore opportunities to improve audience engagement and commercial value through digital content.

5. Technical & ProductionCoordination

Coordinate technical production requirements for assigned events, entertainment programmes and venue activations.

Liaise with internal technical personnel, sound engineers, vendors and contractors.

Ensure event technical requirements are confirmed in advance and equipment is ready for use.

Coordinate technical systems including:

LED walls

Resolume Media Server

Projectors and presentation systems

Audio systemsMultimedia and visual equipment

Where trained, support basic operation, setup, testing and troubleshooting of technical systems.

Escalate complex technical issues to the appropriate technical personnel or vendor.

Support consistent production and technical standards across assigned events.

6. Sound Engineering Coordination

Coordinate sound engineer schedules and manpower deployment for regular programming and special events.

Ensure sufficient technical coverage is arranged based on event and venue requirements.

Verify attendance and deployment records for sound engineers.

Submit accurate attendance and payroll-related records to the relevant department for processing.

Communicate event schedules and technical requirements clearly to assigned technical personnel.

Provide basic operational or technical support during events where trained and required.

Highlight recurring technical or manpower issues and recommend process improvements.

7. Major Events & Team Support

Work collaboratively with the MCE team on major festivals, flagship events and company-wide activations.

Take ownership of assigned workstreams and deliverables.

Support projects from concept development through planning, execution and post-event review.

Coordinate with internal departments, venue stakeholders, vendors, artistes and external partners.

Ensure assigned timelines, budgets and operational requirements are met.

Provide support to other team members during major or high-volume event periods where required.

8. Financial & AdministrativeResponsibilities

Prepare quotations, invoices, purchase requirements and event-related documentation accurately and on time.

Maintain proper records of enquiries, client communications, contracts, schedules and event documents.

Track revenue, direct event costs and assigned event expenditure.

Monitor event profitability against approved quotations and budgets.

Follow up on outstanding documentation, deposits and payment requirements with relevant stakeholders.

Support monthly revenue tracking and performance reporting.

Provide inputs for departmental budgeting and business planning where required.

Revenue Growth Responsibilities

The Executive is expected to contribute to the commercial growth ofthe MCE portfolio through:

Corporate events

Venue rentals

Private functions

Ticketed programmes

Sponsorships

Entertainment programming

Brand activations

Commercial partnerships

The Executive should actively identify opportunities to increase revenue, improve venue utilisation, generate repeat business and enhance even tprofitability while maintaining service and operational standards.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance may be assessed based on:

Achievement of assigned individual and/or team revenue targets

Sales conversion and development of the business pipeline

Event profitability and cost management

Successful execution of assigned events and programmes

Client satisfaction and repeat business

Sponsorship and commercial opportunities generated

Timeliness and accuracy of quotations, proposals and event documentation

Contribution to programming, technical operations and overall MCE performance

Remuneration & Commission

The position comprises a fixed monthly salary together with eligibility for sales commission.

Commission may apply to qualifying revenue generated from approved revenue streams including:

Corporate events and functions

Venue rentals

Private events

Sponsorships

Commercial partnerships

Other approved revenue-generating opportunities

Commission eligibility, revenue attribution, calculation, qualifying conditions, exclusions and payment arrangements will be governed separately by the Company’s prevailing commission scheme.

Requirements

Diploma or Degree in Events Management, Hospitality, Business, Marketing, Media, Communications or a related discipline preferred.

Relevant experience in events, hospitality, entertainment, venue operations, sales or business development would be advantageous.

Strong coordination, organisation and time-management skills.

Good written and verbal communication skills.

Confident in dealing with clients, artistes, vendors and internal stakeholders.

Commercially minded with a strong interest in sales and business development.

Able to manage multiple events, enquiries and priorities concurrently.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced and operational environment.

Willing to work evenings, weekends and public holidays where required for events and entertainment programmes.

Basic understanding of audio-visual or live entertainment production would be advantageous.

Knowledge of LED walls, Resolume, audio systems or livestreaming would be an added advantage.

Hands-on, resourceful and able to respond calmly to changes during live events.

Today, Timbre holds a portfolio of live music restaurants-bars and dining concepts, two Hawker Centres (Timbre + & Yishun Park Hawker Centre), and artist management agency and a music academy.

title: Assistant PR Manager
description:
Join the Bacha Coffee team

Great ideas start with coffee, Bacha Coffee starts with you. We are headquartered in Singapore with coffee rooms and boutiques in Europe and Asia currently. We are expanding aggressively to achieve a worldwide presence in the upcoming months...

Bacha Coffee specialises in 100% Arabica coffees and provides customers with a unique opportunity to travel the world through their cup by exploring harvests from over 30 of the most well-reputed coffee producing countries. Even our distinctive fine blended, fine-flavoured and naturally decaffeinated coffees are produced using only 100% Arabica beans to give coffee lovers the widest choice, without ever sacrificing quality or flavour.

The qualities that have made Bacha Coffee a legendary brand around the world also make us a great place to work: innovation, creativity, passion, and excellence.

Job Summary

Responsible for planning and implementing Bacha Coffee’s global public relations strategies and activities while ensuring consistency in brand messaging across relevant markets. This role is responsible for the development and implementation of support materials and management of PR agencies internationally, as well as coordinating strategically with the other departments and stakeholders within the company and the brand.

Primary Relationships

The position reports directly to the Public Relations Manager.

Within the organisation, this position has primary working relationships with the other members of the Corporate Communication Department, other HQ Departments and overseas partners.

Outside the organization, the position coordinates primarily with PR agencies, business partners and the media.

Responsibilities

Create and execute global Public Relations strategy that align with the brand developments, priorities and announcements

Familiarising with the brand DNA, heritage and offerings, while embodying the brand ethos. Support other departments, partners and stakeholders in ensuring that all external-facing communication is on-brand and Bacha Coffee’s desired image and positioning is consistently and accurately articulated

Support Public Relations Manager to guide overseas partners (both subsidiaries and franchises) for the management of their local media relations and vet their suggested press releases, PR campaigns, etc. across all markets globally

Write and proofread communication materials i.e., press releases, responses for media queries and interviews, boilerplates, management biographies, fact sheets, media kits, etc.

Elevating brand presence and positioning the brand accurately in local and global media sphere through media related activities such as media liaison, gifting, events and hostings, overseas media trips, etc.

Coordinating internally with other departments on all Public Relations matters including the creation of Public Relations materials and assets

Working with Bacha Coffee subsidiaries, franchises and distributors to ensure implementation of brand and editorial guidelines and directives

Effectively manage issues and crises in collaboration with Public Relations teams and Public Relations agencies in Singapore and overseas

Ensuring that proper archives of global media clippings are maintained and regularly updating Public Relations reporting standards

Regularly monitoring trends and informing management of developments in luxury, retail and F&B industries

Maintaining Bacha Coffee media databases and periodically revising and refreshing media outreach to constantly remain current

Qualifications

Required:

Minimum of 5 years’ experience in communications or public relations with demonstrated success, preferably in the luxury retail sector

Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, marketing, or public relations preferred

Past experience working in a Public Relations agency or managing international Public Relations agencies preferred

Past experience practising Public Relations for a luxury brand preferred

Past experience dealing with international markets/stakeholders and media being responsible for a global or regional scope

Applicants must be fluent in written and spoken English and have excellent writing and proofreading skills.

A second or third language would be an advantage, as it would support effective communication with our diverse franchise partners

Other:

Strong creative, strategic, analytical, organizational and personal skills

Demonstrated successful experience writing press releases, pitching and hosting media

Computer literacy in word processing, data base management and page layout

Commitment to working in cross-functional teams

Very strong oral and written communication skills

Ability to manage multiple projects at a time

Out-of-town, overnight travel might be required from time to time (less than 10%)

Bacha Coffee is an equal opportunity employer. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

The story of Bacha Coffee begins in the medina of Marrakech, Morocco. Built in 1910, the spectacular Dar el Bacha palace, which means “house of the Pasha”, united the greatest cultural and political minds of the century over glittering pots of “coffee of Arabia” or Arabica, as it is known today. Being the finest luxury coffee brand in the world, Bacha Coffee specialises in 100% Arabica coffees and provides customers with a unique opportunity to travel the world through their cup by exploring harvests from over 30 of the most well-reputed coffee producing countries. Even our distinctive fine blended, fine flavoured and naturally decaffeinated coffees are produced using only 100% Arabica beans to give coffee lovers the widest choice, without ever sacrificing quality or flavour.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
About This Role

We’re looking for an Account Manager who can make a complex account feel clear, controlled and well-run—for the client and for the team delivering it.

You will be a senior day-to-day client contact across TGP’s social media accounts. You will guide the client relationship, account plan, delivery rhythm and commercial health of the work, while collaborating closely with an Account Executive and colleagues across strategy, content, design and production.

The role brings together client partnership, delivery management and commercial awareness. You will turn client priorities into clear action, keep the team ahead of deadlines and give the client confidence that TGP understands both the work and the wider business context.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Build strong client relationships: Lead day-to-day communication, meetings and status updates. Understand the client’s priorities, working style, brand sensitivities and internal stakeholders.

• Shape the account plan: Work with the strategy and content teams to translate monthly priorities into a clear content calendar, production plan and approval schedule.

• Turn discussions into clear action: Make sure important meetings are followed by an accurate written record covering the client’s request, TGP’s recommendation, agreed deliverables, owners and deadlines.

• Provide clear recommendations: Bring together input from the team, explain TGP’s point of view confidently and help the client make informed decisions.

• Coordinate delivery: Keep content, design, production, editing, approvals and publishing moving across multiple work streams. Identify risks early and work with the relevant people to resolve them.

• Work closely with the AccountExecutive: Agree priorities, coordinate responsibilities and review key trackers, follow-ups and client records together. Help the AE build confidence and take on greater ownership over time.

• Support the account’s commercial health: Track deliverables against the agreed scope, identify additional requests, support costings and keep agency time and margins in mind.

• Keep communication connected: Make sure everyone has the context, decisions and client feedback needed to do the work well.

• Turn performance into action: Coordinate reporting and work with the wider team to identify useful recommendations for the next content cycle.

• Contribute to pitches: Bring client insight, delivery planning and account-management thinking to new-business opportunities when needed.

Who You Are

You are organised, calm and decisive. You communicate early, maintain clear written records and keep several priorities moving with clarity.

You are comfortable bringing a point of view rather than simply reporting a problem. When an issue needs attention, you can explain the context, recommend a way forward and identify the decision required.

You are collaborative and generous with information. You understand that strong account management helps different disciplines work well together while giving the client a clear and consistent experience.

You are also comfortable using modern tools, includingAI-assisted tools where useful, to reduce repetitive administration, structure information and improve speed. You review the work carefully and apply your own judgment, client knowledge and communication standards before it is used.

Skills & Experience

• 4+ years of account management or client-services experience, ideally in a creative, social media, digital or integrated agency.

• Experience managing recurring content or social media retainers with multiple monthly deliverables is strongly preferred.

• Strong client-facing presence and clear, confident written communication.

• Proven ability to manage calendars, approvals, revisions, production dependencies and competing deadlines.

• Experience working with and supporting the development of an Account Executive or junior colleague.

• Commercial awareness, including scope control, cost implications and agency profitability.

• Confidence collaborating with strategists, writers, designers, producers and editors.

• Familiarity with social media content workflows, platform formats, reporting and publishing processes.

• Resourcefulness and a willingness to learn and apply tools that improve how work is organised and delivered.

Company Profile

Creative For More is a cross-border digital marketing and creative agency headquartered in Singapore, with presence in Tokyo and New York. We help brands grow across Asia and the US through strategic marketing, social media, content production, design and paid media. Our creative and production work is kept in-house, so the people who plan a campaign are the same people who shoot and edit it.

Job Description

We're looking for a Content Production Intern with a strong videography focus: someone who loves being behind the camera, is just as comfortable talking to the people in front of it, and is happy to pitch in on whatever the team needs.

You'll go on location to shoot social media and YouTube content for our clients and for C4M's own channels. On set, you're the face of C4M: you'll greet clients, guide talent, ask good questions and keep the energy up so the content feels natural. Back at base, you'll help turn the footage into short-form videos, YouTube edits and case study films that our clients actually publish.

Alongside production, you'll support day-to-day client work across our accounts, help put together proposals and pitch materials, and pick up internal projects as they come up.

This role suits someone outgoing who enjoys meeting new people, speaks up confidently, and gets a buzz from a busy shoot day.

Scope of work

1. On-location shoots

Travel to client locations across Singapore (offices, retail outlets, events, studios, outdoor sets) to film social media and YouTube content

Set up and operate camera, lighting and audio equipment, including lapel and shotgun mics, gimbals and tripods

Capture A-roll (interviews, talking heads, presenter pieces) and B-roll (product shots, behind-the-scenes, location and lifestyle footage)

Shoot in both vertical (9:16) and horizontal (16:9) formats so one shoot serves Reels, TikTok, Shorts and YouTube

Follow shot lists and storyboards, and flag gaps or extra opportunities on the day

Manage files on set: label cards, back up footage and keep the shoot organised

2. Client engagement on set

Act as a friendly, confident point of contact for clients and talent during shoots

Brief interviewees on what to expect, put them at ease, and direct them through takes

Ask follow-up questions in interviews to draw out natural, usable answers

Speak up when something isn't working (lighting, audio, framing, talent delivery) and suggest a fix

Represent C4M professionally and keep the client relationship warm from arrival to wrap

3. Pre-production

Help plan shoots with the account and creative team: shot lists, call sheets, location checks and equipment lists

Contribute content ideas for social media and YouTube, including hooks, trends and formats that suit each client

Help draft simple scripts and interview question lists

4. Post-production

Edit short-form videos (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) and longer YouTube content

Add captions, subtitles, music, motion text and basic colour correction

Prepare multiple cuts and aspect ratios from a single shoot

Take on feedback from the team and clients, and turn revisions around on time

5. Content operations

Organise and archive footage in our shared drive using C4M's folder and naming conventions

Track shoot schedules and deliverables so nothing slips

Capture behind-the-scenes content for C4M's own social channels

Take part in C4M's intern reflection and documentation programme

6. Client work, proposals and internal projects

Support the account team on ongoing client work beyond video, such as content calendars, social posts, photo assets and campaign reporting

Help prepare proposals and pitch decks: pull together sample work, shoot references, mood boards and case study material

Take on internal projects as they come up, including C4M's own social content, showreels, website assets and team initiatives

Be flexible and willing to switch between tasks as priorities shift

Working hours and arrangement

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:30am to 6:30pm (Singapore time)

Presence: You're expected to be fully present and engaged throughout working hours. That means speaking up in meetings, contributing ideas, and being visibly active with the team and clients, not just working quietly in the background.

Daily huddle: Join the 10am team huddle every day, including remote days

Office and shoot days: Tuesdays and Wednesdays are in-office days at our Tanjong Katong office. Shoots are scheduled around client availability and may fall on any weekday, so you'll be on location whenever a shoot is booked.

Remote days: Stay active on Slack and respond to colleagues and supervisors within 30 minutes during working hours. Your supervisor may ask you to come in or head to a shoot on a remote day, and we expect you to accommodate this.

Occasional flexibility: Some shoots may start early or run slightly past 6:30pm. We'll give advance notice and keep these to a minimum.

Who we're looking for

Skills can be taught. Presence on set is harder to teach, so personality matters a lot for this role.

Outgoing and personable. You're naturally extroverted, enjoy meeting new people, and can strike up a conversation with a client or interviewee within minutes.

Confident communicator. You speak clearly, give direction to talent without hesitation, and aren't shy to share an idea in a team meeting.

Calm under pressure. Shoot days move fast. You stay positive and solve problems on the spot when plans change.

Proactive. You don't wait to be told what to shoot next. You spot good moments and suggest them.

Reliable. You turn up on time, prepared, with charged batteries and empty cards.

Curious about social media. You know what's working on TikTok, Reels and YouTube right now, and why.

Requirements

Must have

Currently studying, or recently graduated in, Film, Media, Digital Media, Communications or a related field

Must own a DSLR camera (mandatory), with hands-on experience shooting video on it

Working knowledge of at least one editing tool: Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut

Basic understanding of framing, lighting and clean audio capture

Strong spoken and written English

Able to travel to shoot locations across Singapore and carry equipment

A portfolio or showreel of video work (school, personal or freelance projects all count)

Nice to have

Experience creating short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts

Experience filming interviews or corporate and brand content

Basic motion graphics skills (After Effects or similar)

Experience with drones, gimbals or multi-camera setups

Conversational Mandarin, Japanese or another Asian language, given our cross-border clients

Own lighting or audio gear (LED panels, lapel or shotgun mics)

What you'll gain

A real portfolio of published client work across brands in Singapore and the region

Direct exposure to client-facing production, from briefing to delivery

Hands-on mentorship from our design, video and account teams

Experience producing content for cross-border brands with ties to Japan and the US

A structured reflection and documentation programme to track your growth across the internship

A reference letter on successful completion

That someone is you.

title: Assistant Manager / Manager, Corporate & Industry Partnerships
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

NVPC is the national agency dedicated to growing a culture of volunteerism and philanthropy in Singapore. By engaging individuals, organisations, communities and leaders across the people, private and public sectors, we seek to create a more caring, inclusive, and compassionate society. Together, we envision Singapore as a City of Good, where everyone is able to give every day and everywhere (3Es), contributing their time, talent, treasure, ties and testimony (5Ts). Learn more at nvpc.org.sg.

RESPONSIBILITIES

This role sits in NVPC's Corporate and Industry Partnerships (CIP) department, which drives the Company of Good (COG) initiative — a national platform that supports and recognises companies in Singapore to integrate purpose and social impact into their core business strategies.

Today, there are over 1,000 recognised Companies of Good, helping businesses translate purpose into action across five key impact areas: People, Society, Governance, Environment, and Economic.

As the anchor for this work, NVPC's CIP department plays a pivotal role in shaping and strengthening Singapore's corporate purpose ecosystem — catalysing partnerships and collective impact, with the business community as a driving force for a stronger Singapore.

We are now seeking a purpose-driven and impact-led individual to help advance this national momentum — where both meaningful programme delivery and growing awareness of COG will increasingly become key levers for scaling impact.

In this role, you will support the design, execution and evaluation of programmes and platforms that encourage companies to give and volunteer more, as they embed purpose and impact into how they operate.

Your core work will centre on three key areas: (1) strengthening corporate capabilities in social impact, (2) building and growing the Company of Good community, and (3) scaling impact programmes.

This role works closely with colleagues across CIP to understand what companies are experiencing on the ground, and uses that insight to continuously refine our programmes — ensuring the overall Company of Good journey for firms remains relevant and valuable, not just individual initiatives in isolation.

Strengthen Corporate Capabilities in Social Impact

Support the planning and delivery of our leadership development programmes — spanning different leadership audiences — to enable organisations to volunteer and/or donate better - as one reflection of corporates' purpose journeys

Proactively cultivate new leads through targeted publicity and peer referrals

Follow through (and improve) processes that will create powerful and valuable experiences for participants

Build and Grow the Community

Support the design and facilitation of community-building and engagement efforts within the Company of Good ecosystem e.g. peer learning, networking events, and platforms for programme alumni to connect, share, and deepen their contributions

Support the development and implementation of community engagement and growth strategies

Scale Impact Programmes

Support the planning and delivery of NVPC's flagship corporate volunteering programme and ensure it remains relevant to corporates

Cultivate potential leads and enable corporates to participate in our volunteering programme

Respond to and fulfil requests from corporates seeking support in their corporate volunteering journey

Gather insights and feedback from existing partners to identify opportunities to strengthen programme design, delivery and impact

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's Degree in Business, Communications, Social Sciences, or a related discipline

ACTA or WSQ Advanced Certificate in Learning and Performance (ACLP) qualification is advantageous

Experience in managing multiple concurrent projects and working across different departments and teams

Comfortable forging and growing corporate partnerships to deepen organisations' engagement with NVPC

Ability to gather and synthesise input from colleagues and stakeholders to inform programme design and improvement, rather than working in a silo

A collaborative mindset; experience in partnerships and stakeholder engagement is an advantage

Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing

Comfortable navigating ambiguity and uncertainty while keeping an eye on outcomes

Exposure to ESG, sustainability, or social and community impact initiatives is an advantage

Please note that your application will be sent to and reviewed by the direct employer - National Volunteer & Philanthropy Centre

title: Marketing Executive, Shiseido
description:

The Marketing Executive translates brand and marketing plans into integrated retail activation strategies, ensuring strong omnichannel execution tailored by retailer and channel.

The role also supports product marketing initiatives and is responsible for delivering elevated in-store brand experiences through effective visual merchandising, retail excellence, and consumer-centric activations. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Retail and Trade Marketing

Commercially driven with a strong understanding of retail dynamics

Highly organized with excellent execution capabilities

description:
About the Role

We're looking for a fast, social-first video editor to support our growing social media content team. You'll edit short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn — talking-head videos, event snippets, founder-led content, campaign cutdowns, testimonials, and other social-first formats.

You should be comfortable with quick turnarounds, platform-native editing styles, subtitles, text overlays, music, sound effects, simple motion graphics, and leveraging AI tools to speed up your workflow. This role is for someone who understands that social editing isn't just about making videos look nice — it's about holding attention, improving clarity, and helping content perform.

Key Responsibilities

Edit short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn.

Add subtitles, hooks, text overlays, sound effects, music, transitions, and simple graphics.

Utilise AI tools (e.g. for audio cleanup, auto-captioning, or generative assets) to streamline the editing process and enhance production value.

Adapt videos into different aspect ratios and formats.

Work from briefs provided by the social media team.

Suggest improvements to pacing, hooks, structure, and visual flow.

Manage revisions efficiently and keep project files and footage organised.

Support simple thumbnail or cover-frame creation where needed, using traditional or AI-generative design tools.

Requirements

Fresh grads welcome, as long as you have a strong portfolio of short-form social videos.

Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and social video pacing.

Proficient in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar editing tools.

Familiarity with AI-driven editing features (e.g. text-based editing, auto-reframe) and generative AI platforms (such as Midjourney, ElevenLabs, Runway, or CapCut's AI toolkit).

Able to edit quickly without sacrificing clarity.

Good sense of rhythm, captions, hooks, and viewer retention.

Comfortable working in a lean, fast-moving team.

Location: Singapore (on-site) — Kewalram House, 8 Jalan Kilang Timor

title: Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT STYL SOLUTIONS

Ride on the wave of Industry 4.0! Join STYL Solutions in the forefront of using Fintech and IoT technologies for smart city/nation transformation. Headquartered in Singapore with R&D center in Vietnam, STYL Solutions designs, develops, and supplies hardware, software and integrated solutions for applications in payment, loyalty management, location tracking, self-service operation, telemetry.

Our market segment coverage extends from financial services, retail, mass transit, education to social services markets in Singapore and South Asia Pacific.

Our vision is to use Fintech and IoT to create smart and efficient cities that enhance Quality of Life through convenience and healthier living.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We are looking for an independent and creative Marketing Manager to join us in our growth journey. You will own the full spectrum of STYL Solutions' marketing communications (MarComm) and corporate communications (CorpComm) activities. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role spanning event marketing, content and campaign development, sales collateral, digital and social media, corporate website management, presentation branding, a physical product demo space, and internal communications. You will work closely with the Product, Sales and Management teams and, where required, external vendors and subcontractors, to plan, produce and measure marketing outcomes that support customer acquisition, brand consistency and employee engagement.

RESPONSIBILITIES

A. Marketing Communications (MarComm)

Trade Show & Event Marketing

Plan and coordinate STYL's participation in trade shows and industry events in Singapore and overseas, from booth concept to on-site execution.

Design the booth layout and develop event collateral (backdrop, banners, brochures) and event gifts, including sourcing quotations and managing vendors and job orders.

Develop pre-event promotional eDMs and email signature banners; set up lead-collection methods for the event team.

Consolidate post-event leads, produce a post-event report, coordinate lead nurturing with Sales, and publish post-event social media content.

Content & Inbound Marketing

Work with Product Owners and Sales to plan a campaign calendar (topics, audience, timing) promoting STYL's SaaS solutions.

Maintain and grow the leads database; develop and broadcast eDM campaigns with clear, customer-focused messaging and calls to action.

Track campaign performance (delivery, open and click-through rates, conversions) and hand qualified leads to Sales for follow-up.

Produce blogs, whitepapers, case studies and product videos, and distribute them across the website, social media and sales channels; report on content performance and lead generation.

Product & Solution Pitch Decks and Brochures

Review and refresh existing brochures and Product-team pitch decks for clarity, professionalism and consistent STYL branding.

Simplify technical content into customer-focused messaging and finalise materials for use by Product, Sales and Marketing.

Product Advertising & Campaigns

Plan and execute advertising and marketing campaigns with Product and Sales teams, from objective-setting through channel selection and content creation.

Launch campaigns across selected channels, track reach, engagement and leads, and report results with recommendations for future campaigns.

STYL Marketplace Marketing Support

Support the Marketplace team's campaigns for merchants and the parent/student community, including decal designs, artwork and supporting digital materials.

Ensure all Marketplace marketing materials follow STYL branding and track campaign performance where applicable.

B. Corporate Communications (CorpComm)

Internal Communications

Develop a company-wide internal communications plan covering CEO messages, Town Halls, product updates and newsletters.

Coordinate with Management and other teams to produce and distribute clear, consistent internal content through appropriate channels.

Corporate Website Management

Keep the STYL corporate website accurate, current and optimised for SEO; monitor traffic and page performance.

Publish company news, events and articles, and coordinate with internal teams or the website vendor on content, design and functionality updates.

Social Media Management

Develop and maintain a LinkedIn content calendar; create on-brand posts and visuals covering company activities, products and events.

Schedule and publish approved content, and monitor performance (impressions, engagement, follower growth) to continuously improve STYL's social presence across various platforms (i.e. LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook).

Presentation Templates & Branding

Standardise STYL's corporate PowerPoint templates — layout, fonts, colours and slide types — for consistent, professional use across teams.

Product & Solution Demo Space

Plan a dedicated demo space to showcase STYL's products, including layout, branding, signage and content requirements.

Prepare cost estimates and budget for management approval, and coordinate with vendors and subcontractors on installation, then test and finalise the space for customer visits.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Here at STYL Solutions, we value proactive ownership and require independence and hands-on involvement in our daily responsibilities. We seek entrepreneurial candidates with the following:

Experience

At least 3 years of relevant experience in marketing communications and/or corporate communications, ideally in a B2B technology, hardware or SaaS environment.

Demonstrated experience planning and executing trade shows or corporate events, from concept to post-event reporting.

Experience running digital and content marketing campaigns (eDM, webinars, social media, SEO) and managing a leads database.

Experience liaising with external vendors, printers, designers or subcontractors, including obtaining quotations and managing budgets, is an advantage.

Prior exposure to internal communications (newsletters, Town Halls, management messaging) is an advantage.

Education & Qualifications

Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Mass Communications, Business Administration or a related field.

Skills

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to translate technical product information into clear, customer-friendly messaging.

Working knowledge of digital marketing tools (eDM platforms, basic SEO, social media scheduling and analytics).

Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Word for presentation and collateral development; working knowledge of design tools (e.g. Canva, Adobe Creative Suite) or the ability to brief designers effectively.

Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel for tracking campaign metrics, budgets and reporting.

Project and vendor management skills, including budgeting, timeline management and coordination of multiple external suppliers.

Aptitudes & Personal Attributes

Highly organised self-starter, able to independently manage multiple concurrent work streams across events, content, digital and internal communications.

Strong stakeholder management skills, able to work closely with Product, Sales and Management to align marketing output with business needs.

Creative and detail-oriented, with sound judgement on brand consistency and messaging.

Comfortable working hands-on across both strategic planning and operational execution.

Adaptable and resourceful, comfortable operating with a lean or single-person marketing function.

What measures the success of the role

Event Execution & Lead Generation

: Successful planning and execution of trade shows and corporate events, resulting in qualified lead collection and timely post-event sales nurturing.

Digital Campaign & Content Performance

: Engagement levels, open/click-through rates, and lead conversions from eDM, social media, and website campaigns.

Brand Consistency & Collateral Quality

: Delivery of clear, standardized, and customer-focused product pitch decks, marketing collateral, and corporate presentation templates.

Website & Social Media Growth

: Up-to-date corporate website and steady growth in follower reach and engagement on the Company’s social media accounts.

Internal & Operational Delivery

: On-time execution of internal communication initiatives, demo space setup, and efficient vendor and budget management.

STYL SOLUTIONS PTE. LTD.

Established in 2008, STYL has grown significantly from a small startup into a leading trusted partner for Fintech IoT solutions with 100+ employees and market segment coverage extending from financial services, retail, mass transit, education to social services in Singapore and South Asia Pacific today.

Headquartered in Singapore with a dedicated R&D center in Vietnam, we provide end-to-end solutions from designing, developing, and supplying hardware to software integration for applications in payment, loyalty management, location tracking, self-service operation, environment management and telemetry. Our Mission is to infuse Fintech IoT to create smart and efficient cities that enhance Quality of Life for all through convenience and healthier living.

As we continue and bring our mission journey globally, we give thanks to our dedicated People who contribute to our continuous success. Hence, we strive to provide opportunities for employees to learn, grow and thrive yet maintain a well-balance lifestyle. With our lean and open organization culture, we believe that trusting work relationships will be built and our People can continue to drive creativity, innovation, and excellence with confidence.

Join us now if you are interested to be part of the creation of smarter and more efficient cities through our solutions!

PR planning and story development

Support the development and delivery of integrated PR plans that strengthen NTUC Club’s corporate reputation across its B2B and B2C portfolios. Identify newsworthy angles, shape story narratives and key messages for corporate announcements, campaigns and strategic initiatives, and maintain a forward publicity pipeline aligned with organisational and business priorities.

Media materials and editorial

Draft, edit and proofread media releases, advisories, interview pitches, media invitations, fact sheets, FAQs, holding statements, speeches, talking points and briefing notes. Ensure materials are clear, accurate, aligned with NTUC Club’s house style and tone of voice, and ready for the intended audience and channel.

Media pitching, relations and engagement

Develop and proactively pitch tailored story angles to relevant journalists, editors and producers to secure earned-media opportunities. Build and maintain strong working relationships with media contacts, PR partners and relevant stakeholders; disseminate approved materials; manage follow-ups; and respond promptly and professionally to media enquiries and requests to drive coverage, publicity and brand visibility.

Interviews and spokesperson support

Coordinate interview opportunities, media briefings and on-site coverage. Prepare spokesperson briefs, anticipated questions and approved messages; manage logistics and ensure relevant internal stakeholders are aligned before engagement.

Media events, drops and influencer engagement

Plan and execute media previews, invitations, media drops and relevant influencer engagements. Manage guest lists, RSVPs, materials, gifting and on-site requirements while ensuring appropriate approvals, records and follow-up.

Media monitoring and reporting

Monitor media coverage, public sentiment and relevant conversations; maintain accurate clipping records; and prepare PR reports post-campaign. Assess results against agreed indicators, highlight sentiment and emerging issues, recommend actions where necessary, and capture learnings and recommendations for future outreach.

Issues and crisis communications support

Monitor for potential reputational issues, escalate concerns promptly and support crisis communications planning and response across external channels in accordance with the approved Incident and Media Management SOP. Assist with fact gathering, holding lines, stakeholder coordination, media monitoring and post-incident documentation.

Stakeholder and clearance management

Work with business units, corporate stakeholders, Customer Experience, PR partners and other relevant teams to obtain complete information, visuals and factual confirmation, and to address reputational issues and opportunities. Maintain clear review and approval trails, and ensure materials are not disseminated before the required departmental, management and business unit clearances are secured.

PR platforms, databases and records

Maintain the media database, campaign media lists, PR WIP, coverage folders, templates, approved materials and decision history in SharePoint. Support the effective use and administration of media-monitoring and PR tools.

Budget, vendor and governance support

Track approved PR spend, quotations and commitments; brief and coordinate vendors; and maintain supporting procurement, reconciliation, evaluation and audit documentation in accordance with internal requirements.

Requirements:

Degree or diploma in Mass Communications, Public Relations, Media Studies, Journalism or a related field.

At least 3–5 years of relevant experience in public relations, media relations, corporate communications or a related communications role.

Proven experience in media pitching, developing newsworthy story angles and securing earned media opportunities.

Exceptional writing, copywriting, editing and proofreading skills, with strong news judgement and critical-thinking ability.

Strong project management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate internal teams, media contacts, agencies and vendors.

Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment while supporting both B2B and B2C portfolios.

Ability to multitask, manage competing priorities and deadlines, and respond calmly and promptly to emerging media or reputational issues.

Note: This scope of work is not limited to the above and may include additional responsibilities under the Group Marketing, Communications and Brand department, as required by business needs.

About NTUC Club @ Downtown East

Established in 1986 as the entertainment and leisure arm of the National Trades Union Congress (NTUC), NTUC Club is committed to the social mission of providing affordable recreational experiences of choice for our members and the public.

We also support the Labour Movement and aim to build a more inclusive society in Singapore. This means taking a social responsibility towards our staff, the community, and the environment, which is core to everything NTUC Club does.

Brands and Entities

Our key properties include Downtown East, a lifestyle destination which provides exciting activities and fun facilities for members of the Labour Movement and public alike under one roof. With the completion of the five-year Refreshing Downtown East redevelopment project in 2018, Downtown East now includes the nature-inspired D’Resort, an expanded water park Wild Wild Wet, a myriad of retail dining and entertainment options at Market Square – E!Avenue and E!Hub, and union engagement amenities MUCE (Membership & Union Community Engagement).

Other brands under NTUC Club include Aranda Country Club, Orchid Country Club, Marina Bay Golf Course, Quebec Leisure as well as clubhouses such as Scarlet City, Happy Days, Jest D’Place and Union Square.

NTUC Club also engages members of the Labour Movement at their various life stages – nEbO, the junior membership arm of NTUC for youths aged 12 to 25; U Live, the community for active agers aged 55 and above; and U Sports, for sports enthusiasts.

Social Commitment

NTUC Club's Family Fun Fiesta (F3) is one of the ways we fulfil our social purpose to ensure no one is excluded from enjoying quality recreational experiences. Held several times a year, F3 provides lower-income NTUC members and their families with complimentary experiential fun at our facilities.

In addition, we also give back to the community by volunteering and working with various beneficiaries. Our staff visited beneficiaries such as Willing Hearts and Singapore Food Bank, to help prepare meals. Together with the Attractions, Resorts & Entertainment Union (AREU), our staff sewed stuffed toys made from socks, with proceeds going to Dignity Mama to enable young adults with disabilities to gain basic entrepreneurial skills and lead independent lives.

If you aspire to be part of the Labour Movement, and believe in our social mission, find out more at: www.ntucclub.com/career.

title: Manager/Senior Manager, Outreach Events and Management (WOD)
description:
Responsibilities

• Lead the planning and delivery of career events, workshops, networking sessions and other outreach initiatives across physical, virtual and hybrid formats, ensuring alignment with Workforce Outreach Division priorities and workforce needs.

• Conceptualise event formats, participant journeys and engagement approaches; pilot new initiatives and improve existing formats to strengthen employer participation, jobseeker engagement and job-matching outcomes.

• Build and maintain effective working relationships with employers, industry partners, associations, Self-Help Groups, community/grassroots organisations and internal stakeholders to mobilise participation, partnerships and resources.

• Shape targeted outreach and engagement strategies to attract suitable jobseekers and employers, advocate jobseeker capabilities and workforce needs, and curate activities that reduce skills and hiring mismatch.

• Oversee end-to-end event operations, including vendor appointment and management, logistics, registration, event-day execution, post-event follow-up, procurement and governance requirements.

• Develop event budget requirements, monitor utilisation, exercise cost discipline, verify billing and ensure effective deployment of resources while delivering value for money.

• Establish and monitor event performance measures, analyse participation, engagement and outcome data, identify trends and translate insights into actionable improvements.

• Lead post-event reviews, consolidate feedback from stakeholders, identify gaps and improvement opportunities, and institutionalise good practices across the event portfolio.

• Coordinate internal teams and external parties to deliver multiple concurrent events, provide direction on priorities and resolve operational issues to ensure timely, quality outcomes.

Requirements

Experience & Qualifications

• At least 5 years of relevant experience in event management, programme delivery, project management, partnerships, outreach or a related field, with demonstrated experience leading end-to-end events or engagement initiatives.

• Experience managing vendors, budgets, stakeholders and concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience in workforce, community, employer engagement or career-related initiatives will be an advantage.

• Candidates without the required qualifications but with strong relevant experience may be considered.

Knowledge

• Events, programme and project management principles, including physical, virtual and hybrid delivery.

• Workforce segment needs, employer hiring challenges and labour market / sectoral manpower trends.

• Job matching, employability and employer engagement considerations.

• HR hiring processes and relevant national employment policies.

• Knowledge of WSG programmes and/or relevant workforce initiatives will be an added advantage.

Skills

• Strategic Planning & Event Management: Translate organisational priorities into practical event strategies, formats and delivery plans.

• Stakeholder & Partnership Management: Build trusted relationships, align diverse interests and mobilise stakeholders towards shared outcomes.

• Budget & Vendor Management: Manage budgets, procurement considerations and vendors with strong governance and value-for-money focus.

• Communication: Strong business writing, presentation and facilitation skills across internal and external audiences.

• Data & Insights: Use participation, engagement and outcome data to evaluate effectiveness and guide improvements.

• Problem Solving & Decision Making: Assess issues, evaluate options and make timely decisions in a changing operating environment.

• Digital & Technology: Proficient in Microsoft Office and able to learn and apply event, collaboration and other digital tools quickly.

Abilities/Aptitudes

• Takes ownership, demonstrates sound judgement and follows through on commitments and outcomes.

• Adaptable and resilient, with the ability to manage last-minute changes and competing priorities.

• Systematic, organised and able to manage concurrent projects without losing attention to detail.

• Collaborative team player who can rally resources, influence stakeholders and resolve issues constructively.

• Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment with a strong service and outcome orientation.

Other Characteristics

• Established network or experience working with industry partners, employers and/or associations.

• Experience working with Self-Help Groups, community or grassroots organisations is an advantage.

Successful candidates will be offered a contract in the first instance and may be considered for an extension or be placed on a permanent tenure.

Candidates are encouraged to sign up for a Careers & Skills Passport (CSP) account and include your CSP public profile in your resume. Please check out www.myskillsfuture.gov.sg for details on the CSP

About Skills and Workforce Development Agency

The Skills and Workforce Development Agency (SWDA) drives lifelong learning and workforce development to enable Singaporeans to take charge of their careers, learn for life, access good jobs, and grow in fulfilling careers. We enable employers to build a skilled, future-ready workforce, design quality jobs, and adopt skills recognition practices. Together with our partners, we build a trusted, high-quality, industry-relevant, and innovative ecosystem that meets the evolving workforce needs of both businesses and workers. For more information, please visit www.swda.gov.sg.

title: Social Media Executive
description:
You will run day-to-day organic social for a portfolio of client accounts. Manage communities: reply to comments and direct messages, and flag leads and sensitive issues to the client quickly
