Coordinate influencer and creator collaborations, from sourcing to post-campaign reporting

Liaise with clients on briefs, approvals and feedback to keep content timelines on track

Follow platform changes, trends and competitor activity, and recommend which ideas are worth acting on

Support new business pitches with social audits and sample content

Keep approved assets and project files organised for easy retrieval and reuse

Use AI tools to speed up production without the result looking AI-made

Basic qualifications

Diploma or degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media or a related field, or equivalent work experience

1–2 years of experience managing brand social media accounts in an agency or in-house team

A portfolio of accounts you have managed or campaigns you have run, with results to show for them

Strong written and spoken English

Hands-on experience with Meta Business Suite, TikTok and at least one scheduling tool

Basic design and video editing skills in Canva and CapCut

Able to read platform analytics and turn the numbers into a clear report

Good grasp of short-form video: what makes a hook work, pacing, and which trends suit a brand

Organised and detail-oriented: able to meet deadlines for several clients without errors

Confident communicating with clients, and self-directed when working remotely

Good to have

Agency experience handling several brands at once

Paid social experience, including Meta Ads Manager and boosted posts

Experience running influencer or KOL campaigns

Photography or videography skills, and comfort filming on location

Adobe Creative Suite skills

Experience in hospitality, beauty, lifestyle or healthcare

Mandarin, for clients whose audiences are reached in both English and Chinese

Experience with social listening or management tools such as Sprout Social or Sprinklr

Since our inception in 1998, Agape Communications’ core philosophy has led us into the new decade as a strategy-led creative brand agency that aims to bridge the gap between consulting and creating, while keeping our focus on our clients’ growth in the post-COVID landscape.

Creatives never stop thinking, and good ideas never stay still.

Strategic Thinking

We think, a lot. Our strategy is focused on deriving insights, data analysis and knowledge inquiry so that we can make farsighted decisions and effective executions.

Boldness

We keep up with the times. Our swift responses and daring approach to new ideas and contexts mean we are not afraid to take risks and express ourselves.

Perspective & Insight

We are multifaceted. Every individual in Agape brings fresh and unique perspectives to the table every day, so that there is never a moment where any of us sees the same idea in the same way.

title: Social Media Content Producer
description:
Social Media Content Producer

Role Overview

The Social Media Content Producer is responsible for developing, producing and delivering engaging social media content across multiple platforms and formats. The role combines content ideation, hands-on production, platform knowledge and project coordination, with a strong focus on creating timely, relevant and audience-centric content.

The successful candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, responding to evolving content needs and managing projects from concept and pre-production through filming, editing and final delivery. The role requires someone who is creatively driven, digitally savvy and able to translate communications objectives into effective social-first content.

Key Responsibilities

Social Media Content Development

Conceptualise and develop creative content ideas based on client briefs, communications objectives, target audiences and platform requirements.

Translate key messages into compelling social-first content, including short-form videos, reels, interviews, explainers, event coverage and other digital formats.

Develop content treatments, storyboards, scripts, shot lists and other pre-production materials where required.

Keep abreast of emerging social media trends, formats, platform features and audience behaviours, and identify opportunities to incorporate them appropriately into content.

Adapt content and storytelling approaches for platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn and other emerging channels.

Content Production

Plan and execute social media shoots, including interviews, events, activations and other on-location productions.

Operate cameras and basic production equipment where required and work closely with videographers, editors, designers and other creative team members.

Edit short-form and social media videos, including basic colour correction, audio treatment, graphics, captions and platform-specific formatting.

Produce content with an understanding of the need for speed, relevance and turnaround, particularly for time-sensitive or event-based communications.

Repurpose and optimise existing assets into suitable content formats for different platforms.

Project & Client Management

Manage assigned content projects from brief through to final delivery, ensuring timelines, deliverables and quality standards are met.

Work directly with clients and internal stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify briefs and provide recommendations on content execution.

Coordinate production schedules, talent, locations, equipment and other resources required for shoots.

Manage feedback and revisions efficiently while maintaining the creative intent and communications objectives of the project.

Support multiple concurrent projects and prioritise deliverables according to deadlines and operational requirements.

Content Strategy & Performance

Contribute ideas to social media content plans, campaigns and always-on content strategies.

Apply an understanding of platform algorithms, audience behaviour and content performance when developing content.

Review content performance and identify learnings that can improve future creative execution.

Work with account, strategy and creative teams to ensure content is aligned with the broader campaign and communications strategy.

AI & Emerging Content Tools

Explore and apply AI-enabled tools to support content ideation, scripting, visualisation, editing, asset generation and production workflows.

Identify opportunities where AI and emerging technologies can improve turnaround time, production efficiency and creative possibilities.

Remain current with developments in generative AI and new digital content-production tools while ensuring responsible and appropriate use.

We are EVOLV Communications Ltd., a Company Limited by Guarantee and set up by the Ministry of Communications and Information.

We are a separate entity from MCI and the Government.

description:

is an integrated communications agency with leading expertise in marketing communications, public relations, events, content creation and brand strategy. title: Digital Content Executive
description:

About the Role:

Love turning ideas into photos, videos and digital content? Join ShopNJoy and help bring local merchants, shopper experiences and brand collaborations to life.

ShopNJoy is a consumer rewards and merchant discovery platform connecting shoppers with physical retail and F&B businesses. We’re looking for a hands-on

Digital Content Executive

to create content and publish it across our marketing channels and app.

This is an

entry-level opportunity

, suitable for a fresh polytechnic graduate with a strong creative portfolio and a willingness to learn.

Plan and carry out shoots for merchant profiles, products, services and brand activities.

Submit your CV and portfolio, including web links of example photography, video editing or digital content you’ve created. For group projects, tell us which parts you personally handled.

Show us your eye for a story—and your ability to bring it to life.

title: Marketing & Growth Assistant
description:
We are looking for a creative and commercially curious Marketing & Growth Assistant to help RhetoriQo grow its brand and business. You'll have creative bandwidth to generate content ideas, produce videos, and track performance — and you'll also get hands-on exposure to business development, from identifying opportunities to supporting outreach.

RhetoriQo transforms inner voices into outside influence through curated speaking and communication training programmes. Founded by seasoned speaker, lawyer, and coach Zulhafni Zulkeflee, we empower individuals and organisations to excel in their high-stakes settings with public speaking, negotiation, persuasion, and communication skills.

Content Planning & Ideation:

Lead RhetoriQo's online presence by (i) maintaining a clear content calendar for Instagram, TikTok, and other platforms, and (ii) proposing daily post ideas — including videos, images, and captions — that align with our coaching mission, based on research trends and industry topics.

Capture, edit, and polish videos (e.g., Reels, TikToks, stories) optimised for trend relevance, engagement, and credibility-building — with an opportunity to work within the public speaking and communication sector.

Platform Management & Community Engagement:

Lead RhetoriQo's social media growth by managing content across our platforms (e.g., scheduling and publishing according to best posting times), monitoring performance, and refining strategy based on analytics.

Analytics & Strategy:

Experiment with different content formats (e.g., storytelling, teaching snippets, behind-the-scenes) to learn what resonates, by tracking engagement, reach, and other key metrics.

Business Development Support:

Support RhetoriQo's growth by (i) researching potential corporate clients, events, and partnership opportunities, (ii) assisting with outreach tracking and lead lists (e.g., on LinkedIn), and (iii) collaborating on growth ideas — such as relevant industry events to attend, speak at, or pitch to — as you grow into the role.

Qualifications

We value an openness to learn and experiment over experience — if you have the traits below and are up for a new challenge, we would be happy to chat with you:

Proficient in content editing tools (Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere, etc.) and general office tools (e.g., Google Docs/Sheets, Excel, Email)

Strong awareness and curiosity of social media trends, particularly on Instagram/TikTok

Excellent written and verbal communication, organisational skills, and attention to detail

Keen to try new things and have an eye for creativity

Commercially curious — you think about not just how to grow an audience, but how that translates into real business opportunities

Self-motivated with the ability to propose ideas and follow through independently

Previous experience in content creation or social media is a plus, but not necessary — if you're new to this, tell us how you'd go about learning and growing in the role

Remuneration & Working Conditions

Contract/part-time role: 3–4 hours/day, flexible schedule

SGD $13–15/hour

Remote and/or hybrid (Singapore-based preferred; you may be required to follow along for training programmes or sessions on occasion)

Why Join Us?

Real ownership from day one — you won't be a pair of hands, you'll have genuine creative and commercial input into how RhetoriQo grows

Work directly with a highly experienced public speaking trainer and coach within the training and coaching industry

Clear growth pathway — at 3 months we'll assess fit and scope, with potential to convert to a higher rate or full-time role

Ready to apply?

Send us: (i) your resume, (ii) samples of content if you have them (Reels, TikToks, CapCut projects, or anything you're proud of), and (iii) a short response to this:

what is one initiative — an event, a partnership, or an outreach campaign — you would propose to help RhetoriQo win its next client?

title: Digital Marketing & Branding Lead (FT / Renewable Contract)
description:
Job Summary

Love great design, beautiful spaces and the thrill of building brands that people genuinely connect with? Do you obsess over conversion rates, live for a good sales milestone and believe that great marketing should always drive real commercial results? You might just be the person we are looking for.

We are on the hunt for a dynamic and commercially savvy Digital Marketing & Branding Lead to take the wheel on marketing and brand-building for our growing portfolio of home and living brands in Singapore. As a multi-brand distributor we represent a curated collection of international labels spanning lifestyle and home essentials and honestly it is a pretty exciting space to be in right now.

This is not a sit-back-and-delegate kind of role. You will be the brand custodian, the campaign architect and the digital marketing engine all rolled into one. From growing brand awareness to driving consumer engagement and commercial performance across every brand in our portfolio you will be the one making it happen. You will work closely with brand principals, retail partners and internal teams to craft and execute integrated marketing campaigns that truly resonate with Singapore's home and living consumers.

If you are someone who gets excited about a beautiful Instagram feed, hitting sales objectives and knows how to tell a compelling brand story across every touchpoint then we would love to hear from you.

Job Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Management

Be the guardian of each brand's identity, tone of voice and visual standards across every digital and physical touchpoint because consistency is everything

Develop and maintain brand guidelines for each label so that every piece of communication looks and feels unmistakably on-brand

Run regular brand audits to make sure our brands stay fresh, relevant and visually compelling in Singapore's ever-evolving home and living market

Partner closely with brand principals to make sure our localised execution stays true to the bigger brand vision

Digital Marketing Strategy & Planning

Build a digital marketing roadmap that actually moves the needle by translating business goals into sharp integrated strategies with clear KPIs and real measurable outcomes

Get hands-on with all digital channels including SEO, SEM, AIO, GEO and whatever else the ever-changing digital landscape throws at us

Dig into the data, spot the trends and uncover growth opportunities before anyone else does

Allocate the digital marketing budget across all brand

Social Media & Community Management

Take the reins on the social media presence of all our brands across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and beyond

Plan posts, create content, keep the feeds looking good and make sure every account is active, engaging and true to its brand personality

Show up in the comments and DMs because community building is not just a checkbox but a relationship

Scout, manage influencers, livestreamers partnerships, content creators collaborations and brand tie-ups that make sense for the home and living world

E-Commerce & Digital Presence

Roll up your sleeves and get into the weeds of our e-commerce platforms and brand websites covering uploads, listings, visuals and all

Write and edit product listings that are not just accurate but actually make people want to buy

Ensure every touchpoint online delivers a seamless and enjoyable user experience with a sharp eye on UI and UX

Team up with sales and operations on promotions and digital merchandising and constantly find smarter ways to boost conversion and keep customers coming back for more

Key Experience & Skills

Experience & Background

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field

At least 3 to 5 years of experience in digital marketing with exposure to brand management ideally within the lifestyle or home and living category

Proven track record of directly managing multi-brand or multi-product digital marketing campaigns

Comfortable leading and executing at the same time in a lean team environment

Confident and comfortable in front of the camera whether it is a quick product reel, a brand story or a live session

Performance Marketing & Analytics

Strong expertise and hands-on experience in performance marketing, analytics tools including Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, Shopify and apps, as well as any other marketing SaaS implementation and integration

Knowledge in using Canva, video editing software, Microsoft Office tools or other tools

Highly proficient in running campaigns, analysing performance and optimising results

Data-first mindset with a clear focus on commercial impact including pipeline contribution, revenue growth and return on investment

Someone who measures success against real business outcomes and not just pretty numbers on a dashboard

Customer Journey & Digital Funnels

Deep understanding of end-to-end customer journey orchestration and what it takes to keep people engaged at every stage

Experienced in mapping and managing digital funnels that move customers seamlessly from awareness through to conversion and retention

AI Application in Marketing

Advanced hands-on experience applying AI in day-to-day marketing operations including AI-driven campaign optimisation and predictive targeting

description:
NLCS (Singapore) believes that each employee makes a significant contribution to our success and that contributions should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities.

Therefore, this position description is designed to outline primary duties, qualifications, and job scope, but not limit the employee, nor NLCS (Singapore), to only the work identified. Our School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. The School expects all teaching staff, non‐teaching staff and volunteers to share and uphold this commitment.

The Marketing Executive will take ownership of the day-to-day delivery of the School’s marketing activities across campaigns, content, digital, events, partnerships and communications.

Working within the School’s agreed marketing strategy, the role is expected to be proactive, bring forward ideas and opportunities, lead projects through to completion and ensure marketing activity is delivered accurately, consistently and on time.

The role requires someone who can think beyond execution, understand the purpose behind each initiative and recommend practical ways to strengthen the School’s visibility, engagement and admissions objectives.

1. Campaigns & Marketing Delivery

Lead the day-to-day delivery of agreed marketing campaigns and initiatives.

Proactively propose campaign ideas, themes, content opportunities and improvements.

Develop first drafts of campaign messaging, concepts and supporting content for review.

Own campaign timelines, actions, approvals and follow-ups through to completion.

2. Content, PR & Communications

Develop content for social media, emailers, website, PR, third-party deliverables and marketing materials.

Develop and maintain a regular pipeline of blogs, thought leadership articles, school stories and long-form website content aligned with marketing and admissions priorities.

Proactively identify student, staff, academic, enrichment and community stories.

Develop story angles and content ideas that strengthen the School’s positioning and reputation.

Support PR opportunities by preparing content, background information, imagery and other required materials.

Identify content opportunities that strengthen the School’s authority and discoverability across SEO, GEO and AEO.

Maintain a forward content pipeline aligned with School marketing and admissions priorities.

3. Digital Presence, Social Media & Website

Lead day-to-day social media publishing and content scheduling.

Identify and implement opportunities to improve reach, engagement and content performance.

Monitor comments, messages and online engagement, escalating sensitive matters where appropriate.

Identify areas of the website requiring updates or improvements and take them forward with the relevant teams.

Support the continuous development of the School’s digital presence through SEO, GEO and AEO, including website content, blogs, FAQs, landing pages and other relevant content.

Identify and recommend content and website improvements based on search behaviour, emerging queries and marketing priorities.

Work with relevant internal and external teams to ensure content is structured and optimised for traditional search engines and AI-led discovery platforms.

Monitor organic visibility, website engagement and content performance and recommend areas for improvement.

4. Events & Community Marketing

Own the marketing requirements for admissions events, Open Houses, education fairs, community activities and outreach initiatives.

Develop event promotion plans and ensure digital, creative, signage, collateral and content requirements are delivered on time.

Review and maintain the Marketing Events Calendar and plan marketing activity sufficiently in advance.

Support live content and social media coverage at key events.

Identify content opportunities from events for future marketing use.

5. Brand, Collateral & Multimedia

Lead the development and production of routine marketing and event collateral.

Review materials for accuracy, consistency and quality before production or publication.

Identify photography and videography requirements for campaigns and key School events.

Maintain an organised and current library of photography, video and marketing assets.

Identify opportunities that support SEO, GEO and AEO visibility, brand awareness and lead generation.

Maintain and regularly review School profiles across education portals, directories and external listings.

Support delivery of agreed marketing requirements for partnerships and external collaborations.

Ensure partner branding and marketing assets remain consistent with School guidelines.

Monitor agreed third-party deliverables and ensure required content and assets are supplied within deadlines.

7. Reporting, Suppliers & Marketing Operations

Prepare quarterly marketing reports covering campaigns, social media, website activity, digital visibility and other agreed performance metrics, working with relevant team members to consolidate inputs.

Maintain and develop trackers and reports for management review, internal planning and marketing strategy alignment.

Maintain accurate marketing trackers, calendars and project records.

Obtain supplier quotations and manage routine production requirements within approved parameters.

Track supplier deliverables, timelines and quality, escalating issues where required.

Maintain records of marketing expenditure, purchase requests, invoices and associated documentation.

Maintain appropriate stock levels of marketing collateral, branded materials and event assets.

Take ownership of agreed marketing requests and ensure they are followed through to completion.

Manage competing deadlines and escalate priorities where appropriate.

Proactively identify opportunities across School activities that could support marketing, reputation or admissions objectives.

Contribute actively to marketing planning discussions and team initiatives.

Ensure appropriate safeguarding, consent and privacy requirements are followed in relation to student photography, filming and marketing content.

Undertake other reasonable responsibilities and provide additional support as required in line with the evolving business needs of the AMC Department.

title: Head of Marketing and Communications (Singapore and Indonesia)
description:
About The Role

Lead marketing and communications for CBRE across Singapore and Indonesia, and position the company as the pre-eminent real estate thought leader in both markets. Using earned and owned media, digital and social channels, events and research-led content, you will build share of voice and turn CBRE’s market intelligence into commercial advantage.

Armed with strong media relationships, you will identify opportunities to profile subject matter experts and work closely with them to deliver differentiated points of view on the real estate industry. You will lead a team of five to eight marketing and communications professionals, own the country marketing budget, and act as a trusted adviser to country and business line leadership.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role in a matrix environment. You will set strategy and stay close enough to the work to deliver it.

What You’ll Do

Strategy and business partnering

‒ Develop and deliver an integrated, ROI-focused marketing and communications strategy across Singapore and Indonesia, covering public relations, digital and social, events, internal communications and brand.

‒ Partner country leadership and business line leaders so that marketing and communications operates as a business enabler rather than a service desk.

‒ Own and manage the country marketing budget, with clear reporting of spend against outcomes.

‒ Set the measurement standard for the function, covering share of voice, campaign performance, event contribution to pipeline and digital engagement, and report against it to leadership each quarter.

‒ Contribute to regional marketing and communications initiatives and project roll-outs across Asia Pacific.

Public relations and media

‒ Act as the key media liaison in Singapore and Indonesia, identifying and pitching stories and securing profiling opportunities for business leaders.

‒ Develop compelling messages, media releases, media responses, byline articles and speeches for senior management.

‒ Build and maintain relationships with tier-one business, property and trade media across both markets.

‒ Manage PR agency partners, including scope, performance, deliverables and budget.

‒ Support regional and global teams on issues and crisis communications, preparing local statements, briefing spokespeople and managing local media response, escalating in line with CBRE protocol.

‒ Maintain spokesperson briefing materials and question-and-answer documents, and arrange media training for senior leaders.

Events and industry engagement

‒ Own the events strategy end to end, from flagship client events and research launches to executive roundtables, industry sponsorships and internal town halls.

‒ Manage event budgets, venue and vendor selection, run of show, speaker preparation and post-event follow-up, with clear measurement of commercial return.

‒ Develop an influencer and industry body engagement strategy, including CBRE’s presence and speaking platforms at key industry events in both markets.

Content, research marketing and digital

‒ Work with CBRE Research to turn market intelligence into campaign-ready content and to build launch moments around flagship reports.

‒ Drive lead generation through social and digital channels, working with regional digital teams on campaign build, targeting, marketing technology and reporting.

‒ Act as brand custodian for both markets, maintaining CBRE brand standards across every piece of external and internal output.

‒ Support business development and pursuit teams with marketing collateral and credentials for major client bids.

Internal communications and employer brand

‒ Drive internal communications for employee engagement, change communications and leadership visibility.

‒ Strengthen CBRE’s employer brand in partnership with the People team, supporting recruitment and retention priorities.

Team leadership

‒ Lead, coach and develop a team of five to eight professionals across PR, digital, events and internal communications.

‒ Set objectives, manage performance and build capability and succession within the team.

‒ Provide direction and quality control across all local marketing initiatives and campaigns.

What You’ll Need

Experience: essential

‒ Degree holder with 12 to 14 years’ experience in marketing and communications.

‒ Within that, a minimum of three to four years leading public relations and events at a senior level, with direct accountability for media strategy and for flagship event delivery.

‒ Experience gained in a multinational or large listed organisation with multiple stakeholders, matrix reporting and regional or global reporting lines. This is a requirement, not a preference.

‒ Proven record of managing PR and event agencies, including briefing, performance management and budget control.

‒ Demonstrated ownership of a marketing budget, with the ability to report return on that spend.

‒ People leadership experience, having managed a team of five or more.

‒ Established media relationships in Singapore, with proven ability to secure tier-one coverage.

Experience: advantageous

‒ Indonesia market exposure, or a demonstrated track record of building media relationships in a new market.

‒ Real estate, professional services, financial services or agency background.

‒ Experience supporting issues or crisis communications within an established corporate protocol.

‒ Bahasa Indonesia or Mandarin in addition to strong written and spoken English in view of the in-country market communications.

Skills and attributes

‒ Proven expertise in social and digital marketing, including campaign measurement and marketing technology platforms.

‒ Credible with senior stakeholders, and comfortable advising and constructively challenging country and business line leadership.

‒ Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a dynamic environment with competing priorities.

‒ A positive, can-do attitude and readiness to roll up the sleeves and get the job done.

‒ Willingness to travel between Singapore and Indonesia as the role requires.

Why CBRE

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

Applicant AI Use Disclosure

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

OUR VALUES IN HIRING

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

title: Government Relations and Public Policy Manager
description:
We’re looking for an experienced

Government Relations Manager

to advance our policy and regulatory objectives in South East Asia and help us get closer to to help us get closer to achieving our mission of low cost and high speed international payments. You will be expected to represent the company with gravitas and be influential in doing so.

This job requires active external advocacy, public campaigning and engagement with policymakers and policy influencers to prosecute our interests for direct access to payment systems and transparent pricing of foreign exchange.

You will have responsibility for our engagement with the respective government but with potential for further responsibilities in other markets as we grow and expand into different locales.

We lead the way in calling for the full implementation of the G20 Cross Border Payments Roadmap through our annual G20 Scorecard Reports, with a heavy focus on driving direct access and price transparency.

What you’ll experience

You will be based in our

Singapore office

and work closely with our Product, Banking, Compliance, Public Relations and Legal teams across South East Asian markets - particularly Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines and Thailand but with potential for responsibility for other markets as we grow and expand into different locales. You will be expected to travel frequently to other markets, particularly Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines in order to advance our mission.

Wise is an ‘in person’ company, so you will be based in our full stack office in Singapore and report to the APAC Government Relations Lead (also based in Singapore); you will have a high degree of autonomy in how you work to achieve our mission goals.

You will also be expected to play an integral part supporting our APAC and global leadership team in their external facing meetings with governments, regulators and trade associations as well as assist in Environmental, Social and Governance compliance processes.

You will be part of the global Government Relations team. It is a small but effective group of professionals who prioritise active advocacy to achieve our mission.

Qualifications

Be a natural self-starter who can work productively and efficiently without regular direct supervision. You must be capable of identifying problems, developing a plan to solve those issues and then delivering your plan to fulfill our mission.

Be willing to advocate proactively and robustly for Wise’s interests with government stakeholders to the exclusion of all other interests.

Have an ability to constructively challenge, with evidence, those in positions of authority who do not want to see change.

Be capable of identifying potential issues, developing a plan to solve those problems and then delivering on your plan to fulfill our mission.

Have a minimum of 7 years’ of relevant experience in government, politics or public policy roles.

Understand our mission in respect to international payments.

Have an ability to constructively challenge those in positions of authority who do not want to see change.

Be fluent in written and spoken English and preferably in another language.

Have experience operating in at least one South East Asian Market with an established network and an understanding of government structures, regulatory systems and political institutions.

Proficiency in financial services, payments and consumer protection policy is considered a plus.

Be a persuasive advocate and skilled communicator both in speaking and writing - your written work will be both for internal and public consumption and your advocacy may be used in the media.

Be tenacious, inquisitive and have an appetite to learn about new areas of policy and their application to our business.

Have an ability to work across teams and cultures in a dynamic and diverse workplace with respect for and curiosity about other cultures and systems.

Who we are

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move money around the world. With the Wise account people and businesses can hold over 40 currencies, move money between countries and spend money abroad. Large companies and banks use Wise technology too; an entirely new cross-border payments network that will one day power money without borders for everyone, everywhere. However you use the platform, Wise is on a mission to make your life easier and save you money.

Co-founded by Kristo Käärmann and Taavet Hinrikus, Wise launched in 2011 under its original name TransferWise. It is one of the world’s fastest growing, profitable technology companies and is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker, WISE.

16 million people and businesses use Wise. In fiscal year 2023, Wise processed approximately £105 billion in cross-border transactions, saving customers around £1.5 billion.

What it’s really like to work here

At Wise, we do things a bit differently. There’s no corporate nonsense, and no old-fashioned hierarchy. Instead, we work in dozens of self-sufficient, autonomous teams. Think of them like start-ups within a start-up that learn from each other.

Each team picks the problems they want to solve. So there’s no micro-management. No hiding behind fancy job titles. And no one telling you what to do. You are your own boss. But you’ll get tons of guidance and plenty of support from talented, super-smart colleagues from all over Wise.

title: Social Media Account Manager
description:
Social Media Account ManagerThe Role Brief

We're Network, a Singapore media company that only does interior design marketing. 120+ ID firms on our books. We have a full creative team, a production team and consultants handling the commercial side, so you're not designing, editing or filming. You own the account. What gets made, what gets written, when it gets shot, and whether it grew. Every account you hold is judged on the organic result, not on how full the calendar looked.

Starting Salary: SGD 2,380 to 2,690 a month, Singapore based.

(Why the range? We pay based on skill. This is STARTING SALARY, and there are incentives to grow it.)

* Write the briefs. Complete enough that the creative team never comes back with questions.
* Schedule the shoots. Client and production team aligned so shoot days actually happen.
* Own the client groupchat. Fast replies, no dropped threads.
* Own the organic result. Reach, page growth, enquiries.
* Write the captions and hooks. In the client's voice, not a house voice.
* Platforms: IG, FB, TikTok, YT.

Language

You need to speak conversational Mandarin. A lot of our ID clients are more comfortable in Mandarin, and you'll be on calls and in groupchats with them.

All written content is in English. Captions, hooks, briefs, everything that goes out. You don't need to write in Mandarin, but your English writing needs to be good.

Working arrangement

Mainly remote. (90% of time)

Occasionally you'll have meetings with clients, and sometimes with celebrities or talent attached to a shoot, to align on what we're making. Some of those are over Google Meet, some are in person.

70/30

Every account has a consultant attached to it. The split is 70/30. You carry 70, which is why the title says Account Manager. They carry 30 on the commercial side.

They own the client relationship and the money conversation. You own the delivery and the result. When a client asks for something that won't work, you say so and give the consultant an alternative to take back.

What you get to work with

You'll have a full stack creative team behind you:

* Full stack UI/UX and backend developers
* Video editors
* Graphic designers
* Content strategists
* Performance marketers and lead gen media buyers

Plus team training, which is the part that matters most if you're serious about this.

Why this role, specifically

We're not looking for a competent account manager. We're looking for someone we can train.

You'll be taught organic and direct response marketing by people who do it every day, at volume, across 120+ accounts in one vertical. The goal is that you can execute and generate real ROI for a client, not just keep their feed looking busy. That skill is worth more than this salary, and it compounds.

Our delivery is our pride. Our fulfilment is our pride. If you want to take pride in your own work, this is the team to be around.

Pay: $2,380.00 - $2,690.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

1. Content Development and Storytelling

Lead the development of annual impact report, newsletters, website content, event materials and other communications assets.

Maintain an editorial calendar and coordinate content contribution from across the organisation.

2. Social Media Management

Monitor and analyse social media performance and recommend improvements to increase engagement and reach.

Keep abreast of emerging social media trends and identify opportunities to enhance digital engagement.

3. Internal Communications and Stakeholder Engagement

Work closely with Mandai Wildlife Group teams (Life Sciences, Education, Communications, Brand and Partnerships Development) and Mandai Nature team to support internal communications initiatives to increase awareness of Mandai Nature’s work across Mandai Wildlife Group.

Build strong working relationships with stakeholders to source content, gather project updates, and identify communications opportunities.

Manage communications requests and coordinate the development of supporting materials.

Review presentations, reports, publications and other communications materials to ensure factual accuracy and consistency with Mandai Nature’s messaging and brand standards.

Develop and maintain templates, guidelines, and communications resources for internal teams

Provide editorial support and communications advice to colleagues when required.

4. Media Relations and Publicity

Support media outreach efforts by identifying story opportunities and preparing media materials.

Draft press releases, media pitches, fact sheets and briefing materials.

Coordinate media interviews, filming opportunities, and media visits.

Maintain media contact lists and support relationship-building with journalists and media outlets.

5. Brand and Visual Communications

Ensure all communication materials adhere to Mandai Nature’s brand guidelines and visual identity.

Work closely with designers, photographers, videographers, and external agencies to develop high-quality communication assets.

Provide guidance on visual presentation of communication materials to maximise audience engagement.

Conduct quality assurance reviews to ensure communication materials are accurate, consistent and on brand.

6. Events and Outreach Communications

Lead communications support for fundraising donor events, outreach events, exhibitions and public engagement initiatives including the Festival of Biodiversity.

Develop creative content and messaging that drives audience engagement and participation.

Manage event communication materials, signage, digital content, and post-event storytelling.

Job Requirements:

Degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, Public Relations, English or a related field.

Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in communications, public relations, content marketing, or a related field, preferably in the non-profit, conservation or environmental sector.

Experience managing social media channels and creating digital content.

Experience in coordinating multiple stakeholders and managing projects simultaneously.

Experience working with creative agencies, designers, photographers, and video production vendor is an advantage.

Excellent writing, editing and proofreading skills

Strong visual communication skills with an eye for design, branding and audience engagement.

Strong storytelling skills and the ability to translate complex topics into engaging content.

Excellent stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.

Strong attention to detail and editorial judgment.

Creative, proactive and highly organised.

Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

A genuine interest in wildlife conservation, environmental sustainability and philanthropy is highly desirable.

Build common PM tools, templates, dashboards and analytical approaches to improve consistency, efficiency and decision-making.

Leverage automation and AI tools to streamline recurring reporting and analysis.

Strengthen country PM capabilities through business reviews, coaching, shared standards and capability-building initiatives.

8+years of relevant experience in Product Marketing, Product Management,Commercial Strategy or a related function within consumer electronics,technology or device businesses.

Strongcommercial and strategic thinking, with the ability to translate businessobjectives into practical plans and measurable actions.

Stronganalytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify rootcauses and translate data into actionable insights.

Stronginterpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence andcollaborate effectively with senior stakeholders, country teams andcross-functional partners.

Proactive,practical and results-oriented approach, with the ability to manage multiplepriorities in a fast-paced regional environment.

Comfortable leveraging AI and digital tools to improve analysis, reporting and ways of working.

Product Marketing experience in the Monitor business, particularly Gaming Monitors, is highly preferred.

title: Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Specialist
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.

Job description

We are looking for a Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Specialist to be the visionary link between our brand identity & measurable e-commerce performance. You will shape how our health brands communicate across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & social media.

This role is responsible for developing high-impact creative strategies & producing assets (visual, video, copy) designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok E-Commerce stores. You will work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the expansion of our business. You won't just be creating content; you will be engineering 'Performance Stories' that turn scientific evidence into consumer trust & measurable revenue.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry.

Key Responsibilities

1. Creative & Performance Strategy

Full-Funnel Content: Craft tailored strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific formats (e.g. Meta carousel ads, Meta/TikTok Reels, Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banners & Klaviyo email/whatsapp marketing)

A/B Testing & Data Insights: Develop clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, CTAs, visual styles) & run A/B tests to improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion)

Competitive Intelligence: Identify emerging hooks & messaging trends in the wellness/supplement industry to keep our brands ahead of the curve

2. In-House Content Production & Execution

Performance Creative Development: Lead end-to-end creative production for organic & paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube) with a focus on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing

Video & Static Creation: Rapidly produce & edit native social content, including:

Video: Fast-paced assembly of UGC-style content, product demos & testimonials (CapCut/Premiere)

Static: Adapting product photography into high-performing ad variations & storefront banners

Generative AI Integration: Utilize AI tools & prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video & image assets for rapid testing cycles

Copywriting: Write high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & captions that align with brand voice & regulatory requirements

Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok storefronts

3. E-commerce Growth & Social Account Management

E-Commerce Storefront Custodian (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok): Integrate winning creative messages into e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a seamless customer journey for maximum sales conversion

Social Accounts Ownership & Community Manager: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for Miraco’s official accounts on Meta (FB/IG) & TikTok. Ensure all profiles are optimized for conversion, featuring up-to-date bios, Linktree/Shopify integrations & high-lighted stories

Content Programming & Scheduling: Develop & maintain a consistent content calendar that balances "Digital Pearls" (educational), Lifestyle (relatable) & Promotional (sales-driven) posts

Active Social Listening: Use comments & DMs to identify "pain points" to fuel new content hooks

User Generated Content (UGC) Mining: Identify & curate customer testimonials from the community to use as high-converting growth assets

Growth Analytics: Monitor account health metrics (Follower growth, Engagement Rate, Profile Visits) & use these insights to refine the organic reach strategy

Data-Driven Optimization: Work with the Marketing Manager to analyze performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving revenue on Shopify & Marketplaces. Apply insights & analytics to refine content effectiveness continuously

4. Performance Media & Technical Tracking

Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google):

Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Sales & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces

Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries

ABOUT THE COMPANY

The Global Centre for Maritime Decarbonisation (GCMD) was established as an independent, non-profit organisationon 1 August 2021 to help international shipping decarbonise through pilots and trials. Its mission is to support decarbonisation through four pillars: shaping standards, deploying solutions, financing projects, and fostering collaboration across sectors.

GCMD was founded with the support of industry partners, alongside funding from the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) for qualifying research and development programmes. Since its founding, GCMD has expanded its ecosystem to include more than 130 centre- and project-level partners contributing funds, expertise, and in-kind support to pilot, accelerate the deployment, and scale the adoption of decarbonisation solutions.

GCMD has launched four key initiatives to close technical and operational gaps in: enabling ammonia as a marine fuel, developing an assurance framework for drop-in green fuels, unlocking the carbon value chain through onboard carbon capture and articulating the value chain of captured carbon dioxide, as well as closing the data-financing gap to scale the adoption of energy efficiency technologies.

Strong writing and editing skills.

Experience working with media, social media, websites and/or events.

About the Role:

Who You Are:

You are passionate about theatre and the performing arts.

You possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

You have strong organisational and time management skills.

You are creative, resourceful, and a team player.

Experience in marketing, communications, or a related field is an advantage.

Proficiency in social media platforms and digital marketing tools is preferred.

Comfortable working across English and Chinese communications, including reviewing bilingual marketing materials.

The Theatre Practice (Practice) is Singapore’s longest-standing professional bilingual theatre institution. Artist-driven and deeply progressive, Practice strives to be an arts space in Singapore that consciously nurtures and empowers people who care about humanity. Over the past 61 years, we have developed and presented works that aim to reflect the richness and complexities of Singapore’s diverse cultures.

Today, we carry on the work of our visionary co-founders and cultural medallion recipients, Kuo Pao Kun and Goh Lay Kuan. Under the helm of current Artistic Director Kuo Jian Hong, Practice continues to shape Singapore’s cultural landscape as the definitive voice in Singapore theatre. Jian Hong is deeply influenced by the importance of play in art-making and under her leadership, Practice has become the embodiment of the irrepressible spirit and fearless experimentation of play.

Practice is motivated by a desire to always respectfully entertain. We have collaborated with Singapore and international artists alike to present a critically-acclaimed repertoire of over 330 productions including musicals, classics, original and experimental works. We have toured extensively in the region. Many of our works have entered the canon of Southeast Asian literature and have been adapted and presented by theatre companies worldwide, presenting an authentically Singaporean voice on the world stage.

Since our inception, Practice has served as a cultural bridge between Asia and the world. Our current theatre festival – M1 Patch! A Theatre Festival of Artful Play – comes from a legacy of carefully curated festivals and seminars that gather practitioners of all disciplines and cultures for sharing and exchange, while providing a valuable platform for outstanding international works.

As pioneers in Arts Education in Singapore, Practice has been instrumental both in nurturing leaders in the Singapore arts scene, and inculcating a love for the arts in generations of Singapore youth.

Artistically diverse and constantly relevant, Practice will always engage with the ceaseless exploration of new frontiers.

The Theatre Practice is an Institution of Public Character, a recipient of the National Arts Council’s Major Grant 2017-2020, and a member of the Singapore Chinese Language Theatre Alliance.

Coordinate with external designers, videographers, agencies, KOLs and other marketing partners when required.

Support membership promotions, customer engagement and retention initiatives.

hands-on Marketing Executive who enjoys creating, testing and executing ideas

.

technology, automation and accessible physical wellness experiences

This role is suitable for someone who enjoys *social media, content creation and storytelling*, but is also comfortable being hands-on with campaign execution and engaging with visitors and partners.

This is *6 to 12-month contract role*, with potential for extension or conversion to a full-time position depending on business needs and performance.

*Key Responsibilities*

*1. Social Media & Digital Marketing*

* Manage and maintain the Centre's social media channels, including *Xiaohongshu, WeChat, Instagram and TiktTok*

* Create and publish platform-appropriate content, including captions, graphics, photos, short-form videos and reels

* Keep up with social media trends and suggest relevant content ideas, formats and campaigns

*2. Content Creation*

* Support photography and short-form video production for social media and marketing campaigns

*3. Marketing Campaigns, Partnerships & Activations*

* Support the planning and execution of marketing campaigns, promotions, events and visitor activations

*4. Visitor Engagement*

* Regularly use platforms such as *Xiaohongshu, WeChat, Instagram or TikTok* and understand what makes content engaging on each platform

* Enjoy meeting people and don't mind being in front of the camera occasionally

title: Marketing Communication
description:
JOBDESCRIPTION

Position: Marketing Communications Executive

Department:

Marketing / BusinessDevelopment

1. JobPurpose

The Marketing Communications Executive isresponsible for supporting the planning and execution of the Institute’smarketing and communications activities to strengthen brand awareness, promoteits programmes and services, and support student recruitment objectives.

The role manages marketing content andcommunication channels, including the Institute’s website, social mediaplatforms, digital campaigns, marketing collateral, events and otherpromotional activities.

As the Institute operates as a PrivateEducation Institution (PEI) in Singapore, the Executive is also responsible forensuring that published marketing information is accurate, current andconsistent with approved institutional and course information, and complieswith applicable regulatory requirements and internal policies.

2. KeyResponsibilities

A. Marketing Communications & BrandManagement

Support the development and implementation of the Institute’s marketing and communications plans.

Develop marketing content that communicates the Institute’s programmes, strengths, facilities, student experience and progression opportunities.

Maintain consistent branding, messaging, tone and visual identity across marketing channels.

Prepare and update brochures, flyers, posters, presentations, advertisements, banners and other marketing collateral.

Coordinate with internal departments to ensure that information communicated externally is accurate and up to date.

Maintain organised records of approved marketing materials, artwork and communication assets.

B. Digital Marketing & Social Media

Manage and regularly update the Institute’s social media platforms and other digital communication channels.

Develop and maintain a content calendar for social media and digital campaigns.

Create and publish engaging content, including graphics, photographs, short-form videos, programme highlights, student activities and institutional updates.

Support paid digital advertising campaigns, including campaign setup, content preparation and performance monitoring.

Monitor engagement, enquiries, reach, traffic and other relevant digital marketing indicators.

Recommend improvements to digital campaigns based on performance data and audience response.

Monitor online comments, messages and enquiries and coordinate appropriate responses or escalation.

C. Website & Online Content

Maintain and update marketing-related content on the Institute’s website.

Ensure information relating to programmes, intakes, fees, entry requirements, facilities and institutional information is presented accurately based on approved information.

Coordinate with relevant departments or vendors for website updates and improvements.

Review website content periodically to identify outdated, inaccurate or inconsistent information.

Support search engine optimisation (SEO) and other initiatives to improve the Institute’s online visibility.

D. Marketing Content & Creative Production

Produce written and visual content for marketing campaigns and institutional communications.

Coordinate photography, videography and design work for school activities, events and promotional campaigns.

Develop content featuring student activities, achievements, campus life, academic programmes and institutional developments.

Liaise with external designers, printers, photographers, media agencies and other marketing vendors where required.

Ensure appropriate consent and approval are obtained before using student photographs, videos, testimonials or personal information for marketing purposes.

E. Student Recruitment & BusinessDevelopment Support

Support Business Development and Student Services teams with marketing materials and communication required for student recruitment.

Prepare programme presentations, recruitment materials and promotional content for prospective students, parents, education agents and partners.

Support education fairs, roadshows, open houses, school visits, recruitment events and other promotional activities.

Assist with the preparation of materials for overseas and local recruitment activities.

Support communication campaigns for upcoming intakes, new programmes and institutional initiatives.

Track marketing-generated enquiries and provide relevant reports to management.

F. Events & Institutional Communications

Support the planning, promotion and execution of institutional events such as orientation programmes, graduation ceremonies, open houses, student activities and partner events.

Prepare event publicity materials, invitations, signage, presentation materials and digital communications.

Coordinate photography and content collection during institutional activities and events.

Support internal and external communications relating to significant institutional developments and activities.

G. PEI Marketing Compliance & InformationAccuracy

Ensure marketing and promotional materials are based on approved and current information.

Verify programme names, course duration, fees, entry requirements, awarding bodies, progression pathways, and other key information with relevant departments, ensuring compliance with the CPE Advertising Code for Private Education Institutions prior to publication.

Ensure that marketing communications do not contain misleading, unsubstantiated or unauthorised claims.

Ensure references to regulatory status, certifications, awards, partnerships and institutional achievements are accurately represented and appropriately approved.

Support periodic reviews of published marketing materials, social media content and website information for accuracy and compliance.

Promptly correct, withdraw or escalate marketing information identified as inaccurate, outdated or potentially misleading.

Maintain proper records and versions of approved marketing materials where required for internal review or regulatory purposes.

Observe applicable requirements relating to personal data protection, copyright, intellectual property and the use of student images and testimonials.

H. Marketing Performance & Reporting

Maintain records of marketing activities, campaigns, enquiries and expenditure.

Track agreed marketing KPIs such as reach, engagement, leads, enquiries, conversion indicators and campaign performance.

Prepare regular marketing reports for management.

Analyse the effectiveness of different marketing channels and recommend improvements.

Assist with the preparation and monitoring of the marketing budget.

Coordinate quotations, purchase requests and invoices relating to marketing activities and vendors.

3. OtherResponsibilities

Work collaboratively with Academic, Student Services, Business Development, Quality Assurance and other departments.

Participate in institutional meetings, events and improvement initiatives where required.

Maintain confidentiality of student, staff and institutional information.

Follow the Institute’s policies, procedures and quality assurance requirements.

Perform other reasonable duties assigned by the Principal or Management that are relevant to the position.

4. KeyPerformance Indicators

Performance may be assessed based on:

Timely execution of approved marketing plans and campaigns.

Quality and consistency of marketing content and branding.

Effectiveness of marketing campaigns and recruitment activities.

Accuracy and timeliness of website and marketing information.

Timely completion of marketing materials and projects.

Effectiveness of event and recruitment support.

Achieve the pre-determined number of leads specific to campaigns.

Achieve the pre-determined impression to leads conversion rate.

Achieve the pre-determined number to traffics visiting our website.

Achieve the pre-determined duration which an average visitor will stay on our website.

Achieved the pre-determined number of followers on our social platforms.

5.Requirements

Education

Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Mass Communication, Digital Marketing, Business or a related discipline.

Experience

Relevant experience in marketing, communications, digital marketing or content creation.

Experience within the education, training or private education sector would be advantageous.

Experience managing social media platforms and digital campaigns is preferred.

Budget planning for all activities.

Principal, Business Development, Student Services, Academic Department, QualityAssurance, Finance and Administration.

External:

Prospective students and parents, education agents, institutional partners,marketing agencies, designers, printers, photographers, media vendors and eventorganisers.

title: Public Relations Officer
description:
Job Summary: We are seeking a skilled and motivated Public Relations Officer to join our team. As a Public Relations Officer, you will be responsible for managing and enhancing the public image and reputation of our organization. You will develop and execute effective communication strategies, build relationships with key stakeholders, and handle media relations. The ideal candidate has exceptional communication skills, a strong understanding of public relations principles, and the ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Responsibilities:

Communication Strategy: Develop and implement comprehensive communication strategies that align with the organization's goals and objectives. Create messaging frameworks, key talking points, and press releases to effectively convey the organization's mission, initiatives, and achievements.

Media Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with media representatives, journalists, and influencers. Proactively pitch stories and secure media coverage for the organization and its events, campaigns, and milestones. Serve as the primary point of contact for media inquiries and coordinate interviews and press conferences.

Content Creation: Write, edit, and distribute compelling and engaging content for various channels, including press releases, newsletters, articles, blog posts, and social media. Ensure all content is accurate, consistent, and aligned with the organization's brand and messaging.

Crisis Management: Act as the organization's spokesperson during times of crisis or reputation management issues. Develop crisis communication plans, prepare key messaging, and manage media inquiries effectively. Mitigate potential damage to the organization's reputation and maintain transparency and trust with stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, partners, government agencies, and community organizations. Develop communication materials tailored to specific audiences and collaborate with internal teams to ensure consistent messaging across all touchpoints.

Event Planning and Management: Coordinate and oversee the planning and execution of press conferences, product launches, corporate events, and other public relations initiatives. Work closely with event organizers, vendors, and internal teams to ensure seamless execution and maximum media exposure.

Monitoring and Reporting: Monitor media coverage and public sentiment related to the organization and its industry. Prepare regular reports on media activity, campaign effectiveness, and key performance indicators. Analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

Requirements:

Proven work experience as a Public Relations Officer or in a similar role.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building abilities.

Knowledge of public relations principles, strategies, and best practices.

Experience in media relations, including pitching stories and handling media inquiries.

Ability to effectively manage crisis situations and handle sensitive information.

Familiarity with social media platforms and digital marketing trends.

Exceptional organizational and time management skills.

Proficiency in relevant software and tools.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

We offer a competitive salary, along with benefits and opportunities for professional growth. If you have a passion for public relations, a knack for storytelling, and a desire to shape and protect our organization's reputation, we invite you to apply for the position of Public Relations Officer.

Association of Advertising & Marketing Singapore (AAMS) is a non-profit trade association and professional body representing all aspects of Advertising, Marketing, Media, and Communications. We work closely with partners, members, and stakeholders towards excellence in the Admarcom industry. Our members comprise brand marketers across all businesses, industries, advertising & media agencies, and media owners.

We organise Singapore’s most respected industry platforms, including:

Effie Singapore Awards

Singapore Media Marketing Awards (SMMA)

GONG Awards

Crowbar Awards

Hall of Fame

NexGen Awards

Industry conferences

Membership events

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organised Activations Executive to support the planning and execution of AAMS awards, conferences and membership events.

This is a hands-on role focused on logistics, systems setup and operational coordination. You will work closely with the Head of Activations to ensure events and judging processes are executed accurately and efficiently.

Your Scope of Work

1. Event Planning & Execution

Coordinate venue logistics, AV setup, registration counters and on-site Activations.

Plan and execute AAMS industry awards, conferences and membership events i.e. networking events and roundtables.

Manage production materials and printed assets, such as banners, posters, trophies etc.

Support rehearsals and run-of-show execution.

Ensure events are delivered according to operational timelines.

2. Awards & Judging Activations

Set up and manage entry and registration portals.

Configure and ensure judging portals are fully operational prior to judging sessions.

Coordinate in-person judging logistics i.e. venue set-up, materials and score management.

Collate and tabulate judges’ scores accurately.

Ensure confidentiality and integrity of judging processes.

3. Membership & Conference Events

Manage speaker logistics including briefing materials, slide collection, scheduling, and on-site coordination.

Oversee delegate registration and attendance reporting.

Ensure smooth front-of-house Activations during events.

4. Partner & Vendor Coordination

Liaise with vendors, venues and production partners to ensure operational requirements are met.

Coordinate production partners, printers and venue teams.

Support fulfilment of sponsor deliverables from an Activations standpoint.

5. Finance & Administration

Track event expenses and purchase orders.

Monitor outstanding payments and maintain organised documentation of contracts and invoices.

Prepare post-event reports.

Requirements

Minimum 1 year experience in events management or project coordination.

Strong organisational and time management skills.

Proficient in Microsoft Office (especially Excel).

Familiar with Canva and Adobe is an advantage.

Highly detail-oriented (accuracy is critical).

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Willing to work occasional evenings during events.

About the Association of Advertising and Marketing Singapore (AAMS)

The Association of Advertising and Marketing Singapore (AAMS) was established through the merger of the Association of Accredited Advertising Agents, Singapore (4As) and the Institute of Advertising Singapore (IAS). As the national industry body, AAMS represents the collective interests of the advertising, marketing, and communications sector in Singapore.

Built on over 100 years of industry experience and guided by an Executive Committee comprising senior industry leaders, AAMS is committed to advancing standards in marketing excellence, creativity, and effectiveness. The Association plays a pivotal role in fostering regional collaboration, strengthening the local industry ecosystem, supporting talent development, and championing innovation.

For more information, please visit https://aams.org.sg/.

description:
TSH Corporation Limited specialises in offering and distributing the epitome of premium whiskies, cocktails and spirits. Our portfolio comprises nine distinctive concepts: Quaich Bar Collector, Quaich Bar Avant-garde, Quaich Bar Wanderlust, The Other Room, Signature Reserve, Capitol Cigar & Whisky Lounge, The Auld Alliance, The Whisky Store and Whisky Journey. This December, Signature Reserve will collaborate with FOC Restaurant on an exciting new concept that brings together the world of whisky and Catalan cuisine, creating yet another distinctive and elevated hospitality experience within our growing portfolio.

As we continue to expand our portfolio and strengthen our presence in the industry, we are seeking passionate, committed and service-oriented individuals to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity for those looking to grow their careers within the premium spirits and hospitality industry and be part of a growing organisation that continues to evolve and introduce new concepts and experiences for its consumers.

General Duties & Responsibilities:

Coordinate with external vendors, printers and suppliers to ensure marketing materials are produced and delivered on time.

Assist with website, digital menu and online platform updates to ensure information is accurate and up to date.

Assist with social media postings across all brand and outlet channels, including preparing captions, coordinating assets, scheduling posts and ensuring content is published according to the marketing calendar.

Support photoshoots, content production, events and marketing campaigns when required.

Conduct basic checks on marketing materials and social media content to ensure pricing, dates, promotion mechanics, branding and information are accurate before publication.

⁠Support time-sensitive marketing requests while ensuring communication remains clear between outlets, designers, vendors and the marketing team.

Follow up with relevant teams on outstanding information, artwork, approvals and deliverables to keep marketing projects on track.

Maintain organised records of artwork files, campaign materials, promotion details and past marketing assets for easy reference.

The Whisky Store began in 2005 as a humble retail kiosk in Tanglin Mall run by escapees from the corporate world, Khoon Hui and Joyce. At that time, the Singaporean market lacked a dedicated whisky bar and through the dedicated pursuit of their passion for fine whisky, Khoon and Joyce opened a whisky bar one year later. Born in 2007, Quaich Bar was the first whisky concept bar in Singapore.

Today, The Whisky Store is much more than a kiosk. The group provides retail and wholesale of a very wide range of whiskies, many of which they hold in exclusive agency for in Singapore. These close relationships allow The Whisky Store to gain access to exclusive bottlings and casks that cannot be found anywhere else. Quaich Bar is still where it began in 2007, but now has a sister bar Quaich Bar South Beach. And in 2021, a new bar and restaurant called Signature Reserve was opened.

2-5 years of experience in social media, content marketing, digital marketing or a related role.

Strong experience managing

Instagram, TikTok and Facebook

.

Strong understanding of social media trends and Singapore's digital landscape.

Strong copywriting and storytelling skills.

Creative, proactive and commercially minded.

Strong project management and organisational skills.

Experience in

F&B, hospitality, lifestyle or consumer brands

.

Basic photography and videography skills.

We are looking for someone who is:

Creative

— You know what makes people stop scrolling.

Hands-on

Strategic

— You understand that social media is more than likes and followers.

Commercially minded

— You understand how social media can influence customer behaviour, outlet traffic and sales.

Brand-conscious

— You know how to create fun and engaging content without compromising the Greendot brand.

Growth of Greendot's social media presence

Engagement and audience growth

Short-form video performance

Quality and consistency of content

Successful execution of campaigns and launches

Growth of organic reach

Social media-driven customer engagement

CRM/member acquisition from social channels

Campaign performance

Opportunity to

shape the social media direction of a growing Singapore F&B brand

.

Build an internal social media function from the ground up.

Work across exciting food, lifestyle and cultural campaigns.

Be involved in new product launches and the development of

Greendot Kopihouse

.

Work in a fast-paced environment where your ideas can quickly become real campaigns.

Opportunity to grow with the business and build a team.

Interested?

If you are passionate about

social media, food, content and building brands

, we'd love to hear from you.

Please submit your

CV and portfolio/social media accounts

showcasing relevant work, particularly examples of

Reels, TikToks, campaigns or F&B content

that you have created or managed.

Position:

Social Media Lead / Manager

Marketing

Singapore

Employment Type:

Full-Time

Salary:

Competitive, depending on experience and portfolio

We strive to make the world a happier place through the power of plant-based nourishment!

Come experience the Green Transformation

Backed by over a decade of experience in serving delicious plantbased meals with a local spin, Greendot is a lifestyle F&B concept brand that truly embraces the “Green Transformation”. Green is all about green earth, green food, green lifestyle. True to our brand ethos, Greendot creates positive and meaningful experiences beyond plant-based food. We empower people to renew their mind and embrace new habits, and help them to become kind to themselves and to others, creating a positive ripple effect.

Goodness - Greendot's core business is serving food that nourishes the mind and body. Beyond food, it also reflects the intrinsic qualities of the brand - Inspiring people to create a positive impact that brings lasting good to themselves and to others.

Turn client briefs, product features and brand positioning into clear, memorable narratives.

Copy across channels

Brand voice

Collaboration

Get to know our briefing, review and approval process, and how copy, design and strategy hand off to each other. Read into the tone, audience and goals of each account you are assigned.

A portfolio that shows conceptual thinking, strong campaign headlines, social copy and integrated campaign work.

Excellent written English and a sharp eye for grammar, rhythm and detail.

The ability to picture an idea and explain it clearly to designers, clients and other non-writers.

Awareness of digital culture, platform formats and what audiences are responding to now.

Self-discipline to manage your own time and deadlines in a WFH-first team.

Comfort with tight turnarounds and with taking feedback and revising quickly.

Experience in hospitality, travel, beauty, lifestyle or healthcare brands.

Scriptwriting for Reels, TikTok or short films.

Working knowledge of SEO and performance copy.

A second language used in our markets, such as Mandarin.

Curious and resourceful

Clear communicator

Organised and dependable

Strategic problem-solver

Takes initiative and ownership

Real creative ownership.

You help shape campaigns and brand voices from the concept up, not fill in text boxes on templates.

Brands people know.

You write for established regional and global names in hospitality, beauty and lifestyle.

A small team with no layers.
