title: Operations Executive
description:
About the role

To take day-to-day operational ownership of content on the Jamiyah SuperApp. Tasks include planning, publishing, checking and keeping it current so that the platform is live, accurate, on-brand and useful to members, volunteers, donors and beneficiaries every day. The role is the point where content from across Jamiyah's departments, from JamiyahTV and from the News Desk is turned into a coherent daily experience in the app.

Key responsibilities

Plan, schedule and publish daily content across all SuperApp modules: Jamiyah News & Activities, Education Programmes, Volunteer Opportunities, the Digital Donation Centre, Digital Publications (Voice of Islam, Jamiyah Bulletin, Impact Reports), JamiyahTV and the Jamiyah News Desk.

Maintain a rolling content calendar aligned to both Jamiyah's programme calendar and the Islamic calendar, with advance planning for Ramadan, the two Eids, Awal Muharram, Maulidur Rasul and major community events.

Write, edit and proofread in-app copy: headlines, standfirsts, event listings, push notifications, in-app banners and campaign messages.

Brief and quality-check graphics, thumbnails, key art and promotional assets with the Art/Graphics Unit of Jamiyah Studio Dept; ensure correct use of the Jamiyah and JamiyahTV brand identities.

Apply the editorial principles set out in the JamiyahTV master plan to publish accurate, respectful, family-friendly, educational, inclusive, professionally produced, and aligned with Jamiyah's mission and values.

Maintain metadata, tagging, categorisation and archiving so that content remains searchable and reusable.

Act as the single point of contact for content submissions from MarComm, Fundraising, Outreach, CODD, FoodBank, Education and the Homes.

Serve as day-to-day operational contact with the appointed technology partner: log defects, track fixes, and carry out user acceptance testing before each release.

Track engagement metrics: reach, active users, session depth, watch time on embedded JamiyahTV content, including in-app conversions involving donations, volunteer sign-ups, programme registrations and subscription take-up.

Produce a monthly performance report for the unit head, with observations and recommended changes to content mix, timing and promotion.

About you

Diploma or degree in Communications, Media, Digital Marketing, Journalism or a related discipline.

A minimum of three years of hands-on experience in digital content operations, platform or app operations, e-commerce operations, or newsroom production.

Strong written English, with the ability to write cleanly and quickly to a deadline.

Working proficiency in Malay, to handle community content and audience communication for a substantially Malay-Muslim readership.

Hands-on competence with content management systems, scheduling tools, basic design tools such as Canva or the Adobe suite, and basic analytics such as GA4 or an equivalent app analytics platform.

Demonstrably organised and deadline-driven, and comfortable with a daily publishing rhythm rather than project-based work.

Maintain high standards of professional and ethical conduct.

Support and promote diversity and inclusion within the workplace.

Engage in continuous learning and development.

About us

Jamiyah Singapore's vision is serving the community, caring for all. The mission is to work and contribute towards the welfare and development of the Muslim community and mankind.

Jamiyah Singapore, also known as Muslim Missionary Society Singapore, was founded in 1932 by the Roving Ambassador of Peace from Meerut (India), Moulana Abdul Aleem Siddique. Continuing Moulana’s legacy, vision and mission is to serve the community and to provide welfare services to the less privileged and disadvantaged of all races and faiths.

Nike is looking for an experienced procurement leader who can engage stakeholders, create geographically relevant category strategies and deliver measurable business outcomes across Marketing and Places categories. The ideal candidate brings a marketing, retail and/or construction or facilities management procurement background, strong business acumen, and a category leadership mindset.

This role is focused on building deep stakeholder engagement and strategic category development, not execution of sourcing work. Working knowledge of sourcing is important, but the strongest candidate will be distinguished by the ability to connect business requirements with external supplier and market capabilities to develop and implement strategies that deliver value to the enterprise.

6+ years of relevant experience in marketing, retail and/or construction or FM procurement, category management, sourcing, or a closely related field.
Demonstrated ability to operate across local, geography and global stakeholder groups, managing multiple categories, markets and business priorities in a matrixed environment.
Proven ability to engage stakeholders, clarify business requirements, develop strategy, influence decisions, and lead execution in a matrixed organization.
Working knowledge of strategic sourcing, including requests for information, quotation, and proposal (RFx); supplier evaluation; negotiations; and contracting.
Clear, influential communication skills, executive presence, analytical acumen, and the judgment to navigate ambiguity and move work forward.
Bachelor’s degree in business, procurement or relevant categories or equivalent combination of experience, training and education.
Ability to lead through influence across cross-functional teams and external delivery partners
Experience using supplier, market, spend and operational insights to shape category strategies, identify opportunities and manage business risk.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

In this role you will develop deep engagement with relevant stakeholders across the geo and territory working in partnership with them to develop and implement relevant category strategies to deliver value, manage risk, and advance business objectives. You will engage with the Marketing & Places Procurement team to drive knowledge and insights from across the multiple geographies.

You will be expected to:

Build trusted stakeholder relationships and align on the prioritization and sequencing of incoming work based on business requirements, value, and risk.
Use operational and market knowledge to evaluate supplier capabilities, challenge assumptions, identify execution risks, and recommend practical solutions.
Conduct spend, market, supplier, and operational analysis to identify value opportunities and support fact-based decisions.
Provide direction to Procurement Operations and the procurement managed service provider to ensure high-quality sourcing and contracting execution.
Develop concise, executive-ready materials that communicate strategy, recommendations, risks, decisions, and outcomes.
Adopt and scale effective procurement practices, tools, and ways of working across Marketing & Places categories in APLA.

title: SOCIAL MEDIA & CONTENT MARKETING MANAGER
description:
BMG Hospitality is building a hospitality ecosystem combining hotels, restaurants, social experiences and community-driven marketing.

who can turn everyday hospitality experiences into engaging content that people want to watch, share and visit.

This is not a role where you simply schedule posts.

We want someone who can

think, shoot, design, edit, publish, experiment and teach others how to create content.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

You will manage and create content across:

• Instagram

• TikTok

• Facebook

• LinkedIn

• YouTube

You will work closely with the BMG Hospitality, Gabriel Restaurant and Capsule Social Modern teams to build a consistent and recognisable brand presence.

CONTENT CREATION

You should be comfortable producing:

🎥 Short-form videos and Reels

🎥 TikTok videos

🎥 30–60 second animated videos

🎥 Restaurant food and lifestyle videos

🎥 Hotel and guest-experience content

🎥 Longer-form YouTube videos

📸 Photography and photo editing

✍️ Captions, storytelling and social-media copy

You should also be able to create

YouTube-style brand and storytelling videos similar in concept and production quality to reference videos provided by BMG

, and repurpose longer videos into multiple short-form pieces for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook and YouTube Shorts.

A VERY IMPORTANT PART OF THE ROLE

We do not want content creation to depend on only one person.

You will be expected to

teach and coach our Front Desk, Guest Experience and Restaurant Crew

to create simple, engaging content themselves.

Our objective is for staff members to eventually be capable of producing a

60-second animated or edited social-media video

, using AI and modern content-creation tools.

You will create simple templates, workflows and training so that the operating team can capture moments happening inside our hotels and restaurants every day.

YOU SHOULD BE FAMILIAR WITH

• CapCut / Adobe Premiere Pro or similar

• Canva / Adobe Creative Suite

• AI video and image-generation tools

• AI-assisted content creation

• TikTok and Instagram Reels editing

• YouTube production

• Graphic design

• Photography and videography

• Social-media analytics

• Content calendars

• Meta Business Suite

• LinkedIn content

• TikTok trends and formats

Knowledge of tools such as

ChatGPT, Claude and other AI creative platforms

will be highly advantageous.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We want someone who is:

✔ Creative but commercially minded

✔ Comfortable appearing behind or occasionally in front of the camera

✔ Able to work independently and as part of a hospitality team

✔ Fast at turning ideas into actual content

✔ Comfortable working with restaurant and hotel operational teams

✔ Able to teach non-marketing staff how to create content

✔ Interested in AI-assisted content production

✔ Able to understand what makes people stop scrolling

✔ Focused on generating engagement, footfall, bookings and revenue — not merely followers

YOUR SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED BY

The quality and consistency of content produced, audience growth and engagement, restaurant traffic and hotel enquiries generated through social media, video performance, development of reusable content formats, and the ability to turn our operational team into a wider network of content creators.

BMG Hospitality Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based hospitality and lifestyle company building a technology-enabled ecosystem across accommodation, food & beverage, talent, education, community, digital marketing and media.

Our core hospitality concept, Capsule Modern, focuses on modern, well-designed and affordable accommodation for the next generation of travellers. We aim to combine efficient hotel operations, strong guest experiences, social interaction and technology to create a scalable hospitality platform. Our target guests include independent travellers, digital natives and younger international visitors seeking convenient locations, quality facilities, value and community experiences.

Alongside our hotels, BMG Hospitality is developing Gabriel Restaurants to support both hotel guests and external customers. The restaurant platform is designed to complement hotel operations through breakfast services, food and beverage offerings and social experiences while developing its own standalone revenue streams.

BMG operates with an asset-light approach, focusing primarily on leasing and converting suitable properties rather than purchasing real estate. Standardised operating procedures, technology, centralised management and disciplined project execution are intended to allow new properties to be developed and launched efficiently.

Technology and artificial intelligence form an important part of BMG's operating philosophy. We are building a cloud-based management environment covering hotel operations, revenue management, reservations, customer relationship management, finance, HR, recruitment, project management, marketing, social media, reporting and management dashboards. Our managers are expected to use AI as a practical working tool to improve productivity, decision-making, communication and reporting.

Beyond hotels and restaurants, BMG is developing an ecosystem that includes talent recruitment and development, BMG Academy, affiliate marketing, community programmes and digital media. These businesses are intended to support the hospitality platform by developing employees, creating additional distribution channels, building customer communities and creating new sources of revenue.

BMG's organisational culture is built around entrepreneurship, accountability, continuous learning and measurable performance. We believe technology should empower employees rather than replace the human relationships that remain fundamental to hospitality. Team members are encouraged to understand the commercial impact of their roles, develop leadership capabilities and continuously improve the systems they manage.

The company is currently focused on establishing and scaling its Singapore operations, with longer-term opportunities across selected Asian markets. As BMG grows, we are building a management team capable of creating repeatable operating systems that can support multiple hotels, restaurants and related businesses across different locations.

Our objective is to build more than a collection of hotels. We aim to develop an integrated hospitality ecosystem where accommodation, food, technology, talent, education, community and digital distribution work together to create stronger customer experiences, operational efficiency and sustainable long-term growth.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
About Us:

BYD by 1826 is Singapore’s first integrated automotive-lifestyle brand—where electric mobility meets immersive experience. Beyond car showrooms, our multi-concept spaces fuse innovation, sustainability, F&B, and community into one seamless lifestyle offering. From cutting-edge EV launches and immersive roadshows to curated pop-ups and heritage-inspired campaigns, we activate our brand through storytelling that moves people—literally and emotionally.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Marketing Manager (or Assistant Marketing Manager, depending on experience) to support and execute 360° brand and campaign initiatives across digital, on-ground, and retail platforms. This role will work closely with the Chief Brand Officer, Events, Marketing & Creative teams to drive integrated marketing strategies, amplify brand visibility, and strengthen customer engagement across our touchpoints.

You’ll be expected to wear many hats—developing campaign plans, coordinating timelines, liaising with partners and internal teams, managing content calendars, and supporting the execution of automotive-lifestyle experiences that define BYD by 1826.

Liaise with external partners, agencies, and vendors for joint marketing efforts, influencer activations, or campaign collaborations.

Coordinate asset requests and approvals, ensuring materials are aligned with brand tone, visual identity, and strategy.

Monitor and report on campaign performance, digital engagement, and event outcomes to guide future strategy.

Stay up-to-date with trends in EV, lifestyle, F&B, and digital marketing to keep campaigns relevant and innovative.

Support the planning and publicity for roadshows, outlet launches, and automotive showcases across Singapore.

Assist in preparing decks, reports, and proposals for internal stakeholders and external partners.

3–5 years of experience in marketing, branding, or communications—preferably in a hybrid lifestyle, automotive, F&B, or retail environment.

Experience with campaign planning, social media management, and cross-functional marketing coordination.

Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills with a keen eye for detail and brand tone.

Familiarity with digital marketing tools and platforms preferred (e.g., Meta Business Suite, Mailchimp, Google Analytics, Canva, etc.).

: BYD by 1826

About Us

:

Welcome to BYD by 1826, a distinctive fusion of casual-premium dining and automotive retail, offering a remarkable experience that caters to both food lovers and car enthusiasts. Building upon the successful concept of the highly-regarded 1826 Restaurant (Boat Quay), BYD by 1826 represents an innovative union of style, functionality, and sophistication.

Situated in the city's vibrant heart, our two concept stores (Boat Quay and Suntec City) combines the relaxed yet premium dining experience of the 1826 Restaurant with an exclusive showroom showcasing BYD, a globally celebrated manufacturer of electric vehicles and state-of-the-art automotive technology. BYD by 1826 provides guests with the opportunity to delight in exceptional cuisine in a laid-back yet elegant atmosphere, while simultaneously discovering an array of BYD's most advanced and innovative electric vehicles. We seamlessly blend two traditionally separate experiences into a cohesive and memorable event.

Our restaurant features culinary creations from top-notch chefs; who take pride in developing a diverse menu inspired by seasonal ingredients and global food trends. Our auto showroom presents an impressive collection of BYD vehicles, complete with a team of well-informed, passionate sales professionals always ready to assist and educate.

Our Culture

:

Our pursuit of excellence defines every aspect of our work. Our team consists of dynamic, enthusiastic, and forward-thinking individuals with a deep appreciation for food and automotive culture. We cherish diversity, collaboration, and mutual respect, fostering an environment that promotes professional growth and development.

Join Us

:

Whether your passion lies in crafting unique gastronomic experiences or in bringing the latest in electric vehicle technology to the public, we encourage you to explore our open positions. We're continuously on the lookout for skilled individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, creative, and customer-focused environment.

Join BYD by 1826 and play a pivotal role in reshaping the conventional boundaries of dining and retail.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
About UnlockLand

UnlockLand is a Singapore-based AI technology company building software for land development, urban planning and pre-development decision-making.

Our platform combines planning policies, land data, development evidence and AI-powered workflows to help developers, planners and public-sector organisations make better decisions.

We are looking for an experienced Social Media & PR Executive to build UnlockLand’s public presence through short-form video, social media, content and public relations.

Job Summary

You will be responsible for creating and publishing engaging content that communicates UnlockLand’s products, technology, customer projects and company progress.

The ideal candidate combines social media experience, short-form video production and basic design capability. You should be able to understand complex topics such as AI, urban planning and real estate, then turn them into clear, attractive and easy-to-understand content.

A background in urban planning, architecture, urban design, real estate or another built-environment discipline is strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Manage and grow UnlockLand’s LinkedIn and other relevant social media channels.

Plan and execute weekly social media and content calendars.

Create short-form videos for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and other platforms.

Develop video concepts, scripts, storyboards and content formats.

Film, edit and publish short videos, interviews, product demonstrations and event content.

Create visual assets, social media graphics, carousels, presentations and simple motion content.

Write social media posts, blog articles, newsletters, company updates and PR materials.

Turn product updates, customer projects, technical developments and company milestones into engaging stories.

Interview founders, engineers, planners, customers and partners to identify content opportunities.

Support press releases, media pitches, interviews, events and industry outreach.

Research relevant topics in AI, urban planning, PropTech, real estate and technology.

Maintain media lists, content libraries, brand materials and publishing schedules.

Track social media performance, audience growth, engagement and content reach.

Support SEO and GEO initiatives to improve UnlockLand’s visibility online.

Ensure that all published content is accurate, professional and consistent with the company’s brand.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience managing social media, content, PR or digital communications for a company or organisation.

Proven experience creating and editing short-form videos for social media.

Strong understanding of LinkedIn and other professional or consumer social media platforms.

Basic to intermediate visual design skills.

Proficiency in tools such as Canva, Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar tools.

Strong written and spoken English.

Ability to understand technical, planning and business topics and communicate them clearly.

Strong writing, storytelling, research and interviewing skills.

Good visual judgment and attention to detail.

Ability to manage content production independently and meet deadlines.

Comfortable working directly with founders, engineers, planners, customers and external stakeholders.

Strong interest in AI, urban planning, real estate technology and startups.

Preferred Qualifications

Academic or professional background in urban planning, urban design, architecture, real estate, geography or a related built-environment discipline.

Experience creating content for technology, AI, PropTech, architecture, planning or real estate companies.

Experience producing founder-led content, interviews, webinars, podcasts or product demonstrations.

Experience with photography, videography, motion graphics or basic animation.

Familiarity with SEO, GEO, content analytics and digital distribution.

Experience supporting media outreach, events or corporate communications.

Professional proficiency in Mandarin is an advantage.

A portfolio of short videos, social media campaigns, designs, articles or PR work.

What Success Looks Like

UnlockLand publishes high-quality social content consistently.

Short-form videos clearly explain the company’s technology, products and progress.

Social media engagement and audience reach improve over time.

Product launches, customer projects and company milestones receive timely content coverage.

UnlockLand develops a credible, professional and recognisable public presence.

Content supports customer trust, recruitment, partnerships and investor interest.

What We Offer

Work at the intersection of AI, urban planning and real estate.

Direct exposure to founders, engineers, planners and enterprise customers.

The opportunity to shape UnlockLand’s public image and content direction.

Hands-on ownership across social media, short video, design and PR.

A fast-moving startup environment with opportunities for professional growth.

UNLOCKLAND is a Singapore-headquartered, AI-native software company building a decision platform for real estate development.

Our platform helps real estate developers discover opportunities, evaluate land, compare development scenarios, and make faster, smarter, and lower-risk investment decisions.

We connect parcel, planning, market, and development evidence to the workflows that turn land into a complete, reviewable opportunity.

Our data coverage currently spans 15 global markets across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East, including Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, New Zealand, the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, France, the Netherlands, Denmark, Norway, Finland, and Saudi Arabia.

We are expanding rapidly across new markets, deeper data coverage, and more connected development workflows.

title: Manager, Marketing and Communications
description:
About Asia Climate Philanthropy Advisory

The Asia Climate Philanthropy Advisory (ACPA) is headquartered in Singapore and supported by several leading philanthropists and climate foundations. ACPA is mandated to support ultra-high-net-worth individuals to make philanthropic investments into the climate action space by providing bespoke advisory support, curated local climate knowledge, carefully vetted giving opportunities, and access to a diverse network of climate-focused experts, peers and partners.

About the Role

We seek a seasoned, outstanding individual to join as its Manager, Marketing & Communications and lead the implementation of ACPA’s communications roadmap, including content strategy, digital engagement, events planning, and media outreach. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who combines strategic thinking with strong execution, creative flair, and excellent project management skills.

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, the Manager will help position ACPA as a trusted, visible, and credible partner in the Asian philanthropy ecosystem — translating complex ideas into compelling narratives that inspire giving and collaboration on climate action.

Responsibilities

The Manager, Marketing & Communications will engage in the following areas of responsibility.

Support the implementation of ACPA’s brand strategy, messaging framework, and tone of voice across all channels.

Work with external agencies to produce brand and communications assets (e.g., templates, decks, infographics, case studies).

Develop and manage ACPA’s editorial calendar and content pipeline across website, LinkedIn, and other platforms as required.

Research, copywrite, and edit high-quality content such as articles, donor stories, partner spotlights, and thought leadership pieces.

Oversee website updates and work with designers and developers to enhance user experience and impact storytelling.

Support media engagement, including drafting press releases, managing media lists, and coordinating interviews and coverage.

Cultivate relationships with key communications and ecosystem partners to amplify ACPA’s visibility.

Track and evaluate media performance and engagement metrics.

Develop communications plans and promotional materials for ACPA convenings, briefings, and flagship gatherings.

Create on-site and post-event content, including talking points, recaps, and visual assets.

Support the production of POS and knowledge materials

Support communications with donor clients as needed by the Climate and Philanthropy teams

Manage external vendors and freelancers (writers, designers, photographers) to ensure timely delivery of outputs.

Track communications KPIs, maintain documentation and asset libraries, and contribute to reporting and evaluation.

Qualifications and Requirements

10-12 years of experience and track record in communications – ideally with non-profit/non-governmental organizations.

Proven experience developing and executing communication and brand strategies.

Superb verbal and written communication skills in English, with proficiency in writing, editing and storytelling. Proficiency in other Asian languages is advantageous.

Excellent writing, editing, and storytelling skills,

with a strong grasp of tone and audience adaptation.

Experience managing social media channels and content calendars.

Strong project management skills and comfort working with external vendors and cross-functional teams.

While not mandatory, a genuine interest in climate change and social impact, and ability to quickly grasp related concepts are desirable.

Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a small, dynamic and collaborative team.

Excellent event, project management and coordination abilities.

Track record of working in environments requiring professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.

Resourceful problem-solving skills with a proactive, ‘can-do’ attitude towards challenges and changes.

Alignment with ACPA’s mission and commitment to embodying ACPA values.

Bachelor’s degree in communications, public relations, marketing, journalism, or related field.

Only Shortlisted candidates will be notified.

Job Description

• Lead the brands that protect lives and shape the future of healthcare.
• Transform insight into strategy, launches into impact, and potential into growth.
• Inspire teams, influence decisions, and drive meaningful change for patients.

Role overview:

We is seeking a strategic, customer-focused and people-orientedMarketing Lead to shape the next phase of growth for theVaccines and Pharma portfolio acrossSingapore and Brunei. The role provides functional leadership across established brands, recent launches and future growth assets, translating patient, customer, market and competitive insights into clear portfolio choices and measurable execution.

The Marketing Lead will lead and develop Product Managers, establish clear priorities and decision rights, and mobilise cross-functional partners across Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Policy and Communications, Regulatory Affairs, Finance, Supply Chain, Commercial Operations, Data and Analytics, and Legal and Compliance.

What will you do

Portfolio and commercial strategy

• Lead integrated portfolio strategy across Vaccines and Pharma, balancing near-term performance with launch and pipeline priorities.

Integrated execution and performance

• Define leading and lagging indicators, diagnose gaps and adapt plans.

• Develop succession plans, address performance gaps fairly and create cross-portfolio development experiences.

Enterprise leadership and stewardship

• Mobilise cross-functional teams around common outcomes and resolve competing priorities through fact-based dialogue.
• Communicate complex issues simply and credibly to senior local, regional and global stakeholders.

• Strong written and verbal English communication and demonstrated commitment to ethics and integrity.

We are known as Merck Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have brought forward medicines and vaccines for many of the worlds most challenging diseases.

We are looking for a leader who combines strategic thinking, operational discipline, and clear, compelling communication. If you bring intellectual rigor, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to convert ideas into measurable outcomes across a complex matrix, we invite you to help shape how Asia Pacific turns strategy into sustained performance and patient impact.

title: EWTP, Senior Executive (Marketing & Engagement)
description:
The Enterprise Workforce Transformation Package Programme (EWTPP) is a strategic initiative supported by Workforce Singapore Agency (WSG) and administered by the Singapore Business Federation (SBF) as the anchor programme partner. It aims to support companies in their workforce transformation efforts.

 The Senior Executive (Marketing & Engagement) supports the effective implementation of marketing, communications, and engagement activities for the EWTP Programme. This role provides operational and administrative support to the programme team, assists in outreach and reporting, manages programme communications channels, and contributes to resource development. The Senior Executive works closely with Managers and Advisors to ensure robust engagement with companies and stakeholders, supporting programme outcomes and compliance with WSG funding agreement requirements.

 The role also supports lead qualification and handoff by ensuring that engagement and outreach activities surface actionable enterprise leads for follow‑up and progression into bundled One‑WDD solutions, rather than event‑level participation alone.

Job Responsibilities:

Marketing, Communications & Outreach

Execute marketing, communications and outreach activities for EWTP and One WDD programmes, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
Develop and implement sector-wide marketing campaigns across physical and digital channels to drive programme outcomes.
Curate and disseminate programme materials such as EDM, newsletters, event invitations and success stories.
Plan and organise outreach initiatives, workshops and engagement events for participating companies.
Track event performance, analyse data, prepare reports, and ensure compliance with procurement policies and KPIs.
Support lead generation, qualification and structured handoff from marketing and outreach activities to engagement and advisory teams, enabling progression into bundled One‑WDD solutions rather than standalone event participation.

Programme Administration & Reporting

Manage the programme email account and respond to enquiries from companies, partners and stakeholders.
Assist in compiling weekly or monthly engagement reports and programme dashboard.
Support the Lead Manager in preparing reports for internal and external stakeholders, including WSG.
Assist in profiling success stories and gathering feedback from companies to inform continuous improvement.

Governance, Compliance & Continuous Improvement

Ensure all marketing, engagement, and outreach activities comply with WSG funding agreement requirements, including branding, messaging and approval protocols.
Maintain comprehensive records and documentation to support audits, reporting and data integrity.
Identify opportunities to improve engagement processes and resource development, supporting the effectiveness of the EWTP Programme.

Job Requirements:

Job Experience and Preferred Qualifications

Diploma or degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Human Resources, or a related discipline.
At least 2 years of experience in marketing, communications, stakeholder engagement, or programme administration within the enterprise, workforce development or public sector landscape.
Demonstrated ability to support outreach, engagement, and reporting activities in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment.
Experience in managing communications channels, resource platforms or CRM systems is advantageous

Technical Competencies

Strong organisational and administrative skills, with attention to detail in managing communications and reporting.
Proficiency in digital and AI tools, including Canva, CRM, SharePoint, CoPilot and marketing platforms.
Competence in supporting event coordination, stakeholder engagement and resource development.
Ability to compile reports, track engagement metrics and maintain accurate records.

Soft Skills

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proactive, adaptable and able to work independently or as part of a team.
Collaborative team player with the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders.
Strong drive to deliver results and contribute to programme success.

title: Marketing Manager (ACMV Construction Company✨)
description:
Job Description

The Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and implementing marketing and business development strategies to enhance the Company’s market presence, strengthen client and stakeholder relationships, and support business growth within the M&E construction industry.

The role requires a strong understanding of the construction/M&E environment, excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to identify opportunities, analyse market information and develop practical marketing strategies aligned with the Company’s business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Marketing & Business Development

Develop and implement marketing strategies and initiatives to promote the Company’s M&E construction capabilities, projects, services and expertise.

Identify new business opportunities, potential clients and market segments within the construction and M&E industry.

Conduct market research and monitor industry trends, competitors and emerging opportunities.

Support business development activities, including preparation of company profiles, presentations, proposals and marketing materials.

Develop and maintain the Company’s corporate branding and marketing communications.

Coordinate marketing campaigns, corporate events, industry networking activities and client engagement initiatives.

Work closely with management to develop strategies for strengthening the Company’s market positioning.

2. Client & Stakeholder Management

Liaise with clients, consultants, contractors, developers, suppliers and other relevant stakeholders.

Understand client requirements and coordinate internally to ensure appropriate responses and follow-up.

Attend client meetings, networking events, site meetings and industry functions where required.

Gather client and market feedback and communicate relevant information to management and internal teams.

3. Proposal & Tender Support

Maintain an updated database of clients, business contacts, project opportunities and market intelligence.

4. Corporate Communications & Branding

Develop and maintain corporate communication materials, including company brochures, presentations.

Ensure consistency in the Company’s corporate image, branding and external communications.

Highlight the Company’s project achievements, technical capabilities, certifications and industry experience.

Coordinate corporate photography, project case studies and other marketing content.

5. Market Intelligence & Strategic Analysis

Monitor construction and M&E industry developments, market trends and potential business opportunities.

Analyse market information and provide insights to management to support business decisions.

Demonstrate critical thinking and commercial awareness when evaluating business opportunities and marketing initiatives.

Identify potential risks, challenges and opportunities and recommend practical solutions.

6. Internal Collaboration

Work closely with Engineering, Project, Commercial, Procurement, HR and Operations teams to support business and marketing initiatives.

Coordinate with internal stakeholders to obtain accurate project information and ensure timely completion of marketing and business development activities.

Support management in strategic projects and other assignments as required.

Essential

Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Business, Construction Management, Engineering or a related discipline.

Relevant experience in the construction M&E industry is

mandatory.

Minimum 5 years of relevant marketing/business development experience, preferably within the construction, M&E, engineering or built environment sector.

Strong understanding of the Singapore construction and M&E industry, including key stakeholders and business practices.

Proven experience in client and stakeholder management.

Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.

Strong critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills.

Able to understand technical information and translate it into clear and effective marketing or business development materials.

Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with clients, consultants, contractors and senior management.

Good organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly PowerPoint, Word and Excel.

Personal Attributes

The successful candidate should be:

Proactive and commercially minded.

Confident in engaging clients and external stakeholders.

Analytical, resourceful and solutions oriented.

Able to exercise sound judgement and think critically before making recommendations.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced construction environment.

Independent while also being an effective team player.

Professional, approachable and able to represent the Company positively.

Send a short introduction, examples of content you’ve created, and one promotional idea for Genuine Grape. Tell us which AI tools you use and how they help your work.

title: Communications Executive
description:
*We're Hiring: Communications Executive (English & Mandarin Speaking)*

*Quintessential Education | Full-Time or Part-Time | Orchard Road, Singapore*

*About QE*

Quintessential Education is Singapore's leading provider of pre-tertiary academic programmes (IGCSE & IB) and university admissions advisory for top-tier global universities — Ivy League, Oxbridge, and NUS/NTU/SMU. Since 2012 we have worked with more than 700 students, and most of our new families come to us through referrals. We deliver a fully integrated journey for families: academic mastery, guardianship, and university placement under one roof.

We aim to bring out the best in our students, ignite opportunities and nurture them towards success.

We are looking for committed and talented additions to our team. As an ideal candidate, you should display a proven ability to develop and maintain an environment of trust, diversity, and inclusion within the QE team. You should be able to work with the team to meet deadlines and instill a culture of continuous work improvement.

As part of the position, you will work with the founders, Ivy League and Oxbridge graduates and other high-performing teammates.

*The Role*

We're looking for a Communications Executive to own the day-to-day relationship between QE and our families. You'll be the first person a parent speaks to when they enquire, and the person who keeps them informed once their child is with us. That means answering enquiries every day, matching students with the right tutors and mentors, and following up with students and parents regularly so nothing slips through.

You'll also help keep our marketing materials and partner relationships in good order. We are open to full-time or part-time candidates, so tell us the arrangement that works for you.

If you're a confident communicator in both *English and Mandarin\**, stay calm and warm with demanding parents, and like being the person who makes sure things actually get done — we'd love to meet you.

\*As a major group of customers are from China and are only able to converse in Mandarin.

*Key Responsibilities:*

*1. Enquiries & Enrolment*

* Respond to daily parent and student enquiries via phone, WhatsApp, WeChat, and email, ideally within the same working day.
* Explain our IGCSE, IB, and admissions programmes clearly and recommend the right fit for each student.
* Match students with suitable tutors and mentors, and arrange trial lessons and consultations.
* Track every enquiry through to enrolment and follow up with families who have not yet decided.

*2. Student Follow-Up & Parent Relations*

* Check in regularly with enrolled students and parents on progress, attendance, and any concerns.
* Collect lesson feedback from students and tutors, and deal with issues early before they become complaints.
* Arrange class schedules, replacement lessons, and changes with tutors and families.
* Keep parents informed ahead of key moments: exam periods, predicted grades, application deadlines, and results day.
* Follow up on renewals and next-stage programmes (e.g. IGCSE to IB, IB to university applications).

*3. Business Operations*

* Prepare and track invoices and payments.
* Draft and manage service agreements for clients and tutors.
* Keep client records, notes, and follow-up schedules up to date.
* Keep a simple monthly record of enquiries, enrolments, and renewals for the founders.

*4. Marketing & Partnerships*

* Keep brochures, website content, and newsletters accurate and up to date.
* Work with design and digital marketing agencies on campaigns and collateral.
* Support parent seminars and events, including Mandarin-language sessions with our China school partners.
* Maintain relationships with partner schools, education consultants, and collaborators.

*We're Looking For Someone Who:*

* Has experience in a client-facing role such as education, admissions, client services, or customer service. Fresh graduates with strong communication skills are welcome to apply.
* Has excellent verbal and written communication in English and Chinese. This is required as some Chinese customers can only communicate in Chinese. Japanese and Korean are a bonus as some customers only communicate in these languages.
* Is calm, warm, and professional with high-expectation parents, and comfortable handling difficult conversations.
* Is highly organised, follows up without being reminded, and keeps clear records.
* Can manage many families and a busy inbox at the same time without losing track of details.
* Is proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), Notion or Airtable, and marketing tools (Mailchimp, Canva).
* Is comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) and light automation to streamline workflows.

*Bonus If You:*

* Have experience in the education, tuition, or admissions sector.
* Know the IB, IGCSE, or university application process (UK, US, or Singapore).
* Are familiar with WeChat or Xiaohongshu.

*Working Hours*

*Location: *545 Orchard Road, #14-06/9, Singapore 238882. In Person role.

*Start Date: *As soon as possible

*Commitment: *Full-time or part-time. Propose the days and hours that suit you in your application.

* *Full-time: *5-day work week, Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, 4 days in office and 1 day remote
* *Part-time: *Days and hours by arrangement, with enough weekday cover to keep up with daily enquiries

*Salary & Benefits*

* *Monthly Salary: *$4,500 upwards for full-time, depending on experience; pro-rated for part-time
* *Bonuses: *Additional performance and team-based bonuses apply
* *Benefits Include: *$500 Specialist Stipend per annum (e.g. medical or mental health support), $100 Dental Stipend per annum, $500 Personal Development Stipend per annum (for courses, books, conferences, etc.)

*How to Apply*

Send your CV and a short paragraph on why you're interested in the role to hr@qeducation.sg with the subject line: *Application – Communications Executive (Full Time / Part Time)*

We look forward to hearing from people who want to make a real difference to the families we work with.

Work Location: In person

title: Project Officer (Project Coordination/Event Management/Administration)
description:
Young and research-intensive, Nanyang Technological University (NTU Singapore) is ranked among the world’s top universities. The University combines technological strength with human creativity to address the significant challenges facing society, and draws its faculty and students from across the world.

The College of Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences (CoHASS) aims to be Asia’s leading centre for innovative, interdisciplinary humanities, arts and social science teaching and research. Its research priorities are Digital Culture and Society; Health, Culture and Society; Global Asia; and Art, Science and Ecology.

The Global Asia Research Centre (GARC) is a research centre within the College of Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences (CoHASS), Nanyang Technological University, Singapore. The Centre serves as a platform for interdisciplinary research and scholarly exchange on Asia and its global connections, bringing together academics, researchers, policymakers, and industry partners through research initiatives, conferences, workshops, seminars, and public engagement activities.

Through its research programmes and events, GARC facilitates dialogue on issues of regional and global significance, supports the dissemination of research findings, and fosters collaborations across institutions and disciplines.

For more information, please visit: https://www.ntu.edu.sg/hass/research/global-asia-research-centre

-

Globally ranked among top research and technology organizations in the environment and water domain, the NTU’s Nanyang Environment and Water Research Institute (NEWRI) ecosystem interacts across a multi- and inter- disciplinary platform of Research – engineering – Development (RED) activities in its approach to developing innovative solutions.

With leading edge technology and robust engineering, NEWRI strives to take its fundamental research from novel lab-scale innovation to industry-level translation and derisking activities - from field applications to piloting and development at full scale in real life settings. Through industrial and community- philanthropic projects for commercial and societal impact, NEWRI continuously strives to make a difference towards developing a circular economy for global sustainability.

For more details, please view https://www.ntu.edu.sg/newri

This is a joint appointment between the Global Asia Research Centre and the Mining Mineral Life project, housed at the Nanyang Environment and Water Research Institute (NEWRI). The Project Officer will contribute to the management and delivery of programs in the Global Asia Research Centre and the Mining Mineral Life: Extracting the Energy Transition in Southeast Asia research project. The role will be divided 60% on the Global Asia Research Centre and 40% on Mining Mineral Life. The role will be essential to the delivery of world class research programs and impact activities including organizing international conferences, seminars, fieldwork logistics.

At GARC, the candidate will join a team of the Director, the Deputy Director, and multiple Early Career Fellows. The centre also hosts Visiting Fellows and Visiting Professors.

On the Mining Mineral Life side, the candidate will join a team including the PI, two Research Fellows, and one PhD student. The team will also collaborate with artists and graphic designers on a program of scholarly and public facing artistic impact projects.

Shoot in Apple Log, then upload the raws the same day. No editing. Our team takes it from there.

Up to 2 shoots a day across Singapore.

Reliable. On time, raws uploaded the same day.

You go quiet on site and wait to be told what to do.

title: Brand Partnerships & Growth Specialist
description:
Crimson Education is the world’s leading college admissions consulting firm, with over 1,490 Ivy League offers and 2,410 to the US Top 15. We help ambitious students gain admission to the world’s top universities through expert-led guidance and proven, data-driven strategies. Crimson students are 7x more likely to get into the Ivy League than their peers. We were recently featured on the front page of the Wall Street Journal.

Crimson is the only college admissions consultancy that brings together:

Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications

Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation

Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards

Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation

We’re backed by leading VC firms, including Tiger Global, Heal Partners, IceHouse Ventures, and Movac, and recently closed a USD $40M Series D funding round at a USD $640M valuation. We now operate across 21 markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, and New Zealand.

Beyond college admissions consulting, Crimson offers a wide range of Enrichment programs designed to help students discover their interests, develop new skills, and achieve meaningful academic and extracurricular accomplishments. As we continue expanding our reach internationally, we're looking for a part-time Brand Partnerships & Growth Specialist to help introduce these programs to new audiences and strengthen their presence in key markets.

The role will initially focus on Indigo Research and Crimson Rise, two of our key Enrichment products. You’ll find creative ways to get them in front of the right students and families — whether through partnerships with leading schools and organizations, media and podcasts, creators, conferences, community placements, events, pop-ups, or other brand activations.

You’ll work closely with our marketing and leadership teams to identify opportunities others might miss and turn them into action. We’re looking for someone with strong existing networks who can open doors, generate ideas independently, and think commercially about how greater visibility can translate into audience growth, leads, and ultimately revenue.

Responsibilities include

Brand Growth & Opportunity Development

Identify creative ways to get Indigo and Rise in front of the right audiences – from media, podcasts, and creators to conferences, school and community placements, pop-ups, activations, and other unconventional opportunities.

Strengthen Indigo and Rise’s positioning across international markets, adapting ideas and messaging to local audiences while maintaining a consistent global brand.

Turn student, mentor, leadership, and company stories into compelling campaigns, content, PR, thought leadership, and other brand-building opportunities.

Develop and test creative market-specific ideas that build awareness and credibility, while considering how visibility can translate into audience growth, qualified leads, demand, and revenue.

Track results, identify what works, and recommend which channels, ideas, and initiatives we should scale.

Partnerships, Networks & Execution

Use your existing network – and continuously expand it – to open doors with journalists, creators, schools, education organizations, event organizers, companies, communities, and other influential partners.

Develop creative collaborations such as events, content partnerships, creator campaigns, webinars, competitions, community initiatives, and brand activations.

Proactively secure high-value media coverage, podcast appearances, speaking opportunities, conference placements, partnerships, and other forms of brand exposure.

Own opportunities end-to-end, from identifying the idea and making the introduction through pitching, execution, follow-up, and measuring impact.

What skills and experience you’ll need

5+ years of experience across brand marketing, partnerships, PR, growth, events, communications, or a related field.

Demonstrated experience building brands and creating growth opportunities across international markets.

An established, active network in at least one of our priority markets – the US, India, Singapore/Southeast Asia, or the Middle East – with relationships you can genuinely activate to open doors. This could include journalists, media outlets, schools, education organizations, event organizers, creators, influencers, community leaders, or other relevant partners.

A track record of independently spotting and creating opportunities – from partnerships and PR to events, creator collaborations, activations, and other forms of meaningful brand exposure.

A commercial mindset: not every brand activity needs to generate leads immediately, but you naturally think about how awareness and credibility can ultimately contribute to audience growth, demand, leads, and revenue.

Excellent written and spoken English, with strong pitching, storytelling, and communication skills.

Strong relationship-building skills and confidence approaching journalists, creators, organizations, partners, and senior external stakeholders.

Highly proactive, resourceful, and organized – you can take a broad objective, identify the right opportunity and people, and independently drive it from idea through execution.

What success looks like

Indigo and Rise become meaningfully more visible, relevant, and credible in the markets you own.

You consistently uncover opportunities we would not have found without you – new partners, creators, media, events, communities, placements, and creative ways to reach our target audiences.

Your existing network opens doors quickly, while the network you build becomes an increasingly valuable asset for Indigo and Rise.

Your initiatives generate measurable outcomes across brand awareness, audience growth, qualified leads, strategic relationships, and ultimately revenue.

You develop a clear understanding of what works in each market, learn quickly from what doesn’t, and scale the strongest ideas.

Why join us

Part-time, fully remote role with flexible working hours.

Help shape two education brands across multiple international markets.

High ownership and the freedom to turn good ideas into real campaigns, partnerships, and events.

Work with a global team of ambitious, curious people.

Please keep an eye on your spam/junk email folder for correspondence from Team Tailor.

title: Senior Marketing & Communications Specialist
description:
Overview

ENGIE is a global energy company, a leading provider of electricity, natural gas, and energy services. With 100 000 employees in more than 70 countries worldwide, ENGIE achieved revenue of €95 billion in 2023. ENGIE is committed to being a leader in the energy transition. We are looking for talented and motivated people to create the future of energy. Join a rewarding and flexible work environment that encourages innovation and creativity, and help us meet the energy challenges of today and tomorrow.

The Supply & Energy Management (S&EM) Global Business Unit covers trading and risk management activities as well as B2B and B2C supply activities across a large and highly diversified energy portfolio, including electricity, natural gas, biomass, LNG and other fuels, CO2 and environmental products

Within the S&EM Business Unit, Business Platform APAC is developing ENGIE’s trading and risk management activities across the APAC region, Middle East and India, around 4 main pillars: risk management and market access, asset management, green solutions and energy supply businesses.

Purpose

The Senior Marketing & Communications Specialist supports the development and delivery of integrated marketing and communications activities that strengthen ENGIE’s Supply & Energy Management positioning and business growth across Asia.The role serves as a regional principal Marketing and Communications focal point of contact for S&EM activities across markets in the region, including Singapore and Japan, working closely ensuring consistency of S&EM’s positioning and coordinating with the relevant Country, GBU and Group Communications teams to ensure consistent messaging, brand alignment and effective execution in accordance with the ENGIE Communications operating model. Communications accountability in individual markets remains with the respective Country Communications teams.

The role contributes to positioning ENGIE as a credible partner in energy supply, renewable energy solutions, corporate PPAs, environmental products, energy management and decarbonisation. Working with commercial, trading and business development teams, the role supports market-facing campaigns, thought leadership, customer engagement initiatives and communications materials that build visibility and enable business development.

Key Responsibilities

Business marketing and commercial support: Support the planning and execution of marketing and communications activities aligned with S&EM growth objectives; work with commercial and business development teams to develop customer-facing materials; and prepare sales-enablement content, presentations, business profiles and solution collateral.

Thought leadership and market positioning: Support and in the development of markets relevant to S&EM’s regional activities and client coverage market insights, executive viewpoints, case studies, industry articles and customer success stories; work with subject matter experts to translate complex market and trading topics into clear, engaging content for customers and internal stakeholders.

External communications and reputation: Support proactive communications activities linked to S&EM business priorities; draft and coordinate media materials, press releases, industry submissions and external messaging; monitor relevant industry developments and support issues management preparation when required.

Digital marketing and content: Manage and produce content for websites, LinkedIn and other relevant channels; maintain an S&EM editorial calendar aligned to commercial priorities; develop campaign assets, newsletters, infographics, videos and presentations; and track engagement and campaign performance indicators.

Events and customer engagement: Coordinate communications and marketing support for industry conferences, customer forums, webinars, roundtables and trade exhibitions; prepare event content, key messages and engagement materials; and support regional customer engagement initiatives.

Internal communications: Prepare internal communications materials that build awareness of S&EM’s activities, products and capabilities across ENGIE; support leadership communications, employee engagement content and regional announcements.

Brand and governance: Ensure communications and marketing materials follow ENGIE brand standards; coordinate with ENGIE Group and regional communications teams; and apply established communications review and approval processes.

Qualifications, skills and experience

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Public Relations, Journalism or a related discipline.

Professional communications, digital marketing or brand-related certification would be advantageous.

Technical Skills & Experience

4 years’ experience in B2B marketing, communications, corporate affairs, digital marketing or a related field.

Exposure to power, utilities, energy trading, renewable energy, sustainability, infrastructure or related sectors would be advantageous.

Good understanding of commercial marketing, customer engagement and business development support.

Experience assisting with thought leadership content, digital campaigns, customer-facing communications materials and executive presentations.

Strong writing, editing, messaging and storytelling capability, with the ability to simplify technical energy and market topics for different audiences.

Ability to coordinate with stakeholders across commercial, trading, leadership, communications and regional teams.

Competencies

Clear communication and business partnering mindset.

Commercial awareness and ability to connect marketing activities to business priorities.

Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

Creativity, curiosity and ability to develop compelling market-facing narratives.

High attention to detail, brand discipline and governance mindset.

Ability to work independently while seeking alignment in a regional, matrixed environment.

ENGIE Energy Marketing Singapore Pte Ltd

ENGIE Energy Marketing Singapore Pte Ltd is the LNG trading platform at the heart of ENGIE, a global energy player in the three businesses of gas, power and energy services, and a comprehensive presence throughout the energy value chain.

Combining in-depth industry experience and financial-market know-how, we serve with LNG solutions all ENGIE business activities worldwide and trade LNG with third parties, from upstream producers to downstream utilities.

ENGIE Energy Marketing Singapore Pte Ltd also has a local presence in Europe (Paris, London, and Madrid).

Unequivocally client-focused, we bring the best of both worlds – energy and trading – to our business partners, be they within the Group or external customers.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Kiztopia Group is a leading family edutainment and active entertainment business dedicated to creating meaningful, engaging experiences through play, exploration and movement.

With multiple concepts and locations across Singapore and the region, we continue to grow our portfolio through innovation, creativity and a commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences.

Our established Kiztopia brand brings families together through purposeful play, while Xventure, our next-generation indoor actives ports park, introduces exciting experiences designed for older children, youths, young adults and families.

As we expand, we are looking for passionate and capable individuals to help strengthen our brands, grow our customer base and shape the future of entertainment in Singapore.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a

commercially driven, creative and hands-on Marketing Manager

to lead the marketing strategy, planning and execution for Kiztopia Group's Singapore businesses, including Kiztopia and Xventure.

You will take ownership of integrated marketing initiatives that strengthen brand positioning, increase customer acquisition, drive visitorship and contribute to business growth.

This role requires someone who can translate business objectives into actionable marketing strategies, balance brand-building with performance marketing, and lead campaigns from concept through execution and performance evaluation.

You will manage marketing budgets, guide team members, coordinate external agencies and work closely with Commercial, Operations and other stakeholders to deliver results.

We are looking for a well-rounded marketing leader who is equally comfortable developing strategy, analysing performance and getting involved in execution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketing Strategy & Business Growth

Develop and lead integrated marketing strategies for Kiztopia and Xventure, aligned with brand positioning, commercial objectives and business priorities.

Translate revenue targets, visitorship goals and customer acquisition objectives into actionable monthly, quarterly and annual marketing plans.

Develop targeted strategies for different customer segments, including families, children, youths, young adults, schools and relevant community groups.

Identify opportunities to drive ticket sales, increase repeat visits, build brand loyalty and strengthen customer lifetime value.

Plan and manage campaigns across business-as-usual operations, seasonal peaks, new outlet launches and special events.

Monitor consumer trends, competitor activities and market opportunities to keep our brands relevant and competitive.

2. Integrated Campaign Management

Lead end-to-end planning and execution of marketing campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels.

Develop clear campaign objectives, audience targeting, promotional mechanics, timelines, budgets and measurable KPIs.

Oversee campaign delivery across social media, digital advertising, CRM, website, partnerships, PR and on-ground activations.

Establish effective customer journeys from awareness and engagement through to ticket purchase and repeat visits.

Ensure campaigns are delivered on time, within budget and aligned with business objectives.

Review campaign effectiveness and refine strategies based on performance data and customer response.

3. Digital Marketing & Performance Management

Lead digital marketing strategies across platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok and other relevant channels.

Manage advertising budgets and optimise resource allocation based on campaign objectives and performance.

Oversee audience segmentation, retargeting, conversion campaigns and relevant testing initiatives.

Monitor key performance indicators such as reach, engagement, website traffic, acquisition cost, conversions and attributable revenue.

Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency, conversion rates and return on marketing investment.

Work with relevant stakeholders to improve website, booking and ticketing conversion journeys.

4. Brand, Social Media & Content Strategy

Own the overall brand marketing direction and ensure consistent positioning across campaigns and communication channels.

Develop differentiated content and communication strategies for Kiztopia and Xventure based on their respective target audiences.

Lead social media planning across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and other relevant platforms.

Guide the development of engaging content, including short-form videos, attraction highlights, promotional campaigns, customer experiences and community-driven content.

Review creative concepts, campaign messaging and marketing assets to ensure brand consistency and audience relevance.

Identify emerging content formats, cultural trends and creative opportunities that can strengthen organic reach and brand visibility.

Work closely with the marketing team, content creators and external agencies to deliver relevant, high-quality content.

5. Customer Engagement, CRM & Retention

Develop CRM and customer engagement strategies to encourage repeat visits, strengthen relationships and drive incremental revenue.

Oversee segmented email marketing, WhatsApp campaigns and other customer communications.

Identify opportunities for cross-promotion between Kiztopia, Xventure and other relevant business concepts.

Develop targeted campaigns around school holidays, birthdays, memberships, special occasions and customer engagement opportunities.

Review customer engagement and campaign data to identify opportunities for improved targeting and retention.

6. Partnerships, Events & Brand Activations

Collaborate with mall partners, ticketing platforms, community groups, schools, influencers and external partners on marketing initiatives.

Work closely with Commercial and Operations teams to support new outlet launches, grand openings, events and promotional activations.

Develop marketing initiatives that build awareness, generate publicity and encourage customer participation.

Identify and evaluate potential partnerships based on audience relevance, commercial value and expected marketing exposure.

Manage external agencies and vendors, ensuring clear deliverables, timelines, quality standards and value for money.

7. Budget, Reporting & Performance Accountability

Develop, manage and monitor marketing budgets across brands, campaigns and channels.

Track campaign performance against marketing KPIs and business objectives.

Prepare weekly marketing performance updates and monthly management reports covering key results, budget utilisation, insights and recommended actions.

Evaluate campaign effectiveness beyond engagement metrics, with emphasis on measurable business outcomes.

Identify underperforming initiatives early and recommend practical corrective actions.

Maintain clear marketing plans, campaign trackers, budgets and reporting frameworks.

8. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Lead, coach and develop the Singapore marketing team, establishing clear priorities, ownership and performance expectations.

Delegate effectively while remaining hands-on when required by business priorities.

Establish efficient workflows for campaign planning, creative production, approvals, execution and reporting.

Work collaboratively with Operations, Commercial, Partnerships, Sales and regional stakeholders.

Ensure marketing campaigns and promotions are communicated clearly to frontline teams and are operationally executable.

Foster a culture of accountability, creativity, initiative and continuous improvement.

REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Minimum 5 years of relevant marketing experience, with demonstrated ownership of integrated marketing campaigns and experience leading projects or team members.

Strong understanding of digital marketing, performance advertising, social media, CRM and integrated campaign management.

Proven ability to develop actionable marketing plans and manage campaigns from strategy to execution.

Commercially minded, with the ability to interpret campaign performance and connect marketing activities to business outcomes.

Experience managing marketing budgets, external agencies and multiple concurrent campaigns.

Strong leadership, project management, communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

Proactive, resourceful and comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Creative and analytical, with the ability to balance brand development and performance-driven marketing.

Willingness to take a hands-on approach and support execution where necessary.

ADDED ADVANTAGES

Experience in attractions, entertainment, family-oriented businesses, lifestyle, leisure, retail, hospitality or other consumer-facing industries.

Experience managing multiple brands, business locations or new product launches.

Familiarity with online ticketing platforms, e-commerce conversion and customer acquisition campaigns.

Knowledge of SEO, Google Analytics, marketing automation or relevant CRM tools.

Experience in influencer marketing, community engagement, experiential marketing or event activations.

Hands-on content creation, photography or video editing experience.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Clear, executable marketing plans aligned with commercial and brand objectives.

Improved brand visibility, customer engagement and qualified traffic.

Measurable contribution to customer acquisition, ticket sales, visitorship and repeat visits.

Effective utilisation of marketing budgets and continuous campaign optimisation.

Consistent delivery of high-quality campaigns across Kiztopia and Xventure.

A well-organised, accountable marketing team capable of executing independently.

WHY JOIN US?

Lead marketing for two exciting entertainment brands with distinct growth opportunities.

Play a meaningful role in new brand development, outlet launches and business expansion.

Take ownership of marketing initiatives with direct visibility into business performance.

Work in a dynamic, entrepreneurial and collaborative environment.

Grow professionally within an expanding regional entertainment group.

If you enjoy building brands, developing creative campaigns and turning marketing ideas into measurable results, we would love to hear from you.

Kiztopia is Singapore's mega-indoor kids' edutainment playgrond centre for families to enjoy endless fun and have a unique "Play, Learn, Eat and Bond" experience. Warm, inviting and family-oriented environments with specially designed play areas to support holistic development of children.

title: Program Origination & Marketing Manager
description:
Company Overview

The Singapore Mint, established in 1968, has evolved into a leading innovative mint producing high-quality coins, medallions, and collectibles. It combines advanced technology with skilled craftsmanship and serves both local and international markets.

Job Summary

The Manager, Programme Origination leads the team to develop and execute commemorative coin and collectible product programmes, owning strategy, marketing, delivery, and P&L to achieve commercial and performance targets.

Responsibilities

Lead and manage the Programme Origination team to deliver product programmes that meet yearly margin targets and enhance team capabilities in a dynamic environment

Plan, execute, and review programmes managing scope, schedule, budget, quality, launch readiness, risks, and post-launch performance

Conduct market research to identify trends and originate differentiated product concepts that enhance brand equity

Oversee marketing and communications plans, including product storytelling, campaign briefs, sales enablement materials, and channel support across retail, e-commerce, corporate sales, and digital platforms

Coordinate internal teams across programme origination, marketing, sales, design, production, and operations to ensure aligned delivery and accountability

Manage external contractors, agencies, vendors, and partners to deliver quality, cost, timelines, messaging, and brand standards

Monitor programme KPIs and P&L, track sales, margin, and engagement targets, and implement timely corrective actions

Provide accurate programme reporting, documentation, and management updates

Recommend programme concepts, timelines, budget allocations, go-to-market requirements, and risk mitigation or performance improvement actions

Influence cross-functional delivery across marketing, production, operations, sales, and external partners to ensure cohesive execution

The Singapore Mint was established in 1968 to mint circulation coins for the newly-independent nation. Over the years, The Singapore Mint has evolved from a basic minting facility to a fully integrated business operation, comprising programme concept, product design, marketing, sales and distribution with after sales service. Focusing on quality system and standards, The Singapore Mint is a certified ISO 9001 and 14001 organisation. Today, it has grown to become one of the leading innovative mints in the industry, capable of producing coins and medallions of the highest quality.

Leveraging on technology, The Singapore Mint has developed hybrid techniques to create high security and innovative features on circulation and commemorative coins and collectables. Fusing advanced minting technologies with authentic crafting methods, The Singapore Mint is one of the few mints in the world that still maintains a team of highly skilled craftsmen, adding intricate elements that can only be meticulously achieved by the human touch.

As a testament of its high quality crafting techniques, The Singapore Mint has won multiple international awards and its rising stature has garnered much interest internationally. The mint has been appointed by issuing authorities around the world for the production of their coins.

Other than producing coins and medallions, The Singapore Mint has also expanded to provide quality currency-related gifts and collectibles, lifestyle products and services to both local and international markets. We continue to pledge our unwavering commitment to our customers, business associates and partners to offer the best in quality, value and service.

The Singapore Mint (Singapore Precision Industries Pte Ltd) is a fully owned subsidiary of Sembcorp Industries.

in Brand Protection, corporate or supply-chain security, investigations, Customs or law enforcement, or closely related industry engagement roles.

Direct responsibility for managing external stakeholder relationships

, together with the ability to engage logistics and supply-chain stakeholders credibly.

Direct experience across

at least two

Brand Owners, LSPs, Customs/LEAs

.

We welcome applications from experienced professionals who are passionate about brand protection, industry collaboration, and strengthening supply chain security across Asia Pacific.

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV, together with a brief summary of their relevant experience, particularly any prior engagement with brand owners, LEAs, customs authorities, and regional industry programmes.

Please describe stakeholder relationships without disclosing confidential information.
