Subject:

Application – Brand Protection Lead, APAC

Website:

TAPA APAC

Shortlisting will focus on demonstrated domain experience, stakeholder credibility and evidence of delivery.

The Leading Association for Global Supply Chain Resilience & Sustainability

The Transported Asset Protection Association (TAPA) is the leading global association that unites supply chain industry leaders and organizations with the common aim of upholding the highest standards of supply chain resilience and sustainability.

Today, in Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA), The Americas and Asia Pacific (APAC), TAPA’s membership is at its highest ever level – and growing month-on-month. The Association’s members include many of the world’s leading manufacturing brands as well as their logistics and transport providers with combined annual sales of over US$900 billion.

At Asia Pacific, TAPA APAC is the fastest growing supply chain community of over 1000 member companies, government agencies and custom partners in the region.

TAPA APAC members include:

Manufacturers & Shippers;

Logistic Service Providers;

Security Service Providers;

Insurance Providers;

Parking Place Operators;

Independent Audit Bodies;

Law Enforcement Agencies, Government Entities & Customs Partners;

Academic Partners and others.

Mission

To minimize cargo losses from the supply chain. TAPA achieves this through the development and application of global security standards, recognized industry practices, technology, education, benchmarking, regulatory collaboration, and the proactive identification of crime trends and supply chain security threats

Vision

TAPA’s vision is an international supply chain where controlled and traceable product can be transported in a cost efficient and secure environment.

· Run regular website performance reviews and recommend improvements, including A/B testing of landing pages, forms and calls-to-action.

· Create and manage campaign landing pages and enquiry forms, ensuring they are tracked and integrated with CRM or enquiry-handling processes where applicable.

· Work with IT and external vendors on hosting, security, backups, domain/SSL renewals, PDPA-compliant cookie consent, and troubleshooting.

· Produce high-quality digital content for web, social media, email and online campaigns on a consistent publishing schedule.

· Design graphics, infographics, social media posts, banners, e-brochures, e-posters, digital invitations, and presentation materials (e.g., Canva, Adobe Creative Suite).

· Write and edit website copy, blog articles, patient education content, newsletters, captions, and press or announcement content.

Digital Campaigns & Social Media

Event & Outreach Digital Support

· Create digital promotional materials for events, talks, workshops, and outreach activities (e-invites, banners, registration pages, countdown posts).

· Manage online registration forms and event landing pages.

· Provide live social media coverage and post-event content (recaps, photo albums, highlight videos).

Requirements

· Prior experience in digital marketing or content creation (healthcare experience is a plus).

· Hands-on experience with a CMS (WordPress preferred) and basic HTML/CSS knowledge.

· Organised and able to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

· Strong writing, communication, and creative skills.

campaigns that align with Mondrian Singapore’s brand tone and objectives.

description:
*Communications Executive (Compassionate Leave Cover 6 months)*

*1. JOB DESCRIPTION*

Job Title

Communications Executive (Compassionate Leave Cover 6 months)

Occupation

MARKETING COMMUNICATIONS EXECUTIVE

Job Description & Requirements

We're Hiring: Communications Executive

Quintessential Education | Full-Time or Part-Time | Orchard Road, Singapore

About QE

Quintessential Education is Singapore's leading provider of pre-tertiary academic programmes (IGCSE & IB) and university admissions advisory for top-tier global universities — Ivy League, Oxbridge, and NUS/NTU/SMU. Since 2012 we have worked with more than 700 students, and most of our new families come to us through referrals. We deliver a fully integrated journey for families: academic mastery, guardianship, and university placement under one roof.

We aim to bring out the best in our students, ignite opportunities and nurture them towards success.

We are looking for committed and talented additions to our team. As an ideal candidate, you should display a proven ability to develop and maintain an environment of trust, diversity, and inclusion within the QE team. You should be able to work with the team to meet deadlines and instill a culture of continuous work improvement.

As part of the position, you will work with the founders, Ivy League and Oxbridge graduates and other high-performing teammates.

The Role

We're looking for a Communications Executive to own the day-to-day relationship between QE and our families. You'll be the first person a parent speaks to when they enquire, and the person who keeps them informed once their child is with us. That means answering enquiries every day, matching students with the right tutors and mentors, and following up with students and parents regularly so nothing slips through.

You'll also help keep our marketing materials and partner relationships in good order. We are open to full-time or part-time candidates, so tell us the arrangement that works for you.

If you're a confident communicator in both English and Mandarin\*, stay calm and warm with demanding parents, and like being the person who makes sure things actually get done — we'd love to meet you.

This is a temporary role for 6 months to cover a colleague on leave for 4-6 months. If desired, conversion to full time permanent can be discussed closer from the 5-6th month onwards.

\*As a major group of customers are from China and are only able to converse in Mandarin.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Enquiries & Enrolment

* Respond to daily parent and student enquiries via phone, WhatsApp, WeChat, and email, ideally within the same working day.
* Explain our IGCSE, IB, and admissions programmes clearly and recommend the right fit for each student.
* Match students with suitable tutors and mentors, and arrange trial lessons and consultations.
* Track every enquiry through to enrolment and follow up with families who have not yet decided.

2. Student Follow-Up & Parent Relations

* Check in regularly with enrolled students and parents on progress, attendance, and any concerns.
* Collect lesson feedback from students and tutors, and deal with issues early before they become complaints.
* Arrange class schedules, replacement lessons, and changes with tutors and families.
* Keep parents informed ahead of key moments: exam periods, predicted grades, application deadlines, and results day.
* Follow up on renewals and next-stage programmes (e.g. IGCSE to IB, IB to university applications).

3. Business Operations

* Prepare and track invoices and payments.
* Draft and manage service agreements for clients and tutors.
* Keep client records, notes, and follow-up schedules up to date.
* Keep a simple monthly record of enquiries, enrolments, and renewals for the founders.

4. Marketing & Partnerships

* Keep brochures, website content, and newsletters accurate and up to date.
* Work with design and digital marketing agencies on campaigns and collateral.
* Support parent seminars and events, including Mandarin-language sessions with our China school partners.
* Maintain relationships with partner schools, education consultants, and collaborators.

We're Looking For Someone Who:

* Has experience in a client-facing role such as education, admissions, client services, or customer service. Fresh graduates with strong communication skills are welcome to apply.
* Has excellent verbal and written communication in English and Chinese. This is required as some Chinese customers can only communicate in Chinese. Japanese and Korean are a bonus as some customers only communicate in these languages.
* Is calm, warm, and professional with high-expectation parents, and comfortable handling difficult conversations.
* Is highly organised, follows up without being reminded, and keeps clear records.
* Can manage many families and a busy inbox at the same time without losing track of details.
* Is proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), Notion or Airtable, and marketing tools (Mailchimp, Canva).
* Is comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) and light automation to streamline workflows.

Bonus If You:

* Have experience in the education, tuition, or admissions sector.
* Know the IB, IGCSE, or university application process (UK, US, or Singapore).
* Are familiar with WeChat or Xiaohongshu.

Working Hours

Location: 545 Orchard Road, #14-06/9, Singapore 238882. In Person role.

Start Date: As soon as possible

Commitment: Full-time or part-time. Propose the days and hours that suit you in your application.

* Full-time: 5-day work week, Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, 4 days in office and 1 day remote
* Part-time: Days and hours by arrangement, with enough weekday cover to keep up with daily enquiries

Salary & Benefits

* Monthly Salary: $4,500 upwards for full-time, depending on experience; pro-rated for part-time

* Benefits Include: $500 Specialist Stipend per annum (e.g. medical or mental health support), $100 Dental Stipend per annum, $500 Personal Development Stipend per annum (for courses, books, conferences, etc.)

How to Apply

Send your CV and a short paragraph on why you're interested in the role to hr@qeducation.sg with the subject line: Application – Communications Executive (Full Time / Part Time)

title: Manager, Exhibitor Marketing & Buyer Programmes
description:
The Manager, Exhibitor Marketing & Buyer Programmes leads exhibitor-facing marketing and high-value buyer programmes across IAPL’s portfolio of shows.

The role supports exhibitor recruitment and retention through year-round marketing campaigns, while also taking ownership of hosted and high-value buyer acquisition, matchmaking and guaranteed meeting programmes that directly contribute to the value delivered to exhibitors.

The position works across InfoComm India and InfoComm Asia, as well as international buyer recruitment for InfoComm China. As a team member working closely with the Sales team, the role connects exhibitor requirements with qualified buyer acquisition and helps demonstrate measurable return on investment to exhibitors.

For InfoComm Asia, the role will work closely with the Senior Marketing Manager, who owns the overall visitor and audience strategy, with this position specifically responsible for the hosted and high-value buyer segment.

*KEY INDUSTRIES*

* Professional audiovisual and integrated experiential communications technology
* Emerging technologies including AI, IoT, 5G, AR/VR/MR, Big Data Analytics, Drones, Robotics, Content Development (Software), Wearables and Cloud Applications

*OVERALL RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES*

*Exhibitor Marketing*

* Lead and execute year-round exhibitor marketing campaigns that support exhibitor recruitment, retention and rebooking across IAPL’s portfolio of shows.
* Achieve agreed sales-accepted lead targets for exhibitor recruitment and provide Sales with a consistent pipeline of qualified prospects.
* Develop exhibitor-facing marketing materials including sector collateral, sales prospectuses, case studies, testimonials and ROI evidence that support the Sales team in converting prospects.
* Own exhibitor communications across the pre-show, onsite and post-show journey, ensuring communications are timely, accurate and relevant.
* Develop campaigns that demonstrate the business value and ROI of participating in IAPL’s exhibitions.
* Develop co-marketing and advocacy programmes with exhibitors to extend buyer reach.
* Support exhibitor retention and rebooking activities through post-show communications, performance reporting and ROI evidence.
* Work closely with Sales to understand exhibitor requirements, market feedback and commercial priorities.

*High-Value & Hosted Buyer Acquisition*

* Own and deliver hosted and high-value buyer acquisition programmes against agreed recruitment, attendance and quality targets.
* Source, identify and qualify senior decision-makers, buyers, specifiers and other high-value attendees relevant to the exhibitor mix.
* Manage the complete buyer journey including sourcing, qualification, invitation, confirmation, communications, attendance and onsite experience.
* Lead overseas hosted and local high-value strategic buyer programmes for InfoComm India and InfoComm Asia.
* Recruit and manage international buyers attending InfoComm China in collaboration with the China marketing team.
* Develop qualification criteria to ensure buyer profiles meet agreed programme requirements and are relevant to participating exhibitors.
* Monitor buyer registration and confirmation pipelines, identify potential shortfalls early and implement corrective actions.
* Manage buyer attendance and no-show rates to maximise programme effectiveness.

*Matchmaking & Guaranteed Meetings*

* Design, manage and deliver exhibitor–buyer matchmaking and guaranteed meeting programmes against commitments sold to exhibitors.
* Work closely with Sales to understand contractual meeting commitments and exhibitor buyer-profile requirements.
* Match qualified buyers with relevant exhibitors based on purchasing requirements, product interests, industry sector and other agreed criteria.
* Track scheduled and completed meetings against targets and contractual commitments.
* Identify potential meeting shortfalls early and work with Sales and relevant teams to implement corrective actions.
* Ensure accurate records are maintained for scheduled, completed, cancelled and no-show meetings.
* Collect feedback from exhibitors and buyers to continuously improve the matchmaking programme.

*Agency, Vendor & Programme Management*

* Manage buyer acquisition agencies, matchmaking platforms and event vendors against agreed scope, budget, timeline and performance targets.
* Establish clear KPIs and deliverables for external agencies and vendors.
* Monitor agency performance including buyer quality, attendance, cost per qualified buyer and delivery against contracted targets.
* Ensure external expenditure remains within approved budgets and flag potential variances in a timely manner.
* Evaluate vendor and agency effectiveness following each show and recommend improvements for future cycles.

*Sponsorship Delivery & Fulfilment*

* Coordinate with Sales, Operations and Marketing to ensure marketing-related sponsorship and exhibitor deliverables are fulfilled as contracted.
* Maintain clear records of relevant exhibitor and sponsorship commitments and monitor delivery status.
* Work with Sales to ensure that buyer and matchmaking commitments sold to exhibitors are understood and appropriately delivered.
* Support onsite delivery of hosted buyer, matchmaking and exhibitor programmes.
* Produce post-show exhibitor ROI reporting jointly with Sales.
* Contribute to exhibitor NPS, satisfaction and rebooking initiatives.

*Data, CRM & Reporting*

* Maintain high-value buyer information within CRM and marketing automation platforms.
* Use CRM data to segment, target and track buyer campaigns.
* Provide timely updates on exhibitor lead generation, buyer recruitment pipeline, confirmed buyers, meeting volumes and overall programme status.
* Track campaign and programme performance against agreed KPIs.
* Analyse buyer profiles, attendance, meeting completion and exhibitor feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Produce post-show analysis covering buyer performance, matchmaking results, exhibitor engagement and programme effectiveness.
* Maintain high standards of data quality and accuracy across buyer databases.

*Collaboration*

* Work closely with Sales on B2B/exhibitor promotion, marketing priorities, buyer requirements, contractual commitments and post-show reporting.
* Work with the Show Marketing Managers across shows to ensure high-value and hosted buyer programmes are aligned with the overall audience strategy.
* Work closely with Operations on onsite buyer and sponsor delivery.
* Contribute to marketing campaigns across IAPL’s three expos and work with counterpart teams across the wider global show portfolio.
* Maintain awareness of industry trends, key market players, buyer requirements and competing regional events.

*EXPERIENCE & ATTRIBUTES*

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in B2B sales/marketing, exhibition marketing, buyer acquisition, event marketing, exhibition sales support or a related field.
* At least 2 years of experience leading campaigns, programmes or projects with measurable targets.
* Experience in hosted buyer, delegate acquisition, audience acquisition or exhibitor–buyer matchmaking programmes is highly preferred.
* Experience within trade exhibitions, conferences, B2B events or related industries would be a strong advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to manage external agencies, vendors and programme partners.
* Commercially aware and comfortable working with targets, budgets and performance data.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills with the ability to monitor buyer pipelines, conversion rates and programme performance.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to achieve and exceed buyer and lead-generation targets.
* Dependable with strong follow-through on commitments made to exhibitors and internal stakeholders.
* Highly organised with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple programmes simultaneously.
* Experienced with marketing automation and CRM platforms such as HubSpot or equivalent, and confident working with database segmentation, data quality and analysis.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and customer service skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.

description:

​*Key Responsibilities*

​Manage, grow, and maintain active presence across key social platforms, primarily TikTok (TT), Xiaohongshu (XHS), Instagram (IG), and Facebook (FB).

​3. Influencer & KOL Engagement

​Track and evaluate the performance of influencer collaborations.

​4. Event Coordination & On-Ground Support

​Support the planning, promotion, and execution of precinct events (e.g., Mid-Autumn Festival, Chinese New Year, and events markets).

​Provide live on-ground social media coverage (IG Stories & short clips) during key events and activations.

​Coordinate with external vendors, stakeholders, and tenants to ensure smooth campaign delivery.

​*Requirements & Qualifications*

​Experience: 2–3 years of experience in digital marketing, content creation, social media management, or event execution.

Creative, strategic thinker with strong project management skills

Fast & independent worker with strong organization ability with attention to details.

​*Technical Skills:*

​Proficient in Adobe Illustrator and Canva for visual graphics design, wix /wordpress for website.

​Proficient in CapCut (or equivalent mobile/desktop editing software) for short-form video creation.

​Platform Expertise: Well-versed with audience trends, algorithms, and best practices on TikTok, Xiaohongshu (XHS), Instagram, and Facebook.

​Influencer Marketing: Proven experience in managing influencer/KOL outreach, campaign execution, and relationship management.

​Language & Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in Mandarin is a strong advantage (to effectively engage with local stakeholders, merchants, and social media agencies).

5.5 day work alternate week and willing to work on weekend during events.

title: Social Media Executive
description:
ABOUT MODERN WEALTH ACADEMY

Modern Wealth Academy is a Singapore-based education company. We create educational content and support classes, workshops and community activities.

We are hiring ONE full-time Social Media Executive. Monthly salary: S$2,300 to S$2,800, depending on skills and relevant experience. Fresh polytechnic graduates are welcome. School, internship and personal projects are accepted as portfolio evidence.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Plan content calendars for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and LinkedIn.

- Research ideas, write hooks and scripts, film footage and edit Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts.

- Create captions, simple graphics, carousels, stories and thumbnails.

- Repurpose classes, webinars, interviews and longer videos into short content.

- Capture workshops, events, testimonials and behind-the-scenes content with the founder, trainers, students and team.

- Publish approved content, monitor interactions, route enquiries and review performance.

- Learn and use AI tools to improve productivity while checking output quality and accuracy.

- Grow into leading defined content projects from planning through production, publishing and review.

WHAT YOU SHOULD BRING

- Basic skills in filming, editing, writing, simple design, planning, publishing and social media analytics.

- Ability to use an editing tool such as CapCut, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve and a design tool such as Canva, or equivalent tools. You do not need every tool listed.

- Initiative: research solutions, suggest ideas and make progress without instructions at every step.

- Independent learning, attention to detail, clear communication and willingness to apply feedback.

- Ownership of deadlines, progress updates and early escalation of problems.

- Openness to learning AI tools. Existing AI expertise is useful but not required.

WORK ARRANGEMENTS

Office: 10 Ubi Crescent, #05-49 Lobby C, Ubi Techpark, Singapore 408564. Remote work is by agreement with the manager. Classes, shoots and events may be at other Singapore locations.

Five working days and 40 working hours weekly, scheduled across Monday to Sunday according to operational needs. Start and finish times are flexible and arranged with the manager. Working days may include weekends and evening event coverage. One rest day and one additional non-working day are scheduled each week and communicated in advance. Selected travel requires prior agreement; appearing in company content may form part of the role.

Content must meet brand and accuracy standards, including internal approval of financial, investment, income and student-result claims.

Bring basic skills when you join and become increasingly independent as you learn our business and standards.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through MyCareersFuture with your CV, links to two or three work samples, expected salary and earliest start date. Explain your personal contribution to each sample. School and personal projects are welcome. Include a brief example of a skill you taught yourself and how you used it to complete a project. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a practical assessment and interview.

description:

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

 Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

 We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

Why join

Help shape how OCBC engages, inspires, and connects with current and future talent. As an HR Marketing & Communications Intern, you'll be part of a team that brings our employer brand to life through compelling content, digital campaigns, employee engagement initiatives, and internal communications. You'll have the opportunity to develop your skills in marketing, storytelling, content creation, and event management while contributing to initiatives that strengthen OCBC's culture and employee experience.

How you succeed

To excel in this role, you'll need to be creative, detail-oriented, and passionate about communications and branding. You'll work closely with stakeholders across Human Resources to create engaging content, support digital marketing efforts, and deliver impactful employee engagement initiatives. Your ability to communicate effectively, think creatively, and manage multiple projects simultaneously will help you drive meaningful engagement across a variety of audiences.

What you do

Your responsibilities will include:

Employer Branding: support initiatives that strengthen OCBC's employer brand across internal and external platforms
Content Creation: develop engaging content for recruitment campaigns, employer branding initiatives, learning and development programmes, and employee engagement activities
Recruitment Marketing: assist in crafting messaging and content for recruitment advertisements, talent attraction campaigns, and hiring initiatives
Digital Media Production: support the planning and creative direction of photography, videography, and other multimedia content for HR-related communications
Social Media Management: create and manage content for social media platforms, blogs, and digital channels to enhance audience engagement
Internal Communications: assist in developing articles, newsletters, announcements, and communication materials that support organisational initiatives and employee engagement
Digital Marketing: maintain and update content across HR websites, intranet platforms, and social media channels to ensure content remains relevant and impactful
Events Management: support the planning, coordination, and execution of employee engagement events, town halls, campaigns, and other HR initiatives
Project Coordination: work with various stakeholders to manage timelines, coordinate activities, and support the successful delivery of communications and engagement projects
Ad-hoc Tasks: provide support on employer branding, communications, marketing, and engagement initiatives as assigned

Who you work with

The HR Marketing & Communications team sits within People Analytics & Engagement and plays a key role in shaping the employee and candidate experience at OCBC. You'll work alongside HR professionals, marketing specialists, designers, and business stakeholders to deliver meaningful communications and engagement initiatives that support recruitment, learning and development, culture-building, and employee experience across the organisation.

Who you are
Open to learning and feedback
Strong interest in marketing, communications, employer branding, and employee engagement
Creative with an eye for detail and visual storytelling
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Comfortable creating content across different communication channels and formats
Familiarity with social media platforms and digital marketing concepts
Good organisational and project coordination skills
Able to manage multiple priorities and timelines effectively
Proactive, resourceful, and eager to learn
Able to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team
Experience in content marketing, social media management, event management, or project coordination would be advantageous
Currently pursuing an undergraduate or postgraduate degree
Available to commit to the full internship period

Learning Objectives

This internship will provide you with:

Exposure to employer branding and talent attraction strategies within a leading financial institution
Hands-on experience developing content for recruitment marketing, employee engagement, and internal communications
Opportunities to strengthen social media marketing and digital content creation skills
Exposure to employee engagement initiatives and culture-building programmes
Experience supporting end-to-end event planning and execution
Opportunities to develop stakeholder management, project coordination, and communication skills
Exposure to photography, videography, and multimedia content planning for corporate communications
Experience managing content across digital platforms, including websites, intranet platforms, newsletters, and social media channels
A deeper understanding of how employer branding, communications, and employee engagement contribute to building a strong organisational culture and employee experience
Practical experience working on impactful projects that influence how employees and candidates experience OCBC's employer brand and culture

What we offer:

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

title: Content creator
description:
Company Overview

Löyly Studio is Singapore's authentic Finnish sauna space offering traditional sauna rituals with wood-panelled saunas and cold plunges. We promote wellness through heat, cold, and stillness to reduce stress and boost longevity in a founder-led, culture-driven environment.

Job Summary

This role creates engaging short-form video content and educational copy to teach the Finnish sauna ritual, building cultural literacy and habitual sauna practice in Singapore through authentic storytelling and community engagement.

Responsibilities

Shoot and edit short-form vertical videos for Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook independently to showcase the sauna ritual

Write clear, educational captions and short copy explaining sauna practices including löyly, hot-cold cycles, vihta, rest, and etiquette

Build and maintain a digital asset library of B-roll, still photos, guest testimonials (with consent), and event coverage

Capture live moments during guided sauna sessions, community events, and partner activities to enrich content

Analyze engagement metrics such as reach, saves, watch-through rates, and profile visits to inform weekly content reviews

Participate in the sauna ritual weekly to authentically experience and communicate the practice

Required competencies and certifications

Currently enrolled in or recently completed a diploma/degree in Media, Communications, Marketing, Design, or a related field, or possess a portfolio demonstrating equivalent skills

Portfolio of self-shot and self-edited vertical videos with at least 3 links, including view/save metrics if available

Proficient written English with a calm, warm, and unhurried tone, avoiding hype and clickbait

Working knowledge of video editing tools such as CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut, or equivalents, and design tools like Canva or Figma

Comfortable with heat and cold immersion and willing to practice sauna rituals weekly

Own a phone and laptop suitable for content creation

Based in Singapore with legal right to undertake an internship

Preferred competencies and qualifications

Comfortable on camera and willing to present to the lens when the shot calls for it

Prior content work for a consumer wellness, fitness, hospitality or F&B venue, where filming happens around live guests

Working knowledge of Meta Business Suite, native TikTok/Instagram scheduling, and reading platform analytics beyond surface reach

Still photography and light retouching in natural and low light — much of our footage is shot in dim, high-humidity conditions

Basic motion graphics, subtitling and sound design

Copywriting for email or newsletter formats in addition to social captions

Genuine interest in one or more of: Nordic culture, endurance sport, longevity, sleep, or mental wellbeing

Ability to plan a monthly content calendar independently from a set of brand themes, rather than working post-by-post

Availability for evening and weekend coverage, when the studio is busiest and most of our community moments happen

Löyly Studio is a Wellness space inspired by Finnish Sauna tradition and culture.

In Finnish, löyly is the spirit of the sauna—the rising steam, the living breath of the room. To the Finns, it’s sacred. To us, it’s the perfect word for what we want Löyly Studio to be: a space where the spirit of warmth can soften the edges of daily life.

We lead a busy life, inverted work-rest cycles, reports of many people struggling with stress and anxiety and rising burnout across professionals and seniors, and growing interest in longevity and holistic fitness. The solution isn’t always more productivity, or even more exercise. It’s balance.

The kind of balance the sauna offers—a rhythm of heat, cold, and stillness proven to lower cortisol, improve circulation, and eve n boost mood. One Finnish study linked regular sauna use with reduced risk of depression. Another showed that older adults who practiced sauna bathing several times a week lived longer, healthier lives

title: Senior Marketing Executive / Assistant Manager, Marketing & Communications
description:
About the Role

OaksPlus Limited is seeking a proactive, creative and results-driven marketing professional to join our Marketing & Communications team as a Senior Marketing Executive or Assistant Manager.

This role will focus primarily on growing the visibility, brand presence and enrolment opportunities of 7oaks Preschool through integrated digital and offline marketing initiatives.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing digital marketing campaigns and agency relationships, driving social media and content strategies, overseeing website content, developing marketing communications materials and building corporate partnerships.

We are looking for someone who combines creative thinking with strong execution capabilities, is comfortable working with data and can independently drive marketing initiatives from planning through to implementation and performance evaluation.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is both a strategic thinker and a hands-on executor — someone who can translate marketing plans into well-executed campaigns and measurable outcomes.

You should be comfortable managing agencies and external partners, working with internal stakeholders, analysing campaign results and taking the initiative to improve performance.

Above all, you should have a strong sense of ownership, attention to detail and a genuine interest in building brands that connect meaningfully with families.

Key Responsibilities

1. Digital Marketing & Agency Management

Plan, coordinate and execute integrated digital marketing campaigns across platforms including Google, Meta and other relevant channels to drive brand awareness, enquiries and enrolments.

Manage external digital marketing agencies, including campaign briefs, creative development, budgets, timelines, performance reviews and optimisation.

Monitor campaign performance against agreed KPIs, including website traffic, leads, cost per lead (CPL), lead quality and enrolment conversions.

Work closely with agencies to identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness, return on investment and marketing efficiency.

Prepare regular performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.

2. Social Media & Content Management

Develop and manage social media content plans and calendars across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.

Plan and execute engaging content that showcases the preschool's curriculum, learning experiences, educators, community engagement and brand proposition.

Oversee content creation, including copywriting, graphic design, photography and short-form video production.

Coordinate content gathering with preschool centres and internal stakeholders to ensure a consistent flow of relevant and engaging content.

Monitor social media performance, audience engagement and emerging trends to continuously improve content effectiveness.

Maintain consistent brand messaging, visual identity and quality across all social media platforms.

3. Website Management & Digital Presence

Manage and maintain the 7oaks Preschool website using WordPress, ensuring content is accurate, relevant and regularly updated.

Oversee updates to website pages, campaign landing pages, blog articles, promotional content and calls to action.

Coordinate with web developers and external vendors on website enhancements, maintenance and technical issues.

Monitor website performance using tools such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console and other relevant analytics platforms.

Work with agencies and vendors to improve search engine visibility, website user experience and lead generation effectiveness.

Support ongoing website enhancement and revamp initiatives where required.

4. Marketing Communications & Brand Management

Plan and execute marketing communications initiatives across digital and offline channels, ensuring alignment with brand positioning and business objectives.

Develop and coordinate marketing collaterals, including brochures, flyers, posters, banners, digital advertisements, out-of-home (OOH) advertising and promotional materials.

Support corporate communications and internal branding requirements, including staff event collaterals, Dinner & Dance materials, annual reports, presentations and internal announcements.

Liaise with creative agencies, printers, media owners and other vendors to ensure timely and cost-effective production of marketing materials.

Maintain brand consistency across all communications touchpoints.

Support public relations, community outreach and other brand-building opportunities as required.

5. Corporate Partnerships & Community Outreach

Identify and develop corporate partnership opportunities to increase brand awareness, generate qualified leads and support preschool enrolment.

Establish and maintain relationships with companies, community organisations and other relevant partners.

Develop partnership proposals, promotional arrangements and joint marketing initiatives.

Coordinate corporate outreach activities, roadshows and partnership activations.

Track partnership activities, leads generated and outcomes to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.

6. Campaigns, Events & Performance Reporting

Plan and coordinate marketing support for preschool open houses, Discovery Days, roadshows, enrolment drives and other events.

Work closely with centre leaders and internal stakeholders to ensure marketing initiatives support centre-specific enrolment priorities.

Track marketing performance across channels, including leads, centre visit registrations, visit attendance and enrolment conversions.

Maintain campaign budgets, timelines, marketing calendars and performance reports.

Identify gaps in performance and recommend corrective actions to improve results.

Support other marketing and communications initiatives as assigned.

Requirements

title: Executive/Senior Executive, Climate and Sustainability Communications
description:
WWF-Singapore is seeking a dynamic and creative Executive/ Senior Executive, Climate Communications to support communications and engagement activities for the WWF-Singapore's climate and carbon finance programmes.

The role will support the development and delivery of compelling communications that raise awareness, engage stakeholders and showcase WWF's work in advancing climate resilience, sustainable food systems and innovative climate finance solutions across Southeast Asia.

Working closely with programme teams and WWF-Singapore's communications team, the Senior Executive will help translate complex technical topics into accessible and impactful content for diverse audiences.

Key Responsibilities

1. Communications & Content Development

Develop engaging communications materials, including articles, social media content, newsletters, presentations, infographics and other digital content.

Translate technical information on climate resilience, sustainable agriculture and carbon finance into clear and compelling narratives for different audiences.

Support the development of key messages, storytelling and communications materials that showcase WWF's climate programmes.

Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to source stories, case studies and other content.

2. Communications Campaigns & Outreach

Support the planning and execution of communications campaigns to raise the visibility of WWF-Singapore's climate initiatives.

Coordinate content publication across WWF's digital platforms, social media and partner communications channels.

Support media engagement activities, including drafting press releases, media briefs and other publicity materials.

Track communications performance and prepare updates on outreach and engagement outcomes.

3. Partner & Coalition Communications

Support communications and engagement activities for WWF Singapore’s Climate activities including related Coalitions

Develop partner-facing communications materials, including newsletters, presentations, updates and briefing documents.

Coordinate with coalition partners on joint communications, announcements and storytelling opportunities.

Support communications for stakeholder events, workshops, roundtables and regional convenings.

4. Programme & Communications Coordination

Work closely with WWF's Strategic Communications teams to ensure consistent messaging and alignment with WWF's brand and communications priorities.

Support the development and implementation of communications plans for climate programmes.

Coordinate with external vendors, designers and content creators where required.

Maintain communications calendars, content libraries and relevant reporting materials.

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, Public Relations, Environmental Studies or a related field.

2–4 years of relevant experience in communications, content development, digital marketing, public relations or related fields.

Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly and engagingly.

Experience developing content for digital platforms, social media and stakeholder communications.

Familiarity with climate change, sustainability, agriculture or environmental issues would be advantageous.

Basic graphic design, video editing or multimedia content creation skills would be an advantage.

Strong organisational and project coordination skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple assignments.

Proactive, creative and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively across teams and with external partners.

Why Join Us

Join WWF-Singapore to help tell the stories that inspire action for climate, nature and communities. You will contribute to high-impact regional initiatives, working with diverse partners to raise awareness and accelerate solutions for climate resilience, sustainable food systems and nature-positive development across Southeast Asia.

This job description covers the main tasks and conveys the spirit of the sort of tasks that are anticipated proactively from staff. Other tasks may be assigned as necessary according to organisational needs.

Interested applicants are encouraged to complete the online application form -

https://forms.cloud.microsoft/e/AD1HJvJsz9

. Priority consideration will be given to candidates who have submitted the form.

ABOUT WWF-SINGAPORE

World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF) is one of the world’s largest and most respected independent conservation organisations. WWF’s mission is to stop the degradation of Earth’s natural environment and to build
a future in which humans live in harmony with nature. As one of WWF’s international hubs, WWF-Singapore supports a global network spanning over 100 countries.

WWF-Singapore works closely with local stakeholders towards a greener and more sustainable Singapore and the region around us. We work to address key environmental concerns, such as climate change, sustainable finance, deforestation, illegal wildlife trade, species recovery, as well as sustainable production and consumption, through collaboration, education and outreach efforts involving the communities, businesses, and governments.

title: Brand Communications Manager
description:
Be the voice of one of the best-known brands in marketing.

Ahrefs helps marketers get their brands found online, in search, in AI answers and on social. Our tools run on the largest search and AI datasets on the web. We've been bootstrapped and profitable for fifteen years, with no investors and no board, and we have offices in Singapore, Tokyo, Palo Alto and Cambridge (MA).

The product has a big reputation, and we want every word around it to live up to that. Up to now, copy at Ahrefs has been something talented people do alongside their main job. We want someone for whom it is the main job.

The job

You'll be the voice of Ahrefs. You'll decide how we sound and what we say about ourselves, write much of it yourself, and get every team using it. The homepage, a banner ad, a renewal email and a booth wall should all sound like the same company. When someone here wants to know how to say something better, they'll come to you.

What you'll do
The website. Homepage, tool pages, comparison pages, ad landing pages, and the scripts for the explainer videos on them.
Campaigns. Concepts, headlines, banners and video scripts for our advertising.
Customer messages. Product emails and in-app notifications, the kind people read rather than archive.
Print and events. Brochures, flyers, and the copy on our booth walls.
The stage. Shape the message in our team's conference talks, including keynotes at Ahrefs Evolve.
Social. Work with our social media lead so a post and a landing page sound like they came from the same place.
Positioning and messaging. Decide the core story for the company and each product, write it down, and get other teams to adopt it.
You're probably right for this if
Writing copy is what you do best, and most of your career has gone into it: campaigns, websites, product emails, scripts.
You're hands-on. You'd rather write it yourself than brief someone else to. You can turn a banner headline around the same day you're halfway through a homepage rewrite, and you like having both on the go.
You can show us your work. Real, published copy, and you can tell us exactly which parts you wrote.
You know when to be funny and when to get straight to the point.
You pick up technical products quickly, and can explain them to experts without dumbing them down. You don't need to know SEO.
You've owned a brand voice or positioning before, and got teams who didn't report to you to use it.
You'll argue for a word with a CMO, and let go of the ones that don't matter.
Good to have
UX writing or product marketing experience.
Video scripts and speechwriting.
Comfortable enough in Figma or a CMS to fix your own copy in place.
Why Ahrefs?

We believe in giving smart people real ownership and not micromanaging them. You'll own how Ahrefs sounds, everywhere, and shape how millions of marketers see the brand. We value honesty, results and simple solutions over complicated ones, and you'll work with a smart, low-ego team where your words make a real difference.

Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third-party recruitment providers for the roles we hire for. If we need help, we'll let you know.

Location: Singapore, Tokyo, Palo Alto (CA) or Cambridge (MA). On-site; you'll need the right to work in the office you choose.

Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third party recruitment solutions for the roles we hire for. If at any point we need help, we'll let you know!

ABOUT US

The Hey Co Group is a homegrown Singapore F&B group founded in 2016. Over nine years we have built and scaled a portfolio of brands across quick-service, casual dining, cafe, restaurant and bar. We are not a chain. Each brand has its own identity, its own audience, and its own reason to exist — and we obsess over quality and consistency across every touchpoint, including the ones on people's screens.

Social media is where most people meet our brands for the first time. A single Reel can fill a restaurant on a quiet Tuesday. That is why this role sits at the heart of how we grow.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a creative Social Media Executive to support our Branding & Marketing Manager in bringing six distinct brands to life.

You will be the hands-on engine of our social channels — creating content and caring for our communities. You bring the ideas and the execution. The Branding & Marketing Manager brings the strategy and brand direction. Together you will make sure each brand shows up consistently, on time, and looking its best, every single week.

We are a team that embraces AI, and we want someone who uses it to create faster and think bigger — from ideation through to editing.

This is a great role for a creative, platform-native person who wants to do the work, learn fast, and see their content reach thousands of guests.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

No two days look the same. A typical week might involve shooting a new menu launch at one of our cafes in the morning, editing a batch of Reels and Stories over lunch, scheduling the week's posts, replying to a wave of comments and DMs, checking how last week's content performed, and syncing with the Branding & Marketing Manager on an upcoming campaign.

Some days are quiet and edit-heavy. Others are fast, on-location and full of energy.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Create content — shoot, edit, schedule and publish posts, Reels and Stories across our brands, following the direction and calendar set with the Branding & Marketing Manager

Shoot and edit — capture short-form video and photography in-store and on-location, quickly, with a phone and light kit

Community — reply to comments and DMs across assigned brand accounts, engage followers, and keep each brand's tone right. Escalate service issues and complaints to the relevant outlet manager promptly

Support campaigns — support the launches, seasonal menus, promotions and collaborations that the Branding & Marketing Manager plans

Paid social support — set up and boost posts across Meta and TikTok under the Branding & Marketing Manager's direction. Monitor spend and basic performance, and flag what is and is not working

Local SEO support — keep our Google Business Profiles current across outlets (hours, photos, menus, review responses) and apply keyword and caption basics so our content is easier to find

KOL coordination — coordinate influencer and food creator visits: scheduling, logistics and hosting on the day

Use AI — use AI tools to work faster and smarter: drafting captions and ideas, generating and editing images and video, researching trends, and streamlining your day to day

Report — track reach, engagement, saves and follower growth by brand, and share a simple monthly update on what is working and what is not

Consistency and ideas — keep each brand's tone, look and quality distinct and consistent, and bring fresh, on-trend ideas to the table

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

Essential:

One to three years in social media and content — F&B, hospitality, lifestyle or agency

A portfolio, showreel, or links to two or three accounts you have personally run. Applications without work samples will not be reviewed

A creative, ideas-driven eye for aesthetics, storytelling, and food that looks irresistible

Strong hands-on skills across Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, plus shooting and editing short-form video and photography

Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager at boosting and basic campaign level

Basic understanding of local SEO — keywords, captions, hashtags, and Google Business Profile management

Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Canva AI, CapCut, image and video generators) to create, ideate and work efficiently

Able to juggle several brands and deadlines without dropping quality, and to hold distinct brand voices apart rather than blending them into one

Comfortable working in live restaurant environments, including occasional evenings and weekends for shoots

A genuine love for food, hospitality, culture and people

Based in Singapore and able to travel between our outlets

Advantageous:

Basic design ability (Canva, Figma or Adobe)

Familiarity with Xiaohongshu

Written Mandarin

Experience with a multi-outlet or multi-brand group

Familiarity with the Singapore F&B and dining scene

HOW TO APPLY

Send the following to HR@theheyco.com:

Your CV

A short note on why this excites you

Links to content you have created — a portfolio, a showreel, or two to three accounts you have run, with a line on what you were responsible for

The Hey Co Group (HCG) is a Singapore-born F&B group founded in 2016. In under a decade, we've grown into a family of brands spanning — each built with the same obsession: concepts that are timeless, consistent, and genuinely good. We do not chase trends but rather market demands; we're building things that last, held together by a tight ecosystem across branding, marketing, operations, supply chain, and cost.

What makes HCG different is how we work. We move fast, we stay hands-on, and we care as much about our people as we do our product. Our teams have real ownership, direct access to leadership, and the room to grow with the group as we expand. Whether you're behind the bar, in the kitchen, running an outlet, or supporting from HQ, you're part of building something — not just clocking a shift.

We look for people who are curious, gritty, and take pride in getting the details right. If you want to learn fast, be trusted with responsibility, and grow alongside a group that's still hungry, HCG is a place to build a career — not just find a job.

title: PUBLIC RELATIONS OFFICER
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Public Relations Officer to join our team. As a Public Relations Officer, you will be responsible for managing and enhancing the public image and reputation of our organization. You will develop and execute effective communication strategies, build relationships with key stakeholders, and handle media relations. The ideal candidate has exceptional communication skills, a strong understanding of public relations principles, and the ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Responsibilities

Communication Strategy: Develop and implement comprehensive communication strategies that align with the organization's goals and objectives. Create messaging frameworks, key talking points, and press releases to effectively convey the organization's mission, initiatives, and achievements.

Media Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with media representatives, journalists, and influencers. Proactively pitch stories and secure media coverage for the organization and its events, campaigns, and milestones. Serve as the primary point of contact for media inquiries and coordinate interviews and press conferences.

Content Creation: Write, edit, and distribute compelling and engaging content for various channels, including press releases, newsletters, articles, blog posts, and social media. Ensure all content is accurate, consistent, and aligned with the organization's brand and messaging.

Crisis Management: Act as the organization's spokesperson during times of crisis or reputation management issues. Develop crisis communication plans, prepare key messaging, and manage media inquiries effectively. Mitigate potential damage to the organization's reputation and maintain transparency and trust with stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, partners, government agencies, and community organizations. Develop communication materials tailored to specific audiences and collaborate with internal teams to ensure consistent messaging across all touchpoints.

Event Planning and Management: Coordinate and oversee the planning and execution of press conferences, product launches, corporate events, and other public relations initiatives. Work closely with event organizers, vendors, and internal teams to ensure seamless execution and maximum media exposure.

Monitoring and Reporting: Monitor media coverage and public sentiment related to the organization and its industry. Prepare regular reports on media activity, campaign effectiveness, and key performance indicators. Analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

Requirements

Experience working in the entertainment and nightlife industry

Able to work on weekends and public holidays if required

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building abilities.

Knowledge of public relations principles, strategies, and best practices.

Experience in media relations, including pitching stories and handling media inquiries.

Ability to effectively manage crisis situations and handle sensitive information.

Familiarity with social media platforms and digital marketing trends.

Exceptional organizational and time management skills.

Proficiency in relevant software and tools.

Knowledge of mandarin dialect is essential as our customer base is primarily mandarin speaking

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Able to work late-night hours up to 3am, including weekends and public holidays

We offer a competitive salary, along with benefits and opportunities for professional growth. If you have a passion for public relations, a knack for storytelling, and a desire to shape and protect our organization's reputation, we invite you to apply for the position of Public Relations Officer.

title: Social Media & Content Creation Intern
description:
ABOUT US

Kiztopia is a leading family edutainment brand dedicated to creating meaningful play experiences for children and families. With multiple concepts and locations across Singapore and the region, we continue to grow through innovation, creativity, and a commitment to delivering exceptional experiences.

As part of our continued growth, we are expanding our portfolio with Xventure—our next-generation indoor active sports park designed to inspire movement, challenge and repeat play for older children, youths and families. Together, Kiztopia and Xventure reflect our commitment to creating engaging experiences that bring people together through play, exploration and active entertainment.

Join us and be part of an exciting growth journey as we shape the future of family and active entertainment across the region.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Love TikTok, Instagram Reels and creating videos that people actually want to watch?

We're looking for a

creative, energetic and hands-on Social Media & Content Creation Intern

to join our Singapore marketing team.

You will play an active role in creating engaging digital content for Kiztopia and Xventure, from brainstorming ideas and filming at our attractions to editing videos and producing social media content.

This is not just a desk-based internship. You will have opportunities to visit our attractions, capture real experiences, participate in marketing activities and see your creative work published across our official brand channels.

We welcome students, recent graduates and individuals looking to gain practical experience in social media marketing and content creation.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Content Creation & Video Production

• Brainstorm and develop creative ideas for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook and other social media platforms.

• Film engaging short-form videos featuring attractions, activities, customer experiences, events and promotional campaigns.

• Edit videos using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro or similar editing tools.

• Create attention-grabbing hooks, captions, transitions, subtitles and other visual elements.

• Assist with photography, basic graphic design and the development of creative social media assets.

• Adapt content styles to suit different audiences, from families and young children to youths and young adults.

2. Social Media & Creative Support

• Support the development and execution of social media content calendars.

• Assist in scheduling, publishing and managing social media posts.

• Research trending content formats, sounds, challenges and creative ideas relevant to our brands.

• Suggest fresh ways to showcase our attractions, experiences and promotional activities.

• Support social media campaigns, giveaways and other engagement initiatives.

• Assist with basic performance tracking and identify content that resonates with our audiences.

3. On-Ground Content & Marketing Activities

• Visit Kiztopia and Xventure outlets to capture photos, videos and promotional content.

• Assist with content coverage during new launches, events, influencer visits and marketing activations.

• Work with the marketing team to capture behind-the-scenes content, attraction highlights and customer experiences.

• Support the preparation of creative assets for campaigns and promotions.

• Coordinate basic content production requirements with relevant internal teams.

4. Creative Collaboration

• Work closely with the marketing team to turn campaign ideas into engaging visual content.

• Contribute creative ideas during content brainstorming and campaign discussions.

• Organise and maintain content files, footage and creative assets.

• Learn how content performance contributes to brand awareness, engagement and marketing objectives.

REQUIREMENTS

• Currently pursuing or recently completed studies in Marketing, Communications, Media, Film, Design or a related field, or able to demonstrate relevant practical skills.

• Strong interest in social media, digital content and emerging online trends.

•

Basic video editing skills are essential

, preferably using CapCut or similar tools.

• Comfortable filming content using a smartphone or camera.

• Creative, proactive and willing to experiment with different content formats.

• Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively.

• Organised, responsible and able to complete assigned projects within deadlines.

• Comfortable travelling to different outlets in Singapore for content shoots when required.

• Able to commit to a 3-month internship.

ADDED ADVANTAGES

• Experience creating TikTok videos, Instagram Reels or other short-form social content.

• Familiarity with Canva, Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop or other creative tools.

• Basic photography, videography, motion graphics or graphic design skills.

• Experience managing personal, school, community or business social media accounts.

• Confidence appearing on camera or directing simple video shoots.

• A personal portfolio or examples of previous content creation work.

Applicants are encouraged to share examples of videos, social media posts or creative projects they have produced. A professional portfolio is not required.

WHAT YOU WILL GAIN

• Real-world experience creating content for established and growing entertainment brands.

• Opportunities to film, edit and publish content on official brand platforms.

• Exposure to social media marketing, campaign planning, brand launches and events.

• Experience working with a professional marketing team in a fast-paced business environment.

• The opportunity to build a portfolio of creative work.

• A chance to contribute ideas and see their impact on real marketing campaigns.

JOIN US!

If you're passionate about social media, enjoy telling stories through videos and want to turn your creativity into real-world experience, we'd love to hear from you!

Apply with your resume and examples of your creative work, and be part of the Kiztopia and Xventure journey.

Kiztopia is Singapore's mega-indoor kids' edutainment playgrond centre for families to enjoy endless fun and have a unique "Play, Learn, Eat and Bond" experience. Warm, inviting and family-oriented environments with specially designed play areas to support holistic development of children.

title: Brand Director
description:
We are looking for a commercially minded Brand Director to lead brand and marketing across the Clermont Group. The role is accountable for delivering measurable business value through brand activity, including growth in awareness, preference, demand, and revenue. They will set brand strategy, including positioning and brand architecture, for Clermont and its operating companies, and ensure it is applied consistently across every market and channel. They will lead the Design team, translating strategy into high-quality creative work at pace. They must have excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders at Clermont and at our operating companies.

Responsibilities

Own brand across the Clermont Group and its contribution to growth, with accountability for brand equity, commercial performance, and return on brand investment

Define and evolve brand strategy for Clermont and its operating companies, including positioning, value propositions, and messaging

Set and maintain brand architecture for operating companies

Establish brand governance so that strategy, guidelines, and visual identity are implemented consistently across operating companies, markets, and touchpoints

Partner with operating company leaders to develop marketing plans and campaigns that support their growth objectives, and ensure execution meets Clermont’s standards

Define KPIs for brand and marketing activity, including brand health, campaign effectiveness, and return on investment, and report results to senior leadership

Translate brand strategy into clear creative briefs, and set a high bar for creative excellence across print, digital, video, and multimedia output

Lead and develop the Design team, providing end-to-end oversight of concurrent workstreams and remaining hands-on where required

Continuously evolve the function by introducing innovative tools and ways of working, including the thoughtful adoption of AI

Requirements

The successful candidate will ideally possess the following traits:

A minimum of 10 years’ experience in brand, marketing, or design

Proven experience developing brand strategy, including positioning, brand architecture, and messaging

A track record of embedding brand standards consistently across a multi-brand or multi-market organisation

Demonstrated ability to link brand and marketing activity to commercial outcomes, with experience setting and reporting on KPIs

Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to build a business case for brand and marketing investment

Exceptional creative judgement and attention to detail, with a strong critical eye for consistency and quality

Demonstrated ability to influence and manage senior stakeholders

A growth mindset, with the confidence to challenge conventions and step outside comfort zones

Professional presence and polish, appropriate for a senior leadership role

Positive, energising attitude, with the ability to inspire teams and stakeholders

Strong verbal and written communication skills

Benefits

An excellent opportunity for a commercially minded creative leader to shape the brand of an international business group that highly values design and storytelling.

Clermont Group

title: Communication and Engagement Specialist
description:

title: SVP/VP, AdTech Lead, Performance Marketing Platforms, Group Marketing & Communications
description:
Business Function:

Group Marketing & Communications is responsible for building, protecting, and enhancing the DBS brand in an increasingly commoditised banking industry. Working closely with all units within the DBS Group, we create and execute integrated strategies that focus on communications especially digital communications, marketing, and research to differentiate - and elevate - our brand from the rest of the competition.

Job Purpose

This is a hands-on product and platform leadership role, not a day-to-day campaign operations position. The successful candidate should have the technical expertise to interpret API documentation, design solutions and requirements, lead prototypes, validate integrations, and approve production solutions with Technology and Data teams.
Build and scale DBS’s in-house performance marketing platform, controls, and operating Own the AdTech product strategy, roadmap, AdTech architecture, AdOps standards, audience activation, measurement, and transition of selected repeatable media activities from agencies to DBS.
Create a hybrid operating model that reduces unnecessary agency reliance while preserving access to specialist expertise and flexible capacity.
Develop an enterprise performance marketing capability across Marketing, Data, and Technology, directly influencing platform strategy, operating standards, investment priorities, and measurable business outcomes across markets.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy and roadmap: Define the target operating model for in-house paid digital media capability, overall product strategy, target architecture, capability backlog and success measures for performance marketing platforms, AdTech and AdOps.
Platform ownership : Establish DBS-owned account, access and campaign structures across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok and approved programmatic platforms, including clear controls for agency and market access. Define automation, machine learning and AI capabilities to enable scalable, agentic media planning, audience targeting, bid optimisation, creative generation, execution and performance optimisation.
AdTech product delivery: Convert marketing needs into solution designs, API and data requirements, event schemas, acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements and production-readiness standards. Deliver the capabilities working with Technology, Data Engineering, Analytics and platform partners.
Performance creative enablement: Connect paid-media requirements with in-house creative automation by defining channel specifications, reusable templates, creative metadata, testing frameworks, asset refresh rules and governance for AI-generated content.
AdOps capability and controls : Define standards for trafficking, naming, permissions, tags, pixels, events, feeds, conversion validation, launch QA, budget controls, brand safety, incidents and change management.
Audience and signal activation: Lead the roadmap for first-party audience activation, exclusions, audience synchronization, server-side tagging, conversion APIs, enhanced and offline conversions, and media-platform feedback loops.
Measurement and optimisation: Define the conversion framework and closed-loop measurement capability covering attribution, incrementality, experimentation, automated bidding, value signals and business-outcome reporting. Own the technical requirements for signal quality (tracking, conversions, audience feeds) in partnership with Data Engineering
Hybrid operating model: Decide which repeatable activities should be operated internally, and which specialist services should remain with agencies. Establish service levels, decision rights, handoffs, scorecards and escalation paths.
Leadership and governance: Align senior stakeholders across Marketing, Technology, Data, Analytics, Risk, Legal, Procurement, markets, agencies and media platforms. Own investment cases, delivery governance and measurable outcomes.

Requirements

12+ years across performance marketing, paid media, AdTech, AdOps or digital platform product leadership, including ownership of enterprise-scale transformation and delivery.
Deep working knowledge of Google Ads and Google Marketing Platform, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, TikTok Ads and relevant programmatic platforms.
Hands-on understanding of Google Ads API, Meta Marketing API, LinkedIn Advertising API and platform authentication, permissions, account hierarchies, campaign, audience, creative, reporting and conversion services.
Working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager and server-side tagging, AppsFlyer, conversion and event APIs, enhanced and offline conversions, audience matching and customer-data or audience-activation platforms such as Tealium.
Ability to interpret API documentation, JSON payloads, event schemas, data mappings and integration logs; shape prototypes; diagnose defects; and assess implementation quality and production readiness.
Practical experience establishing or governing AdOps across account setup, campaign trafficking, access, tagging, audience onboarding, feeds, conversion validation, launch QA and operational support.
Proven leadership across Marketing, Technology, Data Engineering, Analytics, external platform or agency partners.
Strong understanding of Data Science, Machine Learning and AI product development, including model lifecycle management, experimentation frameworks, predictive marketing, recommendation systems, generative AI and agentic workflows. Experience defining requirements for AI-enabled marketing capabilities and translating business objectives into scalable data and AI solutions.
Demonstrated experience designing or materially improving an in-house or hybrid performance-media operating model, including agency transition and capability transfer.
Experience in financial services or another regulated environment is strongly preferred.
Strong command of automated bidding, signal quality, campaign architecture, attribution, incrementality, experimentation and closed-loop optimisation.
Knowledge of access governance, privacy, brand safety, media quality, change and incident controls, including governance for AI-generated advertising assets.
Product-led and outcome-oriented, with the ability to connect business goals, customer value, platform decisions and measurable results.
Technically credible without losing commercial judgement or becoming a pure engineering specialist.

Experience developing clear, compelling and brand-consistent marketing communications across retail touchpoints.
