Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

title: Director of Sales & Marketing / EAM - Sales & Marketing
description:
Summary

COME, EXPRESS YOUR ANDAZ

Join Andaz Singapore, the first Andaz hotel in Southeast Asia.

Occupying Levels 25 to 39 of the DUO Tower, Andaz Singapore is a lifestyle hotel brand by Hyatt Hotels Corporation that inspires fresh perspectives. The first Andaz property in Southeast Asia offers well-appointed guestrooms and suites, four event venues, and five dining and drinking concepts. Situated at the crossroads of the Kampong Glam, Little India and Bras Basah Bugis cultural districts—with their intimate shophouse-filled alleyways and atmospheric colours, textures and flavours— Andaz Singapore aims to spark discovery of the rich culture of Singapore and inspire guests to experience the city from new angles.

Global in scale while local in perspective, the Andaz brand empowers self-expression and stimulates guests’ curiosity through imaginative travel for a distinctively local experience. Through thoughtful, unscripted service tailored for travelers, Andaz hotels enable guests to go beyond the familiar to discover and define their personal essence while immersing themselves in the spirit of the eclectic culture around them.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

At Andaz Singapore, we believe in creating inspiring experiences through genuine connections, thoughtful leadership and a culture where colleagues can be their best selves.

We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Director of Sales & Marketing / Executive Assistant Manager-Sales & Marketing to join our Leadership Committee. Reporting to the General Manager, this role provides strategic leadership across Sales, Events, Weddings, Revenue Management coordination, Marketing Communications and Digital Marketing. The position translates the hotel’s strategy, brand direction and financial priorities into integrated commercial plans that drive revenue, market share, customer preference and long-term brand value.

This is an exciting opportunity for an accomplished commercial leader who combines strong business acumen with a passion for developing people, building meaningful customer relationships and delivering measurable results.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

· Develop and execute an integrated Sales & Marketing business plan covering key market segments, accounts, channels, events, weddings and communications.

· Lead commercial strategies that drive room, event and wedding revenue, market share, demand generation and conversion.

· Set the hotel’s sales deployment, key-account development, prospecting, customer engagement and market coverage priorities.

· Guide the Revenue Management function in evaluating business pace, demand patterns, competitive conditions, displacement and need periods, while developing well-supported pricing and revenue recommendations.

· Lead the commercial performance of Events and Weddings, including pipeline conversion, space utilisation, client engagement, revenue delivery and cross-functional handovers.

· Oversee integrated marketing, public relations, digital, advertising, partnership and content initiatives, ensuring measurable returns and consistency with Andaz brand standards.

· Maintain accurate commercial forecasts, pipeline information, competitive intelligence, campaign analysis and executive performance reporting.

· Manage the department’s budget, productivity, promotional investment, contracts, purchasing and financial controls.

· Recruit, coach and develop a high-performing and inclusive commercial team, while strengthening succession planning and leadership capability.

· Ensure that commercial activities, contracts, records, data controls and departmental procedures comply with Hyatt policies and applicable requirements.

Qualifications

WHAT YOU HAVE

· Substantial senior leadership experience in luxury hospitality Sales & Marketing.

· Broad commercial exposure across sales, events, revenue collaboration, marketing communications and digital channels.

· A demonstrated ability to develop complex commercial plans, interpret market and financial performance, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

· Strong understanding of lifestyle positioning, customer expectations, brand standards and long-term brand equity.

· Executive presence, sound judgement, discretion and the ability to contribute constructively to hotel-wide decisions.

· Strong communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to engage senior leaders, owners, corporate partners, customers and colleagues.

· A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Hospitality, Communications or a related discipline, or equivalent executive experience. You will be expected to connect market intelligence, customer demand, pricing, channel performance and hotel operating capacity to clear commercial action. You will use financial, digital, CRM, business intelligence and revenue data to identify opportunities, manage risks and improve performance.

You will work collaboratively with the General Manager, hotel leadership, operating divisions, Finance, Human Resources and Hyatt partners to create shared accountability and deliver sustainable results. You will build strong customer and industry relationships, communicate with clarity, and create an environment where colleagues are empowered to experiment, improve and grow.

title: Assistant Manager, Marketing Communications
description:
Company Description

HOTEL OVERVIEW

Strategically located in the heart of Singapore’s shopping, dining and entertainment districts and with the City Hall and Esplanade Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) train stations and other major transportation nodes at its doorstep, Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford are the gateway to explore Singapore’s landscapes at your convenience. With a total of 2,030 well-appointed guestrooms, both hotels also offer a distinct collection of 12 lifestyle and dining choices including Michelin-starred fine dining restaurant JAAN by Kirk Westaway, cutting-edge meeting space at Raffles City Convention Centre with 34 meeting rooms and one of Asia’s largest spas, Willow Stream Spa.

ABOUT OUR COMPANY

At Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford, we design career plans and unveil new professional perspectives through our various development programs. We shine when YOU shine. Come and be part of our dynamic team and experience immerse growth and career opportunities with us.

Job Description

The Assistant Marketing Communications Manager develops and leads communications strategies for assigned revenue streams and lifestyle-led portfolios across Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford. This role has a strong focus on campaign management, public relations, media relations, content development, influencer engagement, media planning, partnerships, F&B storytelling, spa and lifestyle campaigns, while supporting broader hotel, brand and corporate initiatives. The role supports the Director of Marketing Communications in managing campaign execution, agency coordination, media hosting and team workflow. This is a leadership position as second in-charge to lead and manage the team.

COMMUNICATIONS & MEDIA PLANNING

Formulate communications and media calendars for assigned portfolios, ensuring timely and accurate execution of initiatives with relevant business units and stakeholders.

Develop Public Relations angles, media materials, influencer briefs and content narratives that generate positive and relevant coverage across local, regional and international channels.

Develop media plan for campaigns and dedicated business units for brand positioning and/or to meet campaign objectives

Review communications materials including press releases, media pitches, social copy, sales decks, in-house collaterals, ad copy and campaign assets to ensure accuracy, tonality and brand alignment.

Lead assigned awards submissions, canvassing of votes or nominations, and post-award amplification with relevant stakeholders.

Identify partnership opportunities with lifestyle, luxury, F&B, wellness, cultural and corporate brands to create differentiated guest experiences.

LIFESTYLE, PUBLIC RELATIONS & PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT

Lead or support lifestyle and Public Relations -driven portfolios such as selected F&B venues, spa, wellness, partnerships, IP-led collaborations, festive campaigns and hotel stories.

Manage media, blogger, content creator and influencer hosting to drive positive coverage and beneficial commercial outcomes.

Coordinate media familiarisation stays, F&B tastings, chef interviews, partner activations and hosted experiences in line with approved strategy and budgets.

Support restaurant and bar positioning by developing story angles around culinary concepts, chefs, menus, events, awards and collaborations.

Maintain active awareness of hospitality, lifestyle, dining, wellness and media trends to identify relevant opportunities.

CAMPAIGN & EVENT MANAGEMENT

Conceptualise, plan and execute integrated communications campaigns with the Director, internal team, Public relations agencies, digital partners and business unit stakeholders.

Support marketing and promotion of hotel-led events, ensuring strong attendance, media relevance, guest experience and post-event reporting.

Prepare campaign briefs, timelines, content requirements, photography or videography briefs, creative references and partner deliverables.

Coordinate cross-channel launches across website, social media, email, in-house displays, press outreach, partner platforms and advertising placements.

Monitor campaign performance and prepare updates with recommendations for optimisation.

MARKET RESEARCH & ANALYSIS

Conduct market research to identify consumer preferences, competitor activity, hospitality trends and relevant lifestyle or dining developments.

Analyse public relations , campaign, media monitoring, social and stakeholder feedback to develop informed recommendations that support business goals.

Review competitive communications to identify opportunities for differentiation and stronger positioning.

PARTNER, AGENCY & VENDOR ENGAGEMENT

Manage day-to-day agency, partner and vendor coordination for assigned projects, ensuring clear scopes, timelines, deliverables and approvals.

Host partners and industry contacts for ongoing engagement and potential collaborations.

Support negotiation of value-added partner arrangements that enhance brand relevance, reduce costs or improve guest experiences.

BUDGETING & ADMINISTRATION

Manage campaign and assigned business unit budgets and forecast.

Monitor campaign-level budgets, quotations and supplier costs for assigned projects, ensuring forecast accuracy and procurement compliance.

Support annual budget planning by gathering scopes, historical costs and proposed activity requirements.

Work with the Coordinator to ensure agreements, purchase requests, invoices and accruals are submitted accurately and on time.

OTHERS

Comply with hotel and department policies and procedures at all times.

Assist with Sales & Marketing projects and carry out other duties as assigned by Management.

Qualifications

Degree or Diploma in Hospitality, Tourism, Marketing, Communications, Public Relations or a related discipline.

 Minimum 3 to 6 years of marketing communications or public relations experience, preferably within hospitality, travel, lifestyle, luxury, F&B or agency environments.

Leadership – experience in leading and managing teams

Excellent spoken and written English. Fluency in a second language is preferred.

AI-enabled marketer, proficient in Claude, ChatGPT, relevant tools for content creation, presentations, project management

Strong knowledge of marketing communications (Branding, Public Relations , Events, Advertising), hospitality trends, media//KOL connections locally/regionally

Excellent writing, editing, media pitching and content planning skills.

Strong stakeholder management with the ability to work across multiple business units and senior stakeholders.

Ability to brief agencies, designers, photographers and vendors with clear objectives and timelines.

Strong analytical skills with comfort using media monitoring, influencer analysis and campaign performance data.

Creative, proactive and commercially minded, with a passion for hospitality and guest experiences.

Collaborative, adaptable and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a creative, motivated and results-driven

Online Marketing Executive (E-Commerce & Live Streaming)

to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing e-commerce platforms, developing digital marketing strategies, creating engaging promotional content and hosting live streaming sessions to promote our products and drive online sales.

The ideal candidate should be familiar with online marketplaces, social media marketing, digital advertising and live streaming. Experience in the food wholesale, distribution or FMCG industry will be an advantage.

Job Responsibilities

1. E-Commerce Management

Manage daily operations of e-commerce platforms such as Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop and other online sales channels.

Create, upload and maintain product listings, including product descriptions, images, pricing and promotions.

Monitor online orders and coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to ensure timely order fulfilment.

Monitor product availability, inventory levels and online stock information.

Handle customer enquiries, reviews, complaints and feedback professionally.

Plan and execute promotional campaigns to increase online traffic and sales.

Analyse online sales performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Ensure all online product information and pricing are accurate and up to date.

2. Live Streaming & Online Sales

Plan, organise and host live streaming sessions on TikTok, Facebook, Shopee Live and other relevant platforms.

Introduce, demonstrate and promote company products during live streaming sessions.

Explain product features, pricing, promotions and special offers to viewers.

Engage with live audiences by answering questions and encouraging customer interaction.

Develop creative live streaming concepts, scripts and promotional strategies to attract viewers.

Prepare products, promotional materials and equipment before each live streaming session.

Coordinate with the sales and warehouse teams to ensure sufficient stock availability during promotional campaigns.

Monitor live streaming performance, including viewer engagement, sales conversion and revenue.

Identify ways to improve live streaming content, audience engagement and sales results.

Assist in setting up lighting, cameras, microphones and other live streaming equipment.

3. Digital Marketing & Social Media

Plan and execute digital marketing strategies to increase brand awareness, customer engagement and online sales.

Manage company social media accounts, including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and other relevant platforms.

Create engaging content such as promotional posts, product photographs, short videos and advertisements.

Develop and maintain a social media content calendar.

Plan online advertising campaigns through Meta Ads, Google Ads and marketplace advertising platforms.

Monitor advertising performance, marketing budgets and campaign effectiveness.

Research market trends, competitors and customer preferences.

Collaborate with internal departments to develop marketing campaigns and product promotions.

Ensure consistent branding and messaging across all digital channels.

4. Content Creation & Product Promotion

Create attractive product visuals, promotional banners, videos and marketing materials.

Produce short-form video content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook and other social media platforms.

Assist with product photography, basic video editing and content production.

Develop creative promotional ideas for festive campaigns, seasonal sales and special events.

Write engaging product descriptions, advertising captions and marketing content.

Ensure marketing materials accurately represent the company's products.

5. Sales Reporting & Performance Analysis

Prepare weekly and monthly reports on e-commerce sales and marketing performance.

Track online orders, sales revenue, customer engagement and conversion rates.

Monitor live streaming sales performance and campaign results.

Analyse customer behaviour and identify opportunities to improve online sales.

Recommend improvements to digital marketing and e-commerce strategies.

Maintain accurate records of marketing activities, promotional campaigns and online sales performance.

6. General Duties

Coordinate with sales, warehouse, logistics and other departments to ensure smooth e-commerce operations.

Assist with online customer service and order-related enquiries.

Support company marketing events, promotions and product launches.

Perform other marketing, e-commerce and administrative duties assigned by management.

Job Requirements

Education & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Business, E-Commerce, Digital Marketing, Mass Communication or a related field.

Previous experience in e-commerce operations, online marketing or live streaming is preferred.

Experience managing Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop or other online marketplaces will be an advantage.

Experience in food wholesale, distribution, retail or FMCG industries is preferred.

Skills & Knowledge

Familiar with TikTok Live, Shopee Live, Facebook Live or similar live streaming platforms.

Comfortable appearing on camera and conducting live product presentations.

Good communication, presentation and customer engagement skills.

Knowledge of social media marketing, digital advertising and content creation.

Basic knowledge of SEO, SEM, Meta Ads and Google Ads is an advantage.

Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word and PowerPoint.

Familiar with Canva, CapCut or other graphic design and video editing software.

Basic knowledge of live streaming equipment, lighting and audio setup.

Good organisational, analytical and problem-solving skills.

Personal Attributes

Creative, confident and comfortable speaking in front of a camera.

Self-motivated, responsible and results-oriented.

Able to communicate effectively and engage with online audiences.

Able to work independently and collaborate with different departments.

Willing to learn new marketing trends, technologies and e-commerce strategies.

Able to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment.

Flexible to conduct scheduled live streaming sessions when required.

Employee Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.

Annual Leave and Medical Leave in accordance with Singapore employment regulations.

CPF contributions for eligible employees.

Other employee benefits according to company policy.

description:
WHO WE ARE

We are EssilorLuxottica, a global leader in the design, manufacture and distribution of ophthalmic lenses, frames and sunglasses. The Company brings together the complementary expertise of two industry pioneers, one in advanced lens technologies and the other in the craftsmanship of iconic eyewear, to create a vertically integrated business that is uniquely positioned to address the world’s evolving vision needs and the global demand of a growing eyewear industry.

With over 200,000 dedicated employees in 150 countries driving our iconic brands, our people are creative, entrepreneurial and celebrated for their unique perspectives and individuality. Committed to vision, we enable people to “see more and be more” thanks to our innovative designs and lens technologies, exceptional quality and cutting-edge processing methods. We are looking for a driven and resourceful Event Sales Manager to grow our catering and events portfolio and lead our sales team. You will lead business development efforts, build strong client relationships and manage each opportunity from the first enquiry through to successful event delivery.

title: marketing manager
description:
Core Objective:

Drive consistent inbound customer inquiries, maintain a fully booked installation schedule for car wrapping and PPF bays, and position the studio as the go-to brand for automotive styling in the region.

Key Duties & Scope of Work

Performance Advertising & Lead Funnels:

Plan, budget, and manage paid acquisition campaigns across Meta Ads Manager (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok Ads, and Google Search (SEM/PMAX).

Design and optimize lead funnels pointing directly to WhatsApp Business, capturing qualified car owners (make/model, desired service, timeline).

Continuously test ad creatives, hooks, headlines, and audience targeting (segmenting daily commuters, EV owners, and luxury/performance car enthusiasts).

Content Production & Social Media Management:

Direct daily workshop content capture: time-lapses of panel disassemblies, precision knife-work, ASMR vinyl peeling, paint correction prep, and final showroom reveals.

Plan, edit, and schedule short-form vertical video (Reels, TikTok, Xiaohongshu/RED, YouTube Shorts) capitalizing on trending audios and automotive memes.

Write engaging copy and car-care educational posts highlighting the practical differences between TPU Paint Protection Film (PPF) and color-change vinyl wraps.

Implement lead tagging and follow-up reminders for seasonal campaigns, maintenance wash reminders, and wrap inspection checkups.

B2B Partnerships & Community Activation:

Build referral networks with car clubs, automotive performance workshops, tinting shops, ceramic coating detailers, and used car dealerships.

Secure commercial fleet wrapping accounts (corporate branding for delivery vans, company cars, and promotional demo vehicles).

Coordinate studio open houses, car meets, and influencer sponsorships to drive local brand buzz.

Analytics, Reporting & Budget Control:

Track and report weekly KPIs: Ad Spend, Cost Per Lead (CPL), Cost Per Bay Booking (CPA), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and gross revenue per vehicle service.

Allocate marketing budgets dynamically toward the highest-margin service categories (full-body PPF vs. partial accents/de-chrome).

Professional Experience:

3 to 5 years of proven marketing experience, with direct experience running lead-generation campaigns for visual-heavy craft services, high-ticket consumer services, or the automotive aftermarket.

Paid Media Expertise:

Hands-on proficiency with

Meta Ads Manager

(custom audiences, retargeting, conversion tracking) and

Google Search Ads

; able to demonstrate past ad account ROAS and CPL benchmarks.

Content Creation Skills:

Proficiency shooting with mobile rigs/stabilizers and fast-turnaround video editing using

CapCut, Adobe Premiere Rush, or DaVinci Resolve

.

Automotive Acumen:

Clear technical understanding of car finishes, vinyl wrap categories (cast vs. polymeric, gloss, satin, matte, color shift), and PPF characteristics (self-healing, hydrophobic properties, stone chip protection).

Language Proficiency:

Strong communication in

English

and

Chinese (Mandarin)

, necessary for creating multi-language ad copy and engaging local car owner demographics across platforms like Xiaohongshu and Facebook groups.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

Personal involvement in the local automotive enthusiast scene, track days, or car club communities.

title: Senior Producer
description:
The Senior Producer is responsible for leading the end-to-end development and execution of video productions across corporate, government, broadcast, digital and social media platforms. The role oversees the full production lifecycle — from conceptualisation and pre-production planning to on-ground execution and post-production delivery — ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget and to a high creative and technical standard.

The role requires strong storytelling instincts, production leadership, stakeholder management and the ability to manage multiple fast-turnaround projects in a dynamic agency environment. The Senior Producer is also expected to mentor junior producers and production crew, uphold production SOPs, and contribute towards strengthening organisational capabilities in emerging production technologies and workflows.

Key Responsibilities

Production Management & Execution

Lead and manage the full video production process from ideation to final delivery.

Develop creative concepts, treatments, production approaches and storytelling strategies aligned with client objectives.

Oversee production schedules, manpower deployment, logistics, budgeting and vendor coordination.

Manage shoots across studio, field, overseas and live-event environments.

Ensure production quality, technical standards and visual consistency across all deliverables.

Troubleshoot production challenges and provide practical on-ground solutions during shoots

Creative Development

Work closely with creative, editorial and account servicing teams to conceptualise compelling content and campaign narratives.

Translate client briefs into engaging visual storytelling formats suitable for digital, broadcast and social platforms.

Provide creative direction on filming style, pacing, interview approaches, graphics integration and overall narrative flow.

Review scripts, storyboards and edits to ensure alignment with campaign objectives and brand guidelines.

Stakeholder & Client Management

Serve as the main production point-of-contact for clients, talents, agencies and partners during projects.

Present production concepts, filming approaches and creative recommendations confidently to stakeholders.

Manage client expectations, timelines and feedback throughout the production process.

Build strong working relationships with Government stakeholders, agencies and production partners.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

Supervise and guide producers, videographers, editors and freelancers on assigned projects.

Ensure adherence to production SOPs, equipment protocols and operational workflows.

Conduct pre-production briefings and post-project reviews to strengthen team performance and operational standards.

Mentor junior staff and support capability development within the production team.

Production Operations & Resource Planning

Coordinate equipment bookings, crew deployment, filming permits and production logistics.

Ensure productions are executed efficiently while maintaining prudent cost management.

Monitor production timelines and resource utilisation to support operational efficiency.

Support the implementation of improved workflows and production systems.

Post-Production Oversight

Oversee editing workflows, review rough cuts and ensure quality control before delivery.

Work with editors, motion graphics artists and sound designers to ensure creative consistency.

Ensure final deliverables meet platform specifications, broadcast standards and client requirements.

Innovation & Capability Development

Keep abreast of emerging production trends, AI-assisted workflows, virtual production and evolving digital content formats.

Explore new production technologies and methodologies to improve efficiency and creative output.

Contribute ideas to strengthen the organisation’s production capabilities and creative offerings.

Requirements

Degree, Diploma or equivalent experience in Film, Media Production, Communications or related disciplines.

At least 6–8 years of relevant experience in video production, agency, broadcast or communications environments.

Strong understanding of production workflows, camera operations, lighting, audio and post-production processes.

Experience managing Government or corporate communications projects will be advantageous.

Ability to manage multiple projects and tight timelines in a fast-paced environment.

Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills.

Familiarity with social media video formats and digital-first storytelling approaches.

Willingness to work irregular hours, weekends or overseas where required by production schedules.

Preferred Competencies

Strong storytelling and editorial judgement.

Calm and decisive under pressure.

title: Event Sales Consultant
description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:

As a Sales Executive in our catering team, you will play a vital role in driving our growth and ensuring exceptional customer experiences. You'll be responsible for managing client inquiries, preparing customized catering proposals, and coordinating with our culinary and event teams to deliver seamless service.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Client Management

Attending incoming enquiries via phone, email, messages or any online 3rd party platform. Please take down clear client requirements

Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, offering personalized attention and ensuring a seamless experience.

Monitor and manage client accounts to ensure repeat business and encourage referrals.

Proactively address client needs and concerns, striving for continuous satisfaction.

Engage in thorough conversations with clients to understand their catering needs, preferences, and expectations.

Offer customized catering menus and solutions tailored to individual client requirements.

Provide expert guidance and recommendations to clients regarding menu selection and event planning.

Introduce new offerings that align with client needs and enhance their overall experience.

Identify opportunities for upselling additional catering products or services to existing clients.

Present innovative ideas and options to enhance the value of our catering offerings.

Work closely with clients to provide customized catering solutions, ensuring their expectations are met

Promptly and professionally address any issues or concerns raised by clients, collaborating with internal teams for effective resolution.

Establish and nurture strong relationships with clients through regular and meaningful communication.

Proactively engage with clients to understand evolving needs and preferences.

Conduct follow-up communication with clients to gather feedback on the catering services provided. Address any post-event concerns or additional requirements.

Utilize feedback to make continuous improvements, enhance client satisfaction, and refine catering services.

Conduct regular quality assessments to maintain and improve service excellence.

Menu Planning, Budget Management and Quotation Preparation:

Demonstrate a deep understanding of client requirements and qualify leads before providing quotations/rates

Prepare detailed and accurate quotations/ menus based on client requirements. Ensure that quotations are clear, transparent, and aligned with pricing strategies.

Demonstrate a deep understanding of diverse cuisines, cooking techniques, and flavours that cater to different preferences, dietary needs, and event themes.

Negotiate pricing with clients when necessary, balancing competitive rates with the company's financial goals.

Serve as the main point of contact for clients during the order processing phase.

Maintain accurate and organized records of all orders, quotations, and client communications.

Ensure that all documentation complies with internal procedures and legal requirements.

Order Processing, Event Planning & Execution:

Receive and review client orders, ensuring accuracy and completeness.

Liaise with internal teams, including culinary and logistics, to coordinate the execution of catering orders.

Coordinate logistics for catering events, including staffing, equipment, and transportation from initial planning to on-site execution.

Collaborate with the operation/ kitchen/ purchasing to align client deliverables and expectations

Address any issues or challenges that arise during the event planning and execution stages.

Ensure the timely and efficient execution of catering services on the day of the event

Work closely with operational teams to ensure seamless and successful event delivery.

Lead and manage catering staff, providing training and guidance as needed.

Foster a positive and collaborative environment on-site

Coordination with Other Departments:

Collaborate with the marketing team to develop promotional campaigns and initiatives. Contribute ideas to shape marketing strategies and increase the visibility of catering services.

Work closely with culinary, operations, and sales teams to ensure effective cross-departmental collaboration.

Communicate event details and client expectations to relevant teams for seamless execution.

Work collaboratively with internal catering teams to address challenges, ensuring a seamless client experience from planning to execution.

Uphold high-quality standards in food presentation, service delivery, and overall customer experience.

Requirements:

Minimum Diploma

Strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills

Ability to communicate effectively and work well within a team

Eagerness to learn and embrace challenges for team success

Proactive approach to continuous improvement and professional development

Proficiency in Google tools and general IT savvy

Join our culinary journey that began in a cozy 1500-square-foot shophouse in Joo Chiat! Back in 1989, our founder fell in love with his wife and the world of kitchen magic. With the guidance of skilled chefs in the family, he honed his culinary skills and laid the foundation for our tasty venture.

Fuelled by ambition, we officially launched Four Seasons Catering in 1994. Our passion for scrumptious delights led us to a serene location in Pasir Panjang. By day, we delighted nearby office-goers with our seafood restaurant, and by night, we catered to events in style. It was like having the best of both culinary worlds!

Fast forward to today, and we've come a long way. We've moved to a spacious 26,000-square-foot building, upgrading our kitchen game and maintaining squeaky-clean hygiene standards. Oh, and did we mention that the founder's daughters, Ophelia and Carella, joined the family business? They bring their own spice to the mix, with Ophelia mastering the art of sales and procurement, while Carella adds a dash of marketing magic.

Now, here's where you come in. We're on a mission to revolutionize the catering market and we need your help to make it happen! Join our innovative team and let's create unforgettable culinary experiences together. Don't worry if you're new to the field – we're all about nurturing talent and having a great time while doing it. Together, let's bring a fresh flavor to the world of catering!

title: Media Buying Specialist
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and analytically strong Media Buying Specialist to manage and optimise our paid media investments in support of institutional branding, student recruitment, thought leadership, and content amplification efforts.

Reporting to Head, Digital Communications from the Corporate Communications Office, the successful candidate will oversee end-to-end paid media execution across social platforms, search engines, native/content discovery networks and beyond, with a particular focus on the distribution and performance of long-form editorial, research, and institutional content in furtherance of building NTU’s global brand presence.

This is an in-house role, working closely with internal stakeholders across the University.

1. Media Planning and Campaign Management

Develop and execute integrated paid media strategies aligned with institutional priorities, campaign objectives, and audience segmentation frameworks.
Plan, launch, and manage campaigns across:
Paid social (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube and relevant platforms)
Search engine marketing and display advertising
Native and content discovery platforms (e.g., Outbrain, Taboola, and similar networks)
Translate campaign briefs and editorial priorities into structured media plans, budgets, and flighting schedules.
Own full-funnel media activation, from awareness and consideration to lead generation and engagement.

2. Social Media Boosting and Content Amplification

Lead paid distribution of institutional content, including – but not limited to – social media posts and long-form stories (e.g. research highlights, thought leadership articles, news pieces).
Design and execute social boosting strategies to maximise reach, engagement, and qualified traffic to long-form content.
Optimise formats, placements, and targeting to enhance content discoverability and engagement.

3. Ad Operations (Ad Ops) and Platform Management

Manage day-to-day ad operations, including:
Campaign setup and trafficking
Creative uploads and approvals
Pixel and conversion event validation
Naming conventions (e.g. adherence to the master UTM taxonomy) and documentation
Budget pacing and reconciliation
Procurement and finance processes related to media buying
Maintain clean and scalable account structures across platforms.
Ensure compliance with institutional governance, brand guidelines, and data privacy requirements.

4. Performance Optimisation and Testing

Monitor campaign performance on an ongoing basis and conduct systematic optimisation to improve efficiency and outcomes.

title: Business Development & Adviser Marketing Executive

About Us

Global Financial Consultants Pte Ltd (GFC) is one of Singapore’s longest established wealth management and financial advisory firms, located in the heart of the financial district at Raffles Place. About The Role

We are looking for a commercially driven, creative and proactive

Business Development & Adviser Marketing Executive

to work closely with an allocated Senior Financial Consultant (SFC). This is a hands-on, dual-function role combining prospecting, appointment setting, digital marketing, creative content production and campaign management to support the SFC's business growth.

The successful candidate will enjoy a performance-based remuneration structure comprising a monthly basic salary and commission, with opportunities to grow alongside the business.

A. Business Development & Lead Generation

B. Adviser Marketing & Digital Content

Ideate, plan, film and edit engaging short-form videos, reels, interviews and other digital content.

Create compelling marketing materials, social media posts, captions, visuals and campaign assets across relevant digital platforms.

Manage and maintain the SFC's approved social media presence and content calendar.

Leverage AI-powered tools to support content ideation, copywriting, editing, repurposing, research and workflow efficiency.

Develop creative campaign concepts to increase brand awareness, audience engagement, inbound enquiries and qualified leads.

Track and analyse campaign performance, including reach, engagement, enquiries, lead quality, appointment conversion and return on marketing spend where measurable.

Prepare regular marketing performance reports and recommend data-driven improvements.

Keep abreast of relevant digital marketing trends, content formats, platform developments and emerging AI tools.

C. Business Growth & Stakeholder Collaboration

Work closely with the allocated SFC to understand business priorities, target markets, client profiles and growth objectives.

Translate business objectives into actionable prospecting plans and marketing campaigns.

Coordinate with internal marketing, compliance and other relevant stakeholders to ensure marketing materials and activities follow GFC's policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

Maintain accurate records of leads, communications, appointments, campaigns and performance metrics.

Undertake other relevant business development and adviser marketing responsibilities as required.

Requirements

Minimum 2–3 years of relevant experience in business development, lead generation, digital marketing, content creation or a related field.

Degree or Diploma in Marketing, Communications, Media, Digital Media or a related discipline.

Proven ability to generate leads, engage prospects, arrange appointments and manage business development activities.

Strong portfolio showcasing content creation, video editing, or campaign work (personal, academic, or professional).

Demonstrated proficiency in video editing software (CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, and/or Adobe After Effects preferred)

Excellent attention to detail, creativity, and a strong aesthetic sense.

Strong communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills.

Proactive, organised and able to manage multiple campaigns, prospect follow-ups and deadlines independently.

Willingness to attend networking events and participate in business development activities outside the office when required.

Excellent English proficiency; additional languages relevant to GFC's target markets are an advantage.

Experience in financial services, wealth management, insurance, professional services or serving expatriate clients is an advantage.

Remuneration & Benefits

Competitive monthly basic salary + commission.

Opportunity to develop expertise across business development, digital marketing, creative content and wealth management client acquisition.

Collaborative working environment with direct exposure to business growth initiatives.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume together with a portfolio of relevant marketing campaigns, social media content, videos or other examples of their work. Candidates with demonstrable business development results may also include relevant examples of lead generation and appointment-setting achievements.

Based in the heart of the financial district of Singapore, GFC is focused on providing a tailored and client-centric approach to help safeguard our clients’ financial future whilst guiding them on the path to achieve their personal financial goals and objectives. title: SENIOR MARKETING MANAGER
description:
ABOUT

We are a new international school in Singapore committed to delivering excellence in education and nurturing a generation of culturally diverse students. Our mission is to create a community that fosters curiosity, creativity, and a lifelong passion for learning.

ROLE

The Senior Marketing Manager manages the operational delivery of the school’s marketing activities in support of enrolment, brand awareness and community engagement. The role translates agreed marketing priorities into campaigns, events and projects; coordinates internal teams and external partners; and tracks delivery and results. Strategic direction and priorities are set with the school’s leadership and marketing lead.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Campaigns and Promotions

Coordinate and deliver integrated marketing campaigns across digital, print, events and partner channels, based on agreed objectives and audience segments.

Manage campaign timelines, briefs, creative assets, approvals, landing pages and calls to action.

Work with Admissions to align campaign activity with enquiry generation, open houses and other recruitment priorities.

Track campaign activity and results, identify delivery issues and share recommendations for optimization.

Search and Digital Marketing

Manage the appointed agency’s delivery of Search Engine Marketing (SEM), including paid search campaigns on platforms such as Google Ads. Coordinate campaign briefs, keywords, ad copy, budgets and landing pages; review results such as impressions, clicks, cost per click, conversions and enquiry quality.

Coordinate Search Engine Optimization (SEO) activity to improve the school’s visibility in unpaid search results. This may include keyword and content recommendations, page titles and descriptions, website content updates, internal linking and monitoring organic traffic and search performance.

Coordinate paid social and other digital campaigns with agencies or platform partners, ensuring assets, targeting, tracking and reporting are in place.

Coordinate website and landing page updates through the relevant content management system (CMS), keeping information accurate and the enquiry journey clear.

Liaise with Admissions and CRM users to support campaign tracking and follow-up of marketing-generated enquiries.

Events and Community Activity

Plan and deliver marketing support for open houses, school events, exhibitions, webinars and community initiatives.

Coordinate event promotion, registration communications, collateral, suppliers, logistics and post-event follow-up.

Work with Admissions and relevant school teams to ensure event activity supports family engagement and enrolment objectives.

Marketing Projects and Content

Coordinate marketing projects from brief to completion, maintaining schedules, deliverables, approvals and stakeholder updates.

Work with internal teams and external creatives to develop and update digital and print materials, including photography, video, banners, brochures and campaign assets.

Coordinate EDMs and other audience communications, including copy, design, audience lists, approvals and deployment.

Ensure materials follow the school’s agreed brand and messaging guidelines, escalating content or positioning decisions to the marketing lead.

Agency, Media and Partner Liaison

Manage day-to-day relationships with digital agencies, media contacts, vendors and third-party partners.

Prepare clear briefs, coordinate approvals and assets, monitor timelines and follow up on agreed deliverables.

Coordinate media placements, listings, sponsorships and promotional opportunities with relevant external organizations.

Budget and Performance Reporting

Track campaign and event spend against approved budgets and coordinate quotations, purchase requests and supplier invoices.

Maintain a marketing calendar and records of campaign, event and partner activity.

Compile regular reports on campaign delivery and performance, including lead generation, website and search activity, event registrations and spend.

Use results and feedback to suggest practical improvements to future activity.

REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Marketing, Public Relations, or related field is preferred.

At least 7 years of experience in similar role, with at least 3 years in a leadership role. Experience in the education sector is desirable.

Proven track record of developing and implementing successful marketing strategies.

Strong leadership skills and the ability to manage cross-functional teams.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in English.

Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Strong analytical skills and some experience with CRM and CMS systems.

Knowledge of the Singapore and International education market is a plus.

At RD American School, you’ll be part of a forward-thinking team shaping the future of education. You’ll have the opportunity to innovate, lead, and make a meaningful impact on learners and families across the region.

description:
As an Executive / Manager, Engagement & Experience (Producer & Trade Communications) at BCRS Ltd, you will support the planning and execution of communications and engagement for producers, retailers, F&B operators and other trade stakeholders participating in the Beverage Container Return Scheme (BCRS).

The role translates regulatory and operational requirements into clear, timely and actionable communications, helping stakeholders understand what they need to do and where to get support.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Develop and execute communications for producers, retailers, F&B operators and industry partners.

Translate Scheme requirements and operational updates into clear, practical communications.

Maintain a communications calendar around key milestones, deadlines, reminders and changes.

Ensure consistent messaging across stakeholder touchpoints.

Manage stakeholder engagement

Develop and maintain B2B communications and channels

Requirements

Degree or diploma in Communications, Marketing, Business or related discipline.

3–6 years' experience in communications, stakeholder engagement, public affairs or B2B marketing.

Highly motivated entry-level candidates or those without prior experience, but who possess strong writing abilities, a willingness to learn, and a keen interest in sustainability, are strongly encouraged to apply.

Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to simplify complex information.

Good project management and stakeholder coordination skills.

Comfortable working across operational, technical and regulatory subject matter.

Experience in sustainability, supply chain, retail, government programmes or regulated sectors would be advantageous.

We thank all applicants for their interest in joining BCRS Ltd. Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

The Beverage Container Return Scheme (BCRS) was recommended by a Citizens’ Workgroup in 2019 as part of efforts to protect the environment, conserve finite resources, and increase recycling rates in Singapore.

The Scheme is designed to spark behavioural change by encouraging more sustainable consumption habits and enabling the transition towards a circular economy.

Under the Scheme:

Beverage producers and retailers are responsible for ensuring that beverage containers are properly collected and treated at end-of-life, and

Consumers are encouraged to return empty containers for recycling in exchange for a deposit refund.

The Scheme contributes to a more sustainable Singapore by:

Increasing the recycling rate of beverage containers and reducing waste sent for disposal;

Encouraging consistent recycling habits among Singaporeans; and

Aggregating a clean, high-quality stream of recyclable materials.

The impact of BCRS will be significant. The Scheme will cover more than one billion beverage containers used each year, allowing us to recover over 16,000 tonnes of material annually. This means less waste sent for incineration, lower carbon emissions, and a more circular economy.

BCRS is Singapore’s second Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) scheme, following the introduction of the e-waste EPR framework in 2021. EPR schemes place responsibility on producers for the collection and end-of-life management of the products they put on the market. Over time they will make changes to their supply chains, processes and materials used, knowing that they have some responsibility for recycling the container after it is sold.

As a producer-led scheme, BCRS is designed and operated by the industry, for the industry. This approach allows producers to determine the most practical and cost-effective way to recover used beverage containers, while maintaining efficiency and service standards. Producer-led return schemes have been shown to be effective in countries such as Norway, Denmark and Lithuania.

Successful implementation requires the support, understanding, and shared commitment from all stakeholders involved: producers, retailers, recyclers, and consumers. There will be teething issues and adjustments along the way, but we can address them with everyone’s support. Launching the Scheme in April is the first step and adjustments will need to be made along the way, in order for the scheme to be effective and impactful.

title: Content Specialist, IKEA Singapore
description:
Company Description

The IKEA vision is to create a better everyday life for the many people. We do this by offering a wide range of well-designed, functional home furnishing products at prices so low that as many people as possible can afford them. We operate in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand – and have an ambitious expansion plan to bring a little bit of Sweden to new markets in the region. We are part of the Ikano Group of companies and the only IKEA franchisee owned by the Kamprad family that founded IKEA.

We also develop, own and operate Shopping Centres that are anchored by IKEA and create walkable communities by including residential, office and other types of real estate in our development plans.

We work towards making sustainability a natural part of our everyday work. We are active in our communities, driving and supporting social initiatives that benefit children, women and the environment.

Job Description

We are looking for an energetic, creatively driven and hands-on Content Specialist who knows how to turn ideas into compelling stories across social, digital and other brand channels. Someone who is curious, culturally tuned in, confident behind the camera and in the edit suite, and passionate about home furnishing and the IKEA brand. From playful trend-led content and unexpected product stories to influencer collaborations, major campaigns and in-store activations, you’ll help bring the IKEA brand to life through strong copy, photography and video—with wit, warmth and a little twinkle in the eye.

Work closely with Marketing colleagues (including Social Media Manager) to plan and execute content that supports IKEA Singapore's communication and business priorities.
Contribute ideas and support the sourcing, adaptation, hands-on production and delivery of engaging content, including copy, stills, videos and graphics, across social, digital and other relevant brand channels.
Plan and execute photography and video shoots, including concept development, storyboarding, shot planning, audio capture and on-location production.
Help turn products, offers, campaigns, trends and everyday moments into relevant stories.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Sales, Web, Food, Communications) to gather information, product lists and align requirements to ensure campaign readiness and content accuracy.
Coordinate with agencies, influencers, creators and vendors on content development, production and publishing matters, while overseeing timelines, deliverables and administrative matters.
Build and nurture relationships with influencers, content creators and influencer agencies to amplify brand narratives and extend reach.
Support social media listening and community management across IKEA Singapore's owned channels.
Monitor content performance, identify useful learnings and contribute to post-campaign reports, internal updates and performance trackers.
Support the team with purchase orders, agency billings and other administrative requirements that keep the work moving smoothly.

Qualifications

At least 3-4 years of experience managing, producing & publishing content across social channels.
Strong understanding of social platforms including its algorithms, publishing & advertising capabilities.
Proficient in software/tools for content creation, video editing and animation (e.g. Photoshop, InDesign, Adobe Premiere, CapCut).
Hands-on experience with AI tools for content production will be an added advantage.
Creative copywriting or journalistic experience with an ability to develop engaging content.
Hands-on experience planning and executing photography and video shoots for campaigns, products, events or social-first content.
High energy, proactive, highly responsible and able to multitask, work in a fast-paced environment and manage deliverables & timelines well.
Analytical skills to track, measure, and improve performance based on data and learnings.
Experience working with creative advertising/media agencies.
Able to work independently on shoots and collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders, creators, agencies and vendors.
Have a passion for home furnishing and the IKEA brand, share the IKEA values, tone of voice and vision and develop deep understanding of customer needs and living situations to craft impactful content.

Additional Information

Please apply by 26 October 2026.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
*BlueTree Education | Full-Time | Singapore*

*Big Ideas. Good People. Meaningful Growth.*

Love marketing, enjoy bringing ideas to life, and want to work with people who genuinely care about what they do?

*Come grow with BlueTree!*

At BlueTree Education, we believe that great work happens when passionate people come together in a supportive, fun-loving environment.

We are a growing Singapore education company with a big heart, ambitious plans and a shared belief that learning should make a difference.

Our team works hard, celebrates wins, supports one another and believes there is always room to learn, improve and grow.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we are looking for a \**Marketing Manager who brings both creativity and commercial thinking to the table.* Someone who enjoys rolling up their sleeves, taking ownership and turning good ideas into real results.

*The Role*

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead marketing execution across two education brands, bringing our 2027 marketing strategy to life.

You will have the opportunity to shape campaigns, develop our brand presence, work with a passionate team and make a measurable impact on business growth.

This is not a role where you simply manage agencies and review reports. We want someone who enjoys being in the action, experimenting with ideas and making things happen.

*What You'll Be Doing*

*1. Branding*

* Own and protect our brand across all touchpoints, including centres, signage, print, digital and parent materials. Ensure every piece of work is consistent with our brand direction and guidelines, and lead brand refresh projects.

*2. External Communication*

* Lead parent communications, public relations, media relations, partnerships and crisis communications. Shape how BlueTree is seen by parents, schools and the wider education community.

*3. Internal Communication*

* Plan and deliver communications to staff across our seven branches, so that teachers and branch teams understand, support and represent our campaigns, brand standards and key messages.

*4. Make Campaigns Happen*

* Plan and execute creative, effective marketing campaigns that attract parents, generate enquiries and drive student enrolments.

*5. Grow Our Digital Presence*

* Manage and optimise Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO and organic content to improve visibility, lead quality and conversions. And manage BlueTree Education's social media channels, including Instagram, TikTok and Facebook.

*6. Build Stronger Parent Connections*

* Develop referral campaigns, engagement initiatives and re-enrolment activities that strengthen relationships with our BlueTree families.

*7. Bring Ideas to Life*

* Work closely with our teachers, centre teams and creative partners to develop engaging content, promotions and brand experiences.

*8. Lead and Grow Together*

* Guide our Marketing Executive, collaborate with external agencies and freelancers, and build a positive, productive marketing team.

*9. Know Your Numbers*

* Track campaign performance, marketing budgets, leads, trials and enrolments. Use insights to make smarter decisions and drive continuous improvement.

*10. Team Leadership*

* Lead and develop the marketing executive, and manage agencies and vendors.

*Who We're Looking For*

We would love to meet someone who:

* Has a proven track record in marketing, particularly in generating leads, sales or enrolments.
* At least 5 years of marketing experience, with a track record of leading campaigns end to end and managing a brand
* Proven experience in branding and in internal and external communications
* Is confident with Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, GA4 and content marketing.
* Understands Singapore parents and ideally has experience in education, enrichment or consumer marketing.
* Is both creative and analytical — someone who loves a great campaign idea but also cares about the results.
* Enjoys taking ownership, solving problems and getting things done.
* Has experience guiding junior team members and managing external partners.
* Brings positive energy, a collaborative spirit and a good sense of humour.
* Is curious about AI and new ways to make marketing more effective.
* Experience leading junior staff and managing agencies or vendors

Experience in multi-brand, multi-branch or referral marketing would be a bonus.

*Why You'll Love Working with Us*

*A Warm, Close-Knit Team*

_We believe work should be enjoyable. Expect friendly colleagues, genuine support, laughter and a workplace where people know one another beyond their job titles._

*Big Ambitions, Real Opportunities*

_We are an established education company with exciting growth plans. You will have the space to contribute ideas, take ownership and grow professionally alongside the business._

*Your Ideas Matter*

_We value initiative over hierarchy. Good ideas can come from anyone, and we encourage people to speak up, experiment and make things better._

*Work That Makes a Difference*

_Behind every campaign is a child learning, a parent finding support and a teacher making an impact. Your work contributes to something meaningful._

*A Culture of Learning and Celebration*

_We believe in developing our people, recognising effort and celebrating milestones — big and small._

*Ready to Grow with Us?*

If you are a marketer who loves a good challenge, enjoys working with good people and wants to be part of a growing education brand, *we would love to hear from you!*

Location: Singapore, , Singapore

Company: NCS

Job Requisition ID: RQ26-01948-1-1

Company Description

NCS is a leading AI Tech Services company. With a 15,000-strong team across the Asia Pacific, NCS scales its platforms and capabilities to provide clients with greater agility and AI expertise across a range of Industries. Embracing a strong ecosystem of global partners, NCS transforms technology services delivery combining AI with digital resilience to drive real business impact. NCS is a subsidiary of the Singtel Group.

Job Description

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Robotics Experience & Events Coordinator to build and operate a new business around humanoid robotics shows, demonstrations and technology experiences.

This role will own the end-to-end event lifecycle — from event concept, client engagement through to costing, planning, logistics, technical coordination and on-site execution.

The successful candidate will continuously develop new show concepts, audience experiences, robotics demonstrations and event packages that differentiate our offering and create business.

You will lead a small technical operations team of up to 2 team members, working closely with robotics engineers, vendors and clients to deliver safe, reliable and engaging live experiences.

Key Responsibilities

1. Event Concept

Develop innovative concepts for humanoid robotics shows, demonstrations, corporate events, exhibitions, and public experiences.
Develop repeatable show packages and customised experiences based on client requirements.
Work with technology and robotics teams to translate emerging capabilities into compelling event experiences.
Research robotics and event trends to continuously refresh the company's show portfolio.

2. Event Planning

Own the end-to-end planning and execution of events from initial brief to post-event review.
Coordinate venue requirements including space, flooring, power, connectivity, access, storage and operating conditions.
Conduct site surveys and technical walkthroughs to identify operational constraints early.
Coordinate rehearsals, demonstrations, stage movements, audience interaction and show cues.
Manage event setup, live operations and teardown.

3. Resource Planning

Prepare event quotations, budgets and cost models covering:
Robot and technical resources
Manpower
Venue, connectivity requirements, Logistics and transportation
Insurance and permits
Customisation and content development
Setup and stand down
Build reusable costing templates and event packages to improve work efficiency.

4. Robotics & Technical Operations

Coordinate with robotics engineers and operators to ensure robots are event-ready.
Plan robot deployment, transportation, charging, batteries, controllers, networking and supporting equipment.
Ensure pre-event testing, rehearsal and technical readiness.
Establish operational checklists and contingency plans for robot or technology failures.
Coordinate technical troubleshooting during live events and ensure appropriate escalation.
Maintain equipment inventory, readiness schedules and deployment records.

5. Safety & Risk Management

Incorporate robotics-specific safety requirements into every event plan.
Establish robot operating zones, crowd separation, emergency stop procedures and safe operating protocols.
Conduct event risk assessments and ensure appropriate mitigation measures are in place.
Coordinate relevant venue requirements, permits, insurance and safety documentation.
Develop contingency plans for robot failure, network failure, power issues, venue changes and other show disruptions.

6. Point of Contact

Act as the primary client contact from initial enquiry through event completion.
Understand client objectives and translate them into practical robotics experiences.
Manage expectations around robot capabilities, limitations, operating conditions and show requirements.

Qualifications

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who combines event management discipline with a technology mindset.

Required

1+ years of experience in event management, exhibitions, technology demonstrations or related fields.
Proven experience managing events end-to-end, including planning, costing, logistics and on-site execution.
Ability to manage budgets, quotations and vendor negotiations.
Comfortable working hands-on in a fast-moving environment.
Strong problem-solving ability under live-event pressure.
Willingness to work evenings, weekends and travel when required.
Strong interest in robotics, AI and emerging technologies.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to help build a new category of business — not simply manage events.

Collaborate on the development and implementation of all consumer-focused communications and production of those assets
Own and manage all marketing services offered by this internal team, including toolkit development and optimization, development of SOPs and guidelines, website maintenance, newsletter content development, asset requests, regional promotional campaigns, email engagement campaigns, documentation creation to educate and enable internal teams to find and properly leverage the best marketing assets. Continually explore how to elevate and refine marketing tactics and channels
Contribute to and provide strategic input and/or executional support towards global marketing initiatives and campaign development

Clearly and effectively storytell to multiple audiences (internal, users, stakeholders), embodying and evolving the brand tone
Contribute to strategic planning, development and delivery of an integrated marketing strategy and communications plan
Ideate, improve, and rollout processes to drive efficiencies across teams and more effective collaboration

Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree
Minimum 5-7 years of relevant marketing and communications experience managing a broad marketing mix with proven ability to build relationships, identify needs and implement solutions end-to-end
Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to influence others
Experience with G-suite tools and Canva
Personal interest in health and wellbeing
Proven experience navigating a matrixed environment, with the ability to effectively communicate and influence stakeholders at all levels.

A natural connector with a positive, team-building approach
Enthusiastic about cross-functional and collaborative work, comfortable interfacing with multiple stakeholders
Experienced leading team dynamics; you’re comfortable leading meetings, developing agendas and nudging conversations in a productive and inspiring way
Reliable: someone we can count on to get stuff done
Adaptable; comfortable with ambiguity (we are constantly evolving, growing and don’t always have the answers) and working in a dynamic global environment
Driven by goals, objectives, and key results, but willing to challenge assumptions (especially when you know there is a better answer!)

WHO WE ARE

For nearly 30 years, Exos has been dedicated to getting people ready for the moments that matter by promoting a holistic approach to health. Simply put, we “get you ready” for the moments that matter — whether that’s striving to excel at work, or training for a major athletic event. How do we do it? Our professional athlete training programs propel elite athletes to new heights in the NFL combine and NBA Draft each year, and our practitioner education courses and workshops provide industry professionals ongoing opportunities for development.

We’ve never been the type to accept the status quo. We’re all about studying, learning, innovating, and making waves. And we feel that it’s our responsibility to help others because we know there’s a better way. That better way is Exos Readiness.

title: Manager, Loyalty Marketing, APEC
description:
Additional Information
Job Number26130284
Job CategorySales & Marketing
Location2 Harbourfront Place #06-08, Bank of America, Singapore 098499, Singapore
ScheduleFull Time
Located Remotely?N
Position Type Management

JOB SUMMARY

The Manager, Loyalty Marketing is a high-impact, commercially oriented role responsible for driving member growth, engagement and retention across Asia Pacific excluding China (APEC).

This is a new role sitting at the intersection of loyalty strategy, CRM, and experiential partnerships - built for a marketer who is equally comfortable designing a lifecycle journey and activating world-class partnerships. You will own the end-to-end member journeys for one of the world's largest hospitality loyalty programs, translating global strategy into locally relevant, measurable initiatives across a diverse and dynamic region. This role will report to the Director, Loyalty Marketing, APEC.

You will lead the evolution of CRM and lifecycle marketing for APEC — defining segmentation strategy, designing engagement programs, and driving measurable improvements in activation, retention and reactivation. You will work in close collaboration with global, continent and market teams, and play a central role in building the reach and scaling our loyalty program as a long-term growth driver for the business. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, strategic thinking and a member-centric mindset.

This role is based in Singapore.

CORE COMPETENCIES

CRM & Lifecycle Marketing: Deep, hands-on experience designing and executing programs across the full customer journey. Builds segmentation logic, personalisation strategy and automated flows anchored in commercial outcomes, not just campaign execution.
Loyalty & Partnership Marketing: Solid understanding of loyalty program mechanics (earn/burn, tiering, member value proposition) and how to market them effectively across segments and channels. Proven ability to activate brand partnerships, event management and experiential moments from brief to delivery, with strong agency management.
Data Analysis & Fluency: Comfortable working with member behaviour data, campaign analytics and dashboards to surface insight and drive continuous improvement. Tracks activity to outcomes, not outputs.
Communication & Brand Stewardship: Executes customer-facing communications with a consistent, on-brand voice across owned and paid channels. Brings sharp copywriting instincts, strong creative review judgment, and the ability to influence and align across global, regional and local teams with different cultures and working styles.
Execution & Project Management: Highly organised with a strong bias for delivery. Manages multiple workstreams simultaneously, ensuring projects adhere to timelines.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

We are looking for a marketer with 4+ years of experience in loyalty, CRM or lifecycle marketing, ideally within hospitality, travel, or a consumer brand environment.

Requirement

4-5 years of relevant professional experience in program management, marketing strategy, loyalty and lifecycle disciplines, digital or related function
Experience managing and directing strategic partners / agencies /vendors. Demonstrated relationship marketing skills a must.
Team player, proven ability to lead and work with cross-functional teams in support of specific business priorities
Languages: Proficiency in English required; proficiency in reading and writing in other Asian languages strongly preferred.

JOB SCOPE

Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing

Drive member growth, engagement and advocacy across APEC through loyalty-led initiatives that build program awareness, deepen usage and deliver locally relevant member value
Develop and execute the continent's loyalty marketing plan - spanning promotions, lifecycle programs and CRM strategy - aligned with global strategy and optimised for local market nuance
Define and manage CRM strategy across the full customer lifecycle: acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention and reactivation
Plan and execute loyalty-led campaigns across owned channels (email, app, digital) and paid channels (social, digital) with audience analysis, targeting, segmentation and performance tracking
Identify opportunities for segmentation, personalisation to deliver on deeper customer value optimisation; drive continuous improvement in CRM effectiveness and automation capabilities
 Leverage market research, member insights and data analytics to inform engagement strategies and personalised experiences
Design, implement and optimise loyalty programs that drive advocacy and revenue, delivering tangible value to target member segments
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including but not limited to MarTech, Enterprise Partnerships (Co-Brand, Airlines, Everyday Earn) and Loyalty Operations to integrate and orchestrate initiatives across key customer touchpoints
Serve as gatekeeper for all loyalty member communications, ensuring on-brand, accurate and effective execution

Performance Operations & Governance

Track and report program KPIs covering member acquisition, activation, retention, revenue contribution and repeat stay behaviour, with clear recommendations for improvement
Oversee CRM data accuracy, integrity and compliance across programs
Drive effective onboarding, training and adoption of loyalty programs and systems across property teams

Experiential Partnerships

Support the activation of global and regional marketing partnerships translating partnership rights into compelling, member-facing campaigns that drive high member engagement, leveraging on Marriott Bonvoy Moments
Ensure all partnership campaigns are executed in full alignment with partners, with rigorous agency management and end-to-end campaign planning
Support end-to-end event management and logistics planning for partnership activations, ensuring seamless on-ground execution and member experiences

Working Relations

Key interfaces:-

Area Directors of Marketing
Field Marketing team
Continent level agencies.

Integrated Marketing Planning

Supports development of continent destination marketing strategy and focused on key source markets and KPIs.
Monitor competitive activity in the category.

Promotions/ Partnerships

Partners with Revenue Strategy, develops and executes promotions/offers that drive KPIs for the continent or market (eg. Enrollment goals, direct channel goals, driving leisure revenue, etc.).
Partner with analytics team to ensure proper tracking and communication of all programs.

Integrated Marketing Execution

Develops marketing brief with clear KPIs and conducts kick off for all new programs.
Engages agencies in RFP process and project manages the creative design and execution process to bring a program to market. Ensures consumer messaging is clear.
Is responsible for ensuring all key stakeholders of the program are aligned.
Is responsible for communicating programs to the market and corporate teams and ensuring all channels are leveraged (social, digital, sales, etc).
Reviews program performance in real time and modifies program as needed.

Area/ Hotel Support

Partners with Directors of Field Marketing and other area marketing leaders.
Provides strong guidance on positioning and pull through of brands.
Advises field marketing on effective marketing communications planning, implementation and evaluation.
Conducts destination marketing training and develops resources and materials for Directors of Sales and Marketing with a focus on marketing planning, branding, positioning, messaging and storytelling.
Deal with own development of the process for new hotel ramp up and hotel positioning and messaging development. Partners with area marketing leaders to execute where needed.

MANAGEMENT COMPETENCIES

Leadership

Adaptability - Maintains performance level under pressure or when experiencing changes or challenges in the workplace.

Communication - Conveys information and ideas to others in a convincing and engaging manner through a variety of methods.

Problem Solving and Decision Making - Identifies and understands issues, problems, and opportunities; obtains and compares information from different sources to draw conclusions, develops and evaluates alternatives and solutions, solves problems, and chooses a course of action.
