title: Social Media & Content Designer
description:
Dr Scalp is a Singapore scalp and hair care brand with two studios, at Raffles City and The Centrepoint, and our own range of scalp and hair care products.

We use AI scalp scanning to show people what’s actually happening on their scalp, then treat it. It’s genuinely interesting to look at, and almost nobody has seen it before. We’re rebuilding this brand from the ground up, and a second AWHL brand joins in the next 6 to 12 months. What you build here is the foundation for both.

The Role

You’ll own our social end to end, filming in our studios, editing, designing, posting, replying, and telling us what’s working. You'll also design what customers see everywhere else. Emails, marketplace listings, website visuals and in-studio collateral.

What You’ll Do

Film & Photograph:

• Run batched shoot days across our two studios

• Film treatments, scan sessions, consultations, products and the team (always with consent captured first)

• Photograph products, studio spaces and before/after series to our photo standard

• Screen-record and capture scalp scan imagery as a repeatable content format

• Keep the raw asset library organised, named and backed up

Edit & Design:

• Edit short-form vertical video: cut, caption, subtitle, music, colour

• Produce static posts and carousels in Canva or Photoshop to brand templates

• Resize and re-version assets for Instagram, TikTok, the website and email

• Basic motion graphics and text animation

• Design EDM templates and campaign emails, working with the e-commerce team on the offer and copy

• Design marketplace listing images and enhanced content for Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop, to each platform's specification

• Design website banners, product imagery and landing page visuals

• Design in-studio collateral when we need it. Price displays, treatment menus, posters

• Keep everytouchpoint consistent, so the ad, the email, the listing and the studio wall look like the same company

Publish & Engage:

• Own the content calendar, planned at least four weeks ahead

• Write captions in our brand voice, with hashtags and alt text

• Reply to comments and DMs the same working day, and hand genuine enquiries to the booking team

• Liaise with UGC creators to bring in additional content

• Set up and maintain automated replies, saved responses and story highlights

Who We’re Looking For

• At least 3 years of experience, in-house or agency. If you've grown an account from a cold start, lead with that and tell us what you achieved

• You shoot and edit short-form vertical video independently, by phone or camera, in CapCut or Premiere

• Basic graphic design in Canva. Photoshop or Figma is an advantage

• You write clean, natural English captions

• You're comfortable being on camera

• You're organised enough to hold a four-week content calendar

• You're fluent in current TikTok and Instagram Reels trends. Formats, audio, what's working right now

• You can turn a reactive piece around within 24 hours when something is moving

• You're happy working across different locations with a camera kit, and the occasional evening or weekend for shoots and events

• You've designed for e-commerce or email before, or you can show us layout work that isn't social

• Beauty, wellness or aesthetics experience is a plus, not a requirement

This Role Is Not For You If…

• You need to be reminded to meet deadlines

• You post content only when inspired. Consistency is not your strong suit

• You wait to be told what to do instead of spotting opportunities yourself

• You're looking for a slow, structured corporate environment

• You treat social media as a side hobby, not a craft

DrScalp is a pioneer in advanced scalp health solutions, and is a Singapore-based, science-driven scalp-care clinic offering AI analysis and advanced treatments for healthier hair and scalp.

Our mission

To provide our customers with customised treatments that address the root cause of scalp issues like hair loss, dandruff and inflammation. We combine state-of-the-art technology with personalised care to help you achieve healthier hair from the scalp up.

Our Vision

We believe that everyone deserves healthy, beautiful hair and that starts with proper scalp care. Our vision at DrScalp is to make cutting-edge scalp treatments accessible to everyone, ensuring long-term health and visible results. We’re here to transform the way you think about scalp health.

Our Commitment

We are committed to not only providing the best treatments but also educating our customers. We believe in empowering everyone with the knowledge to maintain a healthy scalp long after they leave our centre. From your first consultation to ongoing care, we’ll be with you every step of the way.

title: B2B Marketing Lead
description:
The Role

We’re looking for a commercially minded marketing lead to shape and deliver programmes that generate enterprise demand, build pipeline and strengthen Intellect’s presence across priority markets.

You’ll translate business priorities into focused marketing plans and own their execution, bringing together campaigns, events, partner marketing, digital channels, content and prospect lifecycle marketing. Alongside demand generation, you’ll help sharpen how we communicate our solutions, bring offerings to market and improve the effectiveness of our marketing activity.

Working closely with sales, product and content marketing, and local commercial teams, you’ll make decisions about where to focus, coordinate the support needed and carry initiatives through from idea to commercial results. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys combining strategic judgement with execution and building a more effective, repeatable marketing engine.

Your Responsibilities

Marketing Planning & Commercial Priorities

Translate business and market priorities into practical marketing plans, with clear audiences, objectives, budgets and measures of success.

Identify the campaigns, channels and opportunities most likely to generate relevant demand, balancing immediate commercial needs with longer-term market presence.

Own delivery across your marketing programmes, coordinating internal contributors, creative support and external partners.

Review results with commercial stakeholders and recommend where to invest, refine or stop activity.

Integrated Campaigns & Demand Generation

Plan and execute integrated campaigns targeting priority industries, enterprise accounts and decision-makers.

Bring together email, events, webinars, partner channels, content distribution and selective paid activity to generate qualified demand and commercial opportunities.

Own campaign delivery, including audience targeting, briefs, landing pages, email sequences and launch coordination.

Improve digital discovery and conversion across relevant website journeys, search and campaign channels, working with specialist support where needed.

Events & Partner Marketing

Lead the marketing execution of webinars, roundtables, industry conferences and other selected events, from assessing opportunities and shaping the proposition to promotion, delivery and follow-up.

Develop joint marketing programmes with partners, associations and industry communities to extend Intellect’s reach and credibility.

Work with sales to engage relevant prospects before and after events, turning participation into qualified conversations and opportunities.

Evaluate event and partnership performance to guide future activity and investment.

Prospect Lifecycle & Conversion

Build and run prospect nurture programmes across the enterprise buying cycle, including event follow-up, ongoing education and reactivation of dormant leads.

Personally manage audience segmentation, email campaigns and marketing automation workflows to deliver relevant, coordinated communications.

Align with sales on qualification, lead routing, handover and follow-up so marketing engagement translates into timely commercial action.

Use engagement data, funnel performance and sales feedback to improve lead quality and progression.

Market Positioning & Go-to-Market Support

Help translate Intellect’s solutions into clear, compelling messages for different buyers, industries and markets, working with product and content marketing.

Partner with local commercial teams to adapt marketing plans to buyer needs and support market expansion and the launch of relevant offerings.

Shape briefs and contribute to customer stories, campaign content and sales materials, drawing on expertise from clinical, product and commercial teams.

Strengthen Intellect’s visibility and credibility through consistent messaging and the distribution of thought leadership, customer evidence and expert perspectives.

Marketing Performance & Operations

Maintain a clear marketing calendar, reliable campaign tracking and visibility into performance across key programmes.

Assess results through qualified engagement, sales-accepted opportunities, pipeline contribution and conversion, using findings to improve activity and budget allocation.

Work with sales and the relevant CRM or revenue operations owner to strengthen reporting, attribution and shared processes.

Build reusable templates and workflows, using AI and automation thoughtfully to improve execution speed, quality and consistency.

Requirements

An experienced B2B marketer. You have personally owned and delivered marketing programmes for business audiences, ideally involving enterprise buyers and considered purchasing decisions. We value demonstrated scope, judgement and results over a particular title.

Able to shape the plan and deliver it. You can turn commercial objectives into clear priorities, choose an appropriate channel mix and carry work through without needing every step prescribed.

A hands-on owner. You’re comfortable moving between planning, campaign setup, copy and briefs, CRM execution and performance analysis, bringing in support where it adds the most value.

Comfortable across marketing disciplines. You bring practical depth in demand generation, events or webinars, and email nurture, with the ability to connect these to messaging, content and digital channels.

Commercially and analytically minded. You understand enterprise sales cycles and can explain how your work generated relevant demand, improved conversion or contributed to pipeline.

Confident with marketing tools. You can build segments, launch email journeys, configure straightforward automation and use CRM and campaign reporting to guide decisions.

A strong communicator and collaborator. You can develop effective copy and briefs, make complex solutions understandable, and align sales, subject-matter experts and external partners around a clear objective.

Resourceful and organised. You make sensible trade-offs, manage budgets and multiple workstreams reliably, and deliver within a lean environment.

Motivated by the mission. You’re excited to help expand access to mental healthcare and build marketing programmes that support meaningful business growth.

Intellect (

intellect.co

) is a venture-backed digital health company reinventing how mental health is in Asia. Our goal is to make it simple, easy and stigma-free for everyone.

We're building an entirely new way for modern organisations to easily provide support for their employees’ mental health & mental wellbeing, no matter where they are on their journey.

Join us on our mission to eliminate barriers to mental health and to create a wellbeing approach that people love using.

title: Regional Associate Marketing Manager
description:
About the Company

Our client is a leading multinational medical technology company dedicated to developing innovative healthcare solutions that improve patient outcomes and advance clinical practice. With a strong international presence, the organisation is committed to delivering high-quality products and supporting healthcare professionals through innovation, education and customer-centric solutions.

Job Summary

We are seeking a driven and commercially minded Assistant Marketing Manager to support the development and execution of regional marketing strategies across Southeast Asia. This role will work closely with regional and country commercial teams to drive product growth, strengthen market positioning and support business objectives across the region.

The ideal candidate has experience in medical device or healthcare marketing, with a strong understanding of product marketing, campaign execution and stakeholder management. The candidate should be comfortable working in a matrix multinational environment and translating regional marketing strategies into effective local market initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Regional Marketing Strategy & Execution

Support the development and implementation of regional marketing plans aligned with business objectives and growth priorities.

Coordinate marketing activities across SEA markets, ensuring alignment with regional strategies and local market needs.

Work closely with country teams to identify market opportunities, address business challenges and drive marketing effectiveness.

Monitor market trends, competitor activities and customer insights to support strategic planning and decision-making.

Product Marketing & Management

Support product launches, portfolio development and lifecycle management initiatives across the region.

Develop product positioning, value propositions and marketing materials tailored to target customer segments.

Translate product features and clinical benefits into compelling marketing messages for healthcare professionals and other relevant stakeholders.

Collaborate with global and regional teams to adapt product campaigns and marketing assets for local market requirements.

Campaigns & Demand Generation

Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns, including digital marketing, events, exhibitions, workshops and customer engagement initiatives.

Support the development of sales enablement tools, presentations, brochures and other promotional materials.

Partner with commercial teams to strengthen customer engagement, generate leads and support sales growth.

Evaluate campaign performance and recommend improvements based on market feedback and key performance indicators.

Stakeholder & Cross-functional Collaboration

Collaborate with regional sales, product management, clinical, medical affairs and global marketing teams to ensure effective execution of marketing initiatives.

Support the planning and execution of product training, clinical education programmes and regional marketing events.

Build strong working relationships with country stakeholders to drive alignment and consistent brand messaging across SEA.

Coordinate with external agencies and vendors to deliver marketing projects within agreed timelines and budgets.

Performance Tracking & Compliance

Track marketing expenditure, campaign effectiveness and key performance indicators to assess return on marketing investment.

Prepare regular reports on marketing activities, market developments and business performance.

Ensure all marketing materials and activities comply with applicable healthcare regulations, company policies and local market requirements.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline.

Approximately 8 years of experience in marketing, preferably within the medical technology, medical device, pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.

Experience in product marketing, regional marketing or integrated marketing campaign execution will be an advantage.

Strong commercial acumen and the ability to connect marketing initiatives with business and sales objectives.

Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders in a multinational or matrix organisation.

Good understanding of digital marketing, customer engagement and marketing performance measurement.

Excellent communication, presentation, project management and stakeholder management skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects, work independently and collaborate effectively with teams across different markets.

Willingness to travel within Southeast Asia when required.

title: Social Media & Creative Intern
description:
Social Media & Creative Intern

Tiger & Lotus | Singapore Paid Internship: SGD 800/month Minimum commitment: 3 months

We’re not looking for someone to just “manage social media.”

We’re looking for someone who wants to learn how a brand is built visually, emotionally and creatively.

At Tiger & Lotus, you’ll work closely with a designer, with hands-on mentorship throughout the internship. You’ll be encouraged to experiment, ask questions, bring ideas and understand the thinking behind the work, not just execute tasks.

This is for someone who notices details. Someone who saves interesting campaigns, takes photos because the light looks beautiful, plays with AI, writes captions in their head and is curious about why certain brands feel different.

What you’ll get to create

• Shoot photos, videos and Reels in-store, at events and behind the scenes

• Create content for Instagram and other social platforms

• Work with our designer to develop visual ideas and campaign concepts

• Experiment with AI image generation and new creative tools

• Write captions and stories in the Tiger & Lotus voice

• Create and update website copy and product descriptions

• Help develop EDMs and newsletters

• Assist with social and content calendars

• Research visual trends, creators, sounds, campaigns and cultural ideas

• Support launches, collaborations, shoots and in-store events

• Turn products into stories rather than just posts

• Bring us ideas we haven’t thought of yet

What makes this internship different

You won’t be sitting on the sidelines.

You’ll be involved in real projects for a growing independent brand and will see how an idea moves from a conversation to a moodboard, a photograph, a campaign, a website story and eventually something a customer sees.

You’ll work alongside a designer and receive mentorship, feedback and guidance throughout the internship.

You’ll have room to explore areas you’re particularly interested in, whether that’s photography, content creation, design, AI, writing, branding or storytelling.

We want you to leave with real work for your portfolio and a much deeper understanding of how a creative brand comes together.

You might be our person if

…

• You have a strong visual instinct

• You love art, interiors, fashion, jewellery, photography or design

• You understand Instagram and short-form content naturally

• You enjoy writing and storytelling

• You’re curious about AI and emerging creative tools

• You know Canva; Adobe skills are a bonus

• You’re comfortable taking photos and videos

• You notice the little things

• You’re independent but also enjoy collaborating

• You’re willing to try something, get feedback and make it better

You don’t need an impressive CV.

Show us how you think and what you create.

That could be your Instagram, TikTok, photography, writing, university project, moodboards, AI visuals, a campaign idea or something completely personal.

The details

Location: Tiger & Lotus, 317 Joo Chiat Road, Singapore Internship allowance: SGD 800/month Commitment: Minimum 3 months Type: Paid internship

Tiger & Lotus is an independent Singapore lifestyle brand bringing together artisanal homeware, jewellery, fashion, art and extraordinary objects from around the world.

We like things with character, stories and a little unexpectedness.

If that sounds like your kind of world, we’d love to meet you.

And tell us one thing:

What brand, creator or Instagram account do you think is doing something genuinely interesting right now and why?

Write to us at hello@tigerandlotus.com

Strategy and channel ownership

Apply sound creative judgement and streamlined approvals, considering audience relevance, cultural sensitivity and reputation. Test approaches and apply learning.

Social media expertise across departments

Advise and support all departments on audiences, channels, content, campaign planning, organic and paid amplification, and performance measurement.
Help develop briefs, review content and coordinate corporate and departmental channel support. Agree delivery responsibilities and priorities according to departmental needs and capacity.
Provide templates, coaching and training; maintain social media standards and review departmental accounts to strengthen effectiveness and brand coherence.

Community engagement and reputation

Manage comments, messages and moderation; coordinate responses and route enquiries to relevant teams.
Use social listening to identify audience needs, sentiment and emerging issues. Escalate concerns and implement approved responses with Corporate Communications under agreed protocols.

Campaigns agencies and performance

Serve as SG Enable’s internal social media subject matter expert for all departments and Business Units, including those without their own accounts. Provide strategic advice and practical support for their programmes, services, campaigns and initiatives.
Work with Brand Marketing, Public Education, Enabling Village, Digital, Media and Partnerships colleagues on campaign plans, creator collaborations and amplification. Manage agreed paid social activity within approved media plans and budgets.
Manage the social media agency’s briefs, scope, quality, timelines, budget and KPIs; balance agency and in-house production and support procurement and evaluation with Marketing Excellence.

Degree in Communications, Marketing, Digital Media or a related field.

Proven ability to grow engaged audiences and create effective content for Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram and TikTok, with strong English writing, editorial judgement and hands-on photography and short-form video skills.
Experience in agency and budget management, paid social, community engagement, social listening and issues management.

title: Communications Executive
description:
We're Hiring: Communications Executive

Quintessential Education | Full-Time or Part-Time | Orchard Road, Singapore

About QE

Quintessential Education is Singapore's leading provider of pre-tertiary academic programmes (IGCSE & IB) and university admissions advisory for top-tier global universities — Ivy League, Oxbridge, and NUS/NTU/SMU. Since 2012 we have worked with more than 700 students, and most of our new families come to us through referrals. We deliver a fully integrated journey for families: academic mastery, guardianship, and university placement under one roof.

We aim to bring out the best in our students, ignite opportunities and nurture them towards success.

We are looking for committed and talented additions to our team. As an ideal candidate, you should display a proven ability to develop and maintain an environment of trust, diversity, and inclusion within the QE team. You should be able to work with the team to meet deadlines and instill a culture of continuous work improvement.

As part of the position, you will work with the founders, Ivy League and Oxbridge graduates and other high-performing teammates.

The Role

We're looking for a Communications Executive to own the day-to-day relationship between QE and our families. You'll be the first person a parent speaks to when they enquire, and the person who keeps them informed once their child is with us. That means answering enquiries every day, matching students with the right tutors and mentors, and following up with students and parents regularly so nothing slips through.

You'll also help keep our marketing materials and partner relationships in good order. We are open to full-time or part-time candidates, so tell us the arrangement that works for you.

If you're a confident communicator in both English and Mandarin*, stay calm and warm with demanding parents, and like being the person who makes sure things actually get done — we'd love to meet you.

*As a major group of customers are from China and are only able to converse in Mandarin.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Enquiries & Enrolment

Respond to daily parent and student enquiries via phone, WhatsApp, WeChat, and email, ideally within the same working day.

Explain our IGCSE, IB, and admissions programmes clearly and recommend the right fit for each student.

Match students with suitable tutors and mentors, and arrange trial lessons and consultations.

Track every enquiry through to enrolment and follow up with families who have not yet decided.

2. Student Follow-Up & Parent Relations

Check in regularly with enrolled students and parents on progress, attendance, and any concerns.

Collect lesson feedback from students and tutors, and deal with issues early before they become complaints.

Arrange class schedules, replacement lessons, and changes with tutors and families.

Keep parents informed ahead of key moments: exam periods, predicted grades, application deadlines, and results day.

Follow up on renewals and next-stage programmes (e.g. IGCSE to IB, IB to university applications).

3. Business Operations

Prepare and track invoices and payments.

Draft and manage service agreements for clients and tutors.

Keep client records, notes, and follow-up schedules up to date.

Keep a simple monthly record of enquiries, enrolments, and renewals for the founders.

4. Marketing & Partnerships

Keep brochures, website content, and newsletters accurate and up to date.

Work with design and digital marketing agencies on campaigns and collateral.

Support parent seminars and events, including Mandarin-language sessions with our China school partners.

Maintain relationships with partner schools, education consultants, and collaborators.

We're Looking For Someone Who:

Has experience in a client-facing role such as education, admissions, client services, or customer service. Fresh graduates with strong communication skills are welcome to apply.

Has excellent verbal and written communication in English and Chinese. This is required as some Chinese customers can only communicate in Chinese. Japanese and Korean are a bonus as some customers only communicate in these languages.

Is calm, warm, and professional with high-expectation parents, and comfortable handling difficult conversations.

Is highly organised, follows up without being reminded, and keeps clear records.

Can manage many families and a busy inbox at the same time without losing track of details.

Is proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), Notion or Airtable, and marketing tools (Mailchimp, Canva).

Is comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) and light automation to streamline workflows.

Bonus If You:

Have experience in the education, tuition, or admissions sector.

Know the IB, IGCSE, or university application process (UK, US, or Singapore).

Are familiar with WeChat or Xiaohongshu.

Working Hours

Location: 545 Orchard Road, #14-06/9, Singapore 238882. In Person role.

Start Date: As soon as possible

Commitment: Full-time or part-time. Propose the days and hours that suit you in your application.

Full-time: 5-day work week, Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, 4 days in office and 1 day remote

Part-time: Days and hours by arrangement, with enough weekday cover to keep up with daily enquiries

Salary & Benefits

Monthly Salary: $4,500 upwards for full-time, depending on experience; pro-rated for part-time

Bonuses: Additional performance and team-based bonuses apply

Benefits Include: $500 Specialist Stipend per annum (e.g. medical or mental health support), $100 Dental Stipend per annum, $500 Personal Development Stipend per annum (for courses, books, conferences, etc.)

How to Apply

Send your CV and a short paragraph on why you're interested in the role to hr@qeducation.sg with the subject line: Application – Communications Executive (Full Time / Part Time)

We look forward to hearing from people who want to make a real difference to the families we work with.

title: Integrated Marketing Manager CFD/Financial Industry
description:

title: Digital Content Specialist
description:
SL Aesthetic Group is a leading name in the aesthetics and wellness industry, with a diverse portfolio of established brands, including SL Aesthetic Clinic, SkinLab The Medical Spa, TrichoLab, Prologue, and Euphie. Each brand is dedicated to delivering premium experiences and effective results through professional expertise, innovation, and care.

Job Description

Content Strategy & Creative Ideation

Explore industry trends, audience behaviour, search demand and competitor insights to identify content gaps, emerging topics and opportunities for differentiation.

Develop and maintain a strategic content calendar that balances editorial priorities, audience interests, search opportunities and business objectives.

Pitch fresh ideas, compelling angles and distinctive content formats that engage audiences across different levels of knowledge and experience.

Build content strategies around audience needs and search intent, creating meaningful connections between what people want to know, what the brand can offer and what the business aims to achieve.

Editorial Voice & Written Content

Write and edit clear, engaging and well-researched content across blogs, articles, email newsletters, websites, landing pages, advertisements and social media.

Establish a strong editorial voice that makes complex concepts accessible, builds audience trust and differentiates the brand from competitors.

Balance editorial quality, originality and storytelling with search visibility, audience engagement and commercial objectives, ensuring content delivers value beyond rankings and traffic.

Translate complex topics into useful, relatable and easy-to-understand content without oversimplifying important information or losing the brand's point of view.

Apply strong editorial judgement to research, fact-checking, content structuring and editing, maintaining accuracy, clarity and consistency across all formats.

SEO, AI Search & Content Discoverability

Apply SEO fundamentals and advanced content optimisation techniques to improve organic visibility across traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered search experiences.

Structure content to support discoverability across search engine results, AI-generated answers and other relevant discovery platforms, using clear information architecture, descriptive headings, relevant entities and well-organised, authoritative content.

Understand how search intent, topical authority, internal linking, content depth and source credibility influence content discovery, and apply these principles throughout the content development process.

Monitor developments in AI search, answer engines and changing search behaviour to identify new opportunities for content visibility, brand mentions and citations.

Use relevant SEO and AI search tools to research topics, evaluate content performance and identify opportunities for optimisation, while maintaining original thinking, editorial integrity and human oversight.

Visual Content

Collaborate with designers to translate editorial ideas and complex information into engaging infographics, charts, illustrations and other visual formats.

Use AI-powered tools to create and refine infographics, data visualisations and supporting graphics that make complex concepts easier to understand and complement written content.

Performance Analytics & Optimisation

Track and analyse content performance across relevant metrics, including organic traffic, search visibility, AI citations and brand mentions, engagement, conversions and audience retention.

Interpret performance data to understand what resonates with audiences, identify content gaps and inform future editorial and distribution strategies.

Conduct experiments with headlines, content formats, visuals, calls to action and page structures to improve content effectiveness.

Conduct regular content audits to identify opportunities to refresh, consolidate, expand or repurpose existing content based on audience needs, search trends and business priorities.

Translate insights into actionable recommendations that improve content quality, discoverability and contribution to business goals.

AI-Assisted Content Development

Use AI-powered tools to support research, ideation, content analysis, workflow efficiency and optimisation, while applying sound editorial judgement and human oversight.

Evaluate AI-generated outputs critically, verifying factual accuracy, identifying generic or unsupported claims, and ensuring content reflects the brand's original perspective and editorial standards.

Identify opportunities to integrate AI into content workflows responsibly, improving efficiency without compromising originality, quality or audience trust.

Requirements

A bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, or a related field.

Minimum 2 years of experience as a Content Creator, Content Writer, or similar, with a portfolio that showcases versatility and creativity.

Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading abilities as well as the skill to switch tone depending on platform and audience.

Experience producing content for blogs, websites, and platforms such as X, Telegram, Discord, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, etc.

A solid grasp of SEO, content marketing, and digital storytelling.

Familiarity with CMS tools and social publishing platforms.

Strong research skills, especially when navigating medical aesthetics topics.

Ability to handle multiple projects at once, stay organised, and deliver on time.

A creative eye, a hunger to experiment, and a genuine love for creating great content.

A growth mindset, always improving, always learning.

About the Role

SICCI is seeking a proactive and hands-on Assistant Manager / Manager to lead digital marketing activities, strengthen audience engagement and support membership growth and event participation.

The role combines content creation, campaign management, digital platform management and practical use of AI tools. You will work closely with the CEO, membership and events teams, relevant Board committees and external partners to communicate SICCI’s value to members and the wider business community.

Appointment at Assistant Manager or Manager level will depend on relevant experience and capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Digital Marketing and Content Creation

Develop and implement digital marketing plans aligned with SICCI’s priorities, membership initiatives and events.

Manage a monthly content calendar across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, email, the website and other approved channels.

Research, write, edit and publish engaging content, including social media posts, newsletters, website updates and promotional materials.

Create or coordinate visuals, short videos and event content, adapting materials to each platform and target audience.

Maintain consistent branding, messaging and content quality across communications.

Audience Engagement and Campaign Management

Manage social media publishing, community engagement and responses to enquiries, coordinating with relevant colleagues where necessary.

Plan and execute campaigns promoting SICCI membership, events, programmes and business opportunities.

Use audience insights and platform analytics to improve content, targeting and campaign effectiveness.

Develop clear calls to action and support enquiry and registration pathways through landing pages, forms, email campaigns and tracked links.

Membership Growth and Engagement

Collaborate with the membership team on campaigns to attract prospective members and communicate membership benefits.

Support audience segmentation, lead generation, enquiry nurturing and follow-up communications.

Maintain accurate lead records and coordinate the handover of qualified enquiries to the membership team.

Support membership renewal and re-engagement communications.

Event Marketing and Communications

Work with the events team to develop promotional plans and attendee communications.

Coordinate promotional content with speakers, partners and sponsors.

Monitor registration trends and adjust promotional activities where needed.

Support event content capture, publicity and post-event communications.

Provide on-site marketing and communications support for events when required.

Website, App and Performance Reporting

Keep website and SICCI app content, event listings and member information accurate and current.

Coordinate with vendors or technical teams to improve navigation, enquiry capture and registration journeys.

Track and analyse content performance, audience engagement, website traffic, enquiries and registrations.

Prepare regular reports with insights and recommendations to improve marketing activities.

AI Tools and Workflow Improvement

Use AI tools to support research, content development, repurposing, reporting and campaign preparation.

Develop reusable prompts, templates and workflows to improve efficiency and consistency.

Explore suitable automation and AI-assisted processes, subject to SICCI’s approval and review requirements.

Verify information and ensure accuracy, appropriate tone and confidentiality before publication.

Share practical tools and improvements with colleagues.

Job Requirements

Diploma or degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

Relevant experience in digital marketing, content creation, communications or growth marketing, with the ability to manage campaigns independently.

Strong English writing, editing and communication skills.

Hands-on experience managing social media platforms and using tools such as Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn analytics and email marketing platforms.

Familiarity with website content management, web analytics such as Google Analytics 4, and CRM systems or lead trackers.

Ability to create or coordinate visual and video content; proficiency in Canva or similar tools is an advantage.

Practical experience using AI tools for professional tasks, with sound judgment in reviewing and verifying outputs.

Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.

Experience in B2B marketing, membership organisations, business associations, events or engagement with SMEs is an advantage.

SINGAPORE INDIAN CHAMBER OF COMMERCE & INDUSTRY (SICCI)

Singapore Indian Chamber of Commerce is one of the oldest establishments in Singapore. From humble beginnings in 1924, SICCI has emerged as one of Singapore‘s most respected and active commercial organisations today with close to 1000 members.

Offering members a diverse range of services to meet their business needs, SICCI provides a diverse range of services to meet their business needs. Its subsidiaries – SICCI Trade Match, SME Centre@SICCI and SICCI-Institute of Business – combine to actively promote the development of its members and provide the necessary networking opportunities and linkages for its members to grow their businesses and operations locally and globally.

As the body representing the Singapore Indian business community, SICCI serves as the community’s spokesman at various private and public sector platforms sector platforms in Singapore. Apart from its role in the business environment, it plays a leading role in the promotion of social welfare and in Singapore’s nation building.

title: Associate/ Senior Associate, Marketing
description:
GLG is looking to hire a Marketing Associate to join our South APAC marketing team, covering Australia, New Zealand, India, and Southeast Asia. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role for a digital marketer with proven experience across SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation), and paid digital channels — someone who can own workstreams independently, connect data to strategy, and drive measurable results across a complex, multi-market region.

You will work closely with the Senior Marketing Manager to plan and execute integrated campaigns, lifecycle programmes, and organic and paid digital strategies across the South APAC region, spanning three business segments: Corporate, Financial Services, and Consulting.

This role requires at least two years of relevant working experience. We are not looking for a generalist — we need someone who can hit the ground running, take strategic ownership of digital and content workstreams, and proactively identify opportunities.

Campaign Execution & Lifecycle Marketing

Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across email, paid, and organic channels for the South APAC region in collaboration with the Senior Marketing Manager — from strategy to deployment to optimisation.
Own lifecycle campaign workstreams end-to-end: audience segmentation, copy, trigger logic, CTA design, and post-launch analysis.
Independently analyse campaign performance data and translate findings into segment-specific, market-specific recommendations.
Proactively identify performance gaps, content opportunities, and activation levers.

SEO, GEO & Organic Traffic

Execute the regional SEO and GEO roadmap in collaboration with the Senior Marketing Manager, covering ANZ, India, and SEA: keyword research, on-page optimisation, content gap analysis, and content development optimised for AI discovery surfaces (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) — including knowing how to brief the global digital team on GEO implementation requirements.
Conduct keyword research and map findings to specific page update recommendations with a prioritised execution timeline.
Collaborate with the global digital team to implement geo-targeted page variations (cookie-based or IP-based) for localised search demand.
Monitor and report on organic traffic, AI assistant referral traffic, keyword rankings, and search share of voice by region on a regular cadence.
Provide written SEO and GEO optimisation recommendations for all new and existing localised website content and landing pages prior to publication.

Paid Digital & SEM

Support the planning and independently manage paid search (SEM), retargeting, and display advertising campaigns for the South APAC region, including campaign setup, audience targeting, bid strategy, and budget management.
Execute and optimise paid media campaigns that complement organic efforts — particularly where organic reach is limited or where time-to-impact requires a paid lever.
Analyse paid performance data by market and channel, and provide actionable recommendations to improve CTR, CPL, and conversion efficiency.
Contribute a strong point of view on paid channel strategy — identify best practices, test hypotheses, and make data-driven recommendations on what to run, where, and for whom.

Content Development & Strategy

Create and adapt marketing content — email copy, landing pages, digital ads, campaign briefs — that speaks directly to each segment's client engagement context, not generic product descriptions.
Understand how GLG's clients use the platform in practice and reflect that in copy.
Stay current on GLG's product updates, new capability launches, and platform features, and proactively identify how these can be incorporated into campaign content.
Conduct competitor and market research to inform content strategy and identify positioning opportunities.

Data, Reporting & Analytical Ownership

Independently compile and share a regular digital performance dashboard covering web traffic by region, keyword and paid media performance, email engagement metrics, and lead activation data.
Produce analysis that goes beyond reporting numbers: identify the why behind performance patterns, flag issues and propose specific next steps.
Work with Salesforce, Marketo, GA4, Google Search Console, and SEMrush to surface insights and track campaign effectiveness.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication

Coordinate with Business Development, Business Unit, and Marketing Operations stakeholders across ANZ, India, and SEA to align on campaign priorities, audience lists, and content direction.
Submit all deliverables with clear context.

Requirements

Minimum 2 years of working experience in digital marketing, ideally in a B2B or professional services context.
Hands-on SEO experience: keyword research, on-page optimisation, content gap analysis, and performance monitoring using tools such as SEMrush, Google Search Console, and GA4.
GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) knowledge: understanding of how AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) surface content, and how to write and brief content that performs well on these channels — this is a growing and important channel for our region.
SEM and paid digital experience: campaign setup and management across Google Ads and/or LinkedIn, including retargeting and display. Able to develop and execute paid strategies independently and make data-driven optimisation decisions.
Email marketing and marketing automation: experience building and executing lifecycle campaigns in Marketo or equivalent, including audience segmentation, trigger logic, and A/B testing.
Strong analytical skills: ability to work with performance data across multiple channels and markets, identify what the data means, and translate findings into specific recommended actions — not just summaries.
Content development: ability to write clear, audience-appropriate marketing copy for B2B audiences, with an understanding of how different audience types use services differently.
Excellent communication

Experience & Skills — Preferred

Familiarity with Salesforce CRM for campaign tracking and lead management.
Experience working across multiple markets in Asia Pacific simultaneously.
Familiarity with technical SEO concepts and how to brief global or specialist teams on implementation requirements.
Understanding of B2B audience segmentation across corporate, financial services, and professional services verticals.

About GLG / Gerson Lehrman Group

GLG is the world's leading platform for trusted human expertise. We connect global decision-makers—from hedge fund managers and private equity partners to strategy leaders at Fortune 500s—with the specific, authoritative voices required to answer their most critical questions.

Job Purpose

The Marketing Officer supports the planning, coordination, and execution of partnership initiatives, events, sales enablement activities, and marketing campaigns across Stellar Lifestyle and Stellar Ace ecosystem.

The role works closely with sales teams, internal business units, brand partners, sponsors, tenants, merchants, vendors and other stakeholders to develop impactful partnership opportunities, event activations, sales materials and marketing initiatives that drive business growth, brand awareness, customer engagement, and stakeholder value.

Through the successful delivery of collaborations, campaigns, and activations across transit, retail, lifestyle and media platforms, the Marketing Officer plays a key role in supporting revenue opportunities, strengthening partner relationships, and enhancing the Stellar Lifestyle ecosystem.

Support the planning, coordination, and execution of partnership initiatives, sponsorship opportunities, sales pitches and marketing outreach activities.
Assist in the preparation of pitch decks, proposals, presentations, sales kits, and marketing collaterals to support advertising, partnership, and outreach efforts.

Maintain proper records of sales materials, partner databases, and follow-up documentation.

Events & Activations

Support on-site event requirements, including setup, manpower planning, publicity materials, stakeholder briefings and event-day support.
Assist in tracking event deliverables, timelines, budgets and post-event reporting.

Marketing & Communications Support

Support the development of marketing collaterals, campaign materials, communication assets, and promotional content for partnerships and events
Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors on creative assets, publicity materials, digital content, and campaign requirements.

Administrative Support

Provide administrative support for marketing, partnerships, and event-related activities, including scheduling, documentation, filing and coordination.
Assist with procurement processes, including vendor quotations, PR/PO submissions, invoice processing, payment follow-ups and budget tracking.
Maintain organized records of contracts, campaign materials, event documentation, partner correspondence, and supporting documents for audit and reporting purposes.
Perform other duties and ad-hoc tasks as assigned to support departmental operations and business objectives.
Qualifications & Work Experience
Diploma in Marketing, Business, Communications, Events Management, or a related field.
Candidates with 1–2 years of marketing, communications, digital, retail marketing, or campaign management experience are preferred.
Fresh graduates with a positive attitude, strong learning mindset, and relevant internship experience may be considered.
Experience in events, retail marketing, partnerships, media, advertising or stakeholder coordination will be advantageous.
Skills
Coordination Skills: Able to support multiple marketing, partnership, and event-related tasks while keeping track of timelines and deliverables.

Organisational Skills: Meticulous and structured in managing documentation, schedules, marketing assets, event requirements, and follow-up items.
Marketing Knowledge: Basic understanding of marketing campaigns, events, social media, digital platforms, and customer engagement.
Technical Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Office, Teams, Outlook, PowerPoint, and other commonly used presentation or reporting tools.
Creative and Design Sense: Able to assist with simple presentation layouts, marketing collaterals, and content coordination, with a good eye for detail.
Problem-Solving Attitude: Resourceful, proactive, and willing to learn, with the ability to remain calm and helpful during events or tight timelines.
Team Player: Positive disposition and collaborative mindset, with willingness to support on-site activities and cross-functional initiatives.

Retail and Advertising Solutions & Services Partner

Stellar Lifestyle is the largest managing agent of retail and advertising spaces in Singapore’s rail network. We create vibrant transit destinations through continuous innovation and a desire to make our everyday touchpoints better. Our expertise also includes retail mall management, outdoor media & digital advertising solutions, and digital engagement platforms.

description:

Sales & Marketing Manager / Assistant Manager (Brand & Bakery)

Department

Sales & Marketing

General Manager (day-to-day); Chief Executive Officer (brand direction)

Direct Reports

Employment Type

Salary Range

Assistant Manager: S$3,300 – S$3,800 Manager: S$3,800 – S$4,300

(Final offer commensurate with experience and portfolio)

1.

Job Purpose

The Sales & Marketing Manager / Assistant Manager owns the full marketing portfolio of Keong Saik Bakery and is accountable for translating the founder’s vision for the brand into a coherent, commercially effective marketing programme across our retail outlets, e-commerce, and corporate / B2B channels.

This is a standalone role. The successful candidate will be the company’s only dedicated marketing resource, and must therefore be equally comfortable setting direction and executing it personally – from building and maintaining the marketing framework and managing the marketing budget, through to shooting content, briefing printers, and installing collateral at outlet level.

The role suits a self-motivated individual who is energised by building something from the ground up in a small, fast-moving business, and who understands that marketing is ultimately accountable for commercial outcomes and not activity alone.

2.

Key Responsibilities

a. Marketing Framework& Brand Direction

i.

Framework Ownership:

Develop, document, and own the company’s marketing framework, covering brand positioning, target audience, channel strategy, content pillars, campaign calendar, and partnership approach.

ii.

Relevance & Refresh:

Review and refresh the framework at least annually, and on an ad hoc basis where market conditions require, so that it remains relevant to consumer trends, competitor activity, and the company’s commercial priorities.

iii.

Alignment to Brand Vision:

Ensure all marketing direction, tone of voice, and visual identity remain aligned with the founder’s vision for the brand. Where the post-holder wishes to evolve the brand expression, this is to be proposed to and agreed with the Chief Executive Officer and General Manager before execution.

iv.

Campaign Planning:

Translate the framework into a rolling campaign calendar covering seasonal and festive campaigns, product launches, and always-on activity, with sufficient lead time for production and operational readiness.

b. Digital Content Creation

i.

Content Production:

Plan, shoot, and edit all digital content – photography, videography, and short-form video – for social media, website, e-commerce, and third-party delivery platforms.

ii.

Visual Storytelling:

Lead and conduct all product and lifestyle photoshoots, coordinating with the kitchen, outlet teams, and external vendors as required.

iii.

Copywriting:

Write all brand-facing copy, including social captions, EDM content, website and product descriptions, menu copy, and campaign messaging.

iv.

Asset Management:

Maintain an organised content and asset library so that approved images, videos, and copy are readily retrievable by the wider team.

c. Physical Marketing Materials

i.

Design:

Design all physical marketing collateral, including menus, posters, banners, buntings, flyers, table talkers, packaging inserts, and point-of-sale displays.

ii.

Print & Vendor Management:

Source, brief, and manage print and fabrication vendors – obtaining quotations, checking proofs and colour accuracy, and controlling cost and lead times.

iii.

Installation & Upkeep:

Take personal responsibility for the installation, rotation, and upkeep of physical collateral at both outlets, ensuring displays are current, correctly sited, and in good condition. This is a hands-on responsibility and not one that is delegated to outlet teams by default.

iv.

Approvals:

Obtain any landlord, building management, or regulatory approvals required for external signage, displays, or promotional installations.

d. Marketing Budget

i.

Budget Development:

Propose an annual marketing budget, broken down by channel, campaign, and expense category, for approval by the General Manager and Chief Executive Officer.

ii.

Budget Management:

Manage spend against the approved budget, maintain a live spend tracker, and flag anticipated variances in advance rather than in retrospect.

iii.

Return on Spend:

Justify marketing spend against expected commercial return, and reallocate budget away from underperforming activity where the evidence supports doing so.

iv.

Cost Control:

Negotiate rates and terms with vendors, media partners, platforms, and collaborators.

e. Sales Development &Lead Management

i.

Lead Generation:

Identify and pursue corporate, catering, gifting, event-planner, and community sales opportunities through outreach, networking, and partnerships.

ii.

Enquiry Management:

Manage incoming sales and event enquiries end-to-end – response, quotation, follow-up, and conversion – within agreed response timelines.

iii.

Client Relationships:

Build and maintain relationships with prospective and existing corporate clients to support repeat business and long-term accounts.

iv.

Opportunity Tracking:

Maintain an organised lead and opportunity tracker capturing enquiry source, status, value, and conversion outcome, to support forecasting and reporting.

v.

Operational Coordination:

Coordinate with outlet managers and the kitchen to confirm that corporate orders, catering, and event bookings are operationally deliverable before commitments are made to the client.

f. Community &Partnerships

i.

Partnership Development:

Identify and develop brand partnerships, collaborations, and co- marketing opportunities that extend reach without proportional increases in spend.

ii.

Media & Creators

:

Manage relationships with media, food publications, influencers, and content creators, including hosting and briefing.

iii.

Social Media &Community:

Maintain a consistent and timely presence across all company social media accounts, including community management of comments, direct messages, and public reviews.

iv.

On-the-Ground Coordination:

Work with outlet managers and frontline staff to capture authentic in-store content and to ensure campaigns are executed correctly and consistently at store level.

g. Reporting & Performance Measurement

i.

Metrics Design:

Propose, implement, and maintain a set of marketing performance measures that connect marketing activity to sales outcomes, rather than reporting reach and engagement in isolation.

ii.

Fortnightly Updates:

Provide a written fortnightly update to the General Manager and Chief Executive Officer covering campaigns currently in market, campaigns upcoming, spend against budget, results against agreed measures, and any matters requiring a decision.

iii.

Management Reporting:

Present a consolidated marketing and sales performance review at Management Team Meetings.

iv.

Post-Campaign Review:

Conduct a documented review after every major campaign, recording what worked, what did not, and what will be done differently next time.

3.

Working Relationships

– Reports to the General Manager on day-to-day priorities, budget, and performance, and to the Chief Executive Officer on brand direction and major campaign approvals.

– Works closely with outlet managers and operations teams to ensure campaigns, promotions, catering requests, and partnership activations are operationally executable and delivered to brand standard.

– Coordinates with the Head Baker and production team on product launches, seasonal offerings, product photography, and promotional planning, with adequate lead time for production capacity.

– Maintains working relationships with external vendors, photographers, designers, printers, media partners, influencers, and community collaborators.

– Develops and manages relationships with corporate clients, event organisers, and business partners to support revenue growth and brand visibility.

– Collaborates with frontline staff to gather customer insight, identify emerging trends, and capture authentic brand content at store level.

4.

Qualifications & Experience

– Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related discipline. Equivalent practical experience and a strong portfolio will be considered in lieu of formal qualifications.

–

Manager:

Minimum four years of relevant experience, including at least two years independently owning a marketing function, brand, or portfolio.

–

Assistant Manager:

Minimum two years of relevant experience, with demonstrated readiness to take on end-to-end ownership of a marketing portfolio.

– Prior experience in F&B, retail, hospitality, or a consumer lifestyle brand is strongly preferred.

– A portfolio of self-produced work – photography, video, design, and campaign examples– is required at interview.

– Experience managing a marketing budget and reporting on commercial outcomes is a distinct advantage.

5.

Skills Required

– Marketing strategy, framework development, and campaign planning

– Sales development, lead generation, and pipeline management

– Social media management, content scheduling, and community management

– Photography, videography, and content editing (including short-form video)

– Graphic design and production of marketing collateral

– Copywriting and brand communication

– Print production knowledge – file preparation, material selection, and vendor briefing

– Budget planning, spend tracking, and cost negotiation

– Data tracking, reporting, and performance analysis, including familiarity with social platform analytics, website analytics, and POS sales reporting

– Client relationship management and business development

– Event and partnership coordination

– Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, CapCut, or equivalent creative platforms

– Proficiency in Microsoft Office and presentation tools

– Strong verbal and written communication skills in English

6.

Key Attributes

–

Self-Motivated & Self-Directed:

Sets own priorities, works to self-imposed deadlines, and makes progress without being chased or closely supervised.

–

Comfortable Operating Independently:

Able to function effectively as a department of one, without an in-house team or standing agency support, and to know when to bring in external help.

–

Hands-On:

Willing to do the work personally – including shooting content, carrying and installing collateral, and being present at outlets – rather than working exclusively at a planning level.

–

Creative & Commercial Mindset:

Balances strong creative ideas against practical business and revenue objectives, and can explain why a piece of work is expected to earn its cost.

–

Commercially Numerate:

Comfortable working with budgets, sales figures, and performance data, and able to draw defensible conclusions from them.

��

Receptive to Direction:

Able to work within an established brand vision set by the founder, contributing ideas constructively and raising disagreement through discussion rather than through unilateral action.

–

Relationship Builder & Collaborative:

Comfortable engaging customers, partners, vendors, and internal teams across all levels, and contributes positively to team culture.

–

Organised & Detail-Oriented:

Maintainsstrong attention to detail across campaigns, communications, timelines,quotations, and sales coordination.

–

Adaptable & Resourceful:

Operates effectively where priorities and operational needs shift quickly, problem-solves independently, andremains composed under pressure or tight deadlines.

–

Brand Conscious & Culturally Attuned:

Understands the importance of consistency in branding, customer experience, and public perception, and has genuine feeling for the local heritage and food culture the brand is built on.

–

Results-Oriented:

Driven by measurable outcomes, continual improvement, and business growth.

–

Professionalism & Accountability:

Demonstrates maturity, reliability, discretion, and accountability in representing the company internally and externally.

7.

What Success Looks Like in the First Twelve Months

The following are indicative expectations and will be confirmed with the post-holder on appointment:

1. A documented marketing framework, approved by the Chief Executive Officer and General Manager, in active use as the basis for campaign planning.

2. An approved annual marketing budget supported by a live spend tracker, with spend managed within approved limits.

3. A consistent content cadence maintained across all active channels, with no unplanned gaps in the calendar.

4. A functioning lead and opportunity tracker, with measurable improvement in corporate and catering enquiry conversion.

5. An agreed set of performance measures that credibly links marketing activity to sales outcomes, reported on consistently.

6. Fortnightly reporting established as routine practice, and post-campaign reviews completed for all major campaigns.

Network manages social media for interior design firms, architects and furniture suppliers across IG, FB, TikTok and YouTube. Production, design and video editing sit with the delivery team.

This role owns the account and the result. Everything that reaches a client's channel goes through this person: what gets made, what gets written, when it gets shot, and whether it performs.

Key responsibilities

Client strategy

Build the content strategy for each account with the consultant assigned to it

Take the commercial context from the consultant (what the client sells, who they want, what they have promised) and turn it into a content direction that delivers it

Set the account's organic objective with the consultant at the start of each cycle, and agree what success looks like

Bring performance data to the consultant so strategy changes are based on what happened, not on what the client asked for last

Flag when a client request will not serve the objective, and give the consultant an alternative to take back

The consultant owns the client relationship and the commercial conversation. The Account Manager owns what gets made and why.

Organic performance

Own the organic result on every assigned account: reach, engagement, page growth and enquiries

Decide what gets made based on what is performing, not on filling a calendar

Track performance weekly and change direction on evidence, not at month end

Reject work that meets the brief but misses the bar, and say why

Publish or schedule all content to the agreed calendar

Review every asset before it goes live for typos, brand accuracy and strategic fit

Take responsibility for anything published in error, including retraction and client explanation

Respond within working hours, with no dropped threads

Errors reaching a live client channel (target: zero)

Delivery team blocked time attributable to missing briefs or information

We're Network, a Singapore media company that only does interior design marketing. 120+ ID firms on our books. Working arrangement

Mainly remote. (90% of time)

70/30

They own the client relationship and the money conversation. You own the delivery and the result. When a client asks for something that won't work, you say so and give the consultant an alternative to take back.

Company Profile

Creative For More is a cross-border digital marketing and creative agency headquartered in Singapore, with presence in Tokyo and New York. We help brands grow across Asia and the US through strategic marketing, social media, content production, design and paid media. Our creative and production work is kept in-house, so the people who plan a campaign are the same people who shoot and edit it.

Job Description

We're looking for a Content Production Intern with a strong videography focus: someone who loves being behind the camera, is just as comfortable talking to the people in front of it, and is happy to pitch in on whatever the team needs.

You'll go on location to shoot social media and YouTube content for our clients and for C4M's own channels. On set, you're the face of C4M: you'll greet clients, guide talent, ask good questions and keep the energy up so the content feels natural. Back at base, you'll help turn the footage into short-form videos, YouTube edits and case study films that our clients actually publish.

Alongside production, you'll support day-to-day client work across our accounts, help put together proposals and pitch materials, and pick up internal projects as they come up.

This role suits someone outgoing who enjoys meeting new people, speaks up confidently, and gets a buzz from a busy shoot day.

Scope of work

1. On-location shoots

Travel to client locations across Singapore (offices, retail outlets, events, studios, outdoor sets) to film social media and YouTube content

Set up and operate camera, lighting and audio equipment, including lapel and shotgun mics, gimbals and tripods

Capture A-roll (interviews, talking heads, presenter pieces) and B-roll (product shots, behind-the-scenes, location and lifestyle footage)

Shoot in both vertical (9:16) and horizontal (16:9) formats so one shoot serves Reels, TikTok, Shorts and YouTube

Follow shot lists and storyboards, and flag gaps or extra opportunities on the day

Manage files on set: label cards, back up footage and keep the shoot organised

2. Client engagement on set

Act as a friendly, confident point of contact for clients and talent during shoots

Brief interviewees on what to expect, put them at ease, and direct them through takes

Ask follow-up questions in interviews to draw out natural, usable answers

Speak up when something isn't working (lighting, audio, framing, talent delivery) and suggest a fix

Represent C4M professionally and keep the client relationship warm from arrival to wrap

3. Pre-production

Help plan shoots with the account and creative team: shot lists, call sheets, location checks and equipment lists

Contribute content ideas for social media and YouTube, including hooks, trends and formats that suit each client

Help draft simple scripts and interview question lists

4. Post-production

Edit short-form videos (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) and longer YouTube content

Add captions, subtitles, music, motion text and basic colour correction

Prepare multiple cuts and aspect ratios from a single shoot

Take on feedback from the team and clients, and turn revisions around on time

5. Content operations

Organise and archive footage in our shared drive using C4M's folder and naming conventions

Track shoot schedules and deliverables so nothing slips

Capture behind-the-scenes content for C4M's own social channels

Take part in C4M's intern reflection and documentation programme

6. Client work, proposals and internal projects

Support the account team on ongoing client work beyond video, such as content calendars, social posts, photo assets and campaign reporting

Help prepare proposals and pitch decks: pull together sample work, shoot references, mood boards and case study material

Take on internal projects as they come up, including C4M's own social content, showreels, website assets and team initiatives

Be flexible and willing to switch between tasks as priorities shift

Working hours and arrangement

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:30am to 6:30pm (Singapore time)

Presence: You're expected to be fully present and engaged throughout working hours. That means speaking up in meetings, contributing ideas, and being visibly active with the team and clients, not just working quietly in the background.

Daily huddle: Join the 10am team huddle every day, including remote days

Office and shoot days: Tuesdays and Wednesdays are in-office days at our Tanjong Katong office. Shoots are scheduled around client availability and may fall on any weekday, so you'll be on location whenever a shoot is booked.

Remote days: Stay active on Slack and respond to colleagues and supervisors within 30 minutes during working hours. Your supervisor may ask you to come in or head to a shoot on a remote day, and we expect you to accommodate this.

Occasional flexibility: Some shoots may start early or run slightly past 6:30pm. We'll give advance notice and keep these to a minimum.

Who we're looking for

Skills can be taught. Presence on set is harder to teach, so personality matters a lot for this role.

Outgoing and personable. You're naturally extroverted, enjoy meeting new people, and can strike up a conversation with a client or interviewee within minutes.

Confident communicator. You speak clearly, give direction to talent without hesitation, and aren't shy to share an idea in a team meeting.

Calm under pressure. Shoot days move fast. You stay positive and solve problems on the spot when plans change.

Proactive. You don't wait to be told what to shoot next. You spot good moments and suggest them.

Reliable. You turn up on time, prepared, with charged batteries and empty cards.

Curious about social media. You know what's working on TikTok, Reels and YouTube right now, and why.

Requirements

Must have

Currently studying, or recently graduated in, Film, Media, Digital Media, Communications or a related field

Must own a DSLR camera (mandatory), with hands-on experience shooting video on it

Working knowledge of at least one editing tool: Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut

Basic understanding of framing, lighting and clean audio capture

Strong spoken and written English

Able to travel to shoot locations across Singapore and carry equipment

A portfolio or showreel of video work (school, personal or freelance projects all count)

Nice to have

Experience creating short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts

Experience filming interviews or corporate and brand content

Basic motion graphics skills (After Effects or similar)

Experience with drones, gimbals or multi-camera setups

Conversational Mandarin, Japanese or another Asian language, given our cross-border clients

Own lighting or audio gear (LED panels, lapel or shotgun mics)

What you'll gain

A real portfolio of published client work across brands in Singapore and the region

Direct exposure to client-facing production, from briefing to delivery

Hands-on mentorship from our design, video and account teams

Experience producing content for cross-border brands with ties to Japan and the US

A structured reflection and documentation programme to track your growth across the internship

A reference letter on successful completion

Be the voice of one of the best-known brands in marketing.

Ahrefs helps marketers get their brands found online, in search, in AI answers and on social. Our tools run on the largest search and AI datasets on the web. We've been bootstrapped and profitable for fifteen years, with no investors and no board, and we have offices in Singapore, Tokyo, Palo Alto and Cambridge (MA).

The product has a big reputation, and we want every word around it to live up to that. Up to now, copy at Ahrefs has been something talented people do alongside their main job. We want someone for whom it is the main job.

The job

You'll be the voice of Ahrefs. You'll decide how we sound and what we say about ourselves, write much of it yourself, and get every team using it. The homepage, a banner ad, a renewal email and a booth wall should all sound like the same company. When someone here wants to know how to say something better, they'll come to you.

What you'll do
The website. Homepage, tool pages, comparison pages, ad landing pages, and the scripts for the explainer videos on them.
Campaigns. Concepts, headlines, banners and video scripts for our advertising.
Customer messages. Product emails and in-app notifications, the kind people read rather than archive.
Print and events. Brochures, flyers, and the copy on our booth walls.
The stage. Shape the message in our team's conference talks, including keynotes at Ahrefs Evolve.
Social. Work with our social media lead so a post and a landing page sound like they came from the same place.
Positioning and messaging. Decide the core story for the company and each product, write it down, and get other teams to adopt it.
You're probably right for this if
Writing copy is what you do best, and most of your career has gone into it: campaigns, websites, product emails, scripts.
You're hands-on. You'd rather write it yourself than brief someone else to. You can turn a banner headline around the same day you're halfway through a homepage rewrite, and you like having both on the go.
You can show us your work. Real, published copy, and you can tell us exactly which parts you wrote.
You know when to be funny and when to get straight to the point.
You pick up technical products quickly, and can explain them to experts without dumbing them down. You don't need to know SEO.
You've owned a brand voice or positioning before, and got teams who didn't report to you to use it.
You'll argue for a word with a CMO, and let go of the ones that don't matter.
Good to have
UX writing or product marketing experience.
Video scripts and speechwriting.
Comfortable enough in Figma or a CMS to fix your own copy in place.
Why Ahrefs?

We believe in giving smart people real ownership and not micromanaging them. You'll own how Ahrefs sounds, everywhere, and shape how millions of marketers see the brand. We value honesty, results and simple solutions over complicated ones, and you'll work with a smart, low-ego team where your words make a real difference.

GetBlock launched in 2019 as a two-person company. Seven years later, Coinbase, Trust Wallet, Garanti BBVA, Arkham, Chainalysis, and many more run on GetBlock infrastructure.
