A small, senior marketing team built one of the most visible brands in the RPC segment:

getblock.io has ranked #3 in the segment by organic traffic and LLM visibility for many months in a row in 2026

The GetBlock blog was the most visited and most active blog in the entire segment in 2025

150,000 website visits every month

100+ ecosystem partners and 20,000+ builders in the community

Team background includes Forbes, BeInCrypto, and Crypto Briefing

The team under-promises and over-delivers, every time.

About the role

This is a full-stack marketing role.

You will own campaigns across all GetBlock channels, from the first draft to the final report, and decide where the next channel should open. In a single week you might write a launch thread for X and present next quarter's channel strategy to leadership.

GetBlock markets to a few.

The product is technical, and its audience is technical and product decision-makers at Web3 companies, the people who choose which RPC provider their engineers build on. Reach outside that group counts for little, so every campaign you run is judged by whether it lands with them.

Most of the team works around UTC+3. We need solid overlap with those hours, and the exact time zone is flexible.

What you'll do

Plan campaigns across GetBlock's existing channels and measure what each one delivers: social media, community, partnerships, owned media, performance marketing, and SEO/GEO. Owned media takes the biggest share of your time, SEO/GEO the smallest.

Propose new marketing channels, run the first tests, and scale any channel that brings in the right audience.

Own marketing analytics. Find out which campaigns reach technical decision-makers and which burn budget, then shift spend to match.

Run paid traffic together with our performance marketer: suggest hypotheses, design the tests, read the results, and scale what works.

Shape positioning and messaging for product launches with the product team, then carry them into every channel.

Write and edit copy yourself: X threads, LinkedIn posts, blog articles, partner announcements.

Work with GetBlock's 100+ ecosystem partners on joint announcements and co-marketing campaigns.

What you'll bring

Fluent English at C1 or above, spoken and written. This one is a must: English is the only language GetBlock markets in and nearly the only one the team works in.

3+ years in product marketing, including B2B.

Strong writing. You produce a clean first draft without a copywriter and edit other people's copy without flattening their voice.

Marketing taste built on seeing a lot of good and bad work. You can spot a strong launch at a glance and explain what makes it land.

Hands-on experience with X, LinkedIn, Reddit, and Telegram, plus owned media on Medium and Dev.to.

Basic CMS skills. GetBlock's site runs on Prismic.

Confidence with partners: you can run a call with a partner's CMO and walk away with an agreed plan.

How you work with AI

GetBlock marketing already runs on custom skills and agents, and you will add to that setup.

You know when AI helps and when to stop and do the work yourself.

You have built AI workflows that automate 90-100% of a routine end to end, and you keep them running.

You build your own tooling: custom skills, loops, and agents. Lazy prompts and AI slop give you an allergic reaction.

Nice to have

Experience managing a small team.

Vibe-coding experience on products that paying customers use, with a working grasp of GitLab, deployment pipelines, and IDEs.

Mindset and deal-breakers

People who do well at GetBlock are curious and happy to wear many hats. Everyone on the team, this role included, works by two rules:

We are all operators. No task is junior enough to drop.

We are all strategists. No task is senior enough to avoid.

You will probably not enjoy this role if:

Your main strength is managing Jira cards.

Your marketing playbook is mostly KOLs, airdrops, and incentive programs. GetBlock does boring marketing that pays off over years.

You need a translator or heavy editing to work in English.

Honest remote. GetBlock is fully remote by design, with no US-only, EU-only, or UK-only restrictions and no hybrid schedule that puts you in an office three days a week.

A running start. GetBlock is an established brand with a busy marketing pipeline and growing metrics, so there is nothing to build from scratch. You join to accelerate what already works.

20 days of annual leave plus 12 personal days in place of a fixed public holiday calendar. Spend them on local celebrations, a loved one's birthday, or a break when you need one. Sick leave is paid on top.

Well-being programs to help you stay healthy and keep your balance.

About the Role:

The Communications & Marketing Executive plays a vital role in promoting Practice and its programmes, as well as advocating for the value and importance of Singapore theatre by crafting compelling marketing campaigns and fostering strategic partnerships. Reporting to the managers/lead of the department, you'll work closely with internal and external stakeholders to achieve our organisational goals and objectives, ensuring the success of our diverse programmes and initiatives.

What You'll Do:

Assist the team in brainstorming and executing marketing and publicity strategies for sales, ticketing, and promotions.

Develop and execute comprehensive marketing communication plans across various communication channels, including direct marketing, digital marketing, advertising, etc.

Assist in creating marketing materials, preparing reports, and analysing campaign results.

Develop and manage timelines and project plans for various marketing and publicity initiatives. This includes:

Setting realistic deadlines for each phase of the project

Identifying and managing dependencies between tasks

Monitoring progress and making adjustments as needed

Manage social media strategy and content calendar. Work closely with the team to create content, schedule and publish content consistently, track and analyse key metrics to provide feedback, and respond and engage with the online community.

Develop and foster strategic partnerships with like-minded organisations for increased publicity.

Collaborate with various stakeholders to maintain consistent brand messaging.

Attend regular meetings and contribute ideas and insights to achieve marketing and sales targets.

Communicate effectively with partners and audiences, handle inquiries professionally, and gather feedback for improvement.

Provide administrative support to team members as needed.

Who You Are:

You are passionate about theatre and the performing arts.

You possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

You have strong organisational and time management skills.

You are creative, resourceful, and a team player.

Experience in marketing, communications, or a related field is an advantage.

Proficiency in social media platforms and digital marketing tools is preferred.

Comfortable working across English and Chinese communications, including reviewing bilingual marketing materials.

The Theatre Practice (Practice) is Singapore’s longest-standing professional bilingual theatre institution. Artist-driven and deeply progressive, Practice strives to be an arts space in Singapore that consciously nurtures and empowers people who care about humanity. Over the past 61 years, we have developed and presented works that aim to reflect the richness and complexities of Singapore’s diverse cultures.

Today, we carry on the work of our visionary co-founders and cultural medallion recipients, Kuo Pao Kun and Goh Lay Kuan. Under the helm of current Artistic Director Kuo Jian Hong, Practice continues to shape Singapore’s cultural landscape as the definitive voice in Singapore theatre. Jian Hong is deeply influenced by the importance of play in art-making and under her leadership, Practice has become the embodiment of the irrepressible spirit and fearless experimentation of play.

Practice is motivated by a desire to always respectfully entertain. We have collaborated with Singapore and international artists alike to present a critically-acclaimed repertoire of over 330 productions including musicals, classics, original and experimental works. We have toured extensively in the region. Many of our works have entered the canon of Southeast Asian literature and have been adapted and presented by theatre companies worldwide, presenting an authentically Singaporean voice on the world stage.

Since our inception, Practice has served as a cultural bridge between Asia and the world. Our current theatre festival – M1 Patch! A Theatre Festival of Artful Play – comes from a legacy of carefully curated festivals and seminars that gather practitioners of all disciplines and cultures for sharing and exchange, while providing a valuable platform for outstanding international works.

As pioneers in Arts Education in Singapore, Practice has been instrumental both in nurturing leaders in the Singapore arts scene, and inculcating a love for the arts in generations of Singapore youth.

Artistically diverse and constantly relevant, Practice will always engage with the ceaseless exploration of new frontiers.

The Theatre Practice is an Institution of Public Character, a recipient of the National Arts Council’s Major Grant 2017-2020, and a member of the Singapore Chinese Language Theatre Alliance.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured through:

Growth in overall brand awareness.

Growth in social media audience and engagement.

Increase in website traffic and qualified leads.

Growth in sales of journals, card games and lifestyle merchandise.

Successful execution of campaigns and product launches.

Strong relationships with schools and strategic partners.

Development of an organised, high-performing marketing department.

Qualifications & Skills

· A marketing professional with a strong creative mindset and entrepreneurial spirit.

· Ideal personal interest in journaling and promoting wellbeing through reflective practices.

· Minimum 3-5 years’ experience in marketing activities (preferably in wellness or education sectors).

· Proven experience running successful digital and affiliate campaigns.

· Strong community engagement and robust communication skills.

· Self-driven and able to manage multiple priorities independently.

· Ability to work independently while also thriving in a collaborative team environment.

· Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

Experience building or scaling a marketing function is highly advantageous.

Experience in education, wellness, lifestyle or purpose-driven brands is preferred.

Demonstrated ability to grow social media communities and translate engagement into measurable business outcomes.

Strong understanding of branding, content marketing, digital marketing, SEO, paid advertising and analytics.

Commercial mindset with the ability to balance creativity and business performance.

·

Work hours

· Weekdays between 09:00 and 17:30 hours

Other

· Able to travel within the region as per company’s requirements and plans.

· Attractive remuneration as well as employee overall benefits.

At How I Care, mental health and well-being are not just priorities—they are the essence of our mission. Based in Singapore, we are an Education Lab dedicated to elevating social awareness and personal growth through transformative education across Asia.

Our curriculum, now implemented in schools throughout the region, is tailored to the unique needs of each school year, aiming to equip students with effective strategies to embrace challenges and grow into socially aware, responsible individuals. We create engaging learning textbooks and conduct workshops that foster character development. Additionally, we offer training for teachers to maximise the impact of our resources.

Join us in our mission to empower the next generation. Together, we can nurture a better tomorrow and ensure every student has the opportunity to thrive confidently and contribute meaningfully to their community.

Metadata and AI Tagging Management

Develop and maintain metadata standards, taxonomies, genre classifications, keyword hierarchies, and tagging conventions aligned with entertainment content workflows

Ensure consistent tagging across drama, variety, lifestyle, reality, music, promotional, short-form, and archival assets to support accurate search and retrieval within the Production Asset Management system.

Maintain structured metadata for key entertainment attributes, including programme title, episode number, season, synopsis, cast, hosts, guests, locations, topics, themes, language, subtitles, ratings, rights windows, platform restrictions, embargoes, and promotional usage

Support improved content discoverability for internal users across production, editorial, programming, marketing, digital, social, distribution, and related teams

Workflow Integration and Asset Management

Ensure entertainment assets are properly organised for multiplatform use, including digital platforms, social media platforms, partner platforms, and commercial distribution

Work with stakeholders to streamline media handover processes from production, field teams and post-production into archival and publishing workflows

Quality Control, Rights, and Compliance

Perform regular quality checks on ingested video, audio, image, subtitle, caption, transcript, and promotional assets to ensure technical, branding, metadata, and compliance integrity

Oversee copyright management, talent rights, music rights, clip usage, third-party material, platform restrictions, embargoes, sponsorship obligations, and rights usage tracking

Ensure compliance with data privacy policies and content governance frameworks, particularly for facial recognition, audience footage, minors, and rights-managed material

Maintain adherence to archival, retention, backup, and preservation policies to protect the long-term value and integrity of entertainment content

Flag missing, inconsistent, outdated, duplicated, sensitive, embargoed, or incorrectly tagged assets and coordinate resolution with relevant teams

Training and User Support

Conduct training sessions and workshops for producers, promo teams, programming teams, marketers, and digital teams on AI-enabled search, tagging, metadata standards, and media retrieval

Develop user manuals, quick guides, workflow notes, and best practice documents for entertainment metadata management and AI-assisted asset workflows

Gather user feedback and work with Technology and Data Governance teams to improve system usability, tagging accuracy, workflow efficiency, and adoption across entertainment operations

Monitor and report on system performance metrics, including tagging accuracy, ingest efficiency, search success rate, asset usage, storage utilisation, and metadata completeness

Propose workflow improvements based on user feedback, operational needs, emerging technologies, and evolving multiplatform content strategies

Support initiatives that improve content discoverability, archive value, entertainment content reuse, multiplatform publishing efficiency, and audience engagement

Degree or Diploma in Media Management, Broadcast Technology, Mass Communication, Film, Television, Digital Media, Entertainment Management, or a related field

We’re a small, close-knit marketing agency working with brands across Southeast Asia. Our team is fast-paced, collaborative and always connected to what’s happening online.

As a Content Production Intern, you’ll be behind the camera on active campaigns across different brands and industries. Your days may range from setting up a product shoot in our studio to filming outdoors or capturing content at a client’s location, then shaping that footage into short-form videos. You’ll see how content goes from a shot list to a finished post, and you’ll help make it happen.

*What you’ll do*

* Film product and lifestyle content on camera and iPhone
* Capture vertical, social-first footage for TikTok and Instagram Reels
* Prepare shoots, from setting up props and products to arranging lighting and the set
* Follow shot lists and production plans, and suggest shots that could make the content stronger
* Organise and archive footage so the team can find it easily
* Capture behind-the-scenes content for our own channels
* Join creative brainstorms and contribute ideas for how content should look and feel

*You’ll fit right in if you*

* Have a genuine interest in video, content creation and social media
* Are comfortable shooting on both cameras and iPhone
* Have basic editing skills and enjoy the process of putting footage together
* Have a good eye for framing, detail and composition
* Are open to feedback and willing to refine your work
* Care about producing thoughtful and high-quality work

Bonus if you have studio lighting experience or have shot content for TikTok or Reels before.

*What you’ll get*

* Hands-on experience shooting real brand campaigns
* Exposure to studio, outdoor and on-location production
* Opportunities to take content from the shoot to the final edit
* Experience working across different brands, products and creative styles
* Opportunities to contribute ideas and gradually take ownership of shoots
* Portfolio-ready video work published by real brands
* Direct guidance and feedback from a young and friendly team
* A welcoming office environment with a friendly office dog

*Internship details*

* Internship duration: 3-6 months
* Opportunity to convert to a full-time position depending on performance
* Flexible working arrangements, subject to shoot schedules

Work Location: In person

title: Business Development Manager (Digital Marketing)
description:
*Business Development Manager — Digital Marketing Sales*

*Mustard Seed Digital | Singapore | Full-Time*

*About Mustard Seed Digital*

Mustard Seed Digital is a Singapore-based creative-performance digital marketing agency that helps brands grow through strategy, content, creativity, performance marketing, and marketing technology.

We work with businesses that want more than “just posts” or “just ads”. Our role is to help clients clarify their marketing direction, strengthen their brand presence, generate better leads, improve campaign performance, and build more effective digital marketing systems.

Our services include social media management, content marketing, creative production, performance marketing, paid search, paid social, website design and development, branding, copywriting, CRM, marketing automation, and digital marketing training.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a *Business Development Manager* who can help us open new doors, build strong B2B relationships, and bring in quality clients who value strategic and measurable digital marketing support.

*About the Role*

This is a *client acquisition and revenue growth role*.

We are looking for a confident B2B hunter who enjoys prospecting, meeting business owners and marketing decision-makers, uncovering client needs, and presenting practical digital marketing solutions.

You should not be someone who only waits for inbound leads. You should be comfortable identifying prospects, initiating conversations, following up consistently, building trust, and moving opportunities from first contact to proposal and closing.

This role is ideal for someone who has experience in B2B sales, digital marketing sales, agency sales, media sales, SaaS sales, marketing consultancy, or professional services business development.

You do not need to be a digital marketing specialist, but you must be able to understand and discuss marketing challenges confidently with clients. You should be able to ask good questions, identify business pain points, and work with our internal team to recommend suitable solutions.

*What You Will Be Responsible For*

*Business Development & Client Acquisition*

* Identify, prospect, and develop new B2B client opportunities in Singapore
* Build your own sales pipeline through outreach, referrals, networking, events, partnerships, and follow-ups
* Engage business owners, SME leaders, marketing managers, corporate decision-makers, and brand teams
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand clients’ business goals, marketing challenges, budget, and decision-making process
* Promote MSD’s digital marketing, creative, content, performance marketing, website, CRM, and marketing automation solutions
* Prepare and present proposals, quotations, pitch decks, and commercial scopes
* Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to proposal, negotiation, closing, and handover
* Achieve agreed sales, revenue, and gross profit targets
* Maintain strong relationships with prospects and clients to support repeat business and long-term account growth

*Consultative Selling & Solution Development*

* Understand each client’s business situation before recommending a solution
* Help clients see how digital marketing can support brand growth, lead generation, customer engagement, and business performance
* Work with internal teams to shape solutions that are relevant, realistic, and commercially viable
* Present ideas clearly and confidently to clients
* Translate client needs into practical digital marketing scopes and proposals
* Provide market feedback and client insights to help MSD improve its offerings

*Internal Coordination*

* Work closely with the Accounts, Creative, Performance Marketing, and Operations teams
* Ensure proper handover after a deal is closed
* Support smooth client onboarding and expectation-setting
* Monitor client feedback where needed and support service recovery or account growth opportunities
* Keep sales activities, pipeline updates, and client information properly documented

*Who We Are Looking For*

We are looking for someone who is commercially driven, proactive, and comfortable with B2B client acquisition.

*The ideal candidate should have:*

* Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, account acquisition, or client-facing revenue growth
* Experience selling digital marketing, advertising, creative services, media, SaaS, consulting, professional services, or other B2B solutions
* A good understanding of digital marketing services such as social media, content marketing, paid advertising, SEO, websites, branding, CRM, or marketing automation
* Confidence in prospecting and opening new business conversations
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
* Ability to speak with business owners, marketing teams, and senior decision-makers
* Strong commercial sense and the ability to work towards revenue and profitability targets
* Good follow-up discipline and the ability to manage multiple leads at different stages
* Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with internal teams
* A consultative mindset — able to understand client needs instead of simply pushing packages

*We Are Especially Interested In Candidates Who Have*

* Existing B2B sales experience in Singapore
* Experience in a digital agency, creative agency, media agency, marketing consultancy, SaaS company, or related business
* A network of SME owners, marketing decision-makers, corporate contacts, or potential business leads
* Experience preparing proposals, quotations, pitch decks, or commercial scopes
* Experience selling retainers, campaigns, projects, or marketing-related solutions
* Confidence in approaching new clients and creating opportunities from scratch

*This Role May Be a Good Fit If You Are*

* A hunter who enjoys opening new doors and building your own pipeline
* Someone who understands that good sales is about asking the right questions, not just giving a sales pitch
* Comfortable speaking about digital marketing, branding, content, websites, and paid media with clients
* Motivated by revenue growth, client relationships, and business impact
* Looking for a role where your contribution to agency growth is visible and valued
* Able to work in a boutique agency environment where initiative, ownership, and accountability matter

*This Role May Not Be Suitable If You*

* Prefer to handle only inbound enquiries
* Are uncomfortable with prospecting or cold outreach
* Have no interest in digital marketing, content, branding, or performance marketing
* Prefer a highly structured corporate sales environment with fixed scripts and rigid processes
* Are looking for a purely account servicing role without revenue responsibility

*Why Join Mustard Seed Digital?*

At MSD, you will not be selling generic marketing packages. You will be helping businesses think through how digital marketing can support their growth.

*You will have the opportunity to:*

* Sell a broad range of creative, digital, content, performance, and marketing technology solutions
* Work with a team that values strategy, creativity, performance, and purposeful growth
* Shape meaningful client conversations from the first meeting
* Build relationships across different industries and business segments
* Play a direct role in growing the agency’s client base and market presence
* Be part of a boutique agency where your effort, ideas, and results are visible

*Employment Details*

*Employment Type:* Full-time
*Location:* Singapore
*Role Type:* Business Development / Digital Marketing Sales / B2B Client Acquisition

*How to Apply*

Interested candidates are invited to apply with your resume on the portal and a short note on your business development experience.

In your application, please share:

* The types of clients or industries you have sold to
* The products, services, or solutions you have sold previously
* Any experience you have in digital marketing, media, creative services, SaaS, consulting, or professional services
* Examples of how you have developed new business or built your own sales pipeline

We are looking for someone who can help us grow, open new opportunities, and build long-term client relationships for Mustard Seed Digital.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

BUILD BRAND-OWNED CONTENT ASSETS — APPROXIMATELY 35%

Create practical English-language content that answers real customer questions and supports Amazon purchase decisions.

• Explanations of product length, capacity, value and intended use

• Frequently asked questions based on real customer concerns

Employees do not always need to appear on camera. Clear product demonstrations, hand movements, close-up shots, captions and simple voiceovers are acceptable.

Strong master content should be repurposed into suitable formats for the company website and different social media platforms.

OPERATE BRAND SOCIAL MEDIA AND GENERATE ORGANIC TRAFFIC — APPROXIMATELY 25%

Support and operate ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned social media channels, which may include TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest and Facebook.

Responsibilities include:

• Maintaining a practical content calendar

• Publishing approved content consistently

• Adapting content for each platform and audience

• Writing clear English captions, titles and calls to action

• Responding appropriately to relevant public questions and comments

• Participating helpfully in relevant online discussions while respecting community rules

• Directing interested customers to the correct Amazon product page

• Checking that every published Amazon link is accurate and traceable

• Reusing effective content across suitable channels

ChoiceRefill’s social media and off-Amazon growth activities must be able to operate normally without relying on external influencers.

RESEARCH CUSTOMER DEMAND AND IMPROVE CONVERSION — APPROXIMATELY 15%

Actively identify what US customers need to know before making a purchase.

Research sources may include:

• Amazon customer reviews and product questions

• Competitor reviews and recurring complaints

• Customer enquiries received through the ChoiceRefill website

• Social media comments and discussions

• Search suggestions and frequently asked questions

• Feedback from existing ChoiceRefill customers

• Performance data from previously published content

Turn useful findings into:

• New content topics

• FAQ improvements

• Troubleshooting guides

• Website updates

• Product-information recommendations

• Clear suggestions for Amazon Listing improvement for the founder’s consideration

Employees should report “problem + evidence + recommendation,” rather than forwarding screenshots without analysis.

TRACK RESULTS AND RUN GROWTH EXPERIMENTS — APPROXIMATELY 15%

Use Amazon Attribution and internal tracking sheets to measure employee-owned content and traffic sources.

Responsibilities include:

• Using an approved tracking link for each content item

• Recording the platform, content ID, product, publication date and responsible employee

• Monitoring clicks, product-page activity, purchases and attributable sales

• Comparing different topics, formats, openings, captions and calls to action

• Identifying content that attracts clicks but does not result in purchases

• Recommending which content should be repeated, improved or discontinued

• Preparing a short weekly performance summary

• Maintaining accurate content and campaign records

Each employee will receive a separately assigned Amazon Attribution link structure so that individual contributions can be measured.

SUPPORT DAILY E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS — APPROXIMATELY 15%

Support the founder by completing and following up on routine work surrounding the Amazon business.

Responsibilities may include:

• Monitoring obvious price, stock, variation, image or link abnormalities

• Tracking approved inventory, inbound-shipment and replenishment matters

• Maintaining product information, packaging files, images and version records

• Preparing supporting information for platform cases

• Following up on approved changes and confirming completion

• Escalating urgent issues with evidence and a recommended next step

Employees do not independently change Amazon advertising, Listings, prices, purchasing plans or budgets.

HANDLE LIMITED CUSTOMER ENQUIRIES — UP TO 10%

Customer service is a small, on-demand part of this position.

Most ChoiceRefill customers understand and purchase the product directly through Amazon. The role is not expected to spend most of the working day handling enquiries.

Responsibilities include:

• Checking the company website for customer enquiries

• Answering questions about compatibility, installation and product use

• Following up on unresolved matters

• Classifying recurring customer problems

• Updating approved response templates and FAQ drafts

• Turning repeated questions into useful content or improvement recommendations

When customer-service volume is low, the available time will be redirected to content creation, social media operation, research and growth experiments.

OPTIONAL CREATOR AND INFLUENCER COLLABORATION — 0% TO 10%

Creator partnerships are an additional growth opportunity, not the foundation of this role.

When a genuinely suitable US parenting, household or value-focused creator is identified, employees may:

• Make initial contact

• Explain the product clearly

• Coordinate approved product samples

• Prepare a content brief

• Follow up on agreed timelines

Employees are not required to contact creators simply to fill working hours. Creator activity should expand only when it produces useful content, qualified traffic, measurable sales or a valuable long-term relationship.

Time used for creator partnerships will be allocated from the social media and organic-growth portion of the role.

INDIVIDUAL ATTRIBUTION AND SALES INCENTIVES

title: Head of Communications & Brand
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

About BW Group

BW Group is a leading global energy and maritime company involved in shipping, deepwater oil & gas production, renewable energy and digital infrastructure. BW controls a fleet of over 400 vessels transporting oil, gas and dry commodities. In the infrastructure space, the group operates in wind, batteries, water, subsea cable networks and data centres.

BW is proud to be listed among Forbes World's Best Employers and Financial Times Best Employers Asia-Pacific 2025.

Are you ready to make an impact?

What drives us is our mission to deliver energy for the world today, and to find solutions for tomorrow. If you want to make lives better around the world by providing access to energy, while working on sustainability and decarbonisation, we'd like to hear from you. Working at BW you will feel the pulse of the world each day. If something happens in the world, we feel it, and you can play your part by anticipating and responding to it. Our high-performing teams are drawn to BW by the global nature of our work and the satisfaction of working with collaborative people who inspire each other to deliver exceptional results.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Role Overview

Based in Singapore and reporting to the Chief People Officer, BW Group, the Head of Communications & Brand leads communications and corporate brand activities across BW Group whilst also supporting BW LNG.

This is a highly visible role partnering closely with the Chairman, senior executives and Communications leaders across our affiliate companies to strengthen BW's reputation, shape its corporate narrative and foster greater collaboration across the Group.

Success requires far more than exceptional communications capability. You will be a commercially minded strategic thinker who anticipates issues, shapes narratives and influences outcomes through sound judgement, trusted relationships and collaboration in a federated organisation where credibility matters more than hierarchy.

Working with a lean team and external partners, you will combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, helping shape executive communications, protect and enhance the BW brand, support organisational transformation and drive communications excellence across the Group.

Key Accountabilities

Corporate Communications

Develop and deliver BW Group's corporate communications strategy aligned with the Group's long-term vision and priorities.

Shape compelling narratives that strengthen understanding of BW's purpose, strategy and portfolio of businesses.

Advise leaders on communications strategy, executive messaging and stakeholder engagement.

Lead communications for strategic initiatives, organisational change, major announcements and corporate events.

Oversee BW Group's digital communications, including LinkedIn and other channels, delivering engaging content that strengthens the brand and supports strategic objectives.

Executive

Communications

Partner closely with the Chairman and senior executives on speeches, presentations, thought leadership and executive communications.

Develop executive communications that reflect BW's values and high editorial standards.

Lead the production of flagship Group communications, including World Horizon, the Annual Report, Sustainability Report, corporate website and key leadership updates.

Support senior executives at conferences, media engagements, investor events and industry forums through end-to-end communications planning and delivery.

Serve as a trusted communications adviser to the Chairman and senior leadership, providing sound judgement on messaging, stakeholder considerations and reputational matters.

Employee

Communications

Lead Group-wide employee communications across digital channels.

Deliver engaging communications that connect shore-based and seafaring employees through platforms such as BW Connect.

Foster a culture of openness, pride and engagement across the Group.

Brand & Reputation

Act as steward of the BW corporate brand, ensuring consistency whilst respecting the autonomy of our affiliate businesses.

Evolve BW's corporate identity and positioning to strengthen the Group's reputation and create value across the portfolio.

Protect and enhance BW's reputation with employees, customers, investors, regulators, partners and the wider maritime and energy community.

Lead crisis and issues communications, partnering with senior management and external advisers as required for ongoing incidents and with post-communications.

BW LNG Communications & Marketing

Partner with the BW LNG leadership team to develop communications and marketing initiatives that strengthen the company's commercial positioning and reputation.

Lead communications supporting commercial initiatives, including vessel launches, technology innovations, customer campaigns and industry events.

Develop marketing content and digital campaigns that showcase BW LNG's capabilities, innovation and market leadership.

Ensure alignment between BW LNG's communications and the wider BW corporate brand.

Leadership & Influence

Lead BW's Communications Community of Practice, fostering collaboration, sharing best practice and identifying opportunities for greater alignment across affiliate companies.

Build trusted relationships with affiliate CEOs and Communications leaders, influencing through credibility rather than authority.

Foster collaboration across the Group whilst respecting the entrepreneurial culture and autonomy of individual businesses.

Digital Communications & AI

Harness AI and emerging technologies to improve the quality, consistency, efficiency and reach of communications.

Identify and implement new tools, channels and approaches that enhance engagement and communications effectiveness.

Measure communications impact using meaningful qualitative and quantitative insights.

Team Leadership

Lead, coach and develop a small, high-performing communications team.

Manage external agencies and specialist partners to maximise quality, capability and value.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

We're looking for someone who combines strategic communications leadership with exceptional judgement and the ability to influence senior stakeholders. You'll ideally bring:

Significant experience leading corporate communications within a global organisation or consultancy.

Experience advising CEOs and senior executives on communications strategy and reputation management.

Strong understanding of corporate branding, stakeholder engagement and executive communications.

Experience leading communications during periods of organisational change, transformation or significant corporate activity.

Experience working across complex, matrixed or federated organisations would be advantageous.

Experience within the maritime or energy sectors would be beneficial, although not essential.

What Will Make You Successful

You'll be someone who naturally earns trust and credibility. You'll demonstrate:

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

Excellent judgement and discretion.

The ability to simplify complex issues into clear, compelling messages.

Exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills.

Strong commercial awareness.

High levels of curiosity and strategic thinking.

Comfort working directly with senior executives and Board-level stakeholders.

A collaborative style with low ego and high integrity.

The ability to balance strategic thinking with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and deliver.

Demonstrates sound judgement in knowing when to follow established processes and when a pragmatic, flexible approach will deliver a better outcome.

A passion for continuous improvement, innovation and practical application of AI.

This role is unlikely to suit someone who prefers highly structured environments, relies on formal authority to get things done, or wants to specialise in a single area of communications. Success requires sound judgement, adaptability, collaboration and a willingness to operate across a broad range of strategic and hands-on responsibilities.

OTHER INFORMATION

Why BW?

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the voice and reputation of one of the world's most respected maritime and energy groups.

You'll work closely with visionary leaders who value integrity, long-term thinking and collaboration, while helping tell the story of a business investing in both today's energy needs and tomorrow's energy transition.

The role offers exceptional breadth, combining strategy, executive partnership, brand leadership, organisational change, employee engagement and external communications in an entrepreneurial international environment.

Please note that your application will be sent to and reviewed by the direct employer - BW Maritime

title: Associate Client Solutions Consultant

About us

At Fenergo, we’re not just building software—we’re transforming how the world’s leading financial institutions fight financial crime. Headquartered in Dublin and trusted by over 100 of the world’s top financial institutions, we’re on a mission to change the game.

We’re more than a global leader in AI-powered client lifecycle management—we’re reimagining how financial institutions tackle compliance. From Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) to rapidly evolving regulations, we turn complexity into clarity. Our FinCrime Operating System, powered by agentic AI and intelligent automation, helps financial institutions move faster, act smarter, and stay safer across 120+ countries.

But we don’t stop there.

At Fenergo, we believe in a world where financial institutions aren’t just compliant—they’re confident. Where technology doesn’t just meet regulations—it stays ahead of them. Our mission is to empower financial institutions to stop financial crime and create a safer world.

Every product we build, every innovation we deliver, and every partnership we forge is shaped by that belief. We’re tackling some of the toughest challenges in financial technology. From speeding up onboarding to uncovering hidden risks, our work empowers banks to serve their customers with speed, integrity, and peace of mind.

Join us, and be part of a team that’s building smart solutions, solving real problems, and shaping the future—together.

About the role

From small beginnings, we have assembled an excellent team of business and technical staff who have enabled our company to grow rapidly on the international Financial Services stage. Over the last number of years, we have become the market leader in the Client Lifecycle Management and Regulatory Compliance arena.

We are a young company, excited by the future, and we are looking for people who will share this journey with us. The Client Solutions team works closely with our Global Sales Teams, who identify potential opportunities, and we then provide detailed business and technical support throughout the sales cycle. We also work closely with our Product team, identifying gaps and opportunities and contributing directly to the product roadmap and our future success.

This is a client-facing role. You will build relationships and act as the first point of contact with the client's stakeholders and subject matter experts. Understand client challenges and develop the solutions necessary to win new business.

Use knowledge of competitive solutions to help the sales organisation propose the optimal solution for the customer.
Ensure that the sales and professional services organisations are properly aligned to achieve client and sales objectives.
Build strong relationships within the project team, client teams and the internal Product Management team.

A natural leader who looks to ensure a positive outcome for the organisation.
Understands business goals and market perceptions, and how the Client Solutions team impacts both.
A seeker of information, internal and external, to help drive the right approach and lead to the right outcomes.
Knowledge of the organisation's offerings, with a strong focus on attention to detail.

Education and Experience

A degree or Master's in Business, Management Consulting, Business Information Systems or a similar related qualification. A degree in Business Analytics or Quantitative Studies is a plus.
Experience in the Financial Services industry, or in a software company in a different industry, is an advantage but not mandatory.

Through a combination of formal training, programmes and self-learning, successful candidates will quickly build on the experience of the team around them and develop a strong understanding of the principles of the Fenergo platform.

Is this you?

We are looking for people who are passionate about using our technology to solve customer problems. If you are self-motivated, detail-orientated and confident communicating your ideas both verbally and in writing, we would like to hear from you. A new and exciting chapter in your career could be waiting.

We are striving to become global leaders across financial crime we operate in and as part of that we are a high-performing highly collaborative team that works cross-functionally to accommodate our client’s needs.

Collaboration: Working together to achieve our best

title: Vice President - Transformation Specialist - Chief Transformation Office
description:
Company Overview

Nomura is a financial services group with an integrated global network. By connecting markets East & West, we service the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through our four business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking) and Banking.

Driven by the insights of some 28,000 people worldwide, we put our clients at the center of everything we do, delivering unparalleled access to, from and within Asia. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com

Divisional Overview

The Chief Transformation Office function oversees group-wide transformation on mission critical projects for the firm. We’re aligned to our key businesses across the group and operate to global standards and governance across our programs. Our purpose is to support Nomura’s business strategy and deliver consistent group-wide services based on common operating principles.

Job Overview

The Vice President, Transformation Specialist is a high-impact, execution-focused role tasked with defining and delivering strategic transformation initiatives across Nomura. This position bridges strategic vision and operational execution, requiring a change-driven leader who can translate ambiguous objectives into structured, measurable outcomes while engaging senior stakeholders globally.

The ideal candidate is a go-getter with strong technical rigor (financial modeling, AI/Excel) and exceptional leadership (influencing without authority, driving cross-functional alignment). While domain expertise in financial services is advantageous, the role prioritizes technical adaptability, change leadership, and execution excellence.

The VP will lead cross-functional teams and engage senior stakeholders across functions and regions. The portfolio will span structural reform, location strategy, AI-enabled transformation, outsourcing and strategic vendor partnerships, with a focus on measurable outcomes and effective execution.

Responsibilities

Strategy, Business Cases and Workstream Definition

Translate strategic priorities into well-defined initiatives, problem statements, options and target outcomes.

Develop rigorous business cases, including baseline analysis, financial models, benefits, costs, dependencies, implementation options and delivery risks.

Scope workstreams, define deliverables and milestones, establish governance, and create practical mobilisation and execution plans.

Apply strong numerical judgement to challenge assumptions, test scenarios and support evidence-based investment decisions.

Transformation Delivery and Value Realisation

Own initiatives from definition through mobilisation and delivery, maintaining clear plans, decision points, dependencies, risks and outcomes.

Lead multidisciplinary project teams through influence, setting direction and holding contributors accountable without relying on formal line-management authority.

Create transparent reporting for senior governance forums and ensure agreed benefits are measurable, tracked and realised.

Balance strategic ambition, execution feasibility, control requirements and sustainable organisational capability.

Strong AI-Adoption into the role

Identify, articulate and prioritise practical AI prompts and use cases that improve productivity, decision-making and business outcomes within the role.

Use Microsoft Copilot effectively for administration, analysis, document production and presentations; bring familiarity with the broader enterprise AI landscape.

Senior Stakeholder Engagement and Project Leadership

Build trusted relationships with Business Managers and senior stakeholders across functions and regions, including at VP, Executive Director and Managing Director level.

Structure complex issues into concise, decision-ready materials and communicate recommendations with clarity and credibility.

Facilitate workshops, challenge constructively, resolve ambiguity and build alignment across stakeholders with differing priorities.

Coordinate global project teams across Asia, the UK and the US, ensuring clear ownership, timely decisions and consistent execution.

What Success Looks Like

Strategic priorities are converted quickly into credible, decision-ready business cases and clearly scoped workstreams.

Financial and operational assumptions are transparent, evidence-based and sufficiently robust to support senior investment decisions.

Projects mobilise effectively, maintain senior stakeholder alignment and deliver agreed milestones, benefits and control outcomes.

AI use cases and prompts move beyond ideas into practical adoption, with measurable productivity or business value.

Project and business solution recommendations balance value, capability, resilience, governance and regulatory requirements.

The VP is recognized as a trusted, self-directed transformation partner who can lead project teams and influence effectively across functions, cultures and time zones.

Requirements

Minimum Degree in Business Management or related field

Minimum 10 years’ experience in business transformation function with a focus on strategy, change delivery, and business analysis within investment banking or the wider financial services sector.

Minimum 5 years’ experience in financial modelling, scenario analysis, cost-benefit assessment, benefits sizing and confident interpretation of operational and workforce data.

Experience in defining strategic initiatives, preparing compelling business cases with financials and converting ambiguous objectives into structured, executable workstreams.

Advanced Microsoft 365 user skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, with practical experience using Microsoft Copilot for administration, analysis, document creation and presentations.

Demonstrated experience writing and progressing AI prompts and/or use cases that improve productivity or deliver measurable outcomes; knowledge of Anthropic or similar AI models would be advantageous.

Track record of successful end-to-end project delivery, including planning, governance, risk and dependency management, senior reporting and benefits realisation.

Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with the judgement and presence to engage, influence and challenge Business Managers and stakeholders at the working level (Vice President or Executive Director).

Ability to lead cross-functional project teams through influence and accountability in an individual-contributor role.

Experience in one or more of the following is strongly preferred: location strategy and organisational design; target footprint and offshoring execution; AI transformation; or outsourcing and strategic vendor partnerships.

Understanding of sourcing, outsourcing governance, service management third-party risk, operational resilience and applicable regulatory requirements within financial services is preferred.

High attention to detail, sound judgement, intellectual curiosity and the ability to work independently across multiple priorities with targeted direction.

Ability to coordinate effectively with global stakeholders and maintain flexibility to manage stakeholder communications across Asia, the UK and the US.

Nomura Leadership Behaviours

Explore Insights & Vision: Identify the underlying causes of problems faced by you or your team and define a clear vision and direction for the future.

Making Strategic Decisions: Evaluate all the options for resolving the problems and effectively prioritize actions or recommendations.

Inspire Entrepreneurship in People: Inspire team members through effective communication of ideas and motivate them to actively enhance productivity.

Elevate Organizational Capability: Engage proactively in professional development and enhance team productivity through the promotion of knowledge sharing.

Inclusion: Respect DEI, foster a culture of inclusion and psychological safety in the workplace and cultivate a "Risk Culture" (Challenge, Escalate and Respect).

Diversity Statement

Nomura is committed to an employment policy of equal opportunities and is fundamentally opposed to any less favourable treatment accorded to existing or potential members of staff on the grounds of race, creed, colour, nationality, disability, marital status, pregnancy, gender, or sexual orientation.

DISCLAIMER

This Job Description is for reference only, and whilst this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, it is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, skills, efforts, requirements or working conditions associated with the job. The management reserves the right to revise the job and may, at his or her discretion, assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

Nomura is an Equal Opportunity Employer

SFID: 15157

Nomura is a leading financial services group and the preeminent Asian-based investment bank with worldwide reach. Nomura provides a broad range of innovative solutions tailored to the specific requirements of individual, institutional, corporate and government clients through an international network in over 30 countries. Based in Tokyo and with regional headquarters in Hong Kong, London, and New York, Nomura employs over 27,000 staff worldwide. Nomura’s unique understanding of Asia enables the company to make a difference for clients through three business divisions: retail, asset management, and wholesale (global markets and investment banking).

description:

B2B Carpentry Sales Executive

title: Director, Commercial Excellence APAC
description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.

This pivotal role is central to setting the agenda and standard for commercial excellence across APAC. As Director, Commercial Excellence APAC, you will own the design and rollout of WSA's Commercial Excellence program, embedding the Smart Lean methodology into how every country team operates. Reporting to the Regional President, APAC, you will drive commercial excellence in the region — building the program in partnership with global teams, training markets in it, and ensuring it becomes the operating rhythm of every country's commercial approached.

What you will do

Partner with global teams to build and shape WSA's Commercial Excellence program for APAC, ensuring it reflects both global standards and regional commercial realities.

Own the integration and rollout of the Smart Lean methodology into commercial excellence, embedding it as a core operating discipline across the region.

Train and upskill the region in WSA's commercial excellence agenda, maintaining a consistently high standard across all APAC markets.

Champion commercial excellence at the country level, working closely with country commercial teams to ensure the program sits at the center of their day-to-day ways of working.

What you bring

Experience

5+ years of commercial experience, complemented by a minimum of 5 years leading project and change management initiatives, with formal change management qualification.

Smart Lean trained and experienced, with a track record of embedding the methodology into real commercial operations.

Strong interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to bring diverse country teams along through complex transformation.

Experienced working across multiple countries or multinational contexts, able to adapt a regional agenda to fit varied market realities.

Performance and personal competencies

A results-driven high performer with a strong “can-do” attitude

Willing to drive organizational change

Drive, determination and high standards. Resilience, high energy and a ‘can-do’ attitude

Results orientated, accountable, and leads by example, raising standards

Influential, make an impact, drive the teams and act as role model

A people-oriented person who is always looking for solutions and bringing quality and efficiency improvements.

Who we are

At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.

Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.

With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.

WSA is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

WSAudiology is formed in 2019, through the merger of Sivantos and Widex, WS Audiology combines over 140 years of experience in pioneering the use of technology to help people with hearing loss hear the sounds that make life wonderful. We are active in over 125 markets and employ 11,000 people worldwide. Our broad portfolio of hearing-related products and services generates annual revenues of around EUR 2 billion.

title: Head of Sales, Asia
description:
About Intellect

Intellect is the global leader in mental health benefits, trusted by the world’s most forward-thinking employers, insurers, and governments to deliver care that is local, personalised, and effective at scale. Today, we serve over 4 million people across 100 countries and languages, making mental health support truly accessible across borders and cultures.

Our platform powers the mental wellbeing of workforces at hundreds of Fortune 500 and major companies, enabling them to support their people with the highest standards of clinical quality, cultural relevance, and on-demand accessibility.

Driven by our mission to build the world’s most trusted mental health benefits platform, Intellect combines a best-in-class digital platform with a world-leading global provider network to deliver unmatched client outcomes and transformative care experiences.

We are backed by top global investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, Insignia Ventures Partners, HOF Capital, K3 Ventures, JAFCO, Headline, East Ventures, IHH Healthcare, MS&AD Ventures, and more, alongside an extensive coalition of notable family offices, big tech executives, and leading angel investors.

The Role

The Director of Sales, Asia will drive Intellect’s enterprise sales growth across our core Asian markets through direct sales and strategic alliances.

This is a hands-on leadership role with accountability for regional sales performance and an individual new business revenue target. You will lead and develop a team of Account Executives and SDRs while personally originating, owning and closing a focused portfolio of strategic enterprise opportunities.

We are looking for a strong enterprise seller and people leader who understands how to win complex deals, lead competitive RFPs and build trusted relationships with C-suite decision-makers. You should be equally comfortable setting market priorities, coaching a salesperson, leading an executive presentation and negotiating a contract.

You will work closely with Marketing, Revenue Operations and Partnerships to shape our sales go-to-market strategy, strengthen commercial discipline and build repeatable routes to growth. You will also partner with Clinical, Operations, Product and Finance to ensure our proposals deliver value for customers and are commercially sustainable.

Your Responsibilities

1. Revenue Ownership & Enterprise Selling

Own regional new business sales performance, translating revenue targets into clear market priorities, account plans and execution.
Carry an individual new business revenue target and personally own a focused portfolio of strategic deals through the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation, contracting and close.
Build qualified pipeline through targeted outreach, executive networks, referrals and partner channels, alongside Marketing and SDR-led activity.
Navigate complex buying groups, uncover customer priorities, develop compelling business cases and secure access to economic buyers and executive sponsors.
Build and deepen relationships with CHROs, Chief People Officers, Total Rewards and Benefits leaders, and other senior stakeholders involved in enterprise buying decisions.

2. Sales Team Leadership & Development

Lead, coach and develop Account Executives and SDRs, setting clear expectations for pipeline creation, opportunity progression and revenue delivery.
Run effective pipeline reviews, deal reviews and individual coaching, identifying performance gaps early and taking action to address them.
Develop the team’s capabilities in discovery, stakeholder mapping, multithreading, value articulation, executive engagement and negotiation.
Establish clear account and territory ownership; help shape hiring, team structure and incentives as the business scales.
Build a culture of accountability, collaboration and high performance through direct feedback, recognition and timely performance management.

3. RFP Leadership & Complex Deal Strategy

Lead priority enterprise RFPs and tenders end to end, including bid qualification, go/no-go decisions, win strategy, proposal development, presentations and commercial negotiations.
Build each bid strategy around the customer’s priorities, evaluation criteria, competitive landscape and Intellect’s differentiated value.
Coordinate solution specialists and cross-functional contributors to deliver accurate, compelling proposals on time, with clear ownership of deliverables.
Lead customer engagement throughout the process, navigating procurement requirements and aligning stakeholders around the proposed solution.
Use win/loss reviews to improve bid selection, sales execution, proposals and competitive positioning.

4. Go-to-Market Strategy & Marketing Collaboration

Shape and execute the sales go-to-market strategy across Asia, prioritising markets, industries, customer segments and direct versus partner-led routes.
Partner with Marketing on target account selection, account-based campaigns, events and demand generation, with shared focus on qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes.
Establish clear lead handovers and follow-up standards, using conversion data and sales feedback to improve lead quality and campaign effectiveness.
Work with Marketing and Product to sharpen enterprise positioning, value propositions and sales narratives based on customer insights and competitive intelligence.
Translate market feedback into practical recommendations on offerings, packaging and growth opportunities.

5. Alliances & Ecosystem-Led Growth

Work with the Partnerships team to turn broker, insurer and other strategic relationships into qualified enterprise pipeline and revenue.
Develop joint account plans and sales initiatives that improve access to priority customers and markets.
Lead sales execution for agreed alliance-led opportunities, coordinating partner introductions, joint pitches and negotiations.
Establish clear opportunity ownership and handovers with Partnerships, aligning direct and partner-led activity to avoid channel conflict.
Evaluate alliance-led sales activity through pipeline quality, conversion and revenue contribution.

6. Revenue Operations & Commercial Discipline

Partner with Revenue Operations to strengthen the foundations for scale: CRM standards, pipeline stages, qualification criteria, forecasting, account planning and performance reporting.
Own adoption of these standards within Sales, maintaining accurate opportunity data, realistic forecasts and clear next steps.
Use pipeline coverage, conversion, sales cycle and productivity data to identify bottlenecks and improve performance; build repeatable playbooks across priority segments.
Help shape pricing, packaging and deal structures with Finance and relevant teams, balancing customer value, competitiveness, delivery requirements and sustainable margins.
Lead deal negotiations within agreed approval frameworks and ensure effective handovers to Client Success and Operations, with clear customer commitments and ownership of follow-on opportunities.

Requirements

Proven Enterprise Sales Leader

You have a track record of delivering B2B new business growth and leading sales teams against clear revenue targets. You have personally originated and closed complex enterprise deals and can explain your contribution to those wins.

Hands-On Player-Coach

You enjoy leading a team while continuing to own and close your own opportunities. You can balance personal selling with coaching, delegate effectively and step into team deals without creating confusion over ownership.

Experienced RFP Leader

You have led and won competitive enterprise RFPs or tenders. You bring sound judgment on which bids to pursue, how to differentiate a proposal and how to coordinate teams through demanding timelines and commercial negotiations.

Strong Enterprise Seller & Executive Relationship Builder

You understand long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, from discovery and business case development through procurement, legal review and contracting. You can engage credibly with C-suite leaders, develop executive sponsors and build new relationships through outreach, networks and partner introductions.

Disciplined Sales Operator

You understand pipeline generation, qualification, forecasting, territory planning, sales methodologies and performance management. You use data to improve decisions and execution, supported by sound judgment and a close understanding of your customers.

Commercially Strategic & Collaborative

You bring strong judgment on market priorities, pricing, positioning and deal economics. You work effectively with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Partnerships and delivery teams, aligning different perspectives around clear commercial outcomes.

Experienced Across Asian Markets

You have meaningful experience in Asian enterprise markets and understand differences in buying behaviour, procurement practices and market maturity. Experience across Singapore and other major Asian markets is strongly preferred.

Experience in enterprise SaaS, HR technology, employee benefits, healthcare, insurance, professional services or another complex B2B category is advantageous. Direct mental healthcare experience is not required.

Builder Mindset & Mission Alignment

You are comfortable in a growing business where processes continue to evolve. You bring structure, take ownership and adapt as you learn. You are motivated by expanding access to quality mental healthcare while building a commercially sustainable business.

What Success Looks Like
Delivery against regional and individual new business revenue targets.
A healthy enterprise pipeline, stronger conversion and reliable forecasting.
Strategic enterprise and RFP wins on commercially sound terms.
A capable, accountable sales team with improving productivity and performance.
Measurable pipeline and revenue from alliance-led sales.
Repeatable sales practices and effective collaboration across the teams supporting growth.

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

Global company – work in a diverse environment with people from nearly 20 countries
Generous leave policy – time off to rest and recharge
Christmas week off – company-wide break during Christmas, separate from annual leave
Birthday leave – enjoy a day off on your birthday
Quarterly mental health days – one day off every quarter to focus on your wellbeing
Flexible work arrangements – work in a way that suits your lifestyle and goals
Work-life balance – a culture that values personal time and long-term wellness
Medical coverage – comprehensive insurance for peace of mind
Performance bonus – high performance is recognised and rewarded
Development budget - annual allowance to support your professional development
Mental health support – premium coaching access to our mental health app and resources & dedicated budget for clinical and psychiatric care
Socials and communities – regular non-work events/activities to connect and have fun together
