title: Strategy & Programmes Lead, Rice Funder Collaborative (RFC) Secretariat
description:
About Rice Funder Collaborative

The Rice Funder Collaborative (RFC) is a new, Asia-led philanthropic collaborative that aims to mobilise coordinated capital to transform rice farming systems, reducing emissions, building farmer resilience, and improving the livelihoods of millions of smallholder farmers across Asia. By 2030, the RFC aims to mobilise around US$30 million in philanthropic capital and catalyse a further ~US$100 million in aligned public and development finance.

The RFC initiative is hosted at the Asia Community Foundation (ACF) and the Secretariat team is led by Asia Philanthropy Circle (APC).

Asia Philanthropy Circle (APC) is a leading platform that mobilises Asia-focused philanthropists to deepen their practice of philanthropy and address systemic challenges collaboratively, through shared learning, peer exchange and joint action across the region.

Asia Community Foundation (ACF) is APC’s sister organisation, providing the infrastructure that makes collaborative action possible, including regranting, fiscal hosting, shared infrastructure and back-office support, so that philanthropists, funders and impact initiatives can focus on the work itself rather than the operational load.

For more details on RFC, you can find the overview document by visiting

https://tinyurl.com/yc8zd492

Role Overview

This is a full-time role on a 2-year contract (with the opportunity for renewal based on performance and regulatory approvals) with a preference for candidates living in and/or able to work in Singapore.

Reporting to the Interim Secretariat Director, and accountable to the RFC Steering Committee, the Strategy & Programmes Lead owns the RFC’s programmatic strategy and is responsible for its grantmaking. This role shapes the RFC’s shared vision into a coherent, fundable portfolio: developing and refining the strategy and theory of change, building and curating a high-quality pipeline, designing and overseeing grants across both aligned and pooled capital, and managing the portfolio for impact and learning.

The role leads a team of up to two Programme Officers and Programme Associate(s), oversees the Communications & Knowledge function on the programmatic and evidence side, and works closely as a peer with the Partnerships & Community Lead, who leads funder relations, the Community of Practice, and donor cultivation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy and Theory of Change

Develop, operationalise, and continually refine the RFC’s overarching strategy, theory of change, and three-year implementation roadmap, validated with founding members.

Translate the four impact priorities and four pathways for change into clear grantmaking theses, funding priorities, and sequencing across geographies.

Establish the initial prioritisation framework for pooled fund grantmaking, adapting the mix to the readiness, opportunities, and needs of different countries.

2. Pipeline and Grantmaking

Build and maintain a high-quality, curated pipeline of investment-ready opportunities aligned with the strategy, including sourcing internally and incorporating funder-vetted opportunities, with a near-term target of approximately ten high-potential opportunities in the first year

Lead landscape scans and opportunity assessments, identifying priority gaps and areas for philanthropic collaboration

Design and oversee grantmaking strategies, processes, and guidelines for both aligned and pooled capital, and lead due diligence in coordination with ACF’s grant administration

Develop grant recommendations and present them, with clear rationale and evidence, to the Grants/Investment Committee

Ensure grantee support is effective, equitable, and aligned with the Collaborative’s broader goals

3. Pooled Fund and Portfolio Management

Programme the pooled fund’s investments in line with the shared strategy, ensuring grantmaking is informed by, and contributes to, the Secretariat’s learning and pipeline development

Manage the overall portfolio for impact: responsible for outcome and impact frameworks, tracking portfolio-level results, and conducting periodic reviews to shift capital towards the strongest-performing approaches

Build the monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL) framework, with clear indicators for methane reduction, farmer outcomes, and ecosystem strengthening

Sequence funding to support different stages of development, from early exploration and evidence generation to demonstration, scaling, and systems change, while keeping the partner base sufficiently diverse

4. Team Leadership

Recruit, lead, and develop the programmatic team, including two Programme Officers and Programme Associate(s), with a supportive, empowering, and inclusive style

Oversee the Communications & Knowledge function on the evidence and programmatic side, and commission consultants and technical experts as the work requires

Build a culture that values rigour, reflection, and innovation

Recommend additional staff and consulting capacities necessary for the successful implementation of the RFC strategy

5. Knowledge, Evidence, and Ecosystem

Generate and disseminate evidence on what does and does not work to funders and the wider ecosystem, and enable South-South learning across priority geographies

Connect strategy, capital, knowledge, and implementation so that funding is deployed where it can generate the greatest combined impact across mitigation, resilience, livelihoods, and sustainable production

In partnership with the Partnerships & Community Lead and the Secretariat Director, support the case for investment and help crowd in government, multilateral development banks, development finance institutions, and private-sector capital around proven approaches

What Success Looks Like in 12 Months

In the first 12 months, the Strategy & Programmes Lead will have co-developed and validated the RFC’s strategy, theory of change, and three-year roadmap with founding members, and finalised and rolled out the operational and grantmaking guidelines and initial funding priorities that allow both aligned and pooled capital to move.

A first pipeline of approximately ten high-potential opportunities will be curated with clear rationale and evidence, ready for aligned or pooled giving. The programmatic team will be recruited and onboarded, supported by an established MEL framework, and the pooled facility will be progressing towards its US$30 million target, with grantmaking opportunities identified that build credibility with funders and grantees alike.

Experience and Skills

We expect candidates to demonstrate a majority of the following. We are more interested in the right combination of strategic judgment, grantmaking craft, and regional fluency than in any single credential.

At least 12 years of experience in

:

Senior grantmaking and strategy leadership.

A strong track record of designing and overseeing grantmaking or investment portfolios with clear impact pathways, ideally in climate, agriculture, food systems, or rural development, including experience translating strategy into implementation.

Systems thinking

. Demonstrated ability to synthesise complex, technical information into clear strategies and to identify the levers (e.g., policy, finance, research, farmer partnership) that drive change at scale.

Regional depth

. Significant experience working in or across Southeast Asia, with a genuine understanding of the diverse contexts, institutions, and realities of the region’s agricultural and climate systems.

Portfolio and impact management

. Experience building or running monitoring, evaluation, and learning approaches and using evidence to allocate and reallocate capital.

Team building and leadership

. A capable and empowering manager able to build and develop a small, high-performing, multidisciplinary team.

Partnership and influence

. Skill in building trusted relationships across funders, grantees, governments, MDBs, research institutions, and civil society, often across cultural contexts.

Communication

. Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to crystallise complex issues for diverse audiences. Languages relevant to priority geographies are welcomed.

Desirable experience:

Direct topical expertise in rice, agricultural methane, or climate-smart agriculture; knowledge of interventions such as Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD), seed systems, and/or straw management, and familiarity with the importance and practical approaches to Measurement, Reporting, and Verification (MRV) of changes in agricultural systems.

Experience with blended or catalytic finance and with mobilising MDB, DFI, or government co-financing.

Experience in or alongside philanthropy and donor collaboratives.

Experience standing up a new initiative, team, or fund from the ground up

Attributes

Proactive, solutions-driven, and comfortable with ambiguity, iteration, and long-term horizons for change.

A lateral thinker with sound judgment and a strong eye for detail.

Reflective and self-aware, with high integrity, diplomacy, and humility.

A collaborative style that builds partnerships on trust, transparency, and mutual respect.

Deeply committed to a just transition for smallholder farmers, and to the Asia-led mission and values of the Collaborative.

To Apply

Please submit a CV and a short covering letter setting out how you meet the role and person specification.

Closing date:

20 October 2026

The Rice Funder Collaborative believes the transformation of rice systems must be shaped by, and serve, the farmers and communities at its heart. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and we are especially keen to hear from candidates based in and connected to the priority geographies of Southeast Asia.

Asia Community Foundation's goal is to unlock latent giving within Asia by establishing Donor Advised Funds (DAFs) and providing advice for high to ultra-high-net-worth donors, and matching donor interests to funding opportunities in the Asian region. ACF’s key value proposition would be to help donors give more effectively, efficiently and safely within Asia, by leveraging on a shared infrastructure that is professionally managed, technology-led, and well-networked with the necessary local ground intelligence. ACF is working closely with the relevant government agencies in Singapore to ensure that this entire process is smoothly facilitated.

ACF’s core offering will be a holistic suite of services from start-to-end to facilitate smooth cross-border giving for donors who intend to pursue an intentional, strategic giving plan. ACF will establish and manage DAFs for high and ultra-high net worth donors. ACF will then facilitate the various steps for high-impact giving within Asia—from conducting due diligence on non-profit organisations, to grant administration and disbursement of funds, and from programme development to monitoring and evaluation. ACF will also be able to provide a range of advisory services and other elective offerings, ranging from education and consulting to recruiting and grantor-grantee engagement.

title: Social Media Account Manager
description:
Job Description — Social Media Account Manager

Role

Social Media Account Manager

Reports to

Head of Operations

Location

Remote, Singapore-based

Type

Full-time

Compensation

SGD 2,200 per month

Accounts held

[X] client accounts

Review

At 3 months and 6 months

Purpose of the role

Network manages social media for interior design firms, architects and furniture suppliers across IG, FB, TikTok and YouTube. Production, design and video editing sit with the delivery team.

This role owns the account and the result. Everything that reaches a client's channel goes through this person: what gets made, what gets written, when it gets shot, and whether it performs.

The delivery team makes the work. The consultant owns the commercial relationship. The Account Manager is accountable for the work being right, landing on time, and growing the account organically. Delivery is the floor, not the measure.

Key responsibilities

Client strategy

Build the content strategy for each account with the consultant assigned to it

Take the commercial context from the consultant (what the client sells, who they want, what they have promised) and turn it into a content direction that delivers it

Set the account's organic objective with the consultant at the start of each cycle, and agree what success looks like

Bring performance data to the consultant so strategy changes are based on what happened, not on what the client asked for last

Flag when a client request will not serve the objective, and give the consultant an alternative to take back

The consultant owns the client relationship and the commercial conversation. The Account Manager owns what gets made and why.

Organic performance

Own the organic result on every assigned account: reach, engagement, page growth and enquiries

Decide what gets made based on what is performing, not on filling a calendar

Track performance weekly and change direction on evidence, not at month end

Identify formats that work on one account and carry them to others

Visual direction and alignment

Hold the visual standard on every account. Network works in a premium category and output must look considered, not templated

Keep each account visually coherent. A feed should read as one brand, not a run of unrelated posts

Reject work that meets the brief but misses the bar, and say why

Client posting and accountability

Own the posting schedule for every assigned account across all platforms

Publish or schedule all content to the agreed calendar

Review every asset before it goes live for typos, brand accuracy and strategic fit

Take responsibility for anything published in error, including retraction and client explanation

Copywriting

Write captions for all assigned accounts in the client's voice, not a house voice

Write hooks, on-creative text and CTAs supplied to the design and video teams

Adapt one concept into platform-appropriate copy across IG, FB, TikTok and YouTube

Maintain a written voice reference for each account so copy stays consistent

Creative deliverables

Plan the content calendar and pipeline for each account against the agreed monthly deliverable

Write briefs for the graphic and video teams that are complete enough to execute without follow-up

Track every deliverable from brief to published, and know its status without being asked

Run revision rounds with the delivery team and close them out

Shoot scheduling and coordination

Schedule production shoots with the client and the production team

Confirm site access, timing, homeowner permissions and scope before the shoot date

Brief the production team on what the shoot must produce

Chase and confirm footage handover after the shoot

Delivery team communication

Act as the single point of contact between clients and the graphic, video and production teams

Give the delivery team enough lead time to work; escalate capacity conflicts early

Keep the delivery team unblocked so they are never waiting on information

Client communication

Own client group chats as the day-to-day point of contact

Respond within working hours, with no dropped threads

Manage expectations on timelines and flag delays before the client notices them

Performance measures

Performance on this role is judged on organic outcomes, not activity.

Primary

Organic creative performance: reach, retention and engagement on published content against account baseline

Page growth: follower growth, saves and shares across assigned accounts

Organic enquiries: DMs, comments and leads generated through organic content

Visual direction: accounts hold a consistent, premium visual standard across the feed

Strategic alignment: what gets made maps to the account's growth objective

Baseline

On-time publishing rate across all assigned accounts

Errors reaching a live client channel (target: zero)

Deliverables completed against monthly contracted volume

Shoot dates held versus rescheduled

Delivery team blocked time attributable to missing briefs or information

Baseline measures are expectations. Missing them is a problem. Meeting them is not performance.

Requirements

Experience

1–2 years running social media accounts in a client-facing role

Demonstrated organic growth on an account you owned, with numbers

Skills

Written Mandarin and English

Copywriting for social, with samples

Meta Business Suite, native platform scheduling and native analytics

Able to read performance data and change direction from it

Taste. Two versions of an asset in front of you, you can say which is better and why

Able to write a brief another person can execute without asking questions

Able to hold a strategy conversation with a salesperson and push back with reasoning

Accurate proofreading under volume

Other

Contactable and responsive on WhatsApp during working hours

Works without supervision or reminders

Singapore-based

Working arrangement

Remote. Occasional attendance at shoots or client meetings as required. Communication runs through WhatsApp and [project management tool].

Out of scope

Graphic design and video editing

Filming and on-site production

Paid media buying

Client contract negotiation, pricing and upselling

Ownership of the commercial relationship

Network Singapore is a digital marketing and lead generation company specialising in the interior design industry. We operate one of Singapore's leading online portals connecting homeowners with interior design firms, helping businesses grow their client base through targeted digital exposure and a consistent flow of qualified leads.

Founded with a focus on results, we work closely with interior design professionals across Singapore to deliver marketing solutions that are measurable, scalable, and built around the needs of a competitive market. Our platform is designed to reduce the time and cost of client acquisition for interior design firms, allowing them to focus on what they do best — delivering exceptional spaces.

At Network Singapore, we believe in building long-term partnerships with our clients. Our team combines deep industry knowledge with a data-driven approach to ensure that every firm on our platform gets maximum visibility and genuine business opportunities.

We are a growing company with a performance-driven culture, committed to developing talent from within and building a team that takes pride in delivering results.

description:
Social Media Marketing Executive

As the business continues to expand its digital presence, they are looking for a creative and commercially minded

Social Media Marketing Executive

who can take ownership of social media, content creation, digital campaigns and lead-generation activities across multiple business leaders.

We are looking for a creative, hands-on and commercially driven

Social Media Marketing Executive

to manage social media, content creation, personal branding and digital marketing initiatives for multiple business leaders.

Beyond creating content and growing online presence, you will also play an important role in

lead generation, lead nurturing and appointment setting

. You will work closely with individual leaders to understand their business objectives, target audiences and positioning, and translate these into targeted content and campaigns that generate meaningful engagement and business opportunities.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being involved across the full marketing journey, from

content ideation, filming and editing to campaign execution, stakeholder management, lead follow-up and conversion

.

Social Media & Personal Branding

Develop and execute social media strategies across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, Douyin and Xiaohongshu (XHS).

Manage the personal brands of multiple business leaders, tailoring content, messaging and positioning according to their target audiences and business objectives.

Plan and manage monthly content calendars aligned with business priorities, campaigns, events and lead-generation objectives.

Work closely with leaders to understand their expertise, target markets and commercial priorities, and translate these into relevant and engaging content.

Manage day-to-day content publishing, community engagement and social media activities.

Monitor social media trends, audience behaviour and content performance to identify opportunities for improvement and growth.

Content Creation & Video Production

Conceptualise, script, film and edit engaging short-form videos, Reels and social media content.

Handle basic photography and videography for marketing activities, campaigns and events.

Edit videos with subtitles, captions, graphics, music and transitions using tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe or equivalent platforms.

Create marketing materials including social media visuals, EDMs, event collaterals and digital campaign assets.

Maintain consistency in branding, messaging and content quality across different accounts.

Lead Generation & Appointment Setting

Develop and support digital marketing initiatives aimed at generating qualified leads, enquiries and appointments.

Manage incoming leads generated through social media, digital campaigns, events, WhatsApp and other marketing channels.

Follow up and nurture leads professionally to understand their needs and guide suitable prospects towards appointment setting.

Maintain accurate lead records and monitor the progress of leads throughout the marketing and conversion funnel.

Track response rates, lead quality and appointment conversions to identify areas for improvement.

Identify common enquiries, objections and lead behaviours, and provide feedback to improve campaign messaging and conversion strategies.

Account & Stakeholder Management

Serve as the key marketing point of contact for assigned business leaders.

Build strong working relationships with leaders and understand their business objectives, target audiences and marketing priorities.

Coordinate content planning, filming schedules, approvals, campaign timelines and publishing requirements.

Manage multiple accounts and marketing priorities while ensuring deliverables are completed according to agreed timelines.

Provide regular updates on content performance, campaign activities, lead generation and appointment outcomes.

Digital Marketing & Campaign Management

Plan, execute and optimise digital marketing campaigns across Meta, Google and other relevant advertising platforms.

Support paid advertising initiatives aimed at increasing awareness, generating enquiries and acquiring qualified leads.

Manage EDM and email marketing campaigns, including campaign preparation, content and scheduling.

Support marketing initiatives for recruitment drives, seminars, webinars, workshops, events and other business activities.

Develop event promotional materials and coordinate marketing timelines across multiple campaigns.

Monitor campaign performance and use key marketing metrics to recommend improvements to content, targeting and campaign execution.

Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Communications, Mass Communications, Business or a related field.

Entry level candidates and candidates with up to 2 years of relevant experience in social media, digital marketing, content creation, lead generation or account management are welcome.

Strong hands-on ability in content creation, filming, short-form video editing and basic graphic design.

Comfortable using tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite or equivalent content creation platforms.

Familiar with managing social media platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn and/or Xiaohongshu.

Strong communication, interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.

Comfortable working directly with business leaders and managing multiple accounts, priorities and timelines.

Commercially minded and able to understand how marketing activities contribute to lead generation and business conversion.

Organised, proactive and comfortable taking ownership of projects from planning through execution.

Proficiency in English to support communication and content requirements stakeholders and audiences.

Added Advantages

Hands-on experience with Meta Ads, Google Ads or other digital advertising platforms.

Experience using CRM, lead-management or marketing automation platforms.

Experience managing leads, conducting lead follow-ups or supporting appointment-setting activities.

Familiarity with analytics and reporting tools such as Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics or similar platforms.

Previous exposure to the financial services or financial advisory industry would be advantageous.

title: Ad Sales Planner
description:
Job Description
Job Requisition ID: 53533
Job Closing Date: 20/10/2026
Singapore, SGP, 79909

JOB DETAILS

Role: Ad Sales Planner

Contract Type: Permanent, Full-Time

Location: Singapore

Working Rights: Candidates must be legally authorised to work in Singapore without requiring visa sponsorship or work pass support.

WE ARE BBC STUDIOS

A globally renowned media company borne of the BBC. We make and distribute the world's most sought-after TV, audio and digital content.

Our ambition is to be the home of the most powerful, entertaining, and inspiring stories for people all around the world.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Ad Sales Planner is a critical member of the APAC Advertising Sales team, supporting revenue growth across BBC Studios' portfolio of television, digital, audio, sponsorship, branded content and audience solutions. Working closely with sales, clients, agencies and internal stakeholders, the role supports the full advertising sales cycle, from proposal development and campaign planning through to execution, reporting and post-campaign analysis.

The APAC region presents a significant growth opportunity through a dual-pronged strategy of expanding our base of premium television advertisers while accelerating growth across BBC Studios' evolving digital, audience, data and content marketing solutions. As a result, this role plays an important part in helping clients better understand and access BBC Studios' unique audiences, premium content environments and advertising capabilities.

The successful candidate will combine strong commercial acumen, attention to detail and client management skills with a passion for media, content, audience insights and advertising innovation. They will become a trusted partner to the sales team, supporting business growth while ensuring the highest standards of campaign execution and client service.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT

1. Commercial Sales Planning & Client Solutions (55%)

Support the APAC Advertising Sales team in developing strategic advertising solutions that drive revenue growth across television, digital, audio, sponsorship, branded content and audience-led opportunities.

Develop compelling media plans, presentations and commercial proposals in response to client and agency briefs.
Translate client marketing objectives into integrated advertising solutions leveraging BBC Studios' content, audience and platform capabilities.

title: Marketing Director
description:
Job Overview

AWA Gymnastics is seeking an experienced and results-driven

Marketing Director

to lead the academy's marketing, branding, student acquisition and market expansion strategies in Singapore.

The Marketing Director will be responsible for strengthening AWA Gymnastics' brand presence, generating qualified student enquiries, increasing trial-class bookings and enrolments, and developing effective online and offline marketing channels.

This is a leadership role requiring a strong combination of strategic marketing, digital acquisition, brand management, data analysis and commercial awareness.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Student Acquisition

Develop and execute the overall marketing strategy for AWA Gymnastics.

Create marketing plans to increase student enrolment across recreational and competitive rhythmic gymnastics programmes.

Develop targeted campaigns for children, teenagers, adults and parents.

Establish monthly, quarterly and annual marketing targets aligned with enrolment and revenue objectives.

Design effective customer acquisition funnels from initial awareness and enquiry to trial class, enrolment and renewal.

Identify new customer segments and opportunities for business growth.

Digital Marketing

Lead digital marketing campaigns across Google, Meta, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and other relevant platforms.

Develop and manage SEO and SEM strategies to increase organic and paid search visibility.

Plan and optimise paid advertising campaigns based on leads, trial bookings, enrolments and customer acquisition costs.

Manage website marketing performance, landing pages and online enquiry funnels.

Develop retargeting and lead-nurturing strategies for prospective students and parents.

Analyse campaign data and continuously improve marketing ROI.

Brand Management

Develop and strengthen AWA Gymnastics' brand positioning in Singapore's gymnastics and sports education market.

Maintain consistent brand identity and messaging across digital and offline channels.

Oversee the creation of promotional materials, photography, videos, social media content, brochures and advertisements.

Communicate the academy's coaching expertise, training methodology, facilities and student development opportunities effectively.

Build a premium and professional brand image that appeals to both recreational and competitive gymnastics families.

Content & Social Media

Develop the academy's overall content and social media strategy.

Create content plans featuring coaches, training sessions, student development, competitions, events and academy achievements.

Work with coaches and operational teams to identify suitable stories and content opportunities.

Grow the academy's social media presence and engagement.

Develop educational content to help parents understand rhythmic gymnastics, training pathways and student development.

Events, Competitions & Community Marketing

Develop marketing campaigns for trial classes, open houses, holiday camps, workshops and special programmes.

Support the promotion of local and international rhythmic gymnastics competitions.

Coordinate marketing activities around student performances, competitions and academy events.

Develop community outreach initiatives to increase awareness of rhythmic gymnastics.

Identify opportunities for exhibitions, demonstrations and promotional events.

Partnerships & Business Development

Develop partnerships with schools, international schools, preschools, clubs, community organisations and other relevant institutions.

Identify opportunities for school-based rhythmic gymnastics programmes and enrichment partnerships.

Develop referral and cross-promotional partnerships with complementary businesses and organisations.

Explore collaboration opportunities with international coaches, gymnastics organisations and training programmes.

Support the academy's regional and international brand development where appropriate.

Sales & Marketing Coordination

Work closely with the sales and customer service teams to improve enquiry-to-trial and trial-to-enrolment conversion.

Analyse customer feedback and identify barriers to enrolment.

Develop promotional offers and campaigns to support enrolment and student retention.

Monitor the performance of different lead-generation channels.

Ensure marketing campaigns generate measurable commercial outcomes.

Team & Budget Management

Build, manage and develop the marketing team.

Manage external agencies, designers, photographers, videographers and digital marketing partners where required.

Establish clear marketing KPIs and reporting systems.

Manage the annual marketing budget and allocate resources effectively.

Prepare regular marketing performance reports for senior management.

Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Management or a related discipline is preferred.

Relevant experience in marketing, brand management, digital marketing or business development.

Previous experience in a marketing leadership or management position is preferred.

Strong understanding of digital advertising, social media marketing, SEO, SEM and lead generation.

Strong commercial mindset with the ability to connect marketing activities with student enrolment and revenue.

Experience in education, sports, enrichment, fitness, children's services or other B2C industries will be an advantage.

Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate campaign performance and marketing ROI.

Experience managing agencies, vendors or internal marketing teams is preferred.

Knowledge of rhythmic gymnastics or the gymnastics industry is an advantage but not essential.

Ability to work in a fast-paced and growth-oriented environment.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance may be measured based on:

Number of qualified student enquiries

Trial class bookings

Trial-to-enrolment conversion

New student enrolment

Customer acquisition cost

Marketing-generated revenue

Digital advertising performance and ROI

Website traffic and organic search growth

Social media reach and engagement

Partnership and referral channel development

Student retention and re-enrolment support

Overall brand awareness and market presence

What We Offer

Senior marketing leadership position within a growing rhythmic gymnastics academy.

Opportunity to shape the brand and marketing strategy of AWA Gymnastics.

Exposure to both recreational and competitive rhythmic gymnastics programmes.

Opportunity to work with an international coaching team and develop partnerships within the sports and education sectors.

Performance-driven career development opportunities.

Dynamic working environment combining education, sports, events and international competition.

AWA Gymnastics

welcomes experienced marketing professionals who are passionate about brand building, business growth, sports education and developing meaningful experiences for students and families.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
About This Role

We’re looking for an Account Manager who can make a complex account feel clear, controlled and well-run—for the client and for the team delivering it.

You will be a senior day-to-day client contact across TGP’s social media accounts. You will guide the client relationship, account plan, delivery rhythm and commercial health of the work, while collaborating closely with an Account Executive and colleagues across strategy, content, design and production.

The role brings together client partnership, delivery management and commercial awareness. You will turn client priorities into clear action, keep the team ahead of deadlines and give the client confidence that TGP understands both the work and the wider business context.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Build strong client relationships: Lead day-to-day communication, meetings and status updates. Understand the client’s priorities, working style, brand sensitivities and internal stakeholders.

• Shape the account plan: Work with the strategy and content teams to translate monthly priorities into a clear content calendar, production plan and approval schedule.

• Turn discussions into clear action: Make sure important meetings are followed by an accurate written record covering the client’s request, TGP’s recommendation, agreed deliverables, owners and deadlines.

• Provide clear recommendations: Bring together input from the team, explain TGP’s point of view confidently and help the client make informed decisions.

• Coordinate delivery: Keep content, design, production, editing, approvals and publishing moving across multiple work streams. Identify risks early and work with the relevant people to resolve them.

• Work closely with the AccountExecutive: Agree priorities, coordinate responsibilities and review key trackers, follow-ups and client records together. Help the AE build confidence and take on greater ownership over time.

• Support the account’s commercial health: Track deliverables against the agreed scope, identify additional requests, support costings and keep agency time and margins in mind.

• Keep communication connected: Make sure everyone has the context, decisions and client feedback needed to do the work well.

• Turn performance into action: Coordinate reporting and work with the wider team to identify useful recommendations for the next content cycle.

• Contribute to pitches: Bring client insight, delivery planning and account-management thinking to new-business opportunities when needed.

Who You Are

You are organised, calm and decisive. You communicate early, maintain clear written records and keep several priorities moving with clarity.

You are comfortable bringing a point of view rather than simply reporting a problem. When an issue needs attention, you can explain the context, recommend a way forward and identify the decision required.

You are collaborative and generous with information. You understand that strong account management helps different disciplines work well together while giving the client a clear and consistent experience.

You are also comfortable using modern tools, includingAI-assisted tools where useful, to reduce repetitive administration, structure information and improve speed. You review the work carefully and apply your own judgment, client knowledge and communication standards before it is used.

Skills & Experience

• 4+ years of account management or client-services experience, ideally in a creative, social media, digital or integrated agency.

• Experience managing recurring content or social media retainers with multiple monthly deliverables is strongly preferred.

• Strong client-facing presence and clear, confident written communication.

• Proven ability to manage calendars, approvals, revisions, production dependencies and competing deadlines.

• Experience working with and supporting the development of an Account Executive or junior colleague.

• Commercial awareness, including scope control, cost implications and agency profitability.

• Confidence collaborating with strategists, writers, designers, producers and editors.

• Familiarity with social media content workflows, platform formats, reporting and publishing processes.

• Resourcefulness and a willingness to learn and apply tools that improve how work is organised and delivered.

title: Events, Programming & Business Development Executive
description:
The Events, Programming & BusinessDevelopment Executive is responsible for managing assigned events, developing revenue opportunities and supporting entertainment programming and production activities across the company’s venues.

The role covers the end-to-end coordinationof corporate events, venue rentals, private functions, selected ticketed programmes and commercial partnerships, from initial enquiry through execution and post-event follow-up.

This is a commercially driven role withaccountability for assigned sales and revenue targets. The Executive will workclosely with internal departments, clients, artistes, technical personnel,vendors, sponsors and external partners to support the growth of the Music,Content & Events (MCE) portfolio.

The position is eligible for commission onqualifying revenue in accordance with the Company’s prevailing commissionscheme.

Key Responsibilities

1. Events & Client Management

Manage assigned corporate functions, venue rentals, private events, activations and ticketed programmes from enquiry through event completion.

Liaise directly with clients to understand event objectives, requirements, budgets and timelines.

Conduct client meetings, site inspections and event briefings where required.

Prepare event proposals, quotations, timelines, run sheets and operational requirements.

Coordinate with Operations, Marketing, Finance, Technical teams and external vendors to ensure smooth event delivery.

Coordinate venue setup, manpower, equipment, production and event logistics.

Be present on-site for assigned events and manage client and operational requirements during execution.

Resolve event-related issues promptly and escalate matters where necessary.

Ensure assigned events comply with venue requirements, operational procedures, safety standards and applicable licensing requirements.

Conduct post-event follow-up and identify opportunities for repeat business and service improvement.

2. Business Development & Revenue

Develop new business opportunities through corporate events, venue rentals, private functions, sponsorships and commercial partnerships.

Respond promptly to incoming event and venue enquiries.

Build and maintain relationships with corporate clients, event organisers, agencies and business partners.

Prepare and present proposals, quotations, event budgets and commercial packages.

Manage commercial discussions and negotiate within approved pricing and commercial guidelines, escalating exceptions for approval.

Follow up actively on proposals and enquiries to improve sales conversion.

Maintain an updated sales pipeline covering enquiries, proposals, confirmed events and prospective opportunities.

Identify opportunities for repeat business, account development and long-term client relationships.

Achieve assigned individual and/or team revenue targets.

Identify opportunities to improve event profitability and maximise revenue from assigned accounts and events.

3. Sponsorship & Commercial Partnerships

Identify potential sponsors, brand partners and commercial collaboration opportunities.

Develop or support the preparation of sponsorship proposals and activation packages.

Liaise with sponsors and partners on agreed requirements, timelines and deliverables.

Coordinate with Marketing and Operations to ensure agreed brand visibility and activation requirements are fulfilled.

Maintain sponsor and partner relationships before, during and after events.

Explore additional revenue opportunities through brand activations, collaborations and commercial initiatives.

4. Entertainment & DigitalProgramming

Coordinate resident band, artiste and entertainment schedules across assigned venues.

Maintain programming calendars, artiste schedules and related documentation.

Liaise with bands, artistes, agents and relevant partners on bookings, schedules and performance requirements.

Coordinate artiste agreements and administrative requirements where applicable.

Support the development of entertainment concepts aligned with venue positioning, audience profiles and business objectives.

Monitor audience response, customer feedback and programme performance.

Recommend programming improvements or new entertainment formats for management review.

Support livestreaming, TikTok Live and other digital entertainment initiatives where applicable.

Coordinate talent, scheduling and production requirements for digital programming.

Explore opportunities to improve audience engagement and commercial value through digital content.

5. Technical & ProductionCoordination

Coordinate technical production requirements for assigned events, entertainment programmes and venue activations.

Liaise with internal technical personnel, sound engineers, vendors and contractors.

Ensure event technical requirements are confirmed in advance and equipment is ready for use.

Coordinate technical systems including:

LED walls

Resolume Media Server

Projectors and presentation systems

Audio systemsMultimedia and visual equipment

Where trained, support basic operation, setup, testing and troubleshooting of technical systems.

Escalate complex technical issues to the appropriate technical personnel or vendor.

Support consistent production and technical standards across assigned events.

6. Sound Engineering Coordination

Coordinate sound engineer schedules and manpower deployment for regular programming and special events.

Ensure sufficient technical coverage is arranged based on event and venue requirements.

Verify attendance and deployment records for sound engineers.

Submit accurate attendance and payroll-related records to the relevant department for processing.

Communicate event schedules and technical requirements clearly to assigned technical personnel.

Provide basic operational or technical support during events where trained and required.

Highlight recurring technical or manpower issues and recommend process improvements.

7. Major Events & Team Support

Work collaboratively with the MCE team on major festivals, flagship events and company-wide activations.

Take ownership of assigned workstreams and deliverables.

Support projects from concept development through planning, execution and post-event review.

Coordinate with internal departments, venue stakeholders, vendors, artistes and external partners.

Ensure assigned timelines, budgets and operational requirements are met.

Provide support to other team members during major or high-volume event periods where required.

8. Financial & AdministrativeResponsibilities

Prepare quotations, invoices, purchase requirements and event-related documentation accurately and on time.

Maintain proper records of enquiries, client communications, contracts, schedules and event documents.

Track revenue, direct event costs and assigned event expenditure.

Monitor event profitability against approved quotations and budgets.

Follow up on outstanding documentation, deposits and payment requirements with relevant stakeholders.

Support monthly revenue tracking and performance reporting.

Provide inputs for departmental budgeting and business planning where required.

Revenue Growth Responsibilities

The Executive is expected to contribute to the commercial growth ofthe MCE portfolio through:

Corporate events

Venue rentals

Private functions

Ticketed programmes

Sponsorships

Entertainment programming

Brand activations

Commercial partnerships

The Executive should actively identify opportunities to increase revenue, improve venue utilisation, generate repeat business and enhance even tprofitability while maintaining service and operational standards.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance may be assessed based on:

Achievement of assigned individual and/or team revenue targets

Sales conversion and development of the business pipeline

Event profitability and cost management

Successful execution of assigned events and programmes

Client satisfaction and repeat business

Sponsorship and commercial opportunities generated

Timeliness and accuracy of quotations, proposals and event documentation

Contribution to programming, technical operations and overall MCE performance

Remuneration & Commission

The position comprises a fixed monthly salary together with eligibility for sales commission.

Commission may apply to qualifying revenue generated from approved revenue streams including:

Corporate events and functions

Venue rentals

Private events

Sponsorships

Commercial partnerships

Other approved revenue-generating opportunities

Commission eligibility, revenue attribution, calculation, qualifying conditions, exclusions and payment arrangements will be governed separately by the Company’s prevailing commission scheme.

Requirements

Diploma or Degree in Events Management, Hospitality, Business, Marketing, Media, Communications or a related discipline preferred.

Relevant experience in events, hospitality, entertainment, venue operations, sales or business development would be advantageous.

Strong coordination, organisation and time-management skills.

Good written and verbal communication skills.

Confident in dealing with clients, artistes, vendors and internal stakeholders.

Commercially minded with a strong interest in sales and business development.

Able to manage multiple events, enquiries and priorities concurrently.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced and operational environment.

Willing to work evenings, weekends and public holidays where required for events and entertainment programmes.

Basic understanding of audio-visual or live entertainment production would be advantageous.

Knowledge of LED walls, Resolume, audio systems or livestreaming would be an added advantage.

Hands-on, resourceful and able to respond calmly to changes during live events.

Timbre Group was founded with the social mission of developing the Singapore music scene through the talent cultivation of Singapore musicians and growing a sustainable audience for them. Today, Timbre holds a portfolio of live music restaurants-bars and dining concepts, two Hawker Centres (Timbre + & Yishun Park Hawker Centre), and artist management agency and a music academy.

title: Grant Assistant Manager/Manager, Mandai Nature

title: SUPPLY CHAIN OPERATIONS MANAGER, SEA & JP
description:
Role Overview

Supply Chain Operations Manager, SEA & JP leads CPFR(Collaborative Planning, Forecasting and Replenishment) process with distributor partners across South-East Asia and Japan cluster. The role focuses on establishing reliable distributor data flows and actionable performance metrics, and ensuring demand visibility, product availability, inventory health and supply reliability by connecting distributor plans with General Mills commercial and supply chain processes.

The role partners closely with General Mills teams(Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Customer Service & Logistics, Supply Planning, Commercial, Finance, Marketing, COE and Global Business Support) and distributor supply chain and commercial teams. The CPFR Manager establishes a consistent operating rhythm, recurring planning and review routines, ensures high quality collaborative plans with distributors, improves alignment between General Mills and distributors on IMS, shipment, inventory and replenishment plans along with KPI’s and drives timely action on risks and opportunities.

Job Description

1. Distributor Collaboration and CPFR Governance

Own the CPFR process and operating model for the assigned distributor markets & cluster

Establish clear ways of working, meeting cadence, roles, decision rights, inputs, outputs and escalation paths

Build trusted working relationships with distributor supply chain, commercial, customer service and logistics counterparts

Lead regular joint planning reviews and ensure required inputs, decisions and actions are clear and timely

Support distributor partners and planning teams on CPFR principles, forecast quality, inventory management including data requirements, ways of working, GMI processes and order placement timelines and performance tracking

Build distributor planning maturity through standardized routines, data, performance management and joint accountability

Ensure the distributor forecast collection, challenge and consensus process at the appropriate market, brand, SKU and time-horizon level

Ensure distributor demand signals are mapped with commercial plans, promotions, launches, seasonality, market intelligence and historical consumption. Ensure commercial events, launches, portfolio changes and market risks are reflected in the planning cycle

Drive distributor adherence to agreed order placement timelines per brands/plants

Monitor distributor inventory (on hand and in transit), stock cover, open orders, and projected availability and ensure they are rightfully reflected in all relevant GMI tools

Monitor actual sales, stock, shipments, orders, and forecast changes to identify risks and opportunities early

Define and maintain replenishment parameters in partnership with distributors and internal planning teams

Provide clear inputs to market or cluster S&OP forums and other business decision forums

2. Business Outlook, Service, Inventory and Supply Risks Management

Ensure a high quality 12-month rolling IMS outlook to be built with the distributors with identified and actioned risks and opportunities

Collaborate with demand planning team to identify and improve forecast gaps, demand volatility, supply-demand imbalances and projected service risks

Coordinate recovery plans for stock-outs, excess inventory, slow-moving or aged stock, supply constraints, expedites and order changes

Escalate risks with the business impact, recommended action, decision owner and timing

Establish performance baselines and targets for each distributor

Analyse trends and root causes of forecast error, service failures, inventory imbalances and planning instability and lead corrective actions with the appropriate internal and external stakeholders

Improve and standardize data quality, master data discipline, reporting automation and planning transparency

Measure the impact of improvements on service, inventory, cost, planning stability and distributor collaboration

4. Cross-Functional Leadership and Business Integration

Influence internal and external stakeholders without relying solely on direct authority

Lead through influence across a matrix of distributors and General Mills stakeholders

Share best practices across markets and contribute to capability building within the distributor-market supply chain organization

Demonstrate General Mills leadership behaviours by acting with pace, prioritizing what matters, winning as one team and doing the right thing, all the time

Key Performance Indicators

Distributors forecast accuracy and forecast bias (M-3)

Case-fill rate, primary and secondary service level, availability and stock-out rate

Inventory coverage by distributor and category

Order adherence, order stability and schedule change frequency

CPFR action closure and process compliance

CPFR maturity rating per distributor

Qualifications, Skills & Experience

1. Education

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, Economics or a related field

Master’s degree or APICS/IBF certification is a plus

2. Experience

3-5 years of experience in demand planning, supply planning, customer collaboration, replenishment, logistics or end-to-end supply chain

Proven experience working with distributor-led markets or distributors managing CPFR or planning processes across multiple geographies

Practical experience with CPFR, S&OP / IBP, forecasting, inventory management and exception-based planning

Experience leading cross-functional projects and influencing stakeholders without direct authority

Experience in fast-moving consumer goods or a similarly demand-volatile, multi-SKU environment is preferred

3. Skills

Define and maintain dashboards covering forecast accuracy, forecast bias, primary and secondary service levels, stock-outs, stock cover, inventory health, order adherence and action closure.

Strong analytical and numerical ability, proficiency in Excel and planning tools (SAP APO/IBP, OMP)

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across functions and regions with effective negotiation skills

A proven “doer” who acts with speed and agility to deliver results

Deep understanding of forecasting methodologies, in market, shipment and inventory dynamics and S&OP processes

Attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and ability to work in a dynamic environment

Fluency in English

title: Head of Marketing and Communications (Singapore and Indonesia)
description:
About The Role

Lead marketing and communications for CBRE across Singapore and Indonesia, and position the company as the pre-eminent real estate thought leader in both markets. Using earned and owned media, digital and social channels, events and research-led content, you will build share of voice and turn CBRE’s market intelligence into commercial advantage.

Armed with strong media relationships, you will identify opportunities to profile subject matter experts and work closely with them to deliver differentiated points of view on the real estate industry. You will lead a team of five to eight marketing and communications professionals, own the country marketing budget, and act as a trusted adviser to country and business line leadership.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role in a matrix environment. You will set strategy and stay close enough to the work to deliver it.

What You’ll Do

Strategy and business partnering

‒ Develop and deliver an integrated, ROI-focused marketing and communications strategy across Singapore and Indonesia, covering public relations, digital and social, events, internal communications and brand.

‒ Partner country leadership and business line leaders so that marketing and communications operates as a business enabler rather than a service desk.

‒ Own and manage the country marketing budget, with clear reporting of spend against outcomes.

‒ Set the measurement standard for the function, covering share of voice, campaign performance, event contribution to pipeline and digital engagement, and report against it to leadership each quarter.

‒ Contribute to regional marketing and communications initiatives and project roll-outs across Asia Pacific.

Public relations and media

‒ Act as the key media liaison in Singapore and Indonesia, identifying and pitching stories and securing profiling opportunities for business leaders.

‒ Develop compelling messages, media releases, media responses, byline articles and speeches for senior management.

‒ Build and maintain relationships with tier-one business, property and trade media across both markets.

‒ Manage PR agency partners, including scope, performance, deliverables and budget.

‒ Support regional and global teams on issues and crisis communications, preparing local statements, briefing spokespeople and managing local media response, escalating in line with CBRE protocol.

‒ Maintain spokesperson briefing materials and question-and-answer documents, and arrange media training for senior leaders.

Events and industry engagement

‒ Own the events strategy end to end, from flagship client events and research launches to executive roundtables, industry sponsorships and internal town halls.

‒ Manage event budgets, venue and vendor selection, run of show, speaker preparation and post-event follow-up, with clear measurement of commercial return.

‒ Develop an influencer and industry body engagement strategy, including CBRE’s presence and speaking platforms at key industry events in both markets.

Content, research marketing and digital

‒ Work with CBRE Research to turn market intelligence into campaign-ready content and to build launch moments around flagship reports.

‒ Drive lead generation through social and digital channels, working with regional digital teams on campaign build, targeting, marketing technology and reporting.

‒ Act as brand custodian for both markets, maintaining CBRE brand standards across every piece of external and internal output.

‒ Support business development and pursuit teams with marketing collateral and credentials for major client bids.

Internal communications and employer brand

‒ Drive internal communications for employee engagement, change communications and leadership visibility.

‒ Strengthen CBRE’s employer brand in partnership with the People team, supporting recruitment and retention priorities.

Team leadership

‒ Lead, coach and develop a team of five to eight professionals across PR, digital, events and internal communications.

‒ Set objectives, manage performance and build capability and succession within the team.

‒ Provide direction and quality control across all local marketing initiatives and campaigns.

What You’ll Need

Experience: essential

‒ Degree holder with 12 to 14 years’ experience in marketing and communications.

‒ Within that, a minimum of three to four years leading public relations and events at a senior level, with direct accountability for media strategy and for flagship event delivery.

‒ Experience gained in a multinational or large listed organisation with multiple stakeholders, matrix reporting and regional or global reporting lines. This is a requirement, not a preference.

‒ Proven record of managing PR and event agencies, including briefing, performance management and budget control.

‒ Demonstrated ownership of a marketing budget, with the ability to report return on that spend.

‒ People leadership experience, having managed a team of five or more.

‒ Established media relationships in Singapore, with proven ability to secure tier-one coverage.

Experience: advantageous

‒ Indonesia market exposure, or a demonstrated track record of building media relationships in a new market.

‒ Real estate, professional services, financial services or agency background.

‒ Experience supporting issues or crisis communications within an established corporate protocol.

‒ Bahasa Indonesia or Mandarin in addition to strong written and spoken English in view of the in-country market communications.

Skills and attributes

‒ Proven expertise in social and digital marketing, including campaign measurement and marketing technology platforms.

‒ Credible with senior stakeholders, and comfortable advising and constructively challenging country and business line leadership.

‒ Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a dynamic environment with competing priorities.

‒ A positive, can-do attitude and readiness to roll up the sleeves and get the job done.

‒ Willingness to travel between Singapore and Indonesia as the role requires.

Why CBRE

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

Applicant AI Use Disclosure

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

OUR VALUES IN HIRING

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

title: APAC Service Delivery Manager
description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The Role

The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is responsible for overseeing the performance, quality, and operational health of partner-delivered services in APAC. Acting as the primary governance point between ServiceNow and delivery partner(s), the SDM ensures partner engagements are delivered in accordance with agreed service levels, quality standards, contractual commitments, and customer outcome expectations.

The SDM monitors partner delivery performance, identifies risks, drives corrective actions, manages escalations, and provides ongoing visibility into delivery health for ServiceNow leadership. The role serves as the accountability layer that makes partner performance predictable, scalable, and aligned to ServiceNow standards, regardless of whether the partner is delivering managed services, outsourced operations, subcontracted services, or project-based engagements.

Responsibilities

Serve as the primary ServiceNow point of contact for the partner's aligned Delivery Manager(s), maintaining day-to-day oversight of partner service performance against contracted KPIs and SLAs.
Review delivery quality trends, audit findings, and operational metrics to identify systemic issues, root causes, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
Monitor delivery unit economics and cost-per-outcome performance, ensuring the contracted commercial model (unit-based, outcome-based, or hybrid) tracks to delivered value.
Manage the ongoing evolution of the Partner’s service so that new capabilities can be planned and deployed with the appropriate stakeholder alignment, scalable processes and measurable outcomes to drive results
Manage the operational governance cadence, including weekly performance check-ins, monthly reviews, and quarterly business review preparation.
Lead delivery escalations across ServiceNow and partner teams, driving timely issue resolution and ensuring accountability for remediation plans and service recovery activities.
Own tracking and acceptance of transition and mobilization milestones during partner onboarding or service transitions, including staffing ramp against plan, capability/certification readiness, and transition exit criteria.
Own capacity and demand management processes, including utilization tracking, variance planning, and periodic reconciliation against contracted volumes.
Manage the change control process for operational or initiative requests that have contractual implications, engaging Commercial Management as needed.
Flag discrepancies between service delivery status and invoicing or milestone payment triggers to Commercial and Finance stakeholders.
Produce and maintain performance reporting, providing regular updates to internal leadership and ensure effective coverage and handoff models across distributed, multi-shift delivery teams
Identify and implement process improvements in response to changes in tooling, operating model, or service delivery requirements.
Coordinate with Service Delivery Managers in other geographies on initiative design, sequencing, and rollout to ensure global consistency.
Maintain a regular interlock with the Global Partnerships and Channels (GPC) team and the emerging global partner organization, ensuring partner performance insights, escalations, and capability needs are shared and jointly actioned.
Partner with account teams, customer success teams, and delivery stakeholders to protect customer outcomes and address service delivery risks impacting customer health.
Drive consistency in delivery execution, governance processes, and operational standards across partner-delivered services within the geography.

Qualifications

Demonstrated experience in service delivery management, vendor governance, or partner performance management within a complex, matrixed organisation – particularly within India-based organizations.
Experience managing partner, vendor, or supplier performance through structured governance frameworks, scorecards, and business reviews.
Proven ability to manage third-party performance against defined SLAs and KPIs, including escalation and corrective action processes.
Experience managing partners related to Customer Success and Professional Services context
Experience designing and maintaining operational documentation, including playbooks and standard operating procedures.
Strong project and programme management capability, with a track record of delivering cross-functional initiatives to agreed timelines.
Ensure effective coverage and handoff models across distributed, multi-shift delivery teams
Experience monitoring and tracking partner resource ongoing development of skills and certifications in line with service demands
Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate across functions and levels of seniority without direct line authority.
Proficiency in performance data analysis and reporting, with the ability to draw actionable conclusions from KPI and operational metrics.
Familiarity with Customer Success and Professional Service metrics and post-sales operating models, including NPS, utilization, rate cards, and product adoption measures.
Knowledge of, or ability to rapidly develop proficiency in, ServiceNow’s platform and products.
Ability to balance customer outcomes, business objectives, and partner performance requirements in a complex operating environment.
5+ years of experience in service delivery, partner governance, or a related operational role within a global technology or SaaS environment.
Track record of driving continuous improvement and service efficiencies.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working within or alongside a Partner or managed service delivery model, particularly in a vendor governance or service integration capacity.
Familiarity with scaled SaaS operating models, AI Native environments, and partner-delivered service motions.
Experience operating within an organisational transformation programme in a post-sales or customer success context.
Certifications in project management, service management, supplier management, or customer success disciplines (e.g., PMP, ITIL, CSM, COPC).
Exposure to AI-enabled or agentic workflow tooling within an operational team environment.
Experience operating in global teams servicing multiple geographies, including AMS, EMEA, and APAC.

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

title: Fitness Sales Executive Singapore - NOCCO | Barebells | Vitamin Well
description:
Vitamin Well Group develops premium functional drinks, snacks and protein products designed for modern, everyday life and on-the-go consumption. Our portfolio includes Barebells, NOCCO and Vitamin Well. With over 750 employees and revenue of more than SEK 10 billion, we are present in over 50 markets, with our headquarters in Stockholm and local teams and partners around the world. Our growth is driven by a focus on building strong brands, creating products with uncompromising taste and clear functionality, and consistently raising the bar across our categories.

Vitamin Well Group in Asia Pacific

In Asia Pacific, we grow through strong distributor partnerships and high-impact consumer activations. The region represents a strategic growth priority, driven by ambitious expansion plans and a clear expectation of in-market execution. From our APAC Hub in Singapore, we operate with our brands NOCCO, Vitamin Well and Barebells across fitness and retail channels – and see significant further potential for expansion.

To accelerate growth and strengthen our commercial presence, we are now looking for a dedicated Field Sales & Activation Executive.

About the role

This is a commercially driven, field-based role focused on accelerating distribution, sales and brand execution across Singapore.

You will be responsible for growing our presence across gyms, fitness partners, retail and other relevant local accounts. The majority of your time will be spent in the market – visiting customers, identifying and winning new accounts, strengthening existing relationships and ensuring consistent brand execution at point of sale.

Sales is at the core of the role, but your responsibility goes beyond winning the account. You will also plan and execute local activations, sampling, events and demos, and ensure our brands are visible, available and strongly represented at customer sites. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys combining commercial ownership with getting things done in the market.

The position is employed by our local distribution partner in Singapore and fully dedicated to Vitamin Well Group. You will work closely with the local distributor team in day-to-day operations, while reporting to the Sales Manager APAC, Distributor Markets. The role is based in Singapore and is primarily field-based across the market.

In short your responsibilities will be:

Deliver on monthly volume, distribution and other commercial targets through well-planned routes and purposeful customer visits.

Manage and grow existing accounts through regular follow-ups, strong relationships, smart prioritisation and upselling and cross-selling opportunities.

Proactively prospect, approach and win new accounts to expand the presence of NOCCO, Barebells and Vitamin Well across Singapore.

Secure regular orders and strong execution at customer sites, including product availability, visibility, pricing and display standards.

Plan and execute sampling, activations, events and demos, including coordinating sampling teams and taking ownership of agreed larger activations from planning through execution and follow-up.

Own the field execution of our branded fridge placements, from identifying suitable sites and coordinating placements to following up on stock, product range, visibility and performance.

Work closely with the distributor and Vitamin Well Group teams, staying on top of customer needs, competitor activity and market trends and turning insights from the field into action.

What you can expect

A market-facing role where your work has a direct impact on our growth in Singapore.

The opportunity to work across both sales and activation, from identifying commercial opportunities to seeing them come to life in the market.

Close collaboration with regional teams, with visibility across the wider organisation.

An opportunity to combine an interest in fitness, community and active lifestyles with a driven, field-based commercial career.

Who are you

You are a commercially driven sales professional who enjoys being out in the market, meeting customers and turning opportunities into business. You are comfortable approaching new customers, building relationships and asking for the sale, while understanding that strong results come from consistent follow-up and execution.

You thrive in a hands-on environment and take ownership of your customers and priorities. You are proactive, structured and comfortable working independently, while also enjoying the practical side of building brands in the market – from customer execution to activations and events.

You have a genuine interest in sports, fitness and active lifestyles and understand the communities our brands are part of. You are also a team player who shares insights and contributes to the wider team's success.

Essential skills to succeed

Relevant experience in field sales, account management or new business development, including experience winning new accounts.

Demonstrated experience managing and growing customer accounts.

Comfortable working independently in a field-based role and taking ownership of day-to-day execution.

Fluent in English.

Strong local knowledge of Singapore.

Experience within the fitness industry or familiarity with the local fitness community is highly valued.

Legal right to work in Singapore, as visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

How to Apply

Application deadline: October 31st 2026

We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position before the application deadline. We appreciate LinkedIn, but to get a full picture of your experience, we ask you to also include a CV.

Life at Vitamin Well Group

At Vitamin Well Group, we believe that a great workplace fuels great products. With over 750 employees worldwide, our people play an important role in how we build brands, develop products and grow the business. Our values – innovation, courage, drive and responsibility – shape how we work together and how we do business.

Across functions and markets, our teams are hands-on in building our brands, developing our products and making them available to consumers around the world. We embrace an office-first principle because we believe our best ideas emerge when people come together, share ideas, build relationships and take ownership.

Promoting active lifestyles is part of our culture. Employees can take part in run clubs, group workouts, races and sporting events that suit different interests and fitness levels. As we continue to grow, we aim to make a positive impact by reducing our environmental footprint, promoting active and healthy lifestyles, and acting responsibly across our value chain.

As part of the recruitment process, we may ask you to conduct a personality test as well as a test that measures logical ability. The purpose of the tests is to evaluate candidates as objective as possible and identify the best possible match for the role. The tests are based on solid research and are taken through our partner.
