title: Operations/ Implementation Specialist
description:
At #TeamCPF, you’re not just joining a team; you are embracing a culture of excellence, collaboration, and meaningful impact. You will play a pivotal role in empowering over 4 million members to secure their retirement, healthcare, housing needs and better navigate life’s uncertainties.

We thrive on sharp minds and insightful decisions. Your ability to analyse and think critically isn't just valued; it's essential. Every choice you make contributes to our collective success.

Collaboration is our way of life. We believe in the power of effective partnerships and seamless communications across teams. Together, we amplify each other’s strengths and achieve remarkable results.

Our learning never stops. We encourage your inquisitiveness and courage to embrace new challenges head-on. Your agility, readiness to challenge conventions, embrace of data-driven strategies, dedication to learning and applying new skills fuels our innovation and progress.

At the core of everything we do lies a genuine desire to make a difference. We serve our community and support each other with compassion, empathy, and unwavering dedications. Every action we take is guided by a deep sense of purpose and a commitment to those we serve.

Join us at #TeamCPF! Together, let's redefine possibilities and leave a legacy that echoes for generations.

What you will be working on

As an Operations/Implementation Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in driving operational efficiency, optimising processes, and enhancing the overall performance of our organisation. Your expertise in process review, automation, team management, operations-technology integration, and product management will be critical to the successful execution of our strategic initiatives.

In this role, you will:

1. Process Review and Optimisation:

a. Analyse existing operational processes to identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement.

b. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement streamlined processes that enhance productivity and reduce operational costs.

c. Continuously monitor and measure the effectiveness of implemented process improvements, making necessary adjustments as needed.

2. Automation and Technology Integration:

a. Identify opportunities for automation and technology integration across various operational functions.

b. Work closely with the IT and technology teams to develop and implement automated solutions that enhance efficiency and accuracy.

c. Champion the adoption of new tools and technologies to streamline operations and improve decision-making.

3. Team Management and Leadership

a. Lead and manage a team of operations professionals, providing mentorship, guidance, and performance feedback.

b. Foster a collaborative and positive team environment that encourages innovation and continuous learning.

c. Delegate tasks and responsibilities effectively to ensure optimal team performance and project outcomes.

4. Product Management

a. Collaborate with the product development team to understand product features, functionalities, and user requirements.

b. Contribute insights from an operations perspective to influence product design and development, ensuring seamless implementation and user satisfaction.

c. Assist in defining product roadmaps, release schedules, and feature prioritisation based on operational considerations.

What we are looking for

We value the diverse talents and experiences that each individual brings to the table. While mastery of every requirement may not be necessary, familiarity and expertise in some of the following areas will position you for success within this team.

Demonstrate leadership abilities either through academic, extracurricular, or work experiences.

Demonstrate willingness to learn, embrace change, adapt, and thrive in a dynamic environment.

Ability to generate creative solutions proactively, think beyond conventional boundaries, and actively drive positive change.

Ability to contribute to a positive work culture, foster collaboration and build trust among team members.

The seniority of appointment and actual corporate job title will commensurate with individual work experiences.

We welcome fresh graduates in any discipline and candidates without working experience to apply. To help us better understand your academic background, please provide an official or unofficial copy of your academic transcript, as well as any other relevant documents or certificates that you believe would support your application.

Position is on 2-year full time contract directly under the payroll of CPF Board with potential for emplacement into permanent position.

What you can expect

Being part of #TeamCPF means embarking on a challenging and rewarding career in a progressive workplace that values productivity and growth. Here’s what awaits you:

Opportunities to engage in a mix of formal and informal training, keeping your skills sharp in our ever-evolving technological landscape.

Promotion opportunities based on your capability and on-the-job performance.

A vibrant community of like-minded and friendly colleagues, where collaboration and creativity thrive.

A hybrid work model that offers flexibility for remote work, subject to exigencies of service.

Flexible dress code that empowers you to choose your appropriate outfit for the day.

A comprehensive rewards package that includes annual leave, pro-family leave, medical and dental benefits, and access to recreational activities.

Central Provident Fund (CPF) Board is the cornerstone of Singapore's social security system, committed to serving and empowering over 4 million members in securing their retirement, healthcare, and housing needs. As an employer, we believe in developing our people to do their life’s best work through the 3Ps: Purposeful Work, Professional Growth, People & Culture.

Purposeful Work – Beyond being a pension fund, we are unique in being a national social security organisation, and we serve CPF members knowing that our work we make a difference.

Professional Growth – At CPF Board, you will have the opportunity to learn on the job, acquire new skills, and broaden your knowledge. Although you are joining one organisation, you will have access to many career paths in the years ahead.

People and Culture – When you join CPF Board, you become part of a mission-oriented organisation with a strong culture of teamwork, collaboration, and innovation. Our people are our greatest asset, and we champion a culture of respect, diversity, and inclusivity, where every voice is heard and contributions are recognised and celebrated.

We are a recipient of the Enabling Mark (Gold) by SG Enable, we welcome candidates with disabilities and are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment.

Come and be a part of #TeamCPF today, to make a difference in the lives of others and in the future of Singapore. To learn more about CPF Board, visit our website at www.cpf.gov.sg.

title: Strategy and Insights Manager, Large Customer Sales
description:
Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience in media analytics, advertising sales, digital media and marketing, consulting, or financial analysis.

Preferred qualifications:
Experience in C-level engagement and managing cross-functional partnerships.
Experience in working within sales teams with an entrepreneurial mindset to leverage insights for quality results and business growth.
Knowledge of generating customer-centric, commercially-motivated, and engaging insights.
Ability to transform data into narratives that drive executive discourse and action.

About the job

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

In this role, you will drive industry intelligence. You will be a trusted industry advisor, and a commercially-minded strategist. You will be responsible for developing and owning thought leadership, developing new third-party research, and presenting industry-shifting perspectives at Google and external industry events. You will act as a trusted advisor to C-level clients, focusing on big industry shifts and growth advisory. You will engage with sales leaders and Google advertisers to show sales growth opportunities, win budgets, and identify key consumer, category, and seasonal opportunities. You will enhance the engaging intelligence with new data sources and deliver to strengthen the engaging advantage, analyze consumer behavior and managing data partnerships to industry expertise.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Responsibilities
Own the industry thought leadership plan, develop new third-party research, and present industry-shifting perspectives at Google and external industry events.
Act as a trusted advisor to C-level clients, focusing on big industry shifts and growth advisory.
Engage with sales leaders and Google advertisers to show business growth opportunities, win budgets, and identify key consumer, category, and opportunities.
Enhance the market intelligence with new data sources and deliver to strengthen the business advantage.
Identify and analyze opportunities, including new consumer behaviors, and changing shopping journey.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: Team Leader - Commercial Banking Cash -
description:
WHO WE ARE:

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

 Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

 We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

Why Join

As a Team Leader within Commercial Banking Cash (CBC), you will lead a team of Business Banking Managers and play a key role in driving the team’s acquisition performance and overall business objectives.

You will be responsible for achieving team KPIs, managing sales pipelines, coaching and developing your team, and maintaining strong sales and due diligence standards. Beyond day-to-day performance management, you will build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including local and overseas channel partners, and drive business initiatives and projects that support the continued growth of CBC.

How You Succeed

Success in this role comes from combining strong leadership with disciplined sales execution. You will translate business targets into clear priorities for the team, maintain close oversight of performance and pipelines, identify gaps early, and provide timely coaching and guidance to drive results.

You will balance business growth with sound risk and due diligence practices, while building effective partnerships across the Bank and with external stakeholders to create opportunities, resolve issues and enable your team to succeed.

What You Do

Lead and manage a team of Business Banking Managers to achieve team KPIs and targets, with a strong focus on corporate account acquisition
Monitor individual and team performance, identify performance gaps and drive timely follow-up actions
Maintain strong oversight of sales pipelines, including lead progression, conversion and business opportunities
Coach and guide Business Banking Managers on sales management, customer acquisition and due diligence requirements
Ensure customers onboarded by the team are appropriately screened and meet applicable AML and due diligence requirements
Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal stakeholders
Anchor relationships with local and overseas channel partners to strengthen referral flows and support new customer acquisition
Provide guidance and support in resolving complex customer, onboarding, operational and business issues
Develop and drive sales strategies and initiatives to improve team performance and business outcomes
Lead and contribute to business projects, process improvements and other strategic initiatives
Keep abreast of market developments, customer trends and regulatory requirements relevant to Business Banking
Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture within the team

What You Bring

At least 5 years of experience in the banking and financial services industry, with a strong track record in customer acquisition, preferably within corporate or Business Banking
A university degree
Sales management experience, preferably with experience leading or managing a sales team
Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to coach, motivate and develop team members
Strong interpersonal, communication and stakeholder management skills
Good understanding of Business Banking products, customer onboarding, AML and due diligence requirements
Strong sales and pipeline management capabilities, with a focus on delivering business targets
Ability to build productive relationships with internal stakeholders and external business partners
Strong initiative and drive, with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively
Ability to manage multiple priorities, initiatives and projects effectively
Dynamic, adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
Results-driven, hands-on and prepared to take ownership of team performance

What we offer:

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

title: APAC | Data Programme Manager
description:
About the role

As a Project Manager at Infinite Lambda, you'll be a pivotal force behind the successful delivery of large-scale, complex client projects for our most important clients. You will be at the forefront of business transformation, holding ultimate accountability for project execution and owning the entire project lifecycle. You will ensure all projects and workstreams deliver tangible, measurable business value, on time and within budget, helping clients innovate and compete.

You are a key partner in our client relationships, working with our Account Managers to nurture long-term partnerships and spot new opportunities, contributing to the growth of our client accounts. You will use your positive and collaborative attitude to foster a culture of excellence, self-organisation, and high accountability across delivery streams. Your empathy and problem-solving skills will be essential as you guide your team to become more self-organised and accountable, celebrating successes along the way.

Anticipated start date: ASAP

Responsibilities

Lead the end-to-end delivery of client projects using Agile or Waterfall methodologies (depending on the best fit with the client), expertly tailoring your approach to the specific needs and phase of each project.

Develop and maintain clear scope and timelines, ensuring you can protect projects against scope creep and provide alternative solutions to recover as needed.

Gather, analyse, and document business requirements, working closely with clients and internal teams to translate business needs into clear, actionable specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

Facilitate stakeholder interviews and discovery sessions to elicit needs and uncover pain points, constraints, and opportunities.

Develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, including test planning, UAT coordination, and defect triage, ensuring delivered solutions meet agreed acceptance criteria.

Conduct data analysis and profiling to validate requirements, support migration activities, and inform data model and reporting design.

Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, clarifying scope, managing ambiguity, and communicating trade offs.

Proactively develop and champion creative, non-standard solutions to execution challenges, ensuring optimal recovery and continuous improvement in delivery standards.

Establish and uphold stringent project standards and governance models to ensure predictable, high-quality execution across all workstreams.

Facilitate steering committees and provide clear, trusted updates to executive sponsors.

Work with teams from both Infinite Lambda and the client to deliver projects, earning their trust and getting 360-degree feedback on feasibility and plans.

Leverage your technical understanding to constructively challenge assumptions, guide recovery plans, and facilitate trade-off decisions between engineering quality and delivery speed, ensuring alignment with overall project goals.

Create and maintain essential documentation (such as RAID Logs, RACI matrices, business requirement documents, and Gantt charts) and lead ceremonies like standups, retrospectives, and client presentations.

Proactively identify risks and remove roadblocks, helping the team find the pathway to excellence that earns the admiration and respect of your clients.

Track progress and communicate updates to stakeholders regularly through reports and presentations. Conduct project reviews and identify areas for improvement.

Deliver structured, clear, and professional communication, tailoring your style to best suit each client's environment — this is pivotal to how our clients perceive Infinite Lambda.

Maintain a safe and congenial working environment for your team.

Support with client prospects - meetings, follow up and relationship management.

Liaise with our staffing team to ensure visibility on what will be needed to deliver projects.

Work with Account Manager(s) to provide constant and stable visibility on accounts.

Provide active coaching and mentorship to delivery teams, helping them adopt best practices, adhere to project standards, and elevate their own delivery capabilities.

Requirements

Experience:

5+ years of experience leading complex client projects, with a focus on data warehouse migration and/or AI.

Consulting background.

Proven background in leading and managing projects from start to finish.

Demonstrated business analysis experience — eliciting requirements, process mapping, and translating business needs into clear technical and functional specifications.

Extensive experience with agile methodologies and continuous improvement.

Strong conceptual understanding of software engineering and data delivery principles (e.g., architectural patterns, tools, modern development practices) to effectively challenge, guide, and support technical leadership.

Excellent leadership, communication, and people skills — able to articulate a compelling vision.

Experience working with fixed-cost projects as well as T&M.

Travel requirements for this role are mandated by the need of the client and depending on the client some travel is required.

Skills:

Proficiency in a variety of project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Trello).

Strong business analysis toolkit: requirements gathering, process and workflow mapping, user story writing, and stakeholder workshops.

Exceptional problem-solving, conflict resolution, and change management skills.

Ability to break down complex projects into manageable tasks and create work breakdown structures.

Experience in managing multiple projects simultaneously.

Familiarity and practical experience with modern methodologies and the ability to choose and adapt the most suitable ones for the project.

Mindset:

Demonstrated ability to orchestrate the big picture while also managing the details.

A collaborative and positive approach to people and projects.

Willingness to take new directions and adapt to changing priorities.

Nice to have Skills

Working knowledge of SQL and data warehousing concepts.

Familiarity with data visualisation tools (e.g. Omni, Sigma, Tableau, PowerBI).

Proven experience leading data warehousing and analytics projects, preferably migrations.

Soft skills

Servant leadership mindset with the ability to manage, motivate, inspire and support others.

Outstanding communication skills.

A considerate, curious, positive, naturally collaborative and supportive approach to people.

Proactivity regarding risk, issues and planning.

Ability to present complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Natural problem-solving attitude, facilitation skills, and creative thinking.

Proficiency in English.

Interview Process

Take-home technical assignment.

Technical interview with Head of Programme Management: 60 minutes.

Cultural interview with APAC General Manager: 45 minutes.

Why join Infinite Lambda

We support your growth with dedicated learning time, access to top-notch resources and a knowledge-sharing culture;

You work autonomously here in a wholesome environment and get as much paid holiday as you need;

The projects are diverse and give you plenty of opportunity to experiment with new tech;

The benefits are plenty, with private health insurance, work-from-home budget, a company MacBook and more on the list.

Submit your CV in English in PDF.

Mind that as we are an international team, internal communication is in English.

Infinite Lambda is an equal opportunity employer. Our inclusive culture celebrates diversity and treats everyone with dignity and respect. Accordingly, our selection process will never discriminate against applicants on the grounds of any characteristics, such as disability, age, gender, sexual orientation, family status, race, faith or other.

title: Director, Asia Procurement
description:
Barnes Aerospace, is an international manufacturer of precision-machined and fabricated components and assemblies for original equipment manufacturer (OEM) turbine engine, airframe and industrial gas turbine builders throughout the world, and for the military. Barnes Aerospace also provides jet engine component overhaul and repair (MRO) services for many of the world's major turbine engine manufacturers, commercial airlines and the military. Additionally, we manufacture aerospace aftermarket spare parts and provide repair services for aerospace engine components. Barnes Aerospace provides a total solutions package to our customers that leverages the synergies between our OEM and MRO businesses to address complex aerospace customer needs and support products through the entire lifecycle.

Barnes Aerospace Singapore, with legal entity name - Windsor Airmotive Asia Pte Ltd in the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA), is a leading provider of Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) services and spare parts for many of the world's major turbine engine manufacturers, airline operators, and third-party providers. The Barnes Aerospace Singapore OEM Division is a world-class provider for Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), specializing in precision stamped assemblies and tight tolerance machining, serving a robust global customer base throughout the aerospace industry. To learn more about Barnes Aerospace, please visit www.barnesaero.com (http://www.onebarnes.com/).

Barnes Aerospace is seeking an expert Director, ASIA Procurement, to join its team and be responsible for the procurement of raw materials, goods, and services for our manufactured goods and services. This includes the planning, scheduling, and monitoring of the movement of materials through the production cycle; utilizing production schedules to maintain inventory at planned levels; ensuring materials standards are met; and managing outside vendors through the processes of qualifying, obtaining quotes, examining bids, and making award decisions for the company. The Director, ASIA Procurement is the procurement and escalation focal point for raw materials, outside service processes, indirect and CAPEX purchasing, supplier selections, rating of supplier performance and maintaining supplier relationships.

Core Responsibilities:

P2R Governance – Design, document, and roll out standard work for requisition, PO placement, supplier acknowledgment, manage ASL (Approved Supplier List), goods/invoice receipt, and GR/IR resolution; align ERPs and related master-data rules including Coupa implementation transition.
Material Availability & Expediting – Lead daily shortage management and tiered escalation; resolve constraints rapidly while transitioning sites from reactive expediting to disciplined planning.
PO Execution Excellence – Drive 100 % PO accuracy, secure supplier confirmations within 48 hours, and achieve best-in-class on-time delivery through disciplined processes, supplier development, and inventory-buffer strategies (kanban, & VMI).
Performance Management & Analytics – Build real-time dashboards for OTD, inventory turns, PPV, GR/IR aging, and P2P cycle time; facilitate weekly site huddles and monthly executive reviews.
Continuous Improvement – Champion Lean/Six-Sigma kaizens to compress P2P cycle time and release working capital; cleanse MRP parameters (min/max, safety stock, MOQ) to align inventory with demand variability.
People & Change Leadership – Lead tactical buyers/expediters through regional managers; coach talent pipelines and cultivate a culture of data-driven decision-making and operational rigor.
Participate in supplier selections and onboarding of new sources for indirect commodity spend and supplier consolidation.
Maintain current knowledge of market conditions that affect overall cost, lead time, and availability of critical commodities.
Continuously improve supplier performance by understanding business requirements and aligning suppliers with business needs.
Participate in supplier quarterly reviews and communicate expectations.
Work closely with Procurement Managers and Commodity Managers to negotiate favorable contracts and long-term agreements.
Must meet or exceed Key Performance Indicators on cost, quality, delivery and cash flow.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or related discipline
Minimum 10 years’ progressive procurement/materials leadership in aerospace or other complex, regulated manufacturing
Demonstrated success running multi-site P2P or tactical buying organizations (>$250 M annual spend)
Expert knowledge of ERP/MRP systems (Coupa, SAP, Oracle, Syteline, or equivalent) and advanced analytics tools (Power BI/Tableau; Excel)
Proven Lean/Six-Sigma practitioner with quantifiable cost, cycle-time, or inventory wins and supplier relationship management
Willing and able to travel up to 30 % globally
Excellent written and verbal communication skills as well as negotiation, analytical and project management skills
Strong collaboration and leader of teamwork orientation with ability to interact with all levels within the organization
Ability to drive global supply chain goals and performance metrics, reduce total landed costs and develop supplier partnerships
Experience in negotiating with raw material and outside service suppliers to secure favorable pricing and long-term contracts
Experience with advanced data analysis and visualization tools including creative thinking with problem-solving capabilities
Impeccable integrity, strong communication and presentation skills

Preferred Qualifications:

MBA or MS in Supply Chain
Professional certifications (CPSM, CPIM, CSCP)
Experience harmonizing multiple ERPs during M&A or footprint consolidation
Bachelor’s degree required in business administration, supply chain, or related field. MBA or advanced degree preferred

Key Competencies:

Strategic Leadership – Sets clear direction, drives accountability, and elevates performance across geographically dispersed teams
Analytical Rigor – Translates complex data into actionable insights and decisive actions
Change Agent – Standardizes processes in historically decentralized environments; builds stakeholder alignment
Customer & Supplier Focus – Balances cost, delivery, quality, and risk to keep production lines flowing

title: Regional Key Account Manager
company: CEVA ASIA PACIFIC HOLDINGS COMPANY PTE. LTD.
description:
CEVA Logistics provides global supply chain solutions to connect people, products, and providers all around the world. Present in more than 170 countries and with over 110,000 employees across 1,500 sites, we are proud to be a Top 5 global 3PL.

Every day, our people imagine better ways to serve a world in motion – creating smarter, safer, and more sustainable solutions for our customers.

YOUR ROLE

Based in Singapore and reporting to the Head of Sector Luxury – APAC, the Regional Key Account Manager will manage and grow a portfolio of strategic Luxury customers across Asia Pacific.

You will act as the key regional link between our customers and CEVA’s country, product and operational teams across Air, Ocean, Contract Logistics and Ground & Rail. You’ll lead regional account planning and customer governance, coordinate service performance and escalations, and identify opportunities to grow CEVA’s relationship across products and markets.

This is a highly visible regional role suited to an experienced Key Account Manager who can combine strong commercial judgement with a practical understanding of freight forwarding and Contract Logistics. Direct Luxury sector experience is advantageous, but not essential.

WHAT ARE YOU GOING TO DO?

Specifically, you will:

Manage and develop strategic customer relationships across Asia Pacific, acting as the primary regional point of contact.

Lead regional account planning, governance and Quarterly Business Reviews in partnership with Global and National Key Account teams.

Identify and progress opportunities to grow revenue and expand CEVA’s share of wallet across Air, Ocean, Contract Logistics and Ground & Rail.

Coordinate across country, Product and operational teams to deliver agreed service outcomes, resolve escalations and drive continuous improvement.

Build strong relationships with senior customer stakeholders and provide visibility of key priorities, risks and opportunities to CEVA leadership.

Partner with Product teams to develop competitive, customer-specific logistics solutions and support regional tenders, RFQs and commercial processes.

Maintain accurate account and opportunity information within CEVA’s CRM systems and monitor key commercial measures, including customer receivables.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

Our ideal candidate has strong experience in Key Account Management, strategic account management or commercial customer management within logistics, freight forwarding or supply chain, together with a sound understanding of Air and Ocean freight forwarding and Contract Logistics. You’ll be experienced in managing complex customer relationships and influencing stakeholders across multiple teams, countries and levels of seniority.

You will also have:

Strong commercial acumen, including experience with account growth, tenders, RFQs and customer business reviews.

Regional APAC or multi-country experience; alternatively, you may be a high-performing country-level Key Account Manager ready to step into a broader regional role.

Strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills, with a proactive approach and sense of urgency.

The confidence to communicate and influence stakeholders from operational level through to senior management and C-suite.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Experience in Luxury, Consumer, Retail or another high-service customer sector, and relevant tertiary qualifications in Business, Logistics, Supply Chain or a related discipline, will be advantageous.

WHAT DO WE HAVE TO OFFER?

In addition to a challenging and rewarding work environment and competitive compensation, we are proud to offer a range of employee benefits designed to support your wellbeing and help you thrive at work and in life.

Personal wellbeing: benefit from comprehensive group insurance and medical coverage, including Group Term Life, Personal Accident, Hospital & Surgical, Major Medical, outpatient GP and Specialist benefits. Eligible dependants are also covered under the Hospital & Surgical and Major Medical plans.

Work-life balance: enjoy 19 working days’ annual leave in your first year, increasing progressively with service, together with applicable medical, hospitalisation, marriage, childcare, compassionate and palliative care leave.

Flexible benefits: receive SGD 1,000 per year in flexible benefits, which may be used across eligible medical, dental, optical, health and wellness, personal development and selected lifestyle expenses.

Professional development: your growth is essential to us. Unlock your potential through internal mobility opportunities, leadership and mentoring programmes, and MyLearning – our global online platform with more than 1,000 courses.

Diversity is core to who we are.

By reflecting the cultures and perspectives of our customers and communities, we perform at our best. CEVA Logistics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates.

title: APAC | Project Manager (B2B Contractor)
description:
About the role

As a Project Manager at Infinite Lambda, you'll be a pivotal force behind the successful delivery of large-scale, complex client projects for our most important clients. You will be at the forefront of business transformation, holding ultimate accountability for project execution and owning the entire project lifecycle. You will ensure all projects and workstreams deliver tangible, measurable business value, on time and within budget, helping clients innovate and compete.

You are a key partner in our client relationships, working with our Account Managers to nurture long-term partnerships and spot new opportunities, contributing to the growth of our client accounts. You will use your positive and collaborative attitude to foster a culture of excellence, self-organisation, and high accountability across delivery streams. Your empathy and problem-solving skills will be essential as you guide your team to become more self-organised and accountable, celebrating successes along the way.

Anticipated start date: ASAP

Location: APAC

Contract duration: 3 months with very likely extension for 6+ months

Daily Requirement: 8 hours per day, Monday to Friday

Responsibilities

Lead the end-to-end delivery of client projects using Agile or Waterfall methodologies (depending on the best fit with the client), expertly tailoring your approach to the specific needs and phase of each project.

Develop and maintain clear scope and timelines, ensuring you can protect projects against scope creep and provide alternative solutions to recover as needed.

Gather, analyse, and document business requirements, working closely with clients and internal teams to translate business needs into clear, actionable specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

Facilitate stakeholder interviews and discovery sessions to elicit needs and uncover pain points, constraints, and opportunities.

Develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, including test planning, UAT coordination, and defect triage, ensuring delivered solutions meet agreed acceptance criteria.

Conduct data analysis and profiling to validate requirements, support migration activities, and inform data model and reporting design.

Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, clarifying scope, managing ambiguity, and communicating trade offs.

Proactively develop and champion creative, non-standard solutions to execution challenges, ensuring optimal recovery and continuous improvement in delivery standards.

Establish and uphold stringent project standards and governance models to ensure predictable, high-quality execution across all workstreams.

Facilitate steering committees and provide clear, trusted updates to executive sponsors.

Work with teams from both Infinite Lambda and the client to deliver projects, earning their trust and getting 360-degree feedback on feasibility and plans.

Leverage your technical understanding to constructively challenge assumptions, guide recovery plans, and facilitate trade-off decisions between engineering quality and delivery speed, ensuring alignment with overall project goals.

Create and maintain essential documentation (such as RAID Logs, RACI matrices, business requirement documents, and Gantt charts) and lead ceremonies like standups, retrospectives, and client presentations.

Proactively identify risks and remove roadblocks, helping the team find the pathway to excellence that earns the admiration and respect of your clients.

Track progress and communicate updates to stakeholders regularly through reports and presentations. Conduct project reviews and identify areas for improvement.

Deliver structured, clear, and professional communication, tailoring your style to best suit each client's environment — this is pivotal to how our clients perceive Infinite Lambda.

Maintain a safe and congenial working environment for your team.

Support with client prospects - meetings, follow up and relationship management.

Liaise with our staffing team to ensure visibility on what will be needed to deliver projects.

Work with Account Manager(s) to provide constant and stable visibility on accounts.

Provide active coaching and mentorship to delivery teams, helping them adopt best practices, adhere to project standards, and elevate their own delivery capabilities.

Requirements

Experience:

5+ years of experience leading complex client projects, with a focus on data warehouse migration and/or AI.

Consulting background.

Proven background in leading and managing projects from start to finish.

Demonstrated business analysis experience — eliciting requirements, process mapping, and translating business needs into clear technical and functional specifications.

Extensive experience with agile methodologies and continuous improvement.

Strong conceptual understanding of software engineering and data delivery principles (e.g., architectural patterns, tools, modern development practices) to effectively challenge, guide, and support technical leadership.

Excellent leadership, communication, and people skills — able to articulate a compelling vision.

Experience working with fixed-cost projects as well as T&M.

Travel requirements for this role are mandated by the need of the client and depending on the client some travel is required.

Skills:

Proficiency in a variety of project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Trello).

Strong business analysis toolkit: requirements gathering, process and workflow mapping, user story writing, and stakeholder workshops.

Exceptional problem-solving, conflict resolution, and change management skills.

Ability to break down complex projects into manageable tasks and create work breakdown structures.

Experience in managing multiple projects simultaneously.

Familiarity and practical experience with modern methodologies and the ability to choose and adapt the most suitable ones for the project.

Mindset:

Demonstrated ability to orchestrate the big picture while also managing the details.

A collaborative and positive approach to people and projects.

Willingness to take new directions and adapt to changing priorities.

Nice to have Skills

Working knowledge of SQL and data warehousing concepts.

Familiarity with data visualisation tools (e.g. Omni, Sigma, Tableau, PowerBI).

Proven experience leading data warehousing and analytics projects, preferably migrations.

Soft skills

Servant leadership mindset with the ability to manage, motivate, inspire and support others.

Outstanding communication skills.

A considerate, curious, positive, naturally collaborative and supportive approach to people.

Proactivity regarding risk, issues and planning.

Ability to present complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Natural problem-solving attitude, facilitation skills, and creative thinking.

Proficiency in English.

Interview Process

Intro call with Talent Acquisition Business Partner - 30 minutes

Domain Specific Session with Programme Manager - 60 minutes

Cultural interview with Head of Programme Management - 45 minutes.

Why join Infinite Lambda

We support your growth with dedicated learning time, access to top-notch resources and a knowledge-sharing culture;

You work autonomously here in a wholesome environment and get as much paid holiday as you need;

The projects are diverse and give you plenty of opportunity to experiment with new tech;

The benefits are plenty, with private health insurance, work-from-home budget, a company MacBook and more on the list.

Submit your CV in English in PDF.

Mind that as we are an international team, internal communication is in English.

Infinite Lambda is an equal opportunity employer. Our inclusive culture celebrates diversity and treats everyone with dignity and respect. Accordingly, our selection process will never discriminate against applicants on the grounds of any characteristics, such as disability, age, gender, sexual orientation, family status, race, faith or other.

Real ownership from day one — you won't be a pair of hands, you'll have genuine creative and commercial input into how RhetoriQo grows

Clear growth pathway — at 3 months we'll assess fit and scope, with potential to convert to a higher rate or full-time role

what is one initiative — an event, a partnership, or an outreach campaign — you would propose to help RhetoriQo win its next client?

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Marketing Executive to independently manage and execute day-to-day marketing activities across the Company's brands and business activities.

The role covers digital marketing, social media, events, partnerships, marketing communications and market research. The Marketing Executive will work directly with the Director and is expected to take ownership of assigned marketing projects from planning and coordination through to execution and performance reporting.

The role requires a hands-on and organized individual who can work independently, coordinate with internal teams and external vendors, and manage multiple marketing activities with limited day-to-day supervision.

Job Responsibilities

1. Marketing Planning & Campaign Execution

Plan and execute marketing activities in line with business objectives and direction from the Director.

Develop campaign plans, timelines and required marketing materials.

Coordinate campaign setup, scheduling, content placement and execution to ensure activities are delivered accurately and on time.

Monitor campaign results and prepare reports on key performance indicators.

Review campaign results and recommend practical improvements for future activities.

2. Digital & Social Media Marketing

Plan and manage social media content across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram and TikTok.

Maintain content calendars and coordinate content creation, publishing and scheduling.

Plan and execute digital campaigns, including paid social media advertising where required.

Monitor campaign performance, engagement, leads and other relevant metrics.

Coordinate updates to website content, promotional materials and other digital channels.

Manage EDM campaigns and customer communications where required.

3. Events & Offline Marketing

Plan, coordinate and execute marketing activities including roadshows, travel fairs, workshops, promotions, corporate events and other relevant events.

Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, partners and event organizers on logistics, setup, materials and timelines.

Source and coordinate event requirements, including marketing materials, equipment and manpower support.

Support on-site event operations and ensure activities are delivered according to plan.

Conduct post-event follow-up and prepare basic performance reports.

Support weekend events or marketing activities when required.

4. KOL, Partnership & Promotional Activities

Identify and coordinate suitable KOLs, influencers, media partners and other marketing partners.

Coordinate collaborations, sponsorships, barter arrangements and co-marketing opportunities.

Communicate campaign requirements, deliverables and timelines to partners.

Coordinate content submissions and ensure materials are aligned with the Company's brand and campaign requirements.

Monitor the performance of collaborations and maintain good working relationships with partners.

5. Marketing Content & Creative Coordination

Prepare and coordinate marketing content, promotional materials, notices and social media assets.

Use Canva or other basic design tools to create or amend marketing materials where required.

Coordinate with designers, agencies and external vendors for more specialized creative work.

Coordinate the production of printed materials such as brochures, banners, advertisements and promotional collateral.

Ensure marketing materials are accurate, timely and consistent with the Company's brand guidelines.

6. Vendor & Budget Coordination

Source and compare quotations for marketing activities and recommend suitable vendors.

Coordinate with vendors on pricing, deliverables, timelines and service requirements.

Monitor marketing expenses against approved budgets.

Prepare or coordinate purchase requests, quotations and invoices.

Maintain organised records of vendors, quotations, marketing materials and related documents.

Highlight significant cost differences or discrepancies to the Director for review.

7. Market Research

Conduct market and competitor research to identify customer trends, promotional opportunities and relevant market developments.

Monitor competitor campaigns, promotions and social media activities.

Research potential partnerships, marketing channels and promotional opportunities.

Share relevant market insights and recommendations with the Director.

8. Cross-functional Collaboration

Work closely with sales, operations and other departments to understand business needs and coordinate marketing activities.

Coordinate with external agencies, vendors, partners and other third parties.

Manage assigned marketing projects independently from planning through to execution and follow-up.

Handle ad hoc marketing tasks and special projects as assigned.

Job Requirements

Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field.

2–3 years of relevant marketing experience, preferably with exposure to digital marketing, social media and events.

Practical experience in planning and executing marketing campaigns and activities.

Experience managing social media platforms and digital marketing campaigns.

Experience coordinating vendors, quotations and marketing expenses.

Basic knowledge of Canva or other design tools.

Good written and spoken English with strong communication skills.

Good organizational and time-management skills with strong attention to detail.

Able to independently plan, priorities and execute marketing activities with limited day-to-day supervision.

Able to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Proactive, hands-on and willing to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

Willing to support occasional weekend events or marketing activities when required.

description:

Education

Experience
5 - 8 years of relevant experience in customer service, order management, or sales operations
Experience working in a multinational corporation (MNC) environment

Strong organizational and multitasking skills with attention to detail

title: Vice President, Regional HR Business Partner – Audit, Risk & Credit (Location Agnostic) (Job ID: 10079694)
description:
A leading global financial institution is seeking a Vice President, Regional Human Resources Business Partner, to join their dynamic team. This pivotal role offers you the opportunity to shape and deliver high-impact people strategies across multiple regions, working closely with senior leaders and key stakeholders. You will be empowered to drive talent management initiatives, foster inclusion, and support organisational growth through strategic HR advisory. The organisation is committed to putting people first, investing in your development, and providing a flexible work environment that values diverse perspectives and collaboration. If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact on both business outcomes and employee experience, this is your chance to thrive in a supportive and forward-thinking workplace.

You will have the opportunity to influence regional and global HR strategy by partnering directly with senior leadership teams, ensuring alignment with business objectives and talent priorities.

The organisation offers a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and flexibility, enabling you to connect with colleagues across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas while enjoying scheduling flexibility for global connectivity.

Your expertise will be valued as you lead critical change initiatives, drive succession planning, champion diversity and inclusion, and enhance employee wellbeing within a highly respected financial group.

What you'll do:

As Vice President, Regional Human Resources Business Partner, you will play an integral role in shaping the people agenda for the organisation’s regional business functions. Your day-to-day activities will involve building strong partnerships with senior leaders to understand their strategic priorities and translating these into actionable HR solutions. You will act as a connector between global HR teams and local business units, ensuring seamless delivery of talent management initiatives such as succession planning, performance evaluation, recruitment strategy alignment, and employee development. By leveraging your knowledge of best practice HR approaches and market insights, you will proactively identify optimisation opportunities for structural change while fostering an inclusive culture that supports diverse talent. Your success in this role will be measured by your ability to drive collaborative outcomes across multiple regions—balancing stakeholder needs with organisational goals—and your commitment to enhancing employee experience through wellbeing programmes and effective communication.

Build trusted advisor relationships with regional business function heads and their leadership teams to deliver impactful people priorities aligned with the firm’s talent strategy.

Act as a strategic partner to understand business needs, develop tailored HR solutions, and drive talent management initiatives across assigned organisations.

Represent HR at regional business forums, managing relationships between broader HR teams and business units at a regional level.

Collaborate with Centres of Expertise (CoE) to implement operating models based on design principles and business area responsibilities.

Lead regional change initiatives in partnership with global HR leads and relevant stakeholders to embed people priorities into the business function.

Coach leaders on engagement and retention of key talent while supporting talent review processes for high-potential individuals regionally.

Partner with Talent Acquisition teams to anticipate future recruitment needs, ensuring alignment with human capital plans and overseeing senior appointments.

Support performance management processes by guiding annual goal setting, mid-year reviews, moderation of ratings, and compensation calibration exercises.

Drive succession planning by identifying critical roles, developing successor pipelines, creating development plans, and embedding inclusion into culture and decision-making.

Promote employee wellbeing by collaborating on action plans, engaging in employee listening methods, and implementing solutions that protect and enhance wellbeing.

What you bring:

To excel as Vice President, Regional Human Resources Business Partner, you will bring extensive experience from previous roles where you have partnered closely with senior leaders within complex matrixed environments. Your proven ability to develop strategic HR solutions that align with business objectives will be complemented by strong interpersonal skills—enabling you to build trust across cultures while balancing stakeholder needs. You are adept at managing cyclical talent processes such as performance reviews or compensation calibration exercises; your analytical mindset allows you to interpret data effectively for informed decision-making. Discretion is second nature when dealing with sensitive information; your communication style is polished yet empathetic whether coaching managers or presenting recommendations at board level. A deep understanding of current employment regulations ensures compliance throughout all activities while your resourcefulness helps identify alternate paths for achieving results. Your educational background includes at least a bachelor’s degree alongside practical expertise gained from overseeing budgets/resources within large organisations.

Minimum 10 years of experience in an HR business partner or similar role at a global or regional level within a matrixed environment is essential for success in this position.

Proven track record of developing and implementing strategic HR initiatives that contribute meaningfully to achieving business objectives and improving overall performance.

Demonstrated ability to partner with senior leaders and collaborate effectively with key stakeholders to create joint expectations and deliverables.

Strong interpersonal skills including collaboration, influence, empathy, sensitivity to cultural differences, and the ability to manage competing priorities while achieving results.

Deep understanding of generalist HR practices including large-scale cyclical talent management activities such as performance evaluation and compensation processes.

Exceptional discretion when handling confidential information coupled with tactful communication skills suitable for presenting at the highest levels of leadership.

High degree of adaptability combined with resilience; comfortable navigating complex organisational structures while maintaining attention to detail.

Highly numerate with proficiency in analysing data using Microsoft Office applications (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams) to support data-driven decisions.

Solid knowledge of HR policies/procedures as well as employment/labour laws relevant to regional operations; experience overseeing budgets/resources is required.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is mandatory; additional qualifications related to human resources or organisational development are advantageous.

What sets this company apart:

This organisation stands out as one of the world’s most respected financial institutions—valuing long-term relationships not only with clients but also among its employees. The company’s vision centres around trustworthiness: putting people first by listening actively to new ideas from diverse backgrounds. Employees are encouraged to own their careers through access to training opportunities supported by knowledgeable colleagues who foster communal growth. Flexible working arrangements are available so you can connect globally without sacrificing work-life balance; generous pension contributions further demonstrate commitment towards your wellbeing. The leadership team is renowned for its supportive approach—championing inclusion objectives that recruit develop retain under-represented talent whilst nurturing an environment where every voice matters. Joining this organisation means becoming part of a network dedicated both professionally personally towards shared sustainable growth—a place where making an impact is genuinely rewarded.

Exceptional stakeholder management skills with high-net-worth clientele, government agencies, and board-level engagement.

MacGregor is hiring a Production Control Supervisor to manage the manufacturing and assembly of specialized offshore mechanical and hydraulic equipment. In this role, you will oversee primary fabrication and assembly operations—including welding, painting, machining, piping, and assembly—while ensuring all documentation and quality standards align strictly with project requirements.

Working closely with production teams, you will supervise the assembly of mechanical components and hydraulic circuits, leading rigorous testing and acceptance procedures such as pressure testing, system flushing, and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) according to the Inspection and Test Plan (ITP). Additionally, you will monitor and evaluate risks related to quality, cost, and schedule, delivering technical support and proactive risk mitigation to guarantee seamless installation and commissioning.

More tasks and responsibilities
Ensure suppliers adhere to MacGregor quality standards through active workshop presence, supervising mechanical assembly and hydraulic installations.
Follow up on and document quality issues, focusing on mechanical tolerances and hydraulic system integrity, while driving continuous improvement.
Collaborate closely with engineering to refine mechanical design, documentation and production efficiency
Perform comprehensive inspections of mechanical components (bearings, gears, pins), hydraulic assemblies (cylinders, power units, valve blocks), and final machinery, adhering to MGC holding points.
Verify hydraulic cleanliness levels (e.g., ISO 4406 standards) and ensure proper flushing procedures are followed prior to system activation.
Conduct FAT (Factory Acceptance Testing) inspections alongside Class surveyors and customers, specifically witnessing pressure tests and functional load tests.
Supervise mechanical fitters, hydraulic technicians, and test workers at supplier facilities to ensure best practices in assembly.
Provide technical production support to suppliers regarding complex mechanical alignments and hydraulic troubleshooting
Educate and train shipyards and subcontractors on the installation and piping of MacGregor hydraulic systems, including welding of high-pressure lines and proper hose routing.
Regularly audit supplier documentation, including material certificates (3.1/3.2), pressure test logs, and hydraulic flushing reports.
Review and follow up on final Manufacturing Record Books (MRBs) and FAT reports to ensure all mechanical/hydraulic deviations are resolved and documented
Provide input to progress reporting

Reporting directly to the Interim Global Manager, Quality Control and Installation & Commissioning‎, Offshore Solutions Division. The position will be based in MacGregor’s office in Singapore.

What you’ll need to succeed

The ideal candidate combines hands-on mechanical and hydraulic expertise with strong supervisory skills to oversee the manufacturing and assembly of specialized offshore equipment. You thrive in shop floor and supplier environments, taking a proactive approach to quality control, schedule compliance, and technical risk mitigation.

You are a disciplined contributor who excels at coordinating with engineering teams, suppliers, Class surveyors, and customers to ensure strict adherence to project specifications, FAT standards, and safety-critical quality benchmarks.

Ideally you have

Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field (or equivalent extensive hands-on experience in maritime hydraulics).

Minimum 5 years’ experience in supervising mechanical assembly and hydraulic installations, preferably within the marine, offshore, or heavy machinery industries.

Knowledge of mechanical tolerances, fitments, and alignment techniques for large-scale maritime equipment.

Good understanding of hydraulic systems, including the ability to read and interpret hydraulic schematics

Proficiency in reading technical drawings and Manufacturing Record Books (MRB).

Strong problem-solving skills with a "hands-on" approach to troubleshooting mechanical or hydraulic issues on the shop floor.

Effective communication skills to act as the technical bridge between engineering, the supplier, and the customer. Competency in reading, writing and speaking English is required.

High attention to detail, specifically regarding precision measurements and safety-critical hydraulic connections.

Ability to work independently while spending a significant amount of time on-site at partner and supplier workshops.

Work location is primarily in Singapore however there may be a necessity to travel to China.

Why MacGregor?

Our people are behind every success. People create the technology and product lifecycle solutions that make us great, our people are the ones who innovate, and people drive our business forward. With us you will be part of an international collaborative working culture with challenges and opportunities to further develop yourself professionally.

Values guide our daily decisions

Customer Success: Our customer's success is our success. We focus on partnership, transparency, and accountability to deliver lifetime value.

Passion to Improve: Always moving forward. We foster a growth mindset, encourage curiosity, and the courage to challenge the status quo.

Winning Together: No one makes the difference alone. We emphasise internal collaboration and mutual trust to ensure we win as "One MacGregor."

MacGregor is an equal opportunity employer. We recognise that diversity is key to our continued success, and strive to maintain a fair and equitable recruitment process for all applicants

Additional information

Kindly note that we will only review CVs and applications submitted in English through our recruitment portal. Unfortunately we do not consider CVs sent per email.

If you are ready to step into an exciting new role where you can make a significant impact and contribute to the success of MacGregor, apply today!

www.macgregor.com

title: Trade Finance Senior Officer
description:
The Bank is looking for a

Trade Finance Senior Officer

in the Trade Finance Department. This is a back-office function that handles end-to-end processing, document checking, settlement, compliance, and record-keeping for all trade products—strictly following regulatory compliance related to AML/CFT and bank policies and procedures.

Transaction Processing

Manage full lifecycle of LCs, SBLCs, guarantees, and documentary collections (issuance, advising, confirmation, amendment, transfer, claims, and discharge)

Process trade financing: negotiation, discounting, acceptance, pre/post-shipment finance, supply chain finance, trust receipts, and factoring

Execute cross-border and local remittances via SWIFT MT/MX formats; handle Nostro/Vostro settlements, interest/fee calculation, and booking

Administer accounts, process amendments/cancellations, and perform reconciliation with general ledgers

Document Examination

Review documents against UCP 600, ISBP, URC 522, and LC terms

Verify Bills of Lading, invoices, packing lists, insurance, and certificates for completeness and consistency

Identify discrepancies, resolve issues with customers/banks, and decide on acceptance or rejection

Compliance, Risk & Control

Conduct sanctions, AML, and anti-financial crime screening using tools like World-Check One

Review credit limits, facility validity, and collateral; flag high-risk and suspicious transactions

Comply with MAS regulations, OFAC/UN/EU sanctions, and internal controls; follow Maker/Checker workflows and maintain audit trails

SWIFT & System Operations

Prepare, verify, and authorize SWIFT messages; input transactions into core banking systems

Perform compliance and vessel/port checks; maintain secure digital/physical records and archives

Customer & Stakeholder Support

Advise corporate clients and correspondent banks on trade terms and procedures

Provide status updates, settlement confirmations, and coordinate with other department such as Compliance

Reporting

Resolve operational issues and follow up on outstanding items

Prepare management reports, support audits, regulatory submissions, and month-end closing

Assist in process updates, automation, and system UAT; perform other ad-hoc duties as assigned

Qualifications

Diploma or higher in Banking, Finance, Business Administration, or related fields

Preferably 3+ years of hands-on core Trade Finance Operations experience in a bank or financial institution

Understand international trade rules, SWIFT MT/MX messaging, and compliance screening tools

High attention to detail, strong risk awareness, and ability to work efficiently to meet deadlines

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; capable of working independently and collaborating effectively within a team

Krungthai Bank Public Company Limited (KTB) is one of the largest banks in Thailand, playing a vital role in driving economic development and supporting regional trade and investment.

The Singapore Branch, operating under a Corporate Banking license, serves as a strategic platform for delivering comprehensive financial solutions to corporate and institutional clients. Our services include syndicated and bilateral lending, trade finance, treasury products, and deposit services, tailored to meet the needs of businesses with cross-border activities. With strong support from our Head Office in Bangkok, the Singapore Branch is committed to building trusted partnerships, enhancing regional connectivity, and providing reliable banking solutions across ASEAN and beyond.

Contract Type: Permanent, Full-Time

WE ARE BBC STUDIOS

A globally renowned media company borne of the BBC. We make and distribute the world's most sought-after TV, audio and digital content.

Our ambition is to be the home of the most powerful, entertaining, and inspiring stories for people all around the world.

The Ad Sales Planner is a critical member of the APAC Advertising Sales team, supporting revenue growth across BBC Studios' portfolio of television, digital, audio, sponsorship, branded content and audience solutions. Working closely with sales, clients, agencies and internal stakeholders, the role supports the full advertising sales cycle, from proposal development and campaign planning through to execution, reporting and post-campaign analysis.

The APAC region presents a significant growth opportunity through a dual-pronged strategy of expanding our base of premium television advertisers while accelerating growth across BBC Studios' evolving digital, audience, data and content marketing solutions. As a result, this role plays an important part in helping clients better understand and access BBC Studios' unique audiences, premium content environments and advertising capabilities.

The successful candidate will combine strong commercial acumen, attention to detail and client management skills with a passion for media, content, audience insights and advertising innovation. Prepare campaign performance reports, transmission reports and post-campaign reviews.

Build strong day-to-day relationships with agencies, advertisers and regional sales representatives.

Prepare and distribute campaign performance reports, post-campaign analyses, transmission reports and revenue tracking updates.
Support the sales team with audience insights, market intelligence and competitor monitoring to strengthen client conversations and commercial outcomes.

Become a trusted commercial partner to the sales team and a valued contact for clients and agencies.
Contribute to the growth of both premium television advertising and emerging digital, audience and content-led revenue streams.

Excellent organisational, administrative and project management skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Track supplier deliverables, timelines and quality, escalating issues where required.

title: Account & Strategy Lead
description:
A leadership opportunity to shape strategy, inspire creative work and lead a next-generation agency operation for a global hospitality brand.

We are seeking an exceptional Account & Strategy Lead for immediate hire, combining strategic depth, creative judgement and client leadership with personal responsibility for programme delivery and results.

The Role

As Programme & Strategy Lead, you will lead the strategic direction, client relationship and delivery of the client’s Brand Governance & APAC mid-funnel programme. Mid-funnel is made up of two complementary programmes: an always-on campaign and an influencer campaign, both designed to build brand consideration across priority markets.

This is a hands-on senior account leadership role within a lean team. You will partner with the client to understand their business priorities, shape the strategic response, and guide the agency team from brief through to delivery and learning. You will need the judgement to challenge constructively, the creative fluency to recognise and develop strong ideas, and the commercial awareness to connect marketing activity to brand and business outcomes

Responsibilities

Own the senior agency relationship for the APAC agency programme, with accountability for strategic quality, client confidence, delivery and results across both the always-on and influencer programmes.

Work with the client’s leadership team to understand business priorities, shape the annual roadmap, set programme priorities and identify opportunities to strengthen consideration for the brand.

Translate client needs, business objectives, audience insights and performance signals into incisive briefs, creative interpretation and actionable content direction.

Develop, bounce back and constructively challenge ideas with the client and agency teams, ensuring creative work is distinctive, relevant to the audience and connected to the strategic objective

Lead integrated development across strategy, creative, content, influencers, media and performance, ensuring the different disciplines work together as one coherent programme.

• Guide the agency team through briefing, planning, production, approvals and delivery, creating clarity around priorities, roles, timelines, dependencies and decisions.

Personally develop and present persuasive leadership decks, strategic recommendations and creative work, making complex thinking easy to understand and building alignment at senior level.

Own measurement, performance read-outs and learning loops, turning results and market signals into practical optimisation recommendations and stronger future work

What We’re Looking For

Significant senior experience in account leadership, brand strategy, integrated marketing, creative content or a related agency role, ideally across multiple markets.

A strong understanding of how brand strategy, creative work, content, influencers, media and performance connect to build consideration and deliver commercial value

Proven ability to understand a client’s business challenge and translate it into a clear strategic response, inspiring briefs and focused agency action.

A track record of becoming a trusted senior client partner: someone who listens carefully, understands the client’s world, asks the right questions and provides confident, informed counsel.

Strong creative judgement and fluency, with the ability to recognise a good idea, improve it through constructive discussion and guide creative, content and production teams towards high-quality work.

Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to lead senior conversations, facilitate decisions, sell an idea and manage challenge constructively.

A hands-on, solutions-oriented leader who can bring structure to ambiguity, prioritise effectively and lead a small, agile agency team without losing sight of the detail.

Why this role

Own and evolve a regional agency operating model with direct influence on its success.

Be the senior account lead at the centre of a high-profile APAC programme for a globally recognised hospitality brand.

Have direct influence on how client priorities become distinctive, effective and measurable work.

Work within a senior, agile team backed by advanced data, media and technology capabilities, with the opportunity to make a visible difference to the way the partnership operates.

title: Strategic Partnerships Development Manager, Android Ecosystem Partnerships
description:

Experience working in Vietnam and Pakistan markets.

About the job

Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.

As a Strategic Partnerships Development Manager, you will be at the forefront of driving growth for Android and platform and devices product areas across the telco, Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and retail sector. You will be responsible for designing partnership strategies and executing complex agreements that are critical to drive our user acquisition and business generation efforts in the region with partners. As a member of the APAC Android Business Development team, you will work closely with Android Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Legal teams on new initiatives and key strategic relationships. In this role, you will identify industry trends and key influencers, managing the process from start to finish.

Android is Google’s mobile operating system powering more than 3 billion devices worldwide. Android is about bringing computing to everyone in the world. We believe computing is a super power for good, enabling access to information, economic opportunity, productivity, connectivity between friends and family and more. We think everyone in the world should have access to the best computing has to offer. We provide the platform for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and developers to build compelling computing devices (smartphones, tablets, TVs, wearables, etc) that run the best apps/services for everyone in the world.

Responsibilities
Identify and pursue new partnership opportunities to grow and generate business for the Android ecosystem, aligning with Google’s platform and devices strategic goals.
Develop, synthesize and share actionable local partner feedback and market/country trends to drive whole-Android and Platform and Devices (P&D) performance and partner with cross-functional teams to address and mitigate local challenges.
Drive operational excellence in all aspects of our partnership, regular business reviews, agreement integration, escalations management, etc. Serve as the main conduit for partner feedback and insights.
Lead complex, cross-functional business initiatives from conception to launch, ensuring they are delivered on time and to a high standard.
Guide the integration of internal team timelines, goals, and objectives. Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, Marketing and other teams to execute on our overall P&D strategy.

Visual Merchandising Strategy & Execution:

Market Leadership & Partnership:

* Lead market-specific visual merchandising initiatives and Centre of Excellence (COE) projects that elevate the guest experience and drive business impact.

Capability Building & Coaching:

* Design and facilitate training programs, workshops, and learning materials to support store teams.
* Deliver ongoing feedback and guidance to stores to drive continuous improvement in visual execution and brand presentation.
* Identify capability gaps and partner with leaders to develop plans that strengthen visual merchandising excellence across the market.

New Store Openings & Optimization:
* Lead visual merchandising planning and execution for new store openings, renovations, relocations, and store optimization projects.
* Partner with Opening & Optimization teams to develop and implement optimal store layouts, merchandising maps, and visual strategies.
* Ensure all new stores and renovation projects meet lululemon visual standards and deliver a seamless guest experience.
* Facilitate pre-opening training, visual merchandising setup, enrollment activities, and post-opening support.
* Manage visual merchandising project timelines, communications, and stakeholder alignment throughout the project lifecycle.

Program & Process Development:
* Drive the continuous improvement of visual merchandising tools, processes, and resources with APAC VMS.
* Support the development and evolution of programs and other visual merchandising initiatives.
* Maintain and manage visual merchandising resources, databases, and operating procedures.
* Lead project planning, communication strategies, and execution follow-up to ensure successful implementation of key market initiatives.

qualifications

leadership accountabilities

* Builds capability and develops talent through coaching, mentorship, and knowledge sharing.

must haves
