Experience accessing and communicating with senior decision-makers.

Proven ability to create opportunities through direct relationships and business development.

Strong ability to understand customer needs and translate them into practical business or technology solutions.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Professional and confident when representing the company in senior-level meetings.

The opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, planning and real estate.

A fast-moving environment with significant autonomy and responsibility.

title: VP of Tech Expansion (100% REMOTE)
description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Innovate with Tether

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are seeking an exceptional VP of Tech Expansion to lead the global adoption and commercial expansion of Tether’s technology ecosystem.

Reporting directly to the Chief Expansion Officer, this executive will oversee the expansion of current and future technologies across areas such as artificial intelligence, self-custodial infrastructure, peer-to-peer systems, and digital & financial infrastructure.

The VP will lead several senior professionals globally and teams responsible for expanding Tether’s different technology verticals, ensuring a coordinated global strategy and compelling propositions for major companies, institutions, and governments.

The VP will own the talent agenda for international expansion: recruiting, developing and motivating team members, and deepening the existing bench of global leaders across verticals.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role requiring strong technology understanding, commercial judgment, executive presence, and global relationship-building capabilities. The ideal candidate can engage with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, and government leaders, translate complex needs into technology solutions, and convert opportunities into major partnerships and deployments.

Equally important, the VP will turn these engagements into replicable, scalable products and playbooks, so that each deployment strengthens Tether's ability to enter the next market rather than remaining a one-off.

International travel is required.

Responsibilities

Global Strategy & Business Development

Define and execute the global expansion strategy for Tether’s technology ecosystem.
Establish priorities across current and future technology verticals.
Identify high-potential markets, industries, partners, and use cases.
Build relationships with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, government leaders, and other senior stakeholders.
Personally originate, structure, negotiate, and close major partnerships and deployments.
Position Tether as a long-term technology and infrastructure partner.

Solutions & Execution

Connect Tether’s different capabilities to develop tailored and integrated solutions.
Translate market and partner requirements into clear opportunities for product and engineering teams.
Coordinate internal stakeholders and external implementation partners from initial concept through deployment and scale.
Ensure major projects are delivered on time, within budget, and against measurable objectives.
Monitor solutionss performance, identify risks, and develop mitigation plans.

Leadership

Lead the senior professionals and teams responsible for expanding Tether’s different technologies.
Set clear priorities, KPIs, and accountability / monitoring frameworks.
Build a high-performing global Tech Expansion organization.
Ensure effective collaboration with regional Expansion, product, engineering, legal, and regulatory teams.
Develop repeatable commercial and execution playbooks across technologies and markets.
Identify issues requiring escalation and bring them to the Chief Expansion Officer with clear context and recommended options.

Strategic Representation

Position Tether as a global leader in decentralized AI, resilient financial infrastructures, and user-centred technologies.
Represent Tether in strategic engagements with major enterprises, institutions, governments, regulators, and industry leaders.
Act as a senior ambassador for Tether’s technology vision at global conferences, industry forums and in front of global companies senior executives
12+ years of experience across enterprise technology, AI, digital infrastructure, fintech and digital assets, telecommunications, or technology business development, including senior leadership experience.
Strong understanding of emerging technologies, decentralized infrastructure, and digital platforms.
Proven experience originating, structuring, and closing major enterprise or government technology partnerships.
Ability to engage credibly with C-suite executives, government leaders, and other senior decision-makers.
Experience developing global go-to-market strategies across multiple technologies and markets. Strong leadership experience, including managing senior professionals and international teams.
Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to coordinate commercial, product, engineering, legal, regulatory, and implementation teams.
Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to operate effectively in fast-moving environments.
Degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, AI, or a related field, combining strong business expertise with a solid technology foundation; MBA preferred.
Experience working across multiple regions and cultures.
An established global network across major enterprises, technology companies, financial institutions, and governments.

Nice to Have: Professional proficiency in three or more languages.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io
We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Reporting to the Head of Outreach and Marketing, the incumbent will co-lead the planning and delivery of outreach and marketing initiatives , working closely with team members and internal stakeholders to implement local and international student recruitment activities and support the achievement of recruitment objectives.

The role encompasses both local and international student recruitment, including building relationships with educational institutions, representing SIT at recruitment events and education fairs, and enhancing SIT’s profile among prospective students, parents and educators. The incumbent will also support broader admissions and financial aid operations during the admissions cycle, including application processing and applicant engagement. Overseas travel is a key component of the role.

Key Responsibilities

1. Student Recruitment and Outreach

Support the development and implementation of local and international recruitment and outreach plans aligned with the University’s enrolment objectives.
Plan and deliver recruitment and engagement activities, including SIT Open House, learning journeys, education fairs, admissions talks and outreach programmes.
Develop and implement student engagement and yield-enhancement initiatives.
Represent SIT at local and international outreach activities, effectively communicating the University’s programmes and value proposition to prospective students, parents and educators.
Build and maintain relationships with schools, educational institutions and other stakeholders to support student recruitment and strengthen SIT’s presence.
Support international student recruitment and partnership development, including overseas travel where required.
Track outreach activities and outcomes and provide recommendations to improve future recruitment efforts.

2. Marketing and Communications

Support the planning and execution of marketing and communications initiatives to attract and engage prospective students.
Develop, review and coordinate recruitment content, collateral and communications across relevant platforms and channels.
Work closely with internal stakeholders and external agencies, including creative, media and production partners, on marketing campaigns and promotional initiatives.
Oversee and coordinate content creation activities, including photography, videography, student stories and multimedia productions.
Monitor emerging trends in higher education marketing, digital engagement and youth communications to enhance recruitment effectiveness.

3. Admissions and Financial Aid Operations

Support admissions, financial aid and scholarship activities during peak periods.
Undertake application processing, respond to applicant enquiries and support other operational requirements in accordance with University policies and procedures.
Contribute ideas and feedback to improve systems, processes and applicant touchpoints to enhance operational efficiency and applicant experience.

4. Stakeholder Engagement and Partnership Management

Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support recruitment and enrolment objectives.
Coordinate across diverse stakeholder groups to ensure the smooth delivery of outreach, engagement and marketing initiatives.
Represent SIT professionally at public engagements, presentations and recruitment events, both locally and internationally.
Uphold SIT's service standards and contribute to positive stakeholder experiences across all recruitment and applicant touchpoints.

5. Project and Operational Management

Manage assigned outreach, recruitment and marketing projects from planning through implementation, ensuring timelines, budgets and deliverables are met.
Contribute to team planning, process improvements and the development of new engagement initiatives.
Support cross-functional initiatives across the Admissions and Financial Aid Division.
Guide junior team members or project teams where required.
Undertake additional duties and special projects as assigned.

Requirements

A recognised degree from a reputable university.
At least 5 - 7 years of relevant experience, preferably in outreach, marketing and communications, events or a related field.
Experience in developing and delivering recruitment, outreach or marketing initiatives, preferably within the education sector.
Good project management, stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
Strong presentation and public speaking skills, with confidence in engaging diverse audiences.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Experience working with creative agencies and coordinating photography, videography and multimedia productions will be advantageous.
Experience in an international or cross-cultural environment is an added advantage.
Proficiency in additional languages relevant to SIT's international recruitment markets will be an advantage.
Willingness to travel internationally as required.

title: Producer, Singapore International Festival of Arts (SIFA)
description:
Contract Period: 2-Years

Powering the Arts, Empowering You

Join us to shape Singapore’s arts landscape. Collaborate with passionate people, champion bold ideas, and bring iconic spaces to life. Your creativity fuels a vibrant cultural future.

Job Purpose

The Producer will work closely with Arts House Group (AHG) Management, the Festival Director, and key stakeholders to support the development and implementation of the Singapore International Festival of Arts (SIFA) as an enriching experience for both artists and audiences, while positioning SIFA as a significant event in Singapore’s arts and cultural landscape.

Key strategies to achieve the above objectives and outcomes, in alignment with funding KPIs, include:

Driving efforts to heighten SIFA’s local and international profile as AHG's flagship event and as a leading international contemporary arts festival.
Building strong and long-term partnerships with artists and arts organisations, both locally and internationally.
Growing audience engagement and outreach to foster greater arts appreciation across diverse audience segments.

Producing & Programme Management

Serve as an integral member of the AHG Producing team to plan and deliver multiple editions of SIFA as part of its broader festival cycle.
Manage end-to-end project delivery of assigned programmes, including commissions and other presentations. This includes anticipating resource needs and leveraging on AHG’s platforms, partnerships and infrastructure to ensure operational excellence and high presentation standards.
Build and maintain productive relationships with artists, artistic collaborators, commissioning partners and presenting partners, serving as a key point of contact throughout project development and delivery.
Coordinate project staff and liaise with artists and external vendors to ensure the timely and effective execution of assigned programmes.
Work closely with other AHG departments, particularly Marketing, Communications and Partnerships, to optimise visibility, maximise revenue potential and build stakeholder relationships that strengthen the brand identity of both SIFA and AHG.

Administration and Budget

Manage the financial management of assigned programmes, including budget preparation, monitoring, reforecasting and reconciliation. Ensure assigned programmes are delivered on time, within scope and budget.
Manage the preparation, negotiation and administration of contracts and licences of assigned programmes, ensuring terms are fit for purpose and aligned with organisational policies and programme requirements. Work with the wider producing team and relevant AHG departments to ensure compliance with contracting and procurement frameworks, and adherence to funding and organisational guidelines.
Support the tracking and meeting of KPIs for assigned programmes, ensuring timely updates of project progress and alignment with funder and organisational requirements. Maintain clear and comprehensive documentation for audit, reporting and internal knowledge management.
Contribute to the development and continual improvement of producing processes, documentation, templates and workflows to support effective festival planning and delivery.

Others

To carry out and assume any other duties and responsibilities as and when assigned by the Management

Qualifications

Education

Degree in Arts, Arts Management, or a relevant professional qualification in a related field.

Experience

At least 6 to 8 years in programming/producing within an arts institution, arts-centred festival, or equivalent role in the arts sector.
Strong knowledge of the local performing arts scene, including familiarity or understanding of audience preferences and community needs.
Demonstrated programme management experience in the arts, including administrative, production or marketing initiatives.

Skills

Excellent organisational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage or oversee multiple projects concurrently, with strong attention to detail and a meticulous approach to administration, planning and budget management.
Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with artists, partners, vendors and cross-functional teams.
Experience in contract administration and negotiation, with an understanding of procurement and organisational processes.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

Traits

Able to work independently and under pressure to meet tight deadlines.
Agile and adaptable in responding to evolving programme and operational requirements.
Proactive and resourceful in navigating challenges within a dynamic festival environment.
 Able to work on weekends and after office hours as required.

NOTE: This is a 2-year contract role.

title: Senior Building Manager (Site Lead)
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.

Senior Building Manager (Site Lead) - Job Description

Position Overview
The Senior Building Manager is the Account & Operations Lead and serves as one of JLL's most important front-line leadership positions, responsible for delivery to the client across multiple service lines while managing diverse responsibilities and priorities. This role acts as the primary point of contact for all matters related to the account, building and maintaining strong, long-lasting customer relationships backed by competence, knowledge, and experience. The role is accountable for strategic leadership, operational excellence, cost savings, compliance, innovation, risk management, and supporting dynamic client needs in the Integrated Facility Management (IFM) space. This role requires advanced technical and customer experience expertise, project management skills, and the ability to lead teams in complex, regulated environments.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership Management:
Act as the primary point of contact for all matters specific and related to the account, serving as a strategic partner to the client.
Create and execute annual site business plans aligned with client growth and JLL growth plans and initiatives that support account expansion and win: win outcomes.
Drive and track cost-saving initiatives and innovative solutions (including technology, process, and sustainability improvements) to deliver measurable value and support account profitability and growth.
Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships, ensuring deep understanding of client business and strategic objectives.
Ensure seamless and efficient delivery, improving cost optimization, mitigating risk, and fostering sustainable practices, including the development of the team and cross-skilling.

Client Relationship Management
Conduct regular client engagements, including weekly operations meetings, monthly management review meetings, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs).
Demonstrate strong attention to detail and proactive communication of updates, issues, risk mitigation solutions, and delays.
Proactively engage stakeholders to ensure that on-site client expectations are met.
Build and develop effective client/stakeholder relationships across multiple levels of the organizations (JLL and Client).
Serve as on-site key point of contact for Facilities in the client's premises.
Maintain close liaison with the client on-site representatives to address problems and/or enhance working environment performance.

Operational Excellence & Site Operations Management
Manage all building-related technical and service contracts, develop and implement procedures and performance measures to ensure efficiency, accuracy, reliability, and safety of work methods and systems.
Ensure compliance with contract requirements and manage risk, acting as the ultimate compliance authority for the account.
Manage internal reporting such as development tracker, opex and capex pipeline, compliance, risk, and issues.
Recommend continuous quality improvement practices and implement industry best practice operations.
Implement building procedures and performance measures and ensure they are maintained at all times.
Ensure all Critical Environment (CEM) requirements are met, including compliance with ISO, BCA and HSE standards.
Review existing operations regularly to reduce costs and improve operational standards.
Provide 24/7 emergency call support and site attendance as required.
Coordinate critical out-of-hours issues and participate as a key team member in investigations and responses to emergency situations.
Ensure uninterrupted site operations and be present at major events, incidents, and shutdowns.

Business Development & Growth
Develop new business and identify new and innovative business opportunities, expanding the share of wallet by solving client pain points.
Initiate and participate in contract negotiations and agreements.
Work collaboratively with facilities team colleagues both within the client location and in the wider Jones Lang LaSalle network.
Act as a strategic partner to the client, identifying and supporting account growth opportunities, expanding service scope, and ensuring mutually beneficial outcomes.

Team Leadership & People Management
Build and lead empowered, technically capable account teams whose competencies align with the client's industry and business.
Foster talent development and conduct quality career development conversations, including robust succession planning and cross-training initiatives.
Manage diverse teams across the portfolio.
Manage and coach team members, developing and sustaining a high-quality, well-motivated team.
Ensure high staff morale, trust, and work ethics.
Build and maintain an environment that supports teamwork, cooperation, and performance excellence within the team.
Mentor and enable training and development of team members to ensure staff development to anticipate/meet client requirements and growth.
Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability to support evolving client requirements, new technologies, and changes in the business environment.

IFM-Specific Responsibilities
Oversee integrated facilities management services including hard and soft services.
Manage IFM service delivery models (self-performed and sub-contracted) covering facility management, workplace services, site services, ground maintenance, engineering services, employee services, utilities and energy, and specialty services.
Ensure governance and account management structures are in place.
Sponsor the Asset Management Program and Audit program, allocating resources and ensuring delivery execution.
Leverage technology and data analytics (e.g., CMMS, ServiceNow, analytics platforms) to drive operational efficiency, transparency, and continuous improvement in service delivery and asset management.

Procurement & Vendor Management
Manage all 3rd party/subcontractor performance, ensuring vendors are well-managed, deliver services on time and within budget, and minimize JLL’s risk exposure.
Ensure that vendor procurement processes comply with agreed client procurement guidelines as well as Jones Lang LaSalle best practice.
Ensure vendors are selected based on their familiarity with the local market situation, enabling them to offer timely and effective responses to service requests.
Consolidate contracts and suppliers to leverage volume purchasing power and streamline vendor relationships.

Contracts Management
Plan and manage all contracts to ensure that they are professionally delivered at the right costs.
Ensure expiry of contracts are well-monitored and re-procurement is initiated and all compliance needs are met including licensing and insurance coverage.
Ensure contracts are continually assessed to deliver best value to the client.

Financial Management
Actively work to ensure that the site's financial operations are meeting or exceeding targets and control requirements, including the Jones Lang LaSalle Code of Ethics.
Ensure financial processes are followed at all times with no non-compliance outcomes.
Develop and accurately oversee the forecast and budget management for the account, including opex and capex.
Track and report on cost savings achieved, ensuring alignment with client and JLL targets.

Health, Safety, Security & Environment (HSSE) Management
Champion a culture of compliance and safety, ensuring all operations, financial processes, and service delivery meet or exceed JLL and client standards, statutory regulations, and audit requirements.
Ensure the provision of a safe working environment and compliance with statutory regulations on fire, health, and safety standards.
Ensure all working environments meet all requisite OH&S Standards.
Support the Account’s HSSE Team with determining appropriate actions to address risks and opportunities.
Lead the development, implementation, and regular testing of integrated risk management and business continuity frameworks, proactively identifying and mitigating operational, financial, and reputational risks.

Risk Management
Ensure a property risk management program including audits is implemented and maintained.
Ensure disaster recovery and business continuity plans are implemented and maintained.
Ensure escalation procedures and incident reporting procedures are implemented and in place.
Assist in the development of guidelines and strategies to ensure compliance with Jones Lang LaSalle's business conduct.
Act as the first escalation point for issues that require resolution and/or support.

Performance Management
Achieve Key Performance Indicators and Service Level Agreement targets.
Attain client KPIs.
Ensure continual service improvements.
Maintain client satisfaction survey (Client Voice) at the highest level (e.g., >8 Survey Score).
Leverage technology and data analytics to drive operational efficiency, transparency, and continuous improvement in service delivery and asset management.

Administrative Support
Provide assistance in general administrative activities and any other duties as assigned by Account Management on a needs-be basis.
Perform other duties as required to support the dynamic needs of the client and the IFM account, including special projects, transitions, and cross-functional initiatives.

Key Result Areas
Uninterrupted site operations
Client satisfaction
Continual service improvements
Attaining client KPIs
Client growth
Team development and retention

Required Qualifications
Education
Bachelor’s in Engineering/Facilities Management/ Business Management or equivalent.
Advanced degree or professional certifications are advantageous.

Experience
Minimum 8-10 years in Facility Management with proven team management and leadership experience.
Minimum 5+ years in similar multi-service line Leadership position.
Background in Government / Commercial Real Estate industry preferable.
Proven track record managing multiple scaling accounts or small/medium size regional enterprise accounts.
Demonstrable experience in facilities management and corporate real estate.


Technical Knowledge & Skills
Client-centric: Deep empathy, transparent communication, coherent strategies, and passion to meet client and team needs.
Authentic leadership: Ability to earn respect, build trust, and demonstrate integrity.
Solution-oriented: Capability to uncover opportunities and turn challenges into valuable outcomes.
Growth-driven: Focus on enhancing client experience while seeking continuous improvement.
Relationship management: Strong ability to build trust, loyalty, and long-term partnerships.
Financial acumen: Understanding of account financials, contract management, and commercial excellence.
Strong analytical, presentation, excellent communication, and organization skills.
Knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety requirements.
Strength in knowledge of M&E systems, Financial & Management Reporting.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport quickly.
Sound computer skills in Microsoft Office and facility management systems (e.g., CMMS).
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple and complex operational matters on a daily basis.
Leverage technology and data analytics to drive operational efficiency, transparency, and continuous improvement in service delivery and asset management.

Key Competencies & Personal Attributes
Strong personal brand reflecting reputation, expertise, and professional image.
Credibility and passion as a knowledgeable professional who delivers on promises.
Influence to drive decisions and positively impact client outcomes.
Ability to work under pressure and manage emergency situations.
Delivers with, and for, the team as an integrated and hands-on team player.
Executes with speed and leverages capabilities of the team and platform to integrate into workable and structured plans.
Flexibility to provide 24/7 support when required.
High level of professionalism, integrity, and embodies JLL values and behaviors - JLL’s values: Teamwork, Ethics, Excellence. JLL’s leadership behaviors: Be Humble, Win Together, Simplify, Be Decisive, Be Curious
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.

About JLL –

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Enterprise Account Executive, Korea
[Singapore]

Korea is one of Asana's fastest-growing markets, and we're making a significant investment to accelerate that momentum. We're looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to own our go-to-market strategy for Korea, from defining where and how we win to closing the complex, multi-stakeholder deals that get us there.You'll be the face of Asana in market: building relationships with senior decision-makers in Korea's leading enterprises, drawing on your existing network and deep experience selling in Korea, shaping a channel and partner ecosystem that extends our reach, and positioning our AI work management platform, including AI Teammates, AI Studio, and Dash, as the way modern organizations coordinate human + AI work. You'll partner closely with regional and global colleagues across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and Partnerships to turn Korea's growth into a durable, scalable business.

This role is based in our Singapore office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about in-office requirements.

What you'll achieve
Own the Korea go-to-market strategy, including account segmentation, target industries, territory planning, and pipeline generation, and translate it into a clear plan with measurable revenue outcomes.
Lead complex, multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles from first conversation to close, building consensus across business, IT, procurement, and executive stakeholders.
Build and scale relationships with channel and distribution partners in Korea, driving co-selling, joint pipeline, and partner-sourced revenue.
Leverage your relationships across Korea's enterprise and partner community to open doors at target accounts, accelerate early pipeline, and establish Asana as a credible, trusted brand in market.
Serve as a trusted advisor to C-level and line-of-business leaders, translating Asana's value into business outcomes that resonate in the Korean market.
Position and sell Asana's AI portfolio, including AI Teammates, AI Studio, and Dash, helping customers identify high-impact use cases for human + AI collaboration.
Anticipate roadblocks and objections with foresight, crafting win-win solutions that ensure every stakeholder sees the value of Asana.
Partner seamlessly with SDRs, Field Marketing, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to deliver an exceptional customer experience and drive long-term expansion.
Act as the voice of the Korean market internally, sharing customer and competitive insights with Product, Marketing, and regional leadership to inform localization and strategy.
About you
Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.
Native or professional fluency in Korean and English, with a deep understanding of how enterprise buying works in the Korean market.
Direct experience selling into Korean enterprises, with a clear understanding of local buying culture, decision-making hierarchies, procurement processes, and relationship-driven sales cycles.
An established network in the Korean market, such as senior business and IT decision-makers, channel partners, resellers, and system integrators, that you can credibly leverage to build pipeline.
[8+] years of experience closing business, including [4+] years selling directly into the Enterprise segment, ideally in SaaS or enterprise software.
Proven track record of closing large, complex deals with consistently high quota attainment, and a working mastery of a structured methodology such as MEDDPICC or Challenger Sales.
Experience working and managing channel, reseller, or alliance partnerships, and driving partner-sourced or co-sold revenue.
Demonstrated ability to build a market or territory strategy, ideally in a high-growth or "first-in-market" environment.
Experience leading multi-threaded sales processes with thoughtful planning and internal coordination across global and regional teams.
Expertise in cultivating trust and long-term relationships with diverse stakeholders, with a bias toward action.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we'll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

Compensation for this role follows an On-Target Earnings (OTE) structure, which includes a competitive base salary and performance-based sales incentive pay (based on the terms of the Sales Incentive Plan). These ranges are a guideline; actual base salary and OTE may vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process, and the ranges for this role may be modified.

In addition, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity and benefits. We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
Career coaching & support
Inclusive family building benefits

About us

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.

We believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive. Our goal is to ensure that Asana upholds an environment where all people feel that they are respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Join Asana's Talent Network to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.

title: ETD Compliance Advisory – Senior Manager
description:
The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.

Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.

Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.

The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform.

Founded in London in 1866, the Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,200 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.

Role Overview

Compliance Advisory plays a critical role in supporting and constructively challenging the business to achieve the highest standards of regulatory compliance, market integrity and conduct. The function is structured across regional advisory teams and complemented by three Global Heads of Product

Advisory responsible for:

• Securities & Venues

• Derivatives (Rates, FX, Money Markets and Government Bonds)

• Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD) & Commodities

This role is to support the Global Head of ETD Advisory, with responsibility for providing specialist advisory coverage across Exchange Traded Derivatives and physical commodities markets globally. The team provides strategic regulatory oversight and subject matter expertise across Exchange Traded Derivatives and physical commodities related activities, supporting both TP ICAP's Global Broking and Energy & Commodities divisions.

Operating with a strong global coordination mandate, the team ensures the consistent application of regulatory standards, conduct expectations and risk management practices across all jurisdictions in which TP ICAP operates.

The team works in close partnership with regional Compliance Advisory teams, Legal, Risk and business leadership, providing specialist input to support strategic initiatives, regulatory change, investigations, training programmes and governance activities.

The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping the firm's regulatory strategy, supporting the continued evolution of global Exchange Traded Derivatives and Energy & Commodities businesses, and strengthening the firm's culture of compliance worldwide.

Role Responsibilities

· Be part of ETD Compliance Advisory team driving high standards of delivery, and providing expert product advisory support across the global businesses.

· Engage closely with Business Heads to provide regulatory guidance and challenge on business strategy and growth initiatives from a regulatory and conduct perspective.

· Act as a trusted adviser to Front Office leadership, delivering clear, risk-based, and commercially

practical regulatory advice.

· Help to design and deliver global thematic training programmes to enhance regulatory awareness and promote a strong compliance culture.

· Provide compliance guidance and advice on change initiatives, including new product approvals, new broking models, expansion into new jurisdictions, execution workflows, and market structure developments, ensuring alignment with applicable regulatory and exchange requirements.

· Work on global strategic initiatives, including potential acquisitions, and provide Compliance input into due diligence and implementation planning.

· Represent Compliance at senior business and governance forums, influencing decision-making and ensuring appropriate risk management.

· Partner with regional Compliance and Regulatory teams to assess and coordinate the global impact of upcoming exchange and/or regulatory developments.

· Act as the escalation point for complex, sensitive, or high-risk compliance matters relating to Exchange Traded Derivatives and commodities activities globally.

Experience / Competences

Essential

· Significant compliance advisory experience within wholesale financial markets, particularly Exchange Traded Derivatives and Commodities, gained within a global financial services organisation or through a closely related regulatory, legal, risk, exchange, or market oversight role.

· Comprehensive knowledge of global regulatory requirements applicable to Exchange Traded Derivatives, exchanges, and related market structure and market conduct.

· Strong understanding of interdealer brokerage models, exchange-traded markets, clearing frameworks, and associated market infrastructure.

· Proven ability to assess complex regulatory issues and deliver pragmatic, risk-based solutions that support commercial objectives while maintaining regulatory compliance.

· Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders across Front Office, Compliance, Legal, Risk, and Operations functions.

· Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively across seniority levels, functions, and geographic regions.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex regulatory requirements clearly and concisely.

· Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across regional and global teams to deliver consistent regulatory outcomes.

Desirable

· Experience providing compliance advice on new products, business initiatives, trading workflows, and regulatory change initiatives.

· Knowledge of transaction reporting requirements and related regulatory frameworks, including MiFIR and REMIT.

· Experience operating within a complex global financial services organisation with multiple regulatory obligations and stakeholder groups.

· Experience supporting global regulatory change, remediation or transformation activities.

· Experience engaging with regulators, exchanges, clearing houses, or industry bodies.

· Professional Compliance qualification or relevant industry accreditation.

· Strong understanding of evolving market structure developments, electronic execution models, clearing frameworks, and emerging regulatory developments impacting global Exchange Traded Derivatives and commodities markets.

· Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes against tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Job Band & Level

Senior Manager / 7

#LI-Hybrid #LI-MID

Not The Perfect Fit?

Concerned that you may not meet the criteria precisely? At TP ICAP, we wholeheartedly believe in fostering inclusivity and cultivating a work environment where everyone can flourish, regardless of your personal or professional background. If you are enthusiastic about this role but find that your experience doesn't align perfectly with every aspect of the job description, we strongly encourage you to apply. You may be the ideal candidate for this position or another opportunity within our organisation. Our dedicated Talent Acquisition team is here to assist you in recognising how your unique skills and abilities can be a valuable contribution. Don't hesitate to take the leap and explore the possibilities. Your potential is what truly matters to us.

Company Statement

We know that the best innovation happens when diverse people with different perspectives and skills work together in an inclusive atmosphere. That's why we're building a culture where everyone plays a part in making people feel welcome, ready and willing to contribute. TP ICAP Accord - our Employee Network - is a central to this. As well as representing specific groups, TP ICAP Accord helps increase awareness, collaboration, shares best practice, and holds our firm to account for driving continuous cultural improvement.

Location

Singapore - 50 Raffles Place - Singapore

title: Performance and Demand Generation Manager
description:
Description

About the role

The Performance & Demand Generation Manager drives qualified demand, lead generation and customer acquisition for the Singapore business. This hands-on role owns demand generation performance, with a primary focus on paid media, funnel optimisation and data-led experimentation to improve acquisition efficiency and contribute to pipeline and revenue growth.

Working closely with the Business Development team, the role plans, tests and optimises acquisition initiatives within the wider Singapore marketing plan.

Key responsibilities

Demand generation and acquisition

Plan and execute Singapore demand generation initiatives aligned with business priorities and agreed acquisition targets.

Drive qualified lead generation and optimise campaigns for lead volume, lead quality, acquisition efficiency and pipeline contribution.

Identify and test new acquisition opportunities across digital and selected offline channels, prioritising those with measurable commercial potential.

Align demand generation plans and budget priorities with the Senior Marketing Manager.

Paid media and performance marketing

Manage and optimise paid acquisition campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube and other relevant digital channels.

Own campaign set-up, targeting, bidding, audience development and allocation of approved campaign budgets.

Work with creative teams to brief and test messaging, formats and creative variations that improve acquisition performance.

Evaluate emerging advertising platforms and formats, including ChatGPT Ads where available and relevant, through structured tests.

Funnel optimisation and conversion

Monitor the acquisition funnel from lead generation through qualification, opportunity and conversion.

Analyse performance across campaigns, channels, audiences and customer segments to identify bottlenecks.

Optimise landing pages, lead forms, offers and conversion journeys in collaboration with relevant teams.

Use Business Development feedback on lead quality, customer objections and downstream conversion to improve campaigns and lead handover.

Data measurement and experimentation

Track and report lead volume, marketing-qualified leads, cost per lead, customer acquisition cost, conversion rates, pipeline contribution and return on marketing spend.

Translate performance data into actionable insights, recommendations and clear stakeholder reporting.

Run structured experiments across channels, audiences, creative, messaging, offers and landing pages; use findings to guide optimisation and scaling.

title: Product Manager - #1718
description:

title: Flint Asia-Pacific Data Centres Manager / Associate Director
description:
We are looking for a 

Manager

or

Associate Director

with experience related to

data centres

to support the delivery of client work and business development work across our fast-growing

Asia-Pacific

team based in

Singapore

.

You will work closely with team members to support our data centre clients on public policy, regulation, politics, and commercial strategy. There may also be opportunities to work with Flint’s other tech sector clients.

Data centre operators face a challenging policy and regulatory environment across Asia-Pacific. AI and cloud-based demand is driving rapid growth and investment, but delivering a return on this capital is becoming more complicated. In parts of the region, concerns over data centres’ impact on communities, on infrastructure, and on the environment are leading to policy change that impacts on how operators build and operate data centres. We are helping investors and operators of data centres to build understanding of the benefits they bring and to make the case to governments for policy frameworks that enable the growth of the sector.

You will have scope to engage with clients at the most senior levels. The role will provide an unparalleled opportunity to research and analyse the complex policy and political challenges our clients face and develop options and approaches to address those challenges, backing up recommendations with wider strategic and political analysis.

Flint provides an excellent professional and educational environment for people to accelerate their personal and career development. There will be space to engage in discussion and debates on substantive policy and political challenges, as well as significant scope for progression through the company.

You will join a rapidly growing team, with the opportunity to take ownership of tasks and contribute to the company’s growth in the region.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for candidates who have

experience

relevant to

data centre policy

. Relevant issues include power availability and grid connection, permitting and licensing, water, sustainability, cybersecurity and resilience, and community sentiment and social licence to operate.

We are not expecting candidates to have expertise in all of the above

.

We welcome any candidates with experience working in relevant roles in the data centre sector, government departments, regulators, research firms, or other advisory roles. We will consider candidates from a range of functional backgrounds, including those with more technical industry backgrounds. For

Manager / Associate Director level

roles, we will consider candidates with a range of experience - from

4 - 9 years’ work experience –

though this is a

guide

only and we will consider applications on a case-by-case basis.

Our ideal candidate will have:

Strong experience relevant to data centre policy.

The skills required to work on policy and regulation – the ability to research and analyse complex policy issues and to draft policy positions in a clear and structured way.

A professional background in the data centre sector, government, a regulator, consultancy, think tank, or industry body in managerial positions.

A proven track record of managing projects and teams in fast-paced, delivery-focused environments.

Strong interpersonal skills – a flexible approach and the ability to work well across teams, both with colleagues and clients.

Commercial acumen, with the ability to identify new business opportunities and deliver commercially viable solutions to clients.

Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise advice to stakeholders, both in written and verbal form.

(desirable but not required) Connections to government officials and / or regulators working on data centre-related policy in at least one Asia-Pacific country or multilateral grouping.

TO APPLY

To be successful, please submit your

CV

with a short

cover letter

(max 600 words) by

Friday 30 October

. Use your cover letter to explain how your background is relevant to the role and

include at least one paragraph on the policy and regulatory challenges facing the data centre sector in the Asia-Pacific region.

STANDINGOUT

To be successful, please submit your CV and cover letter setting out:

Why you would like to join Flint.

How your experience and skills qualify you for this specific role and its requirements.

The policy and regulatory challenges facing the data centre sector in the Asia-Pacific region.

Whether you have the right to work in Singapore.

Your possible start date and salary expectation.

We will

review applications as they arrive

and may invite candidates to interview before the closing date.

ABOUT FLINT

Flint is a leading global strategy consultancy with a focus on policy, politics, regulation, and economics. We are advisers to some of the largest corporates, financial institutions, and investors in Europe and the Asia-Pacific. We work at the point where government and business meet, drawing on our blend of international expertise and experience to offer an authoritative perspective on both.

We have offices in London, Brussels, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Melbourne, as well as in a number of European capitals. We have also established a network of senior advisers across key Asia-Pacific markets. We offer successful candidates the opportunity to advance within the company.

Flint takes care of its people. We enjoy challenging each other’s thinking and working hard on a wide variety of interesting and stimulating projects, while simultaneously respecting life outside Flint. We offer a flexible working environment with global health insurance coverage and 25 days of holiday accrued from your start date.

We are committed to equality of opportunity for all staff and applications from individuals are encouraged regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships.

description:

www.urbanspace.com.sg

Work closely with marketing to plan campaigns, promotions and outreach activities that generate suitable leads and bookings.

Strong customer engagement, negotiation and closing skills.

Clear verbal and written communication skills, including professional communication through WhatsApp and email.

A proactive and accountable approach, with the willingness to lead the team while remaining personally involved in sales.

Why Join Urbanspace?

We value good service, teamwork, continuous learning and personal growth.

Our Employment Package

Sales incentives

Training and development

Annual leave and medical benefits

Performance bonus and other benefits

How to Apply

Please submit your resume with your contact details, expected salary and earliest available start date.

In your application, briefly highlight your sales achievements and experience leading or developing a team.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Kiztopia Group is a leading family edutainment and active entertainment business dedicated to creating meaningful, engaging experiences through play, exploration and movement.

With multiple concepts and locations across Singapore and the region, we continue to grow our portfolio through innovation, creativity and a commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences.

As we expand, we are looking for passionate and capable individuals to help strengthen our brands, grow our customer base and shape the future of entertainment in Singapore.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a

commercially driven, creative and hands-on Marketing Manager

to lead the marketing strategy, planning and execution for Kiztopia Group's Singapore businesses, including Kiztopia and Xventure.

You will take ownership of integrated marketing initiatives that strengthen brand positioning, increase customer acquisition, drive visitorship and contribute to business growth.

This role requires someone who can translate business objectives into actionable marketing strategies, balance brand-building with performance marketing, and lead campaigns from concept through execution and performance evaluation.

You will manage marketing budgets, guide team members, coordinate external agencies and work closely with Commercial, Operations and other stakeholders to deliver results.

We are looking for a well-rounded marketing leader who is equally comfortable developing strategy, analysing performance and getting involved in execution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketing Strategy & Business Growth

Develop and lead integrated marketing strategies for Kiztopia and Xventure, aligned with brand positioning, commercial objectives and business priorities.

Translate revenue targets, visitorship goals and customer acquisition objectives into actionable monthly, quarterly and annual marketing plans.

Develop targeted strategies for different customer segments, including families, children, youths, young adults, schools and relevant community groups.

Identify opportunities to drive ticket sales, increase repeat visits, build brand loyalty and strengthen customer lifetime value.

Plan and manage campaigns across business-as-usual operations, seasonal peaks, new outlet launches and special events.

Monitor consumer trends, competitor activities and market opportunities to keep our brands relevant and competitive.

2. Integrated Campaign Management

Lead end-to-end planning and execution of marketing campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels.

Develop clear campaign objectives, audience targeting, promotional mechanics, timelines, budgets and measurable KPIs.

Oversee campaign delivery across social media, digital advertising, CRM, website, partnerships, PR and on-ground activations.

Establish effective customer journeys from awareness and engagement through to ticket purchase and repeat visits.

Ensure campaigns are delivered on time, within budget and aligned with business objectives.

Review campaign effectiveness and refine strategies based on performance data and customer response.

3. Digital Marketing & Performance Management

Lead digital marketing strategies across platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok and other relevant channels.

Manage advertising budgets and optimise resource allocation based on campaign objectives and performance.

Oversee audience segmentation, retargeting, conversion campaigns and relevant testing initiatives.

Monitor key performance indicators such as reach, engagement, website traffic, acquisition cost, conversions and attributable revenue.

Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency, conversion rates and return on marketing investment.

Work with relevant stakeholders to improve website, booking and ticketing conversion journeys.

4. Brand, Social Media & Content Strategy

Own the overall brand marketing direction and ensure consistent positioning across campaigns and communication channels.

Develop differentiated content and communication strategies for Kiztopia and Xventure based on their respective target audiences.

Lead social media planning across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and other relevant platforms.

Guide the development of engaging content, including short-form videos, attraction highlights, promotional campaigns, customer experiences and community-driven content.

Review creative concepts, campaign messaging and marketing assets to ensure brand consistency and audience relevance.

Identify emerging content formats, cultural trends and creative opportunities that can strengthen organic reach and brand visibility.

Work closely with the marketing team, content creators and external agencies to deliver relevant, high-quality content.

5. Customer Engagement, CRM & Retention

Develop CRM and customer engagement strategies to encourage repeat visits, strengthen relationships and drive incremental revenue.

Oversee segmented email marketing, WhatsApp campaigns and other customer communications.

description:

THE ROLE

We are looking for a

proactive, creative and hands-on Marketing Executive

This role offers broad exposure across digital marketing, social media, content development, CRM, partnerships, campaigns and events.

You will be responsible for translating marketing plans into effective execution, coordinating with various stakeholders and ensuring campaigns are delivered accurately, efficiently and on schedule.

We are looking for someone who is organised, digitally savvy, resourceful and comfortable taking ownership of day-to-day marketing activities.

Maintain accurate records of campaign spending and results.

Prepare performance reports with key observations and recommendations.

3. Social Media & Content Management

Develop captions, marketing copy, promotional messages and creative briefs.

Coordinate content production with designers, content creators, agencies and internal teams.

Monitor social media comments, enquiries and engagement, coordinating customer responses or escalations where required.

Keep up with relevant social media trends and propose creative content ideas suitable for each brand.

4. CRM, Customer Engagement & Website Updates

Maintain and update website content, promotional details, campaign information and event listings.

Ensure marketing information is accurate and consistent across owned channels and relevant ticketing platforms.

Assist in customer engagement, retention and remarketing initiatives.

Track campaign responses and identify opportunities for improvements.

5. Partnerships, Events & Activations

Coordinate marketing activities with mall partners, influencers, ticketing platforms, schools and community partners.

Support new outlet launches, marketing events, pop-up activations and promotional campaigns.

Assist with influencer coordination, content deliverables, scheduling and campaign follow-up.

Prepare event-related marketing materials, communication schedules and campaign checklists.

Provide on-ground marketing support during key events and activations where required.

6. Reporting, Coordination & Administration

Maintain campaign trackers, content calendars, marketing schedules and deliverable checklists.

Consolidate campaign performance data across digital advertising, social media, CRM and other channels.

Prepare weekly marketing updates covering completed activities, campaign performance, outstanding actions and upcoming priorities.

Coordinate quotations, purchase requests, vendor deliverables and relevant budget records.

Ensure marketing materials, campaigns and promotional information are accurate and approved before release.

Suggest practical improvements to execution efficiency, content performance and campaign effectiveness.

REQUIREMENTS

Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Minimum 2 years of relevant marketing experience

, preferably in a consumer-facing business or agency environment.

Good understanding of social media platforms, content marketing, digital advertising and campaign execution.

Hands-on familiarity with platforms such as Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok or relevant marketing tools.

Ability to coordinate multiple campaigns, stakeholders and deadlines independently.

Good copywriting, communication and organisational skills.

Comfortable working with campaign data, basic performance metrics and reporting tools.

Proactive, resourceful and detail-oriented, with a willingness to learn and take ownership of tasks.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative and hands-on environment.

ADDED ADVANTAGES

Experience in entertainment, attractions, sports, lifestyle, retail, hospitality or leisure industries.

Content creation skills

, including photography, social media reels and short-form video production.

Video editing capabilities

, using tools such as CapCut, Canva, Adobe Premiere Pro or similar applications.

Experience with CRM systems, email marketing, website CMS or e-commerce platforms.

Experience working with influencers, partners or supporting marketing events and activations.

Familiarity with Google Analytics, campaign tracking or basic marketing reporting.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Timely and accurate execution of marketing campaigns.

Consistent delivery of engaging social media and digital marketing content.

Effective management of campaign schedules, assets and stakeholder coordination.

Reliable campaign monitoring, performance reporting and follow-up.

Improved execution efficiency and proactive identification of campaign opportunities.

Meaningful contribution to brand awareness, customer engagement and commercial performance.

WHY JOIN US?

Gain exposure to two exciting brands in the entertainment and leisure industry.

Build practical experience across integrated campaigns, digital marketing, content, CRM and events.

Be part of new brand launches, marketing activations and ongoing business expansion.

Work in a collaborative environment that encourages initiative, learning and ownership.

Responsibilities and Competencies:

Policy-Operations-Technology Integration

• Strategic System Alignment: Ensure operational processes are supported by technology systems and aligned with SWDA’s funding policies and strategic intent

• Operational Policy Development: Formulate and review operational policies to support programme implementation and grants management, translating policy directives into operational guides

• Continuous Improvement Management: Implement systematic refinements to enhance operational effectiveness while maintaining compliance and quality standards.

User Experience and Customer Service Mindset

• Service Standards Implementation: Implement robust service standards and monitor performance of the process to ensure alignment with service framework.

Partnership and Vendor Management

• Strategic Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders and service providers to facilitate delivery of shared services.

• Vendor Performance Management: Develop workflows and work instructions for outsourced providers to implement the programmes; monitors service provider performance in operational delivery and customer service.

Performance Monitoring and Reporting

• Performance Analytics and Reporting: Monitor, track and report programme performance including Service Level Agreements indicators and Key Performance indicators, translating metrics into actionable insights for management.

• Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Identify areas of risks, devise mitigating measures, and establishes control measures to ensure operations align with intended policy parameters.

• People Management

• Nurtures and provide guidance to team members and develops their leadership and functional capabilities through mentoring and coaching.

What we are looking for

You are passionate about solving customer issues, detail-oriented with key strengths in operations management and work processes. You are a people person and is committed to nurture, develop and give guidance to your team members.

• Possess the required competencies to execute the job duties proficiently

• At least 7 years of relevant work experience in operations, programme or project management.

• Strong people management skill, with at least 3 years in a supervisory role

• Strong customer service attitude

• Strong in analysis, communication (both verbal and written), interpersonal, process and project management skills

• Able to multi-task, work independently and perform well under pressure and tight timelines

title: Water Infrastructure Strategy Director
description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

At AirTrunk, we’ve all come together to deliver Data Centres that meet and grow with the needs of our large cloud, content and enterprise customers.

Water management is a key pillar of our sustainability commitments. We design and operate our Data Centers to source water responsibly, reduce reliance on potable water where appropriate, limit usage in water-stressed areas and improve water productivity to support energy, carbon and community outcomes. Through strong water stewardship, we seek to balance business growth with catchment-level resilience, responsible resource use and measurable sustainability impact.

In this leadership role, you will define and lead AirTrunk’s water strategy across the portfolio, managing a team of managers to deliver sustainable, commercially robust and operationally resilient water outcomes.

You will make your mark in a number of ways:

Set and own the regional water strategy for Data Center sites, ensuring scalable, sustainable and resilient water supply solutions across existing and future markets.

Lead, coach and develop a team of managers responsible for utility connections, upgrades, alternative supply options, water infrastructure delivery and site-level optimisation.

Oversee portfolio-wide assessment of water stress, supply risk and regulatory conditions, translating insights into long-term strategic plans and investment priorities.

Build executive-level partnerships with utilities, authorities, customers and solution providers to unlock recycled, industrial and alternative water sourcing opportunities.

Define the roadmap to water positivity, including on-site and off-site water solutions, reuse strategies, discharge optimisation and measurable sustainability outcomes.

Develop and implement a water stewardship framework that aligns site-level water decisions with regional sustainability objectives, local catchment conditions, stakeholder expectations and long-term operational resilience.

Establish governance, performance metrics and reporting cadence for water usage, metering, efficiency, risk management and delivery performance across the portfolio.

Influence design, site selection, development, commercial and operations decisions to ensure water strategy is embedded into major business and customer commitments.

Your Day to Day

Lead a team of managers, setting priorities, removing barriers, allocating resources and ensuring consistent delivery across markets and projects.

Represent AirTrunk with senior utility, government, customer and strategic partner stakeholders to shape water supply, infrastructure and sustainability outcomes.

Provide executive oversight of water projects, including supply connections and upgrades, infrastructure investments, commercial contracts, risk mitigation and delivery milestones.

Partner with customers at senior levels to understand water requirements, influence commitments and ensure AirTrunk’s water strategy supports customer growth and sustainability expectations.

Translate water sustainability strategy into practical implementation plans, including recycled water adoption, water reuse, efficiency initiatives, catchment partnerships, performance targets and transparent reporting.

Work with Design, Site Selection, Development, Commercial and Operations leaders to align water decisions with business strategy, technical requirements and long-term operating performance.

Prepare and present executive-level recommendations, investment papers, governance updates and performance reports for senior leadership forums.

Establish operating rhythms for the team, including portfolio reviews, cross-functional escalation, performance tracking and continuous improvement of water strategy delivery.

Requirements

Minimally 10 years of relevant experience e.g. water utilities, water project development and delivery, water sustainability water infrastructure services, water consulting, water treatment and recycled water, etc.

Strong understanding of the water supply landscape in several of our Asia-Pacific and Japan markets (including Singapore, Malaysia, Australia, Hong Kong and Japan)

Strong expertise in water supply design principles and various water technologies such as water treatment/recycling/recovery/capture

Relationships and networks in the water industry in the above markets

Strong analytical thinking and comfortable with data analysis and presentation (especially in PowerPoint and Excel)

Provide leadership, mentoring, and technical guidance to the regional team.

Demonstrated experience leading multiple concurrent large-scale projects or programs.

Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, leadership, and problem-solving skills. Ie. Build and maintain strong working relationships with consultants, contractors, suppliers, customer representatives, and internal stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to Grow@Hyperscale.

title: Sales Manager Asia
description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors.
