Context (challenges, specific issues):

The position is based in Singapore with regional responsibility across Asia.
Responsible for developing business in diverse Asian markets, each with different customer requirements, competitive environments, procurement practices and regulatory considerations.
Requires effective navigation of the Business Line/DGDI matrix organisation, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders across organisations without direct hierarchical authority.
Requires the ability to identify, shape and capture opportunities at an early stage and translate customer needs into viable business opportunities for Thales.
Requires strong commercial judgement, customer relationship skills and the ability to manage complex, long-cycle opportunities involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.
Requires the ability to operate effectively in a multi-cultural environment and to engage confidently with senior customers, government stakeholders, partners and industry leaders.

Missions and responsibilities:

Regional Sales Development

Own and drive sales activities (with Sales Consultants) for opportunities across Asia, in alignment with Business Line strategy.
Take ownership of key opportunities from early identification and qualification through capture, bid, negotiation and contract award.
Develop and maintain clear opportunity/sales strategies & plans, capture plans, win themes, stakeholder maps and customer engagement strategies for strategic pursuits to achieve Order Intake and growth objectives.
Apply left-shift principles to shape opportunities early and influence customer requirements, procurement strategies, solution definition and partner ecosystems.
Build, maintain and continuously develop a strong and clear opportunities pipeline by identifying new customers, markets, opportunities and business models.
Qualify and prioritise opportunities based on strategic value, probability of success, competitive position and required resources.
Lead commercial engagement and negotiations within delegated authority and in accordance with Thales governance requirements.
Contribute directly to the achievement of regional Order Intake, pipeline and business objectives.

Customer & Market Engagement

Establish and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders across Air Navigation Service Providers (ANSPs), aviation authorities, airports, airlines, government agencies and other relevant aviation and industry organisations.
Lead customer engagements, meetings and presentations for assigned opportunities and represent the AMS Business Line at an appropriate senior level.
Develop a strong understanding of customer strategies, operational requirements, procurement priorities and decision-making processes, translating customer insight into actionable business opportunities.
Work closely with Country Directors and Key Account Managers to ensure coordinated and effective customer engagement.
Build and maintain a strong network across aviation, government, industry, suppliers, technology partners and academic institutions.
Provide market intelligence and competitive insight to support regional strategy, opportunity positioning and Business Line decision-making.

Opportunity Capture, Bid & Negotiation

Lead or co-lead capture activities for strategically important opportunities, coordinating Business Line, country and functional stakeholders.
Develop and maintain capture plans, opportunity strategies, customer engagement plans and competitive positioning.
Work closely with Bid Management, Engineering, Product Management, Finance, Legal, Contracts, Procurement and other stakeholders to develop compelling, competitive and commercially sound offers.
Ensure appropriate governance, quality, commercial discipline and adherence to critical timelines throughout the opportunity lifecycle.
Identify key risks, dependencies and resource requirements at an early stage and escalate appropriately to the Regional Sales Director and relevant Business Line management.
Develop and manage strategic partnerships and local industrial relationships, in cooperation with DGDI Country organisations, to strengthen Thales' competitive position and probability of success.

Business Line / DGDI Matrix Collaboration

Develop effective working relationships with the DGDI Country organisation to align Business Line opportunities with country strategies and priorities.
Work closely with Country Directors and local teams to coordinate customer engagement, opportunity development, partnerships and market access.
Ensure appropriate alignment of roles, responsibilities and priorities between the Business Line and DGDI Country organisations throughout the sales and capture lifecycle.
Influence and mobilise stakeholders across the matrix to achieve common business objectives without relying on hierarchical authority.
Facilitate effective sharing of customer insight, market intelligence, opportunity strategies and best practices across the relevant organisations.
Identify opportunities for collaboration with other Thales Business Lines where this can strengthen customer value propositions and create additional business opportunities.

Pipeline, Forecasting & Commercial Performance

Own the quality, accuracy and development of the assigned regional sales pipeline.
Ensure opportunities are properly qualified, prioritised and regularly updated in accordance with Thales processes.
Provide regular pipeline reviews, sales forecasts, opportunity assessments and business updates to the Regional Sales Director and relevant Business Line management.
Monitor performance against Order Intake, pipeline and business objectives and proactively develop corrective actions where required.
Ensure sales activities and opportunity development remain aligned with Business Line strategic priorities and relevant country business plans.
Maintain appropriate commercial discipline throughout the sales process, including accurate forecasting, opportunity qualification and reporting.

Compliance, Ethics & Integrity

Conduct all sales, business development, customer engagement and commercial activities in full accordance with Thales compliance policies, procedures, ethical standards, integrity principles and applicable laws and regulations.
Ensure that commercial objectives are pursued within the compliance and ethical boundaries established by Thales, without compromising the company's integrity standards.
Exercise sound judgement in identifying potential compliance, ethical or integrity risks and ensure that such matters are appropriately raised and escalated through the established Thales processes.
Ensure that relationships with customers, partners, suppliers and other external stakeholders are managed in accordance with applicable Thales policies and governance requirements.
Maintain a strong culture of integrity and responsible business conduct throughout all opportunity and customer activities.

Strategic Partnerships & Business Development

Identify, assess and develop strategic partnerships, alliances and local industrial relationships that can strengthen Thales' market position and support business growth.
Work with DGDI Country organisations and Business Line stakeholders to develop sustainable ecosystems around strategic opportunities.
Identify new markets, adjacent opportunities and longer-term growth opportunities for Airspace Mobility Solutions in Asia.

Develop relationships with key industry, government, technology and institutional stakeholders that can support future business development.

Marketing & Market Development

Represent Airspace Mobility Solutions at selected industry, government and customer events across the region.
Support and, where appropriate, lead customer workshops, seminars, demonstrations, presentations and other market-development activities.
Provide market and customer insight to regional marketing and business development activities.
Contribute to positioning Thales as a leading technology and business partner within the regional aviation ecosystem.

Requirement :

Required Education/Certificate:

University Degree in Aeronautics, Electronics Engineering, Business or a related discipline.
Additional qualifications in business, sales, strategy or a relevant technical discipline would be advantageous.

Working Experience:

Typically 10+ years of relevant sales, business development, capture or commercial experience, preferably within the aviation, aerospace, defense or related high-technology sector.
Proven experience in managing complex B2B and/or government opportunities involving long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders.
Experience working with ANSPs, aviation authorities, airports, airlines, government agencies or other major aviation stakeholders is highly desirable.
Strong knowledge of the Air Traffic Management / Airspace Mobility / Surveillance industry is highly preferred.
Demonstrated track record of developing and converting significant business opportunities and delivering measurable commercial results.
Experience working successfully within a matrix organisation and across multiple countries and cultures.
Experience in strategic account development, opportunity capture, complex bid management and commercial negotiation.
Proven ability to establish and maintain relationships with senior customer and government stakeholders.

Personnel Skills:

Strong commercial acumen with a strategic business development mindset.
Demonstrated ability to own opportunities, influence stakeholders and deliver measurable business results.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills.
Strong influencing and stakeholder-management capability, particularly within a matrix organisation.
Ability to develop compelling opportunity strategies and competitive positioning.
Strong analytical capability and commercial judgement, with the ability to assess opportunities, risks and priorities.
Able to operate effectively at both strategic and operational levels.
Proactive, entrepreneurial and results-oriented approach to business development.
Strong collaboration skills and ability to mobilise diverse internal and external stakeholders towards common objectives.
Comfortable operating in complex, ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.
Strong cultural awareness and ability to work effectively across diverse Asian markets.
Demonstrates high standards of personal integrity and sound judgement, with the ability to balance commercial objectives with Thales' compliance, ethical and integrity requirements.
Strong commitment to Thales governance, compliance and responsible business practices.

Other:

Willingness to travel extensively across Asia and, where required, internationally.
Able to manage multiple strategic opportunities simultaneously and operate effectively under pressure.
Ability to represent Thales professionally with senior customers, government stakeholders, partners and industry leaders.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: #EG Client Services Lead
description:
Date: 2026-10-19

Location: Singapore, , Singapore

Company: NCS

Job Requisition ID: Evergreen

Company Description

NCS is a leading AI Tech Services company. With a 15,000-strong team across the Asia Pacific, NCS scales its platforms and capabilities to provide clients with greater agility and AI expertise across a range of Industries. Embracing a strong ecosystem of global partners, NCS transforms technology services delivery combining AI with digital resilience to drive real business impact. NCS is a subsidiary of the Singtel Group.

Job Description

As a Client Services Lead (CSL), your mandate is to drive sales through a close partnership and co-creation with key clients and to ensure that what is sold is delivered with high quality and on time on budget.

The CSL has 3 key mandates:

partner and co-create with clients through a consulting approach
drive sales, and
ensure quality delivery

Core to this is the ability of the CSL to engage the clients C-suite to help them solve biz problems, ideate their digitalisation roadmap and help clients seize biz opportunities through the use of technology. All these requires the CSL to have strong consulting abilities.

The role of Client Service Lead (CSL) acts as a leading role in designated key client accounts to build trusted business relationship. As a consultant to the client, this role requires the individual to have expertise and unique knowledge in the client’s business and operating industry, to create differentiated and tailored value prepositions for the key client accounts. This will be in Digital Organisation Design, Digital Strategic and Master Planning, Business Case Development, etc. His/Her work will require close client engagement and interaction and he/she will need to have the right mix of strong domain and industrial knowledge, so that he/she understands the complex business needs of key clients and is able to analyse their needs. Through this, the CSL performs his/her role as a consultant to help the key client achieve its business growth while concurrently acting as a business operator for NCS to grow the client account in a profitable manner. This role is integral to sustaining and growing NCS’ core business.

He/She will lead a client account team which comprises of a Delivery Lead and a Sales Lead. For this, the CSL will be supported by a consulting team and other key staff who are experts in their respective digital, products and platforms fields.

What will you do?

Responsible for managing a profitable key client account(s)
Responsible for developing and operationalising account(s) growth plans for key client account(s)
Act as a consultant to clients and be responsible for achieving high client satisfaction score through a deep understanding of business needs via close client engagement and interaction
Responsible for developing and maintaining deep key client relationships
Responsible for developing a point of view or thought leadership once a year to strengthen NCS brand position in the market place.
Responsible for ideation with client to lead to opportunity originations

Qualifications

The ideal candidate should possess:

15 years or more in IT or ICT Consulting industry is a plus
Strong leadership experiences
Able to be a strong consulting practitioner
Ability to architect value
Has good sales and business acumen
Good Communication and interpersonal skills
Good in managing large, diverse and complex teams
Understand and ability to apply social styles technique to manage stakeholders

Additional Information

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

Scam Alert

We are aware of fraudulent job offers and impersonations of NCS recruiters. Phishing emails using convincing-looking but fake addresses are also commonly used to trick you into thinking that they come from official NCS sources.

Please note that all official communications from NCS Group will only be sent from verified corporate email addresses. Always check that the sender’s email address ends with the genuine NCS domain, @ncs.com.sg and beware of extra letters, symbols or misspellings. When in doubt, verify the sender’s identity by contacting us at reachus@ncs.com.sg.

title: Regional Director, Business Development, APAC
company: Crane Worldwide Logistics S Pte Ltd
description:
General Description

The Regional Director, Business Development, APAC is a senior individual contributor responsible for identifying, developing and securing new business opportunities across the Asia Pacific region.

Based in Singapore, the role will lead regional and cross-border commercial opportunities, develop relationships with multinational and regional customers, and deliver agreed revenue and gross-profit targets across air freight, ocean freight and related logistics services.

The position will work closely with country management, sales, pricing, product, operations and account-management teams to develop commercially competitive and operationally viable solutions. Although the role does not have direct reports, it is expected to provide commercial leadership and coordinate cross-functional pursuit teams across the region.

Essential Job Functions

Regional Business Development Strategy

Develop and execute business development plans aligned with the company’s APAC growth priorities.
Identify target markets, industry sectors and prospective regional or multinational customers.
Maintain awareness of market developments, competitor activity and regulatory changes that may affect commercial opportunities.
Provide market intelligence and recommendations to regional and country leadership.

Market Expansion and Client Acquisition

Identify, qualify and develop new business opportunities across assigned APAC markets, customer segments or industry verticals.
Build and maintain relationships with senior decision-makers within multinational corporations, regional companies and other prospective customers.
Lead the end-to-end sales process, including prospecting, needs assessment, solution development, proposal preparation, commercial negotiation and closing.
Develop tailored freight-forwarding and logistics solutions that meet customer requirements while delivering sustainable revenue and gross profit.
Maintain an active and credible pipeline sufficient to achieve agreed annual new-business targets.

Regional Opportunity Leadership

Coordinate regional and cross-border opportunities involving multiple Crane offices, products and functional teams.
Lead virtual pursuit teams comprising sales, pricing, operations, product and implementation stakeholders.
Establish clear ownership, timelines and deliverables for regional tenders, requests for proposals and other complex commercial opportunities.
Ensure appropriate handover of newly secured business to implementation, operations and account-management teams.
Support alignment on customer ownership and opportunity management to minimise overlap between regional and country commercial teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with country management, product, pricing, operations, account management and customer-service teams to develop commercially viable solutions.
Influence internal stakeholders without direct reporting authority to ensure timely and effective execution of commercial opportunities.
Share market intelligence, customer feedback and commercial best practices across the APAC region.
Support customer-retention and growth initiatives where regional business development involvement is required.

Commercial Negotiation and Partnerships

Lead commercial negotiations for significant regional and cross-border business opportunities within the appropriate approval authority.
Work with internal product teams to develop competitive and sustainable service solutions.
Identify potential commercial partnerships that may strengthen Crane’s service capabilities or market access.
Ensure that commercial commitments are appropriately reviewed and approved before being presented to customers.

Revenue Management and Reporting

Be accountable for agreed annual new-business revenue and gross-profit targets.
Maintain accurate opportunity, pipeline and forecast information within the company’s CRM and commercial reporting systems.
Monitor conversion rates, revenue performance, gross profit and other relevant commercial indicators.
Provide regular updates to regional leadership regarding pipeline development, business wins, risks and forecast performance.
Analyse market and customer information to support pricing decisions and commercial strategy.

Compliance and Operational Excellence

Maintain current knowledge of international trade regulations, customs requirements and relevant compliance obligations.
Ensure that proposed solutions and commercial commitments comply with company policies, approval requirements and applicable regulations.
Work with operations and product teams to confirm that proposed services are operationally viable and can be delivered consistently.
Promote appropriate service standards and customer-experience expectations throughout the business-development and implementation process.

Physical Requirements

Ability to communicate effectively in person, virtually and through written correspondence with internal and external stakeholders.
Ability to perform computer-based work for extended periods using standard office equipment and systems.
Sufficient visual ability to review detailed documents, commercial reports, presentations and digital information.
Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally for customer meetings, regional collaboration, industry events and other business requirements.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

Other Skills / Abilities

Strong knowledge of freight forwarding, including air freight, ocean freight and related supply-chain services.
Demonstrated ability to originate, develop and close complex business opportunities.
Strong commercial judgement, including understanding of revenue, gross profit, pricing and solution viability.
Ability to manage regional and cross-border sales opportunities involving multiple stakeholders and countries.
Strong influencing and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills.
Strong analytical ability and proficiency in CRM systems, Microsoft Office and relevant logistics or commercial platforms.
Ability to work independently and effectively within a fast-paced, competitive and geographically dispersed environment.
Fluency in English is preferred due to the regional responsibilities of the role.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in business, logistics, supply-chain management, international trade or a related discipline is preferred.
At least 10 to 12 years of relevant commercial or business-development experience within freight forwarding, logistics, transportation or supply-chain services.
At least five years of experience managing complex, regional or multinational business opportunities.
Demonstrated record of achieving revenue and gross-profit targets and securing significant new customers.
Experience developing business across multiple APAC markets is strongly preferred.
Proven experience negotiating commercial agreements and presenting solutions to senior customer stakeholders.
Previous experience in a senior individual-contributor, regional business-development or external Director-level role would be advantageous.

Certifications And Licenses

Relevant professional qualifications in logistics, supply-chain management, sales or international trade would be advantageous.

Develop and manage strategic technology partnerships, with particular focus on Zscaler.

Maintain alignment with partner product strategies, technology roadmaps and emerging capabilities.

Translate new partner technologies into commercially viable Singtel products and managed services.

Drive co-innovation and joint solution development with strategic partners.

Combine partner capabilities with Singtel’s strengths in connectivity, mobility, managed services and Cybersecurity operations.

Manage joint business planning, roadmap alignment, commercial optimisation, sales enablement, pipeline development and joint GTM initiatives.

Engage emerging technology and ecosystem partners where appropriate to address portfolio gaps and new opportunities.

Act as the central product owner across Singtel’s commercial, technical and operational teams.

Work closely with Sales, Product Specialists, Engineering, Operations, Service Delivery, Marketing, Commercial, Finance, Legal and strategic partners.

Establish clear product objectives, priorities, responsibilities, timelines and success measures.

Coordinate stakeholders throughout the complete product lifecycle.

Bring together capabilities across Cybersecurity, networking, mobility, cloud and managed services to develop integrated solutions.

Identify and resolve technical, commercial, operational and organisational dependencies.

Ensure products are technically viable, commercially competitive, operationally scalable and ready for customer adoption.

Monitor market trends, customer priorities, competitive developments, regulatory changes and emerging technologies.

Anticipate emerging security challenges and identify new growth opportunities ahead of market demand.

Degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science and AI, or equivalent.

title: Flint Asia-Pacific Technology Manager / Associate Director
description:
We are looking for a 

Manager

or

Associate Director

with experience in

technology policy

to support the delivery of client work and business development work across our fast-growing

Asia-Pacific

team based in

Singapore

.

You will work closely with team members to support our technology sector clients on public policy, regulation, politics, and commercial strategy.

Tech firms face a challenging policy and regulatory environment across Asia-Pacific. Geopolitical tensions, rapid evolutions in technology, and governments’ ambitions to increase regulatory control all affect how tech firms can build and operate successful businesses in the region. We are helping the world’s leading tech firms navigate cutting-edge policy, regulatory, and geopolitical issues across Asia-Pacific and effectively engage with governments and regulators.

You will have scope to engage with clients at the most senior levels. The role will provide an unparalleled opportunity to research and analyse the complex policy challenges our clients face and develop options and approaches to address those challenges, backing up recommendations with wider strategic and political analysis.

Flint provides an excellent professional and educational environment for people to accelerate their personal and career development. There will be space to engage in discussion and debates on substantive policy and political challenges, as well as significant scope for progression through the company.

You will join a rapidly growing team, with the opportunity to take ownership of tasks and contribute to the company’s growth in the region.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for candidates who have

experience

relevant to

technology policy

, particularly in

but not limited to

AI policy and regulation, online safety, data governance, data centres, and competition in digital markets.

We welcome any candidates with experience working for government departments or regulators. We are also open to candidates from commercial backgrounds, including in-house policy roles in industry or experience in other consulting firms, with a keen interest in politics, policy and regulation. For

Manager / Associate Director level

roles, we will consider candidates with a range of experience - from

4 - 9 years’ work experience –

though this is a

g

uide only and we will consider applications on a case-by-case basis.

Our ideal candidate will have:

Strong experience in technology policy fields – this might include one or several of AI policy and regulation, online safety, data governance, data centres, competition in digital markets, and telecommunications.

A professional background in government, a regulator, consultancy, think tank, or industry body in managerial positions.

A proven track record of managing projects and teams in fast-paced, delivery-focused environments.

Excellent analytical, research and problem-solving skills - the ability to quickly dive into new topics and draw out the implications of complex evidence to give clear strategy and policy advice.

Strong interpersonal skills – a flexible approach and the ability to work well across teams, both with colleagues and clients.

Commercial acumen, with the ability to identify new business opportunities and deliver commercially viable solutions to clients.

Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise advice to stakeholders, both in written and verbal form.

(desirable but not required) Connections to government officials and/or regulators working on technology-related policy in at least one Asia-Pacific country or multilateral grouping.

TO APPLY

To be successful, please submit your

CV

with a short

cover letter

(max 600 words) by

Friday 30 October

.

STANDINGOUT

To be successful, please submit your CV and cover letter setting out:

Why you would like to join Flint.

How your experience and skills qualify you for this specific role and its requirements.

The policy areas you are knowledgeable of and/or particularly interested in.

Whether you have the right to work in Singapore.

Your possible start date and salary expectation.

We will

review applications as they arrive

and may invite candidates to interview before the closing date.

ABOUTFLINT

Flint is a leading global strategy consultancy with a focus on policy, politics, regulation, and economics. We are advisers to some of the largest corporates, financial institutions, and investors in Europe and the Asia-Pacific. We work at the point where government and business meet, drawing on our blend of international expertise and experience to offer an authoritative perspective on both.

We have offices in London, Brussels, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Melbourne, as well as in a number of European capitals. We have also established a network of senior advisers across key Asia-Pacific markets. We offer successful candidates the opportunity to advance within the company.

Flint takes care of its people. We enjoy challenging each other’s thinking and working hard on a wide variety of interesting and stimulating projects, while simultaneously respecting life outside Flint. We offer a flexible working environment with global health insurance coverage and 25 days of holiday accrued from your start date.

We are committed to equality of opportunity for all staff and applications from individuals are encouraged regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships.

title: Assistant Commissioning Manager
description:
1. JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title

Assistant Commissioning Manager

Occupation

ENGINEER

Job Description & Requirements

We are looking for a Assistant Commissioning Manager to be responsible for project delivery and work closely with the commissioning team in site operations. The role supports project progression, ensuring expectations, procedures, and deadlines are met. More senior candidates will be considered as Commissioning Manager.

JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

-

Assist Managers in ensuring the successful implementation of projects.

- Undertake all testing and commissioning activities from factory tests to integrated systems tests in the final stage of projects.

- Monitor site progress and coordinate site meetings.

- Attend site meetings and address technical queries from clients.

- Review and track vendor responses and method statements.

- Witness contractor testing and commissioning results and confirm compliance.

- Handle project administration and documentation tasks.

- Support HS&E compliance through PPE use, hazard reporting, documentation assistance, and safe work practices.

- Manage project administration and documentation

REQUIREMENTS AND SKILLS

- Degree in Electrical Engineering is preferred but will consider Mechanical and Building Services Engineering or related discipline in engineering

- Have the right to work in Singapore

- Comfortable to work on-site

- Relevant working experience in MEP systems, building services coordination and/or testing & commissioning process with multi-national corporate exposure

- Hands-on knowledge of PC applications such as MSOffice, MS Project, AutoCAD, Revit

- Good command of written and spoken English and detail oriented

- Reliable and proactive working attitude not afraid to make decisions

- Self-motivated and believe in continuous improvement

- Can manage their time effectively, drive results, building trust and positive partnerships

- Good communication / interpersonal and negotiation skills to handle all stakeholders

Who We Are

At Commtech Asia (cta), our teams are dedicated to delivering intelligent solutions leading to high functioning and integrated built environments. Our extensive network allows our customers to benefit from our proven methodologies, and understanding of local markets, throughout the Asia Pacific region.

Our people are specialist engineers with multi-disciplinary expertise and unrivalled experience, driven with a vision to be the leader in the provision of Commissioning Management and Technical services delivering spaces with exceptional intelligence.

Our Vision

“Building confidence in reliability, safety and sustainability for a better future.”

Our vision statement gives us a sense of purpose and it is why we come to work each day. We understand that building confidence is not only about meeting industry benchmarks but also about surpassing expectations. We constantly strive to raise the bar and set new standards for reliability, safety, and sustainability

Our Mission

“To create a positive employment environment and culture that inspires talented professionals to form high-performing teams, delivering solutions that engineer confidence in buildings.”

We aim to create a positive, inclusive, and supportive work environment that inspires talented professionals, encourages growth, and produces high-performing teams, passionate about service delivery.

Our focus on continuous development ensures that employees reach their full potential, enabling us to deliver exceptional services and innovative solutions to create smart, efficient spaces for a better future.

Our History

From our humble beginnings in 1980 – to establishing our Asia operations in 1999, we have built an unrivalled team of specialist engineers and technical experts and are continually evolving to respond to meet tomorrow’s challenges.

Our early years were led by a handful of passionate engineers, who shared a vision to provide a truly independent service for the commissioning of buildings .

Today, as a market leader, we continue to provide exceptional-quality service in the industry. From Hong Kong to Tokyo and Sydney to Manila, we are focused on delivering independent commissioning management services and integrated project solutions for properties, facilities, and developments.

title: Brand Manager - Fancy Feast
description:

3-5 years experience in marketing and/or generating demand functions at Nestlé or equivalent FMCG
Experience working in cross functional teams
Successful experience in project management.
Successful experience in achieving goals through working with others (ie not sole contributor).
Experience leading a complex portfolio, owning a Brand Plan and budget, and influencing senior stakeholders in ambiguity.
Brief writing, agency management, and successful creative campaign execution.

title: Corporate Solutions Consultant (Client Solutions)
description:
*Corporate Solutions Consultant (Client Solutions)*
_at Singapore's AI and technology training provider_
*Full-time | Singapore | Corporate Solutions | Onsite*

*The opportunity*

Our company is solving some of the most difficult issues in Singapore - workforce transformation. At Vertical Institute, we sit at the centre of that shift. As Singapore's leading AI and technology training provider, we work with enterprises, government agencies, and leading corporations to build the capabilities their people need to compete in an AI-driven world. * Conduct structured training needs analyses to identify business challenges and translate them into practical learning objectives.
* Design and present tailored learning proposals that align with each client's business goals and workforce development priorities.

* Develop strategic partnerships with existing clients to identify opportunities for account growth and repeat business.
* Collaborate closely with internal programme delivery teams to ensure successful implementation and positive client outcomes.
* Maintain regular engagement with key stakeholders to strengthen client satisfaction and retention.

* Manage sales activities across calls, meetings, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and CRM platforms to ensure consistent follow-up.
* Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, forecast opportunities, and prioritise high-value prospects.
* Achieve and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets while maintaining a high standard of client experience.

*What we're looking for*

* Experience in B2B solution selling, consultative sales, business development, account management, or client advisory roles.
* Background in technology, education, HR, professional services, consulting, SaaS, or related industries is highly advantageous.
* Proven ability to manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation, and closing.
* Comfortable engaging senior stakeholders, including C-suite executives, HR leaders, business owners, and department heads.
* Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to uncover business needs and recommend value-driven solutions.

title: Account Manager
description:
About OpenTable

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You'll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

The Position

We are seeking an Account Manager who will be responsible for leading customer retention and revenue growth within your territory of restaurants. This position will report to the District Manager.

You will be in tune with the local restaurant industry and will proactively engage with our restaurant customers. You will be innovative in overcoming customer obstacles, and provide constructive perspectives to challenge current thinking. In This Role, You Will

Work closely with customers to increase product and feature adoption, improve their online availability and ultimately grow their business through our partnership.

Become a trusted adviser to our customers and influencing an ongoing retention of their business with us.

Maintain an experienced level of understanding of all products and services that OpenTable offers.

Proactively incorporate company strategies into your work and constantly be on the lookout for opportunities to increase your impact with customers.

Share and implement standard methodologies with members of the sales and restaurant relations team.

Be highly visible and frequently face-to-face with our customers in the field.

Stay current with organisational changes, initiatives, and vision.

Work collaboratively with colleagues and key internal stakeholders.

Please Apply If

You are passionate about hospitality and technology. Restaurant management and/or sales experience in the food and beverage industry is preferred but not essential.

You are curious, humble and have an eagerness to learn.

You are able to effectively influence and use data to guide your decisions.

You're self-motivated and have the grit necessary to thrive against ambitious expectations.

You naturally communicate well, and can establish trust with people genuinely and quickly.

You are comfortable working in an unstructured and forward-thinking environment.

You are an empathetic, team-orientated sales person who loves to collaborate and grow through learning and feedback.

You are proficient in use of Google Suite and Salesforce CRM.

Benefits

Work from (almost) anywhere now, hybrid in the near future.

1 floating day off per year to celebrate your birthday or another occasion of your choice!

Ongoing Learning and Development opportunities.

Universal Paid Parental leave.

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion

We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, or on the job, we're here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

title: Wellness Education Specialist
description:
*Job Title: *Education & Customer Success Specialist

*Location: *Singapore

*Employment Type:* Full-Time

*Reports To:* Country Manager

*Salary Range: *SGD6,500 - SGD7,500

*Job Highlights:*

* Be part of a *global leading wellness brand*, *Technogym*, that powers *Olympic athletes* and is trusted by luxury gyms, health clubs, and elite sports teams worldwide.
* Be part of a *high performing team* that *challenges individual growth *while continuously innovating in the fitness and wellness industry.
* Get *complimentary access* to our *Technogym showroom equipment *for personal training and workouts as part of your employee benefits.

*About the Company*
*SE Active* is the exclusive partner for *Technogym* in Singapore & Malaysia, managing everything from equipment sales to after-sales services and warranty protection. SE Active aims to be the market leader in offering total wellness solutions in both countries, with a customer-first approach to meet fitness and wellness needs. The company's focus is on growing the brand's presence and anchoring market dominance while providing the Technogym experience by embodying its core values.

*About Technogym*

For more than 40 years, we at *Technogym* have been helping people live healthier and happier lives. If 50 million people in the world train on our equipment every day, it’s not just a matter of chance. We are the global experts of wellness, be it for fitness, health, or sports. Reaching over 100 countries in the world, Technogym has brought wellness through movement to thousands of locations around the world. Technogym produces top-notch fitness equipment found in luxury property gyms and has been the Official Supplier of the Olympic Games for ten consecutive editions, from Sydney 2000 to Milano Cortina 2026, supporting Olympic athletes in their quest for excellence.

*Job Overview:*

As an Education & Customer Success Specialist, you will play a key role in elevating Technogym’s brand experience through impactful education, customer engagement, training excellence, and relationship management. You will work closely with internal teams, partners, trainers, and customers to drive product adoption, customer satisfaction, and long-term engagement with Technogym’s wellness ecosystem.

This role combines elements of wellness education, customer success, account support, coaching, community engagement, and event coordination. You will empower internal teams, B2B partners, and end consumers with in-depth product knowledge and training support, while also building strong customer relationships and a network of certified personal trainers and wellness advocates.

You will serve as a key point of contact in ensuring customers receive a seamless experience throughout their journey — from onboarding and training to ongoing engagement and retention. Through proactive support, product education, and community activation initiatives, you will help customers maximize the value of Technogym solutions while strengthening brand loyalty and advocacy.

The ideal candidate is passionate about fitness, wellness, and customer experience, with strong communication and interpersonal skills. You are a confident trainer and relationship builder who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys engaging with diverse audiences, and is committed to delivering exceptional education and customer experiences across markets.

*Responsibilities:*

*1. Internal Product Education & Sales Enablement*

* Lead ongoing product education and training initiatives for the sales team throughout the year.
* Ensure all sales team members complete Technogym’s product storytelling assessments and maintain a minimum performance score across all products.
* Identify underperforming team members and conduct targeted coaching and training sessions to strengthen product knowledge and storytelling capabilities.
* Maintain a minimum personal product knowledge rating, as assessed by the Regional Education & Training Manager, to qualify for delivering storytelling assessments.
* Develop and update training materials, user guides, and educational resources to support internal product learning and customer engagement.

*2. Customer Onboarding, Training & Success Management*

* Support the onboarding of new customers by guiding them through product setup, training, and adoption to ensure a smooth customer experience.
* Conduct quarterly product refresher trainings and ongoing educational sessions for key account clients in collaboration with their internal training managers.
* Coordinate and deliver on-site product training during new equipment installations, ensuring all facility staff receive relevant training materials via the Technogym Trainer Portal.
* Facilitate post-delivery product education sessions for home customers. Where required, coordinate with certified freelance personal trainers from the Technogym training network to deliver training sessions.
* Create and implement customer success plans that outline customer goals, milestones, adoption strategies, and engagement initiatives.
* Educate customers on product features, capabilities, and best practices to maximize product utilization and long-term value.

*3. Customer Relationship Management & Retention*

* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers to understand their operational needs, business goals, and challenges.
* Proactively engage customers through various communication channels to monitor satisfaction, gather feedback, and support ongoing success.
* Monitor customer usage and adoption trends to identify at-risk accounts and implement retention strategies.
* Support account management activities, including license renewals to drive customer retention and long-term account success.
* Address customer concerns, issues, and escalations promptly while coordinating with internal stakeholders to ensure effective resolution.
* Identify and develop customer advocates for testimonials, referrals, case studies, and community engagement opportunities.

*4. Trainer Network Development*

* Expand and manage the Technogym-certified personal trainer network through onboarding, certification, and ongoing engagement initiatives.
* Ensure certified trainers remain up to date with the latest Technogym products, training methodologies, and wellness solutions.
* Maintain the quality and consistency of training standards through regular assessments, refresher programs, and recertification initiatives.

*5. Community Engagement & Wellness Events*

* Collaborate with frontline managers and the marketing team to identify and engage relevant fitness and wellness communities.
* Establish partnerships with coaches, medical professionals, wellness experts, influencers, and other industry stakeholders to support wellness initiatives and community outreach.
* Plan and execute community-focused events, workshops, clinics, and wellness activations with clearly defined KPIs to measure engagement and impact.
* Represent Technogym as a wellness and product ambassador during events, training sessions, and customer engagements.

*6. Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement*

* Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer satisfaction, training effectiveness, customer retention, engagement, and revenue growth.
* Collect and analyze customer feedback to identify trends, areas for improvement, and opportunities to enhance the customer experience.
* Work closely with sales, marketing, after-sales, and regional teams to ensure a seamless and consistent customer journey.
* Stay updated on industry trends, customer success best practices, and Technogym product developments to continuously improve training delivery and customer engagement strategies.

*Requirements:*

* *Bachelor’s degree* in Sports Science, Exercise Physiology, or a related field.
* *5–7 years of experience *in fitness education, personal training, customer success, business development, consultancy, or a similar client-facing role.
* *Strong presentation and training delivery skills* — able to engage, educate, and inspire diverse audiences including sales teams, fitness professionals, and customers.
* Proven experience in *conducting workshops, seminars, or product training sessions* in a professional setting.
* Ability to *build rapport and credibility* quickly with internal stakeholders (e.g., sales team) and external clients.
* *Confident and polished communicator* with excellent interpersonal skills and professional presence.
* Comfortable working *independently and cross-functionally*, with strong organizational and time management skills.
* Tech-savvy with the ability to *navigate digital platforms* for training, communication, and certification delivery.
* Passionate about *fitness, wellness, and the Technogym philosophy* of lifestyle transformation through movement.
* Certification as a *personal trainer or fitness instructor* (e.g., ACE, NASM, NSCA) is a strong advantage.
* Prior experience in a *premium brand environment* or wellness tech company is a plus.
* Proven ability in *customer success*, account management, consultancy, business development, or pre-sales support roles preferred.
* Strong *customer-centric mindset* with a focus on onboarding, engagement, retention, and long-term relationship building preferred.

*Alignment with our Core Values:*

title: AVP, Compliance Manager, International Oversight
description:
WHO WE ARE:

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

 Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

 We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

Why join

Step into a pivotal role where your expertise contributes directly to strengthening the Group's financial crime risk management framework across our international network. As the Group Oversight Specialist, supporting oversight of the Bank of Singapore (BOS) Branches, Affiliates, Representative Offices and Subsidiaries (BAROS), you will navigate complex regulatory environments while partnering with diverse stakeholders across Group OCBC. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain broad regional exposure, deepen your financial crime compliance expertise, and contribute to the consistent application of Group standards, helping to safeguard the Bank's reputation as a trusted and compliant financial institution.

How you succeed

You will excel in this role if you are able to work effectively across multiple markets, build strong partnerships and provide clear, practical compliance advice. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and a solid understanding of financial crime risks are essential. By staying abreast of regulatory developments and emerging threats, you will help identify and mitigate risks, address audit and regulatory findings, and collaborate with stakeholders to strengthen the Bank’s financial crime control framework and compliance culture.

What you do
Maintain compliance governance and oversight on BOS Branches, Affiliates, Representative Offices and Subsidiaries (“BAROS”).
Implement BOS Group policies and procedures to BAROS.

*Communications Executive (Compassionate Leave Cover 6 months)*

*1. JOB DESCRIPTION*

Job Title

Communications Executive (Compassionate Leave Cover 6 months)

MARKETING COMMUNICATIONS EXECUTIVE

Job Description & Requirements

We're Hiring: Communications Executive

Quintessential Education | Full-Time or Part-Time | Orchard Road, Singapore

About QE

Quintessential Education is Singapore's leading provider of pre-tertiary academic programmes (IGCSE & IB) and university admissions advisory for top-tier global universities — Ivy League, Oxbridge, and NUS/NTU/SMU. Since 2012 we have worked with more than 700 students, and most of our new families come to us through referrals. We deliver a fully integrated journey for families: academic mastery, guardianship, and university placement under one roof.

We aim to bring out the best in our students, ignite opportunities and nurture them towards success.

We are looking for committed and talented additions to our team. As an ideal candidate, you should display a proven ability to develop and maintain an environment of trust, diversity, and inclusion within the QE team. You should be able to work with the team to meet deadlines and instill a culture of continuous work improvement.

As part of the position, you will work with the founders, Ivy League and Oxbridge graduates and other high-performing teammates.

The Role

We're looking for a Communications Executive to own the day-to-day relationship between QE and our families. You'll be the first person a parent speaks to when they enquire, and the person who keeps them informed once their child is with us. That means answering enquiries every day, matching students with the right tutors and mentors, and following up with students and parents regularly so nothing slips through.

You'll also help keep our marketing materials and partner relationships in good order. We are open to full-time or part-time candidates, so tell us the arrangement that works for you.

If you're a confident communicator in both English and Mandarin\*, stay calm and warm with demanding parents, and like being the person who makes sure things actually get done — we'd love to meet you.

This is a temporary role for 6 months to cover a colleague on leave for 4-6 months. If desired, conversion to full time permanent can be discussed closer from the 5-6th month onwards.

\*As a major group of customers are from China and are only able to converse in Mandarin.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Enquiries & Enrolment

* Respond to daily parent and student enquiries via phone, WhatsApp, WeChat, and email, ideally within the same working day.
* Explain our IGCSE, IB, and admissions programmes clearly and recommend the right fit for each student.
* Match students with suitable tutors and mentors, and arrange trial lessons and consultations.
* Track every enquiry through to enrolment and follow up with families who have not yet decided.

2. Student Follow-Up & Parent Relations

* Check in regularly with enrolled students and parents on progress, attendance, and any concerns.
* Collect lesson feedback from students and tutors, and deal with issues early before they become complaints.
* Arrange class schedules, replacement lessons, and changes with tutors and families.
* Keep parents informed ahead of key moments: exam periods, predicted grades, application deadlines, and results day.
* Follow up on renewals and next-stage programmes (e.g. IGCSE to IB, IB to university applications).

3. Business Operations

* Prepare and track invoices and payments.
* Draft and manage service agreements for clients and tutors.
* Keep client records, notes, and follow-up schedules up to date.
* Keep a simple monthly record of enquiries, enrolments, and renewals for the founders.

4. Marketing & Partnerships

* Keep brochures, website content, and newsletters accurate and up to date.
* Work with design and digital marketing agencies on campaigns and collateral.
* Support parent seminars and events, including Mandarin-language sessions with our China school partners.
* Maintain relationships with partner schools, education consultants, and collaborators.

We're Looking For Someone Who:

* Has experience in a client-facing role such as education, admissions, client services, or customer service. Fresh graduates with strong communication skills are welcome to apply.
* Has excellent verbal and written communication in English and Chinese. This is required as some Chinese customers can only communicate in Chinese. Japanese and Korean are a bonus as some customers only communicate in these languages.
* Is calm, warm, and professional with high-expectation parents, and comfortable handling difficult conversations.
* Is highly organised, follows up without being reminded, and keeps clear records.
* Can manage many families and a busy inbox at the same time without losing track of details.
* Is proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), Notion or Airtable, and marketing tools (Mailchimp, Canva).
* Is comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) and light automation to streamline workflows.

Bonus If You:

* Have experience in the education, tuition, or admissions sector.
* Know the IB, IGCSE, or university application process (UK, US, or Singapore).
* Are familiar with WeChat or Xiaohongshu.

Working Hours

Location: 545 Orchard Road, #14-06/9, Singapore 238882. In Person role.

Start Date: As soon as possible

Commitment: Full-time or part-time. Propose the days and hours that suit you in your application.

* Full-time: 5-day work week, Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, 4 days in office and 1 day remote
* Part-time: Days and hours by arrangement, with enough weekday cover to keep up with daily enquiries

Salary & Benefits

* Bonuses: Additional performance and team-based bonuses apply
* Benefits Include: $500 Specialist Stipend per annum (e.g. medical or mental health support), $100 Dental Stipend per annum, $500 Personal Development Stipend per annum (for courses, books, conferences, etc.)

Send your CV and a short paragraph on why you're interested in the role to hr@qeducation.sg with the subject line: Application – Communications Executive (Full Time / Part Time)

description:
Company Description

Carousell Group is the leading recommerce group in Greater Southeast Asia on a mission to inspire the world to start selling, and to make secondhand the first choice. Founded in August 2012 in Singapore, the Group has a leading presence in eight markets under the brands Carousell, Cho Tot, Laku6, Mudah.my, OneKyat, Ox Street, and Refash, serving tens of millions of monthly active users. As a team of passionate individuals working together to solve meaningful problems, there is so much more for you to discover in a career with Carousell. Our culture is made up of hiring, developing, and promoting people who embody our values of solving problems for our users; having a mission-first mindset; being relentlessly resourceful; caring deeply; and staying humble to constantly improve. Together as an organisation, we make magic happen.

Job Description

About the role

Carousell Luxury is growing, and this role sits at the centre of it. You’ll build and run our partner network, working with professional resellers, dealers and trade partners to unlock new growth for the business.

This is a zero-to-one role with real ownership. You’ll test new commercial models, prove the numbers, and help decide what scales. You’ll work closely with Marketing, Tech, Operations, Retail, Finance and Legal.

What you’ll do

Grow our Brand Fair reseller network

Recruit and manage professional resellers to exhibit at Carousell Luxury Brand Fairs, and grow partner participation event by event
Own the event calendar: plan dates (including peak long weekends), secure venues well in advance, and make each event commercially viable

Build B2B partnerships

Develop new B2B partnerships with high-volume luxury resellers and dealers
Design partner processes end to end, working closely with Operations and Retail so they run smoothly without adding to the team’s workload
Negotiate terms, sign and manage partners, and track performance weekly
Make data-driven calls on when to scale, adjust or stop a pilot

Own the numbers

Set targets, track partner performance, and report progress to leadership every week

Qualifications

Experience in B2B partnerships, business development or wholesale, ideally in luxury, resale or retail
Strong commercial judgement: you can size a deal, negotiate terms, and know when to scale or exit a pilot
An operator’s mindset: you design processes that work on the ground
Comfortable owning targets and reporting against them weekly
Self-driven and at home in ambiguity, with a track record of building something new

Why join us

Build new partnerships and channels from the ground up, with real ownership and visibility to leadership
Work at the intersection of luxury, recommerce and marketplaces at Southeast Asia’s leading recommerce platform
A cross-functional role where your decisions directly shape how the business grows

By proceeding with your application, you are adhering to our PDPA policies. In case you are interested to know more, read about our Candidates Personal Data Privacy Statement.

Area operations responsibilities

Follow up on customer feedback and operational issues

Requirements

Diploma or degree in Business, Marketing, Hospitality or a related field

title: Sales Manager (Account Management & Business Development)
description:
Employment Type: Fulltime-Employment Type

Location: Singapore / Hybrid /Customer-facing as required

About Employing Company

HubbIT is a partner-centric Managed IT Services provider helping businesses and technology partners deliver reliable, secure, and scalable IT outcomes. The company focuses on integrated services across managed support, cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, systems, talent resourcing, circular IT, and workflow solutions. Hubb IT is built for customers and partners who require more than transactional hardware or software fulfillment; they need measurable service outcomes, strong account governance, and commercial accountability.

The Opportunity

The Sales Manager will be responsible for driving revenue growth, account expansion, and managed services adoption across new and existing customers. This role is designed for a commercially strong sales professional or technical specialist transitioning into commercial sales, with prior System Integration (SI) experience and proven capability in positioning managed services, not just hardware or software.

The ideal candidate engages business owners, IT leaders, partners, and decision-makers with confidence, translates technical requirements into business value, and manages opportunities from prospecting to closure. You are self-driven, mature, target-oriented, accountable, and comfortable operating in a growth-stage environment where accountability, pipeline discipline, and customer trust are non-negotiable.

What You Will Own

Revenue Growth & Target Ownership:

Own assigned sales and gross profit targets by driving outcome-led deals across SMEs, mid-market, enterprise, and channel-led accounts while protecting margins and recurring revenue.

Consultative Selling & Service Adoption:

Position Hubb IT's managed services, cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure, circular IT, and workflow solutions to help clients reduce operational risk and improve responsiveness.

Account Governance & Lifecycle Management:

Manage the full client relationship—from initial discovery and proposal shaping to contract negotiation, onboarding, and structured periodic account reviews.

Ecosystem & Partner Development:

Collaborate with System Integrators, MSPs, vendors, and distributors to build joint go-to-market opportunities and execute partner-led sales motions.

Pipeline Discipline & Governance:

Maintain strict CRM accuracy and actively participate in the mandatory Weekly Salamanca sales reviews to present opportunity forecasts, deal margins, and actionable next steps.

Required Experience and Competencies

Mandatory Background:

Prior experience working in or selling for a System Integrator (SI) environment is mandatory.

Managed Services Sales Experience:

Experience selling managed IT services, cybersecurity services, cloud migration, cloud operations, infrastructure support, endpoint management, backup and recovery, or helpdesk services.

Technical Domain Understanding:

Strong understanding of cloud solutions, infrastructure, systems, cybersecurity, endpoint environments, networks, servers, and service delivery models.

Account Management & Value Selling:

Good account management capability beyond one-time product transactions, with the ability to sell business outcomes rather than only hardware specifications, software features, or price discounts.

End-to-End Sales Acumen:

Strong sales acumen including prospecting, discovery, objection handling, proposal positioning, negotiation, closing, and account expansion.

Stakeholder Engagement:

Comfort engaging both business and technical stakeholders with strong communication, presentation, proposal writing, and follow-up discipline.

Execution & Reporting Hygiene:

Mandatory CRM discipline and weekly reporting discipline.

Behavioural Expectations:

Self-driven, mature, target-oriented, accountable, and comfortable working in a growth-stage environment.

Good to Have (Preferred Experience)

Business Development (Prospecting):

Proven ability to build industry networks, self-generate leads, and uncover new business opportunities across new accounts and ecosystem channels.

Established Executive Network:

Existing network across SMEs, mid-market customers, technology partners, SI/MSP ecosystem, or vendor communities.

Cross-Functional Team Collaboration:

Experience working with proposal, pre-sales, solution architect, project delivery, or service desk teams.

Framework & SLA Knowledge:

Knowledge of ITIL-aligned service delivery, service level agreements, recurring revenue models, and customer success governance.

Open to Mid-Career Switchers (Engineer/ IT Specialist to Sales)

Open to former L2 Engineers or Systems Specialists looking to transition their technical foundation into commercial sales.

Must possess excellent communication skills: interpersonal skills, active listening, and the communication confidence to engage C-suite and IT decision-makers.

What HubbIT Offers

Company Support & Upskilling:

Dedicated company support for paid professional upgrading, relevant technical certifications, and sales performance courses to sharpen your skill set.

Growth Opportunity:

Opportunity to build and scale a managed services business with strong growth ambitions.

Broad Solution Exposure:

Exposure to cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure, systems, workflow, and partner ecosystem opportunities.

Direct-to-Management:

Direct collaboration with senior leadership and internal teams to shape customer and partner outcomes.

Practical Culture:

A practical, accountable, and forward-looking environment for sales professionals and technical specialists who want to grow beyond standard product selling.

Remuneration Structure

Fixed Salary Base:

Competitive monthly fixed base salary + CPF contributions.

Performance Bonus:

Performance-based sales bonus awarded upon achieving agreed sales KPIs and revenue targets.

title: Country Manager Singapore
description:
Country Manager — Singapore (Commission-Only, Freelance)

Company: Baraca Capital / Baraca Development

Location: Singapore, Singapore (remote, with regular travel in-country and to Lombok/Dubai)

Type: Freelance / independent contractor (not employment)

Pay: Commission-only, no fixed base salary. Paid in SGD or USD. There is no hourly or fixed fee; all pay is commission.

Angle: You've made your profits from Bali — or you missed that wave. Lombok is the next chance.

Compensation: commission-only (freelance/independent). Highly attractive, uncapped commission on every closed sale, plus overrides on deals closed by partners you activated. Details are shared in the interview.

About Baraca

Baraca Capital is a RERA-licensed real estate advisory and investment firm helping investors build portfolios across Dubai, Bali and Lombok. Through Baraca Development we design, permit, build and manage projects under our own name. Flagship: Tampah Beach Villas and a South Lombok pipeline. We also advise investors on Dubai property.

The role

Own Singapore. Build the market for Baraca from the ground up, so investors in Singapore can access Lombok developments and Dubai advisory through you and through partners they already trust.

You will

- Map, sign and activate local brokers, wealth advisers, private bankers, family-office contacts and other partners (e.g. property agencies, private banks, independent wealth managers)

- Train partners on the Lombok thesis, the product, the buying process and compliance basics. Run activation playbooks with them.

- Generate investor leads, qualify them and close them yourself

- Host investor events, seminars and webinars in Singapore. Organise site visits to Lombok.

- Represent Baraca locally at industry events, in the media and with partners

- Track your pipeline and report on active partners, qualified leads and reservations/sales

- Feed market feedback back to Baraca Development and leadership

You bring

- A proven track record selling international or high-ticket real estate or investment products to high-net-worth (HNW) clients

- An existing network of HNW investors, brokers, advisers or partners in Singapore that you can activate now, not only a claim on your CV

- Fluent spoken and written English. Mandarin or other regional languages are a plus.

- Comfort working commission-only and independently. You run your own diary and own a new market.

- Bonus: Indonesia, Bali or Dubai property experience. Experience with developer channel partnerships, or in private banking or wealth management.

Success looks like

- A live roster of activated partners selling Baraca in Singapore

- A steady flow of introductions, reservations and closed sales

- Baraca seen as the go-to name in Singapore for Lombok and Dubai property investment

How to apply

Apply with your CV/LinkedIn and a short note: which partners or networks you can open in your first 90 days, and whether your Bali story is "I rode it" or "I missed it."

Screener questions

1. What is your biggest closed deal or partnership in property or investments, and your role in it?

2. Which brokerages, wealth or private-banking firms or family-office contacts in Singapore could you activate for Baraca, and how?

3. This role is commission-only and freelance. How would you produce your first closed sale within 90 days, and what does your current HNW client or partner network look like?
