title: Business Development Director
description:
We are an early-stage Singapore company in the health, wellness, and digital health sector preparing to establish our commercial presence overseas.

Candidate Profile

We are seeking an experienced

Business Development Director

to lead our in-market business development activities and establish the commercial foundations in our overseas target market.

This is a hands-on role suited to an experienced commercial professional who is comfortable operating and working independently in an entrepreneurial, early-stage small environment, building markets, relationships and opportunities from the ground up.

The Business Development Director will be responsible for developing the company’s local commercial presence, identifying and engaging prospective customers and strategic partners, generating qualified leads and business opportunities, and building a structured pipeline for future revenue growth.

A commercially minded and resilient professional who is comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and integrity.

The successful candidate should be willing to work in an environment where processes, systems, customer relationships and market presence are still being built. This role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and execute the company’s business development and market-entry activities.

Conduct market research and assess local market opportunities, customer segments, competitors, commercial channels and market-entry considerations.

Identify, qualify and engage prospective customers, strategic partners, distributors, channel partners and other relevant commercial stakeholders.

Generate qualified leads and build a structured business development pipeline.

Arrange and conduct in-person business meetings with prospective customers, partners and other stakeholders.

Develop and strengthen local partnerships relevant to the company’s growth strategy.

Progress commercial opportunities from initial engagement through follow-up, proposal development, pilot discussions and potential agreements.

Represent the company professionally in external meetings, market-development activities and relevant industry engagements.

Gather market intelligence and customer feedback to support refinement of the company’s commercial and market-entry strategy.

Prepare commercial proposals, presentations and business cases in collaboration with the Singapore management team.

Execute appropriate in-market business development and marketing activities to support brand awareness and lead generation.

Maintain accurate records of prospects, meetings, opportunities, follow-up actions and commercial outcomes.

Track and report key business development metrics, including leads generated, meetings conducted, partnership opportunities progressed and measurable milestones achieved.

Prepare regular progress reports and provide management with practical recommendations on market opportunities, risks and next steps.

Support the development of the company’s longer-term overseas expansion strategy based on commercial validation.

Job Requirements

The ideal candidate should have:

Significant track record and professional experience in business development, partnerships, sales, commercial strategy and international market entry.

Relevant experience in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, health and wellness, digital health or a similar related sector.

Strong understanding of the commercial dynamics, stakeholders and partnership models relevant to the industry.

Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities, generate leads and develop commercial relationships.

Strong experience in stakeholder engagement, partnership development and external business representation.

Ability to operate independently in the target market.

Strong commercial judgement, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to interact confidently with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting and commercial tracking.

Excellent time-management and organisational skills.

Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.

Ability to remain focused while managing multiple priorities.

Self-motivated, proactive and independent.

Positive, solutions-oriented and adaptable working style.

Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Ability to work effectively with a small team while operating independently.

Willingness and ability to be physically based in the target market for the required assignment period.

The candidate should be comfortable:

building commercial relationships from an early stage;

working without an established local team or mature sales infrastructure;

adapting quickly to changing priorities;

managing multiple workstreams independently;

taking ownership from initial market engagement through to commercial follow-up; and

contributing practically to the company’s market-entry strategy.

Working Environment

As an early-stage company, we operate with a disciplined cost structure and a practical, hands-on working culture.

During the initial market-entry and business-building phase, there may be periods requiring flexibility beyond standard working hours, particularly around important business meetings, commercial deadlines, market-development activities and coordination across time zones.

The successful candidate should therefore be comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and supporting the company through its early growth phase.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured through tangible commercial progress, including:

establishment of a qualified prospect and partner pipeline;

number and quality of prospective customers and partners engaged;

in-person business meetings conducted;

qualified leads generated;

strategic partnership discussions initiated and progressed;

commercial proposals, pilots or collaboration opportunities developed;

market intelligence and customer insights obtained;

measurable progress toward establishing a sustainable commercial presence in the target market; and

development of a clear commercial roadmap for continued market expansion.

title: Business Development Executive Automotive (B2B Sales)
description:
Company Overview

Motoserv is a trusted leader in Singapore’s automotive service industry with 10 outlets islandwide. We deliver quality car maintenance and repair solutions through a franchise model that empowers independent workshops and entrepreneurs to succeed.

Job Summary

You will drive growth by sourcing and developing new B2B corporate accounts, building strong client relationships, promoting services, closing sales, and collaborating with internal teams to expand Motoserv’s corporate customer network across Singapore.

Responsibilities

Source and develop new B2B corporate accounts to expand the corporate customer base

Build and maintain long-term relationships with fleet companies, SMEs, insurance partners, dealerships, workshops, and corporate clients

Promote Motoserv and KlarDetail services and packages to target clients

Follow up on sales leads and close sales opportunities to meet targets

Maintain customer accounts and provide after-sales support to ensure client satisfaction

Collaborate closely with operations and marketing teams to align sales strategies and service delivery

Preferred competencies and qualifications

Experience in B2B sales or business development

Experience in the automotive industry is an advantage

Strong communication and negotiation skills to effectively engage clients and close deals

Self-motivated and target-driven to achieve sales goals

Possession of own transport preferred to facilitate client visits

Other Information

Salary & Benefits

Low basic salary plus high commission structure

Transport allowance provided

Attractive income potential for high performers

Opportunity for career growth within an expanding automotive group

Working Location

Multiple locations islandwide under Motoserv & KlarDetail network

Work schedule: 5 days a week, 9am to 5pm

Motoserv Automotive Franchise – Grow With Us

Motoserv is a trusted leader in Singapore’s automotive service industry, delivering top-tier car maintenance and repair solutions. With 10 outlets islandwide, we have built a strong reputation for quality, reliability, and innovation.

Today, Motoserv is expanding through a proven franchise model, empowering both independent workshop owners and young entrepreneurs to succeed in the automotive industry.

Vision

Our vision is to be the most trusted and innovative automotive service provider in Singapore. We aim to continuously expand our reach, improve our offerings, and set new industry benchmarks.

Comprehensive Services at Motoserv

Motoserv offers a wide array of services to meet every automotive need. From basic maintenance to specialized repairs, we ensure your vehicle receives the best care.

What Sets Us Apart

IMI UK-Certified Technicians

Our team consists of IMI UK-certified technicians, ensuring that your vehicle is serviced to the highest industry standards. This certification reflects our commitment to technical excellence and continuous learning.

Cutting-Edge Facilities

Each Motoserv outlet is equipped with state-of-the-art tools and technology, enabling us to deliver efficient and precise repairs.

Customer-Centric Approach

We prioritize our customers’ needs. From transparent pricing to personalized service, Motoserv aims to provide a hassle-free and rewarding experience for every customer.

Affordability and Transparency

We believe that quality automotive care should be accessible to everyone. Our transparent pricing ensures customers know exactly what they’re paying for, with no hidden fees.

Empowering Independent Workshops

Motoserv is not just a service provider; we’re a partner to independent car workshops. Our franchise model offers small businesses the tools, training, and support needed to thrive in a competitive market.

Commitment to Sustainability

At Motoserv, we are committed to promoting sustainable practices in the automotive industry. Our initiatives include:

Eco-Friendly Operations: Reducing waste and adopting sustainable materials.

Carbon Cleaning: Helping customers reduce their vehicles’ carbon emissions.

Hybrid and EV Focus: Supporting the transition to cleaner, more sustainable transportation options.

Training and Development

K-tech Auto Academy

Through our partnership with K-tech Auto Academy, we provide specialized training programs for our technicians and franchisees. These programs include:

Hybrid/EV Intermediate Courses: Equipping technicians with the skills needed for advanced vehicle systems.

Diagnostics Training: Ensuring our team stays up-to-date with the latest industry advancements.

Continuous learning is a core part of Motoserv’s philosophy, allowing us to maintain our position as an industry leader.

Engaging with Our Community

Social Media and Content Creation

Motoserv actively engages with customers through social media platforms like TikTok. Our content includes repair shop stories, customer testimonials, and tips for maintaining vehicles, helping us build a loyal online community.

Community Involvement

We participate in events like Automechanika KL, where we showcase our expertise and offer exclusive promotions. Motoserv is also committed to supporting local initiatives and charities, giving back to the community we serve.

title: Managing Director
description:
The Managing Director is responsible for shaping and driving Omron Healthcare business in APAC. Leads the country or region, based on Omron Principles, through the development and execution of short, mid-term and long-term business strategies and plans, aimed at the realization of sustainable high revenue and profitability growth. Chair of MSM and BoD.

Provide strategic leadership, aligned with the Omron Healthcare Headquarters's global mission and business strategy, by developing and implementing mid-term and long-range term business strategies, goals and action plans.

Develop, implement and manage annual business strategies, goals, action plan, P&L and budget, in pursuit of sustainable high revenue growth, increased earning capacity and market shares.

Ensure business and functional objectives are communicated, managed and monitored based on critical performance indicators.

Deliver the targeted financial and functional results to ensure committed profitability, revenue growth and expense control.

Provide strategic leadership for the creation of service business and new revenue streams. Pursue, negotiate and realize strategic alliances. Propose potential acquisition targets. Ensure realization post-merger integration key synergies and goals.

Lead regional strategic business projects (in the areas of value chain optimization amongst others).

Represent Omron Healthcare and its subsidiaries towards internal and external key stakeholders.

Lead, manage and coach regional functional leaders, including organizational development, recruitment, performance management, leadership development, talent management and succession planning, reward and employee engagement, based on Omron leadership competencies.

Requirements:

Bachelor Degree or Master Degree

Proficiency in Japanese language required. Looking for an individual who can connect in speaking/writing with Japanese colleagues at Headquarters.

Leading by Example -

Acts as role model on 9 OMRON leadership competencies internally. Solid external representation of OMRON. Communicates inspiring future view to stakeholders.

Acts as change agent. Sets stretch goals. Leads successful and sustainable turnaround(s). Builds strong connections. Ensures compliance.

Shaping the Business -

Shapes the business environment as thought leader. Develops compelling vision and mission, aligned with overall strategic direction. Creates customer centric and integrated (multi-function) mid-term business strategies, based on deep market insights. Identifies and develops organic + acquired growth opportunities in existing and new markets.

Commercial Management -

Successfully launches and commercializes new products and connected services in B2C, B2M and B2B (connected services) environment. Concludes large-scale negotiations with external parties. Optimizes value chain. Creates and develops strategic partnerships and alliances.

Driving Business Results -

Drives business with high speed and a strong sense of urgency. Delivers sustainable P&L results beyond expectations - in a sizeable, multi-country setting - and under different market conditions. Track record of high growth (revenue), increased earnings capacity (profit) and improved SG&A results (operational excellence).

People Management -

Establishes (measurable) high performing + engaged persons, teams, organization and culture. Builds robust and diverse succession pipelines. Attracts, develops and retains high performers and high potentials. Demonstrates ability to collaborate across geographies, functions, job levels and cultures.

With its headquarter in Kyoto, Japan, Omron Healthcare Co. develops and manufactures health equipment for home and medical use, health management software and health promotion services.

In seeking to realize a society where people can enjoy healthy and comfortable lives, Omron Healthcare believes that promoting the prevention of lifestyle diseases is one of the primary objectives. Towards this goal, Omron Healthcare establishes the value of "Healthcare @ Home".

"Healthcare @ Home" connects home and clinical practice with the day-to-day health information measured at home in order to prevent lifestyle diseases and monitor effects of the treatment. By looking beyond technology, our real commitment lies in helping people to lead healthy lives.

title: Senior Marketing Executive / Assistant Manager, Marketing & Communications
description:
About the Role

OaksPlus Limited is seeking a proactive, creative and results-driven marketing professional to join our Marketing & Communications team as a Senior Marketing Executive or Assistant Manager.

This role will focus primarily on growing the visibility, brand presence and enrolment opportunities of 7oaks Preschool through integrated digital and offline marketing initiatives.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing digital marketing campaigns and agency relationships, driving social media and content strategies, overseeing website content, developing marketing communications materials and building corporate partnerships.

We are looking for someone who combines creative thinking with strong execution capabilities, is comfortable working with data and can independently drive marketing initiatives from planning through to implementation and performance evaluation.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is both a strategic thinker and a hands-on executor — someone who can translate marketing plans into well-executed campaigns and measurable outcomes.

You should be comfortable managing agencies and external partners, working with internal stakeholders, analysing campaign results and taking the initiative to improve performance.

Above all, you should have a strong sense of ownership, attention to detail and a genuine interest in building brands that connect meaningfully with families.

Key Responsibilities

1. Digital Marketing & Agency Management

Plan, coordinate and execute integrated digital marketing campaigns across platforms including Google, Meta and other relevant channels to drive brand awareness, enquiries and enrolments.

Manage external digital marketing agencies, including campaign briefs, creative development, budgets, timelines, performance reviews and optimisation.

Monitor campaign performance against agreed KPIs, including website traffic, leads, cost per lead (CPL), lead quality and enrolment conversions.

Work closely with agencies to identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness, return on investment and marketing efficiency.

Prepare regular performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.

2. Social Media & Content Management

Develop and manage social media content plans and calendars across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.

Plan and execute engaging content that showcases the preschool's curriculum, learning experiences, educators, community engagement and brand proposition.

Oversee content creation, including copywriting, graphic design, photography and short-form video production.

Coordinate content gathering with preschool centres and internal stakeholders to ensure a consistent flow of relevant and engaging content.

Monitor social media performance, audience engagement and emerging trends to continuously improve content effectiveness.

Maintain consistent brand messaging, visual identity and quality across all social media platforms.

3. Website Management & Digital Presence

Manage and maintain the 7oaks Preschool website using WordPress, ensuring content is accurate, relevant and regularly updated.

Oversee updates to website pages, campaign landing pages, blog articles, promotional content and calls to action.

Coordinate with web developers and external vendors on website enhancements, maintenance and technical issues.

Monitor website performance using tools such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console and other relevant analytics platforms.

Work with agencies and vendors to improve search engine visibility, website user experience and lead generation effectiveness.

Support ongoing website enhancement and revamp initiatives where required.

4. Marketing Communications & Brand Management

Plan and execute marketing communications initiatives across digital and offline channels, ensuring alignment with brand positioning and business objectives.

Develop and coordinate marketing collaterals, including brochures, flyers, posters, banners, digital advertisements, out-of-home (OOH) advertising and promotional materials.

Support corporate communications and internal branding requirements, including staff event collaterals, Dinner & Dance materials, annual reports, presentations and internal announcements.

Liaise with creative agencies, printers, media owners and other vendors to ensure timely and cost-effective production of marketing materials.

Maintain brand consistency across all communications touchpoints.

Support public relations, community outreach and other brand-building opportunities as required.

5. Corporate Partnerships & Community Outreach

Identify and develop corporate partnership opportunities to increase brand awareness, generate qualified leads and support preschool enrolment.

Establish and maintain relationships with companies, community organisations and other relevant partners.

Develop partnership proposals, promotional arrangements and joint marketing initiatives.

Coordinate corporate outreach activities, roadshows and partnership activations.

Track partnership activities, leads generated and outcomes to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.

6. Campaigns, Events & Performance Reporting

Plan and coordinate marketing support for preschool open houses, Discovery Days, roadshows, enrolment drives and other events.

Work closely with centre leaders and internal stakeholders to ensure marketing initiatives support centre-specific enrolment priorities.

Track marketing performance across channels, including leads, centre visit registrations, visit attendance and enrolment conversions.

Maintain campaign budgets, timelines, marketing calendars and performance reports.

Identify gaps in performance and recommend corrective actions to improve results.

Support other marketing and communications initiatives as assigned.

Requirements

Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Business, Digital Marketing or a related discipline.

Senior Executive: Preferably 3–5 years of relevant marketing experience.

Assistant Manager: Preferably 5–7 years of relevant marketing experience, with demonstrated ownership of marketing campaigns and agency relationships.

Strong hands-on experience in digital marketing, including paid advertising, campaign coordination, agency management and performance tracking.

Proven experience managing social media channels, content calendars and creative production.

Practical experience managing websites using WordPress or a similar CMS; familiarity with basic SEO and website analytics.

Good understanding of digital marketing metrics, including CPL, conversion rates, website traffic and campaign ROI.

Strong writing and communication skills, with the ability to develop compelling marketing content and coordinate with diverse stakeholders.

Good eye for design and familiarity with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar tools.

Experience in offline marketing, collateral production, vendor coordination and event management.

Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and competing deadlines.

Resourceful, proactive and solutions-oriented, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables.

Experience in the education, preschool or family-oriented services sector will be an advantage.

The appointment level will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and capabilities.

Oaks Plus Limited (hereafter known as “OPL”) is a Company Limited by Guarantee (CLG) with Charity status that is committed to assisting underprivileged kids and their families. As one of the appointed operators under ECDA's Partner Operator Scheme, we believe that every child should have equal access to opportunities in learning and education and reach their maximum potential in life regardless of their socioeconomic status.

OPL has experience in serving Singapore’s multi-racial community. Presently, OPL owns and operates 7oaks Preschool centres, offering affordable and quality early childhood offerings that encompass a robust curriculum, highly qualified educators and centre leaders, and standards in line with the SPARK accreditation.

OPL has in place an experienced management committee comprising of the Board of Directors and the preschool management team who brings together a myriad of experience and expertise in the day-to-day running of the company and the curation of OPL early childhood strategies.

OPL also works closely with regulatory agencies such as ECDA and MSF to ensure compliance with legal and licensing regulations of its preschool centres.

title: Business Consultant for Interior Design Firms (Remote)
description:
Job Description

About Us

We help interior design and renovation firms in Singapore grow — through lead generation, branding, and marketing programmes that bring them qualified homeowners and stronger market positioning. Our clients don't just buy a service from us once; they grow with us across tiers as their firms scale. That only works when someone closes the right clients — and then owns the relationship after the first close.

That someone is you.

About the Role

This is a fully remote role.

You'll work from wherever you work best — no daily commute, no office face-time. What matters is that your clients feel looked after and your accounts grow. You'll meet clients over video calls (with the occasional in-person session if a key relationship calls for it), and stay connected to the team through our daily rhythms online.

This is a closing role first, a relationship role always.

You'll start by building your own book of business: running sales conversations with interior design firms, diagnosing where their business is stuck, and closing them into the right programme. Every deal you close becomes an account you own — and from there, your job is to make each relationship deeper, longer, and more valuable over time.

The more you close early on, the bigger the portfolio you manage — and the more your recurring income compounds through renewals, tier upgrades, and referrals. You are the person our clients trust from the very first call, the one who checks in before they have to ask, and the reason they sign, renew, upgrade, and refer.

What You'll Do

Run discovery and sales calls with interior design and renovation firms — diagnosing their growth bottlenecks and closing them into the programme that fits

Manage your own sales pipeline end to end: qualification, follow-ups, objection handling, and closing, with clear monthly targets

Own every account you close as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor

Run regular check-ins and performance reviews with clients — walking them through their results, diagnosing bottlenecks, and recommending next steps

Drive renewals by ensuring clients see and understand the value they're getting throughout the programme, not just at renewal time

Identify and develop expansion opportunities — helping clients climb to higher programme tiers when their business is ready for it

Generate referrals naturally by building the kind of relationship people recommend to their peers

Work with our internal teams to resolve client issues quickly and keep promises made during the sales process

Maintain accurate account records, follow-up rhythms, and relationship health tracking in our CRM

Who You Are

2+ years in B2B sales, account management, or client success — with a track record of hitting sales targets and closing deals

A closer who thinks long-term: you know how to drive a deal to a decision, but you close clients you can grow, not just deals you can win

A natural relationship builder — the close is the start of the relationship, not the end of it

Consistent with follow-through: you do what you say, on time, every time

A clear communicator who can explain performance data and business concepts simply, in person and in writing

Commercially sharp — you can spot an upsell or referral opportunity without making the client feel sold to

Organised and self-directed: you manage your own portfolio, pipeline of renewals, and follow-up cadence

Proven ability to work independently in a remote setup — you stay responsive, structured, and visible without anyone looking over your shoulder

Bonus: experience in or exposure to the interior design, renovation, real estate, or home services industry

Why Join Us

100% remote

— you're measured on client outcomes, not hours at a desk

Base salary + commissions on every deal you close, plus recurring incentives on retention, renewals, and account growth — your income compounds as your portfolio grows

Build your own book of business from day one, backed by proven sales scripts, frameworks, and playbooks — you close it, you keep it, you grow it

Clear frameworks, playbooks, and training on how we sell, manage, and grow accounts

A front-row seat to how design and renovation businesses in Singapore scale

To Apply

Reach out directly to our Head of Sales, Nigel:

WhatsApp: +65 9061 4389

Only candidates who reach out via WhatsApp will be contacted — a short intro message telling us who you are and why this role fits you is all it takes to start the conversation.

Network Singapore is a digital marketing and lead generation company specialising in the interior design industry. We operate one of Singapore's leading online portals connecting homeowners with interior design firms, helping businesses grow their client base through targeted digital exposure and a consistent flow of qualified leads.

Founded with a focus on results, we work closely with interior design professionals across Singapore to deliver marketing solutions that are measurable, scalable, and built around the needs of a competitive market. Our platform is designed to reduce the time and cost of client acquisition for interior design firms, allowing them to focus on what they do best — delivering exceptional spaces.

At Network Singapore, we believe in building long-term partnerships with our clients. Our team combines deep industry knowledge with a data-driven approach to ensure that every firm on our platform gets maximum visibility and genuine business opportunities.

We are a growing company with a performance-driven culture, committed to developing talent from within and building a team that takes pride in delivering results.

ADMISSIONS SPECIALIST

RD American School partners exclusively with Riverdale Country School - one of America's top-ranked private schools. We are more than an educational institution - we are an accelerator of learning. Our approach is grounded in cognitive science and modern pedagogy, empowering students to thrive in a complex, fast-changing world.

The Admissions Specialist is responsible for driving student enrollment growth by managing the full admissions lifecycle, from lead generation and relationship building through application processing and enrollment conversion. Acting as both an admissions advisor and business development professional, the role proactively identifies and nurtures prospective families while ensuring an exceptional admissions experience.

The successful candidate will be a relationship-focused professional who is comfortable engaging with prospective parents, developing community partnerships, conducting school tours, managing a sales pipeline, and achieving enrollment targets.

Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.

Strong customer service and stakeholder engagement skills.

Ability to influence and guide families through complex decision-making processes.

Highly organised with strong attention to detail and follow-through.

Professional, confident, and personable communicator.

title: Enterprise Account Executive, Asia
description:
Intellect is the global leader in hyper localised mental health benefits, trusted by the world’s most forward-thinking employers, insurers, and governments to deliver care that is local, personalised, and effective at scale. Today, we serve over 4 million people across 100 countries and 100+ languages, making mental health support truly accessible across borders and cultures.

Our platform powers the mental wellbeing of workforces at hundreds of Fortune 500 and global multinational companies, enabling them to support their people with the highest standards of clinical quality, cultural relevance, and on-demand accessibility.

Driven by our mission to build the world’s most trusted mental health benefits platform, Intellect combines a best-in-class digital platform with a world-leading global provider network to deliver unmatched client outcomes, and transformative care experiences.

We are backed by top global investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, Insignia Ventures Partners, HOF Capital, K3 Ventures, JAFCO, Headline, East Ventures, IHH Healthcare, MS&AD Ventures, and more, alongside an extensive coalition of notable family offices, big tech executives, and leading angel investors.

The Role

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, Asia to drive new business across mid-market and enterprise customers in the region.

This is a high-ownership, full-cycle sales role for someone who wants to build, not simply inherit a mature territory and run an established sales playbook.

You will have strong support from marketing, partnerships, leadership, product, clinical, customer success, and other teams across Intellect. At the same time, we expect you to be highly proactive in creating momentum yourself: opening doors, developing opportunities, shaping propositions, building compelling pitches, navigating complex buying processes, and doing what is needed to move important deals forward.

We are looking for someone commercially sharp, resourceful, persistent, and comfortable operating with pace and ambiguity.

A builder, not a passenger.

What You Will Do

Build & Win New Business

Own the end-to-end sales cycle across mid-market and enterprise customers in Asia, from first conversation through to contract signature.

Develop a deep understanding of target accounts, their priorities, decision-makers, buying dynamics, and where Intellect can create meaningful value.

Run high-quality discovery with senior stakeholders and translate customer needs into compelling commercial solutions.

Build strong, multi-threaded relationships across organisations and navigate complex regional or enterprise buying processes.

Create & Develop Pipeline

Work closely with marketing and the broader commercial team on inbound opportunities, campaigns, events, account-based initiatives, and other sources of demand.

At the same time, take ownership of creating opportunities yourself through targeted outreach, referrals, networking, events, partnerships, and thoughtful account development.

You should be comfortable working both sides of the equation: converting strong inbound demand and creating new opportunities from scratch.

Shape Complex Enterprise Deals

Develop account strategies and determine the best path to win each opportunity.

Create and customise presentations, proposals, business cases, and commercial narratives around the needs of each customer rather than relying only on standard materials.

Bring the right internal stakeholders into the process - across leadership, product, clinical, customer success, legal, security, and operations - and orchestrate them effectively.

Navigate procurement, legal, security, commercial negotiations, and other enterprise requirements with sound judgement and persistence.

Identify blockers early, create clear next steps, and maintain momentum throughout the sales cycle.

Represent Intellect Across Asia

Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers across the region.

Represent Intellect at customer meetings, industry events, conferences, roundtables, and other commercial opportunities.

Be willing to engage directly in events, lead generation, and market-building activities rather than seeing them as someone else’s responsibility.

Develop a strong understanding of the evolving mental health, employee benefits, HR, healthcare, and workforce landscape across Asia, and bring relevant market insights back into the company.

What Success Looks Like

You consistently build and convert a healthy pipeline of high-quality opportunities.

You win meaningful new mid-market and enterprise customers across Asia.

You create opportunities independently as well as convert marketing-generated demand.

You build credibility with senior stakeholders and develop relationships across multiple decision-makers within an account.

You navigate complex sales cycles with strong commercial judgement and clear ownership.

You create compelling, customer-specific pitches and proposals that move opportunities forward.

You maintain strong discipline around pipeline management, forecasting, follow-ups, and next steps.

You become a credible and trusted representative of Intellect in the market.

You operate effectively without needing a large or highly prescriptive sales machine around you.

Requirements

5-10 years of B2B sales experience, with meaningful exposure to mid-market or enterprise customers.

We care less about a specific industry background than we do about seeing evidence that you can create and win business.

You are likely to be someone who:

Has a strong track record of winning new mid-market or enterprise customers.

Has owned a meaningful portion of the full sales cycle, from opportunity creation through to negotiation and close.

Is commercially hungry and proactive about generating business rather than relying entirely on inbound demand.

Can sell consultatively and understand the underlying business problem rather than simply presenting product features.

Is comfortable navigating complex organisations with multiple stakeholders and decision-makers.

Can communicate credibly with senior executives and adapt your approach across different audiences and markets.

Is comfortable creating or adapting your own decks, proposals, business cases, and sales narratives when needed.

Is highly resourceful and persistent when an opportunity becomes difficult or stalls.

Has strong judgement around account prioritisation, stakeholder management, and how to move a deal forward.

Is comfortable operating in an environment where not every process is perfectly defined.

Has strong commercial discipline without becoming overly dependent on process or infrastructure.

Works effectively across functions and knows how to bring the right people into an opportunity.

Is ambitious, resilient, and motivated by ownership and outcomes.

Is willing to get hands-on where needed, whether that means prospecting, working an event, researching an account, preparing a custom pitch, or pushing through a difficult procurement process.

Experience selling HR technology, employee benefits, healthcare, mental health, SaaS, professional services, or other complex B2B solutions is useful, but not essential.

Experience selling across multiple Asian markets or operating in a regional role would be a strong advantage.

Intellect (

intellect.co

) is a venture-backed digital health company reinventing how mental health is in Asia. Our goal is to make it simple, easy and stigma-free for everyone.

We're building an entirely new way for modern organisations to easily provide support for their employees’ mental health & mental wellbeing, no matter where they are on their journey.

Join us on our mission to eliminate barriers to mental health and to create a wellbeing approach that people love using.

title: PILATES STUDIO MANAGER
description:
STUDIO MANAGER

Position Overview

The

Studio Manager

is responsible for the continued growth, performance and culture of FS8, with a strong focus on creating a

community-led, high-performing and welcoming studio environment

.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining

studio operations, team leadership, client management, business development, training, community engagement, marketing and partnerships

.

The Manager will oversee the day-to-day running of the studio, lead and develop the trainer and front-of-house team, deliver exceptional client experiences, drive membership and revenue growth, and ensure the studio is maintained to the highest operational and presentation standards.

A key component of the role is being visible on the studio floor and building genuine relationships with clients. The Manager will deliver approximately

12 hours of client-facing training per week

, using this time to support client development, understand member needs, build relationships and strengthen the overall studio experience.

The successful candidate will be creative, energetic, organised and commercially minded, with a genuine passion for fitness and community. They will be expected to identify opportunities, develop new initiatives and help establish FS8 as a

community studio — not simply a place where people come to take a class.

Formal FS8 brand and methodology training will be provided.

Key Responsibilities

1. Studio & Operational Management

Take overall responsibility for the smooth and efficient day-to-day operation of the studio.

Manage studio opening and closing procedures, class set-up and pack-down, reception and front-of-house standards.

Oversee trainer schedules, cover requirements and studio timetable requirements.

Ensure all classes are adequately staffed and delivered to FS8 standards.

Maintain a clean, organised, safe and welcoming studio environment at all times.

Conduct regular checks of reformers, equipment, furniture and studio facilities.

Identify maintenance requirements and coordinate repairs or servicing where required.

Ensure equipment is appropriately maintained and reported when issues arise.

Manage studio supplies, stock and operational requirements.

Develop and maintain effective operational procedures and checklists.

Ensure all studio policies, procedures and brand standards are followed.

Monitor studio KPIs and use data to identify opportunities to improve performance.

2. Team Leadership & Staff Development

Lead, support and develop the studio team.

Work closely with trainers to ensure consistent delivery of the FS8 experience and methodology.

Support trainer onboarding, training and development.

Provide regular feedback and coaching to team members.

Assist with trainer scheduling, cover and performance management.

Create a positive, collaborative and accountable team culture.

Identify opportunities to improve team performance and client experience.

Encourage trainers to actively participate in studio community initiatives and events.

Work with senior FS8 leadership on trainer development and ongoing education.

3. Client Training & Experience

The Manager will remain an active part of the studio floor and will deliver approximately

12 hours of client-facing training per week

.

Responsibilities include:

Deliver high-quality FS8 classes in accordance with FS8 methodology and standards.

Build strong relationships with clients through regular interaction and coaching.

Understand individual client goals, motivations and challenges.

Provide appropriate guidance and recommendations to support client progression.

Identify opportunities to improve the client journey and overall studio experience.

Welcome new clients and help them feel comfortable and connected to the studio.

Recognise regular clients and create a personalised experience.

Proactively identify clients who may need additional support, encouragement or follow-up.

Encourage consistency, progression and long-term engagement.

Gather client feedback and turn it into actionable improvements.

4. Client Management & Communication

The Manager will take ownership of the client relationship beyond the studio floor.

Respond promptly and professionally to client enquiries across all communication channels.

Manage client communication through

Mindbody, Loyalsnap, WhatsApp, email and other relevant platforms

.

This includes weekly emails, promotion development and our corporate engagement.

Ensure leads and enquiries are followed up consistently and professionally.

Maintain accurate client records and notes within the client management system.

Monitor client attendance, engagement and purchasing behaviour.

Identify clients at risk of becoming inactive and implement appropriate re-engagement strategies.

Manage membership renewals, upgrades and conversions.

Communicate promotions, programs, events and studio initiatives.

Develop personalised client outreach where appropriate.

Ensure clients receive a high level of communication before, during and after their studio journey.

5. Mindbody & Client Management Systems

Take responsibility for the effective use and administration of

Mindbody

and associated client management systems.

This includes:

Managing client profiles and ensuring information is accurate.

Monitoring bookings, attendance, cancellations and no-shows.

Managing memberships, class packs and relevant client accounts.

Tracking leads and enquiries.

Monitoring client purchasing behaviour.

Supporting reporting and KPI tracking.

Identifying opportunities through client data.

Ensuring the team is appropriately trained in system use.

Maintaining consistent and accurate client records.

Using data to support retention, sales and community-building initiatives.

6. Business Development & Sales

The Manager will play a key role in driving the commercial performance and continued growth of the studio.

Responsibilities include:

Respond promptly and professionally to all enquiries.

Track and manage leads from initial enquiry through to conversion.

Implement systems to maximise enquiry-to-client conversion.

Promote and sell memberships, class packs, programs and studio services.

Meet and exceed agreed membership and sales targets.

Develop member sign-up, retention and renewal strategies.

Identify opportunities to increase client frequency and lifetime value.

Promote studio programs and initiatives consistently.

Develop strategies to increase class utilisation.

Monitor sales performance and identify areas for improvement.

Work with senior management on pricing, promotions and commercial initiatives.

Identify new revenue opportunities for the studio.

7. Community Development

A core objective of this role is to

build FS8 into a community studio

.

The Manager will be responsible for creating an environment where clients know the team, feel recognised and want to spend time at the studio.

This includes:

Developing a strong sense of community among members.

Creating opportunities for clients to connect with one another.

Developing regular studio celebrations and community events.

Celebrating client milestones, achievements and birthdays.

Creating member challenges and participation initiatives.

Developing social and wellness activities outside regular classes.

Encouraging trainers to actively engage with the studio community.

Creating initiatives that make clients feel recognised and valued.

Building relationships with local businesses and the wider MBFC community.

Identifying opportunities to make FS8 a destination within the local corporate and fitness community.

The goal is to create a studio where clients don't simply attend classes — they feel that they belong.

8. Studio Events, Celebrations & Initiatives

The Manager will be responsible for developing and executing initiatives that drive engagement and create memorable studio experiences.

Examples may include:

Member appreciation events.

Studio anniversary celebrations.

Birthday and milestone celebrations.

Fitness challenges.

Community workouts.

Wellness events.

Guest trainer sessions.

Corporate fitness initiatives.

Member competitions and incentives.

New program launches.

Seasonal campaigns.

Charity and community initiatives.

The Manager should continuously look for

new and creative ways to bring people into the studio and give existing clients a reason to remain engaged.

9. Partnerships & Collaborations

Develop and maintain relationships with relevant brands, businesses and organisations.

Responsibilities include:

Identify potential collaboration opportunities.

Develop partnerships with complementary fitness, health, wellness, beauty, food and lifestyle brands.

Build relationships with businesses within the MBFC and CBD community.

Develop corporate wellness opportunities.

Coordinate collaborative events and activations.

Negotiate and manage mutually beneficial partnership arrangements.

Ensure partnerships add genuine value to the FS8 client experience.

Track the performance and effectiveness of collaborations.

10. Marketing & Social Media

The Manager will work closely with the marketing team while taking an active role in the studio's local marketing and digital engagement.

Responsibilities include:

Support the development and execution of local marketing campaigns.

Create and identify opportunities for social media content.

Encourage trainers and clients to participate in content creation.

Promote studio events, offers, challenges and initiatives.

Engage with clients and the local community through social media.

Support Instagram and other digital channels with timely studio updates.

Identify local marketing opportunities within MBFC and Marina Bay.

Work with collaborative brands on joint marketing initiatives.

Ensure the studio's online presence reflects the energy and culture of the physical studio.

11. Training & Development

The Manager will receive formal FS8 brand and methodology training and will be expected to continually develop their own knowledge and skills.

Responsibilities include:

Complete all required FS8 training and education.

Maintain current knowledge of FS8 programming and methodology.

Participate in ongoing trainer development.

Support the development of the wider studio team.

Keep up to date with developments in the fitness and wellness industry.

Bring new ideas and best practices into the studio where appropriate.

Encourage a culture of continuous learning and development.

12. Cleaning, Maintenance & Studio Standards

The Manager is responsible for ensuring the studio consistently meets FS8 standards of cleanliness, presentation and safety.

This includes:

Ensuring reformers and equipment are cleaned and maintained regularly.

Ensuring the studio floor, mats, mirrors and communal areas are clean.

Maintaining reception, changing areas and client facilities.

Monitoring cleaning standards throughout the day.

Managing cleaning schedules and external cleaning providers where applicable.

Reporting and following up on maintenance issues.

Conducting regular equipment and facility checks.

Ensuring the studio is presented to a high standard before, during and after operating hours.

Creating a studio environment that feels professional, welcoming and premium.

13. Reporting & Performance

Monitor studio KPIs including membership growth, sales, retention, attendance and utilisation.

Provide regular performance updates to senior management.

Analyse client and business data to identify trends and opportunities.

Monitor promotional and campaign performance.

Track lead conversion and client retention.

Identify operational issues and propose solutions.

Set and work towards agreed studio targets.

Take ownership of results and proactively communicate challenges and opportunities.

Key Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured through a combination of

commercial performance, client experience and community development

, including:

Membership growth.

Sales and revenue performance.

Lead conversion.

Client retention and renewal.

Class utilisation.

Client attendance and engagement.

Client satisfaction and feedback.

Trainer performance and development.

Studio cleanliness and operational standards.

Successful delivery of events and initiatives.

Growth of corporate and local partnerships.

Social media and digital engagement.

Strength and vibrancy of the FS8 Marina Bay community.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

Has a genuine passion for fitness, health and wellness.

Is confident leading a team.

Is highly organised and commercially aware.

Has excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Enjoys building relationships and creating community.

Is comfortable with sales and achieving targets.

Is proactive and able to work independently.

Is creative and constantly looking for new ideas.

Is confident using technology and client management systems.

Has experience with

Mindbody or a similar booking/CRM platform

.

Is comfortable communicating with clients digitally.

Has strong attention to detail.

Takes pride in the presentation and cleanliness of a studio.

Is willing to be hands-on and lead by example.

Understands that exceptional client experience is created through the small details.

Wants to build something, rather than simply manage something.

Role Philosophy

We are building a community, not just running a studio.

The Studio Manager should be the heartbeat of the studio — the person who knows the clients, supports the trainers, drives the business, creates the energy and makes sure every person who walks through the door feels welcomed and valued.

This role is for someone who wants to take ownership, develop ideas, build relationships and make a visible impact on the growth and culture of the studio.

Collection of elevated and emerging fitness studios, united with a strong Global and regional presence. We are now bringing the vision to Singapore.

title: Head of Legal & Compliance
description:

Head of Legal & Compliance

.

title: Brand Marketing Director
description:
About GNAME

GNAME is Asia’s leading domain registrar, based out of Singapore. We power a native marketplace designed for discovering, buying, and selling the perfect brand identity—including a backorder system of high-value, premium domain names that have expired into digital ether.

For more info on what we do: https://www.gname.com

We are seeking an experienced Brand Marketing Director to lead GNAME's global brand and marketing strategy, strengthen brand positioning, build integrated marketing capabilities, grow brand awareness and customer engagement across priority international markets, and translate business strategy into measurable brand and marketing outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

1. Global Brand Strategy & Positioning

· Develop and lead GNAME's global brand strategy, positioning, value proposition and brand architecture in alignment with business strategy and international growth priorities.

· Define brand narratives, messaging frameworks, tone of voice and visual direction to ensure a consistent and differentiated brand across markets and customer touchpoints.

· Advise senior management on brand strategy, market positioning, reputation and major marketing priorities.

· Establish brand governance standards across corporate, product, digital, event and employer-facing communications.

· Monitor brand health, market perception and competitive positioning and translate insights into strategic actions.

2. Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning

· Develop annual and multi-market marketing strategies, priorities, budgets and execution roadmaps supporting customer acquisition, engagement, retention and business growth.

· Lead integrated campaigns across digital, content, social media, public relations, partnerships, events, community and other relevant channels.

· Translate business and product priorities into audience strategies, campaign propositions and go-to-market programmes.

· Build effective planning, campaign governance, agency/vendor management and performance review processes.

· Balance long-term brand building with measurable demand and commercial outcomes.

3. International Market Development & Go-to-Market

· Lead brand and marketing initiatives for priority international markets, including market-entry and growth programmes where relevant.

· Conduct market, customer, competitor and category analysis to identify growth opportunities, audience needs and positioning gaps.

· Adapt global brand and campaign strategies to local market context while maintaining overall brand consistency.

· Partner with business development, sales, product and operations teams on market launches, customer programmes and strategic partnerships.

· Build relationships with relevant industry communities, media, partners and ecosystem stakeholders to expand GNAME's visibility and credibility.

4. Digital, Content & Community Marketing

· Set the strategy for owned digital channels, social media, content, community and thought-leadership programmes.

· Develop content frameworks communicating GNAME's expertise in domain names and internet services to relevant customer and industry audiences.

· Oversee editorial calendars, campaign content, executive communications, corporate storytelling and key digital assets.

· Strengthen customer and industry engagement through communities, educational content, events and other relationship-building initiatives.

· Ensure content quality, brand consistency and appropriate review processes across external communications.

5. Marketing Performance, Analytics & Customer Insights

· Define marketing KPIs covering brand awareness, engagement, customer acquisition, conversion, campaign effectiveness and return on marketing investment.

· Use customer, market, channel and campaign data to evaluate performance and guide budget and resource allocation.

· Develop regular marketing dashboards and management reports with clear insights, risks and recommended actions.

· Strengthen customer insight and feedback mechanisms to improve positioning, messaging, campaigns and customer experience.

· Promote a test-and-learn culture and continuously improve marketing effectiveness through experimentation and performance analysis.

6. Team Leadership & Cross-functional Collaboration

· Build, lead and develop the brand and marketing function, including capability planning, objective setting, performance management and talent development.

· Work closely with the CEO and senior management to align brand and marketing priorities with Company strategy.

· Partner with product, business development, sales, operations, customer service, compliance, legal, finance and HR teams to deliver integrated initiatives.

· Manage external agencies, consultants, media, creative partners and other vendors where required.

· Establish clear standards, workflows and accountability to ensure high-quality and timely marketing execution.

7. Reputation, Communications & Brand Risk Management

· Oversee corporate brand communications and support reputation management across relevant external channels.

· Develop communication approaches for significant company announcements, partnerships, product developments and industry engagement.

· Work with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure external marketing and communications are accurate, appropriate and aligned with applicable requirements.

· Identify brand and reputation risks and establish appropriate escalation, review and response mechanisms.

· Support senior leaders in external communications and thought leadership where appropriate.

Requirements

· Bachelor's degree or above in Marketing, Communications, Business, Brand Management or a related discipline.

· At least 12 years of progressive experience in brand, marketing or integrated communications, including substantial experience in a senior marketing leadership role.

· Demonstrated experience developing and executing brand and marketing strategy across multiple markets, including brand positioning, integrated campaigns, digital/content marketing and marketing performance.

· Experience in technology, internet, SaaS, digital platforms, e-commerce, fintech or another international digital business is highly preferred.

· Strong understanding of digital customer journeys, international marketing channels, content and community building, and data-driven marketing.

· Proven ability to partner with CEOs, senior executives and cross-functional leaders and translate business strategy into practical brand and marketing programmes.

· Strong leadership, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, analytical, communication and change-management capabilities.

· Experience managing marketing budgets, agencies, vendors and multi-channel programmes with measurable outcomes.

· Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, international and evolving organisation, balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution when required.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Chinese to liaise with internal and external stakeholders.

About Us

GNAME was established in Singapore as a professional international domain name registrar. We are dedicated to creating a comprehensive service platform for Internet domain names. At GNAME, domain names are at the heart of our business, and we offer a wide range of services to our customers, including global domain name registration, dropcatch, transactions, management, API interfaces, and other relevant services. Adopting an open reseller model, we offer reseller a one-stop management system including products, transactions, and financial management, fully supporting their business development. In addition to domain services, we also provide a diverse range of cloud products such as cloud servers, SSL certificates, website protection, and enterprise email services. Based on cloud computing technology, these services are highly scalable and secure, meeting customers’ needs in information technology and network security.

Our strong reputation is built on our commitment to putting customers first. In the future, we will continue to work hard, stay current with industry trends, and deliver the most valuable products and services to our global customers.

title: Vice President, ASEAN FX Strategist (Job ID:10079919)
description:
An exceptional opportunity has arisen for an experienced Vice President Senior Currency Analyst to join a highly respected global financial institution in Singapore. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on producing insightful research reports focused on ASEAN economies and foreign exchange rates, particularly with expertise in INR, VND, and PHP. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the organisation’s visibility across international markets by conducting independent research and contributing to team’s regular publications that provide actionable insights to both internal stakeholders and a diverse global client base. The position offers a unique blend of analytical rigour, stakeholder engagement, and the chance to work closely with colleagues across Tokyo, London, New York, and Asia. With a supportive team environment, this is your chance to make a significant impact while developing your career within a collaborative and inclusive culture.

Deliver high-impact research on ASEAN economies and FX rates, enhancing the organisation’s reputation across global markets through regular publications and thematic studies.

Engage directly with clients and internal teams via seminars, webinars, conference calls, and company visits to share insights and foster strong professional relationships.

Benefit from flexible working opportunities within a knowledgeable team that values collaboration, ongoing learning, and personal growth.

What you'll do:

As a Vice President Senior Currency Analyst based in Singapore, you will be at the forefront of delivering high-quality economic research that shapes strategic decisions for both internal stakeholders and external clients worldwide. Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve producing detailed analyses of ASEAN economies—especially focusing on India (INR), Vietnam (VND), and the Philippines (PHP)—and generating regular publications that keep clients informed about market developments. You will collaborate closely with colleagues across multiple regions to contribute to global research pipelines while also engaging directly with customers through various channels such as seminars or webinars. Success in this role requires not only technical expertise but also excellent communication skills for presenting complex information clearly. Your ability to build strong relationships internally and externally will be crucial as you help drive customer satisfaction through insightful analysis.

Produce comprehensive research reports on ASEAN economic trends and foreign exchange rates with a particular focus on INR, VND, and PHP currencies.

Contribute regularly to daily FX updates, weekly market reviews, and quarterly outlooks as part of the Asia Global Market Research team.

Develop in-depth thematic studies and ad-hoc commentary on economic data releases, policy changes, market events, and currency movements relevant to Southeast Asia.

Create and maintain robust quantitative models for economic indicators and foreign exchange forecasting to support research outputs.

Participate actively in regional and global research initiatives by collaborating with colleagues in Tokyo, London, New York, and other key locations.

Engage with clients through conference calls, seminars, webinars, company visits, and business trips to present research findings and address queries.

Build effective partnerships with sales teams, traders, relationship managers, and other stakeholders to ensure timely responses to market-related questions.

Support junior team members by providing coaching, guidance, and sharing best practices within the Asia GMR team.

Ensure all activities comply with relevant regulations, internal policies, risk controls, and dual-entity guidelines as required by the functional arrangement.

Assist in managing the department’s risk profile by adhering strictly to compliance standards and supporting operational excellence.

What you bring:

To excel as a Vice President Senior Currency Analyst in Singapore you will bring substantial experience from previous roles where you have delivered high-quality economic or FX research within major financial institutions or consultancies. Your background should include advanced academic training—ideally at postgraduate level—in economics or finance coupled with hands-on expertise in both qualitative assessment techniques (such as policy analysis) and quantitative methods (including econometric modelling). You are adept at distilling complex macroeconomic trends into actionable insights for diverse audiences ranging from senior executives to institutional investors. Strong interpersonal skills; you thrive when collaborating across functions or mentoring less experienced colleagues. A deep understanding of compliance requirements—particularly those associated with multi-entity operations—is essential given the dual-hat nature of this role. Above all else your commitment to accuracy integrity teamwork continuous learning sets you apart as an invaluable member of any high-performing research function.

Minimum 10 years of experience in Global markets working in Singapore or any other regional market.

Demonstrated experience of at least eight years in economic or foreign exchange research within financial services or related sectors is essential for this position.

Proven experience building robust models for economic indicators or FX forecasting supports data-driven decision-making within the team

A bachelor’s degree or higher qualification in economics, finance or another relevant discipline provides the necessary academic foundation for success.

Proven ability to conduct both qualitative assessments and quantitative analyses when tackling complex economic issues is vital for producing impactful research outputs.

Strong presentation abilities enable you to communicate findings effectively during seminars, webinars or client meetings across different regions.

A collaborative approach is important as you will work closely with colleagues from various departments such as sales or trading as well as mentor junior staff members.

Familiarity with regulatory frameworks governing financial institutions ensures compliance with all relevant laws including those specific to dual-entity arrangements.

Excellent stakeholder management skills allow you to develop productive relationships both internally within the organisation and externally with global corporate clients.

What sets this company apart:

This organisation stands out as one of the world’s most established financial institutions renowned for its commitment to excellence integrity innovation within global markets. Employees benefit from being part of an inclusive workplace culture that prioritises knowledge-sharing professional development mutual respect among colleagues at every level. The company offers flexible working opportunities designed to support work-life balance alongside access to extensive training resources that empower individuals at all stages of their careers. By joining this team you become part of a network dedicated not only delivering outstanding results but also nurturing talent fostering long-term growth leadership within financial services sector.
