title: Network Sales Admin Support
description:
Job Title

Network Sales Admin Support

Occupation

Sales & Business Development Support

About Super Sistem Group

Super Sistem is a

licensed telecommunications infrastructure operator and builder

, holding a

Facilities-Based Operator (FBO) licence in Singapore

and a

Jartup (Jaringan Telekomunikasi Tertutup) licence in Indonesia

.

These licences enable Super Sistem to develop, operate and manage telecommunications infrastructure across

Singapore and Indonesia

, including submarine cable and terrestrial fibre infrastructure.

We specialize in developing and operating

submarine cable and terrestrial fibre infrastructure

, connecting key digital, data centre and telecommunications hubs across Singapore and Indonesia.

As a rapidly growing cross-border network operator, Super Sistem combines

engineering expertise, regulatory knowledge and commercial capabilities

to develop reliable, scalable and future-ready digital connectivity infrastructure.

We are now seeking a

Network Sales Admin Support

to join our Singapore team and work closely with our

Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)

in developing Super Sistem's regional wholesale connectivity business.

About the Role

The

Network Sales Admin Support

will work closely with the CMO to support the day-to-day execution of Super Sistem's

sales, business development and customer engagement activities

across Singapore and the region.

This is more than a traditional administrative support position. The successful candidate will be exposed to the

full commercial sales cycle

— from identifying prospects and preparing sales materials, to customer meetings, quotations, negotiations, contracting and ultimately closing business.

The role is designed for a

high-potential, commercially minded individual who wants to build a long-term career in telecommunications infrastructure sales

.

The successful candidate will initially provide strong administrative, coordination and sales support to the CMO. As the candidate develops product knowledge, commercial understanding and customer relationships, the role will progressively expand to include

direct customer engagement, account management, business development and ownership of sales opportunities

.

Our objective is to develop the successful candidate towards taking on

greater responsibility and independently leading sales activities within approximately three years

, subject to performance, capability and business requirements.

Prior telecommunications or submarine cable experience is

not essential

. We are particularly interested in candidates who are

fast learners, commercially driven, confident in dealing with people and have a proven track record in sales or customer-facing business development

.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales & Business Development Support

Work closely with the CMO to support

sales and business development activities

across Singapore and the region.

Assist in identifying and researching

potential customers, partners and business opportunities

.

Maintain and update the company's

sales pipeline, customer database and opportunity tracking

.

Coordinate customer follow-ups, meetings, presentations and commercial discussions.

Prepare sales quotations, proposals, presentations, capability statements and other customer-facing materials.

Assist in tracking opportunities from initial enquiry through to

quotation, negotiation, contract and service delivery

.

Ensure timely follow-up on outstanding customer enquiries, proposals and commercial matters.

Support the CMO in maintaining strong relationships with existing customers and business partners.

2. Sales Administration & Coordination

Provide day-to-day administrative and coordination support to the CMO and sales function.

Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, action items and follow-up reports.

Maintain accurate records of

customer contacts, opportunities, quotations, contracts and sales activities

.

Coordinate internally with technical, project, operations, finance and management teams to respond to customer requirements.

Assist in preparing internal sales reports, pipeline updates and management presentations.

Coordinate travel arrangements, customer meetings and regional business activities when required.

3. Customer & Market Research

Conduct research on

telecommunications operators, ISPs, data centres, cloud providers, hyperscalers, content providers and other potential customers

.

Monitor market developments, new infrastructure projects, submarine cable systems, data centre developments and regional connectivity opportunities.

Identify potential new customers and business opportunities for Super Sistem's network infrastructure and connectivity services.

Assist in developing customer and market intelligence to support the CMO's business development strategy.

4. Commercial & Product Development

Develop a strong understanding of Super Sistem's products and services, including

submarine fibre capacity, dark fibre, wavelength, cable landing station and data centre connectivity solutions

.

Work with the technical team to understand customer requirements and translate them into appropriate connectivity solutions.

Assist in preparing commercial models, pricing comparisons and customer proposals.

Develop an understanding of the commercial considerations surrounding

capacity, fibre pairs, IRUs, connectivity services and infrastructure projects

.

Support the CMO in evaluating new commercial opportunities and partnerships.

5. Progressive Sales Responsibility

As the candidate develops experience and demonstrates capability:

Participate directly in

customer meetings and commercial negotiations

.

Take ownership of selected customer accounts and sales opportunities.

Develop and maintain relationships with customers and industry partners.

Independently manage defined sales opportunities from prospecting through to closure.

Develop and maintain an individual sales pipeline and sales targets.

Represent Super Sistem at selected

industry conferences, exhibitions and customer events

.

Progressively take on responsibility for

regional sales and business development activities

.

The long-term objective is for the successful candidate to develop from a sales support role into a

commercially independent sales and business development professional

capable of leading customer relationships and sales opportunities.

Qualifications & Experience

Essential

Diploma or Bachelor's Degree

in Business, Marketing, Sales, Communications, Information Technology or a related discipline.

A

Diploma is sufficient

for this position; academic qualifications are less important than demonstrated commercial ability and attitude.

Proven sales or business development track record

, preferably with measurable sales achievements or customer acquisition results.

Strong interest in developing a career in

sales and business development

.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Confident and comfortable communicating with customers, partners and senior stakeholders.

Strong organisational skills with attention to detail.

Good written and spoken

English

.

Strong Microsoft Office / Google Workspace skills.

Fast learner with the ability to understand new products, technologies and commercial concepts quickly.

Self-motivated, proactive and able to work independently.

Willingness to travel regionally when required, particularly to

Indonesia and other Southeast Asian markets

.

Industry Experience

Prior experience in

telecommunications, submarine cables or digital infrastructure is not mandatory

.

Candidates with sales experience in other sectors are welcome, particularly those from:

IT / technology

Data centres

Cloud services

Engineering

Construction / infrastructure

Energy and utilities

Marine / offshore

Enterprise solutions

B2B services

Other technical or solution-based sales environments

What matters most is

proven sales ability, commercial instinct, willingness to learn and the drive to build a long-term career in network infrastructure sales

.

Career Development

This position is intended to provide a

structured pathway from Sales Support to Network Sales / Business Development

.

First Year — Learn & Support

Build a strong foundation in:

Super Sistem's network and connectivity products

Customers and regional telecommunications markets

Sales processes and CRM/pipeline management

Quotations and commercial proposals

Customer engagement

Submarine cable and fibre infrastructure fundamentals

Second Year — Develop & Own

Progressively take responsibility for:

Customer accounts

Sales opportunities

Customer meetings

Commercial proposals

Business development activities

Regional customer engagement

Third Year — Lead

Subject to performance and capability, take increasing ownership of:

Sales pipeline

Key customer relationships

Business development opportunities

Commercial negotiations

Regional sales activities

New customer acquisition

The intention is to develop the successful candidate into a

capable Network Sales / Business Development professional who can independently originate, manage and close connectivity opportunities

.

Why Join Super Sistem

Join an

emerging licensed telecom infrastructure operator

with an

FBO licence in Singapore and Jartup licence in Indonesia

.

Work directly with senior management and gain exposure to

cross-border telecommunications and digital infrastructure development

.

Learn from an experienced CMO and senior management team with extensive experience in

telecommunications, submarine cable systems and international connectivity

.

Gain exposure to Super Sistem's growing portfolio of

submarine cable and connectivity infrastructure

, including BTI, SS Batam SG and SEAX-1.

Opportunity to build a long-term career in

B2B network sales and business development

, rather than remaining in a purely administrative role.

Structured opportunity to progressively move from

sales support → account management → business development → network sales

.

Work with customers and partners across

Singapore, Indonesia and Southeast Asia

.

Flexible hybrid

(Office / Remote / Customer Meetings / Regional Travel)

work culture.

Competitive salary and benefits package.

What We Value

At Super Sistem, we believe in

curiosity, ownership and adaptability

.

We are looking for someone who is

hungry to learn, comfortable talking to customers and willing to take responsibility

.

You do not need to know everything about submarine cables or telecommunications when you join us. What matters is that you are a

fast learner with proven sales ability

, have the confidence to engage people, and are willing to put in the effort to understand a technically complex industry.

If you have demonstrated that you can

build relationships, identify opportunities and close sales

, we will provide the industry knowledge and exposure needed for you to develop further.

If your ambition is to become a regional network sales professional within the next three years, this role provides an opportunity to learn directly from senior management while helping build Super Sistem's growing connectivity business across Southeast Asia.

Super Sistem's current business spans submarine systems and connectivity solutions including dark fibre, wavelength, cable landing station and data-centre infrastructure.

title: Corporate Development M&A Manager
company: ASIA PROPERTIES & ASSETS CONSULTANCY PTE. LTD.
description:
JobSummary

Asia Properties is seeking a Manager, Corporate Development (M&A) to support the origination, evaluation, and execution of real estate acquisitions, joint ventures, and strategic investments across the region. This role sits at the centre of the company's growth agenda, working closely with senior leadership, business units and external advisors to identify and close deals that expand the company's land bank, income-producing portfolio and development pipeline.

The ideal candidate combines strong financial and analytical rigour with a genuine interest in real estate markets, and is comfortable managing multiple live transactions in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

JobDescription

Deal Origination &Market Intelligence

Identify and screen potential acquisition targets, including land parcels, income-generating assets, development sites, portfolios, and developer/operator partnerships

Build and maintain a pipeline of opportunities through brokers, agents, government land sale programmes, and direct relationships with landowners and developers

Track market trends, transaction comparables, competitor activity and regulatory/policy changes affecting real estate investment across target markets

Financial Analysis &Valuation

Build and maintain financial models to evaluate acquisition opportunities, including DCF analysis, residual land valuation, IRR/equity multiple analysis and cap rate benchmarking

Prepare feasibility studies covering market positioning, highest-and-best-use analysis, development cost estimates and revenue assumptions

Analyse comparable transactions and market data to support pricing and negotiation positions

Due Diligence &Transaction Execution

Coordinate end-to-end due diligence workstreams, including legal, financial, tax, technical/engineering, planning and ESG diligence, working with internal teams and external advisors (lawyers, auditors, consultants, valuers)

Support deal structuring, including joint venture arrangements, SPV structures, earn-outs and financing considerations

Draft and review transaction documents such as term sheets, letters of intent, and investment/board papers, in coordination with legal counsel

Prepare investment committee and board presentations, clearly articulating deal rationale, risks and returns

Stakeholder &Relationship Management

Build and maintain relationships with brokers, agents, joint venture partners, government agencies, financial institutions and other market participants

Liaise with internal stakeholders across finance, legal, development, asset management and operations to align on deal terms and execution requirements

Support negotiations with counterparties, sellers and JV partners under the guidance of senior corporate development leadership

Post-Deal Support

Support integration planning and handover to asset management/development teams following completion

Track post-acquisition performance against underwriting assumptions and flag variances

Requirements

Qualifications &Experience

Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Finance, Business, Economics or a related field; MBA, CFA or equivalent professional qualification is an advantage

5–8 years of relevant experience in corporate development, M&A, investment banking, real estate private equity,or real estate investment/development, with direct exposure to real estate transactions

Demonstrated track record of supporting or executing property acquisitions, joint ventures, or portfolio transactions

Familiarity with real estate asset classes (residential, commercial, retail, industrial/logistics, hospitality)and REIT/fund investment structures is highly valued

Skills & Competencies

Strong financial modelling and valuation skills, including DCF, residual land value and comparable transaction analysis

Solid understanding of real estate fundamentals, market cycles and development economics

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear, concise materials for senior management and investment committees

Strong negotiation andrelationship-management skills

Close attention to detail and strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deals concurrently under tight timelines

Proficiency in Excel-based financial modelling and PowerPoint; familiarity with real estate/finance data platforms

A collaborative, proactive mindset with sound commercial judgement and the ability to work effectively across teams and cultures

title: Relationship Manager — Private Banker
description:
About SeedRock

SeedRock Asia Pte. Ltd. is a Monetary Authority of Singapore regulated multi-family office and licensed fund manager (CMS100959), serving ultra-high-net-worth families and institutional clients across two practice pillars: Private Wealth and Family Governance, and Institutional Mandates.

Our positioning is deliberate: Institutional Sovereignty — the corporate office for your family. We exist to give UHNW principals the governance discipline, investment rigour, and institutional infrastructure ordinarily reserved for sovereign wealth funds and the largest endowments, applied at the scale of a single family or a small group of families.

SeedRock is independent. We hold no proprietary product, carry no distribution agenda, and answer only to the families and institutions that retain us. Our Relationship Managers are bankers in the fullest sense — trusted advisers entrusted with the totality of a client relationship — but they operate inside a firm built for permanence rather than a sales floor built for quarterly volume.

The Role

We are looking for an established private banking professional to join SeedRock as a senior Relationship Manager, bringing an existing, portable ultra-high-net-worth client base into a platform built specifically to serve that calibre of client without the conflicts of a balance-sheet bank.

This is a senior, client-facing mandate. You will be the primary point of contact for your principals, responsible for the full relationship: investment advisory, structured solutions, family governance conversations, and coordination with SeedRock's internal investment, risk, and compliance functions on your clients' behalf. You will operate with the autonomy of a private banker and the backing of an institutional platform.

The successful candidate will be someone for whom the move to SeedRock represents a genuine upgrade in client outcomes — not a lateral change of letterhead.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and grow a portfolio of ultra-high-net-worth client relationships, acting as principal adviser across investment, credit, and family governance matters

• Migrate an existing portable client book (minimum USD 30 million) onto the SeedRock platform within an agreed onboarding period

• Originate and structure investment solutions in partnership with SeedRock's Investment and Strategic Finance and Risk functions, spanning discretionary mandates, structured products, and direct fund allocations

• Lead client conversations on family governance, succession, and institutionalisation — converting personal-relationship-based holdings into structured, multi-generational arrangements where appropriate

• Maintain full ownership of client suitability, KYC, and ongoing due diligence in coordination with Compliance

• Represent SeedRock's institutional positioning consistently — clients should experience continuity of judgement and process, not dependence on a single individual

• Contribute to the firm's broader institutionalisation agenda: converting personal trust into SeedRock-level trust through SMA structures, governance services, and multi-touchpoint client coverage

Candidate Profile

• A minimum of eight years' private banking or wealth management experience at a recognised institution, with a demonstrated track record managing ultra-high-net-worth relationships

• An active, portable client book with minimum AUM of USD 30 million, capable of transitioning within a reasonable onboarding window

• Direct experience advising on structured products, discretionary portfolios, and cross-asset solutions for sophisticated private clients

• A consultative, advice-led approach to client management — comfortable operating without proprietary product pressure

• Existing familiarity with Singapore and regional UHNW client segments; Mandarin or other regional language proficiency an advantage

• Unblemished regulatory record and clean professional history, verifiable through standard background and reference checks

Compensation

This role is structured for a senior, established private banker and is priced accordingly. Compensation is salary-led, providing income stability during the client transition period, with a retrocession override on revenue generated from your migrated and newly originated book.

• Fixed base salary of SGD 15,000 per month or higher, calibrated to portable book size and seniority

• Retrocession override on AUM-generated revenue, payable quarterly, in addition to base salary

• Discretionary annual bonus tied to client retention, book growth, and institutionalisation outcomes

• This structure does not carry an equity or partnership component — it is designed for certainty of income against a high, de-risked base, distinct from SeedRock's commission-led RM tracks

Why SeedRock

• A genuinely open-architecture platform — no proprietary product agenda, no balance-sheet conflicts

• Direct access to SeedRock's CIO, Strategic Finance and Risk function, and governance specialists on every client mandate

• An institutional brand built specifically for the UHNW family office segment, not a retail-down private bank

• A compensation structure designed for stability during transition, not a cliff-edge commission model

To Apply

Please submit your CV in confidence. All applications are handled with strict discretion; no contact will be made with current employers at any stage of the process.

Founded in 2018 as a family office and External Asset Manager, we have rapidly evolved into a prominent player in Singapore’s financial landscape. Our mission is to assist high net-worth individuals and families navigate the ever-changing macro-economic landscape. In the dynamic and complex world of finance, we are our client’s partner in safeguarding and growing our client wealth.

We are thrilled to announce our transformation from a Multi-Family Office into a Full-Fledged Fund Management Company. This transition underscores our commitment to providing comprehensive, sophisticated, and tailored investment solutions to our clients. With a strong track record of success, a seasoned team of experts, and a deep understanding of the global financial markets, we are our client go-to partner for managing and growing our client’s wealth.

title: Legal Counsel (In-house)

title: Social Media Sales Consultant
description:
Job Description

About Us

We help interior design and renovation firms in Singapore grow — through lead generation, branding, and marketing programmes that bring them qualified homeowners and stronger market positioning. Our clients don't just buy a service from us once; they grow with us across tiers as their firms scale. That only works when someone closes the right clients — and then owns the relationship after the first close.

That someone is you.

About the Role

This is a fully remote role.

You'll work from wherever you work best — no daily commute, no office face-time. What matters is that your clients feel looked after and your accounts grow. You'll meet clients over video calls (with the occasional in-person session if a key relationship calls for it), and stay connected to the team through our daily rhythms online.

This is a closing role first, a relationship role always.

You'll start by building your own book of business: running sales conversations with interior design firms, diagnosing where their business is stuck, and closing them into the right programme. Every deal you close becomes an account you own — and from there, your job is to make each relationship deeper, longer, and more valuable over time.

The more you close early on, the bigger the portfolio you manage — and the more your recurring income compounds through renewals, tier upgrades, and referrals. You are the person our clients trust from the very first call, the one who checks in before they have to ask, and the reason they sign, renew, upgrade, and refer.

What You'll Do

Run discovery and sales calls with interior design and renovation firms — diagnosing their growth bottlenecks and closing them into the programme that fits

Manage your own sales pipeline end to end: qualification, follow-ups, objection handling, and closing, with clear monthly targets

Own every account you close as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor

Run regular check-ins and performance reviews with clients — walking them through their results, diagnosing bottlenecks, and recommending next steps

Drive renewals by ensuring clients see and understand the value they're getting throughout the programme, not just at renewal time

Identify and develop expansion opportunities — helping clients climb to higher programme tiers when their business is ready for it

Generate referrals naturally by building the kind of relationship people recommend to their peers

Work with our internal teams to resolve client issues quickly and keep promises made during the sales process

Maintain accurate account records, follow-up rhythms, and relationship health tracking in our CRM

Who You Are

2+ years in B2B sales, account management, or client success — with a track record of hitting sales targets and closing deals

A closer who thinks long-term: you know how to drive a deal to a decision, but you close clients you can grow, not just deals you can win

A natural relationship builder — the close is the start of the relationship, not the end of it

Consistent with follow-through: you do what you say, on time, every time

A clear communicator who can explain performance data and business concepts simply, in person and in writing

Commercially sharp — you can spot an upsell or referral opportunity without making the client feel sold to

Organised and self-directed: you manage your own portfolio, pipeline of renewals, and follow-up cadence

Proven ability to work independently in a remote setup — you stay responsive, structured, and visible without anyone looking over your shoulder

Bonus: experience in or exposure to the interior design, renovation, real estate, or home services industry

Why Join Us

100% remote

— you're measured on client outcomes, not hours at a desk

Base salary + commissions on every deal you close, plus recurring incentives on retention, renewals, and account growth — your income compounds as your portfolio grows

Build your own book of business from day one, backed by proven sales scripts, frameworks, and playbooks — you close it, you keep it, you grow it

Clear frameworks, playbooks, and training on how we sell, manage, and grow accounts

A front-row seat to how design and renovation businesses in Singapore scale

To Apply

Reach out directly to our Head of Sales, Nigel:

WhatsApp: +65 9061 4389

Only candidates who reach out via WhatsApp will be contacted — a short intro message telling us who you are and why this role fits you is all it takes to start the conversation.

Founded with a focus on results, we work closely with interior design professionals across Singapore to deliver marketing solutions that are measurable, scalable, and built around the needs of a competitive market. Our platform is designed to reduce the time and cost of client acquisition for interior design firms, allowing them to focus on what they do best — delivering exceptional spaces.

At Network Singapore, we believe in building long-term partnerships with our clients. Our team combines deep industry knowledge with a data-driven approach to ensure that every firm on our platform gets maximum visibility and genuine business opportunities.

We are a growing company with a performance-driven culture, committed to developing talent from within and building a team that takes pride in delivering results.

title: Leisure Travel Advisor
description:
As a Leisure Travel Advisor, you will be responsible for assisting clients in planning and organizing their travel experiences, while also providing operational and administrative support for products (including GSA, wholesaling, visa, and others).

You will design customized itineraries, coordinate travel logistics, manage bookings, and ensure a seamless and memorable travel experience for clients. This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a good understanding of travel destinations and products.

Key Responsibilities

· Gather and assess client requirements (e.g. budget, travel duration, accommodation preferences, meal requirements, and special requests) when handling new enquiries.

· Liaise effectively with suppliers and partners to develop tailored itineraries and quotations, while negotiating for the most competitive rates and value-added inclusions.

· Provide administrative and operational support to the department, including handling phone and email enquiries, preparing quotations and invoices, and coordinating collection of deposits and final payments.

· Manage client queries, requests, and feedback promptly and professionally to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction and service excellence.

· Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal stakeholders, external clients, and travel partners (e.g. airlines, hotels, tour operators).

· Support visa application processes where required, including documentation checks, coordination with embassies/agents, and ensuring timely submission.

· Assist in sales-related activities, including responding to sales leads, preparing proposals, and identifying opportunities to upsell or cross-sell travel products and services.

· Participate in client visits, travel fairs, and meetings with corporate clients or agents to strengthen relationships and support business development efforts.

· Collaborate with agents and partners to facilitate smooth bookings and ensure alignment on client requirements and service delivery.

· Be prepared to work extended hours during peak travel seasons, major projects, or travel fairs as required.

title: Community Engagement Manager (Partnership, Research & Evaluation)
description:
Job Description & Requirements:

Yellow Ribbon Community Project (YRCP), managed by Singapore Anti-Narcotics Association (SANA) is an island-wide programme that mobilising volunteers to support families impacted by incarceration. The applicant is expected to drive the formation of localised networks across Singapore based on the Collective Impact (CI) model to convene a committed group of stakeholders to review and improve the current support services.

Responsibilities

:

Strategic Coordination & Alignment

Facilitate discussions on systemic issues and landscape mapping to align understanding of challenges

Address implementation challenges, perform sense-making function and facilitate joint efforts in solutioning and resourcing

Ensure strategic coherence by supporting YRCP team and partners in right-siting as well as coordinating joint strategies to contribute to the Common Agenda

Research & Data Management

Assist in overseeing data collection, tracking of output indicators, and analysis of progress and outcomes of YRCP

Support the development and refinement of shared measurement indicators

Document the learning process and insights gathered from localised network partners

Stakeholder & Partnership Engagement

Build and maintain strong relationships with community partners through regular engagements

Coordinate joint activities and align strategies across partners

Lead working group discussions and conduct outreach to follow up on partner progress

Community Engagement

Actively engage grassroot organizations, government agencies, volunteers and social service agencies

Main Coordinator for engagement work related to forming and sustaining of the localised networks

Community Outreach

Actively participate in the process of research, planning, implementation and evaluation for programmes to strengthen family support, mitigate intergenerational offending and improve reintegration outcomes for successful desistance

Facilitate effective communication between partners

Accurately capture key decisions and outcomes from discussions, maintain appropriate filing/archiving measures

Plan and manage stakeholder engagements and prepare summary reports on progress

Work independently and as a team to meet the operational functions of the Community Engagement Team

Good team player and pleasant disposition

Strong conceptual and organizational abilities

Strong interpersonal, communication, presentation and writing skills

Mature, independent and positive work attitude

Strong stakeholder management and engagement skills

Good project management abilities

Strong research & analytical skills

Strong technical proficiency

Event Planning

Strong passion in working with the community

Good understanding of the principles of corrections and successful desistance

Experience in the social service or family support landscape

The Singapore Anti-Narcotics Association (SANA) is a Social Service Agency formed in 1972 to prevent drug-abuse in Singapore by raising awareness of the dangers of drug and substance abuse as well as to provide counselling and aftercare services where necessary.

title: Assistant Manager/Manager, Organisation, Board & Leadership Services
description:

By engaging individuals, organisations, communities and leaders across the people, private and public sectors, we seek to create a more caring, inclusive, and compassionate society. Together, we envision Singapore as a City of Good, where everyone is able to give every day and everywhere (3Es), contributing their time, talent, treasure, ties and testimony (5Ts). The Organisation, Board and Leadership Services team partners with charities and non-profits to innovate new giving models and support channels that strengthen their capacity to drive volunteerism and philanthropy in response to societal needs. title: Manager, Programmes, Secretariat to MigrantWell Singapore
description:
The Manager for Programmes will support the MigrantWell Singapore Secretariat in developing, managing and growing a portfolio of care gap programmes and grants that address the needs and well-being of migrant workers in Singapore.

The role combines programme management, partnership development, grant administration, research, stakeholder engagement and governance support. The successful candidate will be expected to take ownership of assigned programmes from research and design through implementation, evaluation and growth, while ensuring strong partner relationships, sound grant management and clear reporting of impact.

Key Responsibilities

1. Programme Development & Management
Manage a portfolio of care gap programmes and grants, covering research, programme design, implementation, evaluation and growth planning.
Identify opportunities to strengthen existing programmes and develop new programme components to meet emerging needs and organisational targets.
Translate research, stakeholder insights and beneficiary needs into practical programme recommendations.
Draft and manage programme-related funding agreements, MOUs and other partnership documentation.
Monitor programme delivery, milestones, outcomes and risks, ensuring timely follow-through and corrective action where required
Develop and refine programme performance indicators and metrics to support continuous improvement and demonstrate impact.
2. Partner & Stakeholder Management
Build and cultivate strong working relationships with programme partners, corporates, community organisations, government agencies, healthcare institutions and other stakeholders.
Anticipate partner needs and represent MigrantWell Singapore professionally across meetings, communications and engagements.
Lead partner meetings and engagements, including preparing agendas, facilitating discussions, providing recommendations and ensuring clear follow-through on agreed actions.
Identify opportunities to deepen partnerships and expand the reach and impact of MigrantWell programmes.
3. Governance & Secretariat Support
Lead the planning and coordination of two Programme Committee meetings annually, including agenda development, papers, logistics, member availability and follow-up actions.
Support the Head of Secretariat in the preparation and conduct of two Board meetings annually, including board papers, meeting coordination and follow-up.
Prepare clear and accurate reports, presentations, programme updates and impact statements for the Programme Committee, Board and other senior stakeholders.

Maintain proper documentation and records relating to programme decisions, partnerships, grants and governance matters.

4. Grant & Financial Management
Manage grant disbursements and compliance in accordance with approved funding terms and programme plans.
Track budget utilisation against approved budgets and milestones, identifying and escalating variances, risks or potential compliance issues promptly.
Prepare accurate financial and narrative reports, templates and supporting documentation for funders and stakeholders.
Ensure timely completion of fortnightly management updates and other required programme reporting.
Clean, maintain and analyse data to support accurate reporting of the number and profile of companies benefiting from care gap programmes.

Requirements

Degree in social sciences, public policy, business, communications, community development, or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in programme management, grants management, partnerships, social impact, philanthropy, community development or a related field.
Demonstrated experience managing projects or programmes from planning through implementation and evaluation.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to engage corporates, government agencies, community organisations and senior stakeholders.
Strong writing, presentation and facilitation skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear recommendations and reports.
Comfortable working with budgets, programme data, reporting requirements and grant compliance.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, particularly in managing multiple stakeholders, deadlines and workstreams.
Able to work independently, exercise sound judgement and proactively identify issues and solutions.
Experience in migrant worker issues, mental health, healthcare, social services or other social impact areas would be an advantage.

title: Senior IT Project Manager - #1662
description:
As a Senior Project Manager, you will be working on:

• Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex digital products or ICT initiatives, aligning user needs, business outcomes, delivery priorities, technical constraints and operational readiness.

• Lead project governance across predictive, agile or hybrid delivery models, including sprint and release governance, critical-path management, key dependencies and timely management decisions.

• Establish and maintain integrated project plans, consolidated RAID and dependency views, recovery actions and outcome measures, and intervene where delivery performance is at risk.

• Provide release assurance for major implementations by overseeing system, user and security testing, defect-risk decisions, cutover readiness, operational handover and post-release stabilisation.

• Shape user-adoption and stakeholder-engagement approaches for significant releases and direct the resolution of material product or operational issues with product and engineering leads.

• Lead the management of significant maintenance and service contracts, including performance, service levels, commercial obligations, renewal or extension options, service credits and supplier accountability.

• Advise on procurement and contracting approaches and lead the preparation or review of tender specifications, Approval of Requirements, evaluation recommendations, contract variations and direct contracting justifications.

• Participate in significant vendor negotiations and provide evidence-based recommendations on contract scope, commercial exposure and approval risks.

• Establish forward-looking licence, subscription and technology-lifecycle plans covering renewal, end of support, upgrade sequencing, dependency risk and continuity of support.

• Oversee vulnerability remediation, security patching and follow-up of security findings, and escalate material delays or residual risks to the appropriate governance forum.

• Oversee project and annual budget planning, commitments, forecasts, actual expenditure, OOE funding drawdowns and funding sufficiency, and recommend corrective or reprioritisation options where required.

• Provide robust review and challenge of vendor proposals, contract variations, rate-card application and service-request man-day estimates, including identification of duplication, unsupported contingency or inefficient role mix.

• Prioritise and govern major service requests and changes for assigned systems against business value, operational risk, dependencies, capacity and available funding.

• Lead or support steering and senior governance forums as required, present clear options and recommendations to management, and facilitate resolution of cross-functional or supplier disputes.

• Mentor less-experienced project managers where required, contribute reusable project and contract controls, and support lessons learned and continuous improvement.

What we are looking for:

• At least 7 years of experience relevant to the Project Manager job role.

• A proven track record leading complex ICT projects, digital products or major maintenance workstreams from planning and procurement through implementation, transition and operations.

• Demonstrated delivery of effective products and project outcomes under material resource, schedule

or operational constraints.

• End-to-end leadership experience across product, engineering, operations, cybersecurity, procurement, finance and service-provider teams.

• Experience establishing integrated plans, project governance, management reporting and recovery actions across multiple interdependent workstreams.

• Strong experience managing public-sector or comparable regulated procurement and contract activities, including requirements, evaluations, AOR, contract variations, direct contracting and commercial discussions.

• Strong commercial judgment in contract interpretation, vendor performance, service credits, invoice validation, rate-card application, change control and man-day governance.

• Experience managing project or annual budget planning, expenditure forecasting, funding sufficiency and financial recommendations to management.

• Experience establishing licence and technology-lifecycle plans and overseeing end-of-support upgrades, vulnerability remediation and security patch compliance.

• Ability to critically review vendor scope, assumptions and effort estimates and recommend sound commercial and delivery positions.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including management papers, technical writing, governance presentations and engagement with senior stakeholders.

• A highly meticulous, resilient and outcomes-focused approach, with the ability to lead under pressure, resolve ambiguity and drive complex matters to closure.

• Demonstrated ability to tailor predictive, agile and hybrid project-management practices to project risk and governance needs.

Preferred requirements:

• Current PMP or PRINCE2 Practitioner certification; PMI-ACP or an advanced agile credential is advantageous where the candidate has applied it on complex or hybrid ICT initiatives.

• Proven experience leading complex ICT projects or high-impact maintenance workstreams involving multiple vendors, contracts or interdependent technical and business workstreams.

• Experience presenting delivery, financial, contractual and risk recommendations to senior management, steering committees or equivalent governance forums.

• Experience leading substantial Singapore Government or comparable public-sector procurement activities, including evaluation recommendations, AOR, contract variations or direct contracting submissions.

• Experience handling significant vendor-performance and commercial discussions involving contract scope, service levels, rate cards, cost optimisation or remedial actions.

• Experience establishing integrated governance controls such as consolidated schedules, RAID and dependency management, budget forecasting and management dashboards across complex

workstreams.

• Experience overseeing annual project budgets, funding sufficiency and expenditure reprioritisation, with the ability to provide clear financial recommendations to management.

• Experience leading major licence-renewal, end-of-support, platform-upgrade, cloud-migration or technology-modernisation planning across business, technical, security and vendor teams.

• Experience mentoring project managers, improving project or contract-management practices and contributing reusable templates, controls or lessons learned.

• Strong proficiency with

Microsoft Project or equivalent scheduling tools, Jira and Confluence or Azure DevOps, SharePoint, Excel and Power BI for integrated planning and senior-management reporting.

• ITIL 4 certification or relevant cloud, security or governance credentials is advantageous where supported by practical service-management or technology-risk experience.

title: Assistant Relationship Manager - Global Transportation, Global Corporate Banking
description:

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

Why Join

The Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) plays a key role within the Global Transportation team of the Global Corporate Bank, providing essential support to the Relationship Manager (RM) and Business Head (BH) across day-to-day operations, client servicing, and relationship management activities. The role involves active participation in a wide range of transactions and client engagements, working closely with external clients while also collaborating with various internal departments to ensure seamless execution and delivery of banking solutions.

How you succeed

To succeed in this role, the candidate should be a fast learner who can quickly adapt to new situations and work effectively with minimal supervision. The ARM should possess strong numerical aptitude and an analytical mindset, enabling them to assess information critically and support business decision-making. In addition, the ideal candidate will demonstrate excellent interpersonal and communication skills, coupled with a client-focused and service-oriented approach to building and maintaining strong customer relationships.

What you do

1. Assist the RM in managing a portfolio of corporate clients, building strong relationships with clients through regular communication.

2. Conduct regular client meetings to understand their business goals and challenges.

3. Collaborate with product specialists to deliver tailored financial solutions.

4. Drive account strategies to achieve business targets, collaborating with overseas colleagues and product partners, as well as supporting units of the Bank to cross-sell trade, treasury, cash management, capital markets products.

5. Provide exceptional client service, responding to client queries and resolving issues promptly.

6. Assist RM on preparation of credit papers, financial analysis, and post-credit approval activities including follow up with the clients on covenants, exceptions, insurance renewals, trade/treasury excesses, drafting and coordinating of Letters of Offer, Letters of Advice and Syndicated Facility Agreements.

7. Working with Compliance and support end-to-end onboarding and periodic review activities in accordance with regulatory requirements including handling Account Opening KYC Questionnaire and follow up with clients on documents.

8. Identify opportunities across the entire value chain in Singapore and overseas markets, and cross-selling opportunities to enhance client satisfaction and support revenue growth.

Who you are

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, such as business, finance, economics or accountancy.

Minimum 3 - 5 years’ working experience in corporate banking or a related field.

Ability to think strategically and work collaboratively.

Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

Some knowledge of financial products and services, including corporate lending, treasury, cash management.

Good team player. Self-motivated, pro-active, growth mindset and able to work in a fast-paced environment.

Who you work with

Global Corporate Banking takes a partnership approach to helping large companies achieve their potential. Working internationally. Across multiple industries. Our teams grow their industry-specific expertise delivering business-building services. Financing. Cash management. Trade. And Treasury solutions. Right now, we’re actively evolving our digital and sustainability model. This includes developing our people through a continuous learning culture. And that includes you.

What we offer:

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

title: Director of Marketing, APAC
description:
About the role

As the Director of Marketing, APAC, you'll drive full funnel marketing initiatives, brand awareness and commercial impact.

In this role, you’ll own the marketing strategy and execution across our growing Asia-Pacific portfolio — spanning existing markets and new launches across the region.

You will work closely with global leaders, senior APAC leadership, regional General Managers and Sales. You will lead a small, on-the-ground APAC marketing team and serve as the senior marketing authority for the region. This role demands a rare combination: a performance-oriented digital marketer who can drive measurable revenue impact and a hands-on brand leader who thrives in the operational complexity of launching and growing physical, experiential locations.

You are the critical connective tissue between APAC market realities and global marketing strategy — translating local intelligence into decisions that move the needle on leads, occupancy, and brand awareness.

You will report directly to the Vice President of Marketing (US-based) with a dotted-line reporting relationship tothe Managing Director, APAC.

What you’ll do

Digital Performance & Revenue Marketing

• Own regional digital marketing performance end-to-end — managing paid channels (Google, LinkedIn, Meta, and region-specific platforms) directly for APAC, with a Performance Marketing Manager as a direct report.

• You set the strategy, control the budget, and are accountable for results. The global paid media team serves in an advisory capacity, but execution, optimization, and performance decisions live with you and your team.

• Bring deep fluency in digital performance metrics: you know what good looks like, ask the right questions, and hold the team accountable to APAC-specific outcomes.

• Build and maintain tight feedback loops between marketing, sales, and unit operations to ensure demand generation directly supports occupancy goals and revenue targets.

• Report regularly to the Central Corporate Marketing and senior regional stakeholders on marketing performance, pipeline contribution, and ROI.

Overall Marketing Strategy (incl Content, Partnerships, Events)

• Own regional marketing strategy and work closely with APAC Creative and Content Lead to oversee content strategy, ensuring campaigns, messaging, and assets are locally relevant, on-brand, and commercially effective.

• Develop strategic partnerships (e.g. Chambers of Commerce, industry associations, brokers, local businesses) to grow visibility

• Lead activations and events to drive brand awareness, engagement, and qualified demand

• Support Sales leadership on broker marketing and enterprise outreach using global content adapted for local relevance

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

• Develop and manage a lean APAC marketing team,acting as both a strategic coach and a hands-on contributor when needed.

• Build deeply collaborative relationships with regional Sales Leads, General Managers, and Unit Operations teams — functioning as an integrated partner, not a siloed function.

• Guide local teams in developing high-value strategic partnerships (Chambers of Commerce, industry associations, brokernetworks, local businesses) that drive visibility and qualified prospect traffic.

• Partner with regional Sales leadership to support broker marketing and enterprise outreach, leveraging globally produced content with local customization.

Brand, PR & Agency Oversight

• Manage local agencies and freelancers (PR,creative, translation, events) as needed to fill capacity gaps and ensure excellence in execution.

• Coordinate with the US Corporate Brand team on high-visibility PR announcements, creative asset requests, and brand campaigns,ensuring global quality standards are maintained across all APAC markets.

• Serve as a senior brand ambassador for Industrious and Industrious in the region — capable of representing the company's vision clearly and compellingly to media, partners, and prospects.

Go-to-Market Leadership for Regional Launches

• Own and evolve the GTM marketing playbook for newmarket and location launches across APAC, adapting global frameworks for local relevance across varied markets and languages.

Who you are

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business,or a related field; advanced degree a plus

• 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, with at least 3 years in a senior or leadership role

• Background in experiential real estate (flexible office, hospitality, gyms, or related industries) preferred

• Digital performance marketing expertise(paid search, paid social, SEO, lead generation) with demonstrated impact onrevenue and pipeline

• Experience across APAC markets

• Proven experience leading regional marketing teams within a global organization

• Experience partnering with sales teams to drive demand, pipeline, and measurable business outcomes

• Experience managing GTM launches for physical locations

• Proven ability to hire, coach, and scale regional, distributed marketing teams

• Willingness to travel 2–3 times per quarter within APAC and periodically to the US

Qualities

• Strong strategic thinking with a hands-on, execution-focused mindset

• Ability to balance global standards with local market nuances

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills (especially with sales, ops, and creative teams)

• High level of operational rigor and ability to manage complex, multi-market initiatives

• Ability to synthesize market complexity across countries, languages, and buyer behaviors into clear, actionable insights

• Effective leadership in multicultural,distributed team environments

What’s in it for you

• Career progression

• 5-day work week (some weekends or evenings when there is an event)

• Monthly mobile allowance

• Flexible benefits for medical and other approved wellness, healthcare activities etc.

• Beautiful workplace environment that fosters collaboration and interactions with others from a diverse background of cultures

• Opportunity to work with various teams across regional locations

You will operate in both banker and investor capacity, handle and coordinate with various teams on account inquiries and investment-related aspects, and deliver strategic messages to your portfolio. You will also collaborate with other team members to provide high-quality client service and ensure compliance with all regulatory and internal policies.

Support and manage all aspects of client relationships across the team; develop and maintain long-term relationships through professional/personal networks and contacts.
Operate in both banker and investor capacity, and handle/coordinate with various teams on both overall account inquiries/maintenance as well as on investment-related aspects.
Articulate and deliver strategic messages to their portfolio, prepare presentations and proposals, and take both solicited and unsolicited orders in all asset classes. Update clients regularly on markets, portfolio performance, investments opportunities, risks.

title: Manager, Partnerships, Climate & Food Systems (2-year contract)
description:
About WWF

WWF-Singapore World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF) is one of the world’s largest and most respected independent conservation organisations. WWF’s mission is to stop the degradation of the earth’s natural environment and to build a future in which humans live in harmony with nature. As one of WWF’s international hubs, WWF-Singapore supports a global network spanning over 100 countries. WWF Singapore works closely with local stakeholders towards a greener and more sustainable Singapore and the region around us. We work to address key conservation areas, such as climate change, sustainable finance, deforestation, illegal wildlife trade, marine conservation, and sustainable production and consumption, through collaboration, education and outreach efforts involving the community, businesses, and governments. For more information, please visit wwf.sg.

Overview

WWF-Singapore is seeking a Partnerships Manager to develop and manage strategic partnerships for its Climate Finance programmes, with a primary focus on its Climate Resilient Rice/Food Coalition.

The role will identify, onboard and steward partners across the private sector, financial institutions, government, philanthropy and other organisations, helping to build a strong coalition that can mobilise finance and collective action for climate-resilient and low-carbon food systems across Southeast Asia.

Key Responsibilities

1. Partnership Development & Onboarding

Identify and engage prospective partners for the Climate Resilient Rice/Food Coalition.

Develop compelling partnership propositions, proposals and engagement materials.

Lead prospective partners from initial engagement through onboarding and formalisation of partnerships.

Identify opportunities for partners to contribute through finance, technical expertise, market access, procurement and other forms of collaboration.

2. Partner Stewardship

Manage relationships with a portfolio of partners and serve as their primary WWF point of contact.

Maintain regular engagement with partners and identify opportunities to deepen collaboration.

Coordinate with WWF programme and technical teams to ensure effective delivery of partnership commitments.

Prepare partnership updates, reports and briefings as required.

3. Coalition Development & Engagement

Support the growth and development of the Climate Resilient Rice/Food Coalition as an effective regional multi-stakeholder platform.

Engage coalition members and facilitate collaboration across businesses, financial institutions, governments, technical organisations and civil society.

Coordinate coalition meetings, roundtables, workshops and other partner engagements.

Identify opportunities for joint initiatives that can mobilise finance and scale climate-resilient and low-carbon agriculture.

4. Programme Development

Support the development of sustainable food programmes and related carbon finance programmes.

Represent WWF-Singapore at relevant external engagements and industry forums.

Qualifications & Experience

title: Senior/Executive, Business Development & Partnerships

Singapore Environment Council (SEC)

Senior/Executive, Business Development & Partnerships

Grow a business that directly advances Singapore's sustainability goals.

Work with organisations across multiple industries to drive positive environmental impact.

Build expertise in sustainability certifications and environmental standards.

Opportunities for professional development and career growth.

Diversity & Inclusion

title: Marketing Sales Consultant (Remote)
description:
Job Description

About Us

We help interior design and renovation firms in Singapore grow — through lead generation, branding, and marketing programmes that bring them qualified homeowners and stronger market positioning. Our clients don't just buy a service from us once; they grow with us across tiers as their firms scale. That only works when someone closes the right clients — and then owns the relationship after the first close.

That someone is you.

About the Role

This is a fully remote role.

You'll work from wherever you work best — no daily commute, no office face-time. What matters is that your clients feel looked after and your accounts grow. You'll meet clients over video calls (with the occasional in-person session if a key relationship calls for it), and stay connected to the team through our daily rhythms online.

This is a closing role first, a relationship role always.

You'll start by building your own book of business: running sales conversations with interior design firms, diagnosing where their business is stuck, and closing them into the right programme. Every deal you close becomes an account you own — and from there, your job is to make each relationship deeper, longer, and more valuable over time.

The more you close early on, the bigger the portfolio you manage — and the more your recurring income compounds through renewals, tier upgrades, and referrals. You are the person our clients trust from the very first call, the one who checks in before they have to ask, and the reason they sign, renew, upgrade, and refer.

What You'll Do

Run discovery and sales calls with interior design and renovation firms — diagnosing their growth bottlenecks and closing them into the programme that fits

Manage your own sales pipeline end to end: qualification, follow-ups, objection handling, and closing, with clear monthly targets

Own every account you close as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor

Run regular check-ins and performance reviews with clients — walking them through their results, diagnosing bottlenecks, and recommending next steps

Drive renewals by ensuring clients see and understand the value they're getting throughout the programme, not just at renewal time

Identify and develop expansion opportunities — helping clients climb to higher programme tiers when their business is ready for it

Generate referrals naturally by building the kind of relationship people recommend to their peers

Work with our internal teams to resolve client issues quickly and keep promises made during the sales process

Maintain accurate account records, follow-up rhythms, and relationship health tracking in our CRM

Who You Are

2+ years in B2B sales, account management, or client success — with a track record of hitting sales targets and closing deals

A closer who thinks long-term: you know how to drive a deal to a decision, but you close clients you can grow, not just deals you can win

A natural relationship builder — the close is the start of the relationship, not the end of it

Consistent with follow-through: you do what you say, on time, every time

A clear communicator who can explain performance data and business concepts simply, in person and in writing

Commercially sharp — you can spot an upsell or referral opportunity without making the client feel sold to

Organised and self-directed: you manage your own portfolio, pipeline of renewals, and follow-up cadence

Proven ability to work independently in a remote setup — you stay responsive, structured, and visible without anyone looking over your shoulder

Bonus: experience in or exposure to the interior design, renovation, real estate, or home services industry

Why Join Us

100% remote

— you're measured on client outcomes, not hours at a desk

Base salary + commissions on every deal you close, plus recurring incentives on retention, renewals, and account growth — your income compounds as your portfolio grows

Build your own book of business from day one, backed by proven sales scripts, frameworks, and playbooks — you close it, you keep it, you grow it

Clear frameworks, playbooks, and training on how we sell, manage, and grow accounts

A front-row seat to how design and renovation businesses in Singapore scale

To Apply

Reach out directly to our Head of Sales, Nigel:

WhatsApp: +65 9061 4389

Only candidates who reach out via WhatsApp will be contacted — a short intro message telling us who you are and why this role fits you is all it takes to start the conversation.

Founded with a focus on results, we work closely with interior design professionals across Singapore to deliver marketing solutions that are measurable, scalable, and built around the needs of a competitive market. Our platform is designed to reduce the time and cost of client acquisition for interior design firms, allowing them to focus on what they do best — delivering exceptional spaces.

title: Communications & Marketing Executive
description:
About the Role:

The Communications & Marketing Executive plays a vital role in promoting Practice and its programmes, as well as advocating for the value and importance of Singapore theatre by crafting compelling marketing campaigns and fostering strategic partnerships. Reporting to the managers/lead of the department, you'll work closely with internal and external stakeholders to achieve our organisational goals and objectives, ensuring the success of our diverse programmes and initiatives.

What You'll Do:

Assist the team in brainstorming and executing marketing and publicity strategies for sales, ticketing, and promotions.

Develop and execute comprehensive marketing communication plans across various communication channels, including direct marketing, digital marketing, advertising, etc.

Assist in creating marketing materials, preparing reports, and analysing campaign results.

Develop and manage timelines and project plans for various marketing and publicity initiatives. This includes:

Setting realistic deadlines for each phase of the project

Identifying and managing dependencies between tasks

Monitoring progress and making adjustments as needed

Manage social media strategy and content calendar. Work closely with the team to create content, schedule and publish content consistently, track and analyse key metrics to provide feedback, and respond and engage with the online community.

Develop and foster strategic partnerships with like-minded organisations for increased publicity.

Collaborate with various stakeholders to maintain consistent brand messaging.

Attend regular meetings and contribute ideas and insights to achieve marketing and sales targets.

Communicate effectively with partners and audiences, handle inquiries professionally, and gather feedback for improvement.

Provide administrative support to team members as needed.

Who You Are:

You are passionate about theatre and the performing arts.

You possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

You have strong organisational and time management skills.

You are creative, resourceful, and a team player.

Experience in marketing, communications, or a related field is an advantage.

Proficiency in social media platforms and digital marketing tools is preferred.

Comfortable working across English and Chinese communications, including reviewing bilingual marketing materials.

The Theatre Practice (Practice) is Singapore’s longest-standing professional bilingual theatre institution. Artist-driven and deeply progressive, Practice strives to be an arts space in Singapore that consciously nurtures and empowers people who care about humanity. Over the past 61 years, we have developed and presented works that aim to reflect the richness and complexities of Singapore’s diverse cultures.

Today, we carry on the work of our visionary co-founders and cultural medallion recipients, Kuo Pao Kun and Goh Lay Kuan. Under the helm of current Artistic Director Kuo Jian Hong, Practice continues to shape Singapore’s cultural landscape as the definitive voice in Singapore theatre. Jian Hong is deeply influenced by the importance of play in art-making and under her leadership, Practice has become the embodiment of the irrepressible spirit and fearless experimentation of play.

Practice is motivated by a desire to always respectfully entertain. We have collaborated with Singapore and international artists alike to present a critically-acclaimed repertoire of over 330 productions including musicals, classics, original and experimental works. We have toured extensively in the region. Many of our works have entered the canon of Southeast Asian literature and have been adapted and presented by theatre companies worldwide, presenting an authentically Singaporean voice on the world stage.

Since our inception, Practice has served as a cultural bridge between Asia and the world. Our current theatre festival – M1 Patch! A Theatre Festival of Artful Play – comes from a legacy of carefully curated festivals and seminars that gather practitioners of all disciplines and cultures for sharing and exchange, while providing a valuable platform for outstanding international works.

As pioneers in Arts Education in Singapore, Practice has been instrumental both in nurturing leaders in the Singapore arts scene, and inculcating a love for the arts in generations of Singapore youth.

Artistically diverse and constantly relevant, Practice will always engage with the ceaseless exploration of new frontiers.

The Theatre Practice is an Institution of Public Character, a recipient of the National Arts Council’s Major Grant 2017-2020, and a member of the Singapore Chinese Language Theatre Alliance.

title: Assistant Manager / Manager, Corporate & Industry Partnerships
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

NVPC is the national agency dedicated to growing a culture of volunteerism and philanthropy in Singapore. By engaging individuals, organisations, communities and leaders across the people, private and public sectors, we seek to create a more caring, inclusive, and compassionate society. Together, we envision Singapore as a City of Good, where everyone is able to give every day and everywhere (3Es), contributing their time, talent, treasure, ties and testimony (5Ts). Learn more at nvpc.org.sg.

RESPONSIBILITIES

This role sits in NVPC's Corporate and Industry Partnerships (CIP) department, which drives the Company of Good (COG) initiative — a national platform that supports and recognises companies in Singapore to integrate purpose and social impact into their core business strategies.

Today, there are over 1,000 recognised Companies of Good, helping businesses translate purpose into action across five key impact areas: People, Society, Governance, Environment, and Economic.

As the anchor for this work, NVPC's CIP department plays a pivotal role in shaping and strengthening Singapore's corporate purpose ecosystem — catalysing partnerships and collective impact, with the business community as a driving force for a stronger Singapore.

We are now seeking a purpose-driven and impact-led individual to help advance this national momentum — where both meaningful programme delivery and growing awareness of COG will increasingly become key levers for scaling impact.

In this role, you will support the design, execution and evaluation of programmes and platforms that encourage companies to give and volunteer more, as they embed purpose and impact into how they operate.

Your core work will centre on three key areas: (1) strengthening corporate capabilities in social impact, (2) building and growing the Company of Good community, and (3) scaling impact programmes.

This role works closely with colleagues across CIP to understand what companies are experiencing on the ground, and uses that insight to continuously refine our programmes — ensuring the overall Company of Good journey for firms remains relevant and valuable, not just individual initiatives in isolation.

Strengthen Corporate Capabilities in Social Impact

Support the planning and delivery of our leadership development programmes — spanning different leadership audiences — to enable organisations to volunteer and/or donate better - as one reflection of corporates' purpose journeys

Proactively cultivate new leads through targeted publicity and peer referrals

Follow through (and improve) processes that will create powerful and valuable experiences for participants

Build and Grow the Community

Support the design and facilitation of community-building and engagement efforts within the Company of Good ecosystem e.g. peer learning, networking events, and platforms for programme alumni to connect, share, and deepen their contributions

title: Bid Manager Talent Community
description:

The role of Bid Manager is exceptionally rewarding, and you will work across a broad range of interesting client sectors and internal CBRE stakeholders. You will have attention to detail and a flair for understanding and articulating solutions to client needs and challenges. A blend of strategic, organizational, written and interpersonal skills is crucial for success.

The Bid Manager plays a vital role in driving the success of our organization by working in partnership with the Sales Director and Country/Division sales team to oversee the project management and governance of the sales process, particularly at the Request for Information (RFI) and Request for Proposal (RFP) stages. You may also be required to own and lead top pursuits.

You have exceptional writing skills and may already have bid management experience or are looking to take the next step in your bid management career. Using your natural leadership skills to foster a strong team culture, you will drive up standards up by working closely with Business Development Managers (BDM) and Business Unit Sales Coordinators (BUSC) to ensure differentiated, innovative and client focused proposals are delivered on time and to an exceptional standard.

What you’ll do:

Attracting clients
Guide and encourage BDM and BUSC client research activity to support client cultivation
Assist with preparation of materials for prospective client meetings and presentations
Lead (or support) the coordination of Country/Divisional events by inputting into content, themes and materials
Work with the Strategic Development Lead to support BDMs and BUSC’s develop vertical markets.
RFI and RFP process

Ensure request for information (RFI) questionnaires are submitted to a high standard
Work closely with the sales team to manage proposals from initiation to submission, this will include:
Ensure bid tracker/responsibility matrix is created for every opportunity and team remains organized
Response planning and structuring
Work with BDMs and BUSCs to develop win themes aligned to client needs
Write bespoke bid responses and work closely with the BDM to produce compelling executive summaries
Check and challenge BUSC and BDM content, and contributions from others to ensure written responses clearly articulate differentiation and win themes
Ensure final documents are of the highest quality through design, editing and proof reading
Ensure the team are on track for post proposal activities, helping plan and prepare site visit, presentation and workshop materials.
BUSC community
Build and foster a BUSC community to create a team of high performing sales support, this includes holding weekly BUSC catch ups and workload prioritisation meetings
Help BUSCs build confidence by coaching and development through writing and proposal training, and personal development planning
Support BUSC recruitment, onboarding and succession planning.
Knowledge and process
Work in partnership with the Sales Director and Strategic Development Lead to embed and improve process and knowledge across the Country/Division
Work closely with the team to ensure content library is continuously up to date with professional profiles, account profiles and case studies. Share content with the wider business
Proactively stay up to date with CBRE, industry knowledge and innovations, sharing this information with your team and allowing this knowledge to filter in to bid responses
Maintain a consistent process with BDMS and BUSCs to ensure accurate Salesforce reporting.
Networking and collaboration
Build an internal network across the Bid Manager community to enhance knowledge, share best practice, and collectively benefit from shared insights
Build relationships with operational leaders and support functions.

What you will need:
Degree in Business Studies, Engineering or Economics
Minimum 5 years relevant working experiences
Experience working in a bid management and/or sales environment
Experience writing and managing proposals
Experience of meeting tight deadlines
Experience motivating, training and leading teams
Experience of dealing with and co-operating with a wide range of people.
