title: Business Development Executive
description:
Description

The Business Development Executive supports the growth of HFSE Global Education Group by identifying business opportunities, building strategic partnerships, and increasing enrolment and participation across the Group’s schools, student care services, and educational programmes. The role works closely with Management, Admissions, Marketing, and Academic teams to develop opportunities that align with the Group’s mission, service capacity, and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Development and Growth

Identify and pursue opportunities for student enrolment, programme participation, institutional partnerships, and additional revenue.

Develop and implement business development activities aligned with approved growth plans.

Assess opportunities for new programmes, services, markets, and referral channels.

Prepare business proposals outlining potential benefits, costs, resource requirements, and expected outcomes for Management’s review.

2. Partnerships and Stakeholder Engagement

Establish and maintain relationships with companies, community organisations, education providers, relocation agencies, and other potential partners.

Develop referral arrangements, corporate education packages, and collaborative initiatives, subject to Management’s approval.

Coordinate partnership discussions, proposals, agreements, and follow-up activities.

Monitor partnership outcomes and recommend improvements to strengthen collaboration.

3. Lead Generation and Enrolment Support

Generate qualified leads through outreach, networking, referrals, events, and approved campaigns.

Understand prospective families’ and partners’ needs and recommend suitable HFSE services.

Work with Admissions to ensure timely follow-up and a smooth handover of prospective students and families.

Maintain accurate records of enquiries, leads, opportunities, and follow-up actions in the designated system.

Track lead progression and identify opportunities to improve conversion.

4. Market Research and Planning

Monitor market trends, customer needs, competitor offerings, and potential demand for educational services.

Gather feedback from prospective families and partners to support programme and service improvements.

Provide recommendations on market positioning, outreach priorities, and growth opportunities.

Support the preparation of business development plans and budgets.

5. Marketing and Events Collaboration

Coordinate with Marketing to develop campaigns, presentations, and promotional materials for target audiences.

Support open houses, education fairs, school visits, networking activities, and partnership events.

Represent the Group professionally at approved meetings and external activities.

Ensure communications accurately reflect approved programmes, fees, admission requirements, and services.

6. Reporting and Internal Coordination

Submit regular reports on outreach activities, leads, conversions, partnerships, revenue opportunities, and progress against agreed targets.

Coordinate with relevant teams to confirm service capacity and operational readiness before making commitments.

Maintain complete records of proposals, agreements, and business development activities.

Escalate challenges and risks promptly, with practical recommendations.

Perform other related duties assigned by Management.

Qualification and Selection Criteria

Diploma or degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Education Management, or a related discipline.

Candidates with equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.

Preferably at least two years of experience in business development, sales, partnerships, account management, or student recruitment.

Experience in education, student care, enrichment, training, or other service-based industries is an advantage.

Demonstrated ability to generate leads, manage relationships, and achieve agreed targets.

Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Ability to identify business opportunities and prepare clear, practical proposals.

Good understanding of lead management, customer engagement, and sales conversion.

Ability to conduct market research and interpret performance data.

Strong organisational skills, with consistent and timely follow-through.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with customer relationship management or lead-tracking systems.

Ability to learn and accurately explain the Group’s educational programmes, services, and admission requirements.

Happy Family School of Excellence was born as a concept within the confines of a home-school support group composed of a circle of friends who wanted to survive the challenges of raising a family as migrants in Singapore. Knowing the need for their children to grow secured and confident in a loving and nurturing environment away from their home country, they set up a support system that became an educational safe place for their children. Recognising that many other overseas families needed an alternative school option for their children, Happy Family School of Excellence opened its doors in January 2016 as an enrichment centre for home-schooled children. On the 12th of May 2018, the school opened its arms wide to cater to more children and support more families by becoming HFSE International School, a primary school and a seamless solution for preparatory and enrichment classes.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive (Growth & Solutions)

Fresh graduates with strong drive are welcome to apply.

JOB SUMMARY

At PDS International, we do not hire order-takers. We build commercial athletes.

As we expand across Southeast Asia, we are looking for driven individuals who want to grow with the business - not just hit monthly targets, but build accounts, expand categories, and develop long-term partnerships.

You will be given the platform, tools, training and regional exposure to develop your commercial skills in safety solutions, engineered systems and industrial applications.

This role is ideal for someone hungry to prove themselves, comfortable learning technical products, and serious about building a long-term career in B2B sales.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

You are responsible for generating profitable sales growth, not just order volume.

• Develop structured account growth plans to expand product categories.

• Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities across PPE, engineered solutions and safety systems. Analyse customer purchase behaviour to identify gaps and growth opportunities.

2. Build New Business Pipeline

You are expected to actively hunt for new business. This role requires initiative.

• Develop multi-channel prospecting strategies (calls, referrals, digital outreach, networking, trade events).

• Qualify leads and build a healthy, trackable sales pipeline. Create visibility of opportunities using CRM tools.

You are expected to think beyond transactions.

• Monitor competitor activities and pricing movements. Provide structured feedback to Sales and Marketing for campaign optimisation.

• Understand customer operational challenges and recommend appropriate safety solutions.

You are responsible from lead to payment. You own the outcome.

• Prepare professional proposals, quotations and tender submissions. Conduct product demonstrations and application briefings.

• Coordinate with operations, supply chain and technical teams to ensure smooth fulfilment.

• Monitor back orders and update customers. Take ownership of accounts receivable collections.

5. CRM Discipline & Forecasting

We operate with data visibility. Stats don’t lie.

• Maintain accurate opportunity tracking in CRM. Submit weekly sales activity and pipeline reports.

• Provide rolling 3–6 month sales forecast. Demonstrate accountability for your numbers.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We value attitude over tenure.

• Hungry, driven and resilient. CRM and data disciplined.

• Commercially aware, good at numbers.

• Comfortable speaking to engineers, procurement teams and operations managers.

• Strong communication and presentation skills.

• Curious and willing to self-learn technical products.

Fresh graduates with strong drive are welcome to apply.

WHAT YOU WILL GAIN

• Exposure to industrial and safety technology markets.

• Structured development in B2B commercial selling.

• Growth in this role may lead to regional project exposure.

• Performance-based growth opportunities.

• A fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Hello! You'll be joining a family of People Dedicated to Safety! We're a distributor for PPE, technical services and consumer products!

PPE stands for Personal Protective Equipment, in case you didn't know.

Our HQ is in S'pore, with regional subsidiaries and partners across SE Asia and expanding globally.

So join us, so we can all grow together!

Strong financial acumen, with hands-on experience in cost-benefit analysis, ROI modeling, and partnering with Finance on revenue and cost initiatives.

title: Manager of Investment, Utility Power Projects
description:
Job Description

About Peak Energy

Peak Energy is a clean energy platform that develops, finances, builds, and operates utility-scale solar, rooftop generation, onshore wind, and battery storage solutions across Asia-Pacific. As a fast-growing scale-up, we build on the experience of a team drawn from TotalEnergies, Vestas, Cleantech Energy, and other leading players, combining world-class technical expertise with entrepreneurial agility.

With over 300 MW of operating assets and 1 GW of projects in development across Japan, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, the Philippines, Thailand, Singapore and Indonesia, we are greenfield developers at heart, but we also partner flexibly with industrials, developers, and investors to accelerate delivery and scale impact.

We combine the customer focus of a developer, the technical expertise of an EPC and the financial strength of a heavyweight institution, enabling clients to meet decarbonization targets on time, on budget, and without risk of delivery failure. Peak Energy is wholly owned by Stonepeak, one of the world's leading alternative investment firms specializing in infrastructure and real assets. Our financial and technical strength coupled with our relationships in local markets allows us to optimize our capital deployment in high-quality assets.

Our clients can expect clean energy solutions delivered on time, on budget, and at scale, with no surprises. Let's partner together to support your sustainability journey.

Role Overview

The Associate / Senior Associate, Investments will support the identification, evaluation, development, and execution of utility-scale renewable energy investments across Asia Pacific with a closer line of sight to markets in Malaysia, Thailand, and the Philippines. The role is expected to report directly to the CIO in supporting decision-making for the entire group.

Working closely with colleagues across development, engineering, finance, legal, and external stakeholders, this individual will contribute to greenfield development opportunities, mergers and acquisitions, strategic partnerships, and project financing initiatives. The role offers broad exposure across the investment lifecycle and the opportunity to help grow one of the region's leading renewable energy platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Investment Analysis & Evaluation

· Develop and maintain financial models for renewable energy and infrastructure investments.

· Perform valuation, scenario, sensitivity, and risk analyses to support investment decisions including offtake negotiations, FID decisions and devex initiation / monitoring..

· Assess project economics, commercial assumptions, and potential returns across development and acquisition opportunities.

· Support the preparation of investment recommendations and internal approval materials.

· Preparation of regular reporting material with local team to discuss next quarterly spend profiles and project priorities

Greenfield Development & Opportunity Assessment

· Support the evaluation of greenfield renewable energy opportunities across Southeast Asia.

· Conduct market, commercial, and regulatory research to identify attractive investment opportunities.

· Work closely with development teams to assess project viability and investment attractiveness.

· Monitor industry trends, power markets, and competitive activity across the region.

Transaction Execution & Due Diligence

· Support acquisition, partnership, and investment opportunities across the region.

· Participate in due diligence activities and coordinate with internal teams and external advisors.

· Review project and company information to identify key risks and opportunities.

· Support financing, transaction execution, and other strategic initiatives as required.

Stakeholder Collaboration

· Work collaboratively with development, legal, engineering, finance, and operations teams.

· Support engagement with developers, investors, lenders, advisors, and strategic partners.

· Prepare analyses and presentations for management and investment discussions.

· Contribute to initiatives that support the continued growth of Peak Energy's utility-scale platform.

Qualifications & Experience

· Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

· Relevant experience in renewable energy, infrastructure, project finance, investment banking, corporate development, consulting, or a related field.

· Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities.

· Financial modelling experience relating to infrastructure, power, or renewable energy projects is required.

· Financial due diligence experience relating to renewable energy or infrastructure investments is preferred,

· Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across functions and cultures.

Peak Energy is a renewable energy platform with a focus on developing solar, wind and battery projects across Asia. As the region's consumption of energy rises, Peak Energy is dedicated to meeting these demands while contributing to carbon neutrality. We accomplish this by developing large utility-scale projects. These include some of the largest solar and wind farms in Korea and Japan.

Peak Energy is the renewable arm of Stonepeak Infrastructure Partners; a leading global infrastructure investment firm with +USD 57 Bn in assets under management. Our portfolio includes the offshore wind farm in Taiwan with plans to develop a further +5 GWp.

Our team has decades of experience and long-standing relationships. This combination of knowledge and relationships, combined with expertise in design and supply chains enables Peak Energy to deliver high performing, robust alternative energy systems on time and under budget.

At Peak Energy, you'll collaborate with passionate individuals, drive meaningful impact, and be at the forefront of Asia’s transition to renewable energy. We believe everyone is needed for carbon neutrality. Therefore, fresh ideas are always welcomed. Are you excited about disrupting traditional energy sources and developing a sustainable future? Come join our team and be a part of the energy revolution with Peak Energy!

title: International Trade Operations Hub Lead
description:
Role Purpose

The ITO Hub Lead is the regional functional and people leader for an assigned business portfolio within the Asia Pacific Control Tower. The role owns end-to-end ITO governance for the assigned portfolio, leads ITO Specialists, governs complex and systemic escalations, drives carrier/LSP performance, RCI/CAPA effectiveness, risk management and continuous improvement, and consolidates Hub performance for management reporting. The Hub Lead retains full ITO Specialist capability and may directly perform specialist activities when required by business criticality, complexity, workload or continuity needs.

Reports to :

APAC Control Tower Manager

Direct reports :

ITO Specialists assigned to the respective business portfolio

Coverage :

Asia Pacific; assigned business portfolio

Role orientation :

Full ITO functional capability, people leadership, regional governance, systemic escalation, provider performance and continuous improvement

Key Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end ITO governance for the assigned business portfolio, including transportation priorities, critical lanes, service requirements, risks and performance.

• Lead, coach and develop ITO Specialists; allocate priorities, balance workload, maintain backup coverage and ensure consistent quality of specialist outputs.

• Retain full ITO Specialist capability and personally lead or perform specialist work for complex, critical, high-impact or resource-sensitive situations.

• Act as senior transportation SME across ocean, ISO tank, air and other applicable international transportation modes and provide direction on non-standard cases.

• Govern aged, repeated, high-impact, cross-country and cross-provider escalations; challenge recovery plans and ensure timely escalation to the correct stakeholder.

• Lead regional carrier and logistics service provider performance governance, covering booking/service performance, lead-time commitment versus actual, reliability, rollovers, space/equipment, drayage and recurring provider failures.

• Govern capacity, routing and allocation risks and escalate structural or commercial provider issues to the appropriate procurement / commercial owner.

• Lead governance of significant logistics incidents, root-cause investigations and corrective/preventive actions; challenge weak RCA / CAPA and validate effectiveness.

Consolidate assigned-portfolio performance, risks, escalations, provider trends, RCI/CAPA and improvement priorities for direct reporting to the APAC Control Tower Manager.

• Maintain visibility of import-governance themes including broker/customs performance, clearance lead time, backlog, regulatory exceptions and cost exposure.

• Own the portfolio improvement pipeline and convert recurring failures into standardization, automation, productivity, cost-avoidance, service-quality and risk-reduction initiatives.

• Lead or support implementation of new providers, processes, systems, regulatory changes and regional/global initiatives, including training and stabilization.

• Provide performance, risk and improvement inputs for management and strategic customer-governance reviews in partnership with account and Control Tower leadership.

Leadership & Operating Model

• The Hub Lead is a hands-on functional leader, not solely a people manager. The role can perform the complete ITO Specialist scope while carrying broader portfolio accountability and leadership authority.

• Country Operations remains accountable for routine shipment execution, local operational provider management and first-level exception resolution.

• ITO Specialists perform assigned governance and specialist activities; the Hub Lead owns consolidated portfolio outcomes, prioritization, senior escalation and Specialist performance.

• The APAC Control Tower Manager retains overall Control Tower service governance and receives consolidated Hub performance and risk reporting.

Governance Cadence

• Daily / as required: critical escalation, service recovery, risk intervention and Specialist support.

• Weekly: portfolio ITO performance, exception aging, provider issues, RCI/CAPA, risk and improvement priority review.

• Monthly: regional ITO/LSP performance governance covering KPI/SLA, lead time, reliability, recurring failures, CAPA and improvement.

• Quarterly: strategic provider and management-governance support covering systemic trends, capability, risk and improvement roadmap.

• Annual: operating-model, capability/resource, service-strategy and improvement-roadmap planning.

Candidate Profile

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, International Trade, Business or a related discipline.

• Typically 7-10+ years of relevant international logistics, freight forwarding, transportation, supply chain or trade experience, with strong ocean and regional/multi-country exposure.

• People or team leadership experience together with hands-on functional expertise in provider management, escalation, performance governance, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.

• Chemical, industrial, 3PL/4PL, LLP or Control Tower experience is advantageous.

• Strong executive communication, stakeholder management and ability to influence across operational, commercial and functional teams without relying solely on direct authority.

• Strong analytical judgment with the ability to convert performance data and recurring failures into practical, measurable actions.

Success in the Role

• Strong and improving transportation service performance for the assigned portfolio.

• Effective leadership and capability development of ITO Specialists with robust continuity and backup

coverage.

• Reduction in aged, repeated and systemic service failures.

• Improved carrier/LSP performance and sustainable corrective-action effectiveness.

• High-quality RCI/CAPA governance with lower repeat root causes.

• Timely, accurate Hub performance and risk reporting to Control Tower leadership.

• Measurable continuous-improvement, productivity, cost, service-quality and risk-reduction outcomes.

BDP GLOBAL SERVICES PTE. LTD.

Privately owned and operated for nearly 50 years, with an enduring vision to deliver the finest logistics and transportation service experience in the world. We continue to pursue that same vision in today's complex, uncertain world, working every day to earn our customers’ trust. A familiar face. A live voice on the line. A more passionate brand of service you would expect from a family-owned enterprise. Trust the accountability. We are BDP. An extended family of nearly 4200 talented people in every major market around the world with one common goal, to help our customers grow. Trust the experience.

Full-Cycle Execution: Manage the entire sales lifecycle from prospecting and discovery to negotiation and close. You are a "Hunter" who enjoys the thrill of the chase but executes with the precision of a consultant.

Multi-Threaded Selling: Navigate complex organizations to build consensus across technical champions (Dev/Ops/Security practitioners) and executive economic buyers (CTO, CIO, CISO, CFO).

Value Engineering: Move beyond feature/function selling. articulate a clear "Business Value Assessment" (BVA) that ties our technical capabilities to the customer's top-line revenue or bottom-line efficiency.

Methodical Forecasting: Maintain hygiene in Salesforce/CRM. Utilize MEDDPICC or Command of the Message methodologies to provide accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasts.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

Experience: 7+ years of quota-carrying field sales experience, with at least 3+ years selling specifically to the Enterprise ($200k - $1M+ ACV).

Technical Aptitude: You don’t need to code, but you must be "technically fluent." You can hold your ground in a conversation with a VP of Engineering or a Chief Architect about their tech stack, workflow, and pain points.

Methodology Master: You live and breathe sales methodology. You can clearly explain how you use MEDDPICC/MEDDIC to qualify deals and de-risk your pipeline.

Consistency: A documented history of performing in the top 10-20% of your cohort. We want to see President’s Club awards and consistent quota over-achievement.

Start-Up Grit: Experience working in a high-growth environment (Series B to IPO phase). You are comfortable with ambiguity and are willing to build the playbook, not just read it.

Bonus points for:

Domain Expertise: A proven track record of selling complex SaaS/PaaS solutions. Experience in DevOps, Infrastructure, Data, Observability, or Cybersecurity is highly preferred.

Startup Experience: You have been at an early-stage organization where you control your own desk. You function autonomously and strive towards building something great.

Partnership Experience: Successful track record of building equitable relationships with new partners.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation Range: SGD 270K - SGD 320K

title: Sales Account Manager (Remote)
description:
Job Description

About Us

We help interior design and renovation firms in Singapore grow — through lead generation, branding, and marketing programmes that bring them qualified homeowners and stronger market positioning. Our clients don't just buy a service from us once; they grow with us across tiers as their firms scale. That only works when someone closes the right clients — and then owns the relationship after the first close.

That someone is you.

About the Role

This is a fully remote role.

You'll work from wherever you work best — no daily commute, no office face-time. What matters is that your clients feel looked after and your accounts grow. You'll meet clients over video calls (with the occasional in-person session if a key relationship calls for it), and stay connected to the team through our daily rhythms online.

This is a closing role first, a relationship role always.

You'll start by building your own book of business: running sales conversations with interior design firms, diagnosing where their business is stuck, and closing them into the right programme. Every deal you close becomes an account you own — and from there, your job is to make each relationship deeper, longer, and more valuable over time.

The more you close early on, the bigger the portfolio you manage — and the more your recurring income compounds through renewals, tier upgrades, and referrals. You are the person our clients trust from the very first call, the one who checks in before they have to ask, and the reason they sign, renew, upgrade, and refer.

What You'll Do

Run discovery and sales calls with interior design and renovation firms — diagnosing their growth bottlenecks and closing them into the programme that fits

Manage your own sales pipeline end to end: qualification, follow-ups, objection handling, and closing, with clear monthly targets

Own every account you close as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor

Run regular check-ins and performance reviews with clients — walking them through their results, diagnosing bottlenecks, and recommending next steps

Drive renewals by ensuring clients see and understand the value they're getting throughout the programme, not just at renewal time

Identify and develop expansion opportunities — helping clients climb to higher programme tiers when their business is ready for it

Generate referrals naturally by building the kind of relationship people recommend to their peers

Work with our internal teams to resolve client issues quickly and keep promises made during the sales process

Maintain accurate account records, follow-up rhythms, and relationship health tracking in our CRM

Who You Are

2+ years in B2B sales, account management, or client success — with a track record of hitting sales targets and closing deals

A closer who thinks long-term: you know how to drive a deal to a decision, but you close clients you can grow, not just deals you can win

A natural relationship builder — the close is the start of the relationship, not the end of it

Consistent with follow-through: you do what you say, on time, every time

A clear communicator who can explain performance data and business concepts simply, in person and in writing

Commercially sharp — you can spot an upsell or referral opportunity without making the client feel sold to

Organised and self-directed: you manage your own portfolio, pipeline of renewals, and follow-up cadence

Proven ability to work independently in a remote setup — you stay responsive, structured, and visible without anyone looking over your shoulder

Bonus: experience in or exposure to the interior design, renovation, real estate, or home services industry

Why Join Us

100% remote

— you're measured on client outcomes, not hours at a desk

Base salary + commissions on every deal you close, plus recurring incentives on retention, renewals, and account growth — your income compounds as your portfolio grows

Build your own book of business from day one, backed by proven sales scripts, frameworks, and playbooks — you close it, you keep it, you grow it

Clear frameworks, playbooks, and training on how we sell, manage, and grow accounts

A front-row seat to how design and renovation businesses in Singapore scale

To Apply

Reach out directly to our Head of Sales, Nigel:

WhatsApp: +65 9061 4389

Only candidates who reach out via WhatsApp will be contacted — a short intro message telling us who you are and why this role fits you is all it takes to start the conversation.

Our platform is designed to reduce the time and cost of client acquisition for interior design firms, allowing them to focus on what they do best — delivering exceptional spaces.

title: Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Specialist
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.

Job description

We are looking for a Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Specialist to be the visionary link between our brand identity & measurable e-commerce performance. You will shape how our health brands communicate across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & social media.

This role is responsible for developing high-impact creative strategies & producing assets (visual, video, copy) designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok E-Commerce stores. You will work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the expansion of our business. You won't just be creating content; you will be engineering 'Performance Stories' that turn scientific evidence into consumer trust & measurable revenue.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry.

Key Responsibilities

1. Creative & Performance Strategy

Full-Funnel Content: Craft tailored strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific formats (e.g. Meta carousel ads, Meta/TikTok Reels, Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banners & Klaviyo email/whatsapp marketing)

A/B Testing & Data Insights: Develop clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, CTAs, visual styles) & run A/B tests to improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion)

Competitive Intelligence: Identify emerging hooks & messaging trends in the wellness/supplement industry to keep our brands ahead of the curve

2. In-House Content Production & Execution

Performance Creative Development: Lead end-to-end creative production for organic & paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube) with a focus on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing

Video & Static Creation: Rapidly produce & edit native social content, including:

Video: Fast-paced assembly of UGC-style content, product demos & testimonials (CapCut/Premiere)

Static: Adapting product photography into high-performing ad variations & storefront banners

Generative AI Integration: Utilize AI tools & prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video & image assets for rapid testing cycles

Copywriting: Write high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & captions that align with brand voice & regulatory requirements

Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok storefronts

3. E-commerce Growth & Social Account Management

E-Commerce Storefront Custodian (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok): Integrate winning creative messages into e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a seamless customer journey for maximum sales conversion

Social Accounts Ownership & Community Manager: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for Miraco’s official accounts on Meta (FB/IG) & TikTok. Ensure all profiles are optimized for conversion, featuring up-to-date bios, Linktree/Shopify integrations & high-lighted stories

Content Programming & Scheduling: Develop & maintain a consistent content calendar that balances "Digital Pearls" (educational), Lifestyle (relatable) & Promotional (sales-driven) posts

Active Social Listening: Use comments & DMs to identify "pain points" to fuel new content hooks

User Generated Content (UGC) Mining: Identify & curate customer testimonials from the community to use as high-converting growth assets

Growth Analytics: Monitor account health metrics (Follower growth, Engagement Rate, Profile Visits) & use these insights to refine the organic reach strategy

Data-Driven Optimization: Work with the Marketing Manager to analyze performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving revenue on Shopify & Marketplaces. Apply insights & analytics to refine content effectiveness continuously

4. Performance Media & Technical Tracking

Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google):

Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Sales & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces

Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries

Precision Tracking & UTM Tagging: Implement a standardized UTM tagging nomenclature across all Digital Pearls, EDMs, WhatsApp blasts & Affiliate links to ensure 100% attribution accuracy in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) & Shopify

Monitor the "customer path" from the first touchpoint (e.g., a Meta post) to the final conversion (e.g. e-commerce purchase, loyalty program subscription, etc.)

Media Optimization: Manage ad spend budgets effectively, focusing on scaling winning creatives & "killing" underperforming ads based on real-time ROAS & CPA data

5. CRM, Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing (Retention & CLV)

CRM Management, Loyalty & Monetization: Serve as the lead strategist for the CRM loyalty program, designing lifecycle journeys that move customers from "First-Time Buyer" to "Loyal Subscriber"

Develop loyalty-driven content that rewards repeat purchases & encourages long-term brand advocacy to maximize Consumer Lifetime Value (CLV)

Electronic Direct Mailer (EDM) & E-Newsletter Strategy: Develop & execute a high-frequency E-newsletter calendar via Klaviyo. This includes:

Educational Newsletters: Delivering "Digital Pearls" & expert insights from our HCP partners to build brand authority

Promotional EDMs: Creating high-converting seasonal offers & product-launch campaigns

Automated Flow Management: Design & execute end-to-end email & WhatsApp marketing automation (eg. Klaviyo) to nurture leads & re-engage existing customers

Automated Lifecycle Flows: Building "Welcome" series, "Post-Purchase" care, "Win-back" flows & "Replenishment Reminders"

Subscription & Monetization: Craft compelling creative & copy for "Subscribe & Save" programs, focusing on reducing churn & maximizing monthly recurring revenue (MRR)

Optimize the "Subscribe & Save" funnel through targeted email & WhatsApp triggers, focusing on increasing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)

WhatsApp Marketing: Integrate direct-to-consumer WhatsApp communication for personalized health consultations, loyalty rewards & rapid-response promotions

Data-Driven Personalization & Segmented Campaigns: Segment the CRM database based on health concerns, purchase behavior & engagement levels to ensure the right story reaches the right customer at the right time

6. Influencer & Affiliate Strategy (E-Commerce Growth & Acquisition)

Creator Partnerships: Identify & manage relationships with health influencers & HCP advocates via Shopify Collabs, TikTok Creator Marketplace & similar platforms

Affiliate Creative Kits: Develop high-converting "Affiliate Toolkits" (ready-to-use stories, hooks & banners) that empower partners to sell Miraco products effectively

Performance Tracking: Monitor affiliate-driven traffic & conversion data to optimize commission structures & creative briefs for better ROAS

7. Growth-Driven Storytelling

Translating Science to Story: Distilling complex clinical data & health benefits into relatable, high-impact stories that resonate with a consumer’s pain points & emotional aspirations

Narrative Funneling: Crafting story arcs specifically designed for the customer journey, from "educational hooks" that capture attention to "empathy-led consideration" to "urgency-driven conversion"

Growth-Centric CTAs: Developing persuasive, multi-variant Calls-to-Action (CTAs) that don't just ask for a click but provide a compelling reason to engage, directly impacting Click-Through Rates (CTR) & customer acquisition

Performance Iteration: The ability to pivot a brand story based on real-time data insights, identifying which "angle" or "hook" is driving the highest Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

Omnichannel Cohesion: Ensuring a seamless visual & narrative experience across all touchpoints, from high-energy social media (Meta/TikTok) to professional platforms (LinkedIn) & offline trade materials

Compliance & Brand Integrity: Safeguarding brand credibility by ensuring all "Performance Stories" remain factual, align with company values & strictly compliant with regional healthcare advertising standards & product claim guidelines. Partnering with internal teams to audit content for accuracy & compliance prior to regional deployment

Requirements:

3–5 years of experience in full-stack digital growth, with a track record of managing end-to-end performance campaigns (Meta/Google), official social accounts (Meta/TikTok) & e-commerce growth (Shopify is a plus)

Ability to move customers through the funnel—from initial awareness to community loyalty—ideally within the healthcare or wellness sectors

Proven experience managing or creating content for Shopify, TikTok, Shopee & Lazada ecosystems. Familiarity with e-commerce metrics (AOV, CR, ROAS) is essential

Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager & Google Ads

Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Generative AI)

Hands-on proficiency in Klaviyo (highly preferred), HubSpot, or Zoho CRM for email & mobile marketing

Track record of managing or growing a brand loyalty club with a focus on retention & community building

Experience navigating Shopify Collabs, TikTok Marketplace, or similar affiliate management software

A solid understanding of the "Growth Equation": CAC, ROAS, AOV & CLV

Expert in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools

Experience using Generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini AI, Midjourney, Sora/Runway) for rapid asset prototyping & production

Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills. Adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals

Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

Excellent communication, project management skills & the ability to work cross-functionally

title: Manager / Senior Manager, Client Servicing & Onboarding
description:
Job purpose

This role, based in Singapore, is responsible for leading the local Client Servicing Know-Your-Client ("CS KYC") team and ensuring the timely, accurate, and high-quality delivery of client onboarding, KYC reviews, and client file maintenance for institutional and distribution clients across Asia.

The role combines team management, operational oversight, governance, and regional coordination, working closely with headquarter in Paris and other Asian entities to ensure alignment with Group standards, internal policies, control requirements, and local regulatory obligations.

The position is hierarchically attached to the local Client Servicing organization in Singapore and functionally attached to the management of the Global Client Servicing and Onboarding ("CSO") Business Line.

Job description

Team Leadership and Management:

Lead, manage, and develop the Singapore-based CS KYC team, including workload allocation, prioritization, coaching, training, and day-to-day supervision. Ensure strong collaboration, accountability, and service quality across the team.

KYC Onboarding and Due Diligence Oversight:

Oversee the end-to-end onboarding of institutional and distribution clients in line with KYC/AML procedures, internal policies, and regulatory requirements. Review client profiles, identify documentation requirements, and ensure files are complete and ready for validation.

Validation, Escalation, and Follow-up:

Coordinate KYC validation with Compliance and other control functions. Manage follow-up actions, queries, remediation points, and escalations to ensure timely resolution and appropriate communication to stakeholders.

Periodic Review and File Maintenance:

Oversee the update of KYC records through periodic reviews, event-driven updates, and remediation exercises. Ensure client documentation remains accurate, complete, compliant, and properly recorded in internal systems.

Governance and Regional Coordination:

Ensure proper implementation of Group policies, KYC/AML standards, internal procedures, and control requirements across the team. Work closely with HQ Paris and other Asian entities on governance, policy alignment, process consistency, and escalation matters.

Client Categorization and Data Oversight:

Oversee client categorization, suitability, eligibility documentation, and the accurate capture of client and KYC data in internal systems. Promote strong data quality and consistency throughout the onboarding and review lifecycle.

Stakeholder Coordination:

Maintain effective communication with the Global CSO Business Line, Paris teams, and internal stakeholders including Sales, Client Servicing, Compliance, Legal, Operations, and Middle Office, as well as external parties where required.

Functional Alignment with CSO Business Line

: Ensure that local team organization, priorities, governance practices, escalation handling, and service delivery remain aligned with the direction, standards, and expectations of the CSO Business Line, while operating within the local CS reporting line in Singapore.

Control Environment and Continuous Improvement:

Ensure the team operates within a robust control framework, with appropriate documentation, audit trail, and escalation discipline. Contribute to projects and process improvements related to onboarding, regulatory change, governance, and efficiency.

Profile

7 to 10 years of relevant experience in asset management or financial services, with strong exposure to Client Servicing, KYC/AML, client onboarding, Compliance, or a related support/control function.

Proven experience in the onboarding, review, and maintenance of institutional and/or distribution client files.

Proven experience in a team management or senior team lead role, including supervision, coaching, workload allocation, performance follow-up, and escalation management.

Strong understanding of KYC/AML requirements, due diligence standards, client categorization, eligibility documentation, onboarding governance requirements, and control expectations in a regulated environment.

Good understanding of governance frameworks, policy implementation, and the importance of consistency of practices across regional teams and jurisdictions.

Exposure to regional KYC requirements across Asian markets, particularly Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Thailand, South Korea, China, and Taiwan, would be an advantage.

Experience in working with HQ/global teams on governance, policy alignment, or regional oversight would be an advantage.

Familiarity with KYC tools, client data systems, workflow monitoring processes, and management reporting.

Strong coordination, leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders across functions and locations.

Strong attention to detail, analytical capability, sound judgment, and control mindset.

Well-organized, proactive, reliable, adaptable, and able to work within tight deadlines.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Amundi Singapore is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Amundi Group. It was established in 1989 as a business hub for Amundi Group’s operations in South East Asia. title: HEAD OF SALES, ASIA
description:
About Intellect

Intellect is the global leader in mental health benefits, trusted by the world’s most forward-thinking employers, insurers, and governments to deliver care that is local, personalised, and effective at scale. Today, we serve over 4 million people across 100 countries and languages, making mental health support truly accessible across borders and cultures.

Our platform powers the mental wellbeing of workforces at hundreds of Fortune 500 and major companies, enabling them to support their people with the highest standards of clinical quality, cultural relevance, and on-demand accessibility.

Driven by our mission to build the world’s most trusted mental health benefits platform, Intellect combines a best-in-class digital platform with a world-leading global provider network to deliver unmatched client outcomes and transformative care experiences.

We are backed by top global investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, Insignia Ventures Partners, HOF Capital, K3 Ventures, JAFCO, Headline, East Ventures, IHH Healthcare, MS&AD Ventures, and more, alongside an extensive coalition of notable family offices, big tech executives, and leading angel investors.

The Role

The Director of Sales, Asia will drive Intellect’s enterprise sales growth across our core Asian markets through direct sales and strategic alliances.

This is a hands-on leadership role with accountability for regional sales performance and an individual new business revenue target. You will lead and develop a team of Account Executives and SDRs while personally originating, owning and closing a focused portfolio of strategic enterprise opportunities.

We are looking for a strong enterprise seller and people leader who understands how to win complex deals, lead competitive RFPs and build trusted relationships with C-suite decision-makers. You should be equally comfortable setting market priorities, coaching a salesperson, leading an executive presentation and negotiating a contract.

You will work closely with Marketing, Revenue Operations and Partnerships to shape our sales go-to-market strategy, strengthen commercial discipline and build repeatable routes to growth. You will also partner with Clinical, Operations, Product and Finance to ensure our proposals deliver value for customers and are commercially sustainable.

Your Responsibilities

1. Revenue Ownership & Enterprise Selling

Own regional new business sales performance, translating revenue targets into clear market priorities, account plans and execution.

Carry an individual new business revenue target and personally own a focused portfolio of strategic deals through the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation, contracting and close.

Build qualified pipeline through targeted outreach, executive networks, referrals and partner channels, alongside Marketing and SDR-led activity.

Navigate complex buying groups, uncover customer priorities, develop compelling business cases and secure access to economic buyers and executive sponsors.

Build and deepen relationships with CHROs, Chief People Officers, Total Rewards and Benefits leaders, and other senior stakeholders involved in enterprise buying decisions.

2. Sales Team Leadership & Development

Lead, coach and develop Account Executives and SDRs, setting clear expectations for pipeline creation, opportunity progression and revenue delivery.

Run effective pipeline reviews, deal reviews and individual coaching, identifying performance gaps early and taking action to address them.

Develop the team’s capabilities in discovery, stakeholder mapping, multithreading, value articulation, executive engagement and negotiation.

Establish clear account and territory ownership; help shape hiring, team structure and incentives as the business scales.

Build a culture of accountability, collaboration and high performance through direct feedback, recognition and timely performance management.

3. RFP Leadership & Complex Deal Strategy

Lead priority enterprise RFPs and tenders end to end, including bid qualification, go/no-go decisions, win strategy, proposal development, presentations and commercial negotiations.

Build each bid strategy around the customer’s priorities, evaluation criteria, competitive landscape and Intellect’s differentiated value.

Coordinate solution specialists and cross-functional contributors to deliver accurate, compelling proposals on time, with clear ownership of deliverables.

Lead customer engagement throughout the process, navigating procurement requirements and aligning stakeholders around the proposed solution.

Use win/loss reviews to improve bid selection, sales execution, proposals and competitive positioning.

4. Go-to-Market Strategy & Marketing Collaboration

Shape and execute the sales go-to-market strategy across Asia, prioritising markets, industries, customer segments and direct versus partner-led routes.

Partner with Marketing on target account selection, account-based campaigns, events and demand generation, with shared focus on qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes.

Establish clear lead handovers and follow-up standards, using conversion data and sales feedback to improve lead quality and campaign effectiveness.

Work with Marketing and Product to sharpen enterprise positioning, value propositions and sales narratives based on customer insights and competitive intelligence.

Translate market feedback into practical recommendations on offerings, packaging and growth opportunities.

5. Alliances & Ecosystem-Led Growth

Work with the Partnerships team to turn broker, insurer and other strategic relationships into qualified enterprise pipeline and revenue.

Develop joint account plans and sales initiatives that improve access to priority customers and markets.

Lead sales execution for agreed alliance-led opportunities, coordinating partner introductions, joint pitches and negotiations.

Establish clear opportunity ownership and handovers with Partnerships, aligning direct and partner-led activity to avoid channel conflict.

Evaluate alliance-led sales activity through pipeline quality, conversion and revenue contribution.

6. Revenue Operations & Commercial Discipline

Partner with Revenue Operations to strengthen the foundations for scale: CRM standards, pipeline stages, qualification criteria, forecasting, account planning and performance reporting.

Own adoption of these standards within Sales, maintaining accurate opportunity data, realistic forecasts and clear next steps.

Use pipeline coverage, conversion, sales cycle and productivity data to identify bottlenecks and improve performance; build repeatable playbooks across priority segments.

Help shape pricing, packaging and deal structures with Finance and relevant teams, balancing customer value, competitiveness, delivery requirements and sustainable margins.

Lead deal negotiations within agreed approval frameworks and ensure effective handovers to Client Success and Operations, with clear customer commitments and ownership of follow-on opportunities.

Requirements

Proven Enterprise Sales Leader

You have a track record of delivering B2B new business growth and leading sales teams against clear revenue targets. You have personally originated and closed complex enterprise deals and can explain your contribution to those wins.

Hands-On Player-Coach

You enjoy leading a team while continuing to own and close your own opportunities. You can balance personal selling with coaching, delegate effectively and step into team deals without creating confusion over ownership.

Experienced RFP Leader

You have led and won competitive enterprise RFPs or tenders. You bring sound judgment on which bids to pursue, how to differentiate a proposal and how to coordinate teams through demanding timelines and commercial negotiations.

Strong Enterprise Seller & Executive Relationship Builder

You understand long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, from discovery and business case development through procurement, legal review and contracting. You can engage credibly with C-suite leaders, develop executive sponsors and build new relationships through outreach, networks and partner introductions.

Disciplined Sales Operator

You understand pipeline generation, qualification, forecasting, territory planning, sales methodologies and performance management. You use data to improve decisions and execution, supported by sound judgment and a close understanding of your customers.

Commercially Strategic & Collaborative

You bring strong judgment on market priorities, pricing, positioning and deal economics. You work effectively with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Partnerships and delivery teams, aligning different perspectives around clear commercial outcomes.

Experienced Across Asian Markets

You have meaningful experience in Asian enterprise markets and understand differences in buying behaviour, procurement practices and market maturity. Experience across Singapore and other major Asian markets is strongly preferred.

Experience in enterprise SaaS, HR technology, employee benefits, healthcare, insurance, professional services or another complex B2B category is advantageous. Direct mental healthcare experience is not required.

Builder Mindset & Mission Alignment

You are comfortable in a growing business where processes continue to evolve. You bring structure, take ownership and adapt as you learn. You are motivated by expanding access to quality mental healthcare while building a commercially sustainable business.

What Success Looks Like

Delivery against regional and individual new business revenue targets.

A healthy enterprise pipeline, stronger conversion and reliable forecasting.

Strategic enterprise and RFP wins on commercially sound terms.

A capable, accountable sales team with improving productivity and performance.

Measurable pipeline and revenue from alliance-led sales.

Repeatable sales practices and effective collaboration across the teams supporting growth.

Intellect (

intellect.co

) is a venture-backed digital health company reinventing how mental health is in Asia. Our goal is to make it simple, easy and stigma-free for everyone.

We're building an entirely new way for modern organisations to easily provide support for their employees’ mental health & mental wellbeing, no matter where they are on their journey.

Join us on our mission to eliminate barriers to mental health and to create a wellbeing approach that people love using.

title: Manager, Digital Inclusion Programmes
description:
About Engineering Good

Engineering Good (EG) is a Singapore-based non-profit organisation founded in 2014. We harness technology, engineering and community collaboration to create practical solutions to support the needs of underserved communities and persons with disabilities (PWDs).

Our work focuses on two core areas: Digital Inclusion (DI) and Assistive Technology (AT).

Digital Inclusion

We collect, refurbish and redistribute used laptops to underserved communities, including low-income families and migrant workers, providing them with essential access to the digital world. By extending the useful life of donated devices, our DI work also contributes to environmental sustainability by reducing electronic waste.

To enhance our impact, EG is establishing a new initiative focused on delivering meaningful digital literacy programs. These programs aim to help individuals develop the skills and confidence needed to engage effectively in our increasingly digital society. Skills in digital creation, such as graphic design, video editing, and word processing, not only improve the quality of screen time but also serve as valuable tools for advancing education and economic opportunities.

Assistive Technology

Our AT programme brings together engineers, makers, volunteers, community partners and persons with disabilities to co-create practical and affordable AT solutions.

We take a user-centred, hands-on approach, starting with the needs of the person and working through ideation, prototyping, testing and iteration. Our solutions are typically low-to-mid-tech, affordable and open-source, addressing real-world barriers in areas such as daily living, communication, education, recreation and employment.

Our Impact

12,000+ laptops refurbished and distributed

28,000+ kg of e-waste diverted from landfills

2,000+ assistive tech devices created

over 400 community partners served

Our work has helped support disadvantaged individuals in seeking upskilling courses and employment opportunities online, and enabled persons with disabilities to participate more independently in everyday activities.

If you are passionate about making a difference together, we would love to have you join our supportive and collaborative community!

Job Purpose

We are seeking a dynamic and mission-driven Digital Inclusion Programme Manager to lead and expand EG’s Digital Inclusion initiatives. This is a 2-year contract role, offering an opportunity to play a key role in shaping and growing EG’s Digital Inclusion work and creating meaningful impact for underserved communities.

Specifically, EG is focusing on two key areas of Digital Literacy: digital wellness and digital skills for education and economic opportunities and access to essential services online.

You will be responsible for ensuring that our programmes are relevant, impactful and sustainable, responding to the evolving needs of underserved communities while making effective use of the resources and grants entrusted to EG.

Working closely with the Digital Inclusion Programme Executive, you will provide direction and oversight for programme delivery, while managing and supporting the team to execute programmes effectively to achieve intended outcomes and continuously improve how we create impact.

Key Responsibilities

Programme Strategy & Development

Lead and develop EG’s Digital Inclusion programmes, ensuring they remain relevant to the evolving needs of underserved communities.

Set programme goals, priorities and outcomes, and identify opportunities to improve, scale or develop new initiatives.

Ensure our programmes are meaningful, sustainable and aligned with EG’s mission and organisational priorities.

Programme & Team Management

Oversee the effective delivery of the Digital Inclusion programme, working closely with the Digital Inclusion team on day-to-day operations.

Manage the Digital Inclusion team providing clear direction and support.

Ensure appropriate processes, resources and systems are in place for smooth and effective programme delivery.

Partnerships & Community Engagement

Build and maintain strong relationships with Social Service Agencies, community organisations, corporations and other strategic partners.

Work with community partners to understand emerging needs and develop meaningful opportunities for EG to address digital inclusion gaps.

Work closely with fundraising and corporate partners to support and grow the corporate laptop buy-back programme

Support fundraising initiatives by growing the laptop refurbishment services and DI programmes for our community partners.

Develop and facilitate engagement workshops for corporate CSR, ESG, and Learning Day activities to raise awareness on digital inclusion, e-waste management, and to generate donations

Grants, Impact & Resource Management

Oversee the effective utilisation of grants and programme resources, ensuring activities and expenditure are aligned with approved objectives and budgets.

Monitor programme outcomes and use data, feedback and insights to evaluate impact and drive continuous improvement.

Support the fundraising team in grant applications, donor reporting and communications on programme outcomes and impact.

Other Responsibilities

Undertake other projects and responsibilities that support Engineering Good’s mission to empower disadvantaged and vulnerable communities through technology and engineering.

Attributes, Skills and Competencies

Has essential knowledge of IT hardware, software and digital technologies, including laptops, operating systems, basic troubleshooting, device configuration and data security.

Strong understanding of device lifecycle management and refurbishment, including device assessment, data sanitisation, operating system installation, software setup, quality control and basic hardware troubleshooting.

Project management and organisational skills, with the ability to translate strategy into clear plans, timelines, actions and measurable outcomes.

Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management abilities

Analytical and solution-oriented with attention to detail

Ability to use spreadsheets and digital tools to track programme data, budgets and outcomes.

People management in a small team environment, with the ability to build trust and bring people together towards shared goals

Empathy and understanding of the social issues and digital barriers faced by EG’s beneficiaries.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Familiarity with social impact or non-profit work is a strong advantage

Qualifications

Diploma or degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Digital Technology or a related field of study

Relevant professional certifications or equivalent practical experience in IT, digital inclusion, programme management, community development or social impact will also be considered

3–5 years of relevant experience in programme/project management, digital inclusion, IT operations, community programmes or a related field.

Experience managing technology-related programmes, devices, digital skills initiatives or community partnerships is an advantage.

Engineering Good is an equal opportunity employer, and hires based on skills and competency.

Applicants must not require a work visa for employment in Singapore

Application Instructions

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Candidates are encouraged to apply at their earliest convenience.

title: Business Consultant for Construction Firms (Ideally Experienced)
description:
Job Description

About Us

We help interior design and renovation firms in Singapore grow — through lead generation, branding, and marketing programmes that bring them qualified homeowners and stronger market positioning. Our clients don't just buy a service from us once; they grow with us across tiers as their firms scale. That only works when someone closes the right clients — and then owns the relationship after the first close.

That someone is you.

About the Role

This is a fully remote role.

You'll work from wherever you work best — no daily commute, no office face-time. What matters is that your clients feel looked after and your accounts grow. You'll meet clients over video calls (with the occasional in-person session if a key relationship calls for it), and stay connected to the team through our daily rhythms online.

This is a closing role first, a relationship role always.

You'll start by building your own book of business: running sales conversations with interior design firms, diagnosing where their business is stuck, and closing them into the right programme. Every deal you close becomes an account you own — and from there, your job is to make each relationship deeper, longer, and more valuable over time.

The more you close early on, the bigger the portfolio you manage — and the more your recurring income compounds through renewals, tier upgrades, and referrals. You are the person our clients trust from the very first call, the one who checks in before they have to ask, and the reason they sign, renew, upgrade, and refer.

What You'll Do

Run discovery and sales calls with interior design and renovation firms — diagnosing their growth bottlenecks and closing them into the programme that fits

Manage your own sales pipeline end to end: qualification, follow-ups, objection handling, and closing, with clear monthly targets

Own every account you close as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor

Run regular check-ins and performance reviews with clients — walking them through their results, diagnosing bottlenecks, and recommending next steps

Drive renewals by ensuring clients see and understand the value they're getting throughout the programme, not just at renewal time

Identify and develop expansion opportunities — helping clients climb to higher programme tiers when their business is ready for it

Generate referrals naturally by building the kind of relationship people recommend to their peers

Work with our internal teams to resolve client issues quickly and keep promises made during the sales process

Maintain accurate account records, follow-up rhythms, and relationship health tracking in our CRM

Who You Are

2+ years in B2B sales, account management, or client success — with a track record of hitting sales targets and closing deals

A closer who thinks long-term: you know how to drive a deal to a decision, but you close clients you can grow, not just deals you can win

A natural relationship builder — the close is the start of the relationship, not the end of it

Consistent with follow-through: you do what you say, on time, every time

A clear communicator who can explain performance data and business concepts simply, in person and in writing

Commercially sharp — you can spot an upsell or referral opportunity without making the client feel sold to

Organised and self-directed: you manage your own portfolio, pipeline of renewals, and follow-up cadence

Proven ability to work independently in a remote setup — you stay responsive, structured, and visible without anyone looking over your shoulder

Bonus: experience in or exposure to the interior design, renovation, real estate, or home services industry

Why Join Us

100% remote

— you're measured on client outcomes, not hours at a desk

Base salary + commissions on every deal you close, plus recurring incentives on retention, renewals, and account growth — your income compounds as your portfolio grows

Build your own book of business from day one, backed by proven sales scripts, frameworks, and playbooks — you close it, you keep it, you grow it

Clear frameworks, playbooks, and training on how we sell, manage, and grow accounts

A front-row seat to how design and renovation businesses in Singapore scale

To Apply

Reach out directly to our Head of Sales, Nigel:

WhatsApp: +65 9061 4389

Only candidates who reach out via WhatsApp will be contacted — a short intro message telling us who you are and why this role fits you is all it takes to start the conversation.

Our platform is designed to reduce the time and cost of client acquisition for interior design firms, allowing them to focus on what they do best — delivering exceptional spaces.

Hybrid operating model: Decide which repeatable activities should be operated internally, and which specialist services should remain with agencies. Establish service levels, decision rights, handoffs, scorecards and escalation paths.

Strong understanding of Data Science, Machine Learning and AI product development, including model lifecycle management, experimentation frameworks, predictive marketing, recommendation systems, generative AI and agentic workflows. Demonstrated experience designing or materially improving an in-house or hybrid performance-media operating model, including agency transition and capability transfer.

description:

As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.

Global Investment Services

Global Investment Services (GIS) provides strategic investment services and financial management across GIC’s public and private market asset classes. Leveraging data and emerging technologies, the department drives the development and execution of business infrastructure plans while shaping scalable, agile, and resilient operating models that enable growth and deliver operational excellence.

GIS provides operational expertise spanning market settlements, transaction management and execution, investment data operations, portfolio finance, valuations, accounting, and tax services, as well as portfolio administration.

What Impact can you make in this role?

Investment & Deal Execution – Deal Management

You will play a vital role to provide investment and deal closing support to private markets including equity, credit, funds, real assets and external loans through a scalable deal execution platform. This role works closely with the Deal Team and various internal and external functional teams to ensure smooth and prompt closings of private markets investments including finance and regulatory operations. It entails clear communication with various stakeholders, tactical deal advisory, and elite organizational skills with superb attention to details to drive our execution capabilities.

You will be part of the leading team in providing deal management specialists services across equity, credit, funds, real assets and external loans.

What will you do as an Associate/AVP, Deal Management?

Lead as deal execution point of contact with external and internal counterparties, partner Investment and Capital Markets Team in administering deal execution relating to deal and internal compliance considerations
Coordinate across internal stakeholders and external advisors/lenders to advise financial and operational feasibility of holding structure, deal funding mechanics, portfolio accounting / valuations implications and manage various work streams during investments / divestments and loans lifecycles.
Implement efficient operating model including onboarding/ offboarding investment portfolio across various jurisdictions in the region
Collaborative and effective partnering with stakeholders such as internal Investment and Capital Markets Team, Internal Investment Finance Specialists and Investment Operation members, Tax, Legal & Compliance, as well as external advisors, and service providers
Perform and fulfil all operational requirements, including liaising with lenders, partners and external administrator on funding and KYC/AML requirements.
Monitor and test loan covenants, prepare compliance certificates and supporting documentation to ensure timely reporting to lenders and adherence to financing terms.
Support Global and Regional Head to implement various transformation programs and global projects
Identify gaps in current workflow and take a proactive approach (technology enabled solution where makes sense) to drive operational front-mid-back process improvements and efficiencies and reduce operational risks.

What qualifications or skills should you possess in this role?

At least 3-5 years relevant deal accounting and transaction management experience. Ideally in Real Estate supporting direct transactions, or familiarity on Mortgage Lending.
Business-level proficiency in Chinese is required, as the role will support deal operation and coordination in the China market, including reviewing Chinese-language transaction materials and engaging directly with China-based counterparties, advisers and service providers.
Good understanding and awareness of private investments’ deal closing mechanics, investment structuring, documentations and controls.
Degree in accounting, finance, business, or equivalent. Ideally a qualified accountant with Big 4 training.
Detailed oriented analytical thinker, with creative problem-solving capabilities to effectively manage complex situations in a timely manner
Excellent organizational and time-management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks and deals at any given time and deliver to deadlines.
Good interpersonal and stakeholder management skills and drive partnership with internal and external stakeholders.
An inquisitive self-starter with the ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional, cross-regions multicultural environment

We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.

At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. We are an equal opportunity employer

As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. An inclusive environment yields exceptional contribution.

Our PRIME Values
