Vacancy Description

FrieslandCampina is executing a company-wide transformation to accelerate profitable growth, improve margins and strengthen global competitiveness. Marketing and media are key levers in this transformation and must become more focused, effective and efficient to ensure investments drive commercial impact. As Marketing & Media Manager Asia & AMEA, you will play a critical role in making this ambition a reality.

You will lead the creation and activation of the vision for marketing across the region, ensuring marketing remains relevant, competitive, efficient and a strong growth engine for the business. In close partnership with leadership and global stakeholders, you will be responsible for the design and delivery of strategic marketing transformation initiatives.

In this role, you will co-create the marketing transformation roadmap, align priorities with enterprise strategy and business objectives, and ensure measurable business impact through clear milestones, governance and performance tracking. You will drive the implementation of media transformation initiatives, lead the consolidation of creative agency ecosystems and production operations, enabling a more simplified, scalable and efficient operating model. Through the implementation of new governance structures, workflows and ways of working, you will improve transparency, speed, consistency and cross-functional collaboration across teams and markets.

A key part of the role is translating and embedding the new marketing operating model across Operating Companies. You will work closely with Marketing, Sales, eCommerce, IT, Data & Analytics, Procurement, Finance and external agency partners to drive alignment and execution in a highly matrixed and decentralised environment. Success will depend on your ability to influence without direct authority, build strong relationships and bring stakeholders together around a shared vision.

In addition, you will support organisation design, capability building and change adoption efforts. By identifying capability gaps, enabling upskilling and embedding new behaviours, you will ensure transformation is fully adopted and delivers sustainable results. You will continuously identify opportunities to improve media, creative, production and marketing operations while fostering a test-and-learn culture focused on ongoing efficiency and effectiveness gains.

This is a highly visible international role within Global Commerce with impact across Asia & AMEA B2C businesses. It offers the opportunity to shape the future of marketing at FrieslandCampina while working with senior stakeholders across the global marketing ecosystem.

For thousands of people every day, FrieslandCampina means more than just a dairy company. We provide high-quality nutrition while creating value for our member farmers, customers, consumers and communities around the world.

You will join the Global Commerce organisation and work at the centre of FrieslandCampina's marketing transformation agenda. The team is responsible for shaping the future of marketing through operating model excellence, media transformation, capability development and process optimisation. Working across Business Group Europe, B2B, Operating Companies and global functions, the team partners with senior commercial leaders, marketing teams, eCommerce, Sales, IT, Data & Analytics and external agency partners to build a more agile, data-driven and performance-focused marketing organisation.

Together, we are building the capabilities, ways of working and partnerships that will enable marketing to become a true growth engine for FrieslandCampina.

title: Fundraising and Partnership Manager
description:
About the Role

4S is building a dedicated fundraising function for the first time, following the launch of our first integrated fundraising campaign, Adopt-A-Wish, in February 2026. This role will lead that build —establishing the donor pipeline, partnership base, systems and stewardship practices 4S does not yet have, with a particular focus on Community-based Centres (4S Active Ageing Centre and 4S Eldercare Centre @ Eunos Crescent). The role will also contribute to 4S’s overall financial sustainability and support fundraising, partnership and sponsorship opportunities across its facilities.

This is a founding role in a function 4S is investing in as a strategic priority under its 2024–2028 Roadmap. You will have real latitude to shape how 4S fundraises, working closely with the CEO, HQ’s Community Engagement and Corporate Communications & Marketing staff.

Responsibilities

Fundraising Foundations

Design and stand up 4S’ core fundraising approach — a donor pipeline and a repeatable calendar of campaigns/appeals.

Support the procurement and implementation of 4S’ Donor and Volunteer Management System (DVMS), then manage its donation-related functions, including donor records and donation tracking, to support donor engagement and regular giving across the organization.

Develop and implement plans to meet agreed year-one and year-two fundraising targets and grant KPIs, with an initial focus on the Community-based Centres’ funding needs. Track progress and propose higher targets for agreement with the CEO where feasible.

Partnership Development

Build 4S's first structured base of corporate, foundation and community partnerships — moving beyond one-off donations toward small numbers of well-managed, renewable relationships.

Prepare partnership proposals and manage the resulting agreements/MoUs. Coordinate sponsorships and donations (cash/in-kind) with the relevant facilities, including donor follow-up.

Donor Stewardship

Establish a simple, consistent stewardship cadence (acknowledgement, updates, impact reporting) for 4S's existing and new donors.

Use what Adopt-A-Wish surfaced about donor behavior to refine the next campaign.

Governance

Keep accurate fundraising records and ensure activities comply with the Charities Act, Commissioner of Charities and NCSS requirements.

Provide the CEO, Board and relevant Management Committees with straightforward updates on pipeline, funds raised and donor retention at agreed intervals, attending meetings as required. Prepare progress and outcome reports in line with grant requirements.

What you’ll partner on not own:

Digital fundraising platforms, campaign content and social media: partner with the HQ’s Community Engagement and Corporate Communications & Marketing staff on campaign delivery, content, publicity and brand alignment.

Requirements

Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications or related field.

5 years' relevant experience in fundraising, partnerships or business development, including experience helping build or scale a fundraising function (not only operating within an established one) — this is a build role, not a maintenance role.

A proven track record in donor or partnership acquisition, ideally including hands-on campaign delivery rather than only strategy.

Strong proposal writing, communication and relationship-building skills; comfortable working with limited existing infrastructure.

Working knowledge of Singapore charity governance and compliance (Charities Act, IPC requirements).

Genuine interest in eldercare / community-based social service work.

Working Arrangements

Reports to Chief Executive Officer

44 hours per week, 5-day work week

Availability to attend meetings or work on weekends when required

Willingness to work five days per week at Eunos Crescent, Singapore

4S is a social service agency in Singapore established by a team of professionals who dedicated their time and effort to help the sick and the less fortunate in our society. It is:

a secular and non-ethnic based organisation registered with the: Commissioner of Charities on 25 April 1996 (Registration Number: 01172)

Registrar of Societies on 13 September 1996 (UEN: S96SS0160E – from 1 January 2009)

a full member of the National Council of Social Service with Charitable Fund membership.

Our Mission

To be a widely respected social service organisation in Singapore providing holistic and quality services to all

Our Motto

"Love All, Serve All" and "Help Ever, Hurt Never" - The motto that steers 4S in dedicating itself to serve all with love. The service user-centric effort in service delivery, built on strong tradition of care and concern and service excellence over the past 16 years, drives 4S to provide reliable and holistic care with professionalism and a human touch

Our Core Values

Compassion – Being connected with and having a sense of empathy with the less fortunate in our society • Commitment - Being dedicated and taking pride in our work • Integrity – Treating everyone fairly and honestly, and doing what is right in all circumstances • Professionalism – Being skilled and knowledgeable, and working hand in hand with our partners with mutual trust and respect

For more information on 4S, visit http://www.4s.org.sg/

title: Manager, Business Development & Cloud Partnerships Enablement APAC
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Manager, Business Development & Cloud Partnerships Enablement APAC

Overview:
Mastercard Services is building a cloud channel to distribute its ISV and SaaS products through the hyperscalers. AWS is the priority, followed by Microsoft Azure, Alibaba Cloud, and others across Asia Pacific. The priority products are in MarTech (Dynamic Yield personalisation) and cybersecurity (Recorded Future threat intelligence).

As Partner Enablement Manager, reporting to Director, Cloud Partnerships APAC, you will make sure hyperscaler sellers understand what Mastercard brings and why it matters to their customers. You will also make sure Mastercard's own sellers know how to work with the hyperscalers instead of around them. Everything you build should lead to registered opportunities, co-sell activity and revenue through cloud channels.

Role/Responsibilities:
• Hyperscaler Enablement: Getting Cloud Partners Ready to Sell Mastercard
o Design and deliver enablement programs for hyperscaler field teams (account managers, partner managers, solutions architects and marketplace specialists) on Mastercard Services products.
o Build role-based content that gives partner sellers a reason to bring Mastercard into their accounts: value propositions, customer use cases, discovery questions, joint sales plays and objection handling.
o Work with hyperscaler partner teams to plug Mastercard content into their own internal enablement channels and seller programs.
o Support marketplace readiness, including listing content, private offer mechanics and collateral that explains how customers can buy Mastercard solutions through the marketplace and their cloud commitments.
o Localise enablement for APAC markets (e.g. Japan, Australia, Singapore, Southeast Asia), adjusting for language, regulation and how local field teams operate.
o Assist in field marketing activities (e.g. staff a trade show booth, deliver sales presentations, etc.)

• Internal Enablement: Helping Mastercard's Field Win with Hyperscalers
o Equip Mastercard sellers, solution specialists and account teams to co-sell with the hyperscalers confidently.
o Build "How to Win with Cloud Partners" resources covering account mapping, opportunity registration, co-sell programs (e.g. AWS ACE and ISV Accelerate) and marketplace transactions.
o Develop and run the account mapping process between Mastercard and hyperscaler sales teams, from preparation and joint prioritisation through to follow-through. This includes working with Legal and Compliance on what can be shared and when.
o Run regular internal sessions on partner engagement models, deal registration, co-marketing funds and how marketplace deals affect revenue and attribution.
o Act as the go-between for the Mastercard field and the cloud partnerships team, making sure sellers know who to call and when.

• Programs, Content and Operations
o Own the cloud partner enablement library: co-sell decks, battlecards, sales plays, case studies and FAQs, kept current and easy to find.
o Work with Product Marketing and product teams to turn launches and messaging into partner-ready materials quickly.
o Coordinate partner-facing events, workshops and seller enablement days with hyperscaler field teams, including using MDF where it's available.
o Track and manage enablement deliverables across products and markets, and keep stakeholders informed without burying them in status reports.

• Measuring Impact
o Track enablement KPIs and connect them to commercial outcomes: sellers enabled, opportunities registered, co-sell engagement, marketplace transactions and partner-sourced pipeline.
o Use pipeline data, win/loss insights and field feedback to find gaps and improve programs.
o Feed partner and market insights back to Sales, Product and Marketing.
Experience:
• 3+ years in partner enablement, channel enablement or partner programs at a SaaS, cloud or technology company.
• A track record of building scalable partner and internal sales enablement programs tied to pipeline and revenue, not just content production.
• Experience building or supporting account mapping and joint pipeline processes between a vendor's field team and partner sales organisations.
• Strong programme and project management skills, with several workstreams across markets running at once.
• A data-driven approach: you measure what you do and drop what doesn't work.
• Highly Preferred: Hands-on experience with at least one major hyperscaler partner program (AWS strongly preferred), including co-sell mechanics, opportunity registration and marketplace listings.

About you:
• You're comfortable with ambiguity and like building things as you go.
• You can explain a complex product simply enough that a busy hyperscaler seller will remember it on a customer call.
• You build credibility quickly with external partners and internal field teams, and you influence people without having authority over them.
• You're commercially minded and judge your work by the pipeline it creates, not the number of decks you've made.
• You listen well, collaborate well and stay humble enough to keep learning from internal teams and external experts.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Director, Global Materials Portfolio & Supply Strategy
description:
ABOUT YOUR ROLE:

The Director, Material Portfolio and Supply Strategy is a senior enterprise leadership role responsible for shaping VF’s material portfolio strategy, establishing supply strategy frameworks, and enabling Material Experience Centers in Singapore and key regions. The role connects brand needs, category strategy, supplier capability, sustainability, cost/value opportunities, and material storytelling to create a focused, scalable, and commercially impactful material ecosystem.

The incumbent will establish portfolio governance, preferred material platforms, supply strategy frameworks, and center activation models, while partnering with Material Sourcing leads and cross-functional teams to support execution, unlock enterprise leverage, inspire innovation, and improve material decision-making.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

MATERIAL PORTFOLIO STRATEGY, CURATION & VALUE CREATION

• Own the enterprise material portfolio strategy across categories, linking brand needs, product requirements, commercial priorities, sustainability, and supply capabilities.

• Identify cross-brand and cross-category opportunities to increase scale, reduce duplication, improve value, and strengthen strategic supplier partnerships.

• Define portfolio architecture, decision criteria, and governance for preferred, core, strategic, innovative, and emerging materials.

• Lead portfolio reviews to assess relevance, duplication, adoption, performance, and opportunities to scale, refresh, or sunset materials.

SUPPLY STRATEGY FRAMEWORK, SUPPLIER ECOSYSTEM & MATERIAL PLATFORMS

• Establish supply strategy frameworks for strategic material platforms, including supplier segmentation, capability mapping, capacity readiness, cost positioning, regional considerations, and scalability requirements.

• Define the operating model for supply strategy alignment across material categories, brand priorities, sourcing regions, and supplier networks, in partnership with Material Sourcing leads who own execution.

• Enable cross-brand leverage by creating visibility to demand, volume, fragmentation, and supplier opportunities for Material Sourcing leads to execute.

MATERIAL EXPERIENCE CENTER, INNOVATION & MARKET INTELLIGENCE

• Establish and maintain the Singapore Material Experience Center and enable regional centers as spaces for material inspiration, supplier storytelling, innovation, and strategic portfolio engagement.

• Curate material stories, displays, supplier showcases, and experience journeys that spark idea creation and accelerate material exploration across brands.

• Own the multi-year material portfolio roadmap across categories, aligned with brand strategies, product needs, value creation priorities, sustainability goals, and evolving supply-market capabilities.

• Build a structured market intelligence and scouting approach covering material technologies, supplier capabilities, cost drivers, sustainability, regulatory shifts, and consumer expectations.

• Shape strategic supplier engagement for portfolio priorities, preferred platforms, capability development, supply resilience, innovation themes, and enterprise value creation with category sourcing and development leaders.

• Connect supplier capabilities with cross-brand needs to unlock differentiated solutions, faster commercialization, and scalable value.

DIGITAL GOVERNANCE, DATA & ENTERPRISE LEADERSHIP

• Partner with technology and data teams to strengthen the digital material ecosystem and create simple, scalable user experiences.

• Establish dashboards and operating rhythms to track portfolio health, platform adoption, value creation, supply risk, scouting progress, and center engagement.

• Create decision rights, standards, and governance connecting portfolio strategy, supply frameworks, brand needs, regional execution, and supplier partnership processes.

• Lead and develop a high-performing, inclusive team with expertise in material portfolio strategy, supply strategy, category insights, supplier capability, analytics, governance, and operations.

• Build trusted relationships across brands, categories, regions, and functions to align priorities, resolve trade-offs, and deliver enterprise outcomes.

• Influence senior leaders through clear insights, compelling material storytelling, fact-based recommendations, and transparent measures of value.

WHAT WE WILL BE LOOKING FOR IN YOU:

• Deep expertise across material categories, with the ability to connect technical knowledge, portfolio strategy, commercial value, sustainability, and supply considerations.

• Proven experience shaping enterprise material, category, portfolio, innovation, or supplier strategies in a complex global organization.

• Strong commercial and analytical acumen, with demonstrated success converting leverage opportunities into measurable value.

• Demonstrated capability in portfolio governance, supply strategy frameworks, market intelligence, supplier scouting, Material Experience Center activation, and innovation-to-scale processes.

• Ability to translate complex market and technical signals into clear choices, priorities, stories, and actions.

• Experienced people leader and enterprise connector with excellent executive communication, facilitation, and storytelling skills.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• A clear enterprise material portfolio strategy is established, governed, and adopted across brands, categories, and key functional partners.

• Material choices are more focused, commercially grounded, supply-ready, and aligned to brand, consumer, performance, sustainability, and value needs.

• Cross-brand and cross-category leverage opportunities are visible, governed, adopted, and converted into measurable enterprise value.

• A clear material portfolio roadmap and repeatable market intelligence and scouting engine inform brand strategies, supply strategy frameworks, innovation pipelines, and category plans.

• Material Experience Centers in Singapore and key regions are actively used to inspire ideas, showcase strategic materials, engage partners, and convert exploration into pilots or innovation opportunities.

• Material portfolio duplication is reduced, adoption of strategic platforms increases, and teams make faster, better-informed decisions.

• A connected internal and external material ecosystem expands VF’s access to relevant capabilities and future opportunities.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

• A purpose-driven opportunity to transform how material portfolios are built, governed, sourced, shared, and scaled across iconic global brands.

• A platform to lead cross-brand and cross-category impact in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment.

• A best-in-class work environment, well-being policies, and workplace flexibility designed to help you show up and lean into life with your whole self - emotionally, physically, and socially.

title: Social Commerce Executive (Full-Time)
description:
*The Role*

We are looking for a proactive and results-driven *Social Commerce Executive* to grow our TikTok Shop and Shopee social commerce channels through *affiliate partnerships*, *creator collaborations*, and *livestream operations*.

This is a hands-on role where you'll *recruit and manage affiliates*, *coordinate livestream hosts*, *optimise campaign performance*, and *analyse sales data *to drive growth. Working closely with the founder, you'll have the opportunity to shape strategies that directly impact revenue.

*Key ResponsibilitiesAffiliate & Creator Management*

* Recruit 30–50 affiliates and KOCs each month through TikTok Shop and Shopee Affiliate programmes.
* Manage the end-to-end affiliate lifecycle, including prospecting, outreach, sample seeding, follow-ups, onboarding, and relationship management.
* Negotiate commission structures and collaboration opportunities with high-performing creators.
* Manage TikTok Shop Affiliate Center and Shopee Affiliate backend, including campaign setup, sample requests, and payout tracking.
* Build and maintain an affiliate CRM to track creator performance, GMV, engagement, and communications.
* Draft professional outreach messages, partnership proposals, and creator communications.

*Livestream Operations*

* Build and manage the weekly livestream host roster across Singapore and the Philippines.

*Performance & Analytics*

* Monitor key metrics including CTR, Add-to-Cart Rate, Conversion Rate, AOV, and GMV.
* Analyse affiliate, creator, and livestream performance to identify opportunities for growth.
* Benchmark competitors using tools such as Kalodata, FastMoss, and TikTok Shop Analytics.
* Prepare weekly reports with actionable insights and recommendations.

*Who We're Looking For*

* 2–4 years of experience in *social commerce, TikTok Shop, Shopee, e-commerce, affiliate marketing, influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or livestream operations*.
* Experience managing affiliate programmes, creators, KOLs, or influencer campaigns.
* Good understanding of TikTok Shop and Shopee seller ecosystems.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and recommend improvements.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
* Comfortable appearing on camera occasionally or supporting livestream host onboarding.
* Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets.
* Fluent in English. Conversational Mandarin is an advantage.
* Able to work evenings or weekends during major sales campaigns (time off in lieu provided).

*Nice to Have*

* Existing network of TikTok creators, affiliates, or KOCs.
* Experience with OBS, StreamYard, or TikTok Live Studio.
* Familiarity with Kalodata, FastMoss, Shoplus, or similar analytics tools.
* Basic video editing or content creation skills.
* Experience using AI tools to improve outreach or workflow efficiency.

*What You'll Get*

* Base salary: SGD 4,000–5,000, depending on experience.
* Performance incentives tied to affiliate GMV and livestream sales.
* AWS.
* Annual leave and CPF in accordance with Singapore statutory requirements.
* Direct exposure to the founders with fast decision-making and minimal bureaucracy.
* Ownership of initiatives that directly contribute to business growth.
* Opportunities to build expertise in one of Southeast Asia's fastest-growing e-commerce sectors.

*Apply Now*

If you're passionate about TikTok Shop, creator partnerships, affiliate marketing, and livestream commerce, we'd love to hear from you.

Click *"Apply Now"* and submit your resume. If you have a portfolio or examples of campaigns you've managed, feel free to include them with your application.

_Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted within 5 working days._

Pay: $4,000.00 - $5,000.00 per month

Benefits:
* Health insurance
* Professional development
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Singapore 118529

title: GTM Partnerships Manager (Corp Sec & Accounting Firms), SME & Growth
description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

About the team

The GTM Partnerships team at Airwallex is focused on building and scaling partnerships that accelerate customer acquisition, deepen ecosystem reach, and unlock long-term growth. In Singapore, this role will support our SME & Growth segment by owning a curated, high-value portfolio of corporate secretarial and accounting firm partners.

Success in this role comes primarily from deep, hands-on management of your existing book, complemented by growing share of wallet with those partners and hunting new high-priority partners to fill any gaps.

What you'll do

As the GTM Partnerships Manager (Priority), you will own a curated portfolio of roughly 50–60 corporate secretarial and accounting firm partners in Singapore. The majority of your time will go toward managing and growing this existing book — deepening relationships, increasing share of wallet, and preventing churn — with the remainder spent proactively hunting new high-potential partners to fill any gaps in your portfolio.

This role is based in Singapore.

Responsibilities:

Own and manage a curated portfolio of ~50–60 priority corporate secretarial and accounting firm partners through deep, 1:1 relationship management — the core focus of this role

Grow share of wallet with existing partners through tailored campaigns, proposals, and co-marketing initiatives that drive incremental referral volume and conversion

Prevent churn and reactivate dormant partners within your own book before they require broader escalation

Fill gaps in your portfolio by proactively hunting and acquiring new high-potential partners through networking events, referrals, and your own sourced channels

Host and represent Airwallex at networking, partner enablement, and client enablement events to build pipeline and strengthen existing relationships

Own partner performance end-to-end — from referral generation through to conversion — partnering closely with sales, operations, and marketing to close the loop

Negotiate partnership terms, incentive structures, and co-marketing commitments directly with partners

Maintain accurate CRM records and forecast referral and revenue performance for your portfolio

Contribute market and partner insights to senior GTM Partnerships stakeholders on how to strengthen the priority partner tier

Who you are

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

5+ years of experience in channel partnerships, business development, or account management, ideally within or adjacent to the corporate secretarial, accounting, or professional services industry in Singapore

Proven experience designing and executing tailored campaigns or partnership proposals for individual partners

Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills, with a track record of closing and growing partner agreements

Primarily a “farmer” mindset — skilled at deepening existing relationships and growing share of wallet — complemented by a “hunter” instinct for proactively prospecting and acquiring net-new partners to fill portfolio gaps, e.g. through networking events, referrals, or your own sourced channels

Demonstrated ability to own numbers end-to-end, from referral generation through to conversion, and to work cross-functionally with sales, operations, and marketing to do so

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

Preferred qualifications:

Existing network of relationships within the corporate secretarial / accounting firm community in Singapore

Comfortable hosting or leading networking, partner enablement, or client enablement events

Familiarity with CRM tools and forecasting referral / revenue pipelines

Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth technology or fintech environment

Proficiency in both written and spoken English and Mandarin

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Senior Vice President, Product Manager - Tech
description:
We are seeking a Senior Vice President, Applied AI Product Manager – Tech to translate high-value business and client opportunities into viable AI-enabled products, agents and workflow capabilities.

Working alongside the Applied AI Product Manager, you will convert the product vision and intended business outcomes into a clear technical product approach, MVP, delivery backlog and implementation pathway. You will work closely with designers, engineers, AI and data specialists, business teams and control functions to move selected opportunities from discovery through prototype, pilot and production handoff.

You will determine how AI should be applied, how human and AI activities should interact and what data, integrations, controls and evaluation methods are required. You will ensure that proposed products are usable, technically feasible, measurable, governable and appropriate for a highly regulated environment.

You will be expected to operate confidently in technical detail, make informed product trade-offs and provide clear direction to multidisciplinary delivery teams.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

Technical product definition

Partner with the Applied AI Product Manager and Designer to translate business problems, client needs and product concepts into technically viable AI-enabled products and workflows.
Define technical product vision, MVP scope, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and delivery roadmap.
Own and prioritize the technical product backlog, balancing user value, business outcomes, feasibility, risk and delivery effort.
Identify appropriate applications of generative AI, agentic workflows, intelligent automation and decision-support capabilities.
Determine which activities should be automated, augmented, escalated or remain human-led.

AI product development and prototyping

Shape AI-enabled workflows, agents, prototypes and proofs of concept in partnership with AI, data, engineering and design teams.
Define requirements relating to data, integrations, permissions, model behavior, orchestration, user interaction and performance.
Guide product decisions involving large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge systems, prompt and context design and agentic workflows.
Use approved AI-enabled development and prototyping tools to accelerate research, requirements definition, experimentation and product delivery.
Design experiments that test the most important product and technical assumptions before significant investment is committed.

Delivery, governance and measurable outcomes

Lead the technical product journey from opportunity definition through prototype, MVP, pilot and production transition or handoff.
Coordinate engineers, AI and data specialists, designers, platform teams and control partners to maintain delivery momentum and resolve dependencies.
Establish evaluation criteria for product quality, reliability, model performance, user experience and business impact.
Incorporate responsible AI, data, privacy, security, compliance and operational-resilience requirements from the outset.
Use testing, user feedback and performance evidence to refine priorities and inform scale, redesign or stop decisions.
Maintain alignment between the product vision, technical execution, user needs and expected value.

Stakeholder leadership and capability building

Communicate technical product concepts, trade-offs and risks clearly to senior business, client and technology stakeholders.
Build trusted relationships across product, design, engineering, AI, data, operations, risk and business teams.
Create alignment between business and technical stakeholders and ensure key decisions are made at the appropriate level.
Provide direction and accountability across small, multidisciplinary delivery teams.
Mentor colleagues and strengthen applied AI and technical product-management capabilities across APAC.
Contribute reusable methods, patterns and practices that improve the quality and speed of future AI product delivery.

What we are looking for

The ideal candidate combines senior product-management experience, practical AI fluency, financial services knowledge and the ability to translate strategic intent into executable technical products.

You will bring:

Significant experience, typically 15 years or more across technical product management, technology-led transformation, innovation, consulting or enterprise delivery.
Recent experience shaping, building or scaling AI-enabled products, platforms, agents, workflow capabilities or intelligent automation.
Strong financial services expertise, ideally across banking, asset servicing, capital markets, payments, operations, risk, compliance or enterprise data.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into MVPs, product backlogs, requirements, roadmaps, prototypes and delivery plans.
Strong understanding of generative AI, large language model applications, intelligent automation, agentic workflows and responsible AI principles.
Practical familiarity with AI methods such as prompt and context design, retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge graphs, model evaluation or agent orchestration.
Working knowledge of enterprise technology concepts, including APIs, data flows, integration patterns, permissions, security and production readiness.
Experience taking enterprise products from discovery and prototype through pilot, adoption and production transition.
Experience using AI-assisted development, coding or prototyping tools would be advantageous.
Experience operating within complex, regulated and highly governed environments.
Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, prioritization and delivery-leadership skills.
A record of delivering measurable business or client outcomes rather than outputs alone.
Relevant product, agile, AI or industry qualifications would be beneficial; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

Behavioral attributes

The strongest candidates will be:

Technically curious and able to evaluate emerging AI capabilities critically.
Comfortable moving between product strategy, technical requirements and delivery detail.
Commercially aware and focused on applying technology to meaningful business and client problems.
Collaborative and low ego, with the ability to work across business, design and technical disciplines.
Able to create clarity and momentum when the product or delivery path is still evolving.
Open to challenge and willing to change direction when evidence invalidates an assumption.
Resilient in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.
Risk-aware and thoughtful about applying AI within a regulated enterprise.
Committed to developing others and building sustainable team capability.

title: Regional Legal Counsel
company: LVMH Beauty - LVMH Fragrances and Cosmetics
description:
Company Description

The ASPAC Legal Department of LVMH’s Beauty Division is looking to hire a Legal Counsel (7- PQE) to be based in Singapore. If you are a diligent, capable and articulate common-law and private practice-trained lawyer with strong legal fundamentals, intellectual curiosity and exceptional drafting skills, looking for a role where law, data, business and luxury gracefully intertwine, this opportunity is for you – your lawyering prowess, diplomacy and keen eye for detail will directly contribute to the smooth functioning of a fast-paced and dynamic Legal Department in the ASPAC region.

This is an incredible opportunity to work with our iconic houses in the Beauty Division: Parfums Christian Dior, Guerlain, Givenchy, Benefit Cosmetics, Make Up For Ever, Fresh, Acqua di Parma, Maison Francis Kurkdjian, Kendo Brands and Kenzo Parfums.

Job Description

Provide day-to-day legal advice and support to the LVMH Beauty portfolio in both its local market and travel retail businesses and across all operational verticals, including real estate/ leasing, retail, digital, supply chain, marketing and visual merchandising, for the following brands: Parfums Christian Dior, Guerlain, Givenchy, Benefit Cosmetics, Make Up For Ever, Fresh, Acqua di Parma, Maison Francis Kurkdjian, Kendo Brands, Fenty and Kenzo Parfums.
Draft, review and advise on a broad range of commercial, corporate, real estate and regulatory matters relevant to the Beauty Division, including agency, retail, e-commerce, marketing, influencer and talent engagement, events, licensing, supply chain, warehousing, logistics, procurement, services, confidentiality, and other business partnership arrangements.
Spearhead and support data privacy, data governance and legal compliance projects and workstreams, including advising on personal data protection laws, marketing consent frameworks, customer data use, cross-border transfers, vendor compliance and the implementation of internal privacy policies and processes.
Track and interpret developments in ASPAC’s data protection laws and regulatory frameworks, reviewing new legislation to assess its practical implications for the Beauty Division’s operations; provide compliance support in advising Maison stakeholders on data privacy compliance matters arising from the division’s business activities, identifying and recommending best practices where relevant.
Support the conduct of regular privacy and consumer law risk assessments, coordinate data audits, and help maintain accurate and compliant privacy documentation and records.
Assist in managing privacy-related user complaints and data breach incidents, supporting timely investigation, escalation, and resolution in line with regulatory requirements.
Partner with regional and global legal colleagues to develop, roll out and embed legal best practices and legal risk management initiatives across the Beauty Division.
Prepare and update contract templates to maintain an up-to-date repository of contracts for key stakeholders, and provide regular training to stakeholders across the business, including training on the use of contract templates and key legal issues relevant to their roles within the business.
Support legal, privacy and special projects as tasked by the Beauty Division – Regional Legal Director (General Counsel) from time to time.

Qualifications

Holder of a valid legal practitioner qualification in a developed Common Law jurisdiction, preferably Singapore.
7+ years of post-qualification experience in a reputable law firm – our preference is to hire candidates currently working in private practice.
Demonstrated substantial hands-on experience in drafting and reviewing a broad range of commercial, licensing, eCommerce and marketing terms & conditions, as well as preparing articulated legal advice & memoranda. (Strong drafting and communication skills are fundamental requirements for the role and will be assessed as part of the recruitment process through a written test.)
Experience dealing with privacy, data protection and cybersecurity matters arising in the context of general corporate and commercial transactions. Whilst we are not seeking a specialist data privacy counsel - candidates should however be comfortable in reviewing regulations, identifying and addressing mandatory requirements, spotting issues, and undertaking data/ risk mapping exercises as part of the assigned broader commercial legal work.
Demonstrated experience in coordinating and managing legal projects on selected marketing, advertising and eCommerce projects, including working cross-functionally and driving matters through implementation.
Ability to work independently – once the successful candidate is assimilated into the role, he/she will not be under daily supervision for BAU (‘business as usual’) matters.
Highly agile with the ability to adapt quickly to changing circumstances and continuously recalibrate priorities in response to evolving business, legal and organizational needs.
Excellent command of the English language is essential. Proficiency in Mandarin and Bahasa Indonesia/Malay would be an advantage, as the role involves liaising with stakeholders across our Southeast Asia and Greater China operations.
Warm, yet polished, firm and well-spoken, with outstanding interpersonal skills and a proven ability to communicate effectively and diplomatically across diverse cultures and seniority levels.

title: Senior Sales Manager / Director — Renewables & Power, ASEAN
description:
ABOUT UNIVERS

Univers combines global operating scale, deep industrial intelligence, and recognition from the institutions shaping energy, technology, and sustainability. The platforms built for the last decade were designed to monitor.

Univers was built to act — not just report

Univers operates at global scale:

1,070 GW+ Energy assets under AI management

450M+ Connected sensors and devices

800+ Enterprise customers

Leader Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader

ROLE OVERVIEW / THE OPPORTUNITY

You will get Univers software into ASEAN's renewable and power projects, by selling to the companies that own the assets and through the companies that build and equip them. Your customers are large IPPs and developers; your routes to market are EPCs and OEMs (inverter, BESS, turbine and switchgear vendors) that specify control and data systems on every project. You know who's who in ASEAN power, and you know how to turn those relationships into pipeline, specification wins and upsell.

RESPONSIBILITIES/WHAT YOU WILL DO

Sell to end users - large IPPs and developers

Own a new-business quota across ASEAN and build a qualified pipeline of 3-4x target.
Win portfolio-level deals with IPPs and developers for BESS FMS/SCADA, Hybrid Plant Control (PPC), EnOS asset performance management, renewable forecasting, Trading/AIM and long-term service agreements.
Map each customer's portfolio, development pipeline and decision-makers (asset management, O&M, trading, digital, procurement) and build multi-year account plans.
Upsell the installed base: turn single-project software into portfolio frameworks, centralised control centres, upgrades and recurring services.

Sell through the ecosystem - EPCs and OEMs

Build partnerships with EPCs and OEMs so Univers is specified in bids, BOMs and owner's-engineer requirements from the design stage.
Co-sell with Envision Energy and other OEM/integrator partners on BESS and hybrid projects; agree scope, pricing and commercial terms that protect software value.
Equip partners with positioning, reference cases and pricing so they can pull Univers into their deals.
Work with lenders' and owner's engineers, consultants and grid-connection advisors who shape technical specs.

Leverage the ASEAN ecosystem

Use industry networks - national renewable and solar associations, chambers of commerce, ASEAN Centre for Energy, Enlit Asia, Singapore International Energy Week and similar - to open doors and build Univers' brand.
Track tenders, capacity auctions, grid codes, DPPA and market reforms in Vietnam, the Philippines, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia, and turn them into account strategies.
Run complex sales cycles end to end: discovery, solution design with presales, RFP responses, pricing, negotiation and handover to delivery.
Keep Salesforce accurate: weekly pipeline, monthly revenue and cash forecast, win/loss reviews.

REQUIREMENTS/WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Must have

10+ years (Manager: 6+) of B2B sales or business development in the renewable / power sector in ASEAN.
Direct experience selling to large IPPs or developers, and working with EPCs and OEMs to get products specified and sold through.
A strong, current network across ASEAN's power ecosystem: IPPs, developers, EPCs, OEMs, utilities, investors and consultants, in at least three ASEAN markets.
A consistent record of meeting or beating quota (Director: has closed multiple SGD 3M+ deals).
Understanding of renewable and storage project economics (PPAs, merchant revenue, ancillary services) and plant control / grid-connection requirements (SCADA, PPC, EMS, grid codes).
Comfortable negotiating with C-level customers and managing multi-party deals across owner, EPC and OEM.
Eligible to work in Singapore.

Nice to have

Background at an OEM, EPC, BESS integrator or energy software vendor in ASEAN.
Experience with partner / channel programmes and co-selling agreements.
Engineering or finance degree; MBA a plus.

title: Senior Account Manager/Director, Key Account & ASEAN Grid Operators
description:
ABOUT UNIVERS

Univers combines global operating scale, deep industrial intelligence, and recognition from the institutions shaping energy, technology, and sustainability. The platforms built for the last decade were designed to monitor.

Univers was built to act — not just report.

Univers operates at global scale:

1,070 GW+ Energy assets under AI management
450M+ Connected sensors and devices
800+ Enterprise customers
Leader Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader

ROLE OVERVIEW / THE OPPORTUNITY

You will own strategic relationships with leading utility, grid operator, and critical infrastructure customers across Singapore and ASEAN. Your primary objective is to expand existing deployments into multi-product, multi-year partnerships by understanding how operators manage power systems, energy transition initiatives, distributed energy resources, and critical infrastructure operations, and aligning Univers' platform capabilities to their operational and business priorities.

You will work closely with regulators, utilities, system operators, and energy ecosystem stakeholders to identify next-generation grid modernization opportunities, technology adoption pathways, and policy gaps where Univers and industry partners can jointly drive innovation and transformation.

You will also leverage successful customer engagements as reference accounts to expand Univers' footprint across regional utilities, system operators, and energy infrastructure organizations throughout ASEAN.

RESPONSIBILITIES / WHAT YOU WILL DO

Deepen and Expand Strategic Utility & Infrastructure Accounts (~70% of time)

Own strategic account plans, including relationship mapping, white-space analysis, 3-year expansion roadmaps, and annual revenue targets.
Build trusted relationships from operational teams through executive leadership across utilities, grid operators, energy infrastructure organizations, regulators, and associated digital transformation teams.
Translate grid operation pain points, such as DER visibility, flexibility and congestion management, outage and asset health, forecasting, EV charging load, into Univers use cases and business cases.
Expand customer adoption from Virtual Power Plants (VPP) into adjacent offerings including:
AI Grid
BESS EMS/SCADA
Smart EV Charging
District Energy
Smart Building Portfolios
Trading/AIM for market participation
Lead the full commercial cycle including opportunity identification, solution workshops, proposal development, tender submissions, pricing, contract negotiations, and renewals.
Collaborate closely with Solutions, Product, Engineering, and Delivery teams to ensure customer success and feed Key Account requirements into product roadmaps.
Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasting, and revenue tracking within Salesforce.

Extend to ASEAN Grid Operators (~30% of time, growing)

Package successful customer outcomes into repeatable "national grid flexibility" references for regional utilities through ASEAN Power Grid network, qualify and prioritize next Key Account in ASEAN.
Build target account plans for priority operators, e.g. TNB (Malaysia), PLN (Indonesia), EGAT / PEA / MEA (Thailand), EVN / NSMO (Vietnam) and NGCP (Philippines), CLP (Hong Kong).
Build account plans for key regional utility and energy infrastructure organizations across Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines, Hong Kong, and other target markets.
Engage industry forums and events such as:
HAPUA / ASEAN Power Grid
Enlit Asia
Singapore International Energy Week
Regional Utility and Energy Conferences
Position Univers as a leading AI-powered energy and grid transformation partner.
Explore co-selling opportunities and partnerships (with Key Account's partners) with consulting firms, technology partners, utilities, and system integrators across the region.

REQUIREMENTS / WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

title: Group Sustainability (Managing Director, Executive Director)

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. Graduate degree from an accredited university or equivalent.

conversations, and change-management strategy

enablement, and operational decisions

authority

frameworks

title: Leasing Manager (Retail Expansion)
description:
We are looking for an experienced and well-connected Business Development Manager to support the Group’s expansion across its beverage, bakery and retail brands.

This role will be responsible for identifying and securing suitable retail locations across Singapore, with a strong focus on shopping malls, retail developments and high-traffic commercial locations.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of Singapore’s retail and shopping mall landscape, including mall positioning, tenant mix, rental rates, footfall, customer demographics and available retail spaces.

You should also have an established network and strong working relationships with major shopping mall landlords, developers, leasing teams and property representatives, with the ability to identify opportunities and negotiate favourable commercial terms for the Group.

This is a hands-on role covering the full process from site identification and evaluation to lease negotiation, store expansion and lease renewal.

Responsibilities:

1. Retail Site Identification & Expansion

Identify and source suitable retail locations for the Group’s beverage, bakery and retail brands across Singapore.

Proactively monitor upcoming vacancies, new developments, mall repositioning projects and potential retail opportunities.

Build and maintain a pipeline of potential locations suitable for different brand concepts and store formats.

Evaluate locations based on mall positioning, footfall, customer demographics, tenant mix, accessibility, visibility, unit size and commercial potential.

Recommend suitable locations based on each brand’s target customers, business model and expansion strategy.

2. Shopping Mall & Landlord Relationships

Develop and maintain strong relationships with major shopping mall owners, landlords, developers, leasing teams and property agents.

Leverage existing industry networks and market resources to gain access to suitable retail opportunities and upcoming vacancies.

Maintain regular communication with landlords and leasing representatives to stay informed of new opportunities, rental movements and mall developments.

Establish the Group as a preferred and reliable retail/F&B tenant.

3. Rental & Lease Negotiation

Lead negotiations with landlords on rental rates, lease terms, security deposits, rent-free periods, fitting-out periods, turnover rent, service charges, marketing fees and other tenancy terms.

Analyse and benchmark rental rates across comparable malls and locations.

Negotiate commercially favourable terms while considering the long-term viability of each site.

Review and evaluate Letters of Offer, tenancy agreements and other leasing-related documents together with relevant internal teams and professional advisors.

Identify potential commercial or contractual risks and highlight them to management.

4. Lease Renewal & Existing Store Portfolio

Provide management with insights on suitable malls, locations and commercial opportunities.

Assess the suitability of different locations for different brands based on brand positioning, customer profile and expected sales potential.

Coordinate site visits, landlord meetings, commercial discussions and handover requirements.

Support the team from initial site selection through to lease execution and store opening.

Ensure key commercial and tenancy information is clearly communicated to relevant stakeholders.

8. New Business & Strategic Partnerships

Identify potential strategic opportunities with shopping malls, landlords, developers and other property partners.

Explore opportunities for new store formats, pop-ups, kiosks, flagship stores and other retail concepts.

Build long-term partnerships that support the Group’s expansion across Singapore and potentially the wider Southeast Asian market.

Strong understanding of the Singapore shopping mall and retail property landscape.

Proven network and established relationships with major shopping mall landlords, developers, leasing teams and property agents in Singapore.

Strong knowledge of retail rental rates, mall positioning, tenant mix, footfall and retail market trends.

Demonstrated experience in lease negotiation and commercial tenancy negotiations.

Experience managing lease renewals and existing retail portfolios.

Strong commercial acumen with the ability to evaluate the financial viability of potential locations.

Strong negotiation, communication and stakeholder management skills.

Able to work independently, identify opportunities proactively and drive projects from initial discussion through to completion.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with good attention to commercial and contractual details.

Experience in F&B, beverage, bakery, retail, lifestyle or consumer brands is highly preferred.

.

Strong communication in

English

and

title: Senior Assistant Director, Space Planning and Data Intelligence

Develop and maintain a comprehensive space information framework, including space inventory, occupancy and utilisation data, planning parameters, and portfolio information to support consistent and evidence-based decision-making.

Strong data and analytical capabilities, with experience in developing or applying space information systems, dashboards, business intelligence tools, data visualisation, or planning analytics.
Able to translate complex data and analysis into clear strategic insights, recommendations, and actionable plans for senior management and governance-level decision-making.

title: Account Manager - Stakeholder Advisory and Engagement Agency
description:

This is a fantastic opportunity to join one of our client communications teams and deliver high calibre, multi-channel communications solutions for our blue-chip client base. It’s a genuine opportunity to work in a fast-moving environment across a range of channels and audiences.
You will be involved in a diverse client base, providing an opportunity to learn across a range of sectors.
It’s a fantastic chance to grow and expand your responsibilities as part of a career development plan.

Our client communication teams are looking for a highly motivated and ambitious individual, who is looking to deliver high calibre, multi-channel communications solutions for our blue-chip client base, including annual reports and reviews, sustainability reports, investor relations and employee communications, online reporting centres, website maintenance and social media campaigns.

In time you will have the opportunities and platform to develop your career within this growing and highly ambitious organisation.
The successful candidate must be comfortable communicating with clients and internal teams, have a keen eye for detail, strong communication and interpersonal skills, creative flair and want to participate in building one of the largest and most successful professional service companies of its kind.

Responsibilities:
Account management
Successfully manage the delivery of assigned mixed-media projects, taking responsibility for all deliverables
Develop an intrinsic understanding of your clients’ business model and strategy
Effectively manage each project stage
Accurately prepare all project documentation
Demonstrate real strength in identifying and managing account and project problems independently and provide effective solutions
Client relationship management
Proactively build strong client relationships with your day-to-day client contacts
Always deliver exemplary client services helping to ensure we maintain the current high levels of client satisfaction and continually seek ways to exceed our clients’ expectations

Effectively manage project budgets by implementing all Black Sun’s quality assurance and financial processes

Work closely with team leaders to successfully identify new business opportunities from your existing clients, writing client proposals and effectively presenting concepts and delivery presentations
Support the new business process by assisting with the delivery of new business proposals
Research and strategic development
Support internal teams with Black Sun’s research into best practice corporate communications by conducting research
Continually drive your understanding of our clients’ businesses, the industries they operate in, and trends in best practice corporate communications

Qualifications, experience & skills:
Minimum 2.5 years agency or client-side experience, ideally within corporate marketing and communications.
Excellent writing, editing, proof reading skills are essential.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills are essential.
Exceptional attention to detail; and
Be fully conversant with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Your personal qualities:
Strong interpersonal and communications skills necessary to build trust and respect both externally and internally.
High-quality service ethic and committed to customer service excellence.
Ability to manage many urgent and often conflicting priorities.
Strong ‘can do’ attitude with an innate ambition to take initiative and work by yourself as well as in a team.
Flexibility and team focussed approach with a ‘roll up your sleeves’ attitude to getting the job done; and
A great sense of humour and fun!

Reporting Relationships
Reporting to: Account Director
Work closely with: Creative and Production teams, as well as Digital, Research & Strategy and Finance teams.

Interview process
Phone screening with office manager
1st Interview (teams) with hiring manager
2nd interview (f2f) with hiring director and hiring manager, presentation of task

What we offer
In addition to a competitive salary based on skills and experience, as an employee at Black Sun, you will have access to a range of great benefits and perks, including:
Extraordinary Workplace: : Our office is in a 1920s heritage building right in the heart of Chinatown, surrounded by Michelin-rated eats and city buzz. We’ve even got a rooftop garden home to over 70 species of bees and butterflies. It’s certainly not your average workspace!
Hybrid Working : We ask for three days a week in the office to keep our collaborative energy strong, but you can also work fully remotely for up to two 2-week periods a year (within a 2-hour time difference)
In addition to 22 days’ annual leave and bank holidays, we offer 14 fully paid medical leave and childcare leave, in accordance with MOM’s regulations.
Designated medical service via MinMed and have access to our wellbeing support via our international EAP Service ComPsych Guidance Resources, offering confidential emotional, legal, financial, and life support. This is available 24/7 to you and your immediate family with a digital App to easily access all these resources from your own device.
Bonus Scheme : we offer a discretionary annual bonus to recognise great work and team success.
Training & Development We’re big believers in potential. Our new digital learning platform, Viva Learning makes it easier than ever to build skills, explore content, and take ownership of your development. With access to thousands of videos, articles, and Microsoft 365 courses you can learn at your own pace, when and where it suits you.
Have Your Say: We’re a place where ideas are welcome and voices are heard. Our open-door culture means managers are approachable, and your input can genuinely shape how we work and grow.
Team Socials : We take our celebrations seriously. From social activities, festivity luncheons to company get-togethers, there’s always something to look forward to.

Black Sun Global is a stakeholder advisory and engagement agency that’s been driving transformation and positive change for ambitious brands for more than 20 years. title: Business Development Manager - Institutional Payments
description:

title: Global Payments Screening Operations (Japanese & Mandarin Speaker) - Analyst
description:

Help safeguard the financial system at global scale. In Global Screening Operations, you will review client and transaction screening alerts, apply sanctions and Know Your Customer requirements, and help prevent financial crime. You will build strong risk and analytics skills, work with teams across regions, and contribute to process and technology improvements that raise quality and speed. As a Payment Lifecycle Analyst in Global Screening Operations within Payments Operations, you will ensure client and transaction activity complies with global and local regulatory requirements. You will investigate alerts from screening systems and validate potential sanctions and politically exposed person matches, documenting decisions with clear evidence. You will work with Asia-based clients and stakeholders, and the role requires you to read and interpret Japanese and Chinese documents as part of case investigation and resolution. You will also support improvements to controls, metrics, and technology to strengthen outcomes and consistency.

Job responsibilities

Review and investigate transaction and client screening alerts using screening platforms and research tools.
Apply sanctions and Know Your Customer requirements, including Office of Foreign Assets Control and other sanctions regimes.
Validate potential sanctions and politically exposed person matches and escalate cases where required.

Manage shared mailboxes, perform manual screening where needed, and conduct inquiries to close information gaps.
Meet service-level agreements and performance targets while maintaining high quality and confidentiality.
Analyze trends and metrics and prepare management reporting.
Identify process gaps and deliver improvements that increase efficiency, quality, and consistency.
Support technology enhancements, including requirements gathering and user acceptance testing.
Stay current on policy, control, and procedure changes and help embed updates into daily work.
Collaborate with global partners to resolve complex cases and share best practices to maintain consistent standards.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

Bachelor's degree.
Ability to read and speak Japanese (min JLPT N3 level or higher) and Mandarin as the role requires you to read and interpret documents in Japanese and Mandarin as part of case investigation and resolution.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with sound, timely decision-making.
Strong attention to detail, including disciplined documentation and evidence retention.
Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines in a regulatory environment.
Proven ability to manage multiple tasks and adapt to change.
Familiarity with service-level agreements and performance measures such as key performance indicators and key risk indicators.
Commitment to confidentiality and quality in a risk-intensive environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.

Experience in high-volume processing, risk operations, or screening work in financial services.
Experience with payments screening or financial crime prevention.
Knowledge of banking systems across lines of business.

title: Director, OTCR, CIB
description:
Requisition Number: 64054
Job Location: Singapore, SGP
Global Grade: Band 5
Work Type: Office Working
Employment Type: Permanent
Posting Start Date: 15/10/2026
Posting End Date: 15/11/2026
:
Job Summary

The purpose of this role is to act as the primary point of contact within the Second Line Operational, Technology and Cyber Risk (OTCR) function for the Corporate and Investment Banking business (the Business), covering all non‑financial risk matters across operational processes, technology platforms, information security and cyber resilience.

The role provides independent oversight, challenge and assurance to ensure that the Business identifies, assesses, manages and escalates Operational, Technology and Cyber risks in line with the Group’s Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERMF) and the OTCR Risk Type Framework, and that material risks and control weaknesses are transparently governed.

Key Responsibilities

This role includes responsibility for monitoring, reviewing and challenging the Business’s adherence to its obligations under the Operational, Technology and Cyber Risk frameworks, ensuring that:
• Material risks across operations, systems, technology resilience, cyber security and data are appropriately identified and assessed;
• Controls are designed, implemented and operating effectively; and
• Breaches, incidents and weaknesses are escalated in line with appetite, policy and governance requirements.
This is delivered through close collaboration with other Second Line risk teams, including Technology Risk, Information & Cyber Security (ICS), Third Party Risk and relevant Centres of Excellence, as well as enterprise‑wide SMEs.
The role holder is expected to demonstrate deep subject matter expertise in one or more OTCR domains, including:
• Operational and process risk within Corporate and Investment Banking;
• Technology risk, system stability, resilience and change delivery;
• Information and Cyber Security risk, including data protection and control frameworks.
• The role holder must understand the interdependencies between operational processes, technology platforms and cyber vulnerabilities, and how weaknesses in one domain can amplify risk in another.
• Coverage includes all Second Line responsibilities within the Group’s Enterprise Risk Management Framework (‘ERMF’). This includes oversight, review and challenge of all risk decision making within the Business.
From a regulatory perspective, the role requires a strong understanding of global supervisory expectations relating to operational resilience, technology risk and cyber security, including banks’ obligations to demonstrate robust identification, monitoring and control of risks arising from end‑to‑end processes, critical systems and digital infrastructure

• The role holder is expected to understand how these requirements are embedded within the OTCR Risk Type Framework, and how they interact with other Risk Type Frameworks under the ERMF.
• The Second Line OTCR function is responsible for independent oversight and challenge, ensuring that risks are appropriately identified, assessed, controlled and managed within risk appetite, and that material issues are escalated, tracked and remediated. The role holder is accountable for leading the delivery of Second Line OTCR responsibilities for the CIB business, including continuous improvement of risk transparency, control effectiveness and governance outcomes.

Business
• Demonstrate deep understanding of the Business strategic priorities to effectively advise and challenge decisions across all relevant Risk Types. Demonstrated experience/SME in an equivalent 1st line/2nd line role managing one or more areas of the Business particularly Operations is a strong plus.
• Review and recommend resolutions to risk-related escalations from the Business, keeping in mind Operational, Technology and Cyber Risk Appetite thresholds, policies, and procedures.
• Work with OTCR Policy team to clarify / interpret any policy-related matters or queries from the Business.
• Identify internal / external insights and emerging risks that can impact the Business.
• Attend relevant Business Risk committees representing Risk in advising, challenging and providing Risk insights to business stakeholders.

Processes
• Take ownership of all Second Line OTCR accountabilities within the ERMF, as they pertain to the Business, including active participation in OTCR governance forums, risk reviews, control assessments and thematic deep dives.

Risk Management

Governance

Regulatory & Business Conduct

• Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
• Support the CIB Operational, Technology and Cyber Risk function to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles.

Other Responsibilities

Motivations

• Energised by analysing complex risk and control information to identify emerging threats, systemic weaknesses and opportunities for sustainable risk reduction.
• Driven by improving the effectiveness of material controls and ensuring that risk assessments, remediation plans and management decisions are supported by clear evidence and sound judgement.
• Thrives in a fast-paced and evolving risk environment that requires critical thinking, commercial awareness and confident decision-making across technology, cyber, resilience and third-party risk.

Our Ideal Candidate

10+ years of experience in Technology and Cyber Risk management within the Banking industry, including relevant regulation and industry trends. In particular, the role holder will demonstrate:
