title: Aftermarket Product Sales Manager
description:
If you desire to be part of something special, to be part of a winning team, to be part of a fun team – winning is fun. We are looking forward to an Aftermarket Product Sales Manager in Eaton’s Aerospace business, based in Singapore. In Eaton, making our work exciting, engaging, meaningful; ensuring safety, health, wellness; and being a model of inclusion & diversity are already embedded in who we are - it’s in our values, part of our vision, and our clearly defined aspirational goals.

What you’ll do:

Leads the business launch, market development, and profitable growth of aftermarket repair, overhaul, retrofit, modification, and upgrade solutions supported by Eaton Aerospace Component Services Asia (EAS) across the Asia Pacific region.

The Aftermarket Product Sales Manager serves as the commercial business owner for the assigned product lines and aftermarket programs. The position identifies and evaluates market opportunities, develops business and customer capture strategies, establishes pricing approaches, coordinates cross-functional business launch activities, and drives opportunities through execution to achieve order intake, sales, profitability, and market share objectives.

The position works closely with the APAC Sales team, EAS, FMC team, Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Customer Service, and other global stakeholders to translate customer and market requirements into commercially viable aftermarket solutions.

Following the establishment of EAS and the initial deployment of MRO capabilities, the role focuses primarily on launching and sustaining new business, developing the regional opportunity pipeline, expanding customer and product coverage, supporting new repair capability introduction, and ensuring that commercial commitments are converted into sustainable business performance and customer satisfaction.

• Market Development & Opportunity Identification - Identify and prioritize aftermarket repair, upgrade, and service opportunities through market, customer, and competitive analysis to drive profitable growth across APAC.
• Business Development & Customer Capture - Develop customer engagement and capture strategies in partnership with Sales and product teams to convert opportunities into bookings and revenue.
• Opportunity Pipeline Management - Manage the regional opportunity pipeline and drive execution to improve opportunity conversion, forecast accuracy, and business growth.
• Business Launch & Commercial Execution - Lead commercial activities for new business launches, ensuring customer requirements and market opportunities are successfully translated into executable growth plans.
• Capability Expansion & Business Cases - upport new repair capability and service expansion initiatives through market assessments, business case development, and revenue projections.
• Pricing & Commercial Strategy - Develop pricing strategies and commercial proposals that support competitiveness, profitability, and long-term business growth.
• Market Intelligence - Monitor market trends, fleet developments, customer needs, and competitor activities to support strategic decision-making and growth initiatives.
• Forecasting & Business Planning - Prepare forecasts and business analyses that support Profit Plan, SIOP, business reviews, and strategic planning activities.
• Cross-Functional Coordination - Coordinate commercial, operational, and technical stakeholders to support successful business launches and opportunity execution.
• Business Performance Management - Monitor sales, pipeline, pricing, and profitability performance and recommend actions to improve business results and customer satisfaction.
• Customer & Partner Engagement - Support customer engagement and build effective relationships with airlines, MROs, distributors, and strategic partners to expand aftermarket business opportunities.
• Sales Enablement & Knowledge Sharing - Develop sales tools, customer presentations, and training materials to improve commercial effectiveness and organizational capability.

Qualifications:

• Requires a bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing, Aviation, or a related discipline. An MBA or advanced degree is preferred.
• Requires a minimum of five years of relevant experience in sales, product management, business development, marketing, program management, or a related commercial role.

• Requires strong business acumen and the ability to understand customer requirements, market trends, competitive dynamics, business case financials, pricing considerations, and the commercial implications of operational decisions.
• Requires knowledge of the aerospace industry. Experience in aerospace aftermarket, airline maintenance, MRO, component repair, product support, or related service businesses is preferred.
• Requires the ability to conduct market assessments, customer analysis, competitive analysis, opportunity qualification, and business case development.
• Requires the ability to translate market and customer information into practical growth strategies, value propositions, commercial plans, and cross-functional execution actions.
• Requires an understanding of aftermarket business models, including repair and overhaul services, retrofit, modification and upgrade programs, long-term agreements, PBH arrangements, and service capability development.
• Requires demonstrated capability in opportunity pipeline management, sales forecasting, commercial planning, pricing strategy, and performance analysis.
• Requires effective program and project management skills to coordinate business launches, capability expansion activities, customer commitments, and cross-functional deliverables.
• Requires the ability to operate effectively within a global and highly matrixed organization, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and drive alignment across commercial and operational functions.
• Requires strong customer interface skills and the ability to uncover customer needs, frame business problems, develop differentiated solutions, and contribute to winning capture strategies.
• Requires the ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with customers, Sales teams, business leaders, product divisions, operational sites, and strategic partners.
• Requires strong analytical skills and proficiency in interpreting sales, forecast, customer, product, fleet, and financial information.
• Requires strong written and verbal communication, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
• Requires the ability to manage multiple priorities, make recommendations with incomplete information, and maintain execution discipline in a changing business environment.
• Requires proficiency in standard business systems and tools used for customer relationship management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, reporting, presentation development, and data analysis.
• Prefers experience supporting new capability deployment, MRO business launch, commercial integration, or regional expansion initiatives.

title: Monetization Enablement Partner - GBS
description:
Marketing & Communications

Monetization Enablement Partner - GBS

Location :

Singapore

Employment Type :

Regular

Job Code :

A161849

Responsibilities

The Global Business Marketing (GBM) team champions TikTok in the B2B landscape, showing advertisers and sales teams how TikTok's creative ecosystem drives real business results. We build the stories, education, and go-to-market programs that sellers use to deepen client relationships across markets. Working with brands of all sizes, we also bring campaigns to life through creative ideation, brand and event strategy, and the design and production of TikTok for Business marketing, so advertisers can create content that connect with audiences. Trends, consumer behavior, and advertising formats all move quickly on TikTok. The challenge is turning what makes the platform engaging into solutions that are creative, measurable, and scalable across very different markets, without making the experience feel like traditional advertising. You will shape how the market understands TikTok as a business platform, and help brands show up authentically on it. The Monetization Enablement Partner is an individual contributor role focused on building product capability, seller readiness, scaled enablement, and adoption for the GBS sales organization. You will help translate priority products, roadmap changes, and market-facing product narratives into enablement that sellers can understand, practice, and use in customer conversations. At its core, your work will help Monetization Enablement close the gap between knowing a product and confidently selling it. Operating between Product, Product Marketing, Go-to-Market, regional enablement, and Sales, you will turn complex product information into global-ready learning, activation moments, reusable assets, and feedback loops that support consistent execution across markets. This role is intentionally designed as a flexible profile that can sit wherever the team needs additional capacity. The core expectation stays consistent: product fluency, comfort with product and Product Marketing partners, strong enablement craft, and the ability to turn product knowledge into seller readiness at scale. This function will evolve alongside business needs, focusing primarily on: - Product Knowledge Translation: Turning complex product information into practical seller-facing guidance, learning moments, and product walkthroughs. - Global Product Readiness & Activation: Supporting product trainings, deep dives, hands-on activations, and walkthroughs tied to quarterly priority product launches. - Adoption Feedback & Program Improvement: Capturing seller and regional signal to improve future programs and strengthen the connection between enablement, readiness, and adoption. - AI-Enabled Scale: Using AI to improve content workflows, product knowledge management, facilitator support, and reusable enablement assets. - Product Capability & Field Readiness - Serve as a product capability partner across Monetization Enablement, bringing product depth and validation into enablement tied to quarterly product priorities, deep dives, hands-on activations, and product walkthroughs. - Translate complex product capabilities, roadmap changes, and market-facing product narratives into accessible enablement content, learning moments, and field-ready messaging. - Support the design of product trainings and scaled learning moments by making product nuance, use cases, and seller applicability clear. - Synthesize product complexity into simple learning structures that can be delivered consistently by regional POCs across markets. - Activation Design & Seller Adoption - Design repeatable activation formats, hands-on learning experiences, and facilitation guides that regional POCs can adapt and run in their markets. - Help sellers move from product awareness into confidence, usage, and practical customer conversations. - Support product labs, dogfooding, walkthroughs, and other high-impact learning moments tied to priority products. - Help connect activation moments to seller behavior, product adoption, and business outcomes. - Cross-Functional Partnership & Regional Execution - Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Go-to-Market, regional enablement, and Sales stakeholders to ensure programs are accurate, relevant, and tied to real seller needs. - Work closely with regional POCs to improve the quality of execution and ensure global programs are practical, engaging, and regionally relevant. - Capture and synthesize signal from field activations, dogfooding, and regional execution to improve future program design. - Partner with the broader Monetization Enablement team to ensure assigned work aligns with launch timing, readiness needs, and adoption goals. - Scaled Systems & AI Workflows - Help build repeatable frameworks and AI-enabled workflows that make product learning assets easier to create, update, and scale. - Use AI tools to support learning design, content development, knowledge management, facilitator support, and scaled execution. - Help track program success, especially where product understanding, seller confidence, and product adoption need to be connected more clearly. - Operate effectively in an environment that moves quickly, changes rapidly, and values clear thinking, follow-through, and hands-on execution.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications - Experience: Relevant experience in product marketing, product management, product enablement, go-to-market strategy, sales enablement, field activation, learning design, or a closely related field. - Product Translation: Demonstrated ability to translate complex product information into clear, compelling, and practical field-facing content or learning experiences. - Activation Design: Experience supporting product adoption, seller engagement, or commercial outcomes through activations, deep dives, workshops, walkthroughs, or live learning programs. - Stakeholder Partnership: Ability to partner credibly with Product, Product Marketing, Go-to-Market, Sales, and regional stakeholders. - Scaled Enablement: Experience building or supporting enablement programs, reusable frameworks, or learning assets in a fast-moving environment. - AI Comfort: Genuine excitement about AI, with comfort applying AI tools to program design, content development, learning workflows, knowledge management, or scaled execution. - Communication: Clear communication, synthesis, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications - Experience in digital advertising, monetization, commerce, SaaS, or another product-driven business. - Experience supporting product launches, scaled learning programs, or field-facing product readiness efforts across multiple markets. - Experience connecting learning and activation programs to measurable adoption, usage, confidence, or commercial outcomes. - Curiosity and practical ideas for how AI can improve product knowledge systems, enablement design, and learning scale. - Comfort operating in ambiguity and helping build a new capability model while the organization evolves.

Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo. ​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day. ​

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. ​

​

Diversity & Inclusion ​

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
description:
Job description and Responsibility for Chief ExecutiveOfficer and Executive Director, GEM Asset Management Pte Ltd

1. RoleOverview

TheChief Executive Officer (CEO) and Executive Director (ED) is responsible forthe overall management, strategic direction and operational performance of thecompany. The CEO & ED will oversee the company's business activities andensure that appropriate governance, compliance and risk management frameworksare established, implemented and maintained in accordance with applicable MASregulations, notices, guidelines and licensing conditions.

Workingclosely with the Board of Directors, shareholders, senior management andrelevant control functions, the CEOED will ensure that the company operatesresponsibly, maintains high standards of corporate governance, and fulfils itsongoing regulatory obligations.

He/shemust possess strong leadership capabilities; extensive financial marketsexperience and a sound understanding of Singapore's capital markets regulatoryframework.

2. Key Responsibilities

A.Corporate Leadership and Business Strategy

· Leadthe company's overall business operations, strategic planning and long-termdevelopment.

· Developand implement business strategies aligned with the Board's objectives,commercial priorities and risk appetite.

· Identifybusiness opportunities, develop strategic partnerships and strengthen thecompany's market position.

· Monitorbusiness performance and provide regular updates to the Board on strategicinitiatives, operational matters and financial results.

· Buildand lead a competent management team, fostering a culture of integrity,accountability, professionalism and regulatory compliance.

B.Regulatory Compliance and Governance

· Ensurethat the company's business activities comply with applicable MAS regulations,notices, guidelines, licensing conditions and relevant Singapore laws.

· Overseethe implementation and maintenance of appropriate compliance policies,procedures, internal controls and governance arrangements.

· Workclosely with the compliance function to monitor regulatory developments, assesscompliance risks, and implement necessary measures to address changes inregulatory requirements.

· Ensurethat regulatory obligations, including reporting, record-keeping andnotification requirements, are fulfilled accurately and within the applicabletimelines.

· Overseethe identification, escalation, investigation and remediation of materialcompliance breaches, control deficiencies and regulatory incidents.

· Promotea strong compliance culture throughout the organization and ensure thatemployees understand and adhere to applicable regulatory obligations andinternal policies.

· Ensurethat appropriate arrangements are in place for regulatory inspections, auditsand requests for information from MAS.

· Providethe Board with timely updates on material regulatory developments, compliancematters and remediation actions.

C.Operational Management

· Overseethe company's day-to-day operations and ensure that business activities areconducted efficiently and in accordance with established policies andprocedures.

· Ensurethat operational systems, processes and infrastructure remain appropriate forthe company's business activities and regulatory obligations.

· Overseesecurities trading operations, transaction processing, settlement arrangementsand relationships with relevant service providers where applicable.

· Establishclear lines of responsibility, appropriate delegation of authority andeffective management reporting procedures.

· Ensurethat business continuity, disaster recovery, cybersecurity and operationalresilience arrangements are maintained and periodically reviewed.

D.Risk Management and Internal Controls

· Overseethe implementation and maintenance of an effective risk management frameworkappropriate to the company's business model, activities and risk profile.

· Identify,assess, monitor, and mitigate material business, financial, operational,regulatory, technology and reputational risks.

· Ensurethat appropriate trading controls, risk limits, approval procedures andescalation mechanisms are established and maintained where applicable.

· Monitorthe effectiveness of internal controls and ensure that identified deficienciesare addressed promptly.

· Ensurethat material risk events, operational incidents and potential regulatorybreaches are escalated to the appropriate management personnel and the Board.

E.Supervision of Representatives and Employees

· Ensurethat employees and appointed representatives performing regulated activitiesmeet the applicable regulatory requirements.

· Overseeappropriate supervision arrangements in accordance with relevant MASrequirements.

· Ensurethat relevant personnel receive appropriate regulatory compliance andoperational training.

· Promotehigh standards of professional conduct, ethical behaviour and accountability.

· Addressmisconduct, competency deficiencies, and breaches of internal policies throughappropriate escalation and corrective measures.

· Ensurethat relevant personnel understand their responsibilities in maintainingcompliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies.

F.Financial Management and Business Performance

· Overseethe company's financial planning, budgeting, cash flow management, andfinancial performance.

· Ensurethat the company maintains adequate financial resources and complies withapplicable regulatory financial requirements.

· Monitoroperating expenditure, revenue generation, profitability and financialsustainability.

· Establishappropriate financial reporting and management information systems to supporteffective decision-making.

· Reporton material financial matters and emerging financial risks to the Board in atimely manner.

· Ensurethat business expansion and investment decisions are consistent with thecompany's financial capacity, risk appetite and regulatory obligations.

G.Stakeholder and Board Engagement

· Maintaineffective communication with the Board of Directors, shareholders, investors,regulators, auditors, professional advisers and business partners.

· Serveas a key executive contact for MAS and other relevant regulatory authorities inrelation to the company's ongoing regulatory obligations.

· Providethe Board with regular updates on business performance, operational matters,compliance status, risk exposures and regulatory developments.

· Ensurethat material incidents, regulatory concerns and significant businessdevelopments are promptly communicated to the appropriate stakeholders.

· Supportthe Board in fulfilling its corporate governance, oversight and accountabilityresponsibilities.

3. OverallAccountability

· The CEO is ultimately responsible,within the authority delegated by the Board and subject to applicable laws andregulatory requirements, for the effective management and performance of thecompany's business operations.

· The role requires strong commercialleadership combined with a clear commitment to regulatory compliance, soundcorporate governance and effective risk management.

· The CEO must ensure that the company'soperations are conducted in accordance with applicable MAS requirements andthat appropriate systems, policies, procedures and controls are maintained tosupport the company's ongoing regulatory obligations and long-term businessobjectives.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
About Young Hungry Free

Young Hungry Free is a Singapore fashion label founded in 2012, known for edgy basics and wearable trends in sizes XXS to 3XL. A new named collection drops online every Monday at 8pm, and the #YHFAMILY community — members, Telegram subscribers and creators — is at the centre of how the brand grows. We ship from Singapore to customers across the region and beyond.

The role

You will tell the Young Hungry Free story every week. The core of the role is the weekly drop cycle: the content, copy, social publishing and creator seeding that bring each Monday collection to life. Around that, you will help deliver the brand's bigger moments — seasonal and collaboration campaigns, PR and events.

You will lead those bigger moments rather than support them, own media relations, and manage campaign budgets.

What you will do

1. Weekly content and social

Plan and run the content calendar around the Monday 8pm drop: teasers, launch-night content and follow-up.

Write copy for collection launches, product stories, social posts, EDMs and the website, in line with the brand's tone of voice and house style.

Schedule and publish across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and the #YHFAMILY Telegram channel, and manage community comments.

Brief designers, photographers and videographers.

Supply copy and assets for performance and CRM campaigns. The performance and marketing teams own targeting, flows and media buying.

2. Campaigns

Turn campaign strategy into narratives, key messages and visual direction for seasonal, launch and collaboration campaigns.

Coordinate campaign delivery across channels and teams, to agreed timelines.

Lead campaigns from brief to wrap reports.

3. PR and earned media

Maintain the media list, draft press releases and pitches, and manage press seeding.

Track coverage and report on earned media.

Own media relations, including building relationships with editors and handling enquiries.

4. Events and activations

Help plan and run pop-ups, launches and brand events, including vendor coordination and on-the-day delivery.

Lead events from concept to wrap, including vendors and budget.

5. Creators, KOLs and community

Run / Co-run the organic creator and ambassador programme end to end: shortlisting, outreach, product seeding against each drop, briefing and relationship management.

Build a library of user-generated content with written usage permissions.

Ensure all gifted and paid creator content carries the correct disclosure.

Work with the performance team on paid and affiliate creator partnerships, which they co-own.

6. Brand consistency

Apply the brand guidelines across every customer touchpoint, and flag inconsistencies before they go live.

7. Platform, Systems and Channel Management: Content Management Systems, Customer Relationship Management Systems, EDM Tools and Advertising Tools

Plan, execute and improve integrated campaign and marketing initiatives across our different CMS, CRM, EDM, Advertising tools and platforms.

8. Budget and reporting

Track campaign, seeding and event spend against budget, within approval limits set by the Head of Marketing.

Report monthly on content, social, creator and PR performance: what worked, what did not and what to change.

Work closely with performance marketing, CRM, product, operations and customer service.

Take on other duties within the marketing team as needed.

What we are looking for

Essential

Experience at the level you are applying for, ideally in fashion, lifestyle, e-commerce or an agency.

A portfolio showing copy you have written and social content you have produced or managed.

Strong English copywriting, with a sharp ear for tone.

Deep working knowledge of Instagram and TikTok — formats, trends, and what the analytics are telling you.

A strong visual eye and the ability to give clear campaign, marketing and suggest creative direction together with the creative team.

Events, pop-up or physical activation experience.

PR or media relations experience.

Short-form video editing, for example CapCut or Premiere Pro; basic Photoshop, Illustrator or Canva.

Experience with Klaviyo or a similar email platform, and with social scheduling tools.

humans@younghungryfree.com,

include position title in the subject line, your CV and any relevant information and the following details:

Name:

Earliest availability:

title: Assistant Director, Strategy, Public Sector Transformation, PSD
description:
The Challenge

The Public Service operates in an increasingly complex environment shaped by changing citizen expectations, workforce shifts, technological disruption and greater interdependence across agencies. Public Sector Transformation (PST) seeks to ensure that the Singapore Public Service remains future-ready, effective and trusted by continually reimagining how the Public Service works, develops its workforce and organises itself.

The PST Cluster leads and coordinates Whole-of-Government transformation. Its role spans setting the vision and strategic direction for PST, catalysing deep organisational and business transformation, building the capabilities and ecosystem needed to sustain change, applying AI to the key challenges of today and mobilising leaders and officers around a shared transformation agenda.

As Assistant Director (Strategy), you will provide strategic and organisational leadership across key PST strategic portfolios, covering sensemaking, conceptualising, catalyst and mobilising workstreams. You will translate emerging priorities and senior leadership direction into coherent strategies, governance arrangements, programmes and resourcing approaches that enable transformation across the Public Service.

This is both a strategy and delivery role. You will work at the intersection of policy, organisational transformation, innovation, technology, workforce capability and public-sector governance, while leading teams to turn broad and often ambiguous ambitions into practical, coordinated action.

Key Responsibilities

As a Team Lead to a team of 3-5 officers, you will:

A. Set and steward the strategic direction for Public Sector Transformation

Lead the development and continual refinement of the overarching PST strategy, identifying the major shifts required for the Public Service to remain effective and future-ready.
Synthesise emerging operating-environment trends, ground sentiment, organisational data and agency experience to surface strategic priorities and areas requiring Whole-of-Government intervention.
Translate senior leadership direction into clear transformation outcomes, priorities, implementation pathways and narratives for agencies, leaders and officers.
Ensure PST priorities remain aligned with broader Whole-of-Government, Centre-of-Government and Public Service priorities.
Oversee the monitoring and reporting of PST progress, surfacing key achievements, implementation challenges and areas requiring leadership attention.

B. Lead cross-cutting and AI-enabled transformation

Shape and coordinate major cross-cutting transformation priorities requiring joint ownership across policy, technology, workforce and corporate-function stakeholders.
Provide strategic leadership for AI-enabled PST, ensuring technology adoption is connected to business and workflow redesign, organisational change, workforce implications and measurable outcomes.
Work with functional and mission leads to identify high-impact transformation opportunities, define the desired picture of success and establish coherent governance and tracking arrangements.
Develop proposals for the capabilities, funding, headcount and specialist support needed to implement transformation at scale.

C. Shape resourcing, governance and implementation arrangements

Design governance and operating arrangements that clarify accountability, enable timely decisions and provide progress assurance without imposing unnecessary process.
Develop and evaluate funding and manpower proposals for Whole-of-Government transformation initiatives, working with finance and policy partners to align transformation funding with strategic outcomes.
Establish portfolio-level measures, review mechanisms and reporting arrangements that support learning and course correction.

D. Mobilise and align Whole-of-Government partners

Build trusted relationships with Centre-of-Government partners, ministries, statutory boards, transformation offices and delivery agencies.
Convene stakeholders around shared outcomes, particularly where responsibilities and resources are distributed across organisations.
Develop engagement approaches across multiple levels, from senior leadership forums to working-level communities and agency visits.

E. Lead teams and manage an evolving portfolio

Review and assure the quality of key products, including strategies, submissions, briefs, programme designs and senior-leadership materials.
Build a collaborative, high-performing team culture that is comfortable with ambiguity, experimentation and constructive challenge.

Requirements

We are looking for someone who is curious about the future of government, passionate about AI and innovation, and excited to work with diverse stakeholders to shape meaningful transformation across the Public Service.

You enjoy solving complex problems, thrive in collaborative environments and are motivated by turning ideas into practical impact. Whether developing AI-enabled initiatives, building partnerships or supporting innovation programmes, you are driven by a desire to improve outcomes for citizens and public officers alike.

Key Competencies

1. Thinking Clearly and Making Sound Judgement

o You consider stakeholder needs as well as short- and long-term implications in proposing solutions.

o You make sound judgements about different policy options by synthesising various data points and using a good sense of realities on the ground.

o You anticipate and prepare for queries from stakeholders when operationalising solutions.

2. Serving with Heart, Commitment and Purpose

o You guide your team to demonstrate care and empathy in delivering services to citizens and stakeholders.

o You are a role model of, and ensure that your team upholds, the Public Service values in the course of their work.

o You are a role model of resilience and bouncing back from adversity.

o You orchestrate resources and monitor your team’s progress towards deliverables.

o You ensure that your team delivers with high standards and you take responsibility for their collective performance.

3. Working Effectively with External Stakeholders

o You reconcile different opinions and approaches to maintain a constructive partnership with stakeholders.

o You proactively identify opportunities for collaboration with stakeholders to advance a common good.

o You anticipate and manage critical stakeholder issues with patience, humility and timeliness.

4. Stewarding Systems for Today and Tomorrow

o You willingly remove outdated practices and actively explore digital technology and tools to simplify work processes.

o You implement good knowledge management practices to retain and transfer knowledge within your team.

o You enforce measures to safeguard data.

Functional Competencies

5. AI and Digital Transformation

o You understand AI, Generative AI and other digital technologies, and appreciate their potential applications within the public sector.

o You leverage AI and digital technologies, including Generative AI, to improve productivity, redesign workflows and enhance service delivery.

o You translate business needs into practical AI-enabled solutions by balancing user needs, technical feasibility and organisational priorities.

o You demonstrate an understanding of AI governance, data management and responsible AI practices, and apply these principles when designing and implementing AI-enabled initiatives.

o You keep abreast of emerging technologies and continuously identify opportunities to strengthen AI adoption across the Public Service.

Relevant Experience and Track Record

Relevant experience in several of the following areas would be advantageous:

Public-sector strategy or policy
Cross-agency or Centre-of-Government coordination
Organisational transformation or organisational development
Digital or AI-enabled transformation
Innovation and ecosystem development

Capability development

A strong track record of leading complex and ambiguous work, influencing senior stakeholders, developing teams and translating strategy into implementation would be essential. Candidates with at least 3 years of supervisory experience managing small teams in a collaborative environment will be viewed favourably.

title: Structured Trade Finance Manager

description:
Our client, an established international commodities business is seeking a finance professional to support the structuring and execution of trade financing solutions across Asia. This role offers exposure to cross-border financing transactions, banking relationships and a range of financing structures supporting physical commodity flows.

Some of the key responsibilities will include:

• Structure, negotiate and execute bilateral financing facilities with banking partners across Asia, including regional and cross-border transactions.

• Support the execution of structured financing arrangements, including term loans, borrowing base facilities, prepayment financing, inventory and receivables financing, and export credit agency-backed facilities.

• Prepare and negotiate term sheets, facility agreements and security documentation in collaboration with external legal counsel.

• Coordinate transaction workstreams across internal teams, including credit, legal, trading and compliance, as well as external lenders and advisers.

• Monitor financing covenants, drawdowns and ongoing facility administration to ensure transactions are managed effectively.

• Develop and maintain relationships with banks, financial institutions and other financing counterparties.

• Contribute to the development of financing structures that support business requirements and underlying trade flows.

• Analyse relevant commodity markets, supply chains and financing considerations to support transaction execution and decision-making.

To be eligible for this role you will require:

• A degree in Finance, Law, Economics or a related discipline; relevant professional qualifications would be advantageous.

• 6–10 years of relevant experience in structured trade finance, commodity finance, corporate banking, treasury or a related financial services environment.

• Experience supporting cross-border financing transactions and working with banks, legal counsel and internal stakeholders.

• Strong understanding of commodity markets, physical trade flows and the financing requirements associated with underlying transactions.

• Strong documentation, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage complex transactions under tight timelines.

• Excellent command of English; the ability to read Chinese-language documents would be an advantage.

title: Sales & Customer Service Executive

You will handle showroom sales, respond to customer enquiries and provide product recommendations for kitchen and bathroom solutions. The ideal candidate enjoys interacting with people, has a strong service mindset and is committed to delivering a positive customer experience from initial enquiry to after-sales support.

You will be the key point of contact for customers visiting our showroom and those reaching out through WhatsApp, online chat and phone.

Our showroom customers are typically homeowners undertaking renovations and looking for suitable kitchen and bathroom products. You will understand their needs, recommend suitable products, explain product features and help customers make informed purchasing decisions.

You will develop strong product knowledge and provide a friendly, responsive and professional customer experience throughout the customer journey, from initial enquiry to purchase and after-sales support.

Attend to showroom walk-in customers, understand their renovation needs and recommend suitable products.

Explain product features, benefits and technical specifications in simple, practical terms.

Follow up with showroom visitors and prospective customers to support sales conversion.

Respond promptly and professionally to customer enquiries via WhatsApp, online chat and phone.

Assist customers with product information, quotations, order enquiries, delivery coordination and general after-sales support.

Maintain accurate customer enquiry records and follow up on outstanding requests.

Ensure the showroom and product displays are well-maintained and presentable.

Requirements

Warm, confident and patient communicator with good interpersonal skills.

Customer-oriented with the ability to understand customer needs and recommend suitable solutions without adopting a hard-selling approach.

Organised and responsive, with the ability to manage customer enquiries and follow-ups effectively.

Willing to learn product features and technical specifications and explain them clearly to customers.

Comfortable working in a hands-on and growing SME environment.

Experience in retail sales, customer service, interior design, renovation, furniture or hospitality is preferred but not essential.

What We Are Looking For

We welcome candidates who enjoy interacting with people, are service-oriented and take pride in helping customers find the right solutions for their homes. Candidates with a positive attitude, good communication skills and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.

Product training will be provided for candidates who demonstrate the right attitude and commitment to customer service.

Interested candidates, please send your updated resume to cv.get@recruithaus.com.sg

title: SALES SUPERVISOR
description:
A Sales Supervisor plays a critical role in supporting the success of an organization. They are the leader in coordinating the day-to-day activities of the sales representatives and ensuring that they are meeting their goals. The sales supervisor must work closely with the store manager, general manager, and production manager to communicate changing customer needs. As a liaison between the organization and the customers, the production supervisor must anticipate changing customer needs and design products that meet such needs.

Sales Supervisor Job Responsibilities

• Supervise the activities of the sales team including marketing activities like product activations.

• Assist the line manager to recruit, training, enumerating, and retaining a competent sales team.

• Provide reports to top management like sales reports, lead generation reports, customer complaints reports, and new customers’ on-boarded reports.

• Prepare sales presentations and other sales tools.

• Assist the line managers to ensure adequate client communication, maintain contacts with clients and provide feedback.

• Initiate sales activities, strategies, and sales plans required to build brand visibility.

• Serve as a point of reference to employees in terms of showing great work ethic, habits, personal character, and professional character.

• Develop and maintain accurate records of prospects, leads, pricing, sales activities, and active clients.

• Controlling company marketing expenses to ensure the marketing expenditure is kept within budget.

• Attend trade shows and other marketing events and represent the organization.

• Evaluate the performance of the sales team and seek ways to improve the team’s performance.

• Identify the trends in the market, both current, and future that are likely to affect the performance of the organization.

• Ensure the items are displayed correctly in the malls, supermarkets, and other sales points.

Sales Supervisor Skills/Abilities/Knowledge

• Bachelor’s degree in a business-related course with emphasis on marketing.

• Proven work experience in marketing and achieving set targets.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal communication.

• Ability to lead and motivate a sales team, and put in place measures to retain a great team.

• Excellent selling skills, ability to close deals, and deal with post-purchase anxiety.

• Excellent selling skills, people-oriented, and ability to motivate a team.

• Ability to identify potential areas of growth and identify new business partnership opportunities.

• Strong organization skills and multi-tasking skills.

• The ability to work under pressure.

• Availability to work within opening hours (e.g. evenings, holidays, weekends).

The Associate Director, Sales Compensation (Intelligence & Execution) will serve as the global owner for sales compensation operations, accountable for the accuracy, governance, and financial integrity of commission payments across the end-to-end process. This high-accountability role requires sound financial judgment, advanced analytical capability, strong control discipline, and the resilience to lead through complex, high-pressure monthly payroll cycles, overseeing compensation modeling, stress testing, monthly commission calculations, payroll processing, SOX controls, dispute resolution, clawbacks, recoveries, and plan effectiveness analytics.

The successful candidate will combine strategic foresight with operational excellence, acting as both an operational leader and compliance governor for the commission function. By partnering closely with Sales, Finance, Payroll, Legal, People Partners, and Compliance teams, this individual will ensure sales compensation processes remain accurate, transparent, scalable, and governed by strong financial controls.

Responsibilities and Impact:

By combining financial modeling, process discipline, stakeholder partnership, and strong audit readiness, the Finance Manager helps ensure commission payments are accurate, timely, transparent, and aligned with company policy and financial controls. The role directly supports seller trust, expense predictability, regulatory compliance, and scalable compensation operations.

Build and execute high-level and detailed scenario modeling and stress-testing frameworks to forecast total plan spend and assess the financial impact of plan adjustments, structural redesigns, or macroeconomic shifts.

Generate and refine global payout estimates and compensation decision models to support budget alignment.

Analyze plan effectiveness metrics and partner with Sales leadership to design plan optimization strategies and support annual target-setting frameworks.

Lead final validation and control overview for global commission payroll processing runs, providing final review and sign-off before submission.

Evaluate and authorize large payments, non-standard payouts, custom executive incentives, and other high-value commission exceptions.

Review and approve custom withholding, recovery, non-recoverable draw, guarantee, and clawback protocols in partnership with Payroll, Legal, People Partners, and Compliance teams.

Sign off on monthly Audit and SOX controls, ensuring internal controls over financial reporting are properly maintained, documented, and audit-ready.

Perform ongoing risk evaluations related to deal cancellations, retroactive adjustments, clawbacks, unauthorized overrides, and data integrity or security risks.

Conduct variance analyses, automated sanity testing, and targeted spot-checks to ensure commission calculation accuracy and data integrity.

Partner with Legal and People Partners to support resolution of sensitive compensation disputes and high-value sales compensation grievances, payout disputes with objectivity and diplomacy.

Review, evaluate, and approve calculation overrides, custom exception requests, and commission structures tied to Reductions in Force.

Automation & Reconciliation: Practical experience with script-based reconciliation or automation tools. Knowledge of VBA, Python/Pandas, SQL, Alteryx, or equivalent methods is a significant advantage for reconciling large dataset pipelines and identifying calculation or data integrity issues.

Risk Management & Controls: Ability to identify, evaluate, and mitigate risks related to overpayments, underpayments, cancellations, retroactive adjustments, unauthorized overrides, data integrity issues, data security risks, and non-standard payment exceptions.

Audit & SOX/ICFR Controls: Demonstrated ability to support SOX and internal controls over financial reporting, including maintaining audit-ready documentation, approvals, and evidence for commission processing.

Operational Resilience: High emotional intelligence, composure, and ability to operate effectively during deadline-driven payroll cycles without compromising accuracy, control standards, or employee experience.

Disciplined Process Adherence: Commitment to maintaining standardized operational checklists, SOPs, and governance workflows to ensure repeatable and auditable payout cycles.

title: Creative Producer, Senior Manager Asia
description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the Role

The Senior Manager, Creative producer — Asia (Ex IN) will lead the end-to-end operational delivery of regional campaigns across Asia excluding India, including Southeast Asia, Korea, Taiwan, and other priority markets. Based in Singapore, this role will ensure that campaigns move efficiently from brief to market through clear workflows, strong cross-functional coordination, disciplined production management, and reliable launch readiness.

You will work closely with Regional Marketing, Growth, Partnerships, Content, Communications & PR, Localization & Operations, Product, global creative teams, agencies, production partners, and distribution platforms. The role will manage campaign intake, prioritization, briefing, production, approvals, asset delivery, launch tracking, reporting, and post-campaign learning.

This is a senior individual-contributor role requiring strong project management, creative operations expertise, stakeholder influence, attention to detail, and the ability to manage complex multi-market campaigns across different time zones and cultures.

Role overview - Lead creative producer Across Asia (Ex IN)
Own campaign operations from intake and briefing through prioritization, resourcing, production, approvals, launch, and post-campaign closeout.
Translate regional marketing, content, growth, partnership, and communications priorities into clear creative briefs, scopes, workplans, timelines, owners, dependencies, and deliverables.
Establish campaign operating rhythms, status reporting, production trackers, decision forums, and escalation paths.
Maintain a consolidated view of campaign progress, asset status, approvals, risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and launch readiness.
Ensure campaigns are delivered on time, within agreed scope, and in line with brand, market, partner, legal, and channel requirements.
Manage Creative Production and Asset Delivery
Coordinate the development, adaptation, production, review, approval, and delivery of campaign assets across digital, social, content, partner, retail, event, platform, and owned channels.
Partner with creative leads to ensure briefs are complete, objectives are clear, audiences are defined, and deliverables are appropriately scoped.
Manage asset requirements, specifications, version control, usage rights, file delivery, trafficking, and distribution across markets and channels.
Coordinate creative revisions and approvals across Marketing, Creative, Content, Legal, Communications, Partners, and global teams.
Ensure final assets meet Crunchyroll brand standards, campaign objectives, partner specifications, local market requirements, and accessibility expectations.
Coordinate Localization and Market Adaptation
Manage the handoff of creative assets to Localization & Operations for translation, cultural adaptation, subtitling, dubbing, or other market requirements where applicable.
Track localized asset status, quality reviews, approvals, and final delivery across priority Asia (Ex IN) markets.
Ensure local adaptations preserve campaign intent, creative quality, brand consistency, and cultural relevance.
Identify localization dependencies and risks early and incorporate them into campaign plans and launch timelines.
Partner with regional market stakeholders to validate asset relevance and readiness.
Drive Cross-Functional Campaign Readiness
Coordinate with Regional Marketing, Growth, Partnerships, Content, Communications & PR, Localization & Operations, Product, Legal, Data, Finance, and Customer Experience.
Lead readiness reviews for content launches, seasonal campaigns, partner activations, brand initiatives, events, and market programs.
Track decisions, actions, dependencies, risks, and open issues through to resolution.
Ensure all campaign stakeholders understand their roles, deadlines, approval requirements, and launch responsibilities.
Escalate delivery risks and trade-offs in a timely, structured, and solutions-oriented way.
Manage Agencies and Production Partners
Coordinate internal creative teams, agencies, production companies, freelancers, localization vendors, media partners, and other external resources.
Establish clear scopes of work, production schedules, service levels, quality expectations, review cycles, and delivery requirements.
Monitor partner and vendor performance across quality, timeliness, responsiveness, capacity, and cost.
Support partner onboarding, briefing, evaluation, performance improvement, and closeout.
Build trusted relationships that improve creative efficiency, collaboration, and delivery quality.
Build Scalable Campaign Operations
Develop and maintain campaign operations playbooks, templates, workflows, checklists, dashboards, and reporting frameworks.
Improve briefing quality, production visibility, approval speed, asset reuse, localization handoffs, and launch execution.
Maintain organized campaign documentation, asset libraries, version control, rights information, and delivery records.
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and scale recurring campaign operations across the region.
Establish and track operational metrics such as on-time delivery, asset completeness, approval cycle time, issue aging, vendor performance, and launch quality.
Lead post-campaign reviews and translate learnings into improved processes, planning, and future campaign execution.
Experience and qualifications
8+ years of experience in campaign operations, creative operations, integrated marketing, production management, program management, or a related field.
Experience managing complex, multi-market campaigns across entertainment, media, streaming, technology, gaming, consumer platforms, or a related industry.
Strong understanding of creative briefing, production workflows, asset management, localization handoffs, approvals, trafficking, and launch readiness.
Demonstrated experience managing multiple campaigns, agencies, production partners, stakeholders, timelines, and dependencies simultaneously.
Experience building and improving creative operations processes, workflows, templates, trackers, dashboards, and quality-control frameworks.
Experience working with creative teams, marketing teams, localization vendors, media partners, agencies, and external production resources.
Strong project management, organization, prioritization, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to balance creative quality, cultural relevance, brand consistency, launch deadlines, partner requirements, and operational constraints.
Experience working in a matrixed and globally distributed organization across different time zones, markets, cultures, and backgrounds.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide concise status updates and executive-level escalations.
High attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality, timeliness, and follow-through.
Willingness to travel across Asia and internationally as required.
Fluency in English is required; knowledge of relevant Asian languages is a significant plus.
Knowledge and passion for anime, entertainment, creative culture, and fan communities is a significant plus.
Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.
Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.
Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance
Health Saving Account HSA program
Health care and dependent care FSA
401(k) plan, with employer match
Employer paid commuter benefit
Support program for new parents
Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!

The Senior Manager, HNW Distribution is responsible for building, deepening, and managing the HNW business relationships with international broker partners as a core pillar of the wealth distribution strategy. title: Sales Director, Scale
description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Braze is seeking an experienced Commercial Sales Director to drive our mid-market business across Asia. This is a GTM leadership role responsible for driving the next phase of growth, performance acceleration, and operational excellence across a diverse, multi-market region.

You will lead a team of Commercial Account Executives focused on delivering high-value engagements for Braze's market-leading Customer Engagement platform. This role requires a leader who combines strong commercial instincts with disciplined execution, deal strategy expertise, and a passion for developing high-performing teams.

The ideal candidate brings at least 5 years of deep experience leading Commercial sales teams in high-growth, competitive environments across Asia. You have successfully scaled performance, strengthened operating rigor, and driven measurable acceleration in complex markets. You understand the nuances of selling into Southeast Asia and the Greater China region, and you are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders across industries.

This role requires urgency, accountability, and a commitment to raising the bar, while building an inclusive, high-performance culture across diverse markets.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Build, lead, and elevate a high-performing team of Commercial Account Executives across Asia
Establish operational rigor and drive execution against ambitious Financial Year revenue objectives, accelerating both net-new acquisition and expansion within strategic accounts
Strengthen enterprise deal strategy, including multi-threading, executive engagement, and value-based selling in complex environments
Coach with intensity and purpose, raising performance standards while developing future leaders within the organization
Collaborate with Go-to-Market teams including SolCon, BDR, Marketing, Partnerships and Executives to ensure the successful execution of the FY plan and represent a clear, single vision to customers and the marketplace
Represent Braze in customer, partner, and industry forums as a trusted enterprise advisor
Plan and manage at both the strategic and operational levels
Be a proactive voice within our APAC and global sales leadership team

WHAT YOU HAVE

5+ years of experience successfully leading quota-carrying Commercial Account Executives in a high-growth SaaS environment
A proven track record of exceeding revenue goals and driving measurable performance improvement across teams
Demonstrated experience leading diverse, multi-cultural team across multiple Asian markets
Expertise in complex sales cycles, including large deal negotiation, executive alignment, and long-term account expansion
A strong track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing sales people
A proven ability to build connections with Executives, industry subject matter experts and various customer profiles
Experience collaborating cross-functionally across regional and global stakeholders
Strong commercial negotiation skills and executive presence
Prior experience in Marketing Technology or related enterprise SaaS categories is highly preferred

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

Competitive compensation that may include equity
Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
Flexible paid time off
Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 "Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product" in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America's Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

Job Description

Provide strategic leadership and overall direction for the company's restaurant and food catering operations.

Develop and implement short-term and long-term business strategies to achieve organisational objectives, revenue growth and profitability.

Direct and oversee restaurant operations, catering services, food production, procurement and customer service functions.

Establish operational policies, management procedures and performance standards to ensure efficient business operations.

Develop annual business plans, operational budgets, financial forecasts and strategic expansion plans.

Monitor company revenue, operating expenditure, food costs, labour costs and overall financial performance.

Lead and supervise departmental managers, restaurant managers, kitchen management teams and catering operations personnel.

Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and evaluate departmental productivity, operational efficiency and financial results.

Develop strategic plans for business expansion, new restaurant outlets, catering contracts and additional revenue opportunities.

Direct procurement strategies, supplier negotiations, inventory management and supply chain optimisation.

Ensure effective coordination between restaurant operations, kitchen production, catering logistics and administrative departments.

Implement quality management systems to maintain consistent food standards, customer satisfaction and operational excellence.

Ensure compliance with Singapore Food Agency (SFA) regulations, food hygiene requirements, employment regulations and applicable workplace safety standards.

Develop and oversee manpower planning, management recruitment, staff development and organisational performance improvement strategies.

Review operational risks, establish internal controls and implement business continuity and risk management procedures.

Analyse market trends, customer demand, industry competition and commercial opportunities to support strategic business decisions.

Direct sales and marketing strategies to strengthen brand positioning, customer acquisition and business development.

Oversee negotiations for major catering contracts, supplier agreements and commercial partnerships.

Implement technology-driven improvements, including POS systems, inventory management systems and operational reporting processes.

Monitor food production efficiency, wastage control and resource utilisation to optimise operational costs.

Establish customer experience standards and oversee the resolution of significant customer service issues.

Coordinate with finance and administration teams to ensure effective financial reporting, budgeting and operational accountability.

Evaluate investment requirements for kitchen equipment, operational infrastructure and future business expansion.

Conduct regular management meetings to review business performance, operational challenges and strategic priorities.

Develop leadership capabilities among departmental managers and establish succession planning initiatives.

Ensure effective communication and coordination between management, employees, suppliers and business partners.

Take overall responsibility for achieving approved operational targets, maintaining service excellence and supporting long-term business sustainability.

Job Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in Hospitality Management, Food Service Management, Business Administration, Operations Management or a related discipline preferred.

Minimum 8–10 years of relevant experience in restaurant, hospitality, food service or catering operations, including substantial senior management experience.

Proven experience in strategic business planning, operational leadership and financial performance management.

Strong understanding of restaurant operations, catering services, food production management and supply chain coordination.

Demonstrated ability to manage departmental managers and cross-functional operational teams.

Extensive knowledge of budgeting, financial forecasting, cost control and business profitability.

Experience developing business expansion strategies and commercial partnerships.

Good understanding of Singapore's food safety, hygiene and relevant regulatory requirements.

Excellent leadership, strategic decision-making and organisational management capabilities.

Strong analytical, negotiation, communication and problem-solving skills.

Ability to establish operational KPIs, evaluate performance and implement continuous improvement strategies.

Experience in developing and implementing standard operating procedures and management policies.

Proficiency in business reporting, Microsoft Office and operational management systems.

Ability to manage competing business priorities and make independent strategic decisions.

Willingness to attend operational meetings and oversee business activities outside standard office hours when necessary.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Revenue growth and business profitability.

Achievement of approved operational budgets.

Restaurant and catering service performance.

Food cost and operational expenditure control.

Customer satisfaction and service quality.

Business development and corporate catering growth.

Workforce productivity and management effectiveness.

Compliance with applicable food safety and regulatory requirements.

title: Material Suppliers Marketing Consultancy (Remote)
description:
Job Description

About Us

We help interior design and renovation firms in Singapore grow — through lead generation, branding, and marketing programmes that bring them qualified homeowners and stronger market positioning. Our clients don't just buy a service from us once; they grow with us across tiers as their firms scale. That only works when someone closes the right clients — and then owns the relationship after the first close.

That someone is you.

About the Role

This is a fully remote role.

You'll work from wherever you work best — no daily commute, no office face-time. What matters is that your clients feel looked after and your accounts grow. You'll meet clients over video calls (with the occasional in-person session if a key relationship calls for it), and stay connected to the team through our daily rhythms online.

This is a closing role first, a relationship role always.

You'll start by building your own book of business: running sales conversations with interior design firms, diagnosing where their business is stuck, and closing them into the right programme. Every deal you close becomes an account you own — and from there, your job is to make each relationship deeper, longer, and more valuable over time.

The more you close early on, the bigger the portfolio you manage — and the more your recurring income compounds through renewals, tier upgrades, and referrals. You are the person our clients trust from the very first call, the one who checks in before they have to ask, and the reason they sign, renew, upgrade, and refer.

What You'll Do

Run discovery and sales calls with interior design and renovation firms — diagnosing their growth bottlenecks and closing them into the programme that fits

Manage your own sales pipeline end to end: qualification, follow-ups, objection handling, and closing, with clear monthly targets

Own every account you close as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor

Run regular check-ins and performance reviews with clients — walking them through their results, diagnosing bottlenecks, and recommending next steps

Drive renewals by ensuring clients see and understand the value they're getting throughout the programme, not just at renewal time

Identify and develop expansion opportunities — helping clients climb to higher programme tiers when their business is ready for it

Generate referrals naturally by building the kind of relationship people recommend to their peers

Work with our internal teams to resolve client issues quickly and keep promises made during the sales process

Maintain accurate account records, follow-up rhythms, and relationship health tracking in our CRM

Who You Are

2+ years in B2B sales, account management, or client success — with a track record of hitting sales targets and closing deals

A closer who thinks long-term: you know how to drive a deal to a decision, but you close clients you can grow, not just deals you can win

A natural relationship builder — the close is the start of the relationship, not the end of it

Consistent with follow-through: you do what you say, on time, every time

A clear communicator who can explain performance data and business concepts simply, in person and in writing

Commercially sharp — you can spot an upsell or referral opportunity without making the client feel sold to

Organised and self-directed: you manage your own portfolio, pipeline of renewals, and follow-up cadence

Proven ability to work independently in a remote setup — you stay responsive, structured, and visible without anyone looking over your shoulder

Bonus: experience in or exposure to the interior design, renovation, real estate, or home services industry

Why Join Us

100% remote

— you're measured on client outcomes, not hours at a desk

Base salary + commissions on every deal you close, plus recurring incentives on retention, renewals, and account growth — your income compounds as your portfolio grows

Build your own book of business from day one, backed by proven sales scripts, frameworks, and playbooks — you close it, you keep it, you grow it

Clear frameworks, playbooks, and training on how we sell, manage, and grow accounts

A front-row seat to how design and renovation businesses in Singapore scale

To Apply

Reach out directly to our Head of Sales, Nigel:

WhatsApp: +65 9061 4389

Only candidates who reach out via WhatsApp will be contacted — a short intro message telling us who you are and why this role fits you is all it takes to start the conversation.

Network Singapore is a digital marketing and lead generation company specialising in the interior design industry. We operate one of Singapore's leading online portals connecting homeowners with interior design firms, helping businesses grow their client base through targeted digital exposure and a consistent flow of qualified leads.

Founded with a focus on results, we work closely with interior design professionals across Singapore to deliver marketing solutions that are measurable, scalable, and built around the needs of a competitive market. Our platform is designed to reduce the time and cost of client acquisition for interior design firms, allowing them to focus on what they do best — delivering exceptional spaces.

At Network Singapore, we believe in building long-term partnerships with our clients. Our team combines deep industry knowledge with a data-driven approach to ensure that every firm on our platform gets maximum visibility and genuine business opportunities.

We are a growing company with a performance-driven culture, committed to developing talent from within and building a team that takes pride in delivering results.

You will be an integral part of the global VGS team. Working closely with Visa’s various products and solutions teams, this role will scale enabler partnerships as a key route to market by combining Visa and partner capabilities to deliver innovative public sector solutions and accelerate commercial growth across Asia Pacific.

Expand and execute our ecosystem partnership sales strategy in collaboration with in-market VGS Sales teams across the region and global VGS colleagues, creating a prioritized pipeline of partners, solutions and commercial opportunities.

Support VGS in-market sales leads to identify, structure and execute mutually beneficial local partnerships with commercial or strategic agreements that can lead to the growth of VGS business, and onboard suppliers accordingly.

Develop and articulate compelling value propositions for internal and external audiences, positioning VGS as a leader in the payments industry for Governments and a resource for ecosystem partners.

We are looking to partner with Governments around the world as they drive ambitious plans for economic growth, social impact and digitalization, and our ecosystem partners are an important part of how we can elevate payments innovation.

12+ years’ experience working in, or with, organisations that provide technology, infrastructure or other specialist capabilities to governments, ideally with additional payments expertise.

Track record and proven ability to drive commercial outcomes and grow a business through strategic partnerships.

Robust understanding of how public sector sales and public agencies operate with expertise in navigating government agencies and procedures, including government procurement.

Experience structuring partnership deals, with the technical fluency to lead discussions with ecosystem partners and to articulate value propositions across a broad portfolio of solutions.

Proficiency in onboarding and managing partner relationships, with strong troubleshooting, problem-solving skills, and a bias for action and execution.

Consultative sales experience and skillful in developing, negotiating, influencing and selling new partnership synergies to ecosystem partners.

Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills required to influence cross-functional teams in internal solution development and go-to-market strategy.

Strategic and analytical thinker who is hands-on, and with an entrepreneurial ability that includes comfort with ambiguity and challenges the status quo.

Experience working in cross-functional and cross-cultural teams in a matrixed environment.

Comfortable speaking at external events to help build Visa’s presence and reputation through thought leadership.

Executive communication skills (written, oral & presentation) with an ability to explain complex business and technical concepts to broad audiences in an approachable way

Fluent in English. Any additional Asian language a plus.

What will also help:

Active network of ecosystem partners and public sector stakeholders across Asia.

Prior sales and consulting experience servicing government clients and projects.

Knowledge of payment solutions relevant to the ecosystem mentioned.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Strong analytical capabilities, including experience managing operational data, establishing KPIs, identifying performance gaps and driving measurable improvements.
Experience managing or working closely with Field Force agencies and outsourced service providers, with a good understanding of agency performance management, operational KPIs and governance.

Experience in a regional role covering multiple countries or markets.
Experience leading a sizable Retail, Field Force or Sales Operations organization.
Experience working directly with senior subsidiary management and regional leadership.
Experience managing large-scale outsourced Field Force operations and agency contracts.
Exposure to both Mobile and Consumer Electronics retail environments.
Experience leading organizational transformation, operating model redesign or major productivity improvement initiatives.
