Strategic and operational leadership: Connect regional business priorities with practical field execution.
Data-driven decision-making: Identify key performance drivers and translate analysis into clear actions.
Retail execution excellence: Understand the operational realities of merchandising, displays, fixtures and in-store standards.

title: Business Development Executive (Consumer (FMCG))

ROLEOVERVIEW

The Business Development Executive will be responsible for expanding market share, developing new distribution channels and growing the company's consumer goods business.

The role focuses on identifying business opportunities, establishing and managing retail, wholesale and e-commerce partnerships, and improving sales performance across existing customer accounts.

The position may cover consumer goods categories such as fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), consumer electronics, apparel, cosmetics, fashion and related products, depending on the company's business requirements.

KEYRESPONSIBILITIES

1.Business Development and Channel Expansion

+ Identify, develop and secure new business opportunities across retail, wholesale, distribution and other relevant sales channels.

+ Establish and maintain professional relationships with distributors, retailers, supermarkets, wholesalers and traditional trade partners.

+ Evaluate potential business partners and distribution opportunities based on market potential, commercial viability and business objectives.

+ Develop and implement business development plans to increase market coverage, sales revenue and distribution reach.

2.E-commerce and Digital Channel Development

+ Identify and develop partnerships with online marketplaces, e-commerce platforms, quick-commerce providers and other relevant digital sales channels.

+ Support the development and implementation of channel-specific sales strategies and promotional initiatives.

+ Monitor online sales performance and recommend improvements to product visibility, customer engagement and conversion.

3. Key Account Management

+ Build and maintain professional relationships with existing and prospective customers, including distributors, retail buyers, category managers and commercial partners.

+ Negotiate commercial terms, product listings, promotional arrangements and other business agreements within the company's approved policies and authority limits.

+ Monitor account performance, identify opportunities for account growth and address customer concerns in collaboration with relevant internal teams.

4.Sales and Marketing Coordination

+ Work with marketing and other relevant teams to plan and execute trade promotions, merchandising initiatives, product launches and in-store activities.

+ Coordinate promotional calendars, product displays and channel-specific marketing activities with business partners.

+ Review campaign results and recommend improvements based on sales performance and commercial objectives.

5.Sales Forecasting and Performance Analysis

+ Monitor sales performance, customer orders, inventory levels and product movement to support demand forecasting and inventory planning.

+ Analyze relevant sales data, market developments and consumer purchasing trends to identify business opportunities and potential risks.

+ Prepare sales forecasts, pipeline updates and regular performance reports.

+ Recommend appropriate actions to improve sales growth, product availability and inventory turnover.

6.Market Research and Business Development Planning

+ Monitor industry developments, competitor activities, distribution trends and changing consumer demand.

+ Identify potential customer segments, product categories and distribution channels for business expansion.

+ Provide market insights and recommendations to support commercial planning and decision-making.

QUALIFICATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Relevant Experience

+ Experience in sales, business development, account management, channel development or a related commercial role.

+ Experience in FMCG, consumer goods, consumer electronics, apparel, cosmetics, fashion, wholesale distribution, retail or e-commerce would be relevant to the role.

+ Candidates with transferable experience in related industries may also be considered based on the relevance of their skills, knowledge and achievements.

Market and Commercial Knowledge

+ Understanding of retail or wholesale distribution channels, customer account management, sales processes and commercial negotiations.

+ Familiarity with trade promotions, product listings, distribution arrangements and sales performance analysis would be advantageous.

+ Knowledge of consumer purchasing trends and market dynamics relevant to the products and channels managed.

Negotiation and Relationship Management

+ Ability to develop business relationships, identify customer needs and negotiate commercial arrangements.

+ Ability to communicate effectively with customers, distributors and internal stakeholders.

+ Strong commercial awareness, problem-solving skills and customer relationship management capabilities.

Analytical and Organizational Skills

+ Ability to interpret sales data, monitor business performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

+ Good planning, coordination and organizational skills.

+ Proficiency in relevant sales reporting tools, spreadsheets or customer relationship management systems would be advantageous.

Education

+ A bachelor's degree or equivalent professional qualification in Business, Marketing, Sales or a related discipline.

+ Candidates with other relevant qualifications and demonstrable experience may also be considered based on their ability to perform the role.

Strategy Development& Business Planning:

Support the development, refinement, and communication of the company's business strategy, working alongside the executive team and functional leaders.

Conduct market and competitor analysis, model scenarios, define strategic options, and build business cases for new growth vectors, partnerships, or capability investments.

Prepare strategic presentations and executive communications, including Board-level and Executive Committee materials, ensuring clarity, structure, and business relevance.

Translate strategic priorities into actionable enterprise KPIs and initiative roadmaps.

Identify, develop, and propose strategic business initiatives — ensuring AIS can act on emerging opportunities with agility.

Design and lead cross-functional initiative delivery, partnering with key functions (Underwriting, Distribution, Claims, Operations, Finance, IT) to ensure alignment and delivery of outcomes.

Facilitate cross-departmental working groups to develop and validate strategic proposals, ensuring buy-in from key stakeholders.

Initiative Execution& Performance Tracking:

Drive accountability across initiative owners, ensuring consistent follow-through between planning cycles.

Work with various functions to consolidate, report, and analyze initiative progress in a timely, efficient, and accurate manner.

Support benefit realization tracking and post-implementation reviews for completed initiatives.

Flag risks, dependencies, and resource needs to the leadership team, recommending corrective actions where required.

External Environment & Thought Leadership:

Monitor regulatory developments, competitive dynamics, and market trends within Singapore's insurance landscape, advising leadership on strategic implications.

Build and maintain relationships with key external stakeholders, industry bodies, and partners to support strategic objectives.

Contribute thought leadership and insights to support the company's positioning and long-term growth agenda.

Bachelor’s degree in business, Economics, Finance, or a related discipline.

Minimum 5 years of experience in strategy, management consulting, corporate planning, or a strategy office / CEO office environment.

Proven project management experience, having led cross-functional projects from concept to delivery.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data, research, and trends into viable strategic recommendations.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to prepare and deliver executive-level presentations and business cases.

Experience with modern analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI) to support insights generation and initiative tracking.

Familiarity with Singapore's regulatory and competitive insurance landscape.

title: Manager, Programme Development & Client Engagement
description:
ABOUT EQUAL

EQUAL is an IPC-registered charity that delivers equine-assisted and animal-assisted services to support the mental and emotional wellbeing of children, youth, seniors, families, and communities. Our work sits at the intersection of human wellbeing, animal welfare, and experiential learning, and is delivered through a multidisciplinary team of programme professionals, equine specialists, operations staff, and volunteers. Fundraising is mission-critical to EQUAL’s ability to deliver safe, high-quality, and impactful programmes. As the organisation scales, EQUAL is strengthening its fundraising infrastructure, pipeline discipline, and stewardship capability to support sustainable growth.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Manager, Programme Growth & Client Engagement is responsible for growing and sustaining demand for EQUAL's programmes through new institutional engagements, stronger existing client relationships and repeat programme opportunities.

The role proactively develops programme opportunities across schools, social service agencies, healthcare institutions, corporations and community organisations. This includes both fee-paying programme engagements and partnerships that extend programme access and beneficiary reach.

The Manager owns the external client engagement process, from prospecting and enquiries through needs assessment, proposals, quotations, programme confirmation, contracting coordination and renewal.

Working closely with the Programmes & Services team, the Manager ensures that programme opportunities are appropriate, financially sound where applicable, and aligned with EQUAL's programme capabilities and delivery capacity.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Programme Business Growth & New Institutional Engagements

Proactively identify and engage organisations that may benefit from EQUAL's programmes.

Develop new opportunities across schools, social service agencies, healthcare institutions, corporations and community organisations.

Qualify prospective engagements by understanding organisational needs, beneficiary groups, programme objectives, available budgets and potential engagement models.

Convert qualified enquiries and opportunities into confirmed programme engagements.

Respond promptly to assigned programme enquiries, establish clear next steps and follow through until each opportunity is confirmed, declined or closed.

Develop targeted institutional outreach and re-engagement plans.

Identify potential new markets, client segments and programme applications, working with Programme leadership to assess feasibility.

Work with Programme Specialists to assess programme requirements, delivery feasibility and suitable engagement models before making external commitments.

Maintain a clear and actively managed pipeline of programme opportunities.

2. Existing Programme Client Relationships & Retention

Client Relationships & Retention

Manage assigned institutional programme clients and partners.

Maintain regular engagement with existing clients to understand evolving programme needs.

Secure repeat programme engagements and renewals.

Proactively re-engage lapsed programme partners to explore renewed or expanded programme participation.

Identify opportunities to expand programme participation through additional sessions, beneficiary groups or approved programme offerings.

Maintain accurate engagement records, renewal schedules and client follow-up plans.

Collect structured client feedback and coordinate improvements with the Programme team.

3. Programme Proposals, Quotations & Contracting

Lead the preparation of programme proposals, concept notes, quotations and engagement documents, working with Programme Specialists on programme content and delivery requirements

Coordinate programme pricing, budgets and delivery assumptions with the relevant internal teams.

Assess fee-based opportunities using approved pricing, delivery cost and capacity information, escalating exceptions for the appropriate approval.

Manage procurement and tender submissions, including GeBIZ where applicable.

Coordinate service agreements, booking confirmations, contract renewals and amendments.

Ensure programme requirements, commercial terms and delivery commitments receive the necessary internal approvals before confirmation.

Work with Finance to ensure accurate billing information is submitted promptly and help resolve client-related commercial issues.

4. Programme Engagement & Client Coordination

Serve as the primary client-facing contact for assigned programme engagements.

Coordinate client needs and expectations with Programme Specialists and relevant operational colleagues.

Ensure confirmed programme commitments are handed over clearly to the teams responsible for delivery.

Monitor client-facing commitments, programme engagement milestones and renewal opportunities.

Maintain visibility of confirmed programme bookings, client requirements and engagement status, coordinating client-facing issues with the Programme team.

Coordinate the timely submission of agreed programme-client reports and deliverables, using content prepared and approved by the Programme team.

Address client-related issues and escalate operational matters to the relevant functional leads.

5. Programme Pipeline, Performance & Process Improvement

Maintain accurate records of prospective, confirmed and completed programme engagements.

+ Monitor sales performance, customer orders, inventory levels and product movement to support demand forecasting and inventory planning.

+ Recommend appropriate actions to improve sales growth, product availability and inventory turnover.

6.Market Research and Business Development Planning

+ Monitor industry developments, competitor activities, distribution trends and changing consumer demand.

+ Identify potential customer segments, product categories and distribution channels for business expansion.

+ Provide market insights and recommendations to support commercial planning and decision-making.

QUALIFICATION,SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Relevant Experience

+ Experience in sales, business development, account management, channel development or a related commercial role.

+ Experience in FMCG, consumer goods, consumer electronics, apparel, cosmetics, fashion, wholesale distribution, retail or e-commerce would be relevant to the role.

+ Candidates with transferable experience in related industries may also be considered based on the relevance of their skills, knowledge and achievements.

Market and Commercial Knowledge

+ Understanding of retail or wholesale distribution channels, customer account management, sales processes and commercial negotiations.

+ Familiarity with trade promotions, product listings, distribution arrangements and sales performance analysis would be advantageous.

+ Knowledge of consumer purchasing trends and market dynamics relevant to the products and channels managed.

Negotiation and Relationship Management

+ Ability to develop business relationships, identify customer needs and negotiate commercial arrangements.

+ Ability to communicate effectively with customers, distributors and internal stakeholders.

+ Strong commercial awareness, problem-solving skills and customer relationship management capabilities.

Analytical and Organisational Skills

+ Ability to interpret sales data, monitor business performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

+ Good planning, coordination and organisational skills.

+ Proficiency in relevant sales reporting tools, spreadsheets or customer relationship management systems would be advantageous.

Education

+ A bachelor's degree or equivalent professional qualification in Business, Marketing, Sales or a related discipline.

+ Candidates with other relevant qualifications and demonstrable experience may also be considered based on their ability to perform the role.

Strong understanding of merchandising, marketing and retail operations.

Demonstrated track record of growing sales and improving profitability.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent understanding of Singapore’s retail and consumer market.

.

Build trusted partnerships across business, product, client service, technology, risk, finance and regional leadership teams – including State Street’s global operations hubs – to deliver shared priorities.

Apply strong APAC market and cultural awareness to lead effectively across both locations and promote an inclusive, collaborative and high-accountability environment.

Develop a deep, diverse and resilient leadership bench through deliberate talent development, succession planning and disciplined performance management.

As a Managing Director you will:

Champion differentiated client outcomes by aligning stakeholders, resolving complex issues and ensuring service delivery supports broader commercial and relationship priorities.

Ensure timely, accurate and well-controlled delivery of NAV calculations, financial reporting and investor reporting across relevant platforms and client mandates, spanning both Hedge and Private Markets.

Convert performance insights, client feedback and risk indicators into practical action plans with clear ownership, measurable outcomes and disciplined follow-through.

Maintain strong accountability for regulatory compliance, operational risk management, issue remediation and adherence to applicable policies, standards and control expectations.

Engage and influence senior global and regional stakeholders to align priorities, share best practices and advance a consistent, scalable and resilient operating model.

Lead business continuity planning and execution, ensuring operational resilience, governance discipline and readiness across both locations and critical services.

Identify and deliver transformation, automation, standardization and capacity-creation opportunities that improve productivity, control, transparency and client experience.

Lead a multi-location team through clear direction, strong communication, effective delegation, leadership development, employee engagement and succession planning.

What we value

The Managing Director will be expected to operate as a senior enterprise leader within AIS, bringing strategic judgment, commercial awareness, operational excellence, strong control discipline and a deep commitment to people leadership. We value leaders who can:

Navigate a large global organization with confidence, build trusted senior relationships and create an effective stakeholder network across business lines and functions.

Lead effectively in a matrixed environment by aligning stakeholders, managing competing priorities and resolving areas of complexity or contention with sound judgment.

Build, develop and inspire high-performing operations teams with a clear focus on accountability, engagement, inclusion and execution excellence.

Communicate with clarity and executive presence across clients, third parties, senior leaders, peers and large regional teams.

Lead and sponsor change management, transformation and operating model programs in complex, regulated and multi-location environments.

Execute with pace and discipline under challenging circumstances, maintaining focus on risk, quality, client outcomes and delivery commitments.

Coach, influence and collaborate across locations, including virtual teams, to drive shared ownership and enterprise-wide outcomes.

Demonstrate strong cultural intelligence and the ability to lead across the Singapore and Hong Kong markets with respect, openness and consistency.

Role-model inclusion, flexibility, integrity and respect when working with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and locations.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required; degree in finance, accounting, economics, business management or a related discipline preferred.

Excellent written and spoken English communication skills, with the ability to present complex matters clearly to senior audiences.

Strong interpersonal, influencing, negotiation and relationship management skills across senior stakeholders and complex client situations.

15+ years of financial services experience, including senior leadership of large-scale, multi-location operations teams.

Extensive experience managing and delivering fund accounting, financial reporting and/or alternative investment servicing capabilities across both Hedge Fund and Private Markets.

Proven business unit management experience, particularly with complex institutional clients requiring significant senior-level engagement.

Deep knowledge of the financial services industry, with strong understanding of investment management, private markets and alternative investment operations, including hedge fund and private markets fund structures and platforms such as Geneva, Investran and Paxus.

Familiarity with the APAC regulatory and market landscape (MAS, SFC, HKMA) and a broad range of alternative investment structures (BDCs, Interval Funds, ELTIFs, Variable Capital Companies (VCCs), etc.) would be an advantage.

title: Regional Sales Manager (Singapore)
description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview
The Sales team at CRFS Cambridge drives global growth by delivering industry-leading spectrum monitoring and electronic warfare solutions to defence, regulatory, and security agencies. They bridge the gap between complex RF engineering and client requirements, ensuring partners have the actionable intelligence needed to manage and secure the spectrum.

Job Description

As the Sales Manager for APAC, you will be the lead for CRFS in one of the worlds most critical and diverse defence markets. You will be responsible for identifying high-value opportunities within your area of responsibility, defence and adjacent markets, plus various internal security agencies, ensuring our RFeye ecosystem is the standard for regional signals intelligence and border security:

· Design and execute a multi-year growth strategy for your APAC region

· Align CRFS technology with the specific tactical needs of the regional Armed Forces, focusing on border protection, anti-drone (C-UAS) operations, and APAC interoperability.

· Act as the primary subject matter expert in-region. You will deliver technical briefings on signal processing and EW to regional technical leads, program managers, and military commanders.

· Lead the response to complex regional public tenders. You will navigate the country and region Public Procurement Law and offset requirements, moving deals from RFI stage to final contract signature.

· Build and manage strategic partnerships with local and regional defence integrators and distributors to extend CRFS’s reach across the APAC region.

· Act as the strategic link between end-users and our UK-based engineering teams to ensure our product roadmap reflects the unique challenges of the Asia Pacific region.

Basic Requirements

· Experience: 5–10 years of experience in high-end technical sales or business development within the Defence, Aerospace, or Electronic Warfare sectors in the APAC region.

· Clearance: Must hold (or be eligible for) National Security Clearance (Secret or higher). Citizenship of an APAC country is preferred.

· Technical Proficiency: A strong grasp of RF principles, SIGINT, or Spectrum Management. You should be comfortable explaining why a 100MHz real-time bandwidth matters to a tactical commander.

· The "Rolodex": An established network within the regions defence and security industry including intimacy with a number of military commands from at least 3 countries.

· Language: Good level of English and native in regional languages.

Travel Requirements
50-75%

Relocation Provided
None

Position Type
Experienced

Referral Payment Plan
No

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

title: Brand Manager
description:
About the role

We're looking for a Brand Manager who can own the Bells brand system end to end — across all three sub-brands — and who is equally comfortable managing a website launch and standing on-site at a training centre reviewing a kiosk installation. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role at the centre of the Bells brand rollout — spanning digital brand execution (websites, programme pages), physical brand experience (centre branding, kiosks, experiential walls), and the ongoing marketing engine (testimonials, collateral, campaigns) that keeps each brand alive day to day.

You'll work directly with senior brand and marketing leadership, coordinating designers, developers, print vendors, and centre teams to bring a locked brand system to life consistently — online and in person — across every touchpoint a learner encounters, whichever Bells sub-brand they meet first.

Key responsibilities

Own end-to-end execution of Bells websites and programme pages — homepage, About Us, Contact Us, and all course/programme pages — across Bells School of AI, Bells School of Finance, and Bells Academy, coordinating information gathering, content, Figma design, dev handover, staging, and go-live against a live project tracker.

Ensure every page reflects locked, approved copy and the correct brand system for its sub-brand exactly — verbatim accuracy on approved lines is non-negotiable.

Coordinate with content, design, and tech stakeholders to keep multiple programme pages moving through the pipeline in parallel across all three brands without missing deadlines.

Drive the physical rollout of Bells brand guidelines across all training centres — managing video recce, floor plans, design concepts, approvals, print production, and installation end to end — tailored to whichever sub-brand a centre or zone represents.

Own the Centre Branding Playbook and ensure it is replicated consistently across centres, each on its own rollout timeline.

Lead kiosk branding standardisation — from pilot through to uniform rollout across all centres.

Build out the Testimonials Playbook into a repeatable, business-as-usual process across all Bells sub-brands — covering collection (video and static, via structured intake forms), consent tracking, and editing.

Own the On-Ground Collateral / BTL Playbook — flyers, notice boards, hiring and recruitment posters, and event materials — for both marketing and centre/ground-sales needs, across all three sub-brands.

Act as the day-to-day guardian of the Bells brand system — the master brand and each of its three sub-brands — ensuring consistent, correctly-differentiated application across every digital and physical touchpoint.

Maintain and report against the brand ops tracker, proactively surfacing blockers, delays, and dependencies.

About you

4–6 years of experience in brand management, brand marketing, or brand operations, with exposure to both digital execution (websites, content, campaigns) and physical/experiential branding (retail, centre, event, or environmental branding).

Degree holders (preferably in Marketing)

Background in education or edtech is a plus, but not essential.

Experience managing more than one brand or sub-brand at a time is a strong plus.

Strong project management instincts: comfortable owning a tracker with 15–20+ concurrent workstreams, each at a different stage, without letting anything slip.

Working knowledge of how signage, kiosks, and print production actually get made — from concept and design through to approval and installation.

Comfortable reviewing and giving feedback on website and programme page content, with an eye for consistency, tone, and brand fit.

Fluent with AI tools for everyday content, design, and editing work — drafting and refining copy, generating and iterating on visual concepts, and speeding up edits.

Excellent stakeholder management — able to work confidently with founders and leadership as well as designers, vendors, and ground teams.

Meticulous and self-directed: flags issues before they become problems, and can be trusted to represent the brand accurately without constant sign-off.

Based in Singapore, with willingness to travel regularly across Bells training centres for on-site branding rollouts.

About us

Bells Institute of Higher Learning is one of Singapore's most established education providers, with 150,000 learners impacted, 7 training centres, and 40+ courses. Bells is an SSG-appointed programme partner, aligned to SkillsFuture and NTUC e2i, with corporate partners including JP Morgan, DBS Bank, Samsung, Singtel, Meta, and BDO.

The Bells brand structure is being rebuilt around three sub-brands: Bells School of AI, our flagship digital-first anchor brand; Bells School of Finance, built in partnership with Imarticus Learning — a leader in professional education with 1M+ learners impacted globally — bringing AI-embedded finance education to Singapore; and Bells Academy, home to our specialised courses spanning 3D printing, project management, craft skills, and more.

BELLS Education Group's Track Record and Corporate Profile

Champions of Employability

When it comes to career workshops conducted in Singapore, there is no better and more experienced entity than BELLS Education Group. We have an unrivalled rate of placement in the number of participants getting jobs after our workshops, proving our techniques to be both ground-breaking and innovative. Having conducted nationwide programmes and also various programmes for students and alumni members of various educational institutes and private schools, it is clear that BELLS Education Group is the training provider of choice.

title: Partnerships Manager APAC
description:
We are looking for an ambitious and commercially minded Partnerships Manager to join our Strategic Partnerships team in Singapore. You will play a critical role in helping Wise accelerate growth across APAC by building and scaling partnerships that connect us with customers who have international money needs.

APAC is one of Wise's fastest-growing regions and a key growth opportunity. Across international students, travellers, expats and other globally-minded communities, we see significant potential to reach more customers through strategic partnerships.

This is a new role within a global team with high autonomy to own the end to end regional strategy. Working closely with regional growth teams, you will identify, negotiate and launch partnerships across APAC, adapting global opportunities to local markets and turning them into measurable growth.

The goal will be to use your commercial talents to unlock new groups of customers who have a need for Wise, but didn't know enough about us to use us before.

This is not a Wise Platform role -

Your main goal is to accelerate personal adoption of Wise in APAC markets.

Responsibilities

Strategy & Planning

Define and execute the APAC partnership strategy across consumer partnerships, focused on helping internationally-minded customers discover and use Wise.

Own, optimise and grow partnership verticals with full autonomy in collaboration with the global team

Identify and prioritise high-intent customer segments with recurring international money needs, including international students, working holiday travellers, group travel communities, relocation and migration customers

Build market-level partnership plans that align with regional growth priorities and business objectives

Forecast partnership impact and prioritise opportunities based on customer acquisition, volume and long-term value

Sourcing & Negotiation & Execution

Prospect, qualify and develop relationships with potential partners across Australia, Singapore, Malaysia and broader APAC markets

Own the full partnership lifecycle from outreach and discovery through to negotiation, contracting, launch and optimisation

Structure commercial agreements that create value for both Wise and our partners

Build scalable partnership frameworks that can be replicated across markets and partner categories.

Go-To-Market & Execution

Oversee the end-to-end launch of partnership campaigns, working closely with brand, regional growth, legal and product teams to ensure smooth delivery

Performance & Optimisation

Define and track key performance indicators for each partnership, including metrics across the funnel that drive measurable growth

Use data to identify performance trends, opportunities and challenges, turning insights into actions that improve results.

Maintain and nurture long-term relationships with existing partners, identifying opportunities for expansion, renewal, and increased investment based on proven results

Regional Collaboration

Act as the local partnerships expert within APAC

Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders across regional marketing, growth, product and strategy teams

Share market insights and partnership learnings that help shape future regional and global initiatives

Qualifications

A Bit About You

Proven Partnership Success: You have experience sourcing, negotiating and executing successful partnerships that deliver measurable commercial outcomes. Experience working across APAC markets is a strong advantage. You can demonstrate how your work has driven customer acquisition, revenue growth, engagement or other business-critical metrics.

Commercial Acumen: You are a natural at structuring and closing diverse commercial deals, big or small. You know how to identify opportunities, evaluate potential impact and make sound investment decisions.

Strategic Yet Hands-On: You enjoy thinking strategically but are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves and executing. You can take an idea from concept through to launch and optimisation.

Strong Relationship Builder: You are naturally skilled at building trust with both external partners and internal stakeholders. You understand how to navigate different cultures, communication styles and business environments.

Strong Analytical Mindset: You love diving into data, spotting trends, and unearthing insights that directly shape winning strategies and forecasts

Culturally Adaptable: You are comfortable building relationships across different countries, cultures and business environments. You understand how to adapt your approach to local markets while maintaining a consistent commercial strategy.

Self-Starter: You thrive in ambiguity, enjoy solving problems and are motivated by the opportunity to build and scale something new in a fast-growing region.

Results-Oriented: You are focused on outcomes and have a track record of delivering against ambitious commercial targets while managing multiple priorities.

AI-Curious: You actively explore emerging technologies and find innovative ways to integrate AI into your workflows, continuously seeking to improve efficiency and scale your impact.

Mission-Driven: You are deeply aligned with our core purpose and bring an intrinsic motivation to your work, ensuring that your daily contributions directly advance our long-term vision.

Nice-to-have

Experience in FinTech, Payments or Financial Services

Experience in travel, student, migration, relocation or international consumer businesses

Experience using AI and analytical tools

Fluency in an Asian language

Experience working in high-growth technology companies

Who we are

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move money around the world. With the Wise account people and businesses can hold over 40 currencies, move money between countries and spend money abroad. Large companies and banks use Wise technology too; an entirely new cross-border payments network that will one day power money without borders for everyone, everywhere. However you use the platform, Wise is on a mission to make your life easier and save you money.

Co-founded by Kristo Käärmann and Taavet Hinrikus, Wise launched in 2011 under its original name TransferWise. It is one of the world’s fastest growing, profitable technology companies and is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker, WISE.

16 million people and businesses use Wise. In fiscal year 2023, Wise processed approximately £105 billion in cross-border transactions, saving customers around £1.5 billion.

What it’s really like to work here

At Wise, we do things a bit differently. There’s no corporate nonsense, and no old-fashioned hierarchy. Instead, we work in dozens of self-sufficient, autonomous teams. Think of them like start-ups within a start-up that learn from each other.

Each team picks the problems they want to solve. So there’s no micro-management. No hiding behind fancy job titles. And no one telling you what to do. You are your own boss. But you’ll get tons of guidance and plenty of support from talented, super-smart colleagues from all over Wise.

We’re going to be upfront — the way we work doesn’t suit everyone. But if freedom, autonomy, and life-affirming, head-scratching professional challenges rock your world, we could be a match made in heaven.

title: Client Manager
description:
Description

Encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing and feedback within project teams to build capability and improve how we work together.
Implement studio and network-wide strategies within your account teams, ensuring ways of working align with the one Elmwood vision and goals.
Manage team dynamics on your projects, holding people (including yourself) accountable for agreed actions, quality standards and timelines.

Work/offer accountabilities:

Oversee the daily delivery of client projects, making sure tasks are completed on time, meet requirements, and stay within budget.
Lead internal briefings, manage timelines, and coordinate estimates and contact reports, ensuring clarity for internal teams.
Work in partnership with cross-functional teams such as creative, strategy and production to monitor progress and manage deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.

Manage key client relationships and day-to-day interactions, demonstrating a measurable impact on their business and identifying opportunities to grow and deepen the relationship.

Business accountabilities

Engage in weekly planning, resource and forecasting meetings to maintain transparency, accountability and visibility of pipeline and capacity.
Manage and meet specific business targets for your accounts in line with the studio business plan and Strategic Account Plans.
Build and manage the client revenue pipeline for your accounts, ensuring accurate forecasting, visibility and strong recoverability.
Support value-based pricing and project costing, using financial tools and data to manage scope, protect margins and escalate risks early.
Contribute to award entries, case studies and marketing initiatives that build Elmwood’s fame and reputation in the region.

04 What you know and bring.

The knowledge you'll need:

3–5 years of experience in a design, branding, or marketing agency in client servicing and/or project management roles.
Relevant experience in advertising agencies is a plus.
A background in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a similar field is preferred.
Solid understanding of brand and design processes, from briefing and strategy through to creative development and production.
Good commercial acumen, including familiarity with scopes of work, pricing models, budgets, forecasting and profitability drivers.
Proficient in project management, collaboration and file-sharing tools such as ClickUp, Pitch, LucidLink or similar. platforms.
AI fluency: confident using AI tools day to day to work smarter across briefing, planning, reporting and client communication. You're curious about how AI is changing agency workflows and keen to bring new ideas to the team.

The skills that'll set you apart

Proven ability to manage multiple projects and cross-functional teams simultaneously, balancing priorities and deadlines.
Keen attention to detail and accuracy across timings, budgets, documentation and deliverables.
Outstanding organisational and time management abilities, with a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.
Professional writing tone, style, and email etiquette, with the ability to communicate clearly and persuasively with clients and colleagues.
Strong eagerness to listen, learn, and grow in a dynamic, occasionally unstructured environment, bringing a genuine passion for creativity, innovation, and delivering exceptional work.
High sense of responsibility and commitment to the role, taking ownership of outcomes for your clients, projects and team.

Benefits
05 What we offer.

The work

The opportunity to work with leading global and regional brands across categories, shaping strategies and design that get seen and felt in the real world.

The people & culture

A fun studio environment working alongside great and talented individuals, with a collaborative, down-to-earth culture where craft, curiosity and generosity are valued.

Annual festivities and various social events throughout the year that bring the team together.

Growth & development

Access to learning, feedback and stretch opportunities across studios and disciplines, with support to shape a career that works for you.

title: Full-Stack Marketing Manager / Marketing PMM
description:
About GetBlock

GetBlock launched in 2019 as a two-person company. Seven years later, Coinbase, Trust Wallet, Garanti BBVA, Arkham, Chainalysis, and many more run on GetBlock infrastructure. That infrastructure now spans about 1,000 servers in clusters in New York, Frankfurt, and Singapore, covering 130+ blockchain networks. More than 200,000 customers have signed up, and 60,000 of them were active in the last six months.

On Solana, BNB Smart Chain, and Polygon, GetBlock is the fastest RPC provider in key financial hubs, and the independent benchmarks CompareNodes and OpenChainBench rank it among the top providers in the market.

About GetBlock marketing

A small, senior marketing team built one of the most visible brands in the RPC segment:

getblock.io has ranked #3 in the segment by organic traffic and LLM visibility for many months in a row in 2026

The GetBlock blog was the most visited and most active blog in the entire segment in 2025

150,000 website visits every month

100+ ecosystem partners and 20,000+ builders in the community

Team background includes Forbes, BeInCrypto, and Crypto Briefing

The team under-promises and over-delivers, every time.

About the role

This is a full-stack marketing role.

You will own campaigns across all GetBlock channels, from the first draft to the final report, and decide where the next channel should open. In a single week you might write a launch thread for X and present next quarter's channel strategy to leadership.

GetBlock markets to a few.

The product is technical, and its audience is technical and product decision-makers at Web3 companies, the people who choose which RPC provider their engineers build on. Reach outside that group counts for little, so every campaign you run is judged by whether it lands with them.

Most of the team works around UTC+3. We need solid overlap with those hours, and the exact time zone is flexible.

What you'll do

Plan campaigns across GetBlock's existing channels and measure what each one delivers: social media, community, partnerships, owned media, performance marketing, and SEO/GEO. Owned media takes the biggest share of your time, SEO/GEO the smallest.

Propose new marketing channels, run the first tests, and scale any channel that brings in the right audience.

Own marketing analytics. Find out which campaigns reach technical decision-makers and which burn budget, then shift spend to match.

Run paid traffic together with our performance marketer: suggest hypotheses, design the tests, read the results, and scale what works.

Shape positioning and messaging for product launches with the product team, then carry them into every channel.

Write and edit copy yourself: X threads, LinkedIn posts, blog articles, partner announcements.

Work with GetBlock's 100+ ecosystem partners on joint announcements and co-marketing campaigns.

What you'll bring

Fluent English at C1 or above, spoken and written. This one is a must: English is the only language GetBlock markets in and nearly the only one the team works in.

3+ years in product marketing, including B2B.

Strong writing. You produce a clean first draft without a copywriter and edit other people's copy without flattening their voice.

Marketing taste built on seeing a lot of good and bad work. You can spot a strong launch at a glance and explain what makes it land.

Hands-on experience with X, LinkedIn, Reddit, and Telegram, plus owned media on Medium and Dev.to.

Basic CMS skills. GetBlock's site runs on Prismic.

Confidence with partners: you can run a call with a partner's CMO and walk away with an agreed plan.

How you work with AI

GetBlock marketing already runs on custom skills and agents, and you will add to that setup.

You know when AI helps and when to stop and do the work yourself.

You have built AI workflows that automate 90-100% of a routine end to end, and you keep them running.

You build your own tooling: custom skills, loops, and agents. Lazy prompts and AI slop give you an allergic reaction.

Nice to have

Experience managing a small team.

Vibe-coding experience on products that paying customers use, with a working grasp of GitLab, deployment pipelines, and IDEs.

Mindset and deal-breakers

People who do well at GetBlock are curious and happy to wear many hats. Everyone on the team, this role included, works by two rules:

We are all operators. No task is junior enough to drop.

We are all strategists. No task is senior enough to avoid.

You will probably not enjoy this role if:

Your main strength is managing Jira cards.

Your marketing playbook is mostly KOLs, airdrops, and incentive programs. GetBlock does boring marketing that pays off over years.

You need a translator or heavy editing to work in English.

Why GetBlock

Honest remote. GetBlock is fully remote by design, with no US-only, EU-only, or UK-only restrictions and no hybrid schedule that puts you in an office three days a week.

A running start. GetBlock is an established brand with a busy marketing pipeline and growing metrics, so there is nothing to build from scratch. You join to accelerate what already works.

20 days of annual leave plus 12 personal days in place of a fixed public holiday calendar. Spend them on local celebrations, a loved one's birthday, or a break when you need one. Sick leave is paid on top.

Compensation for coworking space and AI tools.

A personalized development roadmap and performance bonuses tied to your impact.

Well-being programs to help you stay healthy and keep your balance.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
*BlueTree Education | Full-Time | Singapore*

*Big Ideas. Good People. Meaningful Growth.*

Love marketing, enjoy bringing ideas to life, and want to work with people who genuinely care about what they do?

*Come grow with BlueTree!*

At BlueTree Education, we believe that great work happens when passionate people come together in a supportive, fun-loving environment.

Our team works hard, celebrates wins, supports one another and believes there is always room to learn, improve and grow.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we are looking for a \**Marketing Manager who brings both creativity and commercial thinking to the table.* Someone who enjoys rolling up their sleeves, taking ownership and turning good ideas into real results.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead marketing execution across two education brands, bringing our 2027 marketing strategy to life.

You will have the opportunity to shape campaigns, develop our brand presence, work with a passionate team and make a measurable impact on business growth.

This is not a role where you simply manage agencies and review reports. We want someone who enjoys being in the action, experimenting with ideas and making things happen.

*1. Branding*

* Own and protect our brand across all touchpoints, including centres, signage, print, digital and parent materials. Ensure every piece of work is consistent with our brand direction and guidelines, and lead brand refresh projects.

*2. External Communication*

* Lead parent communications, public relations, media relations, partnerships and crisis communications. Shape how BlueTree is seen by parents, schools and the wider education community.

*3. Internal Communication*

* Plan and deliver communications to staff across our seven branches, so that teachers and branch teams understand, support and represent our campaigns, brand standards and key messages.

*4. Make Campaigns Happen*

* Plan and execute creative, effective marketing campaigns that attract parents, generate enquiries and drive student enrolments.

*5. Grow Our Digital Presence*

* Manage and optimise Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO and organic content to improve visibility, lead quality and conversions. And manage BlueTree Education's social media channels, including Instagram, TikTok and Facebook.

*6. Build Stronger Parent Connections*

* Develop referral campaigns, engagement initiatives and re-enrolment activities that strengthen relationships with our BlueTree families.

*7. Bring Ideas to Life*

* Work closely with our teachers, centre teams and creative partners to develop engaging content, promotions and brand experiences.

*8. Lead and Grow Together*

* Guide our Marketing Executive, collaborate with external agencies and freelancers, and build a positive, productive marketing team.

*9. Know Your Numbers*

* Track campaign performance, marketing budgets, leads, trials and enrolments. Use insights to make smarter decisions and drive continuous improvement.

*10. Team Leadership*

* Lead and develop the marketing executive, and manage agencies and vendors.

*Who We're Looking For*

We would love to meet someone who:

* Has a proven track record in marketing, particularly in generating leads, sales or enrolments.
* At least 5 years of marketing experience, with a track record of leading campaigns end to end and managing a brand
* Proven experience in branding and in internal and external communications
* Is confident with Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, GA4 and content marketing.
* Understands Singapore parents and ideally has experience in education, enrichment or consumer marketing.
* Is both creative and analytical — someone who loves a great campaign idea but also cares about the results.
* Enjoys taking ownership, solving problems and getting things done.
* Has experience guiding junior team members and managing external partners.
* Brings positive energy, a collaborative spirit and a good sense of humour.
* Is curious about AI and new ways to make marketing more effective.
* Experience leading junior staff and managing agencies or vendors

Experience in multi-brand, multi-branch or referral marketing would be a bonus.

*Why You'll Love Working with Us*

*A Warm, Close-Knit Team*

_We believe work should be enjoyable. Expect friendly colleagues, genuine support, laughter and a workplace where people know one another beyond their job titles._

*Big Ambitions, Real Opportunities*

_We are an established education company with exciting growth plans. You will have the space to contribute ideas, take ownership and grow professionally alongside the business._

*Your Ideas Matter*

_We value initiative over hierarchy. Good ideas can come from anyone, and we encourage people to speak up, experiment and make things better._

*Work That Makes a Difference*

_Behind every campaign is a child learning, a parent finding support and a teacher making an impact. Your work contributes to something meaningful._

*A Culture of Learning and Celebration*

_We believe in developing our people, recognising effort and celebrating milestones — big and small._

*Ready to Grow with Us?*

If you are a marketer who loves a good challenge, enjoys working with good people and wants to be part of a growing education brand, *we would love to hear from you!*

From supporting high-stakes commercial negotiations to coordinating seamlessly with internal teams, you will champion these partnerships from initial engagement through technical integration and a successful go-live, playing a pivotal part in our industry-disrupting transformation journey.

*Key Responsibilities:*

● *Strategic Relationship Management:* Manage and cultivate relationships with existing strategic partners - including banks, payment networks, and digital asset providers - ensuring effective collaboration and identifying avenues for commercial expansion.

● *Partner Acquisition & Onboarding:* Identify, evaluate, and onboard new partners aligned with FOMO Pay’s business strategy, product roadmap, and global market expansion plans.

● *Commercial Negotiation:* Lead commercial discussions and negotiations, defining pricing structures, service scope, implementation requirements, and contractual terms to optimize business outcomes.

● *End-to-End Compliance Management:* Oversee the partner onboarding lifecycle, including comprehensive due diligence, KYC/KYB coordination, internal approvals, and periodic risk reviews.

● *Cross-Functional Collaboration:* Serve as the central liaison coordinating with Business, Product, Technology, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and Operations teams to ensure seamless partner integration.

● *Technical Integration Oversight:* Collaborate closely with internal Product and Technology teams and external partners to oversee technical (API) integrations, UAT testing, and production readiness.

● *Project Management:* Develop and execute go-live plans, meticulously tracking implementation milestones, resolving dependencies, and ensuring timely project delivery.

● *Performance Monitoring:* Track partner performance metrics, operational SLAs, and service quality. Proactively identify operational bottlenecks and manage required escalations.

● *Strategic Optimization:* Conduct regular partner business reviews to uncover opportunities for commercial optimization, product alignment, or expanded strategic collaboration.

● *Pipeline & Reporting:* Maintain a robust partnership pipeline, commercial terms, and documentation repository. Provide concise, regular reporting to the Head of Partnerships on ongoing negotiations, integration statuses, and market opportunities.

*Requirements:*

● Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.

● 3–5 years of proven experience in partnerships, business development, or key account management within fintech, financial services, Web3, digital assets, or the wider payments industry.

● Deep understanding of the global fintech and digital payments ecosystem, including familiarity with banks, payment service providers, financial institutions, and digital asset service providers.

● Demonstrated success in independently managing complex commercial discussions, partner onboarding, and cross-functional project delivery.

● Highly comfortable coordinating with Product and Technology teams on API or system integrations from a strategic business perspective.

● Exceptional relationship-building skills, with a proven ability to influence and collaborate effectively with both external executives and internal teams.

● Strong analytical, problem-solving, and written/verbal communication skills, coupled with meticulous attention to detail.

● Proactive, commercially driven, and highly adaptable, with the ability to thrive and concurrently manage multiple workstreams in FOMO Pay's fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.

*Our Perks and Benefits:*

● Competitive Compensation and Benefit Package

● Group Hospitalisation and Medical Insurance

● Fun and Dynamic Environment with plenty of learning and growth opportunities

● Career Advancement

● Professional Development Training Workshops

● Team Building Sessions

Pay: $4,500.00 - $6,500.00 per month

Benefits:
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Professional development

title: Chief of Staff
description:

title: Sr. Product Manager: Fleet and Mobility
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Senior Product Manager, Fleet and Mobility - Key Client serves as a hands-on, embedded technical partner working day-to-day with internal Visa teams and external partners to build, launch, and scale new fleet and mobility solutions, driving successful solution delivery. This role translates Visa platform capabilities - including VIP authorization, clearing, and payment processing frameworks - into clear, actionable implementation guidance, and leads technical problem-solving and solution design across markets and use cases alongside the Key Client.

Operating within a one-team model across Visa and our key client, the role accelerates delivery by removing integration blockers, aligning stakeholders, and enabling rapid decision-making. The ideal candidate is a subject matter expert in Visa processing and ecosystem integration, brings strong payments and fleet domain knowledge, and has a hands-on execution mindset - able to quickly ramp in as a highly responsive and trusted counterpart to the client’s team.

Key Responsibilities:

Embedded Technical Partnership:

Serve as a hands-on, embedded technical partner working day-to-day with internal Visa teams and external partners to drive successful solution delivery.
Operate as a highly responsive counterpart, ensuring consistent engagement and support to partner teams.
Bring the right internal and external stakeholders together quickly to unblock decisions and accelerate progress.
Support onboarding and enablement of partners by driving knowledge transfer and implementation best practices and ensuring Visa Client Services/various Visa Implementation teams configure and launch all platforms for successful solution delivery.

Technical Problem-Solving and Solution Design:

Translate Visa platform capabilities (e.g., VIP, clearing, payment processing frameworks) into clear, actionable implementation guidance for partners across different markets and use cases.
Lead technical problem-solving and solution design, providing direction on how to implement Visa capabilities effectively.
Act as a subject matter expert on Visa processing and ecosystem integration, including issuer and acquirer capabilities and platform constraints.
Provide guidance on system configurations, dependencies, and limitations, and identify practical paths to achieve desired outcomes.

Product Strategy and Ownership:

Direct product strategy from conception and definition through implementation, ensuring alignment with Visa's fleet and mobility platform objectives and the key partner’s roadmap requirements (as per Visa AOP approvals)
Identify new business and market opportunities within the fleet and mobility ecosystem; develop business plans and prioritize feature delivery across supply-side (fuel merchants) and demand-side (fleet platforms, FMOs) participants.
Determine market and customer requirements and ensure consistency of new capabilities with Visa's organizational objectives and the key client’s platform specifications.
Formulate and execute delivery plans to meet scope, milestone, and cost targets.
Promote adoption of new technologies and industry-leading trends within fleet and mobility payments.

Acquiring, POS and Certification:

Guide issuer and acquirer certification processes required for merchant onboarding and transaction readiness, with particular depth on the acquiring side.
Drive product integration across POS acquiring ecosystems, including terminal enablement and acceptance flows.
Champion merchant system readiness for fleet commercial products by working with terminal vendors and software companies.
Ensure alignment with acquirer, processor, and network requirements across regions.

Execution and Go-To-Market:

Support MVP delivery timelines, including pilot execution and integration milestones.
Partner with regional teams to support go-to-market planning and execution across global markets, including Australia, & New Zealand, broader Asia Pacific, Europe, and other key regions; travel globally on-site as needed to support partner onboarding and alignment.
Drive readiness for issuance, scaling from pilot to production deployment.
Contribute to sales enablement through development of product collateral, demos, and technical FAQs.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Operating Model:

Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Technology, Regional teams, and partners to ensure alignment and execution at scale.
Ensure integration with VisaNet, issuer processors, and partner platforms including Pismo and CyberSource.
Contribute to defining and refining the operating model and ways of working to optimize delivery and scalability.
Track and report on key performance indicators to measure integration progress and product success.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

8 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD.
Experience in applying Agile principles across design, development, testing, and product management.
Experience in developing software capabilities to support sales, service, or customer relationship management functions.
Experience in multi-tasking, organizing, managing, and implementing complex projects directly or through supervision.
Experience in cross-functional collaboration with systems, marketing, and sales teams.
Experience in product management or technical product roles within payments, fintech, or mobility platforms.
Working knowledge of the card payment lifecycle, including VisaNet authorization, clearing, and settlement.
Experience with issuer and/or acquirer certification processes, with preference for acquiring-side exposure.
Familiarity with VisaNet or equivalent network processing environments.
Comfort working with APIs, distributed systems, and platform integrations.
Ability to work across multi-stakeholder initiatives in a cross-functional environment.
Experience working in Agile environments across cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications:

9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD.
Agile certifications such as CSM and CSPO, or their equivalent.
Experience in identifying points of failure and formulating error-handling approaches for product resiliency.
Experience in fleet, mobility, or commercial card ecosystems.
Familiarity with closed-loop and open-loop payment models.
Experience with platforms such as Pismo, CyberSource, or similar payment infrastructure providers.
Understanding of transaction routing, resiliency, and failure handling in payment systems.
Exposure to product rollouts across multiple regions; APAC experience preferred.
Regional knowledge of ANZ or Europe/UK payments or fleet & mobility markets is advantageous but not required.
Requires digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Marketing & Communications Manager
description:
Job Summary:

Our vision is to provide engaging, rewarding, and fun wellbeing experiences that inspire employees to come together, do their best work, and live their best lives. Our high-performing Exos team delivers service and operational excellence across a holistic wellbeing program to support the physical and social health of employees from our large global client.

As Marketing & Communications Manager, you’ll be our eyes and ears across the APAC region, where the client is located - driving strategy, communications and the implementation of regional and global wellbeing marketing programs and initiatives. This role will enable the marketing function in the areas with our greatest density, leading the collaboration with internal stakeholders and managing expectations with client stakeholders. This role will work closely with the AMER, BAY and EMEA Marketing & Communication team members, the Marketing Center of Excellence, and across other teams within the org.

Responsibilities:

Ownership over APAC client and internal stakeholder relationships, responsible for developing, growing and maintaining strategic partnerships that deliver on regional goals, demonstrate value, and aim toward larger org-wide priorities
Manage marketing and communications requests from partners and stakeholders, determining the most strategic response in accordance with our annual strategic plan
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to implement consistent communications across organizations, visually and tonally
Collaborate on the development and implementation of all consumer-focused communications and production of those assets
Own and manage all marketing services offered by this internal team, including toolkit development and optimization, development of SOPs and guidelines, website maintenance, newsletter content development, asset requests, regional promotional campaigns, email engagement campaigns, documentation creation to educate and enable internal teams to find and properly leverage the best marketing assets. Continually explore how to elevate and refine marketing tactics and channels

Align regional campaigns with our global marketing initiatives
Clearly and effectively storytell to multiple audiences (internal, users, stakeholders), embodying and evolving the brand tone
Contribute to strategic planning, development and delivery of an integrated marketing strategy and communications plan
Ideate, improve, and rollout processes to drive efficiencies across teams and more effective collaboration
Take initiative to plan, organize, coordinate and perform work in situations where numerous and diverse demands are involved

Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree
Minimum 5-7 years of relevant marketing and communications experience managing a broad marketing mix with proven ability to build relationships, identify needs and implement solutions end-to-end
Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to influence others
Experience with G-suite tools and Canva
Personal interest in health and wellbeing
Proven experience navigating a matrixed environment, with the ability to effectively communicate and influence stakeholders at all levels.
Ability and willingness to travel regularly (quarterly to annually) as required.

A natural connector with a positive, team-building approach
Enthusiastic about cross-functional and collaborative work, comfortable interfacing with multiple stakeholders
Experienced leading team dynamics; you’re comfortable leading meetings, developing agendas and nudging conversations in a productive and inspiring way
Reliable: someone we can count on to get stuff done

Great with the details; you geek out with organization
Eager to do, but patient to listen and ‘let the play develop’

Think you're a good fit? Check out our internships, apply for a job, or send your resume to be considered when a new position opens.

During the recruiting process, EXOS will never ask for your credit card information or request any form of payment from you. If you receive any communication requesting such information or a payment, please immediately contact privacy@teamexos.com.

For nearly 30 years, Exos has been dedicated to getting people ready for the moments that matter by promoting a holistic approach to health. We’ve never been the type to accept the status quo. We’re all about studying, learning, innovating, and making waves. And we feel that it’s our responsibility to help others because we know there’s a better way. That better way is Exos Readiness.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Who We Are

Overhaul is a supply chain integrity solutions company that allows shippers to connect disparate sources of data into the first fully transparent situational analysis engine designed for the logistics industry. Data that is transformed into critical insights can instantly trigger corrective actions, impacting everything from temperature control to handling requirements or package-level tracking, ensuring cargo arrives at its destination safely, undamaged, and on time. We are a dynamic, innovative, and fun team who is highly committed to our customers' experiences and our Mission and Vision.

The Role

As the Dedicated Customer Success Manager for Asia, you will be a regional owner and subject matter expert for one strategic global customer. This is a highly engaged role focused on knowing the customer's program in depth, staying ahead of performance and priorities, and ensuring that actions move from discussion to completion. You will build a strong working partnership with the customer, develop detailed knowledge of their logistics and security program in your region, and connect their needs to the right Overhaul teams and capabilities.

This role is dedicated to the customer's Asia program and is accountable for regional program health, stakeholder alignment, and execution while operating as part of a coordinated global Customer Success team led from the US.

Success requires curiosity, strong ownership, excellent organization, sound customer judgment, and the ability to connect day-to-day program detail with the customer's broader goals. You will be expected to be proactive, data-driven, and comfortable coordinating across functions, regions, and time zones.

Responsibilities

Regional Program Ownership and SME

Become the subject matter expert on the customer's supply chain, security program, operating model, workflows, use cases, stakeholders, and program requirements within Asia.
Develop a deep understanding of how the customer uses Overhaul across the region, including relevant product capabilities, configurations, monitoring processes, operational workflows, and escalation paths.
Build detailed lane-level knowledge of origins and destinations, transportation modes, carriers, hubs, airports or ports, handoffs, approved or expected routing, normal transit and dwell patterns, and relevant regional security risks.
Use that operational and security knowledge to identify recurring route or risk patterns and work with the customer and internal teams to optimize routing decisions, monitoring workflows, alert strategy, and escalation processes to reduce risk, delay, and unnecessary exceptions.
Stay ahead of the program by maintaining a clear view of priorities, open actions, risks, dependencies, changes, and upcoming needs - and drive customer and internal commitments through completion.

Customer Partnership and Governance

Serve as a primary Customer Success point of contact for the customer's Asia stakeholders and build trusted relationships across operational and leadership teams.
Lead regular customer cadences and program reviews with a clear point of view on program health, progress, risks, decisions, and next steps.
Proactively identify customer needs and challenges, translate them into clear internal actions, and keep the regional program aligned to the customer's business objectives.

Global Account Coordination

Operate as part of one global Customer Success team, partnering closely with the dedicated CSMs in the other regions and the US-based Global Customer Success Lead.
Share regional performance, route and security learnings, risks, customer feedback, and best practices so the customer receives a consistent global experience while legitimate regional differences are understood and managed.
Coordinate cross-region handoffs, dependencies, reporting, and follow-up so issues and initiatives continue moving across time zones and teams, escalating blockers to the Global Customer Success Lead when needed.

Performance and Continuous Improvement

Monitor key performance indicators, adoption, program activity, and service trends to assess account health and identify areas requiring attention.
Use data, shipment activity, event and incident trends, route performance, and customer feedback to identify patterns, gaps, and opportunities to improve program effectiveness, security outcomes, and customer operations.
Drive follow-through on root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives, and bring forward relevant Overhaul capabilities and best practices.

Cross-Functional Orchestration

Work closely with KAM/EAE, Sales, Operations, Support, Product, and other internal teams to ensure customer priorities are understood and advanced.
Own Customer Success coordination of regional escalations, ensuring the right teams are engaged, actions are clear, accountability is maintained, and customer communication is timely and accurate.
Partner with the commercial account team to identify opportunities to expand customer value, use cases, or adoption when aligned with the customer's needs.

What We Expect From You

Highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of follow-through.
Strong ownership mindset with the ability to operate independently while working effectively as part of a global account team.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with both operational teams and senior customer stakeholders.
Analytical mindset with the ability to use data to identify trends, frame problems, and drive decisions.
Ability to coordinate complex work across multiple internal teams and influence outcomes without direct authority.
Strong customer judgment and experience supporting complex customer programs.
Deep understanding of customer success best practices; experience in supply chain, logistics, transportation, cargo security, or technology-enabled operational programs is strongly preferred.
Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a commitment to continuous improvement.
Fluency in English

Our Culture

We are guided by our core values of Diversity and Synergy, Creativity, Problem Solving, Authenticity and Receptivity, Trust, Encouragement, Teaching and Learning, Wellness and Integrity. These values help us recruit aligned talent to join our rapidly expanding team around the globe. It is important to us that each and every Overhauler is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done, but is also an awesome addition to our company culture.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Overhaul is an equal opportunity employer. Our Overhaul Culture Code's top listed commitment is to "Diversity and Synergy." All aspects of employment will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

title: Senior Manager, Client Services & Business Delivery (AIA Investment Management)
description:

At AIA, your skills, perspective and ideas can contribute to our Purpose of helping millions of people live Healthier, Longer, Better Lives. Across our diverse markets, you will take on meaningful challenges, collaborate with talented colleagues and help turn ideas into positive outcomes for our customers and communities.

Join us to shape what comes next, grow through new experiences and extend your impact across Asia.

Join us as Senior Manager, Client Services & Business Delivery at AIA Investment Management!

At AIA Investment Management, we believe in creating long-term value for our clients and communities. We are seeking a dynamic Senior Manager, Client Services and Business Delivery to join our team. Coordinate support functions on client instructions, documentation, reporting and servicing.
Track commitments and deliverables, ensuring timely follow-through and escalation.

Coordinate front-to-back teams to clarify requirements, dependencies and risks.
Represent the client perspective and support timely resolution of implementation issues and trade-offs.

Manage challenging or sensitive discussions with professionalism and credibility.
Ensure materials and communications are accurate, appropriately nuanced and clear for senior audiences.

Minimum Requirements

We are looking for professionals who possess:
