Excellent listening and strong communication skills both verbal and written.
Excellent interpersonal skills, experienced in working collaboratively to lead in team structure
Capable of working across a variety of organizational dimensions and managing across a diversity of disciplines and cultures, with proactive approach and a bias towards collaboration and reaching win-win outcomes
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
Ability to deal with and handle multiple and changing priorities.
Strong self-initiative and accountability; able to work independently

Believe in better with AIA. If you work at AIA, you play an important part in this movement. Which is why we give you every opportunity to learn, grow and shape your career - your way!

#LI-JY1

Build a career with us as we help our customers and the community live Healthier, Longer, Better Lives.

title: Manager, Loyalty Marketing, APEC
description:
Additional Information
Job Number26130284
Job CategorySales & Marketing
Location2 Harbourfront Place #06-08, Bank of America, Singapore 098499, Singapore
ScheduleFull Time
Located Remotely?N
Position Type Management

JOB SUMMARY

The Manager, Loyalty Marketing is a high-impact, commercially oriented role responsible for driving member growth, engagement and retention across Asia Pacific excluding China (APEC).

This is a new role sitting at the intersection of loyalty strategy, CRM, and experiential partnerships - built for a marketer who is equally comfortable designing a lifecycle journey and activating world-class partnerships. You will own the end-to-end member journeys for one of the world's largest hospitality loyalty programs, translating global strategy into locally relevant, measurable initiatives across a diverse and dynamic region. This role will report to the Director, Loyalty Marketing, APEC.

You will lead the evolution of CRM and lifecycle marketing for APEC — defining segmentation strategy, designing engagement programs, and driving measurable improvements in activation, retention and reactivation. You will work in close collaboration with global, continent and market teams, and play a central role in building the reach and scaling our loyalty program as a long-term growth driver for the business. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, strategic thinking and a member-centric mindset.

This role is based in Singapore.

CORE COMPETENCIES

CRM & Lifecycle Marketing: Deep, hands-on experience designing and executing programs across the full customer journey. Builds segmentation logic, personalisation strategy and automated flows anchored in commercial outcomes, not just campaign execution.
Loyalty & Partnership Marketing: Solid understanding of loyalty program mechanics (earn/burn, tiering, member value proposition) and how to market them effectively across segments and channels. Proven ability to activate brand partnerships, event management and experiential moments from brief to delivery, with strong agency management.
Data Analysis & Fluency: Comfortable working with member behaviour data, campaign analytics and dashboards to surface insight and drive continuous improvement. Tracks activity to outcomes, not outputs.
Communication & Brand Stewardship: Executes customer-facing communications with a consistent, on-brand voice across owned and paid channels. Brings sharp copywriting instincts, strong creative review judgment, and the ability to influence and align across global, regional and local teams with different cultures and working styles.
Execution & Project Management: Highly organised with a strong bias for delivery. Manages multiple workstreams simultaneously, ensuring projects adhere to timelines.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

We are looking for a marketer with 4+ years of experience in loyalty, CRM or lifecycle marketing, ideally within hospitality, travel, or a consumer brand environment.

Requirement

4-5 years of relevant professional experience in program management, marketing strategy, loyalty and lifecycle disciplines, digital or related function
Experience managing and directing strategic partners / agencies /vendors. Demonstrated relationship marketing skills a must.
Team player, proven ability to lead and work with cross-functional teams in support of specific business priorities
Languages: Proficiency in English required; proficiency in reading and writing in other Asian languages strongly preferred.

JOB SCOPE

Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing

Drive member growth, engagement and advocacy across APEC through loyalty-led initiatives that build program awareness, deepen usage and deliver locally relevant member value
Develop and execute the continent's loyalty marketing plan - spanning promotions, lifecycle programs and CRM strategy - aligned with global strategy and optimised for local market nuance
Define and manage CRM strategy across the full customer lifecycle: acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention and reactivation
Plan and execute loyalty-led campaigns across owned channels (email, app, digital) and paid channels (social, digital) with audience analysis, targeting, segmentation and performance tracking
Identify opportunities for segmentation, personalisation to deliver on deeper customer value optimisation; drive continuous improvement in CRM effectiveness and automation capabilities
 Leverage market research, member insights and data analytics to inform engagement strategies and personalised experiences
Design, implement and optimise loyalty programs that drive advocacy and revenue, delivering tangible value to target member segments
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including but not limited to MarTech, Enterprise Partnerships (Co-Brand, Airlines, Everyday Earn) and Loyalty Operations to integrate and orchestrate initiatives across key customer touchpoints
Serve as gatekeeper for all loyalty member communications, ensuring on-brand, accurate and effective execution

Performance Operations & Governance

Track and report program KPIs covering member acquisition, activation, retention, revenue contribution and repeat stay behaviour, with clear recommendations for improvement
Oversee CRM data accuracy, integrity and compliance across programs
Drive effective onboarding, training and adoption of loyalty programs and systems across property teams

Experiential Partnerships

Support the activation of global and regional marketing partnerships translating partnership rights into compelling, member-facing campaigns that drive high member engagement, leveraging on Marriott Bonvoy Moments
Ensure all partnership campaigns are executed in full alignment with partners, with rigorous agency management and end-to-end campaign planning
Support end-to-end event management and logistics planning for partnership activations, ensuring seamless on-ground execution and member experiences

Working Relations

Key interfaces:-

Area Directors of Marketing
Field Marketing team
Continent level agencies.

Integrated Marketing Planning

Supports development of continent destination marketing strategy and focused on key source markets and KPIs.
Monitor competitive activity in the category.

Promotions/ Partnerships

Partners with Revenue Strategy, develops and executes promotions/offers that drive KPIs for the continent or market (eg. Enrollment goals, direct channel goals, driving leisure revenue, etc.).
Partner with analytics team to ensure proper tracking and communication of all programs.

Integrated Marketing Execution

Develops marketing brief with clear KPIs and conducts kick off for all new programs.
Engages agencies in RFP process and project manages the creative design and execution process to bring a program to market. Ensures consumer messaging is clear.
Is responsible for ensuring all key stakeholders of the program are aligned.
Is responsible for communicating programs to the market and corporate teams and ensuring all channels are leveraged (social, digital, sales, etc).

Area/ Hotel Support

title: Marketing & Partnerships Manager
description:
Dr Scalp is a Singapore scalp and hair care brand with two studios, at Raffles City and The Centrepoint, and our own range of scalp and hair care products.

We use AI scalp scanning to show people what’s actually happening on their scalp, then treat it. It’s genuinely interesting to look at, and almost nobody has seen it before. We’re rebuilding this brand from the ground up, and a second AWHL brand joins in the next 6 to 12 months. What you build here is the foundation for both.

The Role

You own how Dr Scalp gets sold. The plan, the calendar, the promotions, the events, the partnerships, and the two people who execute them.

This is not a brief-writing job. Half of it is offline: roadshows, mall activations, visual merchandising, and picking up the phone to companies who have never heard of us. The other half is online, where you set the offer and the mechanic and your team builds it.

What You’ll Do

Plan it:

• Own the marketing plan and a rolling campaign calendar at least a quarter ahead

• Decide what each month is trying to achieve, and what the promotion is

• Brief every campaign properly: objective, audience, offer, mechanic, dates, channels, who does what by when

• Keep the calendar clear of collisions, between Dr Scalp promos and later between AWHL brands

Run it online:

• Set every website and marketplace promotion. You decide the offer, dates and target, e-commerce builds it

• Brief and approve every EDM

• Manage the performance marketing agency: budget, targets, weekly review, and the call on whether to keep them

• Decide when paid media comes in-house, build the case for it, and run the transition when it does

• Own the acquisition numbers. Cost per lead, cost per customer, return on ad spend

Run it offline:

• Plan and run roadshows, launch events and in-mall activations, from permit

application to teardown

• Own visual merchandising across both studios

• Own in-studio collateral. What exists, where it sits, when it gets refreshed

• Work the mall marketing teams for tenant campaigns and promotional slots

Open new doors:

• Build and work a pipeline of referral, collaboration and corporate partners

• Corporate wellness packages, workplace screening events, staff perk programmes

• Referral partnerships with salons, clinics, gyms, bridal studios and postnatal

services

• Negotiate the terms, hand them up for signature, and own the renewal

• Carry a partnership revenue target, reported separately from retail

Manage creators and suppliers:

• Source, brief and manage KOLs and paid creators, and measure what each one

actually delivered

• Source, onboard and manage affiliates, including commission structure and

tracking

• Manage the freelance brand designer and any agency we engage

Lead the team

• Manage the Social Media & Content Designer and the E-commerce & CRM

Executive

• Grow the team as the brand does. Scope the roles, write the briefs, and hire

the people

• Run the weekly marketing meeting, the monthly review and the quarterly plan

• Hold the quarterly performance reviews against each person's role standard

Own the numbers

• Spend the quarterly budget and answer for the return on it monthly

• Check every promotion for margin before it goes live

• Approve health and results claims across every channel, once you know the brand

well enough that we hand that over

• Report weekly on spend and campaign status, monthly on revenue against plan

and the partnership pipeline, quarterly on the plan for the next three months

Who We’re Looking For

• 4 to 6 years in marketing, including at least one year owning a plan and a budget

rather than executing someone else's

• You've run both sides. An offline activation and a paid campaign, not only one of

them

• You've closed a partnership or corporate deal yourself. Tell us how you found them

and what you offered

• You've managed people or agencies, and can tell us what you did when someone

underdelivered

• You can hold a media agency to account. You know how a campaign is structured,

what attribution is telling you, and what a well-run account looks like, even if you

are not the one building it

• You read the numbers before forming the opinion

• You can write a brief that a designer and a media buyer both understand

• Retail, beauty, wellness or F&B experience is a plus, not a requirement

This Role Is Not For You If…

• You were hoping someone else would do the cold outreach

• You need a big budget to be effective

• You've only ever briefed agencies and never built a campaign yourself

• You think marketing ends when the campaign goes live

• You want a clean, finished brand to work with rather than one being rebuilt

• You're looking for a slow, structured corporate environment

DrScalp is a pioneer in advanced scalp health solutions, and is a Singapore-based, science-driven scalp-care clinic offering AI analysis and advanced treatments for healthier hair and scalp.

Our mission

To provide our customers with customised treatments that address the root cause of scalp issues like hair loss, dandruff and inflammation. We combine state-of-the-art technology with personalised care to help you achieve healthier hair from the scalp up.

Our Vision

We believe that everyone deserves healthy, beautiful hair and that starts with proper scalp care. Our vision at DrScalp is to make cutting-edge scalp treatments accessible to everyone, ensuring long-term health and visible results. We’re here to transform the way you think about scalp health.

Our Commitment

We are committed to not only providing the best treatments but also educating our customers. We believe in empowering everyone with the knowledge to maintain a healthy scalp long after they leave our centre. From your first consultation to ongoing care, we’ll be with you every step of the way.

title: Course Consultant

Course Consultant

At Singapore's AI and technology training provider

The Opportunity

As a

Course Consultant

, you will engage corporate clients, HR and L&D professionals, business leaders and other key stakeholders to understand their organisation's training and workforce development needs.

You will provide consultative guidance on suitable courses and training programmes, helping organisations identify relevant learning solutions to support employee development, digital transformation and business objectives.

You will manage prospective corporate clients throughout the sales journey, from initial outreach and needs discovery through solution recommendation, proposal, negotiation and enrolment.

Identify new business opportunities through prospecting, outbound outreach, networking, referrals, LinkedIn and other relevant channels.

Collaborate with internal programme and delivery teams to ensure proposed solutions align with client requirements and can be delivered effectively.

Stay updated on Vertical Institute's courses, industry trends, emerging technologies and workforce skills needs to provide relevant and informed recommendations.

Achieve and exceed monthly and quarterly sales and revenue targets.

What We're Looking For

Experience in

B2B sales, business development, corporate sales, account management, consultative sales or a related client-facing role

.

Experience engaging

HR, L&D, business leaders, department heads or other corporate decision-makers

is preferred.

Strong consultative selling and needs-analysis skills, with the ability to understand business challenges and recommend suitable solutions.

Experience managing the

full sales cycle

, from prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation and closing.

Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills.

Comfortable conducting outbound prospecting through calls, email, LinkedIn, networking and other business development channels.

Commercially driven, proactive and comfortable working towards individual and team sales targets.

Strong pipeline management and follow-up discipline, with the ability to prioritise high-value opportunities.

Comfortable using CRM systems and digital communication tools to manage sales activities and client relationships.

Experience in

corporate training, education, technology, HR, professional services, consulting, SaaS or other solution-based industries

is advantageous.

A genuine interest in helping organisations develop their workforce and adopt relevant skills for the evolving digital economy.

Over 50,000 professionals have trained with us across individual programmes and enterprise engagements, including partnerships with government agencies, MNCs, and financial institutions. We are headquartered at the Lifelong Learning Institute.

About Vertical Institute

Vertical Institute prepares individuals for the jobs of tomorrow. We are at the forefront of tech education, providing cutting-edge courses to individuals eager to upskill and stay relevant in today’s rapidly changing world. We specialize in teaching in-demand skills and building the next generation of changemakers and inventors through our world-class tech courses in data analytics, AI, cybersecurity, UX/UI, and beyond.

Our vision is to provide Asia’s workforce with transformative education where every business is digitally empowered and every individual digitally skilled.

title: B2B Marketing Lead
description:
The Role

We’re looking for a commercially minded marketing lead to shape and deliver programmes that generate enterprise demand, build pipeline and strengthen Intellect’s presence across priority markets.

You’ll translate business priorities into focused marketing plans and own their execution, bringing together campaigns, events, partner marketing, digital channels, content and prospect lifecycle marketing. Alongside demand generation, you’ll help sharpen how we communicate our solutions, bring offerings to market and improve the effectiveness of our marketing activity.

Working closely with sales, product and content marketing, and local commercial teams, you’ll make decisions about where to focus, coordinate the support needed and carry initiatives through from idea to commercial results. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys combining strategic judgement with execution and building a more effective, repeatable marketing engine.

Your Responsibilities

Marketing Planning & Commercial Priorities

Translate business and market priorities into practical marketing plans, with clear audiences, objectives, budgets and measures of success.

Identify the campaigns, channels and opportunities most likely to generate relevant demand, balancing immediate commercial needs with longer-term market presence.

Own delivery across your marketing programmes, coordinating internal contributors, creative support and external partners.

Review results with commercial stakeholders and recommend where to invest, refine or stop activity.

Integrated Campaigns & Demand Generation

Plan and execute integrated campaigns targeting priority industries, enterprise accounts and decision-makers.

Bring together email, events, webinars, partner channels, content distribution and selective paid activity to generate qualified demand and commercial opportunities.

Own campaign delivery, including audience targeting, briefs, landing pages, email sequences and launch coordination.

Improve digital discovery and conversion across relevant website journeys, search and campaign channels, working with specialist support where needed.

Events & Partner Marketing

Lead the marketing execution of webinars, roundtables, industry conferences and other selected events, from assessing opportunities and shaping the proposition to promotion, delivery and follow-up.

Develop joint marketing programmes with partners, associations and industry communities to extend Intellect’s reach and credibility.

Work with sales to engage relevant prospects before and after events, turning participation into qualified conversations and opportunities.

Evaluate event and partnership performance to guide future activity and investment.

Prospect Lifecycle & Conversion

Build and run prospect nurture programmes across the enterprise buying cycle, including event follow-up, ongoing education and reactivation of dormant leads.

Personally manage audience segmentation, email campaigns and marketing automation workflows to deliver relevant, coordinated communications.

Align with sales on qualification, lead routing, handover and follow-up so marketing engagement translates into timely commercial action.

Use engagement data, funnel performance and sales feedback to improve lead quality and progression.

Market Positioning & Go-to-Market Support

Help translate Intellect’s solutions into clear, compelling messages for different buyers, industries and markets, working with product and content marketing.

Partner with local commercial teams to adapt marketing plans to buyer needs and support market expansion and the launch of relevant offerings.

Shape briefs and contribute to customer stories, campaign content and sales materials, drawing on expertise from clinical, product and commercial teams.

Strengthen Intellect’s visibility and credibility through consistent messaging and the distribution of thought leadership, customer evidence and expert perspectives.

Marketing Performance & Operations

Maintain a clear marketing calendar, reliable campaign tracking and visibility into performance across key programmes.

Assess results through qualified engagement, sales-accepted opportunities, pipeline contribution and conversion, using findings to improve activity and budget allocation.

Work with sales and the relevant CRM or revenue operations owner to strengthen reporting, attribution and shared processes.

Build reusable templates and workflows, using AI and automation thoughtfully to improve execution speed, quality and consistency.

Requirements

An experienced B2B marketer. You have personally owned and delivered marketing programmes for business audiences, ideally involving enterprise buyers and considered purchasing decisions. We value demonstrated scope, judgement and results over a particular title.

Able to shape the plan and deliver it. You can turn commercial objectives into clear priorities, choose an appropriate channel mix and carry work through without needing every step prescribed.

A hands-on owner. You’re comfortable moving between planning, campaign setup, copy and briefs, CRM execution and performance analysis, bringing in support where it adds the most value.

Comfortable across marketing disciplines. You bring practical depth in demand generation, events or webinars, and email nurture, with the ability to connect these to messaging, content and digital channels.

Commercially and analytically minded. You understand enterprise sales cycles and can explain how your work generated relevant demand, improved conversion or contributed to pipeline.

Confident with marketing tools. You can build segments, launch email journeys, configure straightforward automation and use CRM and campaign reporting to guide decisions.

A strong communicator and collaborator. You can develop effective copy and briefs, make complex solutions understandable, and align sales, subject-matter experts and external partners around a clear objective.

Resourceful and organised. You make sensible trade-offs, manage budgets and multiple workstreams reliably, and deliver within a lean environment.

Motivated by the mission. You’re excited to help expand access to mental healthcare and build marketing programmes that support meaningful business growth.

Intellect (

intellect.co

) is a venture-backed digital health company reinventing how mental health is in Asia. Our goal is to make it simple, easy and stigma-free for everyone.

We're building an entirely new way for modern organisations to easily provide support for their employees’ mental health & mental wellbeing, no matter where they are on their journey.

Join us on our mission to eliminate barriers to mental health and to create a wellbeing approach that people love using.

title: Regional Sales Manager

What You’ll Bring

6–10 years of relevant experience across partner sales, alliances, technology sales, business development or consulting.

Strong relationship-building, discovery and communication skills, including the ability to engage business and technical stakeholders.

Growth in qualified AWS partner-sourced and co-sell pipeline.

Stronger AWS relationships that consistently generate customer opportunities.

Effective use of eligible funding programs to support customer engagements.

Earlier involvement of Slalom in customer discovery, design and scoping.

Clear progression from joint account planning to pursuits, wins and delivery handoffs.

Building systems that allow the business to grow

This role is particularly suited to a

mid-career professional looking for a genuine career transition

.

2 years of relevant working experience

hands-on entrepreneurial and commercial experience

We are looking for an experienced Growth Product Manager with a strong background in cross-border payments, international remittance or fintech to drive user and transaction growth across our remittance markets.

Identify new customer segments and market opportunities.

Drive meaningful product and customer journey improvements.

Standard Chartered is uplifting the financial markets technology estate to a modern architecture to provide solid foundations for its business growth. The “Head of S2BX Engineering” is accountable for defining and delivering the end-to-end technology strategy, platforms and services that support Standard Chartered’s Straight2Bank Exchange (S2BX) - SCB's multi-asset electronic trading platform. This role is at Band 4 level (equivalent to Executive Director). The role leads the critical technology estate that delivers pricing, market connectivity and analytics for FX, NDF, MM, Precious metals & Digital Assets to external clients and Internal Sales & Trading across the SCB footprint.

The role provides senior technology, engineering and organisational leadership across a globally distributed S2BX Engineering organisation, partnering closely with Markets business, Product, Operations, Risk, Finance, Infrastructure and control functions to ensure that platform continues to lead low-latency pricing, execution, algorithmic trading capabilities and market making operations.

As a member of the ‘Markets Pricing, Connectivity & Analytics’ Engineering Team, the role balances strategic transformation with platform stability and service resilience, while driving simplification, modernisation, control uplift, cost discipline and execution excellence across the S2BX estate.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy
• Set and own the end-to-end technology strategy for S2BX Engineering, covering multi-asset trading, real-time pricing, execution algorithms, market making technology and client connectivity, ensuring platforms are ultra-low latency, highly scalable, well-controlled and aligned to Markets business priorities and regulatory obligations.
• Define and maintain a coherent S2BX technology roadmap, translating enterprise, Markets and client objectives into prioritised investments that balance platform modernisation, regulatory commitments, performance optimisation, service resilience and business growth.
• S2BX Core Platform – Responsible for the strategy, design, delivery and resilience of end-to-end technology capabilities across the trading platform estate, ensuring ultra-low latency execution, real-time risk management, strong data integrity, effective risk mitigation and scalable platforms that support global market making operations.
• Drive platform simplification, architectural consistency and reuse across the S2BX estate to reduce fragmentation, strengthen controls, improve performance and enhance long-term maintainability.

• Maintain a forward-looking modernisation roadmap that reduces technology obsolescence, improves execution performance, enhances algorithmic capabilities and ensures long-term supportability of mission-critical S2BX platforms.
• Drive a performance, control and resilience agenda across the software development lifecycle, reducing latency, improving execution integrity and delivering measurable improvements in trading performance and client outcomes.

AI & Innovation
• Provide senior leadership for AI engineering across S2BX platform, acting as an SME for AI-enabled software delivery across pricing, trading and automated risk management, ensuring consistent adoption of approved patterns, standards and secure delivery practices.
• Support innovation in algorithmic trading, client execution optimization and automated market making through advanced analytics, machine learning and AI-driven trading strategies
• Deliver tangible AI-enabled productivity gains and enhanced trading capabilities, translating innovation into measurable execution performance, client experience and operational outcomes
• Support business teams in understanding the 'art of the possible' for AI in electronic trading, supporting the design and delivery of coherent, scalable solutions that enable trading innovation and client differentiation.

Business
• Acts as a senior technology partner to Markets and client-facing leadership, shaping platform strategy, priorities and investment decisions in line with trading performance, client outcomes and competitive positioning.
• Promote a platform-led operating model across S2BX Engineering, building reusable and well-governed capabilities that support multi-asset trading, algorithmic execution and market making while reducing fragmentation and operational dependency.
• Lead investment planning, prioritisation and resource allocation for the S2BX estate, balancing strategic enhancement, performance optimization, platform health and service performance against agreed business and client priorities.
• Influence and challenge senior stakeholders across Business, Sales, Trading and Client Management to translate strategic and client requirements into high-performance platform outcomes.
• Oversee strategic vendor and third-party relationships across the S2BX estate to secure sustainable commercial, service, performance and risk outcomes across critical trading platforms and market data services.

 Processes
• Ensure S2BX platforms operate with the highest standards of performance, availability and operational readiness, supporting time-critical trading, real-time pricing, algorithmic execution and market making workflows.
• Embed disciplined engineering, Agile and DevOps practices across the organisation, with particular focus on low-latency development, performance testing, controlled releases, real-time monitoring and operational resilience.
• Ensure compliance with defined engineering, testing and release disciplines, using automation and tooling to support efficient, repeatable and well-controlled execution of S2BX deliveries without impacting trading performance.
• Define and enforce engineering standards covering ultra-low latency development, real-time data processing, execution integrity, performance monitoring, disaster recovery and end-to-end controls across critical S2BX processes.
• Ensure S2BX platforms support regulatory compliance and supervisory expectations, including strong controls for trade reporting accuracy, best execution, client protection and data governance.
• Drive automation and industrialisation across S2BX processes to reduce manual intervention, improve execution efficiency and enhance trading performance at scale.

Risk Management
• Seek regular assurance that S2BX Engineering is operating to acceptable risk, control and performance standards, taking prompt action to address weaknesses and ensuring timely remediation of any trading or client impact
• Operational Resilience Capability - Strengthen service resilience, disaster recovery and operational integrity for time-critical, high-volume S2BX platforms through disciplined engineering and continuous performance improvement.
• Act quickly and decisively when performance, risk or control weaknesses become apparent, ensuring root-cause resolution, clear accountability and appropriate escalation through relevant governance forums.
• Balance business delivery, performance optimization and transformation objectives with risk and control requirements to ensure platform decisions remain within the Group's risk appetite while maintaining competitive execution quality.

 People and Talent

• Lead by example by role-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.
• • Provides executive leadership for a large, globally distributed S2BX Engineering organisation, setting direction, standards and expectations across low-latency engineering, algorithmic development and mission-critical platform operations.

We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

Job Summary

The Key Leader role is an essential part of the store leadership team, impacting salesfloor team members and guest (i.e., customer) experience every day. Key Leaders are responsible for leading by example and providing support to Educators, facilitating an outstanding guest experience in the store, and overseeing all operations of the retail floor. Key Leaders leverage key performance indicators and metrics to prioritize responsibilities while adapting to day-to-day business adjustments and challenges.

Core Responsibilities of the Job

Leadership and People Management

* Support ongoing learning and development of team members by providing direct feedback, coaching, mentoring, and career path guidance, and addressing performance concerns.
* Provide team members recognition, gap assessment, and overall performance documentation to support and reinforce career and personal growth.
* Develop, maintain, and disseminate product and general company knowledge through appropriate communication channels.

Guest (i.e., Customer) Experience

* Support team members (e.g., leading by example or coaching) with ensuring a great guest experience that values guests' time, including assessing guest needs, providing technical product educations, and supporting in-store transactions and omnichannel programs.
* Interact with and assess guests' unique needs to provide customized, effective purchase and return solutions and support.
* Provide technical product education by articulating the value and benefit of the product.
* Resolve guest feedback and address guest concerns or escalations to make it "right" for guests.
* Dynamically provide coverage on the floor to assess and fulfill the needs of the business, team, and guests.
* Inform guests of local community programs. Plan and execute local, regional, and area driven Community projects and initiatives (e.g., local run club, international day of yoga).

Working with Others

* Contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and celebrating differences to ensure a supportive and engaging experience for all team members and guests.
* Establish supportive and productive relationships with all team members.
* Collaborate with team members to ensure optimal guest experience and support store operations.

Operations

* Provide salesfloor leadership to team members, including planning salesfloor coverage and making decisions to maintain efficiency and effectiveness of salesfloor operations.
* Review business data and metrics to evaluate progress toward goals and determine if adjustments are warranted.
* Open and close the store in accordance with the opening and closing checklists.
* Manage product presentation tasks (e.g., put items back in place, restock or add depleted items to the floor from inventory, destock or relocate items) according to company standards.
* Assign Educators cleaning tasks as needed throughout the shift to maintain the luxury environment of the store.
* Ensure team uses in-store technology to support store operations and provide positive guest experiences.
* Understand and adhere to people safety policies and procedures to maintain a safe work environment.
* Perform work in accordance with applicable policies, procedures, and laws or regulations.

People Management

* Team lead role indirectly responsible for subset of store employees on the floor or as delegated by Store Manager

What We Look For

* Inclusion & Diversity: Creates/supports an inclusive environment that values/celebrates differences
* Integrity/Honesty: Behaves in an honest, fair, and ethical manner
* Guest Experience: Enjoys working and connecting with, understanding, and helping guests
* Collaboration and Teamwork: Works productively with and supports others to achieve goals; seeks partnerships and diverse perspectives
* Leadership: Is able and desires to lead, influence, and inspire others; motivates, empowers, develops, and directs people as they work
* Candid Communication: Is willing to openly/constructively share concerns (i.e., straight talk)
* Decision Making: Uses logic and reasoning to evaluate alternatives and make effective, timely decisions

Job Requirements

Eligibility

* Legally eligible to work in the jurisdiction of the store which you are assigned to.

Availability

* Willing to work a flexible schedule.

Other Willingness Requirements

* Willing to work as part of a team and also complete work independently
* Willing to move through a store for most of a shift to help guests and accomplish work

Experience

* Work experience

Job Assets (i.e., nice to have; not required)

* Education: High School or Secondary School diploma, equivalent or above
* Experience: 1 year of retail/sales

Applicants successful in progressing to interview will be contacted by a Manager or a member of the People & Culture team. Please note any applicant or employee who believes they need a reasonable accommodation to perform the essential duties of the job is welcome to discuss this with the Manager or People and Culture team member when arranging the interview.

Beyond The Paycheck (Benefits & Perks)

At lululemon, we care for and invest in the whole person - body, mind, spirit. Our total rewards program is designed to support you in achieving your goals and focus on the things you love. In addition to competitive base pay and a team-based bonus program, we also offer paid time off, generous employee discounts, fitness/yoga classes, parenthood top up program and personal and professional development programs.

Note: availability of these benefits and perks may be subject to your location & employment type and may have certain eligibility requirements. The Company reserves the right to alter these benefits and perks in whole or in part at any time without advance notice.

title: Head of Alternatives Operations, Singapore & Hong Kong, Managing Director
description:
Who we are looking for

Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS) provides administrative fund services to Alternative Investments Funds and Clients including Hedge Funds, Private Equity and Real Assets Funds. We deliver customized services to our clients, operating in 13 countries supporting all global regions.

We are seeking a highly accomplished senior leader to run State Street’s Alternatives Operations across Singapore and Hong Kong, with accountability for both Hedge Fund and Private Markets servicing spanning Fund Accounting, Alternatives Middle Office and Investor Services. Reporting to the Alternatives EMEA & APAC COO, this role will strengthen end-to-end ownership across the two locations and position the platform for scalable, well-controlled growth. The successful candidate will bring strong executive presence, strategic judgment, operational depth and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across a complex global organization. This leader will be expected to operate with clarity, pace and discipline while leading a sizeable, multi-disciplinary operations platform through continued growth, transformation and change.

Why this role is important to us

This is a critical senior leadership appointment within State Street’s AIS organization, accountable for unifying delivery across Singapore and Hong Kong, strengthening end-to-end ownership and positioning the platform for sustainable growth. The role will provide clear executive accountability for service quality, operational resilience, risk and control discipline, productivity, talent development and the delivery of consistent, high-quality outcomes for clients and stakeholders across both locations – supporting the integrated APAC operating model owned by the Alternative APAC COO.

What you will be responsible for

Critical business priorities:

Provide senior leadership for the Alts operations teams across Singapore and Hong Kong, covering both Hedge Fund and Private Markets servicing across Fund Accounting, Alternatives Middle Office and Investor Services.
Shape and execute a more integrated operating model across the two locations that strengthens end-to-end accountability, simplifies governance and supports scalable growth, aligned to the broader APAC operating model.
Collaborate with regional business and product leadership to advance strategic growth initiatives, support complex commercial opportunities and ensure operational capabilities effectively enable client acquisition, retention and sustainable revenue growth.
Lead strategic transformation across technology, process, data, controls and organizational design, with a clear focus on service excellence and long-term platform efficiency.
Own the delivery of complex daily operations – including NAV production, middle-office trade lifecycle and investor servicing – with robust oversight of vendor-supported activities, critical processes and client-impacting services.
Act as the senior escalation point for Singapore and Hong Kong on operational matters, strategic client priorities, service performance and new business readiness.
Strengthen the risk and control environment while driving productivity, operational discipline, simplification and continuous improvement, meeting regulatory expectations.
Build trusted partnerships across business, product, client service, technology, risk, finance and regional leadership teams – including State Street’s global operations hubs – to deliver shared priorities.
Maintain senior accountability for client experience, service governance, relationship engagement and timely resolution of client-impacting issues.
Apply strong APAC market and cultural awareness to lead effectively across both locations and promote an inclusive, collaborative and high-accountability environment.
Develop a deep, diverse and resilient leadership bench through deliberate talent development, succession planning and disciplined performance management.

As a Managing Director you will:

Champion differentiated client outcomes by aligning stakeholders, resolving complex issues and ensuring service delivery supports broader commercial and relationship priorities.
Ensure timely, accurate and well-controlled delivery of NAV calculations, financial reporting and investor reporting across relevant platforms and client mandates, spanning both Hedge and Private Markets.
Convert performance insights, client feedback and risk indicators into practical action plans with clear ownership, measurable outcomes and disciplined follow-through.
Maintain strong accountability for regulatory compliance, operational risk management, issue remediation and adherence to applicable policies, standards and control expectations.
Engage and influence senior global and regional stakeholders to align priorities, share best practices and advance a consistent, scalable and resilient operating model.
Lead business continuity planning and execution, ensuring operational resilience, governance discipline and readiness across both locations and critical services.
Identify and deliver transformation, automation, standardization and capacity-creation opportunities that improve productivity, control, transparency and client experience.
Lead a multi-location team through clear direction, strong communication, effective delegation, leadership development, employee engagement and succession planning.

What we value

The Managing Director will be expected to operate as a senior enterprise leader within AIS, bringing strategic judgment, commercial awareness, operational excellence, strong control discipline and a deep commitment to people leadership. We value leaders who can:

Navigate a large global organization with confidence, build trusted senior relationships and create an effective stakeholder network across business lines and functions.
Lead effectively in a matrixed environment by aligning stakeholders, managing competing priorities and resolving areas of complexity or contention with sound judgment.
Build, develop and inspire high-performing operations teams with a clear focus on accountability, engagement, inclusion and execution excellence.
Communicate with clarity and executive presence across clients, third parties, senior leaders, peers and large regional teams.
Lead and sponsor change management, transformation and operating model programs in complex, regulated and multi-location environments.
Execute with pace and discipline under challenging circumstances, maintaining focus on risk, quality, client outcomes and delivery commitments.
Coach, influence and collaborate across locations, including virtual teams, to drive shared ownership and enterprise-wide outcomes.
Demonstrate strong cultural intelligence and the ability to lead across the Singapore and Hong Kong markets with respect, openness and consistency.
Role-model inclusion, flexibility, integrity and respect when working with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and locations.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required; degree in finance, accounting, economics, business management or a related discipline preferred.
Excellent written and spoken English communication skills, with the ability to present complex matters clearly to senior audiences.
Strong interpersonal, influencing, negotiation and relationship management skills across senior stakeholders and complex client situations.
15+ years of financial services experience, including senior leadership of large-scale, multi-location operations teams.
Extensive experience managing and delivering fund accounting, financial reporting and/or alternative investment servicing capabilities across both Hedge Fund and Private Markets.
Proven business unit management experience, particularly with complex institutional clients requiring significant senior-level engagement.
Deep knowledge of the financial services industry, with strong understanding of investment management, private markets and alternative investment operations, including hedge fund and private markets fund structures and platforms such as Geneva, Investran and Paxus.
Familiarity with the APAC regulatory and market landscape (MAS, SFC, HKMA) and a broad range of alternative investment structures (BDCs, Interval Funds, ELTIFs, Variable Capital Companies (VCCs), etc.) would be an advantage.
CFA, CPA, MBA or equivalent professional qualification would be an advantage.

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: Client Manager
description:
01 Meet the studio.

MSQ Asia & Elmwood Singapore is our hybrid hub for Southeast Asia, where brand distinctiveness meets joined-up activation for greater impact.

MSQ is the world's most AI-enabled challenger group, with AI-powered human creativity at the heart of everything we do. We fuse the right mix of capabilities to unlock momentum for brands, connecting creative performance to business outcomes in real time. We have global specialists across creative, social and influencer, media and commerce, strategy & insights, CX & creative, tech, sports & entertainment, and AI products & data. This is MSQ's Joined-Up Thinking: the scale of a holding company with the agility of an independent.

Elmwood is our global brand and design capability, with almost 50 years of experience as one of the world's most effective brand and design agencies. With studios in London, New York, Singapore and Shanghai, we create brands that are more meaningful, more memorable and built to move faster than the market. Our work covers brand strategy and identity, packaging and experience design for clients across global personal care, food and beverage, financial services and technology. Elmwood is proud of its long track record at the DBA Design Effectiveness Awards, the longest-running awards for design that delivers measurable business results.

Requirements

02 Why this role matters.

The Account Manager is responsible for managing day-to-day client relationships and projects, translating client needs into clear briefs, and ensuring work is delivered on time, on budget and to an excellent standard, directly impacting client satisfaction, retention and account growth.

03 What you will be doing.

People & Team accountabilities:

Collaborate closely with Account Executives, aiding in their development while also managing smaller-scale projects or specific workstreams independently.
Encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing and feedback within project teams to build capability and improve how we work together.
Implement studio and network-wide strategies within your account teams, ensuring ways of working align with the one Elmwood vision and goals.
Manage team dynamics on your projects, holding people (including yourself) accountable for agreed actions, quality standards and timelines.

Work/offer accountabilities:

Oversee the daily delivery of client projects, making sure tasks are completed on time, meet requirements, and stay within budget.
Lead internal briefings, manage timelines, and coordinate estimates and contact reports, ensuring clarity for internal teams.
Work in partnership with cross-functional teams such as creative, strategy and production to monitor progress and manage deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.
Collaborate with creative and operations teams, as well as external partners, to ensure all work aligns with strategy and achieves the desired creative outcomes.
Track and evaluate project effectiveness with senior team members, helping to define success metrics and feeding learnings back into future work.
Advocate for internal systems, processes, and financial tools, ensuring we stick to budgets and timelines and support accurate reporting.
Document project insights and outcomes through post-project reviews (“washups”) to drive continuous improvement.

Client accountabilities:

Foster trust with client contacts through clear, professional communication, consistent follow-up, and well-managed expectations.
Act as a dependable point of contact for daily updates and issues on your accounts, with support from your senior team members where needed.
Assist in preparing for meetings, presentations and proposal writing, helping to shape compelling, on-brand responses.
Keep detailed records of client feedback, approvals and change requests to ensure alignment and avoid scope creep.
Manage key client relationships and day-to-day interactions, demonstrating a measurable impact on their business and identifying opportunities to grow and deepen the relationship.

Business accountabilities

Engage in weekly planning, resource and forecasting meetings to maintain transparency, accountability and visibility of pipeline and capacity.
Manage and meet specific business targets for your accounts in line with the studio business plan and Strategic Account Plans.
Build and manage the client revenue pipeline for your accounts, ensuring accurate forecasting, visibility and strong recoverability.
Support value-based pricing and project costing, using financial tools and data to manage scope, protect margins and escalate risks early.
Contribute to award entries, case studies and marketing initiatives that build Elmwood’s fame and reputation in the region.

04 What you know and bring.

The knowledge you'll need:

3–5 years of experience in a design, branding, or marketing agency in client servicing and/or project management roles.
Relevant experience in advertising agencies is a plus.
A background in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a similar field is preferred.
Solid understanding of brand and design processes, from briefing and strategy through to creative development and production.
Good commercial acumen, including familiarity with scopes of work, pricing models, budgets, forecasting and profitability drivers.
Proficient in project management, collaboration and file-sharing tools such as ClickUp, Pitch, LucidLink or similar. platforms.
AI fluency: confident using AI tools day to day to work smarter across briefing, planning, reporting and client communication. You're curious about how AI is changing agency workflows and keen to bring new ideas to the team.

The skills that'll set you apart

Proven ability to manage multiple projects and cross-functional teams simultaneously, balancing priorities and deadlines.
Keen attention to detail and accuracy across timings, budgets, documentation and deliverables.
Outstanding organisational and time management abilities, with a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.
Professional writing tone, style, and email etiquette, with the ability to communicate clearly and persuasively with clients and colleagues.
Strong eagerness to listen, learn, and grow in a dynamic, occasionally unstructured environment, bringing a genuine passion for creativity, innovation, and delivering exceptional work.
High sense of responsibility and commitment to the role, taking ownership of outcomes for your clients, projects and team.

Benefits

05 What we offer.

The work

The opportunity to work with leading global and regional brands across categories, shaping strategies and design that get seen and felt in the real world.

The people & culture

A fun studio environment working alongside great and talented individuals, with a collaborative, down-to-earth culture where craft, curiosity and generosity are valued.

Annual festivities and various social events throughout the year that bring the team together.

Growth & development

Access to learning, feedback and stretch opportunities across studios and disciplines, with support to shape a career that works for you.

Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Strategic thinker who is equally comfortable with data, strategy and execution.
Strong change leadership, communication and people-development skills.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building structure where needed.

title: Regional Strategy and Partnership Manager (Malaysia)
description:
Who We Are

title: Communications Executive
description:
*We're Hiring: Communications Executive (English & Mandarin Speaking)*

*Quintessential Education | Full-Time or Part-Time | Orchard Road, Singapore*

*About QE*

Quintessential Education is Singapore's leading provider of pre-tertiary academic programmes (IGCSE & IB) and university admissions advisory for top-tier global universities — Ivy League, Oxbridge, and NUS/NTU/SMU. Since 2012 we have worked with more than 700 students, and most of our new families come to us through referrals. We deliver a fully integrated journey for families: academic mastery, guardianship, and university placement under one roof.

We aim to bring out the best in our students, ignite opportunities and nurture them towards success.

We are looking for committed and talented additions to our team. As an ideal candidate, you should display a proven ability to develop and maintain an environment of trust, diversity, and inclusion within the QE team. You should be able to work with the team to meet deadlines and instill a culture of continuous work improvement.

As part of the position, you will work with the founders, Ivy League and Oxbridge graduates and other high-performing teammates.

*The Role*

We're looking for a Communications Executive to own the day-to-day relationship between QE and our families. You'll be the first person a parent speaks to when they enquire, and the person who keeps them informed once their child is with us. That means answering enquiries every day, matching students with the right tutors and mentors, and following up with students and parents regularly so nothing slips through.

You'll also help keep our marketing materials and partner relationships in good order. We are open to full-time or part-time candidates, so tell us the arrangement that works for you.

If you're a confident communicator in both *English and Mandarin\**, stay calm and warm with demanding parents, and like being the person who makes sure things actually get done — we'd love to meet you.

\*As a major group of customers are from China and are only able to converse in Mandarin.

*Key Responsibilities:*

*1. Enquiries & Enrolment*

* Respond to daily parent and student enquiries via phone, WhatsApp, WeChat, and email, ideally within the same working day.
* Explain our IGCSE, IB, and admissions programmes clearly and recommend the right fit for each student.
* Match students with suitable tutors and mentors, and arrange trial lessons and consultations.
* Track every enquiry through to enrolment and follow up with families who have not yet decided.

*2. Student Follow-Up & Parent Relations*

* Check in regularly with enrolled students and parents on progress, attendance, and any concerns.
* Collect lesson feedback from students and tutors, and deal with issues early before they become complaints.
* Arrange class schedules, replacement lessons, and changes with tutors and families.
* Keep parents informed ahead of key moments: exam periods, predicted grades, application deadlines, and results day.
* Follow up on renewals and next-stage programmes (e.g. IGCSE to IB, IB to university applications).

*3. Business Operations*

* Prepare and track invoices and payments.
* Draft and manage service agreements for clients and tutors.
* Keep client records, notes, and follow-up schedules up to date.
* Keep a simple monthly record of enquiries, enrolments, and renewals for the founders.

*4. Marketing & Partnerships*

* Keep brochures, website content, and newsletters accurate and up to date.
* Work with design and digital marketing agencies on campaigns and collateral.
* Support parent seminars and events, including Mandarin-language sessions with our China school partners.
* Maintain relationships with partner schools, education consultants, and collaborators.

*We're Looking For Someone Who:*

* Has experience in a client-facing role such as education, admissions, client services, or customer service. Fresh graduates with strong communication skills are welcome to apply.
* Has excellent verbal and written communication in English and Chinese. This is required as some Chinese customers can only communicate in Chinese. Japanese and Korean are a bonus as some customers only communicate in these languages.
* Is calm, warm, and professional with high-expectation parents, and comfortable handling difficult conversations.
* Is highly organised, follows up without being reminded, and keeps clear records.
* Can manage many families and a busy inbox at the same time without losing track of details.
* Is proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), Notion or Airtable, and marketing tools (Mailchimp, Canva).
* Is comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) and light automation to streamline workflows.

*Bonus If You:*

* Have experience in the education, tuition, or admissions sector.
* Know the IB, IGCSE, or university application process (UK, US, or Singapore).
* Are familiar with WeChat or Xiaohongshu.

*Working Hours*

*Location: *545 Orchard Road, #14-06/9, Singapore 238882. In Person role.

*Start Date: *As soon as possible

*Commitment: *Full-time or part-time. Propose the days and hours that suit you in your application.

* *Full-time: *5-day work week, Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, 4 days in office and 1 day remote
* *Part-time: *Days and hours by arrangement, with enough weekday cover to keep up with daily enquiries

*Salary & Benefits*

* *Monthly Salary: *$4,500 upwards for full-time, depending on experience; pro-rated for part-time
* *Bonuses: *Additional performance and team-based bonuses apply
* *Benefits Include: *$500 Specialist Stipend per annum (e.g. medical or mental health support), $100 Dental Stipend per annum, $500 Personal Development Stipend per annum (for courses, books, conferences, etc.)

*How to Apply*

Send your CV and a short paragraph on why you're interested in the role to hr@qeducation.sg with the subject line: *Application – Communications Executive (Full Time / Part Time)*

We look forward to hearing from people who want to make a real difference to the families we work with.

Work Location: In person

description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Programme and Project Management

Plan and coordinate SIFAS programmes, workshops, performances, festivals and special events from concept to completion.

Develop project timelines, schedules, briefs, checklists and supporting documentation to ensure smooth execution.

Coordinate internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of programmes and projects.

Support programme proposals, budgeting, approvals and post-event reporting.

Support the planning and execution of SIFAS Productions, concerts, festivals and other artistic projects.

Coordinate with local and international artists, production teams, venues and vendors on contracts, schedules, hospitality and logistical requirements.

Manage event-day operations, including guest management, programme flow and on-ground coordination.

Prepare run sheets, emcee scripts, guest lists, briefing notes and other event materials.

Develop and implement marketing and communications plans for SIFAS programmes, productions and institutional initiatives.

Create and coordinate content for social media, websites, newsletters, EDMs, invitations, press materials and promotional collateral.

Manage content across SIFAS’ digital platforms and support ticketing, audience development and promotional campaigns.

Work with designers, photographers, videographers and external vendors to produce marketing and creative assets.

4. Media and Publicity

Develop publicity angles and media plans to promote key programmes and institutional initiatives.

Draft press releases, media pitches, invitations, programme information and briefing materials.

Liaise with media representatives, journalists and communications partners.

Coordinate media visits, interviews, photography and publicity opportunities.

5. Stakeholder Engagement and Partnerships

Liaise with artists, government agencies, arts organisations, educational institutions, community partners, sponsors and donors.

Support partnerships, collaborations and external engagements that advance SIFAS’ programmes and objectives.

Coordinate official correspondence, invitations and stakeholder communications, ensuring timely follow-up.

Support budget preparation, quotations, contracts, invoices and vendor coordination.

Monitor programme expenditure, project timelines and deliverables.

Maintain accurate project documentation, records and administrative reports.

Singapore Indian Fine Arts Society is one of the premier and longest serving society promoting the

teaching and appreciation of the Indian Fine Arts society since May 1949 in Singapore. The Academy

housed by the Society, offers 15 disciplines in Hindustani and Carnatic music, Bharatanatyam, Kathak

and Kuchipudi dance styles, and visual arts. Currently there are 28 resident teachers. The society offers 8

year programs leading up to a Diploma and Visharadh title designed for music and dance.

The society is a registered charity, and is run by an elected volunteer committee of 15 members. The

Society has some 1600 ordinary members, 275 life members and over 2000 students.

title: B2B Marketing Sales Account Manager (Remote)
description:
Job Description

About Us

We help interior design and renovation firms in Singapore grow — through lead generation, branding, and marketing programmes that bring them qualified homeowners and stronger market positioning. Our clients don't just buy a service from us once; they grow with us across tiers as their firms scale. That only works when someone closes the right clients — and then owns the relationship after the first close.

That someone is you.

About the Role

This is a fully remote role.

You'll work from wherever you work best — no daily commute, no office face-time. What matters is that your clients feel looked after and your accounts grow. You'll meet clients over video calls (with the occasional in-person session if a key relationship calls for it), and stay connected to the team through our daily rhythms online.

This is a closing role first, a relationship role always.

You'll start by building your own book of business: running sales conversations with interior design firms, diagnosing where their business is stuck, and closing them into the right programme. Every deal you close becomes an account you own — and from there, your job is to make each relationship deeper, longer, and more valuable over time.

The more you close early on, the bigger the portfolio you manage — and the more your recurring income compounds through renewals, tier upgrades, and referrals. You are the person our clients trust from the very first call, the one who checks in before they have to ask, and the reason they sign, renew, upgrade, and refer.

What You'll Do

Run discovery and sales calls with interior design and renovation firms — diagnosing their growth bottlenecks and closing them into the programme that fits

Manage your own sales pipeline end to end: qualification, follow-ups, objection handling, and closing, with clear monthly targets

Own every account you close as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor

Run regular check-ins and performance reviews with clients — walking them through their results, diagnosing bottlenecks, and recommending next steps

Drive renewals by ensuring clients see and understand the value they're getting throughout the programme, not just at renewal time

Identify and develop expansion opportunities — helping clients climb to higher programme tiers when their business is ready for it

Generate referrals naturally by building the kind of relationship people recommend to their peers

Work with our internal teams to resolve client issues quickly and keep promises made during the sales process

Maintain accurate account records, follow-up rhythms, and relationship health tracking in our CRM

Who You Are

2+ years in B2B sales, account management, or client success — with a track record of hitting sales targets and closing deals

A closer who thinks long-term: you know how to drive a deal to a decision, but you close clients you can grow, not just deals you can win

A natural relationship builder — the close is the start of the relationship, not the end of it

Consistent with follow-through: you do what you say, on time, every time

A clear communicator who can explain performance data and business concepts simply, in person and in writing

Commercially sharp — you can spot an upsell or referral opportunity without making the client feel sold to

Organised and self-directed: you manage your own portfolio, pipeline of renewals, and follow-up cadence

Proven ability to work independently in a remote setup — you stay responsive, structured, and visible without anyone looking over your shoulder

Bonus: experience in or exposure to the interior design, renovation, real estate, or home services industry

Why Join Us

100% remote

— you're measured on client outcomes, not hours at a desk

Base salary + commissions on every deal you close, plus recurring incentives on retention, renewals, and account growth — your income compounds as your portfolio grows

Build your own book of business from day one, backed by proven sales scripts, frameworks, and playbooks — you close it, you keep it, you grow it

Clear frameworks, playbooks, and training on how we sell, manage, and grow accounts

A front-row seat to how design and renovation businesses in Singapore scale

To Apply

Reach out directly to our Head of Sales, Nigel:

WhatsApp: +65 9061 4389

Only candidates who reach out via WhatsApp will be contacted — a short intro message telling us who you are and why this role fits you is all it takes to start the conversation.

Founded with a focus on results, we work closely with interior design professionals across Singapore to deliver marketing solutions that are measurable, scalable, and built around the needs of a competitive market. Our platform is designed to reduce the time and cost of client acquisition for interior design firms, allowing them to focus on what they do best — delivering exceptional spaces.
