title: Integrated Marketing Manager CFD/Financial Industry
description:
About Hytech

Hytech is a leading management consulting firm headquartered in Australia and Singapore, specialising in digital transformation for fintech and financial services organisations. The company delivers end-to-end consulting services and robust middle- and back-office solutions, enabling clients to optimise operations, enhance efficiency, and stay ahead in a fast-evolving digital landscape. Hytech’s client portfolio includes top global trading platforms and leading crypto exchanges.

Hytech applies AI and data-driven approaches to real-world financial use cases, including risk management, process optimization, and decision support, with a focus on delivering practical impact. With more than 2,000 professionals worldwide, Hytech has a strong and growing international presence, with offices across Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, Taiwan, the Philippines, Thailand, Morocco, Cyprus, Dubai, and beyond.

Job Responsibilities

- Formulate and execute integrated marketing strategies:
- Develop the company’s global integrated marketing strategy and annual marketing plan aligned with corporate strategy and business objectives.
- Leverage CFD and financial industry trends, product iteration cycles, and regional market characteristics to integrate multi-channel resources (social media, content, KOLs, events, advertising, PR).
- Deliver differentiated, actionable integrated marketing solutions and take end-to-end ownership of execution performance to drive core KPIs: brand exposure, user acquisition, product conversion, and user retention.

- Team management & delivery of business goals:
- Build, manage, and develop the integrated marketing team.
- Define team objectives, performance metrics, and collaboration frameworks.
- Allocate projects and human resources rationally, track execution progress and deliverable quality, continuously upgrade team capabilities and operational efficiency, and ensure all marketing targets are delivered on schedule.

- Omnichannel marketing orchestration:
- Oversee content operations, social media operations, paid advertising, and related teams.
- Plan marketing content and publishing cadence for social media ecosystems (Twitter/X, Facebook, LinkedIn, Telegram, etc.) and content channels (official website, blogs, industry media, etc.) to guarantee consistent messaging and unified brand identity across touchpoints.
- Continuously optimize paid promotion strategies for Google and social media ads to drive synergistic growth of paid and organic traffic and improve overall marketing ROI.

- Regional & global campaign leadership:
- Lead end-to-end planning and delivery of flagship global marketing initiatives, including new product launches, trading competitions, user incentive programmes, webinars, market analysis livestreams, and financial summit partnerships.
- Own goal-setting, solution breakdown, resource allocation, cross-functional alignment (Product, Tech, Compliance, Design, etc.), execution, and post-campaign reviews.
- Manage project timelines, compliance standards, and communication outcomes to build high-impact industry-level marketing milestones.

- KOL & partnership ecosystem management:
- Manage global CFD and financial industry KOLs, investment thought leaders, industry media, community influencers, and partner resources.
- Establish and sustain long-term cooperative relationships.
- Define KOL and media collaboration strategies to advance media placements, co-created content, and cross-industry partnerships.
- Expand marketing reach, strengthen brand credibility and global footprint, measure partnership performance, refine cooperation frameworks, and control partnership costs.

- Marketing budget & data governance:
- Plan, allocate, and control annual and project-level integrated marketing budgets.
- Build marketing data tracking and performance evaluation mechanisms.
- Monitor key metrics such as impressions, click-through rates, conversion rates, user acquisition volume, CAC, ROI, and user retention.
- Produce regular marketing analysis and review reports for senior management.
- Adjust marketing strategies, channel mix, and resource investment based on data insights and business feedback to lift marketing efficiency continuously.

- Brand & public sentiment management:
- Collaborate with the brand team to articulate core brand values and tone and safeguard the company’s global brand image.
- Monitor financial industry developments and brand-related public sentiment.
- Implement early-warning and contingency protocols for public-opinion risks, identify and mitigate negative exposure proactively.
- Coordinate with leadership and relevant teams to resolve public-opinion incidents and preserve brand reputation and user trust.

- Cross-functional & cross-region collaboration:
- Act as the key owner for integrated marketing work, maintain high-efficiency collaboration with Product, Sales, Operations, Tech, Compliance, Design, and other teams.
- Align marketing requirements and resource allocation across regional markets.
- Enable localised adaptation of headquarters-level strategies in regional markets, and ensure marketing priorities remain aligned with corporate business goals.

Job Requirements

- Education & professional background:
- Bachelor’s degree or above; majors in Marketing, Advertising, Public Relations, International Business, Finance or related fields are preferred.
- 5-8 years of relevant integrated marketing experience; must have CFD or financial industry exposure, plus minimum 3 years of people-management experience.
- Solid understanding of CFD business models, financial product attributes, target audience profiles, and industry go-to-market logic.

- Strategic & professional marketing capabilities:
- Proven track record in integrated marketing strategy formulation, campaign design, execution governance, and post-mortem analysis.
- Capable of building global marketing strategies derived from business objectives, with verifiable end-to-end global campaign delivery experience.
- Deep familiarity with core CFD/financial marketing channels: social media, KOLs, industry media, paid advertising, and partner channels; able to foster multi-channel synergistic growth.

- Team & project management competencies:
- Strong leadership and people-management skills, with hands-on experience in team building, talent development, performance management, and cross-regional team collaboration.
- Robust project orchestration and resource prioritisation skills; capable of running multiple concurrent marketing projects and aligning Product, Sales, Operations, Tech, Compliance, Design stakeholders to ensure smooth roll-out of marketing initiatives.

- Data-driven & commercial acumen:
- Strong capabilities in data analysis, budget planning, cost control, and commercial judgment.
- Evaluate channel and project performance against core marketing metrics, allocate resources rationally, and take accountability for marketing ROI and business outcomes.

- Global mindset & compliance awareness:
- Global perspective with awareness of cross-cultural nuances, local market dynamics, and financial regulatory frameworks across geographies.
- English as a working language with fluent written and verbal communication skills; capable of independently engaging overseas stakeholders and drafting English-language marketing materials.
- High compliance awareness to enforce compliance standards for marketing content and events and mitigate regulatory risks.

- Personal attributes:
- Strong sense of responsibility, goal orientation, decision-making, communication, coordination, and stress tolerance.
- Thrive in the fast-paced, dynamic financial industry environment.
- Demonstrated learning agility, problem-solving skills, and innovative thinking, with genuine passion for CFD and financial sector business.

- Nice-to-have:
- Hands-on experience in overseas-market integrated marketing and localised team management.
- Successful track record of designing and launching CFD/financial industry marketing campaigns.
- Established network of financial sector KOLs, media contacts, and industry partners.
- Multilingual proficiency.

title: Client Partner – Global Brands APAC
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

You own brand revenue. This is a hunter role. You will own a portfolio of global brand advertisers across APAC — winning new spend, reactivating lapsed or dormant accounts, and expanding existing partnerships. You are the commercial owner for your book of business: strategy, relationships, pipeline, and revenue.
You will work as a trusted advisor to brand marketers and their agency partners, building consultative, insight-led programs that put X at the center of both brand and performance plans. You will work as a peer with the Agency Development and X Cross Functional Teams — close partnership, distinct ownership. This role reports to the Head of Global Brands, APAC.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own and grow revenue across an assigned Global Brands portfolio in APAC. Hit and exceed quarterly and annual targets through new business, expansion, renewals, and reactivation.
Hunt. Build a disciplined pipeline of net-new and returning advertisers. Prioritize client reactivation — bringing lapsed and under-invested global brands back onto the platform with a clear commercial plan.
Establish and deepen relationships with marketing decision-makers at global brands and with the agencies that plan and buy for them (media, creative, social, and holding-company stakeholders).
Build and deliver consultative sales presentations, QBRs, and joint business plans that connect client objectives to X's advertising products, audiences, and measurement — in rooms from brand manager to CMO.
Help advertisers design, launch, and optimize campaigns; measure results; and convert proof into larger, more sustained commitments.
Partner with agencies without outsourcing the sale. You own the client outcome even when the buy sits with a holding company or local shop.
Bring market fluency. Know how decisions get made in Singapore, Jakarta, Bangkok, Ho Chi Minh City, Manila, Kuala Lumpur, Mumbai, and Delhi — and adjust the motion accordingly.
Partner tightly with Agency Development, Client Solutions, Marketing, Content Parternships and regional market teams to remove friction and create incremental revenue.
Stay fluent in the evolving social and digital landscape, X product developments, and competitor activity so you can lead the conversation — not follow it.
Represent X at client meetings, industry events, and in-market reviews across SEA and India.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
Driven, commercially hungry, and comfortable being measured on revenue. Hunter mentality is non-negotiable.
7–10+ years in digital ad sales, ad tech, or martech, with a proven record of growing a book of business against quota.
Deep working knowledge of both the SEA and India advertising markets — how brands plan, how agencies buy, and where decisions actually get made. You have sold in these markets, not just visited them. Relationships may be stronger in one market; fluency must cover both.
Existing, active relationships with global brand clients and their agencies across SEA and India. You can open doors in week one.
Strong presentation and storytelling skills. You can hold a room with a CMO, a regional marketing director, and a working-level planner — and leave with a next step.
Experience reactivating dormant, paused, or under-penetrated clients is strongly preferred. You know how to diagnose why spend left and how to win it back.
Experience working both direct-to-brand and through agency structures.
Self-directed, organized, and effective in a small, high-output team. You do not wait to be told what to sell next.
Willingness to travel approximately 30% of the time across Southeast Asia and India.
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Prior platform, publisher, social, ad tech, or martech sales experience.
Fluency across brand and performance buying.
Additional SEA or Hindi language capability.
Experience with joint business plans, annual commitments, or multi-market brand coordination.

title: Senior Vice President, Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement
description:
Senior Vice President, Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement

Global | Permanent

About Citco

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 50 office locations worldwide. With more than $1.8 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.

For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com

About the Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

Strategic Operations is a dedicated function within Private Assets. It brings transformation delivery, project execution, business analysis, operational initiatives and implementation support into one team, reducing the delivery burden on BAU Operations and maintaining ownership from design through adoption.

The group will be split across three distinct focus areas, aligned under two individual leaders:

Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions: led by the Operating Model & Product leader, this area will define how services should run end to end, shape scalable products and solutions, support complex client implementations, and ensure client commitments are operationally deliverable.

Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement: led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will define Operations requirements for data, reporting and platforms, strengthen data quality and lineage, and carry solutions through testing, deployment and adoption.

Digital Workflow, Automation & AI: also led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will identify and deliver workflow, automation and AI opportunities, establish appropriate controls, and measure whether the expected benefits are realised.

The group works in close partnership with Operations, the Transformation Office, IT, Tactical Operations and Marquee Client teams. Roles may be permanent or approximately 12-month rotational assignments anchored in strategic locations. Rotational colleagues will join from the business, help shape and deliver change, and return to the line with broader project experience.

Your Role

You will lead the Operations data, reporting and platform agenda for Private Assets — setting requirements with IT and the Transformation Office, and delivering alongside them.

Own the Operations view of the data and reporting roadmap, including data quality, lineage, ownership and reporting capability.

Set out Operations’ requirements with IT and the Transformation Office, then deliver alongside them rather than handing over.

Lead platform enablement work — ensuring platform change is specified, tested and adopted with Operations in the room throughout.

Establish reporting standards and reusable data products rather than one-off extracts.

Provide the data and evidence base that other focus areas rely on to quantify a problem and measure a benefit.

Coordinate across Operations, IT, the Transformation Office, Tactical Operations and Data Services.

Lead and mentor focus area resources, including rotational colleagues joining from the business.

Report on progress, risks, dependencies and benefits realisation to the relevant leader and senior stakeholders.

About You

You have 12–15 years’ experience in private assets or a comparable financial services environment, with substantial exposure to data and platform initiatives.

Proven delivery of data, reporting or platform programmes, including requirements definition and UAT ownership.

Strong technical knowledge of private assets accounting and operations, and of the data those processes produce and consume.

Practical understanding of data models, lineage, controls and reporting architecture.

Credibility with technology partners — able to challenge a design and hold a delivery date.

Strong leadership skills and supervisory experience of other professionals, including rotational colleagues joining from the business.

Skilled in business planning, budgeting and stakeholder negotiation.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and SharePoint).

description:
If you desire to be part of something special, to be part of a winning team, to be part of a fun team – winning is fun. In Eaton, making our work exciting, engaging, meaningful; ensuring safety, health, wellness; and being a model of inclusion & diversity are already embedded in who we are - it’s in our values, part of our vision, and our clearly defined aspirational goals.

• Define, plan, and implement the APAC regional sales strategy to meet business objectives.

• Drive sales effectiveness through technical and commercial training, knowledge sharing, and cross-collaboration.
• Serve as a trusted advisor and advocate for electrical system health and thermal monitoring solutions.

Qualifications:

Education
• Master degree in electrical engineering, industrial engineering, computer science, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent degree-level experience.

Experience
• At least 10 years of experience in business development, sales, or technical product marketing.
• Experience in technical or commercial marketing and sales into industrial markets, ideally within electrification or power systems.
• Experience in heavy industry and/or critical infrastructure markets such as logistics centers, new energy, battery energy storage systems, airports, or hospitals.

• Strategic sales planning, regional market development, and business development.
• Customer relationship management and value-based solution selling.
• Market analysis, forecasting, and competitive assessment.
• Channel, OEM, installer, and service partner development.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional relevant regional language capability preferred.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and customer relationship management systems, ideally HubSpot.
• Ability to identify improvement opportunities across own and adjacent functional areas.

Leadership Behaviors
• Collaborative team player with the ability to work independently when needed.
• Agile, confident, thoughtful, and open to bringing forward new ideas.
• Well organized, with the ability to plan workload and meet deadlines.
• Able to deliver projects to defined timescales.
• Detail-oriented, proactive, and collaborative.

description:
Job Title

AVP, Business Proposition, Protection, Global

Job Description

The Role

The AVP, Business Proposition role plays an important role within the Protection business. To be successful in this role, the incumbent will be able to demonstrate long term and “out of the box” thinking to develop compelling solutions to market problems that will ultimately expand our proposition set and support us generating material volumes of highly valuable business in areas we currently do not operate.

This role would see strategic initiatives through end-to-end, working with others in the Global Client Solutions team and wider Protection teams. This role will also work closely with the Divisional Strategy team and will dotted line report into the VP, Strategy, Division, and will join Divisional Strategy meetings.

This role will be expected to collaborate closely with the Client Solutions market teams, and will be a conduit for global idea generation and sharing. Additionally, this role will also require a close working partnership with UnderwriteMe, ensuring where appropriate our UnderwriteMe differentiators are being leveraged in our propositions.

Responsibilities

New market/segments exploration:

Periodic initiation and review of new markets/segments working with relevant in-market Client Solutions Teams

Development of initial stage gates and fail fast criteria, working closely with relevant Protection teams, before eventually passing ownership to the most appropriate BAU market team once relevant stage gates are met

Product/Proposition development:

Leading global product / propositions which are typically large-scale cross market opportunities

Acting as a conduit for the function in Protection to leverage product work being performed in each market and ensure a global mindset is being adopted

From time to time developing ideas and material to support client workshops or pitches, to ensure that the best of our global business is being leveraged

Protection Strategy:

Facilitating periodic review of market strategies for Protection, which will require working closely with the Client Solutions teams in each of our markets and PMLCs

Supporting consistency of approach to strategy across the Line of Business and UMe where appropriate, including providing relevant tools and templates

Identifying opportunities to leverage projects across markets, including DISC initiatives

Divisional Strategy:

Working with the Divisional Strategy team on global or cross Line of Business initiatives

Attending relevant Divisional Strategy team meetings, including leveraging expertise across the business and ensuring consistency where appropriate

Together with the VP, Client Solutions, Protection, Global, providing Chief of Staff type support to the GPEC, including:

Supporting the development and review of strategic objectives

Supporting the reporting of strategic objectives and other initiatives, including in staff meetings and other forums

Working with PMLCs as appropriate to report on progress with strategic initiatives

Essential Qualifications & Experience

Knowledge

Educated to at least degree level preferably with actuarial or other similar training

Proven experience working in a life (re)insurer, preferably in a pricing or client solutions department at a senior level

Leadership Skills

Proven track record in developing strategies and seeing them through to successful execution

Very strong communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills, and ability to deliver difficult/challenging messages

Ability to quickly cut through detail and focus on what is important, being decisive and accountable

Commercial Judgement

Strong analytical skills combined with sound judgement and commercial awareness

Proven ability to “think outside the box” to derive new and innovative approaches to underwriting and/or claims problems

Ability and desire to communicate with business customers at all levels across the business and to work well within a team environment

Organised, conscientious, and deadline focused with an attention to detail

Ability to manage competing demands and deal with non-standard and unstructured requests, at short notice

Motivated to take ownership of work and to seek further responsibility

Desirable Experience

Previous experience working in a life and disability reinsurance environment is preferred

Proficiency extracting, manipulating, analysing and drawing conclusions from data.

Risk Management Responsibilities

The AVP, Business Proposition role is responsible for ensuring a strong risk culture exists within the global enablement team. The key risk management responsibilities include:

Demonstrating awareness and understanding of risk policies, key risks and associated controls;

Translating risk management principles and objectives into priorities, processes and activities that make sense to team members;

Fostering a culture of risk management in the team through training and performance management.

Taking a pro-active approach to identifying, fixing and learning from control failures.

Where relevant, report and effectively manage issues and/or loss events as they arise.

Being particularly cognisant of risks involved in new propositions

Working For Pacific Life Re

Every person in our global team is valued for the unique qualities they bring to our business and we seek to build their expertise and support their individual ambitions at every step. Of course, we take our work seriously and we know our team can operate under great pressure. We work hard and thrive on achievement, but we also know how to have fun and relax too. We regularly host a range of team building days to strengthen our team's connection with each other and reflect on their successes.

Providing employees with a healthy work-life balance is very important to our culture. We have a wide range of employee benefits and we host regular social activities and well being initiatives. We are also committed to supporting our employee's involvement in their communities, by actively fundraising, hosting charity events and overseeing volunteering opportunities.

23 days of annual leave with option to buy/sell more days

Adoption and fertility leave

Generous enhanced parental leave

• Be the trusted partner to senior client stakeholders: From day-to-day engagement to executive business reviews, you'll act as a strategic advisor, communicating performance, managing risks, and strengthening client partnership at every level.
• Lead and develop a regional team of 80: You'll coach, develop, and inspire a geographically dispersed, multicultural team, building capability, managing succession, and creating a high-performance culture across borders.
• Drive digital transformation and innovation: You'll champion the adoption of AI tools, smart building technologies, automation, and data analytics, leading change management to embed new ways of working across teams and vendors.
• Manage financial and commercial performance: From budgeting and forecasting to vendor governance and supply chain spending, you'll support financial targets and identify savings opportunities that deliver value for the client.
• Lead on risk, compliance, and governance: You'll own Health & Safety, engineering risk programmes, audit readiness, and incident reporting — fostering a risk-aware culture across all sites and service lines.
• Shape and execute the regional strategy: Working closely with the Regional Account Executive, you'll translate client priorities into operational action, driving consistency, best practice, and continuous improvement across the entire APAC (including GC exc. West Asia).

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Client & Operational Leadership
• Partner with the Regional Account Executive to maintain strong engagement with client stakeholders and ensure alignment between operational delivery and client business priorities.
• Lead the execution of the regional operational strategy and service delivery across the APAC (including GC exc. West Asia) portfolio.
• Drive a culture of service excellence, continuous improvement, and accountability across all sites and teams.
• Ensure delivery of contractual obligations, including achievement of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Joint Business Plan priorities, and Partnership Incentive Fund (PIF) objectives.
• Partner with Workplace Experience, Projects, Real Estate, Engineering, Risk, and other service line teams to ensure integrated and seamless service delivery.
• Oversee operational governance, reporting, systems, and data integrity to ensure compliance, consistency, and effective decision-making across the portfolio.
• Partner with Workplace Experience, Projects, Engineering, Real Estate, Risk & Compliance, and other service lines to deliver integrated workplace solutions and positive employee experience outcomes.
• Monitor Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM) programs to ensure compliance with local regulations, client standards, and JLL operational requirements.
• Ensuring robust business continuity, crisis management, and emergency response procedures are implemented, maintained, and regularly communicated across all sites.
• Accountable for the regional success of the "autonomous operations" model (EPIC), including delivery, performance, and outcomes.

Digital and Innovation Leadership
• Drive operational innovation and digital transformation initiatives across the portfolio, leveraging technology, automation, AI-enabled tools, smart building solutions, and data-driven insights to improve operational efficiency, service quality, scalability, reporting, and employee experience.
• Partner with account leadership, technology teams, and service line leaders to strengthen digital adoption, operational analytics, and technology-enabled decision-making across the portfolio.
• Lead adoption and change management initiatives related to operational technologies, digital workflows, analytics platforms, and AI-enabled capabilities across regional teams and vendors.

Financial & Commercial Management
• Support the Regional Account Executive in achieving financial targets, operational efficiencies, savings initiatives, and commercial objectives across the portfolio.
• Oversee regional budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and operational expenditure management.
• Provide governance oversight of vendor performance, supply chain expenditure, and commercial compliance activities, including contract changes and service performance management.
People Leadership & Talent Development
• Lead, Inspire and develop a regional team of 80 employees across geographically dispersed and multicultural sites, fostering a high-performance, inclusive, and accountable culture.
• Directly manage the professional development of all direct reports, providing regular coaching, feedback and career growth opportunities aligned to JLL’s talent framework. Ensure team members have clear objectives, professional development plans and participate in training and continuous learning activities.
• Prepare and maintain a robust Succession Plan for the account, identifying and developing high-potential talent to ensure business continuity and pipeline readiness in partnership with HR.
• Champion employee engagement and wellbeing across the regional team, modelling JLL behaviours for the team.
• Manage team resourcing and workload allocation to support effective and sustainable operations.
• Participate in remuneration and talent review processes as required.

Risk, Compliance & Governance
• Promote a strong risk-aware culture across the account and ensure compliance with client, local regulatory, and JLL Health, Safety, Environment, and Risk Management standards.
• Be accountable for regional Health & Safety and Engineering/Design/Risk program and its deliverables.
• Ensure all incidents are reported and managed in accordance with client and JLL procedures.
• Oversee operational risk mitigation activities and ensure appropriate escalation processes are in place across the region.
• Support audit readiness and ensure operational compliance documentation is maintained and accessible.
• Partner with internal risk, compliance, and safety teams to continuously strengthen governance standards and operational resilience.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management
• Act as a trusted advisor and operational partner to senior client stakeholders and internal leadership teams.
• Promote open, constructive, and collaborative relationships across client teams, JLL functions, and external vendors.
• Communicate operational priorities, performance outcomes, risks, and improvement initiatives clearly and effectively.
• Lead by example in demonstrating JLL values, ethical standards, professionalism, and inclusive leadership behaviours.
• Drive operational transformation and innovation initiatives that improve workplace experience, sustainability outcomes, and service efficiency across the portfolio.

Key Performance Measures
Performance will be measured through achievement of:
• Contractual KPIs
• Client satisfaction and employee experience outcomes
• Financial performance, budget management, and savings targets
• Operational consistency and service quality
• Compliance, audit, and safety performance
• Adoption and successful implementation of operational technology and innovation initiatives
• Improvement in operational efficiency, automation, reporting quality, or digital maturity outcomes
• Sustainability and operational efficiency objectives
• Timely and accurate operational and financial reporting
• Team engagement, capability development, and retention

Key Stakeholders
• Regional Account Executive
• Client Regional Leadership and Governance Teams
• Country internal Workplace Experience Teams and client-side leadership
• Engineering Operations and EOS Teams
• Projects and Real Estate Teams
• Finance, Procurement, HR, and Risk Functions
• External Vendors and Service Providers

Skills & Experience
• Strong leadership capability with experience managing geographically dispersed and multicultural teams across APAC & Greater China.
• Strong operational, commercial, and financial management skills.
• Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and clients.
• Experience leading or supporting digital transformation, operational technology adoption, automation initiatives, or data-driven operational improvement programs within facilities management, workplace operations, or corporate real estate environments.
• Demonstrated ability to leverage data, analytics, and technology insights to support operational decision-making, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capability.
• Strong communication and presentation skills, with fluency in English required.
• Additional APAC regional language capability is advantageous.
• Demonstrated ability to lead change, continuous improvement, and operational transformation initiatives.
• Resilient and adaptable in fast-paced and evolving operational environments.
• Strong digital, systems, and data literacy, including workplace technologies, operational reporting platforms, and analytics tools.
• Ability to balance strategic priorities with operational execution.

Competencies
• Leadership: Sets clear objectives and measurable outcomes for teams and stakeholders. Motivates and develops teams to achieve operational excellence and client outcomes. Demonstrates ethical leadership and accountability consistent with JLL values and standards.
• Decision Making: Applies sound judgment and data-driven thinking to resolve complex operational and commercial challenges.
•Communication: Builds trusted relationships and communicates effectively with stakeholders across all organizational levels.
• Strategic Thinking: Leverages data, technology, and commercial insight to improve operational outcomes and support transformation initiatives.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Facilities Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline preferred.
• 10+ years of progressive experience in facilities management, workplace operations, property management, or integrated facilities services.
• Experience leading operational transformation initiatives involving workplace technology, automation, smart building systems, AI-enabled solutions, or digital FM platforms preferred.
• Experience leading and working as part of complex, multi-country multi-service corporate accounts across APAC & Greater China.
• Experience managing large-scale operational teams, vendors, and client stakeholder relationships in a regional environment preferred.
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.

About JLL –

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: VP, International Desk Manager
description:

title: Network Operations & Partnerships Manager
description:
Company Description:

Publicis Groupe is not just a company you work for; it’s a platform for you to take your talent to the world.

If you want to help change the world, ideas alone are not enough. Real impact can only come from having meaningful access to a world of knowledge, people and resources. At Publicis Groupe, you are connected to our global network, intelligence, tools, clients, brands and 80,000 brilliant minds with expertise in data, technology, media, strategy, creativity and business transformation, all literally at your fingertips.

Go ahead, the world is waiting.

Publicis Groupe is the third largest communications group in the world. Founded in Paris in 1926, we are present in more than 100 countries as leaders in marketing, communication, and digital business transformation. Two of its biggest solution hubs in Singapore - Publicis Communications and Publicis Media & Digital.

Publicis Communications, the creative communications hub of the Publicis Groupe, is a collective of the most passionate, purposeful, and progressive creative agencies in Singapore. They are Publicis Worldwide, Leo Burnett, Saatchi & Saatchi, Prodigious, and MSL.

Publicis Media & Digital, which is comprised of global media agency brands Starcom, Zenith, Spark Foundry, and Performics, is powered by digital-first, data-driven global practices that together, help our clients navigate the modern media landscape.

Our two other solution hubs, Publicis Sapient and Publicis Commerce, empower businesses to embrace digital transformation and equip them with a total commerce experience.

Overview:

We are seeking a highly organised and commercially minded Network Operations & Partnerships Manager to connect the Singapore Hub Team across the APAC network and priority regional and global media partners. The role has two primary components: driving disciplined network operations across APAC and building strategic partner relationships that unlock innovation, capability and growth for the account.

Working across global, regional and local stakeholders, this role will translate global direction into consistent market execution, maintain visibility of staffing, finance and operational requirements, and ensure emerging platform opportunities are incorporated into relevant client campaigns. The role will also co-manage the agency test-and-learn roadmap, partnering with pillar leads and market teams to move new capabilities from opportunity to application.

Key Responsibilities:

APAC Network Operations & Governance

Act as the central operational link between the Singapore Hub, APAC local markets and global teams, enabling clear communication, visibility and accountability across the network.
Maintain current market organisation charts, FTE staffing plans and resource views, working with local leadership to update team and capability changes.
Translate global planning principles, governance requirements and communications into clear regional actions, ensuring consistent understanding and adoption across markets.
Coordinate and track recurring market inputs, including timesheets, finance submissions, media reconciliation and other operational or financial reporting requirements.
Partner with finance, account leadership and local teams to improve the accuracy, timeliness and transparency of market submissions and reconciliations.
Consolidate network updates for business reviews and leadership forums, highlighting operational performance, resourcing, financial status, risks and recommended actions.
Manage and maintain new joiner onboarding materials, ensuring resources, process guidance, contact information and training content remain current, accessible and aligned with account ways of working.
Coordinate end-to-end access and onboarding for Publicis internal platforms and relevant media platforms, working with internal teams and partners to ensure new joiners receive the required permissions, tools and training in a timely manner.
Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, standardise ways of working and strengthen operational controls across the APEC network.

Media Partnerships, Innovation & Test-and-Learn

Own and develop relationships with priority regional and global media partners, including Google, Meta, TikTok, Netflix and Amazon, alongside other relevant publishers, platforms and technology partners.
Establish a structured partner engagement plan covering regular business reviews, capability updates, training, thought leadership and access to alpha, beta and new-product opportunities.
Maintain a clear view of partner roadmaps and emerging capabilities, assessing their relevance to client’s business objectives, audiences, markets and upcoming campaigns.
Co-manage the agency test-and-learn roadmap, including opportunity identification, prioritisation, ownership, timelines, measurement approach, results and next-step recommendations.
Work closely with pillar leads, planners, activation teams and analytics specialists to ensure suitable alphas, betas and new products are considered and incorporated into upcoming campaign plans.
Build a reliable pipeline from partner opportunity to campaign activation, removing barriers, clarifying requirements and tracking progress through to learning and potential scale-up.
Partner with local markets to maintain an up-to-date view of key local media relationships, platforms, products and market developments.
Coordinate regular market sharing sessions with the Singapore Hub, with particular focus on Japan, Korea, India and Australia, to strengthen local market knowledge and surface transferable opportunities.
Create and maintain a central repository of partner updates, local market intelligence, case studies, test results and best practices that can inform future planning.
Represent the account in relevant partner and industry forums, bringing actionable insights and opportunities back to the wider client and agency team.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related discipline.
5+ years of experience in integrated media planning, media operations, regional account management, media partnerships, agency operations or a related role.
Experience working across regional or multi-market accounts, ideally within APAC and a media agency environment.
Strong understanding of media planning, activation, governance, financial operations and campaign reconciliation processes.
Demonstrated experience managing senior stakeholders and coordinating deliverables across global, regional and local teams.
Established knowledge of major media platforms and the digital media ecosystem; direct experience working with platform or publisher partners is highly advantageous.
Experience developing or managing innovation, experimentation or test-and-learn programmes, with the ability to connect new capabilities to business and campaign needs.
Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines and dependencies.
High attention to detail and confidence working with staffing, operational and financial data.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with workflow, reporting and collaboration tools is advantageous.

Skills & Competencies

Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills across cultures, seniority levels and disciplines.
Operational discipline, with the ability to create structure, maintain momentum and follow through on commitments.
Commercial and strategic curiosity, with the judgement to distinguish meaningful opportunities from short-term novelty.
Clear, confident communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to turn complex global or partner updates into practical actions.
Proactive, decisive and solutions-oriented, with the ability to identify risks early and support teams in resolving challenges.
Collaborative working style, balancing independent ownership with effective partnership across the wider account.

Experience in mentoring and managing a mid-sized team.

Skills & Competencies

Expertise in media planning and buying (digital and offline), with strong knowledge of APAC media landscape and regional nuances.
Experience in managing Luxury clients
Strong analytical skills to interpret data and drive insights. Proficiency in media analytics a plus.

Excellent client-facing communication skills, with the ability to manage cross-functional and cross-regional collaboration. Skilled at tailoring conversations to fit different client profiles.

description:

title: Senior Director of Orange Movement
description:
About the Orange Movement

Launched in 2022, the Orange Movement™ is a global initiative led by IIX Global to integrate gender equality and climate action into financial markets. At its core are Orange Bonds™ — the world's first gender-lens and climate-focused asset class — designed to.

Mobilize US$15 billion in capital markets by 2030

Positively impact 150 million women, girls, and gender minorities

Position women and gender minorities as leaders in climate resilience and adaptation

The Orange Movement advances this vision through capital mobilization, policy reform, global partnerships, training, and advocacy. With US$2 billion already mobilized and a new US$1 billion Orange Climate Fund anchoring a US$10 billion cooperation agreement with the Government of Indonesia, the Movement is entering a pivotal scale-up phase — with an active co-funder base, formalized governance infrastructure, and the Orange Forum as its flagship annual convening. IIX seeks a Senior Director who can build the Movement into an institution with the financial strength, governance maturity, and operating capability to stand on its own for the long term

Role Summary

The Senior Director of the Orange Movement will provide strategic vision, entrepreneurial drive, and organizational leadership to build the Movement into a durable, self-sustaining institution — expanding its reach, resources, and financial independence globally. This is a rare opportunity to take a coalition at the intersection of finance, gender, and climate from an IIX-incubated initiative to a mature institution with genuine systems-change potential.

This senior leadership role will:

Own and manage the Orange Movement program, working closely with IIX teams — including Sustainable Finance and the newly established Impact & ESG Advisory — as they execute Orange transactions and related projects.

Ensure the long-term financial sustainability of the Orange Movement through diversified, multi-year fundraising — spanning co-funders, grants, and catalytic capital.

Mature the coalition's governance infrastructure into a standard-setting model for stakeholder management, built to operate independently over time.

Spearhead co-funder cultivation, partnership pipeline development, and multi-year fundraising.

This position is ideal for a leader who combines deep networks across finance, philanthropy, and development with the entrepreneurial instincts to build lasting institutions — equally comfortable setting strategy and doing the hands-on work of standing up the operating backbone a growing coalition needs.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Partnerships & Global Alliances

Develop and execute a global strategy to expand the Orange Investor Alliance and Partner Coalition

Build and own a structured co-funder pipeline — from identification and cultivation through to close and stewardship

title: Sales Consultants (Remote)
description:
Job Description

About Us

We help interior design and renovation firms in Singapore grow — through lead generation, branding, and marketing programmes that bring them qualified homeowners and stronger market positioning. Our clients don't just buy a service from us once; they grow with us across tiers as their firms scale. That only works when someone closes the right clients — and then owns the relationship after the first close.

That someone is you.

About the Role

This is a fully remote role.

You'll work from wherever you work best — no daily commute, no office face-time. What matters is that your clients feel looked after and your accounts grow. You'll meet clients over video calls (with the occasional in-person session if a key relationship calls for it), and stay connected to the team through our daily rhythms online.

This is a closing role first, a relationship role always.

You'll start by building your own book of business: running sales conversations with interior design firms, diagnosing where their business is stuck, and closing them into the right programme. Every deal you close becomes an account you own — and from there, your job is to make each relationship deeper, longer, and more valuable over time.

The more you close early on, the bigger the portfolio you manage — and the more your recurring income compounds through renewals, tier upgrades, and referrals. You are the person our clients trust from the very first call, the one who checks in before they have to ask, and the reason they sign, renew, upgrade, and refer.

What You'll Do

Run discovery and sales calls with interior design and renovation firms — diagnosing their growth bottlenecks and closing them into the programme that fits

Manage your own sales pipeline end to end: qualification, follow-ups, objection handling, and closing, with clear monthly targets

Own every account you close as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor

Run regular check-ins and performance reviews with clients — walking them through their results, diagnosing bottlenecks, and recommending next steps

Drive renewals by ensuring clients see and understand the value they're getting throughout the programme, not just at renewal time

Identify and develop expansion opportunities — helping clients climb to higher programme tiers when their business is ready for it

Generate referrals naturally by building the kind of relationship people recommend to their peers

Work with our internal teams to resolve client issues quickly and keep promises made during the sales process

Maintain accurate account records, follow-up rhythms, and relationship health tracking in our CRM

Who You Are

2+ years in B2B sales, account management, or client success — with a track record of hitting sales targets and closing deals

A closer who thinks long-term: you know how to drive a deal to a decision, but you close clients you can grow, not just deals you can win

A natural relationship builder — the close is the start of the relationship, not the end of it

Consistent with follow-through: you do what you say, on time, every time

A clear communicator who can explain performance data and business concepts simply, in person and in writing

Commercially sharp — you can spot an upsell or referral opportunity without making the client feel sold to

Organised and self-directed: you manage your own portfolio, pipeline of renewals, and follow-up cadence

Proven ability to work independently in a remote setup — you stay responsive, structured, and visible without anyone looking over your shoulder

Bonus: experience in or exposure to the interior design, renovation, real estate, or home services industry

Why Join Us

100% remote

— you're measured on client outcomes, not hours at a desk

Base salary + commissions on every deal you close, plus recurring incentives on retention, renewals, and account growth — your income compounds as your portfolio grows

Build your own book of business from day one, backed by proven sales scripts, frameworks, and playbooks — you close it, you keep it, you grow it

Clear frameworks, playbooks, and training on how we sell, manage, and grow accounts

A front-row seat to how design and renovation businesses in Singapore scale

To Apply

Reach out directly to our Head of Sales, Nigel:

WhatsApp: +65 9061 4389

Only candidates who reach out via WhatsApp will be contacted — a short intro message telling us who you are and why this role fits you is all it takes to start the conversation.

Network Singapore is a digital marketing and lead generation company specialising in the interior design industry. We operate one of Singapore's leading online portals connecting homeowners with interior design firms, helping businesses grow their client base through targeted digital exposure and a consistent flow of qualified leads.

Founded with a focus on results, we work closely with interior design professionals across Singapore to deliver marketing solutions that are measurable, scalable, and built around the needs of a competitive market. Our platform is designed to reduce the time and cost of client acquisition for interior design firms, allowing them to focus on what they do best — delivering exceptional spaces.

At Network Singapore, we believe in building long-term partnerships with our clients. Our team combines deep industry knowledge with a data-driven approach to ensure that every firm on our platform gets maximum visibility and genuine business opportunities.

We are a growing company with a performance-driven culture, committed to developing talent from within and building a team that takes pride in delivering results.

title: Director, Client Services, AP Service Experience
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Team Summary

The Client Services team provides industry-leading operational support to Visa’s clients around the world. With our deep knowledge and expertise, we are a key internal partner to product and technology, bringing the voice of the customer into the design, development and successful deployment of Visa products and services, and enabling our client facing teams to deliver and scale new products, services, and initiatives into the market.

The Go-To-Market Client Services team ensures the accountability of our product vision, delivering exceptional service to our clients on behalf of Visa. Within this team, the Service Experience team serves as the bridge between Product, Technology, and broader CS teams. They engage early in the design and development stages, providing crucial input and building out implementation and support requirements. By partnering cross-functionally, they identify and communicate platform and product roadmap impacts to the client-facing support teams, ensuring our clients' success.

What a Director, AP Service Experience does at Visa:

The Director, AP Service Experience leads the design and execution of world-class client experiences by combining deep payments expertise, service leadership, and digital innovation. Working across Product, Technology, and Client Services, this role drives product delivery, service readiness, operational excellence, and AI-enabled transformation to help clients realize the full value of Visa's products and solutions while scaling support for future growth.

The ideal candidate will be a self-directed, analytical, and strategic thinker with experience in new product delivery and service improvement in the payments industry. This pivotal role demands a blend of business acumen, functional expertise, leadership skills, and technical proficiency, offering you the opportunity to thrive and grow within the ever-evolving digital payments landscape.

This position is responsible for building a cohesive high performing team by providing leadership, setting strategic direction, and applying working knowledge of Visa products and services.

Key Responsibilities:

Champion the E2E service experience in deploying new products and solutions with clients.
Design scalable implementation, support, and operating models. Strategically develop and refine the product deployment model, emphasizing operational plans for clients across the Asia Pacific (AP) region.
Drive service readiness across Client Services teams, including processes, playbooks, tools, and training.
Provide leadership and management for a team of individual contributors who are responsible for program management, incubation and delivery of a variety of new Visa products. Build a strong and inclusive team through coaching, setting strategic direction and applying working knowledge of Visa products.
Serve as a subject matter expert within Client Services for assigned products and solution portfolios. Leverage technical expertise and business acumen to address complex and unique challenges through extensive information gathering, analysis, and investigation
Continuously embrace and implement new methodologies to support business growth and enable scalability. Stay current with industry and client trends and maintain a strong knowledge of Visa products, services and emerging technologies
Provide leadership and direction for complex cross-regional or cross-functional initiatives and work towards achieving customer and key stakeholder outcomes
Foster strong cross-functional partnerships across Product, Technology, Sales and Client Services at all levels of staff

Why this is important to Visa:

AP Service Experience is an important element of Visa Inc.’s vision of digitizing payments through additional channels. This role is key to execute Visa’s strategy for Consumer & Value-Added Services (VAS) to achieve the targeted goals for the company

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

What you will need:

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent work experience in Product Delivery/Program Management roles in software or financial services
Over 15 years of experience in product/project delivery, including 5+ years leading a product/project management team in the payments industry.
Deep understanding of digital payments and web-based technologies, particularly within agile frameworks.
Proficient in core transaction processing, including message routing, authorization, clearing, and settlement.
Strong technical aptitude, capable of absorbing technical information and applying it to business solutions where little or no precedence exists; able to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely.
Willingness to embrace new challenges in a fast-paced environment, demonstrating flexibility with multitasking and shifting priorities.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and interpersonal skills for negotiating and influencing both internal and external stakeholders.
Proven abilities in negotiating with and influencing clients and staff at all levels as well as the ability to successfully manage competing priorities while serving as a positive influence across the organization.
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong business relationships with internal and external stakeholders at senior levels
Demonstrated ability to leverage Generative AI, automation, and data-driven insights to enhance client experiences, optimize service delivery, improve operational efficiency, and scale support models

What will also help:

Subject matter expertise in various areas, including card payments, products and services, payment technologies, and wallet services, acquired through extensive experience supporting clients and driving new product initiatives within a payment-processing environment.
Proven experience working with Issuers, Acquirers, Merchants, and Payment Gateways in the Asia Pacific (AP) region.
Willingness to take on new challenges, explore innovative ideas and be flexible with changing priorities

Projects you will be a part of:

 This is an incredibly exciting time to join the AP Service Experience team. You will be operating in a fast-paced, unstructured environment to contribute establishing new product lines. You will work with Visa clients to deploy and operationalize new solutions by collaborating with a high performing team.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Employee Relations Specialist Asia Pacific, Vice President
description:
Date live: 10/09/2026

 Business Area: HR

 Area of Expertise: Human Resources

 Contract: Permanent

 Reference Code: JR-0000131130
Join us as an Employee Relations expert and play a key role in managing employee relations matters across the Asia-Pacific region. Partnering with HR, Legal, Compliance and business leaders, you will manage complex employment matters to ensure fair, consistent and compliant outcomes, while effectively managing legal, regulatory and reputational risks. You will advise on disciplinary, grievance, performance, workforce change and complex employment issues, l lead workplace investigations, support policy and governance initiatives, deliver manager guidance and training, and drive continuous improvement of ER processes and colleague experience. You will build trusted stakeholder relationships and use data, insights and trend analysis to identify risks, strengthen workplace culture and support effective people decision-making.

We are seeking an experienced Employee Relations professional to act as the regional subject matter expert for Asia Pacific. The successful candidate will combine deep ER expertise, sound risk judgement and strong stakeholder-management skills to advise employees, managers, HR teams and control functions on complex and high-risk matters. The role requires a proven ability to manage sensitive cases, influence and coach stakeholders, develop regional policies and governance, strengthen ER capability, identify emerging trends and deliver practical solutions within a regulated and fast-paced financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities
Act as the regional subject matter expert for Employee Relations across Asia Pacific, developing and supporting ER strategies aligned with the organisation’s direction and vision.
Develop, implement and maintain regional and local ER policies, guidelines and risk-management governance.
Benchmark ER practices across markets and provide guidance on country-specific/regional/global policies and labour regulations.
Provide expert consultation, guidance and coaching to HR teams, business leaders, managers and employees on complex or high-risk ER matters.
Manage end-to-end ER cases, including employee complaints, grievances, conduct concerns, disciplinary matters and allegations of harassment, discrimination or retaliation.
Provide advice on workforce change and restructuring activities across Asia Pacific.
Oversee wellbeing initiatives across Asia Pacific, including the Employee Assistance Programme.
Manage industrial relations related activities across the region

Required Skills
Degree-qualified, with at least 10-15 years of Employee Relations experience across multiple APAC markets or regions.
Significant knowledge of employment law and Employee Relations within a regulated, complex financial-services environment.
Strong understanding of employment legislation and cultural awareness across key Asia Pacific markets.
Demonstrated experience managing end-to-end ER cases, including complex investigations, disciplinary matters and cases involving multiple and senior stakeholders.
Proven ability to assess legal, regulatory and organisational risks, and to drive ER matters towards appropriate resolution.
Strong counselling, coaching, conflict-resolution and advisory skills, supported by effective influencing techniques.
Excellent interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with structured thinking and strong presentation skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, practical and client-focused advice.

Preferred Skills
Employee Relations experience within the banking or financial-services industry.
Mandarin language skills (reading and speaking).
Proactive, motivated and positive approach, with the flexibility to adapt to changing priorities.
Creative and innovative mindset, with a focus on practical solutions and continuous improvement.
Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to build trusted relationships across functions and regions.
Calm, balanced and objective approach when handling sensitive or conflict-driven situations.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in the role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, as well as job-specific technical skills.

Barclays is required by law to confirm that you have the Legal Right to Work in any role that you apply for. If you currently hold a work visa sponsored by Barclays, or you would require sponsorship from Barclays, you must declare this as part of your application. Sponsored visas are role and entity specific, and any changes must be reviewed. It is important that you ensure you are working on the correct visa at all times. Failure to accurately disclose your visa status or Legal Right to Work may result in your application or any employment offer being withdrawn at any time.

Purpose of the role

To support the business with the management of employee relations cases, in line with relevant policies, procedures and regulatory requirements. This includes providing professional advice, support and guidance to managers and employees on a range of topics (including Disciplinary, Capability, Grievance and Sickness), and investigating matters where required.

Accountabilities

Provision of ER advice on a range of topics, including reviewing and drafting of documentation, advising on process as well as potential employment / legal risk. Supporting directly where required, often with senior complex, and regulatory matters.
Investigations to resolve employee complaints, grievances, and disciplinary matters and guidance on the completion of these, supporting managers and employees as required.
Employee relations policies and procedures development, implementation, and maintenance, aligning these to all applicable laws, regulations and the overall business strategy.
Production and deployment of ER training in coordination with our control partners with a focus on prevention.
Production and delivery of ER metrics, sharing insights with stakeholders on employee relations issues and trends.

Vice President Expectations

To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Sales Associate
description:
Absolute Kinetics Consultancy (AKC) Pte Ltd officially opened for business on 18 April2001. AKC is an Approved Training Organisation appointed by SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG) to provide a wide range of courses approved by the Ministry of Manpower (MOM), SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG), Singapore Resuscitation and First Aid Council (SRFAC), and Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF).

Why Join AKC

• Gain hands-on exposure to real sales and account growth work

• Build confidence in client communication, relationship management, and follow-through

• Work closely with internal teams and contribute directly to revenue growth

• Develop practical experience in sales coordination, account support, and business development

• Clear growth pathway into Account Management, Business Development, Sales, or Partnerships roles

About the role

We are looking for a results-driven Sales Associate to support AKC’s business growth by managing client relationships, identifying sales opportunities, and helping convert enquiries into long-term accounts.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with people, building strong client relationships, and growing business opportunities over time. You will work closely with clients and internal teams to understand needs, follow up on opportunities, and ensure a smooth sales process from enquiry to conversion.

If you are proactive, confident in communication, and motivated by both relationship-building and results, this role could be a strong fit for you.

Roles and Responsibilities

• Manage and grow client accounts by building strong working relationships

• Identify new sales opportunities within existing and prospective accounts

• Follow up on enquiries, leads, and client discussions in a timely manner

• Understand client needs and recommend relevant AKC courses, services, or solutions

• Prepare quotations, proposals, and follow-up materials where required

• Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth handover, fulfilment, and client support

• Track account activity, sales opportunities, pipeline movement, and follow-up actions

• Maintain accurate records of conversations, opportunities, and account progress

• Support revenue growth by converting leads into active business opportunities

• Help strengthen long-term partnerships through consistent communication and service

Requirements

· ITE Nitec / Higher Nitec, or Diploma in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related fields

· Good communication and people skills

· Confident, proactive, and willing to learn

· Organised and able to manage follow-ups

· Positive attitude and strong sense of responsibility

· Experience in sales, customer service, retail, events, or client-facing work is a plus, but not compulsory

Absolute Kinetics Consultancy (AKC) Pte Ltd officially opened for business on 18th April 2001.

AKC is an Approved Training Organisation appointed by SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG) to provide a wide range of courses approved by Ministry of Manpower (MOM), SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG), Singapore Resuscitation and First Aid Council (SRFAC), & Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF).

Its clientele list includes SMEs to MNCs from various industrials ranging from construction, manufacturing, oil & gas to employment firms (Certificate of Employment Intermediaries for Key Appointment Holders & General Employees). The company is also an approved MOM SIP (Settling in Programme for Foreign Domestic Workers) training center and an approved Food Safety training provider.

AKC conducts workplace and health safety courses as its core business and also offers consultancy, risk management and other specialised training services such as certificate for employment intermediaries. It also has a team of around 100 professionals (comprising full time and part time trainers) skilled in various safety specialisations such as construction safety, scaffolding, shipyard safety, metalworking and welding, amongst others.

title: Marketing Manager (Guest Experience)
description:

Develop and own the annual marketing strategy and plan, aligned with revenue and occupancy targets agreed with the Director.

Prepare, manage and account for the marketing budget; report spend and return on investment to the Director monthly.

Lead brand positioning and ensure consistent brand standards across all channels and touchpoints.

Plan and run campaigns across digital, social media, email, search, OTA listings, partnerships and offline channels.
