title: Key Account Manager
description:
Company Description

Tabsquare is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70+ countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

At TabSquare, we believe dining is more than food – it’s about connection, celebration, and community. Our mission is to reimagine the way people dine and restaurants grow.

We empower thousands of restaurants and small-medium businesses across 10+ APAC markets with AI-powered ordering and engagement tools that democratize digital growth and create memorable dining moments for millions of customers.

Learn more at www.tabsquare.ai

Job Description

We are hiring a Key Account Manager to drive growth and strengthen relationships across Singapore and Malaysia’s leading restaurant groups.

This role is ideal for a strategic, data-driven relationship builder who thrives in managing multi-outlet F&B brands, aligning commercial outcomes with client success, and unlocking new revenue opportunities across TabSquare’s ecosystem.

You will be responsible for retention, upsell, and expansion within a defined portfolio of top-tier enterprise accounts, while also identifying and closing new opportunities within those groups.

You will report to the Head of Account Management & Customer Success and work closely with the Success, Product, and Marketing teams to deliver measurable revenue growth and long-term partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Account Management

Own end-to-end relationship with key enterprise restaurant groups across Singapore and Malaysia.

Serve as the main commercial contact for CXOs, digital transformation heads, and operations leaders.

Conduct regular QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews) to review performance, align on KPIs, and co-create growth plans.

2. Revenue Growth & Expansion

Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities across TabSquare’s suite (SmartQR, Kiosk, Payments, SmartEngage, etc.).

Partner with Success Managers and Solutions Consultants to structure multi-outlet rollouts and new feature adoption.

Negotiate renewals and multi-year agreements to expand share of wallet and account profitability.

3. Retention & Relationship Health

Monitor account health, engagement metrics, and product usage to anticipate churn risks.

Develop joint success plans for each key account to drive measurable outcomes (e.g., GMV growth, customer retention, marketing ROI).

Build trust by acting as a proactive advisor offering insights, benchmarking data, and new solutions aligned with client goals.

4. Market & Competitive Intelligence

Track competitor activities, pricing, and product adoption trends within major F&B groups.

Share intelligence with product and leadership teams to refine go-to-market and feature priorities.

Identify potential pilot or co-marketing opportunities with strategic clients.

5. Commercial Planning & Reporting

Maintain accurate CRM records, renewal dates, and revenue forecasts.

Prepare and present monthly business reviews and performance reports by account.

Contribute to regional account planning, forecasting, and quarterly growth targets.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

5 - 8 years of experience in B2B account management, key account, or enterprise sales roles - preferably in SaaS, Payments or F&B Tech.

Proven track record managing multi-location clients and driving retention and upsell.

Strong commercial acumen, negotiation, and relationship management skills at both CXO and operational levels.

Experience handling cross-border or regional accounts across Singapore and Malaysia is highly preferred.

Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, Pipedrive) and data-driven account planning.

Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders.

Self-driven, structured, and comfortable managing complex enterprise relationships with multiple decision-makers.

Fluency in English required; Mandarin or Bahasa Malaysia proficiency is a plus.

Additional Information

Why Join TabSquare

Redefine the Future of Dining - Build AI, fintech, and digital solutions that transform how restaurants operate

Create Lasting Impact, Fast - We take ownership, move with speed, and focus on what truly matters. See the real-world results of your work quickly and tangibly.

Grow as a Leader - We raise the bar, develop the best, and provide clear career paths to leadership.

Work in a Culture of Curiosity & Excellence - We dive deep, challenge assumptions, and use data to solve problems. We value bold ideas, experimentation, and continuous learning.

Thrive in a Positive, Humble Environment - We bring good vibes through a collaborative, supportive culture where optimism sparks possibility and openness to feedback drives growth.

title: Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)
description:
Position: Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)

Employment Type:

Full-time

Industry:

Food & Beverage / Restaurant

Location:

VivoCity

About the Role

We are looking for an exceptional and highly experienced

Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)

to lead the overall marketing, branding, customer acquisition and growth strategy of our restaurant business in Singapore.

The ideal candidate will be a senior marketing executive with extensive experience in

large-scale F&B businesses, established restaurant chains, hospitality groups, consumer brands or multi-outlet restaurant operations

.

This is a strategic leadership role for a commercially driven marketing professional who understands that restaurant marketing goes beyond social media. You will be responsible for building the brand, driving customer acquisition and retention, developing integrated marketing campaigns, strengthening digital presence, and ultimately delivering measurable revenue and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and lead the company's overall marketing, branding and customer growth strategy.

Establish a clear brand positioning, brand identity and long-term brand development strategy.

Develop integrated marketing strategies covering

digital marketing, social media, PR, KOL/influencer marketing, CRM, loyalty, partnerships, events, content and offline marketing

.

Lead customer acquisition and retention strategies to drive sustainable revenue growth.

Develop annual marketing plans, campaign calendars and marketing budgets aligned with overall business objectives.

Take ownership of marketing performance, ROI and customer acquisition metrics.

Build and manage the company's marketing organization, including digital marketing, social media, content, CRM, PR and creative functions.

Develop strong customer segmentation and data-driven marketing strategies.

Establish CRM, membership and loyalty programs to increase customer frequency, retention and lifetime value.

Lead major brand campaigns, seasonal campaigns, new product launches and new outlet opening campaigns.

Work closely with the COO and operations teams to ensure marketing campaigns translate into actual outlet traffic, sales and profitability.

Develop strategic partnerships with corporations, lifestyle brands, platforms, media companies, influencers and other relevant partners.

Oversee agency relationships and manage external creative, media, PR and digital partners.

Monitor market trends, consumer behavior, competitors and emerging opportunities within the Singapore F&B sector.

Establish marketing KPIs, dashboards and reporting systems to measure campaign effectiveness and commercial results.

Manage marketing budgets and ensure effective allocation of resources.

Strengthen the company's digital ecosystem, including website, social media, CRM, online ordering and customer engagement channels.

Lead the company's reputation management and public communications strategy.

Support the company's expansion strategy and develop scalable marketing systems for future multi-outlet growth.

Requirements

Minimum 10–12 years of relevant marketing experience

, with significant experience in senior marketing leadership positions.

Proven track record in

F&B, restaurant chains, hospitality groups, consumer brands or other high-volume consumer businesses

.

Strong preference for candidates who have held senior marketing positions within

large restaurant groups, established F&B chains, major hospitality groups or recognized consumer brands

.

At least

5 years of senior management / leadership experience

, including experience managing marketing teams and external agencies.

Demonstrated experience developing and executing marketing strategies for

large-scale, multi-outlet or multi-location businesses

.

Proven experience managing substantial marketing budgets and delivering measurable commercial results.

Strong understanding of

brand building, customer acquisition, CRM, loyalty, digital marketing, social media, performance marketing, PR and influencer/KOL marketing

.

Demonstrated ability to connect marketing activities with

revenue, traffic, customer acquisition, retention and profitability

.

Strong experience in new brand launches, new outlet openings, major campaigns and business expansion.

Proven experience leading cross-functional teams and working closely with operations, finance, commercial and senior management teams.

Excellent analytical, strategic planning and commercial decision-making abilities.

Strong understanding of consumer behavior and the Singapore market.

Exceptional communication, leadership, presentation and negotiation skills.

Highly creative while maintaining strong commercial and analytical discipline.

Experience working with

large restaurant chains, flagship restaurants, major hospitality groups or regional consumer brands

will be strongly preferred.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a

senior-level marketing executive rather than a pure digital marketer or social media manager

.

The ideal candidate should have experience building and scaling brands within

large F&B groups, established restaurant chains, hospitality organizations or major consumer businesses

, with a strong understanding of how marketing directly impacts restaurant traffic, revenue and customer lifetime value.

Candidates with a proven track record of leading

large marketing teams, significant budgets, multi-outlet campaigns and major brand-building initiatives

will be strongly preferred.

Experience in taking a restaurant or consumer brand from

growth stage to a larger multi-outlet or regional operation

will be a significant advantage.

title: Technology Support III, Wealth Management Technology
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

As a Technology Support III team member in Wealth Management Technology, you will be responsible for regulatory readiness and operational resiliency oversight across the APAC Asset and Wealth Management application portfolio. The role partners with application owners and global resiliency stakeholders to maintain testing evidence, documentation, control adherence, and audit readiness.

Job Responsibilities

Own portfolio-level resiliency governance for a suite of APAC and international Asset and Wealth Management applications, including oversight of resiliency documentation, testing plans, and evidence management.
Lead and coordinate resiliency testing (e.g., disaster recovery, cyber recovery, data restore, and sustained operations exercises) and ensure issues are tracked to remediation.
Provide guidance to application owners on resiliency and cyber-resiliency planning, including minimum control expectations and documentation standards.
Maintain alignment to firm resiliency taxonomy/standards (e.g., service criticality, recovery objectives, control mapping) and track control compliance across the portfolio.
Produce portfolio reporting and data analysis to maintain audit readiness, identify gaps/trends, and proactively escalate emerging risks.
Coordinate scheduled exercises that may occur outside standard hours (including occasional weekend testing), ensuring stakeholders are prepared and outcomes are documented.
Support for testing activities outside business hours (planned in advance).

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics or a related field
3+ years of experience or equivalent expertise troubleshooting, resolving, and maintaining information technology services
Experience in application resiliency / business continuity / disaster recovery / operational risk / technology controls (ideally in a regulated financial services environment).
Demonstrated experience managing testing programs and maintaining audit-ready evidence.
Strong stakeholder management across technology, risk, and control partners
Fluency in Mandarin and English required (written and spoken) to support clients and stakeholders based in China across Asset Management China and the global Asset and Wealth Management application portfolio.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

Familiarity with APAC regulatory environments (e.g., MAS/HKMA/ASIC—tailor to your footprint).
Experience with cyber recovery practices (e.g., data restore validation, recovery runbooks, control testing).
Strong data/reporting skills

title: Senior Account Executive (Enterprise)
description:
There are NO limits to your career: come shape the future and be part of a truly unique global culture at OutSystems!

About OutSystems

At OutSystems, we are accelerating digital transformation globally by empowering organizations to build enterprise-grade applications quickly and efficiently. As our presence in the Singapore grows rapidly, we are seeking a highly driven and strategic Senior Account Executive (Enterprise) to join our team in Singapore.

This role is a premier opportunity for a dynamic sales professional who wants to elevate their career by combining deep market expertise with the opportunity to shape the technological future.

Position Overview

Role Title: Senior Account Executive
Location: Singapore
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Language Requirements: Business-level fluency in English is mandatory; any other language is advantageous.

Key Responsibilities

As a Senior Account Executive, you will be the main point of contact for OutSystems customers, leading the sales strategy from initial contact through to successful implementation and beyond.

Market Expansion & Hunting: Proactively hunt for new business and secure new logos within the Enterprise space.
Strategic Account Mapping: Map prospective accounts, deeply understanding their organizational structure, key decision-makers, and existing technology stack.
Executive Engagement: Cultivate trust-based relationships. Engage with C-level executives in targeted prospect accounts and orchestrate discussions centered around their specific business needs and regulatory environments.
Value Demonstration: Demonstrate verbally, in writing, and through collaborative product demos how prospective customers can capture value, modernize legacy processes, and envision their future with OutSystems.
Pipeline & Sales Cycle Management: Meet and exceed targets by effectively managing opportunities and pipeline health through a complex enterprise sales cycle. Negotiate for success while overcoming objections.
Account Growth: Strategically advocate for platform upgrades and formulate comprehensive growth plans for existing accounts.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner seamlessly with Solution Architects to provide technical product overviews and insights pertinent to customer needs and usage scenarios.

Qualifications

We are looking for an achievement-driven professional who possesses strong business acumen, a passion for technology, and a deep understanding of the local market.

Professional Experience: Minimum of 10 years of quota-carrying sales experience, specifically selling into the Enterprise space.
Technical Acumen: A solid understanding of cloud computing technologies, business drivers, and emerging IT trends. The capacity to learn and retain knowledge about complex IT products and solutions quickly.
Sales Strategy: A proven track record of recognizing the stages in the buying cycle for prospects and effectively managing a customer relationship through to success. Background in prospecting to IT decision-makers is required.
Communication & Negotiation: Exceptional interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills. Proven ability to handle objections, navigate roadblocks, and negotiate effectively via phone, email, video, and in-person presentations.
Cultural & Market Insight: Deep understanding of the Singapore business culture, emphasizing relationship-building, trust, and long-term partnership development.
Drive & Autonomy: An achievement- and success-driven personality, motivated by performance rewards. Solid time management skills and the ability to work independently with a high level of integrity in a competitive environment.

More about OutSystems

OutSystems is a leading AI Development Platform built for the enterprise. Global organizations trust OutSystems to rapidly build mission-critical apps and agents, modernize legacy processes with agentic systems, and govern their entire AI portfolio across complex regulatory environments, all on one unified platform.

As the future becomes agentic, our customers need us now more than ever. While AI has opened the door to extraordinary possibilities, most large organizations find themselves stuck on one side of the "enterprise gap" because AI by itself doesn't solve their complex use cases and business challenges. OutSystems bridges the "enterprise gap" by combining the speed of generative AI with a deterministic, enterprise-grade framework. We provide the tools for teams of any size to deliver high-quality, reliable AI solutions that drive real business impact.

We are looking for passionate, talented, and motivated people to join us as we empower organizations to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of enterprise software. While we are leading the charge into the agentic era, our mission is broader: we are the platform enterprise leaders trust to evolve their entire business, accelerating innovation through secure, governed human-AI collaboration.

OutSystems is a global company, with more than 900k developer community members, 1,700 employees, more than 600 partners, and thousands of active customers in over 75 countries and across 21 industries. Founded in 2001, OutSystems now has offices in the United States, United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Portugal, Germany, the UAE, Japan, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Australia, India, and Singapore, and includes a thriving, worldwide community of remote employees.

Our customers are some of the world's most recognizable brands across diverse industries— such as Toyota, Heineken, Bosch, KeyBank, and UCLA—who trust OutSystems to deliver ROI and transformational impact.

Consistently recognized as a leader by top analyst firms Gartner, IDC and Forrester, OutSystems continues to shape the future of enterprise software development in the agentic era. We are proud to be named a leader in more than 100 categories on G2, including #1 in Customer Satisfaction in Enterprise Low Code Development, and most recently as a leader in AI Agent Building in the G2 Spring 2026 Reports.

Working at OutSystems

Our culture is built on our core values of Trust, Customer Success, Innovation, and Alignment. We operate as one global OutSystems team, taking ownership to pursue our vision of being the AI platform enterprise leaders trust to build, secure, and evolve their most critical applications and systems.

What do we have to offer you?

A company at the vanguard of the agentic revolution, where we don’t just react to AI innovation—we architect it. Joining OutSystems means stepping onto a high-growth rocket ship that combines the fearless agility of a startup with the sophisticated, global foundation of an enterprise powerhouse.

Real growth opportunities. We don't just talk about development; we invest in it through structured programs designed to scale your expertise. Whether you are aiming for vertical progression, exploring lateral moves into new domains, or mastering specialized AI skills through our Professional Development Fund and Internal Mobility Program, we provide the resources to get you there.

A global collective of world-class talent, where you’ll collaborate with enterprise software legends and sought-after thought leaders. At OutSystems, our industry experts aren't just visionaries—they are accessible, approachable mentors who are deeply invested in your growth as we architect the agentic future together.

OutSystems nurtures an inclusive culture where talented individuals from all backgrounds are empowered to learn, experiment and make an impact. . We believe that driving our next phase of growth requires the radical creativity that only comes from diverse perspectives. We are committed to building a team as global and diverse as the organizations we serve, ensuring every individual can perform to their full potential. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive equal consideration regardless of race, origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.

title: Professional Services Consultant
description:
At Orbus Software, we believe transformation doesn’t happen in a vacuum. It happens through partnership, insight, and the ability to turn complexity into confidence.

Our business transformation platform, OrbusInfinity, helps organizations understand how their business operates, connect strategy to execution, and make better-informed decisions in the age of AI. Trusted by more than 600 enterprises and government organizations across 50+ countries, we work alongside our customers to navigate complex transformation, optimize technology investments, and turn strategy into action.

As a Professional Services Consultant, you will help turn complex Enterprise Architecture requirements into practical solutions for Orbus customers across North America, initially supporting a large new engagement within the US federal government.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Professional Services, North America, you will manage a defined workstream within a large implementation, covering requirements gathering, solution configuration, testing, documentation, workshops and training. Working with client stakeholders and internal Orbus colleagues, you will help move the implementation forward, resolve delivery issues and support customers in using their solutions effectively.

The role is preferably based on the US East Coast to align with client and team working patterns. Candidates based elsewhere in the US may also be considered, provided they can work effectively with the required hours and meet the role’s travel expectations.

What You Will Do

Provide support and guidance to customers during onboarding and implementation, helping them realize value from Orbus products and solutions.

Work closely with internal onboarding colleagues and customer project teams to manage a defined workstream within a large implementation and deliver agreed activities.

Build trusted working relationships with customer stakeholders and contribute to a positive customer experience throughout the engagement.

Understand customer use cases and gather requirements by asking clear and thoughtful questions. Translate customer needs into clear business outcomes and practical solution approaches, using your own initiative to advise customers on how to make best use of Orbus services and solutions to achieve their objectives.

Configure and optimize Orbus products and solutions in line with agreed customer requirements.

Test configured solutions and prepare clear functional documentation to support customer review, handover and ongoing use.

Deliver training courses and develop or adapt custom training materials to support effective knowledge transfer.

Deliver and contribute to customer workshops, working sessions and consultancy sessions throughout the engagement lifecycle. Apply Orbus best practices to provide practical guidance, resolve implementation challenges and support continued adoption of implemented solutions.

Apply relevant Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices where appropriate to support customer initiatives.

Work with Customer Success Managers, Account Managers and other internal colleagues to communicate progress, identify adoption risks and support a consistent customer journey.

Deliver clear solution walkthroughs, implementation updates and working sessions for technical, business and senior customer stakeholders.

Work with internal specialists and Professional Services colleagues to share lessons learned and contribute to reusable methodologies, training materials and published assets.

Advocate for customer needs by identifying adoption barriers and providing structured feedback on how Orbus can better serve customers.

Share relevant customer feedback with Product Development colleagues to inform potential product improvements.

Manage your own delivery activities, actions and priorities, escalating risks, dependencies or issues that require wider decision-making.

What You Will Bring

Essential describes the experience and capabilities you will need to be effective in the role from the start. Desirable describes experience that would be helpful but can be developed after joining.

Essential

Experience managing a defined workstream within a large software, technology or transformation implementation.

Experience delivering customer-facing consultancy, software implementation or professional services engagements.

Ability to understand customer requirements and translate them into practical solution designs and delivery activities.

Experience with software configuration, testing, implementation documentation or customer handover.

Experience delivering workshops, working sessions, consultancy sessions or customer training.

Ability to absorb technical information and communicate it clearly to audiences with different levels of technical knowledge.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence others and identify important information.

A service-oriented approach, with good organization and attention to detail.

Ability to manage your own priorities, meet agreed deadlines and take initiative in identifying and resolving issues.

Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues across a global team.

Willingness to travel for customer engagements, up to approximately 30% of the time.

Desirable

Prior experience in Enterprise Architecture.

Experience working with US federal government customers.

Experience working in a complex, highly governed public-sector or regulated environment.

Experience using Enterprise Architecture, business architecture or transformation management platforms.

Experience delivering professional services in a software-led environment.

Experience creating customer training materials, implementation documentation or reusable delivery methods.

Experience working with project managers, Customer Success Managers or Account Managers to coordinate customer delivery.

Familiarity with Orbus products or comparable enterprise software platforms.

A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related field would be helpful, but equivalent practical experience is equally valued.

Why Orbus

Orbus is at an exciting point in its growth, helping organizations navigate increasingly complex transformation and the opportunities created by AI.

Recognized as a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Enterprise Architecture Tools in both 2024 and 2025, we bring together people across the USA, UK, UAE, Poland and Australia to solve meaningful problems for customers around the world.

If you are curious, motivated and want to do work that makes an impact, we would love to meet you.

Perks & Benefits

We believe great people do their best work when they’re supported, trusted, and given the space to succeed.

Our benefits vary by location and are designed to support your wellbeing, your future and your life outside of work.

Generous time off: We offer competitive paid time off so you can rest, recharge and spend time on what matters outside of work.

Health and financial wellbeing: Depending on your location, benefits may include health, life and disability coverage, as well as retirement or pension plans.

Hybrid working: Where we have offices, we believe there is real value in spending time together. Our hybrid approach combines in-person collaboration with the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.

Support through different life stages: Our benefits include family leave and other support designed to help our people manage work alongside the things that matter outside of it.

title: Sr. Manager, Talent Acquisition APAC
description:
SUMMARY:

The

Sr Manager, Talent Acquisition APAC

will be responsible for full lifecycle recruitment and talent attraction for our corporate functions in APAC. This leader will serve as a strategic partner for our regional APAC leaders across the business providing market insights and building strategies to proactively attract top talent. As a member of the Talent Acquisition Leadership Team (TALT), you will play an active role in developing our talented team, driving talent strategies, and ensure programs and processes are consistent, driving the delivery of best-in-class candidate and hiring experiences. This role reports to the Director, Talent Acquisition APAC.

WHAT YOU’LL DO HERE:

Lead Talent Acquisition Strategy: Works closely with HR and functional leaders to align and prioritize APAC talent needs, ensuring function and market specific recruitment strategies are well managed and executed.

Actively participates and manages leadership requisitions, offering strategic partnership to key stakeholders. Identify and engage with prospective candidates who are category and industry experts for networking and pipeline initiatives.

Team Leadership: Drive consistency across the corporate TA function. Offer mentorship to foster the professional growth and performance of the Talent Acquisition (TA) team.

Drive efficiency and effectiveness with our sourcing team; both our strategy and resources.

Market Intelligence: Keep abreast of retail, fashion and consumer product industry talent trends and market dynamics, offering strategic talent insights to sourcing talent.

Brand Ambassador: Leverage market insights to inform our talent brand strategy. Actively participate in new and innovative ways to position Crocs, Inc. as an employer of choice.

Workforce Planning: Partner with APAC HR team during the AOP process to accurately forecast hiring needs, aligning with business growth projections and strategic objectives.

Leverage and apply data analytics to track recruitment metrics, identify trends, and measure the efficiency of talent acquisition strategies.

Fuels Strategy: Operates in the now but thinks, plans, and acts with a focus on the long-view, sustainability, outstanding outcomes, and scaling the business.

Communicate with Impact: Experience working with various leaders. Ability to tailor detail and transparency in communications, depending on audience and circumstances.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE:

8+ years of talent acquisition experience in APAC, preferably with experience in a global consumer good or retail brand.

Experience in developing a high-performing team; including setting goals, providing feedback, and encouraging a culture of continuous learning and development.

A committed individual who can work effectively at both strategic and tactical levels and is not hesitant to act and collaborate with the team.

Extensive knowledge of standard methodologies in recruitment; including sourcing, assessment, interviewing, and selection processes.

Experience working with global Applicant Tracking System (ATS), CRM and other AI/technology platforms.

A world leader in innovative casual footwear for men, women and children, Crocs, Inc. (NASDAQ: CROX), offers several distinct shoe collections with more than 250 styles to suit every lifestyle. As lighthearted as they are lightweight, Crocs™ footwear provides profound comfort and support for any occasion and every season. All Crocs™ branded shoes feature Croslite™ material, a proprietary, revolutionary technology that produces soft, non-marking, and odor-resistant shoes that conform to your feet.

Crocs™ products are sold in 90 countries. Every day, millions of Crocs™ shoe lovers around the world enjoy the exceptional form, function, versatility and feel-good qualities of these shoes while at work, school and play.

title: Account Manager, Partnerships

title: AVP, Client Account Manager
description:
ADDX is seeking a highly sales- and purpose-driven Client Account Manager who possesses a unique blend of expertise in financial markets, investment products, strategic thinking, and a strong client-focused and entrepreneurial mindset. As a Client Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in working with our Head of Consumer Group to forging strong relationships with new and existing key accredited investors, and providing a strong feedback loop to enhance and improve our platform and digital client journey. This role will need to have the ability to manage a large portfolio of clients at scale, while having the ability to address more bespoke demands from our top-tier investors, as well as identifying strategic partnership opportunities.

Responsibilities:

1. Client Acquisition: Strong ability to acquire quality accredited investors who resonate with ADDX's proposition of investing in private markets and investment alternatives to strengthen and diversify their portfolio.

2. Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with top decile clients, serving as their primary point of contact. Understand their investment needs, objectives, and challenges to provide tailored solutions and meet their needs.

3. Strategic Business Development: Work closely with the Head of Consumer Group and team members to identify opportunities based on client feedback and experience across sales, partnerships, investment product and digital client journeys.

4. Client Support: Provide prompt and effective support to clients, addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and managing escalations.

5. Understand Market Trends: Understand industry trends, competitive landscape, and client-specific dynamics to proactively identify opportunities and mitigate risks.

6.Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with internal teams, including sales, digital marketing, product, and operations, to align on client needs, ensure consistent messaging, and drive customer success. Share client feedback and insights regularly to inform product enhancements and service improvements.

7. Risk Management: Ensure compliance with financial regulatory and compliance standards when conducting regulated activities and managing client relationships.

8. Adherence to Financial Regulations and Standards: Attend mandatory training sessions and workshops conducted by LRC to ensure and enhance understanding and utilization of our products and services. Be aware of financial industry, best practices and trends.

Requirements:

1. Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

2. 3-4 years’ experience in client account management, relationship management or investment advisory, preferably in a finance, brokerage, wealth management, asset management or insurance industry. Experience in a fintech or digital solutions a plus.

3. Network of existing mass affluent and high net-worth individuals would be a big advantage.

4. Strong experience in investment products across traditional and alternative spaces including private markets, hedge funds, etc.

5. Strong understanding of the client execution processes across different product classes would be a big advantage.

6. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build rapport, influence, and negotiate with clients at various levels.

7. Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Demonstrates capability to analyse complex situations, identify solutions, and drive results.

8. Ability to work independently and manage multiple client accounts simultaneously. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to prioritize tasks effectively.

9.Proficiency in CRM software and other relevant tools. Experience with Sales force or similar platforms is desirable.

10. Knowledge of financial markets, investment products, or trading platforms is crucial to being successful in this role.

11. An entrepreneurship mindset, hands-on personality, with the flexibility to adaptand adjust quickly to fast-changing circumstances and scenarios are a must.

12.Candidates are required to have passed RES1B, RES2B, M6 (CM-EIP), and M6A(CM-SIP).

Due to our limited capacity, we regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

We are ADDX, the entry point into private markets, and we aim to democratise private market investments. As a team, we strive to build a future where everybody can access financial ecosystems easily, fairly, and safely.

We have built the World’s first fully regulated platform for digital securities, licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS).

· In 2022, we received USD 58 million in our Pre-Series B funding round.

· We are the first Singapore financial institution to recognise crypto assets for onboarding accredited investors.

We are growing, and are looking for talented individuals like you to join our team and take us forward at rocket speed towards our future as the leaders of the private market. If you believe in a future of fair financial markets, just like we do, we’ve been waiting for you at ADDX.

title: Business Analysis and Transformation Service VP
description:

Description:

Company overview

Nomura is a global financial services group with an integrated network spanning approximately 30 countries and regions. By connecting markets East & West, Nomura services the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through its three business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, and Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking). Founded in 1925, the firm is built on a tradition of disciplined entrepreneurship, serving clients with creative solutions and considered thought leadership. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title: Business Analysis and Transformation Service VP

Corporate Title: Vice President

Department: Operations

Location: Singapore

Licensed Role: No

Department Overview:

The Operations division provides the support and control infrastructure that enables the Firm to develop and deliver financial products throughout the world. Working with the Sales, Trading and Information Technology Divisions, Operations professionals are responsible for the management and execution of transactions in a manner which maximizes profitability and minimizes risk. Our division is responsible for the management and execution of millions of securities transactions on a daily basis. Our responsibilities include trade processing, confirmation, settlement, fails management, margin, asset servicing, risk management, reference data management and various other client services. In partnership with sales, trading, prime services, information technology and other teams from across the bank, we apply a continual focus on improving productivity and efficiency, while seeking new and innovative ways to support our clients' changing needs.

Business Overview:

Strategic, Analytics, and Business Re-engineering (SABRE) aims to align our capabilities to deliver end-to-end solutions that create tangible value for the business. The Business Analysis and Transformation Service within SABRE focuses on driving small and large transformation objectives from ideation to delivery for Operations acting in as Business Analyst, Project Manager and Program manager.

Lead business analysis, transformation initiatives across Operations, driving strategic change programs while managing a high-performing team of business analysts. This role combines deep business analysis expertise with project management capabilities to deliver end-to-end solutions across complex collateral management and middle office processes within the global investment banking environment.

Lead agile delivery through JIRA, Confluence, and other tools, ensuring transparency and continuous improvement

Provide strategic input into engagement decisions including work planning, timeline management, resource allocation, and team career development
Develop comprehensive program strategies encompassing stakeholder assessment, leadership alignment, organizational transition, change readiness, capability transfer, and end-user training
Track and coordinate BoW related issues, improvements and actions till closure.
Champion the adoption of emerging AI technologies within the team to enhance analytical capabilities, reduce manual effort, and improve delivery quality

Domain

Minimum 8 years of Project Manager experience running successful change the bank projects for Operations
Proven experience in Banking operations, including Wealth Management activities. Proven experience of Middle Office and Bank Office functions.
Demonstrated business analysis skills including requirements elicitation, process modelling, gap analysis, user story creation, acceptance criteria definition, and UAT coordination.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills at senior levels.
Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills with proven experience in conflict management and issue resolution
Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams under tight deadlines.
Demonstrated ability to understand, evaluate, and apply AI tools (such as generative AI, process mining, intelligent automation) to streamline business analysis workflows, accelerate documentation, and enhance requirements quality
Understanding of business performance metrics (cost efficiency, productivity, operational risk).

Technical

Strong proficiency in executive storytelling, PowerPoint, and data visualization.
Strong working knowledge of Agile methodologies with hands-on experience using JIRA, Confluence, and other agile project management tools throughout the full delivery lifecycle
Analytical mindset with proficiency in Excel, Power BI, or other visualization tools.
Familiarity with data visualization best practices and executive narrative design principles.
Certification in Project Management (PMP/Prince2) or Business Analysis is a plus.

Explore Insights & Vision

title: Guest Experience & Business Development Manager (CCP PMET)
description:
About the Role

BMG treats guest experience as both a service and a revenue function. The Guest Experience & Business Development Manager will build relationships, community programmes, local partnerships and customer pipelines that generate hotel stays, restaurant diners, groups, events, repeat customers and referrals.

This is not primarily a complaint-handling or front-office role.

Key Responsibilities

Develop relationships with nearby companies, networking groups, local organisations, attractions, communities and complementary businesses.

Generate new hotel, F&B, group, corporate and event business.

Engage hotel and restaurant guests and convert appropriate interactions into permission-based CRM relationships.

Maintain a structured CRM and segment customers by behaviour, relationship, commercial potential and future needs.

Use approved AI tools to personalise follow-ups, proposals, local recommendations and customer journeys.

Develop neighbourhood partnerships and placemaking programmes.

Design community programmes and BMG social activities.

Work with operations and digital resources to create campaigns, offers, events and experiences.

Measure which partnerships and programmes generate bookings, diners, referrals and attributable revenue.

Analyse repeat visits, conversion, customer behaviour and pipeline progress.

Feed customer intelligence into management, pricing, programming and service decisions.

CCP Growth Skills

Consumer Intelligence Analysis

Placemaking for Hospitality

Service Innovation

Digital Marketing

Structured Career Conversion

The selected employee may undergo up to 24 weeks of OJT to develop hospitality-specific customer intelligence, CRM, placemaking, business development, AI-enabled relationship management and service-innovation capabilities.

Suitable Background

Potential backgrounds include community development, events, customer success, corporate relations, sales, marketing, account management, tourism, retail, service industries and partnership development. Candidates do not need to come from a traditional hotel Guest Relations department.

BMG Hospitality Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based hospitality and lifestyle company building a technology-enabled ecosystem across accommodation, food & beverage, talent, education, community, digital marketing and media.

Our core hospitality concept, Capsule Modern, focuses on modern, well-designed and affordable accommodation for the next generation of travellers. We aim to combine efficient hotel operations, strong guest experiences, social interaction and technology to create a scalable hospitality platform. Our target guests include independent travellers, digital natives and younger international visitors seeking convenient locations, quality facilities, value and community experiences.

Alongside our hotels, BMG Hospitality is developing Gabriel Restaurants to support both hotel guests and external customers. The restaurant platform is designed to complement hotel operations through breakfast services, food and beverage offerings and social experiences while developing its own standalone revenue streams.

BMG operates with an asset-light approach, focusing primarily on leasing and converting suitable properties rather than purchasing real estate. Standardised operating procedures, technology, centralised management and disciplined project execution are intended to allow new properties to be developed and launched efficiently.

Technology and artificial intelligence form an important part of BMG's operating philosophy. We are building a cloud-based management environment covering hotel operations, revenue management, reservations, customer relationship management, finance, HR, recruitment, project management, marketing, social media, reporting and management dashboards. Our managers are expected to use AI as a practical working tool to improve productivity, decision-making, communication and reporting.

Beyond hotels and restaurants, BMG is developing an ecosystem that includes talent recruitment and development, BMG Academy, affiliate marketing, community programmes and digital media. These businesses are intended to support the hospitality platform by developing employees, creating additional distribution channels, building customer communities and creating new sources of revenue.

BMG's organisational culture is built around entrepreneurship, accountability, continuous learning and measurable performance. We believe technology should empower employees rather than replace the human relationships that remain fundamental to hospitality. Team members are encouraged to understand the commercial impact of their roles, develop leadership capabilities and continuously improve the systems they manage.

The company is currently focused on establishing and scaling its Singapore operations, with longer-term opportunities across selected Asian markets. As BMG grows, we are building a management team capable of creating repeatable operating systems that can support multiple hotels, restaurants and related businesses across different locations.

Our objective is to build more than a collection of hotels. We aim to develop an integrated hospitality ecosystem where accommodation, food, technology, talent, education, community and digital distribution work together to create stronger customer experiences, operational efficiency and sustainable long-term growth.

title: Head of Client Experience Marketing, Executive Director
description:

Work with Brand, Compliance, Legal, Risk and other relevant functions to ensure programs meet applicable brand, regulatory, safeguarding, gifting and entertainment requirements.

18+ years of relevant experience in client engagement, experiential marketing, branded programs or premium events, with a strong track record in senior leadership roles.
Experience in private banking, premier or priority banking, luxury, hospitality, lifestyle or a comparable premium consumer environment would be advantageous.
Proven experience translating business and brand strategies into high-quality experiential programs spanning experience design, curation, production and content amplification.
Experience building and evolving recurring experiential platforms or signature programs, rather than solely delivering one-off events.

Polished and credible, with the presence to engage senior stakeholders and clients across all segments, including affluent, high-net-worth and next-generation clients.

title: Contract Manager
description:

You'll lead a high-impact onboarding and implementation organization while driving process and digital change that improves the client experience at scale. We'll rely on you to balance daily delivery excellence with a clear transformation roadmap and strong risk discipline. You'll partner closely with product, technology, sales, compliance, and operations to remove friction and strengthen outcomes. If you thrive leading teams through change while delivering results, this role offers meaningful scope and visibility.

As the Head of APAC Payments Client Onboarding and Transformation (Executive Director) within Global Corporate Banking Onboarding, Asia Pacific, you lead the team responsible for client onboarding and implementation of payments solutions across the Asia Pacific (APAC) region. You'll ensure strong day-to-day delivery while building and executing a transformation agenda that improves speed, quality, and scalability. You'll use data and sound risk judgment to strengthen controls, surface issues early, and deliver consistent outcomes. You'll develop inclusive leaders and a high-performing culture where teams can do their best work through change. You'll collaborate across functions to simplify onboarding and improve the end-to-end client journey.

Our onboarding and implementation team sits at the intersection of client experience, operational delivery, and risk management. We focus on building repeatable, well-controlled processes that scale across markets, client needs, and product complexity. You'll work in a highly collaborative model with regional and global partners to modernize delivery and continuously improve client outcomes.

Job responsibilities
• Lead the day-to-day client onboarding and implementation for payments solutions, ensuring consistent execution, service quality, and control discipline
• Manage, coach, and develop people leaders and team members, setting clear expectations and accountability for outcomes
• Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to set expectations, manage milestones, and resolve issues throughout onboarding
• Drive transformation initiatives (for example, automation, workflow redesign, straight-through processing, and operating model improvements) while maintaining delivery performance
• Translate onboarding pain points into a prioritized roadmap with measurable outcomes, clear ownership, and sustained improvements
• Partner with product, technology, sales, compliance, and operations teams to simplify onboarding and reduce client friction
• Use operational data, client feedback, and performance metrics to identify trends, prioritize improvements, and communicate impact
• Build scalable operating rhythms for capacity planning, prioritization, and performance management across the organization
• Lead change adoption by aligning stakeholders, managing resistance, and ensuring training, controls, and governance sustain improvements
• Identify risks early, own issue resolution, and ensure appropriate governance, escalation, and control discipline

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
• Bachelor's Degree
• 10 years of experience leading transformation and complex service delivery in financial services or other industries
• 5 years of people leadership experience, including leading managers and building accountable, inclusive, high-performing teams
• Demonstrated experience delivering material transformation (process and/or digital) with measurable outcomes (for example, re-engineering, automation, workflow modernization, or operating model change)
• Experience in balancing business-as-usual delivery with strategic change, including managing priorities, capacity, and stakeholder expectations
• Strong risk and control mindset, including ability to identify issues, escalate appropriately, and implement sustainable controls
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders without direct authority
• Strong client and stakeholder management skills, including clear communication and structured problem-solving under time pressure
• Data and technology literacy, including ability to interpret operational metrics and use insights to improve performance and client experience
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready updates on progress, risks, and decisions

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
• Experience in onboarding and implementing payments, cash management, liquidity, or closely related treasury solutions
• Experience in leading regional or multi-market onboarding, implementation, or operations teams
• Familiarity with process improvement methodologies (for example, Lean, Six Sigma, or similar)
• Experience designing governance, controls, and operating rhythms that improve consistency at scale
• Cybersecurity and anti-fraud awareness, including protecting sensitive client data and strengthening onboarding integrity

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

ABOUT THE TEAM

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Manager, Internal Communications & Engagement
description:

Working closely with senior leadership, HR, and divisions across the organisation, you will play a key role in strengthening organisational alignment, supporting culture change, enhancing employee engagement, and building internal communications capability across Allkin. Internal Communications Strategy & Governance

Design engagement approaches that build awareness, understanding, adoption, and sustained behavioural change.

Proven experience developing and implementing communications or employee engagement strategies in a complex organisation.

Strong experience working with senior leaders and advising on organisational communications.

Excellent writing, storytelling, stakeholder engagement, and project management skills.

High emotional intelligence, sound judgement, and the ability to communicate sensitively during periods of change.

Strong facilitation, coaching, and influencing skills, with the ability to build communications capability across teams.

title: Brand Partnerships & Growth Specialist
description:
Crimson Education is the world’s leading college admissions consulting firm, with over 1,490 Ivy League offers and 2,410 to the US Top 15. We help ambitious students gain admission to the world’s top universities through expert-led guidance and proven, data-driven strategies. Crimson students are 7x more likely to get into the Ivy League than their peers. We were recently featured on the front page of the Wall Street Journal.

Crimson is the only college admissions consultancy that brings together:

Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications

Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation

Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards

Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation

We’re backed by leading VC firms, including Tiger Global, Heal Partners, IceHouse Ventures, and Movac, and recently closed a USD $40M Series D funding round at a USD $640M valuation. We now operate across 21 markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, and New Zealand.

Beyond college admissions consulting, Crimson offers a wide range of Enrichment programs designed to help students discover their interests, develop new skills, and achieve meaningful academic and extracurricular accomplishments. As we continue expanding our reach internationally, we're looking for a part-time Brand Partnerships & Growth Specialist to help introduce these programs to new audiences and strengthen their presence in key markets.

The role will initially focus on Indigo Research and Crimson Rise, two of our key Enrichment products. You’ll find creative ways to get them in front of the right students and families — whether through partnerships with leading schools and organizations, media and podcasts, creators, conferences, community placements, events, pop-ups, or other brand activations.

You’ll work closely with our marketing and leadership teams to identify opportunities others might miss and turn them into action. We’re looking for someone with strong existing networks who can open doors, generate ideas independently, and think commercially about how greater visibility can translate into audience growth, leads, and ultimately revenue.

Responsibilities include

Brand Growth & Opportunity Development

Identify creative ways to get Indigo and Rise in front of the right audiences – from media, podcasts, and creators to conferences, school and community placements, pop-ups, activations, and other unconventional opportunities.

Strengthen Indigo and Rise’s positioning across international markets, adapting ideas and messaging to local audiences while maintaining a consistent global brand.

Turn student, mentor, leadership, and company stories into compelling campaigns, content, PR, thought leadership, and other brand-building opportunities.

Develop and test creative market-specific ideas that build awareness and credibility, while considering how visibility can translate into audience growth, qualified leads, demand, and revenue.

Track results, identify what works, and recommend which channels, ideas, and initiatives we should scale.

Partnerships, Networks & Execution

Use your existing network – and continuously expand it – to open doors with journalists, creators, schools, education organizations, event organizers, companies, communities, and other influential partners.

Develop creative collaborations such as events, content partnerships, creator campaigns, webinars, competitions, community initiatives, and brand activations.

Proactively secure high-value media coverage, podcast appearances, speaking opportunities, conference placements, partnerships, and other forms of brand exposure.

Own opportunities end-to-end, from identifying the idea and making the introduction through pitching, execution, follow-up, and measuring impact.

What skills and experience you’ll need

5+ years of experience across brand marketing, partnerships, PR, growth, events, communications, or a related field.

Demonstrated experience building brands and creating growth opportunities across international markets.

An established, active network in at least one of our priority markets – the US, India, Singapore/Southeast Asia, or the Middle East – with relationships you can genuinely activate to open doors. This could include journalists, media outlets, schools, education organizations, event organizers, creators, influencers, community leaders, or other relevant partners.

A track record of independently spotting and creating opportunities – from partnerships and PR to events, creator collaborations, activations, and other forms of meaningful brand exposure.

A commercial mindset: not every brand activity needs to generate leads immediately, but you naturally think about how awareness and credibility can ultimately contribute to audience growth, demand, leads, and revenue.

Excellent written and spoken English, with strong pitching, storytelling, and communication skills.

Strong relationship-building skills and confidence approaching journalists, creators, organizations, partners, and senior external stakeholders.

Highly proactive, resourceful, and organized – you can take a broad objective, identify the right opportunity and people, and independently drive it from idea through execution.

What success looks like

Indigo and Rise become meaningfully more visible, relevant, and credible in the markets you own.

You consistently uncover opportunities we would not have found without you – new partners, creators, media, events, communities, placements, and creative ways to reach our target audiences.

Your existing network opens doors quickly, while the network you build becomes an increasingly valuable asset for Indigo and Rise.

Your initiatives generate measurable outcomes across brand awareness, audience growth, qualified leads, strategic relationships, and ultimately revenue.

You develop a clear understanding of what works in each market, learn quickly from what doesn’t, and scale the strongest ideas.

Why join us

Part-time, fully remote role with flexible working hours.

Help shape two education brands across multiple international markets.

High ownership and the freedom to turn good ideas into real campaigns, partnerships, and events.

Work with a global team of ambitious, curious people.

Please keep an eye on your spam/junk email folder for correspondence from Team Tailor.

title: Assistant Director
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Montfort Care is a vibrant workplace with a supportive culture where collaboration and camaraderie thrive. Our teams are highly cooperative, and colleagues genuinely care for each other. We celebrate diversity and innovation, united by our three core values: Resonance, Ingenuity and Stronger Together.

Expect a dynamic and fast-paced environment, as we are in an exciting phase of growth. Success here requires adaptability, agility, and the ability to navigate complexity. Our people stay with us because they find a strong sense of purpose and community, enjoying the opportunity to make a tangible difference in people's lives.

We offer a flexible work environment that values the importance of personal and professional growth. With plenty of opportunities for continuous learning and development, Montfort Care is an ideal place for those who want to grow their careers while contributing to meaningful change.

Join us to be part of an amazing team that's dedicated to making a difference and having fun while doing that!

RESPONSIBILITIES

The Strategy & Growth team is an organisation-wide capability-building function for Montfort Care (MFC), partnering with leaders and teams to address the organisation's most complex and pressing challenges. It combines strategic thinking, transformation expertise and implementation to strengthen organisational capabilities and achieve sustainable impact.

The

Assistant Director

, Transformation leads organisation-wide transformation initiatives that improve service effectiveness, operational efficiency and client experience. Reporting to the Director, Strategy & Growth, the role has a strong focus on rethinking service delivery through digital means while ensuring that services remain accessible and inclusive for clients who may face barriers to digital adoption. The portfolio also includes non-digital aspects that enable digital service delivery, including service redesign, process improvement, operating model changes and new ways of working.

Working closely with the Director, Strategy & Growth, leadership, service leaders and corporate service functions, the Assistant Director identifies high-value digital transformation opportunities and leads initiatives from discovery and business case development through experimentation, implementation, adoption and benefits realisation. The role applies user-centred, agile and data-informed approaches to translate organisational and client needs into scalable solutions.

The

Assistant Director

, Transformation develops the internal capabilities required to sustain new ways of working. The role champions responsible experimentation, digital confidence and continuous improvement, ensuring that transformation strengthens outcomes for clients and employees without leaving digitally less-confident users behind.

This is a high-visibility role with frequent opportunities to engage and present to the Chief Executive Officer and leadership team. The

Assistant Director

must understand strategic intent, exercise sound judgement and translate broad direction into coherent priorities, practical action plans and measurable outcomes. The role offers an opportunity for a transformation practitioner to step into a wider organisational remit and make a significant contribution to Montfort Care's service and organisational outcomes.

Organisation Strategy Alignment and Transformation Planning

Partner with leadership, service leaders, employees and clients to define the future of social service delivery and identify the operating models, capabilities and transformation priorities required to realise it.

Define measurable outcomes and benefits for transformation initiatives, including improvements in client experience, service effectiveness, employee productivity, adoption, accessibility, efficiency and cost, and establish mechanisms to track benefits from baseline through implementation and scale-up.

Lead research, horizon scanning and analysis of client needs, sector developments, emerging technologies and new service delivery models. Translate findings into clear opportunity statements and evidence-based recommendations for leadership consideration.

Work with leadership to shape and prioritise a portfolio of digital and non-digital transformation initiatives based on strategic relevance, client and employee value, feasibility, inclusion, risk, resource requirements and expected benefits.

Facilitating annual/ multi-year strategic planning cycles. Lead secretariat function to organize MFC's annual work plan; this includes pre-retreat planning, conduct of retreats, and organising of cascade briefs to middle managers and front liners.

Transformation Project Management

Map out and track transformation project progress against MFC's strategic objectives to ensure alignment of transformation projects to broader organisational goals.

Establish governance structure for identified transformation projects based on organisation priorities; e.g. project organisation, project charter, timelines, resources, and accountability.

Engage stakeholders to build understanding of transformation objectives and drive ownership of transformation objectives by service pillars.

Diagnose broad or ambiguous symptoms, frame clear problem statements and identify root causes through data analysis, user research and process mapping. Conceptualise and implement fit-for-purpose responses, which may include service redesign, digital solutions, process improvement, operating model or organisation structure changes, capability development, and leadership or culture interventions.

Coach and guide Transformation team and Service Pillar Heads on transformation frameworks, methodologies, change management approaches and best practices. Support leadership in resolving organisation-wide structural, operational, or cultural barriers to transformation success.

Together with Service Pillar Heads, Transformation team, Communications team, drive change management strategies to enable success of transformation projects.

Track and manage transformation project progress and risks to ensure timely delivery of transformation milestones.

Design and deliver a tiered digital capability programme that can be scaled across more than 400 employees, covering foundational digital literacy, role-specific skills and advanced capabilities for digital champions. Develop playbooks, communities of practice, coaching and practical learning interventions that build a digital-first culture while supporting employees with different levels of confidence and readiness.

Experimentation and scaling

Lead research, experimentation and pilots for new ways of delivering services. Define hypotheses and success measures, test solutions with employees and clients, evaluate evidence and risks, and recommend whether initiatives should be stopped, refined or scaled.

Vendor Management

Build and manage partnerships with technology providers, social service agencies, public-sector bodies, research institutions and other ecosystem partners or vendors to co-develop and deliver transformation initiatives. Establish clear outcomes, governance, responsibilities and performance measures for joint projects.

Manage and track KPIs of vendors to ensure service delivered meet our contractual needs.

Funding Management

Research relevant grants and funding opportunities, and develop use cases and applications that support digital and broader transformation initiatives. Manage funding commitments, budgets, milestones, reporting and benefit measures to ensure compliance and intended outcomes.

Plan yearly departmental budget and be accountable for the expenditure of these funds in support of MFC organisational objectives.

People Management

Lead and develop strategy and transformation teams to drive delivery of organisational objectives.

Foster a culture of innovation in the team to meet social mission and objectives.

Risk and Compliance

Understand IPC (Institute of Public Character) and charity organisations compliance and regulatory requirements and ensure adherence.

Identify and manage transformation risks, including data protection, cybersecurity, accessibility, ethical use of technology, vendor dependency, service continuity and unintended exclusion of clients. Work with relevant corporate service functions and funders to ensure that initiatives meet applicable regulatory, security and governance requirements.

Others

Responsibilities listed above are not exhaustive. From time to time, additional duties or projects may be assigned based on organisational needs.

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree from a recognised institution of higher learning in business, information technology, information systems, engineering, social sciences, public policy, organisational development or a related discipline. An advanced degree in business administration, information technology or a related field is advantageous.

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, Change management certifications (e.g. Prosci) is advantageous but not mandatory.

At least 7-10 years of progressive experience in management consulting, internal transformation, service design, digital transformation, innovation or major programme delivery, including demonstrated experience leading digital initiatives from problem de nition through implementation and adoption.

Prior experience in a major technology company, digital consultancy or technology-enabled organisation, with responsibility for delivering digital products or initiatives for internal or external users.

Experience in social sector, healthcare, or mission-driven organisations is advantageous. Candidates from other sectors with an interest in driving the change in the social service sector are encouraged to apply.

3-5 years of leading teams or major workstreams with a demonstrated ability to drive organisation-wide strategy and transformation projects. Hands-on experience in driving transformation planning, stakeholder engagement and governance.

Experience working with data, KPI, OKRs, dashboarding for reporting for leadership teams. Experience in driving process redesign, operating model/ organisation structure, skilling strategy, leadership and culture initiatives.

Demonstrated ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives, establish priorities based on organisational needs and delivery capacity, and build alignment across service, corporate and technology stakeholders.

Ability to lead concurrent initiatives using an agile, test-and-learn mindset while maintaining disciplined governance over scope, priorities, interdependencies, resources, risks and delivery commitments. The candidate must be able to adapt the approach when evidence or organisational needs change without allowing uncontrolled scope expansion.

Strong analytical ability & problem-solving skills to identify critical areas for action in a data-informed manner.

Executive presence and sound judgement to engage senior leadership, challenge assumptions constructively and in uence decisions, combined with the ability to explain complex transformation and digital concepts to frontline employees and non-technical stakeholders to build understanding and commitment.
