title: Vice President, Franchise Innovation
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Vice President, Franchise Innovation

About the Opportunity:
MasterCard operates the world’s fastest payment processing network, connecting consumers, financial institutions, merchants, governments and businesses in more than 210 countries and territories. Every day, everywhere, we use our technology and expertise to make payments safe, simple and smart. We know safety and security are the top priorities of our customers, cardholders and partners, so we won’t stand still in developing new and better ways to keep payments safe.

About the Role:
The Franchise Innovation team is passionate about doing well by doing good.
Our mission is to enhance and evolve our existing Franchise offerings - and to create the new business models and technology for our growing business in both new payments and data.

This role is part of specialized team focusing on innovative solutions to support Mastercard’s customers within the diverse Asia Pacific region enabling our business to expand into new opportunities where Franchise-enabled solutions can be leveraged to drive scale, enable interoperability, create compelling world class experiences for end users and deliver differentiating value to our customers.

This position has a dual reporting line into the SVP, Franchise AP regional lead and the SVP, Franchise Innovation vertical lead.

Accountabilities:
• Create and deliver on corporate strategies that drive innovative solutions for new business initiatives and product flows such as push-based account payments, digital assets (crypto, central bank digital currencies, identity solutions, open banking.
• Provide franchise thought leadership with regards to enabling new growth opportunities and improve pace of internal decision making for new rules developments
• Develop new concepts that support expanding the franchise and creating additional value for Mastercard and its customers, while at the same time ensuring the integrity of our assets
• Stay ahead of business trends related to new market and business opportunities; understand/communicate potential impact on licenses, rules, compliance and systems
• Provide direction for new products and new customer types to transform the payment ecosystem, based on nuanced regional/country landscapes advancement of industry rules and standards.
• Leverage input from internal stakeholders to enhance and align existing and new requirements on standards as well as Mastercard assets to enable Franchise growth
• Ensure new products/platforms will protect the brand integrity while driving new business and/or protecting existing business.
• Execute on the team goals to achieve Franchise priorities in tandem with regional business objectives;

Requirements:
• Extensive knowledge of our payments business and experience in account-based payments, crypto or open banking
• Attention to detail, strong business acumen and solutions-orientation are critical, as is an ability to demonstrate thought leadership
• Technical and/or product development experience
• Strong analytical, problem solving, agility and creative thinking skills
• Strong interpersonal skills with demonstrated cross functional/cross regional collaboration and teamwork
• Solutions oriented / results driven capabilities
• Ability to interact effectively with internal and external business partners
• Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written – ability to build compelling presentations
• Periodic travel required
• Bachelor’s Degree

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Sales Manager, Singapore
description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

As a global leader in Cardiac Rhythm Technologies, we focus on innovative technologies that can improve the way doctors treat people with heart arrhythmias, or irregular heartbeats.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:

• Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
• A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
• A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

As the Sales Manager, Singapore, you will drive sales performance of the business and provide coaching, customer and stakeholder management, performance management and resource planning.

What You’ll Do

• Own and be accountable for the development and execution of the sales plan to achieve business objectives and growth targets.
• Develop and implement marketing initiatives for the assigned territory in collaboration with the Regional Business Manager and Asia Pacific Marketing team to drive business growth and expand market presence.
• Establish and develop key reference sites to support physician training and customer education, in partnership with the Asia Pacific Marketing and Education teams.
• Manage and coordinate operational activities, including field support coverage, logistics, venue arrangements, trade shows, product launches, and customer engagement events. If needed, also need to support the field activities.

• Execute the job responsibilities according to applicable standard operating procedures of Abbott Medical.
• Ensure applicable standard operating procedures of Abbott Medical are executed.

Requirements

• Bachelor of Biomedical Science or Business Management or equivalent.
• 5 years’ experience in healthcare related sales.
• Some experience in people management preferred.

Location:

This position is based in Singapore.

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

Connect with us at www.abbott.com, on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott and on Twitter @AbbottNews and @AbbottGlobal.

title: Senior Manager / Manager, Communications, East Asia
description:
Why join Stryker?
Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

About the job:

The Communications Senior Manager / Manager will lead and execute strategic communications for the East Asia region within Asia Pacific. This role supports business objectives through internal and external communications, issues and crisis management, change management, and stakeholder engagement.

The ideal candidate is a proactive communicator with strong storytelling, writing, and interpersonal skills, passion for healthcare, regional experience, and most importantly, a hunger for growth and development.

Develops and implements communications strategies aligned with East Asia’s goals and priorities to promote and protect Stryker’s business and reputation among internal and external audiences.

Identifies gaps and implements processes to improve communications effectiveness.
Shares communications best practices with businesses, including communications strategies and plans drive greater consistency and effectiveness.

Internal Communications:

Crafts and delivers compelling internal messages to support employee engagement such as East Asia strategy and updates, leadership updates, organizational shifts.

Develop, maintain and optimize internal channels and ensure connectivity to rest of the company.

Stays connected to company-level crisis management team, plans and protocols.

Support the leadership visibility of East Asia VP/GM.
Serves as counsel to the East Asia leadership team.

Tracks and reports on communications effectiveness using KPIs and analytics.
Continuously optimizes strategies based on insights and feedback.

Others:

Works collaboratively with communications leads in and outside of APAC to build communications capabilities and advance opportunities that impact business goals.
Manages third party communication consultants and agency partners as needed.
Holds excellent standards on quality of work and thinking.
Works independently with resourcefulness and superb project management skills.
Brings great energy to the work and inspires trust and credibility among teams and wider stakeholders.

Who are we looking for:

Bachelor’s degree required
10+ years of Communications experience
Excellent storytelling, writing, and presentation skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to manage multiple projects while delivering on established timelines

Ability to influence stakeholders without authority
Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word & PowerPoint)

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Wealth Management Operations - Operational Transformation & Strategy Associate
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Are you a strong team player looking for an opportunity to further expand your exposure with one of the world's most innovative banks? We are looking for a highly motivated individual to support our Private Banking business where we serve the complex wealth management needs of our ultra-high net worth clients across the world.

As an Operational Transformation and Strategy Associate within the Wealth Management Operations team, you will drive intelligent automation initiatives that improve operational efficiency, increase capacity, reduce risk, and enhance the client and service experience. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

At least 5 years of relevant experience in intelligent automation, business/process transformation, or technology-enabled operations improvement.
Proven ability to independently deliver solutions end-to-end, including requirements deep dives, solution design/architecture and documentation, process and data analysis, solution build/configuration/development, testing support, and issue investigation/root-cause analysis.
Strong technical foundation with hands-on experience using intelligent automation tools and modern engineering practices, not limited to GitHub Copilot, Python, SQL, API integration.
Familiarity with applied AI/ML and GenAI concepts, core ML approaches, model evaluation, with an understanding of how to apply these responsibly to use cases.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across multiple business functions.

Experience with Wealth Management business processes.
Advanced technical and AI/ML skills.
Interest in emerging technologies and an innovative mindset.
Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes.

title: Commercial Manager
company: ASTER CHEMICALS AND ENERGY PTE. LTD.
description:
About Aster

Aster is a leading provider of energy, chemical, and infrastructure solutions in Southeast Asia, supplying products and services to various manufacturing industries in both domestic and international markets. It is a Chandra Asri-led joint venture with Glencore.

Since Chandra Asri Group's establishment in 1992, the Group has grown from strength to strength to build its reputation as a reliable growth partner, with strategically well positioned assets in Indonesia and Singapore.

The Group's total asset base includes a refinery with a capacity of more than 300,000 barrels per day with ongoing asset rejuvenation, alongside a 1.1 million metric ton naphtha cracker on Bukom Island, 2.5 million metric tons of downstream chemical assets on Jurong Island, and a 0.9 million metric ton naphtha cracker in Cilegon.

The company's business is supported by core infrastructure assets, including energy, electricity, water, jetty, and tank farm facilities.

For more information, visit www.aster.com.sg.

About The Role

This position will define, lead and execute strategies to deliver sustainable commercial value to the organization. You will own a range of categories and be responsible for managing the spend and contracts underlying these categories, from planning, sourcing, and negotiating to fulfilment. Beyond traditional category and contract management, you are also expected to unlock new business opportunities and manage the end-to-end process from origination to delivery. This role will work for you only if you have an unconstrained view of the world while still remaining grounded enough to get the job done.

Our organization is growing at an accelerated pace, both organically and through partnerships and acquisitions. This role will include portfolios which require you to manage key partnerships/accounts to align interests, negotiate win-win positions, monitor and manage performance, and develop continuous improvement and other business opportunities to solidify our partnerships.

Success in this role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Production, Finance, and Legal. The ability to influence stakeholders and navigate complex interdependencies will be critical to achieving business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Manage key external business partners, alliances, and supplier relationships to deliver business outcomes

Develop and lead execution of business strategies with strong focus on improving business performance

Develop and lead negotiation and commercial deal making strategies/tactics to deliver best commercial outcomes

Demonstrate innovation, agility, and ability to think and work “outside the box” while adhering to our business values and principles

Coach, develop, and inspire a team members and foster a culture of performance, accountability, and growth.

Capably manage internal stakeholders and over time masterfully navigate and steer team through internal decision making processes

Actively Monitor market trends and shifts and connect how these market shifts may potentially create risks or opportunities to our business strategies; Develop and execute risk management strategies

Understand and demonstrate leadership in terms compliance with our business controls, standards, policies as well as external legal/regulatory frameworks.

Advocate, champion or in some areas, sponsor use of digital tools and data-driven decision-making to optimize processes and reporting.

Promote synergy across business units within our group of companies, enabling standardization and best practice sharing.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain or related discipline. Postgraduate qualifications will be an added advantage.

Min. 10-12 years of working experiences in commercial, business development, supply chain, procurement or category management roles; Breadth of experience gained through exposure to diverse roles and responsibilities is a plus.

Excellent deal making, negotiation and business partnering skills; experience managing key strategic accounts is a must have.

Demonstrated experience managing complex stakeholder relationships across diverse internal and external groups, including multicultural and cross-functional environments.

Strong financial, commercial, analytical skills specifically ability to understand what drives business and financial performance, analyze levers to improve business results to improve shareholder returns.

We are a dynamic, fast pace organization with strong focus on results and outcomes. You must be comfortable working in an environment where you are constantly challenged by new ideas, strategies and learning new skills.

Strong verbal and written communication in English.

Work Location

Aster Chemicals and Energy Pte. Ltd.

460 Alexandra Road #07-01

mTower, Singapore 119963

We thank all applicants for their interest. Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Aster Chemicals and Energy is a leading provider of chemical and energy solutions in Singapore and in the Asia region. Building on the foundations of Singapore’s first oil refinery, Aster has a fully integrated refinery and petrochemical manufacturing operation on Pulau Bukom, and downstream chemical assets on Jurong Island.

title: Key Account Manager - Wholesale & Franchise
description:
About us

Love, Bonito is Southeast Asia’s leading womenswear brand, built with a mission to empower women to find confidence through style. Incorporated in 2010 in Singapore, we’ve since grown from a humble online startup into a multi-channel business with over 20 stores and counting across Asia and a thriving online presence.

For the next decade, we are looking to expand through new categories, markets, wholesale partnerships, and brand acquisitions. We are evolving into a next-generation regional consumer group — one that blends heart with performance, and creativity with technology.

At our core, we’re a team of builders, dreamers, and doers who believe culture is more than words on a wall — it’s how we show up every day. We move fast, stay curious, and take bold bets on ideas and people we believe in. Here, you’ll find a community that challenges you to grow, trusts you to lead, and celebrates you for being you. Together, we’re shaping the future of Asian brands — from right here in Southeast Asia, to the world.

Why join us?

At Love, Bonito, you’ll do more than just a job — you’ll help build a movement. We’re creating an organization that’s lean, bold, and full of heart — where every person has the space to make an impact. Here’s what you can expect:

Purpose with performance: We’re building a world-class Asian brand that competes globally. We hold ourselves to high standards and operate with purpose, integrity, grit and excellence. Join us if you take customer service excellence seriously and are passionate about creating real impact!
Growth that’s real: We are known to be incredibly dynamic and fast-paced. You’ll be expected to learn fast, stretch beyond your comfort zone, and work alongside people who challenge and support you in equal measure. Don’t join us if you’re looking for a comfortable, fully structured setup, but do join us if you’re excited to build, shape, and make an impact together!
Culture at our core: If you’re looking for a no-corporate-BS environment, you’ll fit right in. We lead with empathy, celebrate individuality, and believe that great work comes from trust, not titles. We believe in teamwork and effective collaboration - because when we run together, we go further. If this speaks to your values, come join us and be part of #TeamLB!

Join us as we redefine what it means to build an enduring global consumer group.

About the role

As the Key Account Manager - Wholesale & Franchise, you will own the operational and merchandising engine behind Love, Bonito's franchise and wholesale business — from full day-to-day ownership of partner accounts to quarterly buying, onboarding, SOPs, and performance reporting. Reporting to the VP of Business Development, you'll bring strong retail/merchandising judgment to partner buying sessions, coordinate closely with Marketing to ensure campaigns and activations land on the ground, and build the scalable systems that let the business expand across markets. This role is built for someone who leads with operational and merchandising expertise first, and who wants to grow into broader strategic ownership as the franchise network scales

Main responsibilities

1. Partner Relationship & Enablement and Operational Support

Act as day-to-day point of contact for partners: order queries, operations, marketing
Support partners in executing agreed marketing plans, coordinating with internal Marketing on asset delivery, global campaign plans and timing
Lead quarterly buying sessions with partners, curating styles (balancing brand vision, partner appetite and sell-through potential), preparing the buy sheet, ensuring order placements.
Review with internal Merchandising and VM teams the assortment planning recommendations for partners securing their support especially for new store and online channels launch needs.
Ensure franchise partners have the operational tools and training to uphold LB's global standards on brand, customer experience and retail ops
Coordinate with internal teams (IT, Ops) to brief and guide partners on LB website operations

2. Strategic & Growth Planning

Build yearly growth plans (marketing, expansion), sell-in/sell-out and inventory targets
Lead monthly business reviews with performance dashboards and data-driven insights
Own partner P&Ls: annual budgets, quarterly sales plans

3. New Partners Onboarding & New projects Execution Support

Oversee onboarding end-to-end: account setup, store launch, post-launch support
Manage store opening timelines (capex, store design coordination, first-buy ordering) and new online channels to launch (E.g. Tik Tok Shop, LB local website)
Coordinate with Retail Design (store build/design execution), acting as the commercial liaison to ensure partner requirements and timelines are met.
Build cross-functional project briefings to align stakeholders on new store/market opportunities
Run market-entry pilots to test and operationalize new or unproven markets

4. SOP Optimization and Reporting

Manage master timeline for seasonal collection launches (line sheet, buying, campaign sharing, product education, shipping, launch)
Develop, document, and implement SOPs across departments
Build/maintain the operations manual for cohesive execution across markets
Build/maintain consolidated performance dashboards; utilizing data-driven insights to identify operational bottlenecks and efficiency opportunities
Manage admin processes: P&Ls, invoicing, contract milestones

Requirements

Qualifications

6+ years of experience in retail/wholesale operations, buying, merchandising, or franchise/partner management in a fast-paced environment
Strong merchandising instinct — hands-on experience curating assortments, running buying sessions, and balancing brand vision with partner appetite and sell-through potential
Process-oriented mindset with demonstrated ability to build SOPs, operations manuals, and scalable systems from scratch
Experience with inventory management, retail supply chain, or partner/franchise enablement
Comfortable owning P&Ls, budgets, and quarterly sales plans; data-driven decision-making
Excellent cross-functional stakeholder management — able to align Merchandising, VM, Marketing, PMO/Retail Design, and IT/Ops around shared timelines and priorities
Familiarity with reporting/dashboarding tools; interest in using AI to streamline reporting is a plus
Growth-oriented: comfortable operating with hands-on operational and merchandising ownership today, with appetite to take on broader strategic planning as the role and franchise network scale
Willingness to travel up to 20% for market visits, partner meetings, and store openings
Self-starter with high ownership, structured thinking, integrity, and strong follow-through
A collaborative, humble teammate who thrives on building efficient systems and is eager to learn

title: Senior Programme Manager, Social Impact
description:
About TalentTrust

TalentTrust is an award winning IPC registered charity that exists to strengthen Singapore non-profits and their impact through skills-based volunteering. Since 2014, we have bridged the corporate and non-profit sectors by mobilising skilled volunteers to help build the capabilities of non-profit leaders and their organisations so these critical organisations can excel in the delivery of their missions.

At TalentTrust, our unique strength is collaboration. We bring together senior business professionals, non-profit leaders, and corporates to deliver a variety of capacity building programmes that help non-profits to upskill and scale.

In 2023, TalentTrust was recognised with the President’s Volunteerism & Philanthropy Award in 2023 as an Organisation of Good (Non-profit category).

As we enter a new phase of growth, we're seeking collaborative and strategic Programme Managers to shape and deliver high impact programmes that build non-profit capacity and elevate corporate volunteering.

Responsibilities

As part of our small, dynamic team, you will play a critical role in bringing TalentTrust’s mission to life for all of our stakeholders including our volunteer, non-profit, corporate and ecosystem partners.

Working closely with, and reporting to the Head of Programmes, you will be responsible for:

Successful development, implementation, and facilitation of corporate volunteering and non-profit capability building programmes such as training workshops, masterclasses, etc.

Conceptualise and design bespoke programmes for corporate and foundation clients, translating their strategic requirements into customised, scalable programme strategies.

End-to-end programme delivery, from scoping and planning to facilitation and stakeholder engagement — ensuring a high-quality experience and exceptional client satisfaction.

Project management of TalenTrust’s flagship Accelerator programme for non-profits - including monthly meeting scheduling, agenda planning, facilitation, note taking and follow up.

Build and sustain strong partnerships with senior volunteers, corporates, non-profits, foundations, and government partners.

Assist with outreach and recruitment of non-profit partners to build a healthy pipeline.

Contribute to the evaluation of TalentTrust’s impact through the collection of data and follow up with non-profits and corporate partners.

Actively contribute to TalentTrust’s fundraising and volunteer appreciation events.

Skills and Qualifications:

Minimum 5-7 years relevant work experience with an understanding of both corporate and non-profit landscapes.

Recognised degree relating to business, social sciences or related disciplines.

Expertise in programmatic design and design thinking methodologies for complex multi-phase initiatives.

Demonstrated project management experience, with a proven ability to run multiple projects from idea stage through to execution.

Outstanding stakeholder management skills, with solid experience engaging corporates, non-profits, foundations, and government partners.

Excellent facilitation and workshop delivery skills with the ability to lead and manage a room of C-suite business leaders.

Highly organized, self-motivated and results-oriented person with the ability to multi-task, prioritise and meet multiple deadlines to a high standard.

A strong team player, who works collaboratively across teams to achieve shared goals and drive impact.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to write and communicate ideas clearly and concisely.

Proven ability to balance high level strategic perspective while ensuring attention to operational detail.

Proficient in using office productivity tools such as Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive) and generative AI (e.g. Gemini).

talenTtrust is an IPC Charity that serves the community in Singapore through skills-based volunteering. We offer pro bono skills-based volunteering programmes to support charities looking to overcome organisational challenges and strengthen their operations.

Through the combined experience and expertise of our corporate volunteer network, we have worked with charities across the operational spectrum - strategic planning, fundraising, marcomms, leadership development and beyond.

title: Senior Marketing Specialist
description:
Grounded in a talent-centric mindset, Maker Lab is a marketing agency designed to build decentralised technology-led agency teams, rooted in collaboration with clients from the ground up. Maker Lab’s cross-functional teams of multidisciplinary specialists are embedded into client teams across digital marketing competencies — from measurement & analytics to content production.

Marketing Specialist to join us and work on exciting projects for our client - a leading video streaming service and their newest product. This role will see you work with global, regional, and local marketing managers and be responsible for driving campaign strategy and execution and laying the foundation for growth marketing and go to market activities in the region.

Support growth marketing, GTM planning and programme management for the client and its service in the region.
Project manage and execute growth marketing campaigns (e.g. brief development, media plan, experiment design, reporting results & learnings).
Lead localisation of campaigns across the region. Work with agencies to develop creative assets and localise them across multiple markets. Project manage localisation reviews of global and regional growth campaigns.

Strategic mindset and continuous curiosity, with a unique combination of data-driven decision-making and pragmatic bias for action.

Please note: due to the high volume of applications, only successful candidates will be contacted with a follow-up introduction email. Where your application contains personal data of third parties, you confirm that you have obtained all necessary consents to provide the Maker Lab team with such personal data and that we may collect, use and/or disclose such data in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act 2012. If you do not receive an email from Maker Lab, your application has been unsuccessful this time around. Look out for future roles!

title: Brand Manager
description:
Brand & Omnichannel Strategy:

Plan and execute marketing campaigns across all channels—both online (e-commerce, live streams, social media) and offline (retail outlets, pop-up events, trade shows).

Team Leadership & Management:

Directly manage and guide the internal team, including Marketing Designers (visual assets), Admins (operational support), and Live Assistants (stream execution).

Live Streaming & Campaign Execution:

Oversee live stream schedules, promotional mechanics, studio operations, and collaborate with live assistants and hosts to hit sales targets.

Creative Direction:

Review and approve marketing graphics, video content, and promo materials prepared by the designer to ensure consistent brand identity.

Performance & Budget Management:

title: Strategic Partnerships Lead
company: Cambridge Centre for Advanced Research and Education in Singapore Ltd
description:
Who are we?

We are the University of Cambridge research centre in Singapore called Cambridge CARES, sponsored by the

NRF CREATE program CAM.CREATE. Health-driven design for cities (HD4) is a collaborative research programme

between the University of Cambridge, NTU and NUS within Cambridge CARES.

The Health-driven design for cities (HD4) programme at Cambridge CARES will undertake research in the

following key areas: dynamic characterisation of the features of the environment that potentially impact health

in Singapore; understanding the links between environmental factors, individual behaviour and health

outcomes; observing the impact of environmental change on health in Singapore; simulating the impact of

potential changes on the health of Singaporeans; and working with government agencies to co-develop datarich

public health tools.

Who are we looking for?

Work Package 5 (WP5) is HD4's government and strategic partnerships work package. It exists to build and

sustain trusted relationships with the ministries, statutory boards, and agencies that hold the geospatial,

planning, and infrastructure data HD4's research depends on - and to translate HD4's research findings back into

forms that are directly useful for policy and strategic planning.

HD4 is looking for a Strategic Partnerships Lead to act as the programme's principal liaison with the Singapore

public sector for WP5. This is a senior, relationship-led role for someone who has served inside government and

understands how ministries and statutory boards operate, think, and make decisions - particularly agencies

involved in infrastructure, land use, and geospatial data (e.g. planning, transport, land administration, housing,

environment and Smart Nation / GovTech-related functions).

The successful candidate will work at the interface between government and research: opening doors to data

and problem statements, framing HD4's multidisciplinary research (spanning geospatial science, urban planning,

and public health) in terms that resonate with policymakers, and making sure research outputs land as

something agencies can actually use in evidence-based policymaking, strategic planning, and city-design

decisions that improve population health.

Key Responsibilities:

Government & agency engagement

Strategic liaison: Serve as HD4's primary point of contact for government ministries and statutory

boards engaged in WP5, building and maintaining senior-level relationships across relevant agencies.

Data access & partnerships: Work with agency counterparts to identify, negotiate, and facilitate access

to geospatial and related administrative datasets needed for HD4 research, navigating data-sharing

agreements, governance, and security requirements.

Problem-statement development: Engage agencies to surface real policy and planning problem

statements, and help shape these into well-defined, researchable questions that HD4's

multidisciplinary teams can act on.

Co-creation of research: Convene researchers and government stakeholders together to co-design

research questions, study designs, and pilots that are both scientifically rigorous and policy-relevant.

Strategic communications & knowledge translation

Strategic communications: Develop and drive HD4's communications strategy toward government

audiences - briefings, position papers, dashboards, and presentations that make complex,

multidisciplinary research (geospatial, planning, health) accessible to non-technical policymakers.

Evidence-to-policy translation: Translate HD4 research findings into actionable recommendations for

evidence-based policy, strategic planning, and city-design decisions aimed at improving population

health outcomes.

Decision-maker engagement: Prepare senior HD4 investigators and agency leadership for joint

briefings, working committees, and inter-agency forums; represent HD4 at relevant government

platforms and working groups.

Programme support

Internal bridging: Act as an internal “translator” between HD4 researchers and government partners -

helping researchers understand agency priorities, constraints, and timelines, and helping agencies

understand what research can (and cannot) deliver.

Stakeholder mapping & pipeline: Maintain a live map of government stakeholders, data-sharing status,

and collaboration opportunities across WP5, and report progress to HD4 leadership.

Multidisciplinary collaboration: Work comfortably alongside researchers, epidemiologists, urban

planners, data scientists, and public health colleagues, given the multidisciplinary nature of the HD4

programme.

What education, experience & skills do you have?

Education

Bachelor's degree required; a Master's degree is preferred - relevant fields include public policy, urban

planning, geography/geospatial science, public administration, engineering, public health, or a related

discipline.

Formal training or a track record in public policy or public administration (e.g. an MPA/MPP, or

equivalent Singapore Public Service leadership training) is an advantage.

No specific health/medical qualification is required - the emphasis is on the ability to work fluently

across disciplines, not on holding expertise in all of them.

Experience

Around 10-15 years of professional experience, including a substantial track record within the

Singapore Public Service at Senior Manager / Assistant Director level or equivalent (or comparable

seniority in a statutory board).

Cross-agency exposure: A career path that has rotated through, or included secondments/postings to,

ministries or statutory boards involved in infrastructure, land use, urban planning, or geospatial data -

example URA, SLA, HDB, LTA, JTC, PUB, NParks, MND, MSE, GovTech/SNDGO (OneMap and related

geospatial platforms), or similar.

Direct experience working with, or governing, geospatial or administrative datasets - understands datasharing

frameworks, data governance, and the practical realities of getting datasets released for

research or cross-agency use.

Experience engaging with, presenting to, or supporting senior government decision-makers (Directorlevel

and above), including preparing briefing papers, position papers, or Cabinet/inter-agency

committee materials.

Some exposure to, or comfort working alongside, the health or research sector is a strong advantage -

example prior collaboration with MOH, healthcare institutions, research institutes, or universities.

Experience managing multi-stakeholder projects or partnerships involving both public-sector agencies

and external partners (academia, industry or non-profits).

Track record of developing strategic communications materials (briefs, dashboards, reports) aimed at

senior non-technical audiences.

Skills

Stakeholder management: Proven ability to build and sustain trust-based relationships with senior

officials across multiple agencies simultaneously.

Strategic communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to produce clear,

persuasive briefing materials and to present confidently to senior audiences.

Negotiation & facilitation: Skilled at facilitating data-sharing discussions, aligning differing agency

priorities, and brokering agreement between parties with different incentives.

Data literacy: Comfortable discussing geospatial and administrative data at a conceptual level - does

not need to build the analysis, but must understand data-sharing mechanics, common data

formats/platforms (e.g. GIS, OneMap) and governance issues well enough to broker access.

Policy fluency: Understands how evidence feeds into Singapore public policy and strategic planning

processes, and how to position research findings to be actionable within those processes.

Project & programme management: Able to manage multiple concurrent agency relationships and

workstreams, track progress, and report clearly to programme leadership.

Cross-disciplinary collaboration: Comfortable working with researchers, epidemiologists and data

scientists as genuine thought partners, not just as a communications conduit.

(Desirable) Existing personal network across infrastructure, planning and geospatial agencies in

Singapore.

(Desirable) Prior involvement in a research collaboration, sandbox, living-lab or public-private

partnership initiative.

(Desirable) Familiarity with Singapore's Smart Nation initiatives and geospatial data platforms (e.g.

OneMap, national GIS infrastructure).

(Desirable) Experience with, or exposure to, health-in-all-policies, urban health or healthy-city design

concepts.

Please note that this post is mainly based in the CREATE Tower at NUS University Town, Singapore.

When is the position available and for how long?

The position is available for an immediate start and is offered on a fixed-term contract of 1 year in the first

instance, with the possibility of extension.

How to apply?

To apply, please send your CV and cover letter (summarising the most relevant skills and experience that you

have for the position) to https://employmenthero.com/sg/jobs/position/cambridge-cares-strategic-partnerships-lead-government-y0hdh/

Informal enquiries could be sent to the academic lead of the project: Prof Thomas Burgoine and A/Prof Yih Yng

Ng

CAMBRIDGE CENTRE FOR ADVANCED RESEARCH IN ENERGY EFFICIENCY IN SINGAPORE LTD. (CARES)

We are the University of Cambridge presence in Singapore, Cambridge CARES. Our activities are sponsored by the National Research Foundation’s CREATE programme. Our first research programme, Cambridge Centre for Carbon Reduction in Chemical Technology (C4T), is a collaboration between University of Cambridge, Nanyang Technological University and National University of Singapore.

Our team is comprised of world-class scientists and engineers working in a vibrant, fast-paced environment with great opportunities for knowledge and skills development. Further information on our activities can be found at www.cares.cam.ac.uk.

description:
Description

Growth Product Manager

Company: EPOS360 (a brand of Ant International)

Team: AI Commercial, Agentic Growth Team

Location: Singapore, with regional scope across Singapore and Malaysia

Reports to: Head of AI Commercial

About the Team

AI Commercial is one of four departments inside EPOS360 Agentic Growth Team (alongside Marketing,

Ecommerce, and Customer Success). AI Commercial and Ecommerce jointly own the sales/close

numbers for EPOS360, a B2B SaaS point-of-sale platform serving F&B SMEs across Singapore and

Malaysia.

Role Summary

This role owns chat as a growth channel and drives the go-to-market initiatives that run through it, using

data and experimentation to decide what to prioritize rather than instinct. This is a product and program

role, not a technical architecture role; you partner with engineering on execution rather than owning the

technical build yourself. Because growth and GTM work by nature touches marketing, BD, customer

success, and engineering at once, strong stakeholder management and the ability to keep initiatives from

stalling matter as much as product judgment.

Key Responsibilities

Chat as a Growth Channel

Own the roadmap for chat-based customer experiences from a business and customer-outcome perspective: what the chat should accomplish, for whom, and why

Define product requirements and user stories for chat features; partner with engineering on execution without owning the technical build

Own message and flow content decisions in partnership with marketing: what the bot says, when it hands off to a human

Go-to-Market Initiatives

Own go-to-market planning for new product and growth initiatives, sequencing launches against team and market capacity

Coordinate cross-functionally with marketing, BD/sales, and customer success to align launch timing, enablement materials, and messaging

Manage the GTM calendar and keep stakeholders aligned on dependencies and deadlines

Proactively unblock stalled launches and escalate early rather than absorbing delay silently

Data-Driven Growth Decisions

Define and track growth metrics for the chat channel (engagement, conversion, satisfaction) and use them to prioritize the roadmap

Design and run experiments (A/B tests on messaging, flows, sequencing) and turn results into concrete prioritization decisions

Feed channel performance into the team's existing attribution and CAC model so growth initiatives are measured consistently with other channels

Report growth performance and decisions to leadership on a regular cadence

Requirements

Requirements

• 3-5+ years of Product Management experience, ideally with growth or GTM experience in B2B SaaS

• Track record of managing cross-functional programs across 3+ stakeholder groups (marketing,

sales/BD, CS, engineering) without direct authority over them; able to speak to specific past

instances, not general philosophy

• Comfortable partnering with technical teams without needing deep architecture expertise

• Data literacy: comfortable reading dashboards and designing experiments to make prioritization calls

(SQL a plus, not required)

• Experience with messaging or chat products (WhatsApp, Telegram, or similar) a plus, not required

• Based in Singapore, with regional exposure to Malaysia market nuances

Nice to Have

• Experience with HubSpot or a comparable CRM

• Prior experience in F&B, retail, or SME-focused SaaS

Benefits

What Success Looks Like (first 6 months)

• A documented chat growth roadmap tied to clear business outcomes

• At least one GTM launch coordinated across 3+ teams and delivered on schedule

EPOS is a dynamic and fast-growing company dedicated to transforming the retail and F&B industry with high-performance tech solutions. We empower businesses to thrive by improving operational efficiency, enhancing customer loyalty, and unlocking unlimited growth opportunities.

We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment, where employees can grow and make an impact. As a team, we are passionate about supporting businesses and creating long-lasting value for our clients.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role with accountability for developing and executing commercial and trade marketing strategy, optimizing the route to market, building premium brands, and leading the local team ensuring sustainable profitable growth.

To lead the Singapore business with full P&L ownership, clear commercial and brand agenda, delivering NSV, market share and brand equity growth through strong market leadership, effective route-to-market management, disciplined execution, a high-performing team culture and cross-functional collaboration.

Description

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd

The World Bank Group is one of the world’s largest sources of funding and knowledge for developing countries. Our mission is to end extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet. We work to drive impactful development that is: i) inclusive of everyone, including women and young people; ii) resilient to shocks, including against climate and biodiversity crises, pandemics and fragility; and iii) sustainable, through growth and job creation, human development, fiscal and debt management, food security and access to clean air, water and affordable energy.
The EAP Infrastructure Department is responsible for project lending and policy advisory work in the energy; transport; urban, land, and resilience, and related climate action and private capital mobilization space for the EAP Region. The department presently comprises an energy and extractives unit, a transport unit, and two urban units.

The energy unit [IEAE1] manages a diverse program of projects, analytic and advisory work. The principal themes underlying the lending and advisory engagements include access to modern energy services; transitioning to a clean energy mix away from coal; climate resilient energy infrastructure; regional energy connectivity, integration and trade; governance reforms and financial strengthening of state-owned enterprises/utilities; and reforming sector regulations to improve the environment for efficient private finance solutions

Duties and accountabilities:

The Senior Energy Specialist will bring a strong track record of leading high-level policy dialogue, advancing regional power integration, and mobilizing private capital for power-sector projects. The successful candidate will combine deep knowledge of policy, regulation, and institutional reform with hands-on experience in project finance, transaction structuring, risk allocation, and private-sector participation. The candidate will also have strong operational experience in project design, implementation, and supervision, including regional and cross-border initiatives. Key responsibilities include:

• Conceptualize and lead investment operations that leverage private capital for energy projects, including ASEAN Power Grid (APG) interconnections and related transmission infrastructure, and/or energy sector operations. Responsibilities include early-stage concept development, project structuring, financial and economic analysis, institutional arrangements, and risk assessment.

• Lead high-level policy dialogue with governments, ASEAN institutions, regulators, utilities, and private-sector stakeholders on cross-border electricity trade, power-market development, investment frameworks, and an enabling environment for private capital mobilization in Southeast Asia.

• Supervise an active portfolio of national and regional lending operations, including Investment Project Financing (IPF) and Program-for-Results (PforR), and apply a strong understanding of guarantees and other risk-mitigation instruments relevant to electricity projects.

• Engage bilateral and multilateral partners, regional organizations, and financing institutions to coordinate support and mobilize resources for APG priorities and other regional energy activities.

• Lead sector analysis and advisory activities on regional power trade, transmission planning, market design, regulatory and institutional frameworks, and the financial and technical performance of power-sector entities.

• Prepare regional, country, and sector briefings, background reports, case studies, and portfolio reviews, energy connectivity, and private financing, ensuring outputs are timely, technically sound, and aligned with program messaging.

• Identify knowledge gaps and develop innovative financing, guarantee, and risk-allocation approaches for energy projects, including cross-border interconnections and associated infrastructure.

• Organize knowledge exchanges and contribute to publications and communications that share operational lessons on cross-border power trade, and private capital mobilization.

• Participate actively in EAP Energy Practice-wide knowledge sharing and contribute to regional and global communities of practice on energy finance and power-system integration.

Selection Criteria

• Master's degree or higher required, in economics, finance, engineering, or a closely related discipline. A combination of financial training with economics and/or engineering is an advantage.

• Minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience in the energy sector, with a strong track record in project preparation, implementation, and supervision. Experience in project finance, regional power integration or cross-border electricity trade, and multilateral development bank operations is highly desirable.

• Demonstrated experience with a range of IBRD, IFC, or MIGA financing instruments, including guarantees and other risk-mitigation approaches, is a significant advantage.

• Experience in Southeast Asia and familiarity with ASEAN energy cooperation, the ASEAN Power Grid, and the region's electricity-sector context is an advantage.

Technical Skills and Professional Competencies

• Strong financial and economic analysis skills, including experience with sector, utility, transmission, and project-level modeling.

• Deep knowledge of energy-sector topics, including power-sector engineering, financing, regional power markets, transmission planning, and related regulatory, commercial, and institutional frameworks.

• Familiarity with World Bank or other multilateral development bank operational policies, including fiduciary and environmental and social standards, is an advantage.

• Collaborative and team-oriented, with demonstrated ability to work across countries, institutions, and disciplines; share information proactively; and align country and regional workstreams.

• Strong communication and stakeholder-engagement skills, with proven writing and editing ability and the capacity to convey complex technical and financial issues clearly to diverse audiences.

• Self-driven and proactive, with the ability to work with a sense of urgency and manage competing demands under tight deadlines.

• Positive, solutions-oriented approach to problem-solving and client engagement.

• Intellectual curiosity and openness to innovation in development approaches.

• International mobility without restrictions and willingness to undertake frequent travel within Southeast Asia and the wider East Asia and Pacific region.

• Professional proficiency in English required.

As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:

Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
Bring experience working in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.

2. Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
3. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

description:

You will partner closely with Business Marketing leadership, cross-functional partners and our external global sales partners to lead marketing strategy that supports revenue goals.

What you'll do:

Develop scalable processes to enable our global sales partners in the region, offering consultation and guidance to ensure their success
Work closely with local and global teams to ensure that global programs resonate locally and meet local sales and marketing needs.
Measure the impact of local marketing initiatives and adjust strategies as needed to achieve business goals
Manage budgets, timelines, and resources to ensure successful execution.

What we're looking for:

Minimal 6-8 years experience in integrated marketing including previous experience working with resellers/agencies
Strong comfort level with B2B marketing
Must have proven integrated marketing experience in the Greater China region including deep understanding of local insights, media landscape, and digital platforms.
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Excellent organisational and project management skills to effectively handle multiple projects, stakeholders and deadlines
Fluency in business Mandarin, Simplified Chinese and English is a must.
Strong written and verbal communication/presentation skills across the above languages to influence internal and external partners
Familiarity with social media platforms and their advertising capabilities, with a specific focus on Pinterest (prior experience a plus)
Basic analytical skills, with the ability to learn how to analyse data and derive actionable insights
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business or equivalent work experience

 This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.

title: Executive, Fundraising & Partnerships
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Founded in 1978 as Singapore's first family service centre, Allkin Singapore is a community-centric social service agency that believes everyone has the potential to create positive change, regardless of age, race, or background.

Through our service offerings, strategic partnerships, and community initiatives, we unlock opportunities for vulnerable individuals and families to overcome life's challenges, build a brighter future, and inspire others to do the same.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Allkin Singapore is a social service organisation that believes in the power of community to drive change. We work alongside partners and residents to strengthen families, build social connections, and foster a culture of care and contribution.

As Executive, Fundraising & Partnerships, you will play a key role in supporting fundraising initiatives and strategic partnerships that help sustain and grow our impact. Working closely with the Senior Executive, you will contribute to donor engagement, partnership development, fundraising campaigns, impact reporting, and stakeholder stewardship. This role is ideal for a resourceful and organised individual who is passionate about building meaningful partnerships and advancing positive social outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Fundraising & Donor Development

Research and identify prospective donors, corporate partners, foundations, grantmakers, and funding opportunities.

Support donor outreach, cultivation, and engagement activities.

Develop grant applications, partnership proposals, sponsorship decks, donor presentations, and fundraising collateral.

Work with programme teams to gather programme information, funding needs, budgets, impact data, and beneficiary stories.

Maintain and track the fundraising pipeline, including donor engagement status and follow-up actions.

Donor & Partner Engagement

Support the stewardship and engagement of donors, corporate partners, foundations, and key stakeholders.

Coordinate donor meetings, site visits, appreciation activities, and partnership engagements.

Manage donor communications, acknowledgements, and recognition requirements.

Ensure timely fulfilment of partnership and sponsorship commitments.

Build and maintain positive, long-term relationships with donors and partners.

Impact Reporting & Accountability

Compile programme outcomes, impact data, and beneficiary stories for donor reporting.

Prepare donor impact reports, partnership updates, and stewardship materials.

Track reporting timelines, funding utilisation, and donor requirements.

Support data collection and impact tracking to demonstrate the outcomes of donor and partner support.

Fundraising Campaigns & Events

Support the planning and execution of fundraising campaigns, events, and community fundraising initiatives.

Coordinate internal teams, partners, vendors, and service providers to ensure successful event delivery.

Work with the communications team to develop fundraising content and campaign materials.

Assist with post-campaign reporting, evaluation, and donor follow-up activities.

Operations & Administration

Maintain accurate donor, donation, and partnership records within relevant systems.

Support fundraising reporting, budget tracking, invoice processing, and reconciliation activities.

Monitor fundraising performance and prepare regular management updates.

Ensure proper documentation and compliance with governance, audit, and reporting requirements.

Manage fundraising and partnership enquiries through shared mailboxes and communication channels.

QUALIFICATIONS

Diploma or Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Social Sciences, or a related field.

At least 3 years of relevant experience in fundraising, partnerships, marketing, stakeholder engagement, or a related function.

Prior experience in the social service or non-profit sector is preferred but not essential.

Skills and Competencies:

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with diverse stakeholders.

Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

Experience in donor management, event coordination, CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce), and digital marketing will be an advantage.

Personal Attributes

Passionate about community impact and committed to advancing Allkin Singapore's mission through meaningful partnerships and fundraising initiatives.

Proactive, resourceful, detail-oriented, and able to work independently.

Professional integrity with a collaborative, customer-centric approach and commitment to excellence.

OTHER INFORMATION

title: Senior Director, Corporate Strategy
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa’s Asia Pacific Corporate Strategy team based in Singapore plays a key role in shaping Visa’s long-term strategy in the region and solving for regional and country-specific opportunities and challenges, in partnership with executives and business leaders across Visa’s organization. Recent initiatives have addressed topics such as market strategy, product strategy, multi-year planning, and organic / inorganic growth opportunities across the region. The team is also responsible for developing thought leadership on emerging trends in payments industry.

What a Senior Director of Corporate Strategy does at Visa:

The Senior Director will be a member of Visa's AP Corporate Strategy team, which is responsible for development of regional and market-specific strategy efforts. As a strategist, the individual will work with and support key areas of the business – both across functions and geographies – in conducting analysis to support development of strategies in alignment with the regional and global priorities. This role will also support regional business planning needs, monitoring of competitive developments across the region / globally, and development of timely response to emerging trends and opportunities across AP. The position will be based in Singapore with some travel expected.

This Senior Director role in the AP Corporate Strategy team supports the AP Regional Head of Strategy in the formulation, analytical review, preparation and communication of the AP strategy and associated Sub Regional and Market Strategy plans. A typical effort may entail working closely with senior stakeholders to understand and logically structure the problem, develop hypothesis, work with cross-functional teams to validate the hypothesis, develop strategy to address the problem, and develop recommendations and execution plan to present to the AP Regional President and the leadership team. The Senior Director is expected to lead end-to-end strategy efforts independently or with a small team of analysts depending on the scope and complexity of the effort. The strategy efforts can range from developing country strategies to developing multi-year plans for the region, addressing emerging competitive and economic model issues, managing commercial response to regulatory changes, developing go-to-market plans for new solutions, and supporting strategic investment assessments.

Why this is important to Visa:

The AP Corporate Strategy team is responsible for helping the senior leadership team in setting the strategic agenda for Visa in AP in close alignment with the Global Corporate Strategy. In close alignment with the regional and global leadership team, you will be instrumental in defining, planning and executing long-term strategic priorities that will set Visa (encompassing all our segments, channels and geographies) on a path to create even greater value for Visa’s shareholders.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

What you will need for this role:
We are looking for an individual with a structured mindset, curiosity about the payments industry, is results-driven, and client focused. As an ideal candidate, you should have:

Bachelor or Master’s degree preferably in Economics, Business or similar fields
15+ years of experience in leading strategy projects at top-tier Management Consulting firms or in a Corporate Strategy group in a multinational environment
Pro-active and effective communicator, experienced in presenting information to all levels and with ability to facilitate group discussions and debate
Ability to lead cross-functional teams and proven experience of project management
Strong interpersonal and execution skills
Strong analytical and strategic acumen
Excellent presentation and verbal and written communication skills
Able to manage work in different time zones effectively
Ability to be recognized as thought leader
Ability to influence the organization in order to make strategy happen
Professional, confident and outgoing with the ability to maintain good communication with wide internal and external audiences
Team player possessing a strong drive to add value to the business direction
Highly numerate with attention to detail and ability to structure and analyze databases and strong knowledge of financial modelling, scenario-building and analysis

What will also help:

Financial Services / FinTech / Payment industry experience would be a distinct advantage
Broad understanding / experience in financial services and / or payments a plus

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
At Sephora, beauty is about feeling seen, valued, and empowered, individually and collectively. It is connecting deeply with others, celebrating diversity and inclusivity, unlocking your potential and making a difference every day. Together, we belong to something beautiful.

Sephora SEA’s omni channel business spans over 8 countries (Australia, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand) with 100+ stores and boasts some global flagships such as ION and Raffles City in Singapore, F88 in Kuala Lumpur and Pitt Street in Sydney. Sephora SEA is experiencing rapid growth in the region with new store openings and business channels (i.e., Click and collect and marketplace).

Senior Legal Counsel, SEAO

Sephora, the world’s leading prestige beauty retailer and part of the LVMH Group, is seeking a commercially minded and highly collaborative Senior Legal Counsel to join our Legal team in Singapore. Sephora Southeast Asia and Oceania serves customers across a diverse and fast-growing region through a compelling omni-channel beauty experience, combining retail, digital, technology, and expert service.

Reporting to the Head of Legal, the Senior Legal Counsel will act as a trusted legal advisor and strategic business partner to Sephora’s SEAO business. The role will provide practical, risk-balanced, and commercially focused legal advice across a broad spectrum of matters, including commercial contracting, compliance, privacy, digital and technology, retail operations, consumer protection, marketing, intellectual property, and disputes. While the role spans the full legal function, particular emphasis will be placed on technology contracting and data protection/privacy.

This is a broad regional role suited to a self-driven legal professional who combines strong technical legal expertise with sound business judgment, stakeholder influence, and a commercially pragmatic approach to problem solving. The successful candidate will work closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to enable business growth, protect Sephora’s interests, and strengthen a culture of compliance across the region.

You will shine here if you enjoy...

Strategic Business Partnership & Legal Advisory

Act as a trusted legal advisor to business leaders across Southeast Asia and Oceania, providing pragmatic and commercially sound legal guidance.
Partner closely with Retail, Digital, E-Commerce, Marketing, Merchandising, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, Technology, and Franchise teams to support business initiatives and strategic priorities.
Identify legal and regulatory risks and provide practical recommendations that balance business objectives with appropriate risk management.
Support business growth, expansion initiatives, new operating models, partnerships, and strategic projects across the region.
Translate complex legal concepts into clear, actionable advice for stakeholders at all levels.

Commercial Contracting & Business Transactions

Draft, review, negotiate, and advise on a broad range of commercial agreements, including technology, software, SaaS, cloud and digital services agreements, e-commerce or platform-related agreements, logistics and supply chain agreements, marketing and advertising agreements, and professional services and consulting agreements. This includes acting as the primary point of contact for technology-related contract negotiations region-wide.
Review marketing campaigns, promotions, and advertising content for regulatory compliance across SEAO markets
Develop and maintain legal templates, playbooks, and guidance materials to improve contracting efficiency, consistency, and stakeholder experience.
Support contract lifecycle management processes and continuous improvements in legal service delivery.

Compliance, Privacy & Regulatory Governance

Serve as a key legal advisor on data privacy and protection matters, including negotiating data processing agreements and providing guidance on marketing, CRM and other customer-facing initiatives
Provide guidance on regulations relating to consumer protection, marketing and advertising, intellectual property and general corporate or commercial matters across multiple jurisdictions within Southeast Asia and Oceania
Support the development, review, and implementation of policies, procedures, governance frameworks, workflows, and legal guidance materials.
Design and deliver practical legal and compliance training programs to increase awareness and strengthen a culture of compliance.
Monitor emerging legal and regulatory developments and proactively advise business stakeholders on potential impacts.

Disputes, Investigations & Risk Management

Manage and advise on contentious matters, including customer complaints, product liability matters, commercial disputes, regulatory inquiries, investigations, and enforcement matters.
Partner with business leaders to assess exposure and implement practical mitigation strategies.
Support crisis management and business continuity activities requiring legal input.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external counsel to achieve timely and commercially appropriate resolutions.

External Counsel Management & Legal Operations

Manage relationships with external legal counsel across the region, ensuring high-quality advice, practical outcomes, and cost-effective support.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives across legal operations, including legal technology adoption, contract automation, knowledge management, process simplification, and service delivery enhancements.
Contribute to the ongoing development of the legal function through best-practice sharing, guidance, mentoring, and coaching where appropriate.

We would love to hear from you if you have ...

Experience & Qualifications

Qualified lawyer in Singapore or another common law jurisdiction, with 7–10 years of post-qualification experience.
Experience in a top-tier law firm and in-house legal role within a multinational organization.
Strong regional experience across Southeast Asia, APAC, or other multi-jurisdictional markets.
Experience in consumer, retail, FMCG, e-commerce, technology, or digital industries is preferred.

Technical Expertise

Strong expertise in technology contracting, data privacy, commercial contracts, and negotiations.
Good knowledge of consumer protection, e-commerce, marketing regulations, and intellectual property.
Ability to translate legal and regulatory requirements into practical business advice.

Leadership & Personal Attributes

Strong commercial acumen, judgment, and stakeholder management skills.
Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Able to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
High integrity, professionalism, and discretion. Additional Asian language skills are an advantage.

Here, you will find:

Community, in which authenticity is embraced, and the strength of our differences fuels our collective spirit
Culture of empowerment, learning & growth, that offers you the tools, space and opportunity to learn, innovate and lead
Work that brings fulfilment, from delighting clients every day, to inspiring our industry at large, every action makes a difference

It is in the Sephora DNA to champion a world of inspiration and inclusion where everyone can celebrate their beauty. You can be yourself, because you are what sets us apart. Join us and belong to something beautiful.

Sephora is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace for all. We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, or other employment practices. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating and fostering an inclusive environment for all employees.
