title: Investor Relations Director (Singapore)
description:
ABOUT ARCHIMED

With offices in Europe, the US and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare. Our mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise positions us as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Priority areas include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools and Biologic Services, MedTech and Pharma Services. ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services.

ARCHIMED manages $11 billion across its funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based GP. MED I, MED II and MED Platform I are all top-decile performers for their vintage according to Preqin data. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation.

THE TEAM

An international team (French, British, German, Polish, Canadian, US, Japanese) with complementary backgrounds across investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational disciplines.

Alumni of INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, École des Ponts ParisTech, ESSEC, Imperial College and Dartmouth, among others.

Professional backgrounds spanning Private Equity (3i, Siparex, USS Ltd, Barings, Capiton, Partners Group), Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), M&A (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC) and Industry (Biotronik, Cerba, pharmacy and veterinary).

THE ROLE

Reporting to the Head of Investor Relations, the Director of Investor Relations will play a leadership role in the strategic direction and execution of ARCHIMED's global capital formation and LP engagement efforts. This is a senior, high-visibility position with direct exposure to the firm's Partners and leadership, significant LP-facing responsibility and ownership of material components of the IR function.

FUNDRAISING LEADERSHIP

Partner with the Head of Investor Relations and firm leadership to shape fundraising strategy across flagship funds, co-investment vehicles and GP-led secondaries, including market positioning, investor segmentation and campaign sequencing.
Own the end-to-end production of institutional-quality fundraising materials (PPM, DDQ, pitch decks, VDR, track record analytics) and manage the legal and structural workstreams alongside external counsel and service providers.
Serve as a senior external voice for the firm. Represent ARCHIMED at investor conferences, industry events and LP meetings, and articulate the firm's strategy, performance and impact thesis with credibility and precision.
Build, deepen and independently manage a portfolio of global LP relationships across sovereign wealth funds, pension plans, insurance companies, endowments, foundations, fund of funds, family offices and consultants. Identify and cultivate new pools of capital to support the firm's growth trajectory.
Lead select roadshows, drive pipeline development and hold direct accountability for LP commitments and conversion metrics.

IR FUNCTION OWNERSHIP

Oversee the operation of the firm's IR program, including quarterly and annual fund and co-investment reporting in partnership with Finance, Impact and Investment Teams.
Own LP servicing including capital calls, distributions, information requests, secondary transfers and bespoke LP workstreams, and establish the standards and playbooks that scale with AUM growth.
Lead the planning and delivery of the Investor AGM and other flagship LP events in close coordination with the Communications team.
Mentor and develop junior IR team members and contribute to the build-out of the function as the platform grows.

CO-INVESTMENTS, GP-LED SECONDARIES AND STRATEGIC VEHICLES

Drive the firm's co-investment program with existing LPs and the broader institutional community, working alongside deal teams to syndicate opportunities efficiently and on favorable terms.
Contribute to the strategic evolution of ARCHIMED's fund platform by structuring and leading GP-led secondaries, continuation vehicles and other bespoke capital solutions where appropriate.

Requirements

Senior IR professional with approximately 10 to 15 years of relevant experience in investor relations, fundraising or LP coverage within private equity or alternative asset management. Prior experience raising institutional capital at scale is essential.
Established network of institutional LP relationships across multiple geographies, with a demonstrated ability to manage complex relationships independently and convert dialogue into commitments.
Strong financial acumen. Fluency with fund structuring, LPA terms, performance metrics (gross and net IRR, TVPI, DPI, PME), portfolio analytics and the quantitative diligence expected by sophisticated LPs.
Deep knowledge of market practice, fund terms, fee structures and the competitive landscape in healthcare and broader PE.
Exceptional communicator. Able to translate complex investment theses, industry dynamics and deal structures into clear, factual narratives for the most sophisticated audiences.
Commercial mindset and entrepreneurial orientation. Capable of identifying new market opportunities, new channels and new product formats to expand AUM.
Proven ability to operate in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities and deliver under pressure without sacrificing quality.
Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills. Fluency with IR CRM systems (Dynamo, Backstop, Altvia or similar) preferred.
Higher education degree in finance, economics or business administration. CFA or MBA a plus.
Embodies ARCHIMED's cultural values of inclusion, meritocracy, partnership, accountability, client focus and trust.

Melbourne International School (MIS) caters for a range of children with special needs. It is for students from 3 years of age through to 18 years.

Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building abilities.

Self-motivated with a hunter mindset — comfortable with cold outreach and closing deals.

Existing network or working relationships with KOLs, professional traders, or crypto community leaders.

title: Senior Director, Sponsorships Commercialization
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Role Overview:

The Senior Director, Sponsorships Commercialisation – Asia Pacific, is a senior leadership role responsible for end-to-end commercialisation of Visa’s global and regional sponsorship assets across Asia Pacific.

This role will lead the strategy, monetisation, and execution of sponsorship-led client marketing programs, transforming sponsorships into a scaled, Marketing Services revenue-generating, Brand building and Core Revenue supporting functon. You will drive commercial outcomes, establish operational rigor, and partner with regional and market teams to embed sponsorships into client growth strategies.

As a member of the AP Marketing Services leadership team, you will act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, shaping how Visa maximizes return on its sponsorship investments while delivering measurable revenue growth and client impact.

What a Senior Director, Sponsorships Commercialisation does at Visa:

Strategic Leadership & Commercial Growth:

Own the commercialisation strategy for Visa’s sponsorship portfolio across Asia Pacific, translating global assets into scalable, revenue-generating client propositions that also strategically drive Visa Brand awareness and core consumer revenue.
Drive incremental revenue, pipeline development, and contribution margin through sponsorship-led solutions
Position sponsorships as a core lever in client growth strategies, aligned to Visa’s business priorities and client needs
Identify and scale new revenue streams (e.g., gaming, emerging platforms, new partnership models)

End-to-End Sponsorship Commercialisation:

Lead the monetisation of sponsorship assets across key properties (e.g., Olympics, FIFA World Cup, NFL, Formula 1), ensuring strong ROI and measurable business outcomes
Establish clear frameworks to price, package, sales assets and sell sponsorship-led marketing solutions to clients.
Partner with Sales, Account Executives, and Client Marketing teams to embed sponsorships into client engagements and go-to-market plans
Drive forecast accuracy, pipeline visibility, and revenue tracking across all sponsorship initiatives

Execution Excellence & Operational Rigor:

Build and lead a commercialisation engine that drives consistent, high-quality execution across markets
Oversee end-to-end delivery including client engagement, activation planning, onsite execution, and performance tracking
Institutionalize processes across contracting, legal, governance, and financial management to support scaled delivery
Drive internalization of capabilities to reduce external agency reliance and improve cost efficiency and control

Client & Stakeholder Leadership:

Serve as the senior sponsorships advisor to regional leadership, country teams, and key clients
Build strong partnerships across Marketing, Sales, Product, and global sponsorship teams to align strategy and execution
Influence senior stakeholders to prioritise sponsorship-led opportunities and investments
Represent AP in global forums, shaping sponsorship strategy and ensuring regional needs are reflected

Team Leadership & Capability Building:

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Sponsorships Commercialisation team across Asia Pacific
Create a strong culture of commercial accountability, performance, and execution excellence
Coach and mentor team members and broader Marketing Services teams on sponsorship strategy and commercialisation
Drive capability uplift across markets to ensure consistent execution standards and best practice sharing

Why this is important to Visa:

Sponsorship investments are a critical component of Visa’s brand and business growth strategy. As these investments scale, Visa must unlock stronger commercial outcomes, moving from activation-led models to a disciplined, revenue-driven approach.

This role is central to delivering that transformation—ensuring sponsorships become a differentiated, scalable growth engine that drives measurable impact for both Visa and its clients.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

What you will need:

Proven senior leadership experience in marketing, sponsorships, commercialisation, or revenue-driven marketing services
Strong track record of driving revenue growth, pipeline development, and commercial outcomes
5+ years of sports sponsorship and partnership experience
Deep understanding of client marketing, co-marketing models, and partnership-driven growth
Experience working across complex, matrixed, and regional organisations with senior stakeholder influence
Strong commercial acumen with ability to translate marketing investment into measurable business outcomes
Demonstrated experience leading and developing high-performing, geographically dispersed teams

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: People Director, MEA and APAC
description:
About us:

Dow Jones is a global provider of news and business information, delivering content to consumers and organizations around the world across multiple formats, including print, digital, mobile and live events. Dow Jones has produced unrivaled quality content for more than 130 years and today has one of the world's largest news-gathering operations globally. It is home to leading publications and products including the flagship Wall Street Journal, America's largest newspaper by paid circulation; Barron's, MarketWatch, Mansion Global, Financial News, Investor's Business Daily, Factiva, Dow Jones Risk & Compliance, Dow Jones Newswires, OPIS and Chemical Market Analytics. Dow Jones is a division of News Corp (Nasdaq: NWS, NWSA; ASX: NWS, NWSLV).

About the Role

We’re looking for a People Director MEA and APAC that is smart, has high emotional intelligence, and possesses an appreciable sense of humour. You will have a track record of problem solving, understanding local compliance and practice in MEA and APAC and continuously driving efficiency and automation. You will have experience building strategic HR teams and programs in a matrixed, global environment and are able to streamline operational activities. With senior leaders you can quickly understand the business to influence at all levels and deliver positive change throughout the organization. As a leader you know how to mentor, coach and inspire the team, breaking down silos and walls to help them succeed. You will influence the team to live our values of Collaboration, Trust, Impact and Excellence through their work, delivering a people-first approach to our client groups and to improve our own ways of working. A true proponent of data-driven strategies, you advocate for change and build relationships.

Reporting to the VP, People EMEA/APAC based in London this role will work on a hybrid-basis from our Singapore office.

You Will:

 Work with the VP to identify, resolve and steer the strategic people plan for the MEA and APAC region. This will include reviewing processes, talent, training and tools to build a more systematic and scalable way of working.

 Act as an international ambassador with a strategic mindset for transforming the employee experience in MEA and APAC and be the voice of specific countries and regions within the people team.

 You will develop an intimate understanding of the region you support and be a partner to the regional and executive leadership in MEA and APAC on initiatives and activities that drive and increase: employee engagement and retention. Bring the right people together to build new tools and improve the way we work.

 Align around clear goals, which helps connect us to the goals of the business and be a strategic partner to our leadership teams.

 Work with COE to advocate diversity, equity and inclusion within the organization, personally and programmatically. You will know how to talk about this concerning all areas of the employee life cycle, our internal programs and how we can have a positive change in each of the teams you support and take into account regional or country-specific areas of focus.

 Take initiative and can use discretion and judgement to escalate and/or make decisions, fail fast and learn from any mistakes. You achieve what you promise your clients, your colleagues and your team – thoughtfully and reliably. Business leaders and your team know they can rely on you to achieve their goals and they experience excellent partnership from you and your team.

 Advocate for and help create HR policies, practices and systems which help attract, retain and mobilize excellent talent, support business priorities and collective bargaining agreements, and promote competitive advantage.

 Co-own country/Geo HR Governance, Crisis Management, Employee Relations & Business Continuity. Partner with country leadership teams to deliver crisis management as needed. Ensure readiness for rapid response in complex and geopolitically dynamic environments, with clear rhythms and escalation paths. Apply appropriate protocols to inform, consult, or escalate across business units

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams and ensure oversight on regional legal entity management, maintaining strict adherence to governance standards, regulatory compliance, and risk mitigation protocols

 Joint ownership of regional and global All-Hands and Ask-Me-Anything (AMA) sessions together with the regional leadership and global Communications team

 Communicate openly, assuming good intent when working with our business, our team and our partners. With courage, you can speak up and be honest, even when it’s hard.

 Manage, directly and indirectly, a team of 8 HR professionals. As well as working closely with COE’s in the US to roll out programs and get support for specific-MEA-APAC challenges.

You Have:

 12+ years combined human resources & management experience

 Ability to position self as credible (garners respect, acts with integrity, keeps commitments); proactive (has a point of view, challenges assumptions, takes initiative); and a trusted thought partner (builds relationships, delivers results)

 Experienced manager and skilled at coaching team members through change as well as driving results and strategic operations

 Demonstrated experience and ability to balance business partnering skills with employee advocacy.

 Developed thoughtful, integrated approaches to promote diversity, equity and inclusion in talent attraction, development and retention

 Experience handling Employee Relations matters.

 Proven experience making recommendations for country-specific challenges and able to mitigate risks to the business

 Ability to use data and analytics to develop recommendations and actions

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Reasonable Accommodation

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application and/or interview process. If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application or participating in an interview due to a disability, email us at talentresourceteam@dowjones.com. Please put "Reasonable Accommodation" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. This inbox will not be monitored for application status updates.

Please refer to the privacy notice at the bottom of this page for submitting any data access, deletion, or other data subject rights requests, where permitted under your local laws and regulations.

title: Managed Services Support
description:

Fully digitalised processes, enabling on demand provisioning of services such as Bandwidth and cyber security
Business Grade connectivity standards that include <1ms ultra low latency performance and clean-pipe connectivity as a default
True network diversity for improved reliability with unique fibre pathways and facilities that are physically separate from incumbent telcos

Significantly expand SPTEL’s customer base through focused new-logo acquisition and repeatable sales motions.

Build a scalable partner ecosystem to penetrate emerging markets and customer segments.

Build senior executive relationships and position SPTEL as a strategic digital infrastructure partner.

Establish systematic prospecting, pipeline development and conversion disciplines.
Develop repeatable sales plays and propositions that improve sales velocity and scalability.

Create measurable vertical growth plans covering pipeline, customer acquisition, revenue and market penetration.

Develop and execute the partner and channel go-to-market strategy.
Recruit and develop strategic channel, technology and ecosystem partners.
Establish clear partner segmentation, commercial models, targets and performance management.
Build repeatable partner propositions that enable SPTEL to scale efficiently into new markets.

Own enterprise revenue, order intake, customer acquisition and pipeline targets.
Establish a high-performance, growth-oriented sales culture with clear accountability.
Drive rigorous pipeline management, forecasting and sales governance.
Improve sales productivity, conversion rates and speed to revenue.
Build and develop strong Key Account, Mid-Tier Enterprise and Channel sales teams.
Personally sponsor strategic customers, major new-business opportunities and priority vertical initiatives.
Collaborate across Product, Solutions, Marketing, Operations and Finance to turn market opportunities into scalable commercial propositions.
Requirements
12+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience, preferably across telecommunications, ICT, digital infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity or managed services.
Proven track record of delivering enterprise revenue growth and building high-performance sales organisations.
Strong experience managing strategic/key accounts together with new-business acquisition.
Demonstrated ability to develop new industry verticals and translate sector opportunities into scalable sales propositions.
Experience rapidly expanding a mid-market or mid-tier enterprise customer base.
Strong channel and ecosystem development experience with ability to build senior C-suite relationships and lead complex enterprise opportunities.

title: Account Executive
description:
Description

title: Strategy and Review Executive

industry, and competitor analysis. The role will also involve contributing to key

corporate initiatives related to strategy, business improvement, and organisational

transformation.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on operations leader to lead our telemedicine operations and medication fulfilment teams. The role may be appointed at Assistant Manager or Manager level, depending on the candidate's experience, demonstrated scope of leadership and ability to manage complex operational outcomes.

At Assistant Manager level, the role will focus on daily execution, team supervision and implementation of established workforce, quality and performance plans, with broader decisions escalated to the Head of Telemedicine. At Manager level, the role will carry full accountability for the unit's operational performance, workforce, controllable costs, risk management, vendor performance and improvement agenda.

Key responsibilities

Lead daily telemedicine and medication fulfilment operations from post-consultation processing through packing, order checks and delivery-partner handoff. Establish clear shift coverage, handover and escalation arrangements.

Monitor demand, work queues and service disruptions, deploy resources where they are needed and lead operational recovery when issues arise.

Plan rosters, staffing coverage, leave and overtime to support operating demand while maintaining fair and sustainable work patterns.

Set clear expectations, coach team members and manage performance, skills development and succession in partnership with Human Resources.

Maintain procedures and controls for medication fulfilment, packing and checks, inventory, patient data and equipment use in line with healthcare, licensing and internal requirements.

Investigate operational incidents, errors and complaints, identify root causes and complete corrective actions.

Monitor and improve service levels covering staffing, turnaround, fulfilment readiness, accuracy, productivity, escalations and inventory.

Manage controllable costs, inventory and courier or vendor performance within delegated authority, report material variances and recommend corrective action.

Coordinate and resolve non-clinical escalations, ensure timely action and identify recurring causes of service failure to prevent repeat issues.

Build effective working relationships across Clinical Services, Medical Concierge, Technology, Product, Finance, Human Resources, Procurement and external partners.

About you

A relevant diploma or degree, or equivalent experience, with a practical understanding of healthcare operations, patient-data protection and medication-fulfilment processes.

For appointment at Assistant Manager level, typically at least four years of relevant operations experience, including demonstrated supervisory or shift-lead responsibility.

For appointment at Manager level, typically at least five years of relevant operations experience, including at least two years of sustained people and operational leadership.

Experience in workforce planning, performance management, operational controls, incident handling, vendor management and process improvement.

Confidence using operational systems and data to investigate issues, improve performance and make clear recommendations.

Strong judgement and communication skills, with the ability to lead teams and coordinate varied stakeholders.

Flexibility to maintain regular contact with operating shifts and provide escalation coverage outside standard office hours when needed.

Telemedicine or technology-enabled healthcare experience is an advantage.

Fullerton Health is a leading vertically integrated healthcare platform in Asia Pacific. Founded in Singapore in 2010, today they own over 500 medical centres and have a large global network of medical providers across 9 markets in Asia Pacific.

Fullerton Health’s value proposition is the integration of healthcare service offerings with customized management and advisory capabilities, in line with its purpose to deliver Affordable and Accessible Care for All in Asia Pacific.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

Providing strategic claims management support for complex and/or contentious FSPG client claims, from notification through to resolution.
Supporting key client relationships with a focus on client governance, claims advocacy and related service undertakings, including participation in client meetings and reviews.
Providing expert advice on policy coverage, claim notification issues and the appropriateness of claims strategies, and working with clients and insurers to resolve a wide range of issues in a practical and creative manner.
Monitoring insurer responses and engaging with insurers and any of their professional advisers to support efficient, fair and timely claim outcomes for clients.
Working with the Claims Advocacy Director and senior colleagues in the training and development of the team, and in the establishment and delivery of best practice service standards to the FSPG client base.
Supporting the maintenance and enhancement of data management systems, including claims data analysis and reporting, and providing insights into loss trends and emerging issues to inform clients and internal stakeholders.

In addition to the core claims advocacy responsibilities, the role will support broader FSPG client servicing and business development initiatives as required, including participation in requests for proposal (RFPs) and tenders, presenting claims advocacy as a key element of Aon’s value proposition.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

Have a strong background in financial lines and/or cyber claims, insurance, legal practice or a related discipline, with experience in handling complex and contentious matters. A minimum of five years’ relevant experience would be advantageous.

Demonstrate sound judgement and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to develop and execute practical, commercially sensible claims strategies in partnership with clients and insurers.
Show strong client relationship and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to non‑specialist audiences and to manage challenging discussions in a professional manner.
Be results and detail oriented, self‑motivated and accountable for delivering high-quality work within required timelines, while working collaboratively as part of a wider team.
Have good written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to prepare clear reports, analyses and presentations for clients and internal stakeholders. Any additional Asian language capabilities would be an advantage.
Be comfortable working with data, including the use of claims systems and tools to produce analysis and insights on loss trends and emerging issues.
Be proficient in common productivity tools such as Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint, and open to using new technology and AI‑enabled tools (for example GPT or Copilot) to enhance claims analysis, reporting and client service.
We welcome overseas candidates

1. Processing of escalated name screening alerts and/or transaction activities alerts;

4. Conducting Standard or Enhanced Customer Due Diligence reviews;

5. Managing customers and internal stakeholders’ request for information and documents;

6. Exiting and closure of customer banking relationships;

7. Tracking of activities progress through MIS update and reporting;

Diploma or Degree holders aspiring to develop a career in AML risk management

Experience

1. Minimum 2 years of Sanctions/AML/CFT operational experience and/or

2. Certification in Sanctions / AML / CFT

Technical Skills

Technical knowledge and understanding of Singapore’s regulatory requirements relating to sanctions, money laundering and terrorism financing

Personal Traits

1. Passionate in developing a career in AML risk management

2. Independent self-starter with a strong positive mindset and self-motivation ability

3. Meticulous, committed and focused

4. Possesses an inquisitive mind and raises critical challenges to augment current work processes

5. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

7. Ability to influence and collaborate well with stakeholders and team members 8. Good written and oral communication skills and ability to interact effectively with people at different levels

title: Technical Program Manager III, Amazon Leo Partner Services (ALPS)
description:
DESCRIPTION

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access. With 38 signed distribution partners globally and service launch approaching, now is an exciting time to join a team that is actively shaping how satellite broadband reaches the world.

As a Technical Program Manager on the Amazon Leo Partner Services team, you will own and drive complex, externally facing technical integration programs with Amazon Leo's global distribution partners, including some of the largest internet service providers in the world. You will serve as the primary program leader responsible for ensuring partners successfully integrate, validate, and launch satellite internet service in their contracted territories and channels. This role sits at the center of partner-facing execution and internal product coordination, spanning API onboarding, BSS/OSS integration, network readiness, operational enablement, and launch milestones. You will work cross-functionally with Amazon Leo engineering, product, solutions architecture, and operations teams to ensure partner-facing deliverables are defined, prioritized, and delivered on time.

This position may require access to export-controlled information (ECI) subject to EAR and ITAR. Final employment decision is contingent upon satisfactory completion of export control screenings and obtaining any necessary export licenses or approvals, based on nationality, citizenship, and other factors considered by applicable export control regulations.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end partner technical integration programs from discovery through launch readiness, defining integration scope, success criteria, milestones, and deliverables across partner and Amazon Leo teams while identifying risks, dependencies, and critical path items early to drive mitigation plans.
- Lead recurring program reviews, executive checkpoints, and milestone tracking sessions with strategic distribution partners, translating partner integration requirements into clear internal execution plans and managing blockers through timely escalation.
- Coordinate delivery across multiple internal workstreams — including API releases, backend services, hardware readiness, and operational tooling — partnering with Product, Engineering, Solutions Architects, and Operations teams to align roadmaps with partner launch commitments.
- Develop and maintain standardized program artifacts such as integration plans, dependency maps, and executive status reporting, and implement repeatable frameworks for global partner onboarding and launch readiness.
- Analyze program data, track integration maturity metrics, and report launch risk to senior leadership, using insights to drive continuous improvement of the ALPS launch model and influence prioritization of partner-critical capabilities.

A day in the life
You will operate in a regional context, supporting distribution partners across your assigned region in coordination with central ALPS teammates and other regional Technical Program Managers. Your day may include leading a partner integration review in the morning, aligning with engineering on API readiness in the afternoon, and preparing an executive launch risk update for leadership. Beyond your regional portfolio, you will also own at least one global-scope initiative aimed at improving the partner experience across all ALPS regions, giving you visibility and impact well beyond your immediate territory.

About the team
The Amazon Leo Partner Services (ALPS) team is responsible for the onboarding, integration, and enablement of Amazon Leo's distribution partners worldwide. We work with telecom operators and regional service providers to deliver satellite internet service in inclusive regulatory and operational environments. With a rapidly growing partner network and service launch on the horizon, the team is scaling quickly to meet demand from some of the largest internet service providers in the world.

Our mission is to make Amazon Leo partnerships predictable, scalable, and launch-ready through technical rigor and disciplined program execution. Every team member owns a regional partner portfolio while also driving at least one global project that raises the bar on the partner experience across all markets. This combination of regional depth and global reach means you will build expertise in local market dynamics while shaping how ALPS operates at scale.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of software development experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Director, AI Consulting
description:
Position Overview

The

Director of AI Consulting

will lead and build the organization’s end-to-end AI consulting function, with overall responsibility for AI consulting strategy, client engagement, solution development, delivery excellence, and team leadership.

This role serves as the bridge between

business strategy, AI technology, data, and implementation

. The Director will work closely with senior business stakeholders to identify high-value AI opportunities, translate business challenges into actionable AI strategies and solutions, and lead multidisciplinary teams from initial discovery and use-case definition through solution design, implementation, adoption, and value realization.

The successful candidate will combine strong

management consulting capabilities, AI expertise, commercial acumen, and organizational leadership

, with the ability to engage executive stakeholders while also providing direction to technical and delivery teams.

Key Responsibilities

1. AI Consulting Strategy & Practice Leadership

Define and lead the overall strategy, operating model, methodologies, and service portfolio for the AI Consulting function.

Build an end-to-end AI consulting capability covering

AI strategy, opportunity assessment, use-case prioritization, solution design, implementation, adoption, and value realization

.

Establish standardized consulting frameworks, methodologies, playbooks, governance models, and reusable assets.

Develop the AI consulting roadmap in alignment with broader business and digital transformation priorities.

Continuously assess developments across Generative AI, AI agents, machine learning, automation, data platforms, and emerging AI technologies to identify new business opportunities.

Establish clear KPIs for the AI Consulting organization and drive continuous improvement in quality, productivity, client satisfaction, and business impact.

2. Executive & Client Advisory

Serve as a trusted AI advisor to senior executives and business leaders.

Lead executive-level discussions to understand strategic priorities, operational challenges, and transformation objectives.

Advise stakeholders on AI strategy, AI operating models, investment priorities, capability development, and transformation roadmaps.

Translate complex AI technologies into clear business implications, opportunities, risks, and investment decisions.

Facilitate executive workshops, AI strategy sessions, ideation workshops, and use-case prioritization exercises.

3. AI Opportunity Identification & Use-Case Development

Lead structured assessments to identify business processes and functions where AI can create measurable value.

Develop and maintain enterprise or business-unit AI use-case portfolios.

Evaluate opportunities based on strategic value, feasibility, data readiness, implementation complexity, risk, and expected ROI.

Build business cases and value hypotheses for AI initiatives.

Define prioritized AI transformation roadmaps covering short-term opportunities and longer-term strategic capabilities.

4. Solution Strategy & Design

Translate business requirements into AI solution concepts and implementation strategies.

Partner with AI engineers, data scientists, architects, product teams, IT, and business SMEs to develop practical and scalable solutions.

Guide solution decisions across areas such as:

Generative AI and Large Language Models

AI agents and agentic workflows

Machine learning and predictive analytics

Intelligent automation

Knowledge management and enterprise search

AI-enabled business process transformation

Data and AI platforms

Ensure proposed solutions balance business value, technical feasibility, scalability, security, compliance, user experience, and cost.

5. End-to-End AI Program Delivery

Provide leadership and governance across the full AI consulting lifecycle:

Discover → Assess → Prioritize → Design → Prototype → Implement → Deploy → Adopt → Scale → Measure Value

Oversee multiple AI consulting engagements and transformation programs simultaneously.

Establish appropriate program governance, milestones, quality standards, risk management, and executive reporting.

Resolve strategic, organizational, and delivery challenges that could impact program outcomes.

Ensure AI initiatives move beyond proof-of-concept and deliver sustainable business impact at scale.

Establish mechanisms for measuring realized business value, adoption, productivity improvement, revenue impact, cost reduction, or other agreed outcomes.

6. AI Governance & Responsible AI

Incorporate Responsible AI principles throughout consulting methodologies and solution development.

Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, Compliance, IT, and other relevant stakeholders to establish appropriate AI governance.

Ensure AI solutions appropriately address data privacy, security, model risk, intellectual property, regulatory requirements, explainability, and human oversight.

Help business stakeholders understand and manage the risks associated with enterprise AI adoption.

7. AI Adoption & Business Transformation

Drive organizational adoption of AI solutions, not simply technical implementation.

Work with business leaders to redesign workflows and operating models around new AI capabilities.

Develop change-management, communication, training, and capability-building strategies.

Identify barriers to adoption and establish plans to increase utilization and realized value.

Promote an AI-enabled culture and improve AI literacy across the organization.

8. Team & Capability Building

Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing AI Consulting organization.

Define team structure, roles, competencies, career paths, and resource requirements.

Recruit and develop talent across AI strategy, business consulting, solution consulting, program management, and related disciplines.

Develop consulting capabilities in structured problem solving, executive communication, business case development, AI solution design, and transformation delivery.

Foster strong collaboration between consulting, engineering, data science, product, IT, and business teams.

Create a culture of client focus, innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and measurable impact.

9. Commercial & Partnership Management

Support development of AI consulting propositions, statements of work, engagement models, resource plans, and commercial proposals where applicable.

Develop strategic relationships with technology providers, AI platforms, implementation partners, and external consulting organizations.

Evaluate build-versus-buy-versus-partner decisions for AI initiatives.

Manage external partners to ensure quality, knowledge transfer, delivery performance, and commercial effectiveness.

Job Requirements

Education

Bachelor's degree or above in

Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Management, or a related discipline

.

MBA, Master's degree, or other advanced degree is preferred.

Professional Experience

Typically

12+ years of professional experience

, including significant experience in management consulting, digital transformation, AI/data consulting, technology strategy, or related fields.

5+ years of leadership experience

managing consulting, AI, digital transformation, data, technology, or multidisciplinary teams.

Demonstrated experience leading complex, enterprise-scale transformation or consulting engagements from strategy through implementation.

Strong track record of engaging and advising senior executives and translating strategic business challenges into technology-enabled transformation programs.

Experience establishing or scaling an

AI, analytics, digital, or technology consulting practice/function

is highly desirable.

Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent projects, teams, stakeholders, and priorities.

title: Executive/Assistant Manager, Partnerships
description:
Responsibilities

We are looking for a commercially minded Senior Executive / Assistant Manager to lead partnerships and partnership marketing across our hotel and serviced residence portfolio. This role is responsible for identifying and growing partnerships that drive room night production, and for bringing them to life through campaigns, collateral and communications.

You will work closely with the Director, Loyalty and CRM, and with cluster, property, marketing and revenue teams, with clear accountability for monitoring, tracking and reporting partnership results.

Partnership Development & Management

Identify, develop and manage partnerships with banks, travel, lifestyle, F&B, retail and other relevant brands, prioritising groupwide partnerships with strong potential to drive room night production in addition to brand visibility.

Develop compelling partnership propositions, benefits and experiences that add value to our guests, moving beyond discount-led offers.

Manage partnerships end-to-end, from opportunity identification and proposal development through to negotiation, activation and performance review.

Develop joint campaigns and activations with partners, ensuring all agreed deliverables are executed effectively.

Work with cluster and property teams so that property-level partnerships complement groupwide partnerships and build brand awareness for each cluster.

Build strong relationships with external partners and with internal commercial, marketing, cluster and property stakeholders.

Customer Engagement & Partnership Marketing

Develop and execute customer-facing campaigns and marketing initiatives to build awareness, participation and engagement with partnership offers.

Develop campaign concepts, messaging and copy across seasonal, promotional and partner initiatives.

Own campaign briefs and work with designers, agencies and internal teams to develop creative assets, collateral and communications.

Ensure consistent brand expression and guest experience across digital, social, website, hotel and other relevant touchpoints.

Manage the partnership marketing calendar and coordinate campaigns from concept through to launch.

Monitoring, Tracking & Reporting

Manage the administration of partnership programmes with both internal and external stakeholders e.g submission of reports to partners for billing

Maintain the Partnership Master List covering all contracted partners, including active partnerships, contract periods, offers, deliverables and production.

Track room nights and revenue achieved by each partnership against agreed targets, and report on a regular cadence.

Monitor campaign and partnership performance, flag underperformance early, and recommend whether to renew, renegotiate or exit.

Prepare performance updates and recommendations for the Director, Loyalty and CRM and senior management.

Maintain partnership agreements and supporting documents.

Requirements

3–5 years' experience in partnerships, marketing, brand, loyalty, hospitality, lifestyle or retail.

Good understanding of branding, including aligning partner brands with Far East Hospitality in customer-facing communications.

Strong partnership and relationship management skills, with the ability to negotiate commercial terms.

Strong hands-on experience in campaign development and execution, including creative concepts, copy and marketing collateral.

Comfortable working with multiple stakeholders, including external partners, cluster and property teams.

Commercially minded and results-driven, with a focus on commercial elements

Organised and detail-oriented, able to track, analyse and report performance, and to manage multiple initiatives from idea to execution.

Experience in hospitality, travel, lifestyle or loyalty programmes is an advantage.

Far East Hospitality Holdings Pte Ltd (Far East Hospitality) is an international hospitality owner and operator with a diverse portfolio of 10 unique and complementary brands of hotels, serviced residences and apartment hotels, including Oasia, Quincy, Rendezvous, Village, Far East Collection, A by Adina, Adina Hotels, Vibe Hotels, Travelodge Hotels and TFE Hotels Collection. We own more than 10 hospitality assets and operate a combined portfolio of more than 17,000 rooms under management across over 100 hotels and serviced residences in ten countries – Australia, Austria, Denmark, Germany, Hungary, Japan, Malaysia, New Zealand, Singapore and Switzerland – with more in our development pipeline.

Formed as a 70-30 joint venture in 2013 between Far East Orchard Limited (a listed company under Far East Organization) and The Straits Trading Company Limited, we in turn completed a 50-50 joint venture through our wholly-owned subsidiary Far East Hospitality Investments (Australia) Pte Ltd, with Australia’s Toga Group to form Toga Far East Hotels (TFE Hotels).

title: Assistant Manager, B2B & Physical Channel Growth
description:
Position:

Assistant Manager, B2B & Physical Channel Growth

At Dr Mark Leong Team, we are more than a weight loss company- we are a community united by one mission: to support ladies above 40 to become fitter, stronger, healthier, and more confident as they age.

We understand that losing weight after 40 is different. Changes in metabolism, hormones, muscle mass, lifestyle, and nutrition can make it increasingly difficult to achieve results using the same methods that worked when we were younger.

That is why we focus on helping our community understand their body, nutrition, food choices, movement, and lifestyle - so that weight loss is not simply about seeing a smaller number on the weighing scale, but about building a stronger and healthier body for the years ahead.

We believe people deserve clarity, not guesswork.

Through education, practical nutrition strategies, community support, and technology, we help our members make better choices that can become part of their everyday lives.

Most importantly, we believe transformation is easier when you do not have to do it alone.

We are building a community where women can learn together, progress together, encourage one another, and celebrate every milestone - from losing weight and becoming fitter to gaining strength, confidence, and a better quality of life.

As the Dr Mark Leong community continues to grow across Asia and beyond, we are looking for passionate, energetic, andmission-driven individuals to join our team and help us create meaningful transformation - one woman, one family, and one community at a time.

We are looking for a commercially driven B2B & PhysicalChannel Growth team member whose primary responsibility is to build DML’s offline business into a profitable, repeatable and scalable revenue channel.

This is a business development and sales growth role, not an event coordination or administrative role.

Responsibilities

1. B2B Sales & Business Development - PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY

Own the commercial growth of DML’s offline B2B business.

Prospect and develop new B2B customers.

Identify corporate wellness, bulk purchase and corporate gifting opportunities.

Conduct meetings and presentations with prospective customers.

Prepare proposals and quotations.

Follow up opportunities through to conversion.

Develop existing customers into repeat accounts.

Identify opportunities to increase order size and product range.

Maintain an active B2B sales pipeline.

Achieve the monthly B2B revenue target.

2. Pop-Ups & Roadshows

Build pop-ups and roadshows into a profitable physical sales channel.

Source opportunities at malls, hospitals, schools, offices, bazaars, wellness events and community locations.

Evaluate footfall, customer profile, rental costs and sales potential.

Negotiate with venue operators and organisers.

Develop a forward calendar of physical sales opportunities.

Set revenue and box targets before each activation.

Monitor sales performance and take action when targets are not being achieved.

3. Physical Channel Execution

Take ownership of the successful commercial execution of each activation.

Coordinate:

Venue and organiser requirements

Booth/display setup

Signage and promotional materials

Inventory and replenishment

Payment systems

Sampling and promotions

Manpower/ DF deployment

Logistics

Daily sales and inventory reporting

4. Retail & Physical Distribution Development

Develop additional offline channels for DML products.

Identify suitable:

Clinics

TCM centres

Gyms and fitness centres

Wellness centres

Health retailers

Corporate offices

Community businesses

Other relevant physical outlets

5. Community & Institutional Partnerships

Develop recurring physical sales opportunities through organisations and communities.

Potential channels include:

Hospitals

Schools and universities

Corporates

Fitness communities

Yoga and wellness groups

Sports communities

Associations

Community organisations

6. DF Physical Sales Enablement

Develop a scalable model that allows DFs to operate physical sales channels.

Identify suitable DFs for pop-ups and roadshows.

Train DFs on physical selling.

Develop sales scripts and operating SOPs.

Provide product and promotional guidance.

Establish inventory and reporting processes.

Test different physical selling formats.

Identify successful models and replicate them.

Progressively hand suitable locations and activations to DFs.

7. Lead Generation & Cross-Selling

Physical channels should generate more than immediate product sales.

Capture and qualify potential:

B2B customers

Corporate accounts

Affiliates

DFs

MLC customers

AI Summit prospects

Strategic partners

8. Account Management & Repeat Business

Build recurring revenue from existing customers and partners.

Maintain relationships with key accounts.

Follow up for replenishment and repeat orders.

Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

Develop recurring corporate programmes where appropriate.

Monitor customer performance and buying patterns.

Reactivate inactive B2B customers.

9. Sales Performance & Channel Optimisation

Track performance across all B2B and physical channels.

Measure:

Revenue

Boxes sold

Average transaction value

Direct costs

Profitability

Leads generated

Conversion

Repeat orders

Performance by location/channel

Requirements

Sales and results driven - measures success by revenue, not activity. Generating at least S$30,000 monthly revenue through B2B sales, retail partnerships, pop-ups and roadshows.

Commercially minded and able to assess whether an opportunity is worth pursuing.

Comfortable prospecting and approaching new businesses.

Strong at relationship building and follow-up.

Comfortable presenting, selling and handling objections.

Resourceful in finding new physical sales opportunities.

Able to negotiate with venues, vendors and business partners.

Highly proactive and able to execute without constant direction.

Organised enough to manage multiple locations and opportunities simultaneously.

Able to analyse performance and make commercially sound decisions.

Comfortable working in a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment.

At Dr Mark Leong Group, we are more than a company — we are a team of healthcare, nutrition, and biotechnology professionals united by one mission: to revolutionize personalized nutrition and empower adults globally to reverse chronic diseases, age gracefully, relieve pain, and regain mobility using food, education, and technology.

Our work goes far beyond supplements.

We conduct nutrient deficiency testing, helping individuals uncover hidden gaps that affect energy, weight, immunity, hormones, sleep, digestion, and overall vitality. From this data, our experts craft personalised meal plans and targeted supplement protocols designed to restore health from within.

We believe people deserve clarity, not guesswork.

Our team is deeply committed to consumer education, collaborating with schools, healthcare providers, and government bodies to deliver science-backed nutrition knowledge through engaging, practical, and enjoyable experiences. We help individuals learn what is safe to eat, what to avoid, and how to nourish their bodies for long-term wellbeing.

As we expand across Asia and beyond, we are continuously seeking passionate, mission-driven individuals to join us in reshaping the future of health — one person, one family, and one community at a time.

title: Head/Senior Manager, Activations
description:
About the job

Head/Senior Manager, Activations & Events

📍 Singapore | Full-Time

Join the team behind Singapore's leading advertising, marketing and media industry platforms.

About AAMS

The Association of Advertising & Marketing Singapore (AAMS) is the national industry body representing Singapore's advertising, marketing and communications sector. Formed in 2019 through the merger of the Association of Accredited Advertising Agents, Singapore (4As) and the Institute of Advertising Singapore (IAS), AAMS unites the strengths of both organisations to champion marketing excellence, creativity, innovation, and industry transformation.

AAMS drives industry growth through advocacy, capability development, thought leadership and strategic partnerships. Its work spans membership, professional training, networking, industry engagement, and the organisation of Singapore's premier marketing and creative awards, including the Singapore Media Marketing Awards (SMMA), Gong Awards, The Crowbar Awards, Effie Singapore Awards and the Hall of Fame Awards.

AAMS expanded its regional leadership with the launch of Beyond Boundaries, its flagship conference on AI, content and data, and the establishment of the Asia Admarcom Alliance (AAA), a network of six ASEAN industry associations advancing regional collaboration and best practices.

We organise some of Singapore's most respected industry programmes, including:

🏆 GONG Awards

🏆 Effie Singapore Awards

🏆 Singapore Media Marketing Awards (SMMA)

🏆 Hall of Fame

🏆 Crowbar Awards

🏆 NexGen Awards

🎤 Industry Conferences & Learning Festivals

🤝 Membership & Networking Events

As we continue to grow our programmes and industry impact, we are seeking passionate event professionals to join our Activations team.

We're Hiring :

Head/ Senior Manager, Activations

We are seeking an experienced event leader to oversee the planning, management and execution of AAMS' portfolio of awards programmes, conferences, industry initiatives and member engagement activities.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the strategy, planning and execution of all AAMS awards, conferences and events.

Manage major award programmes including GONG Awards, Effie Singapore Awards, SMMA, Hall of Fame, Crowbar Awards and NexGen Awards.

Oversee awards submissions, judging operations and awards ceremonies.

Drive stakeholder engagement with sponsors, partners, members, committee members and industry leaders.

Manage event budgets, forecasting and P&L performance.

Lead vendor negotiations, procurement and contract management.

Ensure sponsorship and partnership deliverables are successfully fulfilled.

Develop operational processes and drive continuous improvement across programmes.

Prepare management reports and performance analysis.

Requirements

Minimum 6-8 years of experience in events, activations, conferences or awards management.

Proven experience managing large-scale events and multiple stakeholders.

Strong project management, budgeting and leadership skills.

Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation abilities.

Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Passion for the advertising, marketing, media and communications industry.

Willing to work occasional evenings and weekends during events.

Why Join AAMS?

Work with some of Singapore's leading marketers, agencies and media organisations.

Be part of the team behind the industry's most prestigious awards and events.

Gain exposure to senior industry leaders and decision-makers.

Join a dynamic, collaborative and purpose-driven organisation that shapes the future of the AdMarCom industry.

About the Association of Advertising and Marketing Singapore (AAMS)

The Association of Advertising and Marketing Singapore (AAMS) was established through the merger of the Association of Accredited Advertising Agents, Singapore (4As) and the Institute of Advertising Singapore (IAS). As the national industry body, AAMS represents the collective interests of the advertising, marketing, and communications sector in Singapore.

Built on over 100 years of industry experience and guided by an Executive Committee comprising senior industry leaders, AAMS is committed to advancing standards in marketing excellence, creativity, and effectiveness. The Association plays a pivotal role in fostering regional collaboration, strengthening the local industry ecosystem, supporting talent development, and championing innovation.

For more information, please visit https://aams.org.sg/.

title: Senior Manager, AP VAS Issuing Solutions
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Team Summary

The AP VAS Issuing Solutions team is responsible for driving the growth and expansion of Visa's next-generation issuing capabilities across Asia Pacific. Leveraging Pismo's cloud-native banking and issuer processing platform, the team works closely with regional and global stakeholders to bring innovative issuing, core banking, lending, and digital account solutions to market.

Operating at the intersection of product strategy, go-to-market execution, and client engagement, the team partners across Issuing Solutions Sales, Sales Engineering, Product, Pismo, and market teams to identify new growth opportunities, shape product roadmaps, and accelerate adoption across AP markets.

What a Senior Manager, AP VAS Issuing Solutions does at Visa

As a Senior Manager, AP VAS Issuing Solutions, you will play a key role in shaping and executing the regional growth strategy for Pismo and Visa's Issuing Solutions portfolio across Asia Pacific.

You will evaluate market opportunities, define go-to-market strategies, support commercial expansion initiatives, and help ensure product readiness for launch across priority markets. Working closely with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will help drive adoption of Pismo's issuer processing, core banking, lending, and digital account capabilities while influencing product enhancements based on market needs.

This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, product management expertise, commercial acumen, and strong cross-functional leadership to support Visa's continued expansion in the issuer processing and banking technology space.

Why this is important to Visa

Pismo represents a strategic pillar of Visa's growth strategy in issuer processing, digital banking, and next-generation financial infrastructure. As Visa continues to expand its Issuing Solutions capabilities across Asia Pacific, this role will help identify new market opportunities, accelerate commercialization efforts, and ensure successful market deployment of innovative banking and payments solutions.

The role directly contributes to revenue growth, client acquisition, market expansion, and Visa's long-term vision of enabling modern, cloud-native financial services across the region.

Projects you will be a part of

You will contribute to a range of strategic initiatives, including:

Defining expansion strategies and go-to-market plans for Pismo across priority Asia Pacific markets.
Evaluating new business opportunities for issuer processing, core banking, lending, and digital account solutions.
Supporting market entry and launch readiness activities, including product localization and regulatory alignment.
Developing commercial business cases, growth plans, and multi-year product roadmaps.
Identifying partnership opportunities, including collaborations with system integrators, technology providers, and ecosystem partners.
Driving product enhancements and capability development based on client needs, industry trends, and competitive insights.
Enabling regional and in-market teams through training, knowledge sharing, and sales readiness programs.

Key Responsibilities
Contribute to implementing a regional strategy, ensuring alignment with global and enterprise objectives over a multiyear period.
Prioritize and execute commercial goals for Pismo during the AP expansion in collaboration with essential stakeholders locally and globally.
Identify and execute upgrades to Pismo to address evolving client needs, local market conditions, and foster innovations beneficial to both clients and Visa.
Motivate, challenge, and mentor the team to enhance their problem-solving and product management abilities.
Support competitive analysis, customer insights, and market studies with market-facing teams to aid the development of new features and capabilities.
Play a significant role in assessing new market opportunities and potential partnerships, including alternative sales models (e.g. through System Integrators)
Influence budget and financial planning by offering insights into potential revenue opportunities and associated costs.
Develop and execute continuous training programs and provisioning of information materials to help market teams effectively sell and deploy Pismo and supporting VAS products.
Prepare and deliver presentations and documentation for both internal and external audiences through working groups, webinars, and other formats regarding product ownership.
Promote PISMO by building extensive internal partnerships within Visa across various functions regionally.
Effectively collaborate with a diverse set of Visa teams, including but not limited to Visa Consulting and Analytics, Marketing, Legal, Corporate Communications, Finance, Client Services and others to achieve company goals.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

10+ years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree, or 8+ years with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Masters, MBA).
Experience in the payments industry, preferably in product management or strategy at an Issuer, Issuer Processor, or Core banking platform provider.
Understanding of Issuer Core Banking & Processing, related regulations, and market competitiveness across AP.
Proven leadership in driving solution delivery and creating commercial & revenue opportunities based on market and client demand.
Expertise in scaling and distributing products/services within a technology company, with a focus on overcoming commercial, technical, industry, and internal challenges.
Exceptional business acumen, analytical skills, and deep understanding of new technology, processing business models, and profitability drivers.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to navigate a matrix organization and manage multiple priorities under time constraints

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Commercial Operations Analyst (Americas)
description:
General Description

Commercially-minded Commercial Operations Analyst to support business development, shipping operations and commercial decision-making from our Singapore office.

The role combines shipping market analysis, operational and fixture-related data, client intelligence and business analytics to identify opportunities, monitor performance and support client-facing teams across Asia and the Americas. The position is collaborative and client-facing, requiring strong interpersonal skills, sound judgement and the ability to engage effectively across cultures and seniority levels.

Given the Americas focus, the role requires regular overlap with Americas business hours, flexibility outside standard Singapore office hours, and periodic travel. Fluency in English and Spanish is required, with Spanish supporting commercial engagement across Latin America and the wider Americas.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Commercial & Shipping Analytics

Analyse vessel, fleet and market data to identify commercial opportunities and trends.

Monitor shipowners, managers, operators, charterers, newbuildings, S&P activity and fleet movements.

Analyze client portfolios, flag composition, registration opportunities, pipelines and fleet performance.

Support client acquisition, fleet expansion and retention through market-share and competitor analysis.

Develop forecasts, KPIs and management reporting.

Analyze regulatory, inspection and Port State Control data where commercially relevant.

Operations, Fixtures &Post-Fixture

Support analysis of vessel employment, fixtures and operational performance.

Track voyages, vessel activity, cargo movements and client fleets.

Assist with post-fixture analysis, including performance, costs, documentation and commercial follow-up.

Monitor vessel and trade activity across Asia, North America, the US Gulf, Caribbean and Latin America.

Prepare vessel, fleet and client briefs for commercial discussions.

Data Analytics &Business Intelligence

Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, Excel models and commercial reporting tools.

Clean, combine and validate data from internal systems and external maritime databases.

Automate recurring reports and analytical processes where practical.

Use Salesforce or similar CRM platforms for pipeline analysis, segmentation and commercial prioritization.

Present analytical findings clearly to management and commercial stakeholders.

Market Intelligence &Client Support

Monitor shipping activity across Asia and the Americas.

Research shipowners, managers, operators, charterers and other industry participants.

Track newbuildings, ownership and management changes and other events that may create commercial opportunities.

Analyze fleet developments and trading patterns across the Americas.

Support engagement with US and Latin American maritime stakeholders.

Prepare client profiles, fleet analyses, presentations and commercial proposals.

Visit client offices, vessels and other operational premises as required to support commercial relationships and gain direct insight into client operations.

Travel periodically within Asia and to the Americas for client meetings and industry events.

General Qualification Guidelines

Bachelor's degree or equivalent.

Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience in shipping, maritime services, commercial analytics or vessel operations.

Strong proficiency in Excel and Power BI and experience with complex datasets.

Familiarity with Salesforce and maritime data sources such as S&P Global/IHS, Waypoint, Clarksons or AIS platforms is advantageous.

Understanding of shipping operations, vessel terminology and fixture/post-fixture processes.

Knowledge of the Americas shipping market, including fleet developments and key maritime stakeholders, is highly desirable.

Familiarity with US and Latin American maritime regulatory and commercial environments is advantageous.

Experience with forecasting, automation or APIs is beneficial.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Strong analytical and commercial judgement.

Ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights.

Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence, with the ability to build rapport and read situations effectively.

Confidence engaging with stakeholders across cultures and seniority levels.

Strong attention to detail, communication and presentation skills.

Ability to work independently and take ownership.

Comfortable working across commercial, operational and technical teams.

Flexibility to maintain regular overlap with business hours in the Americas and travel internationally as required.

The role requires regular working-hour overlap with North and Latin American time zones, including early-morning and/or evening hours in Singapore where required. Periodic travel to the Americas and within Asia, including visits to client premises, vessels and industry events, will form part of the role.

You will also partner with Clinical, Operations, Product and Finance to ensure our proposals deliver value for customers and are commercially sustainable.

Your Responsibilities

1. Revenue Ownership & Enterprise Selling

Carry an individual new business revenue target and personally own a focused portfolio of strategic deals through the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation, contracting and close.
Build qualified pipeline through targeted outreach, executive networks, referrals and partner channels, alongside Marketing and SDR-led activity.
Navigate complex buying groups, uncover customer priorities, develop compelling business cases and secure access to economic buyers and executive sponsors.
Build and deepen relationships with CHROs, Chief People Officers, Total Rewards and Benefits leaders, and other senior stakeholders involved in enterprise buying decisions.
