title: Vice President, ASEAN FX Strategist (Job ID:10079919)
description:
An exceptional opportunity has arisen for an experienced Vice President Senior Currency Analyst to join a highly respected global financial institution in Singapore. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on producing insightful research reports focused on ASEAN economies and foreign exchange rates, particularly with expertise in INR, VND, and PHP. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the organisation’s visibility across international markets by conducting independent research and contributing to team’s regular publications that provide actionable insights to both internal stakeholders and a diverse global client base. The position offers a unique blend of analytical rigour, stakeholder engagement, and the chance to work closely with colleagues across Tokyo, London, New York, and Asia. With a supportive team environment, this is your chance to make a significant impact while developing your career within a collaborative and inclusive culture.

Deliver high-impact research on ASEAN economies and FX rates, enhancing the organisation’s reputation across global markets through regular publications and thematic studies.

Engage directly with clients and internal teams via seminars, webinars, conference calls, and company visits to share insights and foster strong professional relationships.

Benefit from flexible working opportunities within a knowledgeable team that values collaboration, ongoing learning, and personal growth.

What you'll do:

As a Vice President Senior Currency Analyst based in Singapore, you will be at the forefront of delivering high-quality economic research that shapes strategic decisions for both internal stakeholders and external clients worldwide. Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve producing detailed analyses of ASEAN economies—especially focusing on India (INR), Vietnam (VND), and the Philippines (PHP)—and generating regular publications that keep clients informed about market developments. You will collaborate closely with colleagues across multiple regions to contribute to global research pipelines while also engaging directly with customers through various channels such as seminars or webinars. Success in this role requires not only technical expertise but also excellent communication skills for presenting complex information clearly. Your ability to build strong relationships internally and externally will be crucial as you help drive customer satisfaction through insightful analysis.

Produce comprehensive research reports on ASEAN economic trends and foreign exchange rates with a particular focus on INR, VND, and PHP currencies.

Contribute regularly to daily FX updates, weekly market reviews, and quarterly outlooks as part of the Asia Global Market Research team.

Develop in-depth thematic studies and ad-hoc commentary on economic data releases, policy changes, market events, and currency movements relevant to Southeast Asia.

Create and maintain robust quantitative models for economic indicators and foreign exchange forecasting to support research outputs.

Participate actively in regional and global research initiatives by collaborating with colleagues in Tokyo, London, New York, and other key locations.

Engage with clients through conference calls, seminars, webinars, company visits, and business trips to present research findings and address queries.

Build effective partnerships with sales teams, traders, relationship managers, and other stakeholders to ensure timely responses to market-related questions.

Support junior team members by providing coaching, guidance, and sharing best practices within the Asia GMR team.

Ensure all activities comply with relevant regulations, internal policies, risk controls, and dual-entity guidelines as required by the functional arrangement.

Assist in managing the department’s risk profile by adhering strictly to compliance standards and supporting operational excellence.

What you bring:

To excel as a Vice President Senior Currency Analyst in Singapore you will bring substantial experience from previous roles where you have delivered high-quality economic or FX research within major financial institutions or consultancies. Your background should include advanced academic training—ideally at postgraduate level—in economics or finance coupled with hands-on expertise in both qualitative assessment techniques (such as policy analysis) and quantitative methods (including econometric modelling). You are adept at distilling complex macroeconomic trends into actionable insights for diverse audiences ranging from senior executives to institutional investors. Strong interpersonal skills; you thrive when collaborating across functions or mentoring less experienced colleagues. A deep understanding of compliance requirements—particularly those associated with multi-entity operations—is essential given the dual-hat nature of this role. Above all else your commitment to accuracy integrity teamwork continuous learning sets you apart as an invaluable member of any high-performing research function.

Minimum 10 years of experience in Global markets working in Singapore or any other regional market.

Demonstrated experience of at least eight years in economic or foreign exchange research within financial services or related sectors is essential for this position.

Proven experience building robust models for economic indicators or FX forecasting supports data-driven decision-making within the team

A bachelor’s degree or higher qualification in economics, finance or another relevant discipline provides the necessary academic foundation for success.

Proven ability to conduct both qualitative assessments and quantitative analyses when tackling complex economic issues is vital for producing impactful research outputs.

Strong presentation abilities enable you to communicate findings effectively during seminars, webinars or client meetings across different regions.

A collaborative approach is important as you will work closely with colleagues from various departments such as sales or trading as well as mentor junior staff members.

Familiarity with regulatory frameworks governing financial institutions ensures compliance with all relevant laws including those specific to dual-entity arrangements.

Excellent stakeholder management skills allow you to develop productive relationships both internally within the organisation and externally with global corporate clients.

What sets this company apart:

This organisation stands out as one of the world’s most established financial institutions renowned for its commitment to excellence integrity innovation within global markets. Employees benefit from being part of an inclusive workplace culture that prioritises knowledge-sharing professional development mutual respect among colleagues at every level. The company offers flexible working opportunities designed to support work-life balance alongside access to extensive training resources that empower individuals at all stages of their careers. Collaboration is deeply embedded in everyday practice ensuring everyone feels valued supported able contribute meaningfully towards shared goals whether working locally in Singapore or connecting virtually with peers around the globe. By joining this team you become part of a network dedicated not only delivering outstanding results but also nurturing talent fostering long-term growth leadership within financial services sector.

description:

JOB DETAILS

Role: Ad Sales Planner

Contract Type: Permanent, Full-Time

Location: Singapore

Working Rights: Candidates must be legally authorised to work in Singapore without requiring visa sponsorship or work pass support.

WE ARE BBC STUDIOS

A globally renowned media company borne of the BBC. We make and distribute the world's most sought-after TV, audio and digital content.

Our ambition is to be the home of the most powerful, entertaining, and inspiring stories for people all around the world.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Ad Sales Planner is a critical member of the APAC Advertising Sales team, supporting revenue growth across BBC Studios' portfolio of television, digital, audio, sponsorship, branded content and audience solutions. Working closely with sales, clients, agencies and internal stakeholders, the role supports the full advertising sales cycle, from proposal development and campaign planning through to execution, reporting and post-campaign analysis.

The APAC region presents a significant growth opportunity through a dual-pronged strategy of expanding our base of premium television advertisers while accelerating growth across BBC Studios' evolving digital, audience, data and content marketing solutions. As a result, this role plays an important part in helping clients better understand and access BBC Studios' unique audiences, premium content environments and advertising capabilities.

The successful candidate will combine strong commercial acumen, attention to detail and client management skills with a passion for media, content, audience insights and advertising innovation. They will become a trusted partner to the sales team, supporting business growth while ensuring the highest standards of campaign execution and client service.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT

1. Commercial Sales Planning & Client Solutions (55%)

Support the APAC Advertising Sales team in developing strategic advertising solutions that drive revenue growth across television, digital, audio, sponsorship, branded content and audience-led opportunities.

Develop compelling media plans, presentations and commercial proposals in response to client and agency briefs.
Translate client marketing objectives into integrated advertising solutions leveraging BBC Studios' content, audience and platform capabilities.
Partner with Sales, Insights, StoryWorks and other internal stakeholders to deliver competitive and commercially effective recommendations.
Support proactive pitches and business development initiatives designed to grow revenue and expand advertiser relationships.
Identify opportunities to introduce clients to BBC Studios' growing suite of audience, data, content and digital advertising solutions.
Review inventory availability and recommend effective advertising, sponsorship and content-led opportunities.
Ensure proposals are commercially sound, accurately costed and aligned with sales objectives.
Support programmatic advertising opportunities and act as a point of contact for agency trading desks where required.
Assist in creating best-in-class sales material that positions BBC Studios as a premium advertising partner across APAC.
Act as a trusted commercial partner to the sales team, anticipating client needs and delivering responsive support throughout the sales process.
2. Campaign Management & Client Service Excellence (30%)

Manage the successful implementation, delivery and optimisation of campaigns while providing exceptional support to clients, agencies and internal stakeholders.

Coordinate campaign setup and execution with Ad Operations, StoryWorks, Compliance and other business functions.
Manage campaign bookings, insertion orders, sponsorship documentation and internal approval processes.
Liaise with clients and agencies to ensure all creative materials and campaign assets are received, approved and delivered on schedule.
Monitor campaign performance and identify optimisation opportunities to maximise campaign outcomes.
Provide timely communication and support throughout the campaign lifecycle.
Troubleshoot campaign delivery issues in partnership with operational teams and communicate resolutions to stakeholders.
Prepare campaign performance reports, transmission reports and post-campaign reviews.
Ensure campaigns are delivered in accordance with contractual commitments and client expectations.
Build strong day-to-day relationships with agencies, advertisers and regional sales representatives.
Act as a reliable first point of contact for campaign-related enquiries and operational support.
3. Commercial Reporting, Sales Operations & Business Support (15%)

Provide accurate reporting, financial coordination and operational support to enable effective decision-making and seamless commercial execution.

Prepare and distribute campaign performance reports, post-campaign analyses, transmission reports and revenue tracking updates.
Support the sales team with audience insights, market intelligence and competitor monitoring to strengthen client conversations and commercial outcomes.
Partner closely with Finance to support billing accuracy, invoice reconciliation, revenue recognition processes and client payment enquiries.
Coordinate client onboarding requirements and ensure all necessary commercial documentation, contracts and compliance processes are completed.
Maintain accurate information across CRM, booking, reporting and sales management systems.
Support regional business reporting requirements and sales administration processes.
Ensure consistency with BBC Studios' commercial policies, reporting standards and product messaging across APAC.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and sales effectiveness.
Success Measures

The Ad Sales Planner will be successful when they:

Deliver high-quality, strategic media plans that contribute to revenue growth across APAC.
Become a trusted commercial partner to the sales team and a valued contact for clients and agencies.
Contribute to the growth of both premium television advertising and emerging digital, audience and content-led revenue streams.
Maintain high standards of campaign delivery, reporting accuracy and client satisfaction.
Drive operational excellence through efficient processes, accurate forecasting and strong financial coordination.
Provide actionable insights that strengthen BBC Studios' commercial proposition and market position.
Support the achievement of regional revenue targets through outstanding planning, execution, campaign servicing and stakeholder management.
YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Essential

Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
Experience within a media owner, publisher, agency or advertising environment preferred.
Strong interest in media, advertising, content marketing and audience strategy.
Excellent organisational, administrative and project management skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Commercially minded with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Numerate and data-driven, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Ability to interpret campaign performance data and convert insights into actionable recommendations.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple teams and markets.
Self-starter with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.
Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment.
Fluent written and spoken English.

Desirable

Experience in digital advertising, broadcast advertising, audio advertising or programmatic media.
Understanding of media planning, campaign management or advertising operations.
Familiarity with audience measurement, analytics and reporting platforms.
Knowledge of branded content, sponsorship and content marketing solutions.
Experience working with CRM, ad-serving, booking or sales management systems.
Additional APAC language capabilities are advantageous.
Passion for media, technology and emerging advertising trends.

The Account Executive will be responsible for building strategic relationships, identifying customer needs and converting opportunities into POCs, pilots and long-term contracts.

Navigate enterprise and public-sector procurement and tender processes.

Build long-term relationships that support renewals, expansion and strategic partnerships.

Represent UnlockLand professionally at client meetings, conferences and industry events.

Requirements

Professional experience in enterprise sales, business development, partnerships or strategic accounts.

Existing and verifiable relationships with Singapore government agencies, statutory boards, property developers or infrastructure organisations.

Experience accessing and communicating with senior decision-makers.

Proven ability to create opportunities through direct relationships and business development.

Experience managing enterprise sales cycles from discovery through POC, pilot, procurement and contract signing.

Strong ability to understand customer needs and translate them into practical business or technology solutions.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong presentation, negotiation, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Professional and confident when representing the company in senior-level meetings.

Commercially driven, organised and accountable for business results.

Able to work independently in a fast-moving startup environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience selling enterprise software, AI, data products, PropTech or planning technology.

Experience working with URA, JTC, HDB, LTA, GovTech or major Singapore property developers.

Understanding of Singapore’s urban planning, land development, infrastructure or real estate ecosystem.

Experience delivering government or enterprise POCs and pilot projects.

Familiarity with public-sector procurement, tenders and enterprise purchasing processes.

Experience working with technology, consulting, planning or built-environment solutions.

Professional proficiency in Mandarin is an advantage.

This Role May Not Be Suitable If

Your experience is mainly in digital marketing, advertising or inbound lead handling.

You do not have relevant relationships within Singapore’s government, property or infrastructure sectors.

You have not previously managed enterprise opportunities through POC, procurement and contract negotiation.

You are looking for a role focused only on making introductions without owning commercial outcomes.

What Success Looks Like

Creating qualified access to relevant senior decision-makers.

Converting customer discussions into structured POCs and pilots.

Managing opportunities through procurement and commercial negotiation.

Converting successful pilots into paid enterprise contracts.

Building long-term strategic relationships and expanding customer accounts.

Establishing UnlockLand as a trusted AI technology partner in Singapore’s built environment.

What We Offer

The opportunity to represent an AI-native Singapore technology company.

Direct exposure to government, infrastructure and real estate organisations.

Ownership of strategic accounts from first engagement to signed contract.

The opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, planning and real estate.

A fast-moving environment with significant autonomy and responsibility.

Opportunities to contribute to regional and international expansion.

UNLOCKLAND is a Singapore-headquartered, AI-native software company building a decision platform for real estate development.

Our platform helps real estate developers discover opportunities, evaluate land, compare development scenarios, and make faster, smarter, and lower-risk investment decisions.

We connect parcel, planning, market, and development evidence to the workflows that turn land into a complete, reviewable opportunity.

Our data coverage currently spans 15 global markets across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East, including Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, New Zealand, the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, France, the Netherlands, Denmark, Norway, Finland, and Saudi Arabia.

We are expanding rapidly across new markets, deeper data coverage, and more connected development workflows.

At VFI Food Pte Ltd, we don’t just produce food – we create a culinary excellence experience for our customers.

title: Business Development Executive / Senior Executive
description:
Business Development Executive / Senior Executive

Looking for an opportunity to grow a business and build your own customer portfolio?

Join a growing specialist pest management company where you'll play an important role in expanding our commercial business in Singapore. You'll work closely with the Managing Director to develop new customers, open new opportunities and build long-term recurring business.

About the Role

HEYMONSTER Pest Control is a Singapore-based specialist pest management company providing services to vessels, shipyards, offices, warehouses and commercial facilities. We are committed to delivering professional, responsive and practical pestmanagement solutions while building long-term relationships with our customers.

As our Business Development Executive, your main focus will be growing our commercial pest control business in Singapore.

You'll focus on developing new business across offices, warehouses, factories, F&B establishments and other commercial facilities, with a strong focus on securing recurring pest management contracts.

We're looking for someone who enjoys meeting people, opening new doors and turning opportunities into long-term business.

What you’ll be doing

Identify and develop new commercial and industrial customers

Generate leads through networking, referrals, prospecting and existing connections

Build relationships with facility managers, managing agents, procurement teams and business owners

Arrange customer meetings and assist with site surveys where required

Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable pest management solutions

Prepare quotations and proposals together with the Managing Director

Follow up on quotations and secure new business

Develop recurring pest management contracts and long-term customer relationships

Identify opportunities to expand business within newly acquired accounts

Maintain and follow up on your sales pipeline

Coordinate internally to ensure a smooth handover and service delivery for new customers

What we’re looking for

Proven experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong track record in new customer acquisition

Good communication and interpersonal skills

Confident in meeting customers and developing new relationships

Self-motivated and comfortable generating your own leads

Able to work independently and take ownership of your sales pipeline and results

Positive attitude and results driven

Persistent and comfortable following up on opportunities until a clear outcome is reached

Comfortable using Microsoft Office

Bonus if you have

Experience in the pest control industry will be highly advantageous

Existing network within commercial, industrial, facilities management or property sectors will be highly advantageous

Experience selling recurring service contracts

Proven track record in developing and securing new B2B customers

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be measured based on:

New customer acquisition

New recurring contracts secured

New sales revenue generated

Sales pipeline development

Conversion of opportunities into customers

Growth opportunities within newly acquired accounts

Why join us

Work closely with the Managing Director and play a direct role in growing the business

Opportunity to build and develop your own commercial customer portfolio

Attractive sales incentives

Exposure to both commercial and marine pest management

Be part of a growing company where your contribution can make a real difference

Office conveniently located beside IMM Building (Jurong East)

Salary, Benefits & Working Hours

5-day work week (Monday to Friday)

Normal working hours: 9:00am to 6:00pm

Customer meetings and site visits around Singapore may be required

Office location: Jurong East (beside IMM Building)

Basic salary: S$3,000 to S$5,000, depending on experience and track record

Attractive sales incentives

Performance-based bonus

Transport reimbursement

Annual leave benefits

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified. We look forward to welcoming someone who is ready to grow with us.

HEYMONSTER Pest Control Pte. Ltd. is a specialised vessel pest control and fumigation company in Singapore, supporting commercial vessels including oil tankers, bulk carriers, container ships and cruise ships, as well as FPSOs and drilling rigs at anchorage, PSA terminals and in shipyards.

Our services are delivered through VPMP™, HEYMONSTER’s proprietary Vessel Pest Management Programme developed specifically for marine environments. Built on practical onboard experience, the programme focuses on identifying pest risks at source and delivering consistent, well-documented treatments suited to vessel operations and port health requirements.

In addition to our marine services, we also provide pest management support for warehouses, offices and other commercial facilities.

title: Client Success Director- Singapore
description:
Thought Machine's mission is bold – to properly and permanently rid the world's banks of legacy technology. To achieve this, we have developed the foundations of modern banking through core and payments technology which run natively in the cloud. What we are attempting is hard and means we need great people working together to build great technology.

We have grown rapidly in the past few years – growing our team to more than 550 individuals across offices in London, New York, Singapore, Sydney and our newly established Engineering Hub in Lisbon. We have raised more than £500m in funding and our investors include Molten Ventures, Eurazeo, Intesa Sanpaolo, Temasek, Nyca Partners, JPMorgan Chase Strategic Investments, Standard Chartered Ventures, and more.

We have created a culture that enables our team to produce the best work in the industry while ensuring we have fun along the way. We're regularly cited as having a fantastic workplace culture and have been recognised by Sifted magazine as having one of the highest Glassdoor ratings for a UK fintech company and the industry's most generous employee share package. Named one of the world's most innovative fintechs by Global Finance Magazine, we were also recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe's fastest-growing companies for two consecutive years—and a UK Best Employer for 2026.

The Client Success Director (CSD) is accountable for ensuring Clients successfully adopt and scale our platform to achieve their contracted outcomes. The primary measure of success for this role is enabling clients to reach their contracted volume of live accounts within agreed milestone dates and budget, while maintaining high client satisfaction and long-term commercial value.

This is a senior, client-facing role requiring deep experience in core banking transformation programmes, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to orchestrate delivery, support, and sales teams across complex, multi-year engagements.

Duties

Client Outcomes & Delivery

Own the end-to-end client success plan from sales support, to implementation through to scale and steady state.

Ensure clients achieve their contracted account volumes within agreed milestones, timelines, and budgets.

Act as the primary point of accountability for delivery outcomes across implementation, upgrades, and ongoing services within the scope of the MSA.

Proactively identify risks to delivery, adoption, or timelines and drive mitigation plans across internal and client teams.

Monitor and analyse client product usage, forecasting key account metrics.

Client Engagement & Governance

Following the Vault Delivery Framework, establish and run robust account governance, including steering committees, operational forums, and executive engagement.

Own CSAT, including measurement, action planning, and continuous improvement.

As part of the governance model and ensuring compliance with Thought Machine Support requirements, define the Target Operating Model for support as early on in the engagement as possible.

As part of being accountable for the client success plan, lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), demonstrating progress against milestones, value delivered, and forward roadmap.

Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders across business, technology, and operations.

Ensure Client production readiness is complete and signed off by all stakeholders for all go live events including upgrades, particularly the issue of SPM’s (Service Procedure Manuals) and the acceptance into support by the Thought Machine Support organisation.

Support & Platform Stability

Act as the escalation point for support issues, ensuring the support organisation resolves defects and incidents in a timely and transparent manner.

Work with the assigned client support lead to track and communicate bug resolution, root cause analysis, and preventative actions to clients.

Work with the assigned client support lead to ensure platform stability and service quality meet contractual and regulatory expectations.

Commercial & Financial Ownership

Own the P&L for all paid services delivered to the client, ensuring services are delivered profitably or within the understood company investment envelope for a specified outcome to assure client success.

Maintain overall services profitability for the client, balancing issue remediation and client satisfaction, delivery quality, cost control, and long-term account value.

Oversee commercials related to professional services, managed services, upgrades, and Statements of Work (SOWs).

Work closely with the CCO office and Finance to forecast revenue, margin, and delivery costs.

Growth & Sales Collaboration

Partner with the Account Director who is accountable for growing the account and expanding white space.

Support sales cycles by articulating and presenting the client journey — from onboarding to scale — tailoring the level of engagement to be as “hands-on” as the client desires depending on the nature of the engagement (client maturity, partner involvement etc.).

Identify expansion opportunities across modules, services, upgrades, and additional volumes to get the client to the contracted volume on the platform.

Contribute to renewals and contract extensions through demonstrated value and strong relationships.

Upgrades & Roadmap Management

Oversee planning and execution of platform upgrades, ensuring minimal disruption and clear client communication.

Being the voice of the client to ensure alignment of client roadmaps and their required regulatory change with product evolution.

Ensure upgrades are delivered on time, within scope, and are commercially aligned.

Requirements

Essential

Proven experience delivering core banking transformation programmes, either:

On the vendor side (core banking / fintech provider), or

On the client side (bank, building society, or financial institution).

Strong understanding of core banking domains, including account servicing, payments, lending, and regulatory considerations.

Demonstrated accountability for delivery outcomes, milestones, and Client adoption at scale,

Experience owning or influencing commercials, P&L, and services profitability.

Ability to operate credibly with senior banking stakeholders, including CIO, COO, and business heads.

Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive-level presentation skills.

Desirable

Experience in SaaS or cloud-based core banking platforms.

Background in professional services, client success, managed services, or large-scale systems integration.

Familiarity with regulated operating environments and supervisory expectations.

Personal Attributes

Outcome-driven, commercially astute, and comfortable being held accountable,

Calm under pressure and effective in complex, multi-stakeholder environments,

Collaborative leader who can influence without direct authority,

Pragmatic problem-solver with a strong Client-first mindset.

Benefits

Highly competitive salary

Healthcare

25 days holiday and public holidays

Competitive maternity and paternity leave

$1,500 SGD per year flexible spend benefit

All the latest tech you need

A talented and experienced team as your colleagues

An environment where we encourage learning and progress

We actively hire candidates who demonstrate technical excellence in their field and welcome people of all ages and backgrounds, providing everyone with equal access to professional development. You are encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't accurately match the job description. We also encourage applications from those with different abilities, including candidates with ADHD, autism, dyslexia or dyspraxia.

title: Business Development & Sales Executive
description:
Job Summary

The Business Development & Sales Executive drives offline sales growth by acquiring new B2B customers, expanding retail and wholesale channels, promoting consumer electronic products, and achieving sales targets within the consumer electronics market.

Responsibilities

Identify and research potential B2B customers such as electronics retailers, mobile phone shops, wholesalers, distributors, and corporate buyers to expand the customer base.

Proactively source new customers using cold calling, WhatsApp, email, referrals, networking, field visits, and trade shows to generate sales opportunities.

Conduct regular field visits to present product offerings and establish new business relationships.

Develop and maintain a sales pipeline with detailed customer information, business needs, and follow-up status to track prospects effectively.

Convert qualified prospects into active purchasing accounts and meet new customer acquisition targets.

Promote the company’s product range by explaining specifications, features, pricing, and competitive advantages to customers.

Recommend products tailored to customers’ target markets, profiles, budgets, and purchasing requirements.

Introduce new product launches, promotional bundles, and seasonal offers to existing and prospective customers.

Provide sales materials such as catalogues, quotations, and samples to support customer decision-making.

Collect and report customer feedback on product quality, packaging, pricing, and market acceptance to inform product strategy.

Prepare and submit quotations, proposals, and price lists aligned with company pricing and discount policies.

Negotiate prices, order quantities, promotional terms, and commercial conditions to close sales within approved guidelines.

Follow up on quotations and enquiries to convert opportunities into confirmed purchase orders.

Encourage bulk purchases, product range expansion, and repeat orders to maximize sales revenue.

Monitor sales opportunities’ progress and maintain accurate records of negotiations and expected closing dates.

Document and obtain approval for all confirmed orders, prices, and terms according to company procedures.

Identify and develop new retail outlets, resellers, wholesale partners, and distribution channels to increase product availability.

Build relationships with decision-makers such as shop owners and purchasing managers to support channel growth.

Recommend product assortments and order quantities based on customer demand and market trends.

Identify opportunities for bulk supply, corporate gifts, promotional bundles, and B2B product packages.

Monitor product sell-through, customer demand, and replenishment needs to support inventory management.

Explore new territories, customer segments, and partnerships to sustain business growth.

Maintain regular contact and conduct scheduled visits with existing customers to support retention and growth.

Follow up on customers’ purchasing plans, stock replenishment, and new product needs to encourage repeat sales.

Introduce cross-selling opportunities and new products to increase account value.

Monitor customer purchasing patterns and resolve routine sales-related issues professionally.

Coordinate with internal teams on product quality, warranty, and technical matters to ensure customer satisfaction.

Monitor competitors’ products, pricing, promotions, and distribution to identify market trends and opportunities.

Gather customer insights on preferred brands, specifications, price points, and buying behavior to inform sales strategy.

Provide regular market intelligence and actionable recommendations to management.

Verify product availability, pricing, and delivery lead times before confirming orders to ensure accuracy.

Coordinate with warehouse, customer service, and finance teams to manage order fulfillment, invoicing, and payment follow-up.

Monitor outstanding payments and follow up on overdue accounts in line with company credit policies.

Escalate significant issues such as stock shortages, defects, delivery delays, or pricing disputes promptly.

Avoid unauthorized commitments on product specifications, delivery dates, warranties, discounts, or credit terms.

Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets for revenue, gross profit, and customer acquisition.

Maintain updated customer databases, sales pipelines, quotation records, and purchase order histories.

Submit regular reports on sales performance, customer visits, quotations, order conversions, and market developments.

Prepare sales forecasts based on customer requirements, confirmed orders, and qualified opportunities.

Review sales performance and propose action plans to address shortfalls.

Ensure accurate and timely updates of sales activities and customer records in CRM, ERP, or reporting systems.

Maintain current knowledge of product range, specifications, pricing, and approved claims to ensure accurate communication.

Comply with company policies on pricing, discounts, credit, order approvals, and sales documentation.

Observe product safety, labeling, and regulatory requirements when promoting and supplying electronic products.

Handle customer and company pricing information confidentially.

Represent the company professionally during customer meetings, business visits, exhibitions, and sales activities.

Communicate effectively in English to engage with customers and internal teams; additional languages relevant to the customer base are advantageous.

Travel locally as needed to conduct customer visits and business development activities.

Preferred competencies and qualifications

Previous experience in sales, business development, or B2B customer management.

Experience in consumer electronics, mobile accessories, IT products, retail distribution, or wholesale trading.

Ability to quickly learn and understand electronic accessories product specifications.

Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.

Proactive, independent, and target-driven with capability to conduct field sales activities.

Good organizational skills to manage multiple customers and sales opportunities.

Proficiency in basic computer applications, spreadsheets, and sales reporting systems.

Valid driving licence and own transport are advantageous for field sales.

title: Key Account Manager Global Account APAC

The Key Account Manager maintains and expands relationships with important clients and will work closely with various business departments in order to maintain and further develop the relationships. The Key Account Manager supports the business in achievement of the sales quota and is assigned key objectives/metrics relevant to key accounts. The Key Accounts Manager represents the entire range of company solutions to the assigned partners. Support Booking.com strategy & influencing initiatives and vision for key regional partners.

Support booking.com product development based on regional knowledge and key partner relationships.

title: APAC Service Delivery Manager
description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The Role

The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is responsible for overseeing the performance, quality, and operational health of partner-delivered services in APAC. Acting as the primary governance point between ServiceNow and delivery partner(s), the SDM ensures partner engagements are delivered in accordance with agreed service levels, quality standards, contractual commitments, and customer outcome expectations.

The SDM monitors partner delivery performance, identifies risks, drives corrective actions, manages escalations, and provides ongoing visibility into delivery health for ServiceNow leadership. The role serves as the accountability layer that makes partner performance predictable, scalable, and aligned to ServiceNow standards, regardless of whether the partner is delivering managed services, outsourced operations, subcontracted services, or project-based engagements.

Responsibilities

Serve as the primary ServiceNow point of contact for the partner's aligned Delivery Manager(s), maintaining day-to-day oversight of partner service performance against contracted KPIs and SLAs.
Review delivery quality trends, audit findings, and operational metrics to identify systemic issues, root causes, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
Monitor delivery unit economics and cost-per-outcome performance, ensuring the contracted commercial model (unit-based, outcome-based, or hybrid) tracks to delivered value.
Manage the ongoing evolution of the Partner’s service so that new capabilities can be planned and deployed with the appropriate stakeholder alignment, scalable processes and measurable outcomes to drive results
Manage the operational governance cadence, including weekly performance check-ins, monthly reviews, and quarterly business review preparation.
Lead delivery escalations across ServiceNow and partner teams, driving timely issue resolution and ensuring accountability for remediation plans and service recovery activities.
Own tracking and acceptance of transition and mobilization milestones during partner onboarding or service transitions, including staffing ramp against plan, capability/certification readiness, and transition exit criteria.
Own capacity and demand management processes, including utilization tracking, variance planning, and periodic reconciliation against contracted volumes.
Manage the change control process for operational or initiative requests that have contractual implications, engaging Commercial Management as needed.
Flag discrepancies between service delivery status and invoicing or milestone payment triggers to Commercial and Finance stakeholders.
Produce and maintain performance reporting, providing regular updates to internal leadership and ensure effective coverage and handoff models across distributed, multi-shift delivery teams
Identify and implement process improvements in response to changes in tooling, operating model, or service delivery requirements.
Coordinate with Service Delivery Managers in other geographies on initiative design, sequencing, and rollout to ensure global consistency.
Maintain a regular interlock with the Global Partnerships and Channels (GPC) team and the emerging global partner organization, ensuring partner performance insights, escalations, and capability needs are shared and jointly actioned.
Partner with account teams, customer success teams, and delivery stakeholders to protect customer outcomes and address service delivery risks impacting customer health.
Drive consistency in delivery execution, governance processes, and operational standards across partner-delivered services within the geography.

Qualifications

Demonstrated experience in service delivery management, vendor governance, or partner performance management within a complex, matrixed organisation – particularly within India-based organizations.
Experience managing partner, vendor, or supplier performance through structured governance frameworks, scorecards, and business reviews.
Proven ability to manage third-party performance against defined SLAs and KPIs, including escalation and corrective action processes.
Experience managing partners related to Customer Success and Professional Services context
Experience designing and maintaining operational documentation, including playbooks and standard operating procedures.
Strong project and programme management capability, with a track record of delivering cross-functional initiatives to agreed timelines.
Ensure effective coverage and handoff models across distributed, multi-shift delivery teams
Experience monitoring and tracking partner resource ongoing development of skills and certifications in line with service demands
Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate across functions and levels of seniority without direct line authority.
Proficiency in performance data analysis and reporting, with the ability to draw actionable conclusions from KPI and operational metrics.
Familiarity with Customer Success and Professional Service metrics and post-sales operating models, including NPS, utilization, rate cards, and product adoption measures.
Knowledge of, or ability to rapidly develop proficiency in, ServiceNow’s platform and products.
Ability to balance customer outcomes, business objectives, and partner performance requirements in a complex operating environment.
5+ years of experience in service delivery, partner governance, or a related operational role within a global technology or SaaS environment.
Track record of driving continuous improvement and service efficiencies.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working within or alongside a Partner or managed service delivery model, particularly in a vendor governance or service integration capacity.
Familiarity with scaled SaaS operating models, AI Native environments, and partner-delivered service motions.
Experience operating within an organisational transformation programme in a post-sales or customer success context.
Certifications in project management, service management, supplier management, or customer success disciplines (e.g., PMP, ITIL, CSM, COPC).
Exposure to AI-enabled or agentic workflow tooling within an operational team environment.
Experience operating in global teams servicing multiple geographies, including AMS, EMEA, and APAC.

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

title: Account Executive, Japan & Korea
description:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the next-generation commodity trading platform.

We give trading desks the clarity, control, and collaboration they need to move faster and trade smarter.

In February 2025, we secured $42 million in Series B funding. Now we’re scaling up across the business, and it’s an exciting time to join.

Our people are the driving force behind everything we do. At Sparta, you’ll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. You’ll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow. Because building something this ambitious takes everyone at their best.

At Sparta, your work has reach. From improving our platform, to powering smarter decisions for our customers, to changing how commodity trading is done around the world.

And because we’re growing fast, you won’t just build your career. You’ll accelerate it, with a level of ownership and impact you simply don’t get at bigger, more bureaucratic companies.

The Role

This is a new-logo hunter role with an account development edge. Based in Singapore, you will own Sparta’s Japanese and Korean territory: building pipeline from scratch, getting in front of trading desks in person, and closing complex, multi-product deals. Roughly 70% of your time goes to winning new logos and 30% to growing and supporting the clients you bring in.

Japan is the immediate priority, with Korea following as the territory matures. Many of the desks you sell to sit in Singapore, but sometimes the budget, the mandate and the long-term relationship often sit with headquarters in Tokyo or Seoul. You will work both, building credibility locally and sponsorship at HQ.

You will sell to C-suite and VP-level buyers while winning over the traders, analysts and risk managers who will use the product and know their market cold.

You will have pre-sales and Customer Success behind you, and an Asia Pacific team growing quickly.

You will work from our Singapore office 4 days a week.

What You Will Be Doing

New Business

• Research opportunities, initiate discussions, build prospect relationships, run demos, manage product trials and close deals across Japanese and Korean energy commodity firms.

• Develop a pipeline of high-value opportunities through networking, events and in-person interaction with traders and decision-makers in Singapore and HQ.

• Sell to C-suite, VP-level and trading desks, articulating a clear business case and ROI for our SaaS solutions.

• Build relationships with headquarters stakeholders so that regional wins convert into group-level commitments.

Account Development and Expansion

• Grow the clients you win: expand usage across desks, verticals and products, and build the internal advocacy that turns a first deal into a multi-year relationship.

• Work with Customer Success to protect renewals and spot expansion signals early.

• Act as the commercial point of contact your clients trust, and bring their market feedback back into the business.

Enterprise Sales Execution

• Lead a virtual account team, coordinating with internal resources across pre-sales, customer success and marketing to drive deals forward.

• Use value-selling methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger and SPIN to align solutions with customer pain points and strategic initiatives.

• Structure and negotiate complex, multi-product deals tailored to customer needs.

Forecasting and Pipeline Management

• Maintain accurate sales forecasts, using HubSpot and sales analytics tools to manage deal progression and pipeline health.

• Track sales KPIs and continually refine sales tactics to improve conversion rates and shorten deal cycles.

About You

• 5+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, preference selling into commodities or energy markets.

• Business-level fluency in Japanese or Korean, in addition to English. This is required because most stakeholders will be Japanese and Koreans and prefer this as their working language

• Proven track record of hunting and closing complex, high-value deals, and hitting six- or seven-figure annual revenue targets.

• Able to build pipeline across a set territory from scratch: identifying the right opportunities, getting access to senior decision-makers, and building the internal advocacy that enterprise deals need.

• Comfortable running product demonstrations and navigating long sales cycles with multiple business and technical stakeholders.

title: Senior/Executive, Business Development & Partnerships
description:
Senior/Executive, Business Development & Partnerships

Singapore Environment Council (SEC)

Grow Sustainability. Grow Your Career.

The Singapore Environment Council (SEC) is an independent, non-profit organisation dedicated to promoting environmental sustainability and responsible business practices. Through certification programmes, sustainability initiatives and stakeholder engagement, SEC works with organisations across industries to drive positive environmental impact.

We are looking for a driven, results-oriented

Senior/Executive, Business Development & Partnerships

to grow SEC's certification, sustainability and advisory business. If you enjoy opening doors, closing deals and building partnerships that create real environmental impact, we would like to hear from you.

If you have a passion for client engagement, business development and sustainability, we would like to hear from you.

About the Role

As a Senior/Executive, Client Engagement & Business Development, you will play an important role in growing SEC's certification and sustainability services. You will engage clients and partners, develop new business opportunities, support agreement development, and provide administrative support to ensure smooth departmental operations.

This is an individual contributor position with sales targets and opportunities to develop expertise in sustainability certification programmes and environmental standards.

Key Responsibilities

Identify, qualify and pursue new business opportunities across SEC's certification, sustainability and advisory service offerings.

Achieve individual sales targets and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospects.

Generate leads through networking, outreach, industry events and targeted campaigns.

Conduct presentations and pitches to organisations interested in SEC's programmes and services.

Build and maintain relationships with new and existing clients to secure renewals and expand business.

Partnerships & Deal Closing

Develop partnerships with industry associations, corporates, government agencies and other stakeholders.

Draft, format and negotiate business agreements, Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs) and partnership proposals.

Work with internal stakeholders and external parties to move agreements through review to finalisation.

Maintain accurate records of agreements, proposals and deal status.

Events & Market Presence

Represent SEC at industry events, exhibitions, networking sessions and stakeholder engagement activities.

Support the planning and execution of major SEC events and programmes to generate leads and partnerships.

Business Operations Support

Prepare sales reports, pipeline updates, presentations and management materials.

Coordinate meetings and follow-up actions with the Deputy Director, Client Engagement.

Support departmental projects and initiatives as required.

What We're Looking For

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Sustainability, or a related discipline.

At least 3 years of experience in business development, sales, partnerships or account management, with a track record of meeting targets.

Experience selling services in sustainability, certification, compliance, environmental services, professional services or consulting will be an advantage.

Candidates with strong business development experience but no sustainability background are encouraged to apply; we will help you build that expertise.

Skills & Competencies

Proactive and target-driven, comfortable with prospecting and outreach.

Confident presenter and persuasive communicator, in writing and in person.

Able to draft and negotiate business documents with attention to detail.

Works independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Word and Excel.

Manages multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic environment.

Professional and ethical in handling confidential information.

Additional Information

Occasional regional travel may be required for business development, stakeholder engagement and certification-related activities.

Why Join SEC?

Grow a business that directly advances Singapore's sustainability goals.

Work with organisations across multiple industries to drive positive environmental impact.

Build expertise in sustainability certifications and environmental standards.

Be part of a purpose-driven organisation committed to a more sustainable future.

Opportunities for professional development and career growth.

Diversity & Inclusion

Singapore Environment Council is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, gender, race, religion, marital status, caregiving responsibilities, disability status or background. Selection is based on merit, skills, experience and job-related competencies.

Interested applicants are invited to submit a detailed resume outlining their relevant experience and achievements, including sales or partnership results where possible.

Established in 1995, the

Singapore Environment Council (SEC)

is an independently managed, non-profit, non-governmental organisation (NGO) dedicated to fostering a lasting culture of environmental ownership. As an approved

Institution of a Public Character (IPC)

, we serve as a primary catalyst for environmental advocacy and coordinate efforts across Singapore and the region.

We hold a unique position in the global sustainability landscape:

Global Recognition:

We are the only recognised member of the

Global Ecolabelling Network (GEN)

in Singapore, a non-profit association of leading eco-labelling organisations worldwide.

UN Accreditation:

In 2018, the SEC was granted

United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)

accredited environmental NGO status, further amplifying our influence on sustainability issues.

National Impact:

We work closely with government agencies, statutory boards, and industry partners to translate environmental policy into actionable solutions, such as the

Resource Sustainability Act

and

Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)

frameworks.

At SEC, we don't just influence thinking; we drive systemic change. By joining our team, you will be at the heart of Singapore’s transition toward a circular economy and a more sustainable future

title: Business Development Executive
description:
*About NuSpace*

NuSpace is a Singapore-headquartered company building satellite IoT connectivity and CubeSat hardware. Our mission is to connect every sensor, asset, and machine on Earth, including the places terrestrial networks never reach. Our NuLink connectivity service and CubeSat bus platform serve customers who need reliable data from remote and demanding environments. We are a small, engineering-led team entering a commercial growth phase, and we are hiring our first dedicated business development associate.

*About the Role*

You will work directly with our Chief Executive Officer to turn our technology into customer relationships. This is a commercial role, not a research role. You will spend most of your time on market research, outreach, and proposal support, and you will learn how a deep-tech company actually wins business. Sales cycles in this industry are long, so expect early wins to be small: a qualified lead, a well-received proposal, an insight that changes how we position a product.

What you will do:

* *Research markets:* Analyse where satellite IoT and CubeSat hardware create the most value (for example agriculture, logistics, maritime, energy, and government) and recommend where we should focus.
* *Qualify leads:* Handle inbound inquiries and outbound outreach, working out who the decision-maker is, what the customer needs, and whether it is a real opportunity.
* *Support proposals and bids:* Help draft proposals, capability documents, and grant or tender submissions, working with our engineers to translate technical specs into customer language.
* *Maintain the pipeline:* Keep our prospective customer lists accurate and give leadership a clear weekly view of opportunities and risks.
* *Feed customer insight back:* Bring what customers say to our product and engineering team. Your notes will be used in roadmap discussions.

*What your first 12 months look like*

* *Months 1 to 3:* Learn our products and customers, shadow leadership on calls and meetings, and create your own lead tracker and market research pack.
* *Months 4 to 6:* Run lead qualification independently and draft proposals with review.
* *Months 7 to 12:* Own a defined segment or account set, and take part in pricing and positioning discussions.
* *At 12 months:* We review your scope, title, and compensation together, based on agreed goals set at the start.

*Who You Are*

* You are a recent graduate (or within two years of graduating) in business, engineering, science, or a related field. Any discipline is fine if you can show the skills below.
* You are curious about how technology becomes a product customers pay for. Interest in space is welcome, and we will teach you the rest.
* You write clearly and can explain technical ideas to non-technical people, and business needs to engineers.
* You take initiative, follow through, and treat rejection as information.
* You are comfortable with ambiguity and with a small team where roles overlap.

*Nice to have*

* Internship or project experience in sales, market research, or client-facing work.
* Familiarity with creating a method to track prospective customers or proposal writing.
* Startup or fast-paced team experience.

*What We Offer*

* *Real ownership:* A small team means your work is visible and your input is used.
* *Structured mentorship:* Regular one-to-ones with CEO and exposure to engineering, so you learn both the technology and the commercial side.
* *A defined growth path:* A documented 12-month review and clear expectations for what the next role looks like.
* *A team that supports each other:* We start you off at the deep end by having you identify unfamiliar concepts, then provide guidance to fill those gaps. The team is friendly, welcoming, and supportive throughout.

*How to Apply*

Send your resume and a short written note (no more than 300 words) on what interests you about our business and one market you think we should pursue and why, to jobs@nuspace.sg. We review every application and will reply within 3 working days.

Pay: $4,000.00 - $5,000.00 per month

Benefits:
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Parental leave
* Professional development
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Singapore 117292

Seniority Level: Associate | Job Function: Sales, Business Development | Industry: Food and Beverage Services

About Foodmax

Foodmax is a technology-driven fresh food supply chain platform in Singapore that offers F&B businesses a one-stop ingredient sourcing solution. Through the Foodmax app, customers can order a full range of food products, including meat, poultry, eggs, vegetables, fruits, packaged goods and dry goods, quickly and reliably.

About the Role

We are looking for a results-driven Sales Executive to grow our F&B customer base in Singapore. Your main focus will be acquiring new F&B customers and getting them to download the Foodmax app and order through it. You will also handle after-sales service, collections and ongoing account management so that customers keep ordering more over time.

Key Responsibilities

New Customer Acquisition

Acquire new F&B customers, including restaurants, cafés, hotels, food court and hawker stalls, central kitchens, and catering companies, and achieve your individual sales and acquisition targets.

Generate leads through field visits, cold calls, referrals and industry events. Learn each customer's menu, purchasing categories, volumes and current suppliers, and recommend suitable products and pricing.

Get customers to download and register on the Foodmax app, support their first order, and train them to order on their own.

Account Management & Growth

Build long-term relationships with existing customers through regular check-ins, and increase their repeat orders and ordering frequency.

Encourage customers to expand from one category to the full range of products, increasing their spend and Foodmax's share of their purchasing.

Spot customers whose orders are dropping or who may leave, follow up early and put plans in place to win them back.

After-Sales Service & Issue Resolution

Act as the customers' main point of contact for issues such as product quality, specifications, stock availability, wrong or missing items, and delivery timing.

Work with the Quality Control, Procurement, Warehouse, Logistics and Customer Service teams to handle returns, replacements and credit notes, make sure each issue is fully resolved, and update the customer.

Gather customer feedback on products, pricing and service, and share it internally to drive improvements.

Collections & Credit Management

Track customer payment terms and statement reconciliation to make sure payments come in on time.

Follow up on overdue payments and work with the Finance team to recover outstanding amounts and reduce bad-debt risk.

Assess the creditworthiness of new customers and flag high-risk accounts early.

Reporting

Keep customer records, visit notes and pipeline updates current in the CRM or sales system.

Track your performance on new customers acquired, active ordering customers, sales revenue, repeat order rate and collection rate.

Report regularly on your progress and on market conditions, including competitor activity and pricing.

Requirements

At least 3 years of sales experience in the HORECA or F&B industry. Experience in food distribution, fresh food supply chain, FMCG or B2B ordering platforms is preferred.

An existing network of F&B customers in Singapore is a strong advantage.

A proven track record in new business development, with the drive to prospect and cold-call, resilience and a results-oriented mindset.

Good understanding of F&B purchasing needs. Familiarity with meat, poultry, eggs, fresh produce and dry goods is a plus.

Experience in after-sales issue handling, account reconciliation and payment collection, with the ability to work across teams to resolve problems.

Familiar with CRM or sales tracking tools. Experience getting customers to adopt an app or online ordering platform is preferred.

Strong communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills, and able to work independently.

Proficiency in Mandarin and/or Malay is an advantage, as the role serves F&B customers from diverse language backgrounds.

Willing to travel frequently for customer visits. A valid driving licence and own vehicle are an advantage.

What We Offer

Competitive base salary plus performance-based commission

Growth opportunities in a fast-growing food-tech company

A full product range and digital ordering tools that make selling easier

A collaborative, results-driven team culture

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

Corporate Sales & Business Development Executive

The Gift Expert is a leading corporate gifting and merchandising company that helps businesses strengthen relationships through thoughtfully curated gifts, branded merchandise, promotional products, employee appreciation programmes, and customised gift solutions. As we continue to expand, we are looking for 3 to 4 ambitious, driven, and relationship-focused individuals to join our growing Corporate Sales & Business Development team.

This role is ideal for candidates who enjoy meeting people, building relationships, presenting ideas, and helping clients find creative gifting solutions. Whether you have previous sales experience or are looking to build a career in B2B sales, we provide the training and support needed to develop your skills in corporate sales, business development, and account management.

As a Corporate Sales & Business Development Executive, you will play a key role in driving business growth by identifying and engaging potential corporate clients across various industries. Your responsibilities will include prospecting new business opportunities, conducting cold calls and client outreach, introducing our corporate gifting and merchandise solutions, understanding clients' branding and campaign objectives, preparing quotations and proposals, following up on enquiries, negotiating opportunities, and converting leads into long-term business relationships.

You will also support The Gift Expert's expansion into retail merchandising by working with theme parks, tourist attractions, museums, hotels, resorts, lifestyle brands, and destination retailers to develop customised souvenir collections, retail-ready merchandise, and exclusive gift products.

Working closely with our internal teams and supplier network, you will coordinate product recommendations, sourcing, sampling, artwork approvals, pricing, production schedules, and delivery timelines to ensure every project is delivered smoothly and exceeds client expectations.

Candidates with backgrounds in sales, events management, event organising, hospitality, tourism, retail, marketing, client servicing, project coordination, or customer relationship management will have an advantage, as these experiences translate well into understanding client expectations, managing multiple projects, coordinating timelines, and delivering outstanding customer experiences. Experience in organising corporate events, exhibitions, roadshows, conferences, or marketing activations is an added bonus, as many corporate gifting projects are closely aligned with events, product launches, employee engagement initiatives, and client appreciation programmes.

We are looking for individuals who are energetic, proactive, confident communicators, and eager to learn. Success in this role comes from having a positive attitude, resilience, strong interpersonal skills, and a genuine interest in helping businesses create memorable gifting experiences. We welcome motivated individuals who are prepared to take ownership of their work and grow within a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

The Gift Expert offers comprehensive training in corporate sales, cold calling, business development, client relationship management, solution selling, and merchandising. In addition to a competitive basic salary, this role includes an attractive commission structure that rewards strong performance and provides significant earning potential as you build and expand your client portfolio.

If you enjoy meeting clients, developing creative solutions, and building long-term business relationships, this is an excellent opportunity to establish a rewarding career in the corporate gifting and merchandising industry with The Gift Expert.

WE ARE BBC STUDIOS

A globally renowned media company borne of the BBC. We make and distribute the world's most sought-after TV, audio and digital content.

Our ambition is to be the home of the most powerful, entertaining, and inspiring stories for people all around the world.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Ad Sales Planner is a critical member of the APAC Advertising Sales team, supporting revenue growth across BBC Studios' portfolio of television, digital, audio, sponsorship, branded content and audience solutions. Working closely with sales, clients, agencies and internal stakeholders, the role supports the full advertising sales cycle, from proposal development and campaign planning through to execution, reporting and post-campaign analysis.

The APAC region presents a significant growth opportunity through a dual-pronged strategy of expanding our base of premium television advertisers while accelerating growth across BBC Studios' evolving digital, audience, data and content marketing solutions. As a result, this role plays an important part in helping clients better understand and access BBC Studios' unique audiences, premium content environments and advertising capabilities.

The successful candidate will combine strong commercial acumen, attention to detail and client management skills with a passion for media, content, audience insights and advertising innovation. They will become a trusted partner to the sales team, supporting business growth while ensuring the highest standards of campaign execution and client service.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT

1. Commercial Sales Planning & Client Solutions (55%)

Support the APAC Advertising Sales team in developing strategic advertising solutions that drive revenue growth across television, digital, audio, sponsorship, branded content and audience-led opportunities.

Develop compelling media plans, presentations and commercial proposals in response to client and agency briefs.
Translate client marketing objectives into integrated advertising solutions leveraging BBC Studios' content, audience and platform capabilities.
Partner with Sales, Insights, StoryWorks and other internal stakeholders to deliver competitive and commercially effective recommendations.

Support programmatic advertising opportunities and act as a point of contact for agency trading desks where required.
Assist in creating best-in-class sales material that positions BBC Studios as a premium advertising partner across APAC.
Act as a trusted commercial partner to the sales team, anticipating client needs and delivering responsive support throughout the sales process.
2. Campaign Management & Client Service Excellence (30%)

Manage the successful implementation, delivery and optimisation of campaigns while providing exceptional support to clients, agencies and internal stakeholders.

Coordinate campaign setup and execution with Ad Operations, StoryWorks, Compliance and other business functions.
Manage campaign bookings, insertion orders, sponsorship documentation and internal approval processes.
Liaise with clients and agencies to ensure all creative materials and campaign assets are received, approved and delivered on schedule.
Monitor campaign performance and identify optimisation opportunities to maximise campaign outcomes.
Provide timely communication and support throughout the campaign lifecycle.
Troubleshoot campaign delivery issues in partnership with operational teams and communicate resolutions to stakeholders.
Prepare campaign performance reports, transmission reports and post-campaign reviews.
Ensure campaigns are delivered in accordance with contractual commitments and client expectations.
Build strong day-to-day relationships with agencies, advertisers and regional sales representatives.
Act as a reliable first point of contact for campaign-related enquiries and operational support.
3. Commercial Reporting, Sales Operations & Business Support (15%)

Provide accurate reporting, financial coordination and operational support to enable effective decision-making and seamless commercial execution.

Prepare and distribute campaign performance reports, post-campaign analyses, transmission reports and revenue tracking updates.
Support the sales team with audience insights, market intelligence and competitor monitoring to strengthen client conversations and commercial outcomes.
Partner closely with Finance to support billing accuracy, invoice reconciliation, revenue recognition processes and client payment enquiries.

Maintain accurate information across CRM, booking, reporting and sales management systems.
Support regional business reporting requirements and sales administration processes.
Ensure consistency with BBC Studios' commercial policies, reporting standards and product messaging across APAC.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and sales effectiveness.

Deliver high-quality, strategic media plans that contribute to revenue growth across APAC.
Become a trusted commercial partner to the sales team and a valued contact for clients and agencies.
Contribute to the growth of both premium television advertising and emerging digital, audience and content-led revenue streams.
Maintain high standards of campaign delivery, reporting accuracy and client satisfaction.
Drive operational excellence through efficient processes, accurate forecasting and strong financial coordination.
Provide actionable insights that strengthen BBC Studios' commercial proposition and market position.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
Experience within a media owner, publisher, agency or advertising environment preferred.

Excellent organisational, administrative and project management skills.
