By using massive amounts of new satellite data and pioneering work in artificial intelligence, Vortexa creates an unprecedented view of global seaborne energy flows in real-time, bringing transparency and efficiency to the energy markets.

With offices in London, New York, Houston, Singapore, Geneva and the UAE, we are building the definitive platform for energy and freight analytics globally - backed by leading investors including Morgan Stanley & Notion Capital.

The Role:

We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our BDR Pipeline Generation team, based in our Singapore office and focused on the APAC region. You will play a crucial role in driving the growth of our business, helping to generate new opportunities across our core APAC customer segments.

You’ll be responsible for identifying and engaging high-potential prospects across APAC — including Singapore and Southeast Asia (e.g. Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and Vietnam), Japan, South Korea, Australia, India and Greater China — through both marketing-generated leads and proactive outbound efforts ensuring our Sales team is set up to succeed. You'll work closely with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to drive pipeline generation through inbound lead discovery and qualification, proactive and energetic outbounding, and driving attendance at key APAC industry events.

It’s an ideal opportunity for someone eager to develop their SaaS career in a high-performing, global team, while learning about one of the world’s most impactful and complex industries.

In this role you will:

Drive qualified pipeline through personalised, multichannel outreach (email, LinkedIn, phone, event follow-up, and local channels such as WeChat, LINE and KakaoTalk where appropriate)
Conduct Discovery calls and qualify leads before handover to Sales, mapping the buying group and approval process (often consensus-driven in markets such as Japan and Korea)
Research and map high-potential accounts across APAC’s core segments — national oil companies and refiners, Japanese trading houses and utilities, Singapore-based trading firms, shipowners and brokers, bunkering, and banks and commodity funds
Collaborate with the Marketing team to promote and drive registrations for Vortexa-hosted and APAC industry events (e.g. Singapore International Energy Week, APPEC, Singapore Maritime Week, Asia Pacific Maritime, and LNG and freight conferences in Japan, Korea and Australia)
Collaborate with the RevOps, Sales, and Marketing teams to evolve scalable playbooks and processes
Ensure accurate tracking and maintenance of data within the BDR tech stack (Salesforce, Salesloft, Gong, Marketo etc.)
Run outreach in line with regional data-privacy and anti-spam rules (e.g. Singapore PDPA, China PIPL, Japan APPI, India DPDP Act, Australia Spam Act)
Maintain core working hours aligned to Singapore time, with flexibility to engage prospects across APAC time zones (from India to Japan and Australia), plus occasional regional travel for key events and customer meetings (10-20%)
Consistently meet or exceed quarterly targets for revenue contribution (e.g. qualified demos booked with AEs, pipeline created, and pipeline closed won)

Requirements

You will have:

At least 2 years of experience in a SaaS BDR, SDR, or commercial associate role
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling outreach and hold engaging conversations with senior stakeholders to engage prospects and nurture leads
Cultural fluency in APAC business norms, including relationship-led selling and hierarchy-aware engagement with senior stakeholders
Genuine interest in the energy, freight, or commodities space; (experience in the sector is a plus)
A proactive and curious attitude, with an eagerness to grow within a high-performing team
A proven track record of exceeding commercial OKRs
Experience with Salesforce, Salesloft, Gong, ZoomInfo, etc. or similar tools, plus the resourcefulness to research accounts manually where database coverage is thin (common in North and Southeast Asia)
Professional working proficiency English and additional local languages (bonus)
Sound judgement when engaging prospects in sanctions-sensitive or politically sensitive trade flows
The ability to work independently, take initiative, and meet deadlines

Great if you have:

A background in the energy industry (e.g. oil & gas trading, freight analytics, commodities, etc.) and are looking to pivot into a SaaS commercial career, we’d love to hear from you.
Prior exposure to APAC commercial, trading or maritime environments.

Benefits

Stock-options in a fast-growing, high-potential business
An open, collaborative, and supportive working culture built on merit, which celebrates creative thinking and “getting things done.”
The opportunity to work with AI-driven technology in a scale-up environment with commodity trading experts
Private Health Insurance offered via AXA
A flexible working policy- accommodating both remote & home working, with regular staff events
Global Volunteering Policy to help you ‘do good’ and feel better
Competitive base salary plus commission and a clear career path from BDR to Sales Manager

Maintain accurate customer records, quotations, sales pipelines and order documentation.

Identify opportunities to improve customer service, repeat business and sales performance.

Strong communication, interpersonal and customer service skills.

A proactive, responsible and results-oriented approach to work.

Confidence in approaching customers, following up on opportunities and developing business relationships.

Good organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple orders and deadlines.

A practical mindset and willingness to learn about garment products, fabrics, sizing and production processes.

Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues, customers and suppliers.

Preferably 2–3 years of experience in B2B sales, corporate sales, account management, business development or a related field.

Experience in uniforms, apparel, garment merchandising, textiles or workwear will be a strong advantage.

Experience in preparing quotations, processing purchase orders and coordinating production or deliveries is advantageous.

A diploma or degree in Business, Sales & Marketing, Fashion, Apparel, Textiles or a related discipline is preferred; relevant practical experience will also be considered.

Good written and spoken English for customer communication and business documentation.

Familiarity with Microsoft Office, spreadsheets and sales or order-management systems is an advantage.

Candidates with strong B2B sales experience from other industries are welcome to apply if they can demonstrate relevant commercial skills and a willingness to learn the uniform business.

The Singapore Mint was established in 1968 to mint circulation coins for the newly-independent nation. Over the years, The Singapore Mint has evolved from a basic minting facility to a fully integrated business operation, comprising programme concept, product design, marketing, sales and distribution with after sales service. Focusing on quality system and standards, The Singapore Mint is a certified ISO 9001 and 14001 organisation. Today, it has grown to become one of the leading innovative mints in the industry, capable of producing coins and medallions of the highest quality.

Leveraging on technology, The Singapore Mint has developed hybrid techniques to create high security and innovative features on circulation and commemorative coins and collectables. Fusing advanced minting technologies with authentic crafting methods, The Singapore Mint is one of the few mints in the world that still maintains a team of highly skilled craftsmen, adding intricate elements that can only be meticulously achieved by the human touch.

As a testament of its high quality crafting techniques, The Singapore Mint has won multiple international awards and its rising stature has garnered much interest internationally. The mint has been appointed by issuing authorities around the world for the production of their coins.

Other than producing coins and medallions, The Singapore Mint has also expanded to provide quality currency-related gifts and collectibles, lifestyle products and services to both local and international markets. We continue to pledge our unwavering commitment to our customers, business associates and partners to offer the best in quality, value and service.

The Singapore Mint (Singapore Precision Industries Pte Ltd) is a fully owned subsidiary of Sembcorp Industries.

We are looking for someone who is proactive, independent, and commercially minded — someone who does not wait for opportunities to appear but actively creates them.

Actively manage sales opportunities through each stage of the commercial process, ensuring consistent follow-up and progression.

Contribute ideas and initiatives to improve sales effectiveness, market positioning, and business development processes.

Participate in relevant industry events, client meetings and regional business activities were commercially beneficial.

Requirements & Qualifications

Professional Experience

Minimum

5 years of proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or new business acquisition.

Experience in Testing, Inspection & Certification (TIC), commodity inspection, logistics, supply chain services or other complex B2B service industries is preferred.

Demonstrated ability to independently generate leads, establish new client relationships, and successfully close business opportunities.

Strong commercial understanding, including opportunity qualification, proposal development, negotiation, and margin awareness.

Experience working with regional or international clients and coordinating with cross-functional teams is advantageous.

Familiarity with CRM systems, preferably HubSpot, and a disciplined approach to pipeline management.

Skills & Personal Attributes

A genuine business hunter: Highly proactive in prospecting, comfortable with cold outreach and motivated by winning new business.

Results-oriented: Able to translate sales activities and client meetings into qualified opportunities, revenue, and profitable business.

Independent and self-driven: Capable of developing new markets and managing priorities with minimal supervision.

Commercially astute: Able to identify client needs, communicate value, negotiate effectively and progress opportunities towards closure.

Curious and adaptable: Willing to explore unfamiliar industries, learn new services and challenge conventional approaches.

Resilient and persistent: Comfortable handling rejection, overcoming objections and maintaining momentum throughout the sales cycle.

Collaborative: Able to work effectively with technical specialists, operational teams and colleagues across different countries and cultures.

Strong communicator: Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to engage senior decisionmakers and build professional relationships.

What We Offer

An opportunity to play a key role in expanding our business presence in Singapore.

Exposure to a broad portfolio of services, industries, and international markets.

Access to our global network of technical experts, commercial specialists, and operational teams.

A structured onboarding programme to build familiarity with our services, internal network, and commercial processes.

Guidance and commercial support during the initial development phase, with increasing autonomy as you establish yourself in the role.

The opportunity to contribute ideas, develop new markets and make a measurable impact on business growth.

A dynamic, internationally connected working environment that values initiative, independent thinking, and collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured simply by the number of contacts made or meetings attended.

We are looking for someone who can consistently create new opportunities, build a qualified sales pipeline, progress negotiations and convert prospects into profitable business.

You will initially focus on developing a strong network of prospects and generating qualified opportunities, with increasing responsibility for delivering new clients, revenue and gross margin as the business pipeline matures.

Ready to Take on the Challenge?

If you are a motivated B2B sales professional who thrives on building new business, enjoys opening doors and wants to make a meaningful commercial impact within an international organisation, we would like to hear from you.

Apply now

and become part of our continued growth in Singapore and the wider Asia Pacific region.

The company focuses on integrated services across managed support, cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, systems, talent resourcing, circular IT, and workflow solutions. Hubb IT is built for customers and partners who require more than transactional hardware or software fulfillment; they need measurable service outcomes, strong account governance, and commercial accountability.

The Opportunity

The Sales Manager will be responsible for driving revenue growth, account expansion, and managed services adoption across new and existing customers. This role is designed for a commercially strong sales professional or technical specialist transitioning into commercial sales, with prior System Integration (SI) experience and proven capability in positioning managed services, not just hardware or software.

The ideal candidate engages business owners, IT leaders, partners, and decision-makers with confidence, translates technical requirements into business value, and manages opportunities from prospecting to closure. You are self-driven, mature, target-oriented, accountable, and comfortable operating in a growth-stage environment where accountability, pipeline discipline, and customer trust are non-negotiable.

What You Will Own

Revenue Growth & Target Ownership:

Own assigned sales and gross profit targets by driving outcome-led deals across SMEs, mid-market, enterprise, and channel-led accounts while protecting margins and recurring revenue.

Consultative Selling & Service Adoption:

Position Hubb IT's managed services, cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure, circular IT, and workflow solutions to help clients reduce operational risk and improve responsiveness.

Account Governance & Lifecycle Management:

Manage the full client relationship—from initial discovery and proposal shaping to contract negotiation, onboarding, and structured periodic account reviews.

Ecosystem & Partner Development:

Collaborate with System Integrators, MSPs, vendors, and distributors to build joint go-to-market opportunities and execute partner-led sales motions.

Pipeline Discipline & Governance:

Maintain strict CRM accuracy and actively participate in the mandatory Weekly Salamanca sales reviews to present opportunity forecasts, deal margins, and actionable next steps.

Required Experience and Competencies

Mandatory Background:

Prior experience working in or selling for a System Integrator (SI) environment is mandatory.

Managed Services Sales Experience:

Experience selling managed IT services, cybersecurity services, cloud migration, cloud operations, infrastructure support, endpoint management, backup and recovery, or helpdesk services.

Technical Domain Understanding:

Strong understanding of cloud solutions, infrastructure, systems, cybersecurity, endpoint environments, networks, servers, and service delivery models.

Account Management & Value Selling:

Good account management capability beyond one-time product transactions, with the ability to sell business outcomes rather than only hardware specifications, software features, or price discounts.

End-to-End Sales Acumen:

Strong sales acumen including prospecting, discovery, objection handling, proposal positioning, negotiation, closing, and account expansion.

Stakeholder Engagement:

Comfort engaging both business and technical stakeholders with strong communication, presentation, proposal writing, and follow-up discipline.

Execution & Reporting Hygiene:

Mandatory CRM discipline and weekly reporting discipline.

Behavioural Expectations:

Self-driven, mature, target-oriented, accountable, and comfortable working in a growth-stage environment.

Good to Have (Preferred Experience)

Business Development (Prospecting):

Proven ability to build industry networks, self-generate leads, and uncover new business opportunities across new accounts and ecosystem channels.

Established Executive Network:

Existing network across SMEs, mid-market customers, technology partners, SI/MSP ecosystem, or vendor communities.

Cross-Functional Team Collaboration:

Experience working with proposal, pre-sales, solution architect, project delivery, or service desk teams.

Framework & SLA Knowledge:

Knowledge of ITIL-aligned service delivery, service level agreements, recurring revenue models, and customer success governance.

Open to Mid-Career Switchers (Engineer/ IT Specialist to Sales)

Open to former L2 Engineers or Systems Specialists looking to transition their technical foundation into commercial sales.

Must possess excellent communication skills: interpersonal skills, active listening, and the communication confidence to engage C-suite and IT decision-makers.

What HubbIT Offers

Company Support & Upskilling:

Dedicated company support for paid professional upgrading, relevant technical certifications, and sales performance courses to sharpen your skill set.

Growth Opportunity:

Opportunity to build and scale a managed services business with strong growth ambitions.

Broad Solution Exposure:

Exposure to cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure, systems, workflow, and partner ecosystem opportunities.

Direct-to-Management:

Direct collaboration with senior leadership and internal teams to shape customer and partner outcomes.

Practical Culture:

A practical, accountable, and forward-looking environment for sales professionals and technical specialists who want to grow beyond standard product selling.

Remuneration Structure

Fixed Salary Base:

Competitive monthly fixed base salary + CPF contributions.

Performance Bonus:

Performance-based sales bonus awarded upon achieving agreed sales KPIs and revenue targets.

title: Business Development Director
description:
We are an early-stage Singapore company in the health, wellness, and digital health sector preparing to establish our commercial presence overseas.

Candidate Profile

We are seeking an experienced

Business Development Director

to lead our in-market business development activities and establish the commercial foundations in our overseas target market.

This is a hands-on role suited to an experienced commercial professional who is comfortable operating and working independently in an entrepreneurial, early-stage small environment, building markets, relationships and opportunities from the ground up.

The Business Development Director will be responsible for developing the company’s local commercial presence, identifying and engaging prospective customers and strategic partners, generating qualified leads and business opportunities, and building a structured pipeline for future revenue growth.

A commercially minded and resilient professional who is comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and integrity.

The successful candidate should be willing to work in an environment where processes, systems, customer relationships and market presence are still being built. This role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and execute the company’s business development and market-entry activities.

Conduct market research and assess local market opportunities, customer segments, competitors, commercial channels and market-entry considerations.

Identify, qualify and engage prospective customers, strategic partners, distributors, channel partners and other relevant commercial stakeholders.

Generate qualified leads and build a structured business development pipeline.

Arrange and conduct in-person business meetings with prospective customers, partners and other stakeholders.

Develop and strengthen local partnerships relevant to the company’s growth strategy.

Progress commercial opportunities from initial engagement through follow-up, proposal development, pilot discussions and potential agreements.

Represent the company professionally in external meetings, market-development activities and relevant industry engagements.

Gather market intelligence and customer feedback to support refinement of the company’s commercial and market-entry strategy.

Prepare commercial proposals, presentations and business cases in collaboration with the Singapore management team.

Execute appropriate in-market business development and marketing activities to support brand awareness and lead generation.

Maintain accurate records of prospects, meetings, opportunities, follow-up actions and commercial outcomes.

Track and report key business development metrics, including leads generated, meetings conducted, partnership opportunities progressed and measurable milestones achieved.

Prepare regular progress reports and provide management with practical recommendations on market opportunities, risks and next steps.

Support the development of the company’s longer-term overseas expansion strategy based on commercial validation.

Job Requirements

The ideal candidate should have:

Significant track record and professional experience in business development, partnerships, sales, commercial strategy and international market entry.

Relevant experience in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, health and wellness, digital health or a similar related sector.

Strong understanding of the commercial dynamics, stakeholders and partnership models relevant to the industry.

Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities, generate leads and develop commercial relationships.

Strong experience in stakeholder engagement, partnership development and external business representation.

Ability to operate independently in the target market.

Strong commercial judgement, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to interact confidently with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting and commercial tracking.

Excellent time-management and organisational skills.

Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.

Ability to remain focused while managing multiple priorities.

Self-motivated, proactive and independent.

Positive, solutions-oriented and adaptable working style.

Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Ability to work effectively with a small team while operating independently.

Willingness and ability to be physically based in the target market for the required assignment period.

The candidate should be comfortable:

building commercial relationships from an early stage;

working without an established local team or mature sales infrastructure;

adapting quickly to changing priorities;

managing multiple workstreams independently;

taking ownership from initial market engagement through to commercial follow-up; and

contributing practically to the company’s market-entry strategy.

Working Environment

As an early-stage company, we operate with a disciplined cost structure and a practical, hands-on working culture.

During the initial market-entry and business-building phase, there may be periods requiring flexibility beyond standard working hours, particularly around important business meetings, commercial deadlines, market-development activities and coordination across time zones.

The successful candidate should therefore be comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and supporting the company through its early growth phase.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured through tangible commercial progress, including:

establishment of a qualified prospect and partner pipeline;

number and quality of prospective customers and partners engaged;

in-person business meetings conducted;

qualified leads generated;

strategic partnership discussions initiated and progressed;

commercial proposals, pilots or collaboration opportunities developed;

market intelligence and customer insights obtained;

measurable progress toward establishing a sustainable commercial presence in the target market; and

development of a clear commercial roadmap for continued market expansion.

Transport allowance provided

Opportunity for career growth within an expanding automotive group

Motoserv Automotive Franchise – Grow With Us

Motoserv is a trusted leader in Singapore’s automotive service industry, delivering top-tier car maintenance and repair solutions. With 10 outlets islandwide, we have built a strong reputation for quality, reliability, and innovation.

Today, Motoserv is expanding through a proven franchise model, empowering both independent workshop owners and young entrepreneurs to succeed in the automotive industry.

Vision

Our vision is to be the most trusted and innovative automotive service provider in Singapore. We aim to continuously expand our reach, improve our offerings, and set new industry benchmarks.

Comprehensive Services at Motoserv

Motoserv offers a wide array of services to meet every automotive need. From basic maintenance to specialized repairs, we ensure your vehicle receives the best care.

What Sets Us Apart

IMI UK-Certified Technicians

Our team consists of IMI UK-certified technicians, ensuring that your vehicle is serviced to the highest industry standards. This certification reflects our commitment to technical excellence and continuous learning.

Cutting-Edge Facilities

Each Motoserv outlet is equipped with state-of-the-art tools and technology, enabling us to deliver efficient and precise repairs.

Customer-Centric Approach

We prioritize our customers’ needs. From transparent pricing to personalized service, Motoserv aims to provide a hassle-free and rewarding experience for every customer.

Affordability and Transparency

We believe that quality automotive care should be accessible to everyone. Our transparent pricing ensures customers know exactly what they’re paying for, with no hidden fees.

Empowering Independent Workshops

Motoserv is not just a service provider; we’re a partner to independent car workshops. Our franchise model offers small businesses the tools, training, and support needed to thrive in a competitive market.

Commitment to Sustainability

At Motoserv, we are committed to promoting sustainable practices in the automotive industry. Our initiatives include:

Eco-Friendly Operations: Reducing waste and adopting sustainable materials.

Carbon Cleaning: Helping customers reduce their vehicles’ carbon emissions.

Hybrid and EV Focus: Supporting the transition to cleaner, more sustainable transportation options.

Training and Development

K-tech Auto Academy

Through our partnership with K-tech Auto Academy, we provide specialized training programs for our technicians and franchisees. These programs include:

Hybrid/EV Intermediate Courses: Equipping technicians with the skills needed for advanced vehicle systems.

Diagnostics Training: Ensuring our team stays up-to-date with the latest industry advancements.

Continuous learning is a core part of Motoserv’s philosophy, allowing us to maintain our position as an industry leader.

Engaging with Our Community

Social Media and Content Creation

Motoserv actively engages with customers through social media platforms like TikTok. Our content includes repair shop stories, customer testimonials, and tips for maintaining vehicles, helping us build a loyal online community.

Community Involvement

We participate in events like Automechanika KL, where we showcase our expertise and offer exclusive promotions. Motoserv is also committed to supporting local initiatives and charities, giving back to the community we serve.

Positive attitude, self-motivation, and a strong desire to achieve sales targets.

Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple sales opportunities.

Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Previous experience in IT sales, telemarketing, lead generation, customer service, or business development.

Basic understanding of IT hardware, software, networking, or cybersecurity concepts.

Familiarity with CRM systems and sales pipeline management.

Experience preparing quotations, proposals, or sales presentations.

Number of qualified leads generated.

Number of customer meetings and sales opportunities developed.

Timely follow-up on enquiries and quotations.

Conversion of qualified opportunities into sales.

Achievement of assigned sales and revenue targets.

Accuracy of CRM updates and sales reporting.

title: Business Development Exectutive
description:
SINBOR

was established over 55 years ago. We are looking for a few Sales & Business Development Executives.

ROLE

Sinbor is seeking motivated sales professionals to grow our customer base and promote our range of high-quality marble and other building materials in Singapore. We welcome applications from both junior candidates with strong relationship-building potential and experienced senior professionals with established industry connections and product expertise. The level of appointment and responsibilities will be aligned with the successful candidate’s experience.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. NEW BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

• Identify and develop new business opportunities within Singapore's marble, natural stone, interior design and construction sectors.

• Proactively approach and build relationships with interior designers, architects, property developers, contractors, quantity surveyors, contract managers, project managers and other relevant decision-makers.

• Identify upcoming and existing residential, commercial, hospitality and other projects where marble and other building materials may be required.

• Develop relationships with project stakeholders and increase awareness and consideration of the company's marble and other building material products.

• Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective customers and projects.

• Arrange client meetings, presentations, showroom visits and site visits where appropriate.

• Convert new prospects into active customers and develop opportunities for repeat business and referrals.

2. PROJECT & PRODUCT SALES

• Understand customer and project requirements and recommend suitable products from the company's existing product range.

• Promote and sell high quality marble and building materials for residential, commercial and other project applications.

• Manage sales opportunities from initial enquiry through quotation, negotiation, closing and order coordination.

• Prepare accurate quotations using the company's established pricing structure for marble and other building materials and fabrication and dry-lay services.

• Ensure quotations accurately reflect required materials, dimensions, fabrication requirements and other relevant project specifications.

• Follow up consistently on quotations and outstanding opportunities.

• Negotiate with customers within established company pricing guidelines.

• Maintain accurate records of leads, quotations, opportunities and confirmed orders.

3. NON-STANDARD MATERIAL REQUIREMENTS

Where a customer requests a material or specification outside the company's standard product range, the Sales Manager will work with the Purchaser to identify an appropriate solution.

• Identify when a customer's requested marble, colour, pattern, size or specification is outside the standard product range.

• Clearly communicate the customer's material requirements and specifications to the Purchaser.

• Work with the Purchaser to understand available alternatives, costs and lead times.

• Use information provided by the Purchaser to prepare an appropriate customer quotation.

• Maintain ownership of the customer relationship and sales opportunity throughout the process.

4. ORDER & DELIVERY COORDINATION

• Coordinate confirmed orders with relevant internal teams.

• Ensure customer requirements are accurately communicated to teams responsible for dry-lay, fabrication and fulfilment.

• Monitor order progress and delivery schedules.

• Keep customers informed of relevant updates.

• Identify and escalate potential issues that could affect delivery or customer satisfaction.

• Follow up after delivery to support customer satisfaction and identify opportunities for repeat business.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Proven experience in sales, business development or project sales, preferably within marble, natural stone, building materials, interior finishes or a related industry.

• Strong track record of generating new business rather than relying solely on inbound enquiries or existing accounts.

• Established network within Singapore's interior design, architecture, property development, construction or related industries is highly advantageous.

• Existing relationships with owners, interior designers, architects, developers, contractors, quantity surveyors, contract managers or project managers will be strongly valued.

• Strong commercial and negotiation skills with the ability to convert opportunities into confirmed sales.

• Excellent communication, relationship-building and presentation skills.

• Strong follow-up, organization and pipeline-management abilities.

• Ability to work independently, take ownership of opportunities and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

• Good understanding of project-based sales and the ability to communicate product and material requirements clearly.

• Comfortable working with established pricing guidelines and fabrication costs.

JUNIOR SALES / BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT | 1–3 Years’ Experience

• 1–3 years of experience in sales, business development, account management or a customer-facing commercial role; B2B exposure is advantageous.

• Strong interpersonal communication, active listening and relationship-building skills, with confidence approaching new prospects.

• Demonstrated initiative in prospecting, following up on leads, arranging meetings and developing customer relationships.

• Enthusiasm for learning about marble, natural stone, building materials, project specifications and the construction / interior design ecosystem.

• Good organisation, responsiveness and discipline in managing leads, sales records and follow-up activities.

• Positive, proactive attitude, willingness to learn from feedback and ability to work collaboratively with senior colleagues and internal teams.

SENIOR SALES / BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT | 5+ Years Experience

• Proven record of generating new business and closing project-based or B2B sales, ideally in marble, natural stone, tiles, architectural surfaces, interior finishes or premium building materials.

• Established, active relationships with Singapore-based architects, interior designers, developers, main contractors, quantity surveyors, project managers or other project decision-makers.

• Strong product knowledge of marble and natural stone, including applications, material selection, sizes, finishes, fabrication considerations and relevant project specifications.

• Ability to independently identify projects, influence product specification, develop commercial opportunities, negotiate and close sales.

• Understanding of project sales cycles, stakeholder engagement, quotations, margins, pricing guidelines and order-delivery coordination.

• Ability to manage multiple opportunities and long sales cycles with minimal supervision; confident presentation and consultative selling skills.

• Experience with high-end residential, commercial or hospitality projects, cut-to-size stone, fabrication or tabletop applications is advantageous.

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE

Success will be measured primarily by the ability to generate new business, build a strong pipeline of project opportunities, develop relationships with key industry stakeholders, convert opportunities into sales and maintain strong customer relationships through delivery and beyond.

Willingness to travel for customer meetings and business development activities when required.

Achievement of annual sales and revenue targets.

Successful execution of go-to-market strategies.

Strong customer retention and long-term account development.

title: Manager of Investment, Utility Power Projects
description:
Job Description

About Peak Energy

Peak Energy is a clean energy platform that develops, finances, builds, and operates utility-scale solar, rooftop generation, onshore wind, and battery storage solutions across Asia-Pacific. As a fast-growing scale-up, we build on the experience of a team drawn from TotalEnergies, Vestas, Cleantech Energy, and other leading players, combining world-class technical expertise with entrepreneurial agility.

With over 300 MW of operating assets and 1 GW of projects in development across Japan, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, the Philippines, Thailand, Singapore and Indonesia, we are greenfield developers at heart, but we also partner flexibly with industrials, developers, and investors to accelerate delivery and scale impact.

We combine the customer focus of a developer, the technical expertise of an EPC and the financial strength of a heavyweight institution, enabling clients to meet decarbonization targets on time, on budget, and without risk of delivery failure. Peak Energy is wholly owned by Stonepeak, one of the world's leading alternative investment firms specializing in infrastructure and real assets. Our financial and technical strength coupled with our relationships in local markets allows us to optimize our capital deployment in high-quality assets.

Our clients can expect clean energy solutions delivered on time, on budget, and at scale, with no surprises. Let's partner together to support your sustainability journey.

Role Overview

The Associate / Senior Associate, Investments will support the identification, evaluation, development, and execution of utility-scale renewable energy investments across Asia Pacific with a closer line of sight to markets in Malaysia, Thailand, and the Philippines. The role is expected to report directly to the CIO in supporting decision-making for the entire group.

Working closely with colleagues across development, engineering, finance, legal, and external stakeholders, this individual will contribute to greenfield development opportunities, mergers and acquisitions, strategic partnerships, and project financing initiatives. The role offers broad exposure across the investment lifecycle and the opportunity to help grow one of the region's leading renewable energy platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Investment Analysis & Evaluation

· Develop and maintain financial models for renewable energy and infrastructure investments.

· Perform valuation, scenario, sensitivity, and risk analyses to support investment decisions including offtake negotiations, FID decisions and devex initiation / monitoring..

· Assess project economics, commercial assumptions, and potential returns across development and acquisition opportunities.

· Support the preparation of investment recommendations and internal approval materials.

· Preparation of regular reporting material with local team to discuss next quarterly spend profiles and project priorities

Greenfield Development & Opportunity Assessment

· Support the evaluation of greenfield renewable energy opportunities across Southeast Asia.

· Conduct market, commercial, and regulatory research to identify attractive investment opportunities.

· Work closely with development teams to assess project viability and investment attractiveness.

· Monitor industry trends, power markets, and competitive activity across the region.

Transaction Execution & Due Diligence

· Support acquisition, partnership, and investment opportunities across the region.

· Participate in due diligence activities and coordinate with internal teams and external advisors.

· Review project and company information to identify key risks and opportunities.

· Support financing, transaction execution, and other strategic initiatives as required.

Stakeholder Collaboration

· Work collaboratively with development, legal, engineering, finance, and operations teams.

· Support engagement with developers, investors, lenders, advisors, and strategic partners.

· Prepare analyses and presentations for management and investment discussions.

· Contribute to initiatives that support the continued growth of Peak Energy's utility-scale platform.

Qualifications & Experience

· Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

· Relevant experience in renewable energy, infrastructure, project finance, investment banking, corporate development, consulting, or a related field.

· Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities.

· Financial modelling experience relating to infrastructure, power, or renewable energy projects is required.

· Financial due diligence experience relating to renewable energy or infrastructure investments is preferred,

· Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across functions and cultures.

Peak Energy is a renewable energy platform with a focus on developing solar, wind and battery projects across Asia. As the region's consumption of energy rises, Peak Energy is dedicated to meeting these demands while contributing to carbon neutrality. We accomplish this by developing large utility-scale projects. These include some of the largest solar and wind farms in Korea and Japan.

Peak Energy is the renewable arm of Stonepeak Infrastructure Partners; a leading global infrastructure investment firm with +USD 57 Bn in assets under management. Our portfolio includes the offshore wind farm in Taiwan with plans to develop a further +5 GWp.

Our team has decades of experience and long-standing relationships. This combination of knowledge and relationships, combined with expertise in design and supply chains enables Peak Energy to deliver high performing, robust alternative energy systems on time and under budget.

At Peak Energy, you'll collaborate with passionate individuals, drive meaningful impact, and be at the forefront of Asia’s transition to renewable energy. We believe everyone is needed for carbon neutrality. Therefore, fresh ideas are always welcomed. Are you excited about disrupting traditional energy sources and developing a sustainable future? Come join our team and be a part of the energy revolution with Peak Energy!

title: Regional Key Account Manager

Professional development: your growth is essential to us. Unlock your potential through internal mobility opportunities, leadership and mentoring programmes, and MyLearning – our global online platform with more than 1,000 courses.

title: Business Development Executive (Corporate Wellness)
description:
ABOUT US

Bewell Chiropractic is an established Gonstead chiropractic group with three clinics in Malaysia's Klang Valley. Our Singapore clinic in Novena is its first outside Malaysia. We keep things simple and transparent: published prices, no long prepaid packages, and no pressure selling.

THE ROLE

You will build our corporate wellness partnerships, working closely with our founder, who leads corporate business development. Your job is to open doors with HR, people and workplace-wellness teams at companies, government agencies and building owners around Novena and across Singapore, and turn those conversations into ongoing programmes: workplace talks, on-site posture check sessions, and employee-benefit arrangements.

This is a relationship role, not a sales-floor job. Success means programmes that actually run and partners who come back, not signatures alone.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Research and build a target list of companies, agencies and buildings (HR, L&D, workplace wellness and facilities contacts), using AI tools to speed up research and qualification

Reach out by email, LinkedIn, phone and in person; book introductory meetings

Organise and attend workplace talks and on-site posture check days with our chiropractors

Prepare simple proposals and partnership agreements using our approved templates and price list

Help employers explain how staff can use flexible benefits or wellness allowances with us

Use AI assistants (such as Claude or ChatGPT) daily to draft outreach, proposals and follow-ups, then check and personalise every message before it goes out

Keep a clean CRM record of every contact, meeting and follow-up

Report monthly on activity: contacts made, meetings held, talks booked and partnerships signed

Represent Bewell at networking events, HR forums and community events

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

2+ years of experience personally sourcing and opening B2B accounts through outbound outreach (corporate wellness, healthcare, fitness, insurance or HR benefits is a plus)

Diploma or degree in any discipline, or equivalent practical experience

Able to write proposals and conduct corporate meetings in English, the working language used with our target clients

Organised and self-driven: you plan your own week and follow up without being chased

Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT in your daily work (research, writing, planning). Tell us how you use them

Comfortable with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 and a CRM

Honest by default. You never over-promise what a service can do

IMPORTANT: HOW WE TALK ABOUT OUR SERVICES

Chiropractic in Singapore is subject to strict advertising rules. You must describe only what we deliver (a screening, a talk, a session, a written report) and never promise health outcomes or name medical conditions. We will train you on this from day one and ask you to follow our communications guidelines in writing. If that sounds reasonable to you, we'd like to hear from you.

WHAT WE OFFER

S$3,500 to S$4,000 per month fixed salary, full-time, 5 days per week

No commission; performance reviewed against agreed partnership-development milestones

CPF, annual leave, sick leave and public holidays

13th-month AWS, written into your contract

A clear path to Senior Business Development Executive as the corporate programme grows

Work directly with the founder in a small team where your work shapes a new clinic's growth

A modern, AI-first way of working, with tools provided

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through Indeed with your CV and a short note describing one account you personally sourced: who the decision-maker was, how you approached them, how long it took to agree, the result, and your own contribution. Also tell us, in one or two lines, how you use AI tools in your work. Please anonymise confidential details.

The employing entity is Cura Naturale Pte Ltd.

Pay: $3,500.00 - $4,000.00 per month

Benefits:
* Professional development

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.

Leading a geographically distributed team across Asia, Americas and EMEA, you will be responsible for translating business priorities into regional go-to-market activities, enabling sales growth, strengthening customer relationships and ensuring a consistent DNV brand experience worldwide. title: Lead, Account Management
description:
Company Description

foodpanda is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Description

We are looking for a passionate, people-first, and commercially driven Team Lead, Account Management to guide, coach, and inspire our account management team. In this role, you will lead a dedicated team focused on nurturing, scaling, and championing our restaurant partners across the platform.

You sit right at the heart of our commercial engine. You are an encouraging leader who is excited to step up and develop talent, as well as a relentless advocate for the F&B industry. You genuinely love food, understand the hustle of running a kitchen, and thrive on walking into a restaurant, sitting down with owners, chefs, and decision-makers, and building lasting, trust-based partnerships that unlock sustainable mutual growth.

Team Vision

Champion Restaurant Success & Food Culture: Act as the voice of our restaurant partners. We don’t just manage accounts; we partner with culinary visionaries, local favorites, and household brands to help their businesses flourish.

Empower & Elevate People: Build a collaborative, high-energy coaching culture where Account Managers are mentored to reach their peak potential and take pride in their craft.

Drive Commercial Excellence & Sustainable Growth: Deliver mutual value through Joint Business Planning (JBPs), data-led menu and marketing optimizations, and win-win commercial frameworks.

Responsibilities:

People Leadership & Team Enablement

Lead and Mentor: Guide, coach, and support a team of Account Managers, fostering a culture of ownership, curiosity, and high performance.

Target Setting & Accountability: Define, track, and review clear operational and commercial KPIs (portfolio GMV, revenue growth, partner retention, campaign adoption).

Talent Development: Conduct regular 1-on-1s, support individual career growth paths, resolve day-to-day escalations, and participate in hiring and onboarding future team members.

Relationship Building & Partner Advocacy

Authentic Relationship Management: Build authentic, long-term relationships with restaurant owners, F&B group directors, and store managers. You speak the language of restaurateurs—from table turn rates and kitchen workflows to margin pressures.

Commercial Dialogues & Escalations: Step in on key partner discussions, including joint brand promotions, POS integrations, commission frameworks, and contract renewals.

Partner Voice: Advocate fiercely for merchant needs internally, collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Operations, Marketing, and Logistics to resolve operational pain points.

Commercial Strategy & Account Growth

Business Reviews & Planning: Guide the execution of Joint Business Plans (JBPs) and Business Reviews with key partners to forecast revenue, set growth milestones, and align promotional calendars.

Growth Campaigns & Deals: Support your team in co-creating high-performing commercial campaigns, exclusive offerings, and curated vendor deals that delight foodies and maximize vendor profitability.

Data-Driven Advisory: Translate platform analytics into clear commercial narratives, consulting partners on order trends, basket sizes, pricing architecture, and customer retention.

Operational Agility & Process Optimization

Streamline Best Practices: Standardize AM workflows, SOPs, and reporting routines to minimize administrative friction and free up time for strategic partner touchpoints.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with commercial ops, legal, and finance to ensure smooth contract management, incentive payouts, and billing processes.

Qualifications

Experience: 4–8 years of commercial account management, business development, or merchant partnerships experience—ideally in food delivery, e-commerce, F&B retail, or fast-paced digital marketplaces.

Genuine Passion for Food & Hospitality: You truly love food and respect the craft of the restaurant industry. You are energized by meeting owners, listening to their culinary journeys, and helping local eateries and restaurant brands thrive.

Masterful Relationship & Negotiation Skills: An exceptional communicator with proven presence when interfacing with partners of all sizes—from head chefs and independent store owners to executive decision-makers. Skilled in navigating commercial discussions with empathy and backbone.

Leadership & Coaching Mindset: A natural mentor who takes joy in supporting team members, sharing best practices, celebrating wins, and helping others navigate challenges.

Analytical & Commercial Acumen: Confident working with data (Looker, Excel, Salesforce, or equivalent BI tools) to uncover growth bottlenecks, present business cases, and make informed decisions.

Agility & Drive: A proactive, self-starter mentality with the ability to navigate ambiguity, roll up your sleeves, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Additional Information

What we can offer:

High Impact at Scale: Shape the future of the local culinary and on-demand delivery ecosystem, directly impacting thousands of restaurant livelihoods and millions of customers.

Leadership & Growth: Ample room for personal and professional growth with international mobility options across the wider Delivery Hero network.

Autonomy & Culture: A vibrant, inclusive, and collaborative working atmosphere with regular team events and a strong feedback culture.

Total Rewards: Competitive compensation package, health and dental coverage, generous food perks, and tailored learning and development programs.

title: Business Development Manager — Hunter
description:
About SeedRock

SeedRock Asia Pte. Ltd. is a Monetary Authority of Singapore regulated multi-family office and licensed fund manager (CMS100959), serving ultra-high-net-worth families and institutional clients across two practice pillars: Private Wealth and Family Governance, and Institutional Mandates.

Our positioning is deliberate: Institutional Sovereignty — the corporate office for your family. We exist to give UHNW principals the governance discipline, investment rigour, and institutional infrastructure ordinarily reserved for sovereign wealth funds and the largest endowments, applied at the scale of a single family or a small group of families.

SeedRock is independent. We hold no proprietary product, carry no distribution agenda, and answer only to the families and institutions that retain us. As the firm scales, origination is becoming a discipline in its own right — distinct from relationship management — and we are building a dedicated hunting function to support it.

The Role

We are looking for a connected, credible originator to join SeedRock as a Business Development Manager, focused purely on opening doors: introducing ultra-high-net-worth principals and family office decision-makers to SeedRock, and converting those introductions into qualified client relationships for our Private Asset Management team to take forward.

This is a deliberately distinct role from SeedRock's Relationship Manager track. A Hunter does not hold or manage a client book — your job is to find the relationship, make the introduction, and bring SeedRock's proposition to people who would genuinely benefit from it. Once a client is onboarded, the relationship is handed to an RM for ongoing management; you move on to the next introduction.

If you have a genuine network among UHNW individuals, family offices, or the professionals who serve them — and you would rather be rewarded for opening doors than for managing what comes through them — this role is built for you.

Key Responsibilities

• Originate and qualify new UHNW client introductions and family office leads, building a consistent pipeline of warm prospects for SeedRock's Private Asset Management team

• Leverage and actively expand an existing network across UHNW individuals, family offices, and the accountants, lawyers, and other professionals who serve them

• Run an initial qualification process on each introduction — establishing fit, scale, and intent before handing the relationship to an RM for full onboarding

• Meet quarterly origination targets, measured against qualified AUM or deal value introduced to the platform

• Represent SeedRock's institutional positioning credibly in first conversations — clients should leave the first meeting with a clear sense of what makes SeedRock different from a private bank

• Work closely with the Executive Director, Private Asset Management, to ensure a clean and well-briefed handover of every qualified introduction

• Maintain a disciplined personal pipeline log, providing visibility on origination activity and conversion at all times

Candidate Profile

• A genuine, active network among ultra-high-net-worth individuals or family offices — this is the single non-negotiable requirement for the role

• We are deliberately open to non-traditional origination talent: relationship-rich professionals (accountants, lawyers, corporate bankers with UHNW relationships), returning Singaporean diaspora from overseas finance careers, and business owners' right hands (CFOs or chiefs of staff to UHNW families) are all strong fits, alongside conventional private banking backgrounds

• Comfortable being measured purely on origination outcomes, without the security or upside of managing a long-term client book

• Polished, credible, and able to represent an institutional brand convincingly in a first meeting with a sophisticated principal

• Self-directed and resilient — origination is a long-cycle activity and this role rewards consistency over time, not single big wins

• Unblemished regulatory record and clean professional history, verifiable through standard background and reference checks

Compensation

This role is structured to reward consistent, credible origination rather than book management. Compensation is salary-led, with a directed annual bonus tied to origination performance against quarterly targets.

• Fixed base salary of SGD 7,000 to 9,000 per month, calibrated to network strength and origination track record

• Quarterly targets set against AUM or deal value originated and successfully onboarded

• Directed annual bonus, assessed against cumulative origination performance across the year

• This compensation reflects an expectation of an active, existing UHNW or family office network from day one — it is priced for a credible operator, not for a network still being built

Why SeedRock

• A genuinely open-architecture platform — no proprietary product agenda, no balance-sheet conflicts to navigate in the introduction conversation

• A clean, focused mandate: origination only, with no expectation to manage or service a book afterwards

• Direct line of sight to SeedRock's Executive Director on every qualified introduction, ensuring credit for origination is never lost in handover

• An institutional brand built specifically for the UHNW family office segment, genuinely differentiated from a retail-down private bank pitch

To Apply

Please submit your CV in confidence. All applications are handled with strict discretion; no contact will be made with current employers at any stage of the process.

Founded in 2018 as a family office and External Asset Manager, we have rapidly evolved into a prominent player in Singapore’s financial landscape. Our mission is to assist high net-worth individuals and families navigate the ever-changing macro-economic landscape. In the dynamic and complex world of finance, we are our client’s partner in safeguarding and growing our client wealth.

We are thrilled to announce our transformation from a Multi-Family Office into a Full-Fledged Fund Management Company. This transition underscores our commitment to providing comprehensive, sophisticated, and tailored investment solutions to our clients. With a strong track record of success, a seasoned team of experts, and a deep understanding of the global financial markets, we are our client go-to partner for managing and growing our client’s wealth.

description:

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. 12+ years of experience across enterprise technology, AI, digital infrastructure, fintech and digital assets, telecommunications, or technology business development, including senior leadership experience.

title: Emerging Southeast Asia Sales, Wealth Business
description:

The Southeast Asia Wealth team is responsible for understanding market trends and client needs across Southeast Asia’s diverse Wealth markets and then translating these into commercial opportunities for our business. The team works with onshore asset managers, private / consumer banks, insurers, and wealth platforms to offer the full range of BlackRock active funds, ETFs and alternatives products.

We partner with clients to build bespoke solutions for specific client needs, while offering model portfolios and discretionary investment offerings backed by our market-leading in-house technology and risk analytics. The team is based in Singapore and works closely with colleagues around the globe to deliver the best of BlackRock to APAC Wealth investors.

BlackRock's Southeast Asia Wealth business is looking for a Vice President to lead and engage with main Wealth clients in the Philippines and Emerging Southeast Asia markets. The primary responsibility is to enhance commercial engagement with clients, contribute to Wealth distribution strategy, and deliver business results through high-quality business development and client engagement. The role requires collaboration with multiple teams across product and business groups in APAC, EMEA, and the US to deliver the firm's capabilities to clients.

You will be responsible for execution and management of key client accounts and will work closely with the product teams to contribute to product development and new product ideas. Success would mean delivering our value proposition, investment capabilities and commercial expertise with clients as well as help their end-investors achieve financial goals and investment objectives.

Reporting to the Head of Emerging Southeast Asia Wealth, the successful candidate should have demonstrated knowledge of the Wealth segment and distributors in the Philippines including private and retail banks, insurance, advisory, and platforms. A proficient understanding of investment strategies, investment management, capital markets, sustainable investing and alternative strategies would be advantageous. A keen interest to learn and be a "Student of the Market" will be a strong contributor to this success for this role. Additionally outstanding social skills, relationship management, and the ability to connect effectively across a matrix and sophisticated organization are critical for success.

Key Responsibilities:

· Based in Singapore, the role works with the broader Emerging Southeast Asia Wealth team to develop and execute a detailed sales strategy, with a focus on promoting the benefits and extending the usage of BlackRock solutions.

· Proactively position and differentiate BlackRock and our investment products against competitor firms and products to Financial Advisers.

· Exhibit in-depth knowledge of all investment products, including the demonstration of a high level of comfort in communicating this information to Advisers in the context of portfolio construction

· Expand existing client base by uncovering investment needs and presenting solutions.

Exhibit high-level market knowledge and ability to converse with financial advisers on investment solutions and current economic and market conditions

· Embrace the firm’s commitment to the client experience and exceed client contact expectations

· Partner with colleagues across the organization to improve the BlackRock/Client relationship.

· Follow a team-based approach and leverage the Firm’s resources at appropriate times in the sales cycle, in order to broaden and deepen the usage of BlackRock solutions.

· Diligent use of client relationship management tools to record client activity/interaction.

· Administrative tasks: prepare client materials and reports for management.

· Responsible to ensure that all regulatory and legal requirements and standards are met.

Experience/Qualifications:

· 8+ years of proven experience in a similar industry with established network of wealth industry relationships, and their key stakeholders.

· Established track record in relationship management and growing a mutual fund business.

· Strong analytical skills and ability to synthesize data to draw conclusions, informing business strategies and client recommendations.

· Relevant industry and investment knowledge. Strong proficiency across a wide range of traditional, alternative Investment products and ETFs. Clear awareness of key issues affecting Wealth clients.

· Strong presentation and communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively convey complex information to clients and internal teams.

· Strong team player, who is able to collaborate credibly internally in order to leverage the Firm's resources locally as well as globally

· Self-motivated individual, with a commitment to excellence.

· Proficiency in Tagalog will be a plus to support the Filipino clientele base in the Philippines

· BA/BS degree in related field.

BlackRock’s purpose is to help more and more people experience financial well-being. As a global investment manager and a leading provider of financial technology, our clients—from grandparents, doctors, and teachers to large institutions—turn to us for the solutions they need when planning for their most important goals. At BlackRock, you will have an opportunity to do meaningful work with diverse colleagues across the globe, all with the support of a company that’s committed to your well-being and invested in your success. Discover how you can have a career at BlackRock that’s exciting, rewarding and full of possibilities.

title: Business Development Executive (E-Commerce & Digital Sales)

title: Strategic AI, NeoClouds & NVIDIA Business Development Lead
description:
About The Job:

DDN is seeking a highly connected, commercially oriented Director of AI Sales to accelerate growth across APAC through strategic collaboration with NVIDIA, AI infrastructure providers, Neoclouds/NVIDIA Cloud Partners (NCPs), and the broader AI technology ecosystem.

This role will be reporting to worldwide vice president of NCP & AI Native sales and serve as the primary regional connector between DDN's APAC Sales organization, NVIDIA's regional sales and technical teams, key Neocloud/NCP partners, and DDN's NVIDIA headquarters organization. The Director will build relationships, identify opportunities, create alignment across organizations, and help DDN gain earlier and more strategic participation in major AI infrastructure opportunities.

This is primarily a business development and relationship leadership role, with approximately 80% of the focus on ecosystem engagement, relationship development, opportunity creation, and field collaboration, and 20% on technical fluency and solution positioning.

What Will You Do:

NVIDIA Regional Engagement

• Build and maintain strong relationships with NVIDIA sales, business development, solution architecture, and ecosystem teams across APAC.

• Establish DDN as a trusted infrastructure partner for NVIDIA field teams pursuing strategic AI opportunities.

• Connect DDN account teams with the appropriate NVIDIA sales and technical resources and identify NVIDIA-influenced opportunities early.

• Work closely with DDN's NVIDIA HQ team to navigate NVIDIA organizational structures, executive relationships, technical influencers, and decision-makers.

• Ensure regional intelligence and field activity are connected back to DDN's broader global NVIDIA strategy.

Neocloud & NCP Development

• Identify and develop relationships with Neoclouds, GPU cloud providers, NVIDIA Cloud Partners, sovereign AI providers, and emerging AI infrastructure companies across APAC.

• Map key decision-makers, technical influencers, investors, customers, and ecosystem relationships surrounding priority AI infrastructure providers.

• Connect DDN field teams to emerging Neocloud/NCP opportunities and help coordinate multi-party pursuit strategies.

• Identify expansion opportunities within established AI infrastructure customers and new opportunities with emerging providers.

• Help DDN understand where GPU capacity is being deployed across APAC and which organizations are likely to become important future AI infrastructure buyers.

Regional AI Business Development

• Serve as a business development overlay to DDN's APAC sales organization for strategic AI opportunities.

• Collaborate with Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Strategic AI sellers, partner teams, and regional leadership on account and opportunity strategies.

• Create connections across customers, NVIDIA, Neoclouds, technology partners, and DDN resources that improve DDN's ability to win.

• Develop account and ecosystem maps for priority AI opportunities and support executive meetings, partner engagements, and strategic pursuits.

• Identify emerging trends, companies, workloads, and investment patterns that should influence DDN's regional strategy.

AI Ecosystem & Technology Partnerships

• Identify ISVs and technology partners that are becoming influential in AI infrastructure buying decisions.

• Work with DDN's ISV and Technical Alliances organization to develop relationships and joint motions with priority software and platform partners.

• Understand where orchestration, data platforms, inference technologies, AI frameworks, and security platforms influence infrastructure decisions.

Technical & Solution Fluency

• Maintain working knowledge of DDN's AI infrastructure portfolio and its role in GPU-intensive environments.

• Understand at a high level how storage, networking, data movement, GPU utilization, training, inference, checkpointing, and AI data pipelines affect infrastructure architecture.

• Understand NVIDIA's major AI infrastructure architectures, platforms, and ecosystem motions sufficiently to identify where DDN adds value.

• Recognize when deeper technical engagement is required and bring the appropriate DDN Solution Engineering, Solution Architecture, Field CTO, Product, or Engineering resources into the opportunity.

• Translate technical differentiation into customer and partner business value.

GEOGRAPHIC SCOPE

The role will cover APAC and requires the ability to operate across highly diverse markets, cultures, business practices, and stages of AI infrastructure adoption. The successful candidate will prioritize markets with significant GPU investment, Neocloud activity, sovereign AI initiatives, hyperscale infrastructure development, and AI-native company formation. Frequent travel throughout the region and close collaboration across time zones will be expected.

What Will You Bring:

10+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, business development, alliances, AI infrastructure, cloud, data infrastructure, or related markets.

Strong track record of developing executive and field relationships across complex technology ecosystems.

Demonstrated ability to create opportunities through relationships and ecosystem engagement rather than relying solely on traditional direct selling.

Experience working collaboratively with field sales and technical organizations.

Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure and the evolving AI technology ecosystem.

Ability to engage credibly with sales executives, technical leaders, partners, customers, and senior executives.

Excellent executive communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills; ability to operate independently in an entrepreneurial environment.

Preferred Experience

Existing relationships within NVIDIA or the NVIDIA partner ecosystem.

Experience with Neoclouds, GPU cloud providers, NCPs, hyperscalers, AI infrastructure companies, or AI-native organizations.

Experience with GPU infrastructure, HPC, high-performance storage, networking, cloud infrastructure, or AI data platforms.

Familiarity with NVIDIA DGX, SuperPOD, reference architectures, accelerated computing, and AI infrastructure concepts.

Experience working with AI software vendors, data platforms, orchestration technologies, or emerging accelerator providers.

Experience developing business across multiple APAC markets.

We are looking for someone who is proactive, independent, and commercially minded — someone who does not wait for opportunities to appear but actively creates them.

Business Development & New Client Acquisition

Proactively identify, target, and engage potential clients through cold calling, LinkedIn, networking, referrals, industry events, conferences, and direct outreach.

Work closely with technical, commodity and international colleagues to develop commercially competitive solutions that meet client requirements.
Prepare and follow up on commercial proposals and quotations, ensuring timely progression of opportunities.
Negotiate commercial terms within agreed authority while maintaining a strong focus on profitability and sustainable business growth.

Develop selected existing-client relationships while maintaining a strong emphasis on new business acquisition.

Actively manage sales opportunities through each stage of the commercial process, ensuring consistent follow-up and progression.
Contribute ideas and initiatives to improve sales effectiveness, market positioning, and business development processes.
Participate in relevant industry events, client meetings and regional business activities were commercially beneficial.

Professional Experience

Minimum 5 years of proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or new business acquisition.
Experience in Testing, Inspection & Certification (TIC), commodity inspection, logistics, supply chain services or other complex B2B service industries is preferred.
Demonstrated ability to independently generate leads, establish new client relationships, and successfully close business opportunities.
Strong commercial understanding, including opportunity qualification, proposal development, negotiation, and margin awareness.
Experience working with regional or international clients and coordinating with cross-functional teams is advantageous.
Familiarity with CRM systems, preferably HubSpot, and a disciplined approach to pipeline management.

Skills & Personal Attributes

A genuine business hunter: Highly proactive in prospecting, comfortable with cold outreach and motivated by winning new business.
Results-oriented: Able to translate sales activities and client meetings into qualified opportunities, revenue, and profitable business.
Independent and self-driven: Capable of developing new markets and managing priorities with minimal supervision.
Commercially astute: Able to identify client needs, communicate value, negotiate effectively and progress opportunities towards closure.
Curious and adaptable: Willing to explore unfamiliar industries, learn new services and challenge conventional approaches.

An opportunity to play a key role in expanding Control Union’s business presence in Singapore.
Exposure to a broad portfolio of services, industries, and international markets.
Access to Control Union’s global network of technical experts, commercial specialists, and operational teams.
A structured onboarding programme to build familiarity with our services, internal network, and commercial processes.
Guidance and commercial support during the initial development phase, with increasing autonomy as you establish yourself in the role.
The opportunity to contribute ideas, develop new markets and make a measurable impact on business growth.
A dynamic, internationally connected working environment that values initiative, independent thinking, and collaboration.

Success in this role is not measured simply by the number of contacts made or meetings attended.

We are looking for someone who can consistently create new opportunities, build a qualified sales pipeline, progress negotiations and convert prospects into profitable business.

You will initially focus on developing a strong network of prospects and generating qualified opportunities, with increasing responsibility for delivering new clients, revenue and gross margin as the business pipeline matures.

Apply now and become part of Control Union’s continued growth in Singapore and the wider Asia Pacific region.

title: Associate Client Solutions Consultant
description:
About us
