We’re more than a global leader in AI-powered client lifecycle management—we’re reimagining how financial institutions tackle compliance. From Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) to rapidly evolving regulations, we turn complexity into clarity. Our FinCrime Operating System, powered by agentic AI and intelligent automation, helps financial institutions move faster, act smarter, and stay safer across 120+ countries.

But we don’t stop there.

At Fenergo, we believe in a world where financial institutions aren’t just compliant—they’re confident. Where technology doesn’t just meet regulations—it stays ahead of them. Our mission is to empower financial institutions to stop financial crime and create a safer world.

Every product we build, every innovation we deliver, and every partnership we forge is shaped by that belief. We’re tackling some of the toughest challenges in financial technology. From speeding up onboarding to uncovering hidden risks, our work empowers banks to serve their customers with speed, integrity, and peace of mind.

Join us, and be part of a team that’s building smart solutions, solving real problems, and shaping the future—together.

About the role

Fenergo is committed to hiring the best people. From small beginnings, we have assembled an excellent team of business and technical staff who have enabled our company to grow rapidly on the international Financial Services stage. Over the last number of years, we have become the market leader in the Client Lifecycle Management and Regulatory Compliance arena.

We thrive on the challenge of building our product and continuously improving our people, processes and knowledge to meet the needs of our growing customer base. We are a young company, excited by the future, and we are looking for people who will share this journey with us. We have a number of opportunities that allow for rapid personal and career development for the right candidate.

The Client Solutions team works closely with our Global Sales Teams, who identify potential opportunities, and we then provide detailed business and technical support throughout the sales cycle. We also work closely with our Product team, identifying gaps and opportunities and contributing directly to the product roadmap and our future success.

This is a client-facing role. You will build relationships and act as the first point of contact with the client's stakeholders and subject matter experts. The role requires absolute professionalism in advising clients and guiding them through a multi-faceted change process, so that they see early and continuous value in their organisations.

Core Responsibilities

For each prospect engagement, you will work alongside the sales team and other internal stakeholders, including the regulatory team, professional services and a technical team, to guide the client through the following key tasks:

Ensure that the Fenergo application is presented in the best light with new and existing customers.
Deliver product demos that show how Fenergo can help clients achieve meaningful and rapid improvements in their organisation. This includes demo preparation, delivery and follow-up on outstanding questions.
Understand client challenges and develop the solutions necessary to win new business.
Lead and conduct onsite engagements to understand customer processes and requirements, and to facilitate architecture and solution discussions.
Work with prospective clients to align their tactical and strategic challenges with the implementation of the Fenergo product across their organisation.
Proactively scope the functional and technical requirements needed to address customer requirements, assess customers' met and unmet needs, and recommend solutions that optimise value for both the customer and Fenergo.
Maintain and expand your working knowledge of the Fenergo product, and provide feedback to the Product organisation on enhancements.
Work with Sales Ops Support to complete RFx documents on behalf of the company.
Use knowledge of competitive solutions to help the sales organisation propose the optimal solution for the customer.
Ensure that the sales and professional services organisations are properly aligned to achieve client and sales objectives.
Build strong relationships within the project team, client teams and the internal Product Management team.
Keep abreast of product, regulatory and industry changes.

Requirements

Core Competencies

Excellent client-facing skills, with the ability to 'own the room'. Soft skills include communication, co-ordination and negotiation.
Mandarin, Cantonese or Malay speakers will be preferred.
A natural leader who looks to ensure a positive outcome for the organisation.
Understands business goals and market perceptions, and how the Client Solutions team impacts both.
A seeker of information, internal and external, to help drive the right approach and lead to the right outcomes.
Knowledge of the organisation's offerings, with a strong focus on attention to detail.

Education and Experience

A degree or Master's in Business, Management Consulting, Business Information Systems or a similar related qualification. A degree in Business Analytics or Quantitative Studies is a plus.
Experience in the Financial Services industry, or in a software company in a different industry, is an advantage but not mandatory.

Through a combination of formal training, programmes and self-learning, successful candidates will quickly build on the experience of the team around them and develop a strong understanding of the principles of the Fenergo platform.

Is this you?

We are looking for people who are passionate about using our technology to solve customer problems. If you are self-motivated, detail-orientated and confident communicating your ideas both verbally and in writing, we would like to hear from you. A new and exciting chapter in your career could be waiting.

title: JUNIOR COMMODITY TRADER
description:
Essential Language Requirement — Please Read Before Applying

*Working proficiency in both English and Mandarin is mandatory for this position.*

The successful candidate must be able to:

* Conduct business conversations, meetings and commercial discussions confidently in both English and Mandarin.
* Read and understand business correspondence, quotations, product specifications and commercial documents in both languages.
* Write clear and professional emails and messages in both English and Mandarin.
* Communicate directly with counterparties in China and Taiwan who conduct their business communications primarily in Mandarin.

*Candidates who are unable to conduct business communications in both English and Mandarin will not meet the essential requirements of this position. Language proficiency will be assessed during the interview process.*

About Sherman Mineral Trading

Sherman Mineral Trading is an international commodity trading company focused on supporting the metals, mining and mineral-processing industries.

Our trading activities include sulphur, sulphuric acid, nickel-related products, battery materials and other industrial commodities. We work with producers, suppliers, customers and business partners across Asia, the Middle East and other international markets.

Position Overview

We are seeking a bilingual, commercially astute, resourceful and highly motivated Junior Commodity Trader to join our Singapore team.

The successful candidate will support the full physical commodity trading cycle—from market research, supplier sourcing and business development to commercial negotiation, contract execution, shipping coordination and payment follow-up.

This is a hands-on commercial position requiring strong situational awareness, practical judgement and the confidence to communicate with suppliers, customers, banks, shipping companies and internal stakeholders.

We are looking for someone who is not only academically capable, but also practical, adaptable and commercially alert. The candidate must be able to understand people and situations, identify what is important, ask intelligent questions and respond appropriately without requiring detailed instructions at every stage.

Key ResponsibilitiesTrading and Business Development

* Support the sourcing, purchase and sale of sulphur, sulphuric acid, nickel-related products, battery materials and other industrial commodities.
* Identify and develop potential suppliers, customers, traders and strategic business partners in international markets.
* Communicate directly with counterparties in English and Mandarin to obtain quotations, product specifications, available quantities, shipment schedules and payment terms.
* Prepare commercial comparisons covering price, product quality, logistics, financing costs, payment risks and expected trading margins.
* Support senior management during negotiations, meetings and commercial discussions.
* Follow up actively with counterparties and maintain momentum until each opportunity reaches a clear outcome.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of trading leads, quotations, negotiations and outstanding action items.
* Assist in preparing commercial proposals, presentations and management updates.

Market Intelligence

* Monitor commodity prices, regional supply and demand, freight rates, port conditions and relevant geopolitical and industry developments.
* Prepare concise market updates and highlight developments that may affect pricing, supply availability, logistics or trading strategy.
* Verify market information through multiple credible sources instead of accepting unconfirmed statements at face value.
* Develop a practical understanding of major producers, traders, customers, shipping routes and end-use industries.
* Identify new business opportunities and promptly escalate commercially significant information to management.
* Distinguish actionable market intelligence from rumours, promotional claims and unreliable information.

Trade Execution

* Coordinate with operations, finance, banks, customers, suppliers, brokers, surveyors, shipping agents and other service providers to ensure smooth trade execution.
* Review commercial terms, product specifications, contracts, invoices, letters of credit and shipping documents for accuracy and consistency.
* Track important milestones, including contract execution, payment, vessel nomination, loading, documentation, arrival, discharge and final settlement.
* Anticipate potential delays, discrepancies or execution risks and raise them early, together with practical proposed solutions.
* Ensure that commitments, deadlines and management instructions are accurately recorded and followed through.
* Support the resolution of operational, documentation and payment discrepancies.

Counterparty Assessment and Risk Control

* Conduct preliminary due diligence on prospective suppliers, customers and intermediaries.
* Check company registration information, ownership, operating history, website and email authenticity, product origin, trading record and commercial references.
* Recognise warning signs such as unrealistic pricing, unclear product origin, inconsistent documents, unusual advance-payment requests or reluctance to provide verifiable information.
* Support sanctions screening, compliance checks and internal approval processes.
* Escalate material commercial, credit, documentation or counterparty risks promptly.
* Protect the company’s commercial interests and confidential information at all times.

Relationship and Stakeholder Management

* Build professional and constructive relationships with internal and external stakeholders from different countries, cultures and seniority levels.
* Communicate tactfully and confidently when seeking clarification, correcting misunderstandings, negotiating terms or following up on overdue matters.
* Understand the priorities and sensitivities of different stakeholders and adjust communication appropriately.
* Represent Sherman Mineral Trading professionally during meetings, business meals, conferences, site visits and overseas travel.
* Prepare clear bilingual meeting notes, action lists and follow-up communications when required.
* Maintain professionalism and composure when dealing with difficult, sensitive or fast-moving situations.

Required Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, Maritime Studies, Engineering or a related discipline.
* One to three years of relevant experience in commodity trading, international trade, shipping, logistics, banking, procurement or business development is preferred.
* Strong fresh graduates with relevant internship experience, commercial maturity and demonstrated initiative may also be considered.
* Strong numerical ability and proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Outlook.
* Basic understanding of international trade, shipping documents, payment terms and letters of credit is preferred.
* Willingness to travel internationally and attend occasional business engagements outside normal office hours.

Mandatory Language Proficiency

* Strong spoken and written English.
* Strong spoken and written Mandarin.
* Ability to conduct commercial conversations and prepare professional business correspondence in both languages.
* Ability to read Mandarin quotations, commercial correspondence, specifications and other business documents.
* Language proficiency will be tested during the selection process.

Essential Personal Qualities

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

* *Commercial awareness:* Understands how price, quality, logistics, financing, timing and counterparty risk affect profitability.
* *Situational awareness:* Notices important details, reads situations appropriately and understands the wider commercial context.
* *Practical judgement:* Distinguishes urgent or material matters from routine issues and knows when to act independently or escalate.
* *Resourcefulness:* Looks for practical solutions and alternative approaches when facing obstacles.
* *Initiative:* Follows through without repeated reminders and takes appropriate action without waiting to be directed at every stage.
* *Interpersonal maturity:* Communicates appropriately with senior executives, colleagues, customers and suppliers.
* *Intellectual curiosity:* Asks thoughtful questions and seeks to understand the reasons behind instructions and decisions.
* *Learning agility:* Learns quickly from experience and feedback and does not repeatedly make the same mistake.
* *Attention to detail:* Carefully checks prices, specifications, quantities, dates, payment terms and documentation.
* *Resilience:* Remains composed and effective in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.
* *Integrity:* Handles confidential information responsibly and communicates facts accurately.
* *Ownership:* Accepts personal responsibility for assignments from initiation through completion.
* *Commercial confidence:* Is comfortable speaking with unfamiliar parties, asking direct questions and following up persistently but professionally.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Junior Commodity Trader will:

* Provide management with timely, accurate and commercially useful information.
* Communicate effectively with counterparties in both English and Mandarin.
* Follow up consistently and close action items without constant supervision.
* Identify risks, inconsistencies and warning signs before they become serious problems.
* Exercise sound judgement when handling unfamiliar or ambiguous situations.
* Build a dependable network of suppliers, customers and market contacts.
* Progressively manage selected counterparties and trading opportunities independently.
* Contribute positively to Sherman’s culture of *Accuracy, Discipline, Accountability and Commercial Excellence*.

What We Offer

* Direct exposure to international physical commodity trading and senior decision-makers.
* Hands-on involvement in sourcing, negotiation, trade finance, shipping and execution.
* Opportunities to work with major mining, energy and industrial groups.
* Regional and international business exposure.
* Performance-based rewards and career development for employees who demonstrate strong judgement, initiative and results.

Application Requirement

Applicants should submit an English résumé and clearly indicate their level of spoken and written Mandarin proficiency.

Shortlisted candidates should expect part of the interview and practical assessment to be conducted in Mandarin.

Pay: $4,000.00 - $5,200.00 per month

Benefits:
* Professional development

Work Location: In person

Account Operations Support: Assist in ensuring smooth account operations including adherence to globally defined media thresholds, sufficiency exercises, PO trackers, monthly billing inputs, and reporting cadences.

In 3 Months:

Establish relationships with client contacts, internal teams, and key partners.
Develop a thorough understanding of the client's business, brand portfolio, media approach, and historical campaign performance.

Understand and support the team in ensuring robust KPI-setting and tracking frameworks are in place across active campaigns.

Demonstrate strong ownership of assigned tasks and a proactive approach to learning

In 12 Months:

Become a reliable and integral member of the account team, consistently delivering high-quality support and contributing to client satisfaction.
Build a track record of proactive support and measurable contributions to campaign impact.
Demonstrate a growing understanding of the media landscape and client objectives.

At least 1 year of media planning experience, with a strong track record in integrated digital and traditional media planning within a media agency environment.

Strong analytical skills with an ability to support the development of insight-driven media strategies aligned to client business objectives.
Excellent organizational, operational, and numeracy skills, with strong attention to detail.

A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

title: Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement Lead
description:
Who are we?

Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.

People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.

Why Join Howden US?

At Howden, we’re not just building a business- We’re rewriting the rules of what a global insurance broker can be. And now, it’s your turn to be part of something extraordinary. From three people and a dog to over 22,000 employees across 56 countries, we’ve grown into a $4bn revenue powerhouse with bold ambition: to become a $13bn business with 40,000 people by 2030.

We’re launching our US retail platform with the same entrepreneurial spirit that’s driven our success worldwide- and we’re looking for trailblazers to help shape the future.

Why Howden?

You’ll Own It
With 6,000 employee shareholders owning 34% of the company, our unique ownership model means you’re not just joining a team—you’re building a business you truly own.
You’ll Be Empowered
We’re a destination for talent where people are trusted to look after their clients and grow together. You’ll have the freedom to lead, backed by global scale and local expertise.
You’ll Be Part of Something Bigger
Our integrated platform spans broking, reinsurance, and MGA capabilities—giving you access to everything you need to deliver for clients and build something remarkable

We have always been employee-owned and driven by entrepreneurial spirit. Right from the beginning, we've focused on employing talented individuals and empowering them to make a real difference to the company, whilst building successful and fulfilling careers at the same time. Simply put, we hire talented specialists and give them what they need to make a difference for clients. Always have, always will.

What is the role?

We are seeking a Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement Lead to support the design, documentation, and governance of end-to-end operational processes and target operating model elements across the US Retail business. This role will play a critical part in translating strategic change into clear, executable processes while ensuring appropriate controls are embedded.

Reporting to the Head of Continuous Improvement & Change, you will act as a hands-on process and standards leader – driving consistency, enabling scale, and reinforcing operational discipline across teams. This role is an exciting opportunity for a process leader who can translate strategic priorities into clear, governed, and executable ways of working.

What will you be doing?

Process Design and Standardization

Support the design, documentation, and maintenance end-to-end operational processes.
Develop clear SOPs, process maps, RACI models, and handoffs.
Ensure processes are scalable, repeatable, and aligned to business strategy and regulatory requirements.
Partner with business and functional leaders to simplify workflows and eliminate inefficiencies.

Process Governance

Help maintain clear process ownership, documentation, and change control standards.
Maintain process documentation and ensure updates are reflected accurately and consistently.
Define KPIs and partner with Operations on measurement and reporting.
Support audit readiness by ensuring processes are well-documented and consistently executed.

Adoption and Continuous Improvement

Ensure processes, SOPs, and controls are clear, complete and ready for adoption, partnering with Capability & Change on enablement.
Partner with Capability & Change to support enablement where process changes require training or reinforcement.
Identify improvement opportunities using operational data, performance metrics, and stakeholder feedback.
Partner closely with industry practice groups, Operations, Technology, and Learning & Development to align process designs with day-to-day execution.
Provide practical input to leaders and teams on process clarity, consistency, and operational readiness.

Key Skills & Competencies

Strong experience in process design, documentation, and governance within complex environments.
Experience in insurance brokerage, with a strong understanding of core brokerage and client service processes.
Ability to translate complex operations into clear, executable processes.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Highly collaborative, detail-oriented, and execution-focused.

Qualifications

8+ years of experience in process design, process governance, or operational excellence roles within an insurance brokerage or related financial service environment.
Strong understanding of brokerage operations, systems (e.g., Epic or other AMS), and core workflows (e.g., client service, policy administration, certificates, billing).
Proven ability to design, document, and govern end-to-end operational processes that improve efficiency, consistency, and control.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, or related field.
Lean, Six Sigma, or similar continuous improvement training is a plus.
Experience with process mapping and documentation tools is an advantage.

What do we offer in return? A career that you define.

Our business succeeds by allowing our people to make a mark in the areas they care about most: personal development, volunteering, and fundraising for charity, or creating new insurance products that address society’s greatest challenges.

And we know that separate home and work lives don't really exist. If you're happy and healthy at home, you're more likely to be happy and fulfilled at work – and vice versa. That's why we do our best to support our people in every aspect of their lives.

Compensation and Benefits

The expected base salary range for this role is $125,000 - $175,000; actual base salary will be determined based on factors including candidate experience and work location. This role is classified as exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).

In addition to a competitive base salary, employees are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus. Howden also offers a variety of benefits and programs, subject to eligibility, including:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including healthcare savings and reimbursement accounts
401(k) retirement plan
Flexible Paid Time Off and paid parental leave
Life and Disability insurance

Our sustainability promise

We’re on a life-long journey to become an ever-more sustainable group. It's a commitment to taking care of our people and the world we live in, to doing good business, and to making a positive impact wherever we can. Our governance processes, company policies, and review systems are all geared towards our goal of making a positive impact in the world. You can read more about our sustainability work here.

What do we offer in return?

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new

We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges

We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

Reasonable adjustments

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.

If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.

*Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.

title: Originator (Assets)
description:
Your Role In Our Story

We are seeking candidate to grow ACT’s renewable energy asset portfolio across APAC. The primary focus of the role is to identify and engage renewable energy asset owners, onboard their facilities for registration with relevant renewable energy certificate (REC) registries through ACT, and propose commercial arrangements for ACT to manage and optimise the RECs generated by these assets.

The role requires a combination of business development, relationship management, commercial negotiation, and project coordination. The successful candidate will actively originate new opportunities through market mapping, cold outreach, industry networks, and direct engagement with renewable energy asset owners and developers.

Key Responsibilities

Renewable Asset Origination & Business Development

Identify, prospect, and engage renewable energy asset owners, project developers, power generation companies, utilities, and other relevant stakeholders across APAC to build a strong pipeline of renewable assets.

Conduct proactive business development activities, including cold calling, direct outreach, industry networking, client meetings, and presentations to renewable energy facility owners.

Educate asset owners on REC registration, issuance, market opportunities, and ACT’s capabilities in managing and monetizing their environmental attributes.

Continuously develop and implement strategies to improve ACT’s access to renewable asset owners and expand the portfolio of renewable assets under management.

Commercial Structuring & Negotiation

Identify opportunities for REC sales and develop commercial solutions that help renewable asset owners maximize the value of their renewable energy portfolios.

Commercial discussions and negotiations with asset owners, including proposing pricing and commercial structures, negotiating terms, and finalizing REC management and/or offtake agreements in accordance with ACT’s internal guidelines.

Develop sourcing strategies that balance competitiveness for asset owners with ACT’s commercial and margin objectives.

Asset Registration & Portfolio Management

Work closely with renewable asset owners and ACT’s Operations team to facilitate timely registration of renewable energy facilities with the relevant registries and support subsequent REC issuance.

Coordinate the collection of required documentation and information from asset owners, ensuring complete and timely submission to Operations and relevant registries.

Maintain visibility over the asset onboarding and registration pipeline, proactively addressing issues that may delay registration or REC issuance.

Monitor the performance and expected REC generation of the renewable asset portfolio and provide relevant updates to commercial and trading teams.

Market & Trading Collaboration

Work closely with ACT’s trading and other front-office teams to understand REC demand, pricing dynamics, buyer requirements, and emerging market opportunities.

Use market intelligence to prioritize origination efforts toward countries, technologies, asset types, and REC products where buyer demand and commercial opportunities are strongest.

Collaborate with trading teams to develop optimal solutions for managing and monetizing sourced RECs and matching renewable asset supply with end-buyer demand.

Provide market feedback from asset owners to support ACT’s broader REC trading and commercial strategy.

Market Intelligence & Strategy

Stay abreast of developments in APAC renewable energy certificate markets, including changes in regulations, registry requirements, green electricity markets, corporate renewable energy procurement, and relevant carbon and environmental markets.

Monitor regulatory and market developments that may create new sourcing opportunities or affect the eligibility and value of renewable energy assets and RECs.

Formulate and execute market-entry and sourcing strategies to expand ACT’s renewable asset portfolio and maximize the commercial value and profitability of REC origination activities.

Your Expertise

To be successful in this role, we are looking for candidates with the following qualifications and attributes

Fluent in English and any SEA language is a plus

Bachelor’s/master's degree, preferably in Energy, Environmental, Electricity, Business and/or other similar fields

2 years experience in the power sector, ESG, particularly in solar project development or EPC sales.

Relevant experience in business development, renewable energy, environmental commodities, power markets, project development, or related sectors.

Existing relationships or experience working with renewable energy asset owners, project developers, utilities, power generation companies, or grid-related organizations in APAC is highly desirable.

Strong business development capabilities, including prospecting, cold outreach, relationship building, client presentations, and pipeline development.

Strong commercial acumen with experience in negotiating agreements and developing commercial or offtake structures.

Ability to understand renewable energy and REC market dynamics and translate market information to support actionable origination strategies.

Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to work effectively across commercial, trading, and operational teams.

Self-driven and comfortable developing new markets and relationships from the ground up.

Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

Ability to work across multiple APAC markets and cultures.

Recommend improvements to program format, curation and experience based on performance, client feedback and execution learnings.
Support Segment in refreshing, scaling or evolving programs, bringing an experience and execution perspective.
Build and share best practices across the portfolio to continuously improve quality, efficiency and client impact.

Build and manage a strong ecosystem of partners across luxury, hospitality, lifestyle, entertainment, content and experiential marketing.
Lead agency and vendor selection, negotiation and performance management, while maintaining a strong bench of preferred partners.

Partner closely with Segment Heads, Sales, Relationship Managers, Marketing and other stakeholders to deliver programs against intended client and business objectives.
Bring creative and execution expertise to program planning, constructively challenging and recommending enhancements where appropriate.
Work with Brand, Compliance, Legal, Risk and other relevant functions to ensure programs meet applicable brand, regulatory, safeguarding, gifting and entertainment requirements.

18+ years of relevant experience in client engagement, experiential marketing, branded programs or premium events, with a strong track record in senior leadership roles.
Experience in private banking, premier or priority banking, luxury, hospitality, lifestyle or a comparable premium consumer environment would be advantageous.
Proven experience translating business and brand strategies into high-quality experiential programs spanning experience design, curation, production and content amplification.
Experience building and evolving recurring experiential platforms or signature programs, rather than solely delivering one-off events.
Ability to design experiences for different customer segments and life stages, including affluent, high-net-worth and intergenerational families.
Strong experience in content and social amplification, agency management and luxury, hospitality, lifestyle and experiential ecosystem.
Excellent senior stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed organization where program ownership sits with the business.
Polished and credible, with the presence to engage senior stakeholders and clients across all segments, including affluent, high-net-worth and next-generation clients.

title: Business Development Manager – Retail Expansion, Site Acquisition & Leasing
description:
We are looking for an experienced and well-connected Business Development Manager to support the Group’s expansion across its beverage, bakery and retail brands.

This role will be responsible for identifying and securing suitable retail locations across Singapore, with a strong focus on shopping malls, retail developments and high-traffic commercial locations.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of Singapore’s retail and shopping mall landscape, including mall positioning, tenant mix, rental rates, footfall, customer demographics and available retail spaces.

You should also have an established network and strong working relationships with major shopping mall landlords, developers, leasing teams and property representatives, with the ability to identify opportunities and negotiate favourable commercial terms for the Group.

This is a hands-on role covering the full process from site identification and evaluation to lease negotiation, store expansion and lease renewal.

Responsibilities:

1. Retail Site Identification & Expansion

Identify and source suitable retail locations for the Group’s beverage, bakery and retail brands across Singapore.

Proactively monitor upcoming vacancies, new developments, mall repositioning projects and potential retail opportunities.

Build and maintain a pipeline of potential locations suitable for different brand concepts and store formats.

Evaluate locations based on mall positioning, footfall, customer demographics, tenant mix, accessibility, visibility, unit size and commercial potential.

Recommend suitable locations based on each brand’s target customers, business model and expansion strategy.

2. Shopping Mall & Landlord Relationships

Develop and maintain strong relationships with major shopping mall owners, landlords, developers, leasing teams and property agents.

Leverage existing industry networks and market resources to gain access to suitable retail opportunities and upcoming vacancies.

Maintain regular communication with landlords and leasing representatives to stay informed of new opportunities, rental movements and mall developments.

Establish the Group as a preferred and reliable retail/F&B tenant.

3. Rental & Lease Negotiation

Lead negotiations with landlords on rental rates, lease terms, security deposits, rent-free periods, fitting-out periods, turnover rent, service charges, marketing fees and other tenancy terms.

Analyse and benchmark rental rates across comparable malls and locations.

Negotiate commercially favourable terms while considering the long-term viability of each site.

Review and evaluate Letters of Offer, tenancy agreements and other leasing-related documents together with relevant internal teams and professional advisors.

Identify potential commercial or contractual risks and highlight them to management.

4. Lease Renewal & Existing Store Portfolio

Manage and monitor the Group’s existing retail lease portfolio and upcoming renewal timelines.

Lead lease renewal negotiations with landlords and seek improved or commercially sustainable terms.

Review rental increases, lease conditions, renewal options and other tenancy changes.

Recommend whether to renew, relocate, renegotiate or exit a location based on business performance and market conditions.

Maintain a clear database of lease expiry dates, renewal options, rental rates and key tenancy terms.

5. Market & Rental Intelligence

Maintain strong knowledge of Singapore’s retail property and shopping mall landscape.

Track rental rates, mall performance, footfall trends, tenant mix, new developments, competitor expansion and market movements.

Conduct regular market and location analysis to support the Group’s expansion strategy.

Provide management with insights on suitable malls, locations and commercial opportunities.

Benchmark proposed rental rates and tenancy terms against comparable locations.

6. Site Evaluation & Commercial Analysis

Conduct initial commercial assessments of potential locations.

Work with Finance, Operations and Management to evaluate projected sales, rental costs, occupancy costs and overall store viability.

Prepare site comparison and investment analysis for management review.

Assess the suitability of different locations for different brands based on brand positioning, customer profile and expected sales potential.

7. Cross-Functional Coordination

Work closely with Management, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Design, Procurement and Project/Renovation teams throughout the site acquisition and opening process.

Coordinate site visits, landlord meetings, commercial discussions and handover requirements.

Support the team from initial site selection through to lease execution and store opening.

Ensure key commercial and tenancy information is clearly communicated to relevant stakeholders.

8. New Business & Strategic Partnerships

Identify potential strategic opportunities with shopping malls, landlords, developers and other property partners.

Explore opportunities for new store formats, pop-ups, kiosks, flagship stores and other retail concepts.

Build long-term partnerships that support the Group’s expansion across Singapore and potentially the wider Southeast Asian market.

Requirements:

5–8 years of relevant experience in Business Development, Retail Leasing, Property Leasing, Site Acquisition, Retail Expansion or a related field.

Strong understanding of the Singapore shopping mall and retail property landscape.

Proven network and established relationships with major shopping mall landlords, developers, leasing teams and property agents in Singapore.

Strong knowledge of retail rental rates, mall positioning, tenant mix, footfall and retail market trends.

Demonstrated experience in lease negotiation and commercial tenancy negotiations.

Experience managing lease renewals and existing retail portfolios.

Strong commercial acumen with the ability to evaluate the financial viability of potential locations.

Strong negotiation, communication and stakeholder management skills.

Able to work independently, identify opportunities proactively and drive projects from initial discussion through to completion.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with good attention to commercial and contractual details.

Experience in F&B, beverage, bakery, retail, lifestyle or consumer brands is highly preferred.

Strong knowledge of Singapore’s retail market; regional Southeast Asian experience will be an advantage.

iTea

is a growing beverage brand dedicated to bringing refreshing, quality tea and specialty beverages to customers across Singapore. We focus on using quality ingredients, consistent preparation standards, and friendly service to create an enjoyable experience for every customer.

As a fast-growing F&B brand, iTea is continuously expanding its presence and developing new opportunities for our customers, franchise partners, and employees.

At iTea, we believe our people are the key to our success. We are committed to creating a positive and supportive working environment where team members can learn, develop their skills, and build a rewarding career in the F&B industry.

From our

Baristas and Service Crew to Outlet Managers and Operations teams

, every team member plays an important role in delivering our brand promise and maintaining high standards across our outlets.

title: Manager, Business Development - Strategy & Performance
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Manager, Business Development - Strategy & Performance

Overview
The Manager, Business Development will support business growth by servicing key client accounts, identifying new commercial opportunities, and providing data-driven insights to inform account and market strategies.

As a key member of the account management team, the role will support the development and execution of account plans and client strategies. This includes coordinating client initiatives, structuring proposals, supporting the activation of new products and services, and ensuring high-quality delivery and client satisfaction.

The role will also partner closely with the Singapore Country Manager and cross-functional stakeholders to analyse business performance, identify market trends and business gaps, and translate insights into actionable recommendations. The individual will leverage Mastercard’s platforms, products, technology, and analytical capabilities to support strategic planning and incremental business growth.

Key Responsibilities
Account Management and Business Development
• Prepare account plans and support the development and execution of account strategies.
• Identify opportunities to grow existing client relationships and generate incremental business.
• Structure customised pitches, business propositions, and proposals based on client needs and data-driven insights.
• Support the onboarding of new clients and the activation of new products, services, and joint marketing initiatives.
• Own and coordinate activities within execution plans to ensure timely delivery and client satisfaction.
• Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into commercially relevant solutions.
• Support overall client servicing and contribute to best-in-class client satisfaction.

Business Analytics and Market Insights
• Use business, financial, and marketing analytics to identify performance drivers, emerging trends, business gaps, and growth opportunities.
• Translate analytical findings into clear and compelling insights for the Country Manager, Account Managers, clients, and other stakeholders.
• Use insights to inform product, account, client, and market strategies.
• Develop data-driven business propositions that support client objectives and Mastercard’s business priorities.
• Analyse the commercial impact of programmes and initiatives, including their contribution to business performance.
• Monitor business performance and recommend corrective actions or new opportunities where appropriate.
• Integrate information and perspectives from multiple sources to support strategic planning and decision-making.

Strategic and Cross-functional Partnership
• Partner closely with the Country Manager on business analysis, market insights, strategic planning, and market priorities.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Market Development, Product, Digital, Services, Finance, and Operations, to deliver client and business initiatives.
• Work with internal business partners to understand their needs and translate them into focused analytical and execution plans.
• Participate in client, account, and market planning processes.
• Ensure that analytical work and business development activities are aligned with Mastercard’s business objectives and client requirements.
• Take ownership of deliverables and maintain a high standard of quality across all work.

All About You
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Technology, Marketing, Statistics, or a related discipline. An advanced degree is advantageous.
• Experience in business development, account management, business analytics, consulting, client service, or a related field.
• Strong analytical capabilities, commercial acumen, and strategic planning skills.
• Ability to translate complex business and analytical information into clear, compelling presentations and actionable recommendations.
• Experience developing account plans, business propositions, client proposals, or market strategies.
• Track record of executing initiatives and projects to achieve desired business outcomes.
• Strong client and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage expectations effectively.
• Excellent communication, presentation, problem-solving, and organisational skills.
• Ability to collaborate cross-functionally and influence stakeholders outside the direct reporting structure.
• Self-motivated, intellectually curious, and comfortable working in a dynamic environment.
• Broad understanding of the payments landscape and commercial economics gained through relevant professional experience.
• Prior experience within banking, payments, financial services, or a client-facing commercial environment is preferred.
• Prior experience in consulting and strategy planning is preferred.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Regional Sales & Marketing Manager
description:

Averis Systems stands behind every stage of the guest journey — from arrival to departure — as your distributor, systems integrator and support partner in one.

The Regional Sales & Marketing Manager is responsible for managing and growing sales pipeline and client accounts across the APAC region, while also driving the regional marketing activities that support client acquisition and brand positioning — covering hotel locking systems, refrigeration solutions, access control, GRMS, building automation, and related proprietary software platforms. The role owns the end-to-end sales cycle for existing and prospective regional accounts, from qualification through to close, and shapes the marketing strategy, campaigns, and market presence that generate and support that pipeline. Travel regionally as required to support client meetings, project handovers, account reviews, and marketing/trade events.

Experience managing regional accounts across APAC markets.

description:
Job Description – Business Development Executive WAREHOUSE123

About the job

Most sales roles begin with a product list. This role begins with a customer’s warehouse problem.

We are building WAREHOUSE123 (https://youtu.be/_rMZWsB-NaY?si=qs-2_Yd0lTHtho70) around a simple goal: when a business thinks, “We need this for our warehouse,” WAREHOUSE123 should be the name they think of.

That means going beyond individual products. We want to understand how customers store, move, handle and protect goods, then connect them with practical solutions across racking, shelving, material handling, warehouse equipment and related operational needs.

We are looking for someone who wants to grow into this mission with us — someone prepared to speak with customers, attend sites, work through incomplete RFQs, ask good questions and take responsibility for moving an enquiry towards a workable solution.

What you will do

Attend to customer enquiries promptly, professionally & with clear follow-through.

Speak with customer to understand what they are trying to achieve, what information is missing & what should happen next.

Join customer site visits & progressively learn to conduct site surveys, take measurements, document observations & identify operational constraints.

Review storage needs, product dimensions & loads, material-handling equipment, aisle requirements, workflow & site conditions before recommending a solution.

Coordinate internally & with suppliers to develop recommendations, quotation inputs, product options & follow-up actions.

Track each enquiry carefully so commitments, unanswered questions & next steps are not forgotten.

Look beyond the immediate request to identify related warehouse needs that may improve safety, efficiency, storage capacity or daily operations.

Who we are looking for

You take ownership of work & follow through without needing to be chased repeatedly.

You are curious & willing to learn products, technical details & warehouse operations that may initially be unfamiliar.

You are comfortable meeting customers & working in both office & site environments.

You ask questions when information is unclear instead of guessing or passing the problem to someone else.

You remain constructive when a task becomes difficult, changes direction or requires extra investigation.

You communicate clearly and respectfully in spoken and written English.

You are organized enough to manage several enquiries, follow-ups & open items at the same time.

You are comfortable with basic measurements, numbers & common office or digital tools.

Background

Early-career applicants & career-switchers are welcome. Experience in sales, customer service, logistics, warehouse operations, engineering, project coordination, material handling or industrial products would be useful, but it is not essential. We are more interested in evidence of responsibility, learning ability & practical problem-solving than in a perfect job title.

Whatyou can build here

Real experience in customer discovery, RFQ handling, site surveys & solution development.

Working knowledge across storage systems, warehouse equipment, lift truck, material handling products & related product categories.

The opportunity to influence which products & solutions WAREHOUSE123 develops next.

Progressively greater responsibility as your product knowledge, judgement &customer-handling ability grow.

A role where good work can contribute directly to a long-term Singapore warehouse-solutions brand.

Our working approach

We do not expect a new team member to know every answer on day one. We do expect honesty, effort, disciplined follow-up & the willingness to keep learning. When a customer gives us an incomplete request, our job is not to dismiss it or guess. Our job is to clarify the need, inspect the situation where necessary and work towards the most practical solution we can responsibly provide.

Application process

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to discuss a simple, realistic customer scenario. This is not a test of memorized warehouse knowledge. It helps us understand how you ask questions, organize incomplete information and approach a practical problem.

If this sounds like the kind of responsibility & learning opportunity you have been looking for, submit your resume to sunny@yktoh.com& and tell us briefly why this role interests you.

We assess applicants using job-related skills, experience, potential & ability to perform the role.

Singapore Locals and Singapore Permanent Residents Preferred.

The IFSR role exercises independent judgment and discretion in adapting our multi-antenna MIMO radio and mesh networking systems to meet complex customer requirements, as well as in the diagnosis and resolution of complex field issues. This position reports to the Director of Sales Engineering and operates autonomously in the field, collaborating closely with Engineering, Sales, and Product Management. Act as a technical subject matter expert and advisor for advanced wireless communication systems, working closely with customers to assess needs and deliver customized solutions.

Collaborate with Engineering and Product Management teams to provide field-driven input into product design, enhancements, and troubleshooting strategies.

Exercise independent judgment in diagnosing and resolving complex field issues, coordinating with Engineering, Product, and Sales teams to develop corrective actions and strategic recommendations.
Operate autonomously in dynamic environments, balancing multiple customer engagements, travel schedules, and mission requirements with minimal supervision.
Provide technical training to end users, tailoring materials and delivery methods to customer skill levels and mission requirements.
Utilize advanced problem-solving skills to identify, analyze, and resolve field failures and performance issues.
Lead customer engagement and influence technical decision-making through deep product expertise and communication of competitive advantages.
Document field observations and prepare recommendations that influence product roadmaps and internal support processes.
Contribute to the development of our internal best practices and process improvements for customer support and deployment success.
Perform other related duties of which the above are representative.
Travel up to 75% of the time and work on-site at the customer's location.-

Completion of secondary education (such as GCSEs or an equivalent national qualification; high school diploma or GED) is required. A degree in a technical field is preferred.
Minimum 1-3 years’ experience supporting communications, radios, or data networks in a DoD, Military, or Law Enforcement environment with a minimum of 1-3 years of experience as an FSR or equivalent in a customer-facing technical role. Years of experience determine FSR level placement.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP protocols, network architecture, and radio frequency systems.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
Basic proficiency in English (reading and writing) is required.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Must be based in Singapore.

Corporate Sales & Business Development Executive

The Gift Expert is a leading corporate gifting and merchandising company that helps businesses strengthen relationships through thoughtfully curated gifts, branded merchandise, promotional products, employee appreciation programmes, and customised gift solutions. As we continue to expand, we are looking for 3 to 4 ambitious, driven, and relationship-focused individuals to join our growing Corporate Sales & Business Development team.

This role is ideal for candidates who enjoy meeting people, building relationships, presenting ideas, and helping clients find creative gifting solutions. Whether you have previous sales experience or are looking to build a career in B2B sales, we provide the training and support needed to develop your skills in corporate sales, business development, and account management.

As a Corporate Sales & Business Development Executive, you will play a key role in driving business growth by identifying and engaging potential corporate clients across various industries. Your responsibilities will include prospecting new business opportunities, conducting cold calls and client outreach, introducing our corporate gifting and merchandise solutions, understanding clients' branding and campaign objectives, preparing quotations and proposals, following up on enquiries, negotiating opportunities, and converting leads into long-term business relationships.

You will also support The Gift Expert's expansion into retail merchandising by working with theme parks, tourist attractions, museums, hotels, resorts, lifestyle brands, and destination retailers to develop customised souvenir collections, retail-ready merchandise, and exclusive gift products.

Working closely with our internal teams and supplier network, you will coordinate product recommendations, sourcing, sampling, artwork approvals, pricing, production schedules, and delivery timelines to ensure every project is delivered smoothly and exceeds client expectations.

Candidates with backgrounds in sales, events management, event organising, hospitality, tourism, retail, marketing, client servicing, project coordination, or customer relationship management will have an advantage, as these experiences translate well into understanding client expectations, managing multiple projects, coordinating timelines, and delivering outstanding customer experiences. Experience in organising corporate events, exhibitions, roadshows, conferences, or marketing activations is an added bonus, as many corporate gifting projects are closely aligned with events, product launches, employee engagement initiatives, and client appreciation programmes.

We are looking for individuals who are energetic, proactive, confident communicators, and eager to learn. Success in this role comes from having a positive attitude, resilience, strong interpersonal skills, and a genuine interest in helping businesses create memorable gifting experiences. We welcome motivated individuals who are prepared to take ownership of their work and grow within a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

The Gift Expert offers comprehensive training in corporate sales, cold calling, business development, client relationship management, solution selling, and merchandising. In addition to a competitive basic salary, this role includes an attractive commission structure that rewards strong performance and provides significant earning potential as you build and expand your client portfolio.

If you enjoy meeting clients, developing creative solutions, and building long-term business relationships, this is an excellent opportunity to establish a rewarding career in the corporate gifting and merchandising industry with The Gift Expert.

title: Sponsorship & Exhibition Sales Manager, International Future Fuels Week (IFFW)
company: INTERNATIONAL FUTURE FUELS WEEK PTE. LTD.
description:
About the organisation

IFFW is an exhibitions and media group serving the future fuels sector across aviation, maritime and land transport. Its flagship event, International Future Fuels Week, is a B2B conference and exhibition. The inaugural edition will take place from 14 to 17 June 2027 at Sands Expo & Convention Centre, Marina Bay Sands, Singapore, and is expected to attract 3,500 delegates from more than 30 countries.

Role purpose

The Sponsorship & Exhibition Sales Manager is responsible for generating sponsorship and exhibition revenue for IFFW 2027. The role covers the full sales cycle, from prospecting and proposal through to contract, payment and client servicing up to and during the event. The role holder will also support the Executive Director on strategic accounts and commercial projects.

As 2027 is the inaugural edition, there is no prior-year client base to renew. The role holder will build the sponsor and exhibitor base from the ground up, and should enjoy new-business selling.

Key responsibilities

Sales and business development

Identify, qualify and approach prospective sponsors and exhibitors across the fuels, energy, aviation, maritime and transport sectors.

Engage senior decision-makers, including heads of commercial, business development and marketing, to understand their objectives and recommend the right mix of sponsorship, exhibition and branding.

Sell sponsorship packages and add-on opportunities in line with the approved rate card.

Sell exhibition space, advising clients on stand options, locations and applicable charges.

Follow up leads generated by marketing campaigns by phone and email, and convert them into qualified opportunities.

Develop and maintain working relationships with exhibition and stand-building agencies.

Represent IFFW at selected industry events to generate new business.

Track competing events and sponsorship trends across the energy and transport sectors, and feed market insight back to the Executive Director.

Client management

Act as the principal point of contact for assigned sponsors and exhibitors from contract through to the close of the event.

Work with the marketing, programme and operations teams to align sales campaigns, floorplan planning and the delivery of sponsor and exhibitor entitlements as contracted.

Sales administration and reporting

Prepare proposals, quotations and contracts, and follow up to ensure timely signature and payment.

Maintain accurate records of the floorplan and sold sponsorship inventory to prevent double allocation.

Maintain the sales pipeline in the CRM and report weekly to the Executive Director on pipeline, bookings, revenue forecast and market feedback.

At the event

Look after sponsors and exhibitors on site and strengthen relationships face to face.

Run the rebooking campaign for the 2028 edition, securing commitments from current sponsors and exhibitors during the show.

Meet prospective sponsors among the delegates and exhibitors to build next year's pipeline.

Supporting the Executive Director

Prepare briefing notes, proposals and follow-ups for the Executive Director's meetings with senior sponsors, partners and government agencies.

Support strategic and high-value accounts that the Executive Director leads directly, from first meeting through to contract.

Follow up commercial leads from the Executive Director's network, speaking engagements and roadshow events.

Take on ad hoc commercial projects as the event develops, such as new sponsorship products or partner programmes.

Qualifications and experience

Essential

At least three years of experience in B2B sales, preferably in sponsorship, exhibition or conference sales.

Experience managing the full sales cycle, from lead generation through to contract and payment.

A record of closing high-value sponsorship deals, with the confidence to negotiate face to face with VP and C-level buyers.

Demonstrated record of achieving or exceeding sales targets.

Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills, including the preparation of tailored commercial proposals.

Ability to manage multiple accounts and deadlines with minimal supervision.

Willingness to travel.

Desirable

Established relationships with exhibition or stand-building agencies in Singapore or the wider region.

Familiarity with the energy, aviation, maritime or transport sectors.

Experience selling a launch or first-edition event.

Working knowledge of Salesforce or a comparable CRM.

Experience selling sponsorship for digital or virtual events as well as physical ones.

Proficiency in Mandarin or another foreign language.

What we offer

A competitive base salary and a commission scheme linked to sponsorship and exhibition revenue, commensurate with experience.

A founding role on a new international event planned to run annually, with scope to grow as the event grows.

Direct working access to the Executive Director, and to senior industry and government contacts across the region.

Application

Interested candidates should submit a CV and a brief cover note outlining relevant sales experience. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Regional Sales Manager - Naval Drones & Subsea Navigation - APAC - F/M
description:
Exail is looking for an experienced Regional Sales & Business Development Manager to accelerate the growth of our Naval Drones and Subsea Navigation business across the Asia-Pacific region.

Based in Singapore, you will develop new business opportunities, strengthen strategic customer relationships and drive sales across Exail’s portfolio of maritime robotics, autonomous naval systems, subsea navigation and underwater positioning solutions.

This is a highly strategic and customer-facing position combining business development, technical sales, key account management and defence programme capture.

Your mission will be to identify opportunities at an early stage, position Exail’s technologies with key regional stakeholders and turn complex, long-term programmes into sustainable business.

Your responsibilities:
Drive business development across APAC

You will be responsible for developing and executing Exail’s regional sales and business development strategy. Your main responsibilities will include:

Identify and develop new opportunities across naval defence, maritime autonomy, mine countermeasures, subsea navigation and underwater positioning.
Build and manage a strong pipeline of short-, medium- and long-term opportunities.
Manage the complete sales cycle, from early opportunity identification and qualification through tendering, negotiation and contract award.
Identify and capture major naval modernisation and autonomous maritime programmes across APAC.
Develop strategic relationships with navies, defence organisations, shipyards, defence primes, system integrators and maritime technology companies.
Manage and develop regional partners, agents and industrial cooperation opportunities.
Coordinate customer demonstrations, operational trials and technical presentations.
Represent Exail at major defence and maritime industry events across the region.
Maintain accurate sales forecasts, CRM reporting and strategic account plans.
Develop strategic defence programmes

You will engage with customers and partners early in their programmes to understand operational challenges and position Exail’s technologies accordingly. Working alongside our product, engineering and programme teams, you will contribute to the development of competitive technical and commercial solutions for complex naval and maritime programmes.

You will also monitor regional defence programmes, procurement activities, market developments and competitive dynamics to identify future growth opportunities.

Our technologies

You will develop sales opportunities across Exail’s portfolio, with a particular focus on:

Naval Drones & Autonomous Systems

Uncrewed Surface Vehicles (USVs)
Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs)
Subsea Navigation & Positioning

Inertial Navigation Systems (INS)
ROV and AUV navigation solutions
USBL and LBL underwater acoustic positioning
Integrated inertial and acoustic navigation systems
Subsea navigation software and related technologies
Your key customers and partners will include navies, defence procurement organisations, naval shipyards, defence primes, autonomous systems manufacturers, subsea contractors and maritime system integrators.

You have at least 10 years of experience in regional sales, business development or strategic account management within one or more of the following environments:

Naval defence
Maritime technology
Autonomous maritime systems
Subsea technologies
Underwater navigation and positioning
Complex defence or maritime systems

You have a proven track record of developing new business and managing complex, long-term sales opportunities. Previous experience securing major contracts or contributing to large defence or naval programmes in APAC will be particularly valuable.

Your background

To succeed in this role, you ideally bring:

A strong understanding of naval procurement processes, defence programmes and complex sales cycles.
Experience selling sophisticated technical equipment, integrated systems or solutions.
A solid network within the APAC naval and maritime ecosystem.
Experience managing strategic accounts, partners and complex commercial negotiations.
Knowledge of autonomous maritime systems, underwater navigation, positioning or subsea technologies.
A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Marine Technology, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
Fluency in English. Additional APAC languages would be an advantage.
What will make you successful

We are looking for someone who is:

Commercially driven, with a strong ability to turn opportunities into long-term business.
Entrepreneurial and proactive, with a strong business development mindset.
Strategic, with the ability to navigate complex defence programmes and long sales cycles.
Technically curious, able to understand complex naval and subsea solutions.
A strong relationship builder, comfortable engaging with operational, technical, procurement and executive stakeholders.
Autonomous, with the ability to manage multiple markets across a large geographical region.
Internationally minded, comfortable working across different cultures and with global teams.
Committed to maintaining high standards of integrity and compliance.
Travel

Based in Singapore, the position requires frequent travel throughout the Asia-Pacific region, representing approximately 30–50% of the role, depending on customer meetings, programmes, demonstrations and industry events. Occasional travel to Exail facilities in Europe will also be required.

GLAS’ vision is to be recognised as the best-in-class independent, non-creditor, conflict-free provider of institutional debt administration services, enabling global clients and counterparties to achieve successful outcomes on their transactions.

The business currently comprises c.500 employees who deliver a solution-based, innovative service, ensuring GLAS is the preferred global partner of choice. GLAS has a blue-chip customer base developed over many years; select clients include Apollo, Blackstone, CVC, Deutsche Bank and Goldman Sachs. GLAS has been recognised as the premier independent provider of loan agency and bond trustee services with a portfolio of over $800 billion assets across its global platform. The company is headquartered in London with offices in Paris, Frankfurt, Madrid, New York, New Jersey, Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong, Milan and Rome.

description:
As the

Product Marketing Manager

, you will own product portfolio, driving product strategy, pricing, go-to-market execution and lifecycle management to deliver sustainable business growth.

You will work at the intersection of product, marketing and commercial strategy, translating market insights into innovative propositions while partnering with Sales, IT, Consumer Operations and Marketing teams to deliver market-leading mobile plans that maximize customer acquisition, retention and profitability.

How You will Make An Impact:

Own the end-to-end product portfolio, including product strategy, pricing, P&L performance and lifecycle management.

Develop and evolve mobile price plans, commercial policies, terms and conditions to ensure Singtel remains competitive in a fast-changing market.

Lead go-to-market planning and execution for new product launches, promotional campaigns and product enhancements.

Monitor product performance through weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting, providing actionable insights to improve commercial outcomes.

Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify customer trends, pricing opportunities and new product innovations.

Develop business cases for new initiatives by evaluating commercial viability, revenue opportunities and potential cannibalization.

Design campaigns and sales enablement materials that support subscriber acquisition, attachment rates, penetration and ARPU growth.

Partner with Sales, Marketing, IT and Consumer Operations teams to deliver seamless product launches and operational readiness.

Define and improve business processes to enhance product governance and operational efficiency.

Manage product-related escalations, customer policy exceptions and waiver governance to ensure consistent customer experiences.

Present commercial recommendations and performance updates to key stakeholders and senior management.

Skills for Success:

Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Economics or a related discipline.

At least 3–5 years of experience in Product Marketing, Product Management or Product Development.

Experience managing product portfolios, pricing strategies and go-to-market initiatives.

Strong commercial acumen with experience managing product P&L and business performance.

Experience developing business cases, product strategies and lifecycle management plans.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into commercial insights and business decisions.

Experience conducting market research and competitive analysis.

Strong project management and execution capabilities.

Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Strong presentation, communication and strategic storytelling skills.

Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Power BI is an advantage.

Self-motivated, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

The Singtel Group is Asia's leading communications group, providing a wide spectrum of multimedia and infocomms technology (ICT) solutions across 3 global business units.

Group Consumer focuses on next-generation communication, infotainment and technology services to consumers and small businesses. Group Enterprise provides innovative and comprehensive ICT solutions, i.e. satellite services, international data and managed services, cloud computing, enterprise mobility services, and end-to-end solutions. Group Digital L!fe strives to bring people together with a cutting edge mix of digital services such as NextGen TV, e-books, music, digital concierge, cloud-based gaming and hyperlocal content.

Headquartered in Singapore, Singtel’s 130 years of operating experience has played a pivotal role in the country’s transformation into a major communications hub. Our Australian arm, Optus is an innovative leader in integrated telecommunications. Through our strategic investments in five regional mobile operators, Telkomsel, Globe Telecom, Advanced Info Service, PBTL, and Bharti Airtel, we are a major communications player in Asia and Africa.

Singtel is the largest listed company on the Singapore Exchange by market capitalisation. We have a vast network of offices in countries and territories throughout Asia Pacific, in Europe, USA and Australia. The Group employs more than 21,000 staff worldwide and has served 468 million mobile customers globally as of 31 March 2013.

title: Business Growth & AI Solutions Consultant
description:
Business Growth & AI Solutions Consultant

Company Overview

Nestly Technologies Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based technology company focused on developing innovative digital solutions that empower businesses through artificial intelligence (AI), data analytics, and digital transformation.

Our flagship platform,

Peekaa

, is an integrated business management solution combining customer relationship management (CRM), loyalty programmes, marketing, and appointment scheduling. We aim to help businesses streamline operations, improve customer engagement, and make smarter, data-driven decisions.

Our goal is to build smarter technology, empower businesses, and shape the future of intelligent business solutions.

The Opportunity

We are looking for ambitious, entrepreneurial, and self-driven individuals to join us as

Business Growth & AI Solutions Consultants

.

This is more than a traditional sales role. You will work closely with business owners to understand their challenges, identify opportunities for improvement, and introduce digital solutions that help them operate more efficiently and grow sustainably.

You will take ownership of the

entire client journey, from business acquisition and onboarding to ongoing relationship management, customer success, and retention

.

As you grow your portfolio of clients, you will have the opportunity to build a sustainable recurring income stream through commissions from customers who continue subscribing to our services.

With flexible working hours, attractive commission opportunities, and strong career growth potential, this role is ideal for individuals who want to take ownership of their success while building a meaningful career in the technology industry.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Development & Client Acquisition

Proactively identify and engage business owners to introduce Peekaa's digital solutions.

Build a pipeline of prospective business clients through networking, referrals, outreach, and other business development activities.

Conduct product demonstrations and consultations to understand business needs.

Present tailored solutions, handle client enquiries, and convert prospective clients into paying subscribers.

2. Business Consulting & Digital Transformation

Understand clients' existing business workflows, operational processes, and customer engagement strategies.

Identify inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions to improve productivity, customer retention, and operational performance.

Help business owners understand how digital tools, data analytics, and emerging AI capabilities can support business decisions.

Position yourself as a trusted business partner by providing practical, value-driven recommendations.
