Manage the complete onboarding process to ensure new clients successfully adopt Peekaa.

Guide business owners and their teams in understanding and using the platform effectively.

Maintain ongoing relationships with clients through regular follow-ups, consultations, and support.

Monitor client satisfaction, address concerns, and work towards long-term retention and subscription renewals.

Identify opportunities to help existing clients maximise the value of the platform.

4. Portfolio Growth & Customer Success

Develop and manage your own portfolio of business clients.

Build long-term customer relationships that support continued subscriptions and recurring commission opportunities.

Gather customer feedback and collaborate with internal teams to improve our products and services.

Work towards individual acquisition, retention, and business growth objectives.

Who We're Looking For

Entrepreneurial, self-motivated individuals who enjoy meeting people and building relationships.

Strong communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.

Passionate about business development, technology, and helping businesses grow.

Comfortable engaging business owners, understanding their challenges, and recommending solutions.

Willingness to learn about AI, data analytics, business processes, and digital transformation.

Ability to work independently, manage client relationships, and take ownership of results.

Experience in sales, business development, account management, or consulting will be an advantage.

Why Join Nestly Technologies?

Attractive Commission & Recurring Income Opportunities

High commission potential for successfully onboarding new paying business clients.

Opportunities to earn recurring commissions from eligible customers who continue their paid subscriptions.

Build your own client portfolio and develop long-term earning potential through acquisition and retention.

Performance-driven earning opportunities that reward individual contributions and results.

Flexible Working Arrangements

Enjoy flexible working hours and greater autonomy over your daily schedule.

Plan your own client appointments, business development activities, and follow-ups.

Take ownership of your performance while maintaining flexibility in how you manage your work.

Strong Career Growth Opportunities

Be part of a growing technology company with opportunities for professional development.

Gain valuable experience in business consulting, sales, AI, data analytics, and digital solutions.

Opportunities to progress into senior consulting, business development management, and leadership roles as the company expands.

Grow alongside the business and play a meaningful role in its development.

Be Part of the Future of Technology

Gain exposure to emerging AI technologies and data-driven business solutions.

Work directly with business owners across different industries.

Make a real difference by helping businesses improve efficiency, strengthen customer loyalty, and achieve sustainable growth.

Build Your Career With Us

At Nestly Technologies, we believe your growth should reflect your ambition, effort, and contributions.

If you are driven by success, enjoy building meaningful business relationships, and want to be part of a growing technology company, we would love to hear from you.

Build your client portfolio. Grow your recurring income. Shape the future of business technology with us.

Nestly Technologies Pte. Ltd.

Empowering Businesses Through AI, Data & Innovation.

Nestly Technologies Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based technology company focused on developing intelligent digital solutions that transform how businesses operate, engage customers, and drive sustainable growth.

Our flagship platform,

By developing intelligent insights, customer behaviour analytics, and data-driven business tools, we aim to empower businesses to better understand their customers, identify growth opportunities, improve customer retention, optimise marketing effectiveness, and make smarter business decisions.

We believe the future of business lies not just in digitalisation, but in transforming everyday business data into meaningful, actionable intelligence.

Our Vision

To make AI-powered technology and data-driven insights accessible to businesses of all sizes, enabling smarter decisions, stronger customer relationships, and sustainable business growth.

Our Culture & People

At Nestly Technologies, we believe innovation begins with people.

We are building an ambitious, forward-thinking team driven by creativity, collaboration, continuous learning, and a shared passion for technology.

We value individuals who are curious, proactive, adaptable, and willing to challenge conventional thinking. We encourage ownership, fresh ideas, and the opportunity to make meaningful contributions.

As a growing technology company, we offer an opportunity to be part of a business at the intersection of

AI, data analytics, software innovation, and digital transformation

.

Our team members have the opportunity to contribute to real-world business solutions, gain hands-on experience, develop professionally, and grow alongside the company.

Whether in software development, AI, data analytics, business development, marketing, or operations, we welcome individuals who are passionate about innovation and making a difference.

Our goal is to build smarter technology, empower businesses, and shape the future of intelligent business solutions.

title: Commercial and CX Graduate Associate - CHR 805
description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

09

S&P Global Energy Commercial and CX Graduate Program

Role: Associate, Commercial and CX Graduate

The Location: Singapore

The S&P Global Energy Commercial and CX Graduate Program journey begins with an intensive 5-week onboarding in our London office.

The 3-months thereafter will be part of the EMEA Customer Success Team, focusing on building a foundational knowledge of the commodity markets, developing essential business-related skills while learning about various S&P Global Energy data, research and analytical products. With Customer Success, you would be a primary contact for clients, providing solutions to their requests in a timely, professional and courteous manner and providing training on S&P Global Energy products through virtual and onsite visits.

The program will consist of rotations to customer success, sales, channel management and marketing functions. This will enable each graduate to gain a holistic perspective of the business. Combined with on-the-job learning, graduates must complete and pass certification milestones along with a rigorous evaluation process that will test and stretch their skills and capabilities. As you progress though the program, you will have the opportunity to support the sales team and ultimately generate additional revenue that helps to grow our business

You will be offered the opportunity to assist S&P Global Energy in achieving its mission of being one of the leading providers of the highest quality price assessments and analytical information to the world’s financial and commodity markets. Our real-time news, pricing and analytical services help markets operate with transparency and efficiency worldwide. As the principal provider of commodity price assessment and information to more than 10,000 customers in 150 countries and with 20 offices spanning five continents, you will form part of a truly globally diverse workforce. You will be part of a rapidly growing organization with an exceptional corporate culture. Our data, analytics, and research help our customers make informed, smarter business decisions and investments.

We are looking for high achievers from a diverse pool of current undergraduates or recent graduates who are passionate about the energy and commodities markets and want to develop their career in a dynamic, high performing and multicultural commercial team. You will be someone who can quickly work out how to make things happen through intellectual curiosity, creativity, exceptional learning agility and problem solving skills as well as effective networking and collaboration skills. Additionally, proficiency in Generative AI technologies and the ability to leverage these tools for innovative solutions will be highly valued.

What’s in it for you:

You will join as a member of a cohort of Commercial and CX Associates. Here, you will be introduced to world-class experts in various commodities including former chief economists, traders and risk managers. They will give presentations about how commodity markets work and provide insightful perspectives on global economic, political, technological and legal issues linked to their specializations. You will also be enrolled in an e-learning curriculum, providing foundational knowledge about the technical aspects of various commodities and market.

Within weeks you will have the opportunity to present topics to senior management and to get constructive feedback on your progress. Throughout the program you will learn how to use tools including S&P Global Energy-Platts, CERA and HORIZON products, Excel add-ins and CRM systems.
You will be challenged on a daily basis with a steep learning curve. You will get the opportunity to work with a broad range of clients including governments, investment banks, commodity trading houses, major oil and gas companies, hedge funds and industry and get to be part of a large energetic and international team with fantastic opportunities for growth.

Career paths after the 18-month initial phase of the program include:

Regional Sales
Specialist Sales
Customer Success

Responsibilities:

Help clients understand how to navigate and extract useful data from the S&P Global Energy product range.
Liaise with the content, commercial and technical teams to address any client queries and ensure our data is maintained to the highest standards.
Proactively reaching out to clients for face-to-face/virtual training (this will apply towards the later stages of development once fully fluent and certified on the product range).
Conduct research about important issues at the forefront of energy and commodity markets and present this to colleagues.
Support sales teams with research and proposals.
Build account overviews and plans to support strategic sales teams.
Design data-driven models and templates for clients.
Create marketing materials for commercial culture initiatives and future graduate cohorts.
Getting involved in special project initiatives where determined necessary by management.

Requirements:

Ability to join a class of new hires in late February 2027
BSc or BA degree, or equivalent.
All applicants must have the right to work in Singapore
Fluent command of English is a prerequisite. Proficiency in additional ASEAN (Mandarin/Vietnamese/Thai) languages is highly desirable.
Strong presentation and communication skills. You must have good telephone manners and be comfortable presenting to large groups both in person and remotely.
Strong understanding and command of AI Capabilities.
Familiarity with or strong interest in learning about financial and commodity markets.
Good PC skills including the Microsoft Office product range.
Well versed in Excel
Ability to effectively multi-task and work independently.
Willingness to learn and take on a wide variety of tasks.

About S&P Global Energy
At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.

S&P Global Energy is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global enables businesses, governments, and individuals with trusted data, expertise, and technology to make decisions with conviction. We are Advancing Essential Intelligence through world-leading benchmarks, data, and insights that customers need in order to plan confidently, act decisively, and thrive economically in a rapidly changing global landscape. We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

title: Associate Product Manager - Wider Asia
description:
About the position

Aurora’s Software Solutions team is building the global investment analytics platform for the energy transition. It is a seamlessly integrated suite of software products allowing our users to value and benchmark any asset or portfolio, under any business model and market scenario, anywhere in the world. Widely adopted by leading energy companies and investors, the platform changes the way that energy market analytics is performed and delivered. We are currently looking for an entrepreneurial and quantitatively minded product manager for our software business in Wider Asia. Please note that this role is based in our Singapore office. Together with software leadership in Sydney, Melbourne and Oxford, you will own our Wider Asia software product strategy and drive its execution. You will understand the needs of our external and internal software customers and closely engage with our technical teams to design and deliver solutions.

Key responsibilities

You will play a key role in defining the vision and strategy for our software platform in the Wider Asia markets (Philippines, South Korea, Singapore, Malaysia) and contribute to our APAC strategy.

You will build and maintain the regional roadmap for all Wider Asia software products making key decisions on feature prioritisation in line with product vision and strategy.

You will own and manage a structured backlog of user needs and feature ideas.

You will define requirements for UI and modelling features of our Wider Asia software, and work with Aurora’s technical teams to design solutions meeting these requirements.

You will play a leading role in a cross-functional team of highly skilled software engineers, product managers, modellers, research and advisory analysts, commercial (sales) and client solutions representatives in continuous product delivery.

You will develop and manage client relationships, develop in-depth understanding of client requirements, and manage user feedback.

You will build relationships with software stakeholders across our offices in APAC and Oxford, fostering positive working culture and providing mentorship and development opportunities for the team.

What we are looking for

Required attributes:

Minimum 2-3 years of experience at a consultancy, energy company, software company, financial services company, or other knowledge-focused firm or institution

Good understanding of energy markets – you don’t need to have experience in energy, but you should demonstrate your knowledge of the sector

Proven track record of successfully managing large complex projects or products that require significant cross-functional coordination

Excellent communication and analytical skills (including quantitative analysis), and attention to detail

Results-driven, with a high degree of persistence in reaching goals and a hands-on approach to ensuring targets are achieved.

Desirable attributes:

Good understanding of power market models, and the life cycle and commercial arrangements of energy projects

Track record of building stakeholder relationships across functions and countries

A self-guided approach to investigating and solving technical problems

What we Offer

The opportunity to substantially influence major decisions in the energy sector

The opportunity to grow into a publicly visible industry expert

Private healthcare

Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.

Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects

title: Business Development Manager - Institutional Payments
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Business Development Manager to expand our institutional client base and develop strategic partnerships within the fintech and payments ecosystem.

The successful candidate will be responsible for acquiring institutional clients, identifying new business opportunities and building long-term commercial relationships with payment service providers, remittance companies, fintech platforms and other financial services organisations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Identify, prospect and acquire institutional clients, including payment service providers (PSPs), remittance companies, fintech platforms and other financial services organisations.

2. Develop new business opportunities and strategic partnerships in cross-border payments, international collections, payouts, foreign exchange and related payment services.

3. Build and maintain strong relationships with senior executives, business owners and key decision-makers across the financial services and payments ecosystem.

4. Lead the full business development cycle, from prospecting and qualification to solution discussions, commercial negotiations, onboarding coordination and activation.

5. Understand institutional clients' business models, payment flows, settlement requirements and operational needs to develop commercially viable solutions.

6. Collaborate with Product, Compliance, Legal and Operations teams to evaluate partnership opportunities, address client requirements and support successful execution.

7. Achieve business development and revenue targets, manage an active sales pipeline and identify opportunities to expand existing institutional relationships.

1. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics or a related discipline.

2. At least 3 years of experience in institutional sales, business development or strategic partnerships within fintech, payments, banking or financial services.

3. Good understanding of cross-border payments, payment processing, foreign exchange, settlement and the financial services ecosystem.

4. Proven ability to develop institutional relationships and negotiate complex B2B commercial opportunities; an established network in the payments or fintech industry is highly advantageous.

5. Fluent in both English and Chinese, written and spoken, with strong communication, presentation, relationship management and negotiation skills.

6. Self-driven, commercially minded and results-oriented, with the ability to independently develop and manage institutional business opportunities.

What We Offer

• Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

• Opportunities to build strategic partnerships across the international fintech and payments industry.

• A dynamic and collaborative environment with regional business exposure.

• Employee benefits in accordance with company policy.

ROECNY provides businesses and individuals in over 189 countries with seamless collection, transfer, spending, and ATM withdrawal services.

ROECNY's payment services offer 700+ payment methods to businesses in 50+ countries, supporting online payments in 150+ currencies and reaching end consumers in 200+ countries and regions worldwide.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Company Overview

Monex is a leading global financial solutions provider, offering a complete set of tools to support business growth and strategic financial operations.

We specialise in FX risk management and international payments, helping corporate and institutional clients design tailored FX solutions to navigate currency volatility with confidence. Our team of FX specialists implement well-considered currency strategies, offering dedicated support to help clients manage their payment needs – whether for goods, services, or direct investments.

In 2023, Monex facilitated $309 billion in FX turnover, managed $10.7 billion in assets, and processed 8.5 million transactions. With offices across North America (Canada, the US, and Mexico), Asia (Singapore), and Europe (the UK, Spain, and the Netherlands), we serve over 66,000 clients worldwide.

By combining global reach with deep local market expertise, Monex enhances businesses with a suite of financial solutions and FX market analysis to help optimise efficiency, mitigate currency risk, and protect margins in an increasingly complex financial landscape. Our corporate client experience is further enhanced by our dedicated sector expertise across a range of industries.

Department Overview

The Sales department is responsible for the strategic planning of overall business growth identifying opportunities with new Companies and Clients for all Monex currency products (FX Spot, Forwards, Options) as well as maintaining relationships with existing Companies and Clients, increasing their business revenue and cross collaborating with the Introducing Brokers (IB) department wherever possible.

Job Overview

FX Sales is responsible for the management of the Sales relationships with existing client accounts as well as prospecting new Clients and Accounts. They serve as the interface between Clients and the Dealing Team and work closely with Compliance and Risk to ensure adherence to regulatory guidelines.

The role holder requires knowledge of all MonFX’s products and the regulatory framework under which they must operates to successfully market these products to new and existing Clients, putting the Clients’ long-term interests first with fair and equitable outcomes for both the role holder and the firm.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

Sales Responsibilities (mainly Singapore and Asia Pacific)

Conduct research to identify and target potential clients to generate new business opportunities.

Conduct high volume outbound sales calls.

Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers, stakeholders, and potential clients through networking, cold calling, email outreach, and other methods.

Along with Senior Account Manager, present and promote the company's foreign exchange products and services to potential clients, emphasizing their unique value propositions and benefits.

Collaborate with internal teams, including sales, marketing, and research, to develop and execute comprehensive sales strategies and initiatives.

Monitor market conditions, competitor activities, and regulatory changes to identify potential risks and opportunities within the foreign exchange industry.

Provide regular sales reports and updates to management, including pipeline analysis, revenue forecasts, and progress towards sales targets.

Continuously update knowledge of the foreign exchange market, industry best practices, and emerging trends to effectively position our company in the market.

Maintaining current market knowledge (e.g. reading Financial press, attending webinars etc.);

Maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast;

Meeting set Sales targets/KPI’s on a weekly/monthly/quarterly/annual basis;

Keeping accurate records and client interaction notes in the Company database FXDB (in line with PIPEDA requirements).

Required to diligently assess the needs and expectations of clients they bring onboard.

Must ensure thorough research and analysis of client requirements to guarantee optimal service provision and customer satisfaction.

Obligated to verify the authenticity and legitimacy of clients they bring onboard, safeguarding against the inclusion of false or fraudulent individuals or entities in the company’s clientele.

Operational & Compliance Responsibilities

Adhere to all internal sales processes, remuneration policies, and risk management frameworks

Ensure compliance with key regulatory policies including Treating Customers Fairly (TCF), pricing, and conduct standards

Identify and escalate any conduct or compliance risks appropriately

Risk, Technology & Data

Participate in regular sales audits and risk assessments

Ensure all client data is handled in compliance with PDPA, GDPR and internal data protection policies

Required Skills and Qualifications

Proven track record in B2B sales, ideally within financial services or FX

Strong ability to generate new business and close deals

Experience managing client relationships and delivering high-quality service

Commercially driven with strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities

Ability to operate in a fast-paced, target-driven environment

Additional Qualifications

Diploma / Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification

Experience working within a regulated financial institution is highly desirable

Proven track record of operating within a commercial sales environment

Ability to clearly articulate full understanding of end-to-end sales processes

Strong sales techniques (Negotiation, influencing and closing skills)

Good knowledge of FX products is a plus

Excellent all-round communication skills, strong judgement and problem-solving skills

Results driven, self-motivated and takes initiative

Experience using CRM systems and sales tools

title: Monetization Enablement Partner - GBS
description:
Marketing & Communications

Monetization Enablement Partner - GBS

Location :

Singapore

Employment Type :

Regular

Job Code :

A161849

Responsibilities

The Global Business Marketing (GBM) team champions TikTok in the B2B landscape, showing advertisers and sales teams how TikTok's creative ecosystem drives real business results. We build the stories, education, and go-to-market programs that sellers use to deepen client relationships across markets. Working with brands of all sizes, we also bring campaigns to life through creative ideation, brand and event strategy, and the design and production of TikTok for Business marketing, so advertisers can create content that connect with audiences. Trends, consumer behavior, and advertising formats all move quickly on TikTok. The challenge is turning what makes the platform engaging into solutions that are creative, measurable, and scalable across very different markets, without making the experience feel like traditional advertising. You will shape how the market understands TikTok as a business platform, and help brands show up authentically on it. The Monetization Enablement Partner is an individual contributor role focused on building product capability, seller readiness, scaled enablement, and adoption for the GBS sales organization. You will help translate priority products, roadmap changes, and market-facing product narratives into enablement that sellers can understand, practice, and use in customer conversations. At its core, your work will help Monetization Enablement close the gap between knowing a product and confidently selling it. Operating between Product, Product Marketing, Go-to-Market, regional enablement, and Sales, you will turn complex product information into global-ready learning, activation moments, reusable assets, and feedback loops that support consistent execution across markets. This role is intentionally designed as a flexible profile that can sit wherever the team needs additional capacity. The core expectation stays consistent: product fluency, comfort with product and Product Marketing partners, strong enablement craft, and the ability to turn product knowledge into seller readiness at scale. This function will evolve alongside business needs, focusing primarily on: - Product Knowledge Translation: Turning complex product information into practical seller-facing guidance, learning moments, and product walkthroughs. - Global Product Readiness & Activation: Supporting product trainings, deep dives, hands-on activations, and walkthroughs tied to quarterly priority product launches. - Adoption Feedback & Program Improvement: Capturing seller and regional signal to improve future programs and strengthen the connection between enablement, readiness, and adoption. - AI-Enabled Scale: Using AI to improve content workflows, product knowledge management, facilitator support, and reusable enablement assets. - Product Capability & Field Readiness - Serve as a product capability partner across Monetization Enablement, bringing product depth and validation into enablement tied to quarterly product priorities, deep dives, hands-on activations, and product walkthroughs. - Translate complex product capabilities, roadmap changes, and market-facing product narratives into accessible enablement content, learning moments, and field-ready messaging. - Support the design of product trainings and scaled learning moments by making product nuance, use cases, and seller applicability clear. - Synthesize product complexity into simple learning structures that can be delivered consistently by regional POCs across markets. - Activation Design & Seller Adoption - Design repeatable activation formats, hands-on learning experiences, and facilitation guides that regional POCs can adapt and run in their markets. - Help sellers move from product awareness into confidence, usage, and practical customer conversations. - Support product labs, dogfooding, walkthroughs, and other high-impact learning moments tied to priority products. - Help connect activation moments to seller behavior, product adoption, and business outcomes. - Cross-Functional Partnership & Regional Execution - Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Go-to-Market, regional enablement, and Sales stakeholders to ensure programs are accurate, relevant, and tied to real seller needs. - Work closely with regional POCs to improve the quality of execution and ensure global programs are practical, engaging, and regionally relevant. - Capture and synthesize signal from field activations, dogfooding, and regional execution to improve future program design. - Partner with the broader Monetization Enablement team to ensure assigned work aligns with launch timing, readiness needs, and adoption goals. - Scaled Systems & AI Workflows - Help build repeatable frameworks and AI-enabled workflows that make product learning assets easier to create, update, and scale. - Use AI tools to support learning design, content development, knowledge management, facilitator support, and scaled execution. - Help track program success, especially where product understanding, seller confidence, and product adoption need to be connected more clearly. - Operate effectively in an environment that moves quickly, changes rapidly, and values clear thinking, follow-through, and hands-on execution.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications - Experience: Relevant experience in product marketing, product management, product enablement, go-to-market strategy, sales enablement, field activation, learning design, or a closely related field. - Product Translation: Demonstrated ability to translate complex product information into clear, compelling, and practical field-facing content or learning experiences. - Activation Design: Experience supporting product adoption, seller engagement, or commercial outcomes through activations, deep dives, workshops, walkthroughs, or live learning programs. - Stakeholder Partnership: Ability to partner credibly with Product, Product Marketing, Go-to-Market, Sales, and regional stakeholders. - Scaled Enablement: Experience building or supporting enablement programs, reusable frameworks, or learning assets in a fast-moving environment. - AI Comfort: Genuine excitement about AI, with comfort applying AI tools to program design, content development, learning workflows, knowledge management, or scaled execution. - Communication: Clear communication, synthesis, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications - Experience in digital advertising, monetization, commerce, SaaS, or another product-driven business. - Experience supporting product launches, scaled learning programs, or field-facing product readiness efforts across multiple markets. - Experience connecting learning and activation programs to measurable adoption, usage, confidence, or commercial outcomes. - Curiosity and practical ideas for how AI can improve product knowledge systems, enablement design, and learning scale. - Comfort operating in ambiguity and helping build a new capability model while the organization evolves.

Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo. ​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day. ​

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. ​

​

Diversity & Inclusion ​

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

title: Sales Director, Scale
description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Braze is seeking an experienced Commercial Sales Director to drive our mid-market business across Asia. This is a GTM leadership role responsible for driving the next phase of growth, performance acceleration, and operational excellence across a diverse, multi-market region.

You will lead a team of Commercial Account Executives focused on delivering high-value engagements for Braze's market-leading Customer Engagement platform. This role requires a leader who combines strong commercial instincts with disciplined execution, deal strategy expertise, and a passion for developing high-performing teams.

The ideal candidate brings at least 5 years of deep experience leading Commercial sales teams in high-growth, competitive environments across Asia. You have successfully scaled performance, strengthened operating rigor, and driven measurable acceleration in complex markets. You understand the nuances of selling into Southeast Asia and the Greater China region, and you are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders across industries.

This role requires urgency, accountability, and a commitment to raising the bar, while building an inclusive, high-performance culture across diverse markets.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Build, lead, and elevate a high-performing team of Commercial Account Executives across Asia
Establish operational rigor and drive execution against ambitious Financial Year revenue objectives, accelerating both net-new acquisition and expansion within strategic accounts
Strengthen enterprise deal strategy, including multi-threading, executive engagement, and value-based selling in complex environments
Coach with intensity and purpose, raising performance standards while developing future leaders within the organization
Collaborate with Go-to-Market teams including SolCon, BDR, Marketing, Partnerships and Executives to ensure the successful execution of the FY plan and represent a clear, single vision to customers and the marketplace
Represent Braze in customer, partner, and industry forums as a trusted enterprise advisor
Plan and manage at both the strategic and operational levels
Be a proactive voice within our APAC and global sales leadership team

WHAT YOU HAVE

5+ years of experience successfully leading quota-carrying Commercial Account Executives in a high-growth SaaS environment
A proven track record of exceeding revenue goals and driving measurable performance improvement across teams
Demonstrated experience leading diverse, multi-cultural team across multiple Asian markets
Expertise in complex sales cycles, including large deal negotiation, executive alignment, and long-term account expansion
A strong track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing sales people
A proven ability to build connections with Executives, industry subject matter experts and various customer profiles
Experience collaborating cross-functionally across regional and global stakeholders
Strong commercial negotiation skills and executive presence
Prior experience in Marketing Technology or related enterprise SaaS categories is highly preferred

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

Competitive compensation that may include equity
Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
Flexible paid time off
Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

title: Principal Manager, SkillsFuture Credit (IMD)
description:
Incentives Management Division (IMD) is part of SWDA’s Incentives Management and Enforcement Group (IMEG) which contributes to pan-organisational efforts of building an effective, responsive and inclusive CET eco-system through effective grant management, Skills Development Levy (SDL) collection, and enforcement against fraud and abuse. IMD administers training grants, training allowance and SkillsFuture Credits (Enterprise and Individual) to contribute towards the development of a responsive and high-quality CET ecosystem

What you will be working on

As a Principal Manager, you are a Team Leader supervising a team of Managers. You report to the Assistant Director and are responsible for the operations management of SWDA’s programmes such as SkillsFuture Credits and other funding programmes.

Responsibilities and Competencies:

Policy-Operations-Technology Integration

• Strategic System Alignment: Ensure operational processes are supported by technology systems and aligned with SWDA’s funding policies and strategic intent

• Operational Policy Development: Formulate and review operational policies to support programme implementation and grants management, translating policy directives into operational guides

• Continuous Improvement Management: Implement systematic refinements to enhance operational effectiveness while maintaining compliance and quality standards.

User Experience and Customer Service Mindset

• Customer Journey Design: Develop comprehensive end-to-end customer interaction points (offline and online); identifying service gaps and value-creation opportunities.

• Process Streamlining and Appeals Management: Streamline customer management processes and appeal processes; manage escalated enquiries and audit queries on post training activities, grant administration and disbursement process.

• Service Standards Implementation: Implement robust service standards and monitor performance of the process to ensure alignment with service framework.

Partnership and Vendor Management

• Strategic Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders and service providers to facilitate delivery of shared services.

• System Development Coordination: Coordinate with internal divisions and service providers to manage system development, change requests, problem resolution, including validating requirements and testing.

• Vendor Performance Management: Develop workflows and work instructions for outsourced providers to implement the programmes; monitors service provider performance in operational delivery and customer service.

Performance Monitoring and Reporting

• Performance Analytics and Reporting: Monitor, track and report programme performance including Service Level Agreements indicators and Key Performance indicators, translating metrics into actionable insights for management.

• Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Identify areas of risks, devise mitigating measures, and establishes control measures to ensure operations align with intended policy parameters.

• People Management

• Nurtures and provide guidance to team members and develops their leadership and functional capabilities through mentoring and coaching.

What we are looking for

You are passionate about solving customer issues, detail-oriented with key strengths in operations management and work processes. You are a people person and is committed to nurture, develop and give guidance to your team members.

• Possess the required competencies to execute the job duties proficiently

• At least 7 years of relevant work experience in operations, programme or project management.

• Strong people management skill, with at least 3 years in a supervisory role

• Strong customer service attitude

• Strong in analysis, communication (both verbal and written), interpersonal, process and project management skills

• Able to multi-task, work independently and perform well under pressure and tight timelines

Note: This is a team lead role.

Successful candidates will be offered a contract in the first instance and may be considered for an extension or be placed on a permanent tenure.

Candidates are encouraged to sign up for a Careers &Skills Passport (CSP) account and include your CSP public profile in your resume. Please check out www.myskillsfuture.gov.sg for details on the CSP.

About Skills and Workforce Development Agency

The Skills and Workforce Development Agency (SWDA) drives lifelong learning and workforce development to enable Singaporeans to take charge of their careers, learn for life, access good jobs, and grow in fulfilling careers. We enable employers to build a skilled, future-ready workforce, design quality jobs, and adopt skills recognition practices. Together with our partners, we build a trusted, high-quality, industry-relevant, and innovative ecosystem that meets the evolving workforce needs of both businesses and workers. For more information, please visit www.swda.gov.sg.

description:
Partner Account Manager

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

Job Family Definition:

Serves as a trusted adviser to the Partner and develops a mutually beneficial relationship in alignment with HPE business priorities. Drives end-to-end revenue, HPE profitability, and pipeline through joint business plans and data-driven sales efforts. Articulates both HPE global and local business strategies to effectively “sell with”, “sell to”, and “sell through” the Partner, creating a scalable selling ecosystem. Develops knowledge of Partner priorities, industry trends, IT landscape, IT investment strategy, HPE priorities, and HPE Technology to differentiate HPE from competitors. Coordinates and executes HPE activities with the Partner, leveraging HPE specialists when needed. Aligns field sales to drive increased value to HPE for pipeline and revenue/profit growth while leveraging the collective strength of the partner ecosystem. Leads HPE strategy, programs, and systems with and on behalf of the Partner to assure accelerated financial outcomes and build partner loyalty to HPE. These jobs focus on selling to customers through the Partner as an extension of HPE's salesforce, typically through work that occurs outside HPE offices.

Management Level Definition:

Applies intermediate level of subject matter knowledge to solve a variety of common business issues. Works on problems of moderately complex scope. Acts as an informed team member providing analysis of information and limited project direction input. Exercises independent judgment within defined practices and procedures to determine appropriate action. Follows established guidelines and interprets policies. Evaluates unique circumstances and makes recommendations.

Responsibilities:

Provides resources and guidance to the Partner (e.g. Value Added Reseller (VAR), Distributor, SI, ISV, Managed Service Provider) on where to play within emerging trends in Partner's ecosystem in alignment with HPE business priorities. Works with the Partner to create a mutually beneficial plan for the future.
Drives end-to end HPE revenue, profitability, and pipeline by implementing joint business plans and data-driven sales efforts with the Partner.
Articulates both HPE global and local business strategies to effectively "sell with," "sell to," and "sell through" the Partner, creating a scalable selling ecosystem.
Develops knowledge of partner priorities, industry trends, IT landscape, IT investment strategy, HPE priorities, and HPE Technology and communicates value of the portfolios and solutions to better differentiate HPE from competitors.
Demonstrates business and sales leadership by building mutually beneficial relationships with one or many Partners to grow HPE market share.
Coordinates HPE activities with the Partner, leveraging HPE specialists when needed, including sales cadence, education, marketing, executive briefings, proactive forecasting, business planning, and client engagements. Drives HPE marketing strategy through the customer.
Enacts day-to-day HPE strategy, programs, and systems with and on behalf of the Partner to assure accelerated financial outcomes and build partner loyalty to HPE.
Tailors selling solutions to fit the needs of the partner's customer profile including HPE products, services and technology alliances to achieve assigned quota.
May recruit and develop business relationships with new partners, working to increase partner commitment to HPE.
May spend time monitoring Partner sales floor to help develop pipeline.
Works to ensure that partners are aware of, and compliant with, HPE's SBC requirements for Partners, including applicable legal obligations.

Education and Experience:

University or Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent experience.
Typically 2-5+ years of selling experience.
Experience developing positive relationships and solving customer problems.

Knowledge and Skills:

Technology Acumen: Awareness of current technology trends and related HPE strategy and ability to articulate same to Partner.
Sales Acumen: Able to influence the partner to take actions that create increased value to HPE. Effectively exercises selling skills such as identifying potential opportunities, utilizing appropriate sales platforms and resources, and formulating and proposing solutions with the goal of expanding HPE's business. Acts with a sense of urgency to build strong customer relationships and drive solutions for the partner.
Account Management: Understanding of business and financial fundamentals to develop strategic plans with the partner that are aligned to customer and HPE strategies, creating increased business opportunities and value for HPE.
Portfolio Knowledge: Understanding of HPE products and how they can deliver value to customers in contrast to HPE's competitors. Ability to select the best product for the customer's needs, maximizing value for both the customer and HPE.
Partner Industry Acumen: Understanding of Partner industry, trends, competitors, and the channel.
Partnering Acumen: Builds understanding of and relationships with partner and internal community among all types and levels of the business, integrating sales engagement efforts. Understanding of the Partner's relationships and needs.
Financial Acumen: Understanding of financial accounting concepts such as income statements, balance sheets, revenue projections, etc. to assess customer financial health, identify potential risks, and position value propositions of HPE solutions.
Sales Forecasting: Ability to look forward and anticipate partner needs, proactively forecasting sales quota and effectively bridging sales gaps.
Communication: Professional, clear, and effective verbal and written communication.
Time Management: Ability to prioritize and effectively meet deadlines.
Creativity and Entrepreneurship: Ability to innovate, think beyond proscribed solutions, and take proactive steps to advance HPE sales efforts.

Impact/Scope:

Handles accounts with low to mid-levels of annual revenue.
Primary focus for partner sales on SMB segment.
Typically assigned average size quota.

Complexity:

Local and Country accounts.
Focus on partners with low to mid-levels of HPE specialization and commitment.

description:

This role serves as a Cybersecurity Evangelist, possessing a comprehensive understanding of the security landscape, architectural models, and the ability to assess and position security capabilities for generative AI and agentic AI and cutting-edge solutions. The Pre-Sales Consultant will engage with both C-level stakeholders and technical teams to deliver impactful solutions and act as a trusted advisor.

What will you do?

Pre-Sales Support and Solution Design

Client Engagement and Consulting

• Build and maintain professional relationships with clients through regular communication, on-site meetings, and executive briefings.

• Engage with C-level executives to identify and address domain-specific cybersecurity needs.

• Deliver proactive technical guidance to clients to drive cybersecurity operational excellence.

• Influence clients' cybersecurity postures by contributing to in-flight projects and leading innovation initiatives.

Expertise Development and Industry Awareness

• Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity technologies, regulatory frameworks, and industry trends.

• Support ongoing client requirements related to regulatory compliance (e.g., IM8, AIAS, CSA Security by Design, MAS TRM).

• Participate in trade shows and conferences as a senior technical resource

• Act as a subject matter expert (SME) in cyber security solutions and technologies.

Securing AI systems

• Understand enterprise AI architectures—including LLMs, RAG, vector databases, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, and MCP integrations—and assess risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, insecure outputs, excessive agency, tool misuse, retrieval poisoning, and supply chain compromise.

• Design AI security controls spanning gateways, runtime protection, model scanning, posture management, and monitoring; enforce least privilege across agent identities, tools, and downstream systems through scoped authorisation, tool allowlists, sandboxing, human approvals, audit trails, and emergency shutdown mechanisms.

The ideal candidate should possess:

• Extensive experience (5+ years) as a Security Presales Consultant

• Presales experience in designing and architecting comprehensive cybersecurity solutions that involve at least two or more cybersecurity domains, such as:

• Application Security

• Database Security

• Regulatory Compliance

• Identity and Access Management

• Privileged Access Management

• Cloud Security

• Endpoint Security

• Incident Response and Managed Security Services

• Infrastructure and Network Security

• DevSecOps

• Zero Trust Security

• Experience in designing and architecting comprehensive cybersecurity solutions, including Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity and Access Management (IAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Data Access Management (DAM), Secure Service Edge (SSE), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Endpoint Security, and Network Security, ensuring robust protection against evolving threats.

• Familiarity with cloud-based solutions (Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) and best practices for security, resilience, and recovery.

• Solid understanding of security protocols, cryptography, PKI, and authentication/authorization frameworks.

• Experience implementing SIEM/SOAR tools and conducting database configurations and basic queries.

• Ability to translate complex security solutions into business value propositions

• Knowledge of WAN, IoT/Video, Kubernetes, and containerized applications is advantageous.

• Previous experience with government tenders and Governance, Risk Management, and Compliance (GRC).

• Experience working with security practitioners, network, application, and database operations personnel.

• Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.

• Professional certifications (e.g., CISA, CISM, CISSP, GCIA) are highly desirable.

• Experience working in client-serving/project-based models

title: HEAD OF SALES, ASIA
description:
About Intellect

Intellect is the global leader in mental health benefits, trusted by the world’s most forward-thinking employers, insurers, and governments to deliver care that is local, personalised, and effective at scale. Today, we serve over 4 million people across 100 countries and languages, making mental health support truly accessible across borders and cultures.

Our platform powers the mental wellbeing of workforces at hundreds of Fortune 500 and major companies, enabling them to support their people with the highest standards of clinical quality, cultural relevance, and on-demand accessibility.

Driven by our mission to build the world’s most trusted mental health benefits platform, Intellect combines a best-in-class digital platform with a world-leading global provider network to deliver unmatched client outcomes and transformative care experiences.

We are backed by top global investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, Insignia Ventures Partners, HOF Capital, K3 Ventures, JAFCO, Headline, East Ventures, IHH Healthcare, MS&AD Ventures, and more, alongside an extensive coalition of notable family offices, big tech executives, and leading angel investors.

The Role

The Director of Sales, Asia will drive Intellect’s enterprise sales growth across our core Asian markets through direct sales and strategic alliances.

This is a hands-on leadership role with accountability for regional sales performance and an individual new business revenue target. You will lead and develop a team of Account Executives and SDRs while personally originating, owning and closing a focused portfolio of strategic enterprise opportunities.

We are looking for a strong enterprise seller and people leader who understands how to win complex deals, lead competitive RFPs and build trusted relationships with C-suite decision-makers. You should be equally comfortable setting market priorities, coaching a salesperson, leading an executive presentation and negotiating a contract.

You will work closely with Marketing, Revenue Operations and Partnerships to shape our sales go-to-market strategy, strengthen commercial discipline and build repeatable routes to growth. You will also partner with Clinical, Operations, Product and Finance to ensure our proposals deliver value for customers and are commercially sustainable.

Your Responsibilities

1. Revenue Ownership & Enterprise Selling

Own regional new business sales performance, translating revenue targets into clear market priorities, account plans and execution.

Carry an individual new business revenue target and personally own a focused portfolio of strategic deals through the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation, contracting and close.

Build qualified pipeline through targeted outreach, executive networks, referrals and partner channels, alongside Marketing and SDR-led activity.

Navigate complex buying groups, uncover customer priorities, develop compelling business cases and secure access to economic buyers and executive sponsors.

Build and deepen relationships with CHROs, Chief People Officers, Total Rewards and Benefits leaders, and other senior stakeholders involved in enterprise buying decisions.

2. Sales Team Leadership & Development

Lead, coach and develop Account Executives and SDRs, setting clear expectations for pipeline creation, opportunity progression and revenue delivery.

Run effective pipeline reviews, deal reviews and individual coaching, identifying performance gaps early and taking action to address them.

Develop the team’s capabilities in discovery, stakeholder mapping, multithreading, value articulation, executive engagement and negotiation.

Establish clear account and territory ownership; help shape hiring, team structure and incentives as the business scales.

Build a culture of accountability, collaboration and high performance through direct feedback, recognition and timely performance management.

3. RFP Leadership & Complex Deal Strategy

Lead priority enterprise RFPs and tenders end to end, including bid qualification, go/no-go decisions, win strategy, proposal development, presentations and commercial negotiations.

Build each bid strategy around the customer’s priorities, evaluation criteria, competitive landscape and Intellect’s differentiated value.

Coordinate solution specialists and cross-functional contributors to deliver accurate, compelling proposals on time, with clear ownership of deliverables.

Lead customer engagement throughout the process, navigating procurement requirements and aligning stakeholders around the proposed solution.

Use win/loss reviews to improve bid selection, sales execution, proposals and competitive positioning.

4. Go-to-Market Strategy & Marketing Collaboration

Shape and execute the sales go-to-market strategy across Asia, prioritising markets, industries, customer segments and direct versus partner-led routes.

Partner with Marketing on target account selection, account-based campaigns, events and demand generation, with shared focus on qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes.

Establish clear lead handovers and follow-up standards, using conversion data and sales feedback to improve lead quality and campaign effectiveness.

Work with Marketing and Product to sharpen enterprise positioning, value propositions and sales narratives based on customer insights and competitive intelligence.

Translate market feedback into practical recommendations on offerings, packaging and growth opportunities.

5. Alliances & Ecosystem-Led Growth

Work with the Partnerships team to turn broker, insurer and other strategic relationships into qualified enterprise pipeline and revenue.

Develop joint account plans and sales initiatives that improve access to priority customers and markets.

Lead sales execution for agreed alliance-led opportunities, coordinating partner introductions, joint pitches and negotiations.

Establish clear opportunity ownership and handovers with Partnerships, aligning direct and partner-led activity to avoid channel conflict.

Evaluate alliance-led sales activity through pipeline quality, conversion and revenue contribution.

6. Revenue Operations & Commercial Discipline

Partner with Revenue Operations to strengthen the foundations for scale: CRM standards, pipeline stages, qualification criteria, forecasting, account planning and performance reporting.

Own adoption of these standards within Sales, maintaining accurate opportunity data, realistic forecasts and clear next steps.

Use pipeline coverage, conversion, sales cycle and productivity data to identify bottlenecks and improve performance; build repeatable playbooks across priority segments.

Help shape pricing, packaging and deal structures with Finance and relevant teams, balancing customer value, competitiveness, delivery requirements and sustainable margins.

Lead deal negotiations within agreed approval frameworks and ensure effective handovers to Client Success and Operations, with clear customer commitments and ownership of follow-on opportunities.

Requirements

Proven Enterprise Sales Leader

You have a track record of delivering B2B new business growth and leading sales teams against clear revenue targets. You have personally originated and closed complex enterprise deals and can explain your contribution to those wins.

Hands-On Player-Coach

You enjoy leading a team while continuing to own and close your own opportunities. You can balance personal selling with coaching, delegate effectively and step into team deals without creating confusion over ownership.

Experienced RFP Leader

You have led and won competitive enterprise RFPs or tenders. You bring sound judgment on which bids to pursue, how to differentiate a proposal and how to coordinate teams through demanding timelines and commercial negotiations.

Strong Enterprise Seller & Executive Relationship Builder

You understand long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, from discovery and business case development through procurement, legal review and contracting. You can engage credibly with C-suite leaders, develop executive sponsors and build new relationships through outreach, networks and partner introductions.

Disciplined Sales Operator

You understand pipeline generation, qualification, forecasting, territory planning, sales methodologies and performance management. You use data to improve decisions and execution, supported by sound judgment and a close understanding of your customers.

Commercially Strategic & Collaborative

You bring strong judgment on market priorities, pricing, positioning and deal economics. You work effectively with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Partnerships and delivery teams, aligning different perspectives around clear commercial outcomes.

Experienced Across Asian Markets

You have meaningful experience in Asian enterprise markets and understand differences in buying behaviour, procurement practices and market maturity. Experience across Singapore and other major Asian markets is strongly preferred.

Experience in enterprise SaaS, HR technology, employee benefits, healthcare, insurance, professional services or another complex B2B category is advantageous. Direct mental healthcare experience is not required.

Builder Mindset & Mission Alignment

You are comfortable in a growing business where processes continue to evolve. You bring structure, take ownership and adapt as you learn. You are motivated by expanding access to quality mental healthcare while building a commercially sustainable business.

What Success Looks Like

Delivery against regional and individual new business revenue targets.

A healthy enterprise pipeline, stronger conversion and reliable forecasting.

Strategic enterprise and RFP wins on commercially sound terms.

A capable, accountable sales team with improving productivity and performance.

Measurable pipeline and revenue from alliance-led sales.

Repeatable sales practices and effective collaboration across the teams supporting growth.

We're building an entirely new way for modern organisations to easily provide support for their employees’ mental health & mental wellbeing, no matter where they are on their journey.

Join us on our mission to eliminate barriers to mental health and to create a wellbeing approach that people love using.

title: Assistant Manager, Bids and Business Development
description:
Part of SJ Group, Prostruct is a specialist consultancy for Protective Technology and Civil & Structural Engineering. Established in 2012, we have grown to be one of Singapore’s leading blast consulting firms. We offer integrated and customised solutions for protecting buildings and infrastructure against blast and other effects, therefore designing for the safe storage across multiple industries.

Based in our SJ Campus at 38 Cleantech Loop, we are looking an Assistant Manager for Bids and Business Development to support the growth and effective delivery of our Prostruct security and engineering consultancy.

The role develops opportunities across security, protective design, infrastructure, buildings, and mission-critical facilities; coordinates technical proposals and client engagement; and supports project mobilisation, commercial administration, and business operations.

Key Responsibilities:

• Market and opportunity development: Research public- and private-sector opportunities in security consultancy, protective design and engineering for infrastructure, buildings, data centres, and other mission-critical facilities; identify decision-makers and maintain a qualified pipeline.

• Client and stakeholder engagement: Follow-ups with developers, asset owners, government agencies, architects, engineers, contractors, and strategic partners.

• Proposals and tenders: Manage expressions of interest, prequalifications, quotations, fee proposals, and tender submissions; coordinate technical inputs, project references, CVs, compliance schedules, approvals, and deadlines.

• Service positioning: Support the preparation of marketing materials and case studies for services such as security risk assessment, security-by-design, blast and protective security engineering, threat and vulnerability assessment, security systems planning, and multidisciplinary engineering consultancy.

• Commercial administration: Assist with fee build-ups, subconsultant quotations, contractual documentation, revenue forecasting, and work-in-progress monitoring.

• Project mobilisation and operations: Project setup, resource schedules, deliverable registers, document control, subconsultants, and internal kick-off activities.

• Resource and delivery support: Work with technical leads and project managers to monitor workload, programme, deliverables, risks, changes, and actions, escalating issues where necessary.

• Business systems and reporting: Maintain accurate customer relationship management, tender, project, and commercial records; prepare reports on pipeline, order intake, hit rate, revenue, utilisation, project status, and outstanding actions.

• Governance and confidentiality: Support compliance with company procedures, client security requirements, tender conditions, contractual obligations, quality management processes,

and the secure handling of sensitive project information.

• Process improvement: Develop templates, trackers, standard operating procedures, and knowledge resources that improve proposal quality, project administration, collaboration, and operational efficiency.

Job Requirements:

• Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, Security Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.

• Two to four years of relevant experience in business development, bid coordination, consultancy operations, project administration, or professional services; experience in an engineering, construction, infrastructure, built-environment, or security consultancy is preferred.

• Working understanding of the consultancy business cycle, including lead identification, prequalification, proposal development, appointment, project mobilisation, delivery, invoicing, and close-out.

• Ability to coordinate multidisciplinary technical submissions, interpret tender requirements, manage compliance schedules, and obtain timely inputs from security specialists, engineers, and project teams.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare accurate proposals, capability statements, presentations, correspondence, reports, and meeting records.

• Commercial awareness and confidence working with consultancy fees, budgets, contracts, subconsultant costs, variations, invoices, revenue forecasts, and performance data.

title: Business Development Executive (Consumer (FMCG))

ROLEOVERVIEW

The Business Development Executive will be responsible for expanding market share, developing new distribution channels and growing the company's consumer goods business.

The role focuses on identifying business opportunities, establishing and managing retail, wholesale and e-commerce partnerships, and improving sales performance across existing customer accounts.

The position may cover consumer goods categories such as fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), consumer electronics, apparel, cosmetics, fashion and related products, depending on the company's business requirements.

KEYRESPONSIBILITIES

1.Business Development and Channel Expansion

+ Identify, develop and secure new business opportunities across retail, wholesale, distribution and other relevant sales channels.

+ Establish and maintain professional relationships with distributors, retailers, supermarkets, wholesalers and traditional trade partners.

+ Evaluate potential business partners and distribution opportunities based on market potential, commercial viability and business objectives.

+ Develop and implement business development plans to increase market coverage, sales revenue and distribution reach.

2.E-commerce and Digital Channel Development

+ Identify and develop partnerships with online marketplaces, e-commerce platforms, quick-commerce providers and other relevant digital sales channels.

+ Support the development and implementation of channel-specific sales strategies and promotional initiatives.

+ Monitor online sales performance and recommend improvements to product visibility, customer engagement and conversion.

3. Key Account Management

+ Build and maintain professional relationships with existing and prospective customers, including distributors, retail buyers, category managers and commercial partners.

+ Negotiate commercial terms, product listings, promotional arrangements and other business agreements within the company's approved policies and authority limits.

+ Monitor account performance, identify opportunities for account growth and address customer concerns in collaboration with relevant internal teams.

4.Sales and Marketing Coordination

+ Work with marketing and other relevant teams to plan and execute trade promotions, merchandising initiatives, product launches and in-store activities.

+ Coordinate promotional calendars, product displays and channel-specific marketing activities with business partners.

+ Review campaign results and recommend improvements based on sales performance and commercial objectives.

5.Sales Forecasting and Performance Analysis

+ Monitor sales performance, customer orders, inventory levels and product movement to support demand forecasting and inventory planning.

+ Analyse relevant sales data, market developments and consumer purchasing trends to identify business opportunities and potential risks.

+ Prepare sales forecasts, pipeline updates and regular performance reports.

+ Recommend appropriate actions to improve sales growth, product availability and inventory turnover.

6.Market Research and Business Development Planning

+ Monitor industry developments, competitor activities, distribution trends and changing consumer demand.

+ Identify potential customer segments, product categories and distribution channels for business expansion.

+ Provide market insights and recommendations to support commercial planning and decision-making.

QUALIFICATION,SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Relevant Experience

+ Experience in sales, business development, account management, channel development or a related commercial role.

+ Experience in FMCG, consumer goods, consumer electronics, apparel, cosmetics, fashion, wholesale distribution, retail or e-commerce would be relevant to the role.

+ Candidates with transferable experience in related industries may also be considered based on the relevance of their skills, knowledge and achievements.

Market and Commercial Knowledge

+ Understanding of retail or wholesale distribution channels, customer account management, sales processes and commercial negotiations.

+ Familiarity with trade promotions, product listings, distribution arrangements and sales performance analysis would be advantageous.

+ Knowledge of consumer purchasing trends and market dynamics relevant to the products and channels managed.

Negotiation and Relationship Management

+ Ability to develop business relationships, identify customer needs and negotiate commercial arrangements.

+ Ability to communicate effectively with customers, distributors and internal stakeholders.

+ Strong commercial awareness, problem-solving skills and customer relationship management capabilities.

Analytical and Organisational Skills

+ Ability to interpret sales data, monitor business performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

+ Good planning, coordination and organisational skills.

+ Proficiency in relevant sales reporting tools, spreadsheets or customer relationship management systems would be advantageous.

Education

+ A bachelor's degree or equivalent professional qualification in Business, Marketing, Sales or a related discipline.

+ Candidates with other relevant qualifications and demonstrable experience may also be considered based on their ability to perform the role.
