title: Senior Director- Customer Success Management
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

Skills and Competencies

12+ years of experience in banking, financial services, or enterprise technology, with at least 5 years in strategic account management, customer success leadership, or senior client-facing roles
Proven track record of managing and growing complex, high-value enterprise accounts ($5M+ ARR)
Deep understanding of the banking industry including regulation, origination, risk management, and lending practices
Demonstrated ability to build and sustain C-level and senior executive relationships across client organizations
Experience developing and executing multi-year strategic account plans with measurable growth outcomes
Strong executive presence with excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
Ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence without direct authority in a matrixed organization
Willingness to travel approximately 30–40% within the APAC for client and executive meetings
Deep expertise in artificial intelligence, with a track record of implementing advanced AI solutions to drive strategic transformation and operational efficiency. Strong experience using AI tools to lead innovation initiatives. Demonstrated leadership in managing AI-related risks, ensuring ethical governance, and fostering a culture of responsible AI adoption across the organization

Education

Bachelor's degree required
MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Business, or a related field preferred

Responsibilities

The Senior Director, Customer Success Management serves as a senior strategic leader responsible for owning Moody's most critical banking client relationships and driving long-term account growth across a portfolio of high-value strategic accounts.

Serve as the primary executive sponsor and strategic point of contact for a portfolio of Moody's highest-value banking clients
Develop and execute comprehensive multi-year account plans with measurable growth targets, engagement milestones, and risk mitigation strategies
Drive account revenue growth through identification of upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities while proactively identifying and mitigating churn risk
Design and orchestrate Executive Business Reviews with senior client stakeholders, presenting strategic insights and forward-looking roadmaps
Partner with clients to define transformation roadmaps that leverage Moody's Risk, Finance, and Lending solutions, acting as a trusted strategic advisor who elevates conversations from product features to business outcomes
Lead and mobilize cross-functional account teams — including Sales, Product, Research, Client Support, and Marketing — to deliver coordinated, high-impact outcomes for strategic accounts
Serve as the voice of strategic clients in product development and roadmap discussions, channeling structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams to inform solution enhancements
Cultivate a network of executive client champions and represent Moody's at industry conferences, client advisory boards, and executive forums

About the Team

In the Banking group, we help lending institutions make critical decisions about their business — particularly when they are providing loans, managing risk, or conducting financial planning. We do this with innovative software and reliable analytics, helping clients understand how to operate more effectively through training, learning solutions, and advisory services. We are a dedicated team of experts in technology and financial analytics who understand what our clients need. By joining our team, you will be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking group leveraging AI-driven insights and cutting-edge risk solutions to shape the future of banking.

title: Executive Director, Technology Sales Advisory
description:

The Executive Director of Tech Advisory is accountable for all elements of Technology for the assigned Sub-Division, including priorities for the vertical division to differentiate, client NPS & delivery escalations, and market penetration strategy. The Executive Director of Tech Advisory acts as overall technology advisor lead for the Sub-Division and aligned accounts to define technology-enabled growth and operating efficiency priorities. In this capacity they own and communicate the technology strategy for the vertical in close collaboration with broader JLL Technology strategy. This includes ensuring Technology delivery meets client expectations of JLL’s contracts. The Executive Director of Tech Advisory is directly responsible for the go to market strategy and execution across the Sub-Division for the portfolio of JLL technology products.

The role requires well versed expertise across many domains of real estate and facilities culminating in the bringing together of multiple software product and services solutions to solve complex challenges. The role requires strategic problem-solving ability and established credibility in the Commercial Real Estate community that instills confidence and trust.

Key responsibilities include:
Technology Advisory
· Accountable for all elements of Technology for the Sub-Division.
· Serve as the lead technology advisor for the Sub-Division and aligned accounts.
· Define priorities for Account Tech Advisors aligned to accounts in Sub-Division for NPS Improvements, Internal Education, Growth and Innovation.

· Establish and monitor technology priorities that enhance the Sub-Division's competitive advantage, communicate VOC to Product teams.
· Support SD Sales team with strategic tech guidance for complex or major pursuits in the division ensuring alignment with account tech roadmaps.
· Partner with Technology Delivery Executive for the Sub-Division to align priorities, communicate technology initiatives as well as drive technology adoptions within the Accounts in the Sub-Division and resolve and oversee delivery escalations.
Technology Sales
· Develop and oversee comprehensive technology sales strategy for the Sub-Division.
· Provide account segmentation strategy of accounts in the Sub-Division.
· Provide input to Technology Sales Managers to align sellers to accounts and opportunities.
· Design market penetration strategies for technology products and services in assigned Sub-Division; works with BD, Marketing and Sales Managers to activate.
· Collaborate with Sales teams; removing barriers to sales with the WD accounts business, managing sales escalations and deconflicting sales motions.
· Participate in deal go-no go, deal strategy development for key clients/opportunities.

The Candidate Experience
10+ years of sales or sales solutioning experience at a large, global organization.

Experience across multiple disciplines of Corporate Real Estate services, technologies and/or solutions.

Proven capabilities in growing relationships at the senior executive level and C-Suite for global, Fortune 500.

Successful track record of achieving immediate credibility; presenting varying ideas to create value and challenge the status quo; and able to think quickly, listen well, and understand how to react and modify approach in front of clients and other key influencers.

Outstanding stakeholder management skills and ability to influence and motivate others on a team and help them succeed.

High attention to detail and very organized with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

An excellent communicator with strong written and verbal presentation skills.

Results driven, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth work environment.

Ability to supervise and manage multiple projects at the same time.

Capacity to conceptualize as well as operationalize commercial strategies.

Ability to efficiently interact with company senior leaders.

Superior organizational awareness.

Experienced at managing diverse and geographically remote teams.

Understands the market of CRE Technologies, Prop Tech, IWMS, Smart Buildings, IoT, Experience Technologies etc.

Experience with successful selling outcomes using structured sales processes and tools such as Miller Heiman and Salesforce.


Behavioral Competencies
Passion to Win – wakes up every day thinking about how to engage new clients and beat the competition.

Strategic mindset – able to see big picture and future direction of the business, then translate into achievable new business development opportunities.

Influential – persuasive yet instills confidence among stakeholders, gravitas to drive change and obtain results.

Connector – can bring together various constituents across the organization to help drive client solutions.

Thrives in Ambiguity - can navigate through a complex, multi-faceted organization with multiple stakeholders.

Obsessed with customer habits – can use data derived from those behaviors; and trends within the industry to drive share of wallet.


If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.

About JLL –

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Partner Sales Manager, AWS
description:
Who You’ll Work With

You’ll work in Slalom to grow our AWS partnership and turn shared opportunities into meaningful customer outcomes.

We’re looking for an activator partner sales manager who can build trusted relationships, build opportunities and bring the right people together to move them forward. You’ll combine a consulting mindset with technical fluency and a strong focus on activating partner programs and funding.

What You’ll Do

Grow the AWS partnership: Develop and execute a partner sales plan that increases partner-sourced pipeline, joint customer engagement and revenue.

Activate partner relationships: Build strong relationships with AWS account teams, partner managers, specialists and Professional Services stakeholders to identify opportunities and position Slalom early in customer conversations.

Originate and qualify opportunities: Understand customer priorities, business drivers, technology environments, budget and decision-making processes to assess opportunity fit and readiness.

Bring technical fluency to sales conversations: Discuss cloud migration, modernization, data and AI opportunities confidently, recognizing when to involve Slalom’s technical and delivery specialists.

Maximize funding opportunities: Identify relevant AWS funding and partner programs, assess their applicability and coordinate with the appropriate teams on submissions, approvals and delivery requirements.

Shape joint pursuits: Connect AWS stakeholders with Slalom account and practice teams to develop customer propositions, shape scope and progress opportunities toward closure.

Drive focused go-to-market activity: Translate joint account planning, campaigns, events and workshops into qualified opportunities and clear follow-up actions.

Maintain pipeline discipline: Keep opportunity records, partner registrations, forecasts and next steps accurate and current.

Enable both sides of the partnership: Help AWS teams understand Slalom’s capabilities and help Slalom teams recognize where AWS relationships and programs can support customer outcomes.

What You’ll Bring

6–10 years of relevant experience across partner sales, alliances, technology sales, business development or consulting.

A consulting or professional services background is preferred, with an understanding of how advisory and technology engagements are scoped, sold and delivered.

Experience working with AWS or a comparable cloud partner ecosystem, ideally including joint selling and partner-led opportunity development.

Sufficient technical understanding to qualify cloud, data, modernization and AI opportunities, without needing to own detailed solution architecture.

Experience identifying and activating partner funding programs, with the ability to connect program requirements to customer opportunities.

A track record of building qualified pipeline and progressing complex, multi-stakeholder sales opportunities.

Strong relationship-building, discovery and communication skills, including the ability to engage business and technical stakeholders.

An activator mindset: resourceful, proactive and comfortable turning relationships and ideas into concrete next steps.

The ability to work independently while coordinating effectively across sales, consulting, delivery and partner teams.

AWS certifications are advantageous, but practical technical fluency and commercial judgment are more important.

What Success Looks Like

Growth in qualified AWS partner-sourced and co-sell pipeline.

Stronger AWS relationships that consistently generate customer opportunities.

Effective use of eligible funding programs to support customer engagements.

Earlier involvement of Slalom in customer discovery, design and scoping.

Clear progression from joint account planning to pursuits, wins and delivery handoffs.

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes and partners with leaders—bringing more together.

From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 54 offices in 12 countries collaborate with you to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products, services, and businesses to life. Every day, we work at the forefront of industry, combining our deep roots in technology and data, to help you tackle challenges, improve operations, and drive sustainable growth. It’s why we are trusted by leaders across the majority of the Global 1000, many of the world’s most successful enterprise, mid-market, and emerging companies, and more than 500 high-impact public sector agencies, foundations, and universities.

We lead with a balance of heart and practicality, curiosity and agility, local soul and global expertise. That means understanding your culture, goals, organization, and customers. That means being tireless problem solvers. And that means always standing by you as your trusted advisor, respectful challenger, and unwavering champion.

Even our partnerships are built different. For more than 20 years, we've sought out and made strategic investments in the world’s emerging and leading technology platforms. Our 360-degree relationships with these innovators, built on mutual trust and respect, has cemented our position as a premier (and often first) partner of choice. We work together as one to offer tailored solutions that unlock the full potential of these technologies.

At Slalom, we bring more day-one advantages, more connections and breakthroughs, more doing the right thing, more care for you and your team, and more return on your investment. So that together, we can dream bigger, move faster, and build better tomorrows for all.

title: Business Development & Retail Growth Executive / Manager
description:
Business Development & Retail Growth Senior Executive/ Manager

LAURENE Living | Singapore | Full-Time | S$3,500/month | Career Conversion Opportunity

Build a growing Singapore lifestyle brand from the ground up.

LAURENE Living is a Singapore-based modern botanical home & lifestyle brand creating thoughtfully crafted products that elevate everyday spaces.

We are looking for an

entrepreneurial, commercially minded and energetic mid-career professional

who is interested in making a career transition into business development, retail, entrepreneurship and AI-enabled business growth.

This is not a conventional retail sales role. You will work directly with the founder and progressively take ownership of

business development, physical retail, product operations and business scaling

.

The Opportunity

LAURENE Living already has external support for digital marketing and an integrated website.

Your primary focus will therefore be the

physical and commercial side of the business

— getting our products into people's hands, developing partnerships, understanding customers and building a repeatable model for growth.

PHASE 1 — Business Development & Physical Retail

You will:

Introduce and demonstrate LAURENE Living products to potential customers

Develop corporate gifting opportunities

Approach boutiques, lifestyle businesses and potential retail partners

Identify suitable events, pop-ups and offline sales opportunities

Build relationships with potential business partners

Conduct product demonstrations and scent experiences

Gather customer feedback and identify new opportunities

Develop and manage a pipeline of potential sales and partnerships

Test different offline sales strategies and measure results

PHASE 2 — Product & Operations

As you become familiar with the business, you will progressively learn the operational side of LAURENE Living.

This may include:

Small-batch product production

Working with established product formulations and processes

Production and quality control

Product costing and margins

Inventory and fulfilment

Developing standard operating procedures

Improving production efficiency

Exploring ways to delegate and standardise production

PHASE 3 — Build a Scalable Business

The longer-term objective is to make LAURENE Living less dependent on the founder personally making, selling and managing every aspect of the business.

You will explore:

Building repeatable sales processes

Training and coordinating other people

Developing production SOPs

Creating scalable retail and partnership models

Improving unit economics

Using AI to automate repetitive work

Using customer data and feedback to improve decisions

Building systems that allow the business to grow

PHASE 4 — Regional Expansion

As the business develops, you may have the opportunity to work on expansion beyond Singapore, including:

APAC market research

Identifying potential distributors and partners

Evaluating new markets

Exploring regional retail opportunities

Understanding local customer preferences

Supporting cross-border growth

Who We Are Looking For

This role is particularly suited to a

mid-career professional looking for a genuine career transition

.

Essential requirements

To be considered for this opportunity, you should:

Be a

Singapore Citizen aged 40 or above

Have at least

2 years of relevant working experience

Be looking to make a

genuine career transition into a new role/function

Be willing to undertake structured on-the-job training

Be available for

full-time employment

Be comfortable in a customer-facing environment

Be willing to approach people and businesses in person

Be proactive, resourceful and commercially minded

Be comfortable learning new skills outside your previous career

Be interested in entrepreneurship, business development and AI

Be able to work independently and take initiative

Candidates whose previous experience is in a different occupation or industry and who are seeking to transition into business development, retail and growth are particularly encouraged to apply.

Useful backgrounds

Experience in any of the following would be useful:

Sales

Business development

Retail

Marketing

Hospitality

Luxury

Consumer products

Events

Design

Technology

Entrepreneurship

Customer experience

However,

you do not need to come from the retail industry

. We are interested in people who can bring transferable skills and are genuinue motivated to move into a new career direction.

Career Conversion Opportunity

This position is intended to be structured as a

Career Conversion Programme (CCP) opportunity

, subject to the eligibility of the employer, candidate, role and programme approval.

The role involves meaningful development across:

Business Development → Retail → Sales → Product → Operations → AI → Scaling → Regional Expansion

This is an opportunity to build practical experience across the commercial and operational sides of a growing consumer brand.

What Makes This Role Different?

You will work directly with the founder of a growing Singapore brand and have the opportunity to see how a business is built from the ground up.

This is suited to someone who wants to move beyond a conventional corporate role and develop

hands-on entrepreneurial and commercial experience

.

You will not simply be given a fixed list of tasks.

The long-term objective is to find someone who can

take ownership of meaningful parts of the business and help build LAURENE Living into a scalable regional brand.

LAURENE Living

is a Singapore-based modern botanical home & lifestyle brand creating thoughtfully crafted products that elevate everyday spaces.

Inspired by nature, calm and modern living, we create premium home essentials designed to bring a sense of freshness and wellbeing into everyday routines. Our approach combines thoughtful product design, botanical ingredients and a clean, contemporary aesthetic.

As a growing founder-led brand, we are building LAURENE Living with a long-term ambition to expand beyond Singapore. We are exploring new retail, corporate, partnership and regional opportunities while using technology and AI to build a more efficient and scalable business.

We are looking for entrepreneurial people who want to be part of building a brand — not simply working in one.

title: Growth Product Manager – Cross-Border Remittance
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Growth Product Manager with a strong background in cross-border payments, international remittance or fintech to drive user and transaction growth across our remittance markets.

You will work at the intersection of Product, Growth and Business Development, identifying market and customer opportunities, improving the product and customer journey, and turning those opportunities into measurable growth in users, transaction volume and revenue.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can identify opportunities from the market and customer perspective, develop growth strategies and work cross-functionally to turn ideas into results.

Key Responsibilities

1、Research target markets, customer segments and competitive landscapes to identify new growth opportunities and potential customer segments.

2、Develop a deep understanding of the end-to-end remittance journey, from onboarding and verification to transaction initiation, payment and completion, and identify key drivers of conversion, transaction success and repeat usage.

3、Identify product, process and customer experience improvements that can remove barriers to customer acquisition, conversion and transaction growth.

4、Develop and execute market-specific growth and operating strategies across customer acquisition, conversion, retention and repeat transactions.

5、Work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, Business Development, Customer Support and Compliance teams to take growth initiatives from idea and validation through execution and optimisation.

6、Monitor key metrics including registration, first transaction, conversion, transaction success rate, repeat transactions, transaction volume and revenue, and use data to continuously optimise growth strategies.

7、Monitor competitors, market trends and industry developments, and explore new acquisition channels, partnerships and business opportunities.

8、Contribute to product and growth roadmaps by prioritising opportunities based on customer needs, market potential and business impact.

Requirements

1、Bachelor's degree or above, with 5+ years of relevant experience.

2、At least 3 years of experience in cross-border payments, international remittance, digital wallets or Fintech.

3、Strong understanding of the international remittance business model, customer needs and end-to-end transaction lifecycle, with knowledge of payments, FX and settlement.

4、Strong market research, customer insight and commercial thinking, with the ability to identify and validate business growth opportunities.

5、Strong product mindset, with the ability to translate customer needs and business problems into product and process improvements.

6、Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to identifying growth opportunities, diagnosing bottlenecks and measuring results.

7、Strong stakeholder management and execution skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, Compliance and Business Development.

8、Experience in Southeast Asian or other international markets is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

Identify new customer segments and market opportunities.

Identify and remove key barriers to customer conversion and repeat transactions.

Drive meaningful product and customer journey improvements.

Develop and execute targeted growth initiatives that increase transaction volume and revenue.

Take ownership of measurable growth outcomes in the markets you are responsible for.

Panda Remit, Love without Borders

Panda Remit is a technology product and brand created in Hong Kong by Wo Transfer (HK) Limited, holding MSO license. We aim to provide safe, convenient, and low-cost money transfer service globally. Our goal is to make sending money home as easy as sending WeChat Red Packets to families. Traditional remittance service providers are offline, slow, and depend on an agent network, which incur significantly higher costs and lower quality of service. We are different from traditional MSB’s. Panda Remit is Internet-based, self-operated, and 100% online money transfer. We are able to keep our costs and overhead low, which enables us to greatly reduce transaction fee of remittance for customers. For what you pay for a cup of coffee, you are able to send money throughout the world with Panda Remit!

title: Business Development Ecommerce Enabler
description:
About uParcel

uParcel(MXHL Pte Ltd) is a Singapore-based e-commerce fulfilment and last-mile delivery company. Operating our own warehouse and fleet out of Defu Industrial City, we help online sellers on Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop store, pack, and deliver their orders reliably — acting as a true “e-commerce enabler” that combines warehousing, marketplace integrations, and same-day delivery under one roof.

About the Role

We are looking for a driven Business Development Executive to grow uParcel's e-commerce enabler segment — our fulfilment and last-mile solution for online sellers and brands. You will identify, pursue, and close new business with marketplace sellers, D2C brands, and SMEs looking to outsource their warehousing and delivery operations, while also nurturing existing accounts to grow wallet share. This is a hunter-oriented role suited to someone comfortable prospecting, pitching, and closing in a competitive, fast-moving logistics market.

Key Responsibilities

• Identify and prospect new business opportunities among e-commerce sellers, marketplace merchants(Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop), and D2C brands seeking fulfilment and last-mile delivery solutions.

• Build and manage a healthy sales pipeline in the CRM, from lead generation through proposal, negotiation, and closing.

• Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals that position uParcel's integrated fulfilment + delivery model against competitors.

• Understand each prospect's fulfilment needs (storage, pick-and-pack, delivery volumes, SLAs)and work with Operations to scope feasible, profitable solutions.

• Negotiate commercial terms and pricing within approved guidelines, and close new client agreements.

• Manage a portfolio of onboarded clients, ensuring smooth handover to Operations and identifying opportunities to expand service usage.

• Monitor market trends, competitor offerings, and marketplace policy changes (e.g. Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop programmes) to spot new business opportunities.

• Represent uParcel at industry events, marketplace seller communities, and networking sessions to build brand visibility and generate leads.

• Track and report on sales activities, pipeline health, and conversion metrics to management on a regular basis.

Requirements

• Diploma or degree in Business, Marketing, Logistics, or a related field.

• 1–3 years of experience in business development, sales, or account management; experience in e-commerce, logistics, or fulfilment is a strong advantage.

• Familiarity with marketplace platforms (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop) and how online sellers operate is a plus.

• Confident communicator and presenter, comfortable pitching to business owners and decision-makers.

• Results-driven with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

• Proficient in CRM tools(e.g. Zoho CRM), and presentation software.

• Self-motivated, able towork independently, and comfortable with a mix of office-based and on-the-ground client engagement.

uParcel has planned, matched and optimised millions of same day deliveries using our proprietary logistics technology platform. Backed by data and driven by an innovative decentralised clustering model, we provide the most efficient deliveries to consumers through artificial intelligence assignment of delivery jobs to our network of delivery partners.

In contrast to the traditional hub-and-spoke last mile delivery model, our point-to-point clustering model enable same day deliveries efficiently by removing the need for extensive packaging, warehouse sorting and reducing distance travelled for greater productivity.

Our vision is to become the leading logistics platform that enables greater resource sharing and optimized routing to move the world more sustainably.

We are currently present in Singapore and Malaysia, with expansion plans to the rest of the region.

This Southeast Asia (SEA) focused TEM/XPS Product Specialist / Sales Development representative will work with a motivated and successful team at the forefront of electron microscopy in SEA, APAC and around the world, including applications, product development, sales and marketing. You will become a product expert and help to deliver TEM and/or XPS business growth in SEA, working closely with our academic and industrial research customers, to understand their application needs and find effective ways to promote our solutions. You will help to understand and build relationships with key researchers and match our technology and solutions to customer needs, and help to increase materials science electron microscopy and surface analysis sales in the region.

Job responsibilities will include:

• Keeping up to date on the latest products and technology (mainly TEM and/or XPS), by developing relationships both inside and outside the APAC region, including with hands-on experience if possible.

• Establishing and maintaining strong relationships with customers to better understand how to make them successful, both in academia and industry.

• Partner with regional sales managers to execute our annual operation plan, develop and drive business development projects for target market segments. Overlook the progress to ensure the key projects in good shape, on track and deliver the target pipeline growth.

• Helping with event planning and execution including conferences, workshops, trade shows and webinars, and presenting at such events.

• Discussing with the MSBU product team about customer and market trends and requests, to improve the development of the next generation of electron microscopes

• Adapting or translating marketing materials for local use.

• Helping to train and develop other members of the team.

The ideal candidate would have:

• Good knowledge of TEM and/or XPS techniques and applications (preferably some knowledge of SEM and DualBeam as well), and passion about the fields of electron microscopy and materials science

• Strong background in materials science research, academic or industrial, or good understanding of a range of materials science customer applications, and experience interacting with industrial or academic scientists and researchers

• A university degree or equivalent, preferably a PhD or similar research experience in the field of materials science, metallurgy, electron microscopy, nanotechnology or engineering.

• Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, (primarily in English, but other languages welcome) including the ability to explain technical concepts, workflows and applications clearly to a range of audiences, to gain trust, to influence and persuade others, to present at conferences, to work well in teams, and to listen and understand customer needs.

• Ability to achieve results and work to agreed timelines.

• Be able to produce and implement new ideas, and to see new opportunities and realize them.

• Good judgement and decision-making skills.

• Enthusiasm to work within a diverse, cross-functional team across multiple sites

• A high level of integrity and a desire to improve customer outcomes and achieve customer satisfaction

• Ability to travel up to 50-75% within assigned territory, mainly within SEA and some APAC regions

title: Technical Sales Lead, Singapore (SG)
description:
Location: Singapore, SG

Corporate Title: Vice President

Division: CSH-Public Sector Solutions (50008266)

Department: CSHA-PSS Market Units (50008267)

Purpose

Our dedicated Public Sector Solutions (PSS) team specialises in serving Public Sector clients and brokers, addressing the unique challenges of this client segment with trusted risk insights, data analytics, and risk transfer solutions. By connecting public sector brokers and clients to the full capabilities of the Swiss Re Group, we turn their needs into outcomes. Together, we navigate an increasingly complex world, building resilience for governments and beyond.

Our PSS team is focused on, for Swiss Re Group, public sector institutions with non-standard buying behaviour, influences and/or needs driven by unique political or budgetary considerations, motivations, gestation periods and/or procurement processes impacting decision-making, solution design and/or execution. This includes:

Governments at central, state, and municipal levels
State-backed risk pools, captives and international sovereign risk pools
Publicly owned Export Credit Agencies
World Bank, UN Agencies and IMF, and other Supranational & Development Finance Institutions; and
Non-governmental organizations (NGOs)

About the Role

You will be responsible for enabling business origination by utilizing deep technical subject matter expertise of designing insurance solutions to actively promote and eventually execute effective risk transfer strategies. The role has a specific focus to promote and facilitate new sales opportunities by offering innovative insurance solutions in line with Swiss Re risk appetite and underwriting standards for Natural Catastrophe (Nat Cat) and climate risks. The end goal is to deliver opportunities for Swiss Re Group including, but not limited to Reinsurance, Corporate Solutions, Alternative Capital Partners, and Risk Data Solutions (the tool and consulting arm of Swiss Re Group) aligned with their growth priorities and target liability portfolios. You will work in close coordination with the Business Units (BUs) where the underwriting and P&L authority sits, to deliver business success in a collaborative ecosystem. There is also close collaboration with other Group Functions such as Regulatory Affairs, Risk Management, and Swiss Re Institute.

Your key responsibilities are:

Enable business origination by providing subject matter expertise to develop and provide technical solutions and eliminating technical hurdles often experienced by public sector clients, primarily in property and Nat Cat areas.
As a member of a team with local presence but global reach, you ensure flexible and effective product- and know-how transfer and deploy your expertise in a manner that maximizes cost-benefit for local origination efforts while at the same time building a consistent common global knowledge base.
Transform data driven risk "challenges" into applicable, sellable risk transfer solutions for external stakeholders (clients, brokers, risk and finance managers, etc).
Make product demonstrations and accelerate the sales process by presenting potentially complex products in an easy-to-understand but data-backed way.
Strong collaboration with relevant 3rd party vendors such as but not limited to ICEYE, REASK, Floodbase, Planet, JBA, RMS, Verisk, etc.
Develop, maintain and utilize technical networks internally and externally to stay abreast of market developments, competitor activities and technical best practices, with a particular focus on supporting Swiss Re BUs.
Contribute technical and public entity thought leadership at high profile industry events, through media outreach and at speaking engagements.
Establish yourself as part of BU property network, including but not limited to Alternative Capital Partners (ACP), Parametric Centre of Excellence (CoE), Alternative Risk Transfer (ART), etc. – notably scientific, engineering, and structured insurance solution experts across the company.
Guide placement of bespoke solutions jointly with structuring, underwriting, and client management in compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, as well as in accordance with internal risk management and performance guidelines.
Work closely with PSS CM team to ensure maximum sales effectiveness, while providing regular updates and helping manage deal flow.
For your supported transactions maintain oversight of production numbers against defined plan figures.

About You

Master's degree preferred in natural science, computer, engineering, mathematics, finance or actuarial sciences.
7+ years of experience working in property insurance market in underwriting, risk management or insurance/Insurtech sales/marketing complemented by practical experience in structuring and executing structured insurance solutions, ideally but not limited to parametric natural catastrophe products that yield strong economic profit for the company.
Strong knowledge of traditional and structured insurance products and markets.
Strong financial acumen with deep capital and financial management proficiency as well as analytical and modelling capabilities.
Good command of systems and tools (geospatial, computing - e.g., Excel, R, Python), risk analysis and willingness to learn proprietary Swiss Re tools.
High attention to details and ability to meet tight deadlines.
Ability to work both independently and as part of a cross-functional team to achieve financial targets.
Ability to triage effectively and to stop low return on investment propositions early and decisively.
Above average presentation skills and personal gravitas to interact with an external client base with ease and under pressure.
Effective communicator in English and flexibility to adapt to audience at different seniority levels.
Chinese (Mandarin) a strong asset.
Willingness to travel extensively in the APAC region.

Local/ Specific Role Requirements

Full proficiency in English. Chinese (Mandarin) a strong asset
Driving technical development (IT, coding, programming)
Structuring Expert tailored cases, including but not limited to parametric (Property mostly)
Climate or Geoscience Expert
Co-owning regional account management responsibility with local senior lead of ROW APAC market (except ANZ)

About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
SY Foodstuffs and Trading is a progressive food distribution and automated retail company in Singapore. We bridge the gap between daily essential consumer goods and modern convenience. From supplying core staples like beverages, bakery items, and fresh eggs to traditional retail networks, to pioneering smart vending machine solutions in high-traffic hubs, we are shaping the future of micro-retail.

We are looking for a high-energy

Business Development Executive

who thrives in the field, loves the thrill of closing deals, and wants to play a pivotal role in scaling our dual-channel growth strategy.

This is not a passive account-management desk job. You will be operating on the front lines of Singapore's vibrant food landscape. Your time will be split between expanding our wholesale distribution footprint and hunting for prime real estate to deploy our automated retail/vending machines.

Reports To:

Business Development Manager / Director

Location:

Singapore (Field-based / Office in Great World)

Key Mission:

Increase product volume in traditional stores while simultaneously securing high-footfall footprint for our vending machine fleet.

Core Responsibilities

1. Traditional Trade & FMCG Expansion (Minimarts,Canteens, Coffeeshops)

B2B Customer Acquisition:

Actively cold-call, door-knock, and pitch to independent minimarts, coffeeshop operators, industrial canteens, and small-format grocers across Singapore.

Volume & Margin Growth:

Secure opening orders and establish recurring delivery schedules for our core product lines (Beverages, Bakery, Eggs, and assorted FMCG goods).

Merchandising & Relationship Management:

Conduct regular site visits to ensure prominent product placement, manage stock rotations, resolve credit/payment queries with shop owners, and build bulletproof rapport.

Market Mapping:

Identify underserved areas and map out competitor pricing strategies to keep our offerings highly competitive.

2. Automated Retail & Vending Machine Site Acquisition

Location Scouting:

Conduct market research and foot-traffic analysis to identify high-yielding spots for vending machine placement (e.g., student campuses, staff canteens, transport hubs, major coffee shops).

Landlord & Institutional B2B Pitching:

Approach, pitch, and present automated retail solutions to corporate landlords, school boards, and property management committees.

Contract Negotiation:

Navigate and secure favorable lease agreements, revenue-sharing models, or space rental terms.

Deployment Coordination:

Act as the project lead for new installations—coordinating with landlords for power/space requirements and collaborating with our internal logistics team to ensure a seamless launch.

Data-Driven Optimization:

Monitor post-deployment sales data to recommend adjustments in product mix or machine relocation if targets aren't met.

What Success Looks Like (KPIs)

New Doors Opened:

Consistent monthly acquisition of new minimart/canteen wholesale accounts.

Successful Machine Deployments:

Meeting quarterly targets for newly signed and operational vending machine locations.

Account Retention & Growth:

Maintaining low churn among existing B2B clients and increasing average order values over time.

Requirements: Who You Are

The Experience:

2+ years of hardcore field sales experience in Singapore. Experience in FMCG distribution, food supply chains, or commercial real estate/vending space acquisition is highly valued.

The Hustle:

You are comfortable walking the ground, building quick rapport with traditional shop owners (ability to communicate effectively in local languages/dialects is a major advantage), while still being polished enough to pitch to a corporate landlord or school administrator.

The Commercial Mindset:

You understand margins, cost of goods sold (COGS), rental overheads, and basic contract terms.

The Tech/Data Comfort:

Ability to use CRM tools and basic Excel/data to look at vending sales trends.

We are a Singapore based company that Speciliased in Wholesale distribution of Beverages and Snacks products.

title: Head of Sales, Public Sector
description:

title: Enterprise Account Executive, Asia
description:
Intellect is the global leader in hyper localised mental health benefits, trusted by the world’s most forward-thinking employers, insurers, and governments to deliver care that is local, personalised, and effective at scale. Today, we serve over 4 million people across 100 countries and 100+ languages, making mental health support truly accessible across borders and cultures.

Our platform powers the mental wellbeing of workforces at hundreds of Fortune 500 and global multinational companies, enabling them to support their people with the highest standards of clinical quality, cultural relevance, and on-demand accessibility.

Driven by our mission to build the world’s most trusted mental health benefits platform, Intellect combines a best-in-class digital platform with a world-leading global provider network to deliver unmatched client outcomes, and transformative care experiences.

We are backed by top global investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, Insignia Ventures Partners, HOF Capital, K3 Ventures, JAFCO, Headline, East Ventures, IHH Healthcare, MS&AD Ventures, and more, alongside an extensive coalition of notable family offices, big tech executives, and leading angel investors.

The Role

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, Asia to drive new business across mid-market and enterprise customers in the region.

This is a high-ownership, full-cycle sales role for someone who wants to build, not simply inherit a mature territory and run an established sales playbook.

You will have strong support from marketing, partnerships, leadership, product, clinical, customer success, and other teams across Intellect. At the same time, we expect you to be highly proactive in creating momentum yourself: opening doors, developing opportunities, shaping propositions, building compelling pitches, navigating complex buying processes, and doing what is needed to move important deals forward.

We are looking for someone commercially sharp, resourceful, persistent, and comfortable operating with pace and ambiguity.

A builder, not a passenger.

What You Will Do

Build & Win New Business

Own the end-to-end sales cycle across mid-market and enterprise customers in Asia, from first conversation through to contract signature.
Develop a deep understanding of target accounts, their priorities, decision-makers, buying dynamics, and where Intellect can create meaningful value.
Run high-quality discovery with senior stakeholders and translate customer needs into compelling commercial solutions.
Build strong, multi-threaded relationships across organisations and navigate complex regional or enterprise buying processes.

Create & Develop Pipeline

Work closely with marketing and the broader commercial team on inbound opportunities, campaigns, events, account-based initiatives, and other sources of demand.
At the same time, take ownership of creating opportunities yourself through targeted outreach, referrals, networking, events, partnerships, and thoughtful account development.
You should be comfortable working both sides of the equation: converting strong inbound demand and creating new opportunities from scratch.

Shape Complex Enterprise Deals

Develop account strategies and determine the best path to win each opportunity.
Create and customise presentations, proposals, business cases, and commercial narratives around the needs of each customer rather than relying only on standard materials.
Bring the right internal stakeholders into the process - across leadership, product, clinical, customer success, legal, security, and operations - and orchestrate them effectively.
Navigate procurement, legal, security, commercial negotiations, and other enterprise requirements with sound judgement and persistence.
Identify blockers early, create clear next steps, and maintain momentum throughout the sales cycle.

Represent Intellect Across Asia

Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers across the region.
Represent Intellect at customer meetings, industry events, conferences, roundtables, and other commercial opportunities.
Be willing to engage directly in events, lead generation, and market-building activities rather than seeing them as someone else’s responsibility.
Develop a strong understanding of the evolving mental health, employee benefits, HR, healthcare, and workforce landscape across Asia, and bring relevant market insights back into the company.
What Success Looks Like
You consistently build and convert a healthy pipeline of high-quality opportunities.
You win meaningful new mid-market and enterprise customers across Asia.
You create opportunities independently as well as convert marketing-generated demand.
You build credibility with senior stakeholders and develop relationships across multiple decision-makers within an account.
You navigate complex sales cycles with strong commercial judgement and clear ownership.
You create compelling, customer-specific pitches and proposals that move opportunities forward.
You maintain strong discipline around pipeline management, forecasting, follow-ups, and next steps.
You become a credible and trusted representative of Intellect in the market.
You operate effectively without needing a large or highly prescriptive sales machine around you.

Requirements

5-10 years of B2B sales experience, with meaningful exposure to mid-market or enterprise customers.
We care less about a specific industry background than we do about seeing evidence that you can create and win business.

You are likely to be someone who:

Has a strong track record of winning new mid-market or enterprise customers.
Has owned a meaningful portion of the full sales cycle, from opportunity creation through to negotiation and close.
Is commercially hungry and proactive about generating business rather than relying entirely on inbound demand.
Can sell consultatively and understand the underlying business problem rather than simply presenting product features.
Is comfortable navigating complex organisations with multiple stakeholders and decision-makers.
Can communicate credibly with senior executives and adapt your approach across different audiences and markets.
Is comfortable creating or adapting your own decks, proposals, business cases, and sales narratives when needed.
Is highly resourceful and persistent when an opportunity becomes difficult or stalls.
Has strong judgement around account prioritisation, stakeholder management, and how to move a deal forward.
Is comfortable operating in an environment where not every process is perfectly defined.
Has strong commercial discipline without becoming overly dependent on process or infrastructure.
Works effectively across functions and knows how to bring the right people into an opportunity.
Is ambitious, resilient, and motivated by ownership and outcomes.
Is willing to get hands-on where needed, whether that means prospecting, working an event, researching an account, preparing a custom pitch, or pushing through a difficult procurement process.

Experience selling HR technology, employee benefits, healthcare, mental health, SaaS, professional services, or other complex B2B solutions is useful, but not essential.

Experience selling across multiple Asian markets or operating in a regional role would be a strong advantage.

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

Global company – work in a diverse environment with people from nearly 20 countries
Generous leave policy – time off to rest and recharge
Christmas week off – company-wide break during Christmas, separate from annual leave
Birthday leave – enjoy a day off on your birthday
Quarterly mental health days – one day off every quarter to focus on your wellbeing
Flexible work arrangements – work in a way that suits your lifestyle and goals
Work-life balance – a culture that values personal time and long-term wellness
Medical coverage – comprehensive insurance for peace of mind
Performance bonus – high performance is recognised and rewarded
Development budget - annual allowance to support your professional development
Mental health support – premium coaching access to our mental health app and resources & dedicated budget for clinical and psychiatric care
Socials and communities – regular non-work events/activities to connect and have fun together

Position Overview

Location: Singapore

Key Responsibilities

title: Business Development Operations Manager (Franchise & Wholesale)
description:
About us

Love, Bonito is Southeast Asia’s leading womenswear brand, built with a mission to empower women to find confidence through style. Incorporated in 2010 in Singapore, we’ve since grown from a humble online startup into a multi-channel business with over 20 stores and counting across Asia and a thriving online presence.

For the next decade, we are looking to expand through new categories, markets, wholesale partnerships, and brand acquisitions. We are evolving into a next-generation regional consumer group — one that blends heart with performance, and creativity with technology.

At our core, we’re a team of builders, dreamers, and doers who believe culture is more than words on a wall — it’s how we show up every day. We move fast, stay curious, and take bold bets on ideas and people we believe in. Here, you’ll find a community that challenges you to grow, trusts you to lead, and celebrates you for being you. Together, we’re shaping the future of Asian brands — from right here in Southeast Asia, to the world.

Why join us?

At Love, Bonito, you’ll do more than just a job — you’ll help build a movement. We’re creating an organization that’s lean, bold, and full of heart — where every person has the space to make an impact. Here’s what you can expect:

Purpose with performance: We’re building a world-class Asian brand that competes globally. We hold ourselves to high standards and operate with purpose, integrity, grit and excellence. Join us if you take customer service excellence seriously and are passionate about creating real impact!
Growth that’s real: We are known to be incredibly dynamic and fast-paced. You’ll be expected to learn fast, stretch beyond your comfort zone, and work alongside people who challenge and support you in equal measure. Don’t join us if you’re looking for a comfortable, fully structured setup, but do join us if you’re excited to build, shape, and make an impact together!
Culture at our core: If you’re looking for a no-corporate-BS environment, you’ll fit right in. We lead with empathy, celebrate individuality, and believe that great work comes from trust, not titles. We believe in teamwork and effective collaboration - because when we run together, we go further. If this speaks to your values, come join us and be part of #TeamLB!

Join us as we redefine what it means to build an enduring global consumer group.

About the role

As the Business Development Operations Manager, you will own the operational and merchandising engine behind Love, Bonito's franchise and wholesale business — from full day-to-day ownership of partner accounts to quarterly buying, onboarding, SOPs, and performance reporting. Reporting to the VP of Business Development, you'll bring strong retail/merchandising judgment to partner buying sessions, coordinate closely with Marketing to ensure campaigns and activations land on the ground, and build the scalable systems that let the business expand across markets. This role is built for someone who leads with operational and merchandising expertise first, and who wants to grow into broader strategic ownership as the franchise network scales

Main responsibilities

1. Partner Relationship & Enablement and Operational Support

Act as day-to-day point of contact for partners: order queries, operations, marketing
Support partners in executing agreed marketing plans, coordinating with internal Marketing on asset delivery, global campaign plans and timing
Lead quarterly buying sessions with partners, curating styles (balancing brand vision, partner appetite and sell-through potential), preparing the buy sheet, ensuring order placements.
Review with internal Merchandising and VM teams the assortment planning recommendations for partners securing their support especially for new store and online channels launch needs.
Ensure franchise partners have the operational tools and training to uphold LB's global standards on brand, customer experience and retail ops
Coordinate with internal teams (IT, Ops) to brief and guide partners on LB website operations

2. Strategic & Growth Planning

Build yearly growth plans (marketing, expansion), sell-in/sell-out and inventory targets
Lead monthly business reviews with performance dashboards and data-driven insights
Own partner P&Ls: annual budgets, quarterly sales plans

3. New Partners Onboarding & New projects Execution Support

Oversee onboarding end-to-end: account setup, store launch, post-launch support
Manage store opening timelines (capex, store design coordination, first-buy ordering) and new online channels to launch (E.g. Tik Tok Shop, LB local website)
Coordinate with Retail Design (store build/design execution), acting as the commercial liaison to ensure partner requirements and timelines are met.
Build cross-functional project briefings to align stakeholders on new store/market opportunities
Run market-entry pilots to test and operationalize new or unproven markets

4. SOP Optimization and Reporting

Manage master timeline for seasonal collection launches (line sheet, buying, campaign sharing, product education, shipping, launch)
Develop, document, and implement SOPs across departments
Build/maintain the operations manual for cohesive execution across markets
Build/maintain consolidated performance dashboards; utilizing data-driven insights to identify operational bottlenecks and efficiency opportunities
Manage admin processes: P&Ls, invoicing, contract milestones

Requirements

Qualifications

6+ years of experience in retail/wholesale operations, buying, merchandising, or franchise/partner management in a fast-paced environment
Strong merchandising instinct — hands-on experience curating assortments, running buying sessions, and balancing brand vision with partner appetite and sell-through potential
Process-oriented mindset with demonstrated ability to build SOPs, operations manuals, and scalable systems from scratch
Experience with inventory management, retail supply chain, or partner/franchise enablement
Comfortable owning P&Ls, budgets, and quarterly sales plans; data-driven decision-making
Excellent cross-functional stakeholder management — able to align Merchandising, VM, Marketing, PMO/Retail Design, and IT/Ops around shared timelines and priorities
Familiarity with reporting/dashboarding tools; interest in using AI to streamline reporting is a plus
Growth-oriented: comfortable operating with hands-on operational and merchandising ownership today, with appetite to take on broader strategic planning as the role and franchise network scale
Willingness to travel up to 20% for market visits, partner meetings, and store openings
Self-starter with high ownership, structured thinking, integrity, and strong follow-through
A collaborative, humble teammate who thrives on building efficient systems and is eager to learn

title: Guest Experience & Business Development Manager (CCP PMET)
description:
About the Role

BMG treats guest experience as both a service and a revenue function. The Guest Experience & Business Development Manager will build relationships, community programmes, local partnerships and customer pipelines that generate hotel stays, restaurant diners, groups, events, repeat customers and referrals.

This is not primarily a complaint-handling or front-office role.

Key Responsibilities

Develop relationships with nearby companies, networking groups, local organisations, attractions, communities and complementary businesses.

Generate new hotel, F&B, group, corporate and event business.

Engage hotel and restaurant guests and convert appropriate interactions into permission-based CRM relationships.

Maintain a structured CRM and segment customers by behaviour, relationship, commercial potential and future needs.

Use approved AI tools to personalise follow-ups, proposals, local recommendations and customer journeys.

Develop neighbourhood partnerships and placemaking programmes.

Design community programmes and BMG social activities.

Work with operations and digital resources to create campaigns, offers, events and experiences.

Measure which partnerships and programmes generate bookings, diners, referrals and attributable revenue.

Analyse repeat visits, conversion, customer behaviour and pipeline progress.

Feed customer intelligence into management, pricing, programming and service decisions.

CCP Growth Skills

Consumer Intelligence Analysis

Placemaking for Hospitality

Service Innovation

Digital Marketing

Structured Career Conversion

The selected employee may undergo up to 24 weeks of OJT to develop hospitality-specific customer intelligence, CRM, placemaking, business development, AI-enabled relationship management and service-innovation capabilities.

Suitable Background

Potential backgrounds include community development, events, customer success, corporate relations, sales, marketing, account management, tourism, retail, service industries and partnership development. Candidates do not need to come from a traditional hotel Guest Relations department.

BMG Hospitality Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based hospitality and lifestyle company building a technology-enabled ecosystem across accommodation, food & beverage, talent, education, community, digital marketing and media.

Our core hospitality concept, Capsule Modern, focuses on modern, well-designed and affordable accommodation for the next generation of travellers. We aim to combine efficient hotel operations, strong guest experiences, social interaction and technology to create a scalable hospitality platform. Our target guests include independent travellers, digital natives and younger international visitors seeking convenient locations, quality facilities, value and community experiences.

Alongside our hotels, BMG Hospitality is developing Gabriel Restaurants to support both hotel guests and external customers. The restaurant platform is designed to complement hotel operations through breakfast services, food and beverage offerings and social experiences while developing its own standalone revenue streams.

BMG operates with an asset-light approach, focusing primarily on leasing and converting suitable properties rather than purchasing real estate. Standardised operating procedures, technology, centralised management and disciplined project execution are intended to allow new properties to be developed and launched efficiently.

Technology and artificial intelligence form an important part of BMG's operating philosophy. We are building a cloud-based management environment covering hotel operations, revenue management, reservations, customer relationship management, finance, HR, recruitment, project management, marketing, social media, reporting and management dashboards. Our managers are expected to use AI as a practical working tool to improve productivity, decision-making, communication and reporting.

Beyond hotels and restaurants, BMG is developing an ecosystem that includes talent recruitment and development, BMG Academy, affiliate marketing, community programmes and digital media. These businesses are intended to support the hospitality platform by developing employees, creating additional distribution channels, building customer communities and creating new sources of revenue.

BMG's organisational culture is built around entrepreneurship, accountability, continuous learning and measurable performance. We believe technology should empower employees rather than replace the human relationships that remain fundamental to hospitality. Team members are encouraged to understand the commercial impact of their roles, develop leadership capabilities and continuously improve the systems they manage.

The company is currently focused on establishing and scaling its Singapore operations, with longer-term opportunities across selected Asian markets. As BMG grows, we are building a management team capable of creating repeatable operating systems that can support multiple hotels, restaurants and related businesses across different locations.

Our objective is to build more than a collection of hotels. We aim to develop an integrated hospitality ecosystem where accommodation, food, technology, talent, education, community and digital distribution work together to create stronger customer experiences, operational efficiency and sustainable long-term growth.

title: Account Executive, Japan & Korea
description:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

The Role

This is a new-logo hunter role with an account development edge. Based in Singapore, you will own Sparta’s Japanese and Korean territory: building pipeline from scratch, getting in front of trading desks in person, and closing complex, multi-product deals. Roughly 70% of your time goes to winning new logos and 30% to growing and supporting the clients you bring in.

Japan is the immediate priority, with Korea following as the territory matures. Many of the desks you sell to sit in Singapore, but sometimes the budget, the mandate and the long-term relationship often sit with headquarters in Tokyo or Seoul. You will work both, building credibility locally and sponsorship at HQ.

You will sell to C-suite and VP-level buyers while winning over the traders, analysts and risk managers who will use the product and know their market cold.

You will have pre-sales and Customer Success behind you, and an Asia Pacific team growing quickly.

You will work from our Singapore office 4 days a week.

What You Will Be Doing

New Business

• Research opportunities, initiate discussions, build prospect relationships, run demos, manage product trials and close deals across Japanese and Korean energy commodity firms.

• Develop a pipeline of high-value opportunities through networking, events and in-person interaction with traders and decision-makers in Singapore and HQ.

• Sell to C-suite, VP-level and trading desks, articulating a clear business case and ROI for our SaaS solutions.

• Build relationships with headquarters stakeholders so that regional wins convert into group-level commitments.

Account Development and Expansion

• Grow the clients you win: expand usage across desks, verticals and products, and build the internal advocacy that turns a first deal into a multi-year relationship.

• Work with Customer Success to protect renewals and spot expansion signals early.

• Act as the commercial point of contact your clients trust, and bring their market feedback back into the business.

Enterprise Sales Execution

• Lead a virtual account team, coordinating with internal resources across pre-sales, customer success and marketing to drive deals forward.

• Use value-selling methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger and SPIN to align solutions with customer pain points and strategic initiatives.

• Structure and negotiate complex, multi-product deals tailored to customer needs.

Forecasting and Pipeline Management

• Maintain accurate sales forecasts, using HubSpot and sales analytics tools to manage deal progression and pipeline health.

• Track sales KPIs and continually refine sales tactics to improve conversion rates and shorten deal cycles.

About You

• 5+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, preference selling into commodities or energy markets.

• Business-level fluency in Japanese or Korean, in addition to English. This is required because most stakeholders will be Japanese and Koreans and prefer this as their working language

• Proven track record of hunting and closing complex, high-value deals, and hitting six- or seven-figure annual revenue targets.

• Able to build pipeline across a set territory from scratch: identifying the right opportunities, getting access to senior decision-makers, and building the internal advocacy that enterprise deals need.

• Comfortable running product demonstrations and navigating long sales cycles with multiple business and technical stakeholders.

• Strong knowledge of value-based selling frameworks such as MEDDPICC, Challenger and SPIN, and able to run a consultative sales motion.

• Experience orchestrating a cross-functional virtual team across pre-sales, customer success, marketing and executive sponsors.

• Based in Singapore, in the office 4 days a week, and happy to travel frequently for customer meetings and industry events across Asia Pacific. This is a face-to-face, relationship-driven role.

Nice to Have

• Prior exposure to energy and commodity markets, particularly refining, petrochemicals, shipping or trading houses.

• Experience selling financial data platforms, analytics software or SaaS solutions directly to traders, analysts, quants or risk managers.

• An existing network across Japanese or Korean trading houses, refiners, utilities or shipping firms.

• Experience selling for a scale-up or challenger brand, where the name does not open the door for you.

• Familiarity with HubSpot and Claude.

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law.

Build/maintain consolidated performance dashboards; utilizing data-driven insights to identify operational bottlenecks and efficiency opportunities
Manage admin processes: P&Ls, invoicing, contract milestones

6+ years of experience in retail/wholesale operations, buying, merchandising, or franchise/partner management in a fast-paced environment
Strong merchandising instinct — hands-on experience curating assortments, running buying sessions, and balancing brand vision with partner appetite and sell-through potential
Process-oriented mindset with demonstrated ability to build SOPs, operations manuals, and scalable systems from scratch
Experience with inventory management, retail supply chain, or partner/franchise enablement
Comfortable owning P&Ls, budgets, and quarterly sales plans; data-driven decision-making
