title: Analyst/Associate - Customer Success & Client Acquisitions
description:
Role Purpose

This role sits at the intersection of performance marketing and client acquisitions operations. You will work with both the Marketing and Commercial teams to execute how Keenai generates, converts, and onboards clients, from campaign and event-led lead generation through to funnel conversion and compliant onboarding, while ensuring the Sales team adheres to the relevant regulatory and compliance requirements across jurisdictions.

You will support a data-driven client acquisition engine: helping set channel and campaign strategy, tracking performance against acquisition metrics, and partnering closely with the Marketing and Commercial teams, RMs, Legal, and Compliance to generate, convert, and onboard clients into active, well-onboarded accounts.

Key Responsibilities

Acquisition Strategy & Performance Marketing: Support the end-to-end client acquisition funnel strategy. Help define and prioritise channels (campaigns, events, partnerships, referrals) based on CAC, conversion rate, and pipeline quality. Track targets and report on acquisition performance to leadership.

Campaign & Event-Led Lead Generation: Plan, coordinate, and measure client-facing events, roadshows, and acquisition campaigns as strategic lead-generation channels. Manage logistics, guest and vendor management, and post-event follow-up, and track ROI and lead-to-client conversion for each initiative.

Funnel & Conversion Analytics: Build and maintain reporting on the acquisition funnel from lead to onboarded client. Identify drop-off points and friction, and recommend process or channel changes that improve conversion and time-to-onboard.

Client On-boarding: Conduct thorough customer due diligence, analyse customer activities, and keep the company's KYC records current per internal standards and regulatory guidelines, ensuring onboarding operations keep pace with acquisition volume.

Document Analysis: Assess customer identity documents, source of wealth documentation, adverse screening, company registries, business structures, beneficial ownership, and other sources and collaterals needed to make the assessment.

RM Enablement: Support RMs' acquisition efforts by coordinating prospect documentation, expediting onboarding turnaround, and removing friction that could delay a lead from converting into an active client. Liaise with RMs to collect, verify, and follow up on required client documents; flag gaps or discrepancies before submission.

Risk & Compliance Oversight: Ensure adherence to internal SOPs, regulatory requirements, and audit standards throughout the onboarding lifecycle. Conduct periodic reviews of client transaction history and account usage, and escalate activities exceeding internal risk tolerance or regulatory guidelines to Keenai's relevant teams.

Records Keeping: Ensure customer records are accurate, organised, and updated as required, in compliance with data privacy regulations and internal data security protocols.

Client Communication: Communicate with clients and prospects clearly and professionally through Keenai's approved communication channels, across both marketing and onboarding touchpoints.

Stakeholder Management: Coordinate with Marketing, Compliance, Risk, and Operations teams to align campaign activity with onboarding capacity, and to resolve queries and expedite approvals.

Relevant Experience

Experience in performance marketing, growth, or acquisitions roles, ideally with ownership of funnel metrics (CAC, conversion rate, ROI).

Experience planning or coordinating client events, roadshows, or acquisition campaigns.

Experience in partnerships, business development, or value engineering roles.

Familiarity with AI or conversational AI technologies.

Prior 0-1 startup or fast-paced high-growth environment experience.

Success Metrics

Client acquisition cost (CAC) and lead-to-client conversion rate

Number and ROI of events/campaigns run

Time to on-board client account

% of onboarding cases resolved within target timeframe

Number of timely account / portfolio reviews

Number of aged/escalated cases

On-boarding TAT:

TAT from Operations for key client topics

Average time from document receipt to account activation, measured against SLA targets.

Qualifications

Proficiency in verbal and written English.

2 to 4 years of relevant experience; based in Singapore, full-time, 5 days a week in office.

Domain knowledge in Wealth Management is a plus.

Experience with performance marketing tools and analytics (e.g., GA4, Meta/Google Ads, CRM reporting) is a plus.

Working knowledge of KYC/AML regulations and onboarding documentation requirements.

Proficiency with CRM and onboarding/workflow systems (e.g., Salesforce, proprietary onboarding platforms), with hands-on experience running campaigns on MoEngage (or similar marketing automation/CRM platforms).

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; comfortable managing multiple campaigns and cases simultaneously.

Ability to do process gap identification and support with process streamlining.

title: Business Development Executive/ Manager
description:
Top performers in this role don't wait for opportunities—they create them.

At Qashier, we're building the leading all-in-one commerce platform for SMEs across Southeast Asia. We're looking for competitive, resilient sales hunters who love winning new business, thrive in the field, and are motivated by uncapped earnings.

This is a true new business acquisition role.

There are no warm leads to inherit. Success comes from building your own pipeline, creating opportunities every day, and consistently closing merchants through disciplined outbound execution.

If you're someone who enjoys hearing "yes" because you've earned it—not because the lead was handed to you—this role is for you.

What You'll Own

You will own the entire sales cycle—from prospecting to signed merchant.

Specifically, you will:

Build and manage your own pipeline through cold calls, walk-ins, Google Maps prospecting, referrals, networking, and creative outbound outreach.
Consistently execute high outbound activity (40+ quality prospecting touches daily) to generate new business opportunities.
Meet SME owners face-to-face, understand how they operate, identify business challenges, and recommend the right Qashier solution.
Sell a complete commerce platform combining POS, integrated payments, QR payments, loyalty, e-invoicing, and merchant solutions that help businesses operate more efficiently.
Own your sales metrics including pipeline health, activity levels, conversion rates, revenue, and forecast accuracy.
Conduct compelling product demonstrations, negotiate commercial terms, and confidently close new merchant partnerships.
Partner closely with our Operations and Account Management teams to ensure a seamless merchant onboarding experience.
Continuously improve your sales process, messaging, and prospecting strategy to consistently outperform your targets.

What Makes Someone Successful Here

Our highest performers consistently demonstrate the following:

Hunter mentality — You enjoy winning new business and take pride in opening doors that others cannot.
Bias for action — When pipeline is low, your instinct is to increase activity, not wait for better leads.
Commercial judgment — You know where your time creates the greatest return and prioritize opportunities that matter.
Resilience — Rejection fuels you. Every "no" simply gets you closer to the next "yes."
Consultative selling — You ask thoughtful questions, understand each merchant's business, and tailor solutions rather than relying on generic pitches.
Coachability — You actively seek feedback, adapt quickly, and continuously improve.
Ownership mindset — You treat your territory like your own business and take accountability for your results.
Strong communication — You communicate with confidence, clarity, and credibility across merchants from different industries.

What We're Looking For
2–5 years of experience in B2B field sales, merchant acquisition, business development, or outbound sales.
Consistent track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets.
Comfortable spending most of your time in the field meeting merchants.
Proven ability to build your own pipeline through outbound prospecting.
Experience selling to SMEs is highly preferred.
Strong English communication skills. Mandarin is an advantage for serving a broader merchant base.
Based in Singapore and willing to travel within your assigned territory.
Experience in merchant acquiring, fintech, payments, POS, SaaS, business banking, telecommunications, ERP, HRIS, CRM, or other B2B technology solutions is highly advantageous.
Strong sales professionals from adjacent industries with a proven hunter mindset are encouraged to apply.

What You'll Get
Competitive base salary.
Uncapped commission with no ceiling on earnings.
Opportunity to sell one of Southeast Asia's leading all-in-one commerce platforms for SMEs.
Clear career progression based on performance—not tenure.
Ownership from Day One with real impact on company growth.
Flexi Benefits covering health, wellbeing, productivity, learning, travel, and lifestyle expenses.
Hybrid working environment with the flexibility to perform at your best.
Opportunity to work alongside ambitious, high-performing teammates across Southeast Asia.

description:
Job Title: International B2B Sales & Export Executive – Electronics

*Company:* JK IMPORT AND EXPORT PTE LTD
*Job Type:* Full-time
*Industry:* International Trading, Electronics, Import & Export
*Experience Required:* 3–5 years or more in international B2B sales and export operations

About Our Company

JK IMPORT AND EXPORT PTE LTD is an international trading and export company specialising in sourcing, supplying, and exporting electronics, electrical products, consumer goods, and other products to international markets.

We work with manufacturers, suppliers, distributors, wholesalers, and corporate buyers across multiple international markets.

We are looking for an experienced and proactive professional who has worked in an export house, international trading company, or export-oriented manufacturing company and can independently manage international B2B sales alongside export operations and shipment coordination.

Job Responsibilities

*1. International B2B Sales & Business Development*

* Develop new international customers, distributors, wholesalers, importers, and corporate buyers for electronics and electrical products.
* Identify new business opportunities in international markets, including Africa, the Middle East, Asia, and other export markets.
* Generate leads, contact potential customers, follow up on enquiries, and convert enquiries into confirmed orders.
* Prepare quotations, proforma invoices, commercial offers, and sales proposals.
* Negotiate prices, payment terms, delivery schedules, and other commercial conditions with international customers.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing customers and develop long-term business opportunities.
* Coordinate with manufacturers and suppliers to obtain product specifications, pricing, samples, and delivery timelines.

*2. Export Documentation & Shipment Management*

* Independently manage the export process from order confirmation until shipment dispatch and document submission.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, shipping lines, transporters, customs brokers, and other logistics service providers.
* Arrange sea freight, air freight, and other international shipping requirements.
* Obtain and compare freight quotations and negotiate competitive shipping rates.
* Coordinate shipment bookings, container loading, cargo collection, and shipment schedules.
* Prepare and verify commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, shipping instructions, and other applicable export documents.
* Coordinate with customs brokers and relevant parties for export declarations and customs clearance.
* Track shipments and keep customers informed about dispatch dates, estimated arrival times, and shipment status.
* Follow up on bills of lading, airway bills, and other shipping documents as applicable.

*3. Third-Party Inspection & Quality Control Coordination*

* Coordinate third-party inspections with inspection agencies such as SGS, Bureau Veritas, Intertek, or other approved inspection companies, as required by the customer or contract.
* Arrange pre-shipment inspections and factory inspections where applicable.
* Coordinate inspection schedules with manufacturers, suppliers, and inspection agencies.
* Ensure products are ready for inspection according to customer specifications, purchase orders, and agreed quality requirements.
* Follow up on inspection reports, test reports, quality certificates, and other required documents.
* Coordinate corrective actions with suppliers in case of inspection failures, discrepancies, or quality issues.
* Ensure shipments meet the applicable contractual and destination-market requirements before dispatch.

*4. Supplier & Order Coordination*

* Liaise with electronics manufacturers, factories, and suppliers to confirm order details, production schedules, quantities, and delivery dates.
* Monitor order progress and ensure goods are ready for inspection and shipment on time.
* Coordinate product specifications, labelling, packaging, carton markings, and shipping requirements.
* Resolve supplier delays, shipment discrepancies, documentation errors, and other export-related issues.
* Maintain proper records of purchase orders, sales orders, supplier quotations, inspection reports, and shipping documents.

*5. Customer Service & Sales Reporting*

* Maintain regular communication with international customers regarding quotations, orders, inspections, and shipments.
* Follow up on outstanding quotations and pending orders.
* Maintain accurate customer, supplier, and shipment records.
* Prepare regular reports on sales enquiries, confirmed orders, shipment status, and new business opportunities.
* Work towards achieving sales targets and improving export business performance.

Requirements

* Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in international B2B sales, export operations, or international trading.
* Previous experience working in an export house, international trading company, export-oriented manufacturing company, or electronics export business is strongly preferred.
* Practical knowledge of export procedures, international shipping, freight forwarding, and export documentation.
* Experience coordinating third-party inspections and pre-shipment inspections.
* Working knowledge of shipping lines, freight forwarders, customs brokers, container shipments, and shipment bookings.
* Understanding of Incoterms, including EXW, FOB, CFR, CIF, and other applicable trade terms.
* Good understanding of commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, certificates of origin, and other relevant export documents.
* Experience dealing with international customers, overseas suppliers, and logistics service providers.
* Strong negotiation, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple customer orders and shipments simultaneously.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, email communication, and basic reporting.
* Self-motivated, organised, responsible, and capable of working independently.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience exporting electronics, electrical products, consumer electronics, or electrical appliances.
* Experience managing exports to Africa, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, or other international markets.
* Experience coordinating with manufacturers in China.
* Experience handling container shipments, consolidated cargo, and international freight arrangements.
* Familiarity with export compliance, product certifications, destination-country requirements, and customer-specific inspection requirements.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who understands the complete export business cycle, from finding international B2B customers and negotiating orders to coordinating suppliers, arranging third-party inspections, managing freight forwarders, and ensuring goods are shipped with the correct documentation.

The ideal candidate should be able to take ownership of an order and coordinate the entire process without requiring constant supervision.

*Candidates with practical experience in an export house or international trading company will be given preference.*

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit their updated CV, highlighting their experience in international B2B sales, export documentation, third-party inspections, freight forwarding, shipping coordination, and electronics exports.

Coordinate with internal teams on product development, pricing, availability, order fulfilment and partner requirements.

Prepare regular reports on market opportunities, sales performance, partnership progress and business development activities.

Conduct market research and business visits to identify potential customers, evaluate commercial opportunities and strengthen partner relationships.

Travel regionally when required for business meetings, market research, customer visits and partnership development.

Relevant qualifications in Business Administration, Business Development, Marketing, International Business, Food & Beverage Management or a related field.

Relevant experience in F&B business development, product sales, food concept development, strategic partnerships or commercial management.

Good understanding of the F&B industry, including food products, menu concepts, sales channels, distribution and customer preferences.

Experience in identifying new business opportunities, developing commercial proposals, negotiating partnerships and managing customer relationships.

Ability to evaluate market trends and translate business opportunities into practical food concepts, product offerings and commercial initiatives.

Strong business development, negotiation, communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.

Good written and spoken English for business communication.

Proficiency in spoken Tagalog and Bahasa Indonesia to facilitate direct communication, commercial discussions and effective working relationships with strategic partners in the Philippines and business contacts in Indonesia.

Strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and business priorities.

A proactive and entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to develop new ideas, build partnerships and pursue sustainable business growth.

Willingness to travel regionally when required.

Strategic business development and opportunity identification.

F&B product sales and commercial growth.

Food concept development and market adaptation.

Strategic partnership management and relationship building.

Regional market research and business expansion.

Commercial negotiation and stakeholder communication.

The Singapore Mint was established in 1968 to mint circulation coins for the newly-independent nation. Over the years, The Singapore Mint has evolved from a basic minting facility to a fully integrated business operation, comprising programme concept, product design, marketing, sales and distribution with after sales service. Focusing on quality system and standards, The Singapore Mint is a certified ISO 9001 and 14001 organisation. Today, it has grown to become one of the leading innovative mints in the industry, capable of producing coins and medallions of the highest quality.

Leveraging on technology, The Singapore Mint has developed hybrid techniques to create high security and innovative features on circulation and commemorative coins and collectables. Fusing advanced minting technologies with authentic crafting methods, The Singapore Mint is one of the few mints in the world that still maintains a team of highly skilled craftsmen, adding intricate elements that can only be meticulously achieved by the human touch.

As a testament of its high quality crafting techniques, The Singapore Mint has won multiple international awards and its rising stature has garnered much interest internationally. The mint has been appointed by issuing authorities around the world for the production of their coins.

Other than producing coins and medallions, The Singapore Mint has also expanded to provide quality currency-related gifts and collectibles, lifestyle products and services to both local and international markets. We continue to pledge our unwavering commitment to our customers, business associates and partners to offer the best in quality, value and service.

The Singapore Mint (Singapore Precision Industries Pte Ltd) is a fully owned subsidiary of Sembcorp Industries.

title: Brand Protection Lead – Asia Pacific

description:
We’re Hiring | Brand Protection Lead – Asia Pacific

Employment Type:

Full-time

Regional Scope:

Asia Pacific

Reporting To:

Executive Director, TAPA APAC

About the Role:

TAPA APAC is seeking an experienced Brand Protection professional to lead stakeholder engagement, programme adoption and regional growth of its established Brand Protection programme and standards.

The role requires credible industry relationships and the ability to turn engagement into practical collaboration, programme adoption and membership growth. You will serve as the dedicated relationship owner across

Brand Owners, Logistics Service Providers (LSPs), Customs and Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs)

.

This is a hands-on role requiring sustained external engagement, proactive follow-up and measurable results. Applicants must demonstrate relevant industry experience and direct stakeholder ownership.

Key Responsibilities:

Brand Owner and Industry Engagement

Build and maintain trusted relationships with Brand Owners, manufacturers, intellectual property rights holders and corporate Brand Protection, security and investigations teams.

Identify stakeholder needs, adoption barriers and opportunities for collaboration.

Develop and manage a qualified pipeline of prospective Brand Owner participants and members.

LSP Engagement and Programme Adoption

Engage logistics providers and supply-chain security stakeholders to drive participation in TAPA APAC’s Brand Protection programme.

Connect Brand Owners with relevant LSPs to support practical adoption and collaborative outcomes.

Own the engagement process from prospecting and needs assessment through to adoption, membership conversion and ongoing relationship management.

Customs and Law Enforcement Collaboration

Develop and sustain relationships with Customs, LEAs and relevant government stakeholders across APAC.

Facilitate lawful information-sharing, industry dialogue, stakeholder briefings and capacity-building activities.

Coordinate public-private collaboration addressing counterfeiting, illicit trade, product diversion and related supply-chain risks.

Membership Growth and Commercial Contribution

Deliver agreed targets for Buyer and LSP Brand Protection memberships and associated revenue.

Identify opportunities for training, certification, events, sponsorship and broader industry participation.

Maintain clear stakeholder plans, engagement pipelines and follow-up actions.

Industry Consultation and Internal Coordination

Organise stakeholder meetings, roundtables and regional consultation activities.

Maintain structured records of stakeholder feedback, emerging issues and programme improvement opportunities.

Support periodic standards reviews through consultation, user feedback and practical-operability validation.

Work with CREATE on technical interpretation and standards matters, and AMPLIFY on intelligence, communications and events. Technical drafting and standards governance remain with CREATE.

Performance and Reporting

Maintain accurate, current CRM records covering stakeholder ownership, engagement stage, next actions and outcomes.

Report on programme adoption, institutional engagement, membership conversion and commercial contribution.

Represent TAPA APAC at relevant industry conferences and regional stakeholder meetings.

Essential Experience and Capabilities:

To be considered, applicants must demonstrate:

At least five years of directly relevant experience

in Brand Protection, corporate or supply-chain security, investigations, Customs or law enforcement, or closely related industry engagement roles.

Direct responsibility for managing external stakeholder relationships

, with specific examples of sustained engagement and results.

Established professional relationships with Brand Owners and/or Customs or LEAs

, together with the ability to engage logistics and supply-chain stakeholders credibly.

A working understanding of counterfeiting, illicit trade, product diversion and supply-chain operations.

Experience translating stakeholder needs into programme participation, partnerships, adoption or other measurable outcomes.

Strong prospecting, presentation, facilitation, negotiation and follow-up skills.

Disciplined CRM, pipeline management, documentation and reporting practices.

The ability to work independently, manage regional priorities and remain accountable for agreed KPIs.

Professional proficiency in English and willingness to travel across APAC.

Strongly Preferred:

Direct experience across

at least two

of the following stakeholder groups:

Brand Owners, LSPs, Customs/LEAs

.

Experience engaging senior corporate or institutional stakeholders across multiple APAC markets.

Demonstrated membership conversion, business development or programme commercialisation outcomes.

Experience facilitating public-private partnerships, industry consultations or standards adoption.

Additional Asian-language capabilities.

A relevant degree or equivalent professional experience.

Relevant backgrounds include Brand Owner Brand Protection or corporate security teams, Customs or law enforcement, LSP security functions, and specialist Brand Protection, investigations or risk consultancies.

Applicants whose experience is primarily in general sales, marketing or administration must also demonstrate substantial, directly relevant Brand Protection or supply-chain security experience and stakeholder relationships.

How Success Will Be Measured

Performance will be assessed against agreed objectives covering:

Brand Owner and LSP engagement and programme adoption.

Customs/LEA relationships and collaborative outcomes.

Buyer and LSP membership conversion and revenue contribution.

Industry consultation and actionable standards feedback.

CRM accuracy, follow-through and reporting discipline.

What We Offer

Ownership of a regional Brand Protection engagement and adoption agenda.

Direct collaboration with TAPA APAC’s Executive Director and industry leadership.

Access to an established international supply-chain security community.

Opportunities to work with multinational Brand Owners, logistics providers and government stakeholders across APAC.

How to Apply

We welcome applications from experienced professionals who are passionate about brand protection, industry collaboration, and strengthening supply chain security across Asia Pacific.

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV, together with a brief summary of their relevant experience, particularly any prior engagement with brand owners, LEAs, customs authorities, and regional industry programmes.

Please describe stakeholder relationships without disclosing confidential information.

Email To: secretariat@tapa-apac.org

Subject:

Application – Brand Protection Lead, APAC

Website:

TAPA APAC

Shortlisting will focus on demonstrated domain experience, stakeholder credibility and evidence of delivery.

The Leading Association for Global Supply Chain Resilience & Sustainability

The Transported Asset Protection Association (TAPA) is the leading global association that unites supply chain industry leaders and organizations with the common aim of upholding the highest standards of supply chain resilience and sustainability.

Today, in Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA), The Americas and Asia Pacific (APAC), TAPA’s membership is at its highest ever level – and growing month-on-month. The Association’s members include many of the world’s leading manufacturing brands as well as their logistics and transport providers with combined annual sales of over US$900 billion.

At Asia Pacific, TAPA APAC is the fastest growing supply chain community of over 1000 member companies, government agencies and custom partners in the region.

TAPA APAC members include:

Manufacturers & Shippers;

Logistic Service Providers;

Security Service Providers;

Insurance Providers;

Parking Place Operators;

Independent Audit Bodies;

Law Enforcement Agencies, Government Entities & Customs Partners;

Academic Partners and others.

Mission

To minimize cargo losses from the supply chain. TAPA achieves this through the development and application of global security standards, recognized industry practices, technology, education, benchmarking, regulatory collaboration, and the proactive identification of crime trends and supply chain security threats

Vision

TAPA’s vision is an international supply chain where controlled and traceable product can be transported in a cost efficient and secure environment.

title: Internship: Group Human Resources, People Analytics and Engagement, HR Marketing and Communications [Jan to May 2027]
description:
WHO WE ARE:

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

 Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

 We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

Why join

Help shape how OCBC engages, inspires, and connects with current and future talent. As an HR Marketing & Communications Intern, you'll be part of a team that brings our employer brand to life through compelling content, digital campaigns, employee engagement initiatives, and internal communications. You'll have the opportunity to develop your skills in marketing, storytelling, content creation, and event management while contributing to initiatives that strengthen OCBC's culture and employee experience.

How you succeed

To excel in this role, you'll need to be creative, detail-oriented, and passionate about communications and branding. You'll work closely with stakeholders across Human Resources to create engaging content, support digital marketing efforts, and deliver impactful employee engagement initiatives. Your ability to communicate effectively, think creatively, and manage multiple projects simultaneously will help you drive meaningful engagement across a variety of audiences.

What you do

Your responsibilities will include:

Employer Branding: support initiatives that strengthen OCBC's employer brand across internal and external platforms
Content Creation: develop engaging content for recruitment campaigns, employer branding initiatives, learning and development programmes, and employee engagement activities
Recruitment Marketing: assist in crafting messaging and content for recruitment advertisements, talent attraction campaigns, and hiring initiatives
Digital Media Production: support the planning and creative direction of photography, videography, and other multimedia content for HR-related communications
Social Media Management: create and manage content for social media platforms, blogs, and digital channels to enhance audience engagement
Internal Communications: assist in developing articles, newsletters, announcements, and communication materials that support organisational initiatives and employee engagement
Digital Marketing: maintain and update content across HR websites, intranet platforms, and social media channels to ensure content remains relevant and impactful
Events Management: support the planning, coordination, and execution of employee engagement events, town halls, campaigns, and other HR initiatives
Project Coordination: work with various stakeholders to manage timelines, coordinate activities, and support the successful delivery of communications and engagement projects
Ad-hoc Tasks: provide support on employer branding, communications, marketing, and engagement initiatives as assigned

Who you work with

The HR Marketing & Communications team sits within People Analytics & Engagement and plays a key role in shaping the employee and candidate experience at OCBC. You'll work alongside HR professionals, marketing specialists, designers, and business stakeholders to deliver meaningful communications and engagement initiatives that support recruitment, learning and development, culture-building, and employee experience across the organisation.

Who you are
Open to learning and feedback
Strong interest in marketing, communications, employer branding, and employee engagement
Creative with an eye for detail and visual storytelling
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Comfortable creating content across different communication channels and formats
Familiarity with social media platforms and digital marketing concepts
Good organisational and project coordination skills
Able to manage multiple priorities and timelines effectively
Proactive, resourceful, and eager to learn
Able to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team
Experience in content marketing, social media management, event management, or project coordination would be advantageous
Currently pursuing an undergraduate or postgraduate degree
Available to commit to the full internship period

Learning Objectives

This internship will provide you with:

Exposure to employer branding and talent attraction strategies within a leading financial institution
Hands-on experience developing content for recruitment marketing, employee engagement, and internal communications
Opportunities to strengthen social media marketing and digital content creation skills
Exposure to employee engagement initiatives and culture-building programmes
Experience supporting end-to-end event planning and execution
Opportunities to develop stakeholder management, project coordination, and communication skills
Exposure to photography, videography, and multimedia content planning for corporate communications
Experience managing content across digital platforms, including websites, intranet platforms, newsletters, and social media channels
A deeper understanding of how employer branding, communications, and employee engagement contribute to building a strong organisational culture and employee experience
Practical experience working on impactful projects that influence how employees and candidates experience OCBC's employer brand and culture

What we offer:

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

title: HR Executive / Senior HR Executive
description:
HR Executive / Senior HR Executive

AMICI Events & Catering Pte Ltd

About the Role

We are seeking a proactive, organised and process-driven HR Executive / Senior HR Executive to oversee our human resource operations and support the continued growth of our business.

Operating across events, catering and ready-to-eat (RTE) food production, our workforce comprises corporate employees, kitchen and production personnel, and part-time or casual event crew.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing day-to-day HR operations, strengthening HR policies and procedures, improving workforce management systems, and supporting organisational development.

This role reports directly to the Chief Financial Officer.

Key Responsibilities

1. HR Operations & Process Improvement

Review, develop and implement HR policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and employee lifecycle processes.

Standardise recruitment, onboarding, attendance, leave administration, payroll coordination and offboarding procedures.

Identify opportunities to improve HR efficiency, documentation and internal controls.

Support management in reviewing organisational structures, reporting lines, job responsibilities and career progression frameworks.

2. Workforce Management & Payroll

Administer and optimise StaffAny for employee scheduling, attendance tracking and timesheet management.

Monitor employee attendance, working hours, overtime, rest days and shift arrangements.

Consolidate and verify attendance records for monthly payroll processing.

Manage payroll-related variables, including overtime, night shifts and part-time or casual labour payments.

Ensure accurate and timely maintenance of workforce and payroll records.

3. Recruitment & Talent Management

Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including job advertisements, candidate screening, interview coordination, onboarding and employee documentation.

Coordinate recruitment for corporate, kitchen, production, operations and event-related positions.

Develop and maintain a pool of part-time, freelance and casual event personnel to support operational requirements.

Work closely with department heads on manpower planning and recruitment needs.

4. HR Compliance & Employee Administration

Ensure HR practices comply with applicable Singapore employment legislation and statutory requirements, including MOM regulations, the Employment Act and CPF obligations.

Maintain accurate employee records, employment documentation and HR databases.

Administer employee leave, insurance, medical claims and other employment-related matters.

Monitor applicable employee training, medical checks and food hygiene certification requirements.

Support HR reporting, recordkeeping and compliance documentation.

5. Employee Relations & Performance Management

Handle employee enquiries, grievances and workplace matters professionally and confidentially.

Support department heads in managing employee performance, disciplinary processes and employee development.

Promote consistent HR practices and effective communication between management and employees.

Requirements

Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration or a related discipline.

3–7 years of relevant HR generalist experience.

Experience in F&B, hospitality, catering, events or food manufacturing will be an advantage.

Good working knowledge of Singapore employment legislation, MOM regulations and CPF requirements.

Experience using StaffAny or similar workforce management systems is preferred.

Familiarity with payroll processing, attendance management, recruitment and HR administration.

Experience developing HR policies, SOPs or employee handbooks will be advantageous.

Strong communication, organisational, problem-solving and interpersonal skills.

Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and coordinate with different departments.

Comfortable supporting a workforce comprising full-time, part-time and casual employees.

What We Are Looking For

We value candidates who are hands-on, detail-oriented and capable of improving existing processes while managing everyday HR responsibilities.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a dynamic operational environment and collaborating with both frontline employees and senior management.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to submit their applications and updated resumes through MyCareersFuture.

title: Senior Marketing Executive / Assistant Manager, Marketing & Communications
description:
About the Role

OaksPlus Limited is seeking a proactive, creative and results-driven marketing professional to join our Marketing & Communications team as a Senior Marketing Executive or Assistant Manager.

This role will focus primarily on growing the visibility, brand presence and enrolment opportunities of 7oaks Preschool through integrated digital and offline marketing initiatives.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing digital marketing campaigns and agency relationships, driving social media and content strategies, overseeing website content, developing marketing communications materials and building corporate partnerships.

We are looking for someone who combines creative thinking with strong execution capabilities, is comfortable working with data and can independently drive marketing initiatives from planning through to implementation and performance evaluation.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is both a strategic thinker and a hands-on executor — someone who can translate marketing plans into well-executed campaigns and measurable outcomes.

You should be comfortable managing agencies and external partners, working with internal stakeholders, analysing campaign results and taking the initiative to improve performance.

Above all, you should have a strong sense of ownership, attention to detail and a genuine interest in building brands that connect meaningfully with families.

Key Responsibilities

1. Digital Marketing & Agency Management

Plan, coordinate and execute integrated digital marketing campaigns across platforms including Google, Meta and other relevant channels to drive brand awareness, enquiries and enrolments.

Manage external digital marketing agencies, including campaign briefs, creative development, budgets, timelines, performance reviews and optimisation.

Monitor campaign performance against agreed KPIs, including website traffic, leads, cost per lead (CPL), lead quality and enrolment conversions.

Work closely with agencies to identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness, return on investment and marketing efficiency.

Prepare regular performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.

2. Social Media & Content Management

Develop and manage social media content plans and calendars across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.

Plan and execute engaging content that showcases the preschool's curriculum, learning experiences, educators, community engagement and brand proposition.

Oversee content creation, including copywriting, graphic design, photography and short-form video production.

Coordinate content gathering with preschool centres and internal stakeholders to ensure a consistent flow of relevant and engaging content.

Monitor social media performance, audience engagement and emerging trends to continuously improve content effectiveness.

Maintain consistent brand messaging, visual identity and quality across all social media platforms.

3. Website Management & Digital Presence

Manage and maintain the 7oaks Preschool website using WordPress, ensuring content is accurate, relevant and regularly updated.

Oversee updates to website pages, campaign landing pages, blog articles, promotional content and calls to action.

Coordinate with web developers and external vendors on website enhancements, maintenance and technical issues.

Monitor website performance using tools such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console and other relevant analytics platforms.

Work with agencies and vendors to improve search engine visibility, website user experience and lead generation effectiveness.

Support ongoing website enhancement and revamp initiatives where required.

4. Marketing Communications & Brand Management

Plan and execute marketing communications initiatives across digital and offline channels, ensuring alignment with brand positioning and business objectives.

Develop and coordinate marketing collaterals, including brochures, flyers, posters, banners, digital advertisements, out-of-home (OOH) advertising and promotional materials.

Support corporate communications and internal branding requirements, including staff event collaterals, Dinner & Dance materials, annual reports, presentations and internal announcements.

Liaise with creative agencies, printers, media owners and other vendors to ensure timely and cost-effective production of marketing materials.

Maintain brand consistency across all communications touchpoints.

Support public relations, community outreach and other brand-building opportunities as required.

5. Corporate Partnerships & Community Outreach

Identify and develop corporate partnership opportunities to increase brand awareness, generate qualified leads and support preschool enrolment.

Establish and maintain relationships with companies, community organisations and other relevant partners.

Develop partnership proposals, promotional arrangements and joint marketing initiatives.

Coordinate corporate outreach activities, roadshows and partnership activations.

Track partnership activities, leads generated and outcomes to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.

6. Campaigns, Events & Performance Reporting

Plan and coordinate marketing support for preschool open houses, Discovery Days, roadshows, enrolment drives and other events.

Work closely with centre leaders and internal stakeholders to ensure marketing initiatives support centre-specific enrolment priorities.

Track marketing performance across channels, including leads, centre visit registrations, visit attendance and enrolment conversions.

Maintain campaign budgets, timelines, marketing calendars and performance reports.

Identify gaps in performance and recommend corrective actions to improve results.

Support other marketing and communications initiatives as assigned.

Requirements

Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Business, Digital Marketing or a related discipline.

Senior Executive: Preferably 3–5 years of relevant marketing experience.

Assistant Manager: Preferably 5–7 years of relevant marketing experience, with demonstrated ownership of marketing campaigns and agency relationships.

Strong hands-on experience in digital marketing, including paid advertising, campaign coordination, agency management and performance tracking.

Proven experience managing social media channels, content calendars and creative production.

Practical experience managing websites using WordPress or a similar CMS; familiarity with basic SEO and website analytics.

Good understanding of digital marketing metrics, including CPL, conversion rates, website traffic and campaign ROI.

Strong writing and communication skills, with the ability to develop compelling marketing content and coordinate with diverse stakeholders.

Good eye for design and familiarity with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar tools.

Experience in offline marketing, collateral production, vendor coordination and event management.

Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and competing deadlines.

Resourceful, proactive and solutions-oriented, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables.

Experience in the education, preschool or family-oriented services sector will be an advantage.

The appointment level will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and capabilities.

Oaks Plus Limited (hereafter known as “OPL”) is a Company Limited by Guarantee (CLG) with Charity status that is committed to assisting underprivileged kids and their families. As one of the appointed operators under ECDA's Partner Operator Scheme, we believe that every child should have equal access to opportunities in learning and education and reach their maximum potential in life regardless of their socioeconomic status.

OPL has experience in serving Singapore’s multi-racial community. Presently, OPL owns and operates 7oaks Preschool centres, offering affordable and quality early childhood offerings that encompass a robust curriculum, highly qualified educators and centre leaders, and standards in line with the SPARK accreditation.

OPL has in place an experienced management committee comprising of the Board of Directors and the preschool management team who brings together a myriad of experience and expertise in the day-to-day running of the company and the curation of OPL early childhood strategies.

OPL also works closely with regulatory agencies such as ECDA and MSF to ensure compliance with legal and licensing regulations of its preschool centres.

title: Brand & Marketing Manager
description:
We are lookingfor a hands-on Brand & Marketing Manager to grow our clinics across thevarious locations.

Prepare regular reports on advertising expenditure, enquiries, bookings, attended appointments and campaign performance.

Analyze the effectiveness of marketing activities and identify opportunities for improvement.

Where data is available, track treatment conversion and revenue attributable to marketing campaigns.

Recommend marketing priorities and budget allocation based on measurable results.

Work with management to establish clear campaign objectives, KPIs and action plans.

Analyse referral, campaign, event,patient-engagement and conversion results and identify practical follow-upactions.

Support the Managements bi-weekly, monthly andquarterly reporting with accurate analysis and clear recommendations.

Maintain oversight of agreed campaign andoutreach trackers and ensure assigned work is closed out.

Other ad-hoc administrative task as assigned by the Management.

Coordinate local marketing initiatives and campaigns tailored to individual clinic locations.

Support patient engagement and brand building initiatives across the business.

Create loyalty and engagement content and community-building initiatives to support CRM.

Plan and support member activities, education sessions and brand-led experiences.

3–6 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, performance marketing or customer acquisition.

Hands on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.

Able to interpret campaign data, manage budgets and make optimization decisions independently.

Strong content planning and social media skills, particularly short-form video and Instagram Reels.

Good communication and coordination skills, with the confidence to work with clinic teams.

Organized, proactive and comfortable managing multiple campaigns and locations.

Strong project ownership, stakeholdermanagement, writing, presentation and analytical skills.

title: Event Sales Executive
description:
Join us on our next chapter of growth at The Brewerkz Group!

This role sits at the heart of our events business — bringing to life memorable experiences across some of Singapore's most iconic F&B brands. Whether it's an intimate dinner at Jiak Kim House, a craft beer celebration at Brewerkz, or a vibrant fiesta at Café Iguana, you'll be the person who makes it happen.

We're looking for a self-driven, personable go-getter who loves building relationships, closing deals, and growing a business. This is a pure sales role — ideal for fresh graduates or individuals with up to a year of experience who are ready to kickstart a career in F&B events and business development. If you thrive on energy, initiative, and people, we'd love to meet you!

Our Brands

Brewerkz

– Singapore's longest-running craft brewery, with six thriving restaurants and a proud Made with Passion brand

Café Iguana

– serving modern Mexican food and a pioneer in Singapore's Mexican dining scene since 2000

Jiak Kim House

– a tribute to modern Asian cuisine housed in a beautifully restored 1920s warehouse along the Singapore River, helmed by Chef-Partner Seow Tzi Qin (TQ)

Responsibilities

This role will report directly to Head of Marketing and work closely with outlet teams, the central marketing team, and external vendors. Your main responsibilities include:

Promote, sell, and secure group bookings and event enquiries

Manage inbound leads, prepare proposals and quotations, handle follow-ups, and confirm event bookings

Conduct site visits and present venue offerings professionally

Coordinate with operations teams to ensure smooth sales handover and execution

Liaise with third-party vendors when required to meet client expectations (e.g. florists, AV, décor)

Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline; track leads and conversions

Maintain accurate sales records and provide reports with insights and recommendations

Drive new business through cold outreach, on-site networking, and proactive client engagement

Deliver excellent pre-sale service that leaves clients excited to come back

Support company initiatives and new projects as and when required

Requirements:

Fresh graduates or candidates with up to 1 year of experience in sales, events, hospitality, or customer-facing roles are welcome

Outgoing and confident communicator with strong interpersonal skills

Highly organised, responsive, and detail-oriented

Independent, proactive, and self-motivated — you don't wait to be told what to do

Able to juggle multiple clients and timelines without dropping the ball

Genuine passion for F&B, hospitality, or events

Candidate should ideally possess a tertiary qualification

The Brewerkz Group is a lifestyle food and beverage company. Our business ranges from craft beer to fine wines, restaurants to beverage distribution. Many of our brands are long established, well known and well loved by our customers.

Over the years, more than a few of our customers have become our close friends. They say it’s tough in the F&B business, but we love the F&B business. It’s where we work, eat and bond over with our families and friends.

title: Marketing Officer
description:
Marketing Officer

Job Purpose

The Marketing Officer supports the planning, coordination, and execution of partnership initiatives, events, sales enablement activities, and marketing campaigns across Stellar Lifestyle and Stellar Ace ecosystem.

The role works closely with sales teams, internal business units, brand partners, sponsors, tenants, merchants, vendors and other stakeholders to develop impactful partnership opportunities, event activations, sales materials and marketing initiatives that drive business growth, brand awareness, customer engagement, and stakeholder value.

Through the successful delivery of collaborations, campaigns, and activations across transit, retail, lifestyle and media platforms, the Marketing Officer plays a key role in supporting revenue opportunities, strengthening partner relationships, and enhancing the Stellar Lifestyle ecosystem.

Responsibilities

Partnerships & Sales Enablement

Support the planning, coordination, and execution of partnership initiatives, sponsorship opportunities, sales pitches and marketing outreach activities.
Assist in the preparation of pitch decks, proposals, presentations, sales kits, and marketing collaterals to support advertising, partnership, and outreach efforts.
Coordinate with partners, sponsors, merchants, tenants, and external stakeholders on deliverables, participation details, and campaign requirements.
Conduct research on market trends, potential partners, sponsorship opportunities, and industry developments to support business growth and team’s planning.
Maintain proper records of sales materials, partner databases, and follow-up documentation.

Events & Activations

Support the planning, coordination and execution of events, partner campaigns, station activations, and engagement programmes.
Liaise with event vendors, venue partners, tenants, station operations teams, and internal departments to ensure smooth event logistics and operational coordination.
Assist in sourcing for event materials, suppliers, vendors, premiums, and other resources while ensuring cost-effectiveness and quality standards.
Support on-site event requirements, including setup, manpower planning, publicity materials, stakeholder briefings and event-day support.
Assist in tracking event deliverables, timelines, budgets and post-event reporting.

Marketing & Communications Support

Support the development of marketing collaterals, campaign materials, communication assets, and promotional content for partnerships and events
Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors on creative assets, publicity materials, digital content, and campaign requirements.

Administrative Support

Provide administrative support for marketing, partnerships, and event-related activities, including scheduling, documentation, filing and coordination.
Assist with procurement processes, including vendor quotations, PR/PO submissions, invoice processing, payment follow-ups and budget tracking.
Maintain organized records of contracts, campaign materials, event documentation, partner correspondence, and supporting documents for audit and reporting purposes.
Perform other duties and ad-hoc tasks as assigned to support departmental operations and business objectives.
Qualifications & Work Experience
Diploma in Marketing, Business, Communications, Events Management, or a related field.
Candidates with 1–2 years of marketing, communications, digital, retail marketing, or campaign management experience are preferred.
Fresh graduates with a positive attitude, strong learning mindset, and relevant internship experience may be considered.
Experience in events, retail marketing, partnerships, media, advertising or stakeholder coordination will be advantageous.
Skills
Coordination Skills: Able to support multiple marketing, partnership, and event-related tasks while keeping track of timelines and deliverables.
Communication Skills: Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills when liaising with internal teams, vendors, partners, tenants, and other stakeholders.
Organisational Skills: Meticulous and structured in managing documentation, schedules, marketing assets, event requirements, and follow-up items.
Marketing Knowledge: Basic understanding of marketing campaigns, events, social media, digital platforms, and customer engagement.
Technical Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Office, Teams, Outlook, PowerPoint, and other commonly used presentation or reporting tools.
Creative and Design Sense: Able to assist with simple presentation layouts, marketing collaterals, and content coordination, with a good eye for detail.
Problem-Solving Attitude: Resourceful, proactive, and willing to learn, with the ability to remain calm and helpful during events or tight timelines.
Team Player: Positive disposition and collaborative mindset, with willingness to support on-site activities and cross-functional initiatives.

Retail and Advertising Solutions & Services Partner

Stellar Lifestyle is the largest managing agent of retail and advertising spaces in Singapore’s rail network. We create vibrant transit destinations through continuous innovation and a desire to make our everyday touchpoints better. Our expertise also includes retail mall management, outdoor media & digital advertising solutions, and digital engagement platforms.

title: Head of Communications & Brand
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

About BW Group

BW Group is a leading global energy and maritime company involved in shipping, deepwater oil & gas production, renewable energy and digital infrastructure. BW controls a fleet of over 400 vessels transporting oil, gas and dry commodities. In the infrastructure space, the group operates in wind, batteries, water, subsea cable networks and data centres.

BW is proud to be listed among Forbes World's Best Employers and Financial Times Best Employers Asia-Pacific 2025.

Are you ready to make an impact?

What drives us is our mission to deliver energy for the world today, and to find solutions for tomorrow. If you want to make lives better around the world by providing access to energy, while working on sustainability and decarbonisation, we'd like to hear from you. Working at BW you will feel the pulse of the world each day. If something happens in the world, we feel it, and you can play your part by anticipating and responding to it. Our high-performing teams are drawn to BW by the global nature of our work and the satisfaction of working with collaborative people who inspire each other to deliver exceptional results.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Role Overview

Based in Singapore and reporting to the Chief People Officer, BW Group, the Head of Communications & Brand leads communications and corporate brand activities across BW Group whilst also supporting BW LNG.

This is a highly visible role partnering closely with the Chairman, senior executives and Communications leaders across our affiliate companies to strengthen BW's reputation, shape its corporate narrative and foster greater collaboration across the Group.

Success requires far more than exceptional communications capability. You will be a commercially minded strategic thinker who anticipates issues, shapes narratives and influences outcomes through sound judgement, trusted relationships and collaboration in a federated organisation where credibility matters more than hierarchy.

Working with a lean team and external partners, you will combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, helping shape executive communications, protect and enhance the BW brand, support organisational transformation and drive communications excellence across the Group.

Key Accountabilities

Corporate Communications

Develop and deliver BW Group's corporate communications strategy aligned with the Group's long-term vision and priorities.

Shape compelling narratives that strengthen understanding of BW's purpose, strategy and portfolio of businesses.

Advise leaders on communications strategy, executive messaging and stakeholder engagement.

Lead communications for strategic initiatives, organisational change, major announcements and corporate events.

Oversee BW Group's digital communications, including LinkedIn and other channels, delivering engaging content that strengthens the brand and supports strategic objectives.

Executive

Communications

Partner closely with the Chairman and senior executives on speeches, presentations, thought leadership and executive communications.

Develop executive communications that reflect BW's values and high editorial standards.

Lead the production of flagship Group communications, including World Horizon, the Annual Report, Sustainability Report, corporate website and key leadership updates.

Support senior executives at conferences, media engagements, investor events and industry forums through end-to-end communications planning and delivery.

Serve as a trusted communications adviser to the Chairman and senior leadership, providing sound judgement on messaging, stakeholder considerations and reputational matters.

Employee

Communications

Lead Group-wide employee communications across digital channels.

Deliver engaging communications that connect shore-based and seafaring employees through platforms such as BW Connect.

Foster a culture of openness, pride and engagement across the Group.

Brand & Reputation

Act as steward of the BW corporate brand, ensuring consistency whilst respecting the autonomy of our affiliate businesses.

Evolve BW's corporate identity and positioning to strengthen the Group's reputation and create value across the portfolio.

Protect and enhance BW's reputation with employees, customers, investors, regulators, partners and the wider maritime and energy community.

Lead crisis and issues communications, partnering with senior management and external advisers as required for ongoing incidents and with post-communications.

BW LNG Communications & Marketing

Partner with the BW LNG leadership team to develop communications and marketing initiatives that strengthen the company's commercial positioning and reputation.

Lead communications supporting commercial initiatives, including vessel launches, technology innovations, customer campaigns and industry events.

Develop marketing content and digital campaigns that showcase BW LNG's capabilities, innovation and market leadership.

Ensure alignment between BW LNG's communications and the wider BW corporate brand.

Leadership & Influence

Lead BW's Communications Community of Practice, fostering collaboration, sharing best practice and identifying opportunities for greater alignment across affiliate companies.

Build trusted relationships with affiliate CEOs and Communications leaders, influencing through credibility rather than authority.

Foster collaboration across the Group whilst respecting the entrepreneurial culture and autonomy of individual businesses.

Digital Communications & AI

Harness AI and emerging technologies to improve the quality, consistency, efficiency and reach of communications.

Identify and implement new tools, channels and approaches that enhance engagement and communications effectiveness.

Measure communications impact using meaningful qualitative and quantitative insights.

Team Leadership

Lead, coach and develop a small, high-performing communications team.

Manage external agencies and specialist partners to maximise quality, capability and value.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

We're looking for someone who combines strategic communications leadership with exceptional judgement and the ability to influence senior stakeholders. You'll ideally bring:

Significant experience leading corporate communications within a global organisation or consultancy.

Experience advising CEOs and senior executives on communications strategy and reputation management.

Strong understanding of corporate branding, stakeholder engagement and executive communications.

Experience leading communications during periods of organisational change, transformation or significant corporate activity.

Experience working across complex, matrixed or federated organisations would be advantageous.

Experience within the maritime or energy sectors would be beneficial, although not essential.

What Will Make You Successful

You'll be someone who naturally earns trust and credibility. You'll demonstrate:

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

Excellent judgement and discretion.

The ability to simplify complex issues into clear, compelling messages.

Exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills.

Strong commercial awareness.

High levels of curiosity and strategic thinking.

Comfort working directly with senior executives and Board-level stakeholders.

A collaborative style with low ego and high integrity.

The ability to balance strategic thinking with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and deliver.

Demonstrates sound judgement in knowing when to follow established processes and when a pragmatic, flexible approach will deliver a better outcome.

A passion for continuous improvement, innovation and practical application of AI.

This role is unlikely to suit someone who prefers highly structured environments, relies on formal authority to get things done, or wants to specialise in a single area of communications. Success requires sound judgement, adaptability, collaboration and a willingness to operate across a broad range of strategic and hands-on responsibilities.

OTHER INFORMATION

Why BW?

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the voice and reputation of one of the world's most respected maritime and energy groups.

You'll work closely with visionary leaders who value integrity, long-term thinking and collaboration, while helping tell the story of a business investing in both today's energy needs and tomorrow's energy transition.

The role offers exceptional breadth, combining strategy, executive partnership, brand leadership, organisational change, employee engagement and external communications in an entrepreneurial international environment.

title: Part-Time Administrative & Client Servicing Assistant
description:
*Job Summary*

We are looking for a reliable, organised and proactive *Part-Time Administrative & Client Servicing Assistant* to support a Financial Consultant with day-to-day client servicing, administrative work, appointment coordination, events, marketing activities and business operations.

This is a varied role suited to someone who enjoys organising information, communicating with clients, following up on outstanding matters and ensuring that tasks are completed properly from start to finish.

You will work closely with the Financial Consultant and assist with both routine administrative duties and ongoing projects. The role requires good attention to detail, initiative and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines independently.

*Key Responsibilities*

*1. Client Servicing & Appointment Management*

* Contact clients through phone, WhatsApp and email for appointment scheduling, reminders and follow-ups.
* Confirm, reschedule and track client appointments and maintain the consultant's calendar.
* Follow up with clients on outstanding forms, documents, payments and administrative matters.
* Assist with policy review appointment outreach and maintain records of previous and upcoming client meetings.
* Maintain client databases, contact information, birthdays, client categories, review dates and engagement history.
* Track client responses and ensure outstanding matters are followed through to completion.

*2. Insurance, Policy & Claims Administration*

* Provide administrative support for policy servicing, claims and general insurance matters.
* Follow up with relevant departments regarding claim status, policy documents and outstanding requirements.
* Assist clients in gathering required documents for claims and policy servicing.
* Maintain claims trackers and monitor ongoing cases until completion.
* Organise policy certificates, insurance documents, settlement letters and related records.
* Update internal insurance and commission tracking spreadsheets and maintain proper filing in Google Drive.
* Create and maintain reminders for policy renewals and outstanding client matters.

*3. Database, Campaign & Reporting Support*

* Maintain and update client listings, lead databases and internal spreadsheets.
* Perform data entry and update campaign information in internal systems.
* Track leads, appointments, client status, event attendance and other business activity.
* Assist with year-end and periodic reporting, including appointment statistics, client movements, claims status and campaign performance.
* Maintain organised and accurate digital records.

*4. Administrative & Operational Support*

* Manage documents, filing, Google Drive folders, emails and digital records.
* Assist with timesheets, payslips, petty cash, receipts, invoices and basic expense tracking.
* Organise office and operational materials when required.
* Maintain Trello task lists, reminders and recurring monthly tasks.

*5. SOP & Process Management*

* Create, document and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for recurring administrative and client-servicing processes.
* Improve filing, tracking and follow-up workflows.
* Create templates, checklists and step-by-step instructions so recurring tasks can be completed consistently.
* Identify outstanding matters and proactively follow up until they are resolved.

*Requirements*

* Good written and verbal communication skills (English and Chinese)
* Comfortable speaking with clients
* Strong attention to detail
* Organised, responsible and able to manage multiple tasks at the same time.
* Able to follow instructions while also working independently and taking initiative.
* Comfortable using Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace, especially Google Sheets, Docs and Drive.
* Comfortable learning systems such as Trello and industry-specific administrative platforms.
* Able to perform basic spreadsheet tracking and data organisation.

*Working Arrangement*

* Part-time
* Minimum 3 days per week, 3–4 hours per working day (or more)
* Flexible schedule

Pay: $11.00 - $14.00 per hour

Expected hours: 9.0 – 35.0 per week

Benefits:
