title: Sales & Marketing Manager / Assistant Manager (Brand & Bakery)
description:
Job Title

Sales & Marketing Manager / Assistant Manager (Brand & Bakery)

Department

Sales & Marketing

Reports To

General Manager (day-to-day); Chief Executive Officer (brand direction)

Direct Reports

Nil – standalone role

Employment Type

Full-time, permanent

Work Location

70 Bendemeer Road #01-03 (Luzerne) and 44 Jalan Merah Saga #01-42 (Chip Bee Gardens), with travel between outlets and to client / vendor sites

Salary Range

Assistant Manager: S$3,300 – S$3,800 Manager: S$3,800 – S$4,300

(Final offer commensurate with experience and portfolio)

1.

Job Purpose

The Sales & Marketing Manager / Assistant Manager owns the full marketing portfolio of Keong Saik Bakery and is accountable for translating the founder’s vision for the brand into a coherent, commercially effective marketing programme across our retail outlets, e-commerce, and corporate / B2B channels.

This is a standalone role. The successful candidate will be the company’s only dedicated marketing resource, and must therefore be equally comfortable setting direction and executing it personally – from building and maintaining the marketing framework and managing the marketing budget, through to shooting content, briefing printers, and installing collateral at outlet level.

The role suits a self-motivated individual who is energised by building something from the ground up in a small, fast-moving business, and who understands that marketing is ultimately accountable for commercial outcomes and not activity alone.

2.

Key Responsibilities

a. Marketing Framework& Brand Direction

i.

Framework Ownership:

Develop, document, and own the company’s marketing framework, covering brand positioning, target audience, channel strategy, content pillars, campaign calendar, and partnership approach.

ii.

Relevance & Refresh:

Review and refresh the framework at least annually, and on an ad hoc basis where market conditions require, so that it remains relevant to consumer trends, competitor activity, and the company’s commercial priorities.

iii.

Alignment to Brand Vision:

Ensure all marketing direction, tone of voice, and visual identity remain aligned with the founder’s vision for the brand. Where the post-holder wishes to evolve the brand expression, this is to be proposed to and agreed with the Chief Executive Officer and General Manager before execution.

iv.

Campaign Planning:

Translate the framework into a rolling campaign calendar covering seasonal and festive campaigns, product launches, and always-on activity, with sufficient lead time for production and operational readiness.

b. Digital Content Creation

i.

Content Production:

Plan, shoot, and edit all digital content – photography, videography, and short-form video – for social media, website, e-commerce, and third-party delivery platforms.

ii.

Visual Storytelling:

Lead and conduct all product and lifestyle photoshoots, coordinating with the kitchen, outlet teams, and external vendors as required.

iii.

Copywriting:

Write all brand-facing copy, including social captions, EDM content, website and product descriptions, menu copy, and campaign messaging.

iv.

Asset Management:

Maintain an organised content and asset library so that approved images, videos, and copy are readily retrievable by the wider team.

c. Physical Marketing Materials

i.

Design:

Design all physical marketing collateral, including menus, posters, banners, buntings, flyers, table talkers, packaging inserts, and point-of-sale displays.

ii.

Print & Vendor Management:

Source, brief, and manage print and fabrication vendors – obtaining quotations, checking proofs and colour accuracy, and controlling cost and lead times.

iii.

Installation & Upkeep:

Take personal responsibility for the installation, rotation, and upkeep of physical collateral at both outlets, ensuring displays are current, correctly sited, and in good condition. This is a hands-on responsibility and not one that is delegated to outlet teams by default.

iv.

Approvals:

Obtain any landlord, building management, or regulatory approvals required for external signage, displays, or promotional installations.

d. Marketing Budget

i.

Budget Development:

Propose an annual marketing budget, broken down by channel, campaign, and expense category, for approval by the General Manager and Chief Executive Officer.

ii.

Budget Management:

Manage spend against the approved budget, maintain a live spend tracker, and flag anticipated variances in advance rather than in retrospect.

iii.

Return on Spend:

Justify marketing spend against expected commercial return, and reallocate budget away from underperforming activity where the evidence supports doing so.

iv.

Cost Control:

Negotiate rates and terms with vendors, media partners, platforms, and collaborators.

e. Sales Development &Lead Management

i.

Lead Generation:

Identify and pursue corporate, catering, gifting, event-planner, and community sales opportunities through outreach, networking, and partnerships.

ii.

Enquiry Management:

Manage incoming sales and event enquiries end-to-end – response, quotation, follow-up, and conversion – within agreed response timelines.

iii.

Client Relationships:

Build and maintain relationships with prospective and existing corporate clients to support repeat business and long-term accounts.

iv.

Opportunity Tracking:

Maintain an organised lead and opportunity tracker capturing enquiry source, status, value, and conversion outcome, to support forecasting and reporting.

v.

Operational Coordination:

Coordinate with outlet managers and the kitchen to confirm that corporate orders, catering, and event bookings are operationally deliverable before commitments are made to the client.

f. Community &Partnerships

i.

Partnership Development:

Identify and develop brand partnerships, collaborations, and co- marketing opportunities that extend reach without proportional increases in spend.

ii.

Media & Creators

:

Manage relationships with media, food publications, influencers, and content creators, including hosting and briefing.

iii.

Social Media &Community:

Maintain a consistent and timely presence across all company social media accounts, including community management of comments, direct messages, and public reviews.

iv.

On-the-Ground Coordination:

Work with outlet managers and frontline staff to capture authentic in-store content and to ensure campaigns are executed correctly and consistently at store level.

g. Reporting & Performance Measurement

i.

Metrics Design:

Propose, implement, and maintain a set of marketing performance measures that connect marketing activity to sales outcomes, rather than reporting reach and engagement in isolation.

ii.

Fortnightly Updates:

Provide a written fortnightly update to the General Manager and Chief Executive Officer covering campaigns currently in market, campaigns upcoming, spend against budget, results against agreed measures, and any matters requiring a decision.

iii.

Management Reporting:

Present a consolidated marketing and sales performance review at Management Team Meetings.

iv.

Post-Campaign Review:

Conduct a documented review after every major campaign, recording what worked, what did not, and what will be done differently next time.

3.

Working Relationships

– Reports to the General Manager on day-to-day priorities, budget, and performance, and to the Chief Executive Officer on brand direction and major campaign approvals.

– Works closely with outlet managers and operations teams to ensure campaigns, promotions, catering requests, and partnership activations are operationally executable and delivered to brand standard.

– Coordinates with the Head Baker and production team on product launches, seasonal offerings, product photography, and promotional planning, with adequate lead time for production capacity.

– Maintains working relationships with external vendors, photographers, designers, printers, media partners, influencers, and community collaborators.

– Develops and manages relationships with corporate clients, event organisers, and business partners to support revenue growth and brand visibility.

– Collaborates with frontline staff to gather customer insight, identify emerging trends, and capture authentic brand content at store level.

4.

Qualifications & Experience

– Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related discipline. Equivalent practical experience and a strong portfolio will be considered in lieu of formal qualifications.

–

Manager:

Minimum four years of relevant experience, including at least two years independently owning a marketing function, brand, or portfolio.

–

Assistant Manager:

Minimum two years of relevant experience, with demonstrated readiness to take on end-to-end ownership of a marketing portfolio.

– Prior experience in F&B, retail, hospitality, or a consumer lifestyle brand is strongly preferred.

– A portfolio of self-produced work – photography, video, design, and campaign examples– is required at interview.

– Experience managing a marketing budget and reporting on commercial outcomes is a distinct advantage.

5.

Skills Required

– Marketing strategy, framework development, and campaign planning

– Sales development, lead generation, and pipeline management

– Social media management, content scheduling, and community management

– Photography, videography, and content editing (including short-form video)

– Graphic design and production of marketing collateral

– Copywriting and brand communication

– Print production knowledge – file preparation, material selection, and vendor briefing

– Budget planning, spend tracking, and cost negotiation

– Data tracking, reporting, and performance analysis, including familiarity with social platform analytics, website analytics, and POS sales reporting

– Client relationship management and business development

– Event and partnership coordination

– Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, CapCut, or equivalent creative platforms

– Proficiency in Microsoft Office and presentation tools

– Strong verbal and written communication skills in English

6.

Key Attributes

–

Self-Motivated & Self-Directed:

Sets own priorities, works to self-imposed deadlines, and makes progress without being chased or closely supervised.

–

Comfortable Operating Independently:

Able to function effectively as a department of one, without an in-house team or standing agency support, and to know when to bring in external help.

–

Hands-On:

Willing to do the work personally – including shooting content, carrying and installing collateral, and being present at outlets – rather than working exclusively at a planning level.

–

Creative & Commercial Mindset:

Balances strong creative ideas against practical business and revenue objectives, and can explain why a piece of work is expected to earn its cost.

–

Commercially Numerate:

Comfortable working with budgets, sales figures, and performance data, and able to draw defensible conclusions from them.

–

Receptive to Direction:

Able to work within an established brand vision set by the founder, contributing ideas constructively and raising disagreement through discussion rather than through unilateral action.

–

Relationship Builder & Collaborative:

Comfortable engaging customers, partners, vendors, and internal teams across all levels, and contributes positively to team culture.

–

Organised & Detail-Oriented:

Maintainsstrong attention to detail across campaigns, communications, timelines,quotations, and sales coordination.

–

Adaptable & Resourceful:

Operates effectively where priorities and operational needs shift quickly, problem-solves independently, andremains composed under pressure or tight deadlines.

–

Brand Conscious & Culturally Attuned:

Understands the importance of consistency in branding, customer experience, and public perception, and has genuine feeling for the local heritage and food culture the brand is built on.

–

Results-Oriented:

Driven by measurable outcomes, continual improvement, and business growth.

–

Professionalism & Accountability:

Demonstrates maturity, reliability, discretion, and accountability in representing the company internally and externally.

7.

What Success Looks Like in the First Twelve Months

The following are indicative expectations and will be confirmed with the post-holder on appointment:

1. A documented marketing framework, approved by the Chief Executive Officer and General Manager, in active use as the basis for campaign planning.

2. An approved annual marketing budget supported by a live spend tracker, with spend managed within approved limits.

3. A consistent content cadence maintained across all active channels, with no unplanned gaps in the calendar.

4. A functioning lead and opportunity tracker, with measurable improvement in corporate and catering enquiry conversion.

5. An agreed set of performance measures that credibly links marketing activity to sales outcomes, reported on consistently.

6. Fortnightly reporting established as routine practice, and post-campaign reviews completed for all major campaigns.

Interested applicants are invited to send a curriculum vitae and portfolio to hello@keongsaikbakery.com. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

Traditional. Nostalgic. Contemporary.

A bakery bridging the past and present through varying baking styles and flavour combinations.

description:
About GNAME

GNAME is Asia’s leading domain registrar, based out of Singapore. We power a native marketplace designed for discovering, buying, and selling the perfect brand identity—including a backorder system of high-value, premium domain names that have expired into digital ether.

For more info on what we do: https://www.gname.com

We are seeking an experienced Brand Marketing Director to lead GNAME's global brand and marketing strategy, strengthen brand positioning, build integrated marketing capabilities, grow brand awareness and customer engagement across priority international markets, and translate business strategy into measurable brand and marketing outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

1. Global Brand Strategy & Positioning

· Develop and lead GNAME's global brand strategy, positioning, value proposition and brand architecture in alignment with business strategy and international growth priorities.

· Define brand narratives, messaging frameworks, tone of voice and visual direction to ensure a consistent and differentiated brand across markets and customer touchpoints.

· Advise senior management on brand strategy, market positioning, reputation and major marketing priorities.

· Establish brand governance standards across corporate, product, digital, event and employer-facing communications.

· Monitor brand health, market perception and competitive positioning and translate insights into strategic actions.

2. Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning

· Develop annual and multi-market marketing strategies, priorities, budgets and execution roadmaps supporting customer acquisition, engagement, retention and business growth.

· Lead integrated campaigns across digital, content, social media, public relations, partnerships, events, community and other relevant channels.

· Translate business and product priorities into audience strategies, campaign propositions and go-to-market programmes.

· Build effective planning, campaign governance, agency/vendor management and performance review processes.

· Balance long-term brand building with measurable demand and commercial outcomes.

3. International Market Development & Go-to-Market

· Lead brand and marketing initiatives for priority international markets, including market-entry and growth programmes where relevant.

· Conduct market, customer, competitor and category analysis to identify growth opportunities, audience needs and positioning gaps.

· Adapt global brand and campaign strategies to local market context while maintaining overall brand consistency.

· Partner with business development, sales, product and operations teams on market launches, customer programmes and strategic partnerships.

· Build relationships with relevant industry communities, media, partners and ecosystem stakeholders to expand GNAME's visibility and credibility.

4. Digital, Content & Community Marketing

· Set the strategy for owned digital channels, social media, content, community and thought-leadership programmes.

· Develop content frameworks communicating GNAME's expertise in domain names and internet services to relevant customer and industry audiences.

· Oversee editorial calendars, campaign content, executive communications, corporate storytelling and key digital assets.

· Strengthen customer and industry engagement through communities, educational content, events and other relationship-building initiatives.

· Ensure content quality, brand consistency and appropriate review processes across external communications.

5. Marketing Performance, Analytics & Customer Insights

· Define marketing KPIs covering brand awareness, engagement, customer acquisition, conversion, campaign effectiveness and return on marketing investment.

· Use customer, market, channel and campaign data to evaluate performance and guide budget and resource allocation.

· Develop regular marketing dashboards and management reports with clear insights, risks and recommended actions.

· Strengthen customer insight and feedback mechanisms to improve positioning, messaging, campaigns and customer experience.

· Promote a test-and-learn culture and continuously improve marketing effectiveness through experimentation and performance analysis.

6. Team Leadership & Cross-functional Collaboration

· Build, lead and develop the brand and marketing function, including capability planning, objective setting, performance management and talent development.

· Work closely with the CEO and senior management to align brand and marketing priorities with Company strategy.

· Partner with product, business development, sales, operations, customer service, compliance, legal, finance and HR teams to deliver integrated initiatives.

· Manage external agencies, consultants, media, creative partners and other vendors where required.

· Establish clear standards, workflows and accountability to ensure high-quality and timely marketing execution.

7. Reputation, Communications & Brand Risk Management

· Oversee corporate brand communications and support reputation management across relevant external channels.

· Develop communication approaches for significant company announcements, partnerships, product developments and industry engagement.

· Work with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure external marketing and communications are accurate, appropriate and aligned with applicable requirements.

· Identify brand and reputation risks and establish appropriate escalation, review and response mechanisms.

· Support senior leaders in external communications and thought leadership where appropriate.

Requirements

· Bachelor's degree or above in Marketing, Communications, Business, Brand Management or a related discipline.

· At least 12 years of progressive experience in brand, marketing or integrated communications, including substantial experience in a senior marketing leadership role.

· Demonstrated experience developing and executing brand and marketing strategy across multiple markets, including brand positioning, integrated campaigns, digital/content marketing and marketing performance.

· Experience in technology, internet, SaaS, digital platforms, e-commerce, fintech or another international digital business is highly preferred.

· Strong understanding of digital customer journeys, international marketing channels, content and community building, and data-driven marketing.

· Proven ability to partner with CEOs, senior executives and cross-functional leaders and translate business strategy into practical brand and marketing programmes.

· Strong leadership, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, analytical, communication and change-management capabilities.

· Experience managing marketing budgets, agencies, vendors and multi-channel programmes with measurable outcomes.

· Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, international and evolving organisation, balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution when required.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Chinese to liaise with internal and external stakeholders.

About Us

GNAME was established in Singapore as a professional international domain name registrar. We are dedicated to creating a comprehensive service platform for Internet domain names. At GNAME, domain names are at the heart of our business, and we offer a wide range of services to our customers, including global domain name registration, dropcatch, transactions, management, API interfaces, and other relevant services. Adopting an open reseller model, we offer reseller a one-stop management system including products, transactions, and financial management, fully supporting their business development. In addition to domain services, we also provide a diverse range of cloud products such as cloud servers, SSL certificates, website protection, and enterprise email services. Based on cloud computing technology, these services are highly scalable and secure, meeting customers’ needs in information technology and network security.

Our strong reputation is built on our commitment to putting customers first. In the future, we will continue to work hard, stay current with industry trends, and deliver the most valuable products and services to our global customers.

title: CATERING MANAGER
description:
Job Title:

Catering Manager

Industry:

Food & Beverage / Catering Services

Employment Type:

Full-Time

Minimum Education:

Recognised Bachelor's Degree (Compulsory)

Minimum Experience:

5 Years of Relevant Experience

Work Location:

Singapore

1. Job Summary

We are seeking a qualified and experienced Catering Manager to oversee the company's catering operations, including menu planning, food production coordination, event catering, manpower management, procurement, quality control, financial planning, and customer relationship management.

The successful candidate will be responsible for planning and coordinating catering services for corporate functions, private events, institutional clients, and other catering requirements. The role involves managing food preparation schedules, delivery logistics, service personnel, supplier relationships, budgets, and operational performance to ensure consistent food quality, timely service, customer satisfaction, and profitability.

The candidate must possess a recognised bachelor's degree and at least five years of relevant experience in catering management, food service operations, or the food and beverage industry.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Catering Operations Management

Plan, organise, direct, and supervise the company's daily catering operations.

Develop operational schedules for food preparation, packing, transportation, delivery, setup, and service.

Coordinate catering orders according to client requirements, event schedules, guest numbers, and service specifications.

Establish and implement standard operating procedures for catering production, dispatch, delivery, and on-site service.

Monitor operational efficiency and ensure catering assignments are completed accurately and on time.

Coordinate with kitchen teams, service staff, drivers, logistics personnel, and external service providers.

Review operational processes and recommend improvements to increase productivity and service quality.

B. Menu Planning and Food Quality Control

Develop and review catering menus based on customer requirements, event types, budgets, and market demand.

Coordinate with chefs on menu preparation, recipe standardisation, portion sizes, food presentation, and production quantities.

Oversee food production planning for Indian cuisine, international menus, buffet catering, packed meals, and other catering services, where applicable.

Ensure food quality, taste, freshness, consistency, and presentation meet company standards.

Monitor ingredient requirements and implement measures to minimise food wastage.

Review customer feedback and introduce appropriate menu and service improvements.

C. Food Safety and Regulatory Compliance

Ensure catering operations comply with applicable Singapore Food Agency (SFA) requirements and relevant food safety regulations.

Implement proper food handling, temperature monitoring, storage, transportation, sanitation, and cleaning procedures.

Ensure food is prepared, packed, transported, and served under appropriate hygienic conditions.

Conduct regular inspections of kitchens, food preparation areas, storage facilities, catering equipment, and delivery arrangements.

Maintain food safety records, cleaning schedules, inspection reports, and corrective action documentation.

Identify food safety risks and implement preventive and corrective measures.

D. Event Planning and Client Coordination

Liaise with corporate clients, event organisers, private customers, and other business partners to understand catering requirements.

Prepare catering proposals, menus, quotations, service schedules, and event plans.

Coordinate guest counts, dietary requirements, special requests, event layouts, buffet arrangements, and service equipment.

Supervise catering setup, food presentation, service delivery, and breakdown at event venues.

Monitor service standards during events and resolve operational issues promptly.

Develop long-term client relationships and identify opportunities to secure repeat catering contracts.

E. Staff Recruitment and Manpower Management

Determine manpower requirements according to catering orders, production volumes, event schedules, and delivery commitments.

Recruit, train, supervise, and evaluate catering supervisors, kitchen personnel, service staff, and other operational employees.

Prepare staff rosters and allocate responsibilities for food preparation, packing, transportation, setup, and event service.

Monitor attendance, working hours, overtime records, and payroll-related documentation.

Establish performance standards and provide training to improve employee productivity, service quality, and workplace safety.

Maintain effective communication between kitchen, logistics, sales, and event service teams.

F. Financial Management and Cost Control

Prepare operating budgets, catering cost estimates, revenue forecasts, and financial performance reports.

Monitor sales revenue, food costs, labour expenses, transportation costs, equipment rental, and event-related expenditure.

Calculate catering costs and assess profitability for individual orders, events, and corporate contracts.

Review profit-and-loss statements and implement measures to improve margins and operational efficiency.

Control food wastage, excessive purchasing, overtime expenditure, and unnecessary operating costs.

Prepare management reports on sales performance, expenses, gross margins, and business profitability.

G. Inventory, Procurement and Supplier Management

Forecast ingredient and supply requirements based on confirmed orders, expected demand, and catering schedules.

Manage purchasing and inventory of food ingredients, beverages, packaging materials, disposable items, and catering equipment.

Coordinate with suppliers regarding pricing, product specifications, delivery schedules, and quality standards.

Monitor stock levels, expiry dates, storage conditions, stock rotation, and inventory discrepancies.

Evaluate supplier performance and recommend improvements to procurement arrangements.

Ensure sufficient ingredients, equipment, packaging, and operational resources are available for scheduled catering assignments.

H. Logistics and Delivery Coordination

Plan delivery schedules, vehicle allocation, delivery routes, and loading arrangements.

Coordinate with drivers and logistics personnel to ensure food and equipment arrive at the correct venues on time.

Ensure appropriate handling and temperature control during food transportation.

Monitor delivery accuracy, order quantities, packaging standards, and equipment collection.

Resolve delivery delays, missing items, and other logistical issues.

Review transportation efficiency and recommend measures to reduce delivery costs.

I. Business Development and Performance Management

Identify new catering opportunities among corporate clients, event organisers, institutions, and private customers.

Develop strategies to increase catering sales, improve customer retention, and expand the company's customer base.

Review market trends, customer requirements, competitor offerings, and catering service demand.

Coordinate promotional initiatives and recommend new catering packages and service offerings.

Monitor key performance indicators, including sales growth, customer satisfaction, food costs, labour productivity, and order fulfilment.

Prepare periodic reports and recommendations for management on business growth and operational improvement.

3. Job Requirements

Educational Qualification:

A recognised bachelor's degree is compulsory. Applicants must provide documentary evidence of their qualifications.

Work Experience:

Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in catering management, catering operations, food service management, or a related food and beverage management role.

Catering Expertise:

Demonstrated experience in managing catering orders, food production schedules, event logistics, and service delivery.

Management Skills:

Ability to supervise kitchen, catering, service, and logistics personnel.

Financial Competency:

Experience in budgeting, catering cost calculations, financial reporting, inventory control, and profitability analysis.

Food Safety Knowledge:

Familiarity with food hygiene, safe food handling, storage, transportation, and applicable Singapore regulatory requirements.

Planning and Coordination:

Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple catering assignments and deadlines.

Communication Skills:

Strong client management, negotiation, leadership, and problem-solving abilities.

Analytical Ability:

Ability to assess operational performance, identify cost-saving opportunities, and implement service improvements.

Work Flexibility:

Willingness to work according to catering schedules, including weekends and public holidays when required.

4. Application Requirements

Interested applicants should submit a detailed resume outlining their educational qualifications, employment history, catering management experience, and relevant operational responsibilities.

Applicants may be required to provide copies of their educational certificates, employment records, and other supporting documents during the selection process.

Only candidates who meet the essential educational and experience requirements will be considered.

title: Brand Ambassador
description:

Able to work independently and as part of a team.

Sales, retail, hospitality, customer service or fitness-industry experience is an advantage, but not essential.

Prepare marketing proposals and presentations for existing and potential clients

title: General Manager
description:

What You’ll Do:

Operational Leadership:

Strategic and operational leader, driving all FM and Workplace Experience teams & programs, ensuring smooth operations and truly exceptional service delivery.
Direct other department heads to develop and implement strategies to enhance employee and colleague satisfaction.
Builds a cohesive, diverse team dedicated to ongoing improvement of business operations.
Creates, communicates, and monitors the vision, mission, strategy, objectives, business plan, budget, policies and operating plans for assigned responsibilities and leads with empathy.
Serves as a change agent for business improvements.
Develops buy-in and support for new initiatives and processes working with senior executive stakeholders.
Provides effective presentations to regional and global leadership, employees, prospects/clients.
Engages in other outside activities consistent with the company’s and the client’s responsibilities to the community and the industry.
Leads by example to earn respect and trust of peers, employees, and clients.
Clearly supports others by providing honest, open, two-way communication.
Implements or directs the implementation of programs that meet corporate goals and objectives.
Foster a culture of teamwork, professionalism, and continuous improvement among team members.

Colleague/Guest Experience:

Ensure that all colleague/visitors receive personalized and exceptional service throughout their stay in all workplaces.
Monitor colleague feedback and reviews, promptly addressing any concerns and implementing measures to enhance colleague satisfaction.
Lead by example in maintaining high standards of professionalism, attention to detail, and customer service.

Financial Management:

Prepares short and long-range strategic plans, priorities, objectives, and the annual budgets.
Responsible for meeting the financial goals and expense management for assigned areas.
Possess advanced financial skills and knowledge to review the complex financial reports prepared by others and to make recommendations to executives that impact the line of business.
Effectively understands and oversees financial accounting and reporting, identifying mid-year trends and reforecasting as indicated.
Has account wide KPI accountability and leadership to foster successful outcomes.

Facilities Management:

Supports all property facilities management functions, including maintenance works, repairs, vendor management, and space planning.
Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations, building codes, and industry standards.
Collaborate with CBRE’s facilities management experts to implement best practices and ensure efficient building operations.
Oversee facility management sized projects (MAC) e.g. box moves, office alterations, space reconfigurations and minor construction projects.

Staff Development and Training:

Support the recruitment, selection, and onboarding of key managerial positions and oversee the talent acquisition process.
Provides for the effective recruitment, selection, performance management, development, and retention of high calibre management staff to carry out the organization’s mission.
Guides staff in strengthening their competencies.
Implements a career development and succession plan, along with an effective retention program for key personnel, while creating a more diverse organization.
Recognizes expertise and empowers peers and employees to build a dynamic team that is viewed by others as highly productive, capable and the best in the industry.
Supports a healthy balance between work and lifestyle.
Develop and implement training and development programs for all workplace teams to enhance skills, knowledge, and performance.
Foster a positive work environment, promoting teamwork, motivation, and career growth opportunities.

Food & Beverage Management:

Provides oversight and thoughtful management of all 3rd party Food & Beverage vendors partners, including Employee meal programs, conference, meetings and events management.
Specialized knowledge of highest recognized industry standards for Food Safety, Sanitation, and compliance.
 Assurance of forward thinking and innovative partnerships to incorporate industry trends.

Quality Assurance and Compliance:

Ensure compliance with all local, state regulations, as well as brand standards and company policies.
Conduct regular inspections and audits to maintain high-quality standards throughout the workplaces.
Collaborate with the Health & Safety team to implement corrective actions and ensure adherence to established standards.

Client and Stakeholder Management:

Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and stakeholders, understanding their needs and ensuring their satisfaction.
Proactively communicate with clients and stakeholders to address concerns, gather feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional service and exceed client expectations.

Crisis Management and Security:

Follow and implement emergency response plans and procedures to ensure the safety and security of your team members, visitors, and colleagues.
Collaborate with relevant service lines to conduct regular security assessments and training programs.
Coordinate with external agencies and authorities in case of emergencies or security incidents.

Meeting and Events Planning:

Oversee the planning and execution of internal meetings and events.
Support in development of event programs that cater to the diverse needs and interests of colleagues in their workplace.
Incorporate interactive activities, team-building exercises, and workshops to encourage colleagues’ participation and engagement.

What You’ll Need:
A minimum of eight (8+) years experience in a leadership role within the hospitality industry or corporate real estate environment preferably as a General Manager or Area General Manager of luxury hospitality brands or high-end corporate environments with a strong focus on strong guest services / visitor experience / facilities management, and event management

title: Members Services Administrative Support – Events & Travel
description:
ABOUT THE POSITION

This position is being created in response to a temporary increase in activity resulting from a change in the regional operating model and the redistribution of responsibilities within the Members Services function.

To support this transition and maintain a high level of service across Events and Member travel activities, FICOFI is recruiting a Members Services Administrative Support – Events & Travel on a fixed-term basis until 30 June 2027.

Although the requirement is temporary, the assignment offers broad exposure to Members Services, events, travel and cross-functional operational coordination within an international environment

The Members Services Administrative Coordinator – Events & Travel is part of the Members Services Managers (MSM) team and provides administrative and coordination support to the Members Services team globally, with a primary focus on Asia-Pacific and France. The position supports the commercial teams – Le Club FICOFI® Advisors (LCFA) – through the Members Services organization and focuses on the administrative management of Member events, travel arrangements, hospitality bookings, participant follow-up and related invoicing activities.

The role acts as an internal concierge-style support for the Members Services team across locations. It requires a hands-on and service-oriented approach, with the confidence to contact hotels, restaurants, partners, Members’ assistants and internal teams directly, including by phone, to clarify information, resolve issues and secure timely solutions.

KEY RESPONSIBLITIES

Administrative support for Member events:

Coordinate invitation follow-up and maintain accurate RSVP and attendance information in Salesforce or any successor tool.

Proactively follow up with MSMs, LCFAs, Members or their assistants to collect guest names, dietary requirements, hotel details and any information required for the event.

Prepare and update guest lists, attendance trackers (dinners and side activities), table plans and other event administration documents.

Prepare programmes and communications with practical information to participants and keep clear records of communications and confirmations.

Manage programme changes and circulate daily or ad hoc updates to relevant stakeholders and participants.

Travel, hospitality and booking coordination:

Manage hotel bookings with partners, including rooming lists follow-up, confirmations, changes, cancellations and special requests.

Coordinate restaurant bookings and hospitality arrangements linked to Member events, trips and programmes.

Arrange and follow up on side activities, transfers and other travel-related services with providers and participants.

Handle last-minute changes calmly and proactively, escalating only when a decision, exception or approval is required.

Invoicing, payment and administrative control:

Prepare, consolidate and check the information required for event and trip invoicing

Coordinate invoicing follow-up for participation fees, side activities and extra guests, and maintain visibility on pending items.

Follow up on deposits, payments, supporting documents and discrepancies with MSMs.

Ensure event references, participant numbers, pricing information and supporting documentation are accurate and traceable.

Maintain orderly digital files and trackers so that the status of each booking, payment and open point can be understood quickly.

Internal coordination and service delivery:

Work closely with MSMs, LCFAs, Event and Finance Teams to ensure smooth administrative delivery before, during and after events.

Provide regular and concise status updates, highlighting missing information, deadlines, risks and actions required.

Take ownership of follow-up: contact the right person, obtain the answer and close the loop rather than simply forwarding a request.

KEY DELIVERABLES:

Accurate and up-to-date RSVP, guest, dietary, hotel and activity trackers.

Confirmed and documented hotel, restaurant, transfer and side-activity bookings.

Complete invoicing instructions and reliable payment follow-up.

Clear programme communications and controlled management of changes.

Well-maintained event files, checklists and post-event administrative closure.

Proactive reporting on deadlines, missing inputs, risks and unresolved items.

It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties or skills required. Responsibilities may evolve according to business needs, regional activity and the development of the function during the fixed-term assignment ending on 30 June 2027.

KEY SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

Professional Experience

: Approximately 2–5 years in administrative coordination, events, travel, hospitality, executive assistance, customer service or another fast-moving service environment. A varied or non-linear career path may be considered where the candidate demonstrates strong potential.

Proactivity and Resourcefulness

: Willing to take initiative, make direct contact and find practical solutions to move matters forward.

Organization and Attention to Detail

: Able to manage multiple events, deadlines, bookings and changing priorities with accuracy.

Service Orientation and Relationship Skills

: Discreet, thoughtful and reliable when supporting internal teams, Members, assistants and external partners.

Communication

: Confident and courteous in writing, by phone and in person with a wide range of stakeholders.

Problem-Solving:

Calm under pressure, solution-oriented and able to follow issues through to resolution.

Tools:

Good command of Microsoft Office and confidence learning CRM, ERP, event and collaboration tools.

Language Proficiency:

Fluent professional English and Mandarin, written and spoken, to communicate with the internal and external stakeholders.

FICOFI was created in 1990 to bring together the finest wine producers and the finest wine consumers to enjoy and share the experience of fine wine in the setting of a small intimate club. The Club FICOFI is a discreet and global community of successful entrepreneurs, business leaders and philanthropists who share a genuine passion for wine and the special moments it creates.

We serve our members by offering a unique range of tailor-made services that will enhance the enjoyment of their wine collection to thew fullest. We aim at crafting unique experiences through winemaker dinners, annual flagship events, FICOFI trips to the vineyards. We offer storage and insurance services to guarantee optimal safety and transparency, without forgetting worldwide door-to-door deliveries.

We have proudly reached the exclusive cap of 300 Members worldwide and are committed to maintaining this limit preserving the intimate and high-quality experience that defines Le Club FICOFI. At the same time, we are excited to introduce a new initiative—the Friends & Family Program—designed to expand the FICOFI universe. This program allows us to grow and share our unique offerings with a wider circle, all while ensuring that the exclusivity and value of Le Club FICOFI remain uncompromised and undiluted.

We serve wine producers by supporting their actions to grow the size and preserve vineyards of which they are the custodians.

FICOFI has subsidiaries in France (Bordeaux and Paris), UK (London), HK, Singapore, and offices in Sao Polo and Los Angeles.

FICOFI is made of genuine individuals with a high sense of commitment and a great diversity of skills. We value their work and unicity and give them opportunities for self-and career development.

FICOFI stands for FI-delitas (loyalty), CO-ncordia (Harmony, sharing, uniting) and FI-ducia (trust).

title: Manager/Senior Manager, Outreach Events and Management (WOD)
description:
Responsibilities

• Lead the planning and delivery of career events, workshops, networking sessions and other outreach initiatives across physical, virtual and hybrid formats, ensuring alignment with Workforce Outreach Division priorities and workforce needs.

• Conceptualise event formats, participant journeys and engagement approaches; pilot new initiatives and improve existing formats to strengthen employer participation, jobseeker engagement and job-matching outcomes.

• Build and maintain effective working relationships with employers, industry partners, associations, Self-Help Groups, community/grassroots organisations and internal stakeholders to mobilise participation, partnerships and resources.

• Shape targeted outreach and engagement strategies to attract suitable jobseekers and employers, advocate jobseeker capabilities and workforce needs, and curate activities that reduce skills and hiring mismatch.

• Oversee end-to-end event operations, including vendor appointment and management, logistics, registration, event-day execution, post-event follow-up, procurement and governance requirements.

• Develop event budget requirements, monitor utilisation, exercise cost discipline, verify billing and ensure effective deployment of resources while delivering value for money.

• Establish and monitor event performance measures, analyse participation, engagement and outcome data, identify trends and translate insights into actionable improvements.

• Lead post-event reviews, consolidate feedback from stakeholders, identify gaps and improvement opportunities, and institutionalise good practices across the event portfolio.

• Coordinate internal teams and external parties to deliver multiple concurrent events, provide direction on priorities and resolve operational issues to ensure timely, quality outcomes.

Requirements

Experience & Qualifications

• At least 5 years of relevant experience in event management, programme delivery, project management, partnerships, outreach or a related field, with demonstrated experience leading end-to-end events or engagement initiatives.

• Experience managing vendors, budgets, stakeholders and concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience in workforce, community, employer engagement or career-related initiatives will be an advantage.

• Candidates without the required qualifications but with strong relevant experience may be considered.

Knowledge

• Events, programme and project management principles, including physical, virtual and hybrid delivery.

• Workforce segment needs, employer hiring challenges and labour market / sectoral manpower trends.

• Job matching, employability and employer engagement considerations.

• HR hiring processes and relevant national employment policies.

• Knowledge of WSG programmes and/or relevant workforce initiatives will be an added advantage.

Skills

• Strategic Planning & Event Management: Translate organisational priorities into practical event strategies, formats and delivery plans.

• Stakeholder & Partnership Management: Build trusted relationships, align diverse interests and mobilise stakeholders towards shared outcomes.

• Budget & Vendor Management: Manage budgets, procurement considerations and vendors with strong governance and value-for-money focus.

• Communication: Strong business writing, presentation and facilitation skills across internal and external audiences.

• Data & Insights: Use participation, engagement and outcome data to evaluate effectiveness and guide improvements.

• Problem Solving & Decision Making: Assess issues, evaluate options and make timely decisions in a changing operating environment.

• Digital & Technology: Proficient in Microsoft Office and able to learn and apply event, collaboration and other digital tools quickly.

Abilities/Aptitudes

• Takes ownership, demonstrates sound judgement and follows through on commitments and outcomes.

• Adaptable and resilient, with the ability to manage last-minute changes and competing priorities.

• Systematic, organised and able to manage concurrent projects without losing attention to detail.

• Collaborative team player who can rally resources, influence stakeholders and resolve issues constructively.

• Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment with a strong service and outcome orientation.

Other Characteristics

• Established network or experience working with industry partners, employers and/or associations.

• Experience working with Self-Help Groups, community or grassroots organisations is an advantage.

Successful candidates will be offered a contract in the first instance and may be considered for an extension or be placed on a permanent tenure.

Candidates are encouraged to sign up for a Careers & Skills Passport (CSP) account and include your CSP public profile in your resume. Please check out www.myskillsfuture.gov.sg for details on the CSP

About Skills and Workforce Development Agency

The Skills and Workforce Development Agency (SWDA) drives lifelong learning and workforce development to enable Singaporeans to take charge of their careers, learn for life, access good jobs, and grow in fulfilling careers. We enable employers to build a skilled, future-ready workforce, design quality jobs, and adopt skills recognition practices. Together with our partners, we build a trusted, high-quality, industry-relevant, and innovative ecosystem that meets the evolving workforce needs of both businesses and workers. For more information, please visit www.swda.gov.sg.

The Voyage Global Leadership Development Program

Marriott International welcomes recent university graduates to experience the career development adventure of a lifetime and a world of leadership opportunities. Voyage is a full-time, paid development program. As an associate and trainee, you’ll build upon the skills you developed in school by participating in real world assignments.

About the journey
Voyage is an elite, award-winning program that provides a combination of hands-on, discipline-specific training and a leadership-focused curriculum. The program takes place at a Marriott International managed hotel, not a classroom, and is offered in 50+ countries. Voyage is available in the following disciplines:

Accounting & Finance
Culinary
Engineering
Event Operations
Event Planning
Food & Beverage Operations
Human Resources
Revenue Management
Rooms Operations
Sales & Marketing
Information Technology
Residences

When you join Voyage, you gain access to Marriott’s senior leaders and coaches and have many opportunities to stand out. You’ll participate in mini-rotations across the disciplines to learn firsthand how to manage various hotel functions and to connect with current and former Voyage participants through our social collaboration tools. Cultivate customer relationships

title: Marketing Manager
description:
We are seeking a well-rounded and results-driven Marketing Manager to manage the organisation’s branding, communications and promotional campaigns, able to implement marketing strategies for How I Care company with ownership over promotions and awareness of How I Care products.

This role is more than managing day-to-day marketing activities. We are looking for a Marketing Manager who can rebuild and strengthen our marketing function, bringing clarity, structure and consistency across all marketing efforts.

You will lead a team of three to five marketing members and be responsible for creating a high-performing marketing department with clear processes, measurable outcomes and strong collaboration.

Working closely with the CEO, you will develop and execute marketing strategies that increase brand awareness, grow our online community and convert engagement into sustainable business growth.

Success in this role means more people know who How I Care is, understand what we stand for and actively engage with our products, programmes and community.

The ideal candidate will be someone innovative, resourceful using various forms of business intelligence and information to identify key trends and develop successful marketing programmes.

Also, enthusiastic in sharing the power of journaling with others, advocating for mental wellbeing and able to be building a strong connection with our audience.

Be responsible for the implementation of multi-channel marketing strategies, in charge of managing all social platforms (inclusive of community engagement), with clear deliverables in brand engagement and visibility.

If you are a creative thinker, skilled storyteller and results-driven marketer, we would love to meet and talk to you!

The primary objective of this role is to significantly increase awareness of the How I Care brand, establish a strong and engaged online community, and convert that awareness into sustainable growth across our educational programmes, workshops and retail products.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Brand Leadership

Develop and execute the overall marketing strategy aligned with the company's vision and business objectives.

Lead the repositioning and strengthening of the How I Care brand across all customer touchpoints.

Ensure consistency in brand identity, messaging, storytelling and visual communications.

Develop annual and quarterly marketing plans with measurable KPIs.

Build scalable marketing systems, workflows and processes to improve team efficiency and effectiveness.

Identify opportunities for innovation, partnerships and new marketing initiatives.

Digital & Social Media Marketing

· Manage and grow our presence for our brands on Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Facebook, etc. ensuring high engagement and growth of respective channels.

· Strong writing skills and ability to create compelling copy for different channels

· Produce high-quality reels, infographics, photography and video content.

· Create comprehensive and visually appealing content using Canva or Adobe Suite.

Develop content strategies that drive meaningful engagement, community growth and brand advocacy.

Oversee the content calendar across all digital platforms.

Analyse platform performance and optimise content based on insights and analytics.

Grow our social media presence with the objective of establishing How I Care as a leading voice in wellbeing, journaling and self-awareness.

Community Management & Engagement:

· Build and maintain a vibrant journaling community, both online and offline.

· Host or support journal-related events, challenges and wellness campaigns.

· Encourage feedback and collect user stories to shape marketing direction.

Develop brand ambassadors, influencers and strategic partnerships aligned with the How I Care mission.

Build long-term relationships with schools, educators, mental wellbeing advocates and community partners.

·

Merchandise & Product Development

· Support development and promotion of branded merchandise and educational products.

Product Marketing & Commercial Growth

Develop go-to-market strategies for new journals, card games and lifestyle merchandise.

Plan and execute product launch campaigns.

Increase product awareness and drive online and offline sales.

Work closely with internal stakeholders to translate customer insights into future product improvements.

·

Performance Marketing & Analytics

Monitor and report on key marketing metrics including reach, engagement, website traffic, lead generation and sales conversion.

Develop dashboards and reports to evaluate campaign performance.

Optimise marketing spend based on ROI.

Make data-driven recommendations to improve marketing effectiveness.

Budget Management

· Propose and manage marketing budgets to ensure optimal allocation of funds and ROI.

SEO & Paid Ads

· Implement and optimise SEO strategies and Google Ads campaigns to enhance online visibility.

Campaigns and Event Management

· Design, implement and manage marketing campaigns across various platforms (digital, print etc.)

· Plan and execute marketing activations such as pop-up events and school workshops.

Team Leadership

· Manage and mentor marketing members, delegate tasks and foster optimum collaboration amongst members.

Lead, coach and develop a team of three to five marketing professionals.

Set clear goals, responsibilities and performance expectations.

Foster accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement within the team.

Build a culture of creativity, ownership and excellence.

Review team performance and provide regular feedback and development opportunities

·

Market Research

· Analyse market developments to identify key trends, consumer/user behaviour and propose applicable marketing decisions.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured through:

Growth in overall brand awareness.

Growth in social media audience and engagement.

Increase in website traffic and qualified leads.

Growth in sales of journals, card games and lifestyle merchandise.

Successful execution of campaigns and product launches.

Strong relationships with schools and strategic partners.

Development of an organised, high-performing marketing department.

Achievement of agreed marketing KPIs and ROI.

Qualifications & Skills

· A marketing professional with a strong creative mindset and entrepreneurial spirit.

· Ideal personal interest in journaling and promoting wellbeing through reflective practices.

· Minimum 3-5 years’ experience in marketing activities (preferably in wellness or education sectors).

· With at least 2 years in a leadership or team management role.

· Proven experience running successful digital and affiliate campaigns.

· Strong community engagement and robust communication skills.

· Self-driven and able to manage multiple priorities independently.

· Strong time management and budget controlling skills.

· Highly creative with a proactive approach to problem-solving and campaign execution.

· Ability to work independently while also thriving in a collaborative team environment.

· Open to feedback and capable of following instructions effectively.

· Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

Experience building or scaling a marketing function is highly advantageous.

Experience in education, wellness, lifestyle or purpose-driven brands is preferred.

Demonstrated ability to grow social media communities and translate engagement into measurable business outcomes.

Strong understanding of branding, content marketing, digital marketing, SEO, paid advertising and analytics.

Commercial mindset with the ability to balance creativity and business performance.

·

Work hours

· Weekdays between 09:00 and 17:30 hours

Other

· Able to travel within the region as per company’s requirements and plans.

· Attractive remuneration as well as employee overall benefits.

At How I Care, mental health and well-being are not just priorities—they are the essence of our mission. Based in Singapore, we are an Education Lab dedicated to elevating social awareness and personal growth through transformative education across Asia.

Our curriculum, now implemented in schools throughout the region, is tailored to the unique needs of each school year, aiming to equip students with effective strategies to embrace challenges and grow into socially aware, responsible individuals. We create engaging learning textbooks and conduct workshops that foster character development. Additionally, we offer training for teachers to maximise the impact of our resources.

Join us in our mission to empower the next generation. Together, we can nurture a better tomorrow and ensure every student has the opportunity to thrive confidently and contribute meaningfully to their community.

title: Gymnastics Coach
description:
Job Overview:

As a Gymnastics Coach at Galaxy Gymnastics, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality, engaging, and structured gymnastics classes for students of varying skill levels. You will create a fun and safe learning environment, ensuring students develop fundamental movement skills, strength, and confidence. Your role includes class planning, student assessment, parent communication, and contributing to the overall growth of Galaxy Gymnastics.

Key Responsibilities

1. Class Instruction & Student Development

Plan and deliver structured gymnastics lessons based on the Galaxy Gymnastics curriculum.

Ensure progressive skill development, focusing on technique, coordination, and physical literacy.

Modify drills and activities to cater to different learning styles, keeping classes engaging and inclusive.

Promote positive reinforcement, motivating students to achieve their goals.

Maintain class discipline and safety while fostering an encouraging atmosphere.

Guide students through the Galaxy Gymnastics Awards (GGA) Program, tracking their progress.

Implement behavioural management strategies to support student engagement and class cohesion.

2. Student Progress & Evaluations

Assess students' skills and provide feedback on their progress.

Conduct evaluations every three terms (six months) to determine readiness for the next stage.

Recommend students for developmental and competitive pathways where appropriate.

Communicate student progress effectively to parents, ensuring transparency and engagement.

Utilize technology for tracking progress, maintaining records of student performance.

3. Safety & Risk Managemen

t

Ensure a safe training environment by following spotting techniques and gym safety protocols.

Perform regular equipment checks and report any hazards.

Maintain first-aid readiness and respond appropriately to injuries.

4. Parent & Community Engagement

Build strong relationships with students and parents, fostering trust and open communication.

Provide updates on student development and class activities.

Support community events such as showcases, competitions, and holiday camps.

Assist in marketing efforts, including social media engagement, trial classes, and promotional events.

5. Professional Growth & Team Collaboration

Attend regular team meetings and professional development workshops.

Contribute to curriculum development and help refine training methodologies.

Collaborate with other coaches to maintain a consistent teaching standard.

Stay up to date with gymnastics coaching trends and best practices.

Take on mentorship roles by guiding junior coaches and interns.

6. Administrative Responsibilities

Maintain accurate attendance records for all classes.

Ensure timely communication with the administration team regarding class management.

Assist in event planning for competitions, open houses, and workshops.

Utilize digital systems for lesson planning, student tracking, and progress reports.

________________________________________

Qualifications & Experience

Background in gymnastics, sports, or coaching.

Relevant Gymnastics coaching certification.

NROC (National Registry of Coaches) license is a plus.(or willingness to obtain)

Previous experience in coaching recreational and/or competitive gymnastics.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

Passion for working with children to adults and fostering a love for movement.

First-aid certification (or willingness to obtain).

Work Commitment and Hours

Full-time position

Must be available for weekends and occasional evenings to support classes and events.

Full-time, with a minimum of 40 hours per week, including evenings and weekends as needed.

Based in Singapore at Galaxy Gymnastics' facility.

Additional earnings opportunities through workshops, camps, and private coaching.

Probation period of 6 months with a performance review at the end of the period.

Galaxy Gymnastics: A Gym Out of This World

Galaxy Gymnastics is a leading gymnastics center in Singapore, dedicated to making gymnastics fun, creative, and accessible for everyone. Our mission is to provide affordable and engaging gymnastics services that empower individuals of all ages, from toddlers to adults, to discover the joy of movement and self-expression.

At Galaxy Gymnastics, we offer a comprehensive program that caters to both recreational and competitive gymnasts. With 80% of our enrollment focused on recreational gymnastics, we emphasize skill development and proficiency, ensuring that every student has the opportunity to explore their potential. Our unique approach blends traditional gymnastics training with innovative activities that foster creativity, confidence, and a lifelong love for fitness.

We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and supportive environment where gymnasts can thrive. Our dedicated team of coaches, trained in-house and further developed through national courses, is committed to nurturing each student's abilities, regardless of their starting point. By offering pathways from recreational to competitive gymnastics, we ensure that every gymnast has the chance to pursue their goals.

Galaxy Gymnastics stands out from competitors by focusing on the fun and creative aspects of the sport. While other centers may emphasize competition and a strict training regimen, we prioritize making gymnastics enjoyable and accessible, breaking down stereotypes that the sport is difficult or exclusive. Our programs are designed to inspire and challenge, incorporating movement-related activities from other disciplines to broaden our students' horizons.

As we continue to grow, with plans to open additional centers in the coming years, we remain committed to our vision of being a leader in the gymnastics community. Join us at Galaxy Gymnastics, where we shoot for the stars and create a gym experience that is truly out of this world.

title: Project Coordinator (WHP Internship)
description:
Job Description
Posting Start Date: 12/10/2026
Brand: MCI
Country/Region: Singapore
Work Location: Singapore
Workplace Type: Hybrid
Contract type: Intern
Job Function: Project Management
Information at a Glance

We are a global engagement and marketing agency that creates human-centric touchpoints that unleash the power of people to deliver innovation and growth.
Firm believers in the power of building community since 1987, we are helping brands, associations and not-for-profit organisations solve their key people challenges through our core expertise: Live & virtual events, Strategic & digital communications and Consulting & community solutions.

We are an independently owned agency, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, with a global presence of 60 offices in 31 countries.

THE OPPORTUNITY

AMC is a division within MCI that provides consultancy and event management services to associations active in the Asia Pacific Region.

The Project Coordinator will assist in providing professional membership service support to client association clients served by AMC. In addition to the key duties and responsibilities, he/she will assist the team to schedule meetings, conduct research and maintain working relationship with clients. Candidates must be available to commit to a 6 month full time internship.

THE WORK

Operations (30%)

Work with other functional managers on initiatives to improve aspects of MCI and the clients’ business.
Represent Business Support department on any operational matters or meetings in the event of the Business Support Manager’s absence.
Perform all duties and responsibilities and others as assigned by Business Support Manager in a timely, accurate and efficient manner.
Disseminate information received from client contact point to the team members in a timely manner and ensures that the team members are fully briefed on the information received.
Execute project from start to finish, analyzing data and present findings.

Stakeholder Engagement (25%)

Provide membership support service on behalf of AMC associations clients and their members.
Identify client needs and propose strategies to meet their various project objectives.
Provide regional product knowledge and technical expertise to client(s) for compliance issues and to management and other functions for market research purposes.
Attends to member complaints received by team members.
Ensures all 2nd level escalations are followed up and resolved timely and accurately.
Manage telemarketing, translation, and other operational assistance projects.

Market Development (35%)

Maintain and improve performance level by identifying key trends and forecasts business needs through developing strategic, accurate and actionable data analysis.

Identify opportunities, challenges, and workflow issues. Propose solutions with relevant functions and/or divisions.
Communicates performance against objective with the individual team members and constantly monitors performance in terms of agreed key performance indicators.

Strategy Development (10%)

Plan for effective use of resources, anticipating resource needs to ensure consistent delivery of service standards are met and exceeded every day.

THE HIVE

The Project Coordinator reports to the Deputy Director and works closely with the AMC team internally.

THE MUST HAVE

Well-rounded individuals pursuing a degree in Hospitality, Tourism or MICE
Experience within the hospitality or MICE service sector, non-profit, NGO, association will be advantageous and the ability to adapt to changing needs and demands of key stakeholders/membership is important.
Quick, efficient, and accurate in all administrative duties

THE GOOD TO HAVE

Great customer service mind-set and proactive disposition
Superior verbal and written communication skills are essential as success is dependent upon developing positive relationships and communicating with a wide variety of stakeholders related to the association.

Well-developed organizational and leadership skills
Database management experience is beneficial

MCI is where you can bring your true self to work and be proud of what you do. Join us and make a difference!

title: MARKETING & OPERATIONS EXECUTIVE
description:
Position Overview

The Marketing & Operations Executive will support the day-to-day marketing, social media, customer engagement, inventory management, booth operations, order fulfilment, and event activities of Yumi Basics.

The role requires someone who is hands-on, organised, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable supporting both online and offline business operations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Social Media Management

Manage and maintain Yumi Basics' social media platforms.

Plan, create and publish engaging content including posts, Stories, Reels and TikTok videos.

Ensure content is consistent with the brand image and current promotions.

Monitor social media trends and identify opportunities to improve engagement.

Assist with content planning and scheduling.

Capture behind-the-scenes, product, lifestyle and event content when required.

2. Customer Engagement & DM Management

Manage and respond to customer enquiries through Instagram, TikTok and other relevant platforms.

Respond to DMs, comments and enquiries promptly and professionally.

Assist customers with product information, availability, orders and general enquiries.

Follow up with potential customers where required.

Escalate customer issues or complaints to Management when necessary.

3. TikTok Live Administration

Be available to support Yumi Basics' TikTok Live sessions as an Admin when required.

Monitor Live comments and assist with customer enquiries.

Help manage comments, product enquiries and customer engagement during Live sessions.

Support the Live Host with product information and operational matters.

Assist in ensuring each Live session runs smoothly and professionally.

4. Booth & Retail Operations

Assist with setting up and packing down Yumi Basics' booths, pop-ups and events.

Be present and actively assist during booth and event days as required.

Welcome customers and provide product information.

Assist with sales, product display, stock arrangement and customer service.

Ensure the booth is kept clean, organised and presentable throughout the event.

Assist with stock counting before, during and after events.

5. Inventory Management

Maintain accurate records of all Yumi Basics' inventory and stock levels.

Conduct regular stock counts and inventory checks.

Monitor incoming and outgoing stock and update inventory records accordingly.

Receive, check and organise new stock deliveries.

Ensure products are properly labelled, stored and arranged.

Monitor stock levels and highlight low-stock, fast-moving or slow-moving items to Management.

Identify and report missing, damaged, defective or mismatched stock immediately.

Assist with stock reconciliation and investigate inventory discrepancies.

Ensure stock is properly allocated for events, booths, online orders and promotional activities.

Assist Management with inventory planning and stock replenishment.

Maintain an organised stockroom and ensure products can be located easily.

Support stock-taking exercises and periodic inventory audits.

Ensure inventory information is kept accurate and up to date at all times.

6. Order Fulfilment & Packing

Pack customer orders accurately and efficiently.

Prepare parcels for courier collection or delivery.

Check products, quantities and order details before packing.

Ensure products are packed securely and appropriately.

Assist with stock organisation and inventory management.

Monitor and maintain adequate packing materials and supplies.

Report any stock or order discrepancies to Management.

7. Event Planning & Coordination

Assist Management in planning upcoming events, pop-ups, bazaars and promotional activities.

Research potential events, venues and collaboration opportunities.

Assist with event preparation, logistics and scheduling.

Coordinate event requirements such as booth setup, stock, marketing materials and manpower.

Maintain an event calendar and track important deadlines.

Assist during events from setup through to tear-down.

Ensure sufficient stock is prepared and transported for each event.

8. General Marketing & Operations Support

Support promotional campaigns, product launches and sales activities.

Assist with marketing and operational projects assigned by Management.

Identify areas where processes, customer experience and daily operations can be improved.

Work closely with Management and other team members to ensure smooth business operations.

Perform other reasonable duties as assigned based on the Company's business needs.

Requirements

Experience in social media management, content creation, retail, inventory, events or customer service is preferred.

Familiar with Instagram, TikTok and social media trends.

Good communication and customer service skills.

Strong attention to detail, particularly when handling stock and orders.

Organised, responsible and able to manage multiple tasks.

Proactive and willing to take initiative.

Comfortable working at booths, events and outside the usual office/showroom environment.

Able to support TikTok Live sessions and event periods when required.

Able to work independently while also functioning well within a team.

Interest in fashion, beauty, lifestyle or retail is an advantage.

Key Qualities

The ideal candidate should be:

Hands-on and proactive

Organised and detail-oriented

Creative and social-media savvy

Customer-focused

Responsible when handling company stock and products

Comfortable working under pressure

Flexible with event and Live schedules

Willing to support both marketing and operational tasks

Able to multitask and prioritise effectively

Working Environment

This is a hands-on role involving both online and offline responsibilities. The employee may be required to work at the showroom, stockroom, booths, events, pop-ups and other locations depending on business requirements.

The role may require availability outside regular working hours for TikTok Live sessions, events, launches and promotional activities, with scheduling arranged by Management where applicable.
