title: Lead, Programme & Activation (Events & Experiences)
description:
This role is hired under Mandai X, the growth accelerator and venture building arm of Mandai Wildlife Group.

We live in a world where the delicate balance with nature has been disrupted. Reversing this trend will require a global effort of unprecedented speed and scale.

An impossible task alone.

Which is why we challenge ourselves to reach 1 billion consumers, as potential for change can only happen when many come together.

And this is where Mandai X can make a difference. Working to influence changes in attitudes, decisions and behaviours.

Leveraging over 50 years of experience in inspiring people to value and protect nature as part of the Mandai Wildlife Group, our efforts will spark, catalyse and accelerate innovative ventures in completely new domains to drive growth and impact beyond boundaries. Eliminating the well-entrenched trade-offs faced between commercial, human and the planet’s wellbeing; and blending everything together so that these usual conflicts faced are aligned.

We will redefine what a better life means; and unleash humanity’s collective power to make this change through impactful ventures that enable and empower individuals and companies with everyday choices that not only help them, but also make the world a better place at the same time.

Welcome to Mandai X.

Role Purpose

The Lead, Programme & Activation is responsible for the end-to-end development and delivery of Mandai X's edutainment programmes across physical, digital and hybrid formats. The portfolio includes large-scale, digitally enabled missions, recurring partner-led programmes, flagship Ranger Buddies experiences, seasonal campaigns, mall activations, roadshows, pop-ups and community events.

The role translates an approved business plan or proposition into an integrated experience that can operate across multiple locations and partners, supported by the required digital product, content, technology, operations and customer journey.

As the single point of accountability, the role ensures each programme is delivered on time, within budget and to the expected quality, safety and brand standards, while achieving agreed participation, engagement, commercial and strategic outcomes.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Programme Strategy & Portfolio Leadership

Own the end-to-end delivery of physical, digital and hybrid programmes, from approved proposition and business plan through design, build, launch, ongoing operations and post-programme review.

Translate strategic and commercial objectives into a clear programme architecture, delivery roadmap, scope, milestones, governance model, resource plan and success measures.

Manage a portfolio of concurrent initiatives, balancing priorities, dependencies, resources and delivery risk across workstreams.

Design programmes for scale and repeatability, including frameworks that can be extended across locations, partner categories, markets or campaign periods.

Serve as the primary point of accountability for programme outcomes and provide clear recommendations and decisions to senior management.

Digital Missions & Integrated Experience Delivery

Lead large-scale, digitally enabled missions, integrating gameplay, content, partner touchpoints, physical locations and participant journeys into one coherent programme.

Work with Product, Technology and Content teams to define user journeys, functional requirements, delivery priorities, testing plans, launch readiness and operational support for digital mission components.

Ensure the digital and physical experience works as one system, including discovery, registration where applicable, participation, progress, rewards, redemption and re-engagement.

Coordinate pilots, user testing and phased roll-outs; use findings to refine the experience before scaling.

Plan for programme continuity beyond launch, including content refreshes, partner onboarding, issue resolution, participant communications and ongoing optimisation.

Experiential Activation & Operational Delivery

Lead the planning and execution of flagship experiences, mall campaigns, roadshows, exhibitions, community events, partner activations and other physical programme touchpoints.

Coordinate venue readiness, logistics, manpower, technology, merchandising, rewards, customer service and on-ground experience.

Establish operating playbooks, service standards and partner guidelines to ensure consistent delivery across multiple sites and operators.

Ensure operational readiness across all stakeholders before launch, including rehearsals, testing, training, escalation protocols and contingency planning.

Identify and mitigate delivery, safety, customer experience and reputational risks throughout the programme lifecycle.

Commercial & P&L Management

Manage programme financial performance against the approved business plan, including revenue, partner contributions, operating costs, capital requirements and profitability.

Work with Sales and Partnerships to translate sponsor and partner commitments into deliverable scopes, timelines and measurable value.

Track financial performance and commercial commitments throughout the programme lifecycle and recommend corrective action where required.

Work closely with Finance to ensure sound forecasting, reporting, procurement and financial governance.

Identify opportunities to improve programme economics through scale, repeatable assets, partner participation and operational efficiencies.

Partner Ecosystem & Stakeholder Management

Partner closely with Product, Technology, Content, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Operations, Procurement, Data and Legal to deliver integrated programmes.

Coordinate cross-functional workstreams, clarify ownership and dependencies, and drive timely decisions and issue resolution.

Build and manage relationships with sponsors, venue operators, ecosystem partners, agencies, contractors and strategic partners.

Develop practical onboarding requirements and delivery toolkits so multiple partners can participate within a consistent programme and brand framework.

Provide concise and regular updates on progress, risks, financial performance and decisions required to senior management and key stakeholders.

Vendor & Delivery Partner Management

Appoint, manage and evaluate agencies, technology vendors, event organisers, production partners and other delivery partners.

Define and negotiate scope, deliverables, timelines, service levels, acceptance criteria and escalation arrangements.

Ensure vendors meet agreed quality, security, brand, budget and contractual obligations, in partnership with the relevant subject-matter owners.

Performance, Data & Continuous Improvement

Define programme KPIs and success measures across participation, engagement, completion, repeat usage, partner value, customer experience, revenue, operational performance and ROI.

Establish appropriate dashboards and reporting rhythms to monitor performance during live programmes and support timely intervention.

Work with Product and Data teams to ensure programme measurement is designed into the participant journey and complies with applicable data and consent requirements.

Conduct structured reviews after pilots, launches and major programme phases; capture lessons learnt and convert them into improved playbooks, processes and product requirements.

Use participant, partner and operational insights to strengthen programme design and support future scale.

Team Leadership

Lead and develop the Programme & Activation team and any cross-functional programme squads formed for major initiatives.

Allocate resources across concurrent programmes and build the internal and external capabilities required for delivery.

Coach team members in programme management, stakeholder engagement, commercial discipline and operational excellence.

Foster a collaborative, accountable and high-performance culture with strong ownership of outcomes.

Job Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Events Management, Hospitality, Project Management, Digital Product Management or a related discipline.

8-12 years of relevant experience leading complex programmes, integrated experiences, large-scale activations, digital products or platform-enabled initiatives.

Demonstrated experience managing multi-workstream programmes involving Product, Technology, Content, Marketing, Commercial and Operations teams.

Proven ability to take an initiative from concept or approved business case through build, launch, live operations and performance optimisation.

Strong commercial acumen, with experience managing budgets, programme P&L, contracts and partner commitments.

Experience working with external agencies, technology vendors, event organisers, venue operators, sponsors and strategic partners.

Strong understanding of customer journeys, digital engagement, testing, measurement and operational readiness; experience with gamified or location-based experiences is an advantage.

Experience in children's, family, education, entertainment, media, attractions or IP-led experiences is an advantage.

Excellent leadership, communication, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate effectively in an evolving environment.

Project Management Professional (PMP), Agile or equivalent certification is an advantage.

title: Project Manager (ASEAN 2027) â€“ 18-month Contract
description:
Singapore Business Federation (SBF) is seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Project Manager (ASEAN 2027) to support the organisation and delivery of key events under Singapore's ASEAN Chairmanship in 2027. Reporting to the Programme Lead, the candidate will be part of the organising committee and play a central operational role in planning and executing a suite of high-profile regional events. The role is primarily operational in nature, with a focus on end-to-end event coordination, vendor and logistics management, stakeholder liaison and on-site execution to ensure that all events are delivered to the highest standards.

Responsibilities:

1. Event Planning & Project Coordination

Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, task lists and manpower allocation charts for each event.
Coordinate end-to-end logistics including venue sourcing, accommodation, catering, audio-visual setup, transportation and permits for all assigned events.
Track project milestones and flag potential delays or issues to the Programme Lead in a timely manner.
Support the conceptualisation and programming of key events.

2. Vendor & Logistics Management

Liaise with and manage external vendors and service providers including Professional Conference Organisers (PCOs), audio-visual teams, venue operators, catering providers, and transportation companies.
Prepare and manage procurement processes including request for quotations, vendor evaluation and contract documentation.
Ensure all deliverables from vendors are met on time, within budget and to the required quality standards.

3. Budget Tracking & Financial Administration

Monitor expenditure against approved budgets and flag variances promptly.
Support cost negotiations with vendors and assist in the processing of invoices and claims.

4. Stakeholder & Partner Coordination

Serve as the key operational point of contact with regional business organisations, partner agencies, sponsors and other stakeholders on day-to-day event matters.
Coordinate with internal teams across SBF to ensure alignment and smooth implementation of event plans.
Provide regular operational updates to the Programme Lead and relevant programme leads, including status reports and risk flags.

5. On-Site Event Execution

Lead on-site coordination during event set-up, rehearsals and live event execution.
Manage event-day operations including front-of-house, delegate flow, room management and real-time troubleshooting.
Coordinate with protocol and logistics teams to manage VIP guest arrangements, including ministers, Political Office Holders (POHs) and senior business delegates.
Ensure all operational aspects run smoothly and escalate issues to the Director where required.

6. Post-Event Reporting & Process Improvement

Collect participant feedback and compile post-event performance metrics and KPI reports.
Prepare comprehensive post-event summary reports with observations and recommendations for future improvements.
Contribute to the review and enhancement of event SOPs as needed.

7. Administrative & Ad-Hoc Support

Prepare event materials including briefing notes, run-of-show documents, programme booklets and collaterals as required.
Provide secretariat support for internal planning meetings and working groups.
Undertake any other duties as assigned by management in support of SBF's ASEAN Chairmanship 2027 objectives.

Requirements:

A degree in Event Management, Business, Communications, or a related discipline.
At least 5 years of relevant experience in event management, project management, or related fields.
Demonstrated experience managing multi-stakeholder events of a regional or international scale, preferably involving government agencies or associations.
Strong project and event management skills including the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously under tight deadlines.
Proficiency in budget management, cost tracking and vendor administration.
Ability to prepare clear and professional event documentation including project plans, reports and briefing materials.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
Highly organised, detail-oriented and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, take ownership of responsibilities and remain calm and decisive under pressure, particularly during event execution.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across internal teams and external stakeholders in a fast-paced environment and willingness to work irregular hours and weekends during event periods.

description:
Company Description

ABOUT KENDO

Kendo is the small but mighty force behind your favourite beauty products. A play on the words “can do,” Kendo is redefining the beauty industry through next-generation products, visionary campaigns and unforgettable retail presence. Kendo creates original founder brands, partnering with major faces from fashion and entertainment. POSITION SUMMARY

The Brand & Marketing Manager is responsible for orchestrating and executing the brand and marketing strategy for the SEA & India region. Reporting to the Senior Marketing Manager, this role leads the development and implementation of brand positioning, messaging, and consumer engagement across all touchpoints, ensuring a cohesive and impactful brand presence.

The Brand & Marketing Manager drives the planning and execution of comprehensive 360° marketing initiatives, manages the marketing calendar and budget, and collaborates closely with commercial, retail, and education teams to optimize brand performance and market share. Additionally, this role oversees in-store visual merchandising, leads special projects and consumer events, and partners with PR and social media teams to ensure alignment with brand objectives. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker and hands-on leader with deep experience in brand management and marketing within the beauty industry, a proven track record in the SEA & India markets, and a passion for building strong cross-functional relationships in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Brand Management

Responsible to strategize, define and implement the brands’ mission, objectives and positioning in the market. Oversees the consistency & timely delivery of brand messaging across all touchpoints and all stakeholders.

Serves as the brands’ spokesperson, ensuring to maintain a cohesive narrative (brand messaging, brand positions, brand values) across PR, social media, Advertising, Retail & Education.

Lead all brand meetings and support negotiations to secure optimal support from retail partners.

Responsible to design and oversee the consumer engagement journey in collaboration with cross functional stakeholders to achieve brands objectives.

Collaborate with cross functional team to consolidate and share consumer insights to global teams, offering region-specific product enhancement suggestions and championing regional requirements (from brand assets to engagement activities)

Stay abreast of makeup trends, innovations, and regulatory changes in SEA & India. Analyse market trends, consumer behaviour, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and inform marketing plans. Integrate digital and social-first thinking into core brand strategies.

Marketing

Owns the development and management of Marketing Calendar. Responsible to design milestones to achieve brand strategy & aligned KPI. Responsible to ensure all key stakeholders are consulted, informed and aligned on the identified priority in a timely manner.

Lead the planning and execution of comprehensive marketing strategies for SEA & India, spanning paid media, partnerships, promotions, CRM, sampling, retail events, and brand-led initiatives, ensuring alignment with overall brand direction.

Own and manage the brand’s marketing budget, ensuring responsible spending and achievement of ROI targets.

Collaborate with commercial, retail, and education teams to develop tools and materials that drive sell-through and optimize brand presence with retail partners and distributors.

May be appointed to lead or participate in special projects (e.g., always-on campaigns, combat plans), ensuring brand cohesiveness, effective execution, and achievement of KPIs.

Lead and oversees the end-to-end design and execution of consumer events, ensuring consistency with brand guidelines, objectives and delivering a cohesive brand experience.

Define pricing strategies for new launches and review annual price adjustments. Lead product launch forecasting and collaborate with Planning and Retail teams to maintain optimal stock levels, particularly for key products (eg: Key bets, Top SKUs, Hot off Press etc)

Lead the delivery of marketing projects and campaigns, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and timely execution.

Measure and analyze the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and activities. Provide actionable insights and recommendations to the Senior Marketing Manager for continuous improvement.

PR

Partner with the PR and Social Media team to ensure all PR and social media strategies are aligned with brand objectives and guidelines.

Visual Merchandising

Oversee the brand’s in-store visual merchandising and gondola displays, ensuring they are updated seasonally to reflect new launches and discontinuations, and are consistent with brand guidelines.

Work closely with the retail and education teams to ensure timely implementation of marketing mechanics and visual updates at the counter.

General

Foster strong relationships with internal teams and external partners to secure aligned support and resources for all marketing initiatives.

Actively contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and creative team culture in line with Kendo SEA values. Mentor and support team members, promoting a positive and high-performance work environment.

Identify and implement processes, tools, and procedures to enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of brand and marketing operations.

Take ownership for achieving key brand KPIs, leveraging insights from the team and reporting progress and recommendations to the Senior Marketing Manager.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS

At least 7 years of experience in a Brand or Marketing role. Beauty Industry a plus.

Experience in Southeast Asia and India markets is a plus

Strategic thinker and brand builder.

Team player that inspires others and collaborates cross functionally.

The ability to work in a fast-paced environment and juggle multiple priorities.

Strong organizational, keen attention to detail, follow-up skills, hands-on in getting things done.

Strong business acumen and analytical skills, results oriented.

Good interpersonal skills high level of integrity.

Can do attitude, flexible with an ability to work with a level of ambiguity.

Ability to deploy ideas effectively and present to Senior Management.

Proactively collaborate to strengthen the core values and culture of Kendo Brands

title: Admin & Client Servicing Executive (Events & Media)
description:
RS Photography is a Singapore photography and video production company. Since 2013 we have delivered over 2,600 assignments for 693 clients, and we run 150 to 160 shoots a month for government agencies, associations and corporate clients: conferences, award ceremonies, exhibitions, national events and corporate portraits.

We are hiring an Admin Executive. Our job title is Admin & Client Servicing Executive (Events & Media). You will be the person our clients deal with day to day, and the person who keeps our bookings, quotations and invoicing running cleanly. It is a single, defined seat reporting directly to the Director. The work is yours to own, not to assist with.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Run day-to-day office and admin matters independently

- Be the first reply to client enquiries by email and phone, and stay the named contact through to delivery

- Prepare quotations from our standard rate cards for the Director's approval, and follow up on the ones that go quiet

- Work our daily sales queue: review outreach drafts to event organisers and exhibitors, send the approved batches, and log every reply the same day

- Turn replies into bookings: confirm dates, booth numbers and hours, and prepare quotations from our standard rate cards for approval

- Book and brief our freelance photographers and videographers for busy show weeks, so every confirmed booth has a named crew member

- Raise invoices, submit e-invoices online, and track payment, including government purchase orders and their reference numbers

- Turn confirmed jobs into calendar bookings with complete details: contact person, venue, reporting time, shoot requirements, billing notes

- Prepare the weekly shoot schedule and coordinate between clients and our photographers and videographers

- Assist with tender and quotation submissions on government procurement portals

- Handle HR paperwork: employment letters, work pass applications and renewals

- Keep company documents and vendor registrations current

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- At least 2 years in an admin, client servicing, coordination or account support role

- Confident written English. You will be writing to clients directly, often to government officers

- Comfortable writing and sending a high volume of professional emails, and keeping a simple tracker up to date

- Comfortable with numbers: quotations, invoices, purchase orders, simple reconciliation

- Organised under volume. We run 150 to 160 jobs a month; the details are the job

- Working knowledge of Google Workspace or Microsoft Office

- You can use AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to draft, summarise and organise work, and you check the output before it goes to a client. You will show us at the interview

- Someone who follows up without being chased

NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED

- Experience in events, media, production, an agency, or another service business with many small jobs

- Exposure to government procurement: GeBIZ, Vendors@Gov, InvoiceNow, purchase orders

- Experience with work pass applications or HR administration

- Invoicing or bookkeeping software experience

WHAT WE OFFER

- S$2,800 to S$3,000 per month, all fixed, depending on experience

- A 5-day work week, Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm with a one-hour lunch break

- A defined seat reporting to the Director, with real ownership

- A team of 10 where your work is visible and matters

- Training on our booking, quotation and invoicing process in your first weeks

- CPF, annual leave and public holidays in accordance with the Employment Act

LOCATION

Midview City, 22 Sin Ming Lane #06-82, Singapore 573969, in the Sin Ming and Bishan area. This role is based in our Singapore office and we are not able to sponsor employment passes.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through Indeed with your CV. Please tell us your earliest available start date. We are hiring now, and candidates who can start sooner will be prioritised.

title: EVENT OPERATIONS MANAGER
description:
Job Description & Requirements

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented

Event Operations Manager

to oversee the end-to-end operational planning, logistics, and on-site execution of live events, productions, and entertainment experiences. This role leads operational workflows from concept to post-event teardown, ensuring high production standards, strict budget control, venue compliance, and seamless guest experiences.

Key Responsibilities

Operations & Production Management:

Lead end-to-end operational planning and on-site execution for corporate, public, and live entertainment events.

Vendor & Contractor Coordination:

Source, negotiate with, and supervise vendors for audio-visual (AV), staging, lighting, logistics, ticketing, catering, and security.

Permits & Regulatory Compliance:

Secure necessary venue approvals, police permits, SCDF fire safety clearances, and public entertainment licenses in accordance with Singapore statutory requirements.

Risk Assessment & Safety:

Develop and implement crowd management plans, emergency response protocols, and Workplace Safety and Health (WSH) guidelines for bump-in, event duration, and teardown.

Budget & Resource Planning:

Manage operational budgets, monitor run rates, allocate internal/external resources efficiently, and minimize operational wastage.

Team Supervision:

Lead, train, and deploy full-time production crews, part-time event staff, and freelance technicians to ensure seamless coordination on show days.

Post-Event Review:

Manage inventory returns, venue handover inspections, vendor reconciliation, and operational post-mortem reports.

Requirements & Qualifications

Diploma or Degree in Event Management, Operations Management, Hospitality, or a related field.

Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on event operations or live entertainment production experience.

Proven track record managing large-scale event logistics, venue setup/strike, and technical production teams.

Strong familiarity with local venue regulations, statutory licensing, and WSH compliance in Singapore.

Excellent negotiation, conflict resolution, and crisis management skills under tight deadlines.

Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays, based on event schedules.

title: Event Operations & Client Experience Executive
description:
We’re looking for an *Event Operations & Client Experience Executive* to join The Arcade People, where we bring games, entertainment and experiences to events across Singapore.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys *people, problem-solving and a little bit of controlled chaos*.

You’ll work closely with our clients, sales team and operations crew to make sure events run smoothly, from the first client conversation to the final machine packed away.

No two days are quite the same. One day you may be coordinating an event setup, the next you could be helping a client work out the best game selection, and another day you might be on-site solving an unexpected problem that definitely wasn't in the original plan.

What You'll Be Doing

*Client & Event Coordination*

* Communicate with clients to understand their event requirements and expectations
* Coordinate event details, timelines, logistics and on-site requirements
* Assist with client enquiries and provide practical recommendations
* Coordinate with venues, event organisers, suppliers and internal teams
* Build positive relationships with clients and ensure a smooth experience

*Event Operations*

* Coordinate and support event setups, teardowns and on-site operations
* Work closely with our logistics and operations teams to ensure equipment is ready and delivered correctly
* Attend events when required and ensure operations run smoothly
* Make sure our games, attractions and equipment are presented and operated properly

*Problem Solving & Troubleshooting*

* Handle unexpected situations and last-minute changes calmly and efficiently
* Think on your feet and find practical solutions when things don't go according to plan
* Troubleshoot basic equipment or operational issues and coordinate with the relevant team when technical support is required
* Take ownership of problems rather than simply passing them along

*General Operations*

* Assist with quotations, event documentation and internal coordination
* Support day-to-day office and operations activities
* Learn our wide range of arcade games, carnival games, inflatables, F&B stations and other event attractions
* Take on additional projects and responsibilities as you grow into the role

What We're Looking For

We care more about *how you think and how you work* than having a perfect piece of paper.

You may be a great fit if you are:

* *Resourceful* – you naturally look for solutions instead of waiting for someone else to solve the problem
* *Quick-thinking* – you can stay calm and make decisions when things change
* *People-oriented* – you are comfortable speaking with clients, colleagues, vendors and event crews
* *Organised* – you can keep track of multiple moving parts without losing the plot
* *Adaptable* – you're comfortable switching between office work and event sites
* *Hands-on* – you're not afraid to get involved and get things done
* *Responsible* – you take ownership of your work and follow through
* *Willing to learn* – you don't need to know everything, but you should be curious enough to figure things out

*Experience in events, hospitality, customer service, operations or project coordination is an advantage, but not essential.*

Fresh graduates with the right attitude and strong problem-solving skills are welcome to apply.

The Reality of the Role

This isn't a typical desk job.

There will be days where you're answering emails and coordinating clients. There will also be days where you're at an event, moving between different teams, solving problems and making sure everything comes together.

You may occasionally need to work *weekends, evenings or public holidays*, depending on event schedules.

If you enjoy variety, working with people and figuring things out as you go, you'll probably enjoy this role.

Why Join Us?

At The Arcade People, we don't just rent out arcade machines. We create *fun, memorable experiences* for corporate events, activations, parties, attractions and more.

You'll get exposure to:

* Event planning and execution
* Client management
* Operations and logistics
* Sales and commercial coordination
* A wide range of entertainment products and experiences
* Real-world problem solving and project ownership

Most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to *grow with the role*. As you gain experience, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of larger events, projects and client accounts.

Ready to Level Up?

If you're someone who likes variety, enjoys solving problems, can handle people and doesn't panic when Plan A suddenly becomes Plan C...

*We'd love to hear from you. *

Send us your CV and tell us a little about yourself, what you're good at, and why you think you'd be a good fit for The Arcade People.

Pay: $2,000.00 - $3,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Manager, Marketing and Communications
description:
About Asia Climate Philanthropy Advisory

The Asia Climate Philanthropy Advisory (ACPA) is headquartered in Singapore and supported by several leading philanthropists and climate foundations. ACPA is mandated to support ultra-high-net-worth individuals to make philanthropic investments into the climate action space by providing bespoke advisory support, curated local climate knowledge, carefully vetted giving opportunities, and access to a diverse network of climate-focused experts, peers and partners.

About the Role

We seek a seasoned, outstanding individual to join as its Manager, Marketing & Communications and lead the implementation of ACPA’s communications roadmap, including content strategy, digital engagement, events planning, and media outreach. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who combines strategic thinking with strong execution, creative flair, and excellent project management skills.

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, the Manager will help position ACPA as a trusted, visible, and credible partner in the Asian philanthropy ecosystem — translating complex ideas into compelling narratives that inspire giving and collaboration on climate action.

Responsibilities

The Manager, Marketing & Communications will engage in the following areas of responsibility.

Support the implementation of ACPA’s brand strategy, messaging framework, and tone of voice across all channels.

Work with external agencies to produce brand and communications assets (e.g., templates, decks, infographics, case studies).

Develop and manage ACPA’s editorial calendar and content pipeline across website, LinkedIn, and other platforms as required.

Research, copywrite, and edit high-quality content such as articles, donor stories, partner spotlights, and thought leadership pieces.

Oversee website updates and work with designers and developers to enhance user experience and impact storytelling.

Support media engagement, including drafting press releases, managing media lists, and coordinating interviews and coverage.

Cultivate relationships with key communications and ecosystem partners to amplify ACPA’s visibility.

Track and evaluate media performance and engagement metrics.

Develop communications plans and promotional materials for ACPA convenings, briefings, and flagship gatherings.

Create on-site and post-event content, including talking points, recaps, and visual assets.

Support the production of POS and knowledge materials

Support communications with donor clients as needed by the Climate and Philanthropy teams

Manage external vendors and freelancers (writers, designers, photographers) to ensure timely delivery of outputs.

Track communications KPIs, maintain documentation and asset libraries, and contribute to reporting and evaluation.

Qualifications and Requirements

10-12 years of experience and track record in communications – ideally with non-profit/non-governmental organizations.

Proven experience developing and executing communication and brand strategies.

Superb verbal and written communication skills in English, with proficiency in writing, editing and storytelling. Proficiency in other Asian languages is advantageous.

Excellent writing, editing, and storytelling skills,

with a strong grasp of tone and audience adaptation.

Experience managing social media channels and content calendars.

Strong project management skills and comfort working with external vendors and cross-functional teams.

While not mandatory, a genuine interest in climate change and social impact, and ability to quickly grasp related concepts are desirable.

Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a small, dynamic and collaborative team.

Excellent event, project management and coordination abilities.

Track record of working in environments requiring professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.

Resourceful problem-solving skills with a proactive, ‘can-do’ attitude towards challenges and changes.

Alignment with ACPA’s mission and commitment to embodying ACPA values.

Bachelor’s degree in communications, public relations, marketing, journalism, or related field.

Note :

Only Shortlisted candidates will be notified.

several leading philanthropists and climate foundations. Read more about how we support Endeavor Entrepreneurs around the world - from Nairobi to Kuala Lumpur, Mexico City to Dubai.

About how we plan to advance the Multiplier Effect by helping entrepreneurs grow faster, think bigger, and give back to their communities as they inspire, mentor, and invest in others.

title: Events, Programming & Business Development Executive
description:
The Events, Programming & BusinessDevelopment Executive is responsible for managing assigned events, developing revenue opportunities and supporting entertainment programming and production activities across the company’s venues.

The role covers the end-to-end coordinationof corporate events, venue rentals, private functions, selected ticketed programmes and commercial partnerships, from initial enquiry through execution and post-event follow-up.

This is a commercially driven role withaccountability for assigned sales and revenue targets. The Executive will workclosely with internal departments, clients, artistes, technical personnel,vendors, sponsors and external partners to support the growth of the Music,Content & Events (MCE) portfolio.

The position is eligible for commission onqualifying revenue in accordance with the Company’s prevailing commissionscheme.

Key Responsibilities

1. Events & Client Management

Manage assigned corporate functions, venue rentals, private events, activations and ticketed programmes from enquiry through event completion.

Liaise directly with clients to understand event objectives, requirements, budgets and timelines.

Conduct client meetings, site inspections and event briefings where required.

Prepare event proposals, quotations, timelines, run sheets and operational requirements.

Coordinate with Operations, Marketing, Finance, Technical teams and external vendors to ensure smooth event delivery.

Coordinate venue setup, manpower, equipment, production and event logistics.

Be present on-site for assigned events and manage client and operational requirements during execution.

Resolve event-related issues promptly and escalate matters where necessary.

Ensure assigned events comply with venue requirements, operational procedures, safety standards and applicable licensing requirements.

Conduct post-event follow-up and identify opportunities for repeat business and service improvement.

2. Business Development & Revenue

Develop new business opportunities through corporate events, venue rentals, private functions, sponsorships and commercial partnerships.

Respond promptly to incoming event and venue enquiries.

Build and maintain relationships with corporate clients, event organisers, agencies and business partners.

Prepare and present proposals, quotations, event budgets and commercial packages.

Manage commercial discussions and negotiate within approved pricing and commercial guidelines, escalating exceptions for approval.

Follow up actively on proposals and enquiries to improve sales conversion.

Maintain an updated sales pipeline covering enquiries, proposals, confirmed events and prospective opportunities.

Identify opportunities for repeat business, account development and long-term client relationships.

Achieve assigned individual and/or team revenue targets.

Identify opportunities to improve event profitability and maximise revenue from assigned accounts and events.

3. Sponsorship & Commercial Partnerships

Identify potential sponsors, brand partners and commercial collaboration opportunities.

Develop or support the preparation of sponsorship proposals and activation packages.

Liaise with sponsors and partners on agreed requirements, timelines and deliverables.

Coordinate with Marketing and Operations to ensure agreed brand visibility and activation requirements are fulfilled.

Maintain sponsor and partner relationships before, during and after events.

Explore additional revenue opportunities through brand activations, collaborations and commercial initiatives.

4. Entertainment & DigitalProgramming

Coordinate resident band, artiste and entertainment schedules across assigned venues.

Maintain programming calendars, artiste schedules and related documentation.

Liaise with bands, artistes, agents and relevant partners on bookings, schedules and performance requirements.

Coordinate artiste agreements and administrative requirements where applicable.

Support the development of entertainment concepts aligned with venue positioning, audience profiles and business objectives.

Monitor audience response, customer feedback and programme performance.

Recommend programming improvements or new entertainment formats for management review.

Support livestreaming, TikTok Live and other digital entertainment initiatives where applicable.

Coordinate talent, scheduling and production requirements for digital programming.

Explore opportunities to improve audience engagement and commercial value through digital content.

5. Technical & ProductionCoordination

Coordinate technical production requirements for assigned events, entertainment programmes and venue activations.

Liaise with internal technical personnel, sound engineers, vendors and contractors.

Ensure event technical requirements are confirmed in advance and equipment is ready for use.

Coordinate technical systems including:

LED walls

Resolume Media Server

Projectors and presentation systems

Audio systemsMultimedia and visual equipment

Where trained, support basic operation, setup, testing and troubleshooting of technical systems.

Escalate complex technical issues to the appropriate technical personnel or vendor.

Support consistent production and technical standards across assigned events.

6. Sound Engineering Coordination

Coordinate sound engineer schedules and manpower deployment for regular programming and special events.

Ensure sufficient technical coverage is arranged based on event and venue requirements.

Verify attendance and deployment records for sound engineers.

Submit accurate attendance and payroll-related records to the relevant department for processing.

Communicate event schedules and technical requirements clearly to assigned technical personnel.

Provide basic operational or technical support during events where trained and required.

Highlight recurring technical or manpower issues and recommend process improvements.

7. Major Events & Team Support

Work collaboratively with the MCE team on major festivals, flagship events and company-wide activations.

Take ownership of assigned workstreams and deliverables.

Support projects from concept development through planning, execution and post-event review.

Coordinate with internal departments, venue stakeholders, vendors, artistes and external partners.

Ensure assigned timelines, budgets and operational requirements are met.

Provide support to other team members during major or high-volume event periods where required.

8. Financial & AdministrativeResponsibilities

Prepare quotations, invoices, purchase requirements and event-related documentation accurately and on time.

Maintain proper records of enquiries, client communications, contracts, schedules and event documents.

Track revenue, direct event costs and assigned event expenditure.

Monitor event profitability against approved quotations and budgets.

Follow up on outstanding documentation, deposits and payment requirements with relevant stakeholders.

Support monthly revenue tracking and performance reporting.

Provide inputs for departmental budgeting and business planning where required.

Revenue Growth Responsibilities

The Executive is expected to contribute to the commercial growth ofthe MCE portfolio through:

Corporate events

Venue rentals

Private functions

Ticketed programmes

Sponsorships

Entertainment programming

Brand activations

Commercial partnerships

The Executive should actively identify opportunities to increase revenue, improve venue utilisation, generate repeat business and enhance even tprofitability while maintaining service and operational standards.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance may be assessed based on:

Achievement of assigned individual and/or team revenue targets

Sales conversion and development of the business pipeline

Event profitability and cost management

Successful execution of assigned events and programmes

Client satisfaction and repeat business

Sponsorship and commercial opportunities generated

Timeliness and accuracy of quotations, proposals and event documentation

Contribution to programming, technical operations and overall MCE performance

Remuneration & Commission

The position comprises a fixed monthly salary together with eligibility for sales commission.

Commission may apply to qualifying revenue generated from approved revenue streams including:

Corporate events and functions

Venue rentals

Private events

Sponsorships

Commercial partnerships

Other approved revenue-generating opportunities

Commission eligibility, revenue attribution, calculation, qualifying conditions, exclusions and payment arrangements will be governed separately by the Company’s prevailing commission scheme.

Requirements

Diploma or Degree in Events Management, Hospitality, Business, Marketing, Media, Communications or a related discipline preferred.

Relevant experience in events, hospitality, entertainment, venue operations, sales or business development would be advantageous.

Strong coordination, organisation and time-management skills.

Good written and verbal communication skills.

Confident in dealing with clients, artistes, vendors and internal stakeholders.

Commercially minded with a strong interest in sales and business development.

Able to manage multiple events, enquiries and priorities concurrently.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced and operational environment.

Willing to work evenings, weekends and public holidays where required for events and entertainment programmes.

Basic understanding of audio-visual or live entertainment production would be advantageous.

Knowledge of LED walls, Resolume, audio systems or livestreaming would be an added advantage.

Hands-on, resourceful and able to respond calmly to changes during live events.

Timbre Group was founded with the social mission of developing the Singapore music scene through the talent cultivation of Singapore musicians and growing a sustainable audience for them. Today, Timbre holds a portfolio of live music restaurants-bars and dining concepts, two Hawker Centres (Timbre + & Yishun Park Hawker Centre), and artist management agency and a music academy.

Responsibilities:

Manage employee event requests through client CMMS system or as advised by client stakeholders. Respond to event request and inquiries with efficiency, coordinating with operations team as required.
Coordinate and execute on-site and remote events: taking ownership and making real time decisions to secure space, managing AV setup and takedown, greeting guests, and liaise with catering or logistics teams. Accountable to the overall budget associate and only escalate when costs, scope, risk, or safety considerations materially change.
Support and manage meeting rooms, all-hands spaces, and other bookable areas - helping troubleshoot calendar clashes and ensuring the environment is meeting-ready.
Maintain a strong working relationship with building management and operations teams - coordinating access control, cleaning schedules, maintenance visits, and ongoing facility’s needs accordance with event requirement.
Communicate updates and announcements through client’s platform or email, ensuring clarity around visitor experience and space usage during event operations.
Work closely with the FM and HX teams on initiatives, event rollouts, employee programs, and special projects.
Collaborate with the FM, HSE Team and Workplace Security during safety drills and evacuation exercises.
Conduct daily office walkthroughs to ensure a clean, safe, and well-stocked event environment..

Requirements:
3+ years of experience in office coordination, hospitality, facilities, or workplace operations.
A strong operational mindset with a genuine passion for building meaningful employee experiences.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities with exceptional attention to detail.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills across email and in-person interactions.
Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and comfort using CMMS platform or help desk platforms.
A proactive, positive, and solutions-oriented attitude - someone who thrives in fast-paced, people-first environments.

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.

About JLL –

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.

Attend to general workplace enquiries.
Receive, sort and distribute incoming mail, parcels and courier deliveries.

Meeting Rooms and Shared SpacesCoordinate meeting-room bookings, access requests and special arrangements.

Support pre-event preparation, on-site coordination and post-event reinstatement.
Ensure event arrangements comply with site safety, security and workplace requirements.
Pantry Supplies and Workplace AmenitiesMonitor and coordinate pantry supplies, refreshments and workplace consumables.
Maintain suitable stock levels and arrange replenishment when required.
Request quotations and place orders within the approved budget and process.
Coordinate with vendors on product selection, deliveries and replenishment schedules.
Coordinate servicing and repairs for coffee machines, water dispensers and other pantry equipment.
Monitor pantry service standards and follow up on employee feedback.
Inventory and Asset ManagementMaintain accurate inventories of workplace supplies, consumables, equipment and facilities assets.
Monitor stock levels and coordinate timely replenishment.
Maintain records of stock received, issued, transferred or disposed of.
Conduct periodic inventory checks and reconcile discrepancies.
Coordinate the issuance and return of facilities-related items where required.
Support asset tagging, tracking and disposal documentation.
Maintain organized storage areas and ensure items are properly labelled.
Vendor and Procurement AdministrationRequest, review and follow up on vendor quotations.
Coordinate vendor appointments, site visits, deliveries and service activities.
Assist with vendor registration and onboarding documentation.
Prepare and maintain purchase, quotation, purchase-order and invoice records.
Follow up with vendors, Procurement and Finance on payment matters.
Verify delivery orders and supporting documents before submission.
Maintain organized vendor, contract and service documentation.
Monitor service schedules and follow up on outstanding vendor deliverables.
Records and Compliance SupportCoordinate document-storage and records-management activities.
Maintain carton, file and document listings.
Support document-retention reviews and destruction approval processes.
Prepare safety notices, restricted-access signs and workplace posters.
Assist with first-aid, AED, CERT, EHS and audit documentation.
Maintain accurate records for internal reviews, inspections and compliance requirements.

Comfortable using Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Stay in regular contact with clients to build lasting partnerships and encourage repeat business.

Diploma in Event Management, Marketing, or a related field

With at least 2-3 years of working experience in the events industry.

A genuine passion for events and experiential marketing, and for creating memorable experiences.

A positive mindset and the motivation to take ownership of your clients and results.

A strong relationship builder with a client-focused, service-oriented approach.

A team player who enjoys working with colleagues across departments and countries.

Flexibility to work outside regular hours during event periods, including evenings and weekends when needed.

Experience in events, hospitality or sales is a plus, but we value attitude and sincerity just as much.

5-day workweek. Occasional weekend work may be required if events fall on weekends(rare).

APAC regional travel required. Flights, accommodation, and meals will be provided.

Full-time, permanent role.

A supportive team that looks out for one another, especially during the busiest seasons.

The chance to work with a diverse regional team across APAC regions!

Real ownership of your clients from first conversation to final event.

The satisfaction of seeing your work come to life, and the memories that come with it.

Flat working structure. We take your feedback and contribution seriously, and we want you to grow together with the company

Preferably possess at least two years of relevant experience in learning and development, continuing education and training, human resources, or a related field. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
Good understanding of, or strong interest in, emerging workforce trends, particularly generative and agentic AI, automation and data on jobs and skills.
Basic competency in data analysis and visualisation using tools such as Microsoft Excel or Power BI, with the ability to interpret data and present meaningful insights.
Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to prepare clear communications, reports, presentations and publicity materials.
Strong planning, coordination and project management skills, with close attention to detail and the ability to work effectively as a collaborative team player.
Comfortable engaging different groups of stakeholders, including learners, educators, senior leaders and external partners.

title: Public Relations Officer
description:
Job Summary: We are seeking a skilled and motivated Public Relations Officer to join our team. As a Public Relations Officer, you will be responsible for managing and enhancing the public image and reputation of our organization. You will develop and execute effective communication strategies, build relationships with key stakeholders, and handle media relations. The ideal candidate has exceptional communication skills, a strong understanding of public relations principles, and the ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Responsibilities:

Communication Strategy: Develop and implement comprehensive communication strategies that align with the organization's goals and objectives. Create messaging frameworks, key talking points, and press releases to effectively convey the organization's mission, initiatives, and achievements.

Media Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with media representatives, journalists, and influencers. Proactively pitch stories and secure media coverage for the organization and its events, campaigns, and milestones. Serve as the primary point of contact for media inquiries and coordinate interviews and press conferences.

Content Creation: Write, edit, and distribute compelling and engaging content for various channels, including press releases, newsletters, articles, blog posts, and social media. Ensure all content is accurate, consistent, and aligned with the organization's brand and messaging.

Crisis Management: Act as the organization's spokesperson during times of crisis or reputation management issues. Develop crisis communication plans, prepare key messaging, and manage media inquiries effectively. Mitigate potential damage to the organization's reputation and maintain transparency and trust with stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, partners, government agencies, and community organizations. Develop communication materials tailored to specific audiences and collaborate with internal teams to ensure consistent messaging across all touchpoints.

Event Planning and Management: Coordinate and oversee the planning and execution of press conferences, product launches, corporate events, and other public relations initiatives. Work closely with event organizers, vendors, and internal teams to ensure seamless execution and maximum media exposure.

Monitoring and Reporting: Monitor media coverage and public sentiment related to the organization and its industry. Prepare regular reports on media activity, campaign effectiveness, and key performance indicators. Analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

Requirements:

Proven work experience as a Public Relations Officer or in a similar role.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building abilities.

Knowledge of public relations principles, strategies, and best practices.

Experience in media relations, including pitching stories and handling media inquiries.

Ability to effectively manage crisis situations and handle sensitive information.

Familiarity with social media platforms and digital marketing trends.

Exceptional organizational and time management skills.

Proficiency in relevant software and tools.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

We offer a competitive salary, along with benefits and opportunities for professional growth. If you have a passion for public relations, a knack for storytelling, and a desire to shape and protect our organization's reputation, we invite you to apply for the position of Public Relations Officer.

title: Project Officer (Project Coordination/Event Management/Administration)
description:
Young and research-intensive, Nanyang Technological University (NTU Singapore) is ranked among the world’s top universities. The University combines technological strength with human creativity to address the significant challenges facing society, and draws its faculty and students from across the world.

The College of Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences (CoHASS) aims to be Asia’s leading centre for innovative, interdisciplinary humanities, arts and social science teaching and research. Its research priorities are Digital Culture and Society; Health, Culture and Society; Global Asia; and Art, Science and Ecology.

The Global Asia Research Centre (GARC) is a research centre within the College of Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences (CoHASS), Nanyang Technological University, Singapore. The Centre serves as a platform for interdisciplinary research and scholarly exchange on Asia and its global connections, bringing together academics, researchers, policymakers, and industry partners through research initiatives, conferences, workshops, seminars, and public engagement activities.

Through its research programmes and events, GARC facilitates dialogue on issues of regional and global significance, supports the dissemination of research findings, and fosters collaborations across institutions and disciplines.

For more information, please visit: https://www.ntu.edu.sg/hass/research/global-asia-research-centre

-

Globally ranked among top research and technology organizations in the environment and water domain, the NTU’s Nanyang Environment and Water Research Institute (NEWRI) ecosystem interacts across a multi- and inter- disciplinary platform of Research – engineering – Development (RED) activities in its approach to developing innovative solutions.

With leading edge technology and robust engineering, NEWRI strives to take its fundamental research from novel lab-scale innovation to industry-level translation and derisking activities - from field applications to piloting and development at full scale in real life settings. Through industrial and community- philanthropic projects for commercial and societal impact, NEWRI continuously strives to make a difference towards developing a circular economy for global sustainability.

For more details, please view https://www.ntu.edu.sg/newri

This is a joint appointment between the Global Asia Research Centre and the Mining Mineral Life project, housed at the Nanyang Environment and Water Research Institute (NEWRI). The Project Officer will contribute to the management and delivery of programs in the Global Asia Research Centre and the Mining Mineral Life: Extracting the Energy Transition in Southeast Asia research project. The role will be divided 60% on the Global Asia Research Centre and 40% on Mining Mineral Life. The role will be essential to the delivery of world class research programs and impact activities including organizing international conferences, seminars, fieldwork logistics.

At GARC, the candidate will join a team of the Director, the Deputy Director, and multiple Early Career Fellows. The centre also hosts Visiting Fellows and Visiting Professors.

On the Mining Mineral Life side, the candidate will join a team including the PI, two Research Fellows, and one PhD student. The team will also collaborate with artists and graphic designers on a program of scholarly and public facing artistic impact projects.

Key Responsibilities:

Coordinate the planning and execution of conferences, workshops, seminars, lectures, and other Centre-related events.
Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to confirm event requirements, budgets, timelines, and deliverables.
Manage venue bookings, travel arrangements, accommodation, transportation, catering, and other logistical requirements.
Administer event registration platforms and maintain participant databases.
Coordinate the preparation and dissemination of invitations, publicity materials, event websites, and email communications.
Monitor project and event budgets, process procurement requests, and support financial administration activities.
Liaise with vendors and service providers, including caterers, transport providers, photographers, and accommodation providers.
Coordinate event setup, onsite operations, attendee registration, and troubleshoot operational issues during events.
Manage photography, videography, and event recording arrangements where required.
Prepare post-event reports, maintain project documentation, and support reimbursement and claims processing.
Support website content updates and post-event publicity activities.
Undertake other administrative and project-related duties as assigned.
Assist in the delivery of international conferences at NTU and elsewhere by liaising with participants, facilitating travel arrangements, booking of rooms and spaces at NTU and beyond. Helping to facilitate during events, manage and arrange catering and other essential bookings.
Assist with hiring and onboarding of new research staff and PhD students.
Assist with fieldwork logistics for research team, including flights, accommodation, visa applications, budgeting, monitoring project accounts, facilitate local and overseas payments.

Experience

Experience in project coordination, event management, programme administration, or a related field is preferred.

title: Executive Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Executive Coordinator

Reports To: The Council & Secretariat

Location: Singapore

Employment Type: Full-Time / Permanent

Job Overview

Landscape Industry Association (Singapore) is seeking an organised, proactive Executive Coordinator to manage and drive the association's educational programs and events operations. In this role, you will manage day-to-day operations in our Association—working closely with the Executive Council and Committees to develop and deliver impactful workshops, educational courses, and industry programs.

The ideal candidate excels at balancing cross-functional communication, managing timelines with committee members, and delivering reliable, efficient administrative and logistical execution.

Key Responsibilities

1.End-to-End Training & events management/coordination

Facilitate the complete project lifecycle for training programs/events—from initial course scoping and curriculum scheduling to execution and final closeout.

· Ensure all course dependencies (e.g. accreditation/CEU submissions, trainer onboarding, venue bookings) are completed on time.

Conduct post-training evaluations, compile feedback analysis, and present findings to the Committee to continuously refine course quality.

Coordinate events organised by LIAS in conjunction with council and existing secretariat team

2.Committee Liaison & Stakeholder Engagement

Act as the primary liaison for Committee members, gathering, managing, and prioritising all incoming requests.

Foster team collaboration and idea-sharing among Committee members

Coordinate communications and facilitate information flow between the association, government agencies, and industry partners to ensure timely responses to joint initiatives and industry inquiries.

Build and maintain positive working relationships with trainers, industry regulators, government agencies and venue partners.

· Organise, facilitate, and document Committee meetings, preparing agendas, tracking action items, and circulating meeting minutes.

3.Timeline Tracking, Risk Management & Issue Resolution

Develop and maintain the full-year training calendar for operational tracking and resource planning

Proactively identify potential project risks (e.g., low registration numbers, trainer availability shifts) and implement contingency plans.

Resolve operational issues and participant inquiries professionally and promptly.

4.Project Documentation & SOP Management

Maintain a centralised, secure archive of course materials, participant databases, attendance records, and certification records.

Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) including association documentations.

Requirements& Qualifications

Education: Diploma or Degree in Business Administration, Education/Training Management, Project Management, or a related field.

Experience: 2–4 years of experience in project coordination, event management, or administrative operations—preferably within an industry association, non-profit, or professional membership body.

Key Skills:

Demonstrated ability to liaise with stakeholders, committee members, and external agencies.

Strong project planning skills

Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

The Landscape Industry Association (Singapore) (LIAS) was incorporated in 2001. Our mission is to develop and promote professionalism and quality in landscape products and services, supporting Singapore’s vision of being a City in Nature. LIAS fosters better networking among members, encourages industry discussions, and maximizes trade opportunities. We disseminate industry updates, organize trade programs and promotions, and conduct activities related to landscaping.

Managing Sales Activities

• Solicits/books local catering business and develops group business.

• Develops and manages catering sales revenue and operation budgets, and provides forecasting reports.

• Works with the management team to create and implement a catering sales/marketing plan addressing revenue, customers and market.

• Assists with selling, implementation and follow-through of catering promotions.

• Executes and supports Marriott’s Customer Service Standards and hotel’s Brand Standards.

• Coordinates and deploys catering sales resources on-property to establish pull-through and sustainment of catering sales strategies and selling solutions. Develops a close working relationship with operations to execute strategies at the hotel level.

• Verifies that the property implements a seamless turnover from sales to operations and back to sales while consistently delivering high level of service.

• Monitors the effective resolution of guest issues that arise as a result of the sales process by creating mechanisms to channel issues to property leadership and/or other appropriate stakeholders.

• Maintains successful performance by increasing revenues, controlling expenses and providing a return on investment for the owner and Marriott International.

• Implements the brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in all aspects of the sales process.

• Performs other duties, as assigned, to meet business needs.

Building Successful Relationships

• Interacts effectively with guests/clients, sales and kitchen, vendors, competitors, local community, catering associations and other hotel departments in order to monitor guest satisfaction.

• Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and monitoring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.

• Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to Marriott.

• Gains understanding of the hotel’s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.

• Partners with key stakeholders within Area Sales to receive warms leads for more in-depth qualification of the business for the property.

• Partners with Event Management and hotel operations to sell products and services that the hotel has the ability to successfully execute.

Leadership

• Manages and directs the on-property catering sales managers to achieve hotel revenue goals by proactively targeting current and new high value accounts in the market and implementing effective catering sales deployment strategies to grow market share.

• Partners with Human Resources (HR) to attract, develop and retain the right people in order to support the strategic priorities of the market.

• Creates effective structures, processes, jobs and performance management systems are in place.

• Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the Leadership Performance Process (LPP), align performance and rewards, addresses performance issues and holds staff accountable for successful results.

• Forecasts talent needs and manages talent acquisition strategy with HR to minimize lost time due to turnover.

• Keeps an active list of the competition’s best sales people and executes a recruitment and acquisition plan with HR.

• Supports tools and training resources to educate sales associates on winning catering solutions.

• Champions leadership development and workforce planning priorities by assessing, selecting, retaining and developing diverse, high-caliber talent that can lead the organization today and strengthen the leadership bench for the future; continues to upgrade the sales & marketing talent; works with HR to anticipate future talent needs based on business growth plans.

• Identifies, trains and mentors catering sales associates.

• Transfers functional knowledge and develop catering sales skills of other discipline managers.

• Shares responsibility for achieving revenue goals, guest and associate satisfaction and the financial performance of the department.

• Provides day to day leadership to a team of on-property catering sales associates.

On the Event Production team, our fellow Amazonians are our customers and we enable them to work hard, have fun, and make history by providing them with leading-edge video conferencing and audio visual (AV) support in meeting rooms at Amazon locations around the globe. The engineer will be based onsite in EBCs in Singapore, and will be responsible for 'white gloves' support, preparing meeting rooms and “day of” briefing meeting escalations.

A successful candidate will bring their experience with audio visual and video conferencing large scope of IT software, hardware, and networking disciplines into a fast-paced corporate environment to standardize, improve productivity, reduce time to resolve, and reduce defects.

As part of the Event Productions team in Singapore, you will also have opportunities to autonomously support livestreaming events and video content creation.

Key job responsibilities
• Windows/Mac OS support
• User hardware/software/peripheral support
• Creating and maintaining documentation
• Provide break/fix support for Video Conferencing equipment in meeting rooms
• Provide high level customers with assistance on using Video Conferencing technology
• Coordinate equipment for meetings including video conferencing gear, displays, projectors, speakers, microphones, cameras, telephones, laptops, media players, document cameras, etc.
• AV room furniture setup/strike and straightening including tables, chairs, lecterns, pipe and drape, easels, and other equipment as needed or directed
• Assist customers with finding and scheduling appropriate meeting rooms
• Train customers to use self-service tools to schedule their own spaces, services, and resources
• Assist high level customers with finding event services including production, livestreaming and remote recording
• Provide courteous phone and chat support to customers
• Create and maintain excellent relationships with our internal customers and co-workers
• Adjust work schedule when needed to support Amazon business needs.
• Track your work via our ticketing system
• Assist event organizers with presentation formatting
• Responsible for resolving or escalating technical issues in EBC rooms
• Event Production: operation of cameras and livestream equipment. Edit video content as required.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Minimum Diploma or equivalent qualification in Information Technology, or a AV related discipline
- 3+ years of experience in AV systems deployment and troubleshooting, video conferencing interfaces, signal flows, operations, and maintenance
- Practical IT support experience (Windows/Mac OS, networking fundamentals, hardware/software troubleshooting)
- Proven ability to independently diagnose and resolve AV/IT issues in a multi-user high availability environment experience
- Strong communication skills with experience supporting senior executives and high-profile stakeholders
- 2+ years of corporate setting Windows, Mac or Linux Operating systems support experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Minimally 2+ years of networking (such as DNS, DHCP, SSL, OSI Model, and TCP/IP) experience
- 1+ years of Windows Server technologies: AD, DFS, Print Services, SCCM experience
- 2+ years of PC repair, troubleshooting, deployment and liquidation experience
- 1+ years of IT client, server, and network service delivery experience
- 2+ years of networking (such as DNS, DHCP, SSL, OSI Model, and TCP/IP) experience
