title: Brand Partnerships & Growth Specialist
description:
Crimson Education is the world’s leading college admissions consulting firm, with over 1,490 Ivy League offers and 2,410 to the US Top 15. We help ambitious students gain admission to the world’s top universities through expert-led guidance and proven, data-driven strategies. Crimson students are 7x more likely to get into the Ivy League than their peers. We were recently featured on the front page of the Wall Street Journal.

Crimson is the only college admissions consultancy that brings together:

Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications

Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation

Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards

Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation

We’re backed by leading VC firms, including Tiger Global, Heal Partners, IceHouse Ventures, and Movac, and recently closed a USD $40M Series D funding round at a USD $640M valuation. We now operate across 21 markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, and New Zealand.

Beyond college admissions consulting, Crimson offers a wide range of Enrichment programs designed to help students discover their interests, develop new skills, and achieve meaningful academic and extracurricular accomplishments. As we continue expanding our reach internationally, we're looking for a part-time Brand Partnerships & Growth Specialist to help introduce these programs to new audiences and strengthen their presence in key markets.

The role will initially focus on Indigo Research and Crimson Rise, two of our key Enrichment products. You’ll find creative ways to get them in front of the right students and families — whether through partnerships with leading schools and organizations, media and podcasts, creators, conferences, community placements, events, pop-ups, or other brand activations.

You’ll work closely with our marketing and leadership teams to identify opportunities others might miss and turn them into action. We’re looking for someone with strong existing networks who can open doors, generate ideas independently, and think commercially about how greater visibility can translate into audience growth, leads, and ultimately revenue.

Responsibilities include

Brand Growth & Opportunity Development

Identify creative ways to get Indigo and Rise in front of the right audiences – from media, podcasts, and creators to conferences, school and community placements, pop-ups, activations, and other unconventional opportunities.

Strengthen Indigo and Rise’s positioning across international markets, adapting ideas and messaging to local audiences while maintaining a consistent global brand.

Turn student, mentor, leadership, and company stories into compelling campaigns, content, PR, thought leadership, and other brand-building opportunities.

Develop and test creative market-specific ideas that build awareness and credibility, while considering how visibility can translate into audience growth, qualified leads, demand, and revenue.

Track results, identify what works, and recommend which channels, ideas, and initiatives we should scale.

Partnerships, Networks & Execution

Use your existing network – and continuously expand it – to open doors with journalists, creators, schools, education organizations, event organizers, companies, communities, and other influential partners.

Develop creative collaborations such as events, content partnerships, creator campaigns, webinars, competitions, community initiatives, and brand activations.

Proactively secure high-value media coverage, podcast appearances, speaking opportunities, conference placements, partnerships, and other forms of brand exposure.

Own opportunities end-to-end, from identifying the idea and making the introduction through pitching, execution, follow-up, and measuring impact.

What skills and experience you’ll need

5+ years of experience across brand marketing, partnerships, PR, growth, events, communications, or a related field.

Demonstrated experience building brands and creating growth opportunities across international markets.

An established, active network in at least one of our priority markets – the US, India, Singapore/Southeast Asia, or the Middle East – with relationships you can genuinely activate to open doors. This could include journalists, media outlets, schools, education organizations, event organizers, creators, influencers, community leaders, or other relevant partners.

A track record of independently spotting and creating opportunities – from partnerships and PR to events, creator collaborations, activations, and other forms of meaningful brand exposure.

A commercial mindset: not every brand activity needs to generate leads immediately, but you naturally think about how awareness and credibility can ultimately contribute to audience growth, demand, leads, and revenue.

Excellent written and spoken English, with strong pitching, storytelling, and communication skills.

Strong relationship-building skills and confidence approaching journalists, creators, organizations, partners, and senior external stakeholders.

Highly proactive, resourceful, and organized – you can take a broad objective, identify the right opportunity and people, and independently drive it from idea through execution.

What success looks like

Indigo and Rise become meaningfully more visible, relevant, and credible in the markets you own.

You consistently uncover opportunities we would not have found without you – new partners, creators, media, events, communities, placements, and creative ways to reach our target audiences.

Your existing network opens doors quickly, while the network you build becomes an increasingly valuable asset for Indigo and Rise.

Your initiatives generate measurable outcomes across brand awareness, audience growth, qualified leads, strategic relationships, and ultimately revenue.

You develop a clear understanding of what works in each market, learn quickly from what doesn’t, and scale the strongest ideas.

Why join us

Part-time, fully remote role with flexible working hours.

Help shape two education brands across multiple international markets.

High ownership and the freedom to turn good ideas into real campaigns, partnerships, and events.

Work with a global team of ambitious, curious people.

Please keep an eye on your spam/junk email folder for correspondence from Team Tailor.

title: Production & Planning Specialist, MICE AV Services
description:
WE TAKE YOU ABOVE BEYOND

Job Responsibilities

Event Planning & Documentation Support

Contact clients and participate in planning/coordination meetings as assigned to understand, clarify, and document event needs and technical requirements (e.g., electrical provisions, rigging points, audio-visual services, event flow, and event floor plan). Prepare and update event technical documentation such as service orders, technical riders, run-downs, equipment lists, floor plans/drawings (where applicable), and cost estimates for internal review and customer confirmation. Maintain accurate, up-to-date event information in relevant systems and trackers, ensuring version control and timely communication to internal stakeholders.

Scheduling, Resource & Logistics Coordination

Support team scheduling and deployment coordination by consolidating event requirements, manpower needs, and set-up/tear-down timelines for review by the Planning & Production leadership team.

Coordinate equipment requests, rentals, and logistics arrangements with internal teams and approved vendors to meet operational timelines.

On-Site Event Delivery Support

Attend production meetings, site recce sessions, and event rehearsals as assigned; capture actions and translate requirements into updated documentation and work instructions.

Provide on-site coordination support with in-house teams and vendors during event load-in, live operations, and load-out to ensure services are delivered in accordance with approved orders and service standards.

Operational & Vendor Liaison

Liaise with internal departments (e.g., Event Planning, Operations, Security, Facilities) to align event readiness and resolve operational requirements or constraints.

Coordinate with external contractors/service providers on delivery timing, access, and scope of work under supervision; escalate issues and risks promptly.

Cost Tracking & Administrative Control

Support monitoring of event-related costs (e.g., casual labour, external services, equipment rentals) and maintain supporting records for reconciliation and reporting.

Assist in raising required internal requests and documentation (e.g., rental requests, purchase/service requisitions where applicable) in line with department processes.

Safety, Compliance & Standards

Follow established safety procedures and operational guidelines during planning and on-site execution; report hazards, incidents, or non-compliances immediately.

Support the collection and filing of event documentation required for audits, accreditation, and compliance (e.g., permits, method statements, risk assessments) as directed.

Continuous Improvement & Team Support

Participate in post-event debriefs and support the capture of learnings, feedback, and improvement actions.

Perform other duties as assigned to support departmental and operational objectives.

Job Requirements

Education & Certification

NITEC / Higher NITEC or Diploma in Audio Visual, Electronics/Electrical Engineering, Event Production, Event Management, Media Production, or related disciplines is preferred.

Relevant local polytechnic diplomas may include:

Republic Polytechnic (RP) – Diploma in Events & Project Management

Republic Polytechnic (RP) – Diploma in Arts & Entertainment Production Management

Singapore Polytechnic (SP) – Diploma in Media, Arts & Design (Sound & Music)

Ngee Ann Polytechnic (NP) – Diploma in Film, Sound & Video

Exposure to event planning documentation, on-site coordination, and working with vendors/contractors.

Working knowledge of media production and content tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite such as Photoshop, Premiere Pro/other video editing tools; basic image/video file formats and workflows) is an advantage.

Able to work in loud environments and in operational/back-of-house areas.

title: Workplace Ambassador
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. Workplace Experience Ambassador - Job Description

About the Role:
As a Workplace Experience Ambassador scope of work own the overall workplace experience, be the primary touch point with Client employees, visitors, and service partners - delivering a high-touch and high-impact workplace experience. This role will be responsible for managing daily soft facilities operations in the Singapore office, including close collaboration with building landlord and client’s pantries partners.

You’ll work in close partnership with Workplace Experience Manager, Engineering team, Senior Facilities Manager (Site Lead) and the client’s real estate team, contributing to the entire client workplace experience includes cleaning, landscape, pest control, waste disposal, space & move management, events and support pantries management. While the role requires someone highly proactive and independent, you will also be a key collaborator on strategic workplace experience initiatives that enhance employee experience, operational excellence, and our cross-site & function collaboration.

Responsibilities:
To coordinate all on-site soft facilities operational and administrative duties.
Partnering closely with the in-house maintenance team for all daily maintenance matters and conducting daily inspection to ensure quality standards are being maintained.
Monitor submission of service partners’ daily inspection and periodic reports.
Responsible for coordinating and improve efficiency of storage, transportation, space planning, event planning and meeting room arrangement.
Oversee the planning and executing of the waste, pest control and cleaning scheduling.
Review service partners’ deployment and duties to optimal use of manpower.
Regular inspection for conformance to service standards and expectation of cleanliness, waste management.
Ensuring that all service partners conduct themselves in accordance with relevant policy on health and safety. They will be committed to maintaining a healthy and safe work environment.
Ensuring at all times that they carry out their work safely and with due regard for others in accordance with HS&E procedures and instructions, contractual, legislative and local requirements.
Reporting immediately any non-conformance, unsafe act or unsafe condition to line management for investigation and corrective action.
Identify, collate and report any building defects.
Coordinate with all service partner on their plan training programme for cleaners, landscapers, waste and pest control.
Coordinate and support events from set up requirements to logistical support including AV set-up, liaise with onsite support team on layout etc.
Conduct daily toolbox talk to address HSE, work activities and shared lesson learnt.
Serve as first point of coverage for client receptionist by supporting in delivering warm, professional hospitality while following site security protocols for all visitors. independently.
Complete additional responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements:
Nitec/Higher/Nitec/Diploma in Hotel & Hospitality Management, Facilities Management, or an equivalent field of study required
3+ years of experience in office coordination, hospitality, facilities, or workplace operations.
A strong operational mindset with a genuine passion for building meaningful employee experiences.
Experience in managing a substantial size of workers
Excellent time management skills and ability to multi-task and prioritize work.
A positive attitude and a good team-player with good interpersonal and supervisory skills.
A proactive, positive, and solutions-oriented attitude - someone who thrives in fast-paced, people-first environments.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills across email and in-person interactions.
Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and comfort using CMMS platform or help desk platforms.
Others: The role includes the need to potentially provide after-hours coverage when necessary.
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.

About JLL –

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

description:
[What the role is]

The Manager/Senior Manager, Outreach Events and Management, leads the end-to-end planning and delivery of career events, workshops and outreach initiatives across physical, virtual and hybrid formats. The role involves conceptualising event formats and engagement approaches, building partnerships with employers, industry partners and community organisations, and shaping targeted outreach strategies to improve job-matching outcomes. The incumbent oversees event operations, vendor and budget management, and ensures compliance with procurement and governance requirements. The role also involves monitoring event performance, analysing data to drive improvements, and coordinating internal and external stakeholders to deliver multiple concurrent events effectively.

[What you will be working on]

Lead the planning and delivery of career events, workshops, networking sessions and other outreach initiatives across physical, virtual and hybrid formats, ensuring alignment with Workforce Outreach Division priorities and workforce needs.
Conceptualise event formats, participant journeys and engagement approaches; pilot new initiatives and improve existing formats to strengthen employer participation, jobseeker engagement and job-matching outcomes.
Build and maintain effective working relationships with employers, industry partners, associations, Self-Help Groups, community/grassroots organisations and internal stakeholders to mobilise participation, partnerships and resources.
Shape targeted outreach and engagement strategies to attract suitable jobseekers and employers, advocate jobseeker capabilities and workforce needs, and curate activities that reduce skills and hiring mismatch.
Oversee end-to-end event operations, including vendor appointment and management, logistics, registration, event-day execution, post-event follow-up, procurement and governance requirements.
Develop event budget requirements, monitor utilisation, exercise cost discipline, verify billing and ensure effective deployment of resources while delivering value for money.
Establish and monitor event performance measures, analyse participation, engagement and outcome data, identify trends and translate insights into actionable improvements.
Lead post-event reviews, consolidate feedback from stakeholders, identify gaps and improvement opportunities, and institutionalise good practices across the event portfolio.
Coordinate internal teams and external parties to deliver multiple concurrent events, provide direction on priorities and resolve operational issues to ensure timely, quality outcomes.

[What we are looking for]

Experience & Qualifications

At least 5 years of relevant experience in event management, programme delivery, project management, partnerships, outreach or a related field, with demonstrated experience leading end-to-end events or engagement initiatives.
Experience managing vendors, budgets, stakeholders and concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.
Experience in workforce, community, employer engagement or career-related initiatives will be an advantage.
Candidates without the required qualifications but with strong relevant experience may be considered.

Knowledge

Events, programme and project management principles, including physical, virtual and hybrid delivery.
Workforce segment needs, employer hiring challenges and labour market / sectoral manpower trends.
Job matching, employability and employer engagement considerations.
HR hiring processes and relevant national employment policies.
Knowledge of WSG programmes and/or relevant workforce initiatives will be an added advantage.

Skills

Strategic Planning & Event Management: Translate organisational priorities into practical event strategies, formats and delivery plans.
Stakeholder & Partnership Management: Build trusted relationships, align diverse interests and mobilise stakeholders towards shared outcomes.
Budget & Vendor Management: Manage budgets, procurement considerations and vendors with strong governance and value-for-money focus.
Communication: Strong business writing, presentation and facilitation skills across internal and external audiences.
Data & Insights: Use participation, engagement and outcome data to evaluate effectiveness and guide improvements.
Problem Solving & Decision Making: Assess issues, evaluate options and make timely decisions in a changing operating environment.
Digital & Technology: Proficient in Microsoft Office and able to learn and apply event, collaboration and other digital tools quickly.

Abilities/Aptitudes

Takes ownership, demonstrates sound judgement and follows through on commitments and outcomes.
Adaptable and resilient, with the ability to manage last-minute changes and competing priorities.
Systematic, organised and able to manage concurrent projects without losing attention to detail.
Collaborative team player who can rally resources, influence stakeholders and resolve issues constructively.
Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment with a strong service and outcome orientation.

Other Characteristics

Established network or experience working with industry partners, employers and/or associations.
Experience working with Self-Help Groups, community or grassroots organisations is an advantage.

Successful candidates will be offered a contract in the first instance and may be considered for an extension or be placed on a permanent tenure.

title: Events Executive
description:
Singapore Squash is the National Sports Association for the sport of squash in Singapore. We are seeking an energetic, driven and passionate individual to join our multi-cultural and vibrant team as an Events Executive.

If you are excited by the opportunity to be at the heart of national sporting events, work alongside top athletes, and contribute to the growth of squash in Singapore and beyond, we would love to hear from you.

Why Join Singapore Squash?

At Singapore Squash, you will gain valuable exposure to both local and international sporting environments while working in a collaborative and dynamic setting.

What You Can Look Forward To

Opportunity to work alongside national and regionalathletes

Exposure to international and professional sporting bodies

Hands-on experience in local and international event operations

Casual and friendly work environment with relaxed dress code

Convenient office location next to Stadium MRT

Guaranteed 13th Month Annual Wage Supplement (AWS)

Performance-based year-end bonus opportunities

Opportunities for professional growth and development within the sports industry

About the Role

The Events Executive plays a key role in supporting the successful planning, coordination, and execution of Singapore Squash’s tournaments, programmes, and events. This position is integral to ensuring operational excellence and supporting the SSRA Board in advancing the sport locally and internationally.

You will play the leading role in the design and execution of the Primary Schools tournament series which will kick off in 2027.You will have the opportunity to lead (with supervision of the Events Manager) on a new initiative, which will serve as an important pipeline toward the pathway development of our sport.

You will also be involved in both the strategic planning and ground execution of other events, making this an ideal role for someone who enjoys being both the “brains and brawn” behind successful sporting experiences.

Key Responsibilities

Event Planning & Operations

End-to-end planning and execution of Singapore Squash’s annual local tournaments and events calendar

Coordinate all operational aspects of tournaments and events to ensure smooth delivery

Manage tournament administration using platforms such as Tournament Software/Planner and SportyHQ, including:

Seeding

Draws

Scheduling

Tournament management

Marketing & Communications

Develop and execute marketing initiatives and social media campaigns for tournaments and events

Create engaging promotional content to drive participation and audience engagement

Support event publicity and communications efforts across relevant platforms

Stakeholder & Volunteer Management

Coordinate and manage event volunteers, including National Training Programme athletes

Source and liaise with referees and officials fortournaments as required

Build and maintain positive working relationshipswith Associate Clubs, International Federations, Athletes, Vendors, Eventpartners and stakeholders

Financial & Administrative Support

Manage event budgets - ensure revenue and expenditure are in line

Ensure procurement processes comply with SSRA procurement guidelines

Coordinate timely processing of payments, revenues,claims, and reconciliations with the Events Manager

Assist in preparation of post-event reports,including operational reviews and performance metrics

Additional Responsibilities

Provide support for other SSRA programmes andinitiatives as required

Undertake additional duties that commensurate withthe level of the role

What We’re Looking For

Requirements

Strong and active interest in sports is essential

Interest or experience in squash will be an advantage

Minimum ITE or Diploma qualification, preferably in:

Sports Management

Business Administration

Marketing

Communications

Physical Education, or related disciplines

Fresh graduates with athlete backgrounds or strong sporting interest are encouraged to apply

Candidates with at least 1 year of relevant sports or event management experience will have an advantage

Skills & Attributes

Tech-savvy and willing to learn event management software platforms

Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word,Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint)

Familiarity with Canva, Adobe, WordPress or other design tools is a plus

Strong communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills

Excellent organisational and project management abilities

Creative, resourceful, and able to think independently

Comfortable working in a fast-paced event environment

Willing to work evenings and weekends during event periods when required

Remuneration

Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and relevant experience.

Join Us

If you are passionate about sports and excited about delivering impactful sporting events, we invite you to be part of Singapore Squash’s journey in growing the sport and supporting athletes at every level.

Apply now and be part of a team that brings the squash community together through world-class events and programmes.

Singapore Squash Rackets Association (SSRA) is the National Sports Association (NSA) and governing body for the sport of Squash in Singapore.

We are governed by Sport Singapore (SportSG) and is a member of the Singapore National Olympic Council (SNOC), South East Asian Squash Federation (SEASF), Asian Squash Federation (ASF) and World Squash Federation (WSF).

SSRA was formed in 1970 and we are an Institute of Public Character (IPC) charity organisation. SSRA aims to promote, support and advance the sport of Squash in Singapore through our core values of Integrity, Teamwork and Diversity.

title: Brand Communications Manager
description:
Be the voice of one of the best-known brands in marketing.

Ahrefs helps marketers get their brands found online, in search, in AI answers and on social. Our tools run on the largest search and AI datasets on the web. We've been bootstrapped and profitable for fifteen years, with no investors and no board, and we have offices in Singapore, Tokyo, Palo Alto and Cambridge (MA).

The product has a big reputation, and we want every word around it to live up to that. Up to now, copy at Ahrefs has been something talented people do alongside their main job. We want someone for whom it is the main job.

The job

You'll be the voice of Ahrefs. You'll decide how we sound and what we say about ourselves, write much of it yourself, and get every team using it. The homepage, a banner ad, a renewal email and a booth wall should all sound like the same company. When someone here wants to know how to say something better, they'll come to you.

What you'll do
The website. Homepage, tool pages, comparison pages, ad landing pages, and the scripts for the explainer videos on them.
Campaigns. Concepts, headlines, banners and video scripts for our advertising.
Customer messages. Product emails and in-app notifications, the kind people read rather than archive.
Print and events. Brochures, flyers, and the copy on our booth walls.
The stage. Shape the message in our team's conference talks, including keynotes at Ahrefs Evolve.
Social. Work with our social media lead so a post and a landing page sound like they came from the same place.
Positioning and messaging. Decide the core story for the company and each product, write it down, and get other teams to adopt it.
You're probably right for this if
Writing copy is what you do best, and most of your career has gone into it: campaigns, websites, product emails, scripts.
You're hands-on. You'd rather write it yourself than brief someone else to. You can turn a banner headline around the same day you're halfway through a homepage rewrite, and you like having both on the go.
You can show us your work. Real, published copy, and you can tell us exactly which parts you wrote.
You know when to be funny and when to get straight to the point.
You pick up technical products quickly, and can explain them to experts without dumbing them down. You don't need to know SEO.
You've owned a brand voice or positioning before, and got teams who didn't report to you to use it.
You'll argue for a word with a CMO, and let go of the ones that don't matter.
Good to have
UX writing or product marketing experience.
Video scripts and speechwriting.
Comfortable enough in Figma or a CMS to fix your own copy in place.
Why Ahrefs?

We believe in giving smart people real ownership and not micromanaging them. You'll own how Ahrefs sounds, everywhere, and shape how millions of marketers see the brand. We value honesty, results and simple solutions over complicated ones, and you'll work with a smart, low-ego team where your words make a real difference.

Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third-party recruitment providers for the roles we hire for. If we need help, we'll let you know.

Location: Singapore, Tokyo, Palo Alto (CA) or Cambridge (MA). On-site; you'll need the right to work in the office you choose.

Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third party recruitment solutions for the roles we hire for. If at any point we need help, we'll let you know!

title: Speech & Language Therapist / Senior Speech & Language Therapist
description:
Employer: Grace Orchard School

Grace Orchard School caters to students who have been diagnosed with Mild Intellectual Disability (MID) and those with Mild Autism Spectrum Disorders(ASD). The school is specifically for students ranging from 7-18 years old who have Intellectual Quotient (IQ) which falls within the range of 50-70. The school is a non- profit organisation under Presbyterian Community Social Services (PCS).

Job Summary

The Speech Therapist, under the supervision of the Head of Department (Allied Professionals), is a member of the school’s AP Department. He / She works via an inter-disciplinary model with fellow allied professionals, teaching staff and parents / caregivers in providing speech therapy intervention (assessment, intervention, consultation and evaluation) to students with Mild Intellectual Disability, as well as those with Autism Spectrum Disorder. He / She will participate in case consultations and provide relevant support services to benefit students and their families. The standard of professional practice will be ethical and delivered with due consideration to the relevant legislation and procedures.

Job Description:

• Identify and assess individual therapy needs of students using standardized assessment tools and school in-house assessment forms.

• Facilitate development of appropriate and effective tools for identification, assessment, intervention of students.

• Formulate and implement individual/group therapy programme for students.

• Involve in the school’s interdisciplinary process of Individual Education Plan (IEP) and Individual Transition Plan (ITP).

• Provide intervention for students on a one-to-one basis, group, class, work experience or special setting based on the needs of the students.

• Evaluate and document students’ therapy needs and progress regularly, and review the effectiveness of the intervention .

• Provide consultation and update students’ status to the relevant staff members and caregivers.

• Work in collaboration with teaching/non-teaching staff and caregivers for the effective enhancement of services.

• Work with external agencies e.g. hospitals, external therapists for the effective enhancement of services.

• Develop and review department and related policies in conjunction with the management.

• Maintain and update students’ case records with relevant documentation reports.

• Conduct relevant in-house training for school staff, parents and caregivers e.g. workshops, professional learning sessions etc.

• Conduct placement assessment screening for all new students enrolled into the school.

• Conduct home visits when necessary.

• Work in collaboration with teaching/non-teaching staff in various school committees including school event planning, subject curriculum and school programmes.

• Maintain proper inventory and usage of therapy items/resources in the therapy rooms and update the need to replace or purchase them when needed.

• Assist in the development and management of the budget for the Department.

• Attend school meetings e.g. staff contact time, department meetings, committee meetings, interdisciplinary meetings and school holiday staff meetings etc. to keep updated on school matters and planning.

• Attend internal and external trainings e.g. professional learning teams to keep abreast of the latest trends and developments to develop and maintain skills that increase effectiveness.

• Perform other duties and be involved in committee work as assigned by the school management e.g. guide therapy assistants in supporting intervention work with the students.

Requirements:

• At least a Bachelor Degree in (Speech & Language Pathology)

• Eligible to register with the Allied Health Professions Council (AHPC) in Singapore as conditional registrant or full registrant

• Previous working experience in schools

• Passion to work with children, youths and their families

• Ability to work independently and as a team member in a fast-paced work environment

title: PUBLIC RELATIONS OFFICER
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Public Relations Officer to join our team. As a Public Relations Officer, you will be responsible for managing and enhancing the public image and reputation of our organization. You will develop and execute effective communication strategies, build relationships with key stakeholders, and handle media relations. The ideal candidate has exceptional communication skills, a strong understanding of public relations principles, and the ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Communication Strategy: Develop and implement comprehensive communication strategies that align with the organization's goals and objectives. Create messaging frameworks, key talking points, and press releases to effectively convey the organization's mission, initiatives, and achievements.

Media Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with media representatives, journalists, and influencers. Proactively pitch stories and secure media coverage for the organization and its events, campaigns, and milestones. Content Creation: Write, edit, and distribute compelling and engaging content for various channels, including press releases, newsletters, articles, blog posts, and social media. Ensure all content is accurate, consistent, and aligned with the organization's brand and messaging.

Crisis Management: Act as the organization's spokesperson during times of crisis or reputation management issues. Develop crisis communication plans, prepare key messaging, and manage media inquiries effectively. Mitigate potential damage to the organization's reputation and maintain transparency and trust with stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, partners, government agencies, and community organizations. Develop communication materials tailored to specific audiences and collaborate with internal teams to ensure consistent messaging across all touchpoints.

Event Planning and Management: Coordinate and oversee the planning and execution of press conferences, product launches, corporate events, and other public relations initiatives. Work closely with event organizers, vendors, and internal teams to ensure seamless execution and maximum media exposure.

Monitoring and Reporting: Monitor media coverage and public sentiment related to the organization and its industry. Prepare regular reports on media activity, campaign effectiveness, and key performance indicators. Analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

Requirements

Experience working in the entertainment and nightlife industry

Able to work on weekends and public holidays if required

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building abilities.

Knowledge of public relations principles, strategies, and best practices.

Experience in media relations, including pitching stories and handling media inquiries.

Ability to effectively manage crisis situations and handle sensitive information.

Familiarity with social media platforms and digital marketing trends.

Exceptional organizational and time management skills.

Proficiency in relevant software and tools.

Knowledge of mandarin dialect is essential as our customer base is primarily mandarin speaking

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Able to work late-night hours up to 3am, including weekends and public holidays

We offer a competitive salary, along with benefits and opportunities for professional growth. If you have a passion for public relations, a knack for storytelling, and a desire to shape and protect our organization's reputation, we invite you to apply for the position of Public Relations Officer.

title: Education & Outreach Intern - Schools Programme
description:
Position title

:

Education & Outreach Intern

Reports to

: Manager, Youth Engagement and Manager, Schools Programme

Duration:

6 months (Minimum 3 months)

Location:

Singapore

About WWF-Singapore

World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF) is one of the world’s largest and most respected independent conservation organisations. WWF’s mission is to stop the degradation of the earth’s natural environment and to build a future in which humans live in harmony with nature. As one of WWF’s international hubs, WWF-Singapore supports a global network spanning over 100 countries. WWF Singapore works closely with local stakeholders towards a greener and more sustainable Singapore and the region around us. We work to address key conservation areas, such as climate change, sustainable finance, deforestation, illegal wildlife trade, marine conservation, and sustainable production and consumption, through collaboration, education and outreach efforts involving the community, businesses, and governments. For more information, please visit wwf.sg.

About Schools Programme

The WWF Schools Programme empowers students to understand environmental issues and take meaningful action for nature and sustainability. The programme delivers engaging learning experiences through classroom workshops, outdoor activities, school projects and digital resources, covering topics such as climate change, biodiversity, oceans, waste and food sustainability..

About #WeGotThis (Youth Programme)

#WeGotThis is WWF-Singapore’s flagship youth accelerator programme that empowers youths to move beyond awareness and take meaningful action for people and the planet. Through workshops, mentorship, networking opportunities, and hands-on projects, participants develop skills, knowledge, and confidence to learn fieldwork techniques, test conservation technologies, and develop film documentaries to address biodiversity and climate challenges.

Role Overview

As the Education and Outreach Intern, you will play a key role in growing our school and youth community and amplifying programme impact through engaging digital content. You will be responsible for developing social media content, supporting community engagement initiatives, and assisting with programme logistics and events.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys content creation, social media trends, event coordination, and working with young changemakers.

Key Responsibilities

1. Social Media, Digital Content & Communications (50%)

Develop and execute content ideas for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, websites, emailers and other digital platforms.

Create short-form videos, reels, graphics, carousels, stories and other multimedia content to showcase programme activities, school and youth projects, mentor highlights, and challenge statement topics.

Attend programme sessions and events to capture photos, videos, interviews, and behind-the-scenes content.

Draft engaging captions, social media copy and digital storytelling content aligned with WWF-Singapore’s brand voice.

Create content for programme emailers and participant communications

Support the design, maintenance and updating of programme webpages, ensuring information remains current, user-friendly and engaging.

Develop website content including programme descriptions, participant stories, mentor profiles, event pages and impact highlights.

Research emerging social media trends and recommend new content approaches to increase reach and engagement.

Maintain content calendars and publishing schedules across social media, website and email channels.

Track and report social media performance metrics and insights.

2. Community Management & Engagement (30%)

Support engagement of programme participants, alumni, mentors, and volunteers, responding to enquiries in a timely and professional manner.

Develop and maintain programme FAQs and resource guides to improve participant experience. Develop educational materials to engage students on sustainability issues.

Create and manage registration forms, application forms, surveys, attendance tracking systems, and feedback forms.

Monitor and respond to programme email enquiries, social media messages, and participant queries.

Coordinate participant onboarding and provide timely updates, reminders, and key programme information.

Escalate and manage participant issues, concerns, and requests, working closely with the Education and Outreach team to ensure effective resolution.

Gather participant stories, testimonials, and feedback for programme improvement and communications.

Support initiatives to strengthen engagement within the school, #WeGotThis youth and alumni community.

3. Event Planning & Logistics (20%)

Support planning and execution of workshops, networking sessions, mentorship events, field trips, and programme showcases.

Coordinate event registrations, attendance tracking, and participant communications.

Assist with venue setup, materials preparation, and on-site event support.

Liaise with internal teams, speakers, mentors, and external partners on logistical requirements.

Provide on-site event support, including registration and tasks as required.

Support procurement and administrative processes where required.

Consolidate post-event feedback and assist with reporting.

Who We’re Looking For

Essential

Current undergraduate, polytechnic student, or recent graduate.

Strong interest in sustainability, youth development, conservation, or social impact.

Active user of social media platforms, especially Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Good eye for visual storytelling and content creation.

Organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

Comfortable engaging with youths and diverse stakeholders.

Bonus Skills

Experience using Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar design and video editing tools.

Experience creating content for social media, websites, newsletters, or student organisations.

Basic photography and videography skills.

Knowledge of social media analytics and digital marketing concepts.

Event planning or community engagement experience.

This job description covers the main tasks. Other tasks may be assigned as necessary according to organisational needs.

We may also disclose personal data about you to our affiliates in the network in order to manage our relationship with you.

Interested candidates are required to submit their

cover letter, CV and a short portfolio (or examples) of social media content, videos, graphics, or campaigns they have created

to the HR Department of WWF-Singapore (Email: hr@wwf.sg). Please indicate the position being applied for ‘

Education & Outreach Intern

’ in the subject line, and also complete the questionnaire from this link .

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Thank you for your understanding

a future in which humans live in harmony with nature. As one of WWF’s international hubs, WWF-Singapore supports a global network spanning over 100 countries.

WWF-Singapore works closely with local stakeholders towards a greener and more sustainable Singapore and the region around us. Company Profile

About Vocalise

With over 18 years of expertise, Vocalise has built a portfolio spanning well-known international brands across luxury lifestyle and hospitality, as well as private events. We specialise in planning, designing and executing music performances around the vision each client has for their event.

We’re looking for someone energetic, organised and resourceful, who’s excited about the work that goes on behind a great performance.

IG: @vocalise.sg

Website: www.vocalise.com.sg

Job Description

About the role

Ever wondered what happens before the first note?

Every performance we deliver rests on the work behind it — the right musicians booked, the schedules aligned, the scores in the right hands, everyone knowing exactly where to be and when. It’s quiet work, and it’s the reason the night goes beautifully.

That’s what you’ll be learning, and growing into owning. You’ll start alongside our team, and over your first few months take on the artiste booking and scheduling yourself. It’s a real seat rather than a shadowing role.

It’s a five-month internship, with a path to a paid full-time role for the right person.

What you’ll be doing

Booking musicians for events, rehearsals and our Candlelight concert series, keeping the schedule accurate so nothing clashes
Looking after our artiste booking sheet — it’s what our musicians are paid from, so care here really matters
Scheduling rehearsals and working closely with our events team
Getting everything ready ahead of each event, so the day runs without surprises
Joining us on site to support the team, and capturing behind-the-scenes and event footage for our socials
Lending a hand with proposals and client follow-ups

What we’re hoping you’ll bring

You’re careful with detail. A booking entered wrong means a musician turns up on the wrong day, so accuracy matters more here than speed
You follow things through, and you chase when someone hasn’t come back to you
You’re comfortable coordinating with professional musicians, many of whom will be considerably more experienced than you
You communicate clearly and warmly in English, written and spoken
You can hold several things at once without letting any of them slip
You’re happy working some evenings and weekends, as scheduled
A love of music helps, and knowledge of classical music is a real plus

Qualifications

Diploma or degree in Events Management, Arts Management, Communications, Public Relations or a related field
Undergraduates and fresh graduates are very welcome

What you’ll gain

A proper look at how a small entertainment company actually runs, from booking through to performance night
Direct mentoring from our team, working alongside you daily
Real ownership of the artiste schedule as you grow into it, rather than only supporting someone else’s work
Time with our musicians and our Candlelight concert series, seeing how a performance comes together from the inside
A clear path: for the right person, this becomes a paid full-time role at the end

title: Assistant Manager, Marketing Communications
description:
Company Description

HOTEL OVERVIEW

Strategically located in the heart of Singapore’s shopping, dining and entertainment districts and with the City Hall and Esplanade Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) train stations and other major transportation nodes at its doorstep, Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford are the gateway to explore Singapore’s landscapes at your convenience. With a total of 2,030 well-appointed guestrooms, both hotels also offer a distinct collection of 12 lifestyle and dining choices including Michelin-starred fine dining restaurant JAAN by Kirk Westaway, cutting-edge meeting space at Raffles City Convention Centre with 34 meeting rooms and one of Asia’s largest spas, Willow Stream Spa.

ABOUT OUR COMPANY

At Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford, we design career plans and unveil new professional perspectives through our various development programs. We shine when YOU shine. Come and be part of our dynamic team and experience immerse growth and career opportunities with us.

Job Description

The Assistant Marketing Communications Manager develops and leads communications strategies for assigned revenue streams and lifestyle-led portfolios across Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford. This role has a strong focus on campaign management, public relations, media relations, content development, influencer engagement, media planning, partnerships, F&B storytelling, spa and lifestyle campaigns, while supporting broader hotel, brand and corporate initiatives. The role supports the Director of Marketing Communications in managing campaign execution, agency coordination, media hosting and team workflow. This is a leadership position as second in-charge to lead and manage the team.

COMMUNICATIONS & MEDIA PLANNING

Formulate communications and media calendars for assigned portfolios, ensuring timely and accurate execution of initiatives with relevant business units and stakeholders.

Develop Public Relations angles, media materials, influencer briefs and content narratives that generate positive and relevant coverage across local, regional and international channels.

Develop media plan for campaigns and dedicated business units for brand positioning and/or to meet campaign objectives

Review communications materials including press releases, media pitches, social copy, sales decks, in-house collaterals, ad copy and campaign assets to ensure accuracy, tonality and brand alignment.

Lead assigned awards submissions, canvassing of votes or nominations, and post-award amplification with relevant stakeholders.

Identify partnership opportunities with lifestyle, luxury, F&B, wellness, cultural and corporate brands to create differentiated guest experiences.

LIFESTYLE, PUBLIC RELATIONS & PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT

Lead or support lifestyle and Public Relations -driven portfolios such as selected F&B venues, spa, wellness, partnerships, IP-led collaborations, festive campaigns and hotel stories.

Manage media, blogger, content creator and influencer hosting to drive positive coverage and beneficial commercial outcomes.

Coordinate media familiarisation stays, F&B tastings, chef interviews, partner activations and hosted experiences in line with approved strategy and budgets.

Support restaurant and bar positioning by developing story angles around culinary concepts, chefs, menus, events, awards and collaborations.

Maintain active awareness of hospitality, lifestyle, dining, wellness and media trends to identify relevant opportunities.

CAMPAIGN & EVENT MANAGEMENT

Conceptualise, plan and execute integrated communications campaigns with the Director, internal team, Public relations agencies, digital partners and business unit stakeholders.

Support marketing and promotion of hotel-led events, ensuring strong attendance, media relevance, guest experience and post-event reporting.

Prepare campaign briefs, timelines, content requirements, photography or videography briefs, creative references and partner deliverables.

Coordinate cross-channel launches across website, social media, email, in-house displays, press outreach, partner platforms and advertising placements.

Monitor campaign performance and prepare updates with recommendations for optimisation.

MARKET RESEARCH & ANALYSIS

Conduct market research to identify consumer preferences, competitor activity, hospitality trends and relevant lifestyle or dining developments.

Analyse public relations , campaign, media monitoring, social and stakeholder feedback to develop informed recommendations that support business goals.

Review competitive communications to identify opportunities for differentiation and stronger positioning.

PARTNER, AGENCY & VENDOR ENGAGEMENT

Manage day-to-day agency, partner and vendor coordination for assigned projects, ensuring clear scopes, timelines, deliverables and approvals.

Host partners and industry contacts for ongoing engagement and potential collaborations.

Support negotiation of value-added partner arrangements that enhance brand relevance, reduce costs or improve guest experiences.

BUDGETING & ADMINISTRATION

Manage campaign and assigned business unit budgets and forecast.

Monitor campaign-level budgets, quotations and supplier costs for assigned projects, ensuring forecast accuracy and procurement compliance.

Support annual budget planning by gathering scopes, historical costs and proposed activity requirements.

Work with the Coordinator to ensure agreements, purchase requests, invoices and accruals are submitted accurately and on time.

OTHERS

Comply with hotel and department policies and procedures at all times.

Assist with Sales & Marketing projects and carry out other duties as assigned by Management.

Qualifications

Degree or Diploma in Hospitality, Tourism, Marketing, Communications, Public Relations or a related discipline.

 Minimum 3 to 6 years of marketing communications or public relations experience, preferably within hospitality, travel, lifestyle, luxury, F&B or agency environments.

Leadership – experience in leading and managing teams

Excellent spoken and written English. Fluency in a second language is preferred.

AI-enabled marketer, proficient in Claude, ChatGPT, relevant tools for content creation, presentations, project management

Strong knowledge of marketing communications (Branding, Public Relations , Events, Advertising), hospitality trends, media//KOL connections locally/regionally

Excellent writing, editing, media pitching and content planning skills.

Strong stakeholder management with the ability to work across multiple business units and senior stakeholders.

Ability to brief agencies, designers, photographers and vendors with clear objectives and timelines.

Strong analytical skills with comfort using media monitoring, influencer analysis and campaign performance data.

Creative, proactive and commercially minded, with a passion for hospitality and guest experiences.

Collaborative, adaptable and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Able to manage several tasks, prioritise work and follow through on agreed deadlines.

Detail-oriented and organised, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

Positive and proactive attitude, with an interest in community programmes and access to vision care.

Proficient in Canva, with the ability to design clear, engaging event collaterals; comfortable using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Outlook.

Able to work independently, take initiative and follow through on tasks; a team player who works well with colleagues and partners across countries and cultures.

Willing to learn clinic operations and support both planning and routine administration.

Conduct follow-up communication with clients to gather feedback on the catering services provided. Address any post-event concerns or additional requirements.

Utilize feedback to make continuous improvements, enhance client satisfaction, and refine catering services.

Conduct regular quality assessments to maintain and improve service excellence.

Menu Planning, Budget Management and Quotation Preparation:

Demonstrate a deep understanding of client requirements and qualify leads before providing quotations/rates

Prepare detailed and accurate quotations/ menus based on client requirements. Ensure that quotations are clear, transparent, and aligned with pricing strategies.

Demonstrate a deep understanding of diverse cuisines, cooking techniques, and flavours that cater to different preferences, dietary needs, and event themes.

Negotiate pricing with clients when necessary, balancing competitive rates with the company's financial goals.

Serve as the main point of contact for clients during the order processing phase.

Maintain accurate and organized records of all orders, quotations, and client communications.

Ensure that all documentation complies with internal procedures and legal requirements.

Order Processing, Event Planning & Execution:

Receive and review client orders, ensuring accuracy and completeness.

Liaise with internal teams, including culinary and logistics, to coordinate the execution of catering orders.

Coordinate logistics for catering events, including staffing, equipment, and transportation from initial planning to on-site execution.

Collaborate with the operation/ kitchen/ purchasing to align client deliverables and expectations

Address any issues or challenges that arise during the event planning and execution stages.

Ensure the timely and efficient execution of catering services on the day of the event

Work closely with operational teams to ensure seamless and successful event delivery.

Lead and manage catering staff, providing training and guidance as needed.

Foster a positive and collaborative environment on-site

Proficiency in Google tools and general IT savvy

Join our culinary journey that began in a cozy 1500-square-foot shophouse in Joo Chiat! Back in 1989, our founder fell in love with his wife and the world of kitchen magic. With the guidance of skilled chefs in the family, he honed his culinary skills and laid the foundation for our tasty venture.

Fuelled by ambition, we officially launched Four Seasons Catering in 1994. Our passion for scrumptious delights led us to a serene location in Pasir Panjang. By day, we delighted nearby office-goers with our seafood restaurant, and by night, we catered to events in style. It was like having the best of both culinary worlds!

Fast forward to today, and we've come a long way. We've moved to a spacious 26,000-square-foot building, upgrading our kitchen game and maintaining squeaky-clean hygiene standards. Oh, and did we mention that the founder's daughters, Ophelia and Carella, joined the family business? They bring their own spice to the mix, with Ophelia mastering the art of sales and procurement, while Carella adds a dash of marketing magic.

Now, here's where you come in. We're on a mission to revolutionize the catering market and we need your help to make it happen! Join our innovative team and let's create unforgettable culinary experiences together. Don't worry if you're new to the field – we're all about nurturing talent and having a great time while doing it. Together, let's bring a fresh flavor to the world of catering!

title: Business Development Executive (MICE, Exhibitions & Event Partners)
description:
RS Photography is a Singapore event photography and video company. Since 2013 we have worked with government agencies, universities, conference organisers and corporate teams, and we run 150 to 160 shoots a month. We are rated 4.9 stars from 290+ Google reviews, and we are a team of 10.

We are hiring one person to run our quotations and grow our partner channels. Our systems find event leads and write first drafts every day. You turn those leads into paid bookings: you prepare the quotation, follow up until the client decides, and build relationships with the companies that bring us work: stand builders, professional congress organisers (PCOs), event agencies and exhibitors.

You prepare, the Director approves. Every quotation, and every price that is not on our rate cards, is approved by the Director before it goes out.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Prepare quotations for enquiries from our approved rate cards, and follow up until the client says yes, no or not now

- Follow our follow-up rhythm: a short, human note on working day 2, 4 and 9, then stop

- Build partner channels: stand builders, PCOs, event agencies and exhibitors. Open the conversation, send our partner rate card, and keep the relationship warm

- Turn replies into confirmed bookings: dates, venue, hours, crew needs, and the deposit or purchase order

- Use our AI drafting tools every day: check each draft, personalise it, and correct anything that is not true

- Keep our CRM and weekly pipeline report accurate: quotes sent, replies, bookings and the reason for every lost deal

- Attend a few industry events a month (for example SACEOS events, trade shows, venue open days) and bring back named contacts

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- At least 3 years in B2B sales or account management in Singapore: events, exhibitions, MICE, media, agencies or corporate services

- Experience writing quotations or proposals and following them up until a decision

- Clear written English. Clients should be able to forward your emails without editing

- Comfortable with numbers, rate cards and purchase orders

- Honest selling: you never promise what we cannot deliver and you never invent a price

- Organised and CRM-disciplined

- You can use AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for research and drafting, and you check the facts before anything goes out. You will show us live at the interview

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience selling to stand builders, PCOs, exhibition organisers or event agencies

- Exposure to government procurement (GeBIZ, purchase orders)

WHAT WE OFFER

- Base salary S$3,500 to S$4,500 per month depending on experience, plus commission: 5% of revenue from new clients in their first 12 months, and 2% on renewals you manage, paid every quarter on cash we have collected

- CPF and annual leave in accordance with the Employment Act

- Full-time, based in our office in Sin Ming, with client visits and some events outside office hours

- A direct line to the Director, and a small team where your work is visible

HOW TO APPLY

Apply with your CV. In your application, add two lines: the biggest B2B deal you closed, and how you followed it up.

Pay: $3,500.00 - $4,500.00 per month

Benefits:
* Professional development

title: Intern, Occupational Health, Safety, & Wellbeing
description:
Company Description

About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Job Description

Get to Know the Team

The Corporate Real Estate and Security Team (CREST) supports Grab's workplace facilities, security, safety, and health. The team works with internal stakeholders to maintain safe and healthy workplaces, prepare for emergencies, and support the wellbeing of Grabbers.

Get to Know the Role

As a Health, Safety & Wellbeing Intern, you will support the documentation and daily coordination of workplace safety and health activities. Working with the OHS team and other company partners, you will help track inspections and follow-ups, support risk assessments and emergency preparedness, and coordinate wellbeing activities.

This onsite internship is at Grab One North, Singapore, from January to May/June 2027. The role includes workplace walk-throughs and support for drills and events.

You will report to Singapore Country OHS & Security Manager.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Your responsibilities fall into three main areas: Compliance & Audits, Proactive Safety, and Programme Management.

Maintain OHS Compliance & Readiness:
You will support routine workplace safety inspections, record findings, and track follow-up actions for fire, first-aid, and other safety equipment.
Manage Risk & Emergency Preparedness:
You will help update risk assessments, Safe Work Procedures, and emergency response plans with guidance from the OHS team.
You will coordinate emergency drills and support the documentation and follow-up of incident and near-miss investigations.
You will help incorporate safety considerations into workplace projects, including renovations and space planning.
Promote Wellness & Data Reporting:
You will plan and coordinate health and wellbeing activities, such as health talks and ergonomic workshops.
You will maintain OHS records and trackers, compile monthly data, and prepare reports on incidents and compliance.
You will use approved AI tools to support research, documentation, data analysis, or event planning, and check outputs for accuracy before use.

Qualifications

What Essential Skills You Will Need

You are pursuing a diploma or undergraduate degree. It will be in one of the following fields: Workplace Safety and Health or Occupational Health and Safety. Alternatively, it could be in Environmental Science, Health, Engineering, Facilities Management, the Built Environment, or Public Health, or a related field.
You will have knowledge of workplace hazards, risk assessment, and safe work practices, and be able to apply it under guidance.
You will maintain accurate records and trackers, prepare meeting notes and reports, and use Excel or similar tools to organise data.
You will coordinate follow-ups with different teams and document safety findings and actions.
You will support onsite walk-throughs, event safety preparations, and emergency drills.
You have experience engaging with AI tools and latest technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows, and contribute new ideas, such as in research, documentation, or data analysis.

Additional Information

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer our Interns:

Comprehensive Medical Insurance: We got you covered with medical insurance plans.
Leave Entitlement: Enjoy a range of leave options including Annual Leave, Medical Leave, and Hospitalization Leave.
Flexible Work Arrangements: Benefit from a flexible work schedule that allows you to balance your academic commitments and personal life.
Community Involvement: Get involved in community service through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) programs.
Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique

description:
Company Overview

Get Out! Events is dedicated to creating unforgettable events that inspire and connect. Specialising in

corporate events, summits and conferences

, we deliver tailored experiences with creativity, precision and seamless execution to leave a lasting impact.

We are an

AI-native events agency

AI tools and agents

, so our people spend less time on repetitive admin and more time on clients, creativity and great events.

Role Overview

Get Out! Events is looking for an

Event Executive

to support the planning, coordination, and execution of corporate and government events.

This role is ideal for someone who has some events experience and wants to build deeper hands-on exposure across event planning, coordination, and execution. You will work closely with our Event Managers and project team, with the opportunity to grow into larger event responsibilities over time.

Why Join Us

AI-native way of working

: every staff member is equipped with AI tools and agents to support their day-to-day work

Less admin, more event craft

: AI helps with first drafts of run sheets, packing lists, vendor follow-ups and documentation, so you can focus on learning and execution

Learn from experienced Event Managers

and grow into larger event responsibilities

Future-ready skills

: learn to run events alongside AI, a capability few events agencies offer

Key Responsibilities

Event Planning Support

Assist Event Managers with event planning, timelines, run sheets, vendor coordination, and logistical preparation.

Help prepare event documents such as programme flows, packing lists, manpower plans, briefing notes, and setup requirements.

Coordinate with vendors, suppliers, venues, crew, and internal team members to ensure event requirements are clear and followed up.

Support sourcing, quotation requests, simple proposal inputs, and operational planning where required.

Event Operations

Support on-site event setup, execution, and teardown.

Assist with registration, guest flow, activity management, stage coordination, vendor coordination, and general event operations.

Ensure event equipment, materials, signage, and supplies are properly prepared, packed, transported, and accounted for.

Help troubleshoot on-ground issues calmly and escalate matters to the Event Manager when needed.

Client and Team Coordination

Communicate professionally with clients, vendors, partners, and internal team members.

Attend internal briefings, client meetings, site recces, and event debriefs when required.

Take clear notes, follow up on assigned tasks, and keep the Event Manager updated on progress.

Learn to manage client expectations and support smooth communication across all parties.

Requirements

Some experience in events, hospitality, production, customer service, operations, or a related field.

Comfortable working on-site at events, including weekends or irregular hours when required.

Organised, responsible, and able to follow through on assigned tasks.

Good communication skills and a positive working attitude.

Willingness to learn, ask questions, receive feedback, and improve.

Able to stay calm under pressure and work well with different teams.

Comfortable using AI tools and modern productivity platforms to research, organise information, draft documents, and coordinate event work.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is dependable, humble, hands-on, and eager to grow. You should be comfortable taking ownership of assigned event components while learning to handle larger responsibilities over time.

Career Growth

This role offers exposure to a wide range of corporate and government events and a clear pathway to take on larger event responsibilities as you build confidence, consistency, and execution ability.

Working Style

This is a hands-on events role. You will support both office-based planning and on-site event execution. Some events may require early mornings, evenings, weekends, or physical setup work.

Other Information

Full-time position based in Singapore

Salary range:

SGD 2,500 to SGD 3,300 per month

Working hours: weekdays,

10am to 6pm

Occasional evening and weekend work during events

Job Description & Requirements

Administration Manager job brief

We are looking for an experienced Administration Manager to supervise daily support operations of our company and plan the most efficient administrative procedures. You will lead a team of professionals to complete a range of administrative duties in different departments.

A great administration manager has excellent communication and organizational skills. The ideal candidate will be well-versed in departmental procedures and policies and will be able to actively discover new ways to do the job more efficiently.

The goal is to ensure all support activities are carried on efficiently and effectively to allow the other operations to function properly.

Administration Manager Responsibilities

• Plan and coordinate administrative procedures and systems and devise ways to streamline processes

• Recruit and train personnel and allocate responsibilities and office space

• Assess staff performance and provide coaching and guidance to ensure maximum efficiency

• Ensure the smooth and adequate flow of information within the company to facilitate other business operations

• Manage schedules and deadlines

• Monitor inventory of office supplies and the purchasing of new material with attention to budgetary constraints

• Monitor costs and expenses to assist in budget preparation

• Oversee facilities services, maintenance activities and tradespersons (e.g electricians)

• Organize and supervise other office activities (recycling, renovations, event planning etc.)

• Ensure operations adhere to policies and regulations

• Keep abreast with all organizational changes and business developments

• Perform any other duties assigned by the director.

Administration Manager Requirements and skills

• Proven experience as administration manager

• In-depth understanding of office management procedures and departmental and legal policies

• Familiarity with financial and facilities management principles

• Proficient in MS Office

• An analytical mind with problem-solving skills

• Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities

• A team player with leadership skills

• BSc/BA in business administration or relative field

• The ability to work under pressure.

• Availability to work within opening hours (e.g. evenings, holidays, weekends).

title: Community Engagement Manager
description:
SANA strives to educate the community on the harms of drug abuse, provide support for persons-in-recovery towards desistance, and advocate for a drug-free society. We support long-term recovery and reintegration for ex-drug offenders and their families through a variety of programmes and services.

Responsibilities:

1. Community Engagement (Yellow Ribbon Community Project)

Actively engage grassroot organizations, government departments and social service agencies

Main Coordinator for engagement work with relevant social service agencies

2. Community Outreach

Actively participate in the process of research, planning, implementation and evaluation for programmes to reduce drug-taking behaviour in the community (e.g., outreach programmes, etc.).

3. Volunteer Management

Actively engage with volunteers to ensure clients’ needs are well-supported

Constant liaising with volunteers in relation to programme execution

Provide guidance and support to volunteers

Assist in drawing up and implementing training program for the volunteers

4. Operations

Work independently and in a team. Be diligent in completing tasks relevant to community engagement. Able to work on some weekday nights and some Saturdays when required.

Technical Competencies:

1. Preferably a

Degree in Social Work, Psychology or Counselling

2. Ability to relate with ex-offenders and their families

Core Competencies:

1. Good team player and pleasant disposition

2. Strong conceptual and organizational abilities

3. Good interpersonal, communication and writing skills

4. Mature, Independent and positive work attitude

5. Event Planning

Preferred achievements / characteristics:

1. Strong Passion in working with the community

2. Good understanding of the principles of drug addiction and recovery

3. Candidates with experience working with volunteers would be an added advantage

4. Preferably able to communicate with Mandarin - or Malay-speaking clients

The Singapore Anti-Narcotics Association (SANA) is a Social Service Agency formed in 1972 to prevent drug-abuse in Singapore by raising awareness of the dangers of drug and substance abuse as well as to provide counselling and aftercare services where necessary.
