title: Brand Manager (VIVAIA)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, commercially driven General Manager – Singapore to lead VIVAIA’s Singapore business and accelerate sustainable growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role with overall responsibility for the Singapore business, including sales growth, P&L, retail operations, merchandising, marketing, customer experience and business development.

We are looking for someone who does not simply manage the existing business, but can constantly identify why sales are growing or declining, what is driving the change, and what actions should be taken to improve performance.

The successful candidate should have a strong understanding of modern retail, consumer behaviour, digital marketing and store operations, with a proven track record of growing retail businesses.

Responsibilities:

Overall Business & P&L Management

Take overall responsibility for VIVAIA Singapore’s sales, profitability and business performance.

Develop annual and monthly sales, profit and growth plans.

Monitor sales, gross margin, operating expenses, inventory and store profitability.

Identify business opportunities and risks early and take corrective action.

Present regular business reviews and growth plans to regional/global management.

2. Sales Growth

Drive sustainable growth across all Singapore retail stores and relevant online channels.

Monitor daily, weekly and monthly sales performance.

Analyse sales performance by store, product category, SKU, price point and customer segment.

Identify the reasons behind sales growth or decline and translate insights into specific actions.

Improve key retail metrics including traffic, conversion rate, average transaction value and units per transaction.

3. Retail Operations

Lead the Retail Operations team and all store performance.

Set store-level sales targets and performance KPIs.

Work closely with store managers to improve productivity and customer experience.

Identify underperforming stores and develop turnaround plans.

Improve staff selling skills, service standards and sales productivity.

Evaluate new locations and provide recommendations for store openings, relocations or closures.

4. Merchandising & Product

Lead and work closely with the Merchandising/Product team.

Analyse product performance and identify best sellers, slow movers and emerging trends.

Ensure the right products, sizes, colours and inventory are available at the right stores.

Provide market feedback to regional/global product teams.

Develop Singapore-specific product, assortment and pricing recommendations where appropriate.

Improve inventory turnover and reduce unnecessary markdowns.

5. Marketing & Customer Acquisition

Lead the Marketing team in developing effective Singapore marketing strategies.

Build integrated online and offline marketing campaigns.

Evaluate the effectiveness of Meta, Google, TikTok, Xiaohongshu, influencers/KOLs, CRM, affiliates and other digital channels.

Develop campaigns that generate measurable incremental traffic, customers and sales.

Work closely with Retail Operations to convert marketing traffic into store visits and purchases.

Develop customer retention and CRM strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer lifetime value.

6. Customer & Market Insights

Continuously monitor Singapore consumer trends, competitors and market developments.

Track key competitors including international and local fashion, footwear and lifestyle brands.

Understand changing customer preferences, price sensitivity and shopping behaviour.

Use data and customer feedback to improve product, marketing, pricing and store strategies.

7. Commercial & Business Development

Develop partnerships with shopping malls, platforms, strategic partners and relevant organisations.

Negotiate and evaluate commercial opportunities together with relevant internal teams.

Identify opportunities for new stores, pop-ups, events and other channels

Ensure commercial decisions are based on expected sales, profitability and long-term brand value.

8. Team Leadership

Directly manage and develop the key Singapore functions, including:

Head / Manager of Retail Operations

Head / Manager of Merchandising / Product

Head / Manager of Marketing

Build a high-performance culture based on accountability, data and results.

⸻

Key Performance Indicators

The successful candidate will be evaluated primarily on measurable business results, including:

Total Sales Growth

Like-for-Like Sales Growth

Store Sales Productivity

Gross Margin

Store EBITDA / Profitability

Conversion Rate

Average Transaction Value (ATV)

Units Per Transaction (UPT)

Customer Acquisition Cost

Marketing ROI

Repeat Customer Rate

Inventory Turnover

Markdown Rate

New Store Performance

Requirements:

5 years of relevant experience in retail, fashion, footwear, lifestyle, beauty or other consumer brands.

Proven experience managing multi-store retail operations.

Experience managing P&L and business performance.

Strong understanding of merchandising, marketing and retail operations.

Demonstrated track record of growing sales and improving profitability.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent understanding of Singapore’s retail and consumer market.

Strong leadership and people-management skills.

Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

VIVAIA

is a modern fashion footwear brand that combines

style, comfort and sustainability

to create versatile footwear for the modern consumer.

The brand focuses on designing stylish and comfortable shoes for everyday wear, with an emphasis on innovative materials, thoughtful design and more sustainable production practices. VIVAIA has built its brand presence through a combination of

digital commerce, social media, influencer marketing and physical retail experiences

.

As VIVAIA continues to expand its presence in

Singapore and across the region

, the company is looking to strengthen its local brand presence and connect with more consumers through innovative marketing, engaging customer experiences and strong retail and digital strategies.

VIVAIA represents the intersection of fashion, comfort and conscious design — creating footwear that fits modern lifestyles while keeping sustainability in mind.

title: Brand Manager
description:
About the role

We're looking for a Brand Manager who can own the Bells brand system end to end — across all three sub-brands — and who is equally comfortable managing a website launch and standing on-site at a training centre reviewing a kiosk installation. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role at the centre of the Bells brand rollout — spanning digital brand execution (websites, programme pages), physical brand experience (centre branding, kiosks, experiential walls), and the ongoing marketing engine (testimonials, collateral, campaigns) that keeps each brand alive day to day.

You'll work directly with senior brand and marketing leadership, coordinating designers, developers, print vendors, and centre teams to bring a locked brand system to life consistently — online and in person — across every touchpoint a learner encounters, whichever Bells sub-brand they meet first.

Key responsibilities

Own end-to-end execution of Bells websites and programme pages — homepage, About Us, Contact Us, and all course/programme pages — across Bells School of AI, Bells School of Finance, and Bells Academy, coordinating information gathering, content, Figma design, dev handover, staging, and go-live against a live project tracker.

Ensure every page reflects locked, approved copy and the correct brand system for its sub-brand exactly — verbatim accuracy on approved lines is non-negotiable.

Coordinate with content, design, and tech stakeholders to keep multiple programme pages moving through the pipeline in parallel across all three brands without missing deadlines.

Drive the physical rollout of Bells brand guidelines across all training centres — managing video recce, floor plans, design concepts, approvals, print production, and installation end to end — tailored to whichever sub-brand a centre or zone represents.

Own the Centre Branding Playbook and ensure it is replicated consistently across centres, each on its own rollout timeline.

Lead kiosk branding standardisation — from pilot through to uniform rollout across all centres.

Build out the Testimonials Playbook into a repeatable, business-as-usual process across all Bells sub-brands — covering collection (video and static, via structured intake forms), consent tracking, and editing.

Own the On-Ground Collateral / BTL Playbook — flyers, notice boards, hiring and recruitment posters, and event materials — for both marketing and centre/ground-sales needs, across all three sub-brands.

Act as the day-to-day guardian of the Bells brand system — the master brand and each of its three sub-brands — ensuring consistent, correctly-differentiated application across every digital and physical touchpoint.

Maintain and report against the brand ops tracker, proactively surfacing blockers, delays, and dependencies.

About you

4–6 years of experience in brand management, brand marketing, or brand operations, with exposure to both digital execution (websites, content, campaigns) and physical/experiential branding (retail, centre, event, or environmental branding).

Degree holders (preferably in Marketing)

Background in education or edtech is a plus, but not essential.

Experience managing more than one brand or sub-brand at a time is a strong plus.

Strong project management instincts: comfortable owning a tracker with 15–20+ concurrent workstreams, each at a different stage, without letting anything slip.

Working knowledge of how signage, kiosks, and print production actually get made — from concept and design through to approval and installation.

Comfortable reviewing and giving feedback on website and programme page content, with an eye for consistency, tone, and brand fit.

Fluent with AI tools for everyday content, design, and editing work — drafting and refining copy, generating and iterating on visual concepts, and speeding up edits.

Excellent stakeholder management — able to work confidently with founders and leadership as well as designers, vendors, and ground teams.

Meticulous and self-directed: flags issues before they become problems, and can be trusted to represent the brand accurately without constant sign-off.

Based in Singapore, with willingness to travel regularly across Bells training centres for on-site branding rollouts.

About us

Bells Institute of Higher Learning is one of Singapore's most established education providers, with 150,000 learners impacted, 7 training centres, and 40+ courses. Bells is an SSG-appointed programme partner, aligned to SkillsFuture and NTUC e2i, with corporate partners including JP Morgan, DBS Bank, Samsung, Singtel, Meta, and BDO.

The Bells brand structure is being rebuilt around three sub-brands: Bells School of AI, our flagship digital-first anchor brand; Bells School of Finance, built in partnership with Imarticus Learning — a leader in professional education with 1M+ learners impacted globally — bringing AI-embedded finance education to Singapore; and Bells Academy, home to our specialised courses spanning 3D printing, project management, craft skills, and more.

BELLS Education Group's Track Record and Corporate Profile

Champions of Employability

When it comes to career workshops conducted in Singapore, there is no better and more experienced entity than BELLS Education Group. We have an unrivalled rate of placement in the number of participants getting jobs after our workshops, proving our techniques to be both ground-breaking and innovative. Having conducted nationwide programmes and also various programmes for students and alumni members of various educational institutes and private schools, it is clear that BELLS Education Group is the training provider of choice.

title: #EX Robotics Experience & Events Coordinator
description:
Date: 2026-10-14

Location: Singapore, Singapore

Company: NCS

Job Requisition ID: RQ26-01948-1-1
Company Description

NCS is a leading AI Tech Services company. With a 15,000-strong team across the Asia Pacific, NCS scales its platforms and capabilities to provide clients with greater agility and AI expertise across a range of Industries. Embracing a strong ecosystem of global partners, NCS transforms technology services delivery combining AI with digital resilience to drive real business impact. NCS is a subsidiary of the Singtel Group.

Job Description

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Robotics Experience & Events Coordinator to build and operate a new business around humanoid robotics shows, demonstrations and technology experiences.

This role will own the end-to-end event lifecycle — from event concept, client engagement through to costing, planning, logistics, technical coordination and on-site execution.

The successful candidate will continuously develop new show concepts, audience experiences, robotics demonstrations and event packages that differentiate our offering and create business.

You will lead a small technical operations team of up to 2 team members, working closely with robotics engineers, vendors and clients to deliver safe, reliable and engaging live experiences.

Key Responsibilities

1. Event Concept

Develop innovative concepts for humanoid robotics shows, demonstrations, corporate events, exhibitions, and public experiences.
Develop repeatable show packages and customised experiences based on client requirements.
Work with technology and robotics teams to translate emerging capabilities into compelling event experiences.
Research robotics and event trends to continuously refresh the company's show portfolio.

2. Event Planning

Own the end-to-end planning and execution of events from initial brief to post-event review.
Coordinate venue requirements including space, flooring, power, connectivity, access, storage and operating conditions.
Conduct site surveys and technical walkthroughs to identify operational constraints early.
Coordinate rehearsals, demonstrations, stage movements, audience interaction and show cues.
Manage event setup, live operations and teardown.

3. Resource Planning

Prepare event quotations, budgets and cost models covering:
Robot and technical resources
Manpower
Venue, connectivity requirements, Logistics and transportation
Insurance and permits
Customisation and content development
Setup and stand down
Build reusable costing templates and event packages to improve work efficiency.

4. Robotics & Technical Operations

Coordinate with robotics engineers and operators to ensure robots are event-ready.
Plan robot deployment, transportation, charging, batteries, controllers, networking and supporting equipment.
Ensure pre-event testing, rehearsal and technical readiness.
Establish operational checklists and contingency plans for robot or technology failures.
Coordinate technical troubleshooting during live events and ensure appropriate escalation.
Maintain equipment inventory, readiness schedules and deployment records.

5. Safety & Risk Management

Incorporate robotics-specific safety requirements into every event plan.
Establish robot operating zones, crowd separation, emergency stop procedures and safe operating protocols.
Conduct event risk assessments and ensure appropriate mitigation measures are in place.
Coordinate relevant venue requirements, permits, insurance and safety documentation.
Develop contingency plans for robot failure, network failure, power issues, venue changes and other show disruptions.

6. Point of Contact

Act as the primary client contact from initial enquiry through event completion.
Understand client objectives and translate them into practical robotics experiences.
Manage expectations around robot capabilities, limitations, operating conditions and show requirements.

Qualifications

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who combines event management discipline with a technology mindset.

Required

1+ years of experience in event management, exhibitions, technology demonstrations or related fields.
Proven experience managing events end-to-end, including planning, costing, logistics and on-site execution.
Ability to manage budgets, quotations and vendor negotiations.
Comfortable working hands-on in a fast-moving environment.
Strong problem-solving ability under live-event pressure.
Willingness to work evenings, weekends and travel when required.
Strong interest in robotics, AI and emerging technologies.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to help build a new category of business — not simply manage events.

This is a part-time contract position. Working hours will be 3 days/week (including weekends).

Additional Information

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

Scam Alert

We are aware of fraudulent job offers and impersonations of NCS recruiters. Phishing emails using convincing-looking but fake addresses are also commonly used to trick you into thinking that they come from official NCS sources.

Please note that all official communications from NCS Group will only be sent from verified corporate email addresses. Always check that the sender’s email address ends with the genuine NCS domain, @ncs.com.sg and beware of extra letters, symbols or misspellings. When in doubt, verify the sender’s identity by contacting us at reachus@ncs.com.sg.

title: Manager, Loyalty Marketing, APEC
description:
Additional Information
Job Number26130284
Job CategorySales & Marketing
Location2 Harbourfront Place #06-08, Bank of America, Singapore 098499, Singapore
ScheduleFull Time
Located Remotely?N
Position Type Management

JOB SUMMARY

The Manager, Loyalty Marketing is a high-impact, commercially oriented role responsible for driving member growth, engagement and retention across Asia Pacific excluding China (APEC).

This is a new role sitting at the intersection of loyalty strategy, CRM, and experiential partnerships - built for a marketer who is equally comfortable designing a lifecycle journey and activating world-class partnerships. You will own the end-to-end member journeys for one of the world's largest hospitality loyalty programs, translating global strategy into locally relevant, measurable initiatives across a diverse and dynamic region. This role will report to the Director, Loyalty Marketing, APEC.

You will lead the evolution of CRM and lifecycle marketing for APEC — defining segmentation strategy, designing engagement programs, and driving measurable improvements in activation, retention and reactivation. You will work in close collaboration with global, continent and market teams, and play a central role in building the reach and scaling our loyalty program as a long-term growth driver for the business. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, strategic thinking and a member-centric mindset.

This role is based in Singapore.

CORE COMPETENCIES

CRM & Lifecycle Marketing: Deep, hands-on experience designing and executing programs across the full customer journey. Builds segmentation logic, personalisation strategy and automated flows anchored in commercial outcomes, not just campaign execution.
Loyalty & Partnership Marketing: Solid understanding of loyalty program mechanics (earn/burn, tiering, member value proposition) and how to market them effectively across segments and channels. Proven ability to activate brand partnerships, event management and experiential moments from brief to delivery, with strong agency management.
Data Analysis & Fluency: Comfortable working with member behaviour data, campaign analytics and dashboards to surface insight and drive continuous improvement. Tracks activity to outcomes, not outputs.
Communication & Brand Stewardship: Executes customer-facing communications with a consistent, on-brand voice across owned and paid channels. Brings sharp copywriting instincts, strong creative review judgment, and the ability to influence and align across global, regional and local teams with different cultures and working styles.
Execution & Project Management: Highly organised with a strong bias for delivery. Manages multiple workstreams simultaneously, ensuring projects adhere to timelines.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

We are looking for a marketer with 4+ years of experience in loyalty, CRM or lifecycle marketing, ideally within hospitality, travel, or a consumer brand environment.

Requirement

4-5 years of relevant professional experience in program management, marketing strategy, loyalty and lifecycle disciplines, digital or related function
Experience managing and directing strategic partners / agencies /vendors. Demonstrated relationship marketing skills a must.
Team player, proven ability to lead and work with cross-functional teams in support of specific business priorities
Languages: Proficiency in English required; proficiency in reading and writing in other Asian languages strongly preferred.

JOB SCOPE

Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing

Drive member growth, engagement and advocacy across APEC through loyalty-led initiatives that build program awareness, deepen usage and deliver locally relevant member value
Develop and execute the continent's loyalty marketing plan - spanning promotions, lifecycle programs and CRM strategy - aligned with global strategy and optimised for local market nuance
Define and manage CRM strategy across the full customer lifecycle: acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention and reactivation
Plan and execute loyalty-led campaigns across owned channels (email, app, digital) and paid channels (social, digital) with audience analysis, targeting, segmentation and performance tracking
Identify opportunities for segmentation, personalisation to deliver on deeper customer value optimisation; drive continuous improvement in CRM effectiveness and automation capabilities
 Leverage market research, member insights and data analytics to inform engagement strategies and personalised experiences
Design, implement and optimise loyalty programs that drive advocacy and revenue, delivering tangible value to target member segments
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including but not limited to MarTech, Enterprise Partnerships (Co-Brand, Airlines, Everyday Earn) and Loyalty Operations to integrate and orchestrate initiatives across key customer touchpoints
Serve as gatekeeper for all loyalty member communications, ensuring on-brand, accurate and effective execution

Performance Operations & Governance

Track and report program KPIs covering member acquisition, activation, retention, revenue contribution and repeat stay behaviour, with clear recommendations for improvement
Oversee CRM data accuracy, integrity and compliance across programs
Drive effective onboarding, training and adoption of loyalty programs and systems across property teams

Experiential Partnerships

Support the activation of global and regional marketing partnerships translating partnership rights into compelling, member-facing campaigns that drive high member engagement, leveraging on Marriott Bonvoy Moments
Ensure all partnership campaigns are executed in full alignment with partners, with rigorous agency management and end-to-end campaign planning
Support end-to-end event management and logistics planning for partnership activations, ensuring seamless on-ground execution and member experiences

Working Relations

Key interfaces:-

Area Directors of Marketing
Field Marketing team
Continent level agencies.

Integrated Marketing Planning

Supports development of continent destination marketing strategy and focused on key source markets and KPIs.
Monitor competitive activity in the category.

Promotions/ Partnerships

Partners with Revenue Strategy, develops and executes promotions/offers that drive KPIs for the continent or market (eg. Enrollment goals, direct channel goals, driving leisure revenue, etc.).
Partner with analytics team to ensure proper tracking and communication of all programs.

Integrated Marketing Execution

Develops marketing brief with clear KPIs and conducts kick off for all new programs.
Engages agencies in RFP process and project manages the creative design and execution process to bring a program to market. Ensures consumer messaging is clear.
Is responsible for ensuring all key stakeholders of the program are aligned.
Is responsible for communicating programs to the market and corporate teams and ensuring all channels are leveraged (social, digital, sales, etc).
Reviews program performance in real time and modifies program as needed.

Area/ Hotel Support

Partners with Directors of Field Marketing and other area marketing leaders.
Provides strong guidance on positioning and pull through of brands.
Advises field marketing on effective marketing communications planning, implementation and evaluation.
Conducts destination marketing training and develops resources and materials for Directors of Sales and Marketing with a focus on marketing planning, branding, positioning, messaging and storytelling.
Deal with own development of the process for new hotel ramp up and hotel positioning and messaging development. Partners with area marketing leaders to execute where needed.

MANAGEMENT COMPETENCIES

Leadership

Adaptability - Maintains performance level under pressure or when experiencing changes or challenges in the workplace.

Communication - Conveys information and ideas to others in a convincing and engaging manner through a variety of methods.

Problem Solving and Decision Making - Identifies and understands issues, problems, and opportunities; obtains and compares information from different sources to draw conclusions, develops and evaluates alternatives and solutions, solves problems, and chooses a course of action.

Professional Demeanor - Exhibits behavioral styles that convey confidence and command respect from others; makes a good first impression and represents the company in alignment with its values.

Managing Execution

Building and Contributing to Teams - Participates as a member of a team to move toward the completion of common goals while fostering cohesion and collaboration among team members.

Driving for Results - Sets high standards of performance for self and/or others; assumes responsibility for work objectives; initiates, focuses, and monitors the efforts of self and/or others toward the accomplishment goals; proactively takes action and goes beyond what is required.

Planning and Organizing - Gathers information and resources required to set a plan of action for self and/or others; prioritizes and arranges work requirements to accomplish goals and ensure work is completed.

Building Relationships

Coworker Relationships - Interacts with others in a way that builds openness, trust, and confidence in the pursuit of organizational goals and lasting relationships.

Customer Relationships - Develops and sustains relationships based on an understanding of customer/stakeholder needs and actions consistent with the company’s service standards.

Global Mindset - Supports employees and business partners with diverse styles, abilities, motivations, and/or cultural perspectives; utilizes differences to drive innovation, engagement and enhance business results; and ensures employees are given the opportunity to contribute to their full potential.

Generating Talent and Organizational Capability

Organizational Capability - Evaluates and adapts the structure of assignments and work processes to best fit the needs and/or support the goals of an organizational unit.

Talent Management - Provides guidance and feedback to help individuals develop and strengthen skills and abilities needed to accomplish work objectives.

The ideal candidate must possess strong sales and customer engagement skills, extensive knowledge of Indian cuisine and catering operations, and the ability to independently manage catering enquiries, secure orders and execute events successfully.

Catering Sales & Business Development

Actively promote and develop catering business for weddings, corporate functions, private parties, religious functions and other events.

Engage customers confidently, understand their requirements and recommend suitable menus and catering packages.

Prepare catering quotations, negotiate commercial terms and follow up to secure orders.

Build strong relationships with corporate clients, event organisers and individual customers.

Develop strategies to increase catering sales, repeat orders and customer referrals.

Identify opportunities for festive promotions, bulk food orders and corporate catering contracts.

Catering Operations & Event Management

Independently manage end-to-end catering operations, from order confirmation to successful event completion.

Plan and coordinate event requirements, including menus, food quantities, logistics, equipment and manpower.

Oversee buffet setup, food presentation, replenishment, service and post-event clearance.

Coordinate closely with kitchen teams to ensure timely preparation, packing and delivery.

Supervise catering staff and ensure smooth operations at event venues.

Handle multiple catering orders and events simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Resolve last-minute operational challenges and customer requests professionally.

Customer Service & Relationship Management

Provide excellent customer service throughout the catering process.

Demonstrate strong persuasive selling, upselling and negotiation skills.

Maintain accurate catering order details, including menu selections, quantities, delivery schedules and special requirements.

Handle customer feedback, complaints and service recovery effectively.

Maintain regular communication with customers before, during and after events.

Cost Control & Administration

Monitor catering costs, food quantities, manpower expenses and event profitability.

Prepare and maintain quotations, invoices, booking records and payment follow-ups.

Coordinate with suppliers, transport providers and external service partners.

Minimise wastage while maintaining food quality and service standards.

Maintain accurate sales records and provide regular business performance updates to management.

Job Requirements

Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in catering, restaurant operations, event management or F&B sales.

Strong knowledge of Indian cuisine, particularly South Indian and North Indian catering menus.

Experience handling weddings, corporate catering, buffet services and large-scale events is preferred.

Excellent sales, negotiation, customer engagement and order-conversion skills.

Strong communication skills in English; Tamil communication skills are advantageous for serving Tamil-speaking customers and coordinating with staff.

Ability to independently prepare catering quotations, plan events and manage customer requirements.

Strong organisational, multitasking and problem-solving skills.

Capable of managing high-pressure situations and multiple events simultaneously.

Hands-on attitude with willingness to assist in buffet setup, food service, packing, delivery coordination and other operational duties.

Willing to work flexible hours, weekends and public holidays based on event schedules.

Strong sense of ownership, accountability and commitment to achieving catering sales targets.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a

Catering Manager who is both a strong salesperson and a hands-on operations leader

.

The successful candidate must be capable of independently securing catering orders, convincing customers, recommending menus, preparing quotations, coordinating kitchen production and managing events from start to finish.

The candidate should thrive in a challenging environment, take ownership of catering business growth and consistently deliver excellent customer experiences.

Candidates with a passion for Indian cuisine, strong business development skills and proven catering management experience are encouraged to apply.

title: Specialist, Field Marketing
description:
Posting Type

Remote

Job Overview

About Relativity

Legal technology is having its moment, and Relativity is at the centre of it.

We are a leading legal data intelligence company. Our extensible, AI cloud platform, RelativityOne, is trusted by the world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies to turn complex data into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, arbitration, and other high-stakes legal matters.

In Asia, the momentum speaks for itself: RelativityOne adoption jumped 46% year-over-year, a sign that organisations have moved beyond experimentation and are now applying AI in production environments to modernise how legal work gets done at scale.

To meet this moment, we’re expanding our Singapore team and on-the-ground presence. This is an opportunity to be part of an exciting growth story. We are looking for mid-level professionals across sales, technical solutions, customer success, and marketing to support our continued expansion. You’ll have the backing of an established industry leader and the opportunity to help grow our customer base across Asia.

If you’re ready to help write the next chapter of legal AI in Asia, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description and Requirements

Job Summary

A fantastic opportunity for a hands-on marketer, with an entrepreneurial spirit, who thrives on making a real impact across diverse markets.

As Marketing Specialist, Field Marketing — Asia, based in Singapore, you will support the planning and execution of integrated marketing campaigns across our four key Asia markets — Singapore, Hong Kong, India, and South Korea — with a strong focus on demand generation and event marketing. You will partner with the APAC marketing team and sales organisation to ensure marketing activities are closely aligned to regional business priorities.

This is a hands-on, operational role suited to a marketing generalist. Data-driven, proactive, and energetic; you will project-manage end-to-end integrated marketing campaigns to strengthen our position across key markets. You will ensure efficient and effective campaign management and planning, orchestrating key deliverables, and driving execution. You will keep campaign deliverables on time and on budget, and monitor campaign performance to achieve regional pipeline goals. You are most comfortable rolling up your sleeves and getting involved across all aspects of Asia marketing in an execution and operational capacity.

As part of a wider global marketing team, you will work closely with Australia and US-based colleagues to maximise resources and ensure consistency of brand and message across the Asia region.

You are driven to succeed, bring creative ideas to the table, and are an exceptional collaborator, communicator, and project manager — able to navigate confidently across functions and geographies to deliver impactful marketing results.

Responsibilities

Execute integrated demand generation campaigns aligned to regional and global marketing priorities, including digital and event-driven tactics
Plan and deliver field and virtual events (e.g., trade shows, customer events, webinars), including logistics, vendor coordination, and on-site/virtual execution
Collaborate with Sales to align campaigns and events to target accounts, pipeline goals, and customer segments
Manage campaign and event timelines, budgets, and project plans to ensure on-time and on-budget delivery
Build and manages multi-channel campaigns using tools such as Salesforce, Marketo, and Asana.
Works with the Asia marketing team to track and report on campaign and event performance metrics; (e.g., engagement, pipeline contribution, ROI) and make data-driven optimisation recommendations
Amplifies global marketing initiatives to ensure messaging resonates with audiences across each of the four Asia markets.
Plays a key role in the delivery of RelFest Sydney and Asia events, including operational and logistical support, audience acquisition, and driving registrations across the region.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of experience executing integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels (digital, email, events)
Experience of event planning (in-person and/or virtual), including logistics and vendor coordination
Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to analyse campaign performance and translate data into actionable insights.
Experience collaborating cross-functionally, particularly with Sales and Marketing stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in B2B technology or SaaS marketing environments.
Familiarity with marketing automation and CRM platforms (e.g., Marketo, Salesforce)
Experience supporting account-based marketing (ABM) or field marketing programs.
Familiarity with the legal technology sector is an advantage.

Key Competencies

Execution Excellence: Delivers high-quality work with attention to detail and consistency.
Collaboration: Builds strong working relationships across teams to achieve shared outcomes. Confident working across all levels of a business and managing multiple stakeholder relationships in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
Data-Driven Mindset: Uses metrics to evaluate success and improve future performance.
Customer Focus: Understands target audiences and contributes to engaging buyer experiences.
Ownership: Takes accountability for campaign and event deliverables from planning through execution.

Suggested Skills:

Content Marketing, Conversion Rate, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Data Analysis, Demand Generation, Lead Generation, Marketing Automation, Project Management, Salesforce (Software)

We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

You own brand revenue. This is a hunter role. You will own a portfolio of global brand advertisers across APAC — winning new spend, reactivating lapsed or dormant accounts, and expanding existing partnerships. You are the commercial owner for your book of business: strategy, relationships, pipeline, and revenue.
You will work as a trusted advisor to brand marketers and their agency partners, building consultative, insight-led programs that put X at the center of both brand and performance plans. You will work as a peer with the Agency Development and X Cross Functional Teams — close partnership, distinct ownership. This role reports to the Head of Global Brands, APAC.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own and grow revenue across an assigned Global Brands portfolio in APAC. Hit and exceed quarterly and annual targets through new business, expansion, renewals, and reactivation.
Hunt. Build a disciplined pipeline of net-new and returning advertisers. Prioritize client reactivation — bringing lapsed and under-invested global brands back onto the platform with a clear commercial plan.
Establish and deepen relationships with marketing decision-makers at global brands and with the agencies that plan and buy for them (media, creative, social, and holding-company stakeholders).
Build and deliver consultative sales presentations, QBRs, and joint business plans that connect client objectives to X's advertising products, audiences, and measurement — in rooms from brand manager to CMO.
Help advertisers design, launch, and optimize campaigns; measure results; and convert proof into larger, more sustained commitments.
Partner with agencies without outsourcing the sale. You own the client outcome even when the buy sits with a holding company or local shop.
Bring market fluency. Know how decisions get made in Singapore, Jakarta, Bangkok, Ho Chi Minh City, Manila, Kuala Lumpur, Mumbai, and Delhi — and adjust the motion accordingly.
Partner tightly with Agency Development, Client Solutions, Marketing, Content Parternships and regional market teams to remove friction and create incremental revenue.
Stay fluent in the evolving social and digital landscape, X product developments, and competitor activity so you can lead the conversation — not follow it.
Represent X at client meetings, industry events, and in-market reviews across SEA and India.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
Driven, commercially hungry, and comfortable being measured on revenue. Hunter mentality is non-negotiable.
7–10+ years in digital ad sales, ad tech, or martech, with a proven record of growing a book of business against quota.
Deep working knowledge of both the SEA and India advertising markets — how brands plan, how agencies buy, and where decisions actually get made. You have sold in these markets, not just visited them. Relationships may be stronger in one market; fluency must cover both.
Existing, active relationships with global brand clients and their agencies across SEA and India. You can open doors in week one.
Strong presentation and storytelling skills. You can hold a room with a CMO, a regional marketing director, and a working-level planner — and leave with a next step.
Experience reactivating dormant, paused, or under-penetrated clients is strongly preferred. You know how to diagnose why spend left and how to win it back.
Experience working both direct-to-brand and through agency structures.
Self-directed, organized, and effective in a small, high-output team. You do not wait to be told what to sell next.
Willingness to travel approximately 30% of the time across Southeast Asia and India.
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Prior platform, publisher, social, ad tech, or martech sales experience.
Fluency across brand and performance buying.
Additional SEA or Hindi language capability.
Experience with joint business plans, annual commitments, or multi-market brand coordination.

title: Senior Agency Development Manager – Global Brands APAC
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Agencies decide what gets planned, pitched, and bought. This role exists to make X the default recommendation inside those rooms.

You own the agency system and the commercial architecture for Global Brands across APAC. That means holding-company and regional leadership in Singapore and India — and, as a hiring requirement, the Business Directors, Client Directors, and Account Directors who write the plans and clear the buys. A C-suite network without working-level relationships is not sufficient for this role. You will structure commercial deals, navigate complex agency structures, and create the conditions for the sales tea to win more spend.

This is a senior individual-contributor role. You will operate independently, set your own map, and be accountable for agency-sourced revenue influence and partnership quality. You will work as a peer with the Global Brand sales team — close partnership, distinct ownership. This role reports to the Head of Global Brands, APAC.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Build and run the agency development plan for Global Brands across APAC — covering holding companies, regional hubs in Singapore and India, operating companies, and key independents.
Develop strategic relationships at two levels, both required:
Structure and negotiate commercial deals with agencies: trading agreements, partnership frameworks, incentives, joint business plans, and other constructs that lock in commitment and unlock spend.
Navigate complex agency structures — holdco vs. opco, regional vs. local P&Ls, media vs. creative vs. social specialists, and split decision rights between Singapore regional teams and in-market India / SEA offices. Know who decides, who influences, who executes, and how a regional recommendation dies or ships in-market.
Act as the primary trusted advisor to priority agencies. Educate teams on X products, audiences, creative, brand safety, and measurement. Arm them to recommend X to their brand clients without you in the room.
Partner with Client Partners and market teams to convert agency relationships into live campaigns, larger statements of work, and multi-market commitments.
Identify whitespace: agencies and pods that should be recommending X and currently are not. Open those doors and create a path to revenue.
Represent X at agency town halls, leadership forums, holding-company reviews, industry events, and in-market working sessions.
Track partnership health and commercial performance. Course-correct quickly. Do not wait for a quarterly review to find out a key agency has gone quiet.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
A self-starter who runs independently. You do not need a playbook handed to you. You build one, socialize it, and execute.
10–12+ years in media sales, agency development, or senior agency-side commercial / client leadership, with a clear record of driving revenue through agency partnerships in APAC.
An existing network you can use immediately — not a list you hope to build. It must already include:
Proven experience structuring commercial deals and working through layered agency decision-making (holding companies, operating companies, local markets, specialist units).
Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills. Credible with a regional CEO and useful to a Business Director running a global brand the same week.
Deep understanding of how media, creative, social, and performance agencies plan and buy in APAC.
Comfortable with ambiguity, competing stakeholders, and a fast-moving product environment.
Willingness to travel regularly across Southeast Asia and India.
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Southeast Asian language skills preferred — this will materially increase effectiveness in key markets.
Time spent inside a holding-company network (WPP, Publicis, Omnicom, IPG, Dentsu, Havas) or a major independent, plus platform-side agency development.
Direct experience standing up or resetting an agency partnership in a market where the platform was under-indexed.
Working fluency in how global brands brief regional and local agencies across SEA and India.
Experience with both brand and performance agency models.

title: Regional Technical Sales Manager - TEM/XPS
description:
Work Schedule

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Position Summary

This Southeast Asia (SEA) focused TEM/XPS Product Specialist / Sales Development representative will work with a motivated and successful team at the forefront of electron microscopy in SEA, APAC and around the world, including applications, product development, sales and marketing. You will become a product expert and help to deliver TEM and/or XPS business growth in SEA, working closely with our academic and industrial research customers, to understand their application needs and find effective ways to promote our solutions. You will help to understand and build relationships with key researchers and match our technology and solutions to customer needs, and help to increase materials science electron microscopy and surface analysis sales in the region.

Job responsibilities will include:

• Keeping up to date on the latest products and technology (mainly TEM and/or XPS), by developing relationships both inside and outside the APAC region, including with hands-on experience if possible.

• Establishing and maintaining strong relationships with customers to better understand how to make them successful, both in academia and industry.

• Explaining new products, workflows and solutions to customers including in the battery, steel, automotive, and coatings industries, as well as to academic researchers.

• Supporting the sales team to improve win-rate for electron microscopy and surface analysis opportunities

• Supporting the planning, preparation and execution of product demonstrations

• Partner with regional sales managers to execute our annual operation plan, develop and drive business development projects for target market segments. Overlook the progress to ensure the key projects in good shape, on track and deliver the target pipeline growth.

• TEM/XPS market and competition intelligence, including participating in microscopy societies and conferences, identifying key opinion leaders, understanding competitor products and strategies, and sharing microscopy technical expertise and advice to internal and external customers

• Helping with event planning and execution including conferences, workshops, trade shows and webinars, and presenting at such events.

• Discussing with the MSBU product team about customer and market trends and requests, to improve the development of the next generation of electron microscopes

• Adapting or translating marketing materials for local use.

• Helping to train and develop other members of the team.

The ideal candidate would have:

• Good knowledge of TEM and/or XPS techniques and applications (preferably some knowledge of SEM and DualBeam as well), and passion about the fields of electron microscopy and materials science

• Strong background in materials science research, academic or industrial, or good understanding of a range of materials science customer applications, and experience interacting with industrial or academic scientists and researchers

• A university degree or equivalent, preferably a PhD or similar research experience in the field of materials science, metallurgy, electron microscopy, nanotechnology or engineering.

• Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, (primarily in English, but other languages welcome) including the ability to explain technical concepts, workflows and applications clearly to a range of audiences, to gain trust, to influence and persuade others, to present at conferences, to work well in teams, and to listen and understand customer needs.

• Ability to achieve results and work to agreed timelines.

• Be able to produce and implement new ideas, and to see new opportunities and realize them.

• Good judgement and decision-making skills.

• Enthusiasm to work within a diverse, cross-functional team across multiple sites

• A high level of integrity and a desire to improve customer outcomes and achieve customer satisfaction

• Ability to travel up to 50-75% within assigned territory, mainly within SEA and some APAC regions

What do we expect of you?

Reporting into the Director of Food & Beverages, you ensure that Mondrian guests have exceptional entertainment experiences. You are responsible for the day-to-day management of performers, musicians, and other entertainers and works closely with these artists to ensure that they are well prepared for their performances and appearances.

description:
The Singapore Baseball & Softball Association (SBSA) is seeking an organised and proactive individual to support our Baseball national team programmes and deliver tournaments and events. You will work closely with coaches, athletes, team managers and partners to help create the conditions for our teams to train, compete and improve.

Key Responsibilities

High Performance Operations

- Coordinate training and competition activities for national and age-group baseball teams.

- Arrange training venues, equipment, friendly matches and athlete support services.

- Manage competition entries, athlete registrations, accreditation and selection administration.

- Coordinate approved overseas travel, accommodation, insurance and team logistics.

- Maintain athlete and programme records, and support coaches’ post-competition reviews.

- Work with the Pathway Manager to support athlete progression into national squads.

Tournaments and Events

- Plan and deliver assigned baseball competitions and SBSA events.

- Coordinate schedules, venues, officials, volunteers, equipment and communications.

- Support competition compliance, safety arrangements and post-event reviews.

- Assist with facility readiness, equipment inventories and maintenance coordination at the National Training Centre.

Administration and Stakeholder Coordination

- Prepare activity budgets, track expenditure and process procurement and claims with Finance.

- Support grant applications, athlete assistance submissions and programme reporting.

- Liaise with coaches, athletes, parents, clubs, schools, committees and external partners.

- Provide regular progress updates and follow through on outstanding actions.

- Apply SBSA’s policies on safeguarding, athlete conduct, travel and financial approvals.

What We Are Looking For

- A diploma in sport management, business, events or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

- Experience in sports administration, team operations or event delivery will be an advantage.

- Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage several activities and deadlines.

- Clear communication skills and confidence working with athletes, coaches, parents and partners.

- Sound administrative skills, including spreadsheets, budget tracking and record keeping.

- A proactive, dependable approach and willingness to support practical work on the ground.

- An interest in athlete development and high performance sport. Knowledge of baseball or softball is an advantage.

- Willingness to work evenings and weekends, and travel overseas when required.

*No prior experience in Baseball is required.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV to

gm@sbsa.org.sg

and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience, expected salary and availability.

The

Singapore Baseball & Softball Association (SBSA)

is the National Sports Association responsible for the development, governance, and promotion of baseball and softball in Singapore.

With a history spanning several decades, SBSA has been instrumental in building the sport from grassroots participation to national representation. Over the past 20 years, our national teams have competed consistently at regional and international levels, supported by structured high-performance programmes and strong partnerships with organisations such as Sport Singapore and the High Performance Sports Institute.

SBSA oversees national leagues, tournaments, and athlete development pathways, while working closely with schools and the wider community to grow the sport. We are committed to strengthening Singapore’s baseball and softball ecosystem and achieving sustained high-performance success.

title: Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships & Fundraising
description:
ABOUT EQUAL

EQUAL is an IPC-registered charity that delivers equine-assisted and animal-assisted services to support the mental and emotional wellbeing of children, youth, seniors, families, and communities. Our work sits at the intersection of human wellbeing, animal welfare, and experiential learning, and is delivered through a multidisciplinary team of programme professionals, equine specialists, operations staff, and volunteers. Fundraising is mission-critical to EQUAL’s ability to deliver safe, high-quality, and impactful programmes. As the organisation scales, EQUAL is strengthening its fundraising infrastructure, pipeline discipline, and stewardship capability to support sustainable growth.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships & Fundraising is responsible for developing and securing corporate, philanthropic and institutional funding partnerships that support EQUAL's programmes and long-term sustainability.

The role takes ownership of assigned funding opportunities and works closely with the CEO and Board on major donor relationships and strategic partnerships.

The Senior Manager works within EQUAL's partnerships and fundraising function, supported by a Manager, Partnerships & Development and a Digital Marketing Consultant.

The Senior Manager focuses on revenue generation and relationship development, with administrative, stewardship, communications and grant-related support from relevant colleagues.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Success will be measured through fundraising results, partnership development and the strength of the funding pipeline.

Success will be measured through:

Revenue generation: Delivering agreed annual fundraising targets through directly managed and collaborative funding opportunities.

New partnerships: Securing new corporate, philanthropic and institutional funding partners.

Pipeline development: Building, managing and converting qualified funding opportunities.

Partner retention and growth: Developing repeat and multi-year funding from assigned partners.

Strategic contribution: Supporting CEO- and Board-led major donor engagements and fundraising initiatives.

Annual revenue targets, individual responsibilities and performance milestones will be agreed with the CEO, taking into account organisational priorities, existing funding opportunities and available resources.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (6-12 month horizon)

Understand EQUAL's fundraising priorities, existing partners and funding pipeline.

Build and actively manage a qualified pipeline of new opportunities.

Progress priority prospects and convert funding opportunities where feasible.

Deliver against agreed revenue and pipeline targets.

Convert qualified opportunities into funded partnerships.

Develop repeat and multi-year funding opportunities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Strategic Partnerships & Funding Development

Lead assigned corporate, philanthropic and institutional funding opportunities from prospect identification through to funding commitments and partnership growth.

Responsibilities include:

Identify and cultivate corporate partners, family offices, foundations and private donors aligned with EQUAL's mission.

Develop tailored funding proposals, sponsorship packages and CSR partnership opportunities.

Lead partnership discussions and funding negotiations for assigned opportunities.

Secure programme funding, sponsorships, multi-year commitments and strategic partnerships.

2. Partnership Pipeline Development

Build and manage a qualified partnership pipeline, ensuring opportunities are prioritised, actively progressed and accurately tracked.

Responsibilities include:

Identify and qualify new funding prospects.

Maintain clear opportunity ownership, funding potential, priorities and next steps.

Prepare donor briefings and ensure timely follow-up after meetings.

Review pipeline progress and revenue forecasts regularly with the CEO, supported by accurate CRM records.

3. Strategic Fundraising Campaigns & Initiatives

Develop funding and partnership opportunities that support EQUAL's key campaigns and fundraising initiatives.

Responsibilities include:

Secure sponsorships and partner funding for agreed fundraising campaigns and events.

Work with internal teams to develop funding propositions aligned with programme needs and impact.

Develop corporate engagement opportunities that support longer-term partnerships.

4. Major Donor & High-Value Partnerships

Work closely with the CEO and, where appropriate, Board members to develop and progress major donor relationships and high-value funding opportunities.

Responsibilities include:

Develop proposals, briefing materials and funding recommendations for major donor engagements.

Support relationship cultivation, strategic partnership discussions and multi-year funding opportunities.

Coordinate follow-up and progression of CEO- and Board-led funding opportunities.

The CEO typically leads selected major donor relationships, with Board involvement where appropriate. The Senior Manager's responsibilities for these opportunities will be agreed with the CEO.

5. Fundraising Events & Donor Engagement

Support EQUAL's major fundraising events and donor engagement activities, with a primary focus on securing sponsorships, funding partnerships and building donor relationships.

Responsibilities include:

Securing sponsorships and funding partnerships for key events and initiatives.

Engaging prospective donors through events, programme visits and other engagement activities.

Following up with prospects and partners to develop longer-term funding relationships.

Working collaboratively with colleagues to support the planning and delivery of major organisational events.\

Event planning and delivery are shared responsibilities across relevant teams, with the Senior Manager contributing as part of the broader organisational effort.

ROLE ACCOUNTABILITY & ORGANISATIONAL SUPPORT

The Senior Manager is accountable for developing and converting assigned funding opportunities, delivering agreed revenue and pipeline targets, and contributing to EQUAL's broader fundraising efforts.

The role is supported by:

CEO

: Leads selected major donor relationships and supports senior-level strategic partnership engagements.

Board and Fundraising Committee

: Strategic guidance and participation in selected donor engagements, where appropriate.

Manager, Partnerships & Development

: Partnership/key event coordination, donor stewardship, CRM administration and fundraising documentation.

Digital Marketing Consultant

: Communications and digital marketing support for agreed fundraising campaigns and partnership initiatives.

Programmes and Services teams

: Programme information, impact data and coordination support for agreed donor engagements.

The Senior Manager's primary focus is fundraising and partnership development, supported by colleagues in areas such as grant reporting, CRM administration, donor stewardship and communications. As part of EQUAL's collaborative working culture, the role also contributes to major organisational events and initiatives where crossteam support is required.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

Substantial relevant experience, typically 8 years or more, in fundraising, strategic partnerships, business development or corporate engagement.

Demonstrated success in originating, developing and converting funding or commercial partnerships, with clear accountability for individual contributions and results.

Experience engaging senior corporate leaders, donors or institutional stakeholders.

Experience in nonprofit fundraising, major gifts or CSR partnerships is an advantage.

Core Competencies

Strong relationship-building and senior stakeholder engagement capabilities.

Proven ability to develop, manage and convert partnership opportunities.

Strong proposal development, negotiation and communication skills.

Sound commercial judgement and ability to prioritise opportunities.

Strategic thinking combined with disciplined, hands-on execution.

Key Attributes

Proactive and outcome-driven

Professional and credible with senior stakeholders

Highly organised and disciplined in follow-through

Comfortable operating in a lean team with shared responsibilities

Motivated by mission and impact

WHY JOIN US?

Make a tangible impact in a mission-driven team, grow across operations and systems, and work in a unique, nature-rich environment with meaningful outcomes.

HOW TO APPLY

Please email your updated CV and a short cover letter to

pradeep.thevar@equal.org.sg

with the subject line “Partnership & Development – Your Name”.

Founded in 2015, EQUAL (an IPC charity) strives to transform lives through Animal-Assisted Services. EQUAL partners with animals to provide experiential and educational programmes that help empower vulnerable persons such as children, youths, persons with special needs, families and seniors by enhancing their social and emotional well-being and supporting social integration in a safe environment — building resilience and inclusive communities.

The Mechanobiology Institute (MBI) at the National University of Singapore (NUS) is a leading multi-disciplinary institute devoted to developing new paradigms for understanding biological functions in health and diseases from the perspective of cell, tissue and organ mechanics/dynamics and mechano-signal transduction. The institute operates on a fully integrated open-lab philosophy, with an extensive infrastructure supported by core facilities dedicated to technology such as state-of-the-art light microscopy, nano- and micro- fabrication, and computing.

The MBI seeks a dynamic and organized individual to join our administrative team and ensure the seamless management of institute communications and events. As a Communications and Events Associate, you will have a critical role in planning, managing and overseeing communications for the institute and general administration of MBI events. You will work closely with faculty, staff, and external partners to ensure everything runs smoothly from conception to completion.

Communications

Manage and coordinate MBI internal and external communications, including but not limited to email dissemination, website updates, and social media
Maintain and update mailing lists
Update and maintain event listings on the MBI website and other platforms as required

Events

Coordinate and execute a diverse range of regularly scheduled MBI events, such as seminars, invited talks, and outreach visits
Research and coordinate travel arrangements for invited speakers, including bookings and event logistics
Provide day-to-day administrative support including meeting logistics, room bookings, file management, and archiving
Monitor and manage inventory of outreach materials, organise events catering, and liaise with vendors for procurement, production and timely delivery of requisitions
Assist the MBI conference secretariat in the organisation of MBI conferences or symposiums

The role acts as an internal concierge-style support for the Members Services team across locations. It requires a hands-on and service-oriented approach, with the confidence to contact hotels, restaurants, partners, Members’ assistants and internal teams directly, including by phone, to clarify information, resolve issues and secure timely solutions.

*KEY RESPONSIBLITIES*

*Administrative support for Member events:*

* Coordinate invitation follow-up and maintain accurate RSVP and attendance information in Salesforce or any successor tool.
* Proactively follow up with MSMs, LCFAs, Members or their assistants to collect guest names, dietary requirements, hotel details and any information required for the event.
* Prepare and update guest lists, attendance trackers (dinners and side activities), table plans and other event administration documents.
* Prepare programmes and communications with practical information to participants and keep clear records of communications and confirmations.
* Manage programme changes and circulate daily or ad hoc updates to relevant stakeholders and participants.

*Travel, hospitality and booking coordination:*

* Manage hotel bookings with partners, including rooming lists follow-up, confirmations, changes, cancellations and special requests.
* Coordinate restaurant bookings and hospitality arrangements linked to Member events, trips and programmes.
* Arrange and follow up on side activities, transfers and other travel-related services with providers and participants.
* Handle last-minute changes calmly and proactively, escalating only when a decision, exception or approval is required.

*Invoicing, payment and administrative control:*

* Prepare, consolidate and check the information required for event and trip invoicing
* Coordinate invoicing follow-up for participation fees, side activities and extra guests, and maintain visibility on pending items.
* Follow up on deposits, payments, supporting documents and discrepancies with MSMs.
* Ensure event references, participant numbers, pricing information and supporting documentation are accurate and traceable.
* Maintain orderly digital files and trackers so that the status of each booking, payment and open point can be understood quickly.

*Internal coordination and service delivery:*

* Work closely with MSMs, LCFAs, Event and Finance Teams to ensure smooth administrative delivery before, during and after events.
* Provide regular and concise status updates, highlighting missing information, deadlines, risks and actions required.
* Take ownership of follow-up: contact the right person, obtain the answer and close the loop rather than simply forwarding a request.

*KEY DELIVERABLES:*

* Accurate and up-to-date RSVP, guest, dietary, hotel and activity trackers.
* Confirmed and documented hotel, restaurant, transfer and side-activity bookings.
* Complete invoicing instructions and reliable payment follow-up.
* Clear programme communications and controlled management of changes.
* Well-maintained event files, checklists and post-event administrative closure.
* Proactive reporting on deadlines, missing inputs, risks and unresolved items.

_It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties or skills required. Responsibilities may evolve according to business needs, regional activity and the development of the function during the fixed-term assignment ending on 30 June 2027._

*KEY SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS*

*Professional Experience*: Approximately 2–5 years in administrative coordination, events, travel, hospitality, executive assistance, customer service or another fast-moving service environment. A varied or non-linear career path may be considered where the candidate demonstrates strong potential.

*Proactivity and Resourcefulness*: Willing to take initiative, make direct contact and find practical solutions to move matters forward.

*Organization and Attention to Detail*: Able to manage multiple events, deadlines, bookings and changing priorities with accuracy.

*Service Orientation and Relationship Skills*: Discreet, thoughtful and reliable when supporting internal teams, Members, assistants and external partners.

*Communication*: Confident and courteous in writing, by phone and in person with a wide range of stakeholders.

*Problem-Solving:* Calm under pressure, solution-oriented and able to follow issues through to resolution.

*Tools: *Good command of Microsoft Office and confidence learning CRM, ERP, event and collaboration tools.

* *Language Proficiency: *Fluent professional English and Mandarin, written and spoken, to communicate with the internal and external stakeholders.

Events Executive (Activations Executive)

About Association of Advertising & Marketing Singapore (AAMS)

Association of Advertising & Marketing Singapore (AAMS) is a non-profit trade association and professional body representing all aspects of Advertising, Marketing, Media, and Communications. We work closely with partners, members, and stakeholders towards excellence in the Admarcom industry. Effie Singapore Awards

GONG Awards

Crowbar Awards

Hall of Fame

NexGen Awards

Industry conferences

Membership events

About the Role

Ensure events are delivered according to operational timelines.

title: EOI: Facilities Coordinator
description:
About CBRE
CBRE is the world’s leading and largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, servicing more than 90% of the Fortune 100. Through our Global Workplace Solutions (GWS) business, we deliver integrated facilities and workplace services that create exceptional outcomes for our clients and people.

About the Role
As a Facilities Coordinator (Events) you will play a highly visible, hands-on role in shaping the day-to-day workplace experience. Your core focus will be supporting soft services operations and workplace coordination to ensure the office runs smoothly and efficiently.

In addition, you will provide events coordination support on an as-needed basis, assisting with corporate events and conferences when required. This is not a full-time events role, but an add-on responsibility that supports business needs as they arise.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being on the move, working closely with people, solving problems in real time, and taking pride in delivering consistently high service standards. Your presence, attention to detail, and proactive mindset will directly impact user satisfaction and how the workplace is experienced every day.

What You’ll Do

Generate, track, and maintain reports related to meeting rooms, events, and calls as required.
Manage general administrative and soft services operations such as janitorial services and other assigned services.
Conduct daily office inspections to ensure facilities, front office, lobby areas, and office equipment are fully operational and well maintained.
Ensure day-to-day operational excellence for sites under your coordination, meeting agreed SLAs and KPIs for self-service requests and helpdesk support.
Support asset and inventory management, ensuring critical items are tracked, available, and properly documented.
Provide day-to-day operational management of vendors, ensuring timely response within SLA, no downtime for critical services, and effective handling of escalated customer complaints.
Ensure all facilities-related documentation is properly filed, maintained, and inventoried at site.
Coordinate and oversee pantry supplies, stationery, and first aid items replenishment, working with housekeeping to ensure pantry and vending machines are consistently stocked.
Ensure employee services are delivered in line with customer expectations and within SLAs and KPIs, obtaining necessary approvals for any ad-hoc or special requests prior to implementation.
Support finance-related activities by verifying vendor invoices, goods receipts (GR), and payment documentation, and assisting with the issuance of purchase orders for ad-hoc requirements.
Assist in the preparation of reports and operational analysis as needed.
Follow all department policies, procedures, and service standards.
Actively participate in annual and site-wide activities such as fire drills, building power shutdowns, and other operational events.
Remain mobile across the workplace, performing daily check-ins around the front office and lobby, identifying issues early, resolving disruptions quickly, and contributing ideas to continuously improve workplace performance and user satisfaction.
Provide ad-hoc coordination support for conferences and large group events when required, assisting across the event lifecycle from initial request through execution and post-event activities.
Liaise with requestors and users to understand event objectives, requirements, and logistical needs, ensuring expectations are clearly defined and supported.
Support meeting room and event space utilisation by assisting with room reservations and space management processes, resolving scheduling conflicts, and coordinating space requirements with stakeholders as needed.
Support day-of event execution when required by coordinating with internal teams and vendors, assisting with last-minute logistics, setup, and smooth delivery.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with vendors, internal teams, and key stakeholders through open communication, collaboration, and engagement.
Perform post-event support tasks when applicable, including expense processing, basic event reporting, and assisting with the collection of feedback from requestors.

What You’ll Need

Diploma or Degree in Facilities Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
Experience in facilities operations or soft services roles within an office or corporate environment; exposure to corporate events coordination is an advantage.
Strong coordination and communication skills with the ability to work effectively with users, vendors, and internal teams.
Hands-on, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, onsite role.
Ability to prioritise tasks, respond quickly to issues, and manage multiple activities at the same time.
Basic understanding of SLAs, KPIs, vendor coordination, and invoice processing.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and workplace or facilities management systems.
Physically mobile and comfortable performing regular walkthroughs of office spaces and common areas.
A proactive, service-driven mindset with a natural ability to spot issues and suggest practical solutions.

Why CBRE
At CBRE, we create workplaces where people and businesses thrive. You will be part of a collaborative, professional team that values service excellence, integrity, and continuous improvement. This role offers hands-on experience within a global organisation and the opportunity to contribute directly to workplace performance and employee experience.

Applicant AI Use Disclosure
CBRE values human interaction in understanding each candidate’s experience, skills, and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence tools to make hiring decisions. Candidates are encouraged to disclose any use of AI tools during the application or interview process.

title: Senior Employer Brand & Employee Experience Specialist
description:

WHO YOU ARE

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to work seamlessly with agencies, designers, producers, and internal global teams across multiple time zones.

Communication Skills: Exceptional written, verbal, and visual content development skills.
Proactive Mindset: A self-starter who exercises sound judgment, takes initiative, solves problems creatively, and adapts quickly to changing needs.
