WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

Competitive compensation that may include equity
Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
Flexible paid time off
Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching

Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 "Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product" in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America's Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

description:

Job Description – Workplace Event Lead (IFM - Singapore)

Summary:
Workplace Event Lead duties and responsibilities include leading a team of Workplace Ambassadors, planning, coordinating, and executing workplace events that enhance client’ss employee engagement, foster client’s company culture, and support client’s organization objectives.
This role requires to work closely with Workplace Experience team (Soft-Service), Engineering team, Senior Facilities Manager and the client, contributing to larger workplace & event experience for all offices. While the role requires someone highly proactive and independent, it also requires strong project management skills, creative vision, and the ability to manage multiple events and stakeholders simultaneously while staying within budget.
Responsibilities:
Team Leadership: This role provides direct supervision and mentorship to event ambassadors. Responsibilities include recruiting, hiring, and onboarding event team members, setting clear performance expectations and delegating responsibilities and empowering team members to make decisions, managing workload distribution to optimize team efficiency, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team culture, and conducting regular team meetings to align on priorities and share knowledge.

Event Program Management: Workplace Event Lead oversees the complete portfolio of workplace events across multiple categories and locations. This encompasses managing large-scale corporate events including town halls, leadership summits, and annual celebrations, awards ceremonies, wellness initiatives and health-focused events and cultural celebrations, department workshops, facilitating team-building activities and support community outreach and corporate events.

Budget Management: Managing substantial event budgets for the client is a core responsibility requiring basic financial acumen and strategic resource allocation. This includes developing annual event budgets, allocating resources across event portfolio based on strategic priorities, negotiating favorable vendor, tracking expenses and identifying cost-saving opportunities while maintaining event quality.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management: Success requires effective collaboration with multiple departments and stakeholders throughout the client organization. This includes serving as primary liaison between events team and department stakeholders, collaboration with communications team on event messaging and internal communication, working closely Facilities team on space planning and operational support, coordinating with IT on technology infrastructure, audio-visual needs, and virtual platforms, and building relationships with different site stakeholders for multi-location coordination

Crisis Management & Problem Solving: The ability to manage unexpected challenges and maintain composure under pressure. This includes serving as primary point of escalation for event-related issues and emergencies, making real-time decisions to address logistical challenges and vendor failures, implementing contingency plans for unforeseen circumstances, managing stakeholder expectations during crisis situations with professionalism, maintaining calm and providing clear direction to team members during high-pressure situations.

Health & Safety Management: Ensuring all events meet safety standard, this includes developing comprehensive risk assessment frameworks for all event types, ensuring all vendors compliance with health and safety regulations including food handling, coordinating security requirements for high-profile or large-scale events, managing data privacy and information security for event registrations and attendee data and conducting post-event incident reviews and implementing corrective actions.

Event Planning & Strategy: The Workplace Event Lead develops comprehensive event strategies aligned with client organizational goals and company culture. This includes managing annual event calendars, defining event objectives and success metrics, and researching emerging trends in workplace experiences.

Event Execution & Management: Primary responsibility includes end-to-end management of all workplace events, from commencement to post-event evaluation. This encompasses venue selection, vendor management and relationship building, budget tracking, timeline creation and deadline management, and logistics coordination including catering and audio-visual equipment. The role also involves creating event materials such as invitations and signage, while managing event registration and attendance tracking.

Requirements:
Minimum 3 year of supervisory experience in Soft Facilities Management, Hospitality Management, Marketing & Communications, or related field required
Minimum Diploma Holder in Hospitality Management, Facilities Management, Business Administration or its equivalent
A strong operational mindset with a genuine passion for building meaningful employee experiences
Proven ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities with exceptional attention to detail

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.

About JLL –

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

Ensure brand consistency across platforms and materials

Agency Partnership & Creative Direction

Contribute to the department strategy a creative lens, bringing an external perspective on how peer institutions are evolving their brand presence.
Collaborate with team members and cross-functional departments to align creative direction with strategic goals

What makes you a successful candidate?

8–10 years in brand, creative, or design roles — in-house or senior agency side
Background in financial services, professional services, or institutional organisations strongly preferred — you understand how to brief and direct work that feels right in a regulated, high-trust environment
Proven track record as a sophisticated creative client — experience managing multiple relationships and projects effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Experience operating as a trusted creative advisor to senior stakeholders – diagnosing needs, shaping direction and bringing an outside-in view of how leading institutions are evolving their brand.
Hands-on experience producing a range of collateral and creative outputs – brand identity, events creative, publication, video/ motion content and multi-formal institutional design
History of raising agency output quality through better briefing, sharper creative standards, and informed, constructive feedback

Skills & Attributes

Strong design software skills — fluent in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Familiarity with Figma or Sketch and basic HTML/CSS knowledge, Understanding of UX/UI design and accessibility best practices and comfortable as both strategist and maker: you can write the brief and produce the asset.
Strategic, consultative mindset — sets the creative standard, exercises independent judgment on what 'right' looks like for GIC, and influences rather than simply executes.
Strong stakeholder and project management skills — able to run multiple workstreams concurrently, manage agency and internal timelines across time zones, and land creative ideas in a conservative institutional context without diluting them.
A genuine team player — generous with time and knowledge, supportive of colleagues, and invested in the team's collective success, not just individual output.
Builds strong relationships across a wide range of stakeholders, raising the quality and confidence of everyone they work with.
Strong problem-solver — anticipates, initiates, and resolves issues, and able to pivot in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.
Highly organised — delivers to a high standard under competing deadlines, with a positive, continuous-learning attitude.

Work at the Point of Impact

We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.

At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. https://gic.careers/group/corporate-affairs-communication/

Our PRIME Values
Our PRIME Values

GIC is a values driven organization. GIC’s PRIME Values act as our compass, enabling us to fulfil our fundamental purpose and objectives. It is the foundational bedrock which governs our behaviors, our decision making, and our focus. It informs both our long-term strategy as a firm, and the way we relate to our Client, business partners and employees. PRIME stands for Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence.

title: Marketing Intern
description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

SentinelOne seeks a motivated Marketing Intern to join our team in Singapore, offering an exceptional opportunity to delve into diverse aspects of cybersecurity marketing. In this 3 month internship, you'll immerse yourself in various marketing dimensions, collaborating closely with our seasoned team to learn and shape marketing campaigns, and pioneer innovative initiatives.

Your fresh perspectives and creative ideas will drive us to explore new avenues for engaging with our target audience. Whether brainstorming content ideas, conducting market research, or assisting in executing cutting-edge campaigns, your contributions will be pivotal in driving our brand forward.

Additionally, as cybersecurity continues to be a top priority for organizations worldwide, your role as a Marketing Intern will also intersect with cybersecurity trends. You will have the opportunity to gain insights into the latest cybersecurity threats, technologies, and solutions.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

Assist in the development of local marketing plans and strategies to enhance brand visibility and drive demand generation for SentinelOne.
Support the execution of marketing campaigns, including content creation, social media management, and email marketing.
Support the marketing team in event planning and coordination for webinars, conferences, and other promotional activities.
Assist in the development of marketing materials, presentations, and reports.
Executive pre and post campaign operational support, i.e. open procurement requests, source vendors and suppliers, upload leads lists, support events with onsite tasks, etc.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

Proficient in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Positive attitude, with a willingness to learn and contribute to a collaborative team environment.
Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, or similar tools.
Ability to multitask and prioritise tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Creative, tenacious problem solver with can-do attitude, coachable, with a high willingness to learn and the ability to work under limited supervision.
Eligible to work in Singapore
Professional demeanor at all times.
Support and adhere to SentinelOne's Core Values.
Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

Our global internship program trains the next-generation of cybersecurity talent across a range of specializations, from threat intelligence to information security, engineering and marketing. Interns can learn about the network security industry from leading thinkers, grow their professional networks, and be part of a career-defining experience including:

1:1 mentorship throughout your internship
Hands-on experience with challenging, meaningful projects
Access to training and professional development opportunities
Networking connections with recent graduates and employees across the company
Leadership speaker series featuring senior leaders and industry experts
A fun, engaging workplace with regular team events

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Events, Marketing & Communications Associate (Contract)
description:
About QAI Ventures

QAI Ventures AG is a Swiss-headquartered global venture capital firm and ecosystem platform investing in Quantum Tech and Enabling Technologies across the advanced computing value chain. Operating at pre-seed through Series C, QAI uniquely combines a VC fund, accelerator programs (Switzerland, Singapore, Canada), and a corporate innovation offering.

Our Singapore office is a hub for the APAC region, running accelerator cohorts, building early-stage ventures, and engaging the region's deep tech ecosystem. This internship sits at the center of those activities.

The Role

This is a hands-on, high-impact associate role on contract basis for a recent graduate who wants to gain real experience at the intersection of deep tech, startup programs, and strategic communications. You will work directly with the QAI Ventures Singapore team to drive events, marketing, and communications for QAI as a firm and the early-stage ventures we build and support.

You will contribute meaningfully from day one: producing content, coordinating events, shaping brand narratives, and helping portfolio ventures establish their market presence. This role carries genuine responsibility and offers direct exposure to founders, investors, and the regional deep tech ecosystem.

Tasks

Key Responsibilities

EVENTS & COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT

Plan, coordinate, and execute QAI Ventures Singapore events, including accelerator showcases, investor briefings, ecosystem meetups, and participation in regional conferences.
Manage end-to-end event logistics: venue sourcing, speaker coordination, guest communications, on-site delivery, cost tracking, vendor negotiations, and post-event follow-up.
Support QAI's presence at APAC deep tech and innovation events, including preparation of materials and briefings for the team.
Build and maintain relationships with event partners, venues, and co-organizers across the Singapore and APAC ecosystem.

MARKETING & BRAND

Support the implementation of QAI's marketing strategy for Singapore and the APAC region, in coordination with the Global CMO based in Europe, to ensure consistent QAI branding and communications.
Manage and grow QAI Singapore's social media presence (primarily LinkedIn), including content planning, drafting, scheduling, and performance tracking.
Maintain and update the QAI Singapore website and local marketing materials to ensure alignment with global brand standards.
Coordinate with local agencies and freelancers on design, content, and campaign execution.
Contribute to building marketing infrastructure for portfolio ventures: website content logic, messaging frameworks, and brand foundations.
Help develop positioning and value propositions for early-stage deep tech ventures, translating complex quantum and AI technologies into clear, compelling narratives for customers, partners, and investors.
Create and adapt central marketing and communication materials for ventures and for QAI Singapore.
Track and report on marketing KPIs, generating qualified applications for programs and pipeline for partnerships.

COMMUNICATIONS & CONTENT

Draft and edit external communications including newsletters, program announcements, and ecosystem updates.
Support the development of pitch narratives and investor storylines for portfolio ventures.
Produce compelling content that communicates QAI's investment thesis and portfolio activity across written, digital, and event formats.
Ensure consistent tone, messaging, and brand voice across all QAI Singapore communications.
Assist in generating qualified applications for QAI's accelerator programs through targeted outreach and content campaigns.
Requirements

What We're Looking For

REQUIRED

Recent graduate (BA, MA, MBA, or PhD) in marketing, communications, business, technology management, or a related field.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; you write clearly, precisely, and without clutter.
Ability to translate complex or technical subject matter into accessible, compelling narratives for different audiences.
Demonstrated experience in events coordination, content creation, or marketing, through internships, student projects, or independent work.
Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.
Proactive, execution-oriented mindset, comfortable taking ownership and delivering without constant direction.
Based in Singapore.

ADVANTAGEOUS

Familiarity with deep tech, quantum technologies, AI, or advanced computing is not required; intellectual curiosity in these areas is essential.
Experience with social media management tools, CMS platforms, or marketing analytics.
Exposure to the Asian startup or innovation ecosystem.
Experience working in or with early-stage startups, accelerators, or venture capital environments.
Graphic design or multimedia content skills (e.g., Canva, Adobe, video editing).
Benefits

Why join QAI Ventures

You will work alongside founders, venture leads, and investors on some of the most technically ambitious companies being built today. From your first week, you will own deliverables, contribute to strategy, and have direct visibility into how a global deep tech VC operates.

Direct exposure to quantum computing, AI infrastructure, and advanced computing ventures in their earliest, most formative stages.
A seat at the table with QAI's Singapore team, with close collaboration across our global offices in Switzerland and Canada.
Hands-on experience across the full marketing mix, from event production and brand building to venture narrative and growth.
An APAC platform at the frontier of next-generation compute, a field with significant and still-emerging global impact.
Mentorship from experienced venture builders, investors, and operators across QAI's global team.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short cover letter explaining why you are interested in this role and what you would bring to the QAI Ventures Singapore team. Applications should be submitted via the QAI Ventures careers portal on Join.com.

We review applications on a rolling basis - early submissions are encouraged.

The Congress Coordinator works closely with the Congress Project Manager (CPM) and is typically a behind-the-scenes role; however, there may be instances where it makes sense for the Congress Coordinator to interact directly with the client. An example might be that the client requires a complicated web-build and wants to speak to the Congress Coordinator directly or the client requires frequent attendee status updates and wants to communicate with the Congress Coordinator directly. Most of the time, the Congress Coordinator is NOT client facing.

Your responsibilities :

Core Responsibility 1: Meeting Planning

• Ensure all compliance requirements and guidelines are followed and properly documented
• Reconcile meeting in accordance with Client audit standards/maintain an audit ready environment

• Prepare all Printed Material/Communications (Welcome Packet, Front Desk letter, etc.) and ship to congress locations
• Coordinate on-site job responsibilities with on-site logistics team (Dinners, ground, logistics, etc.)

Core Responsibility 3: Technology Tools
• Oversee the creation and sending of registration forms and other communications
• Correctly upload and maintain attendee data required for logistics and reporting
• Review client congress database for accuracy
• Oversee accuracy for all assigned congresses in the technology tool (Cvent)
• Experience using Cvent attendee, hotel, and reporting modules
• Correctly import and maintain attendee data in Cvent
• Keep data and savings information accurate in Cvent at all times
• Ensure internal and external reporting requirements are met accurately and on time
• Create and maintain a master response chart for each assigned congress
• Oversee the creation and sending of final confirmation emails and other communications
• Create shared drive folder for assigned congresses
• Partner with internal planning team members to start Congress Workbook and continually update throughout the planning process
• Oversee the creation and sending/upload of restaurant descriptions and request forms and other pertinent communications, and save in the proper shared drive(s)

• Maintain current records of all communications (i.e. TEF, Country Meal Summary, Manifests, etc.) in the proper shared drive(s)
• Distribute Post Congress Survey through proper technology tool

Core Responsibility 4: Client Communication
• Advise and project manage critical deadlines in planning process
• Overall fiscal responsibility for congress activities
• Consult with Congress Specialist, Sourcing and make appropriate suggestions to ensure congress success regarding proposed hotel blocks. Prepare hotel availability grid with appropriate options in collaboration with internal planning team members.
• Primary client contact with regards to all logistical arrangements surrounding congress.
• Oversight of Client registration and reporting questions.
• Maintain the highest level of quality, professionalism and integrity when negotiating with suppliers.
• Partner with internal planning team members to negotiate all supplier contracts for the best possible prices and concessions in order to meet savings expectation on congress spend.

Other:

Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice or as required by local regulations.

About the Role:

Conference Services Manager

Bring Every Detail Together. Create Experiences That Matter.

As a Conference Services Manager, you will be the key link between our clients and the hotel, transforming event plans into seamless, memorable experiences.

From executive meetings and conferences to social celebrations and bespoke events, you will take ownership of the planning and coordination journey, ensuring every detail is thoughtfully considered and every team is aligned. You will work closely with clients to understand their vision, anticipate their needs and bring their expectations to life with care and precision.

Working across Catering, Food & Beverage, Culinary and other hotel departments, you will orchestrate the details that allow every event to feel effortless for our guests.

This role is ideal for a hospitality professional who thrives on ownership, enjoys bringing people and details together, and takes pride in creating experiences that leave a lasting impression.

What you will do:

Take ownership of the end-to-end conference servicing journey, from event handover and planning through to execution and post-event follow-up.

Build strong relationships with clients, understanding their objectives, preferences and expectations to create a personalised event experience.

Conduct planning meetings, site inspections and pre-event discussions to ensure every detail is understood and thoughtfully coordinated.

Prepare and manage Banquet Event Orders (BEOs) and ensure all event information is accurate, clear and communicated to the relevant teams.

Coordinate closely with Food & Beverage, Culinary, Engineering, Housekeeping, Front Office and other departments to ensure seamless event execution.

Lead event briefings and communicate key requirements, timelines, VIP details and special arrangements to all stakeholders.

Be present during events to anticipate needs, resolve challenges and make real-time decisions, ensuring the experience remains seamless from start to finish.

Proactively identify potential gaps or challenges before they arise and put solutions in place to ensure flawless delivery.

Manage last-minute changes and special requests with flexibility and a solutions-focused approach.

Follow up with clients after events, gather feedback and identify opportunities to further elevate the guest experience.

Maintain accurate event records, schedules and relevant systems to ensure effective communication and operational continuity.

Support the team in identifying opportunities to improve processes, enhance service delivery and elevate the overall conference experience and future business partnerships.

Lead by example and contribute to a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement.

What You Bring:

Bachelor’s Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Events, Business or a related discipline.

Relevant experience in Conference Services, Catering, Banquets, Events or luxury hospitality.

Strong understanding of event planning, conference operations and the end-to-end guest journey.

Exceptional organisational skills and a meticulous eye for detail, with the ability to manage multiple events and priorities simultaneously.

Confident communicator who can build strong relationships with clients and effectively influence and coordinate across departments.

Proactive mindset with the ability to anticipate needs.

Strong ownership and accountability

Team player who enjoys bringing people together and creating alignment across different functions.

Passion for creating seamless, personalised and memorable experiences for guests and clients.

A growth mindset, curiosity and ambition to develop further within luxury hospitality.

What We Offer:

A culture built on mutual respect, offering a growing world of opportunities and an environment that supports the pursuit of excellence.

Career growth opportunities.

A strong, unique culture.

Best-in-industry training.

Complimentary stays at Four Seasons properties (subject to availability), with discounted meals.

Paid holidays/vacation.

Dental, medical, and life insurance.

Employee service awards/Birthday Gift.

Annual employee party/social and sporting events.

Complimentary meals in a dedicated employee restaurant.

Schedule & Hours: This position requires one to work from Mondays to Fridays, 8.30 am to 6.00 pm, with the flexibility to work weekends and public holidays as business needs arise.
